orphan-billionaire.title: Orphan Billionaire
orphan-billionaire.description: When a billionaire CEO goes undercover to find a love that isn't bought, he is thrust into a nightmare of classist humiliation and betrayal; now, he must decide if the woman who defended his honor is worthy of the truth, or if his quest for vengeance will destroy the only heart that ever beat for him.

mandi-ka-badshah.title: Mandi Ka Badshah
mandi-ka-badshah.description: Wrongly jailed for three years, Aman Verma returns to his Varanasi mohalla, where neighbours openly brand him a counterfeit medicine dealer. His family shop, Verma Medicos, is chained shut under a cracked red government seal. In the attached quarters, he bends to touch his ailing father Om Prakash's feet. Om Prakash recoils, reveals Aman's mother died of grief while he was in jail, and throws him out onto the street.

the-warlords-revenge.title: The Warlord's Revenge
the-warlords-revenge.description: In a war-torn kingdom consumed by corruption, famine, and invading forces, Xu Mu, a powerful and strategic commander, is determined to save the collapsing Da Ji Empire. Forced to deal with a corrupt Prime Minister who controls the court, Xu Mu secretly joins forces with loyal generals and soldiers to overthrow the traitors.

lady-dhurandhar-kaali.title: Lady Dhurandhar- Kaali
lady-dhurandhar-kaali.description: After her legendary commander dies taking a sniper shot meant for her, an erased black-ops operative works as a silent academy cleaner to protect his paralyzed son from a ruthless private military tycoon, forcing her to unleash her lethal skills when his family and academy face total destruction.

the-pregnant-king.title: The Pregnant King
the-pregnant-king.description: After insulting Ardhanarishvara, a ruthless king is cursed with an impossible pregnancy, forcing him to discover that true strength lies not in power, but in love and sacrifice.

cold-war-1.title: Cold War
cold-war-1.description: When a successful businessman gifts his middle-class housing society a central AC system, the greedy residents demand he pay their electricity bills too; but when he tears the system down in Delhi's brutal 45°C summer, a manipulative gold-digger and a toxic community leader try to ruin him, forcing him to fight for his dignity and the quiet woman who truly saved his family.

pilot-bachha.title: Pilot Bachha
pilot-bachha.description:
Celebrated pilot Arjun dies and gets one chance to return to the 2026 plane crash that killed his parents.
Back in his 8-year-old body, he finds himself aboard the same doomed flight.
Using the skills of his past life, he must save 147 passengers against impossible odds.
This time, Arjun is determined to rewrite destiny and save his family.

bhediya-ka-pyaar.title: Bhediye Ka Pyaar
bhediya-ka-pyaar.description:
In 2040 Varanasi, cursed werewolf king Bhanu Pratap must find his destined soulmate before his 30th birthday—or die.  
He finds Priya, an ordinary human whose mysterious moon mark can save him, but their union could cost her life.  
What begins as a desperate bargain turns into a forbidden love that threatens Bhanu’s bloodline, his throne, and the life of their extraordinary hybrid child.

mummy-by-mistake.title: Mummy by Mistake
mummy-by-mistake.description: When modern-day agent Ji Mia wakes up inside a novel, she finds herself trapped as the cruel stepmother of three children destined to become feared villains. Determined to change their fate, she protects the children, saves their father Pei Yuan, and slowly turns a broken family into one bound by love. But every change to the story puts them in greater danger. As Ji Mia rewrites their destiny, she must decide whether the life she entered by mistake is the life she was meant to keep

coolie-aur-crorepati-dulhan.title: Coolie Aur Crorepati Dulhan
coolie-aur-crorepati-dulhan.description: Billionaire heir Aryan Roy escapes his powerful family by disguising himself as a railway coolie, only to cross paths with runaway bride Aarohi, who is being forced to marry Danish for a business deal. Their pretend marriage slowly turns into real love as Aryan risks everything to protect her from Danish and her status-obsessed family. While everyone mocks him as a poor coolie, Aryan hides a shocking truth—he is heir to one of the world’s biggest diamond empires.

14d84498-b87d-4c9c-9385-d32f48a2c3f5.title: Mechanic Annayya 2.0
14d84498-b87d-4c9c-9385-d32f48a2c3f5.description: A simple mechanic by appearance, he quietly watches as his sister is humiliated by powerful elites. What nobody knows is that beneath the grease-stained clothes hides one of the most influential men in the world. When his sister’s dignity is destroyed, he unleashes a ruthless takedown that exposes the true difference between wealth, power, and respect.

jai-loue-le-petit-ami-parfait.title: J’ai Loué le Petit Ami Parfait
jai-loue-le-petit-ami-parfait.description: Fatiguée d’être la déception de sa famille, Natalie engage Noah pour jouer le rôle du petit ami parfait et l’aider à récupérer sa chère maison au bord du lac. Mais leurs faux baisers éveillent de vrais sentiments. Entre les manigances de sa famille et le mystérieux lien de Noah avec son passé, leur contrat devient un combat pour l’héritage de Natalie, sa confiance en elle et un amour qui n’aurait jamais dû être réel.

never-a-doormat-always-the-master.title: Never a Doormat, Always the Master
never-a-doormat-always-the-master.description: Li Muchen, a powerful young master raised in the mountains, descends into the city to fulfill his grandfather’s wishes and settle an old marriage arrangement with the wealthy Lin family. But when Lin Manqing’s family humiliates him and tries to buy him off, they have no idea who they’ve just offended. As enemies close in and hidden powers emerge, Li Muchen must protect the woman who was meant to become his fiancée while uncovering the secrets threatening the Lin family.

the-blackwood-creek.title: The Blackwood Creek
the-blackwood-creek.description: To cure his paralyzed wife Penelope, a guilt-ridden man moves her to a strange town with one rule: never look outside during the 3:03 AM whistling. But his guilt makes him break the rule, turning her cure into a rotting nightmare.

married-my-exs-billionaire-rival-1.title: Married My Ex's Billionaire Rival
married-my-exs-billionaire-rival-1.description: Betrayed by her boyfriend and her own sister, Emma loses everything—including her place in the family she once trusted. With nowhere to turn, she makes an unexpected deal: marry Dylan Hayes, the billionaire rival her ex fears most. What begins as a marriage of convenience soon pulls her into a dangerous battle over family, fortune, and legacy. But as Emma and Dylan fight side by side, revenge begins to blur into something neither of them expected—real love.

the-penitent-blade.title: The Penitent Blade
the-penitent-blade.description: Blind and condemned to die, Caleb Brand survives a cursed iron coffin no man has walked out of, and wakes up bound to it forever, blood and warmth draining away for a killer's thermal sight. Now the church's disposable weapon, he hunts the truth behind his sister's execution: a holy empire built on manufactured plague and innocent ashes. With the medic he loves fighting beside him, Caleb turns his captors' blade against them, before the fire takes everything else he loves.

novio-de-alquiler.title: Novio de Alquiler
novio-de-alquiler.description: Cansada de ser la decepción de su familia, Natalie contrata a Noah, un encantador novio de alquiler, para fingir la relación perfecta y quedarse con la casa del lago que tanto ama. Pero cuando los besos falsos despiertan sentimientos reales, el sabotaje familiar y la misteriosa conexión de Noah con su pasado amenazan con destruirlo todo. Lo que comenzó como un contrato se convierte en una lucha por su herencia, su dignidad y un amor inesperado.

english-bol-daal.title: English Bol Daal
english-bol-daal.description: When Yuvaan’s sister Pihu disappears, he vows to find her—even if it means learning English and going to America. But his journey with an English teacher uncovers a dangerous kidnapping network that may be behind Pihu’s disappearance.

triplets-one-billionaire-pilot-one-secre.title: Triplets, One billionaire pilot, One secret
triplets-one-billionaire-pilot-one-secre.description: An air hostess bound by a secret heir-provision contract to a billionaire pilot to pay her mother's medical bills must survive high-altitude sabotage from his predatory family, while a magical pain-sharing link forces the pilot to feel her triplet pregnancy symptoms during flight operations.

the-real-deal-1.title: The Real Deal
the-real-deal-1.description: A feared ex-convict returns after a decade in prison to save his estranged daughter from a life of abuse, but as he battles her tormentors, he must also overcome her hatred and the haunting consequences of his own violent past.

prema-khaidi-1.title: Prema Khaidi
prema-khaidi-1.description:
A wedding turns tragic when the bride's father accidentally injures the groom's mother.
Blinded by anger, the groom's love turns into hatred, and he pushes his wife away.
As she battles illness and heartbreak, fate drives them even further apart.
They reunite when she loses her memory, giving him a second chance to make things right.

Through love, forgiveness, and redemption, he wins her back, and together they begin a new chapter in their lives.

minha-mae-e-a-chefona-da-mafia.title: Minha Mãe é a Chefona da Máfia
minha-mae-e-a-chefona-da-mafia.description: Após a morte do marido, Samantha Moretti deixa para trás sua poderosa família criminosa para dar à filha, Allison, uma vida normal. Mas, quando Allison se torna alvo de Dave Donovan, um implacável chefe do crime, e é sequestrada repetidas vezes, Sam precisa voltar a ser a guerreira que um dia foi. Ao retomar o controle do império Moretti, ela declara guerra a Donovan para destruí-lo — correndo o risco de se tornar o monstro do qual tentou fugir.

完璧な彼氏をレンタルしたら.title: 完璧な彼氏をレンタルしたら
完璧な彼氏をレンタルしたら.slug: 完璧な彼氏をレンタルしたら
完璧な彼氏をレンタルしたら.description: 家族から失望され続けてきたナタリーは、大切な湖畔の家を手に入れるため、魅力的なノアを“レンタル彼氏”として雇い、完璧な恋人同士を演じる。しかし偽りのキスはやがて本物の恋へ。家族の妨害が激しくなる中、ノアと彼女の過去をつなぐ秘密まで明らかになる。契約から始まった関係は、遺産と自分の未来、そして本物の愛を守るための戦いへと変わっていく。
完璧な彼氏をレンタルしたら.url: https://kukutv.app/show/完璧な彼氏をレンタルしたら

the-last-oath.title: The Last Oath
the-last-oath.description: Immortal Taoist Li Qing has witnessed decades of Ming Dynasty turmoil and now serves under Emperor Yongle. As Yongle strengthens the empire through trade, industry, military expansion, and political reforms, Li Qing becomes deeply involved in shaping the future of the dynasty. Meanwhile, a fierce succession struggle grows among Yongle’s three sons, threatening to repeat the bloodshed of the past.

落ちこぼれ魔術師、実は魂喰らいでした.title: 落ちこぼれ魔術師、実は魂喰らいでした
落ちこぼれ魔術師、実は魂喰らいでした.slug: 落ちこぼれ魔術師、実は魂喰らいでした
落ちこぼれ魔術師、実は魂喰らいでした.description: 魔法を持たない“落ちこぼれ”として育ったイーサン。しかし18歳の夜、封印が解け、彼の正体が魔力も魂も記憶さえも喰らう禁断の存在「魂喰らい」だと判明する。魔法学院で最強の決闘士ヴァイオレットと組まされた彼は、怪物を倒した瞬間、その魂を吸収してしまう。秘密を知った彼女は、イーサンを守るか、魔法界の掟に従い彼を滅ぼすか、究極の選択を迫られる。
落ちこぼれ魔術師、実は魂喰らいでした.url: https://kukutv.app/show/落ちこぼれ魔術師、実は魂喰らいでした

ma-mere-est-la-reine-de-la-mafia.title: Ma Mère est la Reine de la Mafia
ma-mere-est-la-reine-de-la-mafia.description: Après la mort de son mari, Samantha Moretti quitte sa puissante famille mafieuse pour offrir une vie normale à sa fille Allison. Mais lorsque le cruel Dave Donovan s’en prend à elle et la kidnappe, Samantha renoue avec son passé. Reprenant le contrôle de l’empire Moretti, elle déclenche une guerre pour détruire Donovan. Mais pour sauver sa fille, elle risque de redevenir le monstre qu’elle avait fui.

school-of-the-dead.title: School Of The Dead
school-of-the-dead.description: Viral fame ke liye Won-mo ek abandoned school mein horror livestream karne gaya tha, lekin wahan uski mulaqat Ju-hyeon ki rooh se hui. Dheere-dheere usne school ke khaufnaak raaz, ek powerful evil spirit aur Ju-hyeon ki dardnaak maut ka sach jaana. Evil spirit se bachne ki koshish mein Won-mo ne Ju-hyeon ko azaad karne ke liye apni jaan tak daav par laga di. Lekin Kya wo apne maksad me kamiyaab ho paaya?

ich-heiratete-den-milliardenschweren-riv.title: Ich heiratete den milliardenschweren Rivalen meine
ich-heiratete-den-milliardenschweren-riv.description: Emmas Leben zerbricht, als sie ihren Verlobten Cody mit ihrer Stiefschwester Sophia erwischt. Doch ihre Stiefmutter stellt Emma als Verräterin dar, woraufhin ihr Vater sie verstößt und enterbt. Ohne alles muss sie neu anfangen. Als ein mächtiger Milliardär an ihre Seite tritt, beginnt Emma ihren Kampf gegen die Familie, die sie zerstört hat – entschlossen, die Wahrheit aufzudecken, ihr Erbe zurückzuholen und sich zu rächen.

bhagwad-geeta-samasyaon-ka-samadhan.title: Bhagwad Geeta : Samasyaon Ka Samadhan
bhagwad-geeta-samasyaon-ka-samadhan.description: Bhagavad Gita’s timeless wisdom comes alive in everyday life as the Sharma family faces modern struggles of relationships, career, fear, failure, and identity—discovering that every problem has a solution when we learn to see life through Krishna’s teachings.

ich-mietete-meinen-perfekten-freund.title: Ich mietete meinen perfekten Freund
ich-mietete-meinen-perfekten-freund.description: Natalie hat es satt, die Enttäuschung ihrer Familie zu sein. Um ihr geliebtes Haus am See zu gewinnen, engagiert sie Noah als perfekten Freund auf Zeit. Doch aus inszenierten Küssen werden echte Gefühle. Während ihre Familie versucht, alles zu sabotieren, droht Noahs geheimnisvolle Verbindung zu ihrer Vergangenheit ihre Beziehung zu zerstören. Aus einem einfachen Vertrag wird ein Kampf um Natalies Erbe, ihren Selbstwert und eine unerwartete Liebe.

the-billionaire-in-disguise.title: The Billionaire in Disguise
the-billionaire-in-disguise.description: Prithviraj Mehta, a powerful billionaire hiding behind a false identity, enters Vaani Kapoor’s life as her quiet protector. As Vaani grows from uncertainty into a strong, confident woman, their bond deepens. But Rajveer, driven by jealousy, ego and obsession, refuses to accept her choice and targets Prithviraj. What begins as a clash of pride soon turns into a dangerous battle of love, loyalty and hidden power.

Die-Rache-der-verstoßenen-Erbin.title: Die Rache der verstoßenen Erbin
Die-Rache-der-verstoßenen-Erbin.description: Nach dem Tod ihres Vaters wird Claire von ihrer Stieffamilie zu einer Scheinehe mit Luke, einem einfachen Fahrer, gezwungen, um ihr Erbe zu verlieren. Während sie die gehorsame Ehefrau spielt, plant sie heimlich ihre Rache. Dann entdeckt Claire, dass Luke in Wahrheit ein zurückgezogen lebender Milliardär ist. Aus ihrer falschen Ehe wird eine mächtige Allianz, mit der sie ihre Familie zu Fall bringen und das Vermächtnis ihres Vaters zurückholen will.

love-emergency-2.title: Love Emergency
love-emergency-2.description: திருமண நாளன்று கணவனும் தோழியும் செய்த துரோகத்தால் நிலைகுலைந்து போகிறாள் தான்வி. அவமானத்தால் மயங்கும் அவளை ரெஹான் என்ற ஆம்புலன்ஸ் ஓட்டுநர் காப்பாற்றுகிறான். துரோகிகளுக்குப் பதிலடி கொடுக்க, உடனே தன்னைத் திருமணம் செய்துகொள்ளுமாறு அவனிடம் கேட்கிறாள். ஆனால், தந்தையிடமிருந்து தப்பி அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து வாழும் ஒரு பெரும் கோடீஸ்வர வாரிசுதான் ரெஹான் என்ற ரகசியம் அவளுக்குத் தெரியாது. விதியின் இந்தத் திருப்பம் அவர்களின் வாழ்க்கையை எங்கு கொண்டு சேர்க்கும்?

married-the-wrong-girl.title: Married The Wrong Girl
married-the-wrong-girl.description: After divorcing his manipulative wife who falsely claimed to be the girl who rescued him in a childhood fire accident to exploit his family trust, a billionaire heir disguised as an ordinary worker tracks down his true, prideful savior—bound by a mutual grandfather pact—only to realize he must win her heart for who he is today, all while his toxic ex-wife schemes to destroy them both.

step-sister-stole-my-diamond-empire.title: Step Sister Stole My Diamond Empire
step-sister-stole-my-diamond-empire.description: They stole her mother's jewelry empire, her name, and her future, then cast her out with nothing. But they forgot the one thing they could never take: her genius for cutting the world's rarest diamonds. Now she returns, allied with a cold, ruthless diamond billionaire who has secrets of his own. Together they set a trap disguised as the most dazzling auction the world has ever seen. But as the bidding begins, a stranger raises a paddle for the final stone.

karnapishachini-the-ear-whisperer.title: Karnapishachini - The Ear Whisperer
karnapishachini-the-ear-whisperer.description: To save his ancestral forest from a ruthless land contractor, a desperate farmer’s son unleashes a whispering demon to destroy his enemies with dark secrets, only to realize he must sacrifice his farmer’s son unleashes a whispering demon to destroy his enemies with dark secrets, only to realize he must sacrifice his fiancée's family to pay the spiritual debt.

sabak.title: Sabak
sabak.description: Dr. Raghunath, a renowned child specialist, races to the hospital to save an 11-year-old girl fighting for her life. However, a minor road accident with wealthy couple Inder and Jasmine turns into a bitter confrontation when they refuse to let him leave until he pays for their luxury car. Unaware that the critically ill child is their own daughter, Jassi, they humiliate and obstruct the doctor while her condition continues to worsen.

the-sea-kings-bride.title: The Sea King's Bride
the-sea-kings-bride.description: Born illegitimate and condemned to a life of humiliation, Sunita finds salvation in Manu—a mysterious slave who is secretly the immortal Sea Prince of Dwarka. But when a divine war turns days apart into ten human years, their love must survive abandonment, jealous gods, stolen memories and monstrous betrayals as Sunita fights across two worlds to reclaim her husband, protect their children, and rise from a rejected mortal to Queen of the Seas.

she-refused-the-don-1.title: She Refused the Don
she-refused-the-don-1.description: After a brave young woman saves the life of Mumbai's most feared gangster, he becomes determined to win her heart. But when her boyfriend betrays her and she is forced into an unwanted marriage, the gangster saves her and makes her his wife—only to discover that winning her love is far more difficult than ruling the underworld.

love-gone-wrong.title: Love Gone Wrong
love-gone-wrong.description: When wealthy businessman Rohan Singh’s jealous fiancée mistakes his vulnerable younger sister Aanya for his mistress, a wedding-day misunderstanding spirals into brutal humiliation, false accusations and a deadly cover-up—forcing Rohan to race against time to save his sister and uncover the truth before it is too late.

cylinder-samrat.title: Cylinder Samrat
cylinder-samrat.description: Vedant, a wealthy petroleum CEO, disguises as a cylinder delivery boy to expose an LPG scam. He marries Meera, a poor girl, in a contract marriage. When she discovers his true identity, she feels betrayed. Forced to marry corrupt MLA Mehta's daughter Riya, Vedant's mother tricks Meera into signing divorce papers. But Meera finds evidence of the MLA's cylinder hoarding scheme and exposes it. She replaces Riya at the wedding; the MLA is arrested. Vedant and Meera's marriage is confirmed.

maaya-machindra.title: Maaya Machindra
maaya-machindra.description: தேவ், ஒரு குணமான உணவக ஊழியன். தான் மிகவும் நம்பிய ஒருவனாலேயே ஒரே இரவில் வேலை, மனைவி, தன்மானம் என அனைத்தையும் இழக்கிறான். தாயின் உயிரைக் காப்பாற்ற வழியின்றி தவிக்கும் அவனை, இந்த உலகம் ஒவ்வொரு அடியிலும் அவமானப்படுத்துகிறது. எதுவுமே இல்லாத நிலைக்குத் தள்ளப்பட்ட தேவ், தன் நம்பிக்கையை மட்டுமே மூலதனமாகக் கொண்டு மீண்டும் பூஜ்ஜியத்திலிருந்து எப்படி உயர்ந்து நிற்கிறான் என்பதன் கதையே இது!

born-to-win.title: Born To Win
born-to-win.description: After being reincarnated into the body of a fallen noble heir, Liang Xiao discovers that his fiancée Nina has fallen for the celebrated General Lingyun. Rather than beg for her love, Liang chooses divorce and starts rebuilding his life on his own terms. As he uncovers the truth behind his family’s downfall and the general’s stolen glory, Liang sets out to reclaim his family’s honor, rise through the ranks, and reshape the empire.

the-dog-date-1.title: The Dog Date
the-dog-date-1.description: Haunted by a forgotten past, billionaire Mayur hides his identity and enters a three-month contract marriage with fearless pet-shop owner Kavya, who is desperate to escape her abusive brother-in-law. As their fake marriage blossoms into real love, buried secrets and a mysterious shared past threaten to tear them apart.

torn-between-brothers.title: Torn Between Brothers
torn-between-brothers.description: To save her framed father from prison, a middle-class girl makes a secret, passionate deal with a cold-hearted business heir, only to find herself caught in a dangerous war of desire when his wild, rebellious younger brother returns to claim her.

dummy-chairman.title: Dummy Chairman
dummy-chairman.description: சுரேஷ், தன் அடையாளத்தை மறைத்த கோடீஸ்வரன். தன் மனைவியிடம் உண்மையைப் மறைத்து வாழும் அவனுக்குத் துரோகமே பரிசாகக் கிடைக்கிறது. அவளுக்காகச் சிறுநீரகத்தையே கொடுத்தும், அவனைப் 'பயனற்றவன்' என இழிவுபடுத்தி பிரான் என்ற கள்ளக்காதலனுடன் கொண்டாடுகிறாள். பிரான் அவளை அடித்துவிட்டு, பழியைச் சுரேஷ் மீது போட்டுச் சிறைக்கு அனுப்புகிறான். கோடீஸ்வரனில் இருந்து சிறை வரை — துரோகமும் பழிவாங்களும் நிறைந்த கதை!

money-magic.title: Money & Magic
money-magic.description:
Dev, a kind-hearted waiter, loses everything in one night — his job, his wife, and his dignity — all at the hands of the one person he trusted most.
With his mother's life on the line and nowhere to turn, the world humiliates him at every step.
This is a story of Dev — a man left with nothing but his will, and what he builds from the ground up.

suryaputra-ki-gatha.title: Suryaputra Ki Gatha
suryaputra-ki-gatha.description: An abandoned boy raised as a humble carpenter discovers that he is the long-lost son of a royal family and possesses the divine powers of Surya Dev. When a ruthless enemy threatens his newly reunited family and unleashes a monstrous force against the kingdom, Suraj must embrace his true identity as the chosen successor to the Rajaon Ke Raja and rise as the legendary warrior destined to defeat the darkness.

daayan-dulha-le-jayegi.title: Daayan Dulha Le Jayegi
daayan-dulha-le-jayegi.description: A poor, humiliated Mumbai office peon gets a magic ring that summons a dark witch who gives him ₹25,000 crore but takes a human life for every wish, forcing him to choose between endless wealth and the woman he truly loves.

ultimate-minister-1.title: Ultimate Minister
ultimate-minister-1.description:
Ashutosh, the newly appointed Health Minister, returns to his village after ten years for his first love, Prerna, only to discover she is engaged to the corrupt MLA’s son and has completely rejected him.
While exposing the illegal hospital racket, Ashutosh is brutally attacked and nearly killed, unaware that his true identity as the Health Minister is about to turn the entire corrupt system upside down.

one-forbidden-night.title: One Forbidden Night
one-forbidden-night.description: Escaping an oppressive marriage forced by her orthodox father, a quiet classical temple singer from Mylapore finds refuge and forbidden desire in the arms of a ruthless tech billionaire. As she fights for her personal freedom and musical career against rigid traditional bounds, she uncovers a devastating secret: her savior's romance is a pre-planned vendetta meant to destroy her father

the-wolf-queen-of-the-vampire-king.title: The Wolf Queen of the Vampire King
the-wolf-queen-of-the-vampire-king.description: After her two cruel wolf mates crush her beast and cast her into the freezing wilderness, a broken outcast survives by forming a blood bond with a vampire king, returning as a powerful hybrid to watch her former lovers beg for forgiveness.

the-outcast-wizard-claims-her-body-soul.title: The Outcast Wizard Claims Her - Body & Soul

shaitan-ki-dulhan.title: Shaitan ki Dulhan
shaitan-ki-dulhan.description: Hee-jin’s perfect life with Yo-han shatters when she discovers his terrifying connection to the secret cult Kaaljyot. Chosen as their new Mahamaya, she learns she may be destined for a deadly sacrifice. As Yo-han rises to become Mahaguru, his love for her clashes with the dark world he cannot escape. Surrounded by masked followers, forbidden rituals and deadly secrets, Hee-jin must uncover the truth before Kaaljyot claims her forever.

the-dog-date.title: The Dog Date
the-dog-date.description: Pressured by his mother's emotional blackmail, a reluctant hero agrees to bride-hunting, despite confessing to a past drunken mistake with an unknown woman. Meanwhile, a dedicated pet carer goes to a coffee shop to meet a client but mistakenly approaches the hero instead. Once the hilarious mix-up is cleared, the desperate hero sees an unexpected way out and proposes a contract marriage!"

born-with-cheat-codes.title: Born With Cheat Codes
born-with-cheat-codes.description: After being sent to Earth as a fairy, Vivi is reborn into a poor family whose cruel grandmother treats her as a burden. Using her magical powers, Vivi saves her brothers, heals her family, revives their barren land, and brings prosperity to the village. As her powers become impossible to hide, Vivi is finally revealed as the fairy destined to protect the entire village and change her family’s fate

the-fifth-clan.title: The Fifth Clan
the-fifth-clan.description: The last heir of a serpent clan that once served Shiva must wake his imprisoned ancestor. But the truth he uncovers the gods' original plan for humanity could shatter reality itself.

reborn-in-dragonfire.title: Reborn in Dragonfire
reborn-in-dragonfire.description: In the scorched badlands of the Sun-Gouge territory, Baron Magnus Drake controls the only surviving dragon-vein aquifers, bleeding the desert dry with mechanized drills and bio-engineered chimera predators. When his most lethal hunter, Val Thorne, refuses to slaughter the peaceful frontier settlement of Ocotillo, Drake executes her and dumps her corpse into the deep wastes.

half-husband.title: Half Husband
half-husband.description: After discovering that her fiancé Nanxun and his secretary are plotting her “accidental death” for the family fortune, Shi Ning decides to turn the tables. Determined to save her critically ill brother, she seeks help from Nanxun’s enigmatic half-brother, Lingchen. What begins as a calculated temptation soon sparks a dangerous game of revenge, betrayal, forbidden attraction, and shifting loyalties.

kanavan-for-sale.title: Kanavan For Sale
kanavan-for-sale.description: கல்லூரி பேராசிரியரான கபீர், நேர்மையையும் காதலையும் மட்டுமே நம்பி வாழ்கிறார். ஆனால் அவரது மனைவி ஆர்யா, பணம் மற்றும் ஆடம்பர வாழ்க்கைக்காக எதையும் செய்யத் தயங்காதவள். கணவனை கூட பணத்திற்காக மற்றொரு பெண்ணிடம் ஒப்படைக்கத் தயாராகும் அவளின் பேராசை, வாழ்க்கையை தலைகீழாக மாற்றுகிறது. உண்மையான காதல், தியாகம் மற்றும் பேராசையின் விளைவுகளை உணர்த்தும் வலிமையான குடும்பக் காதல் நாடகம்.

lost-mani-of-mahabharat.title: Lost Mani Of Mahabharat
lost-mani-of-mahabharat.description: Thousands of years after the Mahabharat, an ancient evil awakens in the Himalayas when the lost divine Mani of Ashwatthama falls into the hands of Shalyaketu, a forgotten warrior consumed by a centuries-old thirst for revenge. Blessed with the power to change forms, immense strength, and the boon of Ichchha-Mrityu, Shalyaketu sets out to destroy the descendants of the Pandavas and claim Hastinapur.

naanu-nanna-gandandru.title: Naanu nanna Gandandru
naanu-nanna-gandandru.description: Bengaluru's powerful businessman hides his billionaire identity to raise his daughter with strong values. But when they are humiliated at her college by a wealthy family trying to buy her science award, he uncovers a shocking truth, his wife has been living a double life with them, using his wealth for her own gain. As greed, betrayal, and inheritance wars erupt, he must choose between revenge and protecting his daughter’s future.

ninakkai-mathram.title: Ninakkai Mathram
ninakkai-mathram.description: After enduring years of emotional abuse and violent humiliation as a secretary for his ungrateful secret love, an undercover AI prodigy resigns to claim his rightful throne as a tech company CEO—ultimately exposing his manipulative rival's fraudulent lies and leaving his deeply regretful former boss behind for a woman who truly values his worth.

my-poor-husband-is-a-god.title: My Poor Husband Is a God
my-poor-husband-is-a-god.description: After being betrayed and murdered by her ambitious stepsister, a princess gets a second chance at life. Determined to rewrite her fate, she rejects the prince she once married and unknowingly chooses a ragged beggar, only to discover he is the hidden Prince of Swarnalok,

naa-ninna-mareyalaare.title: Naa Ninna Mareyalaare
naa-ninna-mareyalaare.description: After enduring years of emotional abuse and violent humiliation as a secretary for his ungrateful secret love, an undercover AI prodigy resigns to claim his rightful throne as a tech company CEO—ultimately exposing his manipulative rival's fraudulent lies and leaving his deeply regretful former boss behind for a woman who truly values his worth.

pirata-que-nunca-afunda.title: Pirata que Nunca Afunda
pirata-que-nunca-afunda.description: Lançado ao mar ainda bebê por ter nascido sem magia, Ronan Drift cresceu sem vínculos, tatuagens ou família. Vivendo como um andarilho solitário, ele salva uma princesa pirata e descobre ser o herdeiro perdido de uma casa real que o abandonou para morrer. Para recuperar seu legado, precisará enfrentar os piratas mais perigosos do mundo — inclusive o temido número um, que acaba se ajoelhando diante dele. Uma história de vingança, poder e um amor escolhido pelo próprio mar.

criminal-lawyer-marathi.title: Criminal Lawyer (Marathi)
criminal-lawyer-marathi.description: A famous criminal lawyer informs the police after a mysterious man asks him for a murder plan to kill a respected person in the city. The police try to stop the crime, but the murder still happens in a shocking way. As the investigation moves forward, secrets, betrayal, and hidden motives begin to come out. Soon, everyone is left asking the same question, who planned the murder, and who is the real killer?

criminal-lawyer-telugu.title: Criminal Lawyer (Telugu)
criminal-lawyer-telugu.description: A famous criminal lawyer informs the police after a mysterious man asks him for a murder plan to kill a respected person in the city. The police try to stop the crime, but the murder still happens in a shocking way. As the investigation moves forward, secrets, betrayal, and hidden motives begin to come out. Soon, everyone is left asking the same question, who planned the murder, and who is the real killer?

naaglok-reino-das-serpentes.title: Naaglok: Reino das Serpentes
naaglok-reino-das-serpentes.description: Um humilde servo serpente do reino místico de Naaglok arrisca tudo pela ambiciosa dançarina que ama. Mas logo descobre que sua maior batalha não será para conquistar o coração dela, e sim para desvendar o próprio destino há muito esquecido.

naseeb-no-khel.title: Naseeb No Khel
naseeb-no-khel.description: When humble street-food vendor Pooja is cruelly dumped by her ambitious fiancé, the penniless beggar she fed out of pure kindness steps in to save her dying grandmother’s final wish with a fake wedding. But her savior is harboring a jaw-dropping secret: he isn’t a beggar at all, but Harsh Swastika missing billionaire CEO playing the ultimate undercover game of love and redemption.

coracao-certo-rumo-errado.title: Coração Certo, Rumo Errado
coracao-certo-rumo-errado.description: Ao descobrir que o amor do Deus da Guerra era uma mentira para usá-la como escudo de sua ambiciosa meia-irmã, uma princesa lunar traída troca secretamente as noivas de um casamento divino e se casa com o amaldiçoado e cego Senhor do Submundo. Ao lado daquele que deveria ser o homem errado, ela encontra o amor verdadeiro — e desencadeia uma guerra entre os três reinos quando seu antigo noivo decide que prefere destruí-la a perdê-la.

en-munnaal-kaathali.title: En Munnaal Kaathali
en-munnaal-kaathali.description: ஏழ்மையான ஆனால் நேர்மையான ஆதித்யா, தனது காதலிக்காக எல்லாவற்றையும் தியாகம் செய்கிறான். ஆனால் பணத்திற்காக அவள் அவனைக் கைவிட்டு, அவர்களின் குழந்தையையும் அழிக்கிறாள். உடைந்த மனதுடன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் கட்டியெழுப்பும் ஆதித்யா, மிகப்பெரிய நிறுவனத்தின் CEO ஆக உயர்கிறான். அந்த நேரத்தில் அவன் முன்னாள் காதலி மீண்டும் அவன் வாழ்க்கைக்குள் வரும்போது, பழைய காதலும் புதிய அதிகாரமும் மோதும் உணர்ச்சிகரமான பயணம் தொடங்குகிறது.

bhola-danca-da-destruicao.title: Bhola: Dança da Destruição
bhola-danca-da-destruicao.description: Um jovem camponês, desprezado e chamado de “bastardo” por desconhecer suas origens, inicia uma jornada para se tornar o maior guerreiro Bahubali de Pataliputra. Guiado por sua coragem, determinação e poderes divinos ocultos, ele enfrentará inimigos poderosos dispostos a tudo para destruí-lo antes que descubra seu verdadeiro destino.

the-billionaires-ice-queen-5.title: The Billionaire's Ice Queen
the-billionaires-ice-queen-5.description: Once a rising figure-skating prodigy, Hannah Wells is blacklisted after Grace Ivers steals her choreography and destroys her career. Five years later, billionaire John Logan gives Hannah a chance to reclaim the ice while she helps his traumatized son, Leo, rediscover his confidence. But as Dean and Grace fight to bury Hannah’s past, her comeback threatens to expose the powerful conspiracy that ruined her life.

even-winners-pay-the-price.title: Even Winners Pay the Price
even-winners-pay-the-price.description: When a benched backup quarterback gains an ancient supernatural system that guarantees ten perfect throws a day at the cost of crippling nerve recoil, he must rely on his own football IQ, uncover the dark fate of past users, outsmart a corrupt booster empire, and lead an underdog Texas team to a state title before his throwing arm is destroyed forever.

protocolo-sombra-cura-mortal.title: Protocolo Sombra: Cura Mortal
protocolo-sombra-cura-mortal.description: Treinada para matar com substâncias químicas, Auri Trell agora vive escondida como faxineira. Mas tudo muda quando precisa salvar Kaz Venture, o filho cadeirante de seu falecido comandante, de uma neurotoxina geneticamente modificada e de uma tomada corporativa liderada pela implacável Savine Rath. Enquanto luta para proteger Kaz e o legado de seu pai, Auri descobre que resistir à atração entre os dois pode ser um desafio ainda maior do que mantê-lo vivo.

my-partner-is-a-wall-street-ghost.title: My Partner is a wall street ghost !
my-partner-is-a-wall-street-ghost.description: Framed for a massive fraud, a blacklisted credit strategist is visited and mentored by the ghost of a murdered founder. Partnering with the man's impoverished, blacklisted widow, he uses his sharp financial mind and spectral guidance to clear their names, reclaim the stolen company, and bring down the corrupt Wall Street cartel that ruined them both.

noiva-comprada-do-chefao.title: Noiva Comprada do Chefão
noiva-comprada-do-chefao.description: Isabella begins the story trapped in a coercive web of marriage, family betrayal, and stolen identity. She refuses to be treated as a bargaining chip, even as Lucien presents himself as both captor and protector. Her family, especially Olivia and Damian, are tied to the theft of her career, engagement, research, and public standing. Isabella keeps finding clues, including hidden records and signs concealed among flowers, that suggest corruption, blackmail, and secret crimes. The mansion and the corporate world both feel like prisons, with locked doors, forged papers, and guarded authority shaping her every move. Lucien’s control is constant, but so is his claim that he is shielding her from danger and from a family willing to sell her. Isabella repeatedly challenges him, tries to expose the truth, and refuses contracts that would bind her name and future to his. At the same time, Damian remains a persistent threat, using isolation, gaslighting, and old wounds to keep her off balance. Just when Isabella believes Lucien may be the main enemy, she discovers that he is secretly protecting women, children, and displaced families in hidden refuges. This revelation shifts the story from simple suspicion into a more complicated struggle over secrecy, survival, and trust. Isabella’s anger does not disappear, because Lucien’s methods are still controlling and his explanations remain incomplete. Their relationship becomes a tense mix of distrust, reluctant attraction, and unresolved history. Outside threats continue to press in, and the danger around the hidden operation never fully goes away. The emotional center deepens when Julie, Isabella’s last mother figure and closest support, becomes part of the larger mystery. Julie’s sudden death leaves Isabella grieving, isolated, and more determined to understand who is lying and why. By the end of the batch, Isabella is still trapped inside a sealed and dangerous world, fighting for freedom from both love and control. The stakes are no longer only her reputation or marriage, but the truth behind the hidden refuge, Julie’s death, and the forces trying to keep everything buried.

the-secret-chairman.title: The Secret Chairman
the-secret-chairman.description: Sukesh, a secret billionaire, hides his identity for 15 years for his wife Sheela. On her birthday, he discovers she's partying with another man Pran. Despite giving her his kidney, she calls him useless. Pran slaps Sheela and frames Sukesh for domestic violence. Police arrest the innocent husband while the cheating wife and her lover celebrate. From billionaire to jail — a story of betrayal and revenge.

the-vivasayi-king.title: The Vivasayi King
the-vivasayi-king.description: பணத்துக்காக சொந்த குடும்பத்தாலேயே விற்கப்பட்ட ஸ்ரேயா, பேச முடியாத மகளை வளர்க்கும் விவசாயி ரகுவை கட்டாயமாக திருமணம் செய்கிறாள். அவனால் நிராகரிக்கப்பட்டு பண்ணை வீட்டை அடையும் அவள், வழியில் சண்டை போட்ட அந்நியனே தன் கணவன் என்பதை அறிகிறாள். தியாவின் அன்பைப் பெறும் ஸ்ரேயாவை, ரகுவின் குடும்பமும் மோனிகாவும் அழிக்க சதி செய்கின்றனர். தன் மனைவி, மகளுக்காக பண்ணை ராஜா ரகு திருப்பி அடிக்கிறான்.

mystery-wala-chef.title: Mystery Wala Chef
mystery-wala-chef.description: Once the masked three-time world champion R.R., Rohan now hides as a lowly kitchen helper at Revayat Heritage while dangerous men hunt him. When Vikram schemes to seize the hotel through a deadly cooking competition, Rohan’s quiet mastery begins exposing his true calibre. He saves Anirudh’s team, defeats elite chefs and enters the final against a fake “R.R.” His simple khichdi overturns the result, while clues force everyone toward the same truth: Rohan may be the legendary master chef himself.

mi-madre-jefa-de-la-mafia.title: Mi Madre, Jefa de la Mafia
mi-madre-jefa-de-la-mafia.description: Tras la muerte de su esposo, Samantha Moretti abandona a su poderosa familia criminal para darle a su hija Allison una vida normal. Pero cuando el despiadado mafioso Dave Donovan secuestra repetidamente a la joven, Samantha se ve obligada a recuperar a la guerrera que fue. Al retomar el control del imperio Moretti, inicia una guerra para destruir a Donovan, aunque corre el riesgo de convertirse en el monstruo del que intentó escapar.

boss-lady-reloaded.title: Boss Lady Reloaded
boss-lady-reloaded.description: Aarohi Raichand returns to Mumbai hiding a powerful identity, only to be betrayed and publicly humiliated by her fiancé Arjun. When hotel CEO Vivaan Oberoi steps in, protects her and declares her his wife, their fake marriage becomes a shield against enemies and family pressure. As Vivaan risks his position for Aarohi, everyone mocks her as an ordinary receptionist—unaware that she is actually the mysterious Queen whose power can change all their lives.

singham-daddy-1.title: Singham Daddy
singham-daddy-1.description: A feared ex-convict returns after a decade in prison to save his estranged daughter from a life of abuse, but as he battles her tormentors, he must also overcome her hatred and the haunting consequences of his own violent past.

my-dad-my-hero-1.title: My Dad My Hero
my-dad-my-hero-1.description: தனது மகனைப் பாதுகாக்கவும் சாம்ராஜ்யத்தைக் காப்பாற்றவும் ஒரு பெண் தொழிலதிபர், ஏழை லிப்ட் மெக்கானிக்குடன் போலித் திருமணம் செய்ய நிர்பந்திக்கப்படுகிறார். ஆனால், தாங்கள் இருவரும் பிரிந்த பழைய காதலர்கள் என்பதும், அந்த குழந்தையின் உண்மைப் பெற்றோர்கள் என்பதும் அவர்களுக்குத் தெரியாது. அதுமட்டுமின்றி, மும்பையின் பெரும் பணக்கார குடும்பங்களையே உலுக்கப்போகும் ஒரு பெரும் ரகசியத்தின் உண்மையான வாரிசுகளும் அவர்கள்தான் என்பதை அவர்கள் அறியும்போது கதை எதிர்பாராத திருப்புமுனையை நோக்கி நகர்கிறது.

ghar-jamai-bana-arabpati-the-mentors-sec.title: Ghar Jamai Bana Arabpati: The Mentor's Secret
ghar-jamai-bana-arabpati-the-mentors-sec.description: For five years, Dev lives as Rati’s contract husband, loving and caring for her while she treats him like a servant and remains emotionally tied to her first love, Avinash. When Avinash returns, Dev finally divorces Rati and disappears. A year later, Rati finds him transformed into world-renowned zillionaire researcher “The Mentor.” Realizing too late that she loves him, she begs him back—but Dev rejects the woman who never valued him and chooses Shreya instead.

asli-dhurandhar-1.title: Asli Dhurandhar
asli-dhurandhar-1.description: After sacrificing his billionaire lifestyle as the secret founder of a tech empire to give his family a simple life, a hidden tycoon is ruthlessly humiliated and divorced by his status-climbing wife for a corrupt corporate rival. When he is forced to reclaim his throne as the multi-billion-dollar CEO of Oracle Group, he must systematically dismantle his enemies, teach his entitled son the true value of hard work, and leave his regretful ex-wife behind forever to secure his legendary legacy.

love-ki-century.title: Love ki Century
love-ki-century.description: Meenakshi’s story begins with betrayal on the eve of a wedding tied to family power and business control. When she discovers Aditya’s deception, she refuses to accept public humiliation and instead turns the wedding into a strategic move by changing the groom. Raj enters as a poor young man whose mother urgently needs surgery, leaving him vulnerable to a marriage deal arranged to fund her treatment. That contract pulls him into Meenakshi’s world and into the Mumbai Titans cricket setup, where he is treated as an outsider from the start. The team hierarchy, especially senior players and coaches, repeatedly tests and humiliates him, making clear that status and discipline matter as much as talent. Raj keeps pushing back, insisting that skill should decide his place. Rival players such as Rohan and others intensify the pressure through hostility, accusations, and sabotage. Even so, a senior woman on the board and later the coach begin to recognize that Raj has real ability. His explosive six-ball trial becomes a turning point, forcing the Titans to accept that he can play. But selection does not end the struggle, because the batch shows that staying in the team is even harder than joining it. Raj is then caught in a wider web of team politics, public confrontations, and mounting pressure over conduct and reliability. At the same time, Meena is trapped in a secret marriage and a growing family crisis, trying to keep powerful elders from learning the truth. Her hidden personal life collides with Raj’s rise as marriage documents and family demands threaten to expose everything. The franchise itself also begins to wobble, with investors losing confidence and senior management worrying about instability. Raj continues to face open hostility from Rohan and Samarth, and one confrontation turns violent. Meena, meanwhile, grows suspicious and angry as she believes Rajvardhan is hiding something and may be involved with another woman. Across both threads, pride, secrecy, and control drive the drama, while the stakes keep rising for Raj’s career, Meena’s reputation, and the future of the Titans.

protocolo-sombra-la-cura.title: Protocolo Sombra: La Cura
protocolo-sombra-la-cura.description: Auri Trell fue entrenada para matar usando productos químicos, pero ahora se esconde como limpiadora. Debe salvar a Kaz Venture, el hijo paralizado de su antiguo comandante, de una neurotoxina genética y de una despiadada toma corporativa. Mientras protege su legado familiar, Auri también lucha contra la atracción irresistible que siente por Kaz.

yaar-ne-hi-loot-liya-ghar-yaar-ka.title: Yaar Ne Hi Loot Liya, Ghar Yaar Ka
yaar-ne-hi-loot-liya-ghar-yaar-ka.description: Anna is caught between a future built on wealth and a past love that refuses to stay hidden. She appears ready to marry Dong, but that choice is repeatedly shadowed by Chen Han, the man who once saved and protected her and who has stayed near her under a concealed identity. As the wedding pressure builds, private history keeps breaking into public space, turning ceremonies into stages for humiliation, accusation, and status games. Han’s claim of a long relationship with the bride, and the bride’s denial of him, deepen the sense that the truth is being fought over in front of everyone. Dong is pulled into the middle, torn between trust, pride, and the possibility that the people closest to him have been lying. Around them, family authority and social rank matter almost as much as romance, with mothers-in-law, fathers, and patrons using access, approval, and rejection to control the younger generation. Gifts, luxury clothes, and expensive wedding presents become weapons, not symbols of love, and every exchange seems to measure who has power and who can be discarded. Anna’s own stance is complicated: she rejects the man who cared for her after her accident, yet she also refuses to be easily intimidated when the scandal turns against her. Other women enter the conflict to expose affairs, claim husbands, or demand compensation, widening the emotional damage and making loyalty look fragile. Several men respond by asserting status through money, public gestures, or threats, but those displays often backfire into embarrassment. The repeated reclaiming of gifts and the exposure of tiny or insulting payments underline how quickly affection can be reduced to transaction. At the same time, hidden leverage keeps surfacing, suggesting that people who seem powerless may still have a plan. The story keeps returning to weddings because marriage is where love, family pride, and class conflict collide most violently. Each public confrontation makes it harder for anyone to preserve face, and every attempt to control the narrative only exposes more betrayal. By the end of the batch, the hidden relationship at the center of Anna’s life is openly challenged, and the surrounding families are fractured by suspicion and resentment. The stakes are no longer just who marries whom, but who gets to define the truth, the value of loyalty, and the meaning of love itself.

el-mafioso-compro-a-su-novia.title: El Mafioso Compró a su Novia
el-mafioso-compro-a-su-novia.description: Isabella Romano creía que casarse con el multimillonario Lucien Devereux aseguraría su futuro. En cambio, se convierte en la esposa de un despiadado rey de la mafia, cuyo amor es tan peligroso como sus enemigos. Obligada a permanecer junto a él, Isabella planea escapar, pero la atracción prohibida, los secretos y su inesperada protección la hacen dudar entre huir o convertirse en su reina.

the-doctor-billionaire-battle.title: The Doctor Billionaire Battle
the-doctor-billionaire-battle.description: On the eve of her 12th birthday, mischievous Arya suddenly collapses with a rare, life-threatening condition. Specialist Dr. Raghunath races to the hospital, but a minor road incident traps him in a cruel confrontation with an arrogant couple who humiliate and extort him despite his pleas to save a child. Unaware that the dying patient is their own daughter Arya, Roshan and Nilima keep delaying the one doctor who may save her, turning their ego into a terrifying race against time.

the-ceo-intern.title: The CEO Intern
the-ceo-intern.description: Leo Vance, a brilliant intern at Sterling Tech, is secretly the comatose founder Arthur Sterling’s son. After discovering that deputy Marcus Ward poisoned Arthur to seize and sell the company, Leo steals the physical security key Marcus needs to access its vault. Working under a fake identity, Leo hides the key, secretly treats his father, and maintains a medical smokescreen all while racing to stop Marcus before his father’s recovery is exposed.

billionaire-ceo-ka-ivf-ishq.title: Billionaire CEO ka IVF Ishq
billionaire-ceo-ka-ivf-ishq.description: To pay for her mother’s urgent surgery, a proud South Asian indie singer signs a contract marriage with a cold shipping tycoon under a secret pregnancy pact, but when his elite family tries to steal her baby, she must fight the powerful maritime dynasty to protect her child and their forbidden love.

meine-schwester-stahl-mir-meinen-milliar.title: Meine Schwester stahl mir meinen Milliardär
meine-schwester-stahl-mir-meinen-milliar.description: Sechs Jahre lang liebt Ellie Whitmore Damian Vale heimlich, bis er sich für ihre Schwester entscheidet. Am Hochzeitstag tauscht Ellie ihren Platz am Altar und geht eine Zweckehe mit einem angeblich komatösen politischen Erben ein. Doch Damian will sie nicht gehen lassen. Als die Wahrheit über den Verrat ans Licht kommt, drohen die Geheimnisse zwei der mächtigsten Familien des Landes zu zerstören.

der-preis-meiner-hingabe.title: Der Preis meiner Hingabe
der-preis-meiner-hingabe.description: Um ihre todkranke Schwester zu retten, geht Clara einen gefährlichen Deal mit der mächtigen Galeristin Alexandra Sterling ein: Geld gegen die Kontrolle über Claras Kunst und ihr Leben. Was als kalte Vereinbarung beginnt, entwickelt sich zu einer intensiven Beziehung, der keine von beiden entkommen kann. Als ihr Geheimnis auffliegt, muss Clara entscheiden, wie weit sie gehen wird, um Alexandra zu schützen.

biwi-for-resale.title: Biwi For Resale
biwi-for-resale.description: Pankhuri Sharma begins as a woman publicly shamed by Yash Oberoi, who uses class prejudice and humiliation to strip her of dignity. Instead of accepting defeat, she refuses to stay broken and turns the insult into a fight for her name, her family, and her future. A mysterious marriage proposal from Manan Rajvansh leads to a contract marriage that gives her protection, money, and a way to push back against her enemies. Once she enters the Rajvansh household, she faces hostility from insiders and continued attacks from the Oberoi side, but she also gains a powerful ally in Veer Rajvansh. Veer repeatedly stands beside her, defending her in public and at home when others try to shame her or cast her out. The conflict quickly expands beyond personal revenge into a battle over land records, forged documents, and the legal ownership of her ancestral haveli. Pankhuri’s father and mother remain tied to the struggle, since the family home and legacy are constantly under threat. The Oberoi side escalates with demolition pressure, fake notices, and public accusations, while Pankhuri answers by searching for proof and refusing to surrender. A hidden clue tied to old records and the Chandni Chowk Corridor becomes important as the property fight deepens. In parallel, the story widens into corporate warfare, including stolen blueprints, coercion, and a trust scam that exposes corruption around the rival families. Public confrontations on live television, in clubs, and in elite gatherings keep forcing Pankhuri to defend her identity as Mrs. Pankhuri Veer Rajvansh. Each attack is meant to isolate her, but it instead strengthens her resolve and brings Veer closer to her side. The legal battle becomes sharper when forged records are exposed and original documents surface, shifting the balance of power. By the end of the batch, demolition threats and ownership claims converge, and Pankhuri gains a decisive advantage when the haveli is revealed to belong to her legally. The stakes are no longer only about insult or revenge, but about preserving a family legacy against wealth, fraud, and organized pressure. Through every setback, Pankhuri’s struggle becomes a fight for dignity, home, and rightful place in a world determined to deny her all three.

meine-mutter-ist-die-mafia-konigin.title: Meine Mutter ist die Mafia-Königin
meine-mutter-ist-die-mafia-konigin.description: Nach dem Tod ihres Mannes verlässt Samantha Moretti ihre mächtige Mafiafamilie, um ihrer Tochter Allison ein normales Leben zu ermöglichen. Doch als der skrupellose Verbrecherboss Dave Donovan Allison ins Visier nimmt, kehrt Samantha in die Unterwelt zurück. Sie übernimmt erneut das Moretti-Imperium und beginnt einen erbarmungslosen Krieg. Doch um ihre Tochter zu retten, droht sie selbst zu dem Monster zu werden, dem sie einst entkommen wollte.

ready-to-die.title: Ready to die
ready-to-die.description:
Rudra realizes his nightmare of betrayal and death in Sheshvan is actually a vision of the future.
Trapped with a deadly Sheshnaag and treacherous friends, he must change fate before the nightmare becomes real.

mein-armer-soldat-war-heimlich-ein-herzo.title: Mein armer Soldat war heimlich ein Herzog
mein-armer-soldat-war-heimlich-ein-herzo.description: Von ihrer Stiefmutter misshandelt und von ihrem Verlobten Gerald verraten, heiratet Prinzessin Juliana einen einfachen Soldaten. Doch ihre eifersüchtige Stiefschwester Clarissa setzt alles daran, sie zu zerstören. Als Juliana eine Herzogin rettet, wird sie zu Unrecht eingesperrt. Gerade als jede Hoffnung verloren scheint, enthüllt ihr Ehemann seine wahre Identität – und ein Geheimnis, das alles verändert.

the-cursed-prince.title: The Cursed Prince
the-cursed-prince.description: Veer Devgarh is mocked as a drunken gambler, but behind the disguise lies Aryavart’s most powerful protector—the mysterious Divya Garud. Hiding his strength to protect his mother and uncover the truth behind his father’s murder, Veer enters the Rajya Veer Pariksha. When the deadly princes of Purvi Agnikul threaten the kingdom, he must finally unleash his true power, defeat them, and rise as Aryavart’s unlikely saviour.

the-secret-superman.title: The Secret Superman
the-secret-superman.description: Sabki nazron mein ek nikamma Son-in-Law, Lio asal mein duniya ka pehla 3S-Rank Enhanced Human — Subject 001 tha. Saalon pehle ek dangerous human-modification experiment se bachne ke baad, woh apni pehchaan chhupakar Rumi aur uske parivaar ke saath ek shaant zindagi jee raha tha. Lekin aakhirkaar uska ateet aur Tian Apocalypse Society us tak pahunch hi gaye. Apne parivaar ko bachane aur Tian ko khatam karne ke liye, kya woh dobara wahi deadly weapon banega, jisse duniya kabhi khauf khaati thi?
