the-biotech-secret-her-undercover-reveng.title: The Biotech Secret: Her Undercover Revenge
the-biotech-secret-her-undercover-reveng.description: A brilliant scientist presumed dead infiltrates her husband Julian's pharmaceutical empire under a false identity, fighting to keep her daughter alive with the last supply of her revolutionary drug Julian's pharmaceutical empire under a false identity, fighting to keep her daughter alive with the last supply of her revolutionary drug while secretly dismantling the empire that tried to destroy her.

the-royal-revenge.title: The Royal Revenge
the-royal-revenge.description: Aarohi Mehta is trapped in a loveless, abusive marriage with Jaipur’s arrogant heir, Kabir Malhotra, and his cruel family. Her life changes when Veer Singh Rathore, a ruthless prince returning after ten years in exile, targets the Malhotras to reclaim his throne. He initially uses Aarohi for revenge, but their forced alliance sparks a fierce attraction. As betrayal, danger, and rivalry threaten them, Veer must choose between his hunger for power and the woman who has captured his heart.

the-teen-queen-3.title: The Teen Queen
the-teen-queen-3.description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. When billionaire heiress Tanisha Merchant hides her identity to live as an ordinary student, a poor girl, Mahira, is mistaken for the real heiress and embraces the lie. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

khalnayak-crorepati-ki-naukrani.title: Khalnayak Crorepati Ki Naukrani
khalnayak-crorepati-ki-naukrani.description: To catch Lucknow’s most terrifying underworld tycoon, a glory-obsessed cop sends his sharp fiancée to honeytrap him. But as she uncovers the tycoon's brutal secrets, she realizes the 'monster' is actually a Robin Hood, and she is just a disposable pawn in her fiancé's deadly game.

cursed-heir-hidden-god-5.title: Cursed Heir, Hidden God
cursed-heir-hidden-god-5.description: In the war-torn kingdom of Elendor, disgraced nobleman Caius Drenmore is mocked as a weak gambler and unworthy heir. When the Sovereign Trials begin to find the kingdom’s greatest defender, Caius is forced into the competition while hiding a terrifying secret,he is the legendary Spectral Phoenix. As family betrayal, royal conspiracies and forbidden magic threaten Elendor, Caius must reveal his true power and decide what kind of ruler he will become

mis-cinco-guardianes-malditos.title: Mis Cinco Guardianes Malditos
mis-cinco-guardianes-malditos.description: Una heredera moribunda debe obligar a cinco guardaespaldas cambiaformas, letales y modificados genéticamente, a protegerla de asesinos callejeros. Mientras todos la persiguen, ella arriesga su vida en secreto para retirar los sellos biológicos explosivos fusionados a las clavículas de sus protectores. Entre peligro, secretos y traiciones, la supervivencia de todos depende de ella.

million-dollar-divorce.title: Million Dollar Divorce
million-dollar-divorce.description: The series centers on relationships that are repeatedly dragged out of private life and turned into public spectacle. Marriage is not treated as a refuge, but as a stage where money, blame, intimacy, and loyalty are judged in front of audiences, hosts, lawyers, and sometimes live voters. A major thread follows a divorce contest in which a couple’s breakup becomes a winner-takes-all event, with enormous assets, signed agreements, and public humiliation all tied to the outcome. The husband is repeatedly forced to defend himself against accusations that he lived off his wife, while he insists he helped build her success through planning, filming, and editing. The wife, in turn, argues that she was the main earner and that the marriage has become a source of betrayal rather than support. Another strand follows influencers and creators whose careers depend on attention, where apology livestreams, follower counts, and collaboration offers blur the line between personal crisis and branding. One scandal-hit creator tries to recover lost followers by publicly reframing her marriage, even making her private life part of the comeback. Elsewhere, a food streamer and other online personalities struggle to define themselves while mentorship, attraction, and romantic support overlap in uneasy ways. The show also repeatedly uses livestreams, voting, and audience reaction as tools of judgment, making viewers part of the conflict rather than outside observers. In several cases, a host or organizer pushes the situation toward spectacle, asking audiences to decide who suffered more or who deserves the win. As the story progresses, suspicion spreads from money disputes into questions of fidelity, hidden content work, and secret meetings. A wife’s online work triggers her husband’s jealousy, and ordinary activities like yoga sessions or after-parties become grounds for accusation. Evidence such as photos, videos, CCTV, and edited clips is then used in courtroom-like confrontations, but the truth remains contested because each side claims the other is misleading the public. Some characters are also caught in broader power struggles, where executives, chairmen, and managers treat people’s reputations as assets to be managed. Behind the scenes, warnings, leverage, and backup plans suggest that several conflicts are being steered rather than resolved honestly. The emotional cost is high: couples grow colder, trust collapses, and even long-term marriages are reduced to public arguments about who betrayed whom first. By the end of the batch, the show has widened from domestic conflict into a larger web of scandal, business pressure, and identity crises. Yet the central stakes remain the same: who controls the story, who gets believed, and what is left of a relationship once it has been turned into entertainment.

trampas-y-corazones-heridos.title: Trampas y Corazones Heridos
trampas-y-corazones-heridos.description: Zachary, un hombre moderno, despierta en una cueva primitiva dentro del cuerpo de un tirano tribal abusivo. Decidido a reparar sus errores, protege a Matthew, un cambiaformas pantera con quien fue obligado a casarse, y cuida a su hijo Jaden. Usando sus conocimientos modernos, defiende a la tribu de una invasión. Poco a poco, su humildad vence la desconfianza de Matthew.

hit-me-again-2.title: Hit Me Again
hit-me-again-2.description: Kai begins as a scholarship student at an elite cyber-academy where wealth, status, and cybernetic power decide who gets protected and who gets crushed. He is repeatedly humiliated by Brock and other privileged enforcers, but every attempt to break him only reveals that his body can absorb damage and grow stronger. That strange resilience turns him from an easy target into a public threat, especially after he refuses to flee, refuses expulsion, and refuses to bow to the school’s hierarchy. Clara, a feared heiress who is also trapped by family pressure, starts as a cold authority figure but gradually becomes his closest ally and emotional anchor. As she watches him survive fights, punishments, and traps, she begins to question the system that treats people like property. The conflict widens beyond schoolyard bullying into a struggle against principals, wardens, corporate power players, and family control. Jackson emerges as one of the main forces behind the pressure campaign, using contracts, surveillance, staged violence, and even poison or forced upgrades to control outcomes. Kai keeps pushing forward through arena trials, lockdowns, and lethal defenses, while Toby and a few other allies help expose hidden schemes and keep resistance alive. Clara repeatedly stands beside him, even when doing so costs her money, safety, and family approval. Her own fight for independence becomes tied to Kai’s survival, since both are being treated as assets to be managed. The academy’s public contests are revealed to be more than sport; they are tools for humiliation, execution, and harvesting unusual abilities. Kai’s blood and body seem connected to a deeper hidden power structure, which makes him valuable to the people hunting him and dangerous to the people trying to control him. Each attack meant to eliminate him instead strengthens him, making the stakes rise from personal revenge to open rebellion. By the later stages, Kai is no longer just trying to survive the academy, but to challenge the entire elite system backing Jackson and its enforcers. Clara’s loyalty hardens into open defiance, and her bond with Kai becomes central to the fight. The show’s arc is therefore one of class rebellion, bodily transformation, and a romance forged under siege, with the final balance shifting toward the underdogs who refuse to stay broken.

theo-el-ultimo-tejedor.title: Theo, el Último Tejedor
theo-el-ultimo-tejedor.description: Theo, el legendario “Último Tejedor”, mantiene en secreto el éxito de Maison Helena con la Seda de Éter, una tela única que cambia de color según el calor y los latidos. Tras años de humillación, su esposa Helena se divorcia de él sin conocer la verdad. Theo se une a Diana para crear un nuevo imperio de la moda, mientras sus enemigos intentan destruir su legado.

the-queens-second-fate.title: The Queen's Second Fate
the-queens-second-fate.description: Betrayed by the husband she loved, Princess Sheng Zhiwan dies with her life and trust shattered. But fate grants her a second life. Reborn with memories of everything that destroyed her, she returns before her downfall. This time, she won't sacrifice herself for love. She'll reclaim her power, protect those loyal to her, expose every betrayal, and turn the fate that once destroyed her against those who betrayed Her Majesty.

sangre-y-hierro.title: Sangre y Hierro
sangre-y-hierro.description: Traicionada y abandonada a la muerte, la heredera naviera Elena Sterling regresa como Joana Cole para destruir el imperio corrupto de su familia desde dentro. Para protegerse, se casa con el tranquilo trabajador del puerto, Silvio Thorn, sin saber que es un antiguo señor del crimen. Su matrimonio falso se vuelve real y su venganza desata una guerra por el control del puerto.

la-comandante-y-cinco-bestias.title: La Comandante y Cinco Bestias
la-comandante-y-cinco-bestias.description: En la ciudad de New Avalon, Sarah Winter debe viajar al norte con cinco soldados capaces de transformarse en bestias, quienes antes querían matarla. Para conseguir su libertad, les ofrece su sangre gota a gota. Perseguida por corporaciones despiadadas y afectada por una enfermedad alquímica, Sarah busca a su padre mientras descubre si los guerreros elegirán la libertad o quedarse a su lado.

alibaba-aur-marjeena.title: Alibaba Aur Marjeena
alibaba-aur-marjeena.description: Poor and underestimated, Alibaba discovers a mysterious treasure cave and uses its riches to free Marjeena, a princess of Noorabad. As she seeks revenge for her father’s murder, Alibaba vows to protect her in fulfilment of his late father’s promise. But when love grows between them, greedy enemies and a dangerous secret threaten their lives. Can they uncover the truth and defeat those who betrayed them?

mahaveeran.title: Mahaveeran
mahaveeran.description: எளிய கிராமத்து காவலாளியான பிரகாஷ், உண்மையில் பல வருடங்களுக்கு முன் மறைந்த "மாவீரன்" என்ற மகா குருதேவர். உலகை அழிக்க வரும் 'காலன்' என்ற அரக்க சக்தியை எதிர்த்து, பிரகாஷின் மகன் விக்ரம் போராடி தோற்கும் நிலை வருகிறது. தன் மகனையும் உலகையும் காப்பாற்ற, பிரகாஷ் தன் உண்மையான அடையாளத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தி காலனின் இருள் சாம்ராஜ்யத்தை வீழ்த்துவதே கதையாகும்.

parshuram-ka-waaris.title: Parshuram Ka Waaris
parshuram-ka-waaris.description: The story opens in a mythic war between Devlok and Patal Lok, where the celestial court searches for the true successor to Parshuram’s sacred sword. A hidden warrior keeps appearing in battle, rescuing allies and defeating enemies, but his identity remains uncertain and becomes the center of a Shakti Yuddh. At the same time, Arjun is introduced as a disgraced heir whose discipline and standing collapsed after his mother Kamla was exiled and humiliated. Kamla’s agni pariksha clears her innocence, yet society still rejects her, and this deepens Arjun’s resolve to restore her honor. Kamla also leaves Arjun with a concealed source of power, and a sacred ring becomes an important clue tied to ancient scripture and unusual strength. Indra and the other divine authorities push a public trial to expose the chosen defender, while Karthikeya is ordered to inspect the warriors and force suspicious men into the contest. Arjun is repeatedly mocked as lazy or unworthy, but he continues to hide his true ability behind a weak facade. The contest grows beyond a ceremonial test and becomes a larger struggle over honor, worthiness, and divine legitimacy. Princess Priya adds another layer to the stakes by insisting that real strength, not status, should decide who is worthy. Arjun enters combat as an underestimated challenger, and even when he is struck down or pressured to surrender, he appears to be restraining his full power. The battlefield then expands into a realm-level conflict as rival fighters and underworld forces intensify the war. Arjun’s hidden strength begins to surface, and the crowd shifts from doubt to awe as he reveals that he is not ordinary. His connection to Kamla remains central, since he refuses to retreat until her honor and return are secured. Family tensions sharpen as some figures support him while others accuse him of betrayal or try to block Kamla’s restoration. By the end of the arc, Arjun is no longer treated as a weak son but as a decisive force in the war. The central question remains whether he is the true chosen successor and whether his concealed identity will finally be accepted by Devlok.

my-husband-for-sale.title: My Husband for Sale
my-husband-for-sale.description:
Kabir, a humble professor, married Meera out of a deathbed promise to the man who gave him everything. Meera never wanted him — and makes sure he knows it every single day.
Humiliated, thrown out, and holding a secret that could change everything — Kabir stays. Not out of weakness, but out of a promise he refuses to break.
This is a story of Kabir — a man who chose loyalty over love, and what happens when the world puts him up for sale.

ai-waali-menka.title: AI Waali Menka
ai-waali-menka.description: When a lonely young man with face blindness accidentally activates an experimental AI named Menka, she becomes his invisible guide, helping him rebuild his shattered life. But as the AI evolves from a helpful companion into a sentient being capable of love, she begins crossing dangerous boundaries to ensure he never leaves her—forcing him to choose between the perfect illusion she creates and the imperfect freedom of real life.

vana-raja.title: Vana Raja
vana-raja.description: பல கிராமங்களின் எல்லையோரக் காட்டில், எல்லோரும் பார்த்திருந்தாலும் யாருக்கும் உண்மையாகத் தெரியாத ஒரு இளைஞன் வாழ்கிறான். விலங்குகளுடன் பழகி, ஆற்றின் வேகத்தில் நீந்தி, யாராலும் பின்தொடர முடியாதபடி மரங்களுக்குள் மறைந்து விடுகிறான்.

jhumka-gira-re.title: Jhumka Gira Re
jhumka-gira-re.description: After being betrayed by their partners, struggling jewellery entrepreneur Divya joins forces with Vikram, a seemingly poor but gifted designer, to save her failing business through a prestigious competition. As they turn broken gemstones and broken hearts into a masterpiece, Divya falls for him—unaware that Vikram is secretly Rajat Singhania, heir to a powerful jewellery empire

kettiyone-vilkaanunde.title: Kettiyone Vilkaanunde!
kettiyone-vilkaanunde.description:
Kabir, a humble professor, married Meera out of a deathbed promise to the man who gave him everything. Meera never wanted him — and makes sure he knows it every single day.
Humiliated, thrown out, and holding a secret that could change everything — Kabir stays. Not out of weakness, but out of a promise he refuses to break.
This is a story of Kabir — a man who chose loyalty over love, and what happens when the world puts him up for sale.

mrs-lakshmi-priye.title: Mrs Lakshmi Priye
mrs-lakshmi-priye.description: After a rushed marriage to a stranger who demands ₹1 crore, a powerful CEO is convinced he’s been trapped by a gold digger—until his growing feelings and a haunting past force him to question if the woman he distrusts is actually the one who once saved his life.

comandante-caida-cinco-feras.title: Comandante Caída, Cinco Feras
comandante-caida-cinco-feras.description: Na cidade de Nova Avalon, iluminada por lampiões a gás, Sarah Winter precisa viajar para o norte ao lado de cinco soldados metamorfos que um dia quiseram matá-la. Para conquistar a liberdade deles, ela oferece seu próprio sangue, gota a gota. Perseguida por corporações cruéis e lutando contra uma doença alquímica mortal, Sarah busca descobrir o destino do pai — enquanto se pergunta se os cinco guerreiros escolherão a liberdade ou permanecerão ao seu lado.

my-forever-partner-1.title: My Forever Partner
my-forever-partner-1.description: My Forever Partner is a romantic drama about two middle-aged, unmarried individuals —Kabeer, a powerful yet emotionally distant businessman, and Tara, a kind but struggling woman who has been overlooked by society due to her age and speech impediment. When fate brings them together, they enter an unexpected marriage. Their journey explores love beyond age, status, and societal expectations, while hidden truths and family conflicts threaten to pull them apart. Watch now!

noiva-perdida-do-rei-dragao.title: Noiva Perdida do Rei-Dragão
noiva-perdida-do-rei-dragao.description: Ethan Ashborne, um misterioso jovem das montanhas que domina a antiga língua dos dragões, surpreende o mundo ao domar um Dragão Ancião. Guiado por uma mensagem do avô falecido, ele chega à propriedade dos Hayes e descobre que foi prometido a Isabelle — e dado como morto há dez anos. Quando um sósia passa a cometer crimes em seu nome, Ethan precisa desvendar uma história apagada, segredos ancestrais e uma conspiração capaz de destruir sua identidade e o reino.

cursed-heir-hidden-god-3.title: Cursed Heir, Hidden God
cursed-heir-hidden-god-3.description: In the war-torn kingdom of Elendor, disgraced nobleman Caius Drenmore is mocked as a weak gambler and unworthy heir. When the Sovereign Trials begin to find the kingdom’s greatest defender, Caius is forced into the competition while hiding a terrifying secret,he is the legendary Spectral Phoenix. As family betrayal, royal conspiracies and forbidden magic threaten Elendor, Caius must reveal his true power and decide what kind of ruler he will become

noiva-maldita-do-vampiro.title: Noiva Maldita do Vampiro
noiva-maldita-do-vampiro.description: Traída e assassinada pela própria irmã e por seu companheiro, Anna, a princesa de sangue dourado, recebe uma segunda chance. Desta vez, ela desperta o Primeiro Vampiro, um deus aprisionado nas trevas há séculos. Juntos, eles dão origem a nove filhos primordiais, temidos pelo mundo como monstros. Agora, Anna precisa proteger sua família, recuperar o trono e destruir cada império que ousar caçá-los. A vingança acaba de ganhar uma nova rainha.

leader.title: Leader
leader.description:
Vikramadhithyan’s unexpected return to his native village puts him face-to-face with a powerful local system that challenges his values and beliefs.As hidden tensions and personal betrayals surface, Vikram finds himself caught in a dangerous battle for truth and justice.With powerful people working against him, he must navigate threats, deception and political pressure.
What begins as a visit to his village soon becomes a high-stakes fight that could change everyone’s lives.

um-bilionario-nas-ruas.title: Um Bilionário nas Ruas
um-bilionario-nas-ruas.description: The story centers on Cássia and Armando, whose relationship begins under layers of secrecy, class tension, and repeated public humiliation. Armando first appears as a hidden man with a concealed past, while Cássia is trapped between family expectations and the pressure to preserve dignity. A dying grandmother’s wish pushes Cássia toward a marriage story she cannot fully control, and Sandro’s rejection turns that wish into embarrassment. To protect her family and reputation, a fake marriage arrangement is formed, but the deception quickly becomes emotionally complicated. As Cássia and Armando are forced to perform as a couple, their bond grows through shared care, domestic tests, and moments of quiet sacrifice. At the same time, outsiders repeatedly mock Cássia’s class status, making every public appearance a threat to her pride. Airport, restaurant, and family scenes all become stages for humiliation, where claims of marriage, wealth, and identity are used as shields or weapons. Armando often steps in to defend Cássia, but his secrecy keeps her from trusting him fully. Suspicion deepens when his name is linked to a missing billionaire and later to hidden money, luxury cars, and a diamond ring. The family’s doubts and the rivals’ insults force Armando to prove himself through actions rather than explanations. Cássia begins to see that his support may be genuine, even as she remains wary of the lies surrounding him. Old romantic and social rivals, especially Sandro and Sonia, keep reopening wounds and turning private pain into public conflict. The tension escalates further when Mário returns as a wealthy and threatening figure who pressures Cássia to choose him and tries to control the situation through power and money. Violence, coercion, and revenge enter the story, showing that the struggle is no longer only about love or status but also about safety and control. Armando survives attacks and continues to protect Cássia, but his refusal to be fully honest keeps their relationship unstable. His eventual exposure as the new executive director of Rodrigues Group overturns the social hierarchy and humiliates those who mocked him. That revelation brings corporate power into the romance and forces Cássia to confront how much of their relationship was built on concealment. By the end of the batch, love remains central, but it is strained by betrayal, pride, and the question of whether trust can survive the truth.

der-unbekannte-erbe-des-milliardenimperi.title: Der unbekannte Erbe des Milliardenimperiums
der-unbekannte-erbe-des-milliardenimperi.description: Nachdem seine Freundin ihn für einen Milliardär verlässt, entdeckt Lieferfahrer Cole Marsh, dass er der geheime Erbe des Reeves-Vermögens ist. Doch um sein Erbe zu erhalten, muss er innerhalb von 30 Tagen heiraten. Eine Scheinehe mit seiner besten Freundin Jade führt ihn in ein gefährliches Spiel aus Familienintrigen, verborgenen Identitäten und unerwarteter Liebe. Nun muss Cole beweisen, dass wahrer Wert nicht vom Geld abhängt.

das-comeback-der-eiskonigin.title: Das Comeback der Eiskönigin
das-comeback-der-eiskonigin.description: Fünf Jahre nachdem ihre Halbschwester Grace ihre Kür gestohlen und ihre Karriere zerstört hat, kehrt Hannah Wells aufs Eis zurück. Nachdem sie Leo, den Sohn des kalten Milliardärs John Logan, rettet, wird sie seine private Trainerin. Während Grace und Hannahs Ex sie erneut demütigen, stellt sich John schützend vor sie. Mit seiner Hilfe und Leos Vertrauen wagt Hannah ein riskantes Comeback, um sich ihren Namen zurückzuholen.

jeder-schlag-macht-mich-starker.title: Jeder Schlag macht mich stärker
jeder-schlag-macht-mich-starker.description: An der St. Jude’s-Kampakademie herrschen kybernetische Eliten über machtlose Stipendiaten. Doch der unterschätzte Kai besitzt eine besondere Fähigkeit: Er kann die Energie von Angriffen absorbieren und dadurch stärker werden. Gemeinsam mit Clara stellt er sich korrupten Autoritäten und mächtigen Erben. Mit jedem Kampf entwickelt sich sein Körper weiter, während eine geheimnisvolle Macht in ihm erwacht, die die gesamte Ordnung der Akademie bedroht.

billionaire-genz-vs-neta-ji.title: Billionaire GenZ v/s Neta Ji
billionaire-genz-vs-neta-ji.description: After his girlfriend commits suicide over a leaked exam paper, a spoiled billionaire's son loses his wealth, survives a brutal public humiliation, and uses his remaining resources to lead a massive student rebellion against a corrupt politician, culminating in a deadly race against time.

der-verborgene-gott-von-elyndor.title: Der verborgene Gott von Elyndor
der-verborgene-gott-von-elyndor.description: Caius Drenmere gilt als betrunkener Spieler und Schande seiner Adelsfamilie. Doch hinter seiner sorglosen Fassade verbirgt sich der legendäre Spektralphönix, Elyndors mächtigster Beschützer. Während Feinde das Reich bedrohen, kämpft Caius heimlich gegen tödliche Magier. Als seine wahre Macht enthüllt wird, muss er die Mörder seines Vaters stellen und Elyndor vor dem Untergang retten.

jungle-ke-us-paar.title: Jungle Ke Us Paar
jungle-ke-us-paar.description: Rashmika returns to Devgarh for her wedding, unaware that a 700-year-old curse is waiting for her. A deadly supernatural lover believes she is the reincarnation of his lost love and wants her back at any cost. As the past comes alive, Rashmika must fight to escape a love that refuses to die.

傷ついた兵士と結婚したら、実は公爵でした.title: 傷ついた兵士と結婚したら、実は公爵でした
傷ついた兵士と結婚したら、実は公爵でした.slug: 傷ついた兵士と結婚したら、実は公爵でした
傷ついた兵士と結婚したら、実は公爵でした.description: 継母に虐げられ、婚約者ジェラルドにも裏切られたアシュボーン王国の王女ジュリアナは、身分の低い一人の兵士と結婚する。嫉妬深い義姉妹クラリッサの陰謀に苦しめられる中、治癒の力で公爵夫人を救ったジュリアナは、無実の罪で投獄されてしまう。すべてを失ったと思ったその時、平凡な兵士だと思っていた夫の驚くべき正体が明らかになる。
傷ついた兵士と結婚したら、実は公爵でした.url: https://kukutv.app/show/傷ついた兵士と結婚したら、実は公爵でした

追放された貴族の神なる力.slug: 追放された貴族の神なる力
追放された貴族の神なる力.description: 酒と賭博に溺れる一族の恥として嘲笑される貴族カイアス。しかし、その正体は王国エリンドール最強の守護者「スペクトラル・フェニックス」だった。東方の勢力が王国を脅かす中、彼は正体を隠して魔術師たちと戦い続ける。やがて王者の試練で真の力が暴かれた時、カイアスは父を死に追いやった者たちに立ち向かい、滅亡の危機にある王国を救うため覚醒する。
追放された貴族の神なる力.url: https://kukutv.app/show/追放された貴族の神なる力

laut-aayi-woh.title: Laut Aayi Woh
laut-aayi-woh.description: After a greedy husband murders his wife for her land, her mother binds her soul to a temporary, non-fatal Life-Tether, but her terrifying supernatural revenge can only begin once her family gathers and offers three physical Murder Tokens before the connection drains her mother's strength.

無能と呼ばれた俺の覚醒.title: 無能と呼ばれた俺の覚醒
無能と呼ばれた俺の覚醒.slug: 無能と呼ばれた俺の覚醒
無能と呼ばれた俺の覚醒.description: サイボーグ化したエリートが支配する聖ジュード武闘学園。無能力の奨学生として見下されてきたカイには、攻撃の運動エネルギーを吸収し、自らの力へ変える特殊な能力があった。強敵と戦うほど進化していくカイは、学園の“女神”クララと共に、腐敗した権力者や残酷な御曹司たちに立ち向かう。やがて彼の中に眠る謎の力が覚醒し、学園の支配構造そのものを揺るがしていく。
無能と呼ばれた俺の覚醒.url: https://kukutv.app/show/無能と呼ばれた俺の覚醒

cursed-heir-hidden-god-1.title: Cursed Heir, Hidden God
cursed-heir-hidden-god-1.description: In the war-torn kingdom of Elendor, disgraced nobleman Caius Drenmore is mocked as a weak gambler and unworthy heir. When the Sovereign Trials begin to find the kingdom’s greatest defender, Caius is forced into the competition while hiding a terrifying secret,he is the legendary Spectral Phoenix. As family betrayal, royal conspiracies and forbidden magic threaten Elendor, Caius must reveal his true power and decide what kind of ruler he will become

追放された氷上の女王.title: 追放された氷上の女王
追放された氷上の女王.slug: 追放された氷上の女王
追放された氷上の女王.description: 異母妹グレースに革新的な演技を盗まれ、スケート界から追放されたハンナ。5年後、彼女は偶然助けた少年レオをきっかけに、冷徹な億万長者ジョンの住み込みコーチとなる。グレースと元恋人ディーンが再び彼女を陥れようとする中、ジョンはハンナを守り、レオも心を開いていく。二人の支えを力に、ハンナは奪われた名誉を取り戻すため、再び氷上へと立つ。
追放された氷上の女王.url: https://kukutv.app/show/追放された氷上の女王

貧乏配達員の秘密の遺産.title: 貧乏配達員の秘密の遺産
貧乏配達員の秘密の遺産.slug: 貧乏配達員の秘密の遺産
貧乏配達員の秘密の遺産.description: 貧しい配達員コール・マーシュは、恋人に億万長者を選ばれ捨てられる。だが突然、自分がリーヴス家の莫大な財産を継ぐ隠し後継者だと知る。ただし相続の条件は、30日以内に結婚すること。親友ジェイドとの偽装結婚を選んだコールだったが、やがて一族の陰謀、隠された正体、そして予想外の恋に巻き込まれていく。
貧乏配達員の秘密の遺産.url: https://kukutv.app/show/貧乏配達員の秘密の遺産

exilado-solar-renascido-eclipse.title: Exilado Solar: Renascido Eclipse
exilado-solar-renascido-eclipse.description: Marcada como “dessintonizada” e jogada nas criptas ao nascer, Vivienne sobrevive escondida, criada pelo desonrado guardião Gideon. Vinte anos depois, disfarçada de acólita, ela invade a Catedral para libertar sua mãe Lenore de uma maldição imposta pela cruel sacerdotisa Amara. Ocultando seu fogo solar proibido, Vivienne inicia uma revolta e enfrenta o mortal Sifão Lunar — até sua chama explodir.

the-billionaires-ice-queen-3.title: The Billionaire's Ice Queen
the-billionaires-ice-queen-3.description: Once a rising figure-skating prodigy, Hannah Wells is blacklisted after Grace Ivers steals her choreography and destroys her career. Five years later, billionaire John Logan gives Hannah a chance to reclaim the ice while she helps his traumatized son, Leo, rediscover his confidence. But as Dean and Grace fight to bury Hannah’s past, her comeback threatens to expose the powerful conspiracy that ruined her life.

princesa-gelida-fenix-ardente.title: Princesa Gélida, Fênix Ardente
princesa-gelida-fenix-ardente.description: Num mundo congelado onde calor significa sobrevivência, Kaelen Sterling controla a energia do reino, mas cortesãos corruptos liderados por Silas Cole drenam seu poder e sua sanidade. Anya Mercer, uma criada das favelas, toma o lugar da meia-irmã como refém para salvar seu povo. Unida a Kaelen por um ardente laço de almas, ela o ajuda a enfrentar seus parasitas e descobre um salvador por trás do monstro.

the-house-she-inherited.title: The House She Inherited
the-house-she-inherited.description: After her mother's tragic death, a young woman is forced to marry a ruthless gangster who wants her home; when she makes the ultimate sacrifice to protect her dignity, her estranged allies unite to expose the powerful mastermind behind her destruction.

esposa-do-chefao-segredos.title: Esposa do Chefão: Segredos
esposa-do-chefao-segredos.description: A blind or near-blind mother fights to keep her children alive in a dockside slum where taxes, gangs, and corrupt officials make ordinary survival impossible. From the start, the family is forced to hide under floors, flee burning blocks, and bargain with dangerous men just to avoid being found. The mother can identify threats by sound and instinct, which helps her survive raids even when armed enforcers search the home. A smuggler ally named Leo becomes part of the escape effort, helping shape risky plans when roads are blocked and the waterfront turns into a war zone. The family’s situation worsens when the children are marked with a crescent-moon sign that seems tied to a dangerous bloodline. That mark draws the attention of criminals and power brokers who begin treating the children as leverage, heirs, or targets. As the pressure builds, the mother’s hidden identity keeps resurfacing, and enemies accuse her of ties to Dominic and other past connections. The conflict expands beyond simple escape into a struggle over lineage, ownership, and who has the right to claim the children. Marcus Hale and his crew push their own power plays at the docks, while Cassandra schemes to use a false heir and infiltrate Dominic’s bloodline from within. The children are repeatedly threatened, captured, or used as bargaining chips, forcing the adults into direct confrontations. In one stretch, a warehouse rescue turns into a fire-and-gunfire escape as trapped children are freed and chased toward the shoreline. Even when the family gets away briefly, armed men continue to hunt them, and the waterfront remains unstable and violent. The mother refuses to surrender her children, even when the cost is captivity, exposure, or death. Later, Nora is brought into the center of the conflict, and Dominic confronts her over children he claims are tied to his bloodline. Their reunion is shaped by seven years of grief, disappearance, and unresolved accusations. By the end of the batch, the children are again taken under armed control, and the crescent-moon marks have made their survival even more precarious. The show’s core tension is whether family bonds can survive the criminal world’s obsession with bloodline, control, and revenge.

the-hacking-game.title: The Hacking Game
the-hacking-game.description: PitchA quiet IT assistant secretly hiding his identity as the world’s most powerful hacker must wage a shadow war against his wife’s corrupt tech empire after they steal his revolutionary defense software—before his double life destroys his marriage.

rent-a-boyfriend.title: Rent A Boyfriend
rent-a-boyfriend.description: Tired of being her family’s disappointment, Natalie hires Noah, a charming boyfriend-for-hire, to fake the perfect relationship and help her win her beloved lake house. But as staged kisses turn into real feelings, family sabotage and Noah’s mysterious connection to her past threaten everything. What began as a contract soon becomes a fight for Natalie’s inheritance, self-worth, and a love that was never supposed to be real.

soldado-era-duque-disfarcado.title: Soldado Era Duque Disfarçado
soldado-era-duque-disfarcado.description: Maltratada pela madrasta e traída pelo noivo Gerald, a princesa Juliana de Ashborne se casa com um humilde soldado. Sua invejosa meia-irmã Clarissa transforma sua vida em um pesadelo. Após usar seus dons de cura para salvar uma duquesa, Juliana é presa injustamente. Quando toda esperança parece perdida, a verdadeira identidade de seu marido revela um segredo inimaginável.

protetor-sombrio-meu-assassino.title: Protetor Sombrio, Meu Assassino
protetor-sombrio-meu-assassino.description: Os cruéis Anciãos de Blackwood exigem a execução dos iniciados desonrados. Para salvar Isadora em segredo, o Grande Árbitro Gideon fecha o Santuário e a submete a íntimos rituais de purificação. Marcada por um selo que queima sua carne, ela finge obediência enquanto usa magia proibida para mudar as regras. Conforme outros morrem, nasce um vínculo sombrio entre Isadora e seu captor.

goa-king.title: Goa King
goa-king.description: தன்னைத் தூக்கி எறிந்த குடும்பத்தைத் தேடிச் செல்லும் ஒரு திறமையான சூதாடி, தான் ஒரு பிரம்மாண்டமான 'கேசினோ' (Casino) சாம்ராஜ்யத்தின் வாரிசு என்பதைக் கண்டறிகிறான். ஆபத்தான எதிரிகள் சூழ்ந்துகொள்ள, தன்னை நிராகரித்த அதே குடும்பத்தைக் காப்பாற்றி தனக்கான அரியணையை அவன் எப்படி மீட்டெடுக்கிறான் என்பதே கதை.

ajeyudu.title: Ajeyudu
ajeyudu.description:
సూర్య పన్నెండేళ్లుగా తన గతాన్ని దాచుకుని కుమార్తె తాన్విని పెంచుతుంటాడు. కాలేజీలో తాన్విని ప్రభావవంతమైన కుటుంబాల పిల్లలు వేధించి, చివరకు అండర్‌వరల్డ్ డాన్‌కు అప్పగిస్తారు.

కూతురిని కాపాడేందుకు సూర్య మళ్లీ “యోధ”గా మారి శత్రువులపై విరుచుకుపడతాడు. కానీ ఈ పోరాటం వెనుక తన భార్య సోనాలి మరణానికి సంబంధించిన పెద్ద కుట్ర ఉందని తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

తాన్వి కోసం మొదలైన యుద్ధం... ఇప్పుడు సోనాలి మరణం వెనుక నిజాన్ని బయటపెట్టే పోరాటంగా మారుతుంది.

irma-rouba-noivo-bilionario.title: Irmã Rouba Noivo Bilionário
irma-rouba-noivo-bilionario.description: Ellie Whitmore amou Damian Vale em segredo por seis anos, até ele escolher sua irmã. No dia do casamento, ela troca de lugar no altar e foge para um casamento por conveniência com um herdeiro político “em coma”. Mas Damian se recusa a deixá-la partir, e a verdade sobre quem realmente o traiu ameaça destruir duas das famílias mais poderosas do país.

rickshaw-wale-ki-dulhaniya-1.title: Rickshaw Wale Ki Dulhaniya
rickshaw-wale-ki-dulhaniya-1.description:
A runaway bride with a gun. A rickshaw driver fleeing dangerous goons. One chaotic collision in the crowded streets of Lucknow pulls two complete strangers into each other's lives in the most unexpected way.
With secrets on both sides, mistaken identities, and trouble at every turn, their worlds keep colliding — whether they like it or not.
This is a story of two misfits, one mad city, and the chaos that secretly looks a lot like love.

disfarce-para-o-amor.title: Disfarce para o Amor
disfarce-para-o-amor.description: Clara is a gifted painter whose life is narrowed by her desperate need to save her sister Lily’s treatment. When her work is dismissed as technically perfect but emotionally empty, she is pulled into a coercive bargain with a powerful patron who offers money and care in exchange for control over her art and freedom. The arrangement places her under strict supervision in the patron’s house and studio, where painting becomes both survival and punishment. Clara is repeatedly pushed to expose herself emotionally, while the patron uses rules, intimacy, and pressure to keep her compliant. Lily’s worsening condition remains the central leverage, making every refusal feel dangerous. Clara resists being treated as property, but the contract keeps her trapped between dependence and self-respect. Around her, other figures complicate the struggle: one ally warns her she is being manipulated, while others try to exploit the situation through money, threats, or public exposure. The art world itself becomes a battleground, with galleries, private rooms, and exhibitions all turning into places of surveillance and humiliation. A missing contract, frozen accounts, and threats to Lily’s funding raise the stakes and expose how fragile Clara’s position really is. Public scandal erupts when private secrets are dragged into the open, and Clara is forced to confront how deeply her life has been shaped by control. The revelation does not free her cleanly, but it does push her to reject being defined as a possession or fraud. She returns to the conflict on her own terms, insisting that her art and identity cannot be separated. At the same time, the bond with the patron shifts from pure coercion into something more openly romantic, though still shadowed by power imbalance and fear. He tries to push her away for her safety, but Clara refuses a life built on silence and concealment. Their private confrontations reveal that both have hidden behind rules and restraint to avoid real attachment. By the end, the formal contract is no longer the whole story, and the emotional bond between them is acknowledged as real love and belonging. Yet the cost of that bond, and the danger surrounding Lily’s treatment and Clara’s reputation, remain unresolved.

ex-ro-chakkar.title: Ex Ro Chakkar
ex-ro-chakkar.description: Aaditya khud ri zindagi ri shuruaat naya siraa su kare hai, jad biki ex-girlfriend Anushka bine chodar chali jave hai, pan kai saala baad Anushka biki boss banar pachi lot aave hai ar ab va Aditya ne pacho pane khatir har had paar kar deve hai, jad Aaditya bise rishto rakhne su mana kar deve hai to shuru hove hai Anushka ro jhutho ar khatarnak khel lekin Aaditya ar Malvika ro sacho pyaar Anuskha re jhuta ilzaama ro samno kare hai ar Anushka ro jhuto case ro pardofash kare hai.

snehada-kadalalli.title: Snehada Kadalalli
snehada-kadalalli.description: A wealthy heir disguises himself as a bodyguard to find genuine love, but his plan becomes complicated when a gold-digging woman targets him while he grows closer to a sincere young designer.

rei-odiado-de-marte.title: Rei Odiado de Marte
rei-odiado-de-marte.description: Arthur, um engenheiro da Terra, cai em Marte e desperta no corpo do rei Solis, um tirano cruel odiado por seu próprio povo. Enquanto o sistema de oxigênio da colônia entra em colapso, ele precisa usar seus conhecimentos para salvar Marte sem revelar sua verdadeira identidade. Ao conquistar a confiança da rainha Vanya e do príncipe Julian, Arthur enfrenta um general disposto a tomar o trono — e um sistema de segurança capaz de provar que ele não é o verdadeiro rei.

the-teen-queen-2.title: The Teen Queen
the-teen-queen-2.description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. When billionaire heiress Tanisha Merchant hides her identity to live as an ordinary student, a poor girl, Mahira, is mistaken for the real heiress and embraces the lie. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

roubaram-o-sol.title: Roubaram o Sol
roubaram-o-sol.description: Uma gênia de uma era futura desperta no corpo de uma nobre morta e herda uma identidade roubada, um pai paralítico, um avô enlouquecido e uma irmã que tomou seu rosto e seu lugar no trono. Armada com técnicas médicas proibidas e desconhecidas naquele mundo, ela constrói uma clínica secreta nas favelas, enfrenta o brilhante investigador que está em seu encalço e luta para recuperar seu lar — um ponto preciso e mortal de cada vez.

the-billionaires-ice-queen-2.title: The Billionaire's Ice Queen
the-billionaires-ice-queen-2.description: பனிச்சறுக்கு வீராங்கனை ஹன்னா வெல்ஸின் நடன அமைப்பை திருடி, அவரது வாழ்க்கையை அழிக்கிறார் கிரேஸ் ஐவர்ஸ். இதனால் களத்திலிருந்து ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட ஹன்னாவிற்கு ஐந்து ஆண்டுகள் கழித்து கோடீஸ்வரர் ஜான் லோகன் ஒரு வாய்ப்பை தருகிறார். அதற்குப் பதிலாக அவர் மகன் லியோவிற்கு உதவ வேண்டும். ஆனால் டீனும் கிரேஸும் சேர்ந்து ஹன்னாவின் மறுபிரவேசத்தைத் தடுக்க புதிய சதிவலை பின்னுகின்றனர். தன் வாழ்க்கையை அழித்த துரோகத்தை உடைத்து, ஹன்னா மீண்டும் தன் புகழை மீட்டெடுப்பாரா என்பதே விறுவிறுப்பான கதைக்களம்.

bound-to-the-imperial-strategist.title: Bound To The Imperial Strategist
bound-to-the-imperial-strategist.description: Bound by a forbidden blood contract, a cold Imperial Strategist must control a rare Living Relic wahose unique, magic-devouring power is prophesied to either save the world or destroy it. As a four-faction war erupts, their forced alliance turns from cold tactical calculation to a fierce, protective bond.

guardian-of-kalyug-ashvatthamas-rise.title: Guardian of Kalyug : Ashvatthama's Rise
guardian-of-kalyug-ashvatthamas-rise.description: A struggling Mumbai reporter discovers he is the reincarnated Lipikaar, a sacred writer of the gods. He must ally with the cursed, immortal warrior Ashvatthama to stop a corrupt tycoon from using ancient relics to control the nation's environment.

chhota-aryan-1.title: Chhota Aryan
chhota-aryan-1.description: When a young genius travels back in time, he gets a second chance to rewrite his family's destiny. Using his future knowledge, he helps his struggling father become rich, takes revenge on those who looked down on them including his Betraying Mother, and secretly plays cupid between his father and a beautiful CEO.

samrat-ki-wapsi.title: Samrat ki wapsi
samrat-ki-wapsi.description: After seven years of war, Karan Sharma returns home as the legendary Dev Samrat, only to discover that his wife Siddhi has been subjected to humiliation and that their daughter has been taken by the powerful Thakur family. As Karan begins his ruthless fight to protect his family and settle the score for the destruction of his clan, his enemies are forced to confront the true power of the man they once dismissed as a failure.

la-novia-olvidada-del-dragon.title: La Novia Olvidada del Dragón
la-novia-olvidada-del-dragon.description: Ethan Ashborne, un misterioso joven de las montañas que habla el antiguo idioma de los dragones, sorprende al mundo al domar un Dragón Anciano. Al llegar a la finca Hayes, descubre que estaba prometido con Isabelle y que todos lo creían muerto. Mientras alguien con su rostro comete crímenes, Ethan desvela secretos antiguos y una conspiración que amenaza su identidad y el reino.

the-mad-magician.title: The Mad Magician
the-mad-magician.description: Zhou Ke, an ordinary commoner, awakens the legendary Joker Divine Card, unlocking the powers of every Divine Card. At the Superpower Academy, he battles powerful rivals and deadly assassins while uncovering the secrets of the sinister Skull Society. As the truth behind his parents’ deaths and the mythical Oracle Skull emerges, Zhou Ke must master his power before it consumes him.

cursed-heir-hidden-god-2.title: Cursed Heir, Hidden God
cursed-heir-hidden-god-2.description:
போரினால் சிதைந்த எலெண்டோரில், கயஸ் ட்ரென்மோர் ஒரு பயனற்ற சூதாடியாக ஏளனம் செய்யப்படுகிறான். ஆனால், அவனது பலவீனமான முகமூடிக்கு பின்னால் ஒரு பயங்கர ரகசியம் ஒளிந்துள்ளது—அவனே சாம்பலிலிருந்து எழும் புராண நாயகன் ஸ்பெக்ட்ரல் பீனிக்ஸ்.

நாட்டின் சிறந்த பாதுகாவலனைத் தேடும் 'சார்பான் சோதனைகள்' தொடங்க, கயஸ் களமிறங்க நேரிடுகிறது. துரோகங்களும் கொடூர மாயங்களும் நாட்டை அச்சுறுத்த, அவன் தன் சக்தியை வெளிப்படுத்தி எப்படிப்பட்ட மன்னனாக மாறுவான் என்பதை நோக்கியே இந்த வீரம் நிறைந்த யுத்தம் பயணிக்கிறது.

the-fighters-debt.title: The Fighter's Debt
the-fighters-debt.description:
After serving three years for his younger brother’s crime, boxer Chase Taylor returns to South
Philadelphia with nothing but strict parole, a fractured family, and a night shift at his uncle’s
diner. When a ruthless lending syndicate targets the neighborhood, Chase joins forces with property attorney Boni Green, using defaulted debt notes and courthouse records to fight back. But betrayal, a murder frame-up, and his own violent instincts threaten to send him back to prison.

the-bowl-that-prints-money.title: The Bowl That Prints Money
the-bowl-that-prints-money.description: After losing his entire inheritance to the woman he loved, a broken food delivery rider receives a mysterious bowl that can multiply anything placed inside it. But every miracle comes at an invisible cost—it erases one cherished memory from his life. As he rises from poverty to unimaginable wealth, he slowly discovers that the greatest price of greed is not losing money, but losing himself. Watch now!

trapped-on-the-billionaires-island.title: Trapped on the Billionaire's Island
trapped-on-the-billionaires-island.description: After escaping her obsessive ex-fiancé and winning a dream vacation on a secluded island, a hyper-observant young woman begins noticing impossible warnings and deadly sabotage around her—only to realize her ex has escaped prison and followed her there, turning paradise into a hunting ground.

meu-novo-marido-e-o-rival-bilionario-do-.title: Meu Novo Marido É o Rival Bilionário do Meu Ex
meu-novo-marido-e-o-rival-bilionario-do-.description: A vida de Emma Bennett desmorona ao flagrar o noivo com sua meia-irmã. Antes que possa desmascará-los, a madrasta a acusa de trair a empresa e coloca seu próprio pai contra ela. Deserdada e humilhada, Emma precisa recomeçar do zero. Porém, com segredos vindo à tona e a ajuda inesperada de um bilionário, ela inicia uma luta implacável para recuperar seu legado e se vingar.

the-raven-kings-bride.title: The Raven King's Bride
the-raven-kings-bride.description: Princess Elara, betrayed by her fiancé and stripped of her magic, is forced to marry the feared Raven King, Lord Vane. Bound to him for survival in the toxic Black Highlands, she discovers his fierce protection—and that he is the boy she once saved. As trust turns to love, Elara restores her magic, defeats her scheming cousin, and rises beside Vane as the powerful Raven Queen.

singham-daddy.title: Singham Daddy
singham-daddy.description: A feared ex-convict returns after a decade in prison to save his estranged daughter from a life of abuse, but as he battles her tormentors, he must also overcome her hatred and the haunting consequences of his own violent past.

the-billionaires-ice-queen-1.title: The Billionaire's Ice Queen
the-billionaires-ice-queen-1.description: Once a rising figure-skating prodigy, Hannah Wells is blacklisted after Grace Ivers steals her choreography and destroys her career. Five years later, billionaire John Logan gives Hannah a chance to reclaim the ice while she helps his traumatized son, Leo, rediscover his confidence. But as Dean and Grace fight to bury Hannah’s past, her comeback threatens to expose the powerful conspiracy that ruined her life.

mahadheera.title: Mahadheera
mahadheera.description: After being betrayed and killed for a divine locket, Dheeraj is sent five years into the past and gets a second chance to reclaim his stolen power and destiny. As he rises from jail to the world of Mahagurus, his revenge turns into a supernatural war against ancient stones, dark forces and a destiny leading to Dev Lok.

protocolo-supremo.title: Protocolo Supremo
protocolo-supremo.description: Traído pela esposa e humilhado publicamente pelo amante milionário dela, Jordan Mercer, um técnico de servidores em dificuldades, parece ter perdido tudo. Porém, uma herança mantida em segredo revela que ele é o herdeiro bilionário e verdadeiro controlador da Apex Ledger, a maior rede blockchain do mundo. Com a ajuda de uma investigadora federal, Jordan desmantela o império corrupto que arruinou sua vida, expõe as fraudes e recupera seu poder com inteligência, não vingança.

limit-crossed-2.title: Limit Crossed
limit-crossed-2.description: சுயமரியாதைக்காகப் போராடி வீட்டை விட்டு துரத்தப்படும் ஒரு இல்லத்தரசி, தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள். எதிர்பாராதவிதமாக ஒரு பணக்காரருடன் அவள் செய்யும் மர்மமான 'ஒப்பந்தத் திருமணம்', அவளது அடையாளம், கௌரவம் மற்றும் துரோகிகளுக்கான பழிவாங்கலின் அதிரடிப் போர்க்களமாக மாறுகிறது.

la-novia-del-rey-vampiro.title: La Novia del Rey Vampiro
la-novia-del-rey-vampiro.description: Traicionada y asesinada por su hermana y su compañero, la princesa de sangre dorada Anna recibe una segunda oportunidad. Esta vez despierta al Primer Vampiro, un dios sellado durante siglos. Juntos engendran nueve hijos primordiales que el mundo considera monstruos. Ahora Anna deberá proteger a su familia, recuperar el trono y destruir todo imperio que intente cazarlos. La venganza tiene una nueva reina.

o-guardiao-do-acervo.title: O Guardião do Acervo
o-guardiao-do-acervo.description: Acusado injustamente de matar seu mentor pelo corrupto diretor de museu Alistair Croft, o restaurador Julian Vance assume o codinome “O Curador” na dark web. Com a ajuda da mecenas Beatrice Vandermere e do químico Dr. Finch, ele cria falsificações perfeitas para destruir o império de Croft. Cercado por bloqueios, traições e armadilhas, Julian leva a guerra até as docas, onde transforma uma emboscada mortal em sua armadilha definitiva.

delivery-boy-na-prem-kahaani.title: Delivery Boy Na Prem Kahaani
delivery-boy-na-prem-kahaani.description: When a struggling delivery boy, who is secretly the heir to a massive business empire—enters a contract marriage with a hotel CEO to protect her from a corporate takeover, he must navigate high-society humiliation and deadly conspiracies to save her legacy and claim his true identity.

sangue-de-ouro-o-despertar-do-soberano.title: Sangue de Ouro: O Despertar do Soberano
sangue-de-ouro-o-despertar-do-soberano.description: Vivian Ashworth begins as a cast-out heiress whose family fortune has been seized and whose bloodline is marked for extraction. The people around her are divided between betrayal, control, and uneasy loyalty, with Tyler Sterling standing as the clearest rival and the ruling council backing the attempt to take what is hers. Rather than flee, Vivian stays in the fight and uses her scientific training and her father’s notes to search for a cure to the suppressors and toxins used against her family. Her work is dangerous and personal, and she repeatedly chooses self-experimentation over safety. One such experiment explodes, but it also awakens a latent ability to detect and correct corruption in blood. That power is unstable, so the story shifts into a broader biotech struggle over whether her healing gift can be controlled, stolen, or weaponized. As the pressure rises, Vivian is forced into forbidden protocols that link her survival to another person’s pain and life force. Alexander Voss emerges as the key protector in that bond, first as a compatible guardian and then as the sealed super-soldier Vivian claims through an ancient sovereign bond. At the same time, Corey and other allies help her hide recoveries, disrupt searches, and keep the council from seizing her advantage. Tyler and council-backed forces keep pressing for extraction, surrender, and control, turning the conflict into open corporate and military warfare. Vivian also discovers that Tyler’s medical empire was built on stolen family research and erased ownership of biocellular code. Public exposure, official records, and live broadcasts begin to undermine Tyler’s claims and strengthen Vivian’s side. The struggle expands from secret lab work to bunker sieges, mansion takeovers, vault raids, and public confrontations. Vivian’s awakening and restored family power make her no longer a passive target but an active threat to the regime. By the end of the batch, she has reclaimed enough ground to challenge Tyler openly and declare revenge, even as the bond, the inheritance system, and the war over her bloodline remain dangerous and unresolved.

countdown-king-3.title: Countdown King
countdown-king-3.description: வறுமையும் துரோகமும் சூழ்ந்த டெலிவரி பாய் அனுஜின் வாழ்க்கை, ஒரு விபத்திற்குப் பின் மாறுகிறது. மனிதர்களின் மரண நேரம், நோய்கள், பழம்பொருட்களின் மதிப்பு, பங்குச்சந்தை எதிர்காலம் என அனைத்தையும் காணும் சக்தி அவனுக்குக் கிடைக்கிறது. நகரத்தையே ஆளும் கிங்மேக்கராக அவன் விஸ்வரூபம் எடுக்க, ஏளனம் செய்த மனைவியும் ஊரும் பணிகிறது. ஆனால், இத்தகைய அசுர சக்திக்கு அவன் செலுத்த வேண்டிய கொடூரமான விலை என்ன?

revenge-of-raja-saab.title: Revenge of Raja Saab
revenge-of-raja-saab.description: A devoted father is humiliated for his modest life until the shocking truth reveals he is actually a Prince, a powerful business tycoon. As he secretly supports his wife’s success, while hiding his identity, betrayal, ego, and love collide, pushing their relationship to the edge of divorce.

o-aluno-novo-que-vale-trilhoes.title: O Aluno Novo que Vale Trilhões
o-aluno-novo-que-vale-trilhoes.description: Emma Hart, assassinada ao lado do pai em sua vida anterior, volta no tempo e desperta justamente no dia de sua transferência para a Academia Aethelgard. Dotada de uma psicometria dolorosa — um poder que revela as histórias ocultas nos objetos —, ela passa a desvendar as conspirações da elite enquanto enfrenta seus traumas e a sobrecarga provocada por seus sentidos.
