frozen-wife.title: Frozen Wife
frozen-wife.description: கணவர் தீரஜ் துரோகம் செய்துவிட்டதாக தவறாக நம்பும் மருத்துவர் அம்ரிதா, பல தசாப்தங்களுக்குத் தன்னை உறையவைக்கும் ஆபத்தான 'கிரையோஜெனிக்' சோதனையில் இறங்க முடிவெடுக்கிறார். ஆனால், அந்தத் துரோகமே ஒரு மூன்றாம் நபரால் பின்னப்பட்ட சதி என்பதை அறியாமல், அவளைக் காப்பாற்ற தீரஜ் மரண ஓட்டம் பிடிக்கிறான்.

casei-com-um-medico-letal.title: Casei com um Médico Letal
casei-com-um-medico-letal.description: Dra. Chloe Thompson, uma brilhante residente de cirurgia sem recursos, entra no prestigiado programa de trauma do Lakefront Memorial e se torna alvo da poderosa família Mercer. Protegida pelo temido Dr. Josh Mercer, ela descobre uma conspiração que o incriminou e ameaça inúmeras vidas. Unidos, eles enfrentam corrupção, traições e um amor proibido para revelar a verdade e recuperar seus futuros.

30-days-with-a-gangster.title: 30 Days with a Gangster
30-days-with-a-gangster.description: A simple act of kindness turns an ordinary girl's life upside down when she saves a wounded stranger, only to discover he is a ruthless gangster. Captivated by her, he demands marriage. When she refuses, he offers a daring ultimatum: a 30-day contract marriage. If she doesn't fall in love with him within a month, she is free to walk away. Will 30 days with a gangster spark an unexpected romance?

de-volta-ao-jogo-a-lenda.title: De Volta ao Jogo: A Lenda
de-volta-ao-jogo-a-lenda.description: Após ser banido pelo poderoso sindicato Fathom Climb, Levi, uma lenda da escalada livre, vive como limpador de janelas de arranha-céus e compete em segredo sob o codinome “Ledger”. Ao formar uma equipe de escaladores de rua, ele descobre que uma corporação lucra com os dados biométricos dos atletas. Agora, Levi terá de enfrentar uma elite corrupta, revelar a verdade e arriscar tudo para reconquistar seu lugar no topo.

oru-driver-kodeeshwaran.title: Oru Driver Kodeeshwaran
oru-driver-kodeeshwaran.description: A humble Mumbai cab driver, Vijay Pratap Singh, is publicly humiliated by Mumbai's elite at a luxury society auction — until they discover he is secretly a powerful billionaire. Hidden for 18 years to protect his son Samar and avenge his wife's murder, Vijay finally confronts the ruthless mafia kingpin Keshav Khanna, dismantling his empire and delivering long-awaited justice. Watch now.

king-in-disguise-2.title: King in Disguise
king-in-disguise-2.description: பத்து ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு வீடு திரும்பும் கோடீஸ்வர வாரிசு வேத், பிச்சைக்காரன் என அவமானப்படுத்தப்படுகிறான். தங்கையை காப்பாற்ற அனைத்தையும் பொறுத்துக்கொள்ளும் அவன், தனது உண்மை அடையாளம் வெளிவந்ததும் எதிரிகளின் உலகையே தலைகீழாக மாற்றுகிறான்.

segredos-a-luz-do-neon-vermelho.title: Segredos à Luz do Neon Vermelho
segredos-a-luz-do-neon-vermelho.description: Vendida a um clã de vampiros para pagar as dívidas da família, a esperta atriz Lora finge ser amante do cruel mafioso Dominic Thorne. Ao descobrir que ele está morrendo devido a uma maldição alquímica, o romance de fachada se torna real. Em meio a guerras e conspirações, Lora desperta poderes de cura e descobre que sua própria mãe é a mente por trás da maldição.

village-pellam-ceo-mogudu.title: Village Pellam CEO Mogudu
village-pellam-ceo-mogudu.description: A billionaire CEO is forced into a contract marriage with a fearless small-town girl to protect his family business, but as they desperately try to get divorced while hiding their true identities, love, corporate conspiracies, and greedy rivals turn their fake marriage into the biggest battle of their lives.

o-bilionario-esta-atras-do-meu-poder.title: O Bilionário Está Atrás do Meu Poder
o-bilionario-esta-atras-do-meu-poder.description: Eli Reyes, bolsista e jardineiro de uma escola de elite, luta para impedir o despejo da mãe viúva. Após ser humilhado pelo herdeiro Tyler Calloway, ele encontra a pulseira tecnológica do falecido pai e se torna “O Fantasma”. Com a ajuda de Maya, irmã de Tyler, Eli descobre roubos, assassinatos e uma conspiração ligada à família Calloway. Agora, eles planejam expor tudo antes que Eli seja capturado.

boss-behind-the-bars.title: Boss Behind The Bars
boss-behind-the-bars.description:
Betrayed by his greedy girlfriend Nikitha, billionaire Darshan sacrifices his identity and freedom, only to return from prison years later seeking a fresh start.

When he saves fearless single mother Vijaya and her daughter Keerthi, Darshan discovers the love and family he never had. But when Nikitha, his buried past, and a deadly conspiracy return, Darshan must face his enemies and expose the truth in a shocking final revelation.

autokarante-manavaatti.title: Autokarante Manavaatti
autokarante-manavaatti.description:
A runaway bride with a gun. A rickshaw driver fleeing dangerous goons. One chaotic collision in the crowded streets of Lucknow pulls two complete strangers into each other's lives in the most unexpected way.
With secrets on both sides, mistaken identities, and trouble at every turn, their worlds keep colliding — whether they like it or not.
This is a story of two misfits, one mad city, and the chaos that secretly looks a lot like love.

o-desconhecido-por-tras-da-mascara.title: O Desconhecido por Trás da Máscara
o-desconhecido-por-tras-da-mascara.description: Após a morte da avó, o modelo Cole Ash herda 42 diários misteriosos que revelam vidas ocultas, segredos enterrados e promessas inacabadas. Guiado por pistas que parecem prever seu futuro, ele embarca em uma perigosa jornada de redenção e conspiração. A cada nova descoberta, Cole precisa decidir se seguirá o caminho traçado por ela ou arriscará perder tudo o que sua avó tentou proteger.

my-mother-is-a-mafia-boss.title: My Mother Is A Mafia Boss
my-mother-is-a-mafia-boss.description: After her husband’s death, Samantha Moretti abandons her powerful criminal family to give her daughter Allison a normal life. But when Allison is targeted and repeatedly kidnapped by ruthless crime lord Dave Donovan, Sam is forced to become the fighter she once was. Reclaiming control of the Moretti empire, she wages war to destroy Donovan, but risks becoming the very monster she tried to escape.

a-academia-dos-deuses.title: A Academia dos Deuses
a-academia-dos-deuses.description: Aethon Hall, deuses condenados têm seus poderes arrancados por um cruel programa escolar. Oren Vael, o único aluno que se lembra da verdade, descobre que a formatura significa ser apagado para sempre. Ao se apaixonar por Sable, a mulher que um dia condenou, os dois desafiam o destino, recuperam seus poderes e iniciam uma guerra contra a força que controla o futuro.

the-outcast-brides-retribution.title: The Outcast Bride’s Retribution
the-outcast-brides-retribution.description:
The wasteland's law says "survive in pairs or die alone, she never told her husband the dead earth blooms at her touch."
When the warlord forces every exile into survival marriages, Christine picks a scarred, silent stranger to share a dead canyon homestead. What he doesn't know: she can pull water and crops from poisoned red clay. While he thinks he's protecting a broken exile, she's quietly building an empire, until the warlord comes to burn it down.

secret-big-bull-husband-1.title: Secret Big Bull Husband
secret-big-bull-husband-1.description: He loved her more than his own life. But when she chooses greed over love, the hidden billionaire unleashes a revenge that will leave his enemies with nothing.

o-ultimo-da-linhagem.title: O Último da Linhagem
o-ultimo-da-linhagem.description: Zane Morrow, um veterano de guerra falido e considerado sem poderes, ativa com seu sangue uma misteriosa placa militar e descobre ser o último herdeiro de uma linhagem sobre-humana. Caçado por uma organização secreta, ele revela uma conspiração por trás da guerra que devastou a humanidade. Agora, Zane terá que decidir até onde irá para salvar o mundo sem se tornar o poder que todos temem.

genius-delivery-boy-2.title: Genius Delivery Boy
genius-delivery-boy-2.description: A hidden billionaire living as a delivery man is betrayed and divorced by his ungrateful wife, leading him to reclaim his true identity as "Lord Singhania" to ruin his oppressors and find true love with a rival business tycoon.

memorias-que-nao-eram-minhas.title: Memórias que Não Eram Minhas
memorias-que-nao-eram-minhas.description: The story follows a chain of outsiders, defectors, and overlooked people who keep colliding with systems built to rank, trade, and discard them. In the Null Field and other hostile spaces, survival depends on rules that seem arbitrary until someone breaks them. A man who says he was sent to die instead becomes the one person able to save others, while a commander struggles to hold a defense together as powers fail and danger closes in. Again and again, characters who are mocked as useless or low-status turn out to be the ones the system cannot predict. Some are cut off from networks, some are denied entry, and some are trapped in economies where memories, access, and even life experience can be bought or surrendered. That same instability creates openings, because broken chips, blackout conditions, and hidden routes can reverse the balance of power. The show keeps widening its mystery through questions of identity and recognition, including a face-swap confrontation and warnings about a dangerous figure who must not be seen. At the same time, prophecy and hidden knowledge suggest that these events are not random, but part of a larger trap already in motion. Serena’s impossible vision of a man arriving before he should have been there reinforces the sense that fate and manipulation are intertwined. Elsewhere, teams race through underground corridors, shifting mazes, guarded buildings, and sealed facilities in search of registers, records, and vaults that control what truth is allowed to exist. These searches are always under pressure, with countdowns, audits, and threats of violence forcing people to choose quickly. A father pleading for his children, a soldier under interrogation, and an outsider who survives by staying unseen all show how harsh the power structures are. Even when alliances form, they are fragile and mixed with suspicion, because everyone seems to be hiding something. The sealed door that demands memory as payment makes the cost of knowledge literal, and the warning that no one returns raises the stakes further. Across the batch, secrecy becomes both protection and weapon, and silence can be as strategic as speech. By the end, the larger conflict feels less like a single battle than a widening conspiracy in which hidden systems, buried truths, and unstable loyalties keep pushing the outsiders toward a confrontation they do not fully understand.

drobsessive-fall-for-him-or-lose-your-mi.title: DR.OBSESSIVE: FALL FOR HIM OR LOSE YOUR MIND
drobsessive-fall-for-him-or-lose-your-mi.description: Trapped in a clinic that rewrites minds, programmer Maya fakes total devotion to the doctor obsessed with her, while secretly hacking the chip in her own brain. One wrong heartbeat and her fake love becomes real. One failed line of code and she loses herself forever. Can she escape before her memories are erased?

theo-the-last-weaver.title: My Useless Husband is actually a God
theo-the-last-weaver.description: Theo, the legendary “Last Weaver,” secretly keeps Maison Helena alive with Aether-Silk, a rare fabric that changes color with body heat and heartbeat. After enduring years of humiliation, his wife Helena divorces him, unaware he is the source of her success. Theo joins rival Diana to build a new fashion empire, while Helena and Marcus sabotage them. When Marcus targets the rare Living Bloom orchid, Theo fights to protect his art and bring his enemies to ruin.

o-apice-da-vinganca.title: O Ápice da Vingança
o-apice-da-vinganca.description: O lendário treinador de automobilismo Steve Jackman morre em um acidente suspeito e desperta no corpo de Coby Whitemore, herdeiro de uma poderosa família. Ao descobrir que ambas as tragédias foram planejadas pelo cruel Victor Whitemore, Steve assume a identidade de Coby. Entre corridas, corrupção e segredos, ele arriscará tudo para revelar a verdade, fazer justiça e destruir um império criminoso.

mis-varma.title: Mis Varma
mis-varma.description: Seeking a simple life, Varma hides her wealthy background and true identity. But things take a wild turn when her family driver's daughter steals the spotlight, pretending to be the elite Varma heir and showing off in their car. Varma quietly observes the charade until the perfect moment arrives. Watch as the real Varma steps out of the shadows, exposes the imposter's lies, and finally reveals who she truly is!

a-volta-por-cima-que-vale-bilhoes.title: A Volta por Cima que Vale Bilhões
a-volta-por-cima-que-vale-bilhoes.description: Após ser abandonado pela namorada, Cole Marsh sobrevive trabalhando como entregador até descobrir que um avô bilionário que ele nunca conheceu lhe deixou uma fortuna. De repente, Cole entra em um mundo de luxo, rivais cruéis e segredos de família. Para conquistar sua herança, ele terá que provar seu valor, enfrentar aqueles que querem roubar tudo e descobrir o legado que sempre lhe pertenceu.

asal-dhurandhar.title: Asal Dhurandhar
asal-dhurandhar.description: குடும்பத்திற்காக தன் பில்லியனர் அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து எளியவனாக வாழ்ந்த ஒருவன், பேராசை பிடித்த மனைவியால் ஏமாற்றப்பட்டு துரத்தப்பட, மீண்டும் தன் அசுர பலமிக்க கார்ப்பரேட் சிம்மாசனத்தை அடைந்து துரோகிகளை வீழ்த்தி, மகனுக்குப் பாடம் புகட்டி தன் சாம்ராஜ்யத்தை நிலைநிறுத்தும் பழிவாங்கல் கதை.

dead-to-them-alive-for-revenge.title: Dead To Them, Alive For Revenge
dead-to-them-alive-for-revenge.description: Ken ki chaalon mein aakar Kiara aur Lili ne Chen, jo ek successful designer tha, use apne hi Family se door kar diya. Chen ke designs churakar Ken ne uska naam bhi badnaam kiya. Ek haadse ke baad Chen ko mara hua samajhkar sab pachtane lage. Lekin Chen zinda tha aur ek nayi pehchaan ke saath wapas laut chuka tha. Jab Ken ka sach sabke saamne aaya, Kiara aur Lili ne Chen se maafi maangi, par kya toota hua rishta kabhi jud paaya?

matti-nunchi-mahabali.title: Matti nunchi Mahabali
matti-nunchi-mahabali.description: A man who was once destined for greatness chooses to live an ordinary life, hiding his true potential from the world. But when unexpected challenges begin to test his patience and courage, the line between the man he appears to be and the fighter he truly is starts to blur.

the-kingmaker.title: The Kingmaker
the-kingmaker.description: Li Qing, a clever physician in the Ming Dynasty, is unexpectedly drawn into the dangerous world of the imperial palace after successfully treating Empress Ma. His intelligence earns him the trust of Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang, turning him from a simple doctor into a powerful Jinyi Guard and royal confidant, as Li Qing falls in love with Mo Yue and builds a family, he becomes deeply involved in the struggle for the Ming throne.

5-star-ko-billionaire-naukar.title: 5 Star ko Billionaire Naukar
5-star-ko-billionaire-naukar.description: Arjun Raichand, Howard su MBA karyo ek Arabpati ro choro hai, pan apne baap ri 50,000 cr ri saltnat ro waris banba khatir une khud ne sabit karno pade hai, Ee khatir ek hotel me Housekeeper banke kaam shuru kare hai, jathe une apmaan ar dhokho sehno pade hai. Ee bich Arjun ek Hatya ri sazish ar corporate ro pardofash kar deve hai, sachai ne sabke samne laake ar ek Aurat ri jaan bachake, Arjun khud ne sabit kare hai ar akhirkaar woh kamyab CEO ar apne baap ri saltnat ro asli waris bane hai.

the-chosen-survivor.title: The Chosen Survivor
the-chosen-survivor.description: In a post-apocalyptic future, scavenger Lin Chen awakens a mysterious power that transforms his life. As he battles deadly alien forces and rises from a powerless outcast to an unstoppable warrior, he uncovers shocking secrets about his father, his twin brother and the fate of Planet Blue. Now, Lin must embrace his hidden legacy and become the survivor capable of changing humanity’s future.

hit-me-again-3.title: Hit Me Again
hit-me-again-3.description: The story follows a scholarship underdog who keeps entering elite schools, arenas, and high-status power circles where wealth, rank, and cybernetic upgrades decide who gets respect. From the start, he is mocked and cornered by privileged rivals, especially Brock and other protected elites, and every clash exposes the same class divide between those with power and those expected to submit. Instead of breaking, he keeps surviving punishment that should have ended him, and his body begins to show unusual resilience and enhancement. Clara becomes a central presence throughout the conflict, first as a guarded heiress and later as a protective ally whose bond with the underdog is tense, emotional, and increasingly important. Their connection is complicated by family control, public pressure, and the threat that she may be used as leverage against him. The academy and its authorities repeatedly try to discipline, expel, contain, or publicly humiliate him, but he refuses to bow even when his scholarship, dorm access, and safety are threatened. Rival enforcers and commanders escalate the violence with traps, shock weapons, gravity tests, and live-streamed punishment, turning ordinary school conflict into a weaponized spectacle. At the same time, the story keeps widening into a larger cyberpunk struggle over engineered bodies, illegal upgrades, and hidden bloodlines. Toby and other allies provide warnings and technical support, helping the fighters survive systems designed to crush them. Clara also resists being controlled by her father and by the elite order around her, refusing forced arrangements and rejecting attempts to buy her loyalty. Several confrontations center on rescue attempts, especially when Clara is taken into a wealthy estate and pressured toward an arranged marriage with Jackson. The outsider fighter pushes through deadly defenses to reach her, while the family and its gatekeepers try to keep him out. Jackson emerges as a recurring force of authority and cruelty, using status, force, and illegal enhancement to tighten control over everyone around him. Yet each time he escalates, the resistance only grows stronger, and the crowd begins to recognize that the system is afraid of the very people it tries to crush. By the later stages, the conflict has become open rebellion, with public defiance, revenge, and loyalty all colliding in the same battles. The underdog’s survival itself becomes a challenge to the ruling order, and the stakes shift from personal humiliation to the collapse of elite control. The arc ends with the characters bracing for even larger confrontations, as revenge, love, and engineered power all point toward a decisive showdown.

secret-big-bull-husband.title: Secret Big Bull Husband
secret-big-bull-husband.description: Vetri loved Janani more than his own life. But when she chooses greed over love, the hidden billionaire unleashes a revenge that will leave his enemies with nothing.

one-night-with-the-alpha.title: One Night with the Alpha
one-night-with-the-alpha.description: A poor surrogate mother hides her werewolf twins from their billionaire father, until a deadly supernatural war forces them to unite and fight for their destiny.

meera-weds-maadhava.title: Meera Weds Maadhava
meera-weds-maadhava.description: The story follows Meera Deshpande and Madhava through a long struggle where marriage, business control, and personal dignity become inseparable. It begins with hostility, public humiliation, and hidden motives, then quickly turns into a marriage arrangement shaped by family pressure and company stakes. A wealthy man in disguise is linked to Meera through an old family promise, and that connection feeds into a formal marriage negotiation. Meera later proposes a contractual marriage, treating love and money as secondary to practical control. Madhava accepts the arrangement, but the relationship is immediately burdened by strict rules, suspicion, and constant testing. Family authority and corporate authority keep colliding, especially as relatives and business rivals try to use the marriage to influence ownership and shares. The conflict grows more public at company events, where Meera is insulted, Madhava is mocked as a cleaner, and hidden truths about ownership and deals are exposed. Ruby Bhatia becomes an important figure in the business struggle, and her support gives Madhava and Meera access to elite circles and strategic opportunities. At the same time, sabotage, fraud, frozen accounts, and violent attacks reveal that the company war is not just social but dangerous. The airport project becomes a major prize, drawing in rival groups, funding pressure, and sabotage attempts. Madhava repeatedly refuses to stay in a simple subordinate role and instead chooses to learn the business from the ground up. He is also repeatedly pulled into fights where he protects Meera, even when others doubt him or try to humiliate him. Meera’s trust in him shifts slowly, moving from suspicion and control toward reluctant dependence and then deeper feeling. Their bond is tested by the contract’s deadline, since Madhava insists the agreement must end on schedule while Meera wants it to continue. Public recognition at forums and ceremonies raises Madhava’s status, but it also exposes him to new enemies and sharper scrutiny. By the end of the batch, the relationship is no longer only tactical, because Meera pushes for a real marriage based on mutual consent and affection. The larger stakes remain unresolved, with company power, family honor, and survival still tied to the couple’s future.

they-chose-the-wrong-enemy.title: They Chose the Wrong Enemy
they-chose-the-wrong-enemy.description: Trivik Yadav, secretly the powerful force behind the Sisodhia family’s rise, is betrayed and left for dead by the three sisters he raised after they choose a mysterious man claiming to be their real brother. When his pregnant wife Devika is targeted too, Trivik returns with divine strength and hidden allies, determined to protect his family and make those who betrayed him face the consequences.

arabpati-gymwalo.title: Arabpati Gymwalo
arabpati-gymwalo.description: Raj, also known as Rajveer Sisodia, is introduced as a humble gym trainer who hides the fact that he is actually a powerful industrialist. His strict belief in discipline and self-respect puts him in direct conflict with people who want shortcuts, especially Tanisha Rao, who tries to use political influence to force her way. As the story grows, Raj’s role expands beyond the gym and into the lives of vulnerable women who need protection, including Bindya and Shanaya. He repeatedly becomes involved in family crises, rescue situations, and marriage pressure, even when he tries to stay detached. Shanaya pushes him toward her sister Sukanya, whose future is tied to business arrangements, family expectations, and a marriage linked to Aryan. Raj refuses to treat marriage as a transaction, but his care for Sukanya deepens as he helps her recover physically and emotionally. Sukanya begins to see the difference between Raj’s patient support and Aryan’s cold, strategic behavior. At the same time, business success, public humiliation, and class conflict turn personal relationships into power struggles. A major deal and repeated arguments over credit show that status and recognition matter as much as romance. Sukanya is pulled between her own dignity and the pressure to accept a marriage arrangement that others treat like a contract. Raj keeps stepping in as her protector, telling her that he is her family when hers abandons her. The wider world around them becomes increasingly public and hostile, with parties, contracts, and elite gatherings exposing jealousy and manipulation. Hidden wealth and influence are gradually revealed, showing that the man living as a trainer has far more power than anyone expected. Lord Titan’s authority eventually overtakes both business and politics, and he uses that power to punish enemies and protect those he cares about. In private, he admits that Sukanya’s arrival gave meaning to his lonely life and that he returned under a new identity to secure her future. The story then resolves its central romantic tension when Rajveer publicly proposes to Sukanya and she accepts him for who he is, not only for his CEO identity. Their union also becomes a transfer of power, as he makes her his wife and places Ecocorp and Sisodia Industries in her name. Even after that public victory, the ending suggests one final unresolved task before their future can fully begin.

billion-dollar-delivery-boy-1.title: Billion Dollar Delivery Boy
billion-dollar-delivery-boy-1.description: காதலியால் கைவிடப்பட்ட எளிய டெலிவரி பாய் கோல், தான் ஒரு பெரும் பணக்காரக் குடும்பத்தின் வாரிசு என்பதை அறிகிறான். ஆனால், சொத்து கிடைக்க 30 நாட்களுக்குள் அவன் திருமணம் செய்ய வேண்டும். தன் தோழி ஜேடுடன் போடும் போலித் திருமணம், குடும்பப் பகை மற்றும் சதிகளுக்கு மத்தியில் உண்மைக் காதலாக மாறுகிறது. துரோகங்களை வென்று, ஒரு மனிதனின் உண்மையான மதிப்பு பணத்தில் அல்ல, அவனது நற்குணத்திலேயே உள்ளது என்பதை கோல் நிரூபிக்கும் விறுவிறுப்பான கதை.

anjaani-dulhan.title: Anjaani Dulhan
anjaani-dulhan.description: Priya’s life collapses when she discovers her supposedly disabled husband Ranjit is secretly a wealthy businessman involved with her rival, Ritu. Homeless and abandoned, she is rescued by billionaire Amit, who offers her a two-year marriage to become a mother to his mute adopted daughter, Yashica. As Priya rebuilds her life and falls for Amit, Ranjit’s obsession returns—while a shocking secret from Priya’s past threatens their new beginning.

billion-dollar-delivery-boy-2.title: Billion Dollar Delivery Boy
billion-dollar-delivery-boy-2.description: After being dumped for a billionaire, struggling delivery driver Cole Marsh discovers he is the secret heir to the Reeves fortune. But to claim his inheritance, he must marry within 30 days. A fake marriage with his best friend Jade spirals into a dangerous game of hidden identities, ruthless family rivals, and unexpected love. As enemies close in and secrets unravel, Cole must prove that true worth isn't measured by wealth, but by character.

the-warriors-promise.title: The Warrior’s Promise
the-warriors-promise.description: The story spans a long war that begins with border survival and grows into a struggle over loyalty, command, and the fate of the kingdom. Early on, commanders and soldiers are pushed into harsher battles as missions to the frontier reveal how fractured the military has become. Loyal forces are betrayed by the court, and hidden survivors continue to support the war in secret even after their armies are shattered. Several leaders refuse blind obedience and instead choose to protect civilians, hold fortresses, and fight for the people rather than for empty rank. As the fighting intensifies, the war shifts from direct clashes to sabotage, ambushes, and desperate fortress defenses. Supplies run low, reinforcements fail to arrive, and shrinking garrisons keep resisting overwhelming enemy forces. A decisive arrow kills an enemy ruler, but victory quickly turns into conflict over credit, honor, and responsibility. Grief, burial rites, and accusations of betrayal replace celebration, and battlefield tokens become symbols of both loss and political power. The conflict then widens beyond the front lines into famine, grain seizure, refugee unrest, poison plots, and public humiliation. Commanders and officials are repeatedly tested by whether they will protect the vulnerable or serve corrupt authority. Some figures are punished with secrecy or exile, while others are drawn into hidden service, secret documents, and covert missions. Court intrigue grows alongside the war, with marriage alliances, family rivalries, and succession struggles used as tools of control. Several characters are pressured to trade personal loyalty for military advantage, but many refuse to abandon spouses, companions, or the people who stood by them. At the same time, younger leaders and trainees are positioned to inherit the struggle from aging veterans and dying patriots. Hidden mines, horse purchases, and recruitment efforts suggest that both sides are preparing for a larger conflict. By the later episodes, rebellion, corruption, and foreign threat have pushed the kingdom toward collapse. Dying strategists and retired leaders continue to pass on documents, warnings, and final plans to trusted operatives. The final movement gathers soldiers for a covert uprising timed to the New Year court gathering, turning the palace itself into the battlefield. Across the whole show, the central stakes remain the same: survival of the nation, protection of the innocent, and the cost of choosing duty over safety.

shadow-protocol-the-cleaners-cure.title: Shadow Protocol : The Cleaner's Cure
shadow-protocol-the-cleaners-cure.description: Auri Trell was trained to kill with chemicals. Now hiding as a cleaner, she must save her late commander’s wheelchair-bound son Kaz Venture from a lethal genetically engineered neurotoxin and a ruthless corporate takeover led by Savine Rath that threatens everything, including his father's legacy. But resisting the irresistible attraction between Auri and Kaz might prove a bigger challenge for Auri than saving Kaz.

the-billionaire-mafia-king-who-bought-hi.title: The Billionaire Mafia King Who Bought His Bride
the-billionaire-mafia-king-who-bought-hi.description:
Isabella Romano thought marrying billionaire Lucien Devereux would secure her future. Instead,
she becomes the bride of a ruthless mafia king whose love is as dangerous as his enemies.
Bound by a marriage she never chose, Isabella vows to escape him—until forbidden attraction,
deadly secrets, and unexpected protection blur the line between captivity and devotion. But
when rivalries ignite and blood vows are tested, she must decide: run from the king... or
become his queen.

blades-of-destiny.title: Blades of Destiny
blades-of-destiny.description: A legendary, off-the-books special forces operator posing as a disgraced mountain truck driver must unleash his lethal tactical reflexes in the freezing Karakoram wilderness to protect his court-martialed father from a private mercenary army led by his former protégé.

the-fearless-father.title: The Fearless Father
the-fearless-father.description: A father comes from jail and ,find his doughter and she is in trouble with his husband ,and the father take care of her doughther and revel his identity

reset-queen.title: Reset Queen
reset-queen.description: Zisha is pulled into a dangerous royal world where court power, execution threats, and time-rewind abilities collide. At first, she is trapped in repeated attempts to save her family, but every change seems to lead back to punishment and humiliation. Her strange power draws the attention of the Maharaj, ministers, priests, and spiritual advisers, who cannot agree whether she is cursed, supernatural, or a political threat. She is captured, confined in the palace, and forced to endure hunger, surveillance, and public control. Even so, she keeps pushing for her father’s innocence and for a fresh investigation into the accusations against her family. The court’s response shifts between cruelty and cautious appeasement as the ruler begins to realize her power can alter time. Around her, rival royal women and powerful officials use forged letters, scandals, and public accusations to attack one another and protect their own positions. Zisha is also drawn into a drought crisis, where she is pressured to bring rain and even face cruel demands, but she refuses child sacrifice and insists that all lives are equal. Her repeated rain rituals and rewinds strain her body, showing that her gift comes at a real cost. Maharaj increasingly stands beside her, sometimes protective and sometimes controlling, and their bond grows more intimate even as trust remains fragile. The palace becomes a place where care and domination are hard to separate, especially when medicine, recovery, and closeness are all tied to royal authority. As Zisha rises in favor, senior queens and matriarchs see her as a threat to hierarchy and succession. Her elevation brings protection and freedom, but also deeper jealousy, whispers, and new schemes against her family. The story keeps widening into rebellion, hidden armies, burned evidence, and court unrest, making every private bond feel politically dangerous. Zisha also faces attacks on her reputation and legitimacy, including poison plots and attempts to disgrace her in public. In the middle of this chaos, she finds moments of romance, confession, and loyalty, but those feelings are always tested by duty and betrayal. By the end of the batch, the court is still unstable, the conspiracy is still alive, and Zisha remains caught between saving others, surviving the throne, and deciding how much power she can bear.

raj-tilaka.title: Raj Tilaka
raj-tilaka.description: A reincarnated ancient prince is reborn as a 15-year-old lost heir in a powerful modern family, where he faces rejection, rivalry, and betrayal. Armed with mysterious powers and knowledge from his past life, he sets out to reclaim his rightful place and uncover hidden truths.

back-for-the-crown.title: Back for the Crown
back-for-the-crown.description: Suryalok is thrown into crisis when succession becomes tied to the divine Surya Mukut, a crown that chooses its ruler by fate rather than simple bloodline. Prince Aryan is named heir and the crown accepts him, but that victory immediately draws war, betrayal, and supernatural pressure toward the palace. The kingdom’s defense becomes inseparable from Aryan’s own fate, as he is ordered to protect the realm while enemies try to seize power through force. Inside the royal family, resentment turns poisonous, and Vikrant emerges as a bitter rival who believes he has been overlooked. The struggle is not only political, because dark forces and prophecy keep pushing the brothers toward conflict. Sarpaash repeatedly appears as a hidden manipulator, using betrayal, ritual, and deadlines to intensify the fight for the crown. The crown itself resists violent claims, suggesting that legitimacy cannot be forced. Aryan is also shown in a humbler life as a struggling husband and worker, where he faces humiliation at home and in public. Those scenes ground the story in hardship and make his silence and endurance part of the drama. Strange encounters with elders, healers, and mystic figures begin to reveal that Aryan is more than an ordinary man. He is recognized as a reborn Rajkumar or lost prince, and visions of crowns, swords, and sacred marks point him back toward his hidden identity. As the truth emerges, the conflict widens from palace politics into a fate-driven struggle over memory, destiny, and divine duty. Shivani’s role adds another layer of tension, since she is pulled between resentment, survival, and possible protection of Aryan. Meera and other guardians sense both light and darkness around him, warning that closeness to his destiny can bring danger. Aryan is killed and reborn, then appears in the human world as a waiter, where divine power no longer works and humiliation continues. That shift turns the story into a cross-realm chase, with the royal struggle following him beyond the palace. By the end, Sarpaash opens a forbidden gate between realms, raising the stakes from a succession dispute to a larger war across worlds. The overall arc is one of duty versus ambition, with Aryan repeatedly forced to choose protection over power even as family bonds, love, and loyalty are torn apart.

sethji-boyfriend.title: Sethji Boyfriend
sethji-boyfriend.description:
Sargun jine aapri khud ri behan Pallavi dhokho deve hai. Pallavi, Sargun ro Loket churakar ek arabpati ri zaydaad hathiyaan ri koshish kare hai, Mihir Reheja re mall me kaam karti Sargun ne Pyaar mil jave hai, pan une jara bhi khabhar koni ki Asali Waris to va hi hai.
Pallavi ro lalach khatarnaak mod le leve hai, pan jad bika apraadh saamne aave hai, to bika sara jhuth ar sazish ro pardofash ho jave hai ar Sargun aapno haq ar asli pehchaan haasil kare hai ar Kismat su sacho prem bhi.

the-pirate-who-never-drown.title: The Pirate Who Never Drown
the-pirate-who-never-drown.description: Thrown into the sea as a baby for being born without magic, Ronan Drift grew up tetherless, tattoo-less, and forgotten. Now a lone drifter, he saves a pirate princess and learns the truth: he's the lost heir of a royal house that left him for dead. To reclaim his family, he must fight his way up a ladder of the world's deadliest ranked pirates — even the number one pirate alive, who turns out to kneel to him. Revenge, power, and a love the sea itself chose.

the-battle-within.title: The Battle Within
the-battle-within.description: Meera emerges as the driving force of a local resistance movement, fighting to protect the basti, its children, and the community center from Devraj Vardhan’s violent power. Kabir first enters this struggle as a proud outsider who is drawn into Meera’s orbit during a street protest, where his arrest and later release make him dependent on her help. To stay hidden, he uses the false name Kabeer Sharma, even as Meera repeatedly defends him against suspicion from Divya and others. Over time, Kabir becomes more than a stranger in the settlement, teaching neighborhood children and quietly supporting the community. His growing attachment to Meera is clear, but so is the danger of his secret, since his family ties place him close to the very power threatening the basti. The conflict widens when a wealthy benefactor appears with a large donation and promises of a school, but the offer is quickly suspected to be a cover for land control. Meera refuses the business group’s terms, and the dispute turns into a battle over dignity, memory, and survival. A major family revelation follows when Meera is shown to be Mr. Dewan’s biological daughter, hidden for years from Devraj’s danger. This truth explains some of the older tensions, but it also deepens the risks around her identity. Devraj’s influence is shown through threats, forged papers, police pressure, eviction notices, and other forms of coercion. Mr. Dewan, despite his own failures, asks Kabir to protect Meera because Devraj could kill her if he learns the truth. Kabir then openly defies both corporate power and his father, choosing Meera and the basti over family loyalty. He also helps drive back attackers when Meera’s land is threatened, proving his commitment in action. Yet his forceful protection unsettles Meera, leaving their bond emotionally complicated rather than secure. By the end of the combined arc, the story centers on a community under siege, a hidden family history, and a love tested by secrecy, betrayal, and the cost of choosing sides.

hit-me-hard.title: Hit me Hard
hit-me-hard.description: On the outside, he is just a harmless scholar bullied by everyone. But they don't know his shocking secret: every hit he takes doesn't weaken him—it doubles his hidden power! Armed with this invincible ability, watch him take every punch with a smile as he fights against all odds to protect the girl he loves."

the-awakeners.title: The Awakeners
the-awakeners.description: Ek gareeb aur apni pehchaan chhipakar jee raha immortal ladka, 'Zen', 3S Forbidden Spell Master banta hai—ek aisi cursed power , jo har spell ke badle uski zindagi chheen leti hai. Lekin jab woh apni immortality ka istemaal karke asambhav taakat haasil karta hai, to woh school rivalries se lekar Qingcheng ke underworld aur antatah Demon Emperor 'Luna' tak pahunch jaata hai, jahan use apni chhipi hui shakti 'Eternal Balance' ki raksha karte hue duniya ko bachana hai

agathan.title: Agathan
agathan.description: A penniless boy who survived betrayal returns as one of India's most powerful businessmen, hiding his identity until the perfect moment to reclaim his family and settle every unfinished score.

a-brothers-debt.title: A Brother's Debt
a-brothers-debt.description:
When real-estate tycoon Ranveer disguises himself as a labourer to reunite with his long-lost sister Ridhima, he discovers that she is being exploited by corrupt men within his own company and has been robbed of her home, dignity and daughter. Keeping his billionaire identity hidden, Ranveer enters her brutal world to punish her tormentors, reunite her with her child and prove that the brother she lost decades ago has finally returned to protect her.
When real-estate tycoon Ranveer disguises himself as a labourer to reunite with his long-lost sister Ridhima, he discovers that she is being exploited by corrupt men within his own company and has been robbed of her home, dignity and daughter. Keeping his billionaire identity hidden, Ranveer enters her brutal world to punish her tormentors, reunite her with her child and prove that the brother she lost decades ago has finally returned to protect her.

oh-kadhal-kanmaniye.title: Oh Kadhal Kanmaniye
oh-kadhal-kanmaniye.description: வாழ்க்கை  இப்படியே போயிடுமா சார்ன்னு  பீல் பண்ணுற டெலிவரி பாய் சிவாவோட தலை எழுத்து ஒரே நாள்ல தலை கீழா மாறுது... அவன் வாழ்க்கைல நடந்த அந்த மிராக்கள் என்ன?

renascido-para-governar.title: Renascido para governar
renascido-para-governar.description: O brilhante engenheiro Julian Sinclair é lançado em um mundo dominado por magia sombria, clãs cruéis e criaturas mortais. Sem poderes mágicos, ele usa apenas sua inteligência, estratégia e coragem para enfrentar inimigos impossíveis. Enquanto forças poderosas tentam destruí-lo, Julian transforma seu conhecimento em sua maior arma e ameaça mudar para sempre um mundo que jamais imaginou temer um engenheiro.

hit-me-again-1.title: Hit Me Again
hit-me-again-1.description: At St. Jude’s Martial Academy, society is ruled by cybernetic elites who look down on powerless scholarship students. Kai, an underestimated student with an extraordinary ability to absorb kinetic energy, refuses to accept the caste system. As he defeats increasingly powerful enemies, his body evolves into something terrifying. With Clara, the academy’s elite “goddess,” by his side, Kai challenges corrupt authorities, ruthless heirs, while uncovering the mysterious sovereign power within him.

mr-bull.title: Mr Bull
mr-bull.description: Desperate for a normal life, a mysterious man named Bull hides his true identity to settle down with his wife. But when he uncovers her secret affair, his dreams of a peaceful life are shattered. Driven by betrayal, Bull's dark side resurfaces as he sets out on a ruthless path of revenge against the woman who broke his trust

dormindo-com-o-herdeiro-do-inimigo.title: Dormindo com o herdeiro do inimigo
dormindo-com-o-herdeiro-do-inimigo.description: Por dois anos, Cole Maddox vive como um marido desprezado pela poderosa família Calloway, escondendo sua verdadeira identidade: o líder da organização secreta The Five. Quando uma antiga conspiração ligada à queda de sua família ressurge, Cole precisa revelar seu verdadeiro poder para proteger sua esposa, Sienna. Entre traições, inimigos e vingança, ele fará de tudo para destruir aqueles que ameaçam sua família.

muniyamma.title: Muniyamma
muniyamma.description: Muniyamma, an abused mother struggling to feed her children, finds hope when her singing video goes viral. She escapes her violent husband and becomes a successful social-media influencer. But fame brings Kaviya, a jealous influencer secretly plotting her downfall. Soon, her husband’s family fights to take custody of her children. As her fame, money and dignity begin to collapse, Muniyamma is pushed to the edge. She must fight back to save her children and rebuild her life.

sob-a-lona.title: Segredos por Trás da Pintura
sob-a-lona.description: Beatrice Moore is drawn into a widening conspiracy where art restoration, laboratory science, and family power are all used to hide poison, forgery, and murder. At first, she is forced to authenticate a priceless painting under Julian’s control, but the work quickly becomes tied to a larger criminal network. Silas Thorne enters as a rogue investigator who challenges the official story and keeps pushing Beatrice toward the truth. The evidence shifts from a disputed masterpiece to toxic pigments, hidden formulas, stolen records, and secret workshops. Beatrice learns that restored artworks may be used to deliver poison with delayed fatal effects, and that her own research has been stolen and weaponized. Julian uses debt, contracts, surveillance, security agents, and lockdowns to keep her compliant and to bury the case. Beatrice is repeatedly humiliated and threatened, yet she keeps using her scientific skill to stall, hide evidence, and survive. Marcus remains a nervous helper caught between sides, trying to protect records and avoid destruction. A coded chemical message and other hidden clues point Silas toward secret properties and illicit production tied to Julian’s operation. As Beatrice and Silas investigate together, their trust deepens, though the danger around them only grows. Their search links stolen family art to forged documents, export licenses, counterfeit records, and laundering schemes. The conspiracy also reaches beyond the lab into guarded vaults, elite institutions, and private auctions. Beatrice is increasingly framed as both accomplice and scapegoat, making escape and proof equally urgent. Silas shifts from outsider to protector, often risking himself to keep Beatrice alive. The conflict escalates into gunpoint confrontations, sabotage, and a collapsing lockdown that cuts off air and traps them inside. An explosion opens a possible route through the metro tunnels, but the escape is still incomplete. By the end of the batch, Beatrice and Silas are racing to preserve the hidden record, save Marcus, and expose Julian before he can finish burying the truth.

final-breakup-1.title: Final Breakup
final-breakup-1.description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

toxic-wife.title: Toxic Wife
toxic-wife.description:
A man finally decides to walk away from a toxic marriage—but before he can reclaim his freedom, he must face the sacrifices, secrets, and choices that kept him trapped.

What made him enter this marriage, and what awaits him when he finally chooses himself?
Kuku Tv Original

o-contrato-da-ivy-league.title: O Contrato da Universidade de Elite
o-contrato-da-ivy-league.description: Isaiah, um jovem brilhante e bolsista sem dinheiro, aceita trabalhar como tutor na mansão da poderosa família Valentine para garantir o futuro da irmã. Lá, ele conhece quatro herdeiras idênticas e se envolve em seus segredos. Após um beijo misterioso durante um apagão, Isaiah não sabe qual delas conquistou seu coração. Entre pistas falsas, jogos e uma matriarca implacável, ele terá que descobrir a verdade.

le-protecteur-de-lombre.title: Le Protecteur de l’Ombre
le-protecteur-de-lombre.description: Linda, the president of Maxwell Group, is pulled into a widening struggle over power, medicine, and family control. Her breakthrough plant-based medicine and related pharmaceutical assets become the center of corporate pressure, sabotage, and violent takeover attempts. At the same time, she is repeatedly forced to deal with Tyler and the Lawson family, who use unfinished agreements, threats, and even marriage demands to try to corner her. A martial arts disciple is assigned to protect Linda for three months, and Mike also emerges as a key protector whose loyalty is tested by both business rivals and armed attackers. The protection arrangement becomes more complicated as Linda alternates between suspicion and trust, especially when Mike proves useful during breaches and sniper threats. Public boardroom battles and private confrontations keep colliding, showing that the conflict is not only about money but also about who controls Linda’s company and her future. Heavenly Medicine and the artificial skeleton technology both become symbols of what the rival factions want to seize. Linda refuses schemes that would exploit patients or surrender the company, even when the pressure includes stock attacks, sabotage, and ultimatums. The Lawson side escalates from negotiation to coercion, demanding patents, shares, and compliance while trying to control evidence and public exposure. Mike responds by confronting enemies directly, humiliating some of them, and refusing to back down when bribed or threatened. Several digests suggest that old betrayals and family grudges lie beneath the present war, making the conflict feel larger than a single business dispute. A separate thread of martial-arts violence reinforces that the world around Linda is unstable and dangerous, with poison, ambushes, and close combat shaping the stakes. Linda’s allies are uneven, and even insiders and former enemies shift sides as the struggle deepens. The story keeps returning to the tension between protection and possession: who is guarding Linda, and who is trying to claim her and her company. By the end of the batch digests, the war is still unresolved, but Linda remains determined to keep Maxwell alive and under her control. Mike stays at the center of the fighting, tied to Linda by duty, trust, and unresolved personal feeling. The overall arc is a relentless escalation from corporate maneuvering into open violence, with family honor, revenge, and survival all on the line.

ela-construiu-o-imperio-dele.title: Por Trás do Império Dele, Estava Ela
ela-construiu-o-imperio-dele.description: Clara Vance, uma brilhante programadora financeira, recupera memórias que revelam que foi drogada, considerada mentalmente incapaz, separada do filho e roubada de seu revolucionário algoritmo. Rejeitando a ajuda do ex-marido bilionário, ela retorna a Wall Street para enfrentar a elite que destruiu sua vida, revelar a conspiração, recuperar seu filho e derrubar o império construído às suas custas.

in-the-attic-she-stays.title: In The Attic She Stays
in-the-attic-she-stays.description: Jamie and Eric’s marriage is introduced as a strained partnership trapped inside a decaying family homestead. Their poverty, debt, and constant blame make the house feel like both a financial burden and a symbol of their broken life together. Jamie refuses to rely on Eric’s help and instead tries to keep the children safe by building a small livelihood through handmade lavender soap. That fragile plan becomes the family’s only real hope, even as failed batches and ruined supplies keep pushing them toward collapse. At the same time, the house itself grows increasingly hostile, with cold drafts, wet sounds, soot, and other signs that something is wrong inside the walls. A locked room, a missing key, and warnings from Pastor John suggest that the property hides a buried history. The pressure is not only supernatural but also financial, because hidden debt and a secret mortgage leave the family facing foreclosure and possible eviction. The church’s demands escalate into threats of sheriff action, seizure, and even demolition if the debt is not paid. Jamie discovers that Eric has concealed major financial decisions, and that secrecy deepens the fracture in their marriage. Public trouble follows when the soap business is blamed for burns and poisoning, bringing shame, suspicion, and legal danger. The mystery around the sealed attic and the hidden woman Sonia makes it harder to tell where sabotage ends and haunting begins. Jamie starts to suspect that the house is tied to a past tragedy rather than random bad luck. Eric eventually reveals that Noel’s wife Sonia and their children died in a fire after being trapped in the attic. That revelation connects the present danger to a buried family trauma that still seems active in the house. The supernatural presence remains unresolved, and the children are still at risk as the household is pulled between debt, mistrust, and fear. By the end of the arc, Jamie’s soap business is still the family’s most fragile lifeline, but it is not enough to guarantee safety or peace. The show’s central stakes are whether the family can survive the house’s hidden history, the crushing debt, and the collapse of trust between husband and wife.

a-viuva-do-meu-irmao-a-minha-obsessao.title: A Viúva do Meu Irmão Virou Minha Obsessão
a-viuva-do-meu-irmao-a-minha-obsessao.description: Helena Vance spends the story fighting to keep Arthur’s vineyard estate from being taken by creditors, bankers, and men who claim they can save it better than she can. The land is threatened by debt deadlines, foreclosure pressure, water shutoff, blocked sales, and the constant risk of auction or liquidation. Helena refuses to surrender the estate because it is tied not only to her livelihood but also to Arthur’s memory and legacy. At first, the conflict looks like a straightforward battle against Charles Sterling and other outside powers. That changes when Julian returns from Zurich and presents himself as a rescuer who has paid the debt and bought the property. His help quickly becomes another form of control, because he uses the debt, contracts, and records to pressure Helena into obedience. Helena is repeatedly forced into impossible choices, including signing coercive papers, handing over diaries and formulas, or accepting eviction. The estate itself becomes a battleground over hidden documents, water rights, and the exact wine knowledge Arthur left behind. As Helena digs deeper, she begins to suspect that Arthur’s death was not a simple accident and that bank transfers and hidden files point to a cover-up. Tom remains one of her clearest allies, warning her when the danger grows and helping her search for answers. Meanwhile, Marcus and Charles Sterling appear tied to the financial and legal machinery that keeps the truth buried. Julian’s role stays unstable, since he acts at times like a protector and at other times like the person most determined to dominate Helena’s future. Their relationship is no longer only about business, but the story keeps showing that debt, guilt, separation, and desire are all tangled together. Helena also has to defend her reputation when scandal and public exposure threaten to isolate her further. Around the vineyard, other disputes over kitchens, property, and damaged buildings mirror the larger fight over ownership and control. Suspicious leaks, surveillance, and a shadowy mastermind widen the conflict beyond a single estate. By the end of the batch, Helena has not regained control, but she is still resisting every attempt to erase her claim, her grief, and the truth about what happened to Arthur.

la-renacida-del-eclipse.title: La Renacida del Eclipse
la-renacida-del-eclipse.description: Marcada como “incompatible” y arrojada a las criptas al nacer, Vivienne sobrevive en secreto bajo la protección del deshonrado guardián Gideon. Veinte años después, se infiltra en la Catedral para salvar a su madre Lenore de una maldición impuesta por la cruel sacerdotisa Amara. Ocultando su fuego solar prohibido, lidera una rebelión y sobrevive a una prueba mortal, hasta que sus llamas destruyen el orden sagrado.

the-vampire-kings-cursed-bride.title: The Vampire King's Cursed Bride
the-vampire-kings-cursed-bride.description: Anna begins as a royal heir who is betrayed by Beatrice and Roy, stripped of her throne, and left for dead. She survives the fall and wakes with memory of the betrayal, which turns her coming-of-age into a struggle against the court’s control. Beatrice, Roy, and the religious authorities repeatedly force her into public rituals meant to expose, shame, or bind her. Anna refuses to submit, and each refusal deepens the conflict between her bloodline and the sacred law used against her. She is accused of sacrilege and pushed toward deadly tests of purity, legitimacy, and inheritance. When the court demands proof of her worth through a golden heir, Anna flees rather than yield. She finds dangerous allies in witches and forbidden magic, including Sybil of the Blood Pine, and drinks the Abyssal Blood Elixir despite the pain it brings. That choice strengthens her connection to shadow power and marks her as more than the court expected. As Roy continues to hunt her, Anna reveals herself as the last true gold-blood heir and opens a sealed tomb tied to the first vampire. The struggle then widens from a personal betrayal into a succession war over who has the right to rule. Anna is dragged before religious and royal judgment again, this time with her fertility and children treated as crimes. She reveals a forbidden pregnancy, and later her children, which causes panic and turns the sanctuary into a battlefield. The court brands the children monsters and demands proof or death, while Beatrice and Vespera press the condemnation. Anna answers by defending her children and raising blood magic that destabilizes the court’s own sacred spaces. In the middle of this chaos, the First Vampire awakens and claims Anna and the children as his family, confirming that her line is tied to forces the court cannot control. A sacred blood trial with the Scepter of the Dawn is used to test her lineage, but the violence only exposes how fragile the court’s judgment has become. By the end of the batch, Anna’s family is protected by increasingly dangerous powers, and her claim to the kingdom stands in open conflict with those trying to erase her line.

meu-marido-uma-estrela-de-cinema.title: Casei com um Astro do Cinema!
meu-marido-uma-estrela-de-cinema.description: Após denunciar a corrupção de Hollywood, o lendário ator Ethan Cross é assassinado e desperta no corpo do desacreditado herdeiro Christian Vance. Escondendo sua verdadeira identidade, ele usa seu talento para reconstruir a carreira e descobrir quem ordenou sua morte. Cercado por inimigos, Ethan encontra na poderosa Victoria Thorne uma improvável aliada e sua única chance de fazer justiça.

ಇಮ್ಮಡಿ-ಪುಲಕೇಶಿ--ಭಾರತದ-ಮೊದಲ-ಕನ್ನಡ-ಸಾಮ್ರಾಟ.title: ಇಮ್ಮಡಿ ಪುಲಕೇಶಿ - ಭಾರತದ ಮೊದಲ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಟ
ಇಮ್ಮಡಿ-ಪುಲಕೇಶಿ--ಭಾರತದ-ಮೊದಲ-ಕನ್ನಡ-ಸಾಮ್ರಾಟ.description: ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ನಕ್ಸಲೈಟ್ ಯುವತಿಯೊಬ್ಬಳು ಚಾಲುಕ್ಯ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಇಮ್ಮಡಿ ಪುಲಕೇಶಿಯ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದರೆ ಏನಾಗಬಹುದು? ಬಂಡಾಯದ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ಅವಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ ಮತ್ತು ದೇಶಪ್ರೇಮ ಜಾಗೃತವಾಗುವ ಈ ರೋಚಕ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪದೇ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ!

a-chefe-suprema.title: A Chefona Suprema
a-chefe-suprema.description: Claire’s story is a sustained fight to reclaim her father’s legacy while being pushed down at every turn by family, executives, and rivals who want her powerless. She is stripped of status inside her own company, forced into humiliating work, and repeatedly treated as an outsider in both boardrooms and elite social spaces. Even so, she keeps searching for the truth behind her father’s death, his missing will, and the theft of his project. Her investigation uncovers hidden transfers, bribery records, shell companies, frozen assets, and other signs of a coordinated corruption scheme. Luke enters the company undercover as a driver, but he steadily proves himself to be more than a covert observer. He helps Claire recover and reconstruct evidence, steal incriminating records, and trace money trails through hidden accounts and suspicious documents. As the pressure grows, the conflict expands from workplace bullying into a broader corporate and inheritance war. Claire is trapped by legal traps, signature demands, and clauses meant to strip away her rights if she marries the wrong person. The forced marriage to Luke initially looks like another control tactic, but it also becomes a strategic shield that protects her claim. Luke’s calm support and public defense of Claire gradually expose that his low-status cover hides real leverage. Claire, meanwhile, becomes more determined and more capable, refusing blind consent and insisting on her right to her father’s company and fund. The family and boardroom powers keep escalating their retaliation through humiliation, surveillance, and financial pressure. Claire responds by waiting, gathering proof, and setting traps rather than surrendering. The stakes are no longer only personal dignity, but ownership, inheritance, and the future control of the company itself. By the end of the arc, the hidden alliance between Claire and Luke has shifted the balance, even though the hostile power structure remains dangerous and unstable. The show closes with the sense that the truth is finally close enough to expose, but only if Claire can survive the last round of sabotage and legal warfare.

secreto-de-la-esposa.title: Secreto de la Esposa
secreto-de-la-esposa.description: Evelyn, una costurera ciega, sobrevive en los peligrosos barrios bajos de Iron Shore mientras cría en secreto a sus talentosos gemelos. Cuando un sindicato secuestra a sus hijos, su rescate la reúne con Dominic, el despiadado líder del Dragón Negro y su esposo desaparecido. Atrapada en su ático, deberá vencer a enemigos mortales, sobrevivir a un brutal juicio y recuperar su lugar junto al hombre que perdió.

casada-con-un-duque.title: Casada con un Duque
casada-con-un-duque.description: La princesa Juliana de Ashborne, maltratada por su madrastra y traicionada por su prometido Gerald, termina casándose con un humilde soldado. Su celosa hermanastra Clarissa convierte su vida en una pesadilla y logra encarcelarla injustamente después de que Juliana salva a una duquesa con sus habilidades médicas. Cuando todo parece perdido, la verdadera identidad de su esposo revela un secreto capaz de cambiarlo todo.

sitaron-ka-raja.title: Sitaron Ka Raja
sitaron-ka-raja.description: Mocked as a weak cadet, Commander Zhao unlocks the mysterious Super Star Fleet System, gaining legendary engineering skills and the power to build unstoppable starships. As rival commanders, deadly space wars, and impossible missions threaten the galaxy, Zhao must outsmart every enemy, recruit elite allies, and transform from an underdog into the universe's most feared fleet commander.

papa-asesino.title: Papá Asesino
papa-asesino.description: Los crueles Ancianos de Blackwood exigen ejecutar a los iniciados caídos en desgracia. Para salvar a Isadora en secreto, el Gran Árbitro Gideon sella el santuario y la somete a peligrosas pruebas de purificación. Marcada por un vínculo abrasador, ella finge obediencia mientras usa magia prohibida para cambiar las reglas. Cuando los rituales se vuelven mortales, Isadora desarrolla una oscura conexión con su captor.

the-healers-secret.title: The Healer's Secret
the-healers-secret.description: Sanju, a medical college dropout gifted with extraordinary Ayurvedic healing, enters the country's most prestigious hospital where modern medicine dismisses him as a fraud. As he battles hospital politics, protects an ancient Ayurvedic manuscript, and finds himself caught between two women in love with him, he must prove that true healing comes from knowledge—not a degree.

ella-se-rebaja.title: Ella se Rebaja
ella-se-rebaja.description: Desesperada por salvar a su hermana moribunda, Clara acepta el trato de Alexandra Sterling, una poderosa galerista que le ofrece el dinero necesario a cambio del control absoluto sobre su arte y sobre ella. Lo que comienza como una transacción despiadada se convierte en un vínculo irresistible. Cuando un coleccionista celoso y una amiga de confianza revelan su secreto, Clara deberá decidir hasta dónde llegará para proteger a la mujer que cambió su vida.

princesa-de-nieve.title: Princesa de Nieve
princesa-de-nieve.description: In a frozen northern stronghold, survival depends on heat, rank, and obedience, and a young woman from the outer settlements is drawn into the center of that struggle. She first comes forward to save her people when a broken heat pact leaves a settlement at risk of freezing, and her desperation puts her in direct conflict with the fortress guards. What begins as a fight for warmth quickly becomes a political crisis, because the fortress rulers treat heat as leverage and captives as bargaining pieces. She is taken prisoner, bargained over, and repeatedly used as a hostage in disputes between the fortress, the council, and the outer districts. As the pressure rises, a supernatural soul bond and a blood-sealed contract emerge between her and the ruling lord, making their connection both dangerous and difficult to escape. The ruler’s behavior stays conflicted, shifting between punishment, control, and protection, which leaves her safety tied to his unstable authority. At the same time, her defiance exposes the cruelty inside the fortress and the suffering hidden beneath its order. She challenges the hierarchy openly, defends servants, and refuses to accept the humiliation imposed on her and other vulnerable women. The fortress itself seems to react to her presence, suggesting that her arrival matters beyond ordinary politics. Meanwhile, sabotage of the heating system deepens the crisis and reveals that the cold is being used deliberately against districts and captives. Evidence of tampered valves, forced molten material, and cut thermal lines points to corruption rather than accident. As accusations spread, court figures question her identity, emblem, and legitimacy, turning her very name into a weapon against her. Allies and protectors step in at different moments, but their help is often tangled with secrecy, law, and hidden motives. A counselor and other nobles try to shame or expose her, while the ruler shields her from some of the worst attacks. The result is a tense balance where her place in the stronghold remains uncertain, protected by a bond she did not choose and threatened by a court that wants to break her. The larger stakes are not only her survival, but the fate of the people who depend on the fortress’s heat and the truth behind the bargains that keep them alive.

jhukega-nahi-saala-phir-se.title: Jhukega Nahi Saala Phir Se
jhukega-nahi-saala-phir-se.description: To protect an asthmatic child and her disowned mother from a corrupt waterfront syndicate, an undercover motorboat pilot—secretly a billionaire shipping heir—enters a convenient marriage, only to discover the child is his own, unleashing his global maritime empire to crush his ruthless father-in-law and reclaim their heritage estate.

le-dieu-cache-delyndor.title: Le Dieu Caché d’Elyndor
le-dieu-cache-delyndor.description: Caius Drenmere est méprisé comme un ivrogne et un joueur qui déshonore sa noble famille. Mais derrière cette façade se cache le légendaire Phénix Spectral, le plus puissant protecteur d’Elyndor. Alors que le royaume est menacé, Caius affronte en secret sorciers, trahisons et complots. Lorsque son véritable pouvoir éclate au grand jour, il doit venger son père et sauver Elyndor de la destruction.

lies-we-loved.title: Lies We Loved
lies-we-loved.description: Lina Qiao thought she had found love in Yan Huo—until she discovers she was only a pawn in his revenge against her sister, Wei Qiao. Trapped between a dangerous family feud, a shattered heart and a secret that could destroy them all, Lina must decide: forgive Yan or make him pay.

le-retour-de-la-reine-des-glaces.title: Le Retour de la Reine des Glaces
le-retour-de-la-reine-des-glaces.description: Cinq ans après que sa demi-sœur Grace lui a volé sa chorégraphie et détruit sa carrière, Hannah Wells revient sur la glace. Après avoir sauvé Leo, le fils d’un milliardaire froid et puissant, elle devient son entraîneuse privée. Tandis que Grace et son ex cherchent à l’humilier, Hannah trouve le soutien de John et prépare un retour clandestin pour reprendre sa place et restaurer son nom.

bound-to-my-five-cursed-protectors.title: Bound to My Five Cursed Protectors
bound-to-my-five-cursed-protectors.description: Dying syndicate heiress must force five deadly genetically engineered beast-shifter bodyguards to protect her from street assassins while she secretly risks her life to surgically break the explosive bio-seals fused to their collarbones.

reborn-queen-ka-badla.title: Reborn Queen Ka Badla
reborn-queen-ka-badla.description: Yue Lin stands at the center of a long family and business reckoning after returning as a wronged heiress determined to reclaim what was taken from her. The Lin household treats her as an outsider or servant, while Rui is repeatedly favored as the adopted or preferred daughter, deepening the split inside the family. Much of the conflict turns on inheritance, company shares, and the family residence, with the grandmother’s arrangements giving Yue Lin real leverage. Rui and other relatives use accusations, humiliation, and manipulation to keep Yue Lin under control, including false blame around a chili allergy crisis and other public scandals. Yue Lin refuses to keep apologizing and increasingly answers the family’s pressure with open defiance. Her resistance exposes the household’s hypocrisy and forces the father, mother, and other elders to confront the damage they have done. Auntie Lan emerges as an important ally who helps Yue Lin challenge the family’s authority from inside the mansion. The feud does not stay private, because school, public gatherings, and elite family events all become stages for humiliation and retaliation. At college, Yue Lin is threatened with expulsion or transfer, but she refuses to leave and demands accountability instead. The rivalry also spreads into romance and status struggles, with Shen Yu, Ming, and other figures pulled into conflicts over loyalty, money, and reputation. Shen Yu’s own humiliation over debt and family bills mirrors the larger theme of people being crushed by financial pressure. In the business world, stock crashes, investment losses, and corporate sabotage turn family power into a weapon. Several digests point to hidden schemes, secret networks, and even a mysterious system that affects luck, fortune, and connection. As the Lin empire weakens, Yue Lin and other underestimated women gain strength through strategy, inheritance, and timing. Rui’s lies are eventually exposed, and she is forced into apology or collapse, while Yue Lin rejects reconciliation and claims the house and shares for herself. The overall arc is one of betrayal, public shame, and revenge, with the heroine steadily moving from isolation to control. By the end, the old family ties are broken, the betrayers are humiliated, and Yue Lin stands in a stronger position than those who once tried to erase her.

cricket-ka-king.title: Cricket ka king
cricket-ka-king.description: Aryan Malhotra takes charge of a struggling women’s cricket team as its new head coach. But when ambitious player and social-media star Nisha falsely accuses him of harassment, Aryan becomes the target of public hatred and his career is put at stake. As he fights to transform the team and uncover the truth, Nisha’s lies spiral out of control—until the shocking truth about her betrayal, her boyfriend Karan, and Aryan’s innocence finally comes out.

robo-a-mi-novio.title: Robó a mi Novio
robo-a-mi-novio.description: Ellie Whitmore amó en secreto a Damian Vale durante seis años, hasta que él eligió a su hermana. El día de la boda, Ellie cambia de lugar en el altar y acepta un matrimonio por conveniencia con un heredero político supuestamente en coma. Pero Damian se niega a dejarla ir, mientras la verdad sobre quién lo traicionó amenaza con destruir a dos de las familias más poderosas del país.

sundarbans-no-mercy.title: Sundarbans: No Mercy
sundarbans-no-mercy.description: A wild, tide-whispering honey-collector, bound by a childhood covenant with the Forest Goddess, must reveal his forbidden mud-healing powers and face a deadly rising tide to rescue his scarred, outcast soulmate from a corrupt timber tycoon clear-cutting their sacred mangrove sanctuary.

avakashi.title: Avakashi
avakashi.description: After being lost for twenty years, a simple young man finds his family, unaware they are secretly Asia's richest billionaires and military elites hiding their identities to protect him from international spies. High-Stakes Romantic Drama with Action-Thriller elements, perfectly tailored for fast-paced digital platforms.

the-solar-outcast-rebirth-of-the-eclipse.title: The Solar Outcast: Rebirth of the Eclipse
the-solar-outcast-rebirth-of-the-eclipse.description: Branded 'unattuned' and thrown into the crypts as a newborn, Vivienne survives in secret, raised by disgraced warden Gideon. Twenty years later, disguised as an acolyte, she infiltrates the Cathedral to save her silenced mother Lenore from a soul-curse under cruel High Priestess Amara. Hiding her forbidden solar fire, Vivienne sparks a servant uprising and survives a lethal Moon-Siphon trial — until her flame erupts, shattering the sacre

thukra-ke-mera-pyar.title: The Ex You Thought Was Dead
thukra-ke-mera-pyar.description: Seeking cold revenge for a past betrayal and public rejection, tycoon Kabir Malhotra returns to Mumbai—opening the series humming 'Thukra ke mera pyaar'—and stages his former fiancée Shanaya’s kidnapping to rescue her and act as her savior, making her fall hopelessly in love with him despite her forced engagement to a corrupt politician's son Raghav Chauhan, before unleashing a calculated campaign of public ruin and legal warfare.

rey-odiado-de-marte.title: Rey Odiado de Marte
rey-odiado-de-marte.description: Solis, also referred to as Solus, Soles, or Arthur in different accounts, stands at the center of a collapsing dome-city where air, power, and authority are all failing at once. At first he is treated as a feared captor and a cruel ruler, accused of imprisoning his wife and child and of abusing workers and prisoners. The city’s oxygen system is running toward disaster, and repeated pressure failures, quarantine lockdowns, and plasma overloads make survival increasingly uncertain. Solis insists that he can diagnose and repair what others cannot, and his technical skill repeatedly proves essential when the colony is on the brink. He refuses demands to execute engineers and saboteurs, arguing that the people who can keep the dome alive should not be sacrificed. That mercy puts him in direct conflict with hardline military figures who want punishment and tighter control. Vana remains his sharpest opponent, confronting him over past cruelty, manipulation, and betrayal while also being forced to consider whether he has truly changed. Their conflict is not only political but deeply personal, because Julian is caught between them as the child both sides claim to protect. Solis repeatedly shows a protective bond with Julian, and several scenes suggest he is trying to keep the boy safe even while others distrust him. The story also widens into a mystery about identity and memory, as Solis describes surviving a crash and waking changed, while scans suggest Arthur or Soles no longer matches the expected brain pattern. This raises the possibility that he is not the same man others remember, or that he is living in a different body. That uncertainty makes every act of mercy or secrecy more dangerous, because no one can fully tell whether he is a redeemed tyrant, a replacement, or something else entirely. Even so, he keeps stepping into the most dangerous systems himself, manually repairing failures and overriding lockdowns when the colony would otherwise lose hundreds. Some former skeptics begin to soften when they learn he was originally a rescue engineer and when his hidden knowledge proves useful. Julian’s small gestures of trust, including a protective amulet and moments of shared learning, create fragile openings in the conflict. By the end of the arc, the dome-city is still under threat, leadership remains unstable, and the central question is whether Solis’s secrecy will save the colony or destroy the last trust holding it together.

the-billionaire-delivery-boy.title: The Billionaire Delivery Boy
the-billionaire-delivery-boy.description: Cole Marsh, a struggling delivery boy, suddenly inherits a billionaire's fortune after a DNA match reveals him as the heir. But there's one condition, he must marry Viviana Hale within 90 days, a fiercely independent businesswoman whose company desperately needs his inheritance. Their contract marriage begins as a deal, but genuine love grows between them. Just when everything seems perfect, Cole's true identity and the inheritance itself come under threat.

el-sol-robado.title: El Sol Robado
el-sol-robado.description: Una genio del futuro despierta en el cuerpo de una noble muerta y hereda una identidad robada, un padre paralizado, un abuelo enloquecido y una hermana que ocupa el trono con su rostro. Armada con una medicina desconocida en ese mundo, abre una clínica secreta en los barrios bajos, evade al brillante investigador que la persigue y lucha por recuperar su hogar, una puntada letal a la vez.

mareas-de-blackwood.title: Mareas de Blackwood
mareas-de-blackwood.description: Tras ser asesinada por su cruel prometido, Dan Blackwood, Christina Scott renace siete días antes de su muerte, conservando los recuerdos de su trágica vida anterior. Atrapada en la mansión Blackwood y rodeada de enemigos, finge ser una víctima indefensa mientras prepara su venganza. Con el banquete de verano cada vez más cerca, Christina planea una trampa definitiva para revelar los crímenes de la familia y cambiar su destino.

the-secret-of-kimi.title: The Secret of Kimi
the-secret-of-kimi.description: Kimi, a gifted young girl raised in a struggling mountain ashram, is sent to the city to earn money with her extraordinary abilities to predict the future and heal the sick. Her innocent nature and mysterious powers soon bring her into the powerful Qin family, where she becomes their lucky charm. But as Kimi uncovers hidden dangers and family secrets, a shocking truth about her identity changes everything.

Ram-Ikshvakuche-Vanshaj-राम-इक्ष्वाकुचे-.title: Ram Ikshvakuche Vanshaj: राम इक्ष्वाकुचे वंशज

secret-of-mob-kings-wife.title: Secret Of Mob King's Wife
secret-of-mob-kings-wife.description: Blind seamstress Evelyn survives the brutal slums of Iron Shore while secretly raising her gifted twins. When a syndicate sweep kidnaps her children, she is forced into a deadly rescue that reunites her with Dominic—the ruthless godfather of the Black Dragon Syndicate and her long-lost husband. Trapped in his penthouse, Evelyn must outwit deadly enemies, survive a brutal dockside trial, and reclaim her place beside the man she lost.

love-at-first-glitch.title: Love At First Glitch
love-at-first-glitch.description: After a rich playboy destroys her heart, career and home, delivery girl Ruhi accepts one crore to spend ten days testing LUV—a handsome humanoid robot engineered to be the world’s first perfect boyfriend. But when their fake relationship awakens real emotions inside him, Ruhi must fight a ruthless ex, a corrupt tech billionaire and LUV’s own programming to save the machine who has become more human than every man she has ever loved.

darling-darling.title: Darling Darling
darling-darling.description: கோடீஸ்வர வாரிசான தனய், உண்மையான காதலைத் தேடி எளிய விற்பனையாளராக மாறுகிறான். ஆனால், அவன் காதலி தியா பணத்துக்காக அவனுக்குத் துரோகம் செய்கிறாள். இறுதியில் பெரும் தொழிலதிபராகத் தன் நிஜ முகத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தும் தனய், துரோகிகளுக்குத் தகுந்த பாடம் புகட்டுகிறான்.

the-hidden-iron-king.title: The Hidden Iron King
