the-hidden-iron-king.description: When the newly crowned emperor Veerat Suryavanshi secretly leaves his palace and lives as a poor blacksmith named Ved to understand his people, he is humiliated, betrayed by his first love, and underestimated by everyone. But as a ruthless minister schemes to seize a kingdom's legendary mines, Veerat must hide his true identity, prove his unmatched skill as a weapon maker, and ultimately reveal himself as the rightful king to save his people from a deadly evil.

al-milyardir-fi-al-sijn.title: Al-Milyardir Fi Al-Sijn
al-milyardir-fi-al-sijn.description: The Billionaire in Prison -The Billionaire Behind Bars

taxi-driver-is-a-shadow-commander.title: Taxi Driver is a Shadow Commander
taxi-driver-is-a-shadow-commander.description: Retired commando Rajveer lives quietly as a taxi driver, hiding his legendary past from his son Veer. But when Veer and the woman he loves are threatened, Rajveer is forced back into action. As his extraordinary skills expose his true identity, Veer discovers that the ordinary taxi driver he was ashamed of is actually the nation’s legendary “Fastest Phantom.”

chendakkaran-koodeshwaran.title: Chendakkaran Koodeshwaran
chendakkaran-koodeshwaran.description:
Sania is being sold off as a business deal — a bride gifted by her greedy family to save their sinking empire. Rishab is the billionaire groom who never wanted this wedding either.
When Sania escapes mid-baarat and stumbles straight into a band-baaja van — she has no idea the stranger hiding her from her family's guards is the man she just ran away from.
This is a story of Sania and Rishab — two people who ran from the same wedding, and somehow ended up running toward each other.

car-cleaning-se-paisa-kaise-kamayein.title: Car Cleaning Se Paisa Kaise Kamayein?
car-cleaning-se-paisa-kaise-kamayein.description: Car Cleaning Se Paisa Kaise Kamayein?

love-emergency-1.title: Love Emergency
love-emergency-1.description: On her wedding day, small-town waitress Tanvi is betrayed by her groom and best friend. Humiliated, she collapses—only to be saved by Rehan, a charming ambulance driver. In a bold act of defiance, she asks him to marry her on the spot. But Tanvi doesn’t know Rehan is secretly a billionaire heir, hiding his identity to escape his father and honor his mother’s values.

the-royal-trio-1.title: The Royal Trio
the-royal-trio-1.description: The story centers on the Jhaveri family and Aadith, an orphan whose past is tied to them in ways no one fully understands at first. It opens with rescue and gratitude, but that quickly gives way to suspicion, rejection, and the sense that Aadith may be more than a stranger. A family token, a locket, and repeated references to a 24-year separation suggest a buried secret about a lost son. As the family conflict deepens, one woman insists Aadith is her son, while others treat him as an outsider or a threat. The drama then expands from the household into Goa’s casino world, where family honor and business control become inseparable. Rival families challenge the Jhaveris through formal contests, card duels, and high-stakes wagers that turn public humiliation into danger. Aadith enters these contests not for wealth, but to uncover the truth about his origins and the family he lost. He is repeatedly warned that his abilities could be exploited, and others try to trap him with offers, threats, and tests. Violence escalates as cheating accusations, armed intimidation, and brutal rules make every game feel life-or-death. A returning long-exiled man is blamed for the family’s downfall, then partially recognized, but he remains emotionally distant and unwilling to forgive. His return confirms that the family’s old wounds are still open and that the past has not been settled. Meanwhile, figures like Rudra Chauhan and other enforcers turn the casino conflict into a harsh contest of loyalty and survival. Aadith is pulled into these struggles as both defender and challenger, especially when family honor is publicly attacked. The search for Saar and the hidden Black Orchid add another layer of mystery, linking Aadith’s personal quest to a larger secret system. A powerful woman offers him a cruel bargain: win, and he may reach the person he seeks. By the end of the batch, some apparent kidnappings are revealed as loyalty tests, and authority over the hidden casino world begins shifting toward a new successor. Even so, the emotional center remains unresolved, with Aadith still chasing identity and the Jhaveri family still trapped by its own past.

the-royal-outsider.title: The Royal Outsider
the-royal-outsider.description: Yichen Mo, a carefree royal son-in-law desperate to escape an arranged marriage, is dragged into palace conspiracies after surviving an assassination attempt. Beneath his foolish façade lies a brilliant strategist who defeats rivals through wit, commerce and unconventional ideas. As Li Hua slowly falls for him, Yichen becomes a key player in a deadly battle for power, where every alliance could cost him his life.

beyond-the-delivery-boy.title: Beyond the Delivery Boy
beyond-the-delivery-boy.description: Disguising his true identity, a wealthy man lives as a simple delivery boy. He transforms his poor wife's life, showering her with riches. But blinded by luxury, she betrays him. Heartbroken yet fierce, he reveals his true self, strips her of all wealth, and sends her back to the streets. As he finds true love with another woman, watch his ultimate revenge unfold!

the-coast-has-a-new-king.title: The Coast Has a New King
the-coast-has-a-new-king.description: Poor fisherman Madhav is constantly humiliated by his powerful father-in-law Narayan and brother-in-law Kaashi. When they cheat him after he risks his life to secure an impossible catch, he vows never to depend on them again. Armed with his wife's unwavering faith, Madhav battles deadly seas, betrayal and murder attempts to rise from a penniless labourer to the coast’s legendary fishing king.

my-cleaner-pondatti.title: My Cleaner Pondatti
my-cleaner-pondatti.description: Oviya’s story begins with a public humiliation that unexpectedly draws her into a family’s marriage plans. A kind act at a restaurant earns her the trust of a protective mother, who quickly sees her as a bride for her son. That proposal soon becomes tangled with urgent money needs, because Oviya is also trying to secure a large sum for her sister’s treatment. The man at the center of the match is not who he seems, and the romance is complicated by hidden identities, class confusion, and strategic lies. As the story moves into the workplace, Oviya is judged, mocked, and repeatedly forced to defend her talent and dignity. Shruti emerges as a persistent rival, using interviews, presentations, and office politics to undermine her. Even when Oviya is accused of fraud or theft, she keeps pushing forward and sometimes gains support from powerful men who expose the limits of privilege around her. Kannan remains a mysterious presence, sometimes protective and sometimes deceptive, and his connection to Oviya grows more emotionally charged as the truth stays hidden. Public affection, gossip, and jealousy spread through the office, making her reputation a constant target. A necklace dispute then pulls family honor into the same conflict, turning a personal symbol into proof of status and legitimacy. Multiple women claim the jewel, and the argument escalates into accusations, threats, and public exposure. Oviya is repeatedly caught between silence and confrontation, while others try to use her to validate their own place in the family. The truth of the necklace is tested, and the existence of duplicates weakens the false claims around it. At the same time, hidden authority and corporate power continue to shape events behind the scenes. Oviya’s life also becomes entangled with a deeper romantic deception, as the man she trusts is eventually revealed to be far more powerful than he first appeared. That revelation leaves her shaken, especially after she realizes how much of their relationship was built on lies and unequal power. She tries to leave, but the emotional bond is not easy to break, and outside scandals keep pulling them back together. Public claims of engagement, marriage, and pregnancy intensify the chaos, only for those claims to be denied and exposed as manipulative. By the end, the story settles into a fragile emotional crossroads, with betrayal, regret, and lingering love all still unresolved.

snow-princess-and-a-fiery-phoenix.title: Snow Princess and a Fiery Phoenix
snow-princess-and-a-fiery-phoenix.description: In a frozen world where warmth is the key to survival, Kaelen Sterling controls the kingdom’s precious heat but is manipulated by corrupt courtiers led by Silas Cole, who drain his power and sanity. Anya Mercer, a compassionate slum maid, replaces her half-sister as a hostage to save her village. Bound to Kaelen by a burning soul-bond, she helps him fight his parasites and discovers that the feared monster may actually be a misunderstood savior.

o-entregador-de-um-bilhao-de-dolares.title: O Entregador de Um Bilhão de Dólares
o-entregador-de-um-bilhao-de-dolares.description: The show follows a long chain of hidden identities, inheritance fights, and power struggles that keep collapsing romance into leverage. It begins with distrust around money, secret meetings, and relationships that do not look as simple as they first seem. Cole is repeatedly pulled into inheritance mysteries, first as an underestimated man and later as someone revealed to have far more wealth and influence than outsiders believed. Several marriage arrangements, including fake couples and contract marriages, are used as tools to protect companies, secure fortunes, or survive public scrutiny. Across these arcs, women like Jade, Vivian, Chelsea, Alana, and others are pressured by class expectations, controlling men, and corporate threats, but they also push back with strategy and refusal. Business conflicts escalate from boardroom maneuvering into hostile takeovers, hidden share purchases, and legal battles over who truly owns a company or legacy. The inheritance thread becomes even more personal when Walton Reeves is shown to have chosen Cole based on character rather than blood, turning the question of legitimacy into a test of loyalty and worth. At the same time, family control and custody threats expose how often wealth is tied to coercion, especially when husbands, fathers, and patriarchs use money to trap women and children. The story then widens into criminal and undercover territory, with ports, smuggling, trafficking, and mafia households all connected by secret files and surveillance. Cole and Viviane/Vivian remain central as their relationship shifts between protection, secrecy, and genuine love under extreme pressure. Their bond is repeatedly tested by hidden missions, pregnancy, memory manipulation, and the danger of being exposed. The island and Foundation storylines introduce a larger system of elite control, where contestants are isolated, monitored, and forced into competitions that are really tests of obedience. Vivian emerges as a stubborn challenger who refuses to accept the rules, saves others when she can, and keeps pushing toward the truth even when the system tries to erase her. Adrian is positioned as both protector and controller, with his motives remaining mixed as he moves between rescue, manipulation, and resistance to the Seven. Memory loss becomes one of the darkest stakes in the later stretch, as characters discover that emotions, family ties, and even identity may have been altered by design. The final arc leaves Vivian waking after a wipe with only fragments of herself intact, while Adrian tries to restore what was lost and another rescue thread involving Walter and a missing mother remains unresolved. Overall, the show is driven by the question of who can be trusted when love, inheritance, and identity are all being rewritten by powerful people.

naagaloka.title: Naagaloka
naagaloka.description: A humble serpent servant in the mystical kingdom of Naaglok risks everything for the ambitious dancer he loves, only to discover that his greatest battle is not for her heart, but for his own forgotten destiny.

manda-mais-uma.title: Manda mais uma
manda-mais-uma.description: Na Academia Marcial St. Jude, uma elite cibernética domina e despreza os alunos bolsistas sem poderes. Subestimado por todos, Kai possui uma habilidade única: absorver energia cinética e ficar mais forte a cada golpe. Ao lado de Clara, a “deusa” da academia, ele enfrenta herdeiros cruéis, autoridades corruptas e inimigos poderosos, enquanto desperta uma força misteriosa capaz de destruir toda a hierarquia.

saving-prince-charming-2.title: Saving Prince Charming
saving-prince-charming-2.description: Shakti, a fearless young woman blessed with extraordinary strength, becomes the personal bodyguard of Prince Harshvardhan, the heir to a royal family torn apart by betrayal and deadly conspiracies. As she repeatedly saves his life, love blossoms between them while they expose a decades-old plot to steal the throne. Along the way, Shakti uncovers the shocking truth about her own past, proving she was destined not just to protect the crown, but to change its fate forever.

she-stoops-to-conquer.title: She Stoops To Conquer
she-stoops-to-conquer.description: Desperate to save her dying sister, Clara makes a shocking bargain with Alexandra Sterling, a powerful gallery owner who promises the money she needs in exchange for complete control over Clara’s art—and her surrender. What begins as a ruthless transaction soon becomes an intoxicating bond neither woman can escape. But when a jealous collector and a trusted friend expose their secret, Clara must decide how far she’ll go to protect the woman who changed her life.

herdeiro-amaldicoado-deus-oculto.title: Herdeiro Amaldiçoado, Deus Oculto
herdeiro-amaldicoado-deus-oculto.description: Caius Drenmere é desprezado como um bêbado e jogador que envergonha sua família nobre. Mas por trás dessa fachada se esconde a lendária Fênix Espectral, a maior protetora de Elyndor. Enquanto inimigos ameaçam o reino, Caius enfrenta feiticeiros, traições e conspirações em segredo. Quando seu verdadeiro poder é revelado, ele terá de vingar a morte do pai e salvar Elyndor da destruição.

my-shadow-daddy-is-also-my-assassin.title: My Shadow Daddy is Also My Assassin
my-shadow-daddy-is-also-my-assassin.description: The cruel Elders of Blackwood demand the immediate execution of disgraced initiates. To secretly save her, the Grand Arbiter Gideon plays a dangerous double game. He seals the Sanctuary of Blackwood and forces Isadora to perform intimate cleansing trials. Bound by a flesh-searing mark, Isadora plays the submissive vessel while secretly using forbidden magic to alter the rules. As the trials grow bloodier, other initiates die, Isadora's instincts draw her into a dark bond with her captor.

a-rainha-de-gelo-do-bilionario.title: A Rainha de Gelo do Bilionário
a-rainha-de-gelo-do-bilionario.description: Hannah Wells begins as a disgraced former skating star whose career was destroyed by stolen choreography, false accusations, and the sport’s power structure. After confronting Jean and learning he chose fame and Grace over her, she is pushed into survival mode and determined to expose the truth. Logan, a powerful CEO with influence over the rink and related businesses, finds her and repeatedly pulls her into his world through housing, work, and ice access. Her bond with Leo, Logan’s withdrawn son, becomes the emotional center of the story because the child responds to her when no one else can reach him. Hannah tries to protect that fragile safety while resisting being treated as disposable, owned, or reduced to a tool in someone else’s plan. As she secretly returns to skating and coaching, Grace and Dean keep attacking her legitimacy through accusations, leaks, and hidden agreements. The Federation and other officials respond with bans, legal pressure, and public humiliation, turning her comeback into a fight against an entire system. Logan answers with money, ownership, and threats, shielding Hannah while also becoming increasingly possessive and controlling. Their relationship shifts from guarded trust to intense loyalty, but Hannah never fully stops challenging his need to control the terms of her life. A stolen silver necklace, buried family betrayal, and hints of deeper wrongdoing around Grace and Logan’s past widen the conflict beyond the rink. Hannah’s injuries and fear of returning to competition make every step back onto the ice feel costly, yet she keeps training through pain. Public scandals, tabloid attacks, and corporate warfare escalate the battle from private grievance into open confrontation. At several points, Logan and Hannah are stranded in immediate danger, forcing trust and rescue to matter as much as ambition. The story then expands into a broader struggle over records, broadcasts, and institutional control, as hidden recordings and public showdowns expose sabotage and bribery. Hannah’s performances become proof of both her talent and the theft done to her, and the corrupt order around her begins to collapse. Logan eventually clears her record and secures her place, but the victory is tied to his power as much as her own persistence. In the later arc, their bond deepens into formal commitment and family, with Leo accepting Hannah as mother and the household becoming a chosen home. Even after that, outside pressures from family, rivals, boards, and custody threats keep testing whether Hannah can truly belong without being erased again.

rise-of-naglok.title: Rise of Naglok
rise-of-naglok.description: Phani loves Nagamani deeply, sacrificing grand opportunities from a rival kingdom just to stay by her side. However, the selfish Nagamani only uses his devotion for her own vanity. When she abandons him for a wealthy prince and watches silently as Phani is ruthlessly beaten, his heart shatters. Leaving his toxic past behind, Phani finally embraces his destiny in the rival kingdom, rising to become a powerful prince.

ragasiya-kaadhali.title: Ragasiya Kaadhali
ragasiya-kaadhali.description: குடும்பத்தை அழிவிலிருந்து காப்பாற்ற, அபூர்வ மச்சம் கொண்ட பெண்ணை கோடீஸ்வரன் சூர்யா திருமணம் செய்ய வேண்டும். அந்தப் பெண் ஏழை துப்புரவுப் பணியாளரான நித்யா என்பதை அறியாமல் அவளிடம் காதலில் விழுகிறான். ஆனால் நித்யாவின் அடையாளத்தைத் திருடும் அவளது சகோதரி, சூர்யாவை மணக்கத் தயாராகிறாள். 107 வருட ரகசியத்தை சூர்யா கண்டுபிடிப்பானா? நித்யா தனது காதலையும் விதியையும் மீட்பாளா?

obsessed-with-you.title: Obsessed With You
obsessed-with-you.description: After three years under Rong’s control, Wanwan finally walks away, determined to reclaim her freedom and save her ailing Nani. But Rong’s possessiveness refuses to let her go, while Wang and Bai Xue complicate their already volatile relationship. As family schemes, money troubles, and buried emotions collide, Wanwan must choose between escaping Rong’s grip and confronting the feelings that still bind them.

little-chess-god-4.title: Little Chess God
little-chess-god-4.description: A humble chess academy is thrown into chaos when a ruthless former student returns with a team of undefeated champions, challenging its players to deadly high-stakes matches where every loss comes at a horrific price. Refusing to surrender, the academy's coach and students risk everything in a battle of strategy, courage, and revenge to protect their home and prove that true champions are made by heart, not fear.

ek-chehra-do-saazish.title: Ek Chehra Do Saazish
ek-chehra-do-saazish.description: Banita, a successful businesswoman, falls for her employee Rohit, unaware he has a vengeful twin, Mohit. The brothers enter her life to destroy her family over their father’s past injustice. But Rohit genuinely loves Banita and turns against Mohit. When she discovers the truth, her trust shatters. As Mohit threatens Banita and her unborn child, Rohit risks his life to save her. Can she ever love him again?

little-chess-god-3.title: Little Chess God
little-chess-god-3.description: ஒரு சிறிய சதுரங்கப் பயிற்சிப் பள்ளியை (Chess Academy) அழிக்க வரும் முன்னாள் மாணவன், உயிருக்கு ஆபத்தான போட்டிகளுக்கு சவால் விடுகிறான். அவனிடம் சரணடைய மறுக்கும் அகாடமி மாஸ்டரும் மாணவர்களும் வியூகம் மற்றும் தைரியத்தால் அவனை எதிர்கொண்டு, "உண்மையான சாம்பியன்கள் துணிச்சலால் உருவாகிறார்கள், பயத்தால் அல்ல" என்பதை எப்படி நிரூபிக்கிறார்கள் என்பதே இக்கதை.

immortal-curse.title: Immortal Curse
immortal-curse.description: Jinwoo ko log ek manhoos kabadi samajhte the, lekin uske paas 18 tomb-exploration grandmasters ki skills aur Qi vansh ka khaas fingerprint bhi tha. Maa-baap ki maut ka raaz jaanne ke liye woh Immortality Society ke saath Chilin tomb mein utara. Khatarnaak traps, monsters aur purane guardians ka saamna karte hue usne Renzo ki 2,000 saal purani saazish ka pata lagaya. Chilin ki divine power haasil kar amar hone se pehle kya Jinwoo use rok paaya?

i-married-a-broken-soldier-he-was-a-duke.title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
i-married-a-broken-soldier-he-was-a-duke.description: Princess Juliana of Ashborne, mistreated by her stepmother and betrayed by her fiancé Gerald, marries a humble soldier. Her jealous stepsister Clarissa creates deadly problems in her life. When Juliana uses her healing skills to save a Duchess, she is falsely imprisoned. But just when all hope seems lost, her husband’s true identity reveals a secret no one could have ever imagined.

my-ex-is-my-husband.title: My Ex Is My Husband
my-ex-is-my-husband.description: When a self-made billionaire CEO is forced to fake a marriage with a poor lift mechanic to protect her son and save her empire, neither of them realizes that they are actually reunited lovers, the child's real parents, and heirs to a secret that will shake Mumbai's most powerful families.

cleaner-ya-golddigger.title: Desi Cinderella
cleaner-ya-golddigger.description: Three years after a mysterious girl saves billionaire resort owner Aarav from drowning, fate brings Anusha into his life again. When her father urgently needs ₹1 crore for surgery, Anusha agrees to marry Aarav for his grandfather’s offer. Mistaking her for a gold digger, Aarav keeps their marriage secret as Anusha works in his own resort and suffers humiliation. But as hidden truths emerge, Aarav realizes the woman he has been searching for may already be his wife.

sang-kaisar-kembali-dewa-perang-tak-tert.title: Sang Kaisar Kembali / Dewa Perang Tak Tertandingi
sang-kaisar-kembali-dewa-perang-tak-tert.description: Sang Kaisar Kembali / Dewa Perang Tak Tertandingi

sakshi-par-hamla.title: Sakshi Par Hamla
sakshi-par-hamla.description: After a fearless pregnant influencer is brutally attacked and left for dead, her IPS brother-in-law and a relentless cop race to uncover who ordered her murder—only to find a web of suspects spanning her husband, an obsessive ex-lover, a powerful godman and the people closest to her. But when Sakshi begins recovering fractured memories, the truth she remembers could expose the killer—or put her life in even greater danger. Watch Now!

pournami-rahasyam.title: Pournami rahasyam
pournami-rahasyam.description: Virupa, a divine child immune to dark magic, is sent into the world to fight evil and awaken her powers. She wins the heart of Prasanth, a grieving father crippled by a sorcerer's curse, calling him "Nanna." But scheming relatives, a fake heir, rigged DNA tests, and a dark sorcerer's plots isolate and nearly destroy her. As secrets unravel, Virupa must reclaim her place as protector and daughter in a final battle between divine power and dark magic.

veshadhari.title: Veshadhari
veshadhari.description: A kind-hearted young woman finds herself caught in an unexpected situation when a mysterious man enters her life. What begins as an unusual relationship soon brings unexpected emotions, hidden secrets, and powerful challenges that could change both their lives forever

pretty-thief-lover-of-the-mafia-boss.title: Pretty Thief Lover of the Mafia Boss
pretty-thief-lover-of-the-mafia-boss.description: Yash, a feared mafia heir known for his ruthless justice, never expects his life to be disrupted by Khushi—a fearless chaiwali, pickpocket, and caretaker of an orphanage who steals the one thing he values most: his dead mother's watch. Forced into his world by a dangerous secret, Khushi moves into Yash's mansion to betray him, only to discover that beneath the monster everyone fears is a lonely man starved of love.

my-sister-stole-my-billionaire-groom.title: My Sister Stole My Billionaire Groom
my-sister-stole-my-billionaire-groom.description: Ellie Whitmore spent six years loving Damian Vale in secret until he chose her sister instead. So on their wedding day, she swaps places at the altar and disappears into a marriage of convenience with a "comatose" political heir. But Damian won't let her go that easily, and the truth about who really betrayed him is about to blow up two of the most powerful families in the country.

little-chess-god-1.title: Little Chess God
little-chess-god-1.description: The story follows a chess world where talent, family legacy, and hidden betrayal are constantly colliding. Geetha Kapoor is introduced as a celebrated chess prodigy whose matches carry the weight of her mother’s legacy and the expectations of those around her. Her games are not only about strategy, but also about nerves, as rivals watch for weakness and family members push her to endure. That pressure spills into a hospital crisis, where Geetha’s condition becomes critical and the people closest to her are forced to face the cost of the struggle. Her emotional life is also tangled with Vishal and Nikhil, and she ultimately chooses to protect the man who loves her. At the same time, the story opens into a younger generation of chess players, including a village girl sent to the city with a locket and instructions to find Nikhil Kapoor. The academy she reaches is shabby on the surface, but it is treated as a place where hidden ambition and buried resentment are waiting to erupt. Outsiders mock the academy, while rivals threaten to destroy it, and the future of the place becomes tied to chess challenges that can decide who stays and who is forced out. Rohit, Vishal, and other young players are repeatedly tested by humiliation, teasing, and public pressure, and even small mistakes carry heavy consequences. Coaches and authority figures often respond with harshness, turning training into a struggle for dignity as much as skill. Danish emerges as a dominant challenger whose presence raises the stakes and makes every match feel like a larger battle for control. Vishal is pushed into these conflicts as both a player and a defender, and his path is marked by rivalry, exclusion, and the need to prove he belongs. The story also introduces gifted children who solve impossible puzzles or win against stronger opponents, suggesting that the next generation may be even more dangerous than the last. Beneath the competition, there are repeated hints of sabotage, punishment, and a long-running plan that has shaped the academy’s conflicts from the start. Family mystery deepens when Vishal’s missing pendant, unknown parents, and a twelve-year search for Geetha and a missing child begin to connect. The final stretch reveals that the past was not simply lost but concealed through poisoning, coma, and years of separation. By the end, the hidden truth comes into focus: Vishal is the son of Nikhil and Geetha, and the chess battles have been shadowed all along by a broken family trying to find its way back together.

little-chess-god-2.title: Little Grandmaster
little-chess-god-2.description: Driven by the hope of finding his missing parents, a young village boy journeys to the bustling city. Armed with an extraordinary genius for chess, he takes the world by storm, defeating seasoned champions to become a legendary Grandmaster. But beyond the titles and checkmates, his true victory lies in the ultimate, heartwarming reunion with his family. Witness the inspiring journey of the Little Grandmaster!

this-time-she-knows.title: This Time, She Knows
this-time-she-knows.description: After being betrayed and killed by the people she trusted, Feng Ning mysteriously returns to the past—with every memory of her doomed fate intact. This time, she refuses to play by their rules. She marries the seemingly fragile Yuvraj Lin and joins forces with him to uncover a dangerous conspiracy. As old enemies repeat their schemes, Feng Ning must outsmart them, protect the man she never expected to love, and rewrite the ending she once suffered.

the-teen-queen-1.title: The Teen Queen
the-teen-queen-1.description: ஒரு சாதாரண கல்லூரி வாழ்க்கையை அனுபவிப்பதற்காக, ஒரு கோடீஸ்வரனின் மகள் எளிய மாணவியாக நடிக்கிறாள்; ஆனால், இரக்கமற்ற சக மாணவி ஒருத்தி அவளது அடையாளத்தைத் திருடி அவள் மீதே பழி சுமத்த முயலும் போது, தனது சுயமரியாதையையும் குடும்பப் பாரம்பரியத்தையும் காப்பாற்ற அந்தப் போலி நபரைக் களையெடுக்க வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்திற்கு ஆளாகிறாள் அவள்.

നാഗലോകം.title: നാഗലോകം
നാഗലോകം.description: A humble serpent servant in the mystical kingdom of Naaglok risks everything for the ambitious dancer he loves, only to discover that his greatest battle is not for her heart, but for his own forgotten destiny.

gaonwala-scientist.title: Gaonwala Scientist
gaonwala-scientist.description: When a 2026 scientist gets unexpectedly time-traveled into the body of an abusive, alcoholic 1951 villager, he must use modern scientific tricks and economic know-how to turn his life around, take on corrupt local elites, and lift his community out of poverty.

masuk-novel-jadi-ibu-tiga-penjahat.title: Masuk Novel, Jadi Ibu Tiga Penjahat
masuk-novel-jadi-ibu-tiga-penjahat.description: Ji Chi-huan repeatedly wakes up inside the body of a hated stepmother or disgraced wife and must survive a hostile household that initially sees her as disposable. Her first struggle is simply to keep the family’s gravely injured father alive, and that crisis soon reveals poison, Gu worms, and a deeper assassination plot. As she treats him with improvised care and a mysterious healing space, the family slowly begins to rely on her instead of rejecting her. The children remain suspicious for a long time, accusing her of greed, theft, and betrayal, but her actions in protecting them from hunger, violence, and humiliation gradually earn trust. The household’s danger is not only medical but also economic, because the family has no rice, no money, and constant pressure from bullies and hostile neighbors. Public shame becomes a recurring weapon, with accusations of adultery, murder, theft, and poisoning repeatedly threatening to destroy the family’s name. Ji Chi-huan answers by fighting back in public, exposing hypocrisy, and trying to turn survival skills into income through market trade and bargaining. Across the wider story, other poor households face the same struggle between dignity and survival, especially when school fees, admission letters, and compensation disputes become status battles. Education itself turns into a major source of conflict, as fraud, stolen opportunities, and demands for proof push families into open confrontation. Several business arcs run alongside the family drama, including food sales, recipe disputes, franchise expansion, and sabotage from rivals who want control of the market. Some characters gain respect through skill, whether by cooking, selling, or healing, while others are disgraced by cheating, bullying, or abuse of power. The story also widens into village and court politics, where hidden identities, secret marriages, and military authority complicate every personal bond. A housewarming feast, a village raid, and later official interventions show how quickly ordinary life can collapse into chaos. In the court storyline, accusations of murder, usurpation, and poisoning escalate into a struggle over legitimacy and command. Symbols of power such as the Tiger Tally and imperial authority expose how fragile the ruling order has become. At the same time, several romantic and family threads soften the tone, showing reconciliation, devotion, and the desire for a quieter life after hardship. By the end of the batch, the central stakes remain survival, reputation, and loyalty, with both family and political conflicts still unresolved.

samrat-mihir-bhoj-bharat-ka-rakshak.title: Samrat Mihir Bhoj: Bharat Ka Rakshak

la-escuela-de-los-dioses.title: LA ESCUELA DE LOS DIOSES
la-escuela-de-los-dioses.description: En Aethon Hall, los dioses condenados son despojados de su divinidad mediante un despiadado programa escolar. Oren Vael, el único alumno que recuerda la verdad, descubre que graduarse significa ser borrado para siempre. Al enamorarse de Sable, la mujer que una vez condenó, ambos lo arriesgan todo para desafiar al destino, recuperar sus poderes e iniciar una guerra contra la fuerza que controla el futuro.

desnuda-en-neon-carmesi.title: Desnuda en neón carmesí
desnuda-en-neon-carmesi.description: Vendida a un sindicato de vampiros para pagar las deudas de su familia, la astuta actriz Lora debe fingir ser la amante del despiadado mafioso Dominic Thorne. Al descubrir que una misteriosa maldición alquímica lo está matando, su falso romance se vuelve real. En medio de guerras criminales y conspiraciones, Lora descubre sus poderes curativos y una verdad devastadora: su propia madre está detrás de la maldición.

millonario-busca-poder.title: Millonario busca poder
millonario-busca-poder.description: Jamie Reyes is trapped under the Calloway family’s power, where debt, eviction threats, and public humiliation put his mother’s home at risk. When his father’s legacy is dismissed and the family is pushed out, Jamie finds a hidden device left behind by his father and begins to awaken unusual abilities tied to revenge. What starts as a fight to keep a home becomes a wider battle over stolen technology, fraud, and the family empire built around it. Tyler Calloway stands at the center of that public power, using status, athletics, and security to protect the image of success. His celebrated victories are increasingly shadowed by rumors that they depend on stolen technology and hidden sacrifice. Maya, a Calloway heiress, slowly becomes Jamie’s most important insider ally as she secretly passes evidence and helps him move through the family’s defenses. Their bond grows more dangerous and more personal, marked by trust, secrecy, and a silver ring. As surveillance tightens, Jamie is hunted through school, corporate spaces, and the Calloway estate, while allies like Jun and other covert operators help him survive. The conflict expands from eviction pressure into sabotage, blackouts, hacked systems, and public scandals that expose how far the family will go to stay in control. Jamie also learns that his father may have been poisoned and that the death was covered up as a suicide. That discovery hardens his grief into revenge and gives the fight a deeper personal stake. Maya admits her own family helped alter the record and continues to guide Jamie toward hidden files, patent keys, and proof. Tyler and the family respond with lockdowns, trackers, patrols, and threats against Jamie’s mother to force him back into line. Jamie keeps pushing deeper into the enemy’s world, sometimes disguised as a servant or maintenance worker, to recover stolen patent files and murder evidence. The truth points more and more toward Richard Calloway as the center of the cover-up and corporate theft. By the end of the arc, Jamie and Maya are still hunted, but they have moved from survival into an active plan to expose the stolen patents and the falsified death.

the-hacker-jamaai.title: The Hacker Jamaai
the-hacker-jamaai.description: Abeer, a struggling computer repairman, enters a powerful politician’s mansion as a Ghar Jamaai, secretly working as the hacker Khulasa AI to expose her corruption. As he falls in love with her daughter Aarohi, his revenge mission becomes personal. But when the truth about his family and the politician’s deadly past is finally revealed, Abeer must risk everything to bring her empire crashing down.

el-extrano-enmascarado.title: El extraño enmascarado
el-extrano-enmascarado.description: The show follows a world where fashion, branding, and corporate power constantly turn people into products, masks, or liabilities. At the center is a group of models, creatives, and industry figures who keep fighting to be seen as whole people instead of simplified images. Early on, a mixed-race outsider refuses to accept a marketable label, setting the tone for a larger struggle over identity and control. Around that conflict, other women and men in the industry face humiliation, stolen credit, and pressure to stay silent. A young model is pushed to trust her natural features, while a male model challenges an older figure over ownership of his work and is threatened in return. The story also introduces a quieter but persistent sense of surveillance, with missed calls, buzzing, flashes, and unknown watchers suggesting that privacy is already gone. As the episodes continue, hidden truths surface through tests, discipline, and sudden identity breaks, making it clear that many characters have been living under long-term control. Technology deepens that control when an anonymous package and predictive app seem designed to train and monitor a man in his own apartment. Corporate danger grows around Meridian, where lawsuits, missing money, and public scandals expose how much leverage powerful people hold over others. A young model becomes entangled with a wealthy CEO whose attention feels both romantic and threatening, while legal pressure and media fallout leave even the victorious publicly shattered. The show then expands into masked events, viral exposure, and a ranking system that traps people in unwanted auditions or games, making identity itself feel like a contest. Cole becomes increasingly central as he is pulled between blackmail, hidden identity, and alliances with people who know too much about him. Gloria Reed emerges as a powerful force from the past, confronting hidden selves and keeping old secrets alive through knowledge and leverage. The danger shifts toward Vox Global and Isla Vox, a private island tied to scandal, control, and people returning changed. Mia warns that Cole may already be trapped in that system, and Cole himself seems torn between escape and the need to uncover the truth. By the end of the batch, multiple plans are running at once, with countdowns, disguises, backups, and contingency measures showing how far everyone has moved from ordinary professional conflict into covert survival. Across the whole arc, the stakes are not just careers or reputations but the right to own one’s body, name, and story in a world built to erase them.

my-daughter-found-him-in-a-day.title: My Daughter Found Him in a Day
my-daughter-found-him-in-a-day.description: After a mysterious one-night encounter six years ago, a poor construction worker named Aryan crosses paths with Gauri, a powerful CEO, and her sick daughter Pihu, who desperately wants to find her missing father. When Pihu recognizes Aryan as her father through a mysterious locket, Gauri brings him into her life as her personal assistant—but as their bond grows, a jealous rival tries to destroy Aryan while a shocking truth about his past threatens to change all their lives.

mi-esposo-doctor-letal.title: Mi esposo doctor letal
mi-esposo-doctor-letal.description: Chloe Thompson enters a prestigious hospital as a gifted young surgeon, but her talent is immediately undermined by senior doctors and administrators who weaponize her background, debt, and status against her. Dr. Mercer, Pierre, and other authority figures repeatedly use humiliation, threats, and control over records to keep her from proving herself. Josh becomes her most consistent ally, defending her qualifications and keeping her on the team when others try to push her out. Even under brutal shifts and constant surveillance, Chloe keeps saving patients by catching missed diagnoses, preventing dangerous mistakes, and stepping into emergencies when others hesitate. Her skill repeatedly exposes the weakness and arrogance of the people above her, turning the hospital into a struggle over merit, privilege, and power. As the pressure rises, Chloe is dragged into accusations involving restricted drugs, falsified records, and a broader cover-up tied to the Mercer-controlled institution. She is publicly humiliated, dismissed, and even stripped of protection, while the hospital leadership tries to force her into silence. A hidden marriage bond between Chloe and Josh becomes part of the conflict, first as a secret and later as a legal shield against Pierre and the board. That bond also deepens the stakes, because protecting Chloe now means risking Josh’s career, reputation, and freedom. Meanwhile, Chloe and her allies uncover evidence of altered files, hidden backups, and corrupted ledgers that suggest the scandal reaches far beyond one bad decision. The hospital’s crises escalate into explosions, toxic-gas emergencies, blackouts, lockdowns, and operating-room disasters, forcing the characters to choose between procedure and survival. Chloe and Josh are repeatedly pulled together in these emergencies, even when their relationship is strained by coercion and public scrutiny. The more they uncover, the more the Mercer family and its allies retaliate with board hearings, disciplinary threats, and attempts to destroy evidence. Chloe is pressured to sign a confession that would save herself only by incriminating Josh, but she refuses to betray him. Instead, she and her allies keep pushing toward exposure through recovered ledgers, verified signatures, and outside oversight. By the end of the batch, the corruption is still contested, but Chloe has become a proven threat to the system that tried to erase her, and the fight over truth, career, and protection remains unresolved.

genius-delivery-boy-1.title: Genius Delivery Boy
genius-delivery-boy-1.description: டெலிவரி பாயாக எளிய வாழ்க்கை வாழும் ஒரு மறைமுக கோடீஸ்வரனை, அவனது நன்றியற்ற மனைவி ஏமாற்றி விவாகரத்து செய்கிறாள். இதனால் ஆத்திரமடையும் அவன், மீண்டும் 'சிங்கானியா'வாக தனது ராஜ விஸ்வரூபத்தை எடுத்து, தன்னை அவமானப்படுத்தியவர்களைப் பழிவாங்கி, தொழில் போட்டியாளரான ஒரு பெண்ணுடன் உண்மையான காதலையும் கண்டடைகிறான்.

bhagwan-goes-viral.title: Bhagwan Goes Viral
bhagwan-goes-viral.description: Fans will love it because it turns their own doomscrolling guilt into cosmic comedy watching gods panic over follower counts and chase engagement is a hilarious, biting mirror of modern social media addiction, wrapped in a premise fresh enough that no one's done it before.

el-ultimo-heredero.title: El Último Heredero
el-ultimo-heredero.description: Un veterano de guerra en la ruina, señalado como alguien sin poder alguno, activa una placa militar misteriosa con su sangre y descubre que es el último heredero de un linaje sobrehumano oculto. Perseguido por una hermandad secreta y obligado a sobrevivir una herencia sellada con sangre, revela la conspiración detrás de una devastadora guerra interestelar. Cuando la verdad emerge, debe decidir si salvar a la humanidad vale convertirse en el poder que todos temen.

the-dog-date-mix-up.title: The Dog Date Mix-Up
the-dog-date-mix-up.description: Haunted by a forgotten past, billionaire Mayur hides his identity and enters a three-month contract marriage with fearless pet-shop owner Kavya, who is desperate to escape her abusive brother-in-law. As their fake marriage blossoms into real love, buried secrets and a mysterious shared past threaten to tear them apart.

recuerdos-prestados.title: Recuerdos Prestados
recuerdos-prestados.description: En un futuro donde los recuerdos son la moneda más valiosa de la humanidad, todos están conectados mediante un implante neuronal que almacena y manipula experiencias. Un joven nacido con el chip defectuoso resulta inmune al sistema que controla la sociedad. Al descubrir la conspiración detrás de esa red y de un misterioso campo de vacío, se convierte en la única esperanza de un mundo donde la memoria define identidad, poder y libertad.

casado-con-la-enemiga.title: Casado Con La Enemiga
casado-con-la-enemiga.description: Cole’s life is built on concealment, and the people around him slowly realize that the calm husband they know is also tied to covert missions and criminal power. At home, Sienna grows more affectionate yet more suspicious, while her family’s hostility toward Cole keeps the household tense and unstable. Outside the house, Cole manages timed exchanges, watches for leaks, and stays patient even when his own crew wants revenge. The wider world around him is full of rival operators, false tips, missing shipments, and traps that turn suspicion inward. At the same time, Sienna becomes entangled in another family scandal when Vincent Daly’s debts, fraud, and secret marriage are exposed, forcing a canceled wedding and a public reassessment of who can be trusted. The story keeps widening into elite institutions and hidden networks, including a school abuse cover-up, a hidden board member, and a child who must be rescued before the truth is buried. Cole’s own cover becomes more fragile when investigators probe his manufactured identity and find records that are too perfect to feel real. He is then pulled back toward a larger organization that gives him a deadline to return, warning that the rival side has expanded and that he is now highly exposed. That pressure becomes personal when Cole admits he was originally sent on assignment but stayed because he fell for Valerie, tying romance directly to the mission. The emotional stakes rise further as hidden marriages, unfinished business, and old loyalties make it unclear whether love is part of the plan or the reason the plan is failing. Meanwhile, Dylan Crane keeps pushing takeover schemes, surveillance, and division, using leverage to weaken rivals and isolate targets. The conflict spreads into legal and media pressure, with corruption cases, subpoenas, and dossiers turning private secrets into public danger. Family history also becomes a major fault line when the truth emerges that Cole’s mother did not die in an accident, but was murdered and covered up for years. That revelation sends investigators tracing hotel records, phone signals, and old witnesses while threats and silence close in around the people who know too much. Across the story, marriages, inheritances, and public alliances are repeatedly used as weapons, especially in the Maddox and Calloway circles. By the end, nearly every faction is exposed to betrayal, and survival depends on who can control the evidence, the loyalties, and the next move.

she-refused-the-don.title: She Refused the Don
she-refused-the-don.description: The story unfolds in a rain-soaked Mumbai world where crime, class pressure, and romance constantly collide. Kabir Tyagi stands at the center as a feared gangster and possessive force, moving between violence, protection, and coercion. His presence turns ordinary spaces like buses, hospitals, hotels, and homes into battlegrounds of pride and survival. Around him, women repeatedly resist being treated as bargains, prizes, or property, even when family pressure and money make refusal dangerous. Several men are trapped by debt, work stress, or social expectations, and their romantic lives become unstable under that strain. Marriage is never simple here: it is pushed as duty, used as leverage, or offered as a way out of danger. Vivan and Rivaan both struggle to balance love with financial insecurity and outside pressure, while their relationships are tested by jealousy and misunderstanding. Ashika, Radhika, Rhea, and other women push back against coercive proposals and public humiliation, insisting on dignity even when threatened. Kabir repeatedly declares desire as ownership, but the women around him do not accept that logic without resistance. Tiger appears as another aggressive power figure, sometimes supporting Kabir and sometimes intensifying the pressure around women and marriage. Hospital crises add another layer, showing how illness and money can trap families into desperate choices. In those moments, help can look like care, but it can also become another form of control. The show keeps returning to the same emotional conflict: love versus ownership, trust versus suspicion, and survival versus pride. Gang violence and police pressure remain in the background, making every personal dispute feel dangerous. Even when characters offer gifts, money, or promises, those gestures rarely settle the conflict for long. Instead, they expose hidden motives and deepen mistrust. By the end of the batch, relationships remain unstable, with unresolved confrontations, forced choices, and the sense that marriage itself has become both a weapon and a refuge.

venganza-en-la-pista.title: Venganza En La Pista
venganza-en-la-pista.description: Un legendario entrenador de automovilismo muere en un accidente sospechoso y despierta en el cuerpo del maltratado heredero de una familia poderosa. Al descubrir que el accidente y el "suicidio" del joven fueron orquestados por un despiadado magnate del deporte, asume su identidad para exponer la conspiración. Mientras reconstruye un equipo, revela la corrupción empresarial y lucha por justicia dentro y fuera de la pista, arriesga todo para derribar un imperio criminal.

a-home-rewritten.title: A Home Rewritten
a-home-rewritten.description: Reborn with memories of a painful past, Sheng Mimi accepts an unexpected marriage which was initially meant for her sister into a powerful but broken household. A missing husband, two mischievous children, and a mansion full of secrets await her. What begins as a deal for wealth slowly turns into a journey of love, trust, and belonging as Mimi transforms strangers into family and an empty house into a true home.

de-repartidor-a-heredero.title: De Repartidor A Heredero
de-repartidor-a-heredero.description: Julian’s story begins in humiliation, as he is publicly dumped by Chloe for Preston and then loses his job when the breakup becomes a workplace scandal. From that low point, he starts to reappear with impossible luck and hidden leverage, including a mysterious system-like signal and sudden money that no one around him can explain. His rise is tied to repeated reversals of status, from being mistaken for a valet to buying access to luxury spaces and taking control of them. Sienna enters as a struggling architect who first connects with Julian through kindness and shared hardship, but her own ambitions are threatened when Preston steals her eco-resort concept. Julian then shifts from survivor to patron, funding Sienna’s restart and helping place her back into a future with real scale. Around them, the story widens into hotel, restaurant, and corporate warfare, where rivals use contracts, bribery, sabotage, and public humiliation to protect their power. Julian answers by recruiting allies, exposing corruption, and turning elite spaces into battlegrounds he can win. In the culinary thread, a mysterious benefactor pushes a woman toward becoming the best chef she can be, while a collapsing restaurant is given a second chance through high-stakes tests and support. The emotional stakes keep rising as promises of empire, public scandal, and broken glass suggest that intimacy and danger are always colliding. Harper’s thread adds another layer of control and rescue, as she is pursued, constrained by a contract, and later abducted. Julian repeatedly becomes the person who stands between vulnerable women and the men or systems trying to own them. His rescues are not simple victories, because each one reveals a larger network behind the immediate threat. That larger network includes a global hotel syndicate, mercenaries, and a broader conspiracy built on bribery, kidnapping, and violence. The conflict then expands beyond hotels into crime and digital warfare, with hidden accounts, blackmail files, and a luxury island casino tied to an underground vault. Elena’s arc also turns dangerous, as she is relocated for protection after a syndicate attack and becomes part of a wider struggle over survival and retaliation. By the later stretch, corruption reaches government and media levels, with bribery, rigged contracts, a senator under pressure, and a deepfake scandal aimed at a powerful heroine. Across all of these threads, the central pattern is the same: people who were underestimated or cornered keep finding ways to fight back, while Julian emerges as a hidden power moving through chaos, protecting allies, and forcing stronger enemies to lose control.

main-bhi-buddhu.title: Main Bhi Buddhu
main-bhi-buddhu.description: Everyone in college calls him Buddhu—the poor delivery boy they can bully, mock and betray. Until one humiliation too many makes him stand up, challenge the college’s most powerful student leader, and turn from the campus joke into the voice of everyone too scared to fight back. Watch now!

wingman-no1-2.title: Wingman No.1
wingman-no1-2.description: Betrayed by his own family and left to die, a billionaire gets a second chance at life—reborn as his 8-year-old self. Armed with memories of the future, he sets out to protect his father, rebuild his empire, and rewrite his destiny before history repeats itself.

waterman-1.title: Waterman
waterman-1.description: The drama centers on a drought-hit rural village where survival depends on bringing water back to the land. Across the story, reform-minded men refuse to accept migration, surrender, or the loss of farming life. They keep proposing canals, embankments, check dams, roads, and irrigation routes as practical answers to hunger and dry fields. At first, these efforts are met with ridicule, family pressure, and village skepticism. Younger people and desperate parents often want city labor, modern comforts, or immediate escape instead of long, uncertain work. The reformers, however, insist that the village can still be revived if water is controlled and shared. Their struggle is not only against drought but also against authority, since elders, sarpanches, guards, officials, and local power holders repeatedly block approval or mock the plans. Bureaucratic delay and class prejudice make the work harder, especially when hand-drawn or improvised plans are dismissed as unworthy. Even so, the builders continue digging through hard ground and rocky hillsides, trusting practical knowledge learned from the fields. Support grows slowly as some women, villagers, and elders join the effort after first doubting it. The work becomes collective labor, with people gathering tools, digging together, and waiting anxiously for the monsoon. Storms, hunger, fatigue, and threats of punishment test whether the community can hold together long enough to finish. In several moments, water finally breaks through or begins reaching the land, proving that persistence can change the village’s future. Yet the victory is never simple, because sabotage, violence, and land disputes repeatedly turn progress into danger. Some characters are beaten, blamed, driven out, or left grieving as the canal struggle intensifies. Family conflict mirrors the larger social conflict, with fathers demanding obedience and sons refusing to abandon the project. The story also frames this labor as a legacy, revealing that quiet water-saving work can become a source of family pride and communal memory. By the end, the central stake remains the same: whether the village will keep fighting for water, land, and dignity, or give in to despair.

the-stolen-sun.title: The Stolen Sun
the-stolen-sun.description: A future-era genius wakes up in a dead noblewoman’s body, inherits her stolen identity, her paralyzed father, her mad grandfather, and a sister wearing her stolen face on the throne. Armed with forbidden medicine nobody in this world has ever seen, she builds a secret clinic in the slums, outmaneuvers the brilliant investigator hunting her, and fights her way back into her own home — one precise, lethal stitch at a time.

the-monk-man.title: The Monk Man
the-monk-man.description: After surviving a plane crash and growing up among monks deep in the jungle, a young man suddenly regains memories of his true identity. He returns to Mumbai to reclaim his billion-dollar empire and take revenge on the family that destroyed his own.

yevaraa-varudu.title: Yevaraa varudu
yevaraa-varudu.description: A simple wedding takes an unexpected turn, bringing two strangers closer in ways they never imagined. What will happen after the wedding is the interesting story.

yajamani-20.title: Yajamani 2.0
yajamani-20.description: Secretly wealthy business powerhouse Samanvita unexpectedly pairs up with Akash, who gives up his family's fortune to stand by her after her shallow ex-fiancé abandons her. Faced with constant humiliation from their corrupt families and rivals, Samanvita protects Akash while keeping her true status hidden. At a massive press conference, she proves her identity as the legendary "Sky Queen" by transferring 100 million into Akash's account, crushing her abusers and securing her empire alongside him

baal-baal-bache.title: Baal Baal Bache
baal-baal-bache.description: The story is built around humiliation, appearance, and the way public judgment shapes private lives. It begins with teasing and flirtation, as Malvika and Vicky turn a public roast into a charged exchange that mixes embarrassment with attraction. In parallel, a young man is crushed by baldness-related mockery at home, where his father wants to help him with a hair transplant but his mother and stepmother resist or weaponize his insecurity. The same pressure follows him into the workplace, where promotion, resentment, and beauty standards make skill feel less important than image. A fake herbal oil scam and other public spectacles show how desperation around baldness can be exploited for profit and entertainment. Rahul’s story then becomes central as he is repeatedly drawn into staged moments that look romantic but are often manipulative, especially around Yamini and the powerful men around her. He mistakes attention for affection, while coworkers and rivals turn his feelings into public embarrassment. As the corporate world grows more aggressive, Yamini’s ambitions rise through modeling, makeovers, and risky alliances, but her choices deepen jealousy and mistrust. A series of public confrontations, viral clips, and staged tests expose how easily reputation can be used as a weapon. Rahul is pushed to a breaking point by rejection, humiliation, and workplace cruelty, and he nearly gives up on life. Bhumi becomes his steady support, urging him to survive and later to fight back instead of surrendering. A sudden lottery windfall changes his fate and gives him the means to reinvent himself. He returns as Vicky Malhotra, founder of Inner Beauty, and turns his pain into a calculated campaign against Cosmetic Excellence. The rivalry becomes both personal and commercial, with brand attacks, loyalty tests, and market warfare replacing the old humiliation with a new kind of power struggle. Yamini and Karthik’s bond collapses under the pressure of scandal, control, and public exposure, especially after the fairness-cream stunt goes viral and triggers boycott calls. Karthik chooses the company over Yamini, while she rejects his claim that he made her career and tries to reclaim her independence. The scandal also widens into a broader critique of beauty pressure, colorism, and consumer deception, making the cosmetics conflict feel socially charged as well as personal. By the end, the story settles into a harsh but decisive arc of reinvention, where shame is answered with retaliation, self-respect, and a fight for dominance in both love and business.

el-protocolo-del-billonario.title: El Protocolo del Billonario
el-protocolo-del-billonario.description: Traicionado por su esposa y humillado por su rico amante, Jordan Mercer parece haberlo perdido todo. Pero una herencia oculta revela que es el heredero multimillonario detrás de Apex Ledger, la red blockchain más poderosa del mundo. Con ayuda de una investigadora federal, Jordan comienza a desmantelar en secreto el imperio corrupto que destruyó su vida, exponiendo fraudes y recuperando su poder con inteligencia, no con venganza.

jab-they-met.title: Jab They Met!!!
jab-they-met.description: Mahi, a hardworking college student battling poverty and her father’s illness, wants only to secure his treatment. Her life changes when she clashes with Kunal, a rich, arrogant campus star. Forced to become his assistant, their rivalry turns into a playful, slow-burning romance. But jealousy, prejudice and painful secrets test them, until Mahi discovers her worth—and Kunal learns love can’t be bought.

el-curador.title: El Curador
el-curador.description: Acusado injustamente del asesinato de su mentor por el corrupto director Alistair Croft, el restaurador Julian Vance adopta la identidad secreta de “El Curador”. Desde las sombras, crea falsificaciones perfectas para destruir el imperio de Croft. Entre traiciones, trampas y peligrosos engaños, Julian convierte su lucha por demostrar su inocencia en una calculada venganza donde una sola jugada puede costarle la vida.

el-regreso-de-la-leyenda.title: El Regreso de la Leyenda
el-regreso-de-la-leyenda.description: Levi’s story is driven by a fight to stay visible in a world that wants to control, replace, or erase him. A corporate executive named Maxwell tries to bury Levi’s legacy with a confidentiality deal and threatens to block him from every tower, but Levi refuses to trade away his identity for safety. That refusal pushes him into harsher climbs where survival and reputation are both on the line. He is forced into dangerous vertical tests, including storm-battered work and a deadly ascent with no safety lines, where instinct matters more than official approval. Jason Creed stands as the polished, algorithm-guided rival who is meant to replace Levi, yet Levi’s unlogged climb exposes the weakness of the system that tries to manage talent. Becca and Ledger become important allies, helping with survival work and a trace-free breach that depends on scavenged gear, local access, and trust. Their success shows that resistance in this world is improvised and collective rather than official. The company can see the result of Levi’s ascent, but not the climber himself, which keeps his identity unresolved and dangerous. Around him, other climbers are also trapped between control and self-definition. Valerie begins as confident and self-reliant, but storm conditions force her to accept Leon’s step-by-step guidance and to trust instinct over fixed plans. Her climb becomes a lesson in dependence, discipline, and the cost of trying to escape confinement. In the dockyard, Val and Skyline turn a crane climb into a precise shared rhythm, suggesting that skill can still create freedom inside a controlled environment. Their story is shadowed by hints of past loss and family legacy, which deepen the emotional stakes without changing the basic struggle. The wider world grows harsher as surveillance drones, biometric sweeps, AI tracking, and blacklist systems interfere with rescue and ascent alike. Levi and other climbers are pulled into rescues where human compassion clashes with automated protocol. A hidden rescuer, Legic, saves a man from a skyscraper and is later revealed to be hiding behind a window-cleaner cover identity, reinforcing the theme of concealed lives. Another mysterious climber, Skyline, reappears, evades infrared sensors, and escapes with help, showing how fragile official control really is. The batch closes with Valerie being saved by an unidentified man who disappears before security can name him, leaving hidden pasts, rivalries, and the struggle for freedom still unresolved.

a-soldiers-oath.title: A Soldier's Oath
a-soldiers-oath.description: After eight years of war, legendary General Lin Yuanlong returns home, only to find his mother Xiu and sister Rumi crushed by the corruption and cruelty of Magistrate Qing and his son Huang Shen. When justice fails his family, Yuan’s loyalty to his people turns into a relentless fight for truth, honor, and retribution.

renacido-para-reinar.title: Renacido para reinar
renacido-para-reinar.description: El brillante ingeniero Julian Sinclair llega a un mundo gobernado por magia oscura, aquelarres despiadados y criaturas monstruosas. Armado solo con su inteligencia y determinación, supera cada amenaza mediante la estrategia y la tecnología. Mientras poderosas facciones lo persiguen, Julian deberá pensar, construir y luchar para sobrevivir y transformar un mundo que jamás imaginó que un ingeniero se convertiría en su mayor amenaza.

ultimate-minister.title: Ultimate minister
ultimate-minister.description: The story centers on Ashutosh Rathore, a powerful Health Minister whose public reform image hides a deeply personal and dangerous return to Navgarh. He comes back searching for Prerna, but that private mission collides with old wounds, public suspicion, and a growing web of corruption. Prerna is tied to Chandan, and their relationship becomes a pressure point as Ashutosh’s presence reopens a long-buried past of misunderstanding and betrayal. At first, the conflict feels personal, but it quickly expands into a larger battle over a corrupt hospital system that exploits poor patients. Fees are inflated, bodies are held for ransom, and staff, fixers, and political protectors work together to keep the truth buried. Ashutosh repeatedly confronts this network, demanding records, exposing extortion, and refusing to be silenced. Police, officials, and commissioners enter the struggle as searches, cover-ups, and false identities deepen the mystery. The hospital becomes a place of fear, where injured people are hidden, violence breaks out, and even a found phone or bloodstain can trigger a wider investigation. Chandan emerges as both a personal rival and a political strongman, tied to the local power structure and determined to control the narrative. Prerna resists Ashutosh’s claims and rejects what she sees as obsession or false promises, while also being pulled into public roles that others try to use for image and strategy. The story suggests that Ashutosh’s past with Prerna is not simple, since a ten-year-old rescue memory is disputed and never fully settled. Meanwhile, other families suffer under the same corrupt system, and their grief and anger turn into protest. A young man’s fight to recover his father’s body shows how deeply the hospital racket wounds ordinary people. Public events, ceremonies, and political gatherings become stages for humiliation, exposure, and counterclaims. Ashutosh is at times dismissed as an impostor, but he ultimately reveals himself and pushes back against those trying to erase him. The crackdown reaches Akram Singh, Chandan, and their allies, exposing a wider alliance between medicine, administration, and politics. By the end of the batch, the struggle has shifted from a hidden personal search into an open confrontation over power, accountability, and the cost of corruption. The emotional stakes remain unresolved, but the political stakes have become impossible to ignore.

la-novia-que-quemo-el-cielo.title: La Novia que Quemó el Cielo
la-novia-que-quemo-el-cielo.description: Evangeline Gray, una tejedora de sudarios cautiva, es obligada a comprometerse con Cassian Vane, un obsesivo Sumo Sacerdote, mientras oculta su adictiva sangre de oro líquido de peligrosos semidioses. Cuando Julian regresa convertido en un oscuro fanático y el Cielo intenta destruirla, Evangeline deberá elegir entre ascender y perderlo todo o gobernar junto al monstruo que juró protegerla.

linaje-dorado-el-despertar-soberano.title: Linaje Dorado: El Despertar Soberano
linaje-dorado-el-despertar-soberano.description: En Ashcroft Bay, donde el linaje lo es todo, Vivienne Ashworth es condenada a muerte tras la caída de su familia. Para sobrevivir, forma un vínculo prohibido con el letal Alexander Voss. Armada con el poder oculto de su sangre, Vivienne reúne aliados y lidera una rebelión contra los tiránicos Ocho Fundadores. Su batalla final decidirá si recupera su legado o muere en el intento.

queens-jackpot-vision.title: Queen's Jackpot Vision
queens-jackpot-vision.description: Queen’s Jackpot Vision ek supernatural business microdrama hai jahan power sirf paison se nahi, vision se aati hai. Juhi, ek broke college girl, accident ke baad extraordinary powers paati hai aur rich, corrupt aur powerful logon ki duniya mein ghuskar unke rules tod deti hai. Har episode ka promise simple hai — log Juhi ko underestimate karenge, aur Juhi unhe embarrass karegi.

la-estudiante-de-un-billon-de-dolares.title: La Estudiante de un Billón de Dólares
la-estudiante-de-un-billon-de-dolares.description: Tras ser asesinada junto a su padre, Emma Hart regresa al pasado y despierta el día de su llegada a la Academia Aethelgard. Con el poder de descubrir la historia oculta de los objetos, comienza a revelar los secretos de la élite. Junto a Liam Ashworth, Emma luchará contra una poderosa conspiración, salvará a su padre y reconstruirá el legado de su familia, pasando de víctima perseguida a una implacable vengadora.

the-poet-who-built-an-empire.title: The Poet Who Built an Empire
the-poet-who-built-an-empire.description: After mysteriously awakening in an ancient kingdom, a failed modern-day man finds himself trapped in the body of an infamous good-for-nothing noble. Armed with nothing but his memory of three hundred classical poems and modern knowledge, he turns poetry into power, wealth, influence, and love. As rivals rise and kingdoms collide, his words become weapons in a journey from ridicule to ruling an empire.

casada-con-el-rival.title: Casada con el rival
casada-con-el-rival.description: La vida de Emma se derrumba al descubrir que su prometido la engaña con su hermanastra. Su madrastra la acusa de traicionar a la empresa familiar y consigue que su padre la desherede. Humillada y obligada a empezar de cero, Emma encuentra un inesperado aliado multimillonario. Juntos, desvelarán oscuros secretos mientras ella lucha por recuperar su legado y vengarse de quienes la traicionaron.

bajo-el-lienzo.title: Bajo el Lienzo
bajo-el-lienzo.description: La brillante restauradora de arte Beatrice Moore vive atrapada bajo el control de su manipulador hermano. Cuando el investigador Silas Thorne vincula una serie de obras falsificadas con su laboratorio, ambos forman una peligrosa alianza. Entre recuerdos ocultos, asesinatos y una conspiración internacional, Beatrice deberá descubrir la verdad sobre la muerte de sus padres, recuperar su libertad y destruir un imperio construido sobre sangre y mentiras.

rathore-returns.title: Rathore Returns
rathore-returns.description: The show opens on a harsh world where unpaid laborers demand wages and are met with violence, setting a tone of exploitation and power abuse. From there, the story expands into a crime-heavy arc centered on Aryan Rathod, a feared enforcer who is trying to finish one last job and leave the underworld behind. His loyalty to Malik and his desire to walk away create constant tension, especially as hidden betrayals and criminal pressure keep pulling him back in. At the same time, Aryan returns home after many years and faces a father who cannot forgive the abandonment that left the family to suffer. That reunion is made even more painful by the father’s illness and the sense that Aryan’s absence forced others to carry the household burden. Across the show, Aryan is repeatedly framed as a protector, stepping in when vulnerable people are threatened. The central romantic thread follows Kavya, who is trapped inside a smuggling conspiracy and forced to cooperate under blackmail, surveillance, and threats of jail or violence. She and Aryan are drawn toward each other, but their bond is repeatedly strained by danger, secrecy, and her attempts to keep him away from the fallout. The smuggling plot widens from airport parcels and gold consignments into a larger network of corrupt officers, insiders, and evidence files that can expose the operation. Just as the characters seem close to breaking that ring, the danger shifts again into a hospital-based organ-trafficking conspiracy. Meera becomes the key figure in that medical nightmare, uncovering hidden records, vanished patients, and doctors who use the hospital as a controlled battlefield. Aryan again becomes the main ally, helping with rescue efforts and even donating a kidney when Meera’s life depends on it. Her survival comes at a cost, because the surgery leaves emotional wounds and unresolved feelings between them. Meera’s confession of long-held love is met with Aryan’s guarded silence, keeping the romance suspended rather than resolved. The later stretch broadens into workplace and family melodrama, where Pihu is torn between Rocky, who promises a future while chasing status, and Aryan, who returns with regret and warns that Rocky cannot be trusted. Public confrontations, apologies, jealousy, and humiliation push Pihu toward heartbreak as relationships collapse under scrutiny. By the end, the show has fused crime thriller, medical peril, family conflict, and romantic betrayal into one escalating struggle over loyalty, survival, and who can truly be trusted.

el-contrato-de-la-ivy-league.title: El contrato de la Ivy League
el-contrato-de-la-ivy-league.description: Isaiah, un brillante estudiante becado y sin dinero, acepta trabajar como tutor en la mansión de la poderosa familia Valentine para asegurar el futuro de su hermana. Allí conoce a cuatro hermanas herederas idénticas y queda atrapado entre sus secretos. Tras un misterioso beso durante un apagón, Isaiah no sabe cuál de ellas conquistó su corazón. Entre engaños, pistas falsas y una despiadada matriarca, deberá descubrir la verdad.

ghost-protocol-last-strike.title: Ghost Protocol: Last Strike
ghost-protocol-last-strike.description: Branded a traitor’s son and forced to bury his identity as India’s legendary Air Force fighter pilot, “The Ghost,” Lakshya Sharma must return to the skies for an impossible covert mission—to destroy five enemy airbases before a devastating attack, expose the conspiracy that disgraced his father, and prove that while a soldier’s honour may be stolen, his love for his family and motherland can never be defeated.

la-heredera-imparable.title: La Heredera Imparable
la-heredera-imparable.description: Tras la muerte de su padre, Claire queda atrapada bajo el control de su cruel familia y es obligada a casarse con Luke, un simple chofer, para perder su herencia. Fingiendo ser una esposa sumisa, comienza a sabotear en secreto los negocios ilegales de su familia. Pero cuando descubre que Luke es en realidad un poderoso billonario, su falso matrimonio se convierte en una alianza para destruir a quienes les arrebataron todo.

red-flag-husband.title: Red Flag Husband
red-flag-husband.description: When Kim Ha-na wakes up inside the romance novel she's reading, she realizes she's the doomed fiancée destined to be poisoned. To rewrite her fate, she proposes a contract marriage to Park Woo-jin, the ruthless billionaire known as the story's tyrant. As deadly conspiracies, family power games, and unexpected romance unfold, Ha-na must outsmart the very story that wants her dead.

la-viuda-de-mi-hermano-mi-obsesion.title: La Viuda de Mi Hermano, Mi Obsesión
la-viuda-de-mi-hermano-mi-obsesion.description: Tras la muerte de su esposo Arthur, Elena Vance se niega a abandonar Vance Crest, el viñedo familiar, incluso cuando el despiadado Charles Sterling se apodera de la propiedad. Atrapada en sus propias tierras y rodeada de traiciones, Elena está a punto de perderlo todo. Pero Julian, el hermano menor de Arthur, regresa del extranjero con un poder oculto, decidido a recuperar el legado de su familia y enfrentar a quienes lo destruyeron.

ella-construyo-su-imperio.title: Ella construyó su imperio
ella-construyo-su-imperio.description: Clara Vance, una brillante programadora financiera, recupera recuerdos que revelan cómo fue drogada, declarada mentalmente inestable, separada de su hijo y despojada de su revolucionario algoritmo. Rechazando la ayuda de su exmarido multimillonario, regresa a Wall Street para vengarse, desenmascarar la conspiración, recuperar a su hijo y derribar el imperio que construyeron a costa de ella.

nurse-by-day-super-yaaksh-by-destiny.title: Nurse By Day, Super Yaaksh By Destiny
nurse-by-day-super-yaaksh-by-destiny.description: The story begins as a hospital mystery centered on Dr. Megha and Ajay, where a clue in case 201 suggests that Ajay is tied to a dangerous hidden truth. Very quickly, the plot expands beyond medicine into a supernatural world of Yaksh origins, ancient enemies, and buried identities. Chandrakanta and Riddhi act as guides who awaken Ajay and Mrityunjay to their true nature, while warnings about lost memories and an approaching celestial event raise the urgency. Ajay is repeatedly pulled into strange cases involving possession, curses, and spiritual illness, and he often sees the truth before others believe him. His attempts to help patients are met with skepticism, public humiliation, and accusations, which keeps his position unstable even as his abilities become harder to deny. At the same time, his bond with Megha grows complicated, because she pushes him to recover his memories while also struggling with family pressure and her own feelings. The romance thread is repeatedly interrupted by misunderstandings, staged scandals, and the demand that Ajay prove himself worthy in front of others. A separate social and corporate conflict adds another layer, with company shares, fake idols, and public fraud exposing how money and status are used to control people. Ajay’s exposure of the fake idol scam shifts power away from his rivals and shows that he can overturn public opinion when he reveals the truth. Across these arcs, characters like Sandy, Deepesh, Viraj, and others keep turning relationships into transactions, betrayals, or status games. The show also introduces larger mythic threats such as Vinash and Sahul, making the conflict feel increasingly dangerous and personal. Ajay is not only fighting social humiliation but also enemies who want to kill him, erase him, or exploit his hidden power. His death, return, and memory loss deepen the mystery around who he really is and who betrayed him. As the supernatural war grows, Ajay learns that his Yaksh identity is central to the struggle and that protecting Megha may require keeping distance from her. Megha, however, refuses to simply step aside, which keeps their relationship emotionally charged even when danger closes in. By the end of the batch, the story has become a layered battle over identity, love, family approval, corporate control, and survival against forces that cannot be seen by ordinary people.
