bodyguard-ponnu.title: Bodyguard Ponnu
bodyguard-ponnu.description: அசாத்திய சக்தி கொண்ட துணிச்சலான ஷக்தி, இளவரசர் ஹர்ஷவர்தனின் பாதுகாவலராகிறார். அரியணையை கைப்பற்றும் சதியை முறியடிக்கும் போது இருவருக்கும் காதல் மலர்கிறது. அதேசமயம், ஷக்தி தனது கடந்தகாலத்தின் அதிர்ச்சி உண்மையை அறிந்து, அரச குடும்பத்தின் விதியையே மாற்றுகிறாள்.

sati-ke-mahadev.title: Sati Ke Mahadev
sati-ke-mahadev.description: A warrior princess driven by vengeance challenges the enigmatic Mahadev, only to become the love that awakens the heart of the eternal ascetic—until a tragic sacrifice turns their immortal romance into the very force that shakes the three worlds.

നിഴൽ-യുദ്ധം.title: നിഴൽ യുദ്ധം
നിഴൽ-യുദ്ധം.description: After sacrificing his billionaire lifestyle as the secret founder of a tech empire to give his family a simple life, a hidden tycoon is ruthlessly humiliated and divorced by his status-climbing wife for a corrupt corporate rival. When he is forced to reclaim his throne as the multi-billion-dollar CEO of Oracle Group, he must systematically dismantle his enemies, teach his entitled son the true value of hard work, and leave his regretful ex-wife behind forever to secure his legendary legacy.

my-dad-my-hero.title: My Dad My Hero
my-dad-my-hero.description: A hard-working mechanic's life takes a wild turn when a beautiful woman asks him to pose as her husband. But as they spend time together, buried memories resurface—he realizes she is the exact same girl he saved and shared an intimate, drunken night with years ago! Just as he pieces the puzzle of his love life together, the biggest shock drops. His father, seemingly a humble office peon, finally reveals their family's true, powerful identity—a secret kept hidden even from the hero himself!

vaqeel-sahab-ka-badla.title: Vaqeel Sahab ka Badla
vaqeel-sahab-ka-badla.description: Harshvardhan Malhotra, India's most celebrated lawyer, defends wealthy heir Raunak Thapar in a sexual assault case, unaware that Raunak later attacks Harsh's pregnant wife, causing the death of their unborn child. When Harsh vows revenge, a shocking truth emerges—Raunak is his long-lost brother. Torn between family and justice, Harsh risks everything to expose a corrupt empire and punish the man who ruined his life.

laakha-di-galtiyan.title: Laakha Di Galtiyan
laakha-di-galtiyan.description:
**Laakha Di Galtiyan**

When Harleen and Rajinder Grewal visit their own resort in simple clothes to celebrate their anniversary, they are mistaken for poor impostors and humiliated by arrogant manager Simran and her allies. As their true identity is repeatedly dismissed, the cruelty spirals out of control. *Laakha Di Galtiyan* is a gripping tale of pride, prejudice, family loyalty and the heavy price of judging people by appearances.

crowned-in-white.title: Crowned in White
crowned-in-white.description: After being widowed, humiliated and cast aside by her in-laws, Neha is forced into a marriage with a man she believes is an ordinary milkman. But Sagar is actually heir to a vast dairy empire—and the one man who sees her true worth. With his love beside her, Neha rises from rejection to power, reclaiming her dignity and confronting those who once destroyed her.

dil-hack-love-crack.title: Dil Hack, Love Crack
dil-hack-love-crack.description: ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ದ್ರೋಹ ಮತ್ತು ನೋವಿನ ಕಥೆಯಾಗಿ ಮಾರ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸತ್ಯಗಳು ಹೊರಬಂದಂತೆ, ಮಹಿಳೆ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಮರು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.

mechanic-annayya-1.title: Mechanic Annayya
mechanic-annayya-1.description: Karan enters the story as a disciplined specialist who uncovers sabotage in the F-31 mission, and that early technical crisis sets the tone for a world where hidden danger matters as much as public status. Very quickly, the drama widens beyond the mission into weddings, family disputes, and elite gatherings where people are judged by rank, money, and access. Maitri repeatedly stands up for her brother and draws firm lines against anyone who insults her family or tries to control her marriage space. Karan is often dismissed as only a mechanic, but he keeps insisting that character and duty matter more than appearance or wealth. Public humiliation becomes a recurring weapon, especially when wealthy rivals and former classmates mock him and his sister for their past and present circumstances. Those insults repeatedly trigger confrontations that turn verbal cruelty into slaps, threats, and physical fights. At the same time, money troubles deepen the conflict, with arguments over funding, transfers, frozen accounts, and who is responsible for family losses. The wedding and ceremony settings become battlegrounds where romance, obligation, and financial leverage are all tangled together. Vivaan is caught between family pressure and love, while Kiara is tied to a tense arrangement that may also carry real emotional stakes. Ranvijay Shah emerges as a major power figure whose presence changes the atmosphere of every room he enters. He is treated as someone who can control access, silence mockery, and shift the balance between the powerful and the vulnerable. Karan’s enemies repeatedly underestimate him, only to discover that he has connections strong enough to threaten major institutions. That reversal grows sharper when the wealthy elite realize the man they mocked is actually Karan Ravuth, the Star Lord and founder of CE Universe. The story also keeps returning to old wounds, especially the public shame inflicted on Maitri and the way those memories still shape present conflicts. Family loyalty is tested again and again, as brothers, sisters, and parents choose between protection, control, and humiliation. In the later stretch, the drama moves from exposure and revenge toward a more emotional resolution, with Ranvijay and Maithri entering a partnership and love arc. The final tone suggests that trust and protection can survive the chaos, even after betrayal, class prejudice, and public disgrace.

the-dark-emperor.title: The Dark Emperor
the-dark-emperor.description: After a modern civil engineer is mysteriously transported into the body of a notorious thug in an ancient kingdom, he vows to leave his criminal past behind. Refusing to sell his newly acquired wife like everyone expects, he uses his modern knowledge to create a successful liquor business, protect the innocent, and rise from poverty. As famine, corruption, and powerful enemies threaten his path, Xu Mu must build an empire while earning the trust and love of the woman he swore to protect.

dark-tides-of-blackwood-manor.title: Dark Tides of Blackwood Manor
dark-tides-of-blackwood-manor.description: After being murdered by her cruel fiancé, Dan Blackwood, Christina Scott awakens seven days before her death reborn with the memories of her doomed first life. Trapped inside Blackwood Manor, surrounded by Dan, his ruthless mistress Beatrice, and a corrupt family determined to destroy her, Christina hides her true intentions behind the façade of a helpless victim. As the midsummer banquet approaches, Christina prepares her final trap one that could expose the Blackwoods forever.

born-of-darkness.title: Born Of Darkness
born-of-darkness.description: Kai Zhou, jise pehle star ka nikamma maana jaata tha, darasal Ninyanve star ki judwa shakti wala yoddha tha. Pita ki maut ke baad usne apni mu-boli behen Lina ki zimmedari sambhali.Kisi wajah se Lina gehri neend mein chali gayi, Tabhi use pata chala ki Lina teesri rajkumari hai aur uske sharir mein Demon Emperor Mo Xuluo qaid tha. Lina ko bachane ke liye Kai ne us shaitaan ko azaad kiya, par wo hairaan reh gaya kyunki woh khud Mo Xuluo ka punarjanam tha. Kya ab woh is duniya ko mita dega?

la-reina-del-hielo-del-billonario.title: La Reina del Hielo del Billonario
la-reina-del-hielo-del-billonario.description: Cinco años después de que su hermanastra Grace le robara una revolucionaria rutina de patinaje y arruinara su carrera, Hannah Wells regresa al hielo decidida a recuperar lo que le pertenece. Tras salvar a Leo, el hijo de un frío billonario, Hannah se convierte en su entrenadora y encuentra una inesperada oportunidad para volver a competir. Entre humillaciones, traiciones una creciente conexión con John Logan, Hannah luchará por recuperar su nombre demostrar quién es la verdadera reina del hielo.

king-in-disguise-1.title: King in Disguise
king-in-disguise-1.description: The story follows Ved, a devoted heir and rescue worker, as he returns after years away and is immediately pulled back into family, romance, and corporate conflict. He is shaken when Arpita reveals she is in love and may marry someone else, even as he admits he has long put her first. Arpita still asks for his support, but she keeps parts of the truth from him while larger schemes gather around her family. At the same time, Rena and Tej begin plotting to use Arpita’s long-lost younger brother to gain control of Purohit Enterprises. What starts as personal heartbreak quickly expands into a world of public humiliation, roadside fights, and class cruelty, where damaged property and status become excuses for violence. Repeated confrontations show wealthy figures using guards, money, and social power to dominate ordinary people, while others refuse to bow or apologize. Yash Sharma emerges as a major force in these clashes, backed by authority and family influence, but he is repeatedly challenged by rivals who question his entitlement. The conflict deepens when a family photograph and a child’s resemblance to Arpita raise suspicions about hidden identity and secret family ties. Ved is later injured and found with severe asthma complications, adding urgency and danger to the struggle around him. Arpita’s fear grows as she searches for her missing younger brother and tries to protect those caught in the chaos. The business side of the story becomes just as volatile, with audits, missing approvals, and allegations of misuse exposing corruption inside the company. Ashok’s takeover of Purohit Enterprises and his investigation into Yash’s activities turn the company into a battlefield of loyalty and control. Ved resists being handed power too quickly and insists on seeing the ground reality before accepting responsibility. Reena remains tied to the social and romantic tension, sometimes as a bold public presence and sometimes as part of the humiliation and accusation surrounding Ved and Yash. Charity events and elite gatherings become stages for both generosity and scandal, where donations, luxury items, and public accusations are used as weapons. The final stretch shifts toward revelation, as Arpita defends the injured young man and the truth about his identity begins to surface. Ved Purohith is ultimately revealed as the heir and appointed new CEO, but the earlier accusations and betrayals are not neatly resolved. Across the whole arc, the stakes are whether love, family loyalty, and truth can survive manipulation, class prejudice, and the fight for corporate power.

maa-tujhe-kaal-ka-salaam.title: Maa Tujhe Kaal Ka Salaam
maa-tujhe-kaal-ka-salaam.description: Neil, India’s deadliest undercover commando, is forced to pose as Col Singh’s daughter Kiara’s fiancé to foil her planned abduction. Humiliated as a servant, he silently hunts the enemy within. When Rahul, Kiara’s charming friend, is exposed as an arms kingpin, Neil’s true identity as KAAL emerges. Kiara joins him, and the hunted becomes the hunter. Now, it’s not revenge. It’s WAR!

arya-veeran.title: Arya Veeran
arya-veeran.description: The story follows Aaryaveera as he struggles to uncover the truth of his origins while sacred objects and royal bloodlines keep pointing him toward a destiny he does not fully understand. Early on, he confronts Maha Guru about years of secrecy, and the guidance he receives suggests that Chandramani and other heirlooms are meant to lead him back to family. At the same time, the court is filled with competing claims over lost sons, abandoned infants, and rightful heirs, making identity itself the central conflict. Urmila repeatedly stands at the center of these disputes, defending the humiliated and the vulnerable, and her courage draws royal attention as well as danger. Elanjan is pulled into this larger struggle after rescuing Urmila and revealing his own abandoned-orphan past, which opens a search for his parents and place in the royal order. Elsewhere, mothers such as Kunti and another queen plead for recognition of sons who have been denied by authority, but rulers repeatedly refuse or delay the truth. The palace tensions grow sharper as princes and maharajas clash over legitimacy, with Nakul Veer, Maharaja Chandradheep, and others asserting power while others challenge their judgments. Mani and the cowherd-like humble figures become symbols of hidden lineage, as family bonds are hinted at but not fully accepted. In parallel, Arya Veera and Ashoka are tested through public suspicion, impossible feats, and challenges to prove who they really are. Reports that Arya Veera split the sacred Nandi stone and later the Kaaliyasthram conflict make him both celebrated and doubted. The story also widens into battlefield politics, where Bindusara openly challenges the ruler and the conflict expands into questions of women’s dignity, throne control, and who deserves to lead. Gurudev and other moral figures defend honor and warn of hidden enemies, while darker forces pursue sacred weapons and forbidden power. A forbidden ritual, soul sacrifice, and the search for the Kaali Astram raise the stakes from court dispute to mythic war. Through all of this, Aaryaveera is repeatedly pushed to prove that power cannot simply be taken, because the greater weapon chooses its rightful wielder. By the end, he emerges as a warrior-king whose authority is publicly recognized, even as mercy, justice, and unresolved family truths remain part of his burden. The show closes with his identity and destiny affirmed in public, but the emotional wounds around lineage, abandonment, and rightful belonging still shape the world around him.

my-pa-is-a-political-prince.title: My PA is a Political Prince
my-pa-is-a-political-prince.description:
My PA Is a Political Prince

Fearless activist Riya dreams of changing the world, unaware that her unpaid PA, Aryaman, is actually the heir to a powerful political dynasty. As love grows between them, ambitious politician Vikram pulls Riya into a dangerous world of fame and power. Torn between love and ambition, Riya must discover who truly stands by her before she loses everything.

ಮೈಸೂರು-ಅರಮನೆಯ-Unknown-Secrets.title: ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆಯ Unknown Secrets
ಮೈಸೂರು-ಅರಮನೆಯ-Unknown-Secrets.description: ಮೈಸೂರು ಅಂಬಾ ವಿಲಾಸ ಅರಮನೆಯ ಭವ್ಯತೆಯ ಹಿಂದೆ ಅಡಗಿರುವ ರಹಸ್ಯ ವಿಧಿವಿಧಾನಗಳು, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ತಂತ್ರಗಾರಿಕೆಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ನಿಗೂಢ ಕಥೆಗಳೇನು? ಒಡೆಯರ್ ರಾಜವಂಶದ ತೆರೆಮರೆಯ ನೈಜ ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ತ್ಯಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ಅರಮನೆಯ ಅಪರೂಪದ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಚ್ಚಿಡುವ ಈ ಸರಣಿಯನ್ನು ಈಗಲೇ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ!

love-left-to-bleed.title: Love Left To Bleed
love-left-to-bleed.description: Archaeological Department ka expert researcher Jun apni wife Lili se beintehaa pyaar karta tha, lekin woh apne purane premi aur foreign-returned PhD Ray ke paas laut gayi. Dono ne Jun ko har mod par dhokha diya aur ek khatarnak haadse mein hui mauton ka zimmedar bhi use hi thehara diya. Lekin jab sach saamne aaya, Ray ki farzi degree aur uski saazish ka pardafaash ho gaya. Kya Lili apna toota rishta kabhi jod paayi?

ceo-pellam-intern-mogudu.title: CEO Pellam Intern Mogudu
ceo-pellam-intern-mogudu.description: The story follows a corporate and family power struggle that begins with Abhi or Abhiram entering Alpha Tech as an intern even though he is already tied to CEO Keerthi. He refuses shortcuts and insists on earning his place from the bottom, which immediately makes him a target for suspicion and humiliation. Coworkers and executives keep trying to uncover his real purpose, while his hidden marriage creates pressure at home and at work. Keerthi supports him, but her mother strongly rejects the union and pushes for control over Keerthi’s future. The family conflict grows sharper as accusations, investigations, and talk of pregnancy and divorce begin to surround the couple. In the office, class divisions are constantly exposed through mockery, false assumptions, and public tests of status. Abhi is mistaken for a delivery boy, insulted over small mistakes, and repeatedly challenged to prove he belongs. The tension escalates into public confrontations, security threats, and physical clashes, showing that the workplace has become a battlefield of pride and power. A separate wealth-and-status thread reinforces the same theme through characters who use mansions, watches, and money to intimidate others while hiding insecurity and deception. The corporate conflict then turns more dangerous when Abhi is sent to secure funding, and the meeting becomes a coercive trap that leads to a false assault accusation and public scandal. Natasha Virani’s arrest turns the dispute into a wider crisis, and blame spreads across the company as people split over who is truthful and who is manipulating events. Contract disputes, forged-signature claims, and firings follow, but the dismissed man later returns with BK Group-backed funding, proving that the struggle is not over. Keerthi then takes control after the Alpha/VK takeover and imposes strict discipline, publicly punishing bullying and harassment. Even so, hidden access to leadership remains a mystery, because a verified CEO-signed document and a funded AI proposal suggest Abhiram has deeper ties than others expected. The story keeps folding personal identity into corporate ambition, with secret marriages, mistaken husbands, and spouses working inside the same company under false or hidden roles. Family betrayal becomes more painful when Kanakamma exposes Vicky’s lies about his background and his denial of his own mother. By the end, Abhiram is publicly restored and even appointed Chief Architect, but the peace does not last. The final stretch leaves the company and the family still unstable, with violent returns, hostage threats, and a new order forming around Keerthi and Satya while the truth about loyalty, status, and identity remains contested.

vanarajan.title: Vanarajan
vanarajan.description: In the forests bordering a cluster of villages lives a young man everyone has seen but no one truly knows. He moves with animals, crosses the river as quickly as it runs, and disappears into the trees before anyone can follow

the-royal-trio.title: The Royal Trio
the-royal-trio.description: A master gambler reunites with his long-lost parents and saves his sister, guided by a secret token from his guru. His family's joy is threatened when ruthless rivals plot to steal their grand casino. After his younger brother loses a high-stakes match, losing their empire, the hero takes over the table. Unleashing his extraordinary hidden powers, he dominates the ultimate game to crush their enemies and protect his family's legacy.

the-god-of-medicine.title: The God of Medicine
the-god-of-medicine.description: The story spans a long chain of family, medical, corporate, and romantic crises that keep tightening around the same core problem: people are forced to trade money, loyalty, and even their bodies or lives to survive. At the center is Kian, who appears in different roles across the conflict, but is consistently tied to healing, protection, and high-stakes power struggles. Around him, wives, children, and lovers are pulled into arguments over illness, debt, and betrayal, and many of those conflicts begin at home before spilling into public view. A seriously ill child and other vulnerable family members repeatedly raise the stakes, making treatment money and medical access urgent rather than abstract. Several parents and partners break under pressure, with divorce threats, separation, and accusations showing how financial desperation corrodes trust. At the same time, Kian’s hidden medical skill and unusual authority make him valuable to powerful families and companies that want to use him for their own ends. Corporate battles over succession, shares, land, and district projects become as dangerous as the domestic ones, especially when scandals, leaks, and takeover threats expose how fragile the companies really are. Wealthy figures repeatedly try to control others through blank cheques, forced bargains, public humiliation, and threats of kidnapping or retaliation. Rescue scenes recur often, but each rescue only reveals a deeper layer of danger, whether the threat comes from debt collectors, hostile rivals, or people hiding behind official power. The romantic thread is equally unstable, with confessions, jealousy, hidden marriages, and public claims of boyfriend or husband status creating constant emotional fallout. In several places, a woman’s safety or a child’s treatment is tied to whether someone will betray Kian or sign away control. The medical thread grows darker as rare herbs, ancestral energy, mind control, and a mysterious guide or book become central to survival and revenge. Illness is never just personal here; it becomes leverage in boardrooms, hospitals, and family homes alike. Even when Kian wins temporary victories, such as saving a chairman, securing land, or reviving a collapsing situation, those wins only deepen the larger struggle for control. The repeated pattern is that every solution creates a new debt, a new enemy, or a new emotional wound. By the end of the batch, relationships are fractured, trust is badly damaged, and the fight over family, medicine, and power is still unresolved.

mass-daddy-leo.title: Mass Daddy Leo
mass-daddy-leo.description: சாதாரண செக்யூரிட்டி கார்டாக மறைந்து வாழும் ஒரு மாபெரும் வீரன், தன் தங்கையின் கொலைக்குக் காரணமான கொடூரக் கும்பலின் பின்னணியைக் கண்டுபிடிக்கும் அதே வேளையில், இரக்கமற்ற கார்ப்பரேட் எதிரிகளிடமிருந்து தன் மனைவியையும் மகளையும் காப்பாற்றப் போராடுகிறான்.

el-heredero-maldito-es-un-dios.title: El Heredero Maldito es un Dios
el-heredero-maldito-es-un-dios.description: Caius Drenmere es despreciado como un jugador borracho y la vergüenza de su noble familia. Pero tras su fachada despreocupada se oculta el legendario Fénix Espectral, el protector más poderoso del reino de Elyndor. Mientras fuerzas enemigas amenazan el reino, Caius combate en secreto a peligrosos hechiceros y soporta traiciones y humillaciones. Cuando las Pruebas Soberanas revelan su verdadero poder, deberá enfrentar a los responsables de la muerte de su padre y salvar Elyndor de la destrucción.

melting-ice-melting-hearts.title: Melting Ice, Melting Hearts
melting-ice-melting-hearts.description: Billionaire Aryan hides behind the life of a humble ice-lolly seller, while heiress Mira is nursing a broken heart after being betrayed by the man she loved. A chance encounter turns into a contract marriage, but as dangerous family secrets, hidden identities and enemies close in, their fake relationship begins melting into something real.

golpeame-otra-vez.title: Golpéame Otra Vez
golpeame-otra-vez.description: En la Academia Marcial St. Jude, las élites cibernéticas dominan y desprecian a los estudiantes becados sin poderes. Pero Kai esconde una habilidad extraordinaria: puede absorber la energía de cada golpe y volverse más fuerte. Junto a Clara, la “diosa” de la academia, desafiará a poderosos herederos, autoridades corruptas y enemigos cada vez más letales, mientras despierta un misterioso poder capaz de destruir toda la jerarquía de la academia.

galat-raah-sahi-dil.title: Galat Raah, Sahi Dil
galat-raah-sahi-dil.description: After discovering that the God of War’s love was merely a lie to use her as a shield for her scheming half-sister, a betrayed moon princess engineers a divine bride swap and marries the cursed, blind Lord of the Underworld—only to find true love on the “wrong” path and ignite a war across the three realms when her former fiancé decides he would rather destroy her than lose her.

love-on-duty-2.title: Love on Duty
love-on-duty-2.description: On her wedding day, small-town waitress Tanvi is betrayed by her groom and best friend. Humiliated, she collapses—only to be saved by Rehan, a charming ambulance driver. In a bold act of defiance, she asks him to marry her on the spot. But Tanvi doesn’t know Rehan is secretly a billionaire heir, hiding his identity to escape his father and honor his mother’s values.

vaarasulu-vacharu.title: Vaarasulu Vacharu
vaarasulu-vacharu.description: The show follows a Telugu family whose celebrations repeatedly turn into battles over pride, truth, and belonging. Birthdays and Deepavali gatherings begin with greetings and gifts, but they quickly expose old wounds between fathers, sons, and sons-in-law. Anand returns to a fractured household hoping for acceptance, yet his father repeatedly rejects him and drags up a buried scandal from the past. His mother keeps trying to hold the family together and shield him from humiliation. Around the table, expensive gifts become symbols of status, favoritism, and shame rather than affection. Wine bottles in particular become a recurring test of authenticity, with scanners, experts, invoices, and certificates used to prove whether a gift is real or fake. These disputes often escalate into public accusations, forced apologies, and even physical confrontation. Arjun also becomes tied to the gift conflicts, with his role shifting between family tension, control, and proof of status. As the story widens, workplace and business pressures enter the family drama through hotel links, contracts, and corporate authority. Kavya emerges as a credible voice who uses evidence and professional standing to defend disputed items and her own achievements. Akhil’s return from a new job adds another layer of suspicion, especially when relatives question whether his success and gifts are genuine. The family’s obsession with appearances keeps colliding with hidden truths about ownership, payment, and inheritance. Sandeep’s business deal and corporate standing raise the stakes beyond domestic pride, showing that the same struggle for credibility exists in both family and work. A vengeful outsider and other challengers further destabilize the household by reopening old grievances and disputed claims. At several points, the family learns that the younger generation holds more power than expected, forcing elders to reconsider their judgments. Some apologies and a shared meal suggest partial repair, but the emotional damage is not fully healed. By the end, the show remains centered on whether this family can move past humiliation and deception, or whether every celebration will keep becoming another contest of ego.

mr-tees-maar-khan.title: Mr. Tees Maar Khan
mr-tees-maar-khan.description: Zoya ka bachpan ka pyaar Zhen usse shaadi karne wapas lauta, lekin tab tak Zoya apne pita ki bimaari aur doobte business se joojh rahi thi. Chang Brothers ne uski majboori ka fayda uthaya, Zhen ka mazaak udaaya aur apni daulat aur taqat ka dikhava kiya. Unhe kya pata tha ki pichhle 8 saalon mein Zhen desh ke mahaan experts ko tayyar kar chuka tha aur khud Supreme Dragon Commander ban gaya tha. Kya Zoya ko uska pyaar wapas mila?aur kya Chang Brothers ko unke ghamand ki saza mili?

jaggu-daada-mbbs-12th-fail.title: Jaggu Daada MBBS 12th Fail
jaggu-daada-mbbs-12th-fail.description: The story centers on Abhi, whose life is repeatedly shaken by identity confusion, family conflict, campus rivalry, and underworld pressure. It opens with Jaggu Dada, a feared gangster, suddenly waking up in a young student’s body, which gives the larger drama a strange and unstable foundation. From there, Abhi becomes the focus of suspicion in a series of public and private clashes, including blame over a terrace fall, accusations of betrayal, and heated arguments at home. His family often demands apology and obedience, while Abhi resists being reduced to the family’s shame. At college, rival students and authority figures keep pulling him into fights, discipline meetings, and public humiliation. Preethi remains an important emotional center, with Abhi’s feelings for her tangled up in jealousy, danger, and social pressure. The romance is never simple, because other relationships and rival claims keep interrupting it, including moments where Abhi appears with both a bouquet and a knife. Sunitha and other women around him try to prove that he has been wrongly blamed, but evidence, including a fake AI-generated video, only deepens the confusion. The story also suggests that hidden histories and secret guidance connect some of the younger men to a larger power structure. Meanwhile, the Desai family and other influential adults bring status, apology, and control into the conflict, making every dispute feel bigger than one person. Abhi is repeatedly forced to choose between defending himself and keeping peace, but he rarely gets either. In the middle of the chaos, he is also pushed toward studies, especially when a teacher urges him into the Maths Olympiad. That academic thread gives him a second path forward, even as gang rivalry and family expectations keep closing in. Putte’s resistance to an arranged marriage adds another layer of pressure, and Abhi is drawn into that struggle by pretending to be her boyfriend. The underworld side of the story grows more violent as rival bosses and gang forces challenge one another over power and loyalty. Family bonds are tested just as hard, especially when Rakesh’s jealousy, blame, and confession turn a private grievance into a full crisis. By the end of the batch, the show balances revenge, romance, school ambition, and family repair, with Abhi standing at the center of every unresolved conflict.

virasat-ki-jung.title: Virasat Ki Jung
virasat-ki-jung.description: The story follows a widening conflict around a sacred magical bottle that is tied to family power, supernatural danger, and long-buried betrayal. Early on, a betrayal inside one of the great families exposes the bottle’s secret to enemies, and a loyal immortal woman is ordered to protect it at all costs. She is repeatedly forced into combat and resistance as soldiers, outsiders, and rival claimants close in. At the same time, a modern young man is sent to an old haveli, where he keeps encountering a mysterious woman whose presence is linked to an old photograph and a hidden past. That supernatural thread grows darker as the woman is suspected of black magic, blood-drinking, or being a pishachini, though the digests keep her exact nature uncertain. The bottle becomes the center of a larger curse involving four families, with warnings that punishment, death, and loss of wealth will follow if it is not returned. Several characters try to bargain for the bottle, including offers of immortality, but those bargains are rejected or turn dangerous. In the family sphere, inheritance warfare intensifies as relatives accuse one another of murder, betrayal, and disgrace, while a patriarch weakens and succession is overturned. Outsiders and younger heirs are humiliated, threatened, or driven out, and the household’s authority shifts unpredictably. The mysterious woman’s authority also grows, as elders recognize her power and insist she must be obeyed. Across the modern romance threads, attraction is tangled with control, jealousy, and rivalry, and no relationship feels stable. Wang is pulled between multiple women and multiple dangers, while others around him use family status, marriage promises, or possessiveness to claim him. Blood becomes another source of power, healing, and dependence, linking immortality to sacrifice and exploitation. As the bottle’s trail is traced through schools, clubs, hidden hideouts, and family compounds, every faction becomes more desperate. By the end, the bottle remains unrecovered, the supernatural threat remains active, and the families are bracing for a larger confrontation that could decide wealth, survival, and control.

little-aryan.title: Little Aryan
little-aryan.description: ஒரு இளம் மேதை காலப்பயணம் செய்து, தனது குடும்பத்தின் தலைவிதியை மாற்ற இரண்டாவது வாய்ப்பைப் பெறுகிறான். எதிர்கால அறிவைப் பயன்படுத்தி, ஏழ்மையில் தவிக்கும் தந்தையை பணக்காரராக்கி, தங்களை அவமதித்த தாய் உட்பட எல்லோரையும் பழிவாங்குகிறான். அதேசமயம், தனது தந்தைக்கும் அழகான CEO-வுக்கும் காதல் ஏற்படச் செய்கிறான்.

the-second-beggining.title: The Second Beginning
the-second-beggining.description: After being humiliated and thrown out by her own family, warm-hearted street food vendor Janki unexpectedly finds love and respect in the wealthy yet secretive Tripathy family. As billionaire Om Tripathy hides his true identity to win her trust, relationships heal, old wounds resurface, and a lost mother’s hope of reuniting with her missing son slowly comes alive again. Watch now.

aaya-toofan.title: Aaya Toofan
aaya-toofan.description: On the eve of India’s independence, a revolutionary freedom fighter who sacrificed his freedom to save his lover is released from prison, only to face rejection and humiliation from her; seeking a fresh start, he accepts a fake marriage proposal from a wealthy newspaper owner, ultimate leading him to reclaim his true identity and the honor he deserves.

the-queen-returns.title: The Queen Returns
the-queen-returns.description: Just as Doctor Nova decides to reveal her true identity, she catches her husband cheating. Heartbroken, she leaves him and unexpectedly proposes marriage to a stranger. Ironically, her ex-husband's new manipulative lover pretends to be the famous "Doctor Nova." When the fake is exposed and he realizes his ex-wife was the real mastermind all along, he begs for a second chance. But the real Doctor Nova refuses to forgive his ultimate betrayal.

the-ancient-water-pot-changed-my-life.title: The Ancient Water Pot changed My Life
the-ancient-water-pot-changed-my-life.description: After being betrayed and thrown out of his family, a wealthy young man discovers his mother’s magical water pot connects him to Lata, a village girl living in 1975. Using knowledge from the future, they transform each other’s lives and fall in love across 51 years. But when their connection is destroyed, Sahil discovers that the love he was searching for may have been beside him all along.

ekka-raja-rani-1.title: Ekka Raja Rani
ekka-raja-rani-1.description: A gifted gambler sets out to find the family that abandoned him, only to discover he is the long-lost heir to a powerful casino empire. As ruthless enemies close in and old prophecies resurface, he must risk everything to protect the family that once rejected him and reclaim his destiny.

bhola-ka-tandav.title: Bhola ka Tandav
bhola-ka-tandav.description: A poor farmer boy, constantly mocked as a “bastard” because of his unknown lineage, begins a journey to become the greatest Bahubali warrior of Pataliputra using his hidden divine powers, courage, and determination — while powerful enemies try to destroy him.

pardes-walo-dulho.title: Pardes Walo Dulho
pardes-walo-dulho.description: The story centers on privileged young men being forced into hardship, humiliation, and ordinary work so they can prove their worth. Arjun is sent away from elite life and made to live like a common man, with his father insisting that struggle will teach him success. He moves through garages, workshops, and family business spaces where he is mocked, trained, and tested by supervisors and workers. At the same time, the drama keeps tying his hidden identity to questions of class, dignity, and authority. A driver-and-heir disguise becomes central, and Arjun repeatedly has to protect his cover while still standing up for poorer people and for himself. Simran, Tanya, and Rohit form the main romantic and social triangle around him, with gossip, teasing, and attraction slowly turning into deeper conflict. Simran is drawn to Arjun’s kindness and defiance, even as family pressure and an arranged match keep pulling her elsewhere. Rohit repeatedly humiliates Arjun and tries to assert status, but those clashes only sharpen the class divide and make Arjun’s restraint more striking. The story also uses comic domestic confusion, including bathroom mix-ups and teasing, to keep the romance and rivalry in motion. Birthday and party sequences raise the stakes through expensive gifts, public comparisons, and suspicion over whether Arjun’s gestures are genuine. Arjun’s gifts and secret repairs suggest hidden resources, while others keep doubting his motives and identity. Simran first rejects him because of family expectations, yet his protective behavior and quiet sacrifices make her feelings grow stronger. The romance becomes more tangled when engagement and marriage plans are pushed forward by elders and business interests. Arjun tries to slow those decisions, while Simran pleads for rescue from a forced marriage and later admits her love for him. That confession triggers outrage, jealousy, and more public confrontation, especially when Rohit reacts with insults and possessiveness. The family conflict widens into corporate pressure, property fears, and accusations that marriage is being used to seize assets. A major reveal then overturns assumptions by exposing Arjun as a billionaire heir, even as he continues to be treated through the lens of class and suspicion. By the end, marriage, business, and family loyalty are all locked together in a fragile balance of pressure, sacrifice, and unresolved power struggles.

fearless-father-3.title: Fearless Father
fearless-father-3.description: அஜய் மற்றும் ருக்மிணி, தங்களது மகன் ரோஹனின் வருங்கால மனைவி அனிகா, மற்றொரு ஆணுடன் தொடர்பில் இருப்பதோடு, ஒரு பெரிய சதியில் ஈடுபட்டுள்ள ஏமாற்றுக்காரி என்பதை கண்டுபிடிக்கின்றனர். அனிகாவால் அவமானப்படுத்தப்பட்டு தாக்கப்பட்ட பிறகு, ஆதாரங்களைத் திரட்டி, நிச்சயதார்த்த விழாவில் அவளது உண்மையை அனைவருக்கும் வெளிப்படுத்துகின்றனர். இதன் மூலம் ரோஹனை துரோகத்திலிருந்து காப்பாற்றி, திட்டமிட்ட பழிவாங்கலின் மூலம் தங்களது மரியாதையை மீட்டெடுக்கின்றனர்.

dare-to-dream-1.title: Dare to Dream
dare-to-dream-1.description: Rohit, a poor village kabaddi player, dreams of representing India. After an incredible performance earns him a place at the National Selection Camp, he rises from a struggling villager to the Captain of the Indian Kabaddi Team. But his success enrages powerful Sarpanch Ratan and his son Monty. They create an AI-generated scandal to destroy Rohit’s reputation. Returning home to humiliation and betrayal, Rohit must expose the conspiracy and prove that no one can crush his dream.

chandravamsha.title: Chandravamsha
chandravamsha.description: The story follows Aryaveera, a warrior whose life is shaped by long separation, hidden parentage, and the search for his true place in the world. It begins with him confronting his guru over a 25-year absence from his family, and the guru finally reveals a buried truth while giving him the Chandramani as a guide toward his origins. From there, the narrative repeatedly returns to mothers, sons, and disputed bloodlines, showing how identity is both sacred and politically dangerous. Urmila becomes a key protector figure, defending a mysterious young man in court and later insisting that he is her son, even as rulers suspect him of being a spy or impostor. Kunti’s grief over her child and the rejection of Karna deepen the same emotional pattern, with royal authority refusing to recognize what a mother knows. The court and battlefield are equally unstable, as public humiliation, accusations of illegitimacy, and threats of violence turn family truth into a matter of state. Nakula Veera’s arrogance and the king’s suspicion intensify the pressure around Urmila and the young man, while Aryaveera is repeatedly challenged to prove his worth before hostile witnesses. Sacred objects and powers, including the Nandi stone, Brahmasattva, and later the Kaali Astra, raise the stakes beyond ordinary politics and make legitimacy feel tied to divine favor. As war spreads, the story widens into a kingdom-level crisis where rulers, warriors, and ministers all struggle to hold authority against invasion and internal doubt. Aryavira is questioned for his strength, his allegiance, and even his identity, yet allies continue to protect him and insist on his importance. Karna also emerges as a rival presence, doubting Aryaveera while remaining entangled in the same larger conflict over family and honor. The middle of the arc grows darker as poison, deception, and ritual sacrifice enter the struggle for sacred power. The Maha Guru is poisoned, and the battle for the Kaali Astra becomes a test of surrender, desire, and spiritual cost. Aryaveera is drawn into this larger mythic conflict while still carrying the personal burden of saving his father and family. In the final stretch, he faces Betaala, who mocks him as powerless after the destruction of the Kaali astram, but Aryaveera answers that true power lies in rightful choice rather than brute possession. He unleashes a sudden surge of force, and the conflict expands into open war over the kingdom. The weakened king is defeated and asks his son for forgiveness, revealing the emotional damage beneath the political struggle. The arc closes with soldiers hailing Aryaveera as maharaja, marking a hard-won transfer of power that comes after grief, conflict, and repeated tests of legitimacy.

gazab-love-story-1.title: Gazab Love story
gazab-love-story-1.description: After years apart, a secretly billionaire heir reunites with the girl he has loved since college and impulsively marries her to escape his grandfather’s pressure. But when struggling Shanaya agrees to the marriage only as a one-year contract, unaware of Vikram’s true identity, their fake relationship slowly turns into real love—until his hidden wealth, her dangerous past, and the enemies determined to tear them apart threaten to expose everything.

for-your-love.title: For Your Love
for-your-love.description: The story centers on Gyan and Neeta, whose bond is shaped by years of devotion, secrecy, and repeated misunderstandings. Gyan stays close to Neeta for a long time, even turning down better opportunities, because he hopes for one chance with her. His confession is crushed when Neeta says she loves Arun, and from that point their connection becomes a mix of hidden longing, workplace dependence, and public humiliation. Neeta’s life is shown as tightly controlled, with her image, household, and business all under pressure. A past rescue from nine or ten years earlier becomes a major source of conflict, because Gyan claims he was the one who saved her, while Arun is later exposed as having hidden the truth. That revelation deepens the sense that much of the breakup was shaped by manipulation, false blame, and incomplete memories. At work and at parties, Gyan is repeatedly shamed, accused, and forced to defend his dignity, while others try to use his position against him. The romance triangle grows harsher as Arun returns, questions Neeta, and keeps pushing the idea that he was treated as a secret. Neeta swings between rejection, regret, and concern, especially when Gyan’s absence begins to damage both her daily life and the company. His resignation and disappearance expose how much she relied on him, not only emotionally but also in practical business matters. Corporate pressure rises as contracts, client meetings, and an AI project become tied to his fate. Gyan’s role also changes from assistant to a figure of growing importance, with his future linked to the company’s leadership. Public scenes repeatedly force private feelings into the open, whether through accusations, a torn love letter, or a public confession of nine years of love. Gyan eventually declares his love and even proposes marriage, but Neeta cannot fully accept him because of old betrayal wounds and the damage already done. As the company’s future shifts, Gyan is promoted into a powerful new position, showing that his personal and professional paths are now inseparable. By the end, Neeta is left facing both heartbreak and the practical need to save her failing business, while Gyan has emotionally pulled away and moved toward a new beginning with Anjali/Anjali-like support. The overall arc is one of love delayed by pride, lies, and status, with the stakes rising from private longing to corporate succession.

oru-second-class-yathra.title: Oru Second Class Yathra
oru-second-class-yathra.description: The show follows a relentless chain of public confrontations that begin with small disputes and keep widening into humiliation, violence, and family crisis. Early on, Sameera travels with her mother’s necklace and worries about being accepted at an important family meeting, while Vikram is pulled between his wedding duties and his family obligations. A seat dispute on the train quickly turns into insults and threats, and later train incidents escalate into blame, slaps, and panic in crowded public spaces. Women are repeatedly accused of causing harm, and they are often forced to defend themselves against crowds, relatives, and authority figures who arrive too late or refuse to help. Family members step in again and again, with mothers, fathers, sisters, and elders trying to protect injured or shamed relatives. As the conflict grows, the story shifts from ordinary train trouble into a larger battle over reputation, hidden relationships, and public proof. Reema, Rima, and other women are dragged into scandals involving money, marriage, photographs, and accusations of blackmail or betrayal. A powerful strongman and later the Singh family turn these disputes into a wider struggle over control, honor, and punishment. Sameera or Samyra becomes the center of an identity crisis, with her necklace, her claimed parentage, and her place in the Singh family all contested. Vansh is repeatedly forced to confront claims about her, while others accuse her of lying, extortion, or manipulation. The story also introduces corporate conflict through Sync Corporation, where internal betrayal and a security breach suggest a deeper conspiracy. Reema is publicly rejected after being accused of faking a pregnancy and deceiving the family, which deepens the emotional fallout. Vansh then faces a hostile power grab that ends with police intervention and his custody. Across these arcs, the show keeps returning to the same pattern: a public accusation, a desperate defense, and a family or authority figure trying to restore order. By the end, the stakes are no longer just personal shame but inheritance, corporate power, legal consequences, and the survival of damaged family bonds. The final movement leaves several conflicts unresolved, but it does close on a quieter apology between a father and his daughter, offering a brief pause after so much public chaos.

sabse-bada-dramebaaz.title: Sabse Bada Dramebaaz
sabse-bada-dramebaaz.description: India's most talented performers battle through dramatic challenges, unforgettable performances, and tough eliminations in the country's biggest vertical reality show, where one viral moment can change a life forever.

majnoun-ya-kbeer.title: Majnoun Ya Kbeer
majnoun-ya-kbeer.description: Majnoun Ya Kbeer - Bade Miyaan Deewane

genius-delivery-boy.title: Genius Delivery Boy
genius-delivery-boy.description: A hidden billionaire living as a delivery man is betrayed and divorced by his ungrateful wife, leading him to reclaim his true identity as "Lord Singhania" to ruin his oppressors and find true love with a rival business tycoon.

unnodu-naan-irundhal.title: Unnodu Naan Irundhal
unnodu-naan-irundhal.description: சொந்தக் குடும்பத்தாராலேயே கைவிடப்பட்ட, பேசுவதில் தடுமாற்றமுள்ள ஓர் அப்பாவிப் பெண், உண்மையான அன்பைத் தேடி ஏழை நாடகக் கலைஞனாக நடிக்கும் ஒரு கோடீஸ்வரனை அறியாமல் மணக்கிறாள்; இந்தத் திருமணம் பல துரோகங்களை வெளிச்சத்திற்குக் கொண்டுவருவதோடு, பல வருடங்களுக்கு முன்பு தொலைந்துபோன அவளது சொந்தத் தங்கையையும் அவளிடம் சேர்க்கும் என்பது அவளுக்குத் தெரியாது.

forbidden-prince.title: Forbidden Prince
forbidden-prince.description: A modern-day actress, Ning Xiaocha, mysteriously finds herself trapped in an ancient royal palace, where she is forced to seduce the ascetic Crown Prince Zheng or face execution. Using her wit, humor, and fearless nature, she slowly melts the prince's icy heart while uncovering deadly palace conspiracies, hidden identities, and a dangerous political game that could change the fate of the kingdom.

the-shadow-father.title: The Shadow Father
the-shadow-father.description: Father is an waiter in a hotel and his son loves his dad ,and the father hide is billionaier identity ..

isqh-kills-pyar-dhoka-aur-murder-1.title: Ishq Kills: Pyar, Dhoka Aur Murder
isqh-kills-pyar-dhoka-aur-murder-1.description: Isqh Kills: Pyar, Dhoka Aur Murder

karmayogi.title: Karmayogi
karmayogi.description: Bound by blood but divided by belief, two brothers take opposite paths after a devastating tragedy, one becoming the chosen warrior of Lord Muthappan, the other embracing forbidden dark powers, leading to an epic battle where faith confronts vengeance.

super-badshah.title: Super Badshah
super-badshah.description: The story begins with Arush and Devika trapped in a collapsing marriage that quickly turns from a failed anniversary surprise into separation, legal conflict, and public humiliation. Their breakup is not just emotional, because accusations of abuse, control, and property turn the relationship into a courtroom battle. As the conflict widens, Devika becomes entangled in rival claims and confrontations that push the drama beyond one marriage and into a larger struggle over status and dominance. At the same time, the narrative moves into the underworld, where Abhimanyu, Badshah, and Aman are pulled into threats, deals, and offers of power tied to criminal control. Badshah emerges as a feared ruler whose authority is tied to bloodline, inheritance, and supernatural legacy, making succession a deadly test rather than a simple transfer of power. Devika also appears as a gatekeeper to that throne, forcing challengers to survive dangerous trials before they can claim any place in the hierarchy. JK is repeatedly accused of betrayal through records and testimony, but the evidence is challenged, leaving the group unsure whether he is guilty or framed. Arush, meanwhile, is mocked, tested, and accused, yet he begins to uncover an unusual ability to sense heartbeats, suggesting that his role in the conflict is changing. The story also reveals that hidden identity and family concealment are central to the larger arc, as Shiva learns he was protected from a family war and another man discovers a tattoo-linked truth about his own identity. A sacred ring and related bloodline inheritance deepen the mythic side of the plot, linking lies, gifts, and succession to a divine origin. Badshah’s empire is shown to rest on both criminal force and inherited power, and his nearing death raises the stakes of who will carry that legacy forward. Dev is rescued from humiliation and brought into Badshah’s household, but his new place only sharpens his desire for revenge against those he blames for his suffering. Loyalty inside the empire is fragile, with Vishakha fiercely protecting Badshah and later becoming a hostage in a separate conflict. Rival gangster Naagraj escalates the violence through kidnappings, graveyard threats, and open challenges to Badshah’s control. Arush is dragged into these larger struggles through ambushes, trials, and repeated public shaming, while a mysterious woman and Vishakha help keep him alive long enough to continue. Alok becomes another key figure when a strange force awakens in him, giving him the power to compel others and shifting the balance again. Across the whole story, love, revenge, inheritance, and criminal power keep colliding, so every personal wound becomes part of a larger fight for identity and rule. By the end of the batch, no conflict is fully settled, and the central question remains who can survive the betrayals, trials, and hidden truths long enough to claim power.

mosada-preethiya-reethi.title: Mosada Preethiya Reethi
mosada-preethiya-reethi.description: After catching her husband Arjun with her best friend, Sruthi pretends to lose her memory after an accident. Using her condition, Arjun falsely places her in the life of wealthy CEO George. But as lies deepen, Sruthi secretly begins a dangerous game of revenge.

chandravansham-1.title: Chandravansham
chandravansham-1.description:
Chandravansham is story of Aryaveer, abandoned at birth, rises from a nameless shepherd to a legendary warrior. Betrayed by blood yet driven by truth, he fights to reclaim identity, family, and honor.
In the clash of power and destiny, he proves that true strength lies beyond lineage. Watch now.

dilwala-ya-daulatwala.title: Dilwala ya Daulatwala?
dilwala-ya-daulatwala.description: When kind-hearted Mia gives shelter to an injured stranger, she never imagines he's Ken Bai, the missing heir to a billion-dollar empire. As the two fake a relationship and fall in love, hidden identities, jealous rivals, and a ruthless family power struggle threaten to tear them apart. Will Mia choose the man she loves—or the billionaire the world fears?

the-shakthi-secret.title: The Shakthi Secret
the-shakthi-secret.description: Shakti’s story begins with humiliation and injustice, as she is threatened, assaulted, and fired after refusing unwanted advances from a powerful man. Forced to survive on her own, she searches for work to pay for her grandmother’s treatment and is drawn into the orbit of Harshavardhan, a wealthy and powerful man whose world is full of danger and control. A bodyguard competition becomes her entry point, and she proves herself in combat before being hired as his personal protector. Once inside his household, Shakti is pulled into a palace-like environment where loyalty, inheritance, and revenge are constantly at war. Harshavardhan’s family is divided by succession disputes, hidden schemes, and people who want his shares, his authority, or his downfall. At the same time, Shakti is repeatedly forced to defend her name, since she is blamed for attacks and accidents even when she insists others are responsible. Her bond with Harshavardhan grows more complicated as he protects her, admits his feelings, and even declares that she will become his wife. Riya, Aastha, and other women around him create emotional tension, but the story keeps returning to the question of who truly belongs beside him. The household is also haunted by missing people, old promises, and family members who may not be who they seem. A pendant, a memory loss, and a long-buried past suggest that Shakti may be tied to the family’s hidden bloodline, though the truth remains uncertain for much of the story. Meanwhile, Harshavardhan’s grandfather, mother figures, and other elders keep pushing the family toward answers while grief and illness interrupt every confrontation. Violence escalates through attacks, murder attempts, and a coma, making the struggle for control feel increasingly dangerous. As secrets surface, the family’s business conflicts become inseparable from its emotional wounds. Marriage proposals and romantic claims are never simple love stories here; they are tied to legitimacy, inheritance, and power. By the later part of the story, the search for identity becomes central, with lost daughters, returned memories, and exposed deceptions reshaping alliances. Shakti remains at the center as both protector and possible heir to a deeper family truth. The show’s stakes are therefore personal and dynastic at once: survival, love, and rightful belonging all depend on uncovering who can be trusted.

love-beneath-paris-skies.title: Love Beneath Paris Skies
love-beneath-paris-skies.description: When a fiery billionaire heiress is forced to work with a rugged ex-army driver in Paris, their constant clashes turn into an unexpected romance. But as a ruthless family conspiracy, deadly attacks, and a shocking contract marriage threaten their lives and the Oberoi empire, they must decide whether to trust each other—or lose everything they love

enakena-vandha-devadhai.title: Enakena Vandha Devadhai
enakena-vandha-devadhai.description: குடும்பத்தால் அவமானப்படுத்தப்பட்டு வெளியேற்றப்படும் ஜானகிக்கு, பணக்கார திரிபாதி குடும்பத்தில் எதிர்பாராத அன்பும் மரியாதையும் கிடைக்கிறது. தனது அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து ஜானகியின் நம்பிக்கையை வெல்லும் ஓம், பழைய காயங்களை ஆற்றும் அதே நேரத்தில், காணாமல் போன மகனைத் தேடும் ஒரு தாயின் நம்பிக்கைக்கும் உயிர் கொடுக்கிறார்.

revenge-of-the-heart.title: Revenge Of the Heart
revenge-of-the-heart.description: A husabnd maintain affair with her wife 's bestie and then she look there affair in ther house bedroom and she felt down and she loose his memory ,and the huysband says he is not his husband and the husband frnf is the real husband ,and then the wife play a game in between them

sitara-ka-swayamvar.title: Sitara ka Swayamvar
sitara-ka-swayamvar.description: A rich city businessman enters a dangerous tribal swayamvar only to win a piece of land, but after marrying a mysterious village woman hiding painful secrets, he slowly finds himself trapped between love, betrayal, destiny, and a divine connection that has followed him since childhood.

saubhagya-nu-bandhan.title: Saubhagya Nu Bandhan
saubhagya-nu-bandhan.description: The drama centers on a family crisis where business collapse, illness, and old secrets all become tied to marriage and identity. Arjun is told by a purohit that his family’s ruin repeats a 107-year-old curse, and that only a girl with a matching birthmark can break it. That search pulls several women into danger, especially those already struggling with work, money, and household pressure. Roshni, Nisha, and Shreya each move through spaces where they are humiliated, dismissed, or forced to prove themselves. Wealthy men and family elders repeatedly use authority to control women’s choices, whether through job pressure, travel money, or marriage demands. The marked girl becomes the center of a larger conflict over fate, legitimacy, and inheritance. Clues from airports, addresses, gifts, and family calls keep the search moving, but they also deepen suspicion inside the household. A royal heir arrives with ceremonial gifts and says his family wants to marry the girl with the mark because of an old promise. That proposal turns into a public test of identity, and the possibility that the marked girl is an illegitimate younger sister adds shame and conflict. At the same time, Arjun’s own position grows more controlling as he keeps women close and tries to manage the household crisis. Several scenes show women trapped in humiliating or dangerous situations, including being stranded, hidden, locked out, or forced to work. The story also widens into business rivalry, with fraud, lost tenders, and property deals feeding the panic around the marriage. A father who had been in a wheelchair later stands up, which the family treats as a miracle and a sign that the crisis is shifting. But the apparent relief does not end the suspicion, because the wedding rituals themselves keep exposing doubts about who the bride really is. Priests, tattoo checks, photographs, and visible marks all become tools for judging truth. Family members accuse one another of theft, deception, and betrayal, and even celebrations collapse into confrontation. By the end of the batch, the household is still divided, and the marriage remains both a promise and a threat, with the women’s dignity and survival hanging in the balance.

korea-ka-khooni-raaz.title: Korea Ka Khooni Raaz
korea-ka-khooni-raaz.description: Based On The Hwaseong Murders Mystery case
