ఆంధ్ర-ఆదివాసీ-బాలికల-6-మరణాలుHPV-Vaccine.description: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లో ఆదివాసీ బాలికల 6 మరణాలకు నిజంగా HPV వ్యాక్సిన్ కారణమా? ఈ ఘటనలో అసలు ఏమి జరిగింది, దర్యాప్తులు ఏమి తేల్చాయి, మరణాలకు వ్యాక్సిన్‌తో సంబంధం ఉందని ఆధారాలు దొరికాయా? ఈ డాక్యుమెంటరీలో అధికారిక నివేదికలు, వైద్య నిపుణుల అభిప్రాయాలు, అందుబాటులో ఉన్న ఆధారాల ఆధారంగా వాస్తవాలను పరిశీలిద్దాం.

love-out-for-delivery.title: Love, Out for Delivery
love-out-for-delivery.description: Charlie lives as a humble delivery boy, hiding his true life as a billionaire to test his wife’s love. When she chooses betrayal and career over their marriage, Charlie is shattered. Now, the mask comes off. Witness the ultimate rise as a broken husband reclaims his massive empire to serve a cold, calculated revenge to the woman who discarded him.

the-king-of-network-marketing.title: The King of Network Marketing
the-king-of-network-marketing.description: After years of humiliation and poverty, Amit discovers a business opportunity that promises unlimited wealth. As he rises from a struggling tailor's helper to a millionaire leader, everyone who once mocked him begins to bow before him. But behind the glamorous seminars, luxury lifestyle, and motivational speeches lies a dangerous game where greed, power, and deception collide.

sigma-king.title: Sigma king
sigma-king.description: Sigma King follows Vivek, a rejected and humiliated young man who suddenly receives ₹10 crore through a mysterious Virtual App. As he spends the money and gains beauty points from women around him, his ordinary life transforms into one of wealth, power and influence.

astro-darbar-1.title: Astrology Adda
astro-darbar-1.description: The show is a studio-based advice series that blends astrology, devotion, and practical self-help for everyday anxieties. It repeatedly invites hosts, experts, and ordinary callers to discuss money, work, love, marriage, health, and family strain. A major early thread is financial insecurity, including debt, unstable cash flow, and the fear that money enters the home but does not stay. The speakers answer these worries with kundli readings, numerology, ritual timing, and devotional practices linked to Lakshmi, Vishnu, Ganesh, and Shani Dev. Money is treated as something that must be handled with discipline, stored carefully, and supported by right conduct as well as worship. The show also extends this logic to career problems, especially interview failures, stalled growth, and the decision to quit a job or start a business. In those segments, viewers are given ritualized guidance about posture, footsteps, temple visits, donations, tilaks, and auspicious timing. Relationship concerns form another major arc, with discussions of cheating, divorce, love versus marriage, compatibility, Manglik fears, and emotional distance between spouses. The advice often combines emotional language with Vastu tips, love-language ideas, and household remedies meant to restore harmony. Several episodes focus on delayed marriage and parental worry, especially when a daughter remains unmarried or a marriage feels close to breaking. Domestic tension also appears through workplace attraction, mother-in-law conflict, and the pressure on women to stabilize the home. Health is treated through a similar spiritual-practical lens, with astrology used to discuss weight gain, cravings, chronic illness, and the need to continue medical treatment. The show repeatedly warns that hard work alone may not be enough when progress feels blocked, so faith-based remedies are presented as support rather than replacement. It also explores protection from nazar, inherited burdens, and negative energy through cleansing rituals, secrecy, salt, incense, and ancestral offerings. Numerology and repeating numbers are framed as signs of new beginnings, communication, balance, and wish fulfillment. Later segments broaden into food habits, pranayama, brain balance, and the symbolic meaning of utensils, colors, and fasting days. The tone is generally reassuring, but it keeps returning to uncertainty, fear, and the hope that discipline and belief can shift outcomes. Across the whole run, the show presents life as a mix of effort, timing, devotion, and self-control, with astrology used to interpret where each person is stuck and how they might move forward.

neenu-thriller-nanu-killer.title: Neenu Thriller Nanu Killer
neenu-thriller-nanu-killer.description: A fearless martial arts master lives as a beggar, hiding his legendary past. When love and honor drag him back into the fighting world, enemies rise and secrets explode. Betrayal, destiny, and raw power collide as he reclaims his true identity as the Grandmaster.

game-changer-2.title: Game Changer
game-changer-2.description: After hiding in the shadows as an ordinary family man for two decades, a devoted husband is finally ready to show his family who he truly is. But fate has other plans. He uncovers a painful secret: his wife is growing dangerously close to her old flame. Devastated, he files for divorce, steps back into his power, and starts a fresh chapter with a new love who truly values him.

daddy-cool.title: Daddy cool
daddy-cool.description: The story is built around repeated public humiliations that expose the gap between wealth and dignity. Hari begins as a working-class outsider who is mocked in corporate spaces, showrooms, roadsides, and family gatherings, yet he refuses to stay silent. Prathap and other elders repeatedly try to restrain conflict, but the pressure of class pride keeps pushing the characters into open confrontation. Across the early arc, Hari is treated as disposable, while powerful men use money, status, and police threats to control the situation. At the same time, family pain keeps surfacing in public, suggesting that old wounds are tied to the present power struggle. A powerful father then brings Hari into the family orbit as a corrective force, hoping hardship will reshape his privileged son and expose what really matters. The story widens into marriage and identity crises, including claims about children, rented-husband arrangements, secret contract marriage, and public declarations that someone is already married. Swathi becomes a key figure in these conflicts, standing by Hari at times while also being pulled into pressure from family, business, and rival men. Samir and other elites repeatedly try to shame Hari, but those attempts often backfire when his skill, loyalty, or hidden value is revealed. One major turning point comes when a gift first dismissed as worthless is identified as an extremely valuable Faberge egg, turning ridicule into shock. Another comes when Hari is publicly declared Daksh’s real father, transforming a social insult into a hidden-family crisis. The corporate thread grows harsher as theft accusations, police involvement, land-grab allegations, and bankruptcy threats collide with family loyalties. Hari is also repeatedly tested through tasks meant to expose him, from impossible interviews to public challenges that question his worth. In one phase, he is even revealed as tied to a hidden royal lineage and named an heir, overturning earlier mockery. Yet the story does not simply reward status; it keeps asking whether power can survive without trust, love, and self-respect. That question becomes central when Hari is forced to choose between empire and home. He insists that money and inheritance mean nothing without Swathi and Daksh, and he rejects wealth if it costs him family peace. The final reveal shows that this rejection was itself a test, and Hari passes by choosing love over power. In the end, Hari and Swathi are recognized as the rightful heirs, but the emotional core remains their insistence that family is the true measure of wealth.

billionaire-on-board.title: Billionaire on Board
billionaire-on-board.description: Traveling undercover on his own airline, a billionaire CEO is mocked by everyone. An air hostess, unaware of his true identity, takes a liking to him and asks him to play her fake boyfriend. As her friends continue to ridicule him, they have no idea about his terrifying reality: he is actually a ruthless mafia boss with a secret past, a wife, and a son! Where will this dangerous game of love and deception lead?

mr-serious-ms-chaos.title: Mr. Serious & Ms. Chaos
mr-serious-ms-chaos.description: After escaping loan sharks, Neha enters a 30-day fake marriage with Vijay to save his family. While she tries to become the world's worst wife, every disaster only brings them closer. As Vijay hides his identity as a billionaire, their fake marriage blossoms into an unexpected love story.

anul-mele-panithuzhi.title: Anul Mele Panithuzhi
anul-mele-panithuzhi.description: உயிருக்கு உயிராய் காதலித்த தியாவை கண்டு கொள்ளாமல், நல்லவள் என நினைத்து அவள் தங்கை ஜீவிதா பின்னால் சுற்றுகிறான் கோடீஸ்வரன் ஆதி. ஆனால் ஒருநாள் மறைத்த உண்மைகள் எல்லாம் தெரிய வரும் பொழுது, ஆதியின் மொத்த உலகமும் உடைந்து போகிறது.

first-class-billionaire-1.title: First Class Billionaire
first-class-billionaire-1.description: Jagadish, the owner of Aira Airlines, disguises as a ground crew worker and books a firstclass ticket to secretly test his airline's service. When a snobbish air hostess judges his appearance and humiliates him by forcing him to the economy cabin, kind-hearted air hostess Nethra steps forward and defends him with grace and dignity. Now Jagadish must silently navigate the chaos, protect his identity, and decide the fate of those who failed and those who truly represent the heart of Aira Airlines.

the-rising-son-from-shame-to-supremacy.title: The Rising Son - From Shame to Supremacy
the-rising-son-from-shame-to-supremacy.description: Branded a bastard and humiliated as the son of a servant, Samar fights powerful families, corrupt institutions, and impossible warriors to protect his mother’s dignity and rise from outcast to the kingdom’s strongest warrior.

beggar-to-grandmaster.title: Beggar To Grandmaster
beggar-to-grandmaster.description: A humble salesman, secretly the heir to a massive business empire, hides his identity to find true love. Misjudged as poor, he faces insults from his greedy lover’s family while proving his worth through hard work. His lover betrays him for wealth, unaware of his true status. After rising to become a powerful entrepreneur, he reveals the truth, leading to regret, revenge, and justice.

jhukega-nahi-saala-season-2.title: Jhukega Nahi Saala Season 2
jhukega-nahi-saala-season-2.description: Shridhar Singhania returns in Jhukega Nahi Saala 2, bigger, stronger, and more determined than ever. After defeating his enemies, he sets out to build a better future—until a ruthless revenge conspiracy threatens his family, empire, and ideals. Packed with action, family drama, corporate warfare, and shocking betrayals, the season proves that true strength lies in standing tall when the world wants you to bend.

neelambari-fall-of-a-queen.title: Neelambari : Fall Of A Queen
neelambari-fall-of-a-queen.description: தன் உண்மையான அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து வாழும் ஒரு கோடீஸ்வர மாமனாரை, மகனின் பேராசை கொண்ட காதலி பொதுமக்கள் முன் அவமானப்படுத்துகிறாள். அவளின் ரகசிய காதலும் குடும்பச் சொத்தை கைப்பற்றும் சதியும் வெளிவரும்போது, அதிரடியான பழிவாங்கல் தொடங்குகிறது. துரோகம், அதிர்ச்சி திருப்பங்கள், கர்மா நிறைந்த கோடீஸ்வர குடும்பத் த்ரில்லர்.

nuvvunte-naa-jatagaa.title: Nuvvunte Naa Jatagaa
nuvvunte-naa-jatagaa.description: మాధవి ఒక నర్స్, ప్రాణాలు కాపాడటమే తన డ్యూటీ అనుకుని ఆరోజు రాత్రి చిక్కుల్లో పడింది. ఒక మాఫియా డాన్ కి ఒక మామూలు నర్స్ కి మధ్య జరిగిన కథ నువ్వుంటే నా జతగా.

el-repartidor-multimillonario.title: El Repartidor Multimillonario
el-repartidor-multimillonario.description: The story follows a long chain of class conflict, hidden inheritance, and dangerous romance centered on Carlos, Viviana, Julia, and later Vivian Hale. It begins with public humiliation and breakup energy, as Carlos is rejected for not matching the wealth and status others expect. That rejection opens the door to an inheritance mystery tied to Walter Rivas, a DNA match, and a marriage deadline that turns love into a legal condition. Carlos keeps being underestimated as a deliveryman or ordinary worker, even while clues suggest he has a much larger identity and hidden resources. Julia’s fake-boyfriend scheme and later trust crisis show how secrecy poisons relationships even when affection remains. Viviana enters as both a romantic partner and a business figure, and her connection to Carlos shifts from contract pressure toward real trust. Around them, marriage repeatedly becomes a tool of control, whether through inheritance clauses, corporate coercion, or family pressure. The women in the story are often trapped by men using money, custody threats, surveillance, or public shame, but they increasingly push back through strategy and refusal. Corporate warfare grows alongside the romance, with hostile takeovers, shell companies, leaked records, and boardroom coups reshaping who holds power. Carlos’s hidden wealth and Walter’s long observation of him eventually reveal that he was chosen for character, not blood, which complicates every claim to legitimacy. At the same time, other family lines fracture under inheritance battles, custody fights, and accusations of corruption. The story then widens into a darker underworld of mafia households, kidnappings, and covert missions, where Cole/Carlos-like figures move between chauffeur cover, bodyguard work, and secret operations. Chelsea becomes a key emotional and strategic presence in that world, often recognizing more than she is supposed to and forcing the hidden man to choose between exposure and protection. Across these arcs, identity is repeatedly unstable: people are watched, tested, drugged, or made to doubt their own memories. The later material shifts into a larger conspiracy involving the Seven, a hidden elite network controlling finance, politics, media, and succession. Vivian Hale becomes the central challenger to that system, first as a contestant, then as a trapped subject, and finally as someone who begins to turn the system’s own rules against it. Her bond with Adrian remains charged and unresolved, but it is constantly tested by manipulation, memory loss, and competing loyalties. By the end, the stakes are no longer just romance or money, but who gets to define identity, inheritance, and truth inside a world built to control all three.

rbi-grade-b-officer-kaise-banein.title: RBI Grade B Officer Kaise Banein
rbi-grade-b-officer-kaise-banein.description: RBI Grade B Officer Kaise Banein

her-sweet-revenge.title: Her Sweet Revenge
her-sweet-revenge.description: தன் கணவன் அர்ஜுன், தன் சிறந்த தோழியுடன் கள்ளத் தொடர்பில் இருப்பதை அறிந்துகொள்ளும் ஸ்ருதி, ஒரு விபத்திற்குப் பிறகு தன் நினைவாற்றலை இழந்துவிட்டது போல் நடிக்கிறாள். அவளது இந்தச் சூழ்நிலையைப் பயன்படுத்தி, அர்ஜுன் அவளை பொய் சொல்லி செல்வந்தரான 'ஜார்ஜ்' என்பவரின் வாழ்க்கைக்குள் தள்ளிவிடுகிறான். ஆனால், பொய்கள் தீவிரமடையும் வேளையில், ஸ்ருதி யாருக்கும் தெரியாமல் ஒரு ஆபத்தான பழிவாங்கும் விளையாட்டைத் தொடங்குகிறாள்

saving-prince-charming-1.title: Saving Prince Charming
saving-prince-charming-1.description: The story begins with Shakthi suffering a public humiliation and losing her job after a powerful customer uses political influence against her. Her struggle is not just about pride, but about survival, because she needs work to pay for her grandmother’s treatment. That desperation pulls her toward an unusual opportunity in the world of elite security, where she crosses paths with Harshavardhan. Their first clashes are tense and playful, but they soon turn serious when Harshavardhan appoints her as his personal bodyguard after a physical showdown. From that point on, Shakthi is drawn into his private world of wealth, family pressure, and business conflict. Around them, hotel projects, bribery allegations, missing aides, and rival interests create a constant sense of instability. Harshavardhan is also trapped in succession disputes, with relatives challenging legitimacy, inheritance, and his place in the family. Shakthi repeatedly proves herself by protecting him from attackers and standing beside him when threats close in. At the same time, the story keeps hinting that identity and bloodline are not what they seem, especially through references to Meenakshi, a pendant, and people who look strangely familiar. Romantic tension grows as Harshavardhan’s feelings become entangled with Shakthi, while other women, including Ashika and Riya, complicate his emotional life. Ashika’s return as an ex-girlfriend brings open conflict, blame, and an accident that deepens the divide around Harshavardhan. Family elders and mothers try to steady the chaos, but their efforts often reveal old promises, hidden histories, and unresolved grievances instead. The drama also expands into royal and lineage-based conflicts, where protection, status, and belonging are treated as matters of blood. In those moments, characters are forced to defend who counts as family and who does not. Harshavardhan repeatedly rejects pressure from hostile relatives and refuses to let others decide his future for him. Shakthi, meanwhile, remains caught between duty and emotion as she guards him while also becoming part of his household. The later stretch intensifies the danger with blackmail, theft pressure, police involvement, and violent confrontations. By the end of the batch, long-buried secrets begin to surface, and a pendant appears to confirm a lost daughter connection, shifting the family toward reunion and a possible wedding. Even so, the larger web of betrayal, inheritance, and hidden identity remains unresolved, leaving the characters facing both emotional and power-driven stakes.

hai-naa-bolo-bolo-part-2.title: Hai Naa, Bolo Bolo Part 2
hai-naa-bolo-bolo-part-2.description: Maya chooses love over power, but that choice ignites a war with Delhi's most feared dynasty. Then Laila Mirza appears—beautiful, dangerous, and powerful enough to change the course of that war. As the truth behind Mandeep's murdered sister and the hidden empire pulling every string comes to light, three lives become bound together in a final reckoning where love, loyalty, and vengeance demand the ultimate price. Watch Now!

karma-express.title: Karma Express
karma-express.description: The story follows Samaira as she moves through a series of public crises that repeatedly test her dignity, identity, and place within a powerful family. It begins with her traveling by train carrying a precious gift from her late mother to meet a new maternal figure, while her protective father worries about her safety. That journey quickly mirrors the larger world of the show, where crowded public spaces become stages for humiliation, threats, and violence. Seat disputes, harassment, and physical attacks keep erupting, and women are often forced to defend themselves against men who use status, force, and public pressure to dominate them. Samaira is repeatedly pulled into accusations tied to violence, theft, blackmail, and scandal, and she insists more than once that she is being framed. Reema appears as an important ally at first, rushing to help and defending family members, but the later episodes reveal that her role is far more complicated. The drama widens into wedding scandals, damaged phones, compromising photos, and threats of public exposure, showing how reputation can be weaponized as effectively as fists. A necklace becomes a crucial object in the conflict, shifting the story from simple accusation to a deeper struggle over lineage and inheritance. Samaira is challenged over whether she truly belongs to the Singh family, and the answer becomes tied to an ancestral ornament and to claims about hidden parentage. The pressure on her grows until she is forced into a false confession and then publicly beaten for insisting on her identity. At the same time, police, guards, and powerful family members enter the conflict, turning private shame into a legal and social battle. The story then reveals that Samaira is not merely a romantic outsider but the orphaned daughter of Vansh’s late best friend, whom he has raised and protected since childhood. That revelation reframes earlier hostility and explains why Vansh keeps searching for her even as the family crisis deepens. Samaira’s health becomes another urgent stake when she is rushed to the hospital with a serious heart condition, and the family’s blame games continue around her suffering. Reema’s hidden agenda is eventually exposed when she admits she entered the family through marriage in order to seize control of Singh Corporation. From there, the conflict expands into corporate betrayal, hostage-style extortion, and police intervention, with Vansh refusing to give in to blackmail. By the end, arrests, broken alliances, and repeated pleas for forgiveness leave the family fractured, while loyalty, bloodline, and revenge remain unresolved forces driving the drama.

serial-4.title: Serial
serial-4.description:
A serial killer who only targets actors from the biggest Hindi serials on TV gets
investigated by a group of TV superfans who create a reddit group/online community to find
clues about the killer’s identity.

the-second-begining.title: The Second Begining
the-second-begining.description:
Rishte Restart 
When an elderly man seeks a life companion, his grandson finds the perfect match in a kind-hearted grandmother. To win her heart genuinely, he hides his identity and poses as her driver. Meanwhile, the woman faces cruel hardships and is thrown out of her home by her daughter-in-law. With nowhere to go, she turns to her driver. Their journey leads to an unexpected marriage, finally culminating in the heartwarming reveal of his true identity.

kanal.title: Kanal
kanal.description: Diya and Arvind’s story begins as a marriage crisis, with Diya confronting years of emotional neglect and her lack of legal or financial security. Arvind responds by apologizing and offering her shares, but that gesture quickly pulls them into a larger corporate struggle around Phantom Enterprises. A risky share transfer, hidden ownership questions, and pressure over company control turn their private conflict into a business conspiracy. The situation darkens when a car crash leaves Arvind presumed dead, sending Diya into grief before the story reveals that revenge and alliance may have been planned all along. Amit emerges as an important ally in that scheme, while investigations uncover large money transfers, CCTV evidence, and attempts to seize shares, property, and control of the company. Arvind later returns alive, shocking Diya and exposing that hidden motives and family tensions were never resolved. His return also brings warnings from family members that Diya may be using him, while his own identity and power are gradually revealed. Across the next stretch, mistrust spreads through public confrontations, accusations of betrayal, and fights over footage that may even be fake or AI-generated. Anu remains caught in the middle of the emotional triangle, and repeated clashes show how jealousy and humiliation keep spilling into public spaces. The corporate side grows harsher as parties, ownership claims, and legal threats become tied to the marriage conflict. Diya repeatedly tries to force the truth out and protect her position, while Arvind tries to control the narrative and preserve his authority. The Phantom Enterprises thread expands into demands for impossible wealth proofs, including a 100-crore condition and secret arrangements involving savings, jewelry, and property. Financial scrutiny exposes fake collateral, incomplete paperwork, and loan rejection, showing that the money games are unstable and risky. The conflict then escalates into a massive 200-crore transfer, with public humiliation, contract pressure, and accusations of fraud. That money is later revealed to have moved into a personal account, deepening suspicion and suggesting manipulation from within. Family revelations also surface, including divorce papers, a long-lost brother reunion, and a paternity dispute that adds more uncertainty to the relationships. By the end of the batch, the story is still driven by control, identity, and survival, with romance, family duty, and business power all tangled together.

born-to-strike.title: Born To Strike
born-to-strike.description: Mocked as a nobody, Tianbao possesses a mysterious right hand capable of unimaginable power. While trying to impress the fearless Zhao Ying, he is drawn into a brutal world of rival martial clans, deadly tournaments, and ancient secrets. With loyal friends by his side and powerful enemies closing in, Tianbao must master his extraordinary gift, protect the people he loves, and fight his way from an underestimated nobody to a legendary martial arts hero.

the-prince-who-hated-me.title: The Prince Who Hated Me
the-prince-who-hated-me.description: Yoon Jin wakes in a weak body inside a historical court world and is immediately pulled into scandal, suspicion, and family intrigue. From the start, she is framed by misunderstandings involving rooms, drugs, theft, and accusations of impropriety, and she has to fight back just to keep her name intact. Her clashes with hostile men and court figures keep turning private moments into public disgrace, while elders try to protect family honor without exposing deeper truths. At the same time, Rajkumar and other powerful men are trapped by their own secrets, including fake illness, hidden poison, and political weakness that others want to exploit. A long-hidden romance is gradually revealed, but love in this world is never separate from status, coercion, or survival. Marriage becomes a weapon, with proposals, refusals, bride-swaps, divorce terms, and strategic contracts all used to control people and territory. Yoon Jin is repeatedly dragged into these schemes, sometimes as a target, sometimes as leverage, and sometimes as the only person willing to challenge the lies. Court pressure grows through hearings, interrogations, and punishments, as rulers and nobles argue over who is guilty and who is being used. A larger conspiracy emerges around poisoning, smuggling, corruption, and an account book that could expose dangerous crimes. Several women are threatened, blamed, or publicly shamed, but they also push back with denials, accusations, and demands for justice. The emotional center keeps shifting between Yoon Jin and the men tied to her, especially as trust breaks down and then briefly returns through confession, protection, and reluctant tenderness. Even when romance deepens, it is shadowed by surveillance, jealousy, and the fear that any bond can be turned into evidence against them. The story also widens into family betrayals, where broken promises, forced marriages, and rejected blood ties show how little safety remains inside the household. Violence escalates from private threats to public attacks, including ambushes, poisonings, fire, and arrests that shake the court. Some characters try to seize power through military command or royal favor, while others abandon ambition for love or loyalty. By the end of the arc, secrets are still being uncovered, but every revelation seems to create a new enemy or a new danger. The overall stakes are survival, reputation, and the struggle to choose love or truth in a world built to punish both.
