mathe-mungaru.title: Mathe Mungaru
mathe-mungaru.description: After being humiliated and thrown out by her own family, warm-hearted street food vendor Janki unexpectedly finds love and respect in the wealthy yet secretive Tripathy family. As billionaire Om Tripathy hides his true identity to win her trust, relationships heal, old wounds resurface, and a lost mother’s hope of reuniting with her missing son slowly comes alive again

kismat-ki-chingari.title: Kismat Ki Chingari
kismat-ki-chingari.description: Jiu Jiu enters the story as a storm-born child in a poor rural family, and her unusual awareness quickly sets her apart from everyone around her. She can understand birds and hide a mysterious space, but she keeps those gifts secret so she will not be treated as a witch. Her parents protect her, and she in turn resolves to change the family’s financial fate. Early signs of luck, such as a blooming barren tree and multiplying animals, make the household believe she may bring prosperity. At the same time, she senses poison, danger, and betrayal inside the home, especially around a cruel mother-in-law who keeps trying to force harmful black medicine on a younger woman. Family conflict widens into inheritance fights, public arguments, and repeated clashes over loyalty and control. Jiu Jiu’s mother confronts the abuse directly, but the household remains unstable and the disputes keep spilling into public view. The story then moves into court, where Tang challenges unfair authority and defends the Fu family in a case tied to cruelty and inheritance. The magistrate’s rulings punish the accused and briefly free the wronged family, while Tang’s high-status necklace and calm confidence hint that he is hiding something about himself. Back in the village, marriage pressure becomes another major source of chaos, with Jiu Jiu rejecting forced matches and other characters being pushed into unwanted unions or public claims. One thread centers on Yong, whose name becomes tied to pregnancy accusations, marriage demands, and family shame before he is later revealed to be alive. His battlefield success brings imperial rewards, land, and promotion, but that new status also attracts scams, false claims, and fresh humiliation for those trying to exploit him. The village repeatedly turns private matters into public spectacle, whether through gossip about fertility, jealousy, or suspected betrayal. Alongside the conflict, the story also opens space for healing and education, as a young man asks to study traditional medicine and later the focus expands toward girls’ schooling and social reform. Jiu Jiu remains a steady force through these shifts, helping save lives, defending the vulnerable, and pushing practical improvements like farming and fairer punishment. A childbirth emergency shows how central she has become, since she insists that both mother and child can survive when others believe only one life can be saved. The household and village also begin to change through labor-based punishment, strawberry farming, and a new cafe venture that turns hardship into business. Even so, greed and fraud continue to threaten families, especially when money disputes expose manipulation inside marriages and among relatives. By the end of the batch, the drama has expanded from one gifted child’s birth into a broad web of family feuds, court battles, romance pressure, scams, and reform, with Jiu Jiu still at the center of the struggle for survival and dignity.

pranaya-theeram.title: Pranaya theeram
pranaya-theeram.description: A romantic drama about two middle-aged, unmarried individuals —Kabeer, a powerful yet emotionally distant businessman, and Tara, a kind but struggling woman who has been overlooked by society due to her age and speech impediment. When fate brings them together, they enter an unexpected marriage. Their journey explores love beyond age, status, and societal expectations, while hidden truths and family conflicts threaten to pull them apart. Watch now!

love-on-duty-1.title: Love On Duty
love-on-duty-1.description: Working as a humble ambulance driver, a secret billionaire saves a young woman's life and enters into a complicated contract marriage with her. As they grow closer, his massive fortune and hidden identity are suddenly exposed. Feeling betrayed by his lies, the furious heroine walks out on him. Now, the billionaire must drop his ego and fight to convince his angry wife that while his identity was fake, his love for her is absolutely real!

my-psycho-pondatti.title: My Psycho Pondatti
my-psycho-pondatti.description: ஷீத்தல் என்ற இரக்கமற்ற தொழிலதிபர், தன் ஊழியரான ராஜ்ஜை அவமானப்படுத்துகிறாள். ஆனால், அவன் தன் அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து வாழும் ஒரு சக்திவாய்ந்த கோடீஸ்வரன் என்பது அவளுக்குத் தெரியாது. அகந்தையினால் நடக்கும் இந்தத் திருமணத்தில் அவளது கொடுமைகளை அமைதியாகத் தாங்கும் ராஜ், அவளையும் அவளது நிறுவனத்தையும் ஆபத்துகளில் இருந்து காப்பாற்றுகிறான். பழிவாங்கல் மற்றும் அதிகாரப் போட்டிக்கு மத்தியில், இருவரின் வெறுப்பு காதலாக மாறுவதே கதையாகும்.

sauda-pyaar-ka.title: Sauda Pyaar Ka
sauda-pyaar-ka.description: Sauda Pyaar Ka is an emotional romance where a humble tailor secretly lives a double life as India's biggest fashion tycoon. While he sacrifices everything for the woman he loves, she betrays him for wealth and status—only to discover his true identity when it's too late. A story of love, heartbreak, betrayal, and redemption.

hit-me-again.title: Hit me again
hit-me-again.description: At St. Jude’s Martial Academy, society is ruled by cybernetic elites who look down on powerless scholarship students. Kai, an underestimated student with an extraordinary ability to absorb kinetic energy, refuses to accept the caste system. As he defeats increasingly powerful enemies, his body evolves into something terrifying. With Clara, the academy’s elite “goddess,” by his side, Kai challenges corrupt authorities, ruthless heirs, while uncovering the mysterious sovereign power within him.

the-protector.title: The Protector
the-protector.description: When a protective father discovers his son is deeply in love with a deceitful girl, he takes matters into his own hands. To save his son from a ruined future, he goes undercover. Without revealing his true identity as the boy's father, he teams up with a secret crew and orchestrates a brilliant master plan to expose her hidden affairs and true, dark colors. How far will a father go to protect his child?

not-your-family-man.title: Not Your Family Man
not-your-family-man.description: A carefree yet extraordinarily powerful mountain warrior, Nivan Shandilya, enters the modern world to fulfil his grandfather’s final wish—an arranged marriage with heiress Mysha Dhanraj. But when he discovers dark forces, family conspiracies, underworld threats, and black magic surrounding her world, Nivan must protect the woman who rejected him while proving that true power lies beyond wealth, status, and fear.

satya-ni-shodh-ma.title: Satya Ni Shodh Ma
satya-ni-shodh-ma.description: Ek powerful lagan ma betrayal, hidden identity ane shocking secrets badhu j badli nakhe chhe. Prem jyare badla ma badlay chhe, tyare Aviva ane Adhiraj vachche satya ni shodh ek khatarnak jung bani jaay chhe.

state-psc-group-b-ki-taiyari.title: State PSC Group B Ki Taiyari
state-psc-group-b-ki-taiyari.description: State PSC Group B Ki Taiyari

cursed-heir-hidden-god.title: Cursed Heir, Hidden God
cursed-heir-hidden-god.description: Caius Drenmere is mocked as a drunken gambler and disgrace to his noble family, but behind his careless façade hides the legendary Spectral Phoenix—the kingdom of Elyndor’s most powerful protector. As Eastern forces threaten the realm, Caius secretly battles deadly sorcerers while enduring betrayal, humiliation, and schemes against his family. When the Sovereign Trials expose his true power, Caius must finally reveal himself, confront those responsible for his father’s death.

hridayam.title: Hridayam
hridayam.description: After being humiliated for his poverty, a now-billionaire returns to his hometown to execute a calculated revenge plan, exposing his childhood sweetheart's greed and systematically destroying the life of her arrogant fiancé.

past-ka-secret-link.title: Past Ka Secret Link
past-ka-secret-link.description: Desperate to save his family from poverty, Lin discovers a mysterious app that connects him to the legendary General Han Li in ancient China. Every video Lin uploads helps Han win impossible battles, while priceless treasures from the past appear in Lin's hands. But as a ruthless conspiracy closes in, one wrong upload could destroy an empire... and erase Lin's future forever.

thangamagal.title: Thangamagal
thangamagal.description: The story centers on Siddharth, Ranjani, and their child Sanjana as a family crisis keeps colliding with work pressure, public suspicion, and a failing marriage. It begins with a child trapped in a locked car in extreme heat, immediately setting a life-or-death tone and exposing how fragile the family situation already is. Siddharth is pulled between his job and the emergency, and the workplace conflict only sharpens the sense that he is failing in both places. As the search widens, clues from a phone call, social media, vehicle details, and police reports keep the hope of rescue alive, but every lead also brings confusion and mistrust. Ranjani becomes increasingly central to the crisis, sometimes resisting Siddharth and sometimes appearing tied to the child’s safety in ways that are hard to read at first. Bala and other family or party figures add to the chaos by dismissing warnings, arguing over responsibility, or deepening the misunderstanding around Sanjana’s disappearance. The search moves through homes, parties, parking lots, and hotel areas, with Siddharth repeatedly forced to prove that he is not the threat but the desperate father. Public humiliation and even physical attack follow when strangers mistake him for an abductor, showing how badly the situation has spiraled. The emotional core remains Sanjana’s repeated cries for her parents, which confirm that the danger is real and that time is running out. Eventually the crisis turns into a crash and rescue attempt, and Sanjana is left critically injured, shifting the story from disappearance to medical emergency. In the hospital, doctors warn that the next 48 hours are crucial, making survival uncertain and every family argument more painful. The truth then surfaces that Ranjani had locked Sanjana inside the car, turning the earlier confusion into a devastating confession. That confession does not end the conflict, because blame, guilt, and old resentment immediately split the family further. Siddharth is defended as a man who sacrificed career and comfort for his child, but others reject that defense and the confrontation becomes openly hostile. He finally breaks with Ranjani and sends divorce papers, showing that the marriage has been shattered by the crisis. Even after that, the child remains unconscious and fragile, while brief signs of movement offer only cautious hope. The final emotional state is one of separation, guilt, and unresolved fear, with Sanjana still asking for her mother and the family left to face the consequences of what happened.

ek-adhoora-ishq.title: Ek Adhoora Ishq
ek-adhoora-ishq.description: After losing her eyesight while saving her childhood love, Mulan is abandoned by him and spends seven years being cared for by Fan, a servant's son who loves her unconditionally. When her vision returns, she secretly marries her former lover to save him, shattering Fan's heart. Choosing self-respect over sacrifice, Fan decides to leave forever,only then does Mulan begin to realize who truly stood by her through every darkness.

first-night-with-devva.title: First Night With Devva
first-night-with-devva.description: First Night With Devvais a supernatural horror thriller about Arun and Radhika, a troubled married couple who travel to a mysterious forest bungalow to repair their broken relationship. What begins as a romantic getaway soon turns into a terrifying fight for survival when a vengeful spirit named Malathi begins haunting Arun and the couple.

fearless-father-2.title: Fearless Father
fearless-father-2.description: A couple discovers their son's fiancée is a manipulative fraud involved with another man and a larger conspiracy. After being humiliated and attacked by her, they gather evidence and expose the truth during the engagement, saving their son from betrayal and reclaiming their dignity through a calculated revenge. Watch now.

saat-phere-do-chehre.title: Saat Phere, Do Chehre
saat-phere-do-chehre.description: On the night of her wedding, Han Yan is reborn with memories of a lifetime stolen by betrayal. Refusing to repeat her tragic fate with her deceitful husband Shen Yu, she rewrites every step of her destiny. As she fights for justice and finds unwavering support in Fu Yuchen, old lies unravel, hidden faces are exposed, and the sacred seven vows become the ultimate battleground between love, revenge, and redemption.

orma.title: Orma
orma.description: When brilliant anesthesiologist Dr.Amrita discovers what appears to be her husband Dr.Dhiraj’s devastating affair, she volunteers for a dangerous cryogenic experiment that will make her disappear for decades. But as she silently prepares to leave forever, her husband races to find her, unaware that a manipulative outsider has engineered the betrayal that is about to destroy their love, their marriage, and their future. Watch Now!

roar-of-the-champion.title: Roar Of The Champion
roar-of-the-champion.description: Once a celebrated Taekwondo world champion, Mien Jun gives up glory to coach a struggling school team. But when ruthless rival Pang frames him, destroys his reputation, and pushes his students to the brink, Jun must rise from humiliation to fight for justice. In a battle of honor, revenge, and resilience, one fallen champion proves that true greatness is earned by never giving up.

fake-doctor-1.title: Fake Doctor
fake-doctor-1.description: The story begins with a devastating collapse in Dr. Ravi’s life, as injustice strips him of his license, reputation, research, and love before a fatal crash closes his arc in tragedy. From there, the show shifts into a chain of medical emergencies where a critically injured child becomes the center of repeated roadside, airport, and hospital crises. In those moments, a mysterious medical worker is blamed, doubted, and even physically threatened, yet keeps pushing to save the child when others panic or follow procedure too rigidly. Randhir and later Vedant emerge as unexpected lifesavers, using hidden medical knowledge to stop harmful treatment and stabilize the boy despite public suspicion. The hospital then reveals that the man dismissed as a compounder is actually Dr. Vedant Mehra, a former doctor whose past has been buried behind a lower-status role. His hidden history becomes central to the larger conflict, because every attempt to help seems to reopen old accusations about his license and conduct. At the same time, Kashish Batra grows into a major force in the emergency response, using her authority to clear obstacles and later becoming tied to the minister’s family crisis. Another thread follows Vedang Mehra, who presents six years of heart research after losing his license and grieving his father, showing that he has continued to work toward healing even after public disgrace. The hospital itself becomes a battleground of status and control, with Viraj repeatedly trying to dominate treatment decisions and treat the institution as a matter of power rather than care. Senior doctors and staff argue over whether the dismissed worker is a real doctor or merely a compounder, while junior staff quietly recognize his skill. Nisha is pulled into this conflict through both professional judgment and personal ties, as her engagement and emotional loyalties become entangled with Viraj and the overlooked ward boy or doctor. Aryan’s compassionate presence in the ward adds a quieter emotional line, but his six-year relationship with Nisha ends in rejection when marriage pressure and class differences surface. The stakes rise further when a critically ill government minister is brought in, forcing the hospital to balance medicine, politics, and reputation under extreme pressure. Doctors disagree over whether surgery is possible, and the minister’s condition becomes a test of who can be trusted to act when time is running out. Vedant is repeatedly blocked, humiliated, and accused, yet he keeps returning to the emergency because he is often the only one with a workable solution. The conflict reaches its peak when a non-surgical heart treatment and other special techniques are finally used in desperate circumstances, proving that the man everyone tried to dismiss may be the one who can save the most impossible cases. By the end of the batch, the hospital’s leadership and moral authority are both in flux, with recognition, punishment, and possible transfer of control all hanging on the outcome of these life-or-death interventions.

perfect-betrayal.title: Perfect Betrayal
perfect-betrayal.description: He gave up his dreams for love. She married him to keep a promise to someone else. When Ray uncovers the truth behind six years of lies, he walks away with his daughter. But the end of their marriage is only the beginning, as buried secrets, betrayal, and regret threaten to destroy everyone involved.

samajavaragamana.title: Samajavaragamana
samajavaragamana.description: After being betrayed at her wedding, Veda impulsively marries a humble sweeper to save her dignity. But she soon discovers that her new husband, Arjun, is actually a powerful billionaire hiding his true identity.

servant-chakravarthi.title: Servant Chakravarthi
servant-chakravarthi.description: When a wealthy heir enters into a six-month contract marriage with an innocent orphan girl who has lost faith in the rich after being betrayed by the man she loved, their arrangement slowly turns into genuine love—forcing them to fight his powerful family's opposition, a jealous ex-lover, deadly conspiracies, and a secret pregnancy that threatens to tear them apart.

the-underworld-teacher-returns.title: The Underworld Teacher Returns
the-underworld-teacher-returns.description: The Underworld Teacher Returns is an inspiring sports drama about a legendary teacher who revives a failing college sports team through unconventional training methods, transforming a group of underconfident students into champions while helping them overcome their personal struggles. It's a heartwarming story of mentorship, resilience, and the power of believing in yourself. Watch now!

when-a-billionaire-met-a-mafia-family-on.title: When a Billionaire Met a Mafia Family On a Train
when-a-billionaire-met-a-mafia-family-on.description: On a speeding train, a wounded young woman is brutally humiliated, branded a gold-digger, and nearly killed by a ruthless billionaire family—until a shocking truth explodes: the “helpless” girl they tortured is actually the only daughter of the powerful tycoon they’re desperate to marry into.

the-greatest-game-changer.title: The Greatest Game Changer
the-greatest-game-changer.description: This is an emotional revenge-success drama set in the world of gaming and technology. The story follows a gifted creator who loses everything due to greed, betrayal, and corporate politics. As Anirudh rebuilds his life with the support of a visionary entrepreneur, the series explores ambition, loyalty, innovation, and the triumph of talent over corruption.

fearless-father-1.title: Fearless Father
fearless-father-1.description: Ajay and Rukmini discover their son Rohan’s fiancée Anika is a manipulative fraud involved with another man and a larger conspiracy. After being humiliated and attacked by her, they gather evidence and expose her truth during the engagement, saving Rohan from betrayal and reclaiming their dignity through a calculated revenge.

adhipathi-aryavera.title: Adhipathi Aryavera
adhipathi-aryavera.description: Aryavera, raised as an orphan, is given a sacred pearl by his Guru to find his true family. His journey leads him to a royal fort where the Queen recognizes him as her lost son. However, the King rejects him for lacking the divine Brahmastra. As a rival army attacks, Aryavera unleashes his extraordinary hidden powers to protect the kingdom. Witness this epic tale of bravery as he proves his royal bloodline and fights to reclaim his destiny!

mahayodha-ka-prahaar.title: Mahayodha Ka Prahaar
mahayodha-ka-prahaar.description: A legendary warrior hiding in the modern world is forced to reveal his true identity when ruthless enemies and an ancient order hunt him down, putting the woman he loves in grave danger. As forgotten powers awaken and deadly secrets unfold, he must embrace his destiny as the greatest warrior of Siddhabhoomi to defeat evil and protect both worlds.

raani-sa-ro-comback.title: Raani Sa Ro Comback
raani-sa-ro-comback.description:
Kiara Bansal, ek selfmade arabpati, apni asli pehchaan ne chupa kar logaa ri sachai ne parkhno chave hai. lekin unne sirf beijjati or dhokho hi mile hai or ek din kismat kiara ne milavave hai Tej jaysingh su ek bahut badi company ro CEO, aa mulakat ek nakli rishta su shuru hove hai pan waqt or mushkila ee  rishta ne sach me gehro kar deve hai.
pan jad kiara ri asli pehchan "The Sky Queen" ro raaz sabke sami aave hai to kaai hosi?

x-ray-aankhon-wala-saiyaan.title: X Ray Aankhon Wala Saiyaan
x-ray-aankhon-wala-saiyaan.description: A man with X ray vision eyes comes to town to marry a woman his guruji told him to marry. That woman has a lot of goons behind her who want to marry her. Our hero saves her with the power of his x ray vision which he can see anyone naked.

megamo-avan.title: Megamo Avan
megamo-avan.description: தன்னோட கணவன் மாறன் ஒரு பால்காரன்னு நம்பி கல்யாணம் பண்ண சக்திக்கு அவனோட உண்மையான அடையாளம் தெரிய வந்த போது, அவ மொத்த வாழ்க்கையும் மாறி போயிடுச்சு... யார் இந்த மாறன்? அவனோட அடையாளம் என்ன?

daddys-secret-power.title: Daddy's Secret Power
daddys-secret-power.description: தனது உண்மையான அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து, சாதாரண மனிதனாக வாழும் ஒரு தந்தையின் உணர்ச்சிப்பூர்வமான பயணத்தைச் சொல்லும் குடும்ப–டிராமா. சமூகத்தில் பணமும் பதவியும் மட்டுமே மதிக்கப்படும் சூழலில், தனது மகளின் மரியாதைக்காகவும் எதிர்காலத்திற்காகவும் போராடும் அந்த தந்தை, சரியான நேரத்தில் தனது மறைந்திருக்கும் சக்தியை வெளிப்படுத்துகிறார். அன்பு, தியாகம், குடும்ப பாசம் மற்றும் நீதி ஆகியவற்றை மையமாகக் கொண்ட ஒரு விறுவிறுப்பான கதை.

the-miracle-i-found.title: The Miracle I Found
the-miracle-i-found.description:
Gunbao, a mischievous little girl, is actually the reincarnation of the Little God of Wealth. After failing her heavenly trials three times, she is given one final chance to prove herself. Sent to the human world, she must help people, fulfill their wishes, and earn enough merit to return to Heaven.

But Gunbao's innocent way of granting wishes creates unexpected chaos. The villagers misunderstand her miracles and begin believing that she is a Goddess of Misfortune rather than a God of Wealth.

blood-never-lies.title: Blood Never Lies
blood-never-lies.description: The story centers on Long, also known as Chu Long or Long Bhai, a former underworld figure who keeps trying to live quietly as a mechanic or shopkeeper while the criminal world keeps dragging him back. His attempt to stay clean is constantly undermined by old enemies, debt collectors, and rumors about his violent past. Around him, Siya or Sia becomes the emotional anchor, trying to protect him, defend him from humiliation, and survive the danger that follows him. Their bond is repeatedly tested by extortion, kidnapping, public shame, and pressure from powerful families and bosses. Early conflicts begin at the garage, where damaged cars, debt threats, and intimidation turn ordinary work into a battleground. As rival bosses and street crews close in, Long’s hidden status and old connections are exposed, briefly shifting the balance of power but never ending the threat. The story widens into class conflict as wealthy classmates, elite figures, and business rivals use money and status to humiliate Long and those beside him. Sia repeatedly refuses to bow to family pressure or arranged plans, even when those choices put her at odds with her mother and other powerful people. At the same time, Long’s past with brothers and former allies becomes more important, especially as hidden wealth, broken promises, and old loyalties surface. The death of Lina becomes a major turning point, with Long refusing the official story and demanding the truth behind what happened. That search reveals gang war, betrayal, and a chain of violence tied to former allies and rival criminal groups. Several episodes show that brotherhood in this world is fragile, because protection, guilt, and revenge keep turning friends into enemies. Long is repeatedly forced to choose between revenge and restraint, and each time the choice costs him more safety and peace. The violence also spreads outward to children, women, and family members who are used as leverage in larger power struggles. Even when hidden status, corporate influence, or sudden wealth briefly reverse a humiliation, the deeper conflicts remain unresolved. By the later stretch, the story becomes a cycle of rescue missions, hostage threats, and revenge bargains that keep pulling Long back into danger. The final arc suggests that love and loyalty are still the only things keeping him from fully surrendering to the underworld, but those same bonds also make him vulnerable.

swapnakoodu-1.title: Swapnakoodu
swapnakoodu-1.description: After being thrown out by his own son, a school cleaner secretly living as the world’s richest man, believes love and family are over for him. But when he meets a strong single mother fighting to protect her school, his life changes forever. What begins as a fake relationship slowly turns into an emotional love story filled with heartbreak, family betrayal, hidden power, and shocking revelations. The world sees him as a nobody… until his biggest secret changes everything.

the-silent-warrior.title: The Silent Warrior
the-silent-warrior.description: A humiliated, seemingly powerless husband risks everything to save his marriage, only to discover that his greatest weakness is the key to unlocking a legendary power that can make him an unstoppable warrior.

king-beyond-death.title: King Beyond Death
king-beyond-death.description: The story follows a man whose ordinary life is repeatedly shattered by humiliation, family conflict, and a growing supernatural destiny. It begins with public shame over a broken marriage and accusations of betrayal, but that personal pain quickly opens into visions of a cosmic war and a reborn ruler tied to life, death, and an approaching catastrophe. As he moves through the mortal world, he is pulled into scams, extortion attempts, and violent disputes where powerful people try to seize women, homes, and status. At the same time, mysterious signs suggest that he may be the reincarnation of an ancient divine figure, and sacred relics and hidden texts begin to confirm that larger forces are watching him. The story also widens into a family crisis centered on a dying elder, where healing, authority, and trust become weapons in a struggle over the household. False masters, rival claimants, and suspicious healers all compete to control the situation, while the elder’s illness is increasingly linked to occult manipulation. A coercive marriage bargain emerges from that crisis, forcing a granddaughter to trade her future for her grandfather’s survival. Even when healing seems to work, the relief is unstable, and the promise made under pressure keeps binding the family to dangerous powers. In parallel, the protagonist is dragged into public trials where officials accuse him of fraud and murder, yet witnesses keep stepping forward to defend the truth of what he has done. Each confrontation raises the stakes from local humiliation to sect-level judgment, with enemies demanding confession, submission, or death. The narrative then expands into a cultivation hierarchy, where higher figures arrive from distant realms and reveal that the local conflict is only one layer of a much larger struggle. Sacred shrines, inscriptions, pillars, and ritual tests repeatedly challenge who is worthy, who is lying, and who truly carries divine legitimacy. Rumors spread that several figures may be avatars or reincarnations of legendary beings, but certainty remains elusive because every revelation is met with skepticism or violence. Public tests on stairways, swords, and statues turn identity into a life-or-death matter, and even the heavens seem to react when hidden power is exposed. Forced marriage, wedding interruptions, and family shame continue to collide with these mythic disputes, keeping romance and duty in constant conflict. By the end of the batch, the story has become a broad battle over inheritance, sacred authority, and hidden truth, with the protagonist and those around him still resisting judgment while a larger celestial crisis gathers.

husband-wife-psycho-secretary.title: Husband Wife & Psycho Secretary
husband-wife-psycho-secretary.description: When the undercover billionaire CEO of a mega-conglomerate is mistaken for her husband’s mistress by his ambitious secretary, she endures a brutal public assault and a forced abortion, prompting her to orchestrate an elaborate, globally broadcast sting operation to exact ultimate revenge.

driver-ka-plot-twist.title: Driver ka plot twist
driver-ka-plot-twist.description: After giving up his billion-dollar empire to live as an ordinary driver for the woman he loves, Amar dreams of a simple family life. But when his wife Naina sacrifices their unborn child for ambition and grows closer to her wealthy ex-husband, Amar is branded a failure. As love turns into betrayal, the hidden founder of WhiteRock finally reclaims his empire—forcing everyone who humiliated him to bow before the man they called a loser.

ente-nataka-bharya.title: Ente Nataka Bharya
ente-nataka-bharya.description: The story follows a long collapse of modern relationships under the weight of old love, family pressure, money, and hidden agreements. At the center is Dev and Riya’s marriage, which is repeatedly shown to be unstable and emotionally exhausted. Their five-year contract marriage ends in divorce, but the separation does not bring peace. Instead, Avinash’s return as Riya’s former love keeps reopening the wound and makes Dev believe she may be happier without him. Even when Dev tries to care for Riya one last time or step back for her sake, the household remains tense and unresolved. Public gatherings only make things worse, as private hurt turns into accusations, humiliation, and physical conflict. Family members and outsiders keep pushing the couple in different directions, sometimes urging them to stay together and sometimes forcing them apart. A birthday celebration, a reunion meal, and other social events become stages for old memories, jealousy, and blame. Dev is also pulled into work-related and corporate pressures, including a research project, a secret mission, and conditions that demand separation and silence. These outside demands deepen the sense that his personal life is being controlled by larger forces. Riya refuses to accept the breakup at first and continues to insist that Dev still loves her. At the same time, she is confronted with claims about money, abandonment, and betrayal that make the truth harder to trust. Watches, divorce papers, and contracts become symbols of the hidden terms governing these relationships. Several women connected to Dev, including Shreya, Sakshi, and others named in the conflicts, intensify the sense that his past and present are tangled together. Avinash also remains a disruptive presence, whether as a rival, an injured guest, or a figure tied to public confrontation. By the end of the batch, no relationship is cleanly healed, and every attempt at closure seems to expose another layer of deception or sacrifice. The overall arc is one of love turning into obligation, then into suspicion, with each revelation making the emotional stakes more painful.

the-retired-king-doesnt-stay-retired.title: The Retired King Doesn't Stay Retired
the-retired-king-doesnt-stay-retired.description: Aradhya’s story begins in danger, with a violent nighttime attack that is interrupted by a mysterious rescuer, and from that point forward she remains under constant threat. Poisonings, strange attackers, and warnings about her rare mixed blood make it clear that she is being hunted for more than ordinary revenge. Adarsh stays close to her as a protective lover, but their bond is repeatedly strained by secrecy, suspicion, and outside manipulation. The household around them becomes a battlefield of accusations, with Shakti, Sameera, Karishma, and others turning private conflict into public humiliation and mistrust. Evidence, hidden videos, and claims of betrayal make it hard for anyone to know who is lying, and even Adarsh is pushed into believing Aradhya has betrayed him. At the same time, a larger criminal and supernatural conspiracy unfolds around Marco Varayan and his allies, who are tied to illegal drugs, mind control, and a formula that could become unstoppable if Aradhya’s blood is used. Arjun and other protectors work on an antidote and try to stop the control medicine before it spreads further. The story widens again into royal and alien identity threads, where sacred bracelets, succession claims, and hidden bloodlines suggest that several characters are tied to a deeper power struggle. Aradhya is eventually revealed to be half-human and half-Varayan, linking her fate to a hidden royal kingdom and making her even more valuable to her enemies. Adarsh’s own truth is also exposed in stages, including his secret identity and his attempts to hide it in order to protect her. As the danger grows, Aradhya is kidnapped, drugged, isolated, and repeatedly rescued, while allies race to find her and expose the people behind the traps. Family gatherings turn into crises when poison, intruders, and armed threats break through the fragile peace. Betrayals inside the group become as dangerous as the enemies outside it, especially when trusted figures are suspected of leaking information or serving hidden masters. The conflict also reaches into the past, with revelations about murder, disappearance, and a locket tied to the larger plan. By the end of the batch, the struggle is no longer just about romance or family honor, but about survival against a network of control, revenge, and hidden allegiance. Aradhya remains at the center of every scheme, while the people around her fight over whether to protect her, use her, or destroy her.

my-forever-partner.title: My Forever Partner
my-forever-partner.description: A billionaire sister need a wife for his brother ,and she found an innocent girl and the brother hide his identity from her and will marry to her

the-mafiya-express.title: The Mafiya Express
the-mafiya-express.description: Traveling to her father's wedding, an adopted daughter is brutally insulted and beaten by her future step-aunt over a train seat. At the station, the cruel bride-to-be joins the torment, mocking the girl's claims of being the groom's daughter. The nightmare ends when the frantic father finally finds her, reveals her true identity to the shocked abusers, and sends his wicked fiancée straight to jail, choosing his beloved daughter over the marriage.

math-ka-maharaj.title: Math ka Maharaj
math-ka-maharaj.description: An ordinary mathematics teacher suffering from amnesia slowly discovers that he is the anonymous cyber genius who has secretly protected the nation for years — while enemies hunt him, corrupt officials betray him, and two powerful women fight to stand beside him as he races against time to stop catastrophic cyber and nuclear attacks. Watch now!

game-changer-1.title: Game Changer
game-changer-1.description: To fulfill his grandfather’s dying wish, a secretive multi-billionaire lives undercover as a lowly toilet sweeper, navigating a contractual marriage to a struggling CEO while using his hidden influence and lethal skills to dismantle her corporate enemies and underworld threats.

gold-digger-nan-hudgi.title: Gold Digger? Nan Hudgi!
gold-digger-nan-hudgi.description: Watch family entertainment show 'Gold Digger? Nan Hudgi! '. Only on KukuTV

ajnaatha-bandham.title: Manjil Virinja Pookal
ajnaatha-bandham.description: A cold, contract marriage binds Priya to a man she barely recalls. Landing a job as personal assistant to the ruthless mogul Arjun, she's unaware he’s the husband who abandoned her. Trapped in a web of mistaken identity, can this couple survive a collision of secrets and dangerous, suppressed desire before their hidden bond is destroyed?

khoon-ke-badle-dhokha.title: Khoon Ke Badle Dhokha
khoon-ke-badle-dhokha.description: Wong family ne Chen ko sirf Lin ka permanent blood donor banane ke liye god liya tha. Maa-baap, behen aur yahan tak ki jis Kiara se woh pyaar karta tha, usne bhi uska istemal kiya. Toot chuka Chen unhe chhodkar ek door-daraaz island chala gaya, jahan Lu parivaar ki jaan bachane aur unke saath rehne ke baad use pehli baar sachcha apnapan mila. Tab khulasa hua ki Lin ke saath hone wale haadse sirf dhong the. Pachtave mein doobi Wong family Chen ko dhoondhne nikli, par kya woh kabhi lautega?

ಕೊಳ್ಳೆಗಾಲ--ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ-ಬ್ಲಾಕ್-ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್-ಕ್ಯಾ.title: ಕೊಳ್ಳೆಗಾಲ - ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್ ಕ್ಯಾಪಿಟಲ್
ಕೊಳ್ಳೆಗಾಲ--ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ-ಬ್ಲಾಕ್-ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್-ಕ್ಯಾ.description: ಮಾಟ-ಮಂತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ರಹಸ್ಯ ತಂತ್ರಗಳ ತವರೂರು ಎಂದೇ ಬಿಂಬಿತವಾಗಿರುವ 'ಕೊಳ್ಳೇಗಾಲ'ದ ಅಸಲಿ ಸತ್ಯವೇನು? ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಕಾಣದ ನಿಗೂಢ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳು, ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳ ಹಿಂದಿರುವ ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ನಂಬಿಕೆಯ ಮುಖಗಳನ್ನು ಬಯಲು ಮಾಡುವ ಈ ರೋಚಕ ಇನ್ವೆಸ್ಟಿಗೇಷನ್ ತಪ್ಪದೇ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ!

trilok-yatri.title: Trilok Yatri
trilok-yatri.description: **Trilok Yatri** follows Neo, an ordinary young man who mysteriously awakens in a future ruled by advanced star empires. Mocked as the weakest cadet at a prestigious starship academy, he uses knowledge from his past life to rebuild forgotten warships into legendary weapons. With the fearless Elara by his side, Neo defeats powerful enemies, reshapes the balance of the galaxy, and begins an extraordinary journey to build the greatest empire among the stars.

awdat-shen-lang.title: Awdat Shen Lang
awdat-shen-lang.description: The Return of Shen Lang - Shen Lang Returns as a God-Level Dragon Guard

watch-out-i-am-the-king-now.title: The Blessing of Billions
watch-out-i-am-the-king-now.description: After receiving an impossible blessing that makes him richer than anyone alive, a struggling delivery boy rises from humiliation to unimaginable power. But while he uses his wealth to help others, a ruthless billionaire steals the same gift for greed and revenge—triggering a supernatural reckoning that will decide who truly deserves unlimited wealth.

Mobile-Photography-Masterclass--ಮನೋಹರ್-ಜ.title: Mobile Photography Masterclass - ಮನೋಹರ್ ಜೋಷಿ ಜೊತೆ
Mobile-Photography-Masterclass--ಮನೋಹರ್-ಜ.description: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೊಬೈಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲೇ ಪ್ರೊಫೆಷನಲ್ ಫೋಟೋಗಳನ್ನು ಕ್ಲಿಕ್ಕಿಸಬೇಕೇ? ಹೆಸರಾಂತ ಸಿನಿಮಾಟೋಗ್ರಾಫರ್ ಮನೋಹರ್ ಜೋಶಿ ಅವರ ಈ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ಕ್ಲಾಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಲೈಟಿಂಗ್, ಆಂಗಲ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಫ್ರೇಮಿಂಗ್ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋಟೋಗ್ರಫಿ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು ಇಂದೇ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ!

raw-chief-never-forgives.title: RAW Chief Never Forgives
raw-chief-never-forgives.description: Three years after his sister is driven to suicide by betrayal and corporate fraud, an Indian Army officer returns home with a chilling promise—within three days, everyone responsible will be forced to confess, beg for forgiveness, and lose everything they stole, even as he fights to reclaim his family's honor and save his broken marriage.

bor-ashbe-ekkhuni-niye-jabe-tokkhuni.title: Bor Ashbe Ekkhuni, Niye Jabe Tokkhuni
bor-ashbe-ekkhuni-niye-jabe-tokkhuni.description: Arjun Malhotra begins as a privileged heir who is forced out of comfort and sent to India to learn discipline without revealing who he really is. He is stripped of luxury, mocked in ordinary labor settings, and pushed through humiliating training that tests both his pride and his ability to survive. As he struggles to adapt, Rahul and other figures around the business world help steady the process, while garage and workshop tensions show how far Arjun is from the life he knew. The story widens when Simran returns from America and becomes tied to the same family and business circle, bringing romance into the conflict. Arjun is repeatedly drawn into class clashes, especially when wealthy men try to control, insult, or expose him while he works as a driver and learns from below. Simran’s birthday and other social events turn gifts, money, and status into symbols of power, but they also reveal Arjun’s sincerity and growing attachment to her. Rohit emerges as the main rival, using wealth and public humiliation to claim Simran and force Arjun into submission. Arjun answers with restraint, quiet defiance, and occasional public authority, which makes his hidden strength more visible. Simran is pulled between family duty, social expectations, and her feelings for Arjun, and she repeatedly tries to keep their bond hidden from others. At the same time, the story introduces other romantic and strategic arrangements, including proposals and fake romance meant to cover deeper loyalties. Arjun’s concealed identity becomes harder to maintain as people around him begin to suspect that the driver is not ordinary at all. His father and other family figures add pressure by threatening exposure, pushing marriage plans, and using business interests to control the situation. Public confrontations escalate into accusations, class insults, and physical clashes, showing that love and status are now inseparable from family honor. Simran eventually admits her love for Arjun, but that confession only deepens the outrage around them. By the end, Arjun’s true identity as a billionaire heir is exposed, while the surrounding business and family conflicts remain unresolved. The show’s stakes rest on whether Arjun can keep his love, his identity, and his place in the family intact while surviving the demands of power, pride, and arranged alliances.

apex-protocol.title: Apex Protocol
apex-protocol.description: After being betrayed by his wife and publicly humiliated by her wealthy lover, struggling server technician Jordan Mercer appears to have lost everything. But a long-hidden inheritance restores him as the billionaire heir and controlling force behind Apex Ledger, the world's most powerful blockchain network. With the help of a federal investigator, Jordan secretly dismantles the corrupt empire that stole his life, exposing fraud and reclaiming his power through strategy instead of revenge.

found-real-love-in-spain.title: Found Real Love in Spain
found-real-love-in-spain.description: After waiting two years for her husband Karan to take her to Barcelona, Avni discovers he has a secret wife and has reduced her to a servant. Her only ally is Rishab, a humble taxi driver who is secretly the owner of Karan's company. As Rishab helps Avni rebuild her life under a fake marriage, love blossoms between them. With Karan's betrayal exposed, Avni divorces him and finds the happiness she was always promised.

the-curator.title: The Curator
the-curator.description: Framed for his mentor's murder by corrupt museum director Alistair Croft, art restorer Julian Vance adopts the dark-web alias "The Curator". Operating from a Brooklyn loft, Julian creates flawless forgeries with help from patroness Beatrice Vandermere and chemist Dr. Finch to sabotage Croft's empire. Despite supply blockades and traps orchestrated by Croft and Julian's treacherous insider Simon, Julian orchestrates high-stakes bluffs and hacks.

sanskari-daku.title: Sanskari Daku
sanskari-daku.description: A lazy and unlucky young man from 2026 suddenly finds himself trapped in a mysterious old-world village with three beautiful widows who now believe he is their husband. With the help of a sarcastic AI system called Lilli, he must protect them from dangerous criminals, earn emotional “points,” and slowly transform from a cowardly nobody into an unlikely hero.

sotul-meu-miliardar-accidental.title: Soțul meu miliardar accidental
sotul-meu-miliardar-accidental.description: زوجي الملياردير بالصدفة - Sorry Not a Gold Digger

respawn-the-legend.title: Respawn : the legend
respawn-the-legend.description: After being blacklisted by the powerful Fathom Climb syndicate, legendary free-climber Levi lives as a humble skyscraper window-cleaner while secretly competing under the anonymous alias "Ledger." As he builds a team of fearless street climbers, Levi uncovers a conspiracy where the corporation harvests climbers' biometric data for profit. Forced into a dangerous battle against corrupt elites, he risks everything to expose the truth and reclaim the skyline.

bhai-ni-beni-laadki.title: Bhai Ni Beni Laadki
bhai-ni-beni-laadki.description: Karan ne loko varamvar gareeb ane saamanya maanas samjine apmanit kare chhe, pan teni behen Maitree hamesha teni sathe ubhi rahe chhe. Jyare Karan ni asli odakh Star Lord tarike same aave chhe, tyare badhani duniya badlai jaay chhe. Shu have te potana parivar na sanman mate ladshe?

debut-setelah-sepuluh-tahun-di-penjara.title: Debut Setelah Sepuluh Tahun di Penjara
debut-setelah-sepuluh-tahun-di-penjara.description: Usai bebas dari penjara, seorang pria berharap bisa memulai hidup baru, tetapi justru menghadapi pengkhianatan dan penghinaan. Saat membangun karier di dunia musik, ia terjebak dalam konspirasi yang melibatkan penculikan, fitnah, dan perebutan kekuasaan. Dengan keberanian dan bukti yang dimilikinya, ia berjuang membersihkan namanya dan mengungkap kebenaran.

my-lucky-star-2.title: My Lucky Star
my-lucky-star-2.description:
A stubborn village girl, Akira, is forced into a contract marriage with a seemingly poor catering boy, Lakshya.
Unaware that he is actually the secret billionaire CEO of the Vardhan Group, Akira marries him to save her grandmother and protect her village.
As Akira fights to stop the demolition of her village market by the Vardhan empire, Lakshya struggles between love and his hidden identity.
What begins as a fake marriage turns into a battle of truth, love, and redemption.

first-lie.title: First Lie
first-lie.description: In a world where no one lies, Rajesh accidentally discovers that deception is possible after a bank honors a cheque with an extra zero. He exploits this secret to gain love, wealth, and power until Suresh uncovers the truth and exposes it to everyone. As trust shatters and lies spread, a perfect truth-based society descends into chaos, all because of one accidental mistake.

kadhal-countdown.title: Kadhal Countdown
kadhal-countdown.description: காயமடைந்த ஒரு ரவுடியைக் காப்பாற்றும் நர்ஸ், அவனுடைய அடையாளத்தை மறைப்பதற்காக 30 நாள் ஒப்பந்தத் திருமணம் செய்ய கட்டாயப்படுத்தப்படுகிறாள்; அவனைப் போலீஸில் காட்டிக் கொடுப்பதற்கும், அவன் மீது ஏற்படும் காதலுக்கும் இடையே அவள் சந்திக்கும் போராட்டமே இக்கதை.

gori-aur-gangster.title: Gori aur Gangster
gori-aur-gangster.description: Tara's life falls apart after losing her shop and discovering her fiancé's betrayal. In a new city, she finds an unlikely protector in Riansh, a fearless stranger who secretly falls in love with her. Unaware that he is the notorious don Riansh Raizada—the man she blames for her suffering. Tara marries him under unusual circumstances. As love deepens and hidden truths unravel, their relationship is pushed to the brink by betrayal, enemies, and dangerous secrets.

ninna-gungalle.title: Ninna Gungalle
ninna-gungalle.description: When brilliant anesthesiologist Dr.Amrita discovers what appears to be her husband Dr.Dhiraj’s devastating affair, she volunteers for a dangerous cryogenic experiment that will make her disappear for decades. But as she silently prepares to leave forever, her husband races to find her, unaware that a manipulative outsider has engineered the betrayal that is about to destroy their love, their marriage, and their future.

the-last-promise.title: The Last Promise
the-last-promise.description: The husband has an affair and he not able to take care of her wife and then wife was tired for everything from his side and she decided to fullfill his mom dream ..

naaglok.title: Naaglok
naaglok.description: A humble serpent servant in the mystical kingdom of Naaglok risks everything for the ambitious dancer he loves, only to discover that his greatest battle is not for her heart, but for his own forgotten destiny.

ayyo-pavam-rajakumaran.title: Ayyo Pavam Rajakumaran
ayyo-pavam-rajakumaran.description: A devoted father, Raj, is humiliated for his modest life—until the shocking truth reveals he is actually Prince Singhai, a powerful business tycoon. As he secretly supports his wife Latika’s success while hiding his identity, betrayal, ego, and love collide, pushing their relationship to the edge of divorce.

they-lost-him-forever.title: They Lost Him Forever
they-lost-him-forever.description: Tenzin ne 3 saal tak apni ek galti ka bojh uthate hue paralysis se pidit Han ki seva ki, lekin badle mein use sirf apmaan aur thukraav mila. Yuna ne bhi apne dad ke kehne Par uska saath chhodkar Jin ko chun liya. Toota hua Tenzin Yuna Ko divorce dekar ek nayi zindagi shuru karne chala gaya. Lekin jab Jin ki haqeeqat saamne aayi, tab Yuna aur Han dono ko Tenzin ki asli keemat samajh aayi. Ab sawaal yeh tha—kya pachtawa aur maafi Tenzin ko wapas laane ke liye kaafi the?

ellam-avan-seyal.title: Ellam Avan Seyal
ellam-avan-seyal.description: தன் மனைவியின் வெற்றிக்காக தனது அடையாளத்தையே மறைத்த ஒரு தலைசிறந்த வழக்கறிஞன், அவளின் துரோகத்தால் அனைத்தையும் இழக்கிறான். உண்மையையும் நீதியையும் மீட்டெடுக்க அவன் தொடங்கும் போராட்டமே இந்தக் கதை

married-my-exs-billionaire-rival.title: Married My Ex's Billionaire Rival
married-my-exs-billionaire-rival.description: Emma Bennett's life shatters when she catches her fiancé, Cody, cheating with her stepsister, Sophia. Before she can expose them, her manipulative stepmother frames her for corporate betrayal, turning her own father against her. Disowned, stripped of her inheritance, and cast into humiliation, Emma is forced to survive from nothing. But as hidden truths, ruthless power struggles, and an unexpected billionaire ally emerge, Emma begins a relentless journey to reclaim her legacy and exact revenge.

betrayed-by-blood.title: Betrayed by Blood
betrayed-by-blood.description: Kai’s story is driven by a long cycle of betrayal, family control, and repeated attempts to reclaim a place that has already been taken from him. After returning from prison, he is met not with forgiveness but with blame, humiliation, and constant comparison to Lin, the favored adopted family member. The household’s loyalty is repeatedly shown to be divided, and even celebrations become arenas for public shame and accusation. As the conflict grows, marriage is used both as sacrifice and as a weapon, with Sia pulled into a fake union that is meant to honor one man’s wish while exposing her true feelings for Kai. Kai repeatedly interrupts these arrangements, rejects the family’s version of events, and insists that the past cannot be rewritten so easily. Hidden violence then surfaces through videos, courier-delivered evidence, captivity, and threats of jail, making private resentment into public scandal. The story also widens beyond the family into performance and reinvention, as Master Chen offers second chances, new identities, and even a star path to men trying to escape their pasts. At the same time, identity confusion becomes central, with names, faces, and even deaths questioned, and with one recovered body later revealed to be only a dummy. Kai’s bond with Sia remains emotionally charged and unstable, shifting between love, denial, sacrifice, and grief as each tries to survive the damage done by the family conflict. A crisis reveals that Sia is tied to Kai in a deeper way than expected, and the show keeps returning to the pain of what was hidden, delayed, or misunderstood. The Wong family’s power structure collapses under its own cruelty, especially as it becomes clear that protecting Lin may have cost Kai everything. Kai eventually cuts legal and emotional ties, divorcing Sia and severing himself from his parents, but that break does not end the damage. A suspicious fire and an unidentifiable burned body push the story into mourning and uncertainty, while loved ones refuse to accept the loss. Later, the narrative shifts into rescue, reunion, and renewed identity struggles, with Kai surviving in a new life and under a new name while people from his old life search for him. Even when he is found or recognized, the reunion is rarely simple, because grief, revenge, and old promises keep reopening the wound. In the final stretch, the story turns toward sacrifice and public commitment again, with wedding plans, family pressure, and a marriage that is shadowed by the return of someone who should have stayed gone. Across the whole arc, the stakes are emotional survival, family belonging, and the right to define one’s own identity after being blamed, replaced, or erased.

my-brothers-widow-my-obsession.title: My Brother's Widow, My Obsession
my-brothers-widow-my-obsession.description: After her husband Arthur's death, Elena Vance refuses to abandon Vance Crest, the family vineyard, despite ruthless businessman Charles Sterling seizing the estate. Imprisoned on her own land, she becomes the target of greed and betrayal. But as foreclosure closes in, Arthur's younger brother, Julian Vance, returns from abroad with hidden power, determined to reclaim the family's legacy and confront those who destroyed it.

rate-my-hero.title: Rate My Hero
rate-my-hero.description: The show opens with public humiliation and honor disputes, where a small-town misunderstanding turns a simple act of help into a loud scandal. From there, the story quickly expands into a supernatural world of deadlines, point systems, and divine missions that govern love, power, and survival. Rahul and Neil emerge as central men caught between devotion and impossible tests, each trying to prove worthiness while facing rejection from stern guardians and rivals. Suhani’s love life becomes a source of conflict, with different men claiming her future while authority figures try to control the outcome. At the same time, the narrative keeps returning to hidden identity, where characters are accused of fraud, then slowly revealed as healers, protectors, or people with secret abilities. Several women around the leads move between suspicion and trust, often debating who truly saved them or whether the men are sincere. The app-based point missions add a game-like pressure, forcing the heroes to help others, earn rewards, and avoid penalties under tight deadlines. In parallel, workplace and hospital arcs introduce class tension, medical emergencies, and powerful families whose influence threatens to bury the truth. Neel is repeatedly tested in public, sometimes mocked as a conman and sometimes recognized as the only one who can help. His actions expose poisoning, fraud, and other hidden wrongdoing, but each victory also draws more danger toward him. The story widens into crime and revenge when debt, blackmail, and violent enforcers enter the picture. A burned hotel, a raid, and accusations of drugs and cash suggest that corruption runs deeper than anyone first admits. Family loyalty remains a major stake, especially where fathers, daughters, and adopted sons are pulled into suspicion, punishment, or rescue. Supernatural elements continue to surface through healing, black magic accusations, and strange powers that appear during fights and recoveries. Even when romance softens the tone, it rarely stays simple, because marriage demands, jealousy, and competing claims keep disrupting every relationship. By the later stretch, the show balances emotional breakthroughs with escalating threats, as mobility is restored, hidden wealth is noticed, and old enemies keep returning. Overall, the arc is driven by a constant struggle to prove identity, protect loved ones, and survive a world where love, status, and power are all under pressure.

the-trillion-dollar-transfer-student.title: The Trillion Dollar Transfer Student
the-trillion-dollar-transfer-student.description: Emma Hart, murdered alongside her father in a past life, regresses to her transfer day at Aethelgard Academy. Gifted with painful psychometry that reveals objects' hidden histories, she exposes elite conspiracies while battling trauma and sensory overload. With Liam Ashworth as her protector and anchor, Emma dismantles the corrupt Founding Circle, rebuilds her family's legacy, saves her father, and transforms from a hunted victim into a powerful avenger.

the-teen-queen.title: The Teen Queen
the-teen-queen.description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. When billionaire heiress Tanisha Merchant hides her identity to live as an ordinary student, a poor girl, Mahira, is mistaken for the real heiress and embraces the lie. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

the-school-of-gods.title: THE SCHOOL OF GODS
the-school-of-gods.description: At Aethon Hall, condemned gods are stripped of their divinity under a ruthless school program. Oren Vael, the only student who remembers the truth, uncovers a deadly conspiracy where graduation means erasure. As he falls for Sable, the woman he once condemned, they risk everything to defy fate, reclaim their powers, and ignite a war against the force that controls destiny itself.

the-saffron-heiress.title: The Saffron Heiress
the-saffron-heiress.description: Tara begins as a fearless, outspoken woman who refuses to be pushed around, first in a marketplace and then in the orbit of the Kesar family. Her defiance draws her into a much larger conflict when Mr. Kesar reveals that she is his long-lost daughter and names her the rightful heir to his property and majority stake in the empire. That inheritance immediately makes her a target inside the household, where Janvi, Savita, and other insiders try to humiliate her and drive her out. Tara does not back down, and her refusal to accept shame becomes the engine of the story. The conflict deepens when she exposes counterfeit saffron at a formal dinner, showing that the family’s polished image hides serious dishonesty. From there, the struggle moves into Kesar Industries, where fraud, fake invoices, double payments, and suspicious server records point to a wider conspiracy. Vikram repeatedly emerges as Tara’s strongest ally, using evidence, timestamps, and cyber traces to challenge the people trying to frame her. At the same time, Tara is forced to fight for legitimacy in front of the board, which questions her experience and resists her authority. The company’s crisis grows more dangerous when a poisoned saffron export shipment triggers police raids, customs action, and arrests. Tara is arrested and publicly disgraced, but she insists her login was stolen and that she has been framed through a cyber setup. Vikram blocks the arrest from becoming final and pushes for the truth, while Tara is left to endure frozen shares, public humiliation, and threats to her future. The story keeps widening as outside informants, forged evidence, bank transfers, and shell-company trails reveal how carefully the scandal was built. Devika stands out as a fierce rival who attacks Tara’s claim to the empire and refuses to accept her downfall. Rohan is also pulled into the fraud dispute, denied, suspended, and later arrested as the evidence tightens around the inner circle. Even as the corporate war intensifies, Tara’s position shifts from outsider to central authority, and she eventually becomes the controlling power at Kesar Industries. Yet that rise does not end the conflict, because her legitimacy is still challenged and the family rivalry remains unresolved. Karan enters as her bodyguard and protector, but his closeness to Tara adds a quieter emotional tension to the larger battle. By the end of the arc, the immediate scandal has been contained enough for Tara to stand at the center of the empire, but betrayal, revenge, and uncertain loyalties still hang over her.

ash-shayf-al-ghamid.title: Ash-Shayf Al-Ghāmiḍ
ash-shayf-al-ghamid.description: Ash-Shayf Al-Ghāmiḍ -  the mysterious master chef

throne-of-second-chances.title: Throne of Second Chances
throne-of-second-chances.description: Everyone knows Prince Liang as the kingdom's most useless playboy. But after a mysterious twist of fate, a brilliant modern-day soul awakens in his body. Hiding behind the prince's infamous reputation, Liang outsmarts ruthless rivals, survives deadly conspiracies, and turns every insult into a weapon. The fool they laughed at may be the king they were destined to serve.

competitia-tacuta.title: Competiția tăcută
competitia-tacuta.description: The story begins in violence and humiliation, with a street clash over counterfeit medicine that exposes betrayal and unresolved anger. From there, the world widens into a struggle for honor, where family pride, public mockery, and martial ambition shape nearly every conflict. Arvind, Dron, and the Shekhawat clan are drawn into a system where rare talent and special training can change status, but only if the right authority approves it. Baharat and Shika become trapped in a harsh family dispute over separation and divorce, and the pressure on them grows through public tests, secret meetings, and escalating challenges. Baharat refuses to abandon Shika and keeps accepting ordeals meant to break him, including endurance trials and fights against stronger rivals. His bond with Shika remains central, even as others use her fear and loyalty to control him. The martial arena becomes a place of repeated humiliation, where Prashant dominates challengers and tries to force Baharat into submission. Baharat is pushed to fight through pain, but he also begins to reveal hidden strength in front of the crowd. Questions of who deserves to train him, judge him, or claim authority over him become as important as the fights themselves. A mysterious master and rival teachers complicate the power structure, turning personal conflict into a larger struggle over rank and destiny. At one point, Baharat is publicly elevated to a position of authority, while others are humiliated and ordered to serve him, but this does not fully heal the fractures around him. Family resentment, wounded pride, and incomplete reconciliation keep the peace unstable. The conflict then expands into wider status battles involving powerful households, denied family meetings, and threats of forced marriage. Baharat continues to resist submission, even when the cost is separation, punishment, or public disgrace. Shika’s illness and pregnancy raise the emotional stakes and make protection more urgent. Baharat later storms a banquet to demand an audience, but the household treats him as an outsider and turns the gathering hostile. The crowd’s anger escalates into a hunt, and the feud moves toward open violence as he tries to reclaim his wife. By the end of the batch, hostages, humiliation, and authority figures are all being used as leverage, and the struggle remains unresolved. The closing tone suggests that honor, family loyalty, and survival are still locked in a dangerous balance.

silent-rowdy.title: Silent Rowdy
silent-rowdy.description: A legendary warrior hiding behind the identity of an ordinary bodyguard is assigned to protect Kiro, the heiress of a powerful pharmaceutical empire. As ruthless enemies, family betrayal, and corporate conspiracies close in, Zhang Hao must keep his true past hidden while risking everything to save the woman he swore to protect. Action, romance, and shocking secrets collide in a battle where nothing is as it seems.

almelarder-alsre.title: Almelarder Alsre
almelarder-alsre.description: بيليونير على الطائرة - Billionaire on Plane

cruel-attraction.title: Cruel Attraction
cruel-attraction.description: After being framed and imprisoned for a crime she didn't commit, Chandni returns home determined to find her missing younger sister. Forced into a dangerous deal with the notorious playboy Luv Rathore, she agrees to seduce his golden-boy brother Kush as part of a revenge scheme. But as buried secrets surface, Chandni discovers that one brother may be the villain everyone loves—and the other may be the devil willing to save her.

ஜோடி-பொருத்தம்.title: ஜோடி பொருத்தம்
ஜோடி-பொருத்தம்.description: ரவியும் அரவிந்தும் சிறந்த நண்பர்கள். அரவிந்த் வேலை தேடும் வாலிபன். அவனுக்கு ரவி மூலம் வேலை கிடைக்கிறது. அரவிந்த வேலை கிடைத்த சந்தோஷத்தில் கோவிலுக்கு செல்கிறான். அங்கு அகல்யாவை சந்திக்கிறான், அவள்மீது காதல் வசப்படுகிறான் அதை வெளிப்படுத்தி கொள்ளாமல், இருக்கின்றான். முதல் சந்திப்பிலே இருவருக்கும் மோதல் ஏற்பட்டுவிடுகிறது. இவர்கள் இருவரையும் இணைக்க ரவி செய்யபோகும் நிகழ்வே ஜோடி பொருத்தம்...

veeradi-veera.title: Veeradi Veera
veeradi-veera.description: ఒకప్పుడు శక్తివంతమైన శూరవీరుడైన ఓ వ్యక్తి, కొన్ని కారణాల వల్ల పంక్చర్ షాప్ పెట్టుకుని సాధారణ జీవితం గడుపుతుంటాడు. అతని ప్రపంచమంతా తన కూతురే. కానీ ఆమెను నాలుగు శక్తివంతమైన కుటుంబాలు టార్గెట్ చేయడంతో, తన కూతురిని కాపాడేందుకు మళ్లీ తన పాత అవతారంలోకి అడుగుపెడతాడు. అయితే అతను తిరిగి శూరవీరుడిగా మారిన క్షణమే, కొన్ని దుష్ట శక్తులు కలిసి ఓ మహాయుద్ధానికి తెరతీస్తాయి.

cholavamsa-veeranganai.title: Cholavamsa Veeranganai
cholavamsa-veeranganai.description:
தந்தையை காப்பாற்ற ஒரு வீரப் பெண், ஆணாக மாறி சோழப் படையில் இணைகிறாள்.
தன் தந்தையை சிக்க வைத்த சதிகாரர்களின் ரகசியத்தை கண்டுபிடிக்க எதிரிகளின் நடுவே ஊடுருவுகிறாள். மரபு, துரோகம், ஆபத்தான எதிரிகளை எதிர்த்து நீதிக்காக போராடுகிறாள். அவளது வீரப் பயணம் சோழர்களின் முதல் பெண் போர்வீராங்கனையாக அவளை உருவாக்குகிறது.

virigina-manasu.title: Virigina Manasu
virigina-manasu.description: ఏడేళ్ల క్రితం జరిగిన ఓ విషాదకరమైన పెళ్లి వారి ప్రేమను ద్వేషంగా మార్చేస్తుంది. తల్లి మరణానికి భార్యే కారణమని నమ్మిన భర్త, ఆమెను ఏళ్ల తరబడి శిక్షిస్తుంటాడు. కానీ ఆమె ప్రాణాంతకమైన క్యాన్సర్‌తో పోరాడుతూ, తనకు మిగిలిన రోజులను కూడా అతనిని కాపాడటానికే నిశ్శబ్దంగా త్యాగం చేస్తోందని అతనికి తెలియదు.

wake-the-heir.title: Wake the Heir
wake-the-heir.description: தந்தையின் ஆயிரக்கணக்கான கோடி கடனை அடைத்து குடும்பத்தையும் நிறுவனத்தையும் காப்பாற்ற, கோமாவில் இருக்கும் தொழிலதிபர் கார்த்திக்கை திருமணம் செய்ய சம்மதிக்கிறாள் நிலா. ஆனால் ஒரு தியாகமாக தொடங்கிய அந்தத் திருமணம், கார்த்திக்கின் குடும்பத்துக்குள் பதுங்கியிருக்கும் சதி, எதிரிகள் மற்றும் உயிருக்கு ஆபத்தான மர்மங்களை எதிர்கொள்ளும் போராட்டமாக மாறுகிறது.

the-marriage-trap.title: The Marriage Trap
the-marriage-trap.description: தன் மகன் திருமணம் செய்யப் போகும் பெண்ணின் உண்மையான குணத்தை அறிய, நாட்டின் மிகப்பெரிய தொழிலதிபர் ஒருவர் ஏழை முதியவராக மாறுவேடம் போட்டு அவளைச் சோதிக்கிறார். ஆனால் அந்தச் சோதனையில், மருமகளின் இரட்டை முகத்துக்குப் பின்னால் தன் குடும்பத்தையும் தொழில் சாம்ராஜ்யத்தையும் அழிக்கத் திட்டமிடும் அதிர்ச்சிகரமான சதி இருப்பதை கண்டுபிடிக்கிறார்

married-to-a-beggar.title: Married to a Beggar
married-to-a-beggar.description: திருமண மேடையில் ஏமாற்றப்பட்ட ஷ்ருதி, தனது மரியாதையை காப்பாற்ற ஒரு பிச்சைக்காரனை திருமணம் செய்கிறாள். ஆனால் அவர் வேடமிட்டிருக்கும் கோடீஸ்வரர் என்பதை அறியாமல், இருவரும் துரோகம், சொத்து சதி, குடும்ப விரோதம் ஆகியவற்றை எதிர்கொண்டு உண்மையான காதலை கண்டுபிடிக்கிறார்கள்.

code-of-love.title: Code of Love
code-of-love.description: லவ் அல்காரிதம் என்பது ஒருதலைக் காதல், தியாகம், கார்ப்பரேட் உலகம் மற்றும் உண்மையான அன்பின் மதிப்பை பேசும் உணர்வுப்பூர்வமான காதல் நாடகம். உலகத் தரம் வாய்ந்த ஏஐ இன்ஜினியராக உயரக்கூடிய திறமை இருந்தும், தன் காதலியான நிலாவின் நிழலாக வாழ சூர்யா தனது கனவுகளைத் தியாகம் செய்கிறான். ஆனால், அவனது அன்பை அறியாத நிலா, தனது முன்னாள் காதலன் அருணின் வார்த்தைகளில் சிக்கிக் கொள்கிறாள். உண்மையான அன்புக்கும், பொய்யான முகமூடிக்கும் இடையே நடக்கும் இந்தப் போராட்டத்தில், யார் நிலாவின் இதயத்தை வெல்வார்கள்.

the-heirs-revenge.title: The Heir’s Revenge
the-heirs-revenge.description: டாக்ஸி கிங் என்பது மர்மம், அதிரடி, பழிவாங்குதல் மற்றும் மறைக்கப்பட்ட அடையாளங்களை மையமாகக் கொண்ட சஸ்பென்ஸ் திரில்லர். மும்பையில் சாதாரண டாக்ஸி டிரைவராக வாழும் ஸ்ரீதர், உண்மையில் தனது தாயின் கொலைக்குப் பின்னால் இருக்கும் குற்றவாளிகளை ரகசியமாக வேட்டையாடும் கோடீஸ்வர வாரிசு. நினைவிழந்த ஒரு இளம் பெண்ணைக் காப்பாற்றிய பிறகு, இருவரும் நாட்டையே அதிரவைக்கும் சதியின் மையத்தில் சிக்கிக் கொள்கிறார்கள்.

the-accidental-wife.title: The Accidental Wife
the-accidental-wife.description: தி ஸ்வீப்பர் பில்லியனர் என்பது அடையாளம் மறைத்த கோடீஸ்வரன், அனாதைப் பெண், எதிர்பாராத திருமணம், காதல், குடும்பம் மற்றும் அதிகார மோதல்களை மையமாகக் கொண்ட உணர்வுப்பூர்வமான காதல் குடும்ப நாடகம். நிச்சயதார்த்தத்திலிருந்து தப்பிக்க துப்புரவுத் தொழிலாளியாக மாறும் அர்ஜுன், ஆபத்தில் சிக்கிய நிலாவைக் காப்பாற்றும் சூழ்நிலையில் அவளது கழுத்தில் தாலி கட்ட நேரிடுகிறது. ஒரு போலி திருமணமாகத் தொடங்கிய உறவு, விதி எழுதிய உண்மையான வாழ்க்கைப் பயணமாக மாறுகிறது.

kaadhal-kaditham.title: Kaadhal Kaditham
kaadhal-kaditham.description: ஒருவரையொருவர் யார் என்றே தெரியாமல், பழைய நூலகப் புத்தகத்தில் மறைத்து வைக்கப்படும் காதல் கடிதங்கள் மூலம் காதலில் விழுகிறாள் ஒரு பணக்கார இளம் பெண். அவளின் மறுமுனைக் காதலன் ஒரு சாதாரண மெக்கானிக் என்பதை அறியாத நிலையில், குடும்ப அந்தஸ்து, திருமண அழுத்தம், பழைய காதலின் வலி என பல தடைகள் அவர்களின் காதலைப் பிரிக்க முயல்கின்றன. இறுதியில் அந்த முகமறியாத காதலன் யார் என்பது தெரியவரும் போது, குடும்பம் தேர்ந்தெடுத்த வாழ்க்கையா… அல்லது கடிதங்களில் பிறந்த உண்மையான காதலா

nizhal-vaarthai.title: Nizhal Vaarthai
nizhal-vaarthai.description: கணவர் அருணின் திடீர் மரணத்தால் வாழ்க்கையே சிதைந்துபோன கவிதா, பிரபல மனநல மருத்துவரிடம் சிகிச்சை பெறத் தொடங்குகிறாள். ஆனால் மர்மமான எச்சரிக்கைகள், நினைவிழக்கும் தருணங்கள், சந்தேகத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும் தெரபி அமர்வுகள் ஆகியவை, அவள் நம்பிய ஒவ்வொருவரையும் கேள்விக்குறியாக மாற்றுகின்றன. உண்மைக்கும் பொய்க்கும் இடையில் சிக்கிய கவிதா, தனது கணவரின் மரணத்திற்குப் பின்னால் இருக்கும் அதிர்ச்சிகரமான சதியையும், மனித மனதை ஆயுதமாக பயன்படுத்தும் குற்றவலையையும் எதிர்கொள்கிறாள்.

viplava-veerudu-alluri-sitaramaraju.title: Viplava Veerudu Alluri Sitaramaraju
viplava-veerudu-alluri-sitaramaraju.description: అల్లూరి సీతారామరాజు — నిజమైన జాతీయ విప్లవకారుడు. ఎం.వి.ఆర్.శాస్త్రి ఈ పుస్తకంలో అల్లూరి పోరాటాన్ని జాతీయ కోణంలో విశ్లేషించారు. చారిత్రక ఆనవాళ్ల అన్వేషణ, అపరిష్కృత ప్రశ్నలు, బ్రిటిష్ సామ్రాజ్యాన్ని సవాలు చేసిన వీరుని నిజమైన చరిత్రను వెలుగులోకి తెచ్చే అద్భుతమైన రచన!

udhayabanu-maamazhai.title: Udhayabanu  Maamazhai
udhayabanu-maamazhai.description: 1001 CE — சோழ தண்டநாயகர் மழபாடியார் ஆதித்த கரிகாலரின் கொலை மர்மத்தை துலக்க இடைமருதில் பயணிக்கிறார். சேர நாட்டில் சதிகாரர்கள் மீண்டும் திட்டமிடுகின்றனர். விசுவாசம், துரோகம், பழிவாங்கல் — சோழ சேர பாண்டிய மண்டலங்களில் விரியும் "உதயபானு — மாமழை

ambareesh-1.title: Ambareesh
ambareesh-1.description: ಖಳನಾಯಕನಿಂದ ನಾಯಕನಾಗಿ, ರಾಜಕಾರಣಿಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಅಂಬರೀಷ್ ಅವರ ವರ್ಣರಂಜಿತ ಜೀವನಚರಿತ್ರೆ. ಡಾ. ಶರಣು ಹುಲ್ಲೂರು ರಚಿಸಿದ ಈ ಕೃತಿ — ಲಿಕ್ಕರ್ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಿಂದ ಸೆಲ್ಯುಲಾಯ್ಡ್ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿದ ಅವರ ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ ಪಯಣವನ್ನು ಸ್ವಾರಸ್ಯಕರವಾಗಿ ತೆರೆದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ!

mouna-sammadham.title: Mouna sammadham
mouna-sammadham.description: A week before their wedding, software engineer Nandhini and her fiancé Aravind mysteriously disappear on their way to a temple. As Inspector Meera investigates, she uncovers a deadly corporate conspiracy where silence isn't acceptance—it's survival.

parthiban-kanavu-3.title: Parthiban Kanavu
parthiban-kanavu-3.description: ஒரு காலம் பேரரசாக விளங்கிய சோழப் பேரரசு பல்லவர்களுக்கு அடிமையானது. சோழ அரசன் பார்த்திபன் தன் மகன் விக்கிரமனுக்கு இழந்த பெருமையை மீட்க உத்வேகம் அளிக்கிறான். அந்த கனவை நிறைவேற்றும் விக்கிரமனின் சாகசக் கதையே கல்கியின் அமர காவியம் — "பார்த்திபன் கனவு"!

the-missing-month.title: The Missing Month
the-missing-month.description: After surviving a horrific accident, billionaire Raghav wakes up with 38 days erased from his memory—only to discover he is the prime suspect in a high-profile political murder. As he races to recover his missing month, every clue uncovers a darker conspiracy where someone has stolen not just his identity, but his entire life.

reels-shorts-entertainment-or-addiction.title: Reels & Shorts: Entertainment or Addiction?
reels-shorts-entertainment-or-addiction.description: Millions spend hours scrolling through Reels and Shorts every day. But while some people are losing time, others are building careers and businesses from the same platforms. This show explores both sides of the short-form content revolution.

ammavin-kaadhalan.title: Ammavin Kaadhalan
ammavin-kaadhalan.description: 20 வயதான யாழினி, தான் காதலிக்கும் ஆதவனை தனது அம்மா லலிதாவிடம் அறிமுகப்படுத்துகிறாள். ஆனால் ஆதவனை பார்த்த அந்த நொடியில், இருபது ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன் தன் முதல் காதலை மீண்டும் பார்த்த அதிர்ச்சியில் லலிதாவின் உலகமே தலைகீழாகிறது. கடந்த காலத்தின் காதலும், நிகழ்காலத்தின் காதலும் ஒரே மனிதனைச் சுற்றி பின்னிப் பிணைய, பல ஆண்டுகளாக புதைக்கப்பட்ட உண்மைகள் வெளிவரத் தொடங்குகின்றன. யாழினி யார் என்பதை ஆதவனுக்கு ஏற்கனவே தெரிந்திருந்ததா, இல்லை இது வெறும் தற்செயலா?

oru-dalit-yuvathiyude-kadana-katha-1.title: Oru Dalit Yuvathiyude kadana Katha
oru-dalit-yuvathiyude-kadana-katha-1.description: സ്കൂൾ ഓഫ് ഡ്രാമയിൽ ദളിത് യുവതിയുടെ അവമാനം റിയലിസ്റ്റിക്കായി അവതരിപ്പിക്കാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന കരീംബോയി — ആ വേഷം ചെയ്യാൻ ആളെ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നത് ഒരു വലിയ വെല്ലുവിളി. രാധിക വിസമ്മതിക്കുന്നു, ഒടുവിൽ വസുന്ധര സ്വമനസ്സാലേ എത്തുന്നു — ആർട്ടും ധൈര്യവും ഒന്നിക്കുന്ന കഥ!

nuvve-kaadu-1.title: Nuvve Kaadu
nuvve-kaadu-1.description: మానవ సంబంధాలలో డబ్బు పాత్ర, దురాశ మరియు అవినీతి — ఇవే "నువ్వే కాదు" నవల మూల స్తంభాలు. డబ్బు వ్యక్తుల జీవితాలను, అనుబంధాలను ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుందో, నైతిక విలువలు ఎలా కోల్పోతాయో శక్తివంతంగా చిత్రించిన నవల!

sir-m-vishvesvariah.title: Sir M. Vishvesvariah
sir-m-vishvesvariah.description: ಸರ್ ಎಂ. ವಿಶ್ವೇಶ್ವರಯ್ಯ — ಭಾರತದ ಮಹಾನ್ ಸಿವಿಲ್ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್, ರಾಜಕಾರಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮೈಸೂರಿನ 19ನೇ ದಿವಾನ್. 1912-1919ರ ವರೆಗೆ ಮೈಸೂರು ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ನೀಡಿದ ಈ ದಾರ್ಶನಿಕ ನಾಯಕನ ಕಿರು ಜೀವನಚರಿತ್ರೆ!

irandhavanin-tholaipesi.title: Irandhavanin Tholaipesi
irandhavanin-tholaipesi.description: சாலை விபத்தில் இறந்ததாக கருதப்பட்ட தனது கணவரின் வங்கி கணக்கிலிருந்து மூன்று மாதங்கள் கழித்து பணப்பரிவர்த்தனை அறிவிப்பு வருகிறது. அந்த ஒரு Notification-ஐத் தொடர்ந்து தொடங்கும் தேடல், பல கோடி ரூபாய் நிதி மோசடி, துரோகம் மற்றும் கொலையின் பின்னால் மறைந்திருக்கும் அதிர்ச்சி உண்மையை வெளிச்சத்துக்குக் கொண்டு வருகிறது.

ellara-mane-dose.title: Ellara Mane Dose
ellara-mane-dose.description: ಮಣಿಪಾಲ್ ವೈದ್ಯ ಡಾ. ವಿರೂಪಾಕ್ಷ ದೇವರಮನೆ ಅವರ ಜೀವನಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿಯ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಸಂಕಲನ. ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ, ಅನುಭವಿಸಿದ ಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಥೆಯ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಲ್ಟ್ರಾಸೌಂಡ್ ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನಿಂಗ್‌ನಂತೆ ನಮ್ಮೊಳಗನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುವ ಅಪೂರ್ವ ಕೃತಿ — ಏಕಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಕಿಟಕಿಯೂ, ಕನ್ನಡಿಯೂ!

kasturba-gandhi.title: Kasturba Gandhi
kasturba-gandhi.description: ಕಸ್ತೂರ್ಬಾ ಗಾಂಧಿ — ಮಹಾತ್ಮ ಗಾಂಧಿಯವರ ಜೀವನ ಸಂಗಾತಿ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟದ ಧೀರ ಕಾರ್ಯಕರ್ತೆ. ಈ ಕಿರು ಜೀವನಚರಿತ್ರೆ ಅವರ ತ್ಯಾಗ, ಸೇವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಚಲ ನಿಷ್ಠೆಯ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ನಮ್ಮ ಮುಂದೆ ತೆರೆದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ!

setril-manitharkal.title: Setril Manitharkal
setril-manitharkal.description: நாட்டின் முதுகெலும்பான விவசாயி — இன்று என்ன நிலையில் இருக்கிறார்? ராஜம் கிருஷ்ணன் இந்நாவலில் விவசாயிகளின் கடின வாழ்க்கை, நிலச்சுவந்தார்களின் சுரண்டல், மதம்-சாதி என்ற சங்கிலிகளால் பிணைக்கப்பட்ட அவலநிலையை சக்தியான படிமங்களால் சித்தரித்துள்ளார்!

en-kanavanin-kuzhandhai.title: En Kanavanin Kuzhandhai
en-kanavanin-kuzhandhai.description: திருமண நாளிலேயே, கர்ப்பிணியான ஒரு பெண் தனது வயிற்றில் வளரும் குழந்தைக்கு கார்த்திக்கே தந்தை என்று கூற, நித்யாவின் வாழ்க்கை தலைகீழாக மாறுகிறது. உண்மை வெளிவரும் வரை ஒரே வீட்டில் வாழ வேண்டிய சூழலில், மறைக்கப்பட்ட ரகசியங்களும் அதிர்ச்சி உண்மைகளும் ஒன்றன்பின் ஒன்றாக வெளிவருகின்றன. இறுதியில், உண்மையைச் சொல்வது யார் என்ற கேள்வியே அனைவரையும் துரத்துகிறது.

ninaivai-nee.title: Ninaivai Nee
ninaivai-nee.description: ஆறு மாதங்களாக ஒரே மர்மக் கனவால் துன்பப்படும் திருமணமான கார்த்திக், அதே கனவை காணும் மாயாவை நிஜத்தில் சந்திக்கிறார். இருவரும் சேர்ந்து தேடத் தொடங்கும் உண்மை, கடந்த ஜென்மக் காதல், கொலை மர்மம், மறுபிறவி, மற்றும் காலத்தை வென்ற ஆத்ம பந்தத்தை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு கொண்டு வருகிறது.

srilanka-mein-dussehra-kya-hai-sach.title: Sri Lanka Mein Dussehra - Kya Hai Sach?

bangarwadi.title: Bangarwadi
bangarwadi.description: एक तरुण उत्साही शिक्षक बनगरवाडी या छोट्याशा गावात शिक्षणाचा प्रसार करण्यासाठी येतो. पण तिथल्या साध्या-भोळ्या माणसांकडून त्याला आयुष्याचे खरे धडे मिळतात. शिक्षण देण्यास आलेला शिक्षक स्वतःच खूप काही शिकून जातो — एक हृदयस्पर्शी मराठी कथा!

kaanaamal-pona-episode.title: Kaanaamal pona Episode
kaanaamal-pona-episode.description:
ஆல் இந்தியா ரேடியோவில் பணிபுரியும் ஆதவன், 1976-ல் காணாமல் போன ஒரு பழைய ஒலிப்பதிவை தேடத் தொடங்குகிறான்.
அந்த தேடல், பல ஆண்டுகளாக மறைக்கப்பட்ட சாதி வன்முறை மற்றும் அரசியல் சதிகளை வெளிக்கொணர்கிறது. அந்த காணாமல் போன ஒலிப்பதிவில் என்ன ரகசியம் மறைந்திருக்கிறது? ஆதவனின் குடும்பத்துடன் அதற்கு என்ன தொடர்பு? உண்மை வெளிவந்தால் யாருடைய முகமூடி கிழியும்?

art-of-winning-the-chanakya-way.title: Art of Winning - The Chanakya Way

andha-kadaisi-seat.title: Andha Kadaisi Seat
andha-kadaisi-seat.description: ஒவ்வொரு வெள்ளிக்கிழமை நள்ளிரவும், ஒரு மர்மமான பெண் பேருந்தின் கடைசி இருக்கையில் தோன்றுகிறாள். அவள் அருகில் அமர்பவர்கள் சில நாட்களுக்குள் மரணமடைய, கண்டக்டர் செல்வம் அதற்கான காரணத்தை தேட ஆரம்பிக்கிறார். ஆனால் அந்த பெண் தேடுவது உண்மையையா... இல்லை செல்வத்தையா?

dhurandhar-sniper-3.title: Dhurandhar Sniper
dhurandhar-sniper-3.description: For a year, Rohan has been known only as a simple cleaner at a shooting academy. No one knows he is actually G-9, the deadliest sniper. After losing his mentor, he left his past behind, but when the academy, an innocent child, and a family come under threat, he is forced to pick up the gun again. Now every shot becomes a choice - keep his identity hidden or reveal the truth to the world.

mann-mein-hain-vishwas.title: Mann mein hain Vishwas
mann-mein-hain-vishwas.description: पोलीस अधिकारी विश्वास नांगरे पाटील यांनी 'मन में है विश्वास' मध्ये स्वतःला मोकळेपणाने व्यक्त केले आहे. कुटुंब, समाज आणि नात्यांची प्रत्ययकारी पुनर्तपासणी करत लिहिलेलं हे आत्मकथन वाचकाला लेखकाच्या प्रगल्भ मनाची खोल ओळख करून देते!

vanadeviyin-maindhargal-1.title: Vanadeviyin Maindhargal
vanadeviyin-maindhargal-1.description: முடிசூட்டிய பின்னும் கருவுற்ற சீதையை கானகத்தில் விட்டதா ராமன்? ஊர்க்குரலுக்கு பயந்து செய்த இந்த நாடுகடத்தல் நியாயமா? ராஜம் கிருஷ்ணனின் "வனதேவியின் மைந்தர்கள்" சீதையின் கதையை வேறொரு கோணத்தில் நம்மிடம் கொண்டு வருகிறது — கேள்விகள் எழுப்பி, மனசாட்சியை உலுக்கி!

goyenda-indranath-rudra-samagra-2.title: Goyenda Indranath Rudra Samagra 2
goyenda-indranath-rudra-samagra-2.description: গোয়েন্দা ইন্দ্রনাথ রুদ্র — ইটালিয়ান ভাস্কর্যের মতো সুদর্শন, বজ্রকঠিন ব্যক্তিত্বের অধিকারী। নরম হাসির আড়ালে লুকিয়ে বিদ্যুৎগতি বুদ্ধি আর অব্যর্থ লক্ষ্যভেদ। অদৃশ বর্ধনের কলমে জীবন্ত হয়ে ওঠা এই রহস্যময় গোয়েন্দার দ্বিতীয় সমগ্রে অপেক্ষা করছে রোমাঞ্চকর অ্যাডভেঞ্চার!

the-moonfire-throne.title: The Moonfire Throne
the-moonfire-throne.description: A peaceful village is wiped out in a single night, leaving Elara Veyne as the only survivor. Before dying, her parents entrust her with a crescent-moon pendant and warn her never to remove it. When deadly creatures hunt her again, she crosses paths with the feared Lycan King, Kael. As buried secrets resurface, Elara discovers her blood holds an ancient power that could challenge the Lycan throne and reignite a war thought long buried.

aangal-illaadha-graamam.title: Aangal illaadha graamam
aangal-illaadha-graamam.description: ஆண்கள் யாரும் இல்லாத ஒரு மர்ம கிராமத்திற்குச் செல்லும் பத்திரிகையாளர் நவீன், பல ஆண்டுகளாக பெண்கள் அனைவரும் சேர்ந்து மறைத்து வைத்திருக்கும் பயங்கரமான உண்மையைத் தேடும் ஆபத்தான விசாரணையில் சிக்கிக்கொள்கிறார்.

mathorubagan.title: Mathorubagan
