mathorubagan.description: குழந்தைப்பேறின்மையால் சமூக விலக்கத்திற்கு உள்ளான பொன்னாவும் காளியும் — இருவரின் உறவும் வலியும் இந்நாவலின் ஆன்மா. இருபதாம் நூற்றாண்டு நடுப்பகுதியில் நடைபெறும் இக்கதை, சமூக விதிகளையும் விதிமீறல்களையும் ஆழமாக அலசுகிறது. தடை கோரிக்கைகளையும் தாண்டி உலக வாசகரை வென்ற அசாதாரண நாவல்!

uyirin-vilai.title: Uyirin Vilai
uyirin-vilai.description: சாதாரண அறுவை சிகிச்சையில் இளம் மாணவி மர்மமாக உயிரிழந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து, மருத்துவர் கவின் ஒரு அதிர்ச்சி உண்மையை கண்டுபிடிக்கிறார். நோயாளிகளின் உயிரை வைத்து சட்டவிரோத மருந்து பரிசோதனை நடத்தும் பல ஆயிரம் கோடி ரூபாய் மருத்துவ மாஃபியாவுக்கு எதிராக அவர் தொடுக்கும் போராட்டமே உயிரின் விலை.

endrum-ilamai.title: Endrum Ilamai
endrum-ilamai.description: மீரா நூறு ஆண்டுகளாக வயதே ஆகாமல் வாழும் மர்மமான பெண். அவளை காதலிக்கும் ஒவ்வொருவரும் மர்மமான முறையில் உயிரிழக்க, அவளின் வாழ்க்கையை ஆராய வந்த அர்ஜுன் அவளையே காதலிக்கத் தொடங்குகிறான். ஆனால் மீராவின் அழியாத இளமைக்கும் அந்த சாபத்திற்கும் பின்னால் இருக்கும் உண்மை என்ன?

mathilukal-1.title: Mathilukal
mathilukal-1.description: ബ്രിട്ടീഷുകാര്‍ക്കെതിരെ എഴുതിയെന്ന കുറ്റത്തിന് തടവിലാക്കപ്പെട്ട ബഷീറിന്റെ ജയിലനുഭവമാണ് മതിലുകള്‍. മതിലിനപ്പുറത്തെ സ്ത്രീതടവുകാരുടെ ജയിലിൽ താൻ കണ്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്ത നാരായണിയുമായുള്ള ബഷീറിന്റെ പ്രണയത്തിലൂടെ മലയാളനോവല്‍ അതുവരെ പരിചയിക്കാത്ത പ്രണയത്തിന്റെ ചെറുമഴകളെ അനുഭവിപ്പിക്കുകയായിരുന്നു ബഷീര്‍.

vishwas-ghatakder-jonye-1.title: Vishwas Ghatakder Jonye
vishwas-ghatakder-jonye-1.description: সাহিত্য সম্মেলনে যোগ দিতে এসে বন্ধ ঘরে খুন হয়ে গেলেন মহিলা সাংবাদিক দেবারতি মানি, কিন্তু কেন, একজন সাংবাদিক এর প্রতি কার এমন কি আক্রোশ থাকতে পারে যার জেরে তাকে পৃথিবী থেকে সরিয়ে ফেলা হলো, কারা বা কে আছে এর পেছনে, উপন্যাসের অধিকাংশ চরিত্র রহস্য গল্পের লেখক লেখিকা, গোয়েন্দা অশোকচন্দ্র গুপ্ত খুনের তদন্তে নেমে অনেকের নাম কেই তালিকা ভুক্ত করেন, শেষ অবধি কি অশোকচন্দ্র গুপ্ত এই 'লকড রুম' এর রহস্যের কিনারা করতে পারবে , খুনি কি বাইরের কেউ নাকি সম্মেলনে যোগ দিতে আসা লেখক লেখিকা দেরিই কেউ?

behind-closed-doors-rajneeti-aur-apradh.title: Behind Closed Doors: Rajneeti Aur Apradh

akhari-atidhi-1.title: AKHARI ATIDHI
akhari-atidhi-1.description: In 'Akhari Atidhi' (The Final Guest), writer Malladi Venkata Krishna Murthy portrays death as an inevitable final visitor. While ordinary people meet death just once, Dr. Srijith faces the impossible: he encounters this ultimate guest multiple times over the course of three bizarre days. Blending thrilling fiction, fantasy, and intense suspense, this gripping, emotional tale takes readers on a mind-bending journey through Srijith's extraordinary experiences. It will surely move you.

prachina-bharatadesa-charitra-1.title: Prachina Bharatadesa Charitra
prachina-bharatadesa-charitra-1.description: భారతీయ చరిత్రకు శాస్త్రీయ దృక్పథం అందించిన ప్రఖ్యాత చరిత్రకారుడు డి.డి.కోశాంబిని పరిచయం చేస్తూ కె.బాలగోపాల్ రచించిన విలువైన గ్రంథమిది. చరిత్రను కేవలం వాస్తవాలుగా కాకుండా విశ్లేషణాత్మకంగా అర్థం చేసుకోవాలనే ఆలోచనాపరుల కోసం అద్భుతమైన రచన!

rajneeti-no-khel.title: Rajneeti No Khel
rajneeti-no-khel.description: Devgarh ma corruption, power ane politics vachche Aditya Pratap Singh sharu kare chhe nyay ni jang. Prem, dhokho ane shocking secrets vachche shu satya ni jeet thashe? Darek episode ma navo twist tamne bandhayi rakhse.

sold-to-the-djinn.title: Sold to the Djinn
sold-to-the-djinn.description: Forced into a five-year contract marriage to inherit her family's empire, a billionaire heiress discovers that her mysterious husband is an immortal Djinn whose love could rewrite her destiny.

vimaanamlo-aadapilla.title: Vimaanamlo Aadapilla
vimaanamlo-aadapilla.description: An innocent girl travelling to attend her brother’s wedding is humiliated in a flight by the bride’s arrogant family, who mistake her for his mistress. When her true identity as the billionaire groom’s sister is revealed, the wedding turns into a storm of revenge, justice and shocking betrayal.

the-fallen-hero.title: The Fallen Hero
the-fallen-hero.description: A mysterious homeless man, Ken, saves struggling single mother Su Yue and her daughter from ruthless gangsters. Unknown to everyone, he is the legendary "Mad Dog," a fallen war hero hiding from his past. As he takes on the corrupt King of the South to protect the innocent and uncover the truth behind his betrayed army, love, redemption, and justice collide.

veruthe-oru-barthaavu.title: Veruthe oru 'Barthaavu'
veruthe-oru-barthaavu.description: The story begins with nervous anticipation around first meetings, family teasing, and immediate romantic tension, but it quickly turns into rejection and humiliation. Purnima/Porni’s hopes are shaken when Rohan refuses the marriage, leaving her devastated and forcing her to face public shame. At the same time, Deva is pushed by family and business pressure into arrangements he does not fully want, and romance starts to look like obligation. A temporary marriage is formed under public strain, and what begins as a practical arrangement slowly becomes emotionally real as the couple shares space and support. Even then, the relationship remains unstable because contracts, settlement demands, and outside interference keep turning private life into a battleground. Class conflict and public ridicule repeatedly surface in malls, restaurants, offices, and wedding settings, exposing how status and money are used to shame people. Poornima’s past abandonment and distrust of wealthy people deepen the emotional conflict, making trust harder to build. Deva’s kindness, protection, and remembered gestures suggest a bond growing beneath the tension, even as rivals and relatives keep testing it. Workplace scenes add another layer of pressure, with Poornima humiliated on her first day before the boss protects her and gives her a chance to stand on her own. Jealousy and rumor then spread through the office and family circles, threatening reputations and pulling old relationships back into the open. Rohan continues to challenge Poornima’s marriage and feelings, while Deva repeatedly steps in to defend her and warn him off. Family members, especially controlling mothers and an aunt, try to dictate who should love whom and what marriage should mean. Devika’s presence and the talk of divorce, future brides, and legal status make the marriage conflict even more bitter and public. The story grows darker when the conflict reaches hospital crisis, where a critically ill child and a pregnancy create an impossible choice. In that moment, compassion, duty, and survival collide, and the heroine is forced to weigh one life against another. The final stretch adds both hope and danger: a pregnancy is revealed with joy, family support briefly softens the mood, and news arrives that Devika has been caught by police. Across the whole arc, love is never simple; it is constantly tested by pride, class, coercion, legal ties, and the fear of losing family, status, or the people they care about.

mafia-mogudu.title: Mafia Mogudu
mafia-mogudu.description: Raghuram, a humble cleaner and waiter, secretly lives as The Ghost, a billionaire controlling a powerful business empire. When young CEO Shivani enters his life through a contract marriage, his hidden identity, father-son emotion, corporate enemies and shocking power reveals turn their relationship into a mass revenge drama.

desii-boy.title: Desii Boy!!
desii-boy.description: Munna’s story begins with village pride being carried into bigger public spaces, where local talent is first celebrated and then repeatedly tested against elite judgment. A message from Mumbai opens the door for rural performers and craftsmen to step into fashion events, airports, and other high-status arenas. Munna emerges as a charismatic village figure whose confidence, devotional spirit, and rustic style make him impossible to ignore. But each time he enters an urban setting, he is mocked for his background, manners, food, language, or appearance. The humiliation is not only social; it also becomes practical, with threats of removal, police action, and public embarrassment. Even so, Munna keeps answering with calm defiance, and at times hidden backing or official recognition suddenly shifts the balance in his favor. Several confrontations revolve around travel and flight, where rural outsiders are belittled until a ministerial call, a rescue, or a storm landing exposes their courage and usefulness. The conflict widens into fashion and cultural debates, where village craft is set against money, status, and foreign swagger. Kiara becomes an important presence in this world, sometimes defending Munna and sometimes linking him to a deeper village past. Naina also stays near him in the elite spaces, helping manage the embarrassment that follows him. As Munna’s visibility grows, so does suspicion, and rivals try to discredit him through accusations, staged traps, and social-media pressure. False claims of misconduct and fraud turn crowds into weapons, showing how quickly public opinion can be manipulated. Yet Munna continues to insist that he represents desi talent, labor, and authenticity rather than empty hype. The shahi kapda and other symbols of heritage become central proof in the struggle over what is real and valuable. Family support, especially from his mother and the memory of his father, gives emotional weight to his fight. By the end of the batch, the conflict has moved from simple humiliation to a larger battle over identity, legitimacy, and who gets to define success. The final note is one of partial victory and ongoing tension: local skill is recognized, but the losers resist, and the social contest is clearly not over.

theeratha-vilaiyatttu-pillai-returns.title: Theeratha Vilaiyatttu Pillai Returns
theeratha-vilaiyatttu-pillai-returns.description: After a five-year prison sentence for a crime he didn’t commit, a betrayed delivery boy discovers a mysterious device that multiplies his wealth a hundredfold for every act of genuine kindness he shows. Now armed with limitless power, he embarks on a complex journey to reclaim his life while navigating the entangled hearts of four powerful women who find in him the authenticity they’ve been missing.

biwi-no-3.title: Biwi No. 3
biwi-no-3.description: When small-town beauty parlour stylist Charu, sneaks to Mumbai for the funeral of her secretly-married childhood love Mohit, she discovers that he had two other wives. Now, Mohit’s struggling lawyer best friend Tejas needs to find out who the “real wife” is before Mohit’s massive inheritance goes to the wrong woman.

love-war-30.title: Love War 3.0
love-war-30.description:
ஒரு கேம். ஒரு வின். நூறு கோடி கேஸ் ப்ரைஸ். 
நீ ஒரு லூசர் கேமர்டான்னு கலட்டி விட்ட லவ்வர் முன்னாடி ஜெயிச்சு காட்ட, உயிரயே பணயம் வச்சு ரிஸ்க் எடுக்குறான் ரேயன். ரேயன் எடுத்த ரிஸ்க் என்ன? அவனுக்கு அந்த நூறு கோடி கிடைச்சுதா?

moonam-uzham.title: Moonam Uzham
moonam-uzham.description: The story centers on a family and company crisis that keeps collapsing into one another. It begins with a birthday celebration that should have been joyful, but instead exposes a fragile household and a child who is unsure whom to call mother. Arjun repeatedly appears as a steady father figure, while Veena is treated as a possible mother figure whose place in the child’s life is still contested. The child’s shifting use of "amma" and the adults’ tense reactions make clear that affection exists, but acceptance does not. As the family conflict deepens, workplace pressure rises at EC Tech and later in other company settings, where Veena’s authority is challenged and gossip follows her every move. Mithun Chandra’s return as Vice President adds suspicion, especially because people speculate about his connection to Veena and because old feelings and betrayals seem unresolved. Abhi and Abhimanyu repeatedly act as protective or confrontational figures, sometimes defending children or exposing misconduct, and sometimes becoming part of the emotional conflict themselves. A senior client’s boundary-crossing behavior is checked when Abhi confronts him with proof, showing that the workplace is also a place of hidden abuse and power games. The children remain at the center of the drama, whether through school disputes, allergy blame, or a hospital scare, and their needs repeatedly expose the adults’ failures. One school conflict turns on a strawberry cake and an allergy, while another meeting erupts when a child openly claims Veena as her mother. The family struggle grows harsher when medical and legal details surface, including a falsified report and suspicious money transfer that suggest manipulation behind the scenes. Veena and Rahul’s marriage breaks apart under accusation and rejection, and the demand for divorce makes the separation public and final in tone. At the same time, Veena tries to hold onto her place in the child’s life, but the child often resists or chooses the mother she already knows. The corporate plot escalates into takeover threats, share claims, and public humiliation, showing that business control is as unstable as family loyalty. Abhimanyu’s hidden position as a real co-owner and the exposure of a fake investment push the company toward scandal and collapse. Across all of this, the emotional stakes stay the same: who can claim the child, who can be trusted, and whether any family bond can survive the betrayals around it. By the end, both the household and the business remain in crisis, with love, parenthood, and power all left unresolved.

doctor-of-the-gods.title: Doctor Of The Gods
doctor-of-the-gods.description: After being mocked as a madman for three years, Arinjay suddenly returns with mysterious ancient powers that allow him to heal the impossible, defeat powerful enemies, and uncover secrets hidden from the world. As billionaires, criminals, and even his own family stand against him, he begins a journey to reclaim his legacy and prove that the man everyone laughed at was destined to become a legend.

she-built-his-empire.title: She Built His Empire
she-built-his-empire.description: Brilliant quantitative programmer Clara Vance regains memories revealing she was drugged, framed as mentally unfit, stripped of her son, and robbed of her revolutionary trading algorithm. Refusing charity from her regretful billionaire ex-husband, she returns to Wall Street to outsmart the elite who destroyed her life. Using her unmatched financial genius, Clara wages a ruthless algorithmic war to expose the conspiracy, reclaim her child, and bring an empire to its knees.

chaiwale-ki-ias-girlfriend.title: Chaiwale ki IAS Girlfriend
chaiwale-ki-ias-girlfriend.description: Megha’s story begins with a painful rupture from the family who raised her, after her uncle and aunt block her IAS dream and she is stopped from ending her life. A compassionate young man, Navneet, becomes her steady support and helps pull her back toward hope. When Megha wins a full scholarship to a top coaching institute, she leaves home and starts a new life in the city. Before she goes, she and Navneet share a tender farewell and promise to wait for each other. In the hostel, Megha settles in with help from her roommate Shweta and throws herself into study, determined to become a collector. Navneet stays close through calls and encouragement, but he quietly hides his own financial hardship. He works at a tea stall, takes extra labor, and even sells his old phone so Megha can keep studying. Megha’s focus on exams is repeatedly tested by teasing classmates, campus distractions, and the strain of missed calls and delayed replies. As her bond with Navneet deepens, their connection is also complicated by secrecy, timing, and the pressure of ambition. Navneet continues arranging support behind the scenes, including study materials, while Megha remains unaware of the full cost. A warm, teasing romance begins to surface on campus, and another possible romantic thread around Raj adds more tension, but Navneet remains her central emotional anchor. Megha eventually asks for friendship only until her exams are over, choosing her future over immediate love. She clears the UPSC exam and becomes a Collector, but success brings distance and conflict instead of peace. Navneet tries to reach her, yet she rejects him because their positions now seem too far apart. The hidden truth then comes out: Navneet had sacrificed money, work, and comfort to pay for her fees, books, and admission. Megha struggles to accept that his devotion shaped her rise. The story ends in tragedy when she learns that Navneet has died after giving everything for her future.

princess-of-wealth.title: Princess of Wealth
princess-of-wealth.description: After dying from exhaustion while working overtime in the corporate world, a young woman discovers she has won a ₹1 crore lottery—but before she can claim it, she is reborn as the Second Princess of a powerful kingdom. Strangely, the lottery fortune follows her into this new life, giving her wealth and an edge in palace politics. Surrounded by princes eager to win her hand, she navigates rivalries, conspiracies, and her jealous elder sister, the First Princess, with wit, courage, and confidence.

unstoppable-gharjamai.title: Unstoppable Gharjamai
unstoppable-gharjamai.description: When modern-day college student Yuan awakens in the body of the disgraced Han Yuan, he becomes the unwanted live-in husband of the proud Jianjia. Mocked as a failure and framed for crimes he didn't commit, Yuan uses his modern knowledge and fearless wit to outsmart powerful enemies, win unexpected allies, and rise from the most rejected man in Yunzhou to a legendary force no one can stop.

lucky-curse.title: Lucky Curse
lucky-curse.description: 'Kimi' ek 6 saal ki choti si bacchi thi jiske paas kayi jadui shaktiyan thi, lekin ek dikkat bhi thi—wo jo bhi bolti thi, uska ulta ho jaata tha. Ise badalne ke liye uski master 'Luna' ne use ek lucky insaan ke saath rakhne ka faisla kiya, lekin galti se wo 'Ken' ke paas pahunch gayi, jo behad badkismat tha. Lekin jab Kimi ko pata chala ki Ken ki kismat chura li gayi thi, to usne use wapas dilane ki thaan li. Kya wo isme kamiyaab ho paayi, ya koi aur raaz saamne aa gaya?

setelah-tiga-tahun-aku-berbalik-melawann.title: Setelah Tiga Tahun, Aku Berbalik Melawannya
setelah-tiga-tahun-aku-berbalik-melawann.description: Kabir berhasil membangun perusahaan besar, tetapi terus ditekan dan dipermalukan oleh Naina. Persaingan pribadi berkembang menjadi perang bisnis yang dipenuhi rahasia, balas dendam, dan perebutan kekuasaan. Saat kebenaran masa lalu terungkap, semua pihak harus menghadapi konsekuensi dari pilihan mereka.

the-dna-that-broke-everything.title: The DNA That Broke Everything
the-dna-that-broke-everything.description: After a tragic accident separates two brothers for twenty years, a successful CEO begins to suspect that the poor woman being humiliated as a cleaner is actually his biological mother. As a DNA test threatens to expose the truth, greed, betrayal, and a younger brother's shocking deception push an entire family toward a life-changing revelation.

paisa-no-power.title: Paisa No Power
paisa-no-power.description: Dev ane Riya ni 5 varsh ni contract marriage no ant, ane sharu thay chhe prem, dhokho, revenge ane redemption ni safar. Family politics, shocking secrets ane unexpected twists vachche Dev potani olakh fari thi banave chhe. Shu Riya potani bhulo samjhshe? Ke aa kahani no ant badhu j badli nakhshe?

broken-parivaar.title: Broken Parivaar
broken-parivaar.description: A humble father who secretly owns a business empire watches his talented son face humiliation and corruption on the cricket field, while a shocking betrayal from his own wife threatens to destroy his family. As hidden identities unravel, he fights powerful enemies to expose the truth, reclaim his legacy, and protect his son's future.

ondu-delivery-eradu-hrudaya.title: Ondu Delivery, Eradu Hrudaya
ondu-delivery-eradu-hrudaya.description: The story begins with a corporate power struggle, as Priya Chakraborty learns that Ashok Verma is preparing a board meeting to remove her from power. She is not shaken by the warning and starts watching his moves closely, showing that the hotel conflict will be fought with strategy as much as force. At the same time, the narrative follows Gautam, a delivery boy whose life is thrown into chaos by accidents, money trouble, and repeated clashes with people above and around him. A near-collision and a returned credit card create an uneasy link between Gautam and Priya, and that connection keeps pulling him into her world of wealth, authority, and suspicion. Gautam is repeatedly judged as an outsider, mocked for his status, and dragged into fights over rent, food, and dignity. His hardships deepen when family burdens surface, including his father’s serious medical problems and the cost of care. Romantic tension also grows around him, first through flirtation and party invitations, then through public embarrassment when he is forced to present Priya as his girlfriend and faces classist humiliation. Priya answers those insults sharply, but the relationship remains mixed, shaped by attraction, pressure, and social divide. The hotel setting becomes more important as interviews, hiring disputes, and access battles expose how tightly status controls opportunity. Shweta’s humiliation at the hotel and her threat of legal action underline how harsh the system is for those without power. Gautam is also pushed into the hotel world in unexpected ways, sometimes as a target, sometimes as a participant, and sometimes as someone asked to take responsibility inside the very place that rejects him. The conflict then turns more secretive when a family-arranged marriage is confirmed and treated as something that must stay hidden. That hidden marriage becomes tied to business interests and to the struggle over who can control the hotel. Priya is caught between protecting her position and managing the risks of secrecy, while Gautam pushes back against the terms and asks for work in the same environment. Workplace unrest grows as security staff face threats, salary pressure, and unfair rules, leading to open resistance. Aditya Chakravarthy emerges as a major force in the hotel conflict, humiliating staff and challenging Gautam’s place there. The tension widens into violence and rescue, with Gautam repeatedly confronting aggressors and refusing money or intimidation when Priya is in danger. Boardroom pressure also rises as investors withdraw and control of the business becomes uncertain. A mistaken attack leaves Divya injured, bringing police scrutiny and raising the stakes around accountability. By the end, hidden family truth, inheritance questions, revenge, and loyalty all collide, while Gautam and Priya remain bound together by both danger and unresolved feeling.

andhagaadu.title: Andhagaadu
andhagaadu.description: ఆదిత్య వర్మ ఒక పెద్ద బిజినెస్ మేన్. తన నాయనమ్మ చేసిన చిన్న తప్పు వల్ల అతను పెద్ద చిక్కుల్లో పడిపోయాడు. నాయనమ్మ ఏం చేసింది?  వెన్నెలని ఎలా కలిసాడు? ప్రేమలు, మలుపులు కలగలిసిన రొమాంటిక్ డ్రామా అంధగాడు.

taxi-driver-1.title: Taxi driver
taxi-driver-1.description: After a one-night encounter with a wealthy woman, Varun, a taxi driver, discovers five years later that he is the father of her daughter and enters a marriage of convenience, only to face some hidden secrets about each other.

the-final-betrayal-11.title: The Final Betrayal
the-final-betrayal-11.description: The story follows Shivam and Sejal as their marriage is repeatedly tested by public humiliation, class prejudice, and dangerous power games. It begins with playful trust between the newlyweds, but Shivam also uses dramatic gestures to keep Sejal close, including fake divorce papers that turn out to hide honeymoon tickets to Mauritius. As the trip and their public life unfold, Sejal is repeatedly judged for her appearance, clothes, and background in malls, airports, hotels, and resorts. Shivam consistently steps in as a protective husband, defending her dignity and using his status to push back against rude staff, strangers, and gatekeepers. Their honeymoon and travel plans become less about luxury and more about whether Sejal can be treated with basic respect. The pressure grows when Sejal is isolated, denied entry, or forced to prove her identity and connection to Shivam in front of hostile people. In parallel, another woman, Savi, is unexpectedly given special treatment in first class, which draws suspicion and jealousy and suggests a hidden connection to Shivam. The wider world around them is full of people who weaponize wealth, rank, and rumor to shame others. At luxury hotels and resorts, Sejal is mocked, blocked, and doubted until Shivam makes a bold public stand for her. One major turning point comes when Shivam promises to buy an entire hotel after Sejal is insulted, and the supposed frauds are later revealed as the hotel’s new owners. That reversal restores some power, but it also shows how much of the conflict is driven by status and public image. The romance then deepens and strains at once, as Shivam tries to win back Sejal with gifts and tenderness while she insists that love matters more than money. Their bond is tested again in a casino, where family resentment, old betrayals, and rival men turn gambling into a battle over pride and control. Sejal’s sister attacks her marriage and status, while Shivam keeps defending Sejal and refusing to let others touch her. The casino stakes rise into a ruthless showdown with Thakral, where Shivam risks enormous sums and finally wins with a rare hand. Thakral’s accusation of cheating collapses when no proof is found, but the victory only exposes how far the rivalry and humiliation have gone. The final stretch adds another layer of danger when Sejal is threatened over property papers and protected by Rajveer, who reassures her that no harm will come to her. The closing revelation that Radhika claims to be Shivam’s first wife leaves Sejal facing a deeper personal crisis, suggesting that the marriage itself may be built on an unresolved secret.

abc-songs-for-kids-s-to-z.title: ABC Songs For Kids (S to Z)
abc-songs-for-kids-s-to-z.description: ABC Songs For Kids (S to Z)

gilded-bloodline-sovereign-awakening.title: Gilded Bloodline: Sovereign Awakening
gilded-bloodline-sovereign-awakening.description: In Ashcroft Bay, where bloodlines rule, outcast Vivienne Ashworth is marked for death after her family's downfall. To survive, she forms a forbidden Life-Binding with the deadly guardian Alexander Voss. Armed with her family's hidden bio-cellular legacy, she cures allies, builds a secret resistance, and wages war against the tyrannical Founding Eight. Her final battle will decide whether she reclaims her birthright or dies trying.

my-adopted-brother-stole-my-life.title: My Adopted Brother Stole My Life
my-adopted-brother-stole-my-life.description: After being wrongfully imprisoned for attempting to murder his adopted brother, Harsh returns home determined to rebuild his shattered life. But when the same manipulative brother continues to frame him, steal his family, his inheritance, and even his fiancée, Harsh must expose the monster hiding behind a perfect smile before he loses everything forever.

107-years-of-mystery.title: 107 Years of Mystery
107-years-of-mystery.description: A cursed billionaire family's only hope for survival rests on a girl with a unique birthmark. But when her greedy sister fakes the mark to steal her destiny, a battle for the family's fortune and future begins.

al-mudeer-wal-qalb.title: Al-Mudeer wal-Qalb
al-mudeer-wal-qalb.description: Marrying My Daughter's CEO Mom - The Boss and the Heart

mastermind-of-paper-leaks.title: MasterMind Of Paper Leaks
mastermind-of-paper-leaks.description: When yet another government exam is cancelled due to a paper leak, an honest UPSC aspirant's dream of becoming an officer transforms into a relentless mission to expose a powerful paper leak syndicate. As he takes on corrupt politicians, businessmen, and an education mafia that profits by selling students' futures, he must risk everything—including his family, love, and life—to bring justice to millions of betrayed aspirants.

siraa-arsh-al-sharikah.title: Siraa' Arsh Al-Sharikah
siraa-arsh-al-sharikah.description:
Ba****ds of Boardroom - Corporate Thrones


The Ba***ds of Boardroom is an engaging story of a mother sacrifices everything to raise a child she believes is hers. Betrayal, greed, and blood ties collide inside boardrooms and bedrooms alike. When the final chess move is revealed, only one woman stands victorious. Watch now.

charudutt-ki-vasantsena.title: Charudutt Ki Vasantsena
charudutt-ki-vasantsena.description: Adapted from the 5th Century Sanskrit play 'Mrrichchakatikam' (The Little Clay Cart) by Sudraka - when honourable merchant Charudutt loses his fortune on the day of his wedding, society abandons him—except for the Ujjayini's most celebrated courtesan. As they fall into a forbidden love that defies wealth, caste and reputation, their romance attracts the obsession of a ruthless prince, igniting a chain of betrayal, political rebellion and sacrifice that will change an entire kingdom. Watch Now!

azagana-ratchasan.title: Azagana Ratchasan
azagana-ratchasan.description: மனைவிக்கு கொடுத்த வாக்குறுதியை காப்பாற்ற உலகின் மிகப்பெரிய கோடீஸ்வரர் தனது அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து பள்ளி கிளீனராக வாழ்கிறார். ஆனால் பேராசை, அவமானம், குடும்பத் துரோகம் மற்றும் காதல் அவரது வாழ்க்கையை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்திற்கு இட்டுச் செல்கிறது.

dalam-hal-pernikahan-lord-pei-adalah-ora.title: Dalam hal pernikahan, Lord Pei adalah orang yang
dalam-hal-pernikahan-lord-pei-adalah-ora.description: Seorang pewaris wanita menerima pernikahan yang telah diatur, tanpa menyadari bahwa calon suaminya adalah mentor yang pernah membimbingnya. Hubungan mereka diuji oleh rahasia masa lalu, persaingan keluarga, dan berbagai intrik. Bersama, mereka berusaha melawan takdir dan memperjuangkan cinta yang tak biasa.

the-final-punch.title: The Final Punch
the-final-punch.description: Kai returns from strict underground training with his power deliberately sealed, but his hidden strength quickly proves impossible to hide. He is pulled into a world where clubs, arenas, and criminal bosses use violence, betting, and intimidation to control fighters. Leena stands as a steady protector and organizer, trying to keep the club together while outside threats close in. Repeated challengers like Fang, Feng, Zen, and other rivals force the group into constant defense, and the club’s survival becomes a recurring stake. Kai’s calm refusal to retreat shocks opponents and onlookers alike, and his victories expose how much skill he had concealed. As the pressure grows, he is drawn deeper into the illegal circuit by offers of money, underground matches, and promises of answers. The fights are rarely fair, with rigged rules, ambushes, poison, and public humiliation shaping the path forward. Kai’s personal drive sharpens when he learns his father was killed, and the search for the truth becomes inseparable from revenge. Leena and other allies repeatedly urge restraint, survival, and strategy, even as Kai keeps pushing toward the people behind the violence. The story widens from club rivalries into a larger underground hierarchy, where champions, gatekeepers, and bosses control who advances and who is crushed. Lone Wolf emerges as a feared figure tied to old killings and old grudges, making the past feel dangerously alive. Kai’s clashes with stronger opponents force him to shift from brute force to patience, precision, and reading weaknesses. At the same time, the arena’s leaders investigate him, suggesting his talent makes him either a threat or a valuable asset. The truth about his father’s death slowly becomes more complicated, pointing to a planned operation and multiple people involved rather than a single killer. That revelation pushes Kai toward the Beast Club and toward Scorpion, whose empire links fighting, corruption, and business ambitions. The Beast Club arc raises the stakes further with championship pressure, sabotage, and public scandal. Kai is poisoned, hospitalized, and pressured to sign away control in exchange for the truth, showing how far the conspiracy reaches. Even when he returns to the ring weakened, he keeps fighting, but the cost of revenge keeps rising. In the end, Kai storms the Beast Club to confront Scorpion, only for Lena to pull him back from murder and toward legal punishment. The arc closes with Scorpion publicly condemned and sentenced to death for illegal betting and murder, giving the conflict a final reckoning through law rather than personal vengeance.

kaid-mein-arabpati.title: Kaid Mein Arabpati
kaid-mein-arabpati.description: jad pyaar, dhokho aur olakh ro dangerous khel, ek Arabpati Raghav ri zindagi ne hila deve hai, jin pyaar ri khatir Raghav apno sab kuch daav pr laga deve hai, woh pyaar hi ban jaave hai sabsu badi galti, pan jad Ragav apni kismat su haar jave hai to Suhana ek ameer ghar ri ladki Ragav ne apnave hai bina koi shart, or pher shuru hove hai ek asli pariksha, duniya ra log ee prem re khilaaf ho jave hai, pan jad Ragav ri asliyat su sab rubaru hove hai to puri duniya jhukne pr majboor ho jave hai

the-rogue-king.title: The Rogue King
the-rogue-king.description: Devgarh is repeatedly shaken by clashes between royal pride, family shame, and outside threats. The king’s authority is tested by Pindari raids, while court customs and bloodline politics keep turning merit into humiliation. Tej and other warriors struggle to prove themselves in battles that are never only about combat, but also about status and recognition. At the same time, the courtesan-house thread follows a reckless heir who defies his elders for Laila and refuses to surrender what he believes is his right. That storyline exposes class prejudice, hidden family pain, and the pressure to conceal shameful origins. Another family conflict grows around a disgraced heir, a grieving mother, and a stepmother figure who is accused of poisoning and plotting to replace him. Across these threads, public punishment and private resentment keep feeding each other. The swayamvar for Princess Veena becomes a central arena where marriage, power, and royal legitimacy collide. Suitors are judged not only by rank but by courage, grace, and loyalty, even as rivals try to use the contest for political gain. Shan/Shaan is repeatedly mocked as unworthy, yet he keeps returning to prove himself. He is pushed, rejected, and publicly humiliated, but he also survives deadly attacks and begins to earn notice through hidden strength. The story suggests that his victories are tied to a mysterious force as well as his own resolve. As the Pindari threat grows, the kingdom’s conflicts widen from personal insult into a crisis of survival. Shan is even accused of betrayal when Princess Veena is taken captive, forcing the court to question whether he is a traitor or the only one who can save her. He ultimately reveals that the capture was part of a larger plan to reach the Pindaris and stop their ritual threat. In the end, he rescues Veena, defeats Lakha and the raiders, and restores royal honor. The aftermath shifts his status dramatically, with the ruler naming him rightful successor before the throne is passed to Tej. Even so, the unresolved rivalries and earlier wounds leave the world tense, with honor, desire, and identity still under pressure.

simple-aag-ond-lovestory.title: Simple Aag Ond Lovestory
simple-aag-ond-lovestory.description: Sinchana’s story is built around repeated public humiliation, romantic betrayal, and the struggle to keep her dignity in spaces where money and status decide everything. Early on, she is accused of stealing Rohit, and a fake photo, office punishment, and a public engagement scandal turn private betrayal into a public spectacle. Rohit’s relationship with Priya is exposed as part of the mess, while his parents’ class prejudice makes the conflict even harsher. Across the same stretch, business pressure and investment leverage are used to control people, especially women, and domestic threats like eviction show how fragile security can be. Sinchana keeps insisting on the truth and refuses to stay silent, even when others try to dismiss her or force her out. She is repeatedly pushed into new jobs and new spaces, but those spaces are rarely safe, since gossip, favoritism, and hidden connections follow her everywhere. At one point she is rejected at a house, her luggage is thrown out, and she is treated as if she does not belong, though Sanjay tries to protect her and arrange her stay and work. Rohit continues to pressure her, even threatening her career, but Sinchana rejects being treated like a transaction and insists she earned her place on merit. Her workplace arc becomes another battlefield, with accusations of stolen designs, public slaps, and a competition that puts her talent under scrutiny. A supervisor and other powerful men sometimes protect her, but their attention also adds uncertainty about whether she is valued for herself or for the status around her. The story then shifts into a more intimate romance thread, where illness, storms, and caregiving create tenderness, yet misunderstandings about who belongs with whom keep Sinchana emotionally unsettled. She is also brought into a wealthy family setting as a prospective bride, where approval, guarded reactions, and family pressure shape her future. Public teasing and a truth-or-dare challenge push her feelings into the open, and Karan eventually confesses love for her in front of others. Even then, jealousy, gossip, and workplace fallout continue to threaten both her reputation and her relationships. The conflict expands into inheritance and property battles, with Sinchana fighting over her late parents’ house, a necklace, and forged papers while Karan supports her. Near the end, Karan returns her father’s cherished painting, reinforcing their bond, but duty pulls him away on the eve of their anniversary. Rohit returns with regret and a marriage proposal, yet Sinchana refuses to be anyone’s second choice and chooses Karan instead. She boldly proposes marriage to Karan, and he accepts immediately, giving the story a decisive romantic turn after so much humiliation and uncertainty.

pathinettam-padi.title: Pathinettam Padi
pathinettam-padi.description: A mysterious young teacher with a hidden billionaire legacy takes on a college ruled by ego, corruption, and manipulation. When a false scandal threatens to destroy him, he fights back not with revenge, but with truth - ultimately becoming the hero, mentor, and savior of those who once hated him.

mahadev-ka-sabse-bada-bhakt-markandeya.title: Mahadev Ka Sabse Bada Bhakt Markandeya
mahadev-ka-sabse-bada-bhakt-markandeya.description: Mahadev Ka Sabse Bada Bhakt Markandeya

maa-naanna-maha-yodha.title: Maa Naanna Maha Yodha
maa-naanna-maha-yodha.description: అదృశ్య శక్తులు రాజ్యం మీద పడినపుడు సైనికుల గుండె ధైర్యం బయటపడుతుంది. అందులో యోధులెవరో వీరులెవరో తెలుస్తుంది. సువర్ణపురి రాజ్యం మీద కన్నేసిన అదృశ్య శక్తులను అడ్డుకున్న ఒక మామూలు రైతు కథ ఇది. చూడండి మా నాన్న మహా యోధ.

war-of-the-divine-blood.title: War of the Divine Blood
war-of-the-divine-blood.description: A child born with both divine and demonic blood is secretly sent to Nanjing and raised by a group of fallen heroes. Believed to be powerless, Jinwoo grows up surrounded by love and sacrifice. When a ruthless ruler orders the extermination of all Nanjing's people, Jinwoo must uncover the truth of his origin, awaken his extraordinary strength, and fight to save his home from destruction.

the-bride-who-burned-heaven.title: The Bride Who Burned Heaven
the-bride-who-burned-heaven.description: Evangeline Gray, a shroud-weaver captive, is forced into a holy betrothal with the obsessive High Priest Cassian Vane—while hiding her addictive liquid-gold blood from demigod predators. As Julian returns as a dark zealot and Heaven descends to erase her, Evangeline must choose: sterile ascension or sovereign rule beside the monster who protects her.

laid-bare-in-crimson-neon.title: Laid bare in Crimson Neon
laid-bare-in-crimson-neon.description: Laura begins as a poor street actress whose life is shattered when her uncle sells her debt contract and Dominic Thorne claims her at auction. Dominic is a powerful syndicate heir whose control over Laura is enforced through contracts, trackers, and the threat of violence, yet his world is also marked by a hidden alchemical illness that is slowly killing him. Laura is dragged into his public orbit as both a protected companion and a convenient shield against rivals, while she struggles to survive humiliation from his family and the constant danger around him. What first looks like pure captivity gradually becomes more complicated when Laura discovers that her own knowledge of purification may be tied to the only possible cure for Dominic’s condition. The two are repeatedly tested by elite gatherings, audits, inspections, and attacks that expose how fragile Dominic’s authority really is. Valerie emerges as a major threat, attacking Laura’s background, challenging Dominic’s legitimacy, and trying to expose illegal alchemical practices. Euphorine also adds to the chaos, while Marcus repeatedly acts as an enforcer who keeps Laura alive even when she tries to escape. Laura’s attempt to flee fails when she learns that a blood tracker and armed hunters make freedom nearly impossible. The danger deepens when poisoned drinks, hidden seals, and assassination attempts reveal that someone inside the family or syndicate may be engineering the violence. Laura’s buried past as a cabaret performer is exposed, and the story suggests that her identity has been concealed for reasons beyond simple shame. A hidden journal and her father’s records point toward a cure for Dominic’s heart rot, making Laura valuable not only as a captive but as a key to his survival. Her bloodline appears to matter, and the possibility that her mother may still be alive under another identity raises the stakes of her own origin story. Laura’s unregistered purification power is eventually revealed when she administers a rare remedy and triggers an unusual burst of energy. That revelation shifts the balance between captive and captor, because Laura is no longer merely someone Dominic owns or protects. At the same time, the wider criminal world is shown to be rotting from within, with forbidden medicine, corrupted drugs, and staged attacks designed to provoke gang war. The evidence increasingly points to a hidden third faction or internal betrayal orchestrating the violence for control. By the end of the batch, Laura and Dominic are bound together by danger, blood, and mutual dependence, even as the conspiracy around them grows larger and more lethal.

the-night-ceo.title: The Night CEO
the-night-ceo.description: On the eve of her wedding, Ishqi discovers that her fiancé has betrayed her and her own family has sold her for money. Desperate to escape, she spends one unforgettable night with a mysterious billionaire—only to discover he's her ex-fiancé's powerful uncle and new CEO. As love, revenge, and dangerous secrets collide, Ishqi must decide whether to trust the ruthless man who is willing to burn the world to protect her.

beneath-the-canvas.title: Beneath the Canvas
beneath-the-canvas.description: Trapped in her brother's underground art conservation vault, brilliant chemist Beatrice Moore is forced to preserve priceless masterpieces for a ruthless art-laundering empire. When obsessive investigator Silas Thorne uncovers a trail of murders leading to her lab, they form a dangerous alliance to expose a global conspiracy. As buried memories and deadly secrets surface, they risk everything to bring down the cartel and uncover the truth behind her parents' murder.

point-of-view.title: Point Of View Clash
point-of-view.description: A fearless host brings together outspoken debaters with opposing ideologies to battle over India's most controversial social issues, where every argument challenges beliefs—and the audience delivers the final verdict.

the-billionaire-wants-my-power.title: The Billionaire Wants My Power
the-billionaire-wants-my-power.description: Eli Reyes begins the story as a humiliated young man trapped under the Calloway family’s control, with his mother’s home hanging by a thread. The family uses eviction threats, public cruelty, and security pressure to keep him powerless. Eli’s life changes when he finds a hidden device left by his father, and it bonds to him in a way that gives him dangerous new abilities. That power turns him from a victim into someone who can fight back, but it also makes him a target. As Eli digs deeper, he discovers that Tyler Calloway’s public success may rest on stolen technology and fraud. The conflict widens from personal humiliation into a larger struggle over patents, hidden files, and a family cover-up. Maya, a powerful heiress tied to the Calloways, gradually turns against her family and begins helping Eli in secret. Their alliance becomes both strategic and romantic, even as surveillance and retaliation make every move risky. Together they uncover evidence that Maya’s father may have been poisoned and framed, rather than having died by suicide. That discovery gives their fight a sharper edge, since the stolen patents and the suspicious death appear to be part of the same conspiracy. Eli’s goal shifts from survival and money to revenge and truth, while Maya fights to reclaim her father’s legacy. Tyler repeatedly tries to humiliate them, expose Eli, and protect the family image. The Calloways respond with blackouts, tracking systems, lockdowns, and armed pursuit, turning the town and school into a hunting ground. Eli keeps infiltrating elite spaces, using his technical skill and his father’s legacy to steal evidence and disrupt the family’s systems. Maya’s access and insider knowledge become essential as the pair break into secured facilities and corporate spaces. Their efforts bring them closer to the truth, but also closer to exposure, injury, and capture. By the end of the batch, Eli and Maya are still allied and still under threat, with the conflict unresolved and the stakes higher than ever.

my-wifes-secret.title: My Wife's Secret
my-wifes-secret.description: A courier boy hiding his identity from his wife and working as a poor guy ,when he decided to tell his identity with her ,she started cheating with him and cought directly ,and last he release his identity and then the wife relise..

shadi-by-chance.title: Shadi by chance
shadi-by-chance.description: When business heir Rajveer Malhotra goes undercover to uncover a dangerous conspiracy, he unexpectedly crosses paths with Ishaani, a runaway bride desperate to escape a forced marriage. A three-month marriage of convenience soon turns complicated as hidden identities, family schemes, and unexpected love begin to change their lives.

toxic-love-story.title: Toxic Love Story
toxic-love-story.description: ஒரு சாதாரண நர்ஸ்... ஒரு கொடூரமான மாஃபியா தலைவனின் உயிரைக் காப்பாற்றுகிறாள். ஆனால் அந்த ஒரு முடிவு, அவளின் வாழ்க்கையை முழுவதுமாக மாற்றிவிடுகிறது. காதல், பயம், அதிகாரம், உயிர்ப்போர் என ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் ஒரு புதிய போராட்டமாக மாறுகிறது.

return-of-the-alpha.title: Return of the Alpha
return-of-the-alpha.description: When legendary bomb disposal expert Karan Mehra saves a hostage by making an impossible choice, a viral video turns him into the nation's biggest villain. Betrayed by his fiancée, framed by his ambitious rival, and suspended from the Bomb Squad, Karan walks away. But when a deadly terrorist attack leaves the country with only one man capable of stopping it, the hero everyone abandoned becomes the nation's last hope.

rich-mane-aliya.title: Rich Mane Aliya
rich-mane-aliya.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

the-billionaires-ice-queen.title: The Billionaire's Ice Queen
the-billionaires-ice-queen.description: Hannah Wells begins as a disgraced skater whose career was destroyed by betrayal, stolen choreography, and a blacklisting tied to Dean, Grace, and the skating establishment. She confronts the people who took her future and refuses to stay hidden, even when she is forced into low-status work and public humiliation. Her path back to the ice is repeatedly shaped by John Logan, a powerful arena owner and protector who sees both her skating value and her importance to his family. Logan offers Hannah contracts, private ice access, legal force, and public shielding, but his control also creates tension because Hannah wants her independence back, not just rescue. A major emotional thread grows around Leo, whose fear and silence begin to ease through Hannah’s patient coaching and care. As Hannah helps Leo recover confidence, the adults around him fight over custody, legitimacy, and who gets to define his future. The skating world around them is shown as deeply corrupted, with stolen files, bribes, surveillance, false reports, and federation pressure shaping who is allowed to compete. Grace remains Hannah’s most persistent rival, using scandal, sabotage, and public attacks to protect her own standing and keep Hannah out. Dean also remains entangled in the damage, sometimes warning Hannah and sometimes appearing complicit in the betrayal that ruined her. Logan’s protection expands into corporate warfare as he buys assets, shuts down hostile coverage, and challenges the federation’s control of the sport. Hannah’s comeback becomes inseparable from her fight to reclaim her name, her body, and her right to belong. Injuries, bans, and staged disasters keep threatening to end her return before it can fully begin. The conflict then widens beyond the rink into family power struggles, boardroom battles, and questions about who truly belongs in Logan’s household. Vivian emerges as another major force in that larger struggle, using influence, manipulation, and hidden records to undermine Hannah and shape the family narrative. Hannah and John’s bond deepens through repeated crises, but it is strained by jealousy, old betrayals, and the fear that protection can become another form of control. The story eventually moves into kidnapping and rescue, with Hannah abducted through a covert network and John forcing an international search to bring her back. Hannah survives captivity, helps leave clues, and is eventually rescued through a dangerous operation that exposes shell companies, forged codes, and a wider conspiracy. After the rescue, the story turns toward recovery, public vindication, and family healing as false reporting collapses and Hannah is finally affirmed as belonging in the home. Even then, the show keeps the stakes high with lingering trauma, pregnancy fears, and new threats that suggest the fight for safety, trust, and a stable future is not over.

the-blind-husbands-revenge.title: The Blind Husband's Revenge
the-blind-husbands-revenge.description: When a blind billionaire regains his eyesight and discovers that his wife and the police officer assigned to protect him are having an affair and using his disability to steal his fortune, he secretly pretends to remain blind and launches a dangerous game of revenge, only to uncover an even darker truth: his real daughter has been kidnapped and replaced.

final-lady-boss.title: Final Lady Boss
final-lady-boss.description: After her father's sudden death, Claire is trapped under her abusive stepfamily's control and forced into a sham marriage with Luke, a quiet corporate driver, to strip her of her inheritance. Pretending to be powerless, Claire secretly fights back, using Luke's apparent connections to sabotage their schemes. When Luke is revealed as a reclusive billionaire, their fake marriage becomes a powerful alliance that destroys her stepfamily's empire and restores her father's legacy.

road-to-the-end.title: Road To The End
road-to-the-end.description: Hours before a zombie apocalypse begins, Lu Han receives a mysterious warning and a futuristic survival rover with limitless upgrade potential. After spending his fortune on supplies before money loses all value, he races to save his parents. As the world falls apart, Lu Han rescues survivors, transforms his vehicle into a mobile fortress, battles zombies and ruthless humans, and uncovers the truth behind the outbreak.

the-ivy-league-contract.title: The Ivy League Contract
the-ivy-league-contract.description: Isaiah begins as a driven student whose academic win over Cassidy immediately creates new trouble rather than relief. His victory is shadowed by the loss of Iris’s tuition subsidy, which pushes him to look for a way to protect her future. That pressure leads him into the Westchester estate and the orbit of the feared Valentine family, where money, rules, and surveillance shape every interaction. Inside the mansion, he is treated as both a useful tutor and a potential threat, and a strict contract tries to keep him away from the daughters. His rivalry with Cassidy does not stay simple, because their clashes over status and truth gradually turn into moments of trust and emotional tension. Cassidy herself is trapped between family control and her own uncertainty, with adults demanding proof of progress while others try to help her believe she can succeed. Around them, other young women and men are pulled into related struggles over identity, tutoring, and family pressure, showing that the household’s control reaches far beyond one relationship. Isaiah also becomes aware that the family’s power rests on secrecy, hidden papers, and possible inheritance disputes. He repeatedly pushes back against deception, whether by spotting impersonation, challenging unfair judgments, or refusing manipulative bargains. At the same time, he is forced to defend his own place in a world that judges him by background as much as by ability. Cassidy’s bond with him deepens when she defends him from public humiliation, even as jealousy and outside interference keep testing them. The story also widens into academic and financial stakes, with deadlines, bursary threats, and evaluations hanging over the characters. Isaiah’s intelligence becomes valuable in a separate wealth-related crisis, where he uncovers a hidden financial leak and outsmarts professionals who missed it. Yet every gain seems to come with renewed scrutiny, as powerful figures investigate his past and try to control what he learns. By the end of the batch, the central conflict remains unresolved: Isaiah is still caught between protecting Iris, resisting the Valentine household’s control, and holding onto his complicated connection with Cassidy. The show’s tension comes from that constant collision of ambition, affection, and secrecy inside wealthy families that never fully reveal what they are hiding.

sadhu-from-iit.title: Sadhu From IIT
sadhu-from-iit.description: An IIT graduate on the brink of suicide becomes a monk, but when he discovers his parents were murdered, he must use both spiritual wisdom and sharp intellect to expose a conspiracy hidden behind faith.

jungle-ka-king-1.title: Jungle Ka King
jungle-ka-king-1.description: Neel’s story follows a young man who is repeatedly hunted, blamed, and pushed to the edge while a hidden divine force, Jalashakti, awakens within him. From the start, he is treated as an outcast, with villagers and powerful enemies tying his suffering to family loss, old tragedy, and a mark they do not understand. A ruthless pursuer and later Vikrant intensify the pressure, using fear, captivity, and public humiliation to break him. Yet each crisis also reveals more of Neel’s connection to water, showing that Jalashakti can heal, protect, and destroy. Neel is warned that his power must remain hidden until the right time, which makes every rescue and confrontation more dangerous. He begins to move from helplessness into action when he awakens the force in battle and turns violence back on those who corner him. His bond with Meera becomes important as she searches for him, stands beside him, and even risks herself to pull him from fire. Neel also proves his instinct to protect by healing Meera and saving an abandoned infant from floodwaters. Sheshanaga’s guidance and other divine warnings suggest that Neel’s path is tied to a larger destiny rather than the village’s judgment. At the same time, the conflict widens beyond personal survival into a struggle over forest land, sacred symbols, and hidden bloodlines. Intruders, captors, and hostile villagers all try to control the forest and define Neel as a threat. An archaeologist, elders, and old legends gradually connect Neel’s mark to a temple idol and an ancient legacy. These revelations point to him as the rightful heir linked to the forest deity and the Vanadevate. Even so, that truth does not end the danger, because fear still drives people to attack him and misunderstand his motives. Neel returns insisting he is not the monster they fear, but a protector trying to defend the land, its creatures, and its people. By the end of the batch, he has accepted the weight of that role, yet the battle for the forest and his identity remains unresolved.

apex-vengeance.title: Apex Vengeance
apex-vengeance.description: Legendary racing coach Steve Jackman dies in a suspicious crash—only to awaken in the body of Coby Whitemore, the abused heir of the powerful Whitemore family. Realizing the crash and Coby's ""suicide"" were orchestrated by ruthless racing tycoon Victor Whitemore, Steve assumes Coby's identity to expose the conspiracy. As he rebuilds a racing team, uncovers corporate corruption, and fights for justice on and off the track, he risks everything to reclaim the truth and bring down a criminal empire

betrayed-but-unbroken.title: Betrayed, But Unbroken
betrayed-but-unbroken.description: Fresh out of jail, Sameer is deceived into marrying Shalini, a scarred heiress abandoned by her own family. His love and secret Ayurvedic cure restore her beauty, but greedy relatives manipulate her into betraying him to steal his formula and destroy his life. Publicly humiliated, divorced, and reduced to a servant, Sameer walks away with one promise—to return, expose every betrayal, and reclaim his dignity. Watch now.

mechanic-brother.title: Mechanic Brother
mechanic-brother.description: எல்லோருக்கும் அவர் ஒரு சாதாரண mechanic... ஆனால் உண்மையில் அவர் நாட்டையே காப்பாற்றும் genius scientist. தனது தங்கை மைத்ரிக்காக எந்த அவமானத்தையும் அமைதியாக தாங்கும் கரண், பணம் மற்றும் அந்தஸ்தை வைத்து மனிதர்களை மதிப்பிடும் சமூகத்தின் உண்மையான முகத்தை வெளிச்சத்துக்கு கொண்டு வருகிறார். ஒவ்வொரு அவமானமும், அவரது மறைக்கப்பட்ட அடையாளத்தை நோக்கி பார்வையாளர்களை இன்னும் நெருக்கமாக அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

nenu-nanna-ayithe.title: Nenu Nanna Ayithe
nenu-nanna-ayithe.description: The show follows a collapsing family-business world where debt, humiliation, and power struggles keep pushing one another into crisis. It begins with a disgraced father whose life falls apart under financial ruin and family rejection, until a hungry daughter’s call briefly pulls him back from despair. From there, the story expands into a supernatural family drama in which a father and son wish for each other’s freedom and end up swapping bodies after a shooting star. That swap throws them into opposite worlds, with the father forced to survive school life and the son dragged into adult office politics. Their new roles expose how badly responsibility, independence, and authority are breaking down inside the family. At work, strict bosses and suspicious colleagues keep testing them, while school discipline and public humiliation create a parallel struggle over control. The corporate side grows more dangerous as risky share deals, hidden messages, and ownership reveals turn ambition into betrayal. Arun becomes the center of this business war, repeatedly clashing with Swathi, Kalpesh, and other rivals over falling shares, market losses, and who really controls the company. He is publicly challenged, removed from office, and then shocks everyone by revealing that he secretly owns most of KVC Mining. Even when he seems to win, the victories are unstable, because auctions, buyouts, and expansion plans keep leading to fresh scandal and financial collapse. Swathi’s role is especially volatile, since she both confronts Arun and, in another turn, defends him in public before a marriage scandal is exposed. That public exposure turns a business event into a personal reckoning, showing that the corporate war is inseparable from buried family history. Meanwhile, family members keep warning about reckless investments, unpaid debts, and the damage caused by pride. The domestic thread becomes even more tangled as parents, children, and spouses argue over exams, marriage, and who has the right to decide the future. Manasa is pulled into the center of this chaos, trying to assert control while sensing that something unnatural may be happening between Arun and Anirudh. Their strange behavior suggests a hidden agreement or possible soul exchange, but the truth is repeatedly delayed. By the end, the show leaves both the business and family crises unresolved, with authority unstable, relationships fractured, and everyone still trapped in the consequences of ambition, debt, and mistaken identity.

royal-strangers-3.title: Royal Strangers
royal-strangers-3.description: A simple elderly couple visits their billionaire son’s luxury empire to celebrate their anniversary, but their modest appearance makes the staff mistake them for beggars. Humiliated, tortured, and thrown out of their own empire, they silently endure brutal cruelty while their powerful son remains unaware of the truth. Royal Strangers is an emotional revenge drama about class, arrogance, hidden identity, and a family pushed to the edge.

rudra-the-martyrs-widow.title: Rudra- The Martyr's Widow
rudra-the-martyrs-widow.description: The show opens in grief, with a military funeral honoring a fallen officer who is remembered as one of the best in service and as a husband and son-in-law. That loss quickly becomes more than private mourning, because a medal, last belongings, and official papers turn the family’s sorrow into a dispute over honor, identity, and legal rights. Rudra is repeatedly pulled into the center of the crisis, sometimes injured, sometimes accused, and sometimes revealed to be tied to General Sandeep Verma in a way that changes how others see her. Around her, mothers and children keep insisting on their bonds to Karthik and to one another, even as crowds refuse to believe them. Public spaces become battlegrounds, especially buses and ceremonies, where women are humiliated, searched, slapped, and accused of fraud, theft, blackmail, or even spying. The medal remains a key symbol throughout, treated as proof of connection to the dead soldier and as something others try to seize, hide, or use against the family. Several scenes also involve children in immediate danger, including breathing trouble, a damaged inhaler, and pleas for help that are ignored or mocked. The conflict widens from family shame into military scandal, with hostile officers, opportunists, and enforcers using the funeral and the soldier’s name for leverage. At the same time, official figures such as lawyers, police, and military superiors appear to force order, but their interventions do not fully settle the truth. The story keeps returning to the question of who really belongs to Karthik, who is telling the truth, and who is exploiting grief for power. As accusations pile up, the women at the center are pushed to defend their names and their children against a crowd that wants simple answers. The pressure escalates into violence, crashes, and armed confrontation, showing that the family dispute has become a larger public crisis. One major thread involves a pregnant woman and other mothers being denied care, which makes the stakes feel immediate and bodily, not just emotional. Another thread follows the hidden or disputed child, whose claims about parentage and legacy keep the dead officer present in the story. Near the end, the conflict reaches a military standoff in which Sreekanth demands a massive transfer and threatens the general’s family, turning the dispute into outright extortion. Gunfire, police intervention, and arrests follow, but even then the emotional damage remains unresolved. The final movement shifts back toward mourning and truth, with a false bomb scare cleared and a child revealing a hidden medal tied to the father’s legacy. The show closes on a mix of grief, family fracture, and fragile reconciliation, with honor still contested but the soldier’s memory still central.

meri-sajni-superstar.title: Meri Sajni Superstar
meri-sajni-superstar.description: After being betrayed and humiliated by the woman he loved, aspiring doctor Ansh Shukla rescues a mysterious bride, Maahi, who is fleeing dangerous enemies. To survive in an unfamiliar city and protect each other, the two strangers enter into a one-month contract marriage. As they battle powerful enemies, hidden secrets, and painful pasts, their fake relationship slowly turns into true love, changing both their lives forever.

double-wife.title: Double Wife
double-wife.description: When brilliant Harini wins an ISRO award, her unfaithful mother Ramya sides with her secret lover Karthik to steal the trophy for his son. Ramya uses embezzled funds to falsely accuse Harini of fraud. However, ISRO Chief Nandhini arrives to expose the conspiracy and Ramya's deceit to her billionaire husband Vikram. Abandoned and stripped of wealth, Ramya is divorced, leaving Vikram and Harini to unite as a family with Nandhini.

the-masked-stranger.title: The Masked Stranger
the-masked-stranger.description: The show follows a fashion and corporate world where people are constantly being packaged, watched, and judged. At its core, several characters fight to keep control of their identities while powerful figures try to turn them into profitable images. One male model resists being reduced to a label, setting the tone for a larger struggle over who gets to define talent and worth. Around him, creative workers are erased from credit, underpaid, or pushed into silence, showing how exploitation runs through both fashion and advertising. A fraud investigation and later legal action against Meridian widen the conflict from personal frustration into open corporate confrontation. The stakes are not only money, but recognition, dignity, and the right to own one’s work and name. A separate emotional thread follows a man burdened by regret, who keeps notebooks of names and memories as he tries to account for loss and wrongdoing. Another thread centers on mentorship and self-revelation, as a photographer sees hidden potential in a rejected young model and urges her to stop performing and show her real self. The story also keeps returning to secrecy: a man enters a place where he does not belong, a hidden digital watcher knows someone’s name, and an anonymous app draws a student into a strange lock-picking mystery. In the fashion world, a tailor’s quiet authority is revealed, reminding everyone that power often sits behind the scenes rather than in the spotlight. Ben’s secret photographs of Arthur add a more intimate version of the same theme, where care and control blur together. Vince’s courtroom win is immediately undercut by leaks and public scrutiny, suggesting that even victory can become another trap. Cole Ash’s refusal of hush money and decision to sue his own agency marks a turning point from humiliation toward resistance. Across the batch, characters repeatedly face the cost of being seen, hidden, or misrepresented. The masked man’s temporary assignment pushes this idea into a more public thriller mode, as he must operate under a false persona with no personal name or agency affiliation. His secrecy becomes unstable when a masked clip goes viral and strangers begin obsessing over who he is. A company-linked woman then asks whether he is ready for a major project, but he remains guarded and refuses to reveal himself. By the end, the show leaves multiple conflicts unresolved, with legal, romantic, and personal identities all still in flux.

little-chess-god.title: Little Chess God
little-chess-god.description: A humble chess academy is thrown into chaos when a ruthless former student returns with a team of undefeated champions, challenging its players to deadly high-stakes matches where every loss comes at a horrific price. Refusing to surrender, the academy's coach and students risk everything in a battle of strategy, courage, and revenge to protect their home and prove that true champions are made by heart, not fear.

billion-dollar-delivery-boy.title: Billion Dollar Delivery Boy
billion-dollar-delivery-boy.description: After being dumped for a billionaire, struggling delivery driver Cole Marsh discovers he is the secret heir to the Reeves fortune. But to claim his inheritance, he must marry within 30 days. A fake marriage with his best friend Jade spirals into a dangerous game of hidden identities, ruthless family rivals, and unexpected love. As enemies close in and secrets unravel, Cole must prove that true worth isn't measured by wealth, but by character.

how-dare-you-touch-my-woman.title: HOW DARE YOU TOUCH MY WOMAN !
how-dare-you-touch-my-woman.description: Ek emotional action-drama jahan motherhood meets power politics. Story follows Amayra—a hidden defence genius and devoted mother—whose world collapses when her daughter becomes the target of bullying, classism, and family betrayal. Between corporate wars, secret identities, romance, revenge, and parental battles, this show explores how far a mother can go when someone threatens her child.

reborn-to-rule.title: Reborn to Rule
reborn-to-rule.description: Brilliant engineer Julian Sinclair is thrust into a world ruled by dark magic, ruthless covens, and monstrous enemies. Armed only with his intellect and fearless determination, he challenges impossible odds, dismantling every obstacle through strategy instead of sorcery. As powerful factions close in, Julian must outthink, outbuild, and outfight them all to survive and reshape a world that never expected an engineer to become its greatest threat.

billion-dollar-rebound.title: Billion Dollar Rebound
billion-dollar-rebound.description: After being dumped by his longtime girlfriend and scraping by as a delivery driver, Cole Marsh receives a life-changing surprise—a mysterious fortune left to him by a billionaire grandfather he never knew existed. Thrust into a world of immense wealth, ruthless rivals, and hidden family secrets, Cole must prove he deserves his inheritance while exposing those determined to steal it and discovering the legacy that was always meant to be his.

matrimonial-wali-dulhan.title: Matrimonial Wali Dulhan
matrimonial-wali-dulhan.description: Billionaire Mihir Mittal, wary of gold-diggers, poses as poor clerk "Mridul" on a matrimonial site to find genuine love. He meets simple, mistreated Meenal, secretly funding her career while maintaining his disguise—even faking a slum home with his reluctant mother Roshni. Meenal turns out to be a kidnapped heiress, Kavya Suryavanshi. When Mihir's wealth is exposed, Meenal feels betrayed by his lies. But love and truth prevail as her father accepts him, proving genuine devotion beats deception.

my-deadly-doctor-husband.title: My Deadly doctor Husband
my-deadly-doctor-husband.description: Dr. Chloe Thompson, a gifted but impoverished surgical resident, enters Lakefront Memorial’s elite trauma program and becomes the target of the powerful Mercer medical dynasty. Protected by the feared Chief of Trauma, Dr. Josh Mercer, she uncovers a conspiracy that framed him and threatens countless lives. Together, they battle corruption, betrayal, and forbidden love, risking everything to expose the truth and reclaim their futures.

state-psc-bdoexcise-inspector-kaise-bane.title: State PSC: BDO/Excise Inspector Kaise Banein?
state-psc-bdoexcise-inspector-kaise-bane.description: State PSC: BDO/Excise Inspector Kaise Banein?

sleeping-with-the-enemy-heir.title: Sleeping With The Enemy's Heir
sleeping-with-the-enemy-heir.description: For two years, Cole Maddox has lived as an overlooked househusband in the powerful Calloway family, hiding his true identity as the leader of the elite underground organization, The Five. When a decades-old conspiracy linked to his family's downfall resurfaces, Cole must reveal his brilliance to protect his wife, Sienna, and dismantle powerful enemies. A gripping crime thriller of hidden identities, betrayal, strategy, and revenge.

maa-kaali-ki-jeebhsakti-ya-shanti.title: Maa Kaali Ki Jeebh:Sakti Ya Shanti ?
maa-kaali-ki-jeebhsakti-ya-shanti.description: Maa Kaali Ki Jeebh:Sakti Ya Shanti ?

my-husband-a-movie-star.title: MY HUSBAND, A MOVIE STAR !!
my-husband-a-movie-star.description: After exposing Hollywood's corrupt nepotism, legendary actor Ethan Cross is murdered and awakens in the body of disgraced celebrity heir Christian Vance. Hiding his true identity, he uses his unmatched talent to rebuild his career, expose the powerful studio empire behind his death, and bring down the industry from within. As enemies close in, an unlikely alliance with ruthless executive Victoria Thorne becomes his greatest strength, and his only chance at justice.

the-last-heir.title: The Last Heir
the-last-heir.description: Zane Morrow, a broke war veteran labeled powerless, unlocks a mysterious dog tag with his blood and discovers he is the last heir to a hidden superhuman bloodline. Hunted by the secret Covenant and forced to survive a deadly blood-bound inheritance, he uncovers a conspiracy behind humanity's devastating interstellar war. As the truth emerges, Zane must decide whether saving humanity is worth becoming the very power others fear.

borrowed-memories-1.title: Borrowed Memories
borrowed-memories-1.description: The story unfolds in a bleak sci-fi world where chips, memory, surveillance, and controlled access decide who gets to survive. Across the arc, people marked as broken, null, low-class, or disposable repeatedly prove to be the ones who can still function when the system fails. A battlefield collapse shows this pattern early, when a fighter whose chip never worked remains active while others are disabled. In the same world, memory is treated like currency, and survival often means trading pieces of identity for borrowed skills or passage through dangerous zones. Black-market routes, guarded facilities, and shifting industrial spaces all reinforce the sense that every movement is monitored or manipulated. Several characters are pushed into situations where they must hide what they know, because knowledge itself is dangerous. Others are tested by enforcers, command rooms, or covert brokers who measure loyalty only by usefulness. A drifter, an outcast, and a Null each move through hostile systems that seem designed to reject them, yet those same systems cannot fully control them. One blind woman claims to have already seen an arriving man, suggesting that some events were arranged long before anyone understood them. Elsewhere, a brutal enforcer punishes hidden resources and unpaid tribute, showing how violently the hierarchy protects itself. A wounded woman reaches a guarded facility and is revealed to have been placed there in advance, deepening the sense that many arrivals are not accidental. Cass endures a prison-like routine until an electrical surge and alarm disrupt the order and raise new questions about identity. In another thread, a covert search for a buried origin record drives operatives deeper into a secured facility while authorities close in around them. Public punishment, secret retaliation, and delayed betrayal all suggest a larger conspiracy moving beneath the surface. A prison block that changes layout every night, an underground chase, and a guarded breach for financial records all point to systems built to confuse and contain. Even direct combat is interrupted by unknown forces, as if the world itself resists clear answers. By the end of the batch, identity feels unstable, with doubles, hidden doubles, and darker selves making it unclear who is real, who is controlled, and who is setting the chaos in motion. The larger stakes are survival, truth, and the right to act before the hidden powers decide everyone’s fate.

2611-kasab-ani-me.title: 26/11 Kasab ani me
2611-kasab-ani-me.description: 26/11 मुंबई हमले का एकमात्र जिंदा पकड़ा गया आतंकी — कसाब। मुख्य जांच अधिकारी रमेश महाले ने कसाब से कड़ी पूछताछ कर पाकिस्तान की भारत विरोधी साजिश को अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंच पर बेनकाब किया। यह है उस रोमांचकारी और साहसी जांच की अविश्वसनीय दास्तान!

final-trust-1.title: Final Trust
final-trust-1.description: 'फायनल ट्रस्ट' ही शाश्वत या श्रीमंत उद्योजकाची कथा आहे. खऱ्या प्रेमासाठी तो आपली ओळख लपवून सामान्य माणूस बनतो. त्यांची भेट सुनैनाशी होते, जी कठीण संघर्षातून जात आहे. ही मालिका प्रेम आणि नात्यांच्या गुंतागुंतीचा एक भावनिक प्रवास आहे.

prema-oka-kala.title: Prema Oka Kala
prema-oka-kala.description: ప్రేమ అంటే కేవలం హృదయాన్ని గిలిగింతలు పెట్టేది మాత్రమే కాదు — అది చాలా లోతైనది. ఈ పుస్తకం మీకు స్నేహం, ఆప్యాయత, ప్రేమ, మోహం, దాంపత్యం, రొమాన్స్ మరియు అనుబంధం అనే ఏడు అధ్యాయాల గురించి చెప్తుంది. తొలి చూపు నుండి లివ్-ఇన్ వరకు, పప్పీ లవ్ నుండి రొమాన్స్ యొక్క ఆరు మెట్ల వరకు — ఇది మానవ సంబంధాల సంపూర్ణ యాత్ర. ప్రేమించిన, కోల్పోయిన లేదా కోరుకున్న ప్రతి ఒక్కరూ వినాల్సిన పుస్తకం.

72-hours.title: 72 HOURS
72-hours.description: மீராவும் கௌதமும் கொண்ட ரகசிய காதல், 72 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் ஒரு சக்திவாய்ந்த தொழிலதிபரை கொல்ல வேண்டும் என்ற மிரட்டலால் பயங்கர கனவாக மாறுகிறது. நேரம் குறைந்து கொண்டிருக்க, சந்தேகம், துரோகம் மற்றும் மறைக்கப்பட்ட உண்மைகள் அவர்களின் காதலையும் வாழ்க்கையையும் சிதைக்கத் தொடங்குகின்றன. ஒவ்வொரு அசைவும் கண்காணிக்கப்படும் இந்த ஆபத்தான விளையாட்டில், உயிர் பிழைப்பதற்கான விலை மிகவும் கொடூரமாக இருக்கலாம்.

wedding-day-betrayal-3.title: Wedding Day Betrayal
wedding-day-betrayal-3.description: Maheep aar Shaurya er biye shedin e venge gelo, jhedin theke tar notun jibon shuru howar kotha chilo. Ek dike Maheep er mone chilo shudhu bhalobasha, onyo dike Shaurya er jibone Rhea agun jhaliye dilo. Majhe atokte porlo Shaurya er guilt, Rhea er obsession aar Maheep er vanga bisshash. Protiti shomporke lukiye ache ek raaz, aar protiti raaz er pechone ache ek karon... kintu ki shotto kokhono samne ashbe?

lady-boss-returns-13.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns-13.description: 'लेडी बॉस रिटर्न्स' ही कियारा बन्सल या एका अत्यंत प्रभावशाली आणि गूढ 'स्काय क्वीन'ची कथा आहे. आपली खरी ओळख लपवून ती एका सामान्य रिसेप्शनिस्टच्या वेशात भारतात येते. तिथे तिची भेट तेज जयसिंगशी होते, जो आपल्या वडिलांच्या जबरदस्तीच्या लग्नापासून पळत असतो. जेव्हा कियाराचा विश्वासघातकी प्रियकर ऋषी तिचा सर्वांसमोर अपमान करतो, तेव्हा कियारा आपली खरी ओळख 'स्काय क्वीन' म्हणून उघड करण्याचा निर्णय घेते. ही मालिका विश्वासघात, प्रेम, कॉर्पोरेट जगतातील राजकारण आणि एका महिलेच्या जबरदस्त पुनरागमनाचा प्रवास आहे.

dhurandhar-sniper-1.title: Dhurandhar Sniper
dhurandhar-sniper-1.description: ఒక సంవత్సరం పాటు రోహన్‌ను అందరూ సాధారణ క్లీనర్‌గా మాత్రమే చూశారు. కానీ అతనే ప్రపంచంలోనే అత్యంత ప్రమాదకరమైన స్నైపర్ G-9. గతాన్ని వదిలేసి ప్రశాంతంగా జీవిస్తున్న అతను, అకాడమీ మరియు ఓ అమాయక కుటుంబం ప్రమాదంలో పడినప్పుడు మళ్లీ తుపాకీ ఎత్తాల్సి వస్తుంది. ఇప్పుడు ప్రతి షాట్ అతని రహస్యాన్ని బయటపెట్టే ప్రమాదంతో నిండి ఉంది.

dhurandhar-child-king-returns-6.title: Dhurandhar - Child King Returns
