dhurandhar-child-king-returns-6.description: ६ वर्षांचा केशव, जो १००० वर्षांपूर्वीचा चंद्रवंशी युवराज आहे, राजहंस ग्रुपमधील लोभी नातेवाईकांना आव्हान देतो. तो दिव्य शक्ती आणि बुद्धी वापरून कंपनीचे 'लक्झरी डिव्हिजन' जिंकतो. सुधीर आणि रुद्र आजीला विष देतात. केशव 'संजीवनी अर्क' वापरून आजीला वाचवतो. रुद्र आणि मधु राय (सुधीरची प्रेयसी) सुधीरला धोका देतात. अंती, केशव आपल्या गुप्त 'गरुड दलाला' (ज्यात जागतिक नेते आहेत) बोलावतो आणि संपूर्ण भ्रष्ट कुटुंबाला तुरुंगात पाठवून, 'चंद्रवंशी एंटरप्रायजेस' नावाचे नवीन साम्राज्य स्थापन करतो.

jhaadoowala-billionaire-7.title: Jhaadoowala Billionaire
jhaadoowala-billionaire-7.description: পুলকিতের বিশ্বাসঘাতকতায় ভেঙে পড়া স্নেহল বিয়ে করে নীলকে — এক কোটিপতি, যে নিজের বিয়ে এড়াতে ছদ্মবেশে সাফাইকর্মী। কিন্তু এই মিলন জ্বালায় যুদ্ধের আগুন। শাশুড়ি সুধা চায় তার সর্বনাশ, প্রতিশোধপরায়ণ সানিয়া আর লোভী পুলকিত ষড়যন্ত্রে মেতেছে। ক্ষমতা, প্রেম আর বিশ্বাসঘাতকতার এই খেলায় — স্নেহল কি জানতে পারবে নীলের কোটি টাকার রহস্য? নাকি তার মিথ্যার ভার ভেঙে দেবে সব?

sneha-phillip.title: The unsolved Mystery of Sneha Philip

kannan-varuvaan-1.title: Kannan Varuvaan
kannan-varuvaan-1.description: பிதா மகர் பீஷ்மரின் பார்வையில் கண்ணனின் வாழ்க்கை வரலாற்றை பஞ்ச பாண்டவர்களுக்கு எடுத்துரைப்பதாக அழகாக படைக்கப்பட்டது கண்ணன் வருவான். எழுத்தாளர் இந்திரா சௌந்தர்ராஜனின் சிறந்த படைப்பு. கேட்டு மகிழுங்கள் !

ravan-a-devotee-or-a-demon.title: Ravan: A Devotee Or A Demon

final-trust.title: Final Trust
final-trust.description: Sunaina, a divorcee, is forced into a new life by billionaire Anya’s stubbornness to find her father a wife, Sagar. Sagar hides his wealth to live simply, but Sunaina’s toxic ex and greedy relatives return to torment her. Will she ever learn that her humble husband is actually a tycoon? Amidst betrayal and hidden riches, how will this love story end?

the-final-boss-12.title: The Final Boss
the-final-boss-12.description: Megha rejects her boyfriend Sudeep Raj's proposal, saying she’d rather marry a powerful “invisible CEO” than a “loser” like him—unaware that Raj is actually the world’s richest and most mysterious CEO. Meanwhile, CEO Anamika Gauri offers Raj ₹5 lakh per month to be her contract husband. What happens when both women discover his true identity?

instant-pelli.title: Instant pelli
instant-pelli.description: A woman enters a rushed marriage to fulfill her grandfather’s wish, but her husband leaves without revealing himself. Months later, she unknowingly works for him as his employee. Misunderstandings push them toward divorce, even as they slowly fall in love. When the truth is revealed, they must choose between separation and love.

revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend-7.title: Revenge of My Fake Boyfriend
revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend-7.description: A self-made businessman is offered a fake marriage by a powerful heiress to protect her family legacy. What starts as a simple deal slowly turns into a mix of emotions, ego, and revenge. When his past heartbreak pushes him to reveal his true identity, everything begins to fall apart.

ragasiya-ilavarasan.title: Ragasiya Ilavarasan
ragasiya-ilavarasan.description:
அதிகாரம், பணம், துரோகம் நிரம்பிய corporate உலகில், சாதாரண மனிதனாக தோன்றும் ராஜ், உண்மையில் எல்லாவற்றையும் பின்னாலிருந்து கட்டுப்படுத்தும் மர்ம நாயகன்.

அவமானங்களாலும் துரோகங்களாலும் சிதைந்த அனாமிகாவின் வாழ்க்கையில் அவர் நுழைந்து, ஒரு போலியான திருமணத்தின் மூலம் அவளின் எதிரிகளை அழித்து, அவளின் பேரரசை மீண்டும் எழுப்புகிறார்.

ஆனால், அதிகாரத்திற்காக தொடங்கிய இந்த கூட்டணி, காதல், ego, மற்றும் பழிவாங்குதல் மோதும் ஆபத்தான விளையாட்டாக மாறுகிறது.

இளமை-திரும்புதே-.title: Ilamai Thirumputhey
இளமை-திரும்புதே-.description: வெற்றிகரமான வாழ்க்கை வாழும் சம்பத் திருமேனி, தனிமை என்ற ஒரு வெற்றிடத்துடன் போராடுகிறார். அந்த வெற்றிடத்தை நிரப்ப மகள் திவ்யா முயற்சிக்கும்போது, வாழ்க்கையில் பல துன்பங்களை கடந்து வந்த வந்தனா அவரது வாழ்வில் நுழைகிறார். மறைக்கப்பட்ட உண்மைகள், காணாமல் போன குழந்தையின் ரகசியம், மற்றும் உறவுகளின் சிக்கல்கள்  இவை அனைத்தும் சேர்ந்து அவர்களின் வாழ்க்கையை மாற்றும் ஒரு உணர்ச்சி மிகுந்த பயணமாக மாறுகிறது.

the-final-boss-10.title: The Final Boss
the-final-boss-10.description:
பணமும் அதிகாரமும் நிறைந்த corporate உலகத்தில், ஒரு சாதாரண மனிதனாக தோன்றும் ராஜ், உண்மையில் எல்லாவற்றையும் பின்னாலிருந்து கட்டுப்படுத்தும் ஒரு மர்ம சக்தி.
அவமானங்களும் துரோகங்களும் நடுவில் போராடும் அனாமிகாவுக்கு அவர் துணையாக நின்று, அவளின் வாழ்க்கையையும் பேரரசையும் மீண்டும் கட்டியெழுப்புகிறார்.
Fake marriage-ஆ தொடங்கும் அவர்களின் உறவு, காதல், அதிகாரம், பழி வாங்குதல் ஆகியவற்றின் மத்தியில் ஒரு ஆபத்தான விளையாட்டாக மாறுகிறது.

dhurandhar-child-king-returns-2.title: Keshav - Child King Returns
dhurandhar-child-king-returns-2.description:
ஆயிரம் ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன் வாழ்ந்த ஒரு சக்திவாய்ந்த சக்கரவர்த்தி, விதியின் விளையாட்டால் இன்றைய உலகில் ஒரு ஆறு வயது குழந்தையாக பிறக்கிறார். கேசவன் என்ற அந்த சிறுவன், தன் பழைய நினைவுகளும் அறிவும் கொண்டு அவனை தள்ளுபடி செய்யும் குடும்பத்தையும், அவனை அவமதிக்கும் உலகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்கிறான்.
அவன் வெறும் குழந்தையா? இல்லையென்றால்… திரும்பி வந்த அரசனா?

tiger-ravinder-kaushik.title: Tiger Ravindra Kaushik : India's Best Spy

doctors-vs-billionaires-2.title: Doctors vs Billionaires
doctors-vs-billionaires-2.description:
A wealthy family hides a dangerous mix of love, control, and ego. When 11-year-old Arya suddenly collapses after a small moment of joy, a race against time begins. But in a cruel twist, her own mother unknowingly delays the doctor trying to save her.
As seconds slip away, one question remains: How much can ego cost a life?

royal-gaonwali-3.title: Royal Gaonwali
royal-gaonwali-3.description: Aksha, an innocent village girl, dreams of finding her real mother and true family. Living in the city with Rajeshwari and her jealous daughter Isha, her life changes when her fiancé Vishal comes searching for her. Greedy for wealth and status, Isha steals Aksha’s identity and claims to be Vishal’s childhood friend. As conspiracies unfold, will Aksha reclaim her truth and love, or remain trapped in Isha’s web?

my-homeless-billionaire-husband-10.title: My Homeless Billionaire Husband
my-homeless-billionaire-husband-10.description:
Aakriti chose a homeless beggar, Shashwat, to pretend to be her fake boyfriend—but she had no idea that Shashwat had truly fallen in love with her. What she doesn’t know is that Shashwat is actually an undercover billionaire.

How will Shashwat confess his love to Aakriti without revealing his secret identity? Despite being immensely wealthy, why is he living the life of a homeless beggar?

In this intense game of power, betrayal, and love, will Shashwat succeed in winning Aakriti’s heart?

billion-dollar-wala-blunder-3.title: Billion Dollar Wala Blunder
billion-dollar-wala-blunder-3.description: Sakshi, a bold and glamorous event manager, accidentally insults her company’s founder and his wife, triggering a deadly chain of events. As hidden secrets begin to surface, the arrival of the charismatic yet formidable Arvind turns everything upside down. What follows is an intense battle of love, ambition, power, and betrayal.

cricket-champion-9.title: Cricket Champion
cricket-champion-9.description: The oldest and most mysterious shot in cricket history — the Phantom Shot. Legends say only the God of Cricket can play it. One night, the Gymkhana Cricket Club wall is found mysteriously broken, and the coach suspects the Phantom Shot. With the club ground and a ₹1000 crore deal at risk, the hunt begins. Who played this century-old shot? Can Gymkhana find the God of Cricket? Discover the answer in Cricket Champion.

cricket-champion-8.title: Cricket Champion
cricket-champion-8.description: In a small ground where no one expects magic, **Arun** picks up a bat and changes the game forever. His strange, powerful shot shocks players, coaches, and crowds alike. Laughed at and ignored at first, Arun’s talent refuses to stay hidden. From nowhere to everywhere, this is the rise of a true cricket champion.

cricket-champion-7.title: Cricket Champion
cricket-champion-7.description: ఫ్యాంటం షాట్. క్రికెట్ లోని పాత షాట్. అలాంటి షాట్ తో గోడను సైతం కూల్చగలరు. జింఖానా క్లబ్ లో అలాంటి షాట్ ఆడే ప్లేయర్ ఉన్నాడు. ఆ విషయం ఆ క్లబ్ లోని ప్లేయర్లకు, కోచ్ కి తెలియదు. ఫ్యాంటం షాట్ ఆడే ప్లేయర్ ఆడే ఆటగాడు క్రికెట్ ని పక్కన పెట్టి సాధారణ మనిషిగా ఎందుకు మారాడన్నది ఆసక్తికరమైన కథ.

royal-village-girl-2.title: Royal Gaowali
royal-village-girl-2.description:
Aisha arrives in the city with her mother, only to be shunned by her status-conscious sister, Isha. She hides her identity, rises as a wealthy heiress, and follows a pendant’s clue to her true past.
A shocking DNA reveal exposes Isha’s lies, as Aisha reclaims her real name, her mother, and her honor.

aap-bhi-ban-sakte-hain-ias.title: Aap bhi IAS ban sakte hai

eetharam-ammaayi.title: Royal Gaowali
eetharam-ammaayi.description: పేదరికాన్ని చీదరించుకుని డబ్బు కోసం పెరుగెత్తే ఈషా, పేదరికాన్ని తట్టుకుని నిలబడి జీవితాన్ని మార్చుకోవాలి అనుకునే అక్షర. రెండు విభిన్న మనస్తత్వాలు కలిగిన అక్కచెల్లెళ్ళ కథ ఇది.

billionaire-groom-is-my-new-husband-4.title: Jhadoowala Billionaire
billionaire-groom-is-my-new-husband-4.description: Neel, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Snehal, an orphaned bride abandoned at her wedding, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

daliton-ke-utthan-mein-jj-ram-ka-yogdan.title: Daliton Ke Utthan mein JJ Ram Ka Yogdan

billion-dollar-mess-5.title: Billion dollar wala blunder
billion-dollar-mess-5.description: Sakshi, who works as a manager in a company, makes a major mistake at a charity event. She hopes to marry Aravind, the owner of the company. However, her mistake causes heavy losses. Will she end up marrying him? What happens to Sakshi, who looked down upon people without money?

billionaire-groom-is-my-new-husband-3.title: Jhadoowala Billionaire
billionaire-groom-is-my-new-husband-3.description: Naveen Raymond, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Sona, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Naveen. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

love-and-love-only-1.title: Love and Love Only
love-and-love-only-1.description: Arjun believed he was just an ordinary orphan, but everything changed the day his lover Thara brutally dumped him at the wedding occasion. Saved at his lowest point by Meera, who married him on the spot, his hidden life as a genius AI developer was finally pushed into the light, setting him on a path to reclaim his stolen family fortune.

nee-kavithaigala.title: Nee Kavithaigala
nee-kavithaigala.description: சில சமயம் உண்மையான காதல், நாம தேட நினைக்காத இடத்துல இருந்து கிடைக்கும்... அப்படி தான் வர்ஷினிக்கும் சித்தார்த் மூலமா கிடைச்சது... ஆனா போராட்டம் இல்லாம எந்த காதல் ஜெய்ச்சு இருக்கு? வர்ஷினி அன்ட் சித்து வாழ்க்கைல அப்படி என்ன தான் நடந்துச்சுன்னு, நீ கவிதைகளா பார்த்து தெரிஞ்சுக்கோங்க...

loser-to-legend.title: Loser To Legend
loser-to-legend.description: Lee’s story begins with a sudden displacement into a 17th-century household where he is humiliated, rejected, and pushed out of family protection. Public shame quickly becomes a fight over inheritance, engagement, and status, as those around him use household authority to strip him of wealth and standing. Rather than disappear, Lee turns his disgrace into a vow of revenge and tries to recover power through wit, calculation, and modern knowledge. He first enters the gambling world, where he shocks the room by winning against a rigged setup and refuses to be controlled by the house. The conflict then widens into public performance, and Lee earns attention through poetry and sharp verbal defiance even while rivals accuse him of cheating or madness. His refusal to submit to court authority brings harsher punishment, including exclusion from the palace and repeated clashes with royal figures. At the same time, the story reveals that his strange behavior is tied to practical invention and experimentation, especially around gobar, oranges, fertilizer, and other unusual materials. These experiments are treated with suspicion, but they also place him at the center of a larger crisis involving defense, diplomacy, and a looming threat from the north. As the court struggles with war pressure, secret weapons, and demands for silver, Lee is accused, bargained with, and forced to prove himself under tight deadlines. His role shifts from disgraced outsider to useful strategist when he is asked to help counter danger and is later protected by royal decree. The middle of the story also adds a strong healing thread, as Lee takes on dangerous medical cases and wins trust by attempting cures others doubt. One patient’s survival becomes tied to a marriage promise, showing how romance, gratitude, and survival are constantly linked. Around him, other characters pursue alliances through marriage, revenge, or political leverage, making personal bonds part of the kingdom’s power struggles. Princesses, queens, ministers, and family elders all try to control who marries whom and who gets to speak for the realm. Lee repeatedly resists being owned by any side, even when that resistance costs him access, safety, or reputation. By the later stretch, his talents in healing, invention, and strategy make him harder to dismiss, though suspicion never fully disappears. The overall arc is one of humiliation turning into contested rise: Lee is mocked, expelled, and doubted, but he keeps forcing his way back into relevance through skill, stubbornness, and risky bargains.

agnyatha-sainikudu.title: Agnyatha Sainikudu
agnyatha-sainikudu.description: While delivering his fallen friend's ashes to his family, Abhiram crosses paths with fearless lawyer Shruti and becomes entangled in a web of corruption, crime, and betrayal. Mistaken for an ordinary man, he is relentlessly targeted until his hidden identity as an elite special operations officer is revealed. Driven by duty, sacrifice, and patriotism, Abhiram risks everything to protect the nation and bring justice to the innocent.

tu-khwabon-mein-he-mere.title: Tu Khwabon Mein He Mere
tu-khwabon-mein-he-mere.description: Abhay's daughter Myra fights for her life after being trapped inside a vault, but even as he desperately tries to save her, Ritika falls deeper into Jimmy's manipulation and turns against her own husband. Later, Abhay uncovers CCTV evidence exposing Jimmy's role in the incident, while Jimmy secretly plots to steal the couple's priceless research for his own gain.

queens-comeback.title: Queen's Comeback
queens-comeback.description: After being heartlessly discarded by her tech-CEO husband on their anniversary, a seemingly ordinary assistant reveals her secret identity as the legendary hacker "Doctor Nova" to reclaim her power. Joining forces with her ex’s greatest rival in a high-stakes contract marriage, she orchestrates a brilliant corporate revenge to dismantle her former husband's empire and find true respect.

mannin-makan.title: Mannin Makan
mannin-makan.description: Arjun believed he was just an ordinary orphan, but everything changed the day his lover Thara brutally dumped him at the wedding occasion. Saved at his lowest point by Meera, who married him on the spot, his hidden life as a genius AI developer was finally pushed into the light, setting him on a path to reclaim his stolen family fortune.

legacy-of-betrayal.title: Legacy of Betrayal
legacy-of-betrayal.description: After four years in a mental asylum, Aarav returns home only to be rejected by Devyani, the woman he believes is his mother. Branded as an illegitimate son, he silently endures her hatred while protecting her from a deadly conspiracy. As long-buried secrets come to light, Devyani discovers that Aarav is actually her real son, setting the stage for an emotional battle of truth, betrayal, and redemption.

coolie-ri-diamond-bindani.title: Coolie Ri Diamond Bindani
coolie-ri-diamond-bindani.description:
aa ek dil ne chu lene wali prem kahani hai, jathe ek sadharan lagan walo coolie Aaryan or amir ghar ri chori Aarohi ro pyaar samaaj ri reet-riwaj aur hasiyat su takrav kare hai. jad pariwaar aur duniya inka rishta ro virodh kare hai, to saamne aave hai Aryan ri asal pehchaan ro raaz - kaai woh sach me coolie hai ya koi aur?
pyaar, dhokha or pehchaan ri ee ladai me kaai Aarohi apna dil ri baad mansi ya pariwaar re dabaav me jhuk jasi?

ssc-gd-kiske-liye-best-hai.title: SSC GD - Kiske Liye Best Hai?
ssc-gd-kiske-liye-best-hai.description: SSC GD - Kiske Liye Best Hai?

auto-aale-ki-vip-bahu.title: Auto Aale Ki VIP Bahu
auto-aale-ki-vip-bahu.description:
A runaway bride with a gun. A rickshaw driver fleeing dangerous goons. One chaotic collision in the crowded streets of Lucknow pulls two complete strangers into each other's lives in the most unexpected way.
With secrets on both sides, mistaken identities, and trouble at every turn, their worlds keep colliding — whether they like it or not.
This is a story of two misfits, one mad city, and the chaos that secretly looks a lot like love.

degreehin-daktar.title: Degreehin Daktar
degreehin-daktar.description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

bewafaai.title: Bewafaai
bewafaai.description: The parents of a young girl are dead because of her. Turns out its a part of the plan executed by her husband to snatch all her property from her. What happens when she returns to take revenge from him

chayer-kape-shopno.title: Chayer Kape Shopno
chayer-kape-shopno.description:
A billionaire CEO. A 1000 crore fraud. A disguise no one would ever suspect.
When Arjun Mehra discovers his Kolkata office is bleeding money from the inside, he doesn't send an auditor — he becomes a chaiwala. Trading his penthouse for a tea stall right outside his own company, he watches, listens, and waits.
This is a story of the most powerful man in the room — hiding in plain sight.

doctor-supreme.title: Doctor Supreme
doctor-supreme.description: A mysterious young healer, Kai, leaves his secluded mountain after his mentors send him to fulfill a decade-old marriage promise. But the powerful Tang family insults and rejects him, unaware that he is the legendary master of Dragon Gate and possesses unmatched medical and martial powers. Betrayed yet fearless, Kai begins a journey where enemies become allies, hidden identities are revealed, and those who mocked him are forced to kneel before his true greatness.

protarok-ex.title: Protarok Ex
protarok-ex.description: Aditya builds his career from scratch after his ex Anushka abandons him. Years later, she returns as his boss and billionaire's wife — obsessed, manipulative, and dangerous. When Aditya refuses her advances, she destroys his reputation, gets him fired, and frames him for assault. With his wife Malvika's love as his armor, Aditya picks up his forgotten law degree and fights back. A story of obsession, betrayal, and the price of choosing power over love.

dragon-blood-warrior.title: Dragon Blood Warrior
dragon-blood-warrior.description: When martial arts master Zhao is murdered for the secret Asht Naag Vidya, his young son Tian escapes with the ancient power hidden inside him. Raised by Hu Fenghuang and the struggling Hu Clan, Tian grows up hiding his true strength while mastering the eight forbidden techniques. As a ruthless rival clan threatens to enslave his family, Tian must choose between keeping his father's promise or revealing his destiny.

ravana-mavanda.title: Ravana Mavanda
ravana-mavanda.description: பத்து வருடங்கள் சிறையில் இருக்கும் ரவுடி ராஜன், தன் கடந்த காலத்தை மறந்து, ஒரு நல்ல தந்தையாக மாறி மகள் செல்வியை பார்க்க செல்கிறான்.  ஆனால் செல்வி வாழ்கையில் நடக்கும் கொடுமைகள் ராஜனின் மறைக்கப்பட்ட பக்கங்களை வெளிக்கொண்டு வருகிறது... ஒரு தந்தை மற்றும் மகளின் பாச போராட்டத்தை இந்த கதையில் காணுங்கள்....

secret-adhikaari.title: Secret Adhikaari
secret-adhikaari.description: Everyone believes Siddharth is just an ordinary laborer. But as powerful enemies close in and hidden truths begin to surface, a deadly game of deception changes everyone's fate.

dont-mess-with-my-grandma.title: Don't Mess with My Grandma
dont-mess-with-my-grandma.description: After surviving heart surgery, a humble old woman and her granddaughter are tortured and humiliated by her son’s greedy fiancée, who believes they are frauds. But when the truth explodes at a grand family banquet, the ruthless woman’s lies, abuse, and scam are exposed before everyone

guru-vaarisu.title: Guru Vaarisu
guru-vaarisu.description: Gopi begins as a loyal wrestler trained by Guruji, but he is pushed away from his village and sent toward Mumbai with a hidden promise and an unfinished truth hanging over him. On the road and in the city, violence follows him, and he repeatedly protects women caught in danger, revealing that his calm manner hides serious fighting skill. In Mumbai, he enters the Agarwal family’s world, where marriage, inheritance, and property are tightly linked. Anjali resists the arranged match and the family’s control, while elders treat the marriage as a solution to both status and succession. Gopi arrives as an outsider tied to Anjali by a sacred proposal, and class prejudice quickly turns him into a target. The family’s pressure grows until marriage registration is forced and even a mansion is offered as a wedding gift, making the union feel more like a power move than a choice. The story then shifts into a colder marriage arc with Kavitha, where the relationship is defined by duty, distance, and family obligation rather than affection. Kavitha insists on rules and separation, while Gopi refuses to abandon her and keeps promising to stand by her. Their conflict deepens inside the house and at work, where Gopi is mocked for his village roots and lack of education, yet Kavitha unexpectedly defends him. Danger also spreads through the family, as suspicion of poisoning rises when Kavitha appears unwell and Gopi uncovers that a doctor was instructed to give her poison. Outside the home, public and business conflicts intensify, including the exposure of fake herbal fraud, showing that deception surrounds the family on every side. A sudden miracle then changes the tone when a woman in a wheelchair regains movement, briefly opening the story to healing and hope. At the same time, Anjali confronts Gopi about his hidden identity as Grandmaster Gopi and later apologizes for humiliating him, while Gopi admits his love and turns his attention toward Rocky as a major threat. The mystery of Gopi’s past deepens when he learns his parents died twenty years earlier and that something was left for him in Bahadurpur beneath a banyan tree. His search there leads to a violent clash with an opponent tied to his family history, and a farewell letter from his mother warns him to stay safe while seeking the truth. The final stretch widens the conflict into a blood feud over murder, betrayal, and the Agarwal company, with Kavitha refusing to surrender either her roots or the business. Rocky emerges as a ruthless force who wants the pendant linked to the hidden Grandmaster and keeps attacking, threatening, and humiliating others. By the end, family loyalty, inheritance, romance, and revenge are all entangled, and Gopi stands at the center of a struggle that is both personal and deeply tied to the family’s past.

falling-for-a-farm-king-2.title: Falling For a Farm King
falling-for-a-farm-king-2.description:
A broken single father, Saumya Raghuvanshi, is emotionally blackmailed by his ruthless grandmother into marrying Simar, an orphan girl sold into marriage for money.
What begins as a cold-hearted deal for his mute daughter Kuhu’s care slowly transforms into an intense battle of trust, healing, and love.
Amid family conspiracies, a jealous stepbrother, and dangerous betrayals, Simar must prove she is not a purchased bride… but the woman destined to rebuild a shattered family.

heroine-r-kotipoti-chakor.title: Heroine-r Kotipoti Chakor
heroine-r-kotipoti-chakor.description: Ragini, a vain star, humiliates devoted manager Kabir while chasing Samar, a married man faking ties to tycoon Kabir Kapoor. Truth surfaces: Kabir IS Kabir Kapoor. Samar's exposed, Ragini's career and looks are destroyed, and Kabir rejects her for loyal Tanya, proposing to her onstage. Blacklisted and alone, Ragini discovers she's pregnant with Kabir's child—and sees her chance. She vows to use the baby to tear Tanya and Kabir apart and reclaim everything she lost.of ambition and revenge.

auto-raja-preethi.title: Auto Raja Preethi
auto-raja-preethi.description:
A runaway bride with a gun. A rickshaw driver fleeing dangerous goons. One chaotic collision in the crowded streets of Lucknow pulls two complete strangers into each other's lives in the most unexpected way.
With secrets on both sides, mistaken identities, and trouble at every turn, their worlds keep colliding — whether they like it or not.
This is a story of two misfits, one mad city, and the chaos that secretly looks a lot like love.

ssc-cgl-ki-sabse-powerful-post.title: SSC CGL Ki Sabse Powerful Post
ssc-cgl-ki-sabse-powerful-post.description: SSC CGL Ki Sabse Powerful Post

samrajyam.title: Samrajyam
samrajyam.description: The story centers on a prolonged battle for control of Aakash Group, where money troubles, missing funds, and worker unrest push the company toward collapse. Raghavan is repeatedly cornered by younger rivals and business enemies who want him to sign away the company and its assets. As pressure mounts, he is forced into painful sacrifices, including selling personal property to raise money for wages and urgent medical needs. Ananya stays close to him through the crisis and helps him manage the fallout. The conflict is not only corporate but deeply personal, because old loyalties, betrayals, and unresolved history keep resurfacing. Smitha/Shwetha’s terminal illness adds emotional weight and makes the struggle over money even more urgent. Several batches suggest that family members and insiders are divided, with some defending Raghavan and others trying to humiliate or replace him. The takeover fight expands beyond one company as Karthik Group becomes tied to the dispute and its chairman’s authority is repeatedly invoked or challenged. Disputed documents, forged or contested cheques, and accusations of fraud become central weapons in the war for legitimacy. Public confrontations at elite events turn status into a battlefield, where guests are insulted, removed, or forced to prove they belong. Revathi emerges as a strong defender who refuses to be silenced and keeps insisting that the truth will come out. Sravathi and other women also resist humiliation and push back against the men trying to control the situation. The story repeatedly shifts between boardroom pressure and family confrontation, showing how business power and personal dignity are linked. A major turning point comes when Raghavan’s past sacrifices are exposed, undermining the fraud accusations against him. He is revealed as someone who once rescued and supported others, which changes how the conflict is understood. By the later episodes, traitors are publicly exposed and expelled, but the damage to trust, reputation, and relationships remains severe. The overall arc is less about a clean victory than about survival, loyalty, and whether the company can be held together after so many betrayals.

coffee-ammayi-ambulance-abbayi.title: Coffee Ammayi Ambulance Abbayi
coffee-ammayi-ambulance-abbayi.description: A betrayed coffee-shop girl marries the ambulance driver who saves her life on her wedding day, unaware that he is secretly a billionaire. As love grows between them, he protects her from repeated humiliation while hiding the truth that could break their relationship.

ssc-cgl-shuruaat-se-success-tak.title: SSC CGL: Shuruaat Se Success Tak
ssc-cgl-shuruaat-se-success-tak.description: SSC CGL: Shuruaat Se Success Tak

royal-strangers-2.title: Royal Strangers
royal-strangers-2.description: A simple elderly couple visits their billionaire son’s luxury empire to celebrate their anniversary, but their modest appearance makes the staff mistake them for beggars. Humiliated, tortured, and thrown out of their own empire, they silently endure brutal cruelty while their powerful son remains unaware of the truth. Royal Strangers is an emotional revenge drama about class, arrogance, hidden identity, and a family pushed to the edge.

ssc-cgl-2026-sapna-ya-time-waste.title: SSC CGL 2026: Sapna Ya Time Waste?
ssc-cgl-2026-sapna-ya-time-waste.description: SSC CGL 2026: Sapna Ya Time Waste?

lucky-love-birds.title: Lucky & Love Birds
lucky-love-birds.description: A kind-hearted, middle-class boy from remote village joins Bengaluru's most elite college as a hostel caretaker, where he discovers a mysterious AI-powered system hidden inside a pair of smart glasses. To save his sick mother and escape poverty, he must win the hearts of three extraordinary girls to unlock superhuman abilities

maa-vidaakula-pandaga.title: Maa Vidaakula Pandaga
maa-vidaakula-pandaga.description: హరిశ్చంద్ర ఒక సాధారణ రైతు. సిటీకి వెళ్ళిన తన భార్య రాక కోసం అతను పల్లెటూరిలో ఎదురు చూస్తూ ఉన్నాడు. ఆమె ఒక పెద్ద ట్విస్టుతో వచ్చింది. ఆ తర్వాతే హరిశ్చంద్ర అసలు రూపం అందరికీ తెలిసింది. ప్రేమలో ఎదురు చూపులు సహజం. ఎంత కాలం ఎదురు చూడాలనేదే ప్రశ్న. అందరినీ ఆకట్టుకునే ఫ్యామిలీ డ్రామా మా విడాకుల పండగ.

shaadi-by-chance.title: Shaadi by Chance
shaadi-by-chance.description: Rashmika Khanna’s story begins with a marriage that is formed in confusion and immediately surrounded by secrecy, family pressure, and business interests. A blurred registrar-office encounter leaves her unsure of who she actually married, and that uncertainty follows her into every part of her life. The marriage is treated less like romance than like a contract, with strict boundaries, separate living, and constant scrutiny from both family and corporate circles. As Rashmika struggles with debt, her grandmother’s medical needs, and the loss of support from friends, she is pulled into Alpha Group’s orbit through office work, internships, and secretary duties. The workplace becomes another battlefield, where rumors, humiliation, blackmail, and demotion threaten her dignity. At the same time, senior men repeatedly intervene on her behalf, sometimes as protectors and sometimes as controlling figures, making her position even more unstable. Her hidden marriage status creates confusion about whether she is single, married, separated, or already headed for divorce. Legal papers, compensation demands, and delayed separation keep the relationship unresolved even when divorce seems close. Rashmika is also forced into survival tactics, including part-time violin work and temporary shelter arrangements, to keep herself afloat. Illness and hospital scenes expose how little security she has in her personal life, especially when her husband appears distant or absent. In response, friends and allies suggest cover stories, fake husbands, and other protective lies, but those solutions remain fragile and transactional. The story repeatedly returns to the question of identity: who Rashmika married, who is protecting her, and who is using her situation for control. Samir or Sameer Sharma emerges as the central powerful figure around whom the confusion, protection, and attraction gather, though the exact nature of his role shifts across the arc. He intervenes against harassment, supports her work, and also pushes for control over the marriage and divorce process. As public scandals, family confrontations, and rival women intensify, Rashmika is dragged deeper into a web of class tension and social judgment. Even when she is humiliated, she refuses to stay silent and begins to use the false marriage narrative more strategically. By the later stretch, the line between pretense and feeling starts to blur, especially when she is forced to live inside the Sharma family’s world. Yet the legal marriage remains unresolved, and the emotional stakes rise because the truth could damage reputations, family standing, and Rashmika’s future. The show ends with the central conflict still open: Rashmika is caught between divorce, protection, public scandal, and a relationship that may be becoming real even as it remains legally and socially unstable.

kodeeswaran-time-traveller.title: Kodeeswaran Time Traveller
kodeeswaran-time-traveller.description: கடந்தகாலத்தில் அப்பாவை தூக்கி எறிந்த மகன் . தன் தாயின் உண்மை முகமறிந்து காலம் கடந்து அப்பாவை கொடிய அம்மாவிடமிருந்து காப்பாற்ற வருகிறான் . இருவரும் அம்மாவை தூக்கி எறிந்து இந்த உலகத்தயே திரும்பி பாக்க வைக்கும் சக்தியாக மாறுகிறார்கள் !!

tum-woh-nahi.title: Tum Woh Nahi
tum-woh-nahi.description: Aarohi believes she has killed her abusive husband Karan after years of betrayal and the death of their daughter. But the next day, he returns alive—now caring, protective, and completely different. As hidden identities, family secrets, corporate conspiracies, and a mysterious twin unravel, Aarohi is forced to question everything she knows about love, revenge, and the man she once called her husband. Watch now.

vanaraju.title: Vanaraju
vanaraju.description: Nilakantha is the fearless guardian of a mystical forest, blessed with the power of water. But if this extraordinary power is misused, it could destroy everything. Branded a traitor through the Sarpanch's son's conspiracy, Nilakantha loses the trust of his own people. Meanwhile, Vikram pretends to be their savior while secretly plotting to destroy the village and the forest. When the forest goddess Mira reveals that Nilakantha is her true heir, he embraces his destiny.

cheating-takeoff.title: Cheating @ Takeoff
cheating-takeoff.description: In his past life, betrayed by his wife and best friend, an air traffic controller heroically saved a plane from disaster caused by their deliberate sabotage. Despite his selfless act, he was framed, publicly condemned, and ultimately beaten to death by enraged passengers fueled by their lies. Reborn, he chooses a different path. This time, he will watch as they face the devastating consequences of their own actions.

magic-money.title: Magic Money
magic-money.description:
Dev, a kind-hearted waiter, loses everything in one night — his job, his wife, and his dignity — all at the hands of the one person he trusted most.
With his mother's life on the line and nowhere to turn, the world humiliates him at every step.
This is a story of Dev — a man left with nothing but his will, and what he builds from the ground up.

अरबपति-रो-सफर.title: अरबपति रो सफर
अरबपति-रो-सफर.description: ek safar jathe takat, pisha or raaz takarave hai, to safar or bhi khatarnaak ho jave hai, Aa kahani hai surya mittal or meera ki, donya ki zindagi bilkul alag hai lekin kismat su ek khatrnaak safar me milya surya or meera ek jhutha rishta re khel me bandh jaave hai lekin dhire-dhire o jhutho rishto ek prem ri dor su bandh jave hai, lekin surya mittal ra kayi raaz jad meera or duniya re saame aave hai to rishta or bhi ulazh jave hai, aa kahani hai prem, pehchaan or khud ne sabit karne ri.

crown-in-shadows.title: Crown in Shadows
crown-in-shadows.description: Mocked as a nobody and abandoned by the women who chased status, Hao shocks everyone by choosing Kaira—the scarred girl the world rejected. But beneath his humble facade lies a hidden king with power beyond imagination. As enemies scheme and ex-lovers regret their choices, Hao raises Kaira from humiliation to royalty, forcing an entire city to bow before the queen they once despised.

indian-revenge-of-rebels.title: Indian : Revenge Of Rebels
indian-revenge-of-rebels.description: ஆங்கிலேயனை விரட்டி ஒரு தமிழனை மணம்  முடித்த வீர மங்கை மணிமேகலை . ஜமீன் பரம்பரையான அவளை தன் தாய் தந்தையே கொல்ல முற்படுகிறார்கள் . சுதந்திர போராட்டத்தின் மத்தியில் அவள் கணவன் அவளை காப்பாற்றுவானா ? அந்த ஜமீன் சொத்து மணிமேகலைக்கு கிடைக்குமா ? இந்தியா விடுதலை அடையுமா ?

taaza-taaza-kharbein.title: Taaza Taaza Khabrein
taaza-taaza-kharbein.description: Arav Malhotra returns to the family news channel after his father Aditya Malhotra’s suspicious death and quickly finds himself treated like an outsider in his own workplace. He is publicly humiliated, blocked from his father’s office, and forced into low-level work while he quietly searches for the truth. Early clues, including his father’s warning about tampered brakes and later missing evidence such as a photograph, tapes, and a hard drive, keep pointing him toward murder rather than accident. The newsroom around him is unstable and corrupt, with ratings pressure, hierarchy, and theatrical reporting often overpowering ethics. A journalist helps him get inside the channel, and that working relationship may also become personal, though secrecy and suspicion remain constant. As Arav hides his identity and investigates from within, he is repeatedly mocked as a peon even while showing intelligence and resolve. Family revelations deepen the pressure when he is identified as Aditya’s son and Nani’s grandson, confirming that his search is tied to a buried inheritance and unresolved family conflict. At the same time, powerful figures try to manage him indirectly, suggesting that he may be protected, manipulated, or both. The channel’s public image keeps collapsing under scandals, protests, and live-broadcast crises, showing how easily truth is buried beneath spectacle. The Monkey Man story, miracle-style broadcasts, and other sensational coverage reveal how far the newsroom will go for ratings. Outside unrest, including a violent workers’ protest and a missing reporter, adds to the sense that the whole system is under strain. Inside the company, authority figures continue to tighten control, while Arav keeps pushing back against humiliation and false narratives. A hostile family presence and other internal pressures make his personal search even more dangerous. Founders’ Day and other public moments expose the deeper conflict between the founder’s values and the profit-driven direction of the channel. As hidden deals, loan pressure, and internal maneuvering come to light, the struggle expands beyond one death into a fight over ownership and legacy. By the end of the batch, the truth is still not fully resolved, but the cover-up is increasingly unstable and harder to contain. Arav remains trapped inside the system he is trying to expose, yet his identity and determination have turned him into a direct threat to those in control.

ente-bhagyadevatha.title: Ente Bhagyadevatha
ente-bhagyadevatha.description:
A marriage born out of desperation turns into an unforgettable love story when a billionaire discovers his wife is the mysterious woman who once saved his life.
But before destiny can unite them, they must overcome jealousy, betrayal, and a dangerous conspiracy that threatens their family.Micro Drama

alibaba-aur-chalis-chor.title: Alibaba Ka Jaadui Khazana
alibaba-aur-chalis-chor.description: Jab apne hi bhai ke dhokhe se sab kuch khona padta hai, tab ek seedha-saadha lakadhara Ali Baba, 'Khul Ja Sim Sim' ke jadui khazane tak pahunch kar apni kismat badalne ka mauka paata hai. Par daulat ke saath uske sir par toot padte hain 40 khooni daku, laalchi rishtedaar aur har mod par maut se bhara imtehaan.

halli-haida.title: Halli Haida
halli-haida.description: A humble village farmer and martial arts prodigy, Gopal, arrives in Mumbai to fulfill his guru’s wish and marry the wealthy heiress Anjali, only to discover she despises him and is plotting against her own family.

royal-strangers-1.title: Royal Strangers
royal-strangers-1.description: தங்களின் 25-வது திருமண நாளைக் கொண்டாட ஆடம்பர குடியிருப்புக்கு வரும் ஒரு எளிமையான தம்பதியை, அங்கிருக்கும் ஊழியர்கள் பிச்சைக்காரர்கள் என்று தவறாகப் புரிந்து கொண்டு கொடூரமாக சித்திரவதை செய்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அந்த தம்பதி நாட்டின் மிகப்பெரிய கோடீஸ்வரரான 'பாட்டியா' குடும்பத்தின் மூத்தவர்கள் என்பதும், அந்த இடமே அவர்களது மகனுடையது என்பதும் தெரியவரும்போது ஆட்டம் தலைகீழாக மாறுகிறது.

kaalveer-ka-aagaman.title: Kaalveer ka Aagaman
kaalveer-ka-aagaman.description: Once India's most powerful construction tycoon, Tilak Rana lives as an ordinary fruit seller to raise his son with values instead of privilege. But when a ruthless billionaire's son destroys Harsh's love and threatens his life, Tilak is forced to step in. As his hidden identity begins to unravel, a father's silent sacrifice turns into a battle for love, family, and the empire he left behind.

my-mechanic-brother-runs-the-universe-1.title: My Mechanic Brother Runs The Universe
my-mechanic-brother-runs-the-universe-1.description: The story begins with a technical emergency that pulls Karan into a crisis involving a hacked network and a failing quantum stabilizer. What starts as a machine problem quickly becomes a story about dignity, because Karan is repeatedly judged not by his skill but by his class and mechanic background. He is also racing toward his sister Mythri's wedding, and that family bond stays central even when security blocks him and public humiliation follows. Across weddings and elite gatherings, Mythri and other women repeatedly defend brothers and family members who are mocked by arrogant men. The conflict keeps widening as wealthy figures, businessmen, and powerful hosts turn social events into status contests. Ranvijay Shah emerges as a major force in this world, tied to elite power and to the growing suspicion that money and influence are shaping every relationship. Karan is repeatedly insulted, but he answers with restraint, self-respect, and a fierce protectiveness toward his sister. The pressure also exposes deeper family and business instability, including a massive money dispute, failed investments, frozen accounts, and collapsing plans. As the humiliation escalates, the story hints that Karan is not as ordinary as others believe. His hidden past and the mysterious Star Lord identity begin to reshape how people treat him, especially when his influence proves strong enough to trigger serious investigation. Public confrontations turn physical more than once, showing that pride and prejudice in this world can quickly become violence. At the same time, the narrative keeps returning to love, marriage, and family loyalty, even when those bonds are tangled with funding, arranged expectations, and old betrayals. Maithri's confrontation with Vihaan and other marriage-related tensions suggest that romance is never separate from power here. The elite families try to control who belongs, who marries whom, and who gets to stand in public without shame. By the later part of the story, Karan's hidden authority is no longer easy to dismiss, and the balance of power shifts around him. The final stretch leaves the conflict unresolved but much larger in scope, with business warfare, family collapse, and the Star Lord revelation all feeding into the same struggle over truth, status, and revenge.

the-shadow-king.title: The Shadow King
the-shadow-king.description: Kabir Shekhawat lives as an ordinary man while secretly ruling a global mining empire as the elusive Supremo. His wife Sejal, blinded by ambition, humiliates and divorces him to pursue wealth, power, and proximity to Supremo—unaware that Kabir himself is the man she seeks. As greed, betrayal, and rivalries engulf the mining world, Kabir discovers his true childhood love, Naina, and ultimately exposes the truth, rewarding loyalty while bringing down those driven by arrogance and deception.

yang-asli.title: Yang Asli
yang-asli.description: Seorang pria berpengaruh menjalani kehidupan ganda sebagai pembela keadilan sambil menyembunyikan identitasnya. Pernikahan kontraknya dengan seorang CEO berubah menjadi kisah cinta di tengah intrik perusahaan dan ancaman organisasi misterius. Saat rahasia keluarga, kekayaan, dan identitasnya akhirnya terungkap, keadilan, cinta, dan warisan masa lalu bertemu dalam akhir yang mengejutkan.

a-martyrs-last-wish.title: A Martyr's Last Wish
a-martyrs-last-wish.description: After war hero Captain Vikram Rajpoot's ashes return to India, his grandson Angad sets out to fulfill his final wish. His journey is derailed by the arrogant heiress Sunaina Singhaniya, whose abuse of wealth and power sparks a brutal clash. As buried truths, betrayal, corruption, and old promises unravel, Angad must protect his grandfather's legacy while bringing down a family consumed by greed, ego, and lies.

irul-vasiyam.title: Irul Vasiyam
irul-vasiyam.description: கன்னி பெண்களின் உயிர் தேடி அலைகிறாள்  இரவின் ராணி  ரத்னாங்கி... இவளை அடக்க வருவாளா ஈஸ்வரி?

kaha-gaye-yaduvanshi-1.title: Kaha Gaye Yaduvanshi?
kaha-gaye-yaduvanshi-1.description: Mahabharat ke baad, Gandhari ke shraap aur apne hi vansh ke adharm ke beech, Shri Krishna Yaduvansh ko vinash se bachane ki har sambhav koshish karte hain. Lekin jab niyati apna faisla suna deti hai, tab janm leta hai itihaas ka sabse bada rahasya—Aakhir Kaha Gaye Yaduvanshi?

mere-papa-heeralal.title: Mere Papa Heeralal
mere-papa-heeralal.description: When a self-made billionaire CEO is forced to fake a marriage with a poor lift mechanic to protect her son and save her empire, neither of them realizes that they are actually reunited lovers, the child's real parents, and heirs to a secret that will shake Mumbai's most powerful families.

divine-husband-3.title: Divine Husband
divine-husband-3.description: Once a legendary sage seeking immortality, Anirudh is forced to reincarnate as Rahul, a poor gambler trapped in debt and humiliation. In the human world, he discovers he has a mute wife, Kajal. As his dormant powers awaken, Rahul chooses a new path: to protect her, heal her, and redeem a broken life, even if it costs him his godhood.

theerpu.title: Theerpu
theerpu.description: Publicly humiliated and thrown out as a useless employee, Prithvi hides a shocking truth—he is the real force behind the empire that rejected him. After years of silent sacrifice for love, betrayal turns him ruthless. As he reveals his true identity, he doesn’t fight back—he destroys everything. Now, the woman who insulted him must face the man who can erase her world.

two-idiots.title: Two Idiots
two-idiots.description: Lucky Mehta begins as a humiliated, desperate young man who cannot hold onto ordinary work and keeps stumbling into suspicious opportunities. A high-paying offer pulls him into shady training and criminal errands, and his panic turns even simple tasks into comic disasters. What starts as survival quickly becomes a dangerous game when he is pushed toward an assassination mission and then into a wider web of fraud, offshore money, and fleeing businessmen. As the story expands, Lucky is repeatedly mistaken, chased, and cornered in apartments, hotels, streets, and parking lots, making him look less like a mastermind and more like a frightened man trapped by bad luck. The central object of the conflict becomes a password-protected pen drive or USB drive tied to murder, kidnapping, extortion, bribery, corruption, and land-grabbing. Both criminals and police want it, and each side believes it can expose or protect something bigger than Lucky himself. Gang leaders and their men hunt him while officers like Chintu, CJ, and Constable Jindal tighten the investigation from the other side. The pursuit grows more chaotic as apartment mix-ups, false accusations, missing handcuffs, and broken communication keep everyone off balance. Lucky tries at times to return or hide the drive, but that only deepens the danger and makes him a target for underworld bosses. Police raids and undercover pressure eventually turn the case into a full conspiracy hunt, with evidence being wiped, laptops targeted, and suspects scrambling to erase traces. Chintu, once an awkward amateur detective, becomes more central as he is pushed into real police work and even undercover-style action. Lucky also insists that he is not the mastermind, claiming he was dragged into illegal work after losing his job and girlfriend. That keeps the emotional core on a man trying to prove he is not guilty while still surviving the consequences of being in the wrong place at the wrong time. The tone stays comic, but the stakes keep rising from embarrassment to pursuit to evidence warfare. By the end of the batch, Lucky and the police are working in uneasy alignment, suggesting that his accidental involvement has become essential to cracking the case. The show’s arc is therefore a mix of survival comedy, crime chase, and conspiracy unraveling, with Lucky caught between humiliation, danger, and the hope of clearing his name.

missamma-returns.title: Missamma Returns
missamma-returns.description: వైష్ణవి సాదాసీదా అమ్మాయి కాదు. కానీ ఆమె మామూలు అమ్మాయిగానే భర్త ముందు బతికింది. ఆమె అలా చేయడం వల్లే ఆమె జీవితం తల్లకిందులైంది. ఒక మామూలు వైష్ణవి మిస్సమ్మలా ఎలా మారింది? ఫేక్ ప్రపంచం, ఫేక్ మనుషుల మధ్య ప్రేమను వెతికిన ఒక మామూలు అమ్మాయి కథ.. మిస్సమ్మ రిటర్న్స్

jhukega-nahi-saala-2.title: Jhukega Nahi Saala
jhukega-nahi-saala-2.description: A powerful man living as a taxi driver fights crime while hiding his true identity and past pain. When a woman from his past returns with his daughter, he must protect them and face his enemies and family secrets.

hey-super-nova.title: Hey Super Nova
hey-super-nova.description: சாதாரண மனைவியாக வாழும் ரியா, உலகப் புகழ்பெற்ற ஹேக்கர் "டாக்டர் நோவா" என்பதைக் கூட தனது கணவரிடமிருந்து மறைக்கிறாள். அவன் துரோகம் செய்த பிறகு, தனது உண்மையான திறமையால் அவனது உலகையே தலைகீழாக மாற்ற முடிவு செய்கிறாள்.

verdict-of-love.title: Verdict Of Love
verdict-of-love.description: “Verdict Of Love” is a courtroom drama where justice battles power, manipulation, and emotions. When a poor fruit seller is blamed for an accident caused by a rich man, sharp lawyer steps into a morally complex fight. As cases unfold, the courtroom becomes a stage for truth, love, and ethics, exposing how money and influence twist justice and how courage can challenge it. Watch now.

rise-of-the-dragon-lord.title: Rise of the Dragon Lord
rise-of-the-dragon-lord.description: Betrayed by his own blood and cast out as worthless, Li Zhen loses everything—his family, his power, and his name. But when an ancient Dragon Jade awakens unimaginable power within him, the fallen heir rises stronger than ever. As enemies close in and kingdoms tremble, Zhen must embrace his destiny and become the legendary Dragon Lord.

ajay-the-magical-healer.title: Ajay The Magical Healer
ajay-the-magical-healer.description: a young man named Ajay discovers he possesses mystical powers to both heal and kill with his hands, a secret he carries for fifteen years while building a business empire as the mysterious "Agyaat." After using his abilities to save the daughter of a billionaire and restore the beauty of his long-lost love, Nalini, Ajay faces off against the corrupt Mittal family who once tried to destroy him

knock-do-not-open-the-door.title: Knock! Do not open the door
knock-do-not-open-the-door.description: KNOCK: DO NOT OPEN THE DOOR is a psychological thriller about Tarang Deshmukh, the seemingly perfect caretaker of an isolated Airbnb bungalow, whose twisted sense of justice turns his home into a deadly trap. As Inspector Kabir investigates a series of disappearances linked to the bungalow, the arrival of Alisha threatens to unravel Tarang's carefully controlled world of secrets, obsession, and revenge.

avataram.title: Avataram
avataram.description: A divine soul reborn in a flawed man’s body must transform into the perfect husband while hiding his true identity and battling forces that threaten his newfound love.

billionaire-babu.title: Billionaire Babu
billionaire-babu.description: A wealthy family faces ruthless rivals who try to destroy their fortune, freedom, and honor through stock market battles, auctions, and valuable antiques. But with a gifted child’s genius, a strong wife’s strategy, and unbreakable family unity, they overcome every challenge.

car-god-returns.title: Car God Returns
car-god-returns.description: Apni asli pehchaan se anjaan ek talented mechanic ki zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab uski girlfriend usse dhokha de deti hai aur ek powerful CEO usse contract marriage kar leti hai. Jab sach saamne aata hai ki wahi desh ke sabse bade automobile empire ka asli waaris aur legendary "Car God" hai, to use apna haq wapas paane aur apne dushmano ko unki aukaat dikhani hoti hai.

kanden-kadhalai.title: Kanden Kadhalai
kanden-kadhalai.description: வறுமையிலும் நேர்மையை விடாத ஒரு டெலிவரி பாயின் வாழ்க்கை, ஒரு பணக்கார CEO-வின் விபத்தால் தலைகீழாக மாறுகிறது. அந்த சந்திப்பு அவர்களை காதலுக்கும், ஆபத்தான உண்மைகளுக்கும் வழிநடத்துகிறது.

the-lost-prince.title: The Lost Prince
the-lost-prince.description: Suraj, a humble delivery boy with no memory of his past, is suddenly pulled into a world of billionaires, hidden identities, and ancient prophecies. As he discovers he is both the secret heir to the world's richest man and the lost prince of a legendary martial arts sect, Suraj must reclaim his forgotten destiny, protect the family he has come to love, and defeat a ruthless enemy before darkness destroys everything.

garage-er-gangster.title: Garage-er Gangster
garage-er-gangster.description: After surviving an assassination attempt, a feared underworld king hides his identity as an honest mechanic. When his integrity wins him the trust of a powerful business family, he must choose between his quiet life and reclaiming the empire he left behind, while enemies close in from the shadows.

return-of-lost-shehzada.title: Return Of Lost Shehzada
return-of-lost-shehzada.description: When the heir of a multi-trillion-crore empire finally awakens from a three-year coma, he discovers his devoted girlfriend and her family sacrificed everything to fund his secret treatment while enduring brutal humiliation from abusive relatives. Reunited with his ultra-powerful billionaire parents, the newly awakened CEO unleashes absolute vengeance on their tormentors and elevates his loyal bride to the peak of wealth and status.

en-swasa-katre.title: En Swasa Katre
en-swasa-katre.description:
ராமும் ஜானுவும் உயிருக்கு உயிராக காதலிக்கிறார்கள்.
ஆனால், தனக்கு உயிருக்கு ஆபத்தான புற்றுநோய் இருப்பதை அறிந்த ஜானு, அந்த உண்மையை மறைத்து ராமை விட்டு விலகுகிறாள்.
தன்னை ஏமாற்றிவிட்டாள் என்று நினைத்த ராம், கோடீஸ்வரனாக திரும்பி ஜானுவை வெறுக்கிறான்.
உண்மை வெளிவரும் போது, ஜானுவின் உயிரையும் அவர்கள் காதலையும் காப்பாற்ற ராம் காலத்துடன் போராடுகிறான்.

coolie-to-kodeeshwaran.title: Coolie to Kodeeshwaran
coolie-to-kodeeshwaran.description: A gripping tale of love, betrayal, and hidden identities,Hidden Crorepati follows Tanya, a secret tycoon posing as a receptionist, and Rajvir, a conflicted CEO. A fake marriage turns real amid power struggles and heartbreak. After tragedy and a shocking truth, Rajvir lives as a janitor—until his past returns, forcing him to confront love, loss, and destiny.

total-mismatch.title: Total Mismatch
total-mismatch.description: The story follows Sunny and Sia as a romance repeatedly tested by class, family pressure, and corporate power games. Sunny first appears as a gym trainer with a hidden billionaire life, and he deliberately keeps his wealth secret because he wants to be loved for himself rather than for money or status. That choice puts him in constant conflict with Ronit and other arrogant rivals who use humiliation, jealousy, and class insults to control the people around them. Sia, a powerful CEO and heiress, is pulled into the same world of public betrayal and family scrutiny, and her bond with Sunny grows through confrontation as much as affection. Their chemistry deepens through teasing, support, and shared defiance, even when the relationship is treated as fake, strategic, or temporary by others. Family pressure quickly raises the stakes, with a grandmother, father figures, and other relatives pushing marriage deadlines and approval tests tied to inheritance and company shares. Sunny is repeatedly tested in domestic and social settings, including kitchen challenges and public contests, but he keeps proving his worth through confidence, skill, and refusal to be treated like property. Sia also fights to keep control of her future, resisting attempts to force her into a marriage that would protect business interests at the cost of her freedom. The conflict expands into boardroom warfare when rivals use a pendant, a no-confidence motion, debt pressure, and takeover threats to corner her. Sunny becomes more than a romantic interest in that struggle, since he also offers business insight and a possible alternative path to saving the company. Public events such as charity competitions and dance-offs turn into arenas where pride, humiliation, and attraction are all on display. Sia is mocked and doubted, but Sunny encourages her to trust herself, and together they win admiration that forces earlier mockers to apologize. Even as their bond strengthens, the story keeps returning to marriage as leverage, with rivals trying to turn love into a transaction and control into a contract. A wedding deadline, a proposal ring, and repeated tests of sincerity make it harder for either of them to separate romance from survival. The final stretch becomes especially chaotic when wedding celebrations are disrupted by competing claims, accusations of cheating, and a false wife-and-child story. Sunny works to clear his name while a recorded call and exposed deception weaken the claims against him. Yash remains a major rival throughout, using wealth, mockery, and marriage negotiations to assert control over Sia. By the end of the batch digests, the central stakes are clear: Sunny and Sia must protect both their love and their dignity while surviving family schemes, corporate threats, and public attempts to decide their future for them.

dhokha-dulhan-da.title: Dhokha Dulhan Da
dhokha-dulhan-da.description: A kind-hearted man spends five years in a contract marriage, silently serving a wife still devoted to her first love. After their divorce, he vanishes to rebuild the career he sacrificed for her, returning as a world-famous billionaire researcher. Misled by her toxic family and ex-lover, she brands him a fraud—until the truth is exposed. As she begs for forgiveness, he chooses the woman who believed in him before the world knew his worth.

hidden-ashwatthama.title: Hidden Ashwatthama
hidden-ashwatthama.description: When terrifying supernatural forces threaten to destroy an ancient kingdom, a humble old farmer mocked by everyone is revealed to be the immortal warrior Ashwatthama. As darkness rises and humanity stands on the brink of annihilation, he must reclaim his destiny and lead the final battle between Dharma and ultimate evil.

ragasiya-raguvanshi.title: Ragasiya Raguvanshi
ragasiya-raguvanshi.description: ரகு ராஜ்வன்ஷி, தன் அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து சாதாரண டாய்லெட் கிளீனராக வேலை பார்க்கும் ஒரு கோடீஸ்வர தொழில்அதிபர். தாத்தாவின் சத்தியத்தைக் காப்பாற்ற, பெரிய கம்பெனி CEO-வான காவ்யாவை 3 மாத கான்ட்ராக்ட் திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார். காவ்யாவின் குடும்பத்தாரும் எதிரிகளும் ரகுவை அசிங்கப்படுத்தும் போதெல்லாம், ரகு தன் அதிகாரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி காவ்யாவுக்கு தெரியாமலேயே அவளைக் காப்பாற்றி, எதிரிகளை அடியோடு அழிக்கிறார்.

mass-mogudu-1.title: Mass Mogudu
mass-mogudu-1.description: A humble village youth with extraordinary abilities arrives in Hyderabad to fulfill his guru's last wish and marry a wealthy heiress. But when greed, betrayal, and a family power struggle threaten everyone around him, he unexpectedly finds love with the overlooked granddaughter who learns that true strength lies beyond wealth and status

ssc-chsl-kaunsi-post-best-hai.title: SSC CHSL: Kaunsi Post Best Hai?
ssc-chsl-kaunsi-post-best-hai.description: SSC CHSL: Kaunsi Post Best Hai?

mafia-chakravarthy.title: Mafia Chakravarthy
mafia-chakravarthy.description: మాఫియా కింగ్‌పిన్ కార్తీక్ రాజ్‌ను అతని భార్య అనన్య మోసం చేసి, అతని సంపదను దోచుకుని తన పాత కాలేజీ ప్రత్యర్థి వరుణ్‌ను పెళ్లి చేసుకోవాలని చూస్తుంది. కానీ పెళ్లి మండపంలో కార్తీక్‌ను అవమానించి, అతని తల్లి జ్ఞాపకాన్ని ధ్వంసం చేయడంతో అతని అసలైన రూపం బయటపడుతుంది. తన నిజమైన గుర్తింపును వెల్లడించిన కార్తీక్, అనన్యను దివాళా తీయించి, ఆమె మోసాన్ని బయటపెట్టి, తనను అవమానించిన ప్రతి ఒక్కరిపై ఘోరమైన ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకుంటాడు.

the-last-avenger.title: The Last Avenger
the-last-avenger.description: Aarav Verma was once a helpless young man, mocked as a "madman" after his family's tragic downfall. But a divine intervention sent his soul to Amarlok, where he trained under mystical fairies to become a powerful warrior. He returned to Earth with a secret mission: recover three lost celestial weapons and avenge his parents.

my-fake-pellam.title: My Fake Pellam
my-fake-pellam.description: After enduring five years of emotional abuse and neglect while posing as a lowly delivery boy to save his marriage, a secret billionaire finally exposes his unfaithful wife and her toxic family. Faced with his meteoric rise to power and the truth behind their "contract marriage," the wife struggles with regret as she realizes she traded a devoted man for a hollow opportunist.

my-beautiful-addiction-3.title: My Beautiful Addiction
my-beautiful-addiction-3.description: The story follows Megha and Vikram through a long, unstable romance shaped by danger, coercion, and family pressure. It begins in a world where women are repeatedly pulled into the orbit of powerful men, from Sakshi’s accidental contact with an underworld boss to other women being trapped, threatened, or pushed toward unwanted marriage. As the focus settles on Megha and Vikram, their connection is marked by suspicion, restraint, and a constant struggle over control. Vikram is shown as a powerful man whose influence reaches into both criminal and family spaces, while Megha keeps demanding dignity, freedom, and respect. Their relationship moves through captivity-like tension, forced papers, and strict boundaries, including a marriage arrangement with a deadline and rules meant to keep intimacy at bay. Family members and household politics keep tightening the pressure, with matchmaking attempts, class judgment, and public humiliation complicating every private feeling. Megha’s past connection with Rohit briefly adds jealousy and emotional confusion, but the larger conflict remains her refusal to be treated like property. Vikram repeatedly reacts with possessiveness, threats, and violence, yet he also shows moments of protection and dependence that keep the bond unresolved. Outside forces add more danger, including police pressure, criminal threats, and attempts to force Vikram into compromising deals by targeting Megha. At one point, the wedding itself collapses when Megha refuses to marry him because of his mafia-linked life and the violence around him. Even then, Vikram pleads with her to stay, suggesting he cannot bear to lose her and would give up much if she remained. The story also widens into family and social conflict, with hospital bills, status concerns, and approval from relatives shaping the couple’s future. After separation fears and farewell emotions, the relationship turns again on pregnancy, which raises the stakes and makes every choice feel more permanent. Megha insists that leaving may be necessary for Vikram’s own good, showing that love and protection are still tangled together. By the end, the tone shifts toward a fragile new beginning, with pregnancy confirmed and the couple reacting with joy. Even so, the larger arc remains one of unstable love under pressure, where devotion, control, and survival are never far apart.

saving-prince-charming.title: Saving Prince Charming
saving-prince-charming.description: Shakti, a fearless young woman blessed with extraordinary strength, becomes the personal bodyguard of Prince Harshvardhan, the heir to a royal family torn apart by betrayal and deadly conspiracies. As she repeatedly saves his life, love blossoms between them while they expose a decades-old plot to steal the throne. Along the way, Shakti uncovers the shocking truth about her own past, proving she was destined not just to protect the crown, but to change its fate forever

avtar-sang-pati-terpilih.title: Avtar: Sang Pati Terpilih
avtar-sang-pati-terpilih.description: Setelah lolos dari maut, Harsh terbangun tanpa ingatan dan mendapati dirinya menikah dengan Bhavya yang hidup dalam kemiskinan dan sakit berkepanjangan. Saat mencari kesembuhan lewat ramuan dan batu-batu langka, usahanya berkembang menjadi bisnis penyembuhan yang memicu iri hati, penghinaan, dan ancaman kriminal. Ketika kekuatan gaib mulai mengungkap rahasia jiwanya, cinta dan bahaya bertabrakan.

bitcoinwala-billionaire.title: Bitcoinwala Billionaire
bitcoinwala-billionaire.description: Ved, mocked as a servant by his wife Nandini and her lover Aadesh, is secretly the "Ghost Investor," a billionaire genius. After discovering his father was framed by Nandini’s family, Ved executes a cold revenge. At a global summit, he reveals his power. Misled by greed, Nandini divorces him just as his true wealth is exposed, forfeiting her claim to billions. The traitors are arrested, and Ved finds true love with his loyal lawyer, Shreya.

भाग्य-रे-खिलाफ.title: भाग्य रे खिलाफ
भाग्य-रे-खिलाफ.description: The story follows Atharv, a gifted disciple whose rare knowledge and hidden power repeatedly unsettle gurukul authorities, monks, and rival students. He first proves that Sanjeevani is real by completing the elixir through ordinary means, which forces even skeptical teachers to acknowledge his ability. That early success does not bring peace, because Guru Ji and later spiritual leaders keep testing whether Atharv can control what he knows. Across the wider world of the story, sacred qualification tests, chakra rankings, and ritual judgments decide status, marriage prospects, and spiritual worth. Atharv is drawn into these public trials again and again, sometimes as a candidate and sometimes as the person everyone wants to measure or expose. The Divyamani artifact becomes a central symbol of that judgment, revealing chakra levels and stirring suspicion when its power seems unstable. Ashwini’s marriage conflict runs alongside the academy politics, as she refuses an imposed match and insists on a husband who can truly prove himself. Vedansh is one of the men pulled into that contest, while Atharv’s own presence turns the selection into a broader struggle over destiny and legitimacy. At one point Atharv is publicly mocked after a failed test, but a sudden surge of magical energy and the revelation of six chakras overturn the easy verdicts against him. The story then deepens into identity drama when a hidden mark leads Harkesh to recognize Atharv as his long-lost son. That reunion is complicated by prophecy, old violence, and the sense that enemies may target Atharv because of what he is becoming. The sacred divyamani is later shattered, and Atharv is blamed for the loss, forcing him into a humiliating inquiry and an impossible demand for compensation. Even when Ashwini offers a dagger as replacement, the authorities reject it, showing how little mercy exists inside the ritual hierarchy. In parallel, another gurukul crisis centers on a poisoned master, where Atharva is asked to help save Guru Kostubh through the legendary Sanjeevani and sacred lotus trials. He is tested with magical objects, accused of hiding power, and pushed to prove himself under pressure from both allies and skeptics. The repeated trials suggest that his strength is real, but they also show how dangerous it is to be recognized by institutions that want to control sacred knowledge. By the end of the batch, the central stakes are clear: Atharv must survive judgment, protect his family ties, and decide whether his power will be accepted, feared, or used against him. The emotional thread around Ashwini and Dhruv also remains unresolved, adding a quieter tension beneath the larger spiritual conflict. Overall, the show builds a world where destiny, inheritance, and sacred power collide, and where every revelation only invites a harsher test.

the-hero-who-walks-among-us.title: The Hero Who Walks Among Us
the-hero-who-walks-among-us.description: The show centers on repeated clashes between family duty, public humiliation, hidden status, and reluctant love. It opens with a retired martial figure being asked to return to a powerful past, but he refuses wealth and rank in favor of a quiet family life. Around him, several households fracture over property, money, and control, as elders are cast out, relatives seize assets, and dignity becomes harder to protect than survival. One abandoned elder is rejected by his son and daughter-in-law, yet proves his worth by rushing to save a woman in danger. That rescue opens a softer romantic thread, where gratitude and matchmaking slowly turn into hesitant affection between older adults. In another branch, Yulan enters a practical marriage arrangement that is treated more like a contract than a romance, and she repeatedly tries to manage both business pressure and family expectations. Her public life becomes increasingly unstable when a birthday gift is exposed as counterfeit, then partly explained by a mistaken switch, leaving her reputation damaged but not fully settled. The story widens into corporate and social warfare as stolen property, hidden ownership, and accusations of a frame-up threaten an empire and force a race against time to return what was taken. At the same time, an elder’s worsening illness pulls the family into conflict over treatment, with traditional knowledge, medical authority, and pride all competing for control. Yulan’s husband is repeatedly mocked for low status, yet he keeps stepping forward to help and is defended by those who see his value. Public entrances, access cards, and elite gatherings become stages for humiliation, but hidden authority can suddenly reverse the balance and expose who truly holds power. The show also leans into marriage as a battlefield, with public proposals, remarriage debates, and accusations about age, widowhood, and legitimacy. Several relationships are tested by separation, family pressure, and the fear that love will ruin status or inheritance. In one of the strongest reversals, a man long treated as ordinary is revealed to have a far greater identity than anyone expected. That revelation reshapes the crowd’s assumptions and deepens the sense that appearances in this world are unreliable. Across the whole arc, characters keep trying to protect family honor while being dragged into scandals they cannot fully control. The stakes are not only romantic or financial, but also about who gets believed, who gets welcomed home, and who is forced to live as a burden. By the end, the show has built a world where hidden power, wounded pride, and stubborn loyalty collide again and again.

bach-gya-vip-chhora.title: Bach Gya VIP Chhora
bach-gya-vip-chhora.description: Pregnant Mitali is brutally tortured by her brother Aryan’s jealous fiancée, Vedika, who mistakes her for a gold-digging mistress. After Mitali loses her hand in a horrific attack, Aryan uncovers the truth, exposing Vedika’s fake pregnancy and infidelity. Breaking the engagement, Aryan ensures the villains are arrested, choosing family loyalty over a toxic marriage.

lsd-lash-shadi-aur-drama.title: LSD-Lash, Shadi Aur Drama
lsd-lash-shadi-aur-drama.description: The show begins as a mix of class comedy and romantic promise, with Atul repeatedly humiliated by older men, roommates, and local troublemakers until his frustration starts turning into open resentment and ambition. Around him, other domestic stories unfold in a lighter tone, including furniture-moving chaos, a misplaced key, and a lonely home that seems to be waiting for love. In parallel, a man openly vows to marry Anuradha, framing the romance with devotional language, a ten-day promise, and the expectation of a wedding procession arriving at the house. That early balance of humiliation and hope gives the series its first tension: some characters are trying to rise, while others are trying to secure love or status before they are mocked again. The tone then shifts sharply when a playful sci-fi joke breaks into panic and Atul is left motionless after a chaotic race, opening the door to a darker mystery. From there, the story becomes increasingly about concealment, as multiple men argue over a drug-related death or dead body, debate whether it was murder or suicide, and scramble to avoid CCTV, guards, and police. The hidden body moves from public spaces into apartments and homes, where stairs, keys, cars, and bad timing make the cover-up harder at every step. Domestic life becomes inseparable from crime, as newlywed banter, cleaning, guest visits, and household embarrassment all become part of the effort to keep outsiders from noticing the truth. Anu grows suspicious that her husband is hiding a murder, while he denies everything and tries to stop her from going to the police. Neighbors and bystanders begin to witness enough of the disturbance that gossip spreads, making reputation almost as dangerous as the crime itself. The body remains central, but it is never stable: it is hidden, moved, questioned, and at times seems to reappear in new places, keeping everyone off balance. Police scrutiny grows, yet the truth stays slippery because the evidence is incomplete and the stories keep changing. Several women are pulled into the crisis as they notice suspicious supplies, strange smells, or signs that something is wrong in the house. The cover-up expands beyond one couple into a wider network of helpers, excuses, and improvised plans involving tools, renovation stories, and attempts to explain away the mess. Even when the story briefly softens into romantic or domestic banter, the murder mystery remains unresolved underneath. By the end, the central stakes are no longer only love or status, but whether anyone can prove what really happened before the hidden body and the lies around it collapse the whole household.

arushi-talwar-murder-mistry.title: Aarushi Talwar - The Most Mysterious Murder Case

the-mysterious-master-chef-11.title: The Mysterious Master Chef
the-mysterious-master-chef-11.description:
உலகின் மிகப் பெரிய மாஸ்டர் செஃப் பட்டங்களை வென்ற மர்ம சமையல்காரன் – முகம் யாருக்கும் தெரியாது. உயிர்க்கொல்லும் தாக்குதலுக்குப் பிறகு, அடையாளம் மறைத்து ஒரு ஹோட்டலில் வேலை செய்கிறான். ஹோட்டலை காப்பாற்ற தன் ரகசியத்தை வெளிப்படுத்திய பின், இன்னொரு தாக்குதலில் நினைவிழக்கிறான்.
புதிய தொடக்கம், மறந்த கடந்த காலம் – இந்த புதிய வாழ்க்கையில் அவன் வாழ முடியுமா?

cricket-champion-6.title: Cricket Champion
cricket-champion-6.description: In a small ground where no one expects magic, **Karthik** picks up a bat and changes the game forever. His strange, powerful shot shocks players, coaches, and crowds alike. Laughed at and ignored at first, Karthik’s talent refuses to stay hidden. From nowhere to everywhere, this is the rise of a true cricket champion.

my-homeless-billionaire-husband-8.title: My homeless billionaire husband
my-homeless-billionaire-husband-8.description: Shashwath lives on the streets with nothing to prove who he really is, while the world sees him as just another nobody. When Akriti steps into his life with kindness, a dangerous secret begins to surface. Behind his silence hides power, revenge, and a past that can destroy many lives. The real shock is not who Shashwath is, but why he is pretending to be invisible.

fake-wife-9.title: Fake Wife
fake-wife-9.description: For five years, Deepak Joshi silently endures every insult from his wife. But when his wife's first love, Avinash, returns, Deepak signs the divorce papers and walks away. Just when a billionaire  enters Deepak's life and loves him for who he truly is, his ex-wife is consumed by jealousy and regret over her past actions. Is the billionaire truly the perfect match for Deepak? Will deepak’s ex-wife be able to see Deepak happy, or will she create a new storm in his life?

when-silence-breaks-8.title: When Silence Breaks
when-silence-breaks-8.description: A powerful CEO’s pregnant wife finds herself trapped in a web of jealousy, betrayal, and cruelty at the hands of a scheming secretary. With her dignity torn apart and her safety at stake, she refuses to bow down. This is the story of a woman’s unbreakable fight for truth, justice, and her rightful place.

truth-behind-the-city-of-dwarka.title: Truth behind the city of Dwarka

kanavae-kalaiyaadhae.title: Kanavae Kalaiyaadhae
kanavae-kalaiyaadhae.description:
வர்ஷா ஒரு சாதாரண பெண். ஆனால், CEO அமரை வெல்ல வேண்டும் என்பதே அவளின் கனவு.அதே நேரத்தில், அமரைப் பற்றிய ஒரு பயங்கரமான உண்மையை அவள் கண்டறிகிறாள். அதையெல்லாம் அறிந்த பிறகும், அவள் அவரை காதலிக்கத் தொடருவாளா?
Kuku FM-ல் கேளுங்கள்.

the-mysterious-master-chef-9.title: The Mysterious Master Chef
the-mysterious-master-chef-9.description: An anonymous MasterChef legend hides his face—and his past—after surviving a deadly attack and quietly takes a job at a struggling hotel. Forced to reveal his identity to save it, he is attacked again and loses his memory. With a forgotten past and a new life he doesn’t recognize, can he choose who he wants to be now?

homeless-billioanire.title: My homeless billionaire husband
homeless-billioanire.description: A billionaire living as a beggar enters a contract marriage to fulfill his grandmother’s last wish. What begins as a lie slowly turns into real love with a kind-hearted woman who believes in him. When the truth surfaces, love, trust, and destiny are put to the ultimate test.

fake-wife-8.title: Fake Wife
fake-wife-8.description: For five years, Dev Joshi silently endures every insult from his wife, Riya Kapoor. But when Riya’s first love, Avinash Malhotra, returns, Dev signs the divorce papers and walks away. Just when billionaire Shreya Rao enters Dev’s life and loves him for who he truly is, Riya is consumed by jealousy and regret over her past actions. Is Shreya truly the perfect match for Dev? Will Riya be able to see Dev happy with Shreya, or will she create a new storm in his life?

billionaire-groom-is-my-new-husband-2.title: Jhadoowala Billionaire
billionaire-groom-is-my-new-husband-2.description: தாயின் கட்டாய திருமணத் திட்டங்களுக்கு எதிராக நிற்கும் பணக்கார வாரிசு நீல் ராய்சந்த், தன் அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து சுத்தம் செய்யும் ஊழியராக வாழ்கிறான். மணமேடையில் கைவிடப்பட்ட ஸ்நேஹல், அவனை திடீரென திருமணம் செய்ய முன்வருகிறாள். ஒப்பந்தத் திருமணமாக தொடங்கியது, உண்மை, நம்பிக்கை மற்றும் காதலாக மாறி, எதிர்பாராத இடத்திலும் காதல் மலரும் என்பதை நிரூபிக்கிறது.

nenjam-marappadhillai.title: Royal Gaowali
nenjam-marappadhillai.description: அக்ஷா, தாயுடன் கிராமத்திலிருந்து நகரத்திற்கு வந்து, ‘ஸ்டேட்டஸ்’ காரணமாக அக்கா ஈஷாவால் நிராகரிக்கப்படுகிறாள். உண்மை அடையாளத்தை மறைத்த அவள், ஒரு பழைய பதக்கத்தின் மூலம் பணக்கார வாரிசு எனத் தெரியவருகிறது. டி.என்.ஏ. சோதனையில் அக்ஷா தான் உண்மையான ஷானா படேல் என நிரூபிக்கப்படுகிறது; ஈஷாவின் பொய்கள் வெளிச்சம் பார்க்க, அக்ஷா தன் அடையாளம், தாய் மற்றும் மரியாதையை மீட்டெடுக்கிறாள்.

fake-wife-7.title: Fake Wife
