fake-wife-7.description: Dev marries Riya hoping for love, but ends up alone in his own marriage. When her ex, Avinash, comes back into her life, Dev is pushed aside and treated like nothing. Every day becomes a fight for self respect. How long can he stay in a marriage where he never mattered?

billion-dollar-mess-4.title: Billion dollar wala blunder
billion-dollar-mess-4.description: Sakshika appears smart and powerful as an event manager, but her true nature is cruel. At a charity event, she insults an old couple, thinking they are beggars. One small mistake turns into a big problem that will change her life forever.

raw.title: RAW ke khufiya duniya ki jhalak

the-mysterious-master-chef-8.title: The Mysterious Master Chef
the-mysterious-master-chef-8.description: When an anonymous chef wins the world’s biggest MasterChef titles, the world falls in love with his food but no one has ever seen his face. After surviving a deadly attack, he hides his identity and takes a job at a hotel. One day, to save the hotel, he is forced to reveal his secret. In another attack, he loses his memory. A new beginning, a forgotten past, and an identity that no longer feels his own can he live on with this new self?

my-homeless-billionaire-husband-7.title: My Homeless Billionaire Husband
my-homeless-billionaire-husband-7.description: You’re not my real boyfriend, just my fake one,” Aakriti tells Shashwat. She hires a homeless beggar as her fake boyfriend, unaware that Shashwat has truly fallen for her—and that he is actually an undercover billionaire. Without revealing his secret, can Shashwat win her love? Why does a powerful billionaire live as a beggar? In a game of love, betrayal, and power, who will win?

when-silence-breaks-7.title: When Silence Breaks
when-silence-breaks-7.description: వర్ష సాధారణ అమ్మాయి. కానీ సీఈవో అమర్ ని దక్కించుకోవాలని ఆశ పడింది. అదే టైం లో అమర్ గురించి భయంకరమైన నిజం తెలుస్తుంది. అయినా అతన్ని లవ్ చేస్తుందా..? వినండి "When Silence Breaks " కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

billion-dollar-mess-3.title: Billion dollar wala blunder
billion-dollar-mess-3.description: కంపెనీలో మేనేజర్ గా పని చేస్తున్న సాక్షి, ఛారిటీ ఈవెంట్ లో పెద్ద తప్పు చేస్తుంది. ఆ కంపెనీ ఓనర్ అరవింద్ ని పెళ్ళి చేసుకోవాలని ఆమె అనుకుంటుంది. కానీ ఆమె చేసిన తప్పు వల్ల చాలా నష్టం జరుగుతుంది. అతనితో ఆమెకు పెళ్ళవుతుందా? డబ్బు లేని వాళ్ళను ఛీ కొట్టిన సాక్షి పరిస్థితి ఏమైంది. తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి "Billion Dollar Blunder" మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో

good-karma-make-the-right-choices-for-to.title: Good Karma: Make the Right Choices for Tomorrow
good-karma-make-the-right-choices-for-to.description:
ശരിയായ തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പുകളാണ് ജീവിതത്തിൽ നിങ്ങളെ മുന്നോട്ടു നയിക്കുക.
'ഗുഡ് കർമ്മ' എന്ന ഈ ഓഡിയോബുക്ക്, ഓരോ ചുവടിലും ശരിയായ തീരുമാനങ്ങൾ എടുത്ത് വിജയവഴിയിലേക്ക് നിങ്ങളെ നയിക്കുന്ന മാർഗ്ഗദർശനങ്ങൾ ഉൾക്കൊള്ളുന്നു.
ഇപ്പോൾ തന്നെ കേൾക്കാൻ തുടങ്ങൂ, നല്ല നാളെയിലേക്കുള്ള ആദ്യ ചുവട് വെയ്ക്കൂ.

forever-prisoner.title: Forever Prisoner
forever-prisoner.description:
సీఐఏ “ఎన్హాన్స్డ్ ఇంటర్రోగేషన్” ప్రోగ్రామ్ (9/11 తర్వాత):
సెప్టెంబర్ 11 దాడుల తర్వాత అరెస్టు చేయబడిన తొలి పెద్ద మిలిటెంట్ ఖైదీ అబూ జుబైదా చుట్టూ ఈ కథనం తిరుగుతుంది. ఆయనను 9/11 దాడుల తర్వాత ఆరు నెలలకే పట్టుకొని, థాయ్‌లాండ్‌లోని రహస్యమైన “బ్లాక్ సైట్” కి తరలించారు.

पवित्र-रामायण-से-11-सीख--श्रीराम-की-आदर्.title: Pavitra Ramayan se 11 Seekh - Shri Ram Ki Aadarsh Vani

kannada-dindima-3.title: Kannada Dimdima: Bhaga 03
kannada-dindima-3.description: ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷೆಗೆ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಸುದೀರ್ಘ ಇತಿಹಾಸವಿದೆ. ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಪ್ರಪಂಚದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಭಾಷೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷೆ ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರಿಗೆ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ ನೀಡುವ ವಿಷಯ. ಆದಿಕವಿ ಪಂಪನಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ಚಂದ್ರಶೇಖರ ಕಂಬಾರರ ತನಕ ನೂರಾರು ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಕವಿಗಳು ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷೆಯ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ, ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನ ಹಾಡಿ ಹೊಗಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಭಾಷೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಭಾಷೆಯಾಗಿರೋ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಹಿರಿಮೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಲೇಖಕ ಜಿ. ಆನಂದ್‌ ರಚಿಸಿರುವ ಸುಂದರ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ "ಕನ್ನಡ ಡಿಂಡಿಮ: ಭಾಗ ೩" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

irul-samrajyam.title: Irul samrajyam
irul-samrajyam.description: முடிவில்லாத இந்த இருளில் இருந்து யாராலும் தப்பிக்க முடியாது.

khalisthan.title: Khalisthan
khalisthan.description: సిక్కులు భారతదేశంలో ఒక ముఖ్యమైన మత సమూహం. పంజాబ్ ప్రాంతంలో వీరి అధిక జనాభా ఉంటుంది. 1947లో భారత విభజన సమయంలో పంజాబ్ రాష్ట్రం రెండు భాగాలుగా విడిపోయింది – ఒకటి భారతదేశంలో, మరొకటి పాకిస్తాన్‌లో. ఈ విభజన తర్వాత, పంజాబ్‌లో సిక్కులకు జరిగిన నష్టాలు, భూసంస్కరణలు, భాషా సమస్యలు, రాజకీయ అసమానతలు మొదలైనవి అసంతృప్తికి దారితీశాయి.

silent-aliya.title: Silent Aliya
silent-aliya.description: ತುಂಬಾನೇ ಕನಸು ಕಂಡು ಮದುವೆ ಆಗಿದ್ಲು ಇಶಾ. ಆದ್ರೆ, ಅಶ್ವಿನ್ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ನಡವಳಿಕೆ ಅವಳನ್ನ ಕಂಗಾಲಾಗಿಸಿತ್ತು. ಎಂಥದ್ದೇ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಇದ್ರೂ ಮೂಕನಂತೆ ವರ್ತಿಸ್ತಿದ್ದ. ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಎದುರಾಕಿಕೊಂಡು ಮದುವೆಯಾದ ಇಶಾ ಇವತ್ತು ಅಸಹಾಯಕತೆಯಿಂದ ಕೊರಗ್ತಿದ್ಲು. ಹೀಗಿರ್ವಾಗ್ಲೇ ಅಶ್ವಿನ್ "ಇವತ್ತು ಯಾರು ನನ್ನ ನೋಡಿ ಆಡಿಕೊಳ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೋ, ಅವರ ಮುಂದೆಯೇ ನನ್ನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಕಥೆ ಗೊತ್ತಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಅವತ್ತು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸುಮ್ಮನಾಗ್ತರೆ. ನನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿ ಕೈಹಿಡಿದ ಇಶಾ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಸುಳ್ಳಾಗಲ್ಲ!" ಅಂದುಕೊಂಡ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಅಶ್ವಿನ್ ಯಾರು? ಆ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಗೊತ್ತಾಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಸೈಲೆಂಟ್ ಅಳಿಯ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್.

billionaires-choice-3.title: Billionaire's Choice
billionaires-choice-3.description: ಒಂದು ಕಡೆ ಸಾವು-ಬದುಕಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಹೋರಾಡ್ತಿರೋ ತಾಯಿ. ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಲೈಫ್ ನಡೆಸ್ತಿರೋ ಮಗ ಪ್ರತೀಕ್! ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಕಷ್ಟ ಆದ್ರೂ ತನ್ನ ತಂದೆಯಿಂದ ಸಹಾಯ ಪಡೋಯೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಅಂತಾ ಶಪಥ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದ ಪ್ರತೀಕ್! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಏನಿದು ತಂದೆ-ಮಗನ ರೈವರ್ಲಿ? ಪ್ರತೀಕ್ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಗೊತ್ತಿರೋ ಪ್ರಾರ್ಥನಾ ಪ್ಲಾನ್ ಏನು? ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಪ್ರತೀಕ್ ಯಾರು? ಕೇಳಿ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಅಂಡ್ ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ 'ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್ಸ್ ಚಾಯ್ಸ್'.

the-great-indian-circus.title: The Great Indian Circus
the-great-indian-circus.description: భారతదేశంలో సర్కస్‌ చరిత్ర 19వ శతాబ్దం చివర్లో ప్రారంభమై, గ్రామాలు, పట్టణాల్లో జనరంజక వినోదంగా ఎదిగింది. అద్భుతమైన జిమ్నాస్టిక్స్‌, జంతు ప్రదర్శనలు, సాహసక్రీడలతో ఇది కోట్లాది ప్రేక్షకులను ఆకట్టుకుంది. కాలక్రమేణా సాంకేతికత, సినిమాల ప్రభావంతో తగ్గినా, భారతీయ సర్కస్‌ కళాకారుల ప్రతిభ ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా గౌరవం పొందింది.

mandiyaalvikeyalli-kannadiga.title: Mandiyaalvikeyalli Kannadiga
mandiyaalvikeyalli-kannadiga.description: ‘ಮಂದಿಯಾಳ್ವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗ’ ಕಿರಣ್ ಬಾಟ್ನಿ ಅವರ ಚಿಂತನಾ ಕೃತಿ. ಕನ್ನಡ, ಕನ್ನಡಿಗ ಹಾಗೂ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಹಳೆಯ-ಹೊಸ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಅವುಗಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಹುಡುಕುವ ಹಂಬಲವನ್ನೂ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಗಂಭೀರ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನೆತ್ತಿ, ನಿರ್ಣಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪಿಸುವ ಧೈರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಲೇಖಕರು ತೋರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಕೇಂದ್ರ–ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸಂಬಂಧವೇ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂವಿಧಾನಬದ್ಧ ಅಕ್ರಮಗಳಿಗೆ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಸಂಗತಿಯನ್ನು ಅವರು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಮೊಟ್ಟಮೊದಲು ಓದಿದಾಗ ಇದು ‘ಕನ್ನಡ ರಿಪಬ್ಲಿಕ್’ ಎಂಬ ದೂರದ ಕನಸಿನಂತೆ ತೋರುವುದಾದರೂ, ಆಳವಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದನ್ನೂ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುವ, ವಿಚಾರಿಸುವ, ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರ ಹಿತದೃಷ್ಟಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಡೆವ ಎಚ್ಚರದ ಮನೋಭಾವ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

azim-premji-the-man-behind-the-billion.title: Azim Premji: The Man Behind the Billion.
azim-premji-the-man-behind-the-billion.description: A biography that explores the life and legacy of Azim Premji, the Indian businessman and philanthropist who built Wipro into a global IT giant. The book delves into his professional journey, his philanthropic endeavors, and the values that have shaped his life. It highlights his transformation from a vegetable oil company owner to a tech mogul, and his commitment to giving back to society through his charitable foundation

freedom-manifesto.title: Freedom Manifesto
freedom-manifesto.description: ఆర్థిక స్వాతంత్ర్యం అంటే మన కష్టానికి ఫలితం మనకే చెందే స్వేచ్ఛ; అప్పుల బంధనాల నుంచి బయటపడి, మన ఖర్చులను మనమే నియంత్రించడం మొదటి అడుగు; స్మార్ట్ పెట్టుబడులు, పొదుపు అలవాట్లు, స్పష్టమైన లక్ష్యాలే స్వేచ్ఛా జీవితం కోసం కీ.

oceans-story.title: Ocean's Story
oceans-story.description: భూమిపై సముద్రాల ఉనికి బిలియన్ల సంవత్సరాల క్రితమే ఆరంభమైంది. భూమి ఏర్పడిన 4.5 బిలియన్ సంవత్సరాల తరువాత, వాయుమండలంలోని ఆవిరి చల్లబడటంతో వర్షం కురిసి, భూగర్భపు పగుళ్లలో నీరు చేరి, విశాలమైన సముద్రాలు ఏర్పడ్డాయి. ఇవి జీవం పుట్టిన తొలి వేదికలుగా నిలిచాయి.

राजा-राम-मोहन-रॉय---लेखिका--मौमिता-बागची.title: Raja Ram Mohan Roy | Writer - Momita Bagchi

ambuja-cements.title: Ambuja Cements
ambuja-cements.description:
అంబుజా సిమెంట్స్‌ ప్రయాణం 1981 అక్టోబర్ 20న ప్రారంభమైంది. ఆ సమయంలో ఇది “అంబుజా సిమెంట్స్ ప్రైవేట్ లిమిటెడ్” పేరుతో ప్రైవేట్ కంపెనీగా స్థాపించబడింది. కేవలం రెండేళ్లలోనే, 1983లో, సంస్థను పబ్లిక్ లిమిటెడ్ కంపెనీగా మార్చి “గుజరాత్ అంబుజా సిమెంట్స్ లిమిటెడ్” అని పేరు పెట్టారు.

1986లో గుజరాత్‌లోని కోడినార్ (ప్రస్తుతం అంబుజానగర్) వద్ద మొదటి సిమెంట్ తయారీ ప్లాంట్ ప్రారంభమైంది. మొదటి దశలోనే కంపెనీ తన ప్రత్యేకమైన నాణ్యత, ఆధునిక సాంకేతికత, సమయపాలనతో పరిశ్రమలో ప్రత్యేక గుర్తింపు పొందింది.

final-farewell.title: Final Farewell
final-farewell.description: అంత్యక్రియలు అనేది మనిషి మరణానంతరం చేసే శాస్త్రోక్త కర్మకాండాలకు సాధారణంగా ఉపయోగించే పదం. ఇవి మరణించిన వ్యక్తి ఆత్మకు శాంతి కలిగించడానికి, కుటుంబానికి మానసిక స్థైర్యం ఇవ్వడానికి, మరియు ధార్మిక బాధ్యతను పూర్తిచేయడానికి నిర్వహిస్తారు.

corporate-jungle.title: Corporate Jungle
corporate-jungle.description:
కార్పొరేట్ జంగిల్ అనేది ఆధునిక ఉద్యోగ ప్రపంచాన్ని సూచించే పదం.
ఇందులో పోటీ, ఒత్తిడి, అవకాశాల కోసం జరిగే పోరాటం ప్రధాన లక్షణాలు.
ప్రతిఒక్కరూ తమ స్థానం కాపాడుకోవడానికి నిరంతరం కృషి చేయాలి.
ఇక్కడ విజయానికి వ్యూహం, నైపుణ్యం, మరియు సహనం అవసరం.
ఇది ఒక అడవి లాంటిది – బలమైనవారే నిలదొక్కుకుంటారు.

nimma-jeevana-nimma-aayke.title: Nimma Jeevana, Nimma Aayke : Nanna Anubhava
nimma-jeevana-nimma-aayke.description: 'ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಜಗದ ನಿಯಮ' ಎನ್ನುವ ಮಾತಿನಂತೆ ಪ್ರತಿನಿತ್ಯ ಬದುಕು ಬದಲಾಗ್ತನೇ ಇರುತ್ತೆ! ಪಾಠಗಳನ್ನೂ ಕಲೀತಿವಿ. ಆ ಪಾಠಗಳನ್ನು ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು? ಅನುಭವಗಳೇ ನಾಳಿನ ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲುಗಳಾಗೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಲೇಖಕಿ 'ಕರೇಗೌಡ್ರು ದಿವ್ಯ' ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಯ್ಕೆ : ನನ್ನ ಅನುಭವ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

manassina-rahasyagalu.title: Manassina Rahasyagalu
manassina-rahasyagalu.description: ‘ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು’ ಎಂಬ ಕೃತಿ ಸುಶ್ಮಿತಾ ಪಿ. ನಾಯಕ್ ಕಿಣಿ ಅವರ ಮೂಲ ರಚನೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡಕ್ಕೆ ರೂಪಾಂತರಿಸಿರುವವರು ಕೆ. ಪ್ರವೀಣ್ ನಾಯಕ್. ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಅಸ್ವಸ್ಥತೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸುವವರಿಗೆ ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಭರವಸೆಯ ದೀಪದಂತಿದೆ. ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಗುಟ್ಟುಗಳು, ಅದರ ನಿಲುವುಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ವಂತ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಲೇಖಕಿ ನಿಷ್ಕಪಟವಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಓದುಗರಿಗೂ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುವಂತೆ ಸರಳ ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೋವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಜೀವನದ ಒತ್ತಡ, ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸಂಕಟಗಳಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರಲು ದಾರಿದೀಪವಾಗಬಲ್ಲ ಹಿತಕರ ಗ್ರಂಥದ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

koneya-anka.title: Koneya Anka
koneya-anka.description: ಈ ಕೊನೆಯ ಅಂಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಆತ್ಮಾರಾಮ್‌ ಒಬ್ಬ ರಂಗಕರ್ಮಿ. ಬಾಲ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಆತನ ತಾಯಿಯ ತೀವ್ರ ಪ್ರಭಾವಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗುವ ಅವನು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿ ವಿಚಾರ ಮಾಡುವ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದರೂ, ಬಾಲ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಆತನಿಗಾದ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆಘಾತಗಳಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರಲಾರದೇ ತನ್ನ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಇತರರೊಡನೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದರಲ್ಲಿ, ಕೊನೆಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಜೊತೆಗೇ ತಾನು ಸಹಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಳಲಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ರಂಗಭೂಮಿಯ ಹಿರಿಮೆಯನ್ನು, ಬಾಲ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪೋಷಕರ ಅವಿವೇಕದಿಂದ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಒಳಗಾಗುವ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬನ ಮನಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗತ ವಿಚಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಆಚಾರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ದ್ವಂದ್ವವನ್ನು ಈ ಕೊನೆಯ ಅಂಕ ರಂಗಪ್ರಯೋಗವು ಒಂದು ಹಂತದ ಮಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಲೇಖಕ, ರಂಗಕರ್ಮಿ ಯೋಗೇಶ್‌ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ ಬರೆದಿರುವ "ಕೊನೆಯ ಅಂಕ" ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

दोस्ती-से-ज्यादा-प्यार-से-कम--लेखिका--पू.title: Dosti Se Zayda Pyar Se Kam

antharangada-anna.title: Antharangada Anna
antharangada-anna.description: ಲೇಖಕ ಪ್ರಕಾಶರಾಜ್ ಮೇಹು ಅವರ ಕೃತಿ-ಅಂತರಂಗದ ಅಣ್ಣ. ಕೃತಿಗೆ ಬೆನ್ನುಡಿ ಬರೆದ ಸಾಹಿತಿ ಡಾ. ಬಂಜಗೆರೆ ಜಯಪ್ರಕಾಶ್ ಅವರು ‘ನಟ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ ಅವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬಂದಿರುವ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದರೆ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ತುಂಬಾ ಚಿಕ್ಕದು. ಆದರೂ, ಅದು ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗೆ ಒಡ್ಡಿರುವ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡದು. ರಾಜ್ ಅವರ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವವನ್ನು ಉತ್ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮಾತುಗಳಿಲ್ಲದೇ ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಬರವಣಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮಚಿತ್ತದ ನಿರೂಪಣೆ ಇದೆ. ಸತ್ಯಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ನಿರುದ್ವಿಗ್ನವಾಗಿ ತರ್ಕಿಸುವ ಗುಣ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ’ ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಶಂಸಿಸಿದ್ದರೆ, ಡಾ. ಕೆ. ಪುಟ್ಟಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಅವರು ‘ಕೆಲವು ಅಪರೂಪದ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಒದಗಿಸಿ, ರಾಜ್-ಲೀಲಾ ವಿನೋದವಲ್ಲ’ ಎಂಬ ಆಧ್ಯಾಯ ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಚರ್ಚೆಗೆ ಗ್ರಾಸ ಒದಗಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ’ ಎಂದು ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಪಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ಅಂತರಂಗದ ಅಣ್ಣ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

hucharu-dhoortharu-moorkaru.title: Hucharu Dhoortharu Moorkaru
hucharu-dhoortharu-moorkaru.description: ಹುಚ್ಚರು ಧೂರ್ತರು ಮೂರ್ಕರು ಎಂಬುದು ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ಕನ್ನಡ ಲೇಖಕ ಡಾ. ಭಗವಾನ್ ದಾಸ್ ಅಳ್ವ ಅವರ ಸಂಕಲಿತ ನಾಟಕಗಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರು ಜೀವನದ ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಮನಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳು – ಹುಚ್ಚತನ, ಛಲ ಮತ್ತು ಮೂರ್ಖತ್ವ – ಹೇಗೆ ನಮ್ಮ ನಿತ್ಯ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಆಳುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣವಾದ ಹಾಸ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಂಗ್ಯಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಲೇಖಕದ ಅಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಶೈಲಿ ಸುಲಭವಾದ ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದು, ಚಿಂತನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ಓದುಗರನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.  ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಸ್ವಭಾವ, ಸಮಾಜದ ಹಾಸ್ಯಾಸ್ಪದ ಧೋರಣೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಂಬಿಕೆಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಆಳವಾದ ಅರ್ಥವತ್ತಾದ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮೂಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸರಳ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಭೀರ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆದಿಡುವ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ವ್ಯಂಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ತಾತ್ವಿಕತೆಯ ಮಿಶ್ರಣವನ್ನು ಇಚ್ಛಿಸುವ ಕೇಳುಗರಿಗೆ  ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ "ಹುಚ್ಚರು ಧೂರ್ತರು ಮೂರ್ಕರು" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

naanu-sanyasiyaagalu-horatidde.title: Naanu Sanyasiyaagalu Horatidde
naanu-sanyasiyaagalu-horatidde.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ರಿಗೂ ಒಂದ್ಸಲ, "ಸಾಕಪ್ಪಾ ಈ ಸಂಸಾರದ ಜಂಜಾಟ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬಿಟ್ಟು, ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿಯಾಗ್ಬಿಡಣ.." ಅಂತಾ ಅನ್ಸಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದೇ ಮಾತಿನಂತೆ ಲೇಖಕರಾದ ಮಂಜುನಾಥ್ ಕಾಮತ್ ಅವ್ರು ತಮ್ಮ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲೇ ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿಯಾಗಲು ಹೊರಟಿದ್ರು. ತಮ್ಮನ್ನ ಶಿಷ್ಯರನ್ನಾಗಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿ ಅಂತಾ ಸ್ವಾಮೀಜಿಯೊಬ್ಬರನ್ನ ಕೇಳಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ರು! ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಗುರುಗಳು ಇವರನ್ನ ಶಿಷ್ಯರನ್ನಾಗಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಲಿಲ್ಲ! ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಮುಂದೆ ಬದುಕು ಬದಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಜೀವನದ ಕೆಲವು ಬರಹಗಳೇ ' ನಾನು ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿಯಾಗಲು ಹೊರಟಿದ್ದೆ!' ಕೃತಿ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

marali-manege.title: Marali Manege
marali-manege.description: 'ಸಂಬಂಧ ಅನ್ನೋದು ತುಂಬಾ ದೊಡ್ಡದು'. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ಅಮ್ಮ-ಮಗನ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯ ಬಿಡಿಸಲಾಗದ್ದು. ಹೀಗಿರ್ವಾಗ ನವಮಾಸ ಗರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊತ್ತು, ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಜನ್ಮ ಕೊಡೋ ತಾಯಿಯ ಋಣ ತೀರ್ಸೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಅಂಥ ಜನನಿಯನ್ನ ತೊರೆದು, ಮನೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೋದ ಮಗನ ಕಥೆಯೇ 'ಮರಳಿ ಮನೆಗೆ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯದ್ದು. ಅವನಿಗಾಗಿ ಕಾಯುತ್ತಾ, ತನ್ನಿಡೀ ಬದುಕನ್ನೇ ಸವೆಸಿದ ಮಾತೆಯ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಕಥೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ! 'ಯೋಗೇಶ್ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್' ಬರೆದಿರುವ, ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಕೂಡ ಆಗಿರುವ 'ಮರಳಿ ಮನೆಗೆ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ

karnatakavonde.title: Karnatakavonde : Olithu Tharalide Kedaku
karnatakavonde.description: ಕರುನಾಡು, 'ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ'ವಾಗಿದ್ದರ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮವಿದೆ. ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಆಡಳಿತಗಾರರ ಸುಪರ್ದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಿದು ಹಂಚಿ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದ ನಮ್ಮ ನಾಡು ಒಂದಾಗಿದ್ದು 'ಏಕೀಕರಣ'ದ ನಂತರವೇ! ಆದ್ರೂ ಒಂದಷ್ಟು ಕಿಡಿಗೇಡಿಗಳು ಆಗಾಗ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕವನ್ನು ಒಡೆಯುವುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುವುದು ವಿಪರ್ಯಾಸ. ಇಂಥ ಸಂದಿಗ್ಧ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಯಾಕೆ ಒಂದಾಗಿರ್ಬೇಕು? ಇದ್ರಿಂದ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲದೇ ಅನ್ಯ ಭಾಷಿಗರಿಗೂ ಇರುವ ಉಪಯೋಗವೇನು? ಎನ್ನುವ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರವಾಗಿ 'ಕರ್ನಾಟಕವೊಂದೇ.. : ಒಳಿತು ತರಲಿದೆ ಕೆಡುಕು' ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಲೇಖಕ 'ವಸಂತ ಶೆಟ್ಟಿ'. ಕೇಳಿ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

inchara.title: Inchara
inchara.description: "ರವಿ ಕಾಣದ್ದನ್ನ ಕವಿ ಕಂಡ" ಎನ್ನುವ ಮಾತಿನಂತೆ, ಬರಹಗಾರರಾದ 'ನಾಗರಾಜ‌ ಮಹೇಶ್ವರಪ್ಪ' ಅವರು ಬದುಕಿನ ವಿವಿಧ ಮಜಲುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಕವಿತೆಗಳನ್ನ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆ ಕವನಗಳ ಗುಚ್ಛವೇ 'ಇಂಚರ'. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ

a-monks-almanack.title: A Monk's Almanac : Life Sutras for Troubled Times
a-monks-almanack.description: "A Monk's Almanac: Life Sutras for Troubled Times" is a book by Nityanand Charan Das,  offers guidance for navigating life's challenges using ancient wisdom and practical tools. The book is presented as a guide for addressing pressing life questions, drawing from both personal experience and spiritual scriptures.

हारिये-ना-हिम्मत--लेखक--श्री-राम-शर्मा-आ.title: Haariye Na Himmat | Writer - Shree Ram Sharma Acharya

8-steps-to-innovation.title: 8 Steps to Innovation : Going from Jugaad to Excellence
8-steps-to-innovation.description: 8 Steps to Innovation shows how Indian organizations can move from ad-hoc ideas to structured innovation. With real Indian examples, it teaches how to build an idea pipeline, boost idea flow, and implement solutions effectively — all within real-world constraints. A must-listen for anyone looking to innovate with intention.

swatantra-bharatadalli-atantra-karnataka.title: Swatantra Bharatadalli Atantra Karnataka
swatantra-bharatadalli-atantra-karnataka.description: ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಭಾರತದ ಒಕ್ಕೂಟ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ಅಂಗವಾಗಿರುವ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಗಬೇಕಾದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯಗಳು ಸಿಕ್ಕಿವೆಯೇ? ನೆಲ-ಜಲ-ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಿರುವ ಅನ್ಯಾಯಗಳು ಎಂತಹವು? ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕುರಿತಂತೆ ಹೇಗೆ ವರ್ತಿಸಿವೆ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಜ್ವಲಂತ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದೊಡನೆ ಇಟ್ಟು ನೋಡುತ್ತದೆ ಕೃತಿ. ಕೇಳಿ "ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಂತ್ರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ" ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

geluvina-touch.title: Geluvina Touch
geluvina-touch.description: ದಿನಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಆಯ್ದ ಅಂಕಣ ಬರಹಗಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವೇ "ಗೆಲುವಿನ ಟಚ್" ಪುಸ್ತಕ. ಯಾವುದೇ ಪಕ್ಷ, ಪಂಗಡ, ಜಾತಿ, ಧರ್ಮ, ರಾಜಕೀಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೂರ್ವಗ್ರಹವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನೆತ್ತಿಕೊಂಡು ‘ಇದು ಹೀಗೂ ಇದೆಯೇ!’ ಎಂದು ಅಚ್ಚರಿಯಾಗುವಂತೆ ಬರೆಯುವ ಇವರ ಶೈಲಿ ಅಸಂಖ್ಯ ಓದುಗರ ಮನ ಗೆದ್ದಿದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಲೇಖನವೂ ಅದರ ವಸ್ತುನಿನ ಸುತ್ತ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸುತ್ತದೇ ವಿವಿಧ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ, ಹೊಂದಿಕೆ, ಹೋಲಿಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ಸೃಜನಶೀಲವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಯಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನೈಜ ಜೀವನ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನೂ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ತಿಳಿಸಬೇಕೆಂಬ ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಾಳಜಿ ಮತ್ತು ಲಘು ಹಾಸ್ಯದ ಧಾಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಓದುಗರನ್ನು ನಕ್ಕು ನಗಿಸುತ್ತಲೇ ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಹಚ್ಚುವ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಕರಾಮತ್ತುಗಳು ಈ ಬರಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಫುಲವಾಗಿದೆ.ಕೇಳಿ "ಗೆಲುವಿನ ಟಚ್" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

kedarnath-2013-pralay-ya-chetavani.title: Kedarnath 2013: Pralay ya Chetavani?
kedarnath-2013-pralay-ya-chetavani.description: 17 जून 2013 को केदारनाथ में ऐसा सैलाब आया, जिसने कुछ ही घंटों में हजारों जिंदगियां उजाड़ दीं। चोराबारी ताल के टूटने से आई इस तबाही में लोग अपनों से बिछड़ गए और पूरा केदारनाथ मलबे में दब गया। लेकिन क्या ये सिर्फ एक प्राकृतिक आपदा थी, या पहाड़ पहले ही किसी बड़े खतरे की चेतावनी दे चुके थे? इस प्रलय के बीच एक पिता अपने लापता बेटे को खोजता रहा—और पीछे छूट गया एक सवाल: क्या इस तबाही को रोका जा सकता था?

dahana.title: Dahana
dahana.description:
ಸಮಾಜದ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಬೇಕಾಗಿರುವ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯಂತೆ ಸೇತೂರಾಮ್ ಅವರ ಮೂರು ಕಥೆಗಳು ಇಲ್ಲಿವೆ.‘ನಂಗೇಲಿ’:ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡೀ ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವದ ಅಧಃಪತನದ ನಾಟಕವು ಪ್ರಧಾನ ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ‘ಒಂದೆಲಗ’:ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಂಗಲ್-ಪೇರೆಂಟ್‍ನ ಗಂಡು ಹೆಣ್ಣುಗಳ ಜೀವನಚಿತ್ರಗಳಿವೆ. ಮತ್ತು ದಹನ’:ಉಳಿದೆರಡು ಕಥೆಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಭಿನ್ನವಾದದ್ದು ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣವಾದ ಕಥೆಯಾಗಿದೆ..
ಕೇಳಿ "ದಹನ" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

daari-tappisu-devare.title: Daari Tappisu Devare
daari-tappisu-devare.description: ಮಂಜುನಾಥ್ ಕಾಮತ್ ಅವರ ಎರಡೇ ಪುಸ್ತಕ.‌ ಪ್ರವಾಸ ಕಥನ. ಕನ್ನಡ ಕರಾವಳಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಮಲೆನಾಡ ಸುತ್ತಾಟದ ಕೆಲವು ಕಥೆಗಳ ಸಂಕಲನ. ಪ್ರವಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಹಲವು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಪರಿಚಯ. ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಬದುಕಿನ ರುಚಿಯ ಅಕ್ಷರ. ಕೇಳಿ "ದಾರಿ ತಪ್ಪಿಸು ದೇವರೇ" ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

akele-hum-akele-tum-2.title: Akele Hum Akele Tum
akele-hum-akele-tum-2.description: After losing her father and being thrown out of her own home, Sanvi is left with nothing but her little brother Dhruv. When Dhruv’s life hangs by a thread, a mysterious elderly woman offers Sanvi a deal she cannot refuse—become the heir to the powerful Raydit empire and transform her arrogant grandson Saransh into a responsible man. But entering the Raydit mansion means facing the very man who blames her for everything that went wrong in his life.

the-maverick-effect.title: The Maverick Effect
the-maverick-effect.description:
தி மாவெரிக் எஃபெக்ட்…” இந்தியாவோட ரொம்ப பெரிய ஐ.டி புரட்சி உள்ளுணர்வோட வரலாறு
ஹரிஷ் எஸ். மேத்தா எழுதின இந்த book பெரிய ஹிட்ன்னு சொன்னா சரியா இருக்கும். அன்ட் இந்த புக் ஒரு தனிப்பட்ட வாழ்க்கையோட சமரய்ஸ்ட் வெர்ஷன். அப்புறம் சில கம்பெனிஸோட ஹிஸ்டரியும் இதுல சொல்லப்பட்டு இருக்கு. சோ, முழு புக்கையும் கேட்டு என்ஜாய் பண்ணுங்க

the-making-of-hero.title: The Making of Hero
the-making-of-hero.description: “The Making of Hero”  ன்ற இந்த புக் சம்திங் ஸ்பெஷல் தானுங்க… பிசினஸ் புக் ன்னாலே நமக்குள்ள உள்ள பணம் சம்பாதிக்கிற ஒரு கேரக்டர மேல தூக்கி விடும் இல்லையா? ஆனா இந்த புக்க கேட்டு  முடிக்கும் போது, இது ரொம்பவே நம்ம மனசுக்கு நெருக்கமாகிடும்.

cyber-don-ani-billionaire-boss.title: Cyber Don Ani Billionaire Boss
cyber-don-ani-billionaire-boss.description: The show weaves together two escalating crises: a buried rural injustice and a high-stakes banking cyberattack. It begins with a farmers' suicide and land-grab scandal that powerful people try to suppress through threats, leverage, and pressure on officials. As the truth is pushed toward the courts and public scrutiny, the story widens into the world of Hirakar Bank, where corruption, debt exploitation, and hidden records are tied to the same power network. Vedant emerges as the central technical expert, first recognized for cyber defense success and then repeatedly called back as the only person who can stop a major breach. He is often delayed, doubted, or publicly humiliated, even while warning that customer data, money, and critical systems are in immediate danger. The bank crisis grows more severe as hacked systems, stolen funds, and collapsing balances create a national emergency. Authority figures, police, and wealthy elites repeatedly treat Vedant as suspicious or incompetent, forcing him to prove himself while the timer keeps running. In parallel, the story shows how class power is used to shame ordinary people in public, turning dignity into another battleground. Family pressure also weighs heavily on Vedant, adding personal strain to the professional crisis. The rural thread keeps resurfacing through references to farmer suffering, land grabbing, and revenge for a father's death. These accusations suggest that the banking empire's wealth may have been built on exploitation, though the full extent is not always spelled out. As raids, leaked records, and exposed chats close in, the Hirakar family's control begins to crack. Vikrant Hirakar remains defiant and volatile, trying to dismiss warnings and preserve authority even as losses mount. The cyberattack and fraud scandal converge into one larger collapse of trust, where insiders and outsiders both appear to be involved. Vedant insists he acted under orders and that the threat reaches beyond ordinary crime into national security. By the end of the batch, the bank is in ruins, the scandal is public, and the fight shifts from concealment to survival and accountability.

secret-big-bull-kanavan.title: Secret Big Bull Kanavan
secret-big-bull-kanavan.description: தன்னை வேறொருவனுடன் ஏமாற்றிய காதல் மனைவி ஜனனிக்கு மறு வாய்ப்பு கொடுக்கிறான் கணவன் வெற்றி . ஆனால் அவனுடன் சேர்ந்து காசுக்காக வெற்றியை வயதான பெண் business magnate-ற்கு விற்று தன்னுடைய பிசினஸ்-ஐ வளர்க்க நினைக்கிறாள் . அவள் வலையில் வெற்றி விழுந்தானா? உண்மையில் யார் அவன் ?

nikamma-nahi-sikandar.title: Nikamma Nahi Sikandar
nikamma-nahi-sikandar.description: The story begins with a life-threatening industrial accident that sets a harsh tone of danger and survival. From there, it expands into a workplace world where cleaners, junior workers, and poor employees are repeatedly humiliated by supervisors and elites who use status as a weapon. Subbu, Rahul, Rehan, Aadil, and others are treated as outsiders even when they try to help, work hard, or speak the truth. Their struggle is not only for safety and dignity, but also for the right to be seen as capable people. In several cases, hidden merit slowly comes to light through notebooks, study, technical knowledge, and years of labor. When warnings about faulty formulas are finally proven correct, the balance of power shifts, at least briefly, toward the underdogs. The factory and corporate conflicts also reveal how easily authority figures dismiss truth until it becomes impossible to ignore. At the same time, Zara emerges as a central figure in a separate but connected web of pride, class conflict, and emotional control. She repeatedly humiliates or rejects men who approach her, yet she is also trapped by family pressure, public expectations, and choices made around her. Her relationships are marked by jealousy, forced matches, and arguments over whether love can survive hardship. Farooq and other family elders try to protect or direct her future, sometimes by arranging marriages that deepen her conflict. Sikku’s marriage to Zara becomes especially strained, with tenderness, humiliation, and duty all colliding in public and private. He eventually asks for divorce, showing that the relationship cannot hold under the weight of pride and unequal power. Around the same time, the story widens into a competition and innovation plot where formulas, notebooks, and defense-linked research become sources of both opportunity and conspiracy. Pawar and others are mocked, tested, and suspected, but they continue to prove their worth under pressure. The final stretch ties together stolen work, sabotage, hidden identities, and family secrets, especially through Zara’s revelation of her connection to Vikram Sinha. By the end of the batch, the show remains driven by unresolved battles over recognition, loyalty, class, and who truly deserves power.

countdown-king-2.title: Countdown king
countdown-king-2.description: A man’s life, marked by betrayal and poverty, changes after an accident gives him the power to foresee deaths, hidden illnesses, antique values, and stock futures. Rising from a delivery boy to a city kingmaker, he makes those who rejected him pay. But he soon learns that every power comes with a terrifying cost.

badshah-begum-ghulam.title: Badshah, Begum, Ghulam
badshah-begum-ghulam.description: A gifted gambler sets out to find the family that abandoned him, only to discover he is the long-lost heir to a powerful casino empire. As ruthless enemies close in and old prophecies resurface, he must risk everything to protect the family that once rejected him and reclaim his destiny.

the-alpha-kings-redemption-4.title: The Alpha King’s Redemption
the-alpha-kings-redemption-4.description: A humble street-sweeper lives a hidden life, suppressing his violent past. When his teenage daughter is brutalized and trafficked, he is pushed to the edge. Forced to reclaim his true identity as a powerful and feared wolf clan leader, he rises from the shadows, unleashing his primal fury to dismantle a ruthless trafficking empire and rescue his daughter.

falling-for-a-farm-king-1.title: Falling for a Farm King
falling-for-a-farm-king-1.description:
A broken single father, Saumya Raghuvanshi, is emotionally blackmailed by his ruthless grandmother into marrying Simar, an orphan girl sold into marriage for money.
What begins as a cold-hearted deal for his mute daughter Kuhu’s care slowly transforms into an intense battle of trust, healing, and love.
Amid family conspiracies, a jealous stepbrother, and dangerous betrayals, Simar must prove she is not a purchased bride… but the woman destined to rebuild a shattered family.

last-call-for-zindagi.title: Last call for zindagi
last-call-for-zindagi.description: Harsh loved Anushka deeply, but she married someone else. Heartbroken, he let her go, until her husband, Mukul, betrays her for money and leaves her trapped inside a sinking car in a crocodile-infested lake. Hunted by the police and racing against time, Harsh risks everything to save the woman he never stopped loving. A high-voltage emotional thriller of love, betrayal, and survival. Watch now!

ghayal-champion.title: Ghayal Champion
ghayal-champion.description: A champion of a secret fighting group gives up on his fighting skills when his wife is killed and son is taken away, only to go back to the same life when he is faced with the villains of his past

dhanunjayudi-veera-gaadha.title: Dhanunjayudi Veera Gaadha
dhanunjayudi-veera-gaadha.description: A prince abandoned by his parents for being born different returns years later without knowing his true identity. When fate reveals the truth, he must choose between revenge and protecting the family that betrayed him.

my-wife-is-my-enemy.title: My Wife is My Enemy
my-wife-is-my-enemy.description: A billionaire working undercover as a factory worker marries his arrogant boss, Sheetal Singhania. What begins as a marriage fueled by hatred soon becomes a battle of pride, secrets, and redemption.

mohabbat-hai-mirchi.title: Mohabbat Hai Mirchi
mohabbat-hai-mirchi.description: Ananya begs her father Kapil for her mother’s surgery, but he sells her to settle a debt. Escaping, she meets the lethal Veer, who falls for her purity. Her boyfriend Rahul betrays her, conspiring with Kapil to traffic her. In a deadly showdown, Veer is shot, but Ananya fights back to save him. She destroys her heartless family, discovers Veer is her mysterious childhood savior, and finally claims her place as the queen of his empire.

aaha-kalyanam.title: Aaha Kalyanam
aaha-kalyanam.description: தனிமையில் வாழும் தனது தந்தைக்கு வாழ்க்கைத்துணையைத் தேடும் இளைஞன், குடும்பத்தால் நிராகரிக்கப்பட்ட ஒரு பெண்ணை சந்திக்கிறான். அவர்களின் இரண்டாவது திருமணம் பல உறவுகளின் உண்மையான முகங்களை வெளிக்கொணரும் உணர்ச்சிப்பூர்வமான பயணமாக மாறுகிறது.

the-day-he-walked-away.title: The Day He Walked Away
the-day-he-walked-away.description: Shan, Elin aur Mimi bachpan se saath bade hue the. Elin aur Mimi dono ne apna dil Shan ko de diya tha aur usse vaada liya tha ki college ke pehle din woh kisi ek ko apni zindagi ka hissa banayega. Lekin tabhi Jian naam ke ek chalak ladke ne gareebi ka naatak rachkar unke beech zehar ghol diya. Aur dil tootne ke baad Shan bina kuch kahe door chala gaya. Jab sach saamne aaya, kya Elin aur Mimi apna khoya hua pyaar wapas paa saki?

agni-veeran.title: Agni Veeran
agni-veeran.description: தன் தாயிடம் கொடுத்த சத்தியத்தால் தனது உண்மையான திறமையை மறைத்து வாழும் ஒரு இளைஞன், தங்கையின் உயிரையும் குடும்பத்தின் மரியாதையையும் காப்பாற்ற மீண்டும் சண்டைக் களத்தில் களமிறங்க வேண்டிய சூழ்நிலையை எதிர்கொள்கிறான்.

breakuper-shesh-oddhay.title: Breakuper Shesh Oddhay
breakuper-shesh-oddhay.description: The story centers on Ashish and Richa, whose relationship begins to unravel under secrecy, jealousy, and public pressure. What looks like a stable romance is repeatedly shaken by hidden calls, private meetings, and the sense that one of them may be loving the other as a substitute rather than as a first choice. Ashish discovers signs that Richa has been emotionally tied to Joy and later to other hidden connections, and this makes him question whether her affection is genuine. Richa, meanwhile, is pulled between Ashish and Joy, unable to fully escape either the past or the present. Joy keeps forcing the triangle into the open, turning private feelings into public tests, proposals, and humiliations. The conflict is not only romantic but also social, because status, class, and workplace hierarchy constantly shape how each person is treated. At Sigma Info, office power struggles intensify the emotional damage, with Joy using authority and public confrontation to dominate Ashish. Ashish refuses to submit, and his resistance becomes tied to his dignity as much as to his love life. Family power also enters the story when Ashish’s hidden identity is revealed and his father’s influence at Sigma Info becomes impossible to ignore. This revelation raises the stakes, because Ashish is no longer just a hurt lover or employee but also a man with a protected place in the company. Even so, the emotional core remains unstable, since Richa continues to try to repair what has been broken while Ashish doubts every gesture she makes. Small domestic moments, gifts, apologies, and brief tenderness never fully undo the damage. The relationship repeatedly swings between longing and accusation, with each new revelation reopening old wounds. Joy’s persistence keeps the triangle alive, while coworkers and friends add pressure by taking sides or questioning Richa’s choices. Ashish is also shown as emotionally isolated, with his loneliness and family distance deepening his mistrust. By the end of the batch, no one has found a clean resolution, and the central question remains whether love, loyalty, and honesty can survive the mix of betrayal, pride, and public shame.

the-eight-ball-genius.title: The Eight Ball Genius
the-eight-ball-genius.description: After legendary billiards champion Raj Parmar dies in a mysterious accident, his soul awakens inside the body of a teenage boy, Vaibhav from a fallen pool dynasty. As he secretly uses his genius to revive the disgraced Sengar family, he must battle ruthless rivals, criminal conspiracies, and the risk of exposing his impossible identity. Watch now.

sakalakala-vaidya.title: Sakalakala Vaidya
sakalakala-vaidya.description: Vedant, a brilliant doctor whose license was canceled, works as a hospital ward boy. When he develops a revolutionary non-surgical heart treatment technique, his fiancée Nisha betrays him for the head surgeon Viraj. Expelled from the hospital, Vedant saves a child's life at an airport using his technique. Summoned back to treat the Health Minister, he faces brutal humiliation but ultimately proves his method works, earning redemption and his license restored.

the-fraud-genius.title: The Fraud Genius
the-fraud-genius.description: When a struggling street vendor with extraordinary healing skills crosses paths with a prestigious hospital, a simple herbal patch sparks a medical mystery no one can explain. As doctors question science, rivals challenge his past, and unexpected bonds begin to form, one gifted healer must prove whether his remedies are a miracle… or a fraud.

hrudayada-batsman.title: Hrudayada Batsman
hrudayada-batsman.description: A celebrated cricket star trapped in a fake relationship for publicity longs to reclaim his freedom. His life changes when he falls for a resilient single mother working as a delivery girl, haunted by an abusive ex-husband. As their unlikely romance blossoms, they face fierce opposition from fans, the media, and even his manipulative mother, who will stop at nothing to tear them apart.

dil-darling-aur-dhokha.title: Dil ,Darling aur Dhokha
dil-darling-aur-dhokha.description: Secret billionaire Raghav lives as a valet to test the world’s true colors. He endures extreme humiliation from his daughter Ira’s greedy fiancé, Harsh, and the elitist Nysa. Amidst the abuse, billionaire Diana falls for Raghav’s integrity and marries him. When the villains attempt to destroy his family’s dignity, Raghav reveals his true identity as the King of the Garuda Syndicate. He exacts a satisfying revenge, bankrupting the traitors and reclaiming his throne with his new family.

return-for-revenge-2.title: Return For Revenge
return-for-revenge-2.description: Aditya Pratap Singh, a disciplined government officer, breaks from routine and returns toward Devagada after years away, carrying a private promise to reunite with Varshini. His journey is immediately framed by danger, secrecy, and the sense that he is entering a hostile zone without protection. What begins as a personal return quickly widens into a public conflict over illegal toll collection, roadside extortion, and the abuse of local authority. Aditya and others challenge the people running these collections, and the resistance turns into humiliation, beatings, and open threats. Varshini becomes a central emotional fault line, because multiple men claim ties to her and she pushes back against unwanted possession and old coercion. As the violence deepens, Vikki and other enforcers appear to control the street-level brutality, while police presence does not immediately restore order. At the same time, Aditya’s disappearance or uncertain status draws in officials like Birendra Hegde, who presses police for answers and tries to trace what happened near the toll gate. The search reveals that the local clash is not isolated, but connected to a wider network involving political pressure, hidden identities, and interference from powerful figures. An injured man, Achchu, becomes a key link in that mystery, and his condition raises the stakes from a simple missing-person concern to something much larger. The story also folds in family conflict and public protest, especially through Purnima and Varshini, whose disagreement over respect, loyalty, and justice erupts in front of a crowd. A protest meant to defend dignity is suddenly thrown into danger by an explosion, showing how quickly public dissent can become life-threatening. Achchu’s return after being presumed gone adds another shock, and his confrontation with Varshini suggests old betrayals and unresolved harm. Meanwhile, political actors and police continue to struggle over who controls the narrative, with accusations of impersonation, fraud, and misuse of office repeatedly surfacing. Those identity disputes eventually give way to stronger proof of corruption, including illegal toll collection, abuse of citizens, and misuse of public property tied to influential people. Aditya’s role shifts from missing officer to reform-minded leader as he prepares to expose the corrupt network from within. By the end of the batch, the conflict has expanded from a personal promise into a broad struggle over legitimacy, justice, and political power. The show closes this stretch with the sense that the fight is far from over, and that every revelation only deepens the danger around Aditya, Varshini, and the people caught between them.

the-game-changer-sweeper.title: The Game Changer Sweeper
the-game-changer-sweeper.description: To fulfill his grandfather’s dying wish, a secretive multi-billionaire lives undercover as a lowly toilet sweeper, navigating a contractual marriage to a struggling CEO while using his hidden influence and lethal skills to dismantle her corporate enemies and underworld threats.

lady-boss-returns-14.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns-14.description: The show follows a high-stakes web of corporate romance, family control, and public humiliation centered on women who refuse to stay powerless. Early on, a wealthy heir asks a stranger to pose as his wife to escape family pressure, while another woman rejects a marriage-for-money bargain because she is loyal to her fiance. As the story expands, hotel events and company meetings become battlegrounds where status, money, and reputation are used to attack the heroines. Kiara, Jia, Sayli, and related identities are repeatedly mocked by arrogant men and jealous rivals who try to reduce them to gold-diggers or impostors. Yet each time the women push back, exposing hypocrisy and forcing powerful men to answer for their behavior. Tej Jaisingh emerges as a central figure who is tied to forced marriage pressure, but also repeatedly defends the woman he claims as his wife. Public gatherings become especially explosive, with rumors about rented husbands, fake brides, and hidden pasts turning into open confrontations. The balance of power shifts when Tej’s real authority as a CEO is revealed, undermining those who tried to shame him and Kiara. At the same time, old relationships resurface, including a woman from Tej’s past who claims his rise was built on her secret support. Corporate conflict deepens when major hotel deals, family alliances, and inheritance disputes become inseparable from romance. Queen, Ruby, and other powerful women use strategy and secrecy to redirect business outcomes and expose corruption tied to rival families. The Jindal family becomes a recurring source of manipulation, financial irregularities, and alliance pressure. Political figures and police also defer to the central woman’s influence, showing that her power reaches beyond business. The mystery of the Sky Queen becomes a major turning point, as public disbelief gives way to proof and recognition. Kyaara is first mocked as a fake, then publicly confirmed through a retina scan and other demands for proof. That revelation restores her authority, but it also intensifies the danger around her identity and the people trying to control her. Romance remains tied to equality rather than submission, as she rejects transactional love and accepts marriage only on equal terms as both business and life partner. In the later hotel mystery thread, hidden crying, a frightened mute girl, and blocked phone calls suggest that the polished property is concealing serious wrongdoing. Across all strands, the show’s core stakes stay the same: the heroines must protect their identities, expose corruption, and claim love and power without surrendering to family or class control.

mechanic-annayya.title: Mechanic Annayya
mechanic-annayya.description: Karthik begins as a brilliant, patriotic specialist who saves a failing F-31 mission by repairing a corrupted quantum stabilizer, but his story quickly expands beyond the sci-fi rescue into a long struggle over status, family, and hidden power. After the mission, he is pulled into elite spaces where he is repeatedly judged, blocked, or humiliated for not seeming to belong. His sister Maitri consistently stands beside him, and many of the conflicts turn on her refusal to let powerful people shame her brother. Weddings, business gatherings, hotels, and luxury events become battlegrounds where class prejudice is openly displayed and then challenged. Wealthy figures such as Rahul, Kavitha, Rajkumar Rao, and others use money, invitations, and social rank to control access and enforce hierarchy. The story repeatedly returns to the question of whether Karthik is only a mechanic or someone with a concealed identity and deeper authority. That uncertainty grows stronger as characters hint at his hidden connections, including references to Star Lord and to a past claim of having saved Star Lord’s life. Public insults often escalate into physical clashes, with siblings stepping in to defend one another and turn humiliation into retaliation. Maitri’s loyalty to Karthik remains one of the emotional anchors of the show, even when others try to isolate or expel them. At the same time, the family world around them becomes increasingly unstable, with accusations, broken trust, and financial pressure spreading through multiple gatherings. One branch of the story centers on a marriage that is revealed to be transactional and cruel, with love, bankruptcy, and temporary-spouse accusations tearing it apart. Another branch focuses on business control, where contracts, transfers, frozen accounts, and massive demands expose how money is used as leverage. Rajkumar Rao emerges as a powerful billionaire figure whose presence raises the stakes around access, partnership, and hidden influence. Maya’s interest in Rajkumar and warnings that he may value money over love add another layer of tension around status and romance. As the episodes progress, Karthik’s humiliation becomes harder to sustain because each confrontation suggests he has allies or authority that others failed to recognize. The elite characters who mock him are forced into apologies, panic, or retreat when his true standing begins to surface. By the later episodes, the show is less about whether Karthik can endure shame and more about how long the social order built against him can survive. The arc closes with unresolved conflict, but the balance of power has clearly shifted toward revelation, revenge, and the possibility of a major comeback.

my-lucky-star-1.title: My Lucky Star
my-lucky-star-1.description: The story begins with arranged-marriage pressure colliding with hidden identity and class tension. Vardhan hides as a common worker to avoid a childhood marriage arrangement, while Akhira is drawn into the match through family pressure and a bargain tied to employment. Their marriage becomes official through a rushed registration, but the relationship is immediately strained by domestic friction and the sense that divorce-like pressure still hangs over them. As the show expands, workplaces and public venues become battlegrounds where status is constantly tested. Lucky and Lakshya are repeatedly humiliated or challenged in cafes, restaurants, and corporate spaces, while staff, customers, and managers expose how fragile social standing can be. Akhira is also pushed into kitchens and hotel settings where she is blamed, blocked, or dismissed, yet each setback reveals more of her practical skill and determination. Her cooking talent is recognized by powerful figures, and even class-based mockery is answered by praise for the knowledge behind her food. The corporate world grows more hostile as Vardhan alternates between promotion and humiliation, and Akhira struggles to deliver urgent messages while guards and staff keep her away from decision-makers. The conflict then widens into a village-and-development struggle when Akhira brings forward a proposal tied to Devkund and local businesses, linking her personal fight to the future of her community. Vardhan’s reaction to the village name suggests a buried connection, and that uncertainty deepens the stakes around the redevelopment plan. At the same time, the show keeps returning to hidden truths inside marriage and family, including revelations that someone close may be living a double life or carrying a corporate identity beneath a domestic role. Akhira’s confrontation with powerful men over land, markets, and demolition turns the drama into a fight over memory, livelihood, and who gets to decide a village’s fate. Public humiliation and private betrayal repeatedly push her toward breaking point, but she keeps returning to the conflict rather than retreating. The food exhibition and birthday-event threads show her being forced into the spotlight before elite crowds, where she must perform under pressure and defend her worth. Support from allies such as Lucky, Shadab, and others helps her endure moments when she is mocked as a village girl or treated as unfit for the room she is in. The emotional center also includes softer domestic and romantic beats, where care, grief, and intimacy briefly soften the harsher power struggles. By the later stretch, family claims, marriage rumors, and corporate secrets collide in public showdowns, exposing how business alliances and personal loyalties are entangled. The overall arc is one of a woman fighting to protect her dignity, her village, and her place in a world that keeps trying to reduce her to class, rumor, or obligation.

throgam.title: Throgam
throgam.description: After a billionaire disguises himself as a delivery boy to live a simple life with his wife, he discovers her infidelity and cold-blooded betrayal. He decides to reveal his true identity to humiliate her and her lover, ultimately leaving his unfaithful wife with nothing but the regret of what she threw away.

rise-of-the-sword-king.title: Rise of the Sword King
rise-of-the-sword-king.description: The show follows a broad wuxia and cultivation arc built around hidden power, family shame, and the cost of strength. At its center are several men and women who are repeatedly judged by rank, engagement, and public tests, only to reveal that the people others dismiss may already be far stronger than they appear. One thread begins with Samrat, a legendary warrior who has spent thirty years striking a Tian rock in grief and self-blame after the death of the woman he loved. When the rock finally cracks and bursts apart, the release does not bring peace, because his father meets him with harsh words and the wound between them remains open. Another thread follows Fu Jue, who is mocked as weak, pressured by his father, rivals, and even his fiancée, and threatened with exile if he fails a coming competition. Yet each humiliation pushes him closer to exposing hidden status and sword mastery, making it harder for those around him to deny his worth. Around him, romance is never separate from power, since engagements are treated as public proof of strength and can be broken or preserved only through cultivation and victory. Prerna and Raina are forced to endure public pressure over a missing fiance, while Kaivan and other rivals try to turn her uncertainty into a breakup. Fu Jue repeatedly refuses to surrender his sword or his place, and the story keeps returning to the idea that strength must be proven before love can survive. In the palace and household arcs, succession becomes a battlefield of its own, with an aging patriarch secretly restoring an exiled younger son and placing hope in the next generation. Family bonds are shown as damaged by grief, old accusations, and the fear of disgrace, but some fathers also soften into regret and apology. Several younger characters choose to stay and train rather than flee, suggesting that endurance itself is part of their growth. The cultivation trials escalate quickly, with mysterious stones, sword-energy tests, and rank gaps exposing who has advanced and who has merely claimed status. Some fighters are humiliated, some are accused of cheating, and others suddenly reveal mastery that shocks the court. Ya Huan becomes one of the clearest examples of this reversal, transforming from a dismissed servant into a terrifying powerhouse whose strength comes from within herself. Her rise overturns old hierarchies and leaves former acquaintances unable to approach her as before. Sect conflict then widens the struggle beyond family, as rival factions mock the kingdom, defectors align with stronger powers, and palace authority is openly challenged. Fu-Li and his allies turn succession disputes into sect-versus-clan conflict, while other figures are forced to confront the gap between their current rank and the power now gathering around them. The later arc grows darker as tribulations, demon-linked survival, and dangerous mentors show that rapid advancement can be as deadly as weakness. Aira and other immortals are drawn into these pressures, with loyalty, jealousy, and service becoming tangled around the new palace master. In the end, the scale expands from household disgrace to cosmic conflict, as a sword sage defeats the demon leader Yao Huan, spares her to preserve balance, and then realizes that even godlike power has become a burden. Rather than remain trapped in court glory, he leaves palace life behind for secluded cultivation, closing the show on withdrawal, unresolved rivalry, and the sense that true strength may require stepping away from power rather than seizing it.

maro-avatharam-mogudu-bangaram.title: Maro Avatharam Mogudu Bangaram
maro-avatharam-mogudu-bangaram.description: మనుషులు ఎప్పుడు ఎలా మారతారో ఎవ్వరికీ తెలియదు. అప్పటి వరకూ తాగుబోతుగా ఉన్న వాడి జీవితం ఒక్కసారిగా మారిపోయింది. అసలు అతని జీవితంలో ఏం జరిగింది. మరో అవతారం ఏంటి అనేది ఆసక్తికరమైన కథ.

the-queen-of-the-mehfil.title: The Queen of the Mehfil
the-queen-of-the-mehfil.description: In the kothas of old Lucknow, celebrated courtesan Zarina Jaan is betrayed by the man she loved for seven years, Nawab Raza Mirza, who chooses her protégée Noor over her and leaves her for dead. Believed to have lost her memory, Zarina secretly remembers everything and enters Nawab Tariq Ali Khan's palace under a false pretense to take revenge. But as she destroys her enemies, she finds unexpected respect and love in Tariq, forcing her to choose between revenge and a second chance at happiness.

limit-crossed-1.title: Limit Crossed
limit-crossed-1.description: A betrayed housewife, thrown out of her own home for choosing self-respect over humiliation, rebuilds her life from scratch only to get entangled in a mysterious contract marriage with a wealthy stranger, leading to a powerful showdown of identity, dignity, and revenge.

the-billionaires-107-year-secret-1.title: The Billionaire's 107 Year Secret
the-billionaires-107-year-secret-1.description: Arjun’s wealthy family is thrown into crisis by a chain of disasters that includes damage to the home, his father’s paralysis, failed business deals, and a broken wedding. Seeking an explanation, Arjun turns to a priest who says the family is trapped in a curse that began 107 years ago. The priest shows him an old photograph of a woman who resembles Arjun’s grandmother and says the curse can only be broken if Arjun finds a girl who looks like that woman and marries her. Arjun accepts the burden and begins searching, tying the family’s present collapse to a buried ancestral mystery. As the search continues, the story widens into a modern-day hunt for a marked girl whose identity seems to decide both romance and inheritance. Nisha, Roshni, and other women become entangled in misunderstandings, money disputes, and sudden accusations as clues point to an airport sighting, a Ram Society address, and a distinctive body mark. Arjun’s business troubles briefly ease when a fraud is exposed and a culprit is arrested, but the relief does not last because the marriage mystery keeps tightening around the family. At the same time, Arjun’s feelings begin to shift toward Nisha, creating a romantic thread inside the larger fate-driven conflict. The household repeatedly turns hostile, with women being blamed, pushed out, or forced to prove themselves through marks, photographs, and public verification. A cook applicant’s mark leads to a shocking identity reveal, including recognition of hidden family ties and the return of a father who rises from a wheelchair. That revelation does not settle the conflict; instead, it deepens the struggle over status, obedience, and who truly belongs in the family. Weddings and engagement gatherings become battlegrounds where priests, elders, and relatives argue over auspicious timing, identity, and whether the bride is genuine. Shreya’s hidden connections and Nisha’s repeated humiliation fuel public confrontations, while accusations of theft, kidnapping, and deception fracture trust across the household. The family also links Nisha to bad luck, blaming her for fresh misfortunes and even a major canceled tender. In response, elders push an urgent marriage as a remedy, but the ceremony is repeatedly interrupted by ritual warnings and doubts about the bride’s identity. Arjun eventually recognizes the real woman by a mark and rushes to stop her from leaving, showing that the search has become both a family duty and a personal plea. By the end, the household is split between those trying to preserve control and those trying to escape humiliation, while the curse, the marriage, and the hidden past remain unresolved.

mizhiyariyathe.title: Mizhiyariyathe
mizhiyariyathe.description: The story follows Rahul, also known as Parthiva or Parthi, as family pressure and business leverage repeatedly push him toward marriage. His mother treats marriage as a condition for keeping his position and shares in the Varma business, while he resists with sarcasm and suspicion. A mistaken-identity confrontation in a cafe turns into public humiliation, apologies, and a legal threat, which then becomes the basis for a forced-marriage arrangement. Vani is drawn into that arrangement as a way to save the man from jail, and the wedding goes ahead under pressure. From the start, the marriage is unstable, with the couple clashing over trust, living arrangements, and hidden motives. What looks like a fake or forced union gradually develops real emotional tension, even as both sides keep testing each other. At the same time, the marriage becomes tied to corporate power, and shares are transferred to Vani on the wedding day. That transfer changes the balance of power, because divorce is no longer simple and the family can no longer control the couple as easily. Vani is also pulled into office conflict, where she is overlooked, insulted, and punished through salary threats, demotion, and public humiliation. Catherine Mathew and other powerful figures use status, money, and hidden deals to pressure her, but Vani keeps pushing back. In several moments, vulnerable women around her are falsely accused or shamed, and Vani steps in to defend dignity against abuse of authority. The story also widens into family betrayal, with relatives demanding money, favors, and property while trying to control Vani’s choices. As the hidden marriage and hidden ownership become public, the private bond between husband and wife turns into a full family and business crisis. Vani eventually reveals that she controls a majority stake in Varma Group, overturning the assumptions made about her background and status. Her husband’s role shifts too, because he is shown arranging or supporting the share transfer and defending her openly. Public insults against Vani begin to damage business deals, showing that her social standing now has direct corporate consequences. By the end, the central conflict is no longer whether the marriage will happen, but whether love, loyalty, and shared power can survive the family’s attempts to separate them.

ang-laga-de-re.title: Ang Laga De Re
ang-laga-de-re.description: Navya is dumped by her fiancé Dheeraj for her sister Sanvi. She enters a contract marriage with Krish, thinking he is a poor worker, unaware he is the secret billionaire Diamond King KK. While Sanvi and Dheeraj humiliate her, Krish protects her and reveals his status. Navya inherits 20,000 crores, leaving her betrayers bankrupt. Despite Samaira's schemes, Navya and Krish turn their forced contract into a lifetime of true love.

super-surya.title: Super Surya
super-surya.description: பன்னிரண்டு ஆண்டுகளாக தனது வீர வாழ்க்கையை விட்டு சாதாரண தந்தையாக வாழும் சூர்யா, அதிகாரமும் பணமும் கொண்டு அப்பாவி மக்களை ஒடுக்க நினைக்கும் சக்திகளுக்கு எதிராக மீண்டும் களமிறங்க வேண்டிய சூழ்நிலையில் சிக்குகிறார். தனது கடந்தகாலத்தை மீண்டும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் அவர், நீதிக்காக போராடும் மாவீரனாக மறுபிறவி எடுக்கிறார்.

the-real-boss.title: The Real Boss
the-real-boss.description:
గౌతమ్ ఒక పెద్ద ఇంట్లో తోటమాలిగా నటిస్తుంటాడు, కానీ నిజానికి అతనే అండర్ వరల్డ్ సిండికేట్‌ను శాసించే *"సీక్రెట్ బాస్"*. ఈ నిజం తెలియక అతని భార్య మేఘన, ధనవంతుడైన రానా దేవ్‌ కోసం గౌతమ్‌కు విడాకులు ఇస్తుంది. రానా దేవ్ కుటుంబం సిండికేట్ లాకర్‌ను దోచుకోవాలని చూస్తుంది.
ఈ క్రమంలో, గతంలో బుల్లెట్ గాయమైన తన ప్రాణాలను కాపాడింది మేఘన కాదు, *మాయ* అని గౌతమ్‌కు తెలుస్తుంది. క్లైమాక్స్‌లో గౌతమ్ తన అసలు రూపాన్ని బయటపెట్టి, రానా దేవ్‌ను అంతం చేసి, మాయను సిండికేట్‌కు కొత్త రాణిగా ప్రకటిస్తాడు.

bhoot-kaal.title: Bhoot-Kaal
bhoot-kaal.description: Bhoot-Kaal is a supernatural thriller blending horror, folklore, mystery, and emotional tragedy. Set in the cursed village of Vanshagarh, where every wedding ends in death or disappearance, the story follows Meera, who returns to marry despite Naishka's curse. As terrifying paranormal events unfold, she teams up with paranormal researcher Adrith to uncover the truth - only to realize the curse hides a dark secret that will change everything. Watch now!

taxi-baashha.title: Taxi Baashha
taxi-baashha.description: The story follows Rajat Singhania, who hides in plain sight as taxi driver Sridhar while searching for the truth behind his mother’s death. His undercover life keeps pulling him into street fights, rescues, and confrontations with armed men and criminal networks. At the same time, women around him are caught in danger, humiliation, and confusion, including cases of pursuit, possible drugging, and public shame. Meera tries to pull Rajat back toward his privileged family life, but his hidden mission keeps him tied to conflict and revenge. The drama widens when business and security threats surface, including a weapons-dealing crisis and a bomb-related showdown that force his authority into the open. In those moments, the hidden heir is no longer just a driver but someone powerful enough to challenge criminals and expose corruption. Family truth becomes just as explosive as the criminal plot, especially when a mother arrives with a child and demands answers after years of searching. A DNA report and repeated claims of parentage deepen the uncertainty around who belongs to whom. Shanaya becomes a central figure in this struggle, as relatives argue over whether she is legitimate, where she belongs, and who should protect her. Her scenes are marked by public humiliation, threats of orphanage, and even physical danger. The show also builds around women who are forced into impossible choices, including a rich heroine who offers marriage and money as a bargain to a taxi driver. That marriage pressure connects to a larger web of hidden parentage, forced duty, and emotional manipulation. Ridhima, Sridhar, Aditya, and others are drawn into a tangled fight over marriage, identity, and the child’s future. Class conflict runs through nearly every confrontation, with elite figures mocking poorer parents while those parents fight to defend their dignity. Corporate power struggles intensify alongside the family war, as shares, investors, and company control become weapons in the same battle for recognition. Public events such as charity galas, hotel confrontations, and press conferences repeatedly expose private wounds in front of everyone. By the later episodes, accusations of fraud, inheritance disputes, and revenge over a mother’s death make the conflict even more personal. Across the batch, the central stakes are survival, legitimacy, and the right to be recognized as family, heir, parent, or spouse.

thudakam-20.title: Thudakam 2.0
thudakam-20.description: Still Waiting for Love is an emotional family drama about Minakshi, a selfless mother abandoned by her own children, who finds a second chance through Tushar, a wealthy man living simply, and Vivan, a son yearning for maternal love. Blending romance, comedy, humiliation, and revenge, the story explores class divide, age-gap companionship, sacrifice, greed, and destiny, delivering powerful female resilience, shocking twists, and emotional justice in every episode.

mannina-maga.title: Mannina Maga
mannina-maga.description: Randeep (aka Mahabali) is a hidden prodigy living a fake “loser” life due to a promise to his dying mother. When his sister, school, and honor are threatened by ruthless enemies and underground conspiracies, he slowly unleashes his true identity, leading to revenge, power battles, and a larger hidden system controlling the martial arts world.

married-to-the-farm-king.title: Married To The Farm King
married-to-the-farm-king.description: A broken single father is emotionally forced by his ruthless grandmother to marry an orphan girl who is sold into marriage for money. What starts as a cold deal for the care of his mute daughter slowly becomes a journey of trust, healing, and love. Amid family conspiracies, a jealous stepbrother, and dangerous betrayals, she must prove that she is not a purchased bride, but the woman destined to rebuild a shattered family.

--किराया-रो-बालम.title: किराया रो बालम
--किराया-रो-बालम.description:
Aa bas ek prem kahani nahi Dhokha, ahamkaar ar kismat ro khel hai
Terrence ek ameer ar takatwar ladko ar myra ek sachi ar simple si ladki yaa dona ki mulaqaat jad hove hai to kahani me ek nayo modd aave hai. Ek aiso rishto jo majboori ke chalte banyo pan mushkila aur nafrat re bich ek ankaha rishta me badal jaave hai.
Pan halaat aur bhi jyada mushkil ho jaave hai jad Terrence ko raaz sabke saamne aave hai,  kaai ek soda su shuru hui aa kahani kismat aur halaat re aage haar jaasi?

the-18-year-old-is-my-grandpa.title: The 18 Year Old is My Grandpa

lakshman-the-it-king.title: Lakshman The IT King
lakshman-the-it-king.description: காதலித்த பெண் பணக்கார CEO-வுக்காக அவனை தூக்கி எறிந்தாள்... 'லூசர்' என்று அவமானப்படுத்தினாள். ஆனால் அவள் துரோகம் செய்தவன், ஒரு சாதாரண ஊழியன் அல்ல... உலகின் மிக ஆபத்தான AI ஜீனியஸ்.

return-for-revenge-1.title: Return For Revenge
return-for-revenge-1.description:
A newly appointed Union Minister, hiding a dangerous past as a covert intelligence officer, returns to his forgotten hometown in disguise to reunite with his lost love.
But what he finds is a town drowning in corruption, fear, and betrayal—where even love has chosen power over truth.
When the system turns against him, he must rise not as a minister, but as a man of the people.
In a final face-off, he exposes an entire corrupt network, redefining power, justice, and love.

the-weakest-became-supreme.title: The Weakest Became Supreme
the-weakest-became-supreme.description: Yan gave up his future for the woman he loved, only to be betrayed and abandoned when he needed her most. Mocked as the weakest and trapped at the lowest cultivation level, he becomes the laughing stock of the martial world. But hidden within him is a power that defies all limits. As those who once humiliated him begin to fear his rise, Yan embarks on a path of vengeance, redemption, and glory. The weakest was underestimated… but he is destined to become supreme.

rajavin-parvaiyile.title: Rajavin Parvaiyile
rajavin-parvaiyile.description: தனது திறமையால் நிறுவனம் வளர்ந்ததாக பெருமை பேசும் மோனிகா, அமைதியாக இருந்த பிரித்வியை அனைவரின் முன்னும் இழிவுபடுத்துகிறாள். ஆனால் அவர் சாதாரண ஊழியர் அல்ல; நிறுவனத்தின் வெற்றிக்கு பின்னால் இருந்த மூளையும், உலகின் மிகப்பெரிய தொழில் சாம்ராஜ்யத்தின் வாரிசும் அவர்தான். உண்மை வெளிவந்ததும், மோனிகாவின் ஆணவம் சிதறி, அவள் கட்டிய பேரரசே சரிந்து விழத் தொடங்குகிறது. காதல், பழிவாங்கல், அதிகாரம் மற்றும் உண்மையின் மோதலே இந்தக் கதையின் மையம்.

nanny-se-najdikiyan.title: Nanny Se Najdikiyan
nanny-se-najdikiyan.description: Nandini’s story begins in humiliation, as she is publicly shamed and forced into servitude, but she refuses to be broken and makes clear that her struggle is only beginning. Around her, Adhiraj moves through a world of political pressure, family pride, and public accusations, while an unnamed bond between them keeps resurfacing. Their connection grows through private comfort and open defiance, even as jealousy and suspicion spread through the household. Adhiraj rejects a political marriage alliance and later declares that if anyone comes to him as a bride, it will be Nandini. At the same time, hidden identities and power games deepen the conflict, with women around him trying to control what he remembers and what he believes. A newborn is taken from Nandini under the claim that the baby was dead, and that loss becomes tied to inheritance, deception, and family control. After an accident, Adhiraj wakes with no memory and is manipulated into accepting a false fiancee and a false daughter. Naina enters the wealthy household as a caretaker to support her ill grandmother, but her concealed identity only pulls her deeper into the same web of suspicion. Her presence unsettles the household, draws hostility from Kavya, and also awakens Adhiraj’s unexplained familiarity, strange dreams, and desire to uncover the truth. As the pressure rises, money, education, and a child’s future are used as leverage to keep people silent. Naina endures heartbreak in silence, while others urge her to speak, and Adhiraj asks for help investigating her past. The household’s false stability begins to crack when accusations over stolen jewelry are exposed as a setup, and Mishka’s loyalty to Naina weakens Kavya’s control. A lullaby becomes a crucial emotional clue, linking the present to buried memory and suggesting that the past is not as lost as it seemed. The conflict then turns more dangerous, with poisoning, blackmail, abduction, and threats of death pushing everyone toward open confrontation. Nandini refuses to flee, chooses resistance, and is eventually rescued as the hidden mastermind behind the violence comes into focus. The truth finally breaks through through memory recovery, testimony, and DNA proof, revealing that Mishka is Nandini’s biological daughter who was stolen years earlier. Kavya is exposed as the one who orchestrated the child theft, the lies about her death, and the wider cover-up. By the end, arrests and proof collapse the deception, and Nandini, Adhiraj, and the child are brought back together, though the emotional damage of the past remains.

cheater-hendathi.title: Cheater Hendathi
cheater-hendathi.description: Micro Drama: A delivery boy, Rohit, secretly a billionaire founder, hides his identity to keep his wife Manisha happy. However, her ambition and greed lead her to abort their child and grow close to her wealthy ex, Shashank. Misunderstandings, betrayal, and class conflict escalate, pushing their marriage to the brink as Rohit struggles between love and revealing his true power.

the-ultimate-payback.title: The Ultimate Payback
the-ultimate-payback.description: A humble man returns to fulfill a promise to his first love, only to be humiliated by her and a ruthless MLA's family. Hiding his true identity as a Cabinet Minister, he sets out to destroy a corrupt system from within.

love-in-paris-1.title: Love In Paris
love-in-paris-1.description: After a whirlwind encounter in Paris and a chance reunion years later, a resilient woman named Kavya enters into a high-stakes contract marriage with Vedant, unaware that her "hired" husband is actually a billionaire CEO.

royal-parents.title: Royal Parents
royal-parents.description: The story is a long-running family and workplace conflict built around the Rathod and Rathore households, where status, identity, and humiliation drive nearly every confrontation. It begins with a hopeful anniversary visit to Grand Dominions, where an older couple dreams of owning a home but instead encounters a system that measures people by wealth and appearance. From there, the drama repeatedly shows vulnerable guests being mocked, blocked, or physically mistreated in VIP, service, office, and restaurant settings. Veena emerges as a sharp and often cruel enforcer of this hierarchy, while Vivek repeatedly stands up for people who are being treated as less than human. Ananya also pushes back when she sees Vivek or others being cornered, and several disputes turn public when staff, managers, or family members choose punishment over compassion. As the conflict grows, hidden identities and family claims become central, especially around who truly belongs to the Rathod family and who has the right to speak for it. An older woman insists she is Mrs. Rathod and names Vivek Rathod as her husband, but the crowd rejects her and the situation turns humiliating and violent. At the same time, other women are forced into apologies, restraint, or public degradation to protect husbands, children, or themselves from further harm. Medicine, money, and luxury goods become tools of control, with characters pressured to kneel, beg, or submit before help is given. Corporate power enters the same web of abuse when Veena interrupts a business meeting, claims family authority, and triggers more accusations and retaliation. Abhishek appears as a decisive authority figure who dismisses employees, blacklists them, and tries to contain the fallout, but his actions do not resolve the deeper conflict. The story also keeps returning to accusations of theft, especially around a birthday necklace that one young woman insists is hers. That accusation spreads into slapping, threats, destroyed property, and knife violence, pulling mothers, daughters, and fathers into the struggle. Several characters are forced to choose between protecting family members and preserving their own safety, and those choices often come at a humiliating cost. Even when someone reports an attack or seeks help, the response is usually delayed, conditional, or tied to power. By the later part of the story, blame, revenge, and mistaken identity have overtaken any hope of simple reconciliation. The final stretch widens into kidnapping and rescue pressure, showing that the family feud has become dangerous enough to threaten lives directly. Overall, the show tracks how class prejudice and family pride turn ordinary disputes into cycles of public shame, coercion, and retaliation.

too-late-to-love.title: Too Late To Love
too-late-to-love.description: Trapped in a toxic marriage with a ruthless tech CEO, a brilliant professor is pushed to his absolute breaking point by her twisted mind games and a manipulative student. But when he walks away to rewrite his future, a dark web of lies unravels, sparking a cold-blooded pursuit of revenge and a long-awaited reckoning. Love has a limit-and hers just ran out.

ओळख-रो-खेल.title: ओळख रो खेल
ओळख-रो-खेल.description:
Ek mamuli so dikhne walo aadmi…jike upre 100 crore ka hira ki chori ko ilzaam lag jaave hai or Ek takatwar ladki…jo duniya ri parwah kiye bina uss aadmi su byaav kar leve hai.
Pan jad sach saamne aave hai, to puro khel hi palat jaave hai, kyunki un aadmi ri pehchaan ek gehro raaz hai jo saamne aave hai to sabne hairaan kar deve hai.
Pyaar, taakat aur pehchaan ri ee kahani mein – Har sach ek nayo toofan ler aave hai

kaisa-tera-pyaar-hai.title: Kaisa Tera Pyaar Hai
kaisa-tera-pyaar-hai.description: After enduring years of emotional abuse and violent humiliation as a secretary for his ungrateful secret love, an undercover AI prodigy resigns to claim his rightful throne as a tech company CEO—ultimately exposing his manipulative rival's fraudulent lies and leaving his deeply regretful former boss behind for a woman who truly values his worth.

the-second-promise.title: The Second Promise
the-second-promise.description: Still Waiting for Love is an emotional family drama about a selfless mother abandoned by her own children, who finds a second chance through a wealthy man living simply, and a son yearning for maternal love. Blending romance, comedy, humiliation, and revenge, the story explores class divide, age-gap companionship, sacrifice, greed, and destiny, delivering powerful female resilience, shocking twists, and emotional justice in every episode.

the-magical-well.title: The Magical Well
the-magical-well.description: After being betrayed and murdered by his own family, a prince is reborn through a magical well and returns to the past with one chance to reclaim his kingdom, protect its greatest secret, and change his destiny.

the-arrival.title: The Arrival
the-arrival.description: After living in hiding for 12 years as a humble laborer to protect his daughter, Surya, the legendary legendary "Shoorveer" of Veeram Palace, is forced back into action when corrupt elites brutally bully and kidnap her. He dismantles a powerful criminal conspiracy involving four elite families and the villainous "Master" from his past, ultimately reclaiming his mythical status to deliver absolute justice.

the-bodyguard-husband.title: The Bodyguard Husband
the-bodyguard-husband.description: A haunted ex-elite operative, is pulled back into danger when he learns he has a daughter with powerful CEO. As rival business empires clash and enemies close in, he is forced into a reluctant marriage to protect them. Secrets resurface, loyalties are tested, and a fragile family forms amid a storm of power, betrayal, and survival.

naagvansham.title: Naagvansham
naagvansham.description: In the mystical kingdom of Avantika, young Aryam sets out with his mother Shakuntala to find his unknown father and reclaim her lost honor. Armed with a divine Naag-Dand and hidden powers, Aryam uncovers dark conspiracies, royal betrayals, deadly enemies, and his true destiny as the heir of a powerful dynasty. Amid revenge, war, and love, he rises as the legendary protector “Naagveer Aryam.” Watch now.

marrying-my-daughters-ceo-mom-1.title: Marrying My Daughter's CEO Mom
marrying-my-daughters-ceo-mom-1.description: Naman Ahuja, a haunted ex-elite operative, is pulled back into danger when he learns he has a daughter with powerful CEO Soma Arya. As rival business empires clash and enemies close in, Naman is forced into a reluctant marriage to protect them. Secrets resurface, loyalties are tested, and a fragile family forms amid a storm of power, betrayal, and survival.

thillana-thillana.title: Thillana Thillana
thillana-thillana.description: A ruthless businesswoman, Sheetal, humiliates her employee Raj, unaware he’s a powerful tycoon in disguise. As ego clashes turn into a toxic marriage, Raj silently endures her cruelty while protecting her and her company from hidden threats. Amid revenge, power games, and emotional turmoil, hatred slowly transforms into love and redemption.

suryavanshi-athiraj.title: Suryavanshi Athiraj
suryavanshi-athiraj.description: Adhiraj enters the Suryavanshi world as a disputed outsider, and the household immediately treats him with suspicion, humiliation, and open hostility. The central question is whether he is an illegitimate intruder or the rightful heir tied to an older royal bloodline. His grandmother and other elder women repeatedly protect, test, or publicly support him, keeping that question alive. Early conflicts revolve around lineage clues, especially handwriting, calligraphy, and ancient artifacts that seem to connect him to the Bhairava clan. Even when the family mocks his village background, Adhiraj refuses to submit and keeps pressing his claim. A major turning point comes when he exposes a prized ring as a counterfeit, turning a public humiliation into proof that he understands the family’s hidden history better than his critics do. That dispute leads to apologies, fallout, and growing recognition from powerful elders. He is then formally elevated into leadership within the family business, where he must prove himself again in a corporate arena that mirrors the family war. As the new boss, he pushes a luxury strategy tied to ancestral legacy and launches a premium product as both a business move and a symbolic assertion of belonging. Rival family members resist at every step, and succession becomes an open battle over status, control, and honor. The conflict deepens when attacks, blackmail, and kidnapping suggest that the struggle is no longer only about pride but about survival. Paatti and other elders continue to press for the truth about his identity, while hidden parentage and old betrayals surface around the family. The story expands into a broader mythic lineage reveal, with royal seals, lost bloodlines, and secret formulas reinforcing that the inheritance dispute is larger than one household. At the same time, DNA revelations and buried affairs expose how unstable the family’s foundations really are. Adhiraj is repeatedly challenged by rivals who want to strip him of authority, shares, and legitimacy. The family’s power structure collapses further under legal fights, public exposure, and accusations tied to past crimes. By the end of the arc, the empire is in ruins, and Adhiraj is positioned as the one trusted to rebuild a new legacy from the wreckage.

nanna-fake-hendthi.title: Nanna Fake Hendthi
nanna-fake-hendthi.description: Ramya and Dinesh’s story begins as a forced marriage already poisoned by suspicion, resentment, and the shadow of Arjun. Dinesh repeatedly believes Ramya still loves Arjun and treats her attempts at closeness as proof of deceit. Ramya, meanwhile, tries to hold the relationship together through pleas, explanations, and domestic care, but even ordinary gestures only deepen the mistrust between them. Their private pain keeps spilling into public embarrassment, with friends and family teasing, pressuring, and exposing the cracks in the marriage. Arjun’s return intensifies everything, because his presence keeps reviving old feelings and making Dinesh feel replaced. At one point Dinesh confesses his love and proposes, but Ramya’s acceptance is read as sacrifice rather than genuine choice, which only sharpens the tragedy. Divorce papers, disputed signatures, and repeated separation talk make it clear that the marriage is breaking apart in legal as well as emotional terms. Ramya refuses to accept that the relationship is over, while others around her push her to face the reality of the breakup. The conflict grows more chaotic through public scenes, accidents, and arguments that expose how little trust remains among the people around them. A birthday-party teasing game turns humiliating, and later a struggle leaves Arjun injured, showing how quickly the emotional triangle becomes dangerous. As the story widens, corporate and social power struggles enter the picture, and private heartbreak starts to overlap with accusations of fraud, hidden identity, and betrayal. Shruti emerges as a force who can interrupt violence and challenge powerful men, shifting the balance in the larger conflict. Dinesh is also tied to a major business revelation, including recognition for an AI tool and a dispute around a legendary watch, which adds status and suspicion to the emotional mess. The marriage itself is repeatedly framed as something bound up with contracts, money, and false appearances rather than simple love. Ramya keeps pleading for forgiveness and reconciliation, but Dinesh grows firmer in his refusal and demands accountability for what he sees as betrayal. By the end, the relationship is effectively closed, Ramya is left in unresolved longing, and Dinesh turns toward Shruti as a new romantic possibility.

prema-parichayam.title: Prema Parichayam
prema-parichayam.description: The story follows a repeated struggle for dignity in spaces ruled by status, money, and hidden power. It begins with Harsha, a humble cleaner, being mocked at school until his calm logic forces an apology and hints that someone important may be backing him. From there, the drama widens into family humiliation, where elders and poor relatives are judged harshly at birthdays and gatherings, and where respect is often denied unless wealth or rank is visible. A powerful general is shown living quietly after giving up wealth and authority to honor a promise to his late wife, adding a quieter note of sacrifice beneath the public conflicts. Another family crisis turns legal when Anjaneyulu is pushed out of his own home after signing papers he did not fully understand.
