When she agrees to marry a comatose heir for crores, their twisted love triangle detonates into betrayal, obsession, and a truth that destroys him.

polladhavan.title: Polladhavan
polladhavan.description: தன் மனைவி ரேகாவும் நெருங்கிய நண்பனும் தன்னை ஏமாற்றி கொன்றுவிட்டார்கள் என்பதை அறிந்த ரோகித், மரணத்திற்குப் பிறகு அதே நாளுக்கு மீண்டும் திரும்பும் அதிசய வாய்ப்பைப் பெறுகிறான். இந்த முறை, துரோகத்தை வெளிச்சத்துக்கு கொண்டு வந்து பழிவாங்க உறுதியாகிறான்

dil-ka-rishta-2.title: Dil Ka Rishta
dil-ka-rishta-2.description: The story moves through several connected conflicts about love, status, family duty, and hidden truth. It begins with a dramatic rescue when Rishika survives a street attack and, in shock and gratitude, asks her savior to marry her. Around that same world, a wealthy father sends his son into India to leave comfort behind and prove himself through real work and tire innovation. A separate newcomer also arrives under suspicion, claiming he came from America to drive a rickshaw, while police question his story and the object he carries suggests a deeper family legacy. Raju’s path becomes tied to the rickshaw stand, where he must earn shelter and respect through a timed challenge before the crowd. The street-level world also brings everyday pressure, as Pari and Kajal clash during a rushed ride to an exam and police interference complicates the journey. Another thread introduces a father who is shaken by a desperate offer of money for his daughter’s kidney, and he refuses to trade her body for cash. He hides the truth from his daughter, but the threat hangs over the family and quietly raises the stakes. In the romance arc, Gurleen’s life becomes increasingly unstable as she is pulled between Raju and Rahul, with meet-cutes, jealousy, and public pressure shaping every step. Rahul uses wealth and influence to impress her, but his public confession of love only deepens the conflict. Birthday celebrations and restaurant power plays turn into status contests, and suspicion grows around gifts, clothing, and hidden identities. Raju is repeatedly accused of being a fraud or of hiding a rich identity, while he tries to defend himself and protect his place in the story. Gurleen is also forced to confront deception and humiliation, and the emotional strain suggests that her family situation is not simple. The conflict widens into a family and class war when an arranged engagement is pushed forward without consent. Public confrontations expose betrayal, and the relationship between Rahul and Gurleen is eventually described as a deal rather than a true bond. The pressure becomes darker when the marriage conflict is tied to an organ-harvesting plot, with bribery, kidnapping, and police involvement entering the picture. By the end, apologies and demands for order fail to settle anything, and the characters are left facing punishment, retaliation, and the possibility of jail. Across all these threads, the show keeps returning to the same stakes: who gets to choose love, who controls family honor, and how far powerful people will go to protect their secrets.

prem-ni-shodh-ma.title: Prem Ni Shodh Ma
prem-ni-shodh-ma.description: Ek ameer pan eklo businessman ane ek strong food stall wali ni prem kahani... Pan aa safar ma ek evu secret khulse je badhu badli nakhshe! pan aa saath jeeevanbharno rahese ke nai?

pati-on-emi.title: Pati On EMI
pati-on-emi.description: The story begins with a sudden collapse of status and security, as Jai Kishan Bajaj loses access to his money and property and is publicly abandoned when his engagement falls apart. Around him, family pressure and marriage expectations harden into a survival strategy, while several characters are pushed into relationships that feel more like contracts than choices. Arsh resists being controlled by elders who want marriage to protect the family legacy, and Sakshi also tries to set the terms of her own future rather than submit quietly. Jackie, also known as Jacky or Jai Kishan in later reveals, is forced down from wealth into humiliation, medical urgency, and ordinary work, even hiding his identity to keep going. His hidden life becomes tied to Arshi, a woman who is both a workplace authority and a romantic complication, making every interaction carry professional and personal risk. In the corporate world, he is scolded, tested, and mocked, but he repeatedly turns pressure into proof of competence. He exposes tampering, solves a major customer-service crisis, and later wins approval with a cheaper AI-based solution. Even when rivals and jealous colleagues try to undermine him, he keeps advancing by staying calm and exposing the truth. At the same time, Arshi’s startup faces its own crisis when an investor pulls out, and the company is rescued by a large private investment that seems to come from Jackie’s hidden influence. That rescue deepens Arshi’s dependence on him and makes her feelings harder to control, even as warnings remind her that she is already married and should not cross the line. The romance therefore grows in the shadow of secrecy, duty, and public scrutiny, with workplace rivals and family elders constantly threatening exposure. A separate marriage thread adds more pressure, as secret or contract marriages must be performed in front of family and tradition, often without trust or honesty. The truth about Jackie’s identity eventually comes out, and Arshi confronts him for hiding that he was the man behind the marriage contract and the financial rescue. He explains that he needed urgent money because his father was hospitalized and insists he did not know the bride named in the contract was Arshi. Once his legal identity is confirmed, the confrontation softens, and the relationship begins to move toward reconciliation rather than pure conflict. By the end, the central stakes are no longer just money or status, but whether love can survive deception, corporate sabotage, and the weight of family expectations.

आखिरी-दगाबाजी--खेल-पीशा-रो-दाव-जिंदगी-रो.title: आखिरी दगाबाजी - खेल पीशा रो, दाव जिंदगी रो
आखिरी-दगाबाजी--खेल-पीशा-रो-दाव-जिंदगी-रो.description:
Ek honeymoon jo ban jaave hai maut ko khel
Sejal or Shivan sath – sath  ek nayi Zindagi shuru kare hai pan ek safar jad sejal akeli ho jaave hai to khud ne aisa loga re bich paave hai  jo sejal ne hasiyat su aake hai aur sejal ri beijjati kare hai pan jad sach samne aave hai to safar aur bhi khatrnaak modd par chalyo jaave hai 
Jad Har cheharo jad benaqaab hove hai to shuru hove hai asli khel – jathe daav par Zindagi hai.

maha-veeran.title: Maha Veeran
maha-veeran.description: Randeep (aka Mahabali) is a hidden prodigy living a fake “loser” life due to a promise to his dying mother. When his sister, school, and honor are threatened by ruthless enemies and underground conspiracies, he slowly unleashes his true identity, leading to revenge, power battles, and a larger hidden system controlling the martial arts world.

andhadhun-revenge.title: Andhadhun Revenge
andhadhun-revenge.description: The story begins with a high-stakes business world where a major deal is under pressure, and a sudden street accident pulls a young woman into the Malhotra family’s orbit. She suffers severe eye damage, and doctors warn that surgery may help but carries only a limited chance of success. Raj Malhotra takes responsibility for her treatment and insists money will not be a problem, while his son Vihaan doubts her motives and suspects she may be staging everything. The woman, Meera, is brought into the household for safety and care, but the family’s trust is fragile and arguments over her place quickly grow intense. Raj then shocks everyone by ordering Vihaan to marry her, even though Vihaan is already tied to Naira, and Meera unexpectedly agrees to the marriage. That decision turns a private crisis into a public scandal and pulls romance, duty, and power into the same conflict. At the same time, Naira and Kabir are shown plotting to use marriage, legal papers, and inheritance tricks to seize control of the Malhotra empire and weaken Vihaan. Their schemes deepen the sense that the marriage is not only personal but also a weapon in a larger corporate war. Meera is repeatedly humiliated by people who look down on her class and status, yet she also receives protection from Vihaan and from Raj at different moments. Her own family becomes another source of pressure, with demands for money and attempts to use her vulnerability against her. As the conflict spreads into public spaces, Meera works to support herself and is drawn into elite events where Vihaan’s identity and presence create confusion and suspicion. Public confrontations, including an auction humiliation, keep testing whether she is accepted as a wife or treated as an outsider. The story then escalates into abduction, coercion, and threats, with Kabir’s side using force and manipulation to control Meera and the family’s assets. Vihaan repeatedly rescues her and begins to stand more openly with her, even as enemies try to separate them through deception and business pressure. A major turning point comes when Meera is accused of being a gold digger and of faking blindness, but she reveals that she had hidden the truth to expose a larger conspiracy. Vihaan counters the financial attack by repurchasing shares and regaining leverage, showing that the battle is as much about control of the company as it is about marriage. The conflict also opens the door to a lost-family revelation, when a woman is identified by a birthmark as the rightful heir and shares are restored. By the end, Kabir’s schemes collapse under police pressure, while the family’s future is further complicated by a pregnancy confirmation that raises the stakes around legacy, inheritance, and loyalty.

queen-ka-comeback-1.title: Queen ka Comeback
queen-ka-comeback-1.description: After being heartlessly discarded by her tech-CEO husband on their anniversary, a seemingly ordinary assistant reveals her secret identity as the legendary hacker "Doctor Nova" to reclaim her power. Joining forces with her ex’s greatest rival in a high-stakes contract marriage, she orchestrates a brilliant corporate revenge to dismantle her former husband's empire and find true respect.

empire-of-tomorrow.title: Empire Of Tomorrow
empire-of-tomorrow.description: 25 saal ka Double PhD Jin time travel karke hazaaron saal pehle Chen ke sharir mein pahunch gaya, jo ek sharabi aur juaari tha. Apne scientific dimaag aur inventions ki madad se usne na sirf apni kismat badli, balki doston aur gaonwalon ko bhi ameer bana diya. Lekin uski tarakki se jalne wala Jiladhikari Lee, jo Nina ko paana chahta tha, use barbaad karne ke liye saazishen rachne laga. Kya Chen har chaal ka muqabla kar paaya?

tech-king-husband.title: Tech King Husband
tech-king-husband.description: The story opens as a major cyberattack cripples key tech systems and breaches Trishul Tech Solutions, forcing officers and technicians to argue over whether military data or client systems should be protected first. The attack is organized and persistent, and the search for a way out leads to the elusive hacker SP Varma, whose absence and reputation make him both a rumor and a possible answer. A low-profile young man also appears with the skills to help, but he refuses payment and keeps his motives hidden, deepening the mystery around who is truly driving events. As the crisis widens, background checks, unauthorized access, and recurring network failures pull military figures like Bhargav into the same web of corporate and security concerns. Surya emerges as a central figure tied to the larger threat and to Project Indra, while his private life begins to collide with the public crisis. He is pulled between duty and his love for Priya, and the emotional stakes rise as birthday plans, proposals, and romantic rivalries are repeatedly interrupted by suspicion and humiliation. Public confrontations over identity and status then take over, with Rahul exposed through suspicious documents, false claims, and an elite gathering that turns into a class-based spectacle. Priya, Sahana, and others are drawn into these clashes, and hidden authority figures use wealth and social standing to control who belongs and who does not. The conflict then shifts toward Nandini, who is trapped by legal manipulation, guardianship, and forced-marriage pressure that threatens both her freedom and her business life. She refuses to submit, and with Suryaa’s support she searches for a legal loophole that can break the control over her. A temporary paper marriage to Surya Pratap Varma gives her a way out, cancels the guardianship, and changes her legal standing enough for her to fight back. At the same time, the corporate battle intensifies as Kalyan tries to frame Nandhini for code theft and other fabricated crimes. Digital evidence, a confession from Aditya, and exposure of fake bribery documents reveal that the thefts were ordered and financed as part of a larger scheme. Surya counters these traps by turning them into evidence, bringing law enforcement into the conflict and exposing a wider network involving shell companies and foreign money. Publicly, Nandini is praised for helping uncover the stolen-code plot, while Varma is honored for protecting both the company and the nation. Yet the personal cost remains high, because relationships fracture under pressure and forgiveness is not easily granted. The later arc pushes the story into life-or-death territory as malware, cyberwar, terror financing, and even a missile countdown threaten to overwhelm everyone involved. Surya repeatedly chooses sacrifice over safety, including entering a blazing server room to stop the attack by hand when no software fix remains. In that moment, he transfers core authority, shares, and funds to Nandini, effectively placing the company in her hands and making her the new chief commander. Even after he erases his digital traces and disappears from contact, his influence continues to shape the struggle around identity, loyalty, and control. The closing tone mixes humiliation and longing, as Surya cuts down one woman’s worth in public but then invites another into his small world, suggesting that beneath the power games the story is still driven by hidden love, wounded pride, and the need to reclaim dignity.

asli-dhurandhar.title: Asli Dhurandhar
asli-dhurandhar.description: After sacrificing his billionaire lifestyle as the secret founder of a tech empire to give his family a simple life, a hidden tycoon is ruthlessly humiliated and divorced by his status-climbing wife for a corrupt corporate rival. When he is forced to reclaim his throne as the multi-billion-dollar CEO of Oracle Group, he must systematically dismantle his enemies, teach his entitled son the true value of hard work, and leave his regretful ex-wife behind forever to secure his legendary legacy.

kaaviya-thalaivan.title: Kaaviya Thalaivan
kaaviya-thalaivan.description: பிறந்த நாளிலேயே குடும்பத்தை இழந்தவன்... பல ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு அதே குடும்பத்தின் வாரிசாக திரும்பி வருகிறான். இரத்த பந்தம், துரோகம், அரசியல் சதி - இவையனைத்தையும் உடைத்து தனது விதியை வெல்லும் ஒரு மறக்கப்பட்ட இளவரசனின் கதை

maya-mayooram.title: Maya Mayooram
maya-mayooram.description: When a struggling delivery boy—who is secretly the heir to a massive business empire—enters a contract marriage with a hotel CEO to protect her from a corporate takeover, he must navigate high-society humiliation and deadly conspiracies to save her legacy and claim his true identity.

scientist-ki-waapsi.title: Scientist Ki Waapsi
scientist-ki-waapsi.description: The story centers on a chain of public accusations that begin with a metro confrontation and keep expanding into institutional, digital, and personal warfare. A young woman accuses a man of secretly photographing her, and the crowd quickly turns against him before any proof is established. That pattern repeats in different forms, with names and faces changing, but the core conflict stays the same: accusation first, truth later, if at all. Humiliation becomes a weapon, and public punishment, insults, and collective pressure are used to force confessions or destroy reputations. As the conflict widens, the setting shifts into elite scientific and academic spaces where authority is rigid and suspicion spreads fast. Arjun is branded an outsider at a secret institute, while trainees and mentors clash over discipline, status, and obedience. At the same time, Anil Bhatti emerges as a central figure caught in repeated allegations of misconduct, with mobs, committees, and senior officials all pulled into the fallout. Dimple repeatedly appears as a protective ally, urging caution and trying to keep the situation from collapsing further. The accusations do not stay local for long, because social media, viral messages, and fake or manipulated evidence turn private conflict into public spectacle. A defense and research thread also runs through the story, including a self-sustaining battery concept and a secret project with national stakes, which raises the pressure on everyone involved. The institution itself comes under audits, funding freezes, and corruption investigations, revealing inflated contracts, supplier manipulation, and hidden influence behind official decisions. Kaira or Kyra becomes a major force in the middle of this storm, sometimes as a defiant trainee, sometimes as a humiliated victim, and sometimes as someone driving revenge. Her conflict with authority deepens as she is expelled, publicly shamed, and left feeling betrayed, even as allies and admirers move closer to her side. The story suggests that some attacks are staged, with paid agitators and hidden instigators shaping the chaos from behind the scenes. As the pressure rises, the battle shifts from reputation alone to survival, with threats of jail, retaliation, and elimination entering the picture. Anil is shown as both vulnerable and important, since powerful people want him removed while others protect him because of his scientific value and influence. By the later part of the arc, the struggle has become a contest over who controls the narrative, who can prove the truth, and who will be destroyed by rumor before evidence can speak. The show ends in an unresolved state, with rivalries, accusations, and institutional punishment still intensifying rather than settling.

छोरा-डिलीवरी-आला.title: छोरा डिलीवरी आला
छोरा-डिलीवरी-आला.description: Ananya Mehra stands at the center of a story where romance, class conflict, and corporate power keep colliding. Her world is first shaken by a boardroom plot against her and by a car accident that links her to Ramesh, a struggling working-class man. What begins as awkward contact grows into a tense bond marked by suspicion, help, and repeated interference from outsiders. Ramesh is beaten, threatened, and evicted, forcing him into survival mode while others argue over his place in Ananya’s life and in the company. At the same time, Ananya keeps defending him against public humiliation, even when crowds mock his job, his background, and his worth. The story repeatedly uses parties, interviews, hotels, and boardrooms as stages for shame and status battles. Ramesh is pushed into situations where he is judged as unqualified, yet he often surprises others by staying calm and taking control. Hidden personal ties surface around Shipra and other unresolved connections, keeping the emotional stakes uncertain. Marriage becomes another weapon in the struggle, first through a contract arrangement and then through a secret marriage meant to block family pressure and corporate control. These choices do not settle the conflict so much as deepen it, because secrecy and obligation continue to shape how people treat one another. Hotel and security politics then widen the conflict, with authority figures fighting over control, discipline, wages, and promotions. Ramesh’s rise to head of security gives him status, but it also makes him a bigger target for prejudice and power plays. Violence escalates further when an attack injures Ina and police identify Ramesh as the intended target, turning the plot toward revenge and justice. Ajit Ahuja’s arrest raises the stakes, but his attempts to invoke powerful connections show that the threat is not fully gone. Through all of this, Ananya keeps oscillating between protector, authority figure, and romantic partner, while Ramesh struggles to prove his worth without losing dignity. The relationship between them remains emotionally charged and unresolved, especially after family confrontation forces them to face what their marriage and feelings may really mean. By the end of the batch, the show has become a layered battle over love, legitimacy, and control, with every public space turning into a test of status and loyalty.

no-more-mr-nice-guy.title: No More Mr. Nice Guy
no-more-mr-nice-guy.description: Rahul Bajaj, a timid college boy obsessed with Shanaya, is betrayed, framed for a hit-and-run, and murdered after sacrificing everything for her. Before dying, he prays to Mahadev and wakes up two months in the past with a chance to rewrite destiny. Determined to expose Shanaya’s lies, reclaim his identity, and choose true love over manipulation, Rahul transforms from a helpless “yes man” into a fearless fighter.

engeyum-kadhal.title: Engeyum Kadhal
engeyum-kadhal.description: பாரிஸில் இருந்து வந்த வெற்றிகரமான பிஸினஸ் வுமன் காவ்யா, குடும்பமும் கம்பெனியும் காப்பாற்ற அவசரமாக ஒரு contract marriage செய்ய வேண்டிய சூழ்நிலைக்கு தள்ளப்படுகிறாள். சாதாரண தொழிலாளி போல தோன்றும் வேதாந்தை திருமணம் செய்கிறாள். ஆனால் அவளுக்குத் தெரியாமல், வேதாந்த் உண்மையில் பெரிய கம்பெனியின் CEO. பொய்யில் தொடங்கிய உறவு காதலாக மாறுமா?

pembalasan-adik-sang-ceo-bahasa-original.title: Pembalasan Adik Sang CEO - Bahasa Original
pembalasan-adik-sang-ceo-bahasa-original.description: Seorang wanita baik hati yang sedang menuju pernikahan kakaknya terjebak dalam penerbangan penuh teror bersama seorang wanita kejam dan putranya yang manja. Kekacauan di udara perlahan membuka rahasia tentang kekuasaan, pengkhianatan, dan identitas yang tertukar. Saat cinta, kebohongan, dan harga diri keluarga saling berbenturan, rangkaian balas dendam dan kebenaran mengejutkan pun tak lagi bisa dihentikan.

3-girls-1-love-system.title: 3 Girls. 1 Love System
3-girls-1-love-system.description: A kind-hearted, middle-class boy from Bihar joins Delhi's most elite college as a hostel caretaker, where he discovers a mysterious AI-powered system hidden inside a pair of smart glasses. To save his sick mother and escape poverty, he must win the hearts of three extraordinary girls to unlock superhuman abilities

Saffron-farming--ನಿಮ್ಮ-terrace-ನಿಮ್ಮ-ತೋಟ.title: Saffron farming - ನಿಮ್ಮ terrace ನಿಮ್ಮ ತೋಟ!
Saffron-farming--ನಿಮ್ಮ-terrace-ನಿಮ್ಮ-ತೋಟ.description: ವಿಶ್ವದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ದುಬಾರಿ ಸಾಂಬಾರ ಪದಾರ್ಥ 'ಕುಂಕುಮ ಕೇಸರಿ'ಯನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯ ಟೆರೇಸ್ ಮೇಲೆಯೇ ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ! ಇದರ ಕೃಷಿ ವಿಧಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಲಾಭದಾಯಕ ಟಿಪ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

king-in-disguise.title: King in Disguise
king-in-disguise.description: After a decade of risking his life to save others, billionaire heir Ved returns home only to be mistaken for a beggar. Humiliated, beaten, and forced to kneel by a greedy influencer and her ruthless brother—who are plotting to seize his family's empire—Ved silently endures everything to protect his sister. But when his true identity is revealed, their world is about to collapse.

ವೈರಲ್-ಆಗೋದ್-ಹೇಗೆ-ENT-ಕೀರ್ತಿಯ-ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್-ಮಾ.title: ವೈರಲ್ ಆಗೋದ್ ಹೇಗೆ..?? ENT ಕೀರ್ತಿಯ ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್ ಮಾತ್ರೆ!!
ವೈರಲ್-ಆಗೋದ್-ಹೇಗೆ-ENT-ಕೀರ್ತಿಯ-ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್-ಮಾ.description: ಸೋಷಿಯಲ್ ಮೀಡಿಯಾದಲ್ಲಿ ವೈರಲ್ ಆಗುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ವೀಕ್ಷಕರನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯುವ 'ಕೀರ್ತಿ ಇಎನ್‌ಟಿ ಕ್ಲಿನಿಕ್' ಖ್ಯಾತಿಯ ಕೀರ್ತಿ ಅವರ ರಹಸ್ಯ ಸೂತ್ರ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ! ಕಂಟೆಂಟ್ ಕ್ರಿಯೇಟರ್ ಆಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲು ಅವರು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವ ಟಿಪ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಈಗಲೇ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ!

Genz-ಲವ್-ಸ್ಕೂಲ್--ವೀಣಾಸುಂದರ್-ಕ್ಲಾಸ್-ತೊಗೊಂ.title: Genz ಲವ್ ಸ್ಕೂಲ್ : ವೀಣಾ-ಸುಂದರ್ ಕ್ಲಾಸ್ ತೊಗೊಂಡ್ರು..!!
Genz-ಲವ್-ಸ್ಕೂಲ್--ವೀಣಾಸುಂದರ್-ಕ್ಲಾಸ್-ತೊಗೊಂ.description: ಇಂದಿನ ಜನರೇಷನ್ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಡೇಟಿಂಗ್ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಬರೀ ಕನ್ಫ್ಯೂಷನ್! ಈ ಗೊಂದಲಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲು ವೀಣಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸುಂದರ್ ಸಖತ್ ಕ್ಲಾಸ್ ತಗೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಯೂತ್‌ಫುಲ್ ಹಾಗೂ ಮೋಜಿನ ಈ ಶೋವನ್ನ ಈಗಲೇ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿ!

ಹಾಸನಾಂಬೆ--ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ-ತೆರೆಯುವ-ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ.title: ಹಾಸನಾಂಬೆ - ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ತೆರೆಯುವ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ರಹಸ್ಯ!
ಹಾಸನಾಂಬೆ--ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ-ತೆರೆಯುವ-ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ.description: ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಾಗಿಲು ತೆರೆಯುವ ಹಾಸನಾಂಬೆ ದೇಗುಲದ ದಿವ್ಯ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳೇನು? ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಪವಾಡಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯನ್ನು ಈ ಶೋನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸಿ. ಈ ಭಕ್ತಿಪೂರ್ವಕ ಕೌತುಕವನ್ನು ಈಗಲೇ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ!

second-spark-in-my-life.title: Second Spark in My Life
second-spark-in-my-life.description: Amrit, a wealthy woman confined to a wheelchair by emotional trauma, and Manthan, a widowed father struggling to raise his daughter, Mahi. When fate brings them together, they enter a marriage of convenience that gradually turns into true love. As they face family conspiracies and dangerous challenges, Amrit overcomes her trauma and learns to walk again, while Manthan finds the happiness and family he always deserved.

Aura-healing--ನಿಮ್ಮ-ಪ್ರಭಾವಳಿ-ಸರಿ-ಮಾಡ್ಕೋಳ.title: Aura healing - ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಭಾವಳಿ ಸರಿ ಮಾಡ್ಕೋಳಿ..!!
Aura-healing--ನಿಮ್ಮ-ಪ್ರಭಾವಳಿ-ಸರಿ-ಮಾಡ್ಕೋಳ.description: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ನಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಶಕ್ತಿ ತುಂಬಿದೆಯೇ? ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಭಾವಳಿಯನ್ನು (Aura) ಶುದ್ಧೀಕರಿಸಿ, ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಹೇಗೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಈಗಲೇ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ!

kadhal-psycho.title: Kadhal Psycho
kadhal-psycho.description: தன் தந்தையின் சாம்ராஜ்யத்தை காப்பாற்ற, கோமாவில் இருக்கும் ஒரு பில்லியனர் வாரிசை திருமணம் செய்ய நிர்பந்திக்கப்படும் தன்னம்பிக்கை மிக்க இளம்பெண், பணம், துரோகம் மற்றும் மறைக்கப்பட்ட அடையாளங்கள் நிறைந்த கொடூரமான உலகிற்குள் நுழைகிறாள். ஆனால், தள்ளி வைக்கும் அந்த மர்மமான மெய்க்காப்பாளனே, அவளை உயிருக்கு உயிராக காதலிக்கும் பில்லியனர் சிஇஓ என்பது அவளுக்குத் தெரியாது.

karoge-yaad-toh.title: Karoge Yaad Toh...
karoge-yaad-toh.description: Amrita and Dheeraj’s story begins with a love that is already split between public praise and private damage. Amrita chooses an irreversible cryo-project that threatens her identity, while Dr. Virendra warns that she may not fully grasp what she is giving up. At the same time, Dheeraj is publicly celebrated for a cure named after Amrita, which makes their bond look honored even as it is quietly breaking. Shreya enters as a hostile force who claims to be Dheeraj’s girlfriend and repeatedly exposes hidden ties that Amrita cannot ignore. A hotel-room revelation, anniversary tension, a sealed gift, and a long promise all suggest that the marriage or relationship is being tested from every side. Amrita’s own choices are tied to sacrifice as well, since she becomes involved in a dangerous experiment connected to her late mother’s research and legacy. As jealousy grows, pregnancy claims and demands for divorce turn the conflict into a struggle over loyalty, status, and truth. Dheeraj tries to care for Amrita in the hospital and at home, but his attention is divided and his promises increasingly feel unreliable. Amrita responds by withdrawing emotionally and by hiding what she is doing with the personal items and plans that once tied them together. The story then widens into scandal, with rumors, public confrontations, and a missing-wife crisis that leaves everyone searching for answers. Dheeraj frantically looks for Amrita while others withhold dangerous information, including a death certificate and other secrets that suggest the truth is being buried. A diary about Amrita’s mother reveals a painful history of ruined marriage and a warning against love, which deepens the emotional weight on Amrita’s choices. Hope briefly returns when Dheeraj’s long devotion seems to win Amrita over, but that hope is quickly crushed by exposure of his secret relationship with Shreya and competing pregnancy claims. The conflict becomes more openly hostile as Shreya uses pregnancy and public pressure to force recognition, while Dheeraj is pulled between guilt, duty, and desperation. Amrita’s disappearance then becomes tied to a medical mystery, with reports that she is trapped in an incubator and may be separated from Dheeraj for decades. Around him, inheritance, company control, and even poisoning schemes show that love has become entangled with power and exploitation. By the end, Dheeraj is still trying to reach Amrita, but deception keeps multiplying, including a scheme that dresses another woman as Amrita while he is drugged. The show closes on unresolved grief and manipulation, with Amrita’s fate, Dheeraj’s loyalties, and the truth behind the betrayals still hanging in the balance.

सब्ते-बड़ा-चौधरी.title: सब्ते बड़ा चौधरी
सब्ते-बड़ा-चौधरी.description: The story centers on a wealthy heir who hides in plain sight as a taxi driver while searching for his mother’s killer and repeatedly stepping into danger to protect vulnerable people. His disguise lets him move through street-level threats, but it also draws him into clashes with thugs, an arms dealer, and other men who underestimate him. As the conflicts widen, his secret identity becomes a weapon in fights over power, status, and revenge. At the same time, the drama keeps returning to women and children who are trapped by shame, abandonment, or disputed parentage. A child’s plea and a DNA report confirm one father-daughter bond, but that reunion does not heal the larger family fracture. Instead, the characters are pulled deeper into arguments over legitimacy, honor, and who has the right to belong inside the Singhania family. A wealthy woman’s marriage proposal to the taxi driver adds another layer of unresolved history and suspicion. Public humiliation follows the women most closely tied to these men, especially when children are used as proof, leverage, or scandal. The taxi driver’s refusal to be bought or intimidated keeps him at the center of the conflict, even when he is mocked by the rich. Meanwhile, the family’s elders and corporate authorities use money, shares, and reputation to control the younger generation. The story also introduces a separate workplace thread, where hiring and office authority briefly mirror the larger struggle over who gets to decide. In the middle of these battles, the taxi driver’s protective instincts and hidden strength repeatedly shift the balance against those who try to dominate him. Ridhima emerges as another major figure caught between love, business pressure, and family betrayal. She is publicly shamed, blamed for scandal, and forced to fight for her company and her dignity. Her relationship with the taxi driver remains tense and uncertain, even as he appears to support her and she suspects he is hiding something important. The later episodes deepen the sense that old secrets about bloodline, inheritance, and death are driving everything. By the end, the drama is still unresolved, with revenge, identity, and family loyalty all left in conflict.

betrayed-into-madness.title: Betrayed Into Madness
betrayed-into-madness.description: When Aryan Shah is framed as a madman by his best friend Dev and abandoned by his wife Niya, he is thrown into a brutal mental asylum while Dev steals his family, fortune, and future. But from the depths of that living hell, Aryan rises with one mission: expose the truth, reclaim what was stolen, and make every betrayer pay.

oru-delivery-paranyakatha.title: Oru Delivery Pranayakadha
oru-delivery-paranyakatha.description: A single mother struggling to build a better life for her daughter is hired as the personal assistant to a self-centered movie superstar, igniting an unexpected romance that forces them to fight against his high-stakes celebrity world and the constant threats from her troubled past.

gaonwala-super-husband.title: Gaonwala Super Husband
gaonwala-super-husband.description: A humble village farmer and martial arts prodigy, Gopal, arrives in Mumbai to fulfill his guru’s wish and marry the wealthy heiress Anjali, only to discover she despises him and is plotting against her own family.

return-gift.title: Return Gift
return-gift.description: రిటర్న్ గిఫ్ట్  (Return Gift) ఒక ఆసక్తికరమైన ప్రతీకారగాథ. కె.ఎస్.ఆర్ గ్రూప్‌లో అణకువగా పనిచేసే ప్రణయ్‌ని, అతని బాస్ సరయు అవమానించి గెంటివేస్తుంది. ఆ అవమానంతో రగిలిపోయిన ప్రణయ్, శ్రావణి అనే నమ్మకస్థురాలైన భాగస్వామితో కలిసి పట్టుదలతో ఒక ప్రపంచ స్థాయి సామ్రాజ్యాన్ని నిర్మిస్తాడు. స్వార్థంతో సరయు సామ్రాజ్యం కూలిపోతుంటే, నిజాయితీతో ప్రణయ్ అగ్రస్థానానికి చేరుకుంటాడు. అధికారం కంటే నమ్మకం, విశ్వాసమే శాశ్వతమని నిరూపించే కథే ఈ 'రిటర్న్ గిఫ్ట్ '.

my-fake-pondatti-1.title: My Fake Pondatti
my-fake-pondatti-1.description: After enduring five years of emotional abuse and neglect while posing as a lowly delivery boy to save his marriage, a secret billionaire finally exposes his unfaithful wife and her toxic family. Faced with his meteoric rise to power and the truth behind their "contract marriage," the wife struggles with regret as she realizes she traded a devoted man for a hollow opportunist.

master-of-ten-thousand-years.title: Master of Ten Thousand Years
master-of-ten-thousand-years.description: The story opens on a cosmic emergency, with a meteor threatening Earth while four sages and other divine forces struggle to contain it. Against that backdrop, a boy returns after 10,000 years of tapasya and claims power beyond saints, signaling that hidden strength will shape everything that follows. The narrative then moves into village and family conflict, where returning sons are mocked, fathers are arrested or shamed, and ordinary life is disrupted by suspicion and police trouble. Marriage becomes a major fault line, as promises are forgotten, engagements are questioned, and heartbreak follows when family pressure and financial hardship break a hoped-for union. Feng and Xiao’s relationship collapses under that pressure, turning love into humiliation and regret. Yuri and Fang then emerge as a central pair in a much larger public battle over engagement, dignity, and status. Their conflict is repeatedly staged in front of crowds, where accusations, old letters, and claims of betrayal are used as weapons. Yuri insists on exposing the truth and preserving her dignity, while Fang tries to defend his land, his image, and his chance to win her back. A protective chairman also steps in, offering Yuri a different future and adding another layer to the struggle over her life. The drama keeps widening into weddings, temple disputes, and ceremonial showdowns, where even apologies and compensation become public tests of worth. Money becomes a blunt measure of power, especially when huge shagun transfers are announced and verified in front of everyone. These displays do not settle the conflict, but instead deepen the humiliation and force families to choose between pride and practical acceptance. Hidden romantic histories surface as ex-boyfriends, broken promises, and long-buried feuds complicate every public gathering. At the same time, the story repeatedly returns to the idea that status can be overturned by sudden proof of wealth, lineage, or destiny. That pattern expands further into supernatural and divine confrontations, where rebels challenge sacred authority and are met with overwhelming force. In those arcs, pride is punished, false claims are exposed, and hidden powers are revealed through beasts, saints, and celestial rulers. The stakes keep rising from personal shame to family honor, then to cosmic order, as each conflict suggests that no one can rely on appearances alone. By the end, the show has fused romance, revenge, money, and mythology into one escalating struggle over who has the right to love, rule, and be believed.

delivery-boy-story.title: Delivery Boy Story
delivery-boy-story.description: The story centers on overlapping battles over status, control, and dignity in a modern corporate world. Swami is drawn into a boardroom power play as he learns that Madam’s removal is being pushed through by Mr. Gary Board, and he responds by ordering surveillance and preparing for the next move. In parallel, Ramesh’s life is shaken by a car accident that brings him into contact with Ananya, a powerful CEO whose presence becomes tied to both rescue and suspicion. What begins as confusion after the accident grows into repeated humiliation, as Ramesh is attacked, blocked from reaching Ananya, and forced to endure rent pressure and social embarrassment. His struggle is framed not as failure but as sacrifice, since his family’s medical burden and his father’s treatment explain much of his desperation. The class divide becomes especially sharp at a birthday party where Ramesh is mocked for being a delivery worker, while Tarun tries to defend him and keep the peace. Ananya witnesses this cruelty and the story uses that moment to deepen the uneasy connection between her and Ramesh. The pressure around Ramesh’s dignity continues into hotel and office spaces, where interviews, security checks, and authority figures turn ordinary procedures into public tests of worth. At the same time, the hotel world is shown as rigid and hierarchical, with managers, guards, and executives using discipline, penalties, and rewards to control workers. Ananya repeatedly asserts her authority in this environment, even when investors and board members challenge her decisions about hiring and internal matters. Ramesh is eventually pulled into that same system and rises into a position of authority, which shocks those who had dismissed him. His new role intensifies the conflict rather than ending it, because rivals question his legitimacy and treat his appointment as a threat. Romance and pressure also run through the show, with sudden proposals, guarded promises, and a contract marriage arrangement that is formalized at the registrar’s office. These personal turns do not soften the conflict so much as add another layer of obligation and secrecy. Violence remains close to the surface, as attacks, police investigation, and suspicion around Ajit Ahuja keep the danger active. By the end of the batch, the central stakes are clear: the characters are fighting not only for love or work, but for recognition, survival, and the right to define their own place in a world that keeps trying to rank them.

burning-train-ride.title: Burning Train Ride
burning-train-ride.description: They called him a thief. They forced him to beg. But when a deadly fire traps hundreds of passengers, the old man they humiliated becomes a hero.

-ब्याव-में-बवाल.title: ब्याव में बवाल
-ब्याव-में-बवाल.description:
Jad pyaar bharosa su aage badhkar apmaan aur dhokha mai badal javae hai jad ek Rishta ri asli kimat saanme aave hai . 
Ek hon walo shandaar byaav aur unre bich fasi siya ek Masoom ladki jo sach bole hai pan har koi bine jhuto saabit karne par tulyo hai jad bine apna hi parivaar ri pehchan sabit karni pade hai to shuru hove hai ahamkaar aur nirdayi khel jo insaniyat ri har had ne paar kar deve hai.

thalavan-the-game-changer.title: Thalavan: The Game Changer
thalavan-the-game-changer.description: A humble salesman, Tanay, secretly the heir to a massive business empire, hides his identity to find true love with Dia. Misjudged as poor, he faces insults from her greedy family while proving his worth through hard work. Dia betrays him for wealth, unaware of his real status. After rising as a powerful entrepreneur, Tanay exposes the truth, leading to regret, revenge, and justice.

ava-zubin-ki-mad-love-story.title: Ava Zubin Ki Mad Love Story
ava-zubin-ki-mad-love-story.description: After a lifetime of abuse at the hands of the family that adopted her, Ava Topiwala - a neglected young woman accidentally crosses paths with a billionaire heir Zubin Irani whose mysterious condition makes physical contact with any woman impossible—except her. As their contract marriage blossoms into love, she must survive the jealous family determined to steal her place, her future, and the only person who has ever truly chosen her.

the-undercover-lady-ceo-4.title: The Undercover Lady CEO
the-undercover-lady-ceo-4.description: ಒಬ್ಬ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಮಾಲೀಕನ ಹೆಂಡತಿ ತನ್ನದೇ ಕಂಪನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂಟರ್ನ್ ಆಗಿ ಅಂಡರ್ ಕವರ್ ಆಗಿ ಸೇರಿ ಫ್ರಾಡ್ ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ತನ್ನ ಗುರುತು ಮರೆಮಾಚಿ, ಅವಳು ಅವಮಾನ, ಆಫೀಸ್ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಸತ್ಯ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತಾ ಹೋದಂತೆ, ಅವಳ ಹೋರಾಟ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

shadi-ki-hat-trick.title: Shadi Ki Hat-Trick
shadi-ki-hat-trick.description: A devoted guardian's life spirals into chaos when the girl he raised falls in love with him, triggering a dangerous web of love, betrayal, and three life-altering marriages.

adhisaya-piravi.title: Adhisaya Piravi
adhisaya-piravi.description: முந்தைய பிறவியின் நினைவுகளுடன் மறுபிறவி எடுத்த திறமைமிக்க சிறுவன், தனது தந்தைக்கு உதவுகிறான். அசாதாரண நிதி அறிவால் அவர் வணிக உலகின் சிக்கல்களை வெல்ல உதவுகின்றான். ஆனால் சக்திவாய்ந்த நிறுவனங்கள் மற்றும் எதிரிகள் அவர்களை குறிவைக்கும் நிலையில், ஏமாற்றம், அதிகாரப் போராட்டம் மற்றும் விதி ஆகியவற்றை எதிர்கொண்டு உயிர் பிழைக்க போராடுகிறார்கள்.

cylinderwala-crorepati.title: Cylinderwala Crorepati
cylinderwala-crorepati.description: Vedant, a wealthy petroleum CEO, disguises as a cylinder delivery boy to expose an LPG scam. He marries Meera, a poor girl, in a contract marriage. When she discovers his true identity, she feels betrayed. Forced to marry corrupt MLA Mehta's daughter Riya, Vedant's mother tricks Meera into signing divorce papers. But Meera finds evidence of the MLA's cylinder hoarding scheme and exposes it. She replaces Riya at the wedding; the MLA is arrested. Vedant and Meera's marriage is confirmed.

hai-naa-bolo-bolo-part-1.title: Hai Naa, Bolo Bolo Part 1
hai-naa-bolo-bolo-part-1.description: Maya Aswani’s story begins under threat, when she is drugged on her birthday and moved into a hidden abduction scheme tied to Mr. Juneja. That early danger sets the tone for a larger world where family secrets, corporate control, and revenge keep colliding. At the same time, Mandip steps away from public life to investigate his sister’s death and the Hexagram symbol, suggesting that the violence around him is part of a deeper conspiracy. As the story expands, Maya becomes trapped in a struggle to protect both her company and her child, Krish, while powerful people around her push for shares, succession, and control. A public engagement rumor, old romantic history, and accusations about a past night together add humiliation and tension to the conflict. The hidden child storyline then forces the truth into the open, and DNA confirmation reveals Mandip as Krish’s biological father. Maya admits she kept the child secret for years, and the revelation turns fatherhood into both an emotional reckoning and a source of leverage. Mandip is pulled toward responsibility for Krish even as he continues to chase the truth behind his sister’s death and the larger enemy behind the violence. Around them, business warfare intensifies through share-transfer demands, canceled partnerships, boardroom challenges, and pressure over a project called Summit. Maya refuses intimidation and searches for new allies, including Abhay Mehra, to keep her position from collapsing. Other family and corporate figures also face extortion, armed threats, and public confrontations, showing that the same power network is attacking multiple households at once. In parallel, the mystery widens through the land deal, the locket marked Royal, and the demand for 10,000 acres in Delhi, which makes Maya’s business ambitions even more dangerous. Surveillance, headquarters calls, and the discovery that the sought person has been found suggest that hidden forces are tracking the families closely. The conflict also reveals that Mandeep has a wife and children in Delhi, adding another layer of divided loyalties and unresolved ties. As the episodes progress, domestic scenes of worry and protection sit beside boardroom insults and physical clashes, keeping the emotional cost visible. By the end of the batch, romance, revenge, inheritance, and corporate survival are all locked together, with no easy separation between family loyalty and business war.

डेलीभरी-बॉय-के-प्रेम-कहानी.title: डेलीभरी बॉय के प्रेम कहानी
डेलीभरी-बॉय-के-प्रेम-कहानी.description: The story centers on Ananya and Ramesh as romance, class conflict, and corporate power struggles keep colliding. It begins with a tender, dreamlike intimacy that is quickly broken by reality and by threats inside the business world. Sarita is shown fighting to keep her position while Gary pushes against her and watches her closely. At the same time, Ananya and Ramesh are drawn together through an accident, and their connection is complicated by guilt, injury, money, and uncertainty. Ramesh is hurt, beaten, and burdened by debt, while Ananya keeps reappearing in his life through apologies, calls, and attempts to help. Their relationship is repeatedly tested by social embarrassment, domestic friction, and the pressure of people around them who judge status and worth. Wealthy settings expose how harshly the poor are treated, and Ananya often pushes back when others try to humiliate her or those tied to her. The hotel and hiring storyline turns practical work into another arena of control, with Ananya bringing Ramesh into interviews because she trusts his blunt honesty more than formal polish. That workplace tension grows into open conflict as candidates, rivals, and rejected applicants fight over authority, fairness, and recognition. A contract-marriage arrangement then appears, shaped by money, family pressure, and the need to protect power. As the story moves forward, corporate discipline, security disputes, and boardroom struggles make it clear that control over the company is as important as any personal bond. Ananya faces investors, managers, and security staff who challenge her decisions, while Ramesh tries to keep his job and support his family. A more compassionate figure briefly softens the harsh workplace atmosphere by defending fair treatment for workers. Romance remains present beneath the professional conflict, with kisses, teasing, and denial showing unresolved chemistry. The stakes rise further when someone appears to be framing Ramesh and using him as a scapegoat. Police involvement and surveillance footage suggest that the real culprit is being uncovered, but danger still surrounds the characters. In the final stretch, boardroom hostility, a disrupted merger vote, and a public arrest show how unstable the power struggle has become. The ending reframes Ramesh as a wealthy heir who takes control, exposes family betrayal, and confirms that the arranged-marriage setup between him and Ananya is actually a real love story.

अमीरी-के-ढोंग.title: अमीरी के ढोंग
अमीरी-के-ढोंग.description: मुंबई के उद्योगपति अशोक प्रजापति अपनी अरबपति पहचान छुपाकर बेटी सिम्मी के संस्कार से पालन-पोषण करेलें। जब एगो अमीर परिवार ओकर अपमान करेला आ पत्नी के दोहरी जिंदगी सामने आवेला, त लालच, धोखा आ विरासत के लड़ाई बीच अशोक के बदला आ बेटी के भविष्य में से चुनाव करे के पड़ेला।

war-god-ki-wapasi.title: War God Ki Wapasi
war-god-ki-wapasi.description: The show follows Vijay Thakur, a soldier and father whose return home is repeatedly met with suspicion, humiliation, and unresolved family pain. He comes back after years of service hoping to reconnect with his child, but instead faces accusations of abandonment and selfish motives. Much of the drama turns on whether he is a fraud, an outsider, or a hidden hero, and different family members keep shifting between rejection and reluctant defense. Public gatherings, especially birthday and family celebrations, become battlegrounds where his daughter rejects him in front of others and he tries to prove he came only to protect and honor her. At the same time, the story expands into military and political intrigue around the feared War God, a commander whose identity is hidden, contested, and tied to national security. Vijay is repeatedly challenged in public tests and dangerous confrontations, but he proves himself through calm resolve, gunfire, and explosive action. These moments gradually confirm his status as a national protector, even as journalists expose a wider criminal network involving corruption, drugs, money laundering, and murder. Vibhu Mehra emerges as a major power broker who tries to use family, business, and military connections to raise his own standing. His ambitions collide with the truth about Vijay and with the larger forces surrounding the War God. Pragati stands at the center of the family and romance conflict, openly choosing Vijay despite fierce opposition from elders who mock his status and fear for the family empire. Her decision turns a private relationship into a public struggle over reputation, shareholders, and the future of the company. The family repeatedly argues over who belongs, who has authority, and who gets to define the truth about Vijay’s past. In one thread, a president confronts a supposed traitor, only to discover that the soldiers’ loyalty lies with Grey, who is standing directly before him. In another, a celebrated medal and other symbols of service are mocked, but the hero answers by defending sacrifice, honor, and duty. Sunita’s divorce papers and the breakup around Wolf add another layer of family fracture, showing how personal loyalties keep breaking apart under pressure. By the end, Pragati rejects inherited power and chooses to build her own company, asserting a new identity even as the larger conflicts around Vijay, the War God, and Vibhu remain dangerous and unresolved.

the-return-of-the-prince.title: The Return Of The Prince
the-return-of-the-prince.description: A reincarnated ancient prince is reborn as a 15-year-old lost heir in a powerful modern family, where he faces rejection, rivalry, and betrayal. Armed with mysterious powers and knowledge from his past life, he sets out to reclaim his rightful place and uncover hidden truths.

choomantar.title: Choomantar
choomantar.description: After witnessing his parents’ murder at the hands of a powerful criminal syndicate, Neel, a young man born with genuine supernatural magic hides in plain sight as an intern at a magic company, concealing abilities unlike anything the world has seen. When a public performance exposes him as the mysterious Dark Phantom, he is drawn into a dangerous world of rival magicians and the enemies who destroyed his family, forcing him to choose between revenge and destiny.

berlindung-di-d-subtitled.title: Berlindung di d (Subtitled)
berlindung-di-d-subtitled.description:
Ketika ia kehilangan segalanya, suami, perusahaan, dan putrinya, ia menemukan sekutu tak terduga dalam diri seorang pria yang menyimpan rahasia mematikan.

Sebuah perjalanan liar penuh pengkhianatan, permainan kekuasaan, dan cinta yang mekar di tengah kekacauan.

Yang dimulai sebagai perjuangan bertahan hidup, berakhir sebagai perang antara hati dan warisan.

Saksikan sekarang!

drama-romantissubtitled.title: Drama Romantis(Subtitled)
drama-romantissubtitled.description: Ruby and Charles sit at the center of a romance that is constantly pulled into public scandal, family pressure, and corporate power struggles. Their connection begins with warmth and teasing, but it is quickly framed by contracts, appearances, and the expectations of Charles’s wealthy family. Ruby is repeatedly forced to defend her reputation as rumors, rival actresses, and hostile interviews turn her private life into public spectacle. Charles often tries to manage the situation through staged romance and controlled intimacy, yet his behavior also makes him seem secretive and controlling. The story keeps suggesting that what looks like a relationship may also be a strategy for inheritance, image repair, or business survival. Vera is drawn into a similar kind of arrangement, entering Charles’s home under a signed contract that blurs survival and romance. David stands out as another controlling force, tied to harassment and contract abuse, reinforcing how little freedom the women have in these arrangements. Sisi’s blackout confusion and Spike’s accusation add another layer of uncertainty and deception around the night’s events. Across the batch, women are judged, manipulated, and used as leverage while men in power try to shape the narrative. Ruby’s career rises and falls alongside the romance, with auditions, casting changes, and industry sabotage affecting her standing. Viola repeatedly functions as a rival presence, feeding rumors and competing for attention and roles. Frederick also becomes important as a mentor-like figure who helps Ruby professionally and sometimes personally, even as his presence complicates the emotional triangle around her. As the scandal deepens, leaked photos, interviews, and gossip force Ruby to confront how much of Charles she truly knows. Charles’s family, especially his mother and Catherine, adds pressure by treating the relationship as a threat to inheritance and control. The company’s value drops, investors demand answers, and the board begins moving against Charles as the romance becomes a business crisis. Ruby eventually pulls away, believing she is hurting Charles and the company, while Charles refuses to let her go. By the end, the relationship remains unresolved, the company is still under strain, and the battle between love, image, and power is far from over.

mr-alimony.title: Mr. Alimony
mr-alimony.description: Arya’s story unfolds as a long courtroom battle in which one dispute keeps widening into several. It begins with him as a defamation plaintiff facing public outrage, protests, and a strong defense led by Bhandari. Soon the case is no longer only about reputation, because divorce and alimony questions bring his marriage with Rashi into the center of the fight. Rashi and others describe a relationship shaped by control, restriction, emotional pressure, and financial dependence, while Arya insists he is being persecuted and miscast. Testimony from a maid and other witnesses is used to argue over who supported whom and how long Arya stayed home. The proceedings then expand into claims of secret meetings, hidden romance, and overlapping relationships involving Rashi and Karan. CCTV footage, emails, bank transfers, and repeated money requests are introduced to test whether the relationship was consensual, deceptive, or exploitative. Karan eventually confirms a secret affair with Rashi, and the court hears that she was involved with two men at once. An audio recording is also played to support allegations of threats and blackmail, though the defense questions whether it has been altered. The courtroom becomes even more crowded when Pooja accuses Arya of harassment and Arya argues that her account has been stripped of context. He tries to show that messages, meetings, and demonstrations do not prove the accusations as presented. Medha then enters the fight as a journalist whose reporting Arya says damaged his reputation before any verdict. Medha defends her work as verified and in the public interest, while Arya claims it was sensational and biased. By this point, the case is no longer about one complaint but about whether several women are connected through a shared history and a larger pattern. In the later hearings, Arya openly frames the accusations as a coordinated conspiracy across different phases of his life. The court eventually moves from accusation to consequence, ordering restitution, apologies, and compensation in the financial and defamation disputes. Across the whole arc, the stakes are not only money or marriage, but whether Arya can clear his name before the public record hardens against him.

mafia-kings-revenge.title: Mafia King's Revenge
mafia-kings-revenge.description: எல்லோராலும் “லூசர்” என்று அவமதிக்கப்படும் ஒருவன், தனது கடந்த காலத்தை மறைத்து அமைதியாக வாழ்கிறான். ஆனால் அவன் மனைவி Aviva-வை பணத்திற்காக கைப்பற்ற முயலும் பேராசைக்காரர்கள் அவனை மீண்டும் இருண்ட உலகிற்குள் இழுக்கிறார்கள். அவர்களுக்கு தெரியாமல், அவன் சாதாரண மனிதன் அல்ல — Starlight Group-இன் உண்மையான அதிகாரமும், அச்சுறுத்தும் மாஃபியா டானும் அவனே. துரோகம், காதல், அதிகாரப் போராட்டம், மற்றும் கொதிக்கும் பழிவாங்கல் — இவை அனைத்தும் சேர்ந்து ஒரு வெடிக்கும் கதையாக மாறுகிறது.

tedhi-medhi-kahani.title: Tedhi Medhi Kahani
tedhi-medhi-kahani.description: Ruhi, a fiercely chaotic free spirit, gets stood up on her wedding day and talks her way into a stranger's car — and then his flat. Rohan, a guarded perfectionist still bruised from a broken engagement, finds his carefully ordered life delightfully upended. What begins as two days of domestic disasters, borrowed favours, and noisy silences slowly reveals two deeply lonely people healing each other without meaning to. A warm, funny romance about the beautifully tedhi medhi ways love finds you.

turn-coconut-waste-into-profitable-busin.title: Turn Coconut waste into profitable business
turn-coconut-waste-into-profitable-busin.description: Kobari Bonda thagutham taruvatha dani padestham, kani taruvatha em jarguthundi anedi manki teliyadhu. danitho enno rakala material create chestharu.! Manchi business kuda adhi.! meeru kuda petalanukunte ee video chudandi..!

contract-ganda.title: Contract Ganda
contract-ganda.description: A poor girl marries a "broke" stranger to save her dying mother—only to learn he's a secret billionaire on the run from his own family's betrayal. As fake vows turn into real love, jealous relatives and a treacherous best friend conspire to tear them apart through poison, kidnapping, and gunfire. Love and loyalty triumph as the couple unite in a true marriage at last.

hanuman-ke-4-chamatkaar.title: Hanuman Ke 4 Chamatkaar
hanuman-ke-4-chamatkaar.description: Four devoted bhakts, each struggling with a different challenge—fear, pride, greed, and despair—set out on separate journeys seeking purpose and peace. Guided by mysterious signs, acts of kindness, and lessons of courage, they unknowingly follow the path of Lord Hanuman. As their stories intertwine, they discover that true devotion lies in selfless service, faith, and inner strength. In the end, Hanuman reveals his presence, leading them toward wisdom, unity, and spiritual awakening.

my-husband-is-a-ghost-hunter-1.title: My Husband Is a Ghost Hunter
my-husband-is-a-ghost-hunter-1.description: Naina , a widowed gold magnate, marries Arjun Varma to protect her daughter and her collapsing empire, believing he is only a broken ex-convict. When powerful gold syndicates attack her business and target her child, a buried truth explodes. Her husband Arjun Varma is actually Ghost Hunter, a man once feared by governments and erased from history. As a contract marriage turns real, a caged monster rises to protect his family and claim his throne.

the-eyes-of-truth.title: The Eyes of Truth
the-eyes-of-truth.description: Chen's life falls apart when his girlfriend abandons him for a richer man. But fate gives him an extraordinary gift—eyes that can see the hidden truth behind everything. From exposing fake antiques and spotting priceless treasures to predicting jackpots, Chen rises from a humiliated nobody to an unstoppable force in the antique world. As betrayal turns into regret and a new love enters his life, one truth becomes clear: those who underestimated him never saw his true worth.

blind-love-deadly-truth-2.title: Blind Love Deadly Truth
blind-love-deadly-truth-2.description: After losing his eyesight in an accident, billionaire Karan Malhotra is abandoned by his girlfriend and pushed to the edge of despair. Aradhya, a strong-willed woman hiding her own powerful identity, saves him and agrees to a contract marriage to become his “eyes.” As Karan battles betrayal, a murderous stepbrother, and corporate conspiracies within Malhotra Jewels, the fake marriage slowly turns into real love while buried secrets about Aradhya, their past, and their child begin to surface.

billionaire-rakshakudu.title: Billionaire Rakshakudu
billionaire-rakshakudu.description: The story begins as a wealthy man’s grand proposal to Divya collapses into public humiliation when she rejects him and chooses Rahul instead. Their breakup is not only romantic but also a status contest, with the ring, money, and lifestyle becoming symbols of what Divya values. Karthik is left bitter and convinced that wealth is all people care about, while a loyal friend tries to remind him that real love should be different. From there, the narrative widens into a corporate world where assistants, CEOs, and senior staff struggle over confidence, presentation, and authority. At Ratnam Industries, business assignments and brand launches create a new stage for ambition, and the workplace begins to mirror the same rivalry and pride seen in the romance plot. Tejaswi emerges as a calculated figure who decides to pursue Mr. Ratnam strategically, treating both public correction and private heartbreak as openings. Around her, jewelry campaigns, office presentations, and repeated approvals or criticisms become battles over originality, recognition, and control. Pallavi often sharpens these conflicts by mocking weaker ideas and backing the stronger side, while interns and employees fight to prove that their work is their own. The tension deepens when accusations of stolen concepts, forged evidence, and disputed signatures turn the office into a blame game. Anusha repeatedly insists she is being framed, while others accuse her or use her work to gain advantage. Ratnam’s romantic interest in Tejaswi complicates the corporate struggle, since personal desire and workplace power keep feeding each other. A shipment crisis and later a false bankruptcy scare briefly raise the stakes for the company, but the real danger remains trust itself. Rumors, leaked photos, and a false newspaper scandal push private conflict into public humiliation. Karthik and others try to defend the people they trust, but suspicion keeps spreading through the office. The authority struggle is finally clarified when Rahul identifies Karthik Ratnam as the real CEO, ending one identity dispute but not the larger web of betrayal. Tejaswi is then exposed for leaking secrets to Rahul, and her rise collapses into disgrace and removal. Karthik apologizes to Anusha for wrongly suspecting her, showing that some of the damage can still be repaired. The batch closes with romance returning to the foreground as public confessions and declarations of love turn corporate success into a personal reckoning.

my-magical-man.title: My Magical Man
my-magical-man.description: A powerful demon disciple who is killed and reborn in a human body uses forbidden cultivation and good deeds to escape his dark master Lucifer, but his mission turns complicated when he discovers love, betrayal, and a deadly supernatural war tied to his past life.

aa-karala-raatri.title: Aa Karala Raatri
aa-karala-raatri.description: The story follows a taxi driver and a powerful Kulkarni family as hidden identities, family claims, and business warfare collide. Sathya tries to live apart from his wealthy father’s shadow, but his ordinary work keeps pulling him into danger, chases, and violent confrontations. At the same time, Sridhar Kulkarni appears in shifting roles, sometimes mocked as a beggar or taxi driver and sometimes revealed as a commanding industrialist. The family line becomes harder to ignore when people begin linking the taxi driver to the Kulkarni name and to a child who insists on being recognized. A missing woman, a distressed mother, and a child’s plea for her father turn the conflict into a search for truth and belonging. DNA proof and public arguments make paternity a central stake, but acceptance remains uncertain and contested. Rohini is drawn into the center of this storm as she tries to protect her child, defend her reputation, and hold onto family ties. Her relationship with Sridhar is strained by secrecy, humiliation, and the pressure of outside forces. Around them, elite figures repeatedly shame the family over class, legitimacy, and bloodline, turning private pain into public spectacle. The conflict widens into corporate struggle when shares, CEO power, and investment demands become tied to personal loyalty. Rohini is pushed to secure huge funding, sign papers, and submit to deadlines that threaten her position if she fails. Powerful men use apology, obedience, and public humiliation as tools of control. In parallel, the story keeps returning to older betrayals, including a past death tied to Rohini’s mother and a hidden revenge motive. Violence also remains close at hand, from street beatings to armed clashes and criminal threats. One major thread involves weapons diverted from the army to terrorists, forcing a direct confrontation with the betrayer. Another thread reveals that some characters are not who they seem, including a taxi driver whose true parentage is exposed. By the end of the batch digests, the show has become a layered battle over identity, inheritance, revenge, and family recognition, with no clean resolution in sight.

the-key-lord.title: The Key Lord
the-key-lord.description: The show follows two intertwined battles for power: one inside a criminal hawala empire and another inside a collapsing marriage and household. At the center of the underworld conflict is a hidden vault tied to great wealth, with five keys becoming the only path to control. That search for access pulls heirs, enforcers, and impostors into a succession war marked by suspicion, disguise, and betrayal. The Hawala Lord is repeatedly treated as a figure who hides in plain sight, and several men claim or are accused of claiming his title. As the conflict grows, public confrontations turn into threats, armed standoffs, and open violence over who truly leads the network. Rival figures accuse one another of dividing the group, while recordings, secret meetings, and buried wealth deepen the uncertainty around legitimacy. In parallel, property disputes over a haveli and bungalow mirror the larger struggle for ownership and authority. Guards, gardeners, and outsiders challenge the powerful, and even ordinary entrances become tests of identity and control. Gautam’s relationship with Vani/Bani becomes another site of humiliation and reversal, as marriage, class, and loyalty are all questioned. Gautam repeatedly tries to assert his identity and place, but the relationship fractures under rejection and resentment. Vani/Bani is shown as torn between status, wealth, and self-respect, and her position shifts as the household power balance changes. Sandhya becomes increasingly important in Gautam’s emotional life, while others around him challenge or misunderstand those bonds. The story also shows other women and couples trying to claim their place beside powerful men, suggesting that queenship and loyalty are always contested. By the later stretch, the criminal hierarchy hardens around a new Lord and queen, but resistance remains active. The result is a world where love and rule are both unstable, and every claim to identity must be defended in public. Across the show, the stakes are survival, legitimacy, and the right to stand at the center of power.

सबसू-महँगी-गलती.title: सबसू महँगी गलती
सबसू-महँगी-गलती.description:
Jad pyaar ban jaave hai sabse bado dkhokho
Airline tycoon veer chopra ne laage hai ki bine apni life partner milgi hai – flight attended Lara Smith, pan o pyaar jaldi hi badal jaave hai ek khatarnaak khel mai, jad veer ra maa-baap apni hon wali bahu se milan khatir ussi udaan mai savaar hove hai. 
Udaan ke bicho-bich shuru hove hai ahamkaar, apmaan aur jhuth ro aiso khel… jo na sirf Rishta ne todd deve hai, balki sacchai ro isho raaz khole hai ki sara sapna bikhar jaave hai.

sleeping-with-my-enemy.title: Sleeping With My Enemy
sleeping-with-my-enemy.description: தான் உயிராக காதலித்த மனைவியால் விஷம் கொடுத்து கொலை செய்யப்பட முயன்ற ஒரு பில்லியனர், அனைத்தையும் இழந்து அடையாளமற்றவனாக வாழ வேண்டிய நிலைக்கு தள்ளப்படுகிறார். ஆனால் உண்மையான அன்பும் விசுவாசமும் கொண்ட மனிதர்களின் துணையுடன் மீண்டும் எழுந்து, தன்னை துரோகம் செய்தவர்களை வீழ்த்தி, தனது சாம்ராஜ்யத்தையும் வாழ்க்கையையும் மீட்டெடுக்கிறார்

billionaire-bhai-ka-badla.title: Billionaire Bhai Ka Badla
billionaire-bhai-ka-badla.description: Adopted Meera is brutally abused and cast out by her family due to a manipulative maid’s daughter, Disha. She is rescued by billionaire Shashank, who has loved her since childhood. When the Mehras discover Disha's lies, they beg for forgiveness. Meanwhile, Meera faces jealous rivals but stands tall with Shashank's trust. After Nikhil takes a knife to save her from a vengeful Disha, Meera cordially helps his recovery but permanently leaves her toxic past to marry Shashank.

crash-landed-into-love-2.title: Crash Landed Into Love
crash-landed-into-love-2.description: After a plane crash, billionaire heir Amar Luthra survives with amnesia and is saved by kind-hearted surgeon Dr. Rumi. While greedy nurse Nisha fakes Amar’s death to seize the Luthra empire, Amar lives as a nobody beside the woman who saved him—until love, truth, and a ruthless conspiracy collide, forcing him to reclaim his identity before Rumi loses everything.

jungle-ka-king.title: Jungle ka king
jungle-ka-king.description: Neel’s story follows a young man who is repeatedly humiliated, hunted, and beaten as village power structures try to crush him in public. At first, he is treated as a coward and orphan, then framed for theft and murder, and forced to survive while hiding a strange divine force within him. That force, called Jal Shakti, appears as both a burden and a lifeline, able to heal, defend, and destroy depending on how it is used. Corrupt local leaders and hostile villagers exploit fear around him, while outsiders and spiritual figures begin to sense that he is more than the accusations against him. As the pressure grows, Neel is chained, mocked, and pushed into submission, but each attempt to break him only reveals more of his power. He is also drawn into a wider conflict over the forest, where land clearing, destruction, and control threaten both the jungle and the people around it. In that struggle, Neel declares that the forest may be cut but cannot be owned, showing that his fight is not only for himself but for the land that shelters him. Meera remains close to him across the turmoil, searching for him, helping him, and urging him to control the power awakening inside him. Sheshnag and other spiritual guides reinforce the idea that Neel’s mark and power may be tied to a larger destiny rather than a curse. At the same time, villagers panic when the glowing mark on Neel is linked to an ancient destroyer, and Vikrant uses that fear to turn the crowd against him. The story keeps Neel suspended between two possible identities: a dangerous force that could bring ruin, or a chosen protector of the jungle. His mercy repeatedly causes trouble, especially when he rescues a vulnerable child from floodwaters and is then attacked because villagers mistake his act for harm. That pattern deepens the tragedy of his position, since even his attempts to save others are read as proof of guilt. By the later arc, Neel is no longer only running from accusation; he begins returning to the village and forest to ask for trust and promise defense. The emotional stakes rise as he accepts that his water shakti is tied to the jungle itself and that he may be the rightful guardian it needs. Yet the threat remains unresolved, because Vikrant continues to stir violence, and the fear around Neel’s power still hangs over everyone. The show’s central tension is whether Neel can master the force inside him before others force it into destruction, and whether the village will see him as a monster or as its protector.

price-of-love-4.title: Price of Love
price-of-love-4.description: Piyush lives as a humble tailor while secretly being the billionaire owner of Tantra, sacrificing his wealth so his wife Vaani can succeed on her own. But Vaani humiliates him, cheats with her boss Raghav, and chases luxury and status. When tycoon Meher Mittal offers Vaani 300 crores for Piyush, she shockingly agrees and divorces him. Unaware that he is actually a billionaire, Vaani celebrates her deal until the truth emerges, leading to a downfall and a reckoning between greed and true love

teen-patti-king.title: Teen Patti King
teen-patti-king.description: Vicky Sharma ki duniya us din bikhar gayi jab uske pita shaadi ke shagun ke paise jua me haar baithe, aur ladki walon ne sabke saamne unki izzat mitti me mila di. Beizzati, gareebi aur dhokhe ke us andhere me kisi ko andaza nahi tha ki chup rehne wala Vicky asal me taash ki duniya ka khatarnak khiladi hai. Ab Vicky ne kasam kha li thi — har ek paisa, har ek apmaan aur har ek aansu ka hisaab hoga… daav bhi uska hoga aur Jeet bhi.

assalu-thaggedele.title: Assalu Thaggedele
assalu-thaggedele.description: పెళ్ళి, పిల్లలు వద్దనుకున్న క్యాబ్ డ్రైవర్ రుద్ర ప్రసాద్ ఒక వైపు, అవసరమైతే డబ్బులు ఇచ్చి అయినా సరే పెళ్ళి చేసుకోవాలనే రిషిక మరో వైపు. వీరిద్దరి జీవితం ఎక్కడికి చేరిందనేదే కథ. ప్రేమ, పెళ్ళి, కుటుంబం, ట్విస్టులతో సాగే కథ.. అస్సలు తగ్గేదేలే.

love-under-arrest-3.title: Love Under Arrest
love-under-arrest-3.description:
A wedding turns tragic when the bride's father accidentally injures the groom's mother.
Blinded by anger, the groom's love turns into hatred, and he pushes his wife away.
As she battles illness and heartbreak, fate drives them even further apart.
They reunite when she loses her memory, giving him a second chance to make things right.

Through love, forgiveness, and redemption, he wins her back, and together they begin a new chapter in their lives.

mr-miss-lover.title: Mr. & Miss. Lover
mr-miss-lover.description: Diya Shehrawat, the ruthless boss of the powerful Shehrawat gang, unexpectedly falls for Rancho aka ACP Arjun Kumar after he saves her life during a deadly gang shootout. To the world, Rancho appears to be a cowardly delivery boy, but secretly he is ACP Arjun Kumar, an undercover officer on a mission to infiltrate Diya’s empire and expose the underworld nexus.

nakili-doctor.title: Nakili Doctor
nakili-doctor.description: Vedant, a brilliant doctor whose license was canceled, works as a hospital ward boy. When he develops a revolutionary non-surgical heart treatment technique, his fiancée Nisha betrays him for the head surgeon Viraj. Expelled from the hospital, Vedant saves a child's life at an airport using his technique. Summoned back to treat the Health Minister, he faces brutal humiliation but ultimately proves his method works, earning redemption and his license restored.

shiv-ka-bhakt-shivaay.title: Shiv ka Bhakt, Shivaay
shiv-ka-bhakt-shivaay.description: A grief-stricken boy, Shivaay blessed by Mahadev with the power over life and death grows into a mysterious warrior who must balance divine responsibility, love, and revenge - while protecting his identity and fulfilling a destined promise. Watch now!

unexpected-kadhal.title: Unexpected Kadhal
unexpected-kadhal.description: அஜய் ஒரு சாதாரண மனிதன் போல தோன்றினாலும், அவனிடம் அசாதாரண சக்தி உள்ளது—அவன் நோயுற்றவர்களை குணப்படுத்த முடியும். ஒரு பெரிய தொழிலதிபரின் மகள் ரியாவை காப்பாற்றிய பின், நகரின் செல்வாக்கு மிக்க குடும்பங்கள் அவனை கவனிக்கத் தொடங்குகின்றன. ஆனால் அஜயின் மனதில் ஒரே ஒருவர்—நளினி. அவளை மீண்டும் பெறவும், அவளை அவமானப்படுத்தியவர்களுக்கு பதிலடி கொடுக்கவும், அவன் ஆபத்தான விளையாட்டில் இறங்குகிறான். உண்மை வெளிவரும்போது, காதல், அதிகாரம், பழி—எது வெல்லும்?

my-wifes-boyfriend.title: My Wife’s Boyfriend
my-wifes-boyfriend.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, a man is mocked as useless, unaware to them that he is actually a powerful hidden CEO. Betrayed and humiliated, he begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel. Once his true identity is revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

the-war-that-india-never-talks-about-196.title: The War That India Never Talks About-1967 Nathu La
the-war-that-india-never-talks-about-196.description: Five years after India's defeat in 1962, the Himalayan border was still carrying the scars of war. Then, in 1967, a confrontation at Nathu La in Sikkim escalated into a deadly clash. Young artillery officer Sheru Thapliyal watched from Sebu La as soldiers came under fire and faced a terrifying decision: call artillery without hitting his own men. Through battle, sacrifice and memory, this is the forgotten story of Nathu La 1967.

rajayogi-shri-jayachamarajendra-wadiyar-.title: Rajayogi : Shri Jayachamarajendra Wadiyar Bahaddur
rajayogi-shri-jayachamarajendra-wadiyar-.description: ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಕೊನೆಯ ಆಡಳಿತ ಮಹಾರಾಜರಾದ 'ಶ್ರೀ ಜಯಚಾಮರಾಜೇಂದ್ರ ಒಡೆಯರ್' ಅವರು ರಾಜತಂತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಜಾತಂತ್ರ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಅನುಭವಿಸಿದವರು. ಸಮಾಜಮುಖಿ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಹಾಗೂ ಜನಪರ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳಿಂದ ಮನಗೆದ್ದ ಅಪರೂಪದ ದೊರೆ. ಮೈಸೂರಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲದೇ ಇಡೀ ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾದರಿ ಅರಸರಾದ ಶ್ರೀ ಜಯಚಾಮರಾಜೇಂದ್ರ ಒಡೆಯರ್ ಅವರ ಜೀವನಗಾಥೆಯನ್ನ ಅದ್ಭುತವಾಗಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ 'ಮೈಸೂರು ಸುರೇಶ್'. ಕೇಳಿ ಇವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ರಾಜಯೋಗಿ : ಶ್ರೀ ಜಯಚಾಮರಾಜೇಂದ್ರ ಒಡೆಯರ್ ಬಹದ್ದೂರ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

the-dark-side-of-big-tech.title: The Dark Side Of Big Tech
the-dark-side-of-big-tech.description: Are you using your apps—or are your apps using you? This series goes behind the design of the platforms you use every day, revealing how infinite scroll, notifications, unpredictable rewards, personalised algorithms, autoplay, retargeting and FOMO keep you coming back. Through relatable stories and behavioural psychology, discover how apps compete for your attention and how seemingly small design choices can influence what you watch, buy and do next.

master-2.title: Master
master-2.description: ஒரு சாதாரண குருகுல இளைஞன் கிருஷ்ணா. அவனை உடல்நிலை சரியில்லாமல் இருக்கும் தன் தாத்தாவின் பேச்சை தட்ட முடியாமல் வெறுப்பாக கல்யாணம் செய்கிறாள் பணக்கார வாரிசான அழகிய நந்திதா. ஒரு வேலைக்காரனாக மட்டுமே தன் கணவனை காணும் நந்தித்தாவுக்கு அவனுடைய மறைக்கப்பட்ட இன்னொரு அடையாளம் தெரிய வந்தால்?

ചക്രവ്യൂഹം-.title: ചക്രവ്യൂഹം
ചക്രവ്യൂഹം-.description:
യുദ്ധമുന്നണിയിൽ  എട്ടുചുറ്റുകളോടും  ഒറ്റമാർഗത്തോടും കൂടി ഒരുക്കപ്പെടുന്ന മണ്ഡലാകൃതിയിലുളള സൈന്യവിന്യാസരീതിയാണു ചക്രവ്യൂഹം. ഇവിടെ
മന്ത്ര- തന്ത്ര പാരമ്പര്യങ്ങളുടെ പശ്ഛാത്തലത്തിൽ ഒരു ചക്രവ്യൂഹം നിർമ്മിക്കപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു. മലയാളത്തിൻ്റെ ജനപ്രിയ കഥാകാരൻ എറ്റുമാനൂർ ശിവകുമാറിൻ്റെ തൂലികയിൽ പിറന്ന മറ്റൊരു മാന്ത്രിക നോവൽ.

universe-ke-warning-sign.title: Universe Ke Warning Sign ?
universe-ke-warning-sign.description: What if the coincidences in your life aren't really coincidences? A friend's call just when you were thinking about them. Repeating numbers everywhere. A strange dream that later feels familiar. Or a gut feeling you can't explain. Are these messages from the Universe—or simply your subconscious noticing patterns? This series explores dreams, intuition, angel numbers, energy, money, luck and the hidden signals we may experience every day.

the-boss-1.title: The Boss
the-boss-1.description:
రాజకీయ, మీడియా ప్రపంచాన్ని శాసించిన రాజేశ్వరి దేవి అనూహ్య మరణంతో, ఎన్నేళ్లుగా తండ్రిగారి ఇంటి నుండి దూరంగా ఉన్న మనవడు రఘు తిరిగి హైదరాబాద్‌కి వస్తాడు.

ఆమె చివరి విల్లు లో రఘుకే అసలైన వారసత్వం ప్రకటించబడుతుంది — కేవలం మీడియా సంస్థకే కాదు, నిజాయితీతో కూడిన విలువలకు కూడా!

కానీ కుటుంబాన్ని ఇప్పటికే శివరాం, కిరణ్మయి వర్గం నియంత్రిస్తోంది. ఇప్పుడు రఘు ఒక వారసుడే కాదు — మార్పుకు మార్గదర్శి.

contemporary-kadhal.title: Contemporary Kadhal
contemporary-kadhal.description: Vishnu, who's swamped with office work, gets a call from an unknown number. He'd called for customer care, but the woman's voice on the other end completely captivates him, and he falls for her. Slowly, he starts craving her calls daily, just to hear her voice. He even expresses his love.. Meanwhile, Shruthi, who's secretly in love with Vishnu, is the only one who knows it's an AI, not a real woman. Will Vishnu fall into this trap? And will he ever get out of it?

the-hidden-business-of-astrology.title: The Hidden Business Of Astrology
