the-hidden-business-of-astrology.description: Career, shaadi, paisa, health... jab life uncertain hoti hai, hum answers dhoondte hain. Lekin astrology sirf prediction ka system hai ya reassurance ka business? Is docu-drama mein jaaniye kaise uncertainty, psychology, belief aur business milkar ek multi-crore industry banate hain. Fear marketing se lekar astrology apps aur human brain tak—ye show astrology ko prove ya disprove nahi karta, balki uske peeche chhipe human behaviour ko decode karta hai

how-i-quit-google-to-sell-samosas-3.title: How I Quit Google to Sell Samosas
how-i-quit-google-to-sell-samosas-3.description: From a weekend food pop-up in Cuffe Parade to the pages of Forbes, Munaf's journey is nothing short of inspiring. Through wins, losses, and powerful lessons, he shares the story behind the hustle. A heartfelt tale of passion, resilience, and the making of an unexpected entrepreneur.

bodyguard.title: Bodyguard
bodyguard.description:
విక్రమ్ బాక్ గ్రౌండ్ భాష సినిమా రేంజ్ లో ఉంటుంది కానీ ప్రస్తుతానికి అతను ఒక బాడీ గార్డ్ గా పని చేస్తున్నాడు. అతని లుక్స్ చూస్తే ఏ అమ్మాయి కూడా ప్రపోజ్ చేయకుండా ఉండలేదు. కానీ అతను మాత్రం అమ్మాయిల గాలి కూడా దగ్గరకి రానివ్వడు. ఎందుకంటే హ్యాండ్సామ్ బాడీగార్డ్ కి ఆల్రెడీ పెళ్లి అయ్యింది ఓ అందమైన పాప కూడా ఉంది. గతం పక్కన పెడితే ఇప్పుడు విక్రమ్ అందరి ముందు తన భార్యని చంపిన హంతకుడిలా నిలబడ్డాడు. అందరూ అతన్ని ఒక బిచ్చగాడిలా చూస్తున్నారు. అప్పుడే ఒక బ్లైండ్ డేట్ పేరుతో అతని లైఫ్ లోకి ఎంటర్ అయ్యింది మీనా. 

విక్రమ్ కూతురు హనీ మాములు పాప కాదు తనలో కొన్ని పవర్స్ ఉన్నాయి. ఎవరో గుర్తు తెలియని వ్యక్తులు ఆమె పవర్స్ నీ సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి హనీ నీ ట్రాప్ లో పడేసే పనిలో పడ్డారు. విక్రమ్ ఇటు తన ప్రొఫెషన్ అయిన బాడీగార్డ్ డ్యూటీని చేస్తూనే మరోపక్క హనీ నీ కాపాడుకుంటాడు. ఈ జర్నీ అంత ఈజీ ఏం కాదు. ఎన్నో ట్విస్ట్ లు ఉన్నాయి.

khooni-dulhan.title: Khooni Dulhan
khooni-dulhan.description: Maya, jise police "Khooni Dulhan" ke naam se dhoond rahi hai, ameer aadmiyon se shaadi karke unhe maar deti hai. Lekin woh serial killer nahi, apni behen ke saath hue darindagi ka badla lene nikli hai. Sab badal jaata hai jab woh Arjun se sachcha pyaar kar baithti hai aur pata chalta hai ki asli mastermind uske sabse kareeb hai.

ekka-raja-rani.title: Ekka Raja Rani
ekka-raja-rani.description: ಈ ರೋಚಕ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಕಥೆಯು ಹತ್ತು ವರ್ಷದ ಯಶ್ ನ  ಭಯಾನಕ ಬಾಲ್ಯದ ನೆನಪಿನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಜೂಜಿನ ಸಾಲದ ಕಾರಣ ಅವನ ತಂದೆ ವಿವೇಕ್ ವರ್ಮಾ "ಕಿಂಗ್ ಜೆ" ಎಂಬ ನಿಗೂಢ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಒತ್ತಡದಿಂದ ಆತ್ಮಹತ್ಯೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಹದಿನೈದು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಂತರ, ಆರವ್ ತನ್ನ ಬಾಲ್ಯದ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತೆ ವಿಭಾ ಜೊತೆ  ಸೇಡು ತೀರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಜೂಜಿನ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಕಾಲಿಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕ್ಯಾಸಿನೋದಲ್ಲಿ ಧೂರ್ತ ಫೈಜ್‌ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಆಟವಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಸೋತುಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಫೈಜ್ ಪ್ರಿಯಾಳನ್ನೇ ಪಂದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಕಲು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ನಿಗೂಢ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ನೆರಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆಯು ಸೇಡು, ನಿಷ್ಠೆ ಮತ್ತು ತ್ಯಾಗದ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ "ಎಕ್ಕ ರಾಜ ರಾಣಿ" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

karuppu-roja-1.title: Karuppu Roja
karuppu-roja-1.description:
தனது பெற்றோர்களின் தற்செயலான மரணத்திற்குப் பிறகு நம் நாயகி ரோஜா தனது அன்புக்குரிய தங்கையான பூஜாவை வளர்க்க தாயுமானவலாய் மாறுகிறாள். ரோஜா மற்றும் பூஜாவின் நலம் கருதி ரோஜாவின் நலம் விரும்பி பவானி, அதே ஊரை சேர்த்த பூர்வீக ஜமீன் குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அழகான மருத்துவரான ஸ்ரீதருடன் திருமண முடிச்சுப் போட திட்டமிடுகிறார். அதே நேரத்தில் பூஜா விமான நிலையத்தில் ஸ்ரீதரை கண்ட முதல் பார்வையில் விருப்பம் கொள்கிறாள்.
 
பூஜாவை சிறுவயதிலிருந்தே காதலிக்கும் ரோஜாவின் நண்பன் ராணா. அதை அறித்து கொண்ட ரோஜா அவனுக்கு உதவ முயல்கிறாள்… ஆனால் பூஜா அவனை எல்லா விதத்திலும் வெறுக்கிறாள். பூஜா அழகான ஜோடி புறாக்களான ரோஜாவையும் ஸ்ரீதரையும் பார்க்கும் போதெல்லாம் பொறாமைப்படுகிறாள். பூஜா இந்த பொறாமையை அடுத்த கட்டத்திற்கு கொண்டு செல்கிறாள், தனக்குப் பிடித்த ஸ்ரீதரை தன்னிடம் இருந்து பரித்துக்கொண்டதாக எண்ணி, தன்னை தாய் போல் வளர்த்த சகோதரி ரோஜாவை பழிவாங்க நினைக்கிறாள்.
 
பூஜாவின் இந்த இருண்ட பக்கம் ரோஜாவின் வாழ்க்கையை பாதித்ததா..?!
 
பூஜாவின் மரண வலையில் சிக்கிய ரோஜா எப்படி ஜெயித்தார்..?!

section-377-the-long-road-to-freedom.title: Section 377: The Long Road to Freedom
section-377-the-long-road-to-freedom.description: For nearly 150 years, India had a law that turned the love, identity, and very existence of millions of people into a crime. Section 377 was not merely a legal provision; it became a symbol of fear, silence, blackmail, social stigma, and the forced reality of living invisible lives. Yet, in every era, there were people who refused to bow down to this injustice.

jagannath-rath-yatra-1.title: Jagannath Rath Yatra
jagannath-rath-yatra-1.description:
జగన్నాథుని రథయాత్ర మహోత్సవం భక్తుల సముద్రాన్ని ఆహ్వానిస్తుంది,
పురి వీధుల్లో దేవుళ్లే రథాలపై విహరిస్తారు.
ఈ యాత్రలో అడుగుపెడితే పునర్జన్మల నుండి విముక్తి లభిస్తుందని నమ్మకం.
భక్తి, భవ్యం, భరితమైన ఈ పర్వదినం ఆధ్యాత్మిక యుగానికి ఆహ్వానం.

the-science-of-manipulation.title: The Science Of Manipulation
the-science-of-manipulation.description: You believe your decisions are your own. But what if they're not? Every day, brands, influencers, politicians, algorithms, and even the people closest to you are competing for one thing—control over your attention and choices. The Science of Manipulation is a cinematic series that uncovers the hidden psychological systems behind influence, persuasion, and behavioural control. Because the most dangerous manipulation is the one you never notice.

sugar-baby.title: Sugar Baby
sugar-baby.description: மூன்று ஆண்டுகளாக திருமணமாகியும் தனது மனைவியை ஒருபோதும் காணாத சஞ்சய், எதிர்பாரா விதமாக ஒரு இரவு தனது மனைவியுடன் உறவுகொள்கிறான். காலை விழித்தபோது, அவன் அவளிடம் பேசிய முதல் வாசகம், "இதான் என் Credit Card, எவ்ளோ வேணுமோ எடுத்துக்கோ". உண்மை வெளிவருமா, காதல் வெல்லுமா, இவர்களின் காணா கதை எங்கு போய் முடியும்?

cbe15c58-f39c-4eeb-9f03-b4351f95df6a.title: Dragon
cbe15c58-f39c-4eeb-9f03-b4351f95df6a.description:
ఆకాష్, డ్రాగన్ వరల్డ్ లోనే ఎంతో పవర్ఫుల్ బ్యాక్ గ్రౌండ్ ఉన్నవాడు. అతని పవర్స్ యూస్ చేసి ఎన్నో మిరాకిల్స్ చేయాలి అనుకున్నాడు.  ఇంతలో అనుకోకుండా అతను ఎంతో ప్రాణంగా ప్రేమించిన మల్లికా పృథ్వీ అనే ఒక కుర్రాడితో ఎఫైర్ పెట్టుకుంది. దాంతో ఆకాష్ హార్ట్ బ్రేక్ అయ్యింది. పృథ్వీ ఎవరో కాదు ఆకాష్ సీనియర్. ఆకాష్ అతని మీద ఎదురు తిరిగాడు అన్న కారణంగా అతనికి పవర్స్ లేకుండా చేశాడు పృథ్వీ. వాళ్ళు చేసిన ద్రోహం తట్టుకోలేక సూసైడ్ చేసుకోవాలి అనుకున్నాడు ఆకాష్. కానీ అప్పుడే కథ అసలు మలుపు తిరిగింది. 

స్నేహ అనే ఒక రిచ్ గర్ల్ ఆకాష్ లైఫ్ లోకి వచ్చింది. అనుకోకుండా జరిగిన ఒక యాక్సిడెంట్ వాళ్ళని ఒకటి చేసింది. స్నేహ బ్యాక్ గ్రౌండ్ వాడుకుని ఆకాష్ తన పవర్స్ తిరిగి తెచ్చుకోవాలి అనుకున్నాడు. కానీ ఆ జర్నీ మరో మలుపు తిరిగింది. ఆకాష్ పవర్స్ బయట పడుతున్న కొద్దీ ఎన్నో అద్భుతాలు జరిగాయి.

why-people-obey-power.title: Why People Obey Power
why-people-obey-power.description: What if the India we know today was built by people whose names we rarely hear? From revolutionizing digital payments and building global companies to healing communities and protecting nature, The Indians Who Changed Everything is a cinematic audio docu-drama about ordinary Indians who made extraordinary choices. These are the inspiring, untold stories of courage, vision, and selfless action that quietly transformed the destiny of an entire nation.

thaayumaanaval.title: Thaayumaanaval
thaayumaanaval.description: முகம் தெரியாத நபருடன் செய்த one night stand-ஆல் திவ்யாவிற்கு குழந்தை பிறக்கிறது . பல வருடங்களுக்குப் பிறகு தன் குழந்தையுடன் சொந்த ஊருக்கு வருகிறாள். தன் குழந்தையின் அப்பாவை தேடி கண்டுபிடிக்க முற்படும்போதுதான் தன் தாயும் தங்கையும் செய்த மிகப்பெரிய துரோகம் தெரிய வருகிறது . என்ன துரோகம் அது ? யார் குழந்தையின் அப்பா ?

88a5c0aa-13a9-4361-8d19-8e5d159d2894.title: Master
88a5c0aa-13a9-4361-8d19-8e5d159d2894.description: చిన్ననాటి నుండే సకల వేద శాస్త్రాలను నేర్చుకుని ఆకాశ పర్వతం మీదున్న సిద్ధవనానికి పీఠాధిపతిగా మారాడు రుద్ర. తనకున్న పవర్స్ తో ప్రపంచాన్నే శాసించే స్థాయికి చేరుకున్నాడు కానీ, తన తల్లితండ్రుల చావుకి కారణమైన వంశం మీద పెంచుకున్న పగకి తప్ప మరో ఎమోషన్ కి తన మనసులో చోటివ్వలేదు అతను... ఈ లోకంలో పగే కాదు, ప్రేమ కుడా ఉంటుందని చెప్పడం కోసం రుద్రకి పెళ్లి చేయాలనుకున్నాడు సిద్ధేంద్రుడు. ఆయన ఫిక్స్ చేసిన అమ్మాయి కాకుండా అసలు తానంటే ఇష్టపడని సిరి మెడలో తాళి కట్టాడు. తన ప్రమేయం లేకుండా తన మెళ్లో తాళి కట్టిన రుద్ర మీద కోపం పెంచుకుంది సిరి... మరి ఆ తర్వాత ఏమైంది!? రుద్ర తన పగ తీర్చుకున్నాడా!? పిల్లి ఎలకల్లా పొట్లాడుకునే సిరి - రుద్రల రివెంజ్ లవ్... ఏ తీరాన్ని చేరుకుంది!

detective-namit-golddigger.title: Detective Namit - Golddigger
detective-namit-golddigger.description: In a city where love has become a business, a masked serial killer begins brutally murdering women accused of trapping rich men through lies, blackmail, and manipulation. As fearless detective Namit dives deeper into the horrifying “Gold Digger” murders, he uncovers a deadly game involving powerful businessmen, dark secrets, corrupt systems, and a mysterious lawyer who always stays one step ahead.

indha-murai-nee-dhaan.title: Indha Murai Nee Dhaan
indha-murai-nee-dhaan.description: பத்தாம் மற்றும் பன்னிரண்டாம் வகுப்பு பொதுத்தேர்வுகளை எதிர்கொள்கிற மாணவர்களுக்கு, படிப்பை எளிமையாக புரிந்து கொள்ளும் முறைகள், மனதை தைரியமாக வைத்திருக்கும் பயிற்சிகள், நேர மேலாண்மை மற்றும் உணர்ச்சி கட்டுப்பாடு என அனைத்தையும் நுட்பமாக சொல்லும் இந்த ஆடியோ புத்தகம், வெற்றிக்கான திசையைக் காட்டும் ஒரு உணர்ச்சிப் பயணம்!

kalki-the-end-of-kalyug-1.title: Kalki: The End Of Kalyug
kalki-the-end-of-kalyug-1.description: Is Kalki a future warrior, or a timeless symbol of human transformation? Kalki: The End of Kalyug explores one of Hindu mythology's greatest mysteries through ancient scriptures, philosophy, symbolism, psychology, and modern life. Blending mythology with thought-provoking storytelling, the series asks a powerful question: Is the battle of Kalyug happening in the world—or inside us? A documentary experience that challenges everything you thought you knew.

campus-crush-combat-rush.title: Campus Crush Combat Rush
campus-crush-combat-rush.description: రేవంత్ ఓ ఉన్న‌తాశ‌యం క‌ల యువ‌కుడు..త‌న త‌ల్లి కోరిక మేర‌కు యూనివ‌ర్శిటీ గోల్డు మెడ‌ల్ సాధించ‌డ‌మే ల‌క్ష్‌యంగా యూనిర్శిటీలోకి చేరుతాడు.. అయితే అక్క‌డి ప‌రిస్థితులు అందుకు విరుద్ధంగా ఉంటాయి.. అంత వ‌ర‌కు తాను ఏ ఉపాధ్యాయులనైతే గురువుగా బావిస్తున్నాడో, వారే అకృత్యాల‌కు, అవినీతికి పాల్ప‌డడంతో త‌ట్టుకోలేక పోతాడు.. విద్యార్దులంతా వ‌ర్గాలుగా విడిపోయి, యూనివ‌ర్శిటీ హాస్ట‌ల్ గ‌దుల‌ను ప‌బ్ లుగా , అరాచ‌క కేంద్రాలుగా మార్చ‌డంతో నిజం చెప్పాల‌ని ప్ర‌య‌త్నిస్తాడు. కానీ అత‌ని నిజాయితీకి బ్రేకులు వేసి అత‌నిని ప‌క‌డ్బందీగా యూనివ‌ర్శిటీ నుంచి బ‌య‌ట‌కు పంపిస్తారు. దాంతో త‌న ఆశ‌యానికి అడ్డుత‌గిలిన వారిని ఎలాగైనా నాశ‌నం చెయ్యాల‌ని కంకణం క‌ట్టుకున్న రేవంత్‌, త‌న ప్ర‌ధాన శ‌త్రువు కూతురిని ప్రేమ ఉచ్చులోకి దింపి ప‌ధ‌కం ప్ర‌కారం ఆమె తండ్రి, సోద‌రుల‌ను మ‌ట్టుబెడ‌తాడు.. నిజాయితీగా ఉన్న‌త‌న జీవితాన్ని నాశనం చేసిన వారిని  మ‌ట్టుబెట్టిన అత‌డు చివ‌రికి నిజాయితీగా పోలీసుల‌కు లొంగిపోతాడు.. ఆద్యంతం ఆస్తిక‌ర‌మైన స‌న్నివేశాల‌తో, య‌దార్ధ వాస్త‌వ సంఘ‌ట‌ల‌న‌ను అద్దం ప‌డుతూ ర‌స‌వ‌త్త‌రంగా సాగే స‌స్పెన్స్ ధ్రిల్ల‌ర్ సీరియ‌ల్ ఇది.

vanputra-voice-of-the-jungle.title: Vanputra : Voice Of The Jungle
vanputra-voice-of-the-jungle.description: When 19-year-old Aarav arrives in Nandhaur for an internship, he expects nothing more than a month in the jungle. Instead, he begins hearing mysterious voices, seeing the memories of dead animals, and discovering a hidden connection to his mother’s mysterious death. As a dangerous wildlife conspiracy emerges, Aarav must uncover the truth behind the jungle, his own powers, and the man the forest seems to fear.

the-writer.title: The Writer
the-writer.description: రచయిత సత్య, తన యాక్సిడెంట్ తర్వాత జీవితాన్ని మార్చే సినిమా తీయాలని నిర్ణయిస్తాడు. కానీ అతను రాసిన నవల ఆధారంగా ఫేమ్ కోల్పోయిన సైకో కిల్లర్ ఉస్మాన్ తనపై పగ తీర్చుకోవాలని ప్లాన్ చేస్తాడు.

mudivilla-kadhal.title: Mudivilla Kadhal
mudivilla-kadhal.description: காதலுக்காக எதையும் செய்ய துணிந்த காதலர்கள் இந்த உலகம் முழுக்க இருக்கிறார்கள் ஏன் மீராவும், ஆரவ்வும் கூட அப்படிதான். ஆனால் ஒரு சிறு வித்தியாசம். அந்த காதலோடு உயிரோடு இருப்பது மீரா மட்டும் தான். ஆரவ் அவள் நினைவோட மட்டும் இருக்கிறான். திருமணத்திற்கு சில நாட்களுக்கு முன் விபத்தில் இறந்தான். அவனின் காதலில் இருந்து இன்னும் மீள முடியாமல் தவிக்கிறாள் மீரா.

kaali-zubaan.title: Kaali Zubaan
kaali-zubaan.description: Twenty-year-old Aadaya is sold by her cruel grandmother to a sixty-year-old man. But when he tries to assault her, he suddenly collapses with paralysis. Branded cursed all her life, Aadaya believes she has doomed another man—unaware that someone has traveled all the way to Banaras searching for her, convinced she is anything but a curse.

men-kalaigal.title: Men kalaigal
men-kalaigal.description: மென் கலைகள்- soft skillsன்னு சொல்லப்படுற இந்த மார்டன் கலை தான் இன்றைய காலக்கட்டதோட மிக பெரிய சக்ஸஸ் பார்முலாவா பார்க்கப்படுது.ஆனா நிறைய பேர் மென் கலைகள்ன்னு சொன்னாலே ஏதோ ஆபிஸ் அப்பறம் வொர்க்ல யூஸ் பண்ணுற ஒரு ஸ்கில்ன்னே நினைச்சிட்டு இருக்காங்க. பட், உங்களாளையும் அதை யூஸ் பண்ணி தினசரி வாழ்கையில நிறைய சாதிக்க முடியும்ன்னு சொன்னா... ஆச்சர்யமா இருக்கா? ஆமாங்க... இந்த ஆச்சர்யங்கள் ஒருநாள் உங்க வாழ்க்கைல உண்மைங்க ஆகும்... அதுக்கு இப்போவே  மென்கலைகள் ஆடியோ புக்க கேளுங்க!

one-wedding-two-break-up.title: One Wedding two Break-Up
one-wedding-two-break-up.description: தன் பாட்டியின் உடல்நிலையை காப்பாற்ற கோடீஸ்வரன் ஒருவனை திருமணம் செய்து கொள்ள சம்மதிக்கிறாள் தேவதர்ஷினி. திருமணத்தன்று கூட வேண்டா வெறுப்பாக புகைப்படத்துக்கு நிற்கும் இருவரும், ஒருவர் முகத்தை மற்றவர்கள் பார்ப்பதை கூட தவிர்க்கிறார்கள். தேவதர்ஷினி வேலை பார்க்கும் நிறுவனத்தை சந்தர்ப்ப வசத்தால் வாங்கும் நிலைக்கு ஆளாகிறான் அவள் கணவன். வீட்டிலேயே எலியும் பூனையுமாக இருக்கும் இருவரும் மறுபடியும் நிறுவனத்தில் முகம் பார்க்கிறார்கள்... இங்கேயும் முகத்தைத் திருப்பிகே கொள்வார்களா? இல்லை முட்டளும் மோதலும் காதலாகுமா?

kalki-the-end-of-kalyug.title: Kalki: The End Of Kalyug
kalki-the-end-of-kalyug.description: Is Kalki a future warrior, or a timeless symbol of human transformation? Kalki: The End of Kalyug explores one of Hindu mythology's greatest mysteries through ancient scriptures, philosophy, symbolism, psychology, and modern life. Blending mythology with thought-provoking storytelling, the series asks a powerful question: Is the battle of Kalyug happening in the world—or inside us? A documentary experience that challenges everything you thought you knew.

കാളിപൂജ-.title: കാളിപൂജ
കാളിപൂജ-.description: കാടിനുളളിൽ നിഗൂഢതകൾ നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു ക്ഷേത്ര സമുച്ചയത്തിലേക്ക് അബദ്ധവശാൽ അകപ്പെടുന്ന മിറാൻഡ എന്ന മാദക യുവതി. അവളെ കാത്ത് എന്തെല്ലാം പരീക്ഷണങ്ങളാണു മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നത്. നിഗൂഢതയുടെ ഈ കത്രിക പൂട്ട് ഭേദിച്ച് പുറത്ത് വരാൻ മിറാൻഡക്ക് സാധിക്കുമോ?

silly-hearts.title: Silly Hearts
silly-hearts.description: రిషి, రేణూ ఒక రిసార్ట్ లో ప్రపోజ్ చేసుకుని ఒక్కటవుతారు. ఆ నెక్స్ట్ డే నే రిషి గురించి అసలు నిజం తెలుస్తుంది రేణూకి. తన  బెస్ట్ ఫ్రెండ్ జానూతో ఎంగేజ్మెంట్ చేసుకున్న రిషిని అసహ్యించుకుని వెళ్ళిపోతుంది. కానీ, రిషి బ్లాక్మెయిల్ చేసి ఆమె తన ఆఫీసులోనే పనిచేసేలా చేస్తాడు.  ఈలోగా రేణూ ప్రెగ్నెంట్ అవుతుంది? తర్వాత ఏమైంది? అరవింద్ ఎవరు?ఊహించని మలుపులతో సాగిన స్టోరీ "సిల్లీ హార్ట్స్

the-secret-world-of-casinos-betting.title: The Secret World Of Casinos & Betting
the-secret-world-of-casinos-betting.description: Casinos and betting apps aren't powered by luck—they're powered by psychology. This investigative docu-drama uncovers how behavioral science, dopamine, game design, probability, and digital algorithms are used to keep players hooked. From the House Edge and Near-Miss Effect to online betting addiction and VIP manipulation, every episode exposes the hidden mechanics behind one of the world's biggest industries.

ramyavin-aavi.title: Ramyavin Aavi
ramyavin-aavi.description: திருச்சியில் ஒரு ஆண்டு காலமாக பூட்டியிருந்த பழமையான வீட்டில் நவீனின் குடும்பம் தங்குகிறார்கள். அங்கே அவர்களைத் தொடர்ந்து அமானுஷ்ய சம்பவங்கள் நேரிடத் தொடங்கும். ரம்யா எனும் பெண்ணின் ஆவி வழிகாட்ட, அந்தக் கொலையின் பின்னணியையும், உண்மையையும் அவர்கள் உடைத்து வெளிக்கொணர்கிறார்கள்.

ഭദ്രകാളി--ദ്രാവിഡ-ദേവത.title: ഭദ്രകാളി - ദ്രാവിഡ ദേവത
ഭദ്രകാളി--ദ്രാവിഡ-ദേവത.description: പുറത്തേക്ക് നീട്ടിയ നാവ്, ഒരു കൈയില്‍ രക്തമിറ്റുന്ന തല, കപാല മാല, മുറിച്ചെടുത്ത കൈകള്‍ തൂക്കിയിട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന അരക്കെട്ട്. ഭയാനകമായ ഈ രൂപത്തെ പൂജിക്കുന്നതിനു പിന്നിലും ഒരു രഹസ്യമുണ്ട്. നമ്മെ ഭയപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന രൂപത്തെ ആരാധിക്കുമ്പോള്‍ ഭയം അപ്രത്യക്ഷമാകും എന്നതാണത്.... ഭദ്രകാളി എന്ന ദേവതാസങ്കല്പത്തിൻ്റെ ഉത്പത്തിയും പരിണാമവും വിശ്വാസങ്ങളും പരിശോധിക്കാം.

where-do-thoughts-come-from.title: Where do thoughts come from?
where-do-thoughts-come-from.description: Are you the creator of your thoughts, or merely their observer? This thought-provoking series investigates the hidden forces behind the human mind—from memory and trauma to meditation, dreams, algorithms, and consciousness—to answer one timeless question: Who are we beyond our thoughts?

evandoi-srivaru.title: Evandoi Srivaru
evandoi-srivaru.description:
ఇది ఒక యువ దంపతుల మధ్య జరిగే సాదాసీదా ప్రేమకథ.
వారిద్దరి మధ్య ఉండే స్నేహం, పరస్పర అర్థం చేసుకోవడం, చిన్నచిన్న గొడవలపై ఆధారంగా ఉంటుంది.
పెళ్లి తర్వాత ప్రేమ ఎలా వికసించొచ్చో చూపించే హృదయానికి హత్తుకునే కథ.

astral-travel-beyond-the-body.title: Astral Travel: Beyond the Body
astral-travel-beyond-the-body.description: For thousands of years, mystics claimed the mind could leave the body. Today, science calls it an illusion. Between belief and evidence lies a mystery that could redefine what it means to be human.

shadows-of-terror.title: Shadows Of Terror
shadows-of-terror.description:
ఇది “షాడోస్ ఆఫ్ టెరర్” అనే ఆడియో షో.
ఆతంకవాదం వెనుక ఉన్న నిజాలు, బాధితుల కథలు ఇందులో వెలుగు చూస్తాయి.
మే 21 – జాతీయ ఆతంకవాద నిరోధక దినం నేపథ్యంలో రూపుదిద్దుకున్న శ్రద్ధాంజలిగా ఈ ప్రోగ్రాం నిలుస్తుంది.
దేశభక్తి, బాధ, పోరాటం – అన్నీ కలసిన మానవీయ గాధలుగా ఇది వినిపిస్తుంది.

kashmir-the-unfinished-peace.title: Kashmir The Unfinished Peace
kashmir-the-unfinished-peace.description: ఇది ఒక సత్య ఘటనల ఆధారిత శ్రేణి. స్వాతంత్య్రం తర్వాత కశ్మీర్ ఎలా యుద్ధభూమిగా మారింది, పుల్వామా దాడి నుండి ఆపరేషన్ సిందూర్ వరకు సంఘటనలు ఎలా పర్యవసానించాయి అనే విశ్లేషణను అందిస్తుంది. శాంతికి ఎదురుగా నిలిచిన చరిత్ర, రాజకీయాలు, మరియు ప్రజల త్యాగాల కథ ఇది.

why-indian-cities-are-making-people-lone.title: Why Indian Cities Are Making People Lonely
why-indian-cities-are-making-people-lone.description: Why do we feel lonely even when millions of people surround us? Follow a young professional as he navigates work, friendships, dating, family, independence and social life in an Indian metro city. From fading friendships and dating-app fatigue to living away from home and feeling invisible in a crowd, the show explores the hidden cost of urban life. Is the city making us lonely—or are we slowly losing the ability to connect?

telangana-movement-1.title: Telangana Movement
telangana-movement-1.description:
తెలంగాణ ఉద్యమం తెలంగాణ ప్రజల ఆత్మగౌరవానికి నిదర్శనం.
ప్రత్యేక రాష్ట్రంగా తెలంగాణ ఏర్పాటుకు విద్యార్థులు, ఉద్యోగులు, రైతులు పోరాటం చేశారు.
ఎన్నో త్యాగాల తరువాత 2014లో తెలంగాణ భారతదేశపు 29వ రాష్ట్రంగా అవతరించింది.

swatantra-yodhula-manasulo.title: Swatantra Yodhula Manasulo
swatantra-yodhula-manasulo.description:
ఈ ధారావాహికలో భగత్ సింగ్, సుభాష్ చంద్రబోస్, అల్లూరి సీతారామరాజు, చాకలి ఇలమ్మ, ఉధమ్ సింగ్, తిరుప్పూర్ కుమారన్ వంటి విప్లవ యోధుల నిజ జీవిత ఘట్టాలు, వారి భావోద్వేగాలు, పోరాట విశేషాలు చక్కగా గాథలుగా చెప్పబడతాయి.

గాంధీ మార్గం బయట కూడా ఎంతోమంది పోరాడారని గుర్తుచేసే ధైర్యకథల సంకలనం.

why-everyone-is-faking-success-online.title: Why Everyone Is Faking Success Online
why-everyone-is-faking-success-online.description: Everyone online seems successful. But how much of it is real? From rented luxury cars and fake lifestyle shoots to bought followers, paid authenticity and online gurus selling the dream of wealth, this show goes behind the perfect social media feed. Explore why we compare ourselves, chase validation and perform success—and how an entire economy has emerged around making people look richer, happier and more successful than they really are.

importance-of-family-structure-in-india.title: Importance Of Family Structure In India
importance-of-family-structure-in-india.description:
భారతదేశంలో కుటుంబ నిర్మాణం అనేది జీవన శైలికి మూలస్తంభం.
పెద్దల అనుభవం, చిన్నల ఆదరణ కలసి జీవన పాఠాలు నేర్పుతుంది.
ఒక్కదానికి మద్దతుగా నిలిచే కుటుంబ బంధాలు సాంస్కృతిక విలువలను నిలబెడతాయి.
ఈకకాల Individualism మధ్యా, భారతీయ కుటుంబం అనేది ఉమ్మడి జీవన చైతన్యానికి నిలయంగా ఉంది.

aatmabandhana-season-02.title: Aatmabandhana: Season 02
aatmabandhana-season-02.description: ಶಿವ ಮತ್ತು ಜಗ್ಗು ರಕ್ತಪಿಶಾಚಿ ದಿವಾಕರ್‌ ಚೌಧುರಿಯನ್ನ ಸೋಲಿಸಿ, ಮಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ದಂಡವನ್ನ ರಾಕ್ಷಸಲೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದ್ರು. ಶಿವ ಮಯೂರಿಯನ್ನ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೋಕ್ತವಾಗಿ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿ, ಜಗ್ಗು ಜೊತೆ ಪಟ್ಟಣ ಸೇರ್ಕೊಂಡ. ಅಂದುಕೊಂಡ ಹಾಗೆ ಸಿಟಿಲೀ ಶಿವನ ಜೊತೆ ಮಯೂರಿಯ ಹೊಸ ಜೀವನ ಶುರುವಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಮಯೂರಿ ತಾನು ರಕ್ತಪಿಶಾಚಿ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಮರೆತು, ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಮನುಷ್ಯಳಾಗಿ ಶಿವನ ಜೊತೆ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಳು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಬಂದ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳು ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೇ ಮುಗಿದಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ! ಶಿವ ಮಂತ್ರದಂಡದಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲ ದುಷ್ಟಶಕ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನ ರಾಕ್ಷಸಲೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವಾಗ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ ಕಲಶೇಶ ಕೂಡ ರಾಕ್ಷಸರ ಜೊತೆ ಬಂಧಿಯಾಗಿಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಂಧಿಯಾಗಿರೋ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ ಮತ್ತೆ ವಾಪಸ್‌ ಬರ್ತಾನಾ? ರಾಕ್ಷಸರಿಂದ ಶಿವ, ಜಗ್ಗು ಹಾಗೂ ಮಯೂರಿಗೆ ಎದುರಾಗೋ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟಗಳೇನು? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಮೂಡಿಸೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಹಾರರ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ನ ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್‌ ಸೀಸನ್‌ - "ಆತ್ಮಬಂಧನ: ಸೀಸನ್‌ 02" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

why-loneliness-is-destroying-this-genera.title: Why Loneliness Is Destroying This Generation
why-loneliness-is-destroying-this-genera.description: Why Loneliness Is Destroying This Generation explores the hidden psychology of modern loneliness, social media, relationships and emotional isolation. Why do we feel lonely even when we are constantly connected online? This show examines how digital life, changing relationships and lack of meaningful connection affect happiness, confidence and mental well-being—and reveals practical ways to build deeper relationships and a more connected life.

contract-husband.title: Contract Husband
contract-husband.description: വിവാഹദിനം തന്നെ വഞ്ചിച്ച് കടന്ന് കളഞ്ഞ വരനോടുളള വാശിക്കാണു കാവ്യ ഒരു ഡെലിവറി ബോയ് മാത്രമായ അമൽ രാജിനെ വിവാഹം ചെയ്യുന്നത്. രാജ് വെറുമൊരു സാധാരണക്കാരനല്ലാ മറിച്ച് അതിസമ്പന്ന്‌അമായ ഒരു കുടുംബത്തിൻ്റെ അവകാശിയാണെന്ന് അവൾ അറിയുന്നത് പിന്നീടാണു.  വെറുമൊരു വാശിപ്പുറത്ത് തുടങ്ങിയ ജീവിതം അനവധി പരീക്ഷണങ്ങളെ നേരിടുന്നതോടെ സത്യമായി പരിണമിക്കുന്നു. വെല്ലുവിളികളെ അതിജീവിക്കാൻ അവരുടെ പ്രണയത്തിനാകുമോ?

the-dark-side-of-the-mahabharata.title: The Dark Side Of The Mahabharata
the-dark-side-of-the-mahabharata.description: What if the characters of the Mahabharata were not simply heroes and villains? Explore the darker, more complex side of one of India's greatest epics through the stories of Draupadi, Karna, Duryodhana, Bhishma and Krishna. From injustice and ambition to loyalty, silence, power and controversial strategies, this series examines the moral dilemmas behind their choices. Was Duryodhana simply evil? Was Bhishma's silence duty or escape? Were Krishna's strategies justified?

majili.title: Majili
majili.description: జయ్ వీర్, లాస్య ప్రేమించి పెళ్లి చేసుకున్నా, కుటుంబం, సమాజం మధ్య అపోహలు, అపవాదాలతో వారి బంధం పరీక్షకు గురవుతుంది. ఈ జంట తమ ప్రేమని నిలబెట్టుకునేందుకు అనేక భావోద్వేగ సంఘర్షణలు ఎదుర్కొంటారు. వీరి ప్రేమ ఈ పరీక్షలను తట్టుకుని నిలుస్తుందా?

secret-boyfriend-season-02.title: Secret Boyfriend Season - 02
secret-boyfriend-season-02.description: ರೋಷನಿ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಿಯಕರನನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಲು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿಗೆ ತೆರಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆದರೆ, ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ವಂಚಕನೆಂಬುದನ್ನು ಅವಳು ಅರಿಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವನಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದಲ್ಲಿ, ಆಕೆ ಮತ್ತೊಬ್ಬನ ಜಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಹಾಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಇದು ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆಯಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ ಸಂಬಂಧಕ್ಕೆ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವರ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ, ಕೇವಲ KukuFM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

karna-the-greatest-tragic-hero.title: Karna: The Greatest Tragic Hero
karna-the-greatest-tragic-hero.description: Karna ki kahani sirf Mahabharata ki kahani nahi, balki identity, rejection, loyalty aur destiny ki ek powerful journey hai. Kunti ke pehle putra Karna ko janm se hi apmaan mila, lekin Duryodhana ki dosti ne use samman diya. Jab Krishna aur Kunti ne uske saamne rajgaddi aur apne asli parivaar ko chunne ka mauka rakha, Karna ne wafadari ko chuna. Karna vs Arjun aur Kurukshetra ka antim yudh uski tragic kahani ko amar bana deta hai.

iruvudellava-bittu-season-02.title: Iruvudellava Bittu: Season 02
iruvudellava-bittu-season-02.description: ಚಿಕ್ಕಂದಿನಿಂದಲೇ ತಂದೆ-ತಾಯಿಯನ್ನ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದ ನೈರಾ ಅನಾಥಾಶ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಹುಡುಗಿ. ತಾನು ಮನಸಾರೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿದ್ದ ಹೇಮಂತ್‌ ತನ್ನನ್ನ ಸ್ವಾರ್ಥಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ತಿಳಿದಾಗ ನೈರಾ ಮಾನಸಿಕವಾಗಿ ಕಳೆದು ಹೋಗಿದ್ದಳು! ಅನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಳೆದಿದ್ದ ಆರ್ಯನ್‌ ತನ್ನನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ ಅಂತ ಗೊತ್ತಾದಾಗ ನೈರಾ, ಹೇಮಂತ್‌ನಿಂದ ಡಿವೋರ್ಸ್‌ ಪಡೆದು ದೂರವಾಗಿದ್ದಳು. ಇನ್ನೇನು ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಸರಿ ಹೋಗ್ತಿದೆ, ಆರ್ಯನ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿ ಸೆಟಲ್‌ ಆಗಬಹುದು ಅನ್ನೋವರಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ, ಆರ್ಯನ್‌-ನೈರಾ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಮಿತಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರಿಕಾ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಸಾಲದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೇಮಂತ್‌ ಕೂಡ ವಿಘ್ನವಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ನೈರಾ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದೇನಾಗುತ್ತೆ? ಆರ್ಯನ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ನೈರಾ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಾ? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ರೋಮಾಂಚನ ಮೂಡಿಸೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ನ ಎರಡನೇ ಸೀಸನ್‌ - "ಇರುವುದೆಲ್ಲವ ಬಿಟ್ಟು: ಸೀಸನ್‌ 02" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

ninagoskara-season-02.title: Ninagoskara: Season 02
ninagoskara-season-02.description: ಸಂಜಯ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಹರ್ಷಿತಾ ಆದಿವಾಸಿಗಳ ಕಾಡಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ! ಸಿಟಿ ಜನರು ತಮ್ಮ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಬಂದಿರೋದು ಆದಿವಾಸಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಇಷ್ಟವಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೆ ಅನುಮಾನಾಸ್ಪದವಾಗಿ ಸಾವನ್ನಪ್ಪಿರೋ ಹರ್ಷಿತಾ ತಂದೆಯ ಸಾವಿನ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಆದಿವಾಸಿಗಳ ನಾಯಕನಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿದೆ. ಆ ರಹಸ್ಯವೇನು ಅಂತ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಹರ್ಷಿತಾಗಿದ್ರೆ, ಸಂಜಯ್‌ ತಮ್ಮ ಸಮರ್ಥ್‌ಗೆ ಆದಿವಾಸಿಗಳು ವಿಷ ನೀಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ! ತನ್ನ ತಮ್ಮನನ್ನ ಸಾವಿನ ದವಡೆಯಿಂದ ಪಾರು ಮಾಡೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾಡಲ್ಲಿರೋ ನಾಗ ಬೇರನ್ನ ಸಂಜಯ್‌ ಹುಡುಕಿ ತರಲೇಬೇಕು! ಆದಿವಾಸಿಗಳ ರಹಸ್ಯವೇನು? ಹರ್ಷಿತಾ ತನ್ನ ತಂದೆಯ ಸಾವಿನ ರಹಸ್ಯವನ್ನ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ತಾಳಾ? ಸಮರ್ಥ್‌ನನ್ನ ಬದುಕಿಸೋಕೆ ಸಂಜಯ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಹರ್ಷಿತಾ ನಾಗಬೇರನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ ತರ್ತಾರಾ? - ಹೀಗೆ ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವೀರೇಳಿಸೋ ಹತ್ತಾರು ಕುತೂಹಲಕಾರಿ ಟ್ವಿಸ್ಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ನ ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್‌ ಸೀಸನ್‌ "ನಿನಗೋಸ್ಕರ: ಸೀಸನ್‌ 02" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

paatal-lok-city-of-dwarfs.title: Paatal Lok : City Of Dwarfs
paatal-lok-city-of-dwarfs.description: When Inspector Abhay Singh investigates the mysterious disappearance of villagers in Jaisalmer, he discovers a hidden city buried beneath the desert - home to an advanced civilization of dwarfs. Trapped in their secret world, Abhay must earn the trust of Queen Kohinoor and help protect her kingdom from deadly threats. But when a devastating attack reveals a powerful enemy, Abhay and the Queen must unite to save the hidden kingdom.

no-1-aliya-season-02.title: No. 1 Aliya: Season 02
no-1-aliya-season-02.description: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಬಡಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದು ವಿಧಿಯಾಟದಿಂದ ಜಿಂದಾಲ್‌ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಅಳಿಯನಾಗಿದ್ದ ಅಜಯ್‌ನ ಕಥೆ ಮುಂದುವರೆಯುತ್ತೆ. ಅಜಯ್‌ ದೇಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಸತ್ತುಹೋಗಿದ್ದ ರೋಹನ್‌ ಎಂಬುವವನ ಆತ್ಮ ಸೇರಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದು, ಅದರಿಂದ ಅಜಯ್‌ಗೆ ಸೂಪರ್‌ ಪವರ್‌ಗಳು ಪ್ರಾಪ್ತಿಯಾಗಿವೆ. ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಹೊಸಕಿಹಾಕಲು ಜಿಂದಾಲ್‌ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಮಾಡೋ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕುತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನ ನಿರಾಯಾಸವಾಗಿ ಎದುರಿಸೋ ಅಜಯ್‌ಗೆ ಈಗ ಹೊಸ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟಗಳು ಎದುರಾಗಿವೆ. ಅಜಯ್‌ ದೇಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದ ರೋಹನ್‌ನ ಆತ್ಮ ಸದ್ಯ ಅಜಯ್‌ನಿಂದ ದೂರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಅಜಯ್‌ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂದಿರೋ ಜಾಹ್ನವಿ ಅಜಯ್‌ ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಪೂರಕವಾಗ್ತಾಳಾ? ಅಜಯ್‌ನ ಏಕಾಂಗಿ ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ರೋಹನ್‌ನ ಆತ್ಮ ಮತ್ತೆ ಸಾಥ್‌ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾ? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವೀರೇಳಿಸೋ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯದ ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್‌ ಸೀಸನ್‌ - ನಂ. 1 ಅಳಿಯ: ಸೀಸನ್‌ 02 ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

miss-mayavi-season-02.title: Miss Mayavi: Season 02
miss-mayavi-season-02.description: ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಯಾವಾಗ, ಹೇಗೆ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳೋದಕ್ಕಾಗಲ್ಲ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಜಯಂತ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ಪ್ರೂವ್‌ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರು! ಪುಟ್ಟದೊಂದು ಕಿತ್ತಾಟದಿಂದ ಶುರುವಾಗಿದ್ದ ಜಯಂತ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಸದ್ಯ ಮದುವೆವರೆಗೂ ಬಂದು ನಿಂತಿದೆ. ಅಂದುಕೊಂಡ ಹಾಗೆ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಜಯಂತ್‌-ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ಒಂದಾಗಿವೆ. ಇಷ್ಟೆಲ್ಲಾ ಆದ್ರೂ ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಇರೋ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಸಂಬಂಧಕ್ಕೆ ಏನಂತ ಹೆಸರಿಡಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಎರಡೂ ಜೀವಗಳೂ ಇನ್ನೂ ಕನ್ಫೂಷನ್‌ನಲ್ಲೇ ಇವೆ! ಇದೆಲ್ಲದರ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಪ್ರಿಯಾಳ ನಿಜವಾದ ಅಪ್ಪ ಮದುವೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಏನ್‌ ಹೇಳ್ತಾರೆ? ಪ್ರಿಯಾಳನ್ನ ಕೊಲ್ಲಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹೊಂಚು ಹಾಕ್ತಿರೋ ಸದಾನಂದನ ನೆಕ್ಸ್ಟ್ ಟಾರ್ಗೆಟ್‌ ಯಾರು? - ಹೀಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ಸಿಗದ ಹತ್ತಾರು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ನ ಸೆಕೆಂಡ್‌ ಸೀಸನ್ "ಮಿಸ್‌ ಮಾಯಾವಿ: ಸೀಸನ್‌ 02" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

grandfather-paradox-time-travel-theory.title: Grandfather Paradox: Time Travel Theory
grandfather-paradox-time-travel-theory.description: What if changing just one moment in the past could erase your own existence? Through the gripping story of a young scientist who accidentally unlocks time travel, this series explores the Grandfather Paradox and the mind-bending scientific theories that challenge everything we believe about time, destiny, and reality.

college-billionaire.title: College Billionaire
college-billionaire.description: அனாதையான ஏழை கல்லூரி மாணவரான ஆதவன், தனது பணக்கார சகாக்களால் தொடர்ந்து அவமானப்படுத்தப்படுகிறான். இந்த கஷ்டங்கள் இருந்தபோதிலும், ஆரம்பத்தில் தன்னை இழிவாகப் பார்க்கும் ஒரு பணக்கார மற்றும் பெருமைமிக்க பெண்ணான ரோஷினியை ரகசியமாக காதலிக்கிறான். இக்கதை ஆதவனின் பயணத்தை, அவமதிக்கப்பட்டு ஓரங்கட்டப்பட்டதிலிருந்து அதிகாரம், செல்வம் மற்றும் அந்தஸ்தில் உயர்வு வரை - அவரது தோற்றம் பற்றிய ஆழமான ரகசியங்களை அவிழ்ப்பது, துரோகங்களை எதிர்கொள்வது மற்றும் சிக்கலான காதல் இயக்கவியலில் பயணிப்பது ஆகியவற்றைக் காட்டுகிறது.

en-uyirai-kollum-thaensudarae.title: En Uyirai Kollum Thaensudarae
en-uyirai-kollum-thaensudarae.description: புதியதாக திருமணமான கதையின் நாயகி , தன் கணவரால் திருப்தி அடையவில்லை. தன் உடலின் பட்டாசையை தனித்து அணைக்க முடியாமல், அவள் தன் அயல்பக்கத்து இளைஞனுடன் காதல் தொடர்பில் ஈடுபட்டாள். ஆனால் அதற்கு அடுத்த நாளே அந்த இளைஞன் கொலை செய்யப்பட்டான். யார் இந்த கொலையாளி? ஒரு மனோநிலை சரியில்லாத கொலைக்காரனா? இல்லையெனில் இந்த குடியிருப்பில் புதிதாக வந்த அயல்பக்கத்தினா?

trial-by-media-johnny-vs-amber.title: Trial By Media: Johnny Vs Amber
trial-by-media-johnny-vs-amber.description: What happens when a courtroom becomes entertainment and public opinion becomes the loudest verdict? This is the story of the trial that captivated the world.

understanding-islam-its-original-spirit-.title: Understanding Islam: Its Original Spirit and Core Values
understanding-islam-its-original-spirit-.description: மௌலிக நூலான பரிசுத்தக் குர்ஆனை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டு, மதத்தின் உண்மையான ஆத்மாவையும் சாராம்சத்தையும் ஆராய்கிறது. இஸ்லாம் தன் உண்மைப் பயணத்திலிருந்து எவ்வளவு விலகி விட்டது என்பதையும் விவரிக்கிறது.

attachment-styles.title: Attachment Styles
attachment-styles.description: Why do we keep falling for the wrong people, fear being abandoned, or run away when love gets real? Through the science of Attachment Theory, this series reveals the hidden emotional patterns behind our relationships, and how to finally change them.

Delimination--தொகுதி-மறுசீரமைப்பு-என்றால.title: Delimination - தொகுதி மறுசீரமைப்பு என்றால் என்ன?
Delimination--தொகுதி-மறுசீரமைப்பு-என்றால.description: தொகுதி மறுசீரமைப்பு (Urban Redevelopment) என்பது, பழைய மற்றும் கெடுபிடித்த நகர்ப்புற பகுதிகளை புதுப்பித்து, அதன் பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூக முன்னேற்றத்தை மேம்படுத்தும் செயல்முறை. இதில், பழைய கட்டிடங்களை மாற்றி புதிய கட்டிடங்களை அமைத்தல், சேவைகள் மற்றும் பொதுவான அமைப்புகளை மேம்படுத்தல், மேலும் பொருளாதார வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் வேலைவாய்ப்புகளை அதிகரித்தல் ஆகியவை அடங்கும்.

teacher-i-love-you.title: Teacher I love you
teacher-i-love-you.description: பள்ளியின் டாப் மாணவனான சாய்க்கு புதிய மேக்ஸ் மிஸ்ஸாக வரும் மீனா மீது ஒரு க்ரஸ் உருவாகிறது. ஆனால் அது மெது மெதுவாய் காதலாய் மாறி, சாய் மீனாவை உயிருக்கு உயிராய் விரும்பினால்?

the-money-secrets-of-indian-businessmen.title: The Money Secrets Of Indian Businessmen
the-money-secrets-of-indian-businessmen.description: What separates empire builders from everyone else? From Dhirubhai Ambani and Ratan Tata to Narayana Murthy, Deepinder Goyal, Vijay Mallya, Harshad Mehta and more, this series uncovers the hidden decisions, risks, failures, comebacks and strategies behind India’s biggest business stories. Each episode is a gripping business thriller packed with lessons on money, power, leadership, ambition and survival in the real world.

ആറാട്ടുകടവ്-.title: ആറാട്ടുകടവ്
ആറാട്ടുകടവ്-.description: ഏറ്റുമാനൂർ ശിവകുമാർ എഴുതുന്ന അതീന്ദ്രിയ നോവൽ. അന്ധവിശ്വാസങ്ങളിൽ ആണ്ട് ജീവിക്കുന്ന വലിയവീട് തറവാട്ടിലെ ജീവിതങ്ങളിലൂടെ ഭ്രമാത്മകമായ ഒരു ലോകത്തേക്ക് ശിവകുമാറിൻ്റെ ഈ രചന നിങ്ങളെ നയിക്കുന്നു.

సునామి.title: సునామి
సునామి.description: దియా ఒక రైటర్. ఆమె చేతి నుండి బెస్ట్ సెల్లింగ్ రైటింగ్స్ వచ్చాయి.అలాంటి దియా, కొన్ని కారణాల వల్ల హర్ష అనే అబ్బాయిని లవ్ చేయాలని అనుకుంటుంది. ఈ ప్రాసెస్ లో ఆమె జీవితంలోకి అర్జున్ వస్తాడు? దాంతో ఆమె భయపడిపోతుంది? అర్జున్ కి దియాకి ఏమైనా సంబంధం ఉందా..? అసలు హర్షను ప్రేంఇంచాలని ఎందుకు అనుకుంఇద్? దాని వెనక ఏదైనా బలమైన కారణం ఉందా.? ప్రేమ వర్షంలా జనాలను తడపడమే కాదు, సునామీలా విధ్వంసం కూడా సృష్టిస్తుందని తెలిపే "సునామి" కథ వినండి మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.    Diya is a writer. Best-selling writings have come from her pen. A talented writer like Diya suddenly decides to fall in love with a guy named Harsha, for some reason. But during this process, a man named Arjun enters her life. His arrival scares her. Do Arjun and Diya share any connection? Why did she even decide to love Harsha in the first place? Is there a strong reason behind it?

wings-of-courage.title: Wings of Courage
wings-of-courage.description: Wings of Courage by Charu Malik and Anjali Nanavati is an inspiring collection of real-life stories of Indian women officers in the Indian Air Force. Through their journeys of determination, resilience, and leadership, the book highlights the challenges they overcame while breaking barriers and serving the nation. It is a powerful tribute to courage, perseverance, and the spirit of women in uniform.

maya-ips.title: Maya IPS
maya-ips.description: சட்டமே கண்டு பயப்படும் அதிரடி ஐபிஸ் ஆபிசர் மாயா. நீதியை நிலை நாட்ட தன்னால் முடிந்த அனைத்தையும் துணிச்சலாக செய்ய கூடிய நேர்மையான போலீஸ் அதிகாரி. அவளிடம் ஒருநாள் உதவி கேட்டு ரகசியமாக ஒரு பணக்கார வீட்டு பெண் வர, அவள் கூறும் விஷயங்களை கேட்டு அதிர்கிறாள் மாயா. அனைவர் கண்ணிலும் விரலை விட்டு ஆட்ட கூடிய மிக மோசமான கிரிமினல் சிண்டிகேட்டை தரைமட்டாக்கும் முயற்சியில் மாயா இறங்க, அவள் அதில் வெற்றிபெருவாளா இல்லை உயிரை விடுவாளா?

azhagiya-asuran.title: Azhagiya Asuran
azhagiya-asuran.description: தனது பெட் ரூமிலிருந்து hidden camera வை எடுக்கும் அமலா . திருமணமான ஒரு வருடத்திலேயே தன் அழகான கணவனின் நடத்தையில் மாற்றத்தை உணர்கிறாள் . அவனுடைய செயல்கள் சற்று வித்தியாசமாக, மர்மமாக இருக்கிறது.தன் கணவன் ரோஹித்தின் மறுமுகம் வெளிப்படுமா ? அமலா அதை கண்டு பிடிப்பாளா ?

vishnu-puran-kalyug-mein-kaise-jiyein.title: Vishnu Puran: Kalyug Mein Kaise Jiyein?
vishnu-puran-kalyug-mein-kaise-jiyein.description: Why do we have more wealth, technology and choices, yet feel less peaceful? Vishnu Puran offers timeless wisdom for modern problems like greed, ego, comparison, loneliness, attachment, social media addiction and moral decline. Explore ancient teachings on self-control, responsibility, character and inner peace—and discover how this timeless wisdom can help you live with greater clarity, purpose and balance in the modern age.

revolutionaries-the-other-story-of-how-i.title: Revolutionaries: The Other Story of How India Won Its Freedom
revolutionaries-the-other-story-of-how-i.description: ഇന്ത്യയുടെ സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യസമരത്തെ വിപ്ലവപരമായ കാഴ്‌ചകോണത്തിൽ നിന്ന് സമഗ്രമായി നിരീക്ഷിക്കുന്ന പുസ്തകം. തലമുറകളിൽ നിന്നും തലമുറകളിലേക്ക്   സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യസമരത്തിന്റെ പതാക എങ്ങനെ കൈമാറപ്പെട്ടു എന്നും, അവസാനം ബ്രിട്ടീഷുകാർ ഇന്ത്യ വിട്ടുപോകാൻ നിർബന്ധിതരാകേണ്ടി വന്ന കാരണം എന്താണെന്നും സഞ്ജീവ് സന്യാൽ ഈ  കൃതിയിൽ ആഴത്തിൽ വിശകലനം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

narasimha-mantra-fear-destroyer.title: Narasimha Mantra: Fear Destroyer
narasimha-mantra-fear-destroyer.description: What if the ancient story of Prahlad and Lord Narasimha could help you face modern fears? **Narasimha Mantra: Fear Destroyer** explores fear, anxiety, negative thoughts, helplessness, inner demons and pressure through timeless spiritual lessons. Discover how faith, courage, mindfulness and the mantra “Om Namo Bhagavate Narasimhaya” can help you find inner strength, calm your mind and face life's challenges with greater confidence.

my-husband-is-a-big-shot.title: My Husband Is A Big Shot
my-husband-is-a-big-shot.description: అనాథ, డబ్బులేనివాడని అందరూ చులకనగా చూసే జై దేవ్ రామ్ సడెన్ గా ఒక బిగ్ షాట్ అయ్యాడు. కోటీశ్వరుడు అయిన అతను అజ్ఞాతంలో  ఉండడానికి గల కారణమేంటి? ప్రేమ పెళ్లికి దూరంగా ఉన్న అతని జీవితం శ్రీనిధి రాకతో ఎలాంటి మలుపు తిరిగింది? తన హజ్బెండ్ నార్మల్ పర్సన్ కాదని తెలిసిన శ్రీనిధి నిర్ణయం ఏమై ఉంటుంది?

the-preassure-of-masculinity-and-sexual-.title: The Preassure Of Masculinity And Sexual Expectations
the-preassure-of-masculinity-and-sexual-.description:
ఈ సిరీస్ పురుషత్వంపై సమాజం కల్పించే అంచనాలు, లైంగిక ఒత్తిడులు ఎలా ప్రభావం చూపుతాయో విశ్లేషిస్తుంది.
భావోద్వేగ అణచివేత, తిరస్కరణ భయం, శక్తి డైనమిక్స్ వంటి అంశాలపై లోతైన దృష్టి అందిస్తుంది.
సెక్స్, ప్రేమ, అనుసంధానం—all consent మరియు కమ్యూనికేషన్ ఆధారంగా ఉంటాయని వివరిస్తుంది.
పురుషత్వాన్ని తిరిగి నిర్వచించాల్సిన అవసరాన్ని కలిగించే ఆలోచనాత్మకమైన రచన ఇది.

how-to-build-a-personal-brand.title: How To Build A Personal Brand
how-to-build-a-personal-brand.description: In today's digital world, being talented isn't enough—people need to know who you are. This series breaks down how ordinary people build powerful personal brands from scratch. Learn how algorithms work, why some creators grow while others disappear, how to create content people remember, and how trust turns into opportunities, clients, and income. Perfect for creators, professionals, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and students.

freedom-of-expression.title: Freedom Of Expression
freedom-of-expression.description:
అభిప్రాయ స్వేచ్ఛ అనేది ప్రతి మనిషికి లభించిన మౌలిక హక్కు, భావాలు, మాటలు, కళ ద్వారా స్వేచ్ఛగా వ్యక్తీకరించే శక్తి.
అయితే ఇటీవలి కాలంలో, ఈ స్వేచ్ఛను వ్యక్తిగత లాభాలకు, చుట్టుపక్కల విద్వేషాన్ని రెచ్చగొట్టేందుకు దుర్వినియోగం చేస్తున్నారు.
అదే సమయంలో, నిజమైన విమర్శలను అణిచివేసేందుకు అధికార శక్తులు అభిప్రాయ స్వేచ్ఛను గుదికి వేస్తున్నాయ్.
ఈ సమయాన, అభిప్రాయ స్వేచ్ఛను సమాజ భవితవ్యాన్ని తీర్చిదిద్దే పవిత్ర హక్కుగా రక్షించుకోవాల్సిన అవసరం ఉంది.

avanemba-maaye.title: Avanemba Maaye
avanemba-maaye.description:
"ಅವನೆಂಬ ಮಾಯೆ" ಒಂದು ಇಂಟೆನ್ಸ್ ಲವ್-ಡ್ರಾಮಾ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಕಥೆ. 
ನಿಶಾ – ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಂಪನಿಯ CEO, ಮೋಹಿತ್ – ಅವಳ ಬಾಡಿಗಾರ್ಡ್, ಅದರ ಜೊತೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಸೇಡುಗಾರ. ಡ್ರಗ್, ಮೋಸ, ಲೈಂಗಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡ ಹಾಗು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಕುಟಿಲ ನಿಯಮಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸಿಲುಕಿದ ಅವ್ರಿಬ್ಬರ ಪ್ರೆಮ ಕಥೆಯೇ  "ಅವನೆಂಬ ಮಾಯೆ" .
ಈ ತರಹದ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೇಳ್ತಾ ಇರಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್‌ ಎಮ್.‌

the-reality-of-indian-influencers.title: The Reality Of Indian Influencers
the-reality-of-indian-influencers.description: What is the real cost of India’s booming cyber cities? Explore the hidden reality of Bengaluru, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Pune and Noida—where high salaries and corporate success coexist with burnout, loneliness, money anxiety, EMIs, digital addiction and AI-driven job insecurity. Reality of India’s Cyber Cities uncovers the human cost behind India’s modern tech-driven dream.

guilty-pleasures-of-smart-people.title: Guilty Pleasures of Smart People
guilty-pleasures-of-smart-people.description: చురుకైన మనసులకు కూడా వారి స్వంత మృదు స్వభావాలు ఉంటాయి. రియాలిటీ టీవీని అతిగా చూడటం నుండి మీమ్స్ సంస్కృతిపై నిమగ్నమవ్వడం వరకు, తెలివైన వ్యక్తులు తరచుగా వారి తీవ్రమైన మేధో ప్రపంచాల నుండి విరామం ఇచ్చే సరళమైన, అనుభూతి-మంచి ఆనందాలలో మునిగిపోతారు. ఈ అపరాధ ఆనందాలు ఎవరైనా ఎంత తెలివైనవారైనా, తేలికైన ఆనందాలలోకి కొద్దిగా తప్పించుకోవడం మానవత్వంలో ఒక భాగమని వెల్లడిస్తాయి.

worlds-worst-jobs.title: World's Worst Jobs
worlds-worst-jobs.description: సాంప్రదాయ ఉద్యోగాలతో నిండిన ప్రపంచంలో, చాలా కాలంగా మరచిపోయిన లేదా నీడల్లో దాగి ఉన్న పని యొక్క చీకటి, వింత వైపు ఉంది. ది వరల్డ్స్ వర్స్ట్ జాబ్స్ చరిత్ర అంతటా ప్రజలు అనుభవించిన వింతైన, ప్రమాదకరమైన మరియు తరచుగా అసహ్యకరమైన వృత్తులలోకి లోతుగా ప్రవేశిస్తుంది. ఒంటె మూత్రాన్ని సేకరించేవారి నుండి బహిరంగంగా ఉరితీసే ప్రేక్షకుల వరకు మరియు వృత్తిపరమైన దుఃఖించేవారి నుండి సమాధి తవ్వేవారి వరకు, ఈ షో ఎవరూ కోరుకోని ఉద్యోగాలను చేపట్టిన వ్యక్తుల చెప్పలేని కథలను వెలికితీస్తుంది.

middle-class-se-crorepati.title: Middle Class Se Crorepati
middle-class-se-crorepati.description: Being born into a middle-class family doesn't define your financial future. Middle Class Se Crorepati uncovers the timeless business principles behind India's greatest entrepreneurs, including Dhirubhai Ambani, Narayana Murthy, Azim Premji, Verghese Kurien, and Karsanbhai Patel. Instead of simply telling their stories, the series explains the decisions, mindset, habits, and strategies that helped them build extraordinary success—and how listeners can apply those lessons to their own lives.

memories-together.title: Memories Together
memories-together.description:
నా పేరు మల్లాడి బ్రహ్మరాంబిక హరివల్లి. మాదో ఒక చిన్న కుటుంబం. అమ్మ కు పొదుపు ఎక్కువ, నాన్నకు క్రమశిక్షణ ఎక్కువ దాని వల్ల నాకు నా తమ్ముడుకు ఇంట్లో ఏది చెయ్యాలి అన్నా, భయం ఎక్కువ.
మాకు extortion అంటే తిరుపతి దేవాలయం, weekend పార్టిస్ అంటే గుడిలో ప్రవచనాలు వినడం. 
ఇక అది కాకుండా respected day కి, respected god దగ్గరకు వెళ్లి attendance.. అదే బ్లెస్సింగ్ తీసుకోవడం. 
మధ్యతరగతి కుటుంబం జ్ఞాపకాలు, కోపాలు, చిన్నతనంలో వచ్చే ప్రేమలేఖలు, దొంగతనంగా చూసే సినిమాలు. ఇలా మీరు కూడా వినాలి అనుకుంటే తప్పకుండా నా కథ వినండి.

gandhada-gudi.title: Gandhada Gudi
gandhada-gudi.description: ನಮ್ಮ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹಸಿರು ಸಿರಿಯ ಅಪೂರ್ವ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವನ್ಯಜೀವಿ ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ವಿಶೇಷತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಈ ಧಾರಾವಾಹಿ. ಡಾ. ರಾಜ್‌ಕುಮಾರ್ ಅವರ ಅಜರಾಮರ ಚಿತ್ರದ ಹೆಸರಿನಿಂದ ಪ್ರೇರಿತವಾದ "ಗಂಧದ ಗುಡಿ", ನಮ್ಮ ಅರಣ್ಯ ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು, ಪರಿಸರ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆಯ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿವಿಧ ಅರಣ್ಯಗಳ, ಅಭಯಾರಣ್ಯಗಳ ವಿಶೇಷತೆಗಳನ್ನು, ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ಜನಾಂಗಗಳ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿಯನ್ನು, ಮತ್ತು ನಮ್ಮ ಪರಿಸರ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಮನೋಹರವಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪರ್ವ. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಸರ ಕಾಳಜಿದಾರರಿಗೆ "ಗಂಧದ ಗುಡಿ" ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಕೊಡುಗೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್.ಎಂ ನಲ್ಲಿ "ಗಂಧದ ಗುಡಿ" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಶೋ.

yes-bank-when-success-became-greed.title: Yes Bank: When Success Became Greed
yes-bank-when-success-became-greed.description: Yes Bank ki kahani sirf success ki nahi, greed, ambition aur risky decisions ki bhi hai. Kaise Rana Kapoor ke leadership mein Yes Bank India ke fastest-growing private banks mein se ek bana, aur phir financial crisis ke edge tak pahunch gaya? Explore Yes Bank ka rise, aggressive lending, controversies, downfall aur rescue. Yeh show banking, money, business aur India ke biggest financial stories ko samajhne ka ek gripping journey hai.

luv-30.title: Luv 3.0
luv-30.description: கல்யாணத்தின் மீது நம்பிக்கை இல்லாத வேதா, பொழுது போக்காய் luv. 3.0 அப்படின்ற ஏ.ஐ பாய் ப்ரென்ட் ஆப் ஒன்றை பணம் கொடுத்து போனில் டவுன்லோட் செய்கிறாள். தன் கனவில் வரும் ரகசிய  காதலனை போலவே அதை டிசைன் பண்ணி தினமும் அதனுடன் பேசுகிறாள். ஆரம்பத்தில் சாதாரண  ஏ.ஐயாக இருக்கும் அந்த பாய் பிரண்ட் நாளைடைவில் உண்மையான மனிதன் போலவே நடந்து கொள்ள ஆரம்பித்தால்....... அது வேதாவுக்காக மற்றவர்களை கொல்லும் அளவுக்கு சென்றால்?

how-to-know-if-someone-is-emotionally-un.title: How to Know if Someone is Emotionally Unavailable
how-to-know-if-someone-is-emotionally-un.description: Why do we fall hardest for people who never let us get close? Through the story of Aarohi and Kabir, this series unpacks the psychology of emotional unavailability, revealing how childhood wounds, attachment styles, and the fear of vulnerability shape the way we love—and how healing begins when we stop chasing love and start understanding ourselves.

samurai.title: Samurai
samurai.description: ప్రాణాల పై నిర్లక్ష్యంతో నడిచే నాటకం... మనుషుల జీవితాలను రంగరించిన జాలిలేని దృష్టి... చీకటిని చీల్చగల ఒక సన్నని వెలుగు రేఖ...తెలియని ప్రమాదం వెనుక పరుగులెత్తిన సురేంద్ర, పలువురి ప్రాణాలను తీవ్ర ప్రమాదంలోకి నెట్టాడు. అతని స్వంత గ్యాంగ్‌లో ఉండి కూడా, వీరేంద్ర ఆ క్రూర ఆటను నిశ్శబ్దంగా అడ్డుకునే ప్రయత్నాల్లో తలమునకలై ఉన్నాడు. అనుమానపల్లి గ్రామ రక్షకుడైన రుద్రయ్య, సురేంద్ర ఆటలు పడుగా రావడంతో ఎవరికీ తెలియకుండా నీటిలో కరిగిన నీటిబొట్టులా మాయమయ్యాడు. సురేంద్ర ఆజ్ఞతో, ధర్మేంద్ర పల్లెలో విధ్వంసం సృష్టించి, ప్రతి మూలను మట్టి పాలు చేశాడు. ఈ గందరగోళంలో, రుద్రయ్య పిల్లలు చీకటి గుహలో దాగిన అపురూప వస్తువును చేజిక్కించుకున్నారు. తమ చేతుల్లో ఉన్న శక్తి ప్రపంచాన్నే మార్చగలదని వారికి తెలియదు... తెలియని వలలో చిక్కుకొని బయటపడాలన్న ఆరాటంతో ఉన్న అనుమలపల్లి జీవితగాథ....... మన కథకు మూలం....

handling-uncles-and-aunties-at-functions.title: Handling Uncles And Aunties At Functions
handling-uncles-and-aunties-at-functions.description: ఏం బాబు, ఏం చేస్తున్నావ్? అమ్మాయి పెళ్లి ఎప్పుడో? ఎంత సంపాదిస్తున్నావ్? ఇలాంటి ఇబ్బందికరమైన ప్రశ్నలు మీరు తరచుగా కుటుంబ సమావేశాల్లో ఎదుర్కొంటారా? అయితే, మా ఈ షో మీ కోసమే. ఈ అంకిల్స్ అండ్ ఆంటీలకు చక్కగా చెక్ పెట్టడం ఎలా అనేది తెలుసుకోవాలంటే, మా ఈ షో మీరు తప్పక వినాల్సింది!

how-apps-are-designed-to-addict-you.title: How Apps Are Designed To Addict You
how-apps-are-designed-to-addict-you.description: Why do you instinctively open Instagram, YouTube, or WhatsApp every time you unlock your phone? Is it just habit—or is it by design? How Apps Are Designed to Addict You is a documentary that explores the psychology, neuroscience, and business strategies behind today's most addictive digital platforms. Discover how notifications, infinite scroll, dopamine-driven rewards, and AI-powered algorithms compete for your attention, and learn how to take back control in the age of the attention economy.

సంఘర్షణ-.title: సంఘర్షణ
సంఘర్షణ-.description: నీడలా వెంటాడే గతం... తెలిసి తెలియని వయసులో చేసిన ఒకే ఒక తప్పు జీవితాంతం వెంటాడితే.... అది విధి ఆడే ఆట. లోకం తెలియని పసి వయసులోనే మరో పసిప్రాణానికి జన్మనిచ్చింది పవిత్ర. ఒకప్పటి తన తప్పుకు నిదర్శనంగా కన్న కొడుకు కళ్ళముందే ఉన్న తనే అతని తల్లిని అని చెప్పుకోలేని నిస్సహాయత ఆమెది.కిరీటి తన కన్న కొడుకు కాదు అని తెలియక ప్రాణాలు పెట్టి పెంచుకున్న ప్రేమ పద్మది.ఇన్నాళ్లు తనను పెంచిన వాళ్ళు తన కన్న తల్లిదండ్రులు కాదు అని తెలిస్తే కన్న ప్రేమకి పెంచిన ప్రేమకి మధ్య జరిగే సంఘర్షణ.... ఈ సంఘర్షణ.

evolution-of-digital-world.title: Evolution of Digital World
evolution-of-digital-world.description: ಇದು ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಯುಗ. ಮೊದಲು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಂತಿದ್ದ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್, ಈಗ ಸ್ಕೇಟಿನಂತೆ ಲ್ಯಾಪ್‌ಟಾಪ್ ಆಗುವಷ್ಟು ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಆಹಾರ, ಬಟ್ಟೆ, ಸಾಮಾಗ್ರಿಗಳು ಹೀಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ಲಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಗುವಷ್ಟು ಇಂದು ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಆಗೋಗಿದೆ‌. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾದ ಈ ಇನೋವೇಷನ್, ಯಾವ್ಯಾವ ಹಂತಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಏನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನ ತಂದಿತು? ಇದ್ರಿಂದ ಮಾನವನ‌ ಜೀವನದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆದ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಇದನ್ನೆಲ್ಲಾ ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'Evolution of Digital World' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

pitra-dosh-safalta-ka-adrishya-dushman.title: Pitra Dosh: Safalta Ka Adrishya Dushman
pitra-dosh-safalta-ka-adrishya-dushman.description: Is Pitra Dosh an unseen curse from our ancestors, or a reflection of the emotional and generational patterns we inherit? Blending Vedic wisdom, mythology, astrology, and psychology, this series uncovers one of Hinduism's most misunderstood beliefs—and what it truly means to honor our past while shaping a better future.

modern-day-dating.title: Modern Day Dating
modern-day-dating.description: ఈ రోజుల్లో డేటింగ్ అంటే ఏమిటి తెలుసా? ఫోన్ స్క్రీన్ల మధ్యలో ప్రాణాలు పోతున్న మనుషులు! ఒక్కరు ‘Hi’ అని మెసేజ్ పెట్టారు, మరొకరు దాని బదులుగా ‘Inbox Full’ అని చూపిస్తారు. ఇప్పటికీ ఎమోజీలు బాగా పాతపట్టినవి – ఎవరూ ‘Heart’ లేదా ‘Love’ అని పుస్తకాల్లో మాత్రమే వాడతారు, కానీ ఈ రోజు హార్ట్ పంపితే... ఏం చెప్పమంటారా? ఈ రోజుల్లోనూ “What’s up?” అని అడగగానే, “Nothing much” అని సరదాగా సమాధానం వస్తుంది, కానీ మనసులో అది “I’m busy” అని వ్రాయాలనుకుంటారు! సరే, ఇంకో ఎమోజీ ఇవ్వాలి – ఈ “Haha” పద్ధతిలో నవ్వు చూపించేందుకు..ఇందులో అంతగా అర్థం ఉండదు, కానీ మీ ఫోన్ టైం మీరు స్పెండ్ చేసేలా ఉంటుంది

accidental-marriage.title: Accidental Marriage
accidental-marriage.description: ആദ്യഭാര്യയുടെ ചതിയിൽ തലകുനിച്ചു ജീവിക്കേണ്ടി വന്ന ദേവ ഇനിയൊരുവളെ കണ്ണുമടച്ചു വിശ്വസിക്കില്ലാ എന്ന് നിശ്ഛയിച്ചതിനാൽ  ദുരിതങ്ങൾ സഹിക്കേണ്ടി വന്നത് ചാരുവിനായിരുന്നു. കാറ്റും കോളും നിറഞ്ഞ കടലിലെ കപ്പലിലെ നാവികനെപ്പോലെ ജീവിതത്തോണി ഒറ്റയ്ക്ക് തുഴയാൻ വിധിക്കപ്പെട്ട ചാരുവിൻ്റെ  കഥ.....

criminal-lawyer.title: Criminal Lawyer
criminal-lawyer.description: A famous criminal lawyer informs the police after a mysterious man asks him for a murder plan to kill a respected person in the city. The police try to stop the crime, but the murder still happens in a shocking way. As the investigation moves forward, secrets, betrayal, and hidden motives begin to come out. Soon, everyone is left asking the same question, who planned the murder, and who is the real killer?

randam-oozham.title: Randam Oozham
randam-oozham.description: A mysterious billionaire mafia king lives under a hidden identity until his wife betrays him and plans to marry another man. At the wedding, the "loser" everyone mocked is revealed as the most powerful man of all. As secrets, betrayal, and revenge collide, he fights to reclaim his honor, love, and empire, shaking everyone's world.

dhokebaazi.title: Dhokebaazi
dhokebaazi.description: This story follows Shiva, a humble dhaba worker whose life changes overnight when he discovers he is Abhimanyu Singhvi, heir to the powerful Mezia Group empire. Betrayed by love, hunted by enemies, and dragged into a deadly battle of media, politics, and underworld power, Shiva must rise from humiliation to become a fearless leader who protects his family, empire, and true love. Watch now.

commando-dhruv.title: Commando Dhruv
commando-dhruv.description: Dhruva’s story begins with him appearing as a calm mechanic, but it quickly becomes clear that he is hiding a far larger identity tied to power, duty, and old violence. He is revealed as the feared Panther, a decorated soldier, former ruler, and powerful CEO, which pulls him into conflicts far beyond the garage. Meghana and others urge him to return to service as the nation faces danger, but Dhruva repeatedly resists using power for himself and insists that money and resources should help terror victims instead. Even as he tries to stay detached, his past keeps catching up with him through accusations, grief, and unresolved deaths. A grieving woman blames him for her husband’s death, while others defend him and insist that the truth is more complicated. At home, Menaka and others challenge his place in the family, and the conflict grows into arguments over loyalty, children, and property. Dhruva eventually stands up to that pressure and ends the relationship with cold finality, turning a private wound into a legal and emotional break. The family dispute expands into demands over the house, car, factory, and other assets, with lawyers and papers replacing any hope of reconciliation. In parallel, romantic and social pressure keeps building around him, with Priya and others pushing marriage talk even when it is rejected. Ananya becomes another major force in the story, repeatedly defending her name and business against public humiliation and accusations that she was framed. She is accused of presenting a fake antique painting, but an employee’s confession suggests the blame may not be hers alone. Her conflict widens into a public dispute over an antique sword, which Dhruva identifies as a priceless royal heirloom and which is later confirmed as authentic and extremely valuable. That relic dispute ties Dhruva’s hidden authority to questions of ownership, history, and trust. Ananya also openly protects Dhruva, even offering to sacrifice her properties to save him when police interrogation threatens him. Her loyalty is matched by her own family pressure, as an uncle tries to control her marriage choice and she refuses to surrender her decision. The show keeps shifting between public scandal and private feeling, so every accusation becomes both a legal threat and a test of relationships. By the end of the batch, Dhruva’s identity, Ananya’s reputation, and the truth behind past deaths and property claims remain tightly entangled, while the story moves toward romance, accountability, and unresolved conflict.

small-business-big-profits.title: Small Business Big Profits
small-business-big-profits.description: Business Cheyalani Unda? kani ey business pettalo teliyatleda? aithe okasari ee ideas ni chudandi, chinna pettubadi tho pedda motham lo sampadhana.! ee profits chusthe meeru tappakunda eve business lu pedutharu....!

kahaani-mahayodha-ki.title: Kahaani Mahayodha Ki
kahaani-mahayodha-ki.description: The story centers on Bhuvan, an underdog son-in-law and martial trainee who is repeatedly humiliated for not fitting the family’s idea of strength. Around him, Manu and other husbands also chase respect, but public success only seems to invite more mockery from in-laws and rivals. Gauri remains Bhuvan’s strongest support, defending the marriage even when her father demands a divorce and violence follows. Bhuvan is pushed into a harsh promise to win a competition for Gauri’s father, and that promise becomes the engine of his struggle. He discovers that a mysterious power called Divya Kala is real, but it weakens him, drains his skill, and leaves him vulnerable to sabotage. A fake healer appears to be interfering, though the full manipulation is never fully resolved in the digests. As Bhuvan keeps failing in public tests, rivals and elders question whether he is worthy of honor, discipleship, or even basic respect. The gurukul thread raises the stakes beyond family shame, introducing rival gurus, hidden authority, and a search for the true heir to spiritual and martial legacy. Bhuvan’s hidden strength eventually surfaces, and he begins to win contests that once seemed impossible. Those victories do not end the conflict, because each success triggers new accusations, jealousy, and disputes over lineage and legitimacy. He is challenged for cheating, for his allegiance, and for the source of his power. In the middle of this turmoil, he defends a mocked mentor who is revealed to be the legendary Mahaguru Ashok Sahu. That revelation overturns the hierarchy and forces public confessions from false gurus. Bhuvan first resists authority, then realizes that public acceptance matters, and finally bows to be accepted as a disciple and heir. He is ultimately named chief of the gurukul, but the victory is fragile rather than final. The later household and village scenes show that status brings new dangers, not peace. Gauri’s possible pregnancy adds hope, yet Bhuvan becomes even more protective and keeps her away from threatening gatherings. At a landlord’s banquet, he is again treated as an outsider and ghar-jamai, and the insult turns into another confrontation over rank, identity, and honor. By the end, Bhuvan stands recognized but still under pressure, with family dignity, marriage, and authority all still at stake.

the-princess-is-destined-to-defeat-the-d.title: The Princess Is Destined to Defeat the Demon King
the-princess-is-destined-to-defeat-the-d.description: In a realm under tyrannical rule, a hidden heiress awakens her divine power, destined for vengeance. A Maharaj fiercely resists demands, but when his beloved is captured, a fierce struggle ignites. As divine heirs discover their true heritage and unite forces against sorcery and betrayal, their intertwined destinies converge. They prepare for a climactic battle to reclaim freedom and achieve ultimate justice.

tak-terkalahkan.title: Tak Terkalahkan
tak-terkalahkan.description: The story follows Cheng Jia and the Huo family as a martial tournament and clan war spiral into humiliation, betrayal, and revenge. At first, Cheng Jia shocks the arena with overwhelming skill, but his power comes at a cost because internal energy strains his heart and leaves him coughing. His special constitution and need for the Tiger Dragon Pill make his victories fragile and urgent. Around him, the Huo family is squeezed by outside rivals and by harsh internal control from Huo Tianxing, who repeatedly humiliates and confines his own heirs. Liu Yanyun becomes one of the clearest signs of that collapse, first as a favored heir and later as a public defector who turns against the Huo family and aligns with the Li side. Her betrayal deepens the sense that clan loyalty is breaking apart under pressure from the tournament and old grudges. The Li clan and other challengers use the Shenglong Tournament to press claims of dominance, while accusations of fraud, conspiracy, and hidden identity spread through the crowd. Several fighters are forced to reveal concealed strength, including secret techniques, rank tokens, and proof of true authority that overturn public humiliation. Cheng Jia is repeatedly pushed into conflict as both a disgraced heir and a protector, especially when family danger and revenge demands collide. His father and other elders often choose sacrifice or humiliation to keep younger family members alive. The conflict also widens beyond the arena into rescue missions, palace conspiracies, and attacks on family homes. A ruthless palace leader tortures captives, strengthens defectors with serum, and sends them back into battle, raising the cost of every confrontation. Meanwhile, the Huo family and its allies prepare brutal training and desperate counterattacks, knowing that survival may depend on a fatal final technique. Hidden lineage becomes another major stake, as Cheng Jia learns more about family ties, sworn martial bonds, and the dangerous history behind forbidden methods. The revelation of true masters and true identities repeatedly shifts power away from those who rely on humiliation and false claims. By the later episodes, the struggle is no longer only about honor or tournament rank, but about rescuing captives, protecting children, and surviving a war that keeps consuming families. The batch ends with multiple sides still locked in violent standoffs, with loyalty fractured and revenge still unresolved.

mahendra-jaalam.title: Mahendra Jaalam
mahendra-jaalam.description: After a fatal accident, a delivery boy is reincarnated as a weak scholar in an ancient village. Guided by a stylish genie, he must navigate a new life while married to a princess, a warrior, and a merchant’s daughter. Using modern knowledge and magical boons, he protects his home from bandits and corrupt soldiers. As he wins his wives' devotion, he transforms from a "mad bookworm" into a powerful, beloved ruler.

lee-the-one-man-army.title: Lee- The One Man Army
lee-the-one-man-army.description: Lee, a poor laborer, spends his life enduring humiliation while saving money to marry his girlfriend. A divine miracle suddenly grants him unimaginable strength, unknowingly making him the strongest man alive. As powerful tycoons, rivals, and opportunists seek to exploit his abilities, Lee's world is shattered by betrayal and danger. Forced to protect his loved ones, he embarks on an extraordinary journey from an overlooked worker to a legendary force capable of changing his destiny forever.

झुकब-ना-साला.title: झुकब ना साला
झुकब-ना-साला.description: अपन असली पहचान छुपवले एगो टैक्सी ड्राइवर अकेली माई आ ओकर बिटिया के रक्षा करेला। परिवार के राज, धोखा, दुश्मनी आ साजिशन के बीच ऊ आपन माई के कातिल के खोजे आ आपन प्रिय लोगन के बचावे खातिर जान लगा देला।

the-billionaire-waiter-she-dumped.title: The Billionaire Waiter She Dumped
the-billionaire-waiter-she-dumped.description: Five years after promising to marry Nihal, Arya returns from abroad and shocks everyone by choosing a wealthy business heir over the man who loved and supported her. Betrayed, humiliated, and underestimated, Nihal finally reveals his true identity as a billionaire heir and vows to make those who wronged him pay.

cinta-berlebih.title: Cinta Berlebih
cinta-berlebih.description: Seorang wanita modern tiba-tiba terlempar ke masa lalu dan terjebak dalam tubuh seorang wanita yang dikelilingi rahasia serta musuh berbahaya. Di tengah intrik istana, identitas tersembunyi, dan perebutan kekuasaan, ia jatuh cinta pada seorang pejuang terhormat. Saat rahasia kehidupan masa lalu dan rencana balas dendam mulai terungkap, ia harus memilih antara kembali ke dunianya atau menerima takdir baru demi cinta, keadilan, dan masa depan anak yang dikandungnya.

israel-vs-all.title: The Ghost Of Mossad
israel-vs-all.description: The show opens with Eli Cohen under his false identity, Kamel Amin Thabit, as betrayal closes in and he is forced to write a final letter before his arrest and execution. His farewell to Nadia gives his death the tone of sacrifice, and the story then widens into the larger history that shaped the conflict around him. It moves back through Nazi persecution, deportation, and genocide, then follows Jewish displacement toward Jerusalem and the end of British rule in Palestine. The UN partition plan and the struggle over Jerusalem ignite civil war, and the newly declared Jewish state is immediately attacked by surrounding Arab forces. Israel survives through scarce weapons, improvised defense, and operations that help break the siege of Jerusalem and secure key territory. In this early state-building phase, Mossad emerges as a secret shield against infiltration and hidden threats. The narrative then turns to regional escalation, including the Suez Crisis, where secret diplomacy and a covert alliance lead to an attack on Sinai before international pressure forces withdrawal. At the same time, the show suggests that strategic secrecy is becoming central to the state, from hidden industrial projects in South Israel to the suspected nuclear site at Dimona. Eli Cohen returns as a Mossad asset, living a double life and sending intelligence from Damascus that feeds Israeli military planning. The public trial of Adolf Eichmann brings Holocaust memory into open court and links past trauma to the politics of the present. As the conflict continues, Nasser’s regional challenge, retaliatory violence, and internal political blame deepen the sense that survival depends on secrecy as much as force. The later arc shifts into the long Israeli-Palestinian struggle, beginning with the First Intifada and the rise of Hamas as an organized armed movement. Palestinian statehood is declared and recognized by many, but rejected by Israel and the United States, leaving diplomacy and resistance locked in opposition. The Oslo process briefly raises hopes for self-rule, yet public backlash, violence, and the assassination of Yitzhak Rabin shatter momentum. Shimon Peres tries to carry the process forward, but hardline politics return with Netanyahu’s rise and repeated failures over territory, security, and Jerusalem. The Second Intifada erupts after another failed negotiation, and the conflict shifts from unrest to direct military confrontation. Covert action also intensifies, including a failed Mossad poisoning attempt against Khaled Mashal that turns into a hostage crisis and forces Israel to provide the antidote. Across the whole show, the stakes remain the same: national survival, contested legitimacy, and the cost of choosing between secrecy, retaliation, and peace.

toxic-couple.title: Toxic Couple
toxic-couple.description: Rohit and Manisha’s story begins as a marriage built on secrecy, because Manisha believes Rohit is only an ordinary delivery worker while he is actually hiding a major business identity. He tries to protect her and their relationship by keeping the truth buried, but that silence only deepens mistrust. Early tensions grow around pregnancy, a royal necklace, and Alina’s repeated pressure for Rohit to be honest. The marriage then breaks open over Manisha’s abortion, which Rohit experiences as betrayal while Manisha insists it was her own decision and tied to her future. Shashank becomes the main outside force in that conflict, helping Manisha professionally and becoming the person Rohit most resents. Family members, especially Manisha’s mother, often side with practical stability and career advancement, which leaves Rohit feeling excluded and judged. As the story continues, the couple’s private pain spills into public spaces through arguments, accusations, and humiliating social scenes. Rohit keeps trying to prove his worth with wealth, gifts, and eventually a public reveal of his founder status, but each attempt only exposes how badly the marriage has fractured. Manisha, meanwhile, is torn between dignity, ambition, and the damage caused by the lost child and the constant suspicion around her choices. The triangle with Shashank keeps the conflict alive, since he is alternately a supporter, rival, and symbol of the life Manisha might choose instead. Public events become battlegrounds where class prejudice, hidden identity, and loyalty are tested in front of everyone. Rohit is repeatedly mocked as a delivery boy until his true position as founder of Rapid Road Delivery is confirmed. Even after that reveal, the emotional damage between him and Manisha does not heal, because the core issue is trust rather than status. The marriage moves into divorce threats, separation pressure, and bitter arguments over money, property, and blame. Rohit eventually hardens into revenge, using corporate power and selection processes to turn the tables on those who dismissed him. The final stretch shifts from marital collapse into a larger corporate reckoning, with fraud accusations, evidence, and an arrest threat surrounding the public fallout. By the end, Manisha begs for forgiveness, but Rohit refuses reconciliation and leaves the relationship behind, turning toward a new future with Alina.

अरब-रूपया-रो-बवाल.title: अरब रूपया रो बवाल
अरब-रूपया-रो-बवाल.description:
Shalini aur Mukesh apni shadi ki saalgirh manawan khatir ek resort mai jaave hai pan Resort ri manager parul va donu ne Gareeb samjkar vaaki baijati kare hai or ghamand mai choor parul har had  paar kar deve hai or Shalini ne jaan su maarne ree koshish kare hai pan kismat ro khel bhi niralo hai jad sach saamne aave hai to ghamand kaai taakat bhi haar jaave hai
Jad parul ne Shalini ri asliyat ro pato laagsi to parul kaai karsi, kaai parul ne karma ro hisaab milsi?

breakup-ke-baad.title: Breakup ke Baad
breakup-ke-baad.description: Rahul’s life takes an unbelievable turn when he inherits a ₹500 crore fortune but only if he fulfills an unusual condition: live in a luxurious palace with five stunning women for a month without succumbing to temptation. As attraction, manipulation, hidden agendas, and the return of his former love push him to his limits, Rahul finds himself trapped in a dangerous emotional game where every decision could cost him his inheritance or reveal who he truly is.

boss-will-you-love-me.title: Boss, Will You Love Me?
boss-will-you-love-me.description: Neeraj, A billionaire CEO hides in plain sight as a humble nobody to secretly fund his ex-girlfriend’s rise to the top. But when she cruelly mocks him as a 'loser' and his greatest enemy steps into her life, he must choose: reveal his true power to destroy them, or let his identity die to keep her safe. The clock is ticking—how far will he go before his mask falls off?

pehli-nazar-ka-pyaar.title: Pehli Nazar Ka Pyaar
pehli-nazar-ka-pyaar.description: After being betrayed by her family and boyfriend, a desperate young woman agrees to a contract marriage with a humble bus conductor—only to discover that he is actually a powerful billionaire in disguise, whose hidden truth will change her life forever.

beeda-badshah.title: Beeda Badshah
beeda-badshah.description: To escape an arranged marriage, billionaire Akshay hides as a beeda seller, but his fake poor identity traps him in a contract marriage with Pallavi, a betrayed heiress hiding her own power. What starts as revenge against her ex becomes a double-identity love game, where the people who insulted them finally see their real status.

kalaavida-king-of-3-hearts.title: Kalaavida - King of 3 Hearts
kalaavida-king-of-3-hearts.description: Puneeth, a humble delivery worker, discovers a magical lamp and is transported to a strange kingdom where he is destined to marry three powerful women. Guided by a magical game that rewards love with wishes, he uses modern knowledge, magic, and courage to overcome enemies, rescue loved ones, defeat the feared dacoit Ugrasen, and become king. With his kingdom secured, Mahendra’s greatest challenge becomes winning the hearts of his three queens and balancing love, power, and destiny.

ishq-ka-rang-laal.title: Ishq ka Rang Laal
ishq-ka-rang-laal.description: In a world where vampires secretly and peacefully live among human beings, a love story between two vampires plays a crucial role in deciding the fate of humanity, and its long standing peace with vampires. The married couple has a breakup only to reconnect with each other years later, while they are being pursued by other lovers - who have major ulterior motives.

my-dads-secret-empire.title: My Dad's Secret Empire
my-dads-secret-empire.description: A devoted father, Raj, is humiliated for his modest life until the shocking truth reveals he is actually Prince Singhai, a powerful business tycoon. As he secretly supports his wife Latika’s success while hiding his identity, betrayal, ego, and love collide, pushing their relationship to the edge of divorce.

rajputana-ka-rakshak-veer-durgadas-ratho.title: Rajputana Ka Rakshak - Veer Durgadas Rathore
rajputana-ka-rakshak-veer-durgadas-ratho.description: Rajputana Ka Rakshak - Veer Durgadas Rathore

triangle-love-story.title: Triangle Love Story
triangle-love-story.description: மனைவியும் குடும்பத்தினரும் பயனற்றவன் என்று அவமானப்படுத்தி வெளியேற்றிய ஒருவன், உண்மையில் ஒரு சக்திவாய்ந்த ரகசிய CEO. துரோகம் மற்றும் அவமதிப்பால் சிதைந்த அவன், தனது உண்மையான அடையாளத்தை மறைத்தபடி மீண்டும் வெற்றியின் உச்சிக்குச் செல்கிறான். அவனைச் சுற்றியுள்ள பொய்கள், குடும்ப ரகசியங்கள் மற்றும் தவறான புரிதல்கள் வெளிவரும்போது, தன்னை நிராகரித்த காதலை மீண்டும் ஏற்கலாமா அல்லது அனைத்தையும் பின்னால் விட்டுவிட்டு முன்னேறலாமா என்ற முடிவை எடுக்க வேண்டிய நிலை உருவாகிறது.

code-of-revenge.title: CODE OF REVENGE
code-of-revenge.description: When billionaire tech tycoon Dhruv Makhija falls for his secretary Rumi Rathod, he has no idea she is the legendary AI prodigy “Miss Spark.” But their romance is torn apart by manipulation, betrayal, and Dhruv’s forced engagement to the ruthless Mita. Pregnant and heartbroken, Rumi vanishes—only to return as a powerful business empress, ready to expose the truth, reclaim her identity, and secure her child’s future.

husband-or-boyfriend.title: Husband or Boyfriend?
husband-or-boyfriend.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, a man is mocked as useless, unaware to them that he is actually a powerful hidden CEO. Betrayed and humiliated, he begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel. Once his true identity is revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

return-of-ultimate-sons.title: Return of ultimate Sons
return-of-ultimate-sons.description: Years after being disowned for marrying against his father’s wishes, Shekhar returns home for his father’s 70th birthday. Mocked as a failure by his family, he endures relentless humiliation while his wealthy sisters flaunt their success. But when a mysterious gift from his eldest son turns out to be worth a fortune, long-buried truths begin to surface, exposing greed, betrayal, and the real status of the man everyone looked down on.

return-of-shoorveer.title: Return of Shoorveer
return-of-shoorveer.description: The story opens with a mythic hint of an old warrior legacy and a divine weapon, then moves into a modern world where merit and hidden power collide. Tanvi enters an elite college as a scholarship student and tries to live by discipline and caution, guided by her father’s insistence on dignity. Very quickly, she becomes a target for privileged students and the families behind them, and the bullying grows from insults into physical assault and public humiliation. Her phone is broken, she is isolated from help, and the people with authority around her repeatedly protect status instead of truth. Tanvi’s father keeps arriving to demand justice, but he is met with delay, threats, and intimidation from college officials and powerful trustees. The conflict deepens when Tanvi is pressured to confess, shamed before guards and wealthy men, and forced into pleading for her father’s safety. Across these confrontations, Surya emerges as a central protective force, refusing to accept humiliation or empty apologies. He is first shown trying to avoid violence, but the repeated attacks on Tanvi push him back into open conflict. The story then escalates into abduction, with Tanvi trapped in a hidden room and her family scrambling to find her. Surya leads the rescue, while allies trace her phone and locate the place where she is being held. Even after she is found, the danger does not end, because Tanvi is injured and the men around her continue to treat her as leverage in a larger power game. Powerful figures claim she is being offered as a gift to their master, but her father rejects that language and insists she is his daughter, not property. From there, the plot widens into disputes over business, alliances, and territorial control, with East State Master, Sultan, Janardhan, and Karthik all drawn into the struggle. Public gatherings collapse into confrontations, and rumors of death, return, and hidden weapons make the conflict feel like an old war resurfacing. Revenge becomes a driving force as mercy is refused, apologies are rejected, and retaliation is promised again and again. By the later stretch, Surya and Shuraveera stand as avengers who will not back down, while Tanvi remains the emotional center of the conflict as the person everyone claims to protect or control. The stakes are no longer only college discipline or family pride, but survival, dignity, and the right of a father to keep his daughter safe against wealth, force, and betrayal.

last-avenger-2.title: Last Avenger
last-avenger-2.description: Aarav Verma was once a helpless young man, mocked as a "madman" after his family's tragic downfall. But a divine intervention sent his soul to Amarlok, where he trained under mystical fairies to become a powerful warrior. He returned to Earth with a secret mission: recover three lost celestial weapons and avenge his parents.

surprise-wali-shadi.title: Surprise Wali Shadi
surprise-wali-shadi.description: The story begins with a street-level rescue that sets the tone for everything that follows: a young woman is cornered by threatening men, and a humble pani puri vendor steps in to fight them off. That act of protection draws attention to a man who seems ordinary on the surface but is tied to hidden identity, family duty, and a life larger than his public image. His daughter pushes him toward love and a new future, while women from very different worlds begin to orbit him through dates, apologies, proposals, and workplace conflict. At the same time, the romance is never simple, because class difference, age, and family pride keep turning affection into public embarrassment. A woman who was saved by him vows to find him and even trains in self-defense, showing that the rescue changes her life as much as his. In the corporate world, his sudden rise triggers suspicion, and people repeatedly question how someone from his background could gain status so quickly. Support from powerful women helps him at times, but it also creates backlash, especially when his dignity is challenged in front of others. Engagement plans and relationship promises collapse under humiliation, and one major romance breaks apart after betrayal and a failed apology. The family conflict deepens when a secret marriage is revealed, forcing a wealthy father to confront the man his daughter chose. He rejects the match, tries to buy the husband off, and even turns to force, but the couple keeps standing together. Public gatherings become battlegrounds where classmates, relatives, and business rivals mock his low status and accuse him of deception. The story then widens into a scandal around the Fire Red Diamond, which becomes a symbol of truth, loyalty, and control. He is accused of theft, but the accusation is challenged when someone insists the diamond was given to him legitimately. Corporate corruption is exposed alongside the diamond dispute, and a senior figure is dismissed after misuse of funds comes to light. Even when he is mocked again, he calmly reveals hidden wealth and power, shocking those who judged him. By the later stretch, business negotiations, family approval, and romantic loyalty all collide in the same struggle. The final movement centers on public confession and a proposal, turning corporate alliance into a test of trust, identity, and whether love can survive status games and hidden truths.

झाडूवालो-करोड़पति.title: झाडूवालो करोड़पति
झाडूवालो-करोड़पति.description:
ek ameer businessman Neel apni asli pehchan chupakar ek safaiwalo ban jaave hai, jathe uski mulakaat Snehal su hove hai. Halaat un donu ne ek shadi ke bandhan mai bandh deve hai, lekin jhuth aur raaj re bich dhire-dhire un donu mai saccho pyaar panapne laag jaave hai.
pan samjhota ro o khel ki modd par jaasi jad neel ri asliyat saamne aaveli to unka Rishta ri asli parisksha shuru hosi – kaai unko pyaar har mushkil ro samno kar pavego?

dil-bole-mr-oberoi.title: Dil bole Mr. Oberoi
dil-bole-mr-oberoi.description: Desperate Mytasha is accidentally auctioned at an adult show, rescued by billionaire Ranveer Oberoi — who buys her for ₹10 crore and makes her his contractual assistant. A decades-old family pact forces them into a marriage of convenience, while her vengeful ex Vikram schemes to destroy them both. Through power struggles, danger, and undeniable pull, their cold contract slowly becomes something neither planned — love.

-एक-अनजानो-ब्याव.title: एक अनजानो ब्याव
-एक-अनजानो-ब्याव.description:
Ek Anjaano Byaav – jo Suhani or arjun ri kahani hai, Suhani ek simple si ladki hai aur Arjun ek crorepati businessmen, pan dono ri Zindagi uljhi hui hai, kahani ek nayo modd leve hai jad Suhani, Arjun ri personal assistant bane hai 
Lekin kismat ro khel aiso hove hai ki ateet or vartmaan aapas mai takrave hai or Arjun re sath Suhani ro rishto aur gehro ho jaave hai
Pyaar, aur Galatfehmiya su bhari aa kahani jathe – rishta apna anjaam tak pahuch si yaa pher sab kuch uljhan mai hi bikhar jaasi?

kashmir-ka-sunehra-daur-samrat-lalitadit.title: Kashmir Ka Sunehra Daur: Samrat Lalitaditya
kashmir-ka-sunehra-daur-samrat-lalitadit.description: Kashmir Ka Sunehra Daur: Samrat Lalitaditya

अनजान-सेठ-री-बिटिया.title: अनजान सेठ री बिटिया
अनजान-सेठ-री-बिटिया.description: The story follows a tangled struggle where romance, family honor, and corporate power keep colliding. It opens with violence, rescues, and criminal-linked alliances that hint at a much larger conspiracy around business and status. A dating-app setup and a humiliating blind date expose how easily wealth and identity are used as weapons. Rishi is repeatedly pulled into these conflicts, first as a man judged by class and later as someone whose private life becomes public leverage. Ashna and other powerful women repeatedly reshape the balance of power by defending him, challenging rivals, or revealing their own authority. In one turn, a sudden marriage changes the social order and shocks those around it. In another, workplace promotions and public exposure are used to punish or reward loyalty, making romance inseparable from corporate advancement. Alia is humiliated, then defended, then drawn into elite acceptance, showing how quickly status can be reversed. Arjun’s rise in the company gives him confidence to reject and shame others, but his emotional history with Alia remains unresolved. Priya and other rivals keep the pressure on, using corporate influence and public scenes to deepen the conflict. The Fire Red Diamond becomes a major symbol of accusation, ownership, and corruption, pulling family and business factions into the same fight. As accusations spread, husbands, fathers, and company leaders all try to control the narrative and protect their standing. Rishi is caught in the middle of these disputes, sometimes accused, sometimes defended, and sometimes revealed as stronger than others expected. The marriage plots do not settle the conflict; instead, they intensify suspicion, jealousy, and class resentment. Public gatherings, reunions, and corporate meetings repeatedly become stages for humiliation and reversal. By the end of the batch, the central stakes remain unresolved: love must survive social judgment, and business power must survive betrayal and scandal.

डाॅक्टर-बनाम-अरबपति-.title: डाॅक्टर बनाम अरबपति
डाॅक्टर-बनाम-अरबपति-.description:
Ek kahani jathe pisha aur insaniyat aamne saamne khadya hai. Doctor banam arabpati ek sangharsh ri daastaan hai jad imaandaar Doctor ko samno ameer or laalchi loga su hove hai. 
Jad seva aur doulat ri takkar hove hai to Zindagi or maut ke bich jhul rahi ek Masoom bachi ri zindagi daav par laag jave hai. Lekin kismat or karm ro khel bhi niralo hai jad sach saamne aave hai to taakat bhi nyaay ke aage jhukne par majboor ho jave hai.

never-show-your-aces.title: Ikka Number Paanch
never-show-your-aces.description: Young guy, who is a master of card games, reunites with his family who had discarded him years ago - and goes on to save them and their casino.
