There are multiple games involving card tricks, gambling themes where stakes are the highest - and our hero overcomes obstacles and wins them one by one.

प्रीत-री-आस.title: प्रीत री आस
प्रीत-री-आस.description:
Aaditya singhaniya – Ek businessman pan Zindagi mai akelo hai aur Ruhi ek mehnati or sachi aurat hai jiko ziwan tuto hoyo rishta aur taklifa su bharyo hai lekin ek din Aaditya aur Ruhi ri mulakaat ek choti si vajah su hove hai pan dhire-dhire aa mulakaat ek Rishta ri kahani ban jaave hai. 
ee safar mai prem hi koni Ruhi ne mill jaave hai khoyo huyo ateet.

chhota-aryan.title: Chhota Aryan
chhota-aryan.description: When a young genius travels back in time, he gets a second chance to rewrite his family's destiny. Using his future knowledge, he helps his struggling father become rich, takes revenge on those who looked down on them including his Betraying Mother, and secretly plays cupid between his father and a beautiful CEO.

आखिरी-धणी.title: आखिरी धणी
आखिरी-धणी.description: Aapni hi family su dhokho khayi Sunaina ri Zindagi jad badal jaave hai jad Shashvat – ek sadharan so dikhne walo aadmi, jike paas ek bado secret chhupyo hai – Sunaina ro sath deve hai. Jyaan – jyaan lalach, jhoot aur chupyo hoyo sach saamne aave hai, pyaar, samman aur badala ro ek gehro khel shuru ho jaave hai.

1-lakh-monthly-social-media-trend.title: ₹1 Lakh Monthly Social Media Trend
1-lakh-monthly-social-media-trend.description: Social Media tho Nelaki laksha rupayalu sampadinchachu anedi meeku telusa ? avunu nenu chepedi nijame..! ee kalam lo andharu alane chesthunnaaru so meeru kuda ela start cheyalo telusukovalante idi chudandi...!

surrogate-to-soulmate.title: Surrogate to Soulmate
surrogate-to-soulmate.description: A broke medical student, Isha, becomes billionaire Vivaan's surrogate to fund her father's surgery. What starts as a cold contract slowly becomes love, even as Vivaan's scheming ex-fiancée Priya fakes a pregnancy to reclaim him. After brutal humiliation from his family and society, Priya's lies are publicly exposed at a press conference, and Vivaan proposes to Isha — sealing their love with the birth of their daughter.

स्वाद-रो-सरताज.title: स्वाद रो सरताज
स्वाद-रो-सरताज.description: Swaad Ro Sartaj - Duniya ro sabse mashhoor Master Chef achanak gayab ho jaave hai or  Ek saal baad, wo ek saado rasoiyo ban ke saamne aave hai, pan koi ni jaane ke uski asli pehchaan kai hai. Jyun-jyun pyaar, dhokho ar khatarnak saajishaan usne gherba laage hai, ek sawaal sabne pareshan kare hai - akhir yo gumnam rasoiyo kun hai, ar wo duniya su kyu chup kar baithyo hai?

rani-rajulmati-ki-amar-prem-kahani.title: Rani Rajulmati Ki Amar Prem Kahani
rani-rajulmati-ki-amar-prem-kahani.description: Rani Rajulmati Ki Amar Prem Kahani

नकली-यारसाचो-प्यार.title: नकली यार-साचो प्यार
नकली-यारसाचो-प्यार.description:
Fake boyfriend – blind date par devansh ne sabke samane Gareeb bolkar beijjat kariyo jave hai pan kismat ro khel dekho – akriti jo pariwaar or majboori bich fasi bine 5 lakh mahina mai khud ro “Nakli boyfriend” ban ne ro offer deve hai aur Devansh bhi maan jaave hai
Pan asal khel to jad shuru hove hai…jad Devansh ro sach sabke saamne aave hai 
Raaj, dhokho aur prem ro yo khel… jo pyaar or sach ke saamne sab ne haarva ne majboor kar deve hai.

hidden-tycoon.title: Hidden Tycoon
hidden-tycoon.description: Darshan, a humble repairman with a secret billionaire identity, unexpectedly helps a female CEO survive a corporate crisis.To repay him, she pretends to be his son’s stepmother—setting off a chain of misunderstandings and emotional conflict.When Darshan reveals his true power at his son’s banquet, disbelief turns to shock as the truth finally comes to light.

mrs-golddigger-2.title: Mrs. Golddigger
mrs-golddigger-2.description: After a rushed marriage to a stranger who demands ₹1 crore, a powerful CEO is convinced he’s been trapped by a gold digger—until his growing feelings and a haunting past force him to question if the woman he distrusts is actually the one who once saved his life.

unsubscribed-from-your-love.title: Unsubscribed From Your Love
unsubscribed-from-your-love.description: Rani Singh Rajora sacrificed her empire, identity, and power to make Aman Kumar successful, only to be betrayed and replaced by his younger mistress. But when Aman mistakes her silence for weakness, he awakens the hidden heiress and mastermind behind his empire. As love turns to revenge, Rani doesn't just leave—she destroys the man who forgot her worth. This isn't a heartbreak story; it's a powerful reclamation.

rickshawkaran-rani.title: Rickshawkaran Rani
rickshawkaran-rani.description:
A runaway bride with a gun. A rickshaw driver fleeing dangerous goons. One chaotic collision in the crowded streets of Lucknow pulls two complete strangers into each other's lives in the most unexpected way.
With secrets on both sides, mistaken identities, and trouble at every turn, their worlds keep colliding — whether they like it or not.
This is a story of two misfits, one mad city, and the chaos that secretly looks a lot like love.

builder-billionaire.title: Builder Billionaire
builder-billionaire.description:
**BHIKHARI BILLIONAIRE**

The city's richest billionaire hides as a roadside beggar after a deadly conspiracy. Only one person treats him with love — Siddhi, a salesgirl who feeds him daily. When her fiancé betrays her with her own cousin, Viraat offers a fake marriage to save her family's honour. Insults, makeovers, jealous exes and shocking power reversals follow  until his true identity explodes. Now money can buy everything… except her forgiveness.

bhikshuka-to-boss.title: Bhikshuka to Boss
bhikshuka-to-boss.description: A billionaire hiding as a street beggar to escape an arranged marriage accidentally weds a selfless woman who vows to support her "penniless" husband — not kno…A billionaire hiding as a street beggar to escape an arranged marriage accidentally weds a selfless woman who vows to support her "penniless" husband — not knowing she's already married the richest man in the city.

bhairanpally-massacre-the-hidden-jallian.title: Bhairanpally Massacre-The Hidden Jallianwala Bagh
bhairanpally-massacre-the-hidden-jallian.description: ఈ ఊచకోతను 'మరో జలియన్‌వాలా బాగ్' అని ఎందుకు పిలుస్తారో తెలుసా? దేశ స్వాతంత్ర్యం కోసం కాదు... తమ స్వేచ్ఛ కోసం, తమ గౌరవం కోసం తిరుగుబాటు చేసిన రైతుల గాథ ఇది. అధికారానికి ఎదురు నిలిచిన ఆ ధైర్యవంతుల రక్తంతో నేల ఎర్రబడింది. ఒకప్పుడు నీడనిచ్చిన ఆ మర్రిచెట్టు... చివరికి వారి ఉరితాడుల సాక్షిగా మారింది!

mera-chhupa-rustam-saiyyan.title: Miss CEO fell for Mr. electrician
mera-chhupa-rustam-saiyyan.description: Aaradhya Rajvanshi begins as a wealthy heiress whose life is immediately shaken by public danger, class conflict, and the burden of her family name. A mysterious rescuer, Arjun, saves her, but their first encounters are charged with suspicion because he knows who she is and seems tied to revenge against her father. Even as the story moves into corporate spaces, Aaradhya is shown as principled and authoritative, defending workers from humiliation and insisting on dignity over status. Around her, accusations about a father’s killer, inherited grudges, and hidden records suggest that the family feud is rooted in something much older than the present conflict. Arjun’s role grows from outsider to investigator, and the possibility that he is not what he first appears to be keeps both romance and danger alive. The relationship between Aaradhya and Arjun shifts into a marriage of convenience or forced alliance, but the arrangement does not settle the tension; instead, it deepens mistrust while also allowing attraction to surface. Corporate intrigue expands the conflict through forged signatures, shell transactions, insurance fraud, and a hidden file that may expose the real mastermind. As the Rajvanshi family’s fortunes collapse, Aaradhya loses money, home, and engagement, while her father’s critical illness raises the emotional stakes. Mysterious benefactors, shelter, and hospital support keep her from falling completely, but every rescue seems to come with another layer of secrecy. The family’s downfall becomes public through an auction of heirlooms and even a sealed safe, turning private grief into spectacle. Rival figures such as Ishita, Raghav, Gaurav, and others push the conflict toward control, humiliation, and revenge, while Arjun remains a guarded protector whose motives are never fully simple. Investigation into his background suggests he may be a missing heir or someone hiding a higher-status identity, which makes every alliance feel unstable. Wedding rituals then become another battlefield, with interruptions, accusations of fraud, corrupted evidence, and public insults repeatedly threatening marriage itself. A pregnancy claim and later a fake report intensify the mistrust, while a buried murder truth from twenty years ago finally links the present chaos to a long-delayed revenge story. By the end, arrests for fraud and murder expose the scale of the conspiracy and clear at least one family name, but they do not end the emotional war. Arjun finally appears openly, and the public revelation that he and Radha are already married shifts the story from hidden identity to open confrontation over power, marriage, and image. The show closes on a tense mix of romance, revenge, and family rivalry, with the central couple standing together publicly even as the larger conflict remains unresolved.

rongbaj-romeo.title: Rongbaj Romeo
rongbaj-romeo.description: Taani, a fierce single mother-turned-PA, refuses to be starstruck by cricket star Samrat Gill.Taani, a fierce single mother-turned-PA, refuses to be starstruck by cricket star Samrat Gill. As her manipulative ex and his obsessive fake-girlfriend conspire against her, Samrat fights back — proving love isn't about status or stardom. Between kidnappings, courtrooms, and a cricket final, two wounded souls discover that real love doesn't dazzle you. It simply shows up.

they-called-me-a-worthless-son-in-law.title: They Called Me A Worthless Son-In-Law
they-called-me-a-worthless-son-in-law.description: A humble ghar-jamai named Lin silently endures years of humiliation, exploitation, and discrimination from his wife’s family to protect his marriage and daughter. But when the abuse crosses all limits, he finally reveals the truth: he is the heir to a powerful business empire, forcing those who mocked him to face the consequences of their greed and prejudice.

intern-ceo.title: Intern CEO
intern-ceo.description: A powerful CEO hides her true identity and enters her own company as an intern to uncover a massive fraud. But what starts as a secret mission soon turns into a battlefield of ego, deception, and betrayal where enemies wear friendly faces, and one wrong move could cost her everything.

social-media-billionaire-2.title: Social Media Billionaire
social-media-billionaire-2.description: A humble pizza delivery boy discovers he is the secret heir to an 8,000-crore empire but instead of revealing the truth, he chooses to stay poor and test the world that humiliated him.

the-man-in-seat-1a.title: The Man In Seat 1A
the-man-in-seat-1a.description: The Man in Seat 1A follows Sameer Khanna, a humble and overlooked man who returns from the U.S. to his family’s business empire. Dismissed by his stepmother Devika, stepbrother Karan, and fiancée Tanya, he is betrayed and stripped of his inheritance. But Sameer harbors a secret—he is “Sam,” the billionaire owner of a global defense giant. When pushed too far, he reveals his true power, taking revenge on those who wronged him and reclaiming his rightful place. Watch now.

o-range-revenge.title: O Range Revenge
o-range-revenge.description: ఆఫీస్ టైమ్ లో మొబైల్ గేమ్స్ ఆడుతున్నాడన్న కారణంగా పృథ్వీ ని జాబ్ లోంచి తీసేసారు. దానివల్ల అతని ప్రేమ కూడా పోయింది. అప్పటి నుండి పగ పెంచుకున్నాడు. అతను పగ పెంచుకున్నది ఎవరి మీదా..? నిజంగా గేమ్స్ ఆడుతున్నందుకే అతని జాబ్ పోయిందా అనే ఆసక్తికరమైన అనుమానాలతో సాగే కథ.. ఓ రేంజి రివేంజ్

sacred-marriage-a-love-beyond-gender.title: Sacred Marriage: A Love Beyond Gender
sacred-marriage-a-love-beyond-gender.description: The story centers on Damini and Jai as their relationship is repeatedly tested by public shame, family control, and questions of identity. It begins with Jai traveling to the border with his uncle to find a bride, where marriage is treated like a public contest and his pride pushes him to keep bidding despite warnings. The situation turns scandalous when the woman tied to the marriage is revealed to be a kinnar, and romance quickly becomes a source of humiliation and conflict. Across the early arc, money, status, and social stigma keep overriding personal feeling, and Damini is repeatedly treated as if she can be bought or controlled. Even after marriage, the household and village remain hostile, and Damini fears exposure while Jay tries to defend her dignity. The conflict widens into searches, disappearances, and accusations, with missing money, missing people, and police involvement deepening the crisis. Other figures such as Manjari, Rishi, Swayam, Vikram, and Kamini appear in linked tensions of betrayal, rejection, and attempts to repair past mistakes, but the emotional center keeps returning to Damini’s safety and recognition. Jay’s love for Damini becomes more explicit as he rejects caste and color divisions and insists that she matters more than money. Public declarations of love, however, trigger violence and renewed stigma, showing how fragile their bond is in front of the community. The village women and older relatives intensify the pressure by questioning pregnancy, childlessness, and the legitimacy of the marriage. At one point the panchayat turns the couple’s private life into a public trial and even orders them to be hanged together, making the stakes life-or-death. Their refusal to separate becomes a test of devotion rather than surrender. A Sarpanch then intervenes and argues that Damini’s identity is not wrongdoing, directly challenging the council’s prejudice. His defense forces the elders to reverse the punishment and allow the pair to marry. The council also condemns the violence done to Damini, and the public wedding becomes a symbolic affirmation of her place in the community. Even so, the final movement suggests that acceptance remains fragile, because the story closes with Damini still being urgently called for in a new public setting. Overall, the show tracks a struggle for love, dignity, and social recognition against a world that keeps trying to reduce Damini to stigma or property.

mrs-goldigger.title: Mrs. Golddigger
mrs-goldigger.description: After a rushed marriage to a stranger who demands ₹1 crore, a powerful CEO is convinced he’s been trapped by a gold digger—until his growing feelings and a haunting past force him to question if the woman he distrusts is actually the one who once saved his life.

kaadhal-with-benefits.title: Kaadhal With Benefits
kaadhal-with-benefits.description: The show follows Keerthi and Kishore through a long chain of mistaken identity, forced marriage pressure, and corporate warfare. Early conflict begins with family demands around marriage, where personal choice is repeatedly sacrificed to inheritance, company control, and reputation. A woman is pushed into marriage to avoid legal trouble, while another marriage is treated as a business arrangement tied to KR Industries. Kishore and Keerthi are then trapped in a tense union that is often framed as fake, strategic, or unwanted, even as their closeness keeps resurfacing. Their relationship is complicated by secrecy, teasing, resistance, and repeated boundary-setting, especially when Kishore pushes for intimacy and Keerthi refuses to be rushed. Public humiliation follows them into family spaces, where relatives demand money and treat the marriage as a source of leverage. The workplace storyline is equally harsh, with Keerthi repeatedly judged, demoted, and mocked for her background and presence in corporate spaces. Gayathri becomes a major rival in that arena, using authority, threats, and public criticism to control Keerthi’s position. Keerthi, however, gradually proves her competence and eventually gains status, reversing some of the power imbalance. Kishore’s hidden identity as a CEO and as Keerthi’s husband becomes a major turning point, turning romance into a crisis of trust. Keerthi is furious when the truth comes out, especially after being humiliated by someone she thought was beneath her. At the same time, Kishore is shown as desperate to keep her in his life and to repair the damage he caused. The family-business conflict grows larger as marriage is tied directly to shares, succession, and ownership. Rival figures try to buy Keerthi off or force her out through divorce demands, but she refuses to be treated like a bargaining chip. Keerthi then reveals her own stake in KR Industries, which shifts the balance of power. Kishore publicly confirms their marriage and cancels an engagement, exposing the secret to wider scandal. Even after ultimatums and pressure, the couple remains at the center of a struggle where love, pride, and identity are constantly tested against money and control.

mera-inteqaam-dekhegi.title: Mera Inteqaam Dekhegi
mera-inteqaam-dekhegi.description:
After sacrificing his future to save the woman he loves, Rishi is left disabled and betrayed when his fiancée Trisha abandons him for his rich best friend, Nishant. stands by him and begins exposing the truth behind Trisha's betrayal.

As his enemies mock his disability and question his worth, shocking revelations uncover that Rishi is far more powerful and influential than anyone imagined.

hashtag-love.title: Billionaire Wife On Wheel Chair
hashtag-love.description: A disabled young woman suffers years of abuse from her greedy uncle and aunt who want her property. Her life changes when a kind man with magical healing powers enters her world, protects her, and helps her recover. Together they overcome hardship, find love, and achieve a heartwarming happy ending filled with hope, healing, and justice.

war-of-tomorrow.title: War Of Tomorrow
war-of-tomorrow.description: When a catastrophic solar explosion leaves Earth in ruins, Lo Chen returns after an impossible journey expecting to save the world, only to find that seven years have passed and humanity now survives under brutal rulers and mutated powers. Hiding strength beyond imagination, he must face betrayal, deadly trials, and a broken past to give Earth one last chance at rebirth.

kanavan-20.title: Kanavan 2.0
kanavan-20.description: பழமையான காலத்தைச் சேர்ந்த ஒரு தெய்வீக ஆன்மா, பொறுப்பில்லாத சூதாட்டக்காரரான ஹரிஷின் உடலில் மறுபிறவி எடுக்கிறது. இரக்கமுள்ள வைத்தியராக மாறும் அவர், தனது விதியை மாற்றவும், பேச முடியாத மனைவி பவித்ராவை குணப்படுத்தவும், இருண்ட ரகசியங்களை மறைத்து வைத்திருக்கும் சக்திவாய்ந்த எதிரிகளை எதிர்கொள்ளவும் ஒரு புதிய பயணத்தை தொடங்குகிறார்.

30-divasathe-bharya.title: 30 Divasathe Bharya
30-divasathe-bharya.description: The story centers on Anika and the men who try to claim, control, or protect her, while violence and coercion keep pushing every relationship toward crisis. Across the arc, marriage is repeatedly used as a weapon, whether through forced proposals, contract terms, public declarations, or ceremonial pressure. Ranveer emerges as the most dominant figure, a gangster-like husband or would-be husband who insists Anika belongs with him and repeatedly frames control as love. Anika resists that claim whenever she can, rejecting humiliation, refusing to be treated as subordinate, and trying to preserve her freedom and dignity. Other women are trapped in similar pressure, including Aditi, Meenakshi, and a woman who is pushed into bridal roles or threatened into obedience. Karan appears as a wounded, dangerous, and uncertain presence who may help rescue trapped women, but whose loyalties are not always clear. Amala and other helpers try to get the wounded men medical care or provide support, but the larger world remains ruled by threats, secrecy, and retaliation. The criminal side of the story keeps tightening around the romance, with bosses, orders, evidence, ransom demands, and hidden schemes shaping what happens next. A 30-day contract marriage becomes one of the main battlegrounds, turning domestic life into a test of trust, control, and survival. Small gestures like tea, shopping, or household rituals never fully soften the conflict, because every kindness is shadowed by suspicion. Mahima functions as a major rival and destabilizing force, repeatedly challenging Anika’s place, humiliating her, and using hidden evidence to threaten others. Ranveer publicly defends Anika at times, even presenting expensive proof of his feelings and rejecting transactional ideas of love. Yet his protection is mixed with possessiveness, and his relationship with Anika keeps swinging between devotion and domination. The wider conflict spills into weddings, public gatherings, and gang confrontations, where private jealousy becomes a public scandal. Anika’s disappearance before a ritual, her accusations of betrayal, and the arrival of proof all raise the stakes around her safety and the truth of past events. By the later part of the story, pregnancy, arrest threats, and blackmail make the danger even more personal and irreversible. Ranveer is pushed to the edge, confronting enemies directly and even willing to face police if it means keeping Anika close. The overall arc is one of unstable power, where romance, captivity, and criminal pressure are inseparable and no loyalty can be fully trusted.

love-beyond-the-missing-years.title: Love Beyond The Missing Years
love-beyond-the-missing-years.description: Twenty-Five years after her husband vanished in the Kargil War, Meera still believes he will return. Raising her children alone, she endures a lifetime of sacrifice and loneliness. Fate reunites her with Arun, now a billionaire who survived years of captivity and never stopped searching for her. But before they recognise each other, a greedy woman steals Meera’s identity and claims Arun’s place in her life.

guns-roses.title: Guns & Roses
guns-roses.description: ఒక క్రూరమైన కుటుంబం నుండి రక్షణ కల్పించే క్రమంలో, ఒక శక్తివంతమైన గ్యాంగ్‌స్టర్ అనుకోకుండా ఒక నిస్సహాయురాలైన ఆర్టిస్ట్ జీవితంలోకి అడుగుపెడతాడు, ఆ తర్వాత వారిద్దరూ ఎలా ప్రేమలో పడ్డారనేదే ఈ కథ.

tadap-5.title: Tadap
tadap-5.description: A brilliant but poor young woman, Pihu Mishra, secretly loves star football player Jimmy Shekhawat and sacrifices everything for him. But when Jimmy betrays her, destroys her dreams, and chooses another woman, Pihu leaves to build a new life. Years later, she returns as a world-famous doctor, forcing Jimmy to face the pain of losing the only person who truly loved him.

love-bodyguard.title: Love Bodyguard
love-bodyguard.description: The story follows a high-stakes love triangle that keeps colliding with family pressure, wealth, and public humiliation. Vani, Jahnavi, and Krish are repeatedly pulled into conflicts where marriage is treated as both a personal bond and a bargaining chip. Early on, a marriage-related deal is negotiated under pressure, and Krish openly confesses his love for Jahnavi while jealousy around him becomes impossible to ignore. Vani asserts control in a modern office setting, rejects flirtation and challenge, and chooses Krish as her personal bodyguard, forcing him into constant proximity. Krish accepts the role mainly to stay close to Jahnavi, which keeps his protective instincts and romantic attachment in tension. Jahnavi, meanwhile, is shown as emotionally guarded but still affected by him, and she does not fully escape the pull of their connection. Public incidents, including humiliation, rescue, and awkward intimate moments, keep turning private feelings into visible conflict. Krish defends Jahnavi from embarrassment, reserves protection for her safety, and even marks his devotion in a way that makes his feelings unmistakable. Vani’s resentment grows into open accusations that Jahnavi has stolen her father, home, money, dreams, and love. The family conflict deepens through gatherings, hospital transfers, and punishment scenes, showing that the emotional damage is spreading beyond the central trio. A violent confrontation leaves someone restrained, and the fallout suggests betrayal and love turned to ashes. The story then widens into elite social spaces where status, gifts, and ownership are used as weapons. Krish is revealed as Mr. Kapoor, a billionaire CEO whose hidden pursuit of Janvi had already been expressed through lavish gifts and auction purchases. That revelation does not resolve the tension; instead, it leads into shocking proposal tactics, money-linked marriage pressure, and three mysterious conditions that tighten control over Janvi’s future. The marriage conflict becomes increasingly transactional, with offers of cash, luxury, and property met by resistance from the families who refuse to let love be bought. Wedding rituals themselves turn into crises, with possessiveness, threats, and public panic pushing the ceremony toward collapse. By the end of the batch, the emotional stakes remain unresolved, with old wounds reopened, rivalries still active, and the central women forced to defend their dignity against men who try to decide their futures.

dhoorandhaar-nishaanebaaz-returns.title: Dhoorandhaar Nishaanebaaz Returns
dhoorandhaar-nishaanebaaz-returns.description: After losing his wife in a brutal attack, legendary sharpshooter G-9 gives up his guns and spends 14 years drowning in guilt and alcohol. But when his daughter is kidnapped by a ruthless terrorist network, he is forced to return as the deadly Dhurandhar Nishanebaaz and wage war against the enemies who destroyed his family.

hanya-sedetak-j.title: Hanya Sedetak J
hanya-sedetak-j.description:
Dulu sepasang kekasih, kini rival di dunia korporat yang kejam.

Ketika percikan lama kembali menyala dan kebenaran tersembunyi mulai terungkap, permainan kekuasaan pun menjadi urusan pribadi.

Akankah cinta mereka bertahan, atau ambisi memisahkan mereka selamanya?

Saksikan sekarang!

lies-and-legacy-4.title: Lies and Legacy
lies-and-legacy-4.description: Mumbai’s powerful businessman Ashok Prajapati hides his billionaire identity to raise his daughter Simmi with values. But when they are humiliated at her college by a rich family trying to buy her science award, Ashok uncovers a shocking truth—his wife Shalaka has been living a double life with them using his wealth. As greed, betrayal, and inheritance wars erupt, Ashok must choose revenge or protect Simmi’s future.

onn-cab.title: Aakhri OTP
onn-cab.description: The story begins as a missing-husband case when Anvi reports that her husband vanished after taking a cab and never came home. What first looks like a single disappearance quickly widens into a cab-company crisis, with employees, supervisors, and police all trying to trace the ride and identify the driver. A young couple’s hopeful trip is interrupted by a crash and then by violence, hinting that the road itself has become part of a larger criminal setup. As the investigation deepens, the missing passenger is confirmed to have been abducted, and a kidnapper’s call turns the case into a race against time. The company’s staff are split between those who want to alert police and those who fear scandal, while supervisors argue over whether the threat is real or just a scam. Smita repeatedly warns that danger is already inside the company, but senior management hesitates until the pressure becomes impossible to ignore. The kidnappers demand a huge ransom, and the hostage is used as leverage while the criminals argue over violence, trust, and how to keep control of the money. Police begin tracing calls, ride details, CCTV, and bank activity, and the search shifts from a simple cab ride to a broader fraud investigation. One major clue is that the driver name tied to the case belongs to a man who died a month earlier, suggesting identity theft or a hidden operator using dead records. Even after that death is confirmed, the cab and phone linked to the name remain active, which makes the case feel even more organized and deceptive. The investigation also exposes active bank accounts, suspicious withdrawals, and digital transfers that connect the kidnapping to financial manipulation. As the pressure rises, the criminals and the company both seem to be hiding something, and suspicion keeps moving toward insiders rather than strangers. Sameer Khanna becomes increasingly central as police, employees, and rivals all circle around his role in the crisis. Smita eventually resigns and openly accuses him of using people for personal gain, turning the corporate conflict into an accusation of deeper complicity. At the same time, the hostage situation remains unresolved, with the victim’s family, police, and company staff all trying to keep up with the kidnappers’ changing demands. The case expands from one missing man into a layered conspiracy involving ransom, fraud, possible cover-up, and a network that may reach beyond the cab company itself. By the end of the batch, the investigation is still active, the money trail is still being chased, and the hidden network appears larger than anyone first expected.

mrsgolddigger.title: Mrs.Golddigger
mrsgolddigger.description: Aisha’s story begins with an act of compassion that pulls her into a marriage she never sought. After she helps an injured elderly man, it becomes clear that the accident was staged to bring her together with his grandson, and the grandfather pushes the match despite the young man’s resistance. Aisha asks for money to save her family home rather than dowry, which makes the grandson suspect her motives, but the grandfather defends her and the marriage is formally registered. That financial help protects her father’s house, yet it also traps her inside a relationship built on pressure, secrecy, and suspicion. The story then moves into the fashion-company world, where Aisha works in a low-level cleaning role while her husband is revealed to be the company head. Her hidden status creates constant tension, as coworkers humiliate her and powerful women challenge her place. Tanya emerges as a major rival, proud and aggressive at work, while family elders and office staff keep forcing public confrontations. Aisha’s dignity is repeatedly tested, but her hidden design talent begins to change how others see her. Ishaan notices her skill, supports her in competition, and publicly backs her when others mock her humble background. Her victory in the Kiara Fashion Competition becomes a turning point, earning her recognition and a chief designer role while also deepening jealousy around her. Tanya is punished for breaking company rules, but the emotional conflict does not settle, because Ishaan and Aisha’s marriage remains secret and unstable. The romance grows more complicated as other women are drawn into Ishaan’s unresolved feelings and the workplace becomes a battleground for status and loyalty. A separate pregnancy crisis then raises the stakes sharply, with Ayesha/Priya realizing the child is tied to Ishaan and facing hostile accusations from Tanya and others. The conflict turns public when Ayesha is trapped in a washroom emergency and Ishaan finally claims her as his wife and the baby as his, exposing the hidden marriage. He rejects Tanya, protects Ayesha, and promises to reveal the truth openly, but humiliation from family members and rivals continues to follow her. In the later family and social confrontations, Ishanth/Ishaan repeatedly defends Aisha against accusations, class prejudice, and attempts to remove her from the family. He publicly identifies her as his wife even when his mother and others oppose the relationship, while Tanya keeps trying to break his loyalty and discredit Aisha. The show closes on a tense unresolved balance of love, family honor, public reputation, and hidden past events that are only partly coming to light.

they-betrayed-the-wrong-man.title: They Betrayed the Wrong Man
they-betrayed-the-wrong-man.description: Chen Yu’s story is built around hidden identity, unpaid sacrifice, and the way family power turns love into betrayal. At first, he quietly helps powerful women rise while hiding who he really is, even as the woman who saved him is pregnant with his child and her family still dismisses him as a delivery boy. That secrecy collapses when rivals and family members reject him, and violence breaks out before he can fully reveal himself. From there, the show expands into a long revenge war in which Chen Yu is humiliated, poisoned, beaten, and repeatedly forced to prove his worth against heirs, sisters, commanders, and palace figures. Each time his enemies use status, inheritance, or public ceremony to shame him, he answers with force and with threats to destroy everything they built. The conflict is not only personal but also corporate and political, with elite gatherings, succession disputes, and investment power all becoming weapons in the feud. Medical emergencies keep interrupting the revenge, especially when Yanxi or Yan Shi is injured, pregnant, or in danger, forcing Chen Yu and other protectors to choose between retaliation and rescue. Several women who once stood beside him turn hostile, while others defend him and reveal that he had already saved lives and cleared dangers in secret. The story also widens into family hostage standoffs, where fathers beg for mercy, sons refuse humiliation, and children or wives are threatened to force surrender. Mr. Wang’s intervention and later financial retaliation show that the hostile family’s power can be stripped away as quickly as it was built. Meanwhile, palace and royal conflicts expose how rank can be fake, borrowed, or stolen, and how hidden strength can overturn public authority. In those arcs, Chen Yu and related figures repeatedly defeat elite guards and proud commanders who rely on titles more than truth. The show keeps returning to the same emotional wound: people who were helped, raised, or protected often become the ones who betray him. That betrayal deepens when family members are revealed as impostors, accomplices, or opportunists willing to kill for wealth and status. As the feuds spread, the stakes rise from personal insult to murder, exile, blacklisting, and the collapse of entire family lines. By the end of the batch digests, the central arc is still unresolved, but the direction is clear: hidden identities are being exposed, old loyalties are breaking, and revenge is pushing every family toward a final reckoning.

drvedanthinte-hridayam-1.title: Dr.Vedanthinte Hridayam
drvedanthinte-hridayam-1.description: Vedant, a gifted doctor turned ward boy after losing his medical license, silently endures humiliation from colleagues and heartbreak from his fiancée. Armed with a revolutionary non-surgical heart treatment he spent six years researching, he continues fighting for patients nobody else will save. When a high-profile medical crisis strikes, Vedant faces his greatest test — battling not just the emergency, but the people determined to stop him from doing what he does best.

pichaikaran-to-boss.title: Pichaikaran to Boss
pichaikaran-to-boss.description: A billionaire CEO disguises himself as a beggar to escape a forced marriage arrangement, accidentally ending up wed to Kanisha, a heartbroken orphan abandoned at the altar. What begins as a contractual arrangement slowly reveals hidden identities, workplace jealousy, family drama, and unexpected love until the truth about who he really is changes everything.

the-army-chiefs-hidden-daughter.title: The Army Chief's Hidden Daughter
the-army-chiefs-hidden-daughter.description: The story begins with Shaurya Raichand’s death in a terrorist attack, and his sacrifice turns him into a national hero while leaving his family shattered. His funeral and military honors frame the loss as both public glory and private heartbreak. Around that grief, women and children struggle to survive in a world that repeatedly doubts them. A pregnant army wife tries to travel safely, but public disputes on buses and trains turn her need for help into humiliation and danger. In more than one confrontation, passengers side against vulnerable women, and the crowd’s cruelty escalates into insults, accusations, and violence. A recurring military medal becomes a crucial symbol of truth, identity, and the dead soldier’s legacy. Widows are accused of stealing, lying, or pretending to belong to the army family, even when they insist on their husbands’ honor. The same suspicion spreads to other women who are searched, detained, or called spies after army-linked items are found with them. Children repeatedly expose the human cost of these clashes by pleading for their mothers and asking for protection. The Raichand family’s grief is also tied to status struggles, as marriage schemes and power plays circle around Jayveer Raichand and his household. Rashi’s ambitions and confrontations add another layer of social conflict, showing how pride, class, and influence can quickly become violent. Military authority is not always protective, since some officers enforce suspicion and humiliation instead of mercy. At the same time, a few figures, especially Ajay, resist corrupt pressure and try to protect women and children. The narrative keeps returning to identity claims, with women insisting they are Shaurya’s widow or part of the Raichand family while others refuse to believe them. Public memorial scenes and funeral rites intensify the emotional stakes, because honor is celebrated in ceremony even as the family remains under attack. By the end, arrests, broken trust, and unresolved accusations leave grief, loyalty, and institutional cruelty still in conflict. The show’s central tension is whether truth and dignity can survive in a world that keeps punishing the vulnerable for claiming them.

mechanic-don.title: Mechanic Don
mechanic-don.description: 3:09 PMClaude responded: Rajeev, the world's secret Crypto King, hides as a mechanic while hunting a traitor in his network.Rajeev, the world's secret Crypto King, hides as a mechanic while hunting a traitor in his network. He marries Sunidhi Oberoi, protects her family empire from rivals, and dismantles a criminal conspiracy. When his uncle Brijendra is exposed as the betrayer, Rajeev reveals his true identity, delivers justice, and unites with Sunidhi.

arjun-the-cyber-robinhood.title: CTR+ALT+REVENGE
arjun-the-cyber-robinhood.description: Ruthless billionaire couple Kabir and Meher Singhania have built a powerful loan empire by exploiting the poor. When a massive cyberattack threatens their financial empire and pushes the banking system toward collapse, the only person who can save it is Arjun Dixit, a brilliant cyber expert whose father was destroyed by the Singhanias. Unaware of his identity, they publicly humiliate him, igniting a fierce battle of ego, revenge, and justice where old scores must finally be settled.

flatmate-404-not-found-1.title: Adrishya Flatmate
flatmate-404-not-found-1.description: Sudhanshu, traumatized by witnessing his mother's murder, moves into a cursed bungalow with "Anurag" — a friend existing only in his mind. When flatmate Shruti arrives, his fractured psyche spirals into paranoia, hallucinations, and violence, ending in tragedy as reality and delusion fatally collide.

aakasha-doothu.title: Aakasha Doothu
aakasha-doothu.description: The show follows a long chain of breakups, hidden truths, and family pressure centered on Varun, Shiva, Kalyani, Shivani, and the people pulled into their conflicts. It begins with Shiva ending a three-year relationship with Varun on Valentine’s Day, but the emotional fallout is immediately complicated by new arrivals and old rumors. Ria’s return from the UK stirs talk of Varun’s past and possible reunion, while gossip keeps suggesting that someone is hiding another attachment. The story then turns sharply toward family crisis when Shiva reveals she is pregnant, and her mother and brother react with shame, anger, and demands that she solve the problem at any cost. Shiva refuses to accept blame alone and pushes back against a household that seems more concerned with reputation and money than her dignity. Varun becomes the center of the child-related conflict, denying responsibility at times and treating the situation as something to be managed rather than repaired. Around him, other women are drawn into the same emotional storm, including Kalyani, whose bond with Varun is repeatedly framed as troubled, secretive, and unresolved. Their relationship appears tied to a contract-like arrangement, public scandal, and arguments over marriage terms, fatherhood, and financial settlement. Shivani also becomes deeply entangled in the drama, with her privacy, pregnancy, and marriage repeatedly exposed to pressure and gossip. The show suggests that several of these conflicts are connected by concealed history, including a hidden medical report, a mysterious chain, and a college-era past that has not been fully explained. As the tension rises, hospital scenes and accident fallout force the characters back together, making private lies into public emergencies. Shivani’s crisis becomes especially severe, with reports of a serious accident, surgery, and the loss of a pregnancy. Varun is then confronted with the consequences of his absence, as he learns that she tried to reach him while he was unavailable. Kalyani’s own role becomes more complicated when she is revealed as another accident victim who had hidden the truth about Shivani. Varun rejects Kalyani’s explanations, ends the relationship, and pushes the separation into divorce papers and finality. Even after that, he keeps searching for Shivani, but she remains difficult to reach and seems determined to protect herself. The later material adds another layer of emotional isolation through Captain Rahul, whose need for stability and belonging leads into a medical emergency and a charged reunion with Shivani. By the end, the show remains unresolved, with Varun still trying to repair what was broken while Shivani keeps her distance and the past continues to shape every present relationship.

meri-robo-girlfriend.title: Meri Robo Girlfriend
meri-robo-girlfriend.description: Mohit Kapoor, billionaire with a rare touch allergy creates Zia, a human-like robot, to end loneliness. Since Zia is incomplete, Akshita, a struggling single mother who looks identical to her secretly takes her place. As Akshita pretends to be a robot, she and Mohit slowly fall in love. Meanwhile, Mohit’s rival suitor Ritika repeatedly tries to expose her secret. Filled with romance, comedy, and emotional twists, the story follows Akshita’s fight to protect her identity and find happiness.

pyaar-prema-love.title: Pyaar Prema love
pyaar-prema-love.description: A heartbroken billionaire, hiding as an intern, discovers he's merely a substitute for his girlfriend's ex and must choose between forgiveness and self-respect.

qabool-hai.title: Qabool Hai
qabool-hai.description: The show is a family drama built around weddings, class shame, business pressure, and the long fallout of favoritism. It opens with a nikah that collapses when Danish refuses to marry after being forced to choose between the bride and another woman. The public humiliation pushes the family into damage control, and Zaid, the overlooked younger son who has returned in secret with wealth and a desire for revenge, becomes the unexpected replacement. His decision to step in saves the ceremony, but it does not heal the resentment underneath it. The marriage that follows is tense from the start, with objections from elders, emotional distance, and immediate signs that the household is not ready to accept the new bride. Across the next stretch, romantic conflict keeps colliding with status and obedience, especially as Danish’s relationship with Alina is rejected by both families and turned into a source of public insult. At the same time, Zaid and Maira/Mahira struggle inside a controlling home where chores, unemployment, and humiliation expose how little power the women have. Job pressure and corporate ambition widen the story beyond the house, as Redstar becomes tied to family pride, hidden motives, and competing loyalties. Several relationships are strained by accusations that money has influenced love, and by repeated demands that people apologize, kneel, or submit. A family dinner turns into another test of dignity when money is offered as leverage, but the younger woman refuses to be bought. Zaid repeatedly tries to defend honor, yet his own household remains divided by favoritism and mistrust. The father’s collapse briefly shifts the focus to survival, forcing the family to scramble for transport, treatment, and money while old rivalries continue in the background. Danish’s refusal to return immediately deepens the sense that duty is being abandoned for personal comfort and hidden attachments. As the father recovers, class insults, phone suspicions, and missing money turn the home into a place of accusation rather than support. The conflict then spills into violence and public exposure, with Zaid humiliated, forced out, and followed by Saba, while business schemes and secret romances further destabilize the wider family network. Later, the story turns tragic and remorseful, with a crash, recovered money, and devastating hospital news about Mayra and the baby. In the final stretch, guilt and loss dominate as Maira blames herself, Zed mourns the child he could not save, and both families ask for forgiveness too late. The closing episodes also suggest that some characters are trying to repair what remains, through restored houses, bail efforts, apologies, and renewed vows, but the overall arc remains one of damage, regret, and fragile attempts at reconciliation.

chenkol.title: Chenkol
chenkol.description: A reincarnated ancient prince is reborn as a 15-year-old lost heir in a powerful modern family, where he faces rejection, rivalry, and betrayal. Armed with mysterious powers and knowledge from his past life, he sets out to reclaim his rightful place and uncover hidden truths.

mental-manadhil.title: Mental Manadhil
mental-manadhil.description: ரொமி மற்றும் ஷிகாவின் வாழ்க்கை ஒருகாலத்தில் காதலால் நிரம்பியதாக இருந்தது. ஆனால் ஒரு விபத்தில் ரொமியின் குடும்பத்தை இழந்தபின், அவன் காதல் வெறுப்பாக மாறுகிறது. ஷிகாவை மனதாலும் உடலாலும் துன்புறுத்தி பழிவாங்க நினைக்கும் ரொமி, அவளை ஆயுள் தண்டனை போல வாழ வைக்கிறான். இருந்தாலும், வெறுப்பின் பின்னால் இன்னும் காதல் இருக்கிறது என்பதை ஷிகா நம்புகிறாள்.

b109022b-98ab-4ab6-a8d9-289916cc832f.title: Code Chanakya: The Last Move
b109022b-98ab-4ab6-a8d9-289916cc832f.description: Five years after being humiliated, disowned, and divorced, Yatin Kothari returns to his daughter’s birthday as a nobody. But beneath his modest exterior lies a secret—he is Chanakya, the anonymous mastermind behind billion-dollar empires. As his ex-wife, former family, and rivals mock him, Yatin exposes his true identity, topples the powerful Kotharis, and shocks everyone. But a devastating claim about his daughter’s paternity threatens to destroy everything he fought to reclaim.

the-mysterious-masterchef.title: The Mysterious Master Chef
the-mysterious-masterchef.description: The story centers on Rahul, a chef whose place in a tense hotel kitchen is constantly challenged by hierarchy, sabotage, and power struggles. What begins as ordinary service pressure quickly grows into a larger contest over reputation, ownership, and control of the hotel. Rahul is repeatedly pushed by managers, rivals, and executives who use guest demands and kitchen mistakes to corner him. A celebrated master chef and other elite competitors raise the level of the conflict, turning cooking into a public test of status as much as skill. The hotel’s future becomes tied to competition rules, and the stakes rise to the point where losing can mean surrendering the hotel itself. Rahul is often underestimated, mocked, or accused, yet his calm precision keeps drawing attention. Rival chefs such as Asif, Vikram, Dhruva, Rupesh, and others intensify the pressure through strategy, sabotage, and claims of hidden talent. At one stage, a hidden ace is revealed, and the contest becomes a battle between polished technique, originality, and raw confidence. Rahul’s own hidden identity as Rahul Reddy, also called RR, eventually comes to light, changing how others see him. That revelation does not end the danger, because it also makes him a target for those who want him hunted or removed. The story then widens beyond the kitchen into family conflict, with Priyanka pleading for safety and trying to protect the people she cares about. Violence interrupts the competition when armed attackers and later a brutal ambush force Rahul into direct physical danger. He is badly injured while protecting others, disappears, and later returns with no memory of who he is. Even after that loss, he is drawn back into cooking through shelter, work, and another showdown that proves he still belongs in the fight. His victories are repeatedly challenged by rivals who question fairness, originality, and legitimacy. By the end of the batch, Rahul has emerged as a recognized master chef, but the surrounding threats, rivalries, and unresolved challenges remain active. The overall arc is one of survival, identity, and proving worth in a world where food competition is inseparable from family power and personal danger.

ead8738d-27df-4126-ae55-a395680a0bf2.title: Married to The Halwai for Ten Percent
ead8738d-27df-4126-ae55-a395680a0bf2.description: With just hours left before sunset to save her company, a fiercely independent CEO impulsively enters a contract marriage with an eccentric Chandni Chowk halwai she believes is ordinary. But as enemies close in and a mysterious poison threatens her life, she discovers her sweet-maker husband is actually a billionaire hiding in plain sight—the only man who can heal her, protect her, and fight beside her in a brutal battle for her empire.

last-bench-rowdy.title: Last Bench Rowdy
last-bench-rowdy.description: அப்பாவி மாணவன் அர்ஜுனின் உடலில் கொடூர கேங்ஸ்டர் ருத்ரனின் ஆன்மா புகுந்ததும், எல்லாம் தலைகீழாக மாறுகிறது. அவனை அவமானப்படுத்திய பள்ளி புல்லிகளும், கொடுமைப்படுத்திய குடும்பத்தினரும் ஒருவருக்கொருவர் கணக்கை சந்திக்கிறார்கள். உண்மை வெளிவந்ததும், பழிவாங்கும் ராகுல் குடும்பத்தையே அழிக்க முயல்கிறான். ஆனால் இப்போது அர்ஜுன் பழைய அர்ஜுன் இல்லை... எதிரிகளை நடுங்க வைக்கும் ருத்ரன்!

game-of-guns.title: Game of Guns
game-of-guns.description: Game of Guns follows Diya, an innocent nurse sold into human trafficking, whose life changes when dangerous arms dealer Armaan Shah rescues her. As love grows between them, they become trapped in a deadly world of obsession, betrayal, mafia wars, and revenge. While enemies target their love and unborn child, Armaan and Diya fight together to survive, protect their family, and defeat the darkness surrounding them. Watch now.

aaro-oral.title: Aaro Oral
aaro-oral.description: A wounded woman, a devoted father, and a child longing for a mother's love find each other through fate. As they build a family, buried secrets from the past threaten to destroy everything. Can love survive when the truth finally comes out?

love-beyond-rebirth.title: Love Beyond Rebirth
love-beyond-rebirth.description: Once a legendary sage seeking immortality, he is forced to reincarnate as a poor gambler trapped in debt and humiliation. In the human world, he discovers he has a mute wife. As his dormant powers awaken, he chooses a new path: to protect her, heal her, and redeem a broken life—even if it costs him his godhood.

parvarish-ki-galtiyaan.title: Parvarish Ki Galtiyaan
parvarish-ki-galtiyaan.description: Why do you always seek validation? Why is it so hard to say "no"? Why do you keep repeating the same patterns in your relationships, even when they hurt you? What if the answers were hidden in your childhood? *Parvarish Ki Galtiyaan* uncovers the unseen parenting mistakes that shape our fears, insecurities, self-worth, and relationships, revealing how childhood experiences silently influence the adults we become and how understanding them is the first step toward healing.

love-squad.title: love squad
love-squad.description: ஐந்து நண்பர்கள், ஐந்து லவ் ஸ்டோரிஸ்... காதல், கலாட்டா, காமெடின்னு உங்க டைம என்ஜாய் பண்ண கேளுங்க லவ் ஸ்குவாட்.

munh-nuchwa-kanpurs-alien.title: Munh Nuchwa: Kanpur's Alien
munh-nuchwa-kanpurs-alien.description: In 2002, a mysterious creature called **Munh Nochwa** spread terror across villages in Uttar Pradesh. People woke up with unexplained injuries, rumours spread like wildfire, and fear gripped an entire state. Was it a supernatural entity, a dangerous animal, or a case of mass hysteria? This series investigates one of India's strangest modern mysteries, revealing how fear can become more powerful than the truth.

man-of-masses-1.title: Man Of Masses
man-of-masses-1.description: చిన్న వయసులోనే 'యంగ్ టైగర్' గా మొదలుపెట్టి, ఈరోజు 'మ్యాన్ ఆఫ్ మాసెస్' గా పాన్ ఇండియా స్టార్ అవుతూ, గ్లోబల్ స్థాయిలో క్రేజ్ పొందిన మన జూనియర్ ఎన్టీఆర్ గారి కథ ఏంటి?  ఇంత చిన్న వయసులో అటువంటి గనత సాధించడంలో ఎన్టీఆర్ గారికి ఎలాంటి కష్టాలు ఎదురయ్యాయ్? ఇది ఎవ్వరికీ అందనంత ఎత్తుకి ఎదిగిన మన టైగర్ కథ

athi-rooban.title: Athi Rooban
athi-rooban.description: பெண்களை அறவே வெறுத்து ஒதுக்கும் கோடீஸ்வரன் அதிரூபன், தன் பாட்டியின் கட்டாயத்தால் காண்ட்ராக்ட் மேரேஜ்க்கு சரி என்கிறான். ஒரு குழந்தை பெற்று கொடுத்து விட்டு டிவோர்ஸ் கொடுக்க வேண்டும் என்றவன் பிளான் பண்ணி காய்  நகர்த்த, அதை தகர்க்கவே உள்ளே வந்து அவன் கை பிடிக்கிறாள் சைத்ரா... அதிரூபனுக்கு அவள் மீது காதல் வருமா?

harvey-milk-the-legacy-to-pride.title: Harvey Milk : The Legacy to Pride
harvey-milk-the-legacy-to-pride.description: Harvey Milk was an ordinary man who dreamed of living without fear. At a time when being openly gay was dangerous, he chose to speak up instead of staying silent. He went on to become one of America's first openly gay elected leaders and gave hope to thousands of people fighting for acceptance and equal rights. This series follows his inspiring journey, his rise in politics, the hatred he faced, and the powerful legacy he left behind for generations around the world.

panchatantra-4.title: Panchatantra
panchatantra-4.description: సిద్ధు లవ్ బ్రేకప్ అయిన బాధలో ఉండగా ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయికి పెళ్ళి అని తెలుస్తుంది. ఆ అమ్మాయి పెళ్ళికి వెళ్ళి రచ్చ చేయాలని ఫిక్స్ అవుతారు సిద్ధు అండ్ గ్యాంగ్. ఈ ఐదుగురు కలిసి పెళ్ళింట్లో ఇరుక్కుపోతారు. ఆ సమయంలో అనుకోకుండా కలుస్తుంది కీర్తన. ఇక తర్వాత ఏం జరిగింది? మధ్యలో రంగా,ఎమ్మేల్యేలకి సంబంధించిన కార్ ఎలా మిస్ అయ్యింది? అందులో ఏముంది? చివరికి సిద్ధు అండ్ గ్యాంగ్ ఏం చేశారు? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ షో వినేయండి.

the-rise-of-influencer-culture-in-india.title: The Rise Of Influencer Culture In India
the-rise-of-influencer-culture-in-india.description:
ఇన్‌ఫ్లూయెన్సర్ మార్కెటింగ్ భారతదేశంలో విస్తరించి, ప్రాముఖ్యాన్ని పొందింది, దీనిని బ్రాండ్లు తమ ఉత్పత్తులను ప్రచారం చేయడానికి, ఉత్పత్తులకు ధృవీకృత నమ్మకాన్ని పెంచడానికి ఉపయోగిస్తున్నారు. ఈ విధానం ఎక్కువగా సాంఘిక మీడియా ద్వారా రేటింగ్‌లు, అభిప్రాయాలు, పోస్టుల ద్వారా జరుగుతోంది.

మైక్రో ఇన్‌ఫ్లూయెన్సర్లు ఆధునిక మార్కెటింగ్‌లో కీలక పాత్ర పోషిస్తున్నారు. ఈ సృష్టికర్తలు చిన్న, విశ్వసనీయమైన కమ్యూనిటీలతో ఉండి, అధికంగా నమ్మకం మరియు ప్రామాణికతను కలిగిన ప్రచారాలను నిర్వహిస్తున్నారు, ఇది బ్రాండ్లకు ఎక్కువ ఎంగేజ్‌మెంట్ మరియు రూపాయల రాబడిని కలిగిస్తుంది.

vishnu-sahasranama-fear-se-free-hone-ka-.title: Vishnu Sahasranama: Fear Se Free Hone Ka Code
vishnu-sahasranama-fear-se-free-hone-ka-.description: Kya darr, anxiety aur overthinking ne aapki life ko control kar liya hai? Vishnu Sahasranama sirf ek stotra nahi, balki ek ancient mental operating system hai jo hazaron saalon se logon ko andar se mazboot banata aaya hai. Mahabharat ke Bhishma se lekar aaj ki neuroscience tak, ye series batati hai ki kaise Vishnu ke 1000 naam aapke fear ko confidence, confusion ko clarity aur stress ko shanti mein badal sakte hain. Agar aap fearless aur mentally strong banna chahte hain, toh ye aapke liye hai.

mufti-undercover-seduction.title: Mufti - undercover seduction
mufti-undercover-seduction.description:
போலீஸ் அதிகாரியாக தன் துறையில் ஜொலிக்கும் லேகாவுக்கு பர்சனல் வாழ்க்கை காதலும், காமமும் அற்று வறண்டு காணப்படுகிறது. உனக்கு உணர்ச்சியே இல்ல, நீ பொண்ணே இல்ல என்று கூடலின்போது கணவனால் அவமானப்படுத்தப்படுகிறாள் லேகா.
ஒரு மாஃபியா கும்பல் தலைவனை பிடிக்க பாலியல் தொழிலாளியாக நாடகமிட்டு Undercover Operation செய்ய துணிகிறாள் லேகா. ஆனால் ஆபரேஷன்காக இல்லாமல் தனக்குள் இருக்கும் அந்த காம அரக்கியை அடங்க வைப்பதற்காக, அர்ஜுன் என்ற அந்த மாஃபியா தலைவனை பிடித்தாளா அல்லது தனது காம உணர்ச்சிக்காக தோற்றுப்போனாளா...
எது உண்மை? 
எது வேஷம்?

cross-of-redemption.title: Cross Of Redemption
cross-of-redemption.description: ప్రేమ కోసం జీవితాన్ని అర్పించిన క్రీస్తు, క్రూసిఫికేషన్ ద్వారా మనందరికీ రక్షణ అందించాడు. అతని బాధలు, త్యాగం మనను మరింత శక్తివంతంగా మార్చాయి. ఈ బలిదానం సర్వశక్తిమంతుడైన దేవుని ప్రేమను, దయను ప్రతిబింబిస్తుంది. "రక్షణ" అనే ఈ అద్భుతమైన మార్గం ద్వారా మనం నలుగుతున్నాం.

izehaar-e-superstar.title: Izehaar-E-Superstar
izehaar-e-superstar.description: Years ago, Arjun rejected Mahi, thinking she is just another ordinary girl and his aim is way bigger than her. Today, she's the nation's biggest superstar... and he's the man assigned to protect her. As old wounds, dangerous threats, and buried emotions collide, duty and love become impossible to separate. A powerful blend of romance, suspense, redemption, and second chances that will keep you hooked till the very end.

project-t.title: Project T
project-t.description: అంజలి మరణాన్ని సాధారణ కేసులాగా క్లోజ్ చేయాలనుకుంటారు పోలీసులు. అంజలి అన్నయ్య కార్తీక్ సీక్రెట్గా ఆ కేస్ ఇన్వెస్టిగేషన్ స్టార్ట్ చేస్తాడు.ఆ సమయంలో అతనికి అంజలి డైరీ దొరుకుతుంది. ఆ డైరీలో ఏముంది? కార్తీక్ ని ఫాలో చేస్తున్న హిడెన్ షాడో ఎవరు? అంజలి మరణానికి, ఈ ప్రాజెక్ట్ T కి సంబంధం ఏంటి? అసలు ఈ ప్రాజెక్ట్ T అంటే ఏమిటి? ఇలాంటి మరెన్నో ప్రశ్నలకు సమాధానాలు కావాలంటే "PROJECT -T" ఆడియో షో వినేయండి.

reality-of-indias-cyber-cities.title: Reality Of India'S Cyber Cities
reality-of-indias-cyber-cities.description: Bengaluru, Gurgaon aur India ke cyber cities ko hum success, high salaries aur luxury lifestyle ke symbol ke roop mein dekhte hain. Lekin glass buildings ke peeche kya sach chhupa hai? Reality of India’s Cyber Cities explores burnout, fake hustle culture, loneliness, dating apps, EMI traps, AI job anxiety, corporate pressure aur digital addiction. Kya ye cities future bana rahi hain… ya ek aisi life jahan salary badh rahi hai, par sukoon kam ho raha hai?

sugar-cosmetics-makeup-brand-revolution.title: Sugar Cosmetics : Makeup Brand Revolution
sugar-cosmetics-makeup-brand-revolution.description: ಮೇಕಪ್ ಪ್ರಾಡಕ್ಟ್ಸ್ ಅಂದಾಕ್ಷಣ ಕೇವಲ ವಿದೇಶಿ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ಸ್ ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ, ಭಾರತದ ಸ್ವದೇಶಿ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಇಂದು ವರ್ಲ್ಡ್ ಫೇಮಸ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಅದೇ 'ಶುಗರ್'.! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಈ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಹಿಸ್ಟರಿ ಏನು? ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಬಂದ ಕೆಲವೇ ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಫಾರಿನ್ ಪ್ರಾಡಕ್ಟ್ಸಿಗೆ ಸೆಡ್ಡು ಹೊಡೆದದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಕೋವಿಡ್ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಹೂಡಿದ ತಂತ್ರಗಳೇನು? ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಬೆಸ್ಟ್ ಬ್ಯುಸಿನೆಸ್ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ 'Sugar Cosmetics : Makeup Brand Revolution'. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.

வீட்டிலிருந்தபடியே-சுயதொழில்-செய்ய-உதவும.title: வீட்டிலிருந்தபடியே சுயதொழில் செய்ய உதவும் அரசு கடன் சார்ந்த தகவல்கள்
வீட்டிலிருந்தபடியே-சுயதொழில்-செய்ய-உதவும.description: என்னது நம்ம சுயதொழில் தொடங்க, கவர்மென்ட் இருபது கோடி வரைக்கும் கடன் கொடுப்பாங்களா... கேட்கவே ஆச்சிர்யமா இருக்குல... ஆமாங்க! அரசு சார்ந்த கடன வச்சு நம்ம கனவ, நினைவாக்குற நாள் ரொம்ப பக்கத்துலையே தான் இருக்கு. உங்க கனவ நிஜமாக்க நீங்க தயார்ன்னா இப்போ இந்த ஆடியோ தொகுப்ப கேளுங்க.

temple-energy-kya-mandir-sirf-buildings-.title: Temple Energy: Kya Mandir Sirf Buildings Hain?
temple-energy-kya-mandir-sirf-buildings-.description: Kya mandir sirf pooja ki jagah hain ya unke peeche koi ancient science chhupi hai? Temple Energy explores temple architecture, Garbhagriha, Shikhar, mantras, bells, copper yantras, earthing, sound vibrations, Vastu aur ancient Indian knowledge. Discover the hidden science and mysterious energy of temples and understand why these sacred spaces feel so different.

merupu-kalalu.title: Merupu Kalalu
merupu-kalalu.description: కలలు నెరవేరాలంటే పోరాడాలి. ఆ పోరాట స్ఫూర్తి ఉన్న యువతి ఆనంది. కొన్ని పరిచయాలు మనల్ని జీవితంలో వెనక్కు లాగుతాయి. మరి వసంత్ తో ప్రేమ ఆనంది ప్రయాణాన్ని ఎటు వైపుకు నడిపింది? తన మనస్సు గాయపడిందా? తన స్వరం శ్రుతి తప్పిందా?  లేక అక్క అక్షయ సహకారంతో, ఆనంది తను అనుకున్నది సాధించిందా?  తెలియాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో సిరీస్ వినండి.

pagalpan-1.title: Pagalpan
pagalpan-1.description:
ప్రధాన పాత్ర జోయా, ఒక శక్తివంతమైన మరియు నియంత్రణత్మక తండ్రి ముహమ్మద్ అబ్దుల్లా చేత, తన జీవితంపై కఠిన నియంత్రణకు గురవుతుంది. అయినప్పటికీ, ఆమె అర్జున్ అనే యువకుడితో బలమైన సంబంధాన్ని పెంచుకుంటుంది, అతను తన ప్రాణాలను కూడా జోయాను రక్షించడంలో వేసుకుంటాడు.

ఎపిసోడ్లలో, పాత్రలు ప్రమాదకరమైన మరియు భావోద్వేగ పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాయి, ఇవి మానిప్యులేషన్, ద్రోహం, మరియు కుటుంబంలో శక్తి పోటీల చుట్టూ తిరుగుతాయి. జోయా యొక్క తల్లి వహీదా, తన కూతురికి మద్దతు ఇవ్వడమే కాకుండా, తల్లిగా అతనితో ఉన్న సంబంధంపై సందేహాలు కలిగిన పాత్రగా ఉంటారు.

mahamrityunjaya-mantra-healing-ka-ancien.title: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra: Healing Ka Ancient Code
mahamrityunjaya-mantra-healing-ka-ancien.description: Can an ancient mantra change the way we face fear and stress? For thousands of years, the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra has been associated with protection, courage and spiritual strength. But is its power purely spiritual, or could sound, meditation and psychology offer another perspective? From the legendary story of Markandeya to modern neuroscience, this series explores the mystery, meaning and enduring influence of one of India's most powerful mantras.

gumshuda-waris-1.title: Gumshuda Waris
gumshuda-waris-1.description: Ek gareeb baker Jay aplya saglya savings aaplya girlfriend Naina la deto, karan Naina tyachya sobat lagna publicly announce karaycha promise karte. Pan techa kharach tithach hot nahi – Jay ne design kelela unique ventilator Naina swatahya navane patent karun ghete. Ek public event madhye, jithe Naina Jay la sab samor dhokha dete, tithun suruvat hote Jay cha badla… Aani tya veles Jay cha sath ghete Maya – tyachya company chi billionaire CEO, ji pichle 15 varshapasun aaplya haravlela mulga shodhat hoti. Kahi Jayach Maya cha khoyla gela waris tar nahi? Kahi laplel ahe Jay cha bachpan? Aani kasa ghenar Jay Naina cha dhokhyacha hisaab?

economics-of-dowry.title: Economics Of Dowry
economics-of-dowry.description: కట్నం ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థపై గంభీర ప్రభావం చూపుతుంది. కుటుంబాలు ఎక్కువ మొత్తంలో కట్నం ఇవ్వడానికి లేదా స్వీకరించడానికి బలవంతంగా ఉన్నప్పుడు, ఆర్థిక ఒత్తిడి పెరుగుతుంది. ఈ విధానం సామాజిక, ఆర్థిక అశాంతి కలిగించడానికి దారితీయవచ్చు.

why-smart-people-fail.title: Why Smart People Fail?
why-smart-people-fail.description: Why do some of the smartest people struggle with success, relationships, and happiness? Why do brilliant minds overthink, fear failure, avoid risks, and feel stuck despite having immense potential? Why Smart People Fail is a cinematic self-improvement show that uncovers the hidden habits and psychological patterns holding capable people back. Through relatable stories, behavioural science, and practical exercises, this show helps you stop self-sabotaging and start unlocking your true potential.

gold-digger.title: Gold Digger
gold-digger.description: డబ్బు అంటే ఎంతో పిచ్చితో విలవిలాడే మాయ, విపరీతమైన డబ్బు ఉన్న వాడు అని భావించి శ్రీ హరిని అనే అబ్బాయిని బుట్టలో వెయ్యాలి అని అనుకుంటుంది, కానీ ప్రేమించాక తెలుస్తుంది,  శ్రీ హరి, బికారి అని తెలిసిన తర్వాత వదిలేస్తుంది. అప్పుడే శ్రీ హరికి  మరో ఊహించని మలుపులు తిరిగే సంఘటనలు జరుగుతాయి, అవి ఏంటి? శ్రీ హరి మాయ కలిసారా లేదా అనేది కథ.

contract-kanavan.title: Contract Kanavan
contract-kanavan.description:
மணநாளன்று வரன் தப்பியோட, அஞ்சனா திடீரென பார்கிங் ஊழியர் விக்ரம் தேவ்ராஜை திருமணம் செய்கிறாள். ஆனால் அவன் ஒரு கோடீஸ்வர வாரிசு என்பதறியவில்லை.

பொய் திருமணம் காதலாக மாற, மர்மங்கள் வெளிவர, உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது. அன்பும் தியாகமும் இணைந்து, இருவரும் தங்கள் காதலும் குழந்தையையும் காக்க போராடுகிறார்கள்.

karma-ka-hidden-science.title: Karma Ka Hidden Science
karma-ka-hidden-science.description: What if every choice you make is silently recorded by the universe? "Karma Ka Hidden Science" is a gripping docu-drama that blends the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita, Mahabharata, and ancient scriptures with a modern corporate thriller. Follow Arjun's journey as betrayal, guilt, destiny, and redemption reveal how every action becomes a karmic deposit—and why every account eventually reaches its maturity date

micro-habits.title: Micro Habits
micro-habits.description: നീട്ടിവെക്കുക അഥവാ പ്രൊകാസ്റ്റിനേഷൻ എന്ന് കേട്ടിട്ടുണ്ടോ?? ഇവൻ ചില്ലറക്കാരനല്ല , നമ്മുടെ ഗുഡ് ഹാബിറ്റ്‌സുകളെ കൂടെ കൂട്ടാനുള്ള ശ്രമങ്ങളെ തകിടം മറിക്കുന്ന ഒരു വലിയ ഭീകരനാണ്. അതെങ്ങനെ മറികടക്കാം?, എങ്ങനെ ചെറിയ ശീലങ്ങൾ ഒരു ദിവസം, ഒരു സമയം എന്ന രീതിയിൽ വളർത്തിയെടുക്കാം? എളുപ്പത്തിലും ആസ്വാദ്യകരമായ രീതിയിലും ചെറിയ ശീലങ്ങൾ അഥവാ മൈക്രോ ഹാബിറ്റ്സ് രൂപപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന അറിവുകളിലെക്ക് കടക്കാം.

rise-of-sultan.title: Rise of Sultan
rise-of-sultan.description: Shiva Singh, a humble mechanic ridiculed as a worthless ghar jamai, lives a life of humiliation with only his wife Riya standing by him. Everything changes when he accidentally kills a powerful politician's grandson while saving Riya from an assault. Hunted by the police and branded a murderer, Shiva uncovers a shocking truth—he is the hidden heir of the legendary underworld kingpin Sultan. As buried secrets surface, Shiva must rise from an insignificant nobody to the most feared man in Kanpur.

samudram.title: Samudram
samudram.description: సుమన మమూలు ఆడపిల్ల. తను జీవితంలో ఒక్కసారి కూడా సముద్రాన్ని చూడలేదు. అలాంటి అమ్మాయి జీవితాన్ని సముద్రం పూర్తిగా మార్చివేసింది. భూమి మీద మూతు వంతులు ఉన్న సముద్రంలో మనకు తెలియని రహస్యాలు ఎన్నో ఉన్నాయి. ఆ రహస్య ప్రపంచంలోని వింతలు, విశేషాలు, ఆకట్టుకునే అద్భుత కల్పనలు తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి "సముద్రం.." మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

dating-room.title: Dating room
dating-room.description: డేటింగ్ రూంలో మధురమైన జ్ఞాపకాలు దొరకాలి. అంతేకానీ జ్ఞాపకాలు మాయం అవకూడదు. అనుకోకుండా డేటింగ్ రూం కి వెళ్ళిన అంజలికి అనుకోని సంఘటన జరిగింది. ఇటు అర్జున్ జీవితంలో.. డేటింగ్ రూం వల్ల అనేక మార్పులు వచ్చాయి. డేటింగ్ రూం కి అంజలి ఎందుకు వెళ్ళాలనుకుంది? అర్జున్ లో వచ్చిన మార్పులు ఏంటి? వినండి డేటింగ్ రూం మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

krishna-the-master-of-human-psychology.title: Krishna: The Master Of Human Psychology
krishna-the-master-of-human-psychology.description:
Everyone knows Krishna. Few understand how he thought.

Krishna: The Master of Human Psychology uncovers the psychological brilliance behind the most iconic moments of Krishna's life—from Gokul to Kurukshetra to Dwarka. Discover how he influenced minds, resolved impossible conflicts, mastered emotions, leadership, negotiation, timing, and human behavior. This isn't mythology retold. It's the psychology of one of history's greatest strategists.

my-love-for-sex-worker.title: My Love for Sex Worker
my-love-for-sex-worker.description:
இலவசமாக உயர்கல்வி கற்கும் இடத்துக்கு அழைத்துச் செல்வதாகச் சொல்லி தன் மகளை பணத்திற்காக பாலியல் தொழிலில் தள்ளுகிறார் ஸ்ருதியின் தந்தை. அதிலிருந்து வெளிவர துடிக்கும் ஸ்ருதிக்கு வாய்ப்பில்லாமல் போகவே ஒருகட்டத்தில் அதையே தன் தொழிலாக ஏற்கிறாள்.
பிறகு, அங்கிருந்து வெளியேறி பாலியல் தொழிலைச் சொந்தமாகச் செய்யும் ஸ்ருதி, தன் அப்பாவுக்காக மதுபானம் வாங்க அடிக்கடி மதுபான கடைக்கு முகமூடி அணிந்து செல்கிறாள். அங்கு அவள் கண்களைப் பார்த்தே காதல் கொள்கிறான் அர்ஜுன் என்னும் வெப் டெவலப்பர். ஸ்ருதியிடம் அவன் காதலை வெளிப்படுத்தும்போது என்ன செய்வாள் ஸ்ருதி? பாலியல் தொழிலாளியை தன் மனைவியாக்க முயல்வானா அர்ஜுன்? ஒத்துக்கொண்டதா சமூகம்?

bhanumati.title: Bhanumati
bhanumati.description: ಭಾನುಮತಿ - ರಾಜನೀತಿ, ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಧರ್ಮದ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಘರ್ಷದ ಜೀವನ ಭಾನುಮತಿಯದ್ದು. ಅದು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳ ಕನ್ನಡಿಯೂ ಹೌದು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾನುಮತಿಯ ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನದ ಹೋರಾಟವೂ ಹೌದು.  ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ಪಟ್ಟದರಸಿ ಭಾನುಮತಿಯ ಶಾಪ ಒಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಗತಿಯನ್ನೇ ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಭಾನುಮತಿ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿ.

the-dark-psychology-of-social-media.title: The Dark Psychology Of Social Media
the-dark-psychology-of-social-media.description: Kya hoga agar aapka phone sirf ek device nahi, balki aapki attention ko control karne wali machine ho? Har notification, recommendation aur har endless scroll ko is tarah design kiya gaya hai ki aap zyada se zyada der tak screen par bane rahein. Dark Psychology of Social Media ek cinematic show hai jo social media ke peeche chhupe addiction, influence, comparison aur manipulation ke secrets ko expose karta hai. Kyunki aaj ki sabse badi jung duniya se nahi, humare dimaag ke andar chal rahi hai.

detective-ajay-night-of-double-cross.title: Detective Ajay: Night of Double Cross
detective-ajay-night-of-double-cross.description: ಈ ಹಿಂದೆ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಸರಣಿ ಆತ್ಮಹತ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನ ಕೊಲೆಗಳು ಅಂತ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿದು, ಕೊಲೆಗಾರರನ್ನ ಹಿಡಿಯೋದ್ರಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದ ಫೇಮಸ್‌ ಡಿಟೆಕ್ಟಿವ್‌ ಅಜಯ್‌ ಹೊಸ ಕೇಸ್‌ನ ಕೈಗೆತ್ತಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಲಖ್ನೋ ನಗರದ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಹೋಟೆಲ್‌ ಉದ್ಯಮಿ ಅಜಿತ್‌ ಕಪೂರ್‌ ಬರ್ಬರವಾಗಿ ಕೊಲೆಯಾಗ್ತಾನೆ. ಕಪೂರ್‌ ಕೊಲೆ ಬೆನ್ನಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಪ್ರಾಂಶುಪಾಲರೊಬ್ಬರು ನಿಗೂಢವಾಗಿ ಕೊಲೆಯಾಗ್ತಾರೆ. ಶಾರ್ಪ್‌ ಇನ್ವೆಸ್ಟಿಗೇಷನ್‌ ಮಾಡೋ ಅಜಯ್‌ಗೆ, ಕೊಲೆಯಾದ ಅಜಿತ್‌ ಕಪೂರ್‌ಗೆ ಮಹಿಳೆಯೊಬ್ಬಳ ಜೊತೆ ಅಕ್ರಮ ಸಂಬಂಧವಿರೋದು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತೆ. ಕೊಲೆಗಾರ ಮಾಡ್ತಿರೋ ಸರಣಿ ಕೊಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಕ್ಕೊಂದು ಲಿಂಕ್‌ ಇದೆ ಅಂತ ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ಅಜಯ್, ಕೊಲೆಗಳ ರಹಸ್ಯವನ್ನ ಭೇದಿಸ್ತಾನಾ? ಡಿಟೆಕ್ಟಿವ್‌ ಸರಣಿಯ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ, ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವಿರೇಳಿಸೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "Detective ಅಜಯ್‌: Night of Double Cross" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

the-key-to-success.title: The Key to Success
the-key-to-success.description: சந்தோஷமும் வெற்றியும் எப்பவுமே நமக்கானது தான். அத பக்கத்துல வச்சிக்கிட்டே நாம தேடிட்டு இருக்கோம்ன்னு சொன்னா உங்களால நம்ப முடியுமா? முடியாதுல?  இந்த புக் இந்த நொடி உங்களுக்காக காத்திருக்கு. I mean, வெற்றி உங்களுக்காக காத்திருக்கு. அத அப்டியே ரெண்டு கைலயும் அள்ளிக்க நீங்க ரெடியா?

shani-ka-prakop-se-kaise-bache.title: Shani Ke Prakop Se Kaise Bache?
shani-ka-prakop-se-kaise-bache.description:
Is Shani really the planet of punishment—or the greatest teacher of transformation?
This series explores the deeper meaning behind Shani through astrology, psychology, and Hindu mythology. From career setbacks and financial struggles to loneliness, health, delayed marriage, and Sade Sati, every episode reveals how life's toughest phases can become opportunities for discipline, resilience, and personal growth. A practical journey into karma, mindset, and inner transformation.

secret-nawaab.title: Secret Nawaab
secret-nawaab.description:
വീട്ടുകാർ നിശ്ചയിച്ചു ഉറപ്പിച്ച വിവാഹത്തിൽ നിന്നും രക്ഷപ്പെടാൻ ശ്രേയ സരസ്വത് എന്ന കോടീശ്വരി അന്ന് തന്റെ കൂടെ ഫ്‌ളൈറ്റിൽ കണ്ടുമുട്ടിയ കൺസ്ട്രക്ഷൻ വർക്കറിനോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടത് ത് ഒരേ ഒരു കാര്യം മാത്രമാണ്... അതിനു മാസ ശമ്പളം 10 ലക്ഷം! അവൻ ആ ഓഫർ സ്വീകരിക്കുമോ? സത്യത്തിൽ
എന്തായിരുന്നു ശ്രേയയുടെ ഉദ്ദേശം?? അറിയാനയി ക്കേൾക്കൂ..

career-ka-cosmic-code.title: Career Ka Cosmic Code
career-ka-cosmic-code.description: Why do some people thrive in corporate jobs while others become entrepreneurs? Why do some careers bloom late, while others collapse despite talent? Career Ka Cosmic Code explores fascinating career patterns through Vedic astrology, blending real-life stories, psychological insights, and practical guidance. Every episode investigates one career mystery and decodes how planetary influences may shape your professional journey, helping you understand your strengths and make smarter career decisions

most-notorious-gangs-in-the-world.title: Most Notorious Gangs In The World
most-notorious-gangs-in-the-world.description:
ఈ షోలో ప్రపంచంలోని అత్యంత ఘోరమైన గ్యాంగ్స్ గురించి తెలుసుకోండి. వారి ఏర్పడటం, కార్యకలాపాలు, మానవ వాణిజ్యం, గంజాయితీ, ఎక్స్‌టార్షన్ వంటి దారుణమైన అపరాధాలకు ఎలా పాల్పడుతున్నారో తెలుసుకోండి.
ఈ షోలో మీరు వ్యవస్థలు, అంతర్జాతీయ గ్యాంగ్ లీడర్స్, మరియు వారి క్రిమినల్ పద్ధతులను చూస్తారు. వారి విఘాతం, చీకటి రాజకీయాలు, మరియు ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా వారి ప్రభావం అన్వేషించబడుతుంది.

IPL-ലെ-മലയാളി-താരകങ്ങൾ-.title: IPL ലെ മലയാളി താരകങ്ങൾ
IPL-ലെ-മലയാളി-താരകങ്ങൾ-.description: സുപരിചിതമായ ഒന്നോ രണ്ടോ പേരുകൾക്ക് അപ്പുറം IPL വേദിയിലെ ഗാലറികളെ പോലും തകർത്തുമറിച്ച മല്ലു ബോയ്സിനെക്കുറിച്ച് ഇനിയും അറിയാൻ വൈകണ്ട...കേൾക്കൂ IPL വേദിയിലെ മലയാളി താരകങ്ങൾ!

aditya-hridayam-comeback-ka-mantra.title: Aditya Hridayam: Comeback Ka Mantra
aditya-hridayam-comeback-ka-mantra.description: What gave Lord Ram the strength to rise when defeat seemed certain? Aditya Hridayam: Failure Ke Baad Wapas Khada Hone Ka Mantra decodes one of Hinduism's most powerful stotras through the lens of resilience, discipline, confidence, and mental strength. Blending mythology, psychology, neuroscience, and practical life lessons, this series explores how an ancient mantra can help you overcome failure, self-doubt, burnout, and rebuild yourself from within.

mahabharathada-mahileyaru.title: Mahabharathada Mahileyaru
mahabharathada-mahileyaru.description: "ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು" ಎಂಬ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಾಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿನ ಸ್ರ್ತೀ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿರಿ. ಸತ್ಯವತಿಯ ಮಹತ್ವಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆ, ಕುಂತಿಯ ರಹಸ್ಯ, ಶಿಖಂಡಿಯ ಸೇಡು - ಹೀಗೆ ಅನೇಕ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು ಮಹಾಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ನಿರ್ಣಾಯಕವಾದ ಪಾತ್ರವನ್ನು ವಹಿಸಿದ್ದರು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಒಬ್ಬ ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯ ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ. ಪುರುಷಪ್ರಧಾನ ಕಥನದಿಂದ ಹೊರಬಂದು, ಇವರ ಧೈರ್ಯ, ತ್ಯಾಗ, ಮತ್ತು ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಂಡ ಪುಟಗಳಿಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ.

conscious-living-for-personal-growth.title: Conscious Living for Personal Growth
conscious-living-for-personal-growth.description: ದಿನಾ ಓಡಾಟ, ಚಿಂತೆ, ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಬಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಹೊಸ ದಾರಿ ತೋರಿಸೋ  ಶೋ ಇದು! ಧ್ಯಾನದ ಸರಳ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು, ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಚಿಂತೆ ದೂರ ಮಾಡೋ ಟಿಪ್ಸ್, ಮತ್ತು ಸಂತೋಷವಾಗಿರೋ ಹಳೇ-ಹೊಸ ಉಪಾಯಗಳನ್ನ ಹೇಳ್ತೀವಿ. "ಕಾನ್ಸಿಯಸ್ ಲಿವಿಂಗ್" ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಗೊಂದಲ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸೋ ಯೋಚನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಎಡೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡದೆ, ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ನಿದ್ದೆ ಮಾಡಕ್ಕೆ, ಹೆಂಡತಿ-ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಜೊತೆ ಸಮಾಧಾನವಾಗಿರಕ್ಕೆ, ದುಡ್ಡು-ದುಮ್ಮಾನದ ಚಿಂತೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಖುಷಿಯಾಗಿರಲು ಕಲಿಸುತ್ತೆ.ಅಂದಹಾಗೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಶೋ ಕೇಳಿದ್ರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಲೆ ಬಿಸಿ ಹೋಗಿ, ಮನಸ್ಸು ತಣ್ಣಗಾಗಿ, ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತೆ ನೆಟ್ಟಗಾಗ್ತದೆ! ಬನ್ನಿ, ನಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ ಸೇರಿ! ಕೇಳಿ "ಕಾನ್ಸಿಯಸ್ ಲಿವಿಂಗ್ ಫಾರ್ ಪರ್ಸನಲ್ ಗ್ರೋಥ್" ಶೋ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

the-indians-who-changed-everything.title: The Indians Who Changed Everything
the-indians-who-changed-everything.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki aaj ka Bharat un logon ki wajah se bana hai jinke naam hum aksar jaante hi nahi? Kisi ne digital payments ka tareeka badal diya, kisi ne duniya ko India ki talent power dikhayi, aur kisi ne apni poori zindagi dusron ke liye samarpit kar di. The Indians Who Changed Everything ek cinematic audio docu-drama hai, jo un aam Bharatiyon ki asadharan kahaniyan sunata hai jinki soch, himmat aur niswarth karmon ne poore desh ki takdeer badal di.

indra-deva-shakthi-swartha-mathu-vivada.title: Indra Deva: Shakthi, Swartha Mathu Vivada
indra-deva-shakthi-swartha-mathu-vivada.description: ಇಂದ್ರ ದೇವ - ಶಕ್ತಿ, ಸ್ವಾರ್ಥ ಮತ್ತು ವಿವಾದಾತ್ಮಕ ದೇವರು... ಸ್ವರ್ಗಲೋಕದ ಅಧಿಪತಿ ಇಂದ್ರನ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಚರಿತ್ರೆ. ಇಂದ್ರ ತನ್ನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಚಾರಣೆಯನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವುದರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕಥೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಋಷಿ ಗೌತಮ, ವಿಶ್ವಕರ್ಮ, ಕಾರ್ತಿಕೇಯ, ಯಯಾತಿ ಮುಂತಾದ ವಿವಿಧ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಗಳು ಇಂದ್ರನ ಹಲವಾರು ವಿವಾದಾತ್ಮಕ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಯಲು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ದೇವತೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ಮಾನವನಂತೆ ಅನಿಸಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಇಂದ್ರನ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆಯನ್ನು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿ ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಭ್ರಷ್ಟತೆ, ಕರ್ಮದ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಯಶ್ಚಿತ್ತದ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸುವ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿ ಕೇಳುಗರನ್ನು ಮಂತ್ರಮುಗ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

money-mistakes-in-20s-30s.title: Money Mistakes in 20s & 30s
money-mistakes-in-20s-30s.description: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ 20-30ರ ಆಸುಪಾಸಿನ ವಯಸ್ಸಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಆರ್ಥಿಕವಾಗಿ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರರಾಗೋ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿರ್ತಾರೆ. ಆಗಷ್ಟೇ ಓದು ಮುಗಿಸಿ, ಕೈಯಲ್ಲೊಂದು ಕೆಲಸ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಹೀಗಿರ್ವಾಗ ಬಂದ ಹಣವನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾಕೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಗೊತ್ತಿರ್ಬೇಕು. ಇಲ್ಲವಾದ್ರೆ ಈ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ‌ ಮಾಡಿದ ತಪ್ಪಿನಿಂದಾಗಿ, ಇಡೀ ಜೀವನ ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಸಾಲದ ಸುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕಬೇಕಾದ ದುಃಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಎದುರಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ದುಡ್ಡನ್ನ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸೋದ್ರ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಬಳಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಉಳಿಕೆ ಹೇಗೆ? ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್, ಇನ್ಶುರೆನ್ಸ್, ಟ್ಯಾಕ್ಸ್, ಎಫ್ ಡಿ, ಎಮರ್ಜೆನ್ಸಿ ಫಂಡ್, ಪ್ರಾಪರ್ಟಿ ಪರ್ಚೇಸ್ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್ ಮಾಡೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಚಿಂತೆ ಬಿಡಿ.. 'Money Mistakes in 20s & 30s' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ. Learn, Earn & Return ಪಾಲಿಸಿ ಫಾಲೋ ಮಾಡಿ..

shaapit-mohabbat.title: Shaapit Mohabbat
shaapit-mohabbat.description: शलाड़ गाँव में एक के बाद एक हो रहे रहस्यमयी कत्ल उस अधूरी मोहब्बत की दास्तान को फिर ज़िंदा कर देते हैं, जिसे ज़ुल्म, धोखे और सत्ता ने दफना दिया था। रुद्र और तारा की मौत के बाद पहाड़ों में भटकती रूहों की कहानियाँ हर किसी को डरा रही हैं। लेकिन क्या सचमुच कोई आत्मा अपने अधूरे इश्क़ का बदला लेने लौटी है... या इन खौफनाक मौतों के पीछे सदियों से छिपा कोई ऐसा राज़ है, जो पूरे गाँव को तबाह कर देगा?

the-money-master.title: The Money Master
the-money-master.description: ஒரு சின்ன ஈகோ நம்மள எங்க கொண்டு போய் நிறுத்திடுது... இந்த வாழ்க்கைல நம்ம பல மனிதர்கள கடந்து வந்து இருந்தாலும், அதுல இருக்க கூடிய சுவாரசியம் மட்டும் எப்போதும் குறைஞ்சது கிடையாது. இந்த வாழ்க்கையோட தத்தவம் தான் என்ன? தெரிஞ்சுக்க கேளுங்க மனி மாஸ்டர்

super-hero-dad.title: Super Hero Dad
super-hero-dad.description: നക്ഷത്ര എന്ന കൊച്ചുപെൺകുട്ടി തന്റെ അച്ഛനായ മാനവിനോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടത് സുന്ദരിയും ആയോധന കലകളിൽ അഗ്രഗണ്യയുമായ ദുർഗ എന്ന കുങ്ഫു മാസ്റ്ററെ ആണ്. എന്നാൽ ആ അമ്മയെ തന്റെ മോൾക്ക്‌ സ്വന്തമാക്കിക്കൊടുക്കാൻ  മാനവിന് മുന്നിൽ ഒരേയൊരു വഴി മാത്രമേയുള്ളൂ... ഇടിച്ചു തോൽപ്പിക്കുക!!

bewafa-juliet.title: Bewafa Juliet
bewafa-juliet.description: Everyone believes the woman he loved betrayed him. He believes she's hiding a terrifying truth. With nothing left to lose, he risks his life on a deadly illegal journey where every clue uncovers a darker mystery. Packed with romance, suspense, shocking twists, and relentless survival, Bewafa Juliet will keep you questioning one thing until the very end—is she truly unfaithful?

contract-preethi.title: Contract Preethi
contract-preethi.description: ಅದಿಶಾ, ಫ್ಯಾಷನ್‌ ಡಿಸೈನರ್‌ . ಅವತ್ತು ಅವ್ಳ್‌ ಅಕ್ಕನ್‌ ಎಂಗೇಜ್ಮೆಂಟ್.‌ ಆದ್ರೆ ಅವತ್ತೆ ಅವ್ಳ್‌ ಅದೃಷ್ಟ ಹಾಳಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಯಾಕಂದ್ರೆ ಅವ್ಳ್‌ ಅವತ್‌ ಯಾರೊ ಪರ್ಚಯನೇ ಇಲ್ದಿರೊ ಹ್ಯಾಂಡ್ಸಮ್‌ ಹುಡ್ಗನ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಳ್ದಿದ್ಲು. ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಎಚ್ಚರ ಆದಾಗ ಅವ್ಳೊಂದ್‌ ಹೋಟೆಲ್‌ ಸೂಟಲ್‌ ಇದ್ಲು. ಅವ್ಳ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ಅವತ್ತು ಆ ಬೆಡ್ಡಲ್‌ ಇದ್ದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ ಚಕ್ರವರ್ತಿ. ಚಕ್ರವರ್ತಿ ಫ್ಯಾಬುಲಸ್‌ ವರ್ಲ್ಡ್‌ನ ಪ್ರೆಸಿಡೆಂಟ್.‌ ಅವ್ನ್‌ ಜೀವ್ನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿಯಾಗ್‌ ದ್ವೇಷ ಮಾಡೊ ವಿಷ್ಯ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನ ಮುಟ್ಟೋದು. ಬಟ್‌ ಅನ್‌ಫಾರ್ಚುನೇಟ್ಲಿ, ಹಿಂದಿನ್‌ ದಿನ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಒಬ್ಳು ಹುಡ್ಗಿ ಜೊತೆ ಫಿಸಿಕಲಿ ಮೂವ್‌ ಆಗಿದ್ದ. ತನ್‌ ಬೆಡ್ಡಲ್ಲಿ ರಾತ್ರಿಯಿಡೀ ಇರೊ ಆ ಹುಡ್ಗಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ್ರೆ ಅವ್ಳಿಗ್‌ ಹಾರ್ಡ್‌ ಪನಿಶ್ಮೆಂಟ್‌ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂತ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದ. ಖಂಡಿತ ಅವ್ನು ಅವ್ಳಿಗ್‌ ನರ್ಕ ತೋರ್ಸ್ತಿದ್ದ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅದಿಶಾಗೆ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ ಏನ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ. ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ ಕೈಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ಅದಿಶಾ ಏನ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ತಾಳೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳೊಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಕಾಂಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟ್‌ ಲವ್‌ - ಒಂದು ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಪಯಣ

bolna-hi-hai-1.title: Bolna Hi Hai
bolna-hi-hai-1.description: Ramon Magsaysay Award-winning journalist Ravish Kumar's Bolna Hi Hai — a sharp, unflinching examination of free speech suppression, rising intolerance, and the erosion of democracy in India. How media, elected representatives, and institutions are failing us — and how we can find a way forward. A must-read document of our times, now available in audio for the first time!

i-am-sorry-matte-ba-preethsona.title: I am Sorry! Matte Ba Preethsona
i-am-sorry-matte-ba-preethsona.description: 'ಸುಶ್ಮಿತಾ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜೇಂದ್ರ', ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿ ಮದುವೆಯಾದವ್ರು. ತಮ್ಮ ಬದುಕಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನ ಕಂಡವ್ರು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅನುರೂಪದ ಈ ಜೋಡಿಯ ಮಧ್ಯೆಯೇ ಬಿರುಕುಂಟಾಗಿತ್ತು! ಒಬ್ಬರನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರು ನೋಡಿದ್ರೆ, ಸಹಿಸಲಾಗದ ದ್ವೇಷ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿತ್ತು! ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ ಅದೊಂದು ಆ್ಯಕ್ಸಿಡೆಂಟ್! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಆ ಅಪಘಾತ ಸಂಭವಿಸಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಸುಶ್ಮಿತಾ ಜೀವನ್ಮರಣ ಹೋರಾಟ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ರೂ, ರಾಜೇಂದ್ರ ಕಲ್ಲು ಹೃದಯಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ಯಾಕೆ? ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಬಂದ 'ಶಿವಾನಿ' ಯಾರು? ಕೇಳಿ ಮನಮುಟ್ಟುವ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆ 'I am Sorry! ಮತ್ತೆ ಬಾ ಪ್ರೀತ್ಸೋಣ'. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

doddmane-hudugaru.title: Doddmane Hudugaru
doddmane-hudugaru.description:
ತನ್ನ ತಂದೆಯ ಎಪ್ಪತ್ತೈದನೇ ಹುಟ್ಟುಹಬ್ಬದ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದ ಇಂಚರಾಳಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ತಂಗಿಯರಿಂದ ಅವಮಾನ ಮತ್ತು ವಿರೋಧ ಎದುರಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶ್ರೀಮಂತರಾಗಿರುವ ತನ್ನ ಮಕ್ಕಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅವಳು ಮನೆಯವರ ಮುಂದೆ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲು ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
ಕುಟುಂಬ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು, ಆಸ್ತಿ ವಿವಾದ, ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ಷಮಾಪಣೆಯ ತೀವ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಈ ಕಥೆ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಹಳೆಯ ಗಾಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಬಯಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಗತಿಶೀಲತೆಯು ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
