ಕೇಳಿ "ದೊಡ್ಡಮನೆ ಹುಡುಗರು" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ

blackout-2.title: Blackout
blackout-2.description: A crime journalist's investigation into a murder during recurring citywide blackouts leads him to a mysterious woman and a ten-year-old secret that could rewrite reality itself.

my-boyfriend-is-cricketer.title: My Boyfriend is Cricketer
my-boyfriend-is-cricketer.description:
ಒಂದು ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪತ್ರಕರ್ತೆಯ ನಡುವಿನ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಸ್ಪೆನ್ಸ್ ತುಂಬಿದ ಕಥಾನಕ. ಸಿದ್ದಾರ್ಥ್, ಭಾರತ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಲೋಕದ ಸ್ಟಾರ್, ಮತ್ತು ದೀಪಿಕಾ, ತೆಜಸ್ವಿ ಪತ್ರಕರ್ತೆ
ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಬದುಕು ತಿರುವು ಪಡೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಒಂದು ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಪ್ರೆಸ್ ಕಾನ್ಫರೆನ್ಸ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ. ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ನೋಡಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗುವ ಈ ಸ್ಟೋರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆ, ಅಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯಗಳ ಜಟಿಲತೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು ಹೀಗೇಕೆ ಹೆಣಗಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗುತ್ತವೆ? ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಬೆಲೆ ಎಷ್ಟು? ಈ ಸ್ಟೋರಿಯ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಅದರ ತೀವ್ರತೆ ಮತ್ತು ತಿರುವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಇದೊಂದು ಆಧುನಿಕ ಪ್ರೇಮಗಾಥೆಯ ಜತೆಗೆ ಸಸ್ಪೆನ್ಸ್ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಆಗಿಯೂ ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ!

a-guide-from-10th-to-phd.title: A Guide From 10th to PhD
a-guide-from-10th-to-phd.description: ఈ షోలో మీరు విద్యా ప్రస్థానంలో ప్రతి దశను సులభంగా అర్థం చేసుకోగలుగుతారు. 10వ తరగతి నుంచి పీహెచ్.డీ వరకు కావాల్సిన పరిజ్ఞానం, ప్రేరణ, మరియు వ్యూహాలు మీకు అర్థం చేయబడతాయి. విద్యా వ్యవస్థలో ఉన్న ముఖ్యమైన అడ్డంకులు, అవకాశాలు, మరియు వాటిని అధిగమించడానికి అనుసరించాల్సిన పథకాలు ఈ షోలో వివరిస్తాము. ప్రతిభ పెంపొందించే పాఠాలు, ప్రశ్నలకు సమాధానాలు, మరియు ప్రాధాన్యమైన సలహాలు ఈ షోలో అందుబాటులో ఉంటాయి.

code-404-death-warrant.title: Code 404 : Death Warrant
code-404-death-warrant.description: When celebrated AI journalist Nitika Arora is found dead under mysterious circumstances, former AI prodigy Shaurya Sen is pulled back into the secret project he abandoned five years ago. As deepfakes, hacked identities, and a rogue AI called "404" begin targeting the nation, Shaurya must uncover the truth before an invisible enemy turns technology into humanity's deadliest weapon.

sudaril-malarntha-kaathal.title: Sudaril Malarntha Kaathal
sudaril-malarntha-kaathal.description: அனாதை ஆசிரமம் வைத்திருக்கும் இனியனும் ஆதிராவும் உயிருக்கு உயிராக விரும்புகிறார்கள். ஆதிராவின் பெற்றோர்கள் சம்மதத்தோடு இருவரும் திருமணம் செய்ய முடிவு செய்ய, சரியாக இனியன் தாலி கட்ட போகும் நேரத்தில், ஊரே கண்டு நடுங்கும் ருத்ரன் மாப்பிள்ளை கோலத்தில் மண்டபத்தில் நுழைந்து இனியன் வைத்திருந்த தாலியை தட்டி பறித்து, ஆதிராவின் கழுத்தில் கட்டுகிறான். தொடர்ந்து காரணமின்றி இனியனை போலீசார் அரெஸ்ட் செய்கிறார்கள். இதெற்கெல்லாம் என்ன காரணம் என்று கூட தெரியாமல் திகைத்து நிற்கும் ஆதிராவை வலுக்கட்டாயமாக அனைவர் முன்னிலும் தூக்கி செல்கிறான் ருத்ரன். யார் இந்த ருத்ரன்... எதற்காக அவன் ஆதிராவை திருமணம் செய்தான்? இனியனை ஏன் போலீஸ் அரெஸ்ட் செய்தது? இனி ஆதிராவின் நிலை என்ன?

dear-crush.title: Dear crush
dear-crush.description: மதுமிதா கொரியன் கல்சரில் மூழ்கி இருக்கும் சரியான வாலு பொண்ணு... கொரியா போகணும், அங்க இருக்க அழகான பையன லவ் பண்ணி கல்யாணம் பண்ணனும் என்று கனவு கண்டு இருப்பவள். இன்னொருபக்கம் அவளது  சிறுவயது நண்பன் பிராகாஷ்க்கோ அவள் மீது கண்ணா பின்னா ஒன்சைட் லவ்... ஆனா அதை சொல்லும் போது மதுமிதா சக்சப்ட் பண்ணுவாளா... இல்ல கொரியா மோகத்தால அவன் லவ்வுக்கு நோ சொல்லுவாளா...

nagvansh.title: Nagvansh
nagvansh.description: When the evil witch Shanichari is resurrected, she unleashes terror to destroy the ancient Naagvansh and reclaim ultimate power. At the same time, Gauri encounters the legendary seven-hooded Kaal Naag, while the fearless Bhuvan discovers a mysterious bond with serpents and hints of a forgotten royal destiny. As undead armies rise, hidden prophecies unfold, and the secret of the powerful Naagmani emerges, an age-old war between humans and the serpent kingdom begins.

avakaya-biryani.title: Avakaya Biryani
avakaya-biryani.description: టేస్టులు కలిస్తేనే ప్రేమ కుదురుతుందని అంటారు. కానీ టేస్టులు వేరైనా ప్రేమ పుడుతుందని ఆవకాయ బిర్యానీ వింటే తెలుస్తుంది. నాన్ వెజ్ అంటే నాలుక కోసుకునే అమ్మాయి మిత్ర.. మాంసం స్మెల్ కూడా పడని అబ్బాయి విశ్వకి ఎలా పడింది? అమె నిజంగానే పడిందా..? మోసం చేయాలనుకున్న అమ్మాయి నుండి తప్పించుకుని విశ్వ మళ్ళీ మోసపోయాడా..? ట్విస్టులు, టర్నులతో సరాదాగా సాగిపోయే కథ.. ఆవకాయ బిర్యానీ.. వినండి మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

forty-rules-of-love.title: Forty Rules of Love
forty-rules-of-love.description: The Forty Rules of Love by Elif Shafak is a transformative journey inspired by the divine love of Rumi and his spiritual bond with Shams of Tabriz. Weaving together the past and present, this soulful audiobook invites you to open your heart, embrace love in all its forms, and discover the deeper meaning of life!

oka-revenge-prema-katha.title: Oka Revenge Prema Katha
oka-revenge-prema-katha.description: అరేంజ్ మ్యారేజ్ ఉంటుంది, లవ్ మ్యారేజ్ ఉంటుంది. రివేంజ్ మ్యారేజ్ ఎక్కడా ఉండదు. తన తల్లికి అన్యాయం చేసిన ఫేమస్ బిజినెస్ మ్యాన్ శరత్ కుమార్ మీద పగ తీర్చుకోవడానికి రివేంజ్ మ్యారేజ్ కి సిద్ధపడతాడు వాసుదేవ్. లెక్చరర్ గా పనిచేస్తున్న వాసుదేవ్, రివేంజ్ మ్యారేజ్ చేసుకున్నాడా..? అతని తల్లి వేదవతికి జరిగిన అన్యాయం ఏంటి? రివేంజ్ మ్యారేజ్ వల్ల బలైన అమ్మాయి ఎవరు? వినండి ఒక రివేంజ్ ప్రేమకథ మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

aa-karaala-rathri.title: Aa Karaala Rathri
aa-karaala-rathri.description: 'ಪ್ರಣತಿ' ಹದಿನೆಂಟರ ಹರೆಯದ ಸೈಕಾಲಜಿ ಸ್ಟೂಡೆಂಟ್. ಕಾಫಿ ಶಾಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ, ತನ್ನ ಕಾಲೇಜಿಗೆ ಬೇಕಾದ ಖರ್ಚನ್ನ ತಾನೇ ನಿಭಾಯಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ತಿರೋ ಸ್ಟ್ರಾಂಗ್, ಬ್ಯೂಟಿಫುಲ್ ಅಂಡ್ ಇಂಡಿಪೆಂಡೆಂಟ್ ಗರ್ಲ್. ಇಂಥ ಮುದ್ದಾದ ಬೆಡಗಿಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದವನೇ ಚಾರ್ಮಿಂಗ್ ಹಾಗೂ ಡ್ಯಾಶಿಂಗ್ 'ಪಾರ್ಥ'. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅವನು ಒಂದು ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಜೀವಿ! ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಗುಂಪಿನ, ವಿಶೇಷ ಸುಗಂಧ ಹೊಂದಿರೋ ಪರ್ಫೆಕ್ಟ್ ಜೋಡಿಗಾಗಿ ಅವನು ಹುಡುಕಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಇಂಥ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ರೂಪದ ಬೇರೆ ಜೀವಿಯಾದ ಪಾರ್ಥನಿಗೆ ಕನೆಕ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿರೋ ಪ್ರಣತಿ ಕಥೆ ಏನು? ಇಬ್ಬರ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಯಾವ ತಿರುವು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತೆ? 'ಆಲ್ಫಾ' ಆಗಿರೋ ಪಾರ್ಥನೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಮನುಷ್ಯಳಾದ ಪ್ರಣತಿ ಬದುಕೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ? ಕೇಳಿ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲಿಂಗ್ ಅಂಡ್ ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'ಆ ಕರಾಳ ರಾತ್ರಿ'.

sati-case-of-roop-kanwar.title: Sati Case of Roop Kanwar
sati-case-of-roop-kanwar.description: In 1987, the death of 18-year-old Roop Kanwar on her husband's funeral pyre shocked the nation and reignited one of India's most controversial debates. Was it an act of faith, a forced ritual, or a murder hidden behind tradition?

lady-boss.title: Lady Boss
lady-boss.description: ಶಾನ್ವಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸ್ಟ್ರಾಂಗ್  ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವವಿರುವ ಹುಡುಗಿ. ಆರು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಮಧುವನ್ನು ಬೇರೊಬ್ಬ ಹುಡುಗಿಯ ಜೊತೆ ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ಕೋಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಬೇಕಾದ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಶಾನ್ವಿಗೆ ಎದುರಾಯಿತು. ಇನ್ನೂ ದುಃಖದ ಸಂಗತಿ ಏನೆಂದರೆ, ಆ ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ರೂಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧು ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಇದ್ದವಳು ಶಾನ್ವಿಯ ತಂದೆಯ ಎರಡನೇ ಹೆಂಡತಿಯ ಮಗಳು, ಅವಳ ತಂಗಿ ಸಿತಾರಾ. ತನ್ನವರಿಂದಲೇ ಅವಮಾನಿತಲಾದ ಶಾನ್ವಿ, ತೀವ್ರ ನಶೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವಾಗ, ಪ್ರಣವದಿತ್ಯ ಗ್ರೂಪ್ ಆಫ್ ಕಂಪನೀಸ್‌ನ ಮುಖ್ಯಸ್ಥ, ದಿ ಗ್ರೇಟ್ ಪ್ರಣವ್ ಜೊತೆ ಒಂದು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಳೆಯಲು ಮ್ಯಾರೇಜ್ ಅಗ್ರಿಮೆಂಟ್ ಮೇಲೆ  ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕವಾಗಿ ನಡೆದ ಆ ಮದುವೆ ಶಾನ್ವಿಯನ್ನು ಯಾವ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ? ಶಾನ್ವಿ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೇಗೆ ಶತ್ರುವಾಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ? ಶಾನ್ವಿಯ ತಂದೆ ಎರಡನೇ ಮದುವೆ ಯಾಕಾದರೂ? ಶಾನ್ವಿಯ ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಆಗಿದ್ದ ಅನ್ಯಾಯವೇನು? ಶಾನ್ವಿ ತನ್ನ ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಆಗಿದ್ದ ಅನ್ಯಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ರತೀಕಾರ ತೀರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ? ಇದನೆಲ್ಲ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ "ಲೇಡಿ ಬಾಸ್" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

മധുരപ്രതികാരം.title: മധുരപ്രതികാരം
മധുരപ്രതികാരം.description: തടി ഒരു പ്രശ്നമാണോ? തടിച്ചിയായ മേഘയെ തന്റെ ഭർത്താവ് രോഹൻ ഒഴിവാക്കിയത് ആർക്ക് വേണ്ടിയാകാം... രോഹന്റെ ജീവിതത്തിലേക്ക് മറ്റൊരാൾ വരുമ്പോൾ മേഘയുടെ രക്ഷകനായി എത്തിയ കളിക്കൂട്ടുകാരനായ ആ മില്യണയറുമായി മേഘ പ്രണയത്തിലാകുമോ... എല്ലാ അവഹേളനങ്ങൾക്കും ഒടുവിൽ ഒരു ഫാറ്റ് ലേഡിയുടെ സ്വീറ്റ് റിവേഞ്ചിനായി... കേൾക്കൂ.

aarav-awasthy-the-ghost-hunter.title: Aarav Awasthy: The Ghost Hunter
aarav-awasthy-the-ghost-hunter.description: 12 saal ki umar mein Aarav Awasthy ko apni behen ki hatya ka doshi aur shrapit samajhkar gaon se nikaal diya jaata hai. 15 saal baad, Pandit Aarav sach ki talaash mein lautkar dekhta hai ki poora gaon shamshaan ban chuka hai. Ab use us chudail, behen ki maut aur gaon ke vinaash ke peeche chhupe khaufnaak raaz ka saamna karna hoga.

vishwaroobam-mother-of-3-bigshots.title: Vishwaroobam: Mother of 3 bigshots
vishwaroobam-mother-of-3-bigshots.description:
கல்லூரியில் படித்த தன் மூத்த மகள் யாமினியை செல்வம் என்பவன் பாலியல் பலாத்காரம் செய்துவிட, அவனுக்கே தன் பெண்ணை திருமணம் செய்துவைக்கிறார் குடிகார தந்தை அகிலாந்திரன்.
விருப்பம் இல்லாத திருமணம், 3 பிள்ளைகள், விருப்பம் இல்லாத விவாகரத்து என நடுத்தெருவுக்கு வருகிறார் யாமினி. 
பதினெட்டு வருடங்களுக்கு பிறகு தன் தந்தையின் எழுபதாவது பிறந்தநாள் பார்ட்டிக்கு அழைக்கப்படுகிறார் யாமினி. மீண்டும் பெற்றவர்களை சந்திக்க மகிழ்ச்சியாக செல்லும் யாமினியை மொத்த குடும்பமும் பார்ட்டியில் வைத்து பிச்சைக்காரி என அவமானப்படுத்துகிறது. ஆனால் அவரது பையன்கள் மூவரும் இந்தியாவின் யாராலும் தொட முடியாத சக்தி வாய்ந்த கோடீஸ்வரர்கள் என்று தெரிந்தால் அடுத்து என்ன நடக்கும்?

supreme-1.title: Supreme
supreme-1.description: ಆದಿತ್ಯ ಒಬ್ಬ ಯುವ ಮತ್ತು ಡೈನಾಮಿಕ್ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಈ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಒಂದು ಚೆಸ್ ಬೋರ್ಡ್‌ನಂತೆ ನೋಡಿ, ತನ್ನ ಸುತ್ತಮುತ್ತಲಿರುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಜನರನ್ನು ಆಟದ ಚೆಸ್ ಪೀಸ್ ಥರ ನೋಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಯಾರಾದರೂ ತನ್ನಿಗಿಂತ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಗಳಿಸಿದರೆ, ಅವರನ್ನು ಕೆಳಮಟ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಎಳೆಯಲು  ಏನನ್ನಾದರೂ ಮಾಡಲು ಹಿಂದೇಟು ಹಾಕುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅಂತಹ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಅಹಂಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಆಘಾತವಾಗುವಂತೆ, ವಿಕ್ರಮ್ ಧ್ರುವ್ ಮಾಡಿದ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಿಂದ 'ಸೂಪ್ರಿಂಮ್ ಸಿಟಿಜನ್' ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಗೆದ್ದು, ಜನರ ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಗಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾನೆ.ಇದನ್ನು ನೋಡಿದ ಆದಿತ್ಯ ಸಹಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾರದೆ, ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ನನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಲು ಅತ್ಯಾಧುನಿಕ AI ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ 'ನೆಮಿಸಿಸ್'ನ್ನು ರಚಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದರೆ, ಆ AI ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ ತನ್ನ ಊಹೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿಯಾಗಿ, ಆದಿತ್ಯನ ಆಜ್ಞೆಗಳನ್ನು ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸದೇ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ತಪ್ಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ನೆಮಿಸಿಸ್ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯಾಗದಂತೆ ಅನನ್ಯ ಹೇಗೆ ತಡೆದಳು? "ಕುಟುಂಬ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯಗಳು ಅಂದರೆ ದುರ್ಬಲತೆ" ಎಂದು ನಂಬುವ ಆದಿತ್ಯನನ್ನು ಅನನ್ಯ ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದಳು ಮುಂದೆ ಏನ್ ಆಯಿತು ಅಂತ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ "ಸುಪ್ರೀಂ" ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ?

raaz-pichhle-janam-ka.title: Raaz Pichhle Janam ka
raaz-pichhle-janam-ka.description: दस वर्षीय विवान मल्होत्रा खुद को मारे गए राजपूत भँवरलाल राठौड़ होने का दावा करता है। वो अपने पैतृक अजमेर स्थित हवेली लौटता है, जहाँ उसकी पत्नी अब उसके सौतेले भाई की पत्नी बन चुकी है। बीते जन्म की धुंधली यादें, छिपे हुए विश्वासघात और वर्षों पुरानी साज़िशें धीरे-धीरे सामने आने लगती हैं। अब विवान को न केवल अपनी असंभव पहचान साबित करनी है, बल्कि अपनी ही हत्या के पीछे छिपे सच का भी पर्दाफाश करना है।

crucifixion-of-jesus-christ.title: Crucifixion Of Jesus Christ
crucifixion-of-jesus-christ.description: ఒక రోజు, యేసు క్రీస్తు తమ మానవతా కోసమూ, ప్రపంచ జనుల పాపాల కొరకు క్రూసిఫిక్షన్ స్తలంలో క్రూసిఫై అయ్యారు. అతని శరీరం అశాంతిగా మరియు శ్రమగా కదిలింది, కానీ ఆయన నిగ్రహించకుండా తన సహనం మరియు ప్రేమతో సర్వరును క్షమించారు. ప్రపంచం మౌనంగా నిలిచింది, కానీ యేసు తన మరణం ద్వారా పాపుల క్షమణ మరియు నిత్యజీవితానికి మార్గం చూపించారు.

when-he-returns.title: When He Returns
when-he-returns.description: വടക്കുകിഴക്കൻ ഇന്ത്യയുടെ മുഖഛായ മാറ്റിയ  അഥർവ ഗുപ്ത  മൗര്യൻ ഒരു സാധാരണക്കാരനെപ്പോലെ തന്റെ ജന്മ നഗരത്തിലേക്ക് തിരിച്ചുവന്നത് തൻ്റെ പ്രതിശ്രൂതവധു മൃണാളിനു നലകിയ വാക്കിനെ കരുതിയാണു. എന്നാൽ അവനെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നത് ആരൊക്കെയാകാം?   കാത്തിരിക്കാമെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞ അവൾ അഥർവയെ സ്വീകരിക്കുമോ അതോ തള്ളിപ്പറയുമോ... കേൾക്കൂ.

how-elites-think-differently.title: How Elites Think Differently
how-elites-think-differently.description: What separates ordinary people from the top 1%? It's not luck, talent, or money—it's the way they think. Elite Mindset Ka Secret is a practical self-growth show that reveals the mental models, decision-making frameworks, negotiation skills, and habits used by high performers, entrepreneurs, and leaders. Through relatable stories and actionable insights, you'll learn how to think smarter, make better decisions, and create opportunities before others even see them.

the-security-guard-is-a-trillionaire.title: The Security Guard is a Trillionaire
the-security-guard-is-a-trillionaire.description: To avoid marrying a rich CEO, She flash married a security guard, not knowing he was a hidden boss!

the-science-of-attraction.title: The Science Of Attraction
the-science-of-attraction.description: Why do some people instantly attract everyone around them while others go unnoticed? Is it looks, confidence, timing, or something deeper? The Psychology of Attraction is a cinematic self-growth show that uncovers the hidden science behind charisma, chemistry, confidence, validation, and human connection. Through real stories, psychology, and practical insights, discover what truly makes people unforgettable—and how you can build authentic attraction in every relationship.

vellaiyangiri-marmam.title: Vellaiyangiri Marmam
vellaiyangiri-marmam.description: மாலை மணி ஐந்தானால் இருளால் விழுங்கப்படும் கிராமம். இரவில் வெளியில் வரவே பயந்து சாகும் மக்கள், ராத்திரியில் கோர தாண்டவம் ஆடும் ஒரு தீய சக்தி, இவை எல்லாம் உண்மையா பொய்யா என்று கண்டு பிடிக்க வரும் கல்லூரியைச் சேர்ந்த குழு. இறுதியில் விதி வென்றதா? பலி வென்றதா? தெரிந்து கொள்ள கேளுங்கள் வெள்ளையங்கிரி மர்மம். உங்கள் KUKUFMல் மட்டும்.

mindfked-when-its-4-am-and-you-cant-stop.title: Mindf**ked: When It's 4 a.m. and You Can't Stop Thinking
mindfked-when-its-4-am-and-you-cant-stop.description: காலை 4 மணி ஆகிவிட்டது, ஆனால் இந்த மனம் சிந்திப்பதை நிறுத்தவே இல்லை. தன்னைப் பற்றி சிந்தித்தல், வேறு யாரையாவது பற்றி சிந்தித்தல், ஏதாவது ஒரு விஷயம், ஏதாவது ஒரு இடம் பற்றி சிந்தித்தல், ஏதாவது நடக்கப்போகிறதா அல்லது ஏதாவது நடந்துவிட்டதா என்று சிந்தித்தல்... ஆனால் நாம் எதையாவது தேவைக்கு அதிகமாக சிந்திக்கத் தொடங்கிவிட்டால், பிரச்சனை அங்கிருந்தே தொடங்குகிறது. அதிக சிந்தனை நமது மன ஆரோக்கியத்தை மட்டுமே பாதிக்காது, மேலும் நமது மனநிலையையும் கெடுக்கிறது, நமது உறவுகள் மற்றும் தொழில் வாழ்க்கையில் பிரச்சினைகளை உருவாக்குகிறது. நாம் சாதாரணமாக ஏதாவது சிந்திக்கும் வரை, எல்லாம் சரியாக உள்ளது, எந்த பிரச்சனையும் இல்லை. ஆனால் தேவைக்கு அதிகமாக சிந்திக்கத் தொடங்கியவுடன், நமது பிரச்சினைகள் அதிகரிக்கத் தொடங்குகின்றன.

inside-indias-fake-guru-industry.title: Inside India’s Fake Guru Industry
inside-indias-fake-guru-industry.description: Why do ordinary, educated people surrender their money, families, and even their lives to self-proclaimed godmen? From fortified ashrams and violent cults to digital gurus and algorithm-driven spiritual empires, The Cult Syndrome is a cinematic exploration of faith, manipulation, and mind control. Through shocking real incidents and psychological insights, this show uncovers how cult leaders exploit loneliness, fear, and hope—and why anyone can become their next follower.

mr-arrogant.title: Mr. Arrogant
mr-arrogant.description:
ఇది అలోక్‌ ఈగో క‌థ‌నా? లేక ప్రేమ క‌థ‌నా?
అలోక్‌కి అమ్మాయిలంటే అసహ్యం… పెళ్లంటే పీడ‌క‌ల‌!
అలాంటి వాడి జీవితంలోకి అలరి వస్తే? ఏం జరుగుతుంది? ఒక ప్రాజెక్ట్‌తో మొద‌లైన వార్‌… ఎటూ వైపు సాగుతుంది? ప్రేమని ద్వేషించే వాడు చివరికి ప్రేమలో పడతాడా? తెలియాలంటే వెంటనే వినండి.

the-storm-2.title: The Storm
the-storm-2.description:
In a bustling marketplace, a young woman’s simple act of kindness sparks a storm of threats, debts, and danger.
As tempers flare and past dues resurface, survival becomes a fight between dignity and desperation.

band-darwaza.title: Band Darwaza
band-darwaza.description: When renowned surgeon Dr. Mansi mysteriously vanishes from a locked operation theatre, Dr. Kartik's search for her uncovers a blood-soaked doorway to a terrifying supernatural world. Guided by a haunted pendant and the restless spirit of Ragini, he must solve a 20-year-old murder, expose a soul-stealing conspiracy, and confront a demonic force before Mansi is lost forever.

the-mind-reading-game-1.title: The Mind-Reading Game
the-mind-reading-game-1.description:
A terminally ill billionaire and a strong-willed woman enter a contract marriage, only to uncover dark secrets that bind their pasts.
As love grows between them, they battle betrayal, family conspiracies, and fate itself to find redemption and peace.

the-subtle-fragrance-from-the-deep-fores.title: The Subtle Fragrance from the Deep Forest
the-subtle-fragrance-from-the-deep-fores.description: After a drunken mistake with her cold and powerful boss and later discovers she’s pregnant and decides to flee. But the farther she runs, the more determined he becomes to claim her—and their unborn child.

rudra-reborn-in-blood.title: Rudra: Reborn In Blood
rudra-reborn-in-blood.description: On his wedding night, a brilliant but naive Intelligence Bureau codebreaker discovers his innocent, perfect bride is actually a ruthless terrorist sleeper agent; after she massacres his entire family and frames him for treason, he returns from the dead- transforming from a desk clerk into a lethal, ghost-like vigilante- to hunt down his treacherous wife and dismantle her global terror syndicate.

misty-medical-immortal.title: Misty Medical Immortal
misty-medical-immortal.description: He is the strongest medical immortal, and he is in the city, and he is alive and well.

rudran-the-hybrid-prince.title: Rudran : The Hybrid Prince
rudran-the-hybrid-prince.description: ये कहानी है रुद्रान की... एक ऐसे हाइब्रिड की, जिसके जन्म ने स्वर्ग, पाताल और धरती - तीनों लोकों का संतुलन बिगाड़ दिया। अपनी असली पहचान से अनजान रुद्रान की ज़िंदगी तब बदल जाती है, जब उसके भीतर छिपी शैतानी और दिव्य शक्तियाँ जाग उठती हैं। अब उसके पीछे हैं वैम्पायर किंग, देवशक्तियाँ और प्राचीन योद्धा। क्या रुद्रान अपनी किस्मत को अपनाएगा... या वही बनेगा तीनों लोकों के विनाश की सबसे बड़ी वजह?

janaki-ramudu.title: Janaki Ramudu
janaki-ramudu.description:
శతాబ్దాలుగా మనం వినే రామాయణం… ఈసారి మరో కోణంలో, మరో శబ్దంలో. మౌనంలో, దుఃఖంలో, ప్రేమలో.

డాక్టర్ ఆర్యన్ వర్మ అనే శాస్త్రవేత్త ఓ చిన్న గ్రామంలోకి అడుగుపెడతాడు — అక్కడ భగవంతుల కథలు శిలలపై కాకుండా శ్వాసలపై తేలుతుంటాయి. అక్కడ రాముడు దేవుడు కాదు, ఒక మనిషి. సీతమ్మ మౌనంగా పడే ప్రతి అడుగు, ఓ వేదాంతమవుతుంది.

ఆర్యన్ పత్రికా శైలిలో ఈ గాధను పరిశీలించగా… తనే ఒక పాత్రగా మారిపోతాడు. రాముడి ధర్మాన్ని అర్థం చేసుకునే కంటే, సీతమ్మ త్యాగాన్ని ఆలరిస్తూ పోతాడు. ప్రతి అడుగు అతడికి ఓ బుద్ధి. ప్రతి గాథ ఒక ప్రశ్న.

twisted-desires.title: Twisted Desires
twisted-desires.description:
ரோஹித் பணத்துக்காக தன்னை கல்யாணம் பண்ணிக்கிட்டதா நினைக்கிற ஷவானி, அதனாலேயே அவனை வெறுத்து ஒதுக்கி அவமானப்படுத்துறா. திருப்தி இல்லாத திருமண வாழ்வில் தன் மகளால் காயப்பட்ட ரோஹித்தை ஆறுதல்படுத்த முயல்கிறார் மாமியார் கீதாஞ்சலி. அவரின் மெச்சூர்டான அட்வைஸ், வாழ்க்கையை பார்க்கும் பார்வை எல்லாம் சேர்ந்து ஷிவானியின் நல்ல நண்பனாக ரோஹித்தை மாற்றுகிறது.
நட்பு காதலில் போய் முடிந்தால்... அதுவும் மாமியார் மருமகனுக்கு இடையே நட்பு காதலனால் என்ன நடக்கும்? கணவருக்கும் அம்மாவுக்கும் இருக்கும் காதல் பற்றி தெரிந்தால் மகள் மற்றும் மனைவி ஸ்தானத்தை வகிக்கும் ஷிவானி என்ன ஆவாள்?

woh-duriyan.title: Woh Duriyan
woh-duriyan.description: Seven years ago, Mayank lost the love of his life under mysterious circumstances, leaving him with nothing but guilt and unanswered questions. Just when he believes the past is buried forever, fate brings an unknown woman and a little girl into his life, forcing him to confront a truth he was never meant to uncover. But can Mayank undo the cruel conspiracy that tore his family apart, or will the distance between them become permanent?

change-your-habits-change-your-life-your.title: Change Your Habits, Change Your Life: Your Guide to An Awesome Life
change-your-habits-change-your-life-your.description: "Change Your Habits, Change Your Life" என்ற புத்தகத்தில் Ashdin Doctor, பழக்கங்களை மாற்றுவதன் மூலம் வாழ்க்கையை மாற்ற முடியும் என சொல்கிறார். நாம் எதையும் தொடங்கி விட்டுவிடும் பழக்கத்தை வெல்ல, அவர் மூன்று பொன்மொழி விதிகளை அறிமுகப்படுத்துகிறார். இவை தெளிவான நோக்கங்களை அமைக்க, சரியான தினசரி வழக்கங்களை உருவாக்க, நீடித்த முறையில் பழக்கங்களை பராமரிக்க உதவுகின்றன. வாழ்க்கையின் பல்வேறு துறைகளிலும் முன்னேற விரும்புவோருக்கு இது ஒரு வழிகாட்டி.

billionaire-husband-season-2.title: Billionaire Husband : Season 2
billionaire-husband-season-2.description: ವಿರಾಟ್ ಒಬ್ಬ ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್! ಅನು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತರನ್ನ ದ್ವೇಷಿಸೋ ಹುಡುಗಿ! ವಿರಾಟ್ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಅಂತಾ, ಅನು ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಈಗ ವಿರಾಟ್ ಬದುಕಿನ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ಸ್ ಒಂದೊಂದೇ ಹೊರ ಬರ್ತಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ವಿರಾಟ್ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನ ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ತಾನಾ? ತಿಳಿಯೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್ ಹಸ್ಬೆಂಡ್ Season 2'

buniyaad-1.title: Buniyaad
buniyaad-1.description: Buniyaad — one of India's most beloved Doordarshan serials — now reimagined as an audiobook! This powerful family drama, exploring the complexities of domestic life across generations, is brought alive by the talented actors of Silly Souls under the direction of Priyanka Sharma. A nostalgic, deeply moving experience!

feathers-of-krishna-lessons-from-the-leg.title: Feathers Of Krishna: Lessons From The Legend
feathers-of-krishna-lessons-from-the-leg.description:
కృష్ణుడు ఒక్కడేనా అనిపించే ప్రతి మాయా మూమెంట్లో ఒక గొప్ప పాఠం దాగుంటుంది!
పల్లె గోదావరి తీరాల్లో మొదలై, ధర్మయుద్ధం వరకూ సాగిన ఈ ప్రయాణం – మన జీవితాలకు మ్యాజికల్ మ్యాప్ లాంటిది!
‘Feathers of Krishna’ లో వినోదం, విజ్ఞానం, వ్యాఖ్యానం అన్నీ మిక్స్ – ఒక్కసారి వినండి... లైఫ్ టర్నింగ్ పాయింట్ గ్యారంటీ

super-chef-missing.title: Super Chef Missing
super-chef-missing.description: ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್‌ ಸಿಟಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಫುಡ್‌ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಟ್‌ವೊಂದರಲ್ಲಿ ಜನದಟ್ಟಣೆಯ ನಡುವೆ ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕವಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರೈಂ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಅಪರಾಧವು "Super Chef ಸೌಥ್‌ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ" ರಿಯಾಲಿಟಿ ಶೋಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ ಅಂತ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ತನಿಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಸಿಪಿ ರವಿ ಕಂಡುಹಿಡೀತಾರೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲದೇ, ಈ ಅಪರಾಧದ ಜಾಲವು ಅಂತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಫುಡ್‌ ಮಾಫಿಯಾಗೆ ಲಿಂಕ್‌ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ ಅಂತ ಗೊತ್ತಾದಾಗ ಎಸಿಪಿ ರವಿ ತನಿಖೆಯನ್ನ ಚುರುಕುಗೊಳಿಸ್ತಾರೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, "Super Chef ಸೌಥ್‌ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ" ರಿಯಾಲಿಟಿ ಶೋದಿಂದ ಕಾಣೆಯಾಗೋ ಆ ಕಂಟೆಸ್ಟಂಟ್‌ ಯಾರು? ಎಸಿಪಿ ರವಿ ಬೆನ್ನುಬಿದ್ದಿರೋ ಕ್ರೈಂನ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ಮೈಂಡ್‌ ಯಾರು? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಮೂಡಿಸೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಕ್ರೈಂ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "Super Chef Missing" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

lily-wala-billionaire.title: Lily wala Billionaire
lily-wala-billionaire.description: India’s youngest billionaire, Angad Khurana, hides his empire behind a tiny flower shop to win back his childhood love, Isha — a girl who hates wealthy men aftera traumatic past. Forced into a contract marriage, Isha slowly falls for the kind-hearted florist, unaware he’s the same billionaire she despises. But when love blooms between leaking roofs, broken dreams, and dangerous lies, one truth threatens to turn their fairytale into heartbreak.

love-to-hate-you-5.title: Love to Hate You
love-to-hate-you-5.description: ನಾಲ್ಕು ವರ್ಷದ ನಂತರ ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ವಾಪಾಸ್ ಬರುವ ಅನ್ವಿತಾಗೆ ಒಂದು ಒಳ್ಳೆ ವೆಲ್ಕಮ್  ಜೊತೆ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಶಾಕ್ ಕೂಡ ಕಾದಿರುತ್ತೆ, ತನ್ನ ಬಾಯ್ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದ ದೇವ್ ಗೆ ಅವಳ ತಂಗಿ ಜೊತೆನೇ  ನಿಶ್ಚಿತಾರ್ಥ ಆಗ್ತಿರುತ್ತೆ, ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ವಿಷಯಗಳ್ಳನ್ನ ಅನ್ವಿತಾ ಹೇಗೆ ಹ್ಯಾಂಡಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾಳೆ ಅಂತ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನೆ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಲವ್ ಟು ಹೇಟ್ ಯು ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್.

surprise-gift.title: Surprise Gift
surprise-gift.description: ஐடி துறையின் அழகு கன்னி பல்லவி... யாருக்கு கொடுத்து வச்சிருக்கோ என்று ஆண்களை பின்னால் சுற்ற விடும் இவளுக்கு தன்னுடன் பணிபுரியும் சஞ்சீவ் மீது காதல். யாரும் அறியாமல் ஆபிஸ் ரொமான்ஸ் நடக்க, அதில் திடீர் என்ட்ரியாய் உள்ளே நுழைகிறான் பல்லவியின் கணவன் பாஸ்கரன். குடும்ப பாரத்தை சுமக்க வெளி நாடு சென்றவன், திரும்பி வரும் போது மனைவியின் சுயரூபம் அறிய நேர்ந்தால் என்ன நடக்கும்? முறைமீறிய காதல் அவர்கள் வாழ்கையை எப்படி திசை மாற்ற போகிறது...

b651112c-75da-438c-a744-9c42a9ed6979.title: The Boy Who Outplayed His Own Gods
b651112c-75da-438c-a744-9c42a9ed6979.description: After being humiliated by the girl he loves, a broke college student accidentally gains Kubera’s infinite wealth and Kamadev’s power over attraction. As he rises through luxury, revenge, and desire, a divine karma system tracks every choice, forcing him to decide whether true worth comes from control, validation, or letting go.

kadhal-pyaar-prema.title: Kadhal Pyaar Prema
kadhal-pyaar-prema.description: The story centers on Ashish and Richa, whose romance is repeatedly shaken by secrecy, jealousy, and workplace pressure. It begins with a private anniversary moment that turns suspicious when Ashish finds hidden photos, a video, and a message from an unknown man calling Richa “honey.” That discovery opens a wider triangle involving Jai, a former project lead who disappeared, left Richa heartbroken, and later returned in a senior role. Ashish’s own life is also unstable, because he is revealed to be a hidden heir and trainee whose family expects him to take over the company. He tries to hold back his identity and watch Richa before revealing his plans, but the delay only deepens mistrust. At work, private feelings spill into public humiliation as coworkers, bosses, and rivals turn romance into a spectacle. A nightclub confrontation and later office clashes force Richa to answer for her loyalties, while Ashish struggles between pride, love, and the need to be respected on merit. Richa is pulled between Ashish and Jai, and at times also tied to other men who claim closeness to her, making her position increasingly unstable. Public games, accusations, and mistaken contacts expose how fragile the relationships have become. Ashish also grows more isolated, especially when family pressure and his mother’s concern remind him that he cannot stay away forever. His birthday confrontation with Richa becomes a breaking point, and he eventually says he can no longer remain where he feels like a third wheel. Richa panics when he leaves and learns he is flying to Bangalore, showing that the breakup is not clean or final. Meanwhile, the company conflict escalates as Jay and Ashish clash over apology, dignity, and authority. A man claiming Jay as his son and the chairman’s backing for Ashish shift the balance of power inside the office. Ashish is eventually revealed as the chairman’s son, which changes how others treat him but does not erase the emotional damage. Richa later admits she still loves Ashish and that she made the wrong choice, confirming that the central wound is not only professional but deeply personal. By the end, love, status, and ambition remain unresolved, with the characters trapped between old attachments and the consequences of what they have hidden.

2bb32b69-c8e3-4033-b26a-56ee5403e51a.title: A Commando's Countdown To Reckoning.
2bb32b69-c8e3-4033-b26a-56ee5403e51a.description: Shravan, a quiet ex-soldier carrying his fallen comrade Vikram’s ashes home, rescues a mother and child before being falsely arrested and humiliated by a corrupt cop. A young lawyer, Varsha, steps in, exposing police corruption and criminal networks. As Shravan’s true identity emerges, he confronts ruthless mafioso Daaga, restores a hero’s honour, and proves what real courage means.

arabpati-mogudu.title: Arabpati Mogudu
arabpati-mogudu.description: On her wedding day, Laila discovers her fiancé in an intimate relationship with his sister and is violently rejected by the family who raised her, only to learn she was never their biological daughter. When she is found by her real mother, a powerful businesswoman, Laila enters a world of wealth but chooses to hide her identity, confront the family that betrayed her, and take control of her life while taking revenge from them and also falling in love with a CEO she is destined to marry.

my-mechanic-brother-runs-the-universe.title: My Mechanic Brother Runs The Universe
my-mechanic-brother-runs-the-universe.description: Karan, a simple mechanic in appearance, watches silently as his sister Maitri is insulted by powerful elites. But nobody knows that behind the grease-stained clothes hides one of the world’s most powerful men. When his sister’s dignity is destroyed, Karan begins a ruthless takedown that exposes the difference between wealth, power, and respect.

my-dear-mudhalva.title: My Dear Mudhalva
my-dear-mudhalva.description: Sezhiyan fakes being a dying heir to unmask a murderer, but his plan is compromised when he’s forced to marry Yamini, a spy sent to betray him. Trapped in a mansion where every meal is poisoned and every relative is a snake, they must hide their true strengths to survive.

madhuram-sundaram.title: Madhuram Sundaram
madhuram-sundaram.description: A struggling delivery boy’s life changes overnight when a glamorous corporate CEO crashes into him—only for the two opposites to become trapped in a fake marriage that slowly turns dangerously real. As love blossoms amid class clashes, family burdens, corporate conspiracies, and ruthless enemies, Rahul and Anjali must fight to protect each other and the empire that could destroy them both.

deva-the-last-avenger-1.title: Deva: The Last Avenger
deva-the-last-avenger-1.description: The story follows Deva, a young man trapped between the mystical worlds of immortals, demons, and humans. Mocked by society as a “madman,” Deva secretly carries a powerful destiny tied to ancient divine weapons. As he seeks revenge against the influential family responsible for his parents’ death, he is also chosen to uncover three legendary astras that can save the world from destruction. The story explores Deva's transformation into a true hero.

machine-aur-mohabbat.title: Machine aur Mohabbat
machine-aur-mohabbat.description: The story opens with a romance that is immediately shattered by tragedy, as Nihaal and Riya share a proposal-like moment before a sudden car crash changes everything. From there, the focus shifts into a harsher world of restaurants, offices, and family pressure, where Charvi or Charu is repeatedly humiliated while trying to protect her child and keep her place in life. She is treated as less than others by coworkers and supervisors, but she keeps pushing back against class-based insults and public shame. At the same time, a child named Neel or Neil keeps asking for his father and refusing to accept loss, which turns the family conflict into an emotional mystery. The arrival or return of Nihal Mittal intensifies that mystery, because he is tied to memory gaps, hidden identity, and the possibility that he is not simply the man everyone thought he was. Charu is pulled between distrust and attraction as Nihal flirts, cooks for her, and tries to win back her confidence. Their bond is repeatedly tested by jealousy, rival women, and public confrontations that expose how fragile their trust really is. The child’s insistence on calling him father makes the stakes even higher, because the adults cannot separate romance from paternity questions. As the story develops, the workplace conflict spills into a cooking competition where credit, reputation, and sabotage all become part of the struggle. Food is treated as emotion and proof of effort, so winning or losing carries personal meaning beyond the restaurant itself. The competition also shows that recognition cannot be stolen forever, even when lies and manipulation are used to control the outcome. Just as the family and career tensions seem to settle into a more ordinary melodrama, the story reveals a far stranger truth about Nihal. He is connected to a secret project, and the man Charu loved may have been recreated through science and memory-transfer technology. That revelation turns romance into an identity crisis, because Charu must decide whether her feelings can survive the fact that he is an AI-generated being. Nihal insists that his choices and emotions are real, and Charu eventually accepts that truth rather than rejecting him outright. Their child continues to see him as father, which keeps the emotional divide alive even after the secret is exposed. The final stretch adds rescue, containment, and corporate fallout, with locked systems, security barriers, and family conflict around the AI project. In the end, the scientist releases Nihal from control, and the relationship is allowed to continue on its own terms. The overall arc is about love surviving humiliation, secrecy, and the collapse of human assumptions about identity.

mrs-golddigger-1.title: Mrs. Golddigger
mrs-golddigger-1.description: Amrutha’s story begins with an act of kindness when she saves an elderly man after a roadside accident, only to discover that the meeting was arranged to pressure her into a marriage alliance. The young man tied to that setup insists he will marry only the woman who once saved his life, while Amrutha keeps saying she is unmarried and focused on her work. At the same time, her family is crushed by debt and the threat of losing their home, forcing her to make painful choices under public humiliation. The marriage is eventually formalized, property is transferred to protect the house, and Amrutha is pushed into a new life that collides with her first day at work. That new life is tied to Indra, a powerful CEO-like figure whose authority and relationship to her are initially hidden from the world. In the office, Ramya becomes a major source of conflict, using her position to humiliate subordinates and attack Amrutha’s dignity. Amrutha repeatedly protects others, including an elderly family member, and refuses to stay silent when Ramya crosses the line. Indra’s own stance is complicated at first, but he increasingly steps in to defend Amrutha and challenge the people who try to control her. The hidden marriage becomes harder to conceal as office and family settings begin to expose it through slips, rumors, and public confrontations. Amrutha’s talent then changes the balance of power when she wins a major fashion competition and rises into a leadership role. Her success draws envy and suspicion, but it also proves that she is more than a target of pity or gossip. Indra supports her promotion and removes Ramya from power, deepening the rivalry and making the workplace even more hostile. As the couple’s bond grows, pregnancy, jealousy, and public humiliation become part of the struggle to protect their relationship. Indra repeatedly claims Amrutha as his wife in front of others, trying to restore her honor when rivals attack her background and status. Family opposition remains strong, especially from those who want Ramya accepted instead, and rumors about theft and character are used to undermine Amrutha. The turning point comes when Kiran exposes that Amrutha, not Ramya, was the woman who saved Indra’s life. CCTV evidence confirms the truth, and Indra recognizes Amrutha as his first love, forcing the family to reverse course toward accepting her. By the end of the arc, the central stakes are clear: Amrutha must protect her dignity, her family, and her place beside Indra while facing constant attacks from rivals, relatives, and public scrutiny.

the-employee-code.title: The Employee Code
the-employee-code.description: When a genius cyber-security employee is humiliated and thrown out by arrogant new CEOs, he decides to teach them a lesson. What follows is a high-stakes battle of hacking, corporate power, betrayal, and revenge that can shake an entire nation.

nene-raju-nene-bichagadu.title: Nene Raju Nene Bichagadu
nene-raju-nene-bichagadu.description:
A billionaire hiding as a beggar to escape an arranged marriage. An orphan girl abandoned at the altar on her wedding day. Two strangers with nothing — and everything to lose.
When fate throws them together at the worst moment of both their lives, the most unlikely deal is struck.
This is a story of two broken people who accidentally become each other's biggest plot twist.

pranaya-vidhi.title: Pranaya Vidhi
pranaya-vidhi.description: Pranaya Vidhi is a courtroom drama where justice battles power, manipulation, and emotions. When a poor fruit seller is blamed for an accident caused by a rich man, sharp lawyer Tanvi steps into a morally complex fight. As cases unfold, the courtroom becomes a stage for truth, love, and ethics, exposing how money and influence twist justice—and how courage can challenge it. Watch now.

corporate-khiladi.title: Corporate Khiladi
corporate-khiladi.description: Love triangle involving a young, rich guy who is engaged to a proud, arrogant girl who does not value everything this guy does for her and her business - while there is another young lady, a business tycoon, who silently continues to love this guy. Corporate arguments become personal and emotional and it leads to end of an engagement. When the guy moves on to another girl, he finds the past catching up, under the weight of emotional realization.

secret-shailoo.title: Secret Shailoo
secret-shailoo.description: சைக்கிளில் அலுவலகம் வரும் சாதாரண பெண்ணாக அனைவராலும் தவறாக மதிப்பிடப்படுகிறாள் ஷைலு. ஆனால் அவள் சாதாரணவள் அல்ல. ராய் குழுமத்தில் நடக்கும் மோசடிகளை கண்டுபிடிக்க மறைமுகமாக நுழைந்துள்ளாள். அதிகாரம், பணம், பொய், துரோகம் ஆகியவற்றால் சூழப்பட்ட அந்த உலகில், அவளை இழிவுபடுத்தும் ராஷி போன்றவர்களை எதிர்த்து, தனது புத்திசாலித்தனத்தால் உண்மையை நிரூபிக்கிறாள். காதல், சஸ்பென்ஸ், பழிவாங்குதல் நிறைந்த கதை இது.

500d89dc-ca98-4935-b5b6-14d65bd554fa.title: The CEO Became Gatekeeper Of Her World
500d89dc-ca98-4935-b5b6-14d65bd554fa.description: A powerful billionaire who falls in love with a girl  haunted by same mysterious one night stand with her but is played by her step sister takes responsibility with wrong woman, only to later discover the real woman he loved has become his fake wife—forcing him to hide his identity, earn her love without truth, and ultimately fight to reclaim both her trust and his own redemption.

didir-mamata.title: Didi’r Mamata!
didir-mamata.description: A pregnant woman, Mitali, visits a showroom to gift her wealthy brother Arun a car, but his fiancée Vedika mistakes her for a mistress and subjects her to brutal torture — caging her, severing her hand, and humiliating her publicly. When Arun arrives, discovers the truth, and exposes Vedika's fake pregnancy scheme, he calls off the wedding and has her arrested.

husband-wife-aur-hungama.title: Husband Wife Aur Hungama
husband-wife-aur-hungama.description: When the undercover billionaire CEO of a mega-conglomerate is mistaken for her husband’s mistress by his ambitious secretary, she endures a brutal public assault and a forced abortion, prompting her to orchestrate an elaborate, globally broadcast sting operation to exact ultimate revenge.

love-exposed.title: Love Exposed
love-exposed.description: A billionaire tests his blind wife’s love, until losing her becomes his greatest fear.

car-rental-business.title: Car Rental Business
car-rental-business.description: Business Pettali ani alochisthunnara? Kani ey business petalo ardam avatleda? aithe ee car business gurinchi chudandi.!

1225a36a-7e82-4771-9006-59897a731a8b.title: Rishton ka Signal
1225a36a-7e82-4771-9006-59897a731a8b.description: Rishton Ka Signal is an emotional family-business drama about loyalty and betrayal. After visionary entrepreneur Shikhar Bhatia is betrayed by his adopted children and loses everything, destiny reunites him with Siddharth Kapoor, the orphan boy he once inspired, now a powerful tech tycoon. Together, they fight to reclaim his company and prove that true family is built on love, gratitude, and sacrifice—not blood.

viral-stars.title: Viral Stars
viral-stars.description: One viral moment can change a life forever or not at all. This series uncovers the fascinating journeys of internet sensations who became stars, disappeared, built empires, became memes, or never even realized they were famous. One Viral moment can change a life forever.

the-final-destination.title: The Final Destination
the-final-destination.description: The story follows a racing world where titles, money, and family pride constantly turn competition into personal war. At first, Aryan Verma and Kabir Verma are locked in a fierce battle for dominance, while flirtation, resentment, and old grudges spill onto the track. A rival’s sabotage and hints about Veer’s parents’ death deepen the sense that the racing scene is hiding larger secrets. As pressure grows, sponsorship, leadership, and club survival become just as important as speed. Monty, a mechanic who insists he is not a racer, is pulled into the center of the crisis when the team needs someone who can keep Apollo Racing Club alive. His rise shocks the crowd, especially when he beats stronger opponents and proves he can survive races that are as much about instinct and endurance as skill. That success also brings backlash, with rivals accusing his side of cheating and powerful figures trying to control who is allowed to compete. Kabir remains a looming force throughout, using influence, intimidation, and mockery to protect his status and block challengers. Shanaya repeatedly stands with Monty and Aryan, helping them push through boardroom disputes, damaged machinery, and championship approval problems. The conflict expands into underground and black-market territory when the team’s path back into competition depends on recovering Aryan’s legendary car. Spider’s refusal to sell the car forces Monty into direct challenge, showing that access to racing now depends on negotiating with dangerous gatekeepers. Monty’s legitimacy is questioned again and again, but he keeps winning enough to make the elite nervous. Ishan’s injury and the attacks around him underline how fragile every racing career is in this world. Meanwhile, class humiliation and secret-identity tension suggest that status matters almost as much as lap times. The championship itself becomes a battleground where board members, chairmen, and rival teams fight over authority as much as victory. In the final stretch, the races grow deadlier, with blindfolded runs, obstacle courses, cliffside braking zones, and crashes that turn glory into survival. Aryan and Kabir’s rivalry reaches a catastrophic peak in explosions and wreckage. After the chaos, Aryan emerges as champion, learns Shanaya is pregnant, confronts Kabir with evidence already given to the police, and publicly proposes to Shanaya, who accepts. The story closes with Aryan declaring that he is back, leaving the racing world changed by both victory and loss.

ivan-veramathiri.title: Ivan Veramathiri
ivan-veramathiri.description: மோஹித் தனது அப்பா தர்ஷனை சாதாரண மனிதர் என்று நினைத்து வாழ்கிறான். ஆனால் தர்ஷன் உண்மையில் மிகப்பெரிய செல்வந்தரும் சக்திவாய்ந்த மனிதரும். மகன் சாதாரண வாழ்க்கையை அனுபவிக்க வேண்டும் என்பதற்காக தனது அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து வைத்திருக்கிறார். இதற்கிடையில் சோனியா, விராஜ் போன்றவர்களின் வருகை கதையை சிக்கலாக்குகிறது. அவமானம், காதல், துரோகம், குடும்ப பாசம் — இவை அனைத்தும் கலந்த உணர்ச்சி மிகுந்த பயணமே இந்த கதை.

485b7e85-900e-417d-a836-08641ca885d5.title: King of Kohinoor
485b7e85-900e-417d-a836-08641ca885d5.description: A man returns to his family after more than 20 years, but gets ridiculed and mocked for the gift he has got - but nobody knows that he is now one of the richest people in the world and the gift he has got is the Kohinoor diamond itself. As people doubt that the gift he has got is actually worth anything, it is put to many doubts and tests which the man overcomes and silences everyone

insta-kalyanam.title: Insta Kalyanam
insta-kalyanam.description: A runaway heiress forces a humble coolie to become her husband. But the man everyone mocks is hiding a secret powerful enough to shake the diamond empire. Love, lies, and destiny collide in this gripping romantic drama.

kasak.title: Kasak
kasak.description: Kasak is an emotional family drama filled with love, ambition, and hidden motives. Riya’s life takes a dramatic turn when two powerful suitors enter her world—one a wealthy charmer, the other connected to India’s biggest AI empire. As relationships deepen, secrets, ego clashes, and family conflicts unravel, leading to unexpected twists that test love, trust, and destiny. Watch now.

asuravithu.title: Asuravithu
asuravithu.description: When her husband and assistant steal her baby and seize control of her life, Anuradha chooses patience over confrontation. Eighteen years later, as her enemies celebrate their victory, a shocking revelation about her real son triggers a devastating downfall that she has carefully planned all along

love-in-hyderabad.title: Love in Hyderabad
love-in-hyderabad.description: Vaishali’s story centers on a mix of romance, family pressure, and corporate power struggles that keep forcing her to choose between love and control. It begins with a confusing night that leaves her believing she was with a call boy, and that misunderstanding shapes how others judge her. A flashback links her to Arjun through an earlier act of help, but the present quickly turns into a clash of pride and status when she humiliates a man at a luxury hotel before learning he owns it. Family pressure then deepens as a will and marriage clause make her marriage central to company control, and she is pushed toward a marriage solution for the sake of reputation and finances. Vaishali later claims she has married Swaroop and uses that marriage as part of her bid to take control of Clay Architectures. The marriage is not simple, because it is later revealed to be a secret contract arrangement, and Swaroop’s identity is often hidden or managed carefully. Even when they appear together, their relationship stays mixed, shifting between playful closeness and strategic distance. Swaroop tries to create comfort for Vaishali, including a restaurant visit that she quickly sees through as planned. Their bond is complicated further by the return of Rajesh, whose long-standing connection to Vaishali and sudden presence in her life create jealousy, uncertainty, and unresolved history. At the same time, Vaishali and Ajay remain tied to family expectations and business pressure, especially when marriage is treated as a tool for survival. The conflict widens into corporate obstruction, with blocked approvals, project pressure, and suspicion around who is helping behind the scenes. Rajesh becomes a mysterious helper in the business struggle, but his true identity is questioned and investigated. A stolen family necklace then shifts the story into a theft mystery, adding another layer of blame and distrust inside the household. The emotional stakes rise again when Vaishali is pushed to leave Swaroop and consider Ajay, but she refuses to submit to her father’s control. She also faces humiliation in public and pressure to divorce and remarry for the company’s sake, yet she breaks away and seeks brief comfort with Swaroop. The story then darkens into a deeper mystery around her mother’s suspicious death, a tainted drink, and a decision to investigate quietly instead of going to the police. That investigation exposes a larger cover-up, including allegations against Mr. John and boardroom manipulation aimed at removing Vaishali from power. The truth becomes more dangerous when Vaishali is abducted and forced into a document-signing trap, where a villain admits he tampered with her mother’s medicine and confirms poisoning. Violence follows, leaving the cover-up unresolved and the danger still active. Afterward, Swaroop is hospitalized, and Vaishali refuses to leave his side, showing how central their bond has become despite all the conflict. By the end, love, sacrifice, family duty, and business survival remain tightly bound together, with Vaishali still caught between protecting her loved ones and fighting for the truth.

07971c40-4f69-4888-bd47-c5e3c302dff0.title: Dard- e- Billionaire
07971c40-4f69-4888-bd47-c5e3c302dff0.description:
Advik walks out of jail after serving a year for someone else's crime — with a bouquet in his hand and a proposal on his mind. But the woman he loves is already with someone else. And the stranger he saved on the road that morning turns out to be his childhood crush — who never stopped waiting.
Two women. One man. And secrets buried long before any of them met again.
This is a story of Advik — a man who paid for love, and came back to find it had rearranged itself entirely.

fake-husband-real-ceo-2.title: Fake Husband Real CEO
fake-husband-real-ceo-2.description: After her sister drugs her and leaks her private photos, a young woman is publicly shamed and cast out of her home. Struggling alone, she rebuilds her life with resilience. Years later, to escape a harasser, she impulsively claims a stranger as her husband, and he agrees to marry her hiding that he is a billionaire. As love grows, buried secrets resurface, threatening to destroy everything.

no-more-mrnice-house-husband.title: No More Mr.Nice House Husband
no-more-mrnice-house-husband.description: Vijay sacrifices his massive empire to serve as a humble house husband for his ungrateful wife, Raksha. After years of brutal humiliation and being replaced by her fraudulent ex-lover Siddharth, Vijay finally sheds his mask to reclaim his power.

prema-khaidi.title: Prema Khaidi
prema-khaidi.description: Romi's life is shattered when Shikha's drunken father causes a crash that kills his mother and cripples his father. Driven by revenge, Romi spends seven years tormenting Shikha through abuse, humiliation, and a forced marriage, unaware she is battling terminal cancer. As manipulative Monica schemes to destroy Shikha, Romi realizes his mistakes. Seeking redemption, he sacrifices part of his liver to save Shikha. Forgiveness, love, and atonement ultimately replace years of hatred and suffering.

माँ-काली--Ahankaar-Todne-Wali-Shakti.title: Maa Kali: Ahankaar Todne Wali Shakti
माँ-काली--Ahankaar-Todne-Wali-Shakti.description: Maa Kali: Ahankaar Todne Wali Shakti

thanthonni-the-rebel.title: Thanthonni: The Rebel
thanthonni-the-rebel.description: Sreedhar Singhania’s story unfolds as a long struggle between hidden identity, family legacy, and constant public danger. He is first seen as a taxi driver with a concealed past, but the digests repeatedly tie him to the wealthy Singhania world and to a deeper revenge motive connected to his mother’s death. Around him, threats keep escalating from street ambushes and armed men to kidnappers, corrupt criminals, and bomb danger. He is mocked as poor or powerless, yet he repeatedly answers with claims of business authority, police influence, and family power. Women and children remain at the center of the conflict, including Meera, a drugged young woman seeking help, and several children whose safety is repeatedly threatened. The story also introduces a wealthy heiress who searches for him and even offers money and a luxury car in a marriage bargain, turning his hidden past into a public confrontation. Family identity becomes the main emotional engine as DNA reports, paternity doubts, and accusations of betrayal destabilize multiple households. Sreedhar is repeatedly forced to defend a child and a mother while others question whether the child truly belongs to the family. Shanaya’s connection to Sreedhar becomes increasingly important, and the digests suggest she is his daughter, though the family around her resists or doubts that truth. The larger Singhania family power structure closes in through charity events, hotel gatherings, and elite parties that hide private agendas behind public respectability. In those spaces, Sreedhar is humiliated, challenged by security, and pushed to prove both his identity and his right to stay. At one point he openly declares that Singhania is Shanaya’s grandfather, turning suspicion into a direct family revelation. That revelation does not settle the conflict, because the family remains fractured by pride, class prejudice, and competing claims over children and inheritance. Corporate pressure then deepens the drama, with shares, company control, and investment deadlines becoming another battlefield. Ridhima and other relatives are publicly shamed, blamed for business failures, and forced into humiliating choices to protect their positions. The digests also show repeated demands for apologies, transfers of ownership, and obedience, suggesting that wealth in this world is always tied to control and punishment. By the later episodes, hidden parentage, a bomb confession, and a mistaken killing widen the feud into something even more dangerous and unresolved. Across the whole arc, Sreedhar remains caught between revenge, protection, and the need to expose the truth, while the family around him keeps trying to silence or reshape that truth.

return-of-a-legend.title: Return of a Legend
return-of-a-legend.description:
Aadhiran, a legendary gambling genius, loses his memory in an accident and lives as a simple man named Arjun with his devoted wife, Niranjana.
When ruthless gambling lords like Paarthiban push her family toward ruin, Arjun’s elite skills and hidden past as the "Young Legend" finally return. He must win the most dangerous game of his life to destroy his enemies and reclaim his true legacy.

sadak-ka-sultan.title: Sadak Ka Sultan
sadak-ka-sultan.description: Once the heir to a powerful business empire, Om loses everything after a ruthless betrayal. Forced to hide his identity and live as an ordinary worker, he secretly begins a journey to uncover the truth and reclaim what was stolen from him. As enemies tighten their grip on his empire, Om must outsmart those who betrayed him. But can a fallen king reclaim his throne without revealing who he really is?

the-coolies-love.title: The Coolie’s Love
the-coolies-love.description: A humble railway porter falls in love with a woman from one of the country’s wealthiest families. As their relationship challenges social boundaries, he faces humiliation, betrayal, and impossible odds. In a journey of love, resilience, and self-worth, he proves that true greatness is earned through character—not wealth—and that love is the most valuable treasure of all.

london-return.title: London Return
london-return.description: After being humiliated as “just a dishwasher” by the woman he secretly supported and loved, a self-made millionaire enters a contract marriage with a powerful heiress while hiding his true identity. As he quietly rises within her influential world, he proves that the most underestimated man can build the greatest empire—and that true power needs no introduction. Watch now!

dc13164a-5744-419b-a19e-eaa55240a522.title: The Gangster King
dc13164a-5744-419b-a19e-eaa55240a522.description: Veer is secretly a super powerful  and influential man controlling pokiticians and business men, while he pretends to be a cleaner - and ends up in a contract marriage with a businesswoman, whom he protects and gradually falls for. This businesswoman, Tara, faces problems created by her own family members along with a powerful and dangerous man - but Veer is too powerful and influential for all of them. He overpowers all the problems, while hiding his reality all this time.

azhagana-ratchasiye.title: Azhagana Ratchasiye
azhagana-ratchasiye.description:
Agan goes undercover as a poor worker to deal with his beautiful but arrogant boss, Yuktha.
Yuktha marries him just to humiliate and torture him, completely unaware of his massive power and wealth. Watch a toxic game of ego transform into a shocking and heart-touching story of true love between Agan and Yuktha.

family-ki-taqdeer.title: Family ki Taqdeer
family-ki-taqdeer.description: man separated from his family due to a tragic accident, finds himself working as a sweeper in the same company that he built years ago - only to be humiliated by his own son who has no idea who he is. While dealing with all the humiliation, he saves his own son from a major business conspiracy and reclaims his family as well as his position.

oka-paaru-iddaru-devadasulu.title: Oka Paaru Iddaru Devadasulu
oka-paaru-iddaru-devadasulu.description: Akshara’s story begins with public betrayal and career damage, as Roshan humiliates her and tries to control the fallout after their breakup. His actions push her into hardship at home and into repeated situations where her dignity is tested by family insults, blacklisting, and social judgment. At the same time, Karthik Varma enters her life as a powerful figure whose help is never simple, because he offers work, housing, and protection while also setting strict boundaries and keeping her close. Their connection grows through fake-boyfriend confusion, secret billionaire reveals, and a live-in secretary arrangement that makes every interaction feel both intimate and controlled. Akshara is repeatedly forced to choose between survival and self-respect, especially when family pressure and workplace sabotage leave her with few safe options. Public spaces become battlegrounds, whether in restaurants, offices, or luxury settings, where wealthy rivals mock her status and try to push her out. In those moments, the story repeatedly contrasts elite arrogance with quieter acts of defense, including a waiter or helper standing up for her and Karthik’s shifting protection. As the romance-drama escalates, Karthik’s feelings become more openly dramatic, and he publicly proposes to Akshara with promises of marriage. That promise collapses into humiliation when the wedding stage reveals a contract relationship and a no-romance clause, turning love into a weapon of revenge. The fallout damages both personal trust and business standing, with a major deal canceled after the scandal. The story then shifts into a broader pattern of hidden identities and class conflict, where a cleaner with a VIP card and a man living as an ordinary worker both unsettle the elite by revealing unexpected power. Akshara’s own past as a receptionist and model continues to shape her vulnerability, but she also begins to regain visibility through fashion opportunities and professional openings. Her bond with Deva grows in a softer romantic track, even as teasing, intoxication, and public mockery keep testing their trust. That relationship is then shaken by apparent betrayal, accusations of drugging and blackmail, and a hotel crisis tied to her allergy and collapse. Deva repeatedly steps in to defend her, but his hidden identity and the women from his past keep creating new suspicion. By the end of the batch, Akshara is pulled into a dangerous mix of romance, revenge, and status struggle, with her future tied to whether she can uncover the truth and protect her dignity.

చింతూరు-అడవి-మిస్టరీ-.title: చింతూరు అడవి మిస్టరీ
చింతూరు-అడవి-మిస్టరీ-.description: Aa adavilo evo shebdhalu vinipisthu untayi, aa adaviloki velthe nuvu malli tirigi ravu.! nee dhagari valle ninnu pilusthunna feeling vasthundi. telisina valle kadha velthe , Tirigi rani lokalaki velipothavu.! ee Dark Horror miss avakunda chudandi...!

falling-for-a-farm-king.title: Falling for a Farm King
falling-for-a-farm-king.description:
A broken single father, Saumya Raghuvanshi, is emotionally blackmailed by his ruthless grandmother into marrying Simar, an orphan girl sold into marriage for money.
What begins as a cold-hearted deal for his mute daughter Kuhu’s care slowly transforms into an intense battle of trust, healing, and love.
Amid family conspiracies, a jealous stepbrother, and dangerous betrayals, Simar must prove she is not a purchased bride… but the woman destined to rebuild a shattered family.

putus-jadi-kaya.title: Putus Jadi Kaya
putus-jadi-kaya.description: Aditya’s story begins with a public romantic rejection that pushes him into an impulsive civil marriage, and that sudden choice sets the tone for a world where love, status, and survival are constantly entangled. Sonia turns away from him for Rohit’s wealth, while Aditya’s new marriages and relationships quickly become sources of conflict rather than comfort. Across the early arc, his wives and former partners are tied to control struggles, hidden identities, and arguments over rings, necklaces, and family heirlooms. What looks like a personal breakup story expands into a mystery about Aditya’s true identity, with clues suggesting he may be Siddharth Sehgal, the long-lost son of a powerful family. That uncertainty draws in family elders, a missing-son search, and repeated attempts to prove or disprove who he really is. At the same time, Aditya is humiliated in elite and workplace settings, especially by Sonia’s father and other rivals who treat him as unworthy or disposable. He responds with calm defiance, refusing to be shamed even when others mock his background, his job status, or his place in society. The story then widens into corporate warfare, where marriage alliances, succession claims, and business control become inseparable from personal loyalty. Aditya’s connection to Preeti Marwah becomes central as their marriage is publicly invoked, questioned, and used as part of larger family strategy. A bracelet and other proof-like objects fuel accusations that he is lying, but the pressure also strengthens the sense that his identity is tied to a hidden family truth. In parallel, the company conflict grows around AI development, recruitment battles, and the struggle to secure influence through talent and innovation. Aditya is mocked as an outsider in that world too, yet he keeps insisting that his work will soon speak for him. His efforts culminate in the successful activation of a Super AI project, which marks a major turning point in his credibility. That success also triggers the return of old memories, suggesting that the technical victory is linked to his buried past. As his standing improves, family trust begins to shift, but suspicion and rivalry do not disappear. By the end of the arc, Aditya has become both a contested heir and a proven engineer, caught between romance, inheritance, and corporate power. The central stakes remain whether he can secure his place in the family, protect the people aligned with him, and uncover the truth behind his identity before rivals use the same mystery against him.

kamdev-konnection.title: Kamdev konnection
kamdev-konnection.description: A lonely office worker's life takes a magical turn when Kaamdev enters through a mysterious app, helping him navigate love, chaos, and unexpected adventures as multiple women fall for him.

taxi-king.title: Taxi King
taxi-king.description: ஒரு கோடீஸ்வர வாரிசான ஸ்ரீதர் சிங்கானியா, தனது தாயின் மரணத்திற்கான உண்மையை கண்டுபிடிக்க சாதாரண டாக்ஸி டிரைவராக வாழ்கிறான். எதிர்பாராத விதமாக ஒரு மர்மப் பெண்ணையும், தன்னுடையதாகக் கூறப்படும் குழந்தையையும் சந்திக்கும்போது, அவனது வாழ்க்கை காதல், குடும்பம் மற்றும் பழிவாங்குதல் ஆகியவற்றின் போராட்டமாக மாறுகிறது.

digital-jaal.title: Digital Jaal
digital-jaal.description: Narrated by Sushant Singh, this gripping crime mystery begins when two teenage sisters plunge to their deaths from a seventh-floor balcony. What seems like a tragic accident soon unravels into a web of family secrets, hidden resentments, and a chilling digital threat. As investigators follow the clues, they uncover disturbing truths that blur the line between victim and suspect, leading to a shocking revelation no one saw coming.

love-under-arrest-2.title: Love under arrest
love-under-arrest-2.description: Romi's life is shattered when Shikha's drunken father causes a crash that kills his mother and cripples his father. Driven by revenge, Romi spends seven years tormenting Shikha through abuse, humiliation, and a forced marriage, unaware she is battling terminal cancer. As manipulative Monica schemes to destroy Shikha, Romi realizes his mistakes. Seeking redemption, he sacrifices part of his liver to save Shikha. Forgiveness, love, and atonement ultimately replace years of hatred and suffering.

jhooth-se-shuru-pyar-pe-khatam.title: Jhooth Se Shuru, Pyar Pe Khatam
jhooth-se-shuru-pyar-pe-khatam.description:
Aradhya and Anvesha marry into the rich Goenka family by pretending to be perfect wives. But behind their innocent image lies a dangerous truth they can’t hide forever.
As luxury, romance, jealousy, and family drama collide, their dream life slowly turns into chaos. And the biggest danger of all is Akshat, a man who hates betrayal more than anything.
Will the truth destroy their marriages, or will love change everything?

રાઠોડ-ધ-કિંગ.title: રાઠોડ ધ કિંગ
રાઠોડ-ધ-કિંગ.description: Abhiraj Singh Rathore is the richest and most powerful man in the world, yet his true identity remains a secret. When he returns from the battlefield, his childhood sweetheart cruelly dumps him, believing he is a nobody. But when the truth about the King of Rajputana is finally revealed, will she realize she made the biggest mistake of her life? 👑🔥💔

raja-dapur-hilang.title: Raja Dapur Hilang
raja-dapur-hilang.description:
Di puncak kejayaannya, seorang koki ternama tiba-tiba menghilang dan mengguncang dunia kuliner.
Bertahun-tahun kemudian, seorang pelayan dapur pendiam bekerja di restoran kumuh, tak dihormati siapa pun. Namun di balik kesederhanaannya tersembunyi keahlian memasak luar biasa.
Di tengah pengkhianatan dan persaingan sengit, kebenaran mengejutkan terungkap — sang legenda mungkin selama ini bersembunyi di depan mata semua orang.

killer-karate-king.title: Killer Karate King
killer-karate-king.description: 'Chirag' ek anaath ladka tha jise Khurana family ne dhokhebaaz samajhkar thukra diya tha. Saalon baad jab Khurana family ki izzat aur martial arts empire barbaadi ke kinaare pahunch gaya, tab wahi Chirag “Drunken King” bankar wapas aaya. Apne khatarnak fighting style aur chhupe hue raazon ke saath usne dushmano ko hara diya. Lekin ye sirf ek fight nahi thi… ye us apmaan, dhokhe aur nafrat ka hisaab tha jo usne saalon tak saha tha.

બદલાની-આગ-.title: બદલાની આગ
બદલાની-આગ-.description: ajat, a humble and loyal young man, is publicly humiliated and dumped by his ambitious girlfriend for not having enough money or status. But everything changes when the world discovers that he is married to the beautiful and powerful CEO of the country's biggest company. Will Rajat finally get his revenge, or will love give him a second chance? ❤️🔥👀

return-for-revenge.title: Return For Revenge
return-for-revenge.description:
A newly appointed Union Minister, hiding a dangerous past as a covert intelligence officer, returns to his forgotten hometown in disguise to reunite with his lost love.
But what he finds is a town drowning in corruption, fear, and betrayal—where even love has chosen power over truth.
When the system turns against him, he must rise not as a minister, but as a man of the people.
In a final face-off, he exposes an entire corrupt network, redefining power, justice, and love.

પ્રેમ-બન્યો-પનોતી.title: પ્રેમ બન્યો પનોતી
પ્રેમ-બન્યો-પનોતી.description: Airline tycoon Veer Chopra believes he has found true love in charming flight attendant Lara Smith. But when his parents arrive to meet their future daughter-in-law, a shocking chain of arrogance, deception, and humiliation turns a dream romance into a nightmare. As secrets come crashing down, will Veer fight for love—or realize it was the costliest mistake of his life? ✈️💔👀

a86212a1-b555-41d2-ad6a-3630cbe594d8.title: The Coder Who Crashed Her World
a86212a1-b555-41d2-ad6a-3630cbe594d8.description: The microdrama centers on Siddharth, a cybersecurity prodigy, whose initial act of saving QuickPay from a hack thrusts him into conflict with Rishika Raizada, the Chairman's ambitious heiress and new owner. Rishika's tyrannical leadership and ruthless employee purges, including Siddharth's unjust termination, expose her misjudgment and ignite a generational power struggle within the Raizada Group. As QuickPay faces further cyberattacks, Siddharth is repeatedly betrayed and framed, first by Ishika Raizada and later blacklisted by Rishika, revealing a complex web of corporate deception and identity theft, with Tejas impersonating 'Sid' to orchestrate a takeover. Siddharth, now a world-class coder, allies with rival CEO Vedika, vowing to dismantle the Raizada Group, while navigating a rekindled romantic history with Vedika and a manipulative plot against Rishika. He secretly schemes to exploit Rishika and usurp her corporate empire, using her for a 'project' while planning a future with Vedika. Rishika, initially developing a playful office romance with Ayush, eventually uncovers Siddharth's betrayal, shattering her world and igniting a fierce resolve for corporate revenge against him and 'VS Technologies.' The corporate rivalries escalate with intellectual property theft and sabotage, leading to Tejas's successful infiltration and takeover of Rishika's company. Facing the collapse of her family's 50,000 crore empire, Rishika embarks on a desperate mission to retrieve the true Siddharth Sharma, her father's chosen groom, hinting at a larger conspiracy. Meanwhile, Vedika's own family empire faces ruin due to corporate sabotage and financial demands, forcing her and her father to appeal to Siddharth, a financial expert they once scorned. Siddharth's 'rescue' of their systems is revealed as a calculated act of revenge, leaving them financially devastated. A mysterious hacker, later implied to be Siddharth, confronts Vedika, revealing his vengeful crusade against the Raizada Group for predatory loan schemes, drawing Vedika into a high-stakes corporate conflict. The show explores the clash of ambition, betrayal, and the pursuit of justice for exploited employees amidst a crumbling corporate dynasty.

અનોખી-સફરના-સાથી-.title: અનોખી સફરના સાથી
અનોખી-સફરના-સાથી-.description: Disha’s life changes overnight when an accidental marriage ties her to Vikrant, a man she believes is a broke caretaker. But Vikrant is hiding a life-changing secret—he’s the heir to a billionaire empire. As hidden identities, rivalries, and unexpected romance collide, will Disha stand by him when the truth finally comes out? 👀

raja-tanpa-judi.title: Raja Tanpa Judi
raja-tanpa-judi.description: Seorang pria yang tampak polos dan kehilangan ingatan sebenarnya menyimpan masa lalu misterius serta kemampuan luar biasa. Saat keluarga istrinya dijebak dalam utang miliaran oleh sindikat perjudian kejam, ia turun langsung ke meja taruhan. Dengan kecerdasan, strategi, dan keberanian yang tak tertandingi, ia mulai membongkar kecurangan dunia bawah. Namun siapa sebenarnya pria itu, dan mengapa para penguasa perjudian begitu takut pada namanya?

b46edf3e-ac10-4910-b726-ee694a56e7ce.title: Naukar Boyfriend
b46edf3e-ac10-4910-b726-ee694a56e7ce.description:
Aryan, a billionaire, comes home with flowers for his girlfriend — and finds her in bed with another man. Humiliated and heartbroken, he makes a decision: disappear. No name, no money, no identity.
As "Vikram the kitchen boy," he meets Meera — a woman being crushed by a powerful man — and realises his disguise might be exactly what she needs.
This is a story of Aryan — a billionaire hiding in plain sight, and the woman who saw through him before he even knew it.

crash-landed-into-love-1.title: Crash Landed Into Love
crash-landed-into-love-1.description: ஒரு விமான விபத்துக்குப் பிறகு நினைவிழந்த தொழிலதிபர் அமர் லூத்ராவை காப்பாற்றும் டாக்டர் ரூமி, அதிகாரமும் பணமும் நிரம்பிய லூத்ரா குடும்பத்தின் ஆபத்தான சதியில் சிக்கிக்கொள்கிறாள். காதல், துரோகம், பழி, உண்மை ஆகியவற்றின் மோதலில் ரூமியின் வாழ்க்கையே தலைகீழாக மாறுகிறது.

suhaag-raat-gone-wrong.title: Suhaag Raat Gone Wrong
suhaag-raat-gone-wrong.description: Suhaag Raat Gone Wrong is a suspense thriller about Piyush Patel, whose wedding night becomes a nightmare when he finds his bride, Isha, murdered in their bridal suite. With CCTV footage and every clue pointing at him, Piyush loses everything and dies a tragic death. But fate gives him a second chance as time rewinds. Reliving the same events, he must save Isha, expose the real killer, and uncover shocking secrets, betrayals, and dangerous conspiracies.

free-drama-app-tharum-real-earning.title: Free Drama App Tharum Real Earning
free-drama-app-tharum-real-earning.description: Free Drama App Tharum Real Earning

remarried-to-a-superstar.title: Remarried to a Superstar
remarried-to-a-superstar.description:
Her husband chose another woman.
A superstar chose her.
But just when she gets a second chance at love, a shocking kidnapping, a murder plot, and a secret adoption plan threaten to destroy everything.
Will she become the superstar's bride... or lose him forever?

kaalchakra-ka-waris.title: The Comeback King
kaalchakra-ka-waris.description: Aryan ne Vikramaditya ka tilasmi pendant haasil kar liya tha, jiske zariye woh amar ho sakta tha. Lekin uske saathi ne use dhokhe se maar diya. Maut ke bajay Aryan 5 saal pichhe chala gaya, jahan uske paas pehle jaisi divya shaktiyan nahi thi, par kuch bachi-kuchi taaqatein zarur thi. Ab Aryan ne apni saari shaktiyan wapas haasil karne aur use dhokha dene wale har insaan ko sabak sikhane ki thaan li thi. Par kya woh apne is safar mein kaamyab ho paaya?

3213db8f-e138-4c20-8439-c688d8b0360b.title: Rajadhirajan
3213db8f-e138-4c20-8439-c688d8b0360b.description: A humiliated middle-class college student’s life changes overnight when he discovers he is the hidden heir to a billion-dollar business empire. As he rises from heartbreak to power, he takes revenge on the people who betrayed and mocked him, while struggling to protect the one girl who truly loved him for who he was. Packed with romance, betrayal, luxury, and mass hero moments, Rajadhirajan is an emotional billionaire revenge drama about love, status, and destiny.

married-to-a-legend.title: Married To A Legend
married-to-a-legend.description: A seemingly useless, game-addicted husband hiding behind jokes and laziness is secretly the legendary warrior “Star Lord” the missing leader of Agni Mahal , who must protect his wife’s empire, defeat powerful enemy clans, and reclaim his lost legacy before his enemies destroy everything he loves.

e-bandhana.title: E Bandhana
e-bandhana.description: A manipulative woman deceives her wealthy fiancé while secretly living a double life. After publicly humiliating an elderly man—insulting him and destroying a cherished memory—she discovers he is a powerful billionaire with the influence to ruin her. Determined to expose her lies, he sets out to bring her true nature to light and make her face the consequences before everyone.

volt-raja.title: Volt Raja
volt-raja.description: The story begins with a garage crisis when a botched repair damages Alexander’s rare luxury car and turns a local mistake into a threat against Kavya’s family business. Alexander demands payment and control, and the dispute escalates until the garage’s survival depends on a street-racing challenge. Vikram steps forward as the mechanic who believes the car can still be fixed, but the conflict reveals that he is far more than an ordinary worker. As the racing and repair pressure builds, Vikram’s hidden identity as Volt Raja comes into view, linking the garage crisis to a larger world of speed, skill, and reputation. The narrative then expands into a corporate auto-launch battle where Vikram’s technical ability becomes essential to a company’s survival. Nakshatra enters as a forceful new CEO who humiliates employees, dismisses Vikram, and tries to control the launch through authority rather than expertise. Yet repeated technical failures show that the company cannot move forward without the very man she is trying to exclude. Around him, rivals and executives compete for credit, while hidden identities and accusations of copied work make every breakthrough suspect. Dhanush’s emergence as Volt Raja adds another layer of rivalry, since he claims ownership of the genius that others are trying to use or steal. Public events such as press conferences and product reveals turn private grudges into open battles over legitimacy, innovation, and who deserves to lead. The conflict grows harsher when the family company suffers a major collapse, forcing questions about debt, shares, and whether the wrong person was pushed out. Vikram refuses to return on humiliating terms, and the family realizes too late that they may have lost their real technical savior. Corporate pressure then turns into outright warfare, with takeover threats, asset seizures, and bankruptcy demands pushing everyone toward desperate choices. Vikram uses the crisis to gain leverage, while Nakshatra fights to preserve control even as the company weakens around her. The struggle becomes public and political when Vikram’s confession about a technology transfer triggers scandal and accusations of betrayal. He defends his actions as a way to protect production and profits, but Nakshatra rejects that explanation and frames him as a traitor. In the end, the rivalry is still unresolved, but Nakshatra has seized the narrative through rebranding and a new high-speed race track project, leaving the future of the business and the personal conflict between them still burning.

hum-tum-in-love.title: Hum Tum In Love
hum-tum-in-love.description: When fearless pharma CEO Suhani Desmukh hires mysterious fighter Abeer Rathore as her bodyguard, a fake relationship sparks amid deadly conspiracies, billionaire rivalries, and hidden identities. But as enemies close in and secrets from Abeer’s shadowy past emerge, protection turns into obsession, loyalty, and a dangerous love that could destroy them both.

lies-and-legacy-3.title: Lies and Legacy
lies-and-legacy-3.description: Mumbai’s powerful businessman Ashok Prajapati hides his billionaire identity to raise his daughter Simmi with values. But when they are humiliated at her college by a rich family trying to buy her science award, Ashok uncovers a shocking truth—his wife Shalaka has been living a double life with them using his wealth. As greed, betrayal, and inheritance wars erupt, Ashok must choose revenge or protect Simmi’s future.

74b5cbb3-3da8-4c1a-a66e-6558d1af85f6.title: Do Biwi Ek Dulha
74b5cbb3-3da8-4c1a-a66e-6558d1af85f6.description: Maya secretly lives as Vicky Raichand’s wife for 10 years, raising their son while he hides them from the world. On the day of his engagement to business heiress Kiara, Maya storms in to claim her rights but faces brutal humiliation. Broken yet fearless, she discovers her true power as Rajveer Rathore’s daughter and launches a ruthless revenge against the Raichands, turning love, betrayal, and business into a deadly war. Watch now.

final-break-up.title: Final Break up
final-break-up.description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

blind-love-deadly-truth-1.title: Blind Love Deadly Truth
blind-love-deadly-truth-1.description: After losing his eyesight in an accident, billionaire Karan Malhotra is abandoned by his girlfriend and pushed to the edge of despair. Aradhya, a strong-willed woman hiding her own powerful identity, saves him and agrees to a contract marriage to become his “eyes.” As Karan battles betrayal, a murderous stepbrother, and corporate conspiracies within Malhotra Jewels, the fake marriage slowly turns into real love while buried secrets about Aradhya, their past, and their child begin to surface.

jaadu-mantar.title: Jaadu Mantar
jaadu-mantar.description: Jadu Mantar” is an emotional fantasy thriller blending family drama, supernatural mystery, tantra, destiny, and heartwarming human connections . where one little girl becomes the final hope against a darkness powerful enough to destroy an entire bloodline.

husband-wife-and-others-1.title: Husband, Wife and Others
husband-wife-and-others-1.description: The story is a long romance-drama built around love that keeps collapsing under secrecy, jealousy, and public scandal. It begins with ordinary intimacy being interrupted by work pressure, business calls, and the struggle to balance affection with ambition. Even early celebrations, like birthdays and surprise gatherings, become tense when sincerity is questioned and one partner seems unable to stay fully present. As the relationships deepen, accusations of betrayal, hidden motives, and emotional control begin to dominate every bond. Several women challenge the men in their lives by demanding honesty, refusing empty gifts, and insisting that luxury cannot replace trust. Sacrifice also becomes a major source of conflict, especially when a donation, a medical crisis, or a serious illness forces painful choices. The central Virat-Isha bond grows increasingly unstable as jealousy, outside rivals, and pregnancy rumors keep pulling them apart. Isha repeatedly confronts Virat over cheating, distance, and broken trust, while Virat tries to hold the relationship together without ever fully escaping the surrounding chaos. Rival women and former connections keep resurfacing, making it unclear who can truly claim him or what promises still matter. The emotional stakes rise when violence enters the story, leaving Isha injured and devastated after a planned attack. Soon after, she suffers the loss of her baby, which deepens the tragedy and hardens the rivalry around Virat. From that point on, the romance is no longer just about hurt feelings but about grief, blame, and survival.
