Isha grows more distant, disappears, returns with painful secrets, and begins acting as if separation may be inevitable. Public exposure then turns private betrayal into a larger crisis, with a viral intimate video, abuse allegations, and a marriage unraveling in front of everyone. The fallout reaches the company as well, since shares are sold, control is challenged, and Virat fights to keep both his reputation and his power. Even when the story briefly softens into career recovery and admiration from others, the emotional damage remains unresolved. By the end, repeated pleas for forgiveness and reconciliation fail, and the characters are left facing fractured families, broken trust, and relationships that cannot easily be repaired.

intern-no-1.title: Intern No. 1
intern-no-1.description: Pratik, a gifted designer and secret husband of billionaire CEO Krishika Dhawan, joins Vista as an intern to earn success on his own merit. But Adi, a manipulative imposter, pretends to be Krishika’s husband and humiliates him at every step. Amid office politics, betrayal, family conflict, and deadly conspiracies, Pratik fights to protect his marriage, prove his identity, and emerge as the true visionary behind KP-Vista’s success Watch now.

primero-venganza-luego-amor.title: Primero Venganza, Luego Amor
primero-venganza-luego-amor.description: En nuestro tercer aniversario de bodas, mi esposo me humilló y me abandonó por su amante. Pensaron que era impotente, pero no sabían que soy la hija del hombre más rico del país. Toda su fortuna provenía de mí. Ese mismo día, el destino me condujo a un poderoso multimillonario que lo cambió todo. Ahora tengo riqueza, influencia y una nueva identidad. Que las cosas cambien.

ee635783-2ec8-43cb-9aa0-2a05a7da3f91.title: Breakup Lottery
ee635783-2ec8-43cb-9aa0-2a05a7da3f91.description:
Ajay spent his entire salary on a ring to propose to Suman — only to watch her walk away with a richer man, on the same day. Heartbroken and humiliated on the roadside, a stranger steps out of a car, wipes the mud off his face, and proposes to him instead.
The stranger is Kangana — CEO of the very company Suman works at.
This is a story of Ajay — a man who lost everything in one afternoon, and stumbled into something he never saw coming.

unknown-princess.title: Unknown Princess
unknown-princess.description: A microdrama unfolds around two sisters, a lost inheritance, and a profound deception. One sister's lies lead to impersonation and family betrayal, while the other, suffering from amnesia, is unaware of her true identity. As a powerful connection forms and deep family secrets unravel, a ruthless imposter is unmasked, leading to a fierce vow of revenge.

fake-wife-billionaire-ceo.title: Fake Wife Billionaire CEO
fake-wife-billionaire-ceo.description: Preethi’s story begins as a marriage crisis and quickly expands into a maze of betrayal, memory confusion, and competing claims of love. She first discovers that Raghav is hiding an affair, and the other woman is her close friend Reema. After a hospital injury and apparent memory loss, people around her start treating her as if she belongs to a different life, and she responds with denial, suspicion, and tests of their stories. Tarun Bhatra enters as a powerful husband figure who stays close to her, supports her, and is repeatedly presented as the man tied to her present life. At the same time, Raghav continues to hover as a husband claim from the past, openly mocking Preethi while maintaining a secret connection with Reema. The confusion deepens when Preethi is taken into a mansion and treated like the wife of the house, yet she still insists that an existing marital bond remains unresolved. Public settings turn the private hurt into spectacle, especially when a party game pushes the triangle into the open. Preethi is humiliated by Raghav’s flaunting of Reema, but she also begins to push back with surprising confidence. Her public kiss with Tarun makes the marriage question impossible to ignore, even as others argue that it was only part of a game. As the story continues, the romance web becomes more unstable, with accusations of deception, shifting loyalties, and repeated arguments over who is the real husband. Some characters insist that the husband Preethi knows is false, while Preethi herself refuses to accept that version of events. Legal pressure enters through divorce papers and a move toward formal dispute resolution, showing that the conflict has moved beyond emotion into public and official struggle. Reema’s claim of pregnancy adds another layer of jealousy and desperation, but it only sharpens the hostility around Raghav. Tarun remains the most consistent source of support, even as his bond with Preethi is complicated by memory loss and contested identity. Later revelations suggest that old manipulation and a long-planned deception may have shaped the entire situation from the start. Preethi confronts those false claims directly and contrasts them with what she feels Tarun has shown her about true love. Tarun then admits he has loved her for years and reveals that he had once hoped she would become part of his future long before she married someone else. The story closes in unresolved tension, with a temple wedding proceeding despite a man’s desperate interruption and the emotional stakes still centered on truth, possession, and whether Preethi can reclaim control over her own life.

6d72553b-d249-466b-a890-63df92ca01a7.title: Pati ki Chhichhori Girlfriend
6d72553b-d249-466b-a890-63df92ca01a7.description:
Veronica loved Sahil in silence for years — until the day he proposed to Kavya right in front of her. Humiliated and heartbroken, she left without a word. But she came back — and this time, she has a plan.
What unfolds is a dangerous game of obsession, seduction, and revenge that neither Sahil nor Kavya saw coming.
This is a story of a woman who was overlooked — and decided to make them regret it.

rich-mama-kiladi-kodalu.title: Rich Mama Kiladi Kodalu
rich-mama-kiladi-kodalu.description: Ruhi traps a rich heir, pretending to be innocent while secretly cheating on him. When she humiliates an old man at a car showroom—beating him, insulting him, and burning his wife’s last photograph—she doesn’t realize he is Rajat Singhania, the billionaire founder and her fiancé’s father. Now the insulted tycoon plans a brutal revenge, determined to expose her truth and destroy her in front of the entire city.

officer-on-duty.title: Officer On Duty
officer-on-duty.description: Country’s most celebrated defense scientist is beaten, humiliated, and nearly erased by a billionaire’s untouchable daughter after a roadside clash spirals into violence. But when the assault video goes viral, buried truths explode into public view. Now, one arrogant empire faces the terrifying reality that the man they destroyed may be the one holding their future in his hands.

ala-sravani-nivasamulo.title: Ala Sravani Nivasamulo
ala-sravani-nivasamulo.description: శ్రావణి రెడ్డి.. 18ఏళ్ళుగా మనసులో పెద్ద భారాన్ని మోస్తూనే ఉంది. తన ఇంట్లో ఉన్న వారి మీద పగ తీర్చుకోవడానికి ఆమె సరైన సమయం కోసం ఎదురు చూస్తోంది. శ్రావణి ఇంట్లో జరిగిన ఆసక్తికరమైన కథ "అల శ్రావణి నివాసములో"

mysterious-mogudu.title: Mysterious Mogudu
mysterious-mogudu.description: A war hero who chooses domesticity over medals becomes invisible inside his own marriage—dismissed, humiliated, and betrayed by the woman he loves and the family he supports. As emotional cruelty replaces bullets and ambition replaces loyalty, a buried past resurfaces, forcing a gentle husband to confront how far betrayal can push a man before he breaks.

dhokhebaaz-haseena.title: Dhokhebaaz Haseena
dhokhebaaz-haseena.description: The microdrama centers on the intricate saga of wealthy heir Anant, initially a victim of profound betrayal. His beloved Sonia, presumed dead, faked her suicide with her lover Mayank to steal his fortune, leaving Anant consumed by guilt. Three years later, Sonia reappears, attempting a similar deceit, but Anant, now hardened and astute, has meticulously planned his retribution. He swiftly secures Sonia's shares, declares her legally dead, and divorces her, setting the stage for a high-stakes battle for inheritance and justice. Anant's transformation into a cold and ruthless figure is evident as he orchestrates the financial ruin of others, including his ex-sister-in-law Sadhvi, and deliberately jeopardizes Mayank's life. Sonia, under the guise of Tara at times, desperately attempts to win Anant back, but faces brutal rejection, public humiliation, and ostracization. Her life spirals into destitution, marked by her abandonment of a comatose Mayank due to exorbitant medical costs, and even her own sisters, manipulated by Anant, conspire to stab her for inheritance. Amidst these personal dramas, Anant finds a devoted friend and later wife in Kritika, while navigating complex relationships with Radha and Shruti, whom he cruelly rejects after exposing Mayank's lies. The narrative is a complex web of betrayal, manipulation, and shifting loyalties, culminating in Sonia's tragic downfall and Anant's relentless pursuit of vengeance, leaving a trail of ruined lives and unresolved conflicts.

my-fake-pondatti.title: My Fake Pondatti
my-fake-pondatti.description: After enduring five years of emotional abuse and neglect while posing as a lowly delivery boy to save his marriage, a secret billionaire finally exposes his unfaithful wife and her toxic family. Faced with his meteoric rise to power and the truth behind their "contract marriage," the wife struggles with regret as she realizes she traded a devoted man for a hollow opportunist.

49332f81-25eb-48d6-a68b-308d8fcc02b4.title: Dev - Ek Yodha
49332f81-25eb-48d6-a68b-308d8fcc02b4.description: The story begins in a spiritual training world where students are pushed to awaken hidden abilities, but prejudice and hierarchy repeatedly block those who show promise. A fire at an animal shelter forces an urgent use of forbidden knowledge, and the student who helps is praised only briefly before being condemned as untouchable and accused of crossing boundaries he was never meant to cross. Another low-status student later creates an extraordinary weapon and is denied instruction even after proving his talent, which only deepens suspicion that prophecy is at work. Across these early threads, the central tension is clear: worth is being measured by status, yet the most capable people are the ones being rejected. The search for a true protector then expands beyond the Gurukul, with a higher authority declaring that the one who can answer profound questions will become the community’s defender. That test falls on a low-caste aspirant who must succeed or be permanently excluded, turning knowledge itself into a gatekeeper. The narrative then shifts into a harsher political world where a ruler’s regime crushes villagers with taxes, whippings, debt, and forced labor. In that setting, a warrior figure begins to emerge as a hope for the oppressed by stopping soldiers from seizing a debtor and escorting vulnerable people through danger. At the same time, a marked destiny seems to follow him, and the ruler’s retaliation suggests that this unknown challenger is tied to a larger rebellion. Another major thread centers on healing and social injustice, as greedy healers demand payment before treatment and are challenged by Dev and others who defend compassion over profit. Dev’s healing of a child and later of Siya’s father proves his skill, but it also threatens established authority and draws hostility from those who profit from suffering. Siya’s recovery leads into a marriage struggle where she openly chooses Dev, while powerful figures try to override her choice through status, force, and public ceremony. Dev is repeatedly attacked for his unknown lineage and low standing, yet moments of recognition, including a matriarch publicly adopting him after revealing he once saved her son, briefly strengthen his claim. The swayamvar-like contests become a public battle over legitimacy, with riddles, strength trials, and disputed judgments exposing how easily rules can be bent against the unwanted. Even when Dev wins, rivals accuse him of cheating or delay, and the victory turns into a tense standoff rather than peace. Parallel to this, a separate martial and philosophical thread shows a combatant choosing mercy after victory, underscoring the story’s recurring contrast between power used to dominate and power used to protect. As the marriage conflict and destiny thread intensify, Dev is revealed as the marked man sought by rulers who fear prophecy and want to control or destroy him. He is forced into confrontations with magical attackers, dark manipulation, and enemies who use Siya as leverage, but he repeatedly refuses to abandon her. The tyrant’s pressure escalates into ultimatums that demand Dev surrender himself or lose Siya, and later even his powers, yet he continues to resist. Menka’s attempt to merge with him and absorb his power adds another layer of coercion, showing how many forces want to consume what makes him dangerous. By the end of the batch, Dev’s loyalty to Siya and his refusal to submit to tyranny have become the core of the story. The arc closes with him pushed into a destined protective role, suggesting that the very qualities others tried to suppress are the ones that make him the community’s hope.

final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga-4.title: Final Betrayal - Honeymoon Saga
final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga-4.description: Final Betrayal – Season 2 continues the gripping saga from Season 1, where a humble beggar marries a dhokla vendor, only for a shocking revelation to surface later: the beggar is, in fact, a billionaire. In Season 2, the newly married couple travels to Mauritius for their honeymoon. However, their dream getaway soon turns into a nightmare as unforeseen events and dangerous secrets plunge them into chaos, testing their relationship, trust, and survival.

ab-khel-badlega.title: Ab Khel Badlega
ab-khel-badlega.description: Samir, a struggling nobody with a mysterious ability to see the hidden truth behind people and objects suddenly finds himself inside Mumbai’s deadliest gangster Tiger Bhau's empire after saving a rival don’s grandson. As corrupt heirs, fake loyalties, and criminal power games close in, he becomes the only man capable of exposing lies, reshaping the empire, and helping the don’s idealistic daughter  Zoi Bhau turn a world built on fear into something legal—and human.

uttarmarga-where-freedom-reigns.title: Uttarmarga: Where Freedom Reigns
uttarmarga-where-freedom-reigns.description: Where Freedom Reigns" is more than just a story of freedom—it is a journey through the dreams, struggles, and sacrifices that shaped India’s fight for independence. Set against the backdrop of oppressive feudal rule, social injustice, love, loss, and hope, this powerful tale follows ordinary people striving for dignity, identity, and true freedom. An emotional, inspiring, and deeply moving audiobook experience that brings history and humanity to life.

india-and-the-silk-roads-the-history-of-.title: India and the Silk Roads: The History of a Trading World
india-and-the-silk-roads-the-history-of-.description: இந்தியா மற்றும் மத்திய ஆசியா இடையிலான காரவான் வர்த்தகம், சில்க் சாலைகளில் முக்கியமான இடத்தை பெற்றிருந்தது மற்றும் கப்பல், ஆவிரயில் காலத்திலும் அது முழுமையாக மறையவில்லை. ஜக்‌ஜீத் லல்லி தனது ஆய்வில், இந்த வர்த்தகத்தின் பயணங்களை வரலாற்று ஆவணங்கள் மற்றும் தொல்லியல் ஆதாரங்கள் மூலம் விளக்குகிறார். அவர் இந்த வணிக நெடுஞ்சாலைகள் அரசுகளின் கட்டுப்பாட்டை மீறி, தனித்துவமான இயக்கங்களை கொண்டிருந்ததை உணர்த்துகிறார். இது, வரலாற்றை பேரரசுகள் மற்றும் அதிகாரங்கள் மூலமே விளக்கும் பழமையான முறையை மாற்றுகிறது. காரவான் வர்த்தகம், உலகத்தின் பல மாற்றங்களுடன் தன்னைத் தானாக ஏற்கக்கூடிய தன்மையைக் கொண்டிருந்தது. இந்த பார்வை உலகமயமாக்கலை புதிய கோணத்தில் புரிந்து கொள்ள உதவுகிறது. இன்று சீனாவின் “Belt and Road” திட்டம் மூலம் நில வழி தொடர்புகள் மீண்டும் உயிர் பெறும் நிலையில், இந்த வரலாற்று பார்வை நம் காலத்திற்கு மிகுந்த பொருத்தம் உடையதாக இருக்கிறது.

lekhak-kaise-bane.title: Lekhak Kaise Bane
lekhak-kaise-bane.description: क्या आपके भीतर एक छिपा हुआ लेखक है? रस्किन बॉण्ड की यह किताब उसी लेखक को जगाने का प्रयास है। विषय चुनाव, यादगार पात्र, जीवंत भाषा और लेखकीय जीवन की चुनौतियों का सरल समाधान — यह हैंडबुक हर aspiring writer के लिए अनमोल मार्गदर्शक है!

യക്ഷികഥകൾ-.title: യക്ഷികഥകൾ
യക്ഷികഥകൾ-.description: യക്ഷി - മനോഹരവും വശ്യവുമായ രൂപത്തിലും നോട്ടത്തിലും തന്റെ പകയും പ്രതികാരവും മറച്ചുവെച്ച ഒരു സ്ത്രീ രൂപം. പകയും പ്രേമവും തമ്മിലുള്ള സൂഷ്മമായ അതിരിലാണ് അവളുടെ സാന്നിധ്യം. പഴങ്കഥകളിൽ നിന്നും പുറത്ത് വന്നുള്ള ഒരു യാഥാർത്ഥ്യമായി അവളെ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് അറിയണ്ടേ...യക്ഷിക്കഥകൾക്ക് അപ്പുറം, പഴമയും ആചാരങ്ങളും അടിച്ചമർത്തലുകൾക്കും ഇടയിൽ ഒറ്റയ്ക്ക് പട പൊരുതിയ ഒരു സ്ത്രീയുടെ ഒറ്റയാൾ പോരാട്ടം ... കേൾക്കൂ യക്ഷിക്കഥകൾ.

br-ambedkar-last-days-and-legacy.title: BR. Ambedkar - Last Days And Legacy
br-ambedkar-last-days-and-legacy.description:
అంబేద్కర్ గారి చివరి రోజులు ఆరోగ్యపరంగా క్లిష్టంగా ఉన్నా, ఆలోచనల పరంగా మాత్రం ఉజ్వలంగా సాగాయి. షుగర్, హై బీపీ, న్యూరో సమస్యలు ఉన్నా, ఆయన రచనలు ఆగలేదు. 1956లో "బుద్ధా అండ్ హిస్ ధమ్మా" గ్రంథాన్ని పూర్తిచేశారు.

అదే ఏడాది అక్టోబర్ 14న, నాగ్‌పూర్‌లో బౌద్ధమతంలో మారారు. ఇది కేవలం మతమార్పు కాకుండా, దళితుల కోసం మార్గదర్శకంగా నిలిచింది. డిసెంబర్ 6న ఢిల్లీలోని తన నివాసంలో ఆయన పరమపదించారు.

అంబేద్కర్ చివరి శ్వాస వరకు సమానత్వం, న్యాయం కోసం జీవించారు. ఆయన మరణం ఒక సమాప్తం కాదు — ఒక కొత్త యుగానికి ప్రారంభం.

mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-shakuni-1.title: Mahabharat ke Amar Patra: Shakuni
mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-shakuni-1.description: Shakuni — the cunning king of Gandhar, uncle of the Kauravas, and the mastermind behind Mahabharat's greatest catastrophe. Driven by vengeance for the injustice done to his sister Gandhari, he vowed to destroy the entire Kuru dynasty — manipulating Duryodhana and orchestrating the events that led to the devastating Kurukshetra war!

brother.title: Brother
brother.description: விக்ரம் ஒரு பெரிய தொழிலதிபராக கடுமையாக உழைக்கும் மனிதன். சஞ்சனா என்ற பெண்ணை காதலிக்கிறான். தன் காதலை விட குடும்பமே முக்கியம் என்று முடிவு எடுக்கிறான் விக்ரம். அதனால் அவனை விட்டு செல்கிறாள் சஞ்சனா. தன் தொழிலில் கடுமையாக உழைத்து பெரிய ஆளாக நினைக்கும் விக்ரமிற்கு  சஞ்சனாவின் நியாபகங்கள் தடையாக நிற்கிறது. மேலும், கோவிட்-19 காரணமாக ஏற்பட்ட சிக்கல்களால், விக்ரம் மற்றும் அவரது குடும்பம் புதிய சோதனைகளை எதிர்கொள்கிறது. விக்ரம் என்ன செய்வான்? அவனும் சஞ்சனாவும் இணைவார்களா?

നീരാളി.title: നീരാളി
നീരാളി.description:
ആരെ ചതിച്ചും എങ്ങനെയും വിജയിക്കുക .. എട്ടു ദിവസം അവരിൽ ആർക്കൊക്കെ അതിജീവിക്കാനാകും ..എന്തൊക്കെ ടാസ്കുകളാണ് അവരെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നത് .. ആരാണ് ഈ റിയാലിറ്റി ഷോയുടെ നടത്തിപ്പിന് പിന്നിൽ .. 
ഓരോ ദിവസമായി പലരും കൊല്ലപ്പെടുന്ന ആ ഗേമിൽ രേണുകക്ക് വിജയിക്കാനാകുമോ .. കേൾക്കുക ഒരു കിടിലൻ സർവൈവൽ ത്രില്ലർ...

karnpishachini.title: Karnpishachini
karnpishachini.description: After losing both his business and his fiancée, Veer Mehra meets a mysterious Aghori who introduces him to a powerful occult ritual that changes his destiny. Soon, the enigmatic Kanika enters his life, making him rich, powerful, and capable of taking revenge on his enemies. But Veer soon discovers that Kanika is a supernatural entity who lures men into her deadly trap before claiming their souls.

Kerala-Crimes--കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങൾ-പെരുകുന്ന-.title: Kerala Crimes-  കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങൾ പെരുകുന്ന കേരളം
Kerala-Crimes--കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങൾ-പെരുകുന്ന-.description: അപൂർവമായി മാത്രം നമ്മുക്കിടയിൽ കേട്ടു കേൾവിയുണ്ടായിരുന്ന കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങൾ, കൊലപാതകങ്ങൾ, അതും കൂട്ട കൊലപാതകങ്ങൾ, ഉറ്റവർക്കും ബന്ധുക്കൾക്കും നേരെയുളള അതിക്രമങ്ങൾ എന്നിവയെല്ലാം ഒരേ ദിവസം തന്നെ ഒന്നിൽ കൂടുതൽ എണ്ണം നമ്മുടെ കേരളത്തിൽ ഇന്ന് നടക്കുന്നു...യുവാക്കൾക്കിടയിൽ വർദ്ധിച്ചു വരുന്ന ലഹരിയുടെ ഉപയോഗവും, സിനിമയും, ഇൻ്റർനെറ്റും അടക്കമുളളവയുടെ അമിത സ്വാധീനവും ഇതിനു കാരണമാകാം? എവിടെയാണ് നമുക്ക് കാര്യങ്ങൾ പിഴച്ചു പോകുന്നത്??? കേൾക്കാം....

divorced-on-wedding-day.title: Divorced On Wedding Day
divorced-on-wedding-day.description:
കല്യാണ ദിവസം തന്നെ രണ്ട് വഴിക്കോ!!
ജീവിതകാലം മുഴുവൻ ഒരുമിച്ചു ജീവിക്കാൻ തീരുമാനിച്ച അവരുടെ ജീവിതത്തിൽ ഇടിത്തീ പോലെയാണ് അന്ന് അത് സംഭവിച്ചത്... മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന ഒട്ടനവധി രഹസ്യങ്ങളാലും വിലക്കപ്പെട്ട പ്രണയത്തിന്റെ തീവ്രതയാലും സംഭവബഹുലമായ ആ കല്യാണ ദിവസം ആരും മറക്കില്ല....

karn-20.title: Karn 2.0
karn-20.description: Show ki kahani Atharva Dixit ke ird-gird ghoomti hai, jo khud ko Mahabharat ke 'Karn' ka punarjanm maanta hai. Uske kandhe par Arjun ke baan ka nishaan hai aur use har roz Mahabharat ke yuddh ka sapna aata hai. Shri Krishna ne use Kalyug mein ek khaas maqsad ke liye bheja hai, jahan use Arjun se apna badla bhi lena hai. Par kya hai Shri Krishna ka voh maqsad? Janne ke liye suniye yeh romanchak audio show!

falling-for-my-ex.title: Falling for MY EX
falling-for-my-ex.description: தன்னை உயிருக்கு உயிராய் நேசித்த ரியாவை காரணமே சொல்லாமல் பிரேக்கப் செய்து விட்டு பாரின் சென்று விடுகிறான் ஆரவ். மனம் உடைந்த ரியா காதல் தந்த வலியை தன் இடைவிடாத வேலை மூலமாக மறக்க முயல்கிறாள். ஆனால், ஐந்து வருடத்திற்கு பிறகு மீண்டும் அவள் வாழ்கையில் புயலாய் நுழைகிறான் ஆரவ். இருவரும் ஒரே ப்ராஜெக்ட்டில் பார்ட்னராக மாற பழைய காதல் மோதலாக வெளிப்பட தொடங்குகிறது... ஆரவ் ரியாவை நெருங்க முயலுகிறான்... ஆனா ரியா அவனை மன்னிப்பாளா... ஆரவ் எதற்க்காக ரியாவை பிரேக்கப் செய்தான்? அவர்களை விதி மீண்டும் இணைக்குமா?

the-empire-wife.title: The Empire Wife
the-empire-wife.description: Aadhira Malhotra, India’s powerful hotel empire heiress, treats her middle-class husband Vivaan like a stranger. Humiliated as a “ghar jamai,” Vivaan hides a shocking secret — he is the world’s most famous masked celebrity chef, Chef Veer. But when Aadhira starts losing her memories due to a mysterious neurological disorder, Vivaan discovers someone inside the family is secretly destroying her mind to steal the empire. Now love, betrayal, and power collide in a dangerous game.

your-mind-and-how-to-use-it-a-manual-of-.title: Your Mind and How to Use It: A Manual of Practical Psychology
your-mind-and-how-to-use-it-a-manual-of-.description: மனதின் இயல்பையும், அதன் செயல்பாடுகளையும் விளக்கும் காலத்தால் சோதிக்கப்பட்ட ஒரு வழிகாட்டி. New Thought இயக்கத்தின் முன்னோடியான வில்லியம் வாக்கர் அட்கின்சன் எழுதிய இந்த நூல், சிந்தனை, உணர்ச்சி, விருப்பம் போன்ற மனத் திறன்களைப் புரிந்து கொண்டு, அவற்றைப் பயனுள்ளதாக மாற்றும் முறைகளை பகிர்கிறது. மன சக்தியை முழுமையாகப் பயன்படுத்த விரும்பும் அனைவருக்கும் இது ஒரு தெளிவான மற்றும் பயனுள்ள பயணமாக இருக்கும்.

the-art-of-being-happy.title: The Art of Being Happy
the-art-of-being-happy.description: மிக நீண்ட காலமாக, நாம் மகிழ்ச்சியை அடைய அனுபவப்பூர்வமான ஆலோசனைகளிலும் பரிசோதிக்கப்படாத வழிகளிலும் நம்பிக்கை வைத்து வந்திருக்கிறோம். ஆனால், இப்போது இந்த புத்தகம், உளவியல், நரம்பியல் அறிவியல் (Neuroscience), பரிணாம உயிரியல் (Evolutionary Biology) மற்றும் பல்வேறு துறைகளிலிருந்து பெறப்பட்ட சமீபத்திய கண்டுபிடிப்புகளை ஒருங்கிணைத்து, நம்முடைய சொந்த மகிழ்ச்சியை எவ்வாறு உருவாக்கி, நிறைவான வாழ்க்கையை வாழ முடியும் என்பதை விளக்குகிறது.

bhai-ki-dulhan.title: Bhai Ki Dulhan
bhai-ki-dulhan.description: Bhargavi Malhotra’s life shatters when she discovers the true face and betrayal of her fiancé, Prateek Raichand. In the middle of this heartbreak, she meets Agastya Raichand — a billionaire abandoned by his own family. What begins as a contract marriage slowly turns into love, but Prateek’s unexpected return changes everything. Caught between betrayal, revenge, and emotions, Bhargavi and Agastya must fight for their relationship before the past destroys them forever.

kilmorton-maaligaiyin-marmangal.title: Kilmorton Maaligaiyin Marmangal
kilmorton-maaligaiyin-marmangal.description: எதிர்பாராத நேரத்தில் தனது கண்முன்னே நடக்கும் ஒரு விபத்தில் புதைந்துள்ள மர்மத்தை மோப்பம் பிடித்து, அதற்கு காரணமான கொலைகாரனைத் தேடி களத்தில் இறங்குகிறாள் ஆலியா . அவளையும் அந்த கில்மோர்ட்டோன் மாளிகையையும்  சுற்றி நடக்கும் திகில் சம்பவங்கள் என்னென்ன ?

my-mistress.title: My Mistress
my-mistress.description: അത്ര സുഖകരമല്ലാത്ത സിദ്ധാർത്ഥിൻ്റെയും മീരയുടെയും ദാമ്പത്യ ജീവിതത്തിലേക്ക് കടന്നുവന്ന ആ മൂന്നാമതൊരാൾ ആരാണെന്ന് അറിയണ്ടേ... കേൾക്കൂ

ceos-doctor-wife.title: CEO's Doctor Wife
ceos-doctor-wife.description: Aditi sacrifices years of her life to help Shikhar become a doctor, only to discover that he has married a wealthy woman and cast her aside as a mere “village girl.” Heartbroken, she saves the life of an injured stranger, Virat, and enters a contract marriage with him. What she doesn't know is that Virat is a billionaire pharmaceutical CEO and a feared mafia king.

yarivanu-a-tale-of-billaniore.title: Yarivanu - A Tale of Billaniore
yarivanu-a-tale-of-billaniore.description: ಮೈಥಿಲಿಯ ಪ್ರೇಮ, ವೀರಭದ್ರನ ದುರಾಸೆ, ಮತ್ತು ರವಿವರ್ಮನ ಜೀವನದ ನಿಜವಾದ ಹಿನ್ನಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಿರುವ ಈ ಕಥೆಯೇ ಯಾರಿವನು - A Tale of Billionaire

ghost-marriage.title: Ghost Marriage
ghost-marriage.description: ரியா, தன் லவ்வர் அர்ஜுனுக்காக தன் பரம்பரை வீட்டை அடகு வைக்கிறாள். அவனோ ரியாவின் தோழியோடு ரகசிய தொடர்பில் இருக்க, உண்மை  அறிந்து மனம் உடைகிறாள் ரியா. பெரும் போராட்டாத்திற்கு பிறகு அந்த வீட்டை மீட்டு மன மாற்றத்திற்காக அங்கே செல்லும் ரியாவை அந்த வீட்டில் இருக்கும் பேய் ஒன்று தன்னை திருமணம் செய்து கொள்ள வேண்டும் என மிரட்டுகிறது. அந்த பேயின் நோக்கம் என்ன... ஒரு பேய் எதற்காக மனுசியை திருமணம் செய்ய வேண்டும்... ரியா இதிலிருந்து எப்படி தப்பிக்க போகிறாள்...

the-silent-hunt.title: The Silent Hunt
the-silent-hunt.description: Five years ago, detective Akshat Mehra lost everything when a mysterious serial killer brutally murdered his wife and daughter. Now, a new murder bearing the same chilling signature pulls him back into a deadly game. With a fearless inspector by his side, Akshat uncovers a sinister conspiracy hidden within the system itself. But can he unmask the killer before becoming the next victim, or will his thirst for revenge consume him first? The hunt has begun.

kingfizzer-the-rise-and-fall-of-vijay-ma.title: Kingfizzer: The Rise and Fall of Vijay Mallya
kingfizzer-the-rise-and-fall-of-vijay-ma.description: விஜய் மல்லையாவின் மாஸ்டர் மைண்ட் , வெற்றிகள் , பிரெச்சனைகள் மட்டும் வீழ்ச்சியை பற்றி தெளிவான ஒரு தொகுப்பு . Kingfizzer எவ்வாறு உருவாயிற்று , மல்லையாவின் பங்கு மற்றும் பல தகவல்கள் உள்ளது.

a-ceo-and-star-story.title: A CEO and Star Story
a-ceo-and-star-story.description: ஆறு சாதனையாளர் பெண்கள் தங்கள் சக்திவாய்ந்த தாத்தாவால் ஒரு அசாதாரண திருமண பரிந்துரையைப் பேச அழைக்கப்படுகிறார்கள். சமூக எதிர்பார்ப்புகள் மற்றும் தனிப்பட்ட ஆசைகளை எதிர்கொண்டு, அவர்கள் தங்களின் முன்னணி கருத்துக்களையும், காதலின் உண்மையான அர்த்தத்தையும் சந்திக்க வேண்டும். குடும்ப உறவுகள் மற்றும் எதிர்பாராத வெளிப்பாடுகளின் குழப்பத்தில், ஒரு பெண்மணியின் துணிச்சலான தேர்வு, நெறிமுறைகளை சவால் செய்து, மகிழ்ச்சியை மறுபரிசீலிக்க வைக்கிறது.

dhurandhar-doctor.title: Dhurandhar Doctor
dhurandhar-doctor.description: Rehan, an eight-year-old boy, suffered a life-threatening head injury after a tragic fall. As his family desperately waits for renowned neurosurgeon Dr. Aryan Mehra to save him, Aryan is delayed by the arrogant Neelima Verma, who values her luxury car over a dying child's life. Unaware that the child is her own nephew, her ego sparks a race against time where every second could mean the difference between life and death.

the-spirit-code-what-survives-after-deat.title: The Spirit Code: What survives After Death?
the-spirit-code-what-survives-after-deat.description:
చైతన్యం మరణంతో ముగియదు, అది వివిధ రూపాల్లో కొనసాగుతుంది – జ్ఞాపకాలుగా, అనుభవాలుగా.
డిజిటల్ ఆఫ్టర్‌లైఫ్ ద్వారా మన చైతన్యాన్ని కంప్యూటర్‌లో నిలుపుకునే ప్రయత్నాలు జరుగుతున్నాయి.
శాస్త్రం, తత్వం, అనుభవాలు – ఇవన్నీ కలసి మన ఆత్మ మరణం తరువాత కూడా యాత్రను కొనసాగిస్తుందనే భావనను బలపరుస్తున్నాయి.

detective-namit-mumbai-local.title: Detective Namit - Mumbai Local
detective-namit-mumbai-local.description: When a film financier mysteriously disappears from a crowded Mumbai local and turns up dead in a staged crime scene, eccentric detective Namit Rao dives into a twisted investigation where murders mimic cinema—uncovering a hidden game of revenge, illusion, and a killer scripting death like a film.

nalan-dhamayanthi.title: Nalan Dhamayanthi
nalan-dhamayanthi.description:
தன்னை அடைய நினைக்கும் கணவனின் சகோதரனின் சூழ்ச்சிகளை முறியடிக்கும் தமயந்தி. தன் சகோதரனை நம்பும் நலன் துரோகம், காதல், 
 சூழ்ச்சி என பல பரிமாணங்களை கொண்ட கதை ' நளன்  தமயந்தி '

ipl-winning-stars.title: IPL : Winning Stars
ipl-winning-stars.description: IPL வரலாற்றில் ஸ்டார்ஸ் ஆக திகழ்ந்து ஒரு கலக்கு கலக்கிய டோனி , மலிங்கா பிராவோ , சிங் , ஹர்திக் போன்ற பல  IPL Winning Stars பற்றிய ஆடியோ சீரிஸ் .

haare-ka-sahara.title: Haare Ka Sahara
haare-ka-sahara.description: Ravi Sharma has lost almost everything - his job, his dignity, and the trust of his family. While his wife, son, and in-laws blame him for their struggles, Ravi refuses to give up his unwavering faith in Khatu Shyam Baba. As life pushes him to the edge of despair, a series of mysterious events begin to change his destiny. But will his faith help him reclaim his family, respect, and lost identity, or will he lose everything forever?

the-price-of-passion.title: The Price Of Passion
the-price-of-passion.description: One unforgettable night. A stranger’s bed. And a contract that changed everything. Natalie Morrison thought it was a mistake—something to forget. But Adrian Richardson, billionaire CEO with a dark past, doesn’t forget. He hunts her down, claiming her as his own in a twisted game of power, control, and obsession. Trapped in a luxurious prison, Natalie must obey every rule—or face the consequences. As her world spirals into a blend of danger, desire, and deception, the line between hate and longing begins to blur. Is this madness, punishment, or something deeper?

തിരയും-തീരവും-.title: തിരയും തീരവും
തിരയും-തീരവും-.description: കടലോരജീവിതം പ്രമേയമാക്കിയ ജോസി വാഗമറ്റത്തിൻ്റെ ബ്ലോക്ക്ബസ്റ്റർ നോവൽ ചാവുകടലിൻ്റെ അവസാന ഭാഗം.  പകയും വൈരാഗ്യവും ഏരിഞ്ഞൊടുങ്ങാത്ത കടപ്പുറത്ത് അശാന്തിയുടെ കാറ്റ് വിതയ്ക്കുന്ന ഉദ്ദ്വേഗഭരിതവും സംഘർഷഭരിതവുമായ ഇതിവൃത്തമാണു ഈ നോവലിൻ്റെ വശ്യത. പരുക്കൻ ജീവിവിത യാഥാർത്ഥ്യങ്ങളുടെ കാറിനും കോളിനുമിടയിലൂടെ തെളിനീരുറവ പോലെ ഒഴുകുന്ന പ്രണയത്തിൻ്റെ  ധാരയും. കേൾക്കാം തിരയും തീരവും....

crown-of-shadow.title: Crown of Shadow
crown-of-shadow.description: After being presumed dead for 10 years, Vikram Singhania returns to reclaim his place in India’s most powerful business family. But behind his royal charm hides a terrifying identity feared by Tokyo’s underworld—“The Dragon of Tokyo.” As betrayal, mafia wars, and family conspiracies unfold, a deadly battle for power begins where blood relations mean nothing and survival means everything.

the-psychology-of-indian-consumers.title: The Psychology Of Indian Consumers
the-psychology-of-indian-consumers.description:
భారతీయ వినియోగదారుల మనోభావాలు సామాజిక పరమైన ఒత్తిళ్లు, కుటుంబ విలువలు, మరియు బ్రాండ్ ప్రభావాలతో రూపుదిద్దుకుంటాయి.  
ధర, నమ్మకం, మరియు నాణ్యత ప్రధాన నిర్ణయకరణ అంశాలుగా ఉంటాయి.  
సాంకేతికత పెరుగుతోన్న సమయంలోనూ సంప్రదాయ పరమైన భావనలు ప్రాధాన్యత కలిగి ఉంటాయి.

the-rise-of-digital-gangsters.title: The Rise Of Digital Gangsters
the-rise-of-digital-gangsters.description:
డిజిటల్ గ్యాంగ్‌స్టర్లు అనేవారు కంప్యూటర్‌లు, ఇంటర్నెట్‌ను ఆయుధాలుగా మార్చిన నూతన తరానికి చెందిన నేరస్థులు.  
వారు బ్యాంకుల్ని హ్యాక్ చేయగలరు, డేటాను దోచుకుని లక్షలాది డాలర్లు కొల్లగొట్టగలరు.  
ఇవాళ ప్రపంచాన్ని ఓ స్క్రీన్ వెనక నుంచే శాసించే వీరిని ఎదుర్కొవడం ఎంతో క్లిష్టమైన పని.

the-mace-queen-2-downfall-of-the-dark-1.title: The Mace Queen 2- Downfall of the Dark
the-mace-queen-2-downfall-of-the-dark-1.description: Queen Mace ne apne kingdom ko bachakar shanti toh la di, lekin andhera ab pehle se zyada taaqat ke saath laut aaya hai. Ek pracheen evil force poore rajya ko nigalne ki taiyari mein hai. Dhokhe, raaz aur khooni jungon ke beech, Mace ko apni kismat ka saamna karna hoga. Kya woh andhere ko hara kar apne logon ko bacha payegi, ya darkness uski duniya ko hamesha ke liye apne kabze mein kar legi? An epic dark fantasy adventure.

why-time-feels-faster-as-we-age.title: Why Time Feels Faster As We Age
why-time-feels-faster-as-we-age.description:
వయస్సు పెరిగే కొద్దీ సమయం వేగంగా దూసుకెళ్తోంది అనిపించడానికి ప్రధాన కారణం — మన జీవితం కొలతలుగా, మునుపటి అనుభవాల ఆధారంగా మారిపోవడమే.  
చిన్నప్పుడు ప్రతిదీ కొత్తగా అనిపిస్తుంది, కానీ పెద్దవారయ్యాక రిపీట్ అయ్యే అనుభవాలు మనకి సమయం చాలా తక్కువగా గడిచిపోయినట్టు భావన కలుగజేస్తాయి.

the-fisher-queens-dynasty.title: The Fisher Queen's Dynasty
the-fisher-queens-dynasty.description: The Fisher Queen’s Dynasty by Kavita Kané is a powerful feminist retelling of the Mahabharata, centered on Satyavati. Born a fisherman’s daughter but driven by fierce ambition, she rises to become the matriarch of the Kuru empire. The book explores her transformation from an exploited girl into a ruthless queen who trades love for power, mapping the heavy price she pays for securing her dynasty and the tragic chain of events she sets off, leading to the devastating Kurukshetra war.

secret-marriage-1.title: Secret Marriage
secret-marriage-1.description: ಕಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಇರೋರನ್ನ ನೋಡಿದ್ರೆ ಮರುಗೋ ಶ್ರೇಯಾ, ಮನೆತನದ ಹಿರಿಮೆಯೇ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅನ್ನೋ ಸಿಇಓ ಆದಿತ್ಯ ದಿವಾನ್! ಈ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಜೋಡಿಯನ್ನ ಒಂದು ಮಾಡಿತ್ತು ಆ ಘಟನೆ! ಮೊದಲ ಭೇಟಿಯಲ್ಲೇ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗೋ ಈ ಕಪಲ್, ಮುಂದೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಬಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೀಳ್ತಾರಾ? ಅಥ್ವಾ ವಿವಾಹ ಬಂಧನದಿಂದ ಹೊರ ಬರುತ್ತಾ? ಕೇಳಿ ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಮ್ಯಾರೇಜ್'. ಓನ್ಲಿ ಆನ್ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ

vampire-castle.title: Vampire Castle
vampire-castle.description:
రక్తపాతం నిండిన కోట… ప్రతి గోడ వెనుక రహస్య శబ్దాలు, ప్రతి చీకటి కోణంలో మృతుల ఛాయలు!
ప్రతి అర్ధరాత్రి, బైట ముంచే శబ్దాల వెనుక ఎవరు ఉన్నారో నీకు తెలియదు… నీ ఊపిరిని ఆపేస్తుంది ఈ నిశ్శబ్దం.
ఇది కొంతకాలం క్రితం వదిలిన కోట కాదు… ఇది ఇప్పటికీ రక్తాన్ని కోరే విలన్‌ల ఊతంగా ఉన్న వెంపైర్ కోట!

rahasya-ki-galiyan.title: Rahasya Ki Galiyan
rahasya-ki-galiyan.description: In the ancient city of Varanasi, ACP Aarav Singh returns after 15 years only to face a chilling murder linked to a mysterious symbol — “रक्षति.” As he investigates hidden tunnels, secret societies, and deadly ancient legends, Aarav discovers his missing father was the last protector of a terrifying secret buried beneath Kashi. A gripping thriller of mystery, betrayal, history, and destiny unfolds in the dark alleys of India’s oldest city.

the-controversial-spies.title: The Controversial Spies
the-controversial-spies.description:
ఇవాళ్టి ప్రపంచ చరిత్రను మార్చిన శాడో వారియర్లు వీరే... దేశభక్తులా? లేక దేశద్రోహులా?
వాస్తవంగా వీరెవరు? వారి నిజమైన మిషన్ ఏమిటి..?

biggest-kidney-scandal.title: Biggest Kidney Scandal
biggest-kidney-scandal.description: ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನ ದೇವರ ಜೊತೆ ಹೋಲಿಸೋ ಭಾರತ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ "ವೈದ್ಯೋ ನಾರಾಯಣಿ ಹರಿ" ಅನ್ನೋದು ಪುರಾತನ ಕಾಲದಿಂದಲೂ ರೂಢಿಗತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ, 2008ರಲ್ಲಿ ದೇಶವನ್ನೇ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸುವಂತ ಭಾರೀ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದ ಕಿಡ್ನಿ ಹಗರಣವು ಬೆಳಕಿಗೆ ಬಂದಾಗ, ನಮ್ಮನ್ನ ನಾವೇ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವಂತ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶ ಎದುರಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಅಮಾನವೀಯ ಹಗರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ನೂರಾರು ಬಡ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರನ್ನ ಪುಸಲಾಯಿಸಿ, ಅವರ ಕಿಡ್ನಿಗಳನ್ನ ಒತ್ತಾಯಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಅಥವಾ ಮೋಸದಿಂದ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನ ಭಾರೀ ಮೊತ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತರಿಗೆ ಮಾರಾಟ ಮಾಡಲಾಗ್ತಿತ್ತು. ಹರಿಯಾಣ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಗುರುಗ್ರಾಮ್‌ದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಸಿದ್ದ ದೇಶದ ಬಹುದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಿಡ್ನಿ ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾಮ್‌ನ ಹಿಂದಿದ್ದ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಯಾರು? ಈ ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದ ಕಾಣದ ಕೈಗಳು ಯಾರದ್ದು? ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಕುರಿತಾದ ರೋಚಕ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "Biggest Kidney Scam" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

sarphira-aashiq.title: Sarphira Aashiq
sarphira-aashiq.description:
A perfect marriage. A dangerous obsession.
On their 5th wedding anniversary, Naina starts seeing a terrifying side of her husband Mayank — a man so possessive that love turns into madness. But while Mayank controls Naina’s every move, he hides a dark secret of his own… another woman. As betrayal, lies, and obsession collide, Naina’s perfect life begins to shatter.

the-super-chef.title: The Super Chef
the-super-chef.description: ഒരുകാലം നഗരത്തിലെ എറ്റവും വലിയ സെലിബ്രറ്റി ഷെഫ് ആയിരുന്നു അയാൾ, പ്രശസ്തിയുടെ ഒരു നാൾ അയാൾ പൊടുന്നനെ അപ്രത്യക്ഷനായി. ഇന്നിപ്പോൾ ഒരു സാധാരണ ഹോട്ടലിൽ ആരാലും തിരിച്ചറിയാതെ ഒരു സാധാരണ വെജിറ്റബിൾ കട്ടർ ആയി ജോലി ചെയ്യുന്നു! അയാളുടെ ഈ പതനത്തിനു പിന്നിലെ കാരണം എന്താണ്? ഈ അജ്ഞാതവാസം അവസാനിപ്പിച്ച് അയാൾ വീണ്ടും ഈ ലോകത്തിനും തൻ്റെ അമ്മക്കും മുന്നിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷപ്പെടുമോ? കേൾക്കാം...

orugallu-rahasyam.title: Orugallu Rahasyam
orugallu-rahasyam.description: శతాబ్దాలుగా ఎవ్వరికీ  తెలియకుండా దాగి ఉన్న కాకతీయుల నిధిని వెలికి తీసేందుకు ఆర్కియాలజిస్ట్ రుద్ర వర్మ, జర్నలిస్ట్ వసుంధర వారి బృందాలతో పయనమవుతారు. రహస్య దారులు,  ఎన్నో చిక్కుముడులు పరిష్కరిస్తూ, కార్పొరేట్ సంస్థ పెట్టే హింసలు దాటుకుంటూ, వాళ్ళు నిజంగా ఆ నిధిని చేరగలిగారా? దేవాలయం వెనుక దాగిన నిజం ఏంటి? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే “ఓరుగల్లు రహస్యం” ఆడియో సిరీస్ వినండి.

virasat.title: Virasat
virasat.description: A poor mechanic who is actually the eldest heir of a billionaire family. In childhood, his stepmother burned his hand with a hot iron, leaving scars not only on his skin but also deep within his heart. Now, he is returning with 10 crore rupees and his father’s will… ready to take revenge.

history-of-ugadi.title: History of Ugadi
history-of-ugadi.description: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಹಿಂದೂ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯುಗಾದಿ ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಸ್ಥಾನ-ಮಾನಗಳಿವೆ. ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ಇತಿಹಾಸವನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿರೋ ಈ ಹಬ್ಬವು ಹೊಸ ಯುಗದ ಆರಂಭವನ್ನ ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಚೈತ್ರ ಮಾಸದ ಶುಕ್ಲ ಪಕ್ಷದ ಪ್ರತಿಪದ ತಿಥಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೋ ಯುಗಾದಿ ಹಬ್ಬವನ್ನು ಹಿಂದೂ ಪಂಚಾಂಗದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಹೊಸ ವರ್ಷದ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ದೇವತೆಗಳ ಪೂಜೆಯ ನಂತರ ಬೇವು ಹಾಗೂ ಬೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನು ಸೇವಿಸುವ ಪ್ರತೀತಿ ಇದೆ. ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೋ ಸುಖ-ದುಃಖಗಳನ್ನ ಸಮವಾಗಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತ ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಬೇಕು  ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಯುಗಾದಿ ಹಬ್ಬವು ಸಾರಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠವಾದ ಯುಗಾದಿ ಹಬ್ಬದ ಆರಂಭವಾದದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಯುಗಾದಿ ಹಬ್ಬದ ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ಇತಿಹಾಸವೇನು? ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಸುಂದರ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "History of Ugadi" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

baadalon-ke-uparki-jung-the-kargil-war.title: Baadalon Ke Uparki Jung-The Kargil War
baadalon-ke-uparki-jung-the-kargil-war.description:
Baadalon Ke Upar Ki Jung-The Kargil War

This is an emotional and inspiring story of the 1999 Kargil War, where brave Indian Army soldiers fight against death on the icy mountains to protect their nation.

Heroes like Captain Vikram Batra, Manoj Kumar Pandey, Anuj Nayyar, Vijayant Thapar, Yogendra Singh Yadav, and Sanjay Kumar set out on Operation Vijay to recapture Tiger Hill and Tololing from the enemy.

More than just a war story, this is a powerful tribute to India’s immortal heroes.

the-missing-celebrity-chef.title: The Missing Celebrity Chef
the-missing-celebrity-chef.description: வெற்றிக்கு பின் தலைமறைவான புகழ்பெற்ற chef . ஒரு சாதாரணமான ஹோட்டலில் காய்கறி நறுக்கும் வேலை செய்கிறார். Chefக்கு ஏன் இந்த நிலைமை . மறுபடி தன் முகத்தை இந்த உலகிற்கும் தன் தாய்க்கும் காட்டுவாரா ?

climate-change-5.title: Climate Change
climate-change-5.description:
ప్రపంచాన్ని మెల్లగా మింగేస్తున్న మానవ నిర్మిత విపత్తు — వాతావరణ మార్పు.
ముంచుకొస్తున్న తుఫాన్లు, ఎండిపోతున్న భూమి, మానవులపై మారుతున్న ప్రకృతిని ఆవిష్కరించే కథ.
ఇది భవిష్యత్తు కాదు… ఇప్పుడే జరుగుతోంది.

detective-samar-holmes-puppet-master.title: Detective Samar Holmes - Puppet Master (Season 1)
detective-samar-holmes-puppet-master.description: दिल्ली में 40 करोड़ का हीरा एक हाई-सिक्योरिटी शोरूम से बिना कोई अलार्म बजाए गायब हो जाता है। केस की जांच करते हुए डिटेक्टिव समर होम्स एक ऐसे खौफनाक खेल तक पहुँचता है, जहाँ मासूम बच्चे एक रहस्यमयी “पपेट मास्टर” के हाथों की कठपुतली बन चुके हैं। अब समर को सिर्फ अपराध नहीं, बल्कि इंसानी दिमाग को कंट्रोल करने वाले राक्षस से लड़ना है।

how-cities-shape-us-a-deep-dive-into-urb.title: How Cities Shape Us: A Deep Dive Into Urban Psychology
how-cities-shape-us-a-deep-dive-into-urb.description: నగరాల వేగవంతమైన జీవనశైలిలో మనుషుల మనస్సు ఎలా స్పందిస్తోంది? భారీ ట్రాఫిక్, శబ్ద కాలుష్యం, సమయపాలన, వ్యక్తిగత మరియు వృత్తిపరమైన ఒత్తిడులు – ఇవన్నీ కలిసి ఒక వ్యక్తి మానసిక స్థితిని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తున్నాయో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే, అర్బన్ సైకోలజీ అనేది ముఖ్యమైన అధ్యయనమార్గం.

fake-date-1.title: Fake Date
fake-date-1.description: ತನ್ನ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಯನ್ನ ಮೀಟ್‌ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಅಂತ ವಿಯೆಟ್ನಾಮ್‌ಗೆ ಹೋಗೋ ಜಯಾಳಿಗೆ ಶಾಕಿಂಗ್‌ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳು ಗೊತ್ತಾಗ್ತವೆ. ಇಷ್ಟು ದಿನ ಜಯಾ ಜೊತೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಚಾಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ ಪ್ರಿಯಕರ ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷದ ಹಿಂದೆಯೇ ಸತ್ತು ಹೋಗಿದ್ದ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಜಯಾಳನ್ನ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ ಪ್ರೇಮದಾಟದ ಮೂಲಕ ಟ್ರ್ಯಾಪ್‌ ಮಾಡಲಾಯ್ತಾ? ಜಯಾಳನ್ನ ವಿಯೆಟ್ನಾಮ್‌ ತನಕ ಕರೆಸಿಕೊಂಡಿರೋ ಆ ನಿಗೂಢ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಯಾರು? ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನ ಹುಡುಕ್ತಾ ಬಂದಿರೋ ಜಯಾಗೆ ಕಾದಿದ್ಯಾ ಅಪಾಯ? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಮೂಡಿಸೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "Fake Date" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

khota-shikka-jo-chal-nikla.title: Khota Shikka Jo Chal Nikla
khota-shikka-jo-chal-nikla.description: Raghav Mehra is a genius conman who mastered the art of selling dreams wrapped in lies. From schoolyard forgery to high-society, million-dollar scams, he built an empire of deceit. But when a massive betrayal strips him of everything, his rescue comes from the most unexpected place—Neha, a call girl with more integrity than his entire elite circle. Deprived of his wealth, Raghav must face the ultimate truth: can he successfully con life itself ?

snitch-redefining-mens-fashion-1.title: Snitch: Redefining Men's Fashion
snitch-redefining-mens-fashion-1.description: ಪುರುಷರ ಫ್ಯಾಷನ್‌ ಉಡುಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಾ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯತೆ ಪಡೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಫ್ಯಾ಼ಷನ್‌ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅದು Snitch. ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈಗಾಗ್ಲೇ ತನ್ನದೇ ಛಾಪು ಮೂಡಿಸಿರೋ Snitch, ಆಧುನಿಕ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಪುರುಷರಿಗೆ ಇಷ್ಟವಾಗೋ ನಿಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನ ಫ್ಯಾಷನ್‌ ಸ್ಟೈಲ್‌ನ ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಶರ್ಟ್ಸ್‌, ಟಿ-ಶರ್ಟ್ಸ್‌, ಟ್ರೌಸರ್ಸ್‌, ಜಾಕೆಟ್ಸ್‌ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಹಲವಾರು ಟ್ರೆಂಡ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ವಿಶೇಷತೆಯನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿರೋ Snitch ಇಂಟರ್‌ನ್ಯಾಷನಲ್‌ ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಟಾಪ್‌ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, Snitch ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ನ ಡಿಸೈನ್‌ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು ಯಾರು? ಹೆವಿ ಕಾಂಪಿಟೇಷನ್‌ ಇರೋ ಫ್ಯಾಷನ್‌ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್‌ ಸಾಧಿಸ್ತು? ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ರೋಚಕ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "Snitch: Redefining Men's Fashion" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

secret-marriage-maid-to-queen.title: Secret Marriage: Maid to Queen
secret-marriage-maid-to-queen.description: தன்னுடைய குடும்ப சூழ்நிலையால் ஒரு பணக்கார வீட்டு பையனான ஆல்பர்டை திருமணம் செய்கிறாள் ஏழை லாரா. அந்த திருமணத்திற்கு பின் அவளுடைய வாழ்க்கை நிலை நல்லதாக மாறுமா? இல்லை அந்த திருமணத்தால் அவள் துன்பத்தை அனுபவிப்பாளா.... அவளை விருப்பம் இல்லாமல் திருமணம் செய்து கொள்ளும் ஆல்பர்டின்  மனநிலை என்ன? அவன் அவளை ஏற்றுக் கொள்வானா? இருவரும் இணைவார்களா...

the-mace-queen-1-rise-of-the-empire-4.title: The Mace Queen 1 - Rise of the Empire
the-mace-queen-1-rise-of-the-empire-4.description: Bhavishya ke ek krur desh Akret (India) me ek tanaashah ka raaj hai. Is andhere daur mein, ek nidar ladki is julm ke khilaf khadi hoti hai. Apni shaktishali mace (gada) aur sahas ke sath, woh is taqatwar samrajya ko chunauti deti hai. Yeh kahani bagawat, dosti, balidan aur ladai se bhari hai. Kya woh is julmi sarkar ko gira payegi? Jaanne ke liye suniye yeh jordaar kahani.

hidden-successor.title: Hidden Successor
hidden-successor.description: ലോകമറിയുന്ന ശാസ്ത്രജ്ഞൻ ആകണമെന്നായിരുന്നു ജിഷ്ണുവിൻ്റെ സ്വപ്നം. എന്നാൽ തന്നെ വഞ്ചിച്ച് കടന്നു കളഞ്ഞ കാമുകി തൻ്റെ സകല സമ്പാദ്യങ്ങളും കവർന്നെടുത്തുവെന്ന് തിരിച്ചറിഞ്ഞ നിമിഷം ജിഷ്ണു ആകെ തകർന്ന് പോയി. താൻ തൊഴിലെടുക്കുന്ന കമ്പനി കുട്ടിക്കാലത്ത്  വേർപിരിഞ്ഞ തൻ്റെ ഉടമസ്ഥതിയിൽ ഉള്ളതാണെന്ന വസ്തുതയും ജിഷ്ണും അറിഞ്ഞിരുന്നില്ല. നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട മകനെ തിരയുന്ന ആ അമ്മ മനസ്സ് ജിഷ്ണുവിനെ തിരിച്ച്രിയുമോ? കേൾക്കാം...

ഒരു-Contract-കല്യാണം-.title: ഒരു Contract കല്യാണം
ഒരു-Contract-കല്യാണം-.description: കളിയല്ല കല്യാണം! പക്ഷെ ഒരൊറ്റ ദിവസംകൊണ്ട് ഒരു പണക്കാരന്റെ ഭാവി വധു ആകേണ്ടി വന്നാലോ? അങ്ങനെയെങ്കിൽ നെടുങ്കണ്ടത്തു നിന്നും ബസ്സ്‌ കേറി കൊച്ചിയിലെത്തിയ ഗ്രാമീണ സുന്ദരി ശ്രീബാലയുടെ ജീവിതത്തിൽ എന്ത് സംഭവിച്ചുവെന്നു അറിയണ്ടേ?? കേൾക്കൂ ഒരു കോൺട്രാക്ട് കല്യാണം!

shobhraj-and-nepal-a-deadly-connection.title: Shobhraj and Nepal - A Deadly Connection
shobhraj-and-nepal-a-deadly-connection.description: Charles Sobhraj—a master conman and deadly serial killer known globally as "The Serpent" and "The Bikini Killer." Behind his innocent face lay a sinister mind that baffled police across Europe and Asia. After spending 19 years in a Nepal prison, his sudden release in 2022 shocked the world. Will he turn a new leaf or dive back into darkness? This audiobook uncovers his childhood, his terrifying crimes, his prison life, and the mysterious love story that sets him apart.

oru-ragasiya-vaazhkai.title: Oru Ragasiya Vaazhkai
oru-ragasiya-vaazhkai.description: தன் காம லீலைகளை பொது இடங்களில் செய்யும் ஒரு celebrity couples.  பீச், பார்க், திரையரங்கம் , ரிசார்ட் என பல்வேறு இடங்களில் லீலை செய்யும் Fantasy மிக்க தம்பதி ஒரு படி மேலே சென்று மற்ற ஆண்களை தங்கள் படுக்கையறையில் அனுபவிக்க நினைக்கிறார்கள். இது ஹீரோவின் தம்பிக்கு தெரியவர, பின்பு என்ன நடந்தது?

jail-return-aashiq.title: Jail Return Aashiq
jail-return-aashiq.description: जिस प्यार के लिए दुनिया का सबसे अमीर बिजनेसमैन वरदान सूर्यवंशी सात साल जेल में रहा, बाहर आने के बाद उसे पता चलता है कि वो प्यार सिर्फ एक धोखा था। टूटे दिल के साथ उसकी मुलाकात होती है अनन्या से - एक सिंगल मदर, जो अपनी बेटी और बिजनेस एम्पायर को बचाने के लिए ताकतवर दुश्मनों से लड़ रही है। एक कॉन्ट्रैक्ट शादी से शुरू हुई ये कहानी प्यार, बदले और ताकत की खतरनाक जंग बन जाती है। लेकिन क्या वरदान फिर से प्यार कर पाएगा… या सबकुछ तबाह कर देगा?

rich-richer-richest.title: Rich Richer Richest
rich-richer-richest.description: വര്‍ഷങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് ശേഷം സ്വന്തം വീട്ടിലേക്ക് മടങ്ങിയെത്തുമ്പോള്‍ കനികയ്ക്ക് ഒരു പ്രതീക്ഷയുണ്ടായിരുന്നു. ഒരുപക്ഷേ കാലം മുറിവുകള്‍ ഉണക്കിയിട്ടുണ്ടാവുമെന്ന്. പുതിയ രൂപത്തിലും ഭാവത്തിലും തിരിച്ചു വരുമ്പോൾ  അവളോടൊപ്പമുളള ആ മൂന്നുപേർ ആരെല്ലാമാണ്??? ആ വലിയ തറവാട്ടിലേക്കുളള അവളുടെ വരവ്  ഒരു വലിയ ഷോക്ക് തന്നെ ആകുമോ? കേൾക്കാം..

நான்-அவள்-இல்லை-.title: Naan Aval Illai
நான்-அவள்-இல்லை-.description: சினிமாவில் மிக பிரபலமான கேமரா மேன் கோடி செல்வம். முப்பத்தி ஐந்து வயதில் அவனுக்கு சிறிதும் பொருத்தம் இல்லாத பேரழகியான அபிராமியை திருமணம் செய்கிறான். அவனை பற்றி பலர் பலவிதமாக பேசினாலும் அபிராமி அவனை மிகவும் விரும்புகிறாள். சரியாக முதலிரவு வரை எல்லாம் நன்றாக செல்ல, முதலிரவு முடிந்த அடுத்த கணம் அபிராமி காணாமல் போகிறாள். அபிராமிக்கு என்ன ஆனது? கோடி செல்வம் எதற்காக தன்னை விட வயதில் மிக குறைந்த அபிராமியை திருமணம் செய்ய வேண்டும்.

the-reluctant-thief.title: The Reluctant Thief
the-reluctant-thief.description: Arjun is a master thief who executes every heist with perfection and leaves no trace behind. But when a series of stolen items begin awakening guilt and buried memories, he feels compelled to return everything he has taken. Along the way, he meets Maanvi and discovers love, trust, and a sense of belonging for the first time. However, his hidden past threatens to destroy everything. Can a thief haunted by his mistakes find redemption and prove that people can truly change?

the-missing-master-chef.title: The Missing Master Chef
the-missing-master-chef.description: చిన్నప్పుడు నుంచి వంటపట్ల ఆసక్తి కలిగిన విరాట్, తన తల్లి సంజన స్ఫూర్తితో, పేదరికాన్ని తట్టుకుని, గొప్ప చెఫ్ కావాలని కలలు కంటాడు. తన టాలెంట్‌ని చూపించే అవకాశం వస్తే చాలు అనుకునే అతని జీవితంలో, రాయల్ హోటల్ అనుకోని మలుపు తిప్పింది. అక్కడ పనిచేస్తున్న మాస్టర్ చెఫ్ చంద్రకాంత్, విరాట్‌కి ఛాన్స్ ఇచ్చే పరిస్థితిలో ఉంటాడా? చెఫ్‌స్ మధ్య జరుగుతున్న ఈ గేమ్‌లో ఎవరు విన్నర్ అవుతారు? తెలియాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో సిరీస్ వినండి.

yugapurusha.title: Yugapurusha
yugapurusha.description: ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಹುಡುಗ, ತನ್ನ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದಂತೆ ಪುನರ್ಜನ್ಮ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ! ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ತಂತ್ರಗಾರರ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ 'ಆರ್ಯ ಸೂರ್ಯವಂಶಿ' ಅಂದ್ರೆ, ಎಲ್ರಿಗೂ ಒಂದು ತಿರಸ್ಕಾರ. ಆತನೊಬ್ಬ ದುರ್ಬಲ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಆಲೋಚನೆ! ಹೀಗಿರ್ವಾಗ ಕುಲದ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ನಾಯಕನಾಗಿ, ಆರ್ಯ ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗ್ತನೆ? 'ಅಮೃತ ರಸ' ಅವನ ಬದುಕಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಚಮತ್ಕಾರವೇನು? ಅವನ 'ಬೆಳ್ಳಿ ಕೂದಲಿ'ನ ರಹಸ್ಯವೇನು? ಕೇಳಿ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'ಯುಗಪುರುಷ'. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

kanchi-zindagi-ek-sauda.title: Kanchi: Zindagi Ek Sauda
kanchi-zindagi-ek-sauda.description: Kanchi was sold to the Kotha as her parents owed Kabbo Rani- the owner of the Kotha. Amar had fallen in Love with Kanchi and wanted to get her free. He promised to pay Kabbo Rani in return for her freedom, but when Kabbo Rani found out, she got her goons to beat him up and made Kanchi attend customers, but kanchi fought back and ran away from them.

just-married-with-divorced-wife.title: Just Married : With Divorced Wife
just-married-with-divorced-wife.description: ತನ್ನ ವೈವಾಹಿಕ ಜೀವನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದ ಹುಡುಗಿ 'ಸನ್ನಿಧಿ'.! ಇದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಆಕೆ ಬಹುದೊಡ್ಡ 'ರಾಯಲ್' ರಹಸ್ಯವನ್ನ ತನ್ನೊಳಗೇ ಕಾಪಾಡಿಕೊಂಡಿರ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಕೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಮೋಸ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಅನುಭವಿಸ್ತಾಳೆ. ಈ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈ ಹಿಡಿಯುವವನೇ 'ಸಿದ್ಧಾರ್ಥ್'! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಯಾರು ಈ ಸಿದ್ಧಾರ್ಥ್? ಸನ್ನಿಧಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಯಾವುದು? ಒಂದು ಡಿವೋರ್ಸ್, ಇಬ್ಬರು ಪ್ರೇಮಿಗಳನ್ನ ಒಂದು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ? ಅಥ್ವಾ ಕಂಟ್ರ್ಯಾಕ್ಟ್ ಮದುವೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮುಗಿದು ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾ? ಕೇಳಿ ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಮ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'Just Married : With Divorced Wife'. ಓನ್ಲಿ ಆನ್ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ

kissik-girl.title: Kissik girl
kissik-girl.description: పెళ్ళి మీద కోటి ఆశలతో ఇండియాలో దిగిన అన్వితకు చెల్లెలు మోక్ష షాక్ ఇస్తుంది. ఆ షాక్ లో నిరుపేద వాడైన ఆరవ్ ని పెళ్ళి చేసుకోవడానికి రెడీ అవుతుంది అన్విత. కానీ ఒక కండీషన్ పెడుతుంది. అన్విత పెట్టిన కండీషన్ ఏంటి? మోక్ష ఇచ్చిన షాక్ ఏంటి..? తెలియాలంటే వినండి కిస్సిక్ గర్ల్.. మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

wrong-number-waaley-baba.title: Wrong Number Waale Baba
wrong-number-waaley-baba.description: A simple podcast interview takes a hilarious turn when a fake spiritual guru accidentally hijacks the conversation. Known as the “Wrong Number Waaley Baba,” he answers every question with bizarre wisdom, chaotic logic, and unexpectedly honest truths. Packed with travel, comedy, satire, and unpredictable adventures, this audio series follows a man whose accidental fame turns every wrong number into a wild spiritual journey full of laughter and absurd revelations.

how-to-use-fathers-money-1.title: How to use Father's Money?
how-to-use-fathers-money-1.description: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಪೋಷಕರಿಂದ ಸಿಗೋ ಪಾಕೆಟ್ ಮನಿಯನ್ನ ಟೀನೇಜರ್ಸ್ ಶಾಪಿಂಗ್, ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ ಅಂತಾ ಎಂಟರ್ಟೈನ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡ್ತರೆ. ಅಪ್ಪನ ಹಣವನ್ನ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಉಳಿಸಿ, ಬೆಳೆಸೋದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಉಡಾಯಿಸೋರೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಇರೋ ದುಡ್ಡನ್ನ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಇನ್ವೆಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಬರೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಸಾಲದ ಸುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕ್ಕಿದ್ದ ನಮ್ಮ‌ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ ಹೇಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ‌ ನಿಭಾಯಿಸ್ತಾನೆ? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'How to use father's money?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

mehandipur-balaji-ka-raaz.title: Mehandipur Balaji ka Raaz
mehandipur-balaji-ka-raaz.description: राजस्थान के मेहंदीपुर बालाजी मंदिर की रहस्यमयी दुनिया में एक तर्कवादी प्रोफेसर तब आस्था और विज्ञान के बीच फँस जाता है, जब उसकी पत्नी अजीब और डरावने व्यवहार का शिकार होने लगती है। इलाज की हर कोशिश नाकाम होने के बाद वह मेहंदीपुर पहुँचता है, जहाँ हजारों लोग भूत-प्रेत की बाधाओं से मुक्ति की उम्मीद में वर्षों से रह रहे हैं। यह यात्रा केवल डर की नहीं, बल्कि मानव मन, दबी भावनाओं और उन अनदेखी शक्तियों की खोज है, जिन्हें विज्ञान अब तक समझ नहीं पाया।

chandrakantha.title: Chandrakantha
chandrakantha.description: ಚಂದ್ರಕಾಂತಾ – ಒಂದು ರಹಸ್ಯಮಯ ಪ್ರಣಯ ಕಥೆ! ಈ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜವಂಶದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವಂತಿ ರಾಣಿ ಚಂದ್ರಲೇಖಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸೇವಕ ಗೋಪಿ ನಡುವೆ ಮೂಡುವ ಪ್ರೇಮ, ವಿವಾದ, ವಂಚನೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಅಪಾಯಗಳಿವೆ. ಮಹಾರಾಜನಿಲ್ಲದ ಅರಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಡಗರದಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾದ ಪ್ರಣಯ ಹೇಗೆ ರಹಸ್ಯ, ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ಜಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕುತ್ತದೆ ಎನ್ನುವುದೇ ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಸಾರ. ಕೇಳಿ ಈ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

no-1-aliya.title: No. 1 Aliya
no-1-aliya.description: ಪವರ್‌ಫುಲ್ ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್‌ ಅವಿನಾಶ್‌ ಜಿಂದಾಲ್‌ನ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ಮಗಳು ನಂದಿನಿ ಮೈ ಮೇಲೆ ದುಷ್ಟ ಆತ್ಮವೊಂದು ಆವರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ, ನಂದಿನಿಗೆ ಮದುವೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿದ್ರೆ‌, ಆಕೆಯ ದೇಹದಲ್ಲಿರೋ ದುಷ್ಟ ಆತ್ಮ ಆಕೆಯ ಗಂಡನಿಗೆ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆಯಾಗಿ ನಂದಿನಿ ಬದುಕ್ತಾಳೆ ಅಂತ ಮಂತ್ರವಾದಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಇರೋ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ವಾರಸುದಾರೆ ಮಗಳನ್ನ ಶತಾಯಗತಾಯ ಉಳಿಸ್ಕೋಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಅವಿನಾಶ್‌ ಜಿಂದಾಲ್‌ ನಂದಿನಿ ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಹುಡುಗನನ್ನ ಹುಡುಕೋಕೆ ಆರಂಭಿಸ್ತಾನೆ. ದುಷ್ಟ ಆತ್ಮ ಸೇರ್ಕೊಂಡಿರೋ ನಂದಿನಿನಾ ಮದುವೆ ಆಗೋಕೆ ಮುಂದಾಗೋ ನತದೃಷ್ಟ ಯುವಕ ಯಾರು? ಆತ ನತದೃಷ್ಟನಾ ಅಥವಾ ಸೂಪರ್‌ ಹೀರೋನಾ? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವಿರೇಳಿಸೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ನಂ.೧ ಅಳಿಯ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

jobs-visits-india.title: Jobs Visits India
jobs-visits-india.description: Before becoming the face of Apple, Steve Jobs arrived in India as a restless young seeker searching for meaning beyond technology and material success. Traveling barefoot through the Himalayas and spiritual ashrams, he hoped to find answers from a guru he never even met. This inspiring and humorous journey explores the experiences, struggles, and awakening that shaped the mind of a man who would later revolutionize the digital world.

hidden-fantasy.title: Hidden Fantasy
hidden-fantasy.description: காம உணர்ச்சிகளை கட்டுப்படுத்த முடியாமல் தவிக்கும் மாயா! காணும் ஆண்களை எல்லாம் அனுபவிக்க துடிக்கிறாள். தன் கணவன் அர்ஜூனுடன் இருக்கும் உறவுக்கு களங்கம்  ஏற்படாமல் இருக்க அவள் செய்வது என்ன?

hunting-the-hunter.title: Hunting The Hunter
hunting-the-hunter.description: మల్లేష్ ఒక బస్తీలో రౌడీ. ఒక రాజకీయ నాయకుడి అండతో ఎన్నో దారుణాలు చేస్తాడు. ఆ బస్తీలో  కంటికి కనిపించిన ఆడవారిని  నిర్దాక్షిణ్యంగా తాను అనుభవించడమే కాకుండా, తన మనుషులకు కూడా అప్పగిస్తాడు. అతనికి ఎదురు తిరగాలంటేనే భయం వేసేలా చేస్తాడు మల్లేష్. అలాంటి సమయంలోనే ఆ బస్తీకి వస్తుంది చైత్ర. ఆమె మల్లేష్ ని ఎదిరిస్తుంది. ఆ తర్వాత చైత్ర గతి ఏమయ్యింది? మల్లేష్ ఏం చేశాడు? అసలు ఆ రాజకీయ నాయకుడు మల్లేష్ కి ఎందుకు సాయం చేస్తున్నాడు? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ "హంటింగ్ ద హంటర్" సిరీస్ వినేయండి.

shrapit-prem.title: Shrapit Prem
shrapit-prem.description: Princess Amrita of Amrit Lok falls in love with Vasu, a humble cowherd on Earth who is secretly the Nagraj of Jal Lok. They marry in secret, defying divine boundaries. But jealousy, celestial conflict, and a devastating curse tear them apart. Amrita’s soul is condemned to wander in eternal longing. Though their love is pure and powerful, destiny demands two hundred years of separation and rebirths before they can finally reunite.

contract-kalyanam-20.title: Contract Kalyanam 2.0
contract-kalyanam-20.description: విక్రమ్ ఒక స్ట్రిక్ట్ బిజినెస్‌మ్యాన్. లహరి ఓ సాధారణ అమ్మాయి. చక్రధర్ మనవడు విక్రమ్ తో పెళ్ళికి లహరి సిద్ధంగా ఉందా?  ఆ ఇద్దరి మధ్య మొదట ఏర్పడిన అపోహలు, రోమాన్స్‌కి దారి తీస్తాయా?  ఒప్పందం తో మొదలైన పెళ్లి తర్వాత ఎటువైపు అడుగేసింది తెలియాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో సిరీస్ వినండి.

silent-son-in-law-2.title: Silent Son-In-Law
silent-son-in-law-2.description: Hey 5 lakh ghe ani majhi Isha la divorce de, Ashvin! Kiti vel paryant Isha cha paltu kutra banun jagnaar ahes? Isha ani Ashvin chi shaadi hoti fakta navapurti — na prem hota, na maan. Isha cha ex-boyfriend Rahul kahi pan kela tari hi relationship todaycha hota. Ashvin, jo saglyanchya nazret bekaar ani bezuban hota, ek motha secret thevla hota: tyane 10 varshansathi silent rahaycha agreement sign kela hota. Ani jashi ti deal sampli, Ashvin bannaar hota ek super healer. Pan prashna ha ahe — to paryant tyacha ani Isha cha rishta tikel ka? Kiwa Ashvin cha nava avataar karun takel ya ghar jamai cha life ekdum mess?

october-junction-1.title: October Junction
october-junction-1.description: October Junction is an emotional journey — where characters met at different turns of life carry their unfinished stories with them. Written in Divya Prakash Dubey's simple yet impactful language, this story beautifully captures relationships, memories, and the ever-changing human heart with the passage of time. Every reader will find their own 'junction' somewhere within its pages.

kiss-knight-in-shining-suit.title: KISS : knight in shining suit
kiss-knight-in-shining-suit.description: தொல்லியல் துறை ஆராய்ச்சியாளரான அனுபமா, குறிஞ்சி மலையில் இருக்கும் மர்ம குகையை ஆராய்ச்சி செய்ய செல்கிறாள். அங்கு நடக்கும் எதிர்பாராத அமானுஷ்ய நிகழ்வினால் பதிமூன்றாம் நூற்றாண்டில் வாழும் கார்குழலி என்னும் இளவரசியின் உடலுக்குள் சென்று விடுகிறாள் அனுபமா. அங்கிருக்கும் கார்குழலியோ இங்கிருக்கும் அனுபமாவின் உடலுக்குள் மாற, அவர்கள் மொத்த வாழ்கையும் மிக பெரிய சூழலில் சிக்குகிறது. கடந்த காலத்துக்கு செல்லும் அனுபமா அரசியல் சூழ்ச்சிகளால்  முடி இளவரசன் மாறனை திருமணம் செய்ய, அவனோ இவளை அடியோடு வெறுக்கிறான். இனி நடக்க போவது என்ன? அனுபமா கார்குழலி இருவரும் தங்கள் காலத்துக்கு திரும்புவார்களா.... அவர்கள் சந்திக்க போகும் ஆபத்துக்கள் என்ன?

rama-navami.title: Rama Navami
rama-navami.description: ಈ ರಾಮ ನವಮಿ  ಶೋ ಮೂಲಕ ಶ್ರೀರಾಮನ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಕಥೆಯು ಹೊಸ ಧ್ವನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೀವಂತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ರಾಮನ ಅವತಾರ, ಅಯೋಧ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಘಟನೆಗಳು, ಸೀತೆಯ ವನವಾಸ, ಹನುಮಂತನ ಭಕ್ತಿ, ರಾವಣನ ಜೊತೆ ಯುದ್ಧ – ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಥಾಹಂದರಗಳು ನಿಗೂಢವಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಹತ್ತಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ. ಪೌರಾಣಿಕತೆ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲದೆ, ಜೀವನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನೂ ಸಾರುವ ಈ ಕಥಾನಕ ಎಲ್ಲ ವಯಸ್ಸಿನ ಶ್ರೋತೃಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಣ್ಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯುವ ಧ್ವನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಎಪಿಸೋಡೂ ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.ಈ ರಾಮನವಮಿ, ರಾಮನ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಅನುಭವಿಸಿ –"ರಾಮನವಮಿ" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಶೋ ಕೇಳಿ ಕೇವಲ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ  !

murderer-within-us.title: Murderer Within Us
murderer-within-us.description: A city is shaken by a series of brutal murders targeting men once acquitted of rape due to lack of evidence. As Inspector Vikrant investigates, he uncovers a chilling pattern that challenges the very idea of justice. Each killing is a calculated act of vengeance. In the final revelation, the truth emerges—a grieving father, broken by the system, has turned into a vigilante serial killer. This gripping audio drama explores the fragile line between justice and revenge.

missing-maharaj.title: Vaarasudu
missing-maharaj.description: కోట్లకు వారసురాలైన ప్రియదర్శినికి, కొడుకు అంకిత్ చిన్నప్పుడే దూరమయ్యాడు.  అతని కోసం 20ఏళ్ల తర్వాత వెతకడం మొదలు పెట్టింది. అంకిత్ టాలెంట్ చూసి అతన్ని లవ్ చేస్తుంది రోజీ. ఆ ప్రేమలో అతను మోసపోతాడు. అంకిత్ కి ఉన్న స్పెషల్ టాలెంట్ ఏంటి?  ప్రియదర్శినికి కొడుకు దొరుకుతాడా..? కోట్లకు వారసుడు కాగలుగుతాడా..? వినండి వారసుడు.. మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ లో.

registaan-ka-gabbar.title: Registaan Ka Gabbar
registaan-ka-gabbar.description: In the desolate sands of the Thar Desert rises the legend of Karna Ram Bhil—a feared dacoit whose name once echoed with terror. Yet beneath the outlaw lived a man deeply devoted to music. When an Afghan girl, Leela, enters his life, she awakens his desire for redemption. But destiny refuses him peace. Caught between love, vengeance, and legacy, his journey unfolds into a haunting saga that transforms him from a criminal into an immortal legend.

mysterious-deaths-of-indian-actors.title: Mysterious Deaths Of Indian Actors
mysterious-deaths-of-indian-actors.description: సినీ తారల జీవితం అంటే మనలాంటి సాధారణ ప్రజలు ఎప్పుడూ అది విలాసవంతమైనదే అనుకుంటాం. కానీ ఆ చక్కని వెలుగుల్లో కనిపించని చీకటి కోణాలూ ఉన్నాయి. వారు ఎదుర్కొనే మానసిక ఒత్తిడులు, మనోవేదనలు కొంతమందిని ఆత్మహత్యల దాకా తీసుకెళ్లాయి. అంతే కాదు, కొంత మంది తారల అకస్మాత్తుగా జరిగిన MYSTERIOUS మృతులు ఇంకా అనేక ప్రశ్నల్ని తలెత్తిస్తున్నాయి. నిజానికి అవి నిజంగా ఆత్మహత్యలేనా? లేక ఆత్మహత్యలా మలచిన హత్యలా? లేక యాక్సిడెంట్ గా పక్కాగా ప్లాన్ చేసిన మర్డర్స్‍ ఆ? ఈ మిస్టరీలన్నిటికీ సమాధానాల కోసం వెంటనే ఈ షో వినాల్సిందే!

death-forest.title: Death Forest
death-forest.description: சென்னை விமான நிலையத்தில் ஒரு மர்மமான பணக்காரர் வந்ததும், இருண்ட மாளிகையின் ரகசியங்கள் வெளிப்பட தொடங்குகிறது. வில்லியம், தனது குடும்பத்தின் மர்மங்களை ஆராய்ந்து, உயிருக்கு ஆபத்தான சிக்கல்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறான். காதல், betrayal மற்றும் அதிர்ச்சியால் நிறைந்த இந்த கதையில், உங்களை கவரும் சுவாரசியங்கள் காத்திருக்கின்றன!

silent-billionaire.title: Silent Billionaire
silent-billionaire.description: In the ruthless corporate world, feared tycoon Rudra Singhania hides a secret—he stammers. Mocked by family and targeted by enemies, he fights to protect his empire and legacy. When a fearless little girl restores his dignity, she unknowingly becomes his greatest weakness, pulling him into a dangerous game of power, betrayal, and survival.

forever-haunted.title: Forever Haunted
forever-haunted.description: பெண்களை நெருங்கினால் மரணமடையும் தர்மலிங்கத்தின் சாபம், அவரது குடும்பத்தை எவ்வாறு பாதிக்கிறது? இந்த சாபம், காதலின் அழகையும், பயத்தையும் ஒரே நேரத்தில் உணர்த்துகிறது. தர்மலிங்கத்தின் பேரன்   பிரதீப்பை அந்த சாபம் துரத்துகிறது . தன் காதலியுடன் இணைவானா பிரதீப் .

maa-nanna-superhero.title: Maa Nanna Superhero
maa-nanna-superhero.description:
ఆద్య అనే ఆరు సంవత్సరాల చిన్నారి కన్నులలో తన నాన్న రాఘవే నిజమైన సూపర్ మాన్. తను కూలీ అయినా, తన కూతురికి ఉత్తమ జీవితం ఇవ్వాలనే కసితో బతుకుతున్న రాఘవ కథ ఇది. ఆర్థికంగా వెనుకబడినప్పటికీ, మనోధైర్యం , ప్రేమ, పౌరుషంతో నిండి ఉన్న ఈ తండ్రి తన కూతురికి అన్ని అడ్డంకులు దాటించి ఓ వెలుగు చూపే ప్రయత్నం చేస్తాడు.

అయితే ఒకరోజు అతని గతం, అతని నిడర్వంగా నెట్టుకొస్తున్న జీవితాన్ని కుదిపేస్తుంది. రహస్యంగా జీవిస్తున్న రాఘవ అసలు ఎవరన్నది ఊహించని మలుపులను సృష్టిస్తుంది. ఇంటర్నేషనల్ స్కూల్ చదువుతున్న ఆద్య పట్ల ఆ స్కూల్ పిల్లల తీరూ, రాఘవను కించపరిచే సమాజపు మాటలు, శత్రువుల బలగాల దాడులు – ఈ అన్నిటి మధ్య తన కూతురి భవిష్యత్తును రక్షించేందుకు తండ్రి చేసే పోరాటమే ఈ కథా ప్రవాహానికి ప్రాణం.

detective-namit-game-of-confessions.title: Detective Namit - Game of Confessions
detective-namit-game-of-confessions.description: One murder. Fifteen confessions. And every confession is true. As Inspector Aditya and the brilliant yet unpredictable Detective Namit dive deeper into the case, they confront the mysterious Dr. Architect — a mastermind who manipulates memory, fear, and guilt instead of using weapons. But the real question is: can Namit stop the game… before he becomes its most dangerous victim?

ഐസ്-ക്രീം-പാർലർ-.title: ഐസ് ക്രീം പാർലർ
ഐസ്-ക്രീം-പാർലർ-.description: ഒരു ഐസ്ക്രീം പാർലറിൻ്റെ മറവിൽ രാഷ്ട്രീയ ഉന്നതന്മരുടെ പിന്തുണയോടെ കൊഴുക്കുന്ന ലഹരി വ്യാപാരത്തെ തകർക്കാൻ ഒരു കൂട്ടം ചെറുപ്പക്കാർ മുന്നിട്ടിറങ്ങുന്നു. രാസലഹരിയുടെ പിടിയിൽ അമരുന്ന ഇന്നത്തെ യുവത്വത്തിൻ്റെ നേർചിത്രം. മെഴുവേലി ബാബുജിയുടെ തികച്ചും കാലികമായ ത്രില്ലർ നോവൽ.

10-ways-to-get-private-job.title: 10 Ways to Get Private Job
10-ways-to-get-private-job.description: ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಗವರ್ನ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್‌ ಜಾಬ್‌ ಸಿಗೋದು ತುಂಬಾನೇ ಕಷ್ಟ. ನೂರ ಮೂವತ್ತು ಕೋಟಿಗೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಇರೋ ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗವರ್ನ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್‌ ನೌಕರಿನೇ ಸಿಗಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಹೇಗ್‌ ಸಾಧ್ಯ? ಆದ್ರೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಿದ್ಯಾಭ್ಯಾಸದ ಜೊತೆ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನಿಮಗಿರೋ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನ ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡು ನೀವು ಪ್ರೈವೇಟ್‌ ಜಾಬ್‌ನಾ ಪಡೀಬಹುದು! ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್‌ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳ ಹಬ್‌ ಆಗಿರೋ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ದೇಶದ ಹಲವಾರು ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ಸಿಟಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಖಾಸಗಿ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳು ತಲೆಯೆತ್ತಿ ಬೃಹಾದಾಕಾರಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದು ನಿಂತಿವೆ. ಅಂತಹ ಪ್ರೈವೇಟ್‌ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾಬ್‌ ಗಿಟ್ಟಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಯಾವ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿದ್ರೆ ಒಂದೊಳ್ಳೆ ಪ್ರೈವೇಟ್‌ ಜಾಬ್‌ನ ನಿಮ್ಮದಾಗಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು ಅನ್ನೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗೋ "10 Ways to Get Private Job" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

bhartiya-sena-sahas-aur-balidan-2.title: India's Most Fearless 2
bhartiya-sena-sahas-aur-balidan-2.description:
“I may be martyred, but never captured.”
A Major’s final stand. A Corporal’s revenge. A Lieutenant ordered to fire on sight. A Navy officer entering a submarine in darkness. An Air Force pilot flying with a burning cockpit. India’s Most Fearless – Part 2 brings powerful true stories of courage, sacrifice, and soldiers who lived beyond fear.

yathi-sold-for-love.title: Yathi: Sold For Love
yathi-sold-for-love.description:
ಯತಿ ಎಂಬ ಹುಡುಗಿಯನ್ನು ಅಪರಿಚಿತರು ಅಪಹರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಗೂಂಡಾಗಳ ಹಿಡಿತದಿಂದ  ಹೇಗಾದರೂ ಮಾಡಿ  ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಅವಳು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗ, ಒಂದು ಮುಖವಾಡದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಅವಳನ್ನು ಭಾರಿ ಮೊತ್ತಕ್ಕೆ ಹರಾಜಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಖರೀದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ!
ಯಾರು ಯತಿಯನ್ನು ಈ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರಿದ್ದು? ಭಾರಿ ಮೊತ್ತ ನೀಡಿ ಯತಿಯನ್ನು ಖರೀದಿಸಿದವನ ಉದ್ದೇಶವೇನು? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ಯತಿ: Sold For ಲವ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

shroud-for-a-spy-4.title: SHROUD FOR A SPY
shroud-for-a-spy-4.description: A failed journalist, who is secretly also a spy, gets caught in one final deal—only to uncover a conspiracy that could bring down India’s intelligence network. Shadows of past betrayals resurface, and a mysterious “Rook” begins to rise again. Now, every ally could be an enemy, and survival is just the beginning.

Guru-Ki-Adalat-पति-पर-दहेज-का-Fake-Case.title: Pati Par Dahej Ka Fake Case
Guru-Ki-Adalat-पति-पर-दहेज-का-Fake-Case.description: Pati Par Dahej Ka Fake Case

final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga-3.title: Final Betrayal - Honeymoon Saga
final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga-3.description: Final Betrayal – Season 2 continues the gripping saga from Season 1, where a humble beggar marries a dhokla vendor, only for a shocking revelation to surface later: the beggar is, in fact, a billionaire. In Season 2, the newly married couple travels to Mauritius for their honeymoon. However, their dream getaway soon turns into a nightmare as unforeseen events and dangerous secrets plunge them into chaos, testing their relationship, trust, and survival.

daddy-cool-beta-fool.title: Daring Daddy ka Revenge
daddy-cool-beta-fool.description: A powerful billionaire returns after a decade in hiding, disguised as a poor cab driver, to test his son’s loyalty and uncover the betrayal poisoning his family. As insults, greed, and manipulation push him to the edge, Randhir Ahuja prepares a shocking reveal that will destroy illusions, expose true faces, and change their lives forever.

the-kubera-revenge.title: The Kubera Revenge
the-kubera-revenge.description: When a powerful tycoon freezes his sons’ fortunes, calm and principled Prithvi chooses dignity and hard work while his jealous brother Harsh chooses revenge. A contract marriage with fiery CEO Ragini pulls Prithvi into a web of corporate sabotage, betrayal, and a deadly conspiracy. As poison, greed, and attempted murder shatter the Diwaan empire, Prithvi must rise from ruin to expose the truth. But in the battle for legacy and love, who will truly win his heart? Watch now.

kadhaliyin-kanavan.title: Kadhaliyin Kanavan
kadhaliyin-kanavan.description: Preethi’s life is torn apart when she discovers that Raghav has betrayed her and been involved with her best friend, leaving her marriage in ruins. A crash and head injury deepen the crisis, and memory loss opens the door for manipulation, confusion, and competing claims about who her real husband is. Tarun Badhra enters as a powerful and increasingly central figure, often presented as protective and caring, though the truth around his role remains unstable. As Preethi is fed conflicting versions of her past, she is pushed between Raghav, Tarun, and other rivals who all try to control the story of her marriage. Public events, party games, and humiliating confrontations turn her private pain into spectacle, while jealousy and possessiveness grow more open. Preethi begins in shock and grief, but gradually becomes sharper, more confident, and more willing to challenge the people around her. She confronts lies, rejects apologies, and starts using public moments to push back against the men claiming her. The conflict repeatedly centers on whether she belongs to Raghav, Tarun, or no one at all, and each answer seems to be undermined by another revelation. Divorce papers, accusations of fraud, and legal verification become part of the struggle, showing that the marriage battle has moved beyond emotion into formal conflict. Tarun is at times shown comforting her and arranging rituals for her late mother, which briefly frames him as a steady support. Yet the same arc also reveals deception, old betrayals, and a long-buried revenge plan that complicate any simple reading of his intentions. Raghav remains tied to betrayal, denial, and attempts to reclaim Preethi even after being rejected. Public kisses, marriage claims, and open arguments keep escalating the rivalry until love itself feels inseparable from humiliation and control. Later, the story darkens further with pregnancy denial, loss, guilt, and self-destruction, suggesting that the emotional damage has become severe. Even when Preethi tries to move forward, another man interrupts with a claim that she is still his wife, keeping the central question unresolved. By the end of the batch, Preethi is trapped between competing men, broken trust, and an unstable identity shaped by memory loss and manipulation. The show’s core stakes are her truth, her dignity, and whether she can escape the people who keep rewriting her life.

billionaires-homecoming.title: Billionaire's Homecoming
billionaires-homecoming.description: Self-made CEO Devansh returns to his impoverished hometown, Shivgarh, after eighteen years, only to discover widespread corruption and underdevelopment despite his company's significant financial aid. He embarks on a quest for justice, confronting powerful local figures like Thakur and the Kapoor Group, who prioritize profit over human lives. Simultaneously, Devansh faces a brutal identity theft by Kamlesh, an imposter who usurps his company and control. Another imposter, Amit, also claims Devansh's identity, leading to a physical struggle and a shocking revelation by an Inspector that the assaulted man is the true Devansh. Now identified as the powerful CEO, Devansh confronts corrupt local power brokers, Thakur and Kamlesh, for embezzling funds and endangering villagers, uncovering a deeper web of exploitation. His journey leads him back to his ancestral village, seeking atonement and inquiring about his long-lost love, Kavya. He discovers Kavya, burdened by a strained marriage to the controlling Rajendra, has a spirited daughter, Myra, who fiercely rebels against an arranged marriage. Devansh dramatically intervenes to protect Myra, leading to his emotional reunion with Kavya after eighteen years. A scandalous family secret about Myra's birth is exposed, intensifying pressure for her marriage, with powerful patriarchs Mr. Tejpal and Devash vying for her hand. Devansh is compelled to uncover Myra's paternity, and a DNA test confirms she is his daughter, making him her hidden guardian. This new family dynamic is immediately challenged by Natasha, Devansh's manipulative assistant who has a child calling him "Papa," and his adopted son, Aryan, who resents Kavya's presence. Natasha publicly accuses Devansh and Myra's mother of past betrayal and claims a decade-long intimate relationship, attempting to secure Aryan's position. Devansh passionately confesses his enduring love to Kavya, denying romantic involvement with Natasha, and names Myra as his heir, firing Natasha for her years of betrayal. The conflict escalates as Aryan, seeking retribution, kidnaps Myra and Imli (Myra's mother). Tejpal, fueled by a ruined past, orchestrates a high-stakes game of revenge, kidnapping Devansh's family and forcing him into an agonizing choice. Devansh is tragically forced to choose between Natasha and Myra, leading to Natasha's death and a desperate struggle for survival. Consumed by guilt over this past tragedy, Maayra (Myra) is in deep distress, but Devansh, grappling with his own pain, offers an unwavering promise that they will never again be separated, striving to forge an inseparable future.

tere-ishq-mein-ghayal.title: Tere Ishq Mein Ghayal
tere-ishq-mein-ghayal.description: When the wife he worshipped betrays him with his best friend and plots his death for his fortune, a shattered husband returns to answer every scheme with one of his own. But as husband and wife keep striking back harder, their marriage becomes an explosive battlefield of heartbreak, deception, revenge, and war.

paradise-lo-pellikuthuru.title: Paradise lo pellikuthuru
paradise-lo-pellikuthuru.description: Akhila, a blacklisted model, becomes secretary to billionaire Karthik reddy Singhania, who hides his identity to win her love. Their contract romance is plagued by sabotage from jealous rivals and vindictive exes. Just as she's about to marry him, she discovers Karthik reddy orchestrated the ruse to humiliate her, not wed her. When all is lost, she's saved by another billionaire, and her life takes a series of unexpected, life-changing turns.

ceo-kadhala.title: CEO Kadhala
ceo-kadhala.description: ஈஷாவின் வாழ்க்கை ஒரு இரவில் தலைகீழாக மாறுகிறது. ஒரு சதியின் காரணமாக கோடீஸ்வர வாரிசான ஆதித்யாவுடன் அவளது வாழ்க்கை பின்னிப் பிணைகிறது. தவறான புரிதல்கள், மறைக்கப்பட்ட உண்மைகள் மற்றும் குடும்ப சூழ்ச்சிகளுக்கு நடுவே, அவர்கள் இருவரும் போலியாக தொடங்கிய உறவை காப்பாற்ற போராடுகிறார்கள். அந்த உறவு உண்மையான காதலாக மலருமா? அல்லது கடந்த காலத்தின் ரகசியங்கள் அவர்களைப் பிரித்துவிடுமா?

astha-unlimited.title: Hanuman Series
astha-unlimited.description: The show chronicles the profound and often devastating struggles of several individuals and families against overwhelming adversity, exploring themes of faith, betrayal, redemption, and the unpredictable nature of destiny. It begins with Ravi and Aditi, whose family life rapidly unravels after Ravi loses his job and their daughter Kirti suffers a life-threatening injury, leading to insurmountable medical bills and the repossession of their home. Clinging to their faith in Lord Hanuman, they embark on a desperate journey against an unfeeling system. A parallel narrative follows Sabir, a devoted father battling extreme poverty and his daughter Keerti's critical illness, whose unwavering faith is seemingly rewarded by a mysterious benefactor, "Mahabali," bringing unexpected prosperity. The series then delves into the tumultuous life of Riyansh, a rebellious son whose self-destructive path of alcoholism and defiance leads to disinheritance, a devastating car crash, and his mother's critical injury. Burdened by guilt and accused by family, Riyansh undergoes a profound transformation, vowing to atone for his past mistakes and seek redemption, battling both internal demons and sinister conspirators. Simultaneously, Siddharth, an aspiring doctor, faces academic exploitation and cruel romantic betrayal, culminating in a car crash and a deep crisis of faith that shatters his parents' dreams. His story intertwines with Amruta, who, secretly in love with Siddharth, is forced into an arranged marriage, leading to a desperate suicide attempt and the revelation of her unrequited affections, while Siddharth resolves to claim what he believes is rightfully his. Later, the narrative shifts to Aryan, who makes profound sacrifices for his ailing father and sister's wedding, only to face public scorn and financial ruin. He is ultimately betrayed by his sister Sandhya and her fiancé Mihir, who conspire to seize the family's ancestral property and evict his parents. Left to fight alone, Aryan vows to protect his distraught parents and reclaim his family's honor and inheritance. In a dramatic turn, fueled by a mysterious divine intervention, Aryan transforms from an underdog into a determined hero, saving a powerful CEO's company. Despite declining a massive financial reward, he receives an immense fortune and the return of his family's illegally seized home, a sudden reversal that empowers his family but also exposes deep fractures and ignites a bitter family feud, while hinting at a burgeoning romance. The show ultimately portrays the enduring human spirit in the face of relentless challenges, where faith, resilience, and the pursuit of justice can lead to unexpected and transformative outcomes, though not without further trials.

धाकड़-रसोइया.title: धाकड़ रसोइया
धाकड़-रसोइया.description: The story centers on Rohan, a gifted but initially underestimated chef whose identity is unclear at first and whose rise pulls a hotel kitchen into escalating danger. A staffing shortage and internal weakness create an opening for sabotage, rivalry, and power struggles around the hotel’s future. Rohan is brought in as a last-minute helper, and his cooking quickly overturns the doubts of senior staff and elite guests. His success also exposes deeper schemes tied to business control, family betrayal, and attempts to seize the property. As the stakes rise, the contest for the hotel becomes a brutal showdown where defeat can cost both the hotel and a chef’s career. Rohan’s hidden status as a master chef makes him both a prize and a target, and shadowy enemies begin moving against him. Ishani repeatedly stands near him, sometimes doubting him at first and later protecting him, while their bond grows more personal and possibly romantic. Violence outside the kitchen intensifies when sabotage and attacks threaten not just reputations but lives and careers. Aditya is drawn into the ownership struggle and is forced into a decisive culinary contest that will determine who controls the hotel. Vikram emerges as a ruthless rival, backed by his own champion and driven by a desire to seize control. Family authority also shapes the conflict, since a patriarch or senior investor places trust in Rohan’s hidden potential and bypasses the expected champion. The competition becomes as much about identity and legacy as about food, with public accusations and pressure mounting before the final round. Rohan’s fame grows after a signature dish brings him recognition, but that fame also makes him a hunted man. He is attacked, disappears after an ambush, and later returns with memory loss before recovering his memory. His return shifts the crowd’s mood, and a public vote favors his home-style cooking over Dhruv’s polished confidence. Dhruv’s resentment does not end with the loss, leaving revenge hanging over the outcome. By the end, Rohan emerges as a Master Chef figure, but the victory is shadowed by unresolved enemies and the lingering danger around him.

death-reloaded.title: Death Reloaded
death-reloaded.description: A group of travelers becomes trapped inside an abandoned jungle hotel where terrifying events begin after sunset. While others mock his warnings, Rahul believes deadly man-eating ants are hiding in the darkness. As betrayals, fear, and panic spread through the group, the creatures close in, turning the night into a brutal fight for survival. In the end, the real danger may not just be outside, but within the group itself.

ek-baap-sab-pe-bhaari.title: Ek Baap Sab Pe Bhaari
ek-baap-sab-pe-bhaari.description: A father branded as a wife killer returns after 10 years in jail… only to find his daughter trapped in abuse, hatred, and painful lies about his past. But Vikram isn’t just an ordinary man, he’s a feared legend ready to destroy anyone who hurts his child. As shocking secrets unfold, can a broken father win back his daughter’s trust before it’s too late?

barbaad-billionaire.title: Barbaad Billionaire
barbaad-billionaire.description: The microdrama centers on Riya, a powerful CEO entangled in a web of ambition, past betrayals, and fractured family life. Her secret romance with Raj is exposed, revealing a complex history with her ex-partner Ayan/Aman, who raised their daughter Kyara/Kiara for eight years. Raj, Kyara's biological father, returns as a powerful CEO, Yash, seeking revenge on Riya, while Kyara yearns for her mother's affection amidst Riya's neglect. Kyara suffers abuse and critical illnesses, even intentionally inducing sickness to gain attention, as Riya shows favoritism towards her stepson, Ayaan. The marital conflict between Riya and Raj escalates, leading to a contentious divorce from Aman/Karan and a declaration of divorce from Raj. Corporate pressures intertwine with personal tragedies as Raj navigates a new life, fleeing a volatile marriage for Kyara's safety and forming a bond with Sonia. Raj, secretly a powerful CEO, orchestrates business deals and protects Sonia, while Riya's life unravels with the abrupt departure of Raj and growing suspicion towards her partner, Yash. Riya faces accusations of neglect and betrayal concerning Kyara, who is eventually rescued by her protective father, Ashwin. In a dramatic turn, Riya confronts Raj at his wedding to Sonia, desperately pleading for forgiveness and a family reunion, revealing her CEO identity and launching corporate blackmail against Sonia. Riya threatens to destroy Sonia's company unless she abandons Raj, while another CEO, Diya, also vies for Raj's attention, initiating a corporate war. Raj's true identity and sacrifices for Sonia are revealed, further fueling rivalries. The series culminates in Riya's heartbreaking secret disclosure at Raj and Sonia's wedding, which is tragically ignored as Kyara accepts Sonia, leaving Riya to face devastating loss and the consequences of her past actions.

revenge-of-varisu.title: Revenge of Varisu
revenge-of-varisu.description: பிச்சைக்காரன் என்று அவமானப்படுத்தியவன்தான்... 10,000 கோடி சாம்ராஜ்யத்தின் உண்மையான வாரிசு!" பத்து ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு சொந்த ஊருக்கு திரும்பும் விஷால், தனது அக்கா யாழினியின் வாழ்க்கையில் நுழைந்திருக்கும் அசோக் மற்றும் கீர்த்தியின் பேராசை முகத்தை அறிகிறான். காதல் என்ற பெயரில் சொத்தையும் அதிகாரத்தையும் அபகரிக்க முயலும் அவர்களின் சதியை வெளிச்சத்துக்கு கொண்டு வர, அவமானங்களையும் வலிகளையும் தாண்டி விஷால் நடத்தும் அதிரடி போராட்டமே இந்தக் கதை

black-day-the-untold-stories.title: Black Day : The Untold Stories
black-day-the-untold-stories.description: Black Day: Untold Stories of 1975 is a gripping political drama that uncovers the dark and untold realities of India’s Emergency era, where fear, power, censorship, and resistance changed the fate of a nation forever.

426aad8c-7536-4f63-b1a2-b72309dbb73c.title: Kurudu Preeti
426aad8c-7536-4f63-b1a2-b72309dbb73c.description: ಕುರುಡನಾದ ಕೋಟ್ಯಾಧಿಪತಿ ಕಿರಣ್ ಮತ್ತು ತನ್ನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಗುರುತನ್ನು ಮರೆಮಾಚಿದ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಯ ಮಗಳು ಖುಷಿ, ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಮದುವೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಒಂದಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಅರಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆಯೇ ದ್ರೋಹ, ಕೊಲೆ, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಧಿಯ ಕ್ರೂರ ಆಟ ಅವರ ಬದುಕನ್ನು ತಲೆಕೆಳಗಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹತ್ತು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಬಳಿಕ, ಮರೆತುಹೋದ ನೆನಪುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಳೆದುಹೋದ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು ಮತ್ತೆ ಎದುರಾಗುವಾಗ, ಕಿರಣ್ ಮತ್ತು ಖುಷಿಯ ಪ್ರೇಮ ತನ್ನ ಅಂತಿಮ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ek-anjana-ek-anjani-1.title: Ek Anjana Ek Anjani
