ek-anjana-ek-anjani-1.description: The story unfolds as a web of forced marriages, hidden identities, and workplace power struggles that keep romance tied to sacrifice. It begins with a granddaughter agreeing to marry a groom’s photograph so her dying grandmother can witness the wedding, setting a tone of duty under pressure. Around that same world, other women are pushed into unions or commitments with men they have not properly met, while relatives try to control when and how those relationships become real. In the corporate sphere, a researcher takes a PA job with a powerful CEO after losing her stipend, and an unexplained déjà vu when she sees his eyes hints that their connection may run deeper than a normal boss-subordinate bond. Raghav’s world is equally unstable, with his estranged wife, Babli or Bubbly, surfacing as he tries to manage broken marital ties, family expectations, and the demands of his office. Ritika becomes central to that instability as she moves between professional dependence, emotional restraint, and a hidden marital situation that keeps changing shape. Her accidental disclosures, secret files, and public misunderstandings repeatedly expose how fragile the boundary is between private life and workplace gossip. Bunty’s arranged marriage arc runs in parallel, as he avoids his bride, seeks divorce, hides his identity, and even offers a large settlement to force separation. Babli refuses compensation and insists on dignity, while elders and relatives keep pressing both sides toward decisions they do not fully want. The pressure escalates when a student emergency pulls Raghav and Ritika into a crisis response, deepening their closeness even as others interpret it as an affair. At the same time, family schemes and inheritance motives threaten to trap Raghav in another forced marriage, showing that control over marriage is also control over property and status. Rumors, operatives, and manipulative relatives widen the conflict, with one thread tracing damaging gossip back to a family-backed scheme and another turning violent when Raghav confronts Aradhana and she calls the police. Throughout, Ritika is repeatedly caught between duty and feeling, especially as she begins to believe Raghav may be moving toward someone else and suppresses her own emotions. That misunderstanding drives the story toward public accusations of infidelity and bigamy, where multiple identities and conflicting spouse claims make the truth hard to pin down. As deadlines close in and departures loom, Raghav races to confess and propose before Ritika leaves, while family elders create one more legal and emotional complication by deciding to marry after decades. The younger couple briefly fears that this elder marriage could make them siblings by law, but the situation is ultimately accepted as another sacrifice. In the end, the chaos resolves into a public proposal and acceptance, revealing that Raghav and Ritika are already married and choosing to begin their relationship in earnest.

28c2999f-df03-4af5-9632-e0b91d95f0d7.title: Hacker er Protishodh
28c2999f-df03-4af5-9632-e0b91d95f0d7.description: The story begins with a web of corruption around Mr. Vikrant and the Dhirakal or Hirakar power structure, where blackmail, court influence, and media manipulation are used to bury farmer suicides and land exploitation. Public image matters as much as money, and even tragedy is treated as something to be managed for influence and ratings. In parallel, Ishani and Avik share a light romance, but the possibility of Avik leaving for San Francisco hangs over their relationship. The tone then shifts toward a larger cyber and banking emergency as Vedant emerges as a cybersecurity expert with the skills needed to confront a massive threat. At first, he is not welcomed as a savior but treated as a suspect, thief, or fraud in public spaces and at the bank entrance. Wealth, status, and authority repeatedly block him, and he is humiliated, threatened, and even forced into degrading obedience while trying to warn others. The urgency grows as a countdown runs down and a huge amount of money is at risk in a bank system under attack. Rajun, Arjun, Sakshi, and others race to locate or defend Vedant, but the crisis keeps outpacing their efforts. Inside the bank, leaders like Vikrant and Rajan distrust him, question his identity, and resist accepting help even as the drain continues. The conflict is not only technical but social, because Vedant must fight class prejudice, institutional suspicion, and physical intimidation at the same time. As the breach deepens, the scale of the danger expands from one bank to national stability and citizens' data and money. Vedant insists he can stop the attack, and his role becomes clearer as the only expert capable of responding in time. The story also ties the cyber crisis to older wounds, including debt harassment, farmer deaths, and a family struggle over honor and blame. A grieving son confronts Vikrant over a father lost to crushing debt, showing that the bank's damage has already reached ordinary families. Near the end of the arc, the disaster is reframed as something more morally complex than a simple hack, with Vedant claiming the operation was carried out to protect the nation and target internal forces hollowing it out. Even then, suspicion does not disappear, and the final moments remain tense and unresolved, with hidden control and unanswered demands still hanging in the air.

king-of-diamonds.title: King of Diamonds
king-of-diamonds.description: The show follows a chain of love stories that keep colliding with class prejudice, business warfare, and hidden identities. Vikram begins as a man who has already sacrificed years of his life for love, returning from prison determined to reunite with Nisha and finally reveal who he really is. Instead of a warm reunion, he is met with public humiliation, rejection, and accusations that he is beneath her status. Across the same emotional landscape, other women and children repeatedly force powerful men to prove themselves not by wealth, but by protection and loyalty. A child’s repeated choice of a protector figure over arrogant rivals becomes one of the clearest signs that family bonds matter more than social rank. Prerna’s storyline shifts the drama into a marriage of convenience that slowly becomes genuine support, as she chooses a man others dismiss and insists on presenting him as her husband and father to her daughter. That choice draws fierce judgment from elite circles, especially when Nisha publicly attacks Vikram and tries to expose him as a fraud. The pressure only grows as business collapses, hostile takeovers, canceled deals, and blacklisting threaten Prerna’s company and force everyone to question who is really helping whom. Vikram’s ally repeatedly appears as a mysterious rescuer, sometimes called Vicky or linked to Mr. V, and seems to be quietly driving major deals and reversals behind the scenes. Public events become battlegrounds where rivals accuse him of being a laborer, an impostor, or a man using a child and a wealthy woman for advantage. Yet each time the accusations rise, Prerna stands by him, and the truth keeps shifting the balance of power. The story then deepens into family conflict, with brothers, fathers, and political figures trying to control marriages, assets, and reputations through force or fraud. A forced-marriage scheme, forged contracts, and a fabricated mining deal all point to how far the antagonists will go to seize wealth and influence. At the same time, the hidden past around Thailand and a secret daughter named Jia complicate the central romance and make Vikram’s connection to Prerna even more personal. The biggest turning point comes when the false claims around fake valuables and forged documents collapse, exposing the schemes built against Prerna and Vikram. Vikram is then publicly revealed as the Diamond King, confirming that the man everyone underestimated holds immense power. Once his identity is exposed, he stops defending himself and begins retaliating, including arranging Mihir Khanna’s arrest for fraud and financial crimes. By the end, the emotional stakes have narrowed into a hard choice between false alliances and true family. Vikram, Prerna, and Jia reject the people who tried to use them and choose to rebuild around the bonds that survived betrayal. The show’s arc is ultimately about love surviving humiliation, power being hidden behind ordinary appearances, and truth finally overturning the people who thought status alone would decide everything.

boss-lady-shailoo-1.title: Boss Lady Shailoo
boss-lady-shailoo-1.description:
A powerful CEO hides her true identity and enters her own company as an intern to uncover a massive fraud. But what starts as a secret mission soon turns into a battlefield of ego, deception, and betrayal where enemies wear friendly faces, and one wrong move could cost her everything.
Will Shailoo expose the truth before the truth destroys her?

lies-and-legacy-2.title: Lies And Legacy
lies-and-legacy-2.description: சிம்மி ஒரு புத்திசாலியான மாணவி. உடைந்த சைக்கிளில் பள்ளிக்கு வரும் அவளையும், அவளது தந்தையையும் அனைவரும் ஏழைகளாகவே பார்க்கிறார்கள். அறிவியல் போட்டியில் சிம்மி முதல் பரிசை வென்றபோதும், தனது மகன் சாமுக்காக அந்த விருதை வாங்க பணமும் அதிகாரமும் பயன்படுத்த முயற்சிக்கிறார் தொழிலதிபர் ரமன் ராய். ஆனால் சிம்மியின் தந்தை அசோக் பிரஜாபதி யார் என்ற உண்மை வெளிப்படும்போது, பணத்திற்கும் திறமைக்கும் இடையிலான போராட்டம் எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

heros-homecoming.title: Hero's Homecoming
heros-homecoming.description: A humble garbage collector in a village lives in silent humiliation, abandoned by his own family and society—until his long-lost son returns as a powerful corporate leader. But his homecoming is not just about reunion; it’s about justice, dignity, and rewriting the meaning of “aukaat.” As past wounds resurface, a battle begins between blood ties and self-respect. In Durgapur, power shifts—and so does fate.

ક્લીનર-કે-કરોડપતિ.title: ક્લીનર કે કરોડપતિ?
ક્લીનર-કે-કરોડપતિ.description: Across the story, Surya is repeatedly judged by appearance and treated as if he does not belong in elite spaces. Whether he is on a flight, at an airport, in a company office, or at a high-society event, people insult his clothes, question his ticket, and assume he is poor or dishonest. Each time, the humiliation is public and often backed by people with status or authority, which raises the stakes beyond a personal insult. Surya responds with calm defiance, refusing bribes, refusing to leave, and warning that the truth about him will soon surface. The cabin and corporate conflicts also expose how quickly power shifts when hidden identity is revealed. Several characters who first mock him are forced into damage control once they learn he is connected to the airline or is in fact Mr. Surya Mittal. The airline itself becomes central to the conflict, especially when sentimental family history and ownership are tied to it. A damaged bag and the mention of Sujata suggest that Surya’s personal past is bound to the company’s legacy. Alongside this, Meera emerges as a key ally who repeatedly stands up for him when others try to remove or shame him. Her support turns the romance into a public test of loyalty, because family pressure and social expectations keep pushing her toward a more acceptable match. At the same time, other women in the story, including Maya and Nisha, are caught in their own status struggles and often side with the forces humiliating Surya. The conflict widens from isolated onboard disputes into a larger corporate war over authority, reputation, and succession. Surya’s emergency landing and other moments of competence show that he is not the fraud his critics claim. Yet even after major reversals, suspicion keeps returning, suggesting that his identity remains a weapon others try to use against him. The auction showdown becomes a decisive turning point, because Surya proves his wealth and status in a way no one can dismiss. By the end of the batch, the central stakes are no longer just survival or embarrassment, but whether Surya and Meera can hold onto each other while confronting family control, public scandal, and the collapse of old hierarchies.

3434ce10-22f6-4507-bb18-58e5d256a7d3.title: Lantern to Laal-Batti
3434ce10-22f6-4507-bb18-58e5d256a7d3.description: Lantern to Laalbatti is an inspiring story of Pawan, a poor village boy who becomes a Zapido driver after losing his job, while secretly preparing for UPSC. Through poverty, humiliation, and heartbreak, he never gives up. Rising from the light of a lantern to the red beacon of an IPS officer. A powerful tale of hope, struggle, and determination. Watch now!

લેડી-બોસનો-ખેલ.title: લેડી બોસનો ખેલ
લેડી-બોસનો-ખેલ.description:
k mysterious ane powerful businesswoman potani asli identity chhupavi ne simple waitress bani ne jivan jive chhe. Pan jyare ek arrogant rival CEO tene ordinary chokri samji ne insult kare chhe, tyare sharu thay chhe comedy, heartbreak ane dangerous power game.

Badha jene weak ane normal samajta hata, e j hakikat ma duniya ni sauthi powerful “Sky Queen” nikle chhe — Deemar Group ni malik! Pan jyare sachchai saamay aave chhe, tyare prem, ego ane badlani aa jang ma kon jeetse? 🔥

killer-ashiq.title: Killer Ashiq
killer-ashiq.description: A ruthless heiress and her irresistible bodyguard are trapped in a toxic game of desire, jealousy, and punishment: she loves him but trades him away before he can reject her, while he secretly worships her half-sister. When she agrees to marry a comatose heir for crores, their twisted love triangle detonates into betrayal, obsession, and a truth that destroys him.

skyshot-billionaire.title: Skyshot Billionaire
skyshot-billionaire.description: Raghav Singh, the powerful CEO of Moon Star airline, embarks on an undercover mission, inspired by ancient wisdom, to expose deep-seated class prejudice and uncover the truth behind his company's troubles. Disguised as an impoverished man, he endures relentless humiliation, insults, and physical assaults from arrogant passengers and his own employees, all while orchestrating a powerful lesson in humility and justice. A shocking confrontation hints at a familial connection when he declares to a staff member, Shivam, "I am your father," adding a personal layer to his corporate crusade. A mysterious woman, Sujata, intervenes on his behalf, revealing a past connection and complicating matters with a corporate rival. The drama escalates when Raghav violently intervenes to protect an air hostess from an arrogant Vice President, solidifying his role as a defiant force against corporate corruption. The corporate power struggle intensifies into a terrifying fight for survival when a plane experiences a catastrophic malfunction, later revealed to be sabotage orchestrated by a ruthless woman aiming for Raghav's inheritance. Amidst the chaos, Raghav emerges as an unlikely leader, attempting a perilous emergency landing, and exposing the abusive airline manager, Akshay Saxena, who is subsequently fired by Sujata. Strong-willed passenger Meera places her trust in Raghav, developing a complex dynamic with him. Raghav, initially engaged to the materialistic Tripti, faces public humiliation and rejection when she spurns him for his perceived lack of wealth, unaware of his true identity. Driven by revenge for her betrayal, Raghav orchestrates Tripti's downfall, revealing his power to revoke her prestigious career. He then finds himself deeply in love with wealthy heiress Meera (Mira), but their relationship faces immense opposition from her controlling father and antagonistic sister, who impose impossible conditions and attempt to force an arranged marriage. Raghav endures relentless humiliation and deception, challenging a rival's authenticity in a dramatic confrontation. The narrative culminates in a high-stakes auction where Raghav, initially bidding as Rishi, dramatically reveals his true identity as the powerful CEO of SkyMoon Airlines by instantly transferring a colossal sum to win an AI-driven private jet. This revelation shifts Meera's family's perception, paving the way for Raghav to deliver a heartfelt public speech advocating for social equality and humility. Raghav makes a heartfelt public declaration of love for Meera, based on shared values, and Meera reciprocates his affection, setting the stage for a love story that challenges societal norms and triumphs over class divides.

दिलदार-मालिक.title: दिलदार मालिक
दिलदार-मालिक.description: The show follows a tangled corporate-romantic war where love, status, and business control keep colliding. Kumar returns after years away, carrying a hidden devotion to Menka Ghosh and hoping to confess before her merger ceremony. At the same time, Anamika Gaur tries to use marriage as a strategic solution, but mistaken identity and forced arrangements repeatedly derail her plans. Raj Singh becomes the central figure in that chaos, first as the wrong groom, then as a husband figure, and later as a man whose hidden power keeps being underestimated. He repeatedly insists that wealth and background should not decide a life partner, even as others mock his origins and accuse him of fraud or blackmail. Anamika is pushed toward an arranged marriage to save her family business, but she eventually declares her love for Raj and is disowned for it. Raj responds by protecting her side, canceling contracts, and revealing enough influence to shift the balance of power. Around them, rival heirs and executives turn personal grievances into corporate retaliation, making every relationship a business risk. Menka Ghosh rises through mergers and investment, but her success is tied to betrayal, status, and a willingness to abandon old loyalty. The EV and hydrogen business line adds another layer of uncertainty, as a market collapse threatens fortunes before a government policy shift unexpectedly validates an outsider’s prediction. That shift brings major profit and investment, proving that timing and hidden insight matter as much as public authority. As the corporate stakes rise, marriage becomes a weapon rather than a refuge. Public gatherings and banquets turn into arenas for humiliation, exposure, and status checks. Raj is challenged again and again, but each time his identity or authority is confirmed in a stronger form. He eventually gains decisive control over Shah Industries, giving him veto power over the company’s future. Meanwhile, Menka’s rivalry hardens into revenge, and a betrayed former partner vows to expose hidden truths. By the end of the arc, nearly every bond has been folded into a struggle over mergers, inheritance, and public legitimacy. The show’s core tension is whether any relationship can survive once love is treated as leverage in the boardroom.

balwaan-vinaashak.title: Balwaan Vinaashak
balwaan-vinaashak.description: Secret Underground fighter, known as Balwaan Vinaashak, decides to leave that world behind after his mentor dies - but he is drawn back to that world where he must fight again to end this mafia of underground fighting.

સંબંધોની-પરીક્ષા-.title: સંબંધોની પરીક્ષા
સંબંધોની-પરીક્ષા-.description: Driven by blind insecurity, Veda Mehta orchestrates the brutal assault of a woman she believes is Rajveer’s secret lover. The victim is actually Rajveer's Bhabhi, the woman who raised him. The Mehta family's cruelty results in the death of Shanaya's unborn child and the destruction of a priceless jewel. The drama culminates at the engagement party where Rajveer unmasks the Mehtas as greedy criminals.

82a6ad8d-b2e3-479a-a5fb-31f370883ff8.title: Delivery Boy Ki Prem Kahani
82a6ad8d-b2e3-479a-a5fb-31f370883ff8.description: Ramesh, an ordinary man, sees his mundane life irrevocably altered by a car crash involving the formidable CEO Ananya Mehra. What initially appears to be an accident quickly escalates into a complex web of intrigue. Ramesh, now injured, evicted, and financially desperate, suspects Ananya's involvement in a subsequent brutal assault against him. Driven by a simmering desire for justice and revenge against the powerful heiress and her family, Ramesh confronts Ananya. He rejects her financial compensation, instead demanding a job. Amidst this intense class conflict and pursuit of accountability, Ramesh makes an unexpected and awkward request for Ananya to be his fake girlfriend for a day, setting the stage for an unconventional and potentially transformative connection. As Ananya navigates corporate battles and faces classist insults, Ramesh, initially underestimated and publicly scorned, begins to integrate into her world, finding a complex and developing romance with her. Their relationship deepens when Ananya, facing a scheming uncle and an arranged marriage, proposes a contract marriage to Ramesh to save her company, which he accepts, becoming her personal security guard under strict conditions. Ramesh strategically rises within her organization, first dramatically revealed as the new HR Head, then taking on a strategic 'Security Head' role, orchestrating subtle retribution against those who judged him. This period is fraught with intense corporate and personal turmoil for Ananya, including a security staff strike, clashes with senior executives like Gary and Vivaan, and her abduction by Ajit, who seeks revenge for a past rejection. The situation escalates dramatically into a high-stakes corporate battle where Ananya fights to maintain control of her empire against corporate titan Ajit Ahuja, whom she suspects of her father's murder, facing imminent defeat. Ramesh, operating under a hidden identity as a former delivery boy, meticulously orchestrates a plan to avenge a grave betrayal against Ananya's father. He is dramatically revealed as a wealthy heir, and the "contract marriage" with Ananya is exposed as part of an elaborate deception orchestrated by his powerful father. With Ajit Ahuja arrested for serious charges including murder, forgery, kidnapping, and assault, Ramesh confesses his genuine love for Ananya, which developed long before the pretense began. Their complex journey reveals a profound intertwining of revenge, justice, corporate control, and the unexpected emergence of love amidst deception and high-stakes warfare. Ultimately, this leads to the reclamation of a family legacy and the triumph of their unexpected bond.

4d514711-ab6a-4da4-bf89-55fcc685af90.title: Hridoyer Thikana
4d514711-ab6a-4da4-bf89-55fcc685af90.description:
A billionaire father Shashvat who has everything — except love. A daughter Ananya who is determined to find him the right woman. The woman she finds is Sudarshana — kind, divorced, genuine.
But Sudarshana's son Ishaan has a wife who makes her mother-in-law's life hell every single day.
Two lonely people being pushed toward each other by the ones around them — while the ones beside them only push them away.
This is a story of second chances, found in the most unexpected places.

death-clock.title: Death Clock
death-clock.description: ఒక పేద చెత్త ఏరుకునే వ్యక్తికి, మనుషుల మరణ గడియలను మరియు వస్తువుల అసలైన విలువను చూడగలిగే ఒక అద్భుతమైన దైవిక శక్తి లభిస్తుంది. అవమానాలతో నిండిన అతని జీవితం ఆ తర్వాత ఎలా ఒక శక్తివంతమైన విజయతీరానికి చేరుకుంది అనేదే ఈ కథ.

rishte-restart.title: Rishte Restart
rishte-restart.description: After being humiliated and thrown out by her own family, warm-hearted street food vendor Janki unexpectedly finds love and respect in the wealthy yet secretive Tripathy family. As billionaire Om Tripathy hides his true identity to win her trust, relationships heal, old wounds resurface, and a lost mother’s hope of reuniting with her missing son slowly comes alive again. Watch now.

lies-and-legacy-1.title: Lies and Legacy
lies-and-legacy-1.description: The story follows a long struggle over merit, money, and public status, where school contests and corporate power games keep colliding. It begins with a wealthy father being pushed by his daughter to adopt a greener habit, but the larger conflict quickly shifts to Simi and her father facing humiliation from richer rivals. Simi repeatedly tries to prove that talent and hard work matter more than wealth, while powerful adults try to block her through bullying, bribery, and institutional pressure. Her science fair success and later award claims are repeatedly interrupted by suspicious commands, public accusations, and sudden reversals. At the same time, hidden family links begin to surface through luxury cars, payment cards, and other exposed connections. Raman Rayzada and other powerful figures try to secure awards for their sons or allies, but their methods are repeatedly questioned in public. A mysterious protector steps in when Simi is threatened, showing that she is not entirely alone in the fight. The conflict widens into corporate and family warfare, with rival businessmen using ceremonies, donations, and financial leverage to shame one another. Public reveals about spouses, children, and secret loyalties destabilize both households and make honor itself a battleground. Shalaka emerges as a central force whose loyalties and motives appear divided, and her relationship with Ashok becomes increasingly hostile. Ashok and Raman Rai’s rivalry grows into open confrontation, with accusations of fraud, betrayal, and misuse of power spreading across family and business circles. Simi is then pulled into a harsher struggle over a prized project, patent, and trophy, where she is accused of plagiarism and fraud despite insisting the recognition is hers. Powerful sides publicly favor Sam, disown Simi, and even block her from the ceremony, turning her fight for recognition into a fight for dignity and survival. Her father intervenes when the abuse turns physical, but the scandal only deepens. Elsewhere, a young inventor challenges a wealthy family over destroyed work and compensation, showing that the same pattern of exploitation reaches beyond one student. The later arc becomes even more volatile as hidden parentage, forged identities, and illicit relationships are dragged into the open. Shalaka/Shalini publicly exposes Ashok and claims control of major assets, while Ashok responds with accusations, divorce, and attempts to reclaim authority. Another chairman is exposed for corruption and secret leakage, reinforcing the theme that public power is built on concealed wrongdoing. By the end, several relationships are fractured, reputations are damaged, and financial and emotional ruin spread through the families, even as a quieter possibility of new bonds begins to emerge.

main-samay-hun.title: Main Samay Hun
main-samay-hun.description: Samay, a devoted house-husband sacrifices his billionaire inheritance to build his wife Ishita’s dreams—only to be betrayed, abandoned to kidnappers for three years, and erased from his own daughter Siya’s life. But when he returns as the hidden heir to a luxury empire, the broken man they humiliated begins a ruthless emotional comeback, forcing his family to confront the cost of choosing ambition, status, and lies over love. Watch Now

5ef4e4f7-793e-461e-8b80-00e5c0f5bb36.title: Bhikshakan to Boss
5ef4e4f7-793e-461e-8b80-00e5c0f5bb36.description:
A billionaire hiding as a beggar to escape an arranged marriage. An orphan girl abandoned at the altar on her wedding day. Two strangers with nothing — and everything to lose.
When fate throws them together at the worst moment of both their lives, the most unlikely deal is struck.
This is a story of two broken people who accidentally become each other's biggest plot twist.

billionaire-waiter-1.title: Billionaire Waiter
billionaire-waiter-1.description: When a heartbroken billionaire hotel tycoon disguises himself as a humble waiter to find true love, he impulsively marries a fiery, no-nonsense Tamil bride who has just been dumped at the mandap, only to hide his real identity while falling for her for real. But how long can a secret worth billions survive inside a marriage built on lies, pride, and unexpected love?

sang-legenda-yang-terlupakan.title: Sang Legenda yang Terlupakan
sang-legenda-yang-terlupakan.description:
Ditinggalkan untuk mati oleh saudara kandungnya sendiri, namun takdir berkata lain.
Ketika jati dirinya perlahan kembali, ia bangkit menghadapi penguasa korup, petarung brutal, dan setan-setan dalam dirinya sendiri, demi menjadi legenda yang dulu pernah ia jelmakan.
Sebuah kisah tentang kekuatan, ingatan, dan kebangkitan terhebat seorang manusia.
Saksikan sekarang!

lost-ancient-places-of-andhra-pradesh.title: Lost Ancient places of Andhra Pradesh
lost-ancient-places-of-andhra-pradesh.description: Andhra Pradesh lo manaki teliyakunda jargina vishyalu chaala unnayi, vati gurinchi purthiga telusukovalante ee video chudandi

gone-girl-returns.title: Gone Girl Returns
gone-girl-returns.description: After a devastating earthquake tears her family apart, Meera is forced into an impossible choice that changes three lives forever. Years later, hidden identities, class divides, and buried guilt collide when fate brings the separated daughters back into each other’s world. As shocking truths unravel, love, betrayal, and sacrifice redefine what family truly means.

dc1588a5-25be-47cf-a6cb-b58615788ba7.title: London Arjun Prema Kathe
dc1588a5-25be-47cf-a6cb-b58615788ba7.description:
London Arjun Prema Kathe is a romantic comedy about Arjun Malhotra, a billionaire’s carefree son who fails his exams in London. Instead of giving him the family empire,his father sends him to India to live like a common man and earn success from scratch.
Working at a Delhi garage, Arjun falls for Simran, the owner’s daughter. But her arrogant boyfriend Rohit has plans to grab her family’s property. Arjun must win love and prove his worth, not as a rich heir, but as a real man. WATCH NOW

big-boss-daddy.title: Big Boss Daddy
big-boss-daddy.description: Deepak Sharma desh ke sabse ameer logon mein se ek the, lekin apne bacchon ko paison ki asli keemat sikhane ke liye woh parivaar ke saath gaon mein gareeb bankar rehte the. Jab unke bacchon ko ek reality show ke liye chuna gaya, to papa ko electric scooter dilane ke junoon ki wajah se baccho ne usme hissa lene ka faisla kiya. Lekin Mehra family ne TRP ke liye bacchon par zulm karne shuru kar diye.aakhirkar Deepak Sharma ko saamne aana hi pada..kya gareebi ka yeh natak unpar hi bhaari pad gaya?

boda-secretos-y-escandalo.title: Boda, secretos y escándalo
boda-secretos-y-escandalo.description: “Una chica bondadosa que se dirige a la boda de su hermano queda atrapada en un vuelo de pesadilla con una mujer cruel y su hijo malcriado, desatando un caos que revela impactantes secretos de poder, traición y una identidad equivocada. Cuando el amor, las mentiras y el honor familiar chocan, una tormenta de venganza y revelaciones estalla en pleno vuelo y más allá.”

3d771086-702d-4454-9d7b-6d2f7298bea7.title: Gully Boy ki CEO love
3d771086-702d-4454-9d7b-6d2f7298bea7.description: Set in the vibrant city of Varanasi, the story follows Aman, a simple desi saree salesman deeply rooted in the culture and spirit of Banaras, and Shaily, a modern, educated businesswoman who owns a leading Banarasi saree brand and shopping mall. Coming from completely different worlds, their journey unfolds through love, clashes, and emotions while celebrating the rich traditions, language, and colorful lifestyle of Banaras.

ગુમનામ-બિલિયનર-.title: ગુમનામ બિલિયનર
ગુમનામ-બિલિયનર-.description: Ek billionaire prem mate jail jay che, pan dhokho male che. Varsho pachi te navi identity sathe pachho ave che. Jyaare ey baare aave chhe eni GF ne made chhe tyaare badhu  j badlai gayu hoy chhe ane achanak ena past na secrets ne lidhe eni life ma uthap pathal mache chhe pan eva kaya secrets  chhe je ene staave chhe te jaanva mate juvo Gumnaam Billionaire

royal-strangers.title: Royal Strangers
royal-strangers.description: A simple elderly couple visits their billionaire son’s luxury empire to celebrate their anniversary, but their modest appearance makes the staff mistake them for beggars. Humiliated, tortured, and thrown out of their own empire, they silently endure brutal cruelty while their powerful son remains unaware of the truth. Royal Strangers is an emotional revenge drama about class, arrogance, hidden identity, and a family pushed to the edge.

bluff-bharya-rich-mogudu.title: Bluff Bharya Rich Mogudu
bluff-bharya-rich-mogudu.description: ఒక రిచ్  బిజినెస్ మాన్ తన కూతురు  నిజాయితీగా కస్టపడి సంపాదించిన ట్రోఫీని తీసుకోవడానికి  కూతురితో  కలిసి స్కూల్  కి  వెళ్తాడు కానీ  అక్కడకు వచ్చిన పొగరుబోతు తండ్రి కొడుకులు డబ్బులతో ఆ ట్రోఫీ ని తీసుకోవటానికి ట్రై చేస్తారు .  ఒక ట్రోఫీ కోసం జరిగిన గొడవతో అనుకోకుండా కొన్ని నిజాలు బయటపడతాయి. ఆ నిజాలు వారి జీవితాల్లో ఎలాంటి మలుపులు తీసుకొచ్చాయి? చివరికి ఆ ట్రోఫీని గెలిచిందెవరు? అసలు జీవితంలో గెలిచిందెవరు? ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన ఈ కథను తప్పక చూడండి.

chai-love.title: Chai & Love
chai-love.description: A billionaire CEO hides behind the mask of a humble chaiwala to win the heart of the woman he has loved since his teenage years. When Shruti runs away from a forced marriage, fate throws her into Dharam’s arms—sparking a contract marriage built on lies, laughter, and unexpected love. As class clashes, family drama, and buried truths surface, Dharam must choose between protecting his secret and risking everything for honest love

pyar-ka-panga.title: Pyar Ka Panga
pyar-ka-panga.description: A devoted husband returns after three years of captivity to find his wife choosing her first love over him—until the “chaprasi pati” rises as a billionaire chairman and turns heartbreak into revenge.

swami-koragajja-nambidavara-asare.title: Swami Koragajja - Nambidavara Asare
swami-koragajja-nambidavara-asare.description:
ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ದಾರಿಗಳು ಮುಚ್ಚಿಹೋದಾಗ, ನಮಗ್ಯಾರೂ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂತ ಕಣ್ಣೀರು ಹಾಕುವಾಗ, ನಮಗೆ ಸಿಗೋ ಆ ಕೊನೆಯ ಆಸರೆಯೇ 'ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಕೊರಗಜ್ಜ'.

ಅಮ್ಮ-ಅಪ್ಪನ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಅಜ್ಜನಂತೆ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ನೀಡೋ ಈ ದೈವದ ಕಥೆ ಬರೀ ನಂಬಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲ, ಇದು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಭಕ್ತನ ಎದೆಯ ಮಿಡಿತ. 

ತುಳುನಾಡಿನ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಈ ಅತೀಂದ್ರಿಯ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಅಸಹಾಯಕರ ಬೆನ್ನಿಗೆ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತೆ? ನಮಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯದ ಕೊರಗಜ್ಜನ ಹುಟ್ಟಿನ ಕರಾಳ ಸತ್ಯಗಳೇನು? ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದುಹೋದ ಆ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಭಕ್ತರ ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಪವಾಡಗಳ ಅದ್ಬುತ ದರ್ಶನವೇ ಈ ಮೈಕ್ರೋ ಸಿರೀಸ್.

ebdb473a-6958-4e9f-929c-0797411d026c.title: Bappa, Billionaire & Blessings
ebdb473a-6958-4e9f-929c-0797411d026c.description:
Arav Khanna built a billionaire empire in Jaipur and declared himself his own god — dismissing his mother's devotion to Lord Ganesha as blind faith. His fiancée Shagun walked out. His business crashed. His world turned to dust overnight.

Standing alone with nothing left, Arav finally looks up.

This is a story of a man whose ahankaar broke everything — and whether Ganpati Bappa still answers when you've spent a lifetime turning away.

मजदूर-की-घर-आली-पैसे-आली-.title: मजदूर की घर आली पैसे आली

web-of-betrayal.title: Web of Betrayal
web-of-betrayal.description: The show begins with a devastating fire that shatters Aman, Pooja, and Tina’s family when Aman chooses to save Rani instead of immediately returning for his wife and daughter. In the aftermath, Pooja’s worsening condition and Tina’s desperate attempts to reach Aman expose that his loyalty has shifted toward Rani, while Rani actively keeps him from going back. As Pooja dies, Tina is left with grief, anger, and the belief that her mother’s final suffering was tied to Aman and Rani’s betrayal. Mourning quickly turns into open conflict when Aman continues to favor Rani publicly, deepening Tina’s humiliation and hardening her resolve. What begins as a family tragedy then expands into a broader scandal of hidden affairs, staged injuries, missing evidence, and accusations that the fatal fire was not simply an accident. Tina pushes to expose Rani through confrontations and hidden-camera proof, while Rani tries to control the narrative and even shift blame onto Pooja. A confession eventually makes the stakes even darker, with Rani admitting to killing Puja after being confronted over exploiting her trust. Aman remains torn between suspicion and protection, unable to fully detach from Rani even as the damage to his family becomes undeniable. Tina’s response evolves from emotional accusation into calculated revenge, especially through money, property, and public ruin. She targets Rani through apartment deals, stolen savings, and a collapsing Dream Home project, turning financial ambition into a trap. The property conflict widens beyond one family into scams, bankruptcies, forced signatures, and retaliatory deals that leave multiple people financially and emotionally wrecked. Tina and Teena also emerge as powerful corporate figures who resist or redirect demolition schemes, using authority inside Sunrise Group to challenge corruption and strike back at rivals. Rani and Prem answer with intimidation and seizure attempts, pushing the feud into battles over homes, ancestral land, and even funeral dignity. Aman, already broken by Pooja’s death, is further humiliated in these struggles and vows revenge after public degradation and the desecration of his deceased wife’s ashes. Across these clashes, the fight over property becomes inseparable from older wounds about abandonment, loyalty, inheritance, and who has the right to bury the dead or protect the family home. Later reckonings bring more direct moral judgment, as long-buried manipulation and selfishness are confronted and several characters are forced to answer for the suffering they caused. Tina herself does not emerge untouched, since after jail she seeks redemption but is denied forgiveness by Pooja’s grieving father, showing that revenge has not healed the original loss. Even so, the closing movement shifts toward fragile emotional repair, as Tina tries to begin a new life with Veer while still carrying the weight of her mother’s death. The final note suggests that love, memory, and destiny briefly overcome the show’s long cycle of betrayal and retaliation through a reunion between Tina and her long-lost mother at Tina’s wedding.

aa5c57ef-0c20-4572-a540-67aae96f74e7.title: Mitti ka Pehelwan
aa5c57ef-0c20-4572-a540-67aae96f74e7.description: Randeep (aka Mahabali) is a hidden prodigy living a fake “loser” life due to a promise to his dying mother. When his sister, school, and honor are threatened by ruthless enemies and underground conspiracies, he slowly unleashes his true identity, leading to revenge, power battles, and a larger hidden system controlling the martial arts world.

ચક્રવર્તી-અથર્વ.title: ચક્રવર્તી અથર્વ
ચક્રવર્તી-અથર્વ.description: The microdrama centers on Atharva, an ambitious disciple who defies traditional methods to successfully create a mythical elixir of immortality, challenging ancient wisdom. His Guru, secretly fearing Atharva's immense power, expels him under the guise of a quest to find his family and a fated bride, while concealing a profound secret about Atharva's past. Atharva, now revered by others for his spiritual abilities, reluctantly accepts an invitation to the prestigious Shikhar Gurukul, where he faces a forced marriage proposal and boldly challenges the authority of the Elders. In this mystical world, where spiritual power measured by chakras dictates status, Atharva is initially underestimated and plagued by conflicting teachings. He is thrust into a series of high-stakes qualification tests and competitions, facing arrogant challengers and the disapproval of Ashwini's father regarding an arranged marriage. Despite initial failures and public humiliation, Atharva defies expectations by manifesting unprecedented spiritual chakras, challenging ancient artifacts and established beliefs. His extraordinary abilities lead to him being reluctantly chosen to lead the prestigious Shikhar Gurukul, but also spark skepticism and concern from the esteemed Guru Rajnish, who fears Atharva's power could disrupt the spiritual order. A catastrophic energy surge from a divine artifact then threatens to overwhelm the Gurukul. Atharva's return to his family after two decades reveals a dark secret: he is a lost heir targeted by the malevolent Guru Rajneesh, who previously attempted to eliminate him and his family. Accused of destroying the sacred Divyamani, Atharva is forced to confront his mysterious past and awaken his hidden abilities. He publicly humiliates Guru Rajneesh with a seemingly ordinary dagger that proves impossibly heavy, establishing himself as a formidable challenger. A mysterious woman, Vira, appears, revealing a twenty-year search for Atharva and vowing to protect him, while also seeking his help to create a mythical elixir for her ailing leader, who has been poisoned by Guru Rajneesh. Atharva faces a dilemma between an arranged marriage by his father and a prior commitment by his guru, as he uncovers family secrets and a deeper narrative of revenge and justice connected to his past separation. Concurrently, he embarks on a perilous quest to find the mythical Sanjivani elixir to save his poisoned Guru Kostubh. He faces challenges from figures like Anulom and Vilom, and his engagement to Ira is abruptly broken due to accusations of deceit. A fierce rivalry ignites between Atharva and the established Guru Samahit over the creation of the Sanjivani, with Ira eventually placing her trust in Atharva. The show culminates in Atharva heroically exposing a betrayal against Guru Kostubh, leading to Ira confessing her profound love, but Atharva's mysterious departure for Ashwini leaves him caught in a compelling love triangle, with his ultimate destiny and the full extent of his powers yet to be revealed.

b4cadb3a-8ea7-4ea1-9d2d-8b4ee9726b47.title: Crorepati No. 1
b4cadb3a-8ea7-4ea1-9d2d-8b4ee9726b47.description: The story follows a chain of arranged marriages, hidden wealth, and public humiliation that repeatedly traps women in family power games. Ishita is first dragged back into a forced marriage tied to land, and what looks like a grim match is complicated when the supposed old groom turns out to be the grandson. Around her, other women face similar pressure as men’s true status is concealed, and money is used to control consent, shame resistance, and buy compliance. Netra becomes another central figure in this pattern when she learns that the man tied to her future is far richer and more influential than he first appeared. As the pressure around her grows, she is pulled between fear, family betrayal, and the possibility of safety with Ritesh, who repeatedly presents himself as her protector and future husband. Their bond deepens through shared space, emotional support, and his willingness to give her control over family finances and even name her CEO, but their relationship is repeatedly interrupted by outside threats and family interference. In parallel, the show keeps returning to class warfare in elite spaces, where arrogant people are publicly exposed, expensive appearances are mocked, and hidden status flips the balance of power. Corporate conflict becomes just as ruthless as the marriage plots, with promotions, revenge schemes, audits, forged signatures, and stolen funds turning the workplace into another battlefield. A powerful woman is repeatedly dismissed and humiliated before being revealed as the true CEO, after which she uses documents and security to bring down those who tried to control her. That downfall expands into arrests and legal consequences as financial fraud and misuse of organizational assets are exposed. The personal and professional wars then collide when Netra’s engagement becomes entangled with sibling jealousy and an earlier scheme to marry her off to a supposed garbage collector. Public wedding chaos follows, with accusations, intimate evidence, and rival claims threatening to destroy the ceremony. Ritesh’s own wedding-day scandal briefly seems to confirm the worst when he is found drugged in bed with Meera, who tries to blackmail him into marriage or money. He insists he was framed, and a hidden camera later supports that claim by revealing the setup as a trap for his wealth. Even after that exposure, the damage forces his intended partner to call off the union for a time. The final movement turns back toward reconciliation, as Netra apologizes for her sister’s role in the drugging scheme and the couple rushes to complete their ceremony before the deadline closes in. Across the whole arc, the stakes are emotional survival, social reputation, and control over wealth, with love constantly tested by manipulation, class resentment, and family betrayal.

the-price-of-love.title: The Price of Love
the-price-of-love.description: Piyush, a powerful fashion CEO, secretly lives as a humble tailor, concealing his immense wealth from his materialistic wife, Vaani, believing she values his genuine efforts. However, Vaani openly disdains him, publicly humiliates him, and pursues an illicit affair, fueled by her desire for luxury. She issues an ultimatum, demanding a luxury car or divorce, prompting a heartbroken but determined Piyush to vow to save their marriage by acquiring the car. During this time, Meher Mittal, a wealthy heiress, is captivated by Piyush's integrity and proposes to him, but he rejects her due to his unwavering loyalty to Vaani. Vaani's ruthless ambition culminates in her orchestrating a corporate deal, "selling" Piyush to Meher for immense wealth and a significant corporate stake, publicly humiliating him during their divorce and immediate, transactional remarriage to Meher. Shattered by this betrayal, Piyush, now revealed as a hidden billionaire CEO and Meher's brother, plots corporate revenge against Vaani and her associates. He orchestrates a dramatic downfall for Vaani at India Fashion Week, exposing her fraudulent designs, stripping her of her wealth and power, and publicly disgracing her and her accomplices. Following this, Meher discovers Piyush's hidden agenda, leading her to demand a divorce, believing their marriage was solely a revenge plot. Piyush confesses his past fears and secrets, leading to a heartfelt reconciliation with Meher. Their renewed romance is then challenged by the shocking return of Vaani, who claims pregnancy and Piyush's paternity, demanding a fortune and threatening to abort the child. A dramatic intervention exposes Vaani's paternity fraud, revealing another man as the true father. After a violent confrontation where Piyush saves Meher, he proposes marriage, and Meher accepts on the condition that he relinquishes his corporate identity to be solely her devoted husband.

maa-naanna-rahasya-jeevitham.title: Maa Naanna Rahasya Jeevitham
maa-naanna-rahasya-jeevitham.description: మోహిత్ తన నాన్నకి పెళ్ళి చేయాలని అనుకుంటాడు. అంతకన్నా ముందే మోహిత్ కి పెద్ద షాక్ ఇస్తాడు తండ్రి దర్శ్. అసలేం జరిగింది? దర్శ్ చిలిపి పనులు, రహస్య జీవితం, మలుపులతో కూడిన కథ " మా నాన్న రహస్య జీవితం"

31cc47b7-bfe2-4f7b-a6f3-de454822dc27.title: The Billionaire's 107 Year Secret
31cc47b7-bfe2-4f7b-a6f3-de454822dc27.description: The story centers on a family trapped by a long-standing curse that can only be broken if a destined bride with a unique mark is found and married. Arjun takes on that burden and begins searching for the marked woman while the family’s past and ancestral photographs deepen the mystery. As the search unfolds, the show repeatedly cuts between destiny-driven romance and immediate survival crises, especially for women caught between poverty, family pressure, and powerful men. Nisha emerges as the key figure in the destiny thread, but she is also surrounded by hostility, first from a cruel sister and later through false accusations and expulsion. Arjun’s path crosses with Nisha in a way that makes him see her as a sign of fortune, and he offers her help as their connection grows. At the same time, another man pursues the marked girl through assistants, informants, and a trail that leads to a specific address, reinforcing that the search is becoming more urgent and more public. The mark itself becomes the central object of suspicion, with family members questioning whether it is real, natural, or even stolen. This suspicion pulls in professionals and elders, turning private identity into a matter of ceremony, inheritance, and control. Several women are forced into precarious work or coercive arrangements, showing how survival is repeatedly tied to obedience. In one thread, a jobless woman is briefly given hope through a cooking job, only for the engagement setting to become another site of scrutiny and threat. In another, a captive woman is trapped under a controlling man, underscoring the darker side of wealth and authority in this world. Family secrets also surface around hidden sisters and mothers, exposing class shame and the lies used to protect status. Arjun repeatedly confronts these deceptions, especially when family members conceal their background or try to preserve a false engagement. The wedding itself becomes the main battleground, with priests, elders, and relatives all trying to control who may marry whom and under what conditions. Omens, illness, and sudden disasters are interpreted as signs that the family has strayed from the truth. The pressure builds until the ceremony is openly challenged as fraudulent. By the end of the batch, Arjun interrupts the wedding and identifies the supposed marked bride as fake. He also points to Nisha as the true bearer of the destined mark, throwing the family into chaos and leaving the curse, the marriage, and the question of rightful identity unresolved.

fake-ashiqui.title: Fake Ashiqui
fake-ashiqui.description: Shiven, a rebellious heir, initially defied his patriarchal father by abandoning the family empire to pursue a forbidden love with Kiara, working as a delivery driver. A family crisis, prompted by his grandmother's critical illness, brought him back into contact with his disapproving father. During this vulnerable time, Kiara betrayed Shiven, choosing the wealthy Pratik and entering a contractual marriage, abandoning Shiven during his grandmother's final moments. This profound betrayal, coupled with the revelation that Shiven's marriage to Kiara was never legally registered, shattered him, fueling a vow of relentless retribution. After a five-year absence, Shiven returned to the Bansal Group, facing public humiliation from Kiara and pressure for an arranged marriage. He was appointed CEO, navigating corporate politics and confronting rivals like Pratik, whose company's bankruptcy was exposed by the powerful heiress Minal Goenka. Shiven, sometimes identified as Akshay, then embarked on a calculated revenge plot, returning disguised to a grand wedding where Kiara intended to marry into the Bansal family. He dramatically unmasked himself, revealing his true identity as the powerful heir and new CEO of the colossal Bansal Group. Shiven's proposal to Kiara was a calculated scheme to publicly humiliate her for her past deceptions and her perceived role in his grandmother's death. He ultimately rejected both Kiara and her betraying friend, declaring them indistinguishable. The narrative culminates with Shiven marrying Meenal, presenting her with a family heirloom, and declaring her the owner of a vast corporate empire, elevating her to a formidable heiress and securing his legacy.

janitor-the-king-maker.title: Janitor The King Maker
janitor-the-king-maker.description: Rejected, insulted, and treated like a nobody, Samay hides his true identity as the mysterious King Maker. But when the truth comes out at a grand public event, the same people who mocked him are forced to bow before him.

punch-kick-love.title: Punch Kick Love
punch-kick-love.description: Mocked as a mere janitor in an elite boxing gym, a soft-spoken underdog secretly possesses monstrous natural talent and the bloodline of a fallen boxing legend. When an arrogant national champion pushes him too far, he steps into the ring to fight his way from humiliation to glory—turning a forgotten sweeper into the most dangerous boxer in the tournament.

ludhiana-to-london-3.title: Ludhiana to London
ludhiana-to-london-3.description: After being humiliated as “just a dishwasher” by the woman he secretly loved and supported, a self-made millionaire enters a contract marriage with a wealthy heiress, hiding his true identity as he quietly rises within her powerful world proving that the most underestimated man can command the greatest empire. Watch now!

72789f8c-43e4-4fb0-8643-48169b9f2aa2.title: Mafia Baap
72789f8c-43e4-4fb0-8643-48169b9f2aa2.description: After leaving behind his past as a deadly contract killer, a peaceful café owner is forced back into the underworld when his daughter is kidnapped by a brutal human trafficking syndicate, unleashing a father’s unstoppable war against the monsters who took his child.

bappa-calling.title: Bappa Calling
bappa-calling.description:
Pratik Jalan's business partner steals everything overnight. His wife doesn't believe in his faith. His in-laws mock his devotion. And through every humiliation, the only constant in his life is a small Ganesh idol on his desk — with a diya that never stops burning.

Strange things keep happening. Help arrives from nowhere. A flower falls perfectly into folded hands.

This is a story of Pratik — a man who lost everything, but never lost Bappa, and how Bappa never lost him either.

my-commando-wife-1.title: My Commando Wife
my-commando-wife-1.description: They mocked her, betrayed her, and threw her away as if she were nothing. But beneath the saree and silent smiles hides Surya Gayathri, a legendary Marine Commando whose name became a myth. When her past returns, the family that broke her discovers they have awakened a warrior they can never defeat.

abhaya-hastham.title: Abhaya Hastham
abhaya-hastham.description: A mysterious healer with the power to give life and take life returns as Niteesh, protects the woman he loves, heals her scars, and takes down the powerful families who destroyed her.

pati-ko-zeher-dene-wali-patni.title: Pati Ko Zeher Dene Wali Patni
pati-ko-zeher-dene-wali-patni.description: Pati Ko Zeher Dene Wali Patni

af1979e5-5a94-4b44-b8c8-5b117c8d3731.title: Gold Digger Pellam
af1979e5-5a94-4b44-b8c8-5b117c8d3731.description: Aviraj a wealthy man discovers her wife betrayal with his own secretary. When he learns of their plot against his child and fortune, he vows to protect what's his and ensure justice prevails.

reboot-love.title: Reboot Love
reboot-love.description: The show follows Krish, a man repeatedly humiliated for his apparent poverty and low status, as wedding disasters, corporate exploitation, and family secrets gradually reveal that his identity has been hidden all along. His public downfall begins when Tannu rejects him at the altar for the wealthy Aman Oberoi, mocking his job and lack of money and setting off a chain of emotional and financial wreckage. Similar betrayals echo around him, including abandoned grooms, impulsive marriages, and transactional relationships built around wealth, status, and hidden motives. Even after the broken wedding, Krish continues to be treated as a servant and scapegoat by elite families who use money, inheritance, and public shame as weapons against him. He fights back by insisting that his labor and talent built the success others claim, especially as his concealed brilliance as an AI developer starts to surface. At the same time, a locket, a pendant, and secret DNA testing create a parallel mystery suggesting that an ordinary, mistreated man may actually belong to a powerful family searching for a lost son. Kiara, presented as Krish’s wealthy wife though their marriage initially seems strategic or strained, becomes central to this mystery by sheltering him while also investigating his origins. Their relationship mixes tenderness, suspicion, and protection, especially as she tries to uncover the truth behind his identity. Krish’s humiliation intensifies through public accusations, beatings, and theft claims led by Aman, Tanu, and their circle, even as a mentor figure pushes him to reclaim his hidden status as the "Cyber King," a master AI developer. The buried family truth finally breaks open when DNA evidence and the half-heart locket identify Krish as the biological son of the Oberoi family, while Aman is exposed as adopted. This revelation transforms the central conflict from class humiliation into an inheritance war, as Krish is welcomed by some relatives but denounced by others as a fraud unworthy of family power. Pressured to prove himself in business, he is challenged to secure the support of the elusive Cyber King, only for the hidden-identity reversal to reveal that Krish himself is the figure everyone has been chasing. That triumph does not end the danger, because sabotage and attempted murder follow, including a car crash that Kiara believes was deliberate. As Krish rises from rejected office boy to recognized heir, he uncovers deeper betrayals tied to an old kidnapping, efforts to erase him, and new plots against him and his wife. The family struggle expands into public exposure and legal reckoning, with Krish confronting powerful father and grandfather figures as well as Aman and Tanu over fraud, violence, and long-running deception. By the later arc, the story becomes one of reclaiming dignity through truth: the same man once mocked as disposable uses evidence, intelligence, and public confrontation to dismantle corrupt authority. Across the series, the stakes are both personal and dynastic, as love, marriage, inheritance, and corporate control all hinge on whether Krish can survive humiliation long enough to prove who he is. The overall arc turns repeated public disgrace into a reversal of power, where hidden identity, family legitimacy, and justice reshape the hierarchy that once crushed him.

1dc66d0e-8af0-4202-9d26-a6e623c5c582.title: Final Breakup
1dc66d0e-8af0-4202-9d26-a6e623c5c582.description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

d1d2204d-55e0-4ed8-828f-4574c7831078.title: Shaadi Ki Second Inning
d1d2204d-55e0-4ed8-828f-4574c7831078.description: Still Waiting for Love is an emotional family drama about Minakshi, a selfless mother abandoned by her own children, who finds a second chance through Tushar, a wealthy man living simply, and Vivan, a son yearning for maternal love. Blending romance, comedy, humiliation, and revenge, the story explores class divide, age-gap companionship, sacrifice, greed, and destiny, delivering powerful female resilience, shocking twists, and emotional justice in every episode.

88713004-1ee3-419e-aa15-25145fbc6da7.title: Jothe Jotheyalli
88713004-1ee3-419e-aa15-25145fbc6da7.description: Final Betrayal – Season 2 continues the gripping saga from Season 1, where a humble beggar marries a dhokla vendor, only for a shocking revelation to surface later: the beggar is, in fact, a billionaire. In Season 2, the newly married couple travels to Mauritius for their honeymoon. However, their dream getaway soon turns into a nightmare as unforeseen events and dangerous secrets plunge them into chaos, testing their relationship, trust, and survival.

किस्मत-के-लड़ाई.title: किस्मत के लड़ाई
किस्मत-के-लड़ाई.description: Atharva, a determined disciple, defies his Guruji by successfully creating the legendary Sanjeevani elixir, an act that paradoxically leads to his mysterious expulsion. His Guruji orchestrates a quest for Atharva to uncover his true origins and find his family, bestowing upon him a mystical guiding dagger. Concurrently, Ashwini, a daughter compelled by her dying patriarch's will, embarks on a search for her long-lost brother. Atharva, acting as a mysterious healer, saves Ashwini's father using unconventional methods, which results in a rejected marriage proposal from Atharva, citing his ordinary status and an impending spiritual test. He accepts an invitation to the prestigious Shikhar Gurukul, where he boldly challenges the ancient Dharm Gurus, asserting their lack of true spiritual essence, a stance guided by his enigmatic mentor. Within the Gurukul's rigid, chakra-based hierarchy, Atharva, initially perceived as ordinary, is revealed to possess an unprecedented, hidden spiritual power, directly challenging the established order and the accuracy of the ancient Divyamani artifact. He endures public humiliation and accusations of fraud, yet dramatically manifests the impossible seventh chakra, questioning the very nature of spiritual power and humbly denying divinity. This period culminates in a profound crisis as the Divyamani artifact unleashes an overwhelming, unprecedented energy, threatening to reshape their world. Atharva is then revealed to be Harkesh's long-lost son, a reunion that triggers an ancient prophecy and exposes a deadly conspiracy orchestrated by Guru Rajnish, who had previously sought to eliminate him. Falsely accused of shattering the sacred Divya Mani, Atharva faces Guru Rajnish's demand for impossible 'alaukik' compensation. A mysterious dagger emerges, challenging Guru Rajnish's authority, which he publicly struggles to wield. To defy Guru Rajnish, who seeks to harness his energy, Atharva makes a strategic marriage proposal. The arrival of Ira for an arranged marriage with Atharva, driven by her Guru Kaustav's poisoning by Rajnish, further complicates matters, creating a love triangle involving Atharva, Ira, and Ashwini, whose pre-destined union and tragic past are hinted at. Atharva is tasked with finding the legendary Sanjeevani elixir to save the poisoned Guru Kaustubh, facing skepticism and trials. His fiancée, Ira, breaks their engagement, demanding he create the elixir to win her back. Ultimately, Atharva uncovers Guru Samahit's profound betrayal, revealing he poisoned Guru Kaustubh, leading to Samahit's apprehension. The show explores the clash between tradition and innovation, the unveiling of hidden destinies, and the fight against corruption within spiritual institutions, all centered on Atharva's journey to understand his powers and heritage.

hidden-hawaizada.title: Hidden Hawaizada
hidden-hawaizada.description:
Vikram is a fighter pilot who just returned from battle — with a ring in his pocket and love in his heart. The woman he planned to propose to doesn't just say no. She humiliates him in front of the billionaire who replaced him.
But Vikram Oberoi isn't just a pilot. He is the sole heir to one of the biggest empires in the country — and nobody knows it.
This is a story of a man the world underestimated, hiding in plain sight.

1000-saal-ka-badla.title: 1000 Saal Ka Badla
1000-saal-ka-badla.description: Karan Mehta 1000 saalon tak ek hi din ke time loop mein fasa raha. Usi ek din mein usne aisi fighting skills aur contacts bana liye the, jinhe haasil karna kisi aam insaan ke liye namumkin tha. Lekin woh apni maa ke kaatilon—sauteli maa Kamini, uske bete Ravi aur mastermind Mahesh Modi—se badla nahi le paaya. Duniya ki nazron mein woh ek spoiled brat ban chuka tha. Phir ek din woh us jaal se azaad ho gaya… par kya azaadi ke baad woh apna badla le paaya, ya kisi naye khel mein phas gaya?

aukaat-ka-khel.title: Vardhan Ka Raaz
aukaat-ka-khel.description: A visionary automobile strategist, Kabir, transforms a failing company into India’s top automotive empire while silently enduring relentless humiliation from its arrogant chairperson, Naina, who treats him like a servant despite his brilliance. Bound by a three-year debt of loyalty to her father, Kabir suppresses his self-respect to fulfill his promise. On the very night the company becomes number one, he walks away with truth that power without respect is destined to fall.

superlife.title: SuperLife
superlife.description: ನಾವು ಸೇವಿಸುವ ಆಹಾರ, ನಮ್ಮ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ದೈಹಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ನೇರ ಪರಿಣಾಮವನ್ನು ಉಂಟು ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ! ಹೀಗಾಗಿ ಉತ್ತಮವಾದ ಆಹಾರ ಸೇವನೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಇಂಪಾರ್ಟೆಂಟ್! ಈ ಕೆಮಿಕಲ್ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಹಾರ ಸೇವಿಸೋದು? ಯಾವ ಆಹಾರದಿಂದ ಏನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಲಾಭ? ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಫುಡ್ ಸ್ಟೈಲ್ ಹೇಗಿರ್ಬೇಕು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಸೂಪರ್ ಲೈಫ್' ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬೈಟ್ಸ್!

the-beautiful-cure.title: The Beautiful Cure
the-beautiful-cure.description: ನಾವು ಮೇಲ್ನೋಟಕ್ಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿರ್ಬಹುದು! ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕಾರಣ ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಹದ ಇಮ್ಯೂನ್ ಸಿಸ್ಟಂ! ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ದೈಹಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ನೇರ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿರುವ ಈ ಜೀರ್ಣಕ್ರಿಯೆ, ಹೇಗೆ ಕಾರ್ಯ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತೆ? ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನಡೆದ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಗಳೆಷ್ಟು? ಯಾಕೆ ಇಮ್ಯೂನ್ ಸಿಸ್ಟಂ ತುಂಬಾ ಇಂಪಾರ್ಟೆಂಟ್? ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಲೇಖಕ ಡೇನಿಯಲ್ ಎಂ ಡೇವಿಸ್ ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ಬ್ಯೂಟಿಫುಲ್ ಕ್ಯೂರ್' ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬೈಟ್ಸ್!

once-upon-a-spy-4.title: Once Upon a Spy
once-upon-a-spy-4.description: Once Upon a Spy is a gripping espionage thriller that takes you into a world of mystery, conspiracy, and deeply layered characters. It explores real-inspired elements of the spy world, revealing the complex life of a spy. Every turn brings suspense and unexpected twists. Will the spy fall into enemy hands, or is there a deeper secret hidden behind everything? Perfect for those who love intense thrillers.

the-way-of-zen.title: The Way Of Zen
the-way-of-zen.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾದುದು ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಬದುಕಿನ‌ ಜಂಜಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಸದಾ ಕಳೆದು ಹೋಗಿರ್ತಿವಿ. ಇದ್ರಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಶಾಂತಿಯುತವಾದ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ನಡೆಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಈ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ತುಂಬಾ ಸರಳ ಹಾಗೂ ಸೂಕ್ತವಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಸುತ್ತೆ ಝೆನ್! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಝೆನ್ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನು? ಇದ್ರಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಬದುಕಿನ ಪಾಠಗಳೇನು? ಕೇಳಿ 'ದಿ ವೇ ಆಫ್ ಝೆನ್' ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬೈಟ್ಸ್!

kaalabhairava.title: KaalaBhairava
kaalabhairava.description: ಪರಶಿವನ ರೌದ್ರ ರೂಪವೇ ಕಾಲಭೈರವ! ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಕ್ರೋಶ, ಕೆಂಪು ಕಣ್ಣುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜ್ವಾಲೆ, ಕೊರಳಲ್ಲಿ ರುಂಡ ಮಾಲೆಯನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿರೋ ಭೈರವನನ್ನ ನೋಡ್ತಿದ್ರೆ ಮೈ ನಡುಕ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತೆ! ಆದ್ರೆ ಭೈರವ ನೋಡಲು ಘೋರವಾಗಿದ್ರೂ, ಭಯದಿಂದ ಭಕ್ತರನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸೋ ಕರುಣಾಮಯಿ! ದುಷ್ಟ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣೆ, ಶಿಷ್ಟ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗಾಗಿ ಅವತರಿಸಿ, ಕಲಿಯುಗದಲ್ಲೂ ಚಮತ್ಕಾರ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತಿರೋ ದಯಾಳು! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಭೈರವನ ದೈವಿಕ ಆಗಮನ ಹೇಗಾಯ್ತು? ಜಗದೀಶ್ವರನ ಅವತರಾವಾದ ಭೈರವ, ಶ್ವಾನವನ್ನು ವಾಹನ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡದ್ದು ಯಾಕೆ? ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಹತ್ಯಾ ಶಾಪದ ಕಥೆಯೇನು? ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಭೈರವನನ್ನು ಪೂಜಿಸೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'ಕಾಲಭೈರವ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

indias-most-fearless-1.title: Bhartiya Sena ke Shurviro ki Shaurya Gathaye - 1
indias-most-fearless-1.description: Soldiers hunting terrorists in the dark forests of Kashmir… the Army Major who led the 2016 surgical strikes… a Navy officer rescuing hundreds from a blazing war zone… a wounded Air Force pilot flying a jet turned fireball… and an exclusive account of the 2020 Galwan clash. India’s Most Fearless brings 38 true stories of unmatched courage and sacrifice

the-stress-code.title: The Stress Code
the-stress-code.description: ಬದುಕೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಬೆಳೆಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೆಲಸ ತುಂಬಾ ಇಂಪಾರ್ಟೆಂಟ್. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಕೆಲಸವೇ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಮೇಲೆ ನೆಗೆಟಿವ್ ಪ್ರಭಾವವನ್ನ ಉಂಟು ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ? ಖಂಡಿತ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕೋದಕ್ಕೂ ಆಗಲ್ಲಾ, ಬೆಳೆಯೋದಕ್ಕೂ ಆಗಲ್ಲಾ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಸ್ಟ್ರೆಸ್ ಅಥವಾ ಒತ್ತಡ ಕೊಡೋ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನ ನಿಭಾಯಿಸೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ನಾವು ಸ್ಟ್ರೆಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀವಿ ಅಂತಾ ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಹ ನಮಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತೆ? ಇದನ್ನ ಸರಿ ಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ದಾರಿ ಯಾವುದು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'The Stress Code' ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬೈಟ್ಸ್!

kaamam-to-kaadhal.title: Kaamam to Kaadhal
kaamam-to-kaadhal.description: சிவா லக்ஷ்மி இருவரும் சந்தர்ப்ப சூழ்நிலையால் ஓர் இரவை ஒன்றாய் கழித்திட அந்த இரவை தொடர்வது போல் பெட் ப்ரெண்ட்ஸ் ஆகிறார்கள். ஆனால் காமம் கடந்து காதலாய் அந்த உறவு மாறிட அதை ஏற்றுகொள்ள முடியாதது போல் அவர்கள் கடந்த காலம் தடுக்கிறது. இனி சிவா லக்ஷ்மியின் முடிவு என்ன?

love-in-war.title: Love In War
love-in-war.description: Kya barood ki mehak ke beech kabhi gulaab khil sakte hain? “Love in War” unhi sachchi kahaniyon ka roohani safar hai, jahan jang ke beech bhi ishq zinda raha. Yeh show batata hai ki bandooken shareer ko mita sakti hain, par pyaar aur umeed ko nahi. Nafrat ke daur mein bhi mohabbat ne sarhadon ko chunauti di. Suniye un prem kahaniyon ko jo maut ke saaye mein bhi muskuraati rahi—sirf Kuku FM app par.

അഞ്ജു-മറിയം-ജോണിന്റെ-തിരോധാനം-.title: അഞ്ജു മറിയം ജോണിന്റെ തിരോധാനം
അഞ്ജു-മറിയം-ജോണിന്റെ-തിരോധാനം-.description: പത്ത് കൊല്ലം മുൻപ് കാണാതായ മെഡിക്കൽ വിദ്യാർത്ഥിനി അഞ്ചു മറിയം ജോണിൻ്റെ തിരോധാന രഹസ്യത്തിലേക്ക് വെളിച്ചം വീശൂന്ന ഒരു തുമ്പ് മാധ്യമ പ്രവർത്തകനായ രവിശങ്കറെ തേടിയെത്തുന്നത് തികച്ചും യാദൃശ്ചികമായ് ആണു. ആ തെളിവ് പിന്തുടർന്ന് അയാൾ നടത്തുന്ന അന്വേഷണം നിഗൂഢതകളുടെ ആഴങ്ങളിലേക്ക് അയാളെ നയിക്കുന്നു. കേൾക്കാം അത്യന്തം ഉദ്വേഗഭരിതമായ ക്രൈം ഇൻവസ്റ്റിഗേഷൻ ത്രില്ലർ.

പെൺകൊലയാളികൾ-.title: പെൺകൊലയാളികൾ
പെൺകൊലയാളികൾ-.description: പണത്തിനും അധികാരത്തിനും സ്വന്തം സുഖത്തിനും വേണ്ടി പിഞ്ചുകുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെ പോലെ നിഷ്കരുണം കൊന്നൊടുക്കിയ അനേകം പെൺകൊലയാളികൾ നമുക്ക് ചുറ്റും ഉണ്ട്. കേരള മനസ്സിനെ പിടിച്ചുലച്ച അത്തരത്തിലുള്ള ചില കൊലപാതക കഥകളെ കുറിച്ചാണ് നിങ്ങൾ ഇപ്പോൾ കേൾക്കാൻ പോകുന്നത്...

wife-vs-mistress.title: Wife vs Mistress
wife-vs-mistress.description: After giving birth, Nandini’s world shatters when her newborn is thrown in dustbin by her husband Pratyush and assistant Parul, who replace him with their own child to secure control of her empire. Unknown to them, her real baby survives with a stranger. Nandini returns home and raise their child while secretly plotting revenge to reclaim her son and destroy their conspiracy.

billionaire-ex-wife.title: Billionaire Ex - Wife
billionaire-ex-wife.description: Anjali ne aapla sagla kahi aaplya pati Samarth sathi sodun dila, pan tyach gharat jevha tila apmaan sahayla lagla, tevha ti aapli olakh swayam lihaycha nirnay ghete. Ek dhokebaaz pati, ek chalaak mistress aani ek zalim saas yanchya madhye, Anjali aaplya lifecha sagglyat motha badla ghete – ek taakatwar CEO banun. Ata prashna ha ahe, Samarthchi haar jast dukh deil ki Anjalichi jeet?

undercover-ghar-jamai.title: Undercover Ghar Jamai
undercover-ghar-jamai.description: पिछले कई सालों से एकलव्य मर्चेंट एक साधारण हाउस-हसबैंड की तरह जिंदगी जी रहा है, एक ऐसा सच छुपाकर जो सबकी जिंदगी बदलने वाला था। दरअसल एकलव्य एक वह अंडरकवर नेवी कमांडो था, लेकिन अपना यह सच छिपाकर जैसे-जैसे वह देश के लिए एक खतरनाक मिशन को निभाता है, उसकी निजी जिंदगी अपमान, गलतफहमियों और टूटते रिश्तों में उलझती चली जाती है। क्या उसका सच कभी सामने आएगा, या वह हमेशा एक अनसुना हीरो बनकर रह जाएगा?

jobless-ghar-jamai-15.title: Jobless Ghar Jamai
jobless-ghar-jamai-15.description: Aarav Ambani, jyachya navatch fakht "Ambani" ahe, tyala na gharat maan ahe na baher. Gele teen varsh to faktt saasusathi bhajipala aanat hota ani saalisathi fancy dishes banavat hota. Pan ata tasa nahi! Karan Aaravla shevti to call aala – “Mr. Aarav Ambani, your black Royal card is active now.” Ya callcha arth hota ki Aaravla punha Ambani samrajyat samil kela gelay. Kaya hoil jevha tyachya baaykola – Aditi Chandrala – tyachi khari olakh kalel? Ani Chandra kutumb aaplya gharjamaicha secretly ek billionaire asn patkaru shakel ka?

how-micro-credit-is-making-indians-poor.title: How Micro Credit Is Making Indians Poor
how-micro-credit-is-making-indians-poor.description:
ప్రారంభం" – పేదరికంపై ఆశగా మొదలైన సూక్ష్మ రుణాల ప్రయాణం.
వాస్తవాలు, వ్యతిరేకాలు, వాస్తవిక ప్రభావాల విశ్లేషణ.
పేదలకు సహాయమా? లేదా అప్పుల బానిసలుగా మార్చే వ్యవస్థనా?

energize-your-mind.title: Energize Your Mind
energize-your-mind.description: Take control of your mind to take control of your life. In this bestselling book, life coach Gaur Gopal Das explains how the mind works and how it can be disciplined for greater well-being. Blending powerful stories with practical research, he offers exercises, meditation techniques, and worksheets to help you manage your thoughts and behavior. An essential guide for anyone seeking a more balanced and fulfilling future.

the-secret-housewife-ceo.title: The Secret Housewife CEO
the-secret-housewife-ceo.description: ஷெரின், ஒரு தியாகம் செய்த மனைவி, தனது கணவனின் பழைய காதலனின் மீண்டும் வருவதால் தனது வாழ்க்கையை மறுபடியும் கண்டுபிடிக்கிறாள். காதல், துரோகம் மற்றும் சுய மதிப்பீட்டின் இந்த உணர்ச்சிமயமான பயணத்தில், அவள் தனது உண்மையான சக்தியை அடையாளம் காண்கிறாளா?

lucky-shekar.title: Lucky Shekar
lucky-shekar.description: ప్రేమ ఎవరి మీద పుడుతుందో ఎవ్వరూ చెప్పలేరు. ఒకవేళ ఫలానా వాళ్ళ మీద పుట్టాలని మనసుకు చెప్పుకుంటే అది ప్రేమ కాదు. బిజినెస్ అవుతుంది. మేము బిజినెస్ మాత్రమే చేస్తాం అనుకునే వాళ్ళకు ప్రేమ అర్థం కాదు. సాఫ్ట్ వేర్ ఎంప్లాయి అయిన ఆరాధ్య, డిగ్రీ కూడా చదువుకోలేని శేఖర్ ప్రేమలో ఎలా పడింది? ఆమె ప్రేమను శేఖర్ ఒప్పుకున్నాడా..? సాఫ్ట్ వేర్ ఎంప్లాయీకి సాధారణ డ్రైవర్ కి మధ్య సాగే ఆసక్తికరమైన ప్రేమ కథ లక్కీ శేఖర్.. వినండి కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో..

dhurandhar-sniper.title: Dhurandhar Sniper
dhurandhar-sniper.description: For a year, Rohan has been known only as a simple cleaner at a shooting academy. No one knows he is actually G-9, the deadliest sniper. After losing his mentor, he left his past behind, but when the academy, an innocent child, and a family come under threat, he is forced to pick up the gun again. Now every shot becomes a choice - keep his identity hidden or reveal the truth to the world.

gandhari-kathe.title: Gandhari Kathe
gandhari-kathe.description: “ಗಾಂಧಾರಿ" ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಒಂದು ಅನನ್ಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವವನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮುಂದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ . ಕಣ್ಣು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡು ಧರ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ, ಪತಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೆಗೆ, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಬಲವರ್ಧನೆಗೆ ನಿಷ್ಠೆ ವಹಿಸಿದ ಗಾಂಧಾರಿ ಜೀವನವು ತ್ಯಾಗ, ಕೋಪ, ದುಃಖ ಹಾಗೂ ಶಾಪಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದೆ. ಈ ಶೋ ಗಾಂಧಾರಿಯ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನದಿಂದ ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನೂ, ಅವಳ ಭಾವನೆಗಳ ಒಳತಳಗಳನ್ನೂ ತೆರೆದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. ತಾಯಿತನ, ಪತ್ನಿತನ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಚಾತುರ್ಯ ಹಾಗೂ ನೈತಿಕ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸಿಲುಕಿಕೊಂಡ ಈ ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ.ನ್ಯಾಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ತೀವ್ರವಾದ ಸಂಕಟವನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸಿದ ಗಾಂಧಾರಿಯ ಬದುಕು ನಿಮಗೆ ಹೊಸದೊಂದು ಕಣ್ಣೋಟವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪುರಾತನ ಪಾಠಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧುನಿಕ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು “ಗಾಂಧಾರಿ ಕಥೆ” ಶೋ ಇದನ್ನು ಕೇಳೋದು  ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಅನುಭವಿಸಿ — ಕೇವಲ KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ!

secret-rajkumari.title: Secret Rajkumari
secret-rajkumari.description: ಕೋಟ್ಯಾಧೀಶ ಸುಖೇಶ್‌ ಭಟ್ಟರ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ಮಗಳು ಮನಸ್ವಿನಿ! ಆಗರ್ಭ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳ್ದಿರೋ ಮನಸ್ವಿನಿ ಸಖತ್‌ ಕೋಪಿಷ್ಠೆ. ಭಟ್‌ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಐಕಾನಿಕ್‌ ರೆಸಾರ್ಟ್‌ ʼಸ್ಫಟಿಕ - ದಿ ಹೆವನ್‌ʼಗೆ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಬರೋ ಮನಸ್ವಿನಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನ ಪ್ರೂವ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ಕೋಬೇಕು! ಆದ್ರೆ, ತನ್ನದೇ ರೆಸಾರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮನಸ್ವಿನಿ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಅನುಭವಿಸೋ ಚಾಲೆಂಜ್‌ಸ್‌ಗಳೇನು? ಮನಸ್ವಿನಿ ಲೈಫ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೋ ಆ ಹುಡುಗ ಯಾರು? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವಿರೇಳೇಸೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ಸಿಕ್ರೆಟ್‌ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರಿ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

highway-24-shraapit-safar.title: Highway 24  Shraapit Safar
highway-24-shraapit-safar.description:
Highway 24 – Shraapit Safar is a spine-chilling horror thriller where a simple family road trip turns into a terrifying nightmare. When Siddharth, Megha, and their daughter Pari drive through the isolated Highway 24, a mysterious accident traps them in a cursed loop where roads never end and escape seems impossible.

A vanishing corpse, a haunted Peepal tree, and a vengeful spirit relentlessly follow them. As fear deepens, a dark secret from Siddharth’s past resurfaces—one that now demands a deadly price.

This is not just horror, but a tale of guilt, fear, and revenge—where every turn leads closer to the truth… and to death.
Be warned: once you enter Highway 24, the journey may never end.

the-corporate-jungle-your-guide-to-under.title: The Corporate Jungle: Your Guide to Understanding Workplace, People and Politics
the-corporate-jungle-your-guide-to-under.description: இப்போ நம்ம வாழ்க்கைல நுழஞ்சு இருக்குறது தான் கார்ப்பரேட் சொசைட்டி. அதுல எப்டி சர்வைவ் பன்றதுன்னு தான் இந்த புக் முழுக்க சொல்றாங்க. கார்ப்பரேட் ஜங்கிள். ஆமா, அது ஒரு காடு. மிகப் பெரிய காடு. அங்க பிழைக்கணும்னா முதுல்ல அங்க இருக்க எல்லா விலங்குகள் பத்தியும் நாம தெரிஞ்சிக்கணும். அப்போ தான் எத எப்டி சமாளிக்க முடியும் அப்டின்னு நமக்கு ஒரு க்ளாரிஃபை கிடைக்கும். இந்த விசயத்த தான் நமக்கு இந்த புக்ல சொல்றாரு ஆத்தர். வாங்க கார்ப்பரேட் ஜங்கிள்குள்ள போகலாம்.

detective-ragini-the-last-scream.title: Detective Ragini - The Last Scream
detective-ragini-the-last-scream.description:
“One house… four dead bodies… and a door locked from the inside!”
In Delhi, a case with no evidence and no witnesses—yet the deaths keep increasing.
Within three days, two more bodies are found… this is no longer just murder, but a terrifying game!
A clinic, a black SUV, a mysterious relationship, and a missing girl—all point toward a much bigger secret.
Will Detective Ragini uncover the truth… or will the case consume her too?

പണം-കൈകാര്യം-ചെയ്യാൻ-പഠിക്കാം---Budget-L.title: പണം കൈകാര്യം ചെയ്യാൻ പഠിക്കാം -  Budget Like A Pro
പണം-കൈകാര്യം-ചെയ്യാൻ-പഠിക്കാം---Budget-L.description: നിങ്ങൾ പണം കൈകാര്യം ചെയ്യുന്നതിൽ കൺഫ്യൂസ്ഡ് ആണോ? കൃത്യമായ ഒരു പ്ലാൻ ഇല്ലാതെയാണോ വരവ് ചിലവുകൾ? , അല്ലെങ്കിൽ സാമ്പത്തിക കാര്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് ഒട്ടും അറിവില്ലാത്ത ഒരു വ്യക്തിയാണോ? അങ്ങനെയെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഉറപ്പായും ഈ ഓഡിയോ കേട്ടിരിക്കണം...

amma-mugguru-monagallu.title: Amma Mugguru Monagallu
amma-mugguru-monagallu.description: భర్త లేకపోయినా, కుటుంబం తిరస్కరించినా, ఎన్నో అవమానాలు ఎదురుకున్న మహాలక్ష్మి   తన పిల్లల్ని ఆదర్శవంతంగా పెంచింది. ఆమె పెద్దకొడుకు ధర్మ – సీఈవో, చిన్నవాడు అర్జున్ – ఓ సాహసవంతమైన IPS ఆఫీసర్, దేవ్ – టాలీవుడ్ స్టార్.  వాళ్ళ అమ్మ ను తిరస్కరించిన వాళ్ళ బంధువులు మళ్లీ ఆమెను కలిసినప్పుడు ఏం జరిగింది? అమ్మకు కంచుకోటలా మారిన ఆ ముగ్గురు కొడుకులు ఏం చేశారో తెలియాలంటే, వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో సిరీస్ వినండి.

rejected-billionaire.title: Rejected Billionaire
rejected-billionaire.description: आदित्य शर्मा मैरिज रजिस्ट्रार ऑफिस में अपनी गर्लफ्रेंड सोनिया का इंतज़ार कर रहा था, लेकिन वह उसे छोड़कर एक अमीर आदमी के लिए चली जाती है। टूटे दिल वाले आदित्य से वहीं मौजूद CEO प्रीति शादी कर लेती है, अपनी असली अमीरी छुपाकर। एक दिन प्रीति को उसके लॉकेट से पता चलता है कि आदित्य दरअसल बचपन में खोया हुआ अरबपति परिवार का वारिस है। अब उसकी किस्मत पूरी तरह बदलने वाली है।

rrr-rebel-revenge-rise.title: RRR: Rebel, Revenge, Rise
rrr-rebel-revenge-rise.description: தாரா ஒரு successful business woman. அவள் வீட்டில் ஒரு கிழவனை திருமணம் செய்ய சொல்லி போர்ஸ் பண்ண வேறு வழியே இல்லாமல் contract marriage ஆக தன்னை திருமணம் செய்து கொள்ளுமாறு ஏழையாக நடிக்கும்  ஆதியிடம் கேட்கிறாள். ஆதி தன்னை பற்றிய உண்மையை சொல்லுவானா... தாராவை திருமணம் செய்வானா?

varasdaara.title: Varasdaara
varasdaara.description: ವಾರಸ್ದಾರ - ತಾಯಿಯ ಮಡಿಲಲ್ಲಿ ಆಡೋ ವಯಸಲ್ಲಿ ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾದ ಮಗನಿಗಾಗಿ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗೂ ಹಪಹಪಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ತಾಯಿ ಅಧೀರಾ. ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಕುಡಿಯಾದ್ರೂ ಯಾವುದರ ಅರಿವಿಲ್ಲದೇ ತನ್ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ತಾನು ಬದುಕು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡಿರೋ ಸಮರ್ಥ್. ಸಮರ್ಥ್‌ನ ಬುದ್ದಿವಂತಿಕೆಯನ್ನೇ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ತನ್ನ ಬೇಳೆ ಬೇಯಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ತಿರೋ ಅನಿಕಾ. ಅಧಿರಾ ಜೊತೆ ಇದ್ದೇ ಅವಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಪಿತೂರಿ ಮಾಡ್ತಿರೋ ಬಣ ಇದೆಲ್ಲದರ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ತಾಯಿ ಮಗ ಒಂದಾಗ್ತಾರಾ? ಅನಿಕಾಳ ಮೋಸ ಸಮರ್ಥ್‌ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತಾ? ಅಧಿರಾ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯಾಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮರ್ಥ್‌ ವಾರಸ್ದಾರನಾಗ್ತಾನಾ? ಮೈನವಿರೇಳಿಸೋ ತಾಯಿ ಮಗನ ಭಾಂಧವ್ಯದ ಕಥೆ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

dhokha-on-anniversary.title: Dhokha On Anniversary
dhokha-on-anniversary.description: Ananya’s world shatters when she catches her husband, Ishaan, cheating on their anniversary. Hoping he will change, she gives love another chance—but his betrayal continues. Heartbroken, Ananya disappears from his life. Even after finding her, Ishaan repeats his mistakes, forcing her to leave forever. When he finally realizes her worth, one question remains—has he lost her for good?

ipl-match-review.title: Sandeep Corner  IPL Match Preview & Review

the-brides-secret.title: The Bride's Betrayal
the-brides-secret.description: தன் குடும்பத்தின் விலை உயர்ந்த பொக்கிஷம் ஒன்றை தேடி அலைகிறான் ரிஷி ஓப்ராய்... அப்பொழுது எதிர்பாராத வகையில் தான் ஒன்சைடாக காதலித்த பெண் சாக்ஷியை ஆக்சன் ஒன்றை சந்திக்கின்றவன், அவளை தன்னுடைய பிஏவாக இருக்க சொல்கிறான். ஆனால் அவர்கள் ஒன்றாய் வேலையை ஆரம்பிக்கும் போது மறக்கப்பட்ட காதல் மேலே வர தொடங்குகிறது

gauna-with-bauna.title: Gauna With Bauna
gauna-with-bauna.description: बिहार की कुख्यात “पकड़वा शादी” की दुनिया में, जहां दूल्हों को अगवा कर जबरन शादी कराई जाती है, वहीं फंस जाता है पर्वत सिंह - एक ऐसा इंसान जिसे उसके बौने कद के कारण हमेशा मजाक और तानों का सामना करना पड़ा। एक ही रात में तीन-तीन शादियां होने के बाद, उसकी अपनी पत्नियां भी उसे अपनाने से इंकार कर देती हैं। हर कदम पर अपमान और ठुकराव झेलते हुए, क्या पर्वत खुद को साबित कर पाएगा या ये जबरन रिश्ता उसकी जिंदगी तबाह कर देगा?

ipl-2025-kuku-view-box.title: IPL- 2025 Kuku View Box
