ipl-2025-kuku-view-box.description: ഐ.പി.എൽ-2025, ക്രിക്കറ്റ് ലഹരിയുടെ 45 ദിനങ്ങൾ. ഇക്കുറി സഞ്ചുവിൻ്റെ  രാജ്സ്ഥാൻ റോയൽസോ, ധോണിയുടെ ചെന്നൈയോ, രോഹിത്തിൻ്റെ മുംബൈയോ, അതോ കോലിയുടെ റോയൽ ചലഞ്ചെഴ്സോ ആരാകും വിജയി. ഓരോരുത്തരുടെയും  സാധ്യതകളെയും പ്രകടനങ്ങളെയും ഇഴകീറി പരിശോധിക്കുന്ന വിലയിരുത്തലുകൾ കേൾക്കാം...എല്ലാ ദിവസവും...

rebirth-of-divorced-billionaire-wife.title: Rebirth of Divorced Billionaire Wife
rebirth-of-divorced-billionaire-wife.description: கோடீஸ்வரி என்கிற அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து சாதாரண பெண்ணாக வாழ்கிறாள் ஹரிணி. அவளை சாதாரண பெண் என நினைத்து மணந்த விக்ரம்! அக்ரிமெண்ட் திருமணம் காதலாக மாறுமா?

focus-midnight-library-lo-fi.title: Focus: Midnight Library Lo-Fi
focus-midnight-library-lo-fi.description: Calm Lo-Fi beats inspired by the quiet feeling of a midnight library, helping you focus deeply, stay relaxed, and study without distractions.

bigshot-mappillai.title: Bigshot mappillai
bigshot-mappillai.description: ஆதி தன்னுடைய அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து கொண்டு தன் மனைவி லிசாவின் வீட்டில் ஒரு சாதாரண ஆளாக நடித்து கொண்டிருக்கிறான். இது தெரியாமல் அவனை அனைவரும் அவமானப்படுத்த ஒரு நாள் ஆதியின் பணக்கார அடையாளம் தெரிய வருகிறது...

focus-alpha-wave-flow.title: Focus: Perfect Concentration
focus-alpha-wave-flow.description: Carefully balanced focus sounds designed to sharpen attention, reduce distractions, and help you stay fully concentrated for longer periods.

vishwak-returns.title: Vishwak Returns
vishwak-returns.description: తన కోసం వెయిట్ చేస్తున్న బిజినెస్ అఫీషియల్స్ ని కాదని విశ్వక్ ప్రేమ కోసం  పార్వతీపురం పోవాలని నిర్ణయించుకుంటాడు. తన స్థానంలో అరవింద్ ని అన్నీ చూస్కోమని చెప్పి వెళ్ళాడు. అయితే అతడి ప్రేమ  ఇన్నేళ్ళ తర్వాత కూడా తన కోసం ఎదురు చూస్తుందా? అక్కడికి వెళ్ళిన అతనికి ఏం తెలిసింది? అది తెలియాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో సిరీస్ వినండి.

the-happiness-story-1.title: The Happiness Story
the-happiness-story-1.description: സന്തോഷം നിങ്ങളും ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നില്ലേ? എന്നാൽ അതൊരു വിദൂര സ്വപ്നമായി മാറ്റിവെച്ചിരിക്കുകയാണോ? എങ്കിൽ ഇനി ഞങ്ങളുടെ കൂടെ കൂടാം.. ആ സ്വപ്നത്തിലേക്കുള്ള നിങ്ങളുടെ യാത്ര ഇവിടെ തുടങ്ങുകയാണ്...

focus-clockwork-arpeggios.title: Focus: Soft Patterns
focus-clockwork-arpeggios.description: Gentle repeating sounds and smooth rhythms that help calm the mind, improve focus, and support steady concentration.

ipl-cafe-sandeep.title: IPL Cafe Sandeep
ipl-cafe-sandeep.description: ఇక అసలైన క్రికెట్ ఫీవర్ మొదలైంది.! ఎవరు ఈ టీమ్ ఫేవరెట్ ఓ వాళ్లని సపోర్ట్ చేయడానికి రెడీ అయిపోతారు. ఇందులో మీరు మీ టీమ్ ఎంత స్ట్రాంగ్ గా ఉంది అనేది మన Sandeep మాటలో తెలుసుకోండి.!

billionaires-choice-2.title: Billionaire's Choice
billionaires-choice-2.description: പ്രീതിയ്ക്കും ആരവിനും ഗായത്രിയ്ക്കും  ഇടയിലെ ട്രയാംഗിൾ ലവ് സ്റ്റോറി ആണ് ഈ സീരീസ്.  പുതുമന കുടുംബത്തിലെ പിൻമുറക്കാരനായ ആരവിന്റെ കുടുംബസ്വത്തിലാണ് പ്രീതിയുടെ കണ്ണ് . എന്നാൽ ആരോരും അറിയാതെ ആരവിനെ തീവ്രമായി പ്രണയിക്കുന്നവളാണ് ഗായത്രി, അതിസമ്പന്നയായ ഗായത്രി  തന്റെ ഐഡന്റിറ്റി മറച്ചാണ് അവന് മുന്നിൽ വരുന്നത്. പണവും, പ്രണയവും, പ്രതികാരവും കൂടിക്കുഴയുന്ന ഉദ്ദ്വേഗ്ഗജനകമായ ഒരു പരമ്പര...

focus-gentle-momentum.title: Focus: Gentle Slow
focus-gentle-momentum.description: Soft, slow-paced focus music that creates a calm atmosphere, helping you concentrate without feeling overwhelmed.

varisu-slum-billionaire-returns.title: Varisu: Slum Billionaire Returns
varisu-slum-billionaire-returns.description: வாழ்வா சாவா என்றிருக்கும் அம்மாவை காப்பாற்ற தாத்தாவின் கண்டிஷனுக்கு உடன்படுகிறான் சிறுவயது நாயகன். விபத்தில் கடந்த காலத்தை மறந்து சாதாரணவனாக வாழ்ந்து வரும் நாயகனும், உயிர் பிழைத்தாலும் தன் மகனை தேடும் தாயின் பாசப்போராட்டம் ஒருபக்கம் என நகர்கிறது கதை. இருவரும் சந்திப்பார்களா?

maamannan-the-king-in-undercover.title: Maamannan : The King In Undercover
maamannan-the-king-in-undercover.description: Maraindho sendra Mannan. .. Meendum varuvan !!  Saadhi , kabadam , arasiyal aatangal soozhndha perrarasil , adhigaarathirkkaga yaar yaarai kondru viduvaargal ? aanal unmai perrarasu thirumbi vanthaal ... vilaivu enna ?

focus-synthwave-focus-grid.title: Focus: Intense Music
focus-synthwave-focus-grid.description: Powerful, high-energy focus music designed to boost motivation, sharpen concentration, and keep you locked into deep work sessions.

size-zero-seduction.title: Size zero seduction
size-zero-seduction.description: karthika romba kundana oru ponnu. avala panathukkaga love panratha nadicchu marriage panni yemaathuran karthik. Unmai therinjathum, manasodinju pora Karthika udaney than udal idaiyai kuraichu Size Zero va maarura. Athey neram karthikava, innoru handsome paiyan semaiya love panraan. Ipo thannai love panravanai Karthika yethuppala or ex purusana pali vaanguvaala?

focus-neural-network-pulse.title: Focus: Brain Pulse
focus-neural-network-pulse.description: Steady focus sounds and rhythmic pulses designed to boost concentration, mental clarity, and deep work sessions.

hrudaya-hrudaya.title: Hrudaya... Hrudaya...
hrudaya-hrudaya.description: ರಾಧಾ ತನ್ನ ಫಿಯಾನ್ಸೆ ಈಶ್ವರ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ಎಂಗೇಜ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್‌ನ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕೋತ್ಸವನಾ ಆಚರಿಸಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಫೈವ್‌-ಸ್ಟಾರ್‌ ಹೋಟೆಲ್‌ಗೆ ಬರ್ತಾಳೆ. ಈಶ್ವರ್‌ನ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವೈನ್‌ ಕುಡೀತಾ ವೇಟ್‌ ಮಾಡೋ ರಾಧಾಳಿಗೆ ಕುಡಿದಿದ್ದು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಕಂಟ್ರೋಲ್‌ ತಪ್ಪೋಗುತ್ತೆ. ಮೈ ಮರೆತು ನಿದ್ದೆಗೆ ಜಾರೋ ರಾಧಾಳಿಗೆ ಎಚ್ಚರವಾದಾಗ, ತಾನು ಬೇರೋಬ್ಬನ ರೂಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರೋದು ಗೊತ್ತಾಗಿ ಶಾಕ್‌ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಜೊತೆಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಫಿಯಾನ್ಸೆ ಈಶ್ವರ್‌ ಬೇರೋಬ್ಬಳ ಜೊತೆ ಮಲಗಿರೋದ್ನ ರೆಡ್‌ ಹ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಹಿಡಿಯೋ ರಾಧಾಳಿಗೆ ಆಕಾಶವೇ ಕಳಚಿ ತಲೆ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಹಾಗಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ರಾಧಾ ಜೊತೆ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಳೆದ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಯಾರು? ಈಶ್ವರ್‌ನ ಮೋಸಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಲುಕೋ ರಾಧಾಳ ಕಥೆಯೇನು? ಮೈನವಿರೇಳಿಸೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ಹೃದಯಾ... ಹೃದಯಾ..." ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

karnataka-kshetra.title: Karnataka Kshetra
karnataka-kshetra.description: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ, ತನ್ನ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ, ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಪರಂಪರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದ್ಭುತ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತವಾಗಿದೆ. "ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ" ಶೋ ಮೂಲಕ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು, ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಶಿಲ್ಪಕಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಮಹತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಪುರಾತನ ಹೋಯ್ಸಳ ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಅನಾವರಣವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ವೈಭವಶಾಲಿ ಬದಾಮಿ, ಪಟ್ಟದಕಲ್ಲು, ಹಂಪಿ, ಮುರುಡೇಶ್ವರ, ಧರ್ಮಸ್ಥಳ,  ಮತ್ತು ಮೈಸೂರು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳ ಕತೆಗಳು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸಲಿದೆ. ಈ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಯಾತ್ರೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಪ್ರಪಂಚವನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸಿ! KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ "ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ" ಶೋ ಕೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳ ದೈವೀ ಸತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

zen-singing-bowl-resonance.title: Zen: Sound Therapy
zen-singing-bowl-resonance.description: Relaxing therapeutic sounds designed to reduce stress, calm the mind, and support deep relaxation and emotional balance.

the-fate-of-rome.title: The Fate of Rome
the-fate-of-rome.description: ಕೈಲ್ ಹಾರ್ಪರ್ ಬರೆದಿರುವ ಕೃತಿ 'ದಿ ಫೇಟ್ ಆಫ್ ರೋಮ್'. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ರೋಮ್ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಪತನಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇವಲ ಯುದ್ಧಗಳೇ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ, ಹವಾಮಾನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಕ ರೋಗಗಳೂ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸಿದವು ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ಲೇಗ್, ಜ್ವರ, ಹಿಮಯುಗದ ತರಹದ ಹವಾಮಾನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯಾಗಿ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯವನ್ನು ದುರ್ಬಲ ಮಾಡಿತು. ಇವೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನು ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ, ಮತ್ತು ಡಿಎನ್‌ಎ ರಿಸರ್ಚ್‌ ಮೂಲಕ ಅರ್ಥೈಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಲೇಖಕರು. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬೈಟ್ಸ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

dancing-in-the-street.title: Dancing in the Street
dancing-in-the-street.description: ನೃತ್ಯ ಒಂದು ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕಲೆ. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕವಾಗಿ ಡ್ಯಾನ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ ಏನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಉಪಯೋಗಗಳಿವೆ ಗೊತ್ತಾ? ಹಿಂದಿನ‌ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ಸವಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ನೃತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನ ಜನ ಪಾಲ್ಗೊಳ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದದ್ದು ಯಾಕೆ? ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾಗಿ ನೃತ್ಯ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಬದಿಗಿಟ್ಟು, ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಯಾಕೆ ಡ್ಯಾನ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಡ್ಯಾನ್ಸಿಂಗ್ ಇನ್ ದಿ ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಟ್' ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬೈಟ್ಸ್.

zen-432hz-healing-aura.title: Zen: Healing Sounds
zen-432hz-healing-aura.description: Gentle healing sounds that calm the mind, relax the body, and create a peaceful space for rest, balance, and inner healing.

the-lincoln-conspiracy.title: The Lincoln Conspiracy
the-lincoln-conspiracy.description: ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಅಬ್ರಹಾಂ ಲಿಂಕನ್' ಹೆಸರು ಜನಪ್ರಿಯವಾದುದು. ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷರಾಗಿದ್ದ ಲಿಂಕನ್ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೇಗೆ ಷಡ್ಯಂತ್ರ ನಡೆದಿತ್ತು? ಹಾಗೂ ಅವರ ಹತ್ಯೆಗೆ ಸಂಚು ರೂಪಿಸಿದ್ದರ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಮರ್ಮವೇನು ಅನ್ನೋದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ 'ಬ್ರಾಡ್ ಮೆಲ್ಟ್ಝರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಜೋಷ್ ಮೆನ್ಷ್' ತಮ್ಮ ಕೃತಿಯಾದ 'ದಿ ಲಿಂಕನ್ ಕಾನ್ಸ್ಪಿರಸಿ' ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಬುಕ್ ಬೈಟ್ಸ್ ಕೇಳಿ.

the-art-of-simple-living.title: The Art of Simple Living
the-art-of-simple-living.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಧ್ಯೇಯ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಾಗೋ ಬದುಕೋದು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಇಂದು ಶಾಂತಿಯನ್ನ ಬಿಟ್ಟು, ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಬದುಕು ಸಿಕ್ಕಾಪಟ್ಟೆ ಬ್ಯುಸಿ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರ ಕಥೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಜೀವನ ತುಂಬಾ ಸಿಂಪಲ್‌. ಅದನ್ನ ಜೀವಿಸೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದ್ರೆ, ಬದುಕು ಬ್ಯೂಟಿಫುಲ್ ಕೂಡ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕಿ, ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಿಂದ ಇರೋದು? ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಉತ್ತರ 'ಆರ್ಟ್ ಆಫ್ ಸಿಂಪಲ್‌‌ ಲಿವಿಂಗ್' ಬುಕ್. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ಬೈಟ್ಸ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಕೇಳಿ.

zen-vinyasa-sun-salutation.title: Zen: Surya Namaskaar
zen-vinyasa-sun-salutation.description: Peaceful Zen sounds inspired by the rhythm of Surya Namaskaar, helping you stay focused, balanced, and energized during practice.

billionaire-husband.title: Billionaire Husband
billionaire-husband.description: 'ವಿರಾಟ್' ಒಬ್ಬ ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್.! ಆಗರ್ಭ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಮಡದಿ 'ಅನು' ಜೊತೆ ಸಿಂಪಲ್ ಲೈಫ್ ನಡೆಸ್ತಿರ್ತಾನೆ. ಅನುಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಗಂಡ ಬಡವನಾಗಿದ್ರೂ, ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ರಾಜ ಅನ್ನೋ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ. ಇಂಥ ಅನುರಾಗ ಆಗ್ಲೇ ಕೆಲವರ ಕಣ್ಣು ಕುಕ್ಕೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಶುರುವಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ! ಇದು ವಿರಾಟ್ ಕೊಲೆಯ ಸಂಚಿಗೆ, ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಡಿವೋರ್ಸ್ ಹುನ್ನಾರಕ್ಕೂ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ವಿರಾಟ್ ಇಂಥ ಅಜ್ಞಾತವಾಸ ಮಾಡ್ತಿರೋದರ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಉದ್ದೇಶವೇನು? ಅನು ಈ ವಿಚಾರ ತಿಳಿದ್ರೆ ಏನ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಳೆ? ವಿರಾಟ್ ಈ ಸವಾಲನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ಎದುರಿರ್ಸಾನೆ? ಕೇಳಿ ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಟ್ರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ 'ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್ ಹಸ್ಬೆಂಡ್'. ಓನ್ಲಿ ಆನ್ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ.

zen-restorative-yoga-waves.title: Zen: Relaxing Waves
zen-restorative-yoga-waves.description: Soothing wave-like Zen sounds that calm the mind, ease stress, and create a peaceful atmosphere for relaxation and meditation.

the-confidence-project-2.title: The Confidence Project
the-confidence-project-2.description: The Confidence Project என்பது தனிப்பட்ட வளர்ச்சியை ஊக்குவிக்கும் மற்றும் நம்பிக்கையை உருவாக்கும் வழிமுறைகளை வழங்கும் ஒரு மாற்றமளிக்கும் ஆடியோபுத்தகம். இது, நம்பிக்கையின் உளவியலையும், முடிவெடுக்கும்முறைகளையும் ஆராய்ந்து, சுயநம்பிக்கையை மேம்படுத்த உதவும் நடைமுறை உத்திகளை வழங்குகிறது. மேலும், சமூகத்தில் நம்பிக்கையின் தாக்கத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தும் ஊக்கமளிக்கும் கதைகளைப் பகிர்கிறது.

top-secrets-for-business-and-life.title: Top Secrets for Business and Life
top-secrets-for-business-and-life.description: ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯುವವರ ಗುಪ್ತ ತಂತ್ರಗಳು ನಿಮಗೂ ತಿಳಿದರೆ ಹೇಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ? "ಟಾಪ್ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ಸ್ ಫಾರ್ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಅಂಡ್ ಲೈಫ್" ಶೋ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ದಾರಿಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯುವಂತಹ ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕ ಮತ್ತು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವ ವಿಕಾಸ, ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ತಂತ್ರಗಳು, ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ, ಮತ್ತು ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ಸ್ – ಇದನ್ನು ನಿಖರವಾದ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಈ ಶೋ ನಿಮಗೆ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಸಲಹೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಧಾರಣದಿಂದ ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ ಆಗುವ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರಿಯಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸಿ! ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ದಾರಿ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಿರುವವರಿಗಾಗಿ ಈ ಶೋ ಒಂದು ಗೈಡ್! ಇಂದೇ KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಹಂತಕ್ಕೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗಿ!

sleep-nursery-lo-fi.title: Sleep: Baby Sleep Lo-Fi
sleep-nursery-lo-fi.description: A soothing lo-fi soundscape with soft beats and warm tones, perfect for calming babies and supporting peaceful sleep.

rrr-13.title: RRR
rrr-13.description: సంజయ్ తన గర్ల్ ఫ్రెండ్ లాస్యను చదివించడానికి ఎన్నో లేబర్ పనులు చేస్తాడు. అతని వల్లే మంచి యూనివర్సిటీలో సీట్ తెచ్చుకుని, అతని వల్లే పెద్ద కంపెనీలో జాబ్ తెచ్చుకుంది లాస్య. అయితే జాబ్ వచ్చాక లేబర్ అయిన సంజయ్ ని పెళ్ళి చేసుకోవడం ఆమెకు ఇష్టం లేకపోయింది. ఆల్రెడీ సంజయ్ తో ఎంగేజ్ మెంట్ అయినప్పటికీ అతన్ని వదిలించుకోవాలనుకుంది.   అప్పుడే సంజయ్ జీవితంలో అద్భుతం జరిగింది. ఆ అద్భుతం వల్ల సంజయ్ జీవితంలో చాలా మార్పులు వచ్చాయి. అప్పుడు లాస్య ఏంం చేసింది? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి ఆర్ ఆర్ ఆర్ .. మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో..

ugadi.title: ఉగాది - రాశులు - విశేషాలు
ugadi.description: ఉగాది కొత్త ఆశల ప్రారంభం! ఇది తెలుగు నూతన సంవత్సర ఉత్సవం, సంప్రదాయాలను, పంచాంగ శ్రవణాన్ని, మరియు ఉగాది పచ్చడిని జ్ఞాపకం చేసుకునే ప్రత్యేక రోజు. ఈ ఉత్సవం జీవితంలో శుభారంభం, విజయాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది.

sleep-embers-and-starlight.title: Sleep: Starry Night
sleep-embers-and-starlight.description: Sleep music that feels like resting under the stars. Soft, soothing sounds help your mind settle and make falling asleep easier.

anjathae-anju.title: Anjathae Anju
anjathae-anju.description: கொலை செய்தாலும் கடும் சட்டத்தையும் ஏமாற்ற முடியும் என முடிவு செய்த தொழிலதிபர்! அவரை பிடிக்க சி.பி.ஐ. அதிகாரி விவேக் மற்றும் ரூபாலா தொடுக்கும் பதறவைக்கும் விசாரணை!

మలుపు-.title: మలుపు
మలుపు-.description: టాప్ బిజినెస్ మేన్ అయిన ధనుంజయ్ వర్మ, తన కొడుకు పెళ్ళిని ఘనంగా చేయాలని అన్ని ఏర్పాట్లు చేస్తాడు. పెళ్లికి ముందురోజున దిలీప్ రూపం మారిపోతుంది? అలా జరగడానికి కారణమేంటి? మారిపోయిన రూపంతో దిలీప్ ఏం చేసాడు? అతన్నే పెళ్ళి చేసుకుందామనుకున్న ప్రియాంక పరిస్థితి ఏంటి? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి ఫాంటసీ థ్రిల్లర్ మలుపు మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో..

breathing-zen-4-7-8-oxygen-flow.title: Breathing Zen: Breathing Balance
breathing-zen-4-7-8-oxygen-flow.description: Breathing Zen: Breathe in for 4, hold for 7, and exhale for 8; creating a slow, controlled rhythm that promotes deep relaxation and balance.

get-intimate-with-tantric-sex.title: Get Intimate with Tantric Sex
get-intimate-with-tantric-sex.description:
Sex ன்றது நிஜமாவே ஒரு கெட்ட வார்த்தையா? சத்தியமா இல்லங்க… இத சரியா பண்ண தெரியாம இந்த சமூகத்துல எத்தனையோ பேரு முழுசா உணர்ச்சிய பூர்த்தி பண்ணாமலே சுத்திட்டு இருக்காங்க தெரியுமா? வெளிய சொன்னா அவமானம்னு நினைச்சுக்கிட்டு அத சொல்லவும் மாட்டாங்க. இப்டி முழுமை அடையாமலயே ஒரு நாள் மரணிச்சும் போயிடுவாங்க. இதையெல்லாம் தாண்டி 100 வீதம் intimacy life ல திருப்தியா இருக்குற ஜோடிகள் ஒரு சிலர் மட்டும் தான்.

நீங்களும் அந்த ஒரு சிலர்ல ஒரு ஜோடியா இருக்கணும்னு நினைச்சீங்கன்னா, வாங்க நண்பர்களே… இந்த புத்தகம் உங்களுக்காக தான்.

IPL-2025-ഇതിഹാസത്തിൻ്റെ-വിടവാങ്ങൽ-വേദിയോ.title: IPL- 2025 ഇതിഹാസത്തിൻ്റെ വിടവാങ്ങൽ വേദിയോ?
IPL-2025-ഇതിഹാസത്തിൻ്റെ-വിടവാങ്ങൽ-വേദിയോ.description: ഇന്ത്യൻ പ്രിമിയർ ലീഗിൻ്റെ പതിനെട്ടാം പതിപ്പിനു, 2025, മാർച്ച് 22 നു കൊൽക്കത്തയിൽ തുടക്കമാകുമ്പോൾ ഇക്കുറിയും ആരാധകർ ഏറ്റവും അധികം ഉയർത്തുന്ന ചോദ്യം എം. എസ്. ധോണി എന്ന അതികായൻ്റെ റിട്ടയർമെൻ്റിനെ കുറിച്ചാണു. ഐ.പി.എൽ എന്ന ഷോ ഗെയിൽ എൻ്റർടെയിന്മെൻ്റിലെ ഏറ്റവും വിലപിടിപ്പുളള സമാനതകളില്ലാത്ത ബ്രാൻഡാണു ഢോണി എന്നിരിക്കെ ആ ചോദ്യം തികച്ചും ന്യായമാണു. തൻ്റെ നാല്പതുകളിൽ എത്തിയ ഈ ക്രിക്കറ്റ് ഇതിഹാസം വീണ്ടും അങ്കത്തട്ടിൽ ഇറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ പുതുചരിത്രം പിറക്കുമോ എന്ന് ആരാധകർ ഉറ്റു നോക്കുന്നു..

breathing-zen-prana-pulse.title: Breathing Zen: Inner Flow
breathing-zen-prana-pulse.description: Breathing Zen: Breathe gently and without pause, letting your breath flow softly through the body, creating a sense of ease and balance.

ദേവി-മാഹാത്മ്യം-.title: ദേവി മാഹാത്മ്യം
ദേവി-മാഹാത്മ്യം-.description: ശ്രോതാക്കൾക്ക് ആത്മപ്രചോദനവും ആത്മീയ ഉണർവും നൽകുന്ന ദുർഗാദേവിയുടെ വിവിധ രൂപങ്ങളേയും അവയുടെ ഉത്ഭവകഥകളും, അസുരനിഗ്രഹ കഥകളും അടങ്ങുന്നതാണു ദേവി മാഹാത്മ്യം... ശക്തിയുടേയും ധർമ്മത്തിന്റെയും കഥകളുമായി തിന്മയുടെ മേൽ നന്മയുടെ വിജയക്കൊടി പാറിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുള്ള ഭക്തിസാന്ദ്രമായ ഒരു യാത്ര... കേൾക്കൂ...

breathing-zen-coherence-pacing.title: Breathing Zen: Rhythmic Breathing
breathing-zen-coherence-pacing.description: Breathing Zen: Just breathe at a steady, balanced pace, helping the heart and breath sync into a calm, coherent rhythm.

naa-rakshasi.title: Naa Rakshasi
naa-rakshasi.description: ప్రతి ఒక్క అబ్బాయి జీవితంలోకి ఒక అందాల రాక్షసి వస్తుంది.  ఆమె వస్తూనే, మన హీరో సూర్య జీవితంలో పెను మార్పులను తీసుకొచ్చింది. అప్పటిదాకా అల్లరి చిల్లరిగా తిరిగే అతడి పర్సనాలిటీని పూర్తిగా మార్చేసే మంత్రం ఆమె సొంతం. ఇంతకీ ఆ అందాల రాక్షసి ఎవరు? ఎలా సూర్య జీవితాన్ని మార్చింది? తెలియాలంటే వినండి "నా రాక్షసి" సూపర్ గుడ్ లవ్ స్టోరీ మీ కుకులో

mangalam.title: Mangalam
mangalam.description: పుట్టుకతో వచ్చిన లింగాన్ని కాదని, మనసు కోరుకున్న జీవనాన్ని ఎన్నుకోవడానికి ధైర్యం కావాలి! ఇది మంగళం అనే ఒక ట్రాన్స్ జెండర్ కథ. సామాజిక అణచివేత, కుట్రలు, కబ్జాదారుల దాడి… ఇలా ఎన్ని సమస్యలు వచ్చినా  ఆమె వెనక్కి తగ్గదు. తమ హక్కుల కోసం, తమ అస్తిత్వం కోసం, సమాజం తోనే పోరాడిన ధైర్యశాలి ఆమె. ఈ కథలో ఆవేదన ఉంది… ప్రతిఘటన ఉంది… కానీ అన్నింటినీ మించి ఒక గొప్ప గెలుపు ఉంది! ఆమె ఎలా గెలిచిందో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వెంటనే వినండి ‘Mangalam’ – ఒక శక్తివంతమైన కథ!

breathing-zen-diaphragm-expansion.title: Breathing Zen: Deep Breathing
breathing-zen-diaphragm-expansion.description: Breathing Zen:  Just focus on slow, deep breaths that gently expand the diaphragm, allowing the lungs to fully open and relax the body.

magical-mane-aliya.title: Magical Mane Aliya
magical-mane-aliya.description: ಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವಂತ ಮಗಳ ಮದುವೆಯನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು! ಒಂದು ರಹಸ್ಯಭರಿತ ಹಳೆಯ ಮಾಯಾ ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆ, ಒಂದು ಮದುವೆ ಅದು ಕೇವಲ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಪರಿಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲ, ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ಕೆಟ್ಟ  ಶಕ್ತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವೂ ಹೌದು! ನಾಗಿನಿಯ ವಕ್ರ ದೃಷ್ಟಿ —ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಗೆ  ಗೆಲುವಾಗುತ್ತದೋ, ಅಥವಾ ನಾಗಿನಿಯ ಶಾಪ ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಅಂತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಬರೆಯುತ್ತದೋ? ದರ್ಪಣ ದ್ವಾರದ ಆಚೆ ಇರುವ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಬಹಿರಂಗವಾದಾಗ ಏನಾಗಬಹುದು? ಅಕ್ಷರಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ್ ಯಾವತ್ತಿಗೂ  ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಒಂದಾಗಲಾರರೇ? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್  "ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕಲ್ ಮನೆ ಅಳಿಯ" ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

aa-aaa.title: Pelli Roju Petakulu (A AA)
aa-aaa.description: కొన్ని రోజుల్లో అలేఖ్యను పెళ్ళి చేసుకోబోతున్న ఆనంద్, ఆగమేఘాల మీద ఎయిర్ పోర్ట్ చేరుకుని ఒకమ్మాయిని కలుసుకున్నాడు. ఆమెను కలిసిన తర్వాత ఆనంద్ జీవితం మారిపోయింది. మరోవైపు అలేఖ్య చేసిన పనివల్ల ఆనంద్ అక్క అమృతకు మిస్ క్యారేజ్ అవుతుంది. అసలు అలేఖ్య ఎందుకలా చేసింది?  ఇప్పుడు ఆనంద్ ఏం చేస్తాడు? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి అ. ఆ .. మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

station-wala-ishq.title: Station Wala Ishq
station-wala-ishq.description: एक भीड़भाड़ वाले रेलवे स्टेशन पर, भागती हुई दुल्हन आरोही एक अनजान कुली आर्यन पर बंदूक तानकर उससे शादी करने को मजबूर कर देती है। लेकिन ये कुली असल में एक बड़े डायमंड एम्पायर का वारिस है, जो अपनी पहचान छुपाकर एक कीमती हीरे के साथ भाग रहा है। दुश्मन उसके पीछे हैं, और इसी बीच उनका मजबूरी वाला रिश्ता धीरे-धीरे प्यार में बदलने लगता है—पर क्या ये सच सामने आने के बाद भी टिक पाएगा?

fell-in-love-with-bar-girl.title: Fell in love with Bar girl
fell-in-love-with-bar-girl.description: Handsome business man adhitya avan lover rosy mela semma love va irukkaan. ana ava adhitya oru aambalaiye illainnu solli innoruthan kooda serthu cheat pannidura. ithala depress aagura adhitya bar la dance aadura ponnu kooda one day night onna irukkaan. aana antha oru naal palakkam vaalnaal uruvaa maaruna? melum therinjukka kathaiya kelunga.

നാഗമുഖി.title: നാഗമുഖി
നാഗമുഖി.description: കേരളത്തിലെ നാഗപൂജയും നാഗാരാധനയുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട വിശ്വാസങ്ങളിലൂടെ ഉടലെടുക്കുന്ന പ്രണയ– മാന്ത്രിക നോവൽ. മലയാള ജനപ്രിയ നോവലുകളുടെ നിരയിൽ സ്ഥാനമുറപ്പിച്ച മെഴുവേലി ബാബുജിയുടെ ആരാധകപ്രശംസ നേടിയ രചന. കേൾക്കൂ...

doctor-vs-190min.title: Doctor vs 190 min
doctor-vs-190min.description: Ek minister ki jaan bachane ke liye heart transplant sirf 190 minutes mein karna hai. Dr. Nihal, ek controversial surgeon, iss mission ki last hope hai. Journey ke dauraan ego, power aur betrayal ka dangerous game shuru ho jata hai jab Kamya aur Kabir situation ko aur bigaad dete hain. Kya Nihaal Minister ki jaan bachaa paega?

തനിയേ.title: Billionaire's Ex Wife
തനിയേ.description: തൻ്റെ വിവാഹ വാർഷിക ദിനം, ഭർത്താവ് രോഹൻ അയാളുടെ  പി.എ സാന്ദ്രക്കൊപ്പം കിടക്ക പങ്കിടുന്നത് കാണേണ്ടി വന്ന ഹതഭാഗ്യ ആണു നിരുപമ. താൻ വഞ്ചിക്കപ്പെടുകയായിരുന്നു എന്ന തിരിച്ചറിവിൽ അവൾ വാവാഹമോചനത്തിനു നിർബന്ധിതയാകുന്നു. എന്നാൽ നിരുപമ എം.എഫ് ഗ്രൂപ്പ് എന്ന കോർപ്പറേറ്റ് ബിസിനസ്സ് സാമ്രാജ്യത്തിൻ്റെ അധിപയാണെന്ന സത്യം വൈകിയാണു രോഹൻ തിരിച്ചറിയുന്നതോടെ  ചതിയും, പകയും, പ്രണയവും കൂടി കലരുന്ന ഉദ്വേഗജനകമായ സംഭവപരമ്പരക്ക് തുടക്കമാകുന്നു..

genius-vs-billionaire-boss.title: Genius Vs Billionaire Boss
genius-vs-billionaire-boss.description:
When India’s air defense system was hacked by an enemy nation, even the country’s top cybersecurity company failed to stop the attack. But a seemingly ordinary maintenance staff member, SAMEER, used his hidden coding skills not only to neutralize the threat but to completely destroy the enemy’s offensive system.

However, instead of rewarding SAMEER for his gallant effort, the new boss ARNAV decides to sabotage his career!
Will Sameer be able to defeat Arnav and rise again?

foragers-farmers-and-fossil-fuels.title: Foragers, Farmers and Fossil Fuels
foragers-farmers-and-fossil-fuels.description: ಐನ್ ಮೋರಿಸ್ ಅವರ "Foragers, Farmers and Fossil Fuels" ಮಾನವ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ವಿಕಾಸವನ್ನು ಆಹಾರ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಬಳಕೆ ಎಂಬ ಕೋನದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುವ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಕೃತಿ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ, ಮೋರಿಸ್ ಮಾನವ ಸಮಾಜದ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುವ ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯವರೆಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಶಕ್ತಿಯು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕ ಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಜನಾಂಗ, ಲಿಂಗ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳು ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ ಏಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನದಿಂದ ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥೈಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆಧುನಿಕ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಮುಂದಿನ ದಿಕ್ಕು ಏನಾಗಬಹುದು ಎಂಬ ವಿಚಾರವನ್ನು ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿ ಅನಾಲಿಸಿಸ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬೈಟ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

kadhalika-neram-illai-season-2.title: Kadhalika Neram Illai Season 2
kadhalika-neram-illai-season-2.description: 💔  Kaadhalikka Neram illaama suthittu irukkura Business man Vishal - Romantic kaa vaazhanum nu nenaikira vandhana, Ivanga rendu perukkum idaila nadakkura Kadhalum Modhalum konda Kalakkalaana Kadhal Kathai thaan "kadhalikka Neram Illai". Indha kathai la Yaar Jeyikka Poraa Vishal la? illa Vandhana va?

tech-titans-of-china.title: Tech Titans of China
tech-titans-of-china.description: Tech Titans of China by Rebecca Fannin explores the rise of China’s boldest entrepreneurs and the tech giants reshaping the global economy. From startup hustle to billion-dollar empires, this audiobook reveals the ambition, strategy, innovation, and political landscape powering China’s digital revolution. A must-listen for founders, investors, and anyone curious about the future of global technology.

the-book-of-joy-3.title: The Book of Joy
the-book-of-joy-3.description:
The Book of Joy: Lasting Happiness in a Changing World என்பது தலாய் லாமா மற்றும் ஆர்க்பிஷப் டெஸ்மண்ட் டுட்டு ஆகியோரால் டக்ளஸ் அபிராம்ஸுடன் இணைந்து எழுதப்பட்ட ஒரு ஆழமான மற்றும் ஊக்கமளிக்கும் படைப்பாகும். இந்த புத்தகம், இரு ஆன்மீக தலைவர்களுக்கிடையே நடந்த ஒரு வார கால சந்திப்பை ஆவணப்படுத்துகிறது, அங்கு அவர்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் தவிர்க்க முடியாத துன்பங்கள் மற்றும் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டாலும், உண்மையான மகிழ்ச்சியின் இயல்பை ஆராய்கின்றனர்.

இந்த புத்தகம் மன்னிப்பு, நன்றியுணர்வு, கருணை மற்றும் உறுதிப்பாடு போன்ற கருப்பொருள்களை ஆராய்கிறது, அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையில் மகிழ்ச்சியை வளர்க்கும் வழிகளில் நடைமுறை ஞானம் மற்றும் புரிதல்களை வழங்குகிறது. இது தனிப்பட்ட கதைகள், ஆன்மீக போதனைகள் மற்றும் அறிவியல் ஆராய்ச்சியை இணைத்து, மகிழ்ச்சியைப் பற்றிய ஒரு முழுமையான பார்வையை வழங்குகிறது.

മനസ്സിനെ-വരുതിയിലാക്കാം---Dopamine-Detox.title: മനസ്സിനെ വരുതിയിലാക്കാം -  Dopamine Detox
മനസ്സിനെ-വരുതിയിലാക്കാം---Dopamine-Detox.description: Thettaya sheelangalum amitha uthejanavum ningalude shredhaye vazhithettikkunnuvo? 48 manikkoorinullil ningalude manassinte niyanthranam thirike nedoo, Dopomine Detoxinte sahayathode! Kuranja uthejanavum kooduthal shredhayum nedan shasthreeyamayi theliyicha margangal ithil kandetham.

ek-shadi-sau-tamashe.title: Ek Shadi Sau Tamashe
ek-shadi-sau-tamashe.description:
Siya apne bhai ki shaadi ke liye Mumbai se Goa ja rahi thi—khushiyon se bhara ek safar.

Lekin flight mein Bela ki zid ne sab kuch badal diya. Ek pal mein yeh safar khaufnaak hadse mein badal gaya, jahan Siya ki zindagi khatre mein pad gayi.

Kya Siya bach payegi?

Janne ke liye suniye: "Ek Shadi Sau Tamashe"

my-mysterious-husband.title: My Mysterious Husband
my-mysterious-husband.description: കഥക്ക്  രോഗിയായ അമ്മയെ രക്ഷിക്കേണ്ടതുണ്ട്,  പണത്തിനു വേണ്ടി തൻ്റെ അച്ഛൻ സഞ്ജയ് മേനോനു മുന്നിൽ അവൾ കൈ നീട്ടിയെങ്കിലും അതിനു രണ്ടാനമ്മ ഗൗതമിയും അമ്മയും സഹോദരിയും മുന്നോട്ട് വെച്ച നിബന്ധന ഒരു കഠിന പരീക്ഷ ആയിരുന്നു—കുറ്റവാളിയായ നീരജ് വർമ്മയെ വിവാഹം കഴിക്കുക! മനസ്സില്ലാ മനസ്സോടെ  കഥ അതിനു തയ്യാറാകുന്നു,  അവളുടെ ഭാവി എന്താകും? എന്താണു സഞ്ജയുടെ ലക്ഷ്യം? അറിയാൻ കേൾക്കൂ ‘My Mysterious Husband’!"

why-i-am-a-hindu-1.title: Why I am a Hindu
why-i-am-a-hindu-1.description: ಶಶಿ ತರೂರ್ ಅವರ "Why I Am a Hindu" ಒಂದು ಆಳವಾದ ವೈಚಾರಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಅಧ್ಯಯನವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಹಿಂದೂ ಧರ್ಮದ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳು, ಅದರ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಪರಂಪರೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಿಷ್ಣುತೆಯ ತತ್ವಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಚಿತ್ರಣ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವರು ವ್ಯಾಸ, ಉಪನಿಷತ್, ಶಂಕರಾಚಾರ್ಯ, ರಾಮಾನುಜ, ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ವಿವೇಕಾನಂದರಂತಹ ಮಹಾನ್ ಚಿಂತಕರಿಂದ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ಪಡೆಯುವಂತೆ ಓದುಗರನ್ನು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇದಲ್ಲದೆ, ತರೂರ್ ಆಧುನಿಕ ರಾಜಕೀಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದೂತ್ವದ ಬೇರುಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗಿವೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗಂಭೀರವಾದ ಚರ್ಚೆ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಧರ್ಮದ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು, ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕಲಿಯಲು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬೈಟ್ಸ್  ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ !

tere-bin-kaise-jiya.title: Tere bin kaise Jiya
tere-bin-kaise-jiya.description: A brilliant businessman chooses to live a quiet life as a house husband, hiding his true identity from the world. But when he discovers that the people he trusted the most—his wife, family, and closest allies—have betrayed him, everything changes. Love turns into deception, loyalty into ambition, and a silent man into a dangerous strategist. Now he must rise again to reclaim his power, rebuild his empire, and prove that the king they ignored was never truly defeated.

holi-holika-rakshasiya-kathe.title: Holi: Holika Rakshasiya Kathe
holi-holika-rakshasiya-kathe.description: ಹೊಲಿಕಾ ರಾಕ್ಷಸಿಯ ಕಥೆ ಸತ್ಯ ಬೆಂಕಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಡುವ ಕಥೆಯಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಆದ್ರೆ ಅದು ಶಕ್ತಿ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರೋಹದ ಕಥೆಯೂ ಆಗಿದೆ! ವಿಕ್ರಂ ತನ್ನ ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಬರೆಯುವ ಡೈರಿಯ ಪುಟಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಒಂದು ಅನ್ವೇಷಣಾ ಪ್ರಯಾಣವನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಇದು ಹೋಳಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ನಂಬಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ನಡುಗಿಸಿ ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀವು ಸಹ ಹೋಳಿ:"ಹೋಲಿಕಾ ರಾಕ್ಷಸಿ ಕಥೆ" ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆ ಸತ್ಯವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ, ಇದು ಯಾರೂ ನಿಮಗೆ ಈ ಹಿಂದೆ ಹೇಳಿರದ ಕಥೆ, ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FMಅಲ್ಲಿ.

your-brain-explained.title: Your Brain, Explained.
your-brain-explained.description: மனித மூளை எவ்வாறு செயல்படுகிறது என்ற எளிமையான விளக்கம்....

billionaire-boyfriend-ka-badla-1.title: Billionaire Boyfriend Ka Badla
billionaire-boyfriend-ka-badla-1.description:
Aaliya Thapar, the sharp and powerful CEO of Flywing Airlines, suddenly finds herself trapped in a situation where she urgently needs a ready-made husband to get out of trouble. At that moment, her eyes fall on Shaurya Bansal, a flight steward standing nearby, and without wasting a second, she offers him the role of her fake husband.

But Aaliya has no idea that the man she thinks is just an ordinary steward…
is actually the “Sky King” — the most mysterious and powerful figure in the airline industry.

the-great-influenza.title: The Great Influenza
the-great-influenza.description: ಜಾನ್ ಎಮ್ ಬೇರಿ ಅವರ "The Great Influenza" ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಭಾವಶಾಲಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಆಳವಾದ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ, 1918ರ ಮಹಾಮಾರಿ - ಸ್ಪ್ಯಾನಿಷ್ ಫ್ಲೂ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಾನವ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಮಾರಕ ಮತ್ತು ಭಯಾನಕ ರೋಗಬಾಧೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದ್ದ ಈ ಮಹಾಮಾರಿ, ಕೋಟ್ಯಂತರ ಜನರ ಜೀವಕ್ಕೆ ಅಪಾಯ ತಂದಿತ್ತು. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಪ್ರಗತಿ, ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ವಿಕಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಶಸ್ತ್ರಚಿಕಿತ್ಸಾ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನಗಳು ಈ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಸಾಂಕ್ರಾಮಿಕ ರೋಗವನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸಿದವು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ, ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನವ ಸಹನೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ಕೋವಿಡ್-19 ಸಾಂಕ್ರಾಮಿಕದ ಬೆನ್ನಿಗೇ, ಪಾಂಡಮಿಕ್‌ಗಳ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಿಂದ ಪಾಠ ಕಲಿಯಲು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ!

ek-poora-jeevan-ghar-kaam-aur-hamara-kal.title: Ek Poora Jeevan : Ghar, Kaam Aur Hamara Kal
ek-poora-jeevan-ghar-kaam-aur-hamara-kal.description: My Life in Full tells the inspiring journey of Indra Nooyi, one of the world’s most influential business leaders. From her childhood in India during the 1960s to studying at Yale School of Management and rising to the highest levels of global corporate leadership, this audiobook explores the experiences that shaped her vision, resilience, and success. Alongside professional achievements, it also reveals the emotional and personal struggles behind her remarkable journey.

my-dad-the-real-hero.title: My Daddy Dabang
my-dad-the-real-hero.description:
Raj is a simple janitor and a caring father, but secretly he is the powerful and mysterious “Raja Sahib,” feared by criminals and respected by the biggest business leaders.

When rich businesswoman Sara falls in love with him, Raj hides his true identity while protecting his family from dangerous enemies and underworld threats.

But one day, the world discovers that the poor man they insulted is actually the most powerful man in the room

gold-ghost-guardian.title: Gold. Ghost. Guardian
gold-ghost-guardian.description: A widowed gold magnate enters a contract marriage with a man she believes is a broken ex-convict to protect her daughter and failing empire. When powerful gold syndicates threaten her business and child, a hidden truth emerges her husband is a feared, erased force from the past. As their marriage turns real, he unleashes his true identity to protect his family and reclaim power.

88fc16e9-3b26-45ce-aae9-e95618b35dd9.title: Singham Daddy
88fc16e9-3b26-45ce-aae9-e95618b35dd9.description: A feared ex-convict returns after a decade in prison to save his estranged daughter from a life of abuse, but as he battles her tormentors, he must also overcome her hatred and the haunting consequences of his own violent past.

redflag-wala-pyaar.title: Redflag Wala Pyaar
redflag-wala-pyaar.description: Wani’s world shatters when she discovers that Shekhar Pratap Singh, the powerful mafia-politician she loves — is secretly obsessed with her manipulative stepsister Tripti, forcing her into a painful marriage with blind Arnav and igniting a dark battle of betrayal, obsession, and revenge.

ganda-hendati-boyfriend.title: Ganda Hendati & Boyfriend
ganda-hendati-boyfriend.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, a man is mocked as useless, unaware to them that he is actually a powerful hidden CEO. Betrayed and humiliated, he begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel. Once his true identity is revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

free-drama-tho-sampadinchandi.title: Free Drama Tho Sampadinchandi
free-drama-tho-sampadinchandi.description: Free Drama, ee app lo cinema lu chusthu dabbu sampadinchachu adhi ela telusukovalante meeru idi purthiga chudalsindhe.!

a1837458-68ba-4e9b-9a7a-be3d3f9d9208.title: Baadshaah Begum aur Business
a1837458-68ba-4e9b-9a7a-be3d3f9d9208.description:
Shehzada Bina Taj Ka is a high-voltage corporate revenge drama about betrayal, greed, and comeback.
It's story of Akshay Sethi, a powerful businessman, who gets betrayed by his wife Kawya and business partner Nishant, they snatch his company and publicly humiliate him. Thrown out of his own empire, Akshay vows revenge and returns stronger to expose the conspirators and reclaim his legacy. Watch Now.

kalpalli-smashanada-karala-rahasya.title: Kalpalli Smashanada Karala Rahasya!!
kalpalli-smashanada-karala-rahasya.description:

sarfira-ameerzada.title: Sarfira Ameerzada
sarfira-ameerzada.description:
Aditya, a billionaire's son, crashes a stranger's wedding in Jamnapaar and falls hopelessly in love with Suhani — whose father would rather die than let an Ameerzada near his daughter.

With no shortcuts allowed, Aditya trades his mansion for a chole kulche thela — getting burned, beaten, and humiliated daily, just to prove he is worthy.

This is a story of the Sarfira Ameerzada who gave up everything to earn the one thing money could never buy.

opinion-isthu-dabbu-sampadichandi.title: Opinion Isthu Dabbu Sampadichandi
opinion-isthu-dabbu-sampadichandi.description: Mee Burra vadithe saripothundi  dabbu sampadinchachu adi ela ani alochinchakandi ee video chudandi meeke Telusthundi

1b0a2f2c-1bc1-416a-8575-99d0dc803a83.title: Game Changer
1b0a2f2c-1bc1-416a-8575-99d0dc803a83.description: To fulfill his grandfather’s dying wish, a secretive multi-billionaire lives undercover as a lowly toilet sweeper, navigating a contractual marriage to a struggling CEO while using his hidden influence and lethal skills to dismantle her corporate enemies and underworld threats.

coolie-to-kodeeswaran.title: Coolie to Kodeeswaran
coolie-to-kodeeswaran.description: A gripping tale of love, betrayal, and hidden identities,Hidden Crorepati follows Tanya, a secret tycoon posing as a receptionist, and Rajvir, a conflicted CEO. A fake marriage turns real amid power struggles and heartbreak. After tragedy and a shocking truth, Rajvir lives as a janitor—until his past returns, forcing him to confront love, loss, and destiny.

simhasanam.title: Simhasanam
simhasanam.description: Thrown out of their billionaire father’s empire, twin brothers Ajay and Arjun choose opposite paths in life. While Arjun fights for success with love and loyalty, Ajay embraces betrayal and revenge. As love, revenge, and family secrets collide, the battle between the identical brothers turns into a deadly war where only one can claim the throne.

my-beautiful-addiction.title: My Beautiful Addiction
my-beautiful-addiction.description: A dedicated nurse's life is violently upended when she accidentally saves a powerful mafia boss, Vikram, during a high-speed chase, irrevocably drawing her into his dangerous criminal underworld. Captured and facing a terrifying ultimatum, she is forced into a marriage with her obsessive captor, Vikram, who asserts absolute control over her. Despite her defiance and desperate attempts to escape, Vikram's possessive obsession intensifies, leading to a relentless psychological battle for her autonomy. Her fiancé, Suraj, initially her only hope for rescue, tragically betrays her by abducting and manipulating her, revealing sinister intentions and trapping her in a new, terrifying prison. However, Vikram's role begins to shift from pure captor to a complex protector. He intervenes to safeguard her from other aggressors and fiercely defends her dignity against his own manipulative family, including a cruel stepmother and defiant father. This defiance ignites fierce class conflicts and power struggles within the powerful Rana family, with Megha, an outsider, facing humiliation and plots for her disappearance from jealous rivals. Despite Vikram's continued possessiveness and control, a bewildering love-hate dynamic emerges between them. Their bond deepens through shared crises, such as Megha nursing Vikram back to health after he is gravely wounded in a deadly drug deal. This deepening connection leads to a marriage proposal, where Vikram reveals their current arrangement is a contract marriage set to become real. Yet, their burgeoning romance is constantly threatened by external forces. Vikram's formidable mother vehemently opposes his relationship, while manipulative siblings blackmail Megha with Vikram's secret illegitimate identity, even threatening his life. Plots by rivals like Teena and Priya are designed to tear them apart, leading to heartbreaking separations. The narrative culminates in dramatic wedding halts, exposing a history of hidden secrets and leaving their future uncertain. Megha continues her relentless fight for dignity, freedom, and authentic love amidst a world of betrayal, dynastic pressures, and high-stakes power struggles.

my-undercover-husband-4.title: My Undercover Husband
my-undercover-husband-4.description: Decorated Navy officer Eklavya Merchant grapples with his father's heroic legacy and a yearning for a normal life, a desire complicated by his strained marriage to Smitha. Smitha, an ambitious professional, leverages Eklavya's perceived military background for her corporate success, dismissing his true past as a legendary commando. The reappearance of Smitha's "first love," Jay, further fuels marital conflict, exposing secrets and Eklavya's insecurity, especially when Smitha attempts to gift his father's cherished Navy watch to Jay. Eklavya's grief is compounded by Smitha's neglect of his father's ashes and her affair with Jay Soorya, even as he is publicly demeaned as a freeloader despite being the true financial pillar of their lavish lifestyle. Cast out by Smitha and her manipulative mother, and facing false accusations, Eklavya is lured into an underground fight club, seeking self-redemption and a way to reclaim his lost identity. In a dramatic turn, Eklavya, initially portrayed as a jobless dependent, reveals himself as the formidable fighter and legendary MARCOS Super Commando Thrishul, the silent architect of their shared success. He confronts Jay Soorya in the arena and later exposes Smitha's lavish spending on Jay in a high-stakes courtroom battle, leading to the return of his personal assets. Eklavya reclaims his former home and possessions, demonstrating a complex interplay of revenge and unexpected compassion by sparing Smitha's house while stripping her family of other material wealth. Jay's naval aspirations are abruptly cancelled by Eklavya, leading Jay to manipulate Smitha into a financially burdensome marriage of convenience. Amidst this turmoil, Eklavya encounters Nethra Jaysingh, a brilliant woman whose presence stirs an inexplicable familiarity. Nethra, who Eklavya heroically saved from a pirate attack years ago, confronts him about his secret identity, offers an alliance, and guides him towards reclaiming his dignity. Eklavya definitively ends his relationship with Smitha due to past betrayal, and Nethra proposes marriage, which he accepts, preparing to embark on a journey to perform his deceased father's last rites, signifying a new path and the honoring of his legacy.

college-kodeeswaran.title: College Kodeeswaran
college-kodeeswaran.description: Raja, a heartbroken man, is publicly humiliated and abandoned by his materialistic ex-girlfriend Nithya for the wealthy Rahul due to his lack of financial status. This betrayal fuels his transformation after he discovers he is the sole heir to an 8000 Crore empire, a secret test orchestrated by his deceased billionaire father. However, Raja secretly declines the inheritance, choosing to maintain his humble disguise as a pizza delivery boy to enact a calculated revenge on those who scorned him. He endures further public humiliation from Nithya, Rahul, and arrogant socialites, often being mistaken for a commoner. His true identity as the formidable owner of RRB/R&W Group is dramatically revealed through biometric scans and by his friend Shruthi, shocking his detractors. Despite these revelations, Raja faces escalating class conflicts and false accusations of theft, notably from Rahul and Preethi, who also orchestrates the mysterious transfer of a colossal fortune from his account. Preethi, a calculating heiress, attempts to control Raja through a manipulative 'boyfriend' contract and uses Ashwin as a pawn in her revenge plot against Rahul. Raja is compelled to endure further public degradation at Preethi's party, even after courageously protecting her. Concurrently, Preethi's family faces financial ruin, leading her to desperately seek Raja's help, which he initially declines before confronting Krishnan Sir with a powerful motive. Amidst these challenges, Raja rejects superficial apologies, demanding genuine change and emphasizing character over appearance. His loyal friend Vani fiercely defends him and confesses her love, while Nithya, after a collapse, embarks on a quest to find her mysterious benefactor. Nithya eventually discovers Raja is the powerful CEO she once scorned, leading to a poignant reconciliation where she chooses genuine partnership over materialistic values. The drama explores hidden wealth, societal prejudice, the moral costs of survival, and the enduring search for genuine connection.

kgf-raja-bhai-returns.title: KGF : Raja Bhai Returns
kgf-raja-bhai-returns.description: சிறையில் இருந்து திரும்பும் ராஜா பாய், தனது மகனை காப்பாற்றவும், குடும்பத்தை அவமதித்தவர்களை நசுக்கவும் மீண்டும் மைனிங் உலகை கைப்பற்ற வருகிறார். மாஸ் ஆக்ஷன், கொடூர பழிவாங்கல், எமோஷன், பவர் கேம் எல்லாம் கலந்த அதிரடி கதை இது. காணுங்கள் KUKU TV -ல் !!!

c0fdfdfc-bac1-4582-8f81-10a2660b67ba.title: Phir Le Aaya Dil
c0fdfdfc-bac1-4582-8f81-10a2660b67ba.description: After being thrown out by his own son, Shravan, a school cleaner secretly living as the world’s richest man, believes love and family are over for him. But when he meets Sakshi, a strong single mother fighting to protect her school, his life changes forever. What begins as a fake relationship slowly turns into an emotional love story filled with heartbreak, family betrayal, hidden power, and shocking revelations. The world sees him as a nobody… until his biggest secret changes everything.

london-groom-takes-the-bride-2.title: London Arjun Kadhal Story
london-groom-takes-the-bride-2.description:
London Groom Takes the Bride is a romantic comedy about Arjun Malhotra, a billionaire’s carefree son who fails his exams in London. Instead of giving him the family empire,his father sends him to India to live like a common man and earn success from scratch.
Working at a Delhi garage, Arjun falls for Simran, the owner’s daughter. But her arrogant boyfriend Rohit has plans to grab her family’s property. Arjun must win love and prove his worth, not as a rich heir, but as a real man. WATCH NOW

dil-ki-deal-1.title: Dil ki Deal
dil-ki-deal-1.description:
Priya Sharma’s life shatters when she learns she can never become a mother after three months and catches her boyfriend cheating on her with her best friend. Humiliated, she impulsively vows to marry within a week and become pregnant within three months.

Meanwhile, businessman Nitin Malhotra is under pressure to marry and produce an heir or lose his family empire. To solve their problems, Nitin proposes a three-month contract marriage to Priya

the-ultimate-return-3.title: The Ultimate Return
the-ultimate-return-3.description: The Ultimate Return is a high-octane power drama where a man written off as a loser is revealed as Leo—the unseen kingmaker controlling billion-dollar empires. As ruthless heirs, corrupt elites, and broken relationships collide, love, ambition, and revenge play out in a brutal succession battle where power bows only to truth and courage.

fake-husband-real-ceo.title: Fake Husband Real CEO
fake-husband-real-ceo.description: After her sister drugs her and leaks her private photos, a young woman is publicly shamed and cast out of her home. Struggling alone, she rebuilds her life with resilience. Years later, to escape a harasser, she impulsively claims a stranger as her husband, and he agrees to marry her hiding that he is a billionaire. As love grows, buried secrets resurface, threatening to destroy everything.

ae187d59-52f0-410c-b64f-3502ffd30902.title: Maharaja Hindustani
ae187d59-52f0-410c-b64f-3502ffd30902.description: Raja, a poor taxi driver, becomes a Billionaire by his unique business idea. He goes to meet his girlfriend Karishma in the city. Karishma still thinks Raja is poor and she has made another rich guy as her boyfriend. Karishma and her boyfriend humiliate Raja by treating him like a slave - Raja plays along by hiding his truth so that he will take his revenge when the truth comes out in a few days. Which happens in a big function - and everyone who humiliated Raja begs for his forgiveness.

magamuni-the-saviour.title: Magamuni The Saviour
magamuni-the-saviour.description: Humanity faces imminent annihilation from the reawakened ancient evil, Kaalan, a malevolent demonic force that overwhelms even powerful spiritual figures. This existential threat sparks a desperate, multi-faceted search for the long-lost Guru Maharajan, identified as the sole entity capable of confronting the ultimate evil. Various characters, including a Spiritual Advisor, King Raja, a revered Saint, and warrior Aadhavan, embark on perilous quests. Amidst these grand conflicts, a humble old man, initially dismissed due to class prejudice, dramatically reveals his true authority and is unveiled as the father of the high-ranking Thalapathy, hinting at deeper mysteries. This humble figure, Appa/Devaraya, is also Princess Devika's secret guru, complicating a forced arranged marriage between Devika and Thalapathy Elilan. Devaraya defies the King, is dramatically expelled, and vanishes amidst a surge of energy, prompting Devika to follow his mystical summons. Simultaneously, the artist Jagir, revealed as Aadhavan's guru, challenges Elilan over a 'divine painting,' leading to public humiliation and a dramatic intervention by a Mysterious Stranger. The malevolent Kaalan then emerges, possessing Aadhavan's beloved Thaaragai and threatening widespread destruction. The kingdom is plunged into crisis as Kaalan embodies death and seeks absolute power, causing spiritual masters to vanish and defeating the legendary Mahaveerar. New leaders rise, including young warrior Ezhilan, driven by vendetta, and reluctant soldier Elila, appointed commander. Mahaveerar sacrifices himself to protect children, but his son, Ezhilan, refuses to accept defeat. With a mentor's support, Ezhilan vows to destroy Kaalan. The formidable hero Mahaviran confronts Kaala in a climactic battle, refusing further reprieve despite having once spared the demon. An intense, cataclysmic confrontation ensues, culminating in an explosive event that marks Kaala's defeat and the cessation of its destructive reign, with a young individual's voice heard in the aftermath.

queen-mom.title: Queen Mom
queen-mom.description: After being abandoned and humiliated by her husband and in-laws, a strong Punjabi mother devotes her life to raising her three sons. But years later, her toxic ex-husband’s return and the arrival of a manipulative fiancée threaten to destroy everything she rebuilt. As betrayal, hidden truths, and emotional confrontations shake the family, the mother and her sons must stand together to protect their bond, reclaim their dignity, and find the love and destiny they deserve.

king-of-cards.title: King of Cards
king-of-cards.description: Jeeva, a master strategist and mathematical genius, operates under various covers in a dangerous underworld of high-stakes card games and financial manipulation, driven by a concealed objective and a promise to his father. Initially, he intervenes to protect vulnerable women like Nandhita, Sara, Anbu, and Megha from ruthless antagonists such as Karan, often sacrificing their dignity to maintain his deep cover. His true identity is suspected by Nandhita, who he repeatedly saves, leading to a complex relationship where he tries to distance her for her safety, but she remains unwavering. The stakes escalate dramatically when a Mysterious Lady draws Jeeva into "The Devils Card Championship," a brutal tournament for underworld control, where he is even wagered himself. Faced with Karan's escalating threats and the kidnapping of Nandhita, Jeeva is forced to abandon his disguise, revealing his hidden past as a prodigious mathematical genius. This revelation thrusts him into a world of high finance, where he operates as a 'ghost' manipulator, using revolutionary algorithms to save companies and generate billions. He is blackmailed by an Executive CEO, forcing him into high-stakes trading operations, further entangling him in corporate intrigue. A recurring challenge involves raising 500 crore, often linked to Nandhita's safety, leading to desperate financial heists and alliances with deceptive figures like Meenakshi. The narrative culminates in violent confrontations with Karan over Nandhita and the money, betrayals, and a dramatic asset transfer orchestrated by Jeeva for revenge. Ultimately, Jeeva, under the identity of Arjun, and Nandhita execute a daring plan to launder the stolen funds through cryptocurrency, aiming to escape their past and build a new life together as law enforcement closes in, leaving his promise and true identity's full implications uncertain.

bichagadu-2o.title: Bichagadu 2.O
bichagadu-2o.description: The story begins as a revenge-driven betrayal tale centered on Sravya and Pratik/Prateek, whose romance is revealed to have been a calculated scheme to seize assets. Sravya rejects Pratik’s desperate marriage-and-transfer offer, then turns the tables by taking control of his business and humiliating him publicly. Pratik is left disgraced and vows revenge after learning that Sravya has moved on with other allies, including Vikas and later Aditya. From there, the narrative widens into a world where hidden value and fate keep overturning appearances. A set of rings that seem ordinary is authenticated as genuine and highly valuable, leading to a major sale and a competition tied to recreating a lost earring. That contest becomes a new arena for pride, sabotage, and suspicion, with rivals mocking one another and organizers confronting possible fraud. At the same time, an aspiring jewelry designer struggles to enter the competition while the man beside her hides his ownership of a showroom out of shame over past failures. Support from others helps keep her dream alive, even as money shortages and risky choices threaten to derail it. The show also repeatedly contrasts greed with selflessness through smaller miracle-like moments, including blessings, miraculous doubling, and acts of rescue. A poor man’s generosity is rewarded with abundance, while another man saves a critically ill father and receives a precious family ring in gratitude. Those threads feed into a larger supernatural turn when Prateek receives a magical bowl that can double anything placed inside it. He is warned that it must be used only for genuine need and kept secret, because greed or exposure could bring danger. Prateek hopes the bowl will help him reclaim his lost family legacy and his mother’s jewelry business, but the artifact also attracts pressure from Vikas and Shravya. They try to force him to reveal its secrets, using loved ones as leverage and turning the conflict into a struggle over power, trust, and survival. The bowl’s rules become increasingly dangerous, especially when dropping it is said to have fatal consequences. As the pressure mounts, the story shifts into darker supernatural territory with doppelganger attacks and deathlike visions. Prateek and Sravya are drawn into a strange realm where multiple identical Prateeks appear, and a figure identified as Yamunni enters the conflict. By the end of the batch, Prateek is still fighting to protect both the bowl and the people he cares about, while greed, betrayal, and destiny continue to pull every relationship toward crisis.

sadak-se-mehel-tak.title: Sadak Se Mehel Tak
sadak-se-mehel-tak.description: Mahaj 6 saal ki Priya apni bimaar maa ka khayal rakhti thi. Uski halat dekhkar logon ne use chor aur bhikari samjha aur bahut kuch sunaya. Lekin kismat ne aisa mod liya ki uske gale ka pendant use desh ke sabse ameer khandaan ke waaris Rahul Singhania tak le gaya, jo uska pita nikla. Rahul ne apne bichhde pyaar ki surgery karwakar use theek kiya aur wife-beti ko ghar le aaya. Par kya unki kashmakash yahin khatam hui?

oru-sundari-manavatti.title: Oru Sundari Manavatti
oru-sundari-manavatti.description: Aspiring model Ananya's career is jeopardized by her powerful Creative Head boyfriend, Rohan, who threatens her after she exposes his infidelity. Exploited by her cruel aunt and facing career sabotage, Ananya seeks revenge by enlisting a waiter, Surya, to pose as her new boyfriend, only to discover he is a billionaire CEO with a hidden agenda. She accepts a high-paying secretary position from Surya, leading to a complex live-in arrangement where their undeniable chemistry begins to blur professional boundaries despite a strict "no romance" policy. Ananya endures public humiliation from Rohan and Malini but experiences a dramatic reversal of fortune, gaining exclusive access to venues while her tormentors are denied. Her professional aspirations are rekindled by powerful figures, yet she faces manipulative rivals and continued power struggles involving Rohan. However, Ananya's perceived romance with Surya Aditya is dramatically shattered at the altar when he publicly humiliates her with accusations of gold-digging, revealing a meticulously planned revenge for a past slight. This betrayal leads to Ananya's heartbreak and Surya Aditya's forced arranged marriage. Later, Ananya encounters Anand and then Deva, both wealthy men who initially hide their true identities to win her affection, with Deva orchestrating a fake honeymoon. Deva's true identity as a powerful CEO and his pre-arranged marriage are eventually revealed, shattering Ananya's perception of their union as she discovers their marriage is a temporary contract. Rohan continues his vengeful schemes, and Deva's assertive ex-fiancée appears, demanding a divorce and threatening Ananya's life, forcing Deva to fiercely protect her. Deva's attempts to propose a genuine marriage are repeatedly thwarted by manipulative rivals like Keerthana and Sathya, who drug him and frame him to destroy his relationship with Ananya. Ananya faces new challenges in a management role, including a vengeful former boss and a sinister plot by her ex-boyfriend David. The narrative culminates in Ananya's mysterious disappearance, prompting Deva to seal off the island and confront Keerthana. Deva embarks on a ruthless search, discovering Ananya was abducted by Keerthana. After miraculously saving her life and apprehending their enemies, Ananya becomes suspicious of Deva's extraordinary resources and true identity. Ananya confronts Deva, who, as Adityan, reveals his secret billionaire status, fearing her rejection due to her past distrust of the wealthy. Ultimately, Ananya responds with unwavering love and acceptance, leading Adityan to propose a genuine, unconditional lifelong partnership.

dhokha-mubarak.title: When a Billionaire Met a Mafia Family On a Train
dhokha-mubarak.description: On a speeding train, a wounded young woman is brutally humiliated, branded a gold-digger, and nearly killed by a ruthless billionaire family—until a shocking truth explodes: the “helpless” girl they tortured is actually the only daughter of the powerful tycoon they’re desperate to marry into.

vivegam-return-of-the-racing-king.title: Vivegam - Return of the Racing King
vivegam-return-of-the-racing-king.description: The series opens with champion racer Aryan Varma's career ending in a catastrophic accident, orchestrated by his adopted brother Kabir, who confesses to sabotaging Aryan's vehicle and murdering their parents out of resentment. Stripped of everything, Aryan vanishes. Years later, the struggling Apollo Club, led by Ranbir and his daughter Shanaya, faces financial ruin and a hostile takeover by Vikram Dixit, allied with the now powerful racing magnate Kabir. Their last hope rests on Monty, a reluctant mechanic with a hidden racing talent and a deep vendetta against Kabir, who is revealed to be the 'Triple Crown King'. Monty, secretly Aryan, races dilapidated cars in high-stakes qualifiers, battling rivals like Prathik and Ivan Vasu 'Spider' to save Apollo Club and protect Shanaya. He navigates engine flaws, disqualification threats, and deadly underground 'death races' to acquire his own legendary car. As Monty's victories mount, his true identity as the long-lost prodigy Aryan is gradually revealed, intensifying his personal and corporate conflict with Kabir. Kabir, driven by revenge, seeks to dismantle Aryan's world and reclaim his corporate empire, Apex Velocity, from Chairman Vijay, initiating a fierce power struggle. Aryan, supported by Shanaya, seeks help from the reclusive mechanic Kiara, as a burgeoning romance sparks between them. The Apex Velocity Championship becomes the ultimate battleground, where Aryan faces Kabir's sabotage and superior vehicles, pushing his limits with death-defying maneuvers. In a final, desperate gamble, Aryan makes a fatal choice for victory, disregarding warnings. Ultimately, Aryan triumphs as the Apex Velocity Champion, and his joy is compounded by Shanaya's pregnancy. He unmasks Kabir as his parents' murderer, leading to Kabir's arrest. With justice served and his legacy reclaimed, Aryan proposes to Shanaya, preparing to resume his reign as the 'King of Track'.

husband-home-alone.title: Husband Home Alone
husband-home-alone.description: A brilliant aerospace engineer, targeted by a formidable sharpshooter after his project is leaked, is forced to abandon his identity and become "Shiva the milkman" in a remote village, embarking on a covert mission to track a contract killer. His new life intertwines with Simran's plight, as she is coerced into marrying the violent Babu Kesariya, leading Shiva to rescue her with superhuman speed and enter a transactional marriage for her protection. Their union is quickly complicated by Shiva's hidden identity and Simran's entry into a reality show, "Husband Home Alone," to win money and protect Shiva from a powerful millionaire, exposing their marriage to public scrutiny and accusations of infidelity with Palak. Shiva faces escalating public humiliation and violence, branded as "Simran's deceitful husband" and later arrested as "milkman Shibai" for possessing military equipment, accused of terrorism. Inspector Megha Singh's brutal interrogation and subsequent investigation into Shiva are abruptly shut down by powerful forces, hinting at a deeper conspiracy, while priceless stolen relics are discovered in his home, leading to his mysterious disappearance. Simran's world is further upended by revelations of Shiva's infidelity and his unmasking as Mr. Krishnamurthy, the chairman of ZenX Aerospace, living under a protective disguise due to his family's national service. Investigations by Simran and others uncover a darker side, suggesting Shiva might be a con artist, gigolo, or involved in a "top secret" criminal underworld, evidenced by fraudulent awards and cryptic videos. Amidst these personal crises, Simran wins a house on a reality show but faces demands from her manipulative stepmother and a terrifying ultimatum from Babu to repay a massive debt or marry him. Simran discovers she is an unwitting heiress to vast properties, a secret tied to her husband Shivnarayan, who is being hunted by a relentless antagonist, while an inspector reveals Shiva to be a fraudster, plunging their marriage into crisis. Inspector Megha warns Shiva about Rohit Chadda, a suspected contract killer targeting him, as Simran navigates biometric security to access a lavish mansion registered in her name, connecting it to Shiva's past. At a corporate event, Simran retaliates fiercely against public humiliation, while Shiva dramatically declares himself Chief Scientist and Chairman of Gen-Ex Aerospace, only to be dismissed as a fraud, leaving his true identity a high-stakes mystery. The show culminates with Shiva, now Chief Scientist, facing a corporate power struggle, accused of fraud and sabotage, as his revolutionary turbojet engine project is revealed to be a matter of national security, endangering his life and transforming their domestic life into one of corporate intrigue and constant danger.

yuga-purushan.title: Yuga Purushan
yuga-purushan.description: Prakash, a humble village watchman, hides a legendary past as the "Mahaveeran," a supreme master of divine power who vanished decades ago. When the ancient, apocalyptic force known as Kaalan returns to consume the kingdom, Prakash’s estranged son, Vikram, must lead a desperate army against an enemy they cannot defeat. Forced to step out of the shadows to save his son and the world, Prakash reveals his true identity to dismantle Kaalan's darkness.

maayajala-pichaikaran.title: Maayajala Pichaikaran
maayajala-pichaikaran.description: Aman, a wealthy jeweler, is utterly ruined by his manipulative fiancée, Sanjana, and her accomplice Rishabh, who seize his assets and publicly humiliate him. Destitute, Aman receives a magical, endlessly multiplying sweet and a duplicating ring after acts of kindness, which aid him in heroic deeds. Adopting a new identity, Hari, he discovers his rings are priceless, dramatically shifting his social standing and attracting the attention of influencer Zia, who proposes a high-stakes romance. Hari undergoes a mysterious physical transformation, driven to reclaim his lost empire. As Aman, he selflessly funds Jia Sharma's dreams, facing class prejudice and sabotage in competitions against Rishabh and Sanjana, while also acquiring a powerful duplicating artifact, the Maaya Kinnam. However, he is betrayed by Thripthi, who conspires with Sanjana and Rishabh to steal the bowl, leading to a devastating legal defeat for Aman in his attempt to reclaim his ancestral showroom. Orchestrating a calculated revenge, Amman reclaims his business and deepens his love with Thrupti, only for her to mysteriously duplicate, causing chaos. Sanjana, now desperate, returns, revealing a manipulative plot, and along with Rishabh, traps and tortures Amman and Thrupti for the magic bowl's secrets, culminating in an apparent double murder. Yet, Amman dramatically reappears as Yamadharman, a divine enforcer, his survival linked to the magic bowl, vowing ultimate justice. Later, after a terrifying magical curse causes him and his sister to disintegrate, Aman miraculously recovers and embarks on a profound journey of self-discovery and spiritual redemption, abandoning his pursuit of material wealth for enlightenment, often triggered by powerful objects or divine intervention.

betrayal-ke-baad.title: Betrayal Ke Baad
betrayal-ke-baad.description: A wealthy but secretive businessman, Rohit returns to India to reunite with his longtime fiancée, only to be humiliated and rejected because of his “low status.” At the same time, ambitious CEO Shanaya Mittal crosses paths with him during a business crisis, leading to a chaotic fake-marriage proposal, corporate rivalry, and betrayal.

5-star-billionaire-waiter-2.title: 5 Star Billionaire Waiter
5-star-billionaire-waiter-2.description: Arjun Raichand completes his studies at Harvard and plans to take over his family business. However, his mother gives him a shocking revelation. Soon after, Kavya, the woman he loves, betrays him. What Arjun does amid all these challenges forms the rest of the story.

kahani-adhoori-hamari.title: Kahani Adhoori Hamari
kahani-adhoori-hamari.description: Set against Kannauj’s perfume world, the show weaves business ambition, buried identities, and intimate betrayal into a long-running struggle over legacy, love, and control. Veer Rathore returns after seven years as the face of Mahek Perfumes, publicly vowing to take Kannauj’s fragrance heritage global through a massive deal, but his rise is shadowed by coercion, rivalry, and unresolved memories. Around him, multiple women tied to perfume formulas, hidden pasts, and forced relationships become central to the conflict, especially Ruhi and Kriti. Ruhi’s story is marked by deception, pregnancy, and repeated attempts by powerful people to define her fate, yet she consistently resists pressure, refuses pity, and fights to protect both herself and her unborn child. Her past remains clouded by a drugged night, an unknown companion, and competing claims about paternity, marriage, and ownership of her future. Veer, meanwhile, becomes obsessed with uncovering what truly happened that night, rejecting false confessions and searching for the real woman connected to the encounter. Family pressure and social power turn that mystery into a forced marriage and a strategic alliance, with DNA, legitimacy, and inheritance hanging over every decision. The show repeatedly places Ruhi in humiliating public and private situations, but she gradually shifts from vulnerability to agency, exposing others’ mistakes, pushing back against abuse, and hiding key truths of her own. Her regained eyesight, kept secret for a time, becomes a major reversal that changes how she navigates the people trying to control or expose her. Perfume itself functions as both inheritance and evidence, linking rare scents, stolen formulas, and a father’s legacy to a deeper unresolved past. That larger mystery is echoed by a fifteen-year search for a lost “broken heart,” a childhood locket, and signs that someone once saved Veer long ago. As clues surface, Veer’s emotional loyalties fracture between present commitments and old bonds, especially when Kriti reenters his life carrying deception, ambition, and a possible connection to his past. Their relationship mixes romance, concealment, and corporate calculation, while Ruhi repeatedly resurfaces to challenge Veer’s current life and assert her own claim on him. Elsewhere, betrayal over inherited perfume formulas, auction battles, sabotage, blackmail, and violent intimidation reinforce a world where affection is often transactional and trust is dangerous. Several marriages or proposals are treated less as love than as instruments of revenge, duty, status, or business advantage, deepening the show’s atmosphere of emotional captivity. Even when Veer protects Ruhi in moments of crisis, his role remains unstable, shifting between controller, defender, husband figure, and seeker of truth. By the later arc, pregnancy, secret marriage, and the revelation that Ruhi may already be Veer’s wife raise the stakes from personal scandal to a direct battle over legitimacy and belonging. The recurring locket and broken-heart imagery suggest that the central conflicts are rooted in a past that none of the characters fully understands, even as they destroy evidence and accuse one another of deception. Overall, the show builds a melodramatic saga in which perfume legacy, hidden identity, and unresolved history keep colliding, and where every attempt to claim love, family, or power threatens to expose an older wound.

beggar-fighter.title: Beggar Fighter
beggar-fighter.description: A fearless martial arts master lives as a beggar, hiding his legendary past. When love and honor drag him back into the fighting world, enemies rise and secrets explode. Betrayal, destiny, and raw power collide as he reclaims his true identity as the Grandmaster. Watch now.

dhananjaya-the-supreme-archer.title: Dhananjaya: The Supreme Archer
dhananjaya-the-supreme-archer.description: After his guru dies saving him, a legendary archer leaves royal fame behind and secretly protects the guru’s daughter, granddaughter, and gurukulam. Living as a humble worker, he silently bears insults while defending them from every threat. When enemies attack and the truth comes out, he reclaims his warrior identity, avenges his guru, and becomes the shield of the gurukulam.

45a0bea2-7352-4b70-995f-bb86a6bf065b.title: Genius Delivery Boy
45a0bea2-7352-4b70-995f-bb86a6bf065b.description: A hidden billionaire living as a delivery man is betrayed and divorced by his ungrateful wife, leading him to reclaim his true identity as "Lord Singhania" to ruin his oppressors and find true love with a rival business tycoon.

billionaire-mavana-prateekara.title: Billionaire Mavana Prateekara
billionaire-mavana-prateekara.description: ಒಬ್ಬ ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರಿ ಯುವರಾಜ್, ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ರೂಹಿಯನ್ನು ಕಣ್ಣಮುಚ್ಚಿ ನಂಬಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅವನ ತಂದೆ ರಜತ್ ಸಿಂಘಾನಿಯಾ, ಅವಳ ನಿಜಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ಅವಳ ದುರಾಸೆ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರೋಹದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವಮಾನ, ಪ್ರತೀಕಾರ, ಸುಳ್ಳು ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಗೌರವದ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ನಡೆಯುವ ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ಯುದ್ಧವೇ “Billionaire ಮಾನವ ಪ್ರತೀಕಾರ”. ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆಲ್ಲೋದು ನಿಜವಾದ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಾ ಅಥವಾ ಹಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಆಡಿದ ಆಟವಾ?

jaa-simran-jaa.title: Jaa Simran Jaa
jaa-simran-jaa.description: On the night of their anniversary, quiet homemaker Raj discovers his wife Simran is cheating on him with her ambitious secretary Rahul and has stolen his fortune, his home, and his identity. But when her betrayal pushes him to the edge, Raj reveals he is the hidden heir to a business empire—and launches a ruthless game of revenge that will destroy every lie she built her life on. Watch Now

पैसा-कोनी-प्यार-चाहिए-.title: पैसा कोनी प्यार चाहिए
पैसा-कोनी-प्यार-चाहिए-.description: The series begins with Disha, a compassionate and career-driven architect, whose act of kindness towards an elderly Dadi inadvertently draws her into a matchmaking scheme for Dadi's billionaire grandson, Vikram. An urgent financial crisis for Disha's sister compels her to consider a contract marriage with Vikram, who, under Dadi's pressure, conceals his true identity as a powerful CEO by pretending to be a humble caretaker. Their elaborate deception unfolds as Disha, an underdog in an architectural design competition, is unjustly accused of plagiarism by the privileged heiress, Tia. However, Disha makes a dramatic return as the company's new CEO, setting the stage for a power struggle and revealing Vikram's manipulative tactics. As their tumultuous contract marriage progresses, Vikram (also referred to as Vikrant) is forced into cohabitation with Disha, his true identity as a wealthy CEO slowly unraveling amidst various deceptions and external pressures. Their budding romance is complicated by class confrontations with the arrogant socialite Tia/Roma, who repeatedly attempts to humiliate Disha and assert dominance. Disha discovers a "Golden Card" and later receives a significant, mysterious fortune, which she dedicates to philanthropy, while navigating corporate battles and family secrets, including Dadi's cryptic remarks about a "Vikram-Betal's secret." Vikrant, often disguised as a driver, publicly challenges Roma Singhania, exposing her family's fraudulent claims and hidden bankruptcy, and ultimately revealing his true identity as a powerful CEO. This leads to Roma and her father's blacklisting for harassing Disha, who confronts Vikrant about his prolonged deception. Despite the initial fabrication, a genuine affection blossoms between Disha and Vikrant, but their bond is threatened by Roma's reappearance and obsession. The conflict escalates when Disha is kidnapped by Roma, who blackmails Vikrant into a public engagement. In a defiant move, Vikrant publicly transfers all his immense wealth to Disha, sparking a violent backlash and an attack, solidifying their bond amidst betrayal and a shared vow for revenge against their unseen enemies.

chakravyuham.title: Chakravyuham
chakravyuham.description: The series opens with champion racer Aryan Verma's quest for a record title, marked by a fierce rivalry with his brother Kabeer (Kabir) and a budding romance. However, this initial triumph quickly unravels as Kabir is exposed as a ruthless antagonist, having orchestrated their parents' fatal accident and sabotaged former champion Siddharth's career. Simultaneously, the struggling Apollo Club faces financial ruin and a hostile takeover, exacerbated by their star racer Ishan's critical injury due to ignored warnings from the mysterious mechanic, Monty. Desperate, Apollo Club owner Dharmaprakash compels the reluctant Monty to race, revealing his hidden talent and a personal vendetta against Kabir. Monty, an underdog, triumphs in a dramatic qualifier, securing a crucial victory for Apollo Club despite sabotage and ridicule. His victory, however, incurs the dangerous wrath of Kabir, who is obsessed with the legacy of the vanished "Triple Crown King," Aryan, and initiates plans to dismantle Apollo Club. As Monty's identity becomes shrouded in mystery, hinting at a forgotten past as Aryan, he and his partner Shanaya seek Aryan's legendary car from the ruthless "Black Market King" Spider, intensifying the power struggle with Kabir. Monty, revealed to be a legendary racer, navigates perilous races, battling amnesia and preparing to reclaim his "King" title in the Apex Velocity Championship. He faces Kabir, who has orchestrated a hostile takeover of Apex Velocity and holds a possessive interest in Shanaya. The series culminates in Monty's dramatic unmasking as Aryan, the true heir, fueled by vengeance against Kabir for his parents' murder. Aryan, with Shanaya as his co-driver, enters the high-stakes championship, facing sabotage and a brutal crash. Despite being presumed dead after a devastating crash, Aryan's miraculous survival is hinted at, leading to the compilation of evidence against Kabir for his profound betrayals. Ultimately, Aryan resolves the conflict with Kabir and publicly proposes marriage to Shanaya, blending intense rivalry with a poignant tale of love and truth.

rulebreaker-teacher.title: When A Billionaire Entered A Classroom
rulebreaker-teacher.description: Born billionaire Ajay Khanna is challenged to reform Jagran College’s most notorious class. Facing rebellious students, ego clashes, conspiracies, and a false molestation accusation, Ajay fights with integrity instead of power. His courage and compassion slowly transform enemies into allies, proving that true strength lies in understanding, not dominance.

સીધો-સાદો-કરોડપતિ.title: સીધો સાદો કરોડપતિ
સીધો-સાદો-કરોડપતિ.description: Neel is hiding a billion; Snehal is just trying to survive. After a "janitor" and an orphan say "I do," they start a life of Vada Pav and 1RK struggles—while Neel secretly pulls strings to protect her from the shadows. But with a pregnancy secret and a furious Raichand mother-in-law closing in, will his billion-dollar lie destroy their million-dollar love? Watch to see if the billionaire stays for love or runs for his life!

pati-patni-aur-panga-2.title: Pati Patni Aur Panga
pati-patni-aur-panga-2.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous life of billionaire CEO Amit Desai, whose existence is complicated by multiple contract marriages and a relentless love triangle. Initially, Amit is entangled with superstar Rekha and his supposed wife, Alisha, while another woman named Jaya is blackmailed into a contract marriage. Amit's marriage to a Jaya is strained by a dying friend's wish to support Rekha, leading to divorce demands and a desperate plea for a child. To appease his grandmother, Dadi, Amit and Rekha are forced into a contract marriage, though Jaya defiantly refuses divorce and vows retribution. Amidst corporate power struggles and family deceptions, Jaya meticulously performs as Amit's devoted wife, despite his suspicions of her hidden agenda to exploit Dadi's wealth. Amit protects Jaya from her abusive brother, asserting control, and their professional collaboration reveals a complex trust. Rekha publicly declares her love for Amit, igniting family opposition, and later announces a pregnancy to Jaya, leading to a cruel paternity insinuation and physical confrontation. Amit publicly declares Jaya his wife, but she reveals their union is a strategic contract marriage, which approaches its expiry. Rekha wages a relentless war against Jaya, staging a suicide attempt that backfires, leading to her confinement. The return of Amit's estranged wife, Bhavna, further complicates matters, asserting her marital claim and leading to physical struggles. Jaya delivers an ultimatum to Amit, forcing him to confront mysterious family conditions and hidden truths, while unseen manipulators orchestrate Rekha's vengeful actions. The narrative culminates in the catastrophic collapse of a sustainable project designed by Jaya, which is immediately suspected as sabotage. Rekha, the manipulative superstar, frames Jaya with false accusations and a fake pregnancy, turning Amit against her. However, Rekha's elaborate deception unravels, and she confesses to orchestrating the building collapse and Jaya's car accident, unaware that Jaya has secretly recorded her entire confession, setting the stage for Rekha's dramatic downfall and the potential resolution of the complex web of deceit.

રસોઈનો-રહસ્યમય-રાજા.title: રસોઈનો રહસ્યમય રાજા
રસોઈનો-રહસ્યમય-રાજા.description:
Rohan, a simple kitchen worker, hides a shocking truth—he is the missing world-famous Master Chef. When a dangerous cooking competition turns into a battle of power, betrayal, and survival, he is forced to step in and prove his unmatched skills.

Just when he wins everything and his identity is revealed, enemies from his past attack him, leaving him broken and missing.

But the real question is…
Will the world’s greatest chef ever return—or is his story just beginning?

breaking-crime-laal-drum.title: Breaking Crime: Laal Drum
breaking-crime-laal-drum.description: Sushant Singh narrates a chilling crime story where a seemingly perfect family hides dangerous secrets, betrayal, and obsession. When a husband returns home after sensing something is terribly wrong, a horrifying mystery begins to unfold. A red drum sealed with cement, missing family members, hidden affairs, and shocking lies lead police into one of the most disturbing murder investigations imaginable. But who is the real monster behind it all?

khatarnak-baap.title: Khatarnak Baap
khatarnak-baap.description: Aryan, a man of many masks, operates as the formidable vigilante 'Mahakal' and 'The Ghost,' a secret CEO, while publicly maintaining the guise of a humble cleaner. His clandestine life is fraught with clashes against crime lords like Harish Bhalla and Ranjit Katta, often in defense of Avni, a defiant woman who eventually becomes his fiancée and then wife. This dual existence is complicated by his son, Avinash, who remains oblivious to his father's true power, and the urgent, mysterious circumstances surrounding his marriage to Avni. A formidable, scorned wife from Aryan's past emerges, discovering his son and fiancée work at her hotel, setting the stage for a vengeful plot against his new family. As the narrative unfolds, Avinash faces public humiliation when his father's cleaner identity is exposed, leading to abandonment by his fiancée Riya and further demeaning by Sandy. This ignites the fierce wrath of Avinash's powerful mother, Avni Nagpal, who, enraged by her son's shaming and her new marriage to Aryan, vows retribution and integrates Avinash into her corporate empire. Corporate warfare escalates, with Sandy Chadda orchestrating Riya's downfall and seeking revenge. Aryan, initially an arrogant businessman, undergoes a transformation, apologizing to Avni Nagpal, whose ambition leads her to seek entry into the shadowy 'Syndicate' led by Ranjit Katta. Accusations of theft and corporate conspiracies involving a 'Phoenix Heart' pendant intertwine Aryan and Avni with the Syndicate, as Katta reveals unexpected connections. Aryan's fortunes dramatically reverse, and he faces a brutal ambush, hinting at deeper conspiracies. He reappears as an affluent, mysterious figure at a college reunion, publicly humiliated by former peers, only to stun them by revealing his marriage to Avni Nagpal. However, Avni's ambition leads her into a dangerous corporate trap, where she is drugged and betrayed, falling into the vengeful hands of Gaurav Chopra. Aryan fiercely intervenes to protect Avni, testing their profound bond amidst escalating peril. In a dramatic turn, Avni faces a severe financial crisis and a pivotal syndicate selection, where Aryan, as an unknown rival, makes an exorbitant bid. He then dramatically reveals himself as 'The Ghost,' the founder and true mastermind of the Syndicate, disclosing his secret identity and empire to his son, Abhi. It is revealed that Avni's initial marriage to Aryan was contractual, but he proposes anew, which she accepts. The story culminates with the revelation that Avni was already secretly married to Dhruva (Aryan), who had saved her from a sinister plot orchestrated by her own father's past misjudgments, leading to their reconciliation and the celebration of their enduring, duty-bound union.

એક-અજાણ્યો-સંબંધ.title: એક અજાણ્યો સંબંધ
એક-અજાણ્યો-સંબંધ.description: A dedicated young woman unknowingly takes a job as the personal assistant to the arrogant CEO she was hurriedly married to months prior, sparking a chaotic workplace romance built on mistaken identities and hidden family secrets

final-boss-5.title: Final Boss
final-boss-5.description: Abhiraj Singh Rathore, the secret ruler of Rajputana Corporation and the world’s richest man, returns victorious from war only to be humiliated by his childhood love. He secretly marries rising entrepreneur Anamika Gor, but their hidden union erupts into scandal when Princess Devyani claims Abhiraj was promised to her. Inside Virajgarh Palace, Anamika faces ruthless conspiracies from power-hungry royals as a deadly battle for the throne threatens love, loyalty, and the kingdom itself.

એજન્ટ-પતિ.title: એજન્ટ પતિ
એજન્ટ-પતિ.description: Billionaire Shashvat poses as a poor agent to find true love with Sunaina, a woman abused by her greedy family. While he secretly uses his wealth to protect her, a shocking twist reveals her long-lost daughter is closer than she thinks. Will this secret unite them, or will her ex-husband’s revenge ruin her second chance at a royal life?

29995e57-974b-4b78-a4af-3a6923e628f6.title: Dil ka Diagnosis
