29995e57-974b-4b78-a4af-3a6923e628f6.description: Agastya, a dedicated pharmacist, races against time to develop a cure for his terminally ill wife, Himani, who has only a week to live. His desperate search for funds uncovers a shocking family secret: he is the hidden heir to a powerful pharmaceutical empire. However, his manipulative mother, estranged brother Jatin, and a cunning CEO (who is also Himani's lover) complicate his efforts, plotting to replace him with AI. Himani herself is involved in schemes against Agastya, including seeking a divorce and having a relationship with the CEO. Agastya initially fabricates his own terminal illness to test Himani's devotion, but later reveals that Himani is the one truly afflicted. This leads to a bitter and financially devastating divorce, with Himani and her mother demanding significant assets and company shares. Heartbroken by Himani's profound betrayal, Agastya redirects his life-saving drug research from her to a global patient population. He then mysteriously inherits his deceased grandfather's pharmaceutical empire, NewTech Pharma, becoming its CEO and setting ethical conditions for corporate contracts. Meanwhile, Himani, now divorced, enters a new relationship with Jatin, who secretly plots to seize control of Agastya's company. Agastya's former college crush, Astha, uncovers this plot and seeks to recruit him. Agastya becomes embroiled in intense corporate rivalries at Caretek Pharma, facing accusations of outdated methods, physical assaults, and blackmail, and is framed for corporate theft and illegal drug testing. Jatin, now CEO of Caretek, faces his own challenges, including accusations of industrial espionage and colossal corporate fraud from Himani. CEO Astha Ahuja dramatically defends Agastya against embezzlement charges, revealing their shared past and forming a lucrative alliance with Mooncorp Pharma. Agastya, feigning a terminal illness, orchestrates a cunning revenge plot against Jatin, strategically outmaneuvering him with a flawed AI drug. A monumental pharmaceutical contract is signed between Astha and Agastya, but Agastya is then dramatically exposed as the true, hidden power behind NewTech Pharma, unraveling a complex web of deception and a potential revenge plot. In the end, a formidable CEO Agastya confronts Himani, who is critically ill and seeks his help and forgiveness. Despite having developed a cure for her life-threatening illness, Agastya, hardened by her past betrayals and her refusal to heed his warnings, delivers a chilling verdict of cold justice, leaving her to face the irreversible repercussions of her choices, abandoned even by her own mother.

લગ્નની-માથાકૂટ.title: લગ્નની માથાકૂટ
લગ્નની-માથાકૂટ.description: A broken leg, a secret necklace, and a flight full of enemies—Siya’s journey to her brother’s wedding becomes a living nightmare. Branded a gold digger, tortured, and pushed to the edge, she keeps repeating one truth: “Krish Johri is my brother.” But will anyone believe her before it’s too late?

છેલ્લી-બાજી.title: છેલ્લી બાજી
છેલ્લી-બાજી.description: Sejal’s dream honeymoon turns into a nightmare of high-stakes gambling and cruel humiliation. Shivam wins the final bet to save her, but a dark secret follows them home. A mysterious call from Radhika reveals a hidden past, claiming Shivam is already married. Is their love a lie? Sejal stands frozen as a voice whispers, "He was never yours..."

બિલિયન-ડોલર-વાળો-બ્લન્ડર.title: બિલિયન ડોલર વાળો બ્લન્ડર
બિલિયન-ડોલર-વાળો-બ્લન્ડર.description: Billionaires in Disguise! Shree ane Shrimati Saxena simple bani ne, bodyguards vagar resort pahuche che. Pan lalach ma andhi manager Parul sacha malik sathe garibo jevo vartav kare che. Ahankar ni hadd aave che jyare te bimar Mukesh ne dawa nathi aapti ane bahar fekavani dhamki aape che. Potanu promotion bachavva mate te Mukesh ni peanut allergy no faydo uthavi janleva chaal chale che. Shu Parul ni aa chaal kaamyab thashe ke karma hisaab karshe?

e96b0060-a158-4795-822c-cefe55e9b015.title: Kismat Ka Khel
e96b0060-a158-4795-822c-cefe55e9b015.description: The microdrama centers on Angad, a young man living a humble life, unaware he is the long-lost son of India's wealthiest couple, Rajesh and Sunita Adani. His true lineage is revealed by his maternal grandfather, a former RAW agent, who abducted Angad's parents to share the news. Angad's initial attempts to marry Riya are brutally rejected by her status-conscious father due to his perceived poverty, leading to his public humiliation and a fraudulent "new home" scheme that shatters their engagement. Meanwhile, his parents make immense sacrifices to support him while trying to conceal their vast wealth, creating comedic chaos and deeper deceptions. Angad finds a new connection with heiress Meenal, who faces her own struggles with a controlling father and an arranged marriage. A significant turning point occurs with the emergence of Angad's maternal grandfather, Nanu, initially appearing as a street vendor with a mysterious past. Nanu faces public humiliation and classist insults, but defiantly vows to acquire a luxury car through a high-stakes wager involving military bravery awards. This culminates in Nanu's dramatic revelation as Brigadier Vinay Agarwal, the formidable Chief of RAW, confirming his powerful, top-secret status and vindicating him against his detractors. This revelation hints at Angad's own powerful heritage and hidden connections. Angad then strives to marry Meenal, navigating her father's impossible conditions and a ruthless corporate rivalry. Despite obstacles, Angad secures a crucial corporate deal and an ultra-exclusive wedding venue, suggesting his own access to mysterious wealth and an unresolved past. The narrative escalates into a high-stakes espionage plot when ISI agent Baghira targets Brigadier Agarwal's family, exposing their concealed identities and threatening their lives. Angad bravely offers his life to protect his family, but the Brigadier unveils a cunning counter-trap, revealing Baghira's associates as his own operatives, thereby thwarting the plot and apprehending the agent. The show explores themes of hidden identity, class struggle, familial honor, and national security, as Angad navigates his true heritage and its dangerous implications.

ed51968f-e902-44dd-8b72-b72281b56dbd.title: Shoorveer Ka Aagaman
ed51968f-e902-44dd-8b72-b72281b56dbd.description: Twelve years after the legendary Shurveer vanished, dangerous energies, an old enemy, and signs of a returning conflict begin surfacing again. At the same time, scholarship student Riva enters DCP College, where her arrival is framed as part of a larger plan tied to Shurveer’s possible return. Elsewhere, retired warrior Surya is warned that a devastating attack is imminent and that only Shurveer can stop what is coming, but he initially refuses to abandon the peaceful life he wants with his daughter. The story’s personal and political threads converge at DCP College, where privileged students connected to powerful trustee families rule through cheating, intimidation, and violence. When a vulnerable girl identified across the digests as Tanu, Tannu, or Anu is humiliated, beaten, and pressured into submission to protect her father, the abuse becomes the spark that drives the hidden father figure out of concealment. Anaya’s resistance and a protector’s compassion briefly counter the cruelty, but the institution’s leadership and elite matriarchs close ranks around the perpetrators and insist that wealth determines truth. Faced with his daughter’s suffering, her kidnapping, and the system’s refusal to deliver justice, the father abandons restraint and begins gathering names, family links, and resources for retaliation. His search for his missing daughter escalates into violent confrontations at elite gatherings, where his apparent low status gives way to hints that he is far more powerful than his enemies assumed. As allies track the captive girl, a darker conspiracy emerges: Tanu is being treated as a “gift” or tribute connected to a superior East State power, exposing collusion between wealthy families and a predatory larger network. The rescue attempt turns brutal, with Tanu badly injured and pleading for protection while her father wages open war against guards, family enforcers, and their patrons. In this reckoning, the man dismissed as a laborer is revealed to be Shoorveer or Shurveer, owner of Veeram Palace, transforming a class-based humiliation into the return of a feared force. His reappearance also revives an older feud with the Master, who believed Shurveer had been eliminated twelve years earlier and is tied to betrayal, broken vows, and wider political intrigue. What began as a father’s fight for his daughter expands into a syndicate war involving the Master, rivals such as Sultan and Kartik, and elite families whose private crimes are linked to broader structures of power. The conflict widens further into public struggles over authority as Prince Aditya Verma claims sweeping control, only to be accused of corruption, violence, and mass death. Shurveer rejects pleas for mercy from Aditya and others, insisting that some crimes—especially those tied to Tanu’s suffering and the abuses of four families—cannot be forgiven. He publicly exposes wrongdoing, strips powerful families of status and wealth, and demands atonement rather than easy absolution. Even so, the digests suggest uncertainty around identities and relationships, including whether Surya, Sultan, Malik, Rudra, and Shoorveer are distinct figures or overlapping facets of the same avenging father-force. By the end, Shurveer has returned as both protector and punisher, but the larger network behind betrayal, trafficking-like tribute, political murder, and elite violence is not fully closed. The final movement opens a new mystery around Sonali’s murder and a broken bracelet, implying that after avenging his daughter, the struggle against the hidden criminal structure is still continuing.

husband-ka-badla.title: Husband Ka Badla
husband-ka-badla.description: To fulfill a 1,000-day vow of humility for his father’s honor, the secret heir of the Rajmahal empire endures horrific abuse as a lowly hotel waiter. When his identity is revealed, he uses his massive wealth to buy the hotel and systematically dismantle the lives of the socialites who tormented him. Now the master of those who enslaved him, he enforces a poetic justice where his former bullies must work the very service jobs they once mocked.

zehar-hai-ya-pyaar-hai.title: Zehar Hai Ya Pyaar hai
zehar-hai-ya-pyaar-hai.description: Aditi, a seemingly lucky girl, whose life is controlled by Naman Verma, a powerful and intense man who blames her family for his father’s death. What begins as a forced contract and manipulation slowly reveals hidden motives, as Naman is actually protecting Aditi from deeper dangers tied to her past and her fiancé Vikram. The story unfolds as a tense push-and-pull between hatred, control, sacrifice, and unspoken love, where truth hides behind deception and every relationship carries a shadow

ghar-wapsi-ek-yoddha-ki-kahani.title: Ghar Wapsi: Ek Yoddha Ki Kahani
ghar-wapsi-ek-yoddha-ki-kahani.description: Surya begins as an orphaned warrior trained in secret by his Guru, who sends him to Jhansi to find his lost family using only a childhood locket as a clue. He hides his extraordinary strength at first, but his path quickly turns into a series of public fights, rescues, and confrontations that reveal how dangerous he really is. Along the way, he meets a doctor working on Alzheimer’s research and notices she carries an identical locket, hinting at a shared past and a deeper family mystery. Surya is repeatedly pulled into the Sharma household, where different relatives recognize his locket, his voice, or his presence, and where a mother figure insists he is her son. At the same time, a father who once rejected a newborn son over shame and a perceived defect becomes central to the pain behind Surya’s separation. The story gradually confirms that Surya is tied to this family as the long-lost son, but that truth is contested by those who deny him and call him an imposter. Vikram Singh and other hostile forces turn the family conflict into a corporate war, trying to seize control of the company and the medicine connected to Tara’s cure. Surya keeps choosing protection over retreat, whether he is defending family members, standing beside Tara, or refusing to abandon those threatened by stalking, kidnapping, or ambush. His loyalty also shifts from old criminal ties as he publicly breaks away from that past and declares allegiance to his mentor. That choice does not end the danger, because stronger enemies, hired fighters, and revenge-driven rivals keep coming at him from both the street and the boardroom. Tara’s Alzheimer’s cure becomes a major stake in the conflict, with one side arguing for access and another trying to monopolize it for profit. As the battles widen, Surya is forced to confront not only physical threats but also psychological attacks aimed at breaking his sense of belonging. He is repeatedly reminded that strength alone is not enough, because family honor, loyalty, and love are all being tested at once. The conflict deepens when kidnappings and hostage threats force him into impossible choices between revenge and rescue. Surya’s father’s teachings continue to guide him even as grief pushes him toward vengeance after his father’s death. By the end of the arc, Surya is burdened by loss but also recognized as someone who helped preserve the family’s honor. Tara is placed into the role of daughter-in-law, and a senior family member formally entrusts Surya and Tara with the family’s future and legacy.

love-and-betrayal-1.title: Love and Betrayal
love-and-betrayal-1.description: A devoted house-husband secretly a billionaire sacrifices his empire for love, only to be betrayed by his ambitious wife, manipulative lover, and ungrateful children. Cast out and humiliated, he reclaims his true identity as a powerful CEO and sets a calculated revenge in motion—turning their rise into a public, devastating fall.

મારો-ઘર-વગરનો-કરોડપતિ-.title: મારો ઘર વગરનો કરોડપતિ
મારો-ઘર-વગરનો-કરોડપતિ-.description: Facing immense family pressure to marry for her ailing grandmother's last wish, Nayna is publicly humiliated when her fiancé, Nakul, abandons her for another woman. A charming stranger, Samir, steps in as her protector, leading to a temporary contract marriage to fulfill her grandmother's desire. Despite initial awkwardness, a romance develops, but Samir's mysterious past and hidden wealth raise suspicions, particularly from Nayna's sharp-witted grandmother. Nayna, often referred to as Naina, endures repeated public humiliation from her arrogant aunt and ex-boyfriend Nakul, who is now engaged to Riya, exposing deep-seated class disparities. Her partner, sometimes identified as Nayan, dramatically intervenes, revealing hidden wealth and a meticulously planned scheme to defend her. Later, Sameer, who is also revealed to be a powerful club owner and CEO of Jindal Industries, makes grand entrances, confronts rivals, and orchestrates displays of power and generosity. Naina's traumatic past involving Riya and Kali (Nakul) resurfaces, leading to a dangerous power struggle where Sameer fiercely protects her, disarming Kali and accusing him of crimes. Their love is profoundly tested when Sameer is gravely injured, leading to his confession of love and Naina's reciprocation, yet he conceals a dangerous secret life and orchestrates revenge. Corporate intrigue unfolds with a takeover by CEO Aditya, and investigators probe Naina's unexplained wealth and connection to the formidable, unseen CEO of Jindal Industries. Ultimately, Naina discovers Sameer's profound deception regarding his wealth and identity, leading to her rejection of his marriage proposal and his dramatic ultimatum and departure. The series concludes with an unseen Naina's impending wedding to a devoted groom, leaving her romantic future uncertain amidst the lingering mysteries of Sameer's true identity and intentions.

the-tiger-is-back.title: The Tiger Is Back
the-tiger-is-back.description: Amidst Mumbai's chaos, Shiva, an unassuming security guard, is revealed as "Tiger," a legendary vigilante known as "Mumbai ka asli baap," who vows to cleanse the city and protect women. He lives a double life as Ranveer, a humble watchman, to shield his son, Abhi, from his dangerous underworld, a promise made to his late wife. Simultaneously, CEO Priya Deshmukh seeks out and marries Rajveer, the watchman who saved her, though Rajveer immediately sheds his humble persona to investigate Priya, hinting at deeper corporate intrigue. Abhi's world is complicated by his fiancée Shanaya's betrayal, manipulated by Jeet Adwani for corporate gain, leading to the abrupt end of their engagement. Priya, now Abhi's stepmother, initially faces his defiance but asserts her power by firing Shanaya and Jeet, who then reveals his underworld connections and declares a vendetta against her. Rajveer's true identity as an undercover operative and kingmaker in the arms industry, code-named "Tiger," gradually unravels, linked to a priceless "Phoenix Heart Diamond" and syndicate kingpin Rajesh Shinde. He faces accusations of theft and challenges from his past, including a college acquaintance and Priya's class-conscious father, Dhananjay Deshmukh, who orders an assault on him. Despite these threats, Priya fiercely defends Rajveer, solidifying their bond as he consistently rescues her from corporate traps and abduction orchestrated by figures like Gautam. Rajveer orchestrates Priya's rise to a powerful Syndicate seat, further entangling them in high-stakes crime and power. Ultimately, Priya confesses their marriage was a transactional setup for her inheritance, but Rajveer, choosing forgiveness, proposes a genuine union based on true love. Priya's father, Thakur, seeking redemption for past manipulations, acknowledges Rajveer's heroic actions in saving the family. With Thakur's blessing, their journey culminates in a grand public wedding, transforming their story into a heartwarming celebration of family acceptance and a future where their love triumphs over deceit and danger.

madhura-prathikaram.title: Madhura Prathikaram
madhura-prathikaram.description: After catching her husband Arjun with her best friend, Sruthi pretends to lose her memory after an accident. Using her condition, Arjun falsely places her in the life of wealthy CEO George. But as lies deepen, Sruthi secretly begins a dangerous game of revenge.

fc6b2261-c702-4e91-9cb2-5babe0512ba6.title: Fearless Father
fc6b2261-c702-4e91-9cb2-5babe0512ba6.description: Ajay and Rukmini discover their son Rohan’s fiancée Anika is a manipulative fraud involved with another man and a larger conspiracy. After being humiliated and attacked by her, they gather evidence and expose her truth during the engagement, saving Rohan from betrayal and reclaiming their dignity through a calculated revenge. Watch now.

kharidu-mogudu-karabu-pellaam.title: Kharidu Mogudu Karabu Pellaam
kharidu-mogudu-karabu-pellaam.description: వరుణ్ ఆదిత్య.. జీవితం మీద ఒక రకమైన ఉత్సాహంతో టైలర్‌గా పని చేస్తున్నాడు. కానీ జీవితం బాగుండాలంటే ఉత్సాహం ఒక్కటే సరిపోదని అతనికి అర్థమైంది. అలాంటి సమయంలోనే అతని జీవితంలోకి ఒక వ్యక్తి అడుగుపెట్టారు. ఆ పరిచయం వరుణ్ జీవితాన్ని ఊహించని మలుపుల వైపు నడిపిస్తుంది. ప్రేమ, రహస్యాలు, మలుపులతో కూడిన కథ ‘ఖరీదు మొగుడు కరాబు పెళ్ళాం.

heartbroken-server-king.title: Heartbroken Server King
heartbroken-server-king.description: தான் காதலிக்கும் அஞ்சலியின் உயிரைக் காப்பாற்ற தனது கிட்னியை கொடுக்கிறான் நிரஞ்சன். ஆனால் அந்த தியாகத்துக்கு சக்தி பெயர் வாங்கி, அஞ்சலியின் கண்களில் ஹீரோவாக மாறுகிறான். அஞ்சலி தவறான மனிதனை நம்பிக்கொண்டிருக்க, நிரஞ்சன் தனது வலியையும் காதலையும் மறைத்து அவளை அமைதியாக காப்பாற்றிக்கொண்டே இருக்கிறான். உண்மை வெளிவரும்போது, அஞ்சலிக்கு ஒரு கேள்வி மட்டும் மீதமாகிறது: உண்மையாக காதலித்த நிரஞ்சனை அவள் இழந்துவிட்டாளா, இல்லையா இன்னும் அவனை காப்பாற்ற ஒரு வாய்ப்பு இருக்கிறதா? காணுங்கள் KUKU TV-ல் !!!!!

the-undercover-bodyguard.title: The Undercover Bodyguard
the-undercover-bodyguard.description: Elite ex-soldier Ranveer becomes the personal bodyguard of biotech CEO Sanjana after a deadly attack targets her revolutionary formula, “Divine.” As assassins, corporate rivals, and the ruthless Oberoi empire close in, Ranveer risks everything to protect her. Amid violent conspiracies and growing romance, a shocking truth emerges, Ranveer’s mission is also personal, tied to his parents’ murder and the secret behind Divine.

భర్త-భరణం-అడిగితే.title: భర్త భరణం అడిగితే?
భర్త-భరణం-అడిగితే.description: Mana chuttu enno jaruguthunnayi? ee kalam lo andharu pellilu chesukuntunaru inka konni rojulaki bharyalu bharanam aduguthunnaru manchiga life enjoy chesthunaru.! adhe oka magavadu bharanam adigithe ela untundi ? idhe aa katha koncham chudandi.!

ek-tarfa-pyaar.title: Ek Tarfa Pyaar
ek-tarfa-pyaar.description: Talented jewellery artist Vivaan secretly loves his boss Myra and spends years helping build her dream company. But when her former lover Neil returns with an AI-powered design machine, Vivaan is humiliated, replaced, and falsely accused of sabotage. Heartbroken, he leaves and transforms himself into a powerful businessman. As Myra uncovers the truth about his sacrifices and loyalty, she realizes too late that the man she ignored may be lost forever.

दुल्हनिया-के-धोखा.title: दुल्हनिया के धोखा
दुल्हनिया-के-धोखा.description: The story follows Siya and others as they are pulled into repeated clashes with the powerful Johri family, where class pride, family honor, and public image matter as much as the truth. Early on, Siya’s humble presence is set against Reima’s snobbery and entitlement, establishing a world where the less privileged are easily humiliated. That tension quickly spreads into public spaces, including flights and transport, where seat disputes, assaults, and dangerous standoffs expose how aggressively the powerful can behave. Repeated attempts to restore order are blocked by threats, intimidation, and family influence, while witnesses and recordings slowly begin to challenge the false narratives. Reema emerges as a major force in the conflict, using wealth, status, and family backing to protect herself and push her own ambitions. At the same time, Reema’s actions are repeatedly tied to attempts to silence or shame women who stand in her way. The Johri necklace becomes a symbol of belonging, with claims over the heirloom turning into a wider fight over who is worthy of the family name. Identity becomes central when Siya insists she is Krish Johri’s sister, even as others accuse her of being an impostor or intruder. That claim is eventually strengthened by a family heirloom, giving her recognition after a long period of doubt and humiliation. The conflict then deepens into a life-or-death crisis when Siya’s critical heart condition is revealed. Instead of bringing peace, her vulnerability becomes another battleground, as Reema blocks medical help and pushes to remove her from Krish’s life. Krish’s loyalties shift as he begins to protect Siya more openly and demand help for her survival. Around them, assistants, drivers, police, and other allies are drawn into the struggle, showing how far the conflict reaches beyond the family itself. The situation also becomes entangled with accusations of framing, attempted murder, and other crimes, making every confrontation potentially useful as evidence. A pregnancy revelation adds another layer of pressure, but it does not end the fighting or the demand for accountability. By the end of the batch, the marriage plans, family alliances, and public claims are all fractured, and Siya remains determined to stand her ground. Across the whole arc, the central stakes are survival, identity, and the right to be believed in a world ruled by power and humiliation.

wrongly-yours.title: Wrongly Yours
wrongly-yours.description:
She needed ₹60 lakhs to save her sister.
He pretended to be poor to test her.
A contract marriage turns into love but his biggest lie could destroy everything.

single-hand-cricketer.title: SINGLE HAND CRICKETER
single-hand-cricketer.description: On the day Sachin Malhotra was meant to play his first big match, his parents died in an accident — and he was taken. Years later, Sachin returns with one arm, one dream, and a secret that could destroy the people who took everything from him. This is a story of Sachin — a boy who lost his family, his arm, and his name, but never lost the one shot his brother taught him.

नौकर-बनेला-जब-मालिक.title: नौकर बनेला जब मालिक
नौकर-बनेला-जब-मालिक.description: Ek nanhi bacchi ke jaan khatre me ba, aur okra bachave ke ek hi doctor ba. Jab doctor hospital jaat rahe, tab raaste me kuchh ameer aur ghamandi log uske rok det hai. Samay haath se nikalta jaa raha ba. Ego aur insaaniyat ke beech jung me, ek faisla sab kuch badal sakta ba.

the-leo-returns.title: The Leo Returns
the-leo-returns.description: ఆర్మీలో పనిచేసే విక్రం సింహా… తనకు సహాయం చేసిన ఒక కుటుంబం కోసం జీవితంలో పెద్ద నిర్ణయం తీసుకుంటాడు. కానీ ఆ నిర్ణయమే అతనికి అనేక అవమానాలు, ఊహించని సమస్యలను తెచ్చిపెడుతుంది. ఇంతకీ విక్రం చేసిన పని ఏంటి? ముగ్గురు అమ్మాయిలు అతని జీవితాన్ని ఎలా మార్చారు? ఆసక్తికరమైన మలుపులతో సాగిపోయే కథ ఇది.

7f773351-307c-45ff-883d-a5e1a5b2c9ac.title: The Challenger
7f773351-307c-45ff-883d-a5e1a5b2c9ac.description: Sonia, a powerful CEO, shocks everyone by revealing her pregnancy with her lover Sunny, humiliating her husband Kabir. As Kabir is thrown out and branded impotent, he uncovers Sunny’s fraud and returns to expose the truth. In a dramatic showdown, Kabir reveals his real identity as a billionaire CEO, proves Sonia was never pregnant, and brings Sunny’s lies to light, reclaiming his dignity and choosing a new path. Watch now.

my-sweetheart-kaadhali.title: My Sweetheart Kaadhali
my-sweetheart-kaadhali.description: மதுபோதையில் நடந்த ஒரு நிகழ்வால் கர்ப்பமாகும் சக்தி, பிறந்த இரட்டைக் குழந்தைகள் இறந்துவிட்டதாக நம்ப வைக்கப்படுகிறாள்.பல வருடங்களுக்குப் பிறகு, இரண்டு குழந்தைகளுடன் இருக்கும் ஒரு ஏழை டாக்ஸி டிரைவரை திருமணம் செய்கிறாள்; ஆனால் அவர் மாறுவேடத்தில் இருக்கும் கோடீஸ்வரர் என்பது அவளுக்குத் தெரியாது.அந்த குழந்தைகளின் மச்சம் உண்மையை வெளிப்படுத்த, தங்கையின் கொடூர சதியால் திருடப்பட்ட தன் குடும்பத்தை சக்தி மீண்டும் பெறுவாளா? காணுங்கள் KUKU TV-ல் !!

75d7a53e-a015-4d08-bd5c-9cf2f31804c9.title: Big Bull Returns 2.0
75d7a53e-a015-4d08-bd5c-9cf2f31804c9.description: Kabir, once dismissed as weak, is secretly a powerful CEO betrayed by his ambitious wife Sonia, who falls for a conman, Sunny. As deception unravels, Kabir rises from humiliation to reclaim his identity, exposing lies and seeking justice with the help of Meghna, ultimately turning betrayal into a path of strength and redemption. Watch now.

the-ultimate-return-2.title: The Ultimate Return
the-ultimate-return-2.description: The Ultimate Return is a high-octane power drama where a man written off as a loser is revealed as Leo—the unseen kingmaker controlling billion-dollar empires. As ruthless heirs, corrupt elites, and broken relationships collide, love, ambition, and revenge play out in a brutal succession battle where power bows only to truth and courage.

4352c347-630a-49f2-8a6b-6901624a1ad1.title: Ultimate Protector
4352c347-630a-49f2-8a6b-6901624a1ad1.description: A seemingly lowly tarot card reader, underestimated and divorced by his ambitious wife, reveals his hidden influence as the "Ultimate Protector" when he remarries a powerful pharmaceutical heiress and uses his secret connections to dominate the business world.

last-avenger-1.title: Last Avenger
last-avenger-1.description: Vivaan’s story begins as a humiliation-to-destiny arc, with sacred trials and public judgments repeatedly trying to prove him powerless. Early on, the Karma Union and the Kapoor side dominate the field, using tests, threats, and alliances to decide who may touch legendary power. Vivaan is first branded unworthy by a stone test, but that verdict does not hold, because his hidden strength erupts in ways that shock the people around him. As accusations of fraud, family disgrace, and even death sentences pile up, the line between spiritual prophecy and personal vendetta becomes increasingly blurred. The search for the true wielder of the Karamati/Karamat Vaal and related sacred objects becomes the central conflict. At the same time, Vivaan’s mission is tied to revenge, recovery of divine weapons, and the mystery of his parents’ deaths. He is mocked as unstable or mad, yet those labels are repeatedly overturned when he survives poison, identifies medicine correctly, and demonstrates abilities others did not expect. Protective figures such as Maya, Preethi, Anjana, Tejaswini, Arushi, and others keep trying to shield him, even as their efforts draw them into coercion, blackmail, and public shame. Corporate struggles become inseparable from the mystical plot, with shares, product scandals, auctions, and compensation demands all turning into weapons in the larger war. Vivaan’s choices often look reckless or deceptive, but the digests suggest he is hiding his true mission in order to survive among enemies. Rival claimants like Ravi, Dhruv, and other powerful figures repeatedly challenge his right to the sacred inheritance, while councils and assemblies keep trying to control the outcome. The story widens from family conflict into factional warfare, with regional champions, crime-linked rivals, and council leaders all competing over the Divyamani and related artifacts. Vivaan proves himself in combat more than once, defeating challengers and forcing others to recognize that he is not an ordinary outsider. Yet every victory seems to raise the stakes, because each artifact awakens larger forces and deeper threats. By the later stretch, imperial power enters the conflict, using hostage pressure and execution threats to neutralize him. Vivaan refuses to abandon the people he protects, especially Preethi, even when that loyalty makes him vulnerable. The arrival of divine beings and other mythic forces confirms that his struggle has moved beyond family rivalry or corporate control into a far larger cosmic contest. Across the whole arc, the core stakes remain survival, identity, revenge, and the question of whether Vivaan is cursed, chosen, or both.

asalaina-racing-king.title: ASALAINA RACING KING
asalaina-racing-king.description: A fallen racing champion loses everything after his adopted brother betrays him, rigs a race, kills their parents, and steals his crown. Years later, he returns in disguise as a humble mechanic and joins a struggling racing club. Forced back onto the track, he must face his past, defeat his betrayer, and reclaim his destiny.

30393053-a286-4f31-a3f2-8c5d35a73286.title: Shubh Talaaq Saavadhaan
30393053-a286-4f31-a3f2-8c5d35a73286.description: Poor farmer Shri’s world shatters when his estranged wife Mala returns after years, not for love, but to divorce Shri, seize his ancestral land, and erase every connection to their daughter Tripti. Humiliated and treated as worthless, Shri quietly endures every betrayal while protecting his family’s dignity. But beneath his simple life lies a shocking secret: he is the hidden founder of a powerful agricultural empire, and Tripti has risen to become an ISRO scientist.

arjuna-the-legend.title: Arjuna The Legend
arjuna-the-legend.description: After faking his disappearance from the Chandra Vamsha army, the legendary archer Arjuna lives in disguise as a humble servant to fulfill his dying guru’s last wish , protecting his guru’s daughter and granddaughter. But when greed, betrayal, and deadly warriors threaten to destroy the Gurukul, Arjuna must decide whether to remain hidden… or rise.

accidental-wife-s2.title: Accidental wife S2
accidental-wife-s2.description: Oru car accident la comaku poitan bairav. avanukku coma laye parikara kalyanam panni vaikuranga. Meendu vanthavan wifea paathu unaku eppo marriage aachu nu kekuran! ava solla thayangura! intha vithiyasamana kaathal kathaiya  unga kuku fm-la kelunga

മിഴിയോരം.title: മിഴിയോരം
മിഴിയോരം.description: തീമഴ പോലുള്ള അനുഭവങ്ങളിലൂടെ നന‍ഞ്ഞുകയറിയ ഒരു പെൺകുട്ടിയെ കേന്ദ്രകഥാപാത്രമാക്കി എഴുതപ്പെട്ട അതിഗംഭീര റൊമാന്റിക് ഫാമിലി നോവൽ. വായനക്കാരുടെ പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട നോവലിസ്റ്റ് ജോയ്സിയുടെ മറ്റൊരു മാസ്റ്റർപീസ്.

god-of-badminton.title: God of Badminton
god-of-badminton.description: God of Badminton explores the mystery of the "Cobra Smash," an incredibly powerful and seemingly impossible badminton shot that burns the court at Everest Badminton Academy. Coach Sunil frantically searches for the anonymous player, believing them to be the future "greatest player in the world." Suspicion falls on Abhay, the quiet, poor canteen worker, who is constantly taunted by senior players like Namit and Gaurav. Coach Sunil struggles to accept that a canteen worker could possess such talent, all while being pressured by a mysterious "Madam" who urgently needs the prodigy for the academy's success. The series delves into the conflict between poverty and hidden potential, the intense jealousy among players, and the unraveling secret of the 'impossible' shot.

ചന്ദ്രഭാഗ.title: ചന്ദ്രഭാഗ
ചന്ദ്രഭാഗ.description: നാളുകളായി തന്നെ അലട്ടുന്ന ദു:സ്വപ്നത്തിലെ  ഭയാനകരൂപത്തെ നേരിട്ട് കാണുന്നതോടെ ജയദേവൻ എന്ന പാരസൈക്കോളജി ഗവേഷണ വിദ്യാർത്ഥി അവന്റെ സ്വന്തം തറവാട്ടിലേയ്ക്ക് ഒരു യാത്ര പോകുന്നു. മാന്ത്രിക - താന്ത്രിക വിധികൾക്ക് പേര് കേട്ട, വെളൂർക്കരയിലെ പെരിങ്ങോട്ട് മനയിലേയ്ക്ക്. അവിടെ അയാളെ കാത്തിരുന്നതാകട്ടെ , തലമുറകൾക്ക് മുൻപ് മണ്മറഞ്ഞ ആത്മാക്കളും. ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന അത്യുഗ്രൻ ഫാൻ്റസി  ....

சந்திர-மோகினி-.title: சந்திர மோகினி
சந்திர-மோகினி-.description: 1000 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன்னர், ஒரு கிராமத்தையே அழிக்க முயன்ற சந்திர மோகினி எனும் தீய சக்தியை பற்றி சில கல்லூரி நண்பர்கள் அறிந்து கொள்கிறார்கள். அந்த தீய சக்தியின் செயல்பாடுகள் மீண்டும் தொடர்வதை கண்டு அதிர்ந்து போகிறாக்கள்.

understand-the-cold-war-teach-yourself.title: Understand The Cold War: Teach Yourself
understand-the-cold-war-teach-yourself.description: Yeh audiobook Cold War ki kahani ko simple aur engaging tareeke se samjhata hai. World War II ke baad America aur Soviet Union ke beech shuru hui power rivalry ne duniya ki politics, nuclear race aur global relations ko kaise badla, iss series mein aap Cold War ke major events aur uske impact ko aasani se samajh payenge.

wonder-girl-emma.title: Wonder Girl Emma
wonder-girl-emma.description:
After a devastating public rejection leaves her humiliated and unconscious, Emma awakens with an impossible gift—she can literally see through anything. Lottery tickets, priceless gems, forged antiques, and even human bodies all reveal their secrets to her enhanced vision.
As Emma transforms from a scorned shop girl to a feared power player, her supernatural abilities attract the attention of rival jewelry dynasties and a mysterious Institute connected to her family's past. With ancient Tudor manuscripts hinting at the source of her powers and enemies closing in from all sides, Emma must master her growing abilities while deciding who deserves her loyalty in a world where everyone wears a mask.

love-unbound.title: Love Unbound
love-unbound.description: When Naomi receives a keycard to suite 2320 at The Savoy, she walks straight into her past nightmare: Adrian Rothschild, the powerful billionaire who once claimed her for a night to save her husband's family business. Now, as her marriage crumbles under the weight of betrayal and abuse, Adrian has returned—not just for revenge, but to claim what he believes was always his. Trapped between her violent husband Henry, his manipulative parents who'll stop at nothing to preserve appearances, and Adrian's relentless pursuit, Naomi finds herself drawn to the very man she once feared. In this explosive tale of power, passion and revenge, sometimes the most dangerous path is the one straight to your enemy's heart.

banayen-ek-shandaar-career.title: Banayen Ek Shandaar Career
banayen-ek-shandaar-career.description: Build an Epic Career, Ankur Warikoo shows you how to turn your career into a meaningful journey, not just a job. Learn how to make smart choices, build valuable skills, manage self-doubt, and focus on long-term growth. Gain clarity, confidence, and take charge of building a truly epic career.

black-and-british.title: Black and British
black-and-british.description: ಡೆವಿಡ್ ಓಲುಸೋಗಾ ಅವರ "Black and British" ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಒಂದು ಮರೆಯಾದ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯವನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುವ ಶಕ್ತಿಯುತ ಕೃತಿ. ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಕೇವಲ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಪಾಠವಲ್ಲ, ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಇಂದಿನ ಜಾತಿಯ ತಾರತಮ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಚಿಂತಿಸಲು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುವ ಒಂದು ಮಹತ್ವದ ಕಸುಬು. ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಮರೆಯಾಗಿರುವ ಅಸಲಿ ಸತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು, KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ

buddhism-in-a-week-teach-yourself.title: Buddhism In A Week: Teach Yourself
buddhism-in-a-week-teach-yourself.description: Buddhism In A Week: Teach Yourself mein Clive Erricker aapko sirf saat dinon mein Bauddh dharm ki buniyadi shiksha samjhate hain. Buddha ka jeevan, Four Noble Truths, Eightfold Path, dhyaan, karma aur mindfulness ko asaan bhasha mein samjhaya gaya hai. Yeh audiobook beginners ke liye perfect hai jo jeevan mein shaanti aur spashtata lana chahte hain.

సోషల్-మీడియా.title: సోషల్ మీడియా
సోషల్-మీడియా.description: సోషల్ మీడియాలో హాయిగా కంటెంట్ క్రియేట్ చేస్తూ సాగిపోతున్న సాకేత్, నిఖితల మధ్యలో చిచ్చుపెట్టింది ఎవరు? నిఖితపై సాకేత్ కి ఉన్నది స్నేహమా, ప్రేమనా..? కంటెంట్ క్రియేటర్లకు అమ్మాయిలు ఈజీగా పడిపోతారా..? అందుకే సాకేత్ తప్పు చేసాడా..? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి 'సోషల్ మీడియా' సిరీస్ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

i-love-you-teacher.title: I Love You Teacher
i-love-you-teacher.description:
38 ఏళ్ల వందన రెడ్డి, రాజకీయ నాయకుడు రవి వర్మ భార్యగా నిరాశభరితమైన జీవితం గడుపుతుంటుంది. ఆమె తన 22 ఏళ్ల విద్యార్థి కార్తిక్తో అకస్మాత్తుగా ఒక ప్రబలమైన ప్రేమాయణంలోకి జారుకుంటుంది. వారి సంబంధం వెనుక కోరిక, ఆతృత, ప్రమాదం ముడిపడి ఉంటాయి. ప్రేమ ఒక మధుర మాయగా మొదలై, త్వరలోనే రాజకీయ కుట్రల, బ్లాక్‌మెయిల్, శత్రుత్వం, హత్యా కుట్రలలో చిక్కుకుంటుంది.

రవి వర్మ తన భార్యపై నిఘా పెట్టడం మొదలుపెడతాడు. ఈ వ్యవహారాన్ని తన ప్రయోజనానికి వాడుకోవాలని చూస్తాడు.

lady-boss-returns-6.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns-6.description: Lady Boss Return explores love, betrayal, and revenge through the journey of Kiara Bhansali, a self-made billionaire who hides her identity to test loyalty and integrity — and ends up meeting Tej Jaisingh, an ambitious CEO caught between love and legacy. Their accidental meeting spirals into a whirlwind of mistaken identities, class clashes, fake marriages, and boardroom battles — until Kiara’s true power as the “Sky Queen” turns the game upside down.

8020-sales-and-marketing.title: 80/20 Sales and Marketing
8020-sales-and-marketing.description: ಪೆರಿ ಮಾರ್ಷಲ್ ಅವರ "80/20 Sales and Marketing" ಪುಸ್ತಕವು, ಕಡಿಮೆ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಪರೇಟೋ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತವನ್ನು (80/20 ನಿಯಮ) ಹೇಗೆ ಬಳಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ, ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ವೀಕ್ಷಕರ ತಲುಪುವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ತಂತ್ರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯದ ಸದುಪಯೋಗ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಈ ಕೃತಿ ನಿಖರವಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ 80% ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವು 20% ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದಿಂದ ಸಾಧ್ಯ ಎಂಬ ಈ ತತ್ವವನ್ನು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡರೆ, ನೀವು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಲಾಭಶೀಲರಾಗಬಹುದು. ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟಿಂಗ್ ತಂತ್ರಗಳು, ಮಾರಾಟದ ಸುಗಮ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮರ್ಥ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಅಂಶಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ವ್ಯವಹಾರವನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟವನ್ನು ಗಗನಕ್ಕೇರಿಸಲು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ!

Bruce-Lee-എതിരില്ലാത്ത-ഇതിഹാസം-.title: Bruce Lee- എതിരില്ലാത്ത ഇതിഹാസം
Bruce-Lee-എതിരില്ലാത്ത-ഇതിഹാസം-.description: ബാല്യത്തിൽ ഒരു പ്രൊഫഷണൽ നർത്തകനാകാൻ അവൻ  ആഗ്രഹിച്ചു, എന്നാൽ ജീവിതം അവനെ ഒരു ഇതിഹാസയുദ്ധത്തിന് രൂപപ്പെടുത്തുകയായിരുന്നു. പിന്നീടവൻ ലോകമെമ്പാടും കോടിക്കണക്കിനു ആരാധകരെ സ്വന്തമാക്കി; വെറും 32 വയസ്സിൽ വിടവാങ്ങിയെങ്കിലും, ഇന്നും  ആരാധക ഹൃദയങ്ങളിൽ അവൻ അനശ്വരനാണ്. അവന്റെ പേര് ബ്രൂസ് ലീ.

gambling-god.title: Gambling God
gambling-god.description:
Ek raat ki gambling ne Aryan se uske maa-baap ki saari zindagi bhar ki kamai cheen li. Sharam aur guilt mein dooba Aryan jab zindagi khatam karne jaata hai, tab uska pita Vikram use ek khatarnak casino ki andheri duniya mein le jaata hai.

Ab daav par sirf paisa nahi… baap-bete ki izzat, himmat aur zindagi lagi hai. Kya Vikram apne bete ko barbaadi se bacha payega?

മാടനും-മറുതയും-ചാത്തന്മാരും.title: മാടനും മറുതയും ചാത്തന്മാരും
മാടനും-മറുതയും-ചാത്തന്മാരും.description: കേരളീയ സംസ്ക്കാര- ചരിത്രങ്ങളുടെ ഭാഗമായ തനത് ദൈവങ്ങളുടെ- വിശ്വാസങ്ങളുടെ നേരം പൊരുളും അറിയാം. ചാത്തൻ, മാടൻ, മറുത ഈ സങ്കല്പങ്ങളുടെ ഉത്പത്തിയും സാരവും വിശദമായി പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്ന ഓഡിയോ ബുക്ക് കേൾക്കാം..

kaaman-the-story-of-vatsayana.title: Kaaman - The story of Vatsayana
kaaman-the-story-of-vatsayana.description:
என்னது காமசூத்ராவை எழுதினது ஒரு துறவியா?
எதுவுமே புரியலையா?
அவரோட லைஃப்க்குள்ள போய் பார்த்தா தானே என்ன நடந்துச்சுன்னு தெளிவா புரியும். அப்படின்னா பொறுமையா இதை  கேளுங்க.

sach-kahun-toh.title: Sach Kahun Toh
sach-kahun-toh.description: Sach Kahun Toh is a deeply personal and emotional journey through truth, relationships, and self-discovery. The book explores hidden fears, unspoken feelings, and the courage it takes to confront reality. Through layered storytelling and honest reflections, it reveals how truth can hurt, heal, and ultimately transform lives.

matte-matthe-tejaswi.title: Matte Matthe Tejaswi
matte-matthe-tejaswi.description: ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಪ್ರಿಯರಿಗೆ 'ಪೂಚಂತೇ' ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೇವಲ‌ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಾ, ಅದೊಂದು ಭಕ್ತಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಶಕ್ತಿ! ಅವರ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೃತಿ ಕೂಡ ತುಂಬಾ ಆಪ್ತ ಎನಿಸುತ್ತೆ! ಅರೆ, ತೇಜಸ್ವಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಸುತ್ತಮುತ್ತಲೇ ಇದ್ದಾರೇನೋ ಎನಿಸುವಂಥ ಭಾವ ಮೂಡುತ್ತೆ! ಮಲೆನಾಡಿನ ಮಡಿಲಲ್ಲಿ, ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ಸೊಬಗನ್ನ ಆರಾಧಿಸುತ್ತಾ, ಲೇಖನಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ‌ ಅಕ್ಷರ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನ ಬೆಳಗಿದ 'ಪೂರ್ಣಚಂದ್ರ ತೇಜಸ್ವಿ' ಅವರ ಕೃತಿಗಳನ್ನ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಓದಬೇಕೆನಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಪಾಕಕ್ರಾಂತಿ, ಜುಗಾರಿ ಕ್ರಾಸ್, ಚಿದಂಬರ ರಹಸ್ಯ, ಪರಿಸರದ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಅವರ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕವೂ ಒಂದು ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್ ಪೀಸ್! ಅಂಥ ಕವಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡದ ದಿಗ್ಗಜರು, ಪುಸ್ತಕಪ್ರಿಯರು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದೇನು? ಅವರನ್ನ ಕಾಡಿದ್ದೇನು? ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ತೇಜಸ್ವಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

your-brain-on-porn-14.title: Your Brain on Porn
your-brain-on-porn-14.description: ಪೋರ್ನ್ ನೋಡುವುದು ನಿಮಗೆ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಇದೇಯೇ? ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಈ ವಿನಾಶಕಾರಿ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ನಿಮಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ತುಂಬಾ ತೊಂದರೆಗಳನ್ನು ತರಬಹುದು. ಈ ದಿನವೇ ಪೋರ್ನ್ ನೋಡುವೆ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಗುಡ್ ಬೈ ಹೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಯೆಶಸನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ. ಕೇಳಿ ಈ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ "Your ಬ್ರೈನ್ on porn "  ಕೇವಲ ಕುಕು FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ...

dhurandhar-child-king-returns-1.title: Dhurandhar - Child King Returns
dhurandhar-child-king-returns-1.description: Wo tha duniya ke liye dehati, par uski rooh mein 1000 saal purane Chandravanshi Yuvraj ki shakti jal rahi hai. Jab uska apna khoon uski maut ka farmaan likhta hai, Keshav Gupt Vidya, pracheen ran-neeti aur rahasyamayi Garud Dal ke saath andhere se apna uday rachata hai. Yeh sirf badle ki kahani nahi, yeh ek bachche ke haathon likhi ja rahi nayi saltanat ki dastaan hai.

ஆன்மாவின்-காதல்-.title: ஆன்மாவின் காதல்
ஆன்மாவின்-காதல்-.description: இறந்த காதலனின் ஆன்மாவிற்கும், உயிரோடு இருக்கும் பெண்ணிற்கும் இடையே நிகழும் காதலும் காமமும் தான் கதை...

jeevan-ke-adbhut-rahasya.title: Jeevan Ke Adbhut Rahasya
jeevan-ke-adbhut-rahasya.description:
In today’s fast-paced life, the constant rush and stress have made us forget what it truly means to live. In this audiobook, Gaur Gopal Das shares simple and relatable stories that teach how to bring balance, peace, and purpose back into life. It beautifully explains how to maintain harmony between work, relationships, and self.
 If you want to make your life more meaningful and peaceful, listen to this audiobook now.

puriyadha-pudhir-season-3.title: Puriyadha Pudhir  S 3
puriyadha-pudhir-season-3.description: Oru Munnani IT niruvanathil , Niralpeyaraalar Raajev moondru sagodharigalaana Rani , vichitra mattrum rakeshai oru araiyil irandhu kidandhadhai kandupudikkirar . Inspector surendhar visaaranai seigiraarb . Yaar andha kolaiyaali , epadi kolai nadandhadhu ?

my-ex-boyfriend.title: My Ex Boyfriend
my-ex-boyfriend.description: Mageshum Priya vum breakup ku apram sandhithukolgirargal . Meendum kaadhal varugiradhu , kaamam varugiradhu . Irandu per veetil theriya varugiradhu . Irandu perum seruvaargalaa ?

isro-a-personal-history-1.title: ISRO: A Personal History
isro-a-personal-history-1.description: ISRO: A Personal History shares the inside story of India’s space program through R. Aravamudan’s personal experiences. It traces the early days when big dreams were pursued despite limited resources. From rockets and satellites to landmark missions, this audiobook highlights the dedication, teamwork, and leadership behind ISRO’s rise. A powerful and inspiring account of science, perseverance, and national pride.

the-souls-of-balck-folk.title: The Souls of Black Folk
the-souls-of-balck-folk.description: ಡಬ್ಲ್ಯೂ .ಈ.ಬಿ . ಡು ಬೋಯಿಸ್ ಅವರ "ದಿ ಸೋಲ್ಸ್ ಆಫ್ ಬ್ಲ್ಯಾಕ್ ಫೋಕ್" ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ಆಫ್ರಿಕನ್-ಅಮೆರಿಕನ್ನರ ಜೀವನ, ಅವರ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಹೋರಾಟಗಳ ಆಳವಾದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಕೃತಿ. 1903ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಜಾತ್ಯಾತೀತತೆ, ದ್ವಂದ್ವಚೇತನ (Double Consciousness) ಮತ್ತು ವೈಷಮ್ಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸವಾಲು ಹಾಕುವ ಗ್ರಂಥವಾಗಿದೆ. ಡು ಬೋಯಿಸ್ ತಮ್ಮ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಕಪ್ಪು ಜನಾಂಗದ ಆಳವಾದ ಆತ್ಮಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ತೀವ್ರವಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ನಾಗರಿಕ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳ ಚಳುವಳಿಗೆ ದಾರಿ ಹಚ್ಚಿದ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಕೃತಿಗಳಲ್ಲೊಂದು. ಕಪ್ಪು ಜನಾಂಗದ ಚರಿತ್ರೆ, ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅವರನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ತಾರತಮ್ಯಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಆಳವಾದ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನವನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿ, ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಪ್ರಾಸಕ್ತಿಯುತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FMಅಲ್ಲಿ.

ഏകാകിനി.title: ഏകാകിനി
ഏകാകിനി.description: നഗരത്തിലെ മൂന്ന് സ്കൂൾ വിദ്യാർത്ഥിനികളുടെ തുടർച്ചയായ ദുരൂഹ ആത്മഹത്യകൾക്കു പിന്നിലെ അതീന്ദ്രിയ സാന്നിധ്യം അന്വേഷിക്കാൻ ഫോറൻസിക് ഓഫീസർ അനിരുദ്ധനും പാരാസൈക്കോളജിസ്റ്റ് സുപർണ്ണയും ഒരുമിക്കുന്നു. എല്ലാ മരണങ്ങളിലും  സംശയാസ്പദമായ ഒരു പെൻഡ്രൈവ് ഉണ്ടെന്ന കണ്ടെത്തലിൽ നിന്ന് അന്വേഷണങ്ങൾ   ഭ്രാന്താശുപത്രിയിൽ കഴിയുന്ന സിന്ധു എന്ന പെൺകുട്ടിയിലേക്ക് എത്തുന്നു. മരണങ്ങൾക്ക് പിന്നിലെ രഹസ്യങ്ങൾ പുറത്ത് വരുമ്പോൾ,   വെളിപ്പെടുന്നത് അത്യന്തം ഭയാനകമായ സത്യങ്ങളായിരുന്നു  …

brahmarakshas-3.title: Brahmarakshas
brahmarakshas-3.description:
Dumgharh - Ek aisa gaon jahan ladki ke roop mein janam lena aur shadi karna kisi abhishap se kam nahin.Yahan khamoshi se shadi karna ya ladkiyon ko kuara rakhna hi gaon walon ke liye ek matra rasta bacha unhein uss saye se bachane ka jise log Brahamrakshash kehte hain.
Lekin fir Dumgarh mein aye ek bekhouf ladki Ira jo ek paranormal expert hai. Kya Ira vedon aur granthon ke mahan gyani Brahmrakshas per bhari padeigi? Kya Dumgharh ko mileiga chutkara Brahmrakshash ke atyachaar se?

guardians-of-gaia.title: Guardians of Gaia
guardians-of-gaia.description: வேற்றுகிரகவாசிகளால் கிரகம் அழிக்கப்படுவதைத் தடுக்க முயற்சிக்கும் ஒரு விஞ்ஞானியும் பேசும் மரமும்.

vaidehi-dhwani.title: Vaidehi Dhwani
vaidehi-dhwani.description: ವೈದೇಹಿ ಧ್ವನಿ - ವೈದೇಹಿ, ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನನ್ಯ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆಯಾದ ಲೇಖಕಿ, ತಮ್ಮ ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾದ ಶೈಲಿ, ಆಳವಾದ ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನಸತ್ಯದ ನುಡಿಗಳಿಂದ ಓದುಗರ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಗೆದ್ದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. "ವೈದೇಹಿ ಧ್ವನಿ" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಅವರ ಅಮೋಘ ಬರಹಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಹೊಸತಾದ ಅನುಭವದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

loves-second-chance.title: Billionaire Ex se Badla
loves-second-chance.description: The moment he learns about his last-stage cancer, Daksh Oberoi, the youngest billionaire, makes a life-changing decision. He sells his entire empire and invests the money in the struggling Malhotra Empire — the company owned by his girlfriend, Kiara. Determined to hide his illness and protect her from pain, Daksh even goes as far as staging a false breakup, pushing her away for her own happiness. But will Kiara be able to save Daksh’s life when the truth finally comes out?

கந்தர்வகோட்டை.title: கந்தர்வகோட்டை
கந்தர்வகோட்டை.description: Sudhandhira poraata kaalathil oru british manidhar tamilnaatilirundhu vairam mattrum pira selvangalai thirudi avatrai oru periya maaligaiyil maraikkirar pinnar andha selvangalukkaga pidipadugirar . Avaradhu aathmaavum andha puthaiyalum ondraaga aagiradhu .

islam-an-introduction-teach-yourself.title: Islam - An Introduction: Teach Yourself
islam-an-introduction-teach-yourself.description: Islam – An Introduction: Teach Yourself by Rosalyn Rushbrook (Ruqaiyyah Waris Maqsood) offers a clear and accessible overview of Islam. This audiobook explores its history, core beliefs, the life of Prophet Muhammad, the Qur’an, and the Five Pillars. It also addresses common questions about modern issues, helping listeners gain a balanced and informed understanding of Islam today

അപ്സരസ്സ്.title: അപ്സരസ്സ്
അപ്സരസ്സ്.description: ലഹരിയിൽ മുങ്ങിയ ഒരു രാത്രി  വെള്ളച്ചാട്ടത്തിന് സമീപം കണ്ട ആ ദുരൂഹ സുന്ദരി ഋഷിയുടെ ജീവിതത്തിൽ ഒരു ഒഴിയാബാധ ആയി തീരുന്നു. വർഷങ്ങൾക്ക് ശേഷം അവന്റെ കൂട്ടുകാരൻ  മസൂദിനും അതേ  അനുഭവം ഉണ്ടാകുന്നതോടെ അവർ ഒരുമിച്ച് അതിന്റെ സത്യാന്വേഷണത്തിനായി ഇറങ്ങുന്നു. അവരെ വലയിലാക്കിയ ആ  അപ്സരസ്സിന്റെ പിടിയിൽ നിന്ന് അവർ രക്ഷപ്പെടുമോ?, അതോ എന്നന്നേക്കുമായി അവളുടെ പിടിയിൽ അകപ്പെടുമോ ? കേൾക്കാം അപ്സരസ്സ്...

nee-vandha-pinne.title: Nee vandha pinne
nee-vandha-pinne.description: A romance between a forty-year-old woman and a twenty-eight-year-old boy.

beghar-raja-5.title: Beghar Raja
beghar-raja-5.description: Rajkumari Devangana ko ek bhikhari Veerendra se pyar ho jata hai, par iske liye Devangana ka pariwar use ghar se nikal deta hai. Devangana ko ye pata nahi hai ki jise wo Bhikhari samajh rahi hai, wo asal mein Rudragarh ka Rajkumar hai jispe use apne hi bhai Maharaj Rudra ko marne ka ilzam hai, aur jo Rudragarh se farar hai. Par kya sach mein Veerendra hi hai apne bhai ka khooni? Kya hoga jab Devangana ko pata chalega Veerendra ka sach? Kya Beghar Veerendra kabhi ban payega Rudragarh ka Raja?

ஆண்மை-தவறேல்.title: ஆண்மை தவறேல்...
ஆண்மை-தவறேல்.description: Edhirpaaradha Soozhnilayil , Paaliyal thozhilaaliyidam sendru iravai kazhikkum aan magan, than udaluravu kollum thiranai izhandhu vidugiraan . Adharkkana kaaranathai thedi alaigiraan .

indian-startups.title: Indian Startups
indian-startups.description: భారతదేశంలోని స్టార్టప్‌లు కొత్త ఆవిష్కరణలు, సాంకేతికతలో అభివృద్ధి మరియు వృద్ధికి కట్టుబడి ఉంటాయి. ఇవి యువతకు అవకాశాలను సృష్టించడంలో కీలకపాత్ర పోషిస్తున్నాయి. స్టార్టప్‌లు స్థానిక అవసరాలను గుర్తించి, ప్రపంచ వ్యాప్తంగా విస్తరించేందుకు కృషి చేస్తున్నాయి.

raja-rani-secrets-of-the-beggar-king-3.title: Bhikhari Raja
raja-rani-secrets-of-the-beggar-king-3.description: Rani Manimangla ko pichhle janm mein uski apni hi behen tarika ne maar diya tha. Is janam mein swayamwar ke dauran Tarika phir se dhokhe se uski shadi ek bhikhari Dheeran se kara deti hai, par kisi ko pata nahi hota ki Dheeran asal mein ek Raja hai, jo bhesh badal kar wahan aaya hai. Kya hoga jab Tarika aur Manimangla ko pata chalega Dheeran ka sach? Kya Manimangla legi Tarka se uske paapon ka badla? Kyon apni pehchan chhupa raha hai Dheeran? Tarika aur Manimangla ki dushmani ka kya hai sach?

blood-diamonds-and-dirty-gold.title: Blood Diamonds and Dirty Gold
blood-diamonds-and-dirty-gold.description:
ప్రపంచంలో ఎన్నో రహస్యాలు దాగి ఉన్నాయి, కానీ వాటిలో కొన్ని నిజాలు మన అందరిని షాక్‌కి గురి చేస్తాయి. బంగారం, వజ్రాల వ్యాపారం కేవలం విలాసవంతమైన వస్తువులుగా భావించబడుతుంటే, వాస్తవం మాత్రం మునుపు మనస్సు గడ్డెక్కించే దాగి ఉన్నది.

ఈ గోల్డ్ మరియు డైమండ్ మాఫియా వ్యాపారం ప్రపంచంలో అత్యంత దారుణమైన రూపాల్లో వర్థిల్లుతోంది. వెనుక వున్న అనేక శ్రామికులు, అనేక వలస కార్మికులు, వారి స్వేచ్ఛను కోల్పోయి శాశ్వతంగా బందీగా మార్చబడ్డారు. ఈ వ్యవహారం జాతీయ సరిహద్దులు, మరింతగా ఖండాల మించిన ప్రదేశాల్లో కూడా పెరుగుతోంది.

the-ashes.title: The Ashes
the-ashes.description: "ఆషెస్" అనేది క్రికెట్ లో ఇంగ్లాండ్ మరియు ఆస్ట్రేలియా మధ్య అత్యంత ప్రతిష్టాత్మకమైన మరియు ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన సిరీస్. ఈ పోటీలో జట్లు ఒకరినొకరు గెలుచుకోవడానికి ఎంతో పోరాటం చేస్తారు. దీని విజయాన్ని సాధించడమే, క్రికెట్ ప్రేమికులకు జీవన అనుభవం కావడం.

active-parenting-1.title: Active Parenting
active-parenting-1.description: This audiobook is a practical and empowering guide that simplifies modern parenting. It offers real solutions to everyday parental challenges, helping parents understand children’s emotions and behavior better. More than just tips, it presents a mindful approach to building a strong, joyful, and healthy parent-child bond.

aakasham-erraga-vundhi.title: Aakasham Erraga Vundhi
aakasham-erraga-vundhi.description: వైజాగ్ బీచ్ లో చీకటి రహస్యాలు… వాటిని ఛేదించేందుకు డైనమిక్ డిటెక్టివ్  రామచంద్ర, అతని అసిస్టెంట్  స్వాతి  సిద్ధం!  ఎన్నో హఠాత్తు మలుపులతో,  వినూత్నమైన  హాస్యంతో సాగే ఈ కేసు ఎప్పుడు? ఎక్కడ? ఎలా? మొదలైందో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ప్లీజ్ listen టు “Aakasham Erraga Vundhi” ఓన్లీ ఆన్ KUKU FM.

digital-dairies.title: Digital Dairies
digital-dairies.description: డిజిటల్ విప్లవం మన జీవితాలను పూర్తిగా మార్పు చేసింది. టెక్నాలజీ మన దైనందిన జీవితాల్లో ముఖ్యమైన భాగంగా మారింది, ఇక మనం అన్నీ డిజిటల్ రూపంలో అనుభవిస్తున్నాం. ఈ విప్లవం వ్యక్తిగత, సామాజిక మరియు ఆర్థిక పరిణామాలను ప్రభావితం చేస్తూ, కొత్త అవకాశాలు, సవాళ్లు తెస్తోంది.

secret-shehzada-2.title: Hidden Shehzada
secret-shehzada-2.description: Mumbai ke Mehra House mein Dhruv ek nakara servant bankar aata hai, jo ghar ki malkin Simran ko bilkul pasand nahi. Tab London se wapas lautti hai Simran ki iklauti beti Tara. Dhruv pehli hi nazar mein Tara se pyaar kar baithta hai, lekin Tara ka boyfriend Sameer unke beech badi deewar ban jata hai. Simran ke taane aur Sameer ki teekhi nazron ke beech kya Dhruv Tara ko impress kar payega? Aur kya Tara jaan paayegi Dhruv ka sach? Kaun hai Dhruv, ek nikamma naukar ya ek shaatir shehzada?

the-divorced-billionaire-heiress-5.title: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress
the-divorced-billionaire-heiress-5.description: In search of true love, Ananya hides her real identity, but this very decision leads her to heartbreak when her first love betrays her. Just when she begins to lose hope, Ved enters her life as a caring and dependable companion. Their bond grows stronger with time, yet Ananya continues to keep her truth hidden from him. Despite facing several challenges, Ved never leaves her side. But will Ananya ever find the courage to reveal her real identity and trust him with her past?

the-secret-dead-or-alive.title: The Secret: Dead or Alive
the-secret-dead-or-alive.description: ಸತ್ತವರನ್ನ ಮತ್ತೆ ಬದುಕಿಸಬಹುದಾ ಅನ್ನೋ ಆಲೋಚನೆ ಮನುಷ್ಯನನ್ನ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಕಾಡ್ತಾನೆ ಇದೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ ಆನಂದ್‌ ಕೂಡ ಅಷ್ಟೇ, ಸಾವು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾಗೋದಲ್ಲ, ಬೇರೆ ರೋಗಗಳ ಥರ ಅದು ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು ಖಾಯಿಲೆ ಅಂತ ನಂಬಿರೋನು! ಮಗನ ಹುಚ್ಚು ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸೋಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ ಅಂತ ಅರ್ಥವಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಪ್ಪ ಡಾ|| ದಾಮೋದರ್‌ ದಾಸ್‌ ಮಗನನ್ನ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸೋ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವನ್ನೇ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಬಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಸಾವಿನ ಜೊತೆ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳನ್ನ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಹೋದ್ರೆ, ಉಂಟಾಗೋ ತೊಂದರೆಗಳೇನು ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಕುರಿತಾದ ವಿಸ್ಮಯಕಾರಿ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "The Secret: Dead or Alive" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

unspoken-ties.title: Unspoken Ties
unspoken-ties.description: After a mix-up at The Ritz London, Rose Bennett finds herself in suite 106 instead of 105—and in the arms of billionaire businessman Oliver Kingston instead of her cheating boyfriend. When her family attempts to sell her off to a predatory lord to save their failing business, Oliver presents his own proposition: a marriage of convenience with very unconventional terms. As Rose navigates this new arrangement, what begins as a contract slowly transforms into an undeniable attraction neither can resist. But in a world where business and pleasure dangerously intertwine, Rose must determine if Oliver truly wants her—or if she's simply another acquisition for the ruthless CEO. Sometimes the biggest mistakes lead to the most passionate affairs.

the-nations-homeopath.title: The Nation's Homeopath
the-nations-homeopath.description: This Audiobook Is An Inspiring Journey Of A Homeopath Shaped By Struggle, Loss, Risk, And Vision. From A Small-Town Beginning To A Global Stage, Every Setback Turns Into A Lesson. It Blends Moments Of Friendship, Business, Healing, And Leadership That Motivate Listeners. More Than A Success Story, It Offers A Fresh Perspective On Life — Relatable, Honest, And Deeply Human — Making It An Engaging Experience For Anyone Seeking Growth, Resilience, And Purpose.

the-rebellious-daughter-in-law.title: The Rebellious Daughter-in-law
the-rebellious-daughter-in-law.description: After years of enduring verbal abuse from her husband Ian and his family, Amelia's vow of silence is nearly complete. What her tormentors don't realize is that beneath her submissive facade lies a woman of extraordinary gifts - a master healer with supernatural abilities, a martial arts expert, and a gemstone savant who can spot a fake with a glance. As she begins revealing her talents by saving lives and winning millions in high-stakes competitions, powerful enemies emerge determined to silence her permanently. In this riveting tale of revenge and redemption, Amelia must confront her mysterious past while forcing those who ridiculed her to face an uncomfortable truth: they never knew who they were really living with.

hindavi-swaraj-the-rise-of-marathas.title: Hindavi Swaraj: The Rise Of Marathas
hindavi-swaraj-the-rise-of-marathas.description: హిందవి స్వరాజ్ అనేది స్వాతంత్ర్యానికి, భారతీయుల యొక్క స్వతంత్రత మరియు స్వయం పరిపాలనకు సంబంధించి శివాజీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవేశపెట్టిన భావన. ఈ భావనను ప్రస్తుత బీజేపీ తమ శక్తి సామర్థ్యం మరియు జాతీయతను పెంపొందించడంలో పాటిస్తోంది, అయితే బాల్ తివాకేరిఓ తన రాజకీయ దృష్టితో హిందువుల హక్కులను సాధించడంపై ఎక్కువగా కేంద్రీకృతం చేశాడు. ఈ సూత్రాన్ని అనుసరించి, బీజేపీ జాతీయత, సంస్కృతి మరియు మతపరమైన కట్టుబాట్లను ప్రేరేపిస్తోంది.

we-the-people-of-the-states-of-bharat.title: We The People of the States of Bharat
we-the-people-of-the-states-of-bharat.description: India’s map is not just geography, but a journey of history, politics, and culture. We, The People of the States of Bharat by Sanjeev Chopra shows how India’s states evolved, princely states were integrated, and new states were formed due to linguistic and political demands. Packed with historical insights and engaging stories, this audiobook is a must-listen!

morgan-villa.title: Morgan Villa
morgan-villa.description: സുഹൃത്തുക്കളായ നാല് കോളേജ് വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾ ഒരു തുമ്പും  അവശേഷിപ്പിക്കാതെ ഒരു ദിവസം അപ്രത്യക്ഷരാകുന്നു, നിശ്ചയദാർഢ്യമുള്ള  ഇൻസ്‌പെക്ടർ രാജീവ് നയിക്കുന്ന അന്വേഷണത്തിൽ,  വനത്തിനുളളിൽ ഒറ്റപ്പെട്ട ഒരു ബംഗ്ലാവിനുള്ളിൽ അവരെ ട്രാപ്പിലായ നിലയിൽ കണ്ടെത്തി. അവരെ  സുരക്ഷിതരായി തിരികെ എത്തിക്കാനുളള പോരാട്ടത്തിൽ രാജീവിനു നേരിടാനുണ്ടായിരുന്നത് അത്യന്തം അപകടകാരികളായ അതീന്ദ്രിയ ശക്തികളെ ആയിരുന്നു. കുപ്രസിദ്ധമായ മോർഗൻ വില്ലയുടെ നിഗൂഢതകളിലേക്കുളള അതിസാഹസിക യാത്ര ആരംഭിക്കാം.

it-was-all-a-lie.title: It Was All a Lie
it-was-all-a-lie.description: ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿ ಉದ್ಯಮಿ ಡೊನಾಲ್ಡ್‌ ಜಾನ್‌ ಟ್ರಂಪ್‌ 45ನೇ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷರಾಗಿ ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಬಾರಿ ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಗದ್ದುಗೆ ಏರಿದ್ರು. ಈ ಹಿಂದೆ 2016ರಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷರಾಗಿದ್ದ ಟ್ರಂಪ್‌ ಜಾಗತಿಕ ರಾಜಕಾರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ, ತಮ್ಮ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗಿರೋ ಎಡವಟ್ಟುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಮೆರಿಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಂಟಾದ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮಾನ-ಹಾನಿಗಳು ಏನು ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಸ್ಟುವರ್ಟ್‌ ಸ್ಟೀವನ್ಸ್‌ರವರ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಟ್ರಂಪ್‌ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷರಾಗುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಹಾಗೂ ಅಧ್ಯಕ್ಷರಾದ ನಂತರ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಗಳು, ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಲಸಿಗರ ಮೇಲೆ ಉಂಟಾಗ್ತಿರೋ ದೌರ್ಜನ್ಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಲೇಖಕ ಸ್ಟುವರ್ಟ್‌ ಸ್ಟೀವನ್ಸ್‌ ಸುಧೀರ್ಘವಾಗಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿದ "It Was All a Lie" ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

reboot-3.title: Reboot
reboot-3.description: REBOOT – by Issach John is for anyone who feels stuck, confused, or demotivated in life. This audiobook takes you from self-doubt to self-belief and helps you upgrade your mindset step by step. Through 39 short and relatable episodes, you’ll learn to leave behind old thinking, fear, and excuses, and build a better version of yourself. Don’t wait—put on your headphones, listen to REBOOT, and start a new chapter of your life today

വിചിത്ര-വിശ്വാസങ്ങൾ.title: വിചിത്ര വിശ്വാസങ്ങൾ
വിചിത്ര-വിശ്വാസങ്ങൾ.description: നിങ്ങൾ വിശ്വസിച്ചാലും ഇല്ലെങ്കിലും വിശ്വാസങ്ങളുടെ വിചിത്ര ലോകത്തേക്ക് ഒരു യാത്രയാണിത് ! മരങ്ങളും മൃഗങ്ങളും വരെ വിവാഹിതരാകുന്ന അനേകം വിചിത്രങ്ങളും, അവിശ്വസിനീയങ്ങളുമായ ആചാരങ്ങളുടെയും,  അന്ധവിശ്വാസങ്ങളുടെയും ലോകത്തെ പരിചയപ്പെടാം. ഇന്ത്യയിലും, ലോകത്തിൻ്റെ മറ്റിടങ്ങളിലും, ഈ ആധുനിക കേരളത്തിലും വരെ ഇന്നും നിലനിൽക്കുന്ന വിചിത്രവിശ്വാസങ്ങളുടെ രസകരങ്ങളായ കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം...

facing-up-a-remarkable-journey-to-mount-.title: Facing Up: A Remarkable Journey to Mount Everest
facing-up-a-remarkable-journey-to-mount-.description: Have you ever wondered what happens when every breath is a struggle and every step brings you closer to the edge—do you give up or push forward? Facing Up: A Remarkable Journey To The Summit Of Mount Everest is not just a climb, but a battle with fear, pain, and self-doubt. Feel the grit, the courage, and the unstoppable will. Start listening now on Kuku FM—because this story won’t let you stop halfway.

guilty-pleasures.title: Guilty Pleasures
guilty-pleasures.description: ಸೆಕ್ಸ್‌ ಥೆರಪಿಸ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿರೋ ಡಾ|| ರಿಷಿಕಾಳದ್ದು ಪಕ್ಕಾ ಡಿಸಿಪ್ಲಿನ್‌ಡ್‌ ಲೈಫ್‌! ರಿಷಿಕಾಳ ದಿನಚರಿ ಯೋಗ, ಮೆಡಿಟೇಶನ್‌ ಹಾಗೂ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಡಯಟ್‌ನಾ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರೋ ರಿಷಿಕಾ ದಿನಚರಿ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ೫ ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಶುರುವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಆ ಪರ್ಫೆಕ್ಟ್‌ ದಿನಚರಿಯಿಂದಾನೇ ರಿಷಿಕಾ, ೩೫ ವರ್ಷ ಆದ್ರೂ ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಾಟ್‌ & ಸೆಕ್ಸಿ ಬಾಡಿನಾ ಮೆಂಟೇನ್‌ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾಳೆ. ತನ್ನ ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್ಸ್‌ ಫ್ಯಾಂಟಸಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡೋ ರಿಷಿಕಾ ಲೈಫ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ತಲೆ ಕೆಳಗಾಗೋ ಹಾಗೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್‌ನ ಬರ್ಬರ ಕೊಲೆಯಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಕೊಲೆಯ ಚಕ್ರವ್ಯೂಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ರಿಷಿಕಾಗೆ ಅನಾಮಧೇಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಬ್ಲ್ಯಾಕ್‌ಮೇಲ್‌ ಕರೆಗಳು ಬರತೊಡಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಏನಿದು ಮರ್ಡರ್‌ ಮಿಸ್ಟರಿ? ಈ ಕೇಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ರಿಷಿಕಾಳ ಪಾತ್ರವೇನು? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವೀರೇಳಿಸುವ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "Guilty Pleasures" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

lust-lies.title: Lust & Lies
lust-lies.description: ಎಂಥವರ ಮನಸ್ಸಲ್ಲೂ ಆಸೆ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸುವಂತ ಮೈಮಾಟವನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿರೋ ಕಾಮಿನಿಗೆ ೩೫ ವರ್ಷಗಳಾದ್ರೂ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಸಕ್ಸಸ್‌ಫುಲ್‌ ಲಾಯರ್‌ ಆಗಿರೋ ಕಾಮಿನಿಯ ಮನಸಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಕಾಮನೆಗಳಿಗಂತೂ ಮಿತಿಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಮಾದಕತೆಗೆ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಹೆಸರಾಗಿರೋ ಕಾಮಿನಿಗೆ ಮದನನನ್ನೇ ಮೀರಿಸುವಂತಹ ಮದನ್‌ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಪರಿಚಯವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಕೇಸ್‌ವೊಂದರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಮಿನಿಯನ್ನ ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗೋ ಮದನ್‌ ರಿಯಲ್‌ ಎಸ್ಟೇಟ್‌ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಾನೇ ನಟೋರಿಯಸ್‌ ಆದ ಹೆಸರು ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಮದನ್‌ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಪರ್ಸನಾಲಿಟಿಗೆ ಫಿದಾ ಆಗೋ ಕಾಮಿನಿ, ವೃತ್ತಿಪರತೆಯನ್ನ ಮರೆತು, ಮದನ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ಕಾಮದಾಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಳೆದು ಹೋಗ್ತಾಳೆ. ಮಿತಿಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲದಂತೆ ಮಿಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿ ಹೋಗೋ ಕಾಮಿನಿಗೆ ಮದನ್‌ನ ಕರಾಳ ಸತ್ಯ ಅರಿವಾಗ್ತಾ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ. ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈ ರೋಮಾಂಚನಗೊಳಿಸೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "Lust & Lies" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

sorry-not-a-gold-digger-6.title: I Am Not Your Sugar Baby
sorry-not-a-gold-digger-6.description: On the streets of Mumbai, a delivery girl named Tara helps a helpless old man. But is he really as helpless as he seems? In their very first meeting, he expresses his wish to get his grandson Rohan married to Tara. Will Rohan, who has just returned from London, be able to accept Tara? Why would Tara, who lives life on her own terms, agree to marry a complete stranger? And will she be able to uncover the truth about Rohan and that old grandfather?

falling-for-the-call-girl-season-02.title: Falling For The Call Girl: Season 02
falling-for-the-call-girl-season-02.description: ಟೆಕ್‌ ಸರ್ಕಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಖತ್‌ ಹೆಸರು ಮಾಡಿರೋ ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌, ತನ್ನದೇ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್‌ ಪಾರ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಡಲ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಕೂತಿದ್ದ. ಮಿಡ್‌ನೈಟ್‌ ಬ್ಲೂ ಗೌನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ ಕೂತಿದ್ದ ಟೆರೇಸ್‌ಗೆ ಎಂಟ್ರಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಆ ಮಾದಕ ಚೆಲುವೆ ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ನನ್ನ ಮೊದಲ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲೇ ಇಂಪ್ರೆಸ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ತಾಳೆ. ತನ್ನನ್ನ ತಾನು ಮಾಯಾ ಅಂತ ಪರಿಚಯ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿ, ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ಟೆಕ್ನಾಲಜಿಯಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ಫಿಲಾಸಫಿವರೆಗೂ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಹರಟುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆ ಮೋಹಕ ಬೆಡಗಿ ಮಾಯಾಗೆ ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ ಇನ್ನೇನು ಬಿದ್ದೇಬಿಟ್ಟ ಅನ್ನೋವಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿಯ ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್‌ ಬಂದು ಆಕೆಯನ್ನ ಕರೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗಿಬಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಕೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಕಾಲ್‌ಗರ್ಲ್‌ ಅಂತ ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ಗೆ ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಲವ್‌ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ? ತುಂಬಾನೇ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಆಗಿರೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "Falling for the Call Girl; Season ೦೨" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

secret-affair.title: Secret Affair
secret-affair.description: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಹುಡುಗಿಗೂ ಲೆಕ್ಕವಿಲ್ಲದಷ್ಟು ಆಸೆಗಳು ಇದ್ದೇ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ. ಬೆಟ್ಟದಷ್ಟು ಆಸೆ, ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತಿರೋ ಮಾಯಾಗೂ ಕೂಡ ತನ್ನ ಕೈ ಹಿಡಿಯೋ ಹುಡುಗನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನೂರಾರು ಆಸೆಗಳಿದ್ವು. ಆದ್ರೆ, ವಿಧಿಯ ಆಟ ಬೇರೆನೇ ಆಗಿತ್ತು. ಹೆಸರಿಗಷ್ಟೇ ತಾಳಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಗಂಡನಾಗಿದ್ದ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ ಬೇರೋಬ್ಬಳ ಜೊತೆ ಅಕ್ರಮ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಇಟ್ಕೊಂಡಿರೋದನ್ನ ಮಾಯಾ ರೆಡ್‌ ಹ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ ಆಗಿ ನೋಡಿ ಶಾಕ್‌ ಆಗಿದ್ದಳು. ಇನ್ನೇನು ಜೀವನ ಮುಗಿದೇ ಹೋಯ್ತು ಅಂತ ಡಿಪ್ರೆಷನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ಮಾಯಾ ಲೈಫ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿ ಮಾಯವಾಗಿದ್ದ ಫರ್ಹಾನ್‌ ಮತ್ತೆ ಎಂಟ್ರಿ ಕೊಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡ ಗಂಡ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ ಹಾಗೂ ಹಳೇ ಲವರ್‌ ಫರ್ಹಾನ್‌ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಸಿಲುಕಿರೋ ಮಾಯಾಳ ಕಥೆಯೇನು? ಕ್ಷಣ ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವೀರೇಳಿಸುವ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "Secret ಅಫೇರ್‌" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

jay-mahabharat-ka-sachitra-punarkathan.title: Jaya - Mahabharat Ka Sachitra Punarkathan
jay-mahabharat-ka-sachitra-punarkathan.description: “Jaya” is a deep and experiential retelling, rooted in the original Jaya tradition. It is not just a story of war, but a mirror reflecting dharma, duty, power, and human struggle. Each episode presents emotions, essence, and meaning in a simple, engaging storytelling style, allowing listeners to not just hear the epic, but truly feel it.

shreeman-mookavagithu-nenapina-doniyalli.title: Shreeman Mookavagithu- Nenapina Doniyalli
shreeman-mookavagithu-nenapina-doniyalli.description: ಕುವೆಂಪು ಅವರ "ನೆನಪಿನ ದೋಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ" ಒಂದು ಆತ್ಮಕಥನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಅವರ ಬಾಲ್ಯದಿಂದ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ದಿನಗಳವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆದ ನೆನಪಿನ ಸರಣಿ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಅನುಭವಗಳನ್ನು, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಪ್ರಭಾವ, ಬಾಲ್ಯದ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಪರಿಸರ, ಹಾಗೆಯೇ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದ ಪ್ರಭಾವವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ನೈಜ ಜೀವನದ ಪಾಠಗಳನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಮೂಲಕ, ಓದುಗನನ್ನು ಹಳೆಯ ದಿನಗಳ ನೆನಪುಗಳ ಲೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುವ ಶೈಲಿ ಇದಕ್ಕಿದೆ. ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಭಾಷೆ, ಸರಳವಾದ ಮನೋಧರ್ಮ, ಹಾಗೂ ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕತೆ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಹತ್ತಿರವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

buddhana-nudi-ratnagalu.title: Buddhana Nudi Ratnagalu
buddhana-nudi-ratnagalu.description: ಗೌತಮ ಬುದ್ಧನ ಉಪದೇಶಗಳ ತಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕ ಸಾರವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಜೀವನದ ಮೂಲ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ದುಃಖದ ಕಾರಣ, ಅದನ್ನು ನಿವಾರಿಸುವ ಮಾರ್ಗ, ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸುವ ಹಾದಿಯನ್ನು ಇದು ಬೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸತ್ಯಗಳು, ಅಷ್ಟಾಂಗ ಮಾರ್ಗ, ಕರ್ಮ, ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳು ಇವು ಬುದ್ಧ ತತ್ತ್ವದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಅಂಶಗಳು. ಅಹಿಂಸೆ, ದಯೆ, ತ್ಯಾಗ, ಶಾಂತಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿಹೇಳುವ ಈ ತತ್ತ್ವ, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಆತ್ಮಸಾಕ್ಷಾತ್ಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಒಳಗಿನ ಶಾಂತಿಗಾಗಿ ದಾರಿ ತೋರುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಧರ್ಮಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಅನುಭವಾಧಾರಿತ ಜೀವನ ತತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನು ಬೋಧಿಸುವ ಬುದ್ಧ ತತ್ತ್ವ, ಜೀವನದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಅರಿಯಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸದಾಚಾರ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

make-epic-money.title: Make Epic Money
make-epic-money.description: In Make Epic Money, Ankur Warikoo shares a practical blueprint to earn, spend, save, and grow your money smartly. Say goodbye to jargon and confusion, and discover strategies to make your money work as hard as you do. Listen to this audiobook to boost your financial literacy and take control of your financial future.

cult-leaders.title: Cult Leaders
cult-leaders.description: పగటి వెలుగులోనూ, కొన్ని కులాల నేతలు తమ శక్తిని, మాయను కనబరుస్తూ, మానవ మనసులపై వారి ఆధిపత్యాన్ని ఏర్పరుస్తారు. వారి వాగ్దానాలు, మాయాజాలాలు, మరియు రహస్య ఆజ్ఞలు ప్రజలను వారి వశంలోకి తీసుకువెళ్ళిపోతాయి. ఇది ఒక కొత్త రకమైన గెలుపు; కానీ ఆ గెలుపు మనిషిని ఎంత వెనక్కి లాగుతుంది అనేదే ప్రశ్న!

mahashivudu.title: Mahashivudu
mahashivudu.description:
శివుడి పట్ల అశేష భక్తి మరియు ఆచారాలు శాస్త్రాలలో మరియు భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో చాలా ప్రాచుర్యం పొందినవి. శివుడిని "మహాదేవుడు", "నటరాజ", "భేరవ" మరియు "పశుపతి" వంటి ఎన్నో నామాలతో పిలుస్తారు.

శివుడు యోగుల పాలకుడు, భయంకరమైన, కానీ కారుణ్యంతో కూడిన ఒక శక్తివంతమైన దేవుడు. శివుడు శూన్యపరమేశ్వరుడు, అంటే అతని స్వభావం ప్రపంచం పై ఆధారపడదు. అతను ఈ సమస్తాన్ని ధరించే ప్రకృతి యొక్క ఒక రూపంగా, శక్తి యొక్క అత్యంత శుభ్రమైన రూపంగా దర్శనమిస్తాడు. అతని యోగి రూపం "నటరాజ"గా ప్రసిద్ధి చెందింది, అక్కడ అతను తాండవ నృత్యం చేయడం ద్వారా సృష్టి, సంస్కరణ మరియు వ్యర్ధతను సూచిస్తాడు.

శివుని చిత్రాలు లేదా విగ్రహాలు సాధారణంగా ఒక మూడుపట్టు జుట్టు, గంగా ధార, నల్ల గడ్డం మరియు మణికట్టు ధరిస్తున్న రూపంలో ఉంటాయి. అతనికి పశుపతి (పశు అంటే జంతువులు) అని కూడా పిలుస్తారు, ఇది అతని జంతువుల మీద పూజకు సంబంధించిన విభాగాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది. శివుడు స్వయంగా "నందీశ్వరుడు" అనే ఒక పశుపాలన చేసే ప్రాణిగా కూడా గుర్తించబడుతాడు.

breaking-the-mould.title: Breaking the Mould
breaking-the-mould.description:
Where is India going today?
Becoming the fifth-largest economy after overtaking the UK is a major achievement—but is this growth creating enough jobs and securing the future? In Breaking the Mould, Raghuram Rajan and Rohit Lamba explain how India skipped the traditional development path and the challenges it faces today. Listen to this audiobook to understand India’s choices and the road ahead.

building-your-money-machine-with-chatgpt.title: Building Your Money Machine with ChatGPT
building-your-money-machine-with-chatgpt.description: ಚಾಟ್‌ಜಿಪಿಟಿ ಮುಖಾಂತರ ನೀವು ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಕುತ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹಣ ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಅನ್ನೋದು ನಿಮಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಾ? ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಚಾಟ್‌ಜಿಪಿಟಿಯಂತಹ AI ಟೂಲ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನ ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡು ನೀವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆರಿಯರ್‌ನಾ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಬಿಲ್ಡ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಬಹುದು. ಆಧುನಿಕ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನದ ಮುಖಾಂತರ ಮೇಲ್‌ ಬರೆಯೋದ್ರಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ರೆಸ್ಯೂಮ್‌ ತನಕ ಏನನ್ನ ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೂ ತಯಾರಿಸಬಹುದು. ಯಾವುದೇ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲೂ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಇರೋ ಇಂಪಾರ್ಟೆಂಟ್‌ ಕೆಲಸಗಳನ್ನ ನೀವು AI ಟೆಕ್ನಾಲಜಿ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಾಡಿಸಬಹುದು. ಆದರೆ, ಚಾಟ್‌ಜಿಪಿಟಿಯನ್ನ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಬಳಸೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಯಾವ ವಿಧಾನಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆರಿಯರ್‌ನಾ ಬಿಲ್ಡ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ಕೋಬಹುದು ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಕುರಿತಾದ "Building Your Money Machine with ChatGPT"ನ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

the-war-diary-of-asha-san.title: The War Diary of Asha San
the-war-diary-of-asha-san.description: his audiobook is not just a story, but a journey through a time, a family, and the choices that became part of history. From the setting to the final chapter, it explores struggle, courage, dreams, and the conflict between hope and reality. Each episode unfolds a new turning point where characters face the test of time. This is a deeply moving journey—one that stays with you long after the story ends

naadu-kanda-rajkumar.title: Naadu Kanda Rajkumar
naadu-kanda-rajkumar.description: ನಾಡು ಕಂಡ ರಾಜ್‌ಕುಮಾರ್ ಎಂಬ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ನಮ್ಮ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಹಿರಿಯ ಚಿತ್ರನಟ, ನಾಡೋಡ ರಾಜ್ಯೋತ್ಪನ್ನ ಡಾ. ರಾಜ್‌ಕುಮಾರ್ ಅವರ ಜೀವನದ ಒಂದು ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಕಥೆ. ಡಾ. ರಾಜ್‌ಕುಮಾರ್ ಅವರನ್ನು ನಮ್ಮ ನಾಡು ಹೇಗೆ ಕಂಡಿತ್ತು, ಜನಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಏನಿತ್ತು, ಇವೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನು ಬರಹಗಾರನ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಅನುಭವಗಳ ಜೊತೆ ಬೆರೆಸಿ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ..

detective-deepika-season-2.title: Detective Deepika : Season 2
detective-deepika-season-2.description: 'ದೀಪಿಕಾ' ಬಾಸ್ 'ಅರ್ಜುನ್ ಪ್ರಸಾದ್' ಯಾವ ಕೇಸ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆಯೂ ಇಷ್ಟು ಯೋಚನೆ ಮಾಡಿದವರಲ್ಲಾ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅದೊಂದು ದಿನ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದ 'ಅನಾಮಿಕಾ' ಅನ್ನೋ ಹುಡುಗಿ, ಅರ್ಜುನ್ ಬದುಕನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಿಸಿಬಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ಲು‌. ಅವಳ‌ ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಜುನ್ ಗಾಬರಿಯಾಗಿದ್ರು! ಇದರ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಒಂದು ಡೆಡ್ ಬಾಡಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತ್ತು! ಅರ್ಜುನ್ ಗನ್ ಕೂಡ ಕಾಣೆಯಾಗಿತ್ತು! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಅನಾಮಿಕ ಯಾರು? ಅವಳ ನಾಪತ್ತೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣ ಯಾರು? ಈ ಕೇಸನ್ನ ದೀಪಿಕಾ ಹೇಗೆ ಕ್ಲಿಯರ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಳೆ? ಕೇಳಿ ಇಂಟ್ರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'ಡಿಟೆಕ್ಟಿವ್‌ ದೀಪಿಕಾ ಸೀಸನ್ 2'.

mindfulness-made-easy.title: Mindfulness Made Easy
mindfulness-made-easy.description: Mindfulness Made Easy is a practical audiobook that helps you live in the present moment. This series teaches you how to reduce overthinking, manage stress, and keep your mind calm. In the middle of a busy and demanding life, mindfulness brings clarity, balance, and mental peace. The audiobook shares simple techniques that can be easily followed in everyday life, without the need for any prior meditation experience

neenade-naa.title: Neenade Naa
neenade-naa.description: ಯಂಗ್‌ & ಹ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಸಮ್‌ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್‌ ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಗುಪ್ತಾ ಸಖತ್‌ ಮುಂಗೋಪಿಯಾದ್ರೂ ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಮನಸ್ಸಿರೋ ಹೃದಯವಂತ. ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ಕಾರ್ಡಿಯೋಲಜಿಸ್ಟ್‌ ಆಗಿರೋ ಅಮಿತ್‌ಗೆ ಹುಡ್ಗೀರು, ರೋಮ್ಯಾನ್ಸ್‌ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕಷ್ಟೇ. ಅಂತಹ ಮುಂಗೋಪಿ ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಮನೆಗೆ ಅನೀರಿಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ಬ್ಯೂಟಿಫುಲ್‌ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಸನ್ನಿಧಿ ಪೇಯಿಂಗ್‌ ಗೆಸ್ಟ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಬರ್ತಾಳೆ! ಫರ್ಸ್ಟ್‌ ಕ್ಲಾಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿ.ಎಡ್‌ ಮುಗಿಸಿರೋ ಸನ್ನಿಧಿಗೆ ಬಯಾಲಜಿ ಟೀಚರ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಜಾಬ್‌ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಅಕ್ಕ, ಅಮ್ಮನ ಜೊತೆ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದ ಅಮಿತ್‌ಗೆ ಸನ್ನಿಧಿ ಪೇಯಿಂಗ್‌ ಗೆಸ್ಟ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಬಂದಿರೋದು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪವೂ ಇಷ್ಟ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಟಾಮ್‌ & ಜೆರಿ ಥರ ರಿಯಲ್‌ ಲೈಫ್‌ಲ್ಲೂ ಎನಿಮಿಗಳಾಗೋ ಸನ್ನಿಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಸಖತ್‌ ಕಿತ್ತಾಡ್ಕೋಳ್ತಾರೆ. ಸದ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ದುಷ್‌ಮನ್‌ಗಳಾಗಿರೋ ಸನ್ನಿಧಿ-ಅಮಿತ್‌ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಹೋಗ್ತಾ ಲವ್‌ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತಾ? ಲವ್‌ ಬರ್ಡ್ಸ್‌ಗಳ ಲವ್‌ ಜರ್ನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರಾಫಿಕ್‌ ಇರುತ್ತಾ? ಮೈನವೀರೇಳಿಸುವ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ನೀನಾದೆ ನಾ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

the-ambuja-story.title: The Ambuja Story
the-ambuja-story.description: വർഷം 1983 ഒരു ചെറുകിട പരുത്തി വ്യവസായി മാത്രമായിരുന്ന നരോത്തം ഷെക്ക്സാരിയ എന്ന മുപ്പതുകാർൻ്റെ ബിസിനസ്സ് ബുദ്ധി സിമൻ്റ് നിർമ്മാണ വ്യവസായത്തിൽ തൻ്റെ ഭാവിയെ ദീർഘവീക്ഷണം ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഒരു വലിയ വ്യവസായി ആയി തീരണം എന്ന അയാളുടെ സ്വപ്നത്തിൻ്റെ സാക്ഷാത്ക്കാരമായി അംബുജ സിമൻ്റസ് പിറവിയെടുക്കുന്നു. അവിടെ നിന്നും ലോകത്തെ തന്നെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ സിമൻ്റ് ബ്രാൻഡ് എന്ന നിലയിലേക്കുളള അംബുജയുടെ വളർച്ച തീകച്ചും വ്യത്യസ്തമായിരുന്നു. ആ കഥ നരോത്തം തന്നെ പറയുന്നത് കേൾക്കാം, ഈ കഥയിൽ വിജയങ്ങൾക്കൊപ്പം, കരുതലും, മാനുഷികതയും ഉണ്ട്

tata-stories-6.title: Tata Stories
tata-stories-6.description: Tata Stories is an audiobook of lesser-known tales from the Tata Group—people, moments, and places that helped shape modern India. From a diamond larger than the Kohinoor to Swami Vivekananda, India’s first airline, a homegrown car, Olympic dreams, and the story behind “OK Tata.” Discover the human spirit behind business. Press play and experience the legacy

ബെല്ലാഡോണ-The-Queen-of-Darkness.title: ബെല്ലാഡോണ- The Queen of Darkness
ബെല്ലാഡോണ-The-Queen-of-Darkness.description: ബെല്ലാഡോണ, ആഭിചാരക്രിയയിലൂടെ പുനർജ്ജന്മം നേടാൻ കൊതിക്കുന്ന, അതിനായി ഭൂമിയിലെ ഒരു മനുഷ്യ ജീവനുമായി ബന്ധം സ്ഥാപിക്കാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുന്ന കഥാപാത്രമാണ്. തന്റെ അധികാര ചിഹ്നം പച്ചകുത്തി വരുതിയിൽ നിർത്തുന്ന മനുഷ്യനിലൂടെ തനിക്ക് പുനർജ്ജന്മം സാധ്യമാകുമെന്ന് വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന ദുർദേവതയാണു ബെല്ലാ. മന്ത്രോച്ചാരണങ്ങളും ബന്ധനങ്ങളും കെട്ടുകഥകളും കൊണ്ട് പൂട്ടിയ ആ നിലവറയിൽ  വ്ൾവർഷങ്ങളായി അവൾ ആ നിമിഷത്തിനായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നു....

controversial-world-leaders.title: Controversial World Leaders
controversial-world-leaders.description: చరిత్రలో, కొందరు నాయకులు తమ విధానాలు, సిద్ధాంతాలు, మరియు చర్యల ద్వారా ప్రపంచాన్ని ప్రభావితం చేశారు—అలాగే వారి నిర్ణయాలు విశేషమైన వివాదాస్పదతను కలిగించాయి. ఈ నాన్-ఫిక్షన్ శ్రేణి 16 మంది అటువంటి నాయకుల జీవితాలను, వారి నిర్ణయాలను, వారివల్ల జరిగిన ప్రభావాలను లోతుగా పరిశీలిస్తుంది. వారు అధికారాన్ని ఎలా వినియోగించుకున్నారో, అలాగే ఎందుకు వారు చరిత్రలో విభాజనకర వ్యక్తులుగా నిలిచారో ఈ కథనంలో వివరించబడుతుంది.

women-at-war.title: Women at War
women-at-war.description: Women at War is a powerful audiobook that brings to life the untold stories of India’s freedom struggle, where women stood on the frontlines. It tells the story of the Rani of Jhansi Regiment, Asia’s first all-women military unit, and the courage to choose freedom over silence. Guided by Subhas Chandra Bose’s vision and Captain Lakshmi’s leadership, this audiobook becomes a voice of bravery, sacrifice, and legacy. Listen on KUKU FM

പേമാരി.title: പേമാരി
പേമാരി.description: നഗരം നിയോൺ വിളക്കുകളുടെ മഞ്ഞപ്രഭയിൽ കുളിച്ച് നിൽക്കുന്ന ആ രാത്രികളിൽ വളരെ മുൻപെ കുഴിച്ചു മൂടപ്പെട്ട ഒരു കൊലപാതകത്തിൻ്റെ ദുരൂഹതകളിലേക്ക് കടക്കുകയാണു മിടുക്കിയായ യുവ ജേർണലിസ്റ്റ് നയന. ആ യാത്രയിൽ  വർഷങ്ങൾക്ക് മുൻപ് നടന്ന സ്വന്തം അച്ഛൻ്റെ മരണത്തിലെ നിഗൂഢതകൾ  മറനീക്കിയത് യാദൃശ്ഛികമായിരുന്നില്ല. പിന്നീടുളള അവളുടെ ഓരോ നീക്കവും നഗരത്തിലെ അതിശക്തരായ ശത്രുക്കളെ തന്നിലേക്ക് അടുപ്പിക്കുന്നത് അവൾ അറിയുന്നുണ്ടായിരുന്നോ? നഗരം പെരുമഴയിൽ മുങ്ങിയ ആ രാവുകളിൽ അവൾ നടന്ന് നീങ്ങിയത സ്വയം നാശത്തിലേക്കോ, ഉദ്വേഗഭരിതമായ പക വീട്ടലിലേക്കോ?

business-communication-in-a-week.title: Business Communication in a Week
business-communication-in-a-week.description: Business Communication In A Week ek practical guide hai jo aapko sirf 7 din mein workplace communication improve karna sikhata hai. Is book mein clear emails likhne, meetings mein confidently baat rakhne, presentations dene aur professional communication ke basics simple tareeke se samjhaye gaye hain. Students, working professionals aur managers ke liye yeh book career growth aur better teamwork mein madad karti hai.

sold-for-love-3.title: Sold For Love
sold-for-love-3.description: When Emily awakens at a human trafficking auction, she never imagines her buyer - the masked, enigmatic Benedict - will force her into marriage at the notorious Blackwood Manor. But beneath the manor's gothic façade lies an even darker secret: a criminal empire built on trafficking and murder, with ties to Emily's own tragic past. As she delves deeper into her mother's mysterious death, Emily discovers Benedict may not be the monster she feared, but rather a man trapped in his own dangerous game of deception. Together, they must expose the true architect of horror. This gripping thriller explores the fine line between captor and protector, where survival depends on who you can trust - and love blooms in the most unlikely places.

marali-manasaagide.title: Marali Manasaagide
marali-manasaagide.description: "ಮರಳಿ ಮನಸಾಗಿದೆ" ಒಂದು ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಸ್ಥಿತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಡಿಯೋ ಕಥಾ ಸರಣಿ. ಭೂಮಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಜೀವನದ ನಡುವಿನ ಒಡನಾಡು, ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ತೀವ್ರತೆ, ಗೊಂದಲಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯ ತೀರ್ಮಾನಗಳು ಈ ಕಥೆಗೆ ಜೀವ ತುಂಬಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ದಾಂಪತ್ಯ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷೆ, ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಏರುಪೇರುಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗದ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕುತೂಹಲಕರ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಭೂಮಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ತಿರುವುಗಳು ಓದುಗರನ್ನು ತುದಿಗಾಲಲ್ಲಿ ಕೂರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಅನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ಘಟನೆಗಳು, ಭೂತಕಾಲದ ನೆನಪುಗಳು, ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಾಗುವ ಕಠಿಣ ಸತ್ಯಗಳು—ಈ ಎಲ್ಲದರ ನಡುವೆ, ಭೂಮಿ ತನ್ನ ಬದುಕಿನ ಹೊಸ ದಾರಿ ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ತಾಳಾ? ಎಂಬುವುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳ್ತಾ ಇರಿ KUKU FM.

final-bharosa-3.title: Final Bharosa
final-bharosa-3.description: Sunaina, a divorcee, is forced into a new life by billionaire Anya’s stubbornness to find her father, Shashwat, a wife. Shashwat hides his wealth to live simply, but Sunaina’s toxic ex and greedy relatives return to torment her. Will she ever learn that her humble husband is actually a tycoon? Amidst betrayal and hidden riches, how will this love story end?

u-turn-2.title: U Turn
u-turn-2.description: ಒಬ್ಬ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಯುವತಿ ಭೀಕರ ಕಾರ್ ಆ್ಯಕ್ಸಿಡೆಂಟಲ್ಲಿ ಜೀವ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ತಾಳೆ‌. ಈ ಘಟನೆ ನಡೆದು ಕೆಲವೇ ಹೊತ್ತಿಗೇ ಭಾನುಪ್ರತಾಪ್ ಮಗ ರಿಷಭ್ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ರಸ್ತೆ ಅಪಘಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದ. ಅವನ ಶವವನ್ನೂ ಮನೆಯವರಿಗೆ ಹಸ್ತಾಂತರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಅಂತಿಮ ವಿಧಿ ವಿಧಾನಗಳೂ ನಡೆದ್ವು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಮಾರನೇ ದಿನ ರಿಷಭ್ ಜೀವಂತವಾಗಿ ಕಣ್ಣೆದುರೇ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಮೊದಲು ಅಸು ನೀಗಿದ ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಯಾರು? ಈ ರಿಷಭ್ ಯಾರು? ಈಗ ರಿಷಭ್ ಬದುಕಿದ್ದಾನೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ, ಅಂದು ಸಿಕ್ಕ ದೇಹ ಯಾರದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಕ್ರೈಂ ಸಸ್ಪೆನ್ಸ್ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'U ಟರ್ನ್'.

kalaavida.title: Kalaavida
kalaavida.description: ಒಬ್ಬ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತ ಚಿತ್ರಕಲಾವಿದ, ತನ್ನ ಭವಿಷ್ಯವನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಲು ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾಗ, ಅವನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಚಾನಕ್ ಆಗಿ ಕಲಾವತಿ ಎಂಬ ಅಂಜನಾತ್ಮಕ ಯುವತಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುತ್ತಳೆ. ಇದು ಅವನ ಜೀವನದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಹಾದಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸಿಬಿಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಕಲಾವತಿಯ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಗಂಭೀರ ರಹಸ್ಯವೇನು? ಅವಳ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಏನು? ಸ್ನೇಹ, ಪ್ರೇಮ, ನಂಬಿಕೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಮೋಸಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ನಡೆಯುವ ಈ ಸೈಕಲಾಜಿಕಲ್ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ  KUKUFM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

doctors-vs-billionaires-1.title: Doctors vs Billionaires
doctors-vs-billionaires-1.description: Roshan and Neelima were on their way to celebrate their daughter Arya’s 12th birthday. But on the way, their car collided with Dr. Raghunath’s car. The argument escalated so badly that Roshan and Neelima demanded 50 lakh rupees from him and even crossed all limits of humiliation. However, they had no idea that their daughter Arya had already been taken to the hospital, and the only person who could treat her was Dr. Raghunath himself. Will Dr. Raghunath reach the hospital in time?

mohini-8.title: Mohini
mohini-8.description: "ಮೋಹಿನಿ" ಒಂದು ರೋಮಾಂಚಕ ಸೈಕಲಾಜಿಕಲ್ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಕಥೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಪುರಾತನ ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಭ್ರಮೆ, ರಹಸ್ಯ, ಪ್ರೇತಾತ್ಮಕ ಅನುಭವಗಳ ಜೊತೆ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆಯೂ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.  ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ನಾಯಕ ಆದಿತ್ಯ, ಅವನು ಒಂದು ಪುರಾತತ್ವ ವಿಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಗಾಗಿ ಹೋಗುವ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅವನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ಘಟನೆಗಳು ನಡೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ರಾಮಪುರದ ಕೋಟೆ, ಅದೃಶ್ಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳು, ಮೋಹಕವಾದ ಧ್ವನಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಆತಂಕದ ವಾತಾವರಣ ಈ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಕುತೂಹಲಕರವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಅಂಶಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯೆ, ಮೋಹಿನಿಯು ಎಷ್ಟು ನಿಜ? ಎಷ್ಟು ಭ್ರಮೆ? ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು ಓದುಗರನ್ನು ತುದಿಗಾಲಲ್ಲಿ ಕೂರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ತರಹದ ಇಂಟ್‌ರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳ್ತಾಇರಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FM

the-4-hour-workweek.title: The 4 Hour Workweek
the-4-hour-workweek.description: "The 4-Hour Workweek"  ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಕ್ರಮಣಕಾರಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ ತರಬಹುದಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ 9-5 ಕೆಲಸದ ಸುತ್ತಲಿನ ಗೊಂದಲವನ್ನು ಒಡೆದು, ನಿಮಗೆ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸಲು ಹೊಸ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ, ಪರವಾನಗಿ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ, ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ಹಾದಿಯನ್ನು ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಮನೋಜ್ಞವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

my-papas-perfect-match.title: Papa's Perfect Match
my-papas-perfect-match.description: 6 saal ka Ansh apne papa Samar Oberoi se sirf ek cheez mangta hai - mummy. Ek din Ansh Riya ko dekhkar pehli nazar mein use apni mummy banane ko than leta hai aur Samar ko Riya ko ghar lana padta hai. Par Riya ko pata nahi hai ki wo jis Samar ko ek mamooli driver samajhti hai wo duniya ka sabse ameer businessman hai. Kya hoga jab Riya ko pata chalegi Samar ki asaliyat? Kya Ansh ko milegi uske papa ki perfect match?

this-is-what-america-looks-like.title: This Is What America Looks Like
