this-is-what-america-looks-like.description: ಮಾನಸಿಕವಾಗಿ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದಿರೋ ಅಮೆರಿಕದಂತಹ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ವಲಸೆ ಹೋಗಿ, ಬದುಕು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಸುಲಭದ ಮಾತಲ್ಲ! ಅಮೆರಿಕನ್ನರು ನಿರ್ಲಜ್ಜವಾಗಿ ಆಚರಿಸೋ ವರ್ಣಬೇಧ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿರೋ ಸಂಗತಿಯೇ. ಅದರಲ್ಲೂ ಅವರು ವರ್ಣದ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ವಿದೇಶೀಯರನ್ನ ಹೀಯಾಳಿಸುವ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯಂತೂ ಅಮೆರಿಕನ್ನರ ನೂರಾರು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಎಂದರೆ ತಪ್ಪಾಗಲ್ಲ! ಅಮೆರಿಕದಂತಹ ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್‌ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ವಲಸೆ ಹೋಗಿ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ರೆಫ್ಯೂಜಿಯಾಗಿ, ಹೋರಾಟದ ಮೂಲಕ ಅಮೆರಿಕದ ಗವರ್ನ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಪಡೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಕಪ್ಪು ಹುಡುಗಿಯ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನ ಕೇಳಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ಮೊಟ್ಟಮೊದಲ ಆಫ್ರಿಕನ್‌-ಅಮೆರಿಕನ್‌ ರೆಫ್ಯೂಜಿ ಇಲಾನ್‌ ಓಮರ್‌ಳ ಮೈನವಿರೇಳಿಸುವ ಆತ್ಮಕಥನ "This Is What America Looks Like"ನ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

fake-wife-6.title: Fake Wife
fake-wife-6.description: 5 saal se Dev Joshi apni biwi Riya Kapoor ki har insult chup-chaap sehta hai. Par jab Riya ka pehla pyaar Avinash Malhotra wapas aata hai, toh Dev divorce papers sign karke chala jata hai. Ek din jab billionaire Shreya Rao, Dev ki zindagi mein aati hai aur usse sach mein pyaar karti hai, to Riya yah dekhkar jal uthti hai aur apne kiye par pachhtati hai. Kya Shreya sach mein Dev ki perfect match hai? Kya Riya Dev ko Shreya ke sath khush dekh payegi ya phir khadi karegi uske liye ek nayi museebat?

the-serendipity-mindset.title: The Serendipity Mindset
the-serendipity-mindset.description: ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೂ, ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಹಣ ಕೂಡಿಟ್ರೂ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿದಾಯಕ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸೋದು ಇಂದಿನ ಹೈ-ಟೆಕ್‌ ಲೈಫ್‌ಸ್ಟೈಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಚಾಲೆಂಜಿಂಗ್‌ ಆಗಿಬಿಟ್ಟಿದೆ. ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯನ್ನ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ಭರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಕೆಲಸದ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕೋದನ್ನ ಎಷ್ಟೋ ಜನ ತಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿಯನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಕೆಲಸದ ಜಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೆಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳ ಚಿಂತಿಸೋದು, ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸದ ಒತ್ತಡದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚಿಂತಿಸೋದು - ಹೀಗೆ ಅರ್ಥಹೀನವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕೋದ್ರಿಂದ ಪ್ರಶಾಂತ ಮನಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನ ಹೊಂದೋಕೆ, ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಾದ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸೋಕೆ ಕಷ್ಟಕರವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಜರ್ಮನ್‌ ಲೇಖಕ ಕ್ರಿಶ್ಚಿಯನ್‌ ಬುಷ್‌ ಬರೆದಿರೋ, ಪ್ರಶಾಂತಮಯ ಬದುಕಿಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗಬಲ್ಲ "The Serendipity Mindset" ಎಂಬ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಬುಕ್‌ನ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

i-respectfully-disagree.title: I Respectfully Disagree
i-respectfully-disagree.description: "I Respectfully Disagree" ನಮ್ಮ ಇಂದಿನ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಜನೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿದೆ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ, ಧರ್ಮ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಿಚಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳು ಉಲ್ಬಣವಾಗಿವೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ, ಜಸ್ಟಿನ್ ಜೋನ್ಸ್-ಫೋಸು, ವಿವಾದಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಗೌರವಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ನಾವು ಭಿನ್ನ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿದಾಗ, ಕೋಪಗೊಳ್ಳದೆ, ತಾಳ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ, ಹೃದಯಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಉತ್ತಮ ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಗೌರವಕ್ಕೆ ಐದು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

the-dark-net.title: The Dark Net
the-dark-net.description: The internet was created to share information instantly, without barriers or delay. Today, we make video calls, watch the world live, and distances feel smaller. But in return, people have risked their security, privacy, and personal lives. In India, the impact was once limited, but times have changed. Now, the biggest question for a 12-year-old child is which direction to choose.

b5d789dc-a2fa-4aa2-81a4-18eaac9f0908.title: Champak, The Loser?
b5d789dc-a2fa-4aa2-81a4-18eaac9f0908.description: The microdrama chronicles the tumultuous journey of Armaan, a brilliant tech innovator and rightful heir, whose initial charismatic CEO persona is shattered by public humiliation and betrayal, primarily from his wife Kavya and her associate Rohan. Dismissed and wronged, Armaan undergoes a profound transformation, emerging as a formidable self-made businessman under various aliases, developing revolutionary AI technology with a singular focus on reclaiming his legacy. Simultaneously, Kavya, a ruthless and ambitious entrepreneur, engages in a relentless pursuit of corporate power, often employing manipulative schemes with Rohan, who himself orchestrates elaborate "games" of corporate warfare, driven by personal vendettas and a desire to test his own resilience. The narrative escalates into a high-stakes corporate battle marked by accusations of stolen technology, financial fraud, and corporate espionage, with Armaan, Kavya, and Rohan locked in a bitter rivalry. Armaan, eventually revealing his true identity as Arman Sinha, the rightful heir, strategically returns to reclaim his corporate empire from powerful figures like Rajiv ji, while facing continuous challenges from Kavya and Rohan. Amidst this corporate turmoil, heiress Ananya infiltrates the company, initially to protect her father's legacy, and develops a complex romantic connection with Armaan, further complicating the already strained relationships. Betrayals deepen as Rohan systematically manipulates Kavya, secretly sabotaging her company and marriage, leading to her public humiliation and a vow of revenge. Kavya, in turn, forms dangerous alliances, even with her estranged brother, to sabotage Armaan and Ananya, fueled by jealousy and past grievances. The conflict reaches a critical point with Ananya's poisoning, leading to a coma, and a brutal confrontation between Armaan and Rohan that results in a car crash, critically injuring Kavya. The series culminates in Ananya's miraculous awakening after eighteen months, finding Armaan (now known as Raghav) a successful CEO, publicly reaffirming their enduring love and partnership, signifying a triumph over adversity amidst the ruins of corporate and personal warfare. The show explores themes of revenge, ambition, betrayal, and the enduring power of love and legacy in a cutthroat corporate world.

भाड़े-का-पति-.title: भाड़े का पति
भाड़े-का-पति-.description: The story centers on a romance tested by class prejudice, family pressure, and repeated attempts to expose hidden wealth. Terence repeatedly presents himself in ways that make others underestimate him, first by appearing modest or poor and later by revealing that the money and connections people mocked are real. Myra, also referred to as Maya or Mayra in the digests, is caught between her family’s demands and her loyalty to Terence. Her relatives and rivals repeatedly accuse Terence of being a fraud, a gold-digger, or an opportunist, and they push her toward a more approved match. Mark emerges as the main rival suitor and public challenger, using gifts, prestige, and open declarations of love to undermine Terence. Terence stays calm under humiliation, while Myra defends him and insists that her family respect her choice. The conflict grows sharper when a contract marriage is proposed as a way to escape family pressure and protect the family business. Public gatherings become battlegrounds where insults, gift contests, and authenticity checks are used to judge Terence’s worth. Even after Terence reveals hidden wealth, suspicion does not disappear, and relatives continue to question whether his gifts and valuables are genuine. A missing-valuables dispute tied to Suresh Reddy deepens the accusations and forces the family to brace for verification. As the pressure mounts, Terence claims secret status and powerful backing, which shifts the balance but also draws in more danger. The domestic conflict then spills into criminal territory, with gang violence, kidnapping, and mistaken identity complicating the struggle over truth and control. In the middle of this chaos, a medical emergency involving Nani becomes a turning point, and Terence helps secure urgent treatment that saves her life. Even after that success, family members continue to accuse Terence and Myra of plotting for wealth and inheritance. Terence eventually reveals that he is the sole heir and owner of a major corporate group, confirming that the power behind his calm demeanor is real. That revelation does not end the conflict, but it gives him leverage against those who tried to humiliate him. Across the show, every attempt to shame Terence seems to expose more of his hidden strength, while Myra’s support keeps their relationship at the center of the struggle. The stakes remain both romantic and financial: whether love can survive class prejudice, and whether truth can outlast the family and business wars built around it.

thoda-money-thoda-magic.title: Thoda Money, Thoda Magic
thoda-money-thoda-magic.description:
Dev, a kind-hearted waiter, loses everything in one night — his job, his wife, and his dignity — all at the hands of the one person he trusted most.
With his mother's life on the line and nowhere to turn, the world humiliates him at every step.
This is a story of Dev — a man left with nothing but his will, and what he builds from the ground up.

mere-bhai-ki-dulhan.title: Mere Bhai Ki Dulhan
mere-bhai-ki-dulhan.description: After a tragic accident, Harsh Anand wakes up in the body of Anshula—the secret girlfriend of his soon-to-be brother-in-law, Lakshit. Determined to uncover the truth behind his murder and stop his sister Myra’s wedding, Harsh secretly teams up with his best friend Daksh, who has no idea it’s really him. But as they unravel lies, betrayal, and hidden agendas, Harsh begins to fear that the people closest to him may be behind his downfall.

जहाजवाला-खरबपति.title: जहाजवाला खरबपति
जहाजवाला-खरबपति.description: Ek hawai yatra ke dauraan ek amir CEO apna pahichaan chhupa ke aam aadmi ke roop mein safar karela. Kuch ghamandi air hostess okra ke chhota aadmi samajh ke beizzat kare lageli. Kahani ke beech okra maa ke yaad aur bhavna ubhar ke saamne aave la, jisse uske charitra ke gehraayi dekha jaa la. Dheere-dheere sachchai saamne aave la aur jinhone uske neecha samjha, uhe log sharminda ho jaale. Ee kahani samman, soch aur insaaniyat ke sach batawe

benaam-baap.title: Benaam Baap
benaam-baap.description: A wealthy businessman, Abhilash Singhania, loses his memory after nearly drowning while saving his son. Presumed dead, he starts a new life as a humble hotel worker, unknowingly serving his own family years later. Raised by him, an orphan girl Shikha becomes his emotional anchor. Meanwhile, his son Vihaan—now the hotel owner—mistreats him under manipulation and misunderstanding. As fragments of memory resurface and family paths cross, the story builds toward an emotional reunion.

कुली-के-डायमंड-दुल्हिन-.title: कुली के डायमंड दुल्हिन
कुली-के-डायमंड-दुल्हिन-.description: Ek nidar amir gharana ke beti tayashuda shaadi se bhaag ke khud ke bachawe khatir ego gareeb railway coolie se achanak shaadi kar leti. Bakir u saadharan laage wala aadmi ego bada raaz chhupawle ba. Jaise-jaise pyaar badhela, lalach, parivaar ke ghamand aur dhokha milke varg, pehchaan aur bharosa ke jabardast jang chhed dela.

mission-bahurani.title: Mission Bahurani
mission-bahurani.description: The story centers on the Agarwal family, where marriage, inheritance, and corporate control keep colliding. It begins with Agarwal being shocked by his son Divyan’s sudden plan to move abroad and marry within a month, forcing an immediate meeting with the prospective bride and her mother. What looks like a family decision quickly becomes a test of class, loyalty, and motive, as suspicion grows around brides, alliances, and who is truly worthy of entering the family. Across the same conflict line, public humiliation and false accusations repeatedly target vulnerable people, and those moments often escalate into violence or threats of revenge. A powerful man is mocked and dismissed before revealing himself as Gautam Aggarwal, after which he vows retaliation for the insult. In another thread, a wealthy son is publicly denied by his own father, injured, and pulled into a struggle over whether family duty means obedience or protection. Compassion also becomes a measure of worth when a young woman’s kindness after a car crash convinces an elder patriarch that she should become his daughter-in-law. The corporate side of the drama grows just as unstable, with Madhu facing a collapsing company, vanishing investor confidence, and pressure to resign. A mysterious Old Man offers massive financial help, but only if Madhu agrees to a marriage alliance, turning rescue into coercion. Her father first rejects the arrangement and later disowns her when she insists on honoring it, showing how quickly family support can disappear under financial strain. The engagement and marriage setups around Madhu become tangled with status games, financial advantage, and public humiliation. As the story continues, hidden loyalties and deceptions surface more openly, and Rashmi/Madhu is revealed as a strategic player rather than a simple romantic figure. Pregnancy, property claims, and false paternity become weapons in an inheritance war that splits the family into opposing camps. Divyant moves from defending his father to doubting the family legacy, while still trying to protect the unborn child and the people he believes are his own. Meanwhile, plots to kill Gautam and Divyant, and to frame others for the murders, push the conflict into darker territory. The final stretch suggests that many apparent alliances are unstable, with revenge, exposure, and forced marriage all competing as the family’s chosen path forward. By the end, the central stakes are no longer just love or business, but who controls the family name, the property, and the truth.

अनजान-बियाह-.title: अनजान बियाह
अनजान-बियाह-.description: Ek achanak shaadi Suhani ke taakatwar businessman Arjun se jod dela, baki duuno ek-दूसरा ke sach na jaane. Galatfahmi, raaz, office politics aur parivaar ke dabav ke beech, ee rishta dheere-dheere pyaar, bharosa aur kismat ke kahani ban jaala.

xxxl-wife-ka-hungama.title: XXXL Wife Ka Hungama
xxxl-wife-ka-hungama.description:
Shreya is sharp, talented, and the best at what she does — but the world only sees her size. At work, her own husband Aakash takes her for granted. On the streets, strangers don't hold back.
Every day, she saves someone. Nobody saves her.
This is a story of Shreya — a woman the world kept underestimating, who finally decided to stop being quiet about it.

बिना-घर-वाला-हमार-खरबपति.title: बिना घर वाला हमार खरबपति
बिना-घर-वाला-हमार-खरबपति.description: Naina’s story begins with pressure, heartbreak, and the demand that she marry for family duty rather than love. She first hopes to honor that duty through Nakul, but he rejects her and chooses Riya instead, leaving Naina humiliated and forced to face class-based insults. In the middle of that pain, Sameer repeatedly steps in as her protector, first during public clashes and then through a convenience marriage idea meant to let her grandmother see her married. What starts as an awkward arrangement slowly turns into flirtation and real chemistry, even as Naina struggles to trust another man after betrayal. The family circle becomes increasingly important, with her mother, father, and grandmother all shaping the pressure around her future. At the same time, social status keeps turning every gathering into a contest, whether through salary boasts, gift displays, or public comparisons between lovers and rivals. Naina’s past keeps colliding with her present, especially when Nakul reappears with new claims, forcing her to confront cheating, lies, and the shame he caused. She also faces repeated humiliation from people who judge her background, but she increasingly answers back instead of staying silent. The romance with Sameer deepens under secrecy, and the family begins to notice that their bond is no longer easy to hide. A major turning point comes when Sameer is revealed to be the rumored-dead CEO of Jindal Industries, exposing that the man she thought she knew was living behind a hidden identity. That revelation shakes Naina’s trust, because his wealth and power make his earlier tenderness feel like a deception. Even so, Sameer insists that he loved her when she believed he was poor and asks for forgiveness and marriage. Around them, the story keeps widening into public spectacle, with charity events, auctions, and wedding preparations all becoming stages for pride and conflict. Violence and danger also enter the picture through the club clash, leaving Sameer injured while protecting Naina and forcing the couple to confront the consequences of their secrecy. By the later stretch, the family is pulled into the truth, and acceptance begins to replace suspicion, though not without tension. The show closes its arc on a fragile balance between love, betrayal, status, and the hope that Naina can finally choose a future on her own terms.

doctor-princess.title: Doctor Princess
doctor-princess.description:
Dr. Navya Raizada built a hospital empire across Asia — then walked back into the hospital that made her, quietly, as nobody. Aryman Khurana is a CEO fighting arranged marriage, a needle phobia, and a mother who treats alliances like business deals. One blood test. One distraction. One accidental proposal neither of them saw coming.
This is a story of Navya and Aryman — two powerful people who thought they had everything figured out, until they met each other.

दोबारा-ना-मिलल-खुशी.title: दोबारा ना मिलल खुशी
दोबारा-ना-मिलल-खुशी.description: A young girl fights for her life as the only doctor who can save her gets stuck in a clash with arrogant elites on the road. As seconds slip away, ego and power stand against humanity—turning a small delay into a deadly consequence. Will compassion rise before it’s too late?

prachin-yuddh-neeti-se-modern-warfare-ta.title: Prachin Yuddh Neeti Se Modern Warfare Tak
prachin-yuddh-neeti-se-modern-warfare-ta.description: Prachin Yuddh Neeti Se Modern Warfare Tak

the-billionaire-lawyers-love-1.title: The Billionaire Lawyer's Love
the-billionaire-lawyers-love-1.description: The series begins with Kiran, a powerful CEO, disguising himself to test Sarika's sincerity, only for his plans to be thwarted by his rival, Neeraj, who publicly proposes to Sarika. Despite her father's disapproval, Sarika accepts Neeraj, igniting a brutal love triangle where Kiran endures public humiliation and threats from a jealous Neeraj. Seven years later, Sarika returns as a powerful businesswoman, forcing a professional reunion with Kiran, who still harbors deep feelings for her. Meanwhile, Neeraj, now Sarika's husband, plans to divorce her, and their daughter Mini's life is endangered due to Sarika's severe alcohol addiction, revealing profound marital strife and professional jealousy. Neeraj's life is then manipulated by Megha, who falsely accuses Sarika of child abuse and attempted murder to seize his wealth, framing her for a car incident involving Mini. Sarika is brutally imprisoned, realizing she has been meticulously framed, while Megha swiftly usurps her place by Neeraj's side. Renowned lawyer Kiran Nambiar, sharing a deep, undefined connection with Sarika, intervenes to secure her freedom, facing fierce opposition from a vengeful police officer who accuses him of being Sarika's lover. Despite mounting obstacles, Kiran leverages his immense legal power and influence, culminating in a Senior Supreme Court Judge granting Sarika's bail, exposing Kiran's formidable hidden influence. Kiran initiates a fierce legal and personal battle to free Sarika from Neeraj, who framed her and is Mini's father. Sarika returns after seven years to claim her rightful place as the heiress and CEO of her family's global Gold and Diamond empire, a position she inherits from a retiring matriarchal figure. Kiran is revealed as the current CEO of Sarika's family company and her past love, orchestrating a complex revenge plot against those who wronged Sarika. As Sarika embraces her new identity as "Rani Amma," her claim is vehemently challenged by rivals like Ananda Varma, leading to dramatic confrontations. Sarika navigates intense boardroom conflicts and external threats, asserting her authority amidst a colossal 500-crore deal. Neeraj's corporate dreams are violently shattered, leading him to accuse Sarika of sabotage, only to discover a deeper conspiracy orchestrated by his obsessed ex-lover, Radhika, who framed Sarika and caused the death of his offspring. Radhika confesses to her manipulative actions, revealing her motive to win Neeraj's affection. As Sarika rises to become a formidable CEO, Neeraj desperately seeks reconciliation, feigning remorse, but his sinister true intentions are revealed, leading to a terrifying betrayal of Rani Amma. Amidst the chaos, Sarika finds an enigmatic ally in Kiran, whose possession of her old college diary hints at a long-held secret and a burgeoning romance. The series culminates with a woman, identified as Ammu (likely Sarika), discovering her old diary, leading to Kiran dramatically revealing he became a lawyer to fulfill her youthful fantasy. A passionate modern romance ignites, but Ammu later awakens with amnesia after a mysterious night with Kiran. Despite her lost memories, Ammu accepts Kiran's unexpected marriage proposal, where he declares his love for both her and a mysterious 'Mini.'

the-peoples-saviour.title: The People's Saviour
the-peoples-saviour.description: A humble village watchman secretly lives as a once-legendary master of divine power who vanished long ago. When an ancient, apocalyptic force returns to destroy the kingdom, his estranged son is forced to lead a doomed battle. With no hope left, the man must step out of the shadows, reveal his true identity, and unleash his forgotten power to defeat the darkness and save both his son and the world.

love-test.title: Blind Love
love-test.description: A billionaire tests his blind wife’s love, until losing her becomes his greatest fear.

puthiyaniyamam-the-final-verdict.title: Puthiyaniyamam: The Final Verdict
puthiyaniyamam-the-final-verdict.description: Anirudh, a famous lawyer and hidden billionaire heir, is humiliated and rejected when the woman he loves chooses someone else. Years later, she finds herself trapped in a cruel marriage and accused of a crime she didn’t commit. Now he returns with power, revenge, and one last chance to save her.

solillada-saradaara.title: Solillada Saradaara
solillada-saradaara.description: A powerful man living as a taxi driver fights crime while hiding his true identity and past pain. When a woman from his past returns with his daughter, he must protect them and face his enemies and family secrets.

gansgter-manya-surve-pen-se-pistol-tak.title: Gangter Manya Surve: Pen Se Pistol tak
gansgter-manya-surve-pen-se-pistol-tak.description: Gansgter Manya Surve: Pen Se Pistol tak

secret-srimanthudu.title: Secret Srimanthudu
secret-srimanthudu.description: హోటల్ రిసెప్షనిస్ట్‌ని ప్రేమించి పెళ్లి చేసుకున్న రాజశేఖర్ జీవితం, కొడుకు పుట్టిన రోజు పూర్తిగా మారిపోతుంది. తన భార్య గురించి తెలిసిన ఒక షాకింగ్ నిజం అతన్ని కాలేజ్ క్లీనర్‌గా మార్చేస్తుంది. కానీ సాధారణ క్లీనర్‌లా కనిపించే అతను, ఆ కాలేజ్ ఛెయిర్ ఉమెన్ జీవితాన్ని ఎలా మలుపు తిప్పాడు అనేదే ఈ కథలో అసలు ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ పాయింట్.

the-real-deal.title: The Real Deal
the-real-deal.description: After a multibillionaire living a secret life as a hotel cleaner saves a young tech CEO from a ruthless mafia don, the two enter a contract marriage that forces him to navigate his hidden empire, a treacherous business summit, and his own son’s ignorance to dismantle a corrupt criminal cartel.

london-groom-takes-the-bride-1.title: London Rakumarudi Prema Katha
london-groom-takes-the-bride-1.description:
London Wale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge is a romantic comedy about Arjun Malhotra, a billionaire’s carefree son who fails his exams in London. Instead of giving him the family empire,his father sends him to India to live like a common man and earn success from scratch.
Working at a Delhi garage, Arjun falls for Simran, the owner’s daughter. But her arrogant boyfriend Rohit has plans to grab her family’s property. Arjun must win love and prove his worth, not as a rich heir, but as a real man. WATCH NOW

divine-husband-2.title: Divine Husband
divine-husband-2.description: அமரத்துவத்தை அடைய முயன்ற சக்திவாய்ந்த ஆன்மா, மனித உலகில் ஒரு சூதாட்டக்காரனின் உடலில் மறுபிறவி எடுக்கிறது. தனது புதிய வாழ்க்கையில், பேச முடியாத ஆனால் நல்ல மனம் கொண்ட காஜலின் வாழ்க்கையை மாற்ற முயற்சிக்கும் அவன், பணம், சக்தி, காதல் மற்றும் விதியின் போராட்டத்தில் சிக்கிக்கொள்கிறான்.

against-all-odds-2.title: Against All Odds
against-all-odds-2.description: A poor villager, Parth, dreams of a better life, but fate tests him at every step. When his wife Naina risks everything and even sacrifices her home to save his future, love turns into the ultimate gamble. Separated by destiny, betrayal, and time, will Parth rise to become a powerful CEO or lose the one person who believed in him the most?

dont-call-me-cute-i-ruled-an-empire.title: Don’t Call Me Cute, I Ruled an Empire
dont-call-me-cute-i-ruled-an-empire.description: A thousand-year-old crown prince awakens in the body of a modern six-year-old boy. Keshav Rajhans doesn’t know whether this is destiny at work or a carefully crafted conspiracy. But within the dark and twisted politics of the Rajhans family, his sharp intellect begins to shake everyone to their core. The real question is—can a child rewrite fate itself?

immortal-mahaguru.title: Immortal Mahaguru
immortal-mahaguru.description: The show begins with a dying patriarch trying to save the Singhania legacy from his own greedy descendants by binding Mahaguru to protect the family while living among them as an ordinary human for three years. That pact immediately reshapes the family’s future when Nisha is forced to marry Kunal under threat of losing the family wealth, even though she resents him and treats the marriage as temporary. From the start, Nisha humiliates Kunal and sees him as beneath her, while Kunal silently endures and hints that his place in the family is tied to a dying elder’s promise and a larger purpose. A death during the wedding and Kunal’s sudden shift in demeanor suggest that the meek husband has a far more dangerous side than anyone understands. The marriage soon becomes entangled with business warfare, as Nisha tries to use her former lover Shantanu to secure corporate advantage while Kunal is repeatedly insulted and sidelined. Hidden influence delivers Nisha a major project, but the apparent victory only deepens the mystery of who is really controlling events. Shantanu escalates the conflict by exposing his affair with Nisha to Kunal and pushing the triangle into open humiliation, jealousy, and violence. Even when Kunal intervenes to stop Shantanu’s physical aggression, Nisha sides against him, and the marriage collapses into contempt and mutual accusations. Kunal then ends the relationship decisively, signs the divorce without hesitation, rejects any settlement, and strips the marriage of whatever illusion remained. His disappearance afterward creates uncertainty, but he resurfaces in a gym under a reduced identity, concealing a stronger and possibly privileged past. There, Aalya recognizes value in him that Nisha never did, and Kunal’s protective instincts and startling physical power begin to emerge in public. When Nisha returns and tries to reassert control, she is rejected again as Kunal chooses Aalya instead of his former marriage. Humiliated and enraged, Nisha is manipulated by Shantanu into believing Kunal is a fraud exploiting Aalya, and she turns her corporate power toward revenge. At the same time, Mahaguru moves directly against the Singhania interests after perceiving disrespect, reclaiming projects and cutting contracts in ways that push the family toward financial collapse. As parties, confrontations, and public accusations unfold, Kunal increasingly appears linked to the hidden force behind the family’s downfall, though the exact nature of that link remains deliberately unstable across the digests. The story’s final movement shifts from corporate and marital revenge into overt supernatural revelation, as skepticism toward an ancient figure called Mahaguru triggers terrifying displays of power and transformation. What had long seemed like hidden influence and secret authority is finally exposed as something beyond ordinary human control. In the end, the emotional center resolves not through wealth or dominance but through acceptance, when an ancient non-human being reveals his true form to a selfless woman and finds the unconditional love he had never known before. The show ultimately fuses family legacy, humiliation, revenge, hidden identity, and mystical destiny into a rise-and-fall saga where arrogance destroys worldly power, while love and acceptance become the only lasting resolution.

lawyer-gaari-love-story.title: Lawyer Gaari Love Story
lawyer-gaari-love-story.description: కొన్ని గొప్ప విషయాలను దాచడం వల్ల గొప్ప వాళ్ళను కోల్పోవాల్సి వస్తుంది. అలానే లాయర్ కార్తీక్ తన గురించి సంధ్య దగ్గర ఒక విషయం దాచాడు. దానివల్ల ఆమె జైలుకు వెళ్ళాల్సి వచ్చింది. కార్తీక్ దాచిన ఆ విషయం ఏంటి? మలుపులు, ఎమోషన్స్, ప్రేమ అన్నీ కలిసిన కథ లాయర్ గారి లవ్ స్టోరి.

the-alpha-kings-redemption-3.title: The Alpha King’s Redemption
the-alpha-kings-redemption-3.description: A humble street-sweeper hiding as “Brij Mohan” is forced to reveal his true identity—the feared Alpha King of the wolf clans—when his teenage daughter is brutalized, kidnapped, and offered as a “gift” to a monstrous trafficker. To save her, he must reclaim his throne, unleash the wolf within, and turn an entire empire of predators into prey.

love-emergency.title: Love Emergency
love-emergency.description: Tanvi’s story moves through a series of marriages, betrayals, and status battles where love is constantly tested against money and family control. Early on, she is pushed into a wedding crisis that turns into a strategic marriage after she is saved by an ambulance driver who is later revealed to be a powerful heir or CEO in disguise. Rehan is also forced toward marriage by his father and by pressure tied to funding his NGO, so the union becomes as much about survival as romance. Across these arcs, Tanvi and her partner repeatedly use their marriage to resist humiliation and protect their dignity. Public confrontations with rivals like Daksh, Aalia, and other elite figures turn weddings, restaurants, and social venues into battlegrounds for class conflict. Tanvi is mocked, excluded, and even physically removed from spaces that are supposed to belong to the wealthy, but she keeps pushing back. In several moments, hidden ownership or hidden authority flips the power dynamic and exposes the fragility of the people humiliating her. Rehan’s secrecy becomes a major source of tension, since he presents himself as ordinary while quietly holding wealth and influence. Tanvi’s trust deepens through gestures, gifts, and shared moments, but that trust is repeatedly shaken by concealed identities and manipulative appearances. One thread shows Tanvi struggling with rent, home ownership, and workplace instability, while another shows her being elevated into roles that come with new authority. The cafe and home plots both become arenas where Tanvi must defend her place against people who claim she does not belong. Later, Tanvi learns that the man she married has hidden his true identity and even used wealth to stay close to her, which makes her feel betrayed rather than protected. She reacts by demanding distance and considering divorce, showing that love alone cannot erase deception. At the same time, other couples in the batch are tested by patriarchs who try to buy them apart, only to discover that loyalty cannot be measured in money. Those tests eventually reveal regret in the older generation, suggesting that the real conflict is not only between rich and poor but between control and genuine affection. By the end of the batch, the story settles into a sharper emotional divide: Tanvi wants truth and respect, while the men around her must prove that their love is not just another form of power.

kavalaal-the-ultimate-protector.title: Kavalaal - The Ultimate Protector
kavalaal-the-ultimate-protector.description: After years away, Siddharth Menon returns to his village as a man everyone believes is a failure — unaware that he is now the secret owner of a global corporate empire. As betrayal, greed, and corruption threaten the people who once saved his life, Siddharth hides his true identity while fighting to protect them from within. In a world where truth is mocked and power is disguised; one man quietly becomes their ultimate protector.

ek-khiladi-chaar-haseena.title: Ek Khiladi Chaar Haseena
ek-khiladi-chaar-haseena.description: After a mysterious old man gifts a humiliated delivery rider a device that grants 100X cashback on every rupee spent on a woman, he must systematically transform his life and "max out" the affection of four unique women to reclaim his power and become a king.

chaddi-gang-cctv-gu-sigada-psychogalu.title: Chaddi Gang : CCTV gu sigada Psychogalu
chaddi-gang-cctv-gu-sigada-psychogalu.description: The microdrama unfolds as the tranquil village of Harohalli is targeted by the notorious 'Chaddi Gang,' setting their sights on the isolated home of Appa and Amma. The elderly couple eagerly awaits their son, Vikas, who is returning with significant funds and family jewelry to launch his dream business, making them an unwitting target. Despite initial police vigilance, a perceptive constable's warnings about the gang are dismissed by his superior, leaving the family vulnerable. As the gang invades, Appa is brutally restrained, and Amma awakens to the terrifying reality of their home invasion. Vikas, delayed on a train, senses an impending disaster, his call to his parents cut short as the gang struggles to breach a secure locker. Amma is held hostage and forced to mislead Vikas and his wife, Sushma, over the phone, while the gang grows increasingly violent over the empty locker, threatening her life. Realizing the grave danger, Vikas makes a desperate call to the police. A constable, haunted by the brutal murder of his own parents by the same gang, races to the scene, initially instructed to await backup. Inside, the family, led by Appa, devises a cunning plan to poison the intruders. Driven by personal vendetta, the constable breaches the house alone, only to be ambushed and captured. Vikas's journey home is further delayed by a flat tire, while the gang mysteriously collapses one by one after consuming the poisoned meal. A final confrontation erupts when an enraged robber threatens Appa, but the escaped constable intervenes, leading to the gang's arrest and the family's tearful reunion. The stakes involve the family's survival, the protection of their ancestral assets, and the constable's personal quest for justice against the 'Chaddi Gang.'

runway-ka-rajkumar.title: Runway ka Rajkumar
runway-ka-rajkumar.description:
Kavya, a runaway bride in a wedding lehenga, throws her arms around a complete stranger at the airport and declares him her husband — just to escape the man she's being forced to marry.
The stranger is Armaan. A ground staff worker, she thinks. She has no idea who he really is.
This is a story of Kavya and Armaan — two people who faked a landing, and ended up finding something real.

bediddannu-koduva-rayara-honnava.title: Bediddannu Koduva, Rayara Honnava
bediddannu-koduva-rayara-honnava.description:
ರಾಯರ ದರ್ಶನಕ್ಕೆ ಮಂತ್ರಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗೋಕೆ ಆಗ್ತಿಲ್ವಾ? ಡೋಂಟ್ ವರಿ, ಸಾಕ್ಷಾತ್ ರಾಯರೇ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ!

ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಮಾಗಡಿ ರೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರೋ 'ಹೊನ್ನವ ಮಂತ್ರಾಲಯ'ದ ಪವಾಡಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕೇಳಿದ್ರೆ ನೀವು ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ಪಡ್ತೀರಾ. 

ಸೆಲೆಬ್ರಿಟಿಗಳಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರವರೆಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಬದುಕನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದ ಆ ರಾಯರ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನ ನೋಡೋ ಕುತೂಹಲ ನಿಮ್ಗೆ ಇದ್ಯಾ? ಕಣ್ಣೀರು ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡು ಬಂದವರ ಲೈಫ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಆ ಪವಾಡಗಳೇನ್ನ ನೀವೂ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಬೇಕಾ? 

ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳಿಗೂ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ರಾಯರ ಅಭಯ! ಈಗ್ಲೇ ನೋಡಿ, “ಹೊನ್ನವ ಮಂತ್ರಾಲಯ ಪವಾಡಗಳು” ಗುರು ಆಪ್ ನ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಕ್ಲೂಸಿವ್ ಡಿವೋಷನಲ್ ಸಿರೀಸ್.

kannadada-kotyadhipathigalu-business-mas.title: Kannadada Kotyadhipathigalu - Business Masters
kannadada-kotyadhipathigalu-business-mas.description:
ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರಿಗೆ ಬ್ಯುಸಿನೆಸ್ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಯಾಕಿಷ್ಟು ಭಯ? "ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಕೆಲಸ, safe salary ಸಾಕು" ಅನ್ನೋ mindset ಇಂದ ಹೊರಬಂದು, ನಾವೂ ಬಾಸ್ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋ ಕನಸು ಕಾಣೋದು ತಪ್ಪಾ?

ಬರೀ success ಸ್ಟೋರಿಗಳಲ್ಲ, ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರ Entrepreneurship ಅಸಲಿ ಕಹಾನಿ ಬಿಚ್ಚಿಡ್ತಿರೋ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಕ್ಲೂಸಿವ್ Masterclass ಇದು! 

Family pressure, risk ತಗೊಳೋ ಭಯ, job security ಬಿಟ್ಟು startup ಶುರು ಮಾಡೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? 

ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಮಾತ್ರ ಅಲ್ಲಾ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮೂಲೆ-ಮೂಲೆಯಿಂದ ಬಂದ ರಿಯಲ್ ಬ್ಯುಸಿನೆಸ್ ಮೈಂಡ್‌ಗಳ ಜೊತೆಗಿನ Most informative Micro series.

wife-between-us.title: Wife between Us
wife-between-us.description: A ruthless billionaire discovers his seemingly devoted wife is secretly engaged to his childhood bully, forcing him to crash their engagement and expose a web of betrayal, greed, and past trauma in a brutal showdown

mai-20-ka-lover-40-ki.title: Mai 20 ka, Lover 40 ki
mai-20-ka-lover-40-ki.description:
A 40-year-old widow who accidentally handcuffs a stranger to her bed on her birthday. A 20-year-old celebrity model who finds something real in her that fame never gave him.
The world has opinions. She has doubts. He has only certainty.
This is a story of Sonia and Veer — and what happens when the right person shows up at the most inconvenient age.

doctor-vs-billionaires-4.title: डॉक्टर और पीसा आला की लड़ाई

blunder-on-ship.title: Blunder on Ship
blunder-on-ship.description: After hiring a seemingly ordinary bartender to pose as her "rented husband" to escape a predatory business merger, a struggling CEO discovers her fake spouse is actually the reclusive "Ocean King"—a billionaire tycoon who begins secretly using his vast empire to dismantle her enemies and turn their contract into a reality.

doctor-vs-billionaires-5.title: ડોક્ટર Vs બિલિયોનેર્સ
doctor-vs-billionaires-5.description: એક નાની બાળકી આર્યા જીવ અને મરણ વચ્ચે સંઘર્ષ કરી રહી છે, ત્યારે તેને બચાવી શકે એવો ડોક્ટર રસ્તામાં અમીર લોકોના અહંકારમાં ફસાઈ જાય છે. સમય હાથમાંથી નીકળી રહ્યો છે અને નાની વિલંબ પણ જાનલેણ બની શકે છે. શું માનવતા જીતશે કે પૈસા અને અહંકાર બધું બરબાદ કરી દેશે?

32cf279c-7cb3-4e78-9cc1-e6a8327e5433.title: Sajan Ji Ghar Aaye
32cf279c-7cb3-4e78-9cc1-e6a8327e5433.description: The show follows Avni as her wedding collapses into scandal and public humiliation, while Mayur moves through her life under shifting identities that make him both protector and source of distrust. Early on, betrayal around Avni’s marriage is exposed through confrontations, hidden evidence, and a damaging video that reveals Jatin’s involvement with Isha and destroys whatever trust remained in that match. As the fallout turns mob-like and Avni’s father’s failing condition raises the stakes, Mayur steps in and an immediate marriage is arranged as a protective answer to family honor and a father’s final wish. That marriage begins as a farzi or staged union, forcing Avni and Mayur to perform intimacy in front of relatives while privately guarding the truth. Their fragile arrangement is constantly threatened by simple family questions, wedding rituals, and domestic expectations that could expose the lie at any moment. At the same time, Mayur’s concealed status keeps generating suspicion, because many around Avni see him as socially inferior and treat the marriage as a disgrace. Much of the show’s conflict comes from repeated public humiliations in family and wedding spaces, where Avni is mocked for her husband, her class position, her clothes, and even her right to belong in the household. Mayur repeatedly defends her, but his secrecy also deepens her anger, especially when he delays telling her who he really is. Wealth and status become weapons throughout the story, with rings, designer gifts, a luxury car, and auction items all turning into tests of legitimacy, ownership, and social worth. Jatin and Isha remain recurring sources of taunts and exposure, while other relatives and guests amplify the cruelty by turning rituals and gatherings into spectacles of shame. The pressure expands beyond domestic conflict into danger, including violent confrontations, a deadly standoff, and a shooting after which Avni fears losing Mayur. His survival briefly restores tenderness, and their bond grows more openly emotional even as power, security, and hidden agendas surround him. A major turning point comes when news breaks that Mayur Deshmukh, believed dead after a plane crash, is alive and reclaiming his business, transforming earlier insults into a larger mystery about why he lived in concealment. Later, in a public auction dispute, Mayur’s identity as the Deshmukh CEO is finally validated when payment records and a senior executive confirm his authority. He then explains that his hidden life was tied to an earlier accident he says was orchestrated by his own uncle, and that he stayed undercover to gather proof against that conspiracy. For Avni, this revelation is both vindication and betrayal, because the man she defended and the man who deceived her are the same person. The emotional core of the show becomes whether love can survive a relationship built under pressure, performance, and withheld truth. By the end, Avni and Mayur openly confess love but place honesty and loyalty at the center of their bond, making truth itself the final stake after so many battles over honor, status, and identity.

doctor-vs-billionaires-6.title: डॉक्टर vs अरबपति
doctor-vs-billionaires-6.description: Nanhi Aarya zindagi aur maut se lad rahi ba, jabki ek maahir doctor raaste me kuchh ameer logan ke ego ke chakkar me phans jaata. Samay haath se nikalta jaa raha ba, aur ek chhoti si deri jaanleva ban sakti ba. Kya insaaniyat jeet paayegi ya paisa aur ghamand sab kuchh barbaad kar dega?

anaganaga-oka-raju.title: Anaganaga Oka Raju
anaganaga-oka-raju.description: A struggling delivery boy is reborn in an ancient village as Mahendra, where a magical Thantra, three destined wives, and modern ideas help him rise from a mocked nobody to the ruler and protector of the people.

7cfb8882-98d4-4881-8f63-64be88d4a0dd.title: Tum Agar Saath Ho
7cfb8882-98d4-4881-8f63-64be88d4a0dd.description: The show unfolds as a dense melodrama about family pressure, hidden identities, and the cost of dignity. It begins with several separate but thematically linked conflicts in which characters are pushed by relatives, class prejudice, and urgent medical crises. Kabir refuses to accept reassuring test results for his sister and insists on treatment abroad, showing how fear can override expert certainty. Around him, other households are equally unstable, with marriage pressure, remarriage anxiety, and repeated attempts to measure love against wealth or status. Women in particular are shown absorbing public humiliation at work, in matchmaking, and inside their own homes, often while trying to protect their livelihoods or their place in the family. Romantic possibility appears in awkward, uneven encounters, but it is usually shadowed by money, pride, or social difference. Tara becomes one of the central figures as she is mocked, tested, and repeatedly forced to defend her worth in marriage and in public. Her marriage is immediately strained by suspicion, with her husband questioning her sincerity and another identity mystery opening around a woman who resembles a missing sister. Family rituals that should confirm belonging instead become scenes of insult, slaps, and open hostility. The conflict widens into custody panic, accusations of witchcraft, and threats that suggest how far some relatives will go to control a child or preserve honor. In another thread, a husband is publicly accused of theft and fraud, while his wife refuses to abandon him and others demand apologies for the humiliation. Corporate and social power also enter the story, as a disguised woman is mocked and a major contract becomes entangled with degrading bargains. Tara’s situation grows more dangerous when her ex returns, tries to win her back with money and status, and then undermines her husband’s identity. At the same time, she is pressured to sell her late mother’s land to cover a relative’s emergency care, and a supposed ally secretly helps arrange a coercive land grab. That betrayal escalates into a kidnapping plot, showing how quickly family obligation can turn predatory. The later episodes intensify the theme of concealed truth through a coercive kidney-transplant scheme that is exposed only when Kabir Mehra storms in and reveals the recipient did not actually need the organ. The revelation triggers public confrontation, slaps, and threats, and it also destroys trust in Kabir Mehra’s own marriage when his wife learns he hid his identity as a test of love. Another missing-child investigation then brings a woman named Isha back into the family as the claimed lost sister, keeping identity and belonging at the center of the drama. By the end, the show’s stakes are clear: love is repeatedly tested against deception, family loyalty is repeatedly corrupted by control, and survival depends on whether the characters can protect truth, property, and one another before humiliation turns into irreversible loss.

untold-story-of-sammakka-sarakka.title: Untold Story of Sammakka Sarakka
untold-story-of-sammakka-sarakka.description: Manaku telisna kadha okkati.! manaki teliyani kadha inka chaala undi sammakka sarakka la asalu kadha ippudu ee seris lo undi purthiga chudandi.!

ishq-by-chance.title: Ishq By Chance
ishq-by-chance.description: After being betrayed and fired by her cheating boyfriend and jealous best friend, a resilient designer finds a second chance at love and career when she is hired by a protective CEO who helps her reclaim her professional dignity and ancestral home.

secret-rajkumar.title: Secret Rajkumar
secret-rajkumar.description: Aryan's journey begins as an ordinary student, publicly humiliated and rejected by Priya for a wealthy suitor, only to be dramatically revealed as the long-lost grandson and appointed CEO of the powerful Aurora Group. This sudden rise ignites a fierce desire for revenge against those who scorned him, including his ex-lover Nandhini and her partner Varun, as he navigates intense corporate power struggles. He uses his newfound wealth to challenge institutional corruption, protecting friends like Nila from harassment, but also faces public exposure as a dine-and-dasher before his true identity as a powerful CEO and hidden heir is fully unveiled. As CEO of the Hobray/Oobrai Group, Aryan systematically dismantles corrupt empires, reclaiming his family legacy from figures like Abhimanyu, while confronting past betrayals. He engages in strategic, sometimes fake, relationships, such as with Swetha, but a genuine and complex connection with Nila begins to form. Nila's personal crisis, marked by her mother's critical illness, sees Aryan emerge as her unwavering protector, funding surgery and demonstrating mysterious influence, which deepens their bond. Aryan is unexpectedly named CEO of a formidable corporate empire by his grandfather, a move that threatens to expose his carefully guarded secrets. He enters a contract for a fabricated relationship with Nila to escape her manipulative business partner, Venkat, who becomes a dangerous adversary. His true identity as Arya, the undercover grandson of CEO Raghavan and new CEO of OBR Group, is dramatically revealed, having operated undercover to purge corruption within the organization. Now fully powerful, Aryan rejects ex-lovers and exposes scheming plots, solidifying his commitment to Nila. However, a new and dangerous threat emerges in the form of the obsessive Maya, who violently attacks Aryan, targeting his deep love for Nila and vowing relentless revenge. The show culminates in Aryan's high-stakes fight to protect his loved ones and secure his rightful legacy against escalating personal and corporate adversaries.

blacklisted-wife.title: Blacklisted Wife
blacklisted-wife.description: A hardened army officer strikes a deal with a suicidal, blacklisted girl to become his fake wife, but as suspicion grows that she may be a spy from his past, their contract marriage turns into a dangerous game of trust, identity, and forbidden love.

kodeeswaran-reloaded.title: Kodeeswaran Reloaded
kodeeswaran-reloaded.description: The story repeatedly follows people trying to survive humiliation, poverty, and power games while protecting family ties. It begins with orphaned sisters Aarti and Annanya, who are starving and homeless until a kind stranger feeds them and offers them a home, education, and a new family bond. In parallel, Karthik quietly works multiple jobs and hides his hardship while supporting younger sisters, even as one sister behaves entitled and rejects the food he provides. Family honor becomes another pressure point when Karthik learns that Arthi’s romantic entanglements may damage the family’s reputation, while a loyal younger brother vows to study hard and protect that standing. Another thread introduces Aathi, whose peaceful life is disrupted by a call about a ten-year-old vow and a forgotten past, suggesting old obligations are returning. The narrative then moves deeper into corporate conflict, where Karthik returns after years of penance and is pushed back toward leadership after working as a garbage collector. Nila and other managers treat him harshly, but his firing triggers a collapse in the company’s digital systems and market value, and he retaliates by transferring accounts and funds. Corporate rivalries intensify as Ananya and other ambitious figures are accused of incompetence, nepotism, or stolen success, and threats of legal ruin and professional exposure become common. Hidden family connections repeatedly surface in public, forcing characters to conceal or reveal their origins while competing for jobs and status. Karthik discovers that Ananya is not just a new intern but his estranged sister, yet he refuses legal action and instead says he will personally handle and change her fate. Ananya, meanwhile, loses a job opportunity and blames a mysterious beggar-like figure for ruining her chance, while Aravind helps her try to recover it. Aarthi’s promotion and later appointment as a personal secretary become major turning points, but they also draw suspicion because her brother’s sudden wealth and secrecy do not add up. Public humiliation is a constant weapon, whether in interviews, at a costly restaurant, or in front of company staff, and it often turns into a reversal when hidden status is exposed. A long manager-selection contest pits Ananya against Aarthi, with valuation tests, sabotage, and a failed gold-making machine challenge turning merit into spectacle. Ananya uses romance and manipulation to gain support, while Aarthi repeatedly rejects money and influence and insists that integrity matters more than status. The contest’s outcome remains unstable: Aarthi is declared the winner at one point, but a later fax names Ananya instead, deepening accusations of injustice. Across the batch, family loyalty, class prejudice, and corporate ambition keep colliding, and every attempt to bury the past seems to bring it back more forcefully.

queen-ka-comeback.title: Queen Ka Comeback
queen-ka-comeback.description: After being heartlessly discarded by her tech-CEO husband on their anniversary, a seemingly ordinary assistant reveals her secret identity as the legendary hacker "Doctor Nova" to reclaim her power. Joining forces with her ex’s greatest rival in a high-stakes contract marriage, she orchestrates a brilliant corporate revenge to dismantle her former husband's empire and find true respect.

london-groom-takes-the-bride.title: London Groom Takes the Bride
london-groom-takes-the-bride.description:
London Wale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge is a romantic comedy about Arjun Malhotra, a billionaire’s carefree son who fails his exams in London. Instead of giving him the family empire,his father sends him to India to live like a common man and earn success from scratch.
Working at a Delhi garage, Arjun falls for Simran, the owner’s daughter. But her arrogant boyfriend Rohit has plans to grab her family’s property. Arjun must win love and prove his worth, not as a rich heir, but as a real man. WATCH NOW

car-pyaar-aur-dhoka.title: Car, Pyaar Aur Dhoka
car-pyaar-aur-dhoka.description: A neglected billionaire’s perfect life shatters when his wife’s secret lover crashes his supercar into him, triggering a brutal confrontation where betrayal is revealed in the middle of the street.

my-secret-ceo-kanavan.title: My Secret CEO Kanavan
my-secret-ceo-kanavan.description:
A billionaire loses his memory after a passionate night… and marries the wrong sister by mistake.
Years later, the real girl unknowingly falls in love with him while he hides his true identity as a poor bodyguard. But when the truth about that night comes out, love turns into the deadliest betrayal.

meri-marzi.title: Meri Marzi
meri-marzi.description: The microdrama centers on Anaya Mehta, a defiant heiress battling a pre-arranged marriage to CEO Mihir Virani, crucial for her company's survival, as she fiercely seeks personal and corporate independence. Her path intertwines with the enigmatic Aryan, initially through a proposed contract marriage and later as a business rival, who is also Jessica's scorned ex-fiancé returning wealthy to seek vindication. Aryan publicly humiliates Jessica and her new partner, Vicky, for their materialism. Anaya publicly declares her marriage to Aryan, shattering his past engagement to Jessica and forming a united front against their adversaries, with their initially strategic partnership deepening into a genuine connection. Anaya faces intense pressure from her formidable grandmother, Geethanjali, who disowns her for defying an arranged marriage to Mihir, while battling corporate rivals like Vicky Thakkar and his father. Aryan dramatically reveals his true identity as the powerful CEO Mr. Kapadiya, turning the tables on their enemies, orchestrating corporate takeovers, and securing vital investments for Anaya. Anaya defiantly chooses Aryan over family expectations, leading to her disownment, and uncovers a hostile takeover plot against her company. Amidst these escalating battles, Anaya's romantic life remains complex, with declarations of love for Raaj and Aryan rejecting Inaya (Anaya). Ultimately, Anaaya (Anaya) defies her family's powerful corporate legacy to pursue an independent life with Venky, questioning his acceptance of her beyond her professional status.

aalia-in-paradise.title: Aalia In Paradise
aalia-in-paradise.description: Aaliya, a blacklisted model, becomes secretary to billionaire Kabir Singhania, who hides his identity to win her love. Their contract romance is plagued by sabotage from jealous rivals and vindictive exes. Just as she's about to marry him, she discovers Kabir orchestrated the ruse to humiliate her, not wed her. When all is lost, she's saved by another billionaire, and her life takes a series of unexpected, life-changing turns.

the-cheat-code.title: The Cheat Code
the-cheat-code.description: When prodigy Virat is accused of cheating after his answers mirror his brother Shivaay’s, his world collapses. But fate grants him a second run. Armed with foresight, he re-enters the global contest, hunting the truth behind a chilling secret that’s copying his mind. In a battle of intellect and illusion, trust is the real puzzle.

doctor-vs-billionaires-3.title: Doctor Vs Billionaires
doctor-vs-billionaires-3.description: The story opens with Arya’s close, playful bond with Dadu and Paresh, but that warmth is shattered by a sudden accident that sends her into a life-threatening medical emergency. From that point on, the central stakes become simple and brutal: Arya must reach the right treatment in time, or she may not survive. The hospital repeatedly warns that her pulse is weak, her condition is critical, and every delay matters. At the same time, Paresh and other family members are trapped in a widening web of roadside disputes, extortion, and humiliation that keeps them from the child’s bedside. What begins as a car-damage argument grows into coercion, threats, and violence, with wealthy or powerful figures using the emergency to assert control. Dr. Raghunath, the specialist needed for Arya’s care, is also blocked and pressured, making the medical crisis even harder to resolve. Other doctors and colleagues scramble to find alternatives, but the child’s rare and worsening condition leaves little room for error. As the pressure mounts, the family is pulled into confusion over missing patients, broken communication, and hospital secrecy, and suspicion spreads that someone is hiding the truth. Roshan and Nilima become consumed by blame and revenge, while the hospital turns into a place of fear rather than relief. The conflict escalates into physical confrontation, accusations, and forced apologies, showing how the emergency has been entangled with past grievances and public humiliation. At one point, the family even fears Arya has died, and grief briefly overtakes the story. That fear is later overturned when Arya is revealed to have survived, shifting the emotional center from loss to guilt and reckoning. The parents then face the devastating realization that they themselves had unknowingly delayed the only doctor who could save her. Dr. Raghunath, who had been treated as an enemy, becomes the one who explains the gravity of the mistake and helps stop the parents’ self-punishment. The final stretch turns toward accountability, with Roshan and Nilima receiving legal punishment and the consequences of their actions being framed as a lesson. By the end, the story settles into a fragile peace built on survival, remorse, and the possibility of forgiveness, though the emotional damage is still present.

seven-wonders.title: Seven Wonders
seven-wonders.description: Ek raat nashe me Rajat aur Priya ke beech woh hua jisne unki zindagi hamesha ke liye badal di. Subah ek galatfahmi ne Priya ko Rajat se door kar diya. Iske baad Priya ne saat anokhe bachchon ko janam diya—har ek me chhupi thi ek ajeeb taaqat. Rajat use har jagah dhoondhta raha, par kismat ne kabhi unhe milne na diya. Ab wahi saat bachche apne maa-baap ko milane nikle… kya woh apne maksad me kaamyaab ho paayenge?

the-undercover-lady-ceo-3.title: The Undercover Lady CEO
the-undercover-lady-ceo-3.description: When TerraGem’s young VP Aparna Talwar goes undercover as an intern to expose a massive money-fraud, a ruthless social climber, Revathi, steals her identity as “Mrs. Adithya” and turns the office into a bullying circus. To save her marriage, her company—and her own name—Aparna must outplay the impostor and catch the laundering ring before it destroys her.

mr-jamai-hidden-ceo.title: MR JAMAI HIDDEN CEO
mr-jamai-hidden-ceo.description: Rishi, the hidden founder of aerospace giant Pankh, lives as a poor mechanic for his family, who see him as a failure. Betrayed and humiliated, he reveals his true identity and rises to global success. Now, his wife and daughter must face regret for losing the man they never valued.

boss-lady-shailoo.title: Boss Lady Shailoo
boss-lady-shailoo.description:
A powerful CEO hides her true identity and enters her own company as an intern to uncover a massive fraud. But what starts as a secret mission soon turns into a battlefield of ego, deception, and betrayal where enemies wear friendly faces, and one wrong move could cost her everything.
Will Shailoo expose the truth before the truth destroys her?

the-undercover-lady-ceo-2.title: The Undercover Lady CEO
the-undercover-lady-ceo-2.description: ஆதித்யா தல்வாரின் மனைவி அலேக்யா தல்வார், தனது சொந்த நிறுவனத்தில் மறைமுக இன்டர்னாக சேர்கிறாள். முதல் நாளிலேயே, ரேவதி மூலம் மேலாளராக இருப்பதும் ஊழியராக வேலை செய்வதும் எவ்வளவு வேறுபட்டது என்பதை உணர்கிறாள். அலுவலகத்தில் அனைவரும் ரேவதியின் பக்கம் நிற்க, அலேக்யா தனியாக போராடுகிறாள். இந்த பயணத்தில், தனது கணவர் மற்றும் நிறுவனத்தைப் பற்றிய பல ரகசியங்களை அவள் கண்டுபிடிக்கிறாள்.

farsh-se-arsh-ek-udaan.title: Farsh se Arsh - Ek Udaan
farsh-se-arsh-ek-udaan.description: A powerful heir returns to his roots and is mistaken for a poor laborer, facing humiliation from those who value status over humanity. As his true identity is revealed, he rises to reclaim his dignity, reunite with his family, and expose deep-rooted class prejudice.

the-ultimate-return-1.title: The Ultimate Return
the-ultimate-return-1.description: A man long underestimated and written off as a loser is secretly the invisible force shaping billion-dollar empires. As his true identity begins to unravel, ruthless heirs, corrupt elites, and fractured relationships collide in a brutal struggle for control. In a world driven by ambition and betrayal, only truth and courage can decide who truly holds power.

justice-1.title: JUSTICE
justice-1.description: Decorated military hero Vikram Singh returns to find his family's business empire under threat from a cunning opportunist, prompting him to reclaim his father's legacy. Discovering a deeper mystery tied to the corrupt South Hall jail, Vikram fakes his own arrest and goes undercover as a prisoner to expose systemic rot. Inside, he confronts tyrannical figures like Rana and witnesses brutal mistreatment, including medical malpractice and illegal sentence extensions for profit. His mission takes a dramatic turn when Sanjay Roy, initially a corporate villain, frames him for murder and financial crimes, solidifying his wrongful imprisonment and revealing a deeper betrayal involving Vikram's own father. Despite psychological torment and brutal attacks, Vikram asserts his formidable strength and begins to challenge the pervasive corrupt system from within. He uncovers a sinister conspiracy led by Sanjay, who is also the corrupt security head of the prison, orchestrating illicit activities with his son, Pankaj. Vikram, the rightful owner of the jail, dramatically reveals his true identity, challenging figures like gangster Appu and confronting those who betrayed him, including Nurse Natasha, with whom he had a past intimate relationship. He forms crucial alliances with compassionate caregiver Tanya, who uncovers a medical exploitation scheme, and an elderly inmate, Dada Ji. Relentlessly pursued by Sanjay, Vikram orchestrates a calculated takeover of the high-security facility, exposing Sanjay's multi-crore corruption scheme. He faces vengeful officials and a skeptical judge while trying to prove his identity and dismantle the massive systemic scam. Dr. Tania, a respected medical professional, also faces public humiliation and false accusations orchestrated by her own father, finding an unexpected ally in Vikram. The narrative culminates with Vikram asserting his authority as the new boss, accepting Sneha's love, and publicly pledging to eradicate corruption within the prison and initiate a nationwide reform movement, setting his sights on Sanjay's son as his next target in a broader quest for retribution.

jananayagan-returns.title: Jananayagan Returns
jananayagan-returns.description: ஒரு விமான விபத்துக்குப் பிறகு நினைவிழந்த பணக்கார வாரிசு தீபக், மருத்துவர் மீராவால் காப்பாற்றப்படுகிறார். ஆனால் அவன் இறந்துவிட்டான் என்று பொய் கூறி, அவன் செல்வத்தை கைப்பற்ற சாலினி என்ற சூழ்ச்சியான நர்ஸ் அனைவரையும் ஏமாற்றுகிறாள். காதல், துரோகம், அதிகார ஆசை மோதும் இந்த கதையில் உண்மை வெளிச்சம் பார்க்குமா? இதன் முடிவு என்ன ஆகும்…? பார்க்க KUKU TV.

adheera-alpha.title: Adheera Alpha
adheera-alpha.description: విరాజ్ ఒక పార్క్ లో చెత్త ఊడ్చేవాడు.  గతాన్ని మర్చిపోయి ప్రశాంతంగా పని చేసుకుంటుంటే అధీరా తెగ రక్షకురాలు అవనిజ అతని ముందుకు వచ్చింది.ఆ తర్వాతే అసలు కథ మొదలైది. తెగలకు విరాజ్ ఉన్న సంబంధం ఏంటి? విరాజ్ గతం ఏంటనేది ఆసక్తికరమైన కథ.

billion-dollar-sindoor.title: Billion Dollar Sindoor
billion-dollar-sindoor.description:
Kiara, a runaway bride with a sindoor box and a threat — forces Karan, a simple halwai, to fill her maang at a wedding he's just catering at. One desperate moment. One accidental husband.
But Karan is not who he seems — and neither is the world Kiara just dragged him into.
This is a story of Kiara and Karan — two strangers bound by a chutki of sindoor, and everything that comes with it.

tinder-match.title: Right Match
tinder-match.description: A heartbroken girl gives herself 60 days to find love on her own terms. As she navigates modern dating, heartbreaks, and self-doubt, an unexpected connection tests her faith—until fate reveals that true love was real all along.

master-from-above.title: Master From Above
master-from-above.description: A long-lost heir, Surya, returns to his dying father and reunites with his brother Dhruv, inheriting both duty and hidden power. As he navigates grief and a harsh class divide, Surya protects Dhruv’s love for Kashish against her powerful family, gradually revealing his own influence while confronting elite forces and preparing to change their fate in a clash of love, identity, and status.

high-school-kingpin.title: High School Kingpin
high-school-kingpin.description:
Yash, an underworld don, was killed while saving a schoolboy named Rahul—and his soul ended up inside Rahul’s body. Weak and underestimated by everyone, Rahul begins to transform with Yash’s strength and swagger.

Yash decides to guide Rahul and help him achieve his dream of graduating. At school, Rahul suddenly becomes a hero, and girls are drawn to his charm. But balancing studies and dealing with Yash’s dark past turns into a major challenge.

i-rule-this-palace.title: I Rule This Palace
i-rule-this-palace.description: Rajmata ne apni jaan daav par laga kar chhote yuvaraj Anant ko bachaya, par apni yaaddasht kho di.Kai saalon baad Maharaj ban chuke Anant ne apni maa ki talaash shuru ki, jabki Rajmata mazdoori karti rahi.Ek din use sab yaad aaya, par kisi ne uspar yakeen nahi kiya.Use Maharaj se milne se rokne ke liye har mumkin saazish rachi gayi.Aakhirkar badi jaddo-jahad ke baad maa-bete mile, lekin Rajmata ki takleefein yahin khatam nahi hui, ab use apno se bhi ladna tha.kya is ladhai me sach ki jeet hui?

billionaires-bold-beginning-3.title: Billionaire's Bold Beginning
billionaires-bold-beginning-3.description: ఆదిత్య ఒక కార్ మెకానిక్. అతని చేయి పడకపోతే మార్కెట్ లోకి కొత్త లాంచ్ కానే కాదు. అలాంటి అతనికి ఓంటి నిండా ఈగో ఉన్న అమ్మాయి కీర్తి ఎదురైంది. అసలు కీర్తి ఎవరు? ఆమెకి ఆదిత్యకి మధ్య ఏం జరిగిందనేది ఆసక్తికరమైన కథ.

yeh-ishqq-nahin-aasan.title: Yeh Ishqq nahin aasan
yeh-ishqq-nahin-aasan.description: A tale of love, betrayal, and redemption. Sara returns years after leaving Naman, only to find him a ruthless billionaire bent on revenge. As hidden truths unfold, Naman realizes her sacrifice, while Gaurav’s silent love heals Sara. In the end, some loves break you, while others mend your heart.

bhikhari-fighter-1.title: Bhikhari Fighter
bhikhari-fighter-1.description: ಒಬ್ಬ ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ಸಿ.ಇ.ಒ. ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಿದವನಿಗೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬಹುಮಾನ ನೀಡುವ ಸವಾಲು ಹಾಕುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ವಿಫಲವಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾಗ, ಒಂದು ಭಿಕಾರಿ ರಿಂಗ್‌ಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹಾಸ್ಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯದಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನು ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಗುರುತು ಏನು ಎಂಬುದು ಕಥೆಯ ಸಸ್ಪೆನ್ಸ್.

social-media-billionaire-1.title: Social Media Billionaire
social-media-billionaire-1.description: The microdrama centers on Prince, whose world is initially shattered by the discovery of his girlfriend Naina's infidelity with Rehaan, leading to public humiliation and mockery of his perceived poverty. After a brutal assault, Prince learns the shocking truth: he is not poor but the long-lost heir to the immense Raichand corporate empire, a secret orchestrated by his father. Embracing his new identity, Prince goes undercover, often as a pizza delivery boy, to test loyalties, enduring further public shaming from Naina, Pia, and others who underestimate him. He dramatically reveals his true status at a bank, turning the tables on those who previously humiliated him, yet his journey is far from over. His budding romance with Vani is challenged by the wealthy Pia, who mistakenly has him arrested, unaware of his true power, and he endures periods of destitution, even begging Rehan for college fees. A mysterious "GOD/SYSTEM" orchestrates the vanishing of his immense fortune to protect a secret, leaving him heartbroken by Naina's dismissiveness and open to new connections. Despite these setbacks, Prince's protective instincts ignite when Naina is harassed, prompting him to reveal his true identity as the formidable heir to the RNW Group, using his corporate influence to protect her and confront his tormentors. He makes desperate pacts, endures public humiliation to protect others like Aman, and faces threats from Kaveri, who knows his past, but a profound maternal bond forms with Kaveri Madam, who helps reveal his true identity as a hidden heir. Prince navigates corporate disputes, including rescuing a businessman and pleading for a contract for Pia's father, all while maintaining a humble facade despite public accusations of his billionaire status. Ultimately, Prince, having transitioned from a financially struggling student to a powerful CEO, rejects superficial apologies and proposes to Vani, affirming that genuine love and respect transcend material wealth, having learned from past betrayals, particularly from Naina, and championing the dignity of labor throughout his tumultuous journey.

gangster-returns.title: Gangster Returns
gangster-returns.description: After a near-fatal accident, a ruthless gangster and a troubled teenager swap souls, forcing one to survive high school and the other to navigate a deadly underworld, as betrayal and revenge close in from both sides.

social-media-billionaire.title: Social Media Billionaire
social-media-billionaire.description: Ajay’s story begins with a devastating betrayal when he catches Suma with Rajesh and is openly discarded for Rajesh’s wealth. Suma and Rajesh repeatedly humiliate him for being poor, treating him as if he has no value beyond his money. At his lowest point, Ajay learns a shocking truth: he is the hidden heir to an enormous corporate empire, with his father having kept him unaware until the right age. Rather than immediately claiming that power, Ajay chooses to stay undercover for a time as a delivery worker so he can see who truly respects him. That disguise only deepens the humiliation, as people continue to mock him, exclude him, and refuse to believe he belongs in elite spaces. The pressure eventually breaks through when official verification exposes him as the owner and CEO of a major company, reversing the balance of power. Even after his identity is revealed, Ajay does not simply accept apologies or money, because he wants accountability, not pity. Across the wider conflict, Ajay is repeatedly accused, mocked, and publicly degraded, but each crisis also exposes the cruelty of those who judged him by status. Some people initially appear compassionate, only to reveal that romance or concern can be used as a weapon for revenge or control. Priya becomes one of the clearest manipulators, using affection, public pressure, and other men to isolate Ajay and test loyalty around him. Ajay is forced into degrading situations, including public performances and social-media humiliation, while trying to protect others from the fallout. His hidden wealth and identity keep surfacing at crucial moments, turning accusations back on his accusers and making his secret harder to preserve. The drama also widens into corporate, family, and school conflicts, where money, aid, contracts, and reputation all become tools of power. In one thread, Ajay’s fortune is even shown and then mysteriously removed, suggesting that his wealth itself is part of the struggle over who gets to define him. In another, he defends the dignity of labor and refuses to let status alone decide a person’s worth. The emotional center of the story shifts toward Swathi, whose genuine affection stands apart from the transactional relationships around Ajay. By the end of the arc, Ajay’s hidden identity has been exposed, his enemies have been forced to face the truth, and his choices are framed less by revenge than by the demand that love, dignity, and accountability matter more than wealth.

teacher-vs-billionaire.title: Teacher vs Billionaire
teacher-vs-billionaire.description: IAS officer Raghav Saxena initiates an investigation into billionaire Rudra Dhanraj for child deaths linked to his factory, facing brutal intimidation but remaining defiant. Rudra, a ruthless CEO hardened by past injustice, is exposed for environmental crimes that led to more deaths. His daughter, Ananya, returns from abroad only to be critically poisoned by a deadly gas leak at her family's factory. With conventional medicine failing, the only hope lies in an untested universal antidote, Compound X, developed by Shivay Nayar, an idealistic teacher and former convict, who is initially unaware of the crisis. Shivay, a brilliant scientist, was framed for murder and imprisoned by Rudra to suppress his revolutionary Compound X, fueling a deep-seated vendetta. Despite his desire for revenge, Shivay reluctantly agrees to help save the afflicted, including Ananya. His urgent mission is repeatedly thwarted by Rudra's imperious wife, Vishakha, who publicly humiliates him and destroys his life-saving medicine. Shivay is also mistakenly apprehended by a skeptical police officer, while the patients' conditions critically deteriorate. Rudra, initially driven by arrogance and class prejudice, rejects Shivay's help, even as Ananya's heart monitor flatlines. A shocking revelation exposes Rudra's past conspiracy to destroy Shivay's research and imprison him. As Ananya's life hangs by a thread, Rudra is compelled to grant permission for Compound X to be administered, shifting the power dynamic. The "rescue" operations are then revealed to be meticulously staged traps by Shivay for retribution against corrupt industrialists. Shivay confronts Rudra, withholding the antidote to force a public confession of corporate negligence, including responsibility for 31 child deaths. Rudra, now seemingly aligned with Shivay to save Ananya, becomes an agent in Shivay's scheme, cornering other industrialists like Vikram and Luthra. These industrialists, whose daughters also face life-threatening situations, are forced to confess their heinous crimes, including framing Shivay and building empires on human lives. Luthra further reveals a conspiracy to falsely implicate Shivay in an assistant's murder. Ultimately, Shivay dismantles Rudra Dhanraj's corrupt empire, upholding justice for the downtrodden and becoming a champion for systemic justice.

amaran-the-secret-commando.title: Amaran: The Secret Commando
amaran-the-secret-commando.description:
A humble mechanic who is secretly a war hero, steps into the life of a powerful businesswoman under threat.
While enemies plot to destroy her empire, he quietly protects her from the shadows.
Until one shocking reveal proves he was never ordinary at all.

brahma-ratchasan.title: Brahma Ratchasan
brahma-ratchasan.description:
Brahma Ratchasan doesn’t forgive… he takes.
One broken silence, and the bride is gone. In a village cursed by Brahma Ratchasan, the next bride must face the truth, she isn’t a stranger to him… she’s the one he’s been waiting for.

tea-stall-to-marriage-hall-2.title: Tea Stall To Marriage Hall
tea-stall-to-marriage-hall-2.description: ஒரு பில்லியனர் CEO தனது இளமைக் கால காதலியான பெண்ணுக்கு அருகில் இருக்க, தன்னை ஒரு சாதாரண தேநீர் விற்பவராக மறைத்து வாழ்கிறான். அவள் கட்டாய திருமணத்திலிருந்து தப்பித்து ஓடும் போது, விதி அவர்களை இரகசியங்களும் எதிர்பாராத காதலுமாக அமைந்த ஒரு ஒப்பந்த திருமணத்தில் இணைக்கிறது. ஆனால் உண்மைகளும் குடும்ப முரண்பாடுகளும் வெளிப்படத் தொடங்கும் போது, தனது உண்மையான அடையாளத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தவா, அல்லது அவளை என்றும் இழக்கவா என்று அவன் முடிவு செய்ய வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்தில் சிக்கிறான்.

lies-and-legacy.title: Lies and Legacy
lies-and-legacy.description: Mumbai’s powerful businessman Ashok Prajapati hides his billionaire identity to raise his daughter Simmi with values. But when they are humiliated at her college by a rich family trying to buy her science award, Ashok uncovers a shocking truth—his wife Shalaka has been living a double life with them using his wealth. As greed, betrayal, and inheritance wars erupt, Ashok must choose revenge or protect Simmi’s future.

help-me-i-have-no-discipline-and-zero-se.title: Help Me, I Have No Discipline and Zero Self-Control
help-me-i-have-no-discipline-and-zero-se.description: "Help Me, I Have No Discipline and Zero Self-Control" ಎಂಬ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ನಮ್ಮೊಳಗಿನ ಶಿಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು willpower ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಉಪಯೋಗವಾಗುವ ಅನೇಕ ಉಪಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನಾವು ಕೆಲಸಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದೂಡುವುದು, ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರೋದು, ಮತ್ತು ನಮ್ಮ ಗುರಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಲುಪುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂಬ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. Vaughn Carter ಅವರ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನದ ಮೂಲಕ, ಶಿಸ್ತು ಕೇವಲ ಕಠಿಣತೆ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಇದು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಯೋಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯಿಂದ ಬರುವಂತದ್ದು. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ನಿಮಗೆ ಶಿಸ್ತಿನ ಬದುಕು ರೂಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಸಹಾಯಕ.

free-and-equal.title: Free and Equal
free-and-equal.description: ಜಾನ್ ರಾಲ್ಸ್ ಅವರ "Theory of Justice" ಪ್ರಪಂಚವನ್ನು ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸಲು ಮಹತ್ವದ ದಾರಿಯನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಜವಾದ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಮಾನ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳು, ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ, ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಇರುವ ಸಮಾಜ. ಇದು ಕೇವಲ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ತತ್ತ್ವವಲ್ಲ, ಮಾನವೀಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಆಳವಾದ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ. ಉತ್ತಮ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ, ಸಮಾನ ಅವಕಾಶ, ಮತ್ತು ಜನಪ್ರಭುತ್ವದ ಬಲಪಡಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತ ಸಮಾಜ ಸಾಧ್ಯವೇ? ನಮ್ಮ ದಾರಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಬೇಕಾ? ಅಥಾವಾ ಇಲ್ಲವಾ ಎಂಬುವುದನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

billionaire-bana-fake-boyfriend-1.title: Billionaire Bana Fake Boyfriend
billionaire-bana-fake-boyfriend-1.description: After being betrayed by his girlfriend, Krutika, Prithviraj loses faith in love and lives disguised as a roadside beggar while searching for his true life partner. He meets Vani, who wants to escape her toxic boyfriend, Rajveer. They pretend to be a couple, but their fake relationship slowly turns real. As Rajveer becomes Prithvi’s enemy and Vani’s mother creates new obstacles, secrets, and emotions threaten to change their lives forever.

pakkada-mane-pushpa.title: Pakkada Mane Pushpa
pakkada-mane-pushpa.description: "ಪಕ್ಕದ್ ಮನೆ ಪುಷ್ಪ" ಒಂದು ಸೈಕಲಾಜಿಕಲ್ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಕಥಾಸರಣಿ. ಪುಷ್ಪ, ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಪಾತ್ರ, ತನ್ನ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಭಾವನೆಗಳು, ದಾಂಪತ್ಯ ಜೀವನದ ಆಪ್ತತೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಅನುಭವಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಹೋರಾಟ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಗಂಡನ ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯ, ಹೊಸ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಪ್ರಭಾವ, ಅನೈತಿಕ ಸಂಬಂಧದ ಕುತೂಹಲ, ತೀವ್ರ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಸಂಭವಿಸುವ ಗಂಭೀರ ಘಟನೆಗಳು ಈ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ರೋಚಕವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣತೆಯ ನಡುವೆಯೂ ಭಯಾನಕ ಸತ್ಯಗಳು ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತವೆ, ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ತನಿಖೆ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪುಷ್ಪನ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ಏನಾಗಲಿದೆ? ಈ ಕುತೂಹಲಭರಿತ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ Kuku Fm ನಲ್ಲಿ.

90s-underworld-vs-police.title: 90's Underworld V/S Police
90s-underworld-vs-police.description: ಇದು 90ರ ದಶಕದ ಮುಂಬೈ ಅಂಡರ್‌ವರ್ಲ್ಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪೊಲೀಸರ ನಡುವಿನ ಭಯಾನಕ ಯುದ್ಧದ ಕಥೆ. ಅಪರಾಧ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸೋ ಡಾನ್‌ಗಳ ಆಟಗಳು, ಕಾನೂನು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ವಿರುದ್ಧದ ಹೋರಾಟ, ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರಿಮಿನಲ್‌ ಮೈಂಡ್‌ಗಳ ಬೆನ್ನಟ್ಟೋ ಪೊಲೀಸ್‌ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳ ಸಾಹಸಗಳನ್ನು ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ತಿಳಿದುಕೋಳ್ಳುವಿರಿ. ಈ ತರಹದ ಇಂಟ್‌ರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳ್ತಾಇರಿ KUKU FM.

jhaadoowala-billionaire-5.title: Jhaadoowala Billionaire
jhaadoowala-billionaire-5.description: Abandoned at the altar by Pulkit, Snehal’s world shatters until she marries Neel—a billionaire posing as a cleaning boy to escape his own wedding. But their union ignites a war. Neel’s mother, Sudha, is out for blood, while his vengeful fiancée Sania and a greedy Pulkit plot their downfall. As Sudha unleashes chaos, will Snehal discover Neel’s billion-dollar secret, or will the weight of his lies destroy her first? A high-stakes tale of love, power, and betrayal.

karnatakada-underworld.title: Karnatakada Underworld
karnatakada-underworld.description: Karnatakada Underworld ಈ ಸರಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 1960ರಿಂದ 90ರ ದಶಕದವರೆಗೆ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು, ಮಂಗಳೂರು, ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭೂಗತ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಹಾಗು ಅದರ ಅವನತಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹಾಗು, ಎಂ.ಪಿ. ಜಯರಾಜ್, ಕೊತ್ವಾಲ್ ರಾಮಚಂದ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಕುಖ್ಯಾತ ಡಾನ್‌ಗಳ ಕತೆಗಳು, ಅವರ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾನೂನು ಜಾರಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ರೋಚಕ ಘಟನಾವಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮುಂದಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಈ ಕತ್ತಲೆಯ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಹಿಂದೆ ನಿಂತ ಸತ್ಯ ಏನು? . ಎಂಬುವುದನ್ನು ಹಂತ ಹಂತವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ.

a-suicide-note.title: A Suicide Note
