a-suicide-note.description: സമർത്ഥയായ ക്രിമിനൽ അഭിഭാഷക രേഖക്ക് തികച്ചും യാദൃശ്ഛികമായി ഒരു പഴയ നിയമപുസ്തകത്തിൽ നിന്നും ഒരു ആത്മഹത്യാക്കുറിപ്പും, അവ്യക്തമായ ഒരു വിലാസവും ലഭിക്കുന്നു. അതിനു പിന്നാലെ ഇറങ്ങി തിരിക്കുന്ന രേഖ പതിറ്റാണ്ടുകൾ പഴക്കമുള്ള ഒരു ഗൂഢാലോചനയിലേക്കും കൊലപാതകത്തിലേക്കും എത്തിച്ചേരുന്നു.  തുടർന്നുളള  പോരാട്ടത്തിലൂടെ, രാഷ്ട്രീയക്കാരൂം, ശക്തരായ കുറ്റവാളികളും, നിയമവ്യവസ്ഥയെ നിയന്ത്രിക്കുന്ന  നിഗൂഢ ശക്തികളും ഉൾപ്പെടുന്ന ഒരു നെക്സസ്സിനെ രേഖ അനാവരണം ചെയ്യുന്നു. പക്ഷേ അപ്പോഴും യഥാർത്ഥ ശത്രു മറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുക ആയിരുന്നു.

missing-master-chef-1.title: Lapata Master Chef
missing-master-chef-1.description: Teen baar International MasterChef jeet chuka Prince, duniya ka sabse mashoor chef, jise aaj tak kisi ne nahi dekha. Golden mask ke peeche chhupi uski pehchan aur grand welcome ke din sirf ek mask-Prince ho chuka hai missing. Nayi zindagi mein woh ban gaya hai mamooli helper Munna. Sach tab khulta hai jab boss ka restaurant bachane ke liye woh apna lajawab talent dikhata hai… aur usi raat hota hai jaanleva attack! Kisne toda Munna ke haath? Sach, saazish aur jazba—suniye The Missing MasterChef!

om-shivoham.title: OM Shivoham
om-shivoham.description:
లింగరూపంలో పూజించబడే మహాదేవుడు శివుడు, సృష్టి, స్థితి, లయాలకు అధిపతి.  
శివరాత్రి రోజున భక్తులు ఉపవాసం ఉండి, రాత్రంతా జాగరంతో శివనామ స్మరణ చేస్తారు.  
అభయప్రదాయుడు అయిన భోళేశంకరుడు, భక్తులకు మనోకామనలను తీర్చే అనుగ్రహస్వరూపి.

cricket-champion-5.title: Cricket Champion
cricket-champion-5.description: The oldest and most mysterious shot in cricket history — the Phantom Shot. Legends say only the God of Cricket can play it. One night, the Gymkhana Cricket Club wall is found mysteriously broken, and the coach suspects the Phantom Shot. With the club ground and a ₹1000 crore deal at risk, the hunt begins. Who played this century-old shot? Can Gymkhana find the God of Cricket? Discover the answer in Cricket Champion.

forgotten-historical-events.title: Forgotten Historical Events
forgotten-historical-events.description:
చరిత్ర పేజీల్లో కొన్ని సంఘటనలు ప్రాచుర్యం పొందినా, కొన్ని ప్రపంచాన్ని తలకిందులు చేసినప్పటికీ మరుగునపడిపోయాయి. ఈ ఘటనలు మన దైనందిన జీవితం, పాలన, సైనిక వ్యూహాలు, వైద్య రంగం, సాంకేతిక అభివృద్ధి, వాతావరణ మార్పులపై ప్రభావం చూపించాయి. కానీ, అవి మన చరిత్ర పాఠాల్లో కూడా సరైన స్థానం పొందలేదు.

ఈ ప్రత్యేకమైన సంఘటనలు, కాలాన్ని మించిన ప్రభావాన్ని చూపినప్పటికీ, ఎందుకు మరచిపోయాయి? వాటి వెనుక ఉన్న నిజాలు ఏమిటి? ఈ ప్రాముఖ్యతగల, కానీ విస్మృతమైన చారిత్రక సంఘటనలను పరిశీలించడానికి ఈ ప్రస్తావన.

sacred-mind.title: Sacred Mind
sacred-mind.description: పవిత్రమైన మనసు అనేది స్వచ్ఛత, నిజాయితీ, మరియు శాంతితో నిండినది. ఇది అసూయ, ద్వేషం లాంటి లోపాలను దూరంగా ఉంచి సద్భావనతో జీవించేందుకు దారి చూపుతుంది. మనసును పవిత్రంగా ఉంచితే జీవితంలో నిబద్ధత, శాంతి, మరియు అంతరాత్మ సంతృప్తిని పొందవచ్చు.

understand-roman-civilization-teach-your.title: Understand Roman Civilization: Teach Yourself
understand-roman-civilization-teach-your.description: Understand Roman Civilization: Teach Yourself” takes you into the heart of one of history’s greatest empires. From the Roman Republic to the height of imperial power, this audiobook explains how Rome shaped politics, law, warfare, and culture. Discover the rise, rule, and fall of a civilization whose legacy still influences the modern world.

sathyavana-savithri-vidhi-gedda-preethi.title: Pouranika Premakathegalu
sathyavana-savithri-vidhi-gedda-preethi.description: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಪುರಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕಿಗೆ ದಾರಿ ತೋರಿಸುವ  ಹಲವಾರು ಕಥೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಅವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಧಿಗೆ ಸೆಡ್ಡು ಹೊಡೆದು, ಧೈರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅಚಲ ಸಂಕಲ್ಪಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಾಗಿರುವುದೇ 'ಸತ್ಯವಾನ ಸಾವಿತ್ರಿ' ಮತ್ತು 'ದುಷ್ಯಂತ ಶಕುಂತಲಾ' ಕಥೆಗಳು. ಪತಿ-ಪತ್ನಿಯ ನಡುವಿನ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸಾರುವ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆಗಳು' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

rewire.title: Rewire
rewire.description: "Rewire" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ನಮ್ಮ ಮೆದುಳಿನ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿಂತನಾ ಮಾದರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನರ್‌ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ನೀಡುವ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ನಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಬಹುದು, ಉತ್ತಮ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಶಕ್ತಿಯುತವಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಅನುಭವಾಧಾರಿತ ತಂತ್ರಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಭಾವಶಾಲಿಯಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಇದು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

better-without-you-4.title: Better Without You
better-without-you-4.description:
Khud se das saal bade Raj ke pyaar mein padi Jiya use is kadar chahne lagi ki uske bachche ki maa banne tak ko taiyaar ho gayi. Lekin Raj, Jiya ke pyaar se door bhaagta raha aur kisi aur se rishta jodne chal diya. Phir bhi dono ke dilon mein pyaar ki dastak kam nahi hui aur kuch aisa hua ki na chahte hue bhi unke raaste ek ho gaye.
Kya hai is unsuljhe pyaar ki kahaani? Jaaniye is show mein.

hrudayadali-idhenidhu-season-2.title: Hrudayadali Idhenidhu- Season 2
hrudayadali-idhenidhu-season-2.description: ಅಭಿಷೇಕ್ ಪೂರ್ವಿ ಮತ್ತು ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯಳ ತ್ರಿಕೋನ ಪ್ರೇಮ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಜೊತೆ ಇನ್ನು ಎರಡು ಹೊಸ ಜೋಡಿಗಳ ಪ್ರೇಮ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಕವಲೊಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಕೇಳ್ತಾ ಇರಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ಹೃದಯದಲಿ ಇದೇನಿದು ಸೀಸನ್ 2 ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ,

chubby-gf.title: Chubby GF
chubby-gf.description:
తన శరీరమే తన శత్రువై అడుగడుగునా అవమానాలు ఎదుర్కొంటున్న ఆరాధ్య జీవితంలోకి తనను తానుగా ప్రేమించే వ్యక్తి వస్తాడా?

ఫిట్నెస్ కి ప్రాణం ఇచ్చే అర్జున్ లావుగా ఉన్న ఆరాధ్యను ఇష్టపూర్వకంగా ప్రేమిస్తాడా?

అక్క వల్లే తన తల్లితండ్రులు దూరం అయ్యారు అనే భ్రమలో ఉన్న విధ్య, తన అక్క తప్పు ఏమాత్రం లేదు అని తెలుసుకుని తన అక్కతో ప్రేమగా ఉంటుందా? 

మిస్ చబ్బీ మిస్టర్ ఫిట్ మధ్యలో జరిగే ఎమోషనల్ అండ్ క్యూట్ లవ్ స్టోరీ తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటే ఫాలో అయ్యిపోండి Chubby Girl friend..!

opportunity-2.title: Opportunity
opportunity-2.description: Yeh audiobook un logon ke liye hai jo zindagi mein aane wale maukon ko aksar miss kar dete hain. Yeh batati hai ki opportunity luck nahi, balki ek skill hai jo seekhi ja sakti hai. Aap jaanenge kaise maukon ko pehchaanein, khud ko unke liye taiyaar karein, galtiyon se seekhein aur sahi waqt par action lein. Real-life examples aur practical lessons ke zariye, yeh audiobook aapko apne time, focus aur decisions par control lena sikhati hai.

usire.title: Usire
usire.description:
ಒಬ್ಬ ತಾಯಿ ತನ್ನ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಉತ್ತಮ ಭವಿಷ್ಯವನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಲು ಹೋರಾಡುವ ಕಥೆಯೇ ಉಸಿರೇ.
ಕಾಜಲ್‌ ಅವರಿಗೋಸ್ಕರ ಅನುಭವಿಸುವ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟಗಳು,ಬಡತನ, ಆಪತ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಒತ್ತಡಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸೋಲದೆ ಎದ್ದು ನಿಲ್ಲುವ ಒಂದು ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಕಥೆ ಇದಾಗಿದೆ.
ಈ ತರಹದ ಡಿಫ್ಫರೆಂಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿರಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ  KUKUFMನಲ್ಲಿ.

understand-the-second-world-war-teach-yo.title: Understand the Second World War: Teach Yourself
understand-the-second-world-war-teach-yo.description: Understand the Second World War” takes you through the causes, key events, and consequences of the deadliest conflict in history. From the rise of fascism and global battles to D-Day, the Holocaust, and the atomic bomb, Alan Farmer explains how the war reshaped nations and world politics. A clear, engaging guide to understanding why World War II still matters today

bharatada-udyama-nirmaata-jamshedji-tata.title: Bharatada Udyama Nirmaata Jamshedji TATA
bharatada-udyama-nirmaata-jamshedji-tata.description:
ಒಂದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪಾರ್ಸಿ ಕುಟುಂಬದಿಂದ ಭಾರತ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕಾ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಯ ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವವನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಾರಿಯ ಹಾದಿ ಇದು. ಚಿಕ್ಕ ವಯಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದಲೇ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದ ಒತ್ತಡವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು, ಬಾಂಬೆ (ಮುಂಬೈ) ಯ ಹೊಸ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಕಾಶ ಹುಡುಕಿದ ಜಂಷೇದ್ ಜಿ ಟಾಟಾ, ಮುಂಬರುವ ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕಾ ನವೋತ್ಸಾಹ ನೀಡಲು ಜನಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರ ಕನಸು ನನಸು ಮಾಡಿದವರು.  ತನ್ನ ಜರ್ನಿಯನ್ನು ಕಾಟನ್ ಮಿಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ, ವಿಶ್ವಮಟ್ಟದ ಉದ್ದಿಮೆಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ, ಟಾಟಾ ಸ್ಟೀಲ್, ಇಂಡಿಯನ್ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಟಿಟ್ಯೂಟ್ ಆಫ್ ಸೈನ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ತಾಜ್ ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ ದೇಶದ ಸ್ವಾವಲಂಬನಕ್ಕೆ ಬುನಾದಿ ಹಾಕಿದ ಹಾದಿಯನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿದ ಕಥೆಯೇ ಇದು.  

ಹೀಗೆ ಇಂತಹ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳ್ತಾ ಇರಿ KUKU FM.

mshindi-to-mrsthamizh-the-unknown-prince.title: Ms.Hindi to Mrs.Thamizh- The unknown princess
mshindi-to-mrsthamizh-the-unknown-prince.description: "Our Hero and his colleagues team go to North India to kidnap the girl whom his friend is in love with. They Mistakenly Kidnaps the girl who came to see the festival. Hero Forced to Marry Heroine to Regret his Mistake. The hero's girlfriend and the heroine's family get furious after finding out about their Marriage. In between days the heroine falls in love with the man who made her breathe the independent air...! Meanwhile, the hero is unable to forget his Girlfriend whom he fell in love with.

the-crazy-busy-cure.title: The Crazy Busy Cure
the-crazy-busy-cure.description:
Kya aap hamesha busy rehte ho, lekin kaam phir bhi pending rehta hai? The Crazy Busy Cure un professionals ke liye hai jo distractions, pressure aur overwork se pareshaan hain.

Is audiobook mein Zena Everett simple aur practical tareeke batati hain jisse aap focus improve kar sakte ho, unnecessary kaam hata sakte ho, aur bina extra hours lagaye productive ban sakte ho. Agar aap calm, clear aur in-control feel karna chahte ho, to yeh audiobook aapke liye perfect hai.

melody-of-heart.title: Melody Of Heart
melody-of-heart.description: ఒక అపరిచితుడిని కాపాడాలనే నిశ్చయంతో మొదలైన ప్రయాణం... కానీ అది జీవితాన్ని పూర్తిగా మార్చే అనుభవమవుతుందని ఎవరు ఊహించారు? అనుకోకుండా జరిగిన ఒక ఘటన, తెలియని అనుభూతులు, అర్ధం కాని ఆకర్షణ — ఇదంతా ఒక కొత్త కథకు దారి తీసింది. మనసు మాటను వినాలా? లేక భయంతో వెనక్కి తగ్గాలా? భావోద్వేగాలతో నిండిన ఈ కథలో ప్రేమ, భయం, అపార్థాలు, మరియు ఆత్మీయత ఒక్కటై మనసును తాకే మధుర స్వరంగా మారతాయి.

hornywood-lust-and-lights.title: HornyWood Lust and Lights
hornywood-lust-and-lights.description: ఒక అమ్మాయిని చూసి కన్ను కొట్టకపోతే వాడిని మగాడు అనరు. తన అవసరం కోసం ఓ అమ్మాయి పైట జార్చితే తప్పే అంటారు. ఇక్కడ రెండు తప్పు కాదు. ఈ నాటకాల జగతిలో ప్రతి ఒక్క జాదూనే… ఇప్పుడు మీరు వినబోయే కధలో ఎన్నో పాత్రలు ఉన్నాయి. కొన్ని మత్తులో పడేస్తే ఇంకొన్ని విరక్తిని కలిగిస్తాయి. అన్ని విందాం, కాసేపు సరదగా వాళ్ళని ఓ లుక్ వేద్దాం… విషయం ఏంటంటే, అదొక అందాల ప్రపంచం, అక్కడ అవసరాల మీదే వ్యాపారం. ఇండస్ట్రీ ఏదైనా సరే అమ్మాయికి కొన్ని సమస్యలు తప్పవు. అమ్మాయిలు కూడా ఏమీ తక్కువ కాదు అవసరం అందరితోనూ ఆట ఆడిస్తుంది. చాటుగా ఆడి గెలిచినా వాళ్ళు రాజ్యాలని ఏలుతున్నారు. మీడియాకు దొరికిన వాళ్ళు వెధవల్ల మిగిలిపోయితున్నారు. ఆ రచ్చ ఏంటో తెలియాలి అంటే ఈ హనీవుడ్ లోకి వెళ్లాల్సిందే.

the-spy-chronicles.title: The Spy Chronicles
the-spy-chronicles.description: The Spy Chronicles” is a rare, inside look into the shadowy world of intelligence, diplomacy, and back-channel talks between India and Pakistan. Written by former RAW chief A.S. Dulat and ex-ISI head Asad Durrani, with journalist Aditya Sinha, this audiobook reveals how spies think, how nations negotiate in silence, and how peace and conflict are shaped behind closed doors. A gripping listen for anyone curious about power, secrecy, and South Asia’s most sensitive relationship

preethse-preethse.title: Preethse Preethse
preethse-preethse.description: ನಿವೇದಿತ ಇಂದ ಆ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಆದ ಆ  ಒಂದು ತಪ್ಪು ಈಗ ಅವಳನ್ನೇ ಈ ನಗರವನ್ನು ತೊರೆಯುವ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಮಾಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ರಕ್ಷಿತ್  ಅವಳನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿಕೊಂಡು ಬರುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆ ರಾತ್ರಿ ನಡೆದ ಘಟನೆಯ ಪ್ರತೀಕಾರವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ನಿವೇದಿತಳಿಂದ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಕ್ರೂರತೆಯ ಎಂದಾದರೂ ಲವ್ ಆಗಿ ಚೇಂಜ್ ಆಗಬಹುದೇ? ಅವ್ರ ಈ ಕಥೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ "ಪ್ರೀತ್ಸೇ ಪ್ರೀತ್ಸೇ" ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ !

messages-to-the-future.title: Messages To The Future
messages-to-the-future.description:
టైమ్ క్యాప్సూల్ – ఇది కాలాన్ని దాటి సందేశాలను భవిష్యత్తుకు అందించే మాయాజాడ.  
నేడు రాసిన భావనలు, కధలు, ఆశలు – ఏళ్ల తర్వాత ఒక కొత్త యుగానికి చిరునామా.  
గతం భవిష్యత్తును పలకరించే అద్భుతపు కాలబంధం! 🚀

becoming-babasaheb-birth-to-mahad.title: Becoming Babasaheb : Birth to Mahad
becoming-babasaheb-birth-to-mahad.description: Becoming Babasaheb: Birth to Mahad” takes you deep into the early life of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar—one of India’s most visionary thinkers and architects of social justice. From his childhood struggles to the landmark Mahad Satyagraha, this audiobook traces how a young Bhimrao turned resistance into purpose, and pain into a revolution. It uncovers the experiences, humiliations, courage, and intellect that shaped Babasaheb into a leader who challenged centuries of inequality

psychology-of-serial-killers.title: Psychology Of Serial Killers
psychology-of-serial-killers.description: సీరియల్ కిల్లర్లు (Serial Killers) అనేవారు మనసికంగా చాలా ప్రత్యేకమైన గుణాలను కలిగి ఉంటారు. వీరు సాధారణంగా ఒకే విధమైన హత్యలను మళ్లీ మళ్లీ చేస్తూ ఉంటారు. ఈ హత్యల వెనుక వారి మానసిక స్థితి, మోటివేషన్, మరియు బాల్య అనుభవాలు కీలక పాత్ర పోషిస్తాయి.

శాపం.title: శాపం
శాపం.description: అది ఒక పెద్ద జమీందారీ వంశం... జమీందారీ వ్యవస్థ పోయినా ఆనాటి వైభవానికి సాక్ష్యంగా నిలిచిపోయిన వాళ్ళ ఇల్లు.... ఆ ఇంట్లోనే పూజ గదిలో నిత్యం వెలిగే అఖండ దీపం.... గతంలో జమీందారీ పెత్తనానికి.... అహంకారానికి బలైపోయి ఆ పూజ గదిలోనే అగ్నికి ఆహుతైన ఓ ఆడపిల్ల శాపం తరతరాలన్నీ వెంటాడుతోంది... అనుకోకుండా ఆ వంశ వారసుడైన ఆకాష్ జీవితంలోకి అడుగుపెట్టిన ధరణి ఆ శాపానికి బలి కాబోతోందా... అసలు ఆ శాపం ఏమిటి?

the-slient-oath.title: The Silent Oath
the-slient-oath.description: Ek honest Mumbai surgeon ko galat ilzaam mein fasaa diya jaata hai jab ek billionaire ki beti stage par collapse ho jaati hai. Media trial, forged reports aur corporate power ke beech, uski zindagi palat jaati hai. Jab uski family ko bhi dhamkiyan milne lagti hain, woh ek aisi jung ladne ko majboor ho jaata hai jahan daav par sirf uska naam nahi, balki uski poori duniya hai.

mr-india-2.title: MR. INDIA
mr-india-2.description: తన తల్లి కోరిక మేరకు జీవితంలో ఉన్నత స్థితికి చేరుకోవాలనుకున్న ఓ యువకుడికి ,  పరిస్థితులు అతని జీవితాన్ని ఎలా నాశనం చేశాయన్న కధనంతో సాగే అద్భుతమైన సిరీస్ ఇది. ఆద్యంతం ఉత్కంఠ భరితంగా సాగే ఈ కధనం ప్రస్తుత సమాజంలో విద్యా రంగంలో జరుగుతున్న అవినీతి అక్రమాలను కళ్ళకు కట్టినట్లు ఆవిష్కరిస్తుంది.

understand-stalins-russia-teach-yourself.title: Understand Stalin's Russia: Teach Yourself
understand-stalins-russia-teach-yourself.description: Understand Stalin’s Russia” aapko us daur mein le jaata hai jahan ek leader ke faisle poore desh ki taqdeer likhte the. Fear, power, purges aur propaganda—yeh audiobook USSR ka woh sach batati hai jisse duniya kaanpti thi. Agar aapko dark history, geopolitics aur power games samajhna pasand hai, yeh journey miss mat kariye.

the-silent-witness.title: The Silent Witness
the-silent-witness.description: முற்றிலுமாக எரிந்து போன நிலையில் ராம்குமாரின் கார் வயல்வெளியில் கிடைக்கிறது. அதில் எரிந்து போய்,  பிணமாக கிடக்கிறான் ராம் குமார், ராம் குமாரின் மரணம்  விபத்தா?  கொலையா? கொலை எனில் அவனது கொலைக்கான காரணம் என்ன?

എട്ടുവീട്ടിൽപ്പിളളമാർ-നായകരോ-പ്രതിനായകരോ.title: എട്ടുവീട്ടിൽപ്പിളളമാർ- നായകരോ പ്രതിനായകരോ?
എട്ടുവീട്ടിൽപ്പിളളമാർ-നായകരോ-പ്രതിനായകരോ.description: തിരുവിതാംകൂറിലെ ആദ്യ രാജാവായിരുന്ന  ശ്രീ. മാർത്താണ്ഡവർമ്മയുടെ ചരിത്രത്തോട് ചേർത്താണു  'എട്ടുവീട്ടിൽ പിള്ളമാർ' എന്ന പേർ നാം കേൾക്കുക. മാർത്താണ്ഡവർമ്മയാൽ ഉന്മൂലനം ചെയ്യപ്പെട്ട രാജ്യദ്രോഹികളായാണു ഇവർ പൊതുവിൽ വിശേഷിപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്നതെങ്കിലും പിള്ളമാരുടെ കഥകൾക്ക് മറുപുറങ്ങളുമുണ്ട്. ചരിത്രം പറഞ്ഞും പറയാതെയും നമ്മുക്ക് മുന്നിൽ നിരത്തുന്ന വസ്തുതകളിൽ നിന്ന് ആരായിരുന്നു എട്ടുവീട്ടിൽ പിള്ളമാർ? എന്തായിരുന്നു അവരുടെ ചരിത്രം? പ്രചരിക്കുന്ന കഥകളിലേത് പോലെ പ്രതിനായകർ ആയിരുന്നോ ഇവർ അതോ പൊരുതി വീണ നായകരോ? അറിയാനായി കേൾക്കാം....

papa-ki-dulahaniya.title: Duty Wala Daddy
papa-ki-dulahaniya.description:
Ek saadharan insaan ki tarah zindagi jee raha billionaire Akshat Bajaj galti se 24 saal ki proudy aur beautiful Suri Group ki CEO se takra jaata hai.Woh uske work aur age ko lekar kaafi insult karti hai, lekin dheere-dheere usi ke pyaar mein pagal ho jaati hai.
Lekin sawaal yeh hai ki kya Akshat apne bete aur samaaj ki soch se aage badh kar is rishte ko apna payega?

master-the-art-of-creative-thinking-1.title: Master The Art of Creative Thinking and Stop Oversharing
master-the-art-of-creative-thinking-1.description: ನೀವು ಹೊಸ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ರೂಪಿಸಬಹುದು? ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸಬಹುದು? ಮತ್ತು ವೈಚಾರಿಕ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ದಿಟ್ಟವಾದ ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಅನುಭವ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನವೀನ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು, ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಯ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಈ ಶೋ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಚಿಂತನೆಯ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂತಕ್ಕೆ ಕೊಂಡೊಯ್ಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ – "ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್ ದಿ ಆರ್ಟ್ ಆಫ್ ಕ್ರಿಯೇಟಿವ್ ಥಿಂಕಿಂಗ್" ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

ఆ-ఊరిలో-పంచాయితీ-.title: ఆ ఊరిలో పంచాయితీ
ఆ-ఊరిలో-పంచాయితీ-.description:
పేద బతుకులకి, డబ్బుతో మదమెక్కిన మృగాలకి మధ్య ఓ 11 ఏళ్ళ పసిబిడ్డ. జీవితాలని నాశనం చేసే ఓ కుటుంబం ఆ పల్లెలో శాపంలా పెరుగుతుంది. ఆ ఊరి పంచాయితీకి న్యాయం చేయడం రాదు. అన్యాయమే వాళ్ళు ఎంచుకున్న మార్గం. ఇప్పుడు ఓ అమాయక తండ్రి తన 11 ఏళ్ళ కూతురి మానం తీసిన మగ మృగాన్ని శిక్షించాలని మోకాళ్ళ మీద పడి కోరాడు. అయినా న్యాయం జరగలేదు. రక్షసుల్లా ఆ కుటుంబం పరువు తీశారు. ఎన్నో ప్రాణాలు తీశారు. అంత జరిగాక ఏ పేదవాడు చేతకాని వాడిలా ఉండిపోడుగా….! అందుకే కత్తి పట్టాడు. ఆ ఊరి పంచాయితీ ఏ న్యాయము చేయదు అని తెలిసి అతనే తనకి తన ఊరికి కలిపి సమాన న్యాయం చేసాడు. 


అతను ఎవరినీ చంపలేదు… కానీ అంతకు మించిన శిక్షను వేసాడు. అసలు ఆ పేద రైతు బ్రతుకు కథ ఏంటో తెలుసుకోవాలి అని ఉందా? అయితే ఆ ఊరి పంచాయితీ వినండి.

signature-wedding.title: Signature Wedding
signature-wedding.description: Meera ek divorcee hai, aur Ayaan bhi akela hai. Dono business, samaj aur parivar ke dabav mein shaadi karne ko majboor ho jaate hain. Isliye Covid ke daur mein dono ek fake court marriage kar lete hain. Mask aur virus ke dar se bani doori unhe ek doosre ka chehra dekhne nahi deti. Par kismat ek baar phir dono ko aamne-saamne le aati hai, jahan wo ek doosre ko pasand karne lagte hain. Ab sawaal ye hai, kya dono jaan paayenge ki jisko wo chaahte hain aur jisse shaadi ki hai, wo ek hi insaan hai?

case-file-unsolved.title: Case file: unsolved
case-file-unsolved.description: அதிகாலை நேரத்தில் Police சாருக்கு  தீவிபத்தை பற்றிய தகவல் வருகிறது.  சலிப்புடன் சென்று பார்க்கும் போது ஒரு புறநகர் பகுதியில் இருக்கும் வீடு மொத்தமாக எரிந்து கொண்டிருப்பதை கண்டு அதிர்ந்து போகிறார்கள். பெரும் முயற்சியில் தீயை அணைக்க, ஒரே  குடும்பத்தை சார்ந்த நான்கு பேர் எரித்து  போய் கிடக்கிறார்கள். இதற்கான காரணத்தை தேடுகிறார்கள். தற்கொலையாக இருக்கும் என நினைத்து Caseயை முடிக்க முயற்சி. முதல் கட்டமாக அந்த வீட்டில் கிடைத்த பெரிய பெட்ரோல் கேன், கிடைக்கிறது. அது அங்கே வந்ததற்கான காரணமும் தெரியவில்லை.

the-magic-mindset-how-to-find-your-happy.title: The Magic Mindset- How to find your happy place
the-magic-mindset-how-to-find-your-happy.description: ശരിയായ സമയത്തിനായി കാത്തുനിൽക്കേണ്ടതില്ല, നിങ്ങളുടെ മനസ്സിനെയും ജീവിതത്തെയും മാറ്റാനുള്ള മായാജാലം മാജിക് മൈൻഡ്‌സെറ്റിന്റെ സഹായത്തോടെ കണ്ടെത്തൂ! ജീവിതത്തിലെ  ഓരോ പ്രതിസന്ധിയേയും പുതിയ കോണിൽ നിന്ന് നോക്കി കണ്ട്, ജീവിതം അതിൻ്റെ ഓരോ തലത്തിലും കരുതുന്ന സന്തോഷവും പ്രതീക്ഷയുമെങ്ങനെ ഒരു മായാജാലം പോലെ നിലനിർത്താമെന്നതുമാണ് പ്രീതി ഷേണായ് ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ നിങ്ങളെ പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നത്. ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിലെ നിർദേശങ്ങളും കഥകളും നിങ്ങളെ പുതിയ ഒരു ജീവിത കാഴ്ചപ്പാടിലേക്ക് നയിക്കും..തീർച്ച!

sex-lies-and-two-hindu-gurus.title: Sex, Lies And Two Hindu Guru's
sex-lies-and-two-hindu-gurus.description: Guru ji Vergin Girls Ko Bahut Pasand Karte the, Unhone 15 saal ki us Bachchi ko Kiss kiya aur phir Uski Panty Ke Andar hath daal diya. To ye tha us Baba ka sach jise poori duniya apna Bhagwan manti thi, Lekin Abhi kahani baki thi.

the-24th-mile.title: The 24th Mile
the-24th-mile.description: രണ്ടാം ലോകമഹായുദ്ധം ബർമ്മയെ വിഴുങ്ങിയ കാലം, ഒരു ഇന്ത്യൻ ഡോക്ടർ തൻ്റെ നാടും വീടും വിട്ട് യുദ്ധഭൂമിയിൽ കർമ്മനിരതനായിരുന്നു. ഒടുവിൽ ഇന്ത്യയിലേക്ക് തിരികെ മടങ്ങാൻ ഒരുമ്പെട്ട അദ്ദേഹത്തിനു മുന്നിൽ ആ 24 മൈൽ ദൂരം അസാധ്യമായ ഒരു നരകം പോലെ നിവർന്ന് കിടന്നു. അത് താണ്ടാൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തിനു സാധിച്ചുവോ? കേൾക്കാം അത്യന്തം ഉദ്ദ്വേഗഭരിതമായ ഒരു സംഭവ കഥ....

mr-right-ya-mr-wrong.title: My homeless billionaire husband
mr-right-ya-mr-wrong.description: "Tum mere real nahi fake boyfriend ho,” Aakriti ne ek homeless begger Shashwat ko apna fake boyfriend bana to liya tha par use pata nahi tha Shashwat ko usse pyar ho gaya hai. Shashwat Aakriti ko kaise bata ki wo asal mein ek undercover billionaire hai. Bina apna secret khole Shashwat Aakriti ko kaise manayega apne pyaar ke liye? Itna bada billionaire hokar bhi ek homeless bhikhari ki tarah kyon rah raha hai Shashwat? Power, betrayal aur love ke is khel mein kya jeet payega Shashwat?

മൂന്നാമത്തെ-വധു.title: മൂന്നാമത്തെ വധു
മൂന്നാമത്തെ-വധു.description: 9 മാസം ഗർഭിണിയായിരിക്കെ ആണു ജിതേന്ദ്ര വർമ്മയുടെ ആദ്യ ഭാര്യ കുളത്തിൽ വീണു മരിക്കുന്നത്, രണ്ടാമത് വിവാഹം ചെയ്ത സന്ധ്യ ആകട്ടെ വിവാഹത്തിന്റെ ഒമ്പതാം നാൾ അതേ കുളക്കടവിൽ തന്നെ മരണപ്പെടുന്നു. തലമുറ നിലനിറുത്താനായി പണം വാരിയെറിഞ്ഞ് അയാൾ സ്വന്തമാക്കിയ മൂന്നാമത്തെ വധു മിഴിയേയും കാത്തിരുന്നത് പെടുമരണത്തിൻ്റെ ദുർവിധിയോ?

500-koti-looti.title: 500 Koti Looti
500-koti-looti.description: ಅದು ಹೈದರಾಬಾದಿನ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತ 'ನಿಜಾ಼ಮ್ ಮ್ಯೂಸಿಯಂ. ಚಿನ್ಮದ ಸ್ಪೂನ್, ಬಾಕ್ಸ್, ಟೇಬಲ್, ಕಲಾಕೃತಿಗಳು ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ದುಬಾರಿ ವಸ್ತುಗಳಿದ್ವು. ಅದನ್ನು ಜೋಪಾನದಿಂದ ಕಾಯಲು ಹೈ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟಿ ಕೂಡ ನಿಯೋಜಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಜಸ್ಟ್ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಕಳ್ಳರು ಸೇರಿ ಬರೋಬ್ಬರಿ 500 ಕೋಟಿ ಮೊತ್ತದ ಆ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನ ಕದ್ದಿದ್ರು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನೀವು ನಂಬ್ಲೇಬೇಕು! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಆ ಕಳ್ಳರು ಯಾರು? ಅವರು ಕದ್ದ ಆ ಪುರಾತನ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್ ಪೀಸ್ ಯಾವ್ದು? ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಚಳ್ಳೆಹಣ್ಣು ತಿನ್ನಿಸಲು ಹೊರಟ ಆ ಖದೀಮರನ್ನ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಹಾಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಪ್ಲ್ಯಾನ್ ಏನು? ಕೇಳಿ ರೋಚಕ '500 ಕೋಟಿ ಲೂಟಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

hidden-heiress.title: She is a billionaire
hidden-heiress.description: “Mujhe tum jaisi gareeb ladki nahi Samaira se pyar hai,” Apni 1st marriage anniversary ko hi Kunal Ira ko divorce de deta hai. Par use ye pata nahi hota ki Ira gareeb nahi balki Desh ki richest company ki waris hai. Kunal ki doosri shadi mein Ira Ahaan ko apna husband banakar jaati hai, par Ira ko andaza nahi hota ki ye khel uski zindagi badalne wala hai . Kaun hai Ahaan aur kyon bana hai wo Ira ka contract husband? Kya Ira ko milega Ahaan ka pyar ya Ahaan bhi dega use dhokha?

soulbound.title: Soulbound
soulbound.description: வின்செண்ட் - மேரி தம்பதி, அவர்களின் 18 வயது பெண் ஜெனிஃபர் குடும்பமாக ஒரு புது வீட்டுக்கு குடிபெயர்கிறார்கள். அவர்களின் வீட்டுக்குப் பின்னால் ஒரு ப்ளே கிரவுண்ட் இருக்கிறது. அங்கு, ஒரு ஓரமாக சில சமாதிகள் இருக்கின்றன. ஜெனிபர் ஒரு நாள் அந்த சமாதியைத் தொட்டுவிட, அதில் வெடிப்பு ஏற்படுகிறது. அடுத்து, அதிலிருந்து வெளிப்படும் ஒரு துர் ஆன்மா ஜெனிஃபரைப் பிடித்துவிடுகிறது. அடுத்து, அந்தக் குடும்பத்தை வேட்டையாடத் தொடங்குகிறது. காரணம் ஜெனிஃபர் - அந்த கெட்ட ஆன்மாவின் ஹாரோஸ்கோப் இரண்டும் ஒன்று. அதனால், எளிதாக ஜெனிஃபரைப் பிடித்துவிடுகிறது. ஜெனிபரின் தாய் மாமன் பெயர் டேவிட். அவன் தான் ஹீரோ. அவனது காதலி லூசி. இருவரும் சேர்ந்து எப்படி ஜெனிபரை விடுவிக்கிறார்கள் என்பதே கதை. கதையில் ஒரு ட்விஸ்ட் லூசியின் அம்மா தான் அந்த துர் ஆன்மா.

falling-for-the-call-girl-s-2.title: Falling for the CALL GIRL - S 2
falling-for-the-call-girl-s-2.description: Call Girl ஆக அழைத்துவரப்பட்ட பெண்ணின் மீது தீரனுக்குக் காதல் ஏற்பட்டுவிடுகிறது. ஆனால், அவள் யார் நினைவு எதுவும் அவளுக்கு இல்லை. அவளுக்கும் அவன் மீது காதல் ஏற்பட அவளுக்கு ஒரு விபத்து ஏற்பட்டு விடுகிறது. அந்த விபத்தில் அவளது நினைவு திரும்பிவிடுகிறது. ஆனால் தீரனை மறந்துவிடுகிறாள். தீரன் அவளது காதலை மீண்டும் அடைந்தானா?

detective-ajay-crime-against-crime-1-to-.title: Detective Ajay : Crime Against Crime
detective-ajay-crime-against-crime-1-to-.description: Inspector Aakash par ilzaam hai ki usne apni patni Aradhya aur chhoti beti ko zehar diya. Ussi raat uski maa Santoshi Devi bhi fansee par latki milti hain. Saare saboot Aakash ke khilaaf dikhte hain, par Detective Ajay ko ghar ki khidki, seedhi aur juto ke nishanon mein gadbadi milti hai. Ajay, Rubiya (model), Sameer (caretaker) aur Aakash ke dushmanon ko jodkar, sach tak pahunchne ki koshish karta hai.

rapidex-english-speaking-course-2.title: Rapidex English Speaking Course
rapidex-english-speaking-course-2.description: ಇದು ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಾತ್ಮಕ ಯುಗ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಮೊದಲು ಭಾಷೆಗಳು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಗೊತ್ತಿರ್ಬೇಕು. ಅದ್ರಲೂ ಬೇಸಿಕ್ ಇಂಗ್ಲೀಷ್ ಕಲಿಕೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಹೇಗಪ್ಪಾ ಈ ಇಂಗ್ಲೀಷ್ ಕಲಿಯೋದು? ಈ ಭಾಷೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಕಷ್ಟ ಅಂತಾ ನೀವೇನಾದ್ರೂ ಅಂದ್ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ರೆ, ಚಿಂತೆ ಬಿಡಿ! ನಾವ್ ನಿಮಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಮೂಲಕ, ತುಂಬಾನೇ ಸಿಂಪಲ್ಲಾಗಿ ಇಂಗ್ಲೀಷ್ ಕಲಿಸ್ತೀವಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ತಡ ಯಾಕೆ? ಕೇಳಿ 'Rapidex English Speaking Class' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್

nala-damayanthi.title: Pauranika Vykthigalu Mattu Kathegalu
nala-damayanthi.description: ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಈ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಉಪಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜಾ ನಳ ಮತ್ತು ಸುಂದರಿಯಾದ ದಮಯಂತಿಯ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಪ್ರೇಮಗಾಥೆಯನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಕವಾಗಿ ನಿರೂಪಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಪ್ರೇಮ, ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ, ಹೀನಸ್ಥಿತಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಪುನಃ ಏಳ್ಗೆಯ ಹೃದಯಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿ ಕಥಾಹಂದರ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಶೋದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಮುಗ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ "ನಳ ದಮಯಂತಿ" ಶೋ ಕೇಳಿ, ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕಥಾಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸಿ!

intern-bana-crorepati.title: Intern Bana Crorepati
intern-bana-crorepati.description: Intern Arjun coma mein tha aur uski jaan bachane ke liye Anya sab kuchh haar chuki thi. Tabhi Sourabh usse takraya aur uski khubsurti ka deewana ban gaya. Arjun ko kidnap karke usne Anya ko shaadi ke liye majboor kar diya. Anya jaal mein phans gayi, par Sourabh ki sathi Dr. Maya bhi Arjun se pyar kar baithi. Kya Anya azad ho payegi? Kya Arjun apni Anya ko pehchaan paayega? Aur sabse bada sawal, kya Arjun sirf ek intern tha ya uski asli pehchaan se Anya bhi anjaani thi?

yaarivalu.title: Yaarivalu!
yaarivalu.description: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಒಂದು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್‌ನ ಒಂದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಅಸಾಧಾರಣವಾಗಿತ್ತು , ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ಆ ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್ ಗೆ ವೀಲ್ ಚೇರ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ  ಒಬ್ಬ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಬಂದು ತಾನು ಮರ್ಡರ್ ಪ್ಲಾನರ್ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ ನೀವು ಮ್ಯಾರೇಜ್ ಪ್ಲಾನರ್ ಅಥವಾ ಈವೆಂಟ್ ಪ್ಲಾನರ್‌ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕೇಳಿರಬಹುದು, ಆದರೆ ಈ 'ಮರ್ಡರ್ ಪ್ಲಾನರ್' ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನು ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಹೇಳುವ  ರಹಸ್ಯ ಏನು? ಬನ್ನಿ, ನಮ್ಮ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "ಯಾರಿವಳು!" ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಪತ್ತೆ ಹಚ್ಚೋಣ ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ !

sabarmati.title: Sabarmati Report
sabarmati.description: 2002ರ ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 27ನೇ ತಾರೀಕು ಸಬರಮತಿ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಪ್ರೆಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಅಘಾತಕರ ಘಟನೆ ಇಡೀ ದೇಶವನ್ನು ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸಿತ್ತು. ಅಯೋಧ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಅಹಮದಾಬಾದ್‌ಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಈ ರೈಲು ಜನಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರ ಲೈಫ್ಲೈನ್‌ ಆಗಿತ್ತು. ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಗೋದ್ರಾ ಸ್ಟೇಷನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಲೇ ಕೆಲವು ಕರಸೇವಕರ ಜೊತೆ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಜಗಳ ನಡೆದಿದ್ದು, ರೈಲು ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆಯೇ S6 ಬೋಗಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಂಕಿ ಹೊತ್ತಿಕೊಂಡಿ, ಆ ಬೆಂಕಿಯ ಹಾಹಾಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ 59 ಜನರು ಪ್ರಾಣ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡರು. ಈ ದುರಂತದ ಆಘಾತ ದೇಶಾದ್ಯಂತ ಪಸರಿಸಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಂಘರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿದ ಕಥೆಯೇ ಸಬರಮತಿ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್. ಇಂಥಾ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೆಳ್ತಾ ಇರಿ KUKFM.

ceo-ki-malkin.title: CEO Ki Malkin
ceo-ki-malkin.description:
“Ayaan…mere ‘pet architect’, idhar aao.”
Singh constructions ki CEO, Ananya Singh ki aisi baatein sun sun kar, fake contract mein fansa Ayaan, tang aa chuka tha. Ananya ne uske kaam ka credit to churaya hi, usey har jagah beijjat bhi kiya. Aur fir ek din, Ayaan ne aisa plan banaya jisne Ananya ki zindagi ko narak bana diya. Power, betrayal aur revenge ke is khel mein kya Ayaan, Ananya ke khatarnaak iradon ko sabke saamne la paya, aur kya wo apni dignity bacha paya?

crossing-the-line.title: Crossing the Line
crossing-the-line.description: நிவேதாவுக்குத் திருமண நிச்சயதார்த்தம் ஆகிவிட்டது. பெற்றோர் பார்த்த பையன் மீது பெரிய அளவுக்கு ஈர்ப்பு எதுவும் ஏற்படவில்லை. ஆனால், அவளுக்குப் பிடிக்காமலும் இல்லை. இந்த சூழலில் தான் அவள் ப்ரபொசராக வேலை பார்க்கும் அதே கல்லூரிக்கு அவனுடன் பள்ளிக்கூடத்தில் ஒன்றாகப் படித்த வெங்கட் என்பவன் மாணவனாக வந்து சேர்கிறான். இருவரும் நட்பாகப் பேசிப் பழகத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள். விமல் அவளுக்குப் ப்ரபோஸ் செய்கிறான். அவர்களது நட்பு காதலாக விரிவடையுமா?  நிவேதா யாரைத் திருமணம் செய்துகொண்டாள்? விமலையா அல்லது பெற்றோர் பார்த்த மாப்பிள்ளையையா?

the-forgotten-son-in-law.title: The Forgotten son in law
the-forgotten-son-in-law.description: Ameer banne ke liye apne gaanv se nikla Aaditya jab poore paanch saal baad apne gaanv apne pyar ke pass lauta toh kisi ne use pehchana tak nahi. Kya sach mein aankhon se door huye log dil se bhi door ho jaate hain? Apne hi logo ke beech ajnabi bana Aaditya kaise hasil karega apni khoyi huyi pehchan? Kya uska sachcha pyar uski wife Manu uska sach samajh payegi?  Ya fir khud ko sabit karne ke liye Aaditya ko deni padegi Ek Agnipariksha? Aayiye jante hain is show “The forgotten Son In Law” mein…

broken-but-beautiful.title: Broken but Beautiful
broken-but-beautiful.description: ரம்யா ஒரு பெரிய கம்பெனியின் சி.இ.ஒ. பாரம்பரியமாகவே பில்லினியர் குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்தவள். ஆனால், அவள் தனது பெற்றோரின் பணத்தில் வாழக் கூடாது. சுயமாக, தனது சொந்த வறுமானத்தில், சுதந்திரமாக வாழ வேண்டும் என்ற முடிவுடன் இருக்கையில் அவள் நிர்வகிக்கும் கம்பெனியில் பெரிய இழப்பு வந்து சேர்கிறது. அவள் தனது சொத்தை விற்று கடனை அடைத்து விடுகிறாள். அதே நேரம், அவளிடம் சொத்து இல்லாததால் அவளது காதலனும் விட்டுச் சென்று விடுகிறான். இந்த சூழலைப் பயன்படுத்தி, ரம்யாவுக்குப் பிடிக்காத ஒருத்தனை திருமணம் செய்துவைக்க பெற்றோர்கள் முயல்கிறார்கள். இதனால், மணம் வெறுத்துப் போய், கால் போன போக்கில் பயணிக்கிறாள் ரம்யா. அவளது பயணத்தின் போது, கிருஷ்ணன் என்பவனை சந்திக்கிறாள். கிருஷ்ணன் எப்படி ரம்யாவின் மனதைத் தேற்றுகிறான். இருவரும் சேர்ந்து பயணம் செய்து, காதல், உணவு, காமம், வேறு வேறு ஊர் என்று பலவற்றை எக்ஸ்ப்ளோர் செய்து அனுபவிக்கிறார்கள்.

vyasani-kere.title: Vyasani Kere
vyasani-kere.description: "ವ್ಯಸನಿ ಕೆರೆ" ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ದಶಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನದಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕೆರೆಗಳ ವೇಗದ ಹಾನಿಯನ್ನು ಹಾಗೂ ಮಾನವಕುಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅದರ ಭೀಕರ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ಹೀಗಿನತ್ತ ಗಮನಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಂದಿನ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿರುವ ಮಾದಕ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ದುರ್ಬಳಕಿಯನ್ನು ಕೂಡಾ ಈ ಕಥೆ ಸೊಜಿಗವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳಕಿಗೆ ತರುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಒಂದು ರಹಸ್ಯಮಯ ಮೀನು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹಿಡಿದಿರುತ್ತದೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಥಮ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಲೇಖಕ ಶ್ರೀಚರಣ್ ನರಸಿಂಹ ಅದನ್ನು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ವ್ಯಸನಿ ಕೆರೆ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

guns-ishq.title: Guns & Ishq
guns-ishq.description: Sameer, underworld ka betaaj badshah, saalon se sirf ek naam jeeta hai—Maahi, uske bachpan ka adhoora pyaar. Uski yaadein hi Sameer ka sahara hain, jise dhoondne ke liye woh hadd paar karne ko tayyar hai. Tabhi uski zindagi mein aati hai Aarohi—ek seedhi ladki, jiske peeche chhupa hai dard aur ek raaz. Lekin jab Maahi ke roop mein ek dusro ladki ek saazish liye Sameer ke kareeb aati hai, to kya woh dhokhe aur sach mein fark kar paayega?

ബ്രഹ്മഗിരി.title: ബ്രഹ്മഗിരി
ബ്രഹ്മഗിരി.description: ടിപ്പുവിന്റെ പടയോട്ടകാലത്ത് ആക്രമണം ഭയന്ന്  ഹലേരി വംശജനായ ഒരു രാജാവ് ഒരു ഭൃത്യന്റ്റെ സഹായത്തോടെ കൊടക് ദേശത്തിന്റെ പടിഞ്ഞാറേ ദിക്കിലുള്ള ബ്രഹ്മഗിരി  കാട്ടിൽ ഒളിക്കുന്നു. പിന്നീട് അകാലമൃത്യു വരിച്ച ആ രാജാവിന്റെ ഭൃത്യൻ ഗതികിട്ടാതെ ഒരാത്മാവായി ഇപ്പോഴും ആ കാട്ടിൽ അലഞ്ഞു തിരിയുന്നു എന്നാണ്  നാട്ടുകാരുടെ വിശ്വാസം. വർഷങ്ങൾക്ക് ശേഷം കൊച്ചിയിൽ നിന്നും ബ്രഹ്മഗിരി കാടുകൾ വഴി കൊടകിലേക്ക് യാത്രചെയ്യുന്ന ഐ ടി ജീവനക്കാരായ ഒരുകൂട്ടം ചെറുപ്പക്കാർ  ആ കാട്ടിൽ എത്തിപ്പെടുന്നു, ഒരു ലിഷർ ട്രിപ്പിൽ തുടങ്ങി ഹൊറർ മൂഡിലൂടെ സഞ്ചരിച്ചു അന്വേഷണത്തിന്റെ ദ്രുതതാളത്തിൽ കൊട്ടിക്കലാശിക്കുന്ന ഉദ്വെഗജനകമായ കഥ..

lust-and-lies.title: Lust and Lies
lust-and-lies.description: சென்னையில் அனைத்து கடைகளும், ஹோட்டல்களும் அடைத்து ஊரே கண் தூங்கும் நேரத்தில் திறக்கப்படும் பப் அது. அங்கு ஒரு விசித்திர பழக்கம் உண்டு. அங்கு பார்ட்டி தொடங்கிய பிறகு,கப்பில்ஸ் Swap செய்து கொள்ள வேண்டும்.அப்படித்தான் விஷால் - சுகந்தி இருவரும் வேறு வேறு நபர்களுடன் சேர்ந்து இரவைக் கழிக்கத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள். இது எங்கு சென்று முடிந்தது???

game-of-honour.title: Billion dollar wala blunder
game-of-honour.description: Ek ambitious aur glamorous event manager sakshi, jo anjane hi apni company ke founder aur unki wife ki rooh hila Dene Wali insult Kar deti hai.. aur tab shuru hota hai jhooth Sach aur raaz ka dangerous khel, kyunki entry hoti hai poore empire ko hilakr rakh dene wale powerful and charming Arvind ki,, aur fir hoti hai pyaar, power aur dhokhe ki dil dahla dene wali takkar.

desire-in-paris.title: Desire in Paris
desire-in-paris.description: பாரிசில் எம்.எஸ் படிக்கும் பணக்கார இளைஞன் கவுதம், நடுத்தர வர்க்கத்திலிருந்து வந்த மாலதியுடன் முதலில் வாக்குவாதம் செய்யும் நிலையில் சந்திக்கிறான். ஆனால், விதி அவர்களை காதலர்களாக இணைக்கிறது. இதற்கிடையில், வெனிசைச் சேர்ந்த கேத்தரின் கவுதத்தின் வாழ்க்கையில் நுழைந்து, தன் சூழ்ச்சியில் அவரை மாலதியை விட்டு விலகச் செய்கிறாள். மனமுடைந்த மாலதி விடைவாக சென்றுவிட, பின்னர் கவுதம் கேத்தரின் உண்மையை அறிகிறான். மன்னிப்புக்காக திரும்பிய அவனை மாலதி ஏற்றுக் கொள்வாளா?

brahmi-muhurtham.title: Brahmi Muhurtham
brahmi-muhurtham.description:
ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮೀ ಮುಹೂರ್ತವು ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ 4:30ರ ವೇಳೆಗೆ, ಶುದ್ಧ ವಾತಾವರಣ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಣಶಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿರುವ ಕಾಲ.
ಧ್ಯಾನ, ಯೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಜಪಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಇದು ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಸಮಯವಾಗಿದ್ದು. ದೇಹದ ಜೈವಿಕ ಗಡಿಯಾರವನ್ನು(balance) ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿ ದೀರ್ಘಾಯುಷ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮೆಂಟಲ್ ಕ್ಲಾರಿಟಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಯುರ್ವೇದ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಸಹ ಈ ಸಮಯದ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವಿರಿ.

ಇಂತಹ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ರೋಚಕ ವಿಷಯಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ತಪ್ಪದೆ ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FM.

fake-bride.title: The royal secret
fake-bride.description: London se aayi Jahanvi chahti thi ki use ek aam ladki ki tarah treat kiya jaye. College mein usne apni asli pahchan chhupayi. Lekin Nikita ne uski identity aur boyfriend chura liya. Ab woh uski sabse badi dushman thi. Tabhi bachpan ke dost Naman Jindal ne use kidnap kar, us se zabardasti shaadi kar li, par kyon? Kya bachpan ki dosti jeetegi ya dushmani? Aur kya Jahanvi apni asli pahchan wapas haasil kar paayegi?

secret-billionaire-45.title: Undercover Billionaire
secret-billionaire-45.description: Damon Hemsworth, a struggling college student mocked for his poverty, sees his life flip overnight after a shocking phone call reveals his father is the head of the world’s richest family empire. Gifted ten million dollars, Damon enters a world of power, luxury, and buried secrets. Torn between his past and his future, he must decide if wealth will save him—or destroy him. Experience his transformation in Undercover Billionaire, exclusively on KUKU FM.

siddharth-warrior-of-destiny.title: Taakatwar yodhha
siddharth-warrior-of-destiny.description: Siddharth apni taqat sabit karne Malwa aata hai, jahan teen Gurukul ka raaj hai. Uska lakshya saat chakra jagrit karna hai, lekin wo do rajkumariyon Amba aur Srishti ke pyaar aur dushmani ke beech phans jaata hai. Malwa mein use apni asli pehchaan, asli parivar aur ek kaale saye ka raaz milta hai. Is sangharsh mein woh sabse bade Gurukul ke jhooth ka pardafash karta hai, par kya woh Guru Mahakal ko hara payega? Aur uska dil kiske saath judega?

big-bazar-to-jio-mart.title: Big Bazar to Jio Mart
big-bazar-to-jio-mart.description: 2001ರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಿಶೋರ್ ಬಿಯಾನಿ ಬಿಗ್ ಬಜಾರ್ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಶಾಪಿಂಗ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಭಾವಶಾಲಿಯಾಗಿರ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೆ, ಇ-ಕಾಮರ್ಸ್ ದೈತ್ಯ ಹೊಸ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ನಾಂದಿ ಹಾಡಿ ಹೊಸ ರೂಪವನ್ನೇ ರಚಿಸಿತು, ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ರಿಲಾಯಿನ್ಸ್ ರಿಟೇಲರ್‌ ಬಿಗ್‌ ಬಜಾರನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಜಿಯೋ ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ಆಗಿ ಮಾರ್ಪಾಟು ಮಾಡಿತು ಎನ್ನುವ ರೊಚಕ ಕಥೆ ಇದಾಗಿದೆ. ಇಂತಹ ಇಂಟ್ರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ KUKUFM !

your-brian-on-porn.title: Your Brain On Porn
your-brian-on-porn.description: ಗ್ಯಾರಿ ವಿಲ್ಸನ್ ಅವರ Your Brain on Porn: Internet Pornography and the Emerging Science of Addiction ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು, ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಪೋರ್ನೋಗ್ರಫಿಯ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ವ್ಯಸನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನು ವಿಸ್ತೃತವಾಗಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಪೋರ್ನ್ ಬಳಕೆಯಿಂದ ಮೆದುಳಿನ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳು, ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಅದರಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರುವ ತಂತ್ರಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಆಧಾರದೊಂದಿಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ದೈನಂದಿನ ಜೀವನದ ಮೇಲೆ ಪೋರ್ನ್‌ನ ಪರಿಣಾಮವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಹಾಗೂ ಇದರ ಹಾನಿಕರ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ತೊಡೆದುಹಾಕಲು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.

the-ambuja-story-1.title: The Ambuja Story
the-ambuja-story-1.description: It's a story of visionary people who tackle extraordinary circumstances to create Ambuja Cement. They deployed creative measures to tackle challenges of bureaucracy and society challenges.

passive-income-1.title: Passive Income
passive-income-1.description: ರಿಚರ್ಡ್ ಗ್ಯಾಡ್ಸನ್ ಅವರ Passive Income ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು, ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ಗಳಿಸುವ ತಂತ್ರಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ, ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯೋಜಿತ ಆದಾಯವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಣವನ್ನು ಚಲಾಯಿಸುವ ಬುದ್ದಿಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮವಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ.

trump-20.title: Trump 2.0
trump-20.description: ലോകമാകെ ഡോണൾഡ്  ട്രംപിൻ്റെ ഐതിഹാസികമായ രണ്ടാം വരവിൻ്റെ ഹാങ്ങ് ഓവറിലാണു. നിങ്ങൾ ട്രംപിനെ അനുകൂലിക്കുന്നവരാകാം, എതിർക്കുന്നവരാകാം പക്ഷേ അയാളെ അഭിസംബോധന ചെയ്യാതെ ഈ കാലത്ത് കടന്ന് പോക്ക് സാധ്യമല്ല. 2021ലെ പരാജയവും  തുടർന്നുണ്ടായ ക്യാപ്പിറ്റോൾ ആക്രമണവും അനവധിയായ നിയമകുരുക്കുകളും ആയതോടെ ലോകം ആ പേരിനെ എഴുതി തള്ളി, പക്ഷേ അയാൾ തിരികെ വന്നു തികച്ചും ആധികാരികമായ ജനവിധി സ്വന്തമാക്കി, ഇനിയെന്തെല്ലാമാകും സംഭവിക്കുക എന്നത് ട്രംപ് ശൈലിയിൽ പ്രവചനാതീതമായി തുടരുന്നു..

andhere-ka-gaon.title: Andhere Ka Gaon
andhere-ka-gaon.description:
Kyunki Maapu me insaan nahi, haiwaan rehte Hai!
Himalayon ke beech basa, nakshe se gaayab ek gaav, Maapu, jahan bank ke har manager ki zindagi ban chuki thi maut ka paighaam. Jab Kritika apne 2 chhote bachchon ke saath yahaan naye bank manager ke roop mein aayi, toh use pata bhi nahi tha ki woh ek aise shraapit chakravyuh mein kadam rakh chuki thi, jahan har waqt uske saath koi anhonee ghat rahi thi.
Kaun hai woh saaya jo Kritika ko har jagah se dekh raha hai aur kyun?

principles-of-pleasure.title: Principles of Pleasure
principles-of-pleasure.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಖ-ದುಃಖಗಳನ್ನ ಬ್ಯಾಲೆನ್ಸ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಬದುಕೋದು ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು ಕಲೆ. ಸತ್ವಯುತವಾದ ಜೀವನವನ್ನ ನಡೆಸೋಕೆ ಸಂತೋಷದಿಂದ ಬದುಕೋದು ಎಷ್ಟು ಮುಖ್ಯವೋ, ಸಂತೋಷಕರ ಜೀವನದ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಕೂಡ ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಮುಖ್ಯ. ಭವ್ಯವಾದ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನತೆಯನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿರೋ ನಮ್ಮ ಪೂರ್ವಿಕರು ಸುಖಮಯ ಜೀವನವನ್ನ ನಡೆಸೋಕೆ ಅಂತಾನೇ ಒಂದಿಷ್ಟು ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನ ಹೇಳಿಕೊಡುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಒಬ್ಬ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ತನ್ನ ದೇಹ ಮತ್ತು ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನ ಕಂಟ್ರೋಲ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಜೀವನವನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ನಡೆಸಬಹುದು ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಈ ಸಂಚಿಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಂತೋಷದ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಕಲಿಸುವ ಹಾಗೂ ಸುಖಕರ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "Principles of Pleasure" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

Union-budget-2025--അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കേണ്ട-വസ്ത.title: Union budget 2025-  അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കേണ്ട വസ്തുതകൾ
Union-budget-2025--അറിഞ്ഞിരിക്കേണ്ട-വസ്ത.description: ഇന്ത്യൻ മധ്യവർഗ്ഗത്തിനു ആശ്യാസമായി തീർന്ന ആദായനികുതി ഇളവുകൾ ഉൾപ്പടെ ആശാവഹമായ നിരവധി നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ അടങ്ങിയ 2025-26 സാമ്പത്തിക വർഷത്തിലേക്കുളള കേന്ദ്ര ബജറ്റ് ധനമന്ത്രി നിർമ്മലാ സീതാരാമൻ പാർലമെൻ്റിൽ അവതരിപ്പിച്ചു കഴിഞ്ഞു. ബജറ്റിലെ പ്രതീക്ഷാർഹമായ നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ ഏതൊക്കെയാണു? ഇന്ത്യൻ സാമ്പത്തിക മേഖലയിൽ അവയുടെ അനുരണനങ്ങൾ എന്തെല്ലാം എന്നിവയെല്ലാം ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്ക് ചർച്ച ചെയ്യുന്നു.

aakhari-faisla.title: Akhiri Faisla
aakhari-faisla.description: Ek haadsa Meera se uska sab kuch chheen leta hai, Meera ki apni beti Aarohi or uska pati Vikram. Vahin Vikram bas apna farz nibhaane me itna kho jata hai ki ik pal ke liye apni hi beti or wife ko bhool jaaata hai! Par ye haadsa Meera ko bana deta hai, ek khoonkhaar Maa, jo bas apni beti ki mout ka badla lena chahti hai! Ye kahani hai pyaar, wafadari aur dhokhe ki asli pariksha ki! Sunte rahiye Aakhiri Faisla

your-guide-to-union-budget-2025.title: Your Guide to Union Budget 2025
your-guide-to-union-budget-2025.description: Tamil audio series "Your Guide to Union Budget 2025" where we break down the complex financial policies and allocations into simple, understandable segments for every listeners.

raasi-phalalu.title: Raasi Phalalu
raasi-phalalu.description: రాశి ఫలాలు కు స్వాగతం, ఇక్కడ మనం ఖగోళ రహస్యాలను ఒక్కో గ్రహాన్ని విశ్లేషిస్తూ అర్థం చేసుకుంటాం. ఈరోజు ఎపిసోడ్‌లో, మనం చంద్ర జ్యోతిష్యం మరియు రాశి సూచకాల లోకంలోకి ప్రవేశిస్తాం—ఇది మన భావోద్వేగాలు, మనస్సు, మరియు భవిష్యత్తును ప్రభావితం చేసే ప్రాచీన శాస్త్రం. చంద్రుడు మీ ఆలోచనలు మరియు భావోద్వేగాలను ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తాడు? మరియు మీ రాశి మీ వ్యక్తిత్వం గురించి ఏమి చెబుతుంది? చూద్దాం, పరిశీలిద్దాం!

the-india-way-2.title: The India Way
the-india-way-2.description: The India Way batati hai ki aaj ki changing world me India kaise apni foreign policy ko smart aur confident tarike se shape kar raha hai. Dr S Jaishankar explain karte hain ki China ke rise aur global shifts ke beech India ko react nahi, balki lead karna hoga. Geopolitics samajhne walon ke liye ye ek inspiring aur thought provoking read hai.

shades-of-girlfriend.title: Shades of GirlFriend
shades-of-girlfriend.description: ఒకే ఇంట్లో కొన్నాళ్ళుగా కలిసి  ఉంటున్నారు  లవ్ బర్డ్స్ అయిన  మున్నా, సాత్విక. వాళ్ళని ఎలా అయినా విడగొట్టాలని వరుణ్ వేసిన ప్లాన్ వల్ల మున్నా, సాత్విక ఒక్కటయ్యారు. ఆ విషయం తెలియని వరుణ్, అనితని రంగంలోకి దించాడు. అనిత చేసిన పనివల్ల మున్నా తనకు తెలీకుండానే సాత్వికను చావు అంచుల వరకూ తీసుకుని వెళ్ళాడు. సాత్విక పరిస్థితి ఏమయ్యింది? మున్నా,సాత్వికని ఆ స్థితికి తీసుకుని రావడానికి కారణం ఏమిటి? వరుణ్, అనితల ప్లాన్స్ ఎంతవరకూ సక్సెస్ అయ్యాయి? చివరికి ఏమైంది? ఈ సస్పెన్స్ ఏంటో తెలియాలంటే "SHADES OF GIRLFRIEND"  షో వినేయండి మరి.

the-mysterious-master-chef-7.title: The Mysterious Master Chef
the-mysterious-master-chef-7.description: Jab ek benam chef duniya ke bade masterchef titles jeetta hai to sab uske khane ke deewane ho jaate hain, lekin kisi ne use kabhi dekha nahi. Apne upar hue jaanlewa hamle ke baad voh apni identity chhupakar ek hotel mein naukri karne lagta hai. Lekin ek din hotel ko bachane ke liye use apna asli raaz samne lana pada.  Ek aur vaar mein vo apni yaddasht kho baithta hai. Ab ek nayi shuruaat, ek bhoola hua past aur ek pehchaan jo uski apni bhi nahi lagti. Kya vo apne naye wajood ke sath jee payega?

പ്രണയകേരളം.title: പ്രണയകേരളം
പ്രണയകേരളം.description: മലയാളം സാക്ഷിയായ ഹൃദയസ്പർശിയായ പ്രണയകഥകളുടെ നേർചിത്രം. പ്രണയത്തിൻ്റെ മധുരവും, തിരസ്ക്കാരത്തിൻ്റെ കയ്പും, പരാജയങ്ങളുടെ നോവും ഇവിടെ ഇടകലരുന്നു. ജീവിതത്തിലും സാഹിത്യത്തിലും സിനിമയിലും എന്നു വേണ്ട പ്രണയം കൊണ്ട് മലയാളക്കരയുടെ മനസ്സിനെ തൊട്ട അനേകം കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരമാണിത്. മനസ്സിൽ പ്രണയത്തിൻ്റെ നനവുളള ഏതൊരാൾക്കും ഈ കഥകൾ ഹൃദ്യമാകും, പലപ്പോഴും അത് നിങ്ങളുടെ കഥ തന്നെ ആയി തീരും...

nee-kannu-neeli-samudram.title: Nee Kannu Neeli Samudram
nee-kannu-neeli-samudram.description: ఆకాశం-సముద్రం కలిసే చోట, విశాఖపట్నం తీరప్రాంత గ్రామంలో, ఓ మత్స్యకార కుటుంబంలో జన్మించిన రాం చిన్నతనం నుంచే సముద్రాన్ని చదవడం నేర్చుకుంటాడు. అతడి చిన్ననాటి స్నేహితురాలు సీతా ఊహలకు తాళం వేసిన అమ్మాయి. సముద్రం ఎంత బలవంతమో, ప్రేమ అంతకన్నా ఎక్కువ శక్తివంతమని ఆమె నమ్ముతుంది.

romancing-the-balance-sheet-4.title: Romancing the balance sheet
romancing-the-balance-sheet-4.description: Finance ka matlab sirf numbers nahi, ek kahani hai jo har business ke peeche chhupi hoti hai. Dr. Anil Lamba apni simple aur engaging teaching style ke saath aapko le jaate hain ek aise safar par jahan balance sheet, assets, liabilities, profit aur cash flow sirf terms nahi, balki decision-making ke powerful tools ban jaate hain. Is audiobook mein aap seekhenge kaise break-even point calculate hota hai, cost control se profit kaise badhta hai, aur ROI ka matlab sirf ek number nahi, balki ek soch hai. Budgeting, tax planning, mergers, acquisitions, risk-return ka balance aur wealth creation — sab kuch yahan step-by-step samjhaya gaya hai. Chahe aap ek entrepreneur ho, corporate professional, student, ya apne investments ko samajhna chahte ho, yeh audiobook aapko financial literacy ka wo confidence degi jo aapke har business aur personal finance decision ko majboot banayeg

legends-of-hinduism.title: Legends Of Hinduism
legends-of-hinduism.description: హిందూమత పురాణాలలో, దేవతలు, మహర్షులు, మరియు మహాయోధుల కథలు విశ్వాసం, ధర్మం, మరియు భక్తిని ప్రతిబింబిస్తాయి. రామాయణం, మహాభారతం, భాగవతం వంటి గ్రంథాలు ఈ మహానుభావుల జీవితాలను వివరిస్తాయి. వీరి గాథలు నైతికత, ధర్మసూత్రాలు, మరియు జీవన మార్గాన్ని నేర్పే గాథలుగా తరతరాలుగా కొనసాగుతున్నాయి.

guardians-of-timeless.title: Guardians Of Timeless
guardians-of-timeless.description: "Guardians of the Timeless" ఒక అసాధారణ కథ, ఇది సమయ యాత్ర, పురాతన రహస్యాలు, మరియు సమాజాన్ని ప్రభావితం చేసే వ్యక్తుల చుట్టూ తిరుగుతుంది. ప్రాచీన జ్ఞానం మరియు ఆధునిక విజ్ఞాన శాస్త్రాన్ని కలిపి, కథానాయకులు గతాన్ని మార్చే అవకాశాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటారు. ఈ ప్రయాణంలో, వారు తమ నడికీ నడతకు పరీక్ష పెట్టుకుంటూ, నిజమైన సంరక్షకులుగా మారతారు.

the-making-of-hero-1.title: The Making Of Hero
the-making-of-hero-1.description: The Making of Hero ek safar hai ek chhote se workshop se lekar ek global motorcycle giant ban’ne tak ka. Sunil K. Munjal ke apne shabdon mein, yeh kahani hai Hero group ke char bhaiyon ki — jinhone partition ke baad apne sapne ko zameen par utara. Bicycle parts se shuru hui yeh yatra, licence raj ke daur, Honda ke saath partnership, Splendor jaise blockbuster models, aur phir Honda se alag hone ke baad ek nayi pehchan banane tak pahunchti hai. Har chapter ek lesson hai leadership, innovation, aur resilience ka. Yeh sirf ek business kahani nahi, balki ek inspiration hai un sabke liye jo bada sochne ki himmat rakhte hain. Sunil Munjal aapko company ke andar ke faislon, crises, aur turning points tak le jaate hain — jahan sapne, mehnat aur samay ka sahi istemal ek aam brand ko global hero bana deta hai.

romantic-killer.title: Romantic Killer
romantic-killer.description: సిటీలోనే ఫేమస్ పొలిటీషియన్ కూతురు మున్నీని రేప్ చేసి హత్య చేస్తారు. ఆ మర్డర్ మిస్టరీని సాల్వ్ చేయడానికి స్పెషల్ ఆఫీసర్ అర్జున్ ని రప్పిస్తారు. ఆ క్రమంలో అనుకోకుండా అర్జున్ కి పరిచయం అవుతుంది మీరా. ఆ అమ్మాయి పరిచయంతో కేస్ మొత్తం వేరే టర్న్ తీసుకుంటుంది. అసలు మీరా ఎవరు? అర్జున్ ఈ కేస్ సాల్వ్ చేయగలిగాడా? మున్నీ హత్యకేసులో బయటకు వచ్చిన నిజాలేంటి? ఆమెని చంపిందెవరు, ఎందుకు? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "రొమాంటిక్ కిల్లర్" వినేయండి మరి.

secret-boyfriend-2.title: Secret Boyfriend
secret-boyfriend-2.description: രോഹനെ കുറിച്ച് എല്ലാം തനിക്കറിയാം എന്നായിരുന്നു റോഷ്ണിയുടെ വിശ്വാസം. എന്നാൽ, കൊച്ചിയിലെ ഒരു രാത്രി എല്ലാം മാറ്റിമറിക്കുന്നു. പ്രണയം എന്ന്  ധരിച്ച് അവൾ ചെന്നുപെടുന്നത്   അപകടകരമായ ഒരു കെണിയിൽ ആയിരുന്നു. അവൾക്ക് അതിൽ നിന്നും രക്ഷപ്പെടാനാവുമോ? അതോ അതിലും ഭയാനകമായത്  അവളെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നുവോ? ട്വിസ്റ്റുകളും ഉദ്ദ്വേഗങ്ങളും നിറഞ്ഞ സംഭവപരമ്പരകൾക്ക് തുടക്കമാവുന്നു..

royal-gaonwali-2.title: Royal Gaonwali
royal-gaonwali-2.description:
Aksha ek masoom aur imaandaar gaon ki ladki thi. Uski zindagi ka sabse bada maksad apni asli maa aur parivaar ko dhundhna tha. Use paalne wali maa Rajeshwari aur uski beti Isha ke saath woh shehar mein rehti thi, lekin Isha ki niyat hamesha se kharab thi. Paise aur shohrat ki lalach mein Isha tab Aksha ke raaste ki sabse badi rukawat ban gayi, jab Aksha ka mangetar Vishal use dhundhta hua Rajeshwari ke ghar aaya. Isha ne apni maa ko dhamkaya aur Aksha ki pehchaan chheen li aur khud ko Vishal ki bachpan ki dost bata kar uske saamne aa khadi hui. Lekin Vishal aur Aksha ki asli maa ko Isha ka bartav hamesha se khatakta tha. Isha ne Aksha ko badnaam karne, fasaane aur Vishal se door rakhne ki har koshish ki, par kismat Aksha aur Vishal ko ek dusre ke kareeb le aayi. 
Aksha ko is baat ka pata hi nahi tha ki use apna sach aur haq wapas paane ke liye kitne saazishon se guzarana padega. Kya woh apne bachpan ke pyaar Vishal ko wapas paa sakegi, ya phir Isha ke jaal mein phans kar hamesha ke liye gaon ki ek aam si ladki ban kar reh jayegi?

miss-matched.title: Miss Matched
miss-matched.description: ಐಷಾರಾಮಿ ಬಂಗಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಹಕ್ಕಿಯಂತೆ ಬದುಕ್ತಿರೋ ಮಾನಸ, ಕರಾಳ ನೆನಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಳೆದು ಹೋಗಿದ್ದಾಳೆ. ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಪಂಡಿತನಾಗಿರೋ ಮಾನಸಳ ಸೋದರಮಾವನದ್ದು ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಒಂದು ಸಿಕ್ರೇಟ್‌ ಸೊಸೈಟಿ ಇದೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಪಂಡಿತನಿಗೂ ಮಾನಸಳ ಬಾಯಿಂದ ಶೃಂಗಾರದ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನ ಕೇಳೋ ವಿಕೃತ ಚಪಲ. ಕಾಮುಕರ ಕಪಿಮುಷ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕಿರೋ ಮಾನಸಳ ಕೆಲಸ ಶೃಂಗಾರಭರಿತ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಪಾಠಗಳನ್ನ ಓದೋದು! ಅಂತಹ ಮಾನಸಳಿಗೆ ಪರ್ಸನಲ್‌ ಮೇಡ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಸಂಗೀತಾ ನಾಯರ್‌ ಆ ನರಕ ಸದೃಶ ಬಂಗಲೆಗೆ ಬರ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಒಡತಿ - ಕೆಲಸದಾಕೆ ಎಂಬಂತಿದ್ದ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಕಾಲಕ್ರಮೇಣ ಪ್ರೇಮಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತಾ? ದುಷ್ಟ ಕಾಮುಕರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಸಿಡಿದೇಳೋ ಮಾನಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಗೀತಾರ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ರೆವೆಂಜ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ಮಿಸ್‌ಮ್ಯಾಚ್ಡ್‌" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

the-red-light-butcher.title: The Red Light Butcher
the-red-light-butcher.description:
ACP Shivam ek aise khatarnak serial killer Varun ke peeche hai jo call girls ko maar kar unki videos banata hai, uske liye yeh sirf hatya nahi, ek saza hai un logon ke liye jise woh “gandagi” maanta hai. Varun ki soch, uski bhayankar mansikta aur uska guzra hua kal, ek khooni khel ko janm deta hai jiska naam hai Lust and Murder. Jaise jaise Shivam sach ke kareeb aata hai, usse pata chalta hai ki iss khel ka connection uski apni patni Priya aur escort agency ki owner Aradhana ki maut se bhi hai.
Kya ACP Shivam waqt par Varun ko rok payega? Ya yeh khooni khel aur bhi darawna mod lega?

yarigu-helbedi.title: Yarigu Helbedi
yarigu-helbedi.description: ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಹೇಳ್ಬೇಡಿ! - ಇದೊಂದು ಸರಳ ಮತ್ತು ವಿರಳ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆ.. ನಮ್‌ ಹೀರೋ ವಿಹಾನ್‌ ಬೋಪಯ್ಯ ಚೆಲ್ಲಾಟದ ಹುಡುಗ.. ಮ್ಯೂಸಿಕ್‌ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಪಂಚಪ್ರಾಣ. ಹುಡುಗ ಬುದ್ದಿ ಅಲ್ವಾ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ವಯಸ್ಸಲ್ಲೇ ಬೇಕಾದಷ್ಟು ಹುಡುಗೀರ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ಓಡಾಡಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಇವನ ಲೈಫ್‌ಗೆ ನಮ್‌ ಸೀದಾ ಸಾದಾ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಅನನ್ಯಾ ಎಂಟ್ರಿ ಕೊಡ್ತಾಳೆ. Accidental Pregnancy ವಿಹಾನ್‌ಗೆ ತಲೆ ತಿರುಗುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ. ಹೇಗಾದ್ರು ಮನೆಲಿ ಈ ವಿಷ್ಯ ಹೇಳ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹೋಗೋ ವಿಹಾನ್‌ಗೆ ಅವರಪ್ಪ ರವಿ ಭೋಪಯ್ಯ ಇನ್ನೊಂದ್‌ ವಿಷ್ಯ ಹೇಳ್ತಾರೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿಂದ ಶುರು ನಮ್ ವಿಹಾನ್‌ ಬೋಪಯ್ಯ ಬದುಕಿನ ಹಾವು ಏಣಿ ಆಟ! ಈ ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿ ಡ್ರಾಮಾನಾ ಮಿಸ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ದೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್‌ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ

4d52093f-068b-4b52-b505-44ce66d56cc6.title: Maayavalai
4d52093f-068b-4b52-b505-44ce66d56cc6.description: "தீவிரவாதம், நவீன யுகத்தின் புற்றுநோய். எப்படி இது தீவிரமடைகிறது? ஏன் தடுக்கவோ ஒழிக்கவோ முடிவதில்லை? அல் காயிதா முதல் ஐ.எஸ். வரை ஏராளமான இயக்கங்கள் மத்தியக் கிழக்கு நாடுகளில் செல்வாக்குப் பெற்றது எப்படி? இவர்களுக்கு ஆள்களும் பணமும் கிடைக்கும் வழியென்ன? தீவிரவாத இயக்கங்களின் நெட் ஒர்க் எவ்வாறு செயல்படுகிறது? ஏன் எந்த அரசினாலும் இவர்களைத் தடுக்க முடிவதில்லை? பேரழிவுச் சம்பவங்களை எப்படித் திட்டமிடுகிறார்கள்? எப்படி அவற்றுக்காக உழைக்கிறார்கள்? தீவிரவாதச் செயல்களுக்கு மதம் எப்படி ஒரு கருவியாகப் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகிறது? ஆறு ஆண்டுக்கால ஆராய்ச்சி. ஆதாரபூர்வமான தகவல்கள். உலகை அச்சுறுத்தும் அனைத்துத் தீவிரவாத இயக்கங்களைப் பற்றியும் மிக விரிவான அறிமுகத்தைத் தருகிறது மாயவலை."

revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend-4.title: Revenge Of My Fake Boyfriend
revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend-4.description:
Jab ek self-made businessman Rajat, airport ke luxury lounge mein India ke bade business house ki heiress Riya Kapoor se coincidently mila, to Riya ne uske saamne ek fake shaadi ki deal ka proposal rakha. Riya ko kahan pata tha ki ye deal uski zindagi hi badal degi. Usne apni business legacy bachane ke liye Rajat ko contract marriage ka offer diya tha, jo waqt ke sath emotions, ego aur badle ki aag mein badal gaya. Rajat to apni long-distance girlfriend Somya ke sath nayi zindgi basane ka sapna lekar India wapas aaya tha, jo Somya ke rejection ki wajah se toot kar bikhar gaya. Opportunist Somya ne na keval Rajat ka sapna toda balki business world ke influential logon ke sath milkar Rajat ko itna beizzat kiya ki aakhirkar Rajat ko apni asliyat sabke saamne rakhni hi padi aur baki sab ko unki aukat yaad dila di.
Kya hoga jab Rajat ki asli pehchaan Riya ke saamne aayegi aur Riya ki fake marriage deal par kya faisla lega Rajat?

genius-ki-jung.title: Genius ki jung
genius-ki-jung.description: A humble orphan who believes he’s ordinary discovers he’s a once-in-a-generation genius after creating a life-saving formula—only to become the target of a ruthless scientist who tried to have him killed as a child, and will stop at nothing to protect his legacy when the truth threatens to expose everything.

from-uk-to-kochi.title: From UK to Kochi
from-uk-to-kochi.description: A self-made billionaire returns to Kochi, his homeland to marry the woman he secretly built into a business icon—only to be humiliated and rejected by her. Hiding his true identity as the elusive “Shadow Tycoon,” he enters a contract marriage with a fierce heiress, turning heartbreak into a high-stakes game of power and revenge. But as love, betrayal, and ambition collide, the lines between fake and real begin to blur—and the ultimate price of betrayal is yet to be paid.

avatar-the-chosen-pati.title: Avtar: The Chosen Pati
avatar-the-chosen-pati.description: A divine soul reborn in a flawed man’s body must transform into the perfect husband while hiding his true identity and battling forces that threaten his newfound love.

nurse-no7.title: Nurse No.7
nurse-no7.description: The story follows a long collapse of dignity, love, and power inside and around a hospital world shaped by debt, status, and corruption. It begins with Ramesh sacrificing himself to support Meena’s medical education, working exhausting shifts while trying to preserve his marriage and self-respect. Instead of gratitude, he is repeatedly humiliated, accused, and even struck in public, while money becomes a tool used to control him. As Meena rises professionally, she increasingly rejects the life and husband who supported her, eventually denying their relationship outright and treating his sacrifice as something owed rather than cherished. The pressure intensifies through debt collectors and gang threats, making Ramesh’s private suffering part of a wider system of coercion. In parallel, the hospital itself is shown as a place where vulnerable workers and patients are degraded, framed, and sacrificed to protect the powerful. A nurse known as Number Seven is publicly thrown out, later caught in a deadly cover-up, and eventually transformed into Ram Seven, signaling a hard turn from endurance to revenge. Another thread follows Ram’s attempt to rebuild himself through study and work, revealing that he once served as a nurse, supported his wife’s career, and was abandoned when she chose status over marriage. With help from mentors and allies, he rises academically and socially, but his return to the hospital is driven by unfinished business with Siddharth and the institution that erased him. The conflict widens as Siddharth and Meena become entangled in corruption, forged records, and suspicious deaths, with both trying to shift blame when the scandal breaks. Public exposure, police action, and board intervention eventually bring Siddharth’s power crashing down. Ram then reappears in a stronger position, openly confronting those who humiliated him and demanding accountability rather than simple apology. Meena later seeks forgiveness, but he refuses to let her escape responsibility without first answering to the victims and their families. The hospital crisis does not end with one downfall, because new leaders and reformers step forward to challenge the profit-driven system. Raghu and Siya then frame the struggle as only the beginning, committing themselves to reclaiming and reforming the public hospital. Across the whole arc, the central stakes are survival, dignity, and whether anyone can escape a world where love is traded for status and medicine is corrupted by power.

dead-man-returns.title: Dead Man Returns
dead-man-returns.description: A woman who believes her husband died in a tragic accident is forced to rebuild her life—only for him to return years later as a powerful, vengeful man who thinks she betrayed him, igniting a battle of love, lies, and a hidden truth that could change everything.

oops-not-a-gold-digger-5.title: Oops, Not a Gold Digger
oops-not-a-gold-digger-5.description: ਪੰਜ ਸਾਲ ਬਾਅਦ ਰਾਜ ਆਪਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿਕਾ ਕੋਲ ਵਾਪਸ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਉਹ ਉਸਨੂੰ ਪੈਸੇ ਅਤੇ ਸਟੇਟਸ ਲਈ ਛੱਡ ਦਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਪਰ ਰਾਜ ਅਸਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਰਹੱਸਮਈ ਤੇ ਤਾਕਤਵਰ CEO ਹੈ। ਧੋਖੇ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਉਹ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਸਲੀ ਪਹਚਾਣ ਨਾਲ ਵਾਪਸੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਇੱਜ਼ਤ ਤੇ ਬਦਲਾ ਲੈਣ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

cruise-saga.title: Cruise Saga
cruise-saga.description: Determined to investigate poor reviews of his family's luxury cruise line, billionaire CEO Aditya Rathod goes undercover as a lowly steward, only to endure relentless abuse from classist employees and a heartbreaking betrayal by his long-term girlfriend—ultimately finding true love and justice with a spirited supervisor who valued his character long before she knew his net worth.

the-final-boss-9.title: The Final Boss
the-final-boss-9.description: ਪੰਜ ਸਾਲ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਾਪਸ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਜ ਆਪਣੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿਕਾ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਪੋਜ਼ ਕਰਨ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਉਹ ਉਸਨੂੰ ਪੈਸੇ ਤੇ ਸਟੇਟਸ ਲਈ ਛੱਡ ਦਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਪਰ ਰਾਜ ਕੋਈ ਆਮ ਇਨਸਾਨ ਨਹੀਂ—ਉਹ ਇਕ ਰਹੱਸਮਈ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਕਤਵਰ CEO ਹੈ। ਧੋਖੇ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਉਹ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਸਲੀ ਪਹਚਾਣ ਨਾਲ ਵਾਪਸੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

my-homeless-billionaire-husband-11.title: My Homeless Billionaire Husband
my-homeless-billionaire-husband-11.description: Naina’s story begins with family pressure turning love into an urgent marriage crisis, as her dying grandmother’s wish pushes her toward a Diwali wedding. What should have been a simple promise quickly becomes unstable when Nakul ends their long relationship, humiliates her, and chooses status over commitment. The breakup is not private for long, because family members, rivals, and bystanders all turn it into a public contest over class, money, and dignity. In response to the grandmother’s failing health and the need to show a wedding before it is too late, a temporary marriage arrangement is put in place. That arrangement is staged through rehearsed domestic behavior and public announcements, even as Naina’s feelings remain tangled and uncertain. At the same time, her connection with Sameer grows warmer through small gestures, family introductions, and a sense that he is increasingly willing to stand beside her. Their bond is complicated by secrecy, because Sameer’s identity and status are not what they first seemed. As the story widens, restaurant and family confrontations repeatedly expose how wealth is used to shame others and how fragile social respect can be. Naina is mocked for being poor, while Nakul and others weaponize promotions, salaries, gifts, and luxury displays to prove superiority. Naina refuses to accept that humiliation quietly, and she repeatedly pushes back against the men and women who try to define her worth by money. The romance then becomes more dangerous when rumors, revenge plots, and false marriage claims begin to swirl around her. A nightclub confrontation reveals that Sameer holds hidden authority, shifting the balance of power just as threats against Naina intensify. Violence follows when an armed intruder enters the club, Sameer fires in self-defense, and the situation turns into a legal and emotional emergency. Sameer is injured, and Naina is left blaming herself while caring for him and fearing abandonment. In the hospital, they share vows of protection and a fragile promise not to leave each other, but official scrutiny and cover-up efforts keep the danger alive. Later, Sameer’s true position as CEO of Jindal Industries is revealed, confirming that the man Naina thought she knew was carrying a much larger secret. That revelation does not immediately heal the breach, because Naina feels deceived and throws back the symbols of his hidden life. Even so, the story keeps circling back to whether trust can survive the lies, the class conflict, and the pressure of marriage. By the end, the central stakes remain emotional and social at once: Naina must decide whether the love offered to her is real, while the people around her continue to fight over status, control, and the right to claim her future.

kismat-ka-badshah.title: Kismat Ka Badshah
kismat-ka-badshah.description: Samir’s story begins with a shocking inheritance that pulls him out of street-vendor life and into a world of wealth, suspicion, and gatekeeping. He is told that a deceased relative has left him enormous money and status, but every attempt to prove it is met with disbelief, humiliation, and demands for verification. The black card, the ring, and later the will become symbols of legitimacy that others keep challenging. As Samir tries to claim his place, elite figures and bank staff treat him like an impostor, forcing him into public confrontations over identity and belonging. At the same time, his marriage to Preeti collapses into bitter accusations about money, betrayal, and dignity. Their breakup does not stay private for long, because divorce papers, property disputes, and police complaints turn family conflict into public scandal. Preeti and her relatives accuse Samir of theft and manipulation, while counterclaims and legal scrutiny expose how unstable the accusations are. The story keeps widening into corporate warfare, with board meetings, merger rumors, ownership shifts, and takeover battles tied to the same struggle over legitimacy. Samir is repeatedly blocked from work and corporate spaces by powerful insiders, especially when his ex-wife or other executives use authority to keep him out. Yet each humiliation also pushes the conflict toward a reversal, as hints emerge that his standing has not been properly recognized. Public events become battlegrounds where fraud accusations, fake announcements, and contested chairman claims erupt in front of crowds. A signet ring and DNA evidence deepen the succession fight, suggesting that inheritance is not just money but proof of rightful place in the family and company. Even when Samir is publicly named heir in a will reading, the victory is unstable because rivals continue to question documents, motives, and evidence. The emotional core remains fractured family loyalty: Preeti pleads for him to return for their son, but he rejects her, while another domestic thread shows him aligning with Riya and her child. Beyond the main family feud, the show repeatedly returns to class humiliation at gates, offices, showrooms, and property sites, where permits and access are used to decide who belongs. Children and parents are drawn into these disputes, turning personal pride into public confrontation and punishment. By the end, Samir has moved from outsider to powerful owner and patriarch, but the cost is a landscape of broken relationships, hostile rivals, and unresolved resentment.

happily-never-after-7.title: Happily Never After
happily-never-after-7.description: Ik chhoti kuri zindagi te maut de vich lad rahi ae, jadon ik maahir doctor ohnu bachaan layi ja reha hunda, par raste vich ameer te ghamandi lokan naal panga ho janda. Samay hatho nikal reha ae te chhoti jehi deri jaanleva ban sakdi ae. Ki insaaniyat jeetegi ya ghamand sab kuch barbaad kar devega?

payback-for-parivaar.title: Payback for Parivaar
payback-for-parivaar.description: The story revolves around Hardik, a man wrongfully accused of a crime against his own family. After spending years in jail, he returns with only one goal - to prove his innocence and expose the real culprit hiding within his family. Supported by Radhika, he begins a powerful journey of revenge, truth, and redemption. Watch now!

kesariaam-bana-khaas.title: Kesari…aam bana khaas
kesariaam-bana-khaas.description: Kesari Barabanki is a humble mango seller whose life revolves around his son, Vayu. But behind his simple image, he is secretly a powerful tycoon known as the King of AAP Company. When Munna, the reckless son of his CEO, kidnaps and tortures Vayu for revenge, Kesari unleashes his wrath and destroys Munna’s family business. In the middle of this storm, Kesari meets the kind-hearted Vishakha, and love slowly heals his broken world, leading them to a heartfelt engagement.

the-indian-shooter.title: The Indian Shooter
the-indian-shooter.description: The story begins as a tense thriller built around coded warnings, elite marksmanship, and a looming attack that investigators try to decode through the phrase “Deadly Rose, Blossom Jasmine.” As the threat expands, Vishnu emerges as a central figure whose precision and discipline make him valuable, but whose past and loyalties remain uncertain. Around him, Gunmaster Ginan’s retirement, academy politics, and family obligations pull the narrative toward a shooting academy where skill is constantly tied to honor and control. The academy itself becomes a battleground over land, legacy, and ownership, with Sushma refusing to surrender what her husband built. Rival claimants, family elders, and powerful challengers turn that dispute into public contests judged by Colonel Maheshwari. Those contests expose the gap between reputation and reality, as champions humiliate underdogs and every shot becomes a test of pride, legitimacy, and survival. Vishnu is repeatedly drawn into these conflicts, sometimes as an ally, sometimes as a suspect, and sometimes as a man forced to choose between violence and protection. At one point he vows to stop killing and instead protect a family, but that promise is tested by escalating pressure from rivals and criminal forces. The story then widens into a hostage-and-underworld arc, where Vishnu is coerced into humiliating submission to keep Meishu and others safe. Hidden identities become central when Vishnu is revealed as the feared Gun Master G9, turning earlier rumors and impossible shots into proof of a larger secret. That revelation deepens paranoia, because factions cannot tell whether footage is real, whether a captured man is genuine, or whether an impostor has been planted. Meanwhile, assassination planning tied to national dates and a state-trained counter-sniper raises the stakes from personal rivalry to national security. The conspiracy tightens around Operation Deadly Rose Blossom Jasmine, linking the academy conflict to a broader network of criminals, officers, and informants. Vishnu is eventually blackmailed into carrying out a minister’s assassination in exchange for his family’s safety, forcing his spouse and child into the center of the danger. The final stretch is driven by gunfire, coded demands, and desperate resistance as characters try to survive the consequences of the operation. Across the whole arc, the core tension is whether Vishnu can protect the people he cares about without becoming the weapon others want him to be.

kings-killer-comeback.title: King's Killer Comeback
kings-killer-comeback.description: Yeh high-voltage revenge drama class divide, fake identity aur betrayal par based hai, jiska core theme hai “Perception vs Reality.” Adhiraj, ek billionaire mafia king, apni identity chhupakar jeeta hai, jabki uski wife Aviva usse dhokha dekar uski power ka misuse karti hai. Shaadi ka setup ego clashes aur hidden truths ka battlefield ban jaata hai, jahan har episode ke saath tension aur stakes badhte hain. yeh story greed, ambition aur ultimate power reveal ko explore karti hai

blind-love-4.title: Blind Love
blind-love-4.description: ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಭಂಗವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರೋಹ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತಾ ಹೋದಂತೆ. ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಅನುಮಾನವಾಗಿ ಮಾರ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ. ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಬದುಕಿನ ನಡುವಿನ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಮಹಿಳೆ ತನ್ನ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಮರು ರೂಪಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾಳೆ.

marrying-my-daughters-ceo-mom.title: Marrying My Daughter's CEO Mom
marrying-my-daughters-ceo-mom.description: Naman Ahuja, a haunted ex-elite operative, is pulled back into danger when he learns he has a daughter with powerful CEO Soma Arya. As rival business empires clash and enemies close in, Naman is forced into a reluctant marriage to protect them. Secrets resurface, loyalties are tested, and a fragile family forms amid a storm of power, betrayal, and survival.

countdown-king-1.title: Countdown King
countdown-king-1.description: A man’s life, marked by betrayal and poverty, changes after an accident gives him the power to foresee deaths, hidden illnesses, antique values, and stock futures. Rising from a delivery boy to a city kingmaker, he makes those who rejected him pay. But he soon learns that every power comes with a terrifying cost.

the-billionaire-lawyers-love.title: The Billionaire Lawyer's Love
the-billionaire-lawyers-love.description: Karan Jethmalani, the secret heir of a powerful business empire, hides his identity and comes as a simple lawyer to propose to Sara. But Sara accepts Neel’s proposal, and Karan is humiliated and thrown out in front of everyone. Years later, when Sara is falsely accused and trapped in a cruel marriage, Karan returns with his true power to save her and expose the truth.

last-date-of-love.title: Last Date Of Love
last-date-of-love.description: After enduring a decade of a thankless, contractual marriage to save his grandmother, a devoted man grants his ungrateful wife a divorce when her manipulative ex-lover returns—only to find his hidden worth recognized too late when he becomes a global success and must return to save his estranged family from a dangerous extortion plot.

billion-dollar-revenge-2.title: Billion Dollar Revenge
billion-dollar-revenge-2.description: The show centers on a wealthy family empire where a controlling patriarch tries to shape succession by stripping his sons of financial support and tying inheritance to obedience, self-reliance, and even deathbed conditions. What begins as a harsh family test quickly grows into a broader war over legitimacy, revenge, and who deserves to lead the business after him. Prithvi emerges as the son most willing to prove himself through work, but he is surrounded by resentment from Harsh and by insiders eager to exploit every weakness. In parallel, Ragini is introduced as a forceful corporate leader whose decisions pull Prithvi into her orbit through an unconventional hiring, a public clash with office hierarchy, and a sabotage crisis that he helps defeat. Their connection develops amid formal power imbalance, contract-marriage complications, and repeated questions about whether duty, strategy, and genuine feeling can coexist. As Prithvi rises inside the company, hidden identities, coerced marriage terms, blackmail, and police intervention deepen the sense that both love and business are being manipulated by the same struggle for control. After the patriarch’s final testament names roles for both brothers, grief and succession collide, and the company becomes the battlefield for a bitter split between Prithvi’s authority and Harsh’s ambition. Prithvi briefly appears to consolidate power through corporate success and emotional closeness with Ragini, but that stability is shattered by reports of Harsh’s self-destructive spiral and by a crash that leaves Prithvi’s fate uncertain. From there, the story folds into an amnesia thread in which the injured man lives under the name Sunny and forms a deep bond with Ishani, a young woman resisting coercive marriage pressure and family bargaining. Their relationship grows through rescue, caregiving, and shared defiance, while clues such as a Deewan Industries watch suggest his forgotten past is tied to the same powerful world of inheritance and corporate conflict. Ishani’s home life mirrors the show’s larger themes, as love is treated as a threat, marriage becomes a transaction, and wealth is used to override consent and dignity. Public humiliations, accusations, and violent interruptions repeatedly block Ishani and Sunny from building a new life together, showing how private happiness is constantly invaded by status politics and revenge. When Prithvi’s identity resurfaces, his presumed death, lost memory, and hidden status reveal how rivals used his absence to move on both the company and the women linked to him. Ishani then becomes central to the power struggle herself, defending Prithvi, confronting forged narratives, and ultimately gaining recognition as acting CEO while Harsh’s claims begin to weaken. The conflict escalates through safes, hidden documents, failed fund transfers, exposed lies, and a mother’s admission that illness was faked to force a wealthier marriage, reinforcing that deception runs through both family and corporate life. Violence increasingly replaces intrigue as conspirators order killings, armed men enter homes, and Prithvi shows he has begun anticipating attacks rather than merely surviving them. Harsh’s later confession ties multiple so-called accidents and covert attacks to a deliberate campaign for property and company control, confirming that the succession war has been murderous all along. Even then, the danger does not end, as Ishani faces another armed assault before intervention sends the crisis to the hospital. By the latest turn, survival, inheritance, romantic legitimacy, and the future of the next generation are all bound together, with Ishani’s pregnancy raising the stakes of a conflict that has already consumed love, family trust, and corporate power.

fc7a5d8b-f196-487f-88c7-4a2dfc022344.title: Ghayal Ghatak Gabru
fc7a5d8b-f196-487f-88c7-4a2dfc022344.description:
This is a story of revenge. Nivan’s sister is sexually assaulted, and shockingly, his own wife and her best friend help protect the culprit. Betrayed and shattered, Nivan sets out to take revenge for the injustice done to him and his family. In this journey, he is joined by Meera, his childhood friend, who stands by him.
In the end, both women realize their mistakes, but by then, Nivan has already moved on with his life.

dhurandhar-arjun-1.title: Dhurandhar Arjun
dhurandhar-arjun-1.description: After faking his disappearance from the Chandra Vansh army, the legendary archer Arjun lives in disguise as a humble servant to fulfill his dying guru’s last wish , protecting his guru’s daughter and granddaughter. But when greed, betrayal, and deadly warriors threaten to destroy the Gurukul, Arjun must decide whether to remain hidden… or rise again as the unstoppable Dhurandhar.

prana-sparsha.title: Prana Sparsha
prana-sparsha.description: A young man discovers he can heal or kill with a single touch. Hiding his secret, he vanishes and builds a powerful empire under a mysterious identity. Years later, he returns to save a dying girl and the woman he once loved. But when a corrupt family resurfaces, he must face his past and choose if his power will save lives or destroy everything.

slumdog-billionaire.title: Super Boss
slumdog-billionaire.description:
Hiten is a common man from Dharavi's dirty lanes — no money, no job, no luck. His little daughter Tara is dying of cancer and her treatment stops because he can't pay the bills. Loan sharks beat him on the streets, his landlord throws him out, and his best friend punches him in the face. Every single person he ever trusted has turned their back on him. He has nothing — no home, no hope, no help.
This is a story of a slumdog who refused to stop fighting.

the-sweeper-billionaire-3.title: The Sweeper Billionaire
the-sweeper-billionaire-3.description: Tarun, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Sneha, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

the-price-of-a-miracle.title: The Price Of A Miracle
the-price-of-a-miracle.description: A miracle drug that can cure the deadliest disease or a dangerous lie? Lakshya, a brilliant healer, becomes the face of a medical revolution but behind the success lies a shocking secret. Bound by a ruthless contract, he sacrifices his own blood to save Manya, the very woman who humiliates him. As his freedom nears, power, betrayal, and hidden truths collide, will he finally break free, or lose everything?

commander-surya.title: Commando Surya
commander-surya.description: A quiet househusband hides a dangerous past as an elite naval commando—until betrayal at home forces him to reclaim his identity. As his marriage crumbles and truths unravel, the man everyone underestimated rises with unstoppable force. But when the legend he once buried resurfaces, the world must face the hero they failed to recognize.

the-undercover-lady-ceo-1.title: The Undercover Lady CEO
the-undercover-lady-ceo-1.description: ఆదిత్య తల్వార్ భార్య అలేఖ్య తల్వార్  తన కంపెనీలోనే అండర్ కవర్ లో ఇంటర్న్ గా పని చేస్తోంది. బాస్ గా ఉండడం, ఎంప్లాయీగా వర్క్ చేయడం ఒకటి కాదని ఆమెకు మొదటిరోజే రేవతి వల్ల అర్థమైంది. ఆఫీస్ లో అందరూ రేవతి వైపు ఉంటే ఒంటరిగా పోరాడిన అలేఖ్య తన భర్త గురించి, కంపెనీ గురించి  తెలుసుకున్న రహస్యాలు ఏంటనేదే కథ

chuppa-rustom.title: Chuppa Rustom
chuppa-rustom.description: A humble salesman, Tanay, secretly the heir to a massive business empire, hides his identity to find true love with Dia. Misjudged as poor, he faces insults from her greedy family while proving his worth through hard work. Dia betrays him for wealth, unaware of his real status. After rising as a powerful entrepreneur, Tanay exposes the truth, leading to regret, revenge, and justice.

the-billionaire-father-in-laws-revenge-1.title: The Billionaire Father-in-Law's Revenge
the-billionaire-father-in-laws-revenge-1.description: Ruhi traps a rich heir, pretending to be innocent while secretly cheating on him. When she humiliates an old man at a car showroom—beating him, insulting him, and burning his wife’s last photograph—she doesn’t realize he is Rajat Singhania, the billionaire founder and her fiancé’s father. Now the insulted tycoon plans a brutal revenge, determined to expose her truth and destroy her in front of the entire city.

ek-tha-rockstar.title: Ek Tha Rockstar
ek-tha-rockstar.description: The show unfolds as a melodramatic struggle over family power, corporate control, and the safety of vulnerable women and children. At its center is Ishaan, a rebellious heir who initially rejects the family empire but is repeatedly pulled back into conflict when Kanika’s safety and the family trust are threatened. The household becomes a place of humiliation, accusation, and betrayal, with relatives using inheritance, guardianship, and public shame as weapons. In parallel, Aarti and Kabir are drawn into a medical-romantic conflict that begins with a life-saving transplant and turns into a moral trap. Kabir’s claimed sacrifice creates a debt that he tries to convert into commitment, while Aarti is torn between gratitude, pressure, and her own agency. Ishaan repeatedly challenges Kabir’s story and tries to stop Aarti from binding herself to him, but the truth remains contested for much of the story. As the family and business crises deepen, Raghav’s music company collapses under debt, fraud accusations, and investor panic. The collapse spreads from boardrooms into homes, where control over trust assets, signatures, and reputations becomes increasingly ruthless. Kanika’s minority status makes her especially vulnerable, and multiple parties exploit guardianship law to keep her hidden, sedated, or confined until she can be forced to sign away her rights. Aarti goes undercover to protect Kanika, while Ishaan coordinates covert efforts to expose forged documents and rescue her. Suspicion inside the house grows through missing documents, hidden phones, recordings, and accusations that someone is playing a double game. The conflict escalates into literal imprisonment, with Kanika locked away and pressured through deadlines, forged orders, and threats of relocation. Corporate power and family coercion merge as financiers, relatives, and managers use legal paperwork to seize control of companies and estates. Violence becomes open and public, including self-harm for sympathy, physical intimidation, gun threats, and forced signatures. Throughout, the story keeps returning to the cost of loyalty: brothers protect sisters, lovers demand repayment, and family members are asked to sacrifice everything for property or survival. By the end of the batch digests, the show has become a high-stakes battle over truth, ownership, and bodily autonomy, with arrests, exposure, and romantic declarations colliding against ongoing danger.

blind-love-3.title: Blind Love
blind-love-3.description: The series begins with Sandhya, critically injured and blinded while saving an elderly woman, Patti, in a car crash. Her abusive mother exploits this vulnerability, canceling Sandhya's sight-restoring surgery and forcing her into an arranged marriage for dowry. When funds for Sandhya's urgent optic nerve surgery mysteriously vanish, Patti proposes a contract marriage between Sandhya and her skeptical grandson, Suraj, to cover the costs. Suraj, initially suspicious of Sandhya's blindness and motives, orchestrates a scheme with Patti to feign poverty and test her true intentions, even as a new antagonist, Ravindar, plots her ruin. Despite the initial distrust and their ambiguous marital status, a complex bond forms between Sandhya and Suraj. Suraj, struggling with burgeoning feelings, meticulously cares for Sandhya, who finds solace in his love, believing he sees beyond her physical appearance. However, Sandhya's past trauma resurfaces when she is violently abducted and betrayed by her own brother and cruel stepmother for financial gain. Suraj dramatically intervenes, rescuing her and defiantly declaring her his wife, vowing protection, though he harbors a secret about his true identity. This secret is dramatically revealed at a public event: Suraj Rathi is the city's renowned billionaire CEO, a truth even Sandhya was unaware of. Suraj, who had been meticulously hiding his vast wealth and identity as the owner of "Ratti Industries" while showering Sandhya with lavish gifts and planning her eye surgery, now fiercely defends her from public humiliation and the jealous machinations of Nalini, his scorned "unofficial fiancée." Sandhya, burdened by insecurity and a desire for independence, grapples with the profound deception underpinning her husband's humble facade. The truth shatters Sandhya's trust, but Suraj confesses his initial suspicions and declares his deep, unchanging love, admiring her resilience. Sandhya regains her eyesight, only to face further public humiliation from rivals like Meenakshi and corporate heir Roni, whom Suraj fiercely silences by asserting his ownership of Rathi Industries. The narrative takes a dramatic turn as Sandhya uncovers her true identity: she is a long-lost biological sister to Karan, kidnapped decades ago from a royal family. This revelation sparks a bitter feud with Karan's adopted sister, Nalini, who, consumed by jealousy, vows to prevent Sandhya's integration. Sandhya faces peril, including being paralyzed and targeted, but Suraj consistently saves her, orchestrating an emotional reunion with her biological family.
