Despite being disowned by her patriarch father for an unspecified transgression, Sandhya finds solace and genuine love in her contract marriage with Suraj, who proposes to make their union real amidst an unraveling conspiracy where Nalini is accused of kidnapping the true Singhania heiress.

bard-son-of-the-boxing-ring.title: Ba***rd Son of the Boxing Ring
bard-son-of-the-boxing-ring.description: களத்தில் புகழ்பெற்ற போராளியின் மகனாக பிறந்தாலும், அப்பாவின் அங்கீகாரம் இல்லாமல் வளர்ந்தவன் கர்ணா. அவன் தாயை அவமதிக்கும் உலகத்தில், தன் அடையாளத்திற்காக போராடுகிறான். குடும்பமே எதிரியாக மாற, “Black Tide” என்ற கொடிய கும்பலுக்கு எதிராக நிற்க வேண்டிய சூழல். இரத்த உறவா? அல்லது உண்மையான வீரமா ? கர்ணா எதை தேர்வு செய்வான்? காணுங்கள் !!!

adha-pyar.title: Adha Pyar
adha-pyar.description: Chandni enters Somesh’s life pretending love but secretly plots with Rajiv to seize his empire. Through manipulation, murder, and betrayal, she destroys his family and leaves him broken. Surviving against all odds, Somesh uncovers their crimes, outsmarts them, and turns the game around. As greed and deceit consume Chandni and Rajiv, Somesh rises from “andha pyaar” to calculated revenge, ultimately reclaiming justice, family, and love.

no-way-home-my-sisters-final-24-hours.title: No Way Home: My Sister’s Final 24 Hours
no-way-home-my-sisters-final-24-hours.description: When Prerna Malhotra, a billionaire’s sister, becomes the target of killers, corrupt cops, and a ruthless elite family led by Trisha Mehra, a single bus journey turns into a deadly 24-hour race against time - while her brother Karan Malhotra fights betrayal, power, and fate to save her before it’s too late. Watch now!

baap-nikla-billionaire.title: Baap Nikla Billionaire
baap-nikla-billionaire.description: A poor vegetable seller, Vikram, secretly a former business tycoon, lives a quiet life while his son Ishaan struggles in the city and pretends to be an orphan to marry into a wealthy family. When Vikram attends the wedding, he is humiliated by the bride’s family, and Ishaan, under pressure, denies him. As tensions peak, Vikram reveals his true identity as a powerful CEO, exposing their arrogance and proving that dignity, truth, and family matter more than wealth.

female-ceos-lost-heir.title: Female CEO's Lost Heir
female-ceos-lost-heir.description: Leo’s story begins with a cruel bargain that ties his mother Sara’s life-saving surgery to a wealthy Boss’s demand for marriage and control. Sara refuses the condition, but Leo later learns the treatment was linked to his removal and disappears, leaving her to search for him while others hint that his absence clears the way for the Boss’s plans. The conflict quickly expands beyond one family into a wider world of corporate heirs, missing-son searches, patent claims, and reward offers that pull powerful households into the same mystery. As the stakes rise, Lana becomes entangled in the romance and identity threads, with public proposals and marriage announcements turning private relationships into public weapons. Wealth is repeatedly used as humiliation, whether through cash displays, luxury gifts, or offers meant to buy loyalty and silence. Those displays are often reversed, as characters like Cleo and Sarah reject the elite’s money games and expose desperation beneath the spectacle. A broken watch tied to a missing son shifts the tone from mockery to grief and pushes Sarah toward revenge against Matt. Meanwhile, boardroom and family power struggles intensify, with threats, promotions, firings, and accusations of stolen work showing how status can be enforced or stripped away. Violence becomes increasingly open, from physical confrontations and gun threats to public standoffs where police, military figures, and family elders all try to control the fallout. Leo is eventually found and reunited with Sara after years apart, and his possible status as a true heir threatens the schemes built around KK Industries. That reunion does not calm the conflict; instead, it sharpens the battle over legacy, dignity, and who has the right to claim him. Sarah openly vows revenge for the years she lost with her son, and Leo joins her in confronting the people who kept them apart. Hugo emerges as a major antagonist in the corporate ruin around KK Industries, tying business control to the fate of the child and continuing the cycle of coercion. In the later stretch, Leo becomes a high-value target for assassination, forcing protectors like Saint and a General to shield him and the wounded Sarah during a public standoff. At the same time, Leo returns hardened by revenge and rejects apologies from both his father and Lana, who admits she chose money over him. A mentor then begins teaching Leo a powerful inner knowledge that can create an impenetrable barrier, though it may cost him his memory. The show closes this stretch with multiple unresolved reckonings still in motion: family bonds are broken or contested, enemies are still armed, and the struggle over love, inheritance, and survival remains far from settled.

bhikhari-boss.title: Bhikhari Boss
bhikhari-boss.description:
A billionaire hiding as a beggar to escape an arranged marriage. An orphan girl abandoned at the altar on her wedding day. Two strangers with nothing — and everything to lose.
When fate throws them together at the worst moment of both their lives, the most unlikely deal is struck.
This is a story of two broken people who accidentally become each other's biggest plot twist.

rich-wifes-driver-husband-is-a-billionai.title: Rich Wife’s Driver Husband Is a Billionaire
rich-wifes-driver-husband-is-a-billionai.description: Akash marries Mansi believing love can change fate only to become invisible in his own marriage. Humiliated, replaced, and broken, he walks away in silence… unaware that destiny is about to make him the most powerful man in the room.

the-silent-bull-1.title: The Silent Bull
the-silent-bull-1.description: The story follows Kabir, a hidden gambling prodigy whose life is pulled between public humiliation, criminal coercion, and corporate power struggles. It begins in gambling dens where table stakes escalate from cash to dignity, with cheating accusations, forced returns to the table, and house rules used to transfer debts and control people. Powerful rivals like Rana and his allies try to expose Kabir, but he repeatedly reads cards, spots deception, and survives by keeping his true skill hidden. His secrecy becomes harder to maintain after violent confrontations leave no official trace of him, prompting surveillance and a manhunt. At the same time, his bond with Ananya adds a protective and romantic thread, even as she is used as leverage against him. The conflict then widens into outright coercion when Rana kidnaps Ananya and demands an enormous ransom, cutting Kabir off from his usual gambling path. Around this pressure, the narrative shifts into a corporate-crime arena where trading floors, secret algorithms, and manipulated market moves mirror the same logic of domination seen at the tables. Massive losses, ghost trades, and internal accusations push a firm toward collapse, bankruptcy, and public scandal. Kabir is repeatedly forced into high-risk decisions under secrecy and deadline pressure, while executives and supervisors try to control him through authority, threats, and offers of status. A cleaner, analysts, and hidden operators all become part of the widening web of suspicion around who is moving money and why. As the company crisis deepens, rescue and ransom efforts collide with gunfire, explosions, and financial sabotage, showing that both cash and loyalty are unstable currencies in this world. Kabir also appears as a statistical and algorithmic prodigy, with his probability skills and market code making him more dangerous than others first assume. Yet he keeps weighing survival against exposure, sometimes deliberately folding or losing to preserve his cover. In the later arc, he arrives with a USB and converted crypto proceeds, offering an algorithm that could give the firm a major strategic edge. That offer is not purely business, because he ties it to a personal proposal for a shared domestic partnership with Saisha. Saisha responds cautiously, questioning whether the funds are truly lawful and whether accepting them would expose the firm to criminal and reputational ruin. The show ends on that unresolved moral and strategic tension, with Kabir offering power and intimacy at once, and Saisha left to decide whether the advantage is worth the risk.

chaiwala-billionaire.title: Chaiwala Billionaire
chaiwala-billionaire.description:
A billionaire CEO. A 1000 crore fraud. A disguise no one would ever suspect.
When Arjun Mehra discovers his Kolkata office is bleeding money from the inside, he doesn't send an auditor — he becomes a chaiwala. Trading his penthouse for a tea stall right outside his own company, he watches, listens, and waits.
This is a story of the most powerful man in the room — hiding in plain sight.

the-gun-master.title: The Gun Master
the-gun-master.description: Rohan, India’s top sniper known as Gun Master G-9, quits guns after losing his mentor in a terror attack and lives in hiding, working at a small shooting academy. But when a dangerous terror plan and corrupt forces threaten innocent lives and the nation, he is forced to return. It’s a story of patriotism, sacrifice, and a warrior who can never stop protecting his people.

husband-lost-in-space.title: Husband Lost in Space
husband-lost-in-space.description: A smart man with a special cosmic power feels hurt and betrayed by his family. He joins a one-way space mission and fakes his death to leave everything behind. But soon, his family realizes that they have lost the only person who truly loved them.

the-alpha-kings-redemption-1.title: The Alpha King’s Redemption
the-alpha-kings-redemption-1.description: ಸರಳ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಬ್ರಿಜ್, ತನ್ನ ಹಳೆಯ ಗುರುತಾದ “ಆಲ್ಫಾ ಕಿಂಗ್” ಅನ್ನು ಮರೆಮಾಚಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ತನ್ನ ಮಗಳು ಪರಿಗಾಗಿ ಬದುಕುತ್ತಿರುವ ಅವನ ಜೀವನ, ಮನ್ನಾರ್ ಹಿಂಡಿನ ದೌರ್ಜನ್ಯದಿಂದ ತಲೆಕೆಳಗಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡಲು ಬ್ರಿಜ್ ತನ್ನ ಹಳೆಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸಿ, ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ—ಇದು ಪ್ರತೀಕಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಪುನರುತ್ಥಾನದ ಕಥೆ.

wingman-no1.title: Wingman No.1
wingman-no1.description: The show centers on Vivan and his father Naveen as they struggle against betrayal, class contempt, and elite power structures that repeatedly try to erase or control them. It begins with Vivan near death in a hospital, pressured to sign away assets and consent to an organ procedure, before a flatline sends him back to childhood and the day his family broke apart. In that past, his mother Kamini leaves poor laborer Naveen for wealth and refuses to take Vivan, pushing the boy to choose his father and vow that he will rise through finance. That ambition quickly becomes dangerous as Vivan makes reckless market bets with family money, drawing police scrutiny, public humiliation, and escalating wagers that tie stock performance to family honor and social standing. Again and again, Naveen refuses to abandon him, defending him before mocking elites and powerful rivals such as Gautam even when the stakes become ruinous. Their early underdog victory in the market forces humiliating concessions from opponents and opens a path into the corporate world, where public apologies, advisor offers, and summit invitations turn survival into a larger contest for influence. From there, the story expands into a sustained war of status in which staged marriages, fake public identities, and summit appearances are used to secure access, preserve reputation, and fend off exposure. Vaibhavi increasingly emerges as a crucial protector and corporate authority, publicly defending Naveen, asserting her own power, and tying her company’s fate to his credibility. Public auctions and summit spectacles become the show’s main battlegrounds, with stones, emeralds, paintings, antiques, and relics repeatedly transformed into tests of legitimacy, inheritance, and dominance. Naveen is mocked as an outsider and opportunist, yet he repeatedly identifies hidden value where elites see trash or failure, turning humiliation into sudden reversals that embarrass his rivals. Gautam, Varun, Nikhil, and other antagonists keep converting these contests into financial and social traps, demanding massive payments, public submission, or proof that Naveen’s success is undeserved. At the same time, family conflicts deepen around ancestral secrets such as the Shakti Sutra, hidden inside relics and tied to lineage, betrayal, and the right to inherit authority. These discoveries bring only temporary vindication, because every revelation triggers fresh accusations of tampering, nepotism, manipulation, or fraud. Corporate survival also remains under constant threat as canceled orders, boardroom crises, and hostile conditions force Vaibhavi and Naveen to defend both business partnerships and family honor at once. Across the series, Vivan and Naveen’s bond is the emotional core: the son keeps trying to outplay a world built to humiliate them, while the father keeps absorbing the cost of standing beside him. Kamini’s rejection and later mockery sharpen the class wound that drives much of the conflict, while elite households alternately exploit, test, and partially accept Naveen depending on what he can deliver. By the latest phase, rumors about Naveen’s rise, his ties to powerful families, and the authenticity of the emerald teapot widen the struggle from open rivalry into a broader crisis of reputation. The overall arc is one of repeated public degradation followed by startling reversals, as hidden talent and hidden treasures keep challenging inherited privilege without ever fully ending the feud. The stakes remain both intimate and expansive: whether this father-son side can secure dignity, belonging, and truth before rivals strip them of wealth, credibility, and place.

bichagadu-mayagadu.title: Bichagadu Mayagadu
bichagadu-mayagadu.description: A broken man is granted a second chance by a mysterious beggar, only to realize that the true miracle was never wealth but the transformation of his own soul.

the-secret-son-of-a-trillionaire.title: The Secret Son of a Trillionaire
the-secret-son-of-a-trillionaire.description: The show follows Kunal, also known at different points as Arjun or Akash, as he moves from humiliation and debt into the center of a hidden-heir power struggle. Early on, he is crushed by financial pressure and betrayal, then learns that his long-lost father is alive and immensely powerful. That revelation changes his life overnight, but the sudden wealth does not satisfy him for long. He begins to want purpose, not just luxury, and repeatedly tests his place by going undercover in the company tied to his family. Around him, managers, exes, rivals, and opportunists keep misreading him as poor, disposable, or fake. Mansi and others chase status and the real heir’s attention, while Kunal’s former relationships fracture under the pull of money and rank. The story repeatedly turns on public humiliation, where arrogant people mock him and then are forced to face his real authority. False heirs and imposters also circulate through the same world, making identity itself the main battlefield. Helicopters, clubs, corporate seats, and elite gatherings become symbols of who truly belongs and who is pretending. In one major turn, biometric verification confirms Kunal as the true boss, overturning the social order in front of everyone. In another, a password tied to the rightful owner’s birthday proves legitimacy and exposes rival claimants. The Kapoor family and company remain at the center of the conflict, with Vikram Kapoor’s authority and the chairman’s arrival repeatedly raising the stakes. Isha’s arrival and intervention also validate claims that others tried to deny, showing how fragile the false stories are. Aryan Kapoor emerges as a recurring rival, sometimes claiming heir status himself and sometimes being accused of impersonation or deception. The show keeps widening from personal revenge into corporate warfare, with firings, removals, and public challenges replacing private resentment. Kunal eventually stops merely reacting and starts punishing those who mistreated him, including former employees, social snobs, and deceptive rivals. Even when he helps others, such as covering a friend’s medical cost, the gesture reinforces his power rather than softening it. By the end of the batch, his true standing is increasingly confirmed, but the family and business conflicts remain deeply unsettled.

don-in-uniform-2.title: Don in Uniform
don-in-uniform-2.description: A high‑school body hosting an older underworld soul awakens as a reborn Alex who uncovers that the original Alex framed his adopted brother Max, setting off a trail of revelations. That discovery ruptures the household: parents and a stern patriarch publicly demand apologies, question lineage, and threaten exile and disinheritance. At school Max arrives as a transfer, entangled with Anna, targeted by Gary’s escalating bullying, and repeatedly humiliated by circulated phone and viral video clips. Brown Corporation and its executives repeatedly convert public patronage into coercive leverage, ritualizing a “godson” designation to silence dissent and bend institutional responses. Corporate figures, including a punitive CEO named James and operatives like Robert Miller, intervene at parents‑teacher showdowns and stage public spectacles that deepen reputational harm. Rumors, CCTV verification, and viral evidence push private quarrels into communal scandal and prompt peers to act as investigators. A fifteen‑day exam countdown and competition for a single seat make academic standing a proxy for family honor and social mobility. Max refuses conciliatory pledges at times and then shocks the community by posting a top score (97), which fuels accusations of bribery and influence. Attempts at cover‑ups—hush money, goons, and arranged intimidations—collide with exposes and crumbling framing efforts. Within the household, bargaining over dowries, coerced marriage proposals, and transactional offers to pay medical bills generate gendered violence and desperate bargains. John Brown is recognized within these networks and is at moments said to want to abandon crime even as his network exerts brutal power through hired enforcers. The pattern of intimidation escalates: weapons are found, a hidden young man sleeps in a basement, and Alex admits arranging goons to frighten Max. The situation finally breaks into existential crisis when Alex confesses he laced household food, delivering a cold, violent rhetoric that is read as an attempted poisoning and a direct threat to kin. That confession prompts parents’ pleas, furious denunciations, and Max’s vow of revenge; he formally severs ties and departs the home. Elsewhere Max shifts between protector and aggressor—organizing outside operators, cold‑calling operatives, and provoking violent reckonings while rejecting family ultimatums. Across the arc, competing loyalties—school friends, household members, corporate patrons—fracture, leaving reputations wrecked, families disowned, and futures uncertain, with stakes measured in inheritance, belonging, and bodily safety.

commando-panther-2.title: Commando panther
commando-panther-2.description: The show follows Guru, a mechanic whose seemingly ordinary life is repeatedly disrupted by crises that expose a concealed past tied to military service, elite families, and corporate power. From the outset, explosions, urgent calls among military and corporate figures, and pressure from Malavika to return to duty suggest that Guru is connected to dangers far larger than his garage life. Yet his battles are not only external: he is pulled into humiliating domestic disputes over pregnancy, paternity, marriage, and household honor, where accusations and violence threaten to define him before he can defend himself. Even so, he repeatedly acts as a protector, stopping kidnappers, rescuing vulnerable women, and standing beside those under attack. As family members push possible matches with women such as Meghra, Soundarya, and Meera, marriage becomes less a romantic resolution than a legal, social, and strategic weapon. Around him, elite circles are consumed by scandals over authenticity, ownership, and reputation, especially through Mehra or Meghara’s attempts to secure major partnerships while surviving public accusations of fraud at charity and corporate events. Guru becomes her steady ally in these storms, supporting her as rivals like Siddhu and powerful figures such as Maharaja Vikram Singh turn public humiliation into leverage. Questions over fake art, a disputed sword, a missing knife, and a priceless dagger widen the conflict from personal shame to battles over evidence, provenance, and control of the narrative. Public ceremonies and galas repeatedly become arenas where hidden agendas surface, outsiders are scapegoated, and authority figures try to contain fallout before it destroys alliances. At the same time, private households are no safer: obsessive devotion, threats of exile, class insults, debt, inheritance fights, and claims about hidden parentage keep pushing families toward rupture. Bindu’s affection for Guru and her later warning that a dangerous deal could ruin them deepen the sense that love and loyalty are entangled with larger conspiracies. Guru’s own name is darkened further by murder accusations linked to Deva, while whispers of an old killing and a grieving widow’s demand for truth suggest that the past has been deliberately obscured. Deva’s public honoring as a martyr and undercover agent raises the stakes of those accusations, because the truth now touches both family honor and national sacrifice. Prabhakar emerges as another pivotal figure in this world of ceremonies, testimony, and controlled appearances, where his word can save ruined cases, protect reputations, or trigger new conflict. Meanwhile, Mehra and other powerful women try to use wealth, property transfers, and public standing to shield the men they trust, but those offers do not reliably stop judgment or punishment. The show’s central tension lies in whether truth can survive in a world where every scandal is immediately converted into bargaining power over marriage, business, inheritance, and status. Across corporate offices, gala halls, homes, and public assemblies, Guru and his allies are forced to navigate a system that rewards concealment and punishes vulnerability. By the latest phase, concealed identities, contested loyalties, and public reckonings over paternity, misconduct, and restitution leave multiple households and alliances on the brink of collapse. The overall arc is one of a protector trapped between his buried past and the demands of powerful families, while everyone around him fights to control which version of the truth will prevail.

chat-mangni-pat-byah.title: Chat Mangni Pat Vyah
chat-mangni-pat-byah.description: A fiery small-town girl, Bani, storms into a rich CEO Parth’s life after a hilarious misunderstanding leads to a forced marriage. While Parth hides his true identity, their fake relationship slowly turns real amid family drama, betrayal, power struggles, and corporate intrigue. As enemies plot against them, Bani proves her strength, wins respect, and ultimately stands as both Parth’s equal and the true powerhouse behind it all.

divine-husband-1.title: Divine Husband
divine-husband-1.description: Once a legendary sage who sought immortality, a man is reborn as a poor gambler trapped in debt and humiliation. In his new life, he finds himself married to a mute woman. As his dormant powers begin to awaken, he chooses a different path to protect her, heal her, and redeem a broken life, even if it means sacrificing his godhood.

not-a-delivery-guy.title: Biwi ki Bewafai
not-a-delivery-guy.description: A delivery boy, Rohit, secretly a billionaire founder, hides his identity to keep his wife Manisha happy. However, her ambition and greed lead her to abort their child and grow close to her wealthy ex, Shashank. Misunderstandings, betrayal, and class conflict escalate, pushing their marriage to the brink as Rohit struggles between love and revealing his true power.

his-fake-wife-was-legally-real.title: His Fake Wife Was Legally Real!
his-fake-wife-was-legally-real.description: Wealthy businessman Vikram escapes his daughter’s matchmaking by lying he’s married. Avni, also pretending for family pressure, crosses paths with him while seeking a fake marriage certificate. They agree to a no-strings union, unaware fate has other plans. After an accident, Avni reenters Vikram’s life as his office cleaner. Forced to pose as his wife, love grows amid secrets and chaos. When they move to divorce, they discover they had been truly married all along.

billion-dollar-revenge-1.title: Billion Dollar Revenge
billion-dollar-revenge-1.description: ತನ್ನದೇ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ದ್ರೋಹದಿಂದ ಸಾವಿನ ಅಂಚಿಗೆ ತಲುಪಿದ ಒಬ್ಬ ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್, ತನ್ನ ಬಾಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮರುಜನ್ಮ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈಗ ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ನೆನಪುಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ, ತನ್ನ ತಂದೆಯನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಲು, ಶತ್ರುಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ತನ್ನ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯವನ್ನು ಮರು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ಮುಂದಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಬಾರಿ ಅವನು ಸೋಲುವುದಿಲ್ಲ

khamosh-dil.title: Khamosh Dil
khamosh-dil.description: A passionate journalist, Akshat, loses his voice in an accident caused by his ambitious wife Twinkle, who soon begins to resent and humiliate him. As their marriage crumbles, Akshat rebuilds himself with the help of his childhood friend Reena, creating a revolutionary voice device. Rising from silence to success, he exposes betrayal, reclaims dignity, and finds his true voice.

reborn-god-in-a-gamblers-body.title: Reborn God in a Gambler’s Body
reborn-god-in-a-gamblers-body.description: Once a legendary sage seeking immortality, Anirudh is forced to reincarnate as Rahul, a poor gambler trapped in debt and humiliation. In the human world, he discovers he has a mute wife, Kajal. As his dormant powers awaken, Rahul chooses a new path: to protect her, heal her, and redeem a broken life, even if it costs him his godhood.

jaanleva-ishq.title: Jaanleva Ishq
jaanleva-ishq.description: A rich but undercover heir, Vikram, hides as a waiter to find his enemies, while his life gets tangled with Komal, a small-town girl chasing her dream of becoming a ballet dancer, and her jealous step-sister who stands in her way.

ludhiana-to-london-2.title: Ludhiana to London
ludhiana-to-london-2.description: After being humiliated as “just a dishwasher” by the woman he secretly loved and supported, a self-made millionaire enters a contract marriage with a wealthy heiress, hiding his true identity as he quietly rises within her powerful world proving that the most underestimated man can command the greatest empire. Watch now!

rickshaw-wale-ki-dulhaniya.title: Rickshaw Wale Ki Dulhaniya
rickshaw-wale-ki-dulhaniya.description:
A runaway bride with a gun. A rickshaw driver fleeing dangerous goons. One chaotic collision in the crowded streets of Lucknow pulls two complete strangers into each other's lives in the most unexpected way.
With secrets on both sides, mistaken identities, and trouble at every turn, their worlds keep colliding — whether they like it or not.
This is a story of two misfits, one mad city, and the chaos that secretly looks a lot like love.

billionaires-bold-beginning-2.title: Billionaire's Bold Beginning
billionaires-bold-beginning-2.description: The story begins with a reckless act that sets off a chain reaction: Sainya damages Alexander’s rare car, and the resulting anger threatens a struggling garage with ruin. Alexander and Rose demand immediate payment, but Aarav insists the car can be repaired, turning a simple dispute into a fight over survival and pride. Alexander raises the stakes by forcing the garage into a race, with the 8-crore debt and public humiliation hanging over the outcome. The race itself becomes even harsher when drivers must keep a glass of water on the dashboard or be disqualified, making control and composure as important as speed. As the racing conflict widens, Ruhi and other drivers challenge established power, while the absence of Karthik looms over the track. The narrative then shifts into corporate warfare, where a newly empowered CEO repeatedly humiliates or fires a brilliant expert whose knowledge is essential to a critical launch. Senior staff warn that the company cannot move forward without him, but the leader refuses to back down and even bans mention of his name. Technical failures escalate into smoke, engine breakdowns, and warnings that only the dismissed expert can solve the crisis. Rival companies quickly recognize his value, offering double pay and unrestricted recruitment packages as the battle becomes a wider contest for talent and control. Hidden identities deepen the conflict when a junior employee is revealed to be the renowned Karthik, and later another mechanic is exposed as the same legendary racer figure. Public confrontations over credit, theft, and authorship become central, with Aarav repeatedly accused of stealing designs or misrepresenting work while he insists on his own contributions. At the same time, rival leaders use the chaos to recruit talent and exploit weaknesses, turning every failure into leverage. The pressure peaks around launch events and public presentations, where warnings about sensor failures, unstable fixes, and seized engines are ignored in favor of appearances. One apparent success is later exposed as dangerously unstable, showing that applause has not solved the underlying problems. Personal grudges also sharpen the corporate war, as old rivalries, humiliation, and unresolved betrayal drive characters to threaten one another’s careers and reputations. In the later stretch, Arav is publicly disgraced by accusations of selling technology abroad, and Sonia is devastated as his career collapses. That humiliation is then revealed to have been part of a larger conspiracy, while another public dispute over foreign deals, rights, and national development further complicates the power struggle. False accusations are eventually exposed, the real culprit is identified, and the central figure is publicly exonerated. The company celebrates a turnaround with employees and a double bonus, but the victory is only partial because new arrivals and old wounds keep the conflict alive. By the end, Aarav is vindicated and rises into a new phase of power, renaming Kiara Motors as Next Gen India Motor Corps and unveiling a racing-track plan, signaling that the battle over identity, legacy, and control is far from over.

secret-grandmaster-1.title: Secret Grandmaster
secret-grandmaster-1.description: A fearless martial arts master lives as a beggar, hiding his legendary past. When love and honor drag him back into the fighting world, enemies rise and secrets explode. Betrayal, destiny, and raw power collide as he reclaims his true identity as the Grandmaster. Watch now.

fake-doctor.title: Fake Doctor
fake-doctor.description:
A ward boy with a cancelled medical license. A fiancée who's ashamed of him. A hospital hiding more secrets than its patients.
Vedant is kind, dedicated, and quietly brilliant — but invisible to the world he serves. When betrayal forces him to confront everything he's ignored, a man written off as "just a ward boy" must prove that real medicine was never about the coat.
This is a story of a man rediscovering his worth, one diagnosis at a time.

kotigobba-jameendaara.title: Kotigobba Jameendaara
kotigobba-jameendaara.description:
ಮೀರಾ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಬೇಕಾದ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಹಾಲು ಮಾರುವವನಂತೆ ಕಾಣುವ ಕೃಷ್ಣೇಗೌಡನನ್ನು ಮದುವೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅವನ ಹಿಂದೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಆಸ್ತಿ, ಮಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿರುವ ಸತ್ಯ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

ಸಾಧಾರಣ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲೇ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವ ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಮೀರಾಳ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಣವಲ್ಲ, ಹೃದಯವೇ ನಿಜವಾದ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತಿಕೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

game-of-swapping.title: Game Of Swapping
game-of-swapping.description: When Varun pretends to lose his memory after a near-fatal accident, his longtime girlfriend Kiara coldly hands him off to her step-sister, claiming she was never his lover. As Varun uncovers a web of betrayal, financial crime, and a fabricated pregnancy, he finds himself torn between a woman who used him for power and another woman (Kiara's friend) who loved him silently for years, turning a cruel amnesia prank into a devastating game of love, lies, and emotional replacement.

my-security-husband.title: My Security Husband
my-security-husband.description: Former soldier Vikram, bound by a dying friend's promise, infiltrates the treacherous Moorthy family as a security guard to protect heiress Anika. Facing a hostile takeover and manipulative antagonists like Viraj and Aniket, Anika is forced into a contract marriage with Vikram to save her family's legacy. Despite initial refusals and family disapproval, their marriage of convenience proceeds, with Vikram secretly harboring a revenge plot against Anika's "poisonous" family. As they navigate corporate intrigue and societal expectations, Vikram, initially underestimated, dramatically reveals his true identity as the founder of the powerful "Shadow Alliance" and unveils an astonishing gift, challenging his adversaries and asserting his influence. The powerful Moorthy family, facing financial ruin and a patriarch's illness, desperately seeks Vikram, whose mysterious 50-crore fortune becomes their only hope. Anika is tasked with retrieving Vikram, leading to a budding romance amidst corporate threats and their high-stakes contract marriage to secure a crucial business partnership. However, their alliance is fraught with tension, surveillance, and Vikram's manipulative behavior, while Anika's father grows suspicious of Vikram's hidden identity and wealth. A corporate scandal implicates Anika, forcing her sister Riya into a strategic alliance with the influential Veeraj, as the family patriarch orchestrates a ruthless power play involving a priceless Mona Lisa and the "Shadow Alliance." Anika is plunged into a relentless corporate and personal battle for survival, becoming Viraj's target, forcing Vikram into a dangerous game. Her struggles intensify as she faces betrayal from her own grandfather and a new threat from Virat, who, with Riya as CEO, aims to seize her parents' research. Amidst these intrigues, Vikram's loyalty to Anika is tested by Kavya's sinister revenge plot, which involves drugging him and demanding Anika's research, and by his own mysterious illness and amnesia. Anika, desperate to save her company, forms a reluctant alliance with the mysterious Amar, whose help comes with a significant condition. A fierce corporate power struggle within the enigmatic "Shadow Alliance" ensues, marked by public confrontations and accusations of forged invitations. Anika, initially sidelined and disowned by her patriarch, forms an unexpected, high-stakes alliance with Ishan, only for their new partnership to be publicly scrutinized. The immense power of a mysterious badge, possessed by Anika, is revealed, capable of commanding the Alliance's resources and resolving family fortunes, with Vikram unknowingly at its heart. The complex bond between Anika and Vikram is shattered when he reveals his military past with her deceased brother, Ajay, and a hidden promise to protect her, a truth he concealed by lying about Ajay's death. Ultimately, at Anika's wedding, Vikram dramatically appears in a wedding gown, fulfilling a pact with Ajay, and proposes marriage to Anika, transforming a duty-bound commitment into a profound and unexpected love.

blind-love-2.title: Blind Love
blind-love-2.description: A billionaire tests his blind wife’s love, until losing her becomes his greatest fear.

mere-papa-the-great.title: Mere Papa The Great
mere-papa-the-great.description: The show centers on a powerful family and the women and children caught in its demands for heirs, obedience, and public respectability. At the heart of the story is a sick child, Piku, whose repeated medical emergencies expose how money, status, and uncertain paternity shape every decision around care and protection. His mother, presented as a single mother fighting for treatment and dignity, is forced to navigate hospitals, wealthy households, and workplaces where help is often tied to humiliation, suspicion, or control. In parallel, Siddharth or Siddhant, a wealthy heir under intense patriarchal pressure, is repeatedly pushed to marry, produce heirs, and submit to family arrangements even as he resists being fully controlled. The elders around him treat children as proof, leverage, and legacy, ordering DNA tests, making public declarations about grandchildren, and trying to settle scandal through forced marriage. As the paternity mystery tightens, Siddharth’s connection to Piku becomes increasingly central, though the surrounding claims are often weaponized by others before they become emotionally meaningful. The office storyline mirrors the family one: Rituparna or Mitra enters Siddharth’s professional world on merit, but quickly becomes the target of gatekeeping, gossip, surveillance, and moral policing. Her competence wins her access, yet her status as a mother and later her hidden pregnancy make her vulnerable to cruelty from rivals like Arpita and other coworkers. Workplace humiliation escalates into public exposure, false accusations involving child harm, and pressure for her to resign, turning the office into another arena where class and gender are used to punish her. Even when Siddharth intervenes to protect her position, his support remains complicated by secrecy, mistrust, and his own divided obligations. Their bond grows through shared concern for children and repeated crises, including urgent surgery costs, missing-child fears, and moments when he seeks her advice or offers financial help. At the same time, rival romantic and marital claims crowd the story, with women tied to old engagements, family promises, or social ambition asserting their place beside Siddharth and attacking any outsider who threatens that order. Pregnancy deepens the stakes further, as one woman chooses to keep a child from a one-night encounter, another is revealed to be carrying twins, and family elders rush to claim unborn heirs before the women themselves have security or agency. The domestic conflicts become increasingly coercive, with threats of eviction, hired force, police action, and legal bargaining used to discipline mothers and erase inconvenient truths. Public ceremonies and private confrontations repeatedly collapse into scandal when outsider women refuse to leave quietly and insist on naming the child at the center of the dispute. By the later arc, abduction accusations, custody-like claims, and forensic proof widen the conflict from rumor to open battle over who belongs to whom. Across all these strands, the show’s main tension is whether Siddharth and the elders will treat children as responsibilities to be loved or as instruments for preserving family honor and power. The emotional throughline belongs to the mothers who keep fighting through insult, poverty, and surveillance to protect their children and retain self-respect. The series ultimately builds its stakes around recognition, legitimacy, and survival, with every romance, workplace clash, and family negotiation circling back to the same question: who will be allowed dignity when blood ties, wealth, and truth collide.

commando-panther-1.title: Commando Panther
commando-panther-1.description: A decorated special forces commander, living incognito as a mechanic to escape his traumatic past, finds his secret life upended when he falls for a powerful CEO, forcing him to confront old enemies, a web of corporate conspiracies, and his own guilt to protect his new love and reclaim his destiny. Watch now.

30-din-ki-aashiqui.title: 30 Din ki Aashiqui
30-din-ki-aashiqui.description: On a stormy night, wounded gangster Ranveer forces nurse Anika into a marriage at gunpoint and gives her 30 days to fall in love with him—or walk free. Trapped in his dangerous world, Anika plans to expose him, but slowly discovers his softer side. As her hatred turns into love and she learns she’s pregnant, Ranveer’s past returns, forcing her to leave. When truth finally comes out, love defeats fear—and they reunite.

chai-kottu-prema-katha.title: Chai Kottu Prema Katha
chai-kottu-prema-katha.description: Shruti escapes a forced marriage and impulsively marries Arjun, a seemingly poor tea seller. Unaware he is a billionaire CEO who once loved her from afar, she slowly falls for his sincerity. As love deepens, Arjun’s hidden identity is exposed, breaking her trust. Now, he must prove his love is real not another deal.

airline-staff-by-day-skyking-by-night.title: Airline Staff by Day, Skyking by Night
airline-staff-by-day-skyking-by-night.description: When a fierce young businesswoman desperate to save her airline crosses paths mid-air with the mysterious owner of the very company she seeks investment from, an accidental encounter spirals into a web of romance, deception, and revenge — where love takes flight, but power decides who lands safely.

love-in-paris.title: Love In Paris
love-in-paris.description: After a whirlwind encounter in Paris and a chance reunion years later, a resilient woman named Kavya enters into a high-stakes contract marriage with Vedant, unaware that her "hired" husband is actually a billionaire CEO.

my-undercover-husband-2.title: My Undercover Husband
my-undercover-husband-2.description:
ಏಕಲವ್ಯ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಹಸಿ ಕಮಾಂಡೋ, ಆದರೆ ತನ್ನ ತಂದೆಯ ಮಾತಿಗಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಗುರುತನ್ನು ಮರೆಮಾಚಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮನೆದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳದೇ ಅವಮಾನ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ದ್ರೋಹ ಮತ್ತು ನೋವಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಅವನ ಜೀವನ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಗುರುತನ್ನು ಮರುಪಡೆಯಲು ಹೊರಟಾಗ, ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅಲ್ಪವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡವನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತದೆ.

love-ex-aur-dhokha.title: Love Ex Aur Dhokha
love-ex-aur-dhokha.description: Aditya builds his career from scratch after his ex Anushka abandons him. Years later, she returns as his boss and billionaire's wife — obsessed, manipulative, and dangerous. When Aditya refuses her advances, she destroys his reputation, gets him fired, and frames him for assault. With his wife Malvika's love as his armor, Aditya picks up his forgotten law degree and fights back. A story of obsession, betrayal, and the price of choosing power over love.

commando-panther.title: Commando Panther
commando-panther.description:
ಧ್ರುವ ಎನ್ನುವ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮೆಕ್ಯಾನಿಕ್‌ನ ಹಿಂದೆ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ರಹಸ್ಯ ಅಡಗಿದೆ — ಅವನೇ “ಪ್ಯಾಂಥರ್” ಎಂಬ ಸಾಹಸಿ ಯೋಧ. ತನ್ನ ಹಳೆಯ ಬದುಕಿನಿಂದ ದೂರವಿರಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಅವನ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾಯಾ ಎಂಬ ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ಉದ್ಯಮಿ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.

ಸತ್ಯಗಳು ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತಾ ಹೋದಂತೆ, ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ದ್ರೋಹ ಮತ್ತು ದೇಶದ ಅಪಾಯಗಳು ಅವನನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತವೆ. ತನ್ನ ಭೂತಕಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ನಡುವಿನ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಧ್ರುವ ಯಾವ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎಂಬುದೇ ಕಥೆಯ ಹೃದಯ

husband-wife-and-others.title: Husband , Wife and Others
husband-wife-and-others.description: The show centers on Isha, whose domestic and professional facades unravel as a web of infidelities, lies, and public manipulations. Early suspicions—strange office noises, secret gifts, and furtive phone calls—push Isha into confrontations with lovers, rivals, and a CEO named Vishak (also spelled Vishakh). Rival women such as Rakhi, Shruti, and Maya repeatedly surface, turning private jealousies into public spectacle and threats. Isha uncovers betrayals that include clandestine affairs and the transmission of intimate images, any of which deepens mistrust and escalates conflict. A pregnancy complicates loyalties: competing paternity implications, threats, and a violent incident result in the loss of her unborn child under ambiguous circumstances. That loss hardens Isha's resolve; she vows no forgiveness and begins reclaiming agency by exposing deceit and refusing to return to broken relationships. The scandal widens when an accuser publicly alleges a powerful businessman forced an abortion, igniting media fury and legal jeopardy for Vishak Sanyal. Using her corporate influence, Isha divests large shareholdings and announces donations, moves that destabilize Vishak's control and trigger market decline. She then vanishes, employing paid misdirection and false statements while investigators trace a tracked device and an international search is launched. Vishak scrambles to consolidate power, faces public scorn, and deploys resources to locate her as family mediation repeatedly fails. Personal violence punctuates the feud—physical struggles, a car chase, gunshots, and a moment when Rakhi shoots Vishak, leaving him gravely wounded as Isha attempts to aid him. Meanwhile suitors and protectors—Rohan, Man 1, Anurag, Amal and others—offer support, misread affections, or become entangled in further confrontations. Those alliances are fraught: extreme devotion, misinterpreted caregiving, and plots to replace Isha complicate any simple rescue or reconciliation. The interplay of private vengeance and public exposure raises stakes beyond personal retribution: Isha risks legal scrutiny, reputational collapse, and continued violence even as she seeks accountability. Powerful figures deny paternity and orchestrate denials, deepening the moral and legal consequences that could unseat careers and relationships. The season closes with unresolved tensions—market fallout, ongoing searches, fractured families, and competing claims on Isha's future—leaving both personal restitution and public justice uncertain. Throughout, grief, retribution, and the cost of exposing abuse drive the characters toward further confrontations, with Isha's protective oath for the lost unborn child and her calculated retaliation forming the show's primary stakes.

legacy-of-fire.title: Legacy of Fire
legacy-of-fire.description: Samrat, ek legendary martial arts parivaar ka waaris, chupkar “Ajey Yoddha” ban chuka tha. Par uske pita Kuru use har ladhai se door rakhte rahe. Naraaz Samrat ko sach ka pata Mahaveer war me chala—uski nason me zeher nahi, ek khatarnak divya shakti beh rahi thi. Guru Adhiraj ne use tayyar kiya, kyunki ab usse Shaitaan Rudraksh se takra kar apni maa ko bachana tha. Kya woh is pariksha me kamiyaab ho paaya?

the-sweeper-billionaire-2.title: The Sweeper Billionaire
the-sweeper-billionaire-2.description: The show centers on Sneha and Gaurav, whose relationship begins as a desperate, temporary marriage shaped by humiliation, family pressure, and the need to escape dangerous circumstances rather than by trust. Sneha enters marriage while hiding crucial truths about herself, and Gaurav is already struggling against controlling maternal figures and arranged-marriage expectations. Around them, class prejudice and public shaming repeatedly push vulnerable women into impulsive or transactional unions, making marriage itself a battleground over status, dignity, and survival. What starts as a practical pact slowly becomes more intimate as Gaurav sacrifices stability to help Sneha and the two begin sharing a home under strict emotional boundaries. Sneha’s bitterness toward wealth, rooted in earlier betrayals and humiliation, keeps her guarded even as Gaurav quietly protects her in both personal and professional crises. Their bond deepens when he gives her a meaningful birthday celebration and the pair move from calling themselves temporary partners toward affirming a permanent commitment. Even then, the marriage remains shadowed by secrecy, especially around Gaurav’s hidden family situation and signs that he is far more powerful than he first appeared. As Sneha enters a corporate environment, unusual protection from senior figures brings her opportunity but also jealousy, gossip, and accusations that she is advancing through improper relationships. Those rumors escalate into public disgrace and even physical attacks, forcing Gaurav to defend her more openly and to declare her as his wife in the face of rivals. At the same time, Tarun, tied to Sneha’s painful past, reenters her life and refuses to accept her marriage, turning old emotional wounds into an active threat. His confrontations with the couple expose Gaurav’s concealed identity as a powerful Deshpande figure, transforming the story from a fragile domestic romance into a larger struggle over influence, loyalty, and possession. Sneha consistently insists that her love for Gaurav is real and not about money, but that conviction is tested by rival women, workplace hostility, and repeated attempts by powerful families to separate them. Gaurav’s mother becomes one of the strongest forces against the marriage, using pressure, deception, and even confinement to push him toward another alliance while Sneha is demeaned for her poverty. Tarun also shifts from direct pursuit to more strategic manipulation, using public ceremonies, engagement plans, and family spectacle to keep himself embedded in the conflict and to humiliate Sneha. The marriage then descends into scandal involving false or disputed marital claims, divorce papers, photographs, and accusations of manipulation, leaving trust badly damaged on all sides. The danger becomes physical and life-threatening, with hospital crises, a secret pregnancy, and claims that even an unborn child was targeted amid the feud. In the final movement, Sneha and Gaurav are no longer just fighting for their marriage but for their child’s survival, standing together through a critical medical emergency. Deepika’s arrest for her connection to the family’s suffering finally suggests that some truth and justice are emerging after prolonged manipulation and violence. The show closes on cautious hope: after a journey from contract marriage and class humiliation through corporate intrigue, family coercion, and mortal danger, Sneha and Gaurav remain together and begin moving toward healing.

my-lucky-star.title: My Lucky Star
my-lucky-star.description: This is a romantic drama set against the backdrop of power, identity, and social justice. The story follows Akira, a brave village girl who enters a forced marriage with Lakshya, a billionaire who hides his identity as a poor caterer. While Akira joins the Vardhan Group to stop the demolition of her village’s livelihood, Lakshya secretly helps her while maintaining his disguise. Their relationship evolves from awkward strangers to partners who fight injustice together. The show explores themes of class divide, hidden identity, ambition, love, and rural empowerment. With humour, romance, and emotional confrontations, the narrative builds towards Akira proving that compassion and roots are more powerful than wealth.

billion-dollar-revenge.title: Billion Dollar Revenge
billion-dollar-revenge.description: சக்திவாய்ந்த தொழில் அதிபர் மகன்களின் சொத்துகளை முடக்கியபோது, ப்ரித்வி மரியாதையையும் உழைப்பையும் தேர்வு செய்கிறான்; ஹர்ஷ் பழிவாங்க முடிவெடுக்கிறான். CEO ராகினியுடன் ஒப்பந்த திருமணம், ப்ரித்வியை சதி, துரோகம், கொலை முயற்சிகளின் வலையில் இழுக்கிறது. சிதைந்த திவான் பேரரசில் உண்மையை வெளிக்கொணர ப்ரித்வி போராட, காதலும் பாரம்பரியமும் மோதும் இந்தப் போரில் அவன் இதயத்தை யார் வெல்லப் போகிறார்கள்?

satyamev-jayate-1.title: Satyamev Jayate
satyamev-jayate-1.description: Satyamev Singh, an undefeated lawyer who believes in the justice system, finds his world shattered when the criminal he defends destroys his own family. Now torn between his duty and personal pain, he must decide whether to trust the law or seek justice on his own.

5-star-billionaire-waiter.title: 5 Star Billionaire Waiter
5-star-billionaire-waiter.description: Arjun Raichand completes his studies at Harvard and plans to take over his family business. However, his mother gives him a shocking revelation. Soon after, Kavya, the woman he loves, betrays him. What Arjun does amid all these challenges forms the rest of the story.

raj-tilak.title: Raj Tilak
raj-tilak.description: A reincarnated ancient prince is reborn as a 15-year-old lost heir in a powerful modern family, where he faces rejection, rivalry, and betrayal. Armed with mysterious powers and knowledge from his past life, he sets out to reclaim his rightful place and uncover hidden truths.

ludhiana-to-london-1.title: Ludhiana To London
ludhiana-to-london-1.description: After being humiliated as just a dishwasher by the woman he secretly funded and loved, a self-made millionaire enters a contract marriage with an elite heiress , hiding his true identity as he quietly rises in her powerful world - proving that the most underestimated man can command the greatest empire.

house-of-lies.title: House Of Lies
house-of-lies.description: Ahaan returns to his village as a powerful man, determined to change his father’s life. But while he chases success, a dark truth unfolds at home—his helpless father suffers in silence under someone he trusts. A story of ambition, betrayal, and the painful cost of ignorance.

the-silent-bull.title: The Silent Bull
the-silent-bull.description: A disgraced math genius, hiding as a janitor, uses his extraordinary calculation skills to save the woman he loves from a ruthless underworld. To raise ransom, he enters the stock market, turning a single rupee into a massive fortune. With silent precision, he rises to power and begins destroying his enemies’ financial empires.

billionaires-bold-beginning-1.title: Billionaire's Bold Beginning
billionaires-bold-beginning-1.description: When a genius mechanic secretly known as the legendary racer “Cartik” saves a garage from a gangster through a deadly race, he later joins an electric car company where the arrogant new CEO humiliates and fires him. As rival companies battle to recruit him and a fake genius rises inside the company, Aarav prepares to prove that real talent cannot be replaced.

who-killed-my-bride.title: Who Killed My Bride?
who-killed-my-bride.description: On the day of his wedding, Atharv’s bride Natasha is mysteriously murdered and all the evidence points straight at him. Just when his life is about to end, he wakes up in the past, hours before the tragedy. Determined to change his fate, Atharv must uncover the real killer among the people closest to him before the same deadly destiny repeats itself.

my-undercover-husband-1.title: My Undercover Husband
my-undercover-husband-1.description: A war hero who chooses domesticity over medals becomes invisible inside his own marriage—dismissed, humiliated, and betrayed by the woman he loves and the family he supports. As emotional cruelty replaces bullets and ambition replaces loyalty, a buried past resurfaces, forcing a gentle husband to confront how far betrayal can push a man before he breaks.

momo-chutni-ka-pyaar.title: Momo Chutni ka pyaar
momo-chutni-ka-pyaar.description: After being brutally humiliated and nearly fried by his street-food rivals, a humble Momo hiding his billionaire status as a "cheap dough ball" undergoes a royal transformation to reclaim his title as the world-renowned "Ming," destroy his enemies' reputations, and find true love with a premium Mayonnaise.

her-rejection-his-rise.title: Her Rejection, His Rise
her-rejection-his-rise.description: Arjun, an AI genius, sacrifices his career for love but is humiliated and rejected by Varsha. Heartbroken, he walks away and rises as a powerful CEO. As Varsha realizes his true worth and seeks forgiveness, Arjun chooses self-respect over love, leaving her to face the consequences of losing him forever.

രതിമർമ്മരം.title: രതിമർമ്മരം
രതിമർമ്മരം.description: രതിമർമ്മരം ഒരു ജിം ട്രെയിനർ ആയ രവിയുടെ കഥയാണു.  പ്രണയത്തിൻ്റെയും, രതിയുടെയും, കാമനകളുടെയും പ്രലോഭനങ്ങളിൽ അകപ്പെട്ട്  രഹസ്യ ബന്ധങ്ങളിൽ ചെന്നുപെടുന്ന ഒരു കുടുംബസ്ഥൻ്റെ  കഥ. അപകടകരങ്ങളായ ഈ രഹസ്യ ഇടപാടുകൾ ഒടുവിൽ കൈവിട്ട കളിയായി തീരുന്നു. സ്വന്തം ചെയ്തികൾ തിരിഞ്ഞ് കൊത്തുന്ന ഘട്ടത്തിൽ എത്ര ദൂരം അയാൾക്ക് അതിനെ പ്രതിരോധിക്കാനാകും? കേൾക്കൂ പ്രണയവും, കാമവും, ജീവിതവും ഇഴപിരിയുന്ന സംഘർഷഭരിതമായ ഓഡിയോ സിരീസ്സ്.

the-art-and-science-of-thinking-fast.title: The Art And Science Of Thinking Fast
the-art-and-science-of-thinking-fast.description: మనిషి మనస్సు అనేక రకాలుగా పని చేస్తుంది. కొన్ని సందర్భాల్లో మేము మెల్లిగా ఆలోచించి నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకుంటాము, కానీ మరికొన్ని సందర్భాల్లో క్షణాల్లోనే స్పందించాల్సి వస్తుంది. ఇలాంటి వేగంగా ఆలోచించే సామర్థ్యం మన జీవితంలో ఎంతో కీలకం. దీనికి మానవ మస్తిష్కం ఎలా సహకరిస్తుందో తెలుసుకోవడం ఆసక్తికరమైన విషయం.

sath-jeeyenge-sath-marenge.title: Saath Jieyenge Saath Marenge
sath-jeeyenge-sath-marenge.description:
“Agar tumhara pyaar saccha hai , toh samay ka chakra fir se ghoomega, , Aur kalchakra tum dono ko firse milayega”
Rajkumari Radhika aur tapasvi Aryan ka prem pavitra tha.Lekin samaj aur satta ke chakravarti, Raja Pratap Singh aur Rajkumar Gajendra ko yeh kabool na tha. Jab un dono ko juda karneki, unki har chaal bekaar ho gayi, to Aryan ko maar diya gaya. Aur us gham mein, Radhika ne bhi apna jeevan tyag diya. Lekin sadiyon baad, naye yug mein unka punarjanm hota hai—naye roop, lekin wahi atma, wahi bandhan. Dheere dheere unhe apne purane prem ka ehsaas hone lagta hai.Magar is baar bhi unka raasta asaan nahi tha—kyunki Rajkumar Gajendra bhi unhe rokne ke liye laut aaya hai. Kya is janam mein mil paayenge Radhika aur Aryan? Ya ek baar phir mohabbat ko kurbani deni hogi?

foundations-of-indian-heritage.title: Foundations Of Indian Heritage
foundations-of-indian-heritage.description:
భారతదేశం కర్మభూమి. భారతీయ సంస్కృతి అత్యంత ప్రాచీనమైనది. ఇది అనేక సంప్రదాయాలు, ఆచారాలు, పద్ధతులు, సిద్ధాంతాలు కలిగి ఉన్న దేశం. ప్రాచీన శిల్పకళ, సాహిత్యం, సంగీతం, నృత్యం, చిత్రకళ నైపుణ్యాలు అన్నీ కలసి భారతీయ సంస్కృతిని నిర్మించాయి.  

భారతదేశంలో అనేక మతాలు, భాషలు ఉన్నప్పటికీ, విభిన్నతలో ఏకత్వాన్ని సూచిస్తూ ప్రజల మధ్య బలమైన ఐక్యతాభావం ఉంటుంది. ఈ దేశంలో ప్రతి మతానికి గౌరవం లభిస్తుంది. ప్రజలు తమ ఇష్టమైన మతాన్ని అనుసరించేందుకు సంపూర్ణ స్వేచ్ఛను పొందుతారు. ఇలాంటి వైవిధ్యంతో కూడిన సమగ్ర సమన్వయాన్ని ప్రపంచంలో మరెక్కడా చూడలేం.

body-and-anatomy.title: Body And Anatomy
body-and-anatomy.description: మన శరీరం **వాతం, పిత్తం, కఫం** అనే మూడు ధోషాలపై ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది. ఇవి సమతుల్యంగా ఉన్నప్పుడు ఆరోగ్యం మెరుగ్గా ఉంటుంది, కానీ అసమతుల్యత వల్ల వ్యాధులు వస్తాయి. **తల, గుండె, నాడీ వ్యవస్థ** ముఖ్యమైనవి; మెదడు శరీరాన్ని నియంత్రిస్తే, గుండె రక్త ప్రసరణను నిర్వహిస్తుంది. ధాతువులు, రసాలు, మలాలు ఆరోగ్యాన్ని ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి, కాబట్టి సమతుల్య జీవనశైలి అవసరం.

khalistan-conspiracy.title: KHALISTAN CONSPIRACY
khalistan-conspiracy.description: The Khalistan Conspiracy ek sachchi kahani hai un dino ki jab Punjab ki mitti par siyasat, dharm aur shakti ki jang charam par thi. GBS Sindhu ke anubhav aur aankhon-dekhi gavaahi se likhi gayi yeh kahani, 1970s ke aakhri dino se shuru hoti hai, jab Khalistan ka beej boya gaya. Sant Jarnail Singh Bhindranwale ka uday, Anandpur Sahib Resolution, aur Punjab ke gaon-gaon mein failti bechaini — har mod par ek nayi kahani. Operation Blue Star ka khooni sach, Indira Gandhi ki hatya, 1984 ke dange, aur Khalistan andolan ka uthaan-patan… yeh sab yahan milta hai bina kisi rang-roop ke. Har episode aapko un ghatnaon ke beech le jaayega, jahan faisle sirf kursi ya seema ke liye nahi, balki ek poore samuday ke bhavishya ke liye liye gaye. Yeh sirf itihaas nahi, ek political thriller hai jo aapko ant tak baandhe rakhega.

sharapanjara.title: Sharapanjara
sharapanjara.description: ತ್ರಿವೇಣಿಯವರು ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯರು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಬರೆಯದೇ ಇದ್ದ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರವಣಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿ ಕೆಲವೇ ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಗಳಿಸಿದ ಲೇಖಕಿಯರಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗ್ರಜರು. ಅವರ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾದ ʼಶರಪಂಜರʼ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮರೆಯಲಾಗದ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ʼಶರಪಂಜರʼವು ಹೆಣ್ಣಿನ ದೇಹ, ಒತ್ತಡ, ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮನೋಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯವಾಗಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುವ ಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಚಲನಚಿತ್ರವಾಗಿಯೂ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯತೆ ಪಡೆದಿದೆ. ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಭಾವನೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಿ ಬರೆದ  ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿರುವ ʼಶರಪಂಜರʼ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

hymns-of-immortality.title: Hymns Of Immortality
hymns-of-immortality.description:
అమరత్వ గీతాలు హిందూ గ్రంథాల్లో ముక్తి మార్గాన్ని సూచిస్తాయి.  
భగవద్గీత, ఉపనిషత్తుల ప్రకారం, ఆత్మ అజరామరమైనది, శరీరం మాత్రమే నశిస్తుంది.  
ఆధ్యాత్మిక జ్ఞానం, భక్తి, మరియు యజ్ఞాలు మోక్షానికి మార్గదర్శకాలు.

ajab-jamai-ki-gazab-kahani.title: Ajab Jamai Ki Gazab Kahani
ajab-jamai-ki-gazab-kahani.description: Naman ek aam sa ladka tha jo ek receptionist ki naukri karta tha. Uski zindagi tab badli jab woh Agrawal Group of Industry ki eklauti waris Latika ke pyaar mein pad gaya. Latika ke zidd ke saamne haar kar Naman ne usse shaadi to kar li, lekin uski apni zindagi pareshaniyon se ghiri rahi. Naman ko apni asli maa ke baare mein kuch pata nahi tha aur jis Anjana ne usse god liya tha, woh uske liye ek mayajaal jaisi thi. Shaadi ke baad ghar-jamai ban kar aate hi Naman ko Latika ki chachi-saas Anita ne apni zindagi ka naya shikaar bana liya, jo har din uska jeena aur mushkil kar deti. Zillat aur majbooriyon ke beech jab Naman apni zindagi sambhal hi raha tha, tab ek din uski mulaqat ek aise shakhs se hui jisne uski poori zindagi palat di. Us shakhs ne bataya ki Naman ek Arabpati businessman ka pota hai, lekin daulat milne ke baad bhi Naman ki zindagi khushiyon se zyada dard se bhar gayi. Latika, jise Naman junoon ki hadd tak chahta tha, uske saath hote hue bhi usse door ho gayi. Isi beech Anita se badla lene ki chahat Naman ki zindagi mein ek bade dushman ko le aayi. Ab sawaal yeh hai ki kya Naman apni chachi-saas ko jail ki salakhon ke peeche pahunchakar sukoon paayega? Kaun hai woh dushman jo uske khilaf khada ho gaya? Naman ki asli maa ka raaz kya hai aur god li hui maa ke saath kaun sa raaz juda hai, aur sabse badi baat, Latika ke saath hote hue bhi Naman aakhir akela kyun hai?

apaswara.title: Apaswara
apaswara.description: ತ್ರಿವೇಣಿ ಅವರ 'ಅಪಸ್ವರ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಹೆಣ್ಣಿನ ಕನಸುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕಿ ಮೀರಾ, ತನ್ನ ಆಸೆಗೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ, ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜಮೀನುದಾರನೊಂದಿಗೆ ವಿವಾಹವಾಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಪತ್ನಿಯು ಹೊರಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲೂ ಹೋಗಬಾರದು ಎಂಬ ಪತಿಯ ದಬ್ಬಾಳಿಕೆಯ ಮನೋಭಾವವು ಮೀರಾಳ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಸಂಕೋಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಹೆಣ್ಣಿನ ಆಸೆ-ಆಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಇಲ್ಲವೇ ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯನ್ನು ಎತ್ತುತ್ತದೆ. 'ಅಪಸ್ವರ'ದ ಮುಂದುವರಿದ ಭಾಗವೇ 'ಅಪಜಯ', ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕಿ ಗಟ್ಟಿಗಿತ್ತಿ, ಪತಿಯನ್ನು ಮನವೊಲಿಸಿ ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಈ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಣ್ಣಿನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮವಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

billionaire-beton-ka-badla.title: Billionaire Beton Ka Badla
billionaire-beton-ka-badla.description:
“Woh plastic ki thaili mein tohfa lekar aayi hogi, lekin uski keemat 500 crore hai.”
Radhika, ek talakshuda aurat jise uske parivaar ne bhula diya tha. Woh apni maa ke 70ve janmadin par kaafi umeed lekar lauti thi. Use laga ki uska parivaar use dekhkar khush hoga, lekin uski maa Meera aur uski dono behno ne sirf uski gareebi ka har tarah se mazaak udaya.

dca581fa-ba6a-4b9b-8a50-0cb862a6c646.title: தண்ணீர்
dca581fa-ba6a-4b9b-8a50-0cb862a6c646.description: நகரத்தில் கடும் தண்ணீர்ப் பஞ்சம். மனித வாழ்க்கையின் அடிப்படைத் தேவைகளில் ஒன்றான தண்ணீருக்குத் தட்டுப்பாடு வரும்போது மனித இயல்புகளும் உறவுகளும் மாற்றம்கொள்வதை இந்நாவல் துல்லியமாக விவரிக்கிறது. சாதாரண மக்களிடம் தவிப்பு, கோபம், தந்திரம், மிருகத் தனமான சுயநலம், இவற்றுடன் தாராள குணமும் மேன்மையும் தென்படுவதை நாம் உணரலாம். தினந்தோறும் தண்ணீரைத் தேடி அலைந்து சேகரித்து தேவைக் கேற்ப சேமித்து வைப்பதற்கான போராட்டம் எல்லோரையும் போல ஜமுனா, சாயா, டீச்சரம்மா ஆகியோரையும் அலைக் கழிக்கிறது. இவ்வலைக்கழிப்பு ஜமுனா, சாயாவிடம் வாழ்க்கைப் போராட்டத்தை எதிர்கொள்வதற்கான தெளிவையும் உறுதியையும் ஏற்படுத்துவதுதான் ‘தண்ணீர்’ நாவலின் முதன்மைச் சரடு. ‘தண்ணீர்’ நகர்ப்புறச் சமூகத்தின் இயல்பைப் பற்றிய மகத்தான படைப்பு.

you-are-what-you-eat-3.title: You Are What You Eat
you-are-what-you-eat-3.description: ನಾವು ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಡಯಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಏನನ್ನ ಸೇವಿಸ್ತೀವಿ ಮತ್ತು ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇವಿಸ್ತೀವಿ ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಮೇಲೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಡಿಪೆಂಡ್‌ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ನಾವು ಸೇವಿಸೋ ಆಹಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವೂ ಕೂಡ ಅವಲಂಬಿತವಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಅತಿಯಾದ ಫಾಸ್ಟ್‌ಫುಡ್‌ ಹಾಗೂ ಮೈದಾ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಆಹಾರವನ್ನ ಬಳಸೋದ್ರಿಂದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಹದಗೆಟ್ಟು ಮಾರಣಾಂತಿಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳಾಗೋ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಕೆಲಸದ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೆ ಊಟ ಮಾಡದೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಹೊರಗಡೆ ತಿನ್ನುವವರಲ್ಲಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳು ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ತಾನೆ ಇರ್ತವೆ. ನೀವೂ ಕೂಡ ಆಹಾರದ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇರ್‌ಲೆಸ್‌ ಆಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ಆಹಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಕುರಿತು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "You Are What You Eat" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

she-was-never-mine.title: She Was Never Mine
she-was-never-mine.description:
“Ab mere paas Shetty Anna ki mistress banne ke alawa aur koi raasta nahi bacha hai.”
Chandani, jo Shetty Anna ke bar mein dancer thi, lekin uske dil mein chhupa tha ek raaz. Aur woh raaz juda tha Vihaan se — ek aspiring cricket star, jiska career barbaad ho gaya tha uski dhokhebaaz girlfriend Ira ki wajah se. Jisne Vihaan ke har khwab ko tod kar rakh diya tha, usi Ira ne Chandani ko bhi andhere mein dhakel diya tha.

dr-roy.title: Dr. Roy
dr-roy.description: കൊച്ചിയിലെ ആഢംബര ഫ്ലാറ്റിൽ ആർക്കും വഴങ്ങാത്ത  മനസ്സുമായി അവിവാഹിതനായി തുടരുകയായിരുന്ന നാല്പതുകാരനായ കാർഡിയാക്ക് സർജൻ ഡോ: റോയി. അവിചാരിതമായി അതീവ രഹസ്യമായാണു അയാളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിലേക്ക്  അയൽ ഫ്ലാറ്റിലെ താമസക്കാരിയായ ഭാമ കടന്നു വരുന്നത്. ആദ്യം ഒരാശ്വസമായി തോന്നിയ ആ ബന്ധം പക്ഷേ സംശയങ്ങളുടെയും ഇരുണ്ട രഹസ്യങ്ങളുടെയും ചുഴിയിലകപ്പെട്ടത് വേഗത്തിലായിരുന്നു. പ്രണയവും, കാമവും, സ്വാർത്ഥതയും, വഞ്ചനയും കൂടികലരുന്ന ഈ ത്രില്ലറിൽ ഭാവി ഒരു ഒഴിയാബാധയായി റോയിയെ പിന്തുടരുന്നുവോ?

konark-express.title: Konark Express
konark-express.description: ఇష్టం లేని  పెళ్లి నుండి పారిపోతూ ట్రైన్ ఎక్కిన ఆనందికి, సహాయం చేస్తాడు విజయ్. కానీ ఆ రైలు ప్రయాణంలోనే, ఆమెతో ప్రేమలోనూ పడతాడు. తనని కాదని పారిపోయిన ఆనంది పై పగ తీర్చుకోవడం కోసం ఆమె కోసం వేట మొదలెడతాడు మాధవ్.  ఈ ముగ్గురి జీవితాలను తారుమారు చేస్తూ వారు పయనిస్తున్న ట్రయిన్ హైజాక్ అవుతుంది. ఆ తరువాత ఏంజరిగింది? తెలియాలంటే వినండి "కోణార్క్ express" మీ కుకు లో

risky-ishq-4.title: Risky Ishq
risky-ishq-4.description: “Main tumhe kiss nahi kar sakta kyonki tum mere best friend ki sister ho”, Vivan ne itne kareeb aakar Aanya ko mana kiya tha ki uska dil toot gaya tha. Aanya apne bhai ke bestfriend aur apne bodyguard Vivan ke pyar mein pagal ho chuki thi lekin Vivan har baar uske kareeb aakar peechhe hat jata tha. Par Aanya ne isbar aisa plan banaya tha ki Vivan ke paas koi chara hi nahi bacha tha. Kya Vivan bach payega Aanya ke love trap se? Kya hoga jab Aanya ke bhai Aryan ko pata chalega unke ‘risky ishq’ ke baare mein?

flames-1.title: FLAMES
flames-1.description: వాడికి సంతోషం, బాధ, ఆనందం ఇవేవీ పట్టవు. వేటికి చలించని జడ పదార్థం వాడు. చుట్టూ ఉన్న వాళ్ళని నవ్వించాలని చూస్తుంటాడు. అలాగని వాడికి బాధలే లేవని అనుకోకండి. లైఫ్ నిండా బాధలు ఉన్నా జిందగీ అంటే దిల్ సాప్ గా అనుభవించేయాలని ఫిక్స్ అయ్యాడు. దానికి కారణం Lion King మూవీ... అసలు వాడు ఎవడు!? వాడి కథేంటి? ఆ మూవీకి వాడికి సంబంధం ఏంటి!? ప్రేమకి వాడు ఇచ్చిన నిర్వచనం ఏంటో మీరే వినేయండి...

philosophical-foundations-of-body-and-mi.title: Philosophical Foundations Of Body And Mind
philosophical-foundations-of-body-and-mi.description: మనిషి స్వరూపాన్ని అవగాహన చేయడానికి శరీరం (Body) మరియు మనస్సు (Mind) మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని అర్థం చేసుకోవడం అత్యవసరం. భారతీయ తాత్విక సంప్రదాయాల్లో ఇది విస్తృతంగా చర్చించబడిన విషయం. శరీరం మరియు మనస్సుకు సంబంధించి వేదాంతం, యోగం, సాంఖ్య, బౌద్ధం వంటి పండిత ప్రస్థానాలు వివిధ దృక్కోణాలను సమర్పించాయి.

black-tornado-3.title: Black Tornado
black-tornado-3.description: Samundar ki har fitrat ka deewana hai Mumbai shehar, lekin us din isi samundar ka sahara lekar Pakistan ne Mumbai ke dil ko goliyon se chhalni kar diya! Kasab ke baare mein toh aapne suna hi hoga, lekin is ghatna ki poori sachchai aapko milegi is Audio Book mein.

digital-thief.title: Digital Thief
digital-thief.description: ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಮುಖವಾಡ ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡು ಬಂದು ಸನಿಹ ಅನ್ನೋ ಒಂದು ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಗುವನ್ನ ತನ್ನ ಹೈ ಸೆಕ್ಯೂರಿಟಿ ಮನೆಯಿಂದಲೇ ಕಿಡ್ನಾಪ್ ಹೇಗ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದ? ಅವನು ಯಾರನ್ನು ಟಾರ್ಗೆಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದಾನೆ? ಈ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಥೀಫ್ ಇನ್ನು ಏನ್ ಏನ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಡಿಪಾರ್ಟ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಇವನನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ಅರೆಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ ಅಂತ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ "ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಥೀಫ್" ಒರಿಜಿನಲ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

divorce-ka-punchnama-1.title: Divorce Ka Punchanama
divorce-ka-punchnama-1.description:
"Baccha nahi, najayaz aulad hai, jiska is duniya mein koi kaam nahi." Apne bhatije Ishaan Malhotra ki hone wali biwi, Alisha ke munh se Jaanhvi ne jab yah suna to use apne kaano par yakeen nahi hua. Pregnant hone ke bawjood Jaahnvi ek lamba safar tay karke apne bhatije ki sagai mein aayi thi, jahan use ek galatfehmi ka shikaar hona pad gaya aur usi galatfehmi ki wajah se ek hi din mein kai chehre benaqab hue aur kai bante rishte kuch hi palon mein ujad gaye. Jaanhvi, jisne Ishaan ko apne bete ki tarah pyaar kiya, uski hone wali patni, Alisha ne use hi Ishaan ki mistress batakar use apne parivaar walon ke saath milkar sabke saamne physically assault kiya.
Lekin kya hoga jab Ishaan ko pata chalega ki uski gairmaujudgi mein Alisha ne uski chachi ke sath aisa sulooq kiya? kya Ishaan phir bhi Alisha ko apnayega ya lega badla Alisha aur uske poore parivar se?

44a8c101-1200-443d-ab93-af5656160e0a.title: எங்க உப்பப்பாவுக்கொரு ஆனையிருந்தது
44a8c101-1200-443d-ab93-af5656160e0a.description: எங்க உப்பப்பாவுக்கொரு ஆனையிருந்தது’ நாவலில் ஒரு முஸ்லிம் குடும்பத்தின் அகக் காட்சிகளை முன்வைத்து அந்தச் சமூகத்தைப் பற்றிய ஓர் உருவகத்தை வைக்கம் முகம்மது பஷீர் உருவாக்குகிறார். இறந்த காலத்தின் நினைவுகளுடன் நிகழ்காலத்தை வாழப்பார்க்கிறது அந்தக் குடும்பம். வட்டனடிமைக் காக்காவுக்கு ஊர்ப் பிரமுகராக இருப்பதன் பெருமை. மனைவி குஞ்ஞுத்தாச்சும்மாவுக்கு அவள் அப்பா யானை வளர்த்த காலம் பற்றிய பெருமை. மகள் குஞ்ஞு பாத்தும்மாவுக்கு மணமகன் யானை மேல் வரும் கனவு. இந்தப் பழம் பெருமைகளெல்லாம் கால மாற்றத்தில் கலைந்துபோகின்றன. தாத்தாவின் யானை கொம்பானையல்ல, வெறும் குழியானைதான் என்று புதிய தலைமுறை கற்பிக்கிறது. மூவரும் புதிய உலகத்தின் விதிகளுக்கும் நடைமுறைகளுக்கும் இணங்க நேர்கிறது. அரை நூற்றாண்டு கடந்தும் வாசகர்கள் போற்றிப் பாராட்டி வாசிக்கும் புனைகதையின் புதிய தமிழாக்கம்.

the-sex-book.title: The Sex book
the-sex-book.description: സ്കൂളിൽ നിന്നു വീടുകളിൽ നിന്നും ശരിയായ സെക്സ് എഡ്യൂക്കേഷൻ ലഭിക്കാതെ വരുമ്പോൾ നമ്മുടെ കുട്ടികൾ സെക്സിനെ കുറിച്ചറിയാൻ ഇൻ്റർനെറ്റിനെ ആശ്രയിക്കുന്നു. അതാകട്ടെ ഗുണത്തേക്കാളേറെ ദോഷങ്ങളാണു ചെയ്യുന്നത്. എന്താണു സെക്സ്, ശരീരം, ആനന്ദം എന്ന് അറിയുകയാണു പ്രധാനം. അതിനുളള വളരെ ക്രിയാത്മകമായ ശ്രമമാണു ലീസാ മംഗൽദാസിൻ്റെ ഈ രചന. തന്നെ തേടി വന്ന നിരവധി നേരനുഭവങ്ങളുടെ വെളിച്ചെത്തിൽ സെക്സിൻ്റെ ശാരീരികവും, അനുഭൂതിപരവുമായ വസ്തുതകളെ കുറിച്ച് ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്ക് പറയുന്നു. സെക്സ് എങ്ങനെ ആസ്വാദ്യകരമാക്കാം എന്ന് കേൾക്കാം.

boss-bride.title: Boss Bride
boss-bride.description: Shaadi se ek raat pehle, Ananya apne fiancé Reyansh ko apni behen Riya ki baahon mein dekh leti hai aur us raat uski duniya hil jaati hai. Us raat use ye bhi pata lagta hai ki Riya uski apni behen nahi hai kyuki Ananya adopted thi. Par Ananya ki kismat ye jaan kar badal jati hai ki wo industrialist Nandini Malhotra ki beti hai jo hazaro crore ke shares ke sath uska welcome karti hai. Aur sabse bada surprise maa Nandini uski arranged shaadi Vihaan se ek business deal ke tahat fix kar deti hain. Kya Vihaan aur Ananya ka rishta deal se aage badhkar destiny banega?

history-of-yoga.title: History Of Yoga
history-of-yoga.description:
యోగా అంటే శరీరం, మనస్సు, ఆత్మను సమతుల్యంగా ఉంచే కళ అని మీకు తెలుసా? యోగా చరిత్ర 5000 సంవత్సరాలకు పైగా వెనక్కి వెళ్లుతుంది. ఇది సింధు నదీ నాగరికతలో ప్రారంభమైందని, ఆ కాలానికి సంబంధించిన ముద్రలలో ధ్యాన స్థితుల్లో ఉన్న ఆకారాలు కనిపించడం ద్వారా తెలుస్తుంది. యోగా అనే శాస్త్రాన్ని వ్యవస్థీకృతంగా అందించినవారు మహర్షి పతంజలి. క్రీ.పూ. 200 కాలంలో ఆయన యోగా సూత్రాలను రచించారు. అందులో అష్టాంగ యోగా అనే సూత్రం ఉంది, ఇది ఎనిమిది భాగాల మార్గాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది: నైతిక నియమాలు (యమ, నియమ), శరీరాసనాలు (ఆసన), శ్వాస నియంత్రణ (ప్రాణాయామ), మరియు ధ్యానం (ధ్యాన), చివరకు ఆత్మ సాక్షాత్కారాన్ని (సమాధి) పొందడం. 

యోగా భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో నాగరికత ప్రారంభం నుంచి భాగంగా ఉన్నది.

how-to-earn-money-through-ai.title: How To Earn Money Through AI
how-to-earn-money-through-ai.description: Artificial Intelligence అనేది మీ ఆర్థిక స్వావలంబనకు మేజర్ టూల్. దీనిని ఉపయోగించి డేటా సైన్స్, మెషీన్ లెర్నింగ్ వంటి రంగాల్లో జాబ్స్ చేయడం కాబట్టి, లేదా freelancing ద్వారా కంటెంట్ రైటింగ్, గ్రాఫిక్ డిజైన్ లాంటి creative services అందించడం ద్వారా income పొందవచ్చు. AI ఆధారంగా innovative startups ప్రారంభించి products create చేయడం, లేదా AI tools ఉపయోగించి passive income sources develop చేయడం ఇప్పుడు చాలా ఈజీ. Tools like ChatGPT, DALL-E వంటి వాటితో మీ ideasను monetize చేయడం కోసం చాలా avenues ఉన్నాయి. ఈ డిజిటల్ ageలో creativityతో పాటు technologyతో మీ goals సాధించడం ఇప్పుడు చాలా accessible. Just learn, adapt, and earn!

pehle-badla-phir-mohabbat-4.title: Pehle Badla, Phir Mohabbat
pehle-badla-phir-mohabbat-4.description:
Ananya Mehra apni third wedding anniversary par apne husband Arpit ke liye ek surprise gift lekar aayi thi. Lekin usi din use pata chala ki Arpit use cheat kar raha hai. Arpit us se divorce lena chahta tha kyunki Ananya ek chhote se restaurant mein cook thi. Tab Ananya use batati hai ki woh desh ke sabse bade businessman Mr. Mehra ki iklauti waris hai. Par kisi ne uski baat ka vishwas nahi kiya.
Isi dauraan Ananya ki mulaqat hoti hai Ved Singhania se, ek young business tycoon jo use ek saal ke liye contract marriage ka offer deta hai. Ved Ananya ki simplicity se impress hota hai, lekin uski asli identity par vishwas nahi karta. Kya Ananya sach mein Miss Mehra hai? Kya Ved ko uski sachchai ka ehsaas hoga? Aur kya Ananya Arpit se badla le paayegi?

dubari-divorcegalu.title: Dubari Divorcegalu
dubari-divorcegalu.description: ಇತ್ತೀಚೆಗೆ ಮದುವೆ ಆಗೋದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ, ಡಿವೋರ್ಸ್ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿ ಸೆಲಬ್ರಿಟಿಗಳು ಸುದ್ದಿಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ವರ್ಷಾನುಗಟ್ಟಲೇ ಲವ್ ಮಾಡಿ ವಿವಾಹವಾದವರೇ, ಇಂದು ಹತ್ತಾರು ಕಾರಣಗಳನ್ನ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ದೂರವಾಗ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು.? ಡಿವೋರ್ಸ್ ಆದ್ಮೇಲೆ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ಹಣದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯಾಕಿಷ್ಟು ಕಾಂಟ್ರವರ್ಸಿ.? ದುಡ್ಡಿನ ಮುಂದೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಕೂಡ ಬೇಡವಾಯ್ತಾ.? ಕೇಳಿ ‘ದುಬಾರಿ ಡಿವೋರ್ಸ್‍ಗಳು’ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

ee-bandhana.title: Ee Bandhana
ee-bandhana.description: ಆಡಿಟರ್‌ ಶ್ರೀಕಾಂತ್‌‌ ಶರ್ಮಾ ಒಬ್ಬ ಪರ್ಫೆಕ್ಟ್‌ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿಮ್ಯಾನ್!‌ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿರೋ ಶ್ರೀಕಾಂತ್‌ಗೆ ಡಿಗ್ರೀ ಓದ್ತಿರೋ ಮಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಪಿಯುಸಿ ಓದ್ತಿರೋ ಮಗನಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಆದರೆ ಶ್ರೀಕಾಂತ್‌ ಮಾತ್ರ 45 ವರ್ಷವಾದ್ರೂ ನಂಬೋಕ್‌ ಆಗ್ದೇ ಇರೋವಷ್ಟು ಫಿಟ್‌ ಆಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಪ್ರೊಫೆಷನಲ್‌ ಆಡಿಟರ್‌ ಆಗಿರೋ ಶ್ರೀಕಾಂತ್‌,‌ ತನ್ನ ಫೀಲ್ಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ʼಜೀನಿಯಸ್‌ʼ ಅಂತಾನೇ ಫೇಮಸ್! ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿ ಅಂತ ಬಂದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಾಗಿರೋ ಶ್ರೀಕಾಂತ್‌ನ ಏಕಾಗ್ರತೆಗೆ ಭಂಗ ತರೋಕೆ ಬರ್ತಿರೋ ಆ ಮಾದಕ ಯುವತಿ ಯಾರು? ಆಕೆಯ ಮೋಹಕ್ಕೆ ಮರುಳಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಸುಂದರ ಸಂಸಾರವನ್ನ ಹಾಳು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ತಾನಾ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿಮ್ಯಾನ್‌ ಶ್ರೀಕಾಂತ್?‌ ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಮೂಡಿಸೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "ಈ ಬಂಧನ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

waiting-for-love-7.title: Waiting for Love
waiting-for-love-7.description:
Aditya Singhania, Bharat ka sabse bada businessman aur Singhania Group ka CEO, kaafi saalon se tanha zindagi jee raha tha. Uski beti Tanvi chahti thi ki uske papa fir se kisi ke saath jeevan bitayein. Beti ke kehne par Aditya ne shaadi ke liye haan toh kar di, lekin asli kahani tab shuru hoti hai jab Tanvi ki mulaqat Ruhi se hoti hai. Ruhi ek aisi aurat thi jo apne purane rishton aur tanhaayi se thak chuki thi. Uske paas na ghar tha na sahaara. Aditya ne usse shaadi ki, lekin apni asli identity chhupa kar.
Jo rishta shuruaat mein ek samjhauta lag raha tha, woh dheere dheere pyaar mein badalne laga. Lekin phir Ruhi ka past wapas laut kar aata hai. Purane raaz, purani takleefein aur naye sawaal saamne aate hain. Kya Aditya sach ka samna kar payega? Ya apni jhooti pehchaan ke jaal mein sab kuch khona padega? Suniye ek rishte, ek raaz aur ek nayi shuruaat ki kahani.

why-i-killed-mahatma-1.title: Why I Killed Mahatma
why-i-killed-mahatma-1.description: మహాత్మా గాంధీ! భారత జాతిపితగా భావింపబడే మహానీయుడు, స్వాతంత్ర్య సంగ్రామానికి ఆధ్యాత్మిక దార్శనికుడు, ప్రపంచం గర్వించదగిన ఆహింసా సిద్ధాంతవాది. ఇలాంటి మహోన్నతమైన వ్యక్తి జీవితానికి తుదికన్ను వేసిన ఆ విషాద సంఘటన వెనుక అసలు నికర సత్యమేమిటి? ఆ హత్య వెనుక ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? ఎందుకు ఒక వ్యక్తి గాంధీజీని లక్ష్యంగా చేసుకున్నాడు? రాజకీయ, సామాజిక, మరియు వ్యక్తిగత కారణాలు మేళవించిన ఆ సంఘటన భారతదేశ చరిత్రలో మిగిల్చిన ముద్ర ఏమిటి?

the-divorce-deal.title: The Divorce Deal
the-divorce-deal.description: "Tum meri biwi ho aur tumhein chhoone ka haq sirf mera hai, samjhi tum?" Vikky ka pyaar itna khatarnak tha ki usne apni patni Jiya ko gundon ke hawaale kar diya, sirf isliye ki wo kisi aur mard ke kareeb gayi thi. Das saal ki shaadi mein dhokha khaane ke baad jab Jiya ne talaaq liya aur handsome businessman Samar se mulaqaat ki, to Vikky ka junoon had paar kar gaya. Magar kyon chahta hai Vikky sirf Jiya se hi bachcha? Kaun hai wo rahasymay vyakti jo coma mein pada hai aur jiske jaagne ka Vikky ko besabri se intezaar hai? Kya Samar aur Jiya ke beech sirf boss-employee ka rishta hai ya koi purana connection bhi hai?

viral-couple.title: Viral Couple
viral-couple.description: ఈ రోజుల్లో ప్రేమ అనేది ఒక వైరల్ ఐటెం అయిపోయింది. ప్రేమ అనేది ఎక్కడ లేని వ్యాపారం అయిపోయింది. కానీ వయసు అవుతున్న ఒక rod single గా ఉండటం ఎంత కష్టమో తెలుసా? మన విరాట్ కి తెలుసు, అలాంటి విరాట్ జీవితం లో అనుకోకుండా ఒక అందమైన అమ్మాయి దక్కుతుంది. ఆ అమ్మాయి ఎలాంటి మార్పులు తీసుకుని వచ్చింది? నాకు ఒక గర్ల్ఫ్రెండ్ కావాలి రా అనే మన విరాట్ జీవితం ఎలాంటి షాక్ తిరిగింది అనేది ఈ కథ.

colors-of-love.title: Colors Of Love
colors-of-love.description: మూడు జంటల  మధ్య జరిగిన ప్రేమ కథ.   వన్ సైడ్ లవర్ అయిన విరాట్ హారిక ప్రేమకోసం నానా తంటాలూ పడ్డాడు. కానీ, హారికకి ఆ ధ్యాసే లేదు. ఈలోపు విరాట్ ప్రేమకథలోకి విలన్ లాగా ఎంటర్ అయ్యాడు సుభాష్. అతనితో చనువుగా ఉంటుంది హారిక. మరి, హారిక నిర్ణయం ఎటువైపు ఉందో? రొమాంటిక్ లవ్ బర్డ్స్ అయిన ఆనంద్, శ్రీనికలు చివరికి పెళ్ళి చేసుకున్నారా?   బావా మరదళ్ళు అయిన పృథ్వి, చిన్నూల పెళ్ళికి చిన్నూ తండ్రి ఒప్పుకున్నాడా? వీళ్ళందరి మధ్యలోకి అనుకోని అతిథి లాగా వచ్చిన మేఘన ఎవరు? ఈ వివరాలు అన్నీ తెలుసుకోవాలంటే తప్పకుండా వినండి "కలర్స్ ఆఫ్ లవ్"

benaam-pati.title: Benaam Pati
benaam-pati.description:
Kya hoga jab Naina ke liye jeene wala Kabir achanak usse divorce lene ka faisla le lega? Ek aisa faisla jo naa sirf Naina ko, balki unki chhoti si beti Aaira ko bhi tod kar rakh dega. Kabir ne sirf divorce hi nahin, balki saath mein maangi hai Aaira ki custody bhi...
Inhi mushkilon ke beech shuru hota hai ek aisa coutroom drama, jo Naina ke liye sirf ek rishta nahi, balki uski maa hone ki pehchaan par bhi sawal khada kar deta hai. Akeli Naina, jiske liye zindagi ab sirf ek jang ban chuki hai, uski life tab badalni shuru hoti hai jab in sabhi complications ke beech entry hoti hai Aryan ki- ek aisa dost jo ab dheere-dheere Naina ki zindagi mein ek nayi umeed banne laga hai.
Kya hoga iss rishte ka anjaam? Aakhir, Aaira ki custody kisko milegi? Aur kya ek toota hua pati ban paayega phir se ek behtar baap?

evolution-and-essence-of-yoga.title: Evolution And Essence Of Yoga
evolution-and-essence-of-yoga.description: యోగ అనేది శారీరక, మానసిక మరియు ఆత్మీయ శాంతిని కలిగించే ప్రాచీన భారతీయ జీవన విధానం. ఇది ప్రాణాయామం, ధ్యానం మరియు సమతత్వ సాధన ద్వారా ఆత్మసాక్షాత్కారానికి దారి తీస్తుంది. యోగం, మనిషిని ప్రకృతి మరియు పరమాత్మతో అనుసంధానించే గమనంలో మానవత్వానికి శాశ్వత మార్గం చూపిస్తుంది.

a75b670c-f5a6-4a04-bd46-f05478e127a6.title: Vichithrachithan
a75b670c-f5a6-4a04-bd46-f05478e127a6.description: இருண்டகாலம் என்று சொல்லப்பட்ட கால கட்டத்திலிருந்து தமிழகம் மீண்ட கால கட்டத்தில் மகேந்திர பல்லவன் தனது இளையபருவத்தில் சமணத்தின் பிடியிலிருந்து சைவத்துக்கு எப்படி மாறி வந்து பல்லவ அரசனாக முடிசூட்டிக்கொண்டதை புதினமாக எழுதப்பட்டதுதான் ’விசித்திர சித்தன்’ . கிருஷ்ணா நதிக்கரையிலிருந்து ஆரம்பித்து காவிரி நதிக்கரையில் முடியும் இந்த புதினம் அந்தக் காலகட்ட சமயங்களின் போக்கு, நிலையில்லாத அரசுகள், மதத்தின் பெயரால் ஏற்படும் அராஜகங்கள் இவற்றையெல்லாம் விவரிக்கிறது.

tu-mai-aur-mafia.title: Tu, Mai aur Mafia
tu-mai-aur-mafia.description:
‘Aditya Raizada, ye Shadi maine pyar ke liye nahi power ke liye ki thi aur ab waqt aa gaya hai is shadi ko khatam karne ka.’ 
Apni 5th anniversary par apni biwi Anita ke muh se aisi bat sunkar Aditya ki to duniya hi ujad gayi thi. Duniya ki nazar mein ek sharabi, playboy ladka sacche dil se apni biwi Anita se pyar karta tha aur chahta tha use Mafia Queen banana. Magar Anita ki kismat mein shayad ye nahi tha. Wo to humesha se Mafia king ‘Wazir’ ke sapne dekhti aai thi. Magar use kya pata tha ki jis Aditya ko usne Divorce diya hai wahi hai Asli Wazir. Kya hoga jab Aditya ki Sacchai underworld ke Samne aayegi?

9208233d-6219-47b4-b612-8d4c17c94e98.title: புனலும் மணலும்
