9208233d-6219-47b4-b612-8d4c17c94e98.description: திருவனந்தபுரம் கரமனை ஆற்றில் மணல் அள்ளி வாழும் மக்களைப்பற்றிய கதை இது. பாச்சி என்ற மையக்கதாபாத்திரம் அழகற்ற குரூபி. அவளை அவள் தந்தை வெறுக்கிறார். அவள் அவரை நேசித்து பாதுகாத்து வந்தபோதிலும்கூட வெறுப்பு கூடிக்கூடி வருகிறது. காரணம் என்ன? அவளுக்கு முடிவில் என்ன நேர்கிறது? வாழ்க்கையை உள்ளபடியே சொல்ல முயலும் இயல்புவாத அழகியல் கொண்ட நாவல். காமத்தையும் வன்முறையையும் அப்படியே சொல்கிறது. நீதி ஒழுக்கம் என எதையும் முன்வைப்பதில்லை. கேளுங்கள் புனலும் மணலும்.

నీసిధిలో-వెన్నెల-.title: నీసిధిలో వెన్నెల
నీసిధిలో-వెన్నెల-.description: తనను నమ్మని కుటుంభం ఒక పక్కన..! తన గురించి తెలియకపోయినా తన చేతిని విడవని అతను ఓ పక్క..! అవమాన భారాన్ని మోస్తూ మౌనంగా మారిపోయిన అమ్మాయి జీవితంలోకి నువ్వే నా ప్రాణం అంటూ వచ్చి ఆమె మౌనాన్ని చేధించాడు అతను..! మరి ఆమె మౌనం వీడిందా? అతని రాక ఆమె జీవితంలో వెన్నెల నింపిందా? మౌనాన్ని తన ఆభరణంగా చేసుకున్న ఆమె కథను తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటే వినెయ్యండి నిశీధిలో వెన్నెల..!

the-awakening-7.title: The Awakening
the-awakening-7.description:
“Raghav, humara business bachane ke liye , mujhe Vikram se shaadi karni hi hogi.”
Raghav, ek ghar jamai tha, jo kisi 10 saal ke bachche ki tarah bartav karta tha .Lekin us din, Nisha se alag hone ki baat sunkar, wo poori tarah toot gaya. Achanak uske gale ka taveez chamak utha, aur jaag uthi uski andar chhupi hui ‘YAKSH SHAKTIYAN’.
Raghav ab ek aise raaste par hai jahan uski powers, uska  pyaar aur uska past, teenon takraate hain. Us taveez ne duniya bhar ke chhupe huye protectors ko bhi jagaa diya tha, jinki taaqat ab Raghav ke saath jud gayi thi. Kaha se aai Raghav ke pass ye powers? Kya ab Raghav apne pyar ko hasil kar payega ya uska pyaar uska asli yudh ban jaayega?

3dee83fa-8bb2-487a-9909-f4c7962e9683.title: கடத்தல் காற்று
3dee83fa-8bb2-487a-9909-f4c7962e9683.description: உலகிலேயே மிகப் பெரிய கடத்தல்காரன். பணம் , நகை, கலைப்பொருட்கள் என்று இவன் கடத்தாத விஷயமே இல்லை. பல பேரை நேருக்கு நேர் நின்று ஒரே ஆளாக சமாளிக்க கூடிய பராக்கிரமசாலி. .குறிபார்த்து சுடுவதில் இவனை மிஞ்ச ஆளே கிடையாது. பல மொழிகளில் உரையாடுவான். இவனிடம் ஐந்து நிமிடங்கள் பேசினால் போதும், எந்த பெண்ணும் மயங்கிவிடுவாள். ஒரு ஹீரோவின் அத்தனை லட்சணங்களும் பொருந்திப்போகும் இவன், நிஜத்தில் ஹீரோவா , வில்லனா? தாவூத் இஸ்மாயில் . போலீஸ் இவனுக்கு நண்பனா எதிரியா?

1211358e-e64e-45af-82ee-1900caae9b0f.title: தொட்டுக் கொள்ளவா தொடர்ந்து செல்லவா
1211358e-e64e-45af-82ee-1900caae9b0f.description: கிழக்கிந்தியக் கம்பெனி கால அரசியல் முதல் திராவிட ஆட்சி அரசியல் வரையிலான காலகட்டங்களில் நடக்கும் நிகழ்ச்சிகளின் தாக்கம் எப்படி மனித சுபாவங்களை மாற்றிப்போடுகிறது என்பதை உணர்வு பூர்வமாக விவரிக்கிறது “தொட்டுக் கொள்ளவா தொடர்ந்து செல்லவா!”

na-jaane-kahan-dil-kho-gaya.title: Na Jaane Kahan Dil Kho Gaya
na-jaane-kahan-dil-kho-gaya.description: Jab glamorous award night mein spotlight ke neeche ek top actress Priya behosh ho gai, toh usse kya pata tha ki aankh khulte hi uski zindagi 100 saal purani duniya mein chali jaayegi. 1925 ka India, jahaan na stardom ka matlab hai, na self-respect ki value. Ek anjaan era, ek forced identity aur ek ladka Ajay, jo is naye zamane mein uska eklauta sahara ban gaya. Lekin jab har kadam par hui beizzati, sazish aur ek badi sachchai ka parda faash, toh Priya ko sirf apne time se nahi, apne existence se bhi ladai ladni hogi. Kya woh wapas apne waqt mein laut payegi? Ya is purani duniya mein uska naya kissa likha ja chuka hai?

one-step-ahead-focus-on-daily-habits.title: One Step Ahead: Focus on Daily Habits
one-step-ahead-focus-on-daily-habits.description: ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನ ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಪರಿಶ್ರಮ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್‌ ವರ್ಕ್ ಜೊತೆ ನಮ್ಮ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಅವಶ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸದೃಢ ದೇಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಸದೃಢ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಅನ್ನೋ ಮಾತಿದೆ. ದೇಹದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವನ್ನ ಎಷ್ಟು ಚನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕಾಪಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ತೀವಿ ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಮೇಲೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಡಿಪೆಂಡ್‌ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಅತಿಯಾದ ನಿದ್ದೆ, ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕಾಫಿ, ಟೀ ಕುಡಿಯೋದು, ಕೆಲಸದ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಆಹಾರವನ್ನ ಅವಾಯ್ಡ್ ಮಾಡೋದು, ಮತ್ತು ದೈಹಿಕ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರೋದು - ಹೀಗೆ ಹತ್ತು-ಹಲವು ಅನಾರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳು ದೇಹದ ಮೇಲೆ ವ್ಯತಿರಿಕ್ತ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳನ್ನ ಬೀರುತ್ತವೆ. ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಲೈಫ್‌ನಾ ಲೀಡ್‌ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗೋ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "One Step Ahead: Focus on Daily Habits" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

when-silence-breaks-5.title: When Silence Breaks
when-silence-breaks-5.description: Aman Dixit, ek bada aur taaqatwar business tycoon hai, lekin uski zindagi ka ek aisa pehlu bhi hai, jise duniya ne kabhi nahi dekha. Uski chakachaundh bhari duniya ke peeche chhupa hai ek aisa kala sach, jahan paisa, power aur prestige ke beech ek aurat ki izzat, uska pyaar, aur maa banne ki khushi, kuch logon ke ego aur jhooti shaan ki bali chadh jaate hain. Aman ki patni, Mansi ko pehli baar apne pati ke office jane par milti hai aisi beizzati aur aisa zulm, jisme na sirf uski maan-maryaada kuchli jaati hai, balki uski kokh mein pal rahi masoom zindgi ko bhi khatm kar diya jata hai. Ab sawaal sirf yeh nahi hai ki kya Aman is sach ko jaan payega ya nahi, balki yeh bhi hai ki kya Mansi sirf rokar reh jaayegi, ya phir apne liye insaaf ki ladai ladegi?

hakuna-matata.title: Hakuna Matata
hakuna-matata.description: కోరికలు తీర్చే ఒక పుస్తకం దేవలోకం నుంచి భూలోకానికి జారిపడింది. అది ఎన్నో చేతులు మారి చివరికి అభి అనే దరిద్రుడి చేతిలో పడుతుంది. అంతే ఆ పుస్తకంతో వాడి రాత మారిపోతుంది. దాన్ని నేలకి జారవిడిచిన దేవకన్య అవికాదేవి ఆ పుస్తకం కోసం భూలోకానికి వెళ్తుంది. భూలోకానికి వెళ్లడమే ఆమె అసలు కోరిక. ఆ కోరిక తీరకుండా ఆమె తండ్రి వైరహి ఎలాంటి పన్నాగం పన్నాడు? దానికి మించి ఆమె జీవితం భూలోకంలో ఏమలుపు తిరిగింది? భూలోకానికి పుస్తకం కోసం వెళ్లిన అవికా ఒక మానవుడితో ప్రేమలో పడితే? తన శక్తులన్నీ పోతాయి కాబట్టి పుస్తకాన్ని చాకచక్యంగా చే జిక్కించుకుని తన లోకానికి చెక్కేసిందా? లేదంటే ప్రేమవేసిన సంకెళ్ళకు బానిసగా మారి భూలోకంలోనే ప్రేయసిగా ఓ మానవుడి ఉండిపోయిందా? వైరాహి కుట్రలు చివరికి ఏమయ్యాయి? ఆ కథ మొత్తం తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే  hakuna matata చూసి తీరాల్సిందే.

supreme.title: Supreme
supreme.description:
ఆదిత్య యంగ్ అండ్ డైనమిక్ బిజినెస్‌మేన్. అతను ఈ ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక చెస్ బోర్డులా చూస్తూ, తన చుట్టూ ఉన్న మనుషులందరినీ ఆటలో కదిలే చెస్ పీసెస్‌గా భావిస్తాడు. తనకంటే ఎవరైనా గొప్పగా ఎదిగితే, వారిని పాతాళానికి తొక్కడానికి ఎంతకైనా వెనుకాడడు. అలాంటి వ్యక్తి అహంకారాన్ని దెబ్బతినేలా, విక్రమ్ ధ్రువ్ తన చేసిన మంచి పనులతో సుప్రీమ్ సిటిజన్ అవార్డు గెలుచుకుని ప్రజల హృదయాలలో స్థానం సంపాదించాడు.
ఇది చూసి తట్టుకోలేని ఆదిత్య, విక్రమ్‌ను ఓడించేందుకు అత్యాధునిక AI సిస్టమ్‌ 'నెమిసిస్'ను సృష్టించాడు. కానీ ఆ AI సిస్టమ్ అతని ఊహకంటే శక్తివంతమై, ఆదిత్య కమాండ్లను లెక్కచేయకుండా అదుపుతప్పింది. ఆ నెమిసిస్ ప్రపంచానికి ప్రమాదకరంగా మారకుండా అనన్య ఎలా అడ్డుకుంది? కుటుంబ బంధాలు అనేవి బలహీనతలే అని నమ్మే ఆదిత్యను అనన్య ఎలా మార్చింది?

Garuda-Puraan--मृत्यु-के-बाद-का-सफ़र.title: Garuda Puraan : मृत्यु के बाद का सफ़र
Garuda-Puraan--मृत्यु-के-बाद-का-सफ़र.description: Garuda Puraan : Mrityu Ke Baad Ka Safar.  Garud ji is learning about the journey of a human after his/her death. Vishnu Ji teaches Garud Ji all about the sins, a human made in his lifetime and how an individual suffers even after his death in "nark". The show has a 2 story plot, where Pandavas are going to "Swarg" after the mahabharat era and Vishnu Ji and Garud ji are talking about this. Watch Now!

23fbb92c-26e5-47a3-9aa6-08ba7480e51f.title: வானவில்லின் எட்டாவது நிறம்
23fbb92c-26e5-47a3-9aa6-08ba7480e51f.description: வசுந்தராவின் கெஸ்ட் ஹவுஸ் குளியலறையில் மூன்று பேர் மர்மமான முறையில் கொல்லப்பட்டு கிடக்கிறார்கள். அந்த மூன்று பேரும் வசுந்தராவுக்கு முன்பின் பழக்கமில்லாத மனிதர்கள். அவர்களைக் கொன்றது யார்.....? எந்த காரணத்துக்காக கொலை செய்யப்பட்டார்கள்? வானவில்லின் எட்டாவது நிறத்துக்கும் விப்ஜியார் கம்பெனியில் நடைபெறும் விபரீத சம்பவங்களுக்கும் என்ன சம்பந்தம்?

krishna-the-management-guru-2.title: Krishna: The Management Guru
krishna-the-management-guru-2.description: భగవద్గీతలో శ్రీకృష్ణుడు ఒక మహానాయకుడిగా, మానసిక శాంతి మరియు వ్యూహాత్మక ఆలోచనలకు మార్గదర్శిగా నిలిచాడు. ఆయన ఉపదేశాలు ఆధునిక మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ సూత్రాలకు అనుసరణీయంగా ఉంటాయి. కృష్ణుని జీవితంలో ప్రతిఒక్క సంఘటన మనకు నాయకత్వం, వ్యూహరచన, మానసిక స్థిరత్వం వంటి ముఖ్యమైన పాఠాలు నేర్పుతుంది.

swarg-mei-scam.title: Swarg Mei Scam
swarg-mei-scam.description: Om Prakash Sharma, ek chalu aur charming sarkari officer, ek ajeeb haadse ke baad swarg pahuchta hai. Lekin Heaven waisa nahi jaisa socha tha — yeh hai Bureau of Karma, ek celestial office jahan punarjanm ke cases file hote hain ekdum sarkari style mein. Swarg ke darwaze par jab rishwat nahi chali, toh Om ko mil gaya transfer — clerk ban gaya, woh bhi swarg mein! Apne desi jugaad aur teekhe one-liners ke saath, Om kar deta hai heavenly system mein dhamaal. But Jab ek vakil janm leta hai bakri banke, aur ek kisaan ban jaata hai film star, toh swarg ka poora system hil jaata hai. Tab Om ko milta hai ek bada raaz — ek asmani scam jisme farishte aur rakshas milke logon ki agla janam ka faisla apne fayde ke liye badal rahe hain. Toh kya Om is heavenly scam ko pakad payega, ya swarg ka system hamesha ke liye bigad jayega?

അജ്ഞാതൻ.title: അജ്ഞാതൻ
അജ്ഞാതൻ.description: നട്ടുച്ച നേരത്ത് സുരേഷ് മേനോൻ്റെ ഫ്ലാറ്റിൽ  അയാളുടെ മകൾ, 17കാരി ദീപ   കൊല്ലപ്പെടുന്നു. സർക്കിൾ ഇൻസ്പെക്ടർ  ജീവൻ്റെ സംശയക്കണ്ണുകൾ മേനോനെയും കാമുകി സംഗീതയെയും അവളുടെ മകൾ സൂര്യയെയും സൂര്യയെ ഇഷ്ടപ്പെടുന്ന ഡോക്ടർ ശ്രീനിയെയും ഒരുപോലെ പിന്തുടർന്നു. ഉദ്വേഗം നിറഞ്ഞ അന്വേഷണത്തിന്റെ അന്ത്യത്തിൽ യഥാർത്ഥ പ്രതിയെ  പിടികിട്ടുന്നു. കുടുംബ ബന്ധങ്ങൾക്കിടയിലെ  കണ്ണീരും പോരും ചോരയും പുരണ്ട സന്ദർഭങ്ങൾ കൂട്ടിയിണക്കി സോക്രട്ടീസ് കെ വാലത്ത് എഴുതുന്ന ക്രൈം സിരീസ്സ്.

9c0aced2-a9d2-4724-8ce0-f47e68d44bfc.title: அறத்தின் குரல்
9c0aced2-a9d2-4724-8ce0-f47e68d44bfc.description: அழகு மிளிரும் வாலிபப் பருவத்திலேயே போர்க்களத்தில் வீர மரணம் அடைந்த அபிமன்யுவுக்காக நாம் கண்ணீர் சிந்தாமல் இருப்போமா? எல்லா இன்னல்களுக்கும் அப்பால் குருஷேத்திரக் களத்தில் பதினெட்டு நாட்கள் நிகழ்ந்த யுத்தத்திற்குப்பின் பாண்டவர்கள் மூலமாக உண்மையும், அறமும் வெற்றி பெற்றனவே. அதற்காக தம்முடைய இதயம் விம்மிப் பூரிக்காமல் இருக்குமா?

me-you.title: Me & You
me-you.description:
Woh ek sapna baar-baar kyun aata hai? Kaun hai woh aadmi jo har raat Shreya ke sapne mein aata hai, aur har baar wahi dard deta hai?
Shreya, ek simple si ladki, uski zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab breakup ke turant baad, uski zindagi mein aata hai ek anjaana, mysterious ladka- Rohan. Dikhne me charming, handsome aur attractive, magar uske peeche chhupa hai ek gehra raaz. Rohan sirf ek insaan nahi, balki ek aisa sach hai jo insaani samajh ke pare hai. Baat tab bigdi, jab Rohan ke aane se Shreya ki zindagi mein sapne aur reality milne lage. Rohan ka Shreya ki zindagi mein aana kya ek ittefaak hai? Ya phir kisi sochi-samjhi saazish ka hissa? Kya Rohan Shreya ko bachane aaya hai ya khud Shreya ki barbaadi bankar aaya hai?

bb2232d3-5446-46c1-810d-b0d8429b9656.title: சிவப்பு தாஜ்மஹால்
bb2232d3-5446-46c1-810d-b0d8429b9656.description: நித்யாவுக்கு தாஜ்மஹால் சிவப்பு நிறத்தில் தெரிகிறது. அவளுக்கு வந்த கடிதத்திலும், ஃப்ரம் அட்ரஸில் சிவப்பு மையால் எழுதப்பட்ட எழுத்துக்கள் தெரிகின்றன. நித்யா அட்ரஸை பார்த்துவிட்டு அரண்டு போகிறாள். சிவப்பு தாஜ்மஹாலுக்கும் தனக்கும் என்ன சம்பந்தம் என்று குழம்புகிறாள் நாவலை முழுவதுமாக கேளுங்கள். நித்யாவுக்கு மட்டுமல்ல நமக்கும் குழப்பம் தான். குழப்பங்கள் தீர, கேட்கலாமா சிவப்பு தாஜ்மஹால்.

ceos-affair.title: CEO's Affair
ceos-affair.description:
Riya Sharma, ek private detective hai jo un patniyon ke liye kaam karti hai jinke pati unhe dhokha de rahe hote hain. Jab Simran Malhotra use apne husband Rajveer ke khilaf saboot ikattha karne ke liye hire karti hai, to Riya ko lagta hai ki yeh sirf ek aur case hai. Woh Rajveer ki secretary ban jaati hai, lekin jald hi Simran ke jhooth aur Rajveer ke andar chhupe dard ka sach uske saamne aata hai. Rajveer ab sirf ek suspect nahi, Riya ke liye ek jazbat ban jaata hai.
Bechaini tab aur badh jaati hai jab Simran ka cousin Rishi Verma Riya ke kareeb aane lagta hai. Rajveer ke badalte roop, Rishi ki presence aur ek chhupa hua sach Riya ki zindagi ko uljha dete hain. Jab Riya door jaane ka faisla leti hai, tabhi ek aisa raaz saamne aata hai jo sab kuch hila kar rakh deta hai. Kya Rajveer ke dil mein Riya ke liye jagah hai? Ya phir yeh sab ek aur dhokha tha?

c307e043-acad-426a-8f21-cc0302d7e14f.title: இரவு நேர வானவில்
c307e043-acad-426a-8f21-cc0302d7e14f.description:
அமாவாசை நாட்களில் ராத்திரி வேளைகளில் ரத்த பலி கொடுத்து துஷ்ட தேவதைகளுக்கு பூஜை செய்தால் பெரிய பணக்காரர்களாக மாற முடியும் என்கிற நம்பிக்கையில் கதையில் வரும் கதாபாத்திரங்கள் செயல்பட்டதால் ஏற்படும் விபரீத விளைவுகளே இந்த நாவலின் அடிப்படைக்கரு.

மும்பையில் வேலை பார்க்கும் கல்பனா ரயிலில் புறப்பட்டு சென்னைக்கு வருகிறாள். கல்பனாவுக்கு அம்மா, அப்பா கிடையாது. அண்ணன், அண்ணி மட்டுந்தான். கல்பனாவுக்கு அவர்கள் மாப்பிள்ளை பார்த்து வைத்து இருக்கிறார்கள். அழகான மாப்பிள்ளை. நல்ல இடம்.

கல்பனா ரயில்வே ஸ்டேஷனிலிருந்து வீட்டுக்கு வருகிறாள். வீட்டில் அண்ணனும், அண்ணியும் இல்லை. அவர்கள் எங்கே போனார்கள் என்று தெரியாமல் குழம்புகிறாள் கல்பனா. வீட்டின் உள்ளே போய் ஒவ்வொரு அறையாகப் பார்க்கிறாள். ஒரு பீரோவின் கதவு லேசாய் திறந்து இருப்பதைப் பார்த்துவிட்டு அதை சரியாய் மூட நினைத்து பீரோவின் கதவைத்திறக்க, அவளுக்கு ஒரு அதிர்ச்சி காத்திருந்தது. அது உங்களுக்கும் அதிர்ச்சியாக இருக்கலாம்..

இரவு நேர வானவில்லை பாருங்கள்... சாரி.. கேளுங்கள். விடைகள் கிடைக்கும்.

alwar-chronicles.title: Alwar Chronicles
alwar-chronicles.description: ఆళ్వారులు తమిళనాడులో 6వ శతాబ్దం నుండి 9వ శతాబ్దం మధ్య కాలంలో జీవించిన మహానుభావులు. వీరు విష్ణువు భక్తిలో పూర్తిగా లీనమైనవారు. వీరు తమ కీర్తనల ద్వారా భగవంతుడి మహిమను గానించి, భక్తి మార్గాన్ని సాధారణ ప్రజలకు అందుబాటులోకి తెచ్చారు.

detective-ajay-isi-game-over-ep-1-to-ep-.title: Detective Ajay : ISI Game Over
detective-ajay-isi-game-over-ep-1-to-ep-.description: Ek bomb dhamake ne Vidhayak Yusuf Khan ki jaan le li, aur pura shahar dehshat mei aa gaya. Iske peeche ISI aur aatankwadiyon ka haath hone ka shaq hai. Unka maqsad hai iss kshetra mein Hindu-Muslim ke beech dange bhadkana aur ashanti phailana. Jab Detective Ajay ko ek train ke paas sir-kati laash mili, toh uski khoj aur bhi gehri ho gai. Kya ye dono maamle aapas mein jude hain? Kya ve sabhi aatanki apne naapaak maqsad mein kamyab honge, ya Detective Ajay karega is saazish ka safaya?

the-alchemist-20.title: The Alchemist
the-alchemist-20.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುನ್ನಡೆ ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಕನಸುಗಳು ಪ್ರೇರೆಪಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಆದರೆ ಆ ಕನಸುಗಳು ನನಸಾಗಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ದಾರಿಯನ್ನ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಅತ್ಯವಶ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸೂಕ್ತ ದಾರಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ಕನಸುಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಡಿಪಾಯ ಹಾಕೋದಲ್ಲದೇ, ಭರವಸೆಯ ಬದುಕನ್ನ ನಡೆಸೋಕೆ ನಾಂದಿಯಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನು ನನಸು ಮಾಡಲು ಅನುಸರಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಕಥೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಲೇಖಕ ಪೌಲೋ ಕೊಯೆಲ್ಹೋ ಬರೆದಿರುವ "The Alchemist" ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

deep-work-22.title: Deep Work
deep-work-22.description: ಇಂದಿನ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್‌ ಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಏಕಾಗ್ರತೆ ಸಾಧಿಸೋದು ತುಂಬಾ ಕಷ್ಟಕರವೆಂದೇ ಹೇಳಬಹುದು. ನಮ್ಮ ಗುರಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗೊಂದಲವಿಲ್ಲದೇ, ಯಾವುದೇ ಅಡಚಣೆಗಳಿಲ್ಲದೇ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯೋಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ಅತ್ಯವಶ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಪರಿಣಿತಿ ಸಾಧಿಸೋಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯಗಳನ್ನ ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಬಲಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲಾದ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳುಗರಿಗೆ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹುಮುಖ್ಯವಾದ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೆದುಳನ್ನ ತರಬೇತಿಗೊಳಿಸುವುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಲೇಖಕ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್‌ ನ್ಯೂಪೂರ್ಟ್‌ ಬರೆದಿರುವ "Deep Work" ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

shaktilok-the-last-warrior.title: Shaktilok: The Last Warrior
shaktilok-the-last-warrior.description: Kya hua jab mari hui Tanya achanak zinda ho gayi lekin apne hi pariwaar ko pehchaane se inkaar kar diya? Tanya zinda to hui magar uska bartaav badal chuka tha. Prithvi ki har cheez ab uske liye ajnabi thi. Ab Tanya ke shareer mein tha Rani Inaya ka vaas. Hubahoo Tanya jaisi dikhne wali ek shaktishaali yoddha jiska mission tha Kaalsur jaise maha-shaktishaali asur ko haraana. Ab Inaya ke paas hain sirf kuch din ek khaas talwar tak pahuch kar Shaktilok ki raksha karne ke liye. Kya Tanya aur Inaya sirf ek jaise dikhti thi, ya unke beech tha koi purana, khoon ka rishta? Aakhir kaise hui thi Tanya ki maut? Kya Inaya apne maksad mein kamyaad ho payegi aur dhoondh payegi Tanya ke khooni ko?

12-power-principles-for-success.title: 12 Power Principles for Success
12-power-principles-for-success.description: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್‌ ಆಗಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹಠ ಹೊತ್ತ ಜನ ಯಾವ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನ ಅನುಸರಿಸಬೇಕು, ಯಾವುದನ್ನ ಬಿಡಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗೊಂದಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಇರ್ತಾರೆ. ನೀವೂ ಕೂಡ ಇದೇ ರೀತಿ ಗೊಂದಲದಲ್ಲಿದ್ರೆ, ಈ ಸಾರಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಳನ್ನ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಜನರು ಅನುಸರಿಸುವ 12 ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ತತ್ವಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸುದೀರ್ಘವಾಗಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಜೀವನವನ್ನ ಕ್ರಮಬದ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸೋದು ನಮ್ಮ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲೇ ಇದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ದಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ಅತ್ಯವಶ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ಕುರಿತು ಲೇಖಕ ಬಾಬ್‌ ಪ್ರಾಕ್ಟರ್‌ ಬರೆದಿರೋ "12 Power Principles for Success" ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

vedic-origins-of-healing.title: Vedic Origins of Healing
vedic-origins-of-healing.description: పురాతన వేదాల రహస్యాలు, ఆయుర్వేద జ్ఞానంతో మన శరీరం, మనసు, ఐదు మూలకాలు (భూమి, గాలి, అగ్ని, నీరు, ఆకాశం) మధ్య ఉండే అవినాభావ సంబంధాన్ని తెలియజేస్తుంది. కర్మ ఫలితాలు మన ఆరోగ్యాన్ని, జీవితాన్ని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయో అద్భుతంగా వివరిస్తుంది. ఈ ప్రయాణంలో మంత్రాలు, ఔషధాలు, మరియు జీవితానికి మార్గదర్శకమైన వేదాంత సిద్ధాంతాలు మీకు స్పష్టతను ఇస్తాయి.

faraar-aaropi.title: Faraar Aaropi
faraar-aaropi.description: Ek aisa apradhi jo marne ke baad bhi tha Zinda!! Jisne rachaya  apni hi maut ka jhootha khel? Kya hai wo sangeen jurm jo is darinde ko khud ki chita tak le gaya?  Jaaniye ek faraar aaropi ke fareb, jhooth aur jaalsajhi ki "Dirty Picture"

power-of-manifestation.title: Power of Manifestation
power-of-manifestation.description: “ನಾವು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಏನು ಯೋಚಿಸ್ತಿವೋ, ನಾವು ಅದೇ ಆಗ್ತಿವಿ” ಅನ್ನೋ ಮಾತಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ನಾವು ಕೋಟ್ಯಾಧಿಪತಿ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ಕೊಂಡ್ರೆ ಆಗ್ಬಹುದಾ.? ಅನ್ನೋದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯಾಗಿರ್ಬಹುದು! ಖಂಡಿತವಾಗ್ಲೂ ಆಗ್ಬಹುದು! ಯಾಕಂದ್ರೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಯೋಚನೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಒಂದು ಶಕ್ತಿ ಇರುತ್ತೆ! ಅದನ್ನ ನಾವು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡ್ರೆ ಬದುಕು ಬ್ಯೂಟಿಫುಲ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ! ಯೂನಿವರ್ಸ್ ನಮ್ಮ ೊಳಿತಿಗೆ ಬೇಕಾದ ದಾರಿಗಳನ್ನ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ನೆಗೆಟಿವಿಟಿಯಿಂದ ದೂರ ಬಂದು, ಒಳ್ಳೆದನ್ನೇ ಯೋಚಿಸೋದು ಹೇಗೆ.? ಹೇಗೆ ಇಡೀ ಯೂನಿವರ್ಸ್ ನಮಗೆ ಬೇಕಾದನ್ನ ನೀಡುತ್ತೆ.? ಈ ಅಫಿರ್ಮೇಶನ್, ಲಾ ಆಫ್ ಅಟ್ರ್ಯಾಕ್ಷನ್, ಫ್ರೀಕ್ವೆನ್ಸಿ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನು.? ಇದನ್ನ ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರೂಢಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಹೇಗೆ.? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಉತ್ತರ ಈ ‘ಪವರ್ ಆಫ್ ಮ್ಯಾನಿಫೆಸ್ಟೇಷನ್’ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ಕೇಳಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬದುಕು ಬದಲಾಗೋದು ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ.

നായിക.title: നായിക
നായിക.description: കൊച്ചിയിലെ പ്രമുഖ വാര്‍ത്താ ചാനലിനു വേണ്ടി ഇന്‍വെസ്റ്റിഗേറ്റീവ് ജേര്‍ണലിസ്റ്റുകളായ അന്‍സുലയും ലൈലയും ഒരു ചൂടന്‍ പ്രോഗ്രാം തയ്യാറാക്കാന്‍ തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നു. അതിനായി അവര്‍ സൃഷ്ടിച്ച കെണി പക്ഷേ തിരിഞ്ഞുകൊത്തി, അതില്‍ സുന്ദരിയായ ജേര്‍ണലിസ്റ്റ് അന്‍സുല തന്നെ പെടുന്നു. അവള്‍ ഒരു പോണ്‍ ഫിലം മാഫിയയുടെ കെണിയില്‍ അകപ്പെടുകയായിരുന്നു. മാസങ്ങള്‍ക്കകം അന്‍സുല ലോക പോണ്‍ ഫിലിം രംഗത്തെ റാണിയായി മാറി. കോടികള്‍ കിലുങ്ങുന്ന പോണ്‍ ഫിലിം രംഗം പശ്ഛാത്തലമാക്കിയ ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ത്രില്ലര്‍ സ്റ്റോറിയാണ് നായിക., ഒരു പോണ്‍ സ്റ്റാറിന്‍റെ കഥ..

illegal-husband.title: Illegal Husband
illegal-husband.description:
6 saal pehle judwa bhai Vihan aur Aryan ne ek hi hotel mein do alag ladkiyon ke saath raat bitayi. Dono ne galti se aisa kiya. Subah hone tak unhe kuch bhi yaad nahi raha. Na ladkiyon ka chehra, na naam. Unmein se ek ladki thi Kanika. Usse sirf itna maloom tha ki uske saath Aryan ya Vihan mein se koi tha. Par kaun tha, ye usse bhi nahi pata.
Waqt beeta. Sab apni zindagi mein aage badh gaye. Lekin 6 saal baad kismat ne teenon ko ek hi sheher mein phir la khada kiya. Is baar Kanika akeli nahi thi. Uske saath tha uska beta Mohak. Mohak ek ajeeb si bimari se joojh raha tha. Ye bimari usse uske baap se mili thi. Kanika ke paas na paisa tha, na sahara. Ab sawal ye hai. Kya Mohak ko uska asli baap milega? Kya Aryan aur Vihan ko us raat ki sachchai pata chalegi? Aur sabse bada raaz, wo doosri ladki kaun thi? Suniye ek raaz, ek galti aur ek maa-bete ke jazbaat se judi kahani.

കാന്തമല-Season-2.title: കാന്തമല- Season 2
കാന്തമല-Season-2.description: ആകാശത്തു നിന്നും ഇറങ്ങി വന്ന അറോലക്കൂട്ടം കാവൽ നിൽക്കുന്ന അറോല ക്ഷേത്രത്തിലെ വിലമതിക്കാനാകാത്ത നിധി സ്വന്തമാക്കാനുള്ള ദുഷ്ട ശക്തികളുടെ ശ്രമം തുടരുന്നു. അവരെ എതിർക്കാനായി നന്മയുടെ കാവലാളായി അയ്യപ്പൻ പിറവിയെടുക്കുന്നു. മറവ പടയുടെ തലവൻ ഉദയനന്റെയും അവന്റെ സഹോദരി ചിന്നത്തായി എന്ന മഹിഷിയുടെയും കൊടും ക്രൂരതകൾക്കെതിരെ ജനങ്ങളെ സംരക്ഷിക്കാൻ അയ്യനാർമണിയുടെ ശക്തി ആവാഹിച്ചു അയ്യപ്പൻ വരികയാണ്.  ചോര ചീന്തുന്ന പോരാട്ടങ്ങളുടെ കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം...

365-ways-to-have-a-good-day.title: 365 Ways to Have a Good Day
365-ways-to-have-a-good-day.description:
Har din acha ho sakta hai—bas nazariya badalne ki der hai! Ian Sanders ki ye kitab ek perfect daily companion hai, jo aapko roz ke stress, confusion aur negativity se nikalne ke 365 simple aur powerful tareeke batati hai. Chahe aap kaam se thake ho, personal life mein stuck feel kar rahe ho, ya bas apne din ko thoda behtar banana chahte ho—ye audiobook aapke liye ek chhoti si roshni ki kiran ban sakti hai. Roz ek naya idea, ek chhoti si advice, ya ek fresh perspective—jo aapko inspire karega khud se connect hone, mindful rehne aur life ko thoda zyada enjoy karne ke liye.
To headphones lagaiye, aur har din ko banaiye ek Good Day—ek ek din, ek ek thought ke saath!

vikram-veda.title: Vikram Veda
vikram-veda.description: ವಿಕ್ರಮ್ ವೇದಾ – ಒಂದು ರೋಚಕ ಕೇಸ್‌ನ ಸುತ್ತಾ ಕಥೆ ಸಾಗಿದ್ರೂ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ ವೇದಾ ನಡುವಿನ Lov̧e Hate ಮತ್ತು Romantic Feelings ಕೇಳುಗರಿಗೆ ಮುದ ನೀಡುತ್ತೆ. ಸಿಸಿಬಿ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಜರ್ನಲಿಸ್ಟ್ ವೇದಾ ಅನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತ ಜೀವನ ಪಯಣ. ಪೊಲೀಸ್-ಮೀಡಿಯಾ ಸಂಘರ್ಷದ ನಡುವೆ ಸತ್ಯ ಹೊರಬರುವ ಕಥೆ ನಿಮಗೆ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲಿಂಗ್‌ ಅನುಭವ ನೀಡುತ್ತೆ. ಕ್ರೈಮ್ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಮತ್ತು ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್ ಡ್ರಾಮಾ ಬೆರೆತ ಈ ಸಿರೀಸ್‌ನ ಮಿಸ್‌ ಮಾಡದೇ ಕೇಳಿ

money-kathe.title: Money Kathe
money-kathe.description: ಹಣದ ಮದದಿಂದ ಮೆರೆವ ನೀನು, ಹಣವೇ ಸರ್ವಸ್ವವೆಂಬ ಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ, ಹಣವಾಗಿಯೇ ಹುಟ್ಟುವಂತಾಗಲಿ, ಎಂದು ಒಬ್ಬ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣನಿಂದ ದ್ವಾಪರಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಡೆದ ಒಂದು ವಿಲಕ್ಷಣ ಶಾಪದ ಪಲವಾಗಿ, ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಮುದ್ರಣವಾದ ದಿನದಿಂದ ಚಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಅನರ್ಹವಾಗಿ ಹರಿದು ಬೀಳುವ ತನಕ ನಡೆದ ಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅವಲೋಕಿಸುತ್ತ, ತಾನು ಸೇವೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ತನ್ನ ಹಲವಾರು ಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಮಾಲಿಕರ ಅಜ್ಞಾನ, ಆತ್ಯಾಸೆ, ಆಲೋಚನೆ, ಅವಾಂತರಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನೆದು, ಮರುಗಿ, ಬೆರಗಾಗಿ, ಅವರ ಬದುಕಿನ ಸುಖ ದುಃಖಕ್ಕೆ ಮೂಲವಾದ ಅವರವರ ಕರ್ಮಕ್ಷೆತ್ರದ ಸಂಧರ್ಭಗಳ ಕಿರುಪರಿಚಯ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುತ್ತಾ, ಮುಂದೆ ತನ್ನ ಉದ್ದಾರಕ್ಕೆ ದಾರಿ ಕಾದು, ಶಾಪ ಪರಿಹಾರಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಮುಕ್ತಿಗಾಗಿ ಹಾತೊರೆದು, ಬೇಸತ್ತು, ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರೊಳಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲೊ ಇರಬಹುದಾದ ಕೆಲವು ಪುಣ್ಯಾತ್ಮರ ಸತ್ಸಂಗಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ನಡೆದ, ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಹುಡುಕಾಟದ ಕಥೆ, ಈ ಮನಿ ಕಥೆ.

boss-vs-wife.title: Boss Vs. Wife
boss-vs-wife.description: Apne boyfriend Samarth se badla lene ke liye Kaavya nashe mein ek stranger ke saath one-night stand kar to leti hai par agli subah wo ye dekhkar shocked rah jaati hai ki wo ajnabi koi aur nahi balki usi ki company ka CEO Amrit Jaisawal hai. Kaavya Amrit se chhipne ki koshish karti hai par agle hi din Amrit uske paas aata hai aur kehta hai, “Will you be my wife?” Ab kya karegi Kaavya? Kya wo apne boyfriend ko chhod kar banegi apne boss ki wife?

361712be-2030-4013-9d59-36f935bc78e8.title: Athi Malai Devan Part 1
361712be-2030-4013-9d59-36f935bc78e8.description: காஞ்சி அத்திவரதர் அருள்பாலிக்கும் வரதராஜ பெருமாள் கோயிலை மையமாகக் கொண்டு சரித்திரத்தில் நிகழ்ந்த முக்கிய நிகழ்வுகளின் மர்ம தொகுப்பு தான் அத்திமலைத் தேவன்.

ca28ae8b-68f7-46b7-859a-122a8205b820.title: அபாயம் தொடு
ca28ae8b-68f7-46b7-859a-122a8205b820.description: சமூகத்தில் பெரிய பதவிகளில் உள்ளவர்கள் தாங்கள் என்றென்றும் பதவியில் இருக்க வேண்டும் என்பதற்காக, எப்படிப்பட்ட கொடுமையான செயலையும் செய்யத் தயங்கமாட்டார்கள் என்பதை உணர்த்தும் மல்டி க்ரைம் த்ரில்லர்.

improve-your-cash-flow-teach-yourself.title: Improve Your Cash Flow: Teach Yourself
improve-your-cash-flow-teach-yourself.description: Har mahine salary aati hai, par khatam kahan hoti hai – pata hi nahi chalta? Cash flow problems sirf business ki nahi, aapki personal life ki bhi badi wajah hain. Lekin ek simple mindset shift se aap paisa sambhalna nahi, multiply karna bhi seekh sakte ho.

naale-baa.title: Naale Baa
naale-baa.description: ಎದೆ ನಡುಗಿಸೋ ಭಯಾನಕ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿರೋ ಆ ದಟ್ಟವಾದ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಅಂಟಿಕೊಂಡಿರೋ ಶಾಪಗ್ರಸ್ಥ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ದುರ್ಗಾಪುರ! ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಮನೆಯ ಬಾಗಿಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಳಿ ಬಳಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದಿರೋ ವಿಲಕ್ಷಣ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳು ಎಂತವರಿಗೂ ದಿಗಿಲು ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಭಯದ ನೆರಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕ್ತಿರೋ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರಿಗಂತೂ ಹಗಲು ಹೊತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲೇ ಆಚೆ ಬರದಂತಹ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ! ಅಂತಹ ಭಯಂಕರ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗೆ ಭೇಟಿ ನೀಡೋ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನ ಕೇಳಿ ಆಕರ್ಷಿತಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕಾಡಿನ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇಧಿಸೋಕೆ ಮುಂದಾಗೋ ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ಗೆ ಭಯದ ತೀವ್ರತೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗ್ತಾ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ. ದುರ್ಗಾಪುರಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಟಿರೋ ಭಯಾನಕ ಶಾಪ ಯಾರದ್ದು? ಆ ಕಗ್ಗತ್ತಲ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಗಿರೋ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳೇನು? ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡುಕ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸುವ ಭಯಾನಕ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ನಾಳೆ ಬಾ" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

women-wealth-henmakle-strongu-guru.title: Women & Wealth : Henmakle Strongu Guru
women-wealth-henmakle-strongu-guru.description: ಹೆಣ್ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲೂ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಸೈ ಎನಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇನ್ನು ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ವಿಚಾರದಲ್ಲೂ ಅವರಿಗೆ 'ಹೋಮ್ ಮಿನಿಸ್ಟರ್' ಪಟ್ಟ ಇದೆ‌. ಆದ್ರೆ ಕೆಲವರು ಮಾತ್ರ ಮನಿ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್ಮೆಂಟಿಂದ ಮಾರು ದೂರ ಉಳಿದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಹಣದ ಉಳಿಕೆ-ಗಳಿಕೆ-ಬಳಕೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಮಾಡೋದು? ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ವೆಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ, ಏನು ಉಪಯೋಗ? ಇರೋ ದುಡ್ಡಲ್ಲೇ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತರಾಗೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಆಸ್ತಿಯ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಅದ್ರಿಂದ ಬದುಕಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೀರುವ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳೇನು? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲದಕ್ಕೂ ಉತ್ತರ 'Women & Wealth: ಹೆಣ್ಮಕ್ಕಳೇ ಸ್ಟ್ರಾಂಗು ಗುರು' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

understand-greek-mythology.title: Understand Greek Mythology
understand-greek-mythology.description:
Understand Greek Mythology ek romanchak yatra hai jo aapko le jaati hai un kahaniyon ki duniya mein jahan devta bhi insaanon jaise gusse, prem, ahankaar aur jalan se bhare hue the. Yahaan Zeus apni bijliyon se duniya chalata hai, Poseidon samundaron ka raja hai, aur Hades andheron mein chhupa baitha hai.

Is audiobook mein aap sunenge Medusa ke shraap ki kahani, Hercules ke 12 mushkil kaamon ka safar, aur Helen ke ek chehre se shuru hua Trojan Yudh. Odysseus ka 10 saal ka safar, Achilles ki amar kahani, aur Athena, Apollo, Artemis jaise devtaon ke saath ek ek kahani aapke dil aur dimaag dono ko choo jaayegi.
Har episode aapko mythology ke kisi naye pehlu se milwata hai – kabhi ek tragedy, kabhi ek jeet, aur kabhi ek seekh. Ye sirf puraani kahaniyaan nahi hain, ye manav bhavnaon ke asli roop hain.
Agar aapko mythology, fantasy ya history pasand hai, to ye series aapke liye hai. Kahaniyaan prachin hain, lekin jazbaat bilkul aaj jaise.
Sunna shuru kijiye aur kho jaaiye ek aisi duniya mein jahan devta bhi insaan jaise hi the.

അവനും-ഞാനും.title: അവനും ഞാനും
അവനും-ഞാനും.description: കോൾ ഗേളായ അക്ഷയയെ ഗൗതം തന്നോടൊപ്പം കൂട്ടിയത് ഒരു ആൾമാറാട്ടത്തിനായിരുന്നു. മൂന്നു ദിവസത്തെ ആ നാടകത്തിനിടയിൽ വിധിനിയോഗം പോലെ അവർ പരസ്പരം അടുത്തു. മനസ്സുകൾ ഒന്നിക്കുമ്പോഴും എന്തോ രഹസ്യങ്ങൾ  അവർ അന്യോന്യം ഒളിപ്പിക്കുന്നുണ്ടായിരുന്നു, അവളെ വേട്ടയാടിയത് സ്വന്തം ഭൂതകാലം തന്നെ  ആയിരുന്നെങ്കിൽ, അവൻ്റേത്  ഒരു നഷ്ടപ്രണയത്തിൻ്റെ നീറ്റലായിരുന്നു.  അവർ ഒരുമിച്ച് ഒരു പുതിയ ലോകത്തേക്ക് ചുവടുവെയ്ക്കുമ്പോഴേക്കും പക്ഷേ അവളുടെ പൂർവ്വകാലം പിന്നാലെ എത്തിക്കഴിഞ്ഞു, പിന്നീടങ്ങോട്ട് വേദനാജനകമായ പല സത്യങ്ങളെയും അപ്രതീക്ഷിത നാടകങ്ങളെയും അഭിമുഖീകരിക്കാൻ അവർ നിർബന്ധിതരാകുന്നു. പ്രതികാരത്തിന്റെയും വീണ്ടെടുപ്പിൻ്റെയും അതിശയകരമായ വഴിത്തിരിവുകളുടെയും മുന്നേറുന്ന ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കഥ.

my-middleclass-billionaire.title: My Middleclass Billionaire
my-middleclass-billionaire.description: 21 saal ki Ananya Mehra, jo apne pitaji ke dhabe ko chalate hue, desh ke sabse bade business empire, Rathore Group ke khilaf andolan kar rahi hai, ek din apni poori zindagi badal dene wali ghatnaon mein phans jaati hai. Ananya ki zindagi mein Ishan ki entry hoti hai, aur dono ke beech najdikiya badhne lagti hai. Lekin Ishan ke paas ek bada raaz chhupa hai, jo Ananya ke bimaar pitaji ki zindagi ko Rathore Group se jodta hai. Kya Ananya us raaz ko jaan paayegi? Kya woh apne dil ki sun paayegi, ya phir uska har faisla Rathore Group aur apne parivaar ki izzat ke beech uljha rahega?

anand-apartments.title: Anand Apartments
anand-apartments.description: ಅದು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠಿತ ಅಪಾರ್ಟ್ಮೆಂಟ್. ಒಂದು ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಂತದೊಂದು ಮನೆ ಇರ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಕನಸು ಕಂಡವರ ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಕೈಗೆಟುಕೋ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಟ್ ಸಿಗುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದ ಬಹುದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ! ಆದ್ರೆ ಇದ್ದಕ್ಕಿದ್ಹಾಗೇ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಸಾಲು ಸಾಲು ಮರ್ಡರ್ಗಳು ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್ ಸಿಟಿಯನ್ನೇ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿ ಬೀಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಶಾಲಾ ಬಾಲಾಕಿ, ಕಾಲೇಜ್ ಸ್ಟೂಡೆಂಟ್, ಗೃಹಿಣಿ, ವೃದ್ಧೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳೇ ಟಾರ್ಗೆಟ್ ಆಗಿರೋ ಈ ಕೊಲೆಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಇರೋ ಪಾತಕಿ ಯಾರು.? ಇದು ಮರ್ಯದಾ ಹತ್ಯೆ ಅಂತಾ ಒಂದಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರೆ, ಇವೆಲ್ಲಾ ಭೂತದ ಕಾಟ ಅಂತಾರೆ ಕೆಲವರು! ಈ ಕೊಲೆಗಳ ಮರ್ಮ ಬೇಧಿಸೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರಟ ಇನ್ಸ್ಪೆಕ್ಟರ್ ವಂಶಿ ಕಥೆ ಏನಾಯ್ತು.? ಕೇಳಿ ರೋಚಕ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ‘ಆನಂದ್ ಅಪಾರ್ಟ್ಮೆಂಟ್ಸ್’.

hana-matthu-banking-arthashasthra.title: Hana matthu Banking Arthashasthra
hana-matthu-banking-arthashasthra.description: ಡಾ. ಸಿದ್ಧಲಿಂಗರೆಡ್ಡಿ ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ಹಣ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಂಗ್ ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ' ಕೃತಿಯು ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಅವಶ್ಯಕವಾಗಿದೆ. ಆಧುನಿಕ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ. ಇನ್ನು ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ದಿನಗಳ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ಈ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರಿಗೂ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುವಂತೆ ಸರಳವಾದ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಲೇಖಕರು. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

the-cursed-ameerzada.title: The Cursed Ameerzada
the-cursed-ameerzada.description:
Aryan apni Jaan dekar apni behen ki jaan bachaana chahta hai, lekin har bar naakam ho jata hai , aur use milta hai ek chamatkaari vardaan, jo uski taqdeer palat sakta hai. Lekin wahi vardaan uske liye shraap ban jata hai aur wo ek game ke aise daldal me fans jaata hai, jisme mask pehne hue log Aryan ki har move par nazar rakhe hue hain. Iss game mein har kadam pe hai ek naya twist, ek nayi saazish, aur har insaan ke peeche chhupi hai ek chaukane wali sachchai.
Kya Aryan apne vardaan ka sahi istemal kar payega ya ban jaayega kisi aur ke game ka hissa? Kya woh apni behen ko bacha payega? Kya ye vardaan hai ya ek shraap?

unbreakable-rise-above-challenges.title: Unbreakable: Rise Above Challenges
unbreakable-rise-above-challenges.description: జీవితం మీ ముందుకు విసురుతున్న సవాళ్లు ఎంత పెద్దవైనా, మీరు మీ మనోధైర్యాన్ని, మీ శక్తిని నిలబెట్టుకుని ముందుకు సాగగలరని నిరూపించండి.అచంచలమైన మనోధైర్యం అనేది మీ ప్రగతికి ఒక ప్రేరణగా మారుతుంది. ఒక ఎత్తైన పర్వతాన్ని అధిరోహించడం ఎలా కష్టంగా అనిపిస్తుందో, అలాగే మన లక్ష్యాలకు చేరుకోవడం కూడా సవాళ్లతో నిండివుంటుంది. కానీ మీ ఆత్మవిశ్వాసం, కష్టపడి పనిచేసే శక్తి ఉంటే, మీరు ఏదైనా సాధించగలరు.

hitler-and-india.title: Hitler and India
hitler-and-india.description: Hitler and India അഡോൾഫ് ഹിറ്റ് ലറും ഇന്ത്യയുമായുള്ള ആശ്ചര്യകരവും പലപ്പോഴും തെറ്റിദ്ധരിക്കപ്പെട്ടതുമായ ബന്ധത്തെ പരിശോധിക്കുന്ന രചനയാണു. ഇന്ത്യൻ സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യസമരത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും ഇന്ത്യൻ ജനതയേയും, സംസ്കാരത്തെയും കുറിച്ചുമുള്ള ഹിറ്റ്ലറുടെ കാഴ്ചപ്പാടുകൾ ഇവിടെ അനാവരണം ചെയ്യപ്പെടുന്നു. നേതാജി സുഭാഷ് ചന്ദ്രബോസും നാസി ജർമനിയയുമായുള്ള ഇടപെടലുകൾ ഉൾപ്പെടെ അറിയപ്പെടാത്ത നിരവധി ചരിത്ര സംഭവങ്ങൾ ഇതിൽ കടന്ന് വരുന്നു. കൗതുകകരമായ ഈ അന്വേഷണം ചരിത്രത്തിൽ അപൂർവ്വമായി ചർച്ച ചെയ്യപ്പെട്ടിട്ടുളള, എന്നാൽ ഇന്നും നിർണ്ണായകമായ ഒരു അധ്യായത്തിലേക്കാണു വെളിച്ചം വീശുന്നത്.

jamai-on-contract.title: Jamai On Contract
jamai-on-contract.description: “Ye to apni beti ka birthday cake bhi afford nahi kar sakta.” Siddharth ki beti Anvi ke birthday par uske hi sasural wale use sabke saamne zaleel karte hain, wahi nahi wo Siddharth ki wife Ananya ki shaadi uske ex-boyfriend se karana chahte hain, par unko pata nahi hota ki Siddharth, India ki sabse badi company Singhania Industries ka waris aur CEO hai jo apni pehchan chhupa kar unke sath rah raha hai? Kya hoga jab Ananya aur Siddharth ke sasural walon ko pata chalegi Siddharth ki asaliyat? Itna ameer hokar bhi gareeb bankar sabke taane kyon sun raha hai Siddharth?

mr-fair-and-miss-ugly.title: Mr Fair and Miss Ugly
mr-fair-and-miss-ugly.description:
ఆరాధ్య, తన ఒంటి రంగు నలుపైనా, స్వచ్ఛమైన ముత్యంలాంటి వ్యక్తిత్వం ఆమెది. కానీ కాలేజీలో ఆమె రంగుపై, రూపానిపై కుళ్ళు జోకులు వేసి insult చేస్తారు కొంతమంది తోటి స్టూడెంట్స్. కానీ  ది మోస్ట్ హాండ్సమ్ అబ్బాయి రిషి, మాత్రం అందమైన ఆమె మనసుని చూసి లవ్ లో పడతాడు. 

రంగూ, రూపమే ఆమెకు వరమా ? లేక శాపమా? అనుకోని వరమై చేరిన అతని ప్రేమని ఆమె అంగీకరిస్తుందా? ప్రేమతో దగ్గరైన అతనికి ఆమె మనసులో స్థానం దొరుకుతుందా? ఆమె భయాలని దూరం చేసి అతను ఆరాధ్యకి ధైర్యంగా మారగలడా? వినండి Mr.Fair & miss Ugly

mohini-7.title: Mohini
mohini-7.description: అర్ధరాత్రి సముద్ర తీరంలో ఒక అమ్మాయి ఒంటరిగా నిలబడి ఎవరికోసమో ఎదురు చూస్తూ వుంది. ఆమె అందానికి ఎట్రాక్ట్ అయి తన వెళ్లిన కుమార్ శవంలా మారిపోయాడు. తన స్నేహితుడు రవి కూడా అలానే మాయమై శవంలా దొరికాడు. అసలు ఈ హత్యలు వెనుక ఉన్నది ఎవరు తెలుసుకోవడం పోలీసులకు పెద్ద సవాల్ గా మారింది. ఈ మిస్టేరీ కేస్ వెనక ఉన్నది ఎవరో సిద్ధార్థ్&జ్వాలా కనిపెట్టగలరా!?

mumbai-ka-action-hero.title: Mumbai Ka Action Hero
mumbai-ka-action-hero.description: Joote polish karne vale 10 saal ke Vijay ki kismat tab badalti hai, jab use apne paas rakhe locket ki shaktiyon ka pata chalta hai. Lekin uske pehle hi uski behen Navya ko kisine god le liye, kyonki Vijay ke paas uska ilaaj karane ke paise nahin the. Ab ek khatarnak dushman in bacchon ko dhundh raha hai, kyonki use ye shaktishali locket chahiye. Kya vo shakhs Vijay aur Navya tak pahunch paega? Kya Vijay aur Navya ab dobara mil paenge? Kya Navya ko god lene vala Navya ka illaj karaega? Aakhir kaise aaya Vijay ke paas ye locket? Janane ke liye suniye Mumbai ka Action Hero!

bharatheeya-raniyaru.title: Bharatheeya Raniyaru
bharatheeya-raniyaru.description: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಹೆಸರಾಂತ ರಾಜ ಮನೆತನಗಳಿಂದ  ಶ್ರೀಮಂತಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ರಾಜರಷ್ಟೇ ಸರಿಸಮಾನರಾದ ರಾಣಿಯರ ಕೆಚ್ಚೆದೆಯ ಹೋರಾಟ ಇಂದು ಗತವೈಭವವಾಗಿದೆ. ಕಾಶ್ಮೀರದಿಂದ ಕನ್ಯಾಕುಮಾರಿವರೆಗೆ, ಭಾಷೆ-ಜಾತಿ-ಧರ್ಮದ ಗಡಿ ಮೀರಿ ತಮ್ಮ ರಕ್ತ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಸಂಸ್ಥಾನಗಳನ್ನ, ತಮ್ಮ ಮಾನವನ್ನ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಣವನ್ನ ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿದ ವೀರವನಿತೆಯರ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಭಾರತೀಯ ರಾಣಿಯರು' ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.

cyanide-stories.title: Cyanide Stories
cyanide-stories.description:
"സയനൈഡ് സ്റ്റോറി‌സ്" മനസ്സ് മരവിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കൊലപാതകങ്ങളുടെ കഥകളാണു, അത്യന്തം മാരകമായ സയനൈഡ്  എന്ന സൈലൻ്റ് കില്ലറാണു ഈ കഥകളിലെ വില്ലൻ.                     
അതിൽ സയനൈഡ് മല്ലിക, സയനൈഡ് മോഹനൻ തുടങ്ങി കൂടത്തായിയിലെ ജോളി വരെ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു, ഓരോ കഥയിലും  മറഞ്ഞിരുന്ന വഞ്ചനകളും, ഗൂഢോദ്ദേശ്യങ്ങളും, മാരകമായ രഹസ്യങ്ങളും ഇവിടെ വെളിപ്പെടുന്നു. ഒരു തുളളി ചോര പൊടിയാതെ,  ചതിയിലൂടെ, പുഞ്ചിരിച്ചു കൊണ്ട് ഇരകളുടെ ജീവനെടുത്ത മാരക വിഷം പുരണ്ട ആ കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം..

my-mysterious-patidev.title: Secret Husband
my-mysterious-patidev.description: Kabir, ek saadha-saadha dikhne wala aadmi, Roohi se shaadi ke baad uske ameer aur ghuroor bhare parivaar ko rozana jhelta hai. Lekin ek din, sach sabke saamne aata hai jisse sabke hosh ud jaate hai, jab Kabir ki asli pahchaan sabke saamne aati hai! Jaise-jaise raaz khulte hain, Roohi ka parivaar uss aadmi ke saamne jhukne ko majboor ho jaata hai! Aakhir kya chal raha hai Kabir ke dimag me? Kaise vo chun-chun ke badla lega?

my-new-neighbour.title: My New Neighbour
my-new-neighbour.description:
അടുത്തിടെയാണു വിവാഹിതയായതെങ്കിലും ഭാവന തൻ്റെ ഭർത്താവിൽ അതൃപ്തയായിരുന്നു. തന്റെ കാമതൃഷ്ണയെ  ശമിപ്പിക്കാനായി അയൽവാസിയായ ഒരു യുവാവുമായി അവൾ അവിഹിത ബന്ധത്തിൽ ഏർപ്പെട്ടു. എന്നാൽ അത് സംഭവിച്ച അടുത്ത ദിവസം തന്നെ ആ യുവാവിനെ കൊലപ്പെട്ട നിലയിൽ കണ്ടെത്തി.
ആ കൊലപാതകി ആരാണ്? ഒരു സൈക്കോ കില്ലറോ, അതല്ലാ  കോളനിയിൽ പുതിയതായി വന്ന പുതിയ ആ അയൽക്കാരിയോ?

the-final-boss-5.title: The Final Boss
the-final-boss-5.description: ‘Mujhe tujh jaise loser se nahi invisible CEO se shadi karni hai,” ye kehkar Menka, apne 5 saal ke boyfriend Raj Singh ka proposal thukra deti hai, par use pata nahi hota hai ki Raj hi duniya ka sabse rich wahi invisible CEO Abhiraj Singh Rathore hai jiska chehra bhi Menka ko nahi pata. Wahin India ki ek badi company ki CEO Anamaika Gaur Raj ko 5 lakh per month par apna contract husband banne ka offer deti hai. Kya hoga jab Menka aur Anamika dono ko pata chalegi Raj ki asaliyat?

ప్రియతమా-1947-Love-Story-.title: ప్రియతమా 1947 Love Story
ప్రియతమా-1947-Love-Story-.description: కన్నీటి కెరటాల అంచున నించున్న ఒంటరి బాటసారి అతను…కంచెలు కట్టిన కోట బయట కాలంకు పోటీగా నిలబడి ఎదురు చూసే ప్రేమకారి ఆమె.!1947వ సంవత్సరంలో ఒక్క దేశం, రెండు దేశాలుగా విభజన అయినప్పుడు, ఇద్దరు ప్రేమికులు రెండు దేశస్థులు అయ్యారు. అదే సంవత్సరం మరణించాల్సిన వాళ్ళ ప్రేమ చెట్టును, జ్ఞాపకాలని నీళ్లుగా చేసి ఆ చెట్టు బ్రతికిస్తూ వచ్చారు. అలాంటి ప్రేమికులు మళ్లీ కలిసారా? దేశాలు దాటి వాళ్ళ ప్రేమకోసం ఒకటి ఎలా అయ్యారు? ఎలా వాళ్ళ ప్రేమకు మళ్లీ ప్రాణం పోసారు.

india-automated-3.title: India Automated
india-automated-3.description: 21వ శతాబ్దం భారతదేశానికి సాంకేతిక ప్రగతిలో కీలక దశగా నిలిచింది. ఆటోమేషన్ రంగంలో, దేశం అనేక విభాగాల్లో ముందడుగు వేసింది. కృత్రిమ మేధస్సు (AI), యాంత్రిక శాస్త్రం (Robotics), బిగ్ డేటా (Big Data), మరియు ఇంటర్నెట్ ఆఫ్ థింగ్స్ (IoT) వంటి ఆధునిక సాంకేతికతలతో భారతదేశం ఆర్థిక, సామాజిక మరియు పారిశ్రామిక రంగాల్లో విప్లవాత్మక మార్పులను తీసుకువచ్చింది.

khooni-silence.title: Kolai
khooni-silence.description: Jungle mein mili jali hui laash nayi recruit Madhu ke liye pehla 'dark puzzle' ban jaati hai. Har clue aur gawah jhooth bolte hain, aur ek 'shadowy face' uske aas-paas mandraata hai. Jaise-jaise investigation badhti hai, uska past aur Arjun ka naam baar-baar ubharta hai. Kya Madhu sach khoj payegi ya us game ka hissa banegi jo Arjun abhi bhi khel raha hai?

toofani-bodyguard-1.title: Toofani Bodyguard
toofani-bodyguard-1.description: ಹದಿನೈದು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ತರಬೇತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಕೃಷ್ಣನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಮಹತ್ವದ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ—ಪೃಥ್ವಿ ಜಲಾನ್ ಅನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು. ಮಾನವಕುಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಸ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ನೀಡಬಲ್ಲ ಅವಳ ಆವಿಷ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಅಪಾಯ ಎದುರಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಶತ್ರುಗಳು, ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಭೂತಕಾಲದ ಹುಡುಕಾಟದ ನಡುವೆ, ಕೃಷ್ಣ ತನ್ನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಗುರುತು ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಆರಂಭಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.

golden-boy-ki-love-story.title: Golden Boy Ki Love Story
golden-boy-ki-love-story.description: Yohan, a hidden billionaire, marries Suhana, who is forced to wed to save her inheritance. As love grows, he reveals his true identity and protects her from betrayal and danger. In the end, they overcome all odds and find happiness together.

ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires-4.title: Ultimate Hacker vs Billionaires
ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires-4.description:
A cyber attack threatens India's banking system. 50,000 crore hangs in the balance. The only man who can stop it? Vedant Nayak — a brilliant software engineer and son of a farmer driven to suicide by the very bank he's been called to save.
Humiliated, beaten, and mistaken for a thief, Vedant faces the arrogant billionaire Vikrant Hirakar — who once destroyed his family. With minutes on the clock, Vedant must choose: save his enemy's empire... or let it burn. watch now

band-baja-no-barat.title: Band Baja No Barat
band-baja-no-barat.description:
Isha , a billionaire heiress living a humble life as a flower decorator, dreams of a simple love with her boyfriend Amar. On the day he is supposed to propose, she is humiliated publicly when Aniket and his mother deny knowing her.
But the humiliation takes a shocking turn when India’s richest man, Sumer Bakshi, walks into the party and declares Isha  as his future wife.
As secrets unravel, betrayal, pride, and power collide in a dramatic confrontation that changes everyone's fate.

final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga-2.title: Neeyum Njaanum
final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga-2.description: Final Betrayal – where a humble beggar marries a dhokla vendor, only for a shocking revelation to surface later: the beggar is, in fact, a billionaire. In Season 2, the newly married couple travels to Mauritius for their honeymoon. However, their dream getaway soon turns into a nightmare as unforeseen events and dangerous secrets plunge them into chaos, testing their relationship, trust, and survival.

the-ice-queen-chose-a-delivery-guy-1.title: The Ice Queen Chose a Delivery Guy
the-ice-queen-chose-a-delivery-guy-1.description: Michael, a charismatic hustler burdened by debt and his ailing father's medical needs, finds his dangerous world colliding with executive Ashley Jones after a devastating car crash. What begins as a desperate attempt to return Ashley's lost ID quickly escalates into a brutal assault and Michael's eviction, fueling his vow for revenge against Ashley for the hit-and-run and orchestrated attacks. Supported by his loyal friend Andrew, Michael navigates tense confrontations, exposing a web of lies and a cover-up, even as his dramatic revelation as a celebrated vigilante sparks Ashley's intrigue. Despite facing relentless class-based mockery as a delivery driver, Michael strives to improve his social standing, while Ashley, also a delivery driver, secretly battles to save her critically ill father. Their paths intertwine further as Michael attempts to climb the corporate ladder, enduring humiliation but eventually rising to positions of influence, often with Ashley, now a CEO, asserting her authority to protect him. A high-stakes contract marriage is forged between CEO Ashley Jones and Michael, initially a humble delivery boy, driven by corporate stability and family expectations, immediately establishing a clear power dynamic. This union draws the ire of David Martinez, Ashley's possessive ex-suitor and corporate rival, against whom Michael harbors a deep-seated vendetta. The corporate environment escalates into ruthless power struggles, with Martinez orchestrating hostile takeovers and Michael employing calculated betrayals to consolidate his position within Ashley's company. The true depth of the conflict is revealed when Ashley is violently abducted, uncovering David Martinez's role in her father's murder and his plot to seize the Silver Crest Hotel. Amidst this chaos, Michael's secret identity as the "young master" of the powerful Miller Group is unveiled, a destiny secretly orchestrated by his immensely wealthy father, Mr. Miller. Mr. Miller dramatically intervenes, exposing Martinez as a criminal and resolving the corporate battle, leading to Martinez's arrest and Michael's takeover. Ashley is declared co-heiress of the global Miller Group empire, solidifying their combined power. With new alliances forged with Matthew and Emily, and their inner circle expanded, Michael and Ashley prepare to navigate a new era of corporate power, hinting at impending action and future challenges.

shaadi-mein-mat-aana.title: Shaadi Mein Mat Aana...
shaadi-mein-mat-aana.description: At a lavish billionaire wedding, a dignified pregnant woman, Harshita, faces humiliation from two girls who judge her by appearance. Unaware she is the sister-in-law of powerful CEO Rudra Taneja, they later meet her again at the wedding. Their past behavior returns to haunt them, leading to intense confrontations, shattered egos, and a powerful lesson that true dignity often hides behind simplicity.

gold-diggerarmaan-chibber.title: Gold Digger..Armaan Chibber
gold-diggerarmaan-chibber.description: Prachi Radhakrishnan is publicly shattered by her cheating ex, Vikram — until a stranger, Armaan Chibber, steps in as her unlikely savior… and fake fiancé. But to the world, he’s nothing more than a gold digger chasing her wealth. As Prachi fights for Kanchiloom and her dignity, trust begins to blur and emotions run dangerously deep. With Sneha and Payal plotting their downfall, one question looms — Is Armaan a fraud… or the only truth she has left? Watch now!

billionaire-khaidi.title: Billionaire Khaidi
billionaire-khaidi.description: ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయిని కాపాడాలని చేయని నేరాన్ని తన మీద వేసుకుని జైలుకు వెళ్ళాడు సిద్ధార్థ్. జైలు నుండి రిలీజ్ అయ్యాక తన లవర్ ఇందు అసలు రంగు బయటపడింది. అప్పుడే అతని జీవితం అవంతి రాకతో కొత్త మలుపు తిరిగింది. బిలియనీర్ అయిన సిద్ధార్థ్ ని ఇందు ఎందుకు వద్దనుకుంది. ఆసక్తికరమైన మలుపులతో సాగిపోయే కథ "బిలియనీర్ ఖైదీ"

dil-ka-encounter.title: Dil Ka Encounter
dil-ka-encounter.description: Dil Ka Encounter follows Ishaan Raghuvanshi, a haunted ex-sniper, and Sara Khanna, a billionaire’s daughter turned cadet after a life-changing rescue. Under a hidden identity, Sara joins a Special Forces academy—only to meet Ishaan, now broken and in hiding. As deception, rivalry, and power games unfold, a dangerous bond forms between them. This isn’t just action—it’s a battle between love and duty, past and redemption. Will Ishaan rise again… or lose everything once more? Watch now!

my-billion-dollar-comeback.title: My Billion Dollar Comeback
my-billion-dollar-comeback.description:
A rich businessman is betrayed by his own family.
The boy he once helped returns as a powerful CEO.
They team up to take revenge.
This time, they want everything back.

billionaire-bhikshuka-1.title: Billionaire Bhikshuka
billionaire-bhikshuka-1.description: ಸರಳ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ರಾಜ್‌ ತನ್ನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಗುರುತನ್ನು—ಒಬ್ಬ ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ಕೋಟ್ಯಧಿಪತಿ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು—ಮರೆಮಾಚಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ತನ್ನ ಹೆಂಡತಿ ಲತಿಕಾದ ಯಶಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಮೌನವಾಗಿ ಬೆಂಬಲ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾ ಅವಮಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಸಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅಹಂಕಾರ, ದ್ರೋಹ ಮತ್ತು ತಪ್ಪು ಅರ್ಥಗಳು ಅವರ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಮುರಿಯುವ ಮಟ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ.

5-star-kismat.title: 5 Star Kismat
5-star-kismat.description:
A bloodied stranger… and a love story lost in time. Seven years later, Kavya struggles as a single mother, unaware her past is tied to a powerful empire. Devansh, a wealthy tycoon with no memory, is actually her husband and the father of her children. As truth surfaces, will love reunite them or destroy everything? Fate’s twisted game is about to explode!

Watch Now!

billionaire-on-plane-5.title: Billionaire on Plane
billionaire-on-plane-5.description: A billionaire airline owner boards his own flight in disguise as a cleaner. While most ignore him, one air hostess shows unexpected kindness, unaware of who he really is. A sudden twist brings them closer, leading to a fake relationship that starts to feel all too real.

my-intern.title: My Intern
my-intern.description: The series introduces Meher, a brilliant intern, whose life becomes entangled with the powerful CEO Vikram Malhotra and his corporate empire. She is drawn into an arranged engagement with Honey, Vikram's son, a union orchestrated by Vikram's politically ambitious wife, Ria Malhotra (also known as Sheila, Priya, and Shalini), who leverages Meher's humble background for political gain. Meher faces intense class conflict and emotional abuse from Ria, who attempts to transform her to fit their elite world. Amidst this, Meher develops an unexpected connection with Vikram, sparked by his accidental breaking and subsequent repair of her sentimental bracelet. Vikram confides in Meher about his loveless "political" marriage to Ria, revealing his own loneliness and past heartbreak, and subtly undermining Meher's relationship with Honey. Meher faces professional sabotage and accusations at work, while Aryan (also referred to as Sanjay), a mysterious protector and later revealed powerful CEO, intervenes to save her from harassment and liberates her from an oppressive living situation, blurring the lines between romance and ruthless ambition. Despite her engagement, Meher and Vikram are accidentally confined together, transforming their animosity into charged romantic tension. This leads Vikram to decide to pursue a forbidden second chance at love with Meher, risking everything. Honey, Meher's fiancé, expresses disdain for her and their impending marriage, as his family continues to use Meher as a political prop for election campaigns. Meher's clandestine relationship with Vikram, her fiancé Honey's father, is exposed, leading to public humiliation and the shattering of her forced union with Honey. Matriarchs like Ria Malhotra ruthlessly manipulate these family scandals for political advantage, while Meher grapples with betrayal and public attack. Vikram faces public shaming, corporate termination amidst financial scandal and affair accusations, and is served divorce papers by his vengeful wife, Ria. Despite his downfall, Vikram fiercely protects Meher from the possessive Honey, intensifying their complex romantic tension. The series concludes with Ria Malhotra's re-election victory, causing dread for others who fear her perceived tyranny and decide to abandon their lives to escape her influence, leaving Meher's future uncertain amidst a web of deceit and power struggles.

rocket-raja.title: Rocket Raja
rocket-raja.description: Aditya, a brilliant ex-rocket engineer leading a double life as a powerful businessman, faces immediate threats to his hidden empire and his very existence. Diagnosed with a fabricated terminal illness, he is betrayed by his ex-lover Jiya and ruthless boss Manoj, who seek to exploit his perceived weakness and unpaid bonuses. However, Aditya meticulously orchestrates a complex plan for revenge, using his feigned illness to expose his enemies and reclaim his legacy. He forms a strategic corporate alliance and, under the aliases "Aadhi" or "Surya," publicly humiliates his arrogant rival Prakash, who attempts to bribe for his son's award and discredit Aditya's daughter, Kavya. With the secret assistance of Prakash's wife, Meenakshi, the true CEO, Aditya orchestrates massive financial transfers, setting the stage for a high-stakes battle for corporate control and family honor. This conflict intensifies with Surya's colossal donation from Meenakshi's company, sparking accusations and challenging his marriage, while Prakash claims Meenakshi as his wife and accuses her of betrayal concerning their shared offspring, Aditya. Kavya's patented invention is destroyed by Prakash's son, leading to demands for compensation and strategic control. Meenakshi, a powerful matriarch, navigates these disputes, her scandalous past exposed, forcing her to make difficult choices and publicly disown Kavya under duress. Kavya's career is further shattered by public accusations of patent theft from rivals Surya and Prakash, despite government validation, leading to legal action and public shaming. A mysterious figure, Sathya, dramatically intervenes, claiming Kavya as his daughter, while Meenakshi's past corporate fraud and alleged infidelity are revealed, leading to a confrontation with Aditya. Vijay, initially accused of treason, emerges with a meticulously orchestrated 15-year revenge plot against Meenakshi, who seized control of Aditya's company through fraud. Aditya, stripped of his empire, plots Meenakshi's downfall, exposing her massive financial fraud and a foundational lie about saving him years ago, culminating in a dramatic car crash. Finally, Aditya's tumultuous personal life unravels as his marriage to Vijaya is exposed for manipulative motives, and his marriage to Meenakshi ends in a bitter divorce due to her double life and corporate forgeries. Amidst this, Vijaya, having been betrayed, finds a second chance at love with Aditya, who realizes her long-held devotion, setting the stage for future confrontations.

rakshakan-the-shadow-bodyguard.title: Rakshakan: The Shadow Bodyguard
rakshakan-the-shadow-bodyguard.description: Krishna, a mysterious kickboxing specialist and a shadow warrior, with a forgotten past, becomes the protector of Veda Sreekanth, a brilliant pharma CEO who has discovered a cancer cure. As they navigate their intertwined destinies, they uncover a love story and a decades-old vendetta that have bound them long before fate brought them together.

too-much-mr-husband.title: Too much, Mr Husband
too-much-mr-husband.description: A mysterious truck driver with a hidden past crosses paths with a runaway bride, leading to a one-night encounter that binds them forever, years later, when she returns with a daughter claiming him as the father, their lives collide again amid dangerous enemies, family conspiracies

the-billionaire-father-in-laws-revenge.title: The Billionaire Father-in-Law's Revenge
the-billionaire-father-in-laws-revenge.description: Ruhi traps a rich heir, pretending to be innocent while secretly cheating on him. When she humiliates an old man at a car showroom—beating him, insulting him, and burning his wife’s last photograph—she doesn’t realize he is Rajat Singhania, the billionaire founder and her fiancé’s father. Now the insulted tycoon plans a brutal revenge, determined to expose her truth and destroy her in front of the entire city.

final-breakup.title: Final Breakup
final-breakup.description: Ashish, a billionaire's son living undercover, discovers his girlfriend Richa has been using him as a substitute for her ex, Jay. Silently enduring her betrayal and humiliation, he walks away. Two years later, their paths collide at a conference — where Jay is fired, Richa publicly confesses her love, and Naina, who always believed in Ashish, stands by his side. A story of love lost, dignity reclaimed, and the cost of taking someone for granted.

aa-iddari-madhya.title: Aa Iddari Madhya
aa-iddari-madhya.description: ఒకరి మీద ఎంత ప్రేమ ఉన్నా మరొకరి మీద మోహం పుట్టుకురావడం సహజం. విపరీతమైన ప్రేమనీ, అదిమి పెట్టలేని మోహాన్ని మోస్తూ జీవితాన్ని ఎలా ముందుకు తీసుకెళ్ళాలో తెలియని యువకుడి కథ.. ఆ ఇద్దరి మధ్య

warrior-arjun.title: Warrior Arjun
warrior-arjun.description: After faking his disappearance from the Chandravamsham army, the legendary archer Arjun lives in disguise as a humble servant to fulfil his dying guru’s last wish , protecting his guru’s daughter and granddaughter. But when greed, betrayal, and deadly warriors threaten to destroy the Gurukul, Arjun must decide whether to remain hidden… or rise again as an unstoppable warrior.

mujhe-meri-ceo-se-bachao.title: Yes Boss, No Boss
mujhe-meri-ceo-se-bachao.description: Ambitious CEO Elina Sen strikes a dangerous deal—to tame reckless heir Ranveer Khanna in exchange for power. But beneath boardroom battles and fiery attraction lies her hidden agenda: revenge against his brother Vikram, the man who destroyed her past. As love, manipulation, and betrayal collide, Elina risks losing everything—including her heart to the love-child with a heart of gold Ranveer. Watch Now

rocketwala-billionaire-1.title: Rocketwala Billionaire
rocketwala-billionaire-1.description: ಹಣ, ದ್ರೋಹ ಮತ್ತು ಅಹಂಕಾರದ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಸಾಗುವ ಈ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಒಬ್ಬ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ತನ್ನ ಸತ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನಂಬಿಕೆ ತುಂಡಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಮುಖವಾಡಗಳು ತೆಗೆಯಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತವೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮವಾಗಿ ನಿಜವಾದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಹಣದಲ್ಲಲ್ಲ, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಸಾಬೀತಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

aashiqui-tum-se-hi.title: Aashiqui Tum Se Hi
aashiqui-tum-se-hi.description: After secretly donating a kidney to save the ungrateful woman he loves, a world-class chef hiding in plain sight as a lowly secretary must rise to global fame while enduring the ultimate betrayal—only to discover that his redemption comes with a heartbreaking final sacrifice.

putri-yang-terbuang.title: Putri Yang Terbuang
putri-yang-terbuang.description: The series begins with a tragic baby swap orchestrated to conceal a medical error, setting in motion a complex web of hidden identities and family secrets. Grace, guided by a mysterious birthmark, embarks on a quest to uncover her true parentage, while Alin faces false accusations and a shocking blood type discrepancy, prompting her patriarch, Ayah, to investigate her origins. Both Grace and Gibran endure public humiliation and physical assault, highlighting themes of class conflict and injustice. Grace is repeatedly framed and shamed, often due to a mysterious allergy, and her child, Luna, suffers a life-threatening allergic reaction, leading to a desperate father's pleas and an unexpected intervention. Bastian emerges as a protector, aiding Grace with her illness and secretly investigating her past, suspecting a shared condition. As the narrative unfolds, DNA results reveal Alin's true parentage, exposing a long-held family secret and a mother disguised as a maid watching her stolen child. Concurrently, Pak Wijaya initiates a secret investigation into Grace, suspecting she is his daughter due to a hereditary allergy, only to uncover the devastating truth that his infant died during childbirth, though an enigmatic man claims the child was alive. The desperate search for lost children intensifies as Tuan discovers his newborn was swapped with Alin, and Alvito realizes Grace could be his long-lost child due to a shared date and birthmark. Grace's CEO, Farel, also suspects a familial connection and protects her, while she faces brutal torment from Alya and the vengeful jealousy of Aline. Grace is accused of corporate sabotage and blackmailed by a ruthless executive and Maya, the patriarch's daughter, but Pak Wijaya saves her, declaring possessive ownership. Further revelations expose Nona/Alin's true biological mother as her maid, Bi/Maya, leading to vehement denial and an identity crisis. The series culminates in Grace's world being shattered by her mother's murder, orchestrated by Ruby and Albi, fueling her quest for vengeance. A DNA link miraculously reunites Grace with Chris, her long-lost father and Julian's father, though she struggles with reconciliation, clinging to her mother's memory. The show concludes with Grace's departure, driven by longing for her mother, and a dying young woman calling out to two distinct father figures, "Ayah" and "Papa," hinting at profound, unresolved family secrets.

secret-kitchen-king.title: Secret Kitchen King
secret-kitchen-king.description: At the peak of his fame, world-renowned chef Armaan Kapoor : the “Kitchen King” , suddenly disappears, leaving the culinary world in shock. Years later, a quiet kitchen boy named Mannu works in a struggling restaurant where no one respects him. But behind his humble identity lies extraordinary culinary mastery. As betrayal, family rivalry, and a ruthless cooking challenge threaten everything, a shocking truth begins to unfold, the missing Kitchen King may have been hiding in plain sight.

kneel-before-your-son-in-law.title: Kneel Before Your Son-in-Law
kneel-before-your-son-in-law.description: மாமியாரால் கொடுமை செய்யப்படும் மாப்பிள்ளை சூரியா . தன் உண்மை முகத்தை காட்டாமல் தன் மனைவி மாயா,  குழந்தைக்காக அடங்கி செல்கிறான் .  அனால் அந்த பொறுமைக்கு பின்னால் ஒரு பயங்கரமான , இந்த நாட்டையே ஆளும் ஒரு அசுர முகம் உள்ளது  . அவன் யார் என்ற உண்மை வெளி வருமா ? தொடர்ந்து அந்த கொடுமைகளை அனுபவிப்பானா சூரியா . காணுங்கள் !!!

daulat-ki-taaqat.title: Daulat ki Taaqat
daulat-ki-taaqat.description: A misunderstanding turns violent when a man is mistaken for a stalker, only to reveal he’s a grieving father searching for his long-lost daughter, Naina. Years later, now a powerful yet secretive tycoon, he continues his search while battling betrayal, crime, and deception. As destinies collide, a lost daughter rises unknowingly close to him, facing love, betrayal, and identity. Watch now.

billionaire-hotel-servant-1.title: 5 star Hotel-er Billionaire Chakor
billionaire-hotel-servant-1.description:
A hidden billionaire heir must live as a hotel servant for four days to prove his worth.
Humiliated, betrayed, and pushed to the edge, he fights back while uncovering dark secrets.
But when the truth is revealed, the servant rises as CEO, and everyone who doubted him falls.

bechare-raja-sahab.title: Bechare Raja Sahab
bechare-raja-sahab.description: The microdrama centers on Raj, a man of hidden royal lineage and immense wealth, who initially faces public humiliation and a bitter divorce from his wife, Latika. His journey begins with a classist denial of kindergarten entry for his daughter, Ruhi, prompting him to reveal his underlying power by canceling investments and ordering expulsions. It is soon uncovered that his marriage to Latika was a forced union, orchestrated by her manipulative mother, Asha, who drugged him. Latika, influenced by Asha, pursues a high-stakes corporate career and a lucrative remarriage to Shravan Rajput, dismissing Raj as bankrupt and a liar. Raj fiercely battles for Ruhi's custody, while his former fiancée, Princess Ragini, returns to publicly defend him and declare herself his fiancée, adding layers to his concealed identity. As Prince Singhai/Aditya, Raj strategically orchestrates Ruhi's lavish birthday to reclaim his empire from usurpers Gagan and Roma, with Ruhi demonstrating unwavering loyalty. He confronts the

keshav-child-king-returns-2.title: Keshav: Child King Returns
keshav-child-king-returns-2.description: A thousand-year-old prince, Keshav Supreme, awakens in the body of a modern 6-year-old child. Uncertain whether this is fate or a conspiracy, he navigates the dark politics of the Supreme family, using his sharp mind to disrupt the status quo. The question remains: can a child alter his entire destiny?

final-boss-2.title: Crazy Boss
final-boss-2.description: A mysterious billionaire returns to India in disguise to reunite with his first love—only to be humiliated and rejected for his apparent poverty. As fate pushes him into a powerful alliance with a fearless CEO, hidden identities unravel and a brutal game of power, pride, and revenge begins. When the truth explodes, the man everyone mocked turns out to be the one who controls everything.

secret-grandmaster.title: Secret Grandmaster
secret-grandmaster.description: A fearless martial arts master lives as a beggar, hiding his legendary past. When love and honor drag him back into the fighting world, enemies rise and secrets explode. Betrayal, destiny, and raw power collide as he reclaims his true identity as the Grandmaster.

meri-broken-family.title: Meri Broken Family
meri-broken-family.description: Karthik's journey begins with a profound betrayal when his girlfriend, Sara, is revealed to be secretly married for a green card, facing deportation and extortion. Despite her subsequent cruel rejection of his Indian heritage, Karthik selflessly dedicates himself to saving her, even orchestrating a complex corporate maneuver to secure the necessary funds. Years later, Karthik, now a wealthy and influential businessman, renames his company 'Swadesh International' to honor his roots, and his daughter, Simran, emerges as a brilliant innovator. However, their family faces renewed challenges from the arrogant and prejudiced couple, Amy and Gary, who attempt to undermine Simran's achievements through bribery and xenophobia. It is then revealed that Amy, also known as Gita Ma'am or Geeta, is Karthik's wife and Simran's mother, living a secret double life with Gary and their son, Emmy. Geeta, a powerful matriarch, is driven by ambition for Emmy, leading her to infringe on Simran's design patent and publicly disavow her own daughter, accusing her of fraud and attempting to have her blacklisted and deported. Karthik dramatically intervenes to defend Simran, exposing Geeta's deep-seated deceit, her elaborate double life, and her massive corporate fraud, leading to the collapse of their marriage. A pivotal moment occurs when Hina reveals she, not Geeta, was Karthik's true savior two decades prior, shattering Geeta's long-held deception. Karthik meticulously orchestrates Geeta's downfall, leading to her arrest for financial transgressions and the collapse of her empire. Amidst this, Karthik rekindles a long-lost romance with Hina, who had harbored unrequited love for him for years. The show explores the high stakes of Simran's career and identity, Karthik's legacy, and the profound consequences of betrayal, ambition, and the pursuit of justice against a backdrop of corporate intrigue and family secrets.

heartbreak-to-billionaire-1.title: Heartbreak to Billionaire
heartbreak-to-billionaire-1.description: After being dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, struggling techie Aditya impulsively marries a stranger, Preeti, unaware she is a billionaire CEO. What begins as a deal-driven marriage turns explosive when Aditya is revealed to be the long-lost heir of a powerful business family, and the very man who humiliated him becomes his rival. As love, identity, and ambition collide, Aditya must choose between revenge, legacy, and the woman who believed in him first.

married-to-a-village-billionaire.title: Married To A Village Billionaire
married-to-a-village-billionaire.description: A humble man who appears to be a simple egg seller but is secretly a trillionaire with immense power. After being mistreated and falsely accused by a wealthy socialite, he is saved by Vidya, a delivery girl who is also a widow facing abuse from her own greedy in-laws . Their lives intertwine when they are forced into an arranged marriage

love-ki-adaalat.title: Love ki Adaalat
love-ki-adaalat.description: The series begins with Shubham, a formidable lawyer, secretly orchestrating his ambitious wife Tanvi's career while concealing his own powerful past. Their meticulously built world collapses when Tanvi's assistant, Danny, reveals his romantic feelings for her, leading Shubham to discover their affair. Tanvi brutally humiliates Shubham, asserting sole ownership of their home and dismissing him, while Danny boasts of their long-term relationship and a shocking paternity dispute arises over Tanvi's child. Humiliated and betrayed, Shubham vows chilling revenge, only to become the target of a sinister plot by Tanvi and Danny, culminating in a severe car accident where he is presumed dead. Manipulated by Vaishali, Shubham makes a dramatic comeback as the "King of Court," now known as Shubh, initiating a high-stakes legal battle against Tanvi for divorce and accusing her of attempted murder. He challenges her professional integrity, revealing his instrumental role in her past successes to reclaim his legacy and expose a dangerous conspiracy. Shubham dramatically re-enters Cora Associates, asserting his claim as the true founder and "Big Boss," publicly humiliating Tanvi during a corporate signing. He orchestrates a merger, purges key personnel, and faces accusations of fraud and being an imposter, with the central conflict revolving around a locked vault containing crucial founding documents. Shubham successfully opens the vault, solidifying his claim as a founding partner and majority shareholder, and presents a long-time employee, Naren, as a key witness to the company's origins. His legitimacy is fiercely challenged by Manish, who orchestrates elaborate schemes of betrayal, but Shubham exposes Manish's fraud, leading to his public downfall. Amidst this, Tanvi seeks reconciliation but is coldly rejected, while another ex-wife, Shraddha, defiantly refuses to accept their divorce, creating tension with Shubham's new partner, Divya. Further complications arise as Shubham's scorned wife, Denni, exposes his concealed identity, corporate betrayals, and an affair, while Radha also battles for her child's legitimacy against his denial. Danny, previously believed dead, resurfaces, incarcerated, and is forced to choose between testifying against Tanvi or facing her deadly machinations. Shubham dramatically accuses Tanvi and Mr. Kalra of massive financial fraud, revealing a medical certificate proving her unborn child belongs to Mr. Kalra. The series culminates with Shubham successfully turning the tables on Tanvi in court, demanding colossal compensation for his trauma, and publicly proposing to Vaishali, solidifying a new alliance amidst the chaos.

keshav-child-king-returns-1.title: Keshav Child King Returns
keshav-child-king-returns-1.description: A millennium ago, Prince Keshav is mysteriously propelled into the modern era, resurfacing as the long-lost heir to the powerful Rajhans family. Initially, he faces scorn and rejection from his new family, who favor the adopted son, Rudra, and dismiss him as a "country bumpkin." Despite this, Keshav, supported by his wise grandmother Paattima/Gayatri, begins to assert his ancestral claim, proving his lineage through ancient calligraphy and profound knowledge of artifacts. His unique talents earn him control of the Luxury Lipstick Division, sparking intense corporate and family power struggles. Keshav's ruthless efficiency and defiance lead to dramatic confrontations with executives and relatives like Bunty and Sudhir, who conspire to sabotage his ventures. Amidst these internal battles, a terrifying supernatural force erupts, and a ruthless outsider declares intent to seize the family's assets, hinting at a larger, looming threat. The matriarch, Gayatri, strategically redistributes corporate shares, making Keshav the largest shareholder, but faces kidnapping and poisoning attempts orchestrated by her biological son, Sudhir. It is revealed that Rudhran is Sudhir's illegitimate son, and Rudhran's biological mother reappears, seeking revenge against Gayatri. Keshav is ultimately revealed to be the reincarnation of an ancient prince and rightful heir, possibly a Moon Clan Crown Prince, awakening ancient warrior descendants. Driven by a fierce desire for justice and vengeance, Keshav orchestrates the downfall of his biological father and other betrayers, leading to their arrest. He formally disowns his father and offers his former tormentors a path to redemption through a return to humble village life. Keshav plans to dismantle the perceived corrupt system associated with his father's lineage and establish a new family and legacy, aligning with a powerful alliance to create a new order.

mrs-golddigger.title: Mrs. Golddigger
mrs-golddigger.description: Aysha, an independent woman, initially saves Dadu, leading to her arranged marriage with his grandson, CEO Ishaan, a union she accepts to reclaim her family home. Entering Ishaan's wealthy family with a secret agenda, Aysha begins working as a cleaner at his company, Myntra, where she faces humiliation from chief designer Tanya, who is unaware of Aysha's true identity. Ishaan, initially suspicious, publicly protects Aysha, revealing their hidden marital bond, which creates tension and fuels office gossip, especially due to Tanya's unrequited love for him. As Aysha's past as an expelled design student is exposed by her ex-boyfriend Sunny, she rises from cleaner to chief designer, winning a prestigious competition and rejecting a lucrative offer out of loyalty to Ishaan. This promotion accidentally exposes their clandestine marriage, intensifying Tanya's rivalry and dangerous schemes. Amidst this, Aysha's unexpected pregnancy leads to public humiliation and physical assaults, but Ishaan dramatically intervenes, publicly declaring their union and his unwavering commitment to her and their unborn child. Ishaan becomes increasingly drawn to Aisha, forgetting a past love, and secretly helps her save her ancestral home. Tanya, Ishaan's ex-fiancée, relentlessly schemes to separate them, framing Aisha's father and manipulating an amnesiac Ishaan into believing she saved his life years ago. However, CCTV footage ultimately reveals Aisha as Ishaan's true rescuer, leading to Tanya's arrest and Ishaan's mother's full acceptance of Aisha into the Rathore family, culminating in plans for a grand wedding that solidifies their love and family.

first-class-billionaire.title: First Class Billionaire
first-class-billionaire.description: Jagadish, the 50-year-old widowed owner of Aira Airlines, disguises himself as a ground crew worker and books a first-class ticket to secretly test his airline's service. When an air hostess judges his appearance and humiliates him by forcing him to the economy cabin, kind-hearted air hostess Nethra steps forward and defends him with grace and dignity. Now Jagadish must silently navigate the chaos, protect his identity, and teach them a lesson

love-on-lease.title: Love on Lease
love-on-lease.description: The series opens with individuals navigating complex paths to secure legacies and happiness, often through marriages of convenience. Heiress Amani battles her step-sister and uncle for control of her mother's company, leading her to propose a contract marriage with CEO Viraaj. Simultaneously, Arjun enters a secret, pretend marriage with Ananya to secure a family project, facing fierce opposition from her powerful father due to his humble background. Arjun's character is initially clouded by deception, including using counterfeit items, leading to public humiliation by rivals. Accusations of theft and fraud test Arjun's marriage to Ananya, who fiercely defends him against figures from her past. Arjun eventually reveals his immense, concealed wealth, explaining it was a test of Ananya's genuine love, leading him to publicly reject their contract marriage and propose a future based on authentic love. A violent antagonist, Rakesh, emerges, threatening Ananya and orchestrating a violent separation of the couple. Rakesh forces Ananya into an unwanted marriage, takes over her family's company, and confesses to murdering Arjun's parent, escalating their conflict into a deeply personal vendetta. Arjun, after being captured and replaced by an imposter, escapes and devises a plan to expose Rakesh's massive corporate fraud. Amidst corporate betrayals and his father's stress-induced heart attack, Arjun, supported by Ananya, works to reclaim his family's empire from internal treachery. A manipulative Sumathi is exposed as a murderer and disowned by patriarch Rao, who embraces Ananya and Arjun as his true family. The conflict culminates as CEO Rajiv exposes Rakesh's corruption, leading to Rakesh's arrest. However, Rakesh escapes, taking Ananya hostage and critically wounding her in a violent confrontation. Ananya's near-death experience solidifies her profound love for Arjun, transforming their initial contract marriage into a genuine, unconditional union built on mutual commitment. Ultimately, the couple overcomes betrayals, corporate espionage, and personal vendettas to secure their love and legacy.

chak-de-champion.title: Chak De Champion
chak-de-champion.description: Yash, a talented but poor cricketer, struggles against class bias, betrayal, and a cruel system that favors the rich. Framed, humiliated, and nearly destroyed by Hardy and his allies, he fights back with resilience and truth. As secrets unravel, Yash is revealed as the true heir of the Rawat family, reclaiming his identity, dignity, and place in cricket.

return-of-the-missing-master-chef.title: Return of the Missing Master Chef

my-wife-behind-bars.title: My Wife Behind Bars
my-wife-behind-bars.description: A powerful tech tycoon’s life shatters when an unknown girl claims to be his daughter… and the truth hits—his ex-lover, the mother of his child, is behind bars.

he-died-unwanted-came-back-rich.title: He Died Unwanted, Came Back Rich
he-died-unwanted-came-back-rich.description: Framed and exiled, an adopted son returns to face a family that neglected him for years. Despite a severe heart condition, he rises to become a billionaire CEO, demanding a "family severance agreement." But a shocking truth about his birth and a vengeful biological mother unravels, while his adopted brother's betrayal escalates into a dangerous corporate war, leaving him to fight for justice and find his true family amidst lingering threats.

mission-admission.title: Mission Admission
mission-admission.description: A billionaire father, Sudeep Sahani, disguises himself as a poor man to protect his daughter from humiliation in an elite school. As class prejudice, betrayal, and greed unfold, his ex-wife Anjana and her partner Tony try to exploit him. Sudeep exposes their truth, fights injustice, and challenges the system with his mission of equal education for all. Watch now.

190-minutes-before-the-billionaire-dies.title: 190 Minutes Before The Billionaire Dies
190-minutes-before-the-billionaire-dies.description: Railway Minister Narendra Jha survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant in Patna. With flights grounded, the only hope is Dr. Nihal Mathur - brilliant, controversial, and just reinstated. He has 190 minutes to transport the donor heart and save the Minister. But the mission spirals when socialite Kamya Tiwari, her hot-headed brother Sunny, and her fiancé Kabir Jha sabotage his path with ego and revenge. Every delay pushes the clock closer to death. Watch now!

sorry-not-a-gold-digger-7.title: Sorry! Not a Gold Digger
sorry-not-a-gold-digger-7.description: When hardworking delivery girl Tara crosses paths with billionaire heir Rohan Mehta through a twist of fate, their unexpected flash marriage sparks a journey filled with secrets, clashes, and unspoken love. As Tara struggles to protect her dignity and dreams, and Rohan hides his true identity, will this unlikely union blossom into real love or collapse under lies and pride? Watch Now!

cab-wala-crorepati.title: Cab wala Crorepati
cab-wala-crorepati.description: A humble Mumbai cab driver, Vijay Pratap Singh, is publicly humiliated by Mumbai's elite at a luxury society auction — until they discover he is secretly a powerful billionaire. Hidden for 18 years to protect his son Samar and avenge his wife's murder, Vijay finally confronts the ruthless mafia kingpin Keshav Khanna, dismantling his empire and delivering long-awaited justice. Watch now.

at-30-i-have-a-lot-of-pocket-money-3.title: At 30, I Have a lot of Pocket Money
at-30-i-have-a-lot-of-pocket-money-3.description:
A spoiled rich heir lives a carefree life at 30, still relying on generous pocket money from his powerful family.
But when his wealth is suddenly cut off, he’s forced to face the real world for the first time.

masked-millionaire.title: Masked Millionaire
masked-millionaire.description: A humble street vendor’s life turns into a nightmare when powerful enemies humiliate him, threaten his mother, and tear apart his love. But unknown to all, he carries a hidden identity that could shake the entire power structure. As injustice rises, his transformation from helpless to unstoppable begins.

ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires-3.title: Hacker Raja - The Digital King
ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires-3.description:
A cyber attack threatens India's banking system. 50,000 crore hangs in the balance. The only man who can stop it? Vedant Nayak — a brilliant software engineer and son of a farmer driven to suicide by the very bank he's been called to save.
Humiliated, beaten, and mistaken for a thief, Vedant faces the arrogant billionaire Vikrant Hirakar — who once destroyed his family. With minutes on the clock, Vedant must choose: save his enemy's empire... or let it burn. watch now

final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga-1.title: Honeymoon er Antaraale
final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga-1.description: Final Betrayal – Season 2 continues the gripping saga from Season 1, where a humble beggar marries a dhokla vendor, only for a shocking revelation to surface later: the beggar is, in fact, a billionaire. In Season 2, the newly married couple travels to Mauritius for their honeymoon. However, their dream getaway soon turns into a nightmare as unforeseen events and dangerous secrets plunge them into chaos, testing their relationship, trust, and survival.

badla-6.title: Badla
badla-6.description: Publicly humiliated and thrown out as a useless employee, Prithvi hides a shocking truth—he is the real force behind the empire that rejected him. After years of silent sacrifice for love, betrayal turns him ruthless. As he reveals his true identity, he doesn’t fight back—he destroys everything. Now, the woman who insulted him must face the man who can erase her world.

limit-crossed.title: Limit Crossed
limit-crossed.description: The microdrama centers on Aishwarya's tumultuous journey from betrayal to self-assertion and a complex quest for love and family. Initially, Aishwarya's opulent life shatters upon discovering her husband's infidelity and her children's dismissal, prompting her defiant departure for independence. She accepts a mysterious contract marriage proposal from Angad, an enigmatic businessman driven by family secrets. A violent car crash leaves Aishwarya's fate unknown to Angad, who, now known as Sameer, embarks on a year-long search for his wife, eventually recognizing Megha. During this period, Aishwarya adopts various identities, enduring relentless workplace abuse as Avika and facing public condemnation and physical assault as Radha for her choices. She is also accused of theft and immorality as MA, and publicly shamed as Rishika, consistently battling societal expectations and patriarchal norms. Aishwarya defiantly refuses her estranged husband's demand for a humiliating apology, asserting her self-respect and exposing his profound marital betrayal. Her path intertwines with Aditya, a powerful CEO, who initially seeks a fake wife to deceive his adopted daughter, Saira, leading to a complicated contractual marriage. This relationship is fraught with public humiliation, accusations of infidelity, and vehement opposition from Daddu, who reveals Aishwarya's past as his ex-girlfriend. Angad, believing Aishwarya to be his mother, also confronts her amidst the unfolding truths, further complicating her journey. Despite the turmoil, Aditya confesses his deep love for Aishwarya, apologizing for her past troubles and pleading for a second chance. Their journey culminates in a dramatic wedding where Aditya's father publicly shames Aishwarya with incriminating photos. Aditya fiercely defends Aishwarya, confronting and exposing his father's dark past of harassment and attempted rape. He then marries Aishwarya, publicly challenging societal norms and demanding his parents' reconciliation to mend his fractured family. The series explores the profound struggles of women challenging patriarchal norms and societal expectations in modern India, highlighting themes of resilience, identity, and the pursuit of dignity.
