reel-vs-real.title: Reel V/S Real
reel-vs-real.description: Veera, a devoted villager, arrives in Bengaluru on a desperate quest to find his lost wife, Priya, armed only with a sacred wedding necklace and unwavering faith. He faces the city's harsh realities, only to discover his wife is "Lady Superstar Priya," a famous celebrity who insists their marriage was merely a film scene. Despite her attempts to explain the difference between "reel" and "real," Veera's naive understanding leaves him heartbroken but steadfast, leading to confrontations with her security. A senior figure, Anand, intervenes to protect Veera, while a Swamiji hints at Priya's mysterious identity. Veera is later reluctantly drawn into a "fake" wedding scene for a film, where he accidentally binds himself to junior artist Priya Hegde with a sacred thaali, believing her to be his destined wife, fulfilling a vow to his dying mother. This accidental marriage catches the attention of powerful CEO RK, a manipulative figure with a hidden agenda, who hires Veera only to demote and humiliate him as a pawn in his corporate war against director Anand. As a housekeeper, Veera uncovers a matriarch's sinister plot to seize heiress Priya's estate, while RK faces pressure from his girlfriend Priya and a ruthless ultimatum from his fiancée Aliya, who threatens Priya. A deeper conspiracy unfolds, revealing Maya Devi and RK's plot to deceive Priya for her property. Veteran director Anand, publicly humiliated by RK, manipulates aspiring actor Veera to channel his rage, transforming him into a formidable force to replace RK as the lead in a new project. Influential Priya champions Veera, risking her fortune, drawing on her past success in launching RK's career, while her wealthy ex, Abhi, attempts to sabotage their project. Veera's mysterious past and extraordinary survival skills are revealed when he saves actress Priya from a deadly snake bite, sparking an investigation into his identity and intensifying his rivalry with RK. Investigator Veera ultimately uncovers that superstar CEO RK's energy drink is secretly laced with cocaine, designed to addict the nation's youth for profit. Director Anand and Maya launch a daring public broadcast to expose RK's vast drug operation and a deep-rooted political-criminal nexus, with Maya also unveiling a shocking family betrayal. Amidst this turmoil, superstars Veera and Priya find love and get engaged, hinting at complex personal histories and the lingering weight of secrets.

meri-sanaki-dulhaniya.title: Meri Sanki Dulhaniya
meri-sanaki-dulhaniya.description: A ruthless businesswoman, Sheetal, humiliates her employee Raj, unaware he’s a powerful tycoon in disguise. As ego clashes turn into a toxic marriage, Raj silently endures her cruelty while protecting her and her company from hidden threats. Amid revenge, power games, and emotional turmoil, hatred slowly transforms into love and redemption.

rocket-tycoon.title: Rocket Tycoon
rocket-tycoon.description: A man learns a woman has last-stage lung cancer and needs treatment within three days. A misunderstanding makes her think he is the patient, leading her to panic over money, insult him, and end the relationship. After a time jump, a young scientist wins a major award, but a powerful businessman and his son disrupt the ceremony, forcing the man to intervene and assert his influence.

hero-heroine-aur-hungama.title: Hero Heroine aur Hungama
hero-heroine-aur-hungama.description: Summary: Kartik is a movie superstar who feels that this movie world is fake, and decides to retire from it. On the other hand, a humble writer Alisha writes a story and puts the condition to the Producer that she will act as the Heroine in this film. Alisha becomes Kartik’s fake girlfriend, and later they actually fall in love. After more complications, emotions and “hungama”, our hero and heroine finally come together.

tea-stall-to-marriage-hall-1.title: Tea Stall To Marriage Hall
tea-stall-to-marriage-hall-1.description: A billionaire CEO disguises himself as a humble tea seller to stay close to the woman he has loved since his teenage years. When she runs away from a forced marriage, fate brings them into a contract marriage built on secrets and unexpected romance. But as truth and family conflicts surface, he must decide whether to reveal who he really is or risk losing her forever.

jamai-raja-amar-rahe.title: Jamai Raja Amar Rahe
jamai-raja-amar-rahe.description: A dying patriarch & devotee of Annapurna Devi, forces Siddhi into a three-year contract marriage with Amar—a quiet cook with a hidden identity as an Immortal Gandharva. He silently protects her—saving her family and securing her success. When Siddhi trusts the wrong man, Amar is forced to reveal his power. Still blind, she demands a divorce. This time, Amar agrees. As the truth unravels, Siddhi realizes too late—she may have pushed away the one man who was holding her entire world together.

don-in-class.title: Don in Class
don-in-class.description: 19ఏళ్ల రాహుల్ చాలా అమాయకుడు. కాలేజ్ లో అతన్ని అందరూ ఏడిపిస్తూ ఉంటారు. ఇంట్లో వాళ్ళు అతని బాధను ఎప్పుడూ పట్టించుకోలేదు. అయితే ఒకరోజు బిల్డింగ్ మీద నుండి పడిపోతుంటే అతని జీవితంలో అనుకోని సంఘటన జరిగింది. ట్విస్టులు, నవ్వులు మధ్య జరిగే ఆసక్తికరమైన కథ ఇది.

ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires-2.title: Ultimate Hacker vs Billionaires
ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires-2.description: The series introduces Vikrant, a ruthless magnate who leverages his power to suppress legal battles concerning land grabbing and farmer suicides, while orchestrating a corporate cover-up. His empire, built on morally bankrupt practices, faces a massive hack and theft, exposing his predatory dealings. Amidst this, Vedanth, a brilliant cyber defense expert, emerges, haunted by a personal tragedy linked to Vikrant's bank, Erakkar Bank, which he blames for his father's death and crushing debt. A catastrophic cyber-attack then threatens the entire Indian banking system, identifying Vedanth as the nation's last hope to avert collapse. However, his urgent mission is repeatedly derailed by comical misunderstandings and escalating public humiliations at the hands of an arrogant heiress, Kavitha, who falsely accuses him of theft. Despite facing demeaning servitude and dismissal of his warnings by Vikrant, Vedanth races against time to prevent a national financial crisis. In a dramatic turn, Kavitha reveals her true identity as Vedanth's wife, transforming their dynamic and orchestrating a powerful retribution against Vikrant. Vedanth, at times held captive by Vikrant, works to save the very bank he seeks to dismantle, battling both the cyber-attack and overwhelming suspicion. He demands an audience with powerful figures, hinting at a critical, undisclosed agenda, and successfully averts the immediate cyber threat while warning of deeper dangers. Vedanth ultimately exposes a vast financial fraud involving Vikrant and others, utilizing a "mirror ledger" to detail their crimes against farmers and the fraudulent loans that led to suicides. He successfully secures the nation's data and system integrity, preventing a complete banking system collapse. The series culminates with mastermind Arjun orchestrating the dramatic downfall of corrupt power couple Vikrant and Kavitha Hirakat, using leaked data and raids to expose their massive international loan fraud, leading to justice for countless victims and the irreversible crumbling of their empire. Vedanth, accused of a security failure, claims he followed orders to protect the nation and eliminated those corrupting the system from within.

don-in-uniform-1.title: Don In Uniform
don-in-uniform-1.description: அண்டர்வேர்ல்ட் டான் யாஷ், ராகுல் என்ற பள்ளி மாணவனை காப்பாற்றும் போது உயிரிழக்கிறார்; அவரது ஆவி ராகுலின் உடலில் புகுகிறது. பலவீனமாக இருந்த ராகுல், யாஷின் தைரியமும் ஸ்டைலும் கொண்டு மாறி, பள்ளியில் ஹீரோவாகிறார். ஆனால் படிப்பும் கடந்த காலமும் அவனை சோதிக்க, யாஷ் அவனை நல்ல வழியில் நடத்துவாரா அல்லது குற்றவாளியாக மாற்றுவாரா என்பது கேள்வியாகிறது.

kadhi-chawal-ka-pyaar.title: Kadhi Chawal Ka pyaar
kadhi-chawal-ka-pyaar.description: A simple, white-shirted Chawal marries the elite Kadhi, but she betrays him for the wealthy, greasy Kachori. After a bitter legal battle and a brutal beating, Chawal vows to change his "status" and flees to Hyderabad. There, he undergoes a fiery transformation with Chicken and Mutton to become the billionaire king of dishes, Biryani. In the end, he coldly rejects a now-destitute Kadhi, leaving his "fika" past behind to rule the culinary world.

heartbreak-to-billionaire.title: Heartbreak To Billionaire
heartbreak-to-billionaire.description: Dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, a struggling engineer marries a stranger—unaware she’s a billionaire CEO. Soon, he discovers he is the long-lost heir to a powerful business empire. As love and rivalry collide, he must choose between revenge and the woman who stood by him.

the-billionaire-behind-bars-2.title: The Billionaire Behind Bars
the-billionaire-behind-bars-2.description: After sacrificing his identity and freedom for a woman who only loved his wealth, a mysterious billionaire returns from prison to rebuild his life in anonymity. When he rescues a fearless single mother and her daughter from a powerful enemy, he finds the emotional bond he has long been denied. But as his past resurfaces and betrayal stands exposed, love, revenge, and justice collide in a grand revelation that changes every life forever.

mute-millionaire.title: MUTE MILLIONAIRE
mute-millionaire.description:
Vishal lost his voice and his wife Ridhima lost her patience and loyalty.
Kabir wants the wife, the wealth… and a permanently silent husband. But when Vishal secretly finds his voice again, the game changes.
In a world full of noise, the mute man controls the story.

tea-stall-to-marriage-hall.title: Tea Stall To Marriage Hall
tea-stall-to-marriage-hall.description: పెళ్ళి పీటల మీద నుండి లేచిపోయిన శృతికి టీ బండి దగ్గర ఆనంద్ పరిచయం అవుతాడు. డెస్టినీ వాళ్ళిద్దరినీ ఒక రిలేషన్ లోకి తీసుకెళ్తుంది.  ఆ రిలేషన్ లో వాళ్ళు ఎలాంటి ఇబ్బందులను ఎదుర్కొన్నారనేది చూసి తెలుసుకోవాల్సిందే. మంచి కాఫీ లాంటి కుర్రాడైన ఆనంద్ కథ ఇది.

aloo-bhindi-ka-pyaar.title: Aloo Bhindi Ka Pyaar
aloo-bhindi-ka-pyaar.description: In the dramatic "Sabzi Mandi," Aloo and Bhindi defy their traditional families and a jealous Gobi to protect their forbidden romance. Their journey leads them through a high-stakes vegetable courtroom and a stint in "Cold Storage" before proving their innocence. With the support of friends, they escape the label of being "rotten" to perform a sacred "Kadhai Marriage". Ultimately, their families unite, realizing their world-famous combo is powered by true love.

the-billionaire-behind-bars-1.title: The Billionaire Behind Bars
the-billionaire-behind-bars-1.description: After sacrificing his identity and freedom for a woman who only loved his wealth, a mysterious billionaire returns from prison to rebuild his life in anonymity. When he rescues a fearless single mother and her daughter from a powerful enemy, he finds the emotional bond he has long been denied. But as his past resurfaces and betrayal stands exposed, love, revenge, and justice collide in a grand revelation that changes every life forever.

the-broken-billionaire-1.title: The Broken Billionaire
the-broken-billionaire-1.description: “தி ப்ரோக்கன் பில்லியனேர்” என்பது AI திறமையில் பிரபலமான கரண், தனது ஒருதலைக் காதலான நீத்தாவுக்காக பெரிய வாய்ப்புகளை விட்டுவிட்டு அவளின் செயலாளராக வேலை செய்யும் கதை. நான்கு ஆண்டுகள் அவளின் “Near Solutions” நிறுவனத்தையும் வாழ்க்கையையும் அமைதியாக நிர்வகிக்கும் கரண், ஒருநாள் அவள் தன்னை ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளுவாளா என்ற நம்பிக்கையில் வாழ்கிறான்.

bhai-ka-badla.title: Bhai Ka Badla
bhai-ka-badla.description: Kartik arrives into the family of Vivan, his sister Shivika and Dadaji, claiming that Kartik’s dad died saving Vivan when he was in a fatal accident with his parents, many years ago. Out of a sense of responsibility Shivika and dadaji decide to adopt Kartik but Vivan soon realises Kartik has ulterior motives. Kartik wants to oust Vivan from his own home and become the undeniable variz of the family.

billionaire-on-plane-1.title: Billionaire On Plane
billionaire-on-plane-1.description: A mysterious billionaire CEO, Arjun, embarks on an AirThara flight disguised in humble attire, sparking fierce competition among flight attendants. He endures repeated humiliation and disrespect from staff and passengers, including Nisha, who mistakes him for a "toilet cleaner," and his sentimental, handmade bag becomes a focal point of conflict. Gradually revealing his true identity as Surya Mitthal, the owner and founder of the airline, he initiates a corporate reckoning, exposing class prejudice and leading to significant staff terminations. During a subsequent tense flight, Surya, still partially undercover, intervenes to protect a female staff member from the abusive General Manager Akshay Bhatia, dramatically terminating him. The flight then faces a severe storm, forcing an emergency landing, which Surya heroically manages, saving all on board and solidifying his authority. The narrative then delves into Surya's past, revealing his heartbreak over Maya, an ambitious ex-partner who rejected him for a corporate position and heir Rishabh due to classist pressures. Simultaneously, heiress Meera Singhania becomes captivated by Surya, dramatically defending him and entering into a fake engagement to appease her disapproving family. Meera's elder sister, Aditi, fueled by class conflict, attacks Surya and vows to expose him, questioning the authenticity of his gifts. The arrival of arrogant mogul Gourav further complicates matters, as he publicly belittles Surya and declares his intent to marry Meera. The climax unfolds at an exclusive auction where Meera faces pressure to denounce Surya. However, Surya, now fully unmasked as the hidden billionaire CEO Suryamithal, makes an audacious bid, revealing his immense power and confessing his genuine love for Meera. Despite initial accusations, Meera accepts his heartfelt marriage proposal, concluding his journey from disguised humiliation to public triumph and true love.

shotgun-shaadi.title: Shotgun Shaadi
shotgun-shaadi.description: In the blood-soaked lands of Haryana, Abhimanyu Dahiya watches his father fall to the ruthless Sangwan clan and swears revenge. Years later, he returns in vengeance, destroying everything in his path… until fate binds him to Meher, his enemy’s daughter, in a marriage built on hatred. But when Abhimanyu discovers Meher is the very girl who once saved his life, his world shatters. Torn between his father’s blood and his own heart, he must choose - vengeance… or redemption. Watch Now!

daring-bodyguard-3.title: Daring Bodyguard
daring-bodyguard-3.description: A highly trained fighter enters the life of a brilliant pharma CEO disguised as an ordinary security guard to protect her. She has invented a drug called 'Sunspire',  a breakthrough that could potentially cure cancer. But a powerful businessman is determined to seize this discovery for himself. During the mission, the fighter uncovers a terrifying truth, the businessman’s father was responsible for destroying his family. What began as a protection mission soon turns into a deeply personal war.

dhurandhar-shooter-2.title: The Gun Master
dhurandhar-shooter-2.description: Rohan, India’s best sniper, known as Gun Master G-9. After losing his mentor in a terror attack, Rohan gives up guns and hides his identity while working at a small shooting academy of his mentpr’s widow in Uttarakhand. When criminals, corrupt forces, and an international terror plan threaten an innocent family and the country’s future, Rohan must face his past. The story blends patriotism, sacrifice, family emotions, and revealing how a true warrior never stops protecting his people.

raja-sahab-returns.title: Raja Sahab Returns
raja-sahab-returns.description: Surya, a former jailer and the secret kingpin of the coal mining empire, hides his true identity to give his son Adarsh a normal life. But when Adarsh is brutally humiliated, tortured, & kidnapped by the arrogant son of Surya’s own former ally, Surya is forced to step back into the world he left behind. As enemies try to destroy him and take over his empire, Surya returns as Raja Sahab,  not just to reclaim his throne, but to protect his son, destroy his enemies, & clean his empire from within.

the-storm-bodyguard.title: The Storm Bodyguard
the-storm-bodyguard.description: Amnesiac martial artist Krishna is tasked by his Guru to protect brilliant scientist and CEO Ritika Naidu, whose groundbreaking cancer medicine, "Amrutdhara," makes her a significant target. As Krishna grapples with his lost memories, a mysterious box from his Guru hints at a profound, fated connection between him and Ritika. Ritika faces corporate ruin after falsely announcing her cure is complete, leading to her and her sister Khushi's violent abduction by the menacing Sunny, who claims Ritika as his "future wife." Krishna heroically intervenes, saving them, and is subsequently hired by Ritika as her bodyguard, despite her initial skepticism and his own hidden agenda as a double agent. Their forced proximity leads to a developing connection, with Ritika taking control of Krishna's life and hinting at a mysterious "experiment" while escalating threats from a pharma mafia loom. A ruthless corporate war unfolds, orchestrated by the formidable Jitender Kumar, who seeks to acquire "Amrutadhara" and subjugate Naidu Pharma. Krishna is promoted to Head of Security, secretly seeking to recover his lost memories, and confronts Jitender Kumar's subordinates, unraveling a deeper conspiracy. Ritika faces corporate collapse and is pressured into a contract marriage to save her family's legacy, but with Krishna's unexpected support, she orchestrates a brilliant financial comeback, turning the tables on her adversaries and launching her groundbreaking medicine. Amidst these high-stakes corporate battles, a deep protective bond and a burgeoning romance develop between Ritika and Krishna. However, Jitender's revenge escalates, threatening not only her company but also her personal safety, while a powerful patriarch vows brutal revenge against Krishna. The ruthless Ranadheer Kumar attempts to seize control of medical breakthroughs and orchestrates Ritika's forced marriage to acquire her family's legacy, gravely threatening Krishna's life. A dark prophecy foretells a fated reunion between Krishna and Ritika, whose memories of him were tragically erased after a violent past. Years later, a sadistic villain's plot to brutalize Ritika and force her into marriage with his son ignites a desperate race against time, with Krishna arriving as her protector. Krishna engages in brutal confrontations, driven by a quest for justice and vengeance for his parents' deaths, for which the villain is responsible. As Krishna meticulously pursues his retribution, he reconnects with Ritika, rekindling their childhood love and recalling a pivotal promise to protect her, further intertwining their destinies amidst the ongoing pursuit of justice.

drama-app-se-real-earning.title: Free Drama App Se Real Earning

daring-bodyguard-2.title: Daring Bodyguard
daring-bodyguard-2.description: Shaurya goes undercover as Aarohi’s security guard to shield “Sunspire,” a potential cancer cure worth killing for.   But the mastermind after her carries the bloodline of the man who destroyed Shaurya’s family.  Protect her, or destroy them; either way, Shaurya is going to war.

daring-bodyguard-1.title: Daring Bodyguard
daring-bodyguard-1.description: Arohi Saigal, a brilliant scientist, unveils a revolutionary cancer cure, immediately placing her in grave danger from powerful corporate entities. Her protection falls to an enigmatic individual, initially known by various names like Yuva and Sanjay, who becomes her personal bodyguard and with whom a burgeoning romance ignites. The primary antagonists are the oppressive Vardhan family and their associates, who seek to gain control of Arohi's discovery, often referred to as "Sunspear" or "Sun Spire," and her family's business through hostile takeovers, manipulative marriage proposals, and corporate sabotage. The protector's identity solidifies as Shaurya Rajput, revealing him to be more than just a bodyguard; he is a formidable operative with a forgotten past. Shaurya is eventually revealed as the adopted son of the Rajputh dynasty, driven by a deep-seated vendetta against the Vardhan family for the murder of his parents and the theft of his family's groundbreaking artificial organ technology fifteen years prior. The narrative escalates into a high-stakes corporate war, with Arohi (also known as Aarohi Sehgal or Miss Saigal) fiercely fighting to protect her family's legacy and her invention amidst internal betrayals and shifting alliances. Shaurya systematically dismantles the Vardhan empire, confronting various members like Rudransh Shikhavath, Kabeer Sethi, and Armaan Vardhan, often employing strategic deception and unique abilities. He endures sniper attacks, poison, and blackmail, all while safeguarding Arohi and her sister, Ishitha. The profound connection between Arohi and Shaurya is constantly tested by the escalating threats and personal sacrifices required. Shaurya's relentless quest for vengeance culminates in a final, explosive confrontation with Armaan Vardhan, whom he accuses of mass murder and stealing his family's efforts. Armaan's death marks a significant victory in Shaurya's mission for justice. However, the reappearance of his childhood sweetheart, Chikki, introduces new romantic complexities, hinting that Shaurya's personal journey is far from over. The show portrays a desperate fight for survival, autonomy, and retribution against a powerful and manipulative adversary.

ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires-1.title: Ultimate Hacker Vs Billionaires
ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires-1.description: వేదాంత్ నాయక్ ఒక సాఫ్ట్ వేర్ ఇంజనీర్. ఆర్బీఐ అతని సేవలను ఉపయోగించుకుంటుంది. అలాంటి వేదాంత్ కి విక్రమ్ గజపతి వల్ల తీవ్రమైన అవమానం జరిగింది. డేటాను కాపాడాలని బయలు దేరిన వేదాంత్ కి బిలియనీర్లతో జరిగిన సంఘర్షణ ఇది.

khajuraho-kala-ke-peeche-ka-itihaas.title: Khajuraho: Kala Ke Peeche Ka Itihaas
khajuraho-kala-ke-peeche-ka-itihaas.description: Khajuraho: Kala Ke Peeche Ka Itihaas

dhurandhar-shooter-1.title: The Gun Master
dhurandhar-shooter-1.description: India’s best sniper who vanished after a tragic mission lives in hiding as a cleaner, until his deadly skills are forced back into action to protect a brave widow, her child, and the nation from a dangerous terror plot.

munna-bhai-12th-fail.title: Munna Bhai 12th Fail
munna-bhai-12th-fail.description: Raghu Reddy, a powerful politician and mafia don, heroically sacrifices himself only to awaken in the body of a child he saved, Abir, embarking on an unexpected journey of redemption and academic ambition. While navigating his new identity, Abir faces a manipulative cousin, Rehan, and a biased family who falsely accuse him of attempted murder, forcing him to fake amnesia and plot his revenge. Simultaneously, Raghu Reddy's former enforcers discover his shocking return in a new body, forcing them to accept his leadership as he plans to reclaim his underworld dominion and pursue a political career, aiming to become Chief Minister. Abir's transformation from a timid student to a confident young man sparks a budding romance with his classmate Shanaya, but also intensifies his rivalry with Rehan, leading to violent confrontations and threats, and his eventual disownment by his adoptive family. His connection to the formidable Reddy Gang transforms Abir from a victim into a figure of unexpected influence, allowing him to challenge powerful figures like Mr. Roy. Despite accusations of murder and theft, Abir's integrity is revealed, and he undergoes brutal physical training, driven by a long-term desire for revenge. As Raghubhai's heir, Abir (also referred to as Abheer/Abeer) violently asserts control over the underworld, while also uncovering Rehan's sinister plots against him, forcing Abir and his mother to flee. A high-stakes academic competition becomes a battleground where Rehan attempts sabotage, but Abir unexpectedly wins first place and direct college admission, shattering Rehan's confidence. Rehan is subsequently disqualified and publicly disowned by his father, who, in a shocking turn, claims to be 'Abir's parents.' The drama intensifies with Abir being falsely accused of cheating, only for video evidence to expose Rehan Sethi as the true culprit. The show culminates with a transformed Abir intervening in a poisoning attempt on his estranged family, only to reveal he orchestrated the attack as an act of revenge, challenging his co-conspirator to continue their high-stakes game of retribution against the family.

dhurandhar-shooter.title: Dhurandhar Shooter
dhurandhar-shooter.description: A mysterious man working as a humble gun cleaner hides a dangerous secret—he is the legendary sniper Gun Master G9. When a ruthless colonel, deadly shooters, and a terror plot called Project Dancing Elephant threaten innocent lives and the nation, he must step out of the shadows. With unmatched precision and courage, the silent warrior returns to protect those he loves and stop a deadly conspiracy.

oops-not-a-gold-digger-4.title: Oops, Not a Gold Digger
oops-not-a-gold-digger-4.description: When spirited delivery girl Roxy rescues feisty Grandma from a taxi spat, she has no idea it will lead to an accidental marriage with charming yet mysterious Mark, a man she thinks is just a broke caretaker, but who’s actually heir to a billionaire empire. Between office politics, spoiled rivals like Tia, hidden identities, and Dadi’s matchmaking mischief, Roxy must protect her dreams, her dignity, and maybe her heart. Watch Now!

the-triple-crown.title: The Triple Crown
the-triple-crown.description: After a fatal accident, a delivery boy is reincarnated as a weak scholar in an ancient village. Guided by a stylish genie, he must navigate a new life while married to a princess, a warrior, and a merchant’s daughter. Using modern knowledge and magical boons, he protects his home from bandits and corrupt soldiers. As he wins his wives' devotion, he transforms from a "mad bookworm" into a powerful, beloved ruler.

invincible-bodyguard.title: Invincible Bodyguard
invincible-bodyguard.description: A highly trained fighter goes undercover as a security guard to protect a brilliant scientist who invented "Aura" — a drug that could cure cancer. A ruthless powerful man wants her discovery at any cost. But as the mission unfolds, the fighter discovers a terrifying truth - his enemy's father destroyed his family years ago. This is no longer just a mission. It's personal.

the-billionaire-house-husband.title: The Billionaire House Husband
the-billionaire-house-husband.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

final-190-minutes-4.title: Final 190 Minutes
final-190-minutes-4.description: A powerful government minister survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant. With flights grounded, the only hope is a brilliant yet controversial surgeon who has just been reinstated. He has only 190 minutes to transport a donor heart and save the minister’s life. But the mission turns dangerous when influential people, driven by ego and revenge, begin sabotaging his journey. Every delay pushes the clock closer to death.

love-under-arrest.title: Love Under Arrest
love-under-arrest.description:
Romi and Shikha’s wedding turns tragic when her father accidentally injures Romi’s mother.
Blinded by anger, Romi turns his love into hatred and pushes Shikha away.
As Shikha battles illness and heartbreak, fate separates them further.
They reunite when she loses her memory, giving Romi a second chance.
Through love and redemption, he wins her back and they start anew.

the-billionaire-who-married-for-revenge.title: The Billionaire Who Married For Revenge

tirupati-horror-files-black-dog-ka-raaz.title: Tirupati Horror Files: Black Dog Ka Raaz
tirupati-horror-files-black-dog-ka-raaz.description: Tirupati Horror Files: Black Dog Ka Raaz

final-190-minutes-3.title: Final 190 minutes
final-190-minutes-3.description: Railway Minister Narendra Jha survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant in Patna. With flights grounded, the only hope is Dr. Nihal Mathur - brilliant, controversial, and just reinstated. He has 190 minutes to transport the donor heart and save the Minister. But the mission spirals when socialite Kamya Tiwari, her hot-headed brother Sunny, and her fiancé Kabir Jha sabotage his path with ego and revenge. Every delay pushes the clock closer to death.

pembalasan-adik-sang-ceo.title: Pembalasan Adik Sang CEO ( Dubbed)
pembalasan-adik-sang-ceo.description: The show follows a long-running clash between wealth, status, and vulnerable people who keep getting dragged into public humiliation. It begins with wedding tensions around the Johri family, where romantic plans are repeatedly disrupted by class contempt, family resentment, and sudden accidents. Those conflicts spill onto airplanes and into airports, where passengers, crew, and powerful relatives fight over seats, medical help, and who gets to control the narrative. A desperate mother’s struggle to protect an injured child turns into a larger crisis involving emergency landings, recordings, accusations, and threats of legal action. As the story widens, the same world of privilege keeps producing new scandals, including sabotage claims, arrests, and a powerful figure shutting down an airport to investigate attacks on family members. Rachel emerges as a central force in the conflict, alternately accused, humiliated, and suspected of using marriage to gain power. Her position becomes even more precarious when evidence is used against her and she is pushed toward confinement or worse. At the same time, Chris is pulled between protecting his family and preserving his relationship, while his fiancée’s jealousy and ambition repeatedly deepen the chaos. The mystery around Sophie becomes one of the show’s biggest emotional engines, since she is first treated as a rival or imposter and later revealed as Chris’s sister. That revelation shifts the stakes from romance to family loyalty, forcing Chris to choose between a poisoned wedding and rescuing his sister. Sophie’s heart condition makes every confrontation more urgent, and several scenes hinge on whether she can be found, revived, or hidden from harm. A family heirloom necklace becomes another symbol of belonging, with custody fights, destruction, and accusations of mistress behavior turning it into a weapon of shame. The necklace dispute also helps expose how often truth is buried under manipulation, force, and public spectacle. Across the batch, phones are shattered, recordings are seized, and evidence is repeatedly destroyed or contested. Corporate betrayal then joins the family drama, as insiders reveal infiltration, extortion, and hidden control inside the Johri Group. Legal pressure escalates alongside the personal conflicts, with threats of arrest, imprisonment, and violent retaliation hanging over nearly every major character. By the later episodes, weddings are repeatedly delayed or canceled, not because the characters lack ambition, but because betrayal keeps surfacing faster than anyone can contain it. The overall arc is one of escalating exposure: every attempt to preserve status, marriage, or authority ends up revealing deeper lies and more fractured loyalties.

shakuni-ki-chaal-vs-chanakya-ki-neeti.title: Shakuni Ki Chaal vs Chanakya Ki Neeti
shakuni-ki-chaal-vs-chanakya-ki-neeti.description: Shakuni Ki Chaal vs Chanakya Ki Neeti

love-mocktail-1.title: Love Mocktail
love-mocktail-1.description: Aditya’s life shatters when his girlfriend leaves him on their wedding day for a richer man. In a twist of fate, he impulsively marries Preeti Shetty, a strong and mysterious woman. What begins as a sudden marriage turns into a journey of love, betrayal, and destiny. As secrets unfold, Aditya discovers he is actually Siddharth Sharma, the lost heir of a powerful family, leading to a battle for identity, love, and legacy.

final-190-minutes-2.title: Final 190 Minutes
final-190-minutes-2.description: A powerful government minister survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant. With flights grounded, the only hope is a brilliant yet controversial surgeon who has just been reinstated. He has only 190 minutes to transport a donor heart and save the minister’s life. But the mission turns dangerous when influential people, driven by ego and revenge, begin sabotaging his journey. Every delay pushes the clock closer to death.

my-dad-is-a-killer.title: My Dad Is A Killer
my-dad-is-a-killer.description: A simple taxi driver, Vikram, is pushed into a nightmare when a leaked video threatens his daughter Ananya’s dignity. As blackmail, crime, and dangerous strangers close in, Vikram’s suppressed dark side begins to take control. Torn between being a loving father and a ruthless killer, he must fight his inner demon to protect his daughter. How far will a father go when his child’s honor is at stake?

the-ceo-son-in-law.title: The CEO Son-in-Law
the-ceo-son-in-law.description: The series chronicles the tumultuous marriage of Abhimanyu, a once-promising cricketer struggling with stagnation, and Amrutha, an ambitious executive. Their relationship is plagued by Abhimanyu's unfulfilled aspirations and Amrutha's growing resentment, leading her to embark on an illicit affair with Nikhil, driven by career ambitions and a desire to leave her perceived "loser husband." Unbeknownst to Amrutha, Abhimanyu, initially expelled from his home and disowned by his children, secretly transforms into a powerful, wealthy CEO, meticulously building a multi-crore business, with Amrutha unknowingly working for him. His initial desire for redemption evolves into a calculated quest for vengeance against Amrutha and Nikhil, who schemes to become COO and orchestrate financial fraud. Amrutha's ascent to a COO position at AA Sports is fraught with corporate intrigue and personal betrayals, including threats from her estranged husband and manipulative colleagues. The narrative builds to a dramatic climax where Abhimanyu publicly reveals his true identity as the company's owner and CEO, crashing a corporate event and confronting Amrutha. This revelation exposes Nikhil's massive corporate fraud, leading to his downfall and arrest. Abhimanyu, having meticulously planned his revenge, then executes a ruthless divorce, stripping Amrutha of all assets and declaring their children must become self-reliant. Amidst this corporate takeover and personal reckoning, Abhimanyu dismantles his past life and makes a surprising proposal to his loyal assistant, Vishaka. The show explores themes of ambition, betrayal, secret identities, and the devastating consequences of a marriage consumed by power struggles and revenge.

home-maker-ceo.title: Home Maker CEO
home-maker-ceo.description: The microdrama chronicles the tumultuous marriage of Amrutha Shinde and Abhimanyu, initially marked by his perceived laziness and her rising professional success. Amrutha confronts Abhimanyu over his neglect and later accuses him of being a gold-digger, while she navigates corporate intrigue, becoming a COO and then CEO of AS Sports. She develops a romance with colleague Nikhil, which fuels Abhimanyu's escalating jealousy, leading to accusations of infidelity and physical assault. Their children ultimately side with Amrutha, condemning Abhimanyu's behavior and empowering her to demand his departure. However, a significant twist reveals Abhimanyu as a powerful CEO who secretly built Amrutha's success out of love, enduring her scorn while she remains unaware he is her boss. His friend Vishi, deeply devoted, vows revenge against Amrutha and Nikhil for past harms. Amrutha's career ascent is threatened by Abhimanyu's sabotage and corporate rivals, including Nikhil and Sandeep, as her past marital infidelity and Abhimanyu's true identity loom. Despite betrayals, Abhimanyu's unwavering love prevents him from seeking retribution, even as he feels compelled to disclose painful truths. Corporate chaos intensifies with power struggles, including Amrutha orchestrating a young CEO's appointment and Abhimanyu Shinde's failed attempt to claim the CEO title, publicly shamed by his ex-wife, Ameya. Nikhil also faces public humiliation and removal from his company, while Amritha's career is demoted by Vishakh. The Chairman of AS Sports ultimately transfers his empire to Abhimanyu, his daughter's ex-husband, igniting a fierce power struggle. Abhimanyu then unveils a fifteen-year deception, revealing he secretly built a vast company to test Amrutha's loyalty and secure their children's future. He orchestrates revenge against Nikhil for corporate fraud and personal betrayal, leading to Nikhil's apprehension. Abhimanyu confronts societal double standards and makes the heartbreaking decision to permanently depart from his family. He financially devastates Amrutha in their divorce and strips his children of their privilege, ultimately finding solace and proposing marriage to his loyal confidante, Vishaka.

sweet-revenge.title: Sweet Revenge
sweet-revenge.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous relationship between acclaimed author Prerna Munjal and her husband, Rachit, a hidden author. Initially, Prerna faces a plagiarism scandal and a life-threatening kidney illness, while Rachit desperately tries to secure funds for her transplant, unaware of her sinister plot with lover Ketan to seize his fortune. Prerna manipulates Rachit, falsely accusing him of illness and theft, and eventually orchestrates a ruthless divorce, stripping him of his assets and home. Despite Rachit's efforts to save her, Ketan further manipulates Prerna into refusing a life-saving kidney transplant, leading to the loss of a donor. Rachit, publicly humiliated and accused of fraud, seeks refuge and a new identity, finding unexpected support from publisher Sameera Sachdev, who initially sought justice for him. Their relationship becomes complicated when Sameera's grandfather publicly announces their engagement, forcing them into a charade. The conflict escalates into a high-stakes corporate and legal battle over authorship, with Rachit, now a celebrated author, publicly accusing Prerna of plagiarism and betrayal. CEO Sameera Sachdev backs Rachit's claims, and a unique

rented-husband-5.title: Rented Husband for Christmas Eve
rented-husband-5.description: A mysterious billionaire hides his true identity and agrees to a contract marriage with a woman trying to save her family business, only to face relentless humiliation from her greedy relatives. But as secrets unravel, the tables turn in this emotional rollercoaster of pride, love, and revenge.

mastermind-buddha.title: Mastermind Buddha
mastermind-buddha.description: Devendra Amit Garg, a brilliant scientist, invents a revolutionary invisible coating for fighter jets, making him a national asset, but his personal life crumbles as his materialistic wife, Nisha, and son, Vicky, demand a divorce and plot to profit from his critical illness, aligning with the ruthless CEO Rastogi. While Devendra is scorned and abandoned by his family, powerful corporate figures, including Meera Khanna and CEO Mehta, battle fiercely for control over his groundbreaking military technology. Amidst a hostile corporate takeover by Rastogi against Meera's Khanna Group, Devendra, whose true identity as "Amit Garg" is revealed, finds an unlikely ally in Meera, who had previously helped him, and a compassionate medic named Rahul, as he fights for his life and his invention. The Khanna Group faces corporate collapse orchestrated by Rastogi, with Meera and scientist Amit Garg as their last hope, despite initial skepticism about Amit. Amit identifies a critical production flaw and, through an experimental scientific breakthrough led by Meera, successfully averts the hostile takeover. However, Amit's true motive is revealed to be a deep, personal vendetta against Rastogi for past betrayals, leading him to strategically move to expose Rastogi's misdeeds and ban his company from a crucial tender. Devendra, ousted by his family, finds refuge and support from Meera, forming a compelling alliance. The narrative then centers on the dramatic unraveling of Amit Garg's true identity as the powerful patriarch Devendra Garg, a secret he maintained for two decades. What begins as a high-stakes business tender is repeatedly disrupted by public confrontations, accusations of abandonment from his estranged family (Nisha and Rahul), and corporate espionage. Amit/Devendra navigates accusations of being an imposter and endures brutal interrogations, while his devoted wife, Shruti, fiercely defends him, though at times she appears to expose him as a low-level employee. The powerful patriarch Devendra ultimately reveals his true identity as Amit Garg, a man his family humiliated, initiating a calculated plan of retribution, trapping his kin and warning others. He confronts his sons, Rahul and Amit, and Amit's wife for betrayal and disrespect, leading him to disinherit them and sever all ties. Subsequently, Devendra, a revered national scientist, is subjected to harassment, prompting a powerful Governor to intervene. The Governor orchestrates the arrest of MP Rastogi and others responsible for Devendra's suffering, delivering swift justice. Devendra is honored with a prestigious award, while Miss Khanna secures a major army tender amidst the political drama, signifying a form of professional triumph and resolution.

in-search-of-love.title: In Search of Love
in-search-of-love.description: Sneha, a devoted daughter, initiates a quest to find a genuine wife for her wealthy CEO father, Madhava, who agrees to remarry only if his future wife loves him for himself. Madhava, disguising himself as a humble carpenter, meets and marries Kasthuri, an independent hotelier, concealing his immense wealth and true identity to test her character. Concurrently, Kasthuri, a humble matriarch, endures severe humiliation and abuse from her son Rohit's arrogant wife, Mahitha, and Mahitha's mother, Rajeshwari, who plot public humiliation. Kasthuri also desperately searches for her long-lost daughter, Myra, discovering a striking resemblance and identical age between Myra and Madhav's adopted daughter, Sneha, raising questions about Sneha's true parentage. Kasthuri's suspicions about Madhav's true identity are sparked by prejudiced remarks about his perceived poverty. As the family navigates a high-stakes 100-crore deal, new wealth corrupts Chandu's family, escalating Mahitha's classist prejudice into violence against Kasthuri and her loved ones. Madhav, initially perceived as a humble man, begins to reveal his true power as a Vice President, defending his family against Mahitha and Chandu's arrogance, leading to Dev canceling the deal and banning Chandu's family from RK ventures. Amidst this, Madhav and his ex-wife grapple with their own missing daughter, finding hope in Sneha's resemblance, while Kasturi faces relentless financial demands and humiliation from her greedy relatives. A defiant young woman, identified as Sneha and later Priya, emerges in a corporate setting, challenging corruption and hinting at a significant, undisclosed identity linked to the RK Group. Kasturi's peaceful new life is disrupted by her wealthy ex-husband, Vikas, who plots revenge after being rejected. To protect Madhav, Kasturi attempts to distance herself, unaware of his true status. Madhav dramatically reveals his true identity as the powerful Chairman of RK Group when Kasturi is abused and defrauded by her brother and sister-in-law, unleashing his formidable wrath. A subsequent medical crisis involving Kasturi's son, Rohit, uncovers a shocking deception orchestrated by his manipulative wife, Mahitha, to secure a kidney for her own mother. Madhav intervenes, exposing the fraud, leading to Rohit's divorce from Mahitha, who retaliates by unjustly firing him. Kasturi bravely confronts Mahitha and her powerful father, enduring humiliation and assault in her fight for justice. Finally, Madhav, now fully revealed, enacts swift justice against those who wronged him and his loved ones. After initial conflict over his hidden identity, Madhav and Kasturi reconcile, and he commits to finding Myra. Their quest culminates in an emotional reunion between Kasturi and Myra, completing their family.

robot-romeo-1.title: Robot Romeo
robot-romeo-1.description: A middle-class scientist sacrifices love to protect his dignity only to watch the world replace him with a perfect AI version of himself.

vampire-sirf-kahani-ya-khaufnaak-haqiqat.title: Vampire: Sirf Kahani Ya Khaufnaak Haqiqat?
vampire-sirf-kahani-ya-khaufnaak-haqiqat.description: Vampire: Sirf Kahani Ya Khaufnaak Haqiqat?

daughter-of-the-secret-tycoon-4.title: Daughter Of The Secret Tycoon
daughter-of-the-secret-tycoon-4.description: The series centers on Alex Williams, a seemingly ordinary father concealing immense wealth and a powerful identity from his daughter, Emma, to honor a dying wish. Emma, initially unaware of her father's true status, navigates her own corporate career and personal life, including an engagement to Alex (Fiancé), who is later manipulated by the ambitious Linda. A whirlwind of corporate power plays begins when Alex Williams marries Amanda, a billionaire with a hidden agenda, who strategically promotes Emma's fiancé and orchestrates the breakup of his engagement to Emma. This betrayal ignites a fierce corporate and personal war, with Emma dramatically revealing her own CEO status to defend her father from public humiliation. As the conflict escalates, Alex (Fiancé) and Linda plot revenge, drawing in formidable figures like Mr. Kane, hinting at a larger, mysterious power structure. The enigmatic "Fire Red Diamond" emerges as a central object, revealing hidden pasts and secret identities, including the possibility that Alex Williams is the legendary "Fire Phoenix." Amanda fiercely defends Alex against her disapproving patriarch father, Patrick, who attempts to bribe and violently confront him. Alex, with Amanda's unwavering support, orchestrates a stunning public reveal of his true wealth and status, turning the tables on his condescending acquaintances. The series culminates with Richard Johnson, identified as Alex Williams, dramatically unveiling his true identity as the legendary CEO "Fire Phoenix" to Amanda. He publicly re-proposes to her and entrusts his vast corporate empire to their daughter, Emma, solidifying a legacy amidst ongoing corporate intrigue and power struggles.

ajnabi-ka-intezar-hai.title: Ajnabi ka Intezar Hai
ajnabi-ka-intezar-hai.description: A broken woman, robbed of motherhood, finds unexpected love in a humble construction worker—unaware he’s a secret billionaire hiding his true identity. As their fragile romance deepens, dark secrets, betrayal, and a stolen child resurface, forcing them to fight against fate, enemies, and shattered trust to claim the family they were destined for.

echoes-of-truth.title: Echoes of Truth
echoes-of-truth.description:
A fearless prime-time journalist sees his empire collapse overnight when a brutal media conspiracy brands him a predator and fugitive.
As AI-manipulated evidence, political power plays, and corporate greed tighten the noose, he turns to independent digital journalism to fight back. In a world where perception is power, this gripping thriller asks: when the truth is shattered, who controls the narrative?

journey-back-home.title: Journey Back Home
journey-back-home.description: 30ఏళ్ళ క్రిష్ణ తన ఊరికి బయలుదేరాడు. తన తండ్రి, కూతురు, భార్య వరదల్లో చనిపోయారని తెలిసిన చాలా రోజుల తర్వాత ఊరికి బయలు దేరాడు. ఆ ప్రయాణంలో అతనికి రాహువులా రాహుల్ కలిసాడు.  అ తర్వాత అతని జీవితం మలుపు తీసుకుంది. ఇది కేవలం ప్రయాణానికి సంబంధించిన కథ కాదు. ప్రేమలు, నమ్మకాలను, అభిమానాలను వెతుక్కుంటూ వెళ్ళిన ఒక యువకుడి కథ.

jhukega-nahi-saala.title: Jhukega Nahi Saala
jhukega-nahi-saala.description:
A powerful man living as a taxi driver fights crime while hiding his true identity and past pain.
When a woman from his past returns with his daughter, he must protect them and face his enemies and family secrets.

chinese-anime.title: Chinese Anime
chinese-anime.description:
A gripping micro-drama anime where destiny, emotions, and secrets collide in fast-paced episodes.
Each moment delivers intense drama, striking visuals, and powerful twists that linger long after the screen fades.

assassin-ka-badla.title: Assassin Ka Badla
assassin-ka-badla.description: Assassin Ka Badla follows Veer Pratap Chauhan, a former soldier turned vigilante hiding as a clumsy guard while haunted by his sister Tanvi’s murder. When he saves tech CEO Kiara Rao from a deadly corporate-criminal nexus, his lethal past resurfaces. As betrayal and danger close in, Kiara uncovers Veer’s truth, leading to healing, and together they bring down the shadowy network behind it all.

picked-up-a-racing-king-to-be-my-husband.title: Picked up a Racing King to be my Husband
picked-up-a-racing-king-to-be-my-husband.description: The story centers on a racing world where victory is never just about speed, but about legacy, sabotage, and survival. Cade Stone’s triumph is shattered when Alejandro Rex confesses that he sabotaged Cade’s car and caused the crash that killed Cade’s parents. Cade is left devastated, and the conflict shifts from competition to a deeper search for justice and truth. Around that fallout, the Apollo Club becomes a fragile refuge fighting financial collapse, hostile rivals, and repeated sabotage. Evelyn and the club’s allies struggle to keep the team alive while powerful figures try to strip away its eligibility and control its future. A mysterious mechanic, Alex, enters as an unlikely helper and repeatedly proves he has extraordinary instincts, especially when he can diagnose machines by sound. His skill pushes him from the garage into the driver’s seat, where he becomes the club’s best chance at survival. That rise draws anger from Cade, Raven, Lucius, and other power brokers who see Alex’s success as a threat to their authority. Alex survives a series of brutal and sometimes deadly racing challenges, including blindfolded and reverse-course runs, while the team fights to reclaim stolen or disputed cars and repair sabotage. The stakes keep widening as the club seeks legitimacy, championship access, and the legendary vehicles needed to stay in the fight. Alex’s victories secure temporary hope, but they also intensify the pressure to cut him loose, replace him, or destroy him. His hidden past becomes part of the conflict when he is publicly revealed as a legendary Triple Crown champion, overturning the contempt directed at him. At the same time, his bond with Evelyn deepens, even as he fears revealing too much of himself. The racing itself grows more dangerous, with cliffside pressure, brake failure, explosions, and deliberate collisions turning each contest into a test of endurance as much as skill. In the final stretch, Alex pushes through extreme conditions to win a championship-level race, but the victory is immediately shadowed by catastrophe. Mr. Stone intentionally collides with the winning car, an explosion follows, Evelyn dies, and Alex’s fate is left unknown. In the later family reckoning, Rex wins a championship, learns his partner is pregnant, and confronts Cade again. Cade returns to accuse Rex of ruining his life, but Rex exposes Cade’s responsibility for their parents’ deaths and has him arrested. The batch closes with Rex choosing a future beyond the track, proposing to his partner and promising to return.

my-mystery-husband-hired-me-as-his-secre.title: My Mystery Husband Hired Me as His Secretary!
my-mystery-husband-hired-me-as-his-secre.description: A woman starts falling for her charming boss while adjusting to a new job, but a hidden truth complicates everything — she’s already married to a man she barely knows. Their rare encounters have left their relationship a forgotten shadow of a commitment.

bechara-billionaire-husband.title: Bechara Billionaire Husband
bechara-billionaire-husband.description: House husband is the secret billionaire.

kalyana-kacheri.title: Kalyana Kacheri
kalyana-kacheri.description: The story follows Rohini, Roshan, and the people around them as a series of public clashes turns family loyalty into a prolonged war over identity, marriage, and power. It begins with travel chaos and class tension on a bus, where Rohini is carrying an important family necklace and an affluent passenger’s contempt helps ignite humiliating disputes. What starts as cramped, noisy conflict quickly spreads into accusations, injuries, and threats, with bystanders and relatives using force instead of restraint. The same atmosphere of public shaming then follows Rohini into wedding and resort settings, where she is repeatedly challenged as an outsider and forced to prove she is Roshan’s sister. Family heirlooms such as a ring and the Chittoor necklace become proof of belonging, while their disputed meaning deepens suspicion rather than settling it. At the same time, powerful figures around Chittar Group use influence, intimidation, and even claims that the law cannot touch them to silence opposition. Rohini is framed, beaten, and publicly humiliated, while rival women are accused of trying to marry into power or seize corporate control. The conflict becomes even more dangerous when a woman’s refusal of marriage leads to a brutal assault and death, showing how little value the hostile side places on consent or life. Medical crisis then overtakes the feud as Rohini, identified as heart-ill, is denied or delayed treatment while allies struggle to get her medication and protect her from those calling her a mistress or manipulator. Roshan’s search for Rohini becomes increasingly frantic after her live location fails, struggle sounds are heard, and broken keepsakes suggest abduction or harm. When Rohini is finally found alive but fragile, the panic attack and surrounding evidence only harden Roshan’s belief that she was deliberately endangered. Recordings, images, and alleged surveillance repeatedly surface, but instead of clarifying the truth they deepen mistrust and split former allies. The wedding crisis peaks when accusations, apologies, and violence collide, and Roshan ultimately cancels the marriage rather than accept the accused woman into his family. From there, the story shifts into harsher revenge territory, with demands for lifelong punishment, public humiliation, and retaliation replacing any hope of reconciliation. Corporate corruption also comes to the surface when drug trafficking inside Chittar Corporation is exposed and arrests follow. Even then, personal vengeance remains central, as Roshan continues to treat betrayal as something to be answered through punishment rather than mercy. By the end, the show’s stakes are no longer just a wedding or a family dispute, but survival, reputation, inheritance, and control over who gets to define the truth.

ultimate-kabaddi-champion.title: Ultimate kabaddi champion
ultimate-kabaddi-champion.description: Kabaddi champion Chirag Singh has built his life on strength and silence after losing his father and mother under mysterious circumstances. Reporter Niharika goes undercover as his physiotherapist to uncover a scandal, but instead finds a man carrying deep wounds. As deception turns into love, a jealous rival, corrupt MLA, fake pregnancy scandal and an old murder case collide—forcing Niharika to uncover the truth behind Chirag’s shattered past.

big-money-bigger-mistake.title: Big Money, Bigger Mistake
big-money-bigger-mistake.description: A planned anniversary at a coastal resort becomes the spine of a sprawling microdrama in which medical emergencies, identity disputes, and corporate ambition collide. The CEO sends his loyal assistant Pratap and a promotion offer to the resort, but managerial cruelty and repeated refusals of aid turn minor incidents into life‑threatening confrontations. Front‑desk callousness and a receptionist’s denial of food or medication escalate into physical fights and a pattern of withholding critical medical help, including an inhaler and a phone during allergic crises. An elderly couple claiming Varma lineage — led by a frail Savitri and the ailing Raghu — repeatedly plead their identities while being branded impostors and publicly humiliated. A rival subordinate, Ritika (also referenced as Rithika/Reethika in accounts), uses the medical crisis and allegations of fraud to coerce, assault, and attempt to erase perceived obstacles to her advancement. Attempts to intervene — by Pratap, a mysterious protector Reethu, and other family members — meet violence, ambiguous aid, or managerial cover‑ups that expose divided loyalties. The plot thickens as two imposters briefly assume the Verma identities and receive lavish gifts, even as the real Savitri vows retribution and insists she is Rudra’s mother. Rudra, the powerful CEO, is repeatedly kept in the dark while his mother is secretly detained, and documents and IDs are used to contest parentage and ownership. Ambition and revenge mutate into organized cruelty: kidnappings, ransom demands, and staged humiliations are mounted by former employees seeking penance, money, and public apologies. Kidnap plots escalate to a 20‑crore demand, demands for public penance, and a chaotic cash transfer that ends in gunfire and a private‑jet getaway. Throughout, perpetrators vacillate between ruthless certainty and panic; conflicted accomplices worry the targets may in fact be powerful Varma owners. Parallel to the street‑level violence, boardroom players wage a reputational and legal war — threats of an eight‑crore defamation suit, firings, blacklisting, and public broadcasts designed to weaponize shame. Personal stakes — Raghu’s life, Shreya’s ruined hand and thwarted artistic future, and Savitri’s contested maternity — become intertwined with corporate stakes of honor, control, and property. Pratap’s loyalties fray as his own family is targeted, provoking vengeful impulses even as he alternately aids and exposes the conspirators. By the close of the season the narrative pivots from immediate bodily danger to a larger fight over names, documents, and public opinion, with victims vowing justice and perpetrators plotting retaliation. The arc leaves the family’s true lineage and the balance of power unresolved in the face of escalating legal, reputational, and physical reprisals.

my-commando-wife.title: My Commando Wife
my-commando-wife.description: A humiliated housewife, secretly a legendary Marine Commando presumed to be a myth, rises from betrayal and erasure to reclaim her identity, destroy the family that discarded her, and prove that the woman they broke is the very warrior they were never worthy of.

my-fiance-is-a-bigshot.title: My Fiancé Is A Bigshot
my-fiance-is-a-bigshot.description: குருவை நம்பிய திவ்யாவின் காதல் துரோகத்தில் முடிகிறது. அவமானத்தால் உடைந்த அவள் வாழ்க்கையில் கிஷோர் ஒரு விதமாக தோன்றுகிறார். ஒரு சாதாரண சந்திப்பு விதியாக மாறுகிறது. திவ்யாவின் உண்மையான சக்தி வெளிவந்ததும், விளையாட்டு முழுவதும் மாறுகிறது. காதலும் அதிகாரமும் நேருக்கு நேர் மோதுகின்றன.

the-great-indian-cook.title: The Great Indian Cook
the-great-indian-cook.description:
Samy and Sarath are childhood friends, but their sons, Kathir and Dev, become rivals at the family restaurant. After Samy leaves and Sarath dies, Dev blames Kathir, while Kathir rises from a small roadside stall with his talent.
When they face each other on the Great Indian Kitchen stage, will jealousy win, or will true talent prove itself?

dhurandhar-gendbaaz.title: God Of Cricket
dhurandhar-gendbaaz.description: The series begins with an investigation into inexplicable destruction attributed to a legendary "God of Bowling," sparking a desperate search for a mythical "fireballer." A young admirer points to humble rag picker Raghu, who initially denies but eventually confesses his hidden past as a "fire bowler," revealing a talent he had renounced. Simultaneously, struggling cricket team owner Samaira Rathod desperately seeks a "fireballer" to save her father's legacy and ancestral ground, initially dismissing Raghu. She discovers her captain, Bharat, secretly possesses the skill, but he later admits to fabricating his identity to impress her, exposing the team's vulnerability. Raghu, haunted by his mother's death due to poverty and blaming cricket, had quit the sport, but a miraculous recovery from a critical illness, seemingly triggered by his mother's desperate vow, hints at his extraordinary abilities. Samaira, facing financial ruin and external threats from ruthless rivals like Garima/Karima Khan who seek to seize her ground, realizes Raghu might be the prodigious talent she needs. Despite his reluctance and initial refusal to return to cricket, Samaira recruits him after her team suffers a catastrophic collapse and Bharat's betrayal. Bharat, jealous of Raghu and his growing importance, refuses to yield captaincy and aligns with rivals like Akash, plotting revenge against Samaira. Raghu, who is brutally attacked and suffers career-threatening injuries, is revealed to be Samaira's past protector, rekindling a connection between them. Samaira blames Karima Khan for the attack, and after Raghu's despair following his injury, she is forced to withdraw her team from the league, accusing Karima Khan of foul play. However, Raghu makes a miraculous recovery, and in a dramatic turn, bestows mysterious powers upon Samaira, transforming her into an invulnerable "Cricket-kar" who cannot feel pain. Samaira, now a formidable cricket star and captain of the Faridabad Lions, faces intense rivalries in a high-stakes championship, particularly against Raghu and Captain Bharat of the Ghaziabad Tigers. The competition is marred by psychological warfare and a shocking revelation of technological cheating involving Raghu and an unseen patron. Despite these challenges, Samaira demonstrates unwavering resilience, delivering game-changing performances. The season culminates in a dramatic final match where Raghu makes an audacious strategic shift against Bharat, leading to a stunning victory for a cricket star, public humiliation for a rival who vows revenge, and hints of a deeper conspiracy. The victor asserts dominance, claiming control over the competition's prize and venue, leaving the ultimate fate of the rival and the full extent of the conspiracy uncertain.

my-husband-is-a-ghost-hunter.title: My Husband Is A Ghost Hunter
my-husband-is-a-ghost-hunter.description: நைனா குப்தா, தனது மகளையும் சிதறும் தங்க பேரரசையும் காப்பாற்ற அர்ஜுன் வர்மாவை திருமணம் செய்கிறாள்; அவன் ஒரு முறிந்த முன்னாள் கைதி என நம்புகிறாள். தங்க சிண்டிகேட்கள் தாக்கும் போது, ஒரு மறைந்த உண்மை வெளிப்படுகிறது. அவளின் கணவன் அர்ஜுன் வர்மா உண்மையில் ‘கோஸ்ட் ஹண்டர்’ — அரசுகளே அஞ்சிய மனிதன். ஒப்பந்தமாக தொடங்கிய திருமணம், குடும்பத்தைக் காக்க அவன் மீண்டும் எழும் ஒரு அபாயகரமான பயணமாக மாறுகிறது.

supreme-grandmaster.title: Supreme Grandmaster
supreme-grandmaster.description: Rudra, apni shaktiyon ki madad se logon ki madad karke unka maseeha ban chuka tha, lekin ek din Ronnie, jiski usne kabhi jaan bachayi thi, usi ne uski pregnant biwi Ruby aur pita Virendra ko chot pahunchayi. Badle ki aag mein jalte Rudra ke saamne Ronnie ka baap Vikram khada hua, jisne Tilasmi Masters aur Grandmasters ki madad li. Lekin wo nahi jaanta tha—Rudra hi un sabka Supreme Grandmaster tha. Kya Rudra apna badla poora kar paaya?

kalyanam-on-contract.title: Kalyanam On Contract
kalyanam-on-contract.description: మధుమతి భర్త విక్రాంత్. కానీ అతన్ని ఆ ఇంట్లో పనివాడిలా చూస్తారు. ప్రాణంగా ప్రేమిస్తున్న మధుమతి తనను కేర్ చేయకపోయినా అతను అదే ఇంట్లో ఉంటాడు. కాలం ఎప్పుడూ ఒకేలా ఉండదు కదా. విక్రాంత్ మారాడు. దానికి కారణం ఏంటి? మధుమతి ఏం చేసింది? చూడండి కళ్యాణం ఆన్ కాంట్రాక్ట్ మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

my-homeless-billionaire-husband-9.title: My Homeless Billionaire Husband
my-homeless-billionaire-husband-9.description: A woman, heartbroken by a public breakup due to class divides, enters a temporary marriage of convenience. Her new husband's hidden identity as a powerful CEO unravels, plunging their relationship into a gripping mystery of deception and corporate intrigue. As genuine feelings grow, they face vengeful plots, manipulation, and betrayals. Despite the turmoil, a grand wedding is prepared, suggesting a resolution to their complex romance.

ceo-ki-ghar-wapasi.title: CEO Ki Ghar Wapasi
ceo-ki-ghar-wapasi.description: Arjun, a visionary CEO, mysteriously abandons his company and village for five years to serve as a covert RAW agent, leaving his wife Gauri and son behind. Upon his return, now a wealthy CEO, he is scorned by his family and the community for his perceived abandonment and poverty, finding Gauri engaged to Suraj, who has supported the village. Bound by national security, Arjun cannot reveal his true past, leading to heartbreak and a reluctant agreement to divorce Gauri, despite their marriage still being legally binding. He then strategically attempts to win Gauri back and transform the community with development projects, enduring public humiliation, accusations of deceit, and rejection from his family, while Suraj often claims credit for his efforts. Arjun dramatically seizes control of a powerful company but is immediately accused of theft and fraud, leading to his imprisonment. Gauri, also referred to as Dhara, makes a painful sacrifice, agreeing to divorce Suraj to secure Arjun's freedom. Arjun uncovers a massive corruption scheme within the village development deal, alienating villagers blinded by promised wealth. It is later revealed that Arjun is the son of powerful CEO Mr. Raheja, shifting power dynamics, even as Gauri unknowingly betrays him by signing an exploitative contract. Arjun ultimately triumphs as a visionary leader, exposing corruption, fulfilling his promises to uplift the village, and dramatically revealing his past as a CEO and former RAW agent. However, this public vindication is met with personal heartbreak as Gauri, consumed by guilt over a past betrayal of trust and unaware of his newly revealed status, serves him divorce papers. Despite this, Gauri rejects a manipulative suitor, realizing her enduring love for Arjun, who then relentlessly pursues her, vowing to reclaim their sacred vows amidst her sudden family crisis.

the-sweeper-billionaire.title: The Sweeper Billionaire
the-sweeper-billionaire.description: Tarun, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Sneha, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

love-lottery.title: Love Lottery
love-lottery.description: Ayush, a humble street chaat wala vendor, unexpectedly inherits a ₹2000 crore sweets empire after a mysterious encounter. True love Pooja is forced to leave him due to family pressures, pulling Ayush into an emotional battle alongside his rise to power.  Ayush fights back with courage and intelligence In the end, he exposes the truth, defeats his enemies, and wins back both his rightful position and his love.

maharani-the-substitute-bride-2.title: Maharani - The Substitute Bride
maharani-the-substitute-bride-2.description: Maharani, the substitute bride, is a political family drama set against the backdrop of dynastic Indian politics. The series explores how women, often treated as pawns in the game of power, can become players who change the very rules of the game. At its heart, the story is a love story born out of compulsion, evolving into a political partnership of equals. Through betrayal, corruption, and power struggles, Anandi and Arjun’s journey reflects themes of loyalty. Watch Now.

one-week-cm.title: One Week CM
one-week-cm.description: From delivering food to delivering justice, Vikram becomes the Chief Minister for just seven days to take down a corrupt political empire. Using his secret tech team, he exposes massive scams, but now the powerful elite have ordered a deadly hit on him. As assassins storm his house, Vikram starts one last live stream to reveal the ultimate evidence to the world. With the clock ticking, will he finish the broadcast before the screen goes black?

jaadugar-romeo.title: Jaadugar Romeo
jaadugar-romeo.description: Romeo's journey begins in desperation, struggling to save his ailing mother amidst his materialistic wife's betrayal and an abusive boss. After a near-death experience, he gains the extraordinary ability to see life countdowns, but tragically loses his mother due to unpaid medical bills, a situation worsened by his wife's affair with the wealthy Prateek. Seeking justice, Romeo exposes his corrupt employer and later discovers a new power to perceive objects' true monetary value, which he uses to his advantage. His path intertwines with Saloni, a woman who recognizes him from a past accident and is warned of her impending death, a prophecy that binds their fates. Saloni, revealed as a hospital owner's daughter, clears Romeo's debts and dramatically declares herself his wife, initially for a marriage of convenience to secure her inheritance and believing him to be her destined protector. Thrust into Saloni's opulent world, Romeo faces class-based judgment but uses his life-span perception to save a child and exposes fake antiques, publicly humiliating her family. This integrity earns him a powerful patriarch's business offer. Romeo's fortunes dramatically shift with the discovery of a massive coal mine, leading to alliances with powerful figures like 'Uncle' and the formidable Bhai Ji. Leveraging his newfound influence, Romeo orchestrates ruthless revenge against his ex-fiancée Ankita and Prateek, leading to their complete financial and social ruin. Amidst his vengeful triumphs, Romeo's bond with Saloni deepens, culminating in plans for their marriage with his mother's approval. However, new threats emerge as Saloni's ambitious grandson, Avinash, plots against them, using Rishabh as a pawn to seize their property and trap Saloni. Romeo dramatically rescues Saloni from these schemes, solidifying their romantic connection. An assassination attempt on Romeo ignites a gang war, revealing a larger criminal underworld and Avinash as the mastermind behind an impending attack. The conflict escalates into a desperate fight for survival, involving a high-stakes car chase and shootout, with attackers explicitly targeting Saloni. Subsequently, Pratik, his fiancée, and an accomplice are arrested for murder based on a video confession, which Pratik vehemently denies, even as he is shown caring for a vulnerable Saloni.

royal-prince-returns-2.title: Royal Prince Returns
royal-prince-returns-2.description: கரண் சிறுவயதிலேயே தாயின் அன்பை இழந்தவன். பெரியவனானபோது, சமீரா அவனைத் தள்ளிப் போனாள். தன்னை காதலிப்பதாக நம்ப வைத்துத் துரோகம் செய்த சமீராவை கரண் எப்படி நேருக்கு நேர் எதிர்கொண்டான்? கேக் விற்பனை செய்து வாழ்க்கையை நடத்தும் ஒரு இளைஞனின் கதை

joker-ka-wild-card.title: Joker Ka Wild Card
joker-ka-wild-card.description: Varun looks like a harmless, childlike man who has lost his memory, but behind that innocence lies a mysterious past and terrifying skill. When a ruthless gambling syndicate traps his wife’s family in an 8-crore debt, Varun steps onto the gambling table himself. With brilliant tricks and fearless mind games, he begins exposing the cheats of the underworld. But who is Varun really… and why does the gambling world fear the name Sikandar?

her-luxury-affair-2.title: Her Luxury Affair
her-luxury-affair-2.description: The story follows a chain of romantic lies, class conflict, and power struggles that keep turning private relationships into public crises. It begins with a woman who, desperate to ease her grandmother’s worry about failing health, claims she is engaged even though the plan is false. When the supposed fiancé rejects her and later publicly ends the engagement over status differences, she is left humiliated and vulnerable. A protective outsider steps in after she is insulted and assaulted, and he offers a temporary marriage arrangement meant to comfort the ailing grandmother. That private deal is quickly made public by family pressure, and the new bond begins to deepen through care, transformation, and trust. The woman’s former lover refuses to let go, repeatedly attacking the new man’s class and status and trying to reclaim her. His harassment escalates into threats against her family’s food-cart livelihood and home, showing that he is willing to use both personal cruelty and social power. The conflict widens into the corporate world, where a powerful executive presence is introduced as merciless toward anyone who crosses him. A major reversal follows when the seemingly humble prospective son-in-law is revealed to be the CEO of Amarendra Builders, and he uses that authority to punish the employee who threatened his future wife’s family. From there, the romance shifts into a softer but still unstable phase, with the powerful man wanting to be loved for himself rather than for his wealth. In another thread, luxury itself becomes a weapon and a temptation as a wealthy heiress draws a man into extravagant gifts like a Ferrari and an expensive Rolex. That luxury world is shadowed by manipulation, because another man is shown tracking spending and claiming control over the money behind it. Car disputes, blame games, and public confrontations then spiral into police involvement, bribery attempts, and threats of violence. Hidden ownership and documentary proof repeatedly overturn assumptions, exposing how fragile status can be when real value is revealed. The pressure then turns inward, as financial betrayal, card cancellations, and revenge tactics are used to control relationships and expose secrets. A separate corporate-marital scandal grows around fraud, infidelity, and a damaged luxury car, eventually pushing a marriage toward divorce and public collapse. In the later stretch, hospital emergencies, prison testimony, kidnapping, and forced document signing raise the stakes even further. Across these intertwined arcs, love is repeatedly tested by deception, while wealth, reputation, and family duty drive the characters into escalating reversals. The overall show builds on the tension between genuine care and strategic manipulation, with each apparent victory threatened by a new exposure or betrayal.

mai-jhoota-tu-jhooti.title: Mai Jhoota Tu Jhooti
mai-jhoota-tu-jhooti.description: Two childhood lovers reunite and rush into marriage, believing they’ve found love beyond money. But there’s a twist—both are secretly billionaires, pretending to be poor. As lies pile up, their relationship is tested by ego, humiliation, and hidden truths. When reality finally hits, will their love survive the biggest secret of all… or shatter forever?

her-luxury-affair-3.title: Her Luxury Affair
her-luxury-affair-3.description: Rudhra thinks his life is under control until his wife Trisha starts hiding the truth. What looks like a normal marriage slowly turns into a dangerous game of lies and betrayal. As Rudhra gets closer to the truth, every step puts him in more trouble. In the end, the real question is not what Trisha did, but how far Rudhra will go once he finds out.

7856ed9a-e28b-4997-a1b5-033e80d6a49a.title: The Quran
7856ed9a-e28b-4997-a1b5-033e80d6a49a.description: This is the Quran, the holy book of Islam, revealed by God to Prophet Muhammad. We've made it simple and easy for everyone to understand. Listen and enjoy!

കുറുവാസംഘം-കഥകളും-സത്യവും.title: കുറുവാസംഘം- കഥകളും സത്യവും
കുറുവാസംഘം-കഥകളും-സത്യവും.description: "മുഖം മറച്ച് മേലാകെ എണ്ണയും കരിയും പൂശി ഇരുളിൽ അവർ പതിഞ്ഞിരിപ്പുണ്ട്, ഏത് സമയവും വീടിൻ്റെ വാതിൽ തകർത്ത് അവർ കടന്ന് വരാം, അസാമാന്യ കായികശേഷിയും ആയുധപാടവവും കൈമുതലായുളള അവർ എതിരിടുന്നവരെ നിഷ്ഠൂരം വകവരുത്തും", അടുത്ത് കാലത്തായി മലയാളികളുടെ സ്വൈര്യജീവിതത്തിനു മേൽ വീണ ഭീതിയാണു ഈ വിവരണം. തമിഴ്‌നാട്ടിലെ തിരുച്ചിറപ്പള്ളിക്കടുത്തുളള ഒരു പ്രത്യേക ഗ്രാമവാസികളാണു കുറുവാസംഘങ്ങൾ എന്ന പേരിൽ കുപ്രസിദ്ധരായത് . ആരാണു ഇവർ? എന്താണു ഇവരുടെ രീതികൾ? ഈ ഓഡിയോ ഷോയിലൂടെ കേൾക്കൂ, കുറുവകളുടെയും ലോകമാകെ കുപ്രസിദ്ധി നേടിയ മറ്റ് സമാന കുറ്റവാളിഗോത്രങ്ങളുടെയും ചരിത്രം.

easy-pika-ai-guide-hindi-mein.description: Easy Pika AI Guide Hindi Mein

പുരാണങ്ങളിലെ-രതികഥകൾ.title: പുരാണങ്ങളിലെ രതികഥകൾ
പുരാണങ്ങളിലെ-രതികഥകൾ.description: ദൈവകഥകൾ എങ്കിലും മനുഷ്യ സാധാരണമായ സകലവിധ വികാരങ്ങൾക്കും ഭാരതീയ പുരാണേതിഹാസങ്ങളിൽ ഇടമുണ്ട്. ഭയവും, ക്രോധവും, ദയയും, പകയും എന്നത് പോലെ തന്നെ സ്നേഹവും കാമവും ആ കഥകളിൽ പ്രതിപാദിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു. രേണുകയും ഇന്ദ്രനും, അഗ്നിയും സ്വാഹയും, ശിവനും മോഹിനിയും, ഉർവ്വശിയും ശന്തനുവും, വൈശാലിയും ഋഷ്യശൃംഗനും, പരാശരനും മത്സ്യഗന്ധിയും എന്നിങ്ങനെ പുരാണേതിഹാസങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നുള്ള അതിസുന്ദരങ്ങളായ രതിപ്രധാന കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്കിലൂടെ..

karma-yoga-2.title: Karma Yoga
karma-yoga-2.description: ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ವಿವೇಕಾನಂದರ "ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗ" ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಸ್ವಾರ್ಥ ಸೇವೆಯ ಮಾರ್ಗವಾದ ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಫಲಾಪೇಕ್ಷೆಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದು, ನಿಸ್ವಾರ್ಥ ಸೇವೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಯ ಮೂಲ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮಯೋಗವನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ.

steve-jobs-6.title: Steve Jobs
steve-jobs-6.description: ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಯ ಮಹಾನ್ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನದ ನಾಯಕ ಸ್ಟೀವ್ ಜಾಬ್ಸ್ ಅವರ ಜೀವನ ಚರಿತ್ರೆಯ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವಿದು. ಆ್ಯಪಲ್ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಸಂಸ್ಥಾಪಕರಾದ ಇವರ ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಧನೆಗಳ ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಕಥನ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ವೈಫಲ್ಯದಿಂದ ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ತುತ್ತತುದಿಯವರೆಗಿನ ಅವರ ಪಯಣ, ನಾವೀನ್ಯತೆಯ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ಅವರ ಅಪಾರ ಹಂಬಲ, ಮತ್ತು ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದ ಅವರ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನವನ್ನು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಬಹುದು. ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ, ಡಿಸೈನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರು ತಂದ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಕಾರಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳ ಆಳವಾದ ನೋಟ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ.
