bulletproof-ishq.title: Bulletproof Ishq
bulletproof-ishq.description:
A feared builder RD's life is saved by an innocent girl, Heer sparking a bond that turns dangerously intimate.
 As she uncovers his son’s betrayal, she becomes the target of brutal humiliation and cruelty. When she hits rock bottom, the man she saved rises as her protector, exposing a truth that shatters his own family.  In the end, love survives but only after betrayal, blood, and a legacy destroyed from within.

the-bads-of-boardroom-4.title: The Ba***ds of Boardroom
the-bads-of-boardroom-4.description: Nandini, a resilient new mother and CEO, initially battles for acceptance within the powerful Heaven's Group dynasty, facing relentless opposition from the controlling matriarch, Pavitra. Her husband, Pratyush, is conflicted, navigating a tense love triangle while collaborating with Pavitra in a sinister scheme. The couple's newborn son faces a critical medical crisis and is later abducted, leading Nandini on a desperate fight to reclaim her child and expose the betrayal. As Pavitra's influence grows, claiming maternity and becoming the child's preferred caretaker, Nandini vows revenge amidst corporate intrigue and a looming custody battle. The narrative then reveals a complex web of corporate intrigue, where CEO Pranav is caught in a love triangle, and he and Pavitra conspire to usurp Nandini's multi-million dollar home and the Heavens Group. A shocking revelation at a chess championship exposes Pranav as not Nandini's biological son, igniting a fierce power struggle. Pavitra dramatically declares herself Pranav's biological mother, presenting proof and vowing revenge, leading Pranav to reject Nandini. Nandini's world shatters, but she hints at her own powerful revenge, culminating in a public divorce where she reveals her meticulous orchestration of their downfall. Stripped of her corporate empire and publicly humiliated, Nandini, with her father, orchestrates an intricate plan involving the powerful Roshan Deshpande, whose company is set to take over her former empire. At a high-profile party, Nandini confronts her tormentors, referencing an 18-year-old betrayal that cost her a child and issuing a chilling warning to Pavitra. Multi-billionaire Roshan then introduces Nandini as his long-hidden mother, sparking public accusations, and is later revealed as the long-lost son of powerful patriarch Prithvi. Roshan, driven by vengeance and Nandini's influence, launches a ruthless corporate takeover of Prithvi and Pranav's company. A sinister plot by Roshan to drug Nandini ultimately reveals him as her biological son, confirming the 18-year-old betrayal. Nandini discovers her child was swapped at birth, a betrayal orchestrated by her husband Pratyush and his accomplice Pavitra, and her illegitimate child is the rightful heir to a corporate empire. Roshan, the biological father, uncovers a wider web of manipulation and orchestrates the downfall of Pratyush and Pavitra as an act of vengeance. The conflict culminates in a dangerous hostage situation where Pratyush threatens Roshan's life, demanding Nandini's assets, and a subsequent kidnapping of Nandini's son, forcing a colossal ransom payment. Amidst the chaos, a family reclaims an ancestral ring, symbolizing their enduring resolve for retribution and justice.

son-of-don.title: Son of Don
son-of-don.description: The microdrama begins with Ajay, a young man preparing for his wedding to Yaazhini, unaware of his true parentage and the dark legacy that shadows him. He soon discovers he is adopted, and his biological father, Adhikesavam, was a notorious underworld figure brutally murdered, thrusting Ajay into a complex web of hidden identities and familial betrayals. A 25-year-old vendetta, driven by Veni's desire for inheritance, targets Ajay, placing his life in imminent danger. Simultaneously, Yaazhini's own wedding day is threatened by a ruthless patriarch, Anna, who seeks to seize her family's fortune and force her marriage to his son, Vishal. The threats escalate dramatically as Ajay's biological mother, Karuna, along with Malini, orchestrate relentless assassination attempts and ruthlessly strip him of his properties and family connections to seize his inheritance. Ajay endures brutal torture and coercion, steadfastly refusing to abandon Yaazhini, even as his wedding is hijacked and Vishal is set to marry her. Yaazhini, in turn, faces imprisonment, blackmail, and forced marriage plots from her tyrannical father and the manipulative Malini, with Ajay's life often used as leverage, pushing her to contemplate suicide. The narrative takes a dramatic turn with the miraculous return of Aadi Keshavan, Ajay's biological father, who was presumed dead after an assassination attempt. Aadi Keshavan, a powerful crime boss, orchestrates his own chilling retribution, exposing Malini as the true orchestrator of a sinister plot targeting Ajay and seeking vengeance against all who betrayed him. He initiates a "lifetime punishment" for those who harmed his child, with Ajay becoming both a target and an executor of this justice. In a climactic confrontation, Ajay delivers a chilling act of retribution, crippling his mother, Chandra, for her betrayals. Amidst these intense conflicts, a traditional wedding proceeds, hinting at a fragile truce built on secrets and unresolved family crises, leaving the future uncertain but with a sense of brutal justice having been served.

billionaires-journey-from-kanpur-to-lond.title: Billionaire's Journey From Kanpur To London
billionaires-journey-from-kanpur-to-lond.description: A secret billionaire endures years of abuse from his ungrateful wife in London before reclaiming his Indian empire and a new life. After a high-stakes plane crisis, he finds true love with a kind flight attendant who respected him even when he posed as a lowly cleaner. When his bankrupt ex-wife unknowingly returns to beg for his investment, she is publicly exposed and disgraced. The humble hero and his new queen ultimately unite their worlds of immense wealth and rural tradition.

the-magical-husband.title: The Magical Husband
the-magical-husband.description: The microdrama centers on Anirudh Simha, a powerful but reckless young man with extraordinary abilities and a mysterious destiny, and Ruchitha Varma, a brilliant, physically challenged businesswoman fighting to save her family's company and reclaim a significant past debt from the wealthy Simha family. Their paths converge when Anirudh, revealed as the Simha son, agrees to a forced arranged marriage with Ruchitha, initially driven by his family's financial ruin and his own desire for revenge. Despite public humiliation and the revelation that their union is a contractual fabrication for Ruchitha's ailing grandmother, Anirudh's protective instincts grow. He uncovers a sinister plot by Ruchitha's relatives, Gowtham, Maadhavi, her uncle, and aunt, who are slowly poisoning her to seize her inheritance. Anirudh, possessing divinely bestowed healing abilities, dedicates himself to protecting Ruchitha, searching for genuine medicinal herbs amidst a corrupt market. Through his efforts, Ruchitha miraculously regains her ability to walk, attributing her healing to Anirudh's "magic power," and encourages him to embrace his mystical gifts for humanity. However, Anirudh's estranged younger brother, Rahul, returns, poisons Anirudh, and strips him of his powers, leading to Anirudh's public downfall when he fails to heal a dying father and is accused of fraud. Rahul then publicly exposes Anirudh as a fraud, demonstrating his own authentic supernatural powers. After a spiritual journey with his Master, Anirudh regains his abilities and intervenes to heal Ruchitha's grandmother, Bamma, who was also being poisoned, thereby vindicating himself and confirming the relatives' plot. The conflict escalates into a bitter sibling rivalry between Anirudh and Rahul over Ruchitha and her inheritance, involving a mysterious ring and violent confrontations. Anirudh ultimately embraces his destiny as a hero, embarking on a new quest with a mysterious woman, while Ruchitha faces a battle for survival against her treacherous relatives.

the-hidden-waris.title: The Hidden Waris
the-hidden-waris.description: A self-made tycoon, Deep Shah, hides his roots as the son of a humble security guard. When his father arrives in Mumbai, he’s brutally humiliated by the same elite world Deep now rules. As truth unravels, power flips—exposing class arrogance, testing loyalty, and setting the stage for a ruthless reckoning.

the-bads-of-boardroom-1.title: The Ba***ds of Boardroom
the-bads-of-boardroom-1.description: The Ba***ds of Boardroom is an engaging story of a mother sacrifices everything to raise a child she believes is hers. Betrayal, greed, and blood ties collide inside boardrooms and bedrooms alike. When the final chess move is revealed, only one woman stands victorious. Watch now.

her-ex-between-us-2.title: Her Ex Between Us
her-ex-between-us-2.description: Akash marries Manasa believing love can change fate only to become invisible in his own marriage. Humiliated, replaced, and broken, he walks away in silence… unaware that destiny is about to make him the most powerful man in the room.

prince-paanwaale.title: Prince Paanwala
prince-paanwaale.description:
This drama blends romance, revenge, hidden identity, and high-society power politics. At its heart is Ramya  Rajgeer, the secret heiress of a business empire and the anonymous genius designer “Miss Pearl.” After being humiliated by her opportunistic boyfriend, she impulsively marries Aasman Oberoi—unaware that he too is hiding his real identity as the billionaire head of the Oberoi Group.
Their contract marriage slowly transforms into real love, while enemies from both sides attempt to destroy them. The show explores ego clashes, family honor, ambition, betrayal, and redemption in the glamorous yet ruthless world of business dynasties.

battle-of-babes.title: Battle of Babes
battle-of-babes.description: Fake it till you make it? Not when the real deal is watching. When Aarohi, the actual heir to the Purohit empire, sees a faker soaking up all the fame, things turn savage. Watch the drama unfold in this no-holds-barred identity war! Watch Now!

pyaar-ka-qatal.title: Pyaar Ka Qatal
pyaar-ka-qatal.description: “Pyaar Ka Qatal” is a poignant tale of love, betrayal, and redemption. Ajay, a devoted but struggling man, gives everything for his wife Mouni and daughter, only to be humiliated and betrayed when Mouni chooses wealth and status over him. Heartbroken yet resilient, Ajay rebuilds himself into a successful entrepreneur. When he returns, the story unfolds a powerful journey of regret, truth, and the real meaning of love. Watch now!

the-hidden-hero-4.title: The Hidden Hero
the-hidden-hero-4.description: Kiran is a very wealthy man, but unable to find happiness in money, he steps away from his life and joins a café as a waiter. Finding joy in his work, his life takes many unexpected turns. Watch this engaging drama 'The Hidden Hero' on Kuku TV

raw-agent-vs-delivery-boy-3.title: Raw Agent vs Delivery Boy
raw-agent-vs-delivery-boy-3.description: When delivery rider Kabir Deshmukh meets billionaire CEO Anika in a blind-date mix-up, her daughter Ishita fast-tracks him into a sham marriage to give her mother a partner she can trust. Kabir’s integrity wins hearts, but his mysterious past and enemies in Anika’s world ignite a war that forces him to reveal he’s actually ex-RAW agent Rudra Verma.

medico-vs-bilionarios.title: Médico vs Bilionários
medico-vs-bilionarios.description: The microdrama opens with the sudden, life-threatening collapse of young Arya, whose heart stops, plunging her grandfather, Vovô, into grief and denial. Her father, Paresh, a dedicated medical professional, embarks on a desperate race against time to reach the hospital, but his urgent mission is repeatedly thwarted by a series of unforeseen and cruel obstacles, including a car collision with a demanding, wealthy woman who forces him into humiliating acts of servitude. Concurrently, Dr. Raghunath, a specialist crucial to Arya's survival, is brutally waylaid and held captive by ruthless thugs demanding an exorbitant ransom, while his female captor harbors a personal vendetta against him for past deceptions. A terrifying realization dawns on Dr. Raghunath and his wife that the critically ill child, also referred to as Neelima, might indeed be their own daughter, Arya, previously believed safe. Amidst this chaos, Paresh Kumar, identified as Arya's grandfather, struggles with a massive debt and faces escalating extortion plots to secure funds for her treatment. Roshan and Nilima, fueled by vengeance and misunderstanding, blackmail Dr. Raghunath into a false confession and a significant debt, believing him responsible for their suffering and Arya's plight. Roshan and Lili, Arya's parents, embark on a frantic and increasingly violent search for their missing daughter, confronting hospital administration and a mysterious tormentor who uses Arya's critical condition as 'punishment for their mistake.' They are extorted and forced to retract their blackmail against Dr. Raghunath, unknowingly tormenting the very doctor who could save their child. After a devastating false alarm regarding another child's death, Arya is found in critical condition, leading to a furious confrontation with her paternal grandfather. Roshan ultimately confesses to being the 'negative influence' who tormented the doctor who saved Arya, revealing the complex web of revenge and misunderstanding. Overwhelmed by guilt, Arya's parents beg Dr. Raghunath for forgiveness, who in turn questions Arya's capacity to forgive them. The couple receives a six-month punishment, framed as a necessary lesson in accountability, as deep-seated tensions resurface within the family, hinting at the enduring impact of their 'Sabaki' or lesson.

unknown-connection-4.title: Unknown Connection
unknown-connection-4.description: The show centers on Ankita’s struggle to reclaim her dignity, her children, and the truth behind a long chain of lies. She is first shamed for giving birth out of wedlock and then told her twins died, though the surrounding events suggest they were taken from her instead. As she tries to survive family rejection and workplace sabotage, other women around her are also forced into deceptive arrangements, including fake marriages, contract-like partnerships, and public performances of family life. A widowed father and his children repeatedly search for a mother figure, and a mistaken rescue leads the children to embrace Sindhu as “Amma,” raising the emotional stakes around identity and belonging. Ankita’s path keeps crossing with men who hide their real status, especially Rahul and Arjun, whose lies about class and identity complicate every relationship they enter. At AJ Fashion House, Ankita’s professional life becomes another battlefield as plagiarism accusations, rivalry, and public humiliation threaten her career. The story then widens into a family mystery when a severe medical emergency and a doctor’s insistence on honesty force buried truths to the surface. Arjun is eventually exposed as the powerful CEO behind the disguise, and his connection to Ankita becomes impossible to ignore. Ankita learns that the children she believed lost are alive, and that they are tied to a wealthy family that abandoned and disowned her. Even when Arjun publicly defends her work and tries to repair the damage, Ankita remains torn between anger, grief, and the possibility of love. Aradhya’s return adds another layer of conflict, since she is tied to the children and to Arjun’s past, and her presence keeps reopening old wounds. The children themselves become central to the emotional conflict, because they are repeatedly used as leverage in adult disputes and custody-like struggles. Across the show, family is treated as both refuge and weapon, with mothers, fathers, and stepfamilies all competing over who gets to claim the children. The romance threads are never separate from the mystery threads; every confession about love also exposes a lie about parentage, status, or betrayal. By the end of the batch, the story has shifted into a larger reckoning over stolen children, hidden identities, and revenge against those responsible. The core stakes remain whether Ankita can recover her children, clear her name, and decide whom she can trust after so many betrayals.

meu-marido-bilionario-sem-teto.title: Meu Marido Bilionário Sem-teto
meu-marido-bilionario-sem-teto.description:
Você não é meu namorado de verdade, é só de mentira”, disse Aakriti ao transformar um mendigo sem-teto, Shashwat, em seu namorado falso. Mas ela não sabia que Shashwat acabaria se apaixonando por ela.
Como Shashwat pode contar a Aakriti que, na verdade, ele é um bilionário disfarçado? Sem revelar seu segredo, como ele conseguirá convencê-la de seu amor? E por que, mesmo sendo tão rico, ele vive como um mendigo sem-teto?
Nesse jogo de poder, traição e amor, será que Shashwat conseguirá vencer?

her-ex-between-us-1.title: Her Ex Between Us
her-ex-between-us-1.description: Akash marries Mansi believing love can change fate only to become invisible in his own marriage. Humiliated, replaced, and broken, he walks away in silence… unaware that destiny is about to make him the most powerful man in the room.

esposa-de-mentira.title: Esposa de Mentira
esposa-de-mentira.description: Daniel's five-year contract marriage to Nora concludes, revealing his deep, unrequited love for her, while Nora appears intent on reuniting with her first love, Roger. Despite Daniel's devotion and a life-threatening proposal, Nora accepts with uncertainty, often prioritizing Roger and allowing her family and friends to openly disparage Daniel. Nora's infidelity with Roger becomes evident, leading Daniel to confront her and demand a divorce, enduring constant abuse and humiliation from Nora and her associates, who even frame him for theft. Heartbroken but resolute, Daniel accepts a new career opportunity with a mysterious condition, secretly planning a meticulous revenge against those who wronged him. He mysteriously vanishes, leaving Nora to discover divorce papers and, despite initial suspicions, begin a search for him, uncovering clues about his past and a secret contract. Daniel dramatically resurfaces, now a self-made billionaire, revealing his five-year marriage to Rebeca was also a calculated contract. Public accusations of fraud and

her-ex-between-us.title: Her Ex Between Us
her-ex-between-us.description: Akash marries Manasa believing love can change fate only to become invisible in his own marriage. Humiliated, replaced, and broken, he walks away in silence… unaware that destiny is about to make him the most powerful man in the room.

gruham.title: Gruham
gruham.description: Watch Gruham only on kuku tv!

um-casamento-inesperado.title: Um Casamento Inesperado
um-casamento-inesperado.description: Uma mulher começa a se apaixonar por seu chefe encantador enquanto se adapta a um novo emprego, mas uma verdade oculta complica tudo — ela já é casada com um homem que mal conhece. Seus encontros raros deixaram o relacionamento deles como uma sombra esquecida de um compromisso.

mistaken-fatman-1.title: Mistaken Fatman
mistaken-fatman-1.description:
A lonely, overweight billionaire hiding deep trauma was a successful bodybuilder once. 
As greed, betrayal, and fake friendships close in, only love can save him—or finish him.

a-milionaria-humilhada-pela-cunhada.title: A Milionária Humilhada pela Cunhada
a-milionaria-humilhada-pela-cunhada.description: The microdrama centers on Sophie's perilous journey into a web of family secrets, betrayal, and a fierce battle for identity and survival. It begins with Sophie traveling to her wealthy brother Chris's wedding, immediately encountering tension with her abrasive sister, Raquel. On a flight, a demanding mother, later revealed as Chris's fiancée, and her son brazenly displace and assault an injured passenger, leading to a catastrophic accident. This injured passenger, initially identified as "The Other Woman," is later revealed to be Sophie herself, or a character with a similar arc, who has been having a secret affair with Chris, complicating her identity as his long-lost sister. As the situation spirals, Sophie faces relentless accusations of being a gold-digger, imposter, and home-wrecker, orchestrated primarily by Raquel, who is also Chris's sister and a powerful figure. Raquel, along with Chris's fiancée, subjects Sophie to public humiliation, false accusations of sabotage and drug possession, and brutal physical assaults. A sacred family heirloom, a necklace, becomes central to the conflict, used for blackmail and as a symbol of Sophie's true lineage as Chris's sister, a truth he struggles to accept amidst her severe heart condition. Chris, along with other allies like Neil Jori and Inspector Roshan, emerges as Sophie's fierce protector, defying powerful figures and risking his own safety to save her from Raquel's malicious schemes and the untouchable influence of D'Ore Industries, which ruthlessly destroys evidence. Chris's fiancée, driven by jealousy, actively obstructs efforts to save Sophie, leading to their engagement's dramatic cancellation. The narrative culminates in Chris uncovering the full extent of Raquel's villainy: she orchestrated the initial plane incident, spread lies about Sophie, used Jory Corporation for drug trafficking, and coerced her own sister into a "fake weapon" scheme to secure a marriage into the Jori family. The show explores the high-stakes battle for love, status, and justice within an elite society, as Chris seeks fierce retribution for Sophie's humiliation and assault, fighting to expose Raquel's corporate infiltration and criminal activities, and ultimately to protect his family's honor and Sophie's life.

billionaires-unknown-son-4.title: Billionaire's Unknown Son
billionaires-unknown-son-4.description: Mithun sacrifices his childhood for his mother… 20 years later, Tulasi betrays his love, and fate brings Ragini back for revenge. Watch 'Billionaire's Unknown Son' Only on KukuTV

the-hidden-hero-3.title: The Hidden Hero
the-hidden-hero-3.description: When a principled ex-commander hiding as a humble café worker saves a ruthless yet elegant CEO from a late-night assault, she tests his character with a fake marriage to uncover his weakness but as secrets surface and enemies close in, their staged relationship turns into a high-stakes game of power, loyalty, and unexpected love.

flight-to-hell.title: Flight To Hell
flight-to-hell.description: Suraj boards a flight with his wife, Sheena, desperate to reach their daughter in time for a life-saving surgery. But when a mysterious explosion destroys the plane, Suraj wakes up moments earlier, trapped in a deadly time loop. With only minutes before disaster strikes again, he must uncover the hidden bomb while battling disbelief from passengers and crew. As every reset brings new obstacles, can Suraj break the loop and save everyone on board?

billionaire-boyfriend-revenge.title: Billionaire Boyfriend Revenge
billionaire-boyfriend-revenge.description: When a fierce young businesswoman desperate to save her airline crosses paths mid-air with the mysterious owner of the very company she seeks investment from, an accidental encounter spirals into a web of romance, deception, and revenge where love takes flight, but power decides who lands safely.

the-hidden-boss.title: The Hidden Boss
the-hidden-boss.description: A billionaire CEO, Manav, secretly fakes his own downfall to trap his rival, Karan. On his wedding day, he’s publicly humiliated as “bankrupt,” and his new wife Ritika’s family turns against him. Despite insults and betrayal, Manav silently endures, hiding the truth as he tests love, loyalty, and prepares a powerful comeback.

royal-prince-returns-1.title: Royal Prince Returns
royal-prince-returns-1.description: చిన్నప్పుడు అమ్మ ప్రేమను దూరం చేసుకున్నాడు కరణ్. పెద్దయ్యాక సమీరా అతన్ని దూరం తోసేసింది. ప్రేమించానని నమ్మించి మోసం చేసిన సమీరాను కరణ్ ఎలా ఎదుర్కొన్నాడు. కేక్స్ అమ్ముకుంటూ జీవితం గడుపుతున్న ఓ యువకుడి కథ.

secret-legend-4.title: Secret Legend
secret-legend-4.description: వీర్.. అత్తగారింట్లో అన్ని పనులు చేస్తూ ఇల్లరికపు అల్లుడుగా జీవితం గడుపుతున్నాడు. అతన్నొక చేతకాని వాడిగా అందరూ చూస్తున్నారు. కానీ అతనికి ఒక ఫ్లాష్ బ్యాక్ ఉంది. ఆ ప్లాష్ బ్యాక్ ఇప్పుడు అందరి ముందుకు వస్తే జరిగే కథ మహా ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ గా ఉంటుంది. అసలేంటి ఫ్లాష్ బ్యాక్. చూడండి Secret Legend మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

Mere-सैयां-Arabpati.title: Mere सैयां Arabpati
Mere-सैयां-Arabpati.description:
A young bride’s dream wedding shatters when she catches her fiancé cheating—with her own sister. Thrown out by the only family she knew, Laila discovers she’s the lost heir of a powerful empire. Rising from betrayal to power, she returns—not for revenge, but to reclaim her worth and rewrite her destiny.
WATCH NOW

drowned-in-love-3.title: Drowned in Love
drowned-in-love-3.description: This is a love story between an artist who brings nature to life on canvas and a businessman who stands at the top of the corporate world. Like waves in the ocean, a series of events shape their lives, will those waves carry them safely to the shore, or pull them apart? You’ll have to watch to find out.

mistaken-fatman.title: Mistaken Fatman
mistaken-fatman.description: After his parents die in a tragic accident, champion bodybuilder Akhilan sinks into depression and anxiety. Stress drives him to overeating and he soon loses his fitness, fame and the respect he once commanded. As his lover turns against him, Akhilan hits rock bottom, facing humiliation and self-doubt. Refusing to give up, he accepts a daring challenge to reclaim his body and honor in just three months. Witness his powerful comeback journey in 'Mistaken Fat Man' streaming only on KukuTV.

angels-greatest-creation.title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
angels-greatest-creation.description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

loser-son-in-law-is-a-billionaire-3.title: Loser Son-in-law is a Billionaire
loser-son-in-law-is-a-billionaire-3.description: A humiliated son-in-law, living as a delivery boy, shocks everyone when his hidden identity as a billionaire heir is revealed. Betrayals, power struggles, and family wars ignite as he rises to claim his destiny.

return-of-the-racing-king.title: Return Of The Racing King
return-of-the-racing-king.description: Once a champion racer, Aryan Verma loses everything after betrayal by his adopted brother Kabir, who rigs a race, kills their parents, and takes his crown. Broken and forgotten, Aryan returns in disguise as Monty, a humble mechanic. When a struggling racing club puts its last hope on him, Monty must face his past, defeat Kabir, and reclaim his destiny on the track.

contract-love-5.title: Contract Love
contract-love-5.description: Mamatha is a beautiful young woman who becomes a victim of her younger sister Radhika’s deceit. At that time, Kaushal enters her life. While one represents true love, the other is driven by greed for money. This is a love story where contrasting mindsets and emotions intertwine.

the-richest-bank-robber.title: The Richest Bank Robber
the-richest-bank-robber.description: When billionaire Adarsh Sharma returns to India, a sudden accident leaves his parents critically injured. Stripped of proof of identity, he is ridiculed and denied access to his own wealth. As time runs out, desperation turns into rebellion, forcing him into a daring heist of his own bank. Amid greed, ego, and injustice, the story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, identity, and moral reckoning. Watch Now.

billionaire-boyfriends-revenge-2.title: Billionaire Boyfriend's Revenge
billionaire-boyfriends-revenge-2.description: A formidable Heiress CEO, initially known as the Heiress CEO and later as Aliya or Aalya, faces an ultimatum from her powerful grandfather: secure a major investment or find a husband to avoid a forced corporate marriage. A dramatic flight incident leads her to blackmail SkyJet CEO Shourya Kumar into a temporary contract marriage. While she pursues him for business and later for marriage, Shourya, also known as Shaurya, Surya, King, Skyjet, and ultimately Sky King, is simultaneously entangled in his past, dealing with a former lover, Divya, and a paternity claim involving Sharan, son of Mahendra. Shourya publicly denounces their marriage, prompting Aliya to relentlessly pursue him to uncover the truth behind their tumultuous union. As their relationship deepens, Aliya defies her grandfather's demand for an arranged business alliance, confessing her secret marriage to Shaurya, leading to her disownment. Despite familial opposition and accusations against Shaurya, Aliya remains determined to prove her competence and secure her family's empire. It is revealed that Shaurya, as the enigmatic Skyking and powerful CEO "King," orchestrated Aalya's meteoric corporate rise as part of a complex plan of vengeance against his fraudulent rival, Rudradev. He meticulously plans Rudradev's downfall, forming strategic alliances and navigating political power plays. Shaurya dramatically unmasks himself as the legendary "Sky King," the original Chairman of the Sky Jet empire, reversing power dynamics and exposing those who unknowingly leveraged his influence. He confronts formidable entities like the Rudradeva and Skyking families, facing public humiliation and accusations of betrayal, fiercely defended by his loyal friend and formidable grandmother. Amidst corporate warfare and personal threats from Rudhra, whistleblower Abhimanyu, and CEO Aravind, Shaurya undergoes a biometric scan to prove his immense wealth and identity, transferring a fortune to Aalya. He rejects his ex-fiancée Divya for her opportunism, solidifying a pragmatic alliance with Aalya, whose loyalty is tested as she persuades him to stop his dangerous charade.

invisible-jessi.title: Invisible Jessi
invisible-jessi.description: Jaya aka Jassi is a sweet, innocent, yet highly intelligent girl who longs for genuine friendships. However, she's constantly ignored and humiliated by those around her simply because she doesn't fit society's conventional standards of beauty. With braces on her teeth, a unique sense of style, and an unconventional haircut,Jaya aka Jassi is often judged by her appearance rather than her character.

secret-fiance-of-the-cm.title: Secret Fiancée Of The CM
secret-fiance-of-the-cm.description: Sara, a determined intern, gets caught in a dangerous political scandal involving rising leader Vyom Saxena after a mysterious night changes everything. As enemies plot to ruin him, Sara risks her career and identity to protect him—while hiding a truth that could destroy them both. In a world of power, lies, and love, one wrong move could change everythin

the-hidden-king-4.title: The Hidden King
the-hidden-king-4.description: RAW officer Tiger Pathan aka Akash enters a deadly prison to uncover the truth behind his sister Dr. Roshini’s death. Disguised as inmate Akash, he faces a corrupt prison warden and feared criminal Shankra. With the help of Doctor Kavya and inmate Riya, Sher uncovers a dark conspiracy. But inside these walls, trust is dangerous and justice is buried.

gymwala-billionaire.title: Gymwala Billionaire
gymwala-billionaire.description: Rajveer Sisodia, a principled gym trainer secretly a former CEO haunted by his sister's tragic murder, seeks vengeance while living a humble life. He becomes entangled with two wealthy sisters: the impulsive Shanaya, whom he rescues and forms a protective bond with, and her elder sister Diya, a CEO trapped in a loveless arranged marriage to Aryan Luthra. Shanaya accuses Aryan of causing Diya's paralysis, even as Diya remains determined to marry him for business reasons, while Shanaya herself is diagnosed with a neurological disorder. Simultaneously, Raj develops an unexpected romance with heiress Sukanya during her rehabilitation from an injury, an injury later revealed to be caused by the ruthless Aryan. This relationship sparks a fierce class and power struggle, as Sukanya's family, particularly her father, Lord Titan, pushes for her arranged marriage to Aryan. Aryan publicly humiliates Sukanya, revealing their engagement was a calculated business deal, and then strategically engages another heiress. Protected by Raj, Sukanya defies her father's patriarchal control and Aryan's ambition, choosing love over inheritance, leading to her disinheritance and loss of her company. Raj offers Sukanya refuge, training her in self-defense, and their love deepens amidst escalating threats from a vengeful Aryan and other antagonists. The narrative reveals Raj's true identity as the enigmatic and powerful "Lord Titan," a kingmaker who controls the government. Lord Titan uses his immense power to protect Sukanya, confronting corrupt figures and ultimately transferring ownership of his vast corporate empire to her, solidifying their engagement. Despite earlier romantic entanglements and Sukanya's initial rejection of his powerful persona, Rajveer Sisodia, embracing his dual identity as both gym trainer and Lord Titan, proposes marriage to Sukanya, who accepts. Their unique love story, however, is suddenly plunged into peril by an unexpected gunshot during a motorboat ride, leaving their future uncertain.

death-countdown-3.title: Death Countdown
death-countdown-3.description:
If a person knew exactly when death would come, how would they feel?
What happened to Uday, who gained the power to know when others would die?
How did he get that power? What did he do with it?
Watch “Death Countdown” on your Kuku TV

billionaire-daddy-on-duty.title: Billionaire Daddy on Duty
billionaire-daddy-on-duty.description: A ruthless corporate conspiracy, a night of betrayal, and a child born in tragedy bind two strangers together until a billionaire CEO disguises himself as a labourer and unknowingly steps into his own past, becoming a “rent-a-dad” to the son who might actually be his.

aadhipurush.title: Aadhipurush
aadhipurush.description: In a land ruled by three Gurukuls, a warrior sets out to awaken the seven chakras and prove his strength. Caught between two rival princesses, he uncovers his true identity and must face a higher power to claim his destiny.

hidden-crorepati.title: Hidden Crorepati
hidden-crorepati.description: A gripping tale of love, betrayal, and hidden identities,Hidden Crorepati follows Tanya, a secret tycoon posing as a receptionist, and Rajvir, a conflicted CEO. A fake marriage turns real amid power struggles and heartbreak. After tragedy and a shocking truth, Rajvir lives as a janitor—until his past returns, forcing him to confront love, loss, and destiny.

ceos-lost-bride-7.title: CEO's Lost Bride
ceos-lost-bride-7.description:
One reckless night binds a ruthless CEO to a woman fate refuses to let him forget.
When she walks into his office as an employee. But destiny twists cruelly as a new woman’s arrival fuels lies, jealousy, and half-heard truths. Broken trust leads to painful separation, leaving love buried under pride and regret. What comes next is a storm of revelations, longing, and a final battle between past mistakes and true love?

mid-life-romance-1.title: Mid Life Romance
mid-life-romance-1.description: A lonely ex-army man and a beautiful food-stall owner are brought together by fate and a child’s innocent wish. As he hides his true identity, their bond grows beyond love into healing and trust. But this connection leads her to a shocking truth—the daughter she lost may not be gone forever.

bastard-of-cricket.title: Bad Boys of Cricket
bastard-of-cricket.description: Superstar cricketer Ananya Mehra endures a life-threatening delivery, giving birth to a son, only for her manipulative husband Raghav and jealous sister Kavya to orchestrate a sinister baby swap, replacing Ananya's biological child with their own. Critically injured and betrayed, Ananya slowly uncovers the depth of their conspiracy to steal her child, her husband, and her entire empire. As Kavya openly claims the swapped child, Dhairya (later known as Veer), and Raghav continues his abuse, a mysterious protector, Aryaman, intervenes. The plot deepens as Kavya reveals herself as the biological mother of Veer, whom she raised for seventeen years, igniting a fierce maternal rivalry and a corporate power struggle. Veer, rebellious and spoiled, aligns with Kavya and Raghav in their scheme to seize Ananya's multi-million-dollar corporate empire, leading to Ananya's public humiliation and the loss of her assets, family, and dignity through a meticulously orchestrated corporate coup. However, Ananya calmly reveals that her devastating downfall was merely the first move in her own cunning plan for revenge. Her calculated resurgence begins with the dramatic revelation that powerful CEO Yuvraj Goenka is her son, a secret kept for eighteen years, who fiercely defends her against accusations from Kavya and Raghav. Yuvraj, driven by a personal vendetta, orchestrates hostile takeovers and exposes the intricate web of betrayals, including Kavya's ruthless plot to seize Ananya's corporate empire and the truth about the stolen child. Ananya, with the support of allies like Arjun Goenka, meticulously executes her revenge, leading to the arrests of Raghav and Veer for illegal transactions and corporate sabotage. The bitter sibling rivalry between Ananya and Kavya escalates, with Ananya orchestrating Kavya's downfall through accusations of infidelity. The conflict culminates in a violent standoff where Yuvraj is taken hostage, demanding a corporate transfer and ransom. Ananya, demonstrating a profound emotional connection, offers herself in his place, while Veer unexpectedly intervenes to protect her. The saga ultimately revolves around Ananya's fierce determination to reclaim her stolen child, her identity, her family's legacy, and her corporate empire, seeking justice and vindication against those who betrayed her.

secret-legend-3.title: Secret Legend
secret-legend-3.description: When humble masseur Veer Jindal is humiliated by his wife Simran and her family, they have no idea he is secretly the billionaire chairman of the powerful Choksi Group. As betrayals unfold and family ties are tested, Veer’s hidden identity shakes their world, exposing greed, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Watch Now!

bade-miyaan-deewane.title: Bade Miyaan Deewane
bade-miyaan-deewane.description: A frail old man, hunted by dacoits, awakens an ancient Jinn-e-Malika who grants him three wishes: a wife, eternal youth, and fatherhood. Transformed into the aging Khan, he marries three desperate cousin sisters—Guddi, Bitti, and Chitti—to escape a royal decree and a death sentence. Initially, Chitti revitalizes his dilapidated estate, but Khan's increasingly delusional and abusive nature soon traps his wives in a struggle for survival, leading them to contemplate drastic measures. Khan discovers his father-in-law's unjust imprisonment by Nawab Shamsher, igniting a personal vendetta for justice. He experiences multiple rejuvenations, gaining miraculous strength and growing younger, even becoming Raja Khan, and acquires more wives, eventually totaling five. Despite his renewed vitality, he struggles to provide for his burgeoning family in a barren environment. An impending war looms, compelling Khan (also known as Bade Miyan) to arm his household and decree that women must also become warriors, initiating brutal combat training. Powerful figures emerge, including the formidable Afreen, later revealed as General Jarnail Afrin, who leads her people against dacoits and returns from presumed death to expose truths that could shake the court. Amidst this turmoil, Khan, now Bundu Khan, is falsely accused of murder and branded a rebel, facing execution. He is dramatically saved by General Jarnaila Afreen, plunging her into further political battles. Upon his perilous return, he discovers all five of his wives are simultaneously pregnant, hinting at an impending twist for his family. Political intrigue deepens as Radha, one of his wives, orchestrates a rigged trial, condemning Dalbagh Khan while manipulating Bundu for her own ambitious agenda. A loyal woman, presumed dead, reappears to expose Dalbagh Khan's treacherous plot against the Nawab, revealing a hidden war of power and deception. The show explores themes of survival, justice, patriarchal duty, unexpected transformations, and the high stakes of power struggles.

battle-of-the-babes-3.title: Battle of the Babes
battle-of-the-babes-3.description: A new student, Anjali, orchestrates an elaborate deception, posing as the wealthy heiress Anjali Purushothaman to infiltrate an elite college, initially facing classist insults from peers unaware of her true identity. Her carefully constructed lie is immediately threatened by the arrival of the *real* heiress, Aarohi Purushothaman, who recognizes the impostor and vows to expose her. This ignites a fierce rivalry, marked by public confrontations, accusations of theft, and Anjali's cruel pranks, which only strengthen Aarohi's resolve. Anjali, often aided by a biased principal, attempts to humiliate Aarohi and maintain her fabricated social image, even orchestrating public shaming. However, Aarohi, also known as Rajakumari, strategically begins to dismantle Anjali's facade, exposing her lies about wealth and identity, particularly concerning the Purushothama Mansion. A complex love triangle emerges as Aakash, initially disdainful of "spoiled rich kids," fiercely defends Aarohi and later publicly declares his affection for her, further fueling Anjali's jealousy. The conflict deepens with the shocking revelation that Anjali is actually the daughter of a maid, while Aarohi is the true royal heiress, Princess Aarohi Purushothaman. Aarohi, with the help of Anjali's own father and a rekindled alliance with Aakash, gathers evidence to publicly expose Anjali's false identity. Despite Anjali's continued manipulation, blackmail, and attempts to sabotage Aarohi, including fabricated evidence and coercing friends, Aarohi plans a dramatic exposé. At a college festival and later during the "College Queen" announcement, Aarohi publicly reveals Anjali's deceptions about her age, academic history, and true parentage. The family patriarch ultimately confirms Aarohi as his sole heir, and an officer investigates Anjali for impersonation and the theft of a valuable family heirloom. Aarohi is unexpectedly crowned "College Queen," a triumph orchestrated by a strategist, publicly humiliating Anjali. Stripped of her false identity and status, Anjali is publicly disgraced but vows fierce revenge against Aarohi and her protector, indicating the rivalry is far from over. The show explores the high stakes of identity, social status, deception, and the fight for truth and rightful inheritance within an elite academic and social environment.

engineer-vs-billionaires-4.title: Engineer vs Billionaires
engineer-vs-billionaires-4.description: When a massive storm traps a ruthless billionaire and a humble engineer in a race against time, greed and conscience collide. As disaster looms over the Himalayan valley, one man’s arrogance meets another’s courage. From boardrooms to broken dams, Engineer vs Billionaires is a high-octane survival drama where nature takes revenge, power is tested, and redemption comes at the cost of pride.

delivery-boy-vs-billionaires.title: Delivery Boy Vs Billionaires
delivery-boy-vs-billionaires.description: In a glittering high-rise society where status is everything, a brutal misunderstanding spirals into a nightmare. When Bollywood superstar Kritika Kapoor collapses alone in her apartment due to a life-threatening illness, her fiancé—Arjun Sabarwal, a secretive billionaire and CEO of a fast-growing delivery empire—rushes to save her, disguised as a delivery boy.

fighter-ceo-4.title: Fighter CEO
fighter-ceo-4.description: After five years away, army officer Samrat returns to propose to his longtime love, only to be brutally rejected for being 'poor,' while his true identity as a billionaire CEO remains hidden. Heartbroken, he enters a contract marriage with ambitious businesswoman Priya, believing it to be nothing more than a deal. But everything changes when Samrat’s real power is dramatically revealed at a grand public event.

fake-waris.title: Fake Waris
fake-waris.description:
Aroshi, heir to Mittal Sweets and Namkeen, learns that her husband Shlok and best friend Riddhi swapped her newborn to seize her empire. She secretly reverses the switch and raises both boys, waiting 18 years for revenge.

On their 18th birthday, as Shlok and Riddhi plot to take over and kill her, Aroshi’s plan unfolds—revealing shocking truths, uniting her sons, and, with Raghu (the powerful RK Shekhawat), exposing the betrayal and reclaiming her legacy.

billionaire-boyfriends-revenge-1.title: Billionaire Boyfriend's Revenge
billionaire-boyfriends-revenge-1.description: When a fierce young businesswoman desperate to save her airline crosses paths mid-air with the mysterious owner of the very company she seeks investment from, an accidental encounter spirals into a web of romance, deception, and revenge — where love takes flight, but power decides who lands safely.

gun-gangster-aur-good-boy.title: Gun, Gangster Aur Good Boy
gun-gangster-aur-good-boy.description:
Mafia Girl is a high-voltage romantic crime drama with dark humor and emotional depth.
Mayra, who rules the underworld with fear, experiences love for the first time—with a man who has nothing but honesty.
Sunny, always exploited and underestimated, finally becomes someone worth fighting for.
The show explores class divide, toxic love, power politics, and emotional manipulation.
Every episode blends romance, danger, and drama with shocking twists.
At its heart, it asks—can love survive when it is born in violence?

bewafa-biwi-1.title: Bewafa Biwi
bewafa-biwi-1.description: Akash marries Mansi believing love can change fate only to become invisible in his own marriage. Humiliated, replaced, and broken, he walks away in silence… unaware that destiny is about to make him the most powerful man in the room.

tapori-ki-ceo-girlfriend.title: Tapori Ki CEO Girlfriend
tapori-ki-ceo-girlfriend.description: A broke delivery rider, Uday, accidentally crosses paths with Sameera, a powerful CEO. A simple accident spirals into misunderstandings, street fights, unlikely friendships, and a contract marriage request that changes everything. As two worlds collide, Uday must navigate pride, poverty, and opportunity in a city where luck can flip in a heartbeat.

drowned-in-love-2.title: Drowned in Love
drowned-in-love-2.description: A passionate artist, Needhi, and billionaire Nishchay — once lovers separated by deceit — reunite years later when fate brings them face to face through art. Hidden truths, betrayal, and redemption unfold as they discover their lost daughter and confront their manipulative past. The story ends with forgiveness, justice, and the family finally finding peace and love again. Watch now.

pyar-ka-turbulence.title: Pyar ka Turbulence
pyar-ka-turbulence.description: A pregnant woman fights for her life on a turbulent flight—only to discover her pilot husband abandoning her for another woman. After losing her baby and being framed as a murderer, she rises from betrayal and heartbreak to reclaim her power… returning as a mysterious aviation titan determined to expose the lies that destroyed her life.

billionaire-became-beggar-3.title: Billionaire Became Beggar
billionaire-became-beggar-3.description: Dharma Kamath lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Became Beggar is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

baazigaar-baaz.title: Baazigaar Baaz
baazigaar-baaz.description: The microdrama centers on Diksha's tumultuous engagement, which is repeatedly marred by family strife and external threats, primarily revolving around her brother, Devrath, also known by various names including Dev, Vikrant, Aryan, Baaz, and CEO Devraj Singh Baaz. Initially, Dev faces relentless public humiliation and physical assault due to his perceived lower social status, while Diksha grapples with societal expectations and her fiancé Vikas's disdain for her brother. Unbeknownst to Diksha, Vikas is a manipulative gold-digger planning to marry her for her fortune and then abandon her for his secret girlfriend. Amidst these personal struggles, a larger web of corporate and political intrigue unfolds, involving secret agents like Samrat and Siddharth, dangerous gangs, and figures like VK Khanna, all hinting at the elusive 'Baazigar Baaz.' The narrative escalates with themes of public shaming, false accusations, and the mysterious disappearance of a necklace used for manipulation, as Vikas Khanna orchestrates schemes to acquire land and demean Dev. However, Dev, initially a victim, begins to assert his hidden influence and executive role, challenging family hierarchies and protecting his sister's true desires. The engagement ceremony is further shattered by a mysterious, possessive man and Diksha becomes a victim of financial fraud by Vikas, prompting her brothers, Baz and Akshay, to intervene. The true identity of 'Baazigar Baz' is revealed to be Dev, who, as CEO Dev, delivers uncanny justice and demands restitution from embezzlers. The climax sees CEO Devraj Singh Baaz asserting his formidable authority, exposing his aunt's elaborate property fraud, confronting past bullies by revealing his ownership of a luxurious hotel, and ultimately ensuring the smooth progression of Diksha's engagement while undertaking a high-stakes covert mission to protect her. The show explores the stakes of Diksha's social standing and fortune, Dev's honor and his unwavering commitment to family protection, and the broader fight against corporate and personal betrayal.

maharani-the-substitute-bride-1.title: Maharani The Substitute Bride
maharani-the-substitute-bride-1.description: Maharani, the substitute bride, is a political family drama set against the backdrop of dynastic Indian politics. The series explores how women, often treated as pawns in the game of power, can become players who change the very rules of the game. At its heart, the story is a love story born out of compulsion, evolving into a political partnership of equals. Through betrayal, corruption, and power struggles, Anandi and Arjun’s journey reflects themes of loyalty. Watch Now.

my-grandpa-is-a-hidden-protector.title: My Grandpa Is A Hidden Protector
my-grandpa-is-a-hidden-protector.description: A brave little girl named Sia dreams of becoming a great warrior and finding her lost grandfather. When a princess arrives with a dangerous royal mission promising gold and power, Sia boldly accepts the challenge. But a ruthless demon gang threatens anyone who takes the task. Will Sia and her team survive the deadly journey and complete the mission?

battle-of-the-babes-2.title: Battle of the Babes
battle-of-the-babes-2.description: Fake it till you make it? Not when the real deal is watching. When Aarohi, the actual heir to the Pandiyas' empire, sees a faker soaking up all the fame, things turn savage. Watch the drama unfold in this no-holds-barred identity war!

final-190-minutes-1.title: Final 190 Minutes
final-190-minutes-1.description: Railway Minister Narendra Jha survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant in Patna. With flights grounded, the only hope is Dr. Nihal Mathur - brilliant, controversial, and just reinstated. He has 190 minutes to transport the donor heart and save the Minister. But the mission spirals when socialite Kamya Tiwari, her hot-headed brother Sunny, and her fiancé Kabir Jha sabotage his path with ego and revenge. Every delay pushes the clock closer to death. Watch now!

my-husband-is-the-boss.title: My Husband Is The Boss
my-husband-is-the-boss.description: A broken engagement, a public dowry humiliation, and a marriage decided within hours, Neha never imagined her life would change so drastically. Forced into a sudden wedding with Rohan, who claims to be poor, she enters a relationship built on misunderstandings and ego. But as secrets unfold, she discovers he is actually the city’s most powerful billionaire. Will this marriage turn into true love?

5eeb1e87-4018-4f0f-a5dc-d614fff2ac69.title: ChronoCid
5eeb1e87-4018-4f0f-a5dc-d614fff2ac69.description: When an AI company claims to predict and prevent deaths, a software developer and his allies must expose the truth behind their operation before more innocent lives are lost.

நில்லுங்கள்-ராஜாவே.title: நில்லுங்கள் ராஜாவே
நில்லுங்கள்-ராஜாவே.description: நீங்கள், நீங்கள் இல்லை. வேறு யாரோ! இப்படி ஒருவர் அல்ல, அக்கம் பக்கத்தில் இருப்பவர்கள், உடன் வேலை பார்ப்பவர்கள், உங்கள் மனைவி, குழந்தை... எல்லோரும் சொன்னால் உங்களுக்கு எப்படி இருக்கும்? உச்சக்கட்டமாக வீட்டு நாய்கூட அடையாளம் தெரியாமல் குரைத்து வைக்கிறது, பிடுங்க வருகிறது. இப்படி, யாரும் எதிர்பாராத ஒரு புதுச் சிக்கலுடன் பரபரப்பாகத் தொடங்குகிறது நாவல்.

miss-mayavi.title: Miss Mayavi
miss-mayavi.description: ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ಸಖತ್‌ ಬಬ್ಲೀ ಗರ್ಲ್‌ ಆದ್ರೂ ಹುಡುಗರಂದ್ರೆ ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕಷ್ಟೇ. ಫೇಮಸ್‌ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್‌ಮ್ಯಾನ್‌ ಜಯಂತ್‌ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜ್ ಹುಡುಗಿರಂದ್ರೆ ಉರಿದು ಬೀಳ್ತಾನೆ. ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ಮತ್ತು ಜಯಂತ್‌ ಅನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತವಾದ ಒಂದು ಹಾಟ್‌ ಲಿಪ್‌ಲಾಕ್‌ನಿಂದ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿ ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗ್ತಾರೆ. ಇದ್ರಿಂದ ಡಿಸ್ಟರ್ಬ್‌ ಆಗೋ ಜಯಂತ್‌ ಪ್ರಿಯಾಗೆ ಪಾಠ ಕಲಿಸ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂತ ಶಾಪ ಹಾಕ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅದೇ ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ತನ್ನದೇ ಕಂಪೆನಿಗೆ ಇಂಟರ್ನ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಬಂದಾಗ, ಅವಳ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ, ಮುದ್ದಾದ ಧೈರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಫಿದಾ ಆಗ್ತಾ ಹೋಗ್ತಾನೆ. ಇತ್ತ ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ಕೂಡ ಜಯಂತ್‌ನ ಚಾರ್ಮ್‌ಗೆ ಮಾರು ಹೋಗ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಜಯಂತ್‌ ಜೊತೆಗಿನ ಸಲುಗೆ, ಸ್ನೇಹದಿಂದ ಪ್ರಿಯಾಗೆ ಅಪಾಯಗಳು ಎದುರಾಗ್ತವೆ. ಕ್ಷಣ ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ರೋಮಾಂಚನ ಮೂಡಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ಮತ್ತು ಜಯಂತ್‌ ನಡುವಿನ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಲವ್‌ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "ಮಿಸ್‌ ಮಾಯಾವಿ" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

appraisals-in-a-week.title: Appraisals In A Week
appraisals-in-a-week.description: Sirf 7 din mein seekhiye effective appraisals lene ka tareeka – bina stress ke, full impact ke saath, Ye audiobook aapko seekhayegi ki kaise ek simple conversation ban sakti hai growth ka powerful tool. Chahe aap manager ho ya team lead, yeh guide banayegi aapko ek confident aur inspiring leader.

how-to-gain-self-motivation.title: How To Gain Self Motivation
how-to-gain-self-motivation.description: ప్రేరణ పొందడం చాలా ముఖ్యమైన విషయం, అయితే మనకుమనమే మన లక్ష్యాలను సాధించడానికి మోటివేట్ ఎలా అవ్వాలో విని తెలుసుకోండి.

d3739142-5726-431c-adfb-b41020c43769.title: விலகாதே... ஆருயிரே..!
d3739142-5726-431c-adfb-b41020c43769.description: When a police officer investigates a series of murders targeting women with O-negative blood, his personal life gets entangled as his brother's marriage arrangement becomes complicated by hidden motives and deception.

qurbaan-hua.title: Qurbaan Hua
qurbaan-hua.description: Dr. Ananya Bedi apne beete huye rishte ko peeche chhod kar Judge Arjun Rana ki patni aur chhoti si beti Pihu ki maa ban chuki thi. Zindagi mein sab kuch shaant lag raha tha, jab ek din uski mulaqat uske purane pyaar Aarav se ho gayi. Aarav ke wapas aane se Ananya ek baar phir apne dil, apne parivaar aur apne beete dard ke beech ulajh gai. Kya Ananya apne dil ko samjha paayegi, ya ek baar phir Aarav ke jaal mein phans jaayegi?

bdfe100f-48ef-4204-8bf1-d9b9339e444b.title: The Spirit's Desire
bdfe100f-48ef-4204-8bf1-d9b9339e444b.description: When a series of ritualistic murders rocks the city, a CBI officer and his journalist girlfriend must race against time to stop an ancient witch's soul from claiming its final sacrifice, while discovering one of their own might be the key to her immortality.

importance-of-mental-health.title: Importance Of Mental Health
importance-of-mental-health.description: మానసిక ఆరోగ్యం మన శారీరక ఆరోగ్యం కంటే కూడా ముఖ్యమైంది. ఇది మన ఆలోచనలను, భావోద్వేగాలను, మరియు ప్రవర్తనలను ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది. మంచి మానసిక ఆరోగ్యం జీవన ప్రమాణాలను మెరుగుపరచి, సంబంధాలను బలపరచుతుంది.

कैसे-बनाये-E-Shram-Card-सारे-फायदे-और-₹2.title: कैसे बनाये E Shram Card? सारे फायदे और ₹2 LAKH तक का बीमा COVER
कैसे-बनाये-E-Shram-Card-सारे-फायदे-और-₹2.description: कैसे बनाये E Shram Card? सारे फायदे और ₹2 LAKH तक का बीमा COVER

cursed-2.title: Cursed
cursed-2.description: అనగనగా ఓ ఊరు, ఊరి పేరు నవరీ ఆ ఊరిలో ఓ సరస్సు, ఒకప్పుడు అది వరాల సరస్సు, అందులో దిగి ఏమి కోరుకున్నా వెంటనే ఇచ్చేది, ఈ అక్షయపాత్ర లాంటి సరస్సు హఠాత్తుగా అసుర సరస్సుగా మారింది. ఎవ్వరు వెళ్లినా వాళ్లను అపహరించడం మొదలుపెడుతుంది. నిజంగా ఈ సరస్సు వరమా?శాపమా ?లేదంటే మానవ కట్టు కథ?ఇది తెలుసుకునేందుకు మీరా రాయ్ - జర్నలిస్ట్, అక్కడికు వచ్చి అన్వేషించడం మొదలుపెడుతుంది.

change-your-habits-change-your-life-1.title: Change Your Habits: Change Your Life
change-your-habits-change-your-life-1.description: ദൈനംദിന ജീവിതത്തിലെ ചെറിയ ശീലങ്ങളാണു നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തെ നിർണ്ണയിക്കുന്നതെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞാൽ എത്ര പേർക്ക് അത് വിശ്വസിക്കാൻ കഴിയും?  എന്നാൽ സത്യം അതാണു, ജീവിത ശീലങ്ങളിൽ നല്ല മാറ്റങ്ങൾ വരുത്തി നിങ്ങൾക്ക് സ്വയം പുതുക്കി പണിയാനും ജീവിതത്തെ വിജയതീരത്തേക്ക് നയിക്കാനും സാധിക്കുമെന്ന് ഈ പുസ്തകം അടിവരയിട്ട് പറയുന്നു. നിങ്ങളുടെ തലച്ചോറിനെ നല്ല ശീലങ്ങൾ പരിശീലിപ്പിക്കുന്നതെങ്ങനെ, ചീത്ത ശീലങ്ങളിൽ നിന്ന് മുക്തി നേടുന്നതെങ്ങനെ, ശീലങ്ങളിലെ വ്യതിയാനം കൊണ്ട് ജീവിതം സാർത്ഥകമാകുന്നതെങ്ങനെ എന്നെല്ലാം തോമസ് കോർലി രചിച്ച ഈ ഗ്രന്ഥം നിങ്ങൾക്ക് പറഞ്ഞ് തരൂം.

asli-waaris-season-2.title: Asli Waaris season 2
asli-waaris-season-2.description: Mittal Group ke asli waris banne ki ladaai ek naye mod par pahunch chuki hai. Karan Mittal, jo sabki nazar mein sirf ek ameer ghar ka bigda pota hai, apne dadu Alok Mittal ka bharosa jeetne ke liye bade daav khel raha hai. MBA ke entrance exam se lekar Alok ke secret slush fund ko chhupke grow karne tak, Karan sab kuch kar raha hai taaki apne pita Naveen aur rival Ajit ko hara sake. Kya Karan, Mittal Group ka asli waris ban payega? Ya kursi kisi aur ke haath lag jaayegi?

second-marriage.title: Second Marriage
second-marriage.description: തന്റെ കുടുംബത്തിന്റെ കടബാധ്യതകൾ തീർക്കാനായി അനിയത്തി രവീണയാണെന്ന വ്യാജേന മഹേഷിനെ രണ്ടാം വിവാഹം ചെയേണ്ടി വന്ന പ്രവീണ. അതിസമ്പന്നനും, വലിയൊരു ബിസിനസ് സാമ്രാജ്യത്തിന്റെ ഉടമയുമായ തന്നെ ചൂഷണം ചെയ്യാനാണ് തന്നെ സമീപിക്കുന്ന സ്ത്രീകൾ എല്ലാം ശ്രമിക്കുന്നത് എന്ന് വിശ്വസിക്കുമ്പോഴും, അച്ഛന്റെ നിർബന്ധത്തിന് വഴങ്ങി പ്രവീണയെ വിവാഹം ചെയ്യേണ്ടി വന്ന മുൻകോപക്കാരനായ മഹേഷ്‌...എല്ലാം മറന്ന് പരസ്പരം സ്നേഹിക്കാനും ഒന്നാകുവാനും ഇവർക്ക് കഴിയുമോ..?

b505e3f6-6e07-4f18-ac9a-ea9c81f8d5e7.title: Mafia's Baby Girl
b505e3f6-6e07-4f18-ac9a-ea9c81f8d5e7.description: When a young woman is forced to work for a mafia boss to repay her father's debt, she finds herself caught between her independence and growing feelings for her enigmatic employer.

detective-ajay-gunahon-ke-khiladi-1-to-7.title: Detective Ajay : Gunahon ke Khiladi
detective-ajay-gunahon-ke-khiladi-1-to-7.description: Sheher mein ek ke baad ek hui hatyaon ne dar ka mahaul bana diya tha. Doctor Seema Ahuja ki laash dustbin mein mili, aur shak uske pati Ranjit Ahuja par gaya. Lekin kuch din baad doctor Kunal Agnihotri bhi maut ka shikaar ban gaye. Police ne Seema ke bete Nishant ko zimmedar maana, lekin Detective Ajay ko laga ki asli gunehgar koi aur tha jo sabko chhal kar apna khel khel raha tha. Kya Ajay us asli khiladi tak pahunch paega, ya yeh maut ka silsila chalta rahega?

what-happens-after-death.title: What happens after death?
what-happens-after-death.description: മരണം നമ്മുക്ക് എന്നും ഉത്തരമില്ലാത്ത പ്രഹേളികയാണു, മരണാനന്തരമോ? മരണശേഷം മറ്റൊരു ജന്മം ഉണ്ടെന്ന്  ബഹുഭൂരിപക്ഷവും വിശ്വസിക്കുമ്പോഴും അതിനു ശാസ്ത്രീയമായ യാതൊരു തെളിവും മനുഷ്യർക്ക് കണ്ടെത്താനായിട്ടില്ല. മരണശേഷം മനുഷ്യശരീരത്തിനും, പ്രാണെനെന്നും ആത്മാവെന്നുമെല്ലാം പല പേരിൽ വിളിക്കുന്ന മനസ്സിനും എന്ത് സംഭവിക്കുന്നു എന്ന അന്വേഷണം മനുഷ്യർ ഇന്നും തുടരുന്നു. മരണാനന്തര ജീവിതത്തെ പറ്റി മനുഷ്യർ നടത്തുന്ന ആ അന്വേഷണങ്ങളുടെ കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം ഈ ഓഡിയൊ ബുക്കിലൂടെ..

lal-kitab-astrology.title: Lal Kitaab
lal-kitab-astrology.description: Kya aapki life mein har waqt struggles chal rahe hain? Lal Kitab Astrology ke asardar upaay se bad luck ko goodbye boliye aur success ki nayi kahani likhiye. To der kis baat ki, suniye aur zindagi badalne ka raasta paaiye.

a5ca9267-d9f6-4973-a638-abe93de2d981.title: 1812 Napoleon's War
a5ca9267-d9f6-4973-a638-abe93de2d981.description: A French spy during the Napoleonic Wars must choose between loyalty to his country and his moral conscience when he falls in love with a mysterious woman while uncovering devastating war plans that could destroy countless lives.

ninne-bayaside.title: Ninne Bayaside
ninne-bayaside.description: ಬಿ. ಎಸ್. ಲಲಿತ್ ಕುಮಾರ್ ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರೋ 'ನಿನ್ನೇ ಬಯಸಿದೆ' ಕೃತಿ ಒಂದು ಕವನ ಸಂಕಲನ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ನೂರಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕವಿತೆಗಳಿವೆ‌. ಈ ಕವನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಯೊಬ್ಬನ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಹಾತೊರೆಯುವಿಕೆ, ನಂಬಿಕೆ, ಆತಂಕ, ಅಸಹಾಯಕತೆ, ದಿಟ್ಟತೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಪ್ರೇಮದ ಹಲವು ಆಯಾಮಗಳಿವೆ. ಈ ಸುಂದರ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ. ಕೇಳಿ ಪ್ರೇಮಲೋಕದಲ್ಲೊಮ್ಮೆ ವಿಹರಿಸಿ.!

detective-world-season-2.title: Detective World Season 2
detective-world-season-2.description: Ek charming lekin khatarnak serial killer Teddy sheher mein maut ka khel khel raha hai jiska shikar ban rahe hain bade bade naam. Is raaz ko suljhane ke liye Detective Anuj, fearless reporter Nidhi aur daring officer Satyaki ek team banate hain. Investigation ke dauraan sach itna uljha jata hai ki Ajay jaise apne logon par bhi shaq hone lagta hai. Jab Ashwatthama Sena naam ki ek gupht shakti saamne aati hai, to nyay aur badle ke beech ki lakeer dhundhli ho jaati hai. Kya Anuj apne sabse kareebi logon ke raaz pehchaan paayega? Aur kya Teddy ka agla shikar system hoga, ya usse rokne wale khud?

ba4ad508-4c7b-4c5b-aa38-b78694b685b5.title: Held for Ransom
ba4ad508-4c7b-4c5b-aa38-b78694b685b5.description: When five college friends are kidnapped by criminals demanding ransom, they must find a way to escape their captors while confronting their own personal demons and family struggles.

yellow-humans.title: Yellow humans
yellow-humans.description: ബോധം തെളിഞ്ഞ അലക്സിനു ആ കാഴ്ച വിശ്വസിക്കാനായില്ല തന്റെ ശരീരം പൂർണമായും ഒരു സ്ത്രീയുടേതായി മാറിയിരിക്കുന്നു! ദുരൂഹതകൾ നിറഞ്ഞ ഈ കെട്ടിടത്തിനുള്ളിൽ താൻ അകപ്പെട്ടിട്ടു എത്രയോ കാലങ്ങളായിരിക്കുന്നു. എത്രയും പെട്ടന്ന് ആ ഇരുട്ടറയിൽ നിന്നും പുറത്തു കടക്കാൻ അവൻ ശ്രമിക്കുന്നു...തന്നെ ഈ രൂപത്തിലേക്ക് മാറ്റിയവർ ആരാണെന്ന അന്വേഷണം ഇതുവരെ  അറിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ലാത്ത ദുരൂഹമായ പാതകളിലൂടെ അവനെ നയിക്കുന്നു...ക്ലാര എന്ന പെൺ സുഹൃത്തിനെ കണ്ടു മുട്ടുന്നതോടെ കഥ മറ്റൊരു തലത്തിലേക്ക് വികസിക്കുന്നു. അലക്സ് മാത്രമായിരുന്നില്ല അവരുടെ ഇര,ലോകം മുഴുവൻ കൈപ്പിടിയിലാക്കാൻ ഒരുങ്ങുന്ന ആ ശക്തികളോട് ഒടുവിൽ അവർ  ഏറ്റുമുട്ടുന്നു... ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന സയൻസ് ഫിക്ഷൻ /  ബോഡി ഹൊറർ കഥ കേൾക്കാം.

suvarna-murder-case.title: Suvarna Murder Case
suvarna-murder-case.description:
Suvarna gayab ho gayi hai. Na koi gawaah, na koi saboot. Bas ek mohalla, jahan har khidki ke peeche koi na koi raaz daba baitha hai. Galiyaan chup hain, par deewaron ne sab suna hai. Police har kone ki talashi le rahi hai, lekin har suraag ek aur paheli ban jaata hai.
Kya hua tha us raat? Suvarna ne kisko dekha tha?Aur jab apne hi kuch chhupa rahe ho toh kis par bharosa kiya jaaye?

how-to-become-a-good-leader-1.title: How To Become A Good Leader
how-to-become-a-good-leader-1.description: Meeru Mee lakshyalanu sadhinchalante ontari prayanam saripodu, Meeru brundam tho pani cheyyalsi untundi mari Mee brundaanni vijaya patham lo nadapali ante Meeru good leader avvali andukosame ee audiobook.

escape.title: Escape
escape.description: గేమ్స్ అంటే పిచ్చి ఉన్న 14 సంవత్సరాల అర్జున్ తన ఉరి జాతరలో ఒక విచిత్రమైన మొబైల్ కొనుక్కున్నాడు అయితే ఆ గేమ్ ఆడే క్రమం లో తాను ఆ గేమ్ లో కి వెళ్లిపోతాడు, ఆ గేమ్ నుంచి అర్జున ఎలా బయటపడ్డాడు అసలు అర్జున్ ఆ గేమ్ లోకి ఎలా వేళాడు? అర్జున్ అందులో నుంచి బయటపడుతాడా? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

corporate-affair.title: Corporate Affair
corporate-affair.description: Ananya aur Rohan school sweethearts the, jinhone pyaar se shaadi tak ka safar tay kiya. Shuruaat mein sab theek tha, lekin jab Rohan ki maa unke saath rehne aayi, taano aur zehrile bartav ne Ananya ki zindagi ko dard se bhar diya. Saas ke taane toh seh liye, par jab Rohan bhi usse neecha dikhane laga, Ananya andar se bikhar gayi. Tab uski zindagi mein Abhay aaya, ek aisi roshni bankar jo khud bhi kabhi andheron se guzra tha. Uski biwi Priya usse dhokha de rahi thi, aur uski simplicity ko uski kamzori samajhti thi. Dard se jujh rahe dono dil jab takraaye, toh ek naya sukoon mila. Dheere dheere pyaar bhi umadne laga. Lekin jab Ananya ko Rohan ke affair ka sach pata chala, woh uske liye sirf dhokha nahi, tabahi ban gaya. Kya Ananya aur Rohan ka rishta ab toot jayega? Kya Abhay aur Ananya ek ho payenge?

agent-vo2.title: Agent VO2
agent-vo2.description: అరుణాచల్ ప్రదేశ్ లో LAC లో మన భారతీయ సైనికుల పైన చైనా సైనికులు దాడి చేసి నలభై మంది భారతీయ సైనికులను కిడ్నాప్ చేసి తీసుకోని వెళ్లారు. ఇది జరిగిన సంవత్సరం తరువాత భారత సెంట్రల్ హోం మినిస్టర్ కూతురుని టెర్రరీస్ట్ లు కిడ్నాప్ చేశారని తెలిసి, ఆ అమ్మాయిని కాపాడాలని, RAW యొక్క ప్రత్యేక వింగ్ అయిన "SAGA" "Secret Assassin's & Guardian Angel's" లోని  బెస్ట్ ఆఫీసర్స్ నీ మిషన్ కీ క్రేజీ and dangerous ఏజెంట్ V02 ని పంపారు. ఈ మిషన్ లో ఏజెంట్ V కీ తన గతం లోని అనుభవాలు వల్ల ఎలాంటి పరిణామాలు ఎదుర్కోవాల్సి వచ్చింది? ఎలా సెంట్రల్ హోం మినిస్టర్ కూతురుని తిరిగి తీసుకోని వచ్చారు? అరుణాచల్ ప్రదేశ్ లో భారత సైనికులను ఎందుకు కిడ్నాప్ చేశారు? అనేది కథలో చూద్దాం.

Bose’s-Women-Army-आज़ादी-की-पहली-महिला-फ.title: Bose’s Women Army: आज़ादी की पहली महिला फौज की कहानी

role-of-positivity.title: Role Of Positivity
role-of-positivity.description: విజయం సాధించాలంటే పట్టుదల ఒక్కటి ఉంటె సరిపోదు, భిన్న పరిస్థితులను ఎదురుకునే ధైర్యం ఇంకా సమయస్ఫూర్తి ఉండాలి. మన ఆలోచనలు పాజిటివ్ గా ఉంటే విజయం ఎలా దక్కుతుందో చెప్పే ఆడియోబుక్ మీ కోసం.

no-self-no-problem-1.title: No Self No Problem
no-self-no-problem-1.description: ನೋ ಸೆಲ್ಫ್, ನೋ ಪ್ರಾಬ್ಲಮ್" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಲೇಖಕರು ಬೌದ್ಧ ತತ್ತ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ತಾತ್ತ್ವಿಕ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿಸಿ "ಸ್ವ" ಎಂಬ ಕಲ್ಪನೆಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಬಲ ಮೆದುಳಿನ (Right Brain) ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆ ಮೂಲಕ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಆತ್ಮಕಥಾ ಸ್ವರೂಪವನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. "ಸ್ವ" ಎಂಬ ಭಾವನೆಯು ಅನಾವಶ್ಯಕ ತೃಣಮೂಲ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದನ್ನು ಬಿಡುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಶಾಂತವಾಗಲು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

my-stroke-of-insight.title: My Stroke Of Insight
my-stroke-of-insight.description: "ಮೈ ಸ್ಟ್ರೋಕ್ ಆಫ್ ಇನ್ಸೈಟ್" ನಲ್ಲಿ ನರಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞೆ ಜಿಲ್ ಬೋಲ್ಟೆ ಟೇಲರ್ ಜೀವನದ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಘಟನೆಯಾದ ಮೆದುಳಿನ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ (ಸ್ಟ್ರೋಕ್) ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ತಮ್ಮ ಸ್ಟ್ರೋಕ್ ಅನುಭವದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಲ ಮೇಧಾಭಾಗದ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಷಮತೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿತ್ತೇಂದು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇದರಿಂದ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಜೀವನ, ಮನಸ್ಸು, ಹಾಗೂ ಶ್ರದ್ಧೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ತಳಹದಿಯ ಅರಿವಾಗತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ಮೆದುಳಿನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಚಮತ್ಕಾರವನ್ನೂ, ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಪುನಶ್ಚೇತನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನೂ ತೋರುತ್ತದೆ.

the-zepto-story.title: The Zepto Story
the-zepto-story.description: Stanford University la padichittu  irundha 19 vayasu pasanga rendu per college ja drop pannittu pudhusaa oru business start pannaanga ,adhu dhaan Zepto. Indha  Zepto udaiya value verum rendu varusathula 1.4 billion dollar raa valandhuchu ! Adhu mattum illaama 2023-la namma india la first unicorn company  Zepto thaan. Vaanga indha podcast la  zepto va strat pannina young founders rendu per ta irundhu avangaloda success ragasiyatha theinjukalaam.

ninagagi.title: Ninagagi
ninagagi.description: ಬದುಕಿನ‌ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕಲರ್ಫುಲ್ ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನ ಕಂಡ ಹುಡುಗಿ 'ಪ್ರೀತಿ', ವ್ಹೀಲ್ ಚೇರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸ್ತಿರೋ 'ದರ್ಶನ್'.! ಬೆಣ್ಣೆ-ಬೆಂಕಿಯಂಥ ಈ ಜೋಡಿ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗೋ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ. ಹಾಗಂತ ಇದು ದರ್ಶನದ್ದು ಮೊದಲ ಮದುವೆಯಲ್ಲಾ. ಬರೋಬ್ಬರಿ ಆರನೇ ಮದುವೆ! ಅದೂ ಮದುವೆ ಮುಂಚೆ ವರ್ಜಿನಿಟಿ ಟೆಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಂದಾಗಿರೋ ದರ್ಶನ್ ಯಾರು? ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಇವನಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ್ಲು? ಅವಳಿಗೂ ಇದು ಮೊದಲನೇ ಮದುವೆನಾ? ಅಥ್ವಾ ಕಥೆ ಬೇರೆನೇ ಇದ್ಯಾ? ಕೇಳಿ ಒಂಟಿ ಜೀವಗಳು ಜಂಟಿಯಾಗೋ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'ನಿನಗಾಗಿ'.! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.

history-of-bollywood.title: History of Bollywood
history-of-bollywood.description: ಬಾಲಿವುಡ್ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಇವತ್ತು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಜಗತ್ತು.! ಆದ್ರೆ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಚಿತ್ರರಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಅಡಿಪಾಯ ಹಾಕಿದ ಬಾಲಿವುಡ್ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭದ ದಿನಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಮೊದಲ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಯಾವುದು? ಮೊದಲ ಹೀರೋ-ಹೀರೋಯಿನ್ ಯಾರು? ಮೊದಲ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರ್ ಯಾರು? ಕಪ್ಪು-ಬಿಳುಪು, ಕಲರ್ಫುಲ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಮೂಕಿ, ಟಾಕಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಬಾಲಿವುಡ್ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹಿಸ್ಟರಿ ಆಫ್ ಬಾಲಿವುಡ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.

haage-summane-making-of-mungaru-male.title: Haage Summane: Making of Mungaru Male
haage-summane-making-of-mungaru-male.description: ಮುಂಗಾರು ಮಳೆ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಎಷ್ಟು ಫೇಮಸ್ ಆಗಿದಿಯೋ ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಫೇಮಸ್ ಆ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಹಾಡು ಅನಿಸುತಿದೆ ಯಾಕೋ ಹಾಡು ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಫೇಮಸ್ ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ನಮ್ಮ್ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಚರಿತ್ರೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪುಟ ಅದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮೀಸಲು ಇರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಮುಂಗಾರು ಮಳೆ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಮೇಕಿಂಗ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನೀವು ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ "ಹಾಗೆ ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ: Making of ಮುಂಗಾರು ಮಳೆ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

067d9820-40da-4256-af6d-35b97b03f3ec.title: Jeyippathu Nijam
067d9820-40da-4256-af6d-35b97b03f3ec.description: இலட்சியா -95 அதி நவீன ரக விமானத்தை பற்றிய சில இரகசிய குறிப்புகள் வெளிநாட்டவர்களுக்கு விற்க படுவதாக இரகசிய தகவல் டெல்லியில் உள்ள நேஷனல் செக்யூரிட்டி ஃபோர்ஸிடமிருந்து தகவல், சென்னையில் உள்ள விவேக்கிற்கு வர உடனே டெல்லிக்கு விரைகிறான். இலட்சியா -95 பற்றிய சில இரகசிய தகவல்கள் சேட்டர்ஜி, மெஹரா மற்றும் விஷ்ணு வர்த்தன் இவர்கள் மூவருக்கு மட்டுமே தெரியும், இதில் இருவர் கொல்லப்படுகின்றனர். கடைசியில் தீவிர இரகசிய குழுவில் உள்ள ஒரு கருப்பாடு யார்? என்று கண்டறிந்த இரகசியங்களை எவ்வாறு மீட்கின்றனர் என்பதை அறிய கேளுங்கள் ஜெயிப்பது நிஐம்..

dhaage.title: Dhaage
dhaage.description:
Mayra ek aise raaz ke saath jee rahi hai jo sirf uske dil mein nahi, kisi ki maut se bhi juda hai  aur agar woh raaz kabir ko pata chal gaya, to sirf unka pyaar nahi, unki zindagiyan bhi badal jaayengi. Kabir usse mohabbat karta hai, lekin har kadam par uske beech Raghav ki parchhaayi hai jo sirf Mayra ka pehla pyaar nahi, balki us raaz ka ek zinda gawah bhi hai. Jab teeno ke dhaage takraate hain, toh sirf uljhan nahi badhti, puraani kahaniyaan bhi zakhm ban kar ubhar aati hain.
Kya Mayra apna sach keh paayegi? Ya woh dhaaga uske haathon se hamesha ke liye fisal jaayega?

സ്കന്ദപുരാണം.title: സ്കന്ദപുരാണം
സ്കന്ദപുരാണം.description: പതിനെട്ടു പുരാണങ്ങളിൽ ഏറ്റവും വലുതാണ് സ്കന്ദപുരാണം. ശിവന്റേയും പാർവ്വതിയുടേയും പുത്രനായ സുബ്രഹ്മണ്യൻ്റെ ലീലകളാണ് പ്രധാനമായും ഈ പുരാണത്തിൽ പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്നത്. മുരുകൻ, ആണ്ടവൻ, കർത്തികേയൻ, ബാഹുലേയൻ എന്നിങ്ങനെ സുബ്രഹ്മണ്യനു അപര നാമങ്ങളേറെ. തമിഴ് ഭക്തിപാരമ്പര്യവുമായി അഭേദ്യ ബന്ധമുളള ദേവനും ഇത്  തന്നെ. പഴനി, തിരുച്ചെന്തൂർ, തിരുവണ്ണാമല എന്നിങ്ങനെ സുബൃഹ്മണ്യൻ്ററ്റെ കോവിലുകൾ മലയാളികളുടെയും പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട ആരാധനാ ക്ഷേത്രങ്ങളാണു. കേൾക്കം സുബൃഹ്മണ്യ മാഹാത്മ്യം ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്കിലൂടെ.

heegu-unte.title: Heegu Unte
heegu-unte.description: ಅಂಧಕಾರದ ಈ ಪ್ರಪಂಚದಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬ ಜನ ತಮಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು ಆಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಎಂಥ ಕೆಲಸ ಆದ್ರೂ ಮಾಡೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಹಿಂದೆ ಮುಂದೆ ನೋಡೋದಿಲ್ಲ ಆದ್ರೆ ಇನ್ನು ಕೆಲವರು ನರಬಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಶೂರ್ದ್ರ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಮಾಡೋದಕ್ಕೂ ಏನ್ ಬೇಕಾದ್ರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ ಆದ್ರೆ ಅವ್ರು ನಮ್ಮ ಸಮಾಜದ ತುಂಬ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಅನ್ನೋದೇ ಆಶ್ಚರ್ಯ ಅಂತ ಒಂದು ಘಟನೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳುವ ಕಥೆ ಈ "ಹೀಗೂ ಉಂಟೆ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

41999c45-3ed2-4ef3-b8c5-572c13a37146.title: அங்கே... இங்கே... எங்கே?
41999c45-3ed2-4ef3-b8c5-572c13a37146.description: கதிரியக்கத்தை பயன்படுத்தி பணத்திற்காக மனிதர்களை கொன்று குவித்த அமெரிக்க விஞ்ஞானி போத்தம்ஸ், இந்தியாவில் இரண்டு பேரைக் கொல்வதற்கு வருகிறார். அந்த இரண்டு பேர் யார்? போத்தம்ஸ் தடுக்கப்படுவாறா?

anthiveyilile-ponnu.title: അന്തിവെയിലിലെ പൊന്ന്
anthiveyilile-ponnu.description: മലയാള സിനിമയെ പശ്ഛാത്തലമാക്കി പെരുമ്പടവം രചിച്ച സംഭവബബഹുലമായ നോവൽ ആണ് ‘അന്തിവെയിലിലെ പൊന്ന്, സർവ സാധാരണവും ജനകീയവുമായ ഭാഷയിലാണു പെരുമ്പടവം  ഈ കഥ എഴുതിയത്. മായ എന്ന സാധാരണ പെൺകുട്ടിയുടെ നടി എന്ന നിലയിലുള്ള അപ്രതീക്ഷിത അരങ്ങേറ്റവും വളർച്ചയും അതേതുടർന്ന് ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന സംഭവങ്ങളുമാണു ഇതിവൃത്തം. സിനിമയിൽ ശ്രദ്ധേയനാകാൻ കൊതിക്കുന്ന ഒരു സംവിധായകനായ ഹരിദാസിനെ യാദൃഛികമായി മായ കാണുകയും അവർ തമ്മിൽ തീവ്രമായ അനുരാഗം രുപപ്പെടുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഹരിദാസ് വിവാഹിതനും രണ്ട് കുട്ടികളുടെ അച്ഛനുമാണെന്ന് മായ അറിയുന്നത് പിന്നീടാണു.

karnataka-crime-files.title: Karnataka Crime Files
karnataka-crime-files.description: ಭಾರತ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕತೆ ಹಾಗೂ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ. ವೈವಿಧ್ಯತೆಯ ಜೊತೆಜೊತೆಗೆ ಹತ್ತು ಹಲವು ನಿಗೂಢ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನ ತನ್ನ ಗರ್ಭದಾಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುದುಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡಿದೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಕನ್ನಡ ನಾಡು. ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಜನರ ಮನೆ-ಮನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಅಚ್ಚಳಿಯದೇ ಉಳಿದಿರುವ ಹಲವಾರು ದಂತಕಥೆಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಉತ್ತರವಿಲ್ಲದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ವಿವಿಧ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದುಹೋದ ಹಲವು ಅಪರಾಧಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಅವುಗಳ ಸುತ್ತ ಹೆಣೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಹಲವು ದಂತಕಥೆಗಳ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಮೈನವೀರೇಳಿಸುವ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ Crime Files" ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

shetty-kutumbada-financial-formula.title: Shetty Kutumbada Financial Formula
shetty-kutumbada-financial-formula.description: ಒಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬ ಸಂತೋಷದಿಂದ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಸದಸ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಹಣಕಾಸು ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಅವಶ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಇರಬೇಕು. ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುವ ಆದಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ತೊಂದರೆಯಾಗದಂತೆ ಮನೆಯ ಖರ್ಚು-ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವ ಕಲೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿರಬೇಕು. ಯಾವುದೇ ಕುಟುಂಬವು ಒಗ್ಗಟ್ಟಿನಿಂದ ಜೊತೆಯಾಗಿ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರೂ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಕೊಡುಗೆಯನ್ನ ನೀಡುತ್ತ ಯಾವ ರೀತಿಯಾಗಿ ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಸ್ಥಿರತೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು "ಶೆಟ್ಟಿ ಕುಟುಂಬದ Financial Formula" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ Kuku FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

మాయ-లోకంలో-My-Love.title: మాయ లోకంలో My Love
మాయ-లోకంలో-My-Love.description: దురదృష్టం ఎప్పుడూ వైఫైలా వాడి చుట్టూనే తిరుగుతూ ఉంటుంది. ఎక్కడ అడుగు పెడితే అక్కడే అనర్ధలే అలాంటి వాడికి ఆవగింజంతలో వందో వంతు అదృష్టం కొద్దీ..  ఒక అమ్మాయి దొరికి ఆ అమ్మాయికి దురదృష్టానికి వీడు తనకి నచ్చితే..! తీరా పెళ్లి టైంకి హ్యాండ్ ఇచ్చింది. అన్ని దరిద్రాలని చూసిన అభిషేక్ చివరికి జీవితం మీద విరక్తి పుట్టి చచ్చిపోవాలని డిసైడ్ అయిపోయాడు. కానీ వాడి కర్మ చావు తప్పి మాయా లోకంలోకి  ఎంటర్ అయ్యాడు.. అక్కడ ఏం జరిగిందో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ షో వినాల్సిందే

sadhguru-life-of-a-yogi.title: Sadhguru: Life of a Yogi
sadhguru-life-of-a-yogi.description: ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಚಿಂತನೆಯನ್ನ ಭಾರತದಿಂದ ವಿಶ್ವಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಂಡೊಯ್ದ ಹೆಗ್ಗಳಿಕೆ ಸದ್ಗುರು ಶ್ರೀ ಜಗ್ಗಿ ವಾಸುದೇವ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಸಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮದ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನ ಆಧುನಿಕವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿ, ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಸುವುದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸದ್ಗುರು ನಿಸ್ಸೀಮರು! ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಹಲವಾರು ಕೃತಿಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರವಚನಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುವಂತೆ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮದ ಚಿಂತನೆಯನ್ನ ಹೇಳಿಕೊಟ್ಟ ಸದ್ಗುರುಗಳ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿದಾಯಕವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸದ್ಗುರು ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "ಸದ್ಗುರು: Life of a Yogi" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

kailasa-parvata.title: Kailasa Parvata
kailasa-parvata.description:
ಕೈಲಾಸ ಪರ್ವತ, ಹುಲ್ಮಯ ಎಂಬ ಹಿಮಾಲಯದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಸ್ಥಳ. ಇದು ಶಿವನ ವಾಸಸ್ಥಾನ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವದ ಹಲವು ಪುರಾಣ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಕೇಂದ್ರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪರ್ವತವು ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ರಹಸ್ಯಮಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ಕೈಲಾಸ ಚತುರ್ಮುಖ ಶಿಖರವು ನಿಖರವಾದ ಗತೀಯವಾಗಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ, ಇದು ಈ ಪರ್ವತದ ವಿಸ್ಮಯವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಹತ್ತಲು ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂಬುದು ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಆಸಕ್ತಿಕರ ಅಂಶ.

ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮ, ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ, ಮತ್ತು ಪುರಾಣ ಕಥೆಗಳೊಡನೆ ಕೈಲಾಸ ಪರ್ವತದ ರಹಸ್ಯ ಇನ್ನೂ ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿದೆ.

ಈ ರೀತಿಯ ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಆಸಕ್ತಿಕರ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು Kuku FMನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ!

budha-jeevanada-tatva.title: Buddha Jeevanada Tatva
budha-jeevanada-tatva.description:
ಈ ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಕಥೆಯು ನಮ್ಮನ್ನು ವಿವೇಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬೌದ್ಧ ಭಿಕ್ಷು ಮಠ ತೋಷಿನ್ ಅವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಜೀವನದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳು, ಪಾಠಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನಗಳನ್ನು ಆವಿಷ್ಕರಿಸುವ ಪರಿವರ್ತನಾ ಪ್ರಯಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ. ತವಾಂಗ್ ಮಠದ ಶಾಂತತೆಯ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆ ಹೊಂದಿದ ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಅಧ್ಯಾಯವೂ ನಿಜ ಜೀವನದ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಂದ ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಪಾಠಗಳಿಂದ ಆವೃತ್ತವಾಗಿರುವ ಆಳವಾದ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

 ಇಂತಹ ‌ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಿಸ್ ಮಾಡದೆ  ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FM .

b85e88c7-4721-440a-ab7e-e4b9a58240b8.description: ஆண்களைச் சார்ந்தும் சாராமலும் உருக்கொள்ளும் பெண் உலகின் விரிவையும் அதற்குள் இயங்கும் மன உணர்வுகளையும் காணும் நோக்கு நாவல் ‘ஆலவாயன்.’ உறவுகள் சார்ந்த கேள்விகள் ஒவ்வொரு சந்தர்ப்பத்திலும் ஓயாமல் எழுவதையும் அதைக் கடக்க மனிதர்கள் படும் பாடுகளையும் காட்சிச் சித்திரமாக்கியுள்ளது இந்நாவல்.

ff443617-153f-49ba-9b7b-08f4d13140b2.description: பணத்திற்காக நன்றாக இருந்தவனைக் கொன்று அவன் உடல் உறுப்பைத் தேவைப்படும் ஆட்களுக்குப் பொருத்திய டாக்டர் அமரதீபனை பழிவாங்க புறப்படுகிறான் ஒருத்தன். அவன் டாக்டரால் பயனடைந்த இருவரைக் கொன்றுவிட்டு டாக்டரை நெருங்கும் போது போலீஸ் அவனை நெருங்கிவிடுகிறது. பிடிபட்டானா அல்லது பழிவாங்கினானா?

anthima-horata.title: Anthima Horata
anthima-horata.description: "ಅಂತಿಮ ಹೋರಾಟ" ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ ಅವರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಮಾನವೀಯ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು, ಜೀವನದ ಹೋರಾಟಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮವಾಗಿ ವಿಜಯದ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಜೀವನದ ಗಾಢ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮನೋಭಾವಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂದು ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಕಥಾವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಹೆಣೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
