thara-vs-thara.title: Thara v/s Thara
thara-vs-thara.description: ഇതൊരു പ്രതികാര കഥയാണു, രണ്ട് പെൺകുട്ടികളുടെ പ്രതികാരം; താരാ v/s താരാ. ആരോടാണു ഇവർ പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യുന്നത്? എന്തിനാണു ഈ പ്രതികാരം? കഥ അറിഞ്ഞ് കഴിയുമ്പോൾ ഒരു പക്ഷേ നിങ്ങൾക്കുളളിലെ താരമാരെ നിങ്ങൾ തന്നെ കണ്ടെത്തി എന്ന് വരും. കേൾക്കാം അത്യന്തം ഉദ്ദ്വേഗജനകവും സ്തോഭജനകവുമായ ഒരു റിവഞ്ച് ത്രില്ലർ.

ఆమె.title: ఆమె
ఆమె.description: అమృత చిన్న టౌన్ నుండి సిటీకి ఇంజనీరింగ్ చదువుకోవడం కోసం వస్తుంది. అక్కడ ఒంటరిగా ఉంటున్న ఆమెకు, నవీన్ పరిచయం అవుతాడు. అతని కపట ప్రేమను, అమాయకంగా నిజమని నమ్ముతుంది. ఆమె తాగిన మైకంలో ఉండగా, అడ్వాంటేజ్ తీసుకున్న నవీన్ ఆమెను అనుభవించి, బ్రేక్ అప్ చెప్తాడు. షాక్ అయ్యి డిప్రెషన్ లోకి వెళ్లిపోతుంది. కొన్ని నెలల తరువాత   ఆమెకు ప్రేమ, వెంకట్ రూపంలో మరోసారి పరిచయమవుతుంది. కానీ ఆమె గతం తాలూకు ప్రేమ చేసిన గాయానికి భయపడి అతడిని తిరస్కరిస్తుంది. కానీ అతని ప్రేమలోని నిజాయితీకి కరిగి పెళ్లి చేసుకోవాలనుకున్న వారి జీవితాలను, విధి మరో మలుపు తిప్పుతుంది.  అస్సలు ఏంటా మలుపు ? తెలియాలంటే "ఆమె" కథను ఆమె మాటల్లోనే విందాం.

agni-dev-2.title: Agni Dev
agni-dev-2.description: Agni Dev ne sirf sach bola, lekin mila unhe sabse bada shraap. Kya hota hai jab dharma aur kartavya takraate hain? Yeh gripping kahani sikhati hai ki kabhi kabhi sacchai bhi mehengi pad sakti hai. Sab janiye is khas show mein.

9ef4393c-0fb0-4784-a0e7-3f2c9870c7a0.title: En Veettu Roja Un Veettu Jannalil
9ef4393c-0fb0-4784-a0e7-3f2c9870c7a0.description: கட்டுப்பாடுகள் நிறைந்த நடுத்தர குடும்பத்தில் வளரும் பெண் ஷைலஜாவிற்கும் அவளது ஆருயிர் தோழியான பணக்கார பெண் சித்ராவிற்கும் இடையில் ஒரு போட்டி. ஷைலுவின் காதலன் மதுசூதனனை மையமாக கொண்ட போட்டி . போட்டியால் தோழிகள் இருவரும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் மனமாற்றமும், இறுதியில் வென்றது யார் என்பதையும் சொல்லும் ஓர் உணர்ச்சி காவியம் தான் என் வீட்டு ரோஜா உன் வீட்டு ஜன்னலில்.

shivajis-secret.title: Shivaji's Secret
shivajis-secret.description: Ravi, ek mashhoor psychiatrist, jab Raigad ke Shivrajyabhishek samaroh mein mukhya atithi ban kar pahuchta hai, tab use andaza bhi nahi hota ki woh itihas ke sabse bade raaz ke beech khada hai. Jaane maane itihaskar Suryakant More sabke saamne Shivbhushan puraskar lene se inkaar kar dete hain, ye kehkar ki Shivaji Maharaj ke jeevan se juda ek sach ab tak chhupa hua hai. Siyasat, vichar aur virasat ke is toofan mein, Ravi bhi us raaz ke chakravyuh mein kheenchta chala jaata hai. Kya sach mein Maharaj ke jeevan mein kuch aisa tha jo 350 saal tak koi keh nahi paya? Aur agar woh raaz saamne aaya, to kya poori duniya us sach ko sweekar kar payegi?

love-mocktail.title: Love Cocktail
love-mocktail.description:
20 ವರ್ಷದ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಹುಡುಗಿ ಅಶ್ವಿನಿ, ತನ್ನ ಅತ್ತೆಯ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕ್ರೂರ ಪ್ಲಾನ್‌ನಿಂದ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವತ್ತನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅದೇ ರಾತ್ರಿ, ಆಕೆ ಅಕಸ್ಮಾತ್ತಾಗಿ  ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್‌ಮ್ಯಾನ್ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್ ವಾಸುದೇವನ್‌ ಅವರನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರು ಹೆಲ್ಪ್ ಮಾಡೋ ಮ್ಯಾರೇಜ್ ಡೀಲ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ
ಅಶ್ವಿನಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮರಳಿ ಸಿಗಲು  ಮತ್ತು ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ಗೆ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿ ಪತ್ನಿಯ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಪೂರೈಸಲು ಈ ಡೀಲ್‌ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದಿಂದ ಶುರುವಾಗ್ತಾ, ಸ್ಲೋ ಆಗಿ ಎಮೋಶನಲ್ ಲೆವಲ್ಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಾ ಅಥವಾ ದೂರ ಆಗೋ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳು ಎದುರಾಗ್ತಾವಾ ? 

 ಈ ಕಥೆ  ತಿಳಿಯಲು ತಪ್ಪದೇ ಕೇಳಿ  KukuFM

kisses-and-curries.title: Kisses and Curries
kisses-and-curries.description: ഒരു ധനിക കുടുംബത്തിലെ അംഗമായ ദീപികക്ക്  നഗരത്തിൽ ഒരു തട്ടുകട നടത്തുന്ന ദിനേശിനോട് തോന്നിയ പ്രണയം വെറും സാഹസമായിരുന്നില്ല. ദിനേശിൻ്റെ പാചകമാണു അവളെ  ആദ്യം കീഴ്പ്പെടുത്തിയത്, പിന്നീടത് അസ്ഥിക്ക് പിടിച്ച പ്രണയമായി തീർന്നു. അതോടെ മുന്നോട്ടുളള ജീവിതം എരിവും പുളിയും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു ത്രില്ലർ ആയി തീർന്നു. തളരാതെ പൊരുതിയ ദീപികയുടെയും ദിനേശിൻ്റെയും കഥ കേൾക്കാം..

Emotional-Intelligence-मन-को-समझो-दुनिया.title: Emotional Intelligence: मन को समझो, दुनिया को जीतो
Emotional-Intelligence-मन-को-समझो-दुनिया.description: Emotional Intelligence ek mind-opening kitab hai jo dikhati hai ki sirf IQ hi nahi, balki apne emotions ko samajhna aur control karna bhi success ki real key hai. Yeh kitab reveal karti hai kaise empathy, self-awareness aur social skills aapki personal aur professional life ko next level tak le ja sakte hain...Apni life ko aur better banane ke liye suniye Kuku Fm ki ye nayi peshkash..

94cd2283-50dc-4713-b074-0321ddad81c5.title: சிதம்பர ரகசியம்
94cd2283-50dc-4713-b074-0321ddad81c5.description: இது ஒரு அமானுஷ்ய தொடர்! சென்னையில் மனைவி மகளுடன் வசித்துவரும் ஒரு டாக்டர், தன் சொந்த ஊரான மகேந்திர மங்கலத்துக்கு வந்த இடத்தில் தன் பூர்வீக வீட்டில் உள்ள ஒரு பெட்டியில் சித்தர்களின் ஏடுகள் உள்ளன. அந்த சுவடிகளில் உள்ளவற்றை கேட்டு வரப்போகும் நிகழ்வுகளும், அவர்களுக்கு நடுவில் அதை அபகரிக்க விழையும் ஒரு கூட்டம். வெற்றி பெற்றது யார்?

49edbaba-e21c-453a-a1e4-fecdd1b4f47d.title: நில், கவனி, தாக்கு..!
49edbaba-e21c-453a-a1e4-fecdd1b4f47d.description: 'நில், கவனி, தாக்கு!’ 1970களில் தினமணி கதிரில் தொடராக வந்த ஜேம்ஸ்பாண்ட் பாணி கதை. முழுக்க முழுக்க தன்னிலையில் சொல்லப்படும் இந்நாவல் டெல்லியில் ஓர் அணு விஞ்ஞானி கடத்தப்படும் திடுக் சம்பவத்தில் தொடங்கி, அடிதடி, ரத்தம், சத்தம், சாகசம் என்று பரபரப்பாகி எதிர்பாராத ஆச்சரியத்தில் முடிகிறது. நாவலின் வேகமும், துள்ளல் எழுத்தும் 40 ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகும் இப்போதும் ஈர்க்கிறது.

rahasyamayi-rajkumari.title: Rahasyamayi Rajkumari
rahasyamayi-rajkumari.description: Swara, ek rajgharane ki beti, sirf sapna nahi dekhti, apni taqdeer khud likhne ki zid rakhti hai. Jab uske pita uske sapno ko kuchal kar use zabardasti ki shaadi ke faisle mein baandh dete hain, Swara andheron ko cheer kar nikal padti hai ek aisi yoddha banne, jo khud apni taqdeer ki rani ho. Saalon ki tapasya ke baad, jab uske parivaar par vinaash ka saaya mandrata hai, Swara naqab ke peeche apna roop chhupa kar talwar uthati hai. Kya Swara apne dard se upar uth kar nyaay karegi? Ya phir uski talwar sirf badla chahegi?

unromantic-couple.title: Unromantic Couple
unromantic-couple.description:
మోక్ష, టాలీవుడ్ టాప్ హీరో. వేదిక, అతని జీవితంలోకి అడుగుపెట్టిన ఒక ఆడపులి. వాళ్ళిద్దరి మధ్య ప్రేమ లేదు, కలవడం అనుకోకుండా, ఉండడం అనివార్యం. గ్లామర్ వెనుక గుండెల్ని గుచ్చే నిజాలు.

అసలు వీళ్లిద్దరి జీవితాలు ఒకటవుతాయా?

mr-handsome.title: Mr Handsome
mr-handsome.description: తన డిగ్రీ కంప్లీట్ చేసిన అమ్మాయి సంతోషంగా ఎంబీఏ లోకి అడుగు పెట్టాలనుకున్న టైంలో తనకి ఉన్న ఏకైక రక్తసంబంధం అయిన తల్లికి యాక్సిడెంట్ అవుతుంది. ఆ ఆక్సిడెంట్ తో అమ్మాయి కలలు మొత్తం కల్లలుగా మారడంతో.. చదువుకి స్వస్తి చెప్పి ఉద్యోగం చేయాలనుకుంటుంది. అసలు అమ్మాయిలంటే పడని అతని కంపెనీలోకి అబ్బాయిగా మారి వెళ్లిన ఆ అమ్మాయి పడిన తిప్పలు తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే

damad-by-chance.title: Damad By Chance
damad-by-chance.description: Anand, ek seedha saadha aur imaandaar aadmi, tab toot jaata hai jab wo apni patni Mohini ko uske lover Rajeev ke saath rangey haathon pakadta hai. Apmaan aur dhokhe ke baad, Anand ki duniya ujad jaati hai, lekin kismat usse ek naye mod par le aati hai jab uski mulaqat ek taaqatwar aur dayalu businesswoman Naina se hoti hai. Girkar sambhalne ki koshish mein, kya Anand apni nayi taqdeer likh payega aur kya Anand un logon se badla le payega jinhone use kabhi neecha dikhaya tha?

contract-kalyana.title: Contract Kalyana
contract-kalyana.description: ಫ್ಯಾಷನ್‌ ಡಿಸೈನರ್‌ ಸಂಜನಾ, ಸಾಧಾ ಸೀದಾ ಮುದ್ದಾದ ಮಿಡಲ್‌ ಕ್ಲಾಸ್‌ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಇತ್ತ ನಮ್‌ ಹೀರೋ ರಿಷಿ ದಿ ಗ್ರೇಟ್‌ ಬುಸಿನೆಸ್‌ ಮ್ಯಾನ್‌, ನೇರ ನಿಷ್ಠುರ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವ. ಸಂಜನಾ ಮತ್ತು ರಿಷಿ ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕಳೆದ ಒಂದು ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಬದುಕನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ತಮ್ಮ ತಮ್ಮ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿಂದ ಪಾರಾಗಲು ಈ ಕಾಂಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟ್‌ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗ್ತಾರೆ. ಮದುವೆಯ ನಂತರ ಸಿಡುಕು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ರಿಷಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮೃದು ಸ್ವಭಾವದ ಸಂಜನಾ ಬದುಕು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಾಗತ್ತೆ? ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ನಿಜವಾದ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಮೂಡತ್ತಾ? ಅರಿವಿಲ್ಲದ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆ ಮೈ ಮನಸ್ಸುಗಳನ್ನ ಒಂದು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ? ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ದ್ವೇಷ, ಕುಟುಂಬ ಮತ್ತು ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳ ಅಪರೂಪದ ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಲವ್‌ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ 'ಕಾಂಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟ್ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ'

jasoos-gharjamai-season-2.title: Jasoos Gharjamai Season 2
jasoos-gharjamai-season-2.description: Hidden intelligence agent Arjun ke seene mein uski hi wife aur ISI agent Payal urf Haseena khanjar utaar deti hai. Arjun Payal ke hathon marne se bach to jaata hai lekin jab wo hospital se recover hokar aata hai to usse milne ek aisa shakhs aata hai jise dekhkar uske pairon tale zameen khisak jaati hai. Arjun ki maut chahne wali Payal aaj Arjun se madad maangne aai hai par aakhir kyon? Wo Arjun ko Pakistani terrorists ke ek behad khatarnak attack ka plan batati hai. Desh ko bachane ke liye jab Arjun Payal ke daavo ki investigation karta hai tab use Payal aur Mrs. Agarwal ke ateet ke kuch aise raaz pata chalte hain ki uski zindagi hi badal jaati hai. Aisa kya hai Payal aur uski family ke past mein? Desh ya Pyaar mein se kise chunega Arjun? Kya wo rok payega India par hone wale attack ko?

0889813b-1729-466c-b3e3-24e99677eca5.title: Love Failure
0889813b-1729-466c-b3e3-24e99677eca5.description: జ్ఞాపకం ప్రేమ కి ప్రాణం పోస్తుంది మనసుకు మరణం ఇస్తుంది . చైత్ర ని మర్చిపోలేక తాగుడికి భానిస అయినా సిద్ధార్థ అనుకోని పరిస్థితిలో తన స్నేహితుడి భార్యగా చూస్తాడు. చైత్ర ని చూసిన సిద్ధార్థ మళ్లీ చైత్ర మనసులో చోటు కోసం ప్రయత్నిస్తాడా? చైత్ర సిద్ధార్థ గురించి ఎం అనుకుంటుంది? మళ్ళి వాళ్ళ ఇద్దరు కలుస్తారా? కాలం చూపించే దారి ఏంటి తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

అయ్యప్ప-స్వామి-చరిత్ర.title: అయ్యప్ప స్వామి చరిత్ర
అయ్యప్ప-స్వామి-చరిత్ర.description: అయ్యప్పస్వామి మహత్యం గురించి అందరికీ తెలిసిందే. కానీ, ఆయన చరిత్ర గురించి పూర్తిగా ఎవరికీ తెలియదు.అయ్యప్ప జననం ఎలా జరిగింది?  కార్తీక మాసంలో "స్వామియే శరణం అయ్యప్ప" అంటూ భక్తిగా కొలిచే స్వాములు 41 రోజుల దీక్షని ఏవిధంగా కొనసాగిస్తారు? కేరళ రాష్ట్రం చేరుకున్నాక శబరిమల వెళ్ళే దారి ఎలా ఉంటుంది? మాల ధరించడం దగ్గర నుండి ఇరుముడి విప్పే వరకూ ఆచరించే పద్ధతులు ఏమిటి? ఈ విషయాలన్నీ పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "అయ్యప్పస్వామి చరిత్ర" వినాల్సిందే.

5-POWERFUL-SKILLS-जो-आपकी-LIFE-बदल-देंगी.title: 5 POWERFUL SKILLS जो आपकी LIFE बदल देंगी
5-POWERFUL-SKILLS-जो-आपकी-LIFE-बदल-देंगी.description: 5 POWERFUL SKILLS जो आपकी LIFE बदल देंगी

shadows-of-gallows-gallina-neralu.title: Shadows of Gallows : Gallina Neralu
shadows-of-gallows-gallina-neralu.description: ಭಾರತದ ಜೈಲಿನ ಪ್ರತಿ ಗೋಡೆ, ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ಸರಳುಗಳು ಒಂದೊಂದು ಭಯಾನಕವಾದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಹೇಳ್ತವೆ. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ಮರಣದಂಡನೆಗೆ ಗುರಿಯಾದ ಅಪರಾಧಿಗಳ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ಗಲ್ಲುಶಿಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಗುರಿಯಾದವರ ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪರಾಧಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತೆ ಈ 'Shadows of Gallows: ಗಲ್ಲಿನ ನೆರಳು' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌. ಇದ್ರಲ್ಲಿ 26/11 ಮುಂಬೈ ಟೆರರ್ ಅಟ್ಯಾಕಿನ ರೂವಾರಿ 'ಅಜ್ಮಲ್ ಕಸಬ್'ನಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು, ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವಂತ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿಯನ್ನೇ ಬಲಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟ 'ಶಬ್ನಮ್ ಅಲಿ'ಯ ತನಕ ನೀವು ಕಂಡುಕೇಳರಿಯದ ಕುಕೃತ್ಯಗಳ ಕಂಪ್ಲೀಟ್ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಇದೆ‌‌.

c23e00f9-4b17-4847-9afb-1135f10e1c9b.title: யதி
c23e00f9-4b17-4847-9afb-1135f10e1c9b.description: இந்திய பூமியில் ரிஷிகளும் சித்தர்களும் யோகிகளும் பதித்துச் சென்ற தடங்களின் தொகுப்பு நிகரற்றது. இந்தியப் பாரம்பரியத்தையும் மரபையும் பண்பாட்டையும் தொகுத்து நமக்களித்தவர்கள் இந்த யதிகளே. அவர்களது வாழ்வு வினோதமானது. ஒரு கால் உலகத்திலும் இன்னொரு கால் உணர்வு உச்சத்திலும் நிலைகொண்டு அலைபாய்வது. இந்த நாவல், துறவிகளின வாழ்க்கையை அதன் யதார்த்தத் தன்மையோடும் அதீத புனைவோடும் ஒருங்கே நம் கண்முன் கொண்டு வருகிறது.

861129dc-d8cf-4a94-a488-5389cf76c5ce.title: வரதா வரம் தா..!
861129dc-d8cf-4a94-a488-5389cf76c5ce.description: காஞ்சி மாநகரில் சிறந்து விளங்கும் வரதராஜ பெருமாள் ஆலயத்தின் சிறப்பையும் அதன் பெரு அங்கமான அத்திவரதரின் பெருமை மற்றும் வரலாற்றை சொல்லிடும் ஒரு மகத்தான ஆய்வு நூல் இது.

milana.title: Milana
milana.description:
ಡಾ ಕರಣ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಡಾ ಮಾನ್ವಿ, ಜೋಡಿ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಹೀಗಿರಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋ ತರ ಇದ್ರೆ ರಮಣ್ ಮತ್ತೆ ನಯನಾ ಇಂಥ ಮದುವೆ ಯಾಕ್‌ ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋ ತರದ ಜೋಡಿ. ಕರಣ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನ್ವಿ ಮಧ್ಯೆ beautiful romance and love ಇದ್ರೆ 
ರಮಣ್ ಮತ್ತೆ ನಯನಾ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಕೇವಲ lust and frustration ಇರತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಎರಡೂ ದೋಣಿಗಳು ಕೊನೆಗೂ ತಮ್ಮ ತೀರ ತಲುಪ್ತಾವ? ಇಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರವಾಹಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿ ಕೊಚ್ಚಿ ಹೋಗ್ತಾವ ಅನ್ನೋದೇ ನಿಗೂಢ..  ಇದೊಂಥರ ಮನಸು ಮನಸುಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ನಡೆಯೋ ಮಿಲನ..
ದೇಹ ದೇಹಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಜರುಗೋ ಸಮ್ಮಿಲನ..

security-guard-nikla-crorepati.title: Security Guard Nikla Crorepati
security-guard-nikla-crorepati.description: Apni shadi ke Mandap par gold digger ka thappa lagte hi, Siya ne khud ko sahi saabit karne ke liye ek mamooli security guard se shaadi kar li. Par use yeh nahi pata tha ki jiske saath usne zindagi jodi hai, wo aam security guard nahi balki Malhotra Group ka waaris Arjun Malhotra hai. Kyu Arjun ne apni croron ki jaaydaad chhod di? Kya Siya kabhi Arjun par bharosa kar payegi jab use Arjun ki asli pehchaan ka pata chalega?

gamer-1.title: Gamer
gamer-1.description: జీవితంలో ఉన్నత స్థితికి చేరుకోవాలనుకున్న ఓ యువకుడు ప్రాణాంతకమైన గేమ్ లను రూపొందించి తన లక్ష్యాన్ని చేరుకోవాలనుకుంటాడు. అయితే అతని గేమ్ ల వల్ల ప్రయోజనం కంటే వినాశనమే ఎక్కువ జరుగుతుందని గ్రహించి మొత్తానికి ఆ రంగం నుంచి నిష్క్రమించి కొత్త జీవితాన్ని ప్రారంభిస్తాడు. ఆ తరువాత ఏమి జరిగిందో తెలుసుకోండి ఇది విని.

ex-ki-dulhan.title: Ex Ki Dulhan
ex-ki-dulhan.description: Ek ameer pariwar ki beti Palak, driver ke bete Rohan ke pyar me andhi hokar ban baithi uski kattputli. Par Rohan se pyar ke badle me use mili to bas beizatti. Ek din achanak Palak ho gayi gayab. Do mahine baad Palak ek naye roop me phir se laut aayi hai. Ab uske dil me Rohan nahi, balki hai uska saccha pyar Abhinav. Ab uska ek hi maqsad hai Rohan se uski bewafai ka badla lena. Aakhir kya hai Palak ke is badle hue roop ka raaz? Aur kaun hai ye Abhinav, jo hai uska saccha pyar?

thandavam.title: താണ്ഡവം
thandavam.description: മലയാളത്തിലെ എക്കാലത്തെയും മികച്ച ജനപ്രിയ നോവലിസ്റ്റ് കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥിൻ്റെ മാന്ത്രിക നോവൽ. മന്ത്രതന്ത്ര വിദ്യകളുടെയും അതീന്ദ്രിയ ശക്തികളുടെ ഉപാസനയുടെയും പശ്ഛാത്തലത്തിൽ എഴുതപ്പെട്ട അത്യന്തം ഉദ്ദ്വേഗജനകമായ നോവൽ. കേൾക്കാം, വിവിധ ഭാഷകളിലേക്ക് തർജ്ജമ ചെയ്യപ്പെട്ട  പുഷ്പനാഥിൻ്റെ മറ്റൊരു മാസ്റ്റർപീസ്.

bharatiya-railway-itihaasa.title: Bharatiya Railway Itihaasa
bharatiya-railway-itihaasa.description: ವಿಶ್ವದಲ್ಲೇ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿರುವ ದೇಶ ಭಾರತ. ಇಂತಹ ಬೃಹತ್ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕೂ ಮೂಲೆಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು ನಂಬಲಾರದಷ್ಟು ಸವಾಲಿನ ಕೆಲಸ. ಭಾರತೀಯ ರೈಲ್ವೇ ಈ ವಿಚಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದ ಗಮನೀಯ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಿದೆ. ದೇಶದ ಜೀವನಾಡಿ ಎನ್ನಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವ ರೈಲ್ವೇ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಹಾಗೂ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "ಭಾರತೀಯ ರೈಲ್ವೇ ಇತಿಹಾಸ" ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

operation-afeem-true-case-of-barabanki-d.title: Operation Afeem: True Case Of Barabanki Drug Cartel
operation-afeem-true-case-of-barabanki-d.description: Ek honest SP, ek Qaatil aur ek sheher jo drugs mein doob chuka hai! System ke andar bhi system hai aur har dosti ke peeche chhupi hai saazish...Red-light area ke raaz ho ya netaon ka khel, Barabanki ke kone kone mein hai drugs ki jwala magar Sawaal yeh hai ki kya sach zinda bachega ya andheraa sab kuch nigal jaayega? Abhi suniye yeh show aur sach par se parda uthayiye.

savithri.title: Savithri
savithri.description: பெரும்பாலும் ஆண்களே கோலோச்சுகின்ற தமிழ்த் திரையுலகில் உருவான முன்மாதிரி இல்லாத துருவ நட்சத்திரம் சாவித்திரி.  சிவாஜி சிம்மாசனத்தில் இருந்த காலகட்டத்திலேயே நடிகையர் திலகம் என்ற புகழ்மொழி சாவித்ரிக்கு மட்டுமே சாத்தியமாகியிருக்கிறது. வெற்றிகளை திகட்ட திகட்ட சுவைத்த சாவித்ரியின் இறுதி வாழ்க்கை சோகத்தால் மட்டுமே நிரம்பியிருந்தது என்பது பெரும் முரண். சாவித்ரியின் வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு தமிழ் சினிமா வரலாற்றின் தவிர்க்க முடியாத அத்தியாயம்...

syndicate.title: Syndicate
syndicate.description: నైట్ క్లబ్ లో జరుగుతున్న సెక్స్ రాకెట్ కి తానే లీడర్ అని ప్రియా ఒప్పుకోవడంతో న్యూస్ ఛానల్స్ అన్ని ప్రియా అన్నయ్య అయిన శ్రీ కృష్ణ మీద దండయాత్ర చేస్తాయి.ఆ దండయాత్ర నుండి శ్రీ కృష్ణ ఎలా తప్పించుకున్నాడు?? ప్రియకి సెక్స్ రాకెట్ కి సంబంధం ఏంటి? నైట్ క్లబ్ లో జరుగుతున్న ఇల్లీగల్ ఆక్టివిటీస్ గురించి శ్రీ కృష్ణ తెలుసుకోగలుగుతాడా??

lovers-in-the-dark-season-2.title: Lovers In The Dark Season 2
lovers-in-the-dark-season-2.description: Mayra ek nayi zindagi shuru karne ja rahi thi lekin uske khwab ke neeche ek purana sach chupkar baitha tha. Jab Yuvraj achanak uski zindagi mein wapas laut aaya, ek aise raaz ke saath jo sab kuch badal sakta hai, tab pyaar aur dard ke beech ki seema dhundhli hone lagti hai. Chhupi baatein, junoon, aur ek aisa kamra jahan har tasveer ek sach chhupaaye baithi hai, sab kuch ulajhne lagta hai. Is baar sirf dil nahi tootenge, bharosa, pehchaan aur sachai bhi sawalon mein ghir jaayenge.

seetha-mithilayile-veeranayik.title: മിഥിലയിലെ വീരനായിക
seetha-mithilayile-veeranayik.description: വാല്മീകി രാമായണത്തെ ആധുനിക രീതിയില്‍ പുനര്‍വായന നടത്തുന്ന അമീഷ് ത്രിപാഠിയുടെ നോവൽ പരമ്പരയിലെ  രണ്ടാം പുസ്തകം. ഒരു വയലില്‍ ഉപേക്ഷിക്കപ്പെട്ട നിലയിൽ കണ്ട ഒരു  പെണ്‍കുഞ്ഞിനെ രക്തദാഹികളായ ചെന്നായ്ക്കളില്‍ നിന്ന് അവളെ ഒരു കഴുകന്‍ സംരക്ഷിച്ചു. മിഥിലയിലെ ജനക മഹാരജാവ് പിന്നീട് അവളെ ദത്തെടുക്കുന്നു.  അവള്‍ വളർന്ന് മിഥിലയിലെ പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി സീത ആയി, ജനലക്ഷങ്ങളുടെ ദേവതയായി. ത്യാഗത്തിൻ്റെയും സഹനത്തിൻ്റെയും പര്യായമായ ഇതിഹാസ കഥാപാത്രത്തിൻ്റെ കഥ കേൾക്കാം.

ayyappa-swamy-mahathme.title: Ayyappa Swamy Mahathme
ayyappa-swamy-mahathme.description: ಅಯ್ಯಪ್ಪ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಮಹಾತ್ಮೆಯ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು, ಸ್ವಾಮಿಯ ದೈವಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿ, ಸತ್ಕರ್ಮಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಭಕ್ತರಿಗಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ತ್ಯಾಗಗಳ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಬರಿಮಲೆ ಯಾತ್ರೆಯ ಪಾವಿತ್ರ್ಯ, ಅಯ್ಯಪ್ಪನ ಜೀವಿತಕಥೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಭಕ್ತಿಗೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಭಕ್ತರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾದ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಶ್ರವಣ ಮಾಡುವವರಲ್ಲಿ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಬೆಳಕನ್ನು ತರುತ್ತದೆ.

ghibli-3d-ai-action-figure-banana-seekho.title: Ghibli 3D AI Action Figure Banana Seekho
ghibli-3d-ai-action-figure-banana-seekho.description: Ghibli 3D AI Action Figure Banana Seekho

revenge-of-chanakya-4.title: Revenge of Chanakya
revenge-of-chanakya-4.description: When visionary executive Ravi Kashyap is betrayed by his corrupt CEO Nakul Mehta and abandoned by his wife Shanaya, his world collapses. But a chance encounter with delivery boy Chandra Gupta reignites his fire. Guided by the ancient wisdom of Chanakya Neeti, Ravi transforms himself into a modern day Chanakya building an empire from ashes to take ruthless revenge on those who destroyed him.

baazigar-o-baazigar.title: Baazigar O Baazigar
baazigar-o-baazigar.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous relationship between aspiring singer Ayaan and his secretly married lyricist wife, Vidya. Initially, Ayaan publicly declares his love for Sanjana, neglecting Vidya and fueling public speculation about their romance. This betrayal escalates dramatically when a pregnant Sanjana moves into Ayaan and Vidya's home, leading Ayaan to force Vidya out. Vidya, deeply hurt, eventually exposes Ayaan's double life and their marriage, igniting a bitter rivalry with Sanjana. Following their divorce, Sanjana orchestrates an elaborate deception, faking a pregnancy and miscarriage, and framing Vidya to secure Ayaan's wealth and an engagement. Meanwhile, Vidya, reeling from betrayal and a life-threatening injury, seeks new connections, finding support in Abhimanyu and later encountering music mogul Vidyut Taal. Ayaan, struggling with creative block, is further manipulated by Sanjana, who uses his heartbreak over Vidya's engagement to push for their marriage. However, Ayaan eventually uncovers Sanjana's elaborate deception and her true financial motives, realizing his accusations against Vidya were unfounded. Trapped by Sanjana's blackmail, Ayaan is forced into a marriage to protect his career and Vidya's reputation, while desperately seeking to reconcile with his lost love. Years later, Ayaan, now a successful singer, attempts to win back Vidya, who has moved on and found support in her fiancé, Vidyut. Vidya, having sacrificed her identity for Ayaan's career, repeatedly rejects his apologies and advances, asserting her independence. Sanjana continues her manipulative schemes, threatening Ayaan's career and freedom, even stealing Vidya's musical compositions. The narrative culminates in a dramatic wedding interruption where Ayaan's dangerous deal with a music mogul is exposed, and Vidya confronts him about his artistic deception. Despite pleas for reconciliation from her estranged husband, Aryan (Ayaan), an empowered Vidya chooses self-respect and a fresh start with a new partner. She prioritizes her professional aspirations and demands genuine integrity in both love and art, ultimately leaving her tumultuous past behind to forge her own path. The stakes involve Vidya's artistic integrity, personal freedom, and the pursuit of genuine love versus the manipulative schemes of Sanjana and Ayaan's career ambitions.

fighter-ceo-3.title: Fighter CEO
fighter-ceo-3.description: Samrat, an enigmatic CEO and decorated army major, secretly mentors entrepreneur Thanika Malhotra, whom he plans to propose to. However, Thanika, unaware of his true identity and immense wealth, cruelly rejects him for his perceived lack of status, boasting of her 'Secret CEO' mentor. Simultaneously, powerful heiress Priya Chopra declares Samrat her future husband and proposes a contract marriage, which Samrat accepts with a condition, aiming to prove his capabilities to Thanika. This strategic alliance allows Samrat, now known as Sameer, to access the elite Ashok Vardhan Corporation, sparking suspicion and fear in Thanika, who publicly humiliates him. Despite scorn from Priya's family and ex-fiancé, Sameer gradually reveals his true identity as the sole heir to Shah Industry and a billionaire CEO, orchestrating a meticulous corporate takeover that humbles Thanika. Thanika's world crumbles as her corporate funding is withdrawn, and she realizes Sameer was the 'Silent Billionaire' she scorned. Consumed by bitter regret, Thanika launches an obsessive public campaign to reclaim Sameer, dismissing his marriage to Priya as a mere 'contract arrangement' and even staging a fake suicide attempt. However, Sameer, now Major Samrat Ashok Raj Singh, remains unyielding, asserting his commitment to Priya, whose integrity and unconditional acceptance have transformed their contract marriage into genuine love and a strong partnership. Tanika eventually embarks on a journey of self-discovery, healing from her unhealthy obsession and resolving to launch her own independent business, finding peace and wishing Sameer and Priya happiness. Sameer and Priya celebrate their thriving relationship, leading their company to global expansion and being recognized as 'Business Couple of the Year,' their resilient bond now facing an unknown challenge with the dramatic arrival of a party from England.

thugs-of-ghaziabad-3.title: Thugs of Ghaziabad
thugs-of-ghaziabad-3.description:
A young man is forced into a marriage with a beautiful innocent girl by his powerful gangster-politician father.
As family rivalry spills into the dark politics of Ghaziabad, guns replace words.
One bloodbath will decide who survives—and who rules.

pyaar-ka-price.title: Pyaar ka Price
pyaar-ka-price.description: Piyush, a CEO living a double life as a humble tailor, initially aims to foster his wife Vani's independent success, but Vani, a materialistic designer, publicly shames him and demands a luxury car, threatening divorce. Her disdain escalates into emotional abuse, fueled by her parents, while she secretly plans to divorce Piyush and marry a billionaire. Simultaneously, Meher, a desperate heiress, is drawn to Piyush's humble persona and relentlessly pursues him, sparking a fierce rivalry with Vani over the coveted luxury car. Despite Vani's alleged infidelity and continued humiliation, Piyush makes grand gestures to protect her career, even enduring false accusations of theft and public shaming orchestrated by CEO Raghav, against whom Piyush vows revenge. Meher dramatically enters the corporate world as a new boss, acquiring a significant stake and engaging in a manipulative game with Piyush, hinting at a deeper agenda to 'free' him from Vani's influence. The conflict culminates when Vani, driven by ambition and greed, agrees to 'barter' Piyush to Meher for a dream promotion and corporate power, devastating Piyush who discovers her betrayal at a surprise party he arranged. Emotionally blackmailed by Vani and her parent, Piyush reluctantly divorces Vani and marries Meher, all while secretly planning to reveal his billionaire identity and orchestrate a high-stakes corporate revenge against Vani. Piyush successfully orchestrates Vani's dramatic corporate downfall, stripping her of power and fortune, only for Vani to discover his true identity as a reclusive billionaire and publicly expose him as a 'fraud' and 'mere tailor' at an award ceremony. His wife (Nairitti/Meher) discovers his hidden identity and revenge plot, leading her to demand a divorce, though they later reconcile, affirming their genuine love. However, Piyush's ex-lover Vani reappears, falsely claiming pregnancy with his child and attempting to blackmail him for a massive inheritance. Piyush's sister uncovers Vani's elaborate paternity fraud, exposing the child belongs to another man. In a final, violent confrontation, Vani attacks Piyush and Meher, injuring Meher. Piyush then proposes to Meher, who accepts on the condition that he abandons his corporate identity to be solely her husband, suggesting a path towards a more authentic life for him.

billion-dollar-brother-4.title: Billion Dollar Brother
billion-dollar-brother-4.description: When the arrogant and wealthy Aditya Prasad returns to his hometown after years abroad, he hides his billionaire status behind a simple identity. But when he meets the fiery and independent Jhanvi, his past secrets, family wounds, and unresolved rivalries resurface. In a clash of pride, love, and redemption, Samar must choose between ego and heart before it's too late. Watch Now!

hukum-ka-ikka.title: Hukum Ka Ikka
hukum-ka-ikka.description: "Hukum Ka Ikka" follows Kabir Malhotra, a disgraced mathematical prodigy hiding as a janitor who utilizes his superhuman calculation skills to rescue his love, Ananya, from a ruthless criminal underworld. To pay a massive ransom, Kabir infiltrates the high-stakes stock market, turning a single rupee into a billion-crore fortune through ghost trading and complex algorithms. After striking a desperate deal with a cold corporate CEO, he systematically dismantles his enemies’ financial empires

dulhaniya-in-paradise.title: Dulhaniya In Paradise
dulhaniya-in-paradise.description: Top model Aalya's career is shattered by her manipulative boyfriend, Rohan, who blacklists her from the industry. Facing an abusive home, she impulsively enlists a waiter to pose as her new partner, unknowingly attracting the attention of billionaire CEO Kabir Singhania, who was undercover. Kabir offers Aalya a secretary position with a strict "no-romance" clause and shelter in his penthouse after her aunt throws her out. Aalya accepts, vowing fierce revenge against Rohan for his betrayal and humiliation. As Aalya navigates her new role, she faces public humiliation and sabotage from Rohan and socialite rivals like Malaika, but Kabir consistently acts as her protector and ally, defending her and encouraging her modeling dreams. However, Kabir dramatically betrays Aalya, publicly shaming and abandoning her at their wedding, revealing a vengeful plot. Heartbroken, Aalya enters a contract marriage with the mysterious Devraj, who is secretly the powerful CEO Dev Kapoor, to salvage her honor. Their relationship blossoms amidst corporate power struggles and challenges from Dev's past, including the formidable heiress Karishma Hooda, who claims Dev as her childhood sweetheart and demands he divorce Aalya. Aalya discovers her marriage to Dev is a temporary contract, yet unexpected feelings develop between them. Karishma becomes an obsessive rival, attempting to break them apart through blackmail and staging compromising situations. Aalya also faces threats from her former boss, Rachit, whom Dev brutally retaliates against for harming her. Karishma forms an alliance with an arrogant heiress, leading to Aalya's public humiliation and eventual disappearance. Enraged and suspicious, Dev seals the entire island, confronting Karishma whom he suspects of Aalya's abduction. Dev rescues Aalya from a cold storage unit on an isolated island. Aalya's gratitude turns to suspicion as Dev's immense power contradicts his humble facade, leading to the revelation of his true identity as billionaire Devraj Kapoor. Despite her past trauma with wealthy men, Aalya's unconditional love transcends his wealth. Dev proposes a genuine marriage, explicitly rejecting any transactional agreements, which Aalya accepts, signifying a new beginning for their complex relationship.

unknown-connection-3.title: Unknown Connection
unknown-connection-3.description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonal secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her "family," while Sonal's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonal's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.

secret-legend-2.title: Secret Legend
secret-legend-2.description: When humble Masseur Veer Jindal is humiliated by his wife and her family, they have no idea he is secretly the billionaire chairman of the powerful  Group. As betrayals unfold and family ties are tested, Veer’s hidden identity shakes their world, exposing greed, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Watch Now!

queen-of-snakes.title: Queen Of Snakes
queen-of-snakes.description: Devika thought she had found love, only to discover her husband, Vikrant, was a prince who conspired to destroy her unborn child. Brutalized by his lawful wife and carrying the bloodline of an enemy who wiped out her village, Devika was forced to embrace her identity as a powerful Naag Kanya. As ancient curses flared, she watched her betrayers rot from within, proving that no one escapes the bite of karma.

when-soulmates-meet-again-3.title: When Soulmates Meet Again
when-soulmates-meet-again-3.description: Aarav and Preeti were married as kids but got separated when her family moved away. 15 years later, they unknowingly meet again at work  neither recognizing the other. As they fall in love, both keep searching for the childhood partner they once married, unaware they’ve already found each other.

last-72-hours.title: Last 72 Hours
last-72-hours.description: After a wealthy businessman dies in a mysterious car accident, his grieving family becomes the center of suspicion. As a determined police officer and an insurance investigator dig deeper, hidden secrets and a carefully planned deception begin to surface, revealing that the truth behind the tragedy may be far more dangerous than it appears.

mid-life-romance.title: Mid Life Romance
mid-life-romance.description: A lonely ex-army man and a beautiful food-stall owner are brought together by fate and a child’s innocent wish. As he hides his true identity, their bond grows beyond love into healing and trust. But this connection leads her to a shocking truth—the daughter she lost may not be gone forever.

royal-prince-returns.title: Royal Prince Returns
royal-prince-returns.description: Karan, a poor scrap-collector boy, struggles to save his cancer-stricken mother, unaware he’s the lost heir of the powerful Rathore family. Twenty years later, Rama Rathore has built an empire but still searches for her vanished son. Fate brings them face-to-face, mother and son, unaware of their blood bond, just as betrayal, greed, and revenge close in. The moment truth surfaces, everything they’ve built may burn, because the royal prince is about to return. Watch Now!

d498a27f-681d-4d5a-b009-9c357684ca1b.title: Billionaire Sasur ka Badla
d498a27f-681d-4d5a-b009-9c357684ca1b.description: Ruhi traps a rich heir, pretending to be innocent while secretly cheating on him. When she humiliates an old man at a car showroom—beating him, insulting him, and burning his wife’s last photograph—she doesn’t realize he is Rajat Singhania, the billionaire founder and her fiancé’s father. Now the insulted tycoon plans a brutal revenge, determined to expose her truth and destroy her in front of the entire city.

billionaire-by-pregnancy-2.title: Billionaire by Pregnancy
billionaire-by-pregnancy-2.description:
A smart, hardworking woman’s life takes a shocking turn when she accidentally becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son.
Is the child's father the  biggest billionaire in town? 
A story filled with twists, secrets, and unexpected turns.

unknown-connection-2.title: Unknown Connection
unknown-connection-2.description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonia secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her 'family', while Sonia's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonia's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.

when-soulmates-meet-again-2.title: When Soulmates Meet Again
when-soulmates-meet-again-2.description: Aarav and Preeti were married as kids but got separated when her family moved away. 15 years later, they unknowingly meet again at work — neither recognizing the other. As they fall in love, both keep searching for the childhood partner they once married, unaware they’ve already found each other.

in-481-hijacked.title: IN 481: Hijacked
in-481-hijacked.description: The show centers on a major airborne terror crisis around India Airlines Flight 481, where an early intelligence warning is slowed by bureaucracy and the plane takes off before officials can stop it. Once airborne, the flight becomes a hostage situation as hijackers seize control, threaten passengers, and repeatedly demand the release of Yaqub Baba. The crisis is not just about one aircraft, but about whether the state will negotiate with terrorists or hold its line and risk innocent lives. On the ground, RAW and intelligence officers scramble to respond, with C.B. Raju and others coordinating under pressure while trying to keep track of hidden accomplices and the bomb threat. White Tiger is inserted covertly among the passengers and works to locate and neutralize the device without exposing his cover. The onboard danger escalates from intimidation to open violence, with passengers injured, captives tortured, and the threat of a VX bomb turning the flight into a national security emergency. At several points, the hijackers use executions, gunfire, and psychological abuse to force compliance, while the hostages struggle to protect the vulnerable, including a pregnant woman and a critically ill colonel. The rescue effort becomes more complicated as investigators suspect that some passengers may be linked to the plot, and internal betrayal begins to surface among the captors and their allies. A mid-air commando response is launched, showing that the government is willing to act directly rather than surrender to the demands. The bomb crisis deepens when the device is tied to an even deadlier biological threat, pushing authorities toward extreme options to prevent mass casualties. Across these episodes, the story keeps returning to the same central dilemma: save the people on the plane without giving the terrorists what they want. The conflict also widens beyond the aircraft, with separate hostage and rescue threads showing agents, soldiers, and civilians caught in overlapping violence. Even when the immediate crisis appears to be resolved, the victory feels fragile because the people involved remain scarred, injured, and still under threat. One episode closes with public celebration after a two-hour hijack incident is resolved, but that relief is undercut by the revelation that Shitiz is living a hidden double life. He returns home injured, tries to protect his family from the truth, and is then pulled back into covert duty by a mysterious caller. This ending suggests that the larger struggle is not fully over, and that the cost of the mission continues even after the public thinks the danger has passed.

billionaire-by-pregnancy-1.title: Billionaire By Pregnancy
billionaire-by-pregnancy-1.description: Soumya, a determined single mother, struggles to secure funds for her critically ill son, Krish, while facing societal judgment and a mysterious past. Her path crosses with Aditya, a wealthy CEO under immense family pressure to secure a male heir. Soumya takes a secretarial job with Aditya, reigniting a past connection and facing rivalry from Ruhi, who later assaults Krish. Aditya heroically saves Krish from a severe allergic reaction, hinting at a deeper bond. Aditya's powerful father, Ramprasad, embarks on a desperate search for his missing grandson, Krish, eventually reuniting with him and Soumya and declaring Krish his sole heir, which draws new threats. Amidst corporate intrigue, Soumya's accidental pregnancy with triplets is revealed at work, leading to public shaming. Aditya intervenes, clears her name, and discovers he is the father. He passionately pleads with her to keep the children, promising full responsibility. Aditya's father demands he marry Soumya to secure an heir, but Aditya is also searching for his long-lost love, Nithya, whose father is also searching for her. Aditya's arranged engagement shatters, and he proposes to Soumya after confirming Krish is his son. Soumya's revelation of triplet pregnancy transforms the patriarch's disapproval into joyous acceptance, seemingly breaking a generational curse. However, Aditya secretly plots DNA tests to find Nithya, unaware of Soumya's true identity. Soumya endures further public shaming, but a dramatic turn reveals her as the long-lost Nithya, leading to a poignant family reunion and Aditya's realization of their fated connection. Now identified as Nithya, and heavily pregnant with triplets, she returns home, discovering a vast inheritance. She faces deadly threats from her jealous sister, Rohini, whose manipulative plots escalate to attempted murder and reveal a dark past of kidnapping. Rohini is arrested for conspiracy, vowing revenge. The show culminates with Nithya going into labor, creating a crisis for the family's 18-generation tradition of a single heir, with Rohini's vengeance still looming.

jadui-healer.title: Jadui Healer
jadui-healer.description: a young man named Ajay discovers he possesses mystical powers to both heal and kill with his hands, a secret he carries for fifteen years while building a business empire as the mysterious "Agyaat." After using his abilities to save the daughter of a billionaire and restore the beauty of his long-lost love, Nalini, Ajay faces off against the corrupt Mittal family who once tried to destroy him

thugs-of-ghaziabad-2.title: Thugs Of Ghaziabad
thugs-of-ghaziabad-2.description: he family rivalry trickles into the local politics and underbelly of Ghaziabad. This ignites a chain of gun violence,  leading to the bloodbath that decides the fate of both parties.

invisible-jassi-2.title: Invisible Jassi
invisible-jassi-2.description: Jassi is a sweet, innocent, yet highly intelligent girl who longs for genuine friendships. However, she's constantly ignored and humiliated by those around her simply because she doesn't fit society's conventional standards of beauty. With braces on her teeth, a unique sense of style, and an unconventional haircut, Jassi is often judged by her appearance rather than her character.

cricketer-ki-love-story.title: Cricketer Ki Love Story
cricketer-ki-love-story.description: After a masked one-night encounter with India’s hottest cricket star, struggling physiotherapy student Shanaaya disappears, unknowingly leaving behind the ring her mother gave her. Humiliated and determined to find the mysterious girl who “priced” him, star cricketer Vicky Khurana launches a public hunt. When fate makes Shanaaya his personal physio, a dangerous game of secrets, class conflict, and rising attraction begins.

billionaires-unknown-son-3.title: Billionaire's Unknown Son
billionaires-unknown-son-3.description: Kathir sacrifices his childhood for his mother… 20 years later, Tina betrays his love, and fate brings Ragini back for revenge.

ishq-dhoka-aur-revenge.title: Ishq, Dhoka aur Revenge
ishq-dhoka-aur-revenge.description: Arav Malhotra endured every insult for the woman he loved but Nisha betrayed him for her greed! What she didn't know is that Arav is no ordinary salesman. And his revenge will teach her a lesson she can never forget!

roadside-billionaire.title: Roadside Billionaire
roadside-billionaire.description: Aditya, a rich CEO living like a beggar to stay hidden, falls in love with Kriti—the only one who treats him with kindness. When her fiancé cheats on her, Aditya enters a fake marriage to protect her family and secretly keeps saving her. The truth about him shocks Kriti at first, but she realizes his love is real and chooses to stay with him forever.

don-dolly-aur-dulhaniya.title: Don Dolly Aur Dulhaniya
don-dolly-aur-dulhaniya.description: The series begins with Sanjay, a charismatic hero, protecting Sneha, which blossoms into a romance, even as he secretly plans to dismantle the powerful Talwar dynasty. Sanjay, revealed as wealthy CEO Ishan, lives a double life, intending a grand reveal and a massive investment for Sneha, but his plans are shattered when Sneha, driven by ambition, publicly humiliates him and demands a divorce, aligning with a new partner. This betrayal ignites Sanjay's fierce vow of revenge, leading to his transformation into the enigmatic 'Underground Badshah,' Aryan, who systematically orchestrates the downfall of the Talwar family and Sneha's corporate ambitions. As Aryan, he manipulates events from the shadows, dismantling their financial empire and challenging their authority, while facing threats from global agencies and formidable adversaries. Amidst this, Ishan's focus shifts as Vamika, an heiress, proposes marriage, drawing him away from his criminal world. Their secret marriage is revealed when Vamika's father attempts to force her into an arranged union with the villainous Gulshan, prompting Ishan to dramatically intervene and assert his claim. Despite facing public humiliation and accusations of fraud, Ishan, fiercely defended by Vamika, gradually reveals his formidable hidden identity as the true CEO of Global Gold and the 'Underground Badshah,' with a past in illicit gold. The narrative culminates as Ishan prepares to dramatically unveil his full power, confronting rivals like Nitin and cleansing the corrupt global gold trade. Vamika, having secured significant funding, severs ties with her manipulative parents, choosing Ishan as her family, and proposes a permanent union. Ishan accepts, offering her a powerful business partnership to conquer the world together, signifying a new era of shared power and ambition.

billionaires-unknown-son-2.title: Billionaire's Unknown Son
billionaires-unknown-son-2.description: The story follows Mihir, a devoted young man whose early life is marked by poverty, illness, and the loss of his mother, Hima. After his mother's death and a painful separation from his grandfather, Mihir grows into a talented individual entangled in complex family and corporate dynamics. Ragini, a powerful CEO and Mihir's estranged mother, embarks on a relentless quest to find her missing son, intertwining personal loss with corporate ambition. Mihir's life becomes further complicated when he enters a contract engagement with heiress Teena, blending romance with strategic career moves. Meanwhile, corporate intrigue deepens as Mihir's mother investigates the unauthorized use of his ventilator invention by Morphee Industries. Ragini's suspicions about Mihir's identity lead to DNA tests and orchestrated encounters, including a significant moment involving a distinctive watch. The narrative escalates with Teena's public proposal to Rahul, sparking family tensions and a rivalry that culminates in a violent confrontation and shocking revelations about paternity. Maya emerges as Mihir's protector, exposing Teena's betrayal and igniting a corporate power struggle involving unseen forces like Tina and Ena. Ragini asserts control over the Thrita Group, challenging arrogant heirs like Rahul and Arun, leading to public humiliations, wealth displays, and brutal assaults that fuel a corporate war. The destruction of a cherished watch triggers further vendettas, with CEO Roni blacklisting families and Ragini punishing corrupt executives, highlighting themes of revenge and power. Teena's sudden rise from secretary to wealthy insider adds layers of ambition and hidden motives. The climax reveals deep family ties as Ragini confronts disrespectful heirs and reveals Meher as her son, personalizing corporate conflicts. A long-awaited reunion between Ragini and Mihir confirms his rightful heir status, while the mysterious Singhania prepares to intervene in unresolved affairs. Ajay's journey from seeking revenge to offering forgiveness after reuniting with Ragini and Mihir underscores the transformative power of family and reconciliation. Throughout, the narrative weaves a complex web of love, ambition, betrayal, and identity within the elite corporate world, culminating in battles for control, justice, and belonging.

royal-price-returns.title: Royal Price Returns
royal-price-returns.description: The show follows Karan from a childhood shaped by poverty, illness, and separation into an adulthood defined by betrayal, hidden identity, and a fight to reclaim dignity. As a boy, he does everything he can to support his ailing mother, collecting scrap, making small sacrifices, and clinging to tokens of love such as a cherished watch and a Sun-and-Moon locket. His mother, in turn, repeatedly chooses him over security, even refusing cruel demands that she abandon him in exchange for medical help. Their bond is broken by forced separation and overshadowed by larger threats, leaving Karan to grow up with loss, uncertainty, and later partial memory loss. Years later, while powerful figures search publicly for a missing son named Karan, he lives humbly as a worker and inventor, unaware of how closely his past is closing in on him. His love for Sameera becomes the first major disaster of his adult life, because he gives her his research, savings, and trust while she uses his work for status and aligns herself with wealthier power. When she publicly rejects him and takes credit tied to his years of effort, Karan is humiliated not just romantically but socially and professionally. That humiliation expands into a larger class and corporate war as Vikrant and allied family members use money, influence, and threats to crush him and intimidate anyone who stands beside him. Karan refuses to submit, repeatedly accusing Sameera of stealing his project and patent even when he is mocked, assaulted, or pressured into silence. Around him, protectors begin to emerge, including loyal workers, Veronica, elder family figures, and powerful women whose authority starts reversing the balance against his enemies. The struggle increasingly turns on identity, as clues such as patents, age, baking, a distinctive watch, and especially the Sun-and-Moon locket connect Karan to long-buried family truths. Multiple parental claims and revelations create uncertainty before the story gradually confirms that Karan belongs to a powerful family network tied to Mrs. Rathore, Rima or Rema, and General Bakshi. Once those truths surface, the same elites who degraded him begin losing status, jobs, business ties, and protection, while those who supported him are rewarded and restored. Public ceremonies, engagement politics, lavish gifts, and fake displays of wealth become battlegrounds where status is asserted, exposed, and overturned. Sameera continues trying to rise through money, appointments, and marriage alliances, but she also becomes marked as a threat within the very corporate world she seeks to dominate. Violence and intimidation repeatedly erupt around Karan, Veronica, and their families, showing that the fight is never only emotional but also physical and institutional. In the final movement, the family fracture at the center of Karan’s life is confronted directly as Rema challenges General Bakshi over his absence and Karan is acknowledged as his biological son. That recognition immediately changes the power dynamic, allowing abuses against Karan and his mother to be punished rather than ignored. Even so, the emotional resolution is selective: Karan does not forgive Sameera, condemning her deceit and her contempt for him before his status was known. The show ultimately resolves not through romance but through restoration of family, identity, and honor, as Karan gains a sense of wholeness with his mother and father present while those who exploited his vulnerability are exposed.

blind-love-deadly-truth.title: Blind Love Deadly Truth
blind-love-deadly-truth.description: After losing his eyesight in an accident, billionaire Karan Malhotra is abandoned by his girlfriend and pushed to the edge of despair. Aradhya, a strong-willed woman hiding her own powerful identity, saves him and agrees to a contract marriage to become his “eyes.” As Karan battles betrayal, a murderous stepbrother, and corporate conspiracies within Malhotra Jewels, the fake marriage slowly turns into real love while buried secrets about Aradhya, their past, and their child begin to surface.

the-drunken-fighter-1.title: The Drunken Fighter
the-drunken-fighter-1.description: The series begins with the inexplicable destruction of an ancient, indestructible wall at a revered martial arts academy, prompting Guruji to seek a prophesied "Kung Fu Legend" among his students. Initially, the unassuming laundryman Bablu is suspected and mocked, but the ambitious disciple Prasad dramatically claims responsibility, revealing he secretly mastered a legendary technique to bring global recognition to the academy. Prasad's deceit is soon exposed, however, leading to the academy's financial ruin and a high-stakes championship proposed by the wealthy Vikramjeet, with Prasad initially presented as their champion seeking redemption. Amidst this crisis, Guruji's formidable daughter, Surabhi, emerges, determined to uncover the truth and believing Bablu, a perceived drunkard, holds the key to saving their institution. Surabhi relentlessly pursues Bablu, convinced he is the legendary "God of Kung Fu" and once saved her life, despite his persistent denials and reluctance to use his abilities. Bablu confesses his extraordinary powers once stemmed from a now-shattered sacred vessel, leading him to vow never to perform Kung Fu again, haunted by a past accidental death caused by his strength. However, he is compelled to unleash his dormant skills to protect others and save the academy from closure, often against his will and facing public humiliation. The narrative explores the corrupting influence of mystical elixirs and ancient artifacts, as various characters seek shortcuts to power, while Bablu undergoes a profound transformation, realizing true strength is inherent. Old rivals, including a vengeful Prasad, resurface to sabotage Bablu's dreams and reclaim massive financial losses, further complicating his journey. A shocking revelation unveils Bablu as Guruji's long-lost elder son and Surabhi's brother, possessing ancestral strength and a unique healing skill, though he suffers from memory loss and continues to deny his noble past. Despite pleas from his family, Bablu, now known as Chettan, incurs a staggering 750 crore rupee debt to a ruthless Master due to a financial misjudgment. This forces him into a brutal underground fighting league where losing a single match means death, compelling him to confront his destiny, embrace his true identity, and fight for his life, freedom, and family, ultimately fulfilling the prophecy of the "Kung Fu Legend."

billionaires-bold-beginning.title: Billionaire's Bold Beginning
billionaires-bold-beginning.description: When a genius mechanic secretly known as the legendary racer “Cartik” saves a garage from a gangster through a deadly race, he later joins an electric car company where the arrogant new CEO humiliates and fires him. As rival companies battle to recruit him and a fake genius rises inside the company, Aarav prepares to prove that real talent cannot be replaced.

a-delivery-boys-jackpot-3.title: A Delivery Boy's Jackpot
a-delivery-boys-jackpot-3.description: Bharat, a humble delivery boy, endures public humiliation and heartbreak when his girlfriend, Reshma, betrays him for the wealthy Rocky. On the brink of despair, he receives a mysterious inheritance from Golden Enterprises, a reward for a past selfless act, thrusting him into a world of immense wealth and corporate power. Bharat, also known as Sarvan, immediately faces class prejudice and challenges to his new authority, while his loyal friend Raju is assaulted for refusing to betray him. Embracing his role as a "rakshaka," Bharat vows revenge against Rocky and Reshma, striving to break into elite circles and protect his associates. His journey is marked by a tumultuous engagement to Reshma, which appears short-lived, and the emergence of allies like Girl 1, who defends him against classist rivals. Rocky, fueled by arrogance, orchestrates schemes to publicly shame Bharat, leading to high-stakes financial battles and revealing his own hidden affluence. Bharat later faces financial ruin, forcing him into a contract marriage with Raani to secure an inheritance and cover family secrets, living as a "live-in son-in-law." During this period, he navigates public humiliation from his ex-girlfriend Janvi, whose manager boyfriend's career he inadvertently destroys. Bharat also operates as the enigmatic "Maskman," forming a deep connection with Neenu, whom he rescues from abduction. He reveals his Maskman identity to Janvi, leading to a heartfelt confession of love, but his past catches up when a former lover resurfaces, and he is forced to marry Rani for corporate power. This impending union shatters Janvi, who is brutally kidnapped by her mercenary stepfather and sold to syndicate boss Raj Bhai. Despite Bharat's efforts and declarations of love, Janvi, heartbroken by his divided loyalties, fiercely rejects him. Concurrently, CEO Rani learns she must marry Bharat to save her corporate empire, a union that eventually blossoms into a heartfelt legal marriage. Further complicating matters, Jia orchestrates an identity swap to test Bharat's integrity, revealing a past debt of gratitude, while her friend Janvi, who posed as a wealthy heiress, confesses her elaborate deception. Feeling betrayed by Janvi's deceit, Bharat ultimately rejects her marriage proposal, highlighting the devastating impact of class and identity on love and solidifying his union with Rani.

secret-legend-1.title: Secret Legend
secret-legend-1.description: Veer, a CEO unjustly ousted from his family's Jindal group, returns with a meticulous plan to reclaim his legacy and exact revenge. Initially perceived as a "useless house husband" and publicly humiliated by Sneha's family and former associates, Veer secretly orchestrates a grand comeback. He dramatically reveals his immense personal wealth and hidden power, first by disclosing his role in Sneha's thousand-crore success, then by asserting his identity as the formidable Chairman of Crystal Group. This revelation leads to the downfall of rivals like Akash, who attempts to marry Sneha for corporate gain, only to be fired by Veer. However, the narrative takes a complex turn as a corporate emissary hints Veer is not the Chairman, and Sneha's own strategic power play is suggested. The corporate battle intensifies as Veer, now revealed as the secret billionaire heir and Chairman of the Jindal Group, orchestrates attacks that bring Sneha's company to the brink of ruin. Sneha is manipulated into a contract marriage with Akash due to her family's frozen assets, unaware of Veer's true identity and his calculated involvement in her circumstances. Veer systematically dismantles his adversaries, including former classmates Neha and Neeraj, who mocked his perceived poverty. A shocking twist reveals Akash, previously dismissed, as a powerful CEO, further complicating the corporate landscape. Veer's carefully constructed life unravels as his fraudulent past is exposed, shattering his marriage to Sneha, which was a multi-billion rupee contract. Despite this, he returns as a mysterious benefactor, driven by revenge against his rivals, and finds himself protecting Sneha from danger. The conflict culminates with Veer's ultimate reveal as the true billionaire heir who secretly saved the Jindal company, turning the tables on arrogant Aarav and other betrayers. He initiates calculated revenge, freezing assets and confronting his adversaries. A new antagonist, "The Boss," emerges, challenging Veer, while Aarav makes a sacrifice for Sneha. Amidst the corporate fallout and family betrayals, a complex and strained romantic past between Veer and Sneha resurfaces, leaving Sneha attempting to prevent Veer's departure, indicating an unresolved emotional arc.

countdown-king.title: Countdown King
countdown-king.description: Dhokha, gareebi aur majboori se shuru hui Anuj ki zindagi ek accident ke baad poori tarah palat gayi. Ab woh logon ki maut ka waqt hi nahi, balki antiques ki asli keemat , chhupi bimaariyan,  aur stocks ka future bhi dekh sakta tha. Ek delivery boy shehar ka kingmaker ban gaya. Jis biwi ne use thukraaya tha, use apni galti ka daam chukaana pada… aur jis shehar ne Anuj ko kam samjha tha, wahi uske rutbe ka gawaah bana. par wo ek baat bhul gaya ki har power ka ek khaufnaak daam hota hai.

a-drunken-fighter.title: A Drunken Fighter
a-drunken-fighter.description: The Drunken Fighter is a martial arts action-drama about hidden power, redemption, and destiny. Bablu, a ridiculed drunkard handyman at a legendary Kung Fu academy, secretly possesses the strength of the mythical “Iron Head.” As enemies challenge the academy and impostors claim his glory, Bablu must decide whether to keep hiding in the shadows or rise as the true legend who can save them all.

miracle-of-god-3.title: Miracle Of God
miracle-of-god-3.description: Rudra lives with the wealthy Sahgal family, but despite his loyalty and love for them, he is always treated like an outsider. One night, he is falsely accused of stealing a priceless 50-crore necklace. His father Vineet Sahgal and sister believe the accusation without question and throw him out of the house. Behind the scenes, his manipulative stepbrother Vikrant “Vicky” Sahgal is actually responsible for the theft and secretly enjoys watching Rudra’s humiliation.

drowned-in-love-1.title: Drowned in Love
drowned-in-love-1.description: ప్రకృతిని కాన్వాసు మీదకు తీసుకొచ్చే ఒక ఆర్టిస్టుకు, వ్యాపారంలో టాప్ లో ఉన్న ఒక బిజినెస్ మెన్ కి మధ్య ఉన్న ప్రేమే ఈ కథ.  సముద్రంలో అలల మాదిరిగా వాళ్ళ జీవితంలో సంఘటనలు వాళ్ళను తీరానికి చేర్చాయా లేదా చూడాల్సిందే.

the-billionaires-deal-3.title: The Billionaire's Deal
the-billionaires-deal-3.description: కిషికా ఒక వెయిట్రెస్. అనుకోని కారణాల వల్ల ఆమె విక్రాంత్ దగ్గర సెక్రటరీగా జాయిన్ అవుతుంది. అప్పటి నుండి ఆమెకు ఇబ్బందులు మొదలయ్యాయి. ఆమె తన అప్పులను తీర్చగలిగిందా? సిద్ధార్థ్ తో స్నేహం ఏమైంది? చూడండి "The Billionaire's Deal" మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

ultimate-revenge-1.title: Last Avenger
ultimate-revenge-1.description: Aarav Verma was once a helpless young man, mocked as a "madman" after his family's tragic downfall. But a divine intervention sent his soul to Amarlok, where he trained under mystical fairies to become a powerful warrior. He returned to Earth with a secret mission: recover three lost celestial weapons and avenge his parents.

the-hidden-hero-2.title: The Hidden Hero
the-hidden-hero-2.description: When a principled ex-commander hiding as a humble café worker saves a ruthless yet elegant CEO from a late-night assault, she tests his character with a fake marriage to uncover his weakness—but as secrets surface and enemies close in, their staged relationship turns into a high-stakes game of power, loyalty, and unexpected love.

crash-landed-into-love.title: Crash Landed Into Love
crash-landed-into-love.description: After a plane crash, billionaire heir Amar Luthra survives with amnesia and is saved by kind-hearted surgeon Dr. Rumi. While greedy nurse Nisha fakes Amar’s death to seize the Luthra empire, Amar lives as a nobody beside the woman who saved him—until love, truth, and a ruthless conspiracy collide, forcing him to reclaim his identity before Rumi loses everything.

a-delivery-boys-jackpot-2.title: A Delivery Boy's Jackpot
a-delivery-boys-jackpot-2.description: Luck can strike anyone, at any time, in unexpected ways. On that day, a delivery boy received a phone call—and his life changed forever. But along with the fortune, troubles began to follow. This is the story of a delivery boy who struggles to understand how to embrace sudden luck when it arrives all at once.

damaad-no-1.title: Damaad No. 1
damaad-no-1.description: Yash returns from London to his wife Mehak, only to be mocked as a "gold-digger" by her elite family who favor the wealthy Neel. While they plot to force a divorce, Yash hides his true identity as the powerful CEO of Blackthorn. Facing constant insults and even a police setup, Yash eventually peels back the layers of deception surrounding Neel and his family, proving that true worth isn't always found in a dapper suit. Watch now.

invisible-jassi-1.title: Invisible Jassi
invisible-jassi-1.description: Jessi, a scholarship student, endures profound loneliness and relentless bullying, primarily from her stepsister, Sam, who initially appears loving but betrays Jessi by abandoning her in a terrifying trap and orchestrating public humiliation. Her academic future is jeopardized, forcing her into a high-stakes science project with the arrogant Veer, who initially demands a humiliating act, sparking an intense rivalry. As Jessi grapples with grief over her mother's death, she finds empowerment through her "Mammy's" wisdom, learning to embrace her individuality despite escalating insecurity. However, her journey is challenged by fierce academic rivalries, with Sam and others like Meera attempting to sabotage her project and reputation, often targeting her appearance. A ruthless matriarch, Amma, further complicates matters, manipulating her daughter and conspiring with Sam to prevent Jessi from securing a life-changing scholarship and to seize property, even planning to release damaging videos. Jessi faces repeated public humiliations and betrayals, including from Veer, who seemingly sides with rivals and abruptly abandons her, plunging her into despair. Despite these setbacks, Jessi finds crucial support, notably from her best friend Arjun, who offers second chances, and eventually from Veer, who, despite his own anger issues and manipulative past, attempts to support her. Jessi undergoes a significant personal transformation, moving from uncertainty to an assertive identity, ultimately winning a scholarship for an innovative device designed to manage emotions, specifically Veer's anger. The relationship with Veer is tumultuous, marked by his manipulative and violent outbursts, digital blackmail, and periods of separation and reconciliation. In the climax, Veer, a football prodigy, prioritizes his deepening love for Jessi over his ambitious father's career demands, making a significant sacrifice. After initial rejection due to past betrayals, Jessi learns of Veer's sacrifice and frantically searches for him amidst his dangerous personal vendetta. Their final confrontation leads to Veer revealing his profound love and the true reason for his career choice, culminating in a powerful reconciliation and a promise of eternal commitment, as Jessi achieves academic recognition and personal triumph.

war-hero-returns-3.title: War hero returns
war-hero-returns-3.description: A disgraced war hero living as an auto-driver must team up with his biological son, who is the new Intelligence Chief, to expose a national conspiracy and reclaim his lost honor.

kanoon-ka-king.title: Kanoon Ka King
kanoon-ka-king.description: Karan Jethmalani, the secret heir of a powerful company, hides his identity and comes as a simple lawyer to propose to his college friend Sara. But before he can confess his love, Sara accepts the proposal of rich businessman Neel. Karan is insulted and humiliated in front of everyone. Years later Sara’s marriage becomes a nightmare and she is falsely accused of a terrible crime. When she ends up in jail, Karan returns as the most powerful lawyer to save her and expose Neel’s truth.

war-hero-returns.title: War Hero Returns
war-hero-returns.description: A disgraced war hero living as an auto-driver must team up with his biological son, who is the new Intelligence Chief, to expose a national conspiracy and reclaim his lost honor.

the-last-goodbye.title: Ek Galat Fehmi
the-last-goodbye.description: When Ruhaan Kapoor loses his company, parents, and marriage, he believes his wife Ishani betrayed him for money. What he never knows is that Ishani secretly divorced him to donate her heart to billionaire Prithviraj Bhalla in exchange for saving Ruhaan’s collapsing empire. Living on an artificial heart while raising their daughter Mishti, she lets Ruhaan hate her so he can rebuild. Five years later, Ruhaan learns the truth—but by then, Ishani is dying.

war-hero-returns-2.title: War Hero Returns
war-hero-returns-2.description: A disgraced war hero living as an auto-driver must team up with his biological son, who is the new Intelligence Chief, to expose a national conspiracy and reclaim his lost honor.

the-ceo-she-ignored-3.title: The CEO She Ignored
the-ceo-she-ignored-3.description: A useless house-husband is humiliated, betrayed, and thrown out by his ambitious wife—only to reveal he’s the secret billionaire CEO she depended on all along. As love turns to vengeance, a high-stakes game of power, lies, and karma unfolds, exposing greed, infidelity, and the true cost of underestimating the man who sacrificed everything.

firefighter-vs-billionaire.title: Firefighter vs Billionaire
firefighter-vs-billionaire.description: A young girl, Gia, is trapped in a raging house fire, an inferno that erupts shortly after her grandfather, Dadu, is unexpectedly called away, leaving her feeling betrayed. Concurrently, her parents, Neha and Mihir, are celebrating their anniversary when a car explosion shatters their joy, unaware of their daughter's peril. Firefighter Vikram, dispatched to rescue Gia, faces relentless and escalating obstruction from an entitled woman, later identified as Mihir's companion, and Mihir himself. They demand he clean her car, physically assault him, falsely accuse him, and extort exorbitant sums for trivial car damage, despite his desperate pleas about the trapped child. Vikram is held captive, forced to sacrifice his parents' life savings and record a video confession, as Mihir escalates demands for 'business loss.' Even as bystanders attempt to intervene and a news report reveals Mihir's companion's own child and father are imperiled at the fire location, the couple continues their ruthless demands. Further delays ensue when Vikram is blocked by a women's rights protest and then targeted by a mother and daughter orchestrating a 'revenge' against the 'lying firefighter,' leaving his mission and fate dire. Despite severe injuries and warnings, Vikram bravely plunges into the burning building, repeatedly calling out for 'Jia.' The family initially grieves, believing both Gia and Vikram have perished, but a miraculous emergence of Gia from the smoke offers fleeting hope, only for it to be tragically shattered by a medical professional's confirmation of her death due to suffocation. However, a faint heartbeat is later detected, igniting a desperate fight for Jia's survival. Her father, Mihir, a powerful CEO, unleashes his wealth and influence to control the hospital and save his critically ill daughter, whose condition is linked to his past arrogance and mistreatment of Vikram. A woman named Shikha, seeking revenge for Vikram, holds Jiya hostage, forcing Mihir into public humiliation and concessions to secure his daughter's release. Ultimately, Vikram's selfless heroism in saving Jiya is revealed, profoundly humbling Mihir and Sania, Jiya's mother. They are compelled to seek forgiveness and atone for their past wrongs, facing legal justice for their actions. While Jiya shares an affectionate bond with her parents, Vikram faces a new, unspecified emergency, suggesting the resolution of this immediate crisis but the potential for future challenges.

the-ceo-she-ignored.title: The CEO She Ignored
the-ceo-she-ignored.description: A useless house-husband is humiliated, betrayed, and thrown out by his ambitious wife—only to reveal he’s the secret billionaire CEO she depended on all along. As love turns to vengeance, a high-stakes game of power, lies, and karma unfolds, exposing greed, infidelity, and the true cost of underestimating the man who sacrificed everything.

rise-of-the-rejected-billionaire.title: Rise Of The Rejected Billionaire
rise-of-the-rejected-billionaire.description: Arjun, hamesha sabki izzat karne wala aur dusron ki madad karne wala ladka tha. Woh Tara se beintehaa pyaar karta tha, lekin Tara ke ameer parivaar ne is rishte ko kabhi kabool nahi kiya. Wapas aakar shaadi ka waada karke Tara higher studies ke liye abroad chali gayi, lekin lautne par usne Arjun ko dhokha dekar Vihaan Shah se shaadi kar li. par kis ko pata tha ki wahi Arjun,Oberoi parivaar ka waaris tha. Aur phir power, betrayal aur revenge ka khel shuru hua… jiska ant koi soch bhi nahi sakta.

coolies-diamond-bride-3.title: Coolie’s Diamond Bride
coolies-diamond-bride-3.description: A chance meeting at a railway station brings together Arya, a humble coolie, and Akanksha, the daughter of a powerful diamond tycoon. When Akanksha chooses love over wealth and society, Arya is humiliated, tested, and pushed to his limits. As secrets unravel, the world discovers that true worth is not defined by status or money but by courage, integrity, and love. This is a romantic drama where a “coolie” becomes a king, and love proves to be the rarest diamond of all.

war-hero-returns-1.title: War Hero Returns
war-hero-returns-1.description: A disgraced war hero living as an auto-driver must team up with his biological son, who is the new Intelligence Chief, to expose a national conspiracy and reclaim his lost honor.

not-her-husband.title: Not Her Husband
not-her-husband.description: When Nandini—president of Indus Airlines—catches her husband cheating, he doesn’t just deny it… he erases her. Trapped on a private jet, branded an “impostor,” and watching her daughter suffer, she’s nearly broken—until a quiet cabin crewman steps in, risking everything to protect her. Now Nandini must choose: disappear like he wants… or bring him down with the one ally he never saw coming.

the-ceo-she-ignored-2.title: The CEO She Ignored
the-ceo-she-ignored-2.description: The microdrama begins with CEO Raghav's enigmatic proposal to Neha, a union that, over two decades, sees Raghav secretly orchestrating Neha's career and their son's future while concealing his true identity. Their marriage is fraught with tension, marked by Neha's demanding nature and hints of infidelity, culminating in Raghav's furious accusation and the exposure of years of resentment and financial disparity. Amidst this marital strain, Neha's corporate promotion is marred by public humiliation of Raghav by heiress Aisha, escalating into a violent confrontation involving influential corporate leader Vikram. Vikram further manipulates Raghav into a high-stakes card game, where Raghav is pressured to wager Neha, ultimately losing and publicly shaming her, exposing the irreversible impact of his choices. The drama intensifies with Raghav's explosive public revelation of Neha's affair with Vikram, shattering their two-decade marriage. Neha confesses her love for Vikram, demands a divorce, and, empowered by her son's intervention, expels Raghav from their home amidst accusations of domestic violence. Devastated by betrayal and the death of his mother, Raghav, now aware of Neha's incompetence and his own hidden influence, embarks on a meticulous quest for corporate and personal vengeance against Neha and Vikram. He secretly orchestrates Sneha's rise to CMO, while he himself is reduced to a servant, only to dramatically re-enter the corporate world as the new CEO of Kapoor Hotels, shocking his estranged wife, Pooja, and publicly exposing Vikram as secretly married with a child. As Neha grapples with Vikram's profound deception, Raghav mysteriously vanishes, prompting a dangerous search for truth amidst corporate intrigue. Raghav's true identity as a powerful CEO is dramatically revealed after an assault, fueling his relentless quest for revenge, leading him to terminate his estranged wife, Ananya, and his brother from corporate positions. His son, Aryan, publicly rejects him, preferring 'Vikram uncle,' while Neha confesses an affair with Vikram but insists her unborn child is Raghav's, leading to Raghav's arrest. Kriti and Acting CEO Chechi make dramatic sacrifices to protect Raghav and the family legacy. The conflict culminates in a deadly plot orchestrated by a vengeful antagonist, threatening Raghav's loved ones. Businessman Vikram, in a desperate gamble, loses his entire empire to Raghav, who then kidnaps Vikram's wife and child, fueled by a personal vendetta. However, the tables turn dramatically when Raghav's pregnant partner, Neha, reveals herself as the true mastermind behind his frame-up, exposing a shocking paternity fraud and an inheritance plot with Vikram. Raghav is ultimately killed by Neha on Vikram's command. The series concludes with Arin confronting her mother for her father's betrayal, leading to arrests and Arin's subsequent journey of redemption, cleaning public thoroughfares.

final-dhoka.title: Final Dhoka
final-dhoka.description: After losing her parents, Divya finds family, love, and belonging in Shalini’s home and her son Ishaan. But Ishaan’s growing trust in the manipulative Rohini turns Divya’s life into a nightmare of false accusations, humiliation, and abuse. Betrayed by the man she loves and forced to walk away with her dignity shattered, Divya rebuilds her life elsewhere. When the truth finally emerges, Ishaan is left with guilt, regret, and the irreversible cost of his blind faith.

the-ceo-she-ignored-1.title: The CEO She Ignored
the-ceo-she-ignored-1.description: A useless house-husband is humiliated, betrayed, and thrown out by his ambitious wife—only to reveal he’s the secret billionaire CEO she depended on all along. As love turns to vengeance, a high-stakes game of power, lies, and karma unfolds, exposing greed, infidelity, and the true cost of underestimating the man who sacrificed everything.

a-delivery-boys-jackpot-1.title: A delivery boy's jackpot
a-delivery-boys-jackpot-1.description: A carefree young man suddenly discovers he can predict people’s luck and misfortune with uncanny accuracy. As his gift turns into chaos, comedy, and danger, he must decide whether fortune is a blessing, a curse, or the key to his true destiny.

pyaar-ke-liye-bana-billionaire.title: Pyaar Ke Liye Bana Arabpati
pyaar-ke-liye-bana-billionaire.description: Amit, a self-respecting society guard, falls in love with Priya, a wealthy businessman’s daughter, after she stands up for his dignity. Their love is tested when Priya’s father humiliates Amit and challenges him to earn one crore on his own to prove his worth. Forced apart by manipulation and sacrifice, Amit begins a brutal journey through humiliation, ambition, and heartbreak, determined to rise against class barriers and reclaim both his love and his self-respect.

contract-love-4.title: Contract Love
contract-love-4.description: మమత అందమైన అమ్మాయి. తన చెల్లెలు రాధిక చేసిన మోసానికి ఆమె బలి అయ్యింది. ఆ సమయంలో కౌశల్ ఆమె జీవితంలోకి వచ్చాడు. ఒకరిది నిజమైన ప్రేమ, మరొకరిది డబ్బు మీద ఆశ. ఇలా రకరకాల మనస్తత్వాలు కలగలిసిన ప్రేమ కథ ఇది.

love-test-aur-dhokha.title: Love Test Aur Dhokha
love-test-aur-dhokha.description: A billionaire tests his blind wife’s love, until losing her becomes his greatest fear.

billionaire-by-pregnancy.title: Billionaire by Pregnancy
billionaire-by-pregnancy.description: "Pregnancy Ne Banaya Billionaire"  is a vibrant family drama that blends romance, comedy, and chaos as two very different families prepare for a grand wedding. With lovebirds caught between tradition, clashes of culture, and hilarious misunderstandings, the story shows how true love and togetherness can survive even the most over-the-top shaadi madness

meri-gold-digger-family.title: MERI GOLD DIGGER BIWI
meri-gold-digger-family.description: Aviraj a wealthy man discovers her wife betrayal with his own secretary. When he learns of their plot against his child and fortune, he vows to protect what's his and ensure justice prevails.

raw-agent-vs-delivery-boy-2.title: Raw Agent vs Delivery Boy
raw-agent-vs-delivery-boy-2.description: When delivery rider Kabir meets billionaire CEO Anika Singhania in a blind-date mix-up, her daughter Ishita fast-tracks him into a sham marriage to give her mother a partner she can trust. Kabir’s integrity wins hearts, but his mysterious past and enemies in Anika’s world ignite a war that forces him to reveal he’s actually ex-RAW agent Rudra .

death-countdown-2.title: Death Countdown
death-countdown-2.description:
What if you could see the exact moment someone will die?
Uday, an ordinary man, has a terrifying gift, he can see a death countdown of people. When he warns strangers about their fate, no one believes him… until a shocking plane crash proves him right.Now, caught between destiny and his desperate attempts to save her lover, Uday finds himself battling time, love, betrayal, and a deadly conspiracy. The clock is ticking. Will he save them… or lose everything? Watch now!

born-to-smash.title: Born to Smash
born-to-smash.description: The show follows a sports-drama rise built around underdogs, rival coaches, and clubs fighting for survival. It begins with a shocking upset in a betting match, where an underestimated player defeats an arrogant champion and exposes the legendary status of the coach behind him. That revelation destabilizes the coach’s anonymity and sets off a wider scramble for leadership and credibility. At Sky Sports Club, Paras is passed over for promotion when Lakhan is appointed head coach, and the new appointment immediately creates tension because Lakhan claims he is hiding from Sameer while carrying a letter signed by Sameer Khanna. Paras responds by making an audacious claim that he can turn Raju, a low-status equipment retriever, into someone who can beat club players in just three days. Raju is mocked for his physical limits and his job, but he is pushed into punishing training with unusually heavy bats and forced to prove that determination can outweigh status. The club’s survival becomes urgent when a selector warns that two trainees must be selected or the club will lose funding. Across the tryouts and club challenges, the pressure keeps rising through elimination rounds, champion-level opponents, and tests that expose every weakness. Raju’s arc becomes the emotional center of this struggle as he is taunted, falls behind, and still refuses to quit. Support from his coach and concern from allies help him keep going when injury seems likely. In one major turning point, he gets a new bat and uses it to reverse momentum against a brutal opponent. That victory saves the club’s future, but it also turns the rivalry personal when the defeated opponent vows revenge. Elsewhere, Arjun’s coaching and leadership become increasingly important as he guides players like Mohit and Rajjo through difficult matches and reminds them that steady practice matters. The competition world expands into higher-stakes trials against national champions, hidden identities, and public challenges from rival coaches who try to discredit Arjun. Arjun is accused of cheating and theft, yet official support helps protect his reputation and even places him in partnership with the Federation President. The western zone storyline then pushes Arjun into a larger role after he wins qualification and is appointed coach for the entire zone.
