That success draws fresh hostility from Pooja Nayar, whose challenge to the western zone is tied to a personal grudge and a brother’s earlier defeat. The tournament atmosphere grows darker with sabotage, toxic attacks, and attempts to block medical help, showing that the competition is no longer just about skill. A separate mystery thread deepens around a masked figure, Mr. Mathur, and the long shadow of a decade-old defeat tied to Naina’s death and a broken promise. In the final stretch, the hidden identity is exposed as Arjun Mathur, secretly Sher Singh Mathur, and the past blame surrounding the lost championship comes fully to the surface. Sher Singh accepts the challenge, wins the decisive match, and dedicates the national championship to Naina. By the end, the show frames victory as both a public triumph and a personal reckoning, with hidden masters, wounded rivals, and underdogs all forced into the open.

autowala-billionaire-4.title: Autowala Billionaire
autowala-billionaire-4.description: A billionaire couple goes undercover as poor to test their son’s character, only to watch him lose his values, fall for a toxic heiress, betray them  and eventually face a shocking truth that shatters every relationship. Watch now.

love-gamble.title: Love Gamble
love-gamble.description: Love Gamble is a drama mini-series that follows the unlikely connection between a wealthy nightclub owner and a struggling young woman. The story begins when Litika, a homeless woman, rescues an expensive watch belonging to Nishant Singhaniya, a powerful club owner. Grateful and intrigued, Nishant brings Litika into his world, offering her a job and a place to stay.

autowala-billionaire-3.title: Autowala Billionaire
autowala-billionaire-3.description: A billionaire couple goes undercover as poor to test their son’s character, only to watch him lose his values, fall for a toxic heiress, betray them — and eventually face a shocking truth that shatters every relationship. Watch now!

miss-marriage-mayhem.title: Miss, Marriage & Mayhem
miss-marriage-mayhem.description: “A kind-hearted girl on her way to her brother’s wedding gets trapped in a nightmarish flight with a cruel woman and her spoiled son, leading to chaos that unravels shocking secrets of power, betrayal, and mistaken identity. When love, lies, and family honor collide, a storm of revenge and revelation erupts midair and beyond.”

final-boss-season-2.title: Final Boss Season 2
final-boss-season-2.description: One week after returning from the Navy, Abhiraj’s secret marriage to business tycoon Anamika explodes into scandal at an award ceremony. Princess Devyani claims Abhiraj was promised to her, igniting a royal conflict. As Anamika enters Virajgarh Palace, she faces humiliation and conspiracy from Abhiraj’s uncle and cousin, who seek the throne. With the Maharaja critically ill and a council decision looming, love, power, and betrayal collide in a fierce battle for the crown.

raw-agent-vs-delivery-boy-1.title: Raw Agent vs Delivery Boy
raw-agent-vs-delivery-boy-1.description: When delivery rider Kabir meets billionaire CEO Anika Singhania in a blind-date mix-up, her daughter Ishita fast-tracks him into a sham marriage to give her mother a partner she can trust. Kabir’s integrity wins hearts, but his mysterious past and enemies in Anika’s world ignite a war that forces him to reveal he’s actually ex-RAW agent Rudra .

divine-husband.title: Divine Husband
divine-husband.description: Once a legendary sage seeking immortality, Anirudh is forced to reincarnate as Rahul, a poor gambler trapped in debt and humiliation. In the human world, he discovers he has a mute wife, Kajal. As his dormant powers awaken, Rahul chooses a new path: to protect her, heal her, and redeem a broken life, even if it costs him his godhood.

coolies-diamond-bride-2.title: Coolie's Diamond Bride
coolies-diamond-bride-2.description: A chance meeting at a railway station brings together Aryan, a humble porter, and Aarohi, the daughter of a powerful diamond tycoon. When Aarohi chooses love over wealth and society, Aryan is humiliated, tested, and pushed to his limits. As secrets unravel, the world discovers that true worth is not defined by status or money but by courage, integrity, and love. This is a romantic drama where a “coolie” becomes a king, and love proves to be the rarest diamond of all.

drunken-fighter.title: Drunken Fighter
drunken-fighter.description: Drunken Fighter is a martial arts action-drama about hidden power, redemption, and destiny. Bhuvan a ridiculed drunkard handyman at a legendary Kung Fu academy, secretly possesses the strength of the mythical “Iron Head.” As enemies challenge the academy and imposters claim his glory, Bhuvan must decide whether to keep hiding in the shadows—or rise as the true legend who can save them all.

real-king-kaun.title: Real King Kaun?
real-king-kaun.description: Raj, the iconic but anonymous DJ King, decides to find a wife who loves him for himself not his fame. He meets Simran, a struggling music label CEO. After a whirlwind contract marriage to save her from the sleazy Karan Oberoi, Raj must endure the relentless humiliation and "poor" treatment from her elitist family. He uses his massive wealth and influence to protect Simran’s business, the ultimate reveal looms: the "lowly" DJ they despise is actually the superstar they are desperate to sign.

contract-love-3.title: Contract Love
contract-love-3.description: Mohini's world collapses when her fiancé, Rohan, betrays her by proposing to her step-sister, Nimmi, threatening her family's legacy. To reclaim her company and thwart Rohan's manipulative plot to seize control through marriage, Mohini impulsively hires Kiran, a mysterious waiter, to pose as her partner. Unbeknownst to Mohini, Kiran is a wealthy CEO facing his own family ultimatum to find true love, leading to a strategic contract marriage fraught with deception. Their fake relationship quickly escalates amidst corporate intrigue and family conflicts, as Kiran, disguised as a humble assistant, secretly supports Mohini's corporate ambitions while grappling with his hidden identity. The burgeoning romance between Mohini and Kiran is constantly threatened by his manipulative father's agenda to force a corporate marriage, and by vengeful rivals like Nimmi and Rohini, Kiran's past fiancée, who seek to expose his true identity. Rohan, too, continues his manipulative schemes, at times using aliases and attempting to win Mohini's heart while secretly searching for a lost family heirloom. Mohini's suspicions about Kiran's true wealth grow, leading to dramatic confrontations and accusations of deceit. A lavish party orchestrated by rivals ultimately exposes Kiran's elaborate sham, revealing his double life and a "stupid bet" about his wealth, shattering Mohini's trust and leading to the termination of their relationship. Heartbroken by the betrayal, Mohini initially rejects Kiran's pleas of innocence, even as his father's dying wish urges him to marry for true love. Kiran, a wealthy heir, is prepared to sacrifice his entire empire to prove his authentic affection. He confesses a prenup intended to transfer his vast fortune to Mohini, and it is revealed he was drugged by Rohini. Kiran ultimately risks his inheritance, exposes Rohan's manipulative intentions to exploit Mohini, and sheds his fortune to demonstrate his genuine love. Their journey culminates in a heartfelt wedding, where Kiran's father gifts them a hotel, empowering them to forge a powerful corporate partnership as CEO and CFO, finally uniting in love and business.

dhurandhar-arjun.title: Dhurandhar Arjun
dhurandhar-arjun.description: The microdrama begins with the legendary archer Arjun making an impossible shot to save the Chandravansh kingdom, but his triumph is quickly overshadowed by the brutal slaying of his wise mentor, leaving Arjun with a sacred mission to protect his mentor's unsupported daughter, Vrushali. Arjun, despite achieving military glory, abandons the kingdom and disguises himself as a humble servant named Utsav, secretly watching over Vrushali and her daughter Kiri, who now face escalating abuse from Vrushali's tyrannical husband, Atharv. Arjun defiantly challenges Atharv in an archery contest to defend Vrushali's honor, revealing glimpses of his formidable warrior past and stunning all with his unparalleled skill. This leads to his controversial elevation to teacher by Vrushali, sparking fierce opposition from her noble brother Shantanu, as the ancient Gurukul Vatika faces an existential threat from an estranged uncle, Rajnish, who demands an ancient debt and threatens to convert the sacred institution. A high-stakes warrior competition is proposed to decide the Gurukul's fate, pitting Rajnish's formidable fighters against the Gurukul's champions, where Arjun's extraordinary skill humiliates opponents like Ivan. However, a new, deadlier challenge emerges from Chacha Shree and the terrifying Darshika, forcing Arjun to undergo an arduous spiritual journey to master mystical arts. Arjun's true identity as a legendary disciple is dramatically unveiled during an ambush, but this revelation immediately leads to a grave accusation from Rushali, who blames him for her father's murder. Despite his denials, Rushali banishes Arjun to protect her young daughter, fearing his perceived destructive influence. His poignant departure is violently interrupted by a devastating assault from Pindari mercenaries led by Kartikeya, who kidnaps Kiri and reveals he murdered Arjun's guru. Arjun, now driven by a vow of fierce vengeance, fakes his own death after an assassination attempt by the treacherous Mayadevi, meticulously planning his comeback to confront his enemies and reclaim justice for his family and the Gurukul.

bride-on-the-run-2.title: Bride on the Run
bride-on-the-run-2.description: She is the daughter of a wealthy man, whose life shatters after a shocking encounter with a family driven by greed. Lost, hunted, and unaware of her hidden power, she struggles to survive in a world full of lies.

finding-us-again-5.title: Finding Us Again
finding-us-again-5.description: Nearing fifty, Kuberan sets out in search of true love and marries Sana, a simple and sincere woman. But does their marriage survive the trials they face? Watch "Finding Us Again" on Kuku TV.

romance-of-revenge.title: Romance of Revenge
romance-of-revenge.description: Preeti's seven-year marriage to Raghav shatters upon discovering his affair with her closest confidante, Reema. To expose his betrayal, Preeti feigns amnesia, a deception that quickly spirals out of control when powerful CEO Tarun Batra claims to be her true husband. Unbeknownst to Raghav, who attempts to pawn Preeti off on Tarun, Preeti overhears his sinister plan, transforming her into a determined protagonist seeking revenge. As Tarun genuinely falls for Preeti, complicating her elaborate scheme, Preeti prepares for a public confrontation. The narrative reveals Preeti's amnesia to be a calculated charade, transforming her into a master manipulator orchestrating a high-stakes game against Raghav and Reema. She finds herself caught in a complex quadrangle of infidelity, at times developing feelings for Tarun, who becomes a supportive figure. Preeti orchestrates a plot, flaunting her relationship with Tarun and blindsiding Raghav with divorce papers, leading to violent confrontations between Raghav and Tarun, both fiercely claiming to be Preeti's husband. The stakes escalate as Preeti, at one point suffering from partial memory loss, believes she is happily married to Tarun, only for Raghav to dramatically reappear, claiming to be her true husband and exposing Tarun's evasiveness. In a shocking turn, Preeti murders Reema after Reema confesses her affair and jealousy. Reema's posthumous revelation of Preeti's faked amnesia shatters Raghav's world, leading him to become Preeti's obsessive captor, attempting to force her memories back with extreme measures while Tarun frantically searches for her. Later, Preeti (also identified as Dipti) executes a masterful revenge plan against her manipulative husband, Akash, exposing his deceit. She reveals her genuine love for Raghav, the man Akash intended to use as a pawn, who confesses his long-held affection and proposes marriage. However, their wedding is dramatically interrupted by Akash, who makes desperate pleas, threatens self-harm, and asserts possessive ownership over Preeti, leaving her future uncertain.

london-wale-dulhaniya-le-jayenge.title: London Wale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge
london-wale-dulhaniya-le-jayenge.description:
London Wale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge is a romantic comedy about Arjun Malhotra,a billionaire’s carefree son who fails his exams in London. Instead of giving him the family empire, his father sends him to India to live like a common man and earn success from scratch.

Working at a Delhi garage, Arjun falls for Simran, the owner’s daughter. But her arrogant boyfriend Rohit has plans to grab her family’s property. Arjun must win love and prove his worth not as a rich heir, but as a real man. WATCH NOW

varasdara-a-forgotten-son.title: Varasdara – A Forgotten Son
varasdara-a-forgotten-son.description: Varasdara – A Forgotten Son is a powerful saga where destiny makes a cruel mistake. A mother’s jealousy swaps two newborns, turning a rightful heir into a forgotten son. Raised in poverty and pain, Adi grows up rich in values, while the true prince loses his way in privilege. When fate brings Adi back to the empire meant for him, buried secrets explode—proving that true royalty is not born in blood, but earned through love, sacrifice, and character.

sarphira-saiyaara.title: Sarphira Saiyara
sarphira-saiyaara.description: The microdrama begins with Jay Kapoor's heartbreak after Lavi rejects him due to his lack of wealth, fueling his transformation into a cynical billionaire driven by revenge. Years later, Jay orchestrates a humiliating scheme, offering Lavi's mother financial aid with a cruel condition for Lavi, who is now a confident model facing her own financial struggles and confrontations with scorned ex-lovers. Despite his animosity, Jay's obsessive devotion to Lavi persists, leading him to fiercely protect her from rivals like Balbir Rathore, even as his mother attempts to secure his engagement to Kavya. The narrative takes a dramatic turn when Jay discovers Lavi has a daughter, Riya, believing her to be his own, which culminates in a heartfelt proposal and a paternity dispute. However, DNA results shatter Jay's world, revealing his cousin Lalit as Riya's biological father, a devastating betrayal exposed by Kavya that transforms Jay's love into intense hatred. The truth slowly unravels, revealing Lavi's traumatic past, including Riya's conception from a non-consensual act by Lalit. Jay's manipulative mother, Anita, further complicates matters by forcing Lavi to sever ties with Jay and sacrifice their love to protect him, making Lavi appear as a gold-digger. Misunderstanding Lavi's profound sacrifice, Jay casts her out, consumed by anger. The climax arrives when the truth about Lavi's assault and Anita's manipulation dramatically halts Jay's wedding, propelling him to rescue Lavi and Riya from Lalit's vengeful clutches. In the aftermath, Jay, now a lawyer, becomes an unwavering ally and burgeoning romantic interest for Ravi (Lavi), as she embarks on a quest for justice against Lalit for sexual assault and Tanya for bullying and kidnapping, hinting at a future built on shared struggles and a blossoming romance.

coolies-diamond-bride-1.title: Coolie's Diamond Bride
coolies-diamond-bride-1.description: Under mysterious circumstances, wealthy heiress Aarohi forces humble laborer Aryan into an instant marriage at gunpoint, seeking to escape a powerful 'boss' or an arranged union. Despite their stark class disparities and unconventional beginning, a genuine and passionate love blossoms between them. Their forbidden relationship immediately ignites intense conflict with Aarohi's ruthless diamond tycoon father and her powerful, possessive suitor, Dhanush, who violently oppose the union and attempt to abduct her. Aarohi defiantly defends her love, revealing her secret marriage and challenging societal expectations, even as her family faces financial ruin and pressures her into an arranged marriage for business salvation. Meanwhile, Aryan, initially accused of fraud and publicly humiliated as a 'gold-digger,' secretly holds a high-ranking position as the Managing Director of Blue Diamond, living a double life. His true identity is gradually revealed, disrupting established social structures and escalating the corporate and family drama. When Aarohi's beloved grandfather suffers a critical medical emergency, Aryan bravely vows to save him, further proving his genuine intentions and power. He orchestrates a calculated corporate takedown of Dhanush, asserting his authority as Chairman of Blue Diamond and revealing his meteoric rise from poverty. Aarohi, in turn, emerges as a successful startup MD, securing significant investment. The series culminates in Aryan confronting his father, Mr. Roy, for control of the family empire and the legendary White Lotus Diamond, driven by a vision for ethical industry against his father's illicit ambitions. Aarohi fiercely defends Aryan's integrity, leading to an emotional father-son reconciliation, after which Aryan introduces Aarohi as his 'daughter-in-law.' However, the narrative takes an unexpected turn when Aarohi receives and accepts an unconventional marriage proposal from a 'coolie,' introducing a new romantic dynamic fraught with social disparity.

loser-son-in-law-is-a-billionaire-2.title: Loser Son-in-Law is a Billionaire
loser-son-in-law-is-a-billionaire-2.description: A humiliated son-in-law, living as a delivery boy, shocks everyone when his hidden identity as a billionaire heir is revealed. Betrayals, power struggles, and family wars ignite as he rises to claim his destiny.

ziddi-aashiq-1.title: Ziddi Aashiq
ziddi-aashiq-1.description: "Ziddi Aashiq" follows Ashray, a poor street cricketer, and Anjali, a wealthy mute girl, whose romance is destroyed when her arrogant father and a cruel suitor, Balwant, force her into an abusive marriage. After a dark spiral into alcoholism, Ashray claws his way onto the Indian national cricket team. He ultimately confronts Balwant to rescue Anjali, wins a high-stakes international match, and reunites with her to build a new life.

coolies-diamond-bride.title: Coolie’s Diamond Bride
coolies-diamond-bride.description: A chance meeting at a railway station brings together Aryan, a humble porter, and Aarohi, the daughter of a powerful diamond tycoon. When Aarohi chooses love over wealth and society, Aryan is humiliated, tested, and pushed to his limits. As secrets unravel, the world discovers that true worth is not defined by status or money but by courage, integrity, and love. This is a romantic drama where a “coolie” becomes a king, and love proves to be the rarest diamond of all.

ready-daddy-go.title: Ready Daddy Go!
ready-daddy-go.description: One night, a strict corporate father and his rebellious teenage son mysteriously swap souls — forcing the dad to survive high school drama and the son to run a high-pressure office — only to discover that walking in each other’s shoes might be the only way to fix their broken bond.

the-hidden-king-3.title: The Hidden King
the-hidden-king-3.description: A gripping thriller about RA&W officer Sher Pathan, who deliberately lands himself inside one of the country’s most dangerous prisons. Haunted by the mysterious death of his sister, he enters a brutal world ruled by corrupt warden Rathod, feared inmate Shera, and hidden alliances. Aarav inches closer to a dark truth. But behind bars, every ally is a risk, and every secret could kill. In this prison, justice isn't blind… it's buried.

maharani.title: Maharani - The Substitute Bride
maharani.description:
A woman is pushed into a political marriage she never wanted.
Love slowly grows in a world of power and betrayal.
But when politics turns personal, she must choose her own path. Watch now!

return-of-the-superstar.title: Return Of The Superstar
return-of-the-superstar.description: After ten years behind bars for a murder he didn't commit, rising star Sameer emerged to find his world shattered. His childhood love, Sonia, had climbed the ranks to superstardom, leaving him in the shadows of his past. To reclaim his life, Sameer struck a deal with the powerful CEO Asmita. Amidst dangerous conspiracies and industry sabotage, he fought to expose the truth. In a world of fake glamour, his journey became a brutal quest for justice.

my-gay-husband.title: My Gay Husband
my-gay-husband.description: లవ్ చేసిన అతనే తన జీవితంలోకి భర్తగా వచ్చాడు అనుకున్న అమ్మాయికి అతను గే అని తెలిస్తే తన పరిస్థితి ఏంటి? తన కథ ఎటువంటి మలుపు తిరుగుతుంది? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

the-code-of-the-extraordinary-mind-7.title: The Code Of The Extraordinary Mind
the-code-of-the-extraordinary-mind-7.description: "ದಿ ಕೋಡ್ ಆಫ್ ದ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಟ್ರಾರ್ಡಿನರಿ ಮೈಂಡ್"  ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಜೀವನದ ರೂಢಿಚಾಲಿತ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸುವ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗತ  ಜೀವನದ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಕೋಡ್ ರಚಿಸುವ ಮಾರ್ಗವನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಶನ್ ಲಖಿಯಾನಿ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತುಂಗ ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಬಹುದಾದ 10 ಆಧುನಿಕ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅವು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ, ನಂಬಿಕೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮರು ಆವಿಷ್ಕಾರಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಜ್ಞಾವಂತ ಜೀವನದ, ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಂತೃಪ್ತಿಯತ್ತ ಒಯ್ಯುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕವಾಗಿದೆ.

kaal-dweep.title: Kaal Dweep
kaal-dweep.description:
2067 mein Indian spacecraft Karmabhoomi ek mysterious sanskrit signal ka peecha karte hue Kaal Dweep par land karta hai, ek aisa planet jahan har khamoshi ke peeche ek purani maut chhupi hogi. Captain Vikram aur uski team ek ancient alien parasite ka saamna karte hue apne ship aur dimaag dono ko bachaane ki koshish karte hain.
Arjun, jo ek insaan tha, ek monstrous entity mein badal jaata hai aur poora crew usse rokne ke liye apne kadam uthata hai. Ek galat move aur pura mission poori manavta ke liye sabse bada khatra ban sakta hai. Kya puri team Earth tak laut paayegi ya Arjun ban jaega sabka ant ?

3a2d61f0-54df-4785-aec3-0ffbd6e68998.title: Agilam Vendra Attila
3a2d61f0-54df-4785-aec3-0ffbd6e68998.description: அசைத்துக் கொள்ள முடியாதது என்று இறுமாந்திருந்த உரோமானியப் பேரரசை வீழ்த்திய மாவீரன் அட்டிலா. பரம்பரை, பாரம்பரியம், செல்வாக்கு, வசதி, வாய்ப்புகள் என்று உறுதிமிக்க அடித்தளம் கொண்ட ஆட்சியாளர்களை இந்த நாடோடி வென்று காட்டினான்.

whispering-doll.title: Whispering Doll
whispering-doll.description: Apni beti aur patni ko ek aag mein khona Raghuveer Sharma ke jeevan ka sabse bada dard tha. Us dard se bachne ke liye usne Dilli ke ek purane workshop mein gudiyaayein banana shuru kiya, par woh sirf khilone nahi thi, unmein kuch chhupa tha. Jab ek patrakaar Ananya in gudiyaon se judi maut ki kadi ko samajhne aayi, toh saamne aaya ek purana shraap jo ab tak zinda tha. Kya Raghuveer apna sab kuch khona sweekar karega ya phir un gudiyaon ke saath woh bhi hamesha ke liye bandh jaayega?

2a16d3a4-f500-40f3-b46e-6aee89598af3.title: Sadham Hussain Vazhvum Iraqin Maranamum
2a16d3a4-f500-40f3-b46e-6aee89598af3.description: இராக்கின் முன்னாள் அதிபர் சதாம் ஹுசைனின் இந்த வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு, ஒரு வகையில் நவீன இராக்கின் அரசியல் வரலாறும் ஆகும். 24 ஆண்டுகள் அந்தத் தேசத்தின் தலைவிதியைத் தீர்மானித்தவர் அவர். சதாம் என்கிற ஆளுமையின் முழுப் பரிமாணத்தையும் அறிமுகம் செய்து வைக்கிறது இந்நூல்.

virat-the-warrior.title: Virat The Warrior
virat-the-warrior.description: తన చిన్ననాటనే తల్లిదండ్రులను కోల్పోయిన విరాట్, తన గార్డియన్ సంరక్షణలో పెరుగుతాడు. అయితే, తన అడ్డు తగులుతున్న సవాళ్లలో ఒకటి అతని సవతి అన్నతో సంబంధం. జీవితంలో ఎన్నో కష్టాలను ఎదుర్కొని, తన కృషితో వ్యాపార సామ్రాజ్యాన్ని స్వంతం చేసుకుంటాడు. తన వ్యక్తిగత అనుభవాల వల్ల, అతను వివాహం అనే ఆలోచనను పూర్తిగా వదిలేయాల్సి వస్తుంది. కానీ, ఆ సమయంలో అతని జీవితంలోకి ఒక అమ్మాయి ప్రవేశిస్తుంది. ఆమె వల్ల అతని జీవితం పూర్తిగా మారిపోతుంది. ఆ మార్పు అతని వ్యాపార రంగంలో సవాళ్లను మరింతగా పెంచుతుంది.

hero-ki-secret-recipe.title: Hero Ki Secret Recipe
hero-ki-secret-recipe.description: Intern prep cook Ranveer ko uske hotel wale gareeb aur phatichar kehkar mazak udaate hain. Par ek din, jab hotel ka malik ek bade cooking competition mein apna hotel hi haarne wala hota hai, Ranveer ek aisi dish banata hai jise dekhkar sabhi shocked reh jaate hain. Kyuki Ranveer ki cooking skills kisi aam cook jaise nahi, balki bilkul uski tarah hai jo do saal pehle ek accident ke baad gayab ho gaya tha — India ka sabse bada masterchef, Vikas Barar. Jaise hi ye baat Vikas ke purane dushmanon tak pahuchti hai, Ranveer par ek ke baad ek attack hone lagte hain. Par kya Ranveer hi hai Vikas Barar? Agar haan, to kyun chhupkar ek mamuli prep cook ki zindagi jee raha hai ek masterchef? Kaise niptega wo apne dushmano se, jinhone uska sab kuch chheen liya tha?

kamadeva.title: KAMADEVA
kamadeva.description:
ఈ విశ్వాన్ని సృష్టించిన బ్రహ్మదేవుడు సృష్టిలో అనేక తప్పులు చేసి, వాటికి సంబంధించిన శాపాలను అనుభవించాల్సి వచ్చింది. అయినప్పటికీ, సృష్టికర్తగా తన కర్తవ్యాన్ని నిష్టతో నిర్వర్తించాడు. ఆయన ధ్యానంలో లీనమై ఉన్నప్పుడూ, తన కర్తవ్యాలను తన కుమారులైన దేవతలకు విభజించాడు. 

ఆ దేవతలలో, మనసుకు ప్రియమైన కామదేవుడు ప్రత్యేక స్థానం సంపాదించాడు. కామదేవుడు ప్రపంచానికి ప్రేమ, ఆకర్షణ, ఆనందాన్ని అందిస్తూ జీవనానందానికి రూపమైన శక్తిగా తన పాత్రను సుస్థిరం చేశాడు. కామదేవుడు తన శక్తితో జగత్తులో ప్రేమా భావనలను, మానసిక భావోద్వేగాలను చాటి చెప్పాడు. 

బ్రహ్మదేవుడు మరియు ఆయన సంతానమైన దేవతలు కలిసి ఈ సృష్టిని సంరక్షిస్తూ తమ కర్తవ్యాలను సమర్థంగా నిర్వర్తించారు.

quran-helodenu.title: Quran Helodenu?
quran-helodenu.description: ಕುರಾನ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಕುರ್'ಆನ್‌ನ ಪಠಣವನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಧ್ವನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಲು ಅವಕಾಶವನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಶ್ರವಣದ ಮೂಲಕ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಗ್ರಂಥದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಗ್ರಹಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಯಾವುದೇ ವಯಸ್ಸಿನವರಿಗೂ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಸಮರ್ಥವಾದ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ದೈವಿಕ ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಲು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಗಿದೆ.

campfire-diaries-season-2.title: Campfire Diaries Season 2
campfire-diaries-season-2.description: Do saal pehle Bhilpur mein Karan aur uske doston ne ek purani taaqat ko jagaa diya tha aur phir woh sab gayab ho gaye. Ab Arjun apne bhai Karan ke sach ka pata lagane wapas aaya hai, saath hai ek daring team aur ek YouTube channel ke liye haunted investigation ka plan. Par jaise jaise wo Bhilpur ke shraapit raaz ke kareeb jaate hain, vaise vaise purani atmaayein, purane paap, aur Shadow Walker jaise bhayanak sach unka peecha karne lagte hain. Kya iss baar bhi koi nahi lautega ya phir Bhilpur ek aur kahani nigal jaayega?

the-power-of-habit-10.title: The Power Of Habit
the-power-of-habit-10.description: "ದಿ ಪವರ್ ಆಫ್ ಹ್ಯಾಬಿಟ್"  ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಜೀವನದ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅರಿಯಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳ ಹುಟ್ಟುಹಾಕುವ ಸೈಕಾಲಜಿಯನ್ನು, ಅವು ನಮ್ಮ ನಿತ್ಯ ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೀರುವ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಸಂಶೋಧನೆ, ಹೃದಯಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿ ಕತೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನೈಜ ಜೀವನದ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲು ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕ ಮತ್ತು ಶಕ್ತಿಯುತವಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗಸೂಚಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.

do-the-work-1.title: Do The Work
do-the-work-1.description: ಸ್ಟೀವನ್ ಪ್ರೆಸ್‌ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ಅವರ "ಡೂ ದ ವರ್ಕ್"  ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ತೊಡಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಲು ಸ್ಪೂರ್ತಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ಟೀವನ್ ಪ್ರೆಸ್‌ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ಅವರ ಪಾಠಗಳು ಸರಳವಾಗಿ, ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕವಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮುಂದು ವರಿಸುವ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಯನ್ನು ಆಜ್ಞಾಪಿಸುವ, ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧವನ್ನು ತೊಡೆಯುವ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯಕವಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗಸೂಚಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ಸಾಹದ ಧ್ವನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಈ ಕೃತಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ ನೀಡುವಂತಹ ಅನುಭವವಾಗಿದೆ.

roohani-ishq-season-2.title: Roohani Ishq Season 2
roohani-ishq-season-2.description: Jab bindaas Anika ek ziddi, handsome businessman ki aatma se takrati hai, toh wo use zindagi aur pyaar ka naya matlab sikhane lagta hai. Kya yeh supernatural romance kisi happy ending ki taraf badega, ya phir Anika ko is khatarnak magar rahasyamayi mohabbat ki keemat chukani padegi?

how-to-be-alone.title: How To Be Alone
how-to-be-alone.description: "ಹೌ ಟು ಬಿ ಅಲೋನ್" ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು  ಏಕಾಂತವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಮತ್ತು ಅದರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂತೋಷವಾಗಿರುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯಲು ದಾರಿ ತೋರುತ್ತದೆ. ಮನೋವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ, ಹಾಸ್ಯಮಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮನಸಿಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಒಂಟಿತನವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು, ಗೆಳೆಯರ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿರುವ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ಸವಿಯಬೇಕೆಂಬುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

one-day-billionaire-season-2.title: One Day Billionaire Season 2
one-day-billionaire-season-2.description: College ki fees mushkil se bhar paane wala Sameer bread khakar guzara karta hai, par ek din jab uske hath ek sikka hath lagta hai to uski duniya badal jaati hai. Agle 24 ghante mein use pata chalta hai ki wo ek billionaire hai aur usko apni saari daulat ek mysterious system ke according spend karni hai. Yahin nahi uska samna hota hai behad powerful dushmano se. Kya Sameer bacha payega apni daulat aur power aur ban payega One Day Billionaire?

ഒടിയനും-കുട്ടിച്ചാത്തനും.title: ഒടിയനും കുട്ടിച്ചാത്തനും
ഒടിയനും-കുട്ടിച്ചാത്തനും.description: മാനായും നരിയായും രൂപം മാറി വന്ന് രാത്രികളിൽ പേടിപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന ഒടിയന്മാർ വടക്കൻ കേരളത്തിനു  സുപരിചിതം. ഭയത്തോടെയും  ആരാധനയോടെയും ഒടിയന്മാരുടെ കഥകൾ മലയാളികൾ  തലമുറകൾക്ക് പകർന്ന് നൽകി. എന്നാൽ അല്പം കൂടി തെക്ക് മാറി  തെക്കെ മലാബാർ- കൊച്ചി പ്രദേശങ്ങളിൽ നിറഞ്ഞാടിയ കുട്ടിച്ചാത്തന്മാർക്കാകട്ടെ ഭയത്തിൻ്റെയും മാന്ത്രികതയുടെയും പരിവേഷത്തിനൊപ്പം ഭക്തിയുടെ പിൻബലവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. അതു കൊണ്ട് തന്നെ ഒരു ജനത അവരെ ആരാധിച്ചു, ആ മൂർത്തികളുടെ പ്രീതിക്കായി ഇന്നും അവർ നേദ്യങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്നു. കേരളത്തിൽ പ്രചുരപ്രചാരം നേടിയ ഈ രണ്ട് അതീന്ദ്രിയ കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളുടെ രസകരങ്ങളായ കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം.

ennenno-janmala-bandham.title: Ennenno Janmala Bandham
ennenno-janmala-bandham.description:
కర్మ, శాపం, త్యాగం, ప్రేమ, ద్వేషం... ఈ అయిదు జీవన సత్యాల చుట్టూ నడిచే కథే  "ఎన్నెన్నో జన్మల బంధం"
యుక్త దేవి జీవితం అనిశ్చితి, ఆరాధన, క్షమ, ధైర్యం అనే నాలుగు గుండ్రం దారాల మధ్య నడిచే ఒక ప్రయాణం.  
స్వర్ణనాభ ఆలయం, విష్ణు నాభ స్వామి రహస్యాలు, తాళపత్ర గ్రంథాలు... ఇవన్నీ కలసి ఒక చీకటి శక్తికి ఎదురీదే దీప్తి కావాలి.  
ఈ కథలో ప్రేమ ఒక ద్రవ్యం, ద్వేషం ఒక ఆయుధం, త్యాగం ఒక ధర్మం. ఈ ప్రయాణంలో మిమ్మల్ని మీరు కనుగొనగలరా?  
ప్రశ్నలకు సమాధానం అన్వేషిస్తూ వినండి... "ఎన్నెన్నో జన్మల బంధం".

teen-samandar-paar.title: Teen Samandar Paar
teen-samandar-paar.description:
Ek cruise par mili Sylvia ke chehre ke peeche chhupa tha ek pura itihaas—teen samundar paar se aayi ek girmitiya kahani. Uske dada Mahabeer ne apne gaon se nikal kar Trinidad tak ki mazdoori ka dard saha, aur chauthi peedhi mein unka vanshaj usi desh ka pradhanmantri bana. Yeh kahani hai jaddo-jehad, virasat aur us mitti ki, jise chhod diya gaya lekin kabhi bhulaya nahi gaya.
"Teen Samundar Paar" – ek safar jo cruise se shuru hota hai, aur dil ke sabse gehre kone tak jaata hai.

ചുവപ്പിൽ-ഒരു-പഠനം.title: ചുവപ്പിൽ ഒരു പഠനം
ചുവപ്പിൽ-ഒരു-പഠനം.description: ഷെർലോക്ക് ഹോംസിൻ്റെ സൃഷ്ടാവ് ആർതർ കോനൻ ഡോയലിൻ്റെ വ്യത്യസ്തവും അത്യന്തം  ഉദ്ദ്വേഗഭരിതവുമായ  നോവൽ. 1887 ൽ  രചിക്കപ്പെട്ട ഈ നോവലിലാണു ഷെർലോക്ക് ഹോംസ്, ഡോക്ടർ വാട്സ്ൺ എന്നീ ലോകപ്രസിദ്ധ കുറ്റാന്വേഷകർ അവതരിപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്നത്. കേട്ടു തുടങ്ങിയാൽ നിറുത്താനാവാത്ത വിധം രസകരമായ ആഖ്യാന മികവാണു നൂറ്റാണ്ടുകൾക്കിപ്പറവും ഈ നോവലിനെ  നിലനിറുത്തുന്നത്. കേൾക്കാം.. കുറ്റാന്വേഷണ സാഹിത്യത്തിലെ ക്ലാസിക്ക് രചന- ചുവപ്പിൽ ഒരു പഠനം.

draupadi-mattu-krishna.title: Draupadi Mattu Krishna
draupadi-mattu-krishna.description: ಮಹಾಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ನಡುವಿನ ಸ್ನೇಹ ಸಂಬಂಧ ಉತ್ಕೃಷ್ಟವಾದದ್ದು. ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಸ್ನೇಹದ ಫಲವಾಗಿ ದ್ರೌಪದಿಗೆ ಅತ್ಯಮೂಲ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಒದಗಿದೆ. ದೇವಮಾನವನ ಜೊತೆಗಿನ ಒಂದು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛಂದ ಸ್ನೇಹದ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸಿರೀಸ್ "ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕೃಷ್ಣ" ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

saazish-e-ishq.title: Saazish-E-Ishq
saazish-e-ishq.description: Yeh kahani hai Paavni ki — ek strong, self-independent ladki, jo apne parivaar ke liye kuch bhi kar sakti hai. Par ek din uski mulaqat hoti hai apne sakt boss Garvit se, aur waha se shuru hoti hai inki love story. Lekin, sab kuch tab toot jaata hai, jab Paavni ki behan ke saath hota hai rape aur ilzaam lagta hai Garvit ke bhai Mihir par. Yeh kahani hai pyaar aur dhokhe ki, jisne badal ke rakhde Paavni ki puri zindagi. Ek taraf hai uska pyaar aur dusri taraf hai uski behan keliye insaaf.  Ab kya chunegi Paavni ?

42e80df6-c47b-42df-b2c2-9ab633d54df1.title: Karna parambarai
42e80df6-c47b-42df-b2c2-9ab633d54df1.description: காலச்சக்கரம் நரசிம்மாவின் அடுத்த அதிரடியான நாவல் இது. காலம் காலமாக ஒரு ரகசியம் பாதுகாக்கப்படுகிறது. அந்த ரகசியத்தை ஒரு கயவன் திட்டம் போட்டு களவாடுகிறான். அந்த இரகசியத்தை மீட்பதற்கு நடக்கும் போராட்டம் தான், கர்ணபரம்பரை. இந்தக் கதையின் நாயகி, வயது முதிர்ந்த, கண்பார்வை இல்லாத ஒரு பெண் என்பதே ஒரு வியப்பை ஏற்படுத்தும் விஷயம். இந்த நாவலைக் கேட்டு முடித்தபின், இப்படியும் கூட நடக்குமா என்ற வியப்பு ஏற்படும்.

dwadwasa-jyothirlinga-kshetraalu.title: Dwadwasa Jyothirlinga Kshetraalu
dwadwasa-jyothirlinga-kshetraalu.description: జ్యోతిర్లింగాలు హిందూ ధర్మంలో అత్యంత పవిత్రమైన దేవాలయాలు, ఇవి భగవంతుడు శివుడి ప్రత్యక్ష స్వరూపాలను సూచిస్తాయి. భారతదేశంలోని పన్నెండు జ్యోతిర్లింగ క్షేత్రాలు భక్తుల ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రయాణానికి ముఖ్యమైన కేంద్రాలుగా నిలిచాయి. ఈ దేవాలయాల భక్తి సందర్శన శ్రద్ధ, సమర్పణ, మరియు ఆధ్యాత్మిక మార్గంలో అద్భుతమైన అనుభూతిని కలిగిస్తుంది. ప్రతి క్షేత్రం ప్రత్యేకమైన చారిత్రక ప్రాముఖ్యత, ఆర్కిటెక్చర్, మరియు భగవంతుడి శక్తి ప్రతీకగా నిలుస్తుంది.

maya-setu-samay-ke-us-paar-ki-kahani.title: Maya Setu: Samay Ke Us Paar Ki Kahani
maya-setu-samay-ke-us-paar-ki-kahani.description: Scientist Ishan ki zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab usse milti hai ek prachin Kitab "Maya Setu". Jiske baad uske har sach par prashn uthte hain. Main kaun hoon? Kya sach hai? Inhi sawalon mein chhupa hai jeewan ka satya. Akhir kya hai wo satya, janne ke liye poora suniye ye audioshow "Maya Setu: Samay Ke Us Paar Ki Kahani".

become-emotionless.title: Become Emotionless
become-emotionless.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಪರಿಶ್ರಮದ ಜೊತೆ ಭಾವನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುವ ಕಲೆಯನ್ನು ಕರಗತ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಅತ್ಯವಶ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಭಾವೋದ್ವೇಗಗೊಳ್ಳದೇ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಮನಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಅವಶ್ಯವಾದ ಸುಂದರ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "Become Emotionless" ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

husband-for-sale.title: Husband For Sale
husband-for-sale.description: డబ్బు కోసం   ప్రేమించి  పెళ్లి చేసుకున్న బంగారం లాంటి భర్తని   అమ్మేసింది  శ్రావణి. రెండో  పెళ్లి చేసుకున్నాక  ప్రమోద్ కి కోట్లు కలిసి వస్తాయి. దాంతో  శ్రావణి తిరిగి ప్రమోద్ జీవితంలోకి  వచ్చి అతని ద్వారా బిడ్డని కని, ఆస్తిలో వాటా కొట్టేయాలని ప్లాన్ వేస్తుంది. మరి ఆమె అనుకున్నది సాధించిందా? ఎన్నో మలుపులు, ట్విస్టులు, ప్రేమ కథతో ఎంతో ఆసక్తిగా సాగే స్టోరీని చివరిదాకా వినండి మరి.

my-life-i-decide-19-thought-provoking-id.title: My Life I Decide: 19 Thought Provoking Ideas To Change Your Life
my-life-i-decide-19-thought-provoking-id.description: Kya aap bhi decision lene se darte ho? Public ke saamne bolna awkward lagta hai? Ya kabhi kabhi lagta hai ki aap zyada deserve karte ho par life wahi ki wahi hai? Toh yeh audiobook aapke liye hai.  jo Ek popular mind-shift coach Rinku Sawhney ne iss audiobook mein 19 powerful ideas share kiya hai jo aapki soch, confidence aur approach ko ekdam shift kar denge. Yeh koi boring gyaan nahi hai – yeh ek practical guide hai jismein milega: Real-life stories aur simple exercises jiske through aap apni life ke roadblocks ko pehchan payenge aur unhe cross karne ka seedha raasta bana payenge. Ese sunne ke baad aap apni zindagi ka har faisla khud le payenge, wo bhi bina kisi jhijhak ke.

sorna.title: Sorna
sorna.description: பெத்தவங்க பார்த்த மாப்பிள்ளை சரவணன விரும்பி கல்யாணம் செஞ்சிக்கிட்டா சொர்ணா.  பகல் பொழுது முழுக்க அவன் கூட சந்தோஷமா சிரிச்சி பேசுவா. ஆனா, ராத்திரி வந்தா போதும் அவன பக்கத்துல சேர்த்துக்க மாட்டா. No sex. சரவணன் தவிச்சிப் போறான். சொர்ணா இப்படி செய்ய காரணம் என்ன???

tax-bachat-ke-7-legal-jugaad.title: Tax Bachat Ke 7 Legal Jugaad
tax-bachat-ke-7-legal-jugaad.description: Chahe aap salaried ho, freelancer ya business owner – ye 7 tax-saving secrets aapke liye hi hain. Legal tareeke se kaise kam karein tax aur badhayein apni savings – sab kuch milega simple aur practical language mein. Paisa bachao, smart bano – abhi dekho ye video!

naanu-neenu-avanu.title: Naanu Neenu Avanu
naanu-neenu-avanu.description: ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಅಮೃತ ಅಂತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅದೇ ಅಮೃತ ಮಾರುವೇಷದಲ್ಲಿರೋ ವಿಷಾನೂ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕಿ ಶಿವಾನಿಯ ಆವೇಶ ಅಮಾಯಕ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಯೊಬ್ಬನನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ಸರ್ವನಾಶ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ರೋಚಕ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "ನಾನು ನೀನು ಅವನು"

24-gantalu-santhoshamga-undatam-elaa.title: 24 Gantalu Santhoshamga Undatam Elaa
24-gantalu-santhoshamga-undatam-elaa.description: ప్రతి క్షణాన్ని సంతోషంగా గడపడానికి, మనసులో ఉన్న ఆలోచనలను సానుకూలంగా మార్చుకోవడం చాలా ముఖ్యం. ప్రతి రోజు చిన్న ఆనందాలను గుర్తించి, కృతజ్ఞతతో జీవించండి.

Veer-Saput--आज़ादी-की-पहली-जंग-का-अनसुना.title: Veer Saput : आज़ादी की पहली जंग का अनसुना इतिहास
Veer-Saput--आज़ादी-की-पहली-जंग-का-अनसुना.description:
Kya aapko lagta hai ki Bharat ki pehli azaadi ki ladai 1857 mein shuru hui thi? Toh phir 1855 mein, jab Jharkhand ke jangalon se “Hul! Hul!” ki goonj uthi thi, uska kya? Kya uss vidroh ko hum bhool chuke hain? Ya kabhi sahi se jaana hi nahi?
Yeh kahani hai Sido aur Kanhu Murmu ki — do veer adivasi bhai, jinhone angrezon, lalchi zamindaron aur nirdayi sahukaron ke khilaaf tir-kamaan uthakar ek aisi kranti ki shuruaat ki… jo school ke text books mein toh nahi likhi gayi, lekin Bharat ke swatantrata sangram ki asli pehli chingari thi. Suniye Veer Saput aur janiye wo kahani jo asal mein Aazadi ka pehla sangram tha.

karmaphaladaata-shanideva.title: Karmaphaladaata Shanideva
karmaphaladaata-shanideva.description: ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ಮವೆಂಬುದು ಬಹುಮುಖ್ಯವಾದ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಪಡೆದುಕೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರ ಬದುಕಿನ ನೋವು-ನಲಿವುಗಳು ಅವರು ಮಾಡುವ ಕರ್ಮದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಧಾರಿತವಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ‌. ಕರ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಫಲವನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಅಖಂಡ ಶಕ್ತಿಯೆಂದರೆ ಅದು ಶನಿದೇವರು ಮಾತ್ರ. ಶನಿದೇವರ ಮಹಾತ್ಮೆಯನ್ನು ಸಾರುವ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "ಕರ್ಮಫಲದಾತ ಶನಿದೇವ" ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

the-burning-truth-s2.title: The burning Truth - S2
the-burning-truth-s2.description: எல்லாம் முடிஞ்சு போச்சுன்னு நெனச்சதுக்குப் பிறகு, திரும்பவும் கொடூரமான கொலைகள் நடக்க ஆரம்பிக்குது. அதே மாதிரி பொண்ணுங்க கொடூரமா கொலை செய்யப்படறாங்க. ஹேமாவால அந்த கொலைகள தடுத்து நிறுத்த முடியுமா? என்ன செய்யப் போறாங்க?

lost-in-time-1.title: Lost In Time
lost-in-time-1.description: Roshan ek regular middle-class aadmi tha, jiski zindagi ek routine mein phas chuki thi. Apno se bichhadne ka gham, wife se doori, aur office mein roz-roz ki beizzati ke beech, ab Roshan ka patience tootne laga tha. Lekin ek bhayanak accident ne sab kuch badal diya – aur sath hi usse ek aisi shakti mil gayi jo kisi ke paas nahi thi: waqt ko rokne ki shakti. Shuruaat mein Roshan is power ka maza le raha tha – boss ke saamne presentation ke numbers badal kar, chhoti-chhoti galtiyon ko time reverse karke sudhar kar. Lekin jaise-jaise Roshan waqt se zyada khelta gaya, uski zindagi aur logon ki yaadein badalne lagi thi. Har cheez uske control mein thi – phir bhi sab kuch uske haath se fisalta ja raha tha. Aur phir ek din ek mysterious aadmi uske samne aaya jisne use kuch aisa kaha ki Roshan ne apni shaktiyon ka istemal karna band kar diya.

re-imagining-jobs-in-a-fast-changing-wor.title: RE-IMAGINING JOBS IN A FAST CHANGING WORLD
re-imagining-jobs-in-a-fast-changing-wor.description: ఆధునిక సాంకేతికత, డిజిటలైజేషన్, మరియు మారుతున్న ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థలతో, ఉద్యోగాల భవిష్యత్తు వేగంగా రూపాంతరం చెందుతోంది. మన ప్రతిభ, ఆవిష్కరణ, మరియు సాంకేతికతను కలిపి, ఈ వేగవంతమైన ప్రపంచానికి తగ్గట్లు కొత్త అవకాశాలను సృష్టిద్దాం.

my-imperfect-love-1.title: MY IMPERFECT LOVE
my-imperfect-love-1.description: జీవితం నుండి నీవు నేర్చుకున్నది తప్పించుకోవడం మాత్రమే అయితే, నిలబడి ఉండడానికి ఒక కారణం కనిపించడం ఓ పెద్ద ఆవిష్కరణ అవుతుంది. ఆత్మవిశ్వాసం, తెలివి, అగ్రగామిత్వం కలిగిన రియా తన బ్యాగులు సర్దుకొని, లండన్ స్కూల్ ఆఫ్ ఫ్యాషన్‌లో తన కొత్త గ్లామరస్ కోర్సును ప్రారంభించడానికి సిద్ధంగా ఉంది. ఆమె తల్లికి అత్యంత సన్నిహిత స్నేహితురాలు, అందరికీ రాత్రి 2.00 గంటలకు సహాయపడే వ్యక్తిగా ఆమె ఎంతో ఆధారపడతారు. అందరూ ప్రేమించే రియా, ప్రతి ఒక్కరి నమ్మకమైన వ్యక్తి.

पुराना-क़िला.title: Puraana Qila
पुराना-क़िला.description: Amrit, ek 26 saal ka struggling ladka, sirf ek interview ke liye ek purane mental asylum pahuchta hai, lekin us din jo hota hai, woh uski zindagi ke har logic ko tod deta hai. British era ke iss asylum mein 123 atmaayein qaid hain, jo sirf ek insaan se mukti chahti hain, Amrit se. Har raat ek naye raaz ka darwaza khulta hai, jahan waqt, yaadein aur sach, sab ulat jaate hain aur Amrit samajh nahi pata ki woh unki aatmao ko azad karne wala hai ya unka agla shikaar?

sreebudhan-asiayude-velicham.title: ശ്രീബുദ്ധൻ ഏഷ്യയുടെ വെളിച്ചം
sreebudhan-asiayude-velicham.description: ശ്രീബുദ്ധൻ്റെ  ജീവചരിത്രമാണു എഡ്വിൻ അർനോൾഡ് രചിച്ച ഈ ഗ്രന്ഥം. സിദ്ധാർത്ഥൻ്റെ ജീവിതകഥയിലൂടെ ബുദ്ധമത ചിന്തകളുടെ ആഴവും പരപ്പും അർനോൾഡ് വെളിവാക്കുന്നു. ലോകമാകെ വായിക്കപ്പെട്ട ഒരു സവിശേഷ ഗ്രന്ഥം.

andha-warrior.title: Andha Warrior
andha-warrior.description: Ek andha ladka Rudra, duniya ki nafrat aur apmaan ka samna karta aya tha kyuki wo ek anath bhi tha. Rudra ki maa desh ki sabse powerful Pawar family ke liye kaam karti thi, lekin ek bomb blast mein unki jaan chali gayi. Uski maa ki na body mili, na antim sanskaar hua, bas ek announcement se chhote se Rudra ki duniya ujhad gayi. Use hamesha se uski maa ki maut ek sajish lagi. Kuch dino bad use ahsas hone laga hai ki uski aankhon ke peeche chhupi hai ek jaadui shakti jo use past, present aur future dekhne ki power deti hai. Ab jab uski aankhen jag chuki hain,  kya wo apni maa ki maut ka asli raaz samajh payega ya us raaz ke peeche chhupi hai ek aisi ladaai jo uske hone ka maqsad hi badal degi?

become-your-best.title: Become Your Best
become-your-best.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಎಂಬುದು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಮೂಲಭೂತ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಆ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ದೈನಂದಿನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ರೀತಿ ಹವ್ಯಾಸಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು ಹಾಗೂ ಯೋಚನಾ ಮಟ್ಟವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ವೃದ್ಧಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದರ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಪ್ರೇರಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "Become Your ಬೆಸ್ಟ್" ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

kaathal-solla-vanthen.title: Kaathal Solla Vanthen
kaathal-solla-vanthen.description: A 29-year-old woman agrees to fake-date her neighbor, unaware he's the estranged son of a powerful businessman and haunted by his first love's death, leading them both into an emotional journey that challenges everything they believed about love and second chances.

bhajan-dum-dum-damru-baaje-re.title: Bhajan : Dum - Dum Damru Baaje Re
bhajan-dum-dum-damru-baaje-re.description: Jab bajta hai shiv ka damru tab hota hai burayi ka vinaash aur failta hai achhayi ka raaz. Is Sundar bhajan se kariye din ki shuruaat aur paaiye man ki shanti ke saath saath achha ehsaas. Abhi sunna shuru kijiye.

anpathu-laksham.title: അൻപത് ലക്ഷം
anpathu-laksham.description: ഡിറ്റക്ടീവ് നോവലുകളിലൂടെ മലയാളികളെ ഹരംകൊള്ളിച്ച നോവലിസ്റ്റ് ആണു കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥ്. ഒരു തലമുറയെ വായനയുടെ ലോകത്തേയ്ക്ക് കൈപിടിച്ചുനടത്തിയ ആ പ്രതിഭയുടെ മറ്റൊരു മാസ്റ്റർപീസ് - അൻപതു ലക്ഷം. ഒരു സിനിമാ ചിത്രീകരണത്തിൻ്റെ മറവിൽ എം.എൽ.എ വിജയലക്ഷ്മിയെ കിഡ്നാപ് ചെയ്യുന്ന ടൈഗർ മേഘനാഥൻ എന്ന കൊടും ക്രിമിനലിനെ കീഴ്പെടുത്തുക എന്നത് ഡി.ഐ.ജി വർമ്മയെ സംബന്ധിച്ച് അനിവാര്യമായിരുന്നു. അയാൾ തൻ്റെ പോലീസ് ബുദ്ധിയിൽ അതിനായി കരുക്കൾ നീക്കി.

natya-shikaram.title: NATYA SHIKARAM
natya-shikaram.description: ఒక వ్యక్తి ప్రమాదం చేసి ఒక అమ్మాయి కలను తుడిచివేస్తే, ఆమె కలను సాధించేందుకు అతను ప్రయత్నించి భరతనాట్యం నేర్చుకోవడం మొదలుపెడతాడు.

bhajan-sun-le-meri-pukaar-bhole.title: Bhajan : Sun Le Meri Pukaar Bhole
bhajan-sun-le-meri-pukaar-bhole.description: Shiv Jab sunate hain to har manokaamna poori ho jaati hai.is Bhajan mein bhi hai woh connection jo seedha Bhole Baba tak pahuchta hai. Ek baar sunenge, toh har lafz se ek alag hi shakti mehsoos karenge. Abhi sunna shuru kijiye.

100-things-millionaires-do.title: 100 Things Millionaires Do
100-things-millionaires-do.description: Panakkarana aaganumna panakkaravanga maathiriye yosikkanum. Millionairelaam eppadi panam serkaranga, eppadi yosikkarangannu theriyanuma?  Apo itha kelunga. Neengalum Millionaire aagunga.

ഭാര്യ.title: ഭാര്യ
ഭാര്യ.description: ജനപ്രിയസാഹിത്യ ലോകത്ത് ഏറെ ആഘോഷിക്കപ്പെട്ട നോവൽ, ജോയ്സി എന്ന നോവലിസ്റ്റിൻ്റെ മാസ്റ്റർപീസ്. പിന്നീട് സിനിമയായി രൂപാന്തരപ്പെട്ടപ്പോളും ജനമനസ്സുകൾ കവർന്ന സൂപ്പർഹിറ്റ്. ഹരിയുടെ ഭാര്യയായി കുടുംബത്തിലേക്ക് കാലെടുത്ത വെച്ച ഷൈലജ  എത്തുന്നതോടെ താളപ്പിഴകൾ തുടങ്ങുക ആയിരുന്നു. അതിൽ നട്ടം തിരിയുന്നത് ഹരിദാസ് എന്ന ശുദ്ധാത്മാവും. സാധാരണക്കാരന്റെ വേദനകളെയും പ്രശ്‌നങ്ങളെയും സാധാരണക്കാരുടെ ഭാഷയിൽ പറയുന്നതാണു ഈ നോവലിൻ്റെ സവിശേഷത.

bhajan-shiv-ka-damru-kaanwad-mein.title: Bhajan : Shiv Ka Damru Kaanwad Mein
bhajan-shiv-ka-damru-kaanwad-mein.description: Kabhi laga hai ki sab kuch bolne par bhi koi sun nahi raha? Kaanwad ki dhoom ke is Bhajan mein hai woh connection jo seedha Bhole Baba tak pahuchta hai. Ek baar sunenge, toh har lafz se ek alag hi shakti mehsoos karenge. Abhi sunna shuru kijiye.

ನಿಶಬ್ದ-ವಿಸ್ಫೋಟನ.title: Nishyabda Vispotana
ನಿಶಬ್ದ-ವಿಸ್ಫೋಟನ.description: ಬೇಕಾದಷ್ಟು ಸಸ್ಪೆನ್ಸ್, ಒಂದಷ್ಟು ರೋಮ್ಯಾನ್ಸ್, ಅಲ್ಲಲ್ಲಿ ಪುರಾಣಗಳನ್ನೂ, ಅಷ್ಟೋ ಇಷ್ಟೋ ಕಾವ್ಯ ವರ್ಣನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಹಾಗೂ ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಲೋಕಜ್ಞಾನ, ಭಾಗವತದ ಆಪ್ತತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಿಶ್ರಮಾಡಿ, ಮೂರು ದಶಕಗಳ ನಂತರ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್ ರವರ "ನಿಶ್ಯಬ್ದ ವಿಸ್ಪೋಟನ" ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

mysteries-behind-guna-caves-2.title: Mysteries behind Guna caves
mysteries-behind-guna-caves-2.description: മഞ്ഞുമ്മൽ ബോയ്സ് എന്ന സൂപ്പർ ഹിറ്റ് സിനിമയുടെ ഇതിവൃത്തത്തിനു പശ്ഛാത്തലമായ തമിഴ്‌നാട്ടിലെ കൊടൈക്കനാൽ മലനിരകളിലെ ഗുണ ഗുഹകൾ ഒരു പാട് നിഗൂഢതകളുടെ കേന്ദ്രമാണു. ദശാബ്ദങ്ങൾക്ക് മുൻപ് കമലഹാസൻ നായകനായ ഗുണ എന്ന സിനിമയുടെ ചിത്രീകരണത്തിനു വേദിയായതോടെയാണു ഈ ഗുഹക്ക് ഗുണാ ഗുഹയെന്ന പേരു വരുന്നത്. ഈ വസ്തുതകൾ ഉൾപ്പടെ ഈ ദുരൂഹ ഇടവുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട എല്ലാ ദുരൂഹതകളും ഈ ഓഡിയോബുക്കിൽ വിലയിരുത്തപ്പെടുന്നു.

pyaar-deewana-hota-hai.title: Pyaar Deewana Hota Hai
pyaar-deewana-hota-hai.description: Sona Sharma ke liye sab kuch khatam ho gaya tha us din, jab Akshay ne bina kisi wajah ke usse alag ho kar kisi aur se shaadi kar li. Saalon ki mehnat se Sona ne apna fashion empire khada kiya, sirf dil ke dard ko bhoolne ke liye. Lekin kismat ne ek aisa mod diya, jahan ek business pitch mein uska saamna phir se hua Akshay se, ek successful investor ke roop mein. Purani yaadein, adhoori baatein, aur chhupi hui sachchaiyaan—sab wapas laut aayi hain. Kya Sona phir se tootegi? Ya iss baar woh apna hisaab poora karegi?

the-kerala-housewife-6-kolegala-suttha.title: The Kerala Housewife : 6 Kolegala Suttha
the-kerala-housewife-6-kolegala-suttha.description: 'ಜಾಲಿ ಜೋಸೆಫ್' ಈ ಹೆಸರು ಕೇಳಿದ್ರೆ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿ ಬೀಳೋರು ಅದೆಷ್ಟು ಜನರೋ! ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ ಆಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಸಾಲು ಸಾಲು ಕೊಲೆಗಳು.. ಅದೂ ಒಂದೇ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ದುಕೊಂಡು, ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಸಂದೇಹ ಬರದಂತೆ ಈಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳು ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಅಮಾನವೀಯ.  ಕೇರಳದ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗೃಹಿಣಿ, ತನ್ನವರ ಸಾವಿಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಯಾಕೆ? ಅವಳ ಮನಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ದಿ ಕೇರಳ ಹೌಸ್ ವೈಫ್ : 6 ಕೊಲೆಗಳ ಸುತ್ತಾ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

up-ka-don-kaun.title: U.P Ka Don Kaun?
up-ka-don-kaun.description:
Lucknow ka ek aisa gangster, jiska naam sunte hi police walon ke chehre ka rang udd jaata tha. Ek-ek seedhi chadh kar, usne Uttar Pradesh ki crime duniya mein apna khauf banaya tha. Wo jitna bada apradhi tha, utna hi chhupa-rustom aur shaatir bhi. Lekin ek din, police ne uske khilaaf aisi chaal chali, jiska usne kabhi sapna bhi nahi dekha hoga. 
Kaun tha wo Don jise U.P. ka sabse bada gangster kaha gaya? Aur kis officer ne uski kahani ka the end likha? Uska encounter karne wali Police ko Baarati kyon kaha gaya? Janne ke liye suniye gripping true crime show "U.P. ka Don Kaun?"

parvathi-devi-purana.title: Parvathi Devi Purana
parvathi-devi-purana.description: ಜಗನ್ಮಾತೆ ಪಾರ್ವತಿ ದೇವಿಯ ಮಹಿಮೆ ಅಪಾರ! ಪರಶಿವನಿಗಾಗಿ ತಪಸ್ಸು ಮಾಡಿ, ಆ ಪರಮಾತ್ಮನನ್ನೇ ವರಿಸಿದ ಪಾರ್ವತಿ, ಆದಿಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಅಪಾರವತಾರ.. ಸತಿಯ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಜನ್ಮ.. ದುಷ್ಟ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕಿ, ಶಿಷ್ಟ ರಕ್ಷಕಿ ಮಹಾದೇವಿಯ ಕಥೆಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಪಾರ್ವತಿ ದೇವಿ ಪುರಾಣ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

duddu-minus-duddu.title: Duddu Minus Duddu
duddu-minus-duddu.description: ದುಡ್ಡು ಮೈನಸ್ ದುಡ್ಡು ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್ ಬಹುಚರ್ಚಿತ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ, ಇದು ದುಡ್ಡಿನ ಮಹತ್ವ, ಮಾನವ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳಿಗೆ ಅದರಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಪ್ರಭಾವ, ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರ್ಥಕ ಜೀವನದ ಕಡೆಗಿನ ನೋಟವನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮಾನಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ನಗುವ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುವ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆಳವಾದ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಕಾಣುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಸರಳತೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಕಥಾಹಂದರ ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನದ ಮಿಶ್ರಣ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿ ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಆನಂದದಾಯಕವಾದ ಅನುಭವವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ

mahakumbh-ek-veeran-shamshaan.title: Mahakumbh : Ek Veeran Shamshaan
mahakumbh-ek-veeran-shamshaan.description: Kya moksh ki talash mein gaya Raghav ban gaya ek bhatakti aatma? Mahakumbh ke naam par hone wale rituals aur shamshaan jaisi haqeeqaton ka raaz khulta hai is khas show "Mahakumbh : Ek Veeran Shamshaan" mein. Suniye aur janiye ki kaise aastha ka mela ban gaya maut aur rahasya ki Jagah.

lost-on-the-way.title: Lost On The Way
lost-on-the-way.description: Lost On The Way ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಬ್ಲೇಕ್ ಫಾರ್ಹಾ ಅವರ ಆತ್ಮಾವಲೋಕನದ ಕಥಾನಕವಾಗಿದೆ, ಅದು ಜೀವನದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುವ ಹಾಗೂ ಪಯಣದಲ್ಲೇ ದಾರಿ ತೋರುವ ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕ ಅನುಭವಗಳನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು, ಆತ್ಮಚಿಂತನೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವಿತದ ಅಡಚಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಬಗೆಗೆ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಂತೆಯೇ ಆಳವಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಮನೋಹರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಶ್ರೋತೃಗಳನ್ನು ಜೀವನದ ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ ಪಯಣದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಲೋಚಿಸಲು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

jnanavu-kadeda-shilpa.title: Jnanavu Kadeda Shilpa
jnanavu-kadeda-shilpa.description: ಜ್ಞಾನವು ಕಡೆದ ಶಿಲ್ಪ ಎಂಬ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯು . ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುವ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಬದುಕಿನ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವನ್ನು ಸಂವೇದನಾಶೀಲವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸುವ, ಆಳವಾದ ಕಥಾಹಂದರವನ್ನು ಧ್ವನಿಮಾಧ್ಯಮದ ಮೂಲಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ತಲುಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಂಬ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯು ಯೆಂದಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥರ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುವ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಬದುಕಿನ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವನ್ನು ಸಂವೇದನಾಶೀಲವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸುವ, ಆಳವಾದ ಕಥಾಹಂದರವನ್ನು ಧ್ವನಿಮಾಧ್ಯಮದ ಮೂಲಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ತಲುಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

god-ke-sath-walk.title: GOD Ke Sath WALK
god-ke-sath-walk.description: Morning walk to sab karte hain, par kabhi God ke sath Walk try karni hai? "God Ke Sath Walk" ek aisi audio book hai jaha life ke tough topics bhi asaan lagne lagege aur milega har mushkil samsya ka samadhan. Ye show karegaa aapke mood ko uplift aur milegaa God Se Gyaan.  Yakeen nahin hai to abhi poora sun kar dekhiye.

ಗಾಂಧಿ-ಅಂತ್ಯ-My-Truth.title: Gandhi Antya: My Truth
ಗಾಂಧಿ-ಅಂತ್ಯ-My-Truth.description: "ನಾನು ಗಾಂಧಿಯನ್ನು ಏಕೆ ಕೊಂದೆ" ಎಂಬ ಪುಸ್ತಕವನ್ನು ನಾಥೂರಾಮ್ ಗೋಡ್ಸೆ ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿದ್ದು, 1948ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಾತ್ಮಾ ಗಾಂಧಿಯವರ ಹತ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಅವರು ತಾವು ಏಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದರೆಂಬುದರ ತಾರ್ಕಿಕ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಹಿನ್ನಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಕೋರ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಗೋಡ್ಸೆ ಅವರ ಕೊನೆ ವಾರ್ತೆಯಾಗಿದೆ, ಅದು ತನ್ನ ಕೃತ್ಯದ ಕಾರಣವನ್ನು ಗಾಂಧಿ ಅಂತ್ಯ My Truth ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ.

kurchi-madatha-petti.title: Kurchi Madatha Petti
kurchi-madatha-petti.description: టెక్నాలజీ మన జీవితాలను పాలించేస్తున్న ఈ కాలంలో, పది రకాల సమస్యలు ప్రజలను వేదిస్తున్నాయి. ఈ కథ ఐదుగురు స్నేహితుల చుట్టూ తిరుగుతుంది, వారు తమ స్వంత అనుభవాల ద్వారా ఒక సైబర్ వింగ్ స్థాపిస్తారు. వారి లక్ష్యం సైబర్ నేరాలను ఎదుర్కొని బాధితులకు న్యాయం అందించడం. కానీ ఆ ప్రయాణం  సులువైనదా?

the-bride-collector.title: The Bride Collector
the-bride-collector.description: Mumbai ki naye naye dulhanein ek ke baad ek raaz bhare andaaz mein gayab ho rahi hain, aur har jagah chhoda jaata hai sirf ek kala gulab. Inspector Abhimanyu jab case ki solve karna shuru karta hai, toh uska samna hota hai apne hi ateet ke ek darawane raaz se—Vidushak. Jaanch use le jaati hai Chiroudgarh, ek aisa gaon jahan 31 dulhano ki bali dekar ek tantrik anushthan pura kiya ja raha hai. Jaise jaise raaz gehra hota hai, waise waise maut, sammohan aur andhvishwas ka ek bhayanak jaal saamne aata hai. Kya Abhimanyu bacha payega inn dulhano ki bali chadne se?

eradu-kanasu.title: Eradu Kanasu
eradu-kanasu.description: ಎರಡು ಕ್ರೂರ  ಮೃಗಗಳ ಥರ ಇರೋ ಗಂಡಸರ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಒದ್ದಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ನಳಿನಿಯ ಜೀವನ ಬರಿ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಕನಸೇ. ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತೆಯ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲೇ ಮೋಸ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ನಳಿನಿಯ ಕಥೆ ಏನ್ ಆಯಿತು ಅಂತ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕಾ? ನಳಿನಿಯ ಜೀವನ ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತೆ? ತಡ ಮಾಡದೆ ಕೇಳಿ "ಎರಡು ಕನಸು" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ

mud-sweat-and-tears-the-autobiography-of.title: Mud, Sweat And Tears : The Autobiography of Bear Grylls
mud-sweat-and-tears-the-autobiography-of.description:
"Bear Grylls ki ye Autobiography sirf survival skills ke baare mein nahi hai, balki ye life ke asli challenges se aur apne dar se jeetne ki kahani hai".
Mud, Sweat, and Tears ek bilkul hi epic aur adrenaline-pumping audiobook hai, jisme Bear Grylls apne zindagi ke sabse thrilling aur risky adventures ke baare mein batate hain. Yeh audiobook ek aisi survival story hai jo aapko dar aur excitement dono ka experience karwayegi. Esmein Grylls un sabhi toughest moments ke bare mein share karte hain jahan maut aur unke beech zyada doori nahin bachi thi. Wo batate hain har ek baat jo unhone ghane junglon ke beech, pahaadon ke upar, aur samundar ki gehrai mein apni jaan bachane ke liye kiya hai. 
Yeh audiobook sirf survival ke baare mein nahi hai, yeh aapko yeh bhi sikhaati hai ki apne aapko challenge kaise karein? Apni limits ko break kaise kare? Aur kaise apne fears ka saamna kare? Grylls apne experiences ko itni energy aur passion ke saath share karte hain ki aapko lagega ki aap bhi unke saath adventure par nikle hain.
Suniyega zaroor kyonki es audiobook mein aapko milegi ek rollercoaster journey – jismein junglee raaston ke beech, khatarnaak animals ke aas-paas ho kar ye shaksh chalta hi jata hai kyonki usne thaan liya hai ki apne dar ko kisi bhi haal mein harana hai.

silk-smitha.title: Silk Smitha
silk-smitha.description: 'ಸಿಲ್ಕ್ ಸ್ಮಿತಾ' ಈ ಹೆಸರು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತ ಸಿನಿರಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲ್ ಚಲ್ ಎಬ್ಬಿಸಿದ್ದು ಇಂದು ಇತಿಹಾಸ. ಆದ್ರೆ 'ವಿಜಯಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ವದ್ಲಾಪಟಿ' ಅನ್ನೋ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಹುಡುಗಿ 'ಸಿಲ್ಕ್ ಸ್ಮಿತಾ' ಅಂತಾ ಫೇಮಸ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಲೈಮ್ ಲೈಟಿನ ಹಿಂದೆ ಹೊರಟ ಹೀರೋಯಿನ್ ಬದುಕಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಲು ಆವರಿಸಿದ್ಸು ಯಾಕೆ? ಇವರ ಕೊನೆ ಆಸೆ ಏನಾಗಿತ್ತು ಗೊತ್ತಾ? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಸಿಲ್ಕ್ ಸ್ಮಿತಾ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

the-power-of-small-wins.title: The Power of Small Wins
the-power-of-small-wins.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಗೆಲುವುಗಳು, ಮುಂದಿನ ಯಶಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗ್ತವೆ. ಒಂದೊಂದು ಪುಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು, ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮೈಲುಗಲ್ಲಾಗಿ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ತವೆ. ಇದ್ರಿಂದ ಬದುಕು ಸುಂದರ ಹಾಗೂ ತೃಪ್ತಿದಾಯಕವಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'The Power of Small Wins' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್

khooni-raaz-sajni-ka-sach.title: Khooni Raaz : Sajni Ka Sach
khooni-raaz-sajni-ka-sach.description:
Kehte hain 'shaadi gudde-gudiyon ka khel nahi hoti. Aur jab yeh zabardasti ho, toh zindagi ghutan ban jaati hai.' Aur Ghut-ghut ke jeene wala insaan kab kis mod par koi khaufnaak kadam utha le, koi keh nahi sakta. Ye kahani bhi ghutan mein uthaye gaye khaufnaak aur apradhik kadam ki hai.
Ek aisa apradhi jo apni asli pehchaan chhupa kar nayi zindagi jeeta raha, poore 15 saal tak police aur samaj, dono ki aankhon mein dhool jhonkta raha!
Suniye ek sacchi ghatna par adharit ye show jismein Pati ne patni ko maut ke ghaat utar diya aur poori ghatna ko es tarah se uljha diya ki sach ek raaz ban gaya. Aisa raaz jo khoon se juda tha.

vikrama-matthu-bethala-kathegalu.title: Vikrama matthu Bethala Kathegalu
vikrama-matthu-bethala-kathegalu.description: 'ವಿಕ್ರಮ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇತಾಳ' ಪುರಾಣ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಸರಣಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ವಿಕ್ರಮಾದಿತ್ಯ ಮಹಾರಾಜನು ತನ್ನ ಶೌರ್ಯ, ಧೈರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಜ್ಞಾನದಿಂದ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದನು ಮತ್ತು ಬೇತಾಳ ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರೇತವು ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಜ್ಞಾನಪೂರ್ಣ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವುದರಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಣತಿಯಾಗಿತ್ತು. ತಾನು ಹಿಡಿದುಕೊಂಡ ಪ್ರೇತವನ್ನು ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸಲು ವಿಕ್ರಮನು ಅಪರೂಪದ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಥೆಯು ನೈತಿಕ ಪಾಠ, ತರ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಹೊರಹಾಕುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಸರಣಿ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.!

learn-english-in-7-days-2.title: Learn English In 7 Days
learn-english-in-7-days-2.description: Learn English in 7 Days ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಂಗ್ಲಭಾಷಾ ಕಲಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಸೃಜಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಸುಲಭ ವಾಕ್ಯ ಸಂರಚನೆ, ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಮಾತುಕತೆ, ಮತ್ತು ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಬಳಕೆಗಾಗಿ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾದ ಶಬ್ದಕೋಶವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುವ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಆರಂಭಿಕರಿಗೂ, ಮುಂದುವರಿದ ಅಧ್ಯಯನಕಾರರಿಗೂ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಜಕವಾಗಿದೆ. ಕೇವಲ 7 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಿಗಾಲು ಇಡುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗುವ ಈ ಪಾಠಗಳು ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

zaara-ka-abhishaap.title: Zaara ka Abhishaap
zaara-ka-abhishaap.description:
Zaara, ek amar Persian raqqasa, apne husn aur jawaani ke karan ek vardaan bhi paayi thi aur ek bhayanak shraap bhi , jo bhi uske pyaar mein pada ya usse jismāni rishta banaya, ya toh wo mar gaya ya hamesha ke liye door chala gaya. Har baar, uske mahal mein ek mombatti jal uthti thi. 300 saalon se shraapit Zaara ne jab Nima ko dekha, toh uske dil mein kuch badal gaya. Nima ko paane aur shraap se chutkaara paane ke liye, usne tod diye har qayde, har niyam... 
Kya hai raaz ye 300 so mom-battiyo ka ? Kya Nima bhi banaga ek aur shikar, ya usne likhi ek nayi kahaani?

dr-raj-kidnap-a-108-dinagalu.title: Dr Raj Kidnap - A 108 Dinagalu
dr-raj-kidnap-a-108-dinagalu.description: ಡಾ. ರಾಜಕುಮಾರರನ್ನು ವೀರಪ್ಪನ್ ಅಪಹರಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರಸಂಗ ಕನ್ನಡ ಚಿತ್ರರಂಗ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಇಡೀ ದೇಶದ ಜನಮನಗಳನ್ನು ಕದಡಿದ ಅಘಾತಕಾರಿ ಘಟನೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು 2000ನೇ ವರ್ಷದ ಈ ಘಟನೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗಳು, ತೀವ್ರ ತಾಣಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದೆ. ಡಾ. ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ ಅವರ ಮಾನವೀಯತೆ,  ವೀರಪ್ಪನ್ ಚತುರತೆಯನ್ನೂ ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ರೋಮಾಂಚಕ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಪಹರಣದಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತತೆಯವರೆಗಿನ ಅಪ್ರತಿಮ ಪ್ರವಾಸವನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿಸುವ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಆ ಕಾಲದ ಘಟನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಇಡುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

ತ್ರಿಶೂಲದ-ಅದ್ಭುತ-ಕಥೆಗಳು.title: Thrishulada Adbhuta Kathegalu
ತ್ರಿಶೂಲದ-ಅದ್ಭುತ-ಕಥೆಗಳು.description: ತ್ರಿಶೂಲದ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಕನ್ನಡದ ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾದ ಕಥನಶೈಲಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಓದುಗರನ್ನು ಮರುಮಾರು ತೀರ್ಪುಗಳಿಗೆ, ವೈಚಾರಿಕತೆಯ ಹಾದಿಗೆ ಒಯ್ಯುವ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಲ್ಪನೆಯ ಲೋಕ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಪ್ರತಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಯ ಓದಿ, ಆನಂದಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಒಂದು ಸೂಪರ್‌ನ್ಯಾಚುರಲ್ ಕಥಾಸಂಕಲನವಾಗಿದೆ.

the-curse-of-mahabharat.title: The Curse Of Mahabharat
the-curse-of-mahabharat.description: Yeh sirf Mahabharat ki nahi , hum sabki kahani hai. Ye hai un shraap ki kahani jismein har hero ko chukani padi apne karmon ki keemat. Shikhandi se leker Ashwathama tak, sabka past unka future ban gaya. Is audio show ko poora suniye aur jaaniye kaise aur kin shraap ne badali Mahabharat ki taqdeer.

power-of-hanuman-chalisa-1.title: Jai Hanuman
power-of-hanuman-chalisa-1.description: ಪವನಸುತ ಹನುಮನ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಅನಂತ! ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಭಜರಂಗಬಲಿಯನ್ನು ನೆನೆದ್ರೆ, ಎಂತಹ ಕಷ್ಟ ಕೂಡ ಮಂಜಿನಂತೆ ಕರಗುತ್ತೆ.. ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೀರಾಮನನ್ನು ಪೂಜಿಸಿ, ವಾಯುಪುತ್ರನ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು ಬದುಕು ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ತುಳಸಿದಾಸರು ರಚಿಸಿದ 'ಹನುಮಾನ್ ಚಾಲೀಸಾ'ದ ಮಹಿಮೆ ಅಪಾರ! ಇನ್ನು "ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿ, ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಗೌರವಿಸಿ, ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಲ್ಲೂ ದೇವರನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ.." ಇಂಥ ಅದ್ಭುತವಾದ ಸಾಲುಗಳನ್ನ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದು ಭಾರತದ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಸಂತ 'ನೀಮ್ ಕರೋಲಿ' ಬಾಬಾ. ಸ್ಟೀವ್ ಜಾಬ್ಸ್, ಮಾರ್ಕ್ ಜು಼ಕರ್ ಬರ್ಗ್, ವಿರಾಟ್ ಕೊಹ್ಲಿ, ರಾಮ ದಾಸ್, ಕೃಷ್ಣ ದಾಸ್, ಜ್ಯುಲಿಯಾ ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಸೆಲಬ್ರಿಟಿಗಳು ಇವರ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನದಿಂದ ಬದುಕನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ವಿದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೋಗದೇ, ಪಾಶ್ಚಿಮಾತ್ಯ ದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಪಾರವಾದ ಅನುಯಾಯಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ನೀಮ್ ಕರೋಲಿ ಬಾಬಾ ಅವರ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆ ಏನು? ಹನುಮಾನ್ ಚಾಲೀಸಾದ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಬಾಬಾ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಆಂಜನೇಯನಿಗೂ, ಬಾಬಾಗೂ ಇರೋ ನಂಟೇನು? ಹನುಮಾನ್ ಚಾಲೀಸಾದ ಅರ್ಥವೇನು? ಇದ್ರಿಂದ ಆಗುವ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನಗಳೇನು? ಯಾರು ಇದನ್ನು ಪಠಿಸಬಹುದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಉತ್ತರವಿರೋ 'ಜೈ ಹನುಮಾನ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

Dil-ರಂಗೀಲಾ.title: Dil Rangeela
Dil-ರಂಗೀಲಾ.description:
ಅನು, ಒಬ್ಬ ಹೆಸರಾಂತ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಯ ಮಗಳು. ಲಂಡನ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಓದಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿಗೆ ಬಂದು ಐಷಾರಾಮಿ ಕಾರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಓಡಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು Tasty ಅನಿಸುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ food place ಗಳನ್ನ explore ಮಾಡುವುದು ಅವಳ hobby. 
ವಿನಯ್ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಧಾರಣ ಮಧ್ಯಮ ವರ್ಗದ ಮುಗ್ದ ಹುಡುಗ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬಗೆಯ Nonveg food ಗಳನ್ನ prepare ಮಾಡಿ ತಂದು Food truck ನಲ್ಲಿಟ್ಟು business ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತಾನೆ. 
ಊಟದ ರುಚಿಯಿಂದಲೋ ಅಥವಾ ವಿನಯ್ ನ ಮಾತಿನ ಮೋಡಿಯಿಂದಲೋ ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಶುರುವಾದ ಪ್ರೇಮ, ಎಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಮುಟ್ಟಬಹುದು? ಮುಂದೆ ಈ ಜೋಡಿಗೆ ಎರಡೂ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ವರವೋ ಅಥವಾ ಶಾಪವೋ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕಾ ? ಇಂದೇ ಕೇಳಿ ನಮ್ಮ kuku FM.

nyay-ka-dangal-kanoon-ke-katghare-mein-d.title: Nyay ka Dangal : Kanoon ke Katghare Mein Dharm
nyay-ka-dangal-kanoon-ke-katghare-mein-d.description:
Maharaj ke paksh mein Rajaon ka dabav tha... par sach ke paksh mein tha ek akela patrakar.
12 din tak chali courtroom ki yeh jang bana ek misaal — jise aaj bhi 'landmark case' ke roop mein yaad kiya jata hai. Aisa kya hua tha es historical case mein? Zamana tha 1862 ka. Bombay ki angrezi adalat mein ek dharmik guru, Jadunathji Maharaj, par laga aarop — apni bhakton ka shoshan karne ka. Patrakar Karsandas Mulji ne uthayi thi awaaz, jab poora samaj andhvishwas ke jaal mein jakkad chuka tha.
Case aaya court mein, toh sirf dharm hi nahi, colonial India ka poora power structure hila. Janiye Maharaj Libel Case ka poora sach es special show mein jiska naam hai "Nyay Ka Dangal : Kanoon ke Katghare Mein Dharm"!

the-time-travel-2.title: The Time Travel
the-time-travel-2.description: 1987లోని చింతలేని కాలంలో, సూర్య అనే సాధారణ యువకుడు ప్రేమలో విఫలమై, తన జీవితాన్ని కోల్పోతున్న అనుభూతిని ఎదుర్కుంటాడు. కాని అతని జీవితంలో జరిగిన ఓ వింత సంఘటన, అతన్ని 2024లోకి తీసుకెళ్తుంది. కొత్త ప్రపంచం, కొత్త మనుషులు, అర్థం కాని పరికరాలు… ప్రతి దాంట్లోనూ అతనికి ఆశ్చర్యమే. గతం, భవిష్యత్ కలుస్తున్నప్పుడు, సూర్య తన ప్రేమను గెలిచుకుంటాడా? లేక జీవితానికి కొత్త అర్థాన్ని కనుగొంటాడా?

a-fat-revenge-story.title: A Fat Revenge Story
a-fat-revenge-story.description: Apni hi biwi Mehak ko sabke samne Rohan ne 'moti', 'gendi', 'hathi' aur na jaane kya kya keh kar bulaya tha. Mehak ne apni poori zindagi Rohan ke naam kar di thi par badle mein use sirf dhoka, tana aur divorce mila. Party mein sabke saamne beizzat kar Rohan usse uski hi company aur ghar se nikaal deta hai. Tooti hui Mehak ko sahara milta hai uske bachpan ke dost Aayush ka, jo usse dobara khud par bharosa karna sikhata hai. Yahin se shuru hota hai ek betrayed housewife ka inspiring comeback — jahan Mehak sirf apna roop hi nahi, balki poori kismat ka khel badal deti hai.

arjunana-prema-kathegalu.title: Arjunana Prema Kathegalu
arjunana-prema-kathegalu.description: ನೀವು ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿರದ ಅರ್ಜುನನ ಪ್ರೇಮ ಕಥೆಗಳು ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ. ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಆಸಕ್ತಿದಾಯಕವಾಗಿ ಸಾಗೋ ಅರ್ಜುನನ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರೇಮ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತ ನಮ್ಮ ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಹ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.

ರುದ್ರಯಾನ.title: Rudrayana
ರುದ್ರಯಾನ.description:
ಮಲ್ಲಿನಾಥ ಭಕ್ಷಿ, ಗಂಗವಾಡಿ ಪ್ರಾಂತ್ಯದ ನಾಯಕ.‌ ತನ್ನ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಮಂತ್ರ ತಂತ್ರ ವಿದ್ಯೆಯನ್ನೂ  ಕರಗತ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವವನು. ಕಾಳೀ ದೇವಿ ಉತ್ಸವದ ದಿನ ಗಂಗವಾಡಿಗೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಬರುವ ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಪಾಂಡಿಯಾರ್ ಇಡೀ ಚಿತ್ರಣವನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪಾಂಡಿಯಾರ್ ಉದ್ದೇಶವೇನು..? ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಕಾಮ,‌ ಮಾಂತ್ರಿಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತೀಕಾರದ ಭಯಾನಕ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಕಥೆ ರುದ್ರಯಾನ.
ಕೇಳಲು ಮರೆಯದಿರಿ. KUKUFM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

undercover-nawaab.title: Undercover Nawaab
undercover-nawaab.description: Aryan Malhotra kisi simple employee ki tarah dikhta hai par ₹500 crore ki deal ko ek hi text mein close kar deta hai. Logo ki tarah Shreya bhi Aryan galti se ek normal ladka samjh leti hai aur use contract marriage ka offer deti hai . Shreya ko lagta hai Aryan paison ke liye haan kar dega. Shreya jo khud apni company ki CEO wo Aryan ki powers se anjaan hai. Kya hoga jab is contract par sign kar Aryan kar dega Shreya ka plan hi rewrite? Duniya ka sabse ameer aadmi hone ke baad bhi Aryan kyu kar raha hai Shreya ke sath ye deal?

pavitramaina-ammayi.title: Pavitramaina Ammayi
pavitramaina-ammayi.description:
మాయ తన పేరెంట్స్‌ను కోల్పోయిన తర్వాత ఎన్నో ఆత్మవిశ్వాస లోపాలు, భయాలను ఎదుర్కొంటుంటుంది. అరవ్ దగ్గరికి వచ్చినప్పుడు, అతని రూపం ఒక్కసారిగా భయంకరంగా మారిపోవడం మాయకు కనిపిస్తుంది. ఈ విషయం ఆమెను భయభ్రాంతులకు గురిచేస్తుంటే, అరవ్ మాత్రం దీన్ని ఆమె భ్రమగా తీసుకుంటాడు.

ఇద్దరి మధ్య ఈ భయాలు, అభిప్రాయ భేదాలు మాయలపై ప్రభావం చూపుతాయి. meanwhile, రిషి, వరుణ్, మీరా తో కలిసి ట్రిప్ ప్లాన్ చేస్తారు. మొదట మాయ ఈ ట్రిప్‌కి వెళ్లేందుకు నిరాకరించినా, రిషిని నిరాశపరచకూడదనే భావనతో ఒప్పుకుంటుంది. ట్రిప్ సన్నాహాల మధ్య మాయకు కొన్ని భయానక సంఘటనలు ఎదురవుతాయి.

నారి-నారి-నడుమ-మురారి.title: నారి నారి నడుమ మురారి
నారి-నారి-నడుమ-మురారి.description: బంధానికి విలువిచ్చే కావ్య అనుకోని పరిస్థితుల్లో తన అక్క స్వప్నకి కాబోయే భర్త నందాని.. తన భర్తగా స్వీకరించాల్సి వస్తుంది. స్వప్నతో ప్రేమబంధం అల్లుకున్న నందా ఇప్పుడు కావ్యతో ఏర్పడిన ఈ పెళ్ళి బంధాన్ని నిలుపుకుంటాడా లేక తెంచుకుంటాడా? ఇరువురు భామల కౌగిలిలో ఇరుకున్న ఒక మగాడి పరిస్థితి ఏంటనేది తెలియాలంటే వినండి నారి నారి నడుమ మురారి ఆడియో బుక్ మీ కుకు లో

secret-shehzadi.title: Secret Shehzadi
secret-shehzadi.description: Oberoi empire ki eklauti waaris Aahna sabke saamne auction hall mein tab embarrass ho jaati hai jab uska card decline ho jaata hai. Log apas mein baat karte hain aur Ahana ko ek fraud samjhte hai, par tabhi auction hall mein Trisha Oberoi aa jati hai. Vahi Trisha jiske maut se 15 din pehle puri duniya hil gayi thi. Trisha ke paas woh raaz tha jo United States ke President bhi duniya se chhupana chahte the. Aur ab... woh Trisha wapas aa gayi hai. Kya Aahna sach mein Oberoi waris hai? Ya Trisha woh asli shehzadi hai jise duniya ne peechli baar jhoota sabit kar diya tha?

strange-and-mysterious-places.title: STRANGE AND MYSTERIOUS PLACES
strange-and-mysterious-places.description:
మీకు తెలుసా? ఈ ప్రపంచంలో అనేక విచిత్రమైన మరియు రహస్యమైన ప్రదేశాలు ఉన్నాయి. కొన్ని ప్రదేశాలు భూతాల నమ్మకాలకు ప్రసిద్ధి గాంచాయి, మరికొన్ని ప్రకృతి రహస్యాలకు నిలయంగా ఉన్నాయి. భారతదేశంలోనూ, ఇటలీలోనూ, జపాన్‌లోనూ ఇలాంటి ప్రదేశాలు భౌగోళికంగా, సాంప్రదాయికంగా ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకంగా ఉన్నాయి.

అయితే, ఈ ప్రదేశాల వెనుక ఉన్న రహస్యాలు ఏమిటి? ఎందుకు ఈ ప్రదేశాలు ఇంత ప్రత్యేకంగా మారాయి?

sleep-smarter-7.title: Sleep Smarter
sleep-smarter-7.description: నిద్ర మన ఆరోగ్యానికి, ఉత్పత్తితీరుకు ఎంతో కీలకమైనది. "స్మార్ట్‌గా నిద్రపోవడం" గురించి మనం ఎలా తెలుసుకోగలం? మన నిద్ర నాణ్యతను ఎలా మెరుగుపరచుకోవచ్చు?

secret-empire-1.title: Secret Empire
secret-empire-1.description:
"Agar mujhe rich lifestyle nahi de sakte to divorce de do!"
Bankrupt ho chuke CEO Samar Malhotra ki wife Tara use baar baar divorce dene ki dhamki deti rahi. Yahi nahi uski saasu maa aur uske sasural wale bhi uska behad mazak udaate rahe. Par ek din Tara ko Samar ka ek aisa raaz pata chala jisse uski zindagi badal gai. Use pata chala ki Samar ki bankruptcy ke peechhe uski apni hi maa Kamla ka hath tha aur Samar ne ye sab jaante hue bhi bankrupt hone ka natak kiya. Par kyun duniya ke sabse bade banking group ka ceo rehne ke baad bhi Samar kar raha tha bankrupt hone ki acting? Kya wo lena chahta tha apne sasural walon se badla? Ya in sab ke peechhe tha uska koi aur hi master plan?

the-life-changing-magic-of-tidying-up-1.title: The Life Changing Magic Of Tidying Up
the-life-changing-magic-of-tidying-up-1.description: ಮ್ಯಾರಿ ಕಾಂಡೋ ಅವರ "ದಿ ಲೈಫ್ ಚೇಂಜಿಂಗ್ ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್ ಆಫ್ ಟೈಡಿಂಗ್ ಅಪ್" ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಮನೆಯ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯನ್ನು ಕಲೆವಿದ್ಯೆಯಂತೆ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸುವ ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಕ್ಯಾಂಡೋ ನಿಯಮದ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಜಾಗವನ್ನು ಆರಾಮದಾಯಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಶಾಂತ ಸ್ಥಳವನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನವೀಕೃತ ಮನೋಭಾವದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅಲಂಕಾರವಿಲ್ಲದ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿಯನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲು ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ನೀಡುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಉತ್ತಮ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಬಳಕೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾದ ಸರಳವಾದ ಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

rise-of-hidden-prince.title: Rise Of Hidden Prince
rise-of-hidden-prince.description: Teen saal se Aarth bejaan pada tha, aur Ishani use bachane ke liye sab kuch luta chuki thi. Magar ek din ek aisa sach saamne aaya jo uske hosh udaa gaya, Aarth sirf Aarth nahi, ASR tha! Wohi ASR jise poori duniya dhoond rahi thi. Par Aarth ne apni pehchaan kyun chhupayi? Kya Ishani is raaz ka pata laga payegi? Aur kya wo Aarth ko maut ke muh se bacha payegi?

tomb-of-god.title: Tomb of God
tomb-of-god.description: When a mysterious archaeological discovery in Iraq leads to a brutal massacre, an Indian intelligence officer must race against time to uncover an ancient secret while his cousin unknowingly rides towards the same deadly destination.

anamika-3.title: Anamika
anamika-3.description:
పృథ్వీరాజ్ అనే యువకుడు తన ఊరిలో జరుగుతున్న విచిత్ర మరణాల వెనుక దాగిన అసలైన నిజాలను తెలుసుకోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తాడు. అతనికి అనామిక అనే విచిత్రమైన అమ్మాయి పరిచయం అవుతుంది. ఆమె అందం, మాటలు అతని జీవితాన్ని మార్చేస్తాయి. 
మరోవైపు, తోడేలు దాడులు, దుష్టశక్తుల ఉనికి పృథ్వీకి అనేక సవాళ్లు తేవడం ప్రారంభమవుతుంది. 
అసలు అనామిక ఎవరూ? 
ఆమె మనుషుల జీవితం మీద అంత ప్రభావం ఎందుకు చూపుతోంది? 
పృథ్వీ తన ఊరి లో జరుగుతున్న విచిత్ర మరణాలు మిస్టరీ ని చేదిస్తాడా?

na-ghar-ka-naa-ghaat-ka.title: Na Ghar Ka Naa Ghaat Ka
na-ghar-ka-naa-ghaat-ka.description: International thief Teja apni zindagi ki sabse badi heist - Swiss Bank Robbery ke liye ek dangerous plan banata hai. Par jab uska plan fail hota hai, toh uski duniya hi palat jati hai! Ek ajeeb chemical accident ke wajah se, uski aatma ek struggling journalist Manan ke shareer mein chali jati hai! Ab ek 40 saal ka gangster, ek 20 saal ke journalist ki zindagi jeene par majboor hai. Office ke deadlines, English bolne ki dikkat, pyaar, dosti aur dushmani ke naye kisse. Teja ke naye life ki shuruat ek comedy circus ban jaati hai! Par sachai yeh hai ki Manan ka past ek dark mystery se bhara hai. Kya Teja ek aam insaan ki tarah jee payega? Ya fir uska criminal past usse dhund lega?

aaah.title: ஆ...
aaah.description: கதையின் நாயகன் கம்ப்யூட்டர் மென் பொருள் எழுதுவதில் விற்பன்னன். பெரிய நிறுவனத்தில் வேலை பார்ப்பவன். அன்பான அம்மா, அழகான மனைவி, கை நிறைய சம்பாத்தியம் என்கிற அவனது சந்தோஷ வாழ்க்கையில் திடீரென்று அவன் மண்டைக்குள் ஏதோ ஒரு குரல் கேட்கத் தொடங்குகிறது. அது அவனுக்குக் கட்டளையிடுகிறது. வசப்படுத்த முயற்சிக்கிறது. தற்கொலைக்குத் தூண்டுகிறது. இதைத் தொடர்ந்து ஸ்பிலிட் பர்சனாலிடி, முற்பிறவி, ஆவி என அலைக் கழிக்கப்பட்டு, கொலை, கைது, கோர்ட் விசாரணை என்கிற சமயத்தில் கதைக்குள் கணேஷ், வஸந்த் நுழைகிறார்கள்.

naa-saavu-nenu-sastha.title: Naa Saavu Nen Sasthaa
naa-saavu-nenu-sastha.description:
తల్లిదండ్రుల కోపం ఒక వైపు... పక్కింటి సురేష్ కొడుకు ఇంకో వైపు...
మధ్యలో తానూ తన బెడ్రూమ్‌ ఆగదిలో ఉండే వెంకట సాయికిరణ్ (VSK)!ఫ్రస్ట్రేషన్‌తో, కామెడీతో తన లైఫ్‌ను 'లవ్ స్టోరీ' అనుకుంటే ఫీల్ రాదు, కానీ ‘స్టాండ్‌అప్ కామెడీ’ అంటుంటే అన్నీ వర్కవుట్ అవుతున్నాయ్! తండ్రి మందలింపులు, తల్లి ఆటిట్యూడ్, అంజలి అనే అజ్ఞాత ఆంటీ చూపిన కొత్త దారులు... నవ్వులతో సాగే ఈ ప్రయాణం ‘నా సావు నేను సస్తా’!"

wedding-day-betrayal.title: Wedding Day Betrayal
wedding-day-betrayal.description: Maheep aur Shaurya ki shaadi usi din tooti jis din unki zindagi shuru hone wali thi. Jahan ek taraf Maheep ke dil mein sirf pyaar tha, wahin doosri taraf Shaurya ki zindagi mein ek dusri aurat, Rhea ne aag laga di. Beech mein fasa tha Shaurya ka guilt, Rhea ka obsession aur Maheep ka toota hua vishwas. Har rishte mein chhupa hai ek raaz, aur har raaz ke peeche hai ek wajah... lekin kya sach kabhi samne aa paayega?

bible-helodenu.title: Bible Helodenu?
bible-helodenu.description: ಪವಿತ್ರ ಬೈಬಲ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಹಳೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಒಡಂಬಡಿಕೆಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಗಮವಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕೇಳುವ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಬೈಬಲ್‌ಗಿರುವ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಭಾವವನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಭವಿಸಲು, ಇದು ಒಂದು ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಬಹುದು. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಅಧ್ಯಾಯವೂ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ದೇವರ ಮಾತುಗಳ ಆಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಆವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀವು ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗಲೂ, ಮನೆ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವಾಗಲೂ ಅಥವಾ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆಯುವಾಗಲೂ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಅನುಭೂತಿಯಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಲು ಸೂಕ್ತವಾಗಿದೆ.

philosophy-of-happiness-2.title: Philosophy of Happiness
philosophy-of-happiness-2.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿರೋದು ಏನು.? ಹಣ? ಆಸ್ತಿ? ಅಧಿಕಾರ? ಪ್ರೀತಿ? ಊಹೂಂ.. ಇದ್ಯಾವುದೂ ಅಲ್ಲಾ.! ಇದೆಲ್ಲದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿರೋದು ‘ಸಂತೋಷ’.! ಬದುಕಿನ ಯಾವುದೇ ಘಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿರ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಖುಷಿಯಾಗಿರೋದು ತುಂಬಾ ಇಂಪಾರ್ಟೆಂಟ್. ಆದ್ರೆ ಕಷ್ಟದ ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳಲ್ಲೂ ನಾವು ಹ್ಯಾಪಿಯಾಗಿರೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯನಾ.? ಹೇಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಸಹಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಸಮಾಧಾನವಾಗಿರೋದು.? ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಖ್ಯಾತ ತತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞರು ಹೇಳೋದೇನು.? ಕೇಳಿ ‘ಫಿಲಾಸಫಿ ಆಫ್ ಹ್ಯಾಪಿನೆಸ್’ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.!

main-tenu-phir-milangi-bantware-ke-dard-.title: Main Tenu Phir Milangi :Bantware Ke Dard Me Chipi Ek Prem Kahani
main-tenu-phir-milangi-bantware-ke-dard-.description:
Es kahani mein Bharat ke Bantware ka itihas bhi hai, aur ek amar prem kahani bhi. 
Lahore mein mile the Amrita aur Sahir... aur phir Bantware ne unhe do mulkon mein baant diya. Kaun jaanta tha ki ye do writers, dard ke daur se guzar kar ek amar prem kahani likhenge? Sahir ke geet Bharat ke har kone mein gungunaaye jaayenge, aur Amrita ban jaayengi ek literary icon. Bantware ke baad Pakistan mein hua ek haadsa, jiske baad Sahir Bharat laut aaye. Kya hua tha unke saath? Aur Bharat aane ke baad bhi... kyun na ho sake woh dono ek? Suniye, ye kahani jo Bantware ke zakhmon se nikli aur prem ke rang mein rang gayi.

when-soulmates-meet-again-1.title: When soulmates meet again
when-soulmates-meet-again-1.description: Aarav and Preeti were married as kids but got separated when her family moved away. 15 years later, they unknowingly meet again at work — neither recognizing the other. As they fall in love, both keep searching for the childhood partner they once married, unaware they’ve already found each other.

fake-husband-nika-ceo.title: Fake husband, Nikla CEO
fake-husband-nika-ceo.description: Isha, a kind and simple girl, is betrayed by her jealous step-sister Naina, who drugs her and tries to ruin her reputation. When her life falls apart, a simple security guard named Aadi stands by her side and marries her. What Isha doesn’t know is that Aadi is actually Aditya Shekhawat, a powerful billionaire hiding his identity. As secrets come out and enemies confess, love and truth give Isha the respect and happiness she deserves

billionaire-became-beggar-2.title: Billionaire Became Beggar
billionaire-became-beggar-2.description: Dharam, a powerful CEO, disguises himself as a beggar to test the character of Anya, a woman under immense family pressure to find a partner. Anya, desperate to appease her mother, impulsively hires Dharam as her temporary boyfriend, unaware he is the very CEO she secretly loves. Their transactional relationship quickly complicates as Dharam develops genuine feelings, even as Anya confesses her heart belongs to a powerful CEO, unknowingly to him. The arrival of mysterious, valuable gifts from Khanna Industries at Anya's home begins to expose Dharam's true identity, shattering Anya's perception and transforming their charade into a high-stakes drama. Anya's wealthy family, particularly her protective brother and discerning mother, vehemently disapproves of Dharam's perceived lower social standing, leading to accusations of fraud and theft. Vijay, Anya's childhood friend and rival suitor, further fuels the family's animosity, culminating in Dharam's public humiliation and physical assault. Despite the escalating conflict, Anjali, an employee, fiercely defends Dharam, dramatically revealing his true identity as the undercover CEO of Khanna Industries, a secret he maintained to expose the family's deep-seated class prejudices. Anya's powerful father, Parishith Mehta, orchestrates further violence against Dharam and attempts to force Anya into an arranged marriage. However, Anya courageously defies her family, publicly rejecting the arranged marriage and declaring her love for Dharam. Dharam, now revealed as Chairman Dharam Khanna and operating under the alias Shyam, systematically dismantles Parishith Mehta's empire, seeking vengeance for past injustices against Anya and his own sister. After securing justice and exposing corruption, Dharam proposes to Anya, transforming their temporary arrangement into a permanent bond. Their marriage signifies a new beginning, overcoming class conflict, corporate intrigue, and family control, as their genuine affection triumphs amidst the unraveling of hidden truths and a quest for justice.

billion-dollar-brother-3.title: Billion Dollar Brother
billion-dollar-brother-3.description: When the arrogant and wealthy Aditya returns to his hometown after years abroad, he hides his billionaire status behind a simple identity. But when he meets the fiery and independent Jhanvi, his past secrets, family wounds, and unresolved rivalries resurface. In a clash of pride, love, and redemption, Samar must choose between ego and heart before it's too late. Watch Now!

autowala-billionaire-2.title: autowala billionaire
autowala-billionaire-2.description: A billionaire couple goes undercover as poor to test their son’s character, only to watch him lose his values, fall for a toxic heiress, betray them  and eventually face a shocking truth that shatters every relationship. Watch now.

my-dad-the-boss-1.title: My Dad: The Boss
my-dad-the-boss-1.description: The microdrama centers on Rajpratap Sharma, an ambitious young professional whose efforts to gain social acceptance and impress powerful heiress Sandhya Kashyap are consistently complicated by his humble father, Rana. Rana, initially appearing as a security guard, makes shocking claims of a past connection with Sandhya and publicly accuses Mrs. Kashyap of an inheritance scheme, leading to covert investigations. It is gradually revealed that Rana is not merely a humble father but a powerful, influential figure, a guru to CEO Rahul, and the unacknowledged founder of the Bharat Group, who has been living a double life. He secretly orchestrates Raj and Sandhya's burgeoning romance, hinting at his own complex romantic history with Sandhya. Meanwhile, socialite Neha Arun navigates a series of romantic entanglements and finds herself at the center of corporate maneuvers, protected by Rana and sought after as a potential savior. A deep-seated corporate intrigue unfolds as rival Dhanraj orchestrates a 25-year vendetta against Rana, head of the RP Group, using Preethi Kashyap to sabotage him. This vendetta unearths a decades-old conspiracy, revealing that Rana was framed and driven to suicide, leaving his child disgraced. High-stakes charity auctions and corporate battles, including a financial war testing Raj, serve as backdrops to these personal and corporate conflicts. Ultimately, Dhanraj, revealed as a reclusive patriarch, confesses his past helplessness and unites with his son, Raj, to protect their lineage against a vengeful, shadowy enemy from the past, seeking forgiveness for his silence. The series culminates in the alliance of Raj and Dhanraj, committed to confronting this antagonist and securing their future.

thugs-of-ghaziabad-1.title: Thugs of Ghaziabad
thugs-of-ghaziabad-1.description: The family rivalry trickles into the local politics and underbelly of Ghaziabad. This ignites a chain of gun violence, leading to the bloodbath that decides the fate of both parties.

sabka-masseha.title: Sabka Masseha
sabka-masseha.description: Prakash, a humble village watchman, hides a legendary past as the "Mahaveeran," a supreme master of divine power who vanished decades ago. When the ancient, apocalyptic force known as Kaal returns to consume the kingdom, Prakash’s estranged son, Vikram, must lead a desperate army against an enemy they cannot defeat. Forced to step out of the shadows to save his son and the world, Prakash reveals his true identity to dismantle Kaal’s darkness

unknown-connection-1.title: Unknown Connection
unknown-connection-1.description: The show follows Ananya through a long struggle to rebuild her life after family rejection, hidden betrayals, and the loss or disappearance of her children. It begins with a brutal honor crisis when her premarital pregnancy leads her father and brother to condemn her, and she is cast out after exposing her father’s hypocrisy. Her twins are born with a distinctive heart-shaped birthmark, but they are declared dead even as later clues suggest they were deliberately taken, creating a lasting mystery that shadows everything that follows. Years later, Ananya tries to survive through work and caregiving, repeatedly drawn into households where children become the emotional center and where adults’ secrets cannot stay buried. Her warmth with children and competence at home and at work gradually make her indispensable, while the children themselves keep pushing fractured adults toward a family unit. A romance and marriage take shape around her, but the man beside her is described under shifting names and identities, suggesting that the relationship is built on both genuine devotion and major concealment. He often protects Ananya from humiliation, workplace abuse, and public scandal, yet his hidden past keeps threatening the trust between them. Ananya also fights to establish herself professionally in fashion, only to face renewed accusations of plagiarism, rivalry from her sister Sonal, and class-based embarrassment over her background. As these pressures mount, revelations begin to connect her personal wounds to larger conspiracies: she was framed in the past, a seven-year-old event remains under investigation, and a resurfacing mark keeps pointing back to the children’s origins. The children’s bond with Ananya becomes one of the show’s strongest emotional anchors, especially as they openly choose her as their real mother even when biological claims and former partners return to challenge her place. Crises involving a violent accident and a severe allergy expose how much Ananya loves the children, but also how much she still does not know about them, deepening suspicion that crucial truths were withheld from her.
