At the same time, old family fractures reopen when her estranged sister reappears and when Aradhya reveals herself as Ananya’s biological mother, turning questions of identity into both a personal and generational reckoning. The man at the center of Ananya’s new life is eventually exposed as a powerful CEO living under a false identity, and his delayed confessions push their marriage toward rupture. Ananya’s sense of betrayal intensifies when hidden ex-partners, sabotage from the past, and conflicting declarations of love complicate what had seemed like a hard-won domestic refuge. Even so, the story keeps returning to the idea that chosen bonds may matter more than blood, as children, spouses, and parents repeatedly test who truly stands by one another. Public confrontations, corporate power plays, and romantic jealousy all feed into the same larger stakes: whether Ananya can clear her name, uncover the truth about the past, and hold together the family she has fought to build. By the latest phase, trust remains unstable, with Ananya torn between anger, old attachments, and new revelations, while Arjun continues defending her publicly even as she challenges him personally. Across the full arc, the show presents a melodrama of stolen motherhood, concealed identity, and contested family, where every apparent rescue carries another secret and every reunion risks reopening an older wound.

the-alpha-kings-redemption.title: The Alpha King’s Redemption
the-alpha-kings-redemption.description: A humble street-sweeper hiding as “Brij Mohan” is forced to reveal his true identity—the feared Alpha King of the wolf clans—when his teenage daughter is brutalized, kidnapped, and offered as a “gift” to a monstrous trafficker. To save her, he must reclaim his throne, unleash the wolf within, and turn an entire empire of predators into prey.

my-dad-the-boss-2.title: My Dad: The Boss
my-dad-the-boss-2.description: ఒక మామూలు సెక్యూరిటీ గార్డు తన గతాన్ని దాచుకుని కొడుకును వ్యాపారంలో గొప్పగా మారుస్తాడు. అయితే తన గతం ముందుకొచ్చినపుడు అతనేం చేసాడు? చూడండి "My Dad: The Boss" కుకు టీవీలో.

the-silent-billionaire.title: The Silent Billionaire
the-silent-billionaire.description: The microdrama centers on Kishan, a young man enduring brutal abuse from his Chacha, Jaita, who controls the family's vast assets and plots to disinherit Kishan. Kishan secretly vows revenge and aims to reclaim his rightful inheritance, discovering a sinister conspiracy against him. This plot hinges on the presumed death of his grandfather, who Kishan later finds as an unconscious patient, 'Baba,' in a hospital. Kishan becomes entangled in a dangerous web, secretly drugged while trying to uncover Baba's true identity and the truth behind his family's secrets. Meanwhile, Jaita, later identified as Mukesh, relentlessly seeks the 'old man' patient, orchestrating a ruthless corporate takeover and planning a "celebration of real death" to seize control of the multi-millionaire company. Seven years after his beloved grandfather, Dada ji, was presumed dead, Kishan's world is shattered by his dramatic reappearance after a car crash, sparking violent denial and accusations of delusion from his family, particularly from Mukesh. Mukesh brutally assaults Kishan, demanding he admit Dada ji's death, driven by a high-stakes inheritance battle and a scheme to seize all family assets. Mukesh is also revealed to lead a human organ trafficking operation, targeting Dada ji and marking Kishan for a deadly "Bioscope" transfer. Kishan, refusing to flee, races against time with his loyal guardian Kaka to expose the truth about Dada ji's captivity and rescue him, all while being hunted by assassins who have already eradicated his family. Kishan orchestrates the dramatic public return of his presumed-dead Grandfather to reclaim his inheritance, exposing Mukesh's extensive fraud and betrayal. A family gathering explodes with accusations as the Grandfather reveals Mukesh's treacherous past, including poisoning and physical abuse. Kishan reveals Mukesh, his adopted uncle, murdered his parents seven years prior, and Kishan himself survived the incident, shifting the inheritance battle to a personal quest for vengeance. The narrative culminates in a violent showdown where Mukesh confesses to causing multiple deaths and other crimes. Kishan apprehends Mukesh, Vishambhar Nath, and Chachi, presenting collected evidence and a recorded confession for their crimes. The patriarch Dadda Ji, haunted by past tragedies, is reunited with his grandson, Kishan, and a mysterious woman, his "chhoti bahu." Dadda Ji sees them as his last chance for redemption, vowing to fiercely protect them, heal old wounds, and prevent history from repeating itself, seeking atonement for past failures and restoring honor to his family.

maharani-the-substitute-bride.title: Maharani - The Substitute Bride
maharani-the-substitute-bride.description: Maharani - The Substitute Bride, is a political family drama set against the backdrop of dynastic Indian politics. The series explores how women, often treated as pawns in the game of power, can become players who change the very rules of the game. At its heart, the story is a love story born out of compulsion, evolving into a political partnership of equals. Through betrayal, corruption, and power struggles, Anandi and Arjun’s journey reflects themes of loyalty. Watch Now.

finding-us-again-4.title: Finding Us Again
finding-us-again-4.description: యాభై ఏళ్ళకు దగ్గరవుతున్న సిద్ధార్థ్, అసలైన ప్రేమను వెతికే క్రమంలో సాధారణ మహిళ సనా ను పెళ్ళి చేసుకుంటాడు. వాళ్ళిద్దరి  పెళ్ళి నిలబడిందా..? Watch "Finding Us Again" on Kuku TV.

desh-ka-dhurandhar.title: Desh ka Dhurandhar
desh-ka-dhurandhar.description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.

bodyguard-ceo-2.title: Bodyguard CEO
bodyguard-ceo-2.description: The billionaire became a bodyguard just to find true love! When identities switched, love's true face was revealed!

mad-chef-maddy.title: Mad Chef Maddy
mad-chef-maddy.description: Madhavan “Maddy,” once a celebrated chef, loses his passion after the sudden death of his wife, Anjali  the soul behind his cooking. His restaurant declines as he drifts through grief, cooking without heart. When Bani, a kind young woman trying to save her failing restaurant, seeks his help, she challenges his emptiness and pushes him back into competitive kitchens. Forced to confront his pain and ruthless rivals, Maddy rediscovers his fire rising again to honor Anjali and reclaim his craft.

raw-agent-vs-delivery-boy.title: Raw Agent vs Delivery Boy
raw-agent-vs-delivery-boy.description: The microdrama begins with Nana, a humble delivery boy, whose daughter arranges a blind date, leading to a humorous misunderstanding with the wrong woman. Later identified as Kabir, he faces public humiliation due to class differences with Anika Singhania, yet her influential family unexpectedly seeks him out. After saving Anika, he is offered a life-changing position by her CEO mother, which he initially declines due to his principles, even rejecting a luxury car and resigning. This principled stand leads to Anika's shocking proposal: a contract marriage to save her family's company and maintain a facade of happiness for her daughter, Ishita, trapping Kabir in a contractual union. Kabir's daughter, Priya, inadvertently discovers this secret marriage, mistakenly believing Anika is her stepmother and expressing a desire for Anika to be her mother, a role Anika initially resists. As Anika's corporate empire faces a severe threat from the crime lord Shetty Bhai, Kabir, initially underestimated, steps in as her formidable protector. He demands, in return for his aid, that Anika embrace a maternal role for Priya, leading to a tense agreement. A devastating accident critically injures Priya, plunging Kabir and Anika into a shared crisis that exposes deeper emotional stakes. Priya's life is saved by a mysterious benefactor, and Anika reluctantly accepts a mother-like role, hinting at a deeper commitment with Kabir. Their hidden union is publicly exposed by a rival, Malhotra, leading to confrontations that reveal Kabir's humble past and surprising combat skills. Anika's investigation uncovers a mysterious twelve-year gap in Kabir's past, revealing their marriage is built on secrets, just as a vengeful enemy from his hidden life resurfaces. Anika's family empire faces a multi-pronged attack, including a warehouse fire and her brother Aditya's plot for a corporate takeover, demanding Anika divorce Kabir and marry Rithvik. Kabir, initially dismissed as a "delivery boy," dramatically intervenes, revealing himself as Rudra Varma, a former RAW agent who faked his death to seek justice and protect his family. He asserts his true power at a crucial business summit, humiliating rivals and demanding retribution for insults against Anika. Rudra embarks on a mission to expose a treacherous senior member within his agency, orchestrating Anika's kidnapping by his rival, Baldev, as part of a dangerous, pre-meditated plan. This act shatters Anika's world, forcing her to confront Kabir's true identity and past, ultimately leading to their reconciliation and the blossoming of their deep family bond amidst the unfolding conspiracy.

the-double-life-of-prime-minister.title: The Double Life Of Prime Minister
the-double-life-of-prime-minister.description: Naina, a struggling waitress burdened by debt and a dying mother, is forced into a dangerous situation that leads her to Krish. Unaware that he is the Prime Minister himself, Naina believes Krish is only the PM’s look-alike living a secret life. A marriage of necessity pulls her into power, lies, and national conspiracies, where the truth could cost lives and love becomes the biggest risk.

autowala-billionaire-1.title: Autowala Billionaire
autowala-billionaire-1.description: Kuber Shah, a wealthy industrialist, initially poses as a humble auto driver to instill values in his materialistic son, Gaurav, a deception that strains his marriage to Mira. Concurrently, a power struggle for succession at Kuber Group emerges, with the Grandmother advocating for Gaurav's promotion and the revelation of his true parentage. Unaware of his immense inheritance, Gaurav pursues a marriage with the affluent Karishma, whose CEO father, Mr. Rahuja, initially disapproves due to Gaurav's perceived lower status. However, Kuber Shah dramatically reveals Mr. Rahuja's bankruptcy and corporate secrets, reversing the power dynamic and dictating a forced marriage. The impending union transforms into a high-stakes negotiation, as Karishma's demands clash with Gaurav's powerful family, culminating in Gaurav betraying his family by siding with her. This betrayal deepens when a valuable diamond ring disappears, leading to accusations against Gaurav's parents, and it is revealed Kuber Shah swapped the authentic ring due to the family business facing bankruptcy. Driven by ambition, Gaurav acquires a luxurious flat but coldly denies his parents a home, prioritizing Karishma's lifestyle and his own ascent. He attempts to erase his past to align with Karishma's wealthy world, publicly disowning his impoverished biological parents, Mr. and Mrs. Shah, multiple times. Unbeknownst to Gaurav, his corporate advancements, including a director promotion, are secretly orchestrated by Karishma's powerful parents, Mr. and Mrs. Ahuja, who are testing his loyalty. The dramatic turning point occurs when Kuber Shah, after being cruelly disowned by Gaurav while disguised as a poor man, dramatically reveals his true identity as the powerful owner of Kuber Group. Gaurav then discovers Kuber Shah is his biological father, leading to his disinheritance and betrayal by Karishma, who chooses her family over him. Driven by a desire for redemption and power, Gaurav attempts to impress his father through ruthless corporate purges, firing loyal employees. His ambition culminates in a sinister plot against his parents, leading to his dramatic and final disownment by Kuber Shah for attempted poisoning. The series explores the devastating consequences of greed, ambition, and family betrayal in the pursuit of wealth and status.

humshakal-billionaire.title: Ajab Prem Ki Gazab Kahani
humshakal-billionaire.description: Twin boys are born into a powerful business family. But fate intervenes and separates the newborns forever. One child grows up as Prem , heir to a vast business empire—soft-spoken, timid, and The other son Amar becomes Autowala who is confident and struggling with daily expenses . Fate takes a U turn when Amar takes over to protect Prem from his step mom.

revenge-of-chanakya-3.title: Revenge of Chanakya
revenge-of-chanakya-3.description: Ravi Kashyap, an entitled executive, faces a dramatic downfall, publicly accused of insider trading by CEO Nakul and abandoned by his wife, Shanaya. He hits rock bottom, finding unexpected empathy from a delivery boy he once demeaned, Chandan. Ousted and seeking vengeance against the e-commerce giant Flash Cart and its CEO Nakul, Ravi recruits Chandan, now a delivery boy with a hidden past, to infiltrate the company and lead a rival venture. Chandan, initially an unwitting pawn in Ravi's strategic revenge plot, launches his own precarious delivery startup, Dropstar, to challenge Flash Cart and provide opportunities for unjustly fired delivery partners. His venture faces sabotage and violent threats against his girlfriend, Maya, while Ravi Kashyap battles Nakul, navigating blackmail and a larger corporate plot orchestrated by investor Vikram. A determined journalist investigates the corporate corruption surrounding these events. Prithvi, Chandan's former boss, vows destruction as Chandan rises to become CEO of Flashkart. Ravi, estranged from Shanaya, forms a desperate alliance with her to oust a corporate CEO. He later makes a strategic confession, leading to his arrest for a data breach but securing vital funding for Chandan's venture, while a loyal protégé vows to free his imprisoned mentor. Chandan's personal vendetta against Nakul Shastri escalates, culminating in Maya's capture and a deadly confrontation. Chandan orchestrates Nakul's public downfall, using a trusted associate as a double agent to expose Nakul's vast criminal empire. This leads to Nakul's dramatic arrest on charges of fraud, molestation, and murder. Following this victory, Chandan Gowda secures his position as CEO of Flash Kart and strategically merges with another entity to install his mentor and elder brother, Ravi Kashyap, as Chairman. Nakul, however, defiantly vows relentless revenge, and the introduction of a strategic genius, Shashwat, and a mysterious delivery person, Kanchet, hints at new, deeper conflicts on the horizon.

contract-love-2.title: Contract Love
contract-love-2.description: Mohini's world shatters when her fiancé, Rohan, betrays her with her step-sister, Rimmy, leading to a public humiliation and the threat of losing her family company unless she marries. Desperate to save her inheritance from scheming rivals, Mohini seeks a strategic alliance. Simultaneously, Karan, a wealthy hotelier, is pressured by his father to marry a woman who loves him for himself, unaware of his true status. Their paths intertwine when Mohini, seeking revenge and a solution, hires Karan, initially disguised as a waiter, to pose as her fake fiancé. This calculated contract marriage, built on deception and mutual benefit, ignites a high-stakes battle for corporate control and personal redemption, with Mohini ironically setting rules against lies despite their foundation of pretense. As their fake relationship progresses, genuine feelings begin to emerge between them, complicated by Karan's hidden wealth and Mohini's belief he is a humble waiter. They face numerous external threats from rivals like Rimmy, Rohan, Meera, and others who attempt to sabotage Mohini's career and expose Karan's identity. Karan, secretly aiding Mohini in her corporate battles, struggles to maintain his double life while genuinely falling for her. The deception culminates in a dramatic revelation of Karan's true identity and the confession that their relationship began as a wager, shattering Mohini's trust. Despite this profound betrayal, Karan ultimately chooses Mohini over his vast inheritance, exposing Rohan's manipulative schemes and proving his genuine affection. Their love is tested and affirmed, leading to reconciliation. Karan's father, witnessing their bond, entrusts them with a shared hotel empire, where they embark on a future as CEO and CFO, having navigated a complex web of lies, corporate intrigue, and unexpected love.

somnath-bhatki-aur-balidaan-ki-kahani.title: Somnath: Bhakti Aur Balidaan Ki Kahani
somnath-bhatki-aur-balidaan-ki-kahani.description: Somnath: Bhatki Aur Balidaan Ki Kahani

ceos-lost-bride-3.title: Bride on the Run
ceos-lost-bride-3.description:
Anamika, who works as a waitress in a restaurant, finds out that her uncle and aunt plan to deceive her, so she runs away from the forced wedding. later, she married Jai, who is a stranger to her. why did Anamika and Jai really get married?
Or is there a bigger game behind it?

ludhiana-to-london.title: Ludhiana to London
ludhiana-to-london.description: After being humiliated as “just a dishwasher” by the woman he secretly funded and loved, self-made millionaire Gursewakh Singh enters a contract marriage with elite heiress Simran, hiding his true identity as he quietly rises in her powerful world - proving that the most underestimated man can command the greatest empire. Watch now!

ceos-lost-bride-2.title: Bride On The Run
ceos-lost-bride-2.description:
Anamika, who works as a waitress in a restaurant, finds out that her uncle and aunt plan to deceive her, so she runs away from the forced wedding. later, she married Jai, who is a stranger to her. why did Anamika and Jai really get married?
Or is there a bigger game behind it?

just-divorced.title: Just Divorced
just-divorced.description:
A poor but self-respecting girl discovers that her absentee father is a powerful billionaire who refuses to acknowledge her.
Public humiliation, betrayal, and emotional abandonment shatter her childhood belief in love and family.
As a mother-daughter duo walks away from injustice, fate begins to test the father with guilt, loss, and truth.
This is the story of broken promises, hidden identities, and a daughter who refuses to beg for her father’s love.

billionaire-became-beggar-1.title: Billionaire Became Beggar
billionaire-became-beggar-1.description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Became Beggar is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

billion-dollar-wala-revenge.title: Billion Dollar Wala Revenge
billion-dollar-wala-revenge.description: At the wealthy Diwan mansion, the patriarch abruptly freezes his adult sons’ money and demands they prove themselves by earning ₹50,000 before he names an heir, turning succession into a ruthless test of character and pride. He hardens the ultimatum with a chilling condition: his sons must vow that if he becomes critically ill or dies, none of the family wealth will be spent on his care, forcing at least one son to agree under moral pressure. Resentment curdles into something darker when a disinherited son voices a desire for his father’s death and takeover, and soon the patriarch collapses in a medication-linked crisis, found gasping for breath. With accounts immobilized, saving the patriarch becomes a cash-and-time emergency, and a lawyer-linked bargain offers funds only in exchange for a contract marriage, pushing a son into a hidden “personal commitment” and a lie about where the money came from. That secret sacrifice keeps the father alive for the moment but ignites a fresh inheritance rivalry when a suspicious relative arrives and reads the son’s sudden standing as a threat. In parallel, Ragini’s own life fractures publicly when her groom rejects her at the mandap, and her grandfather demands she marry the same day to protect family honor, driving her toward a legal-document “contract” solution. As Ragini’s corporate world asserts itself, she emerges as a hard-driving company head who hires the late, unprepared outsider Prithvi on the spot, instantly breeding resentment and scrutiny around him. A coordinated sabotage follows—an insider and collaborator plant a virus on Prithvi’s device, crash the system, and point the trail at his network address—forcing Ragini to confront him as the company teeters. Prithvi buys “two minutes,” neutralizes the breach by cloning the attacker’s virus, and earns public recognition and promotion, only for workplace power abuse to flare elsewhere and leave him fired after he challenges an authority figure’s humiliating tyranny. The show’s central knot tightens when a “forgotten” contract marriage resurfaces: an elder demands to meet Ragini’s spouse, and she realizes she doesn’t even know the identity on her own marriage certificate until an assistant finds the name. Ragini later confides she paid 2.5 crore for her contract spouse, unaware she is speaking to him, as the marriage’s transactional origin collides with real emotional proximity that has “developed over” months. Corporate danger escalates when Prithvi learns an internal employee and an external broker plan to sell confidential data and harm both him and Ragini; he records a confession, hands it to an inspector, and the insider is arrested—but vows revenge. As romance threatens to become real—Ragini planning a Valentine’s confession and setting a specific meeting—an unidentified antagonist times an assassination to that exact rendezvous, turning intimacy into a target. Meanwhile, the Diwan power struggle turns lethal: a father’s health crash leads to a will and a CEO elevation, and later a brother admits the patriarch’s death was engineered via a glucose overdose to stop full company ownership transferring to the intended heir. After an accident and presumed deaths, identities and names blur across the aftermath—an executive is believed dead, then wakes with amnesia, and only a brutal blow restores memory and reveals a forced wedding designed to transfer company ownership. That wedding is disrupted by a long-lost lover’s intervention and Ishani’s admission that the marriage is not voluntary, while boardroom warfare peaks with a safe-swap sabotage reveal and a decisive vote that installs Ishani as acting leader until the rightful CEO recovers. The defeated Harsh orders immediate elimination of Ishani and Prithvi, pushing the feud into open assassination attempts that Prithvi counters with a trap built on a swapped, inert weapon and a false death report. In the final collapse, Harsh is confronted by the brother he thought dead, and Ragini reappears with a recorded confession that exposes Harsh’s crimes as the brothers’ fight ends in a gunshot. The violence spills into a separate attack that leaves Ishani gravely injured, but Prithvi gets the assailant apprehended and refuses to let the family’s brutality claim her too. Relief arrives at the hospital when doctors confirm Ishani is out of danger—and pregnant—turning survival into a renewed promise that the next heir will be born into a family finally forced to face what power has cost.

husbands-regret.title: Husband's Regret
husbands-regret.description: Natasha makes a dark deal with a witch, sacrificing her own life so her husband Chirag’s broken fate can change. As Chirag becomes powerful and wealthy, he turns cold, divorces Natasha, and chooses his past love, never knowing the price she paid. Between betrayal, supernatural fate, and a mother’s silent sacrifice, this emotional tale asks: will his remorse come only after her death?

drowned-in-love.title: Drowned in Love
drowned-in-love.description: A passionate artist, Needhi, and billionaire Nishchay — once lovers separated by deceit — reunite years later when fate brings them face to face through art. Hidden truths, betrayal, and redemption unfold as they discover their lost daughter and confront their manipulative past. The story ends with forgiveness, justice, and the family finally finding peace and love again. Watch now.

the-billionaires-deal-2.title: The Billionaire's Deal
the-billionaires-deal-2.description: The Billionaire's Deal is a modern love-hate saga between Yukanika , a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant , a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Yukanika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!

kabadi-waala-billionaire.title: Unworthy Love
kabadi-waala-billionaire.description: Separated from his wealthy family after a childhood accident and raised in poverty, Navneet lives as a humble junk dealer while secretly rising to become a mysterious billionaire CEO. While hiding his elite identity to test the character of those around him, he must protect his long-lost mother and daughter from the greed and humiliation of arrogant socialites.

my-dadthe-boss.title: My Dad:The boss
my-dadthe-boss.description: A humble security guard hides a mysterious past while his son shines as a rising CEO. But when old enemies resurface, father and son must face shocking truths that test family, power, and loyalty.

maut-ka-countdown.title: Shani ka Prakop
maut-ka-countdown.description: Amit, a humble garbage collector, experiences a dramatic transformation after a car crash and divine intervention from Shani Dev, granting him supernatural abilities to perceive lifespans and object values. These new powers initially disorient him, distorting his reality, but he soon embraces them for ambition and revenge amidst public humiliation, his mother's illness, and bitter class conflict. He navigates early challenges, confronting past betrayals, protecting his mother, and violently retaliating against antagonists, all while a mysterious countdown of life and strange occurrences hint at a larger mystical threat. His path intertwines with Natasha, a powerful heiress, who initially uses him as a strategic pawn in her family's corporate power struggle, protecting his mother and orchestrating a fake engagement. However, their alliance deepens into genuine affection as Amit demonstrates integrity and mysterious healing abilities, challenging Natasha's class-conscious family. Amit publicly accuses Natasha's medical family of negligence, leading to their disownment, but his ancient "begging bowl" and the exposure of family lies by Mr. Sinha ultimately lead to Natasha's appointment as CEO. Amit then receives a luxurious bungalow from a grateful patriarch, grappling with his sudden wealth, and is drawn into a new conflict involving black magic targeting Kumar. Guided by Mr. Sinha, Amit saves Kumar, revealing a deeper, unseen enemy, and gains control of Kumar's company, fueling his dark ambition for revenge against those who wronged him. This culminates in Amit, now a powerful businessman, orchestrating a meticulous public revenge against his former partner Shikha and her groom, Vadia, by interrupting their wedding, taking over Vadia's empire, and forcing public humiliation, thus reversing their past power dynamics completely.

a-delivery-boys-jackpot.title: A Delivery Boy's Jackpot
a-delivery-boys-jackpot.description: అదృష్టం ఎప్పుడు ఎవరిని ఎలా వరిస్తుందో తెలియదు. ఆ రోజు డెలివరీ కి ఒక ఫోన్ వచ్చింది. దాంతో అతని జీవితం మారిపోయింది. కానీ చిక్కులు మొదలయ్యాయి. ఒక్కసారిగా అదృష్టం వస్తే దాన్ని ఎలా కౌగిలించుకోవాలో తెలియక అవస్థలు పడిన డెలివరీ బాయ్ కథ ఇది

the-hidden-hero-1.title: The Hidden Hero
the-hidden-hero-1.description: కిరణ్ సంజయ్ బాగా డబ్బున్న వాడు. కానీ డబ్బులో ఆనందం దొరక్క బయటకు వచ్చి ఒక కేఫ్ లో వెయిటర్ గా జాయిన్ అయ్యాడు. పనిలో ఆనందాన్ని పొందుతున్న అతని జీవితం ఎన్నో మలుపులు తిరిగింది. ఆసక్తికరమైన డ్రామా చూడండి"The Hidden Hero" కుకు టీవీలో.

billionaires-unknown-son-1.title: Billionaire's Unknown Son
billionaires-unknown-son-1.description: రోహన్ కేక్స్ అమ్ముకుంటాడు. అతనికి ఒక లవర్ ఉంది. కానీ ఆమెకు అతను కేక్స్ అమ్మడం నచ్చలేదు. మరి ఆమె చేసింది? దారిన పోయే ఒకానొక మహిళ రోహన్ కి ఎందుకు సహాయం చేసింది? చూడండి "Billionaire's unknown Son" మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

rakshak-vs-bhakshak.title: Rakshak vs Bhakshak
rakshak-vs-bhakshak.description: After a tragic accident, a little girl needs urgent medical help. But a rich and arrogant woman stops the ambulance for her car’s damage. As seconds tick away, a brave stranger risks everything to save the child.

the-hidden-king-2.title: The Hidden King
the-hidden-king-2.description: A RA&W officer, Sher Pathan, deliberately enters one of the country’s most dangerous prisons to uncover the truth behind his sister Dr. Roshini’s mysterious death. Inside, he faces a corrupt warden, ruthless inmates, and deadly secrets. Watch now fantastic thriller "The Hidden King" only on Kuku TV.

billionaire-became-beggar.title: Billionaire Became Beggar
billionaire-became-beggar.description: The microdrama unfolds with the powerful 'Sir,' secretly Chairman Dharam Khanna, disguising himself as a beggar to test character, while Anya, under family pressure to marry, hires an impoverished Dharam to pose as her wealthy boyfriend. Their contractual charade, initially for Anya to appease her mother, quickly complicates as Dharam develops genuine feelings, even as Anya remains unaware of his true identity and harbors a crush on the very corporate chairman he secretly is. The intricate web of lies begins to unravel with mysterious, lavish gifts from Kanna Industries arriving at Anya's home and to Deepa Sharma, culminating in Anya's dramatic discovery of Dharam's true identity as the powerful CEO. Despite Dharam's claims of genuine affection, Anya's family, particularly her brother Vijay and sister Anu, vehemently reject him, accusing him of being a con artist and a beggar, a past trauma Dharam endured at the hands of Dharani, who now receives gifts from his company. Dharam, having orchestrated the entire situation as a test of the family's deep-seated class prejudice, finds an unexpected ally in Anjali, who fiercely defends him and hints at his formidable power and connections to Kanna Industries. The conflict escalates dramatically when Anya's family, led by Vijay and patriarch Parikshit Mehta, brutally assaults and humiliates Dharam, attempting to force Anya into an arranged marriage and abducting her. Anya, however, defiantly declares her profound love for Dharam, challenging her father's authority and rejecting the forced engagement. Bound and captive, Dharam vows chilling retribution against Parikshit Mehta and his associates, swiftly unleashing a ruthless corporate war as Chairman Dharam Khanna. He systematically dismantles the empires of those who humiliated him and Anya, exacting his calculated vengeance. In the aftermath of his retribution, Dharam expresses deep remorse to Anya for her distress and proposes marriage, transforming their temporary arrangement into a lifelong commitment. Their union is solidified as Dharam offers Anya and her family protection and a new life of luxury, valuing her intrinsic goodness above his vast wealth, having exposed and punished the class prejudice that threatened their love.

bhikhari-fighter.title: Bhikhari Fighter
bhikhari-fighter.description: A fearless martial arts master lives as a beggar, hiding his legendary past. When love and honor drag him back into the fighting world, enemies rise and secrets explode. Betrayal, destiny, and raw power collide as he reclaims his true identity as the Grandmaster. Watch now.

loser-son-in-law-is-a-billionaire-1.title: Loser Son-in-law is a Billionaire
loser-son-in-law-is-a-billionaire-1.description: Rahul, a powerful scion living a double life as a humble delivery boy, secretly married to industry heiress Maya, orchestrates a plan to save Tadanni Industries, revealing his hidden genius. His clandestine marriage is threatened with exposure, leading to public humiliation and scorn from Maya and her wealthy Mehra family, who dismiss him as worthless. In a dramatic turn, Rahul reveals his true identity as the long-lost third son of the powerful Dhanraj family and owner of Galaxy Group, withdrawing a massive investment from the Mehra family and declaring his intention to divorce Maya, leaving her family facing financial ruin. A rival accuses him of being a cunning imposter orchestrating their downfall as an elaborate revenge plot. Supported by astute businesswoman Divya, Rahul sheds his "useless" facade, revealing a powerful and cunning persona, and they embark on a high-stakes plan for revenge against those who defrauded them. Divya, defying her ex-fiancé Ronny's blackmail, proposes a contract marriage and a significant company stake to Rahul, forming a dangerous alliance despite knowing his deceptive past. Their controversial union sparks a high-stakes corporate battle, with Divya fighting Ronny's sabotage and seeking investment from the enigmatic Lord Dhanraj, while Prateek believes Rahul is manipulating Divya to sabotage his family's corporate empire. Rahul systematically dismantles the empires of his enemies, including Mr. Patel and Ronny, coolly dismissing threats and orchestrating rapid financial ruin. He unveils game-changing invitations, challenging the elite Kapoor for a symbolic "throne," and reveals he commands the very Chamber of Commerce Presidents respected by his accusers. Rahul's ignominious past is publicly exposed, and he faces humiliation from the Mehra family, but Divya defiantly declares him her future husband, fiercely defending him against public scorn and rivals. The true Lord Dhanraj, revealed to be Rahul himself, makes a dramatic return after six years of traditional exile, reclaiming his position as the head of the Galaxy Group. Maya, who had constantly berated Rahul as her "loser" husband, is devastated to discover he is the immensely wealthy and powerful Dhanraj Sir, her ex-husband. Lord Dhanraj confronts a heartbroken Maya about her past betrayals and superficiality. The show culminates with Lord Dhanraj preparing to marry Divya, who remains largely unaware of his full secrets and vengeful past, setting the stage for further power struggles and the full realization of his intricate revenge.

the-ultimate-return.title: The Ultimate Return
the-ultimate-return.description: The Ultimate Return is a high-octane power drama where a man written off as a loser is revealed as Leo—the unseen kingmaker controlling billion-dollar empires. As ruthless heirs, corrupt elites, and broken relationships collide, love, ambition, and revenge play out in a brutal succession battle where power bows only to truth and courage.

b6de2f4e-fa37-45dd-abe4-d55f945cfc35.title: Delete My Number, Not My Heart
b6de2f4e-fa37-45dd-abe4-d55f945cfc35.description: The microdrama unfolds within the cutthroat film industry and powerful families, centering on the intertwined fates of Akash, Varsha, and Sanjana. Sanjana, a former actress, ruthlessly leverages a shocking pregnancy diagnosis and paternity mystery involving producer Akash to secure a lead role, fueling her ambition and manipulating those around her. Simultaneously, aspiring actress Varsha battles for financial independence to support her ailing mother, navigating a fierce professional rivalry with Sanjana and a tumultuous, estranged marriage with Akash. Akash, initially bound by a transactional contract marriage with Anjali, later enters a similar, strategic arrangement with Varsha. This is driven by a family ultimatum to produce an heir and consolidate power, all while attempting to protect Varsha from his dangerous stepmother. As their contract marriage progresses, Varsha grapples with developing genuine feelings for Akash, even as he faces accusations of infidelity and emotional detachment, creating deep emotional conflict and confusion. Sanjana relentlessly pursues Akash, making public claims of pregnancy and impending marriage, further intensifying her bitter rivalry with Varsha and causing Varsha significant public humiliation. Varsha endures severe financial crises due to her mother's urgent medical needs, public shaming, and even mysterious imprisonment, finding temporary solace and support from others like Rahul. Yet, her repeated attempts to divorce Akash are continually thwarted by unforeseen family crises and his manipulative actions, trapping her in the arrangement. A powerful matriarch, Aunty, initially sacrifices herself to save Akash, but later becomes a manipulative force, coercing Sanjana into sinister plots designed to destroy Akash and Varsha's fragile marriage. The narrative escalates with violent confrontations and profound betrayals, as Varsha exposes Akash's secret relationships and ultimately demands a divorce, revealing their marriage as a mere financial contract. Sanjana, orchestrated by the manipulative Aunty, announces her own shocking pregnancy with Akash's child, attempting to force him into marriage and prevent him from inheriting family property. However, in a dramatic and unexpected turn, Varsha's own pregnancy is revealed amidst a complex family conspiracy to disinherit Akash. This revelation prompts a crucial reconciliation with his grandfather, who accepts Varsha and her unborn child. Despite their deeply fractured past and the constant machinations of their rivals, Varsha and Akash find a renewed, albeit complex and uncertain, connection, their future still inextricably entangled by ambition, family legacy, and the profound consequences of their choices. The stakes remain high as they navigate their complicated relationship and the ongoing threats to their family and future.

392af1ac-859c-4f0e-b641-57d1d98ecd9f.title: Fake Wife
392af1ac-859c-4f0e-b641-57d1d98ecd9f.description: Trapped in a loveless contract marriage, a man’s devotion is met with betrayal and humiliation. Years later, he returns as a self-made billionaire, finding true respect and love in someone new. A gripping tale of heartbreak, revenge, and redemption—where dignity triumphs over regret.

meri-billionaire-bahuriya.title: Meri Billionaire Bahuriya
meri-billionaire-bahuriya.description: A greedy mother and daughter brutally attack a pregnant woman on a highway , unaware that she is their own billionaire daughter-in-law

5a92a981-597e-4279-a4fa-602270337e79.title: The Shalini Show Season 2 - Shwetha R Prasad Jothe
5a92a981-597e-4279-a4fa-602270337e79.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರು ಕನಸು. ತಾವು ಇಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸ್ಬೇಕು, ನೇಮು-ಫೇಮು ಗಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋರು ಕೆಲವೇ ಮಂದಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ಇಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಅವರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಪಾಠ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಾಧಕರ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ‌.. The Shalini Show Season 2! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರು ಆ್ಯಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. Watch Now!!

lawaris-bani-billionaire.title: Gumnam Waris
lawaris-bani-billionaire.description: Niharika’s story centers on a family that repeatedly treats her as an outsider while trying to control the truth about its own past. She is blamed for an old fall that left Dadaji comatose, and that accusation shadows every attempt she makes to reclaim her place in the Mehta household. The family’s public image is carefully managed through celebrations, marriage plans, and demands that she hide her boarding-school history and present a false identity. Aryan appears as a protector who shields her from immediate attacks, but he also helps enforce the family’s version of events. Armaan remains another unresolved force in her life, rejecting her and complicating the romantic and family pressure around her future. As the household fractures, women and heirs clash over legitimacy, inheritance, and who truly belongs. Public confrontations turn violent, with slaps, broken glass, threats, and police intervention underscoring how unstable the family has become. Niharika is repeatedly pushed toward strategic marriage as the family’s finances and power structure collapse. At one point she agrees to marry Rajat Khanna as a sacrifice for survival, even as others warn her against it. Later, she insists on that marriage again, saying Rajat makes her feel safe, and Rajat accepts her despite widespread disapproval. Around the same time, the story widens into corporate and inheritance warfare, with Niharika revealed as an heiress tied to major ownership stakes and major deals. That power makes her a target for relatives and hidden enemies who assume she is after wealth, while she insists on defending herself and her grandfather. Dadaji’s worsening condition becomes another battleground, with family members arguing over care, medical files, and whether someone is trying to silence him before he can reveal the truth. The danger escalates into assault, kidnapping, and threats of murder, showing that the conflict is no longer only emotional or social. Mahira emerges as one of the clearest antagonists, accused of trying to kill Dadaji and later exposed as part of a plot to abduct and sell Niharika. Niharika is eventually found alive but traumatized, and the family learns that the betrayal may have been ordered by Mahira’s parent as well. In the end, Niharika rejects reconciliation on the terms offered by her biological family and chooses Rajat and his family as her true kin. The closing note is that rejection and bloodline do not define her worth, even though the threats around her remain unresolved.

love-me-if-you-dare-3.title: Love Me If You Dare
love-me-if-you-dare-3.description: Naomi's journey begins with a defiant act against injustice, leading to systemic exploitation and humiliation in her workplace under her ruthless boss, Lavina. Desperate to fund her sister's education, she endures this until her hidden past as 'Violet Charan' is revealed through formidable combat skills. After quitting, she faces financial ruin, Lavina's vengeful threats, and the violent advances of an obsessive suitor, Darshith. Her life becomes entangled with enigmatic employer Abhinav, whom she initially offends, leading to her termination and a deeper, misunderstood connection. Despite being an MBA graduate, Naomi struggles professionally, facing deception from Abhinav and sabotage from a jealous colleague, Neeta, even after becoming Abhinav's personal assistant. Abhinav, an influential CEO, finds himself increasingly drawn to Naomi, publicly declaring his profound love to defy workplace gossip, which Naomi accepts under an unspecified condition. Their burgeoning romance is immediately complicated by a fierce rival, Drishya, and a possessive vow, as their ambitious AI project faces crisis before Naomi's pivotal role leads to its triumph. However, their bliss is shattered when Abhinav vanishes after a cryptic phone call, hinting at a dangerous secret past. Drishya actively tries to separate them, revealing Abhinav's past as a "rich man's toy" collector and introducing doubt about his loyalty. Simultaneously, Naomi is stalked by her violent ex-lover, Dakshith, and becomes the target of a cryptic corporate sabotage plot linked to her family. A mysterious parcel reveals Abhinav's scorned ex-lover, Lilly, and a child he denies, while another rival, Anita, targets Navami in a corporate conspiracy. Abhinav's fierce devotion leads him to orchestrate a violent attack to protect Navami, even as he plans to propose and leave the country. Their future is jeopardized by escalating threats from Dhrishya, who blames Abhinav for abandoning her and their child, and accusations of murder linked to Abhinav's dark past. A mysterious figure, Navi, emerges seeking revenge for a child's death, orchestrating a sinister plot, while Priya, consumed by grief for her lost child, blames Abhinav and targets Navami for retribution. The couple's harrowing journey culminates in their capture by Lilly, who, driven by the tragic death of her daughter Rosy, seeks deadly vengeance against Abhinav, threatening both their lives amidst a web of betrayal and hidden truths.

boss-ishqq-aur-deal.title: Boss Ishqq aur Deal
boss-ishqq-aur-deal.description: A divorced single mother, Isha, lies to become the PA of billionaire Karan Ahuja to save her daughter’s custody. What begins as hatred, ego clashes, and a reckless bet slowly turns into love. But conspiracies, betrayals, and deadly attacks threaten to destroy everything. Watch now.

c87132c0-7d6b-4eb8-af73-2d08e77106c1.title: Aa Nimisham
c87132c0-7d6b-4eb8-af73-2d08e77106c1.description: The microdrama begins with wealthy scion Rahul Nambiyar suffering amnesia after a fiery car crash and attempted murder, only to be rescued by Susila and her daughter Karthika. A burgeoning connection forms between Rahul and Karthika, complicating his existing relationship with fiancée Anu. Rahul's terminally ill father, Chairman Nambiyar, names Rahul his successor and, out of gratitude, shockingly arranges Rahul's marriage to Karthika, sparking fierce family opposition and exposing deep class divides. Despite Karthika's defiant rejection and Anu's heartbreaking self-sacrifice, Rahul is compelled to enter a contract marriage with Karthika to fulfill his dying father's wish. Karthika faces immediate challenges within the Nambiyar household, navigating Anu's persistent presence and Rahul's manipulative mother, who actively works against Rahul's true love for Anu. The contract marriage is strategically used for corporate rebranding, with Karthika becoming the new face of Nambiyar Apparels, while Rahul maintains a manipulative relationship with Anu. As Karthika's career flourishes, their staged romance is shattered when she is publicly accused of multi-crore fraud and theft, leading to Rahul's violent confrontation and the apparent collapse of their fragile union. However, the situation escalates dramatically with the tragic death of Rahul's father, for which Karthika is blackmailed into a false confession and expelled. Rahul, consumed by grief, spirals into self-destruction, making him vulnerable to a hostile family takeover. The true mastermind, Anu, is soon exposed as the orchestrator of Rahul's father's murder and Karthika's framing, conspiring with Rahul's driver. Rahul, realizing Karthika's suffering, vows to clear her name, suspecting a deeper, shadowy conspiracy. He uncovers that his "brother" Ralph, aided by Anu, orchestrated the murder plot and attempted to kill Rahul for his inheritance. Karthika heroically thwarts an attempt on Rahul's life, making her a target. Ultimately, Ralph and Anu are apprehended, and Karthika's innocence is proven. The series culminates in the transformation of Rahul and Karthika's initial transactional union into a genuine, lifelong commitment, as they overcome betrayal, expose the hidden mastermind, and secure their future against those who sought to destroy them and the Nambiyar legacy. The stakes involve Rahul's life, his family's corporate empire, Karthika's reputation and safety, and the pursuit of justice against a ruthless, hidden enemy.

engineer-vs-billionaires-3.title: Engineer vs Billionaires
engineer-vs-billionaires-3.description: When a massive storm traps a ruthless billionaire and a humble engineer in a race against time, greed and conscience collide. As disaster looms over the Himalayan valley, one man’s arrogance meets another’s courage. From boardrooms to broken dams, Engineer vs Billionaires is a high-octane survival drama where nature takes revenge, power is tested, and redemption comes at the cost of pride.

the-billionaire-behind-bars.title: The Billionaire Behind Bars
the-billionaire-behind-bars.description:
Betrayed by his greedy girlfriend Nikitha, billionaire Darshan sacrifices his identity and freedom, only to return from prison years later seeking a fresh start.

When he saves fearless single mother Vijayalakshmi and her daughter, Darshan discovers the love and family he never had. But when Nikitha, his buried past, and a deadly conspiracy return, Darshan must face his enemies and expose the truth in a shocking final revelation.

the-ghost-in-plain-sight-3.title: The Ghost in Plain Sight
the-ghost-in-plain-sight-3.description: A legendary secret agent, living a deep-cover life as a mocked and "disappointing" insurance agent, is forced to abandon his status-obsessed family when a catastrophic bio-threat emerges, leaving them to unravel the devastating truth after he stages his heroic death.

dhurandhar-qaidi.title: Dhurandhar Qaidi
dhurandhar-qaidi.description: Lakshya Malhotra begins as a celebrated undercover agent and war hero, but his life is shaken when he learns of his father’s death during an award ceremony. Grief pushes him to ask for release from covert service so he can honor his father’s memory and build a new life. That vulnerability is quickly exploited by his paternal uncle Anil, who pretends to support him while trying to get him to sign away control of the Malhotra Group. At the same time, another branch of the story turns toward a prison corruption investigation, where Laksh and other insiders decide the only way to uncover the truth is to go inside the system. Laksh enters the prison disguised as an inmate, despite objections from his brother and with help from a former military colleague already inside. The prison is shown as a brutal place where guards use beatings, humiliation, deprivation, and threats to keep inmates silent. Laksh is repeatedly attacked, detained, and forced to prove who he is, while older prisoners warn that resistance can be fatal. As he digs deeper, the corruption widens beyond prison walls into medical theft, with claims that patient-care funds and medicines are being siphoned off and that staff may be complicit. Several allies risk themselves to help, including a compassionate nurse, a doctor who helps him survive, and others who try to free him or hide him from the authorities. The conflict also includes a fugitive thread, where an injured outsider is sheltered by a woman and the two form a fragile bond while planning escape. Laksh’s hidden identity is eventually exposed, and he is publicly accused, detained, and beaten, but he refuses to stay silent. He later reveals his lineage and openly challenges the officers and the system that has trapped him. A staged medical emergency and open cells trigger prison-wide chaos, suggesting the corruption reaches into the chain of command and that someone inside may be helping the escape. In the midst of this, hidden surveillance and direct confrontation begin to turn the tables on Shera Aulakh and other allies of the corrupt network. The prison scandal spills into a broader public reckoning when a gala and medical appointment are used to expose fraudulent reports and deeper deceit. Accusations against medical leadership and the revelation of an escaped convict intensify the arrests and jailbreak attempts. By the end of the batch, Laksh’s mission has shifted from private grief to open confrontation, with his fight against corruption tied to family legacy, personal redemption, and the struggle to protect the vulnerable.

the-billionaires-deal-1.title: The Billionaire's Deal
the-billionaires-deal-1.description:
A shy medical student is forced to work for a cold, ruthless billionaire to repay her father’s debt.
Their constant clashes ignite an intense love-hate attraction.
But when power turns personal, love may heal him—or destroy her.

billion-dollar-brother-2.title: Billion Dollar Brother
billion-dollar-brother-2.description: Aditya Parameshwaran (Aadi), a powerful CEO, returns to his native village after a long absence, driven by a solemn promise to rescue his sister, Aarti, from a forced marriage and reclaim his family's usurped home. His journey is immediately met with danger and confrontations with local thugs and crime lords, revealing a deep web of corruption and his painful past of being sold into labor by treacherous relatives. Aditya dramatically halts Aarti's forced wedding to the sinister Mahesh, asserting his authority and challenging the control of corrupt figures like Goshal and Bhavan. He unleashes devastating economic revenge on the complicit town and its strongmen, including Mahesh and Jaipal, by withdrawing all corporate funding, even facing financial ruin himself. Aditya then asserts his claim to the AP Group chairmanship, exposing the town elders' past cruelty and confronting corporate fraud orchestrated by Jaipal and Mr. Ghoshal. The narrative expands as Aadi discovers his true love, Madhuri, is also being forced into marriage by her powerful, class-conscious father, Archideva, later identified as Rana. Aadi crashes Madhuri's wedding, declaring her his secret wife, but faces fierce opposition and class prejudice from Rana, who dismisses him as a 'vagabond' and the son of a former laborer. A shocking revelation confirms Aadi's true identity as a legitimate rival CEO, leading Rana to order his death. During a brutal assault, Rana chillingly admits to murdering Aadi's father, igniting Aadi's burning quest for revenge. Madhuri bravely defies her patriarch father to protect Aadi, publicly rejecting her forced marriage and revealing her childhood commitment to Aadhi. A deeper mystery unfolds as Madhuri confronts Rana Pratap, accusing him of murder, only for him to reveal she is not his biological daughter, intensifying her suspicion that he stole her. The show culminates in a final confrontation where SIR (implied to be Aadi), accompanied by Madhuri, defeats the VILLAIN (implied to be Rana Pratap), after Anjali live-streams Rana Pratap's criminal acts, turning his subordinates against him. This high-stakes battle weaves together themes of freedom, family loyalty, justice against a corrupt system, and forbidden love, all intertwined with corporate warfare and a profound quest for identity and retribution.

the-broken-billionaire.title: The Broken Billionaire
the-broken-billionaire.description: The Broken Billionaire " is a high-stakes microdrama that follows the emotional and professional transformation of Gyan, an AI prodigy who sacrifices a lucrative career to serve as a secretary for Neeta, his long-time unrequited love. For four years, Gyan manages Neeta’s life and company, "Near Solutions," while secretly living in her mansion under a pact: if her true love never returns, she might accept him

ceos-lost-bride-1.title: Bride on the run
ceos-lost-bride-1.description: రెస్టారెంట్ లో వెయిట్రెస్ గా పనిచేసే 20ఏళ్ళ అమ్మాయి అనామిక, పెళ్ళి లోంచి పారిపోతుంది. ఆమెను మోసం చేయాలని తన బాబయ్ పిన్ని ఎందుకు అనుకున్నారు. అనామిక, జై పెళ్ళి చేసుకున్నారా? చూడండి "Bride on the run" కుకు టీవీలో.

rocketwala-billionaire.title: Rocketwala Billionaire
rocketwala-billionaire.description: The series begins with Ashok, a rocket engine designer, facing a personal crisis as his girlfriend, Kiara, needs expensive treatment for terminal lung cancer. A grave misunderstanding leads Kiara to believe Ashok is dying, prompting her to prioritize her money over his life, a betrayal that fuels Ashok's ambition and patriotism. This conflict escalates into a corporate battle when Kiara publicly accuses Ashok of fraud, leading Ashok to orchestrate a hostile takeover of her company, revealing her actual illness. Simultaneously, Simmy, a principled scholarship student, faces class snobbery and academic rivalry from the entitled Sam and his wealthy, manipulative father, Raman Rayzada. Raman attempts to buy an award for Sam and humiliate Simmy, but Simmy's father intervenes. The rivalry between the Raizada family and Ashok Prajapati, now revealed as a corporate titan, intensifies, marked by high-stakes battles for prestige and power, often centered around awards and corporate control. A complex web of hidden identities and betrayals emerges, particularly involving Shalaka, Raman's wife and CEO of Tiranga Industries, whose true motives and relationship with Ashok are shrouded in mystery. Simmy, a brilliant inventor, finds her "hyper-speed engine project" sabotaged by Raman and Sam, leading to accusations of plagiarism and fraud against her. Simmy claims maternity to Shalaka, but Shalaka publicly disowns her, fiercely protecting Sam and the family reputation. Shalaka's meticulously crafted double life as Ashok's wife and Raman's lover shatters when Ashok exposes her deceit and financial exploitation. Simmi becomes embroiled in an academic fraud scandal, orchestrated by her own brother and others, threatening her career. Shalaka, seeking vengeance, orchestrates a corporate takeover of Ashok's empire, publicly exposing his infidelity and corporate charade, while also being exposed for her own financial crimes and betrayal with Raman. Ashok meticulously plans his revenge, exposing Shalaka's extensive financial crimes, leading to her downfall and impending incarceration. He initiates divorce proceedings, revealing Shalaka as an imposter who married him for wealth 20 years ago, a truth complicated by conflicting accounts of who truly saved Ashok's life. Shalaka is ultimately disowned by her mother, abandoned by Raman, and left ruined, facing the devastating consequences of her deceitful life. In the end, Shalaka's world collapses as Raman abandons her and their son, while Ashok finds a glimmer of hope for a second chance with his long-time admirer, Vijay, who offers to be a mother figure to his daughter.

invisible-jassi.title: Invisible Jassi
invisible-jassi.description: Jassi is a sweet, innocent, yet highly intelligent girl who longs for genuine friendships. However, she's constantly ignored and humiliated by those around her simply because she doesn't fit society's conventional standards of beauty. With braces on her teeth, a unique sense of style, and an unconventional haircut, Jassi is often judged by her appearance rather than her character.

fat-to-fit.title: Mistaken Fatman
fat-to-fit.description: Akhilan, a powerful corporate figure, finds his life unraveling amidst a high-stakes business deal and a brutal double life. He is swiftly betrayed by multiple parties, including a calculating father and son duo aiming for his company, and his childhood friend Rakshitha, who exploits his unconfessed love and past traumas to seize his fortune. His vulnerability, exacerbated by alcoholism, is further exploited by his household staff. The betrayals culminate in Rakshitha manipulating a grieving Akhilan into signing away his entire company, leading to a hostile takeover and his public humiliation at a planned event. Stripped of his corporate title and publicly disgraced, Akhilan faces relentless body-shaming and defiance from a new rival, Ishwar, at a public ceremony, igniting a fierce and brutal rivalry. He endures repeated physical and verbal assaults, including humiliating weightlifting challenges and street fights, pushing him to profound self-loathing and isolation. Coerced into impossible challenges by a ruthless "Madam" and facing a deep personal crisis, Akhilan defiantly vows revenge, setting a three-month deadline for a high-stakes tournament to reclaim his honor. His journey towards redemption is fraught with intense physical and mental training, despite public ridicule and the desperate pleas of concerned allies. However, a manipulative Rakshitha attempts to sabotage his trust in Dhanya, a caring woman, by exposing a past financial transaction. Simultaneously, a cunning usurper, also named Akilan, who is implicated in his father's death, plots Akhilan's elimination and commissions a paid operative, Ishwar, and an unseen woman to ensure his defeat. Akhilan is publicly disqualified from a competition due to false accusations of steroid use, likely orchestrated by his corporate rival, but is later vindicated and challenges his accusers. The conflict escalates into brutal physical combat as Akhilan battles not only for his title but also for his life against a well-funded conspiracy. He uncovers a deeper family betrayal, revealing that his uncle, Thanikachalam, murdered his father for power and now targets him. Akhilan's relentless pursuit of justice and his fight to reclaim his corporate legacy, his honor, and his very existence define his arduous path. He must overcome a web of corporate fraud, personal betrayals, and deadly conspiracies to emerge victorious.

dangerous-comeback.title: Dangerous Comeback
dangerous-comeback.description: A brutal family throws Aditya out, crushing his dreams and torturing his mother. Years later, Aditya rises from nothing to become a powerful CEO. He returns to reclaim his family’s dignity and confront his past. Watch now.

my-billionaire-ex-wifes-affair.title: Empire of Betrayal
my-billionaire-ex-wifes-affair.description: The show follows Alisha, a woman first seen enduring humiliation in her marital home even as she quietly drives major business decisions behind the scenes. What appears to be a powerless domestic life is gradually overturned by the revelation that she is in fact Alisha Raichand, sole heir to a powerful industrial empire, and that Vicky’s rise has depended heavily on her investments and strategy. Despite warnings from her protective brother Siddharth and signs of buried family conflict, Alisha remains loyal to Vicky and even secures a major collaboration for him. That devotion is repaid with betrayal when Vicky engineers compromising evidence, pushes divorce papers on her, and joins his mother in publicly insulting and expelling her. From that point, the series shifts into a revenge-and-restoration arc in which Alisha vows to expose Vicky, reclaim her standing, and redirect power away from those who used her. Her return to elite social and corporate spaces becomes a recurring spectacle: each attempt to shame her is met by sudden revelations of status, ownership, or backing from powerful allies. Siddharth repeatedly shields her in public, while Rishi emerges as another crucial figure, tied to the same hostile family structure yet positioned as both outsider and protector. Rishi’s own history is marked by exclusion, hidden lineage, and class prejudice, making his bond with Alisha part romance and part rebellion against family control. Around them, elders, rivals, and social climbers turn parties, business events, and selection ceremonies into tests of dignity, loyalty, and authenticity. Several conflicts hinge on staged traps, false accusations, disputed identities, and public humiliations designed to force submission or expose motives. Again and again, hidden truth reverses the balance: fabricated infidelity plots are exposed, false narratives about poverty or status are overturned, and those who mocked Alisha or Rishi are forced to confront their real influence. Corporate stakes rise alongside emotional ones, with threats of audits, frozen investments, blacklists, and the possibility that Alisha herself will decide the fate of former tormentors. The story also emphasizes that Alisha was not merely wealthy by birth but a genuine architect of business success, a fact others belatedly recognize when seeking forgiveness or advantage. Meanwhile, family elders try to tie romance to inheritance, reputation, and control, making Alisha’s future partner a matter of power as much as love. Vicky and Shiny’s efforts to destroy her reputation ultimately backfire as their schemes are exposed and Vicky’s downfall is set in motion. By the later arc, Alisha is no longer fighting simply to be believed; she is choosing who deserves access to her trust, her name, and her power. Rishi’s progression from embattled family outsider to openly devoted partner culminates in his rejection of his old family identity and a direct proposal to Alisha. The show resolves its central emotional movement by pairing Alisha’s regained authority with a love that presents itself as chosen rather than imposed, while leaving the broader family and corporate wounds as the hard-won cost of that transformation.

death-countdown-1.title: Death Countdown
death-countdown-1.description:
What if you could see the exact moment someone will die?
Uday, an ordinary man, has a terrifying gift, he can see a death countdown of people. When he warns strangers about their fate, no one believes him… until a shocking plane crash proves him right.Now, caught between destiny and his desperate attempts to save her lover, Uday finds himself battling time, love, betrayal, and a deadly conspiracy. The clock is ticking. Will he save them… or lose everything? Watch now!

the-hidden-king-1.title: The Hidden King
the-hidden-king-1.description: RA&W officer Sher Pathan aka Akash enters a deadly prison to uncover the truth behind his sister Dr. Roshini’s death. Disguised as inmate Akash, he faces a corrupt prison warden and feared criminal Shankra. With help from doctor Kavya and inmate Riya, Sher uncovers a dark conspiracy. But inside these walls, trust is dangerous and justice is buried.

billionaire-doctor-ka-ishq.title: Billionaire Doctor Ka Ishq
billionaire-doctor-ka-ishq.description: Manisha’s life is shattered when she discovers she is pregnant after being drugged and spending a night with a stranger. As fear and confusion give way to shocking truth, she learns the man involved is a powerful billionaire. Caught between trauma, secrecy, and social judgment, Manisha must navigate a world that questions her character while she struggles to reclaim control over her body, dignity, and future.

toofani-bodyguard.title: Toofani Bodyguard
toofani-bodyguard.description: A mysterious Kalaripayattu warrior, Krishna with a forgotten past becomes the shield of a brilliant pharma CEO, Rutvi who discovers a cancer cure - only to discover that their destinies, love, and a decades-old vendetta were bound long before fate reunited them. Watch now!

battle-of-the-babes-1.title: Battle of the Babes
battle-of-the-babes-1.description: The microdrama centers on Princess Aradhya, the true heiress, who enrolls in college and immediately faces classist bullying after her royal identity is revealed. Simultaneously, Anjali, an ambitious pretender, fabricates her identity as the daughter of industrialist Raja Narendra Varma, striving to solidify her social status. Aradhya, initially concealing her true lineage, begins to challenge Anjali's elaborate deception, leading to escalating rivalries and direct confrontations. Anjali ruthlessly pressures her maid mother to betray her benefactor to maintain her facade, while a male student publicly questions Anjali's claims. As the conflict intensifies, Anjali orchestrates humiliating pranks against Aradhya, but her own fabricated identity as a wealthy heiress begins to crumble, revealing her maid as her true mother. A mysterious man and Arjun emerge, actively questioning and exposing Anjali's lies, further unraveling her aristocratic pretense. Aradhya consistently exposes Anjali's deceptions, from cheating in exams to faking her social status, proving her innocence and turning the tables. Amidst this, a burgeoning romance develops between Aradhya and the charismatic Arjun, though it is complicated by rivals and Aradhya's strict family rules. Aradhya boldly asserts her true lineage, confirming Anjali's claims are false, and plans to publicly expose her rival. The rivalry culminates in dramatic public confrontations where Aradhya, with the assistance of Arjun and a Principal, systematically exposes Anjali's fraud. Anjali's own father publicly disowns her, unequivocally affirming Aradhya as his sole and true heir. Subsequently, an Inspector exposes Anjali for fraud and the theft of a priceless family heirloom, leading to her arrest. Aradhya, having endured public humiliation and accusations, experiences a triumphant vindication. Her journey culminates in her unexpected crowning as "College Queen," an event meticulously orchestrated by a mysterious man seeking revenge against Anjali. This dramatic shift in power ignites a bitter new rivalry, with Anjali vowing retribution against Aradhya and her enigmatic supporter, leaving the future of their conflict uncertain.

my-crazy-ex-girlfriend.title: My Crazy Ex-Girlfriend
my-crazy-ex-girlfriend.description: Hardik Goyal’s perfect life collapses when he loses his company, reputation, and fiancée overnight. Betrayed and broken, fate pulls him into the shadowy world of the mafia, where power replaces principles. As danger escalates, Hardik reconnects with Niharika, his childhood savior, discovering love, strength, and destiny. Choosing the mafia becomes his only way to protect love, family, and his future.

when-soulmates-meet-again.title: When Soulmates meet again
when-soulmates-meet-again.description: తొలిప్రేమను ఎవ్వరూ మర్చిపోలేరు. ఎన్ని సంవత్సరాలైన గుర్తుంటుంది. కానీ మర్చిపోవాలనుకున్నాడు ఆరవ్. అది అతని వల్ల అయ్యిందా..? తొలిప్రేమను మర్చిపోవాలి అనుకునే ప్రాసెస్ లో అతనేం చేసాడు? చూడండి "When Soulmates meet again" మీ కుకు టీవీలో

engineer-vs-billionaires-2.title: Engineer vs Billionaires
engineer-vs-billionaires-2.description: The series begins with visionary entrepreneur Vijay's ambitious "Project Ved," aiming to commercialize a sacred temple, despite dire warnings from a Local Priest about divine wrath and "total destruction." Vijay dedicates this project to his unborn child, setting a personal stake from the outset. This hubris seemingly triggers a catastrophic cloudburst, leading to widespread chaos, ground instability, and the critical failure of a dam's control system, threatening an entire town. A senior engineer, Kiran, receives urgent warnings that the dam is at risk of bursting within hours. Amidst the escalating natural disaster, various individuals embark on perilous journeys: Kiran races against time to reach the compromised dam site, while heavily pregnant women and two sisters undertake spiritual pilgrimages through treacherous, high-altitude conditions, driven by faith and vows. High-profile individuals, including Vijay, become stranded at a secluded resort with no communication. Efforts to mitigate the disaster are severely hampered by bureaucratic hurdles and the callous indifference of powerful figures like tycoon Panjaa and the industrialist Vijay himself, who prioritize personal gain and resort to humiliation and sabotage against those seeking help, highlighting stark class divides. Kiran is cruelly humiliated while seeking a helicopter, and Ajay's pleas are met with demeaning tasks. Pregnant women, including Vijay's wife Vedhika, face life-threatening crises and isolated, traditional deliveries amidst the severe storm and communication failures, adding a deeply personal layer to the unfolding societal drama. One heavily pregnant woman collapses in labor on a mountain, discovered by a compassionate stranger. Vijay's character is multifaceted; he is seen celebrating Vedhika's pregnancy, yet also exacting vengeful cruelty upon a desperate man from his past, Hari, forcing demeaning acts and physical assault. There are hints that the dam crisis might be a calculated "performance" orchestrated by a manipulator, and a "vengeful Vijay (Antagonist)" obstructs Kiran due to a past tragedy, suggesting deep-seated, unresolved conflicts. As the dam collapse looms, Kiran Kaushal takes dangerous, explosive actions to secure transport and save lives. In a parallel thread, a newborn experiences critical breathing difficulties, potentially linked to an unfulfilled commitment and a dire warning, but miraculously begins to breathe, offering a glimmer of hope. A remorseful officer, inspired by Kiran's selfless heroism and wisdom, seeks forgiveness and vows to cease future construction projects, protecting the community's traditional way of life. The narrative culminates in a dramatic confrontation where Vijay is tortured by CEO Abhiram, but then reveals that his and Vedika's child, previously declared dead by Vedika to Abhiram, is alive and in his custody. This revelation shifts power dynamics, setting up a high-stakes battle for the child's future and leaving questions of retribution, redemption, and the ultimate fate of the community open.

codename-pyaar.title: Codename Pyaar
codename-pyaar.description: Ek low-profile genius AI engineer, jise sab bewda aur muftkhor samajhte hain, asal mein India ki self-drive car ka asli hero hai—and jab system uske bina collapse karta hai, tab sach aur jhoot ka sabse khatarnaak test shuru hota hai.

thugs-of-ghaziabad.title: Thugs Of Ghaziabad
thugs-of-ghaziabad.description: The family rivalry trickles into the local politics and underbelly of Ghaziabad. This ignites a chain of gun violence,  leading to the bloodbath that decides the fate of both parties.

ceos-magical-bodyguard.title: CEO's Magical Bodyguard
ceos-magical-bodyguard.description: The show follows a volatile bond between Nimisha, a powerful heiress and later revealed business leader, and Chirag, a bodyguard whose role steadily expands into that of protector, husband, and possibly a figure of sacred lineage. Their connection begins through rescue and recognition, as Chirag saves her from danger and enters her world under Guruji’s mission to find a destined woman. From the start, however, their relationship is tangled in secrecy, disputed identity, and competing claims from other men who seek to possess, expose, or replace him. Nimisha is repeatedly pushed toward coercive marriages and humiliating arrangements by family members and suitors such as Suraj, yet she keeps resisting attempts to strip her of autonomy. Chirag, meanwhile, insists on protecting her and at times claims her publicly as his wife, which triggers backlash from elders, rivals, and powerful families who accuse him of being an impostor. Questions over his ancestry, spiritual status, and legitimacy become inseparable from the marriage conflict, turning romance into a struggle over inheritance, status, and control. As the story widens, multiple elite houses, corporate factions, and criminal groups collide, with Nimisha and Chirag caught at the center of both domestic and larger power wars. Nimisha increasingly emerges not just as a pressured daughter or wife but as a formidable authority figure who confronts magnates, freezes rival assets, forces contracts, and eventually reveals herself as the hidden leader of major family and business interests. At the same time, Chirag is drawn into parallel crises involving Twinkle, Shivani, Shefali, and other endangered figures, reinforcing his role as a sought-after protector in a world where kidnappings, ambushes, and forced signatures are common tools of power. Violent enemies such as Sameer, Veer Rana, and other gang-linked rivals escalate the stakes from family coercion to open warfare, ransom, captivity, and revenge. Chirag’s abilities also appear to exceed ordinary combat, culminating in a mystical transformation when he saves Nimisha from a gang attack and confirming that his hidden nature is central to the balance of power. Even after marriage claims are made, the union remains unstable, strained by injuries, suspicion, family interference, and Nimisha’s own conflicting loyalties, including her attachment to Amit and later the reappearance of a bodyguard figure revealed as Amit. The show repeatedly returns to women resisting control: Nimisha rejects imposed husbands and humiliations, Shefali refuses inheritance and arranged marriage, Shivani pushes toward dangerous leadership, and captives under criminal threat refuse submission. Around them, patriarchs, matriarchs, and corporate heads try to weaponize marriage, lineage, and wealth to secure dynasties or crush rivals. Hidden identities drive nearly every major turn, from Chirag’s disputed heritage and spiritual mission to Nimisha’s concealed authority and the exposure of others living under false status. By the later arc, the conflict has expanded beyond one romance into a layered battle over who truly holds power across families, companies, and armed factions. Nimisha’s rise as an elusive matriarch and Chirag’s emergence as a supernatural defender suggest a partnership of immense consequence, but the story keeps that alliance unstable by surrounding it with betrayal, revenge, and unresolved romantic claims. The central stakes become not only whether Nimisha and Chirag can remain together, but whether either of them can preserve autonomy and legitimacy in a world determined to use love, marriage, and bloodline as instruments of domination.

the-drunken-fighter.title: The Drunken Fighter
the-drunken-fighter.description: The Drunken Fighter is a martial arts action-drama about hidden power, redemption, and destiny. Bablu, a ridiculed drunkard handyman at a legendary Kung Fu academy, secretly possesses the strength of the mythical “Iron Head.” As enemies challenge the academy and imposters claim his glory, Bablu must decide whether to keep hiding in the shadows—or rise as the true legend who can save them all.

my-dad-the-boss.title: My Dad : The Boss
my-dad-the-boss.description: A humble security guard hides a mysterious past while his son shines as a rising CEO. But when old enemies resurface, father and son must face shocking truths that test family, power, and loyalty.

born-to-rise.title: Born To Rise
born-to-rise.description: Jia, a hardworking Hindi-medium village girl, prepares for her engineering entrance to change her father Jeevan’s life. But her uncle Ravi, aunt Meena and cousin Sidhu humiliate her, steal her savings, and label her a cheater and immoral girl. The village sarpanch punishes her father with 30 lashes. Jia refuses to break and bets her fate on the exam result—ready to make them pay when truth explodes.

the-billionaires-deal.title: The Billionaire's Deal
the-billionaires-deal.description: The Billionaire's Deal is a modern love-hate saga between Kruthika, a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant Shetty, a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Kruthika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!

andha-cricketer.title: Andha Cricketer
andha-cricketer.description: This microdrama follows Victor Sethi, a star cricketer who is brutally blinded by his rival, Dushyant, only to resurface years later as a humble, blind sweeper named Vaibhav. When a struggling academy owned by Riya faces a hostile takeover, Victor is forced to reveal his superhuman "sound-based" batting skills to save her legacy. Amidst intense match-fixing and physical threats, he overcomes a rigged final match using a wooden staff to defeat Dushyant once and for all.

bodyguard-ceo-1.title: Bodyguard CEO
