bodyguard-ceo-1.description: A lonely billionaire hides his true identity and becomes a bodyguard to find real love. When the truth starts to come out, he must decide if love is worth risking everything.

papa-billionaire.title: Billionaire Papa
papa-billionaire.description:
The heart-touching story of Anika, a 9-year-old orphan with dreams bigger than her circumstances. Determined to complete her education, she searches for support—but the world turns its back on her.
One fateful day, Anika crosses paths with a wealthy man when she suddenly appears in front of his car. Moved by her struggles, he becomes her benefactor and helps her continue her studies. Wanting to give her a permanent home, he asks his younger brother to adopt her. Will Anika’s faith be rewarded?

my-mothers-lover.title: My Mother's Lover
my-mothers-lover.description: A rising superstar is forced to officiate her own mother’s wedding only to discover the groom is the powerful man who once tried to control her career and her life. Trapped in a billionaire’s mansion as his new stepdaughter, Shreya must protect her mother from a charming predator who wants them both, and will destroy everything to keep them.

bodyguard-ceo.title: Bodyguard CEO
bodyguard-ceo.description: The series begins with CEO Daksh's public humiliation and betrayal by his fiancée Meera and rival Arnav, leading him to renounce love and embark on a quest for genuine connection. To achieve this, Daksh, now CEO of Rajvansh Industries, goes undercover as a bodyguard, tasking his loyal aide, Harsh, to impersonate him in corporate dealings. Amidst this deception, Daksh's interest is piqued by designer Shravani, later identified as the compassionate and talented intern Tanvi. Simultaneously, the ambitious executive Kiara meticulously plans to manipulate the "CEO" (Harsh, the impersonator) for wealth and power, initiating a psychological battle under a facade of love. Kiara ruthlessly dismisses, plagiarizes, and claims credit for Tanvi's innovative designs, leading to Tanvi's public humiliation and temporary termination. As corporate power struggles intensify, Daksh (under various aliases like Mr. Rajvansh and Ansh) initially considers marrying Kiara, while his loyal bodyguard Harsh secretly tests her motives. However, Kiara's manipulative schemes, including orchestrating her own scandal and blackmailing rivals, are gradually exposed by observant colleagues like Rishi and Keera Ma'am. The company faces a fabricated bankruptcy crisis, a strategic move by Daksh to uncover internal corruption and expose the betrayals of Arnav and Kiara, who stole company secrets. Kiara is publicly confronted for intellectual property theft and her deceitful actions. The climax reveals Daksh's true identity as the powerful heir to Rajvansh Industries. Tanvi, who had developed a close bond with her trusted friend and bodyguard Harsh, discovers he is actually Vikrant (Daksh), the powerful CEO who meticulously concealed his identity. Despite her profound heartbreak and sense of betrayal, Vikrant (Daksh/Harsh) passionately confesses his deception, apologizes, and declares his genuine love for Tanvi. The series culminates in Vikrant publicly crediting Tanvi for his success and proposing marriage, acknowledging her as the indispensable "brain" and "beauty of his life."

all-i-want-istum.title: All I want is…Tum
all-i-want-istum.description: A childhood act of bravery connects Krish and Sana, but fate separates them. Years later, a forced contract marriage, misunderstandings, and conspiracies pull them back together. Through betrayal, danger, and emotional turmoil, Krish realizes Saniya is the girl he has been searching for all along—and love finally triumphs over every contract and condition.

billionaire-papa.title: Billionaire Papa
billionaire-papa.description:
A rich businessman agrees to pretend to be a poor girl’s father for just three days.
What begins as an act slowly turns into something real.
But fate has a secret that could change both their lives forever.

awaaz-ka-billionaire.title: Awaaz ka Billionaire
awaaz-ka-billionaire.description: When a superstar’s fame is built on a stolen voice, a betrayed background singer survives murder and is forced to live under a false identity—only to return as a dangerous man determined to reclaim his voice, his love, and his true self.

the-ghost-in-plain-sight-2.title: The Ghost In Plain Sight
the-ghost-in-plain-sight-2.description: A legendary secret agent, living a deep-cover life as a mocked and "disappointing" insurance agent, is forced to abandon his status-obsessed family when a catastrophic bio-threat emerges, leaving them to unravel the devastating truth after he stages his heroic death.

the-billionaire-i-call-dad-1.title: The Billionaire I Call Dad
the-billionaire-i-call-dad-1.description:
The heart-touching story of Anika, a 9-year-old orphan with dreams bigger than her circumstances. Determined to complete her education, she searches for support—but the world turns its back on her.
One fateful day, Anika crosses paths with a wealthy man when she suddenly appears in front of his car. Moved by her struggles, he becomes her benefactor and helps her continue her studies. Wanting to give her a permanent home, he asks his younger brother to adopt her. Will Anika’s faith be rewarded?

final-mulaqaat.title: Final Mulaqaat
final-mulaqaat.description: On a desperate night outside a hospital, Hemant struggles to save his pregnant wife, Gargi, who is gasping for breath. Refused treatment and trapped by circumstances beyond their control, the couple faces an impossible situation as danger closes in around them. With time running out and no help in sight, Gargi is forced to confront a devastating truth, some choices demand a price greater than life itself.

talking-to-strangers.title: Talking To Strangers
talking-to-strangers.description: ಮಾಲ್‌ಕಮ್ ಗ್ಲಾಡ್ವೆಲ್ ಅವರ Talking to Strangers ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಅಜ್ಞಾತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಅಪಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ನಮ್ಮ ತೀರ್ಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡುವ ದೋಷಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುವ ಒಂದು ಆಳವಾದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಮನೋವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಪ್ರಚೋದನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಳವಾಗಿ ತೆರೆದಿಡುವ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಮ್ಮ ನಂಬಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸಲು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

nala-charitham.title: Nala Charitham
nala-charitham.description: நளன் தமயந்தி கதையைப் பேசும் செய்யுள் நூல்கள் தமிழில் இரண்டு உண்டு.ஒன்று அதிவீரராம பாண்டியன் எழுதிய நைடதம். இன்னொன்று புகழேந்திப் புலவரின் நளவெண்பா. திருப்பூர் கிருஷ்ணன் எழுதிய நளசரிதம் அதே கதையை உரைநடையில் இன்னும் விரிவாகப் பேசுகிறது. திடுக்கிட வைக்கும் திருப்பங்களோடு வளரும் இந்த நெஞ்சை உருக்கும் காதல் கதைக்கு இலக்கியச் சிறப்போடு ஆன்மிகச் சிறப்பும் உண்டு. நள சரிதம் கேட்பவர்கள் ஏழரை நாட்டுச் சனியின் பாதிப்பிலிருந்து விடுபடுவார்கள் என்பது தொன்று தொட்டு வரும் நம்பிக்கை.

punarjanm-kaliyug-mein-mahabharat.title: Punarjanm : Kaliyug Mein Mahabharat
punarjanm-kaliyug-mein-mahabharat.description: Ek taraf hai Army officer, jise sapano mein dikhta hai Kurukshetra, doosri taraf hai ek rebel jiske andar Karn ka gussa jaag chuka hai. "Punarjanm" ek aisi kahani hai jahan purane yug ke warrior, Kaliyug ke mein apna karm yaad karne lage hain. Kya is baar bhi Arjun aur Karn takraayenge ya  fir banenge ek dusre ke dost? Suniye poori kahani aur janiye sach.

the-cyanide-mohan-case.title: The Cyanide Mohan Case
the-cyanide-mohan-case.description: ‘ಸೈನೆಡ್ ಮೋಹನ್’ ಈ ಹೆಸರು ಕೇಳ್ತಿದ್ಹಾಗೇ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳು ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷಣ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳ್ತಾರೆ! ಪ್ರೇಮದ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೃತ್ಯುಕೂಪಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ತಿದ್ದ ಮೋಹನ್ ಯಾರು.? ಈ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಾರಣವೇನು.? ಕೇಳಿ ‘ದಿ ಸೈನೆಡ್ ಮೋಹನ್ ಕೇಸ್’ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.

apne-ya-paraaye.title: Apne Ya Paraaye?
apne-ya-paraaye.description: Aakash apni gareeb Maa Sujata se nafrat karta tha to vahin Sujata ka doosra beta Vihaan aaj bhi apni Maa ki talaash me dar dar bhatak raha tha. Kya kabhi Sujata apne donon beton se mil paayegi? Kya Vihaan or Aakash ek doosre ke dushman ban jaayenge? Ya unka milna banega shehar ki nayi taakat?

pulan-visaranai.title: புலன் விசாரணை
pulan-visaranai.description: An honest female collector's transfer sparks a chain of corruption, forbidden romances and political manipulation when her husband falls for a powerful businesswoman while she grows closer to an intelligence officer.

porn-addiction-3.title: Porn addiction
porn-addiction-3.description: మీ సైబర్ శృంగార అలవాట్లను వీడటం ఎలా? మీకు తెలియకుండానే ఈ అలవాటు మీ జీవితాన్ని, సంబంధాలను, భవిష్యత్తును ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుందో ఆలోచించారా? మానసిక సంక్షేమానికి, వ్యక్తిగత అభివృద్ధికి ఆత్మవిశ్లేషణ మొదలుపెట్టండి. మీరు ఈ అలవాట్ల నుండి బయటపడటానికి మార్గం కనుగొనాలనుకుంటే, మా ప్రత్యేక ప్రదర్శనను వినండి. మానసికంగా, భావోద్వేగంగా, జీవితాన్ని తిరిగి సాధించుకోడానికి అవసరమైన సూచనలు మీకు అందిస్తాము. మీ జీవితం విలువైనది! ఇప్పుడే వినండి!

murdon-ki-basti.title: Murdon Ki Basti
murdon-ki-basti.description: Doctor Yash ek practical aadmi hai, jo bhuton aur ruhon mein vishwas nahi karta. Lekin ek raat, uske clinic mein kuch aisa hota hai jo uski poori duniya hila deta hai. Changu-Mangu — do ajeeb bhai Yaash ke pass aa kar kehte hai ki koi “Ruh” unhe control kar rahi hai. Aur phir shuru hoti hai ek aisi journey, jahan Dr. Yash pahuchta hai ek viraan basti mein. Ek aisi basti jahan pedon se dulhanein latki hoti hain, aur har hawaa ke jhonke ke saath sunai deti hai ek hi pukaar:“Humein mukti chahiye…”

leadership-is-an-art.title: Leadership Is An Art
leadership-is-an-art.description: ಮ್ಯಾಕ್ಸ್ ಡಿ ಪ್ರೀ ಅವರ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಮುಖಂಡತ್ವದ ನಕಲಿ ತತ್ವಗಳಿಗಿಂತ, ನಿಜವಾದ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮನುಷ್ಯತ್ವದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಮನಕೇಂದ್ರಿತವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಯಶಸ್ವೀ ಸಂಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ತಂಡವನ್ನು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿ, ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರೀ ಮುಖಂಡತ್ವವೆಂದರೆ ಕೇವಲ ನಿಯಮ ಪಾಲನೆ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಅದು ಕಲೆಯಂತೆಯೇ ಸೃಜನಾತ್ಮಕತೆಯನ್ನು, ಪರಸ್ಪರ ನಂಬಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಕಾರವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕ ನುಡಿಗಳ ಮತ್ತು ದರ್ಶನಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಇದು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮುಖಂಡರಾಗಲು ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

the-happy-kid-handbook.title: The Happy Kid Handbook
the-happy-kid-handbook.description: The Happy Kid Handbook - ಕೇಟಿ ಹರ್ಲಿ ಅವರ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಪೋಷಕರಿಗೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಆರೈಕೆ ಮಾಡುವುದರಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸೌಖ್ಯವನ್ನು ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸಲು ಬಳಕೆಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾರ್ಗಗಳು, ನುಡಿಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಶೈಲಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪಿಸುವ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮಹತ್ವ ಕೊಡುವಂತೆ ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೂ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಗುಣಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿಹೇಳುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿ, ಪೋಷಕರಿಗೆ ಸಂತೋಷಕರ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮತೋಲನಯುತ ಪೋಷಣೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

kaha-gaye-yaduvanshi.title: Kaha Gaye Yaduvanshi?
kaha-gaye-yaduvanshi.description: Kya ek shraap poore vansh ko khatam kar sakta hai? Bhagwaan Shree Krishna Ke Yaduvansh ka vinash ek yojana thi ya niyati ki rachana? Is show mein khulenge ye sabhi chhupe raaz aur aap samjhenge ki kyon ek shraap itihas ka sabse bada paap ban gaya. Abhi Sunana shuru kijiye ye khaas audioshow "Kaha Gaye Yaduvanshi?".

mysteries-behind-guna-caves-1.title: Mysteries Behind Guna Caves
mysteries-behind-guna-caves-1.description: ಗುಣಾ ಗುಹೆಗಳು, ಮೂಲತಃ "ಡೆವಿಲ್ಸ್ ಕಿಚನ್" ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲ್ಪಡುವ ಈ ಗಹನ ಗುಹೆಗಳು, ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಕೊಡೈಕೆನಾಲ್  ಅಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಪ್ರವಾಸಿಗರನ್ನು ವರ್ಷ ತುದಿಯೂ ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುವ ಈ ಸ್ಥಳವು 1991ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ನಟ ಕಮಲ್ ಹಾಸನ್ ಅಭಿನಯದ "ಗುಣಾ" ಚಲನಚಿತ್ರದಿಂದಾಗಿ "ಗುಣಾ ಗುಹೆಗಳು" ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರು ಪಡೆದವು. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ, ಈ ಗುಹೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಮತ್ತು ರಹಸ್ಯಮಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀವು ಆಲಿಸಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಡೆವಿಲ್ಸ್ ಕಿಚನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸುತ್ತುವರೆದಿರುವ ಅದೆಷ್ಟೋ ಹೇಳದ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಈ ಸ್ಥಳದ ಅದ್ಭುತವನ್ನೂ ನೀವು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಭವಿಸಬಹುದು.

My-Dear-ಸ್ಟುಡೆಂಟ್.title: My Dear student
My-Dear-ಸ್ಟುಡೆಂಟ್.description:
ರೋಹಿತ್, ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಿನ ಪ್ರೋಫೆಸರ್, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಒತ್ತಾಯದಿಂದ ಆಮಿಯನ್ನು ಮದ್ವೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಆಮಿ ಹಾಸ್ಯಮಯ ಮತ್ತು ಉಲ್ಲಾಸದ ಹುಡುಗಿ, ರೋಹಿತ್‌ ಆಪ್ಷನ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಅವಳನ್ನ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿ ಹೊಸ ಜೀವನದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ.
ಈ ದಂಪತಿಯ ಪ್ರಯಾಣವು ಕಾಲೇಜನಲ್ಲಿ ಶುರುವಾಗಿ ಅಲ್ಲಾಗುವ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ ಅವರ ಭಾವನೆಗಳು ಒಂದು ನಾಟಕದಂತೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
ರೋಹಿತ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆಮಿ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳ್ತಾರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಅವರ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳಿಂದ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ದೂರವಾಗ್ತಾರಾ? ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ತಪ್ಪದೆ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKUFM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

ajab-gajab-shehzada.title: Ajab Gajab Shehzada
ajab-gajab-shehzada.description: Sabki nazar mein ishaan ek gareeb student tha jo college ki fees dene ke liye bhi struggle kar raha  tha. Apni girlfriend ko naya phone dilane ke liye wo college ke baad part time job karta tha. Par ek din ek galatfehmi mein log use chor samjh lete hai aur uska naam kharab ho jata hai. Uski girlfriend bhi usese breakup kar leti hai. Tuta bikhra hua Ishaan apni kismat ko kos hi raha hota hai ki use ek magical message ata hai. Use pata chalta hai wo Shekhawat parivaar ka waris hai. Aur wo ab tak ek test de raha tha taki wo apne parivaar ko prove kar paye ki wo billionaire banane ke layak hai.

Mirracle-ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್.title: Miracle Doctor
Mirracle-ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್.description: ‌ವಿಕ್ರಮ್ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ. ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಜೀವನ ಅಂತ ಬಂದ್ರೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ್ದು ಬರೀ ಸೋಲೇ! ಆದ್ರೆ  ಒಂದಿನ ಆತ ತನಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲದಂತೆ ಒಂದು ಅದ್ಭುತವಾದ ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್‌ ಶಕ್ತಿನಾ ಪಡೀತಾನೆ. ಆ ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕ್‌ ಶಕ್ತಿನಾ ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ ಅಂತಾ ಮುಂದಾಗೋ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ಗೆ ಒಂದಿಷ್ಟು ಸವಾಲುಗಳ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಅಪಾಯಗಳೂ ಎದುರಾಗ್ತವೆ. ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ಗೆ ಇದ್ದಕ್ಕಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಕಲ್‌ ಪವರ್‌ ಹೇಗ್ ಬಂತು, ಅದ್ರಿಂದ ಅವನು ಏನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "ಮಿರಾಕಲ್‌ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್"‌ ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.

narakdvaar.title: Narakdvaar
narakdvaar.description: Vanshika ke magic brush se bani tasveerein sirf banti nahi, balki zinda ho jaati hain! Jab woh apni qala se Ved ko maut ke panjon se kheench laati hai, to dono ka rishta ek ajeeb dor se bandh jaata hai. Lekin Doomsagadh sirf ek basti nahi, isme kai ajnabi raaz dafan hain, Vanshika ki galti se wahan ka shaapit kuaan khul chuka hai. Kya Vanshika sirf Ved ko wapas laayi hai ya usne  kisi mahashakti ko bhi azaad kar diya hai? Kya koi zinda bach payega Doomsagadh me?

ರಕ್ತ-ಸಿಂಧೂರ.title: Rakta Sindhoora
ರಕ್ತ-ಸಿಂಧೂರ.description: ಮನುಷ್ಯರೇ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಮನುಷ್ಯರೇ ಬರೆದ ನ್ಯಾಯಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ನೈತಿಕ ನಿಲುವುಗಳನ್ನು ಜೀವನ ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆಯೇ? ನವ ಸಮಾಜಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಂದೇಶ. ಯಂಡಮೂರಿಯವರ ಮೈನವಿರೇಳಿಸುವ ವಿಚಾರ ಪ್ರಚೋದಿತ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ.

Secret-of-4-ಯುಗ.title: The Secret of 4 Yugas
Secret-of-4-ಯುಗ.description: 4 ಯುಗಗಳ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳ ಕಥೆ ಏನಿದು? ಒಂದು ಯುಗ ಎಷ್ಟು ವರ್ಷಗಳಾಗುತ್ತದೆ? ಯುಗಗಳ ಆಟವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲಾಯಿತು ಮತ್ತು ಯಾರಿಂದ ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಯುಗಗಳನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಲಾಯಿತು? ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಯುಗಕ್ಕೂ ಅಂತ್ಯವಿದೆಯಾದರೆ, ಕಲಿಯುಗಕ್ಕೂ ಅಂತ್ಯವಿರುತ್ತದೆಯಾ? ಈ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ “ನಾಲ್ಕು ಯುಗಗಳ ರಹಸ್ಯ” ಎಂಬ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೊ ಶೋ.

timeless-dushyant.title: Timeless Dushyant
timeless-dushyant.description: Ek ordinary office worker Dushyant, jo har din apni zindagi ki chhoti-chhoti haaron se lad raha tha, ek mysterious device ke milne ke baad ek bada rahasya kholne chala hai. Uska yeh safar sirf uske bhootkal ke dukhon se nahi, balki ek naye futuristic duniya se bhi judne wala hai. Kya woh apne dadaji ke chhode hue is time machine ka sahi istemal kar sakega, ya yeh uski zindagi ka sabse bada khatra ban jayega?

బ్లాక్-రోజ్.title: బ్లాక్ రోజ్
బ్లాక్-రోజ్.description: భారతదేశంలోని కొన్ని ప్రముఖ నగరాల్లో ఒక సైకో కిల్లర్ వరుసగా హత్యలు చేస్తూ ఉన్నాడు, అతను చంపిన వారి సమాధుల పైన ఒక బ్లాక్ రోజ్ పెడుతున్నాడు. సిబిఐ లోని మెంటల్ ఆఫీసర్ అయిన అరుణ్ మీనన్ కి ఆ కేసు అప్పగించారు, ఆ తర్వాత ఆ కేసు లో అనుకోని మలుపులు మొదలు అయ్యాయి.  ఎవరు? ఎందుకు , ఏ motive కోసం చంపుతున్నాడు? సమాధి పై నల్ల గులాబీ దేనికి నిదర్శనం? తెలియాలంటే వినండి బ్లాక్ రోజ్ ఆడియో బుక్ మీ కుకు లో

വീര-യോദ്ധ-.title: വീരയോദ്ധ
വീര-യോദ്ധ-.description: ഒരു അപകടത്തിനു ശേഷം  മാനസികമായും ശാരീരികമായും ദുർബലനാകുന്ന ബദ്രി സുഹൃത്തുക്കളിൽ നിന്നും ബന്ധുക്കളിൽ നിന്നും അവഹേളനങ്ങൾ നേരിടുന്നു. എന്നാൽ ബദ്രിയുടെ  ജീവിതം പൂർണ്ണമായും മാറ്റിമറിക്കുന്ന ഒരു സംഭവം പിന്നീട് ഉണ്ടാകുന്നു. അന്ന് അവൻ അറിയുന്നു, താൻ അക്ഷയ ലോകത്തിലെ ഒരു തോറ്റ യോദ്ധാവാണെന്ന്; കൂടാതെ തന്റെ പ്രണയിനി തന്നെ വഞ്ചിച്ചുവെന്നും. ഒരുദിവസം കോളേജിൽ പുതിയ ടീച്ചറായ മൈഥിലി കണ്ടപ്പോൾ അവൻ ഞെട്ടി. മൈഥിലിയാണു അക്ഷയ ലോകത്തിലെ തന്റെ പ്രണയിനിയെന്നു അവൻ തിരിച്ചറിയുന്നു.  അറിഞ്ഞതിനു ശേഷം ബദ്രിക്ക് എന്ത് സംഭവിക്കുന്നു? തനിക്കേറ്റ വഞ്ചനയ്ക്ക് അവൻ പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യുമോ? അക്ഷയലോകത്തിലേക്ക് തിരിച്ചുപോയി തോറ്റ പോരാട്ടം ജയിക്കുമോ? കേൾക്കം ഉദ്ദ്വേഗഭരിതമായ കഥ..

bharat-vs-france-itihaas-jo-kitabon-se-m.title: Bharat vs France: Itihaas Jo Kitabon Se Mita Diya Gaya
bharat-vs-france-itihaas-jo-kitabon-se-m.description: Sabko pata hai angrez 1947 mein Bharat chhodkar chale gaye, par kya kisi ko ye maloom hai ki uske baad bhi France ka jhanda Bharat ke kuch shehron mein kyun lahrata raha? Ye show kholta hai itihaas ka ek bada raaz—jab Tipu Sultan ne French se ye soch kar dosti ki, ki unki madad se angrezon ko Bharat se bhaga denge. Lekin ye sapna kyun adhoora reh gaya? 'French aur angrez' dono videshi taakat aapas mein ladte rahe, aur apni jung mein Bharat ko uljha diya. Azadi ke baad bhi French Bharat ke kuch ilaakon mein kyun jamkar baithe rahe, jaise Bharat unki jaagir ho? Ye sab kyun hua, aur aakhir Bharat ne inhein kaise bahar ka rasta dikhaya? Ye kahani behad dilchasp hai fir bhi zyadatar kitabon mein kyon nahi milti? Aise sabhi sawalon ke jawab aapko milenge es show mein jiska naam hai "Bharat vs France: Itihaas Jo Kitabon Se Mita Diya Gaya"

dhanushkodi-1.title: Dhanushkodi
dhanushkodi-1.description: 1964 ഡിസംബർ 22-ന്,  പാംബൻ പാലത്തെ ലക്ഷ്യമിട്ട് ട്രെയിൻ നമ്പർ 8457 പതിവ് പോലെ തന്നെ അന്നും യാത്ര തുടങ്ങിയിരുന്നു. തൊട്ടടുത്ത സ്റ്റേഷനിൽ സ്റ്റേഷൻ മാസ്റ്റർ ശ്രീകുമാർ വൈകി എത്തിയ അടിയന്തര ടെലഗ്രാം സന്ദേശത്തെ നിസ്സഹായതയോടെ നോക്കി നിന്നു, ഉടൻ വീശിയടിക്കാൻ പോകുന്ന വിനാശകാരിയായ ഒരു ചുഴലിക്കാറ്റിനെ പറ്റിയുളള മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് ആയിരുന്നു അത്. 120 യാത്രികരെയും വഹിച്ച് ആ ട്രെയിൻ അപ്പോഴേക്കും കടലിനു കുറുകെയുളള പാമ്പൻ പാലത്തിലേക്ക് എത്തിയിരിക്കണം അയാൾ ഓർത്തു, കേൾക്കൂ സ്തോഭജനകമായ ആ സംഭവകഥയുടെ നാടകീയമായ അവതരണം.

three-women-1.title: Three Women
three-women-1.description: ಲಿಸಾ ಟಾಡಿಯೋ ಅವರ "ತ್ರಿ ವುಮನ್" ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಜೀವನದ ಆಳವಾದ, ಸಮೃದ್ಧ, ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ಪ್ರಣಯ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರ ಜನ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಬಯಕೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ನಿಜವಾದ ಮುಖವಾಡವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತಾತ್ವಿಕವಾಗಿ ಆಳವಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ಮನಮುಟ್ಟುವ ಈ ಕತೆಗಳು ಮಹಿಳಾ ಬಯಕೆಗಳ ಅಪೂರ್ವ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನವನ್ನು ನಮ್ಮ ಮುಂದಿಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳುವುದು, ಬಯಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಯೋಚಿಸಲು ನಿಮಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

chiranjeevi-returns.title: Chiranjeevi Returns
chiranjeevi-returns.description: Jab amar yodha lautate hain, tab sirf safar nahi, pura kaal chakra badalta hai! "Chiranjeevi Returns" bhi ek aisi kahani hai jo aapko kaliyug mein dobara yuddh karne aaye yoddhaon ki adbhut yatra par le jaayegi, jahan bhagya, dharm aur yuddh ki nayi paribhasha likhi ja rahi hai. To abhi suniye mahabharat ke Chiranjeevion ki wapasi ki kahani.

the-ego-trick.title: The Ego Trick
the-ego-trick.description: ಜುಲಿಯನ್ ಬ್ಯಾಗಿನಿ ಅವರ "ದಿ ಈಗೋ ಟ್ರಿಕ್" ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಸ್ವದೇಹ ಮತ್ತು ಅಹಂಕಾರದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. "ನಾನು ಯಾರು?" ಎಂಬ ದಾರ್ಶನಿಕ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲು ಈ ಕೃತಿ ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ, ತತ್ತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ, ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆಯಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ತೊಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು, ಅಹಂಕಾರವು ಒಂದು ನಿರಂತರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಆಗಿರುವ ಕಲ್ಪನೆಯ ಕುರಿತು ವಿಚಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಅನುಭವಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಮೃತಿಗಳ ಸುತ್ತ "ನಾನು" ಎಂಬ ಭಾವನೆ ಹೇಗೆ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ನಿರೂಪಣೆ ಇದು. ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಅನುಭವಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಸ್ವ-ಅನ್ವೇಷಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

dangerous-saiyyan.title: Dangerous Saiyyan
dangerous-saiyyan.description: Dus saal pehle, Rathore family ko ek saazish ka shikaar banaya gaya, unka pura khandan aag me jala diya gaya. Sirf Jaiveer Rathore zinda bacha, kyunki ek ladki Aishwarya Rajput ne apni jaan daav par lagakar usse bachaya. Us din Jaiveer ne badle ki kasam khai thi. Aaj, vahi Jaiveer, Commander Sherdil, Bharat ka sabse taqatwar aur khaufnaak fauj ka leader ban chuka hai. Jab woh Aishwarya ko dhundhne gaya, to sach jaan kar toot gaya. Uski wajah se woh khud jal gayi thi, aur ab log use Rajasthan ki sabse badsoorat ladki kehkar zaleel kar rahe the. Kya apne badle ki aag mein phir se Jaiveer jala dega Aishwarya ko?

radical-compassion.title: Radical Compassion
radical-compassion.description: ತಾರಾ ಬ್ರಾಚ್ ಅವರ "ರ್ಯಾಡಿಕಲ್ ಕಂಪ್ಯಾಷನ್" ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರುಣೆಯಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ ಮನೋಭಾವವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸುವ ಕುರಿತು ಆಳವಾದ ಒಳನೋಟ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಧುನಿಕ ಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಆತ್ಮೀಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕರುಣೆಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಯು ನಮ್ಮ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ತಾರಾ ಬ್ರಾಚ್ ಅವರ RAIN (Recognize, Allow, Investigate, Nurture) ವಿಧಾನವು ನಮ್ಮ ಭಾವನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮಾಧಾನಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥೈಸಿ, ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಂತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಪ್ತತೆಯನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕನ್ನಡ ಶ್ರವಣದ ಹಿತಕಾರಿ ಶೈಲಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ತಾಳ್ಮೆ, ಕರುಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಗಾಢವಾಗಿ ಅನುಭವಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

notes-on-a-nervous-plant.title: Notes On A Nervous Plant
notes-on-a-nervous-plant.description: ಮ್ಯಾಟ್ ಹೇಗ್ ರಚಿಸಿದ "ನೋಟ್ಸ್ ಆನ್ ಎ ನರ್ವಸ್ ಪ್ಲಾಂಟ್" ಆತ್ಮಚಿಂತನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ, ಇದು ಆಧುನಿಕ ಯುಗದ ವಾತಾವರಣವು ನಮ್ಮ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೀರುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪ್ರಭಾವವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆತಂಕ, ಒತ್ತಡ, ಹಾಗೂ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಒತ್ತೊತ್ತಿನ ಸಂಗ್ರಹದ ನಡುವೆ ಬದುಕಲು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಸಲಹೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ನಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಪೋಷಣೆ ನೀಡಲು ಹಾಗೂ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಶಾಂತಿಯನ್ನು ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಲಿಸಲು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಸಮತೋಲನವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಲು ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

royal-returns.title: Royal Returns
royal-returns.description: Riyasat ka Samrat banne ke baad Vikram jab apni mangetar Tejasvini se milne bhes badalkar apne gaon aata hai, to wo hairan ho jata hai ki wo use chhodkar ek Subedar ke bete se shaadi karne wali hoti hai. Yahi nahi Tejasvini ye maanne se inkaar kar deti hai ki Vikram raja ban chuka hai aur use bhikhari samajhti hai. Vikram ko ye bhi pata chalta hai ki uske peeth pichhe usi ke rajya mein usi ke khilaf kitne saazishen ho rahi hain.  Kaise karega wo akele apne dushmano ka saamna? Kya wo tod payega Tejasvini ka ghamand? Kaise dikhayega wo sabko kaun hai asli Samrat?

fe600815-b1ed-4c01-9d91-1aae7bbba14f.title: Prabhakaran Vaazhvum Maranamum
fe600815-b1ed-4c01-9d91-1aae7bbba14f.description: பிரபாகரன் என்னும் ஆளுமையை, அந்த ஆளுமை உருவான விதத்தை, அதன் தாக்கத்தை, விளைவுகளைச் சற்றும் நடுநிலை பிசகாமல் அலசி ஆராய்கிறது இந்நூல். ஈழப் போராட்டத்தின் இறுதித் தோல்விகளுக்கான காரணங்களை, பிரபாகரன் என்னும் தனி மனிதரின் ஆளுமையை முன்வைத்துக் கண்டறியும் முயற்சி இது...

yaazhini-endroru-thenaruvi.title: Yaazhini Endroru Thenaruvi
yaazhini-endroru-thenaruvi.description: Yazhini, abandoned by a billionaire, grows up in an old-age home. On his deathbed, he wills his fortune to her, triggering a search and deceitful claims, while Yazhini refuses to leave her home.

my-richierich-sons.title: My Richierich Sons
my-richierich-sons.description: Kanika ko ek zordaar thappad pada or ek pal me use usi ke ghar se nikaal diya gaya. 18 saal ki kanika shaadi se pahle hi ek sharaabi se pregnent ho gai thi. Uske bachchon ko kisi ne apna naam tak nahin diya. 25 Saal baad vo is ummmed se louti ki shayad uske apne use apna lenge lekin Kanika ke saath dafan the kai raaz... Kya Kanika ki vaapsi Singh Family me bhoochaal le aayegi? Kya Kanika ke bachhchon ko ab unka naam milega?

pco-a-wish-machine.title: PCO - A Wish Machine
pco-a-wish-machine.description: When a young husband discovers a mysterious phone booth that grants wishes, he must carefully navigate its power to help his family while dealing with the unexpected consequences of each wish, all while trying to save his once-verbal wife who has mysteriously lost her ability to speak.

dalithan.title: ദലിതൻ
dalithan.description: കേരളത്തിലെ ദലിത് മുന്നേറ്റത്തിനു ധൈഷണികവും പ്രായോഗികവുമായ നേതൃത്വം നൽകിയ വ്യക്തിത്വമാണു കെ.കെ.കൊച്ച്. അക്കാദമിക സാംസ്ക്കാരിക മേഖലകളിൽ ദലിത് വിചാരങ്ങൾക്ക് ഇടം ഉണ്ടാക്കിയെടുക്കുന്നതിൽ അദ്ദേഹം വഹിച്ച പങ്ക് ചരിത്രപരമാണു. ആ നിലക്ക് അദ്ദേഹത്തിൻ്റെ ആത്മകഥ കേരളത്തിലെ  സാമൂഹിക നവോത്ഥാന പ്രസ്ഥാനങ്ങളുടെ ഒരു ചരിത്ര രേഖ കൂടി ആയി തീരുന്നു.

gumshuda-waris.title: Gumshuda Waris
gumshuda-waris.description: Ek gareeb baker Jay apni saari savings apni girlfriend Naina ko de deta hai kyonki Naina uski aur apni shaadi publicly announce karne ka promise karti hai. Yahi nahi wo Jay ke design kiye hue unique ventilator ko bhi apne naam se patent kara leti hai. Ek public event mein Naina jab Jay ko dhokha deti hai to Jay ka sath dene aati hai Maya, usi company ki billionaire CEO jo 15 saal se apne khoye bete ko dhundh rahi hai. Kya Jay hi hai Maya ka khoya hua waris?

british-indiayum-sayudhasamarangalum.title: ബ്രിട്ടീഷ് ഇന്ത്യയും സായുധ സമരങ്ങളും
british-indiayum-sayudhasamarangalum.description: ഇന്ത്യൻ സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യസമര ചരിത്രത്തിലെ രക്തരൂക്ഷിതമായ ഏടുകളിലേക്ക് വെളിച്ചം വീശുന്ന കൃതി. 1857-ലെ ഒന്നാം സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യ സമരം മുതല്‍ 1946-ലെ നാവികകലാപം വരെയുള്ള സായുധ സമരങ്ങളാണ് ഈ കൃതിയില്‍ വിവരിക്കുന്നത്. ഗാന്ധിയന്‍ സമര രീതിക്ക് കൈവന്ന പ്രാമുഖ്യത്തിനിടയിലും പ്രക്ഷോഭങ്ങളുടെ അടിയൊഴുക്കുകളായി വർത്തിച്ച ഒരോ സാഹസിക മുന്നേറ്റങ്ങളുടെയും ചരിത്രം കേൾക്കാം.

nair-medhavithwathinte-pathanam.title: നായർ മേധാവിത്വത്തിൻ്റെ പതനം
nair-medhavithwathinte-pathanam.description: ആധുനിക കേരളത്തിലെ സാമൂഹിക-രാഷ്ട്രീയ ചരിത്രത്തിലെ നിര്‍ണ്ണായകമായ വഴിത്തിരിവുകളെ സമഗ്രമായി വരച്ചിടുന്ന കൃതി. ഒരു സമുദായത്തിന്റെ പരിവര്‍ത്തനം മാത്രമല്ല, റോബിന്‍ ജെഫ്രി എന്ന പണ്ഡിതന്‍ വായനക്കാര്‍ക്കു മുന്‍പാകെ അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നത്. മറിച്ച്, അന്നേവരെ നിലനിന്നിരുന്ന സകല സമവാക്യങ്ങളെയും തിരുത്തിക്കൊണ്ടുള്ള കേരളദേശത്തിന്റെ സമൂലമായ മാറ്റത്തെയാണ്.

most-wanted-surya.title: Most Wanted Surya
most-wanted-surya.description: Mumbai ke cruise par maa-baap ko khona Surya ke liye sirf ek haadsa nahi, ek jang thi. Saalon tak martial arts ki training li, aur ab wapas aaya hai – badla lene Shamsher Singh se! Lekin asli dushman Shamsher tha, ya uska rahasyamayi baap bhi? Kya Surya sabse balda le paega?

sex-murder-and-the-meaning-of-life.title: Sex Murder And The Meaning Of Life
sex-murder-and-the-meaning-of-life.description: "ಸೆಕ್ಸ್, ಮಾರ್ಡರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಅರ್ಥ" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿ ಮಾನವ ಮನೋವಿಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಗಾಢವಾಗಿ ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಡಗ್ಲಸ್ ಕೆನ್ರಿಕ್, ಮಾನವ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗತಿಗಳು, ನಮ್ಮ ಆದರ್ಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ಹಿಂಬಾಲಿಸುವ ಕಾರಣಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ, ಜೀವನದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸೆಕ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಹತ್ಯೆ ಮುಂತಾದ ಹೀನವಾದ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಲುಪಿದಾಗ, ಮಾನವ ಸ್ವಭಾವ ಮತ್ತು ಜಟಿಲ ಹಕ್ಕು-ಅಧಿಕಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಈ ಸರಣಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

ancient-indian-wisdom-a-holi-special.title: Ancient Indian Wisdom: A Holi Special
ancient-indian-wisdom-a-holi-special.description: Agar aapko ek mauka mile apni puri life ka Restart button dabane ka, toh kya aap dabayenge? Agar Haan to yeh show aapke liye restart button hai jismein, Samay, ek PhD student, batata hai ki kaise Hindu Panchang ke 12 mahine hamari life badal sakte hain! Is show mein har episode ek naye mahine ki wisdom lekar aata hai jo aapki soch ko badalne wala hai. Toh abhi suniye aur janiye ki wo secret Ancient Indian Wisdom jo aapko sabse alag aur safal banayenge!

the-as-if-principle-2.title: The As If Principle
the-as-if-principle-2.description: ನೀವು ಎನಿಸಿದಂತೆ ವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವೇ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು! "ಅಸ್ ಇಫ್ ಪ್ರಿನ್ಸಿಪಲ್" ಆಧಾರಿತ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಲೋಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ವರ್ತನೆ ನಡುವೆ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿ, ಯಶಸ್ಸು, ಸಂತೋಷ ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಆಧಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಸರಳ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಈ ಸರಣಿ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

rethinking-narcissism.title: Rethinking Narcissism
rethinking-narcissism.description: ನಾರ್ಸಿಸಿಸಂ ಎಂದರೇನು? ಏಕೆ ಕೆಲವರು ಸ್ವಪ್ರೇಮದ ವಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕುತ್ತಾರೆ? ಇದರ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳು ಏನು? ಕ್ರೇಗ್ ಮಾಲ್ಕಿನ್ ಅವರ "ರೀಥಿಂಕಿಂಗ್ ನಾರ್ಸಿಸಿಸಂ" ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ನಾರ್ಸಿಸಿಸಂನ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಪುನರಾವಿಷ್ಕರಿಸಿ, ಜಟಿಲ ಮನೋವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಹೂಳುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರ್ಸಿಸಿಸಂನ ಪ್ರಭಾವವನ್ನು ಸಮಜಾಯಿಷಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಉತ್ಸಾಹಭರಿತ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಲುಪಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ek-ladki-thi-deewani-si.title: Ek Ladki Thi Deewani Si
ek-ladki-thi-deewani-si.description: Motape ki wajah se Virat ki nafrat jhelna Aashi ki ab adat ban chuki thi. Par use apne rishte mein sabse bada  zakhm tab mila, jab usne apna baccha bhi kho diya. In zakhmo ko bharne woh sabki zindagi se gayab ho gayi aur chaar saal baad lauti – ek nayi pehchaan, ek nayi soch, aur sirf ek maqsad ke saath – badla lene Virat se! Kya Ashi Virat se badla le paegi? Ya badle ki aag mein pyaar ki nayi kahani shuru ho jaegi?

101-love-1.title: 101% Love
101-love-1.description: A romantic comedy of errors unfolds when two best friends unknowingly end up dating each other's intended partners after meeting at a hotel, leading to complications when both couples must navigate family expectations, tradition, and love in a wealthy Indian business family. As they fall deeper in love with the "wrong" partners, the truth of their switched identities threatens to unravel everything.

falling-for-you.title: Falling For you
falling-for-you.description: హై స్కూల్ డేస్ లో అమ్మాయికి, అబ్బాయికి పుట్టే ఇష్టం ప్రేమ కాకపోయుండొచ్చు, దానికి పేరు లేకపోవచ్చు కానీ అది మనసులో చెరగని ముద్ర వేస్తుంది. అలంటి ఒక ప్రేమ కథే "falling for you". ప్రేమో ఏమో తెలియని రోజుల్లో ఇష్టపడిన గౌతమ్, అధ్యాల సాన్నిహిత్యాన్ని తప్పుగా అర్ధం చేసుకున్న వాళ్ళ పెద్దవాళ్ళు వారిని విడదీస్తారు. కానీ అనూహ్యంగా ఆ ఇద్దరినీ మెడికల్ కాలజీ కలుపుతుంది. మరి వారి చిన్ననాటి ఇష్టాన్ని కొనసాగిస్తారా ? లేక ఎవరి దారిలో వాళ్ళు వెళ్ళిపోతారా ? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి రొమాంటిక్ ప్రేమ కథ "ఫాలింగ్ ఫర్ యూ" మీ కుకు లో

scam-420.title: Scam 420
scam-420.description: Kya hota hai jab duniya ke sabse shaatir chor bhi ek aise aadmi ke saamne aa jate hain jo unki har chaal ka tod nikal leta hai? Jab ek mastermind chor Ashwini, ki puri team ek mysterious enemy ke haathon tabaah ho jaati hai, tab shuru hota hai ek badle ka khel. Saat saal ka intezaar, ek perfect heist ka plan aur 300 crore ke sona ka inaam – kya Ashwini apna badla pura kar sakega? Ya is baar police aur takatwar dushman uska khel khatam kar denge?

నలంద-యూనివర్సిటీ-చరిత్ర.title: నలంద యూనివర్సిటీ చరిత్ర
నలంద-యూనివర్సిటీ-చరిత్ర.description: నలంద యూనివర్సిటీని ఎవరు స్థాపించారు? అక్కడ ఎటువంటి విద్యావిధానం ఉండేది? ఎప్పుడూ వినని గొప్ప చరిత్ర మీకోసం.

porn-and-popcorn-you-can-avoid-porn.title: Porn and Popcorn - You can avoid porn
porn-and-popcorn-you-can-avoid-porn.description: పోర్న్ దుష్ప్రభావాలను చెపుతూ.. పోర్న్ చుట్టూ  తిరిగే ఆసక్తికరమైన థ్రిల్లింగ్, నాటీ స్టోరీ మీకోసం.

money-hai-toh-honey-hai.title: Money Hai Toh Honey Hai
money-hai-toh-honey-hai.description: Vivek ne apni saari bachat aur udhaar lekar Sanjana se shaadi karne ka faisla kiya. Lekin mandap mein uski saas ne achanak bhaari dahej maang liya. Log hansne lage – ek gareeb ladka yeh rakam kahaan se laayega?Par jo kisi ne nahi socha tha, woh sach nikla – Vivek asal mein ek BILLIONAIRE tha! Kya Vivek yeh shaadi pyaar mein kar raha tha ya ye tha Sanjana ka loyalty test?

good-friday.title: గుడ్ ఫ్రైడే
good-friday.description: గుడ్ ఫ్రైడే క్రైస్తవుల పవిత్రమైన రోజుల్లో ఒకటి. ఇది ఏప్రిల్ నెలలో ఈస్టర్ ఆదివారం ముందు వచ్చే శుక్రవారం రోజున జరుపుకుంటారు. గుడ్ ఫ్రైడే అనేది యేసు క్రీస్తు తమ పాపాలకు విముక్తి కలిగించేందుకు శిలువపై మరణించిన దినం. గుడ్ ఫ్రైడే రోజున యేసు క్రీస్తు తన జీవితాన్ని తన అనుచరుల పాపాల రక్షణ కోసం త్యాగం చేశారు.

holika-kaliyug-ki-rakshasi.title: Holika : Kaliyug Ki Rakshasi
holika-kaliyug-ki-rakshasi.description: Holika ka sach sirf aag mein jalne ki kahani nahi, balki power, politics aur dhokhe ki bhi kahani hai! Aarav apni dadi ki diary ke panno se ek aise safar par nikalta hai jo holika ke liye banaye gae uske pure belief system ko hila kar rakh kar deta hai. Aap bhi suniye "Holika: Kaliyug Ki Rakshasi" ki poori kahani aur janiye wo sach jo aapko kabhi kisi ne nahi bataya.

bhagavathakatha.title: Bhagavathakatha
bhagavathakatha.description: ഇന്ത്യയിൽ ഏറ്റവുമധികം വായിക്കപ്പെട്ട ഭാഗവതാഖ്യാനങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്ന് കമലാ സുബ്രഹ്മണ്യത്തിൻ്റേതാണു. ഭഗവാൻ ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണൻ്റെ അവതാര കഥയുടെ സമഗ്രവും സമ്പൂർണ്ണവുമായ അവതരണം.

pravasam.title: പ്രവാസം
pravasam.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

The-Book-Of-Joy--दुख-के-बीच-सुख-का-मार्ग.title: The Book Of Joy : दुख के बीच, सुख का मार्ग
The-Book-Of-Joy--दुख-के-बीच-सुख-का-मार्ग.description: The Book of Joy ek aisi kitaab hai jo life ke asli sukoon aur khushi ka raasta dikhati hai. Dalai Lama aur Desmond Tutu ki baatein itni simple hain jaise do dost baithkar aapse koi raz share kar rahe hon. Sirf feel-good baatein hi nahi, balki gehri aur simple wisdom se bharin, jo mushkil waqt mein bhi sukoon deti hain. Agar aapko bhi khushi aur shanti chahiye, to ise zaroor suniye..

5cac9e48-4f06-4edc-b938-6baca9175f6b.title: Beauty's Formula
5cac9e48-4f06-4edc-b938-6baca9175f6b.description: When aging actress Reshma makes a deal with a mysterious masked figure for eternal youth, she becomes entangled in a sinister conspiracy involving missing women, dark experiments, and a dangerous cult, while her abandoned son Surya searches for his missing fiancée who may be connected to it all.

detective-rebecca-season-2.title: Detective Rebecca - Season 2 & 3
detective-rebecca-season-2.description: ആദ്യത്തെ ചില കേസ്സുകളുടെ സാഹസികവും വിജയകരവുമായ പൂർത്തീകരണത്തിനു ശേഷം റബേക്കയെ തേടി കൂടുതൽ കേസ്സുകൾ വന്നു തുടങ്ങി. പലപ്പോഴും അത് പോലീസുമായുളള ഈഗോ ക്ലാഷുകൾക്ക് വഴിവെച്ചു, ഒന്നിലും ഉലയാത്ത നിശ്ചയദാർഢ്യം കൈമുതലാക്കി റബേക്കയിലെ പ്രൊഫഷണൽ മുന്നേറി. കേൾക്കാം അത്യന്തം ഉദ്ദ്വേഗഭരിതമായ കുറ്റാന്വേഷണ പരമ്പര.

bhootland.title: BHOOTLAND
bhootland.description: Ek aisi duniya jahan sirf bhatakti aatmaayein rehti hain! Jab ek zinda ladki, Ananya, ek dare ke chakkar mein iss bhooton ki duniya mein fas jaati hai, uska samna hota hai Raghav se – ek naakara bhoot jo apni izzat banana chahta hai. Lekin wapas jaane ka sirf ek raasta hai – exit token! Kya Ananya wapas laut payegi ya yeh duniya uska naya ghar ban jayegi?

బర్బరీకుడు-SO-ఘటోత్కచుడు.title: బర్బరీకుడు S/O ఘటోత్కచుడు
బర్బరీకుడు-SO-ఘటోత్కచుడు.description: బార్బరికుడు మహాభారత యుద్ధానికి ముందు ఉన్న గొప్ప యోధుడు, త్రేణు బాణాలతో యుద్ధాన్ని ముగించే శక్తిని కలిగి ఉన్నాడు. ఆ శక్తిని అతను యుద్ధంలో ఎలా ఉపయోగించేవాడు? ఇంకా అతని గురించి మీకు తెలియని ఎన్నో అనేక విషయాలు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో విని తెలుసుకోండి.

సర్దార్-సర్వాయి-పాపన్న-గౌడ్-.title: సర్దార్ సర్వాయి పాపన్న గౌడ్
సర్దార్-సర్వాయి-పాపన్న-గౌడ్-.description: పాపాడు, అసలు పేరు పాపన్న, 18వ శతాబ్దం ప్రారంభంలో విశిష్టమైన స్వాతంత్ర్య సమరయోధుడు.చరిత్రకారులు బార్బరా మరియు థామస్ మెట్కాఫ్ ఆయనను "రాబిన్ హుడ్-లాంటి" లక్షణాలు కలిగి ఉన్న వ్యక్తిగా వర్ణించారు. పాపాడు, దుర్బలులకు తోడుగా నిలిచి అధికారాన్ని సవాలు చేస్తూ ప్రజల మనసులు గెలుచుకున్నాడు. అతని ఇంకా పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

bloody-cat-walk.title: Bloody Catwalk
bloody-cat-walk.description: Maya Nagri Mumbai—sapno ka shehar ya andheron ka ek aur jahaan? Vijay Arora jaise dalalon ke jaal me fansi teen ladkiyan, modeling ki chamak-dhamak ke sapne le kar Mumbai aayi thi. Par kya ye sapne sach honge ya sirf ek dukh bhari kahani ban jayenge? Ek shikaar aur ek shikari ki iss kahani me sachai kab samne aayegi?

భారతరత్న-పివినరసింహారావు-1.title: భారతరత్న పి.వి.నరసింహారావు
భారతరత్న-పివినరసింహారావు-1.description: పీవీ నరసింహారావు గారు భారత ఆర్థిక సంస్కరణలకు మార్గదర్శకుడు. 1991లో ఆర్థిక సంక్షోభ సమయంలో, దేశాన్ని ప్రపంచ ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థలో ప్రాబల్యం పొందేలా చేసారు. విద్య, సాంకేతిక రంగాల్లో విప్లవాత్మక మార్పులు తీసుకురావడంలో కూడా ఆయన గొప్ప పాత్ర పోషించారు. అలాగే, దేశ విదేశాంగ వ్యూహాల్లో సత్తాచాటారు, ఇతర దేశాలతో అనుసంధానాలను మెరుగుపరిచారు. పీవీ నరసింహారావు గారు తెలుగువారికి నిజమైన గర్వకారణం, భారతదేశ చరిత్రలో ఒక గొప్ప నాయకుడిగా నిలిచారు.

సిల్క్-స్మిత-.title: Silk Smitha
సిల్క్-స్మిత-.description: సిల్క్ స్మిత సినిమా ఇండస్ట్రీ లోకి ఎలా వచ్చింది? ఆమె మీద ఎలాంటి అభియోగాలు మోపబడ్డాయి? ఆమెది హత్యా? ఆత్మహత్యా? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.!

8-women-scientists-who-changed-the-world.title: 8 Women Scientists Who Changed The World Forever
8-women-scientists-who-changed-the-world.description: Agar in women scientists ne rukna manzoor kar liya hota, toh aaj ki duniya kitni alag hoti? Ek ne computers ki soch rakhi, ek ne GPS banane ka raasta dikhaya, toh kisi ne space missions ko sambhala! Yeh sirf kahaniyan nahi, yeh jeeti-jaagti misaal hai ki talent kisi gender ka mohtaaj nahi hota. Toh abhi suniye yeh show.

rss-varalaarum-arasiyalum.title: RSS -Varalaarum Arasiyalum
rss-varalaarum-arasiyalum.description: RSS in mulumaiyaana varalaatrai, nadunilaiyodu koorukirathu intha audiobook. Ethirpaalargal - Aadharavaalargal ena iru tharappinaraalum thodarndhu vimarsikka padum intha puthagam miga mukkiyamaana varalaatru aavanam.

rented-wife-in-my-life.title: Rented Wife In My Life
rented-wife-in-my-life.description: Apne judwa bhai doctor Aryan Kapoor ki maut ki guththi suljhane mein uljha London ka famous businessman Ayaan, jise apne judwa bhai Aryan ki maut se parda uthane India aakar uski jagah leni padti hai. Apne bhai ki zindagi ke saath-saath uski hone wali wife se bhi Ayaan ko karni padti hai shaadi. Aryan ke murder se parda uthate hue hua Ayaan ka samna ek bahut bade organ trafficking ke mastermind se. Kaise Ayaan ne liya apni bhai ki maut ka badla? Kya woh itne bade organ trafficking ke dhande ko band karwapaayega? Kya apne bhai ki hone wali wife ko woh apni zindagi mein apni patni ki jagah de paayega?

cleopatra-4.title: Cleopatra: Irumbu Penmani
cleopatra-4.description:
சர்வவல்லமை பொருந்திய ரோம சாம்ராஜ்ஜியத்தின் முதன்மைநாயகர்கள் ஜுலியஸ் ஸீஸரையும், மார்க் ஆன்ட்டனியையும் தன்சுண்டுவிரலில் சுழற்றியவர் கிளியோபாட்ரா. இதைத் தேசிய அவமானமாக நினைத்த ரோமன் வரலாற்று எழுத்தாளர்கள், உடல் கவர்ச்சியை மூலதனமாக வைத்துப் பதவியாட்டம் ஆடியவராக அவரைச் சித்தரித்தார்கள். காலம்காலமாகத் தொடரும் இந்தப் பொது ஜனபிம்பத்தை ஆதார பூர்வமாக எஸ். எல். வி. மூர்த்தி உடைத்தெறிகிறார். அவர் நிலைநிறுத்தும் கிளியோபாட்ரா ஒன்பது மொழிகளில் புலமை, கணிதம், வானியல், சோதிடம், மருத்துவம், தத்துவம், ரசவாதம் ஆகியதுறைகளில் தேர்ச்சி, நாடாளும் நிர்வாகத் திறமை, படை நடத்தும் ஆளுமை எனச் சகலாவல்லவர். துணிச்சலின் அவதாரம். தன்மானம் பாதிக்கப்பட்ட வேளையில் தயங்காமல் மரணத்தைத் தழுவிய இரும்புப் பெண்மணி.
ஜூலியஸ்ஸீஸர், நெப்போலியன், அலெக்சாண்டர், செங்கிஸ்கான் என எஸ். எல். வி. மூர்த்தி உருவாக்கியிருக்கும் சரித்திரநாயகர்கள் வரலாற்று வரிசையில் ஐந்தாம் படைப்பு. குதிரைப்பாய்ச்சல்நடை. வரிக்குவரி சுவாரஸ்யம்.

భయాన్ని-వీడటం-ఎలా-.title: భయాన్ని వీడటం ఎలా
భయాన్ని-వీడటం-ఎలా-.description: మానసిక ఆందోళన, భయం నుండి ఎలా బయటపడాలో ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ మీకు నేర్పిస్తుంది.

Ahom-Empire-मुगलों-पर-17-ऐतिहासिक-जीत-की.title: Ahom Empire: मुगलों पर 17 ऐतिहासिक जीत की कहानी
Ahom-Empire-मुगलों-पर-17-ऐतिहासिक-जीत-की.description: Ek aisa samrajya, jo kabhi Mughlon ke samne jhuka nahi! Ahom Samrajya ne 600 saal tak apni aazaadi ka dum dikhaya aur har invader ko mooh tod jawab diya! Assam ke veer Ahom yoddhao ki yeh kahani aapko batayegi ki kaise ek rajya Mughalon ke liye ek kabhi na tootne wali deewar ban gaya? Jo itihaas mein amar hain.

how-to-live-a-great-life-on-low-salary-1.title: How To Live A Great Life On Low Salary
how-to-live-a-great-life-on-low-salary-1.description: డబ్బు వృధా చెయ్యడం ఈజీ, సంపాదించడమే కష్టం. మీ సంపాదన తక్కువ ఉన్నా కూడా ఆనందంగా ఎలా జీవించాలో తెలుసుకోండి.

9a8acf8b-a4da-4a19-9de6-cd3e3b991f2c.title: Bloody Sweet
9a8acf8b-a4da-4a19-9de6-cd3e3b991f2c.description: தாமஸ் சாக்லேட் ஃபேக்டரியின் உரிமையாளர் வில்லியம் தாமஸின் மகன் ஜோர்ஜ் இருக்கும் போது, சீனியர் மேனேஜர் அஸ்வத்தாமன் அடுத்த சி.இ.ஓ ஆக நியமிக்கப்படுகிறான். இது வில்லியம் தாமஸின் மகன் மற்றும் மகள்க்ளைக் கோபப்படுத்துகிறது. ஃபேக்டரியின் நிர்வாகப் பொறுப்பைக் கைப்பற்ற சதி செய்கிறார்கள். அந்த சதியில் வெற்றி  பெற்றது யார்???

north-king-vikrant.title: North King Vikrant
north-king-vikrant.description: Duniya Vikrant Rajput ko "North King Legend" ke naam se jaanti thi, kyunki ek mysterious Underworld Jail mein band hone ke bawajood, usne apne naam se ek aisi kahani likhi jo sabse powerful Red Demons bhi challenge nahi kar sakte the. Par iss takatwar yoddha ke peeche chhupa tha ek dard se bhara hua baccha—jiske akhon ke samne uske parivaar ka khoon baha tha, jisne sirf 13 saal ki umar me maut ko apni taqat bana liya tha. Ab 18 saal baad, Vikrant Ambala vapas laut raha hai. Par is baar badle ki maksad ke sath!

సూపర్-స్టార్-కృష్ణ.title: సూపర్ స్టార్ కృష్ణ
సూపర్-స్టార్-కృష్ణ.description: తెలుగు సినిమా ఖ్యాతిని పెంచిన సూపర్ స్టార్ కృష్ణ గారి గురించి మీకు తెలియని ఎన్నో విషయాలు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో విని తెలుసుకోండి.

35c384a2-6b9f-4a7d-966d-4f4156e6de83.title: Puriyadha Pudhir - S 2
35c384a2-6b9f-4a7d-966d-4f4156e6de83.description: டாக்டர் சங்கர் அவரது மருத்துவமனையில் ஒரு நாள் கொடூரமாகக் கொலை செய்யப்பட்டுக் கிடக்கிறார். அவரது கொலையில் பலர் சந்தேகிக்கப் படுகிறார்கள். கொலையாளி யார்? டாக்டர் சங்கர் எதற்காகக் கொலை செய்யப்பட்டார்?

billionaire-dulha.title: Billionaire Dulha
billionaire-dulha.description: Raghav ki duniya tab palat jaati hai jab pyaar ke naam par uska sirf istemaal kiya jata hai. Ek shaadi jo sirf ek sauda hai, ek parivaar jo sirf paisa chahta hai, aur ek raaz jo uske pure wajood ko badalne wala hai. Jab usse pata chalta hai ki woh sirf ek aam ladka nahi, balki ek billionaire empire ka asli waris hai, toh khel badal jata hai. Kya Raghav apni pehchaan aur izzat wapas paa sakega, ya mohabbat aur dhokhe ke beech uska sab kuch bikhar jayega?

malabar-kalapam-1921-22.title: മലബാർ കലാപം 1921-22
malabar-kalapam-1921-22.description: 1921 ലെ മലബാർ കലാപത്തിൻ്റെ ഏറ്റവും ആധികാരികമായ ചരിത്രപാഠങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നാണു എം. ഗംഗാധരൻ്റെ മലബാർ കലാപം.  അനേകം വ്യാഖ്യാനങ്ങൾക്കും വളച്ചൊടിക്കലുകൾക്കും വിധേയമായ ഈ ചരിത്ര സന്ദർഭത്തെ കഴിയാവുന്നത്ര സംഗ്രതയോടെ ഈ രചനയിൽ അവതരിപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു. ബ്രിട്ടീഷ് സാമ്രാജ്യത്തിൻ്റെ അധികാര ഹുങ്കിനെ ഒരു നാട്- അവിടുത്തെ ജനത വെല്ലുവിളിച്ച പോരാട്ടത്തിൻ്റെ സ്മരണയാണിത്- കേൾക്കൂ..

bhooton-ki-adalat.title: Bhooton Ki Adalat
bhooton-ki-adalat.description: Bombay High Court ka ek purana, viran 7th floor — jahan sirf insaan hi nahi, balki adrishya taakatien bhi insaaf maangti hain! Avik aur Tanisha, do lawyers, ek ajeeb-o-gareeb case ke dauraan is adalat ki sabse darawani sachaiyon se takra jaate hain. Courtroom me gavel bajne ki awaaz ke saath shuru hone wala ek mamuli sa case, ek bhayanak raaz ban jaata hai. Kya Avik sach ka pata laga paayega, ya phir woh bhi is rahasyamay adalat ka hissa ban jayega?

pak-oru-puthirin-saridham.title: Pak Oru Puthirin Saridham
pak-oru-puthirin-saridham.description: Pakistan varalaatril maraikkappatta pala pakkangalaiyum , naam nichayam therinthu kolla vendiya Pakistan patriya unmaigalaiyum viru viru nadaiyil vivarikkiraar ezhuthaalar Pa. Raghavan. Pakistan varalaatrai muzhumaiyaaga arindhu kolla virumbum evarum miss panna koodaatha audibook idhu.

ilakkiya-munnodigal.title: Ilakkiya munnodigal
ilakkiya-munnodigal.description: 📖 Thamizh ezhuthulagil thalai sirantha 31 thamizh ilakkiya aazhumaigal udanaana thanadhu anubavangalai intha audio puthagathil pakirnthu kolgiraar ezhuthaalar tirupur Krishnan. 👥✨

purna-swaraj-bagawat-aur-aazaadi-ki-lalk.title: Purna Swaraj: Bagawat Aur Aazaadi Ki Lalkaar
purna-swaraj-bagawat-aur-aazaadi-ki-lalk.description:
Kya 1929 ke Lahore Adhiveshan mein ek secret British informer maujood tha? Kya Congress ke andar hi kuch log Poorn Swaraj ke khilaf kaam kar rahe the? Aur sabse bada sawaal – agar yeh proposal reject ho jata, toh Bharat ki azaadi kitne saal late ho jaati? Angrezon ne Congress ko todne ke liye ek aisi chaal chali jo agar kamyab ho jaati, toh azaadi sirf ek sapna ban kar reh jaati! Kaun tha wo insaan jo British aur Congress ke beech double game khel raha tha?
Aise sabhi chaunkane wale raaz aur azaadi ke itihas se judi ansuni kahaniyan aapko es show mein sunne ko milengi.

destination-wedding.title: Destination Wedding
destination-wedding.description: ఉదయ్, అమూల్యపై ఉన్న తన ప్రేమను పెళ్లి వరకు తీసుకెళ్లడానికి లవ్ లెటర్లు రాసాడు, కానీ ఏదీ ఫలించలేదు. చివరికి అతని ఫ్రెండ్ దేవేంద్ర, ఉదయ్ పేరును ఉపయోగించి శ్వేతను ప్రేమించాడు. శ్వేత లవ్ జర్నీ చూసిన తర్వాత అమూల్య కూడా అదే విధమైన ప్రేమను కోరుకుంది. ముఖ్యంగా డెస్టినేషన్ వెడ్డింగ్ చేసుకోవాలన్న తన కల కోసం ఎదురుచూస్తుంది. కనీసం లవ్ లెటర్ కూడా ఇవ్వలేని ఉదయ్, అమూల్యని ఒప్పించి తనకు నచ్చిన విధంగా డెస్టినేషన్ వెడ్డింగ్ చేసుకోగలడా? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

breaking-point-when-bullying-kills.title: Breaking Point- When Bullying Kills
breaking-point-when-bullying-kills.description: In this immersive audio series, we explore the harrowing stories of school bullying victims, pushed to the brink, leading to devastating school massacres in the United States. Set against the backdrop of high school corridors and classrooms, each episode reveals the buildup of torment and isolation that culminates in violent confrontations. Through powerful storytelling, deep research, and haunting soundscapes, we unravel the psychological descent from bullied student to tragic perpetrator, exposing the heartbreaking consequences when the pain of bullying turns deadly.

Decoded-Files--खून-की-राजनीति-.title: Decoded Files - खून की राजनीति
Decoded-Files--खून-की-राजनीति-.description: Ek high-profile murder, ek dangerous political conspiracy aur ek aisa raaz jo sirf codes aur secrets ke beech chhupa hai. Jab foreign minister Ashutosh Maheshwari ko ek charity event ke beech poison dekar maar diya jata hai, crime journalist Kavya is case ke peeche chhupi sachai tak pahunchne ka thaan leti hai. Uska saathi banta hai Aryan—ek cryptologist jo secret codes ko decode karne mein maahir hai. Par jaise-jaise wo dono sachai ke kareeb pahunchte hain, maut ka saya unke aur kareeb aata jata hai. Kya wo dono iss khoon ki raajneeti ka sach duniya ke saamne la paayenge?

నది-ది-రివర్-.title: Nadhi: The River
నది-ది-రివర్-.description: నవీన్ తన కష్టాల నుంచి కోలుకోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తున్నప్పుడు, రౌడీలు అతడిని అపహరిస్తారు. ఈ అపహరణ అతడిని సముద్రతీరంలోని జల్లారిపేటకు తీసుకెళ్తుంది, అక్కడ అతని చిన్ననాటి జ్ఞాపకాలతో పాటు, తన కోసం ఎదురుచూస్తున్న ప్రాణాంతక పరిస్థితులు అతని కథను కొత్త మలుపు తిప్పబోతున్నాయి.

shivam-the-yodha.title: Shivam: The Yodha
shivam-the-yodha.description: కలియుగాంతం తరువాత, మహాదేవుని అనుగ్రహం పొందిన శివమ్, అట్లాంటిస్ అనే గ్రహం లో తాను చేసే సాహస యాత్రలను తెలుపుతుంది ఈ కథ, ఆ గ్రహం లో రాబోయే సమస్య నుంచి అక్కడి ప్రజలను శివమ్ కాపాడగలడా?

garuda-purana-maut-ko-samajhiye-aasan-bh.title: Garuda Purana  : Maut Ko Samajhiye Aasan Bhasha Mein
garuda-purana-maut-ko-samajhiye-aasan-bh.description: Mrityu ke baad kyun kiya jata hai Garuda Purana ka paath? Kyun hoti hai Kusha ghaas pavitra? Mrityu ke devta yamraj hain to fir Garuda Dev ki kyun hoti hai pooja? in sab sawalon ke jawab janane ke liye Suniye ye khas show "Garuda Puran  : Maut Ko Samajhiye Aasan Bhasha Mein".

kolaiyuthir-kaalam-2.title: Kolaiyuthir Kaalam - 2
kolaiyuthir-kaalam-2.description: Shivani's enemies chase her for redemption. Will Shivani & team suruvive this threat? When Police Commissioner Sathyamoorthy and Inspector Krishna attempt to bring down Chennai's ruthless gangster Panchali by orchestrating a conflict with a minister's son, their plan catastrophically backfires - leading to brutal murders, political interference, and a deadly game of cat and mouse where the hunters become the hunted.

6174-1.description: மிகப் பழங்காலத்தில் இருந்தாதகச் சொல்லப்படும் ஆற்றல் நிறைந்த படிகத்தாலான பிரமிட் ஒன்றின் இரு பகுதிகளைக் கண்டுபிடித்து உலகினைத் தன் வசப்படுத்த நினைக்கும் பல குழுக்களின் சதிகளினிடையே , இரு இளம் அறிவியலாளர்கள் மாட்டிக்கொள்கின்றனர். பிரமிடின் பாகங்களை அவர்கள் கண்டுபிடித்தார்களா? அதைத் தொடர்ந்து வரும் ஆபத்திலிருந்து அவர்கள் தப்பித்தார்களா???

guardian-of-9.title: Guardian Of 9
guardian-of-9.description: Samrat Ashoka ne ek vishesh gupt sangathan ka gathan kiya tha, jiska kaam tha alag-alag 9 vishayon par duniya bhar se jaankari ikattha karna aur unhe kitaabon mein sangrahit karna. In kitaabon mein itna gyaan tha ki unse poori duniya ko kaabu kiya ja sakta tha. Is gyaan ki suraksha ke liye Ashoka ne "Kavach" ki sthaapna ki. Lekin Kavach ke ek master, jo aaj "Dark Lord" ke naam se jaana jaata hai, usne inn kitaabon ke gyaan ka istamaal apne swarth ke liye karne ka iraada kar liya. Jab baaki masters ko is baat ka pata chala, to unhone Dark Lord ko Kavach se nishkasit kar diya aur in kitaabon ko ek surakshit jagah chhupa diya. Lekin Dark Lord, jo ab kaali shaktiyon ka swami ban chuka tha, unn kitaabon ko haasil karne ke liye wapas aa gaya. Lekin usse ye pata nahi tha ki ab uska samna Aarav se hone wala hai, jo ek sarvashaktishali "Guardian of 9" ke roop mein samne aane wala tha, jisse abhi tak apni shaktiyo ka ehsas nahi tha. Kya Aarav ko apni asli pehchan aur shaktiyo ke bareme pta chal payega ? Dark lord Aarav ke liye kounsa khatra banne wala hai ?

shalabham-pookkal-airoplane.title: ശലഭം പൂക്കൾ Airoplane
shalabham-pookkal-airoplane.description: ആഖ്യാനത്തിൻ്റെ നൂതന വഴികളിലൂടെയുളള ഒരു സാഹസികയാത്രയാണു ഈ കൃതി. പെണ്ണനുഭവങ്ങളുടെ സൂക്ഷ്മങ്ങളായ ഉൾപിരിവുകളെ ആലേഖനം ചെയ്യുന്ന മനോഹരവും നൂതനവുമായ ഭാഷയാണു ഈ നോവലിൻ്റെ ആത്മാവ്. മൂമു എന്ന ശലഭത്തിന്റെ കഥ, ഒപ്പം ആഷിയുടെയും ജോണ്‍ മാറോക്കിയുടെയും സാമിന്റെയും കഥ.  ഈ മൂവരേയും  പ്രധാന കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളാക്കി ഭാവനയുടെ വിഹായസ്സിലേക്ക് ഒരു വ്യോമയാനമാണു ഈ നോവൽ.

parth-surya-warriors-of-kaalchakra.title: Parth & Surya : Warriors Of Kaalchakra
parth-surya-warriors-of-kaalchakra.description:
Kya sapne sirf mann ki kalpana hote hain, ya phir kisi bhool chuki kahani ka darpan?
Ek ajeeb sapna jo roz raat ko aata hai, ek yuddh ka maidan, ek kathor awaaz jo sawal karti hai – "Kya tumhe yaad hai tumne kya kiya tha?" Parth har subah paseene mein bheeg kar uthta hai. Uske dost ise sirf ek mazaak samajhte hain, lekin Surya jaanta hai – iss sapne mein ek gehra raaz chhupa hai. Kya Parth ka punarjanm ho chuka hai? Kya uska bechain mann uski bhooli yaadon ka darwaza khol raha hai?

secret-boy-friend.title: Secret Boyfriend
secret-boy-friend.description: ರೋಷನಿ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಿಯಕರನನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಲು ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿಗೆ ತೆರಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆದರೆ, ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ವಂಚಕನೆಂಬುದನ್ನು ಅವಳು ಅರಿಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವನಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದಲ್ಲಿ, ಆಕೆ ಮತ್ತೊಬ್ಬನ ಜಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಹಾಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಇದು ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆಯಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ ಸಂಬಂಧಕ್ಕೆ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವರ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ, ಕೇವಲ KukuFM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

06ef6eee-1ad5-4542-96cc-b3f1107805ad.title: Rockstar
06ef6eee-1ad5-4542-96cc-b3f1107805ad.description: నిజం చెప్పే ధైర్యం లేని వాడికి ఆశయం గెలుచుకునే హక్కు లేదు, ఒక రోజు నిన్ను పెంచిన వాళ్ళు ఎక్కువ? లేదంటే నువ్వు పెంచుకున్న ఆశయం ఎక్కువ? అనే ఒక ప్రశ్న వస్తుంది, నువ్వు దేని ఎంచుకుంటావ్? ఈ కథలో కథానాయకుడు రేవా తన ఆశయాన్ని ఎంచుకుని తల్లిదండ్రులు ఉన్నా అనాధ అయ్యాడు. నిజానికి భారత దేశంలో తల్లితండ్రులకు శత్రువు అవ్వాలంటే పెద్ద తప్పు చెయ్యాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు, ఇది నా జీవితం అని మన ఆశయాలు వెనక వెళ్తే సరిపోతుంది, ఖచ్చితంగా శత్రువు అయిపోతాం.  అలానే రాధ వల్లభ - రేవా కూడా అతను ఒక దారి ఎంచుకుని కుటుంబానికి దూరం అయ్యాడు ,  అలాంటి సమయం లో ఒక అమ్మాయి "సత్యభామ" అతనకు female body guard గా చేరుతుంది. ఎవరూ లేని ఒంటరితనం కి స్నేహమే పెద్ద బహుమానం, కానీ ఆ బహుమానం భరించే బలం అవుతుందా ?  బ్రతుకుని బరువుగా మలిచే బరువు అవుతుందా?

rishton-ki-unsuljhi-dor.title: Rishton Ki Unsuljhi Dor
rishton-ki-unsuljhi-dor.description:
Krishaa apni zindagi mein ek ajeeb sapne se pareshaan thi. Vo sapna itna bhahyanak tha ki usse jaagne ke bad krishaa apni zindagi ki hakeekat par hi sawaal uthaane lagti thi. Lekin aakhirkaar ek din uska saamna apne is darr se ho gya, jab Krishaa ko uski behen ke sath ek aisa shaks nazar aaya, jisse Krishaa ne sacche dil se pyaar kiya tha. Ye shaks koi aur nahin balki Siddharth tha. Un donon ko saath dekhkar Krishaa ke dil mein baaki umeeden aur uska vajood chaknaachur ho gya, par shayad ye Krishaa ki zindagi mein dhoko ki shuruaat thi, isse bhi bada ek sach Krishaa ka intzaar kar raha tha. Aakhir kya tha vo sach?
Kya Krishaa ko sach mein diya Siddharth ne dhokaa? Kya ye thi Krishaa ke lie kisi nayi saajish ki shuruaat? Kya hai Krishaa se judaa vo sach, jisse badal jaayegi uski pehchaan?

அபூர்வ-ராமாயணம்--காற்றின்-குரல்-.title: அபூர்வ ராமாயணம் - காற்றின் குரல்
அபூர்வ-ராமாயணம்--காற்றின்-குரல்-.description: இராமர் இந்து இதிகாசங்களின்படி, இந்துக் கடவுள் விஷ்ணுவின் ஏழாவது அவதாரம் மற்றும் இச்வாகு குல அயோத்தியின் அரசர் தசரதனின் நான்கு மகன்களில் மூத்தவர். மற்றவர்கள் இலக்குவன், பரதன், சத்துருகனன் ஆவர். பொதுவாக இராமர் 12,00,000 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன்னர் திரேதா யுகத்தில் பிறந்தார் என்று குறிப்பிடப்படுகின்றார். விஷ்ணுவின் அவதாரங்களுள் ஒருவராக இவர் கருதப்படுகிறார். ராமர் ஏக பத்தினி விரதம் கடை பிடித்தார். தந்தை சொல் மிக்க மந்திரம் இல்லை என்று வாழ்ந்தவர். இத்தொகுப்பில் ராமரின் ஜனனம் மற்றும் ராமாயணம் தொடர்பாக பலராலும் அறியப்படாத பல அறிய நிகழ்வுகள் அவற்றுடன் சொல்லப்பட்டுள்ள அற்புதமான அறநெறிக் கருத்துக்கள் சிறு கதைகளாக கூறப்பட்டுள்ளன.

என்-இனிய-இயந்திரா-.title: என் இனிய இயந்திரா
என்-இனிய-இயந்திரா-.description:
கலை, கவிதை, காதல் தடைசெய்யப்பட்ட, 50 வயதிற்கு மேல் வாழ அனுமதியில்லாத ஒரு சர்வாதிகார இந்தியாவில் தன் கணவனைத் தேடிப் புறப்படுகிறாள் நிலா. அவளுக்கு உதவ இணைகிறான் புரட்சிக்காரன் ரவி மற்றும் அவனது இயந்திர நாய் 'ஜீனோ'. இந்த விசித்திரக் கூட்டணி ஒட்டுமொத்த அரசாங்கத்தையே எப்படி அசைத்துப் பார்க்கிறது?

சுஜாதாவின் புகழ்பெற்ற அறிவியல் புனைகதை இப்போது திரையில். மனிதநேயத்தைக் காக்க ஒரு ரோபோ நாய் நடத்தும் அதிரடிப் போராட்டம்!

dark-vow-jungle-ki-pukar.title: Dark Vow: Jungle Ki Pukar
dark-vow-jungle-ki-pukar.description: Devpur ek aisa gaon hai jismein shanti sirf ek purane samjhaute ki wajah se bani hui thi — ek samjhauta jo ab tootne wala hai. Arjun, jo is gaon se saalon pehle door chala gaya tha, wapas aata hai bina jaane ki ek bhayanak taakat jaag chuki hai. Jungle ki purani kahaniyan sach hone lagti hain, aur ek laalchi shaks ka ek galat kadam pure gaon ko tabahi ki taraf le ja raha hai. Kya Arjun apne gaon aur jungle ko bacha paayega? Ya Van Dev ka prakop sab kuch nasht kar dega?

kishkinthayude-mounam.title: കിഷ്കിന്ധയുടെ മൗനം
kishkinthayude-mounam.description: പുരാതന കാലത്തെ ഇന്ത്യയിൽ നിലനിന്ന ഒരു കൊലയാളി സംഘം  ഒരു ആശ്രമത്തിന്റെ  മറവിൽ പുനർജനിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു. ചരിത്രവും മിത്തും സംയോജിപ്പിച്ച ഒരു ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലർ! 2024ലെ  ഡി സി നോവൽ മത്സരത്തിൽ ഇടം പിടിച്ച കൃതി.

மீண்டும்-ஜீனோ-.title: மீண்டும் ஜீனோ
மீண்டும்-ஜீனோ-.description: முற்றிலும் விஞ்ஞானமயமாக்கப்பட்ட வேறொரு உலகம், அந்த உலகத்தை ஆளும் பொம்மை ராணி நிலா. அவளைப் பின்னாலிருந்து ஆட்டுவிக்கும் ரவி, மனோ இருவர் கையில் ஒட்டுமொத்த அதிகாரமும் இருக்க, இயந்திர நாயான ஜீனோ, நிலாவுக்கு உதவ தன் ஒட்டு மொத்தத் தந்திரங்களையும் மூளையையும் பிரயோகிக்கிறது. ஜீனோவுக்கும் எதிரிகளுக்கும் இடையில் நடக்கும் போரின் முடிவு என்ன என்பதுதான் இந்த நாவல்.

antim-yoddha.title: Antim Yoddha
antim-yoddha.description: Dr. Rao ke experiments se Aarav ke andar super powers activate ho chuki thi lekin ye vahi Dr. Rao tha jisne Aarav ke parents ka badi berahami se murder kiya tha. Kya hoga jab Aarav ke saamne ye kala sach aayega? kya Aarav Dr. Rao ki saajish se bach paayega? Kya Aarav ki super powers vikraal roop le lengi?

the-ghost-in-plain-sight-1.title: The ghost in plain sight
the-ghost-in-plain-sight-1.description: A legendary secret agent, living a deep-cover life as a mocked and "disappointing" insurance agent, is forced to abandon his status-obsessed family when a catastrophic bio-threat emerges, leaving them to unravel the devastating truth after he stages his heroic death.

mera-gaon-wala-billionaire.title: Mera Gaon Wala Billionaire
mera-gaon-wala-billionaire.description: "Mera Gaon Wala Billionaire" is a gripping microdrama that follows Malhar, a humble man who appears to be a simple egg seller but is secretly a trillionaire with immense power. After being mistreated and falsely accused by a wealthy socialite, he is saved by Vidya, a delivery girl who is also a widow facing abuse from her own greedy in-laws . Their lives intertwine when they are forced into an arranged marriage, leading Vidya to discover Malhar’s hidden empire while he uses his resources to protect her and deliver poetic justice to those who wronged them. The series explores themes of hidden identity, ultimate revenge, and the triumph of quiet dignity over arrogant wealth

kaavalan-story-of-billionaire-bodyguard.title: Kaavalan : Story of Billionaire Bodyguard
kaavalan-story-of-billionaire-bodyguard.description: A lonely billionaire hides his true identity and becomes a bodyguard to find real love. When the truth starts to come out, he must decide if love is worth risking everything.

death-countdown.title: Death Countdown
death-countdown.description: చావు ఎప్పుడు వస్తుందో తెలిస్తే మనిషి ఎలా ఫీల్ అవుతాడు? ఇతరులు  ఎప్పుడు చనిపోతారో తన శక్తితో తెలుసుకున్న ఉదయ్ కి ఏం జరిగింది? అతనికి ఆ శక్తి ఎలా వచ్చింది? దానితో ఏం చేసాడు? చూడండి"Death Countdown" మీ కుకు టీవీలొ.

metro-wala-panga.title: Metro Wala Panga
metro-wala-panga.description: On the morning of her wedding, an entitled, powerful woman falsely accuses a frail old man of molestation inside a crowded metro, triggering a brutal mob trial that destroys his dignity—until a buried truth threatens to expose how public outrage, power, and prejudice can turn an innocent man into a criminal in minutes.

revenge-of-chanakya-1.title: Revenge Of Chanakya
revenge-of-chanakya-1.description: When visionary executive Ravi Kashyap is betrayed by his corrupt CEO Nakul Mehta and abandoned by his wife Shanaya, his world collapses. But a chance encounter with delivery boy Chandra Gupta reignites his fire. Guided by the ancient wisdom of Chanakya Neeti, Ravi transforms himself into a modern day Chanakya building an empire from ashes to take ruthless revenge on those who destroyed him.

billionaire-ki-jhooti-biwi.title: Billionaire Ki Jhooti Biwi
billionaire-ki-jhooti-biwi.description: A one-night stand between Sukanya and wealthy businessman Anurag leads to the birth of their son Ansh, but Sukanya's manipulative friend Rumalika steals Anurag's ring and tricks him into marriage. 18 years later when Sukanya becomes Anurag's assistant, Rumalika's web of lies and murderous intentions begins to unravel, culminating in a DNA test that reveals the true parentage of Ansh and Rumalika's son Aditya. Watch Now

billion-dollar-brother-1.title: Billion Dollar Brother
billion-dollar-brother-1.description: When the arrogant and wealthy Aditya Paswan returns to his hometown after years abroad, he hides his billionaire status behind a simple identity. But when he meets the fiery and independent Jhanvi, his past secrets, family wounds, and unresolved rivalries resurface. In a clash of pride, love, and redemption, Samar must choose between ego and heart before it's too late. Watch Now!

the-billionaire-i-call-dad.title: The Billionaire I Call Dad
the-billionaire-i-call-dad.description:
The heart-touching story of Anika, a 9-year-old orphan with dreams bigger than her circumstances. Determined to complete her education, she searches for support—but the world turns its back on her.
One fateful day, Anika crosses paths with a wealthy man when she suddenly appears in front of his car. Moved by her struggles, he becomes her benefactor and helps her continue her studies. Wanting to give her a permanent home, he asks his younger brother to adopt her. Will Anika’s faith be rewarded?

special-ops-commander.title: Special OPS Commander
special-ops-commander.description: The show follows Tara and Veer as their world is consumed by revenge, kidnappings, and shifting power grabs. Tara’s rise begins with the killing of an elderly Godfather and the seizure of control, which immediately sets off retaliation from rival families and armed factions. Veer is pulled away from his own public ascent when his family is attacked and his father is murdered, forcing him into a desperate race to protect his loved ones. As the conflict spreads, captives are humiliated, auctioned, or used as leverage, and family debts become weapons in a larger criminal war. Veer repeatedly tries to rescue those closest to him, but each victory seems to open another trap or expose another layer of conspiracy. Aditi and her family are caught in the middle of this struggle, facing debt pressure, forced arrangements, public humiliation, and threats tied to both business and blood feuds. Veer’s relationship with Aditi remains central, even as her family rejects him and others try to use her as his weakness. The Mehra empire also becomes a battleground, with sabotage, boardroom coups, and hostile takeovers showing that the war is not only physical but corporate. Hidden masterminds, mysterious commanders, and loyal pawns keep reshaping the conflict from behind the scenes. At several points, the story widens into clashes between clans, crime lords, and military figures, making the struggle feel larger than any one family. Kiara’s abduction and the later revelations about child trafficking and organ harvesting add a darker rescue thread to the chaos. Veer and other protectors are forced to choose between revenge and rescue, often doing both at once. The truth about betrayals, framing, and stolen power surfaces gradually, but it rarely brings peace. Instead, each exposed crime triggers a harsher counterattack. By the later stretch, the feud has become an all-out war over legacy, control, and survival. The final state of the conflict suggests old alliances have collapsed and new authority has risen, but the underlying vendettas remain unresolved.

doctor-vs-stranger.title: Doctor vs Stranger
doctor-vs-stranger.description: An arrogant billionaire couple delays and humiliates a middle-class driver over a minor car scratch, unaware that he is the specialist surgeon rushing to perform a life-saving operation on their own dying daughter.

judwa-bhai-ka-badla.title: Judwa Bhai Ka Badla
judwa-bhai-ka-badla.description: Separated by fate but bound by blood, elder brother Virat is forced to step into the dark, ruthless world of his twin Vihan - a workplace that once nearly killed him. Disguised, determined, and driven by unfinished vengeance, Virat infiltrates Vihan’s hellish empire to hunt down the man responsible for destroying his life. This time, revenge won’t be loud or reckless - it will be slow, calculated, and deeply personal. Watch Now!

brahmarakshas-2.title: Brahmarakshas
brahmarakshas-2.description:
In that village, a Brahmrakshas is known for abducting brides on their wedding night.
Despite being aware of this terrifying truth, Eera arrives there to ensure her friend Nivi’s wedding takes place.
Will she be able to stop the Brahmrakshas?
Watch “Brahmrakshas”, streaming exclusively on Kuku TV.

brahmarakshasa.title: Brahmarakshasa
brahmarakshasa.description:
In that village, a Brahmarakshasa is known for abducting brides on their wedding night.
Despite being aware of this terrifying truth, Indu arrives there to ensure her friend's wedding takes place.
Will she be able to stop the Brahmarakshasa?
Watch “Brahmarakshasa”, streaming exclusively on Kuku TV.

undercover-billionaire-nurse.title: Undercover Billionaire Nurse
undercover-billionaire-nurse.description: At his grandfather’s funeral, billionaire CEO Lakshya Malhotra is branded a killer when two brothers accuse his charity nursing home of murder. To uncover the truth, he goes undercover as a nurse—only to find a staged “happy” facade hiding a basement hell of tortured elders, fake audits, and insiders who’ll kill him to keep the money flowing.

lady-boss-returns-4.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns-4.description: Desperate to escape a forced arranged marriage, rebellious heir Tej Jaysinh impulsively proposes a one-day contract marriage to a mysterious woman, Kyra. Kyra, a determined entrepreneur, initially rejects him due to her engagement to Rishi, who subsequently joins Tej's firm. Rishi, however, cruelly abandons Kyra for the wealthy heiress Alya, having also betrayed Kara, a woman instrumental in his rise. Witnessing Kyra's abuse and corporate machinations, Tej dramatically intervenes, publicly declaring Kyra his wife to protect her, sparking rumors of a contract marriage and defying his authoritarian father. This unexpected union ignites a fierce power struggle within the Jaisingh Group, leading to Tej's disinheritance for choosing love over an arranged marriage and family legacy. Amidst these conflicts, Kyra, also known as Kiara and later Tesh, gradually emerges as the formidable 'Sky Queen,' a corporate titan orchestrating strategic moves and determined to expose fraud within the Jindal construction empire. Her true identity is repeatedly challenged and branded as fraudulent, but Tej fiercely defends her, hinting at a deep and growing connection. The conflict escalates into a corporate war, particularly with Vanshika Jindal, who seeks devastating revenge after her public humiliation and broken engagement to Tej. Ultimately, Kyra's identity as the legitimate 'Sky Queen' of D-Mart is definitively confirmed through biometric verification and a transfer of immense wealth. As Tesh, she rejects past manipulators and formalizes a powerful alliance with Tej, her life partner, as they prepare to conquer both love and power, reigning as the 'Sky Queen' and 'Sky King.'

chaiwala-dulhania-le-jayega.title: Chaiwala Dulhania Le Jayega
chaiwala-dulhania-le-jayega.description: A billionaire CEO hides behind the mask of a humble chaiwala to win the heart of the woman he has loved since his teenage years. When Shruti runs away from a forced marriage, fate throws her into Dharam’s arms—sparking a contract marriage built on lies, laughter, and unexpected love. As class clashes, family drama, and buried truths surface, Dharam must choose between protecting his secret and risking everything for honest love

lady-boss-returns-5.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns-5.description: The microdrama unfolds around Kiara Bansai, a powerful heiress known as the Sky Queen, who navigates a treacherous world of corporate intrigue, family betrayal, and societal scorn. Initially, Kiara faces public accusations challenging her identity and motives, but with the support of allies like CEO Tejas Singh and her trusted aide Ruby, she asserts her rightful place as the leader of the D-Mar Group. Her romantic entanglements with Tej, a disowned CEO who chooses love over family legacy, and the complex dynamics with former suitors like Rishi, deepen the personal stakes amid corporate battles. The narrative explores themes of arranged marriages, secret unions, and defiance against patriarchal expectations, as characters like Daivik and Tej confront family ultimatums and societal pressures. Kiara's struggle to prove her legitimacy involves overcoming financial and biometric challenges, culminating in a public affirmation of her status as Sky Queen. Meanwhile, Tejin, her partner, is liberated from manipulative family control, solidifying their alliance as Sky Queen and Sky King. The saga is marked by fierce confrontations, including physical altercations and high-society feuds, as rival families like the Jindals seek revenge and power. Strategic alliances are forged and broken, with the Queen orchestrating moves to dismantle corrupt rivals and secure market dominance. Throughout, the characters grapple with ambition, loyalty, honor, and love, set against a backdrop of tradition clashing with modernity. The climax sees Kiara and Tejin standing united, having overcome challenges to their authority and personal bonds, poised to reshape their corporate empire and family legacies. The stakes remain high as threats from adversaries and unresolved family conflicts hint at ongoing battles for influence and survival.

contract-husband-of-boss-wife.title: Contract Husband Of Boss Wife
contract-husband-of-boss-wife.description: The show follows Kabir, a ruthless Malhotra heir who is offered control of the family empire under a mysterious condition even as he secretly wants to destroy the legacy tied to his past. His rise is immediately shaped by clashes with Priya, Raghav, Chanchal, and other rivals who pull him into cycles of humiliation, debt, violence, and family coercion. What begins as a struggle over money, property, and status deepens when Kabir’s mother falls critically ill, forcing him to fight creditors and a corrupt system while hidden power brokers like Miss Vani emerge. Vani first appears as a force who can challenge institutions and Kabir alike, and their conflict quickly turns into a contract marriage neither side seems fully free to choose. From there, the series expands into a world where marriages, engagements, and business deals are repeatedly used as weapons, with Kabir and Vani trapped inside overlapping family agendas. Kabir is drawn into street-level fights, gang retaliation, and rescue situations that make him both protector and target, while powerful women and rival men try to claim, test, hire, or control him. At the same time, Vani faces ridicule for her attachment to a poor laborer image of Kabir, even as he repeatedly steps forward to defend her publicly and privately. Their bond strengthens through shared danger, especially as wagers, humiliating conditions, and massive debt deadlines threaten Vani’s family and corporate standing. The Mehta family becomes central to the larger conflict as hostile rivals pursue takeovers, counterfeit schemes, loan ultimatums, and asset grabs designed to strip them of control. Kabir, often dismissed as unworthy or inexperienced, keeps turning confrontations in his favor by exposing fraud, proving contracts are real, and intervening at crucial moments in financial and public battles. Yet every apparent victory opens another front, including family distrust, accusations of manipulation, and medical emergencies involving powerful elders whose survival becomes tied to money, secrecy, and unconventional cures. As the pressure escalates, corruption scandals, blackmail, hacked financial secrets, and revenge plots widen the story beyond romance into a broader war over the Mehta empire. Vani’s kidnapping and the murky conspiracy around it push Kabir into brutal retaliation and deeper suspicion, especially when supposed victims or allies appear complicit and hidden organizers remain unclear. Even after rescues and public declarations of loyalty, Kabir and Vani remain surrounded by enemies such as Vikram, Sanjeev, Raghav, Raj Khanna, and others who exploit debt, inheritance, and reputation to attack them. The struggle eventually circles back to the Malhotra family, where Vani wins approval from Kabir’s elder through respect and tradition, and Kabir openly names her as his pillar of strength. But reconciliation remains out of reach because the family’s buried past resurfaces: a dying patriarch begs forgiveness over the tragedy linked to Kabir’s father’s death, offers the empire, and still fails to convince Kabir that the full truth has been told. By the end, the show’s central stakes are no longer just who controls a company or a marriage, but whether Kabir can protect Vani, survive the wars around both families, and uncover the truth behind the legacy he was once determined to destroy.

brahmrakshas-4.title: Brahmrakshas
brahmrakshas-4.description:
In that village, a Brahmrakshasa is known for abducting brides on their wedding night.
Despite being aware of this terrifying truth, Eera arrives there to ensure her friend Nivi’s wedding takes place.
Will she be able to stop the Brahmrakshasan?
Watch “Brahmrakshas”, streaming exclusively on Kuku TV.

second-class-billionaire.title: Second Class Billionaire
second-class-billionaire.description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

pyaar-ya-pagalpan.title: Pyaar Ya Pagalpan
pyaar-ya-pagalpan.description: is an intense romantic psychological thriller. The story follows Param, a struggling yet sincere artist, and Amrita, a powerful but deeply unstable CEO. What begins as admiration for his art slowly turns into obsession, control, and manipulation. As love blurs into madness, Param is trapped in a dangerous game of identity, sacrifice, and survival, where escaping the past becomes the only way to reclaim his freedom and start over.

lady-boss-returns-2.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns-2.description: The show weaves romance, succession battles, and corporate warfare into a single arc about hidden identities and power being tested in public. It begins with heirs and executives trapped by family pressure, especially around marriages treated as business tools rather than personal choices. One early thread follows Sohail, who tries to escape his father’s ultimatum by asking Megh to pose as his wife, only for her bold intervention in his hotel proposal to turn a desperate lie into an unexpectedly successful business breakthrough. That strand establishes a larger pattern: women repeatedly seize control of situations that men and patriarchs think they can manage through coercion. The central conflict, however, gathers around Kiara, whose past with Rishi becomes the basis for repeated accusations that she is greedy, manipulative, or chasing status. Rishi and his mother publicly shame her, escalate from insults to cash offers and physical aggression, and try to erase her legitimacy by tying her to scandal and opportunism. Each time Kiara is cornered, a deeper layer of status and authority emerges, especially through Tej, who steps in to claim her as his wife even when others mock him as insignificant or hired help. As the humiliations move from parties to offices and family gatherings, Tej’s concealed authority as a major hotel-group CEO gradually overturns the social hierarchy that had been used against Kiara. Kiara also begins to fight back directly, revealing ties to a powerful hotel family and threatening revenge on those who tried to destroy her name. Around them, rival heiresses, patriarchs, and corporate families push arranged matches, succession plans, and alliance deals, turning romance into a battlefield for control of hotel empires and business groups. A parallel corporate struggle introduces the figure of the Queen or Sky Queen, whose strategic moves bypass expected alliances, expose corruption, and summon ministers, executives, and rivals into public confrontations. Over time, that identity converges with Kiara herself, as repeated challenges to her legitimacy culminate in the revelation that Kiara Bansal is the true Sky Queen. Even then, her enemies refuse to yield until she proves her status through an enormous transfer and a biometric confirmation, surviving both humiliation and direct threats to her life. Family conflict intensifies alongside these revelations, with Tej pressured to abandon Kiara for an arranged marriage and inheritance, yet choosing her over status and obedience. Fathers and mothers on multiple sides blame one another for broken promises, failed alliances, and damaged reputations, while younger rivals vow revenge and the feud edges into violence. By the later arc, Kiara is no longer merely defending herself from slander; she stands as a confirmed heiress and power center who can reject money-driven exes, dismiss controlling relatives, and define her own alliances. Tej, meanwhile, shifts from hidden protector and CEO to a man facing loss of power, making Kiara’s loyalty to him a meaningful reversal of the earlier rescues. The overall stakes are both intimate and dynastic: love must survive public disgrace, and identity must be proven against families and rivals who weaponize marriage, class, and corporate succession. In the end, the show’s fused arc is about a woman repeatedly called a fraud who emerges as the true center of power, and a couple who choose each other while every surrounding institution tries to separate, buy, or discredit them.

jhaadoowala-secret-agent.title: Jhaadoowala Secret Agent
jhaadoowala-secret-agent.description: A humble street sweeper, constantly humiliated for his profession, hides a powerful past—when his dignity and loved ones are threatened, his broom becomes a symbol of justice, self-respect, and redemption.

the-billionaires-journey-2.title: Second class Billionaire
the-billionaires-journey-2.description:
A honeymoon in a remote cottage turns into a nightmare when a seductive, bloodthirsty spirit begins to stalk a newlywed couple.
Driven by obsession, she wants only one thing—to claim the husband forever. A chilling tale where love, fear, and dark desire collide in terrifying ways.

brahmrakshas-3.title: Brahmrakshas
brahmrakshas-3.description: ఆ ఊరిలో బ్రహ్మ రాక్షసుడు పెళ్ళి కూతుళ్ళను ఎత్తుకుపోతుంటాడు. అది తెలిసి కూడా తన ఫ్రెండ్ నివి పెళ్ళి జరిపించడానికి అక్కడికి వచ్చింది ఈరా. ఆమె బ్రహ్మ రాక్షసుడిని ఆపగలిగిందా..? చూడండి "Brahmrakshas" మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

ghayal-mukkabaaz.title: Ghayal Mukkabaaz
ghayal-mukkabaaz.description: Ghayal Mukkabaz is a gritty boxing drama about Veer, a wounded former boxer hiding his lethal punches behind a cleaner’s mop, who must step back into the ring to protect a threatened academy, confront a ruthless boxing mafia, and unleash the fighter he has kept buried.

the-mysterious-ceo-4.title: The Mysterious CEO
the-mysterious-ceo-4.description: Meera is a beautiful young woman who has done a lot for her boyfriend, Kiran. One day, she decides to reveal her true identity. At that moment, a series of unexpected events unfold. Did Meera finally marry Kiran? Watch 'The Mysterious CEO', only on Kuku TV.

the-undercover-lady-ceo.title: The Undercover Lady CEO
the-undercover-lady-ceo.description: When TerraGem’s young VP Alisha Talwar goes undercover as an intern to expose a massive money-fraud, a ruthless social climber, Reva, steals her identity as “Mrs. Talwar” and turns the office into a bullying circus. To save her marriage, her company—and her own name—Alisha must outplay the impostor and catch the laundering ring before it destroys her.

billionaire-boyfriends-revenge.title: Billionaire Boyfriend's Revenge
billionaire-boyfriends-revenge.description: ఐదేళ్ళ తర్వాత దివ్యాని కలుసుకుని తన రహస్యం చెప్పి సర్ప్రైజ్ ఇవ్వాలనుకున్నాడు సూర్య అల్లూరి. కానీ సూర్యకు దివ్య షాక్ ఇస్తుంది. పొజిషన్ పెరగగానే దివ్య పూర్తిగా మారిపోయింది. అప్పుడు సూర్య ఏం చేసాడు? అతనికి అక్షరకి ఉన్న సంబంధం ఏంటి? చూడండి "Billionaire Boyfriend's Revenge" మీ కుకు టీవీలో

billionaire-shehzada.title: Billionaire Shehzada
billionaire-shehzada.description: Aryan Khanna kuch saal pehle apni gareeb aur budhi maa, apne bade bhai aur apne pyaar ko chhodkar gaon se shehar naukri karne chala gaya tha. Lekin jab woh wapas lauta, toh sab kuch badal chuka tha. Bade-bade businessman uske saamne sar jhukane lage the, aur khaufnaak gunde bhi uski ek nazar se kaanp jaate the. Paisa ab uske liye koi maayne nahi rakhta tha. Par sawaal ye tha — kya yeh sirf kangali se kamyabi ki dastaan thi? Ya iske peeche chhupa tha koi aisa raaz, jo sabko hila kar rakh de?

the-ghost-in-plain-sight.title: The Ghost In Plain Sight
the-ghost-in-plain-sight.description: A legendary secret agent, living a deep-cover life as a mocked and "disappointing" insurance agent, is forced to abandon his status-obsessed family when a catastrophic bio-threat emerges, leaving them to unravel the devastating truth after he stages his heroic death.

baby-loading-pyaar-pending.title: Ajnabi Rishta
baby-loading-pyaar-pending.description:
Baby Loading Pyaar Pending is an engaging story of a pregnant college student, who fights stigma, poverty, and heartbreak while hiding a marriage born of sacrifice.
A powerful CEO unknowingly crosses paths with the wife he once rejected. Fate forces truth, redemption, and love to reunite a broken family. Watch now.

lady-boss-returns-1.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns-1.description: When a powerful yet disguised billionaire businesswoman is mistaken for a waitress by a rival CEO, it sparks a chain of comical misunderstandings, heartbreaks, and power shifts — until love and identity collide, revealing that the woman everyone underestimated is, in fact, the formidable “Sky Queen” of the global Deemar Group.

the-billionaires-journey-1.title: Second Class Billionaire
the-billionaires-journey-1.description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

badri-ki-badsoorat-dulhaniya.title: Badri ki Badsoorat Dulhaniya
