badri-ki-badsoorat-dulhaniya.description: This story follows a billionaire who believes true love is felt, not seen. After a chance meeting, he searches for a mysterious girl, unaware she is a rejected daughter with a hidden beauty and painful past. As families lie and identities clash, love challenges society’s idea of beauty and proves that real connection goes deeper than the face.

the-billionaires-journey.title: The Second Class Billionaire
the-billionaires-journey.description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

temporary-shaadi-permanent-pyaar.title: Temporary Shaadi, Permanent Pyaar
temporary-shaadi-permanent-pyaar.description: A drunken Holi wedding ties Varun and Mita in an accidental marriage they both want to escape. Fate repeatedly throws them together as enemies turn allies and attraction grows into love. When truth finally surfaces, a wrong vow transforms into the right love. Watch now.

the-haunted-honeymoon-4.title: The Haunted Honeymoon
the-haunted-honeymoon-4.description:
A honeymoon in a remote cottage turns into a nightmare when a seductive, bloodthirsty spirit begins to stalk a newlywed couple.
Driven by obsession, she wants only one thing—to claim the husband forever. A chilling tale where love, fear, and dark desire collide in terrifying ways.

security-guard-to-billionaire.title: Security Guard To Billionaire
security-guard-to-billionaire.description: Humiliated as a lowly guard, Krish discovers he is the secret heir to a multi-billion dollar empire. To claim his legacy, he must survive a high-stakes corporate test while outsmarting the elites who once spat on him. From the gates of South Bombay to the halls of power, it’s a journey of absolute power and cold-blooded revenge.

beghar-raja-4.title: Beggar King
beghar-raja-4.description:
A prince framed for his own brother’s murder is forced to live as a beggar. A princess chooses him against the world. And when betrayal rises from within his own family, the fallen heir must return—not for the throne, but for justice.
But can a “beggar king” survive the war waiting for him? Watch now!

my-secret-billionaire-boyfriend-4.title: Mi Novio Multimillonario Secreto
my-secret-billionaire-boyfriend-4.description: Un drama romántico que une dos mundos distintos: un heredero cansado de ser valorado solo por su fortuna decide ocultar su identidad y vivir como un hombre común. En ese camino conoce a una joven heredera atrapada en un matrimonio concertado por las presiones familiares. Lo que inicia como un contrato por conveniencia se transforma en un lazo real, mientras ambos descubren la autenticidad y la bondad que se esconden tras sus vidas privilegiadas.

tilottama-4.title: TILOTTAMA
tilottama-4.description: When a young man returns to his ancestral village to investigate his father's mysterious death, he gets caught in a terrifying local legend about "Tilottama"—a beautiful but deadly celestial being who is reportedly hunting down men in the nearby cursed forest.

the-football-king-returns.title: The Football King Returns
the-football-king-returns.description: When India’s “Football God,” Kunal Varma, dies in a shocking crash, his soul resurfaces a decade later inside a humble stadium sweeper—just as his beloved East Delhi team is spiraling toward a lifetime ban. With a broken squad, a ruthless family takeover, and a world-class rival backed by rigged power, Kunal must reclaim the game—and the team’s fate—before everything is sold, silenced, and lost.

the-haunted-honeymoon-3.title: The Haunted Honeymoon
the-haunted-honeymoon-3.description: The microdrama unfolds as various couples find themselves inexplicably stranded in isolated locations, facing escalating tensions, mysterious encounters, and technological failures. Initially, figures like Ananya and Anand, Arjun and Shravani, and Amir with different partners, are thrust into high-stakes situations involving enigmatic drivers, secluded bungalows, and unsettling caretakers, hinting at unseen forces. The narrative soon centers on Amir, whose reality begins to unravel through terrifying hallucinations and memory loss, leading him to a dilapidated house where he encounters Malathi, an enigmatic woman who is later revealed to be a vengeful spirit from a tragic past, eternally searching for lost love. As the supernatural threat intensifies, Amir and Radhika's romance is plagued by unsettling visions and external dangers, forcing them to flee into a haunted forest where Radhika is attacked by an unseen entity. A skeptical investigator also confronts Malarthi, a malevolent entity targeting married men in a terrified village, confirming the pervasive supernatural threat. Malathi's influence grows, as she directly confronts Abhi (Amir), claiming him and holding Radhika captive, blackmailing him into a relationship for Radhika's life. Trusted figures like Mayura are revealed to be vengeful spirits, and even Jwala, initially a protective guardian, falls under Malathi's pervasive manipulation, leading to horrific acts. The elaborate trap is eventually revealed to be orchestrated by a cunning Man 2, intertwined with a sinister revenge plot by Woman 2 targeting Malathi. The series culminates in a brutal, magic-fueled conflict where Amir and Radhika fight for survival and revenge against their formidable adversary, solidifying their bond amidst the chaos, though a distant scream suggests that not all threats are fully vanquished.

rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons-4.title: Rudraroop - Revenge of Richierich Sons
rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons-4.description: The microdrama centers on Raghav, an estranged son, who returns to his affluent family for his father's 70th birthday, bringing his three sons and a mysterious gift. His arrival immediately shatters the festive atmosphere, as his mother, the proud matriarch, publicly humiliates him, deeming him "worthless" due to his divorce and perceived lack of success, while favoring his successful daughters and other relatives like Rishav. Raghav endures constant scorn and accusations of faking wealth, particularly concerning an expensive wine bottle, leading to a high-stakes bet over its authenticity and value, with public humiliation as the consequence. As the drama unfolds, Raghav is repeatedly accused of fraud, bringing cheap wine, and even attempting to harm family members, especially after Dadu collapses from suspected poisoning. The patriarch's blatant favoritism towards Rishav, who is suddenly declared a CEO and presents extravagant gifts, further fuels the family's animosity towards Raghav. The authenticity of rare wines becomes a recurring theme, leading to public challenges and accusations of technological fraud against Raghav and his son. Amidst escalating family conflicts and corporate intrigue, Raghav vehemently denies the claims, vowing to prove his innocence and defend his family's honor. He dramatically reveals his son, Prem, is the CEO of Positive Enterprises, silencing some critics, but still faces accusations of fraud from his own mother. The power struggle intensifies within the "Royal Group," with siblings Meghna and Sagar accusing Raghav of corporate deceit, and the patriarch's true CEO status being revealed, exposing deep-seated family animosity and a history of deception involving Ma and a powerful sponsor, Rishabh. Further revelations emerge as Rishabh, a formidable young heir with powerful corporate connections, returns to expose alleged corporate fraud and reveals himself as the CEO of Skyscope, disclosing that Ashok and Prem are leaders of other formidable organizations, fundamentally altering family perceptions of hidden corporate power. Despite his efforts, Raghav is ultimately disowned by the family patriarch, who reveals a devastating truth about Raghav's mother's death coinciding with his departure. Disowned by his mother and facing public humiliation, Raghav contemplates leaving his family, prompting desperate pleas for forgiveness from his younger sister, Meghna, and Thakuma, leaving the family's future and Raghav's ultimate fate uncertain.

billionaire-on-plane.title: Billionaire on Plane
billionaire-on-plane.description: Billionaire who owns the aircraft boards his own plane in a mechanic's uniform to identify why customers are not complaining so much about the airline. He gets treated badly, until the staff finds out who he is.

beghar-raja-3.title: Beghar Raja
beghar-raja-3.description: The ancient kingdom of Rudrogod faces a profound crisis as its ailing ruler, Maharaj Rudro Singh, declares his impending death, triggering an urgent succession. With his eldest brother, Prince Mahendra, critically ill, Maharaj Rudro Singh secretly designates his reluctant younger brother, Prince Veer, as the next ruler. Prince Veer grapples with grief and duty, eventually accepting the crown amidst a magical assault on the dying king. Following Maharaj Rudro Singh's brutal assassination, Prince Veer, now his successor, vows vengeance before formally ascending the throne. However, his conspicuous absence from the funeral and a soldier's damning testimony lead to accusations of regicide and fratricide against him, fueled by a cunning courtier, forcing him into exile. In exile, Prince Veer, adopting various identities like Herap and a humble beggar, arrives in Kolyangor seeking answers, where he marries Princess Debangana, defying tradition and enraging her father. He eventually reveals his true identity as the rightful Prince of Rudragarh, framed for his brother King Rudro's murder, and vows revenge, learning of a high-level conspiracy against him. Meanwhile, his kingdom faces rebellion due to lavish spending by a new Maharaj, and an advisor proposes a desperate political alliance. Prince Veer, now known as Chhoto Kumari or the "Beggar King," successfully ignites a rebellion against oppressive taxes and Zamindar Baldev, rallying the common folk. Concurrently, Prince Mahendra, driven by ambition, allies with Ananya to eliminate his brother, Prince Birendra (Veer), and orchestrates a coup against his own father, the King, whom he imprisons. Princess Vishakha, publicly humiliated and betrayed by Lord Dev Thakur and her husband Zamindar Baldev, also seeks vengeance and proposes an alliance to destroy her husband. Prince Birendra's true royal identity is revealed, and the common folk rally behind him as the "Beggar King," but a devastating betrayal from within leads to his assassination after a victory. His younger brother, Rana, then steps forward to avenge Birendra and challenge Mahendra's usurpation, culminating in a brutal sword duel for the kingdom's fate. The kingdom's future hangs on this final confrontation, with justice for the murdered king and the rightful heir at stake.

the-haunted-honeymoon-2.title: The Haunted Honeymoon
the-haunted-honeymoon-2.description:
A honeymoon in a remote cottage turns into a nightmare when a seductive, bloodthirsty spirit begins to stalk a newlywed couple.
Driven by obsession, she wants only one thing—to claim the husband forever. A chilling tale where love, fear, and dark desire collide in terrifying ways.

chaiwala-hero.title: Chaiwala Hero
chaiwala-hero.description: Separated by a terrorist attack 20 years ago, a father and son reunite on opposite sides of a billion-dollar conspiracy. One is a tycoon in disguise; the other, a tea-seller with a weapon that could change the world.

tilottama-3.title: Tilottama
tilottama-3.description: ఒక ఊరిలో ఎవరూ లేని ఇంట్లో చిక్కుకున్న ఇద్దరు కుర్రాళ్ళకి అదే ఇంట్లో అందమైన అమ్మాయి పరిచయం అవుతుంది. ఆమె పేరు తిలోత్తమ. తన అందంతో వాళ్ళకు మత్తెక్కించి ఆమె ఏం చేయనుంది? అసలు తిలోత్తమ ఎవరు? చూడండి "తిలోత్తమ" మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

social-media-ka-billionaire.title: Social Media ka Billionaire
social-media-ka-billionaire.description: A humble pizza delivery boy discovers he is the secret heir to an 8,000-crore empire but instead of revealing the truth, he chooses to stay poor and test the world that humiliated him.

arasan-journey-of-the-homeless-king.title: Arasan: Journey of the Homeless King
arasan-journey-of-the-homeless-king.description: The kingdom of Rudragar is plunged into a profound succession crisis and political turmoil following the grave illness of Maharaja Anna and the tragic murder of Maharaja Rudra Singh. Initially, war hero Veerendra is declared successor by the dying Maharaja Anna, but the assassination of Rudra Singh leads Veerendra to vow vengeance before claiming the throne. Concurrently, Prince Raghav, accused of regicide and matricide, is forced to flee, leaving the throne vacant and the council searching for a legitimate ruler. Amidst this chaos, Princess Devangana enters a scandalous marriage with a commoner, Dev, who is later revealed to be the lost Prince Veerendra, seeking justice for his murdered brother. Their forbidden love sparks intense familial disapproval and class prejudice, forcing Devangana to endure public humiliation and a harrowing Agni Pariksha to prove her husband's innocence. Veerendra, disguised as a commoner, rises as the 'Beggar King,' rallying oppressed villagers against tyrannical lords and vowing revenge against the royals who cast him out. Maharaja Mahendra Singh, initially refusing the throne and seeking truth, later becomes entangled in plots against Veerendra, even as his own Queen faces betrayal. A broader conspiracy unfolds, involving the poisoning of a Maharaja and the deployment of spies to protect a threatened throne. Veerendra eventually triumphs in brutal combat, ascending to the throne as Raja Veerendra, but his celebrated reign is tragically cut short by fratricide committed by his own younger brother. This violent act plunges the kingdom into a renewed power struggle, with a commander vying for the crown against another man sworn to avenge his elder brother, and a wronged heiress, Maha Lakshmi Devangana, confronting her past amidst desperate pleas for forgiveness.

the-haunted-honeymoon-1.title: The Haunted Honeymoon
the-haunted-honeymoon-1.description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika find themselves stalked by Malti  a beautiful, bloodthirsty spirit who wants one thing: possess Amey forever. Tension, gore and dark romance collide in this gripping horror saga.

pati-patni-aur-dhokha.title: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha
pati-patni-aur-dhokha.description: Pati, Patni aur Dhokha ek intense relationship thriller hai jo marriage, infidelity aur obsession ke dark side ko explore karta hai. Yeh kahani ek aurat ke tootne aur phir apne aap ko dobara khada karne ki journey hai. Show poochta hai—kya pyaar ke naam par har zulm maaf ho sakta hai? Aur jab ek aurat apni had se aage badh jaaye, toh kya woh victim rehti hai ya hunter ban jaati hai?

the-mysterious-ceo-2.title: The Mysterious CEO
the-mysterious-ceo-2.description: Enigmatic CEO Maitri, secretly sponsoring ambitious entrepreneur Kiran, returns to India planning to propose, only to face MD Yashwant Verma's declaration of a pre-arranged contract marriage. Kiran, unaware of Maitri's true identity, cruelly abandons her, crediting his success to a 'Mysterious CEO,' prompting Maitri's humiliation and a vow for revenge. She enters a strategic contract marriage with Kiran, challenging him as he ascends to Young Director, before dramatically revealing herself as the CEO of a rival empire at a corporate party. Maitri subtly asserts her formidable, hidden power, hinting at a powerful connection to Varma gaaru, who shockingly introduces her as his wife in a strategic move. This 'marriage' is later exposed as a pretense by Yashwant's traditionalist grandfather, igniting a fierce family conflict. Amidst corporate battles, Maitri, strongly implied to be the long-hidden heiress and CEO of Vardhan Empire, orchestrates an elaborate revenge plot against Yashwant for past betrayals, while also being deeply in love with researcher Kiran Kumar. Ambitious heiress Nayanthara schemes to claim Yashwant and his empire, proposing a strategic marriage to clear his family's debts. Maithri, initially dismissed and publicly shamed by her ex-fiancé Kiran, dramatically reveals her true billionaire status, flipping the power dynamic. She exposes Kiran's fraudulent career and past sacrifices, rejecting his desperate pleas for reconciliation. Ultimately, Maithri, unmasked as the CEO and heiress, embarks on a campaign of retribution to reclaim her empire. She finds reciprocated love with Yashwant, who values her beyond her wealth and status, culminating in a dramatic showdown at the G29 summit.

billionaire-heroine-ka-comeback.title: Billionaire Heroine Ka Comeback
billionaire-heroine-ka-comeback.description: Drishti, a famous screenwriter who hid her identity to marry Naitik. Treated like an unpaid maid and framed by his sister-in-law, she finally accepts a divorce. Reclaiming her status as a powerful heiress, Drishti returns to the spotlight to adapt her hit story for the big screen. As she rises, her past and present collide in a high-stakes tale of revenge and redemption.

beghar-raja-2.title: Beghar Raja
beghar-raja-2.description:
A prince framed for his own brother’s murder is forced to live as a beggar. A princess chooses him against the world. And when betrayal rises from within his own family, the fallen heir must return—not for the throne, but for justice.
But can a “beggar king” survive the war waiting for him? Watch now!

ek-anjana-rishta.title: Ek Anjana Rishta
ek-anjana-rishta.description: Consumed by grief for a past love, Samrat orchestrates a mysterious 'game' that intertwines with the arrival of a vibrant woman also named Shreya. This new Shreya faces devastating betrayal when her fiancé abandons her, prompting Samrat to propose a contract marriage to save her family's honor. Their unconventional union is fraught with hidden identities, as Samrat, a wealthy heir and presumed-dead CEO, defies his disapproving father. As Shreya enters his corporate world, a jealous rival plots her downfall, leading to corporate intrigue and the dramatic exposure of their secret marriage. Samrat's powerful father fiercely opposes their relationship, threatening Samrat's life-saving medical treatment. To ensure his survival, Shreya, now pregnant, makes the agonizing decision to leave him, a departure that tragically culminates in a car crash, resulting in her presumed death and the loss of their unborn child, leaving Samrat consumed by guilt. Years later, a young girl named Jia desperately seeks funds for her critically ill mother's urgent surgery, unaware that her mother is the presumed-dead Shreya. Samrat, now a hospital owner, still grieves his past love, rejecting his controlling father's attempts to arrange a new marriage. A striking resemblance between young Jia and Samrat, coupled with a discarded ring, hints at a profound, hidden familial connection, prompting a secret DNA test. The test confirms Samrat's paternity, leading to an emotional reunion with his presumed-dead love, Shreya, and their daughter, Jia. However, this reunion is violently interrupted by Samrat's vengeful fiancée, who vows revenge. An ambitious Kavya schemes to marry Samrat and seize family assets, ruthlessly obstructing Jia's attempts to secure medical help for her mother. Jia's grandfather, Mr. Singh, intervenes to protect his newly discovered family, seeking to atone for past wrongs. He orchestrates Shreya and Samrat's marriage, revealing Samrat was previously Jia's "papa." A bitter rivalry between Shreya and Kavya escalates, fueled by Kavya's jealousy and manipulative schemes. Ultimately, Kavya's long history of betrayal is exposed through violent confrontations and accidents, leading to her arrest. Shreya fights to legitimize her relationship with Samrat and protect their daughter, navigating a complex web of family secrets and ambition towards a hopeful future.

surya-vamsam-fire-of-humiliation-2.title: Surya Vamsam: Fire of Humiliation
surya-vamsam-fire-of-humiliation-2.description: Rajendran’s dream, Guna Sekar’s plan, Adith’s revenge — when blood mixes with business, who survives? Watch now!

suryavamsha-fire-of-humiliation-1.title: Suryavamsha : Fire of Humiliation
suryavamsha-fire-of-humiliation-1.description: Rajendran’s dream, Guna Sekar’s plan, Adith’s revenge — when blood mixes with business, who survives? Watch now!

mera-pati-mera-ghulam.title: Slumdog Superhero
mera-pati-mera-ghulam.description: A poor kachori seller, forced into a royal marriage and humiliated at every step, discovers that he carries an ancient cosmic power, one that can change his fate and shake an entire empire.

the-haunted-honeymoon.title: The Haunted Honeymoon
the-haunted-honeymoon.description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika step into a nightmare they never saw coming. They are stalked by Malati, a hauntingly beautiful and bloodthirsty spirit obsessed with one thing, possessing Amey forever. As love turns into terror, tension and forbidden dark romance spiral into a chilling horror saga.

smashing-champion.title: Smashing Champion
smashing-champion.description: Smashing Champion is an inspiring sports drama about a mysterious janitor-turned-coach who transforms broken, underestimated players into fearless winners—teaching them that true strength comes not from power, but from belief, discipline, and inner awakening.

tilottama-a-horror-story.title: Tilottama – A Horror Story
tilottama-a-horror-story.description: Two city boys enter a cursed village, unaware they’ve stepped into a deadly trap. Drawn to a mysterious, beautiful woman, they slowly realize her charm hides something supernatural. Is she Tilottama—the enchantress whose beauty seduces… and destroys?

tilottama-2.title: Tilottama
tilottama-2.description:
Tilottama is a witch driven by an insatiable hunger to spend nights with men. But she preys only on those men who, despite having wives at home, fall into the snare of Tilottama’s beauty.

Every full-moon night, when the moon rises in the sky and the flowers on the trees of Rooppur begin to turn from white to red, the villagers understand that Tilottama has claimed her victim. A strange silence envelops the village, and people shut themselves inside their homes.

badmash-of-bollywood.title: Badmash of Bollywood
badmash-of-bollywood.description: In the ruthless world of Bollywood, a newcomer actress is pulled into a toxic love triangle with a manipulative superstar and his powerful mentor only to discover that fame, love, and survival come at a devastating cost.

suryavamsha-fire-of-humiliation.title: Suryavamsha: Fire of Humiliation
suryavamsha-fire-of-humiliation.description: Rajendran’s dream, Guna Sekar’s plan, Adith’s revenge — when blood mixes with business, who survives? Watch now!

damaad-returns.title: Super Damaad
damaad-returns.description: “A humble son-in-law humiliated and thrown out by his greedy in-laws returns years later as a powerful, self-made man. When secrets explode and tables turn, the family that once insulted him is forced to face the damaad they never valued.”

beghar-raja-1.title: രാജാധിപതി - The Tale of a Crownless King
beghar-raja-1.description: A prince framed for his own brother’s murder is forced to live as a beggar. A princess chooses him against the world. And when betrayal rises from within his own family, the fallen heir must return—not for the throne, but for justice. But can a “beggar king” survive the war waiting for him? Watch now!

god-of-cricket.title: Valentine Billionaire
god-of-cricket.description: A humble toy-store worker is pulled into the stormy world of a fallen cricket legend when an unexpected pregnancy ties their fates together—sparking love, danger, and a battle for family.

my-toxic-kadhali.title: My Toxic Kadhali
my-toxic-kadhali.description:
A powerful heir’s romance with a glamorous influencer turns toxic when jealousy twists love into obsession.
A shocking misunderstanding ignites a brutal clash between a possessive bride and a grieving mother. Under the unforgiving glare of social media, lies shatter bonds—and only one truth will survive.

billionaire-ki-virgin-surrogate.title: Waaris Par Bawaal
billionaire-ki-virgin-surrogate.description: A ruthless billionaire, Nutan Kharbanda, forces a poor young woman, Divya, into surrogacy to secure a family heir, exploiting her mother’s illness. Inside the mansion, Divya faces humiliation, betrayal, and deadly conspiracies. As truth unfolds, love grows between Divya and Ranveer, exposing lies, punishing evil, and turning a cruel contract into justice and redemption.

maharakshak-2.title: Maharakshak
maharakshak-2.description: Orphaned as a child and raised under a false name, Meera/Ujjala discovers she is the true heir of the Rajput clan. Alongside the brave Maharaj Siddharth, she must rise from an ordinary girl to a fearless warrior to protect Uttam Nagar from the ruthless demon king Rana Lanka and his dark forces. A tale of hidden identity, courage, and destiny where an ordinary man becomes truly veer.

the-ultimate-boss-4.title: The Ultimate Boss
the-ultimate-boss-4.description: Vedant, a hidden billionaire, sacrifices his identity for love—only to be betrayed by the very woman he trusted most. Fate binds him to powerful businesswoman Tara in a contract marriage, where love, revenge, and secrets collide. In this storm of emotions, emerges… The Ultimate Boss.

breakup-se-bana-billionaire.title: Breakup Se Bana Billionaire
breakup-se-bana-billionaire.description: After being dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, struggling techie Aditya impulsively marries a stranger, Preeti, unaware she is a billionaire CEO. What begins as a deal-driven marriage turns explosive when Aditya is revealed to be the long-lost heir of a powerful business family, and the very man who humiliated him becomes his rival. As love, identity, and ambition collide, Aditya must choose between revenge, legacy, and the woman who believed in him first.

maharakshak-1.title: Maharakshak
maharakshak-1.description: Orphaned as a child and raised under a false name, Meera/Ujjala discovers she is the true heir of the Rajput clan. Alongside the brave Maharaj Siddharth, she must rise from an ordinary girl to a fearless warrior to protect Uttam Nagar from the ruthless demon king Rana Lanka and his dark forces. nikamma-chairman-1.title: Nikamma Chairman
nikamma-chairman-1.description:
Sukesh, a secret billionaire, hides his identity for 15 years for his wife Sheela. On her birthday, he discovers she's partying with another man Pran. Despite giving her his kidney, she calls him useless. Pran slaps Sheela and frames Sukesh for domestic violence. Police arrest the innocent husband while the cheating wife and her lover celebrate. From billionaire to jail — a story of betrayal and revenge.

**WATCH NOW**

waiting-for-love-8.title: Waiting for Love
waiting-for-love-8.description:
Here are **three clean English lines**:

Aditya Singhania, India’s biggest businessman, had been living a lonely life for years until his daughter Tanvi encouraged him to find companionship again. Tanvi’s chance encounter with Ruhi—a woman broken by her past, with no home and no support—changed everything. Aditya married Ruhi while hiding his true identity, unaware that this secret would turn their new beginning into a dramatic twist of fate.

aakhri-udaan.title: Aakhri Udaan
aakhri-udaan.description: The show is an aviation thriller about Nishant, an Air Traffic Controller who saves a passenger flight by breaking protocol but is betrayed and framed by his wife and her lover. Disgraced and broken, Nishant is mysteriously given a second chance to relive the same day. This time, he lets the truth unfold, exposing the real culprits without losing his integrity. Starting afresh as a fighter pilot trainer, Nishant rebuilds his life, purpose, and faith. Watch now!

sorry-not-a-gold-digger-5.title: Sorry Not a Gold Digger
sorry-not-a-gold-digger-5.description: When hardworking delivery girl Tara crosses paths with billionaire heir Rohan Mehta through a twist of fate, their unexpected flash marriage sparks a journey filled with secrets, clashes, and unspoken love. As Tara struggles to protect her dignity and dreams, and Rohan hides his true identity, will this unlikely union blossom into real love or collapse under lies and pride? Watch Now "Sorry Not a Gold Digger" on Kuku TV.

layak-nalayak-haryanvi.title: Layak Nalayak
layak-nalayak-haryanvi.description: The microdrama centers on the profound betrayal of elderly parents, Gayatri and Raghunath (Papa), by their ambitious son, Siddharth, and the subsequent quest for truth and justice by their other son, Kabir. Gayatri and Raghunath make immense sacrifices, including selling their home, to fund Siddharth's education, only for him to achieve success and cruelly disown them, driven by shame over his humble origins and pressure from his materialistic wife. Siddharth forces his parents into a dangerous charade, presenting them as strangers or servants to maintain his fabricated identity as an orphan. Meanwhile, Kabir, initially believed to be adopted by Gayatri and Balraj, returns home after years abroad to discover his adoptive father's accident and the mysterious vanishing of his adoptive parents, leaving a cryptic message about Siddharth and raising questions about his true parentage and a potential sibling rivalry. As the narrative unfolds, Gayatri and Raghunath endure escalating abuse and public humiliation at the hands of Siddharth, his wife, and a cruel matriarch, including false accusations of theft and physical assault. Siddharth initially stands by, even suggesting his mother return a missing ring, but eventually finds it, showing a flicker of remorse. However, Kabir emerges as a fiercely protective son, rising to become a powerful CEO, vowing to defend his parents and uncover the truth behind their torment. He orchestrates events to challenge Siddharth's facade, ultimately exposing Siddharth's shocking deception: that he has been hiding his biological parents, presenting them as servants to his unsuspecting wife. This devastating revelation leads to Kabir vowing severe retribution against Siddharth for abandoning their shared parents, terminating all financial backing for Siddharth's ventures. Facing financial ruin, Siddharth and his wife plot sinister actions against his parents, including forced consumption of poisonous soup, and devise manipulative plans to reclaim their fortunes. Ultimately, Gayatri and Raghunath, deeply humiliated by their sons' actions and the public shame, decide to abandon city life for their ancestral village, seeking honor and peace despite Kabir's desperate pleas for forgiveness and reconciliation. The show explores the devastating impact of denying one's roots, the corrosive nature of social ambition, and the enduring power of familial bonds and the quest for dignity.

super-dad.title: Super Dad
super-dad.description: Kabir is an ordinary man abandoned by his wife for a wealthy man and his family, leaving Kabir to raise their infant daughter Jiya alone. A mysterious Super Dad Reward System activates, testing Kabir’s love and sacrifice for ten years. When Jiya’s own mother returns, ready to trade her daughter’s life for power and status, Kabir is forced to stand against the most painful enemy of all.

happily-never-after-tamasha.title: Felices Nunca Jamás
happily-never-after-tamasha.description: Happily Never After sigue a Rajveer Singhania, cuya vida se convierte en un caos cuando su prometida, Veda Mehta, confunde a su cuñada embarazada, Shanaya Birla, con su amante. Lo que comienza como un malentendido en un compromiso se convierte en una oscura y retorcida historia de traición, violencia y verdades impactantes.

dhurandhar-nishaanebaz.title: Dhoorandhar Nishaanebaz
dhurandhar-nishaanebaz.description: Elite sniper Rohan, attempting to live a reformed life, finds his violent past relentlessly endangering a family he protects, particularly Pihu, and a woman named Sharan/Radha, as his extraordinary sharpshooting skills hint at a legendary identity. The narrative quickly introduces multiple threats: a manipulative brother-in-law, Sandy, challenges Rohan for property and Sharan, while a crime boss seeks to eliminate Purohit, a target once saved by the legendary "Gun Master G9." Concurrently, Sharanpreet Kaur, a grieving widow and academy leader, faces the imminent seizure of her academy by her late husband's ruthless uncle, Kuber, due to a shocking debt. High-stakes shooting competitions are proposed to settle the land dispute, where Rohan, initially an unassuming worker, emerges as a crucial, albeit unconventional, contender. Rohan's impossible "curve shot" and superhuman precision in these competitions draw the attention of powerful figures, including the enraged Bakshi and the ruthless criminal Kamil, who attempts to recruit him, solidifying his connection to the legendary "Gun Master G9," an identity he tries to escape. The plot thickens with the introduction of Kiara, a formidable sharp shooter deployed by Bakshi, whose past is mysteriously linked to G9; she flawlessly executes G9's signature technique, yet the true Gunmaster G9 later denounces her, hinting at a deeper betrayal or misunderstanding. As Rohan, now known by aliases like "Grandmaster G9," grapples with his past, he becomes embroiled in a vast conspiracy orchestrated by Kamil, involving national security threats, hostage situations, and AI-generated deception, with Pihu as a target. Personal stakes escalate as Rohan is blamed for his mentor Kabir's death by Kabir's widow, Shalini, and Komal confronts G9 with the devastating truth that her husband died saving him. Pihu's unwavering belief in the power of "G9" becomes a catalyst, leading the legendary Gunmaster G9 to break his sacred vow of non-violence to avenge harm done to her. His re-emergence as Rohan Batra, an elite operative, shocks criminal kingpins and makes him a target for a shadowy mastermind orchestrating a national assassination plot. Amidst this chaos, a "Terrorist G9" kidnaps operative Kamil's family, forcing Kamil into an assassination plot, which the heroic Gun Master G9 intervenes to stop. The show culminates in brutal confrontations, with Rohan (Gunmaster G9) ultimately returning to reunite with his daughter, Pihu, and atone for past regrets, having confronted his violent past and safeguarded his loved ones and nation.

maharakshak.title: Maharakshak
maharakshak.description: Orphaned as a child and raised under a false name, Meera/Ujjala discovers she is the true heir of the Rajput clan. Alongside the brave Maharaj Siddharth, she must rise from an ordinary girl to a fearless warrior to protect Uttam Nagar from the ruthless demon king Rana Lanka and his dark forces. A tale of hidden identity, courage, and destiny where an ordinary man becomes truly veer.

revenge-of-my-loyal-boyfriend.title: La Venganza de Mi Novio Fiel
revenge-of-my-loyal-boyfriend.description:
Rajat era un chico humilde y leal… hasta que su ambiciosa novia lo humilló públicamente por no tener dinero ni estatus.
Pero todos quedan en shock cuando regresa a la India como el esposo de la CEO más poderosa y hermosa del país.
Descubre ‘La Venganza de Mi Novio Falso’ — una historia intensa de amor, traición… y venganza.

kohinoor-king-returns.title: Kohinoor King Returns
kohinoor-king-returns.description: Aisha, a devoted mother, is initially ensnared in a web of familial manipulation and forced marriages, desperate to save her critically ill daughter, Kiara. Her royal husband, Dev, repeatedly intervenes to protect her from these schemes, including attempts to marry her to a deceased man and later to Mr. Khanna for funds. The enigmatic "Kohinoor Token" emerges as a central element, promising salvation for Kiara but also fueling intense rivalries and deceptions among powerful families like the Khannas and Mittals. Aisha is coerced into contract marriages and even servitude, sacrificing her freedom to secure Kiara's medical treatment and protect Dev, who is secretly a powerful ruler. Dev, revealing hidden authority, fiercely protects Aisha and Kiara, confronting antagonists like Harsh Mittal over alleged organ trafficking and battling a corrupt medical system to save Kiara's life, even performing an unauthorized surgery. As the conflict escalates, the "Kohinoor" evolves from a token to a rare medicinal fruit, crucial for Kiara's survival, and eventually to a powerful, enigmatic entity or person who exerts immense influence. Aisha finds herself at the center of corporate intrigue, forced into strategic alliances and marriages, particularly with the powerful CEO Mr. Mehra, to secure vital projects like the "City in the Sky." Dev, her secret husband, consistently defies these pressures, publicly declaring his marriage to Aisha and vowing to protect her from exploitation and manipulative family agendas. The powerful "The Kohinoor" ultimately issues a decree for Aisha to marry him, sparking fierce rivalries with other women. Throughout these trials, Aisha fights for her agency and dignity, while Dev relentlessly battles to dismantle criminal enterprises, challenge corrupt systems, and ensure the safety and well-being of Aisha and Kiara, amidst a complex web of power, sacrifice, and enduring love.

blood-of-the-billionaire.title: Blood of the Billionaire
blood-of-the-billionaire.description: For 15 years, the powerful Raichand family has been consumed by a desperate search for their lost heir, Ishaan, whose disappearance leaves their corporate empire in limbo. Simultaneously, an aspiring musician named Tarun endures a life of brutal servitude and humiliation within the opulent Bhatnagar household, tormented by the cruel "Young Master" Aviraj. Tarun's raw talent is recognized by a compassionate stranger, offering him a chance at a prestigious music competition, a potential path to freedom. The Raichand family's quest takes a dramatic turn when patriarch Omkaar learns his abducted son was left at a residence 15 years ago, a timeframe that eerily aligns with Tarun's own separation from his family. A manipulative matriarch reluctantly admits to sheltering an abused orphan, hinting at Tarun's potential connection to the lost heir. The narrative then introduces a dramatic discovery of Ishaan, identified by an heirloom bracelet, but this reunion is immediately complicated by Nupur's scheme to present an imposter, which Omkar thwarts, revealing Nupur's own hidden son, also named Tarun. The true Ishaan is subsequently held captive and tormented by a manipulative old woman and her accomplice, who plot to steal his identity and fortune. Meanwhile, the talented singer Tarun faces sadistic torment from the "Young Master" Aviraj, who is determined to crush his musical aspirations, forcing him to endure brutal humiliation for a chance at the competition. A complex battle for identity ensues as two young men, Ishan and another Tarun, emerge claiming to be the rightful Raichand heir, leading to mandated DNA tests. One Tarun is revealed as a false heir, while another, severely injured and abducted, has his voice jeopardized. This injured Tarun survives an assassination attempt and is brought into the Raichand household, sparking animosity from the imposter Ishan. A distinctive burn mark on his leg and a definitive DNA test ultimately confirm this Tarun's true identity as Ishaan Raichand, the long-lost heir. Now identified as Ishaan, he prepares for a singing competition to seek vindication against Viraj Bhatnagar, with the Raichand family ruthlessly sabotaging rivals to secure his success. During this high-stakes event, Ishaan Raichand's true identity as the long-lost heir is publicly revealed. Finally, Mr. Raichand exposes the imposter Ishan and introduces the true Ishaan (formerly Tarun) as the rightful heir at a high-society party. He then uncovers a sinister plot by Komal and Viraj to murder Ishaan and usurp the family empire, leading to their arrest and Ishaan's reinstatement as the rightful owner of the Raichand Group, concluding a saga of hidden identities, betrayal, and a desperate fight for truth and survival.

obsessed-with-my-dead-girlfriend.title: Obsessed With My Dead Girlfriend
obsessed-with-my-dead-girlfriend.description: The microdrama begins with Dr. Rajat, recently discharged from a psychiatric institution, haunted by his deceased girlfriend Simran and convinced he is her extension, seeking a 'victim.' This dark delusion coincides with a high-society wedding disrupted by an explosion and murder, where groom Kunal Thapar is implicated, while another Simran is brutally kidnapped, prompting her loved one, Sameer, to plan meticulous revenge. Corporate power struggles emerge as a powerful matriarch and later Rita demand critically injured Karan be kept alive for answers, with Rajat identified as Karan's suspected attacker. Rajat, now a hospital director, secretly allies with heiress Vishakha, who is also Rita's abusive boss, orchestrating manipulations that endanger Rita. As the narrative progresses, Vishakha and Aryan initiate a chilling revenge plot, while Vishakha's rivalry with Reeta intensifies, revealing past attempted murder and leading to Vishakha's torture. Vishakha uncovers Dr. Rajat's involvement in Simran's murder, leading to a violent confrontation, yet later forms an alliance with him against Kunal. Rajat, consumed by guilt over Simran's car crash death, transforms into a doctor seeking revenge, forming an alliance with a gravely injured man to expose a corporate conspiracy by Vishakha. However, Vishakha is strategically rescued by Rajat, who offers an alliance for redemption, even as she is drawn into a perilous game by Karan, who plans her torture and death. The central conflict deepens as Vishakha embarks on a mission to clear her family's name, uncovering a conspiracy and the betrayal of her former associate, Karan, who falsely accuses her of murder. She discovers her trusted confidant, Kunal, is "The Doctor," a ruthless mastermind who entrapped her. Rajat, meanwhile, confronts Hitesh over a crime against Simran, revealing a dangerous counter-plan. Kunal, manipulated by a mysterious Hospital Director with a vendetta against the Singhania family, brutally interrogates and murders Karan for Simran's postmortem report. A major turning point sees Vishakha, having survived Kunal's machinations, resurface under the identity of Simran, meticulously orchestrated by Rajat for a revenge plot against Kunal. This transformed Vishakha systematically causes Kunal's financial ruin, leading to his obsessive desire for her and his suspicion that she is his presumed-dead fiancée. Rajat's true, elaborate revenge scheme against Vishakha is then unveiled, revealing their entire relationship was a manipulation to expose her role in Simran's death and destroy both her and Kunal. The show culminates in Rajat publicly humiliating Vishakha, confessing to orchestrating murders to achieve his retribution. Amidst accusations of a "pre-planned crime," Rajat proposes to Simran (or her replica), only for his jealous sister to violently interrupt, igniting a brutal family conflict. In a separate but intertwined arc, Rajat is consumed by grief and a vow of vengeance for his murdered beloved Simran, believing in reincarnation, while facing the enigmatic Gauri, who seeks to sever their bond. Ultimately, Rajat makes a profound act of sacrifice, confessing to a crime to ensure Simran's safety, plunging their romance into a gripping crime drama where love and loyalty are tested by severe legal repercussions.

maha-rakshak.title: Maha Rakshak
maha-rakshak.description: The microdrama begins with Meera, the last heir of the Sun Deity lineage, whose memories were erased by a Guru after witnessing her family's massacre; she is now known as Urmila, a formidable warrior destined to reclaim her heritage. Concurrently, Maharaja Siddharth, deeply in love with Urmila, defiantly rejects a forced political marriage to the daughter of Rana Lanka, the ruthless king who murdered his parents, igniting a brutal war. Rana Lanka besieges Siddharth's kingdom and attempts to abduct Urmila, while a prophecy reveals that only a descendant of Meera's revered lineage can defeat him. The conflict intensifies with Urmila's unwavering loyalty to Siddharth, but a shocking betrayal by Kranthi, who publicly accuses Urmila and aligns with Rana Lanka, further jeopardizes Siddharth's rule and Urmila's honor. The kingdom plunges into escalating conflicts, leading to King Siddharth's tragic fall in battle against Urmila, who is revealed to be Meera. Urmila herself tragically dies in battle but is mysteriously revived by Durga, who restores her lost memories, reveals her divine heritage, and a preordained marriage to Siddharth as crucial for their kingdom's survival. Urmila then undertakes a perilous mystical meditation to harness her latent powers, protected by Durgamma. Later, Urmila confronts the malevolent Kali, revealed as Keshava Rajaputhra, her long-lost uncle, who shatters her family and reveals a devastating secret about her daughter, also named Meera, the prophesied 'heir of the Bhaskara deity.' This younger Meera, with burgeoning magical abilities, embarks on a perilous journey to save King Siddharth (or his legacy) and fulfill her destiny, eventually discovering a divine weapon and declaring war against Kali. Kali is defeated by this mysterious princess, Meera, the formidable heir of the Sun Deity. Eighteen years later, the demon overlord returns to demand the surrender of Princess Urmila and her people, who defiantly refuse, setting the stage for an epic battle. Fueled by a fierce vow of vengeance, Meera Rajput (the daughter) confronts the sadistic sorceress Kalikeya Devi, who manipulates Meera's resurrected mother and controlled father against her. Meera is forced into heart-wrenching battles against her own family, but guided by a wise mentor, she embraces her destiny as a warrior. After her father's tragic death in battle, Meera engages in a brutal, mythologically-infused battle against Kalikeya Devi, ultimately defeating her to avenge her parents and restore peace and honor to her kingdom.

layak-nalayak-bhojpuri.description: 2 Bete, Same Parvarish, Different outcome. One is representation of Lord Ram and other completely opposite.

mr-mrs-mafia.title: Mr. & Mrs. Mafia
mr-mrs-mafia.description: Star-crossed lovers Dhruv and Nakshatra lead a quiet life as a chef and a florist, each hiding a lethal secret: they are the heirs to rival mafia empires. When a bloody underworld war forces them back into the shadows, they unknowingly become each other’s deadliest targets.

layak-nalayak-marwari.title: Layak Nalayak
layak-nalayak-marwari.description: 2 Bete, Same Parvarish, Different outcome. One is representation of Lord Ram and other completely opposite.

my-dangerous-love.title: My Dangerous Love
my-dangerous-love.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous arranged marriage between Pankhudi, a woman facing class-based humiliation, and Siddhanth Sinha, a charismatic street fighter and reluctant heir to a dangerous criminal empire. Their union, initially scorned by socialite Sonia and orchestrated by family machinations, is complicated by Siddhanth's hidden identity as the grandson of a notorious gangster, Nanu. Despite initial animosity, their relationship deepens as Siddhanth becomes fiercely protective of Pankhudi, publicly defending her against mockery and choosing her love over material wealth. However, their bond is constantly tested by Siddhanth's frequent disappearances to confront rival gangs, leaving Pankhudi isolated and vulnerable to torment. Siddhanth's brutal retaliation against those who harm Pankhudi reveals the perilous depths of his underworld connections, leading to their disownment by families. Pankhudi attempts to assert her independence by working undercover, navigating corporate deceit and fierce rivalries within the powerful Shetty family, headed by Siddhanth's grandfather, Damodar Shetty. Their marriage faces further strain with the manipulative return of Kavya, Siddhanth's ex-girlfriend, who attempts to reclaim him by fabricating a past leukemia diagnosis. The revelation of Pankhudi's pregnancy strengthens the couple's resolve and elicits a protective, violent warning from the family patriarch to Kavya. Kavya's obsession escalates into a deranged plot: she poisons Nanu, frames Pankhudi, and orchestrates her abduction. Siddhanth races against time to rescue his pregnant wife, ultimately confronting Kavya, who holds Pankhudi and their unborn child hostage with an activated explosive device. In a tragic climax, despite Siddhanth's desperate efforts and unwavering love, he is killed in a subsequent explosion. Pankhudi is left devastated, while a determined ally vows retribution against those responsible, leaving the future uncertain for the grieving widow and her unborn child.

adv-charulatha-ma-llm-season-1.title: Adv. Charulatha MA, LLM - Season 1
adv-charulatha-ma-llm-season-1.description: കേരളത്തെ പിടിച്ചുലച്ച മഹിമ കൊലക്കേസില്‍ വാദം കേള്‍ക്കാനിരിക്കെ പ്രതിഭാഗത്തിനായി ഹാജരാകുന്നതാരെന്ന് കാണാന്‍ കാത്തിരിക്കുകയാണ് ജനങ്ങള്‍. കല്ലേറുകള്‍ മാത്രം ഏറ്റുവാങ്ങിക്കൊണ്ട് കേസേറ്റെടുക്കുമ്പോള്‍ ചാരുലത മുന്നില്‍ കണ്ടത് എന്തൊക്കെയാണ്. മഹിമയുടെ കൊലക്കേസിന് പുറമേ ഭാര്യയുടെ മിസിങ് കേസിലും സംശയദൃഷ്ടികള്‍ ഉയരുമ്പോള്‍ ഫെലിക്‌സിന്റെ നിരപരാധിത്വം തെളിയിക്കാന്‍ ചാരുലതയ്്ക്ക് കഴിയുമോ?!!

girlfriend-by-chance.title: Girlfriend By Chance
girlfriend-by-chance.description: Aditya Rajvansh ek arrogant billionaire hai jo emotions aur pyaar se door bhaagta hai. Par ek din uski zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab uski gaadi ek anjaani ladki, Sneha se takra jati hai. Accident ke baad Sneha apni yaadein kho baithti hai aur galti se Aditya ko apna boyfriend samajh leti hai. Majboori mein Aditya use apne saath rakh leta hai, par dheere-dheere jazbaat badalne lagte hain. Kya yeh sirf ek misunderstanding hai ya taqdeer ne inhe ek saath laane ki koshish ki hai? Ya phir Sneha ka beeta hua kal inka aane wala kal tabaah kar dega?

എൻ-മോഹനന്റെ-കഥകൾ-സമ്പൂർണം-.title: എൻ മോഹനന്റെ കഥകൾ സമ്പൂർണ്ണം
എൻ-മോഹനന്റെ-കഥകൾ-സമ്പൂർണം-.description: ഇരുപതാം നൂറ്റാണ്ടിന്റെ രണ്ടാം പകുതിയിലെ കേരളത്തിന്റെ സാംസ്കാരിക-സാമൂഹിക ജീവിതത്തെ സമഗ്രമായി ആവിഷ്കരിക്കുന്നതാണു എൻ. മോഹനന്റെ കഥാലോകം. നനുത്ത ഹൃദയഹാരിയായ ഭാഷയിൽ മോഹനൻ്റെ കഥകൾ നമ്മോട് സംവേദിക്കുന്നത് ജീവിതത്തിൻ്റെ  സൂക്ഷ്മധ്വനികളാണു. കാല്പനിക സുന്ദരമായ ശ്രുതിയിൽ മന്ത്രിക്കുന്ന ഈ കഥകൾ  ഒരോന്നും മനസ്സിനെ മഥിക്കുന്ന ഭാവഗീതങ്ങളാണു.

kuttanweshanathinte-kanappurangal.title: Kuttanweshanathinte Kanappurangal
kuttanweshanathinte-kanappurangal.description: സംഭവബഹുലമായ ഔദ്യോഗിക ജീവിതത്തിൽ നിന്നും വിരമിച്ച ശേഷം എൻ. രാമചന്ദ്രൻ ഐ.പി.എസ് എഴുതുന്ന അനുഭവകഥകൾ. അസാധാരണവും സ്തോഭജനകവുമായ അനേകം കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങളുടെ ഉള്ളറകളിലേക്ക് ഈ കുറിപ്പികൾ വെളിച്ചം വീശുന്നു. കേരളീയ പൊതുസമൂഹം വിറങ്ങലിപ്പോടെ മാത്രം ഓർക്കുന്ന അനവധി സംഭവങ്ങൾ ഈ കഥകളിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു. കേൾക്കാൻ കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങളുടെ പിന്നാമ്പുറങ്ങളിലേക്ക് നമ്മെ നയിക്കുന്ന കുറിപ്പുകൾ.

phusphusate-jungle-ka-rahasya.title: Phusphusate Jungle ka Rahasya
phusphusate-jungle-ka-rahasya.description: Ek raaz se bhara jungle, jahan har ped ek bhooli-bisri yaad ko sametkar rakhta hai. Anika, ek rakshak, apne dukh bhulane ke liye is jungle ki gehraiyon mein jaati hai, lekin jald hi use ehsaas hota hai ki yeh jungle sirf yaadon ka nahi, balki uske apne ateet ka bhi hissa hai. Purane dushman jungle ke raaz ko mitana chahte hain, aur Anika ko ise bachane ke liye ek pracheen shakti jagani hogi. Lekin kya woh apne mission mein safal ho paayegi?  Ya uska apna ateet hi uski sabse badi rukawat ban jaayegi ?

happy-holidays.title: Happy holidays
happy-holidays.description: Nithya'vum Mithran'um friends aanathe, avangaloda pasanga ore school la padikkuradhu naala dhaan. Rendu perume thani thaniya pala pala veetu prachanaigala face pannitu irukum nilai la, oru mukkiya sandharppam moolama Nithya oda veetla mithran'um, Mithran oda veetla Nithya'um rendu vaaram thanguraanga. Thodarndhu uravugalukkulla enna nadakkum.

major-mukund-varadarajan.title: Major Mukund Varadarajan
major-mukund-varadarajan.description: Naatukaaga than uyiraiye arpanitha veera thamizhanin unarchikaramaana unmai kathai. Miss pannaama kelunga 🎧

phir-bhi-tumko-chahunga.title: Phir Bhi Tumko Chahunga
phir-bhi-tumko-chahunga.description: Naina ki shaadi ke din, uska beeta hua pyaar Aman achanak laut aata hai, ek aise raaz ke saath jo sab kuch badal sakta hai. Saat saal pehle juda ho chuke dono ek baar phir samne hain—unsuljhe jazbaat, adhure sapne aur beete dukhon ke saath. Kya Naina apni nayi zindagi aur samaj ki umeedon ko chunegi, ya phir Aman ka pyaar ek baar phir uska dil jeet lega? Kya beete hue rishte dobara zinda ho sakte hain, ya kuch kahaniyan hamesha adhuri hi reh jaati hain?

sooryane-aninja-oru-sthree.title: Sooryane Aninja Oru Sthree
sooryane-aninja-oru-sthree.description: കെ. ആർ. മീരയുടെ മറ്റൊരു ക്ലാസിക്ക് നോവൽ, മിതഭാഷിയും അന്തർമുഖയുമായിരുന്ന ജെസിബല്ലിൽ നിന്ന് സാമൂഹ്യ നിയമങ്ങളെ വെല്ലുവിളിക്കുന്ന കരുത്തുറ്റ ജെസിബലിലേക്കുളള വളർച്ചയാണു ഈ ഗ്രന്ഥം. ഒരു നിയമവ്യവഹാരത്തിൻ്റെ സങ്കീർണതകളെ മുൻ നിറുത്തി അവതരിപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന അതിശക്തയായ സ്ത്രീ കഥാപാത്രം. അനേകം സ്ത്രീ ജീവിതങ്ങൾക്ക് താദാത്മ്യം തോന്നാവുന്ന ജീവിത സന്ധികളിലൂടെ കടന്ന പോകുന്ന ജെസിബലിൻ്റെ ജീവിതാഖ്യാനം, കേൾക്കാം സുര്യനെ അണിഞ്ഞ ഒരു സ്ത്രീ.

deshiyatha-nayattinirangumbol.title: Deshiyatha Nayattinirangumbol
deshiyatha-nayattinirangumbol.description: ഭയത്തിൻ്റെയും വെറുപ്പിൻ്റെയും അന്തരീക്ഷം ഒരുക്കി സ്വന്തം പൗരന്മാരെ ഭീതിയിലാഴ്ത്തുന്ന ഇന്ത്യൻ തീവ്രദേശീയതയുടെ മുഖം അനാവൃതമാക്കുന്ന രചന. ബഹുസ്വരതയിൽ ഊന്നിയ ഇന്ത്യൻ ദേശീയ സങ്കല്പത്തെ ഏക മത- സംസ്ക്കാരത്തിലേക്ക് ചുരുക്കാൻ വെമ്പുന്ന ഹിന്ദു ദേശീയതയെ അതിനിശിതം വിമർശിക്കുകയും ഒപ്പം ജനാധിപത്യത്തിൽ ഊന്നിയ ഒരു പുതു ലോക വ്യവസ്ഥ സാധ്യമാണെന്ന ആത്മവിശ്വാസം പകരുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നതാണു കെ. അരവിന്ദാക്ഷൻ രചിച്ച ഈ ലേഖന സമാഹാരം.

the-chopper-scam.title: The Chopper Scam
the-chopper-scam.description: ₹3600 crore ki ek high-profile deal, Political corridors mein secret meetings aur ek scam jo sirf Bharat hi nahi, poori duniya ki nazar India ki policies par le aaya! Jo deal desh ki security badhane ke liye thi, wahi crore rupay ki brokerage aur political game ka hissa ban gayi. Lekin asli sawal ye hai ki kya iske peeche sirf ek aadmi tha, ek agency ya poora system? 12 saal tak courts aur politics ke beech ghoomta raha yeh case, lekin sach kya hai? Janne ke liye suniye "The Chopper Scam"!

a-blind-womans-beautiful-revenge.title: A Blind Woman's Beautiful Revenge
a-blind-womans-beautiful-revenge.description: When her wealthy, abusive husband is murdered, Sarah, a blind woman in her mid-30s must navigate a world of newfound independence, handling her husband’s failing business empire, and intense suspicion as she becomes the prime suspect. While grappling with her rebellious teenage daughter and a pre-existing secret affair, she faces a brutal detective and uncovers dark family secrets that lead to a shocking revelation about the true killer.

ennai-enna-seidhaayada.title: Ennai Enna Seidhaayada
ennai-enna-seidhaayada.description: Born and raised in wealth and luxury, the heroine Sri Aishwarya sees money as her only priority and way of life, lacking any regard or concern for people. The story revolves around how the hero, Vinith Saxena, enters her life and changes her, making her realize the importance of human connections.

johar-rani-karnavati-ki-amar-kahani.title: Johar: Rani Karnavati ki Amar Kahani
johar-rani-karnavati-ki-amar-kahani.description:
Ek maa ne apne rakt ka antim boond tak Mewar ki raksha ki!
Maharana Pratap ki kahani har bharatiya ke dil me basi hai, lekin kya aap unki dadi, Rani Karnavati ke balidan ko jaante hain? Ek rani jo Mewar ke swabhimaan ke liye apni aakhri saans tak ladi, aur jisne Mewar ka Raj-sinhansan apne bete aur pote ke haathon tak pahunchaya! Kya aap Panna Dhay ki kahani jante hain? jinhone  ek vachan ke liye apne hi bete ka balidan de diya, taaki Mewar ka chirag bujh na sake! Yeh sirf ek kahani nahi, yeh swabhimaan, balidan aur rajput shaurya ki ek amar gatha hai!

trapped-in-romance.title: Trapped In Romance
trapped-in-romance.description: మనస్ఫూర్తిగా ప్రేమించే వ్యక్తిని దూరం చేసుకొని ఆ అమ్మాయి తప్పు చేసిందా? ఆడపిల్ల అంటే కేవలం కోరికలు తీర్చేదే అని భావించిన వాడు చివరికి ఏమయ్యాడు? ఇద్దరి మగాళ్ల మధ్య ఆ గులాబీ నలిగిందా!

shiv-mahima-sankat-se-nidaan.title: Shiv Mahima : Sankat Se Nidaan
shiv-mahima-sankat-se-nidaan.description: Zindagi ki mushkilon ka koi hal nahi mil raha? To Mahadev ke gyaan se prerna lein aur jeevan ki kathin samasyaon ka samadhan is audiobook ke jariye paayein. Abhi suniye aur Shiv Mahima se apni life sudharane ka rasta khojiye.

i-came-upon-a-lighthouse-a-short-memoir-.title: I Came Upon a Lighthouse: A Short Memoir of Life with Ratan Tata
i-came-upon-a-lighthouse-a-short-memoir-.description: അന്തരിച്ച പ്രമുഖ വ്യവസായിയും മനുഷ്യസ്‌നേഹിയുമായ രത്തൻ ടാറ്റയുമായി  ശാന്തനു നായിഡു എന്ന മുപ്പതുകാരൻ സുഹൃത്ത് പങ്കുവെച്ച അനുഭവങ്ങളുടെ ഓർമ്മക്കുറിപ്പുകളാണ് ഈ പുസ്തകം. 2021 ജനുവരിയിൽ പുറത്തിറങ്ങിയ ഈ ആത്മകഥയിൽ, രത്തൻ ടാറ്റ എന്ന മഹാമനുഷ്യൻ്റെ അടുത്ത് നിന്ന് പ്രവർത്തിക്കാനും അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ജീവിതവും ആശയങ്ങളും മനസിലാക്കാനും ലഭിച്ച അപൂർവ അവസരം പങ്കുവയ്ക്കുന്നു.

the-offer.title: The Offer
the-offer.description: One Fateful Night. Two Prince Charmings. Alisa hasn’t had the best of luck. Her dream of expanding her salon into a franchise has stalled. Her dating life is non-existent. She spends her nights with wine takeout and thriller marathons. Looking to spice up her life she heads back to the one place she knows will satisfy her desires. Little does she know that one night of passion (and a leaked photograph) will upend her life in more ways than one. Christophe and Kadeem have been together for years living and loving under the radar. Their relationship is solid but they’ve always felt that someone was missing from their lives. When they think they’ve met “the one” at a private sex club they are intent on making her theirs. Permanently. The problem: Convincing her that one night will never be enough. Could this be the beginning of happily ever after? Or will their relationship ultimately crash and burn?

contractual-wife-ka-fame.title: Contractual Wife Ka Fame
contractual-wife-ka-fame.description: Teen saal tak contract marriage mein Veer ki bewafayi sahne ke baad, uska Thailand bina bataye chale jaana Kajal ke liye akhri thappad tha. Jab Veer wapas aakar uske qareeb aane ki koshish karta hai, toh Kajal divorce ka faisla le leti hai. Par tabhi, uski saas, Hema Rathore use divorce ke liye ₹400 crore ka offer deti hai— is shart ke sath ki Kajal Saas-Bahu Showdown reality show kare, jisme Hema apni image behtar dikhana chahti hai. Kajal jaanti hai ki iske peeche koi chaal hai. Par jab wo ek wildcat ban kar show ke set par ghus aati hai, toh Veer ka business aur Hema Rathore ki image sabka mazak bana deti hai.

victorious.title: Victorious
victorious.description: From Hollywood to Las Vegas, Flynn and Natalie's whirlwind love affair has it all—romance, passion, steamy hot sex, relentless paparazzi and a murder that could be their undoing. Flynn is a dirty-talking hero who puts it all on the line for the woman he loves. He leaves no desire unfulfilled. He will do anything it takes to protect what's his… Their destiny is sealed in this riveting conclusion to the initial Quantum trilogy.

garuda-purana.title: Garuda Purana
garuda-purana.description:
ಗರುಡ ಪುರಾಣವು ಹಿಂದು ಧರ್ಮದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಮರಣೋತ್ತರ ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ಧರ್ಮಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ಮರಣಾನಂತರ ಆತ್ಮದ ಯಾತ್ರೆ, ಪುನರ್ಜನ್ಮ, ಮತ್ತು ಪಾಪ-ಪುಣ್ಯಗಳ ಫಲಗಳ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಗರುಡ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷ್ಣು ದೇವರ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂವಾದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದಿರುವ ಈ ಪುರಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ, ಆತ್ಮದ ವಿಧಿವಿಧಾನಗಳು, ದೈವವಿಧಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಶ್ರಾದ್ಧ ಕಾರ್ಯವಿಧಾನಗಳ ವಿವರಣೆಗಳು ಸೇರಿವೆ. 

ಮೃತ್ಯು ನಂತರದ ವಿಧಿ-ವಿಧಾನಗಳು, ನಾರಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಆತ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಫಲಗಳು, ಪಾಪ ಮತ್ತು ಪುಣ್ಯಗಳ ಕಾರ್ಯ, ಶ್ರಾದ್ಧ ಮಹತ್ವ, ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಧರ್ಮದ ಆಚರಣೆಯ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿ ಹೇಳುವಲ್ಲಿ ಗರುಡ ಪುರಾಣ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

Qaatil-Bete--अमेरिका-का-सबसे-ख़ौफ़नाक-हत.title: Qaatil Bete : अमेरिका का सबसे ख़ौफ़नाक हत्याकांड
Qaatil-Bete--अमेरिका-का-सबसे-ख़ौफ़नाक-हत.description: Ek khaufnaak raat, Ek aisi ghatna, jismein do bhaiyon ne apne hi maa-baap ko maut ke ghat utaar diya! Par kyun? Kya sirf daulat ka laalach itna gehra tha? Ya phir iss kahaani mein chhupe hain kuch aise raaz, jo aapki rooh tak ko hila denge? Toh abhi suniye yeh show aur uthayiye parda har raaz se!

maduve-album.title: Maduve Album
maduve-album.description: ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದ ನಾಟಕಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ದರಾಗಿರುವ ಜ್ಞಾನಪೀಠ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಪುರಸ್ಕೃತ ಗಿರೀಶ್ ಅವರ ನಾಟಕ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಸ್ತು ಆಧರಿಸಿದ ನಾಟಕ ಇದು. ಮದುವೆಯ ಆಲ್ಬಮ್ ನಾಟಕಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮುಂಚೆ ಗಿರೀಶ ಅವರು ‘ಅಂಜು ಮಲ್ಲಿಗೆ’ ಎಂಬ ನಾಟಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಿದ್ದರು. ಅದು ಸಮುದ್ರದಾಚೆಗೀನ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿತ್ತು. ಅದಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಧುನಿಕ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಬಳಸಿ ಏಕವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನದ ‘ಬಿಂಬ’ ಎಂಬ ನಾಟಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಿದ್ದರು. ಅದಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ‘ಮದುವೆಯ ಆಲ್ಬಮ್’ ನಾಟಕ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಸಮಕಾಲೀನ ಜೀವನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ  ನಾಟಕ ಬರೆದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಖರೇ ನಾಟಕಕಾರ’ ಎಂದು ಹಿರಿಯ ನಾಟಕಕಾರ- ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕ ಜಿ.ಬಿ. ಜೋಷಿ ಅವರು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪಿಸಿರುವ ಗಿರೀಶ ಅವರು ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರತಿವಾದ ಹೂಡಲು ‘ಸಮಕಾಲೀನ ಸಂವೇದನೆ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಹೊರತು ವಿಷಯವಲ್ಲ’ ಎಂದು  ಹೇಳಿದ್ದರಂತೆ. ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ಮರಿಸಿರುವ ಗಿರೀಶ ಅವರು ಜಿ.ಬಿ. ಶತಮಾನೋತ್ಸವ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿಯಾದರೂ ‘ಖರೆ ನಾಟಕಕಾರ’ ಎಂದು ಸಿದ್ದಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ದೊರೆಯಿತಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಸಮಕಾಲೀನ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಆಧಿರಿಸಿದ ನಾಟಕ ‘ಮದುವೆಯ ಆಲ್ಬಮ್’.

kaali-ganga.title: Kaali Ganga
kaali-ganga.description: ಮಹಾಬಲೇಶ್ವರ ಸೈಲ್ ಅವರ ಕಾಳಿ ಗಂಗಾ ಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನ್ಮೂಲದ ಸುಂದರ ಚಿತ್ರಣವನ್ನು ಮೂಡಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಕಾಳಿ ಎಂಬ ಬಲಿಷ್ಠ ಮಹಿಳೆಯ ಕಥೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ, ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಸಮಾಜದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಸುತ್ತುಮುತ್ತು, ಸಂಘರ್ಷ, ಜಡಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಜತೆಯ ಚಿತ್ರಣವನ್ನು ಸೈಲ್ ಅವರು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ನೀಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಜೀವನದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಥೆಗಳು, ಜಾತಿ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ, ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾಳಿ ಎಂಬ ನದಿಯ ಮರ್ಮಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಮೂಲಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಈ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಕೃತಿ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತವಾಗಿದೆ, ಜನಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರ ದ್ವಂದ್ವ ಹಾಗೂ ಬದುಕುಗಳ ಆಳವಾದ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಲು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

sleepwalker.title: Sleepwalker
sleepwalker.description: Psychologist Trisha, Jaisalmer ke ek haunted hotel me vacation manane aati hai, par har raat bina kisi hosh ke kisi ajnabi ke kamre me uthti hai. Hotel ke corridors me use apni purani tasveerein milti hain, aur ek ajeeb buddhi aurat use continuously dekh rahi hoti hai. Itna hi nahi, ek paranormal buffet mein, Trisha ghost hunter Tanish se milti hai aur usse attract ho jati hai. Par jab ghar lautkar apni maa ko Tanish ke baare mei batati hai to uski maa ko heart attack aa jata hai. Aakhir us hotel me aisa kya tha?

karl-marx-2.title: karl marx
karl-marx-2.description: ಕಾರ್ಲ್ ಮಾರ್ಕ್ಸ್ ಅವರ ಪ್ರಭಾವಶಾಲಿ ತತ್ವಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ದರ್ಶನವನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮುಂದೆ ತರುವ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವಿಶ್ವದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಕ್ಸ್ ಅವರ ಜೀವನ, ಅವರ ಪಾಠಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜ ತತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಆಳವಾದ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಹಾಯಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ತತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ವರ್ಗ ಹೋರಾಟ, ಕಮ್ಯುನಿಸಂ ತತ್ವಗಳ ತಜ್ಞನಾದ ಮಾರ್ಕ್ಸ್, ಸಮಾಜದ ಅಸಮಾನತೆಯನ್ನು ಬಗೆಹರಿಸಲು ತಮ್ಮ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ವೃತ್ತಜೀವನ ಮತ್ತು ಅವರ ಬರವಣಿಗೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶಾಲವಾದ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ, ಕಾರ್ಲ್ ಮಾರ್ಕ್ಸ್ ಅವರು ಬರೆದ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಬರಹಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಅವರ ನಿಷ್ಠೆಯು ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಯತ್ತ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ.

chor-machaye-shor.title: Chor Machaye Shor
chor-machaye-shor.description: Rajat, Mumbai ki galiyon me rahne vaala ek anaath ladka, jisne chori ko rozi-roti kamaane ka zariya bana liya tha. Ek khaas chori ke dauran usey milti hai ek jadooi cheez jisse usey behisaab shaktiyan mil jaati hain. Kya karega Rajat in shaktiyon ka? Kya banega vo sabse bada chor? Ya fir ye chor machayega poori Mumbai me shor ?

maha-bharata.title: Mahabharata
maha-bharata.description: ಮಹಾಭಾರತವು ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಮಹಾಕಾವ್ಯ, ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಂಡವರ ಮತ್ತು ಕೌರವರ ನಡುವೆ ಕುರುಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಯುದ್ಧವನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಧರ್ಮ, ನೈತಿಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನ ಪಾಠಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವ ಈ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಭಗವದ್ಗೀತೆ ಅಂಶವು ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿದೆ. ಮಹಾಭಾರತವು ಕೇವಲ ಯುದ್ಧ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲ, ಇದು ಜೀವನದ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳನ್ನೂ ಬೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

yaare-neenu-cheluve.title: Yaare Neenu Cheluve
yaare-neenu-cheluve.description: ಮಿಸ್ಟರ್‌  ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ ಆಚಾರ್ಯ,  ನೀವು  ನನ್ನನ್ನ ಮದ್ವೆ ಆಗ್ತೀರಾ ಆದ್ರೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿವರ್ಗು ಯಾರೂ ಕೂಡ ಅವ್ನ ಬಳಿ ಇಂಥಾ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳೋ ಧೈರ್ಯ ಮಾಡಿರ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ.  ಆದ್ರೆ, ನೋಡಲು ಅಷ್ಟೇನು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲದ, ತನ್ನತ್ತ ಸೆಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಯಾವ್ದೇ ವಿಶೇಷ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳಿಲ್ದೆ ಇರೋವಂತ ಹುಡುಗಿಯೊಬ್ಳು ಈ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿದ್ದು ಅಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ಎಲ್ರಿಗೂ ಆಶ್ವರ್ಯವನ್ನುಂಟು ಮಾಡ್ತು. ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ ಕಣ್ಣಲ್ಲಿ ಇದ್ದದ್ದು ಬರೀ ಎರಡು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು. ಇವ್ಳು ಯಾರು? ಯಾಕೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾಳೆ?

raaz-radhika-ka.title: Raaz Radhika Ka
raaz-radhika-ka.description: Mumbai ka mashhoor Kheruka parivaar, bahut khushaal tha, lekin jaise hi unhone apni badi beti Ananya ki shadi Shekhawati ki pustaini haweli se karne ki sochi, sab kuchh badal gaya. Ananya ke pita wahan shadi karne ke paksh me bilkul nahi the. Lekin ladke walon aur bachcho ki zid ke aage unki ek na chali. Haveli ke shan-o-shaukat ko  dekhkar dulhe ki family aur doston ne yahin shaadi karne par zor diya, aur mazburi me unhe  Shekhawati ki Haweli me  shadi ke liye haami bharni padi. Shaadi ki raunak  ke beech, iss parivar ke ek bhayanak  rahasya se parda uth gaya. Akhir kya hua jab anjane me  Ananya ki behan Khushbu ne haveli ke us band darwaze ko khol diya jo saalon se band pada tha. Us band darwaaze ke khulte hi,  shuru hui ek adhuri dulhan ke khauf aur badle ki kahaani. Kya ye shehri premi- joda bacha payenge apna pyaar , ya fir hoga us adhuri dulhan ka shikaar?

manteswami-katha-prasanga.title: Manteswami Katha Prasanga
manteswami-katha-prasanga.description: ಮಂಟೇಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಕಥಾಪ್ರಸಂಗ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಮೌಖಿಕ ಮಹಾಕಾವ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ. ಹದಿನೈದನೆಯ ಶತಮಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕಿದ್ದ ವೀರಶೈವ ಸಂತ ಮಂಟೇಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದು, ನಗರದ ಪ್ರವೇಶದ್ವಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಸವಣ್ಣನ ಹೆಂಡತಿ ಅವರನ್ನು ಅರಮನೆಗೆ ಕರೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಶರಣರು ಮತ್ತು ಮಂಟೇಸ್ವಾಮಿಯ ನಡುವೆ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ನಡೆದು, ಮಂಟೇಸ್ವಾಮಿಯ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಸಾಬೀತುಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆ ಕಪಟ ಭಕ್ತರ ಮೇಲಿನ ಕೆಳವರ್ಗದವರ ವಿಜಯವನ್ನು ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

the-vampires-forbidden-princess.title: The Vampire's Forbidden Princess
the-vampires-forbidden-princess.description:
"You taste divine, my wife... let me devour you as though you’re my last breath."
Bound in a political marriage to the feared vampire prince Gavriel, Princess Evie is drawn into a dark world of forbidden passion. Their love, fierce and fated, stirs hidden powers within her, setting them on a path where their bond could either unite their worlds or destroy them both.

deewanapan.title: Dushman Se Mohabbat
deewanapan.description: Anant Sindhiya—jiski zindagi ka bas ek hi maqsad tha: apne sabse bade dushman, Rishi Raaychand se badla lena. Wo aaya toh tha apne dushman ke ghar, haath mein bandook lekar… par takra gaya uski beti Aahna se. Aur jo dil na jhuk saka kisi ke saamne, wo haar gaya usi ke pyaar mein. Par yeh mohabbat hai ya ek chaal? Ehsaas hai ya koi saazish? Aahna Anant ka saath degi ya uska vishwas hi todegi?

malegaalada-ondu-sanje.title: Malegaalada Ondu Sanje
malegaalada-ondu-sanje.description: ಭಯೋತ್ಪಾದನೆಯ ಭೀಕರ ಚಿತ್ರಣಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಅದರ ಉಗಮ ಹಾಗೂ ಇತಿಹಾಸವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಕಾರರು. ದೇಶ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬವನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲೂ ಹಿಂದು ಮುಂದು ನೋಡದ ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಆಪರೇಷನ್ ಆ್ಯಂತ್ರಾಸ್ ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟಬಲ್ಲನೇ ಎಂಬುವುದು ಕಥಾವಸ್ತು. ರೋಚಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಸರಾಗವಾಗಿ ಓದಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗುವುದು ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ವಿಶೇಷತೆ.

she-is-a-fantasy.title: She is a Fantasy
she-is-a-fantasy.description: இவளின் அழகுக்கு மயங்காத ஆண் உண்டோ? பேரழகி ரேஷிமாவின் மீது மோகம் கொண்ட ஆண்கள் சமுதாயத்திற்கு மத்தியில் ரேஷிமாவின் வாழ்வில் நடக்கும் திருப்பங்களை கேளுங்கள்.

gurudev-sri-sri-ravi-shankar-ka-jeewan-g.title: Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar Ka Jeewan Gyan : 2
gurudev-sri-sri-ravi-shankar-ka-jeewan-g.description: Kaise milta hai Sachcha Pyar? Kaise banti hai shadi khushhaal? Kin logon se rahana hai door aur kin logon ke jana hai paas? Aise kai sawalon ke jawab suniye Is khas show mein Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar Ji ke sath. Abhi sunana shuru kijiye..

idanna-odhbedi.title: Idanna Odhbedi
idanna-odhbedi.description: 'ಇದನ್ನ ಓದ್ಬೇಡಿ' ಕನ್ನಡದ ಹೆಸರಾಂತ ನಟ, ನಿರ್ದೇಶಕ 'ಉಪೇಂದ್ರ' ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರೋ ಕೃತಿ. ಚಿತ್ರರಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮ ಅನುಭವಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿ, ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ವಿಭಿನ್ನ-ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವನ್ನು ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ತಮ್ಮ ಡಿಫ್ರೆಂಟ್ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಜನರನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿಡುವ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರ್ ಉಪೇಂದ್ರ ಅವರು, ತಮ್ಮ‌ ಕೃತಿಗೂ ಇಂಟ್ರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಆದ ಹೆಸರನ್ನೇ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಓದ್ಬೇಡಿ ಅಂತಾ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಲೇ ಓದುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.. ಇದನ್ನ ಓದ್ಬೇಡಿ.. ಕೇಳಿ..!

abhilashe.title: Abhilashe
abhilashe.description: ಈ ಕಥೆಯು ಭಾರತೀಯ ದಂಡ ಸಂಹಿತೆಯಿಂದ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 302 ಅನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕುವ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಅಂಶವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದೆ.

manusmriti-4-antim-satya-kya-hai.title: Manusmriti - 4 : Antim Satya Kya Hai?
manusmriti-4-antim-satya-kya-hai.description: Hindu dharma ke sabse purane shastro me se ek Manusmriti aapko dharm aur jeene ka saar samajhati hai. Abhi iske saare part suniye! Aur janiye ki kaise ye mahaan shastra aapki zindagi ko behtar banane mein bahut madadgar hai.

asprushyaru.title: Asprushyaru
asprushyaru.description: ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ "ಅಸ್ಪೃಶ್ಯತೆ"ಯ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹೊಸತನದಿಂದ ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವೈದೇಹಿಯವರು ಕೇವಲ ಜಾತಿಗಳ ಅಸ್ಪೃಶ್ಯತೆಯಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಒಂದೇ ಕುಟುಂಬದೊಳಗಿನ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಅಸ್ಪೃಶ್ಯತೆಯ ತಳಹದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕುಂದಾಪುರದ ಕಾಲ್ಪನಿಕ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಕಥಾನಕವು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮಾನಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸಾಗುತ್ತಾ, ವಿಶಾಲವಾದ ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಯ ಪ್ರತೀಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಗಳ ಸಣ್ಣ, ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ವಿವರಗಳಿಂದ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಈ ಕಥೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಕಥೆಯಾದರೂ, ಅಂತರವಿಲ್ಲದ ಸಂಸಾರದ ಸಂಕೇತವಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ.

shrimad-bhagwat-mahapuran-shri-krishna-s.title: Shrimad Bhagwat Mahapuran : Shri Krishna Se Seekhiye Jeewan Jeena
shrimad-bhagwat-mahapuran-shri-krishna-s.description: Aapne kabhi socha hai ki Shri Krishna ki leelaon mein zindagi ke sabhi sawaalon ke jawab chhupe hain? Is show mein aap janenge ki kaise Krishna ki baal leelayen humein bahut kuch sikhati hain aur kaise unki yudh neeti life ki problems ko face karne ki prerna deti hai. To der mat kariye, abhi suniye aur jeevan ka asli arth samajhiye!

ഉന്മാദം.title: ഉന്മാദം
ഉന്മാദം.description: കോഴിക്കോട് താമരശ്ശേരിയില്‍ പ്രകൃതിയുടെ മടിത്തട്ടിലുള്ള ഒരു കിടിലന്‍ ക്യാംപസ്, ഇംപീരിയില്‍ കോളേജ് ഓഫ് എന്‍ജിനീയറിങ്. ആരും പഠിക്കാന്‍ കൊതിക്കുന്ന ക്യാംപസ്! പക്ഷേ പണച്ചാക്കുകള്‍ക്ക് വേണ്ടി മാത്രം കോര്‍പറേറ്റുകള്‍ പണിത ഒരിടം.  അവിടേക്ക് സ്‌കോളര്‍ഷിപ്പില്‍ പഠിക്കാനെത്തുകയാണ് ഒരു കൂട്ടം സാധാരണക്കാരുടെ മക്കള്‍. വിയര്‍പ്പ് തുന്നിയിട്ട കുപ്പായവുമായി അവരെത്തുമ്പോള്‍ കോടികളുടെ പളപളപ്പില്‍ രമിക്കുന്ന ക്യാംപസ് ഗ്യാങ്സ്റ്റര്‍മാര്‍ അവരെ എങ്ങനെയാവും സ്വീകരിക്കുക! കേള്‍ക്കാം ഉന്മാദം!

the-10-rules-of-happiness-1.title: The 10 Rules Of Happiness
the-10-rules-of-happiness-1.description: ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ ಹ್ಯಾಪಿನೆಸ್‌ನ 10 ನಿಯಮಗಳು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತೋಷವನ್ನು ತರುತ್ತದೆ, ಇದು ನಮ್ಮ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಜೀವನದ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆಯೇ ಸಂತೋಷವನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಪರಿಹಾರವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಜೀವನದ ಸೂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸಿ, ನಿರಂತರವಾದ ಸಂತೋಷವನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸುವ ಮಾರ್ಗವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ನಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಅರಿಯಲು, ಆಲೋಚನೆಗೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟತೆಯನ್ನು ತರಲು ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯವನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಂತೋಷದ ನೀತಿ, ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು, ಧ್ಯಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ ಮುಂತಾದ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಆರಾಮದಾಯಕ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ತಂದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವಲ್ಲಿ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

100-things-millionaires-do-1.title: 100 Things Millionaires Do
100-things-millionaires-do-1.description:
Why will you love this audiobook💡 : Ameer logon ki 100 aadatein jo aapki zindagi badal sakti hain!  Wealth mindset ka aisa formula jo aapke financial future ko transform karega! 🚀

Kya sirf sapne dekhne se aadmi crorepati ban sakta hai? Ya phir uske peeche ek solid mindset, sahi planning aur strong habits chhupi hoti hain? Yeh Audiobook aapko sikhayegi asli millionaires ki soch aur unke proven tareeke jo aapki financial journey badal sakte hain. Toh abhi sunna shuru kariye aur apne sapnon ko reality mein badalne ka raasta samajhiye

seevagan.title: சீவகன்
seevagan.description: ஏமாங்கத நாட்டின் இளவரசன் சீவகன். ஆனால், அவன் ஒரு சாதாரண குடிமகனைப் போல வளர்கிறான். அவன் தான் இளவரசன், பட்டத்துக்கு உரியவன் எனும் உண்மை அவனுக்கு எப்போது தெரியவரும்??? மீண்டும் அரியணையைக் கைப்பற்றுவானா?

prem-kahani-falling-for-the-call-girl.title: Falling for the Call Girl
prem-kahani-falling-for-the-call-girl.description: 'ಅಭಿ' ಆಗರ್ಭ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ.. 'ಸಾರಿಕಾ' ಕಾಲ್ ಗರ್ಲ್.. ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಮೊದಲ ನೋಟದಲ್ಲೇ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಹೇಗಾದ್ರೂ ಮಾಡಿ ಸಾರಿಕಾಳನ್ನ ಪಾಪದ ಕೂಪದಿಂದ ಬಿಡಿಸಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಅಭಿಯ ಆಸೆ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಇವರ ಮೊದಲ ಭೇಟಿ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಸಾರಿಕಾ ಕಾಲ್ ಕಾರ್ಲ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಕೇಳಿ ಅಭಿಸಾರಿಕಾ ಅನುರಾಗದ ಕಥೆ 'Falling for the Call Girl' ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ‌ ಮಾತ್ರ..

kala-patthar.title: Kala Patthar
kala-patthar.description:
Deep within the dense jungles of Jharkhand lay a shadowy realm of black stone, where slavery ruled at its most brutal extreme.

Then fate took an unexpected turn. Among the enslaved, a powerful spirit awakened within a seventeen-year-old boy named Ayush.

Will this force reshape Ayush’s destiny?
Can he shatter the chains of bondage and claim his freedom?
And will Jharkhand witness the rise of a new hero for this age?

18-minutes.title: 18 Minutes
18-minutes.description: "18 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು" ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ಸಮಯ ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸತತ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಷಮತೆ, ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧನೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸಮರ್ಪಕ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ತೊಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಅವಶ್ಯಕವಾದ ಚಿಂತನೆ, ಕಾರ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಧ್ಯೇಯಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಎತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರತಿದಿನವೂ ಕೇವಲ 18 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳೆಯುವ ಮೂಲಕ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಗಮಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಉತ್ತಮ ಸಮಯ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಅನುಸರಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಳವಾದ ಪಾಠಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ತಂತ್ರಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಾಮುಖ್ಯತೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚುಟುಕು ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

the-4-hour-body-2.title: The 4 Hour Body
the-4-hour-body-2.description: "ದಿ 4 ಅವರ್ ಬಾಡಿ" ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್  ಪ್ರಭಾವಶಾಲಿ ದೇಹ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿದ ದೇಹತಂತ್ರಗಳು, ತೂಕ ಇಳಿಕೆ, ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ವೃದ್ಧಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಉತ್ತಮೀಕರಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ತಜ್ಞರು ತೋರಿಸಿರುವ ಸರಳ ವಿಧಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸವು  ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ  ದೈಹಿಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸುಲಭ, ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಷಮ ತಂತ್ರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಚುಟುಕು ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ದೇಹದ ಗುರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಸ್ಪೂರ್ತಿಯನ್ನೂ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವನ್ನೂ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

bodyguard-lover.title: My Bodyguard Lover
bodyguard-lover.description: Rudra, ek mysterious aadmi, jab Bollywood ki sabse powerful producer Devika Raichand ki jaan bachata hai, toh use uska personal bodyguard banne ka offer milta hai. Par offer accept karte hi, uska dil usi ghar mein qaid Isha par aa jata hai—jo Devika ki stepdaughter hai aur uspar apni maa ke murder ka ilzaam laga rahi hai. Ab Rudra ek dangerous game me phas chuka hai—ek taraf pyaar, ek taraf wafaadari, aur teesri taraf maut khadi hai.

detective-maaran-s-3-the-road-accident.title: Detective Maaran S 3 : The Road Accident
detective-maaran-s-3-the-road-accident.description:
இரண்டு Accidents. 
லாரி மோதி ஸ்பாட்டிலேயே உயிரிழக்கிறார் தொழிலதிபர் அர்ஜூன் குப்தா. விசாரிக்கச் செல்லும் மாறனும் விபத்தில் சிக்கி படுகாயம் அடைகிறான். Is this just a Coincidence? Or a Planned Execution? Get into the Mission with Maaran

hare-krishna-movement-aadhyatmik-kranti-.title: Hare Krishna Movement : Aadhyatmik Kranti Ka Itihaas
hare-krishna-movement-aadhyatmik-kranti-.description: Ek sant, do dil ke daure, 7.5 dollar aur 108 mandir! Yeh kisi chamatkaar se kam nahi! Bharat se America tak, Shrila Prabhupada ki bhakti yatra jisne Krishna chetna ko poore world mein failaya. Agar aap jaanna chahte hain ki unke nischay aur bhakti se kaise itihaas racha jata hai, to is show ko abhi sunna shuru karein!

junior-kunjappan.title: Junior Kunjappan
junior-kunjappan.description: பிரபல நடிகை தீபிகா சோப்ராவுடன் மகேசன் உல்லாசமாக இருந்த வீடியோ leak ஆகியதால் மகேசன் வாழ்க்கையில் எதிர்பாராத திருப்பம் நிகழ்கிறது. டாக்டர் மகேசன் ஏன் ஜூனியர் குஞ்சப்பன் ஆகிறான்? கேளுங்கள் "ஜூனியர் குஞ்சப்பன்"

tejo-tungabhadra.title: Tejo Tungabhadra
tejo-tungabhadra.description: ವಸುಧೇಂದ್ರ ಅವರ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಕೃತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 'ತೇಜೋ ತುಂಗಭದ್ರಾ' ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು. ಇದು 15-16ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ರಾಜ್ಯಾಡಳಿತ ಹಾಗೂ ಜನಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರ ಬದುಕನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಿರೋ ಕಥೆ‌. ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ, ಪೋರ್ಚುಗೀಸ್, ಬಹುಮನಿ ಸುಲ್ತಾನರ ಕಾಲದ ಇತಿಹಾಸವನ್ನು ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಟ್ಟಿರುವ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ..

gurudev-shri-shri-ravishankar-ka-jeewan-.title: Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar Ka Jeewan Gyan : 1
gurudev-shri-shri-ravishankar-ka-jeewan-.description: Kya shadi ke baad bhi ho skata hai Love? Kya Sadhuon ko bhi hoti hai kaam vaasana? Kaise kar sakte hain spiritual life ko balance? Is khas show mein sab sawalo ke jawaab de rahe hain Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar Ji. Abhi suniye.

detective-maaran-s-4-bloody-knife.title: Detective Maaran S 4 : Bloody Knife
detective-maaran-s-4-bloody-knife.description: A.K International’ன் பார்ட்னர் காமினி தற்கொலை செய்து கொள்கிறாள். கம்பெனியின் மற்றொரு பார்ட்னர் அஜயை காணவில்லை. களத்தில் மீண்டும் இறங்குவாரா மாறான்? இது Detective Maaran : Season 4

detective-maaran-s-2-mysterious-deaths.title: Detective Maaran - S 2 : Mysterious Deaths
detective-maaran-s-2-mysterious-deaths.description: ஒரே நாளில் கல்லூரிப் பேராசிரியர் மற்றும் அவரது உதவியாளர் என்று இருவரும் நெஞ்சு வலி வந்து இறந்து போகிறார்கள். அது இயற்கையான மரணமா அல்லது கொலையா என்று சந்தேகம் வருகிறது. அதைக் கண்டுபிடிக்க வந்த டிடெக்டிவ் மாறனுக்கு பல்வேறு பிரச்னைகள் வருகின்றன. அதைக் கடந்து மாறன் மரணத்தின் மர்மத்தைக் கண்டுபிடித்தானா?

Shivaji-Maharaj-Ki-Teesri-Aankh--बहिर्जी.title: Shivaji Maharaj Ki Teesri Aankh : बहिर्जी नाईक
Shivaji-Maharaj-Ki-Teesri-Aankh--बहिर्जी.description: Bahirji Naik : Ek aisa shatir jasoos, Jo dushman ke dil ka har raaz padh leta tha, Ek aisa Yoddha jise Shivaji Maharaj ki teesri aankh kaha gaya. Janiye Kaise Bahirji Naik Maratha Samarajya ki parchaai ban kar hamesha saath khade rahe aur Swarajya ke sapne ko saakar kiya. Aisa kya khaas tha Bahirji Naik ki ranneetiyon mein ki unhone Mughal Samarajya ki neend uda rakhi thi? Kaise wo bhesh badal kar dushmanon ke darbar ki saari khabar baahar laate the? Milega har sawal ka jawab aapko es khaas historical show mein jo batata hai ki Bharat ki dharti par shaatir aur mahir yodhaaon ki kabhi kami nahin rahi magar ye sach hai ki unki kahaniyaan hum tak pahunchi nahin.

the-big-boss-1.title: The Big Boss
the-big-boss-1.description: 🎭Corporate politics-um Love Relationships-um kalanththa oru thrillig Family drama thaan "The Big Boss". Yaaru antha Big Boss, avanga enna seiyya Poraanga.. therinjukalaam Vaanga 🎧

maaya-nathigal.title: மாய நதிகள்
maaya-nathigal.description: ஐம்பது வயதுக்கும் மேல் ஆன உலகநாதனின் மனைவி இறந்துவிட, இளமையான பெண்ணைத் திருமணம் செய்துகொள்கிறார். இயலாமையால் தவிக்கும் உலகநாதன் கொடுமைப் படுத்த, அந்தப் பெண் எப்படித் தப்பிக்கலாம் என்று தவிக்கிறாள்??? அவள் உலகநாதனிடம் இருந்து விடுதலை பெற்றாளா?

bolti-deewarein.title: Bolti Deewarein
bolti-deewarein.description:
Ek maa ka atoot vishwas, jo use apne khoye hue bete Rinku ki talaash mein Deewaro ke piche ek khaufnaak parallel world aur ek bhayankar shaitaan ke khilaaf ladne par majboor karta hai. 
Kya ek maa apne bete ko wapas laa paayegi ya khud ko is rahasyamay duniya mein kho degi? Shaitaan ki chaalon ke beech uska saahas kya jeet paayega?

குற்றப்-பரம்பரை-.title: குற்றப் பரம்பரை
குற்றப்-பரம்பரை-.description: வெள்ளைக்கார சிப்பாய்களின் தாக்குதலில் கள்ளர் கூட்டத்தின் தலைவர் வேயன்னா தன் மகன் சேதுவை இழந்துவிடுகிறான். சேதுவை வெள்ளைக்காரர்கள் தூக்கிச் சென்றுவிடுகிறார்கள். சேது பின்னாளில் காவல் துறை அதிகாரியாகிறான். வேயன்னா மற்றும் கள்ளர்களை அடக்க வெள்ளைக்காரர்களால் களமிறக்கப்படுகிறான். இந்நேரத்தில் சேது பதவி ஏற்றதும் கள்ளர் கூட்டம் திருந்தியதா இல்லை வேரோடு அழிந்ததா? வேயன்னா என்ன ஆனார்?

Biggest-Kidney-Scandal--जब-डॉक्टर-बना-जल.title: Biggest Kidney Scandal : जब डॉक्टर बना जल्लाद
Biggest-Kidney-Scandal--जब-डॉक्टर-बना-जल.description: Gareeb mazdooron ki kidney nikal kar karadon kamaane wala Dr. Amit har baar law se bach nikalta hai. Par inspector Haneef ke haath ek deadly tip lagi hai! Jo ya toh uska career banayegi ya khatam kar degi. Kya woh bina kisi madad ke is dangerous racket ko expose kar paayega? Kya us doctor ko saja mil payegi jo jallad ban kar masoom logon ko maut ke darwaje par la kar khada kar de raha hai?
