Ya fir hoga wahi jo aksar hota hai, paisa apna rang dikhayega or ye khooni doctor bach kar nikal jayega?

f33ad824-b3fc-4107-bb2d-7640b1d54e57.title: చింతామణి
f33ad824-b3fc-4107-bb2d-7640b1d54e57.description: చింతామణి ఒక వేశ్య , అనుకోని పరిస్థితుల్లో వేశ్యగా మారినా ..తెలివితో చాలా మెట్లు ఎక్కి సంగంలోనే పెద్ద పేరు ఉన్న మహిళగా మారుతుంది , మినిస్టస్ అందరూ ఆమె మాట వినే లా ఇండియా లోనే పెద్ద క్రిమినల్ లాయర్ గా మారుతుంది ..(జఠ్మలానీ అంత ) ఆమె తక్కువ వయసులో ఇంత ఎక్కువ పేరు వచ్చాక జీవితాన్ని ప్రశాంతంగా మార్చుకోవాలని అనుకుంటుంది ..చిన్నప్పటి నుంచి జరిగిన ప్రతి సంఘటనను ఒరిజినల్ గా వున్న పెద్ద పెద్ద బిగ్ షాట్స్ పేర్లు కూడా రాసి బుక్ రాస్తుంది,  కథ మొత్తం బుక్ చుట్టూ తిరుగుతూ ఉంటుంది , ఆ బుక్  రిలీస్ చేసిన తర్వాత దాంట్లో ఉన్న క్యారెక్టర్స్ ఆమె కు ఆగినెస్ట్ గా మారుతారు ...ప్రస్తుతం , గతం మధ్యలో ఆమె ఆడవారి మనస్తత్వాన్ని ఆవిష్కరించే పుస్తకం గా ఆ బుక్ కి మంచి పేరు వస్తుంది ..ఒకవైపు రైటర్ గా మనకు కథ  చెప్తూ మరో వైపు ఆమె మీద జరిగే మానసిక దాడిని ఎదుర్కొంటూ సాగే ఎపిసోడ్స్  చింతామణి .  రొమాన్స్  , ఎమోషన్స్ . ఇండిపెండెన్సీ , రెస్పాన్సిబిలిటీ , అమ్మ తో ఉన్న రిలేషన్ అన్ని టచ్ చేస్తూ ఈ కథ ఉంటుంది .

basic-indian-astrology.title: Basic Indian Astrology
basic-indian-astrology.description: వేద జ్యోతిష్యం ప్రకారం మీరు జీవితంలో చేసే ప్రతి పని మీరు పుట్టిన సమయంలో ఉన్న నక్షత్రాలు మరియు గ్రహాల స్థానాల ద్వారా ప్రభావితమవుతుంది. ఆసక్తికర అంశాల సమాహారం మీకోసం

kalki-sena-kaliyug-ke-avtar.title: Kalki Sena : Kaliyug Ke Avtar
kalki-sena-kaliyug-ke-avtar.description: Aarav ke andar achanak jagti shaktiyaan aur Neel ke khatarnak sapanon ka sach kya hai? Kya Satyug aur Treta ke avatars Kalyug ke paapon ko mita payenge? Kaise yeh powers burai se ladne ke liye istemaal hongi, Suniye is show mein aur kho jaayiye is Kaliyug ke mahayuddh ki unsuni dastaan mein!

refractions.title: Refractions
refractions.description:
Humanity has established its first extra-solar colony, Bethesda, a thriving settlement of thousands. But something has gone terribly wrong - the colony has fallen silent, cutting off all communication with Earth.
Enter Nathalie Hart, who joins the New Horizons interstellar rescue expedition, hoping to escape the crushing guilt of her sister's death. But her mission takes an ominous turn when she's prematurely awakened from cryo-sleep. As alarms blare and smoke fills the corridors of the ship, Nathalie finds herself unexpectedly thrust into command of a crew of strangers, each harboring their own hidden agendas.
The discovery of a threatening message in her cabin - written in a language only she can understand - confirms her worst fears: someone aboard the rescue ship is determined to sabotage their mission and keep Bethesda's secrets buried. With Earth a distant memory and betrayal lurking around every corner, Nathalie must decide who to trust as they race toward the silent colony. But time is running out. Not only do the lives of five thousand colonists hang in the balance, but a deadly secret on Bethesda could threaten everyone back on Earth.
The race to uncover the truth will test not just Nathalie's leadership, but her ability to confront the very demons she thought she'd left behind on Earth.

daivam-phalitham-samsarikkunnu.title: ദൈവം ഫലിതം സംസാരിക്കുന്നു
daivam-phalitham-samsarikkunnu.description: വി ആർ ജ്യോതിഷ്, ക്രിസോസ്റ്റം തിരുമേനിയുമായി നടത്തിയ സംഭാഷണങ്ങളുടെ സമാഹാരമാണ് ഈ പുസ്തകം. തിരുമേനിയുടെ ഓരോ വാക്കുകളിലും ജീവിതത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ആഴമേറിയ കാഴ്ചപ്പാടുകളും, മനുഷ്യനും ദൈവവും തമ്മിലുള്ള സൂക്ഷ്മബന്ധവും, ദൈവത്തിന്റെ അദൃശ്യസാന്നിധ്യവും വെളിവാകുന്നു.

the-curse-of-bridal-death.title: The Curse Of Bridal Death
the-curse-of-bridal-death.description: "Ye... ye kya hua? Savitri?" Somdev apni dulhan ko suhaag ki sej par ek safed laash ke roop mein dekh kar chaunk gaya, uski cheekh haveli mein goonj uthi. Itna hi nahi, amavasya ki raat, use jeevit karne ke liye uski laash ko pahadi jungle par le jaya gaya. Varshon pehle ghati is bhayavah haadse ko Neelay apne sapne mein dekh raha tha. Tabhi uski aankhen khul gayi. Use yaad aaya, kuch din pehle, ek saadhu ne use kisi shraap se mukti pane ka aashirvaad diya tha. Ye shraap kisne diya tha? Aur kyun?

the-power-of-unwavering-focus.title: The Power Of Unwavering Focus
the-power-of-unwavering-focus.description: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಶಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿರುವ ಅಚಲ ಮನೋಬಲದ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಅರಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು, ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ನಿಮಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಜೀವನದ ಗುರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು, ಎಲ್ಲ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಅಲಜ್ಜಿತವನ್ನೂ ನಿವಾರಣೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಸಮಗ್ರವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. The Power of Unwavering Focus ಮೂಲಕ, ದೃಢನಿಶ್ಚಯದ ಮನಸ್ಸು, ಆಳವಾದ ಧ್ಯಾನ, ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಸೂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು,  ಧ್ಯೇಯಸಾಧನೆಗೆ ದಾರಿಯು ಮುಕ್ತವಾಗುವುದನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸಲು ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ!

5-am-club-4.title: 5 AM CLUB
5-am-club-4.description: ನಿಮ್ಮ ದಿನದ ಆರಂಭವೇ ಯಶಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ದಾರಿ ತೆರೆದಿಡಲು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ನಿಖರ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ 5 AM ಕ್ಲಬ್  ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಳಿ ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಈ ಸರಣಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ, ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಶಿಸ್ತಿನಿಂದ ಮಿದುಳಿನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಬಹುದು, ದಿನವನ್ನು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮವಾಗಿ ಏರ್ಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂಬಂತೆ, ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುವ ಸೂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಬಹುದು. ಮನಸ್ಸು, ದೇಹ ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ತಲುಪಿಸುವ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು, ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ 5 ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಎದ್ದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಜ್ವಲಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕಲೆಯನ್ನು ಹತ್ತಿರದಿಂದ ಅನುಭವಿಸಲು ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ.

pataal-devta-ki-pukar.title: Pataal Devta ki Pukar
pataal-devta-ki-pukar.description: “ Hello, Priya! Main Pataal Devta bol raha hoon. Tumhe mera ek kaam karna hai.” Priya Nayak, ek mamuli si bank ki clerk hai par uski zindagi puri tarah tab badal jaati hai jab wo apne ghar ek antique telephone lati hai. Uss telephone mein na to koi connection lines the aur na hi number dials, par phir bhi raat ke 2 baje Priya ko uss telephone se ek call aata hai jise sunkar wo seham jaati hai. Ye call kisi insaan ka nahi, Pataal devta ka tha. Kaun hai ye Pataal Devta aur wo Priya jaise sadharan ladki se apna kya kaam karwana chahta hai?

sampurna-ramayana.title: Sampurna Ramayana
sampurna-ramayana.description: ಮಹಾಕಾವ್ಯ ರಾಮಾಯಣವು ಹಿಂದೂ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಶ್ರವಣ ಮಾಲಿಕೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ, ರಾಮನ ಮಹಾಸಾಗರದಷ್ಟು ವಿಶಾಲವಾದ ಜೀವನದ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನೂ, ಧರ್ಮವನ್ನೂ ಹಾಗೂ ನೀತಿಯನ್ನೂ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವಾಲ್ಮೀಕಿ ಮತ್ತು ತುಳಸಿದಾಸರ ಕಾವ್ಯಗಳ ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿ, ಸೀತಾ ರಾಮರ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಸುತ್ತ, ರಾವಣನ ಮಹಾಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ, ಹನುಮಂತನ ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ದಾಂಡ್ಯವನ್ನೂ, ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣನ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯವನ್ನೂ ಬಿಂಬಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಸಂಚಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳ ಒಳನೋಟ, ಸಾಹಸ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಆನಂದಿಸಬಹುದು.

preethsodh-thappa.title: Preethsodh Thappa
preethsodh-thappa.description: ಸಹನ ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಅಪರಿಚಿತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕಾಣುವ ಸಂದರ್ಭ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಅವಳು ಭಾವಿಸುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದರೆ ಬದುಕಿಗೆ ಬೇರೆ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೇ ಅವಳ ಹೊಸ ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಸ್ ಆಗಿ ಹೊರಹೊಮ್ಮುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರೂ ತಡೆಯಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗದ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಒಳಗಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಶಮಂತ್ ನಿಂದ ದೂರ ಹೋಗಲು ಸಹನ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಾರಿ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅವನು ಪ್ರತಿಸಾರಿ ಅವಳ ಎದುರಿಗೇ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಇದು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯೇ? ಅಥವಾ ಕೇವಲ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆ? ಈ ವಿಶೇಷ ಪ್ರಣಯ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

pirates-of-the-bharat-legendary-kanhoji-.title: Pirates Of The Bharat: Legendary Kanhoji Angre
pirates-of-the-bharat-legendary-kanhoji-.description: Ek 17 saal ki British ladki ka kidnap, 30 hazaar dollar ki deal, aur ek Bharatiya yoddha jisne British samundari rasto par tax lagwa diya! Kanhoji Angre, ye vo naam tha jo Britishers ke liye dar ka doosra naam ban gaya. Toh abhi suniye yeh show aur jaaniye Kanhoji angre ki poori kahani.

ec16b4bf-972f-4b0a-b917-1167cc2ff679.title: X ray Karna
ec16b4bf-972f-4b0a-b917-1167cc2ff679.description:
జనరల్ గా మనకి ప్రపంచం ఎలా కనిపిస్తుంది? ఎలా ఏంటి నీ మొఖం అందరికీ నార్మల్ గా కనిపిస్తుంది అనుకుంటున్నారు కదా?  అవును మనందరికీ నార్మల్గా కనిపించే ప్రపంచం.. మన కర్ణకి అలా కనిపించదు. 
అతని ఎక్స్రే కళ్ళకి ప్రతి ఒక్కటి క్లియర్ గా కనిపిస్తాయి. అవి మనుషులైనా గాని వస్తువులైన గాని..!
బట్టలు వేసుకున్న మనుషులు నేకెడ్ గా కనిపిస్తే.. బిల్డింగ్స్ అన్ని బ్లూ ప్రింట్స్ తో సహా కనిపిస్తాయి.. అలాంటివాడు తనకు ఉన్న పవర్ ని యూస్ చేసుకుని లైఫ్ లో ఎదగాలని ట్రై చేస్తే సక్సెస్ అవుతాడా??
లేదా ఈ పవర్ వల్ల ఏదైనా ప్రాబ్లమ్స్ ఫేస్ చేస్తాడా?? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఇంక లేట్ ఎందుకు వెంటనే వినేయండి ఎక్సరే కర్ణ

skand-puran-shiv-ji-ke-ansujhe-rahasya.title: Skand Puran : Shiv Ji Ke Ansujhe Rahasya
skand-puran-shiv-ji-ke-ansujhe-rahasya.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki Bhagwan Shiv ke jeevan aur unki leelaon mein aise kai rahasya hain jo aaj bhi Samajh paana mushkil hai? Skand Puran ke iss audio show mein aapko milega ek rochak safar jismein bhakti aur gyaan dono ka anand hai. To abhi suniye aur Shiv Ji ke divine rahasyo ko janiye!

universal-kaadhal.title: UNIVERSAL KAADHAL
universal-kaadhal.description: A young scientist’s experiment connects him with a girl from a parallel universe, and as they fall in love, they must navigate the boundaries of reality, testing love, time, and fate in a quest to reunite against impossible odds

vishnu-purana.title: Vishnu Purana
vishnu-purana.description: ವಿಷ್ಣು ಪುರಾಣವು ಹಿಂದೂ ಧರ್ಮದ ಅಷ್ಟಾದಶ ಮಹಾಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪುರಾಣವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪುರಾಣವು ಪ್ರಪಂಚದ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ, ಪಾಲನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಹಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಪಾತ್ರವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಷ್ಣು ಪುರಾಣವು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಂಡದ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ, ದೇವ-ಅಸುರ ಯುದ್ಧಗಳು, ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ವಿವಿಧ ಅವತಾರಗಳು (ಹಾಗು ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಅವತಾರ), ಮತ್ತು ಧರ್ಮದ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಬೋಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನೂ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದ್ದು, ಜೀವನದ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

time-management-in-a-week.title: Time Management In A Week
time-management-in-a-week.description: Email notifications, social media, aur deadlines, Kahin aap bhi time ke gulaam toh nahi? Agar aapka din sirf firefighting mein hi nikal jata hai, toh ye audiobook aapki life ko completely transform kar sakti hai. Toh abhi suniye aur seekhiye kaise apni priorities set karein, multitasking ke jaal se bachein aur time ko apna sabse bada asset banayein!

rayakonda.title: Rayakonda
rayakonda.description: ಲೇಖಕ ಕರಣಂ ಪವನ ಪ್ರಸಾದ ವರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ-ರಾಯಕೊಂಡ. ಆಂಧ್ರ- ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯ ಕಥೆ ಇದು. ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ಕುಟುಂಬವೊಂದರ ತಲೆಮಾರುಗಳ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಆಂಧ್ರದ ಗಡಿಯ ಊರಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ತೆಲುಗು ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆಗಳು ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿವೆ. ಆ ಗಡಿಯ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರ ನಡಾವಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಬಿಂಬಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

బుట్టబొమ్మ-.title: బుట్టబొమ్మ
బుట్టబొమ్మ-.description: గంటలో పెళ్లి చేసుకొని అందమైన జీవితంలోకి అడుగు పెట్టబోతున్న అంజలిని కిడ్నాప్ చేసి, తన పర్సనల్ ఐ లాండ్ కి తీసుకుపోతాడు అర్జున్. 365 డేస్లో తనని ప్రేమించకపోతే, అంజలి తల్లిదండ్రుల్ని చంపేస్తానని వార్నింగ్ ఇస్తాడు. డెవిల్ కింగ్ గా పోలీసులకి కంటి మీద కునుకు లేకుండా చేస్తున్న అర్జున్, అంజలిని ఎందుకు కిడ్నాప్ చేశాడు?? అర్జున్ బారి నుండి అంజలి తప్పించుకుంటుందా? లేదా అతడి ప్రేమలో పడిపోతుందా? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

mahapisach.title: Mahapishach
mahapisach.description: Junior mining engineer Mohnish ko chronic fatigue ki problem thi jiski wajah se wo bachpan se hi physical activities me peechhe tha lekin ek din mining site par khudai karte wakt aazad ho gya Mahapishach jisne Mohnish ko possess karke use di supernatural powers. Ab in powers ke sath kya banega Mohnish? Superhero ya Supervillain?

prema-5.title: Prema
prema-5.description:
ಅವಳ ಹೆಸರು ವೇದಸಂಹಿತ!
ಜೀವನದ ಪಯಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಗುತ್ತಾ, ಯಾವುದೋ ಒಂದು ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾಗಿ ತನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ನಿಂತುಹಾಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕೆಂದು ಅವಳ ಆಸೆ.

dwarika-nagara.title: Dwaraka Nagara
dwarika-nagara.description: ದ್ವಾರಕಾ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನಿಗೆ ಸಮರ್ಪಿತವಾದ ದ್ವಾರಕಾಧೀಶ್ ದೇವಾಲಯವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಪವಿತ್ರ ತೀರ್ಥಸ್ಥಳವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಚಾರ್ಧಾಮ್ ಯಾತ್ರಾ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಆದಿ ಶಂಕರಾಚಾರ್ಯರಿಂದ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ. ದ್ವಾರಕಾ ನಗರವು ಸಪ್ತ ಪುರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಲಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಹಿಂದೂ ಧರ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹುಮೂಲ್ಯವಾದ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಪುರಾತನ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರವಾಗಿದೆ.

Rajguru-शहादत-का-दूसरा-नाम-.title: Rajguru: शहादत का दूसरा नाम
Rajguru-शहादत-का-दूसरा-नाम-.description: Saunders murder ke baad British Empire ki neend ud chuki thi, aur Lahore ke chhote sheher ka ek ladka—Rajguru—angrezi hukumat ka sabse bada dushman ban gaya. Kya unka junoon unhein azaadi ke sapne ke kareeb le gaya? Is show mein aap janege shahadat ki aisi kahani jo itihas ke pannon mein kahin gum ho chuki hai.

sowganthi.title: சௌகந்தி
sowganthi.description: ரிஷியின் அம்மா படுத்த படுக்கையில் அப்படியே இறந்து போய்விட, ரிஷி யாருமில்லா அனாதையைப் போல தவிக்கிறான். ஆனால், அடுத்த நாள் மாமா, அப்பா என்று ஒவ்வொருவராக ரிஷியைத் தேடி வருகிறார்கள். இத்தனை நாட்களாக அவர்கள் ஏன் வரவில்லை?

aisa-kyun-hota-hai-maut-se-jude-sawal-ja.title: Aisa Kyun Hota Hai : Maut se Jude Sawal Jawab
aisa-kyun-hota-hai-maut-se-jude-sawal-ja.description:
Maut ka sach kya hai? Kya atma amar hai? Hindu dharm me "Ram Naam Satya Hai" hi kyon bola jata hai?
Aisa Kyun Hota Hai: Maut Se Jude Sawal Jawab" audio show maut aur usse judi dharmik, adhyatmik aur shaastriya sachchaiyon ka raaz kholta hai. Is show me aap jaanenge ki antim yatra me "Ram Naam" ka uchcharan kyon hota hai, sharir ko mitti kyun kaha jata hai, aur vedon-tantron me maut ka kya arth hai. Agar aap bhi in gehre sawalon ke jawab dhundh rahe hain to roz shaam 8 baje suniye maut se juda naya episode.

kana-kaanum-kaalangal.title: Kana Kaanum Kaalangal
kana-kaanum-kaalangal.description: A naive village youth arrives in Chennai with dreams of a better life, only to face the harsh realities and hidden charms of the bustling city, guided by an unlikely friendship and surprising encounters.

rich-dad-poor-dad-154.title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
rich-dad-poor-dad-154.description: "ರಿಚ್ ಡ್ಯಾಡ್ ಪೂರ್ ಡ್ಯಾಡ್" ಎಂಬುದು ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಅವರ ಜೀವನದ ಕಥೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಅವರು ಎರಡು ತಂದೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆದರು.  ಅವರ ನಿಜವಾದ ತಂದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವರ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನ ತಂದೆ, ರಿಚ್ ಡ್ಯಾಡ್. ಈ ಇಬ್ಬರು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಹಣ ಮತ್ತು ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಅವರ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ರೂಪಿಸಿದರು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಹಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಹಣ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿಯೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವುದರಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುವ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

dil-fake-hai-ye-ishq.title: Dil Fake Hai Ye Ishq
dil-fake-hai-ye-ishq.description: Aryan Raavat, ek raiis family ka iklauta beta, jiski shaadi apne business partner ki beti Vanshita se taye hai. Lekin Aryan ko ye shaadi manzoor nahi hai. Woh America se padhai poori karke India lautata hai, lekin uske saath ek surprise hai - Aditi, jo chhe mahine ki pregnant hai aur Aryan ki patni hone ka daava karti hai. Aryan ke parivaar ko ye baatein manane mein pareshaani hoti hai, lekin Aryan Aditi ko apni patni ke roop mein pesh karta hai. Lekin kya ye jhoothi shaadi sachchai ko chhipa paayegi? Kya Aryan aur Aditi ke parivaar ise swikaar karenge?

the-richest-man-in-babylon-17.title: The Richest Man in Babylon
the-richest-man-in-babylon-17.description: బాబిలోన్‌లో అత్యంత ధనవంతుడు. ఈ పుస్తకం మనలో ప్రతి ఒక్కరి వ్యక్తిగత విజయాన్ని వివరిస్తుంది. విజయం అంటే మన కృషి మరియు సామర్థ్యం నుండి వచ్చే ఫలితాలు. మంచి ప్రిపరేషన్ మన విజయానికి కీలకం. కాబట్టి మీరు సంపాదించిన దానిలో కొంత భాగాన్ని మీ దగ్గర ఉంచుకోండి. పొదుపు వల్ల కలిగే ప్రయోజనాల నుండి ధనవంతులు కావడానికి అవసరమైన విషయాల వరకు, ఈ సేకరణ మీకు డబ్బును ఎలా సంపాదించాలనే దానిపై టైమ్‌లెస్ సమాచారాన్ని అందిస్తుంది. ఇది ధనవంతులు కావడానికి, అదృష్టాన్ని ఆకర్షించడానికి మరియు ఐదు బంగారు నియమాలకు మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తుంది.

akhari-atidhi.title: ఆఖరి అతిథి
akhari-atidhi.description: మరణం మనిషి జీవితం లో చివరి ఘట్టం. మరణం మనిషి కి ఎప్పుడూ చేదే. ఒక మనిషి మరణం ఇంకో మనిషిని ఎంతో బాధిస్తుంది. మరణాన్ని అతిథి లా ప్రస్తావించారు రచయిత మల్లాది వెంకట కృష్ణ మూర్తి గారు. అయితే మనిషి జీవితం లో ఆఖరి అతిథి మరణం. ప్రతి మనిషి తప్పని సరిగా ఏదో ఒక రోజు ఆఖరి అతిథిని కలుసుకుంటాడు. ఒక్కసారి కలుసుకున్నాక, ఇక ఆ మనిషి మరణించినట్టే. కాకపోతే ఈ ఆఖరి అతిథి లో డాక్టర్ శ్రీజిత్ మాత్రం అతన్ని అనేక సార్లు కలుసుకున్నాడు. ఒక మూడు రోజుల్లో అతడికి ఎదురైనా చిత్ర విచిత్ర సంఘటనలను, అనుభవాలను సస్పెన్స్ జోడిస్తూ, ఫాంటసీ అంశాలను ఆవిష్కరిస్తూ ఒక చక్కని కథ ని మన ముందుకు తీసుకొని వచ్చారు. ఈ ఆడియో పుస్తకం కచ్చితంగా మనల్ని కదిలిస్తుంది అనడం లో అతిశయోక్తి లేదు.

budget-2025-aapki-jeb-par-kya-hoga-asar.title: Budget 2025: Aapki Jeb Par Kya Hoga Asar?
budget-2025-aapki-jeb-par-kya-hoga-asar.description: Petrol, tax aur roz ke kharche—Budget 2025 aapki life ka game changer hai!  Kya aapko pata hai ki is baar ka budget aapki pocket ko kaise impact karega? Faayda hoga ya nuksan? Yeh jaanne ke liye abhi suniye yeh show!

Khachitamgaa-Naaku-Telsu-ఖచ్చితంగా-నాకు-.title: ఖచ్చితంగా నాకు తెల్సు - వంశీ
Khachitamgaa-Naaku-Telsu-ఖచ్చితంగా-నాకు-.description: దర్శకుడు వంశీ కలం నుండి జాలువారిన కథలను వినాలనుకుంటున్నారా? మీకు తెలియని ఎన్నో విషయాలను ఖచ్చితంగా నాకు తెలుసు అంటున్న వంశీ నవలను వినేయండి మరి.

vanilla.title: Vanilla
vanilla.description: గ్రామస్తులు అందరూ దేవుడిలా పూజించే దేవర, వెన్నెల మీద మనసు పడ్డాడు. దేవర ఆరో ప్రాణం అర్జున్ కూడా ఆ అమ్మాయినే ప్రాణంగా ప్రేమించాడు. ఆ అమ్మాయి మనసులో మాత్రం ఎన్నో ఏళ్లుగా ఒకరే ఉన్నారు. ఈ ట్రయాంగిల్ లవ్ స్టోరీలో ఎవరికీ తెలియని ఒక మిస్టరీ దాగి ఉంది. ఈ ప్రేమ కోసం ఎన్నో ప్రాణాలు బలి కాబోతున్నాయి.  ప్రతీకారంతో రగిలిపోయే ఒక ఆడదాని వలలో పడిన ఓ మొనగాడు చివరికి ఏమయ్యాడు? గంజాయి , గ్యాంగ్ వార్స్, గన్ కల్చర్ మధ్య సాగే ఈ gangsters కథను తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్.

love-mein-second-chance.title: Love Mein Second Chance
love-mein-second-chance.description: Ishana apne ateet ko bhool naye shehar mein ek nayi shuruaat karne aayi thi, par jis ghar mein wo kadam rakhti hai, wo har mod par use bhaagne ki chetavni deta hai. Ishana vahan ek aaina, jisme uski parchai bina uske hile hilti hai se dar hi rahi hoti hai ki darwaze par dastak hoti hai. Samne hai ek handsome padosi, Avyansh, jis par Ishana ka dil aa jata hai, par wo bina kuch kahe uske haath ek kitaab rakh kar chala jata hai. Aur tabhi ek sach Ishana ke saamne aata hai, aur uska khoon jam jata hai—Avyansh 100 saal se bhi zyada purana hai! Kya yeh ek sapna hai ya ek shraapit kahani jiski wo khud ka ek hissa ban chuki hai?

love-addict.title: Love Addict
love-addict.description: Life la verum failure -ra mattume paathu paathu salichu poyi.. Vaazhkaiyave veruthu irukkura namma Hero life la,  thideernu oru ponnu cross panraa.. Avanga rendu perukku idaila Love varumaa ?, Namma Hero life la avan ilantha santhosam marubadiyum varumaa ?🎭🔥Love Addict -  Sandhegam , Dhrogam, Pali vaangal nu pala visayangal kalandha oru kalakkalaana Love story. Miss Pannidaatheenga 🎧.

nakulan-ips.title: Nakulan IPS
nakulan-ips.description: ഒരു കൊലപാതകക്കേസ് അന്വേഷിക്കുന്ന നകുലൻ IPS, പ്രതിയായ ശുഭത്തിന്റെ നിരപരാധിത്വത്തിൽ വിശ്വസിക്കുമ്പോൾ, തന്നെ വെല്ലുവിളിക്കുന്ന ഒരു സീരിയൽ കില്ലറുടെ സാന്നിധ്യം തിരിച്ചറിയുന്നു -  ആരാണ് യഥാർത്ഥ കൊലയാളി? ഉദ്വേഗജനകമായ ഒരു അന്വേഷണ കഥ കേൾക്കാം.

chor-bana-thanedaar.title: Chor Bana Thanedaar
chor-bana-thanedaar.description: Ek maut ne ek khatarnaak chor ko rakhwala bana diya. Jise kanoon todne ki aadat thi, aaj uske haath mein kanoon ki laathi hai. Aman ki kismat use Chandanpur le aayi, jahan uska khoya pyaar ek paheli ban kar uske saamne aaya. Pahadiyon mein dafan ek raaz uski zindagi mein zeher gholne laga. Chandanpur ki khoobsurti ke peeche chhupa tha ek bhayanak sach. Kya Aman ek nakli policewala bankar wahan ke logon ko insaaf dila paayega?

layak-nalayak-odiya.title: Layak Nalayak
layak-nalayak-odiya.description: This microdrama chronicles the profound sacrifices of working-class parents, Gayatri and Sidharth Sr., who endure immense hardship to fund their son Siddharth Jr.'s education. Upon achieving prosperity, Siddharth Jr. cruelly disowns them, driven by class shame and his wife's prejudice, even forcing them to pose as strangers to meet their grandson and lying about being an orphan. In stark contrast, their adopted son, Kabir, returns successful from abroad, warmly embracing his parents and introducing them to his loving wife, Soumya, offering them solace and protection. The parents face escalating humiliation, false accusations of theft, and physical assaults orchestrated by Siddharth's wife and mother-in-law, often with Siddharth's complicity. Kabir consistently intervenes, protecting his parents and vowing revenge against Siddharth for their public disgrace. A profound family secret is revealed: Kabir is also the biological son of Gayatri and Sidharth Sr., setting the stage for a dramatic confrontation over loyalty and inheritance. Kabir eventually severs all business ties with Siddharth, leading to Siddharth's financial ruin and desperate attempts at reconciliation. Despite Siddharth's manipulative schemes, his parents ultimately disown him, severing all familial ties. Deeply humiliated by their son's betrayal and the public shaming, Gayatri and Sidharth Sr. decide to return to their ancestral village, seeking dignity and self-respect. The narrative explores the devastating impact of classism and unchecked ambition on traditional family bonds, highlighting themes of filial duty, justice, and the resilience of family love amidst profound betrayal.

dhokha-shaadi-aur-hungama-3.title: Dhokha, Shaadi aur Hungama
dhokha-shaadi-aur-hungama-3.description: “A kind-hearted girl on her way to her brother’s wedding gets trapped in a nightmarish flight with a cruel woman and her spoiled son, leading to chaos that unravels shocking secrets of power, betrayal, and mistaken identity. When love, lies, and family honor collide, a storm of revenge and revelation erupts midair and beyond.”

billionaire-maa-ka-gareeb-beta.title: Billionaire Maa ka Gareeb Beta
billionaire-maa-ka-gareeb-beta.description: While fleeing from goons trying to kill her, billionaire businesswoman Meera is forced to hand over her infant son to a poor farmer to save his life. The child grows up as Vikram, raised with love, dignity, and hardship. Years later, fate brings Meera back to the village, only to mistake another boy for her lost son. As greed, lies, and power clash, the real son must fight not just for his identity, but for the values his poor father gave him.

rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons-3.title: Rudraroop - Revenge of Richierich Sons
rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons-3.description: A single mother raises three remarkable sons while facing constant challenges from her family. When she returns home for her father’s seventieth birthday, she is met with coldness and hostility from her father and younger sisters. Refusing to be broken, she stands tall against their prejudice and finds her own path to happiness.

secret-life-of-billionaire-baap.title: Secret Life Of Billionaire Baap
secret-life-of-billionaire-baap.description: Darshan, a humble repairman with a secret billionaire identity, unexpectedly helps a female CEO survive a corporate crisis.To repay him, she pretends to be his son’s stepmother—setting off a chain of misunderstandings and emotional conflict.When Darshan reveals his true power at his son’s banquet, disbelief turns to shock as the truth finally comes to light.

villager-to-billionaire.title: Villager to Billionaire
villager-to-billionaire.description: The microdrama begins with Amma and Prabha's desperate search for Ragini, who they discover living in opulence, leading to the shocking revelation of her live-in relationship and a fierce generational clash with her traditional mother. Ragini's defiance escalates, culminating in her abandoning her family amidst financial ruin and her mother's suicide threats, who blames Ragini for their despair. Prabha makes a significant sacrifice, offering her gold chain to prevent eviction, only for the landlord to expose Ragini's chronic deceptions and scandalous behavior, further tarnishing the family's reputation. As the family struggles, Ragini secures a personal assistant role with CEO Amar, quickly impressing him and sparking a potential romance, though Amar senses a connection to a past love, Divya. Ragini's world is then rocked by Kamal, who exposes their transactional relationship, fueling her desire for revenge. A lost gold chain, initially belonging to Divya, becomes a pivotal clue, leading Amar to mistakenly identify Ragini as Divya, his long-lost love. Seizing this opportunity, Ragini ruthlessly devises a cunning plan to impersonate Divya, claim a vast inheritance, and marry Amar, a future originally intended for the simple Prabha. She blackmails her mother, Radha, threatening murder to maintain her elaborate deception. Meanwhile, the true Divya, a long-lost heiress, attempts to reconnect with her past, while Sanjay, another lost child, seeks his mother, Akhilandeshwari. Suspicions about Ragini's true identity grow, particularly from Amar and an Aunty, as her personality drastically shifts. A family matriarch initiates an investigation into the mysterious woman and the heirloom chain. Amidst this web of deceit, Prabha navigates a clandestine romance with Kamal and conceals her daughter from a menacing threat. However, Amar's affections shift to Prabha, culminating in a mutual declaration of love, despite Divya's (Ragini's) unrequited feelings for him. The imposter Ragini, now revealed as Prabha's greedy sister, plots to eliminate Prabha to secure the inheritance and prevent exposure. This culminates in a violent abduction attempt on Prabha, thwarted by Amar. In the aftermath, Amar exposes Ragini's manipulative plot, leading to her arrest for her ambition to usurp Prabha's life. Despite Ragini's downfall, Prabha grapples with loyalty to her adoptive mother, initially rejecting Amar's suggestion to return to her biological family. However, Prabha's estranged biological mother, consumed by regret, makes a dramatic return, sacrificing her entire fortune to reconcile and atone for past mistakes. The series concludes with a conflict over the guardianship of Prabha's daughter, which Amar resolves, leading to a family reunification and a blossoming romance between Sita and Amar, bringing a semblance of peace after profound betrayal and deception.

5star-ka-billionaire-naukar.title: 5star ka Billionaire Naukar
5star-ka-billionaire-naukar.description:
Arjun Raichand, secret billionaire heir, must work as a hotel servant for 4 days to prove he deserves to be CEO. He faces humiliation, discovers his girlfriend cheating with villain Marcus, and saves Marcus's captive wife Natasha. At the grand party, Marcus humiliates him publicly. But when his shift ends, Arjun is announced CEO, Marcus gets arrested, and Kavya is left begging. From toilet cleaner to ₹50,000 crore empire's CEO.
WATCH NOW..

not-a-gully-boy.title: Not a Gully Boy
not-a-gully-boy.description: The powerful Varma family initiates a desperate search for their long-lost heir, Indra, fifteen years after his disappearance, crucial for their corporate legacy. Unbeknownst to them, their heir, now known as Tarun, lives a life of servitude and abuse under the tyrannical Chinnaya Garu and her son, Vikram Chowdary, who forbid his passion for music. Tarun, a gifted singer, finds a glimmer of hope through a supportive friend who encourages him to enter a high-stakes music competition, seeing it as his only path to freedom. Meanwhile, Omkar, driven by a personal connection to a 15-year-old abduction, actively searches for Indra. The Varma family eventually arrives at Chinnaya Garu's home, where she shockingly realizes that Tarun, her mistreated "foster servant," is the very heir they have been seeking. However, Indra Varma's identity is then stolen by a cunning imposter, leading to his captivity while another young talent, Tarun, faces brutal suppression and humiliation from Chinneya, who obstructs his musical aspirations. Tarun, claiming to be the long-lost heir Indra Varma, becomes embroiled in a fierce inheritance dispute, but a DNA test, possibly tampered with, declares Vikram the legitimate heir, exposing Tarun as a deceiver and leading to his imprisonment. Patriarch Varma takes custody of Tarun from his mother Komali, hinting at unresolved past secrets and her betrayal. Tarun is later targeted for assassination in a hospital but is rescued and protected by Doctor Anusha. A re-test ultimately confirms Tarun as the true long-lost nephew, Indra, revealing his biological mother, Komali, as the orchestrator of the initial assassination attempt. With his voice miraculously recovered, Indra, now a 'super singer,' enters a high-stakes music competition, ruthlessly sabotaging a rival and clashing with the rival heir, Indra Varma (Vikram). Despite facing biased judges and disqualification in a rigged competition, Tarun's exceptional performance and the intervention of a Super Judge lead to his declaration as the rightful winner. At a succession party, Tarun, revealed to be the true heir 'Indra,' exposes his ambitious imposter nephew, Dinesh. Further revelations expose Komal Chowdary's heinous plot against Tarun, leading to the arrest of both Komal and Vikram, solidifying Tarun's claim as the new owner of the Varma Group.

rented-husband-4.title: Rented Husband
rented-husband-4.description: A mysterious billionaire hides his true identity and agrees to a contract marriage with a woman trying to save her family business, only to face relentless humiliation from her greedy relatives. But as secrets unravel, the tables turn in this emotional rollercoaster of pride, love, and revenge.

chuppi.title: Chuppi
chuppi.description: Chuppi is a dark psychological thriller about a woman trapped in an abusive marriage with a powerful ACP. After escaping and starting a new life under a false identity, Aarohi finds hope and healing, until her past hunts her down. The series is a haunting exploration of silence, survival, and the courage to finally speak up. Watch now!

dangerous-dad-6.title: Dangerous Dad
dangerous-dad-6.description: A cleaner, Aaryan, saves a rich girl, Avni, from the clutches of a wealthy man. Aaryan is actually a secret head of the syndicate and is called Ghost, but he has hidden this identity from everyone – even his own son. How will he navigate his life while also fighting his enemies on his journey? Watch now!

rowdy-baap-returns.title: Rowdy Baap Returns
rowdy-baap-returns.description: The series plunges into a brutal urban underworld, where characters, often recently released from incarceration, are immediately thrust into quests for vengeance, justice, and the protection of family. Gang leader Anna, upon release, seeks a mysterious "Chinna" and later unleashes brutal revenge for her daughter, eventually returning as "Rowdy Anna" after fourteen years to reclaim authority and settle old debts, initiating brutal power struggles. Concurrently, Bala Bhai, also recently released, discovers his daughter Meera's suspicious marriage and abandonment, vowing retribution, while Sinna confronts her father for her mother's death and endures an abusive marriage. Meera attempts a fresh start but is drawn into power struggles, with Anna making a possessive claim on her, and the resurfacing mystery of her mother's 14-year-old murder. This long-held secret implicates her father, Appa, and a cunning criminal mastermind who framed Bala for the crime, manipulating Nandini into believing her father's guilt. Throughout the narrative, themes of loyalty, betrayal, and the relentless cycle of violence are paramount. Police officer DGP Shirke wages war against criminal elements, while various characters, including Bala (Tatya's associate), orchestrate meticulously planned 14-year revenge plots for financial retribution or the mistreatment of their daughters. Vulnerable young girls and family members are constantly at risk, prompting fierce protection from figures like Dharma and Anna, whose own daughter is threatened, igniting his protective fury. The stakes escalate as personal vendettas ignite large-scale conflicts, kidnappings, and brutal showdowns, leading to unforgiving justice and shocking betrayals. Ultimately, the show explores the unraveling of long-held secrets and the desperate fight to protect loved ones, culminating in violent confrontations where some characters find a path towards a new, stable life, free from their dangerous pasts, while others face their final, brutal consequences.

layak-nalayak-3.title: Layak Nalayak
layak-nalayak-3.description: The microdrama centers on the profound sacrifices of Gayatri and Raghu (Aai and Baba) for their son Siddharth's education, which he repays with cruel betrayal and deceit. Driven by social ambition, Siddharth disowns his humble parents, fabricating a lie about being an orphan to his affluent wife and her family to secure his elevated status. Throughout the narrative, Gayatri and Raghu endure immense humiliation, forced to pose as strangers, rural neighbors, or even servants, and are falsely accused of theft, leading to public shaming and physical assault. Simultaneously, Kabir, their adopted son, returns from abroad to find his parents in distress, initially hesitant to enter his affluent home due to their perceived "dirty" status. Kabir quickly uncovers Siddharth's betrayal and the ongoing suffering of his parents, vowing to protect them and expose the truth. The conflict escalates as Siddharth continues to publicly discredit and confine his parents to maintain his social standing, even as Kabir, a wealthy CEO, orchestrates a grand plan. Kabir dramatically arrives at a corporate event, publicly revealing Aai and Baba as his true parents, presenting irrefutable evidence that they are also Siddharth's biological parents and that Kabir is Siddharth's brother. This revelation exposes Siddharth's elaborate deception, leading to his financial ruin as Kabir severs business ties and strips him of backing. Facing destitution, Siddharth desperately attempts to manipulate his estranged parents and coerce his wife into a charade of respect for business survival. Adding to the complexity, a vengeful Ria attempts to use the elderly couple as leverage against Kabir in a corporate battle. Ultimately, despite Kabir's pleas, Gayatri and Vasant (Aai and Baba) make the heartbreaking decision to leave the city for their village, seeking dignity over continued humiliation. Kabir, however, remains resolute, vowing ruthless retribution to dismantle Siddharth's entire empire and career.

mechanic-billa-return-of-the-racing-lege.title: Mechanic Billa: Return of the Racing Legend
mechanic-billa-return-of-the-racing-lege.description: ஐந்து ஆண்டுகளாக தலைமறைவாக வாழும் முன்னாள் கார் பந்தய சாம்பியன், தன் கிராமத்தைக் காப்பாற்ற மீண்டும் களமிறங்க, உலகின் தற்போதைய சாம்பியனுடன் மோதும் விறுவிறுப்பான ஆட்டம் தொடங்குகிறது. இப்பவே பாருங்க!

my-accidental-husband-is-a-billionaire-2.title: My Accidental Husband Is A Billionaire
my-accidental-husband-is-a-billionaire-2.description: To escape a forced marriage, Ishita impulsively marries Yuvraj, a poor construction worker with no past or identity. What begins as a marriage of convenience soon changes when hidden truths surface. Yuvraj is not an ordinary laborer but one of the world’s richest men, betrayed by his own family and stripped of his memory. As power, greed, and revenge collide, Ishita must choose between wealth and trust, while Yuvraj fights to reclaim his life and protect the woman who believed in him first.

brother-betrayal-4.title: Brother Betrayal
brother-betrayal-4.description: The microdrama centers on the profound betrayal and escalating conflict within a powerful family, initially stemming from sacrifices made for Rohan's education. Ten years later, Rohan, now an ambitious CEO, returns to his ancestral village with plans to demolish his family home for a resort, callously displacing his struggling sister-in-law Shanti and her daughter Aditi. He aligns with his cruel boss Yogesh, who makes predatory propositions towards Shanti and Aditi. This act of betrayal draws the dramatic return of Alok, Rohan's elder brother, who had been absent for a decade, to protect his family and confront Rohan and Yogesh, revealing a deep-seated grudge. The conflict expands into a ruthless corporate and familial power struggle within the Patalia Finance empire. Alok, often identified as a powerful Chairman or CEO, asserts his authority, seeking retribution for past wrongs and defending his family's honor against those who exploited them. Rohan, accused of unethical practices, exploiting family members, and disloyalty, becomes a central antagonist. He is confronted by Alok/Ashok and The Chairman for his transgressions, including betraying his brother and sister-in-law. The narrative highlights a complex web of corporate corruption, class conflict, and personal vendettas, as Alok orchestrates a "cleaning drive" and corporate takeover to dismantle those who wronged his family. Rohan's defiance escalates, leading to accusations against Alok/Ashok and even an attempt to abduct Alok's daughter. Ultimately, the true Chairman, long hidden, is dramatically revealed, leading to a swift reckoning. The show culminates in Alok's severe punishment and banishment of his brother Rohan, despite pleas from Alok's children, as Alok consolidates his authority and exacts revenge for the injustices suffered by his family. The stakes involve the preservation of family, justice against a corrupt system, and the devastating consequences of greed and betrayal.

asli-desi-billionaire.title: Asli Desi Billionaire
asli-desi-billionaire.description: A secret billionaire hides his identity and works as a peon in the US to uncover discrimination against Indians. When he becomes a woman’s fake boyfriend, real feelings emerge—until his true wealth and power threaten to destroy everything they built.

layak-nalayak-2.title: Layak Nalayak
layak-nalayak-2.description: This microdrama explores the profound sacrifices parents make for their children's success and the devastating consequences of ambition on family bonds. It centers on Siddharth, who leaves his humble home for the city, only to disown his parents, Raghunath and Gayatri, upon achieving affluence, forcing them to endure humiliation and betrayal. Simultaneously, the narrative introduces Kabir, an adopted son who deeply cherishes his adoptive parents, only to discover a shocking truth about his identity and a manipulative biological son, Siddharth, who has caused his adoptive parents to abandon him. Siddharth and his wife mercilessly humiliate and banish his elderly parents and aunt, even falsely accusing them of theft. Kabir emerges as a protective figure for his own parents and vows to rescue Siddharth's parents and confront the injustice. The conflict escalates as Kabir, now a powerful CEO, retaliates against Siddharth for disrespecting his mother, canceling a major business deal. Kabir exposes Siddharth's past betrayal and humiliation of his own parents, leaving him financially vulnerable. Facing ruin, Siddharth attempts manipulative reconciliation, blaming his parents for his plight, but they disown him. A sinister subplot unfolds involving the abuse and exploitation of elderly parents by household staff, with Siddharth's parents being coerced and abused. Siddharth devises a cynical scheme to exploit his parents for financial gain. Ultimately, Kabir confronts Siddharth with DNA evidence, revealing his true parentage and ingratitude. Siddharth's biological parents, having endured immense humiliation, decide to return to their ancestral village to reclaim their dignity, despite his pleas. The show highlights the stark contrast between filial ingratitude and enduring love, exposing the painful chasm between urban aspirations and traditional values.

rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons-2.title: Rudraroop - Revenge of Richierich Sons
rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons-2.description: Estranged son Raghav returns home for his father's 70th birthday, disrupting a family celebration and immediately facing public shaming from his materialistic mother, Sneha, over his divorce and humble gift. Amidst deep-seated class consciousness, his father, Acha, offers unwavering support, contrasting with the familial rejection. The conflict escalates around a deceptive gift exchange involving an expensive wine, leading to a public confrontation, a shocking slap from his mother, and a high-stakes bet challenging the wine's authenticity. Raghav is repeatedly accused of fraud and deceit by family members like Amma and Priya, especially concerning the immense value of various wine bottles. Despite facing overwhelming judgment and threats, Raghav defiantly seeks to clear his name, even as his expert cousin, Raj, is potentially poisoned after a taste test, further implicating Raghav. He silences accusers with digital proof of purchase and dramatically unmasks himself as the true owner of the powerful "Royal Group," shocking his conniving relatives Rishabh and Priya. Raghav asserts his formidable wealth and power through extravagant gifts, challenging other attendees and exposing deceit. A complex web of family secrets and corporate intrigue unravels with Raghav's shocking claim that company owner Prem is his son, intertwining with high-stakes medical research at the Darwin Lab. A formidable matriarch intensifies the family feud, accusing Raghav of fraud, denying his paternity claims, and ultimately disinheriting her own son. Generational conflicts escalate, fueled by class divisions and fraudulent claims, as Bundy and Shruthi lose their jobs to an AI-driven scam, prompting their mother, Amma, to vow retribution. Raghav faces down an arrogant Boss and his son, revealing his own surprising influence and igniting a corporate battle. His corporate dreams and family honor are challenged by a rival and a bitter family dispute over inheritance, leading to public humiliation and death threats. A shocking truth is unveiled: Raghav's sons, Rishabh and Ashok, are revealed to be formidable CEOs of major corporations, shifting power dynamics. Despite this, Raghav, haunted by past betrayals, prepares to sever ties with his family and leave with Meghana, despite their pleas for forgiveness.

ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires.title: Ultimate Hacker vs Billionaire
ultimate-hacker-vs-billionaires.description:
A cyber attack threatens India's banking system. 50,000 crore hangs in the balance. The only man who can stop it? Vedant Nayak — a brilliant software engineer and son of a farmer driven to suicide by the very bank he's been called to save.
Humiliated, beaten, and mistaken for a thief, Vedant faces the arrogant billionaire Vikrant Hirakar — who once destroyed his family. With minutes on the clock, Vedant must choose: save his enemy's empire... or let it burn. Watch now.

billionaire-lost-waris-2.title: Billionaire Lost Waris
billionaire-lost-waris-2.description: Once the heiress of a grand mansion, she is betrayed and reduced to a servant in her own home. But when a mysterious ally reveals himself as her hidden protector, her lost voice and destiny begin to return. Together, they expose the lies, reunite with a father awakening after sixteen years, and reclaim everything stolen from her. Watch now!

billionaire-chaprasi-ki-biwi.title: Secret Shaadi
billionaire-chaprasi-ki-biwi.description: Varsh Marwa, heir to a powerful business empire, refuses to become CEO and goes undercover as a peon in his family’s failing Bastar coal company. There, he joins Bhavya, a poor but honest girl, to expose deep-rooted corruption and a coal mafia. Forced into a secret contract marriage to save Bhavya, Varsh hides his identity until it’s revealed at an international summit—uncovering betrayal within his own family and turning his mission into a fight for love, truth, and redemption.

oops-my-husband-is-mafia-boss.title: Oops My Husband is Mafia Boss
oops-my-husband-is-mafia-boss.description: Sneha, a kind-hearted woman, lives peacefully until her brother’s accident leaves him needing ₹80 lakhs for surgery. Desperate, she meets Vikram Devraj, a ruthless mafia boss with a hidden past. He offers her a deal- marry him for a year in exchange for the money. Reluctantly, she agrees, but their cold contract turns into something deeper. When her ex-lover returns and Vikram’s enemies strike, Sneha’s world spirals into chaos ending in a shocking gunshot that changes everything.

oops-my-husband-is-mafia-boss-2.title: Oops My Husband is Mafia Boss
oops-my-husband-is-mafia-boss-2.description: Her quiet life shatters when her brother’s accident forces her to seek money from a ruthless mafia boss. A one-year contract marriage begins as a cold deal but slowly turns into a dangerous, emotional bond. When her past returns and his enemies close in, one gunshot changes their lives forever.

mr-hero-husband.title: Mr. Hero Husband
mr-hero-husband.description: A billionaire hiding in plain sight. For 3 years, Rahul Oberoi — secret chairman of the Oberoi Group — endures brutal humiliation from in-laws who see him as a "worthless beggar." Only his wife Esha stands by him. This Diwali, when arrogant relatives, scheming suitors, and power-hungry executives push too far, Rahul's true identity unravels — turning every insult into sweet revenge. Watch the tables turn as tormentors fall to their knees. Watch now.

layak-nalayak-1.title: Layak Nalayak
layak-nalayak-1.description:
Two sons, raised with the same upbringing, grow into opposite men.
One becomes a reflection of Lord Ram’s ideals, while the other walks a completely different path.
Their contrasting destinies reveal how character, not parvarish alone, shapes who we become.

mumbai-delhi-mumbai.title: MUMBAI DELHI MUMBAI
mumbai-delhi-mumbai.description: Watch This Evergreen Movie "MUMBAI DELHI MUMBAI" Only on KUKU TV!

oops-my-husband-is-mafia-boss-1.title: Oops My Husband is Mafia Boss
oops-my-husband-is-mafia-boss-1.description: Gangster Vikram is hurt in a rival attack and cared for by a scared nurse. His boss tells him to hunt down his attackers. While he is doing this, a woman, Sneha, has problems with her friend, Jeevan. A shocking betrayal and hidden secrets link the attack, the hunt, and the friend, putting many lives in danger. It is a story of gang war and lies.

parents-tears.title: Parents Tears
parents-tears.description:
Two sons are raised the same, yet grow into opposite men.
One lives by Lord Ram’s values, the other goes his own way.

brother-betrayal-3.title: Brother Betrayal
brother-betrayal-3.description: This microdrama chronicles the decade-long saga of Vinitha and Rohan (Patriarch), who make immense sacrifices for the education of Rohan (Developer), the younger brother. However, Rohan (Developer) returns as a ruthless executive, attempting to demolish their ancestral home and terrorizing Vinitha and her daughter, Aditi, who face extreme poverty, physical assault, and blackmail. After a decade-long absence, Rohan (Patriarch), also known as Alok, returns to confront his greedy younger brother and other powerful antagonists, fighting to reclaim his family's honor, legacy, and home. Initially perceived as an ordinary laborer, Alok dramatically reveals his true identity as the benevolent Chairman of a powerful financial group, systematically exposing deep-seated ingratitude, corporate corruption, and betrayal within his own family and the formidable Pattalia Group. He confronts ambitious managers like Hari Prasad, who attempts to exploit Aditi and threatens Alok's family, and exposes Hari Prasad's history of misconduct, leading to his downfall and arrest. Alok also uncovers fraudulent actions and even attempted fratricide by his brothers, Rohan and Siddarth, who sought to murder him for corporate ambition. With the help of loyal allies, Alok orchestrates the downfall of his enemies, asserting his power and seeking justice against those who dishonored his family. He strategically cancels major investments, causing significant financial and political fallout for his adversaries, including Jyoti's politically influential father. The Chairman, revealed as Rohan, returns after ten years to exact brutal revenge on those who wronged his family, ultimately ordering punishment for a family member who sabotaged his company. The narrative culminates in Alok/Rohan solidifying his position as the unyielding Chairman, navigating complex family dynamics, and revealing a hidden paternal connection to Jyoti, promising a future shaped by his reclaimed authority and pursuit of justice.

don-in-uniform.title: Don In Uniform
don-in-uniform.description: Yash, ek underworld don, school ke ladke Rahul ko bachate hue maara gaya, aur uski aatma Rahul ke andar bas gayi. Kamzor aur bechaara Rahul, jise sab kam aankte the, ab Yash ki taakat aur swag ke saath badalne laga. Yash ne Rahul ko sambhalne aur uska graduation ka sapna poora karne ka faisla kiya. School mein Rahul hero ban gaya, ladkiyan uske charm ki deewani ho gayi. Lekin padhai aur beeta hua past uske liye badi chunauti ban gaye. Kahi Yash Rahul ko apni tarah criminal to nahi bana dega?

billionaire-lost-waris-1.title: Billionaire Lost Waris
billionaire-lost-waris-1.description: “A poor, heartbroken girl’s life changes when a mysterious billionaire singer saves her and brings her into his world of fame, danger, and desire. As hidden enemies and dark secrets surface, their unexpected bond becomes a battle between love, power, and survival.”

hamare-aakhiri-7-din.title: Hamare Aakhiri 7 Din
hamare-aakhiri-7-din.description: Days before his wedding, Akshat chooses a radical memory erasure procedure to forget Soumya after she abandons him for her supposedly terminally ill ex, Harsh, only for the truth to emerge too late, leaving Soumya desperate to reclaim a love Akshat no longer remembers.

layak-nalayak.title: Layak Nalayak
layak-nalayak.description:
Two sons, raised with the same upbringing, grow into opposite men.
One becomes a reflection of Lord Ram’s ideals, while the other walks a completely different path.
Their contrasting destinies reveal how character, not parvarish alone, shapes who we become.

brother-betrayal-2.title: Brother Betrayal
brother-betrayal-2.description:
Once the heiress of a grand mansion, she is betrayed and reduced to a servant in her own home.
But when a mysterious ally reveals himself as her hidden protector, her lost voice and destiny begin to return. Together, they expose the lies, reunite with a father awakening after sixteen years, and reclaim everything stolen from her. Watch now!

super-star-ki-fake-gf.title: Super Star Ki Fake GF
super-star-ki-fake-gf.description: A struggling single mother pretending to be a Bollywood superstar’s girlfriend to survive his ruthless world never imagined the lie would turn into love or that the truth could destroy them both.

gareeb-dil-billionaire-1.title: Gareeb Dil Billionaire
gareeb-dil-billionaire-1.description: The microdrama chronicles the devastating impact of social ambition and class disparity on family bonds, beginning with the immense sacrifices made by humble parents, Gayatri and her husband, for their son Siddharth's education. Years later, Siddharth, now a successful professional, publicly disowns them and fabricates a lie about being an orphan to his affluent wife, Riya, to protect his carefully constructed image. He forces his heartbroken parents to conceal their true identity, leading to their humiliation and being treated as servants or beggars by his wife, Baby, who even falsely accuses them of theft and subjects them to physical assault. Meanwhile, Kabir, a young man Gayatri once took in, returns as a successful adult, reunites with his adoptive parents, and insists on caring for them, growing suspicious of Siddharth's involvement in their distress. Upon discovering his parents' public humiliation and mistreatment by Siddharth, Kabir, now a magnate, vows fierce reckoning. He cancels a lucrative business deal with Siddharth and threatens to dismantle his empire, exposing Siddharth's deception about his biological parents to his wife, Varsha/Anjali. Facing severe financial crisis, Siddharth desperately attempts reconciliation, yet also devises a morally bankrupt scheme to exploit his parents for temporary financial gain, while his wife plots to poison them. A vigilant daughter uncovers the poisoning attempt, prompting the elders to seek relocation. The climax reveals Kabir as Siddharth's biological brother, intensifying the corporate vendetta and personal betrayal. Despite Kabir's pleas, the deeply humiliated parents, Gayatri and her husband, ultimately decide to abandon city life and return to their ancestral village, seeking to reclaim their dignity. This narrative explores the profound consequences of denying one's roots and the agonizing choice between social standing and familial honor.

final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga.title: Final Betrayal - Honeymoon Saga
final-betrayal-honeymoon-saga.description: Final Betrayal – Season 2 continues the gripping saga from Season 1, where a humble beggar marries a dhokla vendor, only for a shocking revelation to surface later: the beggar is, in fact, a billionaire. In Season 2, the newly married couple travels to Mauritius for their honeymoon. However, their dream getaway soon turns into a nightmare as unforeseen events and dangerous secrets plunge them into chaos, testing their relationship, trust, and survival.

brother-betrayal-1.title: Brother Betrayal
brother-betrayal-1.description: తమ్ముడు చదువుకోవాలని తన జీవితాన్ని త్యాగం చేసిన అన్నయ్యకి తమ్ముడిలోని మార్పు షాక్ కి గురి చేస్తుంది. అన్నదమ్ముల మధ్య ఏం జరిగింది? చూడండి "Brother Betrayal" ఫ్యామిలీ డ్రామా మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

bodhi-varma-return-of-the-beggar-dragon-.title: Bodhi Varma: Return of the Beggar Dragon
bodhi-varma-return-of-the-beggar-dragon-.description: Once an unknown stranger, he now rules from the Dragon Throne—where only destiny’s chosen may sit. Whispers spread across nations, echoing one mystery — Who is Varman really? The veil is about to lift. Dive into the truth — watch now!

ceo-bana-ghar-jamai.title: CEO Bana Ghar Jamai
ceo-bana-ghar-jamai.description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

billionaire-lost-waris.title: Billionaire Lost Waris
billionaire-lost-waris.description: Once the heiress of a grand mansion, she is betrayed and reduced to a servant in her own home. But when a mysterious ally reveals himself as her hidden protector, her lost voice and destiny begin to return. Together, they expose the lies, reunite with a father awakening after sixteen years, and reclaim everything stolen from her. Watch now!

my-accidental-husband.title: My Accidental Husband
my-accidental-husband.description: My Accidental Husband is a powerful drama where fate collides two broken lives through a shocking IVF mistake. Payal, abandoned and abused for being childless, finally conceives—only to be discarded by her husband. The child she carries belongs to Ranvijay Rathore, a feared yet principled man bound by legacy and power. As love slowly grows, they face betrayal, violence, and family conspiracies, turning motherhood into a battlefield and love into an act of courage.

brother-betrayal.title: Brother Betrayal
brother-betrayal.description: Alok Upadhyay, a noble elder brother, sacrifices everything to secure a bright future for his younger brother Rohan. But as Alok rises to power with the support of his devoted wife Anita and strong-willed daughter Aditi, Rohan, twisted by greed and fueled by his arrogant wife Diya, betrays the very family that gave him everything. A tale of sacrifice, ambition, and the tragic downfall of brotherhood.

the-lost-billionaire-2.title: The Lost Billionaire
the-lost-billionaire-2.description: Years ago, little Krish was thrown out of Rampur as “unlucky,” shattering his parents’ hearts. Fate had other plans. After 18 years, he returns as Karan Singhania: a rich, powerful man and the unexpected son-in-law of their adopted daughter, Priya. The village that once rejected him now bows in respect, unaware of his truth. As secrets surface, old wounds reopen, relationships crumble, and pride is tested. This is not a story of revenge, but of justice, identity, and a son finally coming home.

bodhi-varma-return-of-the-beggar-dragon.title: Bodhi Varma: Return of the Beggar Dragon
bodhi-varma-return-of-the-beggar-dragon.description: An amnesiac named Babu, later known as Varma, begins a tumultuous journey to uncover his identity while unexpectedly adopting a young girl, Kavita, and forming an unconventional family through multiple marriages to Darshini, Honey, and Kavitha. His past quickly resurfaces, forcing him and Kavita to flee, leading to initial challenges including a martial arts combat with Darshini, whom he marries despite opposition. Varma then faces the formidable martial arts champion Nitish, who relentlessly pursues Dharshini, leading to escalating confrontations that reveal Varma's hidden strength and Dharshini's own mysteriously halved, then amplified, martial prowess. Despite being perceived as a "beggar," Varma unleashes immense mystical power, defeating Nitish in brutal battles and causing his authority to crumble, though a new drug-enhanced challenger immediately emerges. Dharshini's formidable parents intervene to protect Varma from Nitish's revenge, as Varma defiantly holds Nitish captive, vowing to eliminate all threats to his family. The couple faces intense societal scrutiny and demands for divorce due to perceived class disparities, but Dharshini fiercely defends their profound, mystical bond. Varma's reckless actions initially jeopardize his family's standing, but he gradually reveals formidable martial arts skills and a hidden identity, culminating in his dramatic exposure of an imposter "Dragon Master." The true Dragon Master, Thathayya, is revealed but refuses the chair to protect a profound secret and his family's legacy from the looming threat of Karna. Young Kavitha defiantly claims the forbidden Dragon Master Chair, demonstrating extraordinary inherited power by defeating a formidable Dragon Master named Tatha, but is later poisoned by a ruthless Villain. Varma, initially drugged and exiled, emerges as the true, enigmatic Dragon Master, a secret he kept from Dharshini, and fiercely defends his family and title against accusations and challenges. Dharshini ultimately discovers Varma's hidden identity, and he reveals Kavitha is an orphan, solidifying their chosen family bond amidst the ongoing power struggles and the looming threat of the Karna family. Varma fights to protect his loved ones, assert his true power, and unravel the mysteries of his past and the Dragon Master legacy.

bodhi-varma-return-of-the-beggar-dragon-.title: Bodhi Varma: Return of the Beggar Dragon
bodhi-varma-return-of-the-beggar-dragon-.description: Once an unknown stranger, he now rules from the Dragon Throne—where only destiny’s chosen may sit. Whispers spread across nations, echoing one mystery — Who is Varman really? The veil is about to lift. Dive into the truth — watch now!

bhikhari-bana-jadugar.title: Bhikhari Bana Jadugar
bhikhari-bana-jadugar.description: A broken man is granted a second chance by a mysterious beggar, only to realize that the true miracle was never wealth—but the transformation of his own soul.

crowned-in-love-the-mother-of-three-bigs.title: Bhairava 2.0
crowned-in-love-the-mother-of-three-bigs.description: Karthik, facing financial ruin and betrayal, is driven to desperate measures to save his assets, straining his marriage to Nitya amidst his obsession with money and a mysterious voice, Bhairava. A shocking discovery of "bloody crap" hints at the dark origins of unconventional wealth, as Karthik, swindled by a con artist, seeks Bhairava's help for an impossible fortune. He discovers "Bhairava," a mysterious AI phone that grants uncanny insights and rapid success in high-stakes betting, leading to sudden wealth attributed to "baby luck." This newfound power, however, blurs Karthik's moral compass, sparking Nitya's suspicion and loneliness, and attracting the attention of rivals like Roshan and a cynical observer. Nitya confronts Karthik about his dangerous "shortcuts" and "gambling," issuing an ultimatum for him to change his illicit ways or she will leave with their unborn child. Karthik's lavish success, guided by Bhairava, sparks envy and manipulative curiosity, leading to the revelation of this dangerous secret. He becomes entangled in a theft, a police chase, and a critically injured suspect who claims to be framed, further straining his relationship with Nitya. His secretive actions and questionable methods lead to profound distrust and accusations of infidelity from his pregnant partner. Despite Nitya's growing apprehension and warnings about the dangerous power, Karthik continues to use Bhairava, even asking about their future children, leaving Nitya deeply uneasy about the consequences of forbidden knowledge. A corporate war erupts between Karthik and Roshan, with Karthik exposing Roshan's real estate fraud, and Roshan retaliating with ruthless power plays. Meanwhile, a ruthless CEO, Rajesh, becomes obsessed with Bhairava, believing it's the source of Karthik's success, but Bhairava proves to have lethal consequences, falsely accusing Karthik of deaths. Rajesh orchestrates a plot to disable Karthik's phone, leading to his own downfall when an accuser exposes his past involvement in device-related fatalities. Amidst this corporate intrigue, Karthik's marriage to Nitya crumbles due to his phone obsession, culminating in Nitya's divorce ultimatum and his profound regret over his lost family. Roshan faces public accusations of fraud orchestrated by Bhairava, exposing his illicit activities and damaging his reputation. This intense feud is abruptly interrupted when Roshan receives urgent news that Nitya has gone into labor. As Karthik rushes to the hospital, he confronts a devastating personal loss: the death of one of his twin infants, revealed by a mysterious AI as a karmic consequence of his ruthless ambition and greed. This profound tragedy forces Karthik into a deep self-reckoning, leading him to renounce his accumulated power and wealth. He seeks forgiveness from Nitya, and they reconcile, welcoming a healthy baby boy while mourning their lost daughter. Ultimately, Karthik undergoes a complete transformation, entrusting all his assets to Nitya for the greater good, finding true strength in self-confidence and their renewed bond.

agle-24-ghante.title: Agle 24 Ghante
agle-24-ghante.description: Haunted by a decade-old family tragedy, powerful businessman Vikram Bansal, later identified as Karan, faces a chilling ultimatum when his sister, Prerna, is threatened with murder unless a massive ransom is paid. Prerna is kidnapped immediately upon her arrival in Mumbai, forcing Karan to race against time while grappling with a grave secret and an unseen enemy. As Prerna flees, guided by her brother, she uncovers the horrifying truth that their parents were murdered, making her a target in a deadly family vendetta. Her escape turns into a desperate fight for survival, where she encounters both a mysterious protector and aggressive individuals, leading to a catastrophic bus crash that makes her a desperate fugitive with a bounty on her head. Karan, sharing a profound bond with Prerna, embarks on a desperate rescue mission amidst public outrage. Prerna becomes entangled in a deadly family enmity and is targeted by the vengeful heiress Trisha, who publicly humiliates and assaults her, accusing her of seducing Karan and ruining family honor, while Prerna grapples with memory loss. Concurrently, a ruthless plot targets CEO Karan, initially using a woman named Prerna as a decoy. This 'Prerna' is later exposed as an imposter, manipulating her way into Karan's life by falsely claiming to be his long-lost sister and then his future wife. The true heir, Trisha Mehra, orchestrates contract killings and fights to expose the imposter, while Karan's actual sister, Naina, has her identity suppressed. Karan frantically searches for his missing sister, Prerna, only to discover his fiancée, Trisha, is the mastermind behind Prerna's brutal kidnapping and torture, aiming for a corporate takeover. As Karan seeks revenge, Trisha reveals a fake pregnancy with his child, temporarily halting the violence. Simultaneously, Karan becomes the target of an assassination plot orchestrated by his ambitious uncle, Subodh, who confesses to murdering Karan's father years ago for corporate control. Abhay discovers Trisha's elaborate fake pregnancy, leading to her public humiliation and escape. A car explosion, presumed to kill a child, is declared "karma" for Trisha, revealing Karan and Prerna are targets of the same shadowy enemies who killed their parents, escalating the generational feud. Karan makes a dramatic return, alive, to confront Subodh, exposing his long history of fratricide and corporate betrayal. After bringing Subodh to justice, Karan secures his sister Prerna's future by transferring a significant portion of the company's shares to her, solidifying their bond amidst the corporate intrigue and familial treachery.

fake-wife-5.title: Fake Wife
fake-wife-5.description: The series follows Dev, a devoted husband trapped in a five-year contractual marriage, who endures escalating humiliation, deception, and social scorn as his home life collapses. His wife—variously named Riya or Ria in different accounts—repeatedly reconnects with a past lover (Abhinash/Abhi), and those reappearances destabilize the household, provoke jealousy, and lead to public confrontations. Family members, especially a venomous sister‑in‑law and other relatives, amplify the abuse through verbal degradation, physical assault, and power plays over status and money. A series of incidents—photographic evidence of intimacy, a cruel birthday spectacle, and a restaurant accident that reveals cold priorities—push Dev toward filing for divorce and breaking the contract. As marital bonds fray, Dev oscillates between endurance and decisive rupture: he refuses to serve sabotaged food, serves divorce papers, and stages a thirty‑day countdown to reclaim his life. He vanishes after the divorce papers surface, leaving only a few belongings and inflammatory messages that further tarnish his reputation and expose him to accusations of theft. While Dev disappears, Ria/Riya faces pressure from friends and family to remarry and to formally accuse him, even as some allies defend him and question the evidence. Simultaneously, a senior corporate contact emerges as a possible lifeline for Dev: he accepts a professional lead role that carries a mysterious condition and years later reappears aligned with a powerful research project. When Dev returns as a materially transformed figure—described later as a multi‑billionaire and positioned publicly as a mentor—old wounds and new power dynamics lead to corporate and personal retaliation. Central to the unfolding conspiracy are accusations involving a ten crore transfer and a priceless heirloom watch, both of which are used as evidence and leverage by rival factions. A ring of fabricators (named Prem and Puja in the accounts) manipulates bank statements and video to frame Dev, prompting legal confrontations and a violent car crash that puts his fate in doubt. Across high‑society gatherings and courtroom‑style exposés, Dev stages calculated reckonings that unmask fabricated proof, force siblings and conspirators to confess, and draw law enforcement into the dispute. Supporters and protectors—women identified as Sreya, Diya, Shreya/Shreya Rao and others—alternately defend Dev, present the contested timepiece, and use their influence to counter intimidation. The exposure of fraud tied to the watch and to the ten crore accusation culminates in a violent public clash that reorders reputations and threatens several characters with legal jeopardy. Having engineered or guided these revelations, Dev refuses to accept Ria/Riya’s pleas for reconciliation, rejecting earlier conciliatory gestures as calculated steps toward exposing deceit. Instead, he reasserts his dignity publicly, declines to re‑enter the transactional marriage, and signals a new personal and professional trajectory by announcing a fresh marriage proposal elsewhere. The show thus moves from private humiliation to a public reckoning in which reputation, money, and the question of justice are the central stakes as Dev reclaims agency and refuses to be restored to his old, degraded role.

dhokha-shaadi-aur-hungama-2.title: Marriage Drama
dhokha-shaadi-aur-hungama-2.description: A kind-hearted girl’s trip to her brother’s wedding turns into a nightmare when she gets stuck on a chaotic flight with a cruel woman and her spoiled son. What begins as midair madness soon unravels shocking truths of power, betrayal, and mistaken identity. Get ready for a storm of love, lies, and revenge that explodes both in the sky—and on the ground.

billionaire-baap-ka-badla.title: Billionaire Baap Ka Badla
billionaire-baap-ka-badla.description: "Billionaire Baap Ka Badla" is a story of a poor young man unknowingly works inside the empire that once abandoned him. Betrayed by love and robbed of his invention, he is publicly humiliated. At the moment of his lowest fall, fate reveals he is the lost heir to a powerful dynasty. Watch Now.

the-mysterious-master-chef-6.title: Missing Wife
the-mysterious-master-chef-6.description: ఆఫీస్ పనుల్లో పడి తనను పట్టించుకోని భర్త మీద కోపం పెంచుకుంటుంది  28ఏళ్ళ లక్ష్మీ డివోర్స్ కూడా తీసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటుంది. ఆ సమయంలో ఆమె మిస్ అవుతుంది. ఆమెకు ఏం అయ్యింది. చూడండి మిస్సింగ్ వైఫ్ మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

jhootha-parivaar.title: Jhootha Parivaar
jhootha-parivaar.description: "Jhootha Parivaar" is a high-stakes family revenge drama that follows Ishaan, an outcast son who is granted a supernatural second chance to relive his past after a tragic death caused by his family's neglect. Armed with foreknowledge of their betrayals and the manipulation of his "perfect" adopted brother, Rudra, Ishaan transforms from a silent victim into a strategic powerhouse. The script blends intense emotional confrontation with a "rise-from-the-ashes" narrative as Ishaan dismantles his family's toxic legacy to build his own empire

kerala-police-diary-1.title: Kerala Police Diary
kerala-police-diary-1.description: This microdrama chronicles a sprawling police investigation into the mysterious disappearances of numerous young women, initially focusing on Ashwini and others like Tanu and Lakshmi. The inquiry quickly uncovers digital deception, including SIM card swaps and fabricated travel histories, pointing to a sophisticated perpetrator. As the investigation deepens, a horrifying pattern emerges, linking Ashwini's case to at least twenty-five other similar disappearances of affluent young women, suggesting a ruthless serial predator. Key officers, including Investigator Siddharth, face significant internal resistance and skepticism from superiors, with one crucial officer's suspicious death revealing a calculated murder and hinting at widespread internal corruption. Siddharth himself is framed for misconduct and reassigned, yet he relentlessly pursues the truth. The trail leads to Santosh Kumar, an influential criminal lawyer, who is exposed as a cunning serial abductor, murderer, and orchestrator of an international organ trafficking ring. Concurrently, a separate, revenge-driven serial killer emerges, targeting women he perceives as betrayers after being falsely accused of rape by Nandana, leading to tragic consequences for her and others. This vengeful killer, ironically, also uncovers the monstrous organ trafficking operation, bringing him into direct confrontation with its mastermind. The show follows the perilous battle of determined investigators like Siddharth against deeply entrenched cover-ups, multiple dangerous criminals, and a vast network of crime, all while navigating threats to their own lives and careers.

hidden-maharaja.title: Hidden Maharaja
hidden-maharaja.description: A dying industrialist binds a mysterious stranger to his family with a vow—unaware that the man he forces into his granddaughter’s life is no ordinary servant, but a hidden king. For three years, Jay lives as a nobody, silently protecting Riya and her crumbling empire, enduring humiliation, neglect, and heartbreak. Blinded by ambition and class pride, Riya mistakes loyalty for weakness and throws him out of her life.

dhoka-shadi-aur-hungama.title: Dhoka Shadi aur Hungama
dhoka-shadi-aur-hungama.description: “A kind-hearted girl on her way to her brother’s wedding gets trapped in a nightmarish flight with a cruel woman and her spoiled son, leading to chaos that unravels shocking secrets of power, betrayal, and mistaken identity. When love, lies, and family honor collide, a storm of revenge and revelation erupts midair and beyond.”

ishq-with-my-blind-date.title: Blind Billionaire
ishq-with-my-blind-date.description: When fate brings together Namita, a struggling single mother haunted by her past, and Vihaan, a reserved businessman hiding his true identity, their accidental meeting blooms into an unexpected love story—one born from pain, trust, and second chances.

dhokha-shaadi-aur-hungama-1.title: Dhokha, Shaadi aur Hungama
dhokha-shaadi-aur-hungama-1.description: “A kind-hearted girl on her way to her brother’s wedding gets trapped in a nightmarish flight with a cruel woman and her spoiled son, leading to chaos that unravels shocking secrets of power, betrayal, and mistaken identity. When love, lies, and family honor collide, a storm of revenge and revelation erupts midair and beyond.”

divorced-single-mother-8.title: Divorced Single Mother
divorced-single-mother-8.description:
A single mother raises three brilliant sons — now leaders in their fields. But when she returns to her childhood home, she's met not with love, but with humiliation and neglect.
Amidst pain and prejudice, she sets out to rediscover herself — not just as a mother, but as a woman.

blood-of-billionaires.title: Blood of Billionaires
blood-of-billionaires.description: "Blood of Billionaire" follows Vaidehi, a young woman whose world shatters after her parents’ brutal murder. When a mysterious billionaire saves her dying brother, she’s pulled into a dangerous web of power, betrayal, and revenge — where love and lies bleed together, and every secret has a deadly price.

marriage-drama.title: Marriage Drama
marriage-drama.description: The microdrama begins with the impending wedding of affluent Krushna and elitist Reema, a union immediately complicated by the arrival of Krushna's traditional sister, Siya, bearing an ancestral necklace that highlights a deep class and value conflict. This initial tension quickly escalates during a mid-flight confrontation where an entitled mother, Kannan, and her aggressive son violently demand a seat from an injured passenger, Aruna, leading to a

billionaire-ka-mms.title: Billionaire Ka MMS
billionaire-ka-mms.description: The microdrama chronicles the tumultuous journey of Neil Pradhan, the ruthless CEO of Mudra Tech, as he attempts to secure his company's IPO amidst a relentless onslaught of crises. His controversial layoffs and a brutal "purge" of employees ignite a massive PR crisis, which he defiantly embraces, while a mysterious figure from his past and corporate sabotage hint at deeper vulnerabilities. A devastating sex scandal involving a leaked video threatens to ruin his empire, forcing him to confront a mastermind and prevent further damage. His fiancée, Anya, initially defends him, but their relationship is revealed to be strategic, as Neil secretly pursues a forbidden romance with employee Leher Shrivastava. As the corporate stakes escalate, Neil confronts his estranged mother, Nalini, over a scandalous betrayal, eventually framing her to seize control of the company. However, a corporate coup installs Rohit Mehra as the new CEO, leading to a fierce power struggle where Neil's possessive nature and traumatic past drive him to extreme actions. Anya, initially entangled in the conflict, plays a pivotal role in exposing Rohit's elaborate corporate conspiracy, leading to his downfall and Neil's triumphant, albeit temporary, return. The resurfacing of a devastating MMS scandal featuring Neil and Leher shatters his public image and jeopardizes his IPO once more, revealing his manipulative past. Neil desperately tries to unmask a saboteur and frame Leher, but faces condemnation as his empire teeters on the brink. Ultimately, Neil's downfall is orchestrated by a coordinated revenge plot, with former employee Tushar launching a digital attack and Leher, a victim of Neil's exploitation, joining forces to expose his past conduct. Despite his mother's attempts to defend him by revealing his traumatic birth, Leher remains resolute. The series culminates in Neil's public humiliation and ousting from Mudra Tech's IPO by Anya and Leher, a coup masterminded by his former confidante, Pia, who sacrifices him to save the company, leaving Neil's empire in ruins and his deceit fully exposed.

good-bad-ugly.title: Good Bad Ugly
good-bad-ugly.description: அர்ஜுன் ஒரு பிரபல பிளாஸ்டிக் சர்ஜன். அவன் தரை துடிக்கிறவளா இருக்க ஜோதிகாவ காதலிச்சு கல்யாணம் பண்ணுறான். ஆனா ஜோதிகாக்கு, புதுசா வந்த ஹேண்ட்சம் டாக்டர் ராஜ் மேல கள்ள காதல் வருது.  அதுக்கு தடையா இருக்க அர்ஜுன கார் ஏத்தி கொலையும் பண்ணுறா.... அர்ஜுன் செத்துட்டான்னு ஜோதிகா சந்தோசமா இருக்குறப்போ, அவள பழிவாங்க ஒருத்தன் புதுசா வரான். யார் இவன்? அர்ஜுனுக்கு நடந்த அநியாயம் வெளிய வருமா? ஜோதிகா மாட்டுவாளா?

pyaar-vs-parivaar.title: Pyaar vs Parivaar
pyaar-vs-parivaar.description: When an 18-year-old village girl, Meena returns from a Mumbai college trip six months pregnant - with twins fathered by a powerful man, Veer from a “lower caste” - she is brutalized by her family and marked for an honor killing, until the father rescues her and publicly claims her as his wife, forcing a traditional society to confront its own violence, prejudice, and hypocrisy. Watch now!

fake-marriage-on-diwali.title: Fake Marriage on Diwali
fake-marriage-on-diwali.description: Sarah brings Vikram into her family, but instead of safety she finds new dangers. With Vikram’s secrets and her family’s greed pulling them apart, will their love survive or break forever? Watch now!

love-me-again-5.title: Love Me Again
love-me-again-5.description:
A forbidden wedding brews under the shadow of betrayal and threats.
Goons are summoned to shatter vows before they’re made.
A mother fights to protect her fragile child while ghosts of the past return.
In love, lies, and survival—no one’s fate is certain.

my-undercover-husband.title: My Undercover Husband
my-undercover-husband.description: A war hero who chooses domesticity over medals becomes invisible inside his own marriage—dismissed, humiliated, and betrayed by the woman he loves and the family he supports. As emotional cruelty replaces bullets and ambition replaces loyalty, a buried past resurfaces, forcing a gentle husband to confront how far betrayal can push a man before he breaks.

fake-marriage-on-diwali-2.title: Fake Marriage on Diwali
fake-marriage-on-diwali-2.description: The microdrama chronicles the tumultuous journey of brilliant CEO Vikram Varma, who, after a humiliating blind date, enters a contract marriage with desperate heiress Sara to escape an unwanted arranged marriage and save her family's business. Initially branded a "beggar" and "delivery boy" by Sara's elitist mother and arrogant rival Karan, Vikram navigates a world of intense class conflict and deception. As Sara's family relentlessly attempts to dismantle their arrangement and expose Vikram, Sara unexpectedly finds herself drawn to him, sensing a deeper, fated connection despite their transactional start. Tensions escalate during festive celebrations, with Vikram facing accusations of gold-digging and fraud, while hints of his hidden immense fortune and powerful connections begin to emerge. A complex web of identity deception unfolds, revealing an imposter initially believed to be Sara's husband, who is used to discredit the true Vikram Varma. Karan manipulates events, orchestrating the murder of this imposter, while the real CEO, Vikram Varma, endures capture and betrayal, ultimately exacting ruthless retribution on his captors. Amidst these power struggles, Sara fiercely protects Vikram, resisting intense family pressure for a forced marriage to Karan to save her critically ill grandmother, Muthassi.
