Vikram intervenes to save Muthassi, further proving his commitment to Sara, even as he faces public humiliation and accusations of identity theft and past crimes from Karan. The narrative culminates in a ruthless corporate war initiated by Vikram Varma against rival groups, exposing financial vulnerabilities and leading to their collapse. The imposter who attempted to seize control of the Varma Group is exposed, revealing a deeper conspiracy and betrayal by an associate. Ultimately, Vikram Varma, now fully revealed as a formidable business magnate, exacts corporate takedowns while finding genuine love with Sara, culminating in a heartfelt marriage proposal.

the-miracle-surgeon.title: The Miracle Surgeon
the-miracle-surgeon.description: A selfless man who sacrifices his legendary medical career to become a househusband for his wife and daughter is humiliated, cheated on, and brutally divorced only to lose custody of the child he raised as his own. Years later when he returns as India’s most celebrated surgeon, the very medical genius the world worships. Fate pits him against his past when the child he loved faces a life-or-death surgery—and the family who destroyed him must now beg the man they once crushed to save her life

gaadi-wala-panga.title: Gaadi Wala Panga
gaadi-wala-panga.description: A billionaire CEO disguises himself as a beggar to find true love—only to marry a woman who betrays him for money, power, and passion. When her secret affair crashes headfirst into his world, love turns into war. What follows is a brutal game of deception, revenge, and redemption, where loyalty bleeds, masks fall, and a broken man must choose between destroying his past or saving the one soul who truly stood by him.

wheelchair-billionaire.title: Wheelchair Billionaire
wheelchair-billionaire.description: A celebrated dancer is crippled in a planned “accident” by the two women he trusts most, pushing him through humiliation, betrayal, and death—until the truth behind his murder begins to surface.

fake-marriage-on-diwali-1.title: Fake Marriage on Diwali
fake-marriage-on-diwali-1.description: Sarah brings Vikram into her family, but instead of safety she finds new dangers. With Vikram’s secrets and her family’s greed pulling them apart, will their love survive or break forever? Watch now!

born-to-be-a-legend.title: Born to Be a Legend
born-to-be-a-legend.description: When an ordinary delivery driver, Rajveer, saves a mysterious woman named Siya, he’s pulled into a supernatural mystery — her unborn child speaks to him, claiming to be an ancient immortal warrior reborn. As dark forces and powerful enemies close in, Rajveer and Siya must protect the miraculous baby destined to change the fate of the world. Born to Be a Legend is a gripping blend of myth, mystery, and emotion — where love, destiny, and divine power collide. Watch now!

delete-my-number-not-my-heart-2.title: Delete My Number, Not My Heart
delete-my-number-not-my-heart-2.description: When a glamorous marriage between a billionaire producer and a rising actress turns cold, love begins to blur into lies. Behind fame and fortune hides a truth that could destroy everything they built together. Delete My Number, Not My Heart — a dazzling drama of love, betrayal, and the price of ambition.

dangerous-divorce.title: Dangerous Divorce
dangerous-divorce.description: The microdrama chronicles Chirag, a loyal gemstone artist, whose world shatters when his wife Sejal, feigning a critical illness, orchestrates his financial ruin and even murder with her lovers, Ashu and Jignesh. Sejal empties their joint account, publicly humiliating Chirag and chillingly revealing his own terminal kidney failure was part of her calculated scheme to seize his assets. Cast out and professionally discredited by his formidable mother-in-law and estranged wife, Chirag faces false accusations of theft, physical assault, and legal battles. Sejal further aligns with tech innovator Jignesh Shah, whose AI technology threatens Chirag's traditional craftsmanship and career. Amidst his downfall, Chirag finds an unexpected ally and burgeoning romance with jewellery heiress Vartika, who defends his innocence and helps him expose corporate corruption. Recruited by the visionary Zaveri Boss, Chirag embarks on a fierce corporate rivalry, determined to reclaim his honor and champion human artistry against industrial automation. Battling a mysterious illness, Chirag vows revenge on Sejal, predicting the failure of her AI empire and challenging her to a public showdown, while also planning to expose rivals like Manjula Zaveri for intellectual property theft. His groundbreaking designs threaten the Zaveri dynasty, leading to more plots by Jignesh and a Zaveri heiress to discredit him with accusations of flawed work and fraud. However, Chirag gains a discerning patron in Maharaja Uday Singh, who recognizes the soul in his human artistry over machine-made pieces. As CEO of Sanvhi Jewellers, Chirag secures a lucrative royal contract, financially crippling the rival Jhaveri family, who are revealed to be his estranged kin. Sejal falsely accuses Chirag of a fatal illness to disqualify him, but this spectacularly backfires, revealing she is the one suffering from Uremia. Abandoned by her father and con artist boyfriend Jignesh, Sejal faces imminent death, while Chirag orchestrates Jignesh's public exposure and arrest for defrauding multiple women. With Jhaveri Jewelers collapsing, Sejal's mother, Manjula, desperately pushes a dying Sejal to reconcile with Chirag to save both her life and the family business. Despite the profound betrayals, Chirag agrees to provide life-saving medical treatment for Sejal. However, he firmly rejects her desperate pleas for reconciliation, declaring their love irrevocably dead. As a final act of closure, he provides for her future medical treatment, making the finality of his decision clear, and ultimately moves on towards a new beginning with a new companion.

ultimate-khiladi-6.title: Ultimate Khiladi
ultimate-khiladi-6.description: The story follows a corporate and cyber world where technical crises repeatedly expose hidden power struggles. It begins with a serious defense breach and a mysterious newcomer stepping in as the company scrambles to contain damage. Across the early arc, underdogs and overlooked workers are forced to solve problems that managers and executives cannot handle on their own. Sameer Dixit emerges as a brilliant but heavily pressured technical figure, first tied to stopping a self-replicating AI threat and later praised for a fast breakthrough at a technology institute. Even when he is celebrated, suspicion never fully leaves him, and later system failures turn him into a suspect rather than a hero. Tanisha stands at the center of the office conflict, defending her team, defending Sameer’s competence, and resisting bosses who try to control her choices. Her career becomes a major stake as she is pushed toward leadership in HR and pulled into disputes over merit, hiring, salary, and succession. The company hierarchy is repeatedly shaken by questions about who deserves authority and who is only being used as a visible figure while others do the real work. A father-son power structure drives much of the corporate maneuvering, including removals, hidden scandals, and plans to attack rival companies. At the same time, the firm depends on skilled outsiders and dismissed employees, showing how fragile its polished image really is. Samir, another highly capable technical expert, is interrogated, publicly humiliated, and even threatened with blacklisting after a critical failure. Yet powerful women and senior figures repeatedly intervene to protect or recruit him, suggesting that his value is recognized even when his reputation is attacked. The story also keeps folding romance into the workplace, with Tanisha’s relationship under strain from pressure to marry, questions of independence, and later emotional conflict with Arnab. Samir’s own connections become more complicated as he is drawn into flirtation, dependence, and shelter with Madam, while another woman, Naina, supports Sameer during a major launch. The AI launch itself becomes a turning point: it begins as a triumph, but hidden server problems quickly expose deeper flaws and trigger blame. When the system falters, the wrong person is accused, removed, and pushed toward punishment, showing how quickly success can turn into scapegoating. By the end of the batch, the stakes have widened beyond one company’s reputation to include legal pressure, financial collapse, and the threat of bankruptcy. The overall arc is one of ambition, exposure, and survival, where technical genius is constantly entangled with hierarchy, loyalty, and control.

pehle-badla-phir-mohabbat-5.title: Al-Hub wa Al-Intiqam
pehle-badla-phir-mohabbat-5.description: Ananya is introduced as a wealthy heiress who keeps her emotions and identity tightly controlled while her family pushes her toward marriage and public obedience. What first looks like an arranged-match story quickly becomes a struggle over hidden marriages, business leverage, and who has the right to claim the Mehra name. Powerful men around her, including Veed or Vid and others tied to the family circle, try to shape her future through contracts, alliances, and money, but Ananya repeatedly refuses to be treated as a bargaining chip. Her own marriage history becomes a major source of conflict, especially when betrayal, divorce, and anniversary revelations expose how deeply personal pain is tied to corporate power. In public settings, she is humiliated, doubted, and even denied by family members, yet she keeps pushing back and insisting on the truth. The story repeatedly uses elite events, hotel spaces, and corporate gatherings as arenas where status is tested and secrets are exposed. Karishma emerges as a sharp rival who uses class prejudice, false claims, and money demands to challenge Ananya’s position. Vid also resists family pressure, refusing an arranged marriage without love and insisting that his marriage to Ananya is his own business. At one point, a hidden marriage is revealed in front of a crowd, turning a financial crisis into a family confrontation. Ananya’s identity is questioned so aggressively that even her father publicly denies her, calling her a restaurant worker instead of his daughter. The conflict widens into fights over documents, shares, and leadership, showing that the marriage dispute is also a battle for control of the family empire. Suspicion around impostors and stolen access adds another layer, with Ananya challenging false claims and testing who truly belongs in elite spaces. A buried memory tied to a safe password and a plastic rose hints at older romantic history that still shapes the present. The family war grows harsher as accusations of kidnapping, murder, and betrayal surface, and brothers clash over Ananya’s place in the conflict. Through all of this, Ananya remains determined to reveal the truth herself rather than let others define her. By the end of the batch, the tone briefly softens into open love, as Ananya publicly confesses her feelings for Vith Singhania and he returns them, even though the larger power struggle is still unresolved.

sikander-the-boss.title: Sikander The Boss
sikander-the-boss.description: The series begins with the strategic mastermind Armaan "Sikandar" Rajdaan's release from prison after seven years, having secretly orchestrated a Chief Minister's rise to power. His initial plan to marry Sonal, whose career he covertly built from the shadows, is brutally shattered when she not only rejects his public proposal but confesses to manipulating him into taking the fall for her crime, using his sacrifice to build her own empire. Devastated by this profound betrayal and public humiliation, Armaan accepts a contract marriage with the powerful businesswoman Ria Suri, who, despite his criminal record, believes in his potential and seeks to unravel the profound truth he is hiding. Ria herself is facing a devastating corporate scandal involving fake nude photos and the shocking truth about her daughter Ishita's paternity, leading her to desperately seek the elusive "Sikandar" for help. Armaan, acting as an enigmatic protector, intervenes to save Ria and Ishita from attacks by the ruthless Rajveer Bajaj and effortlessly resolves her corporate crisis, revealing a complex web of interconnected lives. This alliance immediately thrusts Armaan into Ria's high-stakes corporate world, where he faces public scorn, challenges from rivals, including the vengeful Sonal, and the obsessive corporate heir Rajveer Bajaj, who relentlessly demands Ria leave Armaan. As Armaan defiantly refuses to be dismissed and begins to challenge the elite, Ria is prompted to investigate his mysterious past and early release from jail. Armaan, now wielding significant influence, orchestrates Sonal's professional downfall, blackmails her with knowledge of a seven-year-old theft, and systematically dismantles Rajveer's family business in ruthless acts of corporate sabotage and revenge. Amidst these escalating corporate and personal battles, a profound revelation surfaces: Ria discloses to Armaan that their forgotten one-night stand seven years prior resulted in their daughter, Ishika, solidifying their commitment as a family. The narrative intensifies as Armaan dramatically reveals his true identity as the formidable CEO Sikandar, owner of Six Seven Sector, declaring a corporate takeover and seeking revenge against Ria's disapproving family, who initially scorn him as an ex-convict and accuse him of theft. The couple faces escalating threats, including a mysterious Man 2 declaring his intent to marry Ria, and a dangerous bomb plot orchestrated by the vengeful Rajveer, who holds Armaan and others hostage. Armaan, a brilliant bomb disposal expert, races against a ten-minute deadline to defuse the critical device, making a poignant confession of love to Ria amidst the peril. Ultimately, Armaan (Sikandar) is recognized as a national hero for successfully diffusing the bomb, exposing Rajveer's false accusations and leading Ria's remorseful family to finally embrace him as the perfect match for their daughter. The series culminates in a heartfelt reconciliation and the promise of a lavish, high-profile wedding for Priya (Ria) and Sikandar, designed to unite influential families and businesses, marking a celebratory new beginning where love and power collide amidst public spectacle.

the-final-boss-7.title: The Final Boss
the-final-boss-7.description: Abhiraj Singh Rathore is the secret Raja of Rajputana Corporation and the richest man on Earth, but when he returns from the battlefield, his childhood sweetheart brutally dumps him, thinking he's a clown. How will the King of all men make her regret it?

7-days-to-erase-you-from-my-heart.title: 7 Days To Erase You From My Heart
7-days-to-erase-you-from-my-heart.description: Harsh apne pehle pyaar Jiya, jo cancer ke aakhri stage par thi, uski ‘aakhri khwahish’ poori karne ke liye usse sirf naam ki shaadi karta hai, jabki uska dil Sneha se juda hua tha. Sach jaane bina, Harsh aur Jiya ki badhti nazdeekiyan dekhkar Sneha toot gayi thi aur apni yaadein mitaane ka treatment karwaya tha. 7 din baad jab Harsh usse mila, Sneha use bhool chuki thi. Ab Harsh har ehsaas ke zariye apna pyaar phir se jagane ki koshish kar raha tha, lekin kya bhuli hui mohabbat laut paayegi?

the-final-betrayal-6.title: The Final Betrayal
the-final-betrayal-6.description: 💃💃💃 During Navratri in Ahmedabad, street vendor Sejal is betrayed by boyfriend Prateek who leaves her for cousin Nandini. Mysterious beggar Shivam proposes a fake marriage to fulfill her dying grandmother’s wish. As they grow closer, Sejal discovers Shivam is actually Shah Industries’ billionaire CEO who went undercover. Despite initial hurt over his deception, true love ultimately prevails and they marry.

7-lifelines-to-cheat-death.title: 7 Lifelines to cheat death
7-lifelines-to-cheat-death.description:
This show feels real because it speaks the language of Gen Z's struggles with unstable jobs, family pressure, loans, broken dreams, and emotional loneliness.
The hero isn’t powerful or privileged; he’s someone who keeps trying, failing, and still doesn’t give up.
Every life he lives reflects problems common people face but never talk about openly.
It’s not fantasy for the elite—it’s hope, pain, and survival for the everyday Indian.

hidden-talent-6.title: Bodhi Varma: Return of the Beggar Dragon
hidden-talent-6.description: An amnesiac man, initially known as Thambi, is found unconscious and, after being nursed by a dying doctor, promises to become the guardian of the doctor's young daughter, Kavi. This unexpected duty propels them on a quest to uncover their true identities and lost heritage. The man, later known as Varman, declares his love for Princess Dharshini, facing challenges from rivals and her family, including a ruthless antagonist, Nitish Das, who threatens Dharshini and her family. Varman must fight to protect his loved ones and their honor, facing a critical choice between peace and battle. Dharshini herself faces brutal ultimatums and accepts duels to protect her family, even as her martial arts power is mysteriously affected after encounters with Varman. Despite being dismissed as a "beggar," Varman reveals formidable hidden martial arts skills, eventually consuming a "poison pill" to triple his strength in a tournament, setting the stage for a climactic showdown with the seemingly invincible Nithesh. This ignites a brutal feud with the powerful Karikaalan family, drawing the wrath of Nitesh's terrifying grandfather and the entire clan, forcing Varman's father to intervene. It is suggested Varman acquired immense power through a past intimate, yet betraying, relationship with Darshini, who is also a formidable martial artist. Darshini publicly confirms her marriage to Varman, sparking societal outrage and violent confrontations over "Dragon rules." An enigmatic Karikaalan emerges, suspected to be the vanished "Dragon Master," a title that becomes central to a furious power struggle. The true identity of the Dragon Master is dramatically unveiled, revealing Varman himself, who then confronts a treacherous former disciple. Amidst these conflicts, Varman's wife, Dharshini (also referred to as Honey), discovers his secret identity, leading to profound truths about Kavi's origins as an orphan and the formation of an unconventional family. A young and extraordinarily powerful Kavi emerges, demonstrating superhuman abilities and challenging Varman's authority, further complicating the power dynamics within their newly formed family.

dahaad.title: Dahaad
dahaad.description: Dahaad is a story of a rising wrestler, whose dream shatters when betrayal, false doping charges, and sacrifice tear lovers apart. Eight years later, truth resurfaces through their daughter, forcing fate to reunite them. Dahaad is a powerful saga of love, sacrifice, redemption, and justice.Watch now.

my-unknown-husband-2.title: My Unknown Husband
my-unknown-husband-2.description: Bound by a marriage of convenience to an absent husband, Meera Kumar seeks a fresh start in the corporate world, becoming the personal assistant to the formidable CEO, Karthik. Despite her marital status, an unspoken romantic tension begins to develop between Meera and Karthik, who is initially devoted to his own wife. Simultaneously, Meera's estranged husband, Karna, is pressured by his grandfather to reconcile with her, leading him to embark on a mission to find Meera. The mystery surrounding Meera's marriage deepens as Karthik's past hints at dangerous connections, and Karna is confronted about his daughter-in-law's prolonged absence, discovering her identity. Karthik's personal life unravels with a looming divorce from his wife, also named Meera, amidst suspicions of infidelity and past abandonment. His PA, Meera, becomes increasingly entangled in his affairs, caring for him during an alcohol-induced crisis and being mistaken for his spouse. Karthik attempts to push for a swift divorce from his estranged wife, offering substantial alimony, while also facing a corporate scandal. Meera, a corporate leader, reveals her secret marriage to her superior, Karthik, only to find their relationship fraught with manipulation and hidden agendas. Karthik, a stressed lawyer, attempts to stall his own divorce from Meera, which is revealed to be a pre-arranged, possibly contractual, marriage he intends to terminate. A tender, yet forbidden, connection blossoms between Karthik and Anjali, but Karthik's jealousy flares when Anjali affirms her love for her own husband. Meera suffers a severe car accident after refusing alimony from Karthik, sparking a complex love triangle involving Karthik's friend Bhargav. Karthik's step-mother attempts to force Meera out of his life, revealing a power struggle and a past command forbidding his romance with Meera. The shocking discovery reveals Karthik, Meera's boss, is also her estranged husband, Karna, a fact she was initially unaware of. Meera's dying grandfather, Tatayya, expresses a wish for her reconciliation with her estranged husband, Karna, who is Karthik. Despite initial confusion and a revenge plot initiated by Karthik, he desperately seeks reconciliation, acknowledging his mistakes and expressing his love. Meera grapples with her feelings, eventually realizing and confessing her profound love for Karthik.

daring-bodyguard.title: Daring Bodyguard
daring-bodyguard.description: Shaurya, ek highly trained fighter, Aarohi Sehgal ko protect karne ke liye ek normal security guard bankar uski zindagi mein aata hai. Aarohi ne “Sunspire” naam ki ek aisi dawa invent ki hai jo cancer ka ilaaj ban sakti hai. Is discovery ke peeche powerful Nirvaan Vardhaan pada hai. Mission ke dauraan Shaurya ko ek khaufnaak sach pata chalta hai—Nirvaan ke baap Armaan Vardhaan ne uski family ko barbaad kiya tha. Ab yeh sirf protection ka mission nahi, balki Shaurya ke liye ek personal war hai.

the-final-boss-6.title: The Final Boss
the-final-boss-6.description: Abhiraj Singh Rathore is the secret Raja of Rajputana Corporation and the richest man on Earth, but when he returns from the battlefield, his childhood sweetheart brutally dumps him, thinking he's a clown. How will the King of all men make her regret it?

my-unknown-husband-1.title: My Unknown Husband
my-unknown-husband-1.description: A newly divorced woman starts working as the PA to her strict boss — and soon, unexpected feelings begin to bloom. Between office drama, emotional twists, and a mysterious secret about her boss, things get delightfully complicated! Get ready for a breezy romantic ride filled with fun, love, and surprises — don’t miss it! 💕

the-bads-of-boardroom.title: The Ba***ds of Boardroom
the-bads-of-boardroom.description: The Ba***ds of Boardroom is an engaging story of a mother sacrifices everything to raise a child she believes is hers. Betrayal, greed, and blood ties collide inside boardrooms and bedrooms alike. When the final chess move is revealed, only one woman stands victorious. Watch now.

ek-raat-ki-mohabbat.title: Miles Between Us
ek-raat-ki-mohabbat.description: Cynical CEO Rahul Marwah's opulent birthday celebration turns into a nightmare when a treacherous cousin plots to seize his empire, leading to a brutal attack that leaves Rahul fighting for his life. He is miraculously saved by an unknown woman, Geeta, who later discovers she is pregnant with his child and harbors a dark secret. Geeta endures relentless abuse and body-shaming from her cruel step-family, who scheme to extort Rahul upon discovering her pregnancy. Despite a near-fatal childbirth, Geeta vows to build a better life for her daughter, Ria, facing discrimination and hardship. Meanwhile, Rahul, pressured to marry and secure his legacy, obsessively searches for his mysterious savior. Seven years later, Rahul, now a powerful CEO, continues his quest, defying his formidable grandmother's demands for an arranged marriage. His path intertwines with Meera, a resilient single mother (later identified as Yogita) struggling against societal stigma and exploitation, with whom he forms an instant connection, unaware she is his lost love and the mother of his child, Ria. Faced with corporate ultimatums and personal pressures, Rahul proposes a contract marriage to Meera/Yogita, a pragmatic alliance while both secretly search for their lost loves. The truth slowly unravels as Rahul's secret marriage and his daughter, Ria, are revealed, disrupting his ambitious brother's plans. Yogita and Rahul maintain their contract marriage for Ria's sake, as Ria innocently insists on reuniting her estranged parents. Rahul, often disguised, embarks on an elaborate revenge plot against Yogita's avaricious and class-prejudiced family, manipulating them into unknowingly transferring all their property to Yogita, empowering her. Yogita struggles with Rahul's hidden identity and past betrayals, especially concerning Ria's true paternity, but Rahul eventually confesses his love. Their happiness is short-lived as an enigmatic "Boss" and Yogita's brother conspire to dismantle their marriage, escalating to deadly intent. Yogita is separated from Rahul, brutally attacked, and abducted by her obsessive old lover, who is revealed to be the "Boss." Believing Rahul dead after an assassination attempt, Yogita is blackmailed into a forced marriage to protect Ria. However, Rahul survives and frantically searches for his kidnapped daughter. The story culminates in Rahul's shocking return, confronting his rival, surviving another attack, and finally reuniting with Ria after a seven-year search, linked by a distinctive earring.

duddu-maaduvudu-hege.title: Duddu Maaduvudu Hege?
duddu-maaduvudu-hege.description: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂಬುದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಚಿಂತೆಯಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಂತಹವರಿಗೆ ನಿಯಮಬದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಹಣ ಮಾಡುವುದರ ಕುರಿತು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡಬಲ್ಲ ಕೃತಿ ‘ದುಡ್ಡು ಮಾಡುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ’. ಕೆಲವು ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಕತೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕವು ದುಡ್ಡಿನ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಲೇಖಕ ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ.

lone-survivor.title: BGMI - Lone Survivor
lone-survivor.description: Kidnapped Carlo ki jab aankh khuli, usne paya khud ko Erangel ke battlefield par. Trained terrorists aur mercenaries ke beech Carlo ke liye ye game ban gaya khatro ka jaal? Dost aur dushman ka farq karna mushkil hai, aur har kadam par hai khatra. Kya Carlo ko milegi ek achhi loot, ya koi kar lega uska Chicken Dinner? Janne ke liye suniye Lone Survivor.

irumbukkai-mayavi.title: இரும்புக் கை மாயாவி
irumbukkai-mayavi.description: அபிமன்யு தனது தோழி ஓவியாவுக்கு ப்ரபோஸ் செய்கிறான். ஆனால், அவளோ அவனது காதலை நிராகரித்துவிட்டுச் சென்றுவிடுகிறாள். அபிமன்யு வருத்தத்தில் இருக்க, ஒரு விபத்தில் சிக்கிக்கொள்கிறான். அப்போது அவனுக்கு ஒரு சூப்பர் பவர் கிடைக்கிறது. அந்த பவர் அவனுக்கு வரமா இல்லை சாபமா?

udugore.title: Udugore
udugore.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಒಂದೊಂದು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಇದ್ದೇ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ದಾಟಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಿದ್ರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ, ಬದುಕು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ! ಈ ಲೈಫಿಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ತುಂಬೋ ಕಾರ್ಯವನ್ನ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕಿಯಾದ ಡಾ. ಎಡಿಟ್ ಈಗರ್ ತಮ್ಮ 'ಉಡುಗೊರೆ' ಕೃತಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಬದುಕಿನ‌ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಗಳಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಉತ್ತರ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್..

khwab-aur-haqiqat.title: Khwab Aur Haqiqat
khwab-aur-haqiqat.description:
Shanaya ek bold aur confident ladki thi, jo hamesha apni zindagi apne terms par jeeti aayi thi. Uski engagement Manav ke sath ho chuki thi, lekin uske dil mein kuch aur tha. Wo aksar Manav ko ignore karte hue doosre ladkon ke saath flirt karti thi, jo Manav ke liye ek gehra dard ban gaya tha. Manav, jo usse dil se pyaar karta tha, uski yeh harkatein bilkul bhi bardasht nahi kar pa raha tha.
Phir ek din, Shanaya ko ek aisi sachai ka pata chalta hai jo uski puri zindagi ko badal ke rakh sakti thi. Uske papa ne Manav ke papa se dhokha karke property haadap li thi. Yeh sachai jab Manav ko pata chalegi, jiske karan dono   ke ristey me tufaan aasakta hai.
Kya Shanaya is sach ko chhupane mein kaamyaab ho paayegi? Aur sabse badi baat, kya Manav iss sach ko jaan kar uska saath dega ya unka rishta toot jayega?

karna-dharma-karmada-adbuta-yatre.title: Karna - Dharma Karmada Adbuta Yatre
karna-dharma-karmada-adbuta-yatre.description: ಕರ್ಣ ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ. ಈತ ಕುಂತಿಯ ಮೊದಲ ಪುತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ದುರ್ಯೋಧನನ ಆಪ್ತ ಮಿತ್ರ. ಇವನ ತಂದೆ ಸೂರ್ಯದೇವ. ಇವನನ್ನು ರಾಧೇಯನೆಂದೂ ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು. ಇವನು ಅಂಗ ದೇಶದ ಅಧಿಪತಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದನು. ಕರ್ಣನನ್ನು ದಾನ ವೀರ ಶೂರ ಕರ್ಣ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇಂಥ ಮಹಾನ್‌ ಪುರುಷ ಕರ್ಣನ ಧರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ಮದ ಅಧ್ಬುತ ಯಾತ್ರೆಯನ್ನ ಕೇಳಿ ಕರ್ಣನ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ವಿಶೇಷ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ

yayati-1.title: Yayati
yayati-1.description: ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಪೂರ್ವಜರ ವಂಶವಿದು. ಯಯಾತಿ, ಪುರು, ಶರ್ಮಿಷ್ಠೆ, ದೇವಯಾನಿ, ಚಿತ್ರಲೇಖೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪಾತ್ರವೂ ಮನೋವಿಜ್ಞಾನದ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅರ್ಥಗರ್ಭಿತ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳು. ಯಯಾತಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಮಹಾರಾಜ. ಆತನ ಆಸೆ-ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಈಡೇರದೇ ಹೋದಾಗ ಆತನ ಪುತ್ರ ಪುರುವಿನ ಯೌವ್ವನ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪುತ್ರ ತಂದೆಯ ಕಣ್ಗೆದುರಲ್ಲೇ ವೃದ್ಧನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪುರುವಿನ ಪತ್ನಿ ಚಿತ್ರಲೇಖೆಯ ತೊಳಲಾಟ, ಮನೋವೇದನೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳು ಓದುಗರಲ್ಲಿ ತೀವ್ರ ಸಂವೇದನೆಯನ್ನುಂಟು ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ.

the-beast-purano-ka-shraap-ya-vardaan.title: THE BEAST - पुराणों का श्राप या वरदान
the-beast-purano-ka-shraap-ya-vardaan.description: Rahasyamay maut aur jaanwaron ke ajeeb hamle local police ko ek purane myth, Navagunjara tak le aaye the—ek shapeshifting creature jo nau jaanwaron ke shareer wala prani tha. Wildlife officer Aarti Mehra aur Inspector Ravi Kumar mil kar iss raaz ko suljhane nikal gaye the Purani granthon aur tribal gyaan ki talash mein, dono ko ek aise dangerous cult ka bhi pata chala tha jo Navagunjara ki shaktiyon ko apne kabze mein karna chahte tha. Kya yeh creature sach mein exist karta hai ? Kya Aarti aur Ravi yeh cult ko sheher par apna control se rok paayengey aur Navagunjara ka rahasya suljhane mein safal ho paayengey ?

mareechike-aarif-loves-sumithra.title: Mareechike: Aarif loves Sumithra
mareechike-aarif-loves-sumithra.description: 'ಆರಿಫ್' ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾವಂತ ಮುಸ್ಲಿಂ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಯುವಕ. ಆದ್ರೆ ತನಗಿಂತ 15 ವರ್ಷ ದೊಡ್ಡವಳಾದ ಹಿಂದೂ ವಿವಾಹಿತೆ 'ಸುಮಿತ್ರಾ'ಳ ಮೋಹಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳಾಗ್ತನೆ. ಇದ್ರಿಂತ ಆತನ ಜೀವನದ ದಿಕ್ಕೇ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಎಳೆಯನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಲೇಖಕರಾದ ಅಬ್ದುಲ್ಲಾ ಖಾನ್ ಅವ್ರು 'ಮರೀಚಿಕೆ: ಆರಿಫ್ ಲವ್ಸ್ ಸುಮಿತ್ರಾ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುವಾದಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಅಬ್ದುಲ್ ರೆಹಮಾನ್ ಪಾಷ ಎಂ.

dharmashree.title: Dharmashree
dharmashree.description: S.L. ಭೈರಪ್ಪರ 'ಧರ್ಮಶ್ರೀ' ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷೆಯ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಸನಾತನ ಧರ್ಮದ ನಂಬಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಜೀವನದ ಕಥೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಲು ಅವನು ಕ್ರಿಶ್ಚಿಯಾನಿಟಿಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಪಡುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಗಾಗಿ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಧರ್ಮವನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಸತ್ಯ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯ ಧರ್ಮದ ನಡುವಿನ ಅವನ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಹುಡುಕಾಟವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

heart-of-a-hero-the-yogendra-yadav-story.title: Heart Of A Hero: The Yogendra Yadav Story
heart-of-a-hero-the-yogendra-yadav-story.description:
19 saal ki umar mein, Captain Yogendra Singh Yadav ne Kargil war mein woh kar dikhaya jo namumkin tha. 17 goliyan khakar bhi, Pakistani fauj ke torture jhel kar bhi, Tiger Hill ki ladai mein akele survivor bankar, desh ke liye jee jaan laga di. Isliye unhe desh ka sabse bada samman - Param Vir Chakra mila.
Aaj pehli baar, ek fauji ki zubani suniye ki kaise ek Ghatak warrior banta hai. Kaise darr ko himmat mein, aur junoon ko fateh mein badla jata hai. Kya hai woh soch jo maut ke samne bhi haar nahi manti?

vayuputrara-shapata.title: Vayuputrara Shapata
vayuputrara-shapata.description: ವಾಯುಪುತ್ರರ ಶಪಥ ಎಂಬುದು ಅಮಿಶ್ ತ್ರಿಪಾಠಿ ಅವರ ಶಿವ ಸರಣಿಯ ಮೂರನೇ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮ ಪುಸ್ತಕ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿವನು ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ದುರಾಸೆಯ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ಮಹಾಯುದ್ಧ ಮತ್ತು ಆ ಯುದ್ಧದ ಹಿಂದಿರುವ ನಿಜವಾದ ದುಷ್ಟತೆಯನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ನಡೆಸಿದ ಅವನ ಆವೇಶಭರಿತ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

India-Divided--बँटवारे-का-पूरा-सच.title: India Divided : बँटवारे का पूरा सच
India-Divided--बँटवारे-का-पूरा-सच.description:
1940 ke March mahine mein Lahore mein aisa kya hua tha ki Pakistan banane ki aawaz unchi hone lagi? Kisne Desh jodne ki koshish ki aur kisne todne ki? Is audiobook mein hai har kisi ka sach. Har controversy ki poori kahani, aur partition se judi har badi theory ka logical analysis.
Suniye Bharat ke first President Dr. Rajendra Prasad ki likhi kitab 'India Divided'. Jo sach unhone Patna Central Jail mein rehkar likhna shuru kiya tha, ab aap wo sun sakte hain.

మాఫియా-ఐలాండ్.title: Mafia Island
మాఫియా-ఐలాండ్.description: ఎలాంటి లాకర్ కోడ్ నైనా ఛేదించగల ఒక తెలివైన దొంగ, డేంజరస్ మాఫియా డాన్ అయినా లూసిఫర్ లాకర్ ని కొల్లగొట్టడానికి వెళ్తూ అతని గర్ల్ ఫ్రెండ్ ని కూడా వెంట తీసుకెళ్తాడు. అడుగుడగున అపాయలకు అడ్డా అయినా ఆ ఐలాండ్ కి, అతను ఎందుకు గర్ల్ ఫ్రెండ్ ని తీసుకెళ్లాడు? అక్కడ అస్సలు ఏంజరిగింది ? అనుక్షణం ఉత్కంఠ రేపుతూ మిమ్మల్ని మంత్రముగ్దులను చేసే అడ్వెంచర్ థ్రిల్లర్ "మాఫియా ఐలాండ్" మీ కుకు FMలో

reunion-2.title: Reunion
reunion-2.description: മാളികവീട്ടിൽ ഐപ്പിന്റെ വഴിപിഴച്ചു വളർന്ന മൂന്നു മക്കൾ, റിയ, സൈമൺ, മീര. സ്വർണ്ണക്കച്ചവടക്കാരനായ അപ്പന്റെ പണത്തിന്റെ ഹുങ്കിൽ ആരെയും വകവെക്കാതെ, തല്ലാനും കൊല്ലാനും  മടിയില്ലാതെ വളർന്നവർ. ഒരു സംഭവത്തിന്മേൽ വഴക്കിട്ടു പിരിഞ്ഞു വീട് വിട്ടിട്ടു വർഷങ്ങൾ അഞ്ചെട്ട് ആയി. രോഗാവസ്ഥയിൽ കിടക്കുന്ന ഐപ്പ് മക്കളെ തിരികെ വിളിക്കുന്നു.  ഇനിയും എന്താണ് ആ വീട്ടിൽ സംഭവിക്കാൻ പോകുന്നത്? അവർ ചെയ്തുകൂട്ടിയ കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങൾ എന്തൊക്കെയാണ് ? അധികാരമോഹവും, കള്ളത്തനങ്ങളും, ചതിയും, അവിഹിതവും, കാമവും, നിറഞ്ഞ; നിറുത്താതെ കേൾക്കാൻ പ്രേരിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഫാമിലി ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലർ, ഉടൻ കേൾക്കു.

2aea63f1-840c-4d84-ad09-38d0c43e7073.title: 9/11: आतंक और मौत का काला इतिहास
2aea63f1-840c-4d84-ad09-38d0c43e7073.description: 911 ki woh subah, jab ek sapnon ka shehar ban gaya ek kabristan. Yeh show le jaayega aapko us din ke har ek pal tak, jahan dar aur himmat ka behtareen muqabla hua. Aakhir kaise huye yeh hamle aur kya thi asli wajah? Suniye abhi yeh show aur samajiye ek aisi tragedy ka sach jo kabhi bhoolayi nahi jaa sakti.

kaathal-vaiththuk-kaaththirunthen.title: காதல் வைத்துக் காத்திருந்தேன்…
kaathal-vaiththuk-kaaththirunthen.description: குடும்பத்தினரின் கட்டாயம் காரணமாக, கதிர் தனது மாமா பெண்ணைத் திருமணம் செய்துகொள்கிறான். ஆனால், அவளோ திருமணத்துக்குப் பிறகு, தன் காதலனுடன் சென்றுவிடுகிறாள். கதிரின் நிலை என்ன ஆனது?

bible-understanding-the-10-commandments-.title: Bible: Understanding The 10 Commandments
bible-understanding-the-10-commandments-.description: మానవులు ధర్మబద్ధమైన జీవితాన్ని ఎలా జీవించాలో, దేవునితో ఎలా సంపూర్ణమైన సంబంధాన్ని కలిగి ఉండాలో మార్గదర్శకాన్ని అందిస్తాయి.

change-your-life-using-law-of-attraction.title: Change Your Life Using Law Of Attraction
change-your-life-using-law-of-attraction.description:
Law of Attraction ke experts Indu aur Mitesh Khatri, 20 saal se logon ki zindagi badal rahe hain. Unhone ek dusre ko manifest kiya, ek fighter pilot ko fir se udne ke kabil banaya, aur hazaron logon ki zindagi badal di. Unka kehna hai ki manifestation ki shakti tabhi kaam karti hai jab humare Feelings, Thoughts, Beliefs aur Actions (FTBA) ek line mein ho. Yeh sikhayenge ki business mein success kaise paaye, rishtey kaise sudhare, aur apni energy ko balance kaise kare.
Ab sawal yeh hai - kya aap bhi apni zindagi badalne ke liye taiyar hain?

sovereign.title: Sovereign
sovereign.description: I have to have her. I’ve been alone for so long. I never thought I would want to change that. But when I saw her, I knew she was meant to be mine. And now that her husband is…gone, it’s time to make my move. I’ve never felt like this about anyone. I want her everything: her body, her mind, her soul. And I’ll do what it takes to make her my submissive. I’ll keep her safe, forgive her debts, and make everyone who’s ever hurt her pay. All I need is her name on that dotted line. Set against the sweeping backdrop of northern Montana in winter, Sovereign is the perfect spicy love story for dark romance readers. Keira Garrison has never known affection from her husband. After being tricked into giving up her family ranch, she finds herself lost and miserable in an unhappy marriage. But one night, she meets the arresting Gerard Sovereign, her husband’s rival and the owner of the biggest cattle ranch in Montana. Sparks fly. Their chemistry is undeniable. But then tragedy strikes and Keira finds herself widowed and alone, unprotected from her late husband’s brothers who will stop at nothing to take the land she inherited. With nowhere to go and no one to turn to, Keira finds herself at the mercy of Gerard Sovereign. He’s handsome, mysterious, dangerous, and hiding secrets that will turn her world upside down. But he’s also her last hope. Sovereign is a dual POV, age gap, dark, high-heat cowboy romance with an anti-hero MMC. It can be read as a standalone. Please check content warnings before reading.

the-rebel.title: The Rebel
the-rebel.description: One bed. Two stranded strangers. Three wildly passionate nights. A thousand secrets between them. After an unplanned sizzling weekend together what happens when Cooper Spade and Rowan Cole return home and realize they spent seventy-two unforgettable hours with the enemy…and loved every second?

zepto-the-gen-z-empire.title: ZEPTO: The Gen Z Empire
zepto-the-gen-z-empire.description:
Stanford jaisi duniya ki top university mein jaana 1% chance hai, lekin ek game-changing company banane ka chance sirf 0.001% . Yeh baat samajh kar do dost - Kaivalya Vohra aur Aadit Palicha ne 19 saal ki umar mein Stanford chhod kar ek sapna dekha. Sapna Zepto ka, jo sirf 2 saal mein $1.4 billion ki company ban kar 2023 ka pehla Indian unicorn bana.
Par sawal yeh hai ki kya sirf business skills aur dimag kaafi hai? Ya fir mehnat ko apni zindagi ka hissa banana padta hai? Success ke liye kitni kurbaani deni padti hai? Aur sabse bada sawal - kya ye entrepreneur ka safar, itni qurbani ke layak hai?

cruel-seduction.title: Cruel Seduction
cruel-seduction.description: Aphrodite has never flinched at getting her perfectly manicured hands dirty and she's not about to start now—even if that means marrying Olympus's enemy number one the new Hephaestus. She has a wicked plan to keep her deadly new husband off-balance seducing the one person he seems to care about most in this world: Pandora a woman as beautiful as she is sweet. Two can play the seduction game however and Hephaestus is all too happy to put his new wife in her place. Her ex Adonis seems like he'll do the trick. It doesn't hurt that he's gorgeous in the way of fallen angels either. The only problem with using seduction as a weapon? Hearts are all too quick to get involved. With Hephaestus and Aphrodite trading venomous strikes that feel a whole lot like foreplay lines become blurred and emotions entangled. But a broken heart may be the least of their worries. With unrest in Olympus reaching new heights these bedroom games may have deadly consequences for them both their city and everyone they've come to love.

when-the-smoke-clears.title: When the Smoke Clears
when-the-smoke-clears.description: Just released from the mental hospital for shooting her ex-husband Kassie is in no mood to date men. Now a newly single mother she’s focused on raising her son. She also has to get her career as an author back on track and rediscover her passion for romance writing. She has things to do. But Lorenzo comes into her life a gorgeous firefighter who isn’t accustomed to hearing the word no. He’s more than a heated distraction. He’s an erotic inferno of lust and everything sizzling. So the chase begins. Neither are ready. There’s too much at stake for them both. They’ve both been broken and betrayed both misused and abused. Yet sensual flames surround them. Desire burns and twists with wet kisses on a moonlit beach. And they’re both caught up in the passionate chaos both intoxicated with the other. Hot sex ignites into something more. And both are left wondering who will be standing when the smoke clears...

dacait-daku-bujharat-aur-dina-ki-ansuni-.title: Dacait : Daku Bujharat Aur Dina ki Ansuni Kahani
dacait-daku-bujharat-aur-dina-ki-ansuni-.description: Es show mein dosti, drama aur dehshat ka aisa khel chalta hai ki aapki saansen tham si jayengi. Purvanchal ke do dabang, daaku Bujharat aur Dina Pandey ne zaat-paat ke bandhan tod kar banayi dosti ki mishal, aur baad mein failaya aisa khauf ki poore ilaake mein unka naam sunke log thar-thar kaampne lage. ye kahani batati hai ki kaise ek Brahmin aur ek Dalit ka jodi poore system ko hila kar rakh deti hai. Lekin Ant kaise hua donon ka?

lush-money.title: Lush Money
lush-money.description: Billionaire CEO Roxanne Medina has conquered small-town bullies Princeton snobs and boardrooms of white male executives who looked down on her Mexican-American ancestry. Mothering a princess—and feeling a little less lonely at the top—is her next rightful adventure. The self-made billionaire feels the bargain she offers the prince is reasonable: After three nights a month in her bed for a year she will divorce him with a settlement large enough to save the small Spanish principality that means everything to him. She gets everything she wants—a fairy-tale heir born into a perfectly crafted world—and nothing she doesn't namely a man who could ruin her perfectly crafted fairy tale.   In jeans and dirty muck boots Prince Mateo Ferdinand Juan Carlos de Esperanza y Santos goes to the billionaire's corner office to tell her to shove it. He's one of the top winegrowers in the world and he's not marrying and having a baby with a stranger even if the millions she's offering could save his once-legendary wine-producing principality. Once there however he realizes the successful single-minded beauty has a weapon he hadn't counted on: his own desire. Give in to this naughty nightmare or keep his soul? Maybe once he can have a taste of Roxanne Medina. Okay twice. But he's certain that too many nights in bed with the powerful intelligent woman will destroy him and everything he values.  What begins as instant carnal attraction for billionaire Roxanne Medina and Príncipe Mateo Esperanza transforms over the course of three nights once a month for a year into something neither planned nor wanted—but that both need more than money or kingdom.

gulaabi-ishq.title: Gulaabi Ishq
gulaabi-ishq.description: Pink City ke rangon mein milte hain do adhure dil—Meera, jo apne ex-husband Raghav ke badle ki aag mein jal rahi hai, aur Kishan, jo apni patni ke bichhadne ke gham se nikal nahi pa raha hai. Jab yeh do zakhmi dil is gulaabi shahar mein takraate hain, toh kya unka milan unhe ek nayi zindagi dega? Ya phir unke beete hue rishte unka peecha karte rahenge?

an-arrangement-of-love.title: An Arrangement of Love
an-arrangement-of-love.description: What would you do for six figures? Billionaire Chase Stone offers Jasmine a six-figure job that requires a full-time commitment in his office—as well as his bed. If only she had known that before she agreed then life would’ve been easier. It’s not that he’s unattractive. She just didn't graduate from Harvard with honors so that she could be some rich guy's overpaid mistress. What’s even more repulsive is that he lives with three women and wants her to be the fourth. Not going to happen! But Chase won't give up and Jasmine won't give in. Someone's going to have to change because the more they meet the more something thick hot and electric bridges between them—until neither can breathe or think.

king-arthur-the-story-of-how-arthur-beca.title: King Arthur: The Story of How Arthur Became King
king-arthur-the-story-of-how-arthur-beca.description: Before Arthur commanded a round table of legendary knights in Camelot he was simply a young squire with dreams of becoming a great knight himself. Arthur lived during a time when Britain was without a ruler but fate would quickly draw him into the middle of a grand search for the next king-a search that involved a sword famously set in stone.

The-Tokyo-Tragedy--हैवानियत-और-मौत-का-खे.title: The Tokyo Tragedy : हैवानियत और मौत का खेल
The-Tokyo-Tragedy--हैवानियत-और-मौत-का-खे.description: Ye kahani ek aise Rape Case ki hai Jisme pure Tokyo shehar ko hilla kar rakh diya tha. Jab ek ladki ko uske hi dosto ne kidnap karke lagatar 30 din tak rape kiya aur use maut ke ghaat utar diya... Kya kuch hua un 30 dino me aur kya un aparadhiyon ko saza mili ya nahi ? Janne ke liye suniye ye pura show.

daughter-of-providence.title: Daughter of Providence
daughter-of-providence.description: Summer 1934: Anne Dodge was raised by her old-money New England Protestant father in the small coastal town of Warwick Rhode Island. She has always been told that her Portuguese mother abandoned them when Anne was a small child and died without ever contacting them again. After her mother's death Anne learns that she has a half-sister Maria Cristina who was raised among Portuguese immigrants - and when Maria Cristina comes to stay with Anne and her father ugly truths begin to surface about what really happened between her parents catalyzing events that end in loss and rediscovery.

maalapalli.title: మాలపల్లి
maalapalli.description: వందేళ్ల క్రితమే భారత దేశంలోని సాంఘీక, ఆర్థిక, ఆధ్యాత్మిక అసమానతలను చూపించిన పుస్తకమే ‘మాలపల్లి’. సంగ దాసు గాంధీ సిద్దాంతాలకు ప్రతీక, వెంకట దాసు భగత్ సింగ్ ఆలోచనలకు ప్రతీక. ఉన్నవ లక్ష్మినారాయణ నాటి సమాజంలో సాంఘిక, ఆర్థిక అసమానతలను తొలగించాలని.. సమసమాజాన్ని స్థాపించాలనేయ్ లక్ష్యంతో పనిచేశారు. కుల వ్యవస్థని నిరసిస్తూ.. అగ్రవర్ణాలు, హరిజనులు కలిసి మెలసి ఉండాలని భావించారు.

ishq-unplugged.title: Ishq Unplugged
ishq-unplugged.description:
Aahi, jo apne sapno mein baar-baar aane wali ek awaaz ke peeche India aayi hai, kya hoga jab use pata chalega ki jiski talash mein woh hai, woh business tycoon Ekansh Rajvansh hai? Kyun Aahi itni bechaini se Ekansh ko khoj rahi hai? Kaise woh uske paas pahuchegi? Aur jab Ekansh ko sach pata chalega, toh kya hoga?
Yeh kahani hai jazbaton, raaz aur pyar ke ek safar ki. Kya Aahi ka faisla sahi hai?

grahana.title: Grahana
grahana.description: S.L. ಭೈರಪ್ಪರ 'ಗ್ರಹಣ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಪಾರಂಪರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ತಾರ್ಕಿಕತೆಯ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಘರ್ಷ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ದ್ವಂದ್ವವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆ ಸೂರ್ಯಗ್ರಹಣದ ಸಂದರ್ಭದ ನಂತರ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ವಿವಿಧ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳು ಕಟ್ಟುಬದ್ಧತೆಯ ವಿರೋಧವಾಗಿ ತರ್ಕದ ಪರವಾಗಿ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸ, ಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ಒತ್ತಡಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಮನನಾತ್ಮಕ ಅನುಭವ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಧರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಸಕ್ತಿರುವವರು ಇದನ್ನು ಓದಬೇಕೆಂದು ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.

bible-4.title: BIBLE
bible-4.description: ಬೈಬಲ್, ಕ್ರಿಶ್ಚಿಯನ್ ಧರ್ಮದ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಗ್ರಂಥ, ಹಳೆಯ ಒಪ್ಪಂದ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಒಪ್ಪಂದವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಹಳೆಯ ಒಪ್ಪಂದವು ದೇವನಿರ್ಮಿತ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ, ಇಸ್ರಾಯೇಲ್ ಜನರ ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಮತ್ತು ದೇವರ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೊಸ ಒಪ್ಪಂದವು ಯೇಸು ಕ್ರಿಸ್ತನ ಜೀವನ, ಉಪದೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಷ್ಯರ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಂತಿ, ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಕ್ಷಮೆ ಮತ್ತು ದೇವರ ಜೊತೆಗಿನ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸುವ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

Junoon--मोहब्बत-में-कतल-की-कहानी.title: Junoon : मोहब्बत में क़त्ल की कहानी
Junoon--मोहब्बत-में-कतल-की-कहानी.description: Hum mein se kisi ko daulat kamaane ki aas hai, to kisi ko shauhrat paane ki. Koi ek acchi zindagi jeene ki aas rakhta hai, to koi apne shauq poore karne ke. Lekin jab- kisi insaan ki aas- uska junoon ban jaaye, to use haiwaan banne main zyada waqt nahi lagta! Dilli mein rehne waali Simran ke saath 'new age digital crime/catfishing' ka aisa vakyaa hua, jisne uski poori zindagi tabah kar ke rakh di! Wo ek aise aadmi se mohabbat kar baithi, jo wo nahi tha jo wo banne ka natak kar raha tha! Aakhir kaun tha ye shaqs?  Wahin, desh ki vardi pehne sipahi par koi bhi aankh band kar ke bharosa kar leta hai, lekin jab Shailja ko pata chala, ki uske pati ka dost hi uske liye apni havas ki saari hadon ko paar kar raha tha, to wo kya karti? Apni family se zyada koi isaan kisi bhi cheez ke liye junooniyat ki had tak nahin jaa sakta. Lekin jab apne family ko ek khushhaal zindagi dene ke liye uska junoon use ek psychotic serial killer bana de, to koi kya kare?

secret-billionaire-son-in-law.title: Secret Billionaire Son-in-Law
secret-billionaire-son-in-law.description: Wealth hidden. Pride swallowed. Humiliated daily. Alex endures constant abuse as the "worthless" live-in son-in-law, secretly harboring an earth-shattering truth – he's a billionaire heir. Bound by promise, he suffers his mother-in-law's endless ridicule, while his supportive wife Daisy faces workplace harassment and family pressure to leave him. But when his platinum credit card reactivates and his true power returns, Alex must choose between keeping his vow and protecting Daisy. Listen "Secret Billionaire Son-in-Law," a gripping drama where love, loyalty, and hidden identities collide in a world obsessed with status and wealth. How long can Alex keep his billions secret?

trinoyoni.title: Trinoyoni
trinoyoni.description: Trina ne pyar kiya, lekin pyar ke badle dhokha mila. Sonagachi mein bechne wale uske apne hi the. Tara, jo maa banne ka natak karti rahi, uski sabse badi dushman nikli, aur usne masoom Trina ko Trinoyoni banne par majboor kar diya. Par usne haar nahi maani balki apne dard ko shakti banakar ladna seekha. Trinoyoni duniya ke andheron ke beech bhi roshni ki talaash mein rahi, lekin uska ant kisi dard bhare sapne se bhi zyada dil dukhane wala tha. Jaaniye, Trina ki zindagi ka woh sach, jo kabhi koi samajh nahi paaya.

om-namo.title: Om Namo
om-namo.description: ಧರ್ಮ, ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ, ಸಮಾಜ, ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ತೊಡಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಂತಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕುವ ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಪಾಡು 'ಶಾಂತಿನಾಥ ದೇಸಾಯಿ' ಅವ್ರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ಓಂ ಣಮೋ' ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಜೈನ ಧರ್ಮದ ಚಿಂತನೆ, ಆಚರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ವಗಳ ಸಂಘರ್ಷ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ..

dhyana-1.title: Dhyana
dhyana-1.description: ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಸಮಯ, ಧ್ಯಾನ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ ಲಭಿಸುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಧ್ಯಾನ ಮಾಡುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಇರೋ ನಿಯಮಗಳೇನು? ಅದು ನಮ್ಮ ದೈಹಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೀರುವ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳೇನು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಶ್ರೀ. ಎಂ' ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ಧ್ಯಾನ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್!

e-shram-card-card-ek-fayde-anek.title: E-SHRAM Card: Card Ek, Fayde Anek
e-shram-card-card-ek-fayde-anek.description: Sochiye, ek aisa card jo aapko sirf government ki schemes ka access hi nahi, balki financial aur social security bhi dilata hai. E-SHRAM Card ke fayde har kaamgaar ki zindagi asaan banane ke liye design kiye gaye hain. Kya aap bhi jaanna chahte hain kaise yeh card aapka bhavishya surakshit karega? Toh abhi suniye yeh show aur is life-changing card ka pura sach samajhiye.

e159bdd1-1b5f-410b-910e-7c70e3e38d89.title: The Air Hostess
e159bdd1-1b5f-410b-910e-7c70e3e38d89.description:
நடு வானில் ஒரு பக்கா ஆக்‌ஷன், சஸ்பென்ஸ் நிறைந்த லவ் ஸ்டோரி.
Listen to the Adventure Story of Charu - The Air Hostess

meluhada-mruthyunjaya.title: Meluhada Mruthyunjaya
meluhada-mruthyunjaya.description: ಶಿವ ನಾವು ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವಂತಹ ದೇವರಾಗಿರದೆ ಒಂದಾನೊಂದು ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಂತೆ ರಕ್ತ, ಮಾಂಸದಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ಮಾನವನಾಗಿದ್ದಿರಬಹುದಲ್ಲವೇ? ಆತನೇ ನಾನು ಮಾಡಿದ ಸತ್ಕರ್ಮಗಳಿಂದ ದೈವತ್ವಕ್ಕೇರಿ ನಮಗೆ ಮಹಾದೇವನಾಗಿ ಕಂಡಿರಬಹುದಲ್ಲವೇ? ಇಂತಹ ಚಿಂತನೆಯ ಸುತ್ತ ಹೆಣೆದಿರುವ ರೋಚಕ ಕಾಲ್ಪನಿಕ ಕಥೆಯೇ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಜೀವಾಳ, ಭಾರತ ದೇಶದ ಭವ್ಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆ ಈ ಮೂರೂ ಮಿಳಿತಗೊಂಡು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿರುವ ಕೃತಿಯೇ 'ಮೆಲೂಹದ ಮೃತ್ಯುಂಜಯ'.

la-on-fire-zindagi-ki-survival-guide.title: LA on Fire: Zindagi Ki Survival Guide
la-on-fire-zindagi-ki-survival-guide.description:
⚡️ "Breaking News: LA ki Fire ne 24 ghanton mein pure sheher ki life barbaad kar di - Hollywood se lekar galiyon tak!"
LA ki is khatarnaak fire ne hume ek bohot bada lesson de diya - life kitni unpredictable hoti hai. Ek pal mein 38,600 acres zameen raakh mein badal gayi, aur kisi ko nahi pata tha ki agla target kaun hoga. 
Kya aap jaante hain ki is fire ne LA ke sabse alag shehron ko kaise ek kar diya? Social media par viral ho rahi fake news ka jungle, private jets hire karne wale celebrities, aur help ke liye aage aane wale log aapko bohot alag sochne par majboor kardenge. Celebrities ke mehenge ghar bhi jal gaye, par kya aap jaante hain evacuation ke time pe unhone kya bachaya? 
Yeh episode aapko le jayega un kahaniyon tak jo media ne chhupayi, aur batayega ki aisi tragedies ke liye kaise tayyari karein.
Iss show se samajhna aur seekhna zaroori hai, kyunki yeh sirf unki kahani nahi hai, yeh kabhi bhi aapki aur hamari reality ban sakti hai!

dhyana.title: Dhyana
dhyana.description: ತೀರ್ಥರಾಮ ವಳಲಂಬೆ ಅವರು ರಚಿಸಿರುವ ಕೃತಿ ಧ್ಯಾನ. ಧ್ಯಾನ ಎಂದರೇನು? ಧ್ಯಾನದ ಉಪಯೋಗಗಳೇನು? ಧ್ಯಾನ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾದ ವಿಧಾನದ ಕುರಿತು ಸಮಗ್ರ ಚಿತ್ರಣವನ್ನು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ

doora-saridaru.title: Doora Saridaru
doora-saridaru.description: ‘ದೂರ ಸರಿದರು’ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಕಾರ ಎಸ್ ಎಲ್ ಭೈರಪ್ಪನವರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಒಂದು ಕಾಲೇಜಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆ. ಹೆಣ್ಣು-ಗಂಡಿನ ಸಮಾನತೆ, ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ, ಮತ್ತು ತತ್ವವೇನು ಸಂಬಂಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಖ್ಯಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರದೋಷವಾಗಿದೆ. ಭೈರಪ್ಪನವರು ಪ್ರೇಮವನ್ನು ತತ್ವದ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಂತೆ ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸಚ್ಚಿದಾನಂದ, ವಸಂತ, ಉಮಾ, ರಮಾ, ಮತ್ತು ವಿನತಾ ಎನ್ನುವ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳು ಈ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾದ ಪಾತ್ರವಹಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಪ್ರೇಮ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ತಾತ್ವಿಕ ಅರ್ಥಗಳನ್ನು ಬೋಧಿಸುತ್ತಾ, ಆಳವಾದ ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

a-cursed-vampire.title: A Cursed Vampire
a-cursed-vampire.description:
Ye kahani hai ek Vampire ke junooni Ishq aur badle ki. Jahan ek shaitani tantrik ki buri najar padte hi ek Premi jode  ki zindagi ho jaati hai tabah. Ek tantrik ke shrap ke karan jahan masoom Darshika ki maut ho jaati hai vahi sadharan sa Avvyaan badal jata hai ek khooni pishach mein. Saalon se is shrap se jujh Rahe Avvyaan ki jindagi mein achanak fir se uska khoya pyar laut aata hai, sath hi aata hai wo tantrik bhi jiske karan hui thi unki jindagi barbad. Isi ke sath badal jaati hai uski khooni pyas , tantrik se badla lene,  apne pyar ko wapas pane  aur use bachane ke junoon me. 
To kaise is sharp se mukt hoga Avvyaan ? Kya is bar wo bacha payega apne pyar ko ? Ya fir ek bar wo tantrik laga dega unki jindagi mein grahan ?

dinakkondu-kathe-karthika-samputa.title: Dinakkondu Kathe - Karthika Samputa
dinakkondu-kathe-karthika-samputa.description: ಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕಿ ಅನುಪಮಾ ನಿರಂಜನ ಅವರು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಬರೆದ ಕತೆಗಳ ಸಂಪುಟಗಳು. ’ಕಥೆಗಳಿಂದ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗುವ ಉಪಯೋಗ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಂಡದಷ್ಟು ಕಥೆಗಳಿಂದ ಮಗುವಿನ ಕಲ್ಪನಾಶಕ್ತಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಕುತೂಹಲ ತಣಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಬುದ್ಧಿ ಚಿಗುರುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಾಹಸಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ, ಅನುಕಂಪ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ದುಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಸೋಲು, ಸತ್ಯವಂತರಿಗೆ ಜಯ ಎಂಬ ನೀತಿ ಮನದಟ್ಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಮಗುವಿನ ಬೌದ್ಧಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಭರತ ಖಂಡದ ಪುರಾಣಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿವಳಿಕೆ ಮೂಡುವುದಲ್ಲದೆ ಅವುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗೌರವಭಾವನೆಯೂ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಇತರ ದೇಶಗಳ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಂದ ತಮ್ಮ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಭಂಡಾರವನ್ನು ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡದ್ದರಿಂದ ಆ ಭಾಷೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಜನರ ಬಗೆಗೆ ಆದರ ಮೂಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಪಂಚವೇ ತನ್ನದು ಎಂಬ ವಿಶಾಲ ಮನೋಭಾವ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ.

kage-mathu-kadlebele-payasa.title: Kage Mathu Kadlebele Payasa
kage-mathu-kadlebele-payasa.description: ಕಾಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಡ್ಲೆಬೇಳೆ ಪಾಯಸ ಕಥಾ ವಸ್ತು, ನಿರೂಪಣಾ ಶೈಲಿ, ಪಾತ್ರಗಳ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿ, ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳ ಜೋಡಣೆ, ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಕ ಅಂಶಗಳಿಂದ ಇಲ್ಲಿಯ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.ವಿಷಯ ಸೀಮಿತ ರೂಪದ್ದಾದರೂ, ಭಾಷೆ -ಭಾವಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಡುವ ತಂತ್ರಗಾರಿಕೆ ಇದೆ. ಪ್ರಯೋಗಶೀಲತೆಯೂ ಇದೆ’ ಕಾಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಡ್ಲೆಬೇಳೆ ಪಾಯಸ ಕತೆಯಂತೂ ಸಾಂಕೇತಿಕತೆಯೂ ಮೈವೆತ್ತಂತೆ ಮೂಡಿ ಬಂದಿದೆ.

the-call-girl.title: The Call Girl
the-call-girl.description:
Advik Mehra, Mehra Industries ka biological waris hote huye bhi use kabhi woh respect nahi mili, jiska woh hakdar tha. Engagement ke din hi, uski fiancé, Ritika , jise woh dil-o-jaan se pyaar karta tha, uske sautele bhai Sameer ke saath ek hi kamere mein Advik ke vishwaas ko todti hui milti hai.
Isi dard aur akelepan ko mitane ke liye, Advik ek call girl, Mayra, ko hotel mein bulata hai. Lekin ek raat ki vo mulaqat ek naye rishte ki shuruaat ban jaati hai, jahan sirf sharir nahi, balki dil ke zakham aur zindagi ke sach saamne aate hain. Advik ki zindage ka ye mod use sochne par majboor karta hai ki 'kya ek call girl pyaar deserve nahi karti?'
Kya Mayra Advik ke bikharte dil ko sambhal payegi? Kya Advik Mayra ko uski Call Girl ki andheri duniya ke shikanje se nikal kar ek naya jeevan de payega ? Aur kya Advik apne sautele bhai Sameer aur uski maa Kalpana ki saazishon ko tod kar Mehra Industries mein apna vo haq cheen payega jiska vo hakdar hai?

రైజింగ్-స్టార్.title: Rising Star
రైజింగ్-స్టార్.description: సినిమా ఇండస్ట్రీ ఎదురుకుంటున్న ప్రస్తుత సమస్య, ప్రముఖులపై వస్తున్న "లైంగిక ఆరోపణలు".  అవన్నీ వాస్తవాలేనా? లేదా కావాలనే వారి ఎదుగుదల ఓర్చుకోలేక, బురద జల్లే ప్రయత్నమా? ఇందులో మీడియా పాత్ర ఏంటి? ఏది నిజం ? ఏది అబద్దం? ఎవరిని ఉద్దేశించి రాసినది కాదు, కేవలం యదార్ధ సంఘటనల ఆధారంగా, ఒక కల్పిత కథ "రైసింగ్ స్టార్" వినండి మీ కుకు FMలో

aalha-udal-ek-musical-yuddh-katha.title: Amar Yoddha: Aalha-Udal Ki Ankahi Kahaani
aalha-udal-ek-musical-yuddh-katha.description: Kaun Aalha - Udal? Arey ! Vahi Aalha Udal Jinhone pani peene wale lote lekar ek poori sena ko hara diya tha, Vahi Aalha Udal jinhone Maharaj Prithviraj Chauhan ko bhi akele 3 baar haraya tha? Isiliye hum aa gaye hain Inhi Veeron ki kahani sunane,Vo bhi poore gaaje-baaje ke sath. Abhi Sunana shuru kijiye.

f9705551-1949-4233-a6b7-5ba3b1b419f4.title: Finding My X
f9705551-1949-4233-a6b7-5ba3b1b419f4.description: Thannoda X girlfriend kaaga namma hero Time travel panraaru. Pirintha kadhali kaaga en past ku poganum ? eppadi itha seiyya mudinjuthu ? appadi enna nadanthuthu ?

the-senators-gambit.title: The Senator's Gambit
the-senators-gambit.description: Rising political star Alexandra thinks she can handle a one-night stand with charming journalist James - until he reveals evidence of corruption that could destroy her career and land her in prison. Their explosive game of manipulation and blackmail spirals into a dangerous investigation of illegal arms deals and presidential corruption, forcing them to become unlikely partners even as they plot to destroy each other. Between steamy encounters and devastating betrayals, Alexandra and James realize they're pawns in a deadly conspiracy reaching from DC bedrooms to foreign intelligence agencies - and their mutual destruction might be the only way out.

power-of-chanting-jeetiye-zindagi-ki-jun.title: Power Of Chanting : Jeetiye Zindagi Ki Jung
power-of-chanting-jeetiye-zindagi-ki-jun.description: Mantra ki shakti se life mein positive changes lana chahate hain? Is audio show mein, aapko milenge powerful mantra ke meanings, unse judi kahaniyan aur correct uchcharan karne ka tarika. Har episode mein janiye ki kaise ye mantra aapki spiritual growth, mental peace aur success ko boost kar sakte hain. To abhi sunna shuru kijiye aur apni life badal lijiye!

vidhura-neeti.title: Vidhura Neeti
vidhura-neeti.description: ವಿದುರ ನೀತಿ ಮಹಾಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾದ ಭಾಗವಾಗಿದೆ. ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನಿಗೆ ವಿವೇಕ ಬೋಧಿಸಲು ವಿದುರನು ನೀಡಿದ ಉಪದೇಶಗಳ ಸಂಕಲನವಿದು. ಕುರುವಂಶದ ಉಪಶಮನಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನಿಗೆ ನಿಷ್ಠೆಯಿಂದ ರಾಜಧರ್ಮ, ಸತ್ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ, ಮತ್ತು ನೈತಿಕತೆಯ ಕುರಿತು ಮಹತ್ವದ ಪಾಠಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಲು ವಿದುರನು ಮುಂದಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವಿದುರನು ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನಿಗೆ ನೀತಿ, ಧರ್ಮ, ರಾಜಕಾರಣ, ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಮೂಲ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಬೋಧಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ತನ್ನ ಸುಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಹಾಗೂ ಗಹನ ತತ್ವಜ್ಞಾನದಿಂದಲೇ ವಿದುರನು ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ನೀತಿಜ್ಞನಾಗಿ ಹೆಸರು ಗಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾನೆ.

ceo-samrat.title: CEO Samrat
ceo-samrat.description: ಸಾಮ್ರಾಟ್ ಶೆಟ್ಟಿ, ಶೆಟ್ಟಿ ಇಂಡಸ್ಟ್ರೀಸ್‌ನ ಏಕೈಕ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರಿ, ತನ್ನ ಮನೆಯವರ ತಂತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಬಿದ್ದು, ಒಂದು ಮುಗ್ಧ  ಹುಡುಗಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅಳಿಸಲಾಗದ ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿಬಿಟ್ಟಿರುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಶಾಲಿನಿಯನ್ನು ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಿ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಟ್ ಅವಳ ಬದಲು ಜೈಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿರುತ್ತಾನೆ . ಅವನು ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಆದ ನಂತರ ಅವನನ್ನು ಮದುವೆಯಾಗುವುದಾಗಿ ಶಾಲಿನಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮಾತು ಕೊಟ್ಟಿರುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆದರೆ ಜೈಲಿನಿಂದ ವಾಪಾಸ್ ಬಂದಮೇಲೆ ಆ ಮುಗ್ಧ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಶಾಲಿನಿ ಅಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಿಯ ಅಂತ ಗೊತ್ತಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಈಗ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಟ್ ಪ್ರಿಯಾಗಾಗಿ ಏನ್ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವನ ತಪ್ಪನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸರಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳುತ್ತಾನೆ ಅಂತ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಕನ್ನಡ  ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "CEO ಸಾಮ್ರಾಟ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

tulsi-main-tere-aangan-ki.title: Tulsi Main Tere Aangan Ki
tulsi-main-tere-aangan-ki.description:
Tulsi ek aam bahu woh Baa ki  laadli, pyaari, aur sacchai ki misaal hai. Par uski muskurahat ke peeche ek gehra dard chhupa hai, jo shaayad koi nahi dekh paata. Aman ke liye bas ek formality aur Kokila Ben ke liye ek samasya, Tulsi ka safar mohabbat aur sangharsh se bhara hai. Tanvi, Aman ki bachpan ki dost, wapas laut aayi hai aur Kokila Ben ke saath milkar Tulsi ki zindagi ko narak banane aur usse Modi Mansion aur Aman ki zindagi se hamesha ke liye nikalne ki saazish rachi ja rahi hai.
Kya Tulsi apne sapno, izzat, aur pyar ke liye Kokila aur Tanvi ke chalakiyon ka samna kar payegi? Ya Modi Mansion ke rishte aur chal rahe khel uski duniya bikher denge?

యమహా-యమా-.title: Yamaho Yama
యమహా-యమా-.description: కామెడీ కథలను ఇష్టపడని వారు ఎవరైనా ఉంటారా ? అందులోను మన తెలుగు వాళ్ళు! మనిషి చనిపోయాక, నరకాలోకనికి చేరేలోపు యమభటులతో  ప్రతి జీవుడు చేసే సరదా సంభాషణ మీరు వినాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే వినండి "యమహా యమా" మీ కుకు FM లో.  విని హాయిగా నవ్వుకోండి.

a-night-before-our-breakup.title: A Night Before Our Breakup
a-night-before-our-breakup.description: Oru long term relationship ku apurama, namma hero and heroine ku set aagala - "Lets breakup" appadi'nu mutual ah decide panranga. Avangaloda pirithal'ku piranga sernthu dhaan aaganum'nu oru kattayam varuthu. Yenna aachu ? Ini avanga life eppadi irukka poguthu ?

aadhar-card-ke-secret-tips.title: Aadhar Card ke Secret Tips
aadhar-card-ke-secret-tips.description: Ab agent ko paise dene ki zaroorat nahi hai! Es Master Guide Show mein hai woh sari jankari jo Aadhaar ke har kaam ko bina commission diye asaan banaye. Naya Aadhaar banwana ho, apne bachche ka Aadhaar register karna ho, ya khoye Aadhaar ko recover karna ho, sab kuch step-by-step yahan es show mein. PAN aur bank linking ke aasan tareeke, aur zaroori security tips ke saath, yeh guide aapki har problem ka solution hai.

உதயபானு--தீம்புனல்.title: உதயபானு - தீம்புனல்
உதயபானு--தீம்புனல்.description:
காலம் கிபி.1000. 
பாண்டியர் தலைநகரான மதுரைக்குச் செல்வதென்று திடீரென முடிவெடுக்கிறார் பேரரசர் அருள்மொழிவர்மர். எதிரிகள் எங்குவேண்டுமானாலும் மறைந்திருக்கலாம். வேலோ ஈட்டியோ எந்த இருட்டு மூலையிலிருந்தும் பாயலாம்! சாகச வேட்டைக்கு தயாராகுங்கள்!

godhara-kand-hadsa-ya-sazish.title: Godhara Kand : हादसा या साज़िश?
godhara-kand-hadsa-ya-sazish.description: Godhra se gujar rahi train ke S6 coach mein aag kisne lagayi? Aur ye aag ki laptein poore Gujrat kaise fail gayi? Es poori ghatna mein kitna hadsa tha aur kitna sazish, ye sab aap es show mein jan sakenge. Saath hi janenge wo chhipe hue sach jo Insaniyat, Dharm aur Rajneeti ko chunauti dete hain.

killer-couple-americas-deadliest-relatio.title: Killer Couple - America's Deadliest Relationships
killer-couple-americas-deadliest-relatio.description: Delve into America's most chilling true crime cases in our immersive audio series "KILLER COUPLE"– where picture-perfect marriages mask sinister secrets. Each episode unravels the complex web of lies, betrayal, and murder that transformed loving partners into deadly predators. Through haunting narratives and immersive soundscapes, we expose the dark reality behind these domestic nightmares: the nurse who weaponized her medical knowledge, the firefighter's wife who orchestrated the perfect hit, or the suburban dad whose American Dream became his family's worst nightmare. What drives a spouse to kill? The truth is more disturbing than fiction. Let's cover each case, two haunting audio stories at a time.

hrudayadali-idhenidhu.title: Hrudayadali Idhenidhu
hrudayadali-idhenidhu.description: ಅಭಿಷೇಕ್‌ ತನ್ನ ಗೆಳತಿ ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯಾಳ ಹುಟ್ಟುಹಬ್ಬದ ಸಂಭ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕವಾಗಿ ಪೂರ್ವಿ ಜೊತೆ ಆ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಳೆದ ನಂತರ ಅವರೆಲ್ಲರ ಜೀವನವು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಘಟನೆಯು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮತ್ತು   ತೀವ್ರ ನಿರ್ಧಾರವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ – ತನ್ನ ಬಹುದಿನದ ಪ್ರೇಯಸಿ ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯಾಳ ಜೊತೆಗಿನ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಮುರಿದು, ಪೂರ್ವಿಯನ್ನು ಮದುವೆ ಆಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಅವಾಂತಾರದ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಯು ಅವನ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಫ್ಯೂಚರ್ ಪ್ಲಾನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಅಸ್ಪಷ್ಟಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆತನ ಭಾವನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆಕಾಂಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸಂಕಟವನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ಹೃದಯದಲಿ ಇದೇನಿದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

rebellion-in-bihar.title: Bihar : Bagaawat Aur Batwara
rebellion-in-bihar.description: Saal 2000 mein Bihar aur Jharkhand ke bantwaare ke dauran, rajneeti, gareebon ke adhikar, aur insaaf ki ladaai ke beech ek kahani janm leti hai. Jalti bastiyon aur sazishon ke darmiyan, Sahil ek aise sangharsh mein fans jaata hai jo sirf uski zindagi hi nahi, balki poore rajya ki tasveer badal sakta hai. Professor Solanki, jo partition ke khilaf logon ko bhadkate hain, Sahil ko is sangharsh ka hissa banate hain. Vaidehi ke wapas aane ki khushi ke beech, Sahil ek hamle mein fas jata hai aur printing press mein dange bhadkane wale slogans dekhkar uska mann badalne lagta hai. Kya Sahil Bihar ke liye sahi faisla karega, ya halat ke samne haar maan lega?

who-killed-me.title: Who killed me?
who-killed-me.description: தன் காதலனை சந்திக்கச் சென்ற நிஹாவை யாரோ கொலைசெய்து விடுகிறார்கள். அடுத்த நாள் அவள் கண் விழித்து கண்ணாடி முன் நிற்கும் போது அதிர்ச்சியடைகிறாள். ஏனெனில், அந்த முகமும் உடலும் அவளுடையது இல்லை.  அடுத்த அதிர்ச்சியாக அன்று தான் அவளுக்குத் திருமணம் நடந்திருக்கிறது, அடுத்த ஒரு மணி நேரத்தில் அவளுக்கு ஃபர்ஸ்ட் நைட். என்ன செய்யப் போகிறாள்?

ಪವರ್-ಸ್ಟಾರ್-ನಿಮಗೆ-ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲದ-ಅಪ್ಪು.title: Power Star- Nimage Gottillada Appu
ಪವರ್-ಸ್ಟಾರ್-ನಿಮಗೆ-ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲದ-ಅಪ್ಪು.description: ಪುನೀತ್‌ ರಾಜ್‌ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಅನ್ನೋ ನಟ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ಹಿರಿಯರವರೆಗೆ ಇಷ್ಟೊಂದು ಹತ್ತಿರವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ? ಪುನೀತ್‌ ಅವರೊಂದಿಗೇ ಬೆಳೆದು ಬಂದ ಒಂದು ಜನರೇಶನ್‌ ಅವರ ಸಿನಿಮಾಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡ್ತಾ, ಮೆಚ್ಚಿಕೊಳ್ತಾ, ಆ ಸಿನಿಮಾಗಳ ಪ್ರಭಾವಕ್ಕೊಳಗಾಗಿ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿನ ಒಳ್ಳೆತನ, ಆದರ್ಶಗಳನ್ನು ತನ್ನದಾಗಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ತಾ ಬಂದ್ರೆ, ಡಾ. ರಾಜ್‌ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಚಿತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಇಷ್ಟಪಡ್ತಿದ್ದ ಅವರ ಕಾಲದ ಜನರೇಶನ್‌, ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಈಗಿನ ಹಿರಿತಲೆಗಳು ಪುನೀತ್‌ ಚಿತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲೇ ಅಣ್ಣಾವ್ರನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ ಅಪ್ಪುವನ್ನು ಮನೆಮಗನಂತೆ ಅಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ತು. ಈಗಿನ ಮೂರನೇ ತಲೆಮಾರಿನ ಪುಟಾಣಿಗಳಿಗೂ ಹಾಡು, ಫೈಟು, ಡಾನ್ಸ್‌ಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ‘ಅಪ್ಪು’ ಇಷ್ಟವಾದ್ರು. ಚಿಲ್ಟುಗಳ ಸೂಪರ್‌ಮ್ಯಾನ್‌, ಹೆಂಗಳೆಯರ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಆದರ್ಶ ಪುರುಷ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಸಹೋದರ, ಯುವಕರ ಪಾಲಿನ ಐಕಾನ್‌, ಯುವತಿಯರ ಕನಸಿನ ರಾಜಕುಮಾರ, ಹಿರಿಯರಿಗೆ ಸ್ವಂತ ಮನೆಮಗನಂತಾಗಿದ್ದ ಪುನೀತ್‌, ಡಾ. ರಾಜ್‌ಕುಮಾರ್‌ ಅಗಲಿಕೆಯ ನಂತರ ಕೂಡಾ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರ ಹೃದಯ ಸಿಂಹಾಸನದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿರಸ್ಥಾಯಿ. ಅವ್ರ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಬದುಕಿನ, ಚಿತ್ರ ಜೀವನದ ಕಥೆ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

aryan-ki-alien.title: Aryan Ki Alien
aryan-ki-alien.description: Aryan Mehra, desh ka sabse bada businessman, apne chhote se Mumbai ke flat mein cancer se ladte hue apne kiye ki saza bhugat raha tha. Uska yeh yakeen tha ki usne apni behen ke saath jo kiya, uske baad uska tadap tadap kar marna tay tha. Lekin sab kuch tab badal gaya jab ek mysterious ladki, Arohi, 7 saal ke baad uski zindagi mein wapas aayi. Arohi ki aankhon ki chamak aur ajeeb si powers Aryan ke cancer ko heal karne lagti hain. Par kya hoga jab Aryan ko yeh pata chalega ki Arohi ek alien hai? Aur Aryan ne apni behen ke saath aakhir aisa kya kiya tha jo uske zindagi bhar ka dard ban gaya?

மணிபல்லவம்-2-.title: மணிபல்லவம் 2
மணிபல்லவம்-2-.description: பூம்புகாரின் வீதிகளில், அறிவு போரில் வெற்றி காணும் இளங்குமரனும், இதயத்தை கொள்ளை கொள்ளும் சுரமஞ்சரியும் நாயகர்களாக உருவெடுக்கிறார்கள். மர்மங்களும் உணர்ச்சிகளும் மிளிரும் இந்த கதை, மணிபல்லவ தீவில் திகட்டும் திருப்பங்களால் வாசகர்களை சிறைபிடிக்கிறது.

xiveri-mates-books-4-6.title: Xiveri Mates: Books 4-6
xiveri-mates-books-4-6.description: Book 4 - Taken to Heimo. He hates me and all humans. But he still calls me his. This full-length space-opera romance features an angry alien and a head-scarf-wearing human heroine who is far too polite to meet anger with anger… most of the time. Book 5 -Roses are red violets are blue Rhork's a psycho and he's a space pirate too. Meet the possessive space pirate of Kor in this adrenaline-filled romp through space featuring a four-armed alien and a plus-sized human heroine. Book 6Taken to Lemora. He's the wealthiest male in the quadrants and I make his horns…itch. Somewhere within a distant constellation a grumpy alien meets a hybrid human female who's just discovering freedom and is eager to grab it by the horns—literally.

jasoos-gharjamai.title: Jasoos Gharjamai
jasoos-gharjamai.description: Laakh koshish karne ke baad bhi ghar jamai Arjun apni wife Payal aur hitler sasu maa ko khush nahi rakh paata aur hamesha unke taane sunta rehta hai. Par uski family ko andaza bhi nahi hai ki wo ek secret RAW Agent hai. Ek din uske paas ek aisa mission aata hai jisse uski duniya hi badal jaati hai. Ek powerful terrorist organisation India par attack karna chahta hai, aur unhe Arjun ke har move ki khabar pehle se hi hoti hai. Kya hoga jab ye mission khol degi uske double life ka secret? Aur kyon RAW agent hone ke baad bhi wo sehta hai apni family ke taane? Kya hai Arjun ki asliyat?

the-players-club.title: The Player's Club
the-players-club.description: It was supposed to be a simple assignment: stake out the golden boy hockey player Cole; Mackenzie as he exited the arena after a Los Angeles Blades game. Follow him. Get dirt on his personal life something salacious to please the money-hungry gossip rag I worked for. But I missed the moment Mac left the building. Or so I thought ; Twenty minutes later I saw actual Mac exit after the media left. Apparently he used a decoy to throw off the press waiting until everyone left to make his getaway in private. I started following the real Mac and got more than I bargained for. He led me to a mystery building tucked away in the middle of the suburbs. Turned out he was going to; a private club. A club that wasn't for the faint of heart soon find out after sneaking in wasn't expecting to connect with Mac inside. Nor did I anticipate him to invite me back as his personal guest. What started as a simple assignment turned into something much more bigger fantasy I never knew I had. This wasn't about the tabloid story anymore. I lied to my boss told him there was nothing to see. Meanwhile I kept returning to the club. I was addicted to unraveling the mysteries of Mac's world. Addicted to the man who lit a fire inside me. But with my own secret it was only a matter of time before I got burned.

maha-kumbh-bhakti-aur-moksh-ka-marg.title: Maha Kumbh : Bhakti Aur Moksh Ka Marg
maha-kumbh-bhakti-aur-moksh-ka-marg.description: Aaj Koi Description nahin hai, Kyuki Maha Kumbh Ishwar se milne ka marg hai jise aap sirf sunkar hi mehsoos kar sakte hain. To description chhodiye aur is Mahakumbh mein ye khas show sunkar Bholenath ki Bhakti mein kho jaiye. Jai Mahakaal !

the-drowning-house.title: The Drowning House
the-drowning-house.description: A mysterious house washes ashore during a storm in the Pacific Northwest, followed by the death of a woman and disappearance of her grandson Simon Culpepper. His childhood friends Melissa and Leo must set aside their differences to search for him on Marrowstone Island. As they investigate, they uncover sinister truths about the house, its builder, and an encroaching evil.

remade-book-1.title: ReMade: Book 1
remade-book-1.description: In one moment the lives of twenty-three teenagers are forever changed and it's not just because they all happen to die. ReMade in a world they barely recognize--one with robots space elevators and unchecked jungle--they must work together to survive. They came from different places backgrounds and families and now they might be the last people on earth. Lost meets The Maze Runner in this exciting adventure from Serial Box Publishing Team-written by some of today's most exciting authors.

zoya-1.title: Zoya
zoya-1.description: Ek One Night Stand ke baad 24 Saal ki Zoya agli subah khud ko ek khandhar mandir me paati hai jahan use ek bhoot ki dulhan banna hai. Use pata lagta hai ye sab kadiyan uske pichhle janm se ja ke judti hain. Kya Zoya pata kar paayegi apni zindagi ka raaz? Ya use hamesha ke liye ban jana hoga ek bhoot ki dulhan?

medley.title: Medley
medley.description:
Olympic gold is within their grasp if they can stay afloat in the sea of feels.
Jacob is drowning. Nineteen and a first-time Olympian, he is in over his head. And the water is only rising as he crushes harder on his tattooed teammate. Sebastian cost his team the medley relay gold four years ago. He won't make the same mistakes at this summer's Olympics. Mistakes like falling for another swimmer at the Games.
Jacob needs all the help he can get. His mentor Sebastian can provide it. But when the irresistible rookie asks for his heart Sebastian is the one left treading water. He wants the gold. He wants Jacob. If he can't find a way to win both he'll sink. And take Jacob and the rest of the team with him.
Take a tattooed bad boy and an adorkable rookie, put them on the same Olympic medley relay team, and watch the heart-eyes fly in this friends-to-lovers MM sports romance.

even-better.title: Even Better
even-better.description: A story about how coming together can break us apart. An old military friend of Blue comes to stay with us and suddenly I have two muscled men surrounding me. Before I can take a breath we're diving into something dirty together and something dangerous. Dangerous because three is a crowd. This is Blue's best friend and one of us will have to leave. EVEN BETTER is a sexy novella best read after BETTER WHEN IT HURTS. Fair warning: Contains two hot ex-military men and a girl caught in the middle.

ajmer-1992-sex-scandal.title: Ajmer 1992 Sex Scandal
ajmer-1992-sex-scandal.description: 100 se zyada ladkiyon ko jinme 11 saal ki ladkiyan bhi thi aur 20 saal ki bhi, sabko kuch darindon ne apna shikaar banaya. Sabko ek farmhouse mein bulaakar ek aise jaal mein fansaya gaya, jiske baad samaaj mein unhe apna muh chupa kar chalne ke liye majboor hona pada. 32 saal baad in ladkiyon ko 2024 mein adalat se nyay mila hai. Par kya adalat sach mein unhe justice de payi? Kya hai inki poori kahani, jaaniye true crime ke is khaas show mein.

the-last-app.title: The Last App
the-last-app.description:
Mick wants to know when he’s going to die. Luckily—or unluckily—there’s an app for that…

Dr. Mick Strong has bought himself something unusual for his seventy-fifth birthday: a LifeTime projection. This new tech crunches data including your medical history diet and lifestyle to predict how much—or little—time you’ve got left.That’s all well and good, but he’s also bought them for his daughter, his grandchildren, and even his eleven-year-old great-grandson. He wants them each to wait until their next birthday to use the app. But whether they scoff at it, sneak an early look, desperately turn into a health nut, or die before their appointed time— the gift is wreaking havoc on the whole family. This dark insightful novel about hope, fear and stubborn curiosity reminds us that we never quite know what lies ahead—and that when it comes to love and family there’s no time like the present.

trouble-on-his-wings.title: Trouble on His Wings
trouble-on-his-wings.description: Daredevil photojournalist Johnny Brice is always looking for trouble... and finding it. But he doesn't know what real trouble is until he rescues the beautiful woman he calls Jinx. They're made for each other — even if they are a dangerous mix. It all comes to a head on assignment in China when the Japanese shoot his plane down and take them prisoner. Is the lady really a jinx... or is she even more sinister? In an adventure full of surprising discoveries getting at the truth leads to the most shocking twist of all. If you're looking for trouble — and high-flying adventure — you'll find it here as the audio version of Trouble on His Wings puts a world of action in your hands.

vidur-sutra-jeet-ka-rahasya.title: Vidur Sutra : Jeet Ka Rahasya
vidur-sutra-jeet-ka-rahasya.description: Kalyug ke bure daur mein Dwapar Yug ke vidwan Vidur ham sabko sikha rahe hain success ke liye rasto ki khoj. Aur bata rahe hain Samay ke sath neeti ki jung ladne ka tarika. Is show mein aapko milega Vidur Niti ke roop mein har samasya ka samadhan. Abhi sunna shuru kijiye.

the-escorts-inc-series.title: The Escorts Inc Series
the-escorts-inc-series.description:
Bundled together for the first time, enjoy The Escorts Inc. series containing Boyfriend for Hire & The Hookup Handbook. 

BOYFRIEND FOR HIRE: I’m the guy you call when you need to impress your overbearing family your boss or your ex. Yeah I’m a male escort but not just any escort I’m the escort. The one with a mile-long waiting list and a pristine reputation that’s very well-deserved. I’m the guy who’ll make you feel beautiful desired and worshipped...all for a steep price. I’m hired to make you shine and I always deliver. I’ll be whatever you want me to be for one night - except my true self. This is just a job a role I play to earn a paycheck. But I’m not the guy who falls for a client. Not once in six years. And then I meet Elle. Her friend has hired me to escort her to a wedding but Elle doesn’t know we’re just pretending. 

THE HOOKUP HANDBOOK: My love wand is on a strike. As bad as that blows pun unintended it’s 10 times worse for me. I’m a male escort but not just any escort I’m the escort. The one with a mile-long waiting list and a pristine reputation that’s very well-deserved. Only now I’m on hiatus. Because after years of pleasing women all over the city my man missile decides to get finicky. And the only woman he wants? Someone I can never have - my best friend’s younger sister the nerdy and awkwardly adorable Sienna.

the-single-dads-club.title: The Single Dads Club
the-single-dads-club.description: **Unexpectedly sweet and with blazing hot steam now in one boxed set. Enjoy four full-length standalone novels featuring single dads from New York Times bestselling author Kendall Ryan in one complete volume. The Dare** As an ER nurse I've seen a lot of things but this might take the cake. Because the charming hottie packing a whole lotta somethin' somethin' beneath his hospital gown? He's all kinds of naughty trouble. And I have time for exactly none of it. I didn't expect to see Cade again - never expected the guy I treated in my ER would turn out to be the sweet single dad I'm now secretly lusting over. Complicated doesn't even begin to cover it. Only for Tonight He’s bossy moody and overprotective. He’s also a pro athlete who needs to focus on winning games and staying out of the headlines. I’m fiercely independent and need a man like I need a second period each month. So when our worlds collide I never expected him to be the one to jump in and save me. Especially not when my roommate disappears leaving me with her baby. I’m clueless about babies - and it shows. Good thing Alexei isn’t. With six nieces and nephews and an apparent hero complex the dude is both sexy and more than capable. It’s a combination that makes it easy to forget we’re just playing house. Penthouse Prince Lexington Dane was my brother’s best friend growing up. We did everything together. He taught me how to throw a punch how to change a tire…and he taught me how to kiss. I fell hard and fast and gave him all my firsts. I promised I’d wait for him… But I’m done waiting because he went off to college and never came back. He took his fancy business degree and moved to New York City where he promptly became a real estate mogul—turning every penthouse and apartment project he touched into gold. It’s been ten years and now he’s back and needs a favor…someone to watch his little girl. That’s right the cocky penthouse prince and heartbreaker extraordinaire Lexington is back with an adorable two-year-old daughter. Guess who he wants to watch her? I’ve never been able to say no to him. I might agree to be the nanny for his precious little angel but there’s no way in hell I’m falling for her hot-as-sin daddy. The Soul Mate The smoking-hot one-night stand I was never supposed to see again? Yeah well I might be pregnant and he’s my OB-GYN.

kathputli-1.title: Kathputli
kathputli-1.description: "Kukdi Rasam," ek khaufnaak rasam jisme shadi ki pehli raat safed chadar par khoon ke daag aurat ki pavitrata ka saboot mane jate hain. Is rasam ke naam par gaon ka sarpanch mahilao ka shoshan karta hai, unhe apni "Kathputli" banata hai. Lekin Badri is atyachar ke khilaf awaz uthata hai, aur uska saath deti hai Kamli ki atma aur uski premika Panna. Inki prem kahani bhi is samajik burai ke chakravyuh me ulajh jati hai. Kya "Kukdi Rasam" ka ant hoga? Kya Badri aur Panna apne pyaar ko anjaam tak le jaa paayenge?

claim.title: Claim
claim.description: He showed me a side of myself I never dreamed existed. Olivia’s professor promised her lessons she couldn’t learn in class. What he didn’t expect was to find peace from his tormented past in her arms. Now that past has caught up to both of them ripping them apart even when he vowed she was the person who mattered most. He has one chance to fight for what’s right even if it costs him his career his reputation his happiness. She has one chance to claim the future she’s worked for and grasp her dreams.
