But in a world hellbent on judgment freedom has a price. What if the price is love? CLAIM is an illicit forbidden full-length novel and the explosive book 3 in the OFF-LIMITS trilogy. Sawyer and Olivia’s story begins in CRAVE and continues in COLLIDE.

kaaldrum-ka-rahasya.title: Kaaldrum Ka Rahasya
kaaldrum-ka-rahasya.description:
1960 ke dashak mein Aryan aur Rudrani ki prem kahani ek rahasya aur khauf mein badal jaati hai. Rudrani ki hari aankhon aur uski jadui taaqaton ke peeche ek badi sacchai chhupi hai.
Detective Darsheel ek chetavni bhari chithti ke zariye Rudrani aur Kaaldrum parivaar ke rahasyo ko samajhne ki koshish karta hai. Ek sanket par woh ek sunsaan chemical factory tak pahuchta hai, jahan rahasya aur khatra dono uska intezaar kar rahe hote hain. Kya Darsheel is rahasya ka parda utha payega, ya khud iska shikar ban jayega?

empire-of-lust.title: Empire of Lust
empire-of-lust.description: I made a mistake. At sixteen years old I fell for the wrong man. Callum Torrio. Ruthless billionaire. Dangerous villain. My best friend's father. At twenty one I gave up hope that he would ever notice me. He’s twenty years older than me and an arms dealer for the mob. The smart choice would be to forget he ever existed. But that’s not possible. His icy blue gaze sculpted physique and huge rough hands play a vivid part in my dreams. Then one night everything changes. Every fantasy I ever had he brings to life. Dominant and possessive he praises and worships me. He makes me feel like a woman when all my life I’ve felt sheltered and controlled. But Callum has dark secrets and a past that refuses to let go. I knew he was a bad man but I never would have anticipated this… This dark romance is the first in a three-book series. It contains dark themes and things that may be triggering to some. Please avoid if you don't like possessive controlling antiheroes.

never-walk-alone.title: Never Walk Alone
never-walk-alone.description: The world is on lockdown due to a virus that originated in Miami. A woman is kidnapped from her apartment and detective Harry Hunter is on the case. At the same time his sister shows up after they haven't seen each other in a year. As it turns out Harry's sister knows more about the virus than she lets on. Soon he wonders if the virus is connected to the missing woman. As he digs deeper into the strange mystery he realizes his sister's life is in great danger and so is his. Never Walk Alone is the fourth book in the Harry Hunter Mystery series.

aaj-ka-rashifal-kaisa-rahega-din.title: Aaj Ka Rashifal : Kaisa Rahega Din
aaj-ka-rashifal-kaisa-rahega-din.description: Zindagi ke chakravyuh mein atke hain? Pandit Ji ke unique tips aur madad ke saath apni life ko simplify kariye. Daily Subah 7 Baje Janiye apni rashi ke liye har din ki bhavishyawani aur aane wali samsyaon ke liye kiya jana wala upchar .

sweetlust.title: Sweetlust
sweetlust.description: In a dystopian world with no men women are “rehabilitated” at an erotic amusement park. Climate change has caused massive flooding and warming in the Balkans where one programmer builds a time machine. And a devious reimagining of The Sorrows of Young Werther refocuses to center a sexually adventurous Charlotte. Asja Baki? deploys the speculative and weird to playfully interrogate conversations around artificial intelligence gender fluidity and environmental degradation. As she did in her acclaimed debut Mars Baki? once again upends her characters’ convictions and identities—and infuses each disorienting universe with sly humor and off-kilter eroticism. Visceral and otherworldly Sweetlust takes apart human desire and fragility repeatedly framing pleasure as both inviting and perilous.

the-intern.title: The Intern
the-intern.description: In the legal world everyone knows my last name. So when Declan Shaw—the hottest most ruthless and sought-after litigator in the state—comes in to mentor my class’s mock trial I decide not to reveal that piece of personal information. I want a one-on-one with him like I’m any other law student especially when we go out to celebrate after class. But the one-on-one ends with us in the alley behind the bar. With us stripping off our clothes. With me screaming his name. It’s desperate-to-have-you no-holds-barred downright filthy sex. And then he ghosts me like a complete alphahole. But a few weeks later when I walk into The Dalton Group—my family’s law firm—where I’m starting my internship my new boss is waiting for me. And it's the man I despise—the man I can still taste in my fantasies—Declan Shaw.

tere-mere-beech-mein.title: Tere Mere Beech Mein
tere-mere-beech-mein.description: Kunal, ek disciplined lawyer, aur Ayesha, ek empathetic psychologist, ek psycho killer ke case ke chalte takraate hain. Is kahani me twist tab aata hai jab Kunal ka carefree bhai Dhruv, Ayesha se pyaar kar baithta hai, aur ek intense love triangle shuru hota hai. Kya pyaar in teeno ko unke dard aur trauma se ubhaar payega, ya sirf naya dard de jayega?

phobos.title: Phobos
phobos.description: Ellie is condemned to work alongside Phobos, Deimos, and Cupid on a Texas ranch, determined to win back their poisoned hearts. But as jealousy and passion flare in the tight quarters they share, Ellie spirals deeper into despair, entangled in tense encounters that push her to her limits—until an unexpected ally shifts the balance once again.

the-reckoning.title: The Reckoning
the-reckoning.description: The newest arrival at a care home for the elderly carries an air of mystery that even a jaded ex-World War 2 resistance fighter can’t resist trying to solve. Then matters take a sinister turn The Reckoning forms part of the Case Files series of short crime fiction stories from USA Today bestselling author Rachel Amphlett.

faith-unlocked-dukh-ke-sathi-shri-krishn.title: Faith Unlocked : Dukh Ke Sathi Shri Krishna
faith-unlocked-dukh-ke-sathi-shri-krishn.description: Life ke struggles mein kya aap khud ko akela pate hain? To aap galat ho skate hain kyu ki zindagi ki samsayaon mein aap akele nhi hain aur bhagwan har kadam par aapko protect karte hain. Abhi suniye ye khas show aur janiye ki kaise Bhagwan aapki life ki har samsaya mein nazar rakhte hain aur madad karte hain.

the-hookup-handbook.title: The Hookup Handbook
the-hookup-handbook.description: My love wand is on a strike. As bad as that blows pun unintended it’s 10 times worse for me. I’m a male escort but not just any escort I’m the escort. The one with a mile-long waiting list and a pristine reputation that’s very well-deserved. Only now I’m on hiatus. Because after years of pleasing women all over the city my man missile decides to get finicky. And the only woman he wants? Someone I can never have - my best friend’s younger sister the nerdy and awkwardly adorable Sienna. She’s working at the agency this summer keeping me organized handling paperwork and most importantly keeping me on track to finish writing my book about sex and intimacy which is due to my publisher in 30 days. She thinks I hate her that I don’t want her here. The truth is much more twisted. I get hard every time she walks into my office. Her wide blue eyes and pouty mouth drive me wild with desire and if she stays I’m not sure how much longer I can stay away from her. Little Miss Overachiever says she’s here to help? Fine. I’m going to put her nerdy curvy tush to work.

2025-mein-ai-se-paise-kamao.title: 2025 Mein AI Se Paise Kamao
2025-mein-ai-se-paise-kamao.description: 2025 ke end tak AI industry ek trillion dollar ka market banne wala hai. Par kya aap es revolutionary technology se paisa kamane ke secrets jaante hain? Ye show batayega proven strategies jo aapko ek normal insaan se successful AI entrepreneur bana sakti hain. Yeh show sirf theories nahi, real success stories aur practical steps ke through batayega ki kaise aap bhi es AI revolution ka hissa kaise ban sakte hain aur apni income kaise badha sakte hain?

torrid-little-affair.title: Torrid Little Affair
torrid-little-affair.description: The best way to get over someone is to get under someone else. And I have the perfect candidate all picked out. My new assistant is tempting beyond belief with her curvy body and take-no-shit attitude. All those luscious curves and a juicy ass I’m already in love with. God the things that I would do to that ass.... But it’s the haunted look in her eyes that speaks to me. Like she’s taken just as much shit in her past as I have - maybe more. We both deserve a little fun. Love can’t fix everything. Mind-blowing sex on the other hand? I have a feeling that might do the trick.

jhaadoowala-billionaire-4.title: Jhaadoowala Billionaire
jhaadoowala-billionaire-4.description: A Billionaire suddenly gets married to a ordinary girl. What will happen next? To know watch "Jhaadoowala Billionaire" only on Kuku TV

toxic-office-3.title: Toxic Office
toxic-office-3.description: A quiet maintenance guy hides a genius-level AI mind capable of saving an entire nation. Betrayed by his girlfriend and thrown out of the company he once protected, the world begins to crumble without him. Now, he rises from the shadows — not just to reclaim his legacy, but to unleash the ultimate revenge.

billionaire-bank-chor.title: Billionaire Bank Chor
billionaire-bank-chor.description: When billionaire Dharam Khurana loses everything—including the love of his life—in a tragic twist, he’s pushed to the edge. Desperate to save her, he storms into his own bank to withdraw his locked fortune, only to be branded a fraud. What begins as a simple plea for help turns into a high-stakes heist filled with humiliation, revenge, and redemption.

billionaire-ka-private-jet.title: Billionaire ka Private Jet
billionaire-ka-private-jet.description: A woman is humiliated for “not belonging” on a private jet. What no one knows is that the jet belongs to her brother. As arrogance meets reality, one revelation turns power, pride, and privilege upside down—proving that the biggest mistake was underestimating a billionaire.

my-unknown-husband.title: My Unknown Husband
my-unknown-husband.description: A newly divorced woman starts working as the PA to her strict boss — and soon, unexpected feelings begin to bloom. Between office drama, emotional twists, and a mysterious secret about her boss, things get delightfully complicated! Get ready for a breezy romantic ride filled with fun, love, and surprises — don’t miss it! 💕

her-beauty-and-his-love.title: Her Beauty And His Love
her-beauty-and-his-love.description:
Riya joins her dream college but faces humiliation from Aksha and Krish. From clashes in a project, love slowly blossoms, though Aksha’s jealousy creates hurdles. Riya transforms and gains confidence, while Krish realizes his true feelings.
In the end, the two unite in love..

sooryavanshi-the-forgotten-war-god.title: Sooryavanshi : The Forgotten War God
sooryavanshi-the-forgotten-war-god.description: Kabhi jo ek mahaan Yuddha Dev tha, aaj wahi Vikramaditya apni yaadashth kho kar shehar me survive karne ke liye struggle kar raha hai. Reema Lakhani uski zindagi ka eklauta sahaara hai, lekin apni doobti company ko bachane ke liye use Raval jaise aadmi ka saath chunna padta hai. Vikram uski madad karna toh chahta hai, par wo is sach se anjaan hai ki 3 saal pehle ek mahaayuddh me usne 4 buri shaktiyon ko hara diya tha… aur unme se sabse khatarnaak Vajra abhi bhi zinda hai aur use dhundh raha hai.

7-worst-purchases-you-make-in-your-20s.title: 7 Worst Purchases You Make in Your 20s
7-worst-purchases-you-make-in-your-20s.description: 7 Worst Purchases You Make in Your 20s is a reality check for young adults chasing trends and instant gratification. From flashy gadgets and expensive outfits to impulse buys that drain your savings, this episode uncovers the biggest money traps of your 20s. Learn how small choices can hurt your financial future and how to spend smarter instead. A must-watch for anyone who wants to save more and regret less!

ek-shaadi-aisi-bhi-1.title: Temporary Husband
ek-shaadi-aisi-bhi-1.description:
**Ek Shaadi Aisi Bhi** is a high-voltage romantic drama where a powerful businesswoman and a self-made, principled man enter into a fake marriage.
Caught between love, ego, class divide, and revenge, their values and loyalties are put to the test.
What begins as a contract marriage slowly transforms into a story of real love and justice.

delete-my-number-not-my-heart-1.title: Delete My Number, Not My Heart
delete-my-number-not-my-heart-1.description: Delete My Number, Not My Heart

fake-wife-3.title: Fake Wife
fake-wife-3.description: Dev Joshi, stuck in a contract marriage, devotes himself to Rati Kapoor, who never values him. Her heart remains with her first love, Avinash, aided by her scheming siblings Pooja and Prem. After Rati dismissively signs divorce papers, Dev leaves and rebuilds his life into a billionaire researcher. He finds true respect and affection with Shreya Rao, unlike the humiliation he endured with Rati. In the end, Dev rejects Rati’s late realization and chooses a dignified future with Shreya. Watch now.

billionaire-ka-ivf-ishq.title: Billionaire Ka IVF Ishq
billionaire-ka-ivf-ishq.description: Naira, heartbroken by betrayal and driven by her dying mother's wish, defiantly pursues independent motherhood through IVF. Simultaneously, reluctant heir Vikram Khanna, pressured to marry for his family's fortune, considers surrogacy, leading to Naira's unexpected selection. A comical misunderstanding evolves into an unconventional co-parenting agreement, complicated by Naira being Vikram's employee and having a loan from his company, which is mysteriously cleared. After being cruelly evicted, Vikram rescues Naira, bringing her to Khanna Mansion under a mysterious deal. There, she faces immediate class conflict with staff member Sophia but finds unexpected protection from Vikram and forms a bond with an enigmatic man, Tejas. Their IVF journey is abruptly shattered, and Naira's dying mother's last wish for a 'baby' prompts Vikram to announce their impending marriage, hinting at a contractual union. The narrative deepens with the introduction of Vikram's brother, Siddharth/Tejas, revealing a fierce sibling rivalry fueled by parental favoritism and competing affections for Naira. Corporate pressures and romantic entanglements create complex love triangles, with Vicky (Vikram) and Tejas clashing over Naira. A young boy, Abhir, appears, calling Vicky 'Papa,' and his mother, Sakshi, publicly claims Vicky as her husband, demanding inheritance, which Vicky vehemently denies. Despite this, Sakshi and Abhir move into the Khanna household, intensifying conflict with the matriarch, Sulekha, who accuses Naira of being a gold-digger. As Naira's pregnancy progresses, she faces threats, including an attempted murder by Vicky's manipulative mother and vengeful Sakshi, with Tejas emerging as her steadfast protector. Paternity fraud regarding Sakshi and Abhir is uncovered, and Vicky is critically wounded by a vengeful Nyra. In a climactic turn, pregnant Naira and Tejas overcome personal risks to donate blood, saving Vicky's life. This selfless act prompts Vicky's mother, Rekha, to reconcile, and Vicky confesses his past wrongdoings. The show culminates in a joyous celebration as Vicky and Naira welcome their baby girl, Pari, and Vicky proposes marriage, solidifying their commitment and marking a new beginning for the family.

business-breakdown.title: Business Breakdown
business-breakdown.description: 'Business Breakdown: Flipkart, Byju’s, Zerodha, Bounce & CCD' is an insightful show that dives deep into the stories behind India’s most talked-about startups and brands. It explores their rise, challenges, strategies, and turning points that defined their success or struggles. Each episode dissects one business, uncovering its business model, innovations, and market impact. The show blends storytelling with sharp analysis, making complex business journeys easy to grasp.

jail-return-ceo.title: Jail Return CEO
jail-return-ceo.description:
A privileged man, Abhay Kumar, is falsely imprisoned for a hit-and-run accident orchestrated by his own family.
After years of brutal injustice, he rebuilds his life from nothing and returns as a powerful entrepreneur.
Truth, betrayal, and redemption collide as Abhay exposes the real culprit and reclaims his dignity and identity.

final-bharosa-2.title: Final Bharosa
final-bharosa-2.description: When humble home kitchen owner Sunaina marries Shashvat, she doesn't know he's secretly billionaire Shashvat Ambani testing her genuine love. As she faces cruel humiliation from her son's in-laws and searches for her missing daughter Nishi, a shocking revelation emerges—Shashvat's adopted daughter Aanya is actually Nishi. Through trials of deception, family betrayal, and hidden identities, true love ultimately triumphs.

jhaadoowala-billionaire-3.title: Jhaadoowala Billionaire
jhaadoowala-billionaire-3.description: Neel Raichand, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Snehal, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

billionaire-hue-kangaal.title: Billionaire Hua Kangal
billionaire-hue-kangaal.description: Living off lies and loans, a show-off “billionaire” family sees its perfect world collapse when one card decline exposes their fake fortune—dragging them from ameeri to gareebi overnight.

law-of-love-3.title: Law of Love
law-of-love-3.description: A determined young woman battles betrayal, love, and family chaos while seeking justice for her imprisoned father. As her world collides with her legal aid’s ambition and deceit, buried secrets begin to surface. In a web of lies and emotions, every choice draws her closer to redemption—or ruin.

digital-arrest.title: Revenge of a Best Friend
digital-arrest.description: Revenge of a Best friend is a gripping cyber-thriller about a respected senior citizen who becomes the victim of a chilling digital scam involving deepfake videos, blackmail, and psychological imprisonment. As his life collapses in silence, his grandson uncovers a dark web of betrayal, exposing how technology can be used to destroy dignity, trust, and lives from within.

fake-wife-2.title: Fake Wife
fake-wife-2.description: Dev Joshi, stuck in a contract marriage, devotes himself to Rati Kapoor, who never values him. Her heart remains with her first love, Avinash, aided by her scheming siblings Pooja and Prem. After Rati dismissively signs divorce papers, Dev leaves and rebuilds his life into a billionaire researcher. He finds true respect and affection with Shreya Rao, unlike the humiliation he endured with Rati. In the end, Dev rejects Rati’s late realization and chooses a dignified future with Shreya. Watch now.

fake-wife-1.title: Fake Wife
fake-wife-1.description: రియా, దేవ్ ప్రేమించి పెళ్ళి చేసుకున్నారు. భర్తగా తన విలువ పెంచుకోవడం కోసం దేవ్ ఒక పని చేసాడు. ఆ పని వల్ల రియా జీవితంలో మార్పులు వచ్చాయి. దేవ్ ఏం చేసాడు? చూడండి "Fake Wife" మీ కుకు టీవీలో

pyaar-on-road.title: Pyaar on Road
pyaar-on-road.description: A street-smart Jaipur Uber driver Prakriti and gentle empire heir Akshay Middha can’t stand each other, until a forced contract marriage slowly turns dislike into love, and boardroom conspiracies, jealous Suhani, and drug-running cousin Tanmay turn their fake vows into a deadly war for power and the heart. Watch now!

aa-nimisham-1.title: Aa Nimisham
aa-nimisham-1.description: A young man’s life changes forever after a tragic accident draws him into a mysterious household. As secrets, lies, and hidden motives unfold, he must confront love, betrayal, and his own haunted past. Aa Nimisham is an emotional thriller where every moment holds a revelation — and nothing is as it seems.

her-beauty-his-love-1.title: Her Beauty, His Love
her-beauty-his-love-1.description:
Riya joins her dream college but faces humiliation from Aksha and Krish. From clashes in a project, love slowly blossoms, though Aksha’s jealousy creates hurdles. Riya transforms and gains confidence, while Krish realizes his true feelings.
In the end, the two unite in love.

love-me-if-you-dare-1.title: Love Me If You Dare
love-me-if-you-dare-1.description: Love me If You Dare is a powerful psychological drama that follows Navami, a young woman trapped between ambition and exploitation. Working in a resto pub, her life takes a dark turn when she encounters Abhinav, a charming yet controlling man whose obsession blurs the line between desire and dominance. As Navami faces harassment, betrayal, she struggles to reclaim her dignity and identity. Through pain and resilience, she transforms from a victim into a voice of strength.

mafias-prisoner.title: Mafia's Prisoner
mafias-prisoner.description: A fearless nurse is forced into marriage with a ruthless gangster who claims to love her, only to turn his obsession into her prison—until love, betrayal, and bloodshed push her to choose between freedom, revenge, and a man whose heart may not be where it belongs.

mafias-90-day-bride.title: Oops My Husband is Mafia Boss
mafias-90-day-bride.description: Sneha, a kind-hearted woman, lives peacefully until her brother’s accident leaves him needing ₹80 lakhs for surgery. Desperate, she meets Vikram Devraj, a ruthless mafia boss with a hidden past. He offers her a deal- marry him for a year in exchange for the money. Reluctantly, she agrees, but their cold contract turns into something deeper. When her ex-lover returns and Vikram’s enemies strike, Sneha’s world spirals into chaos ending in a shocking gunshot that changes everything.

commando-panthar.title: Commando Panther
commando-panthar.description: A decorated special forces commander, living incognito as a mechanic to escape his traumatic past, finds his secret life upended when he falls for a powerful CEO, forcing him to confront old enemies, a web of corporate conspiracies, and his own guilt to protect his new love and reclaim his destiny. Watch now.

love-me-if-you-dare.title: Love Me if You Dare
love-me-if-you-dare.description: Navmi, a principled waitress, is unjustly fired, igniting her fight against systemic power imbalances and forcing her into a high-end nightclub job to support her sister. There, she encounters the mysterious Abhay, later revealed as Abhinav Bhargav, her powerful CEO, sparking a complex relationship fueled by animosity and undeniable attraction. Abhinav manipulates Navmi's career aspirations, publicly humiliating her before forcing her into a 24/7 personal assistant role, hinting at a deeper, pre-existing connection and igniting a dramatic power struggle. Their tumultuous romance is fraught with external threats from jealous rivals like Disha and Neetha, who plot Navmi's downfall and expose Abhinav's hidden past. Navmi's trust in Abhinav is repeatedly tested by suspicions of infidelity, his evasiveness, and increasingly ruthless actions, even as he vows to protect her. Corporate challenges, including a threatened AI project, and personal vendettas intertwine, with Navmi saving Abhinav's company with an innovative app. However, their bond faces relentless targeting, leading to a devastating car crash that leaves Navmi gravely injured and a menacing villain declaring possessive love for her. Abhinav orchestrates violent confrontations to eliminate threats, but vengeful women from his past, particularly Lily, resurface, accusing him of abandonment and claiming he has children. Lily, revealed to be delusional and grieving a lost child, orchestrates a sinister trap involving an abandoned baby, accusing Abhinav of being a "child killer" due to his past cruelty. She seeks to inflict the same agony on Abhinav by targeting Navmi, leading to a violent confrontation where Abhinav shields Navmi from a gunshot. Lily then reveals Abhinav is the father of her child, Rosie, and vows eternal revenge even after her apprehension. The show culminates with Abhinav proposing to Navmi, but she delivers a devastating rejection, leaving their future uncertain amidst brewing family secrets and lingering threats.

chori-mein-mohabbat.title: Chori Mein Mohabbat
chori-mein-mohabbat.description:
This is the story of a fearless, street-smart thief Aishwarya, whose life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with Siddharth Raghuvanshi, the powerful heir of an underworld empire. What begins as a daring heist soon becomes a dangerous game of attraction, betrayal, and survival.
As Aishwarya’s sharp instincts clash with Siddharth’s authority, their chemistry turns electric — every glance charged with risk and desire. Between stolen money and stolen hearts, the line between love and crime starts to blur.
When a high-stakes robbery spirals out of control, both are forced to choose: trust their hearts or protect their secrets. In this world of deception and danger, one wrong move could cost them everything — even the love born from chaos.
At its core, Chori Mein Mohabbat is a passionate crime thriller — a story where romance ignites in the shadows of betrayal, and love itself becomes the ultimate heist.

law-of-love-1.title: Law of Love
law-of-love-1.description: A determined young woman battles betrayal, love, and family chaos while seeking justice for her imprisoned father. As her world collides with her legal aid’s ambition and deceit, buried secrets begin to surface. In a web of lies and emotions, every choice draws her closer to redemption—or ruin.

final-breath-4.title: Final Breath
final-breath-4.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous, fated love story of struggling entrepreneur Kartik Mehra and Aboni (also referred to as Avni), whose relationship is repeatedly tested by illness, betrayal, and manipulation. Initially, their love deepens with a proposal and unexpected pregnancy, but Aboni receives a devastating double diagnosis of infertility and terminal lung cancer. To protect Kartik from her illness and financial burden, Aboni self-sacrificingly pushes him away, feigning materialistic ambitions and abandoning him for the wealthy Rohan, leaving Kartik heartbroken. Unaware of her sacrifice, Kartik transforms into an ambitious CEO, determined to reclaim his empire and seek revenge for her perceived betrayal. He re-encounters Avni as an employee, asserting dominance and allowing his manipulative fiancée, Natasha, to humiliate and fire her. Avni's collapse reveals her grave illness, reawakening Kartik's buried feelings, yet he cruelly offers her a demeaning proposition. Avni endures systematic sabotage, public humiliations, and threats orchestrated by Natasha, who is driven by jealousy and class contempt, and whose family funds Kartik's empire. Amidst this, Kartik is forced into a strategic engagement with the manipulative heiress Tanuja, further complicating his relationship with Avni, who rejects money to leave him but accepts a mysterious agreement, causing Kartik heartbreak. Aboni, burdened by her terminal diagnosis, continues to push Kartik away, even demanding payment for an intimate night, a scheme orchestrated by Natasha. Kartik is compelled into a strategic marriage with Natasha, leading to Avni's public humiliation and denial at his engagement. Avni collapses at the engagement, confirming her severe lung cancer, which Natasha exploits by accusing Avni of faking her illness to manipulate Kartik. Despite his anger, Kartik grapples with profound pity and lingering affection as Avni's health deteriorates. Rohan, Avni's devoted protector, initially defends her, but Kartik later protects Avni from Rohan, whose actions become questionable. Kartik eventually uncovers Natasha's corporate betrayal, leading to the cancellation of their marriage. In a climactic turn, ruthless CEO Kartik orchestrates a corporate takeover and frantically searches for Avni, who is kidnapped and poisoned by Natasha, forcing Kartik into a contract marriage to save Avni's life. A poisoned Avni crashes Kartik and Natasha's wedding, leading to Natasha's dramatic arrest. Gravely ill, Aboni proposes marriage to Kartik, refusing medical treatment until he agrees, and through a spiritual invocation, she experiences a miraculous recovery. Their emotional reunion solidifies their powerful romantic bond, marking a new beginning free from the constraints of illness and past betrayals.

velaikkaran.title: Velaikaran
velaikkaran.description: அப்பாவின் சத்தியத்துக்காக தான் பணக்காரன் என்பதை மறைத்து சாதாரண மிடில் கிளாஸ்காரனாக தன் தங்கையை வளர்க்கிறான் அர்ஜுன். தங்கைக்காக தன் மானம், மரியாதை விட்டுக்கொடுத்து வேலைக்காரனாக தங்கையின் கணவர் வீட்டில் வேலை செய்யும் நிர்பந்தம் ஏற்படுகிறது. ஒருகட்டத்தில் தங்கையும், கணவரும் தான் வளர்த்த கம்பெனியிலேயே பித்தலாட்டம் செய்ய, என்ன முடிவெடுக்கிறான் அர்ஜுன் என்பதுதான் கதை.

the-richest-man-return-to-hometown.title: The Richest Man Return to Hometown
the-richest-man-return-to-hometown.description: The Richest Man Return to Hometown

the-shalini-show-season-2-manju-bhashini.title: The Shalini Show Season 2 - Manju Bhashini Jothe
the-shalini-show-season-2-manju-bhashini.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರು ಕನಸು. ತಾವು ಇಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸ್ಬೇಕು, ನೇಮು-ಫೇಮು ಗಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋರು ಕೆಲವೇ ಮಂದಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ಇಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಅವರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಪಾಠ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಾಧಕರ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ‌.. The Shalini Show Season 2! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರು ಆ್ಯಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. Watch Now!!

my-dream-girl.title: My Dream Girl
my-dream-girl.description: The microdrama opens with Sneha, a young woman grappling with fragmented memories of a drunken night, unknowingly entangled with the powerful CEO and doctor, Vansh Kapoor. Their paths cross unexpectedly when Sneha becomes his patient, creating a complex dynamic further complicated by another woman's possessive claim on Vansh. Simultaneously, Khushi, a spirited woman fending off her boss's advances, finds herself drawn to Vansh Kapoor, who steps in as her protector, sparking undeniable chemistry despite her existing relationship. Khushi later becomes burdened by debt and a desire for revenge against Vansh, leading to a manipulative "deal" with Krish, a charming and wealthy man who shows intense interest in her. As Khushi navigates a "side hustle" as a waitress, she repeatedly encounters Krish, their relationship marked by intense chemistry, his protective yet dominant nature, and her fierce independence, often clashing over past debts and unspoken obligations. A love triangle emerges between Khushi, Krish, and Vansh, with Krish confronting Khushi about her relationship with Vansh and demanding a choice. Khushi faces manipulative propositions from Akshat and persistent romantic advances from Krish, while battling a corrupt boss, Chris, whose corporate empire surprisingly depends on her. Vansh, a protective yet controlling figure, desperately seeks Khushi's forgiveness, but she remains guarded due to past hurts. Khushi endures violent abduction, only to be rescued by Ankit, who is also known as Vansh, and who unexpectedly proposes marriage. She rejects his proposal, revealing she had sought police help during a past distress call, not him, further complicating their bond as Ankit (Vansh) continues to exert a mysterious influence, offering help with chilling demands and exposing a corrupt manager. The narrative culminates as Vansh discovers Khushi hiding another man, revealing a significant deception in their budding relationship. Ultimately, Vansh and Khushi grapple with societal pressures and emotional distance, with Khushi fearing judgment and refusing Vansh's desire for intimacy. A heartbroken Vansh declares his intention to leave her life permanently, setting a condition for his return: Khushi must explicitly call him back. His unwavering devotion, expressed through a serenade, finally emboldens Khushi to confess her love, which Vansh fervently reciprocates, marking a significant milestone in their blossoming romance and overcoming their initial fears.

ultimate-love-1.title: Billionaire Beggar
ultimate-love-1.description: A powerful CEO, living undercover, becomes deeply entangled with Shreeja, a woman he once saved, whose life is in turmoil. Shreeja's world is shattered when her fiancé, Shekhar, publicly betrays her for her sister, Ananya, leaving her heartbroken and desperate to fulfill her dying grandmother's wish for marriage. The disguised CEO, known by various names including Suhas and Sharath, offers Shreeja a pragmatic, temporary marriage to save her family's honor, initiating an awkward cohabitation that gradually fosters a developing intimacy between them. Their unconventional union immediately faces intense class prejudice and family disapproval, with Shreeja and her husband enduring public humiliation from snobbish relatives like Sangita and rivals such as Shekhar, who mock their perceived poverty and disrupt their wedding preparations. This constant scorn and the threat to Shreeja's family honor raise the stakes for their fragile alliance. However, the CEO dramatically reveals his immense hidden wealth and true identity, often as the vanished CEO Suhas Pujari, turning the tables on his detractors and exposing their deceit. This revelation frequently involves displays of power, such as winning high-stakes wagers or acquiring prestigious properties, asserting his dominance over those who scorned them. Despite the initial deception and the contractual basis of their relationship, a genuine and profound romance blossoms between Shreeja and Suhas, as they navigate their complex feelings. Yet, Suhas's mysterious past, which includes a secret life as an undercover cop seeking vengeance for his parents' murder and orchestrating a ruthless illicit empire, causes Shreeja to feel deeply betrayed and question the very foundation of their bond. As a powerful adversary, often Suhas himself, vows retribution against those who wronged him or Shreeja, corporate power struggles and personal vendettas escalate, threatening their fragile happiness and exposing them to public scandal. Amidst this escalating turmoil and the constant threat of his past catching up, Suhas confesses his profound love to Shreeja. After navigating significant challenges and tests of commitment, including a unique agreement to meet only on their wedding day, they reaffirm their bond. Their journey culminates in a traditional marriage ceremony, promising a future together, albeit one still fraught with the consequences of his hidden truths, ongoing conflicts, and the lingering threat of his powerful enemies. The ultimate stakes involve their personal happiness, family honor, and the survival of Suhas's empire against relentless adversaries.

the-father-has-a-reverse-scale.title: The Father Has a Reverse Scale

law-of-love.title: Law of Love
law-of-love.description: A determined young woman battles betrayal, love, and family chaos while seeking justice for her imprisoned father. As her world collides with her legal aid’s ambition and deceit, buried secrets begin to surface. In a web of lies and emotions, every choice draws her closer to redemption—or ruin.

cricket-champion-3.title: Cricket Champion
cricket-champion-3.description: A mysterious "Phantom Shot" damages a cricket facility, initiating a search for its executor. Humble groundskeeper Sourav is initially identified by a young boy but dismissed due to prejudice, while player Mahendra falsely claims the shot, gaining captaincy and putting the team's beloved home ground at risk. A strong female leader, later revealed as a determined heiress and Madam, recognizes Sourav's unparalleled skill despite his public humiliation and vehement denials, believing he is the legendary "God of Cricket" and their only hope for victory. She relentlessly searches for him, convinced he saved her life and can rescue her family's cricket ground, even offering him a colossal sum to captain her team, which he rejects, fueling her suspicion. Mahendra, meanwhile, introduces Sourav as a beggar, linking his power to a mystical bat, which he violently steals, leading Sourav to claim his abilities were tied to the now-missing bat. The narrative further complicates Sourav's identity with the revelation of a long-lost twin brother and an operative undergoing identity-altering surgery to become "Sourav" for sabotage. One "Sourav" declares a "genetic anomaly" superpower, asserting himself as the "God of Cricket" by birth. The principled Sourav faces blackmail from Mr. Singh, whose actions cause his mother's severe accident, forcing Sourav into a high-stakes game to protect his family. This Sourav, also known as Vikram, is a former cricketer haunted by a past trauma, who rescues his mother from a menacing villain. A determined woman, Radha, shatters Vikram's decade-long guilt over his wife Anjali's death by revealing the true cause, sparking his journey towards redemption. Burdened by a colossal debt, Vikram is coerced into match-fixing by a ruthless figure under threat of death. However, he finds his true purpose and love with Radha, culminating in a heartfelt marriage proposal. Ultimately, Vikram, now a public figure, delivers an ultimatum to a dangerous individual, asserting control over his life and protecting his future with Radha, thereby securing his family's legacy and the endangered cricket ground. Through these trials, the protagonist ultimately reclaims his legacy, protects his loved ones, and secures his future in the world of cricket.

ek-mehenga-divorce.title: Ek Mehenga Divorce
ek-mehenga-divorce.description: The microdrama chronicles the devastating unraveling of Ashok and Malini's marriage, driven by Malini's insatiable materialism and her subsequent abandonment of Ashok and their young son, Arjun. A bitter divorce ensues, marked by Malini's false accusations of dowry harassment and domestic violence against Ashok, who vehemently denies them and pleads to save his family. The court rules unfavorably against Ashok, mandating exorbitant maintenance and separating him from his child, setting the stage for decades of suffering. Years later, young Arjun endures severe abuse, abandonment, and forced labor at the hands of Malini and her lover, Yash, while Ashok desperately searches for his son, battling a corrupt legal system and Malini's continued machinations, ultimately losing parental rights for eighteen years. As an adult, Dr. Arjun, a successful cardiologist, embarks on a quest to uncover the truth behind his father's disappearance and his mother's lies, unaware of the full extent of Malini's cruelty, which includes demanding money from Ashok even after falsely claiming Arjun's death. A dramatic twist unfolds when Ashok, burdened by guilt and a desire to die, volunteers for a perilous experimental medical procedure, unknowingly placing his life in the hands of his long-lost son, Dr. Arjun. Arjun begins to suspect his patient's true identity, noticing peculiar mannerisms and a birthmark, while Malini, aware of Ashok's presence, schemes to ensure his demise during the surgery to prevent the truth of their paternity from being revealed and to maintain control over Arjun. Arjun uncovers his mother's manipulative interference and attempts to halt the procedure, but Malini blackmails him with the revelation that Ashok is his biological father, jeopardizing his career. Despite Ashok's initial denial and attempts to escape, a DNA test confirms their father-son relationship, leading to a dramatic confrontation in the operating room where Arjun halts the surgery. Ultimately, Arjun learns that Ashok deliberately kept him estranged for two decades to protect him from Malini's ruthless schemes. Fueled by this revelation, Arjun initiates a comprehensive lawsuit against Malini for fraud, child abandonment, and abuse. Malini's accomplice, Yash, betrays her, and a video confession exposes their elaborate conspiracy to frame Ashok. With justice served, Ashok is exonerated, Malini and Yash are convicted, and Arjun and Ashok finally reunite, establishing a foundation to support victims of false legal cases, marking a poignant new beginning for the family.

breathe-with-you.title: Breathe With You
breathe-with-you.description: A love that defies fate and tests every heartbeat. When lies, betrayal, and a race against time strike, love becomes their only weapon to survive. A thrilling tale of passion, danger, and destiny—where 48 hours decide it all.

at-50-i-rise-through-my-daughters-status.title: At 50, I Rise Through My Daughter's Status

cricket-champion-2.title: Cricket Champion
cricket-champion-2.description: In the bustling streets of Mumbai, a humble groundskeeper hides a supernatural cricket strike known as the Phantom Shot. When greed and ambition expose his gift, betrayal and rivalry turn his life into a battlefield. But in the end, true power lies not in the bat—but in the man who dares to wield it.

poor-beggar-billionaire.title: Poor Beggar Billionaire
poor-beggar-billionaire.description: A powerful CEO, Anand, living undercover, falls for Sreejitha, but her engagement to Shekhar, driven by a dying wish, thwarts his plans. Shekhar publicly humiliates Sreejitha, breaking their engagement and revealing his intention to marry her sister, Ananthitha. Anand intervenes, proposing a contract marriage to save Sreejitha's family honor and fulfill her grandmother's wish. As they navigate this unexpected union, Sreejitha uncovers disturbing secrets about her past fiancé, while Anand, now often identified as Suraj, orchestrates their wedding with deeper motives. Sreejitha and Suraj face continuous public humiliation and class prejudice from her arrogant relatives and Shekhar, who mock her perceived low status and controversial marriage. Suraj, a defiant former CEO on the run, is banned from flights after challenging authority, forcing them into a fake marriage to appease Sreejitha's traditional mother. Amidst family celebrations, Suraj dramatically reveals his true, affluent status through grand gestures, countering the scorn. Their bond is tested by Suraj's sudden wealth, a missing engagement ring, and the shocking revelation that Sreejitha is his "old ex," exposing a complicated past. Their happiness is threatened by Sreejitha's ex-lover, Manik, who orchestrates violent attacks, gravely wounding Suraj. Despite his injuries, Suraj, revealed as a powerful CEO and crime lord, ruthlessly plans his rivals' downfall and insists on a strategic marriage. Their wedding plans are further disrupted by Suraj's mysterious contract, a cryptic warning, and Shekhar's public humiliation, usurping their venue. A dramatic intervention by Bijoy raises Suraj's suspicions about his true intentions. The conflict escalates as Suraj, later identified as Arjun, challenges Shekhar to a high-stakes auction, ultimately initiating a ruthless corporate takeover of Shekhar's company after Shekhar reneges on their wager. Arjun dramatically reveals his hidden identity as a powerful CEO, orchestrating corporate revenge for past wrongs against his wife. This leads to a confrontation where an antagonist attempts to expose him, resulting in her father's dismissal for corporate misconduct. Sreejitha grapples with profound betrayal as Arjun is exposed as a deceitful conman. He then reveals his true identity as an undercover police officer on a mission to avenge his murdered parents, leading to a heartbreaking struggle for trust. Despite their fractured past and lost trust, Arjun and Sreejitha reconcile and celebrate their union in a vibrant traditional Indian wedding, promising eternal devotion.

iruvar-1.title: Iruvar
iruvar-1.description:
இரட்டையர்களாகப் பிறந்த விக்ரம் மற்றும் மனோஜ்... ஆனா விதி அவர்கள் வாழ்க்கையை இரண்டு திசைகளில் தள்ளுகிறது.
பெரிய Business Man ஆக இருக்கும் பணக்கார விக்ரம், College-ல் Bullying-ல் மாட்டிக்கொண்ட பாவமான மனோஜ்.
கல்லூரியை தனது Control-ல் வைத்திருக்கும் Bully Gang-ன் தலைவி பிரியா, மனோஜ்-ஐ தாக்கியதால் அவன் உயிருக்கே போராடி கொண்டிருக்கிறான்.
தனது தம்பிக்காக பழிவாங்க மனோஜ்-ஐ போலவே காலேஜ்-ற்கு வரும் விக்ரம்......
அதிரடி, திருப்பம், திகில் நிறைந்த இந்த Revenge தொடரை இப்போதே பாருங்கள்!

bond-of-fate-2.title: Bond of Fate
bond-of-fate-2.description: ఒకరి మొహం మరొకరికి తెలియకుండా పెళ్ళి చేసుకుంటారా..? అలా చేసుకున్న సారా, విరాజ్ ల జీవితంలో ఎలాంటి మలుపులు కలిగాయి. తెలియాలంటే చూడండి "Bond of Fate" మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

returning-home-with-clothes-on-college-e.title: Returning home with clothes on college entrance
returning-home-with-clothes-on-college-e.description: The microdrama opens with Leo and his sister Lucy being exonerated from false accusations, establishing Leo as a national hero fiercely committed to protecting his sister, a commitment bolstered by influential allies Edwin and Davis. This fragile stability is immediately shattered by a ruthless blackmailer who possesses a recording of Lucy's assault, demanding Leo's submission and plunging him into a profound moral dilemma. In a heartbreaking turn, Lucy, unbeknownst to Leo, sacrifices her own well-being by aligning with the blackmailer and transferring money to him, driven by a desperate need to safeguard her family's honor. Unaware of his sister's profound sacrifice, Leo is consumed by a fierce vow of revenge against the blackmailer, setting him on a dangerous and potentially self-destructive path. Amidst this escalating personal crisis, Leo's volatile nature and protective instincts manifest in other dramatic confrontations. He violently clashes with the cynical groom Bharti at a chaotic wedding, fueled by accusations of fraud and threats against the bride, showcasing his readiness to fight for perceived justice. Later, Leo dramatically interrupts another wedding, desperately pleading with the silent bride, Didi, hinting at a profound, unresolved past involving a child, suggesting deeper personal stakes and a complex history beyond his immediate family. Concurrently, the self-made man Jack celebrates his success and transfers properties, but an unexpected intrusion by an officer foreshadows an impending crisis, hinting at broader societal pressures or legal entanglements that may intersect with Leo's escalating conflicts. The series explores the heavy cost of protecting loved ones, the secrets kept for honor, and the personal demons that drive a hero to the brink, as Leo navigates a world where his past and present collide, and the line between justice and revenge blurs, all while a larger societal crisis potentially looms.

hello-nannu-pelli-chesukuntaava.title: Hello Nannu Pelli Chesukuntaava
hello-nannu-pelli-chesukuntaava.description: The microdrama centers on Neil and Sneha, two individuals desperate to escape unwanted arranged marriages orchestrated by powerful families. Neil, a rebellious heir, defies his matriarch mother to avoid marrying heiress Sania Mehta, while orphan Sneha is publicly humiliated when her wealthy groom, Pulkit Joshi, abandons her. In a bid for dignity, Sneha proposes a contract marriage to a stranger, who is secretly Neil, also seeking to avoid his own forced union. Their marriage of convenience begins with Neil, a man of immense hidden wealth, orchestrating grand gestures for Sneha, who believes she is financially supporting him. This facade is challenged by confrontations with Sneha's past and Neil's concealed identity as the powerful CEO Mr. Raichand/Roychand, who becomes her boss and orchestrates preferential treatment. This favoritism leads to intense jealousy, accusations, and physical assaults against Sneha at her workplace, hinting at deeper conspiracies. Neil fiercely protects Sneha, retaliating against those who harm her, including Sania, whose obsession turns violent. Neil's family, particularly his mother Vimaleshwari/Sudha Raichand, vehemently opposes his secret marriage to Sneha, demanding annulment for corporate gain and attempting to force him into an arranged marriage with Sania. Neil is confined and threatened by his family, while Sneha is offered money to leave him, highlighting the immense class divide. A corporate deal even forces Sneha into a marriage with her obsessed ex-fiancé, Pulkit, from whom Neil dramatically rescues her. Despite Neil's pleas for reconciliation, Sneha initially proceeds with a divorce, believing their class divide is insurmountable. However, Sneha discovers she is secretly pregnant, a truth she fears will further entangle her with Neil's powerful family. After Neil is critically injured protecting Sneha during an ambush orchestrated by Sania, the pregnancy is revealed to his mother, and his father intervenes to secure the Raichand heir. Revived by the news, Neil publicly declares Sneha his wife and abandons his luxurious life for a humble existence with her. Their newfound domestic bliss is short-lived as Neil's formidable mother demands their return to the family mansion, citing business decline and offering Sneha conditional freedom, indicating their struggle for genuine love and independence against powerful family manipulation is far from over.

the-distance-between-the-cloud-and-the-s.title: The distance between the cloud and the sea
the-distance-between-the-cloud-and-the-s.description: The microdrama begins with Hazel initiating a divorce from Peter, believing he loves Alice, despite her own hidden heartbreak from their contract marriage. Peter indifferently accepts, while Alice returns and moves into their home, championed by Peter's manipulative sister, leading to Hazel enduring emotional and physical abuse. Despite desperate attempts to win Peter's affection, even risking her life, his cruel indifference pushes Hazel to vanish after a child's injury, leaving Peter frantic and confused. He receives divorce papers, initially vowing revenge, but his anger shifts to desperate concern as he searches for her, uncovering a mysterious file and facing a car crash. Peter then grapples with the revelation that his five-year marriage to Hazel was a manipulative contract orchestrated by his mother, Maa, who also pushed him towards Alice. Hazel, now a successful painter, asserts her independence, while Alice's dangerous ex-husband, Ruki, reappears, and Siddharth declares himself Hazel's new boyfriend. Hazel confronts Peter, revealing their marriage was a 'gratitude agreement' orchestrated by the Patriarch, and finds solace in a new relationship with Travis. Peter's family attempts to draw Hazel back, leading to public confrontations and corporate repercussions, with the Patriarch eventually punishing Peter's sister and brother for their actions against Hazel. Hazel seeks to sever all ties, repaying a final debt, but Peter desperately attempts to define love with her, only for their discussion to be violently interrupted by a sudden crash. Following a severe accident, Peter, now a powerful magnate, faces the chilling detachment of his former partner, Eva, while Alice endures a brutal betrayal and miscarriage. Peter challenges Hazel to win a coveted land plot, leading to a marriage proposal fraught with caveats about his love. Concurrently, Sara prepares for her wedding to Travis, but rejects his chillingly conditional proposal, while Hazel confronts a former lover burdened by regret, forcing her to choose between a second chance and a definitive goodbye, leaving her future uncertain.

final-breath-2.title: Final Breath
final-breath-2.description: A love that dared to defy fate…Avni, a simple girl whose anklet carries the sound of destiny. Kartik, a powerful yet broken CEO haunted by his past. When love turns into a game of lies, every smile hides a secret, and every promise comes with a price. Betrayal, poison, and only 48 hours to survive! Will love save them, or has destiny already written their end? Watch now!

billionaire-bichagaadu.title: Billionaire Bichagaadu
billionaire-bichagaadu.description: Srijitha, a kind-hearted woman, endures public humiliation and betrayal when her fiancé, Shekhar, abandons her for the arrogant Ananditha, shattering her dreams and her ailing grandmother's dying wish for her marriage. In a desperate attempt to fulfill her grandmother's wish, Srijitha enters a temporary, fake marriage with Sanjay, a mysterious stranger who intervened during her public shaming. Despite the initial awkwardness and pretense, their forced cohabitation and a traditional wedding ceremony unexpectedly bind them, sparking an undeniable attraction and hinting at a genuine connection. However, Sanjay, later identified as Subhendra, conceals his true identity as a wealthy CEO, leading to a web of mistaken identity and classist confrontations. Srijitha and Subhendra face repeated public humiliation and challenges from Shekhar, Ananditha, and Srijitha's snobbish relatives, who actively plot to sabotage their relationship and social standing. Subhendra consistently defends Srijitha, gradually revealing his hidden wealth and power, often dramatically turning the tables on their accusers and proving his worth and love despite his initial deception. The conflict escalates into a high-stakes corporate and personal rivalry between Subhendra and Shekhar, culminating in Subhendra systematically dismantling Shekhar's corporate empire, hinting at a long-planned revenge. Srijitha grapples with the complexities of Subhendra's hidden identity and deceptive actions, seeking solace and renewed self-worth through his empathetic support. Ultimately, Subhendra, now identified as Anirudh, confesses his true identity as an undercover cop on a mission to avenge his parents' murder, revealing the deeper, more dangerous stakes behind his actions. Despite Srijitha's initial heartbreak and rejection due to his deception, their unique love story, marked by traditional customs and a test of faith, culminates in a vibrant wedding ceremony, affirming their deep bond amidst the lingering complexities of trust and commitment. The show explores themes of class disparity, betrayal, revenge, mistaken identity, and the blossoming of genuine love amidst deception and societal prejudice.

cricket-champion.title: Cricket Champion
cricket-champion.description: A humble Mumbai groundskeeper, Sourav, secretly wields the legendary Phantom Shot, a mythical cricket strike that defies physics. Betrayal, stolen magic, and a fallen hero’s rise culminate as Sourav proves that divinity lies not in a bat, but in the man who holds it. Ultimately, the true Cricket Champion reclaims his destiny with quiet, unstoppable grace. Watch now.

beloved-darling-the-ceos-wife-and-genius.title: Beloved Darling: The CEO's Wife and Genius Baby
beloved-darling-the-ceos-wife-and-genius.description: Emily's life was irrevocably shattered when a devastating sacrifice for her mother led to betrayal and her mother's death, compounded by the ruthless theft of her newborn child, leaving her to believe the baby was stillborn. Five years later, Emily, now a successful designer, returns with a meticulously planned vendetta against Benson, the man she holds responsible for her past. Her path intertwines with powerful CEO Mihir, who is drawn to her, and she quickly rises in his company, confronting Priya, an executive who was instrumental in her child's theft. Simultaneously, Emily forms a deep, maternal bond with a runaway boy named Ben, who is Benson's son, unaware of their true connection. As Emily navigates a complex contract marriage with Benson, driven by his desire for a mother for Ben, the truth about her stolen child begins to surface, igniting a fierce custody battle with Diana, who has raised Ben. Investigations reveal Diana's manipulative plot to orchestrate Emily's false stillbirth report and claim Ben as her own. The shocking DNA results confirm Emily is Ben's biological mother and Benson is his father, exposing a long-buried past romance between them. This revelation shatters Benson's world and intensifies the conflict with Diana, who is revealed to be connected to Emily's biological father, Mr. Baker, a man who abandoned Emily's mother and later Emily herself. Further family secrets unravel with the suspicious death of Emily's mother, implicating Mrs. Lita, Diana's mother, and revealing a generational vendetta against Emily's family. Emily faces escalating threats, including a car crash and kidnapping attempts orchestrated by Diana, who is consumed by jealousy and a desire to claim Benson. Diana abducts Ben, leading to a dramatic confrontation where she seemingly perishes, only to miraculously reappear and form an unexpected, albeit manipulative, alliance with Emily. Amidst these revelations, Benson re-proposes to Emily, and a mysterious jade pendant unearths a shocking family secret, intertwining Benson's childhood accident with Emily's mother, suggesting their destinies were always connected. The show explores Emily's fight for justice, stolen motherhood, and the unraveling of deep-seated family conspiracies, all while navigating a complex romance and the lingering manipulations that threaten her newfound family.

fate-connection-2.title: Fate connection
fate-connection-2.description: Sara enters an arranged marriage, only to be immediately abandoned by her enigmatic husband, Virat, who leaves for six months. Determined to forge her own path, Sara secures a job at Kapoor Enterprises, where she encounters her new boss, Virat Kapoor, feeling an inexplicable connection despite his ruthless reputation. Unbeknownst to Sara, her new boss is her estranged husband, a fact revealed to Virat when his grandfather demands he reconcile with "Sara Dikshit." As Virat attempts to win back his wife, he seeks advice from his assistant, Sara, leading to an unexpected closeness and a burgeoning, forbidden attraction. Sara, meanwhile, grapples with her unresolved marriage and her growing feelings for her seemingly married boss. The situation is further complicated by a malicious colleague's attempts to sabotage Sara's career, forcing Viraj to publicly defend her, and his manipulative aunt's schemes to control his life and eliminate Sara. Eventually, Sara discovers her CEO, Viraj, is indeed her estranged husband, leading to profound feelings of betrayal and accusations of calculated deception. Their complicated divorce proceedings are repeatedly delayed, forcing them to confront their true feelings amidst corporate power struggles and societal judgment. Sara faces multiple accidents, during which Viraj displays intense protectiveness, blurring the lines between duty and love. Sara's grandfather, who initially pressured her into the marriage, encourages her independence and later suggests a reunion with Viraj is destiny's second chance. Viraj confesses his long-held feelings, explaining his past abandonment and current manipulation stemmed from misunderstandings about her fidelity and his initial reluctance for a forced marriage. Despite her deep pain and distrust, a reconciliation occurs, with both committing to transparency and a second chance at their fated love.

the-distance-between-the-cloud-and-sea.title: The Distance Between The Cloud And Sea
the-distance-between-the-cloud-and-sea.description: Aradhya endures years in a fractured marriage to Arjun, feeling replaced by his former love, Tanisha, and ultimately decides to divorce him to reclaim her dreams. Her departure from her in-laws' home ignites fiery confrontations with her sister-in-law, Nikki, who actively tries to replace Aradhya with Tanisha, leading to public humiliation and physical assault. Arjun openly prioritizes Tanisha, even striking Aradhya, solidifying Aradhya's resolve for independence from the toxic marriage. Aradhya then vanishes, secretly dissolving their marriage, which Arjun later discovers was a five-year "gratitude contract." This profound deception, coupled with Tanisha's mysterious injury, initially fuels Arjun's protective fury and suspicion towards Aradhya. However, Aradhya re-emerges as an empowered artist, having abandoned previous partners to reclaim her identity, and finds new love and support with Kabir or Siddharth. She confronts Arjun, rejecting his possessiveness and revealing their marriage was a manipulative contractual arrangement orchestrated by his mother, Mrs. Malhotra. Aradhya, supported by her new partner, defiantly repays her debt to the Malhotra family with interest, declaring her freedom. Kabir severs all ties with the Malhotra family, causing their empire to collapse due to an insult to Aradhya, leading Arjun to uncover his mother's manipulative plot and realize he has lost everything. Arjun's formidable patriarch father disinherits him, stripping him of his corporate title and wealth due to his romantic entanglements. Despite Arjun's desperate attempts to reconcile, even after a devastating car crash, Aradhya fiercely rejects him, citing his pattern of involving other women. She reveals she returned under a contract orchestrated by his mother and has found genuine love elsewhere. Meanwhile, Nandu uncovers Tanisha's tragic past, including a miscarriage and abandonment by Aditya, hinting at a mysterious connection to Arjun. The show ultimately depicts Aradhya's journey of self-liberation and reclaiming her dignity amidst betrayal, manipulation, and the dramatic downfall of a powerful family.

golden-son-buried-alive-for-20-years-1.description: Adopted son Gautham risks 20 years of his life. He gave everything to be called a brother… then why did the Mahendran sisters turn cold? And why must he sleep for 20 years? Watch now to find out.

nalayak-billionaire-pati.title: Nalayak Billionaire Pati
nalayak-billionaire-pati.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous and ultimately destructive marriage of Raghav and Neha, initially marked by animosity and Raghav's secret double life to protect his family. Their relationship quickly deteriorates amidst suspicions of infidelity, public humiliations, and the sinister manipulation of the powerful Vikram, who uses Neha as collateral in high-stakes games. Neha's relentless challenges and Raghav's desire to reclaim his pride lead to perilous bets, culminating in a devastating loss for Raghav's family. The marriage dramatically collapses when Neha confesses her affair and love for Vikram, leading to a painful divorce, false accusations against Raghav, and the loss of his family. Consumed by betrayal, Raghav vows retribution, embarking on a calculated plan to dismantle Neha and Vikram's lives by ascending to a powerful corporate position. Raghav dramatically resurfaces as the CEO of Kapoor Hotels, transforming their personal conflict into a bitter corporate power struggle. Amidst this, shocking revelations emerge: Raghav is secretly married to both Neha and Ananya, exposing a complex web of bigamy and betrayal. Neha, now pregnant, publicly humiliates Raghav, accusing him of impersonation and cruelly revealing she prevented him from seeing his dying mother. Vikram, scorned and vengeful, vows to destroy Raghav's empire, while Raghav faces brutal attacks and arrests, shielded by loyal allies like Kriti. The conflict escalates into a brutal personal vendetta, with Raghav losing his empire to Vikram and both men resorting to kidnapping each other's families. Neha orchestrates a ruthless plot against Raghav, falsely accusing him of heinous crimes, revealing their unborn child is Vikram's, and attempting to murder him to acquire his property. Ultimately, Raghav's son, Aryan, confronts his 'devil' mother, leading to Neha's dramatic downfall, public penance, and the stark consequences of her betrayals. The series explores themes of love, betrayal, revenge, and the devastating impact of ambition and deceit on family and personal honor.

dirty-little-promise.title: Dirty Little Promise
dirty-little-promise.description: Conflicted in the depth of her feelings for bad boy Gavin Kingsley lonely librarian Emma Bell knows he's all wrong for her - yet the heart wants what it wants. But if she gives into his dark erotic desires will she lose herself completely? Passion drama and suspense combine in the highly-anticipated conclusion to Emma Bell's love affair with the alpha and enigmatic Kingsley brothers. Secrets will be exposed sides will be chosen and nothing will ever be the same.

Rozana-Angrezi--रोज़-सीखो-English-कहीं-भ.title: Rozana Angrezi : रोज़ सीखो English, कहीं भी, कभी भी!
Rozana-Angrezi--रोज़-सीखो-English-कहीं-भ.description:
"Acchi English sirf ek skill nahi, opportunity ka passport hai!"
Doston, English sikhne ka tension ab khatam hua! Roz sirf 15 minute do, aur practical English bolna seekho - bilkul apni Hindi ki tarah farratedar. Interview ho ya office life, shopping ho ya traveling - har situation mein English confidently bolna ab aapke haath mein hai.
Start your English journey today with 'Rozana Angrezi: रोज़ सीखो English, कहीं भी, कभी भी!'"

the-bedroom-experiment.title: The Bedroom Experiment
the-bedroom-experiment.description: When your stepbrother is a hot hockey stud with more notches in his bedpost than well anyone he’s the perfect candidate to help you gain a little bedroom experience. At least that's my plan this V-day.... Note: This is a hot and steamy low-drama standalone short story. Contents include: One sweet but rough-around-the-edges hockey player who’s going a little crazy. One blunt knows-what-she-wants heroine who picks through his self-defense. No cheating. No angst. No stress. And a sweet melty HEA.

a-botanists-guide-to-parties-and-poisons.title: A Botanist's Guide to Parties and Poisons
a-botanists-guide-to-parties-and-poisons.description: London 1923. Newly minted research assistant Saffron Everleigh is the first woman to hold the position at University College of London. When she attends a dinner party for the school she expects to engage in conversations about the university's large expedition to the Amazon. What she doesn’t expect is for Mrs. Henry one of the professors’ wives to drop to the floor poisoned by an unknown toxin.  Dr. Maxwell Saffron’s mentor is the main suspect and evidence quickly mounts. Joined by flirtatious fellow researcher Alexander Ashton Saffron uses her knowledge of botany as she explores steamy greenhouses dark gardens and deadly poisons to clear Maxwell's name.  Will she be able to uncover the truth or will her investigation land her on the murderer’s list?  In this entertaining examination of society’s expectations debut author Kate Khavari deftly sheds a light on the struggles of women in a male-dominated field wrapped in mystery and murder.

ashok-bhadoriya-a-nightmare-for-dacoits.title: Ashok Bhadoriya : A Nightmare for Dacoits
ashok-bhadoriya-a-nightmare-for-dacoits.description: Chambal ka sabse khatarnak aur brave police officer 'Ashok Bhadoriya' ki kahani jaante hain aap? Ek aisa police officer jisne 116 encounters karke apna naam itihaas mein darj karwa diya hai. Par eske badle mein Ashok ne kya khoya? Ye kahani batai hai ki har encounter ke peeche ek tragedy chupi hai - chahe woh police wale ki ho ya phir dakoo ki. Ashok Ek aisa hero tha, jo criminals se to jeet gaya, par system se haar gaya. System ne aisa kya karwaya es bahadur officer se jise usne apni haar maan liya? Aise kai sawal aur chambal ki dhahlane wali ghatanon ke beech se gujarta ye show aap sunna shuru karenge to end tak sunenge.

one-night-with-you-wie-alles-begann.title: One Night With You
one-night-with-you-wie-alles-begann.description: Wie kam es zu diesem unvergesslichen One-Night-Stand zwischen Sam Holland und Nick Cappuano von dem sechs Jahre später in Fatal Affair zu lesen ist? Was ist passiert als Sam und Nick das erste Mal aufeinander trafen - und ihre erste gemeinsame Nacht miteinander verbrachten? One Night with You erzählt die Geschichte ihrer ersten schicksalhaften Begegnung und dem leidenschaftlichen Feuer das vom ersten Moment an zwischen ihnen aufloderte und seither nie verebbte. Einer Geschichte über die Verbundenheit zweier Menschen die sich zuvor fremd waren. One Night with You verrät alle Details alle prickelnden heißen und romantischen Details. Und erzählt vor allem von einem: Einer Liebe die nicht nur zwei Körper eint sondern auch ihre Seelen. Please note: This audiobook is in German.

dirty-cravings.title: Dirty Cravings
dirty-cravings.description: Kazimir and Emily hunt for a traitor in Italy. Constant threats lurk in the shadows. The more puzzle pieces they discover the more their reality unravels. Dark and deeply erotic this high-octane romance will lure you into a mystery with deadly twists and turns.

insane-insaan.title: Insane Insaan
insane-insaan.description: Raghav ek fateechar middle-class ladka , jiska dil toda uski girlfriend - ek ameer baap ki bigdi beti Advika ne . Lekin fir hua kuch aisa jisne badal daali uski taqdeer. Jail ki salakhon ke peeche mila ek aisa chamatkari locket jiske baad khulne lagi Raghav ki qismat aur fir shuru hua uske farsh se arsh tak ka safar. Kya raghav is locket ki shaktiyon ka sahi istemal kar payega , ya fir ye paheli aur ulajh jayegi?  Kya is baar bhi ye baaji Advika jeet jayegi ya fir Raghav karega kuchh aisa jo sabke hosh udaa dega ?

perfect-and-powerful.title: Perfect and Powerful
perfect-and-powerful.description: Ruby can’t stand lead violinist Jonathan most of the time but she agrees to play his girlfriend at a party so he can fend off a stalker-ish fan. The only problem is that over the course of the night she discovers Jon’s an amazing dancer—and an even better kisser. When she’s in his arms, he’s so passionate and forceful and so unapologetically in command that she forgets how much he irritates her. He’s always a strict taskmaster during rehearsals and concerts but maybe that translates into something more fun in the bedroom. With Ethan’s support and encouragement Ruby decides to find out…

sex-machine.title: Sex Machine
sex-machine.description: Honey Carmichael has never understood what all the hoopla is about when it comes to men and she’s out to change that with the one man in town known for his ability to get the job done. Blake Dempsey is happy to help Honey with her “problem” as long as she knows he’s only interested in one thing. His heart was broken when his high-school girlfriend was killed in the car he was driving and he has nothing to offer other than fun. That’s just fine with Honey until that fantastic fun isn't enough anymore for either of them. Unexpected feelings result in a messy entanglement—and that most definitely wasn’t in the plans. But you know what they say about plans?

shrapit-sannata.title: Shrapit Sannata
shrapit-sannata.description: Journalist Meera Desai apne dukhon se door bhaagne ke liye Devli gaon pahuchti hai, par wahan ek khaufnaak raaz ka saamna karti hai—ek parivaarik shraap jo ek purani, badla lene wali devi se juda hai. Jaise-jaise ajeeb rasmein aur anjaani awaazen use apni taraf kheechegi, Meera ko ek sadiyon purane dhokhe ko samajhna hoga aur apne parivaar ki sacchai ka samna karna hoga. Kya Meera khud ko bacha payegi ya shraap todne ke liye apna sab kuch gawa degi?

rapturous.title: Rapturous
rapturous.description: It's Oscar night and Academy Award-winning director Hayden Roth spontaneously kisses the woman he desires above all others even though he knows she can never be his. Addison York craves her boss's best friend Hayden but he has never given her an ounce of encouragement—until tonight when he kissed her after winning the Oscar. Was that kiss the start of something or another in a long line of frustrations where Hayden is concerned? Something is keeping him from acting on the attraction that simmers between them and Addie is determined to find out what it is. But when Addie stumbles upon the secret that Hayden Flynn and her other close friends have kept from her will she allow hurt feelings to get in the way of true love? When Hayden won't share his BDSM lifestyle with her Addie decides to conduct her own research. Will she be intrigued or repulsed? And what will Hayden do when he finds out how she's been spending her evenings?

kalinjar-ka-rahasya.title: Shaapit Khajana: Kalinjer Qile Ka Darawna Rehasya
kalinjar-ka-rahasya.description: Kalinjar fort - Bharat ke sabse rahasyamay qilon mein se ek, jahan Chandela rajvansh ne tantrik shaktiyon ko saadha aur apne samrajya ko hazaron saal tak amar banaye rakha. Ye show aapko batayega ki kya sach mein fort ke andar kai raz chipe hain? Kya sach mein tantra vidya aaj bhi Kalinjar fort mein mehsoos hoti hai? Es qile ko kab banaya gaya? Ye qila kyon khabaron mein raha? Aur sath hi aap janenge prachin Bharat ke sabse powerful rajvansh ke untold secrets.

never-turn-back.title: Never Turn Back
never-turn-back.description: The bonds of family never truly let go. In fact its grip only tightens the further you try to run: crushing and crippling. Ethan Faulkner is a precocious child with a brilliant but troublesome sister a war vet for a father and a weary mother trying to manage their family. One night a young woman rings their doorbell desperate to hide from two men who are pursuing her when one of the two barges in after her. The struggle leaves both of Ethan's parents dead. Years later Ethan has a successful teaching career and a budding relationship with a coworker. But he hasn't quite followed through on his promise to his dying father—to take care of his sister. Susannah is not an easy person to keep tabs on is a handful even when the tabs are kept and quite frankly Ethan wants her to suffer for preventing him from getting to his dad before he died all those years ago. It was a long time ago and Ethan tries to put all of it behind him. But that's easier said than done. When news of a brutal murder breaks with evidence pointing to Ethan as the prime suspect all the painful memories of his past come rushing to meet him. Lyrically conveyed with emotion and nuance Never Turn Back is a powerful story about family vengeance and how some actions echo through the years with irreparable consequences.

escape-the-country-of-the-blind.title: Escape: The Country of the Blind
escape-the-country-of-the-blind.description: A mountain guide finds a hidden valley where no-one has eyes. However, the blind think that he is deformed. Zebarra is a mining engineer in Ecuador near the towering Andes. Up until a year ago his chief sport was mountaineering. His last climb was an attempt to climb the remote and forbidding peak of Parascotopetl-the 20000-foot crag unconquered by man. It is unconquered still. 3000 feet from the icy summit his party turned back and fled for their lives all escaping except for one a guide named Nunez who slipped and fell over the precipice disappearing into the vast chasm which yearned 10000-feet beneath them. The horror of him falling has haunted Zebarra’s dreams for years and because of it he has forsaken climbing for the rest of his life even though today he has seen Nunez.

the-maverick-effect-the-inside-story-of-.title: The Maverick Effect : The Inside Story of India's IT Revolution
the-maverick-effect-the-inside-story-of-.description:
Why you will love this audiobook: A true story of big dreams and determination that made India a global IT powerhouse!
Ye inspiring kahani hai India ke IT revolution ki, ek aisa revolution jiski shuruaat ek sapne se hui. Janiye kaise visionaries ne $200 billion ka industry banakar million logon ki zindagi badal di. Real struggles, bold decisions aur groundbreaking success se bhari yeh audiobook aapko bada sochne ke liye inspire karegi. Yeh sirf history nahi, apna revolution create karne ka blueprint hai!

dragnet-big-present.title: Dragnet: Big Present
dragnet-big-present.description: In the past two months a thief has broken in to eighteen markets in Los Angeles. There is no lead to his whereabouts and no clue to his identity.

the-bishops-bedroom.title: The Bishop's Bedroom
the-bishops-bedroom.description: Summer 1946. World War II has just come to an end and there’s a yearning for renewal. A man in his thirties is sailing on Lake Maggiore in northern Italy hoping to put off the inevitable return to work. Dropping anchor in a small fashionable port he meets the enigmatic owner of a nearby villa who invites him home for dinner with his older wife and beautiful widowed sister-in-law. The sailor is intrigued by the elegant waterside mansion staffed with servants and imbued with mystery and stays in a guest room previously occupied by a now-deceased bishop related to his host. The two men form an uneasy bond recognizing in each other a shared taste for idling and erotic adventure. They soon set sail together encountering old flames and making new conquests. But tragedy puts an abrupt halt to their revels and shatters the tranquility of the villa. What really happened on the dock? And who was the figure glimpsed cycling around the shore in the dark?

devils-honeymoon.title: Devil's Honeymoon
devils-honeymoon.description: Apne hi suhagrat par, jab Ishita pyaar ka sapna sanjo rahi thi, uski duniya tab ulat gayi jab Aarav – uska pati, usi ki jaan ke peeche pad gaya. Sachayi khul kar saamne aayi ki Aarav, us aurat ka beta hai jiska affair Ishita ke papa ke saath tha. Par sawaal ye hai, itne saalon baad Aarav Ishita ki zindagi mein kyun laut kar aaya? Aur kyun uski jaan lena chahta hai? Ishita ke pyar aur badle ke is tufan ka anjaam kya hoga?

zathura.title: Zathura
zathura.description: On the last page of the Caldecott-winning book Jumanji young Danny Budwing is seen running after his brother Walter with a game tucked under his arm. Now twenty years later Chris Van Allsburg is ready to reveal what happened when Danny and Walter rolled the dice. This time the name of the game is Zathura and the battling Budwing boys are in for the ride of their lives. Soon Zathura unleashes intergalactic challenges that require the quarreling brothers to learn how to work together as a team.

the-color-of-justice.title: The Color of Justice
the-color-of-justice.description:
1964: Justice Mississippi is a town divided. When attorney Coop Lindsay agrees to defend a black man accused of murdering a white teenager, the bribes and death threats don't intimidate him. As he prepares for the case of a lifetime, the young lawyer knows that innocent or guilty, he will no longer be welcome in Justice. 
2014: To some the result of the trial still feels like a fresh wound, even fifty years later when Coop's grandson arrives in Justice seeking answers to the questions unresolved by the trial that changed his family's legacy. When a new case is presented again pitting white against black this third generation Lindsay may have the opportunity he needs to right the wrongs of the past.

haunted-mound.title: Haunted Mound
haunted-mound.description: Group trip pe gaye Aryan aur uske friends ke hosh tab udd gye jab ek raat ko unke friend ka kisi ne guest house mein qatl kar diya. Jab Anshul ne kisi aatma ko mantro ki shaktiyon se bulaya to unhen pata chala unke hi friend Pratik ne  ek haunted mound ko khod diya hai jisase barson se soya Vampire jaag gya hai jo ab unn sabke khoon ka pyasa ho chuka hai. Aakhir kaise niptenge wo sab uss vampire se? Aur Pratik ne kyon khoda tha wo Shaitani Tila?

brave-the-heat.title: Brave the Heat
brave-the-heat.description: Fire Chief Gavin Maguire's past reignites when Jordan McKenna returns to Old Brookfield, her own life marked by heartbreak and missed dreams. But as suspicious fires erupt around town, they soon realize the sparks between them are far from the most dangerous thing they’ll face.

readymade-dulha.title: Readymade Dulha
