readymade-dulha.description: Abhira Kapoor, ek secret agent jo "Black Panther" ke naam se jaani jaati hai, apni maa se nafrat karti hai kyunki unhone bachpan mein usse chhod diya tha kissi aur keliye. Shaadi ke khilaf Abhira ki life mein twist tab aata hai jab uski contract marriage Rudraksh se hoti hai, jo asal mein ek Rajkumar aur number 1 company ka malik hai. Abhira ko apni maa ke raaz aur ek fauji (uske asli pita) se judi dangerous mission par jaana hai. Kya Abhira aur Rudraksh milkar desh ko bacha paayenge aur zindagi ke bade raaz suljha paayenge?

visthaapana-vidhwamsam.title: విస్థాపన - విధ్వంసం
visthaapana-vidhwamsam.description: ఊర్లకు ఊర్లు ఖాళీ చేయాల్సి రావడం ప్రజలకు జరుగుతున్న నష్టానికి వారికి లభిస్తున్న పరిహారానికి పొంతన లేకపోవడం పునరావాసమనేదే చట్టంలో ఇప్పటికీ ఒక హక్కుగా లేకపోవడం ప్రజల అసంతృప్తి ఉద్యమంగా మారినప్పుడు దానిని కఠినంగా అణిచివేయాలని చూడడం... ఇవన్నీ గత 20, 30 ఏళ్లులో అనేకచోట్ల చూశాం. ఇంకా చూస్తూనే ఉన్నాం. కంపెనీలకు వచ్చే లాభాన్ని , వారి అభివృద్ధిని 'దేశం అభివృద్ధి' గానో , 'రాష్ట్ర అభివృద్ధి' గానో పిలిచేవారు నిర్వాసితులయ్యే వేలాది ప్రజలకు కలిగే నష్టాన్ని దేశం నష్టంగానూ , రాష్ట్ర నష్టంగానూ భావించి దేశం లేక రాష్ట్రం దానిని భరించాలని ఎందుకు అడగరు? అటువంటి చట్టం గానీ విధానం గానీ దేశంలో ఎందుకు లేదని ఎందుకు అడగరు ఉన్నవాళ్ల అభివృద్ధి కోసం లేనివాళ్లు పూర్తిగా పతనం అయ్యే ప్రగతిని మనం ఎందుకు అంగీకరించాలి?

bhinna-sandarbhaalu.title: భిన్న సందర్భాలు
bhinna-sandarbhaalu.description: నా ఈ శరీరం నాది కాదా? దీని మీద అధికారం నాది కాదా? దీని మీద హక్కు నాకు లేదా అని నా ఆత్మ అరిచే అరుపులను విననట్లు, అవి వినపడనట్లు కూచోటం నా చేత కావటం లేదు. నేనెక్కడ పరాయిదాన్ని కానో, ఎక్కడ నాకూ, నా ఆలోచనలకూ గౌరవం దొరుకుతుందో ఆ చోటుని వెదుక్కుంటూ వెళ్ళాలి. ఆ చోటు ఎక్కడా లేదని వీళ్ళు చెప్పే మాటలు నేను నమ్మను ఒక వేళ ఇంతవరకూ ఆ చోటు ఎక్కడా లేకపోతే నేను సృష్టిస్తాను. ఆడది కేవలం పిల్లల్ని మాత్రమే సృష్టిస్తుందనుకునే వాళ్ళ కళ్ళు తెరిపించేలా నేను కొత్త ఆలోచనలనూ, కొత్త చోటునూ సృష్టిస్తాను." అంటారు ఓల్గా.

kaliyug-ka-curse.title: Curse Of Kaliyug
kaliyug-ka-curse.description: Baadalpur—ek shapit gaon jahan har Surya Grahan maut ka paigam ban jaata hai. Is gaon ke log sirf ek shraap se nahi, ek kaale rahasya se bhi qaidi hain jo Kaliyug ke ant aur Kalki ke janm se juda hai. Vishnu aur Saloni, jo apne parivaar ke maut ke raaz dhoondhne aaye hain, unka saamna hota hai Rahu-Ketu se. Kya woh milkar is shapit gaon ko azaadi dilayenge ya is rahasya ka hissa ban jaayenge?

alai-osai.title: Alai Osai
alai-osai.description: "Alai Osai" is a renowned novel by Kalki, set against the backdrop of India's Partition. It vividly portrays the emotional struggles and hardships faced by people displaced during this historical event. The novel, which won the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1956, is considered one of the key works in Tamil literature for its poignant depiction of Partition

cherar-kottai-2.title: சேரர் கோட்டை - 2
cherar-kottai-2.description: பத்தாம் நூற்றாண்டின் பிற்பகுதி. புதிய சோழ மன்னராகப் பொறுப்பேற்றிருக்கும் இராஜராஜ சோழரின் ஆணையின் பேரில் துறைமுகப் பட்டினமான நாகையி லிருந்து பரமன் மழபாடி எனும் சோழப் படைவீரரும் கம்பன் மணியன் எனும் சேனானி நாயகமும் இராஜாங்க ஓலைகளோடு கன்னியாகுமரிக்குச் செல்கின்றனர். தாங்கள் எத்தனை பெரிய அரும்பணிக்குத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்டி ருக்கிறோம் என்பதையோ தங்களின் கடந்த காலங்கள் எவ்வாறு எடுத்த காரியத்துடன் சிக்கலான முறையில் பின்னிப் பிணைந்துள்ளன என்பதையோ அறியாமல் பயணப்படும் இரண்டு கதாநாயகர்களும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் மகத்தான அனுபவங்களும் அறைகூவல்களுமாய் விரியும் இந்தப் புதினம், வரலாற்றில் காந்தளூர்ச் சாலை கலமறுத்தல் என்கிற பெயரால் குறிப்பிடப்படும் நிகழ்வை மையமாகக் கொண்டு புனையப்பட்டுள்ளது.

vada-paav-wali-kavya.title: Vada Paav Wali Kavya
vada-paav-wali-kavya.description: School me hamesha soti rehne waali Kavya school - Topper bhi hai. Saare students surprised hain ki aakhir Kavya top kaise kar leti hai? Shaam me sheher ke ek kone me vada paav bechne wali Kavya ka raaz kisi ko nahin pata Lekin ek din Usse uska jeene ka sahara, Vada paav stall hi chhin jata hai... Aakhir kya karegi ab Kavya? Kya hoga jab uske stall ka raaz sabke saamne aa jaayega? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye "Vada Paav Wali Kavya"

natchathira-vaasigal.title: நட்சத்திரவாசிகள்
natchathira-vaasigal.description: IT Company'யில் வேலை செய்யும் Techies பற்றிய Modern Age கதை இது. அவர்கள் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையில் நடக்கும் சிக்கல் நிறைந்த சுவாரஸ்ய சம்பவங்களை கேட்கலாம் வாங்க!

poi-maan-karadu.title: பொய்மான் கரடு
poi-maan-karadu.description: கல்கியின் தலைச்சிறந்த த்ரில்லர் கதை, ‘பொய் மான் கரடு’. சேலம் ஜில்லாவில் உள்ள பொய் மான் கரடு எனும் இடத்தில் ஒரு கொலை நடக்கிறது. அந்தக் கொலையாளி யார், யார் கொலையுண்டார்கள் போன்ற கேள்விகளுக்கு அவருக்கே உரித்த பாணியில் எழுதியுள்ள ஒரு சுவாரஸ்யமான கதை.

the-phantom-judge.title: The Phantom Judge
the-phantom-judge.description: Gujrat me apni nakli adaalat se Samuel ne kohram macha rakha tha. Paise lekar fake judgments nikalne wale Samuel ki ab Uttar Pradesh ke ek shaahi khaandan ko lootne par nazar tiki hai. Lekin Samuel ko rokne aur badla lene ke liye uske peechhe pada hai Munna patel. Kya Samuel apni chaturai se is raja ko lootkar raffoo chakkar ho jayega ya Munna uska saara bhaanda fodne me safal ho jayega.

mind-power-no1-aaguvudu-hege.title: Mind Power No.1 Aaguvudu hege?
mind-power-no1-aaguvudu-hege.description: ಮೊದಲು ನಿನ್ನ ಗುರಿಯೇನೆಂಬುದನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಣಯಿಸಿಕೋ. ಆ ನಂತರ ಹೇಗೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದು ವಿವಿಧ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ಲಾನ್ ಮಾಡು” ಇಂತಹ ಅನೇಕ ಸಾಲುಗಳು ಓದುಗರನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುವುದು ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲದೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಕಾಲಘಟ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಹೇಗೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳು ಬದಲಾಗಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕುರಿತು ಹಲವಾರು ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದ್ದು ಸಲಹೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಲೇಖಕ ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ.

taken-to-lemora.title: Taken to Lemora
taken-to-lemora.description: In this steamy sci-fi romance, a hybrid female up for auction catches the eye of a grumpy Lemoran clan chief—one of the wealthiest males in the quadrants. Though he isn't supposed to bid, he refuses to leave and challenges all rivals to a fight to the death. As she discovers her newfound freedom, she must decide whether to embrace this unexpected protector and the chaos he brings.

12-jyotirling-ke-rahasya.title: 12 Jyotirling Ke Rahasya
12-jyotirling-ke-rahasya.description: Kaise bane ye 12 Jyotirling aur kyu hain ye itne famous? In 12 Jyotirlingo ki kahaniyan, bhakti aur rahasyon se bharpoor hain. Poora sach aur rahasya janane ke liye abhi suniye ye Khas show aur Shiv bhakti mein Kho Jaaiye.

to-the-stars.title: To The Stars
to-the-stars.description: Space is deep Man is small and Time is his relentless enemy... How far is too far? Alan Corday is about to find out. Corday is shanghaied aboard a craft bound for the stars... on a journey at the speed of light the world he leaves behind fast vanishing into the past. And nothing in the dark forbidding reaches of space can prepare him for the astounding discovery he will make upon his return from the stars.

target-attack.title: The Eleventh Commandment
target-attack.description: Ye kahani ek gripping political thriller hai jo politics, deadly conspiracies, aur hidden agendas ke beech ghoomti rehti hai. Mumbai ke Shivaji Park mein opposition leader Satyadev Singh ki ek public rally ke dauraan sniper se hui hatya se poori city ka balance hil jaata hai. Yeh murder sirf ek political rivalry nahi, balki ek badi conspiracy ka hissa hai jisme rogue agent Franklin ka involvement saaf nazar aata hai. Suspense tab aur badhta hai jab ex-IPS officer Aakash ko is case ki investigation ke liye bulaya jata hai. Aakash, jo ek baar system se alag ho chuka hai, wapas aakar is case ko solve karte hue ek dangerous conspiracy ko  uncover karta hai. Political gathjod, underworld ke dark secrets, aur government level par badi sazish- Kya Aakash sachai tak pahunch payega, ya yeh politics uski jaan le legi?

longing-for-love.title: Longing for Love
longing-for-love.description: Series favorite Tiffany Sturgil steals the spotlight in Longing for Love as her new boutique Naughty & Nice opens in downtown Gansett—right in time for the annual spring Race Week festivities. Finally divorced and ready for a new beginning Tiffany wonders if sexy police chief Blaine Taylor thinks of her as often as she thinks of him since their explosive encounter last fall. Back then he directed her to call him the second she was officially divorced but the opening of her store and her unconventional ad campaign have put the island's lingerie queen at odds with the town's top cop. Their clashes make for a steamy build-up that begs for a tension release. Blaine has been burned in the past by love affairs gone wrong and he's wary about risking too much too soon. But he quickly discovers that Tiffany's sarcastic rejoinders and bitter outer shell hide a badly wounded heart of gold. He also discovers she's a sex-toy fraud and convinces her she can't possibly sell the merchandise without trying it out first... While he finds himself thinking of her all the time the mayor is after him to curb her sexy advertising and his mother worries that Blaine has taken on another project that will only break his heart. The McCarthys of Gansett Island take a decidedly erotic turn in this seventh book! If hot sexy men in uniform cavorting with hot sexy women who sell sex toys for a living aren't your thing this book might not be for you!

a-quartet-of-pleasures.title: A Quartet of Pleasures
a-quartet-of-pleasures.description: Definitely Kinky: Ruby's known the guys in her string quartet forever. But after five years Ethan the viola player is still a mystery: quiet unassuming and intensely dedicated to the music they create. Who would've thought he'd be the one to tilt her world sideways using only his voice his fingers and a bundle of rope? Perfect and Powerful: Ruby can’t stand lead violinist Jonathan most of the time but she agrees to play his girlfriend at a party so he can fend off a stalker-ish fan. He’s a strict taskmaster during rehearsals and concerts but he’s an amazing dancer—and an even better kisser—so maybe that’ll all translate into something fun in the bedroom… Play With Me: Steve’s the big-brother type always has been—tall blond fun-loving faithful and protective. When Ruby shows up on the wrong night for one of his famed pajama parties he graciously invites her to stay. Everything’s great—until she gets a little too drunk and professes her horniness for him… repeatedly. Now they have to decide if they want to cross that line... The Full Concerto: The Gold Quartet has been invited to play one of their favorite concertos as guest artists with the noted Berlin Philharmonic but the concert falls on Ruby’s birthday. To make it up to her the guys hatch a plan for a celebration she’ll never forget taking her on a ride of deep passionate surrender that brings this quartet of sensual stories to a spectacular close.

15-aadatein-jo-banayengi-aapko-2025-mein.title: 15 Aadatein Jo Banayengi Aapko 2025 Mein Successful
15-aadatein-jo-banayengi-aapko-2025-mein.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki koi bhi successful apni kismat se nahi, apni aadaton se banta hai? Yeh show aapko unhi 15 aadaton ke baare mein batayega jo aapko 2025 mein safalta ki nayi unchaai tak le ja sakti hain kyunki chhoti aadatein hi bade sapne sach karti hain. Toh Abhi sunna shuru kijiye aur apni zindagi badalne ka pehla kadam uthaiye.

liar.title: Liar
liar.description: He was my uncle's friend and I was too young for him. But in the heat of the moment against the wall in a darkened hallway of an illicit club none of those things mattered. It was just one night of giving in to what we both wanted. I never expected to see him two years later sitting across me during a family dinner encouraging me to do my internship for his business. On day one we both agree that repeating that night would be a mistake. But it's a mistake we can't help but make again and again. The rules are simple. We can't tell my uncle. We have to be content with our hotel rendezvous. And we won't fall in love. But we both know we're liars.

ruin-you.title: Ruin You
ruin-you.description: Simon  The only thing that stands in the way of my revenge is her.  The lying scheming daughter of the man who killed my parents. She has the secrets I need to bring down her father. And I’ll do anything to get them. I will lie to her. Steal from her. Use her. Ruin her.  It helps that our chemistry is explosive.  What I’m not expecting is for her to be so sweet. And so strong. So…irresistible.  Penny  After so many years of lying and hiding I finally have a place to call home. With people I can call a family. The Paintbrush Inn is my life now and I won’t let anyone ruin it.  When sexy and world-weary Simon checks in to the Inn I never expect him to glance my way. I’ve spent my whole life blending into the background. Being overlooked and ignored. It’s been helpful even though it’s lonely. And he’s way out of my league.  But our attraction is powerful. Undeniable. Dangerous.  Because I can’t let anyone close. If the secrets I keep were to be revealed my whole life would be destroyed. But something about Simon makes me break all my own rules. I’m letting him in to my home my body my life never expecting he has his own secrets. His own lies.

anamika-the-ghost-hunter.title: Anamika  The Ghost Hunter
anamika-the-ghost-hunter.description: Ghost hunter Anamika ko bachana hai Shanaya ko jispar uske hi boyfriend Akshay ne ek khatrnaak spirit ko chhod diya tha. Uss spirit ko sirf Akshay hi wapas bula sakta tha.  Isase pahle Anamika Akshay ki help le pati use pata chala ki Akshay ko kisi ne maar diya hai.  kya ab Anamika Shanaya ko uss khatrnak spirit se bacha sakegi? Janne ke lie sune -Anamika -the ghost hunter

shattered-truth.title: Shattered Truth
shattered-truth.description: On the fringes of human space a murder will light a fuse and send two different people colliding together.   He’s a thirty-year veteran of military operations; she’s the youngest daughter of a wealthy business family. Both used roundabout means to become detectives. She’s smart; he’s tactical. Now they need to learn from each other.  Mix in a very early high-budget R&D AI created by the Military and we might have a problem for those trying to hide from justice.  Two years ago a small moon in a far off system was set to be the location of the first intergalactic war between humans and an alien race. It never happened. However something was found many are willing to kill to keep a secret.  Now they have killed the wrong people.  How many will need to die to keep the truth hidden? As many as needed.  He will have vengeance no matter the cost; she will dig for the truth no matter the risk.

hit-list.title: Hit List
hit-list.description: When her old agency is hacked by an elusive crime syndicate ex-secret agent Maggie Black is enjoying the carefree life of a civilian. Then she learns that the names of the agency’s agents past and present are being leaked by the hackers one-by-one until their notorious boss is released from prison. With the government refusing to negotiate with the blackmailers she is forced out of retirement and dragged back into the perilous life of espionage she swore to leave behind. Her name is on that list as well as those she cares about most. As the bodies of agents begin to pile up Maggie risks it all to hunt down the hackers. From the war-torn streets of Somalia to the seedy red-light district of Amsterdam she must race against time before her dark past ruins any chance at a future.

vyuh-rachna-mahabharat-ke-18-din.title: Vyuh Rachna : Mahabharat Ke 18 Din
vyuh-rachna-mahabharat-ke-18-din.description: Mahabharat ke yudh me bane har vyuh ki kahani, jo shakti, buddhi aur dharma ka sangam hai.Aur sath mein janiye Mahabharat ke 18 din aur unmein chhupi zindagi ki sabse gehri seekh. Abhi suniye Mahabharat mein chhipe ansune raaz.

tom-sawyer-abroad.title: Tom Sawyer Abroad
tom-sawyer-abroad.description: Tom Huck and Jim begin a new journey to Africa aboard a futuristic hot-air balloon! As they navigate encounters with lions robbers and fleas they also experience some of the world's most interesting and greatest wonders. This classic is the perfect listen for audiences of all ages and encapsulates the essence of American literature.

curious-case-of-ranveer-bhargav.title: Curious Case Of Ranveer Bhargav
curious-case-of-ranveer-bhargav.description: Advocate Ranveer Bhargav apne past ke zakhmon ke saath ek high-profile double murder case ko handle karta hai, aur uska client Dev Goenka uska purana dushman hai. Fir shuru hota hai sachai, badle aur nyaay ke beech ek khatarnak khel.

closing-the-deal.title: Closing the Deal
closing-the-deal.description: Derrick Warren has lusted after Sydney Fields ever since he first spotted her and after months of intense phone conversations, he’s finally got the delectable redhead all to himself. All he has to do is let the old Warren magic do its thing…until an ex with an axe to grind shows up. Before he knows it, the perfect date ends with Sydney’s wine in his lap. Now she’s not taking his calls. To his utter shock he realizes he’s going to have to work to win her over. Thanks to her mother’s experiences, Sydney is determined to never need a man. Just when she’s moved Derrick to her “loser” column though, she’s tricked into giving him another chance. To her surprise he not only satisfies her deepest sexual fantasies, she finds herself actually craving his company. But when she realizes they’re making love, not just having sex, her old instincts kick in—because she’s starting to like the man not just his body. And that more than anything else scares the hell out of her… Warning: Look out for a stubborn redhead who’s not afraid to throw her wine her opinion or her body at the annoyingly sexy architect determined to keep her for his own.

bones-and-roses.title: Bones and Roses
bones-and-roses.description: From home invasions to cheating spouses Rest Easy Property Management owner Leticia Tish Ballard thought she'd seen it all. Almost four years sober after flambeing her real estate career in an alcohol-fueled blowout she's finally in a good place in her life when the discovery of skeletal human remains rocks her world and plunges her headlong into solving a decades-old crime. Now she must delve into the darkness of her own past including the one-night stand gone horribly wrong with Spence Breedlove who happens to be the lead detective on the case. When the truth comes out at long last Tish finds herself pitted against an enemy who will stop at nothing in a fight for her own life.

mantra-jaap-ishwar-ki-aradhana.title: Mantra Jaap : Ishwar Ki Aradhana
mantra-jaap-ishwar-ki-aradhana.description: 101 baar mantra jaap karne ke baad milne wali shakti ko mahsoos karna chahate hain? "Mantra Jaap: Ishwar Ki Aradhana" show aapko inner peace aur strength ka anubhav karayega. To der kis baat ki, abhi suniye aur apne man ko shanti aur bhakti ke sagar mein utaar lijiye.

the-swiss-family-robinson.title: The Swiss Family Robinson
the-swiss-family-robinson.description: William Elizabeth and their four sons Fritz Ernest Jack and Franz are on a large ship when a terrible storm strikes. The ship's crew gets to safety on lifeboats leaving behind the Swiss family. The family now stranded on the partially destroyed ship finds a small island. They pack up what materials are left on the boat which includes guns and ammunition livestock some provisions and even pieces of the ship. Now the Swiss family is faced with the ultimate scenario of survival as the father William leads his family in a new primitive way of life that they may never escape from.

Anubhavaalu-Jnapakaalu--అనుభవాలు-జ్ఞాపకా.title: అనుభవాలూ - జ్ఞాపకాలూను
Anubhavaalu-Jnapakaalu--అనుభవాలు-జ్ఞాపకా.description: శ్రీపాద సుబ్రహ్మణ్య శాస్త్రి గారు పండితుడుగా, రచయితగా తన జీవితంలో అనుభవించిన "అనుభవాలూ - జ్ఞాపకాలూను" గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? శ్రీపాద వారు ఎదుర్కొన్న ప్రతిబంధకాలు, అనుభవించిన నిర్భంధాలు, పొందిన ఆవేదన, పట్టిన దీక్ష, చేసిన సాధనా, ఆ సాధనాలో వారు కనపరచిన పరాకాష్ట, వారు పొందిన విజయాలు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

mussoorie-mystery.title: Mussoorie Mystery
mussoorie-mystery.description: Raghav ki zindagi ek ajeeb mod par aa chuki hai, sath hi uska past aur present dono hi uljhanon se bhare hue hain. Mussoorie ke ek shandar hotel ki opulent party ke beech, ek ameer businessman, Rajvardhan Roy, ki maut ek suspenseful twist ban jaati hai. Yeh maut sirf ek haadsa hai ya kisi plan ka hissa, yeh samajhna mushkil hai. Raghav, ek tez, observant, aur deeply intuitive detective, is case ko solve karne ki zimmedari uthata hai. Lekin kahani tab aur ulajhti hai jab pata chalta hai ki Rajvardhan ki beti aur Raghav ki purani mohabbat, Preeti, khud ko is murder ka zimmedar thaharati hai. Ye kahani sirf ek murder mystery tak seemit nahi hai. Yeh un dardnaak secrets ka bhi pardafaash karti hai jo Raghav ke dimaag aur dil ko baar-baar jakhm dete hain. Ek taraf Preeti ka confession, jo sach hai ya kisi bade raaz ko chhupane ki koshish, aur doosri taraf jungle mein mile naye saboot, jo case ko ek alag hi mod dete hain. Raghav ko iss case mein na sirf apni professional skills ka use karna padta hai, balki apne dil aur past ke dard se bhi samjhauta karna padta hai.

NAVALA-VENAKA-KATHA-నవల-వెనుక-కథ-.title: నవల వెనక కథ
NAVALA-VENAKA-KATHA-నవల-వెనుక-కథ-.description: ఒక రచయిత ఒక నవల రాయడానికి ఎంత కష్టపడతాడు, ఆ కష్టంలో ఎంత ఇష్టం వెతుక్కుంటాడు అనే అంశం మల్లాది వెంకట కృష్ణమూర్తి చాలా చక్కగా వర్ణించారు. ఆయన వివిధ పత్రికలకి ఇచ్చిన ఇంటర్వ్యూలు, వివిధ పత్రికలలో నిర్వహించిన శీర్షికల వివరాలు, సినిమాలుగా వచ్చిన నవలల వివరాలు, తాను రాసిన అన్ని నవలల వెనుక గల కథలని మన ముందుకు తెచ్చారు.

bhava.title: Bhava
bhava.description: ಕನ್ನಡದ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಸಾಹಿತಿಗಳಲ್ಲೊಬ್ಬರಾದ ಯು.ಆರ್. ಅನಂತಮೂರ್ತಿಯವರ ನಾಲ್ಕನೇ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ 'ಭವ'. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಅವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಸೃಜನಾತ್ಮಕ ಜೀವನದ ಹೊಸ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯವನ್ನು ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.  ಮೂರು ಪೀಳಿಗೆಯ ಮೂವರು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಅನಂತಮೂರ್ತಿ ಉತ್ಕಟ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಸಹನೆಯ ಸಂಗಮವನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ನಾಯಕರು ಸಂಸಾರದ ಗಹನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿದ್ದರೂ ನಿರ್ವಾಣದ ಹುಡುಕಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ತಲ್ಲೀನರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ಆದರೆ ಯೋಗ್ಯ ಮಾರ್ಗವನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳುವಲ್ಲಿ ಕಷ್ಟಪಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ವಿಶ್ವನಾಥ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಿಗಳಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾದ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಪ್ರಸಾದನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ಥಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಬೌದ್ಧ ದಾರ್ಶನಿಕ ಸತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಲೌಕಿಕತೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಂಸಾರ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ವಾಣಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಅಂತರವಿಲ್ಲ ಎನ್ನುವ ಧ್ವನಿಯನ್ನು ಹೊರಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಉಪನಿಷತ್ತಿನ ತತ್ವವನ್ನೂ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಹುಮುಖ ಕಥನಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಒಂದೆಡೆ ಉತ್ಕಟ ಕಥಾವಿನ್ಯಾಸ, ಮತ್ತೊಂದೆಡೆ ಆತ್ಮಚಿಂತನ, ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಲಿಪ್ತ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಯಾಗಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಮುಂದೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ವಲ್ಪವಾದರೂ ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಾಕಾವ್ಯದ ತಂತ್ರವು ಆವಿರ್ಭವಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಇದರ ಕೇಂದ್ರತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಕೇವಲ ನೈತಿಕ ತೀರ್ಮಾನವಲ್ಲ, ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ತುಂಬಿದ ವಿನಯದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಲಾಗಿದೆ, ಎಂಬುದು ಅದರ ಮಹತ್ವವಾಗಿದೆ.

kainchi.title: Kainchi
kainchi.description: Gulab Co-operative Society ke flat no.402 mein rehne wale Samir aur Nikita ki zindagi tab palat jati hai, jab Samir apni biwi ke behaviour par shaq karne lagta hai. Nikita ka din-bhar ka akelapan usey apne pados ke flat no.401 ki Seema ke kareeb le aata hai. Seema, jo shant aur sidhi-sadhi lagti hai, apni paintings ke zariye ek mystery chhupa ke rakhti hain. Ek din, Nikita Seema ke studio mein uski paintings dekh kar kaafi pareshan ho jaati hai. Kahani mein naye mod tab aate hain, jab Nikita aur Seema ke beech ki dosti had se aage badhne lagti hai, aur Samir aur Nikita ka rishta ulajh ke reh jaata hai. Kya hoga, alag alag rishton mein uljhi in teen zindgiyon ka?

dinakkondu-kathe-jeshta-samputa.title: Dinakkondu Kathe - Jeshta Samputa
dinakkondu-kathe-jeshta-samputa.description: ಈ ಸಂಪುಟಗಳು ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡ ಬಗೆಯನ್ನು ಲೇಖಕಿ ಮುನ್ನುಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅದು ಹೀಗಿದೆ- ’ನನ್ನ ಮಕ್ಕಳು "ಅಮ್ಮ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳು" ಎಂದು ದಿನವೂ ದುಂಬಾಲು ಬೀಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು. ಅವರಿಗಾಗಿ ಭಾರತದ ಪುರಾಣ-ಇತಿಹಾಸಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೆಣೆದು ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವಾಗ ನನ್ನ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಊಟ, ನಿದ್ದೆ ಮರೆತು ತನ್ಮಯರಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು. ಅದನ್ನು ಕಂಡು, 'ಕನ್ನಡ ನಾಡಿನ ಇತರ ಮಕ್ಕಳೂ ಇವುಗಳಿಂದ ಸಂತೋಷಪಡುವಂತಾಗಬೇಕು' ಎಂಬ ಹೆಬ್ಬಯಕೆ ನನ್ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಡಿತು. ನಾನು ಹೇಳಿದ ಕಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಆರಿಸಿದುದನ್ನು ಬರೆಯತೊಡಗಿದೆ. "ಹೇಗೂ ನೂರಾರು ಕಥೆ ಬರೀತೀರಿ. ಮುನ್ನೂರ ಅರವತ್ತೈದೇ ಬರೆದ್ರಿಡಿ. ದಿನಕ್ಕೊಂದು ಕಥೆಯಾಗ್ತದೆ" ಎಂದರು ಶ್ರೀ ನಿರಂಜನ. ಈ ರೀತಿ 'ದಿನಕೊಂದು ಕಥೆ'ಯ ಉದಯವಾಯಿತು’ ಎಂದು ಲೇಖಕಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ’ಕಥೆಗಳಿಂದ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗುವ ಉಪಯೋಗ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಂಡದಷ್ಟು ಕಥೆಗಳಿಂದ ಮಗುವಿನ ಕಲ್ಪನಾಶಕ್ತಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಕುತೂಹಲ ತಣಿಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಬುದ್ಧಿ ಚಿಗುರುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಾಹಸಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ, ಅನುಕಂಪ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ದುಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಸೋಲು, ಸತ್ಯವಂತರಿಗೆ ಜಯ ಎಂಬ ನೀತಿ ಮನದಟ್ಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಮಗುವಿನ ಬೌದ್ಧಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಹೊತ್ತಗೆಯ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿದ ಅಥವಾ ಓದಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಕೇಳಿದ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಭರತಖಂಡದ ಪುರಾಣಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿವಳಿಕೆ ಮೂಡುವುದಲ್ಲದೆ ಅವುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗೌರವಭಾವನೆಯೂ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಇತರ ದೇಶಗಳ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಂದ ತಮ್ಮ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಭಂಡಾರವನ್ನು ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡದ್ದರಿಂದ ಆ ಭಾಷೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಜನರ ಬಗೆಗೆ ಆದರ ಮೂಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಪಂಚವೇ ತನ್ನದು ಎಂಬ ವಿಶಾಲ ಮನೋಭಾವ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ. ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಯೋಗ್ಯ ಆಹಾರ ಒದಗಿಸುವುದು ತಂದೆ ತಾಯಿಯರ ಆದ್ಯ ಕರ್ತವ್ಯ’ ಎಂದು ಈ ಸಂಕಲನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

agaala-manithan.title: அகால மனிதன்
agaala-manithan.description: நாதமுனி அய்யரின் மனைவி இறந்துவிட, அவர் தனித்து விடப்படுகிறார். அவரது மகளும் மகனும் திருமணமாகி சென்றுவிட நாதமுனி அய்யர் ஒரு லாட்ஜில் ரூம் எடுத்துத் தங்குகிறார். அவர் மீண்டும் தன் மகன் -மகளுடன் சேர்ந்தாரா? ஸ்டெல்லா புரீஸ் எழுதிய புகழ்பெற்ற பாக்கெட் நாவலைக் கேளுங்கள்...!

empire-of-secrets-1.title: Empire of Secrets
empire-of-secrets-1.description: Bajaj Industries ke black money scandal ko expose karte hue, investigative journalist Ishaan Bajaj ki duniya tab ulat gayi jab ek khufiya letter ne uski zindagi ka sabse bada raaz khola—ki vahi Bajaj Industries ka asli waaris tha! Letter ke mutabik, uske naam par sari property transfer ho chuki thi. Lekin kya yeh sach tha ya ek loyal journalist ko fasane ki saazish? Betrayal aur secrets ke iss jungle mein, Ishaan ne har kadam par sach ke kareeb pahuchne ki koshish ki, lekin usse ek ke baad ek naye chhal ka saamna karna pada. Har raaz ke peeche ek nayi saazish chhupi thi. Kya Ishaan sach ka pata laga paya?

kamala-harris-a-trailblazer-in-power.title: Kamala Harris: A Trailblazer in Power
kamala-harris-a-trailblazer-in-power.description: భారత సంతతికి చెందిన ఒక మహిళ అగ్రరాజ్యానికే అధినేత అయ్యే దిశగా ఎలా ఎదిగింది. స్ఫూర్తినిచ్చే కథ.

khali-hath.title: Khali Hath
khali-hath.description: Jail se riha hone ke baad, Harry ek nayi shuruat karna chahta hai, lekin uski mulakat hoti hai ek raazdaar aurat Ria Marlous se, jo uske saamne 50,000 dollars ka ek chonka dene wala offer rakhti hai. Lekin yeh paisa pana Harry ke liye asaan nahi hai, kyunki iske badle Harry ko ek risky aur shatir plan ka hissa banna hai—ek kidnapping ka hissa! Kya Harry apni moral values aur paison ke lalach ke beech phasa rahega? Ya fir yeh plan usse ek aur mushkil mein daal dega? Suspense, greed aur betrayal se bhari yeh kahani har twist ke saath apko dil thame rakhne par majboor kar degi.

the-sinner.title: The Sinner
the-sinner.description:
"The moment I saw her, I wanted her. The second time, I knew she had to be mine. Blonde hair, cornflower-blue eyes, a body to die for—everything I couldn’t live without. But after one unforgettable night, she disappeared, leaving me desperate for more. I was always the one to leave before morning. This time, it was her—turning her into my obsession. Lily was a mystery, hiding behind secrets she refused to reveal. She was running from something, and I was determined to uncover the truth. Once I did, nothing could stop me from protecting her. They call me the sinner for a reason—because I would burn down the world to keep her safe." 
'The Sinner' is a scorching, he-falls-first, touch-her-and-die billionaire romance from USA Today bestselling author Marni Mann!

mission-earth-volume-8-disaster.title: Mission Earth Volume 8: Disaster
mission-earth-volume-8-disaster.description: Who is the true master of disaster? Earthlings: prepare for the shock of your lives! Global warming... reversed. The energy crisis... over. The greatest problem on Earth... solved. Voltarian Royal Officer of the Fleet Jettero Heller has it all figured out. And he's devised a daring and ingenious plan to make it all happen... if he lives to see the day. Because Heller is headed back to Voltar where he's about to uncover the identity of the powerful figure behind the conspiracy to end all conspiracies. He's facing his deadliest nemesis yet and before the intergalactic battle is over the entire mission could end in disaster.

science-vs-ved-janiye-satya-ko.title: Science V/S Ved : Janiye Satya Ko
science-vs-ved-janiye-satya-ko.description: Kya aap bhi sochte hain ki Ved sirf faith ka topic hain aur science sirf logic ka? 'Science V/S Ved' mein jaaniye is debate ka asli solution. Abhi Sunana shuru kijiye aur samajhiye ki ye dono kis raste par milte hain.

jackdaw.title: Jackdaw
jackdaw.description: From the Sunday Times and international bestselling author of Ragdoll comes a heart-pounding, unputdownable thriller that will keep you awake all night! They call him the Jackdaw. With each victim, he leaves a chilling mark—five scratches—and takes a trophy, adding to his eerie collection with every kill. No one knows what he looks like or where he'll strike next. He could be anyone—your neighbor, your boss, even your husband. The only certainty is that he's out there, watching and waiting. Detective Scarlett Delaney dreads the name Jackdaw, and now it's her job to hunt him down before he kills again. But as Scarlett dives deeper into a web of lies and half-truths, she realizes she's not just tracking a killer—she’s on his list. As the line between predator and prey begins to blur, Scarlett must decide whom to trust. One mistake could be her last!

the-bachelor.title: The Bachelor
the-bachelor.description: Camden Dalton is notorious for three things: his command of the courtroom, his moves in the bedroom, and being the ultimate bachelor— never taking a woman home twice. One drunken night when Camden and I are accidentally left alone we make a deal. My proposition to him? If I don’t lose my virginity within the next year he promises to take it. But I don’t just want to do it. I want to get filthy dirty rocked. And I want to learn how to give as good as I get. His rebuttal? Four lessons on how to be an unforgettable lover. If I can make it through those without catching feelings then we’ll move on to the fifth and final lesson where all my naughtiest dreams will come true. There’s only one problem. Camden’s twin sister is my BFF. And he is forbidden from ever dating any of her friends. We just pray his sister won’t find out because what we’re doing is a whole lot more than dating.

outcaste.title: Outcast
outcaste.description:
Outcaste ek kahani hai dikhave, satta ki rajneeti aur vyakti swatantrata ke sangharsh ki. Paptikutti, Nambudiripad samuday ki ek tej ladki, apne jeevan ke sabse kathin mod par hai. Uspar 66 mahanpurushon ke saath galat sambandh ka aarop laga hai, jo poore samaj ko jhinjhod deta hai.
Rajdarbaar ke faisle aur chhupi sacchai ka samna karte hue, Paptikutti apne sach ko sabit karne aur samaj ke sthapit niyamon ke khilaf khada hone ka sankalp karti hai. Kya woh apne sangharsh mein safal hogi, ya samaj ki kathor pravrittiyan uska ant banengi?
Suniye ek aisi kahani jo vyakti ki azadi aur samajik bediyon ke takraav ko ujagar karti hai.

the-nightmare-man.title: The Nightmare Man
the-nightmare-man.description: Blackwood Mansion looms over New Haven, where bestselling author Ben Bookman wrote his latest horror novel, The Scarecrow. But as the book's release nears, gruesome murders mirroring its plot begin to unfold. Detective Mills and his daughter Samantha must uncover the link between Ben's novel and the "Scarecrow crimes" before the story’s terrifying climax plays out in real life. As the deaths continue, Ben suspects he may have unleashed something sinister from Blackwood’s dark past.

filthy-beautiful-lies.title: Filthy Beautiful Lies
filthy-beautiful-lies.description:
"I have no idea why she auctioned off her virginity for a cool mill. Regardless I'm now the proud new owner of a perfectly intact hymen. A lot of good that will do me. I have certain tastes, certain sexual proclivities. My cock is a bit more discriminatory than most. And training a virgin takes finesse and patience - both of which I lack."

Sophie Evans has been backed into a corner. With her sister's life hanging in the balance, the only choice is to claw her way out even if that means selling her virginity to the highest bidder at an exclusive erotic club. When Colton Drake takes her home she quickly learns nothing is as it seems with this beautifully troubled man. Being with him poses challenges she never expected and pushes her to want things she never anticipated. A sinfully seductive erotic romance where everything has a price and the cost of love is the highest of all, from New York Times & USA Today bestselling author Kendall Ryan.

jagannath-temple-rahasya-aur-satya.title: Jagannath Temple : Rahasya Aur Satya
jagannath-temple-rahasya-aur-satya.description: Jagannath Dhaam ke andar chhipe hain kai rahasya jo aapko hairan kar denge. Is audio show mein aapko milenge purani kahaniyon aur sanskriti ke kai chhipe raaz. Abhi sunna shuru karein aur explore karein iss pawan Dhaam ke chamatkaar ko.

relentless.title: Relentless
relentless.description: I've spent my whole damn life making the wrong calls. Not that anyone ever notices—whether on the track or back home I'm always in the shadow of my perfect big brother. But anonymity has its perks sometimes...like when the firmly off-limits ex of my biggest rival finally looks my way. Chiara Martes—gorgeous, smart, funny, legs just made to wrap around your waist and a smile that makes my heart race faster than anything. She claims she's just looking for some fun on the side and I'm exactly the kind of man who can give it to her. But off-the-charts sexual chemistry (hooking up here and there, everywhere we won't get caught...and some places we might) turns into unexpected feelings we've got to keep secret no matter the cost. And somehow before we know it this desperate thing between us is threatening to destroy us all.

devyudh-mahasangram-gatha.title: Devyudh: Mahasangram Gatha
devyudh-mahasangram-gatha.description: Devyudh: Mahasangram Gatha, katha hai, devtaon aur asuron ke beech ki prachin aur rahasyamay ladai ko bhavya roop mein prastut karne ki. Srishti ke nirmata Brahma, ek vichitra swapn aur ghane jungle mein goonjti ek anjaani hasi se vyakul hain. Unka margdarshan swayam Mahadev karte hain, jo unhe ksheersagar ki or bhejte hain, jahan Sheshnaag ke rahasya aur ek adrishya shakti se unka samna hota hai. Is gatha mein satya aur niyati ka sangharsh, samay ki ajey shakti aur prithvi ke vinash ki bhavishyavaani sab kuch shamil hai. Saat pavitra granthon aur Devi Bhargavi ki samay-shakti ka rahasya, ismein guntha hua hai. Kya Madhev prithvi ko vinash se bacha payenge? Kya niyati ke viruddh jaakar bhavishya ko badla ja sakta hai?

the-lawyer.title: The Lawyer
the-lawyer.description: I’m not the girl who picks up men at bars or lets their hands discover I’m not wearing panties. But Dominick made it impossible to say no, and his wicked tongue had me begging for more. The next morning, I find out he’s my sister’s ruthless lawyer, and he wants to make me famous. But fame comes with a price—sharing the spotlight with my jealous sister and giving up my career. Worst of all, Dominick doesn’t date famous people. Now I have to choose—fame or the man who gave me a night I’ll never forget.

the-one-night-stand-next-door.title: The One Night Stand Next Door
the-one-night-stand-next-door.description:
"Look, I didn't go out of my way to sleep with my next-door neighbor. It just happened. On the counter. Over the counter. Probably under it too if we hadn't moved it to the bedroom. But take it from me: a one-night stand with your neighbor? It's not all it's cracked up to be..." 
The One Night Stand Next Door is a short flirty and dirty prequel to The Girl Next Door. You don't have to listen to it before you dive into The Girl Next Door, but why wouldn't you?

deewane-daulat-ke.title: DEEWANE DAULAT KE
deewane-daulat-ke.description:
Ye kahani hai peshe se Chartered Accountant Raj Gupta ki, jo ki apne hi boss, International Money Laundering ke betaaj badshah ki wife aur uski secretary ke saath avaidh sambandh bana leta hai aur apni barbaadi ki daastaan apne haathon se likh leta hai. Suniye ek aise insaan ki daastaan jiski zindagi jail ki salaakho ke peeche se shuru hoti hai aur khatam bhi jail ki chaar deewari mein pahunchkar hi hoti hai.
Goa ki bindaas zindagi, casino ke ghoomte hue chor-uchakko se lekar jail ki teesri duniya ke kadve sach se rubaru karvaati ek anuthi kahani, ek anokhi daastaan!

the-juliette-society-book-iii.title: The Juliette Society Book III
the-juliette-society-book-iii.description: The pendulum has shifted in Catherine's life once again. Four years after peeling back the curtain on The Janus Chamber we find her now ironically working as a political journalist settled into a mundane routine and dating life because she chose to tell the truth about Inana Luna instead of embracing a life of decadence with The Juliette Society. Meeting a man who reignites her passion for cinema and guilt-free sex makes her realize what she's been missing but an unwanted scandal douses the flame. Forced to lie low she finds an opportunity to take back her career with a human-interest story in Honduras but there are people who see Catherine's article as a threat and will do anything they can to stop her from writing. The world Catherine finds herself in is unlike anything she's ever seen. She is The Mismade Girl and as her life is turned upside down she must choose to either perish or be remade anew.

to-the-vanishing-point.title: To the Vanishing Point
to-the-vanishing-point.description: It was just a boring drive through the Nevada desert...until the Sonderberg family picked up a beautiful young hitchhiker named Mouse and found themselves on a wild careening ride down the exit ramp to Hell. It seems the entire universe is doomed unless Mouse a transdimensional alien can find and heal the dying cosmic Spinner who controls the very fabric of reality. Suddenly attacked by a demonic gas station attendant axe-wielding rats and fire-breathing cops the Sondberg family must become warriors in a now-mystical motor home and battle pangalactic diners weird worlds impossible voids and brain-bending realms of madness. They're driving into a fantastic nightmare to save all creation at the Vanishing Point on the Cosmic Road...which happens to be U.S. Interstate 40!

detective-ajay-barsaat-blind-murder.title: Detective Ajay : Night Of Double Cross
detective-ajay-barsaat-blind-murder.description: Barsaat ki andheri raat, ek ajeeb aur daravna silsila shuru hota hai – Jasoos, Ajay, Lucknow ki barasati raaton mein hue do khaufnaak katlon ke raaz kholne nikla hai. Kya yeh khandani dushmani hai, ya ek maut ka khel jo baarish ke saaye mein khela ja raha hai?

the-island-of-dr-moreau.title: The Island Of Doctor Moreau
the-island-of-dr-moreau.description: Englishman Edward Prendick finds himself shipwrecked on the open ocean. When a passing ship takes him aboard and revives him things are starting to look less gloomy for the young scientist. Yet little does he know things about to get much worse. He is taken to an abandoned island occupied only by Dr. Moreau a disgraced English scientist for his unethical treatment of live creatures. Prendick finds that the Doctor has been up to old habits using the island's animals to create animal-human hybrids. Prendick must learn to survive among these creatures while uncovering even more deadly mysteries about Doctor and the strange inhabitants of the island in this classic sci-fi tale.

the-ionia-sanction.title: The Ionia Sanction
the-ionia-sanction.description: Athens 460 B.C. Life's tough for Nicolaos sole investigating agent in Athens. His girlfriend's left him and his boss wants to fire him. But when an Athenian official is murdered Pericles has no choice but to put Nico on the job. The case takes Nico with a beautiful slave girl to the land of Ionia within the Persian Empire. The Persians will execute him on the spot if they think he's a spy. Beyond that there are only a few minor problems: He's being chased by brigands who are only waiting for the right price before they kill him. He must meet Themistocles the military genius who saved Greece during the Persian Wars and then defected to the hated enemy. And to solve the crime Nico must uncover a secret that could not only destroy Athens but will force him to choose between love ambition and his own life.

master-your-emotions-13.title: Master Your Emotions
master-your-emotions-13.description:
Why You'll Love This Audiobook: Offers 31 coping strategies and a formula to reprogram your mind for better emotional management. 
Ye suna to zaroor hoga ki jisne apne emotions par control kar liya wo sabse aage nikal gaya. Lekin emotions ko master kaise karte hain? Kaise hum Darr aur stress jaisi hazaron negative emotions ko apna nuksan karne se rok sakte hain aur unhein apne fayade ke liye use kar sakte hain? Yahi to ab aap seekhenge. Sochiye agar aapne ye art seekh liya to aap apni life ko kitna badal sakte hain. Ab ye kaam aapke liye aasan hoga kyonki ye audiobook "Master Your Emotions" ek aisi guide hai jo negativity ko puri tarah se hatane aur ek purposeful zindagi jeene mein har kadam par aapki help karega. Yeh audiobook sunein aur esse seekhe hue knowledge ko use kar apni life ko aisa banayein ki har koi aapse seekhna chahe.

chila-nattukaryangal.title: ചില നാട്ടുകാര്യങ്ങള്‍
chila-nattukaryangal.description: ഓണ്‍ലൈന്‍ എഴുത്തുകളിലൂടെ  സുപരിചിതനായ യു.എന്‍ ദുരന്തനിവാരണ വകുപ്പിന്റെ തലവന്‍ മുരളി തുമ്മാരുകുടിയുടെ ഓര്‍മ്മക്കഥകള്‍... ഓര്‍മ്മകളും അനുഭവങ്ങളും നര്‍മ്മമധുരമായി ഹാസ്യത്തില്‍ ചാലിച്ച് അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു മുരളി. ദേശവും പരദേശവും ഒരുപോലെ നിറയുന്ന ഓര്‍മ്മകള്‍, മറ്റുള്ളവരെ എന്നപോലെ തന്നെത്തന്നെയും വിമര്‍ശിച്ചുകൊണ്ട് ഹാസ്യാത്മകതയുടെ പുതിയൊരു തലം സൃഷ്ടിക്കാന്‍ ഈ ഓര്‍മ്മകള്‍ക്കു കഴിയുന്നു.

sir-c-p-thiruvithamkoor-charithrathil.title: സർ സി പി തിരുവിതാംകൂർ ചരിത്രത്തിൽ
sir-c-p-thiruvithamkoor-charithrathil.description: തിരുവിതാംകൂറിന്റെ 1931 മുതല്‍ 1947 വരെ യുള്ള പതിനാറുവര്‍ഷത്തെ അറിയാത്ത ചരിത്രം അനാവരണം ചെയ്യുന്ന അതുല്യ കൃതി. സർ സി പി രാമസ്വാമി അയ്യർ എന്ന ചരിത്രപുരുഷന്റെ ജീവിതം വഴി കേരളത്തിന്റെ യഥാർത്ഥ ചരിത്രം നിങ്ങൾക്ക് മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

darkness-calling.title: Darkness Calling
darkness-calling.description: Mumbai ki baarish wali ek raat mein Pritam, Sonal ki jaan bachata hai. Dheere-dheere, unki dosti pyaar mein badal jaati hai. Par Sonal ke andar ek chudail ka saya chhupa hai, jo kabhi-kabhi uspe haavi ho jaata hai aur wo masoom logon ko maarne lagti hai. Sachchai jaanne ke liye Pritam apne dost Keshav ki madad leta hai, jo paranormal duniya mein vishwas rakhta hai. Sonal ko bachane ki is koshish mein Pritam aur Keshav ko kai baar maut ka saamna karna padta hai. Bhayanak atmaayein, dayan ka badla, aur purani shaitani taqaton se unka saamna hota hai. Pritam aur Sonal ke milan ke raaste mein khadi hai, Ek aatma jo maut ka khel rachti hai aur ek aisi kali shakti ka saaya, jiski wajah se Sonal kabhi shaadi nahi kar sakti. Kya Pritam apni jaan ko daav par lagakar Sonal ko bacha paayega? Kya woh chudail ke shraap se mukt ho paayegi?

kotigobba.title: Kotigobba
kotigobba.description: ಧ್ರುವ MBA ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಬಡ ಕಾಲೇಜು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ, ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅವನ ಕ್ಲಾಸ್ ಮೇಟ್ ಜ್ಯೋತಿ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ತುಂಬ ಇಷ್ಟ ಆದ್ರೆ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಆ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ರಿಚ್ ಕಾರ್ತಿಕ್ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಇಷ್ಟ. ಧ್ರುವನ ಲೈಫ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಅವನ ಎಲ್ಲ ದುರಾಧೃಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ಅಧೃಷ್ಟವನ್ನಗಿ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವ ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಬಂದು ಧ್ರುವಗೆ ತನ್ನ ತಂದೆ ಇನ್ನು ಬದುಕಿದ್ದರೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಅವರು ಈ ದೇಶದ ಒಬ್ಬ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಒಂದು ವಿಷಯ ಧ್ರುವನ ಲೈಫ್ ಅನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸ್ತು ಅಂತ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "ಕೋಟಿಗೊಬ್ಬ" ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ .

blind-date.title: Blind Date
blind-date.description: Ek blind date se shuru hui Naina ki is kahani mein sab kuch badal jaata hai jab uska saamna Aman se hota hai. Pehli mulaqat mein Aman khud ko ek seedha-saadha insurance agent batata hai, lekin sach isse kahin alag aur khaufnaak hai. Asal mein Aman ek shatir aur khatarnak mafia don hai, jisne apni bholi surat ke peeche kayi raaz chupaye hue hain. Naina ko Aman se pyaar aur bharose ki umeed hoti hai, lekin dheere-dheere khaufnaak haqiqat se parda uthne lagta hai. Maut ka saya har mod par uska intezaar kar raha hai. Kya Naina, Aman ke jaal se khud ko bacha paayegi, ya dhokha uski taqdeer ban jaayega? Yeh kahani hai pyaar ke naqaab mein chhipe dhokhe, raaz aur maut ke khel ki.

how-to-overcome-exam-anxiety.title: How to Overcome Exam Anxiety
how-to-overcome-exam-anxiety.description: Intha show va neenga ketteenga naa Exams pathina ungaloda bayam, pathattam, stress ellaame kaanama Poidum. Ungaloda Exam Anxiety ya overcome panni confident ta exams sa face panna pala elimaiyaana practical tips intha audio show la irukku🎯. Miss Pannaama Kelunga🎧.

exam-success-secrets.title: Exam Success Secrets
exam-success-secrets.description: 🎯Exams la Neraya Marks Score Panna , 😰Exam Tension-na viratta,  ✨Padichathu marakkaama irukka..  ipdi pala secrets intha audio show la irukku. Intha Show-va Miss Pannaama Kelunga! 📝 Unga exams sa semmayaa pannunga✅.

Choti-Katwa-Gang-अंधविश्वास-और-साज़िश-की.title: Choti Katwa Gang: अंधविश्वास और साज़िश की दास्तान
Choti-Katwa-Gang-अंधविश्वास-और-साज़िश-की.description: Kaun kaat raha tha soti hui aurton ki choti, aur kyun? Kya yeh andhvishwas tha ya ek gang ki sajish? Es show mein aap jaanenge, dar ke peeche chhupa sach aur samaj mein phaili afwahon ki asli kahani. Ek aisi dastaan, jo apradh aur andhvishwas ke beech ki lakir mita deti hai. Suniyega zaroor!

detective-maaran-season5.title: Detective Maaran S 5 : The Ghost Village
detective-maaran-season5.description: ஆவிகள் நடமாடும் Farm house'ல் ஒரு புதிய Mission. மீண்டும் வேட்டைக்கு தயாராகும் Detective Maaran.

indira-bai.title: Indira Bai
indira-bai.description: ಇಂದಿರಾ , ಕಮಲಾಪುರದ ಸಣ್ಣ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಒರ್ಥಡಾಕ್ಸ್ ಸರಸ್ವತ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನ್ಮ ತಾಳಿದಳು. ಬಾಲ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ವಿವಾಹಿತಳಾಗಿ ವಿಧವೆಯಾದ ಆ ಬೆಳಗುವ, ಕುತೂಹಲದ ಬಾಲಕಿ ಸಮಾಜದ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಧವೆಯ ಕ್ರೂರ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳಿಗೆ ವಿರೋಧ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅವಳನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಲು ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಮಠದ ಮುಖ್ಯಸ್ಥನನ್ನು ಕರೆತರಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅವನು ಅವಳನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾಗ, ವಿಕಲ್ಪಗೊಂಡ ಇಂದಿರಾ ಖ್ಯಾತ ವಕೀಲ ಅಮೃತ ರಾಯ ಅವರ ಮನೆಗೆ ಓಡಿಹೋಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಿತಳಾಗಿ, ವಿದ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಮ್ಯಾಟ್ರಿಕ್ಯುಲೇಶನ್ ಪದವಿ ಪಡೆದು, ನಂತರ ಸಹಾಯಕ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಕರಾದ ಭಾಸ್ಕರ ರಾವ್ ಅವರನ್ನು ವಿವಾಹ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ. 1899ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಇಂದಿರಾದ ಒಬ್ಬ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣಿತ, ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಇಚ್ಚಿತಾದ ಮಹಿಳೆಯಾಗಿ ರೂಪಗೊಳ್ಳುವುದನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು 19ನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಸುಧಾರಣಾ ಚಲನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಿಳೆಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗತಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

MOSSAD-ke-10-Khatarnak-Mission--इज़राइल-.title: MOSSAD ke 10 Khatarnak Mission : इज़राइल की खुफ़िया ताकत का सच
MOSSAD-ke-10-Khatarnak-Mission--इज़राइल-.description: Duniya ki sabse khatarnak intelligence agency ke baare mein suna hai aapne? Aisi agency jiska har mission ek naya raaz hai. Nazi war criminals se lekar Iran ke atomic scientists tak, koi nahi bacha hai inke shikar se. Aisi agency jiske naam se hi khauf ka mahaul ban jaata hai. Lekin ye agency bani kaise aur inhone kaun se aise kaarnamein kiye hain jiske karan inka dar faila rahta hai? Janne ke liye ye show zaroor sunein.

avalukku-peyar-agni.title: அவளுக்கு பெயர் அக்னி
avalukku-peyar-agni.description: முதலிரவில் நந்தினி எதிர்பாராத துன்பத்தைச் சந்தித்தாள். வினாயகத்தின் குணமும், அவரின் நேர்மறை அற்ற அணுகுமுறையும் அவளை மனவலியால் நசுக்கியது. இந்த உறவு நந்தினிக்கு நிலையான துயரமாக மாறுமா?

brindavanamum-nandakumaranum.title: பிருந்தாவனமும் நந்தகுமாரனும்...
brindavanamum-nandakumaranum.description: பிருந்தா மற்றும் நந்தகுமாரனின் காதல் மலர்கிறது. காதலின் சவால்கள் மற்றும் உணர்வுகளின் கலவையில் அவர்கள் பயணிக்கின்றனர், மனதை தொட்டுவிடும் ஒரு அழகான காதல் கதை.

ek-haseen-qatl.title: Ek Haseen Qatl
ek-haseen-qatl.description: Ria, Raj aur Seema – teen dost, jinki zindagi ek bhayanak raaz ke saamne aane se badal jaati hai. Jab dosti par pyaar aur jalan ka saaya padta hai, toh vishwas ke dhaage kamzor hone lagte hain. Ek qatl aur uske peeche chhipe raaz sabko ek aise jaal mein fasa dete hain jahan sach aur jhooth mein antar kar pana mushkil ho jaata hai. Har mod par ek nayi sachchai saamne aati hai, jo dosti ka imtihaan leti hai aur zindagi ko ek aise raate par le jati hai jiski koi manzil nazar nahin aati. Ek suspense aur thriller se bhari kahani jahan pyaar, dosti, vishwas aur dhokha mein uljhi hui hain kai zindgiyan.

the-power-hour.title: The Power Hour
the-power-hour.description: మీ ఉదయాన్ని ఎలా మొదలుపెట్టాలి? ప్రతి రోజు విజయమంతమైన రోజుగా మారాలంటే వినండి ది పవర్ అవర్

lawrence-gunah-ka-naya-chehra.title: Lawrence : Gunah Ka Naya Chehra?
lawrence-gunah-ka-naya-chehra.description: 'Ek college student se international gangster tak', 'Salman Khan ko dhamki se lekar Sidhu Moosewala ke murder tak', 'Blackbuck case se international crime tak' - aisi kai khaufanak kahaniyan chhipi hain Lawrence ki apni kahani mein. Ye show har ek kahani aapko batayega aur saath hi chhodega ek sawal jiska jawab aapko tay karna hai, "kya Lawrence ki kahani itni hi thi, ya abhi Lawrence bana rahega kanoon ke liye ek badi chunauti?"

evo-uprising.title: EVO UPRISING
evo-uprising.description: Seven years after the Judgment Virus—also known as the EVO Virus—swept across the globe humanity finds itself divided. Some have perished while others have emerged with extraordinary powers transforming into superhumans. These beings now walk among us shaping a world where heroism villainy and superhuman military units become the new norm hinting at the possibility of a Cold War on the horizon. At the epicenter of this transformed reality stands Sophia Dennison the inaugural and most potent superhuman on Earth. Unintentionally altering the course of history she grapples with a sense of alienation from the humanity she once belonged to and an aversion to fully embracing the race she inadvertently created. Choosing a life of partial isolation Sophia wields her extraordinary abilities to aid humanity on her own terms eschewing the conventional roles of hero or villain. However, a looming threat to the planet forces her out of the shadows compelling her to confront not only the diverse spectrums of her past but also the potential destiny she may hold. In this highly anticipated sequel to the adrenaline-fueled novel. The First Ewers invites you deeper into the evolving landscape of the EVO Universe. Get ready for the UPRISING as you navigate a world where the choices are stark: evolve or die.

rabb-al-ailah-father-of-3-bigshots.title: Rabb Al-‘Ailah: Father of 3 Bigshots
rabb-al-ailah-father-of-3-bigshots.description: For his father's birthday, he brought a box no one wanted to open. Inside it? A truth that shattered pride, price tags, and silence.

ruthra-thandavam.title: Ruthra Thandavam
ruthra-thandavam.description: Raghav, long estranged from his family, returns with his children for his father Appa's 70th birthday, hoping for reconciliation, but is immediately met with harsh disapproval and public shaming from his materialistic mother, Sneha. The family's disdain escalates during a tense gathering when Raghav is accused of bringing cheap wine to tarnish their honor. His daughter, Priya, uncovers a deceptive gift exchange orchestrated by Kanna, further fueling the internal conflicts. A "wine scanner" is introduced, promising to verify the wine's value, leading to a high-stakes showdown. The scanner reveals the gifted wine to be a priceless Lamarck 1935, worth over a crore, unexpectedly exposing Raghav as a powerful CEO. This revelation, however, intensifies the family's animosity, leading to accusations of fraud and even attempted poisoning, culminating in Grandfather Raj's collapse after tasting the wine. Raghav is publicly humiliated and accused of a scam, with rivals extending claims to his entire family and business empire. Despite his father's pleas to protect the family name, Raghav defiantly vows to clear his honor and integrity. He confronts his defiant children, Rishabh and Priya, revealing himself as the secret owner of the powerful Royal Group. Raghav asserts his high-society status by unveiling a multi-million dollar statue filled with gold coins, challenging his accusers. Meanwhile, Kanna, the 'lesser' son, faces brutal humiliation but defiantly vows his children will claim their rightful place. An arrogant heir, Arman, threatens to ruin Raghav's family, leading to public humiliation and the termination of all business deals. Despite revelations that Miller's (Raghav's) sons are secretly powerful CEOs, Raghav, deeply wounded by his mother's declarations and family betrayal, resolutely departs, rejecting pleas for forgiveness. The show explores deep-seated family discord, power struggles, and a desperate quest for vindication amidst accusations and betrayals, with Raghav fighting to reclaim his honor and status against a family determined to keep him down. The stakes involve not only personal reconciliation but also corporate empires, family legacy, and the very definition of honor within an affluent, complex dynamic.

silent-screams.title: Silent Screams
silent-screams.description: An emotional thriller about Vaibhav and his autistic daughter Kirti. Trapped in a mall’s cold storage, Kirti can’t clearly express her fear, and no one takes her seriously. As she freezes, Vaibhav senses danger but is dismissed as unstable. The story exposes how society ignores broken fathers and silent, disabled children—asking how a child can die unseen in a crowded world.

code-war-3.title: Code War
code-war-3.description: When a massive cyber attack cripples India’s defense, an unsung AI genius secretly prevents disaster - only to be betrayed by those he saved. Left broken and discarded, he rises from the ashes, reclaiming his brilliance to build an empire that rewrites the rules of power. This is a saga of revenge, vision, and redemption - where technology becomes both a weapon and salvation.

coolie-ki-diamond-dulhaniya.title: Coolie Ki Diamond Dulhaniya
coolie-ki-diamond-dulhaniya.description: A chance meeting at a railway station brings together Aryan, a humble porter, and Aarohi, the daughter of a powerful diamond tycoon. When Aarohi chooses love over wealth and society, Aryan is humiliated, tested, and pushed to his limits. As secrets unravel, the world discovers that true worth is not defined by status or money but by courage, integrity, and love. This is a romantic drama where a “coolie” becomes a king, and love proves to be the rarest diamond of all.

after-i-sold-my-sperm-to-a-common-girl.title: After I Sold My Sperm to a Common Girl
after-i-sold-my-sperm-to-a-common-girl.description: After I Sold My Sperm to a Common Girl

sorry-not-a-gold-digger-3.title: Sorry! Not a Gold Digger
sorry-not-a-gold-digger-3.description: When hardworking delivery girl Tara crosses paths with billionaire heir Rohan Mehta through a twist of fate, their unexpected flash marriage sparks a journey filled with secrets, clashes, and unspoken love. As Tara struggles to protect her dignity and dreams, and Rohan hides his true identity, will this unlikely union blossom into real love or collapse under lies and pride? Watch Now!

kesari.title: Dangal ka Daamad
kesari.description: When an orphaned wrestling prodigy is betrayed by his guru’s jealous son and cursed to lose his strength at the worst moment, Kesari is left for dead—only to return as a broken, forgotten man. As love, legacy, and an ancient akhada hang in the balance, Kesari must reclaim his identity to defeat betrayal, destiny, and the past itself.

silent-king.title: Silent King
silent-king.description: Will the Hero reveal his Hidden Empire to his family?

mazdoor-bana-billionaire.title: Mazdoor Bana Billionaire
mazdoor-bana-billionaire.description: Majdoor No. 1 follows Tanay, a silent construction worker mocked as “Ghajini” due to memory loss from a brutal attack. Exploited and abused, his life changes when fragments of his past resurface, revealing he is Aryan Roy, the rightful heir to a powerful business empire. As Tanay fights injustice, uncovers conspiracies, and confronts the man who stole his identity, he rises from an oppressed laborer to a fearless crusader for truth, dignity, and justice.

billionaire-baasha.title: Billionaire Baasha
billionaire-baasha.description: Is this time travel worth for Love?

jadugar-handsome-husband.title: Jadugar Handsome Husband
jadugar-handsome-husband.description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Veer, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Shaifali due to family greed and betrayal, turning two broken lives into an unlikely partnership. As conspiracies, poison plots, and humiliation surround them, Veer secretly uses his powers to protect Shaifali, while love slowly grows between duty, dignity, and destiny.

i-am-bloody-mary.title: Maya Lokam
i-am-bloody-mary.description: A woman enters a powerful family only to uncover a sinister tradition of deceit, sacrifice, and buried crimes. What begins as a fairy-tale marriage becomes a chilling fight for survival against generational evil. Maya unravels a haunting story of love, control, and a woman’s rise from victim to victor.

pyaar-pistol-aur-power.title: Pyaar, Pistol aur Power
pyaar-pistol-aur-power.description: When a suspended female cop goes undercover as a thief inside Mumbai’s most feared mafia don’s empire, a deadly game of power, loyalty, and forbidden love begins, where one wrong move can cost her life, and one truth can destroy an entire criminal kingdom.

rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons-1.title: Rudraroop - Revenge of Richierich Sons
rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons-1.description: A single mother raises three remarkable sons while facing constant challenges from her family. When she returns home for her father’s seventieth birthday, she is met with coldness and hostility from her father and younger sisters. Refusing to be broken, she stands tall against their prejudice and finds her own path to happiness.

zindagi-mil-gayi-dobara.title: Zindagi Mil Gayi Dobara
zindagi-mil-gayi-dobara.description:
'Neel' , ek ladka jise apni pichhli zindagi mein parivaar ne nazarandaaz kiya aur jiski maut usi ghar ke ek sadasya Danny ke wajah se hui.
Par kahani yahin khatm nahi hoti.
Uski Dobara aankh khuli, apne hi janmdin par, 10 saal pehle.
Naya mauka, nayi zindagi, par wahi purana dard jahan khoon ke rishte sirf naam ke hain, aur apnapan ajnabi doston mein milta hai.
Kya Neel apni kismat badal payega?
Ya phir beeta hua kal phir se uske saamne aa jayega?

the-shalini-show-season-2-mohan-shankar-.title: The Shalini Show Season 2 - Mohan Shankar Jothe
the-shalini-show-season-2-mohan-shankar-.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರು ಕನಸು. ತಾವು ಇಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸ್ಬೇಕು, ನೇಮು-ಫೇಮು ಗಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋರು ಕೆಲವೇ ಮಂದಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ಇಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಅವರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಪಾಠ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಾಧಕರ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ‌.. The Shalini Show Season 2! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರು ಆ್ಯಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. Watch Now!!

aa-nimisham.title: Aa Nimisham
aa-nimisham.description:
A young man’s life changes forever after a tragic accident draws him into a mysterious household. As secrets, lies, and hidden motives unfold, he must confront love, betrayal, and his own haunted past.
Aa Nimisham is an emotional thriller where every moment holds a revelation — and nothing is as it seems.

nepo-kid-bana-kabaddi-king.title: Nepo Kid Bana Kabaddi King
nepo-kid-bana-kabaddi-king.description: Ashwin Malhotra, a privileged "nepo kid" actor, endures a catastrophic public downfall, marked by humiliation from rival Armaan, being dropped from a major film, and betrayal by his girlfriend Rashmi. His violent outburst against a fan leads to blacklisting, disownment by his powerful father, and scathing criticism from influential critic Shobaji, leaving him isolated and disgraced. After a string of failures, Ashwin turns to cynical industry veteran Ranjeet Uncle, who offers a cryptic, high-stakes deal to "buy his luck." Financially ruined by a con, Ashwin finds a new purpose by acquiring a Kabaddi team, despite facing immediate hostility and mass resignations from players. He observes rival team dynamics and another owner, Aniket, forced into a money laundering scheme by Mansoor, before his own team is mysteriously disqualified. Ashwin then faces a public #MeToo accusation, later revealed as a fabricated revenge plot orchestrated by Parth against Ashwin's father, deepening a rift with his powerful patriarch. He hires sharp PR expert Kyra, forming an uneasy alliance complicated by a shared, tragic past involving a film set fire. Just as Ashwin begins a redemption arc, his team's captain, Raghu, is sabotaged before a crucial match, plunging Ashwin and his associates into a violent conspiracy. Ashwin is blamed for Raghu's career-ending injury, only to uncover that his own father, Rajesh Malhotra, orchestrated the attack, revealing a generational pattern of betrayal. As a ruthless strategist for the Mumbai Paltan, Ashwin manipulates the Indian Kabaddi League, leading to controversial disqualifications, while a forbidden romance sparks with Kyra. Star player Dalbir mysteriously vanishes, abducted by Mansoor Bhai, and Ashwin discovers his father's plot to sabotage his team with a doping test, facing an agonizing moral dilemma from a powerful figure demanding justice. Entangled in superstar Rajat Malhotra's vengeful scheme and coerced by underworld don Mansoor to eliminate Kyra and fix a championship match, Ashwin faces profound moral choices. He ruthlessly fires Kyra under pressure but later rejects a manipulative ex-girlfriend Rashmi, prioritizing his love for Kyra and reconciling with his estranged father. Despite Mansoor's death threat to lose the final, Ashwin leads his team to a miraculous championship victory, securing a biopic contract. He dramatically confronts Mansoor on the desolate ruins of his mentor's film set, turning the tables and implying he has corrected his error in trusting him. The story concludes with celebrated sports captain Raghu reflecting on his illustrious legacy and his partner Shlo reassuring him that their children will forge their own independent paths.

veergati.title: Veergati
veergati.description: A disgraced war hero living as an auto-driver must team up with his biological son, who is the new Intelligence Chief, to expose a national conspiracy and reclaim his lost honor.

sorry-not-a-gold-digger-2.title: Sorry! Not a Gold Digger
sorry-not-a-gold-digger-2.description: When hardworking delivery girl Tara crosses paths with billionaire heir Rohan Mehta through a twist of fate, their unexpected flash marriage sparks a journey filled with secrets, clashes, and unspoken love. As Tara struggles to protect her dignity and dreams, and Rohan hides his true identity, will this unlikely union blossom into real love or collapse under lies and pride? Watch Now!

pranay-preeti.title: Pranay Preeti
pranay-preeti.description: Lucknow ki mitti mein janmi yeh kahani hai Pranay aur Preeti ki—do jazbaati, ziddi aur bepanaah pyaar karne wale logon ki. Ek pyaar jo galatfahmiyon, saazishon aur ego ke toofan mein bikhar gaya, aur saalon baad ek shaadi ke mandap par phir se takra gaya. Jab beete kal ke raaz khulte hain, aur sach saamne aata hai, tab yeh prem kahani sirf milan ki nahi balki qurbaani, pachtave aur adhoore pyaar ki amar dastaan ban jaati hai—jahan pyaar jeet to jaata hai, par saath rehna naseeb nahi hota.

the-mask-of-a-guard.title: Billionaire’s Hidden Life
the-mask-of-a-guard.description: Revanth, the illegitimate son of a powerful minister, is framed for his father’s murder by his stepmother Pushpa. After marrying Sitara in a twisted setup, he finds love and redemption through her sincerity. As he secretly builds an empire and seeks vengeance, Revanth exposes Pushpa’s crimes, reclaims his honor, and begins a new life with Sitara.

acting-wale-daddy.title: Daddy on Contract
acting-wale-daddy.description: Rohit, an aspiring actor, seeks vindication after public humiliation, while Radhika, a high-powered CEO and single mother, needs a father figure for her daughter, Tia. Their paths converge when Rohit accepts Radhika's unconventional offer to become Tia's 'rented father' through a strictly professional contract. This arrangement, initially transactional, soon blurs the lines between pretense and reality, creating emotional challenges for Rohit and raising questions about their true relationship. The situation is complicated by Sahil, Radhika's co-founder, who harbors romantic feelings for her and exposes Rohit's manipulative entry and 'rented father' role, vowing revenge after Radhika's rejection. Rohit navigates his temporary role, prioritizing Tia's well-being, but faces public humiliation and intense confrontations with Radhika. It is later revealed that Sahil is also Tia's biological father and Radhika's husband, adding a complex layer of deception to the fabricated family dynamic. Rohit's secret fatherhood is further exposed by a formidable casting director, Shalini, revealing a deep, unresolved past. Radhika faces corporate and personal attacks from rivals Sahil and ex-lover Vansh, who threatens to expose her secret of hiring Rohit. Despite these external pressures and internal conflicts, Radhika and Rohit find an unexpected connection and shared vulnerability. Tia's innocent request for a family photo with both of them transforms their tentative connection into a genuine family unit. As Rohit's 'rented husband' contract nears its end, Radhika is forced to confront her true feelings. Sahil, driven by unrequited love and jealousy, orchestrates corporate fraud and publicly accuses Rohit. The conflict escalates dramatically when Sahil kidnaps Tia, forcing Radhika to make agonizing sacrifices to save her child and company. Amidst these crises, another father figure, Abhimanyu, makes a heartbreaking decision to separate from Radhika and Tia for their safety. The show culminates with Rohit making a public marriage proposal to Radhika, revealing a past, undisclosed union, which Radhika accepts, formalizing their family unit.

sorry-not-a-gold-digger.title: Sorry! Not a Gold Digger
sorry-not-a-gold-digger.description: When hardworking delivery girl Tara crosses paths with billionaire heir Rohan Mehta through a twist of fate, their unexpected flash marriage sparks a journey filled with secrets, clashes, and unspoken love. As Tara struggles to protect her dignity and dreams, and Rohan hides his true identity, will this unlikely union blossom into real love or collapse under lies and pride? Watch Now!

rented-husband-3.title: Borrowed Husband
rented-husband-3.description: ఆదిత్య, నెలకు యాభై వేల జీతం తీసుకునే సాధారణ వ్యక్తి. ఒక బ్లైండ్ డేట్‌లో అమ్మాయి అతని జీతాన్ని ఎగతాళి చేస్తుంది. అప్పుడు entry ఇస్తుంది అరవింద ఒక powerful బిజినెస్ ఉమెన్. ఆమె ఆదిత్య కు ఒక వింత ఆఫర్ ఇస్తుంది: “నా ‘రెంటెడ్ హస్బెండ్’ అవుతావా?” అని. కుటుంబ రాజకీయాలు, వ్యాపార కుట్రలు, బలవంతపు వివాహం మధ్య ఆదిత్య చిక్కుకుంటాడు. కానీ ప్రేమ ఒప్పందమైతే, చివరికి ఎవరు అమ్మబడతారు — మనసా, లేక శరీరమా? ఇప్పుడే చూడండి borrowed హస్బండ్ మీ కుకు టివి లో

dhurandhar-of-kashmir.title: Dhurandhar Of Kashmir
dhurandhar-of-kashmir.description: Feared underworld kingpin Nic’s life takes a sharp turn when he meets Kusha, a sheltered girl fleeing her controlling mother. As danger, betrayal, and a police manhunt close in, their unexpected love becomes his path to redemption. But when Nic’s past resurfaces and a traitor destroys his empire, he must choose between vengeance, family, and the woman who awakens his humanity.

the-shalini-show-season-2-dr-durgashree-.title: The Shalini Show Season 2 - Dr. Durgashree Shetty
the-shalini-show-season-2-dr-durgashree-.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರು ಕನಸು. ತಾವು ಇಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸ್ಬೇಕು, ನೇಮು-ಫೇಮು ಗಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋರು ಕೆಲವೇ ಮಂದಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ಇಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಅವರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಪಾಠ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಾಧಕರ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ‌.. damaad-420.title: Damaad 420
damaad-420.description: In Bihar’s lawless heartland, small-time genius conman Keshav Kumar (KK) accidentally ignites a gang war after stealing an entire iron bridge to save a friend. Pulled into a bloody power struggle between liquor mafia don Chuna Chaudhary and ruthless MLA Tinku Yadav, KK cons, schemes, marries into crime, and outsmarts killers—until survival demands he stop running scams and claim the throne himself.

secret-prince-1.title: Secret Prince
secret-prince-1.description: பெரிய பணக்கார குடும்ப வாரிசு நம்ம ஹீரோ. பதவி ஏற்க, 3 மாசம் அடையாளத்தை மறைச்சு, ஒரு பிசினஸ் குடும்பத்துல வேலை செய்யணும்ங்கிறது வழக்கம். அங்க, நிச்சயமான ஹீரோயினை சந்திச்சு காதலில் விழுறாரு. இப்போ, குடும்ப வழக்கத்தை மதிச்சு வாரிசா ஆவாரா, இல்லை காதலிக்காக வழக்கத்தை விடுவாரா?

dear-husband-3.title: Dear Husband
dear-husband-3.description:
She hides her scars, but love, betrayal, and conspiracy find her anyway.
Each trial pushes her bond with Arjun to the edge, testing trust, strength, and destiny itself. A stirring tale of secrets and passion, where love must survive the storm of deception.

ishq-aaj-kal.title: Ishq Aaj Kal
ishq-aaj-kal.description: Ishq Aaj Kal - follows five Mumbai dreamers whose lives intertwine through love, ambition, and heartbreak. Ishaan seeks acceptance, Isha chases fame, Naina faces a broken marriage, Shiraz struggles as a songwriter, and Armaan confronts his past. Each must choose between- love or money, dreams or society, the heart or the world.

doctor-boss.title: Law of Love
doctor-boss.description: The series introduces Anna, a young woman battling despair after a job rejection and fighting to free her unjustly imprisoned father, only to uncover exploitation by her manipulative family. Driven by a quest for justice, she infiltrates a prestigious law firm, encountering Alex Sir. Parallel narratives briefly follow Nisha, who finds romance with Kiran amidst financial ruin, and Roshni, whose connection with a mysterious man is violently disrupted. Anna's life takes a dramatic turn with an unplanned pregnancy, leading to intense family pressure for an abortion to protect their reputation. Despite Alex, the child's father, proposing marriage, Anna initially rejects him due to perceived social disparity, ultimately being forced into a marriage with the wealthy Matthew Tharakan for her family's financial gain. Their tumultuous romance persists as Alex defies an arranged marriage for Anna, but her family, particularly her brother Aliyan, systematically exploits Alex's finances, causing him to question Anna's motives and the paternity of their child. Alex's manipulative mother, Amma, further orchestrates their separation due to social class differences, while Anna is compelled into another unwanted arranged marriage to save her family from ruin. A friend, Roshni, eventually exposes the manipulation to Alex, prompting him to seek justice. Anna resolves to save her father, and Alex uncovers a conspiracy involving "Amia and Koomia" that ruined his life. Later, Anna discovers her father's legal case was secretly closed, implicating 'Shalini Wilson,' and confronts her adoptive family about their deception regarding her father and her true identity. Amidst these revelations, Alex terminates his engagement to a manipulative heiress, only for Anna to mysteriously vanish. Her family disowns her, and Alex receives a devastating call revealing Anna is in critical condition after a severe accident. The show explores themes of resilience, family loyalty, unexpected love, and the harsh realities of seeking justice amidst profound betrayal and societal expectations.
