family-man-ki-cheater-wife.title: The Wife's Secret
family-man-ki-cheater-wife.description: A legendary secret agent, living a deep-cover life as a mocked and "disappointing" insurance agent, is forced to abandon his status-obsessed family when a catastrophic bio-threat emerges, leaving them to unravel the devastating truth after he stages his heroic death.

better-without-you-2.title: Better Without You
better-without-you-2.description:
An orphan girl finds love in the man who once protected her.
But when jealousy, betrayal, and fate intervene, their bond faces its toughest test. A heartfelt story of forbidden love, sacrifice, and redemption that defies all boundaries.

dhurandhar-child-king-returns.title: Dhurandhar: Child King Returns
dhurandhar-child-king-returns.description: An ancient prince, Keshav, is inexplicably reborn as a six-year-old heir into the powerful Rajhans family, thousands of years in the future. He faces immediate scorn from his father and sisters, who favor the adopted son, Rudr, but is quietly backed by the matriarch, Dadi Maa Gayatri. Keshav defiantly asserts his bloodline, uncovering his ancient Chandravansh lineage through calligraphy, which sparks a fierce rivalry and hints at his extraordinary, supernatural power. Despite being perceived as an "uneducated village boy," Keshav demonstrates profound ancient knowledge, publicly exposing a multi-thousand-year deception involving a revered 'Phoenix ring'. This earns him a priceless heirloom and an offer of adoption, further alienating his immediate family who subject him to abuse. Gayatri intervenes, making Keshav the highest stakeholder in the family empire. Keshav then wagers his place in the family to gain control of the luxury lipstick division, successfully recreating a lost royal cosmetic formula. Dadi Maa confirms its authenticity with a magical test, appointing Keshav as General Manager, where he ruthlessly confronts and fires corrupt figures. His ruthless ascent continues as he defies his CEO father, Mr. Rajhans, firing his uncle and seizing control of a corporate division. Keshav launches a high-stakes luxury cosmetics line, navigating corporate sabotage and socialite rivalries, while his father attempts to undermine him. The formidable Dadi removes Mr. Rajhans as CEO, shockingly appointing six-year-old Keshav in his place. Ambushed with Dadi, Keshav begins to unleash devastating, ancient mythical powers, revealing his hidden destiny as a reincarnated prince. As Dadi falls critically ill, Keshav controversially takes control of her treatment, asserting his dominance and drawing the loyalty of ancient warrior descendants. He embraces his identity as the Yuvraj, preparing for a larger conflict. The Matriarch discovers Keshav's ancient soul and offers him family leadership, but a complex web of betrayal unravels. Sudhir (Mr. Rajhans) conspires with his illegitimate son Rudra to seize the empire, kidnapping Keshav and poisoning the Matriarch to force a transfer of shares. Rudra is declared the new head, and his true parentage, along with Madhur's decade-long revenge plot, is exposed. Keshav, having been dispossessed, returns with a powerful alliance, the Garud Dal, to dismantle the dynasty. He orchestrates the Rajhans family's shocking downfall, leading to arrests for past misdeeds and systematically eliminating their assets and influence. Ultimately, Keshav offers the disgraced family a chance at redemption: to rebuild a new, humble legacy in the village under his unexpected guidance, with an elder acknowledging him as a foundational figure for their lineage's recovery.

dear-husband-2.title: Dear Husband
dear-husband-2.description: రూహీ తన గాయాలను దాచే ప్రయత్నంలో ప్రేమ, మోసం, శత్రువుల కుట్రల వలలో చిక్కుకుంటుంది. ప్రతి మలుపులో అర్జున్‌తో ఆమె బంధం ఒక కొత్త పరీక్షను ఎదుర్కొంటుంది.

better-without-you-1.title: Better Without You
better-without-you-1.description:
A shattered relationship turns into a battle of pride, guilt, and unspoken pain.
When two broken souls cross paths again, memories reopen old wounds they tried to forget.
In the space between love and ego, they must decide if letting go is healing—or another heartbreak.

Insta-ग़ालिब-.title: Insta ग़ालिब
Insta-ग़ालिब-.description: A shy, bullied college boy secretly becomes a viral Instagram poet, only to watch the girl of his dreams fall for his fake imposter friend. Caught between his hidden identity and aching love, he must decide whether to stay invisible or finally fight for the truth—and for her heart.

lady-boss-returns.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns.description:
My Boss Lady is a modern romantic drama set against the glittering world of luxury hotels, real estate empires, and high-stakes corporate alliances.
 It explores love, betrayal, and revenge through the journey of Kiara Bhansali, a self-made billionaire who hides her identity to test loyalty and integrity — and ends up meeting Tej Jaisingh, an ambitious CEO caught between love and legacy.
Their accidental meeting spirals into a whirlwind of mistaken identities, class clashes, fake marriages, and boardroom battles — until Kiara’s true power as the “Sky Queen” turns the game upside down.
 The series balances romantic comedy, emotional redemption, and corporate intrigue, delivering a story about a woman reclaiming love and respect on her own terms.

beggar-sultan-secrets-of-the-beggar-king.title: Beggar Sultan: Secrets of the Beggar King
beggar-sultan-secrets-of-the-beggar-king.description: The beggar king found his bride… but the palace walls are closing in with lies, poison, and power. Who survives the final blow? Watch now!

the-price-of-pride.title: The Price Of Pride
the-price-of-pride.description: Raghu, an EV tech innovator, dramatically returns after three years, reuniting with his grieving wife, Sneha, only to face immediate and severe class disparity. Their love is brutally tested as Sneha's wealthy family publicly humiliates Raghu and forces the couple into servitude. Desperate to fund Raghu's dream job abroad, Sneha makes a traumatic sacrifice, mortgaging their home and enduring an unspeakable proposition. Despite immense challenges and family abuse, Raghu secures a life-changing opportunity with an international EV company. He embarks on his journey, fueled by sacrifices and a solemn vow to transform their lives, leaving Sneha and their child behind with a dangerous secret. Years later, a principled businessman, possibly Raghu under a new identity as Raghav, rejects global opportunities to uplift his community, while his hidden technological capabilities begin to surface. His deep love for Avni, potentially Sneha, is challenged by a wealthy, obsessive rival, Karan, escalating into a passionate, class-based love triangle and threats. Individuals who suffered public humiliation and financial ruin, including Raghav and Avani (possibly Sneha), return as powerful corporate titans. They orchestrate elaborate revenge schemes, executing calculated takeovers and demanding humiliating acts of submission from those who wronged them. Avani, once mocked for her perceived poverty, reveals herself as a formidable heiress, working alongside Raghav to dismantle family empires. Raghav is publicly exposed as an alleged fraudster, but dramatically reveals his true identity as a groundbreaking inventor and the world's foremost entrepreneur, respected by global dignitaries. Ultimately, CEO Raghu orchestrates a stunning corporate takeover with unwavering political backing, publicly crushing his rivals. Driven by a deep-seated personal vendetta, he offers 'mercy' to his destitute former in-laws, assigning them humiliating menial jobs within his burgeoning empire, ensuring they never recover their previous status or possessions, thus completing a multi-generational quest for dignity and justice.

bima-scammer.title: Cheater Billionaire
bima-scammer.description: The series chronicles Giridhar, an initially ethical insurance agent who, after public humiliation, transforms into a ruthless schemer driven by a quest for corporate power and revenge, defying his father's wishes for a stable career. He embarks on elaborate insurance fraud schemes, secretly harboring a crush on colleague Jia while manipulating others and answering to a mysterious 'sir.' His operations escalate from fraudulent policies targeting vulnerable individuals to a chilling plan for murder-for-profit, eventually being exposed by his superior, Alok. Concurrently, a mastermind named Amit orchestrates a similar large-scale insurance scam, recruiting agents like Raaji and Mishra, while obsessing over Mohini. Giridhar's schemes face increasing corporate scrutiny, leading to a violent confrontation and his termination, yet he continues to orchestrate fake policies and suspicious payouts. He later uncovers massive corporate fraud himself, but is blackmailed for a significant sum, prompting him to plot the murder of Ramesh, a key figure in a separate criminal enterprise. Ramesh, who had blackmailed his own partner, becomes the target of multiple assassination attempts, including an electrical sabotage planned by Abhishek under a 'Boss.' The suspicious death of insurance agent Ramesh Gupta uncovers a large-scale scam, leading to his accidental electrocution during a confrontation. ACP Ajay Sinha arrives to lead the high-profile murder investigation, complicated by his secret engagement to Mohini and her mysterious past connection to Alok. The investigation uncovers Giridhar's double life as 'Teliya Chor,' a notorious criminal, and reveals a deliberate cover-up with defective CCTV footage. Mohini finds herself tracked by 'Chor' after stealing a phone, while Ajay discovers a love triangle involving Ramesh and Mohini, with Ajay himself implicated in destroying evidence. A key witness is brutally silenced before revealing crucial details to Ajay, deepening the mystery. An investigator hunts for a vanished witness, identifying Giridhar as the prime suspect in the corporate murder. Giridhar orchestrates a vast surveillance plot and attempts to use Rita, who sought his protection, as a scapegoat in his 20 crore scam. However, Rita reveals herself as an undercover operative, turning the tables on Giridhar, gathering evidence, and orchestrating his arrest for his scams and murder, even as Jyotsna unexpectedly complicates his escape plan.

secret-billionaire-parents.title: Por Veeran: The Last War
secret-billionaire-parents.description: The microdrama begins with Hari and his ailing wife, Chandrika, arriving at a luxurious resort where Hari is mistaken for a billionaire, setting off a chain of events. This mistaken identity draws the attention of ambitious resort managers and the malevolent heiress, Tara, who, fueled by past betrayal and class disdain, initiates a sadistic vendetta against the couple. Tara's cruelty escalates from public humiliation and extortion to poisoning Chandrika's mother and holding Hari and Chandrika captive, systematically thwarting Hari's attempts to save his frail wife. Hari, later identified as Marshal Vishwanath, an ex-commando and national hero, fiercely protects Chandrika, vowing retribution for her brutal torture and critical illness. The narrative then intertwines with a high-stakes plot involving a legendary, priceless necklace, initially thought to be stolen from Hari's family, and later revealed to be worth hundreds of crores. Tara is publicly accused of stealing a valuable heirloom, while a powerful CEO also seeks to acquire the legendary Koh-i-noor. The conflict culminates at a high-stakes auction where Marshal Vishwanath, making an unprecedented thousand-crore bid, exposes corporate fraud and orchestrates a series of arrests. His actions are revealed to be a calculated act of retribution, driven by a personal vendetta to avenge Chandrika's brutal torture by the very auctioneer he pursues. Ultimately, Marshal, also referred to as Arjun, delivers unyielding justice to the perpetrators, denying them mercy. He secures peace after resolving past issues and confirms his deep romantic bond with Chandrika, hinting at a complex interplay between unforgiveness, retribution, and surprising acts of redemption.

shubhluck-saavdhaan.title: Kiss My Luck
shubhluck-saavdhaan.description: When fate intertwines the lives of a perpetually lucky boy and an eternally unlucky girl born on the same day, a cosmic kiss flips their destinies - leading to chaos, comedy, and an unexpected romance that proves love is the only real luck. Watch Now!

garib-pati-bana-crorepati.title: Garib Pati Bana Crorepati
garib-pati-bana-crorepati.description:
Once mocked as a poor mechanic, humiliated by in-laws, and abandoned by his own family—he vanished without a trace.
Years later, he returns—not as the man they scorned, but as the billionaire who’ll bring their empire to its knees. When power shifts, who will bow first—the tycoons blinded by pride or the man they once called worthless? Watch now.

operation-chinar.title: Secret Agent in Kashmir
operation-chinar.description: Operation Chinar is a Kashmir set spy thriller about ATS officer Rudra Kaul, who returns home undercover during a college reunion to expose powerful politician Rafiq Mir’s terror network. As he digs deeper, Rudra is torn between a long-buried love, Meera, her fearless daughter Zara, and a conspiracy that reaches the highest ranks of the system,where every ally could be a traitor and every emotion a potential weapon.

eternal-love-5.title: Eternal Love
eternal-love-5.description:

She pretended to be married to please her family. But when fate ties them together in a fake marriage that turns real, love and chaos follow!

When a junior accountant, Vivek, joins the team, secrets begin to unravel with the help of Kannika. Who is Vivek really? and what mission hides behind his calm face? 'Undercover CEO' - a thrilling story of mystery, deception, and truth. Watch now! Only on KukuTV.

drishyam.title: DRISHYAM
drishyam.description: Peter arrives in Pondolim as a new sub-inspector and is quickly drawn into a strange old case centered on Vijay Salgaonkar, a man who seems ordinary on the surface but is repeatedly treated as deeply suspicious. As the investigation unfolds, Vijay is shown in many roles at once: cable-service owner, local strongman, family man, and suspect in a hidden crime. The police search for a missing truth around Sam, while the family story around Vijay keeps shifting under pressure from investigators, witnesses, and public attention. What first looks like a simple alibi becomes a much larger web of staged timelines, altered records, and carefully managed witness accounts. The case is complicated by corruption inside the police system, where officers demand commissions, trade favors, and try to control what gets reported. At the same time, the story keeps returning to domestic life, where Vijay's wife and children argue over ordinary plans, education, and trips, making the larger danger feel close to home. A separate legal thread involving an illegally detained son and a hidden bunker reinforces the show's wider concern with abuse of power and concealment. Another thread turns personal privacy into a weapon when a compromising video is used for blackmail, putting Anju and her mother under intense pressure. Storm-time concealment, a burial, and a murder cover-up deepen the sense that several characters are protecting one another from consequences they cannot fully escape. Nandini and Vijay become tied to the secret through cleanup and silence, even as one of them doubts the cost of staying quiet. Police tracing of phones, SIMs, and vehicles steadily narrows the space for deception. Meera and other investigators keep pushing through contradictory travel details, hotel records, restaurant memories, and CCTV evidence, trying to prove that Vijay's story was built to mislead them. Vijay appears to anticipate each move, using family members and false trails to keep the investigation off balance. Public support for him grows even as the police lose confidence in their case and begin to rely on pressure and confession. Gaitonde's hostility and repeated suspicion add another layer of danger around Vijay's world. By the end of the batch digests, the central conflict remains unresolved, but the stakes are clear: exposure could destroy families, expose corruption, and finally reveal what really happened to Sam.

secret-shehzada-1.title: Secret Shehzada
secret-shehzada-1.description: When a poor servant and a wealthy girl fall in love, their hearts ignite a battle that defies society. Between pride, pain, and passion, love becomes their greatest struggle—and their ultimate victory. A powerful story where class, destiny, and emotion collide in the name of love.

greatest-of-all-time-1.title: Greatest of All Time
greatest-of-all-time-1.description: Arjun, a powerful CEO and secret benefactor, meticulously plans to reveal his true identity and propose to Lavanya, a brilliant research head whose career he secretly orchestrated. However, Lavanya, driven by ambition and materialism, cruelly rejects Arjun, unaware that he is the very CEO she seeks for her future. Heartbroken and humiliated, Arjun vows a calculated revenge against her. He accepts a contract marriage with rival Chairwoman Shruti Raj, who initially mistakes him for someone else, as a strategic move in his elaborate plot. Arjun then secretly orchestrates Lavanya's corporate rise at Silicon Tech, setting a trap for her eventual downfall. As the narrative unfolds, Arjun dramatically reveals his true identity as the formidable King Corp CEO, publicly confronting Lavanya and asserting that her impressive career was merely a "gift" from him. He threatens to dismantle the very empire he secretly built for her, leading to escalating public confrontations. Lavanya, initially dismissive, finds herself entangled in his schemes, even introducing Arjun as her husband, only for Shruti to later do the same, creating a complex web of corporate intrigue and personal vendettas. The emergence of Gautam Prakash, another powerful King Corp CEO and heir, further complicates matters, as he strategically marries Lavanya as part of his own manipulative revenge plot, aiming to weaken Arjun. Prince Vijay, an arrogant heir, also challenges Arjun's CEO claim and attempts to force Shruti into marriage, adding more layers to the power struggle. The climax unfolds at a pivotal King Corp banquet, where Arjun meticulously orchestrates the public downfall of his rivals, exposing imposters and asserting his claim to the highest honor and throne of power. He dramatically interrupts a proposal to Lavanya and reveals his gold invitation, solidifying his authority. In the aftermath, Arjun, now a formidable and vengeful figure, rejects Lavanya's desperate pleas for reconciliation, promising her lifelong suffering. He systematically targets and causes harm to those who previously wronged him, remaining unyielding to pleas for mercy. Amidst his quest for retribution, Arjun introduces Shruti Raj as his beloved wife, intertwining a new romance with his high-stakes world of power and vengeance, leaving Lavanya and her family in adverse circumstances.

the-lost-daughter.title: The Lost Daughter
the-lost-daughter.description: Kusum, an 18-year-old working-class girl, endures relentless humiliation and exploitation from the wealthy Kapoor family, unaware she is their lost daughter, Sheena. Forced into desperate choices and framed for crimes she didn’t commit, she fights to survive. A DNA revelation exposes impostor Zoya and reunites Kusum with her true family, restoring the identity and love stolen from her. Watch now.

superstars-bodyguard.description: When a fierce young wrestler enters a deadly underground fight to save her ailing mother, betrayal shatters her world and a mistaken encounter with a superstar ignites an unexpected bond. As she becomes his bodyguard and uncovers her stolen identity, love, danger, and deception collide—forcing her to choose between her past and the war for her future.

greatest-of-all-time-2.title: Greatest Of All Time
greatest-of-all-time-2.description: The series begins with powerful CEO Arjun secretly orchestrating the promotion of Lavanya, whom he deeply admires, planning a surprise marriage proposal. His plans are complicated when Chairwoman Shruthi, unaware of his true identity, proposes a contract marriage to him, which he initially rejects. Arjun forms a business alliance with Lavanya, who is fighting an arranged marriage and seeking investment. However, their shared past resurfaces, leading Lavanya to brutally reject Arjun, deeming him unworthy of her new corporate status, unaware he is the very King Corp CEO she idolizes. Heartbroken, Arjun agrees to a contract marriage with Shruthi for mutual revenge, while Lavanya, driven by ambition, secures a crucial $10 billion investment by proposing a strategic marriage to CEO King (Arjun). As Arjun and Shruthi navigate their secret marriage, Arjun, initially perceived as an underdog, crashes a corporate event and reveals his marriage to Shruthi, sparking controversy. Shruthi fiercely defends him against public humiliation and accusations of fraud from Lavanya, who repeatedly attempts to discredit him. Arjun is gradually revealed to be a calculating mastermind, whose marriage to Shruthi is part of a meticulously planned revenge plot against Lavanya for past betrayals. Lavanya's career faces ruin after insulting Arjun, who is revealed as a secret genius and the formidable King Corp CEO. Shruthi defies her traditional grandfather by marrying Arjun, leading to her ostracization but also solidifying Arjun's true identity. Rivals like executive Gautam, with a past rivalry with Arjun's family, and royal heir Vijay, Shruthi's ex-fiancé, emerge, plotting against Arjun and Shruthi. Arjun publicly declares his marriage to Shruthi, dismantling Lavanya's career and transferring "wedding gifts" to Shruthi, further escalating the corporate power struggle. The conflict culminates at a high-stakes banquet where Arjun, initially uninvited, orchestrates a dramatic downfall for his rivals. He exposes Vijay's deceit and manipulation, revealing his true identity as the CEO of "King Cops" and reclaiming his rightful position. Arjun systematically reclaims his dignity, wealth, and business ventures from those who humiliated him, including Lavanya. Lavanya, now regretting her past betrayals, confronts Arjun, but he rejects her pleas, confronting her past actions. The series concludes with Arjun finding a new path to companionship, proposing marriage to Vijay's offspring, who accepts, bringing his journey of retribution and corporate dominance to a close.

crown-and-clown.title: Crown and Clown
crown-and-clown.description: When a grief-stricken prince and his street-smart lookalike accidentally swap lives, their playful escape spirals into a deadly conspiracy — forcing the two unlikely brothers-in-spirit to outwit murderous royals, reclaim a stolen throne, and redefine what it truly means to wear the crown… or survive without one.

the-missing-master-chef-4.description: A fallen culinary legend walks away from fame to rediscover the true meaning of food and life. In a world chasing perfection, he finds greatness in simplicity. The Missing Master Chef — where every meal tells a story of heart, humility, and redemption

billionaire-boyfriend-ka-badla.title: Billionaire Boyfriend Ka Badla
billionaire-boyfriend-ka-badla.description: Set against the glamorous yet cut-throat world of aviation and corporate empires, The Sky Between Us is a high-octane romantic thriller that begins with a chance meeting on a flight from Dubai to Mumbai and soars into a battle of egos, love, and legacy.

eternal-love-4.title: Eternal Love
eternal-love-4.description: Wealthy businessman Vikram escapes his daughter’s matchmaking by lying he’s married. Avni, also pretending for family pressure, crosses paths with him while seeking a fake marriage certificate. They agree to a no-strings union, unaware fate has other plans. After an accident, Avni reenters Vikram’s life as his office cleaner. Forced to pose as his wife, love grows amid secrets and chaos. When they move to divorce, they discover they had been truly married all along.

billionaire-ka-safar.title: Billionaire ka Safar
billionaire-ka-safar.description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

gopika-madhav.title: Gopika Madhav
gopika-madhav.description: Madhav, a business magnate, faces devastating financial ruin due to fraud, leading to his materialistic fiancée, Priya, abandoning him and publicly mocking his misfortune. Stripped of his fortune, humiliated, and blacklisted by powerful rival Madhusudhan, Madhav loses everything but vows to reclaim his identity and dignity. A long-lost friend, Sriram, offers him a lucrative partnership, forming a new company with a shared objective of revenge against Priya and her family. Madhav is appointed project manager at Sriram Builders with unchecked power, immediately embarking on ambitious corporate strategies, including high-stakes gambles and schemes to secure lucrative contracts, while confronting Madhusudhan and his family. Amidst these corporate battles, Madhav experiences a fated encounter with Gopika, an orphan woman, leading to a deep connection and love confession despite perceived social disparities, contrasting with a cruel rejection by a status-obsessed socialite. He also navigates potential romances with Archana and social media influencer Anu, developing skepticism about the latter's public persona. Madhav orchestrates a lavish engagement party under mysterious conditions, luring guests with gold, where Gopika, his bride-to-be, reveals her humble background as a school teacher and recognizes Madhav, hinting at a complex shared past. The ceremony is dramatically interrupted by multiple women accusing Madhav of romantic fraud and deceit, adding layers to his enigmatic persona. Concurrently, his materialistic ex-lover Priya resurfaces, torn between marrying the wealthy Nandan and her lingering feelings for Madhav, who challenges Nandan's inherited wealth. Gopika fiercely defends Madhav against an arrogant, privileged family, uniting with him against class injustice, while Priya's hubris leads to a shocking revelation involving Nandan. Madhav, initially humiliated, dramatically reveals his true identity as the immensely wealthy chairman of MD Group, his fortune mysteriously restored after a company collapse two years prior. This re-emergence intertwines with his quest for dominance and revenge, as many who wronged him regret their past judgments, though one woman remains unforgiving of his deception. Gopika confronts Madhav, suspecting his hidden identity and immense wealth, questioning their connection and the sincerity of his intentions. Ultimately, the show explores Madhav's journey from utter ruin to immense power, driven by a desire for revenge and corporate dominance, but complicated by his search for genuine love and the true meaning of wealth and loyalty, especially as Gopika is fated to reunite with her long-lost childhood friend, Hari, hinting at a profound, destined connection that transcends Madhav's complex world.

the-shalini-show-season-2-sukrutha-nag-j.title: The Shalini Show Season 2 - Sukrutha Nag Jothe
the-shalini-show-season-2-sukrutha-nag-j.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರು ಕನಸು. ತಾವು ಇಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸ್ಬೇಕು, ನೇಮು-ಫೇಮು ಗಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋರು ಕೆಲವೇ ಮಂದಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ಇಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಅವರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಪಾಠ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಾಧಕರ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ‌.. The Shalini Show Season 2! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರು ಆ್ಯಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. Watch Now!!

great-desi-wedding-haryanvi.title: Great Desi Wedding (Haryanvi)
great-desi-wedding-haryanvi.description: In The Great Desi Wedding, a celebration meant to unite two hearts turns into a storm of betrayal, vengeance, and buried secrets. When Radha’s honor is shattered by Meera’s jealousy and Arjun’s divided loyalties, love and tradition collide in a brutal test of truth. Amid rituals, revenge, and redemption, this “wedding” becomes a battle for dignity and justice.

eternal-love-3.title: Eternal Love
eternal-love-3.description: Vikram Rathod lies to his daughter that he has remarried and that her stepmother will soon come home. Meanwhile, Avni tries to convince everyone that she’s married too. At one point, Avni and Vikram cross paths. What happens next?

gareebi-se-nikalega-geeta-ka-gyaan.title: Gareebi Se Nikalega Geeta Ka Gyaan
gareebi-se-nikalega-geeta-ka-gyaan.description: Gareebi Se Nikalega Geeta Ka Gyaan

final-bliss-3.title: Final Bliss
final-bliss-3.description: When billionaire industrialist Hardeep Singh Oberoi tries to shield his daughter Mahima from heartbreak, she launches “Mission Daddy Ki Dulhan” to find him a bride. Fate brings them to the warm-hearted Srikavita Nair, whose simple values clash yet connect with Hardeep’s guarded world. But as secrets of Srikavita’s past and her abusive ex-husband Rajeev Menon surface, relationships are tested, identities are shaken, and love, trust, and family bonds must stand the ultimate test. Watch Now!

the-magical-shepherd.title: The Magical shepherd
the-magical-shepherd.description: Watch this show live now on KuKuTV!

sweet-contract-with-the-mafia-boss.title: Her Return
sweet-contract-with-the-mafia-boss.description: Betrayed by her own blood… Shattered, yet unbroken.. Meera rises from the ashes.! In a world that tried to silence her,  she builds her own empire,  fighting every lie, every betrayal. when destiny brings Priya into her life, the battle between past and future begins.! Witness a woman’s powerful comeback. 'Her Return' - only on Kuku TV.

doctor-vs-billionaire.title: Doctor vs Billionaires
doctor-vs-billionaire.description: In a world of wealth, ego, and arrogance, little Aarya’s innocent prank spirals into a fight between life and death. While her heartbeat slips away in the hospital, the only doctor who can save her is trapped on the road, blackmailed, humiliated by a ruthless couple blinded by pride. As every second counts, shocking truths unfold, the child fighting for life may be their own daughter. Will redemption come in time… or will their cruelty cost them the one thing they can never replace? Watch Now!

undercover-agent-mission-narmada-jail.title: Undercover Agent: Mission Narmada Jail
undercover-agent-mission-narmada-jail.description: A disgraced RAW commando infiltrates a high-security Indian prison to expose a terror network, but discovers the man who ruined his father’s name and his nation’s honour has been hiding in the same cell all along.

missing-master-chef.title: Missing Master Chef
missing-master-chef.description: The series introduces John, a humble cook secretly in love with Clara, who faces ridicule in a culinary world longing for the vanished Master Chef. John's extraordinary, almost magical, culinary genius begins to emerge, impressing mentors and stunning judges in high-stakes competitions, even performing an impossible feat that defies conventional understanding. His rapid rise, however, is met with fierce opposition from established rivals like Soma and Antony Joseph, who challenge him and Clara, threatening their professional standing and her family's restaurant with high-stakes battles for ownership. The stakes are immense, involving not just personal honor but also the very legacy of traditional culinary arts. Amidst corporate intrigue, deliberate food sabotage, and public humiliation, John is forced to consume a "garbage" dish and faces accusations, even as his true identity as a formidable wielder of legendary techniques, like the "Dancing Duo Beast Technique," is hinted at and later revealed, baffling observers. A brutal ambush leaves John with severe hand injuries, forcing him into destitution and amnesia, while the renowned Master Chef mysteriously vanishes, later discovered living in disguise. Compassionate restaurant owner George takes in the vulnerable, injured John, whose own traditional business is systematically dismantled by a ruthless rival restaurateur, jeopardizing George's family legacy. Despite his hidden identity and memory loss, John's unparalleled skill is gradually recognized by influential connoisseurs and a Chef Scout, sparking astronomical bidding wars for his dishes, even as he faces new challenges from ambitious chefs like Williams and a newcomer Chef David, who vie for investment and recognition in a cutthroat industry. A violent incident and a profound connection with Clara, his initial love interest, help Master Chef John regain his full memory, setting the stage for his potential comeback amidst ongoing rivalries and class conflicts within the culinary world. He achieves a decisive victory in a high-stakes culinary competition, but not without facing furious accusations of cheating and conspiracy from a defeated rival, Sanjay, who also hints at John's past physical impairment and warns of powerful family interventions. This victory solidifies his position, yet the journey is fraught with betrayals, banishments, and quests for hidden truths about culinary identities, including the public denial of a champion's claim to a legendary master. The series explores the tension between humble origins and elite establishments, questioning the true definition of culinary mastery. Ultimately, John's philosophy of cooking with heart over glory prevails, contrasting sharply with the ambition and deceit of his adversaries and leading to Sanjay's remorse and a potential collaboration for a significant financial investment. The series culminates with John reclaiming his rightful legacy, protecting Clara and her family's honor, and redefining what it means to be a true Master Chef, proving his worth against all odds and securing his place as a culinary legend. His arduous journey underscores the profound impact of empathy, resilience, and genuine talent in a world obsessed with fame and power, ultimately challenging established culinary perceptions and inspiring a new generation.

lawyer-vs-billionaires.title: Lawyer vs Billionaires
lawyer-vs-billionaires.description: “A sharp, fearless lawyer crosses paths with a charming con-man whose lies have ruined countless lives—until she becomes his next target. But when their clash turns into a dangerous game of truth, deception, and unexpected attraction, only one can win the final verdict.”

the-missing-master-chef-2.title: The Missing Master Chef
the-missing-master-chef-2.description: A fallen culinary legend walks away from fame to rediscover the true meaning of food and life. In a world chasing perfection, he finds greatness in simplicity. The Missing Master Chef — where every meal tells a story of heart, humility, and redemption.

brahmrakshas-2.title: Brahmrakshas
brahmrakshas-2.description: When a wedding in the silent village of Dhumgarh breaks an ancient taboo against noise, a curse awakens—the vengeful spirit of Dev, a once-noble scholar betrayed in love and transformed into the dreaded Brahmrakshas. As brides mysteriously vanish, Ira, a fearless paranormal expert, arrives to uncover the truth.

raw-agent-ya-delivery-boy.title: Raw Agent YA Delivery Boy?
raw-agent-ya-delivery-boy.description: When delivery rider Kabir Deshmukh meets billionaire CEO Anika Singhania in a blind-date mix-up, her daughter Ishita fast-tracks him into a sham marriage to give her mother a partner she can trust. Kabir’s integrity wins hearts, but his mysterious past and enemies in Anika’s world ignite a war that forces him to reveal he’s actually ex-RAW agent Rudra Verma.

premanand-se-jaane-jeevan-ka-satya.title: Premanand Se Jaane Jeevan Ka Satya
premanand-se-jaane-jeevan-ka-satya.description: Premanand Se Jaane Jeevan Ka Satya

homeless-billionaire-2.title: Homeless Billionaire
homeless-billionaire-2.description: Aravind Desai, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kalyani, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch "Homeless Billionaire" Now!

ultimate-boxer-4.title: Ultimate Boxer
ultimate-boxer-4.description:
A boxing champion’s world collides with a struggling florist when fate traps them in a contract neither wanted.
As betrayal, humiliation, and hidden conspiracies rise, love sparks in the unlikeliest of places.
But when duty clashes with desire, the question remains—will sacrifice or survival win?

eternal-love-2.title: Eternal Love
eternal-love-2.description: తనకు రెండో పెళ్ళి అయ్యిందని, మీ పిన్ని తొందర్లో ఇంటికి వస్తుందని కూతురుకు అబద్ధం చెబుతాడు తండ్రి విక్రం రాథోడ్. మరోవైపు అవని కూడా తనకు పెళ్ళయిపోయిందని జనాలను నమ్మించాలని చూస్తుంది. ఒకానొక సమయంలో అవని, విక్రం ఒకరొకొకరు ఎదురుపడతారు. తర్వాత ఎం జరిగింది?

remade-book-2.title: ReMade: Book 2
remade-book-2.description: In one moment the lives of twenty-three teenagers are forever changed and it's not just because they all happen to die. ReMade in a world they barely recognize--one with robots space elevators and unchecked jungle--they must work together to survive. They came from different places backgrounds and families and now they might be the last people on earth. Lost meets The Maze Runner in this exciting adventure from Serial Box Publishing. The remade teens forge forward in their future world— a smaller group wiser but tougher. Just as they begin to think they understand their new circumstances though a reminder of past trauma makes them question everything they know and sets them on a new course.

rangeen-rishtey.title: Rangeen Rishtey
rangeen-rishtey.description: Ek ameer, magar bigda hua ladka Shailesh Bajaj, jo LGBT club se high-profile parties tak mein apni zindagi jeeta hai, achanak ek dangerous stalker ke nishane par hai. Shailesh ke liye sab kuch badal jata hai jab ek handsome bodyguard Gagan Talwar uski zindagi mein aata hai. Kya unka saath Shailesh ke traumatic past ke raaz kholne ke liye kafi hoga?

rough-hard-fierce-a-boxed-set.title: Rough Hard Fierce
rough-hard-fierce-a-boxed-set.description:
ROUGH - I have a dark secret, a rare indulgence that offers me a moment of release. On certain nights, I visit a club where I find men who aren't afraid to take what they want—men like Colin, who gives me exactly what I need. HARD - There are things Colin doesn’t know—secrets I must keep to protect my daughter. The enemies in the shadows are relentless, and every day is a battle to keep them at bay. I’m fighting with everything I have, but it’s getting harder to avoid being crushed. FIERCE - I’m torn between the men from my past and the one by my side. Colin has tried to control me, to use me, but he also fiercely protects me, making my heart ache. Yet no matter how much he shields me, this is my fight—and I’ve already lost.
This revised version enhances the flow and emotional impact, providing a clearer sense of the book's tone and themes while retaining the rawness and intensity of the original.

the-education-of-ivy-leavold.title: The Education Of Ivy Leavold
the-education-of-ivy-leavold.description: I knew loving a man like Julian Markham was a risk, but I believed love could conquer his darkness. I was wrong. Ivy Leavold arrived at Markham Hall seeking a fresh start, only to find herself captivated by the mysterious Julian Markham. Their intense love threatens to consume them both, and now Julian offers Ivy the chance to become his bride, the mistress of Markham Hall. She longs to accept, but with love comes danger. The closer Ivy draws to Julian, the more she risks uncovering the truth behind her cousin’s death— a secret that could destroy their love forever.

dashavatar-bhagwan-vishnu-ki-mahima.title: Dashavatar : Bhagwan Vishnu Ki Mahima
dashavatar-bhagwan-vishnu-ki-mahima.description: Kya aapko pata hai ki Bhagwan Vishnu ke Dashavatar humari zindagi ki har problem ka solution dete hain? Is show mein un avataron ke rahasya aur unke diye gyan ko seekh kar apni life ko sudhaariye. Abhi Sunana Shuru karein ye show.

bossy-brit.title: Bossy Brit
bossy-brit.description: Sexy billionaire Liam Bennett is cocky dangerously handsome and more importantly my new boss. If only my ovaries didn't flutter when he was near - yeah that'd be super helpful. When our long hours lead to a dare - and an X-rated encounter - I never expected it to be the hottest sex of my life. It'd also be super helpful if Liam didn't know it and taunt me about it every chance he got. Unable to deny our attraction any longer our work relationship brings a whole new meaning to the term inbox. But being with him comes with some baggage - like an ex-wife and three kids kind of baggage. And a lawyer who wants half of his company. Unsure that I'm cut out for this new level of complicated my traitorous ovaries beg me to try. Heaven help us all. This is a stand-alone novella with lots of steam and a guaranteed HEA. If you like bossy British guys with big hearts...this one is a must-listen!

hunter-2.title: Hunter
hunter-2.description: As the Kingdom of Maldobar emerges victorious from the brutal invasion of the Tibran Empire much of the land is left in utter ruin. With his home destroyed and family gone sixteen-year-old Thatcher Renley has no one left to turn to. And when he’s mistaken for a Tibran soldier and banished to a wartime prison camp Thatcher knows his only hope for freedom lies in appealing to Queen Jenna directly. But getting out of the prison camp might be the least of his worries—especially after he stumbles across a feral dragon locked in an iron cell. As far as dragons go Fornax is a lost cause. The battle that killed his rider also left him blind and too aggressive for any knight to control. But Thatcher can’t deny feeling drawn to the beast. Does he have what it takes to calm Fornax and join the proud ranks of Maldobar’s dragonriders? Only time will tell. And with a bloodthirsty Tibran witch threatening to rekindle the chaos of war everyone’s time may be running out.

the-fourth-estate.title: The Fourth Estate
the-fourth-estate.description: Fourth Estate kahani hai do aise rivals ki, jo zindgi ke do alag raaston par chalte hue, ek doosre se ulajh jaate hain! Ek taraf hai Dinesh Raizada, jo naxalite attack mein apne poore pariwar ko kho chuka hai aur ab uski zingi ka maqsad hai naxaliyon ko khatm karna, jismein seedhi banta hai Colonel Ranjeet ka akhbaar 'Mashaal' aur doosri taraf hai Vikrant, jo politics join karke desh ke halaat badalna chahta hai, lekin apne dad ki expectations ke chalte, wo family business sambhalne ko majboor ho gaya. Life ke tedhe-medhe raaste aur power ki bhookh ne Dinesh aur Vikrant ko aamne-saamne lakakar khada to kar diya, lekin, sacchai aur sensationalism ki ladai mein kya Dinesh ka DNN bazi maarega ya Vikrant ka VBC, TRP ki andhi daud mein sabko peeche chhod dega? Kya yeh rivalry sach ka ujala laayegi, ya fir purane zakhm, ego, aur power ki aag mein sabkuch jal kar raakh ho jayea?

dragnet-the-big-grifter.title: Dragnet: The Big Grifter
dragnet-the-big-grifter.description: Gentleman Wallace a born con-man takes advantage of two used-car dealers and many others. Detective Sergeant Friday is assigned to Bunco Detail. An expert confidence man has resumed operations in the city. His criminal record dates back thirty-five years. He’s a master in the art of the gentle swindle. It ‘s Friday’s job to stop him.

dobara-life-reloaded.title: Dobara- Life Reloaded
dobara-life-reloaded.description:
Ek baar marne ke baad, life ko dobara jeene ka mauka mile, toh kya karoge?
Akshay ki kurbani Kritika ko ek nayi zindagi toh deti hai, lekin use khud ek alaukik shahar Emrald mein bhej deti hai — jahan devtaon aur karm ka khel chalta hai. Maut ke baad bhi, Akshay ka safar khatam nahi hota. Ek rahasyamayi duniya jahan har faisle ki kimat hai. Kya Akshay apne agle janm ka raaz samajh paayega, ya is safar mein usse apni kurbani se bhi badi kimat chukani padegi?

raising-the-bar.title: Raising The Bar
raising-the-bar.description: Dr. Dylan Warren is too old to be swapping places with his twin but to save a career-making deal he’ll play his part. He hadn’t counted on Harper the sexy nosy contractor being able to tell the difference between them. Dylan has never made any bones about being bisexual but he’s never experienced two lovers in his bed before. Suddenly he’s in lust with not only Harper but also the hot bartender serving him more than drinks. Between Freddy a beautiful woman who seems to know him better than he knows himself and Harper a man who won’t take no for an answer Dylan finds himself in that most uncomfortable of places—falling in love and not sure what to do about it…with two people. Warning: Losing a bet may lead to sex clubs threesomes and spankings. One sexy psychiatrist one giant hunk of a contractor and one cute blond bartender combine in all imaginable configurations…and then some.

dark-spies.title: Dark Spies
dark-spies.description: When Will Cochrane encounters a Russian spymaster codenamed Antaeus who everyone believes is dead he is thrust into a deadly game set in motion by powerful players deep inside the intelligence community. His orders from Langley are clear: ANTAEUS MUST NOT BE TOUCHED. FURTHER INQUIRIES REQUIRE PROJECT FERRYMAN CLEARANCE. But Will decides to take his own shot at the spymaster knowing it will make him a marked man. Now the only way to save his career - and his life - is to get into the U.S. and expose the truth about Project Ferryman. But to accomplish that he's got to outmaneuver deadly Russian assassins and an elite FBI team controlled by shadowy officials who will stop at nothing to keep their sins and secrets safe.

cartel-season-2.title: Cartel - Season 2
cartel-season-2.description: Rishton mein dhokha, shehar mein drugs ka jaal – aur beech mein ek officer jo sachai ko be-naqab karne ke liye jaan ki baazi laga dega. Kya hoga aage?

lightning-rods.title: Lightning Rods
lightning-rods.description: Joe, a failed salesman, struggles to sell both encyclopedias and vacuum cleaners, drowning in pity pies from sympathetic customers. Frustrated and living in his trailer, he dreams up a bizarre yet profitable solution: Lightning Rods Inc. His idea—an anonymous outlet for male employees' sexual urges to prevent harassment—catapults him into corporate success. But as Lightning Rods grows, Joe finds himself at the center of absurd corporate insanity, raising provocative questions about workplace culture and morality in this biting satire on American capitalism.

flowering-judas.title: Flowering Judas
flowering-judas.description: Twelve years ago, Chester Morton vanished from his New York hometown without a trace. His mother tirelessly pursued every lead, refusing to give up on finding him. Now, Chester’s body has been discovered hanging from a billboard that ironically advertised his disappearance—but the corpse is recent. With limited resources, the local police enlist Gregor Demarkian, a former FBI agent, to unravel this tragic mystery. As Demarkian delves deeper, he must uncover what truly happened twelve years ago and why Chester’s fate remained hidden for so long.

bisrakh-ravan-ka-gaon.title: Bisrakh : Ravan Ka Gaon
bisrakh-ravan-ka-gaon.description: Ravan ke gaon Bisrakh ki kahani, jaha har kone mein ek raaz chhupa hai.Gaon jo sirf apne naam ke liye nahi, balki apne rahasya aur mythology ke liye bhi jaana jata hai. Suniye is khas show mein Kai ansuni kahaniyan.

he-loved-me-skinny-left-me-fat.title: He Loved Me Skinny, Left Me Fat
he-loved-me-skinny-left-me-fat.description:
Betrayed. Abandoned. Reborn. 
Ellie's world crumbles when her husband leaves her for a skinny yoga instructed. Believed dead after a tragic accident, she returns as Rebecca James - a stunning business mogul with vengeance in her heart. As she infiltrates her ex's life, Ellie weaves a web of manipulation, determined to destroy the man who discarded her. But in a world of money, lies, and unexpected twists, her carefully orchestrated plan may backfire. "He Loved Me Skinny, Left Me Fat" is a gripping tale of transformation and retribution, where every move could lead to triumph or disaster. Will Ellie's thirst for revenge consume her, or will she find redemption in the most unexpected places?

சிகப்பாக-ஒரு-நிழல்.title: சிகப்பாக ஒரு நிழல்
சிகப்பாக-ஒரு-நிழல்.description: சங்கர், நிழல்போல் திரியும் மர்மங்கள் நிறைந்த வாழ்க்கையில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ள, சிகப்பு நிழல் அவனைச் சுட்டெரிக்க நெருங்குகிறது. அந்த நிழலின் ரகசியம் கண்டுபிடிக்கப்படுமா, அல்லது சங்கரை முழுமையாக விழுங்கிவிடுமா?

ceo-of-casanova.title: CEO of Casanova
ceo-of-casanova.description: Ek mysterious app, jiske chakkar mein panskar ek teenager,  apni feelings, relationships aur future ke saath gamble kar baithta hai. Kya wo wapis  control kar payega apni life ko?

sister-rincy.title: Sister Rincy
sister-rincy.description: ഉരുൾപൊട്ടലിൽ എല്ലാം നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട റിൻസി, അപ്രതീക്ഷിത ഗർഭത്തിൽ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ പുതിയ അർത്ഥം കണ്ടെത്തുന്നു. അഞ്ച് വർഷങ്ങൾക്കപ്പുറം, പുതുജീവിതത്തിന്റെ പടിവാതിൽക്കൽ നിൽക്കെ, മരണത്തെ വെല്ലുവിളിച്ച്  തന്റെ കാമുകൻ റിയാസ് മടങ്ങിയെത്തുന്നു - ഇനി എന്ത്?

85a10ee7-c332-4d68-adf0-26994cb21a52.title: Secret Lover
85a10ee7-c332-4d68-adf0-26994cb21a52.description: కలిసిన ప్రతీ మనిషి స్నేహితులు కాలేరు, స్నేహితులు అయినా ప్రతి వాళ్ళు ప్రేమికులుగా మారలేరు. చదివితే కానీ పుస్తకం విలువ తెలియదు, కోలిపోతే తప్ప ప్రేమ విలువ తెలియదు. మనల్ని యుద్ధం చేసేలా చేసేది ప్రేమ, మనతో మనకే అంతర్యుద్ధం చేసేలా చేసేది ప్రేమ!  అలాంటి ప్రేమ విలువ తీసేలా చేసేది మొహం! ప్రేమతో దగ్గర అయ్యినవాడు దూరమైనప్పుడు జ్ఞాపకాలతో బ్రతుకుతాడు ఏమో కానీ, మొహం తో దూరం అయిన వాడి మనసు మార్చడం అసాధ్యం. ఈ ప్రేమ కు మొహానికి మధ్యన జరిగే నిత్యమైన సంఘర్షణే ఈ ప్రేమొహం!

feng-shui-tips-sudharein-ghar-ka-vastu.title: Feng Shui Tips : Sudharein Ghar Ka Vastu
feng-shui-tips-sudharein-ghar-ka-vastu.description: Ghar ka achha vastu aapki life ko bhi perfect bana sakta hai! Feng Shui ke proven techniques se ghar ko banayein happy aur positive energy ka powerhouse.Toh abhi sunana shuru kariye aur apne ghar ko banaiye ek perfect space!

aryabhata-the-cosmos-whisperer.title: Aryabhata: The Cosmos Whisperer
aryabhata-the-cosmos-whisperer.description: Just as the moon reflects the sun's light, reflect the brilliance within yourself. Illuminate the world with the knowledge you possess".ఆర్యభట్ట మన భారతదేశం గర్వించదగ్గ గణిత, ఖగోళ శాస్త్రవేత్త. ఆయన కనిపెట్టిన సున్నా మరియు ఖగోళ రహస్యాల చుట్టూ తిరిగే డ్రమాటిక్ స్టోరీ మీకోసం. "

amogh-astra.title: Amogh Astra
amogh-astra.description: Jab ek cab driver par murder ka ilzaam lagta hai, aur sach chhupane wali chaalein tez ho jaati hain, detective Amogh Agnihotri ko apne hi andheron se ladna padega. Kya voh sachai ko dhoondh payega, ya ek aur kahani raaz ban kar reh jayegi?"

bow-down.title: Bow Down
bow-down.description:
She never thought that she would beg or even bow. And then she met him. Markela aka Bossi is in a league of her own. She has written off love based on her past and what was displayed to her as a child. She is a beautiful full-figured woman thriving and maintaining her rehab clinics that were passed down to her from her mother. Trauma keeps her locked into a world of her own until the universe speaks and sends her him…

He never thought he would change up the way he operated as an alpha male. Symere aka Dinero has a million ways to give a woman what she needs sexually. Romantic intimacy is the one thing that he is devoid of. During the day he's a financial advisor and the CEO of Fugotti Enterprise. At night he collects bloody debts on behalf of his uncle Timothy Fugotti Sr. Symere never thought that a woman could have him so smitten. Markela literally came crashing into him making him question his way of doing things. This book will warm you up like a warm summer day. It will drive you fast around a cliff and just when you thought you would fall off from all of its twist and turns it brings you back to a world full of comfort. Symere will have you questioning all of your darkest desires when it comes to a man making a woman bow down and surrender to his dominant nature. The authentic and unexpected love that builds between Symere and Markela throughout this book is the kind of love we look for in real life but only seem to find within the pages of a book.

doctor-strange-dimension-war.title: Doctor Strange: Dimension War
doctor-strange-dimension-war.description: A self-centered healer Stephen Strange is arrogant but it's almost justified. After all he is one of the best surgeons in the country. However that all takes a dark turn following a horrific car crash. The doctor survives but at a great cost: his hands are irreparably damaged and he can no longer perform surgery. No doctor can help him. Nor can faith healers or gurus. Nearing the end of his rope he seeks out mystic help from the Ancient One a man rumoured to possess unearthly talents. The Ancient One isn’t able to heal his hands but he teaches Stephen the mystic arts as well as discipline self-restraint and eventually selflessness. These qualities soon lead him to clash with his fellow student Baron Mordo. After completing his training Doctor Strange leaves the temple and uses his magical powers to defend the Earth from arcane threats that few humans can conceive of— battling rival sorcerers thwarting Nightmare the malevolent ruler of dreams and daring to defy the terrifying despot of the Dark Dimension Dormammu. This creative novelization of Stan Lee and Steve Ditko’s original Doctor Strange stories sees Doctor Strange magically transform from a vain egoist to one of Earth’s greatest defenders.

love-ka-the-end.title: Love Ka The End
love-ka-the-end.description: Dil ne pyaar kiya, dimaag mein tha revenge. Kya hoga jab tootega trust aur hoga love ka ultimate test! Kya mohabbat karegi survive ya hoga ‘Love Ka The End’

behrouz-gets-lucky.title: Behrouz Gets Lucky
behrouz-gets-lucky.description: Where can a middle-aged Persian-American genderqueer dyke find love these days? Online dating of course! Only butch dykes need apply Behrouz writes eager to swap quiet evenings and a drawer full of well-used sex toys for a real relationship. Enter a response from Lucky: younger rougher dominant and far from perfect. Their first meeting explodes into powerful rough and panting sex and Behrouz is soon determined not to let this captivating woman slip away.

dead-low-tide.title: Dead Low Tide
dead-low-tide.description: While most of the residents in the wealthy historic Charleston enclave of Landgrave Hall are asleep at two-thirty in the morning Huger Dillard and his father Unc are heading to the adjoining golf course. Blinded by a terrible accident that killed his wife Unc prefers to practice his golf game when no one is watching. But before anyone can even tee off Huger makes a grisly find: a woman's body anchored deep in the mud. The discovery sets off a chain of events that puts Huger and his family up against secret military forces shadowy global networks and more. The only thing connecting them all is Landgrave Hall - and the treacherous reason why this area is so important to so many people.

kailash-parvat-ansuljhi-paheli.title: Kailash Parvat : Ansuljhi Paheli
kailash-parvat-ansuljhi-paheli.description: Kya aaj bhi Bhagwan SHIV Kailash parvat par tapasya karte hain? Kyun aaj tak koi kailash parvat ke shikhar par nahin chadh paaya? Aise bahut sare secrets aur mysteries ko janane ke liye suniye ye Audio show.

rebel.title: రెబెల్
rebel.description: ఎవరైనా ఎందుకు ప్రాణాలకు హామీ లేని ఉద్యమాల్ని కావాలని కావిలించుకుంటారు? ఎందుకని తమ పరిసరాల మీద తెగించి తిరుగబడతారు? చివరికి, ఎందుకని తిరుగుబాట్ల మీద కూడా తిరుగబడతారు? అలాంటి మనుషులు ఎలా ‘తయారవుతా’రు? వాళ్లు అలా అవడానికి, పార్టీల్లోనయినా బయటయినా ‘రెబెల్స్’ గా ఉంటానికి భౌతిక, మానసిక కారణాల అన్వేషణ ఈ నవల. పవన్ కుమార్ అనే ఒక సామాన్యుని కథ ఇది. బతుకు పయనంలో భాగంగా, ఉద్యమంలోనికి బయటికి అతడి ‘ట్రావెలోగ్’ ఈ నవల

the-rise-of-the-witch-queen-and-devil-ki.title: The Rise Of The Witch Queen And Devil King
the-rise-of-the-witch-queen-and-devil-ki.description: Seren, the feared daughter of a witch, is forced into marriage with Drayce, the devil’s son and ruthless King of Megaris. Expecting only darkness, Seren instead finds a fierce protector in Drayce, and an unexpected connection forms between them. As their passion ignites, they must embrace their powerful bond to face the dangers that threaten them—or risk losing everything.

valley-of-death.title: Valley of Death
valley-of-death.description: Ek maahir trekker, Justin Reynolds, maut ki ghaati 'Parvati Valley' ke mysterious aur exciting rahasyo mein phans jata hai. Ek purani gufa aur hidden secrets uski life ka sabse bada sawaal ban jaate hain – Kya woh apne sapne aur zindagi ke beech ki yeh ladai jeet payega, ya fir ye valley of death usey bhi nigal legi!!

cursed-vision.title: Cursed Vision
cursed-vision.description: After a humiliating breakup, Ethan discovers he can see through clothes and objects, navigating the complexities of his new powers while grappling with betrayal and a cursed engagement ring that holds dark secrets.

contract-love.title: Contract Love
contract-love.description: "Startup funding ke sapne mein uljhi Ananya ek aise contract par sign kar baithti hai, jahan mysterious billionaire Agastya, kisi bhi had tak jaane ka haq rakhta hai. Sapne, mohabbat aur fayde ka yeh khel kahaan tak jayega?"

devils-broadcast.title: Devil's Broadcast
devils-broadcast.description: Nora, a curious podcaster, unwittingly unleashes an ancient evil through her broadcast, setting off a chain of supernatural events that challenge her sanity, relationships, and the fate of humanity itself.

kaasi-yaatra-charitra.title: కాశీ యాత్ర చరిత్ర
kaasi-yaatra-charitra.description: ఎనుగుల వీరాస్వామయ్య తన కాశీ యాత్రను 1830ల్లో ప్రారంభించాడు. ఆయన కాశీకి వెళ్ళే మార్గంలో వివిధ ప్రాంతాలను సందర్శిస్తూ, ఆయా ప్రాంతాల సంప్రదాయాలు, భక్తుల విధులు, కాశీ నగరం సాంస్కృతిక ప్రాధాన్యతలను తన సొంత అనుభవాలతో ఈ రచనలో వివరించారు. ప్రతి దశలో ఆయన ప్రయాణంలో ఎదురైన సవాళ్ళు, అద్భుత అనుభవాలు, కాశీ పుణ్యక్షేత్రంలో గల భక్తుల ఆచారాలను అభివర్ణించారు.

The-Battle-for-Kohinoor--एलिजाबेथ-के-ताज.title: Kohinoor Ki Khooni Jung
The-Battle-for-Kohinoor--एलिजाबेथ-के-ताज.description: Kya Kohinoor sach mein shapit hai? Kya ye sach hai ki Nadir Shah ne sirf Kohinoor paane ke liye 30,000 Dilli-walon ko zinda jala diya tha? Kya wajah thi ki Raja Ranjit Singh ke baad unke 5 bete aur pote ek-ek karke maare gaye? Kohinoor ko kaatne ke baad 5 British scientists ki maut kaise hui? Jab hum Kohinoor ka Itihaas jaanne ki koshish karte hain to aise kai zaroori sawalon ke jawab samane aa jate hain. Golconda ki khaanon se London Tower tak faili hui hai duniya ke sabse vivaadit heere ki kahani. Ye show aapko Kohinoor ka poora itihaas batayega.

nathicharami.title: Secret Husband
nathicharami.description: 'ಮದುವೆ' ಅನ್ನೋದು ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಲ್ಲೇ ನಿಶ್ವಯವಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತಾರೆ. ಈ ಮಾತಿನಂತೆ ಪ್ಯಾನ್ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಪ್ರೊಡ್ಯೂಸರ್ ಜೈದೇವ್, ವೆಡ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಪ್ಲ್ಯಾನರ್ ನಂದಿನಿಯ ವಿವಾಹಬಂಧ ಏರ್ಪಡುತ್ತೆ! ಆದ್ರೆ ನಂದಿನಿಗೆ ಈಗಾಗ್ಲೇ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ! ಮಕ್ಕಳಿದ್ದೂ ನಂದಿನಿ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ಯಾಕೆ? ಆ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ತಂದೆ ಯಾರು? ಜೆಡಿಗೂ ನಂದಿನಿಗೂ ಇದ್ದ ಊಹಿಸಲಾಗದ ಕನೆಕ್ಷನ್ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ರೊಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಹಸ್ಬೆಂಡ್'.. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

8e36a09f-9772-4e45-b049-475fb753b25b.title: మన్మధ లీలలు
8e36a09f-9772-4e45-b049-475fb753b25b.description: ఇంట్లో అందమైన భార్య ఉండి కూడా అతను తన ఆఫీసులో పనిచేసే సంగీతతో  ఎఫైర్  పెట్టుకున్నాడు. వాళ్ళిద్దరి రొమాన్స్ ని  ఒకడు వీడియో తీసి  బెదిరించాడు. వీడియో వాళ్లకి ఇవ్వాలంటే  ఎన్నో కండిషన్స్ పెట్టాడు. ఆ కండిషన్లకి ఆమె ఒప్పుకుంటుందా? వాళ్ళు చెప్పినట్లు చేసిందా? చదువుకునే వయసులో చదవరాని పుస్తకాలు చదివాడు యశ్వంత్.  ట్యూషన్ టీచర్ స్వప్న కే పాఠాలు  నేర్పించాడు. అవేం పుస్తకాలు? ఆ పుస్తకాలు అతని   జీవితంపై ఎలాంటి ప్రభావం చూపాయి, అతని జీవితాన్ని ఎలాంటి మలుపులు తిప్పాయి? ఎప్పుడూ పూజలు వ్రతాలు నోములు అంటూ భర్తని దూరంగా పెట్టే భార్య మైండ్ ఒక్కసారిగా చేంజ్ అయింది. ఆ పుస్తకాల ప్రభావం ఆమెపై పడింది. కానీ ఆమెలోని మార్పుని అతను ఎంజాయ్ చేయలేకపోయాడు ఎందుకు?

maa-durga-aarti.title: Maa Durga Aarti
maa-durga-aarti.description: Maa Durga Ki Aarti sunein Aur banayein apna jeewan sukhmay.

అర్జునుడి-ప్రేమ-కథలు.title: అర్జునుడి ప్రేమ కథలు
అర్జునుడి-ప్రేమ-కథలు.description: మీరు ఎప్పుడూ వినని అర్జునుడి ప్రేమ కథలు మీకోసం. ఆద్యంతం ఆసక్తిగా సాగే అర్జునుడి ప్రేమ కథలు వింటూ మన పౌరాణికాల గొప్పదనం తెలుసుకోండి.

devils-corner.title: Devils Corner
devils-corner.description: മലയാളത്തിലെ ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലറുകളുടെ രാജാവ് കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥിന്റെ ഡിറ്റക്റ്റീവ്  മാർക്സിൻ നയനാകുന്ന  ഒരു ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലർ. കേൾക്കാം, Devil's Corner!

sai-baba-aarti.title: Sai Baba Aarti
sai-baba-aarti.description: Abhi Sunein Sai Baba Ki Divya Aarti aur banayein Apna Jeewan Safal.

athazhapashnikkarundo-malayalikalude-ach.title: അത്താഴപ്പഷ്ണിക്കാരുണ്ടോ: മലയാളിയുടെ ആചാരങ്ങളും അനാചാരങ്ങളും
athazhapashnikkarundo-malayalikalude-ach.description:
ആചാരങ്ങളും അനാചാരങ്ങളും ഒരുപാടുണ്ടായിരുന്ന നാടാണ് കേരളം. അനാചാരങ്ങളുടെ ഇരുട്ടില്‍ കുടുങ്ങിക്കിടന്ന ഭൂതകാലമുണ്ട് കേരളത്തിന്. പലതും ഇന്ന് അദ്യശ്യമായെ
 ങ്കിലും, ചിലതെല്ലാം പിന്തുടര്‍ന്ന് പോരുന്നുണ്ടാവാം. ഏതൊക്കെയായിരുന്നു ആ ആചാരങ്ങള്‍, എന്തൊക്കെയാണ് മനുഷ്യരെ പല തട്ടില്‍ നിര്‍ത്തിയ ദുരാചാരങ്ങള്‍ എന്നെല്ലാം ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിലൂടെ കേട്ടറിയാം.

board-roomina-sutta-baaga-1.title: Board Roomina Sutta Baaga 1
board-roomina-sutta-baaga-1.description: ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಅಪ್ ಆರಂಭಿಸುವವರಿಗೂ, ಐದು ವರ್ಷ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಅನುಭವವಿರುವವರಿಗೂ, ಪ್ರಗತಿಗೆ ಮುಂದೇನು ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಎಂಬ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ, ಸತ್ಯೇಶ್ ಬೆಳ್ಳೂರ್ ಅವರು 33 ವರ್ಷದ ಅನುಭವದಿಂದ 50 ಲೇಖನಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

shani-dev-aarti.title: Shani Dev : Aarti
shani-dev-aarti.description: Jeewan Mein chal raha hai Rahu-Ketu Ka Kaal to Shani Dev ki aarti sunkar door hongi saari pareshaniyan. Roz suniye bhagwan Shani Dev ki Aarti.

my-dark-web-app.title: My Dark Web App
my-dark-web-app.description:
They say there's an app for everything, but Kevin never expected it to be his gateway to the dark web and the underworld.
When his smartphone starts dishing out quests and rewards, Kevin's ordinary life in New York City takes a sharp turn into the extraordinary. Suddenly, he's dodging mobsters, outsmarting federal agents, and unraveling conspiracies that run deeper than the city's subway system.
With each completed task, the stakes—and the rewards—grow higher. But in a game where the rules keep changing, can Kevin stay ahead without losing himself?
Get ready for a thrilling ride where one swipe could mean the difference between striking gold and sleeping with the fishes.

maa-lakshmi-aarti.title: Maa Lakshmi : Aarti
maa-lakshmi-aarti.description: Jeewan mein hain paiso ki samasya se pareshan to rozana kijiye Maa Lakshmi Ka dhyaan. Subah Maa Lakshmi ki aarti sunane se barsegi Maa Lakshmi Ki Kripa.

nammane-aliya.title: Nammane Aliya
nammane-aliya.description: ಪ್ರೀತಿಗೋಸ್ಕರ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಗಳು ಏನು ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೂ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಈ ಮಾತಿಗೆ ಬೆಸ್ಟ್ ಎಕ್ಸಾಂಪಲ್ ನಮ್ಮ‌ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ 'ಆಕಾಶ್ ಪಟೇಲ್'! ಮಿಲಿಯನೇರ್ ಆಕಾಶ್, ಅದಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮನೆ ಅಳಿಯನಾಗ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದ್ರೂ ಆ 'ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಪಿ' ಅವನನ್ನ ಕಾಡುತ್ತೆ! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಆಕಾಶ್ ಯಾರು? ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಲವ್ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಶುರುವಾಯ್ತು? ಯಾಕೆ ತಾನು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಆಕಾಶ್ ಮರೆಮಾಚಿದ? ಏನಿದು ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಪಿ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ 'ನಮ್ಮನೆ ಅಳಿಯ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್! ಕೇಳಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ!

how-to-prepare-for-civil-services.title: How to Prepare for Civil Services
how-to-prepare-for-civil-services.description: సివిల్ సర్వీసెస్ లో విజయం ఎలా సాధించాలో, పరీక్షకు ఎలా సిద్ధమవ్వాలో, తెలియజేసే సంపూర్ణ వివరణ మీకోసం.

shiv-aarti.title: Shiv Aarti
shiv-aarti.description: Abhi Suniye Shiv Aarti, kariye Bhagwan Shiv Ka Dhayaan aur paaiye Sukh, Shanti tatha Dukhon Ka Samadhan.

వకీల్-సాబ్-నిజం--Inspired-by-real-life-c.title: వకీల్ సాబ్- నిజం - Inspired by real life court cases
వకీల్-సాబ్-నిజం--Inspired-by-real-life-c.description: అమాయకుడైన ఓ గిరిజన యువకుడిని డ్రగ్స్, తీవ్ర వాదుల కేసుల్లో ఇరికించడానికి అవినీతిపరులైన పోలీసులు ఎలాంటి ప్రయత్నాలు చేశారన్న కధనంతో రూపుదిద్దుకున్న కథ. ఆ గిరిజనుడిని, అతని బిడ్డను రక్షించడానికి ఓ యువతి చేసిన సాహసాన్ని అద్దం పట్టే కథ ఇది. ఆద్యంతం ఆసక్తికరంగా సాగే ఈ కథనం అన్యాయంగా శిక్షలు అనుభవిస్తున్న అమాయక జీవుల జీవితాలను కళ్లకు కట్టినట్లు చూపిస్తుంది.

vivada-keralam-keralathe-ulacha-vivadasa.title: വിവാദ കേരളം - കേരളത്തെ ഉലച്ച വിവാദസംഭവങ്ങള്‍
vivada-keralam-keralathe-ulacha-vivadasa.description: കഴിഞ്ഞ ദശാബ്ദങ്ങളില്‍ മലയാള മാധ്യമലോകത്ത് ഏറ്റവും അഘോഷിക്കപ്പെട്ട ഒരു പിടി സംഭവവികാസങ്ങളുടെ വിശദമായ പഠനമാണ് ഈ പുസ്തകം. രാഷ്ട്രീയ ആരോപണങ്ങള്‍ മുതല്‍ നാടിനെ നടുക്കിയ കൊലപാതകങ്ങളുടെ വരെയുളളവയുടെ  നാള്‍വഴികളും സൂക്ഷ്മ യാഥാർത്ഥ്യങ്ങളും കാട്ടിത്തരുന്നു ഈ പുസ്തകം.

fifty-shades-of-pleasure.title: Fifty Shades Of Pleasure
fifty-shades-of-pleasure.description: Ek bold journalist ne controversial BDSM club ki dark duniya mein kadam rakha, jahaan desires aur boundaries ke beech woh apne hi ek aise version se milti hai jo is life ko khul kar enjoy karta hai—kya woh us version ko apnana chahegi ya bandh kar reh jayegi society ki Good girl image me?

മർഡോമെട്രി-.title: മർഡോമെട്രി
മർഡോമെട്രി-.description: പീരുമേട് സ്റ്റേഷനിലെ സബ് ഇൻസ്‌പെക്ടർ സാവിയോയെ തേടി എത്തിയത് കുഴപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഒരു കണക്കു ചോദ്യമാണ്. ഒരു കൊടും കുറ്റവാളിയെ കണ്ടെത്താൻ ഉള്ള ഏക വഴി ഈ കണക്കിന് ഉത്തരങ്ങൾ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നതാണ്  . കേൾക്കാം, സിബി ജോൺ തൂവൽ രചിച്ച വ്യത്യസ്തമായ ഒരു ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലർ.

രതിപർവ്വം.title: രതിപർവ്വം
രതിപർവ്വം.description: കാമത്തിന് കണ്ണില്ല എന്ന്  പറയുന്നത് കണ്ണന്റെ കാര്യത്തിൽ ശരിയാണ്. ഒരു നല്ല ഭാര്യ ഉണ്ടായിട്ടും, തന്റെ ലൈംഗിക താല്പര്യങ്ങൾ തൃപ്തിപ്പെടുത്താൻ അയാൾ  മറ്റൊരു സ്ത്രീയുടെ സാന്നിധ്യം തേടുന്നു. അയാളുടെ കാമകേളിയുടെ വീഡിയോ മറ്റൊരാൾ ലീക്ക് ചെയ്‌താൽ എന്താകും സംഭവിക്കുക? കേൾക്കാം, ആവേശകരമായ പ്രണയമിനിമിഷങ്ങളും ട്വിസ്റ്റുകളും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു ത്രില്ലർ - രതിപർവ്വം!

kanpur-ka-khalnayak-vikas-dubey-ki-kahan.title: Kanpur Ka Khalnayak - Vikas Dubey ki Kahani
kanpur-ka-khalnayak-vikas-dubey-ki-kahan.description: "Kanpur Ka Khalnayak" ek hairatangez aur tehqiqat se bhari kahani hai, jo Vikas Dubey ke dar aur junoon se bharpoor safar ko be-parda karti hai. Yeh show aapko Kanpur ke andheron mein chhipe us khalnayak ke zindagi ke modon aur khaufnaak dastaanon se milaayega, jisse kanoon aur apraadh ka sabse bada takraav hua. Janiye kaise ek aam aadmi khauf ka doosra naam ban gaya aur Kanpur ke itihaas mein apni ek dark story chhod gaya.

nehala.title: Nehala
nehala.description: ಡಾ. ಕೆ. ಎನ್. ಗಣೇಶಯ್ಯ ಅವರ 'ನೇಹಲ' ಕಥಾ ಸಂಕಲನದಲ್ಲಿ 8 ಕತೆಗಳಿದ್ದು, ಇವು ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಸ್ಕೈ-ಫೈ, ಮನೋವಿಜ್ಞಾನ, ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಕಳಕಳಿಯಂತಹ ವಿವಿಧ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿವೆ. ಭಾಸ್ಕರಾಚಾರ್ಯ, ಲೀಲಾವತಿ, ಕೃಷ್ಣದೇವರಾಯ, ಅಲ್ಲೂರಿ ಸೀತಾರಾಮರಾಜು, ಏಕಾಂತ ರಾಮಯ್ಯ ಇಂತಹ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಕಾಲಘಟ್ಟದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದ ಕುತೂಹಲಕಾರಿ ಕಥಾವಸ್ತುಗಳು ಈ ಸಂಕಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಕವಾಗಿವೆ.

mumbai-goa-cruise-murder-case.title: Mumbai Goa Cruise Murder Case
mumbai-goa-cruise-murder-case.description: Ek luxury cruise par adventure ke excitement se shuru hua shandar safar achanak badal gaya murder ki ek khufnaak mystery mein! Kaun hai is qatil khel ka shikaari, aur kaise suljhegi ye mystery!!

ippattentu-hanategalu.title: Ippattentu Hanategalu
ippattentu-hanategalu.description: ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಏನಾಗಿದರೂ ಅದಕ್ಕೊಂದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕಾರಣ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಅನುಭವ ಮತ್ತು ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಇಂತಹ ಹಲವು ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುವ ಉತ್ತಮ ಕೃತಿ "ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತೆಂಟು ಹಣತೆಗಳು".

my-psycho-lover-2.title: My Psycho Lover
my-psycho-lover-2.description: ആറ് വര്‍ഷങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് മുന്‍പുള്ള ആ രാത്രികള്‍ സന്ധ്യയെ ഇപ്പോഴും വേട്ടയാടുകയാണ്. ജോലി ചെയ്യുകയായിരുന്ന ആശുപത്രിയില്‍ വെച്ച നേഴ്‌സ് ആയ തനിക്ക് നേരെ ഉണ്ടായത് ഒരു പെണ്ണിനും ചിന്തിക്കാന്‍ കഴിയാത്ത കാര്യങ്ങളാണ്. അച്ഛനും അമ്മയും ഇല്ലാത്ത അവളെ സ്വന്തക്കാരും ഒടുവില്‍ ആട്ടിയകറ്റി.  തളരാതെ പൊരുതിയ സന്ധ്യയ്ക്കിപ്പോള്‍ പുതിയ മുഖമാണ്. പകയുടെ കനല്‍ ഉള്ളില്‍ കൊണ്ട് നടക്കുന്ന സന്ധ്യ  തിരിച്ച് കേരളത്തിലെത്തിയത് എന്തിനാണ്? എന്തൊക്കെയാണ് അവളെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നത്?

military-girl.title: Military Girl
military-girl.description:
"Mom.. Mujhe akhir kab tak ladka bankar jeena hoga!"  
Ek maa apni beti ko janm se hi ek ladka banaakar jeene ke liye kyun majboor hai? Kya viyona ki 10 hazaar saal baad firse janm lene ki koi khaas wajah hai? Future ki  advance duniya mein, apne Virtual Assistant ki madad se Training puri karke, kya vo apne pita ki tarah ek mahaan yodhha ban paayegi? Aur kya hoga jab Planet ke logo or Military ko pata chalega ki uska asli naam Vihaan nahi.. balki Viyona hai!

prachina-bharatadesa-charitra.title: ప్రాచీన భారతదేశ చరిత్ర
prachina-bharatadesa-charitra.description: భారతదేశపు పురాతన సంస్కృతులు, సామ్రాజ్యాలు, శిల్పకళలు, వేదాలు, ధార్మిక విశ్వాసాలు మొదలైన అంశాల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? విభిన్న సామ్రాజ్యాల పెరుగుదల, వాటి పతనం, మరియు వాటి ప్రభావం గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? భారతదేశపు ప్రాచీన చరిత్రను ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

1857-manam-marachina-maha-yuddham.title: 1857 మనం మరచిన మహా యుద్ధం
1857-manam-marachina-maha-yuddham.description: భారతదేశంలో 1857లో జరిగిన మొదటి స్వాతంత్ర్య పోరాటం గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? ఈ యుద్ధాన్ని బ్రిటిష్ పరిపాలనకు వ్యతిరేకంగా  మొదటి పెద్ద ఎత్తున జరిగిన తిరుగుబాటుగా పరిగణిస్తారు. ఇందులో భారత సైనికులు, రైతులు, మరియు సామాన్య ప్రజలు తమ స్వేచ్ఛ కోసం చేసిన పోరాటాన్ని, సంఘటనల సమగ్ర చరిత్రను మరియు అందులో పాల్గొన్న నాయకుల పాత్రలను "1857 మనం మరచిన మహా యుద్ధం" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ ద్వారా విని తెలుసుకోండి.

one-day-billionaire.title: One Day Billionaire
one-day-billionaire.description: College ki fees mushkil se bhar paane wala Sameer bread khakar guzara karta hai, par ek din jab uske hath ek sikka hath lagta hai to uski duniya badal jaati hai. Agle 24 ghante mein use pata chalta hai ki wo ek billionaire hai aur usko apni saari daulat ek mysterious system ke according spend karni hai. Yahin nahi uska samna hota hai behad powerful dushmano se. Kya Sameer bacha payega apni daulat aur power aur ban payega One Day Billionaire?

Rich-Dad-Poor-Dad-రిచ్-డాడ్-పూర్-డాడ్.title: రిచ్ డాడ్ పూర్ డాడ్
Rich-Dad-Poor-Dad-రిచ్-డాడ్-పూర్-డాడ్.description: మధ్య మరియు పేద తరగతి తల్లిదండ్రులు తమ పిల్లలకు ఎప్పుడూ నేర్పించని డబ్బు విషయాలు ధనవంతులు తమ పిల్లలకు ఏమి నేర్పిస్తారు? జీవితంలో ఎప్పుడూ రిస్క్‌లు ఉంటాయి కానీ పారిపోవడం కంటే వాటిని ఎదుర్కోవడం నేర్చుకోవాలి. ఈ ఆడియో పుస్తకంలో రాబర్ట్ కియోసాకి  విజయాన్ని ఎలా సాధించాలో అనేక ఉదాహరణలు ఇచ్చారు.

balya-sakha.title: Balya Sakha
balya-sakha.description: ಗೆಳೆಯತನಕ್ಕೆ ಜಾತಿ, ವರ್ಗ, ಅಥವಾ ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನ ಅಡ್ಡ ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅವಳು ಮಧ್ಯಮವರ್ಗದ ಗೃಹಿಣಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಅವನು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ. ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಅವಳ ಬಾಸ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದರೂ, ಅವಳ ಕಷ್ಟ ಸುಖಗಳಿಗೆ ಸದಾ ಸ್ಪಂದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವಳ ಪತಿಯ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಸ್ವಭಾವ ಅವಳನ್ನು ಸಂಕಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿಟ್ಟು ಕಾಟ ನೀಡುವಾಗ, ಅವಳ ಬಾಲ್ಯದ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸ್ನೇಹ ಮತ್ತು ದಾಂಪತ್ಯದ ವಿವಿಧ ಅಂಗಗಳನ್ನು ನವಿರಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಿರುವ ಅಶ್ವಿನಿ ಅವರ ಕೃತಿ 'ಬಾಲ್ಯ ಸಖ'.

bheem-gadadhari-mahaveer.title: Bheem : Gadadhari Mahaveer
bheem-gadadhari-mahaveer.description: Kya tha Pandu putra Bheem ki shaktiyon ka raaz? Kyun hua tha rakshashi Hidima se unka vivah? Kyun ki thi Bajrangbali ne unpe apni kripa? In sabhi sawalon ke jawab hai is audio show mein! To Abhi Sunana Shuru Kijiye.

kanmareyada-kathegalu-bhaaga-1.title: Kanmareyada Kathegalu Bhaaga - 1
kanmareyada-kathegalu-bhaaga-1.description: ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯ. ಇವುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಾಲ್ಯದಿಂದಲೇ ಕಲಿಸಿದ್ರೆ ಬದುಕು ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಇಂಥ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ನೀತಿ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಇಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾದ ಕತೆಗಳು ಭಾಗ - 1' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್

unknown-facts-of-indian-mythology.title: Unknown facts of Indian Mythology
unknown-facts-of-indian-mythology.description: కనీవినీ యెరుగని భారత పురాణాల్లో దాగి ఉన్న అంతుచిక్కని రహస్యాల సమాహారం మీకోసం.

accident-ek-rahasya-katha.title: Accident Ek Rahasya Katha
accident-ek-rahasya-katha.description: Ek khoobsurat ladki ki car accident mein maut ke kuch samay baad Bhanupratap ke chhote bete Rishabh ki sadak durghatna mein maut ho gayi. Laash parivaar ko saup di gayi aur uska vidhivat antim sanskaar kar diya gaya. Par agle hi din unke saamne jeeta-jagta Rishabh wapas aa khada hua, jise is durghatna ke baare mein kuch bhi pata nahi tha. kaun thi wo lakdi? aur kaun hai ye rishabh? zinda murda? ya koi behrupiya? jaanne ke liye sune ACCIDENT: EK RAHASYA KATHA

selected-stories-by-charles-dickens.title: Selected Stories by Charles Dickens
selected-stories-by-charles-dickens.description: “Have a heart that never hardens, and a temper that never tires, and a touch that never hurts.” మనందరిని ఊహల లోకం లో విహరింపచేసి, విలువలను నేర్పే చార్లెస్ డికెన్స్ కథలు మీకోసం.

antim-waris.title: Antim Waris
antim-waris.description: Apni gareebi se majboor Arush apni crush ko apni feelings tak nahi bata paata hai aur apna hi room use kisi aur ladke ke sath raat bitane ke liye de deta hai. Par jab Arush ko pata chalta hai ki wo ek behad rich family ka antim waris hai, to uski duniya badal jaati hai. Wo aise secrets ke bhanwar mein phans jata hai jinse wo chah kar bhi bahar nikal nahi pata hai. Kya Arush thukra dega wo daulat jisne use mummy-papa ki jaan li ya phir wo banega apni family ka 'Antim Waris'?

manmatha-leele.title: Manmatha Leele
manmatha-leele.description: ಕಾಮಕ್ಕೆ ಕಣ್ಣಿಲ್ಲಾ ಅಂತಾರೆ! ಈ‌ ಮಾತು ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ ಮೋಹನ್ ವಿಚಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ಷರಶಃ ಸತ್ಯ. ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಆರಾಧಿಸೋ ಹೆಂಡತಿ ಕಸ್ತೂರಿಯಿದ್ರೂ, ತನ್ನ ಕಾಮತೃಷೆ ತೀರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಗೀತಾಳ ತೆಕ್ಕೆಗೆ ಬೀಳ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಜಗತ್ತು ಕುರುಡಲ್ಲ ಅಲ್ವಾ! ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಕಾಮಕೇಳಿ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಮತ್ತೊಬ್ಬರ ಕೈ ಸೇರುತ್ತೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಮುಂದೇನಾಯ್ತು? ಕೇಳಿ ಹಸಿಬಿಸಿ ರೋಚಕ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ 'ಮನ್ಮಥ ಲೀಲೆ'!

forbidden-desire-one-year-to-love.title: Forbidden Desire: One Year To Love
forbidden-desire-one-year-to-love.description: With one year left to live, innocent Abigail pursues cold-hearted billionaire Quentin Blackwood, determined to experience love before she dies. As she enters his dangerous world, Abigail must navigate growing passion and protect her heart, all while the clock ticks down on her life.

lady-don-ek-aurat-hazar-raaz.title: Lady Don: Ek Aurat, Hazar Raaz
lady-don-ek-aurat-hazar-raaz.description: Ye show ek mamuli police constable se underworld ki sabse khatarnak Lady Don banne ki sacchi kahaani bayaan karta hai. Bollywood heroine banne ka sapna lekar Mumbai aayi Archana ko aakhir aisa kaun sa dhokha mila ki wo apradh ki duniya mein jane ko majboor ho gayi? Aur phir kaise usi duniya par raj kiya usne? Puri kahani jaanne ke liye suniye "Lady Don : Ek Aurat, Hazar Raaz" .

2-night-stand.title: LAILA
2-night-stand.description: అర్థరాత్రి తాగిన మత్తులో అనుకోకుండా, రిషిని కలిసిన నిషా, అతను రిచ్ పర్సన్ అనుకుని, శారీరకంగా అతనితో ఒక్కటవుతుంది. ఆ తర్వాత రిషి కార్ సేల్స్ మాన్ అని తెలుసుకుని, అతన్ని ఛీ కొట్టి వెళ్ళిపోతుంది. కానీ అప్పటికే నిషాతో ప్రేమలో పడిపోయిన రిషి, ఆమె కోసం గాలిస్తాడు. ఆ సమయంలోనే నిషా ఒక వేశ్య అనే నిజం అతనికి తెలుస్తుంది. అయినా తన ప్రేమను చంపుకోలేక పోయిన రిషి, ఆమె ప్రేమను పొందడం కోసం, ఇప్పటివరకూ ఏ మగాడు తీసుకోని ఒక వింత నిర్ణయం తీసుకుంటాడు. దాని వల్ల నిషా, రిషిల జీవితాలు ఏ మలుపులు తిరుగుతాయి?. వేశ్యగా ఉన్న నిషా, రిషి లైఫ్ లోకి వస్తుందా? అద్భుతమైన ఈ రొమాంటిక్ జర్నీలో ముందు ముందు ఏం జరుగుతుందో తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

my-girl-friend-is-a-billionaire.title: My girl friend is a billionaire
my-girl-friend-is-a-billionaire.description: Mithra is the owner of a large film production company and a multi-billionaire. She is powerful and confident. She meets a young man named Kaniyan, who has come to Chennai searching for work and is quite stubborn. They become friends. After gaining the friendship of the wealthy woman, what happens to Kaniyan? Where does it lead him?

mira-bai-krishna-ki-deewani.title: Mira Bai : Krishna Ki Deewani
mira-bai-krishna-ki-deewani.description: Mira Bai ki Krishna bhakti mein unke pati Maharaj Bhojraj ne humesha unka sath diya. Ye unka sath hi tha jisne Mira Bai ko shadi ke baad bhi Krishna bhakti karne di. Lekin unki is bhakti ka ant itna saral nahi tha. Aaiye poori kahani janein is audio show mein.

poirotinte-kuttanveshanam.title: പൊയ്‌റോട്ടിന്റെ കുറ്റാന്വേഷണം
poirotinte-kuttanveshanam.description: അഗതാ ക്രിസ്റ്റിയുടെ പ്രശസ്തമായ ഡിറ്റക്റ്റീവ്, ഹെർക്ക്യൂൾ പൊയ്‌റോട്ടിനെ  ആസ്പദമാക്കി തയ്യാറാക്കിയ കഥാസമാഹാരം. തികച്ചും വ്യത്യസ്തമായ അന്വേഷണ രീതി, നിഗൂഢതകൾ, ത്രില്ലറുകൾ, ശാസ്ത്രീയ അന്വേഷണങ്ങൾ തുടങ്ങിയവയിലൂടെ പൊയ്‌റോട്ട് ജീവിതത്തിന്റെയും മരണത്തിന്റെയും ഇരുണ്ട മുഖങ്ങളെ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു. ഡിറ്റക്ടിവ് കഥകളിലെ ഏറ്റവും മികച്ചതും, ലോകം മുഴുവൻ ഇന്നും ആദരിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന ഈ കഥാസമാഹാരം തീർച്ചയായും കേൾക്കുക.

illegal-mistress.title: Illegal Mistress
illegal-mistress.description: സഹോദരന്റെ ചികിത്സക്ക് പണമാവശ്യമായി വന്നപ്പോൾ ഗത്യന്തരമില്ലാതെ ശീതൾ ബോബിയുടെ കാമുകി ആകാമെന്ന് സമ്മതിച്ചു. എന്നാൽ കോടീശ്വരനായ ബോബിക്ക് മറ്റൊരു ഭാര്യയുണ്ടെന്നു അറിഞ്ഞപ്പോളാണ് അയാളുടെ വെപ്പാട്ടി മാത്രമാണു താനെന്നു ശീതൾ അറിയുന്നത്. ശീതൾ ഈ ബന്ധത്തിൽ തുടരുമോ? കാമവെറിയനായ ബോബി തന്നിൽ നിന്നകലാൻ അവളെ  അനുവദിക്കുമോ? സ്നേഹത്തിന്റെയും കാമത്തിന്റെയും വിശ്വസ്തതയുടെയും പല മുഖങ്ങൾ തുറന്നുകാട്ടുന്ന തീവ്രമായ കഥ കേൾക്കൂ.

spy-billionaire.title: Spy Billionaire
spy-billionaire.description: "Rounakpur ke underworld aur corporate duniya mein, ek naam hai—Vardhan Oberoi. Ek businessman aur mastermind jo apne har kadam par dusmanon ke liye jaal bicha leta hai. Badi business deals, high-profile murders aur strategic moves se bhare is kahani mein, Vardhan apne dushmano ko ek-ek kar ke phansata hai, aur apne past ki un kahaniyon se joojhta hai jo uski kamyabi aur guilt ke beech mein hain. TED Talk se board meetings tak, aur underworld se apni khud ki mazi ko kabu mein rakhne tak, Vardhan ka safar ek intriguing aur thakebi kahani hai. Uska asli muqabala tab shuru hota hai jab Srihda, ek purani pehchan aur equal rival, dobara uski zindagi mein wapas aati hai. Janiye is chakkar aur raaz se bhari kahani sirf Kuku FM par!

വിശുദ്ധ-ഖുര്‍ആന്‍-സംക്ഷിപ്തം.title: വിശുദ്ധ ഖുര്‍ആന്‍: സംക്ഷിപ്തം
വിശുദ്ധ-ഖുര്‍ആന്‍-സംക്ഷിപ്തം.description: ഇസ്ലാം മതത്തിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാന ഗ്രന്ഥമാണ് പരിശുദ്ധ ഖുര്‍ആന്‍. വിശ്വാസികളെ സംബന്ധിച്ച് അത് ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വചനമാണ്. മനുഷ്യന്റെ ധാര്‍മികവും ആത്മീയവുമായ പുരോഗതിക്കായുള്ള പാഠങ്ങളും കല്‍പനകളും വിശുദ്ധ ഖുര്‍ആന്‍ നല്‍കുന്നു.  വ്യത്യസ്ത ദൈർഘ്യമുള്ള മുപ്പത് ഭാഗങ്ങളായി ഖുർആനിനെ  വിഭജിക്കുന്നുണ്ട്, ഈ ഭാഗങ്ങൾ ഓരോന്നും  ജുസ്ഹ് എന്ന് അറിയപ്പെടുന്നു .  ഓരോ ജുസ്ഹിന്റെയും (JUZ) ഏറ്റവും ഹ്രസ്വമായ സംഗ്രഹമാണ് ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്കിൽ 30 ഭാഗങ്ങളായി നൽകിയിരിക്കുന്നത്.

brahmastra-amar-yoddhaon-ki-dastaan.title: Brahmastra :  Amar Yoddhaon Ki Dastaan
brahmastra-amar-yoddhaon-ki-dastaan.description: Brahmastra ek pauranik aur rahasyon se ghiri kahani hai, jo aapko Bharat ki sanskriti mein chhipe mahan shastron ki shakti se milvaayegi.Jaaniye Brahmastra ke rakhwale ke bare mein aur uske peeche chhipe wo gehre raaz jo aaj bhi romanch aur adbhut kahaniyon ka hissa hain.

gaadegala-kathakosha-bhaaga-1.title: Gaadegala Kathakosha Bhaaga 1
gaadegala-kathakosha-bhaaga-1.description: ಗಾದೆಗಳು ಮನರಂಜನಾಕಾರಿ ಕತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುತ್ತವೆ, ಹಾಸ್ಯ ಹಾಗೂ ವಿಡಂಬನೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡ ಆ ಕತೆಗಳ ಅಂತರಾಳದ ಆಶಯ ಒಂದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ನೀತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುವುದಾಗಿದೆ.

kempu-nakshatra.title: Kempu Nakshatra
kempu-nakshatra.description: ಈಗಾಗ್ಲೇ ಒಂದು ಆಪಾದನೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಸೆರೆವಾಸದಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಕ್ರಿಮಿನಲ್ ವಿನಂತಿ, ಜೈಲೊಳಗೆ ಇದ್ದುಕೊಂಡೇ ಇಡೀ ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಶಾಕ್ ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಮುಂದಾಗಿರ್ತಾಳೆ‌. ಆದ್ರೆ ಡಿಟೆಕ್ಟಿವ್ ಟೈಡ್ ಈ ಕೇಸ್ ಕೈಗೆತ್ತಿಕೊಂಡು ಊಹಿಸಲಾಗದ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳನ್ನ ಬಿಚ್ಚಿಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ವಿನಂತಿ ಯಾರು? ಈ ಟೈಡ್ ಮಾಡಿದ ತನಿಖೆ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಪ್ರದೀಪ್ ಕುಮಾರ್ ಬರೆದಿರೋ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ 'ಕೆಂಪು ನಕ್ಷತ್ರ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ

amarjeet-sada-ek-nanha-shaitaan.title: 8 Saal Ka Psycho Killer :  Kaun Hai Amarjeet Sada?
amarjeet-sada-ek-nanha-shaitaan.description: Amarjeet Sada, ek 8 saal ka Masoom chehra, lekin andar chhupa hai ek khaufnaak raaz. Bihar ke gaon se aaya yeh bachcha kaise ban gaya duniya ka sabse chhota serial killer? Sunnne ki himmat hai toh suniye, par ye kahani aapke hosh udaa degi.

anoohya.title: Anoohya
