anoohya.description: ಮದುವೆ ಫಿಕ್ಸ್ ಆಗಿರೋ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಇದ್ದಕ್ಕಿದ್ಹಾಗೇ ತನ್ನ ಸಾವಿನ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ನಾಪತ್ತೆಯಾಗ್ತಳೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಆಕೆಯ ಸತ್ತು ಹೋದ ತಂಗಿಯೇ ಕಾರಣ, ಅವಳು ದೆವ್ವವಾಗಿ ಕಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದಾಳೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಕುಟುಂಬದವರ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಇದು ದೆವ್ವದ ಕಾಟವಾ? ಬೇರೆಯವರ ಮಸಲತ್ತಾ? ಇದಕ್ಕದ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೌಂಡಿನ್ಯ ನಾಗೇಶ್ ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರೋ 'ಅನೂಹ್ಯ' ಕೃತಿ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ ರೋಚಕತೆಯ ಅನುಭವ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ!

doctor-miracle.title: Doctor Miracle
doctor-miracle.description: പ്രണയത്തിലും ജീവിതത്തിലും പരാജയപ്പെട്ട ഒരു സാധാരണ മെഡിക്കൽ കോളേജ് വിദ്യാർത്ഥിയായിരുന്നു അശ്വന്ത്. പെട്ടെന്ന്, ഒരു ദിവസം അവന് അത്ഭുതസിദ്ധികൾ ലഭിക്കുന്നു! നിനച്ചിരിക്കാത്ത അപകടങ്ങളും വെല്ലുവിളികളും ആണ് അവനെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നത്. കേൾക്കാം, ഒരു മെഡിക്കൽ സൂപ്പർഹീറോ ത്രില്ലർ!

death-in-colaba.title: Death In Colaba
death-in-colaba.description: "Bombay ke Colaba Beach par ek laash milti hai, jo puri kahani ka raaz ban jaati hai. 1890 ke aspaas, British hukoomat ke neeche, Bombay shahar mein kidnapping ke kuch ajeeb cases hote hain. Inspector Arun ko Poona se Bombay transfer kiya jata hai, jahan wo is ghatna ki tehqiqat mein lag jata hai. Desai parivar ki chhoti beti Tara, apne gujare hue pati ke naam par ek scholarship shuru karne ka iraada karti hai, aur ek mission par nikal padti hai. Jaiwar ke shahi parivar aur Bombay ki kidnap hui ladkiyon ke beech ke anjaane rishte ko samajhne ki koshish mein, Arun aur Tara ko kai raaz aur andheron ka saamna karna padta hai. Suniye ye romanchak kahani sirf Kuku FM par."

xo-zach.title: Xo, Zach
xo-zach.description: From New York Times bestseller Kendall Ryan comes XO, Zach—a steamy, forbidden romance. When a fake date at a party leads to an unexpected connection, Zach can’t stop thinking about her. But when she turns out to be his new student, the lines blur between professional and irresistible, leaving them both struggling to keep their distance.

live-in.title: Live - in
live-in.description:
கல்யாணத்தில் விருப்பம் இல்லாமல் வீட்டை விட்டு ஓடிச் சென்ற தாரா, ஒரு Mysterious Stranger'ஐ சந்திக்கிறாள். அவள் வாழ்க்கையை தலைகீழா மாத்த போற அந்த Stranger யார்?
தெரிச்சுக்க கேளுங்க 'LIVE-IN'

pralay-yugon-ka-sarvnash.title: Pralay : Yugon Ka Sarvnash
pralay-yugon-ka-sarvnash.description: Manu ke pralay se bachne aur nai duniya banane ki journey janani hai? Vishnu ke Matsya Avatar, divine powers aur human emotions ke sangam ke baare mein janana hai to suniye Mystery, adventure aur mythology se bharpoor yeh audiobook.

piragu.title: பிறகு
piragu.description: சக்கிலியக் குடியின் வரலாறு குறித்துக் கருப்பனுக்கும் சிரித்திரனுக்குமிடையேயான உரையாடல்கள் போன்றவை இந்த நாவலைக் காலத்தோடு முன்னகர்த்திச் செல்லும் ஆற்றல் கொண்டவை. தன் சமகாலம் குறித்த பிரக்ஞை எந்தவொரு கலைஞனுக்கும் இன்றியமையாத்து. பூமணி அந்தப் பிரக்ஞையின் கயிற்று நுனியை இறுகப் பற்றியிருக்கும் ஒரு கலைஞன் என்பதற்கு இந்த நாவல் ஒரு வலுவான சான்று.

kalyaana-valaiosai.title: Kalyaana Valaiosai
kalyaana-valaiosai.description: Kalyanam aagi husband veettukku pona namma heroine Sanjana, husband support-um, puguntha veettu support-um illaama oru poratta vaazhkai nadathuraa. Avalai kashtapaduthura antha edathula ava eppadi vaazha poraa.. enna panna Poraa.. therinjukalaam vaanga.

villain-battalion.title: Villain Battalion
villain-battalion.description: "Ek secret sarkari agency ne banayi super-villains ki sabse khatarnak team, jo ab Desh bachayegi! High-tech robots se lekar jaanleva terrorists tak, kya SORD ki Villain Battalion apna mission pura kar paayegi, ya khud hi ban jayegi ek khatra?

nethaji-subash-chandra-bose.title: நேதாஜி சுபாஷ் சந்திரபோஸ்
nethaji-subash-chandra-bose.description: குகன் எழுதிய "நேதாஜி சுபாஷ் சந்திர போஸ்" வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு, விடுதலைக்காக உயிர் கொடுத்த வீரத்தின் கதையை வெற்றிக்கொடி ஏற்றுகிறது. தேசியப் போராட்டத்தின் வீரமிக்க நாயகனின் சாதனைகளை வெளிச்சமிட்டிருக்கும் அற்புத ஆவணம்.

maa-mansa-amarta-ki-devi.title: Maa Mansa : Amarta Ki Devi
maa-mansa-amarta-ki-devi.description: Maa Mansa ki kahaniyan sirf kahaniyan nahi, jeevan ke rahasya hain. Unki kripa se har kathinai ka hal aur har sapne ki siddhi ka raasta milta hai. Abhi suniye ye audiobook aur Maa Mansa ki divya gathaon ko janiye.

manipallavam-5.title: மணிபல்லவம் - 5
manipallavam-5.description: பூம்புகாரின் வீதிகளில், அறிவு போரில் வெற்றி காணும் இளங்குமரனும், இதயத்தை கொள்ளை கொள்ளும் சுரமஞ்சரியும் நாயகர்களாக உருவெடுக்கிறார்கள். மர்மங்களும் உணர்ச்சிகளும் மிளிரும் இந்த கதை, மணிபல்லவ தீவில் திகட்டும் திருப்பங்களால் வாசகர்களை சிறைபிடிக்கிறது.

beghar-raja.title: Beghar Raja
beghar-raja.description:
A prince framed for his own brother’s murder is forced to live as a beggar. A princess chooses him against the world. And when betrayal rises from within his own family, the fallen heir must return, not for the throne, but for justice.
But can a “beggar king” survive the war waiting for him? Watch now!

final-bliss-1.title: Final Bliss
final-bliss-1.description: ఒంటరి జీవితాన్ని గడుపుతున్న నాన్నకు పెళ్ళి చేయాలని అనుకుంటుంది కూతురు. ఆమె అనుకున్నట్టుగానే ఒక మహిళ అతని జీవితంలోకి వస్తుంది. ఐదు పదుల వయసులో పెళ్ళితో అతను ఎదుర్కొన్న సమస్యలేంటి? చూడండి మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

bhatiji-ki-dost-ceo-ki-deewangi.title: Bhatiji Ki Dost, CEO Ki Deewangi
bhatiji-ki-dost-ceo-ki-deewangi.description: “A simple, innocent girl becomes the obsession of a powerful and emotionally damaged CEO after she saves him in an unexpected moment. Torn between her loyalty to her best friend and his uncontrollable passion, their lives collide in a storm of love, madness, and dangerous desire.”

doctor-vs-billionaires-1.title: Doctor Vs Billionaires
doctor-vs-billionaires-1.description:
సంపద, అహంకారం, అహంభావం నిండిన ప్రపంచంలో — చిన్నారి ఆర్య చేసిన ఓ అమాయకపు చిలిపితనం, ప్రాణపణంగా మారింది.
ఆమె గుండె మోగింపు ఆసుపత్రిలో నెమ్మదిగా ఆగిపోతుండగా, ఆమె ప్రాణాన్ని కాపాడగల ఏకైక వైద్యుడు రోడ్డుపై చిక్కుకున్నాడు — ఒక దంపతుల చేతిలో అవమానానికి, బ్లాక్‌మెయిల్‌కు బలి అయ్యాడు.
ప్రతి క్షణం విలువైన ఈ పోరాటంలో, భయంకరమైన నిజాలు బయటపడతాయి — ప్రాణం కోసం తపిస్తున్న ఆ బిడ్డ, వారికే పుట్టిన పిల్ల అయి ఉండవచ్చు!
పశ్చాత్తాపానికి సమయం దొరుకుతుందా…?

influenzza-rocky.title: Influenzza Rocky
influenzza-rocky.description: Rakesh, a salesman with amazing mimicry skills, goes viral by accident and becomes “Rocky.” Encouraged by his friend Bunty, he quits his job to chase influencer fame. As views drop, he fakes a deadly illness, gaining sympathy and fame but losing himself. A sharp, emotional tale of how social-media obsession destroys real relationships.

ceo-in-love-1.title: CEO in Love
ceo-in-love-1.description: Watch most entertaining Love-Drama show 'CEO in Love'. Only on KukuTV

little-chess-master.title: Little Chess Master
little-chess-master.description: A poor village boy with a brilliant mind rises from obscurity to become a chess prodigy, shocking everyone who once underestimated him. As he battles rivals, corruption, and his own fears, his genius becomes his only weapon to protect his family and change his destiny.

youngest-secret-billionaire-4.title: Youngest Secret Billionaire
youngest-secret-billionaire-4.description: Watch family entertaining show 'Youngest Secret Billionaire'. Only on KukuTV

100-rupay-ka-boyfriend-ceo-nikla.title: 100 Rupay Ka Boyfriend, CEO Nikla
100-rupay-ka-boyfriend-ceo-nikla.description: A broke college girl hires a ‘100-rupee boyfriend’ for a fake relationship, only to discover he’s actually a secret multimillionaire CEO testing people’s intentions. As lies, love, and chaos collide, their small deal turns into a life-changing romance neither expected.

love-me-again-4.title: Love Me Again
love-me-again-4.description: A forbidden wedding brews under the shadow of betrayal and threats. Goons are summoned to shatter vows before they’re made. A mother fights to protect her fragile child while ghosts of the past return. In love, lies, and survival—no one’s fate is certain. Watch “Love Me Again” only on KUKU TV!

youngest-secret-billionaire-3.title: Youngest Secret Billionaire
youngest-secret-billionaire-3.description: కాలేజీలో చదువుకునే రాహుల్, చెత్త ఏరుకుంటూ డబ్బులు సంపాదిస్తున్నాడు. అతను పారూ అనే అమ్మాయితో క్లోజ్ గా ఉండేవాడు. ఒకరోజు అతనికి షాకింగ్ న్యూస్ తెలిసింది. అప్పటి నుండి అతని వెనుక వైశాలి తిరగడం మొదలుపెట్టింది? అసలేం జరిగింది? తెలియాలంటే చూడండి "Youngest Secret Billionaire" మీ కుకు టీవీలో

daddy-ke-dost-ki-dulhan.title: Daddy Ke Dost Ki Dulhan
daddy-ke-dost-ki-dulhan.description: Naina, an heiress, initially accepts a proposal from her neglectful boyfriend, Uday, despite the quiet devotion of Mr. Bajaj, who has cared for her since her father's death and hints at being her pre-arranged groom. Her world shatters with Uday's infidelity, leading to a violent confrontation and his scandalous accusations, prompting Naina to vow for genuine love and respect. Pressured by her mother for an arranged marriage, Naina learns her deceased father's final wish was for her to marry Samar, his best friend, and she enters a strategic, unconsummated union with him. Simultaneously, Naina pursues a corporate career, encountering the formidable CEO Mr. Bajaj, who unexpectedly defends her against an aggressive HR Head. Naina's professional ambitions clash with her increasingly public identity as "Mrs. Bajaj," leading to intense rivalry with designer Tara, who also claims the title and is romantically involved with the recently fired Uday. A complex web of relationships unfolds, including a "secret marriage" between Naina and Mr. Bajaj, and her past connection to Samar, which are publicly exposed, creating a scandalous love quadrangle. Naina navigates office politics, accusations of an affair with Mr. Bajaj, and Uday's manipulative reappearance, eventually being introduced as "CEO Mr. Samar Bajaj's wife," suggesting a deeper connection or merging of identities between Samar and Mr. Bajaj. A high-stakes design competition ensues, fraught with plagiarism accusations between Naina and Tara. Samar, mistakenly believing Tara to be Mr. Bajaj's wife, passionately defends her, alleging an affair between Mr. Bajaj and Naina, until Mr. Bajaj's actual wife (implied to be Naina) clarifies the misunderstanding. The tumultuous journey continues with Naina's pregnancy with Samar/Mr. Bajaj. Initial joy turns to suspicion when Samar's unsettling reaction and secret inquiries about abortion shatter trust. A dramatic confrontation and subsequent accident lead to clarification, but deep-seated trust issues persist. Ultimately, a marriage of convenience, implied to be Naina's, transforms into a genuine romantic connection as her reserved husband confesses his long-held love, revealing mutual affection.

the-missing-master-chef-1.title: The Missing Master Chef
the-missing-master-chef-1.description: Master Chef Robin, a culinary prodigy, mysteriously vanishes after unprecedented success, only to resurface under a new identity as a junior cook, drawn to the kind-hearted Stella. His hidden past and social class differences threaten their budding romance as he faces immense pressure and skepticism in new kitchens, often tasked with leading high-stakes feasts. This initial phase of his journey is marked by intense culinary challenges, forcing him into unlikely collaborations and igniting fierce rivalries, while family restaurants face sabotage and bitter conflicts over crucial investments. Later, the protagonist, identified as the legendary Master Chef Robin Fong Skylar, is discovered in exile, grappling with profound amnesia and denying his esteemed title, even as he displays impossible culinary skills. He is brutally pursued and maimed by a sinister leader seeking power, further complicating his lost identity. As a mute beggar, he is taken in by compassionate individuals, slowly beginning to recall his forgotten past through the efforts of Vani, who shares a deep connection with him. Throughout his struggles, he repeatedly saves struggling restaurants from ruin and thwarts unscrupulous villains attempting to invalidate legitimate wins. The culinary world is a cutthroat arena of "Life and Death Competitions," where chefs risk everything for honor and ownership, and rivals like Charlie Oliver use malicious techniques. The protagonist, also known as Daniel, suffers severe hand injuries, threatening his career, but receives crucial support from allies like Mr. Noman and Sanjay. Despite accusations of cheating and relentless public humiliation from critics, his extraordinary cooking earns him recognition as a genius. He eventually rejects the "Master Chef" designation, advocating for a philosophy of heartfelt cooking and inspiring others. His journey culminates in confronting past rivals, leading to their profound awakening and proposals for collaborative ventures, hinting at a path to redemption and a redefined understanding of culinary mastery.

bodhi-varma-return-of-the-beggar-dragon-.title: Bodhi Varma: Return of the Beggar Dragon
bodhi-varma-return-of-the-beggar-dragon-.description:
He came as a nobody… but sat on the Dragon Throne.
Now the whole kingdom wants to know - who REALLY is Varman? The truth awaits - Watch now!

love-me-again-3.title: LOVE ME AGAIN
love-me-again-3.description:
A forbidden wedding brews under the shadow of betrayal and threats.
Goons are summoned to shatter vows before they’re made.
A mother fights to protect her fragile child while ghosts of the past return.
In love, lies, and survival—no one’s fate is certain.

homeless-billionaire-1.title: Homeless Billionaire
homeless-billionaire-1.description: Emerging from hiding after his uncle's murder, the powerful figure Arman, known as "The Boss," seeks to reclaim a vast business empire. Simultaneously, Kanika, driven by her ailing grandmother's dying wish, agrees to a rushed marriage, only to face public humiliation when her fiancé, Sanjay, denies their engagement. To fulfill her grandmother's wish and save her family from ruin, Kanika reluctantly enters a temporary "contract marriage" with Arman, who is disguised as Nicky and later as Sanjay. As Arman, still in disguise, falls for Kanika's aspirations, he struggles with the secret of his true identity, while public confrontations with the antagonist Sanjay escalate tensions. Their fabricated romance is challenged by societal judgment and family suspicions that Arman, initially perceived as a sales manager, might be a missing billionaire CEO. Kanika endures public shaming from socialites and rivals who mock Arman's perceived poverty, yet genuine feelings begin to blossom between them. Arman's mother suspects his double life, pushing him to confess, while Kanika's mother tests his commitment, making Kanika question her own feelings. The delicate pretense is constantly threatened by unexpected arrivals, family secrets, and dramatic revelations about Arman's past. Kanika confronts her manipulative ex-lover Sanjay, fighting for her dignity against his betrayal and the attacks of his current partner. A dangerous new threat emerges in Maddy, Kanika's former obsessive admirer, now a formidable billionaire, who vows revenge and orchestrates elaborate schemes to control Kanika and destroy her relationship with Arman. Maddy's relentless pursuit and violent attacks culminate in Arman being brutally beaten and hospitalized. Despite the escalating danger, Arman, a powerful and secretly wealthy CEO, orchestrates elaborate security to protect Kanika, planning their urgent wedding and a secret project. During a public humiliation at an auction, Arman dramatically reveals his true power and identity as CEO Arman Raheja, unmasking himself to Kanika. Heartbroken and feeling betrayed by his deception, Kanika confronts Arman, questioning their relationship amidst his desperate pleas for forgiveness, leaving their future uncertain.

my-fake-billionaire-boyfriend.title: My Fake Billionaire Boyfriend
my-fake-billionaire-boyfriend.description: Kashish, an ordinary employee, fabricates a secret romance with formidable magnate Dev Raichand to impress her friends and advance her career, a lie that quickly spirals, boosting her social standing and company share prices. This deception draws the attention of her boss, who offers a promotion contingent on arranging a meeting with Dev. Unbeknownst to Kashish, Dev Raichand is secretly in India on a personal quest and begins investigating the source of the false claims about their relationship. Kashish's mission to meet Dev becomes complicated when she is forced to rely on Rahul, her ex-fiancé who abandoned her years ago, who is now Dev's subordinate and confidant. It is soon revealed that Dev Raichand is the man who abandoned Kashish on her wedding night, and he is now disguised as Rahul, testing her love. Dev, as Rahul, orchestrates a high-stakes corporate scandal, diverting a major deal to Kashish's company to expose corruption within his own board and rival Mr. Oberoi. Kashish, unaware of his true identity, enlists Dev (as Rahul) as a 'fake partner' for a social charade, further complicating their burgeoning romance amidst threats from an obsessive ex-friend and a vengeful Saurav. The narrative culminates in Dev dramatically crashing Sandhya's wedding, publicly exposing her greedy in-laws and confessing his profound regret for abandoning Kashish years ago to pursue wealth. He desperately seeks her forgiveness, revealing his true prominent status upon his return to India. However, a now clear-headed Kashish, feeling profoundly betrayed by the revelation that her beloved 'Rahul' is Dev, dramatically rejects his marriage proposal. Empowered by his actions, she vows high-stakes revenge against Dev and commits to uncovering a deeper conspiracy involving her best friend. Despite Dev's pleas for a second chance, Sanjay proposes to Kashish, who accepts on the pivotal condition that he must never lie to her, solidifying their commitment and setting the stage for a new chapter of corporate ambition, past betrayals, and a dangerous, intertwined future.

secretary-rosie-3.title: Secretary Rosie
secretary-rosie-3.description:
She isn’t just a secretary—she’s temptation wrapped in cunning.
With every smile and every touch, she slowly poisons trust, turning love into a battlefield.
How far will she go—to claim his wealth, his empire, and even the wife’s place at his side?

unknown-connection.title: Unknown Connection
unknown-connection.description: Ananya is told her newborn twins died, but her step-sister Sonal secretly sold them to Aradhya. Seven years later, Ananya meets wealthy CEO Arjun (posing as a driver) and his twins—her biological children. As she bonds with them, Aradhya returns claiming her "family," while Sonal's torment continues. Birthmarks and connections reveal the truth: Sonal's betrayal, Aradhya's fake pregnancy, and Arjun's deception. Ananya reunites with her children and marries Arjun.

love-me-again-2.title: LOVE ME AGAIN
love-me-again-2.description:
A forbidden wedding brews under the shadow of betrayal and threats.
துரோகம், மிரட்டல் இதெல்லாம் \, இந்த கல்யாணம் நடக்கக் கூடாதுன்னு சத்தம் போடுது... தாலி கட்டறதுக்கு முன்னாடியே, பல போராட்டம் நடக்குது... இன்னொரு பக்கம், ஒரு அம்மா, தன் பயந்த குழந்தைய காப்பாத்த  போராடுறாங்க... ஆனா, அவங்க பழைய ஞாபகங்கள், அவர்களுக்கு திரும்பி வருது..
இப்படி காதல், பொய், உயிர் காப்பாத்திக்கிறதுன்னு... இதுல யார் தலை எழுத்து எப்படி இருக்கும்னு யாருக்கும் நிச்சயம் தெரியாது.

arabpati-kissan.title: Arabpati Kissan
arabpati-kissan.description: An ordinary man, initially known by various names including Manoj and Ajay, is plunged into a sinister corporate conspiracy after a car crash leaves him with amnesia. He finds refuge and care in the tranquil village of Shankerpur, where he develops a connection with Radha and is embraced by the community led by Mukhiya. However, his newfound peace is shattered when the formidable Turbo Group, spearheaded by Lou and Raghu, attempts to seize the villagers' ancestral lands for industrial expansion. The protagonist, now known as Vijay, rises as a courageous protector, defying Raghu and the corporate threats, even being framed for an assault. His presumed death is hinted to be a deception, as he later returns. Vijay is dramatically exposed as the former CEO of the Turbo Group and brother to Nakul, who is allied with a foreign businesswoman in the land acquisition, shattering the villagers' trust and leading to his banishment. Seeking redemption, Vijay confesses his deceit to the authoritative Mukhiya and is granted a second chance, contingent on a rigorous test. Despite the Mukhiya's deep distrust, his daughter Urmila maintains an emotional connection with Vijay, secretly attempting to uncover his strategic plans against the Turbo Group, leading to a forbidden romance. Vijay inspires the village with his 'Swadeshi' philosophy and spearheads a dairy cooperative to challenge the exploitative 'Turbo Group,' gradually earning the Mukhia's trust by saving their poisoned livestock. His efforts are constantly undermined by external corporate threats and internal betrayals, as Raghu returns to sabotage his plans, and his ruthless corporate executive brother, Nakul, attempts to frame him for fraud and acquire ancestral land. Vijay unmasks Ramdeen, a villager seduced by corporate greed, who then becomes an operative to infiltrate the 'Turbo Group' and expose widespread corruption. A chilling confession reveals an attempted murder against Vijay, orchestrated by Siddharth and Nakul, to prevent him from exposing their scheme to transform 'Turbo Group' into a Chinese company disguised as Indian. Vijay, having survived, enlists journalist Maya to expose his brother Nakul and sister-in-law Liu Chang's conspiracy. Ultimately, Inspector Anshuman arrests Nakul and his foreign associate for corruption and conspiracy, leading to Nakul's public shaming. Vijay rises as a transformed leader championing farmers' rights and national pride, with Shankar Dairy becoming a symbol of 'swadeshi' self-reliance. He envisions expanding the cooperative's success to the city, inviting Urmila to join him, intertwining their personal and national dreams.

raja-rani-secrets-of-the-beggar-king-2.title: Raja Rani: Secrets of the Beggar King
raja-rani-secrets-of-the-beggar-king-2.description: The beggar king found his bride… but the palace walls are closing in with lies, poison, and power. Who survives the final blow? Watch now!

hanuman-code.title: Hanuman Code
hanuman-code.description: Two brothers choose opposite destinies, one blessed with Hanuman’s divine power, the other reborn as an Asur. As darkness rises, a mythic battle between Dharma and Adharma begins… and only one will survive.

ultimate-boxer-3.title: Ultimate Boxer
ultimate-boxer-3.description:
A boxing champion’s world collides with a struggling florist when fate traps them in a contract neither wanted.
As betrayal, humiliation, and hidden conspiracies rise, love sparks in the unlikeliest of places.
But when duty clashes with desire, the question remains—will sacrifice or survival win?

fortune-ka-funda.title: Fortune Ka Funda
fortune-ka-funda.description: “A carefree young man suddenly discovers he can predict people’s luck—and misfortune—with uncanny accuracy. As his gift turns into chaos, comedy, and danger, he must decide whether fortune is a blessing, a curse, or the key to his true destiny.”

youngest-secret-billionaire-2.title: Youngest  Secret Billionaire
youngest-secret-billionaire-2.description: From rejection to revelation, a young man’s hunger for success turns obstacles into steppingstones. Defying betrayal and risking it all, he transforms failure into fortune. Witness the electrifying rise of the world’s youngest secret billionaire a story of grit, ambition, and destiny fulfilled.

oops-my-husband-is-mafia-boss-3.title: Oops My Husband is Mafia Boss
oops-my-husband-is-mafia-boss-3.description: Sneha, a kind-hearted woman, lives peacefully until her brother’s accident leaves him needing ₹80 lakhs for surgery. Desperate, she meets Vikram Devraj, a ruthless mafia boss with a hidden past. He offers her a deal- marry him for a year in exchange for the money. Reluctantly, she agrees, but their cold contract turns into something deeper. When her ex-lover returns and Vikram’s enemies strike, Sneha’s world spirals into chaos ending in a shocking gunshot that changes everything.

the-shalini-show-season-2-arpitha-abhish.title: The Shalini Show Season 2 - Arpitha Abhishek Jothe
the-shalini-show-season-2-arpitha-abhish.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರು ಕನಸು. ತಾವು ಇಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸ್ಬೇಕು, ನೇಮು-ಫೇಮು ಗಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋರು ಕೆಲವೇ ಮಂದಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ಇಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಅವರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಪಾಠ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಾಧಕರ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ‌.. The Shalini Show Season 2! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರು ಆ್ಯಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. Watch Now!!

brother-betrayal-5.title: Brother Betrayal (Gujarati)
brother-betrayal-5.description: Alok is an ordinary man, yet he sacrifices his entire life for his younger brother Rohan’s education. Did Rohan study well and succeed? Was Alok able to protect his home? To find out, watch "Brother Betrayal"  on Kuku TV.

final-bliss.title: Final Bliss
final-bliss.description:
When a protective father becomes the target of his daughter’s matchmaking mission, love finds him in the most unexpected way.
But as a warm-hearted woman enters their lives, buried scars and a dangerous past resurface.
This is a heartfelt saga of family, resilience, and love tested against betrayal and fear.

youngest-secret-billionaire-1.title: Youngest Secret Billionaire
youngest-secret-billionaire-1.description:
From rejection to revelation, a young man’s hunger for success turns obstacles into steppingstones.
Defying betrayal and risking it all, he transforms failure into fortune.
Witness the electrifying rise of the world’s youngest secret billionaire—a story of grit, ambition, and destiny fulfilled.

the-billionaire-returns-home.title: The Billionaire Returns Home
the-billionaire-returns-home.description: Riyansh Singhaniya, a billionaire CEO travels to a small town to buy land for his first mall—only to discover that an old, struggling couple refusing to sell may actually be his long-lost parents. Going undercover as a common man, he witnesses their poverty, humiliation, and the cruelty of their greedy relatives.

secretary-rosie-2.title: Secretary Rosie
secretary-rosie-2.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous rekindling of a past romance between Siddharth and Priya, who is secretly the powerful company president, Priyadarshini Kulkarni, despite Siddharth's current live-in relationship with Teju and his marriage to the 'President Madam.' Their complicated affair is quickly threatened by Rosie, Siddharth's ambitious assistant, who, fiercely loyal to the unseen 'President Madam,' attempts to seduce Siddharth and brutally assaults Priya, believing her to be an imposter and mistress. Priya dramatically reveals her true identity as Siddharth's wife and the actual company president, Priyadarshini Kulkarni, while also disclosing her pregnancy with Siddharth's child. This revelation intensifies the conflict, leading to Rosie holding pregnant Priya captive and coercing her into an abortion, driven by past rejection and a property dispute, believing the child is part of a wealth acquisition scheme. Siddharth frantically searches for his missing, pregnant wife, initially unaware of the horrific events and Rosie's deception, even as he is later accused of orchestrating the abortion. Priya, fighting desperately for her life and her unborn baby, confronts Siddharth about the forced abortion and public humiliation, leading her to vow revenge amidst his denials. The corporate power struggle escalates as Maya, identified as Siddharth's legitimate wife and the true company President, reclaims her authority, further complicating the identities of the 'President Madam.' Priya, now pregnant again, seeks vengeance against Rosie for the loss of her unborn child and for attempting to steal Siddharth, planning a public humiliation with Siddharth's ambiguous help. The rivalry culminates in a public confrontation and a gunshot, leaving Siddharth's fate uncertain, though he later returns from abduction by Rosie. Driven by profound maternal grief over the loss of her son and anticipated grandchild, Priya relentlessly pursues justice and retribution against Sanjaya, whom she holds responsible for manipulative schemes and causing death. Throughout these trials, Siddharth ultimately reaffirms his unwavering support for Priya, strengthening their bond amidst corporate intrigue, personal tragedy, and their shared quest for justice against those who wronged them.

boss-madia-took-me.title: Boss Mafia Took Me
boss-madia-took-me.description: “A helpless girl is kidnapped by a ruthless mafia boss to settle a deadly score, pulling her into a world of danger, power, and forbidden desire. As hatred turns into obsession and secrets unfold, their lives spiral into a dark, intoxicating war between love and control.”

her-fall-her-rise.title: Her Beauty, His Love
her-fall-her-rise.description:
Riya joins her dream college but faces humiliation from Aksha and Krish.
From clashes in a project, love slowly blossoms, though Aksha’s jealousy creates hurdles.
Riya transforms and gains confidence, while Krish realizes his true feelings.
In the end, the two unite in love.

you-are-the-only-one-in-the-world.title: You Are The Only One In The World
you-are-the-only-one-in-the-world.description: Ella Johnson, the only daughter of the Johnson family, was separated from her family as a child and adopted by her foster father. After overcoming numerous difficulties, she finally grew into a strong and independent woman with an indomitable spirit. At the age of 22, Ella Johnson fell in love with Ben at first sight, loving him unconditionally. However, due to her inner...

doctor-vs-billionaires.title: Doctor Vs Billionaires
doctor-vs-billionaires.description: In a world of wealth, ego, and arrogance, little Aarya’s innocent prank spirals into a fight between life and death. While her heartbeat slips away in the hospital, the only doctor who can save her is trapped on the road, blackmailed, humiliated by a ruthless couple blinded by pride. As every second counts, shocking truths unfold, the child fighting for life may be their own daughter. Will redemption come in time… or will their cruelty cost them the one thing they can never replace? Watch Now!

chaukanna-24x7.title: Chaukanna 24x7
chaukanna-24x7.description: Watch This Drama "Chaukanna 24x7" Only On Kuku TV!

secretary-rosie-1.title: Secretary Rosie
secretary-rosie-1.description:
அவள் சாதாரண Secretary இல்லை – பட்டு போர்வையில் மறைந்த கவர்ச்சி.
அலுவலகக் கூட்டங்களை ஆசையின் போர்க்களமாக்கினாள்.
மனைவியின் இடத்தையும், அவனின் பேரரசையும் கைப்பற்ற திட்டமிட்டாள்.
அவள் எவ்வளவு தூரம் செல்வாள்? 🔥👑

fake-boyfriend-exposed.title: Fake Boyfriend Exposed
fake-boyfriend-exposed.description: “After a painful separation, two former lovers are forced back into each other’s lives, reopening wounds they thought had healed. As hidden truths and unresolved feelings rise to the surface, they must decide whether fate is giving them a second chance—or one last heartbreak.”

raja-rani-secrets-of-the-beggar-king-1.title: Raja Rani - Secrets of the Beggar King
raja-rani-secrets-of-the-beggar-king-1.description: The beggar king found his bride… but the palace walls are closing in with lies, poison, and power. Who survives the final blow? Watch now!

beggar-billionaire.title: Beggar Billionaire
beggar-billionaire.description: Armaan Raheja, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kashish, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

raaz-400-feet-ka.title: Raaz 400 feet ka
raaz-400-feet-ka.description: Billionaire Ayush Damani survives being pushed off a 400-feet cliff by his girlfriend Richa and is rescued by Pearly, a simple mountain girl who has no idea who he is. With his memory gone, Ayush finds a new, peaceful life with her but danger still follows him. As greed, secrets, and betrayal rise again, Ayush doesn’t realise Pearly may also be hiding her own hunger for wealth… and the biggest shock of his life is yet to come.

a-tale-of-a-two-timer.title: Double Trouble
a-tale-of-a-two-timer.description:
డబుల్ ట్రబుల్ – ఇది ఓ మలుపులు తిరిగే లవ్ ట్రయాంగిల్.
రామ్ – ఎప్పుడూ సైలెంట్‌, ఎప్పుడూ కూల్, "గ్రీన్ ఫ్లాగ్" అబ్బాయి. కానీ గర్ల్‌ఫ్రెండ్ కీర్తికి ఈ మృదుత్వమే బోర్ కొడుతుంది. "నువ్వు నాకు సరిపోడు" అంటూ వదిలేసి వెళ్ళిపోతుంది.

ఇక్కడికి ఎంట్రీ ఇస్తుంది మాయ – ఓ రౌడీ గ్యాంగ్‌స్టర్ రుద్రయ్య కూతురు. ఆమెలాంటి అమ్మాయి ప్రపోజ్ చేయదు, డిక్లేర్ చేస్తుంది –
“నువ్వే నా బాయ్‌ఫ్రెండ్!”

రామ్ ఒక్కసారిగా రెండు అగ్నిపర్వతాల మధ్య చిక్కుకుంటాడు –
కీర్తి: నిజమైన ప్రేమ.
మాయ: ప్యాషన్ పేరుతో పిచ్చి పాజెషన్.

raja-rani-secrets-of-the-beggar-king.title: Raja Rani: Secrets of the Beggar King
raja-rani-secrets-of-the-beggar-king.description: The microdrama begins with Manimekhala, a woman betrayed and killed in a past life, reborn as a princess vowing revenge. Defying her father and societal norms, Princess Manimekhala chooses the humble "beggar" Dheera as her husband, leading to her disinheritance and public humiliation. Her elder sister, Akka, also defies their father, hinting at their intertwined pasts. Dheera's true identity as a Prince is soon revealed, setting the stage for their love to navigate class disparity and royal status. However, their marriage sparks intense class conflict and familial disapproval, particularly from Manimekhala's father and her rival, Tharaka. Manimekhala endures cruel humiliation, physical torment, and disownment for her unwavering loyalty to Dheera, who fiercely defends her. Tragically, Manimekhala dies from injuries inflicted by the Rajaguru, who enforces ancient customs, igniting Dheera's vengeful quest for justice and leading to open warfare. Following her death, Manimekhala awakens with amnesia in a royal palace, unaware of her past or Dheera's deception, as he fabricates her history to protect her. She faces arduous trials set by the Rajamata, including repeated false accusations of stealing royal gems and harsh treatment as a maid. Dheera, revealed as the Rajamata's hidden son, defies royal traditions by marrying Manimekhala, creating conflict with the Rajamata and jeopardizing his betrothal to another Princess. A vast conspiracy against the throne is exposed, leading to severe judgment, which the Rajamata challenges. The ambitious heiress Menaka, who claims Prince Dheera, is condemned and imprisoned after unknowingly abusing the disguised Queen Mother. Manimekhala's secret romantic relationship with Prince Dheera is exposed, leading to accusations and an assassination attempt on the Queen Mother, for which Dheera is sentenced to death. His execution is dramatically interrupted by the arrival of the Rajakumara. Ultimately, Manimekhala is unjustly condemned for conspiracy, but Prince Gandaraganda Ranadheera challenges the court, uncovers a conspiracy orchestrated by the villainous courtier Taraka, and proves her innocence. The series culminates with Prince Gandaraganda Ranadheera declaring Manimekhala his Queen, and their ascension to the throne.

doctors-vs-billionaires.title: Doctor Vs Billionaires
doctors-vs-billionaires.description: ಹಣ, ಅಹಂಕಾರ, ಅಹಂಭಾವ ತುಂಬಿದ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ, ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಹುಡುಗಿ  ಆರ್ಯಾಳ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಆಟವೇ ಜೀವ–ಸಾವಿನ ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳಿಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಳ ಹೃದಯದ ಬೀಟ್  ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಿರೋ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ, ಆರ್ಯಾಳನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಬಲ್ಲ ಏಕೈಕ ಡಾಕ್ಟರ್ ರಸ್ತೆ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಿಲುಕಿಕೊಂಡು, ಅವನನ್ನು ಬ್ಲ್ಯಾಕ್‌ಮೇಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಅವಮಾನಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪ್ರತೀ ಕ್ಷಣವೂ  ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸುವ ಸತ್ಯಗಳು ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತವೆ – ಬದುಕಿಗಾಗಿ ಹೋರಾಡ್ತಿರುವ ಆ ಮಗು ಅವರದೇ ಮಗಳಾಗಿರಬಹುದು. ಪಶ್ಚಾತ್ತಾಪಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಯ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆಯಾ…? ನೋಡಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಟಿವಿ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

the-wind-falls-upon-the-wild-lands.title: The Wind Falls Upon The Wild Lands
the-wind-falls-upon-the-wild-lands.description: Chutki, a modern woman, is abruptly time-traveled to a brutal prehistoric era, where she is saved by Victor, a primitive tribal leader. She endures extreme culture shock, illness, and accusations of witchcraft due to her refusal to conform to ancient customs, such as consuming raw meat. Victor's fierce devotion leads him on a perilous quest to save her, challenging the tribe's ancient beliefs and dramatically rescuing her from a fiery sacrifice. Their burgeoning romance deepens as Lily, as she is also known, uses her modern intellect to navigate and improve the primitive society. She transforms from an outcast into a revered healer after miraculously saving a woman and her baby during a life-threatening childbirth, but this newfound status immediately sparks power struggles and claims from other powerful men. Lily introduces essential innovations like salt production, cooking with fire, and pottery, earning her the title "Devi" and solidifying her bond with Victor. However, their connection faces a sinister threat from a jealous rival who plots against Lily, culminating in Victor's mysterious disappearance and plunging the community into distress. The community's sacred fire extinguishes, leading to widespread panic and Lily being blamed for sacrilege. She defies ancient beliefs by successfully creating fire, temporarily averting disaster, but her unique abilities and connection to Victor draw the attention of a formidable rival, Chief Fengyan, who abducts her. During her abduction, Lily discovers she is pregnant, transforming the battle for survival into a deeply personal fight for their family's future. She faces relentless accusations of impurity and witchcraft, even from Victor's mother, but her pregnancy is revealed, intensifying the conflict. Despite enduring brutal punishment and magical confrontations, Lily, now revealed as a divine being, awakens from a critical state, affirming her bond with Victor and their unborn children. Victor prepares for war against rival leader Fengyan and deals with internal betrayals. As Queen and teacher, Lily embraces her role, transforming her community through education and innovation. The story culminates with an invasion, forcing Victor and Lily to rally their people for a desperate fight for survival, protecting their lineage and the future of their transformed community.

meri-aashiqui-ab-tum-hi-ho-1.title: Meri Aashiqui Ab Tum Hi Ho
meri-aashiqui-ab-tum-hi-ho-1.description:
A love so deep, it dares to fight fate.
When betrayal masks a hidden sacrifice, passion collides with tragedy in the most heartbreaking way.
Meri Aashiqui Ab Tum Hi Ho is an unforgettable saga of eternal love, secrets, and destiny’s cruel twists.

i-became-the-bride-of-my-brother-in-law.title: I became the bride of my brother-in-law
i-became-the-bride-of-my-brother-in-law.description: After a tragic twist shatters her life, a gentle young woman is forced to marry her cold, dangerous brother-in-law to protect her family’s honor. But as buried secrets, forbidden emotions, and past betrayals surface, their unwanted marriage turns into a storm of passion, pain, and destiny.

cursed-by-love-4.title: Cursed by Love
cursed-by-love-4.description: Vaishnavi, a devoted woman, faces heartbreak when her husband betrays and abandons her. But beneath her sorrow lies a shocking truth she is a wealthy heir and a genius ready to reclaim her power. As she rises from humiliation, fate brings her to Vikranth Desai, a commanding CEO who treats her with unmatched devotion. Unlike her cruel past, he showers her with love and respect, standing by her side as she exposes enemies and seeks justice.

homeless-billionaire.title: Homeless Billionaire
homeless-billionaire.description: A billionaire disguised as a beggar, and a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

mafia-lover.title: Mafia vs Police
mafia-lover.description: The series plunges into a high-stakes world of hidden identities and escalating danger, initially following ACP Tara's determined, vengeful mission to apprehend notorious gangster Lakshya Rathore. Concurrently, a mysterious femme fatale, Tanya, navigates a cryptic past, first appearing as Lakshya's fake girlfriend and later his bodyguard, risking her life for him and deepening their unexpected connection amidst lurking threats. Tara infiltrates Lakshya's inner circle, attempting to secure a "shoot-at-sight" order, but her perilous path soon intertwines with her protective ex-partner, Charan, and a complex web of deceit. Lakshya himself navigates past loyalties and new business ventures, his meticulous revenge plot unexpectedly derailed by a shocking DNA twist. Meanwhile, Tanya's dark criminal past is exposed by an informant, leading to a sinister plot against her and an unexpected marriage proposal, setting the stage for escalating danger and blurred loyalties. As the narrative progresses, Tara goes deep undercover, infiltrating Zafar's syndicate via a fake engagement, secretly planning its downfall, but her cover is soon jeopardized, forcing her into a brutal fight for survival. She develops unexpected, forbidden feelings for Charan, who has become a rising gangster, complicating her assignment to dismantle his organization from within. Concurrently, Tanya is revealed to be an undercover police officer, becoming Charan's fiancée and using their intimate relationship to orchestrate his downfall, all while being targeted for investigation by Inspector Siddharth. The ruthless criminal underworld is rife with internal betrayal, as police moles are exposed within Lakshya's ranks, leading to swift, brutal executions. Intense power struggles erupt, with Lakshya's ambitious sister, Raina, boldly challenging his authority and even orchestrating plots for his assassination, raising the stakes for syndicate control. Tara's mission becomes profoundly personal when she develops a forbidden romance with Lakshya, leading to a shocking pregnancy that creates immense moral conflict. She is blackmailed by Raina to assassinate Lakshya, forcing her to choose between duty and her growing feelings, with her life and mission hanging in the balance. The situation is further complicated by the devastating revelation that Lakshya Rathore, her brother and a syndicate leader, is the true biological father of her child, not Charan, shattering their relationship and trust. Enraged by this profound betrayal, Charan shoots Tara and her unborn child, though Tara miraculously survives the brutal confrontation, driven by a desperate, personal quest for truth and survival. The series culminates with Tara arresting a man she calls 'Papa' and the release of ex-con Lakshy Rathoore, whose past immediately resurfaces, leaving Tara to navigate new alliances with figures like criminal Ajay, who vows to reform for her and their child, and cunning syndicate leader Ranbir, in a treacherous world where love, duty, and betrayal constantly collide amidst a desperate fight for survival and control of the criminal empire.

final-boss-3.title: Greatest of all time
final-boss-3.description: The microdrama centers on Arjun, a powerful CEO and secret benefactor, whose initial plan to propose to Lavanya unravels due to her materialistic ambitions and a misunderstanding involving CEO Shruti Raj. Lavanya, unaware Arjun is the King Corp CEO she seeks to impress, betrays him while trying to secure her company and avoid a forced marriage. Humiliated, Arjun agrees to a contract marriage with Shruti for revenge, simultaneously securing a colossal investment for Lavanya's project under the alias 'Raj,' leading to their transactional marriage. Arjun, initially dismissed as an outsider, re-enters their lives, igniting corporate intrigue and revealing fractured romantic pasts with both Shruti and Lavanya. He confronts Shruti about their past and vows to seize everything from Lavanya, facing accusations of fraud and faking romance. Dramatically, Arjun reveals himself as the formidable King Corp CEO, challenging Shruti's powerful grandfather and asserting his influence. Shruti, defying her family for Arjun, is appointed CEO but faces immediate challenges and public humiliation from Lavanya, who leverages her connections and aligns with CEO representative Gautham Prakash. Arjun fiercely defends Shruti against accusations of fraud and corporate schemes, orchestrating Lavanya's corporate downfall and transferring her assets to Shruti. The tension culminates at a high-society banquet where Arjun crashes Vijay's proposal to Lavanya, publicly accusing her of scheming and asserting his true identity and authority. He transforms this moment of public shame into a triumphant power play, ultimately claiming the 'king's throne.' Hardened by betrayals, Arjun declares himself the legitimate King Corp CEO, rejecting Lavanya's pleas for reconciliation and systematically dismantling the lives of those who wronged him. Amidst this calculated revenge, Arjun finds a heartfelt union with Shruthi Raj, the woman he truly loves, proposing to her and securing their shared future.

secrets-of-malhotra-mansion.title: Secrets Of Malhotra Mansion
secrets-of-malhotra-mansion.description: The microdrama begins with CEO Karan Malhotra's marital discord leading to his wife Simran's departure, prompting him to seek a nanny for his daughter, Myra. Myra unexpectedly chooses Shruti, an earnest but unqualified candidate with a mysterious past, quickly forming a deep bond. However, Shruti's criminal history as a convicted thief is soon uncovered, fueling intense suspicion from Simran, who accuses her of black magic and theft. Despite Myra's critical health and the escalating domestic conflict, Karan finds himself drawn to Shruti, even as he grapples with her perceived irresponsibility and past. As Myra's health deteriorates, requiring a bone marrow transplant, a complex web of family secrets unravels. Simran confesses she is not Myra's biological mother, revealing a clandestine baby transaction. The shocking truth emerges: Shruti is Myra's biological mother, sold as an infant by her sister, Pallavi, who now holds the key to Myra's survival. Karan discovers Myra is not biologically his, leading to his divorce from Simran and a desperate search for Myra's true parentage. Further revelations expose a dark past where Shruti was sold by Rahul, leading to a drugged encounter and Myra's unknown paternity. In a dramatic twist, Rahul reveals Karan himself is Myra's biological father, a truth Karan initially dismisses due to intoxication. Myra's medical crisis ultimately confirms Karan's paternity, forcing him to confront his past denial and seek forgiveness from Shruti. Myra's life is saved by a selfless donor, Mehek, known as "Fairy Maa," who forms a strong bond with Myra and a burgeoning romance with Karan. Karan, now acknowledging Myra as his and Shruti's child, vows relentless justice against Rahul and Pallavi for their betrayals. The show culminates with Karan proposing an unconventional marriage of convenience to Shruti, asking her to become both his wife and Myra's mother. This journey explores themes of betrayal, hidden identities, the power of maternal and paternal bonds, and the formation of an unconventional family amidst profound deceit and a desperate fight for a child's life.

tapasya-vs-temptation-2.title: Tapasya vs Temptation
tapasya-vs-temptation-2.description:
বিহান – এক ধনকুবের পরিবারের উত্তরাধিকারী। জন্মসূত্রে সব কিছু হাতে পেলেও সে সম্পদ আর ভোগলালসা থেকে মুখ ফিরিয়ে নিয়েছে। এখন তার একমাত্র আকাঙ্ক্ষা সন্ন্যাস গ্রহণ, তপস্যায় ডুবে থাকা।
কিন্তু প্রভাবশালী পরিবার সহজে তাকে ছাড়তে রাজি নয়। উত্তরাধিকারীকে ফিরিয়ে আনতে তারা রিয়া-কে আনে—অভিজাত সৌন্দর্য ও বুদ্ধিমত্তায় ভরা এক নারী, যার গোপন দায়িত্ব বিহানকে প্রলুব্ধ করে ভোগজগতের পথে টেনে আনা।

prince-gone-rogue-1.title: Thapass vs Temptation
prince-gone-rogue-1.description: Rio, a broke former TV personality, arrives at the opulent Singhania Palace seeking a clerical job but is quickly drawn into a dangerous selection process, coerced by a mysterious 'Boss' and the formidable matriarch, Mrs. Indrani Singhania. Her perilous mission is to seduce Vihan Singhania, the reclusive heir who has renounced worldly life, and convince him to eat and attend business school, unaware this is a sinister plot by Madam to eliminate him. As Riya, under various aliases, attempts to lure Vihan back to worldly life, their clash sparks unexpected romantic tension, making her a formidable threat to manipulative family members. She goes undercover as a servant, revealing hidden martial arts skills, and faces false accusations and physical altercations from wealthy heiress Suhana Raichand, Vihan's fiancé. Riya relentlessly provokes Vihan, engaging in psychological and physical assaults, leading to a volatile, dark romance, while also trying to warn him of an assassination plot orchestrated by his sinister uncle, Abhimanyu. Despite Vihan's initial coldness and denial, his perceptive uncle exposes Vihan's secret obsession with Riya, pushing him to confront his true emotions. Riya becomes entangled in the family's power struggles, facing threats from Mrs. Singhania and even a shocking abduction orchestrated by Vihan himself, who attempts to distance her for safety. She uncovers betrayal, including Abhimanyu's true traitorous nature, and forms a strategic alliance with Vihan, confessing her love amidst accusations of espionage. Their intense romance deepens, but Riya is coerced by Vihan's stepmother, Indrani, to poison him, and by his father to take contraceptives, revealing dangerous class conflict. Vihan is pressured into a high-stakes marriage with Suhana by his family, while Riya is accused of disrupting his life. Unbeknownst to Vihan, Riya becomes entangled in a ruthless conspiracy orchestrated by the cunning Maya, secretly poisoning him as part of a plot to seize the Singhania empire. A loyal informant, Priya (Riya), races against time to expose the intricate assassination plot involving Vihan's treacherous stepmother, Mrs. Singhania, and Maya. Ultimately, Priya dramatically exposes Mrs. Singhania's true intentions to eliminate Vihan and seize the family fortune, revealing the depth of the manipulative family politics.

secrets-of-my-secretary.title: Secrets of My Secretary
secrets-of-my-secretary.description: Unloved RADHIKA develops mind-reading after an accident, making her a shield against her treacherous adoptive family (TIYA & VIJETA). A forced marriage ties her to untouchable heir SAHIL DWIVEDI, the only person he can touch. Using her gift, she fights corporate schemes and betrayal to reclaim her father's legacy, becoming a powerful woman who finds unexpected love and resilience in her destined partner. Watch now!

thavam-vs-temptation.title: Thavam vs Temptation
thavam-vs-temptation.description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

billionaire-pohawala.title: Billionaire Pohawala
billionaire-pohawala.description: Ethan, a devoted single father, struggles immensely to raise his daughter, Riya, after his materialistic wife, Sophia, abandons them. Facing poverty and guilt over Riya's unfulfilled birthday wishes, Ethan accepts a dangerous Faustian bargain: unimaginable power and wealth for ten years, in exchange for his soul. A decade later, Ethan, now a powerful CEO known as the 'Mad King,' attempts to reconcile with Riya, but his past returns with devastating consequences. Sophia reappears, desperately seeking one of Riya's kidneys to save her critically ill son, Kabir, a request Ethan vehemently rejects. This medical crisis intertwines with a ruthless corporate war Ethan wages against Aditya, a rival from his past, who also seeks revenge and Riya's kidney for his own critically ill son. Ethan's company, 'Med-King,' makes a strategic comeback in the pharmaceutical industry, but he is later accused of obstructing kidney donations, which ultimately leads to Kabir's death. As the ten-year deadline for his soul approaches, Ethan's assets are targeted by rivals, and Riya's life is threatened by Sophia's abduction attempts and the ongoing demand for her kidney. Amidst this, Riya discovers her father's horrifying bargain. Vaidehi emerges as a crucial ally, helping Ethan clear his name by exposing Aditya's massive, decade-old frauds. The show explores the profound cost of Ethan's desperate love and ambition, as he navigates corporate intrigue, moral dilemmas, and personal tragedies, with his soul and Riya's future hanging in the balance. The narrative culminates with Ethan revealing his supernatural contract, and another character accepting a similar bargain, highlighting the cyclical nature of such desperate choices.

revenge-after-30-years-of-sleep.title: Golden Son: Buried Alive for 20 Years
revenge-after-30-years-of-sleep.description: Adopted son Gautham risks 20 years of his life. He gave everything to be called a brother… then why did the Mahendran sisters turn cold? And why must he sleep for 20 years? Watch now to find out.

lover-ka-bhai.title: Gang War For Brother's Wife
lover-ka-bhai.description: The show centers on the Mehra family after Amit Mehra’s apparent death in a crash turns into a suspicious loss that destabilizes both the household and its power structure. In the aftermath, Shalini’s pregnancy makes her and her unborn child the focal point of the family’s future, while Savitri and other elders move to protect the lineage at any cost. At the same time, Rohan rises as the dominant force around the family, presenting himself as protector even as his control over the estate and over Shalini increasingly resembles captivity. What begins as mourning quickly expands into a web of rival attacks, police pressure, hidden deals, and warnings that the family’s enemies may already be inside the house. Shalini is repeatedly targeted through threats, kidnapping, surveillance, extortion, scandal, and direct attempts to endanger her pregnancy, making her safety inseparable from the family’s survival. Each rescue only deepens the feud, and every effort to shield her seems to tighten the cage around her. As public confrontations and private betrayals multiply, the Mehras are forced to navigate both external rivals and internal traitors whose actions threaten to destroy the family from within. Rohan becomes the story’s most volatile protector, using force, blackmail, revenge, and criminal maneuvering to defend Shalini and the family name. Yet his devotion remains morally unstable, because the same man who saves Shalini also watches, confines, and manipulates her in the name of protection. The family’s crisis worsens through poisoned or counterfeit substances, scandalous exposure, accusations of arms dealing, gunfire at the mansion, and a concealed body that could implicate Rohan in murder. Amid this chaos, Shalini evolves from vulnerable widow and expectant mother into a harder, more central figure in the family’s struggle for survival. Even when she is injured and pushed into premature labor, the conflict does not pause, and the household is pulled deeper into retaliation, concealment, and siege. The turning point comes when treachery inside the family is openly exposed, including a confession to betrayal and murder, confirming that the danger long suspected within the home was real. Shalini then claims an active role in vengeance by killing the person held responsible, and this act transforms how key elders see her, accepting her as a daughter and as new strength for the family. In parallel, Rohan and Shalini’s bond hardens into a grim partnership built on shared danger, loyalty, and the promise to secure a future together. Their union is not framed as peace alone, but as something that must be won by eliminating the remaining rival threat, especially the Sheikh. After a decisive confrontation ends that rival’s influence, the family finally reaches a fragile new order. The closing movement shifts from blood feud to inheritance, as an elder passes property, title, and legacy to Yuvika and Neel, suggesting that after so much violence, the family’s deepest stake has always been who will carry the Mehra name, power, and future forward.

tapasya-vs-temptation-1.title: Tapasya vs Temptation
tapasya-vs-temptation-1.description: Radha, a ruined former TV actor, is coerced into a mysterious "talent show" at a mansion, where the formidable Matriarch assigns her a deadly task: make the ascetic Vivek Simha fall in love with her and abandon his spiritual path. Radha quickly uncovers Vivek's hidden brutal nature and formidable martial arts skills, while also learning secrets about the Simha dynasty, including the mysterious death of the family patriarch. As Radha's influence over Vivek grows, the Matriarch, fearing a shift in power and loss of control, begins to plot against her, making Radha an unwitting pawn in a dangerous family power struggle. Radha's mission evolves as a forbidden romance begins to blossom between her and Vivek, despite his initial hostility and his engagement to Suhana, who becomes a jealous rival. Unbeknownst to Vivek, Radha is on a secret mission orchestrated by his manipulative stepmother, Mrs. Simha, but Radha also harbors her own deep-seated vendetta against Vivek. Corporate intrigue deepens as Abhay attempts to use Radha to poison Vivek and seize control of the Simha Group, while Vivek suspects Radha is a pawn in his uncle's schemes. Radha, initially involved in a plot against Vivek, reveals her true intention to protect him, deepening their complex and perilous bond. She falls gravely ill and is targeted by Mrs. Simha for a failed task, leading to her abduction under Mr. Simha's orders. Radha defiantly confronts Mr. Simha, refusing to be sent to Abhay, and reveals to Vivek that Abhay has poisoned him. Vivek's father intervenes, determined to separate them due to Radha's social status and to prevent her from bearing a Simha heir. Despite constant threats and betrayals, Radha passionately declares her love and offers to be Vivek's shield against his manipulative family. Heartbroken by Vivek's perceived betrayal, Radha vows to expose a hidden truth. It is revealed that Sahana, Vivek's fiancée, is slowly poisoning him as part of a scheme to marry him for wealth and seize the family empire, while maintaining a secret affair. Maya, despite orchestrating Vivek's demise for past heartbreak, also exposes a deadly conspiracy against him. Ultimately, Radha orchestrates an elaborate ruse to expose Sahana's ruthless plot, saving Vivek and securing her rightful place by his side amidst the ruthless family politics and corporate intrigue. Their lives constantly hang in the balance as they navigate a web of manipulation, betrayal, and forbidden love.

fake-wife-4.title: The Wife He Pretended To Marry
fake-wife-4.description: Daniel, stuck in a contract marriage, devotes himself to Nora, who never values him. Her heart remains with her first love, Roger, aided by her scheming siblings Angela and Edward. After Nora dismissively signs divorce papers, Daniel leaves and rebuilds his life into a billionaire researcher. He finds true respect and affection with Rebecca, unlike the humiliation he endured with Nora. In the end, Daniel rejects Nora's late realization and chooses a dignified future with Rebecca. Watch now.

kerala-police-diary-2.title: Kerala Police Diary
kerala-police-diary-2.description: In the misty highlands of Kerala, a routine missing-persons case takes a sinister turn. As one cop follows the trail, he unearths a pattern of horror that links the living to the lost. Kerala Police Diary — a haunting investigative thriller where every clue brings you closer to the predator hiding in plain sight.

last-scene-left.title: Secret Rakhwala
last-scene-left.description: Watch this epic drama "Last Scene Left" only on KUKU TV!

heart-beats-only-for-you.title: Heart Beats Only For You
heart-beats-only-for-you.description: "Heart Beats Only For You" is a heartbreaking romantic drama of eternal love, sacrifice, and fate. Meera’s world shatters when she discovers Arjun’s betrayal, unaware he is hiding a fatal illness and pushing her away to protect her dreams. As secrets, scandals, and destiny collide, their love is tested to its final breath—where passion meets tragedy in the most unforgettable way. Watch "Heart Beats Only For You" only on KUKU TV!

cursed-by-love-2.title: Cursed by Love
cursed-by-love-2.description:
A betrayed woman rises from heartbreak to reveal her true identity—an heir with brilliance and power.
From humiliation to triumph, she takes control of her destiny, exposing lies and reclaiming justice.
Along the way, she finds an unexpected ally in a powerful man whose love is built on respect, not control.

sarkaar-1.title: SARKAAR
sarkaar-1.description: “A heartbroken girl crosses paths with a mysterious, powerful man who saves her life and changes it forever—revealing that destiny had tied them together long before they met. As love grows between them, past wounds, miracles, and fate intertwine to show that some bonds are written by God Himself.”

tapasya-vs-temptation.title: Tapasya vs Temptation
tapasya-vs-temptation.description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

power-game.title: Power Game
power-game.description: A mistreated orphan girl discovers she is actually the lost heir to a powerful royal dynasty, throwing her into a world of palaces, politics, and deadly secrets. As enemies rise and love blossoms, she must learn to fight for her crown—and for herself.

battle-of-billionaire.title: Battle of Billionaire
battle-of-billionaire.description: Paarth Singh is the new MD of Singh Group but he has hidden his identity from everyone, even from his wife and in-laws. He visits them for his father in-law’s birthday celebration where they demean and insult him. Will he finally reveal his true identity during this crisis? Watch Now !

my-toxic-lover.title: My Toxic Lover
my-toxic-lover.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous relationship between Arjun and Divya, whose impending wedding is quickly engulfed by corporate intrigue, deep-seated family secrets, and dangerous rivalries. Arjun's powerful mother, initially named Durga and later revealed as CEO Mrs. Archana, promises a lavish corporate gift but harbors a secretive past, including a cryptic "death day" statement and a connection to Arjun's deceased sister and past love, Jaanu, for whose death Arjun feels profound guilt. Divya's intense jealousy is ignited by Jaanu's memory and various rivals like Leela, Archana, and Janu, leading her to become increasingly manipulative and violent, even holding Archana captive and destroying wedding garments. Her ambition for Arjun's fortune drives her ruthless confrontations, as she admits pursuing financial gain over love. As the wedding day approaches, a strategic marriage alliance is violently derailed by a car crash and a ruthless cover-up, while Prabhu grapples with guilt over Janu's death, planning a confession to Divya. Divya faces brutal confrontations and public humiliation, accused of being a "fraud" and sabotaging events. Arjun's brother, Raj, expresses obsessive love, and a sinister figure, Kashi, kidnaps Arjun's mother, Archana, hinting at an "illicit relationship" between Arjun and Jaanu. The wedding ceremony descends into chaos when Archana dramatically accuses Divya of deceit and torture, and Arjun halts the proceedings, exposing Divya and her family for elaborate financial fraud. Divya escapes police custody, becoming a fugitive, prompting Arjun's relentless pursuit as she desperately tries to secure funds by selling jewels. Amidst this, Archana, accused of theft and held captive, claims to be Arjun's long-lost mother, a claim met with disbelief. The narrative escalates to a volatile power struggle where Divya, cornered and accused of widespread deception by Mrs. Archana, brandishes a gun. In an emotional breakdown, Divya accidentally shoots and critically wounds Arjun, leading to her incarceration. Following her release, a vengeful Divya returns, armed with a powerful secret, threatening to dismantle Arjun's family and disrupt his impending arranged marriage, setting the stage for a high-stakes battle of duty, love, and retribution.

final-call-for-love.title: Love Trail
final-call-for-love.description:
వినయ – అందమైనా, ఆత్మవిశ్వాసంతో నిలిచే ఒక స్త్రీ. ఒక రాత్రి చేసిన తప్పు ఆమెకు ఒక అమూల్యమైన కానుకను ఇచ్చింది – కుమారుడు. కానీ ఆ బిడ్డకు తండ్రి ఎవరో తెలియక, అక్రమ సంతానం ముద్రతో వినయ అవమానాన్ని, సమాజపు చేదు మాటలను ఎదుర్కొంటూ జీవిస్తుంది. తన కుమారుడే ఆమె ప్రపంచం.

కానీ ఆ రహస్య తండ్రి మరెవరో కాదు – బిలియనీర్ సీఈఓ చైతన్య. ఏళ్ల తర్వాత అతను అనుకోకుండా ఆమె జీవితంలోకి రక్షకుడిలా అడుగుపెడతాడు. ప్రేమ, మాయ, నిజం కలిసిన ఈ ప్రయాణంలో – గతం ఎప్పుడు బయటపడుతుందో, భవిష్యత్తు ఎటు మలుపుతిప్పుతుందో

husband-honored-wife-esteemed.title: Husband Honored, Wife Esteemed
husband-honored-wife-esteemed.description: The story follows a well-regarded scholar and his talented wife who navigate the challenges of the imperial court, using their intelligence and mutual respect to overcome political strife and conspiracies. It's a tale of a loving, equal partnership where both spouses value each other's contributions in upholding their family's honor.

cursed-by-love-1.title: Cursed By Love
cursed-by-love-1.description: భర్త మోసం చేసి వదిలేసిన వైష్ణవి, అవమానంలో కూరుకుపోతుంది. కానీ ఆమె అసలు నిజం — ధనిక వారసురాలు, ప్రతిభావంతురాలు. తిరిగి లేచి తన శక్తిని చూపించేందుకు సిద్ధమవుతుంది. ఈ సమయంలో ఆమెకు తోడుగా నిలుస్తాడు విక్రాంత్ దేశాయ్ — గౌరవం, ప్రేమతో ఆమెను ఆదరించే సీఈఓ. కలిసి శత్రువులను ఎదుర్కొంటూ, వైష్ణవి న్యాయం కోసం పోరాటం ప్రారంభిస్తుంది.

joru-ka-ghulam-1.title: Love, Lies & Laughter
joru-ka-ghulam-1.description:
A hilarious tale of love, power, and submission inside a marriage where the rules are flipped.
Between family meddling, ego clashes, and laugh-out-loud twists, nothing is as it seems.
Love, Lies & Laughter is a satirical roller-coaster of drama, betrayal, and comedy that hits home.

i-fed-the-ancient-generals-in-the-superm.title: I fed the ancient generals in the supermarket.
i-fed-the-ancient-generals-in-the-superm.description: A gripping romantic drama where a woman walks away from a cold, loveless marriage—only for her ex-husband to realize too late what he has lost. As she rebuilds her life with confidence and charm, he falls for her all over again, determined to win back the woman he once took for granted.

the-mistaken-child-4.title: The Mistaken Child
the-mistaken-child-4.description:
When a child vanishes without a trace, buried secrets erupt and lives are torn apart.
Every clue deepens the web of betrayal, love, and shocking revelations.
The Mistaken Child is a gripping mystery-thriller that keeps you guessing until the very end.

triple-trouble.title: Triple Trouble
triple-trouble.description: When a 6-year-old boy sets out to find the perfect father for his single mother, he accidentally walks into the lives of three powerful triplet brothers—one of whom is his real dad, though none remember the night that connects them. One child, one forgotten encounter, and three men tied to a secret that could destroy the entire Mehta empire.

chakravarthy-1.title: Chakravarthy
chakravarthy-1.description: Watch family entertaining show 'Chakravarthy'. Only on KukuTV

oye-heroine-chill.title: Oye Heroine, Chill!
oye-heroine-chill.description: “A reckless delivery boy dies in an accident and wakes up inside a novel as its doomed villain, but decides he’ll rewrite his fate with swag and street-smart jugaad. As he dodges the overpowered hero, two feisty heroines, and deadly enemies, chaos, comedy, and crazy misunderstandings explode in every scene.”

the-mistaken-child-2.title: The Mistaken Child
the-mistaken-child-2.description: Watch family entertaining show 'The Mistaken Child' only on KukuTV

the-mistaken-child-3.title: The Mistaken Child
the-mistaken-child-3.description: When a child goes missing, secrets unravel and lives collide. The Mistaken Child is a gripping tale of love, betrayal, and the desperate search for truth. Every moment pulls you deeper into the mystery. Watch Now !

billionaire-bana-bodyguard.title: Billionaire Bana Bodyguard
billionaire-bana-bodyguard.description: The billionaire became a bodyguard just to find true love! When identities switched, love's true face was revealed!

the-call-boy-i-met-in-bengaluru.title: The Call Boy I met in Bengaluru
the-call-boy-i-met-in-bengaluru.description: The Call Boy I met in Bengaluru

jabariya-shaadi.title: Jabariya Shaadi
jabariya-shaadi.description: A fearless girl is kidnapped for a forced marriage to a spoiled zamindar’s son, but she turns the tables and fights back with unexpected courage. As family feuds, secrets, and chaos explode around them, this ‘jabariya shaadi’ becomes a wild clash of love, power, and destiny.

throne-of-the-end-game.title: Thani Oruvan - Greatest of All Time
throne-of-the-end-game.description: Intha naatula 90% wealth intha oru CEO kitta thaan irukku. Appadi patta namma hero yaarunu theriyama avara oru kootam asinga paduthuthu. Aduthu varra twist ah therinjuka full show va paarunga.

doctor-vs-billionaires-2.title: The Doctor Who Crossed a Billionaire
doctor-vs-billionaires-2.description: In a world of wealth, ego, and arrogance, little Aarya’s innocent prank spirals into a fight between life and death. While her heartbeat slips away in the hospital, the only doctor who can save her is trapped on the road, blackmailed, humiliated by a ruthless couple blinded by pride. As every second counts, shocking truths unfold, the child fighting for life may be their own daughter. Will redemption come in time… or will their cruelty cost them the one thing they can never replace? Watch Now!

queen-mom-vs-gold-digger.title: Queen Mom vs Gold Digger
queen-mom-vs-gold-digger.description: A heart-warming yet high-stakes family drama where a devoted mother and her three sons battle betrayal from a toxic ex-husband and a manipulative fiancée. Through emotional trials, hidden truths, and dramatic confrontations, the family ultimately unites, love wins, and destiny brings the perfect soulmate into their lives.

chakravarthy.title: Chakravarthy
chakravarthy.description: పార్థ్ సింగ్, సింగ్ గ్రూప్‌కి కొత్త మేనేజింగ్ డైరెక్టర్. కానీ తన అసలు వ్యక్తిత్వాన్ని అందరి నుండి దాచిపెట్టాడు – తన భార్యకు, అత్తమామలకే కాదు. తన మామగారి పుట్టినరోజు వేడుకకు వెళ్లినప్పుడు, వారు అతన్ని తక్కువ చేసి అవమానిస్తారు. ఈ సంక్షోభ సమయంలో అతను తన అసలు వ్యక్తిత్వాన్ని బయటపెడతాడా? చూడండి ఇప్పుడే!

final-190-minutes.title: Final 190 Minutes
final-190-minutes.description: Railway Minister Narendra Jha survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant in Patna. With flights grounded, the only hope is Dr. Nihal Mathur - brilliant, controversial, and just reinstated. He has 190 minutes to transport the donor heart and save the Minister. But the mission spirals when socialite Kamya Tiwari, her hot-headed brother Sunny, and her fiancé Kabir Jha sabotage his path with ego and revenge. Every delay pushes the clock closer to death. Watch now!

happy-ending-1.title: Happy Ending
happy-ending-1.description: అనుమానం దెయ్యం లాంటిది. అది ఎంత పనైనా చేస్తుంది. కొత్త జీవితాన్ని మొదలు పెట్టబోతున్న అనిక జీవితం అనుమానంతో తల్లకిందులైంది. అసలేం జరిగింది? చూడండి హ్యాపీ ఎండింగ్.. మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

beggar-emperor.title: Raja Rani: Secrets of the Beggar King
beggar-emperor.description: The beggar king found his bride… but the palace walls are closing in with lies, poison, and power. Who survives the final blow? Watch now!

manipallavam-4.title: மணிபல்லவம் - 4
manipallavam-4.description: பூம்புகாரின் வீதிகளில், அறிவு போரில் வெற்றி காணும் இளங்குமரனும், இதயத்தை கொள்ளை கொள்ளும் சுரமஞ்சரியும் நாயகர்களாக உருவெடுக்கிறார்கள். மர்மங்களும் உணர்ச்சிகளும் மிளிரும் இந்த கதை, மணிபல்லவ தீவில் திகட்டும் திருப்பங்களால் வாசகர்களை சிறைபிடிக்கிறது.

lav-kush-tap-aur-tyag-ki-gaatha.title: Lav - Kush: Tap Aur Tyag ki Gaatha
lav-kush-tap-aur-tyag-ki-gaatha.description: Kya Lav aur Kush sach mein Shri Ram ke putra hain? Ashwamedh Yagya ka ghoda unhe kaunse raaj kholne ke liye prerit karta hai? Suniye Uttar Ramayan ke unsune kisse, jo Ramayan ke gyaan ko ek naye roop mein aap tak laayenge.

manipallavam-3.title: மணிபல்லவம் - 3
manipallavam-3.description: பூம்புகாரின் வீதிகளில், அறிவு போரில் வெற்றி காணும் இளங்குமரனும், இதயத்தை கொள்ளை கொள்ளும் சுரமஞ்சரியும் நாயகர்களாக உருவெடுக்கிறார்கள். மர்மங்களும் உணர்ச்சிகளும் மிளிரும் இந்த கதை, மணிபல்லவ தீவில் திகட்டும் திருப்பங்களால் வாசகர்களை சிறைபிடிக்கிறது.

akbar-beerabal-kathegalu.title: Akbar Beerabal Kathegalu
akbar-beerabal-kathegalu.description: ಜನಸ್ನೇಹಿ ರಾಜ ಅಕ್ಬರ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಬೀರಬಲ್‌ ನಡುವಿನ ಹಾಸ್ಯ, ಯುಕ್ತಿಯುತ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಯುತವಾದ ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸರಿಸಾಟಿ ಏನಿದೆ ಹೇಳಿ? ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಜೀವನಮೌಲ್ಯ ಕಲಿಸುವ ನೀತಿಕತೆಗಳು ಇಲ್ಲಿವೆ‌. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಅಕ್ಬರ್ ಬೀರಬಲ್ ಕಥೆಗಳು' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

rishi-durvasa-shraap-ke-janak.title: Rishi Durvasa : Shraap Ke Janak
rishi-durvasa-shraap-ke-janak.description: Ek aise Rishi ki kahani, jinke shrap ne logon ke bhavishya badal diye aur jinke vardaan ne itihas rach diya. Kaise unka krodh naye kal ke liye ek raah ban gaya? Is audio show mein suniye Rishi Durvasa ji ka anokha safar, jahan har katha aapko ek seekh deti hai.

samaadhana-bhaaga-1.title: Samaadhana Bhaaga 1
samaadhana-bhaaga-1.description: `ಓ ಮನಸೇ...' ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ಅಂಕಣವೆಂದರೆ `ಸಮಾಧಾನ'. ಈ ಅಂಕಣದ ಶೈಲಿ, ಇಬ್ಬರು ಆಪ್ತ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರು ಎದುರು ಕುಳಿತು ಮನದ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡಂತೆ ತೋರುತ್ತದೆ. ನಾನು ಈ ಅಂಕಣವನ್ನು ಬರೆಯುವಾಗ ನನ್ನ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಗಮನವನ್ನು ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತೇನೆ. ಈ ಅಂಕಣಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದ ಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ನನ್ನ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿಯವರಿಗೆ ಓದಲು ಬಿಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಏಕೆಂದರೆ ನನಗೆ ಇದರತ್ತ ಅಪಾರ ಶ್ರದ್ಧೆ ಇದೆ. ಕಾಲಕಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಈ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳು ನನ್ನಿಗೆ ಲಘುವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಬಹುದು, ಆದರೆ ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವವರಿಗೆ ಅಷ್ಟೇನೂ ಸಣ್ಣ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯಾಗಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅದರಂತೆಯೇ, ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರಾಗಿದೆ `ಸಮಾಧಾನ'.

relationship-cure.title: Relationship Cure
relationship-cure.description: ನಿಮ್ ಲವ್ ಲೈಫ್ ಹೇಗಿರಬೇಕು? ಗಂಡ ಹೆಂಡತಿ ರಿಲೇಷನ್ ಶಿಪ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅನುಭವ ಏನು? ಇಂತಹಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರವಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತೆ ಈ ಕಂಟೆಂಟ್. ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ, ಸ್ನೇಹದ, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲಸದ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸೋಕೆ  ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ಸ್ಕಿಲ್ ಗಳನ್ನ ಇದು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸ್ತಿದೆ. ಒಳ್ಳೆ  ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟಬಹುದು ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಎಮೋಶನಲ್ ಇಂಟೆಲಿಜೆನ್ಸ್ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಪಡಿಸಿ, ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಗಾಢಗೊಳಿಸೋಕೆ ಸುಲಭ ಸೂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನ ಇದು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ದ ರಿಲೇಶನ್‌ಶಿಪ್ ಕ್ಯೂರ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ತೃಪ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂತೋಷವನ್ನು ತರೋಕೆ, ಉತ್ತಮ ಸಂವಹನ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯೋಕೆ ಒಂದು ಗೈಡ್ ರೀತಿ ಇದೆ.

Munna-Bajrangi-अंडरवर्ल्ड-का-नया-बाज़ीगर.title: Munna Bajrangi: अंडरवर्ल्ड का नया बाज़ीगर
Munna-Bajrangi-अंडरवर्ल्ड-का-नया-बाज़ीगर.description: Ek bus conductor se Uttar Pradesh ke sabse bade don tak ka safar! yeh hai Munna Bajrangi ki kahani. 40 se zyada murder, BJP neta aur ACP ka katal, aur jail ke andar uska aakhri anjaam. Yeh daastaan hai ek aise insaan ki, jo khauf ka doosra naam ban gaya.

kanavu-kanni.title: Kanavu kanni
kanavu-kanni.description: அழகே பொறாமை படும் பேரழகி நடிகை ராஷிகா மேனன். ரசிகனை காதலிக்க தொடங்கும் கனவுக்கன்னியின் கதை தான் இது.

Black-Hole-Tragedy-कलकत्ता-का-घिनौना-इति.title: Ghulami Ka Badla:अंग्रेज़ बने अपने ही पाप का शिकार
Black-Hole-Tragedy-कलकत्ता-का-घिनौना-इति.description: Ek aisi raat jo kabhi bhulayi nahi jaa sakti! Black Hole Tragedy ek aisa kaala itihaas hai jahan, British soldiers ek chhoti si jagah mein kaid, hawaa ke bina tadapte, aur maut se ek-ek pal ladte rahe. Yeh daastaan insani himmat aur taqdeer ke ek aise chapter ki hai, jo aapko har mod par jhunjhod degi.

2nd-first-love.title: 2nd first love
2nd-first-love.description: A heartbroken Karthik agrees to an arranged marriage only to discover that his bride, Abinaya, is a mirror image of his late fiancée, Jeni. As they navigate their unexpected connection, love blossoms, but a dark secret from the past threatens to tear them apart.

ulkazhcha-vijayathinu.title: ഉൾകാഴ്ച വിജയത്തിന്
ulkazhcha-vijayathinu.description: ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ ജീവിതവിജയത്തിനുള്ള മാർഗങ്ങൾ, ആത്മാവബോധം, മാനസിക ശക്തി എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ച് പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്നു. ദൈനംദിന ജീവിതത്തിൽ നേരിടുന്ന വെല്ലുവിളികളെ അതിജീവിക്കാനുള്ള പ്രായോഗിക ഉപദേശങ്ങളും, ആത്മവിശ്വാസം വളർത്താനുള്ള തന്ത്രങ്ങളും ഇതിൽ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു.

tilottama.title: Tilottama
tilottama.description: Tilottama ek aisi chudail hai jiske andar mardon ke sath raat guzarne ki pyaas hai. Par wo sirf unhi mardon ka shikar karti hai jo ghar par biwi hone ke bawjood, Tilottama ke sundarta ke jaal mein phas jate hai. Har poornima ki raat ko jab aasman mein chaand aur Rooppur ki pedon par phool safed se lal hone lagte hai, ganv wale samjh jate hai ki Tilottama ne apna shikar kar liya hai. Ek ajeeb sa sannata ganv ko gher leta hai, aur log apne gharon mein band ho jaate hain. Par in sab ke baad bhi kyu Rooppur ke log ab bhi karte hai apsara sadhna aur bulate hai aisi chudail ko?

keralathile-navodhana-nayakar.title: കേരളത്തിലെ നവോത്ഥാന നായകര്‍
keralathile-navodhana-nayakar.description: ജാതിഭ്രാന്തിന്റെ ഇരുട്ടില്‍ നിന്ന് കേരളത്തെ വെളിച്ചത്തിലേക്ക് കൈപിടിച്ച് നടത്തിയ മഹത്തുക്കളുടെ സംഭവബഹുലമായ ജീവിതം കേള്‍ക്കാം. 25 നവോത്ഥാന നായകരുടെ ജീവചരിത്രം അടങ്ങിയ പുസ്തകം.

7-strategies-of-wealth-and-happiness.title: 7 Strategies of wealth and Happiness
7-strategies-of-wealth-and-happiness.description: ನಿಮ್ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಲ್ವಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಈ ಕಂಟೆಂಟ್ ಕೇಳಿ ನೋಡಿ. ಸಕ್ಸಸ್ ಬೇಡ  ಅಂದ್ರೂ ನಿಮ್ ಹಿಂದೆ ಬರೋ ಥರ ಮಾಡೋ ಗುಟ್ಟಿದು. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ  ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಫೈನಾನ್ಸಿಯಲ್ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿಯನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸೋಕೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡೋ ಏಳು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಟೆಕ್ನಿಕ್ ಗಳನ್ನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೆ. ಗುರಿ ಫಿಕ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡೋದು, ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಯೋಚ್ನೆ, ಟೈಮ್ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣದಂತಹ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳ್ತಾ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಭವಿಷ್ಯವನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸೋಕೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನು ನನಸು ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ಶೋ ಮಿಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಡಿ

acid-man.title: The Acid Man
acid-man.description:
Mumbai ke ek flyover ke bhumipujan ke dauraan, mukhyamantri ki upasthiti mein zameen ke neeche se ujagar hui laash ne poore sheher mein bhuchaal la diya. Police department, media aur har nagrik hil gaya. CID officer Makarand Raj aur Vijay ko yeh case solve karne ka zimma diya gaya, par saboot ke taur par sirf ek parking ticket ke alawa unhe kuch haath na lag saka. Lekin doctor Maitreyi aur uski forensic team ke investigation ke baad kuch aise raaz saamne aaye ki laash ki pehchaan ho gayi. Jiski laash mili thi, use Mumbai ki public 'Acid Man' ke naam se jaanti thi.

Ab sawal yeh hai ki kya Makarand aur Vijay iss 'Acid Man' ke qatil tak pahunch paayenge?

hulivesha-kathegalu.title: Hulivesha Kathegalu
hulivesha-kathegalu.description: ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನವರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಶಾರದೋತ್ಸವದ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ 'ಪಿಲಿಕೋಲ' ಅಂತಾನೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಿ ಪಡೆದಿರೋ 'ಹುಲಿಕುಣಿತ' ಸಿಕ್ಕಾಪಟ್ಟೆ ಫೇಮಸ್. ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಾಲ್ಪನಿಕ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು 'ವಿಠಲ್ ಶೆಣೈ' ಅವರು 'ಹುಲಿವೇಷ ಕತೆಗಳು' ಕೃತಿ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ

putta-puttige-putta-hanathe.title: Putta Puttige Putta Hanathe
putta-puttige-putta-hanathe.description: ಪ್ರಪಂಚದ ವಿಚಾರವನ್ನು ಮಗುವಿನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುವ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುತೂಹಲಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸುವ ಅಜ್ಜಿ-ಮೊಮ್ಮಗಳ ಈ ಕಥಾಲೋಕ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಪುಟ್ಟ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗುವುದು ಎನ್ನುವುದಂತೂ ಸುಳ್ಳಲ್ಲ.
