bhanumati-prem-se-pratisodh-tak.title: Bhanumati : Prem Se Pratisodh Tak
bhanumati-prem-se-pratisodh-tak.description: Rajneeti, Prem aur Dharm ke sangharsh mein ghoomti Bhanuvati ki kahani jo Duryodhan ke karmon ka aaina bhi hai aur Bhanuvati ke swabhiman ki ladayi bhi. Is audio series mein suniye kaise ek maharani ka shraap ek rajya ki kismat badal deta hai. Aaj hi sunein poori kahani.

srikanth-bolla-true-story-of-blind-indus.title: Srikanth Bolla: True Story Of Blind Industrialist
srikanth-bolla-true-story-of-blind-indus.description: అవిటితనం శరీరానికే కానీ తెలివికి కాదని నిరూపించి ఉన్నత శిఖరాలను అధిరోహించిన మన తెలుగోడి విజయ గాథ.

lovers-in-the-dark.title: LOVERS IN THE DARK
lovers-in-the-dark.description: Ek mysterious love story jisme Myra ke emotions aur dar ke beech chal raha hai ek khatarnaak khel.  Ek shaksh Jisase maayara ko chidh bhi hai magar khud ko us ke qarib jaane se wo rok bhi nhi paati. kaun hai ye anzaana shaksh Kya Maayra khud ko uske qarib jaane se rok paayegi?

Pillala-Pempakam-Oka-kala-పిల్లల-పెంపకం-.title: పిల్లల పెంపకం ఒక కళ
Pillala-Pempakam-Oka-kala-పిల్లల-పెంపకం-.description: వీడియో గేమ్స్‌, ఛాటింగ్‌, టీవిల పై పిల్లల ఆసక్తిని తగ్గించటం ఎలా? అల్లరికి మొండితనానికి తేడా ఏమిటి? పిల్లలు బాగా చదవాలంటే పెద్దలు ఏం చెయ్యాలి?  టీన్స్‌ని వ్యక్తిత్వంతో పెంచటానికీ కావలసిన గైడ్‌-లైన్స్‌పై సంపూర్ణమైన పుస్తకం.

Cheekatlo-Suryudu-చీకట్లో-సూర్యుడు.title: చీకట్లో సూర్యుడు
Cheekatlo-Suryudu-చీకట్లో-సూర్యుడు.description: "చీకట్లలో సూర్యుడు" యండమూరి వీరేంద్రనాథ్ రాసిన ప్రేరణాత్మక నవల.కథానాయకుడి ప్రయాణం సామాన్య స్థితి నుండి అసాధారణ స్థితికి ఎలా మారిందో, అతని బలహీనతలు మరియు విజయాలు, స్వీయనిర్ణయం, ఆత్మవిశ్వాసం, మరియు పట్టుదలతో అనేక రకాలుగా ఈ కథ వివరించబడింది. కథ మనకు శతాబ్దాల ముందు ఉంది, అంతరిక్ష ప్రయాణం మరియు ప్రేమ త్రిభుజానికి తోడ్పడుతుంది.

1fbf90ce-88a1-4fc2-8c47-495cc487519b.title: Border Gavaskar Trophy 2024-25
1fbf90ce-88a1-4fc2-8c47-495cc487519b.description: BGT 2024-25: Hone wala hai Australia ke khilaf Team India ka maha muqabla shuru! Aggression se bhari takraar, chotil khiladiyon ki tension, aur Kohli-Smith ke records ki takkar – kya India kar paayegi WTC Final ka sapna poora? Dekhiye aur janiye is video mein aanewale young heroes, daring strategies, aur impossible comebacks ki kahaniyan!

Gulaabilu--గులాబీలు.title: గులాబీలు
Gulaabilu--గులాబీలు.description: సారా వ్యతిరేక ఉద్యమం నేపథ్యంలో మధ్య తరగతి మహిళలలో మారుతున్న సామాజిక చైతన్యం గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే "గులాబీలు" అనే ఆడియో కథను వినండి.

panchatantrada-kathegalu-bhaaga-2.title: Panchatantrada Kathegalu Bhaaga 2
panchatantrada-kathegalu-bhaaga-2.description: ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ, ಪಕ್ಷಿ, ಕಾಡು ಮುಂತಾದ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಬದುಕಿನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬೋಧಿಸಬಹುದು. ಈ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಸತ್ಯ, ನ್ಯಾಯ, ನೀತಿ, ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕತೆ ಇವುಗಳ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿ, ಅವರು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಇವುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬ ಸಂದೇಶ ನೀಡಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯ.

kal-ka-arjun.title: Kal Ka Arjun
kal-ka-arjun.description: Saal 2075 me har kisi ko zameen naseeb nahin thi. Arjun aur uske pita bhi ek airland par raha karte the lekin kuch aesa hua ki unse vo airland bhi chhin gaya. Saare airland takrakar zameen par girne lage or tabaahi mach gai. Aese me Arjun ko pata chala ki vo koi aam insaan nahin balki uski zindagi ka ek maksad hai. Is tabahi ko vahi rok sakta hai. Lekin kaise? Kya musibatein aayengi uske saamne? Jaanne ke liye suniye "Kal Ka Arjun".

bottom-item.title: Bottom Item
bottom-item.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಒಂದಲ್ಲಾ ಒಂದು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಇದ್ದೇ ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಬದುಕು ದುರ್ಭರ ಎನಿಸುತ್ತೆ‌. ಸಾಕಪ್ಪಾ ಈ ಭಯ, ಚಿಂತೆ, ಸೋಲು, ಅವಮಾನ, ಕಷ್ಟಗಳನ್ನ ಎದುರಿಸೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯವೇ ಇಲ್ಲಾ ಅಂತಾ ಕೈ ಚೆಲ್ಲೋರು ಹಲವರು. ಬದುಕಿನ ಇಂಥ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಲಹೆಯಂತೆ ಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕ 'ರವಿ ಬೆಳಗೆರೆ' ಅವರು 'ಬಾಟಮ್ ಐಟಮ್' ಅನ್ನೋ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕೃತಿ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

pathways-to-peace-of-mind-1.title: Pathways to peace of mind
pathways-to-peace-of-mind-1.description: ಲೈಫ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಏನ್ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂತ ಯಾರಾದ್ರೂ ಕೇಳಿದ್ರೆ ಏನ್ ಹೇಳ್ತೀರಿ? ದುಡ್ಡು ಮುಖ್ಯಾನಾ ಅಥ್ವಾ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿನ ಅಂತ ಕೇಳಿದ್ರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಏನಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ? ಸಮಾಧಾನ ಶಾಂತಿ ಕಂಡ್ಕೋಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು? ನಮ್ಮ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಒತ್ತಡ, ಆತಂಕ, ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮಸಂತೃಪ್ತಿಗೆ ತೊಂದರೆ ನೀಡುವ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನ ನಿಭಾಯಿಸೋಕೆ, ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಶಾಂತಿಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಸೂಪರ್ರಾಗಿರೋ ಟಿಪ್ಸ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಜಂಜಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ ಮೈಂಡ್ ಕಾಮ್ ಆಗಿರೋಕೆ ನೀವ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕಾಗಿರುವ ಕೆಲಸ ಏನೇನು? ಈ ಶೋನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ

rishi-markandeya-bhakti-aur-amarta-ki-ga.title: Rishi Markandeya : Bhakti Aur Amarta Ki Gatha
rishi-markandeya-bhakti-aur-amarta-ki-ga.description: Kya aap apni life ke sabse bade challenges ke samane helpless feel karte hain? Ye show aapko batayega ki kaise aap Dhruv ki kahani aur Rishi Markandeya ki amaratva shakti se inspire hokar aap apni life badal Sakte hain. To abhi sunna shuru kariye aur zindagi ka ek naya perspective payiye.

how-to-attract-money-9.title: How to attract Money
how-to-attract-money-9.description: ನಾವು ನಮ್ ಸ್ಟ್ರೆಂತ್ ಬಳಸ್ಕೊಂಡು ಹೇಗೆ ಹಣವನ್ನ ಅಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬಹುದು. ನಮ್ಮ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾವನೆಗಳು ನಮ್ಮ ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಬಹಳ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಭಾವಶಾಲಿಯಾಗಿ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಲೇಖಕರು ತಿಳಿಸ್ತಾ ಹೋಗ್ತಾರೆ. ನಮ್ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇಕಾದ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಹುಟ್ಟು ಹಾಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಒಂದು ಸಮೃದ್ಧ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸೋಕೆ ಹಣವನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿನಿಯೋಗಿಸ್ಕೊಬೇಕು? ಹಣ ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಕೂಡಾ ನಾವು ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳ್ತಾ ಹೋಗ್ಬೋದು. ಹಣ ಮಾಡೋರಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೂಡೋರಿಗೆ ಇದು ಬೆಸ್ಟ್ ಕಂಟೆಂಟ್ ಅಂದ್ರೂ ತಪ್ಪಾಗಲ್ಲ!

dream-girl-1.title: Falling For The Call Girl
dream-girl-1.description: ആല്‍ബി കുര്യന്‍ മാത്യു തന്റെ ബിസിനസ് ടെന്‍ഷനും, ഫ്രസ്‌ട്രേഷനുമെല്ലാം തീര്‍ത്തിരുന്നത് വീക്കെന്‍ഡുകളിലെ കാമകേളികളിലൂടെയായിരുന്നു.  എന്നാല്‍ അന്ന് അവന്റെ മുന്നിലെത്തിയ കോള്‍ ഗേള്‍ അവനെ വീഴ്ത്തിക്കളഞ്ഞു. അനശ്വര! ശരിക്കുമൊരു ഡ്രീം ഗേള്‍! എല്ലാവരെയും പോലെ ഒരു പെണ്ണായിരുന്നില്ല അവള്‍. അതുകൊണ്ടു തന്നെ അവളെ സ്വന്തമാക്കാന്‍ സുധാമണി പറഞ്ഞ കാശ് കൊടുക്കാന്‍ അവനാലോചിക്കേണ്ടി വന്നില്ല. പക്ഷേ അവള്‍ ശരിക്കും ആരാണ്?

cartel.title: Cartel
cartel.description: Akash apne pita ke against jakar Police Force ko join kar chuka hai. Aur pehle hi case mein shak ki sui MLA Shankar ki ghoom gayi hai, jis par haath daalne ka matlab Mumbai ko jala dena hai. To kya Akash asli qatilon ko dhoondh payega? Kya Akash apne pita ko samjha payega? Janne ke liye sunien, Cartel...

silent-son-in-law-1.title: Silent Son- in- Law
silent-son-in-law-1.description: ഭാര്യവീട്ടിൽ ഒരു വിലയുമില്ലാതെ, അടിമയെപ്പോലെ ജീവിച്ച അശ്വിന് മറ്റാർക്കും അറിയാത്ത ഒരു രഹസ്യമുണ്ടായിരുന്നു. സംസാരിക്കാൻ കഴിവില്ലാത്ത അശ്വിന്റെ ദാമ്പത്യബന്ധം തകർക്കാൻ അവന്റെ ഭാര്യയുടെ Ex-ബോയ്ഫ്രണ്ട് ശ്രമം തുടങ്ങി. എന്നാൽ ആർക്കും വിശ്വസിക്കാൻ ആകാത്ത കാര്യങ്ങളാണ് പിന്നെയെങ്ങോട്ട്  അവൻ ചെയ്തത്. ശരിക്കും ആരാണ് അശ്വിൻ? എന്തിനാണ് അവൻ ഒരു ഊമയായി അഭിനയിച്ചത്?

haji-mastan-mumbai-ka-don-no1.title: Haji Mastan: Mumbai Ka Don No.1
haji-mastan-mumbai-ka-don-no1.description: Haji Mastan: Mumbai Ka Don No.1 - Ek aise Don ki kahani jiska khauf mumbai ki galiyon se shuru hua aur fir  poore india tak chha gaya! Toh Kaise ek aam aadmi bana Bambai ka Sultan? Suniye uski zindagi ke raaz, dosti, dushmani aur daring decisions ki asli kahani. Miss mat kariyega kyunki Yeh hai glamour aur crime ki duniya ka asli shenshah ka safar!

love-lock.title: Love Lock
love-lock.description: രണ്ട് ഇരട്ട സഹോദരിമാർ, അവരുടെ കുടുംബത്തിന്റെ പാരമ്പര്യ ദേവി പദവിയിൽ നിന്ന് രക്ഷപ്പെടാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുമ്പോൾ, അവർ സ്വയം കണ്ടെത്തലിന്റെയും വഴിതെറ്റിയ പ്രണയത്തിന്റെയും ഒരു സങ്കീർണ്ണമായ വലയിൽ കുരുങ്ങുന്നു, അവസാനം തങ്ങളുടെ വിധി നേരിടാൻ നിർബന്ധിതരാകുന്നു.

kshameyirali-taayi-tunge.title: Kshameyirali Taayi Tunge
kshameyirali-taayi-tunge.description: ನಮ್ಮ ಬದುಕಿನ ಕಾಲಘಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೆಷ್ಟು ಬಾರಿ ನಾವು ಸಂಕ್ರಮಣ ಕಾಲ ಎನ್ನುವ ಮಾತನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತೇವೆ . ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಸುಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಮನಸ್ಸೊಂದು ತನ್ನ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಉಳಿವಿಗಾಗಿ, ಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ, ಮೌಲ್ಯಯುತ ಬಾಳು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಡುವ ನಿಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಸುವ ಹೋರಾಟದ ಕತೆಯೇ "ಕ್ಷಮೆಯಿರಲಿ ತಾಯಿ ತುಂಗೆ".

gutthi.title: Silent Death
gutthi.description: Kapoor Villa me achanak ek raat Manmohan kapoor ke baad unki patni aur beti ka dum ghutne laga jiske baad unki maut ho gai. Lash par koi chot ka nishan na hone ke karan maut ki asli wajah jaan pana behad mushqil tha , ACP Manjari Mishra ke samne ye pahla aisa case tha jiska na sirf qatil farar tha balki qatl karne ka tarika bhi ek raaz tha. Aakhir kaise suljhayegi ye case ACP Manjari Mishra ?

o-manase.title: O Manase
o-manase.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರ ಕನಸು! ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ದಾರಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ದಾರಿದೀಪ ಬೇಕಲ್ವಾ? ಗೆದ್ದಾಗ ಬೆನ್ನು ತಟ್ಟಿ, ಸೋತಾಗ ಕೈ ಹಿಡಿದು ನಾಲ್ಕು ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ ಆಡಿದ್ರೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗೋಕೆ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ. ನೀವು ಕೂಡ ಇದನ್ನೇ ಬಯಸ್ತಿದ್ರೆ ಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕ 'ರವಿ ಬೆಳಗೆರೆ' ಅವರ ' ಓ ಮನಸೇ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ! ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಬದುಕಿಗೆ ಭರವಸೆ ತುಂಬೋ ಮಾತುಗಳು.

വലംപിരിശംഖ്.title: വലംപിരിശംഖ്
വലംപിരിശംഖ്.description: ആദിത്യപുരം കോവിലകത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ രഹസ്യമാണ് വലംപിരിശംഖും വലിയൊരു നിധി ശേഖരവും. പ്രസിദ്ധമായ ആദിത്യപുരം കോവിലകത്തിനെ  നിർത്താതെ വേട്ടയാടുകയാണ് ദുര്മരങ്ങളുടെ ഒരു  പരമ്പര. എന്നാൽ കോവികത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ രഹസ്യമായ വലംപിരിശംഖുമായും നിധിശേഖരവുമായും  ഈ അപകടങ്ങൾക്കു ഒരു ബന്ധമുണ്ട്. കുടുംബങ്ങൾ തമ്മിലുള്ള ഒടുങ്ങാത്ത പകയും മന്ത്രവാദവും ഒടിവിദ്യയും എല്ലാം മനോഹരമായി ആവിഷ്കരിച്ച ഏറ്റുമാനൂർ ശിവകുമാറിന്റെ മാന്ത്രിക നോവൽ- വലംപിരിശംഖ്!

roohani-ishq.title: Roohani Ishq
roohani-ishq.description: Jab bindaas Anika ek ziddi, handsome businessman ki aatma se takrati hai, toh wo use zindagi aur pyaar ka naya matlab sikhane lagta hai. Kya yeh supernatural romance kisi happy ending ki taraf badega, ya phir Anika ko is khatarnak magar rahasyamayi mohabbat ki keemat chukani padegi?

101-love.title: 101% Love
101-love.description: పెళ్లిళ్లు స్వర్గంలో నిర్ణయిస్తారు అంటారు పెద్దలు. అది నిజమే అంటారు మీరు ఈ కథ వింటే. టేబుల్ నంబర్స్ మారిపోవటం వల్ల, పెళ్లి చూపుల కోసం రెస్టారెంట్ కి వచ్చిన అమ్మాయిని, డేటింగ్ ఆప్ లో సెలెక్ట్ చేసుకున్న అబ్బాయి కలుస్తాడు. డేటింగ్ ఆప్ ని టెస్ట్ చెయ్యడానికి వచ్చిన, ఆ ఆప్ డెవలపర్ అయినా అమ్మాయి పొరపాటున పెళ్లి చూపుల కోసం ఎదురుచూస్తున్న అబ్బాయిని కలుస్తుంది. తొలి చూపులోనే ప్రేమలో పడిపోతారు.  ఆ తరువాత కథ ఏమైఉంటుందో అని కన్ఫ్యూషన్ లో ఉన్నారా ?? అయితే వినండి

sleep-easy-music-guidance.title: Sleep Easy : Music & Guidance
sleep-easy-music-guidance.description: Thookkam Varaama Kasta Padreengalaa? "Sleep Easy: Music & Guidance" show ungalukku thaan! . Idha Kelunga Kandippaa Thoongiruveenga🎵😴.

rental-dulha.title: Rental Dulha
rental-dulha.description: Kya Hoga jab Tamanna  apne Ex ko Jealous karne ke liye hire kiye hue rental boyfriend ke hi pyaar me gir jayegi? Tall, Handsome aur Billionaire Chirag ke kuch raaz hai jo nahi janti tamanna. Kya hoga jab use pata chalege raaz? kya hoga is Love story ka Anjaam? Happy Ending ya Dangerous Twist

calmness-music-meditation.title: Calmness : Music Meditation
calmness-music-meditation.description: 🎵🧘Calmness - Music Meditation : Guided meditation + amaithiyaana isai = Ungaloda mana amaithi. Amaithi illaama irukkura unga manasa amaithi padutha oru arumaiyaana marunthu intha show. Miss Pannaama Kelunga 🎧💕

jurm-city-story-of-love-crime-and-punish.title: Jurm City - Story Of Love, Crime And Punishment
jurm-city-story-of-love-crime-and-punish.description: "Raat ke sannate mein ek aadmi ki cheekhein Rounakpur ki sooni galiyon mein gum ho jaati hain. Inspector Satyajit naye shahar mein aate hi ek high-profile murder case mein ulajh jaate hain, jahan unka saamna keval maut se nahi, corruption aur political pressure se bhi hota hai. Dusri taraf, photojournalist Arun Mathur apni zindagi aur apne sapno ke beech joojh raha hai. Ek photo khinchne ki chahat mein, wo galat jagah par khooni haadse ka gawaah ban jaata hai. Rounakpur ki raahon mein hoti khaufnaak killings aur mafia ke ghorakdhandhe mein ulajhte hue Arun aur Satyajit apne tareeke se sach ka saamna karte hain. Suniye ye suspense aur thriller se bhari kahani sirf Kuku FM par!"

Rangula-Ratnam-రంగూల-రత్నం.title: రంగులరాట్నం
Rangula-Ratnam-రంగూల-రత్నం.description:
భారత గ్రామీణ జీవన విధానాన్ని, గ్రామస్తుల నిత్య జీవితాలను అత్యంత హాస్యప్రధానంగా మరియు సహజత్వంతో  ఉన్న కథ గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? కథానాయకుడు తన జీవితంలో అనుభవించిన సన్నివేశాలు, అతని చుట్టూ ఉన్న గ్రామ వాతావరణం, విభిన్న పాత్రల సన్నివేశాలు, వారి హాస్యాస్పద ప్రవర్తనలు, సంభాషణలతో ముందుకు సాగుతుంది. ప్రతి పాత్ర, ప్రతి సంఘటన, వంశీ తన ప్రత్యేక శైలిలో చమత్కారంగా, అందంగా చిత్రించాడు.
 అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "రంగులరాట్నం" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

Prardhana-ప్రార్థన.title: ప్రార్థన
Prardhana-ప్రార్థన.description: ఒక శాస్త్రవేత్త మరియు అతని కుమార్తె గురించి కథ. ఈ కథాంశం ప్రధానంగా క్యాన్సర్ మరియు దాని నివారణపై దృష్టి పెట్టింది. తన కుమార్తె క్యాన్సర్‌తో బాధపడుతున్నట్లు శాస్త్రవేత్త తెలుసుకున్నప్పుడు, ఆ శాస్త్రవేత్త ఏం చేశాడు? తన కూతుర్ని ఎలా రక్షించుకున్నాడు? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "ప్రార్థన" అనే కథను వినండి.

ajnabee-ban-gaye-hum-dono.title: Ajnabee Ban Gaye Hum Dono
ajnabee-ban-gaye-hum-dono.description: "Isse pehle ki ye mera beta Karan us ladki ke aur kareeb aayein, uski yaadein mita do!" Vishal Malhotra ek ruthless businessman tha, jise apni image se aur apni technology company se itna pyaar tha ki usne apne bete Karan tak ko nahin baksha aur uspe experiment kar diya. Kya Karan aur uski girlfriend Priya jaan paenge unki yaadon ka katil kaun tha? Aur kar paenge apni mohabbat puri? Ya ban jaenge vo hamesha ke liye Ajnabee !

mukesh-ambani-vaazhkkai-varalaaru.title: Mukesh Ambani Vaazhkkai Varalaaru
mukesh-ambani-vaazhkkai-varalaaru.description: Raththam mulukka Business cells dhan ivar udambula odum. Listen to the story of India's Richest Man

walt-disney-vaazhkkai-varalaaru.title: வால்ட் டிஸ்னி வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு
walt-disney-vaazhkkai-varalaaru.description: மிக்கி மவுஸ் என்ற ஒரே பாத்திரத்தின்மூலம் உலகப் புகழ் பெற்ற கலைஞர் வால்ட் டிஸ்னி. அதே நேரம், அவருடைய படைப்பாற்றலில் வந்துதித்த பாத்திரங்களைப் பல நாடுகள், பண்பாடுகளைச் சேர்ந்த குழந்தைகள் இன்றைக்கும் ரசித்து மகிழ்ந்துகொண்டிருக்கிறார்கள். தொலைநோக்குப் பார்வையோடு அவர் உருவாக்கிய பொழுதுபோக்குப் பாதையில்தான் இப்போதைய டிஜிட்டல் உலகம்கூட நடைபோடுகிறது. வால்ட் டிஸ்னி வென்ற கதையைச் சுவையான நடையில் விவரிக்கிறது இந்நூல்.

agent-kabir-trapped-in-terror.title: Agent Kabir - Trapped in Terror
agent-kabir-trapped-in-terror.description: Agent Kabir ko apne dost ki talaash karte hue 8 saal beet gaye the. Ek din, use khabar milti hai ki terrorist group Ikhlaaq duniya mein afra-tafri machane ke liye ek khatarnak mission par hai. Ikhlaaq ka mastermind 786 flights ko ek saath crash karane ka  khofnaaq plan bana raha hai, jo duniya bhar mein jang chhed sakta hai. Kabir ke liye ise rokna sirf ek mission nahi, balki poori insaniyat ko bachane ka maamla ban gaya hai. Kya Agent Kabir waqt par is khofnaak saazish ko rok payega?

napoleon-vaazhkkai-varalaaru.title: Napoleon Vaazhkkai Varalaaru
napoleon-vaazhkkai-varalaaru.description: உலகப் புகழ் பெற்ற நெப்போலியனின் வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு.  என். சொக்கன் சுவாரஸ்யமாக விவரிக்கும் இந்தப் புத்தகம், நெப்போலியன் பெற்ற வெற்றி மற்றும் தோல்விகளை சுவாரஸ்யமாக விளக்குகிறது.

elon-musk-12.title: .காம் தீவிரவாதி எலான் மஸ்க்
elon-musk-12.description: எலான் மஸ்க்கின் வாழ்வின் வழியாக, அவரது சாதனைகள் ஊடாக, அவரது இலக்குகளை எட்டும் பயணத்தின் பலனாக நாம் என்ன பெறப்போகிறோம் என்றால் அவரது முயற்சிகள் எல்லாம் வெற்றிபெற்று ஒன்றோடொன்று தொடர்புகளை ஏற்படுத்தி இணையும் புள்ளியில் உலகமே ’எலான்மயம்’ ஆகியிருக்கும். அதில் நாம் என்ன செய்துகொண்டிருப்போம்? என்ற பருந்துப்பார்வை தரிசனம்தான் இந்தப் புத்தகம்!

witch-please.title: Witch, Please!
witch-please.description: Jab Sky car accident ke baad Prince Aakash ke shareer mein aankh kholta hai, uski duniya ulat jaati hai. Kya wo apne naye roop aur jaadui khel se bachkar wapas laut paayega, ya yeh uski nayi kahani ki shuruaat hai?

bhoothagala-university.title: Bhoothagala University
bhoothagala-university.description: ಮಿಸ್ಟೇಕನ್ ಐಡೆಂಟಿಟಿಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ಯಮಧೂತರ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಯಮಲೋಕಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದ ಶ್ಯಾಮರಾವ್ ತನಗಾದ ಅನ್ಯಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕೋಪಗೊಳ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನನ್ನು ಭೂತವಾಗಿ ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲವು ವರ್ಷ ಇರಲು ಟ್ರೇನಿಂಗ್ ಕೊಡಲು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ಸಖತ್ ಕಾಮಿಡಿ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ ಅನ್ನಿಸೋ ಕತೆ‌ಯೇ ಲೇಖಕ ವಾಸುದೇವ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರೋ 'ಭೂತಗಳ ಯೂನಿವರ್ಸಿಟಿ'. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

sagaradaacheya-nadinalli.title: Sagaradaacheya Nadinalli
sagaradaacheya-nadinalli.description: ಹವ್ಯಾಸಿ ಲೇಖಕಿ ವಿಜಯ ಅವರು ಪ್ರವಾಸಿ ಪ್ರಿಯರೂ ಹೌದು. ಅವರು ತಮ್ಮ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಪತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊರದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಪ್ರವಾಸದ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ರಂಜನೀಯವಾಗಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿ ಹೊರದೇಶ ಪ್ರವಾಸ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳುವವರಿಗೆ ಅವರು ಗೆಳತಿಯಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸಲಹೆಗಳು ಆಪ್ತವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

chhote-sarkar-bihar-ka-bahubali.title: Chhote Sarkar: Bihar Ka Bahubali
chhote-sarkar-bihar-ka-bahubali.description: Mokama ka ek aam ladka kaise bana sabke liye dar ka doosra naam – ‘Chhote Sarkar’? Is show mein suniye, Manoj Singh ki kahani – dosti aur dushmani ke us rang mein doobi, jahan har qadam par maut hai aur har faisla ek chakravyuh! Yeh hai Bihar politics ka asli khel!

panchatantrada-kathegalu.title: Panchatantrada Kathegalu
panchatantrada-kathegalu.description: ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ, ಪಕ್ಷಿ, ಕಾಡು ಮುಂತಾದ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಬದುಕಿನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬೋಧಿಸಬಹುದು. ಈ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಸತ್ಯ, ನ್ಯಾಯ, ನೀತಿ, ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕತೆ ಇವುಗಳ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿ, ಅವರು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಇವುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬ ಸಂದೇಶ ನೀಡಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯ.

100-baggers-badi-kamai-ka-chota-formula.title: 100 baggers : Badi Kamai Ka Chota Formula
100-baggers-badi-kamai-ka-chota-formula.description: Chhote Stocks, Badi Kamai - Kaise Ek Sahi Pick Aapki Wealth ko 100 Guna Badha Sakta Hai! Jo bhi chhoti shuruat se stock market mein success ke raaz khojna chahta hai, unke liye yeh audiobook hai. Kya aap bhi 100 bagger stocks dhoondhna chahenge?

vismruthi.title: Vismruthi
vismruthi.description: ಆ ಸುಂದರ ಯುವತಿ ಡಾ. ಫಣಿಕೇತನನ ನರ‍್ಸಿಂಗ್ ಹೋಂಗೆ ಸೇರಿರುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅಪಘಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆನಪು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡವಳಾಕೆ. ಫಣಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಅವಳು ತನ್ನ ತಮ್ಮನ ಸಾವಿಗೆ ಕಾರಣಳಾದ ನೀರದ. ಆದರೆ ಆಕೆ ಅದನ್ನು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆಕೆ ಯಾರು? ಕಥೆ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ತಿರುವುಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮುಂದುವರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾದ ಪಾತ್ರಪೋಷಣೆ, ಕುತೂಹಲಭರಿತ ಶೈಲಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕೂಡಿದ ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿದೆ.

శివ-భక్తి-లీలలు.title: శివ భక్తి లీలలు
శివ-భక్తి-లీలలు.description: పరమేశ్వరుని లీలలు విని తరించండి. ఆ త్రినేత్రుడి కృపకు పాత్రులవ్వండి. భక్తుల మీద శివుని కృపకు తార్కాణం ఈ ఆడియోబుక్

Shakuntala-Aur-Dushyant--प्रेम-वियोग-और-.title: Shakuntala Aur Dushyant : प्रेम, वियोग और मिलन
Shakuntala-Aur-Dushyant--प्रेम-वियोग-और-.description: Kya aap bhi ek aisi kahani sunna chahenge jo pyaar, vishwas aur judai ke dard ko saath le kar aati hai? Shakuntala aur Dushyant ki prem kahani kuch aisi hi hai...kaise? Ye janne ke liye suniye hamara ye show..

e904cb01-bd4c-41ab-be88-0a16feabe27c.title: Hidden CEO
e904cb01-bd4c-41ab-be88-0a16feabe27c.description: ఒక రాత్రి రాజీవ్ చేసిన చిన్న తప్పు జీవితాంతం ఒక భారం మోసే బాధని పుట్టించింది, commander గా ఉన్న అతను తన తప్పుని సరిదిద్దుకోవడం కోసం ఎన్ని మెట్లు దిగాడు, ఎన్ని నిజాలు వెలుగులోకి తీసుకుని వచ్చాడు అనేది ఈ కథ! ఆశలు రాజీవ్ చేసిన తప్పు ఏంటి? అది సరిదిద్దుకోవడానికి ఏం చేసాడు?

ದೇವರಕಾಡು.title: Devarakaadu
ದೇವರಕಾಡು.description: 'ದೇವರ ಕಾಡು' ಐದು ಕಥೆಗಳ ಸಂಕಲನ. ದೇವರ ಕಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಮಿಂಚಿನಬಳ್ಳಿ ಎಂಬುದು ನೀಳ್ಗತೆಗಳು. ಪ್ಯಾರಾಗ್ಲೈಡಿಂಗ್ ತಜ್ಞ ಸಿದ್ಧಾರ್ಥ, ಕೊಡಗಿನ ಯುವಕ ಸುನೀಲನ ಒತ್ತಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟುಬಿದ್ದು ಪಶ್ಚಿಮಘಟ್ಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ಲೈಡಿಂಗ್ ಮಾಡಲು ಹೋದಾಗ ಎದುರಿಸುವ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳ ಚಿತ್ರಣ 'ದೇವರ ಕಾಡು'ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಅರಣ್ಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳ ಅತಿಕ್ರಮಣ ಮತ್ತು ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ಜನರ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. 'ಮಿಂಚಿನಬಳ್ಳಿ'ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕೃತಿ, ಮಾನವನಿಗೆ ಪಾಠ ಕಲಿಸುವಂತೆ ತೋರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಉಳಿದ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಪ್ರೇಮ, ಪತ್ತೇದಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನೊಳಗೊಂಡಿವೆ.

bhawal-ka-rahasya-kabra-se-pare-nyay.title: Punarjanam Ka Rehasya: Bhawal Ki Dabi Huyi Aawaz
bhawal-ka-rahasya-kabra-se-pare-nyay.description: Ek Rajkumar jo jal gaya tha... aur ek Sanyasi jo vaapas aa gaya! Kya yeh sach hai ya saazish? Kholein Bhawal ke is ghumnaam raaz ko, jahaan maut aur vaapsi ke darmiyan ek hairat angez kahani dastak de rahi hai!

a-night-with-neighbour-lady.title: A Night with Neighbour Lady
a-night-with-neighbour-lady.description: ప్రియుడి కోసం తన భర్తను సంహిత హత్య చేసిందా? విక్రాంత్ కామదాహానికి బలైన సంహిత జీవితం చివరికి ఏమయ్యింది?

bhranthu.title: ഭ്രാന്ത്
bhranthu.description: തന്റെ മുറചെറുക്കനുമായുളള  കല്യാണജീവിതം അമ്മു  സ്വപ്നം കണ്ടിരുന്നു, എന്നാൽ താൻ അയാളുടെ കാമശാന്തിക്കുളള ഉപകരണം മാത്രമാണ്  അമ്മു തിരിച്ചറിയുന്നത് വൈകിയാണ് . ഉളളിൽ ഊറികൂടിയ അശാന്തികളെ തലോടിയമർത്താൻ പിന്നീടവൾ പല പുരുഷന്മാരെയും മനസ്സിലേക്കും ശരീരത്തിലേക്കും ആവാഹിച്ചു. പക്ഷേ, ആ ബന്ധങ്ങളൊന്നും ആഗ്രഹിച്ച ശാന്തി നൽകാതെ അവളെ ഒരു ഭ്രാന്തിയാക്കി മാറ്റി. കാമം, മന:ശാസ്ത്രം എന്നിവയെ മുൻനിറുത്തി എഴുതപ്പെട്ട ഹൃദയഹാരിയായ കഥ, തീർച്ചയായും കേൾക്കുക.

himalayan-spy.title: Himalayan Spy
himalayan-spy.description: Lamaon ke khazane par hai China ki nazar. Par unka hi ek agent rogue ho chuka hai aur usne do Indian ko maar giraya hai. Aise mein kya Bharat us khazane ko bacha payega? Kya Col. Jeet Maan Singh Chinese spies ki nazaron se ojhal ho payega? Janne ke liye sunein, Himlayan Spy...

mottambuli.title: മൊട്ടാമ്പുളി
mottambuli.description: അംബികാസുതന്‍ മാങ്ങാടിന്റെ ജീവിതത്തോട് ചേര്‍ന്ന് നില്‍ക്കുന്ന പത്ത് കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരമാണ് മൊട്ടാമ്പുളി. ചിന്താവിഷ്ടയായ സുമംഗല മുതല്‍ കൈക്കലത്തുണി വരെയുള്ള കഥകള്‍, പ്രകൃതിയും മനുഷ്യനും തമ്മിലുള്ള ബന്ധവും, മനുഷ്യനും മനുഷ്യനും തമ്മിലുള്ള ബന്ധവും മനോഹരമായി അനാവരണം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

the-silent-visitor.title: The Silent Visitor
the-silent-visitor.description: Ek aisi kahani  jahaan pyaar aur dar ke beech ek bhool ka inteqaam Zindgi aur maut ka khel ban jaata hai. Shubhangi aur Dr. Mahesh apne raaz aur past se bhaagna chahte hain, par koi hai jo unka peecha chhodne ko tayaar nahi hai.Kaun hai wo Jaanane ke liye suniye "The Silent Visitor".

மான்சியின்-கனவுகள்-.title: மான்சியின் கனவுகள்
மான்சியின்-கனவுகள்-.description: பூ போல மென்மையானவள் மான்சி. அறியாத புரியாத வயதில் மான்சிக்கு வரும் சோதனை. என்ன செய்ய போகிறாள் ??? கேளுங்கள் "மான்சியின் கனவுகள்".

maansiyin-kaadhalan.title: maansiyin kaadhalan
maansiyin-kaadhalan.description: Maanasi, who falls in love with her driver, is caught between her heart's desires and societal expectations. With a mix of passion, love, and lust, their relationship faces unexpected twists and turns. Will their love withstand the challenges and succeed, or will fate pull them apart?

shankh-gaatha-mahabharat-ka-aarambh.title: Shankh Gaatha : Mahabharat Ka Aarambh
shankh-gaatha-mahabharat-ka-aarambh.description: Aryan aur Kadambari ka safar aapko aur unhein le jayega samudramanthan aur shankh ke nikalne ki rahasyamayi duniya mein. Bhardwaj ji ki kahaniyon se kya Aryan ko milega uske sawalon ka jawab? Pata lagaye is kahani mein, sirf Kuku FM par.

my-billionaire-dad.title: My Billionaire Dad
my-billionaire-dad.description: Ranjith oda appa oru billionaire, avar mela oru case pathivu seiyyuraru. Sontha appa mela'ye case podura alavukku enna prcahanai irukka mudiyum ? Appa'vukkum maganukkum irukka koodiya mana porattam, athoda mattum illama... Ranjith ku kaathirukku oru miga periya task.

ellaiyil-oru-eththan.title: எல்லையில் ஒரு எத்தன்
ellaiyil-oru-eththan.description: எல்லையோர கிராமத்திற்கு பன்றி வேட்டையாட வரும் இளவரசன் ஒரு மலைவாசி பெண் மீது காதல் வயப்படுகிறான். திடீரென எதிரிகளால் கடத்தப்பட்டு சிறை வைக்கப்பட்டவனைக் காப்பாற்ற புறப்படுகிறான் ஆதித்தன். இளவரசனை ஆதித்தன் காப்பாற்றுவானா?

Delhi-Crime-ख़ूनी-मोहब्बत-का-आखिरी-सच.title: Delhi Crime: ख़ूनी मोहब्बत का आखिरी सच
Delhi-Crime-ख़ूनी-मोहब्बत-का-आखिरी-सच.description: Delhi ke Mehrauli jungle mein mili insaani haddiyon ka raaz, jo police ke hosh uda deta hai! Kya yeh sirf murder hai ya koi gehri saazish? Kya hai is murder ki parat-dar-parat sacchai? kaise pyaar aur jurm ke dhaage ulajh rahe hain is murder mystery mein, aur kaun hai asal gunahgaar. Yeh sab kuch pata lagane ke liye suniye yeh show.

spicy-love.title: Spicy Love
spicy-love.description: 🌶️💕"Spicy Love"  Idhu oru Kaara Saaramaana Kaadhal kadhai. Periya Panakkaara Kudumbatha serntha namma Heroine ku , Street food kadai vachurukura namma Hero mela Love Varudhu❤️. Avanga Love la ennenna struggles varudhu 😓, epdi avanga adha ellaam face panna poraanga 💪🤔. Therinjikka Kelunga 🎧

மான்சியுடன்-ஒரு-நாள்-.title: மான்சியுடன் ஒரு நாள்
மான்சியுடன்-ஒரு-நாள்-.description: மான்சி ஒரு அழகிய மனம் படைத்த சிறு வயது அம்மா. பிறந்த வீட்டில் அவள் தான் மஹாராணி. புகுந்த வீடும அவளை அப்படிதான் பார்க்கிறதா ?

mission-rakshak-special-forces-ke-janbaa.title: Mission Rakshak: Bharat Ke Asli Hero
mission-rakshak-special-forces-ke-janbaa.description: Yeh hain Bharat ke asli Heroes ki Kahani – woh fauji jo har mission mein maut ko muqabla dete hain! Unke courage, junoon aur tactics ke peechhe ki asli kahani janiye, aur suniye kaise ye special forces operatives desh ke liye sab kuch daav par laga dete hain. Abhi suniye, aur iss heroic journey ka hissa ban jaiye!

மான்சிக்காக-.title: மான்சிக்காக
மான்சிக்காக-.description: ஒரு பெண் குழந்தை பிறந்தா வீட்டுக்கே அழகு'னு சொல்லுவாங்க. ஒரு பெரிய அன்புள்ள கூட்டு குடும்பத்தில்  மான்சி ' யின் பிறப்புக்கு பின் நடக்கும் சில அழகிய நிகழ்வுகள் தான் இந்த கதை.

the-dragon-and-the-slave.title: The Dragon and the Slave

parallel-universe.title: Double Life
parallel-universe.description: A brilliant scientist from another universe teleports into the body of Bhavya, a naive housemaid who is secretly the abused wife of CEO Aman Sinha and a wealthy heiress. The otherworldly entity uncovers Bhavya's true identity and systematic torture by Aman and his manipulative mother, vowing revenge. Bhavya, now empowered, publicly humiliates Aman, revealing herself as the daughter of his rival, Tushar Mittal, and exposing his violent nature with video evidence, initiating a corporate and legal battle. Simultaneously, she grapples with burgeoning human emotions while desperately attempting to return to her home dimension via a banned portal, all while under her father's protective watch. Her journey is complicated by Aman's family facing ruin and his mother pressuring him to pursue Bhavya for financial salvation. A new romantic interest, Tanay, enters her life, unaware of her true nature as a displaced heiress from another universe, who needs a stolen "chip" to return home. Bhavya's past further resurfaces with her long-lost love, Amit, and her husband, Karthik, who crashes her wedding to Tanay, revealing their past marriage. As Bhavya, a magical being from a fairy world, prepares for marriage with Tanay, he reveals he knows her secret. Their wedding is dramatically interrupted when a signal demands her return home, forcing her to vanish and publicly disgrace her family. After reappearing at Tanay's new wedding, Bhavya confesses her otherworldly origins and doubts, but her overwhelming love for Tanay compels her to stay, leading to a heartfelt reconciliation. She ultimately discards a mysterious "chip," abandoning her past life of secrets to dedicate herself entirely to Tanay, choosing an earthly life over her original dimension.

romantic-reddy.title: Romantic Reddy
romantic-reddy.description: The microdrama begins with the public, forced engagement of the arrogant Arjun and the defiant heiress Indu, a union initially fueled by Arjun's resentment and a mutual desire for power and revenge. Indu's unrequited love for Sriman is sabotaged, leading to her public rejection of him and a shifting dynamic with Arjun, who, despite his initial arrogance, is disarmed by her resistance and eventually confesses his love. Their burgeoning romance is immediately complicated by Sriman's vengeful plots and the public declaration of Arjun's engagement to Bobby, a strategic move demanded by Arjun's ruthless father, the MLA. This powerful patriarch manipulates Arjun, forcing alliances and exploiting family secrets, while Arjun briefly rekindles a romance with Bhavitha. Indu embarks on a quest to find her long-lost mother, supported by Arjun, and begins a journey of self-redefinition, challenging societal labels. The narrative intensifies with the exposure of Arjun's past cruel bet and the MLA's manipulative adoption of Akhila for revenge. Indu is publicly revealed as a multi-billionaire heiress and announces her pregnancy, intertwining her fate with Arjun's political ambitions. A cunning mastermind, Siva (Arjun's father/father-in-law), orchestrates a deceptive scheme, presenting Indu as the long-lost daughter of matriarch Rama Devi using fake DNA, all to consolidate his power and seize family assets. Arjun, despite his father's abuse, defiantly enters politics, motivated by Indu, and publicly exposes Siva's deep corruption, including his exploitation of Akhila. The show explores a complex romance amidst ruthless political machinations, familial betrayal, and the search for identity and agency against a backdrop of deceit and power struggles.

surgical-broadcast.title: SURGICAL BROADCAST
surgical-broadcast.description: The series introduces Sophia, an accomplished director, desperately seeking the vanished "Miraculous Doctor" Henry during a critical medical emergency. Unbeknownst to her, Henry works as a humble nurse, secretly harboring unrequited love for Sophia. His hidden medical genius is dramatically revealed when he saves a wealthy heiress, challenging established authority and sparking intense professional battles with Sophia's father, Director Jack, and rival Dean/Vice President Charlie, who accuses Sophia of nepotism and negligence. As Henry's unconventional methods and rapid promotions lead to public acclaim and live-streamed surgeries, Sophia grows suspicious, relentlessly pursuing the truth about his hidden identity as a master surgeon. Henry is eventually forced to reveal his true medical credentials during a life-or-death emergency involving a critically injured pregnant woman, solidifying his reputation but also exposing him to a vengeful figure from his past and institutional prejudice. Amidst these professional challenges, Henry embarks on deeply personal quests: to find a cure for his blind sister and to combat his parents' advanced Alzheimer's, a disease his medical expertise couldn't prevent. He undertakes "impossible" surgeries, such as saving renowned ophthalmologist Dr. Mateo's career-ending hand injury and restoring Marcha's sight, often facing public accusations of fraud and malpractice orchestrated by his rivals. Director Sophia consistently champions Henry, defending his skills against relentless opposition from Charlie and other skeptical authorities, and their professional collaboration hints at a burgeoning personal connection. Despite Charlie's persistent attempts to frame and sabotage him, Henry, often with strategic foresight, orchestrates his rival's downfall. The show culminates with Henry's reputation as a "miracle doctor" firmly established, possessing extraordinary healing capabilities, as he continues his groundbreaking medical research, driven by both professional duty and profound personal stakes.

billion-dollar-waiter-3.title: Billion Dollar Waiter
billion-dollar-waiter-3.description: On the day of her wedding, Riya Kashyap’s world shatters when she discovers her fiancé cheating with her step-sister, who wants to steal both her love and her family empire. A year later, destiny leads Riya to Vedant Mehra — India’s richest businessman disguised as a simple waiter. What begins as a desperate lie soon turns into a high-stakes contract marriage, where love, betrayal, and hidden identities collide.

the-ultimate-boss-3.title: The Ultimate Boss
the-ultimate-boss-3.description:
A billionaire in disguise sacrifices his identity for love—only to be betrayed by the one he trusted most.
Bound by fate in a contract marriage with a powerful woman, he finds himself torn between revenge and desire.
The Ultimate Boss is a storm of secrets, ambition, and unexpected passion where power and love collide.

the-peerless-patriot.title: The Peerless Patriot
the-peerless-patriot.description: Watch this show live now on Kuku TV!

real-fighter.title: Street Fighter
real-fighter.description: అండర్‌గ్రౌండ్ ఫైటింగ్ లోకంలోకి దిగిన ‘థండర్’ దేవా, బెట్టింగ్ ముఠాలు, ఫిక్సర్లు, ‘డ్రాగన్’ సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు. మ్యాచ్ ఫిక్సింగ్, డ్రగ్స్ కుట్రలపై రింగ్‌లోనే సమాధానం చెబుతూ, చాంపియన్‌గా ఎదిగి, తర్వాతి పెద్ద పోరుకు తలుపు తెరిస్తాడు.

shatranj-ka-yodha.title: The Final Bet
shatranj-ka-yodha.description: The microdrama centers on Urvashi, a fiercely independent woman, whose life becomes inextricably linked with Puru, a reluctant sculptor. Their initial encounter involves a disputed "night of union" and a subsequent forced marriage for Urvashi to escape a powerful "Sardar." Urvashi defies an arranged marriage by undertaking a perilous "Karam Pariksha," a trial of fate, which unexpectedly forces her to rely on Puru, despite his initial refusal to help. As Urvashi navigates high-stakes competitions and tyrannical authorities, Puru, initially a shopkeeper, repeatedly intervenes to protect her, sparking a burgeoning romantic connection. Their journey uncovers a forced alliance decree orchestrated by the powerful Giripunj tribe, leading Puru to challenge tribal leaders and deliver a chilling prophecy. Puru later emerges as a mysterious healer, curing a powerful tribal chief, Sardar, in exchange for information about the manipulator behind Urvashi's forced alliance. Despite Urvashi's corrupt father, Tribal Chief Sardar, attempting to secure Puru as his son-in-law and successor, Puru surprisingly rejects the offer, leaving his motives uncertain. A profound sacrifice occurs when Urvashi saves Puru from a deadly attack, shattering his vow of peace and igniting a quest for vengeance. Traumatized, Urvashi insists on leaving Puru, believing her presence endangers him, despite his unwavering devotion and claims of their marriage. Puru, an artisan with extraordinary crafting abilities, becomes embroiled in a larger tribal conflict, facing the formidable Kaalketu, who claims to have murdered the legendary craftsman Param Shilpkar. Amidst these challenges, Princess Sundari intervenes to protect Puru, hinting at deeper entanglements. The narrative escalates with Puru's high-stakes competitions against Kaalketu, securing victories but also igniting deadly threats. Royal intrigue culminates in Kanishk betraying and killing his father, Bamni, blaming Puru and vowing revenge. Ultimately, Puru is instrumental in uniting disparate tribes after a tyrant's downfall, reluctantly nominated to lead them towards a unified future. However, his new destiny is immediately complicated by an arranged marriage to Urvashi, dramatically interrupted by Sundari, who reveals herself as his long-lost childhood betrothed, claiming her love and challenging his current engagement. With another woman also publicly claiming recent intimacy with Puru, the community becomes divided, prompting Puru to propose a dramatic, traditional trial to settle the intense dispute over his affections.

mafias-innocent-bride.title: Mafia's Innocent Bride
mafias-innocent-bride.description:
சென்னை நகரத்தின் இருளை ஆட்சி செய்யும் ஒரே மனிதன், டான் டேவிட். அவன் சொல் சட்டம், அவன் பார்வை மரணம். அதிகாரத்தின் அரியாசனத்தை தன் கைகளில் பிடிக்க, எதையும் செய்யத் தயங்காதவன்.
ஆனால் விதியின் விளையாட்டில், அவனது பாதையில் சிக்கிக் கொள்கிறாள் மீரா.
அவள் விரும்பாமல் நுழைந்த இந்த உலகம், இரத்தம், துரோகம், சூழ்ச்சி, பழிவாங்குதல் என்று பல முகங்களை அவளுக்குக் காட்டுகிறது.

இப்போது அரியாசனத்திற்கான போராட்டம் தீவிரமடைகிறது. 🔥🔥🔥

பல திருப்பங்கள் நிறைந்திருக்கும் இந்த அதிரடி MAFIA தொடரை இப்போதே பாருங்கள்!

ultimate-fighter.title: Ultimate Fighter
ultimate-fighter.description: “A fearless boy discovers he is the chosen heir of an ancient dragon bloodline, destined to fight the dark forces destroying his kingdom. As he rises from orphan to warrior, loyalty, power, and fate collide in an epic battle between light and darkness.”

vaikuntapuramlo.title: Vaikuntapuramlo
vaikuntapuramlo.description: 20 ఏళ్ల క్రితం తప్పిపోయిన తన కుమారుడిని అనేక కష్టాల తర్వాత కనుగొన్న విజయవంతమైన CEO. కానీ అప్పుడు జరిగే ట్విస్ట్‌లు అతని జీవితాన్నే తలకిందులు చేస్తాయి. ఇది ట్విస్ట్ మీద ట్విస్ట్, సస్పెన్స్‌తో నిండిన ఫ్యామిలీ డ్రామా.

e-bike-ka-shahi-safar.title: The Haunted Honeymoon
e-bike-ka-shahi-safar.description: On their honeymoon in a remote cottage, newlyweds Amey and Radhika find themselves stalked by Malti , a beautiful, bloodthirsty spirit who wants one thing: possess Amey forever. Tension, gore and dark romance collide in this gripping horror saga.

taming-mr-black.title: Love me If You Dare
taming-mr-black.description: Love me If You Dare is a powerful psychological drama that follows Navami, a young woman trapped between ambition and exploitation. Working in a resto pub, her life takes a dark turn when she encounters Abhinav, a charming yet controlling man whose obsession blurs the line between desire and dominance. As Navami faces harassment, betrayal, she struggles to reclaim her dignity and identity. Through pain and resilience, she transforms from a victim into a voice of strength.

the-final-betrayal-7.title: The Final Betrayal
the-final-betrayal-7.description: 💃💃💃 During Navratri in Ahmedabad, street vendor Sejal is betrayed by boyfriend Prateek who leaves her for cousin Nandini. Mysterious beggar Shivam proposes a fake marriage to fulfill her dying grandmother’s wish. As they grow closer, Sejal discovers Shivam is actually Shah Industries’ billionaire CEO who went undercover. Despite initial hurt over his deception, true love ultimately prevails and they marry.

mama-soltera-divorciada.title: Mamá Soltera, Divorciada
mama-soltera-divorciada.description: Una mujer dejada atrás cría a su hijo sola, bancándose cada burla y cada mirada cargada de juicio. Pero, en vez de caerse, convierte ese dolor que le quema adentro en pura fuerza. Y así, compadre, empieza a escribir un nuevo capítulo de su vida, a su manera.

la-ultima-traicion.title: La Ultima Traición
la-ultima-traicion.description: Un vendedor callejero en la ciudad, Sejal, es traicionada por su vato Prateek… porque lo cachan con la hermana de ella, Nandini. Un mendigo misterioso, Shivam, le suelta a Sejal una propuesta loca: casarse de mentiritas pa’ cumplir el deseo de su abuela enferma. Poco a poco, los dos se van enredando en el amor. ¿Tendrá huevos Shivam pa’ contarle a Sejal quién es en verdad?

billion-dollor-mess.title: Billion Dollar Mess
billion-dollor-mess.description:
An airline tycoon falls for a dazzling air hostess, believing he has found his perfect match.
But when his unsuspecting parents board a flight to meet their future daughter-in-law, a shocking web of arrogance, deceit, and humiliation unravels mid-air.
What began as love soon turns into the costliest mistake of his life.

i-became-his-beloved-after-divorce.title: I Became His Beloved After Divorce
i-became-his-beloved-after-divorce.description: A gripping romantic drama where a woman walks away from a cold, loveless marriage—only for her ex-husband to realize too late what he has lost. As she rebuilds her life with confidence and charm, he falls for her all over again, determined to win back the woman he once took for granted.

finding-us-agian-tamil.title: Finding Us Again
finding-us-agian-tamil.description: The story centers on a web of betrayal, mistaken identity, family pressure, and revenge that keeps pulling Aradhya and Ajay back together even as their lives are repeatedly threatened. It begins with a shocking romantic betrayal, when a woman discovers her boyfriend has a hidden wife and unborn child, and the confrontation turns violent. From there, the drama widens into a family mystery as Jamuna returns after Deepa’s sudden death and suspects the official explanation is false. At the same time, Aradhya’s clash with Ajay at RK Hospital leads to accusations about her motives, but the tension between them grows as hidden identities and marriage secrets come to light. Ajay is revealed as the real hospital president and later as a man trapped by family demands, while Aradhya is repeatedly forced into situations where her character and intentions are questioned. The pressure intensifies when powerful families trade money, shares, and medical care for control, and Aradhya is pushed toward a marriage she does not freely choose. Ajay is also pressured by his mother and other family interests, making the relationship feel less like a romance than a battlefield of obligations and leverage. As the story unfolds, Aradhya’s hidden past becomes central, and Ajay gradually realizes she is the long-lost Aaru he has been searching for. Their reunion briefly offers hope, and Ajay apologizes and proposes marriage, but that hope is quickly undermined by new accusations, rival interference, and old grudges. A child abduction and ransom crisis raise the stakes further, showing that the conflict has moved beyond emotional betrayal into direct danger for families and children. The mystery deepens through hidden keys, recordings, planted evidence, and suspicious hospital events, suggesting that several deaths and attacks may be tied to the same larger conspiracy. Aradhya is framed, threatened, and even poisoned or attacked through the schemes of enemies who want her removed from Ajay’s life. Priya emerges as a major force of revenge, driven by a long-buried family betrayal and determined to destroy both Ajay and Aradhya. Her vendetta escalates into assassination attempts, kidnappings, and public humiliation, turning trusted relationships into sources of danger. Meanwhile, accusations around a mother’s death and a suspicious coma keep the family locked in grief and suspicion. Aradhya’s pregnancy adds another layer of urgency, because every conflict now threatens not only her marriage but also her unborn child. By the end of the batch digests, the show has become a cycle of rescue, retaliation, and survival, with truth still buried under family power struggles and unresolved crimes.

billion-dollar-mess-2.description: Watch family entertainment micro series 'Billion Dollar Mess'. Only on KukuTV

billionaire-sangeetkar.title: Billionaire Lost Waris
billionaire-sangeetkar.description: “A poor, heartbroken girl’s life changes when a mysterious billionaire singer saves her and brings her into his world of fame, danger, and desire. As hidden enemies and dark secrets surface, their unexpected bond becomes a battle between love, power, and survival.”

a-deal-signed-in-love-3.title: A Deal Signed in Love
a-deal-signed-in-love-3.description: Diya is not an ordinary girl. But her sister, wanting to keep her normal, ruined her marriage. For the sake of property, Diya made a big decision. What was it? Find out in "A Deal Signed in Love", only on your Kuku TV.

game-over-boss.title: Game Over Boss
game-over-boss.description: A gritty transformation-and-revenge saga where gaming ignites destiny. Vicky, burdened by hardship and an ailing grandfather, finds escape in a gaming rig he builds from scraps. Online, he becomes ShadowMaster - unbeatable, untouchable. Offline, he rises from humiliation to challenge Vikram, the ruthless businessman who stole his love and became his biggest enemy. This is Vicky’s journey - from pain to power, from nobody to billionaire. Watch Now!

a-deal-signed-in-love-2.title: A Deal Signed in Love
a-deal-signed-in-love-2.description:
She isn’t ordinary, but her own sister tries to keep her that way—even if it means sabotaging her marriage.
Pushed to the edge, she makes a shocking decision in the fight for love and inheritance.
A Deal Signed in Love is a gripping tale of betrayal, courage, and destiny—only on Kuku TV.

billion-dollar-mess-1.title: Billion Dollar Mess
billion-dollar-mess-1.description:
An airline tycoon falls for a dazzling air hostess, believing he has found his perfect match.
But when his unsuspecting parents board a flight to meet their future daughter-in-law, a shocking web of arrogance, deceit, and humiliation unravels mid-air.
What began as love soon turns into the costliest mistake of his life.

heroine-not-overthink.title: HEROINE NOT OVERTHINK
heroine-not-overthink.description: Heroine Not Overthink is a lighthearted romantic drama about a spirited woman who decides to stop doubting herself and live boldly. Her carefree choices lead to unexpected love, laughter, and a journey of self-discovery.

reborn-for-revenge-2.title: Reborn for Revenge
reborn-for-revenge-2.description: Watch "Reborn for Revenge" Only on KUKU TV!

ultimate-boss.title: The Ultimate Boss
ultimate-boss.description: Vedant, a hidden billionaire, sacrifices his identity for love—only to be betrayed by the very woman he trusted most. Fate binds him to powerful businesswoman Tara in a contract marriage, where love, revenge, and secrets collide. In this storm of emotions, emerges… The Ultimate Boss.

kargil-1999.title: Kargil 1999
kargil-1999.description: The microdrama opens with a veteran Indian Air Force pilot reflecting on his "last mission" during the Kargil War, where he "got airborne, but did not land back," setting a somber tone for the conflict. In 1999 Kashmir, AOC Air Commodore M D Khanna issues an urgent recall of all aircraft as Pakistan's Army Chief orchestrates a clandestine invasion in Kargil, catching India by surprise and threatening vital supply lines. India launches "Operation Safed Sagar," an unprecedented high-altitude aerial battle under strict strategic constraints, with elite IAF pilots facing extreme technical challenges and unforgiving environmental dangers. Early operations prove costly, as Flight Lieutenant Nachiketa's aircraft suffers catastrophic engine failure, forcing him to eject into hostile territory, and Squadron Leader Ajay Ahuja sacrifices his life during a perilous rescue mission. The war intensifies with Indian forces facing brutal combat and devastating losses on treacherous peaks, and initial helicopter air support proves vulnerable to missile barrages, leading to further casualties and a pause in operations. Amidst inter-service tension, IAF Chief Anil Tipnis reluctantly authorizes 'suicidal' helicopter deployments, prompting ingenious modifications to aircraft for survival. Recognizing the need for a decisive shift, Air Marshal Ahluwalia initiates a covert mission to find an alternative weapon system when standard bombs prove unsuitable for high-altitude targets. A seasoned test pilot and technical teams race against time to integrate an experimental laser-guided bombing system, successfully developing precision munitions and uncovering the crucial enemy logistics base, Muntho Dhalo. Elite Mirage squadrons are tasked with its annihilation, culminating in a devastating precision strike that alters the conflict's trajectory. The Indian Air Force then focuses on the strategically vital Tiger Hill, with Chief of Air Staff A.Y. Tipnis insisting on personally flying a perilous sortie involving the new laser-guided bombs. An elite squadron meticulously plans and executes a precision air strike, deploying advanced laser-guided bombs from unprecedented altitudes to obliterate enemy defenses. This groundbreaking use of smart weapons revolutionizes modern warfare, clearing strategic routes and minimizing casualties, while relentless night strikes shatter the Pakistan Army's will to fight. The 47-day high-altitude conflict sees the IAF developing groundbreaking tactics and achieving an unprecedented strategic victory, though not without significant sacrifices.

a-deal-signed-in-love-1.title: A Deal Signed in Love
a-deal-signed-in-love-1.description: Diya's joyous engagement is brutally shattered by her fiancé's betrayal with her stepsister, leading to a near-fatal drowning and the discovery of a corporate clause requiring marriage to inherit her mother's company. A mysterious rescuer, Abhi/Siddu, repeatedly protects her, and their rekindled childhood friendship deepens as they discover a shared past, hinting at a destined reunion. To secure her legacy and escape relentless family pressure, Diya proposes a contract marriage to Siddu, which he reluctantly accepts, igniting a fierce battle for corporate control against her manipulative father and stepsister, Shamika. Diya, initially an underestimated employee, defiantly fights for her independence, revealing a significant 40% company stake and orchestrating devastating corporate sabotage against CEO Dev Varma. Siddu, later revealed as Siddharth Deva Varma and the powerful "Junior Varma," is the grandson of the Varma Corporation founder. He shows unexpected affection and fiercely defends Diya from rivals and family betrayal, though his enigmatic nature and hints of prior acquisition regarding her inherited property initially raise Diya's suspicions. Their contractual union evolves into a genuine bond, with Siddharth confessing his love and proposing a real marriage, strengthening their trust and commitment. However, their happiness is immediately challenged as Siddharth is drawn into a dark family mystery surrounding his mother's death. Simultaneously, Diya faces her obsessive past love, Amit, who is revealed to be a pawn in Shamika's manipulative plot for a forced marriage and financial gain. Diya confronts accusations of plagiarism from Shamika, legal battles over stolen award-winning designs crucial to resolving Siddu's company crisis, and public shaming, but Siddu intervenes, humiliating Shamika and her aggressive husband and sparking their vow of retaliation. The narrative escalates into a deadly family power struggle over inheritance, with Diya's controlling adoptive mother, Kanchana, revealed as the murderer of Diya's biological mother fifteen years ago and an attempted poisoner of Diya and Siddharth. Diya is violently kidnapped, forcing Siddharth into a frantic search and an uneasy alliance, and he is gravely injured while heroically saving her from Kanchana. Amidst this chaos, Siddu, revealed as a true killer who frames Shamika for murder while orchestrating a chilling corporate takeover with Diya as his accomplice, miraculously awakens from a coma. Diya, now CEO, fueled by her profound love and a quest for justice, financially ruins Shamika as retribution for past suffering. The show culminates with Diya and Siddu embarking on a joyful new chapter, celebrating their enduring love and family aspirations with their baby, Mira, in a beautifully renovated farmhouse, having overcome profound betrayals and dark family secrets.

billion-dollar-waiter-2.title: Billion Dollar Waiter
billion-dollar-waiter-2.description: Watch Family Entertainment Show 'Billion Dollar Waiter' Show. Only on KukuTV

homeless-husband.title: Homeless Husband
homeless-husband.description: A defiant heiress and runaway bride, Nisha, finds herself entangled with the confident businessman Kunal after a real estate mix-up forces them into cohabitation over a disputed apartment. Financially cut off by her powerful father, Nisha's initial animosity with Kunal evolves into a complex dynamic, marked by a fiery battle of wills and simmering romantic tension, despite Kunal's initial denial of their shared romantic past. Their relationship deepens when Kunal heroically rescues a trapped Nisha, solidifying a protective bond. Professionally, their paths intertwine as Kunal, a powerful CEO, initially denies Nisha a job due to their unresolved history but later re-hires her after she impresses a client. The narrative escalates into corporate power struggles and personal battles for autonomy, as Nisha defiantly rejects her father, Mr. Singhania, and his corporate demands, asserting her independence. Simultaneously, Kunal, revealed to be the heir to the powerful Mittal hotel empire, navigates his own family pressures and operates under a false identity. Their burgeoning romance becomes fraught with corporate rivalry and personal betrayal when their hidden identities as heirs of rival dynasties are disclosed, especially after Nisha's family is implicated in ruining Kunal's company. Kunal declares war on a traitor within his company after a lucrative deal is sabotaged, and Nisha is accused of corporate espionage, vowing to prove her innocence. Amidst this corporate turmoil, Kunal's complex romantic life unfolds, involving a love triangle with Sanjana and a past 'arranged setup' with Neha, leading him to orchestrate a fake relationship with Nisha to deter Neha. Nisha discovers Kunal's multiple engagements and feels manipulated, confronting him about his deceptions. In a strategic move, Kunal exposes Nisha's betrayal of her own powerful CEO father to gain leverage, offering her father a conditional alliance that demands relinquishing control over Nisha's life. As Kunal prepares to marry Neha, Nisha, harboring deep feelings, confronts him, urging him to abandon his 'compromise marriage.' Kunal reveals he has already called off his wedding, and subsequently stages a fake wedding to test Nisha's true affections, ultimately revealing their undeniable chemistry and an uncertain future for their intertwined lives.

a-blockbuster.title: Blockbuster
a-blockbuster.description: After betrayal and heartbreak, Mayank Gupta rises from ruin with divine powers to seek justice and bring down those who destroyed his family.

when-silence-breaks-3.title: Secretary Rosie
when-silence-breaks-3.description: ఆమె ఒక సెక్రటరీ మాత్రమే కాదు… ఆకర్షణతో ముడిపడిన మాయగుర్తి. ప్రతి చిరునవ్వులో ప్రలోభం, ప్రతి స్పర్శలో కుతంత్రం. భర్త–భార్యల మధ్య నమ్మకాన్ని నెమ్మదిగా చెరిపేస్తూ, ఇంటిని యుద్ధభూమిగా మార్చింది. ఆమె ఎంత దూరం వెళ్తుంది? అతని ఆస్తి మీద హక్కు సాధించడానికి? భార్య స్థానాన్ని దక్కించుకోవడానికి? లేక అతని సామ్రాజ్యాన్ని తన పేరుతో ముద్ర వేసుకోవడానికి?

chinna-raju-vachinadu.title: Chinna Raju Vachinadu
chinna-raju-vachinadu.description: ఒక బిలియనీర్ తన అసలు గుర్తింపును దాచిపెట్టి సాధారణ యువతిని పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటాడు. నిజమైన ప్రేమ అర్థం తెలుసుకోవడానికే ఈ అడుగు. కానీ ఆమె కుటుంబ అనుమానాలు, ఓ క్రూరమైన ప్రత్యర్థి పిచ్చి వీరిద్దరినీ దూరం చేయాలని బెదిరించినప్పుడు, అతను ఇంతకుముందెన్నడూ లేని విధంగా పోరాడాల్సి వస్తుంది. మోసం, నిబద్ధత, లోభంపై విజయం సాధించిన ప్రేమ గాథ ఇది.

miracle-ya-murder.title: Miracle Ya Murder
miracle-ya-murder.description: A brilliant but arrogant doctor falls from grace after a scandal ruins his career, forcing him to work in a small village clinic. There, amid love, rivalry, and redemption, he discovers the true meaning of healing—of both body and soul.

secret-life-of-a-mafia-sweetheart.title: Secret Life Of A Mafia Sweetheart
secret-life-of-a-mafia-sweetheart.description: A deadly mafia assassin living a double life as a flower shop owner falls in love with a man who hides an even darker secret — he’s the heir to her family’s greatest enemy.

vilayati-babu.title: Vilayati Babu
vilayati-babu.description:
Arjun, a wealthy businessman in disguise, returns to his village to uncover his father’s murderer and reunite with his estranged family.
Through dangerous encounters, corruption, and betrayal, he protects the villagers, exposes the culprits, and wins back his family’s trust, and finds love. Watch now.

billion-dollar-waiter-1.title: Billion Dollar Waiter
billion-dollar-waiter-1.description: ஒருவரை உண்மையிலேயே காதலிக்க வைப்பது எது? பணமா, அழகா, இல்லையென்றால் நல்ல மனசா? இதைத்தான் தீபக் யோசிக்க ஆரம்பிக்கிறான். அந்த யோசனைக்குப் பிறகு அவன் ஒரு பிளான் போடுகிறான். ஆனால் அந்த பிளான் என்ன? அதனால் என்ன நடக்கிறது? தெரிஞ்சுக்கொள்ளுங்கள் “Billion Dollar Waiter”-இல், Kuku TV-யில்.

papas-perfect-match-2.title: Papa's Perfect Match
papas-perfect-match-2.description:
A billionaire hiding behind a false identity and a strong single mother fighting for survival are brought together by the innocent wish of a child.
As love blossoms amidst lies, broken dreams find hope again—but the truth about who “Mr. Oberoi” really is could shatter it all.
This is a heartwarming tale of family, deception, and the courage to begin again.

fukra-billionaire.title: Fukra Billionaire
fukra-billionaire.description: A florist, Radhika, falls for single father Vedant, unaware of his hidden wealth and past. Their love faces betrayal, class divides, and manipulation from his ex-wife Neha. A tale of deceit, redemption, and enduring love. Watch now.

obssesed-with-his-silent-bride.title: Mounaragam
obssesed-with-his-silent-bride.description: మౌనం చాలా భావాలను మోస్తుంది. మౌనాన్నే ఆభరణంగా చేసుకున్న నిత్య జీవితం కూడా అంతే. ఎప్పుడు ఎలా మారతాడో తెలియని భర్త చరణ్ నుండి విడిపోవాలని ఆమె అనుకుంది. చిన్నప్పటి నుండి నిత్యని ప్రేమించిన చరణ్.. ఎందుకు మారాడు. ప్రేమ గొప్పదైనపుడు, అర్థం చేసుకునే మనిషి ఎదురుగా ఉన్నప్పుడు మౌనంలోనే కోట్ల మాటలు వినిపిస్తాయి. "మౌనరాగం" అలాంటి కథే. ప్రేమలో తడిసిపోవడానికి "మౌనరాగం" చూడండి మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

fake-shaadi.title: Fake Shaadi
fake-shaadi.description: Kyra's tumultuous life begins with a public feud with her ex-partner's new girlfriend, Richa, and a career-threatening ultimatum orchestrated by a vengeful superior connected to Richa. She enters a fake contract marriage with Vansh to appease his grandmother, Dadi, unaware of his true identity as a powerful CEO. As their undeniable attraction grows amidst corporate intrigue, Kyra discovers Vansh is her elusive interviewee, leading to career advancement but also the jealousy of a rival, Ankita. Her personal life further collapses when her father sells her to an underworld figure, from which she is violently rescued by Samrat, who claims her as his wife, while Abhimanyu makes a counter-claim. Kyra's journey intensifies as she is unjustly fired by Vansh due to Ankita's manipulation, yet a passionate romance blossoms between them. Their relationship faces severe challenges from Vansh's formidable mother, revealed to be Kyra's past tormentor, and external threats from an A-list actress and family demands for an heir. Simultaneously, Kyra's true origins are exposed, revealing her adoptive parents exploited her and are not her biological kin. This leads to the dramatic discovery that she is Dadu's long-lost granddaughter, exchanged at birth, a revelation that ignites fierce jealousy in the current heiress, Richa. Richa attempts to tamper with DNA results and plots against Kyra, who uncovers a scheme by Rishabh and Vansh to drug Dadi for inheritance. Despite Dadi's sudden death complicating matters, Dadu disinherits Rishabh and names Kyra as his rightful heir, publicly disowning Richa after Kyra exposes her mother's hidden "real daughter." Disinherited and betrayed by her manipulative ex-boyfriend Sanket, Kyra becomes the target of Richa, now an unhinged killer, who kidnaps Dadu and attempts to poison Kyra. Vansh Oberoi, her husband, fiercely protects her, rescuing Dadu and vowing retribution against Richa, who escalates her violence. Amidst these escalating threats, Sanjna orchestrates schemes to separate Kyra and Vansh, leaking scandalous photos and creating public scandals, but Kyra's unwavering trust thwarts her initial attempts. Vansh Oberoi initiates legal battles to clear his name and protects Kyra from her extorting parents and a defamation lawsuit, emerging as her decisive protector amidst family conflict and violence. The couple's joy over Kyra's pregnancy is threatened by her "fake father," prompting Vansh to plan revenge while Kyra is bound by a promise not to involve the police. Ultimately, Kyra is named the sole successor to a vast business empire and accepts Vansh Oberoi's marriage proposal, setting the stage for their future.

code-war.title: Code War
code-war.description: A catastrophic cyberattack initially cripples a nation's air defense, where an underestimated maintenance worker, Sumanth, emerges as the sole genius capable of averting the crisis, earning national acclaim. However, his professional triumph is swiftly overshadowed by the arrival of a ruthless new CEO, Arvind, who dismisses Sumanth's vital achievements and fosters a cutthroat corporate environment. Concurrently, Sumanth faces profound personal betrayal as his girlfriend, Nayana, rejects his marriage proposal, prioritizing her career and ambition, and later enters a consensual relationship with Arvind. Unjustly fired by Arvind, Sumanth is further isolated and framed for server sabotage, leading to his professional downfall and a burning desire for revenge. Amidst this, a powerful and enigmatic CEO, Savita Kumar, intervenes, recognizing Sumanth's genius and offering him a senior strategic role and significant stake in her rival company, Technics Solutions. This alliance sets the stage for a high-stakes corporate war against Arvind's dominant Infonova Tech, driven by Savita's ambition and Sumanth's quest to clear his name and reclaim his father's legacy. The conflict intensifies as Savita's team discovers Infonova Tech's leading AI is an incomplete version of their Sumanth's design, fueling a fierce race for market dominance. A complex web of deception involving multiple individuals named Sumanth, and a flawed algorithm at Infonova Tech, further complicates the corporate landscape. As the corporate battle culminates, Infonova Tech suffers a catastrophic system failure due to its unoptimized prototype and an imposter expert, while Sumanth's Tech Ethics Solutions achieves market dominance with its stable platform. The desperate patriarch of the collapsing corporate empire seeks Sumanth's help, but Sumanth, supported by Savita, rejects their pleas for reconciliation. Fueled by past injustices, Sumanth embarks on a path of corporate revenge, ultimately rising to become the new CEO of the very company that once terminated and discredited him. His success is attributed to his powerful partnership with Savitha, who later proposes marriage, solidifying their personal and professional bond.

billion-dollar-waiter.title: Billion Dollar Waiter
billion-dollar-waiter.description: ఒక మనిషిని ప్రేమించడానికి ఏం కావాలి? డబ్బా, అందమా, మనసా.. ప్రేమ పుట్టాలంటే మనిషిలో ఉండాల్సింది ఏంటి? అది తెలుసుకోవాలన్న ఆలోచనతో దీపక్ ఒక ప్లాన్ వేసాడు. ఆ ప్లాన్ ఏంటి? ఆ ప్లాన్ వల్ల జరిగిన కథ ఏంటి? తెలియాలంటే చూడండి.. "Billion Dollar Waiter" మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

sold-to-the-crime-lord.title: Married to my Kidnapper
sold-to-the-crime-lord.description: Kiara is initially forced into a contract marriage with the powerful Aditya to save her ailing father from a massive debt. Trapped and defiant, she struggles for freedom against Aditya's initial ruthless control. Her situation is complicated by Meera, a manipulative rival who claims to be Aditya's true wife, actively scheming against Kiara, even causing her physical harm. Despite Kiara's attempts to escape, Aditya eventually reveals a protective side, especially as Meera's treachery escalates. However, a sinister plot unfolds as Aditya's manipulative brother, Vikram, emerges as the mastermind, framing Kiara for various deceptions and attempting to steal Aditya's life and wife. Kiara relentlessly fights to expose Vikram's betrayal, eventually shattering Aditya's initial familial loyalty. Amidst this, Meera escalates her manipulation with false pregnancy claims, crashing Aditya and Kiara's wedding with accusations of betrayal. A devastating car crash leaves Kiara with amnesia, allowing Meera to further manipulate her by falsely portraying Aditya as an enemy. Aditya desperately tries to reconnect and reveal the truth, while Kiara, after regaining her memories, exposes Meera's deceptions and reaffirms her deep love for Aditya. Violent confrontations ensue between Aditya and Vikram, and Meera, driven by obsession, stabs Aditya, leading to his critical injury. Meera's obsession escalates to a final confrontation where she is apprehended but vows chilling revenge against Kiara. Despite overcoming these external threats, Aditya confesses a profound betrayal: he deliberately lied about Kiara's father's debt, which he had secretly forgiven months prior to keep her close. Devastated, Kiara separates from him, but their deep connection persists. Aditya, filled with remorse, dramatically confesses his unwavering love and seeks forgiveness. Kiara, whose feelings never truly faded, accepts his heartfelt proposal. The show culminates in Aditya and Kiara's traditional Indian wedding ceremony, where they exchange vows, committing to a future built on honesty, redemption, and unwavering love, determined to heal past wounds.

billion-dollar-mess.title: Billion Dollar Mess
billion-dollar-mess.description: ఎయిర్‌లైన్ వ్యాపార మేధావి వీర్ చోప్రా ఆకర్షణీయమైన ఎయిర్ హోస్టెస్ లారా స్మిత్‌పై ప్రేమలో పడతాడు. తాను తనకు సరైన జోడీని కనుగొన్నానని భావిస్తాడు. కానీ, తన అమాయక తల్లిదండ్రులు రాజేశ్ మరియు వినీతా చోప్రా, భవిష్యత్తు కోడలిని కలిసేందుకు విమానంలోకి ఎక్కినప్పుడు, అహంకారం, మోసం, అవమానం అనే షాకింగ్ జాలం మధ్యలోనే బయటపడుతుంది. ఆ క్షణంలోనే ప్రేమ వీర్ జీవితంలో అత్యంత ఖరీదైన తప్పిదంగా మారిపోతుంది.

53b67f99-4ac9-4c41-941f-ed1607c7939d.title: Aa Nimisham
53b67f99-4ac9-4c41-941f-ed1607c7939d.description:
A young man’s life changes forever after a tragic accident draws him into a mysterious household. As secrets, lies, and hidden motives unfold, he must confront love, betrayal, and his own haunted past.
Aa Nimisham is an emotional thriller where every moment holds a revelation — and nothing is as it seems.

the-prince-3.title: The Prince
the-prince-3.description: A billionaire in disguise marries a simple woman to discover the true meaning of love. But when her family’s doubts and a ruthless rival’s obsession threaten to tear them apart, he must fight harder than ever. A heartfelt saga of deception, loyalty, and the triumph of love over greed.

dhokha-shaadi-aur-hungama.title: Dhokha, Shaadi aur Hungama
dhokha-shaadi-aur-hungama.description: “A kind-hearted girl on her way to her brother’s wedding gets trapped in a nightmarish flight with a cruel woman and her spoiled son, leading to chaos that unravels shocking secrets of power, betrayal, and mistaken identity. When love, lies, and family honor collide, a storm of revenge and revelation erupts midair and beyond.”

the-ultimate-boss-1.title: The Ultimate Boss
the-ultimate-boss-1.description: వేదాంత్ – తన ప్రేమ కోసం తన అసలైన గుర్తింపుని త్యాగం చేసిన ఒక రహస్య బిలియనీర్. కానీ అతను నమ్మిన అమ్మాయే ద్రోహం చేస్తుంది. అలాంటి సమయంలో అతని జీవితంలోకి వస్తుంది శక్తివంతమైన బిజినెస్‌వుమన్ తారా — ఒక కాంట్రాక్ట్ మ్యారేజ్‌తో. ప్రేమ, ప్రతీకారం, రహస్యాలు కలిసిన ఈ తుఫానులో ఆవిష్కృతమవుతుంది… ది అల్టిమేట్ బాస్.

waiting-for-love-5.title: Love Reloaded
waiting-for-love-5.description: Raman Mahadeva, a wealthy but lonely businessman, hides his true identity in search of genuine love. Radha, a resilient food stall owner scarred by betrayal and loss, crosses his path with her strength and determination. Their bond deepens into something when Radha’s search for her daughter—lost years ago—intertwines with Raman’s world. As destiny brings them closer through Jaanu, secrets unfold, love is tested, and broken relationships find new meaning. Watch "Love Reloaded" only on KUKU TV!

vipreet-peedhi.title: The Crypto King
vipreet-peedhi.description:
Vikram Mehra, a guilt-ridden businessman, dies after losing everything to his ruthless rival Raghav Malhotra and Rhea Kapoor. Granted a mystical chance to relive his past, Vikram awakens 6 years earlier, in 2019, determined to rewrite his fate and save his love, Ananya, from tragedy. 

Blending revenge, romance, and destiny, Vipreet Peedhi explores how one man’s repentance can alter not just his life, but time itself.

secret-empire-3.title: Telusa Manasa
secret-empire-3.description: The microdrama begins with Kavya, a humble cleaning lady, facing abuse and termination by the ruthless producer Yamini. Her life dramatically shifts with the sudden appearance of superstar Arjun, who unexpectedly hires her as his personal manager. It is soon revealed that Arjun is the secret father of Kavya's daughter, Aadhya, a truth complicated by a past where Arjun's powerful mother, Gayathri Devi, forced Kavya to abort their first child. Further complicating matters, Arjun's lover, Aparna, sacrifices her relationship with him for Rishabh, claiming it's to protect her unborn child and Arjun's future. Kavya becomes pregnant with Arjun's child again, but he vanishes, leaving her disowned and facing eviction. Arjun eventually returns, relentlessly pursuing the truth about Kavya's secretive past and Aadhya's paternity, while Kavya fiercely guards her secrets. Obsessive rival Yamini orchestrates various schemes, from public humiliation to kidnapping, to separate Kavya from Arjun, but these often backfire, strengthening Arjun's protective resolve. A shared physical mark leads Arjun to suspect Aadhya is his daughter, prompting Kavya's confession and Arjun's furious heartbreak over six years of stolen fatherhood. The truth emerges about Arjun's manipulative mother, Amma, who orchestrated their separation and pressured Kavya to abort. Kavya faces public shaming through viral videos, and Yamini's unrequited love for Arjun escalates into murderous rage. Despite these challenges, Arjun commits to Kavya and Aadhya, embracing his role as a father. Kavya confronts Arjun's mother, now Nannamma, over past interference, eventually facilitating a heartwarming reunion between Nannamma and Aadhya. Kavya also rejects her own estranged mother's plea for forgiveness for past abandonment. The show culminates with Arjun publicly declaring Aadhya as his daughter, resolving societal judgment, and the family preparing for a formal wedding, solidifying their unconventional yet loving unit amidst the fallout of past deceptions and ongoing rivalries.

ceos-personal-boss.title: CEO's Personal Boss
ceos-personal-boss.description: CEO’s Personal Boss is a high-voltage romantic thriller filled with secrets, conspiracies, and emotional depth. It follows Rishabh, an ordinary delivery boy hiding a past powerful enough to shatter empires, whose life collides with Avantika Malhotra, the fierce and razor-sharp CEO of Malhotra Builders. Their clash sparks a journey of danger, truth, and unexpected love. Watch now.

venganza-y-luego-amor.title: Venganza y Luego Amor
venganza-y-luego-amor.description: En su tercer aniversario, Ananya descubre que su esposo Arpit la engaña y quiere divorciarse porque ella es solo cocinera. Ella revela ser la única heredera del magnate Mehra, pero nadie la cree. Entonces aparece Ved Singhania, un joven millonario que le propone un matrimonio por contrato. ¿Será Ananya realmente la señorita Mehra? ¿Descubrirá Ved la verdad? ¿Y podrá Ananya vengarse de Arpit?

el-gran-jefe.title: El Gran Jefe
el-gran-jefe.description: Abhiraj Singh Rathore es el rey secreto de la Corporación Rajputana y también el hombre más rico del mundo. Pero cuando regresa del campo de batalla, su amor de la infancia lo confunde con un bufón y lo abandona cruelmente. ¿Cómo hará el rey de todo el pueblo para que su amada se arrepienta?

bye-bye-pati.title: Bye Bye Husband
bye-bye-pati.description: Preeti, an heiress, initially struggles between her love for Veer and her family's business, harboring a secret that could jeopardize everything. Her life dramatically shifts when she marries Mihir, only to discover their union is a revenge plot orchestrated by him to make his ex-lover, Anushka, jealous. Mihir, entangled with Anushka, falsely accuses Preeti of infidelity, leading to her unjust expulsion from his home, further complicated by his manipulative mother's accusations of harming Anushka's unborn child. Stripped of her marriage and reputation, Preeti defiantly reclaims her hidden identity and legacy, vowing vindication while an observer, Rohit, seeks to uncover the truth behind her separation. Returning as a brilliant designer with a hidden identity, Preeti plots corporate revenge against CEO Mihir, aiming to dismantle his empire with the help of his estranged nephew, Kabir. Her sabotage unfolds amidst public scandals involving a pregnant Anushka, who continues to ensnare Mihir with false claims. Preeti dramatically reveals her true identity, confronting Mihir and demanding a public apology to save crucial contracts, even as Mihir stubbornly refuses to grant her a divorce. The conflict intensifies with Anushka's feigned miscarriage and a conspiracy with Mihir's manipulative mother to accuse Preeti of causing harm, ultimately forcing Mihir to divorce her. Despite Mihir's attempts to win her back, he is blackmailed into an unwanted marriage with Anushka, who is later exposed for deceit regarding paternity. Preeti faces corporate espionage and false plagiarism accusations, with Mihir shockingly siding against her, forcing her to fight for her professional integrity and clear her name. As Mihir publicly banishes Anushka and relentlessly seeks Preeti's forgiveness, Anushka resurfaces with a chilling promise of "Preeti's punishment," holding Preeti captive and setting a sinister trap for her husband, Amey, who confesses past betrayals and proposes a new marriage. In a climactic confrontation, Anushka's manipulative fake pregnancy scheme is exposed, revealing her true motive of absolute revenge. Mihir, critically injured and in a coma, miraculously awakens and proposes marriage to Preeti, referencing a previous union, as Preeti navigates a heart-wrenching choice between her family's business and the man who now seeks to atone. The series culminates with Preeti accepting Mihir's proposal, hinting at a shared past and a future built on truth and redemption, with her personal and professional stakes finally resolved. This intricate web of betrayal and ambition ultimately explores the enduring power of truth and forgiveness.

el-jugador-supremo.title: El Jugador Supremo
el-jugador-supremo.description: A nation faces a catastrophic cyberattack, leading to the emergence of Samir Dixit, an underestimated maintenance guy with extraordinary computer science skills, who neutralizes a sophisticated AI threat and secures the system. His triumph is short-lived as a ruthless new CEO takes over Cal-Tech, initiating mass firings despite national security successes. Amidst this corporate upheaval, Samir is betrayed by junior HR employee Tanisha, who cruelly rejects his marriage proposal and reveals her instrumental, transactional role in his job security. He is unjustly terminated after false accusations, further complicated by a case of mistaken identity involving another Samir. A catastrophic server crash forces his former company to seek his expertise again, only for Samir to discover Tanisha's romantic betrayal with CEO Arnab, who she publicly chooses for his wealth and status. Heartbroken and humiliated, Samir vows retribution against the couple. He is then recruited by Sajada Khan, CEO of a rival startup, after being framed for the very system failure he fixed. Sajada fiercely defends Samir, revealing a personal connection and positioning him as her "technical genius" in an escalating corporate war against her powerful business magnate uncle. Samir discovers that InfoNova's market-leading AI is a stolen prototype of his own, fueling his drive for professional resurgence. He races against an impossible deadline for a groundbreaking AI project, navigating a complex personal crisis and an unexpected declaration of love from Sayyada, who offers him refuge and strategic cohabitation. Despite launching a revolutionary AI platform with Arnab, it suffers a catastrophic system failure, revealing that Samir was mistakenly fired by the incompetent CEO's Son. The furious CEO's Father desperately seeks Samir's return to save the family legacy. However, Samir, haunted by past betrayals, adamantly refuses forgiveness, even as the CEO's Father pleads for reconciliation, intertwining themes of revenge, redemption, and unresolved personal conflicts.

back-to-us.title: Final Faisla
back-to-us.description: Raj Mehra had it all — power, money, pride — until his ego destroyed everything. Nine years ago, he drove away his wife, Shanaya, with a divorce she never wanted. Now she’s back as the fierce CEO of Sitara, the rival empire threatening his family’s legacy. But Shanaya holds a deeper secret — a daughter he never knew existed. As love, guilt, and revenge collide, old wounds ignite into a war where hearts and empires will burn.

forced-to-love-the-ruthless-ceo.title: CEO in Love
forced-to-love-the-ruthless-ceo.description: A daughter, Sayo, faces an insurmountable challenge: her critically ill mother requires expensive medical treatment, and all personal savings are depleted. Driven by profound regret and filial duty, Sayo confesses to past desperate acts made to support her mother. Her last hope rests on securing help from Arjun Bro, an influential CEO and doctor, despite his notorious reputation. Arjun offers to cover the exorbitant medical costs, but the offer comes with a chilling, unspoken demand, forcing Sayo into a difficult bargain or agonizing personal sacrifice. Her loyal companion, Pranav, initially supports her, but is later exposed as a manipulative fraud who prioritizes appearances over Sayo's mother's life, intending to exploit and sell Sayo. Arjun funds the mother's critical surgery, but his generosity is transactional, and he declares a possessive desire for Sayo. Meanwhile, Arjun is revealed to be engaged to Vinny Jacob, a woman who saved his life and is now recovering from a coma. Vinny, possessive and manipulative, sabotages Arjun and Sayo's developing affection, even orchestrating Sayo's mother's transfer from the hospital. Arjun struggles with his past trauma and a life-saving debt to Vinny, but confesses genuine love to Sayo. However, Sayo, scarred by perceived exploitation and believing their past relationship was transactional, rejects him, vowing to repay him and assert her independence. Vinny's obsessive schemes against Sayo escalate, including framing her and threatening her life. Arjun confronts Vinny, publicly declares his unwavering love for Sayo, and severs ties with Vinny. The show culminates with Vinny's sudden disappearance, placing her in grave and unknown peril, and Arjun embarking on a relentless, high-stakes search for her, which concludes without resolution, leaving her status unknown.

couple-friendly.title: Couple Friendly
couple-friendly.description:
అనిష్‌ – కృతిల మధ్య అపార్ట్‌మెంట్‌ సమస్యతో మొదలైన పరిచయం క్రమంగా అనుకోని బంధంగా మారుతుంది. తప్పుబాట్లు, అబద్ధాలు, ఆర్థిక ఒత్తిడులు వీరిద్దరినీ మరింత చిక్కుల్లో పడేస్తాయి.
వ్యక్తిగత రహస్యాలు బయటపడటంతో నమ్మకం దెబ్బతింటుంది, వారి సంబంధం సంక్లిష్టమవుతుంది
చివరికి, ఈ కలయిక వారిని విడదీయగలదా లేక కొత్త దారిని చూపుతుందా అన్నదే కథ ప్రధానాంశం.

love-me-if-you-dare-2.title: Love Me if You Dare
love-me-if-you-dare-2.description: Navami, a girl working at a bar, faces the risk of losing her job because of Abhinav. Struggling without money, her life takes unexpected turns. What is the connection between Navami and Abhinav? Find out in "Love Me if You Dare", only on your Kuku TV.

her-beauty-his-love.title: Her Beauty, His Love
her-beauty-his-love.description:
Riya joins her dream college but faces humiliation from Aksha and Krish.
From clashes in a project, love slowly blossoms, though Aksha’s jealousy creates hurdles.
Riya transforms and gains confidence, while Krish realizes his true feelings.
In the end, the two unite in love.

peony-blossoms.title: Peony blossoms
peony-blossoms.description: A graceful period romance set against the backdrop of an ancient empire, where love blooms like peonies amid power, betrayal, and destiny. When a noblewoman’s heart defies royal duty, she must choose between true love and the fate written for her by the throne.

papas-perfect-match-1.title: Papa’s Perfect Match
papas-perfect-match-1.description: Watch family entertainment show 'Papa’s Perfect Match'. Only on KukuTV

billionaire-ki-waapsi-1.title: Billionaire Ki Waapsi
billionaire-ki-waapsi-1.description: A self-made billionaire CEO, Balaram, returns to India after 25 years, having been believed dead, to reconcile with his estranged family. He initially discovers his wife and younger son, Rohit, are supposedly destitute and his wife gravely ill, needing surgery. However, a deeper conspiracy unfolds as Balaram learns his wife, Kamini, and younger son, Rohit, were reported to have tragically died five years ago, a secret kept by his elder son, Rahul, and Rahul's Partner. Rahul and his partner have ruthlessly exploited Balaram's presumed death, secretly receiving a substantial allowance while convincing others Balaram died penniless, and now plot to seize his remaining fortune for their tech venture, Royal Imperial Tech. Balaram, now undercover, witnesses Rahul's cruel indifference towards his family and his attempts to seize all ancestral assets. He also encounters Rohit, who is struggling in poverty with his ailing mother, and begins to suspect a paternal connection. Balaram, impressed by Rohit's character, takes him under his wing, offering him a coveted position at Royal Imperial Tech and covering his mother's medical bills.
