The patriarch then learns the shocking truth that Kamini and his son are, in fact, alive after 15 years, having been hidden by Rahul, with Kamini accusing Rahul of severe abuse and abandonment. Armed with this knowledge, Balaram orchestrates Rahul's downfall, exposing his greed and manipulative schemes. He reclaims his stolen identity and seeks justice for his long-suffering wife and loyal younger son. The family ultimately achieves their dream of homeownership, reuniting around Kamini's cherished cooking, symbolizing enduring love and reconciliation after decades of deceit and betrayal.

the-drifting-king.title: Raftaar King
the-drifting-king.description: Former racing legend Vikram Kapoor returns from obscurity to train young racers, facing fierce rivals and his haunted past. Their journey leads to a high-stakes championship where skill, courage, and redemption define the true drift legend. Watch now.

mom-of-3-billionaires-2.title: Mom Of 3 Billionaires
mom-of-3-billionaires-2.description:
A single mother returns to her family home, only to face old wounds and relentless criticism for her life choices.
But with the strength of raising three successful sons on her own, she refuses to bend under judgment.
This is a moving tale of resilience, love, and reclaiming joy in the face of toxic family dynamics.

adhuri-aashiqui.title: Adhuri Aashiqui
adhuri-aashiqui.description: The microdrama centers on Rajveer, an enigmatic heir burdened by a deadly, generations-old curse requiring him to marry a woman from the Rooh tribe before his 25th birthday to transfer it. His powerful grandmother, Dadi, orchestrates an arranged marriage with Avantika, decreeing the bride will inherit Marwa Industries, initially as a desperate measure to save Rajveer. Avantika's manipulative stepfamily, driven by greed, coerces her into a contract marriage with Rajveer, unaware of the sinister plot for her sacrifice. Rajveer initially intends to transfer the curse to Avantika, but as their forced union progresses, he develops genuine affection, leading to profound internal conflict. He fiercely protects Avantika from public humiliation and false accusations, exposing digital deception and declaring his trust. However, Rajveer's paternal cousin cruelly reveals the curse's true nature to Avantika, forcing her to seek a cure for both their lives. Despite Rajveer's growing love and refusal to sacrifice her, his family, including his stepmother Shagun and ex-fiancée Lattika, continues to plot Avantika's demise to break the curse. Avantika tragically perishes, and Dadi mysteriously dies during a ritual, seemingly ending the curse's immediate threat. Eight years later, a critically ill and blind Avantika reappears, now with a daughter, Riya, who believes Rajveer is her estranged father. Rajveer, who believed Avantika dead, confronts the shocking truth of her survival and a dire prognosis, driven by a dark magic curse. His investigation uncovers a past murder of a family elder and the manipulative ex-lover, Radha/Lathika, responsible for Avantika's initial disappearance and attempts on her life. Rajveer, consumed by guilt and rekindled love, accepts a perilous task to save Avantika, which a prophecy reveals will lead to his own death. He publicly confesses his absence, vows to win back his family, and transfers all his assets to Avantika, who then realizes his profound sacrifices. Rajveer ultimately succumbs to his condition, leaving Riya with a final message for her mother. Years later, Riya questions Avantika about her father's unjust demise, hinting at a deeper, unresolved conspiracy surrounding the curse and Rajveer's ultimate sacrifice.

oops-not-a-gold-digger-3.title: Oops, Not a Gold Digger
oops-not-a-gold-digger-3.description: ఆ అమ్మాయికి అర్జంటుగా 50లక్షలు కావాలి. ఏం చేయాలా అని ఆలోచిస్తుంటే ఒక దారి దొరికింది. ఆ దారిలో వెళ్తే జీవితానికి ఏదైనా అవుతుందేమోనన్న భయం ఉన్నా కూడా ఒప్పుకుంది. నిజంగానే ఆమెకు కావాల్సిన డబ్బులు దొరికాయా.. ఆ తర్వాత ఏం జరిగింది. చూడండి.. మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

finding-us-again-1.title: Finding Us Again
finding-us-again-1.description:
అజయ్ తన బాల్యపు ప్రేమ ఆరాధ్య మళ్లీ తన జీవితంలోకి వస్తుందని ఇరవై ఏళ్లుగా ఎదురుచూస్తూ ఉంటాడు. కానీ ఆరాధ్య తన జీవితంలో ముందుకు సాగిపోయింది, తనకంటూ కష్టాలు ఉన్నాయి. అనుకోకుండా అజయ్ – ఆరాధ్య మళ్లీ కలిసినప్పుడు, వారి ప్రేమకథ అనుకోని మలుపు తిరుగుతుంది. కానీ జీవితం మాత్రం వాళ్లిద్దరినీ మళ్లీ కలిపేలా తన సొంత ప్లాన్ వేసుకుంది.

చూడండి “Finding Us Again” మైక్రో డ్రామా సిరీస్, కేవలం KUKU TVలో.

roshan-alias-jinu.title: Roshan alias Jinu
roshan-alias-jinu.description: അച്ഛന്റെ ജീവൻ രക്ഷിക്കാനുള്ള ദൗത്യത്തിൽ, പാവപെട്ട എഞ്ചിനീയറിംഗ് വിദ്യാർത്ഥിയായ റോഷൻ, വ്യവസായിയായ  മധ്യവയസ്‌ക ശില്പയുടെ രഹസ്യ കാമുകനാവുന്നു. സമ്പത്തിന്റെയും വഞ്ചനയുടെയും അപകടകരമായ ലോകത്തിലേക്ക് കടക്കുന്ന റോഷൻ, നുണകളുടെയും ബ്ലാക്ക്‌മെയിലിന്റെയും വലയിൽ കുടുങ്ങി പോകുന്നു. റോഷൻ്റെ സംഘർഷഭരിതമായ ജീവിതകഥ!

kans-vadh-krishan-ke-janam-ka-ek-karan.title: Kans Vadh : Krishan Ke Janam Ka Ek Karan
kans-vadh-krishan-ke-janam-ka-ek-karan.description: Kans ka atyachar aur Krishan ki ek parakrami yojna -  Ye ek aisi kahani hai jo sirf yudh par ant nahi hoti, par dharam ki sthapna ki ek misaal bhi hai. Is show mein suniye kaise Krishan ne Kans ka vadh karke nyay aur shanti ka sandesh diya.

bite-the-terror-that-feeds.title: Bite the Terror That Feeds
bite-the-terror-that-feeds.description: Kingsnake promised me he would let me go once he found the cure but he’s known this entire time and never once shared it with me. And now that I know the truth—that there is no cure—he still won’t let me go. Now I’m his prisoner once again. He asks to feed from me several times but I refuse all his advances. If he wants my blood he’ll have to force it from me. He comes to my bedchambers to speak with me but I pretend he doesn’t exist. Once his hunger intensifies and the weakness sets in he’s forced to feed—and it won’t be from me. Viper escorts me from my chambers to the brothel where his prey awaits and I’m forced to look at a gorgeous naked woman waiting for him. His betrayal has iced my heart and closed off my feelings but my jealousy can’t be controlled. I may be angry with him but I don’t want him to have anyone else but me. So I submit to the vampire king—again.

the-casebook-of-sherlock-holmes.title: The Casebook of Sherlock Holmes
the-casebook-of-sherlock-holmes.description:
Originally published in 1927, these short stories represent the fifth and final collection of Arthur Conan Doyle's tales featuring Sherlock Holmes. Included are the following stories originally published in Strand Magazine beginning in 1921 and stretching through 1927: 
The Adventure of the Illustrious Client
The Adventure of the Blanched Soldier 
The Adventure of the Mazarin Stone 
The Adventure of the Three Gables 
The Adventure of the Sussex Vampire 
The Adventure of the Three Garridebs 
The Problem of Thor Bridge 
The Adventure of the Creeping Man 
The Adventure of the Lion's Mane 
The Adventure of the Veiled Lodger 
The Adventure of Shoscombe Old Place 
The Adventure of the Retired Colourman 
Note: The original text contained wording and phrasing choices that represented outdated cultural beliefs related to race. Per the publisher's discretion, this audiobook edition makes minor edits to these instances to avoid perpetuating racial prejudice and stereotyping. With these texts now available in the public domain, listeners are free to view the original text via sources such as Project Gutenberg, Wikisource or Faded Page.

mirza-beimaan.title: Mirza Beimaan
mirza-beimaan.description: Samajhdaar aur shaatir drug dealer Mirza laut aya hai apni duniya me ab pehle se bhi zyada khatarnak aur takatwar ban kar , uska bas ek hi maqsad hai - Surajgarh par apna raj phir se hasil karna. Lekin yeh sirf paison aur rajneeti ka khel nahi, maut se baazi lagane jitna khatarnak hai . Kya Mirza apne har dushman ko maat dekar apna sapna poora kar payega?

kodu-thaandadhe.title: கோடு தாண்டாதே
kodu-thaandadhe.description: எந்த ஒரு அநியாயத்திற்கும், அக்கிரமத்திற்கும் எல்லை உண்டு. இந்த சமுதாயத்தில் நடக்கும் சில அநீதிகளை நாம் கண்டும் காணாமலும் கடந்து போய்க்கொண்டு இருக்கிறோம். நம்மில் 90% பேர் அப்படித்தான் இருக்கிறார்கள். வெகு அரிதாக உள்ள 10% பேர் மட்டுமே துணிச்சலோடு முன்வந்து குரல் கொடுக்கிறார்கள். அந்த 10% பேரில் உள்ள ஒரு நான்கு பேரின் கதைதான் இந்த கோடு தாண்டாதே. நம் தமிழ்நாட்டில் நடக்கும் அநீதிகளுக்கு ஒரு எல்லைக்கோட்டை அந்த நான்கு பேரும் வரைந்து எச்சரிக்கை விடுகிறார்கள். இந்த நால்வர் என்ன செய்கிறார்கள்? அறிய கேளுங்கள் கோடு தாண்டாதே

it-hurts-me.title: It Hurts Me
it-hurts-me.description: My husband of two years tells me he wants an open marriage. I'm stunned. I'm hurt. And I'm livid. I don't want to be married to a man who wants to open our bed to other people. But then I get a flat tire in the pouring rain and a sexy-as-hell gentleman helps me out. My husband is in the game so one look at the skull ring on this gentleman's left-hand tells me exactly who he is. The Skull King. I didn't want an open marriage… but I definitely want this man.

chandrakanta-santati-book-4.title: Chandrakanta - 4
chandrakanta-santati-book-4.description: Ek khoobsurat Rajkumari, ek bebaak Rajkumar aur unke beech ka timeless love! Politics, power aur jaado-tone ke is safar mein har pal naya thrill hai. Is kahani ko suniye aur Chandrakanta aur Virendra ke prem ki duniya mein kho jaaiye.

relay.title: Relay
relay.description: A last chance at swimming gold a second chance at lasting love. Team captain. Olympic medalist. Devoted son and brother. Alex has it all and all the demands that go with being the best. The last thing he needs on his crowded plate is his closeted ex. Dane is the biggest swimming star. Carefully crafted from crib to pool his fame feeds his celebrity parents' empire. He dropped the act; the summer he fell in love with Alex. Ten years later the performance is crushing his soul. So is resisting the man he still loves. As the team struggles to gel Alex and Dane clash in and out of the pool. Forgive and forget is easier said than done. But something has to give if Alex and Dane want a shot at gold. And a second chance at love. Team captain and team celebrity square off in this enemies-to-lovers second chance MM sports romance between two elite swimmers fighting against their hearts and fighting for Olympic gold.

change-your-habits-change-your-life.title: Change Your Habits, Change Your Life
change-your-habits-change-your-life.description: Kya aap bhi apne life mein ek fresh restart chahte ho? Agar haan, Toh ye audiobook suniye jismein, Vanshika apne daily boring routine ko todti hai, aur ek best habit coach Ashdin ke saath apni life ko redefine karti hai. Jinki coaching ka fayda aap bhi utha sakte  hain. Toh phir der kis baat ki, Abhi seekhna shuru kariye.

mission-earth-volume-6-death-quest.title: Mission Earth Volume 6: Death Quest
mission-earth-volume-6-death-quest.description: Explosive action, twisted desires, and high-stakes paternity suits collide as Voltarian Royal Officer Jettero Heller fights to protect his love, Countess Krak, from a deadly plot. With enemies closing in and chaos on all sides, love becomes a dangerous battlefield in this thrilling intergalactic adventure.

l-ron-hubbard-presents-writers-of-the-fu.title: L. Ron Hubbard Presents Writers of the Future Volume 39
l-ron-hubbard-presents-writers-of-the-fu.description: This collection features twelve captivating speculative fiction tales chosen by top authors like Brandon Sanderson and Orson Scott Card. From time travelers saving London from a nuclear threat to a beach party with a vampire, dragon, and shape-shifting Chihuahua, these stories span dark fantasy, space opera, and time travel. With writing that is both excellent and varied, it's a must-read for sci-fi and fantasy fans.

jamtara-phone-uthaaoge-toh-lut-jaaoge.title: Jamtara: Phone Uthaaoge Toh Lut Jaaoge
jamtara-phone-uthaaoge-toh-lut-jaaoge.description: Aakhir kaise Jharkhand ke chhote se gaon Jamtara se aata hai ek phone call aur bas ho jata hai poora bank accounts khali. Is show mein suniye Bollywood superstars, sarkari afsar, political leaders aur aam logon ko lootne wale Jamtara ke scammers ki Hairatangez kahani.

fear-4.title: Fear
fear-4.description: Professor James Lowry, a skeptic of the supernatural, loses four hours of his life on a seemingly ordinary evening in Atworthy. As he attempts to unravel the mystery, the town changes around him, becoming increasingly terrifying. A dark, malevolent force warns him: finding his lost time could lead to his death.

enjoying-the-show.title: Enjoying the Show
enjoying-the-show.description: Hailey Jennison is smart funny and unfortunately stacked like a blonde brick house. She's well aware of the impact her looks have on the male gender and she hates it. Socially awkward she keeps to a safe boring routine meeting friends once a week for dinner some laughs and entertainment. Entertainment comes in the form of a little harmless voyeurism watching the living breathing sex god across the quad parade around his apartment half-naked. Hailey watches and yearns indulging in this weekly fantasy that almost—but not quite—satisfies her every desire. When Gage catches Hailey in the act of ogling him he gives her a choice: go out with him or he'll call the cops. But he has no intention of calling the law down on every man's fantasy. For he's been watching her as well. And he has plans to fulfill her every desire. Warning: This title contains the following: girls' night harmless peeping and a man named Mr. Tool.

Begum-Ka-Badla-अंडरवर्ल्ड-का-ख़ूनी-खेल.title: Begum Ka Badla: अंडरवर्ल्ड का ख़ूनी खेल
Begum-Ka-Badla-अंडरवर्ल्ड-का-ख़ूनी-खेल.description: Mumbai ki andheri galiyon mein ek simple housewife ka badla, underworld ke liye sabse bada khatra ban gaya. Ashraf Khan, jo pati ki hatya ke baad Sapna Didi ban gayi, usne dushmanon ko unki hi chaalon mein uljhaane ka khaufnaak khel chuna. Yeh true story hai ek aise junoon ki, jo ek aam house wife ko underworld ka sabse bada challenge bana deta hai.

manasi.title: മാനസി
manasi.description: യുദ്ധം, പരിസ്ഥിതി നശീകരണം, ലൈംഗിക വിവേചനം, വംശീയ വിവേചനം എന്നിവയ്‌ക്കെതിരെ പ്രതികരിക്കുന്നതോടൊപ്പം, ഈ രചന അധികാരത്തിന്റെ രാഷ്ട്രീയത്തെയും അതിന്റെ അതിക്രമപരമായ സ്വഭാവത്തെയും വിമര്‍ശിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. അതേസമയം, ഈ കൃതി ലോകവ്യാപകമായ ജനാധിപത്യത്തിന്റെ ആശയങ്ങളെയും പ്രതിഫലിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

സിഗ്‌മ-ലവർ-.title: സിഗ്‌മ ലവർ
സിഗ്‌മ-ലവർ-.description: കാമുകന്റെ ചതിയും വീട്ടുകാരുടെ അവഗണനയും നേരിട്ട നീതു അപ്രതീക്ഷിതമായാണ് ജീവൻ എന്ന ചെറുപ്പക്കാരനെ പരിചയപ്പെടുന്നത്. തനിക്കു നഷ്ടപെട്ടതെല്ലാം തിരികെ നേടി തരാം എന്ന് ജീവൻ പറഞ്ഞത് വെറുമൊരു സഹായ വാഗ്ദാനം മാത്രം ആയിരുന്നില്ല, പകരം അവൻ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടത് നീതുവിനെ ഞെട്ടിച്ചു. പ്രണയവും പകയും കുടുംബവും പ്രതികാരവും ചുറ്റിപ്പറ്റിയ ഹൃദയഹാരിയായ കഥ തീർച്ചയായും കേൾക്കുക.

indra-dev-shakti-swarth-aur-vivaad-ke-de.title: Indra Dev: Shakti, Swarth Aur Vivaad Ke Devta
indra-dev-shakti-swarth-aur-vivaad-ke-de.description: Swarg ke Devta Indra Dev ke kartooton ka kala sach – kya vasna aur ahankar ne banaya unhe sabse bada paapi? Toh Shraap aur badle ke chakravyuh mein, Kya ab khatam ho jayega Devraj ka swarg ka sukh? Suniye is show mein, Indra Dev ki wo sachayi jo kabhi kisi ne sochi bhi nahi thi!

heart-beats.title: Heart Beats ❤️
heart-beats.description: കോളേജില്‍ പലരുടെയും ക്രഷ് ആയിരുന്ന പ്രണവിനെ ചെറുപ്പം മുതലേ ഇഷ്ടമാണ് അഞ്ജലിക്ക്. കുടുംബങ്ങള്‍ തമ്മിലും അടുപ്പം. അഞ്ജലിയുടെ മനസിലെ ഇഷ്ടം പക്ഷേ പ്രണവിന് അറിയുമായിരുന്നില്ല. പ്രണവിന്റെ മനസില്‍ മറ്റൊരാളായിരുന്നു. പെട്ടെന്നൊരു ദിവസമാണ് അഞ്ജലി പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കാതെ ആ വാര്‍ത്ത എത്തിയത്. പ്രണവിന്റെയും അഞ്ജലിയുടെയും കല്ല്യാണാലോചന. പ്രണവ് ഈ കല്ല്യാണത്തിന് സമ്മതിക്കുമോ!!

lets-talk-money-3.title: Let's Talk Money
lets-talk-money-3.description: "Kya paise ko sahi se manage karna itna mushkil hai?" Yeh audiobook aapko woh tips aur trick dega jo financial stress ko door bhagaane mein madad karega. Suniye aur jaaniye, kaise kuch simple steps se aap apne future ko financially secure bana sakte hain... Aapke sapno ko pura karne aur roadmap yahan hai… bas ek sawal - kya aap apne paise ko apna dost banana chahte hain?

ragasiya-ratchasaa.title: Ragasiya Ratchasaa
ragasiya-ratchasaa.description: Pagal nerathula romeo, iravu nerathula ratchasan"aa irukum oru kanavan. Avanukku pokkishamaa kidaicha vellai manasu konda oru manaivi. Antha pennu'ku kaathirukkum savaalgal enna ? Kanavanudaiya intha maatrathukku enna kaaranam ?

thedathey-kidaikkathu.title: Thedathey Kidaikkathu
thedathey-kidaikkathu.description: Two detectives are in a race against a businessman's adversaries to locate his missing son before they do, uncovering a web of intrigue and danger. As the investigation unfolds, the detectives confront unexpected challenges that test their skills and determination.

easy-money-1-evolution-of-money.title: Easy Money-1 : Evolution of Money
easy-money-1-evolution-of-money.description:
"Tayaar ho jaiye, kyunki yeh sirf paison ki kahani nahi, balki ek aisi duniya ka raaz hai jo har note ke piche chhupa hai! Easy Money 1 ke saath, Vivek Kaul aapko le jaate hain ek safar par – jahan pata chalta hai bade se bada financial system kaise bana aur bikhar gaya! Kaise bani banking aur kaise aaye woh waqt jab har insaan ke sapne paison ki dor se bandh gaye. Ek aisi kahani jo aapko sochne pe majboor kar degi – kya paisa sach mein duniya ghumata hai, ya hum sirf ek chakravyuh mein phanse hain?"
Bolo, kya is safar mein chalein?

the-single-dad.title: The Single Dad
the-single-dad.description: Most college-aged girls go to Europe to experience their sexual awakening. All I had to do was go home. Ford Dalton isn’t the kind of man I’d look at twice—because I can’t stop looking at him at all. We can’t take our hands off each other in the bar. Back at his house it’s our lips. And in his bed? There isn’t a single part of us that’s not on fire. One night would never be long enough for Ford to show me every delicious thing he can do to my body. But there’s something he’s keeping from me: he’s already met the love of his life his daughter Everly. And there’s something I’m keeping from him: I just applied for the job of my dreams being Everly’s new nanny.

violent-beginnings.title: Violent Beginnings
violent-beginnings.description: The deal was sealed the moment she stepped onto that stage. It was like seeing a ghost: sunshine-blonde hair pale skin azure eyes that held a thousand secrets. I didn’t know what caused her to end up on that auction block and I didn’t care. All I knew was that I had to have her—no matter the cost. A million dollars later she became mine. Mine to break. Mine to use. Mine to keep.

ek-raja-do-rani-mahabharat-ki-anokhi-pre.title: Ek Raja Do Rani - Mahabharat ki Anokhi Prem Kahani
ek-raja-do-rani-mahabharat-ki-anokhi-pre.description: "Ek raja, do raniyaan... aur mohabbat, junoon aur vishwasghaat se bhari ek kahani! Har kadam par chhupi hai ek aag, jo yayati ke prem aur paap ko aakhri had tak le jaayegi. Shukracharya ka bhayankar shraap aur yayati ka jawani ka laalach — Devyani aur Sharmistha ke kismat ke khel mein kaun jeetega? Suniye ek aisi dastaan, jismein pyaar bhi hai, badla bhi aur har mod par maut ka saaya!"

house-husband.title: Slumdog Husband
house-husband.description: “ధనం మూలం ఇదం జగత్ ; పెళ్ళాం అనే బంధం మగాడికి శాపం!” అభిమన్యు ఎప్పుడు అనుకునే మాట ఇదే! అభిమన్యు ఒక శ్రీమంతుడు, ఉన్నోడు ఉండచ్చు కదా ఒక అమ్మాయిని ప్రేమిస్తాడు, ఆ అమ్మాయి కోసం ఇల్లరికం కూడా వస్తాడు. సంతానం లేని ఆడది అన్నా, సంపాదన లేని మగాడు అన్నా సమాజం ఎప్పటికి గౌరవం ఇవ్వదు. లోకం దాకా ఎందుకు సొంత వాళ్ళు కూడా లోకువుగా చూస్తారు. అలానే అభిమన్యు ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయి చేత, కూతురుని ఇచ్చిన అత్తయ్య చేత తిట్లు కాస్తూ ఉంటాడు, మనోడు కోటీశ్వరుడైనా ప్రేమ కోసం అవమానం భరిస్తాడు . కానీ ఒకవేళ తన పెళ్ళానికి, ఇంకా వాళ్ళ అత్తయ్యకి అభిమన్యు బాగా డబ్బున్న వాడు అని తెలిస్తే వాళ్ళ పరిస్థితి ఏంటి? వాళ్ళ ముఖ చిత్రాలు ఎలా ఉంటాయి ? తెలుసుకోండి మన ఈ కథ విని.

the-penthouse-affair-complete-series.title: The Penthouse Affair: Complete Series
the-penthouse-affair-complete-series.description: The Penthouse Affair duet contains two steamy romance stories; The Two-Week Arrangement and Seven Nights of Sin. Dear Sexy AF Intern, I know you don't particularly care that I'm the CEO of this company and you're just an intern. I also know you're not impressed by my power or my wealth and that's fine. You think you've got me all figured out from working alongside me for two weeks but you don't know me. Not really. You don't know that I'm a single dad to twin toddlers or that those two little girls matter more to me than this entire hotel chain. I'm not interested in starting something deep and meaningful but what I am interested in is the way your body reacts to mine when we're in the same room. You probably assume the concentration on my face is work-related when in reality I'm figuring out which I want more--to nail you against the wall or to bend you over my desk. While you're too disciplined to act on it I'm not. And the night you stepped into my limo all bets were off.

gullivers-travel-cbse.title: Gulliver's Travels
gullivers-travel-cbse.description: Kya hota hai jab ek mamuli sa insaan samundar ki lehron mein kho kar ajeeb-o-gareeb aur romanchak duniyaon mein pahuch jata hai? Kahin 5-6 inch ke baune samjh lete hain use koi raakshas, toh kahi usse bhi bahut bade insano ke beech wo ban jata hai khud ek khilauna. Yahan udne wale sheher hain, jahaan vigyaan aur jadui raaz hain, aur kahin hain bolne wale intellgent ghode. Har mod par hai aapki soch se pare ek naya twist. Taiyaar ho jaiye Lemuel Gulliver ke saath ek aise safar par nikalne ke liye… kyunki is safar me normal kuch bhi nahi hai!

play-with-me.title: Play With Me
play-with-me.description: Steve is tall, blonde, fun-loving, faithful and protective. When Ruby shows up on the wrong night for one of his famed pajama parties, he graciously invites her to stay and hang out. Everything’s great—until she gets a little too drunk on hard cider and professes her attraction to him… repeatedly. Now Ruby and Steve have to decide if they want to cross that line or if it’s better to preserve their easy friendship. Maybe with a little luck they can do both.

ravenous.title: Ravenous
ravenous.description: Ellie Godfrey has kissed her share of frogs—so many in fact that she fears she won't recognize her prince if and when he finally comes along. Tired of waiting for THE ONE she decides to have a baby on her own before it's too late. When Jasper Autry hears about Ellie's plan, what else can he do but step in and offer to contribute to her project? Does that make him an opportunist? Whatever. He wants the perpetually out-of-reach Ellie Godfrey and when he sees his chance he takes it. That she's the sister of his business partner and close friend Flynn gives him pause but it doesn't stop him from having what he wants. As Jasper and Ellie embark upon their secret project, he makes it clear that for as long as they're together he's in charge—in the bedroom anyway. After the hottest sex of her life Ellie realizes she's made a deal with the devil himself.

ishq-with-a-ghost.title: Ishq With A Ghost
ishq-with-a-ghost.description: Kya ho agar jisse aapko ishq ho, vo Insan na ho kar ek bhatakati aatma ho? Yahi hua tha social media influencer Krutika ke saath ! Followers haasil karne ke chakkar me vo ek ghost ke saath relation me aa jaati hai. Kya anjaam hoga is rishte ka? Kya bhoot union is rishte ko accept Karegi? Kya Krutika ka ye ishq adhoora rah jaayega? Jaanne ke liye suniye "Ishq With A Ghost"

delirious.title: Delirious
delirious.description: As one of Hollywood's hottest producers, Kristian Bowen is on top of the world. With the Quantum team fresh off a clean sweep of awards during award season and looking ahead to the premiere of their new film, his life is exactly how he likes it- complete with a stable of willing subs to tend to his every desire. That is, it was right up until he attended a wedding and met Aileen Gifford. Since meeting her, his carefully cultivated life has changed in ways he never could've expected. Now she and her children are moving to LA and he's not sure whether to be excited or terrified about his powerful feelings for the single mom. Aileen is coming off the worst year of her life spent battling breast cancer while taking care of two young children. When her friends encourage her to move to LA and work for Quantum, she jumps at the chance to give her family a fresh start. And with her off-the-charts attraction to Kristian in the mix, the idea becomes that much sweeter. But then everyone shows up to welcome her and the kids to their new home except him. But Kristian can't avoid Aileen forever and when they finally see each other again sparks fly between the single mom and the producer with a past he's kept hidden from everyone who matters to him. When the past rears its ugly head, will he run away from the woman he loves or turn to her for comfort in the storm? And will she prevail in convincing him that he can be himself in every possible way with her?

Gupta-Samarajya-युद्ध-और-प्रेम-की-गाथा.title: Samrat Chandragupt : Gupt Samrajay Ki Ek Ankahi Dastan
Gupta-Samarajya-युद्ध-और-प्रेम-की-गाथा.description: Ye kahani hai Gupta Empire ke raja Chandragupta Vikramaditya ki. Unke shaurya ki, unke prem ki. Is kahani mein yudh hai, prem hai, dosti hai, sazish hai, satta ka lalach hai. Aitihasik prishthbhoomi par buni gayi ye kahani aapko ek aise romanchak safar par le jayegi, jahan se aap lautna nahin chahenge. To phir soch kya rahe hain, nikal padie apne us safar par.

నల-దమయంతి--A-Timeless-Love-From-The-Maha.title: నల దమయంతి - A Timeless Love From The Mahabharata
నల-దమయంతి--A-Timeless-Love-From-The-Maha.description: పూర్వం నిషిధదేశానికి నలుడు రాజుగా ఉండేవాడు. భరతఖండాన్ని ఏలిన ఆరుగురు చక్రవర్తులలోనూ నలమహారాజు ఒకడు. ఇతని పెళ్లి చాలా చిత్రంగా జరిగింది. నలుడు, దమయంతిల ప్రేమకథ మీకోసం.

irubathi-moonraavadhu-jannal.title: 23-வது ஜன்னல்
irubathi-moonraavadhu-jannal.description: ஒரு பழமையான கிராமத்தில் இருக்கும் ஐஸ்வர்யப் பெருமாள் கோவிலின் பெருமையை உலகிற்கு தெரியப்படுத்தும் நோக்கில் ஒரு தொலைக்காட்சியின் படப்பிடிப்பு குழுவினர் அங்கே வருகிறார்கள். அந்த பழமையான கோவிலின் உள்ளே நூற்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட ஜன்னல்கள் இருக்கின்றன. அந்த ஜன்னல்களில் 23வது ஜன்னல் மட்டும்தான் தனித்தன்மை கொண்டதாக இருக்கிறது. அது என்ன என்பதைச் சொல்லும் நாவல்தான் இது.

mai-gunahgar-hu.title: Main Gunehgar Hoon
mai-gunahgar-hu.description: Jasoosi novels padhne ka shaukeen ek IT professional Rahul Verma, jab ek khoobsurat ladki Rashmi ko drugs case mein be-gunaah sabit karne nikalta hai, to khud ek aise gunah me ulajh jata hai, jo na sirf ek be-gunah ladki Anjali ko fansi tak le jaata hai, balki uski apni zindagi bhi tabaah kar deta hai. Apni atma par lage ‘Mai Gunehgar Hu’ ke daag ko mitaane ke liye Rahul jo raasta chunta hai, wo Hyderabad ke drugs mafia ko hila daalta hai. Kya Rahul khud ko is khatarnak chakravyuh se nikaal payega? Suniye is romanchak show me.

ప్రేమ-దేశం.title: ప్రేమ దేశం
ప్రేమ-దేశం.description: ప్రతి ఒక్కరికి వారి మొదటి ప్రేమ చాలా స్పెషల్. అది ఎప్పటికి మర్చిపోని తియ్యని అనుభూతినైనా మిగులుస్తుంది, లేదా తీరని విషాదాన్ని అయినా ఇస్తుంది. మరి అలంటి ప్రేమ కథను మీరు వినాలంటే "ప్రేమ దేశం" లోకి మీకు ఆహ్వానం పలుకుతుంది

reclaiming-dignity-the-nirbhaya-quest.title: NIRBHAYA
reclaiming-dignity-the-nirbhaya-quest.description: దేశ చరిత్రలో 2012 డిసెంబరులో ఢిల్లీలో జరిగిన అత్యంత దారుణమైన గ్యాంగ్ రేప్ ఘటనను, దాని పరిణామాలను వివరించే నిజ సంఘటన గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే "నిర్భయ" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

chandrakanta-santati-book-3.title: Chandrakanta - 3
chandrakanta-santati-book-3.description: Chandrakanta ka Jaadu Abhi Zinda Hai! Kya Vijaygarh aur Naugarh ke beech ke ye raaz aur bhi gehre honge? Is third part mein aapko milega action, romance aur kaatil twists jo aapki imagination ko hawa dega. Toh bas, headphones lagaiye aur is kahani ki duniya mein kho jaiye!

bhagat-singh-26.title: భగత్ సింగ్
bhagat-singh-26.description: భగత్ సింగ్ చేసిన పోరాటం మీకు తెలుసా? భగత్ సింగ్ ను గాంధీ వ్యతిరేకించారా? భగత్ సింగ్ జీవిత గాథ, అతని వ్యక్తిత్వం, కృషి, త్యాగాలు మరియు భారత స్వాతంత్ర్య పోరాటంలో అతని పాత్రను తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా ?  దేశంకోసం మరణించి ధైర్యశాలిగా, త్యాగశాలీగా పేరు తెచ్చుకున్న విప్లవ సేనాని "భగత్ సింగ్" గురించి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

ormakkurippukal-basheer.title: ഓർമ്മക്കുറിപ്പ് - ബഷീർ
ormakkurippukal-basheer.description: ആത്മകഥാംശം അടങ്ങുന്ന വൈക്കം മുഹമ്മദ് ബഷീറിന്റെ സുന്ദരമായ ലേഖനം, അതിൽ പ്രണയം, മാതൃത്വം, വിപ്ലവം, രാഷ്ട്രീയവും കുടുംബവുമെല്ലാം ഉൾക്കൊള്ളുന്നു. ആ കാലഘട്ടത്തിലെ കേരളത്തിന്റെ രാഷ്ട്രീയ ഭൂപടത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് ബഷീറിന്റെ ഈ പുസ്തകം നമ്മെ ഓർമ്മപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു. തീർച്ചയായും കേൾക്കുക

bollywood-unplugged-daily-filmy-gupshup.title: Bollywood Unplugged: Daily Filmy Gupshup
bollywood-unplugged-daily-filmy-gupshup.description: Kya sach mein Nimrit Kaur bani hai Aish-Abhishek ke divorce ki wajah? Kyun lagayi Bhaijaan ne contestants ko fatkaar? Kya hai Bollywood ki andar ki khabar, saari masaledar gossips ka one place destination Bollywood Unplugged: Daily Filmy Gupshup.

chinnammayi-chittebbayi.title: చిన్నమ్మాయి  చిట్టబ్బాయి
chinnammayi-chittebbayi.description: చిన్నమ్మాయ్, చిట్టబ్బాయ్ అనే ఇద్దరు తమ స్వంత ప్రపంచంలో  స్నేహం, సరదా సంఘటనలతో రోజులు గడుపుతారు. వారి మధ్య ఏర్పడే చిన్న చిన్న సవాళ్లు, హాస్య సంఘటనలు, మనసుకు హత్తుకునే స్నేహం కథలో ఆకట్టుకుంటాయి. కథ చివరికి స్నేహం, ప్రేమ మరియు పరిణతి అనేవి జీవితంలో ఎంత ముఖ్యమో అర్థమవుతుంది.

siwan-ka-sultan-shahaabuddin.title: Siwan Ka Sultan : Shahaabuddin
siwan-ka-sultan-shahaabuddin.description: Yeh kahani hai Md. Shahabuddin ki, ek aise shakhsa ki, jise Bihar ki siyasat mein dar aur taqat ka doosra naam maana jata tha. Uski taqat, raajneeti mein uska kad, aur uske hinsak kaarname aapki rooh ko kanpa denge. Is show mein suniye Kaise ek aam insaan apraadh aur rajneeti ka badshah ban gaya? Yeh raaz aapke hosh uda denge – kya aap sach ka saamna kar paayenge?

യാമിനി-.title: യാമിനി
യാമിനി-.description: ഒളിച്ചോടിയ ജിസ്മിയെയും ലിനസിനെയും ഒളിപ്പിച്ചു താമസിപ്പിക്കാനാണ് ഗായത്രി അടച്ചിട്ടിരുന്ന തന്റെ പഴയ തറവാട്ടിലേക്ക് അവരെ കൂട്ടികൊണ്ടുവരുന്നത്. എന്നാൽ അവരുടെ വരവോടെ വർഷങ്ങൾക്കു മുൻപ്  തളച്ചിട്ടിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു ദുരാത്മാവ് പ്രതികാരദാഹവുമായി മോചിതയാകുന്നു. ശ്വാസം അടക്കിപ്പിടിച്ച് മാത്രം കേൾക്കാൻ കഴിയുന്ന ഒരു സമ്പൂർണ്ണ ഹൊറർ ത്രില്ലർ- യാമിനി!

40bc60e4-7235-4d50-88f3-0645defa20ce.title: WARRIOR
40bc60e4-7235-4d50-88f3-0645defa20ce.description: ధనం మూలం ఇదం జగత్! డబ్బు కోసం మనుషులు ఇంతకు అయినా తెగిస్తారు, ఆఖరికి సొంత నాన్న ను చంపడానికి అయినా, అమరేంద్ర శ్రీ పాద. దేశంలో ధనికుడు అయినా అమరేంద్ర శ్రీపాద ను ఎలా అయినా నోరు మూయించి, ఆస్తి కొట్టేదాం అని చూస్తారు అతని రెండో భార్య పిల్లలు, కానీ అతనికి కవచం లా ఉంటాడు విరాట్, అతని మొదటి భార్య కొడుకు. నాన్నను కాపాడుకుందాం అనుకునే కొడుకు కన్నా గొప్ప వారియర్ ఇంకెవరు ఉంటారు?

maha-yoddha.title: Battle Of The Desert Kings
maha-yoddha.description: Apne swayamvar ki raat, Amravati ki Rajkumari par ek shaktishaali mayavi jeev ka hamla hota hai, jo uski sanson ko rok deta hai. Lekin, ek door desh ka Rajkumar usse maut ke changul se chudane ki koshish karta hai. Kya ye veer Rajkumar Amravati ki Rajkumari ka jeevan bacha kar uska saathi banega, ya phir Rajkumari ke jeevan ki ye aakhri raat hogi?

ജന്മാന്തരം.title: ജന്മാന്തരം
ജന്മാന്തരം.description: ഞെട്ടിക്കുന്ന വാര്‍ത്തകളുടെ പിന്നാലെ പായുന്ന ഇന്‍വെസ്റ്റിഗേറ്റീവ് ജേണലിസ്റ്റായ സ്മൃതിയുടെ ജീവിതത്തില്‍ ഞെട്ടിക്കുന്ന ഒരു രഹസ്യം ഒളിഞ്ഞിരിപ്പുണ്ട്. വൈത്തീശ്വരന്‍ കോവിലില്‍ വെച്ച് അത് ചുരുളഴിഞ്ഞ് തുടങ്ങുകയാണ്. എന്തിനാണ് സ്മൃതി അമ്മയുടെയും അമ്മൂമ്മയുടെയും ഒപ്പം അങ്ങോട്ടേക്ക് പോകുന്നത്? ഇനിയുള്ള അവളുടെ യാത്രകള്‍ ആരെ തേടിയാണ്. കേള്‍ക്കാം ഫാന്റസിയും റൊമാന്‍സും ത്രില്ലറും ഒത്തുചേര്‍ന്ന ജന്മാന്തരം..

39061e24-c1d4-4e1d-912d-fb17f4e6a160.title: టిక్:టిక్:టిక్
39061e24-c1d4-4e1d-912d-fb17f4e6a160.description: అజయ్, విప్లవ్‌లు నల్లమల అటవీ ప్రాంతంలో గుప్తనిధుల అన్వేషణ కోసం వెళ్లి, మంత్రగత్తె అడవిలో చిక్కుకుంటారు. నిధిని వెతికే క్రమంలో ఒక కోటలో రెండు కాలాలకు మధ్య ఉన్న ఒక తలుపును కనుక్కుంటారు. ఆ ద్వారం వారిని మరో కాలపు రాజ్యంలోకి పంపుతుంది. ఆ రాజ్యంలోని అందాల రాజకుమారి శాపం గురించి తెలుస్తుంది. తాంత్రిక శక్తుల పంజరంలో చిక్కుకుపోయిన రాజకుమారిని ఆ ఇద్దరూ రక్షించగలరా? లేదా ఆ తాంత్రిక శక్తులతో చేసే పోరాటంలో ఓడిపోతారా? చివరకు ఏమవుతుంది? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని

urmila-tyag-aur-samarpan-ki-ankahi-gaath.title: Urmila: Tyag Aur Samarpan Ki Ankahi Gaatha
urmila-tyag-aur-samarpan-ki-ankahi-gaath.description: "Urmila" ek kahaani hai un aankhon ki jo hamesha intezaar karti rahi, aur un hothon ki jo kabhi na shikayat kar paaye. Yeh Ramayan ka wo pehlu hai jo aapne kabhi na suna hoga- ek prem kahaani, jo dooriyon ke bawjood kabhi kamzor nahi hui. Toh abhi sunna shuru kariye, aur kho jaaiye Urmila ke is anokhe prem ki kahaani mein.

the-legacy-of-laughter-allu-ramalingayya.title: The Legacy of Laughter - అల్లు రామలింగయ్య నుంచి అల్లు అర్జున్ దాకా...
the-legacy-of-laughter-allu-ramalingayya.description: అల్లు రామలింగయ్యగారి హాస్యపు ప్రయాణం అందరినీ నవ్విస్తే.. అల్లు అర్జున్ ఐకాన్ హీరోగా ఎదిగిన జర్నీ తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా? అయితే "The Legacy of Laughter - అల్లు రామలింగయ్య నుండి అల్లు అర్జున్ దాకా..." అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

albert-einstein-7.title: Albert Einstein
albert-einstein-7.description: ప్రపంచాన్ని మార్చిన అత్యంత ప్రతిభాశాలి శాస్త్రవేత్త, తన ఆవిష్కరణలతో విజ్ఞాన శాస్త్రంలో కొత్త దిశలు చూపించిన "Albert Einstein " జీవిత గాథను ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా వినండి.

6a0e5861-eabd-4c28-8e22-a57664971dae.title: Dharm Ka Sangram: ऋषि जबाली Vs श्रीराम
6a0e5861-eabd-4c28-8e22-a57664971dae.description: Ek taraf Rishi Jabali ka maya par vishwas, aur doosri taraf Ram ka dharm aur aastha ke prati samarpann. Kya hoga jab in dono ki soch takraayengi? Kaun sa sach jeetega aur kaun apne vicharon par kayam reh paayega? Is show mein jaaniye kaise inke beech ki yeh behas naye pehlu ubhaaregi. Yeh kahani aapko apne jeevan ke gyaan aur sachaiyon ko parakhne ka mauka degi.

mathsya-avataar.title: మత్స్యావతారం
mathsya-avataar.description: మహావిష్ణువు తొలి అవతారం గురించి వివరంగా  తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "మత్స్యావతారం" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

japan-and-india-world-war-2.title: Japan and India: World War 2
japan-and-india-world-war-2.description: World War 2 mein Japan ka Bharat ke dil tak pahuncha, Manipur se Singapore tak kabza, aur isi waqt bani thi pehli Indian Army. Suniye kaise Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose ne Azad Hind Fauj ke zariye azaadi ka sapna dekha aur jeet ki koshish ki.

steve-jobs-5.title: STEVE JOBS
steve-jobs-5.description: ది గ్రేట్ ఆపిల్ ఫౌండర్ జీవితంలో జరిగిన ఆసక్తికరమైన విషయాలు గురించి  తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "స్టీవ్ జాబ్స్" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

മായാനദി.title: മായാനദി
മായാനദി.description: ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രായം കുറഞ്ഞ പ്രശസ്തനായ ബിസിനസ്സ് ഷാർക്കാണ് അഭിമന്യു. ബിസിനസ്സിൽ വിജയിയെങ്കിലും, പണ്ട് ഉണ്ടായ ഒരു സംഭവം അവൻ്റെ  പ്രണയ  ജീവിതത്തിനു എല്ലാക്കാലവും തടസ്സമായി. പുറമേ സ്ത്രീകളെ വെറുക്കുന്നുവെന്ന് പറയപ്പെടുമ്പോഴും, പലപ്പോഴും അവൻ പക്ഷേ സ്ത്രീകളുടെ കിടക്കയിൽ കണ്ടെത്തപ്പെടുന്നുമുണ്ട്!  ഹരിദ്വാറിലെ അനാഥയായ പവിത്രയെ കണ്ടുമുട്ടുന്നതോടെ,  അഭിമന്യുവിന്റെ ജീവിതം മാറിമറിയുന്നു? അത് യഥാർത്ഥ പ്രണയമോ അതോ വെറും നേരമ്പോക്കോ?

karm-chakra-janmon-ka-safar.title: Karm Chakra : Janmon Ka Safar
karm-chakra-janmon-ka-safar.description: Karm Chakra ek aisa chakra hai jisse kya raja, kya ranj, koi nahi bach paya. Ye karm chakra hi tha jisne Mahabharat ke waqt Arjun ko Abhimanyu ki mrityu par vichlit hone se roka tha. Kaise? Aur kab aur kahan tak rehta hai ye chakra? Janiye is show mein.

రాజనాగం.title: రాజనాగం
రాజనాగం.description: ప్రతి యుగంలో దుష్ట శక్తికి, దైవ శక్తికి జరిగే యుద్ధం, మరి ఈ కలియుగంలో కూడా జరిగితే, అది లోక వినాశనమా ?? లేక లోక కళ్యాణమా ?? అస్సలు రాజనాగం ఏమిటి ?? ప్రేతనాగం ఎందుకు పుట్టింది ?? అన్న తమ్ములుగా పుట్టిన దుష్ట శక్తి, దైవ శక్తి మధ్య పోరు ఎలా ఉండబోతోందో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "రాజనాగం" ఫాంటసీ కథలోని అడుగు పెట్టెయ్యండి.

chekunthante-kaladikal.title: ചെകുത്താന്റെ കാലടികള്‍
chekunthante-kaladikal.description: ലോകത്തേറ്റവും ആരാധകരുള്ള കുറ്റാന്വേഷകന്‍ ഷെര്‍ലക് ഹോംസിന്റെ ഏഴ് അതിസാഹസിക കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരമാണ് ചെകുത്താന്റെ കാലടികള്‍. സര്‍ ആര്‍തര്‍ കോനന്‍ ഡോയല്‍ അനശ്വരമാക്കിയ ത്രില്ലിങ് കുറ്റാന്വേഷക കഥകള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

arjun-singhania-ki-bhabhi.title: Arjun Singhania Ki Bhabhi
arjun-singhania-ki-bhabhi.description:
"Tumhari himmat kaise hui mujhe kiss karne ki, Arjun? Bhabhi hoon main tumhari!"
18 saal ki umra mein shaadi karne ke baad, apne billionaire pati ko khone wali Jhanvi apne sasural mein sirf kuch logon ko bachane ke liye rehne ka faisla karti hai. Par uske devar Arjun ko lagta hai wo apne bhai ki property ki tarah Jhanvi par bhi haq jama lega. Kya hoga jab Jhanvi ko Arjun se dusri shaadi karne ke liye majboor kiya jaayega?

മരണമുദ്ര-.title: മരണമുദ്ര
മരണമുദ്ര-.description: തന്റെ കുടുംബം തകർത്ത മാഫിയക്കെതിരെ  ഒറ്റയാൾ പോരാട്ടത്തിന് ഇറങ്ങിത്തിരിച്ച യുവാവിന്റെ കഥ. കൊച്ചി അധോലോകം അടക്കിവാഴുന്ന ദാദാഭായിയെ തോല്പിയ്ക്കാൻ അവനാകുമോ. കേൾക്കാം, ഉദ്വേഗം നിറഞ്ഞ സൂപ്പർഹിറ്റ് ത്രില്ലർ- മരണമുദ്ര.

వకీల్-సాబ్--INSPIRED-BY-REAL-LIFE-COURT-.title: వకీల్ సాబ్ - INSPIRED BY REAL LIFE COURT CASES
వకీల్-సాబ్--INSPIRED-BY-REAL-LIFE-COURT-.description: మన వకీల్ సాబ్ తన దగ్గరకు న్యాయం కోసం వచ్చిన వారికి న్యాయాన్ని అందించాడా? నిజ జీవిత కోర్ట్ కేసుల ఆధారంగా రూపొందించబడ్డ ఆడియో సినిమా మీకోసం.

kashi-ka-yuddh-mandir-tootane-ki-kahani.title: Kashi Ka Yuddh : Mandir Tootane Ki Kahani
kashi-ka-yuddh-mandir-tootane-ki-kahani.description: Yeh audiobook aapko le chalegi Kashi Vishwanath Mandir ki virasat ke safar par, jahan ye mandir barbaadi se uttha aur dobara virasat ka adhar bana. Abhi suniye is pracheen mandir ke tootne aur phir se banane ki kahani sirf Kuku FM par.

neyppayasam.title: നെയ്പ്പായസം
neyppayasam.description: സുമംഗല എന്ന കുട്ടികളുടെ പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട എഴുത്തുകാരി രചിച്ച നീണ്ട കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരമാണിത്. ഓരോ കഥയിലൂടെയും കുട്ടികൾക്ക് വായനയുടെ ആനന്ദവും ജീവിതപാഠങ്ങളും സമ്മാനിക്കുന്ന ഈ സമാഹാരം, ചെറുപ്രായക്കാരുടെ ഭാവനാലോകത്തെ വികസിപ്പിക്കാൻ സഹായിക്കും.

sivappu-iravu.title: சிவப்பு இரவு
sivappu-iravu.description: ஆக்டிங் ட்ரைவராக டாக்ஸி ஓட்டும் முத்துக்குமார் ஒரு பயணியை ஏற்றிக்கொண்டு போகும்போது நிகழும் ஒரு குற்ற நிகழ்வில் மாட்டிக்கொள்கிறான். மறுநாள் காலை பொழுது விடிவதற்குள் முத்துக்குமார் அந்த சிவப்பு இரவிலிருந்து எப்படி தப்பித்தான்? கேளுங்கள்.

Shani-Dev-कर्मो-के-देवता.title: Shani Dev: कर्मों के देवता
Shani-Dev-कर्मो-के-देवता.description: Hum sabki taqdeer ki chaabi Shanidev ke haathon mein hai! Is show ko suniye aur janiye, kaise bhale ya bure, har insaan ko milta hai uske karmo ka sahi hisaab. Yeh khel kabse chal raha hai aur kyun? Aur agar bure karm kiye hain, toh kya bachaav ka raasta hai? Milega har jawab karmfal dene wale Shanidev ki is kahani mein, jo aapki soch ko hila kar rakh degi!

bad-cop-and-the-bastards.title: Bad Cop and The Bastards
bad-cop-and-the-bastards.description: హైదరాబాద్ లో వరుసగా  యువకులు అనుమానస్పదంగా చనిపోతున్నారు. ఆ కేసు investigation, అసిస్టెంట్ కమిషనర్ అయిన అరవింద్ టేక్ అప్ చేస్తాడు. కొన్ని సంవత్సరాల క్రితం ఇలాంటి తరహా హత్యల్లో అరెస్ట్ అయి, శిక్ష అనుభవించిన దుర్గాప్రసాద్, చంద్రశేఖర్ అనే ఇద్దరు పాత క్రిమినల్స్ సహాయంతో ఎలా ఇన్వెస్టిగేషన్ చేస్తున్నాడో తెలియాలంటే ఈ ఇన్వెస్టిగేషన్ క్రైమ్ థ్రిల్లర్ స్టోరీ వినండి.

chandrakanta-santati-book-2.title: Chandrakanta : 2
chandrakanta-santati-book-2.description: Ek shaahi prem kahani jo aapko le jaayegi jaadoo aur sainik ranjneeti ki duniya mein. Chandrakanta aur Virendra Singh ka pyaar kaise talwaar aur jaadoo ke beech apni raah banata hai? Is thrilling kahani ke har mod ka anand lene ke liye abhi suniye!

21-fantastic-failures-1.title: 21 Fantastic Failures
21-fantastic-failures-1.description: നിങ്ങൾക്കറിയാമോ? ലോകപ്രശസ്തരായ 21 വ്യക്തികൾ എങ്ങനെയാണ് പരാജയത്തിൽ നിന്ന് അസാധാരണ വിജയം കൈവരിച്ചതെന്ന്? "21 ഫാന്റാസ്റ്റിക് ഫെയിലിയേഴ്സ്" നിങ്ങളെ ആ രഹസ്യത്തിലേക്ക് കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നു!  കല, കായികരംഗം, ശാസ്ത്രം,  സിനിമ -  എന്നിങ്ങനെ സകല മേഖലകളിലും നിന്നുള്ള ഈ പ്രതിഭകൾ എങ്ങനെയാണ്  ഏറ്റവും വലിയ തിരിച്ചടികളെ തങ്ങളുടെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ വിജയങ്ങളാക്കി മാറ്റിയതെന്ന് ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

black-beauty-2.title: Black Beauty
black-beauty-2.description: തൻ്റെ കറുപ്പ്  നിറത്തിൻ്റെ പേരിൽ എന്നും തഴയപ്പെട്ട ലക്ഷ്മി, അപ്രതീക്ഷിതമായി കുടുംബ സ്വത്തിന്റെ ഏക അവകാശിയായി തീരുന്നു. കുടുംബത്തിൽ പിന്നീട് അരങ്ങേറുന്ന  വഞ്ചന, പ്രതികാരം, നിയമയുദ്ധങ്ങൾ എന്നിവയി നിന്നും അവളെ  രക്ഷിക്കാൻ അപ്രതീക്ഷിത സഹായികൾ എത്തുന്നു.  അവൾക്ക് കൈവന്ന  സമ്പത്ത് യഥാർത്ഥത്തിൽ അനുഗ്രഹമോ അതോ അപകടകരമായ ഗൂഢാലോചനയോ? അറിയാഅനായി കേൾക്കൂ..

unbroken-indrani-mukerjea-ki-ankahi-kaha.title: Unbroken: Indrani Mukerjea Ki Ankahi Kahani
unbroken-indrani-mukerjea-ki-ankahi-kaha.description: Kya hua tha us din jab headlines bane, rumours chale, aur ek naam har zubaan par tha - Indrani Mukerjea? Us din ki sachchai aur uske peeche ki kahani aapko sunne milegi is audio show mein. Murder accusations, scandal, aur 2460 din jail - yeh kahani hai ek aisi aurat ki jo har mushkil ke baad bhi rahi 'Unbroken.'

kolai.title: Kolai
kolai.description: A Detective with Asperger's Syndrome is set out to solve blood chilled murder cases.

పైడితల్లి-సిరిమానోత్సవం.title: పైడితల్లి సిరిమానోత్సవం
పైడితల్లి-సిరిమానోత్సవం.description: పైడిమాంబ తల్లి ఉత్సవ విశేషాలు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? పైడిమాంబ తల్లికి విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య రాజులకు అసలు సంబంధం ఏమిటి ? మీ ప్రశ్నలు అన్నిటికీ సమాధానాలను "పైడితల్లి సిరిమానోత్సవం" ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

चाल-पे-चाल.title: Dangerous Trap
चाल-पे-चाल.description: New York ke mashhoor jasoos Dave Fanner ke daftar par ek behad khoobsurat ladki aayi, jisne apni bahan ko dhoondhne ke liye use 6 hazaar dollar diye aur phir gayab ho gayi. Uske kuchh hi der baad Fanner par hamla hua aur uske daftar mein kisi ne laash plant kar di. Ek chalak jasoos hone ke bawajood, Fanner is case mein khud ko fasa hua mehsoos kar raha tha. Kya woh is case ko solve kar paayega ? Jaane ke liye suniye poori kahani !

జాంబవంతుడు.title: జాంబవంతుడు
జాంబవంతుడు.description: పురాణాల్లో ప్రసిద్ధమైన ఎలుగుబంటి రాజు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే "జాంబవంతుడు" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

చాకలి-ఐలమ్మ-.title: చాకలి ఐలమ్మ
చాకలి-ఐలమ్మ-.description: తెలంగాణ రైతాంగ పోరాటంలో వీర వనితగా గుర్తింపు పొందిన "చాకలి ఐలమ్మ" జీవిత చరిత్రను ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

patna-police-affair.title: Patna Police Affair
patna-police-affair.description: "Patna ki chamak ke parde ke peeche chhupi hai ek kahani, jahan mohabbat hai, dhokha hai aur khaufnaak saazish ka jaal. Naina aur Ravi ke bepanah pyaar ne unhein Vijay Chaudhary ki taqat se takra diya. Ek rishte ki sulagti aag, ek khaufnaak khel, jahan pyaar bhi hai aur badla bhi. Kya yeh kahani mohabbat ki jeet hogi ya saazish ki haar?"

అమృతవర్షిణి--మొగుడే-రెండో-ప్రియుడు.title: అమృతవర్షిణి - మొగుడే రెండో ప్రియుడు
అమృతవర్షిణి--మొగుడే-రెండో-ప్రియుడు.description: "పురాణాలలో, పుస్తకాలలో స్త్రీలకోసం ఇద్దరు పురుషులు తన్నుకోవడం చూసి ప్రతి స్త్రీ అటువంటి పరిస్థితిలో తనని ఊహించుకుని కలలు కని ఆనందించవచ్చు. కానీ నిజ జీవితంలో జరిగితే భరించడం దుర్భరం. అమృత నిస్సహాయంగా వారిద్దరి వైపూ చూస్తోంది ఒకరు తను ప్రేమించిన ప్రియుడు ఇంకొకరు తనిప్పుడు ప్రేమిస్తున్న మొగుడు. తర్వాత ఏం జరిగిందో తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే "అమృతవర్షిణి - మొగుడే రెండో ప్రియుడు" అనే ఆడియో కథ వినీ తెలుసుకోండి.

sanak-1.title: SANAK
sanak-1.description: Khoon se sookhi mil rahi Dead Bodies. Is khaunfanak case ko suljhane nikli Inspector Shivi jo khud ban gayi ek serial killer ka shikar. Kaun hai ye Hatyara? Insaan ya Pishach? Janne ke liye sune Sanak.

sapiens-a-brief-history-of-humankind-3.title: సేపియన్స్ మానవ జాతి పరిణామ క్రమం సంక్షిప్త చరిత్ర
sapiens-a-brief-history-of-humankind-3.description: ప్రాథమిక ప్రాణుల నుండి ఆధునిక సమాజాల వరకు మనిషి పరిణామాన్ని గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? మూడు ప్రధాన విప్లవాలు - జ్ఞానవిప్లవం, వ్యవసాయ విప్లవం, శాస్త్ర విప్లవం - మానవ అభివృద్ధిని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేశాయి ? మనుషుల ఆవిర్భావం, సామాజిక నిర్మాణాలు, ధర్మం, సాంకేతికతలు, శాస్త్రవిజ్ఞానం వంటి అంశాలు "సేపియన్స్ మానవ జాతి పరిణామ క్రమం సంక్షిప్త చరిత్ర " అనే ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండ

jarigina-katha.title: జరిగిన కథ
jarigina-katha.description: 'జరిగిన కథ' ఆడియో పుస్తకం లో మల్లాది వెంకట కృష్ణమూర్తి  రచయిత అవడానికి స్ఫూర్తి ఏమిటి? అనే విషయాన్ని వివరించారు. అంతే కాకుండా ఆయన రచనలు ప్రచురించబడ్డ వివిధ దిన, వార, పక్ష, మాసపత్రికల సంపాదకులతో గల అనేక పరిచయాలు, అనుభవాలు తెలియజేస్తూ రచయితగా ఆయన ఎదుర్కొన్న అనుభవాలని పాఠకుల ముందుకు నిజాయితీగా, నిర్భయంగా తీసుకొని వచ్చారు.

silk-smitha-80s-ki-bold-sensation.title: Silk Smitha: 80s Ki Bold Sensation
silk-smitha-80s-ki-bold-sensation.description: 80s ki screen par jo bijli si chamki, woh thi Silk Smitha! South Indian cinema ki asli bold sensation, jinki adaayein aur dance moves ne sabko deewana bana diya. Is show mein jaanein, kaise Vijayalakshmi bani Silk, aur 450+ filmon mein apni chaap chhodte hue ek icon ban gayi. Suniye unki kahani, jo hai glamorous bhi aur tragic bhi!

pelli-koduku.title: పెళ్ళి కొడుకు
pelli-koduku.description: రెండు భిన్న మనస్తత్వాలు కలిగిన శిరీష, సీతారాం ఇద్దరు పెళ్లి చేసుకున్నారు. పెళ్లయిన తరువాత సీతారాం, శిరీష పుట్టింటికి  వెళ్ళడానికి ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడటం లేదు? దాని వెనుక ఉన్న కారణమేంటి? ఈ మధ్య తరగతి  జంట ప్రయాణం ఎలా సాగుతుంది, ఎలాంటి మలుపులు తీసుకుంటుంది తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "పెళ్ళి కొడుకు" అనే కథను వినండి.

august-aiynthu-athikalai.title: ஆகஸ்ட் 5 அதிகாலை
august-aiynthu-athikalai.description: யார் இந்த பட்டாச்சாரியார்? இவ்வளவு பெரிய சம்பவத்தை செய்தது யார்? கேளுங்கள் பிரபல கிரைம் கதை மன்னன் ராஜேஷ் குமார் எழுதிய  "ஆகஸ்ட் 5 அதிகாலை" உங்கள் Kuku FM-இல்.

chandrakanta-3.title: Chandrakanta : 1
chandrakanta-3.description: Ek shaahi prem kahani jo aapko le jaayegi jaadoo aur sainik ranjneeti ki duniya mein. Chandrakanta aur Virendra Singh ka pyaar kaise talwaar aur jaadoo ke beech apni raah banata hai? Is thrilling kahani ke har mod ka anand lene ke liye abhi suniye!

maaya-vizhigal.title: மாய விழிகள்
maaya-vizhigal.description: ஒருவரின் முகத்தில் கண்களே பிரதானம். அது சகலத்தையும் கூறிவிடும். சில கண்கள் வசீகரிக்கும். சில மயக்கி சாய்த்துவிடும். அப்படி ஒரு கண்களை கொண்ட ஒரு பாத்திரத்தின் சாகசங்களை கொண்டதே இந்த புதினம்.

how-to-stop-worrying.title: How to Stop Worrying and Start Living
how-to-stop-worrying.description: Worry - appadi nu sonna udane list of vishayangal namma ellaroda life la yumm irukum. Worry appadi nra indha vaarthai ah namma life la irundhu delete pannitu eppadi life happy ah vaazhalam appadi nradhukkana oru vazhi kaati dhan indha book. Indha book oda mudivula neenga all is well  nu definite ah feel pannuveenga so happy listening..!

kalluri-kaadhal-kadhai.title: kalluri Kaadhal kadhai
kalluri-kaadhal-kadhai.description: A wealthy businessman marries the woman he loves, only to discover she doesn't share his feelings. They strike a secret deal to pose as friends in college for two years—if she falls for him by then, they'll stay married; if not, they’ll go their separate ways.

takshak-the-gods-venom.title: Takshak: The God's Venom
takshak-the-gods-venom.description: Kavya ko dhundhte huye Manas Malhar ke jungalon mein pahunch chuka hai, jahan uski mulakat hoti hai Trisha se. Par Trisha, Manas ke liye kisi rahasya se kam nahi hai. Ishani bhi Raghav ki maut ka pata lagane Malhar pahunchi hai. Par Malhar apne nag-manav se pareshan hai. Kaun hai ye nag-manav? mr-and-mrs-agent.description: ఏజెంట్ ఆర్యన్ తను చేసిన పొరపాటు వల్ల ఒక చిన్న పాపా ప్రాణం పోతుంది, అతని వృత్తి కూడా వదిలేసి సొంత ఊరు బెజవాడ కు వెళ్ళిపోతాడు ,  కానీ విచిత్రం ఏంటంటే అతనికి పెళ్లి జరిగేది కూడ ఒక secret agent, ఆమె నికిత, ఆమె ఎలా అయినా సరే బెజవాడ నుంచి drugs supply చేస్తున్న వాళ్ళని పట్టుకోవాలి అని ఎదురు చూస్తుంది .  వీళ్లిద్దరి ప్రేమ ప్రయాణం ఇంకెన్ని విధ్వంసాలు సృష్టిస్తుందో తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో.

Kiske naam se shuru hua ye tournament? Kya contribution tha unka Indian cricket mein? Janne ke liye sunein Ranji...

balachita-chakra-ki-adbhut-gatha.title: Balachita Ki Adbhut Gatha
balachita-chakra-ki-adbhut-gatha.description: Sheshnaag ke avatar, Daau Balraam ka astra Balachita ! Jise unke siva kisi ne dharan nahi kiya. Isse rok di gayi puri nadi aur maare gaye asur! my-inventions-autobiography-of-nikola-te.title: My Inventions : Autobiography of Nikola Tesla
my-inventions-autobiography-of-nikola-te.description: Electrical Engineering la Pala kandupidippugala kandupidicha Inventor "Nikola Tesla" ⚡🌍 avaroda kandupidippugal pathi ezhuthuna "My Inventions"  Book in Audio vadivam idhu🔊

law-of-love-2.title: Law of Love
law-of-love-2.description: A determined young woman battles betrayal, love, and family chaos while seeking justice for her imprisoned father. As her world collides with her legal aid’s ambition and deceit, buried secrets begin to surface. In a web of lies and emotions, every choice draws her closer to redemption—or ruin.

dangerous-dad-5.title: Dangerous Dad
dangerous-dad-5.description:
By day, he’s a humble cleaner. By night, he’s Ghost—the ruthless syndicate head feared across the underworld.
When he saves a wealthy woman from a predator, his hidden world collides with his personal life, even as he conceals the truth from his own son.
Now, every step forward is a battle against enemies, betrayal, and the impossible balance between fatherhood and vengeance.

oops-not-a-gold-digger-1.title: Oops , Not A Gold Digger
oops-not-a-gold-digger-1.description: A compassionate young woman, Disha, initially prioritizes her career but is drawn into the determined matchmaking efforts of an elderly woman, Paati, for her grandson, Vicky. A life-threatening financial crisis for Disha's ailing sister forces her into a marriage of convenience with Vicky, orchestrated by the cunning Paati. This arrangement is complicated by a suspicious relative and the revelation of Vicky's true identity as Vikram, a powerful corporate heir and CEO. Disha, unaware of his full dual role, also begins working at the same company, where she faces professional rivalry and unjust accusations. As Disha navigates her new life, she rises professionally, but her success is shadowed by Vikram, who, while attentive, deliberately conceals his true identity and wealth, secretly monitoring her for an enigmatic "Boss." Their complex romance is further complicated by corporate intrigue, including a ruthless boss Diya, whom Vikram had previously fired, and accusations of seduction. Disha's journey takes dramatic turns as she is publicly humiliated and fired, only for a mysterious, powerful man to gift her a "golden card," reversing her fortune and thrusting her into high society. Here, she faces classist taunts and accusations, particularly regarding a disputed heirloom and her connection to "Boss Paati." It is revealed that her supposed driver husband, Vikrant, is actually the powerful CEO Vikram/Siddharth, living a double life driven by protectiveness for her, though Disha herself is shown to have manipulative schemes. Their secret marriage is threatened by Diya's possessiveness and Vikram's persistent ex-lover, Roma, who seeks to expose his deception. Roma publicly exposes their marriage, leading to Disha's heartbreak over Vikrant's concealed wealth and a demand for divorce. The rivalry intensifies when Roma kidnaps Disha, forcing Vikrant to publicly announce an engagement to Roma to save his wife. In a defiant act of love, Vikrant transfers all his assets to Disha, enraging Roma, who then orders Disha's elimination, leaving their intertwined lives in deadly peril.

the-olympic-generation-of-ball-gods.title: The Olympic generation of ball gods
the-olympic-generation-of-ball-gods.description: An inspiring sports drama that follows a new generation of young athletes determined to bring glory to their nation. Through sweat, rivalry, and unbreakable friendship, they chase Olympic dreams—proving that champions aren’t born, they’re made on the field.

gaonwala-baap-crorepati.title: Gaonwala Baap Crorepati
gaonwala-baap-crorepati.description: “When a city-bred girl discovers her long-lost father is a simple village farmer, her world of luxury and pride crashes into his world of values and honesty. Through laughter, tears, and love, both learn what family truly means beyond money and class.”

cursed-by-love.title: Cursed By Love
cursed-by-love.description: Vaishnavi, a devoted woman, faces heartbreak when her husband betrays and abandons her. But beneath her sorrow lies a shocking truth she is a wealthy heir and a genius ready to reclaim her power. As she rises from humiliation, fate brings her to Vikranth Desai, a commanding CEO who treats her with unmatched devotion. Unlike her cruel past, he showers her with love and respect, standing by her side as she exposes enemies and seeks justice.

oops-not-a-gold-digger.title: Oops, Not A Gold Digger
oops-not-a-gold-digger.description: Watch family entertainment show 'Oops, Not A Gold Digger'. Only on KukuTV

red-corridor.title: Red Corridor
red-corridor.description: A mysterious housekeeper, Rohit, endures extreme humiliation and classism from the affluent Batra family, particularly Siddhant and Simran, as part of a deep undercover operation. His true mission is to expose a vast criminal enterprise, including black money schemes and corporate corruption, orchestrated by powerful figures like Rohit Batra. Central to his personal stakes is the critically ill child, Myra, who is secretly his daughter, and whose survival becomes intertwined with his dangerous mission. Rohit, also known by aliases like Atul and Arjun, is haunted by past failures involving 'Ananya,' intensifying his resolve to protect Myra. As Myra's condition deteriorates, Rohit is forced to reveal surprising medical expertise, sparking intense suspicion from his embittered ex-wife, Anisha, and Dr. Sahiba, who seek to uncover his true identity. The Batra family, including Ravi Sharma, unleashes violent tirades and attempts to frame Atul for theft, while Simran Batra makes seductive advances, all of which he navigates with a hidden agenda. Myra's critical need for a heart transplant propels Atul into a desperate, high-stakes race against time, facing treacherous conditions, a broken bridge, and a devastating fire. He defies expectations with superhuman skills, orchestrating an unprecedented open-air heart surgery to save her life. Atul Yadav dramatically reveals his true identity as an undercover Anti-Corruption Bureau officer, exposing an 8,400 crore money laundering operation and implicating his ex-wife. A violent confrontation ensues as he attempts to arrest corrupt power broker Rohit Batra and his wife. Despite achieving a significant victory against corruption and saving Myra, a shocking betrayal and the emergence of a new, menacing threat indicate that his fight for justice and personal redemption is far from over.

shattered-bonds-1.title: Shattered Bonds
shattered-bonds-1.description: Watch family entertainment show 'Shattered Bonds'. Only on KukuTV

engineer-vs-billionaires.title: Engineer vs Billionaires
engineer-vs-billionaires.description: When a massive storm traps a ruthless billionaire and a humble engineer in a race against time, greed and conscience collide. As disaster looms over the Himalayan valley, one man’s arrogance meets another’s courage. From boardrooms to broken dams, Engineer vs Billionaires is a high-octane survival drama where nature takes revenge, power is tested, and redemption comes at the cost of pride.

return-of-the-rightful-heir.title: Enga Veetu Pillai
return-of-the-rightful-heir.description: 20 varushathukku munnadi tholanju pona paiyana kashta pattu kandupidikuraaru oru CEO. But anga oru twist nadakkuthu. Ipdi twist mela twist neranja drama thaan ithu.

queen-mom-vs-toxic-family.title: Queen Mom vs Toxic Family
queen-mom-vs-toxic-family.description: A Single Punjabi mother, scorned by her in-laws, rises with her three sons, only to confront betrayal, hidden truths, and her husband’s shocking return, as she reclaims her dignity and destiny. Watch now!

overcoming-obstacles-counterattack-of-tw.title: Overcoming Obstacles: Counterattack of Twin Babies
overcoming-obstacles-counterattack-of-tw.description: Born into hardship, a pair of twin babies grow up plotting to reclaim the life stolen from them. In this twist-filled story, innocence becomes the sharpest weapon for revenge.

desperate-cage-miss-sun-fights-back-4.title: Desperate Cage; Miss Sun Fights Back
desperate-cage-miss-sun-fights-back-4.description:
When a young woman’s pregnancy is revealed, her in-laws humiliate her and attempt to call off the wedding.
But her partner stands by her side, shielding her from shame and choosing love over judgment.
A heartfelt journey of courage, compassion, and the promise of unconditional support.

tere-pyar-mein.title: Tere Pyar Mein
tere-pyar-mein.description: A passionate artist, Needhi, and billionaire Nishchay — once lovers separated by deceit — reunite years later when fate brings them face to face through art. Hidden truths, betrayal, and redemption unfold as they discover their lost daughter and confront their manipulative past. The story ends with forgiveness, justice, and the family finally finding peace and love again. Watch now.

dragon-arm-2.title: Dragon Arm
dragon-arm-2.description:
A legendary warrior bears a cursed dragon arm that holds the power to either save or doom the world.
As kingdoms clash and betrayal brews, his quest for justice becomes a battle for destiny itself.
Revenge, magic, and fate intertwine in this epic saga of power and sacrifice.

kangaal-aur-karodpati.title: Kangaal Karodpati
kangaal-aur-karodpati.description: Arjun, a powerful CEO, is diagnosed with a terminal illness, leading to the appearance of Lara, a mysterious healer whose unconventional methods miraculously cure him. A public scandal then forces Arjun's powerful mother to arrange a marriage of convenience between Arjun and Lara to protect their family and corporate empire. This fragile union is immediately challenged by Arjun's fiercely protective mother and his scorned ex-fiancée, Isha, who vows revenge and attempts to dismantle the marriage. As Lara, an outsider, navigates family secrets and power struggles, Arjun fiercely protects her, hinting at a burgeoning romance. Their bond deepens through subsequent mysterious illnesses and a jealous rival's sabotage, with Lara's unwavering devotion proving crucial. Lara's manipulative estranged father reappears, and her powerful Chief mother, Maa, demands Lara embrace her tribal destiny, leading Arjun to face perilous tribal trials to prove his worth. Lara makes a desperate sacrifice, transferring a dark curse from Arjun to herself, solidifying their fated connection amidst supernatural forces. Their intense connection is further tested by the birth of their child, whose paternity Isha dramatically questions, leading to family confrontation and the child's abduction by Anjana. Maa, a formidable matriarch, claims the newborn for her ancient lineage, sparking a clash, and Arjun faces rigged "impossible tests." Lara is shockingly accused of poisoning Arjun, but he dramatically defends her, even banishing his own mother. Lara's manipulative mother orchestrates a loyalty test for Arjun, and their relationship is strained by ancient rituals, a black magic scandal, and a media storm. A shocking paternity test reveals Arjun is not the biological father of a child, shattering his world and prompting him to confront Isha, whom he suspects of profound betrayal. Despite these trials, Lara is falsely accused and banished, but Arjun becomes her unwavering protector. Anjana, Lara's mother, orchestrates a final "test" involving the abduction of their infant child, which ultimately affirms Arjun and Lara's mutual support. Arjun miraculously recovers from ALS, a cure attributed to the mystical "Rakht-kamal" and their enduring love. Isha attempts to blackmail Arjun about the supernatural truth behind his recovery, while also facing her own cursed fate. Ultimately, Arjun and Lara are entrusted with the mystical "Rakt Kamal beej," whose survival is linked to the emotional harmony of their home, and their profound love is miraculously affirmed by its blooming and the joyous arrival of their child, contrasting with Isha's inescapable suffering.

where-is-home-6.title: Where is Home
where-is-home-6.description:
An accidental identity swap sets off a chain of betrayal, love lost, and revenge.
Years later, the past resurfaces, forcing old secrets into the light.
In this web of lies and redemption, no one escapes unchanged.

eternal-yogi.title: Eternal Yogi
eternal-yogi.description: “Eternal Yogi” follows Gautam, an immortal yogi,  reunites with his lost love "Sunaina" , after 1200 years. Who Now reincarnated as Dr. Janvi Kapoor. Amid divine forces and demonic threats, he battles Kaalroop to protect both love and humanity. The saga ends with evil’s destruction and the lovers’ eternal union beyond time. Watch now.

small-town-mindset-se-kaise-nikle.title: Small Town Mindset Se Kaise Nikle?
small-town-mindset-se-kaise-nikle.description: Small Town Mindset Se Kaise Nikle?

solo-dance-on-glass-shoes-4.title: Solo Dance on Glass Shoes
solo-dance-on-glass-shoes-4.description: In a ruthless corporate jungle, a gifted woman hides her deepest scars while chasing impossible dreams. Love, rivalry, and betrayal twist her path, making every step feel like walking on fragile glass. Will her courage carry her to triumph—or shatter everything she’s built?

my-beautiful-warrior.title: My Beautiful Warrior
my-beautiful-warrior.description: A captivating romantic action drama where a fearless female fighter crosses paths with a man hiding a dangerous secret. Between battles, betrayal, and burning passion, they discover that love can be the strongest weapon of all.

lapras.title: Lapras
lapras.description: Jiya, a devoted wife, endures immense hardship as her national hero husband, John, lies critically ill, requiring costly medical treatment. Her unwavering love is tested by financial despair, family estrangement, and the tragic, secret sacrifice of her father, who died working to fund John's care. Five years after a national conflict, Jiya secretly nurses John back to health, but his survival attracts dangerous attention from shadowy figures and a mysterious antagonist. She confronts Puneet, a powerful businessman whose family is linked to her father's death and a colossal debt, and who demands an indecent personal sacrifice from Jiya. The situation escalates into violence and abduction, forcing Jiya into a perilous fight for justice and her husband's life, with a determined Man 2 intervening in a high-stakes car chase. John, initially incapacitated, is targeted by a ruthless antagonist who manipulates public perception and wields significant power, attempting to discredit him as a 'fake hero' and traitor. Despite these efforts, John is revealed to possess hidden capabilities, a powerful identity as a 'Young Master' and 'Disabled CEO,' and is a legendary 'Master hero' protecting his family's ancient legacy. A defiant Jiya, also known as Miss Jia, fiercely defends John, intervening physically and publicly to protect him from accusations of national betrayal and illicit wealth. John's father desperately pleads for his son's life amidst these grave treason accusations, which are investigated by Inspector Anuj. After his five-year recovery from a severe war injury, John returns with renewed power, determined to seek justice and vengeance against his enemies. He confronts the antagonist, who now controls a city and serves a powerful syndicate, setting the stage for a high-stakes battle. The narrative also explores the mystery of John's true heroic identity, as war survivors clash over their rescuer and a jade pendant hints at powerful families involved. Ultimately, the show depicts a relentless struggle to clear John's name, re-establish his true heroic status, and protect his family's honor against a formidable, vengeful empire.

with-3-months-left-miss-gu-let-herself-g.title: With 3 months left , Miss Gu let herself go
with-3-months-left-miss-gu-let-herself-g.description:
Told she has only months to live, a woman breaks free from her corporate cage and dares to live unapologetically.
But fate twists cruelly—her diagnosis was wrong, her secret husband resurfaces, and her ruthless boss strikes back.
Miss Gu Let Herself Go is a bold, emotional ride of love, betrayal, and reclaiming dignity before it’s too late.

my-double-life-1.title: Mi Doble Vida
my-double-life-1.description: “Double Life” es un drama sobre Kiara y Aryan. Primero, Kiara se divorció de Aryan, pero con el tiempo ambos vuelven a enamorarse. Sin embargo, Sid aparece como la persona que se interpone entre ellos, junto con otra chica que también complica su relación.

pyaar-aur-andhera.title: Dhokhe Se mohabbat
pyaar-aur-andhera.description: “A blind girl and a scarred gangster find unexpected love in each other’s darkness, but their past sins and enemies threaten to tear them apart. Between betrayal, revenge, and redemption, their love becomes both their curse and salvation.”

billionaire-ki-wapasi.title: Billionaire Ki Wapasi
billionaire-ki-wapasi.description: এটি এমন একজন কোটিপতির গল্প, যিনি একসময় নিজের পরিচয় ও সম্পদ হারিয়ে ফেলেছিলেন এবং এখন নিজের বাড়িতে ফিরে এসেছেন। ফিরে এসে তিনি অতীতের স্মৃতি ও মানুষের মুখোমুখি হন। সিরিজটি দেখায়, কীভাবে তিনি হারানো মর্যাদা ফিরে পেতে সংগ্রাম করেন এবং জীবনের ঘটনাগুলোকে সমাধান করেন।

hidden-power-reloaded.title: Bewakoof Billionaire
hidden-power-reloaded.description: Meera brings an injured amnesiac, Ishan, home, igniting family conflict as her grandfather declares him her fated soulmate, while her father fears for their reputation. Pressured into an arranged marriage to save her family from corporate ruin, Meera plans a strategic alliance with CEO Advait, who harbors sinister intentions towards Ishan. After a brutal attack separates him from Meera, Ishan awakens seven years later with his memories restored, fueled by vengeance against powerful figures. He defiantly crashes Meera's wedding and high-society events, claiming her as his wife and challenging the Rathore and Singhania families. The narrative then plunges into a complex web of corporate power struggles, with Advait and the Rathores vying for dominance, and ancient rivalries intertwining with spiritual conflicts between Anand Maharaj and Mahant Vaidyanath. Ishan emerges as a mysterious healer, offering miraculous cures for ailments like 'Ice-Venom,' but his unconventional methods draw accusations of malpractice and attempted murder from figures like Dr. Sharma and Mr. Raghunath Suryavanshi. Despite facing demands for his execution, Ishan is protected by loyal allies, hinting at a deeper destiny. He begins to challenge established authorities, claiming to be the 'Infinite Lord' and audaciously usurping a sacred seat, drawing the ire of institutions like Anant Dham and powerful figures such as Lalita Devi. Ishan demonstrates unprecedented power, even transferring abilities to others and dismissing formidable opponents, leading to accusations of fraud and sacrilege. He disrupts a sacred ceremony, steals a powerful pendant, and shockingly reveals he taught the revered Param Guru. Ultimately, Ishan is exposed as a cunning spy who infiltrated a family to sabotage a sacred festival, drawing the wrath of traditional guardians like Vaibhav Suryavanshi. Maharaj Anant delivers swift justice, imprisoning those who sought forgiveness, while Ishan's wife, Amrita, questions his mysterious past and true identity, leaving his ultimate nature and destiny uncertain.

mom-of-three-billionaires.title: Mom of three Billionaires
mom-of-three-billionaires.description:
ఒంటరిగా ముగ్గురు విజయవంతమైన బిలియనీర్లను పెంచిన తల్లి, తండ్రి జన్మదినం కోసం తన ఇంటికి తిరిగి వస్తుంది.
అక్కడ ఆమె జీవన నిర్ణయాలపై, సింగిల్ మదర్‌గా ఉన్నందుకు బంధువుల విమర్శలు, అవమానాలు ఎదుర్కొంటుంది.
ఆమె ధైర్యం, సంకల్పంతో ఆ విషపూరిత వాతావరణాన్ని ఎదుర్కొని, తన సంతోషానికి కొత్త మార్గాన్ని కనుగొంటుంది.

mom-i-am-back.title: Mom I Am Back
mom-i-am-back.description: An emotional family drama about a child who returns home after years of separation, carrying pain, guilt, and unspoken love. As old wounds reopen, a mother’s unconditional love becomes the bridge that heals what time and distance could not.

a-double-heart.title: Sillunu Oru Kaadhal
a-double-heart.description: The microdrama centers on Akash, a man plagued by severe anger issues and violent outbursts, often directed at his partner, Aarthi, due to his intolerance for perceived dishonesty. Despite enduring a harrowing cycle of abuse and apologies, Aarthi's unwavering loyalty, rooted in Akash's past protection, compels her to seek help for him rather than leave. She devises a deceptive plan to guide him towards professional mental health assistance, a journey Akash reluctantly commits to after an ultimatum from his family. Through intensive therapy, including hypnotherapy, Akash begins to confront his destructive temper and unearths memories of an abusive past relationship and a traumatic childhood incident linked to his aversion to lies. His therapy deepens into profound past-life regression, revealing a tragic romance between Latha and Anand, marked by doubt, betrayal, and Latha's eventual suicide due to false accusations. Akash becomes convinced he is Latha, consumed by her vengeful spirit, and begins to target individuals in his present life, including Aarthi, believing them to be Lakshmi, the past-life rival responsible for Latha's heartbreak. A parallel narrative unfolds with a young Lakshmi, whose obsessive love for her uncle mirrors the ancient karmic entanglement, as she vows to separate a modern-day couple, Sanjay and Latha. As Akash's condition worsens, his doctor uncle investigates the intertwined destinies and hidden family secrets, revealing a complex web of love, betrayal, and vengeance spanning lifetimes. The past-life narrative further details Latha and Anand's love, challenged by Lakshmi's claims and false accusations from Velu, leading to Latha's disappearance and Anand's despair. It is revealed that Akash is indeed possessed by Latha's vengeful spirit, a karmic retribution for past-life cruelties. Ultimately, Akash's regression uncovers Aarthi's own past persona, who, as Lakshmi, orchestrated and concealed Latha's orchestrated death. Aarthi's uncle warns her of a fated reckoning, urging her to confess and appease Latha's spirit. Despite these profound and challenging revelations, Akash credits Aarthi with helping him confront his inner demons. Their modern romance, though tested by past relationships and the lingering shadows of their intertwined destinies, blossoms as they navigate themes of love, betrayal, and the arduous path to forgiveness across lifetimes, suggesting a potential for karmic resolution.

batwara-2.title: Batwara
batwara-2.description: After 40 years of honest service as a railway ticket checker, a father’s retirement celebration turns bitter when his biological children abandon him and his wife. Humiliated and heartbroken, he finds strength in his adopted son and a forgotten book of poems that reveal the true meaning of love. A deeply emotional saga of sacrifice, betrayal, and the priceless bond that defines what family truly is.

gareeb-dil-billionaire.title: Layak Nalayak
gareeb-dil-billionaire.description: 2 Bete, Same Parvarish, Different outcome. One is representation of Lord Ram and other completely opposite.

baby-on-board-3.title: Baby on Board
baby-on-board-3.description: Watch family entertainment show 'Baby on Board'. Only on KukuTV

revenge-of-chanakya.title: Revenge Of Chanakya
revenge-of-chanakya.description: When visionary executive Ravi Kashyap is betrayed by his corrupt CEO Nakul Mehta and abandoned by his wife Shanaya, his world collapses. But a chance encounter with delivery boy Chandra Gupta reignites his fire. Guided by the ancient wisdom of Chanakya Neeti, Ravi transforms himself into a modern day Chanakya building an empire from ashes to take ruthless revenge on those who destroyed him.

the-final-betrayal-3.title: The Final Betrayal
the-final-betrayal-3.description: Disguised as a humble beggar, CEO Shiva plots revenge against his betrayers, but his mission is complicated when he falls for the kind-hearted Sneha. Sneha's world shatters when her fiancé, Pranav, betrays her with her sister, Nanditha, leading to public humiliation and financial ruin. Shiva intervenes, defending Sneha, and proposes a contract marriage to fulfill her father's wish, drawing her into his mysterious world. As their relationship evolves, Sneha grapples with Shiva's dramatic transformation and hidden past, while her grandmother suspects his true identity as a missing billionaire CEO. Their pretense is challenged by public humiliation from Pranav and Nanditha, who mock Sneha's perceived poverty. Shiva dramatically reveals his hidden wealth, stunning everyone and sparking accusations, but his heartfelt confession of love begins to win over Sneha's family. Their romance deepens, but escalating threats from Pranav, Nanditha, and Sneha's vengeful ex-lover, Rohan, test their bond. Shiva fiercely protects Sneha, even after a car accident gravely injures him, secretly orchestrating dangerous operations from his hospital bed to shield her from his double life. The conflict culminates over a wedding venue, where Shiva, now fully revealed as a powerful CEO, acquires the entire property, humiliating his rivals. Sneha feels deeply betrayed by Shiva's hidden identity and secrets, leading to a crisis of trust. Shiva confesses his elaborate deception was born from fear of losing her due to his wealth, expressing his profound love. The show culminates in Shiva's emotional ultimatum to Sneha, her heartfelt acceptance, and their joyous traditional Indian wedding, solidifying their bond amidst family blessings. The stakes involve Shiva's quest for revenge, Sneha's healing from betrayal, and the ultimate test of trust and love against societal pressures and dangerous pasts.

രാമായണം-1.title: രാമായണം
രാമായണം-1.description: When King Dashrath declares Ram as heir, Kaikeyi and Manthara’s deceit sends him into 14 years of exile. Joined by Sita and Lakshman, Ram’s journey of sacrifice, devotion, and dharma becomes an immortal symbol of love and honor. Experience the timeless saga of faith and righteousness—immerse yourself in the devotion of Lord Ram. Watch now!

bezubaan-waris.title: Bezubaan Waris
bezubaan-waris.description: Arundhati, once heir to a grand mansion, is silenced by betrayal and forced to live as a servant while her uncle and cousin steal her life. Her only ally, Adi, hides his true identity - her childhood fiancé and a billionaire, living in disguise to protect her. Together they shatter the web of lies, awaken her lost voice, and reunite her with her father, who rises from a sixteen-year coma to see his daughter reclaim her destiny. Watch now!

shattered-bonds.title: Shattered Bonds
shattered-bonds.description: When railway ticket checker (TT/ TC) Ishwar Pratap retires after 40 years of honest service, his three biological children reveal their cruel indifference, forcing him and his devoted wife Rajni into a humiliating separation - until his adopted son Prem and a book of love poems expose the truth about family, sacrifice, and the price of unconditional love.

fakes-rich-to-marry-billionaire.title: Fakes Rich To Marry Billionaire
fakes-rich-to-marry-billionaire.description: “A poor girl pretends to be wealthy to marry a billionaire, but her lies pull her into a dangerous web of love, rivalry, and betrayal. As truth threatens to shatter her world, she must choose between survival, dignity, and true love.”

billionaires-return.title: Billionaires Return
billionaires-return.description: It's a comeback of a great billionaire

ramayana-11.title: Ramayana
ramayana-11.description: The Ramayana show brings to life the timeless epic of Lord Rama. Through powerful narration, it traces Rama’s journey as Maryada Purushottama, highlighting his unwavering commitment to dharma, the trials of exile, the fierce battles against Ravana, and the deep devotion of Hanuman. The show not only covers the well-known episodes of Sita’s Agni Pariksha and Rama’s victory over evil but also explores lesser-known characters and untold stories from the epic. Rich in cultural wisdom, sacrifice, and moral lessons, this series inspires listeners with values of courage, righteousness, and the eternal triumph of good over evil.

mahaveer.title: Mahaveer
mahaveer.description: What began as a romantic getaway turns into a nightmare of humiliation, betrayal, and hidden power. But when the tables turn, justice comes with a price - Watch now to find out!

nilavidam-vaadagai-vaangi.title: Fake Marriage on Diwali
nilavidam-vaadagai-vaangi.description: Brilliant CEO Vikram Verma, fulfilling a paternal wish, enters a world where his immense wealth is initially concealed and misunderstood. He forms a high-stakes contract marriage with desperate heiress Sara, who seeks to save her family's legacy from financial ruin and an unwanted alliance. Their deceptive union is immediately challenged by Sara's materialistic mother and the arrogant rival, Karan, who relentlessly demeans Vikram and plots to expose him as a fraud. Despite public humiliation and accusations of being a gold-digger, Vikram maintains his composure, while Sara's feelings for her contract husband deepen, leading her to fiercely defend him. Vikram slowly begins to reveal his true identity as a hidden titan of industry, culminating in dramatic confrontations and lavish displays of wealth that stun Sara's family and expose their materialistic values. This revelation shifts the dynamics, but also intensifies Karan's jealousy and desire to reclaim Sara. The narrative then plunges into a complex web of intrigue, including a reported theft, accusations of a sinister plot involving mysterious gifts, and pressure on Sara to divorce Vikram for Karan. Vikram faces abduction orchestrated by Karan, leading to an imposter, Naveen, manipulating the criminal underworld in his place. The real Vikram, after escaping captivity, unleashes his formidable power, exacting brutal retribution on his captors and revealing his awareness of a grand conspiracy involving supposed allies. He intervenes protectively during his matriarch Paatti's life-threatening crisis, further solidifying his protective role. A fierce corporate war ensues, with Vikram systematically dismantling Karan's empire through ruthless tactics, fueled by their bitter rivalry over Sara. Amidst this power struggle and the unraveling of hidden truths, Vikram, now a formidable and authoritative figure, reveals a tender side by proposing marriage to Sara, who accepts, cherishing him for more than his wealth. The show chronicles their journey from a deceptive contract to a genuine partnership, navigating family betrayals, corporate espionage, and the ultimate triumph of their bond against all odds.

murder-god.title: Murder God
murder-god.description: Watch Murder God Only on KUKU TV!

masked-magnate.title: രാജാവിൻ്റെ മകൻ
masked-magnate.description: A billionaire in disguise marries a simple woman to discover the true meaning of love. But when her family’s doubts and a ruthless rival’s obsession threaten to tear them apart, he must fight harder than ever. A heartfelt saga of deception, loyalty, and the triumph of love over greed.

the-wedding-scammer.title: The Wedding Scammer
the-wedding-scammer.description: The microdrama centers on a charismatic con artist, primarily known as Chirag, who masterfully operates under numerous aliases like Aman, Mohit, and Ashish. Driven by ambition, past trauma, and a desire for financial prosperity, he weaves an intricate web of deception, preying on wealthy women through fake marriages and emotional manipulation. He juggles multiple romantic relationships with figures such as Simran, Kashish, Kritika, and Radhika, exploiting their trust and desire for love or family to fund his business ventures and evade commitment. His schemes often involve navigating demanding matriarchs and using family members, like an adoptive uncle, in his illicit activities. However, his elaborate double life gradually begins to unravel as his victims, including Rashmi, Gunjan, and Afsana, grow suspicious and confront the devastating truth of his betrayals and multiple identities.
