Simultaneously, determined law enforcement officers like Yamini and Sherni, along with vengeful individuals like Poonam, launch relentless investigations, sting operations, and cybercrime efforts to expose his systematic fraud. The pursuit intensifies, leading to a psychological profiling of Chirag as a dangerous narcissist on the brink of murder, culminating in a violent car crash and high-stakes chases across cities. Despite moments of confession about a harrowing past of abandonment and a plea for genuine connection, Chirag maintains his manipulative facade, highlighting the profound impact of betrayal, the fragility of trust, and the relentless pursuit of justice against a cunning swindler.

ramayanam-9.title: Ramayanam
ramayanam-9.description: The story begins with the joyous anticipation of Prince Rama's coronation, which is tragically derailed by the manipulative confidante Manthara. She poisons Queen Kaikeyi's mind, leading Kaikeyi to demand Rama's fourteen-year exile and the throne for her son, Bharatha, exploiting forgotten boons from King Dasharatha. King Dasharatha, torn by his word and love, is forced to concede, eventually succumbing to profound grief and dying. Despite his father's pleas, the dutiful Prince Rama accepts his fate, joined in exile by his devoted wife Sita and fiercely loyal brother Lakshmanan, who even forsakes his own wife, Urmila, for his brother's service. Queen Kaikeyi experiences deep regret, while Prince Bharatha, horrified by his mother's actions and his father's death, vehemently rejects the throne, vowing to bring Rama back and symbolically ruling with Rama's sandals. As the exiled trio embraces an austere life in the forest, they encounter allies like the humble boatman Kuhan and the venerable winged entity Jatayu, and seek wisdom from sages like Agastya, preparing for impending conflicts. Their serene pilgrimage is soon threatened by formidable demonic forces, including the monstrous Viradhasuran. A pivotal turn occurs with the arrival of the demoness Shurpanakha, whose unrequited passion for Rama and Lakshmanan leads to her brutal disfigurement by Lakshmanan. This act ignites a furious quest for revenge, enraging her powerful brother, King Ravana of Lanka. Consumed by rage, Ravana vows monumental retribution against Rama, specifically plotting the abduction of Sita. He orchestrates an elaborate deception, using a mystical golden deer to lure Rama away and mimicking Rama's voice to draw Lakshmanan from Sita's side. Despite Lakshmanan drawing a protective barrier, Sita's compassion leads her to cross it, allowing Ravana, disguised as a sage, to abduct her. Rama and Lakshmanan realize the elaborate deception and begin a desperate quest to rescue Sita. Their search leads them to a dying avian entity, who reveals Sita was forcibly taken south by Ravana, transforming their personal grief into a righteous war against evil, driven by duty, sacrifice, and the enduring struggle to uphold dharma.

i-married-my-archenemy-after-reborn.title: I married my archenemy after reborn
i-married-my-archenemy-after-reborn.description: A thrilling reincarnation romance where a woman reborn from betrayal and death swears revenge—only to wake up married to her greatest enemy. As past hatred clashes with new emotions, she must decide whether to destroy him… or fall for him all over again.

great-desi-wedding.title: Great Desi Wedding
great-desi-wedding.description: In The Great Desi Wedding, a celebration meant to unite two hearts turns into a storm of betrayal, vengeance, and buried secrets. When Radha’s honor is shattered by Meera’s jealousy and Arjun’s divided loyalties, love and tradition collide in a brutal test of truth. Amid rituals, revenge, and redemption, this “wedding” becomes a battle for dignity and justice.

dangerous-dad-2.title: Dangerous Dad
dangerous-dad-2.description: A cleaner, Aaryan, saves a rich girl, Avni, from the clutches of a wealthy man. Aaryan is actually a secret head of the syndicate and is called Ghost, but he has hidden this identity from everyone – even his own son. How will he navigate his life while also fighting his enemies on his journey? Watch now!

the-royal-betrayal-2.title: The Crown of Lies
the-royal-betrayal-2.description: The microdrama chronicles Rukmani's arduous journey to establish power within a formidable royal dynasty, beginning with her engagement to Rajvardhan. Her discovery of Rajvardhan's secret liaison with his long-hidden mother, Rani Saubhagya, immediately jeopardizes her position. Rukmani's initial disrespect towards the powerful matriarch leads to rigorous tests, including a silent seven-day assessment, to prove her worthiness as a future Maharani. As she navigates these complex power dynamics, Rukmani faces internal conspiracies and betrayal, notably from her confidante Meera. This forces her to adopt a strategic approach, shifting from seeking acceptance to actively challenging the matriarch. Her quest for legitimacy soon transforms into an insatiable pursuit of truth. She uncovers a long-buried family secret involving an erased individual, Viraj Devnath, and Rani Saubhagya's passionate past love, sacrificed for duty. The matriarch fiercely guards these secrets, while Rukmani's ambition to carve her own path within the royal hierarchy intensifies. Rukmani's public ascent to power is marked by her defiance of tradition and assertion of merit-based leadership. However, this attracts new enemies and relentless vendettas from rivals like Kiran, Shefali, and a re-emerging Meera. Her relentless professional advancement strains her relationship with partner Raj, who warns her of isolation. She also finds herself strategically outmaneuvered by Rajvardhan in corporate dealings. The narrative culminates in a revolutionary declaration to end inherited power, ushering in a merit-based system. This transformation sets the stage for a fierce conflict among new leaders. Rukmani evolves from a ceremonial figure into a formidable player, destined to forge her own path amidst escalating betrayals and a quest for a new order.

ramayan-40.title: Ramayan
ramayan-40.description: অযোধ্যার রাজপুত্র রাম ধর্মপ্রাণ হয়ে পিতার অঙ্গীকার পূরণের জন্য নির্বাসন গ্রহণ করেন। যখন দেবদূত সংকটে পড়ে, সীতাকে অপহরণ করেন রাবণ। তখন রাম, হনুমান ও বানরসেনার সঙ্গে মিলিত হয়ে তাকে উদ্ধার করে অযোধ্যায় ফিরে যান এবং রাজ্যাভিষিক্ত হন।

bumped-into-a-beautiful-ceo.title: BUMPED INTO A BEAUTIFUL CEO
bumped-into-a-beautiful-ceo.description: A mysterious and ambitious figure, known by various names including Mr. Bond, Raj, Chris, Mr. Chrissy, and Mr. Mike, embarks on a decade-long quest for vengeance following the destruction of his family and company. Initially operating in disguise as a humble delivery boy or consultant, he meticulously plans his ascent within the cutthroat digital hardware industry. He forms a complex, often manipulative, alliance with heiress Anita (later identified as Lucy), who is desperately fighting to save her family's Sky Group from internal betrayals, financial collapse, and a looming corporate takeover. As Chris gains influence, he dramatically reveals his true identity as a powerful CEO and Chief Consultant, systematically exposing corporate fraud and corruption within both Sky Group and the dominant Black Gold International. His journey is marked by intense corporate battles against formidable rivals such as the arrogant Paul, scion of Black Gold International and heir of Charles Group, and the ruthless CEO Peter. Chris navigates a complicated personal life, including a rejected romantic overture from Penny, a manipulative ex-fiancée Megan, and a deepening, loyal partnership with Lucy, who fiercely defends him amidst accusations and corporate scrutiny. The narrative reveals Chris's calculated orchestration of the downfall of his enemies' empires, using strategic maneuvers and exposing their past transgressions. A deeper conspiracy unfolds, hinting at a hidden mastermind known as Sonak Reese, "Benaam," or "Raazdaar," with Chris himself being accused of being a fraud and the secret keeper, a claim he denies, deepening the mystery. The corporate war escalates into deeply personal stakes, culminating in threats against Chris's life and a brutal attack that gravely wounds Lucy. Chris, now the "Young Master," must protect his family, including his son and grandfather, while facing public scrutiny and the perilous threats from his past. His meticulously planned vendetta culminates in the systematic destruction of his enemies' corporate holdings and a final confrontation with the tyrannical "Old Man" responsible for his family's original tragedy, leaving the ultimate power dynamics and the true identity of the "Raazdaar" as central, unresolved elements.

okkasaari-cheppaleva.title: Okkasaari Cheppaleva
okkasaari-cheppaleva.description: జిలేబీలు, మిక్చర్ పొట్లాలు అమ్ముకునే అమ్మాయి ప్రేమించకూడదా..? మరెందుకు ఆమెకు ఒక అబ్బాయితో బ్రేకప్ అయ్యింది. బిచ్చగాడు ఆమె జీవితంలోకి ఎలా వచ్చాడు. ఆసక్తికరమైన మలుపులతో అందమైన ప్రేమకథ " ఒక్కసారి చెప్పలెవా" మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

anaganaga-o-naanna.title: Anaganaga O Naanna
anaganaga-o-naanna.description: రైల్వే ఉద్యోగి జీవితంలో జరిగిన సంఘటనల సమాహారమే అనగనగా ఓ నాన్న. పిల్లలు, సమాజం కలిసి మనిషిని ఏ విధంగా మార్చాయన్నది ఇక్కడ తెలుసుకోండి.

billionaire-sautela-bhai.title: Billionaire Sautela Bhai
billionaire-sautela-bhai.description: Arjun Purohit a wronged son cast out as an illegitimate child  rises from betrayal and humiliation to reclaim his father’s billion dollar empire. But as he faces his cunning stepbrother Kunal and manipulative stepmother Ishita, revenge becomes the only inheritance he’s willing to claim.

raaja-re-entry.title: Raaja Re-Entry
raaja-re-entry.description: A businessman celebrates 25 years of his company, Patel Tech, which grew from nothing to a multimillion-dollar firm. He acknowledges the hard work of himself and his family. Now, he decides to return to India permanently to be with his wife and two sons after years of absence. He entrusts the company’s future and the launch of a new product to his team, assuring them they are capable of running it. While concerns are raised about his security as one of the world’s richest men, he stresses that his only wish is to spend the rest of his life with his family as an ordinary man.

banduk-meri-laila.title: Mission Hind
banduk-meri-laila.description: When loyalty clashes with love, a soldier of faith finds his heart on the other side of the gun. Usman, torn between his ruthless commander Sajjad and his forbidden love Fatima, must choose between duty, desire, and the truth that could change nations.

return-of-the-billionaire.title: Return of the Billionaire
return-of-the-billionaire.description: Watch family entertainment series 'Return of the Billionaire'

sweet-love-the-ceo-dad-who-cant-escape.title: Sweet Love: The CEO Dad Who Can't Escape
sweet-love-the-ceo-dad-who-cant-escape.description: A heartwarming romantic comedy about a cold, powerful CEO whose life turns upside down when he discovers he has an adorable child—and the child’s mother is the woman he once let go. Between boardroom battles and bedtime stories, he learns that love is the one thing he can’t escape.

the-final-betrayal-1.title: The Final Betrayal
the-final-betrayal-1.description: During Navratri, street vendor Seetha is betrayed by boyfriend who leaves her for cousin. Mysterious beggar proposes a fake marriage to fulfill her dying grandmother’s wish. As they grow closer, Seetha discovers beggar is actually Industries’ billionaire CEO who went undercover. Despite initial hurt over his deception, true love ultimately prevails and they marry.

billionaire-lover-returns-1.title: Billionaire Lover Returns
billionaire-lover-returns-1.description: A poor but spirited girl dies saving a billionaire and is mysteriously brought back to life a year before her death—with a choice between wealth or her memories. When fate reunites her with the same man, love, revenge, and celestial magic collide in a thrilling battle between destiny and desire.

the-final-betrayal-2.title: The Final Betrayal
the-final-betrayal-2.description: শহরের রাস্তার এক বিক্রেতা সেজলের সাথে প্রেমিক প্রতীকের বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা হয়, কারণ সেজলের বোন নন্দিনীর সাথে তার প্রেমিককে দেখা যায়। রহস্যময় ভিক্ষুক শিবম সেজলকে তার অসুস্থ দিদার ইচ্ছা পূরণের জন্য একটি মিথ্যা  বিয়ের প্রস্তাব দেয়। তারা দুজন ক্রমশ ভালোবাসায় জড়িয়ে পড়ে। শিবম কি পারবে সেজলকে তার আসল পরিচয় জানাতে?

the-return-of-the-heiress-discernment-of.title: The Return of the Heiress: Discernment of Pearls
the-return-of-the-heiress-discernment-of.description:
They came like cunning rogues, stripping the Lin family of everything they owned. What follows is a storm of betrayal, power struggles, and revenge that keeps twisting at every turn.
Packed with roller-coaster thrills and nail-biting moments, this saga will leave you breathless—watch now!

three-lives-ring-5.title: Three Lives Ring
three-lives-ring-5.description: The microdrama begins with Katherin, also known as Rosie, facing the execution of her lover Stuart, only to discover his profound betrayal and become a target for Princess Margaret White seeking a lost lineage ring. A mysterious woman declares war on Katherin over a cursed artifact, revealing Stuart's deception. Simultaneously, Robert, a corporate heir, navigates a ruthless succession battle, forming alliances and engaging in complex romantic relationships amidst family feuds. These narratives intertwine as characters encounter disorienting situations, from amnesia and time-travel to dark pacts, all while powerful entities pursue ancient artifacts and unique bloodlines. Robert falls gravely ill, and Mei, a princess from an immortal clan, secretly sacrifices her potent blood to save him, weakening herself and eventually disappearing. Robert, initially unaware, later learns of her profound devotion, leading to a complicated romance. Mei's unique blood makes her a target for a shadowy organization seeking an ancient artifact, hinting at a larger, sinister plot orchestrated by a "Game Orchestrator" and a mysterious "chechi." Corporate sabotage and the possession of Robert's mother, Amma, further reveal a vast conspiracy linked to "evil forces." The narrative suggests a cycle of reincarnation and fated love, with hints of Robert's past lives and accusations of betrayal from a powerful woman, Anitha. A central conflict revolves around a powerful ring, its secrets, and the "holy virgin's blood" required for its activation. This quest for power and ancient artifacts escalates into a brutal confrontation. Ultimately, Robert is murdered by Catherine, transforming May's grief into a vengeful quest. A dying May laments her unfulfilled love, expressing hope for a reunion in the next life, leaving a legacy of sacrifice and eternal devotion amidst a cosmic struggle over identity and an ancient tribal feud.

dumb-heiress.title: DUMB HEIRESS
dumb-heiress.description: A dramatic romantic-comedy about a misunderstood heiress who hides her sharp mind behind a simple, naive façade. While the world mocks her as “dumb,” she quietly plots revenge against those who betrayed her—proving that intelligence needs no announcement.

the-lost-billionaire-1.title: Randam Varavu
the-lost-billionaire-1.description: A young widow is left shattered after her husband’s sudden death and her little son’s mysterious disappearance. Balancing grief with the responsibility of running a business empire, she unknowingly places her trust in the very man plotting her downfall. A gripping saga of betrayal, suspense, and a mother’s unyielding fight for love, justice, and truth.

fake-marriage.title: Fake Marriage
fake-marriage.description: When struggling IIT student Vikram Raghuvanshi accepts a mysterious offer from powerful businessman Rajveer Mehra, his life takes an unexpected turn. Bound by a deal to marry Rajveer’s arrogant daughter Devanshi, Vikram is thrown into a world of power, deceit, and heartbreak. What begins as a contract soon spirals into a storm of betrayal, sacrifice, and redemption ending with one final, unforgettable goodbye.

love-that-defies-abandonment.title: Code War
love-that-defies-abandonment.description: India faces a national cyber crisis, where its advanced air defense system is catastrophically hacked, leading to a "war situation." Amidst the chaos, the underestimated maintenance worker, Sameer Iyer, dramatically intervenes, single-handedly neutralizing the complex cyber threat with his hidden genius. This act earns him admiration but also makes him a target. Concurrently, Sameer's personal life unravels as his ambitious girlfriend, Naina, rejects his marriage proposal, prioritizing a manipulative career advancement under the ruthless new CEO, Arnov Manyuran. Arnov dismisses Sameer's achievements and establishes a cutthroat corporate environment, unknowingly seeking someone with Sameer's skills for his own challenges. Sameer is unjustly fired due to Naina's betrayal and Arnov's arrogance, shattering his career and leaving him humiliated. However, a powerful rival CEO, Sahida Khan, recognizes Sameer's potential and recruits him as her Senior Strategist, later offering him a partnership and hinting at a deeper past connection. Sameer, now empowered, dramatically unveils formidable hacking skills and forms an alliance with heiress Swetha to dismantle the corporate giant that betrayed him. He discovers that a competitor's leading software is his own stolen, incomplete creation, igniting a corporate war for vindication. The corporate battle culminates in Arnov's company triumphing over an established corporation, which suffers a catastrophic system crash due to the misjudgment of the Boss's son, who had fired the genuine expert, Sameer. Years later, Sameer, supported by Saida, makes a powerful comeback, acquiring the very company that wronged him and becoming its CEO. He publicly acknowledges Saida as his wife and source of strength, ultimately refusing reconciliation with his past adversaries, solidifying his triumph fueled by ambition and revenge.

my-fake-boyfriend-is-a-billionaire.title: My Fake Boyfriend is a Billionaire
my-fake-boyfriend-is-a-billionaire.description: For billionaire Satvik, love is worth more than money. For Nisha, the rich are nothing but arrogant—and she wants nothing to do with them. But fate plays its own game. Can a fake boyfriend act turn into true love? Fall for the sweet romantic micro-series “My Fake Boyfriend is a Billionaire”, only on KUKU TV.

raised-by-five-dads.title: Raised by Three Dads
raised-by-five-dads.description: Raised by Three Dads tells the heartwarming and funny story of little Meera, a girl growing up under the care of more than one father. Her strict biological father, her goofy stepdad, and her protective grandfather. As chaos, love, and life lessons unfold, must learn that raising a child isn't about perfection. It's about heart.

love-cocktail.title: Love Cocktail
love-cocktail.description:
Love Cocktail is a bittersweet tale of love, sacrifice, and destiny. Aditya and Apoorva were once inseparable, bound by youthful passion and dreams of forever - until Apoorva suddenly walked away, shattering his heart. What Aditya never knew was that she was drowning in turmoil: abandoned by her father, burdened with a bankrupt company, and threatened by lawsuits. To protect him, she chose silence, masking her love as rejection.
Years later, Aditya, now a powerful CEO, crosses paths with Apoorva when she unknowingly seeks a job in his company. Cold on the surface but protective in secret, he hides his feelings while she silently battles both her past and her illness. Deepak, her steadfast friend, supports her but recognizes her heart still belongs to Aditya.
But when the truth surfaces, will Aditya forgive her silence?  Can love heal years of heartbreak? Or  will fate serve them one last bitter twist?

Watch “Love Cocktail” Micro Drama Series only on KUKU TV.

golden-son-buried-alive-for-20-years.title: Golden Son: Buried Alive for 20 Years
golden-son-buried-alive-for-20-years.description: Adopted son Gautham risks 20 years of his life. He gave everything to be called a brother… then why did the Mahendran sisters turn cold? And why must he sleep for 20 years? Watch now to find out.

a-deal-signed-in-love.title: A Deal Signed in Love
a-deal-signed-in-love.description: ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ದಿಯಾ ಶೆಟ್ಟಿ ಚಿಕ್ಕವಯಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲೇ ತನ್ನ ತಾಯಿಯನ್ನ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ತಾಳೆ.‌ ತನ್ನ ತಾಯಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದ ಕಂಪೆನಿಯ ಏಕೈಕ ವಾರಸುದಾರಳಾಗಿರೋ ದಿಯಾಳಿಗೆ ತಾನು ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿದ ಅಮಿತ್‌ನನ್ನ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿ ಸೆಟಲ್‌ ಆಗೋ ಕನಸು. ಆದರೆ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ಟೆಪ್‌-ಸಿಸ್ಟರ್‌ ಜೊತೆ ಅಮಿತ್ ಅಫೇರ್‌ ಇಟ್ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾನೆ ಅಂತ ತಿಳಿದಾಗ ದಿಯಾ ಎಂಗೇಜ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್‌ ಕ್ಯಾನ್ಸಲ್‌ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳ್ತಾಳೆ. ಟಾಕ್ಸಿಕ್‌ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ರ್ಯಾಪ್‌ ಆಗಿರೋ ದಿಯಾಳಿಗೆ ನಿಜವಾದ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ? ದಿಯಾ ಲೈಫ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೋ ಸಿದ್ಧಾರ್ಥ್‌ ದೇವ್ ವರ್ಮಾ ಯಾರು? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಮೂಡಿಸೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಮೈಕ್ರೋ ಡ್ರಾಮಾ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "A Deal Signed in Love" ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU TVಯಲ್ಲಿ.

dangerous-dad-1.title: Dangerous Dad
dangerous-dad-1.description: একজন সাফাইকর্মী, আরিয়ান, এক ধনী মেয়ে, আভনিকে বাঁচায়, একজন ধনী ব্যক্তির হাত থেকে। আরিয়ান আসলে সিন্ডিকেটের একজন গোপন মাস্টারমাইন্ড এবং তাকে গোস্ট বলা হয়, কিন্তু সে এই পরিচয় সবার কাছ থেকে লুকিয়ে রেখেছে - এমনকি তার নিজের ছেলের থেকেও। এভাবে সে কীভাবে তার জীবন পরিচালনা করবে?

secrets-behind-the-doorhidden-pivot.title: Secrets Behind the Door/Hidden Pivot
secrets-behind-the-doorhidden-pivot.description: A suspense-filled mystery drama where every locked door hides a truth too dangerous to reveal. When a young woman moves into a mansion filled with whispers and lies, she uncovers a secret that could change everything—and learns that sometimes, the real danger isn’t behind the door, but standing right beside her.

batwara-1.title: Batwara
batwara-1.description: যখন রেলওয়ের টিকিট চেকার (টিটি/টিসি) ঈশ্বর প্রতাপ চৌহান ৪০ বছর সৎভাবে চাকরি করার পর অবসর গ্রহণ করেন, তখন তার তিন জৈবিক সন্তান তাদের নিষ্ঠুর উদাসীনতা প্রকাশ করে, যা তাকে এবং তার একনিষ্ঠ স্ত্রী রজনীকে অপমানজনক বিচ্ছেদে বাধ্য করে - যতক্ষণ না তার দত্তক পুত্র প্রেম এবং প্রেমের কবিতার একটি বই পরিবার, ত্যাগ এবং নিঃশর্ত ভালোবাসার মূল্য সম্পর্কে সত্য প্রকাশ করে।

cm-ki-dulhan.title: CM ki Dulhan
cm-ki-dulhan.description: CM ki Dulhan is a political family drama set against the backdrop of dynastic Indian politics. The series explores how women, often treated as pawns in the game of power, can become players who change the very rules of the game. At its heart, the story is a love story born out of compulsion, evolving into a political partnership of equals. Through betrayal, corruption, and power struggles, Anandi and Arjun’s journey reflects themes of loyalty. Watch Now.

under-cover-prison-king.title: Khaidhi
under-cover-prison-king.description: Vishal Sheth, a fearless undercover cop, is chosen for his most dangerous mission yet. Disguised as a hardened prisoner, he must infiltrate the criminal underworld from within, gain the trust of ruthless gang lords, and uncover the powerful masterminds pulling the strings behind bars. One wrong move could blow his cover—and cost him his life.

the-final-badla-1.title: The Final Badla
the-final-badla-1.description: Naina, long estranged from her powerful patriarch father, Randhir, reluctantly returns home for his 80th birthday, hoping to mend their fractured family. Her arrival immediately ignites fierce animosity, particularly from Randhir, who disowned her years ago for eloping with Vikram, and from her Antagonistic Brother and Sister-in-law, who accuse her of seeking inheritance and fraud. A 30-year-old grudge against her mother resurfaces, fueling Randhir's rage and leading to physical violence, while a valuable vintage whisky gift sparks accusations of theft. It is later revealed that Naina's Antagonistic Brother may have orchestrated the entire scenario as an act of revenge, exposing deep-seated family conflicts and betrayals. Simultaneously, Naina, also referred to as Nayana or Ma, is revealed to be the mother of powerful sons, including Kabir and Priyansh, who fiercely defend her honor against her father, Ranveer Batra, and other antagonists. Kabir, a CEO, navigates corporate intrigue, uncovering a massive fraud orchestrated by his ex-lover Kriti, who is also connected to the wealthy antagonist Rakesh. Naina/Nayana confronts Rakesh, holding him responsible for her military husband's false treason charges and execution, sparking a quest for revenge and justice. A passionate connection develops between Nayana and Manav, a heroic protector who defends her from Rakesh. Kabir, despite his mother's matchmaking attempts, develops a secret workplace romance with Myra, an independent young woman, leading to an arranged marriage orchestrated by Nayana. The narrative culminates in Rakesh, identified as a ruthless villain, taking Naina/Kobir's mother and Manav/Manob babu hostage, demanding all of Kobir's assets. Kobir negotiates their release but is double-crossed, leading to a desperate physical battle to protect his family and freedom. Amidst this turmoil, Manav confesses his profound love to Naina, who reciprocates, embarking on a new romantic journey, while Kabir and Myra's wedding plans are abruptly shattered by an ominous event. The show explores themes of family honor, corporate power, past betrayals, and the pursuit of justice and love amidst relentless threats.

accidental-shaadi.title: Accidental Shaadi
accidental-shaadi.description: When a comatose heir is married to a so called cursed girl to save his life, destiny tears a powerful family apart. His revival sparks his elder brother’s jealousy, twisting blood ties into rivalry. Between love, betrayal, and redemption, Accidental Shaadi explores how fate, family, and power collide in a battle of hearts and egos. Watch now.

ultimate-khiladi-5.title: Ultimate Khiladi
ultimate-khiladi-5.description: When the city’s brightest tech genius is unfairly sacked by a power-hungry heir, he strikes back in the boldest way possible—by joining forces with the rival company’s brilliant CEO. Their alliance ignites a war that topples empires, exposes arrogance, and flips the balance of power in Bangalore’s cutthroat tech world. By the time the mistake is realized, the damage is irreversible—and revenge tastes sweeter than success.

baby-billionaire-and-oops-me.title: Baby, Billionaire... and Oops, Me!
baby-billionaire-and-oops-me.description: Kiara, a struggling writer whose life spirals into chaos after a one-night mix-up with billionaire Aarav Kapoor leaves her unexpectedly pregnant. As secrets, misunderstandings, and emotions collide.

the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.title: The Daughter-in-Law Who Married Far Away
the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.description:
A wealthy woman discovers her beloved daughter is trapped in the grip of a charming but violent husband. Justice doesn’t come from the courts—but from a mother’s silent fury.
“Mother of Revenge” is a chilling tale where love turns into vengeance, and silence carries the deadliest scream.

the-dragon-returns-to-his-homeland-4.title: The Dragon Returns to His Homeland
the-dragon-returns-to-his-homeland-4.description: He gave up his dreams for love, sending his brother away to build the future he couldn’t. Years later, the brother returns a billionaire—but just as long-awaited love finally nears, a ruthless rival rises to snatch it all. A tale of sacrifice, loyalty, and the battle between love, family, and power.

smoke-on-the-wasteland.title: Smoke on the Wasteland
smoke-on-the-wasteland.description: A gripping post-apocalyptic drama set in a world reduced to ashes, where survival is a daily war. Amid the desolate wasteland, a lone wanderer searches for hope, haunted by memories and chased by enemies, as smoke becomes the last sign of life—and death.

the-return-of-the-king-triumphant-return.title: The Return of the King: Triumphant Return
the-return-of-the-king-triumphant-return.description: The series introduces John George, a powerful CEO who operates undercover to expose and deliver justice to corrupt managers within his company. His commitment extends to his personal life, as he returns to his village to protect his elderly mother from a loan shark and confronts his sister-in-law, Lilly, for her betrayal, igniting a fierce quest for retribution. Despite facing initial legal troubles for corporate claims, John George reclaims his rightful leadership within the Millennium Group, dismantling corrupt executives and orchestrating hostile takeovers. Amidst these corporate battles, his mother falls critically ill, compelling him to acquire an entire hospital and expose institutional corruption to ensure her care. His past love, Mona Lisa, resurfaces, trapped in an arranged marriage to save her own ailing mother, prompting John George to dramatically intervene and counter dowry demands, though she ultimately rejects his financial aid. Concurrently, John George navigates a complex relationship with his loyal secretary, Lucy, while his mother attempts to matchmake them. He faces escalating rivalries, particularly with Jackson, who blackmails him and orchestrates a personal vendetta, demanding public humiliation and the divorce of John's brother from the deceptive Lilly, who is revealed to be having an affair with Jackson. John George also confronts Edward, a childhood bully now a powerful executive, and plans to dismantle his corporate empire, asserting his dominance. The threats intensify as John George is targeted by hitmen and framed for a major crime, with Megha, a manipulative blind date, revealed as an accomplice to Jackson. Lucy consistently proves her unwavering loyalty and combat skills, protecting John George from various dangers, hinting at a deepening bond. The stakes rise dramatically when Jackson abducts Lucy, demanding John George's public humiliation and self-termination as ultimate revenge. In a brutal confrontation, John George makes a profound sacrifice to protect Lucy, surviving the ordeal and being acquitted for self-defense. Ultimately, John George recovers and proposes marriage to Lucy, transforming their professional bond into a romantic partnership. The show portrays John George's relentless pursuit of justice and power, his deep familial loyalties, and the personal cost of his formidable influence in a world rife with betrayal and corporate intrigue, ultimately finding a new personal foundation amidst the chaos.

the-victorious-attitude.title: The Victorious Attitude
the-victorious-attitude.description: 🏆 Life-la adhigama achieve panna aasaiya? "The Victorious Attitude" ungaloda normal mindset -ta epdi success- mindset ta matharadhu-nu kathu kodukkudhu. 🌟 vetri adairadhukkaana habits-a build panni, thadaigala thaandi positive attitude-oda overcome panradhu epdi nu therinjukalaam vaanga. 📖  🔊

jennifer-schuett.title: Childhood Trauma -The Jennifer Schuett Story
jennifer-schuett.description: Ek  8 saal ki bacchi jiske saath hui aisi haiwaaniyat jisne use mardon se nafrat karne par makboor kar diya. Agle 20 saalon tak apne is khaufnaak past se ladte-ladte aakhir kaise wo apne trauma se baahar aayi aur kaise usne 20 saal baad dilaai us darinde ko saza? Suniye sirf KUKU FM par

marakkathirikkan-budhiyullavarakan.title: മറക്കാതിരിക്കാൻ ബുദ്ധിയുള്ളവരകാൻ
marakkathirikkan-budhiyullavarakan.description: ബുദ്ധിശക്തിയും ഓർമശക്തിയും വർധിപ്പിക്കാനുള്ള ലളിതവും എന്നാൽ ഫലപ്രദവുമായ  തന്ത്രങ്ങൾ ഈ പുസ്തകം നൽകുന്നു. നിങ്ങളുടെ മനസ്സിന്റെ അപാരമായ സാധ്യതകൾ തുറന്നുകാട്ടുന്ന ഈ അറിവുകൾ എന്തൊക്കെയായിരിക്കും? കേൾകാം മറക്കാതിരിക്കാൻ ബുദ്ധിയുള്ളവരകാൻ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്ക്

dear-better-half.title: Dear Better Half
dear-better-half.description: പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് പ്രിപെയർ ചെയ്യുന്ന കാമുകന്‍ അരവിന്ദുമായി കുറച്ച് കാലത്തേക്ക് കോണ്‍ടാക്റ്റ് ഒന്നുമില്ലാതിരുന്ന ആവണിയുടെ ജീവിതത്തിലേക്ക് രാജകുമാരനെപ്പോലെ അയാള്‍ വന്നെത്തി. ഏട്ടത്തിയുടെ കല്ല്യാണ ഒരുക്കങ്ങള്‍ക്കിടെ അവളും പൂത്തുലഞ്ഞു തുടങ്ങുകയായിരുന്നു. എത്ര പെട്ടെന്നാണ് അയാള്‍ തന്നെ സ്വാധീനിച്ചത്... അരവിന്ദിന് പോലും ഇത്ര പെട്ടെന്നത് കഴിഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ല. താന്‍ ചെയ്യുന്നത് ശരിയാണോ.. അവള്‍ ചിന്തിച്ചുകൂട്ടി. ശരിക്കും ആരായിരിക്കും അവളുടെ ബെറ്റര്‍ഹാഫ്..?!!

brahmastra-ki-adbhut-gatha.title: Brahmastra Ki Adbhut Gatha
brahmastra-ki-adbhut-gatha.description: Brahmand ka sabse adbhut aur bhayankar astr, jiska saamna karne ki taakat kisi dev, asur aur yahan tak ki tridev mein bhi nahi hai. Jab bhi ise prayog kiya gaya, vah vinaash lekar aaya! Aaiye, Brahma ke us astr Brahamastra ki kahani sunte hain.

baazigar-co-hyderabad.title: Baazigar C/O Hyderabad
baazigar-co-hyderabad.description: ముత్తువేలన్ వయసు పై పడ్డ ఒక కళరి పట్టు తెలిసిన వ్యక్తి, కేరళ విడిచి, ఆంధ్రాలో తల దాచుకున్నాడు. అతని ఇంటికి ఆకలి వేసి దొంగతనం కి వచ్చిన చిన్నాతో అతని ప్రయాణం మొదలయ్యింది, ముత్తువేలన్ దగ్గర నేర్చుకున్న కళరి విద్య తో వీధి బాలకుల జీవితం మారుద్దాం అనుకున్న చిన్న హఠాత్తుగా మరణిస్తాడు. ఆ వేదనతో ముత్తువేలన్ ఎలా పిల్లల అవయవాలు అమ్ముకునే వాళ్ళ మీద ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకున్నాడు అనేదే కథ!

mahadev-ka-shraap-kamdev-rati-ki-prem-ka.title: Mahadev Ka Shraap - Kamdev Rati Ki Prem Kahani
mahadev-ka-shraap-kamdev-rati-ki-prem-ka.description:
Devtaon ki ek chalak yojna, aur Kaamdev ko diya gaya ek khaufnaak kaam—Shiv ki tapasya bhang karna. Nateeja? Kaamdev ka vinash. Rati ke liye yeh ek aisa dard hai jo sab kuch badal deta hai, lekin uska pyaar maut ko bhi chunauti dene ko tayar hai.
Shiv ka krodh, Kaamdev ka ant, aur Rati ka badla—yeh prem aur devtaon ke khel ki ek anokhi kahani hai. Kya Rati apne pyaar ko wapas laa payegi? Kya Kaamdev ka punarjanm hoga? Aur devtaon ka asli chaal kya hai?
Ek aisi kahani jahan maut sirf ek shuruaat hai aur punarjanm ek raaz! Toh kya aap tayar hai is raaz ko samajhne ke liye?

o-g-boyfriend.title: OG Boyfriend
o-g-boyfriend.description: Zorro ఐదు అడుగుల పదకొండు అంగుళాల KATANA లాంటి కటౌట్. వాడు ఎలాంటి వాడు అంటే.. వాడు చేసిన రక్తపాతాన్ని తుడిచి పెట్టాలంటే ఎన్ని తుఫాన్లు వచ్చినా సరిపోవు..‌ అలాంటి వాడికి నచ్చక నచ్చక ఒక అమ్మాయి నచ్చి ఆ అమ్మాయి ప్రమాదంలో పడితే.. వాడు మొదలుపెట్టే యుద్ధం ఎంత విధ్వంసం సృష్టిస్తుందో.. తెలుసుకోవాలంటే Meet our OG Boyfriend.. He is a freaking firestorm 🔥

the-dark-door.title: The dark Door
the-dark-door.description: நந்தினியோட கனவு தான் பாதள உலகத்துக்கான போர்டல். அவளோட கனவு வழி இந்த உலகத்துக்கு வர தீய சக்திகள் அவளை வேட்டையாட ஆரம்பிக்குது. அதுலேருந்து அவ எப்படி தப்பிச்சா?

savitri-amar-prem-ki-gatha.title: Satyavan-Savitri : Ek Amar Katha
savitri-amar-prem-ki-gatha.description: Savitri wo naari hai, jisne apne pati ke bhavishya ko jante huye bhi unse shadi ki thi. Phir apne prem aur tapasya se unhone sabki taqdeer badal di. Aur iski prerna mili thi unhe devi Shakuntla se. Kaise? Aur kya hai Savitri ki poori kahani, janiye is show mein!

lady-superstar.title: Lady Superstar
lady-superstar.description:
ஹீரோயின் நேகாவும் அவளது மேனேஜர் சூர்யாவும் ரகசியமாக காதலிப்பதாக, கிசுகிசு செய்தி ஊரெங்கும் பற்றி எறிகிறது. இந்த செய்தியை லீக் செய்தது யார்? 
நேகாவின் காதல் - ஸ்டார் ஆகும் ஆசை இரண்டும் கைகூடுமா?

sold-for-love-2.title: Sold For Love
sold-for-love-2.description: యతిని మార్కెట్ లో బేరానికి ఎందుకు పెట్టారు, అసలు తనని కిడ్నాప్ చేసింది ఎవరు? యతిని కొనుక్కొని తనని రాక్షస వివాహం చేసుకుంది ఎవరు? వినండి Sold For Love

dr-arjun-a-warrior-from-dvapara.title: Dr. Arjun - A Warrior from Dvapara
dr-arjun-a-warrior-from-dvapara.description: Har shahar me ho rahi hatyayen aur man-made disasters ye saabit karte hain ki Mahapralay ko jaldi lane ki koshish shuru ho chuki hai. Dr. Arjun ke upar duniya ko bachane ki zimmedari hai, jabki Naag Yaksha is shristi ka ant chahte hain. Kya Dr. Arjun apni bhooli hui taqaton ka istemal kar ke is jung ko jeet payega?

dattu.title: Daatu
dattu.description:
ಎಸ್.ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ *ದಾಟು* ಕನ್ನಡದ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಒಂದು ಮಹತ್ವದ ಕೃತಿ. 

*ದಾಟು* ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ವಿವರಣೆ:
*ದಾಟು* ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸಮಾಜದ ಮೂಲಭೂತವಾಗಿ ಇದ್ದ ಜಾತಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ಕುರಿತಾಗಿ ಆಳವಾದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟೊಂದು ಗಾಢವಾಗಿ ಬೇರೂರಿರುವ ಜಾತಿಯ ಗಡಿಯನ್ನ ದಾಟಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುವ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ನಿರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. "ದಾಟು" ಎಂದರೆ ಗಡಿಯನ್ನ ದಾಟುವುದು. ಇದು ಕೇವಲ ಭೌತಿಕ ಗಡಿಯನ್ನ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಮನೋವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಗಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಟುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವನ್ನು ಸಂಕೇತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. 
ಈ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳು ಜಾತಿಯ ಬಿಗು ನಿಯಮಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಿ ತಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ತರುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಣಗಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳಿಗೆ ವಿರೋಧ, ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಾಗುವ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟಗಳು, ಮನಸೋ ಇಚ್ಛೆಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಅಸಮಾನತೆಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ನಡೆಯುವ ಹೋರಾಟವನ್ನು ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ತೀವ್ರತೆಯಿಂದ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. *ದಾಟು* ನಮ್ಮ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುವ ಜಾತಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ವಿಭಜನೆಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗೆ ಹಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪೂರಕವಾದ ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.

bhinna.title: ಭಿನ್ನ
bhinna.description: ಅನಾದಿ ಕಾಲದಿಂದಲೂ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರನ್ನ ಭೋಗದ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನಾಗಿ ನೋಡುವ ಕೆಲವು ವರ್ಗವಿದೆ‌. ಹೀಗಾಗಿ ವೇಶ್ಯೆ ವೃತ್ತಿ ಇಂದು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿದೆ. ವೇಶ್ಯೆಯರ ಬದುಕಿನ ಭಯಾನಕ ಕಥಾಹಂದರವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯೇ, ಲೇಖಕಿ 'ಕವಿತಾ ಮಹಾಜನ್' ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರೋ ಮರಾಠಿಯ 'ಭಿನ್ನ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿ. ಇದನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುವಾದಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಖ್ಯಾತ ಕಥೆಗಾರ್ತಿ 'ವೀಣಾ ಶಾಂತೇಶ್ವರ'. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.!

urvashi-apsara-ki-prem-kahani.title: Urvashi : Apsara Ki Prem Kahani
urvashi-apsara-ki-prem-kahani.description: Swarg ki Apsara Urvashi aur ek manav ka prem, jisne swarg ke niyamo ko toda aur pralay tak pahuncha. Kya ye prem apne anjaam tak pahunchega ya devtaon ka krodh jeetega? janiye is Audioshow "Urvashi : Apsara Ki Prem Kahani" mein.

gruhabhanga.title: ಗೃಹಭಂಗ
gruhabhanga.description: ಜೀವನ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸರಳವೋ, ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣವೂ ಹೌದು. ಹೀಗಾಗಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ತರ್ಕವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಬದುಕನ್ನು ಕೇವಲ ಬದುಕನ್ನಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿರುವ ಕೃತಿ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕ ಎಸ್. ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ಗೃಹಭಂಗ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿ. ಇದೊಂದು ಮನೆತನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ನಂಜಮ್ಮ ಅನ್ನೋ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಗಳ ಕಥೆಯಾದ್ರೂ, ಇದು ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೂ, ಯಾರ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೂ ನಡೆಯಬಹುದಾದ ಘಟನೆಯಾಧಾರಿತ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ನಂಜಮ್ಮ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡು ತನ್ನ ಬದುಕಿಗಾಗಿ, ತನ್ನ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ನಡೆಸುವ ಸುದೀರ್ಘ ಹೋರಾಟವೇ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ತಿರುಳು. ಭಾರತದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಭಾಷೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಅನುವಾದಗೊಂಡು, ಓದುಗರ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆಗೆ ಪಾತ್ರವಾಗಿರುವ ಈ 'ಗೃಹಭಂಗ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ.!

saakshi.title: ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ
saakshi.description: ಪುರಾಣ ಮತ್ತು ವಾಸ್ತವ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ಕೃತಿಯೇ ಎಸ್. ಎಲ್.ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ ' ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ'. ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಪಡೆದಿರುವ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ. ಕೇಳಿ.. ಆನಂದಿಸಿ!

operation-tricolor-hindustan-ka-badla.title: Operation Tricolor: Hindustan Ka Badla
operation-tricolor-hindustan-ka-badla.description: Jab Pakistan ke coded message ne RAW agents ko kiya alert, tab shuru hua ek khatarnak khel! "Operation Tricolor" mein jaaniye kaise humare jasoos dushmanon ki yojnaon ko nakaam karne ke liye apni jaan jokhim mein daalte hain. Har episode aapko le jayega Bharat-Pakistaan Ke beech chhidi jung ki unseen duniya mein, jahaan har pal khauf aur dhokha hai.

taayi.title: ತಾಯಿ
taayi.description: ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಯೋಧರಲ್ಲಿ 'ತಾಯಿ' ಕೂಡ ಒಬ್ಬಳು. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತಾಯಂದಿರು ಅಪ್ಪಟ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಕಾರಿಗಳೇ! ಪ್ರತಿದಿನವೂ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಲೇ ತನ್ನವರನ್ನು ಕಾಯುವ ತಾಯಿಗೇ ಸರಿಸಾಟಿ ಮತ್ಯಾರೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ತಾಯಿ ಮತ್ತು ರಷ್ಯಾಕ್ರಾಂತಿಯನ್ನು ಕಥಾವಸ್ತುವನ್ನಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕ 'ಮಕ್ಸೀಂ ಗೋರ್ಕಿ' 'ತಾಯಿ' ಅನ್ನೋ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುವಾದಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ 'ನಿರಂಜನ'. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

lost-in-the-valley-of-death.title: Maut Ki Ghati Mein Gum: Bharat Mein Enlightenment Ka Safar
lost-in-the-valley-of-death.description: Spiritual journey par nikla, lekin wapas kabhi nahi aaya. Lost in the Valley of Death ek western traveller ke behtareen safar ka kissa hai, jahaan bharat ki dharti par enlightenment ka raasta chhupaye hue hain khatre aur raahen jo kabhi khatam nahi hoti.

jaya.title: Jaya
jaya.description: ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಾಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನವಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಥಾವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಕೃತಿಗಳು ಬಂದಿವೆ‌. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲಿ 'ದೇವದತ್ತ ಪಟ್ಟನಾಯಕ' ಅವ್ರು ಬರೆದಿರೋ 'ಜಯ' ಕೃತಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾದುದು‌. ಇದನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುವಾದಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ 'ಗಿರಡ್ಡಿ ಗೋವಿಂದರಾಜ' ಅವರು. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ. ಕೇಳಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ!

jai-bajarangaballi.title: ಜೈ ಭಜರಂಗಬಲಿ
jai-bajarangaballi.description: 'ಜೈ ಭಜರಂಗಬಲಿ' ಕುಂ. ವೀರಭ್ರದ್ರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ. ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗೋದು ಹನುಮನ ಕಿಂಡಿ ಅನ್ನೋ‌ ಅಗ್ರಹಾರದಿಂದ. ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಲಾಲಸೆ, ಧನದಾಹ, ಭ್ರಷ್ಟಾಚಾರ, ಕ್ರೌರ್ಯ, ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೀಗೆ ನಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಮಾನವನ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯನ್ನು, ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಡಂಬನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

bali-vadh-dharam-aur-nyay-ka-dwand.title: Bali Vadh : Dharam Aur Nyay Ka Dwand
bali-vadh-dharam-aur-nyay-ka-dwand.description: Bhagwan Ram ne Jab Bali ka vadh kiya to Ram par prashan kyun uthe? Akhir kyun bhagwan Ram ko chhipkar marna pada Bali ko? Bali aur Sugreev in donon bhaiyon ke beech aisa bhi kya ho gaya tha, jo ye donon ek dusre ke shatru ban baithe the? Agar aap bhi ye sab janna chahte hain to suniye hamara ye naya show, Bali Vadh:Dharam Aur Nyay Ka Dwand

kattegondu-kala.title: ಕತ್ತೆಗೊಂದು ಕಾಲ
kattegondu-kala.description: 'ಕತ್ತೆಗೊಂದು ಕಾಲ' ಕುಂ.ವೀರಭ್ರದ್ರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ. ರಾಜಕೀಯ, ಚುನಾವಣೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಧರ್ಮದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವ್ಯಂಗ್ಯವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿರುವ ಈ‌ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ರಾಜಕಾರಣದಲ್ಲಿ‌ ನಡೆಯುವ ಹಲವು ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

bharathipura.title: Bharathipura
bharathipura.description: ಮೇಲ್ಜಾತಿಯ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ, ಈ ಜಾತಿಪದ್ಧತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿರೋಧಿಸಿ, ಕೆಳಜಾತಿಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸ್ನೇಹ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಾಗುವ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ ಹೇಗೆ ನಿಭಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ ಅನ್ನೋದೇ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ಬರಹಗಾರರಾದ ಯು.ಆರ್. ಅನಂತಮೂರ್ತಿಯವರು ರಚಿಸಿರುವ 'ಭಾರತೀಪುರ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಕಥಾಹಂದರ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ‌.

chota-rajan-power-betrayal-aur-mumbai-ma.title: Chota Rajan: Mumbai Mafia Ka Bada Naam
chota-rajan-power-betrayal-aur-mumbai-ma.description: Chhota Rajan ki kahani ek aise insaan ki hai jo chhote crime se shuru karte hue Mumbai ke underworld ka bada naam ban gaya. Is show mein aap jaanenge kaise ek aam ladka "Chhota Rajan" banne ka safar tay karta hai. Suspense, drama aur dosti-dushmani se bhare is show ko miss mat kariye!

anveshana.title: Anveshana
anveshana.description: ಕನ್ನಡದ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್ ಕೃತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಸ್. ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ 'ಅನ್ವೇಷಣ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು‌. ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಕಥಾನಕ ಅಲೆಮಾರಿಯಾಗಿ, ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ಕೆಲಸಗಾರನಾಗಿ, ಜಟಕಾ ಹೊಡೆಯುವವನಾಗಿ, ಪ್ರಿಯಕರನಾಗಿ ಹೀಗೆ ಹಲವು ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಯಾನ ಪುಸ್ತಕಪ್ರೇಮಿಗಳನ್ನ ಸೆಳೆಯುತ್ತೆ‌. ಜೊತೆ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳ ಒಳಾರ್ಥಗಳು ಬದುಕಿನ ಹೊಸ ಆಯಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ. ಕೇಳಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ!

jalapaata.title: Jalapaatha
jalapaata.description: ಜಲಪಾತ ದೂರದಿಂದ ನೋಡಲು ರಮ್ಯ ಮನೋಹರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಹೋದಾಗ ಅದು ಕೊಡುವ ಅನುಭವ ಒಬ್ಬೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ ಒಂದೊಂದು ರೀತಿ. ಇದೇ ರೀತಿ ಬದುಕಿನ ಸುಖ-ದುಃಖ, ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯ, ಕಾಮ ಇವುಗಳೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಎಸ್. ಎಲ್ ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರು ಅಪರೂಪದ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ 'ಜಲಪಾತ' ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ‌. ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮಗಾದ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿ!

38c4614f-e26d-4da4-9d9d-edd56c96692d.title: Mafia Mahto : Aatank Ka Samrat
38c4614f-e26d-4da4-9d9d-edd56c96692d.description: Doston ke liye farishta, dushmano ke liye maut ka paigam, ye kahani hai us gangster ki, jisne pehle khud apni marzi se police ko surrender kiya. Aur phir daav dekhte hi Nawada jail ko todkar farar ho gaya. Kaise shuru hui thi jurm ki duniya mein uski kahani, janiye har raat 8 baje!

nakkaava-geddavva.title: ನಕ್ಕಾವ ಗೆದ್ದಾವ
nakkaava-geddavva.description: "Nakkava Gedava" is a compelling book that takes you on a journey through the challenges and triumphs of life, highlighting the importance of humor and resilience. Through engaging anecdotes and insightful reflections, the book explores how laughter can be a powerful tool in overcoming obstacles and achieving success. It is a testament to the idea that those who can laugh in the face of adversity are the true victors in life. Perfect for readers seeking inspiration, motivation, and a fresh perspective on the power of positivity.

Alipore-Bomb-Case-भारत-की-आज़ादी-का-आगाज.title: Alipore Bomb Case: भारत की आज़ादी का आगाज़
Alipore-Bomb-Case-भारत-की-आज़ादी-का-आगाज.description: Yeh Alipore Bomb Case ki kahani jaan kar aapke hosh udd jayenge! Kis tarah 18 saal ke Khudiram Bose ne Angrezi huqumat ka jeena mushkil kardiya tha aur ek badi saazish ki planning bhi ho rahi thi, Jo Hindustan ki azaadi ke andolan ka aagaaz ban gayi thi. Toh abhi suniye yeh dhamakedar show, Jo bharpur hai action, drama aur qurbaani se!

neevu-devaranu-nambabedi.title: ನೀವು ದೇವರನ್ನು ನಂಬಬೇಡಿ
neevu-devaranu-nambabedi.description: Devru andre ondu nambike.! Yavde kashta barli "Devriddane Bidu" anno mathu saku, aathmavishwasadinda munde hogoke. Purana kathegalallu ashte, Devru kai hidiyodu olle daariyalli saagthiroranna. "Illi Devru manushyanagoke sadya.! Manushya Devragoke sadya.!" anthare halavaru. Hagadre naavu devranna nambabeka.? Devru nambuvanthe badukabeka.? E prashnege utthara thiliyodakke keli Kannadada famous writer 'Jogi' avru barediruva 'Neevu Devarannu Nambabedi' audiobook.

hello-doctor-2.title: Hello Doctor.!
hello-doctor-2.description: కరోనా కాలం లో ఆయుర్వేదం ద్వారా ఔషధం కనిపెట్టిన సుమంత్ ని ఎలా అయినా సరే మెడికల్ మాఫియా ఆపాలి అనుకుంటుంది, దానికి చంపడానికి కూడా వెనుకాడదు. అలాంటి సమయంలో అక్కడే మెడికల్ క్యాంపు కు వచ్చి సుమంత్ ప్రేమలో పడిపోయిన డాక్టర్ అనన్య మరియు అనంతపల్లి ప్రజలు సుమంత్ కు ఎలా దగ్గరయ్యారు, తనకి ఎలా సహాయపడ్డారనేది కథ !

bharat-cheen-aur-dalai-lama.title: Bharat, China Aur Dalai Lama
bharat-cheen-aur-dalai-lama.description: Bharat aur China mein Panchsheel Agreement ho jane ke baad bhi kyun in donon deshon ke beech darar bani rahi? Aur kaise Dalai Lama In donon deshon ke beech conflict ka karan banein?   Turunt suniye apne in prashnon ka jawab janne ke liye hamara ye show...

superhero-prithvi.title: Superhero Prithvi
superhero-prithvi.description: തന്റെ കാമുകിയോടൊപ്പം രാത്രിയിൽ സമയം ചെലവഴിക്കുമ്പോഴാണ് പൃഥ്വിയെ തേടി ആ ഞെട്ടിക്കുന്ന വാർത്തയെത്തുന്നത്.  ഒറ്റ രാത്രികൊണ്ട്  പഠിത്തം ഉപേക്ഷിച്ച്  അവന് പോലീസിൽ  ചേരേണ്ടി വരുന്നു.   അവിടെ നിന്നും അവൻ സൂപ്പർഹീറോ പൃഥ്വി ആയി മാറിയത് എങ്ങനെ?. കേൾക്കാം,  നിലക്കാത്ത ആക്ഷനും പ്രണയവും വെല്ലുവിളികളും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു സൂപ്പർഹീറോയുടെ ജീവിതം!

arranged-love.title: Arranged LOVE
arranged-love.description: ❤️‍🩹Accident la erandhu pona thannoda Lover pathina nenaippula kavalaiyoda irukkura aishwaryavukku avanga veetla thideernu oru arrange marriage fix panraanga💑. Antha arrange marriage avaloda vazhkaiyave vera maathiri poratti podudhu. 🔊🎧

yaksha-ke-prashana-yudhishthir-ki-pariks.title: Yaksh Ke Prashan: Yudhishthir Ki Pariksha
yaksha-ke-prashana-yudhishthir-ki-pariks.description: Apne bhaiyon ko phir se jivit karne ke liye pandav Yudhishthir ko Yaksha ke kuch prashanon ke jawab dene the. Kya Yaksha unke jawabon se santusht ho paya? Kya baki ke charon pandav phir se jivit ho paaye, ye sab janne ke lie suniye hamari ye series..

hidden-ceo-4.title: Hidden CEO
hidden-ceo-4.description: சித்தார்த்துக்கு துரோகத்தால் நடந்த விபரீதம். அன்று இரவு சித்தார்த் யாருடன் இருந்தான்? சுயநினைவில்லாமல் ஒரு பெண்ணின் வாழ்க்கையில் விளையாடிய சித்தார்த்! யார் காரணம் ? இனி சித்தார்த் என்ன செய்ய போகிறான்?

thirudan-police.title: Thirudan Police
thirudan-police.description: கடமையா? காதலா? ஆதன் எதை கையில் எடுப்பான்? தனது சொந்த ஊரான மதுரையின் மிகப்பெரிய ரவுடியின் மகளையே காதலிக்க தொடங்கும் ஆதன் அடுத்து என்ன செய்ய போகிறான்? கேளுங்கள் "திருடன் போலீஸ்"

drass-ka-tiger.title: Kargil Ka Tiger: Captain Anuj
drass-ka-tiger.description: Ek aisa pal, jab 23 saal ka ek jawan, apne desh ki raksha ke liye maut ke saamne se guzar gaya. Captain Anuj Nayyar ki veerta ki kahani aapko Himalaya ke un uchaeeyon tak le jaayegi jahan zindagi aur maut ki daud hoti hai. Agar aapko asli patriotism ka ehsaas karna hai, toh yeh Audiobook zaroor suniye. Yeh ek shaheed ki amar kahani hai jo aapka dil choo legi.

విదుర-నీతి-.title: విదుర నీతి
విదుర-నీతి-.description: దృతరాష్ట్రుడు ” నిద్ర పట్టటం లేదు ఎమైనా మంచి వాక్యాలు చెప్పు” అని అడిగినదానికి విదురుడు ఇచ్చిన బదులు విదురనీతిగా ప్రసిద్ధి పొందింది. ప్రతి ఒక్కరికీ తెలివితేటలు ఉంటాయి. అయితే ఎవరు సరైన సమయంలో ఉపయోగిస్తారనేది అసలైన ప్రశ్న, ఎవరైతే తమ తెలివితేటలను సరైన రీతిలో వాడతారో, సమయస్ఫూర్తిగా ఉంటారో అలాంటి వ్యక్తులే జీవితంలో సక్సెస్ సాధిస్తారు.

the-hero-takes-revenge.title: The Hero Takes Revenge
the-hero-takes-revenge.description: Betrayed and murdered by the people he had sworn to protect, a Hero rises up from the ashes with a quest for vengeance.

Dwapar-Yug-शुरू-से-अंत-की-कहानी.title: Dwapar Yug: शुरू से अंत की कहानी
Dwapar-Yug-शुरू-से-अंत-की-कहानी.description: Rukmini kaun thi, jinhone Dwarka ko sambhala jab Krishna door the? Kya Dwarka sach mein doobi thi ya ye sirf ek kahani hai? Dwapar Yug ke aise kayi anjaane sach ko explore karna chahte hain? Tab zaroor suniye yeh show, jahaan aapko milega puranon ke saath saath science ka bhi tadka, aur anek aisi kahaniyaan jo aapne kabhi nahi suni.

ഡബിൾ-റോൾ.title: ഡബിൾ റോൾ
ഡബിൾ-റോൾ.description: ഭാര്യവീട്ടിൽ വെറുമൊരു ഭർത്താവുദ്യോഗസ്ഥനായി  വീട്ടുജോലികൾ ചെയ്തു  ശകാരമെല്ലാം കേട്ട് ഒരു വേലക്കാരന് തുല്യം ജീവിക്കുകയാണ് ആദിത്യൻ. എന്നാൽ ആദിത്യന്റെയും ദീപ്തിയുടെയും ജീവിതത്തിലേക്ക് പ്രതീക്ഷിച്ചിരിക്കാതെ ഒരു സൗഭാഗ്യം വന്നു ചേരുന്നു. അറക്കൽ ആദിത്യൻ സത്യത്തിൽ ആരാണെന്നു അവനു ചുറ്റുമുള്ളവർ അറിയാനിരിക്കുന്നതെ ഉള്ളു.

leila-khaled-aatanki-ya-baagi.title: Leila Khaled : Aatanki Ya Baagi?
leila-khaled-aatanki-ya-baagi.description: Kaun thi Leila Khaled? Jisne apni Bra mein bomb chhupakar ki pahli hijacking  aur fir hijack kiye 10 se zyada plane.Jisne akele hi Israel ko hila diya tha.Sab batayenge har raat 8 baje aane wale new episodes mein. To suniyega zaroor Leila Khaled : Aatanki Ya Baagi?.

pandavanmala.title: പാണ്ഡവന്‍മല
pandavanmala.description: പണ്ട്, വളരെ പണ്ട് പാണ്ഡവന്മാര്‍ താമസിച്ചിരുന്നു എന്ന് കരുതപ്പെടുന്ന പാണ്ഡവന്‍മലയുടെ മുകളില്‍ ഇന്നും അതിന്റെ അവശിഷ്ടങ്ങളുണ്ടെന്നാണ് നാട്ടുകാര്‍ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നത്.. ഐതിഹ്യങ്ങളുറങ്ങുന്ന പാണ്ഡവന്‍മലയില്‍ പക്ഷേ ആരുമറിയാത്ത നിഗൂഢതകള്‍ ഒളിഞ്ഞിരിപ്പുണ്ട്. അപസര്‍പ്പക കഥകളുടെ രാജാവായ കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥിന്റെ പാണ്ഡവന്മല കേള്‍ക്കാം.

njaanapusthakam.title: ജ്ഞാനപുസ്തകം
njaanapusthakam.description: വാക്ക് ഒരു നിഗൂഢതയാണ്. ഒരു വാക്ക് കൊണ്ട്  സൃഷ്ടിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന ഉത്തേജനത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് ജീവിതലക്ഷ്യത്തിലെത്താം. അനന്തമായ ശക്തിയുടെ ഉറവിടമായ വാക്കിന്റെ രഹസ്യങ്ങളിലേക്ക് പ്രവേശിക്കാം. അര്‍ത്ഥങ്ങള്‍ക്കിടെയിലെ വ്യാപ്തിയെയും അപാരതയെയും വായിച്ചെടുക്കാനുള്ള ഉള്ളുണര്‍വ് നേടാം. അതിനു ഈ പുസ്തകം നിങ്ങളെ സഹായിക്കും.

Money-Wise-आम-आदमी-की-फाइनेंशियल-गाइड-.title: Money Wise: आम आदमी की फाइनेंशियल गाइड
Money-Wise-आम-आदमी-की-फाइनेंशियल-गाइड-.description: Paise ko bina mehnat ke badhane ka tareeka jaanna hai? Is audiobook mein author Sharath Komarraju aapko batayenge ki, kaise aap apni hard-earned money ko smartly invest karke financial freedom achieve kar sakte hain. Bas abhi sunna shuru kariye aur personal finance ke secrets aur investment strategies jaaniye.

navodhana-kathakal.title: നവോത്ഥാന കഥകള്‍
navodhana-kathakal.description: മലയാളത്തിന് ഒരിക്കലും മറക്കാനാവാത്ത രചനകള്‍ സമ്മാനിച്ച തകഴി, ബഷീര്‍, കെ. സരസ്വതി അമ്മ, കാരൂര്‍ നീലകണ്ഠപ്പിള്ള, പി കേശവദേവ്, ഉറൂബ്‌, ലളിതാംബിക അന്തര്‍ജനം, പൊന്‍കുന്നം വര്‍ക്കി, എസ്.കെ പൊറ്റക്കാട് എന്നിവരുടെ നവോത്ഥാന കഥകള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

meignanam.title: Meignanam
meignanam.description: A parapsychologist battles a relentless spirit from his past, determined to claim his sister’s soul and complete a long-forgotten demonic ritual.

ved-sutra-jeevan-ka-saar.title: Ved Sutra : Jeevan Ka Saar
ved-sutra-jeevan-ka-saar.description: Kya aap jante hai is duniya ke shuruaat ke pehle bhi kuch tha! Lekin kya? Uska janm kaise hua? Kaise uska naam humare granthon mein shamil hai? Us chiz ki ya ye kahein ki us granth ki humare life mein kya importance hai? Jante hai is audio show mein!

adhirum-udhiram.title: அதிரும் உதிரம்
adhirum-udhiram.description: அண்மைக்காலமாய் பெண்களின் மேல் இன்னொரு விபரீதம் அரக்கத்தனமாய் பாய்ந்து குதறி எடுத்துக்கொண்டு இருக்கிறது. அது எதுமாதிரியான விபரீதம் என்பதை நீங்கள் அறிய நேரும்போது உங்களின் உதிரம் அதிரப்போவது உறுதி. ராஜேஷ்குமாரின் மற்றொரு அட்டகாசமான படைப்பு...

the-lost-brother.title: The Lost Brother
the-lost-brother.description: நியூயார்க்ல தன்னோட காதலி க்ளாரா கூட ஜாலியா இருக்கற முகிலன், காணான போன தன்னோட தம்பிய தேடி சென்னைக்கு வரான். வந்தவனுக்கு அதிர்ச்சிக்கு மேல அதிர்ச்சி, ட்விஸ்டுக்கு மேல ட்விஸ்ட் நடக்குது. அவன் தன்னோட தம்பிய கண்டுபிடிச்சானா?

Harshvardhana-प्राचीन-भारत-के-अंतिम-शूरव.title: Harshvardhana: प्राचीन भारत के अंतिम शूरवीर सम्राट
Harshvardhana-प्राचीन-भारत-के-अंतिम-शूरव.description: Kya aapko pata hai Raja Harshvardhana ne sati pratha ko khatam karne mein bada yogdaan diya tha? Ye toh bas shuruaat thi, Unke jeevan aur Shashankaal mein aisi hi kayi romanchak kahaniyan chhupi hain. Agar aapko janna hai kaise unhone apne samrajya ko badla aur Bharat ke itihaas ko ek naye mod par le gaye, toh ye show zaroor suniye.

the-detective-princess.title: The Detective Princess
the-detective-princess.description: From royal courts to crime scenes, a sharp-tongued princess wakes up as a struggling detective in the modern world. She butts heads with her brilliant but aloof superior while tackling dangerous cases. Amidst comedic cultural mishaps and thrilling mysteries, an unexpected romance blooms between the fiery ex-royal and the skeptical team leader. Follow their journey from mismatched colleagues to a formidable duo, as they unravel a sinister connection to the princess's past on Kukufm.

Kamdev-वासना-और-इच्छाओं-के-देवता.title: Kamdev: वासना और इच्छाओं के देवता
Kamdev-वासना-और-इच्छाओं-के-देवता.description: Kaam aur prem ke beech ka daav pech, jahan Kaamdev ne Shiv ji ki tapasya tod di aur shraap ka samna kiya. Yeh kahani kholegi raaz us moh maya ka, jo prem aur vasna ke beech kheli jaati hai. Suniye Kaamdev ki kahani, jo aapki soch ko jhunjhod degi.

kadhalika-neram-illai.title: Kadhalika Neram Illai
kadhalika-neram-illai.description: 💔  Kaadhalikka Neram illaama suthittu irukkura Business man Vishal - Romantic kaa vaazhanum nu nenaikira vandhana, Ivanga rendu perukkum idaila nadakkura Kadhalum Modhalum konda Kalakkalaana Kadhal Kathai thaan "kadhalikka Neram Illai". Indha kathai la Yaar Jeyikka Poraa Vishal la? illa Vandhana va? Vaanga Therinjukalaam 🔊🎧

కాళరాత్రి--Horror-Stories.title: కాళరాత్రి - Horror Stories
కాళరాత్రి--Horror-Stories.description: దేవుడున్నాడని నమ్మితే దెయ్యం ఉందని నమ్మాల్సిందే. చెమటలు పట్టించే దెయ్యం కథలు మీకోసం.

magic-mindset.title: Magic Mindset
magic-mindset.description: "Sahi waqt ka intezaar mat karo, apne man aur zindagi ko badalne ka jaadu Magic Mindset ke saath pao! Preeti Shenoy is kitaab mein aapko sikhaati hain kaise har mushkil ko ek nayi nazar se dekha jaaye, aur zindagi ke har pehlu mein khushi aur ummeed ka magic banaye rakha jaaye. Is kitaab ke tips aur kahaniyan aapko ek naya zindagi jeene ka nazariya dengi!"

Dabbu-To-The-Power-of-Dabbu-Challenge-Mo.title: డబ్బు టుది పవరాఫ్ డబ్బు
Dabbu-To-The-Power-of-Dabbu-Challenge-Mo.description: ఒక వ్యాపార వ్యక్తితో గొడవ పడుతున్న గాంధీ అనే తెలివైన యువకుడు ఎలా ఉంటాడనేది కథ. మీరు తెలివిగా ఉంటే డబ్బు సంపాదించడం ఎంత సులభమో గాంధీ పాత్ర ద్వారా తెలుస్తుంది. ఈ ఘనత సాధించే ప్రయాణంలో ఇద్దరు మహిళలు అతనికి సహాయం చేస్తారు. ఇది ఈ కథలో ఒక రొమాంటిక్ యాంగిల్. క్షుణ్ణంగా వినోదం!

IKIGAI-ఇకిగాయ్.title: ఇకిగాయ్
IKIGAI-ఇకిగాయ్.description: జపాన్ దేశంలో ప్రజలు అనేక మంది 120, 130 ఏళ్ళు వరకు కూడా ఆరోగ్యంగా ఉండగలుగుతున్నారు అంటే కారణం 'ఇకిగాయ్'. అసలు ఈ 'ఇకిగాయ్' అంటే ఏంటి? అదొక జీవన విధానమా? దానిని ఎలా అవలంబించాలి? అనే అంశాలను ఈ ఆడియో పుస్తకం లో విని తెలుసుకోండి.

222bbb70-5fcd-433f-9f90-ce9393624d1c.title: Gandhari - Kahaani Ek Vivash Maa Ki
222bbb70-5fcd-433f-9f90-ce9393624d1c.description: Yuddh mein sainik apni jaan gawa dete hain. Unki peeda unhi ke saath khatm ho jaati hai. Parantu uska kasht bhogne ke liye reh jaate hain unke parivaar ke sadasya. Wo jeevit to rahte hain parantu unka har kshan unki zindagi ko ek shraap jaisa vyatit karata hai. Is sandarbh mein ek Maa jo apni 100 putron ko yuddh mein kho de, uska hriday aakhir kaise usey jeene ki paramarsh de? Parantu bhagya se balshali bhala aur kaun hai? Hum sabko apni zindagi ko bhogna hi hai. Sawaal hai kaise? Jaaniye Mata Gandhari ki dukkhad parantu dhridhata se bhari kahaani se.

ഇസ്താംബുളിലെ-പെണ്‍കുട്ടി.title: ഇസ്താംബുളിലെ പെണ്‍കുട്ടി
ഇസ്താംബുളിലെ-പെണ്‍കുട്ടി.description: സ്വപ്നതുല്യമായ നഗരങ്ങളുടെ ഉള്ളുതൊട്ടറിഞ്ഞ യാത്രാവിവരണം. മനുഷ്യരെയും കഥകളെയും സംസ്‌കാരങ്ങളെയും വാക്കുകളിലൂടെ അനുഭവിപ്പിക്കുന്ന രചനാവൈഭവമാണ് അഭയന്റേത്.  ഷാങ്ഹായ് നഗരവും ഇസ്താബുളുമെല്ലാം കണ്ടതുപോലെ തോന്നുന്ന യാത്രാവിവരണ ഗ്രന്ഥം കേള്‍ക്കാം.

agents-in-love.title: Agents In Love ❤
agents-in-love.description: തനിക്ക് പറ്റിയ തെറ്റ് കാരണം  ഒരു കൊച്ചുപെണ്‍കുട്ടി കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ടതിൻ്റെ ഷോക്കില്‍ എല്ലാം വിട്ടെറിഞ്ഞ് നാട്ടിലേക്ക് പോവുകയാണ് ഏജന്റ് ആര്യന്‍. മാഫിയകള്‍ അരങ്ങുവാഴുന്ന റിയോ ഡി ജനീറോയില്‍ നിന്ന് കട്ടപ്പനയിലേക്ക്. കല്ല്യാണം കഴിച്ച് സമാധാനമായി ജീവിക്കാനാഗ്രഹിച്ച അയാളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിലേക്ക് പൊടുന്നനെ ഒരു പെണ്ണ് കടന്നുവരുന്നു. ആരാണവള്‍!

the-corporate-jungle-your-guide-to-under.title: The Corporate Jungle: Your Guide to Understanding Workplace People and Politics
the-corporate-jungle-your-guide-to-under.description: Corporate game jeetne ka tareeka samajhna hai? Agar han! toh ye audiobook aapke liye hi hai! Kaise bachoge chaalak bosses ke traps se, kaise karoge jealous colleagues ko handle, aur kaise banoge iss corporate jungle ke king, yeh sab seekhne ke liye abhi suno! Kyunki Yeh tips aapke career ko supercharge kar denge.

വേട്ട-.title: വേട്ട
വേട്ട-.description: സ്ത്രീകൾക്കും കുട്ടികൾക്കും എതിരായ കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങൾ കൊണ്ട് വലയുന്ന ഒരു നഗരത്തിൽ, ഡാർക്ക് നൈറ്റ് എന്നറിയപ്പെടുന്ന ഒരു ദുരൂഹ മനുഷ്യൻ , നീതിയിൽ നിന്ന് രക്ഷപ്പെടുന്ന ബലാത്സംഗികളെ വേട്ടയാടുന്നു. അധികാരികൾ അയാളെ.വേട്ടയാടാൻ ശ്രമിക്കും തോറും അയാൾ ജനശ്രദ്ധ നേടുന്നു. കറുത്ത ശക്തികളെ വേട്ടയാടാൻ ഡാർക്ക് നൈറ്റും അയാളെ വേട്ടയാടാൻ പോലീസും ഒരുങ്ങുമ്പോൾ ഉദ്ദ്വേഗജനകമായ ഒരു കഥ ജനിക്കുന്നു.

ರತಿ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.title: Rathi Rahasya
ರತಿ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.description: ಕಾಮ ಮೆಕ್ಯಾನಿಕ್ ಆಗಿರ್ಬಾರ್ದು! ಪ್ಲೆಷರ್ ಇರಬೇಕಷ್ಟೇ ಹೊರತು, ಪ್ರೆಷರ್ ಅನ್ನಿಸಬಾರ್ದು! ಆದ್ರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಇಷ್ಟ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಂಗಾತಿಗೆ ಇಷ್ಟವಿಲ್ಲದಿದ್ರೆ ಏನ್ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು? ಒಲ್ಲದ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಗೆ ಮೂಡ್ ಬರ್ಸೋದಕ್ಕೂ ಇದೆ ಟ್ರಿಕ್ಸ್. ಕಾಮದ ಉತ್ತುಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಸ್ವರ್ಗಸುಖ ಪಡೆಯೋ ಸಖತ್ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ರತಿ ರಹಸ್ಯ' ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

the-happiness-story.title: The Happiness Story
the-happiness-story.description: Kya khushi paana ek sapna hai ya humari ek choice? Apne jawab ke liye ab aapko duniya se ladne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Yeh show aapko sikhayega ki kaise aap apne dreams ko pursue karke, har din bliss aur shanti paa sakte hain.

secret-billionaire-34.title: Secret Tycoon
secret-billionaire-34.description: College student Damon Hemsworth is raised by a struggling single mother and mocked for his poverty. Dumped by his girlfriend and ignored by peers, his future feels empty. Everything changes with one phone call: his father runs the Serafino empire, the richest business family in the world. Given ten million dollars, Damon enters a life of secrets, power, and luxury. Caught between his past and his billionaire identity, he must decide if wealth is a blessing or curse. Listen to Secret Billionaire

kaid-me-kaatil.title: Kaid Me Kaatil
kaid-me-kaatil.description: Mumbai mein ek sensational case sabko hila deta hai jab ek jail me band gangster Vikram Saxena, IPS officer Arjun Sharma ko ek deadly challenge deta hai - ek mahine ke andar jail se bahar aaye bina india ke top 5 businessmen ko maarne ka Challenge. Jaise-jaise alag-alag dead bodies milti hain, Arjun ko ek shocking conspiracy ka pata lagata hai jo uske apne past se judi hui hai. Kya wo Vikram Saxena ko rok payega, ya phir usse realize hoga ki asli villain koi aur hai?

the-dunes-curse.title: The Dune's Curse
the-dunes-curse.description: A renowned monster hunter must confront the devastating truth about his life's work and switch sides to protect the very creatures he once slaughtered, racing against time to expose a far-reaching conspiracy and save his kingdom from an impending environmental catastrophe.

the-dreadful-witcher.title: The Dreadful Witcher
the-dreadful-witcher.description: In a perpetually rain-soaked village cursed by an ancient evil, a Witcher plagued by his own monstrous transformation must uncover dark secrets, battle a shape-shifting abomination, and confront his own humanity to break the curse before the next full moon claims more lives.

history-of-sikh-gurus.title: History of Sikh Gurus
history-of-sikh-gurus.description: Kya aapko pata hai, kaise Guru Gobind Singh ji ne sirf 40 Sikh veeron ke saath 10 lakh Mughal sainikon ka Chamkaur ki gadh mein muqabala kiya? Sikh itihas ke sabse bade balidan ki yeh kahaani, jahan dharm ke liye diye gaye jeevan ke sabse bade tyaag ne Sikh Gurus ka woh itihas banaya, jo aapko is show mein sunne ko milega!

nesippaya.title: Nesippaya..?!
nesippaya.description: Than vaazhkkai'yoda Pala varushatha coma la tholacha Arjun ku kutty paiyan Aadhi aala santhosha'mum vaazhkaikku pudhu arthamum kidaikkudhu. Aadhi yaaru ? avan eppadi arjun vaazhkai kulla vanthan. Idha aadhi oda amma'vum kudumbamum eppadi paakuraanga..?! thodarndhu enna nadakkum ?

miss-you-anbe.title: Miss You Anbe
miss-you-anbe.description: கார்த்திக் ராதாவின் அழகிய காதல், Long Distance காதலாகிறது. பிரிவு தரும் வலியையும் தொடர் திருப்பங்களையும் கதை வடிவில் சொல்கிறது, "Miss You Anbe"

bhootiya-rajdhani.title: Bhootiya Rajdhani
bhootiya-rajdhani.description: Dilli ke mashhoor ilaakon jaise 'Connaught Place' aur 'Mehrauli' mein chhupi hui bhootiya kahaniyan, jo aapko thoda darayengi, thoda sochne par majboor karengi. ye kahani Dilli ki sadkon aur itihas mein dafan raaz ko kholti hai. Ye kitaab Dilli ke bhhoto ke saath aapki mulaqat karwati hai, jahan har mod par ek kahani chhupi hai.

marriage-on-trial.title: Marriage on Trial
marriage-on-trial.description: Megan Clark, a former top model, impulsively marries CEO Ethan Grayson after discovering her fiancé's betrayal. As they navigate their trial marriage, Megan plots revenge against her cheating ex while rekindling her modeling career. Unexpected feelings bloom between Megan and Ethan as they face challenges in the cutthroat world of fashion and entertainment.

the-time-traveled-tycooness.title: The Time Traveled Tycooness
the-time-traveled-tycooness.description: A modern tycooness awakens in her 17-year-old body in 1983 China. Armed with future knowledge, Li Hua defies tradition to rebuild her empire and protect her family, finding an unexpected ally in a seemingly lazy heir. Can she outsmart her enemies and secure a better future? Find out in The Time Traveled Tycooness, only on KukuFM!

gangsters-second-chance.title: Gangster's Second Chance
gangsters-second-chance.description: Apni biwi ko ek IAS officer ke sath cheat karta dekh, Mumbai ke sabse bade gangster Vikram ne college join karne ka faisla liya tha. Hatash wo colleges ko call kar hi raha tha ki uske upar ek 17 saal ka ladka jo apni jaan dene ki koshish kar raha tha achanak aa kar gira. Aur agle pal jab gangster Vikram ko hosh aaya toh usne dekha wo usi 17 saal ke ladke ke shareer mein tha. Ye kaise mumkin tha? Agar Vikram ki aatma school student ke shareer mein hai toh kaha hai Vikram ka shareer? Kya hoga jab ek gangster ki aatma ek suicidal bacche ki shareer mein atak jaye?

ഓര്‍മ്മയിലൊരു-മണ്‍സൂണ്‍.title: ഓര്‍മ്മയിലൊരു മണ്‍സൂണ്‍
ഓര്‍മ്മയിലൊരു-മണ്‍സൂണ്‍.description: മുംബൈയിൽ തുറന്ന് കിടന്ന വാതിലിലൂടെ കാമുകന്റെ ഫ്‌ളാറ്റിലേക്ക് കയറിയ ശ്രുതി കണ്ടത് ഞെട്ടിക്കുന്ന കാഴ്ചയായിരുന്നു. ആരെയും മയക്കുന്ന മുംബൈ പക്ഷേ ശ്രുതിയെ മയക്കിയില്ല, അവള്‍ക്ക് ആ നഗരം കാത്തുവെച്ചത് ചതിക്കുഴിയായിരുന്നു. ഒടുവില്‍ എല്ലാം വിട്ട് ആഗ്രഹിച്ചത് പോലെ അവള്‍ ചിങ്ങപുരത്തെത്തി. ഇനിയുള്ള മഴക്കാലം അവള്‍ക്കായി കാത്തുവെച്ചതെന്താണ്.

Tretayug-शुरू-से-अंत-की-कहानी.title: Tretayug: शुरू से अंत की कहानी
Tretayug-शुरू-से-अंत-की-कहानी.description: Jab Satyug khatam hua aur Tretayug ki shuruaat hui, toh dharm aur adharm ke beech ka sangharsh kaise badal gaya? Janiye Tretayug aur usmein janmein avataaron ki kahaniyaan, jahan Bhagwaan Ram ne sirf Ravan ka vadh nahi kiya, balki samaj aur rishton ko nayi disha di. Agar aap Tretayug ki unsuni gathaon mein kho jaana chahte hain, toh yeh show aapke liye hai.

devil-calling.title: Devil Calling...
devil-calling.description: ஒரே குடும்பத்தில் அடுத்தடுத்து நிகழும் மரணங்கள். விடாமல் துரத்தும் 100 ஆண்டு கால சாபம். யார் அந்த DEVIL?

spell-devouring-mage.title: Spell Devouring Mage
spell-devouring-mage.description:
"In a world where magic is power, knowledge isn't just strength—it's breakfast."
Kidnapped and tossed into the Obsidian Spire Academy, Lucien Silverbrook is labeled a talentless Nullifier. But he's got a secret: he can devour spell books, instantly mastering their contents. As Lucien harnesses this unprecedented ability, he transforms from a powerless novice into a formidable mage. With each book consumed, he grows stronger, inching closer to his true goal: vengeance against those who orchestrated his abduction. In a realm where magic reigns supreme, Lucien will prove that sometimes, the most powerful spells are the ones you digest.

timelock-ateet-ka-raaz.title: Timelock : Ateet ka Raaz
timelock-ateet-ka-raaz.description: Mumbai ki forensic scientist Dr. Kavita Sharma ko milta hai ek aisa case jo uske jeevan ko hamesha ke liye badal deta hai. Gupt shaktiyon aur rahasyamayi sansthaon ke beech, Kavita ko apne ateet, vartamaan, aur bhavishya se ladna hoga. Kya woh samay ke chakra ko todkar sachai ka pata laga payegi ?

mukkona-kathal-kathai.title: Mukkona Kathal Kathai
mukkona-kathal-kathai.description: Azhagaana manaivi, aana nerunga nerunga aabathaa irukku'nra feeling dhaan Ragav ku. Thaan wife mela yerpadura pala sandegangalukku vidai thedi pogum podhu innum pala shocking news avanukku theriya varudhu. Adhellam enna ? Adha eppadi handle pannan ? Ragav oda manaivi innocent ah ? Vaanga... intha audio story la keppom...!

how-successful-people-think-11.title: How Successful People Think
how-successful-people-think-11.description: 🎯 Want to reach your goals? 💡 Learn how successful people think with John C. Maxwell. From creative thinking to realistic planning, this book offers the tools you need to change your thinking and your life! 🌟

parchhai-ka-pichha-the-bengal-crime-file.title: Parchhai Ka Pichha: The Bengal Crime Files
parchhai-ka-pichha-the-bengal-crime-file.description: Apradh ki duniya bahut purani hai. Shayad jab se insaan vajood mein aaya, tab se hi. Is show mein hum apke liye leker aaye hain Bengal ke kuch aise crime cases, jinme se kuch to ek century purane hain. Suniye aur bataiye, kya wo daur aaj se kya kuch alag tha?

married-to-a-mystery.title: Married to a MYSTERY
married-to-a-mystery.description: ப்ரியாவின் குடும்பத்தினர் அவளை ஒரு மல்டி பில்லினியருக்குத் திருமணம் செய்துவைக்க முயற்சி செய்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவளோ முன்பின் தெரியாத கார்த்திக் என்பவனுக்குப் பணம் கொடுத்து சம்பளத்துக்குத் திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறாள். கார்த்திக் என்பது யார்? அவனிடம் புதைந்துள்ள மர்மம் தான் என்ன?

ఓ-స్త్రీ-రేపురా.title: ఓ స్త్రీ రేపురా!
ఓ-స్త్రీ-రేపురా.description: మూడు నెలల గర్భిణీ కడుపు చీల్చి ఇంకా పుట్టని బిడ్డని ఉత్తరం లో ఉన్న అడివికి అర్పిస్తే దోషం పోతుంది అని నమ్ముతారు ఆ ఊరి వాళ్ళు,  ఆ ఊరే భైరవకోణ!. ఆ దోషమే "కాత్యాయిని" రాత్రి పూట పొరపాటుగా ఎవరు తిరిగినా, తరిమి తరిమి వాళ్ళ రక్తం తాగే పిశాచి ఆమె! అలాంటి ఊరిలోకి అనుకోకుండా అభిమన్యు మరియు కడుపుతో ఉన్న తన భార్యాతో వస్తారు. గ్రామస్థుల పైశాచికత్వం ఒక వైపు పిశాచి రాక్షసత్వం మరో వైపు ఈ పద్మవ్యూహం నుంచి మన అభిమన్యు బయటపడతాడా?

killing-fields-of-manipur.title: Killing Fields Of Manipur
killing-fields-of-manipur.description: Killing Fields of Manipur mein aapko dekhne milegi Manipur ke dardnaak hinsa ki asli tasveer. Janiye kaise ek chhoti si jhuthi afwah ne ek poore pradesh ko tabahi ki raah par dhakel diya. Janiye woh sach jo shayad aap tak kabhi pahunch nahi paya ho!

naragavasigal.title: Naragavasigal
naragavasigal.description: Pala amaanushyangal niranja kaadu. Ulla nuzhaiyurathu romba kashtam. Pala per ku ulla poi enna iruku nu therinjikka aarvam iruku, antha kaadu la vilai madhikka mudiyaatha porutkal iruku nu therinja piragu silar ulla poga muyarchikkuraanga. Appo dhaan oru thidukittum unami theriya varudhu....!

the-longest-kiss.title: The Longest Kiss
the-longest-kiss.description: Aaj bhale hi parde par kissing scene karna koi badi baat na rah gayi ho..lekin ek samay tha jab ise darshane ke liye do phoolon ka sahara lia jata tha..Aur phir wo daur badla. tab Devika Rani wo abhinetri banin, jinhone pahli baar hindi cinema ke parde par hero ko kiss karke desh bhar mein halchal macha di. Iske alawa ye aur bhi kai karnon se charcha mein rahin. Kya the wo sab karan aur kaisi thi unki zindagi, ye sab janne ke liye sunein hamari ye peshkash...

swipe-right-for-love.title: Swipe Right for Love
swipe-right-for-love.description: Mia, a whiz-kid coder, creates an AI dating app to prove love's predictable. Her secret ingredient? Unwitting heartthrob Flynn's photos. But when Flynn discovers he's the face of her experiment, sparks fly in unexpected ways. As they team up to fine-tune the app, Mia faces her biggest challenge yet: choosing between her perfectly-coded match and the real-life chemistry threatening to rewrite her love algorithm. It's head versus heart in this delightful rom-com where love refuses to compute!

idli-orchid-aakaasam.title: ఇడ్లీ - ఆర్కిడ్ - ఆకాశం
idli-orchid-aakaasam.description: జీవితంలో ఎదుగుదల, ఆత్మవిశ్వాసం, కష్టాల నుంచి బలంగా ఎదగడం వంటి అంశాలు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? ఇడ్లీ - ఆర్కిడ్ - ఆకాశం యండమూరి వీరేంద్రనాథ్ గారు ద్వారా అనువదించబడిన విఠల్ వెంకటేష్ కామత్ జీవిత చరిత్ర. దేశవ్యాప్తంగా 400 హోటళ్లను కలిగి ఉన్న కామత్ కథ ఇది.ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా వినండి.

asur-samagra.title: Asur Samagra
asur-samagra.description: Banasur, Jwalasur, Mahishasur, Raktbeej... aise kayeen anganit Asur Hindu Pauranik kathaon mein ullekh hain jinhone devtaon ko dharm sthaapna karne mein vivash kar diya tha. Jaaniyen unki rochak kahaniyaan jiske chalte aaj bhi acchai aur buraai ka yuddh jaari hai.

maids-guide-to-mafia.title: Maid's Guide To Mafia
maids-guide-to-mafia.description: When a clumsy maid accidentally falls asleep in the mafia lord's bed, she unexpectedly gains the protection of the ruthless Don, igniting a dangerous game of power, jealousy, and forbidden desire.

enga-veetu-mappilai.title: Veettoda Mapillai
enga-veetu-mappilai.description: Namma hero kalyaanam panni vaazhura veetula, thannoda maamiyaarukku maligai saaman vaangi kuduthu veetu velai ah seiyyuraaru, veetula avarukku mariyathai'yum illa. Oru naal avarukku oru call varudhu "ungala thirumbavum enga saamrajjiyathula sethukkurom" appadi nu. Ini avarukku avara suthi irukkuravangalukku enna nadakkum, antha call oda artham enna ? Ithellam intha swarassiyamaana kathai la kettu therinjikonga...!

the-last-dragon-keeper.title: The Last Dragon Keeper
the-last-dragon-keeper.description: "Agni" ek aisi ladki ki kahani hai,  jise majburi me ek hi waqt par do alag-alag zindagiyaan jeeni pad rahi thi : ek housewife, ek escort.  lekin escort ki life jeete-jeete agni drugs mafia ke ek aise dal-dal mein phans chuki thi jisse uski family ki life bhi khatre mein aa chuki hai. par tabhi agni ko pata chala ki wo ek Dragon keeper bhi hai aur ab use apni family ke sath sath ek Skylar group se duniya ko bhi bachana hai aur us dragon ko sahi jagah par pahunchna hai.

మధురమైన-ఓటమి.title: మధురమైన ఓటమి
మధురమైన-ఓటమి.description: విలువలతో నిండిన కథను గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? కథ లో ఒక యువతి కి మరియు పరిపక్వత గల ఒక మగాడికి మధ్య జరిగే చర్చ ని ఆసక్తికరంగా రచయిత్రి బలభద్రపాత్రుని రమణి వివరించారు. జీవితం లో డబ్బు మరియు ప్రేమ కి గల ఉన్న ప్రాముఖ్యత గురించి వారు చర్చించుకుంటారు. మంచి అంశాలతో మన ముందుకొచ్చిన ఈ కథ మీకు తప్పకుండా నచ్చుతుంది.

dog-series-mommy.title: Dog Series Mom
dog-series-mommy.description: A saleswoman, Jia, desperate to escape the obsessive advances of a married man named Ashley, fabricates a husband, inadvertently intertwining her fate with Chris, a single father whose two young, prematurely born children are in critical health and seeking a new mother. Jia, also known as Zia and Siya, enters a marriage of convenience with Chris, driven by the children's fragile health and her own past trauma of losing a child. Their unconventional union is fraught with hidden identities, as Chris, initially perceived as a bodyguard, is revealed to be a powerful CEO. As Zia becomes a fiercely protective wife and mother, they face external threats from vengeful figures like Zia's scorned ex-lovers and Ashley, all thwarted by Chris's unexpected authority. Chris secretly investigates a five-year-old tragedy, while Zia uncovers a web of family secrets and corporate deceptions, including a mysterious figure named Samuel and Chris's connection to an influential "Bade Sahab." The narrative takes a dark turn when Zia discovers Chris, also known as Mr. Clark, is her manipulative boss and a marital betrayer, linked to a traumatic incident from five years prior. A shocking revelation emerges: Zia's twin sons, long believed dead, were stolen years ago as part of an elaborate plot orchestrated by Chris's sister, Elena. Further complicating matters, Ziya, the presumed-dead biological mother of Mr. Clark's children, resurfaces, challenging Zia's role as "Mummy" and leading to a fierce battle for the children's future. Amidst these betrayals and revelations, Zia confronts Clark, who reveals she is the biological mother of his two children, a truth she already knew, hinting at a deeper, complex past. Ultimately, Zia's humble security guard father-in-law is exposed as a secret billionaire patriarch, who proposes a grand remarriage. Zia, a talented designer, wins a high-stakes competition, unknowingly designing her own wedding ring, which Clark, revealed as the competition's CEO and her husband, orchestrated to find the perfect ring for her, culminating in a public proposal to make their unconventional love story official.

when-silence-breaks-6.title: When Silence Breaks
when-silence-breaks-6.description: A powerful CEO’s pregnant wife finds herself trapped in a web of jealousy, betrayal, and cruelty at the hands of a scheming secretary. With her dignity torn apart and her safety at stake, she refuses to bow down. This is the story of a woman’s unbreakable fight for truth, justice, and her rightful place.

my-ceo-husband.title: My CEO husband
my-ceo-husband.description: A romantic drama about a spirited young woman who unexpectedly marries a cold, powerful CEO. What starts as a marriage of convenience slowly turns into a battle of pride, passion, and hidden emotions—until love finds its way through the cracks of their guarded hearts.

chef-kaanavillai.title: Missing Artist
chef-kaanavillai.description: His face is gone, his identity stolen, his love slipping away… Will he rise again or be forgotten forever? Watch to know.

you-are-my-ultimate-taste-in-the-world-3.title: You Are My Ultimate Taste in the World
you-are-my-ultimate-taste-in-the-world-3.description:
A fiery chef and a smooth-talking restaurant manager find themselves in a battle of flavors and pride. But as the competition simmers, sparks of romance begin to blend with every recipe.
A heartwarming rom-com where food, secrets, and love make the perfect recipe for chaos and connection.

marriage-justice-alliance.title: Marriage Justice Alliance
marriage-justice-alliance.description: Watch "Marriage Justice Alliance" Only On Kuku TV!

boss-ya-bhediya-4.title: Mi Jefe es un Lobo
boss-ya-bhediya-4.description: "Boss Ya Bhediya" es una historia romántica con toques sobrenaturales, donde una joven se ve atrapada entre su jefe dominante y un misterioso hombre lobo. Mientras descubre secretos ocultos y lucha con sus propios sentimientos, debe elegir entre el poder del amor y el peligro del instinto salvaje. Una mezcla de pasión, misterio y fantasía.

billionaire-scam-bride.title: Badnaam Billionaire
billionaire-scam-bride.description: Billionaire Scam Bride tells the thrilling story of Zara, a con artist who marries tech billionaire Aryan Malhotra under false pretenses - only to find herself falling for him. When lies start to unravel and Aryan discovers her secret, Zara must choose between running away with the fortune or staying to fight for the love she never meant to find.

secret-husband-9.title: Mi Esposo Secreto
secret-husband-9.description: "Secret Husband" es una serie romántica y dramática que cuenta la historia de un hombre poderoso que se casa en secreto con una mujer común, ocultando su verdadera identidad. A medida que la verdad comienza a salir a la luz, se desatan conflictos, emociones intensas y revelaciones sorprendentes. Amor, secretos y decisiones difíciles marcan el camino de esta apasionante historia.

the-girl-who-chases-the-wind-4.title: The Girl Who Chases the Wind
the-girl-who-chases-the-wind-4.description: In a remote mountain race, a female cyclist is murdered—her killer vanishing without a trace. Months later, her sister infiltrates the same team as a journalist in disguise, chasing justice on two wheels. But as secrets unravel and allies turn shadows, one question remains: who truly helped her… and at what cost?

saazish-1.title: Saazish
saazish-1.description: Saazish follows Aria, a fierce and mysterious woman who discovers she is the last descendent of an ancient dragon bloodline. As dark forces rise and kingdom falls, Aria must embrace her destiny.

three-brothers-dote-on-me-6.title: Three Brothers Dote on Me
three-brothers-dote-on-me-6.description: Lost as a child and stripped of her identity, Iris Turner rises to power as the enigmatic master of Eternity Pavilion. Betrayals and heartbreak fuel her transformation, as she reunites with her brothers and brings her enemies to ruin. In a world of secrets and vengeance, Iris reclaims her legacy—and writes her own happily ever after.

fathers-last-wish.title: Father's Last Wish
fathers-last-wish.description: Reet's life is upended when her engagement to Sunny shatters due to his betrayal with Karthik, her boss and guardian. Unbeknownst to her, Karthik is also her destined fiancé, a secret her late father kept, forcing Reet to confront a clash between duty and personal desire. A clandestine romance blossoms between Reet and Karthik, but Sunny's possessive reappearance compels Reet to declare an impromptu engagement to Karthik, setting the stage for a complex journey. Post-wedding, Karthik's doubts and an abrupt departure for work mar their wedding night, while Reet enters the corporate world determined to achieve independent success. She faces harassment and clashes with rivals like Abjeet and a returning Sunny, only to be dramatically rescued by Mr. Mehta, who is revealed to be her husband, Karthik. Reet insists on keeping their marriage secret, but workplace intrigue and Sunny's presence at Mehta Group constantly threaten this. As Reet navigates the cutthroat corporate environment, she clashes with Mrs. Mehta (Tina) and faces an impossible workload, while another employee, Tina, leverages a mistaken identity as Karthik's wife. Reet finds herself entangled in a volatile love triangle involving Kartik (a friend/past lover) and Sunny, leading to confrontations. Marital strain deepens as Karthik grapples with self-doubt and suspicion over Reet's late nights, launching a secret investigation into workplace harassment. Simultaneously, Reet's innovative idea is stolen by a rival Tina, leading to a fierce battle for recognition. The show culminates in public accusations of infidelity against Karthik, complicated by Reet's joyous pregnancy announcement, which Karthik meets with unsettling hesitation. Amidst these personal and professional turmoils, Reet (as Ri) also faces a marriage of obligation and accusations against her husband Naman regarding their unborn child. Ultimately, Reeth and Karthik overcome their insecurities, confessing their long-held mutual affection, suggesting a potential resolution to their tumultuous relationship.

ultimate-khiladi-4.title: Ultimate Khiladi
ultimate-khiladi-4.description: India faces a devastating cyberattack, crippling its defense network, until the mysterious tech genius Sameer Dixit emerges, neutralizing a self-replicating AI threat and earning national recognition. Concurrently, a ruthless CEO, also named Sameer, takes over his father's company, promoting Tanisha amidst corporate espionage orchestrated by her partner, Samy. This corporate world is marked by extreme authoritarianism, leading to the unjust dismissal of cybersecurity expert Sameer, who is then framed by Arnav for sabotage. Blacklisted and facing ruin, Sameer is dramatically rescued and recruited by the enigmatic CEO Saira Khan, who recognizes his talent and challenges Arnav's accusations, hinting at a deeper past. Their alliance sets the stage for a corporate drama where Sameer, now a lead engineer at Saira's company, pursues revenge and power. He is deployed as a 'fake expert' to infiltrate Saira's company while secretly planning a power grab at his former employer's AI department.
