Amidst these machinations, Sameer develops a romantic connection with Cyra, who offers him refuge after he loses everything. The corporate war intensifies with two rival teams, led by Saira and a manipulative CEO's father, racing towards critical product launches, making Sameer's loyalties ambiguous. Sameer, now an ambitious CEO, races to launch his own groundbreaking AI platform, but his triumph is short-lived as his company suffers a catastrophic system failure, caused by his rival Mr. Agarwal's son, who mistakenly fired a key expert. Arnav is forced to apologize to Sameer for using his code but then accuses Sameer of illicit business practices. Mr. Agarwal seeks forgiveness from Sameer for his son's past actions that nearly ruined Sameer's career. However, Sameer, still reeling from past betrayals, refuses to forgive Mr. Agarwal's son. The narrative culminates in a tense confrontation where Saira, who once saved him, reappears, facing Sameer's intense fury over a profound personal betrayal, leaving their complex relationship unresolved.

contract-kalyana-1.title: Never Again
contract-kalyana-1.description: Believing Rohan’s love to be true, Shreya feels her entire world collapse when she discovers it was nothing but a web of deceit. Drowning her sorrows in a bar, lost in her barren life, she unexpectedly crosses paths with Akshay. When she agrees to his proposal of a contract marriage, destiny holds a beautiful surprise in store for her. Will the love that once withered bloom again into a flower? Experience the heart-stirring micro-drama series 'Never Again', only on KUKU TV.

dushman-bana-dulha.title: Dil Wala Divorce
dushman-bana-dulha.description: Dil Wala Divorce follows Prapti, a woman betrayed by her own family and fiancé, who finds unexpected love and strength in Taksh, a mysterious businessman. What begins as revenge and heartbreak soon turns into a passionate, twisted romance.

ultimate-khiladi-3.title: Ultimate Khiladi
ultimate-khiladi-3.description:
সামীর, যিনি বেঙ্গালুরুর সবচেয়ে প্রতিভাবান টেক হটশট, যখন তাঁর কোম্পানির সিইও-র দাম্ভিক ছেলে অর্জব তাঁকে চাকরি থেকে বরখাস্ত করে দেয়, তখন তাঁর জীবন এক ঝটকায় বদলে যায়।
প্রতিশোধের আগুনে জ্বলতে জ্বলতে সামীর হাত মেলান সায়েদার সঙ্গে — যিনি তাঁর পুরনো কোম্পানির প্রধান প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী প্রতিষ্ঠানের রূপসী এবং দূরদর্শী সিইও। একসঙ্গে, তারা এমন একটি কৌশল তৈরি করেন যা অর্জবের বাবার কোম্পানিকে ধ্বংসের মুখে ঠেলে দেয়। যখন অর্জব বুঝতে পারে যে সে আসল প্রতিভাকে বরখাস্ত করেছে, তখন অনেক দেরি হয়ে গেছে।

the-big-bull-returns.title: Share Bazaar Ka Secret Billionaire
the-big-bull-returns.description: The microdrama chronicles the tumultuous unraveling of the marriage between self-made billionaire Daksh and ambitious CEO Samaira, a relationship initially strained by Samaira's corporate ambitions and Daksh's hidden identity as 'Mr. Ocean.' Their union is further destabilized by a barrage of accusations from rivals, alleging Daksh's infidelity with his childhood friend Nayesha, gold-digging, and even attempted murder, supported by photographic evidence. This escalating distrust leads to their separation, Daksh's eviction, and a bitter divorce battle, complicated by the revelation of Daksh's secret marriage to Nayesha. As Samaira reclaims her corporate empire, Daksh dramatically re-emerges, challenging her authority and demanding a divorce, while corporate sabotage, potentially orchestrated by him and Nayesha, threatens Samaira's IPO. Seeking revenge and solace, Samaira forms a romantic and vengeful alliance with Vicky, who pledges to help her dismantle Daksh's life. The plot thickens with the enigmatic Mr. Ocean, an investor who blackmails Samaira to divorce Daksh, hinting at deeper machinations. Driven by a thirst for retribution, Samaira and Vicky conspire to murder Daksh, but their plans are upended when Nayesha is abducted, presumed dead, and a murder is orchestrated to frame Daksh. However, Nayesha, having survived, works to expose the intricate conspiracy involving Samaira and Vicky. In a stunning reversal, at what appears to be Samaira and Daksh's wedding, Samaira is framed and arrested for an assassination attempt. The ultimate betrayal is then unveiled: Daksh, in league with his secret lover Purvi, meticulously orchestrated Samaira's elaborate downfall, revealing a complex web of revenge that consumed them all.

অবহেলার-রাজপুত্র.title: অবহেলার রাজপুত্র
অবহেলার-রাজপুত্র.description: রাজেন্দ্রর ৭০তম জন্মদিনে পরিবারের সকলকে আমন্ত্রণ জানানো হয়েছে। বাবার জন্মদিনে প্রত্যেক ভাই বোনের আবার দেখা হলো অনেক বছর পরে। দুই বোন মেঘনা আর প্রিয়ার একে অপরের সাথে সম্পর্ক ভালো হলেও দাদা রাঘবের সাথে পরিবারের কারোর সম্পর্ক ভালো না। পার্টিতে সবাই রাঘবকে অপমান করতে থাকে, এমনকি নিজের মা ও। রাঘবের উপহার কে সবাই ছোট করে দেখে। পরিবারের কেউ বিশ্বাস করতে চায়না যে রাঘব সত্যিই বড়লোক। কিন্তু বাবা রাজেন্দ্র সব সময় রাঘবের পক্ষে এবং তাঁকে স্নেহ ও করে। পার্টিতে রাঘবের তিন ছেলে আসাতে তাঁরা ও অপমানের মুখে পড়ে। তারপর সব সত্যি সামনে আসাতে পরিবারের সবাই মানতে বাধ্য হয়, যে রাঘব সত্যিই বড়লোক। আর রাঘব তাঁর তিন ছেলে কে নিয়ে পার্টি থেকে চলে যায়

vishwaroopam-father-of-3-bigshots-1.title: Vishwaroopam: Father of 3 bigshots
vishwaroopam-father-of-3-bigshots-1.description:
On his father’s birthday, a son presents a gift no one dares to touch. But inside the box lies a truth strong enough to shatter egos, fortunes, and long-held silence.
A haunting tale of family, pride, and the price of secrets—where opening the past changes everything.

anjaani-ladki-billionaire-ki-bahu.title: Game Over
anjaani-ladki-billionaire-ki-bahu.description: Game Over is the gripping journey of Bhavna, an innocent, kind-hearted orphan who is betrayed by her adopted rich family the Singhanias. From being humiliated and disowned to rising as a world-famous Master Healer, Bhavna’s path crosses again with her first love, Karan Thakkar, a powerful billionaire. Love, revenge, and redemption intertwine as the unknown girl becomes the billionaire’s bride proving that true worth shines beyond wealth and bloodlines.

rules-ranks-romance.title: Mission Mohabbat
rules-ranks-romance.description: When duty meets desire, hearts are tested on the battlefield of honor. Rules, Ranks & Romance follows Major Vikram Sinha and Dr. Juhi Singh two souls bound by loss, loyalty, and forbidden love as they fight corruption, betrayal, and their own emotions within the rigid world of military discipline.

ennodu-nee-irundhal.title: Ennodu Nee  Irundhal
ennodu-nee-irundhal.description:
A call shatters Anjali’s world. Her elder sister is DEAD. Anjali, a powerful CEO who had stayed away from her sister’s life, now suspects the heart attack was no accident. At her sister’s home, she meets her charming brother-in-law, a man with a dangerous weakness for women. He wants her, but she wants the truth.
This is a gripping story of lust, betrayal, and revenge. Watch the mystery unfold..

kismat-konnected.title: Kismat Konnected
kismat-konnected.description: Kismat Konnected is a high-voltage saga of passion, memory, and betrayal. Siya and Ved, two souls torn apart by tragedy and deception; spend years believing the other is dead. When fate collides once more, they meet as strangers haunted by love, their minds have erased but their hearts can’t forget. As memories ignite and buried truths surface, they must fight through lies, greed, and cruelty to reclaim each other. Because when love is eternal, even death can’t keep it apart. Watch now!

husband-i-forgot.title: The Husband I Forgot
husband-i-forgot.description: The series opens with Mithra's unsettling arranged marriage to the enigmatic Yuvan, a union quickly complicated by his family's secrets and his mother's disapproval. Their nascent connection is tested when Yuvan's six-month work absence leads to Mithra's isolation and his eventual suspicion of her infidelity, unaware she is an actress delivering a line on a film set. This misunderstanding culminates in their painful breakup, sending Yuvan into despair, further compounded by his controlling mother forcing him into an arranged marriage with Maya. Meanwhile, Mithra navigates her own marital challenges, including a divorce from Jeevan and a family tragedy, leading her influential grandfather, Thatha, to orchestrate her employment under CEO Yuvan, despite his vehement protests and denial of their past marriage. This forced professional proximity ignites a fierce rivalry between Mithra and Maya, who conspires with Yuvan's mother to secure her place in the family. Corporate power struggles intensify as Mithra's innovative ideas are sabotaged, leading to a critical medical emergency due to stress. During her recovery, Yuvan's complex romantic entanglements deepen with the revelation of Monisha claiming to be his wife, and Yuvan himself vanishes the day Mithra is hospitalized. The narrative culminates in a devastating car crash that critically injures Mithra, prompting a guilt-ridden Yuvan to desperately fight for her life. Overwhelmed with remorse for past wrongs, Yuvan tearfully pleads for her forgiveness, leading to their emotional reconciliation and mending their strained bond through Mithra's unwavering love.

boss-revenge-squad.title: Boss Revenge Squad
boss-revenge-squad.description: Nikita, a sales executive, discovers the clandestine "Boss Revenge Squad" (BRS), led by Ravi (KD Sir), after suffering public humiliation and assault by her tyrannical boss. She joins their ranks, alongside members like Anna and Rahul, as they operate from a hidden urban base, delivering vigilante justice to various corporate abusers and corrupt individuals. Their operations face an immediate threat when an unknown intruder breaches their headquarters, forcing the team to prepare for a dangerous confrontation. Meanwhile, other individuals and groups emerge, taking extreme measures to expose corruption and deliver justice where official systems fail, such as con artists uncovering crow meat in a hotel and a "Toss Revenge Squad" exposing fraudulent academics. The BRS expands its targets, confronting ruthless clients and powerful figures exploiting the vulnerable, while also dealing with internal clashes and the emergence of a mysterious 'Sir ji' and other powerful adversaries like Jayant. Ravi himself transforms into a powerful 'Boss,' navigating a world of influence and danger, even as he grapples with personal revelations and family estrangement. The narrative further intertwines with social media influencer Shanaya, whose digital life is destroyed by a cyber-attack orchestrated by a figure from her past, leading to an investigation that connects her father to the enigmatic 'Sirji.' As the stakes escalate, an industrialist launches a ruthless digital manhunt for vengeance, and a brutal fraternal struggle culminates in a sadistic villain forcing a sacrifice, triggering a massive explosion. Ultimately, Ravi's "Squad" rescues new companions, drawing them into their world of vigilante justice, solidifying a new brotherhood as they are forced to operate outside the law against powerful legal adversaries.

the-awakening-5.title: Mahanayakuda
the-awakening-5.description:
a land touched by the gods and cursed by greed, a fragile love story ignites into the flame of destiny.
Within the humble heart of Niranjan lies the dormant power of the Yakshas — guardians of the divine gems of Suryapradese.
When betrayal and bloodshed awaken his locket, he rises as the chosen warrior — the bridge between human suffering and celestial power.

rented-mappillai.title: Husband On Contract
rented-mappillai.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous journey of Vijay and Nila, two ambitious CEOs initially united by a desperate charade to escape familial pressures for arranged marriages. Both fiercely independent, Vijay is blackmailed by his ailing father, while Nila is trapped by a debt of gratitude to the obsessive Raj. Their initial fake relationship, proposed by Nila, quickly spirals into comedic chaos and leads to the discovery of their secret pact. However, their predicament intensifies when Raj, scorned by Nila's deception, transforms into a vengeful antagonist, threatening Vijay and demanding Nila as repayment for a significant family debt. A critical medical emergency involving Nila's mother then forces both their fathers to emotionally blackmail them into an immediate, coerced marriage, ostensibly to save her life. This unexpected union, however, is perceived by Nila as a profound betrayal, leading her to vow revenge against Vijay, whom she views as having cheated her. Vijay, operating under an alias, attempts to test Nila's love by living a middle-class life, fearing she only desires his wealth. Simultaneously, Raj unleashes corporate sabotage against Nila's company and publicly accuses Vijay of marrying her solely for her fortune, while Nila maintains emotional distance, defining their union as a mere contractual arrangement. The corporate warfare escalates with the emergence of Vicky, Chairman of VK Group, who orchestrates a partnership with Nila's company while also threatening her marriage. Nila's company faces a multi-pronged assault, and she suffers from severe depression as her "accident marriage" is exposed. Amidst these escalating conflicts, including Vijay being stabbed, Nila finally uncovers the shocking truth: her husband, Vijay, is the formidable MD of VK Group, and their marriage is a strategic contract. This revelation shatters her world, leading to a vehement rejection of their union due to the perceived betrayal. Yet, Vijay confesses his controversial choices were "all for her," driven by an intense, self-sacrificing love. This forces Nila to re-evaluate the true nature of his devotion and the complex web of deceptions, power struggles, and hidden motives that define their relationship, with their personal freedom, family honor, and corporate empires hanging in the balance.

the-cricket-god.title: Cricket Champion
the-cricket-god.description: The series opens with the enigmatic "Phantom Shot" shattering a cricket facility wall, igniting a desperate search for its elusive master. Initially, humble groundskeeper Saurabh is identified by a young boy as the prodigy, despite widespread skepticism and class prejudice from figures like Mahendra and Anjali. Concurrently, Mahendra, a dedicated player, is also believed to have perfected the legendary shot, leading to his captaincy as the team faces a championship threatening their home ground. A determined heiress, Sakshi, later confronts Sourav, convinced he is the "God of Cricket" who saved her life and can rescue her father's failing cricket legacy, claims Sourav vehemently denies, insisting he is merely a laborer. Despite his reluctance, Sourav, as the doubted 11th batsman, secures a stunning victory for the struggling Mumbai Ghatkopar Girgits, drawing attention to his "magical bat," which conspirators and rivals plot to steal, believing it the source of his power. Amidst these events, Sourav reveals he has an identical twin brother who was the true hero in a past rescue, further complicating his identity. He later learns his extraordinary, supernatural talent is inherited from his mother's "amrit," confirming his innate abilities despite his self-doubt and shattered equipment. However, his newfound recognition comes with immense pressure, as crime lord Mr. Singh blackmails him into captaining a team by threatening his mother, forcing him into a dangerous game of moral compromise alongside Rohan and Singh Sahab. Sourav is also haunted by the accidental death of his wife and unborn child a decade prior, initially resisting a return to cricket. A determined woman, Ria, confronts him with medical documentation, revealing his wife's death was an accident, not his fault, urging him to overcome his guilt and embrace a second chance. Their burgeoning romance is tested by Rohan's match-fixing schemes and Mahendra's treacherous plot to steal his mystical bat, leading to Ambar's rise. Ultimately, Sourav, displaying supernatural skills, finds redemption through Ria, culminating in a heartfelt marriage proposal, as he navigates deceptions, prejudice, and high-stakes cricket to save his loved ones and legacy.

love-for-sale.title: Love for sale
love-for-sale.description: Karthik is the richest man in Tamil Nadu. Just before his wedding, his fiancée Sushma humiliates his father by beating and calling him a thief. But Karthik’s love for his father runs deeper than anything. When the truth comes out, will it tear them apart or bring a storm of revenge?

15-saal-baad-wapas-aayi-waris.title: Waris Ki Wapasi
15-saal-baad-wapas-aayi-waris.description: When Priya returns home after 15 years, she brings with her the truth that can shake an empire. A story of identity, betrayal, and redemption—where every secret has a price. Watch Now !

captain-1.title: Flirt to Forever
captain-1.description: College girl Pavithra is secretly in love with Ashwin. But when Ashwin plots to deceive her, Arjun steps in to protect her—only to find himself falling for her. Determined to throw Arjun out of the college football team, Ashwin uses Pavithra as his pawn in a dangerous game. Will Pavithra see through Ashwin’s true face and realize the depth of Arjun’s love?

sister-revenge.title: Broken Trust
sister-revenge.description:
A wealthy family visits an orphanage to adopt a child. Meera is pure-hearted, Riya is cunning and greedy. Fate chooses Meera, giving her a life of luxury, but also starting a silent war. Years later, Riya enters the same mansion, claiming to be the family’s long-lost child. Lies spread, secrets surface, and the fight turns deadly.
A powerful tale of envy, betrayal, and revenge. Witness the storm.

fast-and-furious.title: Final Race
fast-and-furious.description: Once a world champion racer, Sanjay loses everything after a sabotage by his envious adoptive brother Shourya, leading to his father’s death. Homeless and broken, Sanjay gets a new chance when Ananya rescues him and unknowingly hires him as a mechanic. As fate unfolds, Sanjay re-enters the racing world under disguise, restores his identity, and defeats Shourya in a breathtaking championship finale—redeeming his legacy and exposing his brother’s deceit. Watch now.

man-behind-the-mask.title: The Man Behind The Mask
man-behind-the-mask.description:
“The man who won Ultimate Chef contest  wearing a mask… is now being hunted.”
Raghuvaran, the father of the defeated finalist, is burning with revenge—he wants to rip off the mask and expose the mystery chef to the world. Meanwhile, Mithra, who secretly loves the masked man, longs to see his real face… just once. But behind that mask lies not just a man—but a millionaire with secrets.
Why does he live with and without a face?
Will he accept love—or escape a trap waiting to destroy him?

iceberg-dad-dont-run-im-your-little-drag.title: Iceberg Dad Don't Run I'm Your Little Dragon Treas
iceberg-dad-dont-run-im-your-little-drag.description: A mysterious father hides a dark past beneath his calm surface, but his secrets begin to surface when danger threatens his family. “Iceberg Dad, Don’t Run, I’m Your Little Dragon Treasure” is a gripping tale of love, loyalty, and redemption.

finding-us-again.title: Finding Us Again
finding-us-again.description: While Ajay is still waiting for his childhood love Aradhya to come back into his life whom he met 20 years ago on a tragic day in both of their Lives, But Aradhya is moved on in her Life and she has her own struggles. When Ajay and Aradhya accidentally meet again their Love Life starts to blossom in an unexpected way and the life has other plans on how they both should get together after these many years. Watch “Finding Us Again” Micro Drama Series only on KUKU TV.

yudhdev-ki-wapsi.title: Billionaire ka Sauda
yudhdev-ki-wapsi.description: Beauty & the Billionaire is a modern love-hate saga between Kishika, a shy medical student burdened by her family’s debts, and Vikrant Singh, a cold, arrogant billionaire with a dark past. When fate forces Kishika to work as Vikrant’s personal secretary to repay her late father’s loan, sparks ignite between the fiery opposites. What begins as a battle, but slowly turns into a desire, power, and redemption, where love might heal the beast or destroy the beauty forever. Watch now!

ultimate-khiladi-2.title: Ultimate Khiladi
ultimate-khiladi-2.description: The biggest tech hotshot in all of Bangalore, gets sacked by his CEO's son. He joins forces with the beautiful CEO of his old company's competitor. This causes his former employer to go bankrupt, and when Arnav realizes he's fired the wrong guy, it's already too late.

ultimate-khiladi-1.title: Ultimate Khiladi
ultimate-khiladi-1.description: దేశ రక్షణ వ్యవస్థను శత్రు దేశ హ్యాకర్లు దెబ్బతీయడంతో, అత్యంత రహస్యమైన ఆపరేషన్ ప్రమాదంలో పడుతుంది. మన ప్రత్యర్థిపై తిరిగి దాడి ఎలా చేస్తాం విజయం ఎలా  సాధిస్తము? ఈ షో లో తెలుస్తుంది.

double-sided-maniac.description: Watch "Double Sided Maniac" Only On KUKU TV!

vishwaroopam-father-of-3-bigshots.title: Vishwaroopam: Father of 3 bigshots
vishwaroopam-father-of-3-bigshots.description: The microdrama centers on Raghava, an estranged son, who returns to his affluent family for his father Naanna's 70th birthday, deliberately presenting a humble facade to shed his status. His mother, Sneha, publicly shames him for his perceived lack of success and openly favors his successful sisters, fueling deep-seated resentment and intensifying sibling rivalries, particularly around gift-giving. Raghava defends his son Revanth's humble offering against Priya's attempts to discredit it, but soon faces public humiliation and accusations of fraud over his own wine gift, which is challenged against a rival's using a mysterious "scanner." He accepts a high-stakes challenge, with kneeling as a consequence, setting the stage for a perilous family feud. The conflict escalates dramatically when Raghava's wine is deemed counterfeit, leading to accusations of attempted poisoning and his public condemnation and disinheritance by the Patriarch. A renowned liquor dealer confirms a rival bottle's astronomical value, while an expert is poisoned after tasting the disputed wine, further implicating Raghava. However, Raghava is later vindicated regarding the wine's authenticity, producing an original bill and certificate, which he leverages to assert his dominance. He dramatically reveals himself as the CEO of a powerful international company, demanding humiliating public apologies from his father and other relatives, and claims his son is the reclusive Royal Group CEO, intensifying the family's power struggles and exposing corporate intrigue. A mysterious statue also links Raghava's distressed mother to his sponsor, Mr. Revanth, hinting at deeper secrets. Simultaneously, a parallel storyline unfolds involving Shiva, a habitual liar, whose son Raghu faces accusations of faking wealth and is unjustly fired due to a sinister corporate conspiracy involving voice-altering technology. Shiva's daughter, Shruti, uncovers a medical conspiracy involving a mysterious "Anti-Aging Elixir" at Daven Lab, further entangling the family in external threats and corporate villainy. Raghava, backed by his formidable mother and powerful Sky Corp connections, embarks on a ruthless ascent to power, strategically recruiting followers and issuing threats. Yet, his ambition clashes with the venomous family feud, and he and his three loyal sons are publicly humiliated and exiled by a tyrannical patriarch, prompting them to sever all family ties and vow to build a new legacy. Despite his efforts, Raghava's dreams are brutally shattered when a powerful executive exposes his false claims and deceit, canceling all business deals and blacklisting him globally. Amidst this downfall, an imposing outsider, Shiva, reveals to the family that they have unknowingly mistreated powerful CEOs living within their household, highlighting their ignorance of influential individuals. Ultimately, Raghava, disowned and cast out amidst accusations and past injustices, makes an unyielding departure from his family, refusing their pleas for forgiveness, leaving a legacy of unresolved conflict and severed ties.

give-you-the-rest-of-your-life.title: Give You The Rest of Your Life.
give-you-the-rest-of-your-life.description: Cecilia's life is shattered as she's disowned, pregnant, and discovers she unknowingly replaced her adoptive father's true daughter, plunging her into an identity crisis linked to a powerful lineage. Simultaneously, two manipulative children orchestrate an unconventional family arrangement, forcing Cecilia (also known as Mehak/Celia) into cohabitation with CEO Shaurya/Liam, leading to dramatic misunderstandings. Five years later, President Liam relentlessly searches for a mysterious woman, while Cecilia, now a "fake heir" and shop assistant, faces public humiliation, accusations of seduction, and the wrath of her adoptive family. She is falsely accused of stealing a sentimental necklace, leading to public humiliation and brutal physical assault by her adoptive family, the Limbats, who also pressure her into arranged marriages. Jessica, Cecilia's adoptive sister, emerges as a fierce rival, orchestrating cruel deceptions, framing Cecilia for sabotage and poisoning, and falsely claiming paternity of Liam's children. Throughout these trials, Liam Kane, a powerful CEO, consistently intervenes to protect Cecilia, asserting his absolute power and gradually realizing she is his long-lost love, the anonymous blood donor for his children, and their true mother. Despite initial falsified paternity results implicating Jessica, Liam orders DNA tests to uncover the truth behind his children's parentage. Cecilia endures multiple ambushes, torture by Jessica, and attempts on her life by Rosie in a burning warehouse. Amidst this, Cecilia is revealed to be pregnant and, unbeknownst to Liam, begins to orchestrate a sinister plan involving a secret abortion. The conflict culminates when Liam is severely injured, Jessica is arrested for her betrayals, and Cecilia suffers a grave injury leading to traumatic amnesia. To protect Cecilia's fragile mind, Liam and their son, Zain, orchestrate an elaborate deception, simulating poverty and hiding their true identities. As Cecilia begins to recover her memories, the truth of her past betrayal and Liam's quest for forgiveness comes to light. Ultimately, Liam and Cecilia reunite, solidify their family with two children, and have a grand wedding, though hints of unresolved history and a mysterious jade pendant suggest new dangers.

she-slept-through-betrayal-2.title: She Slept Through Betrayal
she-slept-through-betrayal-2.description: Meher, the adopted sister of the powerful Mehta brothers, volunteers for a perilous scientific experiment to save a family project, driven by an unspecified debt. Her life unravels with the return of Sameera, the family's biological heir, who manipulates the brothers, leading to Meher's abandonment, accusations of deception, and loss of family status. Despite severe health issues and cruel treatment, Meher remains fiercely loyal, secretly arranging to be the eye donor for her visually impaired brother, Gaurav, and planning a profound self-sacrifice to protect their legacy. The betrayal escalates as a family project is renamed to honor Sameera, prompting Meher to sever ties. She is wrongly accused of harming Gaurav and expelled from home. It is revealed that a cunning imposter has spent two years meticulously replacing Meher through forged DNA and manipulation, causing a deep rift within the family. Meher is later discovered confined and near unconsciousness, prompting the brothers, consumed by guilt over their misguided attempts to "teach her a lesson," to frantically search for her. Gaurav regains his sight after a successful eye transplant, but Meher mysteriously vanishes and is diagnosed with a life-threatening blood disease, which her family initially disregarded. Meher's heartfelt letters are discovered, revealing her past as an orphan adopted by the brothers and her deep affection. Gaurav then uncovers the profound secret that Meher was his selfless eye donor. Samaira, the imposter, is unmasked after brutally destroying Meher's scrapbook and attempting to erase her legacy. Surveillance footage exposes Samaira's emotional abuse and her scheme to usurp Meher's identity. Overwhelmed with guilt, the brothers realize their grave error in banishing Meher due to Samaira's lies and launch a desperate public plea for her return. Further revelations expose Sameera's hereditary heart condition and non-biological relation, confirming the imposter's confession of manipulating DNA to impersonate the true heiress. The imposter, Sameera/Sumaira, orchestrated a series of deceptions, potentially leading to Meher's perceived tragic death, to claim fortune and social standing. However, Meher's brother discovers she secretly volunteered for a perilous, groundbreaking experiment, trapping her for five years, a fate he desperately tried to halt. After five agonizing years, Meher undergoes successful eye surgery but awakens with complete amnesia, unable to recognize her own brother, shattering their bond and erasing her identity. The show explores the devastating consequences of deception, the profound sacrifices made for family, and the arduous journey of rediscovering truth and identity amidst betrayal and guilt.

revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend-3.title: Oru Contract Kalyanam
revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend-3.description: A bold CEO proposes to a man she barely knows—unaware he’s the reclusive owner of a global empire. When scheming rivals, greedy relatives, and a spurned ex-girlfriend close in, power games erupt in the boardroom and beyond. In a twist-filled battle of status, secrets, and love, the fake husband may just become the real deal.

the-ceos-maid-turned-out-to-be-the-heire.title: The CEO's Maid Turned Out To Be The Heiress
the-ceos-maid-turned-out-to-be-the-heire.description: Kelly’s story begins with heartbreak and sacrifice, as she pushes away the man she loves because she believes her troubled life would ruin his future. That choice does not free her from him; instead, the relationship returns in a harsher world of money, control, and unresolved feelings. Kelly is also fighting to protect a secret child, Emma, while struggling to survive poverty, eviction, and a cruel mother who exploits her at every turn. The mother’s demands, theft, and violence leave Kelly with almost nothing, and Emma’s urgent medical needs raise the stakes to a desperate level. A missing-heiress report and a crescent-shaped birthmark hint that Kelly may be tied to a hidden family fortune, but the truth remains buried under lies. Around the same time, Philip is trapped by a family marriage arrangement meant to save his company, and his search for the missing heiress keeps pulling him back toward Kelly. Their connection becomes tangled with workplace conflict, public humiliation, jealousy, and moments of protection that suggest both romance and danger. As the story widens, powerful families, adopted daughters, and false fiances turn the search for identity into a battle over inheritance and control. Kelly is repeatedly attacked, restrained, and pressured to accept a life chosen by others, yet she keeps resisting being used as a pawn. The mystery deepens when a child’s disappearance and a decades-old deception point toward a larger conspiracy around the Locke family. Kelly’s scar and hidden past become crucial clues, and the people around her begin to realize that the woman they have dismissed may be the true heir. DNA evidence eventually exposes Jessica as an imposter and confirms Kelly as the real Locke daughter and heir. That revelation collapses the false story built around Kelly’s life and forces the family’s long deception into the open. At the same time, Kelly’s bond with Philip shifts from conflict toward open choice, even as other romantic and family ties remain unsettled. The story also turns darker with abduction, a fatal hospital crisis, and the question of whether Kelly’s death was accident or murder. Yet even after loss and betrayal, the search for Emma and the truth keeps driving the characters forward. In the end, the family’s lies are exposed, Kelly’s place in the bloodline is confirmed, and Philip publicly chooses her. The final movement closes on survival, reunion, and a fragile new beginning built from the wreckage of the old one.

jingle-bell.title: Paisa, Parivaar aur Barbaadi
jingle-bell.description: The spirit of Christmas is tested by chaos, as Santa struggles to manage his gadget-making, accident-prone assistant, Victor. Multiple personal dramas unfold: a bitter rivalry flares between wealthy Martha and struggling Jenny over a decoration contest, two kids plot a heist to reclaim cheated toys, and a spoiled heiress is exiled to her poor uncle's home to learn humility.

revenge-of-xxl-husband-4.title: REVENGE OF XXL HUSBAND
revenge-of-xxl-husband-4.description: When a wife leaves her husband for someone new, she never expects him to return transformed—fit, confident, and unrecognizable. Drawn to the handsome stranger, she falls in love all over again… unaware he’s the man she once discarded. But this time, his heart belongs to the woman who stood by him in his darkest days—and together, they serve revenge cold.

she-slept-through-betrayal-1.title: She Slept Through Betrayal
she-slept-through-betrayal-1.description:
She thought her family was her safe haven—until love turned into betrayal behind closed doors. Every warm smile masked a knife aimed at her back, leaving her to pick up the pieces alone.
She Slept Through Betrayal is a gripping journey of deception, resilience, and finding strength in solitude.

supernatural-billionaire.title: Supernatural Billionaire
supernatural-billionaire.description:
She thought he was just another smooth-talking nobody living off her success - a man the world mocked as a gigolo. But when fate pulls them closer, she discovers he’s far from ordinary. she-slept-through-betrayal.title: She Slept Through Betrayal
she-slept-through-betrayal.description: She trusted her family to be her safe haven, but love turned to lies behind closed doors. Each smile hid a blade aimed at her back, leaving her to stand alone in the ruins of kinship. Watch the Show 'She Slept Through Betrayal'.

my-homeless-billionaire-husband-1.title: Kubeerudu

jade-dynasty.title: Jade Dynasty
jade-dynasty.description: A young man embarks on a journey after tragedy destroys his home. Lost between love, loyalty, and destiny, he is drawn into an ancient sect’s battles, where powerful clans, forbidden techniques, and hidden betrayals collide. As he struggles with inner darkness and unshakable love, he must rise against fate to decide whether he becomes a savior or a demon in the legendary world of Jade Dynasty.

twice-upon-a-time.title: Price of Love
twice-upon-a-time.description: "Price of Love" is a raw, emotional rollercoaster tracing Jhanvi and Dhruva’s star-crossed love. From their spark in photography school to a painful breakup driven by secrets and sacrifice, life pulls them apart through betrayal, ambition, and class war. Years later, fate brings them face to face older, scarred, and holding truths they never dared to share. A hidden pregnancy, a sick child, financial ruin, and burning passion intertwine as love fights to rise from the ashes. But will pride and pain win, or can destiny heal what time shattered? It’s love, but not the kind you see in fairytales."

mitthi-pareshani.title: Once upon a time on Christmas
mitthi-pareshani.description: The series primarily follows two intertwined narratives of family, ambition, and redemption. In one arc, Santa Claus, a demanding leader, grapples with immense pressure and critical deadlines for his gift distribution operation, frequently disrupted by the well-meaning but accident-prone inventor, John, often identified as his son or apprentice. John's untested inventions and mishaps consistently threaten to derail progress, leading to escalating conflicts and Santa's exasperation, even resulting in John's temporary banishment or firing. However, Mrs. Claus consistently intervenes, emphasizing family bonds and advocating for John. Despite their strained history, John eventually proves his brilliance with successful inventions, leading to Santa's profound emotional awakening and a realization of John's immense value, transforming their relationship into one of deep love and understanding. John is later promoted, continuing his inventive contributions to the workshop. Concurrently, the series explores the journey of Ananya, a rebellious heiress facing a generational clash with her traditional parents over her extravagant lifestyle. Her parents force her into a rustic village stay, hoping to instill responsibility, where she initially clashes with the lack of modern amenities and her cousin Manjari's expectations. Ananya resists traditional duties and attempts to escape, but after experiencing a drastic change in circumstances, she returns to help Manjari save her ancestral farm from financial ruin. Together, they devise a plan to convert the farm into a "village stay" and embark on an ambitious culinary venture, aiming for global recognition. This entrepreneurial endeavor, supported by family, faces sudden interruptions, but Ananya ultimately succeeds in saving her family's ancestral home. The show culminates in both families finding renewed purpose and strengthened bonds through overcoming personal and financial challenges.

the-future-is-streaming.title: The Future Is Streaming
the-future-is-streaming.description: The Future Is Streaming explores how digital platforms have transformed entertainment, giving rise to a new era where audiences control what, when, and how they watch. Blending insight, innovation, and real-world trends, it highlights the power shift from traditional media to creators and consumers shaping the future of storytelling.

veera-dheeran.title: Toxic Office
veera-dheeran.description: Mithran, A brilliant but underestimated tech genius faces betrayal from both his company and the woman he loves, leaving him framed and discarded. In the ruthless world of AI and corporate politics, he must outsmart powerful enemies to reclaim his place.

love-has-won.title: Love Has Won
love-has-won.description: A decade-long secret marriage between Hannah and powerful CEO Alex is shattered by Hannah's pregnancy, which Alex initially questions but then manipulates for an heir to his influential family. The situation escalates with the emergence of Mary, Alex's "other woman," also pregnant with his child, who publicly confronts Hannah. Alex abruptly ends his relationship with Mary, offering her money for silence, while coldly dismissing Hannah's claims and demanding she terminate her pregnancy. As Hannah fights for her legitimacy and the life of her unborn child amidst public shaming and physical assaults from Mary, a mysterious "Sir ji" orchestrates a ruthless attack targeting Hannah to seize power. Despite a protector intervening, Hannah tragically loses her unborn child due to a sinister plot by two plotting females. Concurrently, Mary also suffers the devastating loss of her unborn child, suspecting foul play and a cover-up. Alex's complex romantic entanglements are further revealed through his relationships with Rhea, Mehak, Maya, and Jia, exposing his secret marriage to Hannah and a past scandal involving a child's death. Hannah mysteriously vanishes, leading to a desperate search, and upon her return, she demands a divorce from Alex, consumed by grief over her son's death and contemplating suicide. Public figures like Prince accuse Alex of attempted murder and emotional torment. Later, Hannah awakens from a coma, publicly confessing to a manipulative past and clearing Alex of false accusations regarding her injuries, attributing them to an accidental fall. However, she also confesses to causing a child's death, seeking forgiveness but facing relentless retribution from Vanya, who grieves her own lost child. Hannah then counter-accuses Vanya's associates of assault and causing her miscarriage, blurring the lines of justice. Ultimately, after being pressured into signing a critical document, Hannah reveals a cunning plan for revenge, transforming into a formidable player who sees the document as a key to her freedom rather than a restriction. The show explores a ruthless struggle for power, legitimacy, and survival amidst a complex web of betrayal, manipulation, and tragic loss.

true-and-false-dragon-commander-3.title: True and False Dragon Commander
true-and-false-dragon-commander-3.description: రాజు ఆతిత్యుడు తన స్నేహితుడి ద్రోహానికి గురై, పర్వతం మీద నుంచి పడిపోయి చనిపోయాడు. కానీ కళ్ళు తెరిచినప్పుడు, తాను చనిపోలేదని, ఏదో విధంగా మళ్లీ జీవించే అవకాశం దక్కిందని గ్రహించాడు. అయితే, అన్ని ద్రోహులను కనుగొనడానికి తన అసలు గుర్తింపును రహస్యంగా ఉంచుకోవాలి.

madam-your-ceo-husband-will-save-your-vi.description: He’s actually a powerful CEO—living in disguise as a security guard for reasons only he knows. Just as fate would have it, a bold young woman arrives to protect a village… and unknowingly, his heart. A heartwarming tale of secrets, destiny, and a romance that asks: will their bond lead to marriage?

revenge-of-xxl-husband-3.description: Since she no longer likes her fat husband, the wife finds a new partner and divorces him. But by then, the ex-husband has found his life partner, who was by his side during that difficult time. And with her, the ex-husband takes revenge on his ex-wife.

bads-hacker.title: Bad**s Hacker
bads-hacker.description: Kapoor Tech faces imminent collapse from a catastrophic cyberattack, prompting CEO Sir to enlist the legendary hacker, Kabir, who swiftly resolves the crisis. However, the chairman's illness elevates his ruthless heiress, Sakshi Kapoor, to temporary CEO, who promptly fires Kabir for perceived unprofessionalism. This monumental blunder leads to a catastrophic server crash, exposing Sakshi's inexperience. Meanwhile, Meera Agarwal, CEO of rival Agarwal Tech, seizes the opportunity for revenge against the Kapoors, recruiting Kabir and offering him a significant stake in her company, hinting at a personal commitment. Unbeknownst to Meera, Kabir secretly plots a hostile takeover of Agarwal Tech, orchestrating a mass resignation to infiltrate the company with his loyal team. Kabir then initiates a corporate espionage plot against Kapoor Tech, using a deliberately flawed test framework while developing a superior system with Meera, who is driven by a deep-seated desire for revenge for her father's humiliation by the Kapoors. Amidst this corporate battle, a cunning schemer named Sunny plots to steal Kabir's identity to pursue an online romance with Sakshi, who is unaware of his deception and his role in a larger scheme to usurp her family's company. Kapoor Tech's VR launch is sabotaged, and an 'enigmatic outsider' (implied to be Kabir) claims ownership of the critical fix. Sakshi and Meera clash over high-stakes investments, with Kabir entangled in a complex love triangle involving both women. Ultimately, Kabir, fueled by Sakshi's past false accusation that led to his ruin, refuses to help her failing company, revealing his quest for calculated revenge. The series culminates in Kabir and Meera successfully acquiring Kapoor Tech, celebrating their triumph and planning their future together, while Suhana orchestrates the downfall of Mr. Agarwal, bringing the corporate saga to a close.

maaya-1.title: Maaya
maaya-1.description: మాయ.. ముగ్గురు అన్నదమ్ముల ముద్దుల చెల్లి. చిన్నప్పుడు అనాధగా పెరిగిన మాయ, అనుకోకుండా కుటుంబం ఏర్పడింది. అయితే కుటుంబం తాలూకు ఆనందం ఎక్కువ కాలం నిలవలేదు. ఆమె జీవితంలోకి శత్రువు ప్రవేశించింది. ఆ శత్రువుతో చేసిన యుద్ధంలో రహస్యం ఒకానొక బయటకు వచ్చింది. కుటుంబం, ప్రేమ, మోసాల మధ్య సాగే అత్యద్భుతమైన కథ.. మాయ. చూడండి. మీ "మాయ".. మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

oru-kanavan-oru-kaadhalan.title: My Unknown Husband
oru-kanavan-oru-kaadhalan.description: The series begins with Meera Krishnan entering a marriage of convenience for her dying grandfather, soon taking a job at Marina Enterprises where she encounters the demanding CEO, Karthik. Despite initial tensions, she becomes his personal assistant, leading to a simmering attraction and a sense of déjà vu. Karthik, pressured by his grandfather to reconcile with his estranged wife, is unaware that Meera is this forgotten spouse, a truth revealed after Meera is cunningly abandoned and brutally attacked. Karthik initiates divorce proceedings against Meera, fueled by suspicions of infidelity, while battling severe alcohol addiction, with Meera acting as his secret lover and reluctant caregiver. Their professional boundaries blur as Meera navigates his self-destructive behavior and faces a corporate scandal, framed by an antagonist, forcing her to clear her name under Karthik's ultimatum. Their hidden relationship is further complicated by Karthik's manipulative mother, who attempts to orchestrate his marriage to heiress Deepika, and a devastating car crash involving Meera. Amidst a complex love triangle involving a colleague and a mysterious man claiming to be her husband, Karthik's family disapproves of Meera, with his sister accusing her of past betrayal, yet Karthik staunchly defends her. Meera's life takes another dramatic turn with a surprising inheritance from her ailing father-in-law, who wills all family property to her, sparking fierce conflict. Her dying grandfather's wish for her reunion with her husband, Kannan (Karthik), further complicates her ongoing divorce efforts. After losing their marriage certificate, Karthik suddenly refuses the divorce, leading to Meera's shocking discovery that her formidable CEO boss, Karthik, is her estranged husband, unveiling the hidden truth of their arranged marriage. Now aware of Meera's identity and past struggles, Karthik desperately seeks reconciliation, leaving Meera to grapple with doubts about his genuine affection amidst corporate power and a past shrouded in misunderstanding, hinting at a profound, unspoken love.

assassin-wife-1.title: Assassin Wife
assassin-wife-1.description:

Will love save them, or has destiny already written their end? Watch now!

revenge-of-xxl-husband-2.title: Revenge of XXL Husband
revenge-of-xxl-husband-2.description: মোটা স্বামীকে আর পছন্দ না হওয়ায়, স্ত্রী নতুন সঙ্গী খুঁজে নিয়েছে,আর স্বামী কে ডিভোর্স দিয়ে তাড়িয়ে দিয়েছে। স্বামী অপমানে আর লজ্জায় ও প্রতিশোধের জন্য নিজের ওজন কমিয়ে আবার ফিরে এসেছে। হ্যান্ডসাম স্বামী কে চিনতে না পেরে প্রাক্তন স্ত্রী আবার তাঁর প্রেমে পড়ে । কিন্তু ততদিনে প্রাক্তন স্বামী খুঁজে নিয়েছে তাঁর জীবন সঙ্গী,যে সেই দুঃসময় তাঁর পাশে ছিলো। আর তাঁর সাথে মিলে প্রাক্তন স্বামী তাঁর প্রাক্তন স্ত্রীর থেকে প্রতিশোধ নেয়।

phoolon-ka-taaron-ka-1.title: Phoolon ka Taaron Ka
phoolon-ka-taaron-ka-1.description: তিন ভাই ও তাদের হারিয়ে যাওয়া বোনের কাহিনী। ছোটবেলায় প্রিয় বোনকে হারিয়ে ফেলে তিন দাদা। এক অন্য মেয়েকে দত্তক নিয়ে বোনের স্বীকৃতি দিয়ে বড় করে। কিন্তু পরে অন্য একটা মেয়ে আসল বোন বলে নিজেকে জাহির করার চেষ্টা করে। তারপরই শুরু হয় গোলমাল। আসল আর নকল বোনের মধ্যে দ্বন্দ্বের সৃষ্টি হয়। শেষমেশ দেখা যায়, যাকে দত্তক নিয়েছিল সেই তাদের আসল হারিয়ে যাওয়া বোন। এভাবেই দাদা ও বোনের মিল হয় এবং নকল মেয়েটি পরাজিত হয়।

rajvaidya-prithvi.title: Secret Divorce
rajvaidya-prithvi.description: Secret Divorce is the story of Dr. Ravi Bharghav, a brilliant scientist whose family turns against him. Heartbroken Ravi leaves home to join a secret government project, but fate pulls him back when his family falls apart, his son's life is in danger, and his wife finally realises what she has lost.

love-refresh-1.title: Love Refresh
love-refresh-1.description: A grieving mother who lost her daughter crosses paths with a single father ready to marry for his child’s sake. As their lives intertwine, a new chapter begins—one shaped by healing, understanding, and unexpected love. Love Refresh is a heartwarming tale of second chances, emotional rebirth, and love born out of shared loss.

worst-girlfriend.title: Worst Girlfriend
worst-girlfriend.description: Dia, a struggling influencer, launches the audacious "Worst Girlfriend Challenge" with unsuspecting Aarav, aiming for viral fame after her breakup videos fail. What begins as a cynical social media experiment quickly blurs the lines as Dia develops genuine feelings for Aarav, even as another admirer, Aman, complicates her emotional landscape. Despite her growing affection, Dia continues her manipulative schemes for online content, creating tension and straining her bond with Aarav, who yearns for a real connection. The deception culminates when Aarav discovers their relationship was a calculated wager for content, leading to his profound heartbreak and a confrontation. Grappling with immense guilt and realizing her true feelings, Dia desperately seeks Aarav's forgiveness, attempting to confess her past actions and mend their broken trust. She publicly apologizes for her facade and commits to an authentic life with Aarav, but their path is dramatically interrupted by the arrival of Kabir, her obsessive ex-lover and manipulative manager. Kabir relentlessly pursues Dia, threatening to expose past secrets and sabotage her relationship with Aarav, asserting his control over her career and identity. A devastating scandal erupts when intimate videos of Dia and Kabir are leaked, shattering her relationship with Aarav and damaging her public image. Kabir exploits the situation to rekindle their toxic romance, promising fame, while Aarav desperately warns Dia about Kabir's transactional agenda. Torn by indecision and seeking acceptance, Dia initially pushes Aarav away, leading to their painful breakup and her temporary alignment with Kabir for content. Ultimately, Dia defies Kabir's emotional tyranny and threats, recognizing the value of genuine connection over superficial fame. With Aarav's unwavering support, she reclaims her identity, publicly apologizes for her past, and commits to an authentic future, leaving her tumultuous past behind to embrace a real life with Aarav.

in-search-of-her-daughter.title: In Search of Her Daughter
in-search-of-her-daughter.description:
From a shadowed past to the hope of motherhood, she fought to rewrite her fate. When destiny cruelly snatched her daughter away, survival demanded compromises she never imagined.
Now, her relentless search becomes a battle against every odd, driven by love no force can silence.

z-plus-bodyguard.title: Bad**s Bodyguard
z-plus-bodyguard.description: Bad**s Bodyguard follows Arya Dixit, a strong-willed billionaire CEO who rebels against her manipulative family’s plan to marry her off for money, only to find unexpected love and protection in her bodyguard, Neel. Their relationship sparks a storm of betrayal, power struggles, and hidden truths as love collides with greed and deception.

chinese-new-year-the-hidden-dragon-retur.title: Chinese New Year: The Hidden Dragon Returns to the Village
chinese-new-year-the-hidden-dragon-retur.description: When a long-vanished figure returns to his ancestral village during Chinese New Year, old secrets stir beneath the firecracker celebrations. Caught between tradition and change, he must face the ghosts of his past and the legacy he left behind. A gripping tale of mystery, redemption, and the hidden power of homecoming.

a-lament-for-troubled-times-3.title: A Lament For Troubled Times
a-lament-for-troubled-times-3.description: Sold into a powerful noble family, a voiceless bride endures cruelty and manipulation from her tyrant husband. But as secrets unravel and false faces are exposed, her silence becomes her sharpest weapon. A sweeping tale of betrayal, power, and a woman’s unbreakable fight for dignity and freedom.

mere-boyfriend-ki-dangerous-family.title: Final Blunder
mere-boyfriend-ki-dangerous-family.description: “Mere boyfriend ki dangerous family” follows Vidya Sarabhai, the humble yet dignified mother of billionaire Madhav Sarabhai, who faces humiliation and brutality from corrupt resort staff during a cruise trip gone wrong. Mistaken for a poor woman, she endures cruelty until her true identity is revealed, leading to the downfall of her tormentors. The story unfolds into a gripping revenge and redemption drama where greed, arrogance, and kindness collide, ending with family reunion. Watch now.

drop-alert-mr-nan-1.title: Drop Alert, Mr. Nan
drop-alert-mr-nan-1.description:
A rising fashion designer fights to make her mark in the glamorous world of haute couture. But behind the runway lights lies a darker mission—to avenge the parents she lost to injustice.
A fierce saga of ambition, revenge, and the unstoppable will to triumph against all odds.

fakir-sultan.title: Fakir Badshah
fakir-sultan.description: When Princess Ananya Suryavanshi is betrayed and reborn, destiny gives her a second chance — to rewrite her fate and uncover the truth about the mysterious “beggar” she marries, Prithvi, who hides a royal secret. As greed, power, and vengeance drive her sister Radhika to ruin, Ananya rises from ashes — from Fakir’s wife to Sultan’s queen.

dual-plants-decision-3.title: Dual Plants' Decision
dual-plants-decision-3.description: A powerful man’s inner journey unfolds between the ruins of his fallen empire and his unshakable resolve to return. Here, thirst is not for water, but for immortality, and silence speaks louder than any battle cry. A grand symphony of glory, sacrifice, and the relentless will to rise again.

teen-patti.title: Teen Patti
teen-patti.description:
The game introduced by Shakuni in Bharat once led to the fall of empires.
Now, it returns in the form of Teen Patti — seeking new victims.
Shuffle the cards… fortune or ruin — your destiny lies in your own hands.

crorepati-cakewala.title: Crorepati Cakewala
crorepati-cakewala.description: Karan, a poor scrap-collector boy, struggles to save his cancer-stricken mother, unaware he’s the lost heir of the powerful Rathore family. Twenty years later, Rama Rathore has built an empire but still searches for her vanished son. Fate brings them face-to-face, mother and son, unaware of their blood bond, just as betrayal, greed, and revenge close in. The moment truth surfaces, everything they’ve built may burn, because the royal prince is about to return. Watch Now!

after-the-divorce-the-heiress-takes-it-a.description: After the divorce, the heiress takes it all

himraj-aur-naagrani.title: Billionaire Papa
himraj-aur-naagrani.description: Anika, an ambitious student, faces expulsion and a revoked scholarship due to her absent father, while a powerful man, Sanjay, relentlessly searches for his missing daughter, also named Anika. Simultaneously, a dying patriarch seeks a father figure for his granddaughter, Anika, hinting at deeper family secrets and a mysterious DNA investigation. Anika, living a solitary life, is publicly humiliated as an "unclaimed orphan," prompting a protective intervention from Vikrant, whose deception is later revealed. Orphaned, Anika is then adopted into a family by Bhai, where she is exploited as a bone marrow donor for their critically ill son, Aditya, enduring abuse from her adoptive mother and brother, Aadi, though she forms an unexpected bond with Aadi. Her situation worsens as her guardians, Radhika and Anuj, force her to lie to her concerned father, Amar, and plot her expulsion. During the bone marrow procedure for Aditya, Dr. Singh's ethical stance exposes Radhika and Anuj's lies, and a shocking DNA revelation confirms Anika is Amar's long-lost biological daughter. While Aditya's surgery is successful, Anika's condition rapidly deteriorates, leading Amar to disown Radhika and Anuj, as a mysterious manipulator attempts to alter Anika's medical reports. Meanwhile, a critically ill girl, Sweety, is transformed into "Anika" by a benefactor and presented as Amar's long-lost daughter, sparking fierce family conflict and rejection from Dadaji, despite a devoted son's defense. The truth eventually emerges: Sweety is an imposter, and the true Anika was abandoned due to a medical conspiracy involving a falsified DNA report. Rishi, Anika's biological father, uncovers his brother Anuj's fraud to usurp family wealth. Rahul dramatically exposes the imposter, revealing Anika as the true granddaughter, leading the Patriarch to profound guilt and the disownment of deceitful family members. Anika, now living in poverty, confronts her estranged wealthy father, Amar Saxena, who, burdened by guilt and sent by her grandfather, orchestrates a complete erasure of her past to declare her his legitimate daughter, beginning to form a tender bond despite lingering questions about her origins.

in-search-of-pretty-baby-1.title: The Billionaire Baby's Real Mother
in-search-of-pretty-baby-1.description: A woman trapped in the world of prostitution is forced to give up her newborn child during a traumatic phase of life. Unbeknownst to her, the child is adopted and raised in a billionaire’s household, growing up with luxury and identity far from his true roots. Years later, fate intervenes when the same billionaire accidentally rescues the now-worn woman and offers her shelter in his home. While staying there, she stumbles upon a shocking truth—her long-lost son is the very boy raised in that mansion. A heartbreaking reunion unfolds, as blood ties surface amidst wealth, secrets, and redemption.

ভালোবাসার-নতুন-ঠিকানা.title: ভালোবাসার নতুন ঠিকানা
ভালোবাসার-নতুন-ঠিকানা.description: কজন মা, যে তার সন্তানকে হারিয়েছে, আর একজন বাবা, যে নিজের মেয়ের জন্য বিয়ে করছে — তাদের মাঝখানে গড়ে ওঠা ভালোবাসা আর আবেগ নিয়েই 'ইলামাই থিরুম্বুথে'। এই মন ছুঁয়ে যাওয়া গল্পটা মিস করবেন না!

chaar-amir-ek-laadli.title: Deal with Billionaire
chaar-amir-ek-laadli.description: “Deal with Billionaire” is a dramatic saga of love, betrayal, and destiny that follows Simran, a humble waitress who unknowingly belongs to a wealthy family. After years of struggle, heartbreak, and deceit, her life changes when she reunites with her four rich brothers and faces powerful enemies, toxic relationships, and a world of greed while fighting to reclaim her identity and self-respect

rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-5.title: Rebirth: My Cheat Code Life
rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-5.description:
After a painful divorce, a once-silent wife returns fiercer than ever—shaking the elite with her rise to power. From humiliation to dominance, she takes down those who wronged her, one by one.
A revenge-fueled saga of strength, transformation, and the brutal cost of underestimating a woman.

puriyadha-pudhir.title: Puriyadha Pudhir S 1
puriyadha-pudhir.description: திருமணம் முடிந்த ஒரு வாரத்தில் நான்சியின் கணவர் ஜென்சன் கொலை செய்யப்படுகிறான். சந்தேகத்தின் பெயரில் 5 சஸ்பெக்ட்ஸ். இன்ஸ்பெக்டர் ரகு கையில் சிக்குவான கொலைகாரன்?

billionaire-servant.title: Billionaire Servant
billionaire-servant.description: "Aaj se tum mere joote polish karoge Billionaire Veer!" Kai Saalon baad Veer Raheja jab ghar lauta to uski saari duniya hi palat gayi. Uski Dad ki company Raheja Industries koi aur chalaa raha tha, uske ghar pe koi aur hukm chalaa raha tha, aur uski maa ko apne hi ghar pe rehne ke liye ek chotaa sa kamra de diya gaya tha. Aur ye sab karne vala tha us ghar ka vafadaar servant Vikram! Kya Veer apne Dad ki khoyi hui izzat aur daulat vapas la paega?

vanavasi.title: వనవాసి
vanavasi.description: కథకుడు తాను వనంలో గడిపిన ఆరేళ్ళ జీవితాన్ని నెమరు వేసుకుంటూ, తాను మొదటగా అరణ్యం లో అడుగు పెట్టినప్పటి నుంచి, మరలా బయటకు వచ్చే వరకు జరిగిన పరిణామాలని ఎంతో అందం గా వర్ణించాడు. ఒక వనవాసి గా అక్కడి పరిస్థితులని, అక్కడి జనాలని, వారి అభిరుచుల్ని, ఆహార అలవాట్లని, దైనందిన జీవితాన్ని మన కళ్ళకు కట్టినట్టు చూపించారు కథకుడు. అరణ్యం, ప్రకృతి, చెట్లు ఇటువంటి ని ఇష్టపడేవారు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ ను తప్పక ఇష్టపడతారు.

col-ekalingam-adventures.title: కల్నల్ ఏకలింగం అడ్వెంచర్స్
col-ekalingam-adventures.description: కల్నల్ ఏకలింగం పరిష్కరించే కేసులు చాలా ఆసక్తికరంగా ఉంటాయి.అతని సాహసాలు అద్భుతమైనవి. ఇతనికి ఎదురు వచ్చే సవాళ్లు మరియు అవి ఎలా పరిష్కరిస్తాడో అనేది కథలలో ప్రాముఖ్యంగా ఉంటుంది. మల్లాది వెంకట కృష్ణమూర్తి గారి హాస్యంతో కలిసిన సస్పెన్స్ కథలను ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా వినండి.

gangster-agent.title: Gangster Agent
gangster-agent.description: 2045 ka top RAW agent Arjun Singh ek janm-maran ke mission par hai, lekin ek dhokha uski zindagi palat deta hai. Jab uska consciousness 2025 mein ek gangster ke sharir mein phas jata hai, Kaalchakra ki chal aur waqt ke khel mein, kya Arjun apna maksad poora kar payega?

the-ultimate-son-in-law.title: The Silent Son In Law
the-ultimate-son-in-law.description: Namma kathai'yoda hero oru kudumbathoda marumagan. 10 varushama avar pesala. Idhukku kaaranam ennava irukum ? Yen kuripittu pathu varusham pesala ? Athoda vilaivugal enna ? Pathu varusham kazhichu pesa aarambikku podhu, avana suthi irukkuravangaloda vaazhkai eppadi maaruthu nu indha sawarasiyamaana kathai la kettu entertain aagunga...!

bhoot-hunters.title: Bhoot Hunters
bhoot-hunters.description: "Teri bacchi tab tak mere paas rahegi jab tak tu mere pishach mujhe vaapas nahin kar deta!" Saahil aur Vidya ne ab tak hazaron pishacho ko maara tha, lekin jab pishach Kaatim ne unki bacchi Aisha ko chura liya to unke pairon tale zameen khisak gayi. Aur bacchi ke badle Kaatim ne manga unse Bhoot Hunting chodne ka vada!! Kya Saahil aur Vidya Bhoot Hunting chod denge? Aur kaise bachaenge vo apni bacchi Aisha ko?

love-to-hate-you-1.title: Love to Hate you
love-to-hate-you-1.description:
అమ్మాయిలంటేనే పడని ఓ యారొగెంట్ బిలియనీర్‌ బిజినెస్‌మెన్ రాహుల్ శర్మ. సవతి తల్లి మోసం చేసి ఇష్టం లేని పెళ్లి చేయబోతుంటే ఇంటి నుంచి పారిపోయిన మోడ్రన్ అమ్మాయి ప్రియ.వాళ్లిద్దరినీ అనుకోకుండా కలిపిందో రాత్రి. ఆ రాత్రి ఇద్దరూ స్వర్గ సుఖాలు అనుభవించారు. 
అప్పటి నుంచి రాహుల్‌కి ప్రియ అంటే విపరీతమైన మోజు. కానీ ప్రియ దృష్టిలో మాత్రం రాహుల్ ఓ బీస్ట్. మరి ఇలాంటి వీరిద్దరినీ డెస్టినీ ఎలా కలిపింది? వీళ్ల మధ్య ప్రేమెలా పుట్టింది..? వీళ్లిద్దరి లైఫ్‌లని మార్చిన ఆ మోస్ట్ ఇంపార్టెంట్ సీక్రెట్ ఏంటి..? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.!

irumbile-oru-iruthayam.title: Irumbile Oru Iruthayam
irumbile-oru-iruthayam.description: Robots nijamave intha ulagathukku thevai thaana? Robots aala manushangalai replace panna mudiyuma? Meera voda project Aishu vai eppadi affect panna poguthu ? Vaanga Robot ulagathukulla pogalaam.

andhkaar-ka-samrajya.title: Vidyut The Immortal Gamer
andhkaar-ka-samrajya.description: Ek gamer ka gaming addiction use le jata hai ek aisa fantasy world mein, jahan uska har faislea ban jayea ek kharatnaak sach. Ab is accidental hero ko apne special powers se na sirf ancient India ko evil Chandal se bachana hai, balki poore Samrajya ki qismat bhi  tay karni hai!

family-man.title: Family Man
family-man.description: Oru Family Man thannoda kudumbathai kaapatha enna venaalum seivaan. Varadharajan kudumbathukkum Rathinam kudumbathukkum irukkura pagai romba perusu. Ithunaala Varadharajan kudumbathukku erpatta izhappum romba perusu. Vaanga oru nalla kudumba kathai ah kekalaam.

ഒരു-Viral-പ്രണയകഥ-.title: ഒരു Viral പ്രണയകഥ
ഒരു-Viral-പ്രണയകഥ-.description: സ്വന്തം അറേഞ്ച്ഡ് മാരിയേജിൽ നിന്നും രക്ഷപെടാൻ വേണ്ടിയാണ് റിതിക സമ്മതമില്ലാതെ ഒരു അന്യപുരുഷനെ ചുംബിച്ചത്. ഇന്റർനെറ്റിൽ വൈറൽ ആയ ആ ചുംബനം മാറ്റിമറിച്ചത് അവർ ഇരുവരുടെയും ജീവിതമാണ്. നിലക്കാത്ത ട്വിസ്റ്റുകളും അത്യപൂർവ്വന്മായ പ്രണയനിമിഷങ്ങളും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു റൊമാന്റിക് എന്റെർറ്റൈനെർ!

mahayug.title: Brahma-Vision - End of the Universe
mahayug.description: Mahapralay ki kagar par khada Bharat, ek prachin gupt samaj ke haath mein hai, jo Mahayug ke rahasyamay hatyakand mein shamil hai. CBI officer Arjun Sharma aur uski adbhut team ko, is bhayanak khel ko rokne ke liye, apni pichle janmon ki yaadon ka saamna karna hoga. Kya wo Mahapralay se duniya ko bacha payenge ?

double-game.title: Double Game
double-game.description: 💃🏻 Modelling field la success aaganum nu thudikkiraa Kavya, but ava veetla modelling laam venaam kalyaanam pannikko nu solli oru panakkaara maappillaikku kazhutha neeta solraanga, intha nilaila oru naal ava modelling contract visayamaa mumbai ponappo avaloda twin sister kavya va meet panraa.. antha naal la irunthu avaloda life thalaikeelaa maaruthu..

falling-for-the-call-girl.title: Falling for the CALL GIRL
falling-for-the-call-girl.description: Call Girl ஆக அழைத்துவரப்பட்ட பெண்ணின் மீது தீரனுக்குக் காதல் ஏற்பட்டுவிடுகிறது. ஆனால், அவள் யார் நினைவு எதுவும் அவளுக்கு இல்லை. அவளுக்கும் அவன் மீது காதல் ஏற்பட அவளுக்கு ஒரு விபத்து ஏற்பட்டு விடுகிறது. அந்த விபத்தில் அவளது நினைவு திரும்பிவிடுகிறது. ஆனால் தீரனை மறந்துவிடுகிறாள். தீரன் அவளது காதலை மீண்டும் அடைந்தானா?

f46bc646-d663-4df6-b499-1b933e0906bf.title: Shraapit Haveli: Black Magic Ki Bhayanak Kahani
f46bc646-d663-4df6-b499-1b933e0906bf.description: Shraapit Haveli ka kaala raaz khulne wala hai! Aditi ne kiya hai apne purkhon ke gunahon ka saamna, jahan har raaz se nikla hai ek aur daravna sach. Kya Aditi apne parivaar ko bacha paayegi ya phir ho jayega sabkuch khatam? Janne ke liye suniye black magic ki ye kahani is show mein.

irandaam-mudichu.title: Irandaam Mudichu
irandaam-mudichu.description: After a tragic accident, a grieving man switches his stillborn grandchild with another woman’s newborn, binding both families in a twisted fate where hidden truths and guilt slowly tear them apart.

prem-pishach.title: Prem Pishach
prem-pishach.description: Jab Nishit pehli baar chhipkar Ahana ko Ronojoy ke saath bedroom mein dekhta hai, to uska man Ahana ke liye machal jaata hai. Par jab Ahana khud Nishit se love bite mangti hai, tab wo dar jata hai kyonki wo ek rakt pishach hai, aur Ahana ke khoon ki ek boond bhi uski khoon ki pyaas jaga sakti hai. Ahana ke liye apni tadap, aur apne raktpishach hone ki haqeeqat ke beech phansa Nishit, kaise payega Ahana ko? Kya hoga jab Ahana ko pata chalegi Nishit ki asliyat?

moondravathu-kan.title: Moondravathu Kan
moondravathu-kan.description: அனுஷ்காவும் கௌதமும் காதலர்கள். ஒரு நாள் அனுஷ்கா கௌதமை ஒரு ஹோட்டலுக்கு அழைத்துச் சென்று, அவனுடன் மகிழ்ச்சியாக இருக்கிறாள். அனைத்தும் முடிந்ததும், அவனை பிரேக் அப் செய்துவிட்டு செல்கிறாள். கௌதம் விரக்தியில் கத்துகிறான். அப்போது அவனுக்கு ஒரு சூப்பர் பவர் கிடைக்கிறது. அதற்குப் பிறகு நடந்த சம்பவம் என்னென்ன???

en-sandakaari-nee-thaan.title: En Sandakaari Nee Thaan
en-sandakaari-nee-thaan.description: Un moolamaa enakku oru baby 👶🏻 venum, nee adha senjaa.. naan unnoda prachanaiya sari panren nu kodeeswaran Sidharth kitta Ramya thimiraa solraa, avanaala avaloda antha deal la marukka mudiyala , avan adhukku sammathikkiraan ! Avanoda prachana enna ?, avaloda deal ku avan yen OK sonnaan ? Vaanga therijukalaam🔊🎧

tu-chor-main-sipahi.title: Tu Chor Main Sipahi
tu-chor-main-sipahi.description: Rajan India ka sabse bada Con-artist hai, jise Mandira ne dobara giraftar kar liya hai. Par apne case ke silsile mein Mandira ko Rajan ki help chahiye. Kya Rajan Mandira ki help karega? Rihaai se kuch din pehle Rajan ko jail se kyon bhagna pada? Kaun hai Rajan ka Godfather jise police bhi nahi dhoondh payi? Janne ke liye sunein, Tu Chor, Main Sipahi.........

reborn-for-revenge.title: Reborn For Revenge
reborn-for-revenge.description:
Facing death, Heather is magically sent back to her wedding day, armed with knowledge of future betrayals. As she plots revenge against her deceitful fiancé and best friend, she meets the mysterious Nathan, igniting an unexpected romance. Can Heather change her destiny and find justice in this thrilling tale of love and vengeance? 
Discover her gripping journey on Kukufm.

നീലി--The-Deadly-Beauty-.title: നീലി - The Deadly Beauty
നീലി--The-Deadly-Beauty-.description: കൊച്ചിയെ നടുക്കിയ കൊലപാതക  പരമ്പരയുടെ അന്വേഷണം ചെന്നെത്തുന്നത് ഞെട്ടിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഒരു സത്യത്തിലേക്കാണ്. ചെറുപ്പക്കാരെ വശീകരിച്ച് കൊല്ലുന്ന രക്തദാഹിയായ ഒരു യക്ഷി നൂറ്റാണ്ടുകൾക്കു ശേഷം പ്രതികാരത്തിനായി തിരിച്ചെത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു. കാമത്തിന്റെ മൂർധന്യാവസ്ഥയിൽ കൊണ്ടെത്തിച്ച് , തെറ്റ് ചെയ്ത പുരുഷന്മാരെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കുന്ന അവളെ തടുക്കാൻ ആർക്കാണ് കഴിയുക? കേൾക്കൂ,  പ്രണയവും പ്രതികാരവും വഞ്ചനയും കാമവും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഹൊറർ ത്രില്ലർ. [18+]

memory-heist.title: Memory Heist
memory-heist.description: Future mein, jab insaan apni yaadon ke liye AI mafia ke dark web Memory Market par jeene lage hain, Niati – ek aisi ladki hai jo ab bhi sab yaad rakh sakti hai. Usko is khatarnak digital duniya se guzarna hoga. Uska mission? Arjun ki maa ke qaatil ka sach samajhna, lekin raste mein use aise khaufnaak haalaat ka saamna karna hoga jo usne kabhi socha bhi nahi tha

doctor-x.title: Doctor X
doctor-x.description:
வேலை பறிபோய், காதலியால் கழற்றி விடப்பட்டு நடுத்தெருவில் நிற்கும் Xavier’க்கு ஒரு SUPER POWER கிடைக்கிறது. என்ன POWER அது? 
இது Xavier, Doctor X ஆன கதை!

sold-for-love-1.title: Sold For Love
sold-for-love-1.description: വർഷ എന്ന പെൺകുട്ടി അജ്ഞാതരാൽ കിഡ്നാപ്പ് ചെയ്യപ്പെടുകയാണ്. ഗുണ്ടകളുടെ പിടിയിൽ നിന്ന്  ഏങ്ങനെയും രക്ഷപ്പെടാൻ അവൾ ശ്രമിക്കുമ്പോൾ, ഒരു മുഖംമൂടി ധാരി അവളെ  ഉയർന്ന തുക നൽകി ലേലത്തിൽ സ്വന്തമാക്കുന്നു!.  ആരാണ് വർഷയെ ബസാറിൽ വിറ്റത്?,  വലിയ തുക നൽകി അവളെ വാങ്ങിയവരുടെ ഉദ്ദേശ്യമെന്ത്? അറിയാൻ കേൾക്കൂ  Sold For Love!

miracles-of-hindu-gods.title: Miracles of Hindu Gods
miracles-of-hindu-gods.description: Kahin Bhagwan ki murtiyan bolti hain, kahin tantrik shaktiyon se insaan ko janwar bana diya jata hai, aur kahin apne aap murtiyon ki height badhti rehti hai! Hindu dharm ke aise kayi chamatkaar hain jo sun kar aapko jhoothe lag sakte hain, lekin yeh sab hai bilkul sach! Kaise? Iska raaz jaanne ke liye abhi suniye yeh show.

the-dominion-chairman.title: The Dominion Chairman
the-dominion-chairman.description: Humiliated. Empowered. Corrupted. Aron Kingsley's world transformed when he revealed his superhuman abilities, catapulting him from disgraced billionaire to tyrannical Chairman of Liberty Falls. As his quest for acceptance spiraled into a reign of terror, Aron initiated a secret super-soldier program that pushed ethical boundaries beyond their breaking point. With each shocking abuse of power, the line between protector and oppressor blurred. Immerse yourself in "The Dominion Chairman," a relentless, mind-bending political thriller where Aron battles internal demons, external threats, and his own growing madness. Experience every telekinetic twist and psychic turn now, exclusively on the KUKUFM app!

the-last-of-the-unhived.title: The Last Of The Unhived
the-last-of-the-unhived.description: In a world devastated by the Synaptic Flux, a pathogen that turns humans into part of a hive mind, ex-special forces operative Marcus Tanner battles to survive. Joined by a scavenger named Zara and a hopeful youth named Tom, Marcus discovers Dr. Reeves, a scientist working on a potential cure. Together, they navigate a desolate landscape filled with danger, confronting their darkest fears and personal losses. As the fight for humanity's future intensifies, Marcus must decide whether hope is worth the ultimate sacrifice. This gripping audio series blends intense action with deep emotional conflict, exploring the blurred lines between humanity and infection.

90s-underworld-vs-mumbai-police.title: 90's Underworld Vs Mumbai Police
90s-underworld-vs-mumbai-police.description: Sapnon ki nagari Mumbai, aakhir apne andar Underworld ke kitne kaale raaz chhupaye huye hai? Is show mein suniye 90s ke un khaufnaak dino ki kahani jab Police aur Underworld ke beech khoon ki holi kheli ja rahi thi. Jaaniye kaise police aur gangsters ke beech ki jung ne Mumbai ko hila diya, Aur ATS ne kaise is khaufnaak daur se sheher ko bahar nikala.

thought-vibration.title: Thought Vibration:  The Law of Attraction In The Thought World
thought-vibration.description: 💭 Ennangal eppadi nammaloda ulagatha uruvaakkudhu nu eduthu solludhu indha Audiobook 🔊📖🎧. Ungaloda latchiyangalaiyum, kanavugalaiyum adaiya ennangala payanpaduthura ragasiya vithiya kathukkalaam vaanga. 🌈

karim-lala-a-gentleman-don.title: Karim Lala: A Gentleman Don
karim-lala-a-gentleman-don.description: India ke Don No.1 Dawood Ibrahim se pahle Mumbai par jiska raj tha, wo tha Karim Lala. 1930 mein Afgan se aaya ye pathan kaise Mumbai ka badshah ban baitha aur kaise usi ke samne paida hue Dawood ne aage chalkar usi ki jagah li? Akhir kya the Karim Lala ke criminal records, ye janne ke liye turunt sunein hamara ye show.

the-gut.title: The Gut
the-gut.description: 😨Serimaana Prachanai la kasta padureengalaa?  Stamina illaama.. Seekiramaa Tired aagidreengalaa? 🌟appo indha audiobook ungalukkaanadhu thaan. Unga gut ta Natural laa sari panradhu moolama unga noigala heal panni healthy ya vazhrathu eppadi nu kathukkonga 🌿

sooryaradham.title: സൂര്യരഥം
sooryaradham.description: സുന്ദരിയായ രത്നപ്രഭ തന്റെ ലക്ഷ്യപ്രാപ്തിക്ക് വേണ്ടി അവളുടെ കഴിവുകൾ ഓരോന്നായി പുറത്തെടുത്തപ്പോൾ ദുർമരണങ്ങളുടെ പരമ്പര തന്നെ ആ ബംഗ്ളാവിൽ അരങ്ങേറുന്നു. കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥ് 1995 ൽ എഴുതിയ അതിശയിപ്പിക്കുന്ന മാന്ത്രിക നോവൽ!

silent-son-in-law.title: Silent Son-In-Law
silent-son-in-law.description: "Ye 5 lakh lo aur meri Isha ko divorce de do, Ashvin! Kab tak Isha ke paltu kutte bane rahoge?" Isha aur Ashvin ki shaadi sirf naam ki thi—na pyaar tha, na izzat. Isha ka ex boyfriend Rahul kisi bhi tarah ye rishta todna chahta tha. Ashvin, jo sabki nazron mein bekaar aur bezubaan tha, ek raaz chupa raha tha: usne 10 saal tak chup rehne ki agreement sign ki thi. Agreement ke khatam hote hi, Ashvin ek super healer banne wala tha. Par kya tab tak uska aur Isha ka rishta bach paayega? Ya Ashvin ki nayi shaktiyan kar degi is ghar jamai ka jeena mushkil?

pattuthoovala.title: പട്ടുതൂവാല
pattuthoovala.description: അഭിനയത്തെ സ്നേഹിച്ചു വീട് വിട്ടു ഇറങ്ങിയ ജോർജിനെ പ്രണയിച്ചത് മൂന്നു പെൺകുട്ടികളാണ്. എന്നാൽ, അവനെ പിന്തുടർന്ന് നാടെങ്ങുമുള്ള പോലീസുകാരും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. വൈകാരിക നിമിഷങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞ മുട്ടത്തു വർക്കിയുടെ പ്രണയ നോവൽ - പട്ടുതൂവാല!

herbarium.title: ഹെർബേറിയം
herbarium.description: നഗരജീവിതത്തിൽ, കോൺക്രീറ്റു ചുമരുകൾക്കിടയിൽ തളച്ചിടപ്പെട്ട ഒരു കുട്ടിയുടെ ജീവിതം ആവിഷ്കരിക്കുന്ന ഹൃദയഹാരിയായ ഒരു കഥ.  പ്രകൃതിയുടെ മടിത്തട്ടിലേയ്ക്ക് ഇറങ്ങുന്ന കുട്ടിയുടെ സ്വാഭാവിക പരിണാമങ്ങൾ ഈ കൃതിയെ മറ്റൊരു തലത്തിലേക്ക് ഉയർത്തുന്നു.

india-and-the-silk-roads-the-history-of-.title: India And The Silk Roads: The History Of A Trading World
india-and-the-silk-roads-the-history-of-.description: Imagine ek aisa daur jab India aur Central Asia ke beech trade aur samrajya badal rahe the. Kaise ye purane Silk Roads Hindustan ki rajnieeti aur arthvyavastha par asar daalte the? Ye audiobook aapko un raaston par le jayegi, jahan vyapar, yuddh, aur climate ne itihaas ki dhaara badal di. Agar aapko history aur trade ko janne mein dilchaspi hai, to abhi suniye yeh audiobook.

paws-of-the-past.title: Paws Of The Past
paws-of-the-past.description: A deceased software developer reincarnated as a golden retriever must navigate life with his adopted wealthy family while trying to expose the truth about his death.

en-mel-vizhuntha-mazhai-thuliye.title: En Mel Vizhuntha mazhai Thuliye
en-mel-vizhuntha-mazhai-thuliye.description: Life ah namma own terms la vaazhanum nu rombave aasai paduvom, aana adhukkana chance avalo easy ah kidaukkuradhu illa. Oru vela kidaicha ? Life eppadi irukum nra'dha pathi intha kathai la neenga kettu oru positive and empowering world kulla poga poreenga.

slaughter-gang-of-bihar-ranveer-sena.title: Slaughter Gang Of Bihar: Ranveer Sena
slaughter-gang-of-bihar-ranveer-sena.description: Sochiye, Bihar ke 80s ke daur mein jaatiya hinsa ka wo silsila jab khoon se itihaas likha ja raha tha. Ranveer Sena ki kahani aapko aise haadson se rubaru karayegi, jin par yakeen karna mushkil hoga. Agar aap un kaali raaton ke sach ko jaanna chahte hain, jab rajneeti ke naam par masoomon ka katleaam hua, to yeh show abhi suniye.

ఓ-పిశాచి-.title: O Pishachi
ఓ-పిశాచి-.description: మంత్రగత్తె నుండి, ఆమె కొడుకు దెయ్యం పిల్లాడి నుండి వరుణ్ ఆ గ్రామాన్ని రక్షిస్తాడా? వినడానికి సిద్ధమవ్వండి మరి.

porus-vs-sikandar.title: Porus Vs Sikandar
porus-vs-sikandar.description: Jab Bharat ke raja Porus ka saamna hua duniya ke mahan yoddha Sikandar se, toh kya hua? Is legendary battle ki kahani suniye aur pata kariye kaun tha asli winner!

சிக்கிக்கொண்ட-சிறகுகள்-.title: சிக்கிக்கொண்ட சிறகுகள்
சிக்கிக்கொண்ட-சிறகுகள்-.description: அன்றாட வேலைகளை முடித்து விட்டு உறங்கச்செல்லும் இனியாவுக்கு பயங்கரமான கனவு வருகிறது. கனவில் தன் கணவன் மாதவன் தன்னை கொல்லவருவதை நினைத்து பதட்டப்படுகிறாள். பழைய பகை இன்னும் மறையவில்லையோ என்ற பயம் முதல்முறையாக அவளுக்கு தோன்றுகிறது. அது என்ன கனவு? என்ன பழைய பகை? இவர்கள் வாழ்க்கையில் என்ன நடக்க போகிறது?. கேளுங்கள் "சிக்கிக்கொண்ட சிறகுகள்"

kilimanjaro-bookstall.title: കിളിമഞ്ജാരോ ബുക്‌സ്റ്റാള്‍
kilimanjaro-bookstall.description: കിളിമഞ്ജാരോ ബുക്സ്റ്റാളിലെ പുസ്തകവില്പനക്കാരനായി അയാള്‍ ജീവിതം ആരംഭിച്ചു. പുസ്തകങ്ങള്‍ മനുഷ്യരെപ്പിടിക്കുന്ന കെണിയാണെന്ന് വിശ്വസിച്ചിരുന്നതിനാല്‍ എന്നെങ്കിലുമൊരിക്കല്‍ അത് ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുപോകണമെന്ന് അയാള്‍ തീരുമാനിച്ചിരുന്നു. രാജേന്ദ്രന്‍ എടത്തുംകരയുടെ നോവല്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

1757-sabse-bada-dhokha.title: 1757 : Sabse Bada Dhokha
1757-sabse-bada-dhokha.description: Kis ek dhokhe ne badli Bharat ki kismat aur desh bana gulam? Kyun Kaha gaya ise itihas ka sabse bada dhokha? Sab janenge is khas show "1757 : Sabse Bada Dhokha" mein.

sabarimala-ayyappan-mala-araya-daivam.title: ശബരിമല അയ്യപ്പന്‍: മല അരയ ദൈവം
sabarimala-ayyappan-mala-araya-daivam.description: സ്വാമി അയ്യപ്പനും ശബരിമലയുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട വിശ്വാസങ്ങള്‍ക്കും ആചാരങ്ങള്‍ക്കും പിന്നിലെ അറിയാക്കഥകള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം. ഏറെ വിവാദമായ പുസ്തകം.

mission-love.title: Mission Love
mission-love.description: സ്വന്തം കുടുംബം കാരണം താൻ നശിപ്പിച്ച പെൺകുട്ടിയോട് പ്രായശ്ചിത്തം ചെയ്യാനാണ്  രാജീവ് മേനോൻ ജയിലിലേക്ക് പോയത്. ജയിൽ വാസം പൂർത്തിയാക്കി, രഹസ്യ സൈനിക പരിശീലനവും നേടി,  ആ പെൺകുട്ടിയെ തന്നെ വിവാഹം ചെയ്യാൻ എത്തിയ അയാളെ കാത്തിരുന്നത് ഞെട്ടിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഒരു വാർത്തയാണ്. തീവ്രമായ പ്രണയനിമിഷങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞ, ആവേശമുണർത്തുന്ന ഒരു റൊമാന്റിക് ത്രില്ലർ.

mahadev-betting-app-scam-200-crore-ki-ca.title: Mahadev Betting App Scam: 200 Crore Ki Cash Wedding Ka Raaz
mahadev-betting-app-scam-200-crore-ki-ca.description: Mahadev Betting app scam ne kaise logon ki zindagi se khela? Is audio show mein suniye, kaise andhere mein chhupi is duniya ne croreon ko dhoka diya, aur kya raaz chhupe thei is 200 crore ki cash wedding ke peeche? Abhi sunna shuru kariye aur jaaniye is ghatna ka asli sach!

narmadippudava.title: നാര്‍മടിപ്പുടവ
narmadippudava.description: കേരളത്തിലെ തമിഴ് ബ്രാഹ്മണ സമൂഹത്തെ പശ്ചാത്തലമാക്കി സാറാ തോമസ് രചിച്ച നോവലാണ് നാര്‍മടിപ്പുടവ. അഗ്രഹാരത്തിന്റെ ആചാരങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് നടുവില്‍ സ്വജീവിതം മറ്റുള്ളവര്‍ക്കായി ഉഴിഞ്ഞ് വെച്ച കനകാംബാളിന്റെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ നേര്‍ക്കാഴ്ച.1979ലെ കേരള സാഹിത്യ അക്കാദമി അവാര്‍ഡ് ലഭിച്ച നോവല്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

kadal.title: കടല്‍
kadal.description: മലയാളത്തിന്റെ പ്രിയ കഥാകാരന്‍ ടി. പത്മനാഭന്റെ മികച്ച ഒന്‍പത് കഥകളാണ് ഈ സമാഹാരത്തിലുള്ളത്. ഒരു പകല്‍ക്കിനാവ്, സുനന്ദയുടെ അച്ഛന്‍, ദേശ്-ഒരു ഹിന്ദുസ്ഥാനി രാഗം, അബുദാബി, ഒരു കള്ളക്കഥ, ഒരു പഴയ കഥ, ശവദാഹം, നായ്ക്കളും മനുഷ്യരും, കടല്‍ എന്നിവയാണവ.

neet-paper-leak-ka-khulasa.title: Neet Paper Leak Ka Khulasa
neet-paper-leak-ka-khulasa.description: NEET exam ka paper leak ho gaya, Ye khabar toh aapne jaan li hogi lekin ye itna bada scam hua kaise? Iska sach jaanne ke liye abhi suniye ye show, Kyunki ismein kiya gaya hai padhne wale mehnati bachchon ka future barbad karne wale logon ki kaali duniya ka pardafash.

thirakkadha-kadhavugal.title: திறக்காத கதவுகள்
thirakkadha-kadhavugal.description: Psycho கொலைகளை தழுவிய ராஜேஷ் குமார் நாவல்கள் எப்போதும் வாசகர்களிடையே நல்ல வரவேற்பை பெற்றுள்ளது. அந்த வகையில் இந்த திறக்காத கதவுகள் கதை  விறுவிறுப்பிற்கும் ஸ்வாரஸ்யத்திற்கும் பஞ்சமில்லாத கதையாக அமைந்துள்ளது.

the-survival-game.title: The Survival Game
the-survival-game.description:
Trapped. Tested. Transformed. Lucas and his friends find themselves thrust into the Nexus Realm, unwilling pawns in a series of brutal games orchestrated by a sinister shadow organization. As they battle for survival, dark secrets unravel, pushing them to their physical and mental breaking points.
