With each challenge, the line between ally and enemy blurs, testing the very fabric of their friendships.Will Lucas and his companions escape the Nexus Realm's clutches, or will the games claim their lives—and their souls? 
Immerse yourself in "The Survival Games," a heart-stopping, mind-bending thriller where trust is a luxury and survival comes at an unthinkable cost. Binge every pulse-pounding moment now, exclusively on the KUKUFM app!

shankaracharya-vs-mandan-mishra-the-grea.title: Shankaracharya Vs Mandan Mishra : The Greatest Debate
shankaracharya-vs-mandan-mishra-the-grea.description: Shankaracharya aur Mandan Mishra ke is mahaan shastrarth mein kaise gyaan aur tark ki takraar ne naye siddhanton ko janam diya aur aakhir kaun jeeta is debate mein? Kaun hai shweta jo time travel se Shankaracharya ji ke paas pahunch gyi thi? Sab janiye is kamaal ke show Shankaracharya Vs Mandan Mishra : The Greatest Debate mein.

saving-asher.title: Saving Asher
saving-asher.description:
Bereaved. Bewildered. Smitten.
Amelia Thompson's world imploded when Hollywood heartthrob Asher Holloway - the man who saved her life - took his own. In a twist of cosmic fate, she's hurled back in time, thrust into her teenage body with her adult mind intact. Now, Amelia has just six months to rewrite destiny and save the man she's falling for - or lose everything. Will Amelia's desperate gambit save Asher's life, or will uncovering the truth about his mother's death seal both their fates?
Lose yourself in "Saving Asher," a hopelessly romantic journey through time, where true love outshines even Hollywood's brightest lights. Binge every swooning moment now, exclusively on the KUKUFM app!

army-school-par-terrorists-attack.title: Army School Par Terrorists Attack
army-school-par-terrorists-attack.description: 16 December 2014 ka woh din jab Pakistani Army Public School ke classrooms bane maut ka kuaan! Masoom bachchon aur teachers ke upar hua aisa bhayanak aantankwadi hamla jo aapke hosh uda dega. Toh kaise diya gaya tha usko anjaam? Kya thi wajah aur kaun mara gaya kaun bacha? Abhi suniye ye show aur Janiye shuru se ant ki poori kahani.

pankalaaksheede-diary.title: പങ്കലാക്ഷീടെ ഡയറി
pankalaaksheede-diary.description: വീട്ടുവേലക്കാരിയായ പങ്കലാക്ഷിയുടെ അമ്പരപ്പിക്കുന്ന ജീവിതാനുഭവങ്ങള്‍ ഡയറിത്താളുകളിലൂടെ സത്യസന്ധമായി ആവിഷ്‌കരിക്കുന്ന കേശവദേവിന്റെ ലളിതവും വ്യത്യസ്തവുമായ ഒരു നോവല്‍.

yudasinte-suvishesham.title: യൂദാസിന്റെ സുവിശേഷം
yudasinte-suvishesham.description: പ്രേമ എന്ന പതിനഞ്ചുവയസ്സുകാരിക്ക്  നദികളുടെ അടിത്തട്ടിൽ നിന്നും ശവങ്ങൾ വാരിയെടുക്കുന്ന യൂദാസിനോട് പ്രണയം തോന്നുന്നു. പോലീസിന്റെ നക്സൽ വേട്ടയുടെ പശ്ചാത്തലത്തിൽ ഒറ്റിക്കൊടുക്കലിന്റെയും പീഡനത്തിന്റെയും കുമ്പസാരത്തിന്റെ കഥപറയുന്ന ഒരു അതുല്യ കൃതി.  ആധുനിക മലയാള സാഹിത്യത്തിലെ പ്രധാനിയായ കെ.ആർ.മീരയുടെ ഒരു ലഘു നോവൽ.

24th-Mile-बर्मा-में-एक-भारतीय-डॉक्टर-के-.title: 24th Mile: Burma Mein Ek Bhartiya Doctor Ke Sahas Ki Kahani
24th-Mile-बर्मा-में-एक-भारतीय-डॉक्टर-के-.description: Jab duniya par second world war ka kahar baras raha tha, tab Burma mein bharat ka ek doctor apne parivar se door apni duty nibha rahe the. Jab wo bharat laut raha tha, tab 24 mile ka ek aisa distance tha, jise paar karna namumkin tha...kya wo bhartiye doctor us distance ko cover kar paye? ek doctor ke sahas aur romanch se bhari kahani sunne ke liye ye kitab zaroor suniye...

k-ramesan-nayarude-police-kathakal.title: കെ.രമേശന്‍ നായരുടെ പോലിസ് കഥകള്‍
k-ramesan-nayarude-police-kathakal.description: കഥകളെപ്പോലും അതിശയിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ജീവിതയാഥാര്‍ത്ഥ്യങ്ങളിലേക്കു വിരല്‍ചൂണ്ടുന്ന സംഭവകഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരം. പോലിസ് ഡിപ്പാര്‍ട്ട്മെന്റിന്റെ കേസ് ഡയറികളിലും ചരിത്രത്തിന്റെ ഏടുകളിലും പരതി കണ്ടെടുക്കപ്പെട്ട ഈ കഥകള്‍ ഉദ്വേഗജനകമായ സംഭവ പരമ്പരകളുടെ വിസ്മയലോകം തീര്‍ക്കുന്നു. കെ. രമേശന്‍ നായരുടെ മുഴുവന്‍ പോലിസ് കഥകളുടെയും സമാഹാരം.

x-ray-kannan.title: X-Ray Kannan
x-ray-kannan.description: ആരും പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കാത്ത ഒരു സൂപ്പർ പവർ സാധാരണക്കാരനായ കണ്ണന് കിട്ടിയപ്പോൾ അവന്റെ  ലോകം തലകീഴായി മറിയുന്നു.  ഒരു നിമിഷം മുമ്പ് വരെ ബ്രേക്കപ്പിന്റെ വേദനയിൽ വലഞ്ഞിരുന്ന ആ ഹൃദയം ഇപ്പോൾ അത്ഭുതത്താൽ നിറഞ്ഞു. മറ്റുള്ളവർക്ക് അദൃശ്യമായ ഒരു ലോകം അവന് തുറന്നു കിട്ടി. എന്നാൽ ഈ അദ്ഭുത ശക്തി ഒരു വരദാനമാണോ ശാപമാണോ?

detective-ajay-challenger-killer.title: Detective Ajay - Challenger Killer
detective-ajay-challenger-killer.description: Lagatar har Friday raat 12 baje ho rha hai shahar me ek bhayanak murder. Qatil de raha hai har baar ek naya challenge. Kya Ajay ke liye asan hoga is case ko suljhana is baar ?

who-killed-emma.title: Who Killed Emma?
who-killed-emma.description: When Nora Winters, an edgy journalist's perfect life is shattered by vivid flashbacks of a troubled past, she's forced to question everything she thought she knew. As memories of her sister Emma's disappearance resurface, Nora uncovers a sinister web of family secrets and government experiments. Caught between her present reality and a dark, forgotten history, she must unravel the truth before it consumes her. This gripping psychological thriller explores the power of memory and the lengths one woman will go to uncover the truth about her sister's fate.

devadaiyai-kanden.title: Devadaiyai Kanden
devadaiyai-kanden.description: Oru azhagaana muthathula aarambikkum kathal, athoda payanam, athula varra thunbangal thuyarangal, santhoshangal, unarvugal, romance - ithellam kalandha kalavai ah intha kadhai kandippa irukum. Kadhai oda mudivula ungaloda antha devathai'ya pathi kandippa neengalum therinjipeenga.

shivansh-new-age-yoddha.title: Shivansh : New Age Yoddha
shivansh-new-age-yoddha.description: "Jab ek divya yodha Shivansh apni takat se duniya ko bachaane ka sankalp leta hai, uski zindagi mein pyaar ka rang ghul jaata hai. Par jab yeh pyaar ek shaitani saazish ka hissa ban jaaye, to dharti par andhera chhaane lagta hai. Kya Shivansh apne pyaar ke jaal se nikal kar shaitani taqaton ko hara paayega? Ya ek nayi vinashkari shakti ka janm hoga jo sab kuch mita dega?"?

കോബ്ര-ഹൗസ്--.title: കോബ്രാ ഹൗസ്
കോബ്ര-ഹൗസ്--.description: ഇരുട്ടിന്റെ മറവിൽ പതിയിരിക്കുന്ന കോബ്ര എന്ന കൊലയാളി. മഞ്ഞുമൂടിയ മൂന്നാർ താഴ്‌വരയെ നടുക്കുന്ന ഒരു കൊലപാതക പരമ്പര.  പ്രണയവും വഞ്ചനയും പ്രതികാരവും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു റിവഞ്ച്  ത്രില്ലർ - മലയാളത്തിന്റെ ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലറുകളുടെ തമ്പുരാൻ ബാറ്റൺ ബോസ് രചിച്ച "കോബ്രാ  ഹൗസ്!

Satyug-शुरू-से-अंत-की-कहानी-.title: Satyug: शुरू से अंत की कहानी
Satyug-शुरू-से-अंत-की-कहानी-.description: Kya aapko pata hai ki Satyug mein jeevan kaisa tha? Suniye is show mein Swami Akhilanand ke saath, Satyug ki har katha, Jinmein hai, Jeevan ki sachhai, dharm aur adhyatm ke vo pehlu jo aaj tak rahe hain chhipe aur sabse bade sawal ka jawab ki, Jab us yug mein koi paap nahi tha toh phir bhagwan ko avtaar kyun lena pada.

aavilayile-sooryodayam.title: ആവിലയിലെ സൂര്യോദയം
aavilayile-sooryodayam.description: ഒരു വഴിപിഴച്ച സ്ത്രീയുടെ മകനായി ജനിച്ച ഗോവിന്ദൻ ഒടുവിൽ ഒരു മന്ത്രിയായി മാറുകയാണ്, ഗോവിന്ദന്റെ മകൻ പ്രഭാകരനാകട്ടെ പാപത്തിൽ നിന്നും മോക്ഷം തേടി അലയുകയാണ്. രണ്ടു തലമുറകളുടെ പ്രണയത്തിന്റെയും കാമത്തിന്റെയും പാപബോധത്തിന്റെയും കഥ പറയുന്ന എം മുകുന്ദന്റെ ക്ലാസിക് നോവൽ!

c9176dd8-b507-48a8-b1dd-d18bdbc86ed5.title: Losing my Mind
c9176dd8-b507-48a8-b1dd-d18bdbc86ed5.description: Jess is an aspiring true crime podcaster who decides to take matters into her own hands - by kidnapping someone, of course! Enter Miles, a willing victim who's so done with life he figures getting abducted might spice things up a bit. Together, this dysfunctional duo hits the road in a beat-up car, ready to embrace chaos, existential dread, and possibly a felony charge or two. With Jess's questionable decision-making skills and Miles's deadpan acceptance of his fate, they're set to stumble through America's weirdest corners, all while Jess attempts to turn their misadventures into podcast gold. It's a story that asks the important questions: Can you really kidnap someone who wants to be kidnapped? Is "chaotic neutral" a valid life philosophy? And most crucially, will they end up on someone else's true crime podcast before Jess can make her own?

business-plans-in-a-week.title: Business Plans in a Week
business-plans-in-a-week.description: Agar aap ek naya business start karna chahte hain ya apne existing business ko boost dena chahte hain, toh yeh show aapke liye bilkul perfect hai! Aap seekhenge, kaise sirf 7 din mei ek successful business plan  banaya ja sakta hai, without any boring theories! Toh abhi Suniye aur apne business ko success ki raah par le aiye!

e2c1f060-c995-41b6-ae30-269edf5f692b.title: Keeping up with the Kennedys
e2c1f060-c995-41b6-ae30-269edf5f692b.description: Meet the Kennedy family, a powerful dynasty in high finance, real estate and media. Jessica Kennedy, the matriarch and CEO of Kennedy Estate, announces her intention to step down and initiates a competition among her three children to determine her successor. Each child is assigned a division of the company to oversee for six months. The competition triggers underlying tensions within the family and hints at hidden secrets that threaten their stability. As the siblings - Emma, Liam, and Grace - react to this news with varying degrees of enthusiasm and skepticism, the dynamics of their relationships unfold. But is the decision to step down, Jessica's decision or is someone else forcing her hand? When a family has this many secrets, its going to be tough to keep up with the Kennedys. Listen to this exclusive show on KUKU FM.

మా-విడాకులు.title: మా "విడాకులు"
మా-విడాకులు.description: వాళ్ళిద్దరి మధ్యా వున్నది ప్రేమా?  జాలా? అనుకోని పరిస్థితులలో ఒకటైన ఆ ఇద్దరూ వాళ్ళ బంధాన్ని కొనసాగిస్తారా? లేదంటే మధ్యలోనే వాళ్ళ దారులు వేరవుతాయా? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే వినండి మా " విడాకులు "  ఆడియో బుక్.

overcome-ai.title: Overcome AI
overcome-ai.description: Life mein financial freedom achieve karne ke liye aapko chahiye AI ka supercharge. Aur wo milega is audiobook ko sunne ke baad. Kyunki ismein aap seekh payenge ki, Kaise AI technologies ko apne career advancement mein use kiya jaaye, financial goals ko achieve karne ke innovative tareeke kya hain? Aur apni professional growth ko boost dene ke liye AI ke jadoo se bhare insights!

అన్వేషణ-.title: అన్వేషణ
అన్వేషణ-.description: నిత్యం వారాహి అమ్మవారి పూజలు చేసుకునే ఆత్మానంద స్వామీజీ ఆశ్రమంలో జరిగే మరణాల వెనుక ఉన్న మిస్టరీ తెలుసుకోవాలంటే అన్వేషణ ప్రారంభించండి.

chanakya-neeti-16.title: ചാണക്യ നീതി
chanakya-neeti-16.description: ലോകം കണ്ട ഏറ്റവും മികച്ച തത്വചിന്തകരിൽ ഒരാളായ ആചാര്യ ചാണക്ക്യൻ്റെ നീതിശാസ്ത്രത്തെ ആധാരമാക്കി, മനുഷ്യ ജീവിതവുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട അനേകം വസ്തുതകൾ ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്നു. ആരാണു വിജയി?, എന്താണു പരാജയം?  എന്നിങ്ങനെ സാർത്ഥകമായ ജീവിതത്തിനു വഴികാട്ടിയാകാൻ ഈ തത്വോപദേശങ്ങൾക്ക് സാധിക്കും.

voice-of-justice.title: Voice of Justice : Ek Pita Ki Ladaai
voice-of-justice.description: Jab 13 saal ki Kiran ke saath uske gaon ke kuch ladke balatkaar karte hain, toh wo poori tarah se toot jaati hai. Kiran ke pita panchayat mein un ladkon ki sazaa ke liye maang karte hain, par panchayat wo thukra deti hai aur khud Kiran ko doshi thehra deti hai. Apni beti ke upar is lagaye gaye kalank ko uthane ke liye suniye is show mein kaise ek pita nyay ke liye wo har kuch karne ko taiyaar hai jisse shayad wo apna astitva hi kho baithe.

yaadhumaagi-nindraal.title: யாதுமாகி நின்றாள்
yaadhumaagi-nindraal.description: ஒரு பெண்ணின் போராட்டமே இந்த நாவல். பெண்களின் தியாகத்தால் மட்டுமே ஒரு குடும்பம் செழிப்படைய முடியும் என்பதை சொல்லும் நாவல். இதன் நாயகி தியாகி மட்டுமல்ல, பெரும் புத்திசாலியும் கூட.. பேராசை மிகுந்த ஒரு தங்கை, பேதையான ஒரு தங்கை, பென்ஷன் வாங்கும் தமிழாசிரியரான அப்பா, வாயில்லா அம்மா - இது போக ஓடிப்போய்விட்ட மனைவியால் தனித்து விடப்பட்ட ஒரு பெரியப்பா என்கிற கூட்டு குடும்பத்துக்குள் கதாநாயகி படும்பாடுகளே “ யாதுமாகி நின்றாள்!”.

nsk-kalaivanarin-kadhai.title: என்.எஸ்.கே. கலைவாணரின் கதை
nsk-kalaivanarin-kadhai.description: நகைச்சுவை மட்டுமே என்.எஸ்.கேவின் அடையாளம் அல்ல, அதையும் தாண்டிய ஆளுமை அவருடையது. பரிவும் பகுத்தறிவும் அவருடைய இரண்டு கண்கள். ஆம், ஏழைகள், பசித்தவர்கள் என்றால் என்.எஸ்.கேவின் உள்ளம் சட்டென்று இரங்கிவிடும். கையில் இருப்பதை எல்லாம் கொடுத்துவிடக் கூடியவர். அள்ளிக்கொடுக்கும் விஷயத்தில் எம்.ஜி.ஆருக்கே வழிகாட்டியவர் என்.எஸ்.கே. வயிற்றுக்கு மட்டுமல்ல, சிந்தனைக்கும் விருந்து படைத்தவர். என்.எஸ்.கேவின் வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு...

bhootiya-shahron-ke-kisse.title: Bhootiya Shahron Ke Kisse
bhootiya-shahron-ke-kisse.description: Har shahar, har gaon se koi na koi aisa kissa ya afwah judi hoti hai, jiska sidha sambandh bhoot preton ya kisi doosri duniya ke praniyon se hota hai. kya aapne bhi kabhi bhoot pret ki presence ko mahsus kiya hai? ye kitab aapko kuch aise hi darawane kisson ke safar par le jayegi, jo manon to sach hain, na mano to kuch bhi nahin..

veenayil-urangum-raagangal.title: Veenayil Urangum Raagangal
veenayil-urangum-raagangal.description: Yamunavin vaazhkaiyin moolam.. anbu thaan vaazhkaiyai azhagaakkum ena anbin magathuvathai azhagaaga eduthu sollum arputhamaana audio novel idhu. Manitha unarvugalin asaivugal yerpaduthum isaiyai solgirathu Indumathiyin Veenayil Urangum Raagangal. Vaanga Kekkalaam.

sabrimala-aastha-vs-kanoon.title: Sabrimala : Aastha VS Kanoon
sabrimala-aastha-vs-kanoon.description: Kya tha Sabrimala mandir ka vivad? Kya faisla sunaya tha Supreme Court ne us mamle mein? Kaise hal hui mandir mein auraton ke nahi jane wali guthi? Aur sabse zaroori sawal, kya thi is mamle ki jad? In sabhi sawalon ke jawab hain, is audio show mein!

oosi-munayil-usha.title: ஊசி முனையில் உஷா
oosi-munayil-usha.description: சுற்றிலும் புலி, சிங்கம், சிறுத்தை, வேங்கை, நரி என்று ஒரு மிருகக்கும்பல். அதன் மையத்தில் மான் போல மாட்டிக்கொண்ட உஷா. என்ன பிரச்சனை அவளுக்கு? மீண்டு வருவாளா?

may-june-julie.title: May June Julie
may-june-julie.description: Ilam pen July tharkolai seidhu kolgiraal, avaladhu kanavan robert antha tharkolaiyil santhegam kolgiraan.. Police - Visaaranai - Pulanaaivu.. Barath-Suseela indha valakkai investigate seiyya, July in maranam Kolaiyaa Tharkolaiyaa ena vidai kidaikkirathu..

ulfa-north-east-india-ka-taliban.title: ULFA: North East India Ka Taliban
ulfa-north-east-india-ka-taliban.description: "Assam ke ULFA ke dark secrets ko uncover karta yeh show, aapko le jayega insurgency, rebellion aur political intrigue ki duniya mein. Kya hai ULFA ke asli motives, aur kaise iska impact Assam ke aam logo par pada? Suno is gripping kahani ko, jo aapko edge-of-the-seat excitement aur chilling insights ke saath ek nayi universe mein le jaayega."

switched-fates.title: Switched Fates
switched-fates.description: Twin sisters Aria and Luna, unaware of their magical heritage, discover their powers and a love triangle with a mysterious prince in high school. On their 18th birthday, they must unravel family secrets and face deadly foes to break a life-threatening curse.

the-afterlife-agency.title: The Afterlife Agency
the-afterlife-agency.description: Meet Olivia Smith, a young, edgy medium who’s far from your average ghostbuster. Running the Afterlife Agency, Olivia’s job is to help restless spirits wrap up their unfinished business. But things get wild when she uncovers a dark conspiracy led by an ancient entity bent on merging the living with the dead. As she dives into mind-bending cases, Olivia must confront her own haunted past and embrace her freaky powers to keep the worlds from colliding. With unexpected twists, badass action, and a touch of humor, "Afterlife Agency" is the ultimate supernatural ride you didn’t know you needed. Get ready to binge!

hindutva-ke-pop-stars.title: Hindutva Ke Pop Stars
hindutva-ke-pop-stars.description: Kya music sirf entertainment hai ya ek agenda bhi? Is show mein khulasa hoga Hindutva ke pop stars ki chhupi hui dunia ka, jahan music ek nayi disha aur narrative set kar raha hai. Abhi suniye aur janiye ki kaise yeh movement evolve ho raha hai.

the-hidden-queen-of-elaria.title: The Hidden Queen of Elaria
the-hidden-queen-of-elaria.description:
"A hidden queen. A magical realm. A destiny that transcends worlds."
On her 18th birthday, Riley discovers she's the hidden queen of Elaria, a magical realm threatened by dark forces. After a tragic loss, she enters the mysterious Magical Carnival to unlock her powers and face her destiny as Elaria's rightful ruler.
Will Riley embrace her role as Elaria's queen and confront the darkness threatening her kingdom? Continue her extraordinary journey in the next episode, exclusively on KukuFM!

mr-romeo.title: Mr. Romeo
mr-romeo.description: ജീവിതത്തില്‍ ഒരു പെണ്ണിനെയും അടുപ്പിക്കില്ലെന്ന് പ്രതിജ്ഞയെടുത്ത ഇന്ത്യയിലെ അറിയപ്പെടുന്ന ബിസിനസ്മാന്‍ സഞ്ജയ്ക്ക് മുന്നില്‍ ഒരിക്കല്‍ ഒരു വലിയ പ്രതിസന്ധി രൂപപ്പെടുന്നു. അതോടെ അയാളുടെ ജീവിതം കീഴ്‌മേല്‍ മറിയുന്നു. എന്തുകൊണ്ട് സഞ്ജയ് പെണ്ണുങ്ങളെ അകറ്റി നിര്‍ത്തുന്നു..അയാള്‍ പ്രണയത്തിലാകുമോ? കേള്‍ക്കാം മിസ്റ്റര്‍ റോമിയോ.

mathura-ka-mujrim.title: Mathura ka Mujrim
mathura-ka-mujrim.description: Mathura ke Jawahar Bagh mein 2014 se shuru hui ek choti si baithak kaise bani maut ka maidan? Ram Vriksha Yadav ke netritv mein satyagrahis ne machaya halla, jo le gaya 2 SPs aur 22 logon ki jaan. Suniye, kaise police ne is khatarnak aandolan ko khatam kiya aur asli mastermind ko kya anjaam diya!

deadliest-race.title: Deadliest Race
deadliest-race.description: A kidnapped Formula 1 driver must win a series of deadly, inventive races on a remote island to survive, while secretly plotting to free his fellow racers and overthrow the maniacal ex-F1 chief who engineered this lethal competition.

Vijayanagara-Empire-वीरता-कला-और-बुद्धि-.title: Vijayanagara Empire: वीरता, कला और बुद्धि की गाथा
Vijayanagara-Empire-वीरता-कला-और-बुद्धि-.description: Harihara aur Bukka ne Vijayanagara ki buniyaad rakhi, Deva Raya aur Krishna Deva Raya ne ise South India ka sabse bada samrajya banaya. Jaane kaise in rajaon ne apne shaurya aur rajneeti se is samrajya ko itihas mein amar kiya. Yeh show aapko itihas ke un pannon mein le jayega, Jahan shaurya ki kahaniyaan aaj bhi zinda hain.

nepoliyante-prathima.title: നെപ്പോളിയന്റെ പ്രതിമ
nepoliyante-prathima.description: പ്രിയ എഴുത്തുകാരന്‍ കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥിന്റെ തൂലികയില്‍ നിന്നും പിറവിയെടുത്ത വ്യത്യസ്തമായ രചന നെപ്പോളിയന്റെ പ്രതിമ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

hell-guardian-victoria.title: Hell Guardian Victoria
hell-guardian-victoria.description: In the small town of Rosewood, flower shop owner Victoria Pearson secretly guards the underworld. As a rare celestial event threatens to merge the realms, she must balance her earthly life, save her possessed husband, and thwart the dark ambitions of an ancient evil, the Shadow King- Herodotus.

good-karma-make-the-right-choices-for-to.title: Good Karma: Make The Right Choices For Tomorrow
good-karma-make-the-right-choices-for-to.description: Sahi choices hi aapko aage badhati hain. "Good Karma" mein paayiye woh guidance jo aapko har step pe right decision lene mein madad karegi aur success ki taraf le jayegi. Abhi sunna shuru kariye ye audiobook aur apne kal ko behtar bana lijiye.

Contract-కళ్యాణం--.title: Contract కళ్యాణం
Contract-కళ్యాణం--.description: త్రివిక్రమ్ ఎక్కడో రాసినట్టు ప్రేమ చదవడం అయితే పెళ్లి పరీక్ష రాయడం లాంటిది, కానీ ఈ రోజుల్లో ప్రేమ సుఖం కోసం, పెళ్లి లోకం కోసం అయిపొయింది. శౌర్య నాన్న చివరి కోరిక కోసం ప్రేమించిన సంయుక్తని కాకుండా contract తీసుకుని "భూమి" అనే ఆమెని పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటాడు. కాగితాలతో మొదలైన ఆ కళ్యాణం కాలం కదిలే కొద్దీ ఎలా బలపడింది అనేది కథ.

విప్లవ-వీరుడు-అల్లూరి-సీతారామరాజు.title: విప్లవ వీరుడు అల్లూరి సీతారామరాజు
విప్లవ-వీరుడు-అల్లూరి-సీతారామరాజు.description: అల్లూరి సీతారామరాజు ఒక మహానాయకుడు, స్వతంత్ర సమరయోధుడు. చిన్ననాటి నుంచి అతని విప్లవ చరిత్ర వరకు అన్ని సంఘటనలను తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? భారత స్వతంత్ర పోరాటంలో అల్లూరి సీతారామరాజు యొక్క ప్రాముఖ్యతను, అతని ధైర్యం, సాహసాన్ని, దేశభక్తిని ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

nyaya-darshan.title: Nyaya Darshan
nyaya-darshan.description: Jivan mein maujood har chiz chahe sawal-jawab ho ya tark-vitark...inko agar aap sahi logic se samajhna chahte hain, to ye show aapke liye hai. Nyaya Darshan, Maharshi Gautam ki likhi aisi kitaab hai jismein rozmara ki chizon ko sahi logic ke sath samjhaya gaya hai.

the-ceos-crazy-bride.title: The CEO's Crazy Bride
the-ceos-crazy-bride.description: In the glamorous yet cutthroat world of luxury fragrances, Bryan Turner, the enigmatic CEO of Obsidian Fragrances, faces a crisis that could destroy his empire—he's lost his sense of smell. Enter Emma Keith, a mysterious woman with a troubled past and a daring proposition: a marriage of convenience that promises to restore Bryan's career and unravel a web of dark family secrets. Together, they navigate a high-stakes game of power, deception, and unexpected alliances. Will their partnership save them or lead to their downfall? Find out in this intriguing audio show.

gold-digger-by-mistake.title: Galti se Gold Digger
gold-digger-by-mistake.description: Gold Digger by Mistake follows Maya, a hardworking girl wrongly labeled a gold digger after a twist of fate ties her to billionaire Arjun. As misunderstandings, class clashes, and hidden truths unfold, Maya must fight to prove her innocence — and figure out whether love can bloom between two people from completely different worlds.

time-traveling-cute-baby-4.title: Time-Traveling Cute Baby
time-traveling-cute-baby-4.description: The microdrama centers on Wilson, a powerful corporate figure whose meticulously crafted life is shattered by the sudden appearance of two children claiming to be his time-traveling offspring. Initially denying their existence and dismissing them as a threat, Wilson is forced to confront a hidden past and a mysterious mother, Clara, when genetic tests confirm his paternity. The children, driven by their mother's hardship and a desire to reunite their fractured family, relentlessly push Wilson to acknowledge his responsibilities and re-evaluate his priorities between wealth and family. Meanwhile, Clara, an orphaned and struggling young woman, navigates financial ruin and complex relationships, unknowingly forming a deep bond with children who are her own. As Wilson grapples with his newfound fatherhood, he adopts various hidden identities and orchestrates deceptions to protect his children and family amidst corporate intrigue. His past catches up to him in the form of Tina, a formidable and scorned ex-lover, who emerges as a relentless antagonist. Tina orchestrates sinister plots, including corporate espionage, framing Clara, and attempting to destroy her and her unborn child, all to reclaim Wilson and his empire. The time-traveling children continuously intervene, guiding their parents towards their destined union and attempting to prevent a tragic future. A violent car crash leaves Wilson with complete amnesia, which Tina ruthlessly exploits, claiming to be his fiancée. However, an inexplicable connection to Clara persists, and with the help of their future sons, Wilson slowly regains his memory. He ultimately rejects Tina, publicly declaring Clara and their children as his rightful family. The series culminates with Clara, now pregnant with more of Wilson's children, interrupting Tina and Wilson's wedding, asserting her place and setting the stage for their fight for a united future against persistent threats. The show explores themes of identity, sacrifice, the true cost of ambition, and the enduring power of family across time.

flash-marriage-the-all-purpose-dad-2.title: Flash marriage: The All – purpose Dad
flash-marriage-the-all-purpose-dad-2.description: Five years after a painful betrayal involving her child, she enters a flash marriage with a stranger—unaware he’s the CEO… and the child’s father. What begins as an escape from arranged marriages slowly blossoms into something real. A heart-tugging tale of hidden identities, rekindled love, and a family fate never saw coming.

dil-sambhal-ja-zara.title: Dil Sambhal ja Zara
dil-sambhal-ja-zara.description: The Mafia’s Surprise Heirs is a gripping story about betrayal, secrets, and unexpected family ties. When a powerful mafia leader’s hidden past resurfaces, two unsuspecting heirs are thrown into a dangerous world of crime, revenge, and forbidden love—where every choice could cost them their lives or the empire they never meant to inherit.

moondru-natchathiram.title: Vishwaroopam : Father of 3 Bigshots
moondru-natchathiram.description: For his father's birthday, Raghavan brought a box no one wanted to open. Inside it? A truth that shattered pride, price tags, and silence.

thieves-in-love.title: Thieves In Love
thieves-in-love.description: In a world where passion, rivalry, and hidden identities collide, Naina, a kind-hearted yet fiery dancer, finds herself constantly at odds with the arrogant Aryan. Their clashes turn into sparks on and off the stage, even as her best friend Reema flirts her way toward Rohit. But when a mysterious masked benefactor named Raj begins secretly helping those in need, Naina’s heart is torn between admiration and suspicion. Watch Now!

thdc-recruitment-2025-apply-now-1.title: THDC Recruitment 2025: Apply Now!
thdc-recruitment-2025-apply-now-1.description: THDC India Ltd has announced its 2025 recruitment drive—apply now for top government jobs! Exciting roles open for Engineers, Executives, and Officer Trainees across multiple disciplines. This video covers eligibility, salary, and step-by-step application details. Don’t miss this golden opportunity. Secure your future with THDC today!

dark-secrets.title: Revenge Wali Shaadi
dark-secrets.description: Ananya's life is shattered after public shaming and a false accusation lead to her firing, igniting a fierce quest for revenge against class disparity. Her path takes a dark turn when she is drugged, injured in a car crash, and subsequently forced into an arranged marriage with her rescuer, Kabir, who lies in a deep coma. Unbeknownst to Ananya, Kabir is a pawn in a dangerous game orchestrated by his boss, Shantanu, while his terminally ill mother desperately arranges the marriage to secure their family empire. Upon his dramatic return from the coma, Kabir, discovering his mother's death and his mysterious marriage, declares himself "the king," ready to reclaim his corporate throne and exact revenge. Meanwhile, Ananya's ruthless stepfather, Papa, manipulates her into this transactional union to seize control of Kabir's company, further entangling her in corporate intrigue. Ananya, bound by a solemn promise to protect Kabir's house, eventually confronts Papa and divorces Kabir, reclaiming her identity as Dr. Ananya amidst financial hardship and false accusations. Years later, fate brings them together again when Ananya becomes Kabir's new physician, leading to a complex dynamic where Kabir feigns injury to pursue her, all while secretly protecting her from legal troubles. A shocking truth emerges: Kabir discovers Ananya is the daughter of the man who defrauded his company, leading him to believe their marriage was a calculated deception. Fueled by betrayal, Kabir orchestrates swift revenge against Ananya's father and publicly announces a new marriage, coldly evading Ananya's attempts to understand his actions. Ananya, devastated by Kabir's engagement to another and his dismissive attitude, relentlessly pursues the truth behind his deception and their unresolved past, facing accusations of greed. A loyal confidante eventually reveals Ananya's profound, selfless devotion, including marrying him while he was comatose and performing rituals for his recovery. This revelation forces Kabir to confront his deep-seated misjudgment and realize Ananya's pure intentions. He frantically stops her from fleeing the country, apologizes for his past actions, and proposes marriage, leading to a tentative reconciliation. However, their rekindled romance is immediately targeted by a deadly assassination attempt, highlighting the persistent dangers surrounding their lives and the corporate empire. The series explores themes of revenge, corporate power struggles, familial manipulation, and the enduring power of love amidst profound betrayal and hidden truths.

ai-for-animation.title: How to us AI for Animation?
ai-for-animation.description: AI for Animation is revolutionizing how stories are brought to life—faster and smarter. This video explores top tools that turn text into motion, sketches into scenes, and ideas into visuals. From character rigging to lip-syncing, discover how AI simplifies complex animation tasks. Perfect for creators, marketers, and studios aiming for high-quality results with less effort.

malli-rava.title: Malli Raava
malli-rava.description: మహేష్ ఒక బిజినెస్ మేన్. తన భార్య సౌమ్య తప్పు చేసిందని  ఆమెకు దూరమయ్యాడు. అప్పుడే అతనికి అనిత దగ్గరైంది. ఆ సమయంలో భయంకరమైన నిజం తెలిసింది. తనకు కూతురు ఉందని తెలిసి షాకయ్యాడు. ఆ కూతురు నిజంగా మహేష్ కూతురేనా..? సౌమ్యను మహేష్ ఎందుకు దూరం చేసుకున్నాడు? తెలియాలంటే చూడండి.. ఎమొషనల్ రోలర్ కోస్టర్ " మళ్ళీ రావా". మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

her-last-promise.title: Her Last Promise
her-last-promise.description: When Riya’s world collapses under the weight of her father Ranjeet’s betrayal and her family’s ruin, she rises with unshakable strength to protect her ailing grandparents and reclaim their lost dignity. Torn between love, sacrifice, and vengeance, Riya’s journey from a helpless granddaughter to a fierce protector proves that true safety lies not in others but in the arms of one’s own courage. Watch Now!

boss-is-my-lover.title: The Man She Rejected
boss-is-my-lover.description:
Varun leaves the country for his studies and works day and night, sending money in secret to save his girlfriend Shreya’s startup. When he finally comes back, instead of love, she breaks up with him. The day she learns who Varun truly is, her pride cracks and her heart sinks. This is not just a love story, it is a clash of emotions where love turns into betrayal.

Watch it now!

vaidya-se-daitya.title: Vaidya se Daitya
vaidya-se-daitya.description: Dr. Dev Trivedi, a divine healer who brings even the dead back to life, becomes a legend after reviving billionaire Mr. Singhaniya. But his world crumbles when his wife, Nita, betrays him—stealing his sacred secrets to build her empire and plotting his death. At her dazzling IPO launch, shocking truths surface: the real savior and mother of his child is their servant, Kavita. Awakened as Param Ved Ji, Dev unleashes divine justice—proving that no power can outshine the truth.

my-toxic-kaadhali.title: My Toxic Kaadhali
my-toxic-kaadhali.description: The microdrama begins with CEO Arjun's engagement to Divya, seemingly blessed by his matriarch mother, Archana, who gifts Divya company shares. However, Arjun's secret embrace with another woman and a mysterious locket quickly expose a hidden past, fueling Divya's intense jealousy. Divya grapples with Arjun's evasiveness and a tragic family history involving his deceased sister, Janu, while a public accusation of theft against Divya escalates tensions. A shocking twist reveals Archana is not Arjun's mother but his secret lover and a rival, confirming Divya's suspicions and setting the stage for a ruthless revenge plot. Divya holds Archana captive and publicly assaults her, accusing her of being Arjun's secret lover, which Archana's apology seems to confirm. Divya then finds herself held captive and forced into marriage by Man 1 for financial gain, her pleas for help often mistaken for drama. Arjun, meanwhile, is consumed by guilt over Janu's death and his mother's disappearance. Divya faces public humiliation, accused of being a gold-digger and Arjun's secret lover, and her mercenary plot to marry Arjun for wealth is exposed, leading to the cancellation of their wedding. She incurs a massive debt to Mrs. Archana, and her con-artist brother attempts to embezzle funds from Arjun. The conflict intensifies with the emergence of Siddharth, Divya's obsessive ex-lover, who manipulates the law to frame her as a heartbroken fugitive. Richa, another woman, is falsely accused of theft, and Archana's fierce disapproval of Divya persists. The central deception reaches a climax when Arjun's "mother," Archana, is publicly exposed as his mistress, leading to his humiliation and a vow of revenge. Accused of deception and rejected by Arjun's family, Divya shoots Arjun, expressing immediate horror and profound regret. Released from jail, Divya plots revenge against Arjun's family, armed with a secret about a mysterious figure named Jaanu. Simultaneously, Arjun is pressured by his mother into an arranged marriage, indicating the ongoing and complex nature of their intertwined fates.

beti-ka-boost.title: Baap, Beti aur Black Money
beti-ka-boost.description: Baap, Beti aur Black Money tells the story of Suresh, a humble watchman whose life changes overnight when his daughter inherits her late husband’s drug empire and shares her fortune with him. Once humiliated and broken, Suresh rises to power, using his newfound wealth to take revenge on those who betrayed him — and to finally reclaim the dignity and love he was once denied.

vision-unleashed-the-forgotten-master.title: The forgotten Master
vision-unleashed-the-forgotten-master.description: Vyom was left for dead by his own brother, but destiny had other plans. As his true self resurfaces, he takes on corrupt masters, brutal fighters, and inner demons to become the legend he once was. Vision Unleashed is a tale of power, memory, and one man’s ultimate comeback. Watch Now!

mr-billionaires-heart-is-mine.title: Crorepati ki Contract Wife
mr-billionaires-heart-is-mine.description: When fiery Maya Sinha crosses paths with ruthless billionaire lawyer Sameer Malhotra, sparks fly. Between betrayal by her ex Raj and her fight to save her father, Maya discovers that the cold-hearted tycoon’s guarded heart may just belong to her. Watch Now!

the-forgotten-master-4.title: The Forgotten Master
the-forgotten-master-4.description: The microdrama unfolds across two initially distinct martial arts narratives that ultimately converge. One thread introduces Pal Chandra, a revered master who, after winning a prestigious presidency, selflessly cedes the title to his reluctant younger brother, Sharath, igniting a complex tale of brotherhood and simmering resentments. Simultaneously, Lavina, a formidable martial artist, brings home an amnesiac stranger named Tarun, whom she claims saved her life, sparking a love triangle with the possessive Bharath. Tarun's presence at her father Master Sudhir's club draws them into a high-stakes rivalry with the ambitious Akshay, who seeks to reclaim the club for his father, Dhanraj, due to a historical grievance. As the narratives intertwine, Akshay escalates his vendetta, kidnapping Lavina and challenging Master Sudhir's club to a championship with its closure at stake. The amnesiac Tarun, now referred to as Lohith, begins to display extraordinary martial arts prowess and is taken under Master Sudhir's wing, undergoing intense training. Despite initial setbacks and being deemed "not ready," Lohith emerges as the Rising Sun Club's last hope, revealing a hidden past as a professional fighter. He triumphs in the National Martial Art Championship, fueled by a vendetta for his father's assault, securing the club's survival. Lohith's astonishing skills lead to his unexpected ascent as Grandmaster, even as he grapples with violent outbursts and a forgotten past. He faces opposition from the Grand Master's son, Akshay, and is manipulated by his ambitious mentor, Dhanraj, into challenging the Grand Master for the ultimate title. The true Grandmaster, Balachandra (revealed to be Pal Chandra), returns, exposing Sharath's usurpation and reclaiming his position, leading to a brutal confrontation where Sharath is captured while protecting Lavina. Akshay, seeking redemption, later becomes a student under Grandmaster Lohith, promising to uphold principles. However, Sharath, now a disgraced former student and Balachandra's brother, openly defies Lohith and challenges him for leadership. Despite Lohith's offer of forgiveness, Sharath's deep-seated resentment culminates in a deadly, winner-takes-all duel. In a surprising turn, after defeating Sharath, Grandmaster Lohith declares him the rightful successor to the Dragon Club leadership, recontextualizing the brutal fight as a profound test and a transfer of authority, hinting at a complex understanding of legacy and peace.

the-missing-master-chef-3.title: The Missing Master Chef
the-missing-master-chef-3.description: A fallen culinary legend walks away from fame to rediscover the true meaning of food and life. In a world chasing perfection, he finds greatness in simplicity. The Missing Master Chef — where every meal tells a story of heart, humility, and redemption

the-return-of-the-heiress-discernment-of.title: The Return of the Heiress: Discernment of Pearls
the-return-of-the-heiress-discernment-of.description: A newlywed grandfather and Lu Zhui—they plundered the Lin family's property like cunning rogues. This entire plot has so many roller coaster rides. There are so many nail biting moments were take part in these plot. Watch now..

beautiful-boss-and-male-bodyguard.title: Beautiful boss and Male bodyguard
beautiful-boss-and-male-bodyguard.description: “Beautiful Boss & Male Bodyguard” is a dramatic love story that blends passion, mystery, and tragedy. It follows Emma and Robert, two people bound by love yet torn apart by fate, betrayal, and deathly secrets. As emotions run high and reality blurs, the story reveals how love can survive even beyond life itself.

pasion-mafiosa.title: Pasión mafiosa
pasion-mafiosa.description: Sania, a woman with a secret that burns her soul, has just discovered that she is carrying the child of Kabir, the enigmatic and powerful leader of the most influential mafia.

36-1.title: Love Refresh
36-1.description: The microdrama opens with CEO Akash Maran seeking genuine love, leading him to marry Sukanya, a woman burdened by a past of humiliation and a missing daughter, whom he initially tests by concealing his immense wealth. Simultaneously, the dignified matriarch Savitri endures cruel hostility and accusations from her daughter-in-law Ahalya, who questions her husband Raghav's paternity and plots to publicly humiliate Sukanya, revealing deep-seated class prejudice. As Akash and Sukanya navigate their new marriage, the search for Sukanya's lost daughter becomes a central theme, complicated by Akash's own secret that Preethi is not his biological child, creating a poignant undercurrent of shared loss and deception that binds their fates. The narrative intensifies with stark class conflict, as the formidable Maran Group Matriarch and her arrogant kin brutally humiliate Raghav and Sukanya, who struggle for dignity and belonging. Raghav faces public shaming and an ultimatum from the Matriarch, while Sukanya endures classist attacks and threats concerning her son. Amidst these external pressures, Sukanya also battles her greedy brother Annayya, who exploits her kindness and schemes to extract wealth, further highlighting her vulnerability. However, hidden powers begin to emerge. Akash, initially undercover, dramatically reveals his true identity as CEO Maaran to protect Sukanya from corporate arrogance and familial betrayal, delivering swift justice to those who wronged her. Concurrently, a defiant young woman, Preethi, challenges Annayya's family and hints at her own powerful connection to the Maaran Group, setting the stage for a corporate power struggle. A harrowing tale of betrayal unfolds as devoted mother Radha's selfless kidney donation for her son Raghav is exposed as a ruthless manipulation by Ahalya for her own mother's benefit, leading to Raghav's divorce and his fight for custody. The climax sees CEO Raghav unleashing brutal corporate revenge against past betrayers, stripping them of assets and banishing them, while also showing a softer side towards Sukanya, hinting at a complex romantic interest. Akash Maaran, having tested Sukanya's love, proposes marriage, which she joyfully accepts, solidifying their bond. The overarching mystery of Sukanya's missing daughter culminates in an emotional reunion, as Sukanya's father, with Akash's unwavering support, finally reunites with his long-lost daughter, Raaghavi, identified by a unique locket. The show ultimately explores themes of love beyond material wealth, resilience against betrayal, the pursuit of justice, and the profound power of family, both found and reunited, amidst a world dictated by power and privilege, where hidden truths constantly reshape destinies.

pregnant-by-mistake.title: Pregnant By Mistake
pregnant-by-mistake.description: A dramatic tale about a hospital mix-up that implants businessman Kabir’s sperm into a stranger, Jiya. As Jiya becomes pregnant, Kabir brings her home, sparking jealousy in his wife and chaos in the Khanna family. Amid betrayal, greed, and emotional turmoil, an unexpected love begins to grow between Kabir and Jiya. Watch now.

the-billionaire-i-called-honey.title: The Billionaire I Called 'Honey'
the-billionaire-i-called-honey.description: একজন স্ত্রীর গল্প যে তার স্বামী ধনী হওয়ার পর তাকে ডিভোর্স দেওয়ার সিদ্ধান্ত নেয়, কিন্তু তারপর এক আশ্চর্যজনক মোড় নেয়।

launde-ghaziabad-ke.title: Launde ghaziabad ke
launde-ghaziabad-ke.description: The family rivalry trickles into the local politics and underbelly of Ghaziabad. This ignites a chain of gun violence,  leading to the bloodbath that decides the fate of both parties.

bullied-billionaire.title: Loser Baccha Bana Billionaire
bullied-billionaire.description: From a bullied schoolboy to a self-made millionaire — Karan’s journey is raw, emotional, and deeply inspiring. Witness how pain, rejection, and grit shape him into something extraordinary. A story of resilience that proves: your past doesn’t define your future. Watch Now !

the-forgotten-master-3.title: The Forgotten Master
the-forgotten-master-3.description: Left for dead by his own brother, he refuses to let fate have the final say. When his true power resurfaces, he faces corrupt masters, ruthless fighters, and the demons within. A gripping tale of revenge, redemption, and the rebirth of a legend.

final-husband-1.title: FINAL HUSBAND
final-husband-1.description: A modest home cook marries a man she believes is ordinary—unaware he’s a billionaire testing the power of true love. As she endures cruel humiliation and desperately searches for her missing daughter, a stunning truth comes to light. A saga of hidden identities, family betrayal, and unshakable love—where heartbreak meets redemption.

cinderella-aur-andha-ceo.title: Delulu Dulha
cinderella-aur-andha-ceo.description: When fiery small-town girl Naina accidentally crosses paths with arrogant business tycoon Arjun Mehta, a twist of fate forces them into a marriage neither wanted. Between clashing egos, hidden secrets, and unexpected sparks, their journey unfolds like a modern-day fairytale with a sharp twist, where love battles pride, and Cinderella isn’t waiting to be saved.

the-forgotten-master-2.title: The Forgotten Master
the-forgotten-master-2.description:
వ్యోమ్‌ని అతని అన్న చావు దరిదాపుల్లో వదిలేశాడు... కానీ విధి అంత ఈజీగా వదిలేసిందా?”
తన అసలు శక్తి మళ్లీ బయటికొచ్చినపుడు, అవినీతిపరులైన గురువులు, క్రూరమైన ఫైటర్లు, తన అంతరంగపు భూతాలన్నిటినీ ఎదుర్కొని, ఒకప్పుడు తానే సృష్టించిన లెజెండ్‌గా మళ్లీ నిలబడ్డాడు.

the-wife-behind-the-empire.title: The Wife Behind the Empire
the-wife-behind-the-empire.description: The Wife Behind the Empire tells the story of Janvi, a woman betrayed by her husband Veer and his family, who try to replace her with his ex, Soniya. But when Janvi reveals her hidden strength and true identity as the CEO of Acme Group, she shocks everyone, turning her heartbreak into power and reclaiming control over her life and destiny.

the-first-prince-of-daxia-4.title: The First Prince of Daxia
the-first-prince-of-daxia-4.description: The story spans a long chain of palace crises, where magic, food, lineage, and succession keep colliding. It begins with a workplace curse that causes a painful transformation and throws a young man into a frightening new reality. From there, the narrative moves into a court full of disguises, threats, and shifting loyalties, where servants, princes, queens, and rulers repeatedly clash over power. Paul emerges early as a timid but resourceful protector, helping a maid escape danger and later using unusual inventions or methods to defend others. Sia is repeatedly placed in peril, fleeing pursuers, entering palace spaces, and becoming tied to a larger mystery about identity and royal blood. Court women such as Queen Rajni, Empress Rajni, and Hillary are shown fighting over favor, fertility, and control of the throne, while their rivals and allies maneuver through hidden bargains and punishments. One thread centers on a dangerous fertility pact, where a high-ranking consort seeks help from a eunuch and is warned that the cure demands a serious sacrifice. Another thread turns domestic life into comedy and conflict, as couples argue over meals, masculinity, and what it means to be a spouse. Paul James becomes increasingly important as an inventor, chef, and political target, especially after his warm-food innovation draws royal jealousy and leads to confiscations, accusations, and arrest. The palace treats food as both necessity and weapon, with rulers using shortages, bans, and feast demands to control the court. Paul survives by improvising, bluffing, and refusing to surrender, even when powerful figures demand impossible dishes or threaten those close to him. His relationship with Sia remains a source of both tenderness and danger, especially when pregnancy and scandal bring new threats. The succession crisis then widens into claims of hidden parentage, with multiple men insisting they are the emperor's son or rightful heir. Rituals, interrogations, and revelations expose how fragile legitimacy is, while queens and ministers try to erase inconvenient truths. War and academy trials add another layer of danger, as knowledge, strategy, and battlefield leadership become tools in the struggle for survival. By the later episodes, imprisonment, execution threats, impersonation, and revenge all converge around the throne. The final state of the story is unstable rather than resolved, with rival powers still contesting authority and Paul James remaining caught at the center of the conflict.

southern-emperor-of-the-town-3.title: Southern Emperor of the Town
southern-emperor-of-the-town-3.description: A powerful Master, a king from a war-torn fantasy realm, awakens in a modern city with complete amnesia, initially denying his true identity despite Elina's pleas to reclaim his destiny and save his collapsing kingdom. This individual, Simovan, faces a brutal personal betrayal when his wife, Catherin, demands a divorce for a wealthy lover, Albert, pushing him to a violent breaking point. After ascending to the throne of Chengi, Simovan is immediately attacked and left for dead, leading to a three-year disappearance during which rivals seize his empire. He defiantly returns, asserting his royal lineage and demanding the sacred 'Raja Mudra' artifact, facing scorn and public confrontation orchestrated by Albert and other antagonists. Concurrently, Queeny, an heiress, is trapped in a web of forced marriages and familial manipulation by her authoritarian Chin family, including her father Jackson and grandfather, who seek to seize her legacy. Simovan, also known as Master Simon or Simhavan, emerges as her fierce protector, challenging her family's tyrannical control and developing a romantic connection with her. The struggle intensifies as Simovan issues ultimatums for the 'rajmudra' and confronts Albert, Augustin, and Solin in escalating power struggles and violent confrontations. The narrative becomes complex with challenges to Simovan's legitimacy, as he is accused of being an imposter, and a true king, Elvin, emerges, revealing a royal seal with the support of Saara. Queeny makes desperate sacrifices to protect Simovan, even publicly denouncing him under duress, despite her secret efforts to safeguard him. However, influential figures like Mr. Sayre and Mr. Sir hint at Queeny's true worth and a path to vindication, suggesting a hidden identity. The Master, Simovan, asserts his authority as king through ruthless financial and physical force, driven by a desire to settle old scores and protect Queeny. The show culminates in a brutal power struggle, with Simovan mobilizing armies and orchestrating complex plans to reclaim what he believes is his, amidst shifting alliances, betrayals, and a continuous fight for control and survival.

the-westward-2.title: The Westward
the-westward-2.description: The microdrama begins with Maverick, an arrogant demon, tasked by his mentor Guruji to transport Aurora, an entity believed to bring peace. However, Aurora warns Maverick that delivering her to Elijah will unleash destruction, forcing Maverick into a moral dilemma. Defying Guruji and the King, Maverick absorbs Aurora's power to protect her from celestial forces and his rival, General Landon, leading to a devastating battle in Swarg Lok where he is subdued. His true "sin" is revealed as a forbidden love for Aurora, resulting in his incapacitation and a tragic end, with his soul imprisoned for sixteen years, often by the tyrannical Dragon King/Raja. Guruji, also known as Tripitaka or Guru Landon, defies Heaven's decree and embarks on a perilous, long-term quest to free Maverick and retrieve Aurora. This journey involves confronting the Dragon King, navigating ancient feuds, and dealing with powerful artifacts like the Kshetra Granth and the "Book of First Fire." Meanwhile, Maverick's loyal brother Hank, now a king, faces his own trials, including betrayal from his wife Luna and brother Xiao Long, and is coerced into retrieving the Kshetra Granth, leading him down a darker path before he aids in Maverick's liberation efforts. Jasper, Maverick's younger brother, and Orion, a fierce protector, join the fight to free Maverick from the Dragon Raja, with Orion also pursuing his own vendettas. The narrative is rife with cosmic conflicts, manipulations by a Demon Lord, and revelations of Guruji's past deceptions, including his manipulation of a former disciple named Swer. After sixteen years, Maverick's vengeful spirit returns, possessing Jasper, and reignites his fated battle with Guruji and the formidable Three-Eyed General over Aurora. As ancient seals shatter and chaos erupts, Maverick prepares for a climactic battle to reshape the celestial realm, seeking ultimate freedom and justice, culminating in Aurora's miraculous reappearance and her profound bond with Jasper.

the-call-boy-i-met-in-hyderabad.title: The Call Boy I Met In Hyderabad
the-call-boy-i-met-in-hyderabad.description: Riya Srikanth’s life turns upside down after a one-night stand with Vishal Subramaniam, a man she believes is a call boy - leading to a fake marriage and unexpected emotions.

flash-marriage-to-the-president-mrs-gu-i.title: Marriage to President: Mrs. Gu y, a Hidden Tycoon
flash-marriage-to-the-president-mrs-gu-i.description: A father driven by vengeance, a son haunted by a family tragedy, and a wedding that ends in public humiliation. As secrets behind a deadly past unravel, forced alliances begin to crack under emotional strain. This is a story of legacy, betrayal, and choices that defy tradition—where love, revenge, and honor collide.

code-war-2.title: Code War
code-war-2.description: When a massive cyber attack cripples India’s defense, an unsung AI genius secretly prevents disaster - only to be betrayed by those he saved. Left broken and discarded, he rises from the ashes, reclaiming his brilliance to build an empire that rewrites the rules of power. This is a saga of revenge, vision, and redemption - where technology becomes both a weapon and salvation.

true-and-false-the-dragon-commander.title: True and False The Dragon Commander
true-and-false-the-dragon-commander.description: The show centers on a long feud between powerful families and rulers, where pride, legitimacy, and hidden identity keep driving the conflict. Alex Anderson emerges early as a fierce fighter and later as a returned ruler who has been absent for two years. He is repeatedly tied to disguise, public humiliation, and a dangerous mission that seems meant to restore his standing. Around him, Jasmine is pressured by powerful men and family expectations, but she keeps resisting forced choices and defending the person she trusts. Marriage becomes a major battleground, with public announcements, legal proof, and attempts to destroy evidence all used to control who can marry whom. A pendant and other valued objects also become symbols of status, deception, and hidden worth, turning ordinary items into triggers for larger confrontations. The story repeatedly shifts between village gatherings, school settings, palace disputes, and royal courts, but the same stakes remain: who has the right to lead, who is lying, and who can be trusted. Several figures are publicly humiliated or accused, yet those moments only deepen the sense that a larger conspiracy is at work. James is pulled into multiple conflicts as both a protected figure and a target of suspicion, while others accuse him of hiding legendary identities or standing in the way of power. The Dragon King, Dragon Master, and God of War identities are all invoked as markers of true authority, but each claim is challenged by rivals and impostors. Alex is alternately mocked as worthless and praised for impossible feats, and Jasmine often becomes the one who defends him in front of hostile crowds. Their bond grows stronger through repeated public pressure, even as others try to separate them or use Jasmine as leverage. Political and military tensions widen the conflict beyond family drama, bringing in governors, kings, commanders, and armies that are already weakened by betrayal and defeat. Poisoning, collapse, and failed assassination attempts suggest that the struggle is not only social but also deadly. At the same time, some scenes hint at recovery and revelation, as hidden truths about past sacrifices and long absences begin to surface. The final movement of the show keeps both war and romance alive, with prisoners, conspiracies, and royal judgment still unresolved while a marriage proposal finally gives Jasmine a direct choice. Even so, the broader world remains unstable, and the characters’ futures still depend on whether truth, loyalty, and rightful identity can survive the pressure around them.

jhaadoowala-billionaire.title: Jhaadoowala Billionaire
jhaadoowala-billionaire.description: Neel Raichand, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Snehal, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!

mulank-9.title: Mulank 9
mulank-9.description: Mulank 9 represents courage, compassion, and spiritual strength. Those with this number are natural warriors, passionate and selfless in nature. This video explores their heroic traits, emotional intensity, and life mission. Unveil how Mulank 9 shapes their destiny, relationships, and inner power.

mulank-8.title: Mulank 8
mulank-8.description: Mulank 8 signifies power, ambition, and karmic balance. People with this number are strong-willed, disciplined, and often face big life tests. This video uncovers their struggles, strengths, and spiritual growth. Discover how Mulank 8 influences their fate, finances, and transformation.

shaadi-goals-101.title: Shaadi Goals 101
shaadi-goals-101.description: The microdrama begins with the dramatic revelation of Aarav, a humble delivery person, as the heir to the powerful Malhotra family, immediately followed by a devastating car crash that leaves him critically ill and in a three-year coma. His fiercely devoted girlfriend, Saanvi, defies her patriarchal father and societal pressures to secretly care for Aarav, making immense personal and financial sacrifices. Saanvi's unwavering love eventually awakens Aarav, who recovers and proposes marriage, but a mysterious call to 'Ishita' and a clandestine investigation into Saanvi's background hint at hidden agendas. Aarav then makes a grand public proposal, revealing his immense wealth and miraculous recovery, which sparks accusations of fraud but solidifies his claim as the Malhotra heir. He confronts rivals like Nakul Shekhawat, asserting his power and suitability for Saanvi amidst corporate clashes and family opposition to their union. As Aarav reclaims his rightful place, he demands justice for Saanvi and unleashes wrath on those who wronged them, while his powerful sister Ishita and matriarch Mrs. Devika Malhotra rally to defend their legacy. The family faces external threats from General Hemant Wadhwa and the enigmatic Jay Tej Rana, who harbors a personal vendetta and hints at a deep secret about Aarav's past and dangerous lineage. Ishita, wielding a legendary "Warrior Lord's sidearm," fiercely protects Aarav, exposing treacherous family members and challenging General Wadhwa's control. Amidst these power struggles, Aarav faces public humiliation and a forced marriage attempt, with Saanvi, now identified as his sister, intervening to defend their honor. The formidable Warrior Lord, their mother, makes a dramatic entrance to protect her children, asserting supreme authority. As Aarav and Saanvi's grand wedding approaches, Devika, Aarav's mother, hints at a profound secret connected to a past accident and a hidden link between herself and Saanvi's father. Saanvi's parents then reveal the truth about Aarav's accident and their years of deception, including secretly funding her. Despite the unraveling family secrets and corporate treachery, Aarav and Saanvi's profound love emerges as a healing force, clearing their path to a future. However, their long-awaited engagement is violently interrupted by unexpected explosions, suggesting that despite resolving some impediments, new, explosive dangers loom.

mulank-7.title: Mulank 7
mulank-7.description: Mulank 7 symbolizes intuition, spirituality, and deep thinking. Individuals with this number are seekers of truth and inner wisdom. This video unveils their mysterious nature, strengths, and life lessons. Explore how Mulank 7 shapes their journey, choices, and destiny.

2d13e13b-53fb-400f-a90b-91b21cb23e6d.title: Time Travel MBBS
2d13e13b-53fb-400f-a90b-91b21cb23e6d.description: Nobel laureate Dr. Jia Sharma, a passionate advocate for universal healthcare, is seemingly killed in an explosion orchestrated by the powerful pharmaceutical industry. Granted a supernatural second chance, she is reborn as an "innocent, forgotten mother" named Jia, tasked with healing a world ravaged by disease. She awakens disoriented in a rustic world, accused by superstitious villagers of a heinous crime involving two children, and discovers a temporal shift. As she grapples with fragmented memories, she fights to revive the children, proving her innocence and asserting a deep connection to them, earning the label "chudail" (witch). Jia discovers she is impersonating a woman involved in a sinister child trafficking ring, complicating her mission as she navigates a new identity and a trusting "husband," Major Arjun. She must expose the criminals, protect the children, and rectify grave injustices while maintaining her elaborate facade. A deep maternal bond forms with the children, but their fragile new family is immediately plunged into peril when their food is deliberately poisoned. Jia confronts Rekha, revealed as the manipulative culprit driven by jealousy, who publicly accuses Jia of black magic and child selling, and destroys her evidence in a suspicious fire. Despite these challenges, Jia, also known as Dr. Jiya, uses her medical skills to expose Rekha's guilt, revealing her mind belongs to Dr. Jiya Sharma, trapped in another's body. She faces accusations of medical fraud and performs life-saving surgery without credentials, leading to an investigator uncovering her presumed death six years prior, linking her to espionage and a mysterious lineage. A vengeful figure from her past, Saya, and a mysterious operative ("Zinda") emerge, further threatening her concealed identity. Jia confesses her imposter status to her children, who embrace her, but she faces relentless sabotage and false accusations, including a mandated DNA test. She exposes a cunning manipulator's attempt to falsify DNA results through a viral video, garnering widespread public support. In a high-stakes courtroom battle, Jia defends her noble intent to save lives against strict legal technicalities, ultimately achieving verification of her identity and professional contributions. Despite official challenges and accusations of corruption, her past heroic act is revealed, leading to a judge granting her a conditional license: a 30-day public trial at a government-supervised clinic where any complaint could end her career. Undeterred, Dr. Jia opens her clinic, immediately facing an ethical test when her first patient is the very man who sabotaged her past, yet she chooses healing over retribution. Her journey is a relentless quest to protect her children, prove her true identity and medical legitimacy, and fulfill her mission to heal a world ravaged by disease against powerful adversaries and a rigid system.

mulank-6.title: Mulank 6
mulank-6.description: Mulank 6 represents love, harmony, and responsibility. People with this number are nurturing, artistic, and value relationships deeply. This video explores their emotional depth, strengths, and challenges. Find out how Mulank 6 influences their personal life and success journey.

shadow-of-honour.title: Shadow of Honour
shadow-of-honour.description: Single Mother follows Neha, a strong yet struggling woman who moves to Mumbai with her son to rebuild her life. Between surviving odd jobs, facing prejudice, and protecting her dignity, she crosses paths with Aman and his grandfather Baldev, unknowingly stepping into a storm of love, lies, and betrayal that will test her courage and heart.

billion-dollar-blunder-2.title: Billion Dollar Blunder
billion-dollar-blunder-2.description: The microdrama begins with Shalini and Mukesh Saxena embarking on a mysterious 30th-anniversary trip to a modest resort, sparking suspicion in their CEO son, Dhanush. Unbeknownst to them, Dhanush secretly enlists resort manager Parvathy to watch over his parents, inadvertently setting the stage for their torment. At the resort, Shalini and Mukesh face shocking cruelty, denied basic services, and threatened with eviction by aggressive staff, including Parvathy. Mukesh suffers a severe allergic reaction after Parvathy, driven by vengeful corporate ambition, deliberately offers him a peanut-laced sandwich. As Mukesh fights for his life, the couple's claims of being the boss's parents are met with accusations of fraud, leading to a dramatic revelation by Haritha that she is 'your boss's mother.' The narrative then introduces Nandini, a desperate woman fighting to save her critically ill husband, also named Mukesh, by impersonating the powerful Mr. and Mrs. Saxena, a deception that leads to violent confrontations. Mukesh and Shalini are initially exposed for fraudulently using the Saxena name, but documents later confirm their legitimate identity, while Nandini also declares herself the true Shalini Saxena. A sinister plot orchestrated by Tarun against Mukesh's parents unfolds, and Yuvraj Saxena's critically ill father is denied help by Parvathy, igniting a fierce battle for family legacy and retribution. Dhanush Saxena, now a surgeon and heir, enlists Naina in a revenge plot against Parvathy, as other family members engage in their own ambitious schemes for influence. Dhanush emerges as a powerful avenger, intervening to protect the vulnerable and later delivering crushing corporate judgment against those who abused his elderly parents. He confronts and vows retribution against the individuals who brutally abused his parents, demanding colossal compensation and threatening jail. Scarred by his parents' torture, Dhanush rejects forgiveness and orchestrates a plan to dismantle his tormentors' honor. The conflict culminates in a violent crash involving Mrs. Saxena and a brutal attack on an elderly woman claiming to be Dhanush's mother. Finally, CEO Hari, identified as Dhanush Saxena, learns of his mother, Indu Saxena's, kidnapping by the ruthless Parvathi and Tarun, who seek not just money but profound suffering and the destruction of his family and corporate empire. Dhanush mobilizes resources and attempts a rescue, leading to a violent confrontation with gunfire and an undetermined outcome, leaving the fate of several characters hanging in the balance amidst hints of deeper corporate intrigue.

the-forgotten-master-1.title: The Forgotten Master
the-forgotten-master-1.description: ভিয়োমকে তার নিজের ভাই মৃত্যুর জন্য ছেড়ে দিয়েছিল, কিন্তু নিয়তির অন্য পরিকল্পনা ছিল। তার আসল স্বরূপ যখন পুনরুত্থিত হয়, তখন সে দুর্নীতিবাজ প্রভু, নিষ্ঠুর যোদ্ধা এবং ভেতরের রাক্ষসদের সাথে লড়াই করে তার আগের কিংবদন্তিতে পরিণত হয়। দ্যা ফরগটেন মাস্টার  হল শক্তি, স্মৃতি এবং একজন মানুষের চূড়ান্ত প্রত্যাবর্তনের গল্প।

pregnancy-ne-banaya-billionaire.title: Pregnancy Ne Banaya Billionaire
pregnancy-ne-banaya-billionaire.description: “Shaadi Goals” is a vibrant family drama that blends romance, comedy, and chaos as two very different families prepare for a grand wedding. With lovebirds caught between tradition, clashes of culture, and hilarious misunderstandings, the story shows how true love and togetherness can survive even the most over-the-top shaadi madness

mr-idiot-hero-husband-6.title: Mr. Idiot, Hero Husband
mr-idiot-hero-husband-6.description: সবাই যে ছেলেকে গর্ধব আর বোকা ভাবে, সে আসলে অসীম শক্তির অধিকারী। বিপুল সম্পত্তির মালিক সে। সকলে মিলে চক্রান্ত করে তার স্ত্রীকে তার থেকে আলাদা করার আপ্রাণ চেষ্টা চালিয়ে যাচ্ছে। সকলের সামনে ছেলেটিকে প্রতিনিয়ত খুব খারাপ ভাবে অপমান করা হয়। কিন্তু তার স্ত্রী তাকে ভালোবাসে। কবে সেই ছেলে তার আসল রূপ দেখাবে?

meri-maa-mera-bhojh.title: Meri Maa, Mera Bhojh
meri-maa-mera-bhojh.description: A poignant story of a son who grows distant from his mother after marriage, forgetting her sacrifices. When tragedy strikes, guilt and realization hit him too late. This story exposes the pain of neglecting parents in old age. It’s a moving reminder of love, duty, and the irreplaceable bond between mother and child. Watch now.

raising-a-kid-or-cultivator-1.title: Raising A Kid Or Cultivator
raising-a-kid-or-cultivator-1.description:
তানিয়া এক বড় ব্যবসায়ীর মেয়ে, যার ছেলে রহস্যময় শক্তির অধিকারী হবে। সাত বছর আগে তানিয়া আর অনিরুদ্ধের প্রেম থেকে জন্ম নেয় সেই ছেলে। হঠাৎ 
চারদিক শত্রু, লোভ আর চক্রান্তে ভরে ওঠে। অনিরুদ্ধ কি সবাইকে বাঁচাবে, নাকি তার ছেলের ভিতর লুকানো অলৌকিক শক্তিই রক্ষা করবে তাদের

adopted-4.title: Broken Blood Ties
adopted-4.description: Kiara Bharadwaj, who discovers on her 18th birthday that she was adopted by Arjun and Natasha Bharadwaj. What begins as a shocking revelation soon pulls her into a dark journey to uncover the truth about her real parents, Karthik and Kavita Verma, and a hidden past that threatens her very identity. With her best friend Saanvi Shukla and estranged sister Aadhya Kumari by her side, Kiara must decide where her true family lies in blood, or in love. Watch Now

the-fate-is-you-4.title: The Fate Is You
the-fate-is-you-4.description: Saved from danger by a mysterious stranger, one man sets out on a determined quest to find and thank his unknown savior. Meanwhile, a family is torn by tension, where a young member is forced to obey elders under threats of punishment. A gripping tale blending mystery, gratitude, and family conflict—where suspense and emotion walk hand in hand.

double-trouble-double-billionaire.title: Shaadi On Fire
double-trouble-double-billionaire.description: A fiery twin impersonates her shy sister to confront a ruthless billionaire, but ends up falling for his equally powerful twin. Between mistaken identities, passion, and power games, love turns into the most dangerous deal of all.

dont-think-about-it-lady-3.title: Don't Think About it Lady
dont-think-about-it-lady-3.description: A complex microdrama unfolds within a high-stakes world, initially centered on a protagonist forced into the deadly "Crossing Club" game, where survival hinges on avoiding forbidden romantic connections. Concurrently, heiress Mengling navigates tumultuous engagements and corporate power plays, facing betrayal from Yi Fan and the formidable challenge of Duan Tianchi, who also appears as a ruthless mogul. As Mengling seeks independence, she finds aid from a "war god" and complicated protection from Duan Tianchi, while a past love triangle involving Xiao Xiao Tu Mi and Yi Fan resurfaces. The narrative quickly escalates into intense power struggles, marked by deception, mistaken identities, and high-stakes financial maneuvers, with figures like Young Master Yi Feng asserting absolute dominance. Identity manipulation becomes a perilous theme, exemplified by a "face-changing technique" and catastrophic identity swaps, as characters like the resurrected Duan Tianqi return to assert control. Amidst these corporate and personal battles, a central "Young Master," Arun, wields a powerful system and embarks on a perilous quest, encountering ancient beings. Sworn enemies Ye Fan and Duantianchi are later forced into an unbreakable brotherhood by a Master, under a decree of mutual protection, immediately challenged by financial demands. Pharmaceutical CEO Ye Fan faces a moral dilemma, defying corporate pressure to destroy defective medicine, prioritizing public safety over profit, and navigating complex personal relationships, including a toxic engagement and a mysterious quest. He also grapples with public scrutiny over an arranged engagement, a mysterious past, and a unique connection with Fangya Ji, who can hear his thoughts. Ye Fan makes an unthinkable sacrifice, giving up his pharmaceutical empire to a legendary healer to save his secretary's mother, revealing his deep commitment. Corporate intrigues deepen with the Yue family's bankruptcy and a ruthless "Master's" takeover scheme, forcing Ye Fan into an arranged marriage. The enigmatic Ye Fan emerges as a central figure, orchestrating a meticulous plan to dismantle rivals like the formidable Iron King and the self-proclaimed "God of War," Duan Tianqi. He reveals his true identity as a cunning avenger, forcing his "blood brother" Duan Tianqi into submission and systematically dismantling influence in Yang Jang City. The narrative culminates with a "Young Master" orchestrating a ruthless 30-year plan, setting the stage for a high-stakes, long-term battle against his brother, Ye Fan, hinting at a larger, orchestrated "game" controlled by an enigmatic "Host."

became-the-ex-wifes-white-moonlight-afte.title: Became the Ex-Wife's White Moonlight After My Death
became-the-ex-wifes-white-moonlight-afte.description: She begged for love, but he was too busy to hear. Now she’s gone—and the truth she left behind shatters the man who ignored her. Become The Ex-wife’s White Moonlight After My Death is a haunting tale of love realized too late, heartbreak, and regret. Watch now!

too-late-to-beg.title: Supreme Sister
too-late-to-beg.description: The show “Supreme Sister ” follows Isha, an adopted daughter mistreated and framed by her envious sister Riddhi, who manipulates the Arora family into believing Isha is a thief. Wronged and cast out, Isha gets a second chance at life, where she vows to fight back, reclaim her dignity, and rise above betrayal to build her own identity

lucky-dragon-heavenly-fortune-5.title: LUCKY DRAGON: HEAVENLY FORTUNE
lucky-dragon-heavenly-fortune-5.description: A billionaire hiding his true identity works as a food delivery boy, determined to reclaim his fortune. But as greedy relatives conspire to stop him, his journey becomes a thrilling battle of wits and will. A powerful tale of revenge, resilience, and the triumph of honesty over greed.

hawa-gone-rogue.title: Wild Secrets
hawa-gone-rogue.description: When city girl Shefali steps into a dangerous jungle, she faces Garudaa - a fierce warrior who rules with power and passion. What starts with fear turns into fire, love, and revenge. Wild Secrets 🔥 is a bold saga of lust, loyalty, and survival - where ancient rituals clash with modern instincts in a world ruled by desire.

jerk-punishment-club-5.title: Jerk Punishment Club
jerk-punishment-club-5.description: A fearless young woman creates a secret club to punish men who mistreat women. Fueled by her sister’s pain, her mission for vengeance quickly escalates. A bold, thrilling tale of justice, rebellion, and a fight to right every wrong.

the-female-lead-is-the-strongest-mouthpi.title: The Female Lead Is The Strongest Mouthpiece Substitute
the-female-lead-is-the-strongest-mouthpi.description: নারী প্রধান চরিত্রটি হল সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী মুখপাত্রের প্রতিস্থাপক" একটি সংক্ষিপ্ত চীনা নাটক সিরিজ, যা এক তীক্ষ্ণবুদ্ধিসম্পন্ন মহিলাকে ঘিরে গড়ে উঠেছে। সে অন্য কারো পরিচয়ে প্রবেশ করে—একটি ষড়যন্ত্র, রাজনীতি ও গোপন এজেন্ডায় পূর্ণ জগতে এক সাহসী ও শক্তিশালী প্রতিস্থাপক রূপে আত্মপ্রকাশ করে।

retirement-re-hire-and-the-unexpected-wi.title: Retirement Re - hire and the Unexpected Windfall
retirement-re-hire-and-the-unexpected-wi.description: Watch This Beautiful show "Retirement Re - hire and the Unexpected Windfall" Only On KuKu TV!

the-return-of-the-king-triumphant-return.title: The Return of the King: Triumphant Return
the-return-of-the-king-triumphant-return.description: The Return of the King: Triumphant Return

objection-your-honor-1.title: Objection, Your honor
objection-your-honor-1.description: A tragic accident leads to a bitter courtroom clash between a wife and her own husband. As family ties turn into fierce rivalry, justice and loyalty are put on trial. A gripping tale of betrayal, truth, and the ultimate battle to win the case.

mistress-of-deception.title: Badla: Khoon aur Mohabbat
mistress-of-deception.description: Kriti Malhotra, shrouded in secrets and vengeance, weaves her way into the lives of Aditya and his powerful father Vikram. As lies and half-truths entangle them, Aditya struggles to uncover her true identity, Himani, a woman thought to be lost forever. In a world driven by betrayal, greed, and revenge, every move Kriti makes threatens to shatter the Ahuja family, while Vikram, Nitin, and Anita fight to protect their own dark legacies. Watch Now!

the-girl-is-martial-master.title: The Girl is Martial Master
the-girl-is-martial-master.description: তিয়াসা এমন এক পরিবারে জন্মায়, যেখানে মেয়েদের মার্শাল আর্ট শেখা নিষিদ্ধ। তবুও তিয়াসা লুকিয়ে শিখে ফেলে মার্শাল আর্ট। এক শত্রু পরিবার এসে তার ভাইদের হত্যা করে। ওদের বড় ছেলে ভয়ংকর অসুরী শক্তি পেয়েছে। এখন তিয়াসা কি তার পরিবার আর গ্রামকে বাঁচাতে পারবে?

come-home-our-heart-5.title: Come Home, Our Heart
come-home-our-heart-5.description: অনেক বছর আগে বাবা তার ছোট্ট মেয়েকে বিক্রি করে দিয়েছিলেন। তাতে মেয়েটির মায়ের মন ভেঙে চুরমার হয়ে যায়। এখন, আঠারো বছর পর মেয়েটির মা একজন বিলিয়নিয়ার হয়ে উঠেছেন এবং তার ভাইেরা সফল জীবন যাপন করছে। কিন্তু এখনও তাদের মনে সেই দগদগে ঘা রয়েই গিয়েছে। সেটা হল, মায়ের মেয়েকে হারানো এবং ভাইদের পরম আদরের বোনকে হারিয়ে ফেলা। এত বড়লোক হওয়ার পরে কি তারা তাদের বোনকে খুঁজে পাবে?

workers-revenge.title: Loser Billionaire ka Comeback
workers-revenge.description: Nilesh Srivastava, a once-successful entrepreneur betrayed by his friend Pramod Shukla. With his son Akash, sister-in-law Ruchi, and memories of his late wife Sanya, Nilesh rises from humiliation to confront greed, betrayal, and reclaim his dignity.

hermitage.title: Hermitage
hermitage.description: Lukas, an enigmatic CEO, embarks on a quest to uncover his true parentage through a series of contract marriages, initially clashing with heiress Sophia and later miraculously reviving Lily Brown, binding him to a new marriage promise. He becomes entangled with the powerful Davis family, facing accusations of being an imposter and an ex-convict, yet is revealed as a powerful figure poised to manage their businesses, igniting a fierce battle for legitimacy with Emily Davis's half-sister. Emily, trapped in an arranged marriage to Benjamin of the Martin family, defiantly declares her love for Lucas, who repeatedly challenges the Martin family's authority. Concurrently, Sir, the "Prince of the Mountain," uncovers a deep conspiracy involving the Martin family in his parents' disappearance, launching a corporate attack. Mia, a powerful heiress with a complex past with Lucas, intervenes in his life, but ultimately poisons him after he rejects her proposal, revealing crucial information about his missing father. Driven by revenge, Lucas orchestrates a corporate takedown of Martin Pharmaceutical, leveraging ancient medicine formulas, and launches his "Low Group," sparking a medical revolution and fierce rivalry with Benjamin. As Levi's pharmaceutical empire crumbles, Lucas is revealed as the rightful owner of the Lou Group and the legendary "Maharaja," dismantling the Martin group and seizing their assets. Emily, a powerful "Medicine Partner," meticulously conceals her true corporate status, confiding only in Lucas, who, as the hidden "Maharaja," orchestrates a grand scheme to expose a past palace attack and a conspiracy involving influential shareholders and the Martin family. Lucas is ultimately revealed as the long-lost prince and rightful heir, challenging the reigning King and Prime Minister Ezra, and gaining the allegiance of the revered War God Princes. As the true King, Lucas vows vengeance against Grandmaster Ezra for a royal massacre that decimated his family, confronting complicit corporate figures like Mr. Martin, while navigating a dramatic love triangle with Emily and Mia.

gareeb-nanny-ceo-ki-rani.title: Daddy aur Nanny
gareeb-nanny-ceo-ki-rani.description: When a poor nanny enters the mansion of powerful CEO Rohit Rajvanshi, she has no idea that her past and present are about to collide. Little Atharav grows attached to her instantly, but with every passing day secrets, betrayals and hidden truths shake the Rajvanshi family. Can love lost be found again, and can a child become the bridge between two torn hearts?

the-spoiled-billionaire-daughters-secret.title: The Spoiled Billionaire Daughter's Secret Identity Exposed
the-spoiled-billionaire-daughters-secret.description: A girl gets seriously injured in an accident and is admitted to the hospital. Nearing death, she overhears her husband on the phone from the hospital saying, "Let me know if she dies." The helpless girl thinks that in her life, she only loved her father and her husband—but both of them cheated on her. Her father married another woman, and her husband got involved with his general manager. Just three months before her death, she suddenly gets reborn—all her memories intact. This time, she's not weak; she signs the divorce papers lying by her bedside and sends them to her husband, who once used them to threaten her. A new game begins—she returns every one of her husband's actions back to him. But instead of revenge, love slowly blossoms—and a new story begins.

a-lament-for-troubled-times-2.title: A Lament For Troubled Times
a-lament-for-troubled-times-2.description: বিশ্বাসঘাত, ক্ষমতা আর নীরব প্রেমের আবরণের পেছনে, এক শান্ত নারী যার, জীবন একপ্রকার বিক্রি হয়ে গিয়েছে। সে লড়াই করে যাচ্ছে নিজের মর্যাদা ও পরিচয় পুনরুদ্ধারের জন্য। অতীতের ছায়া ও পুরুষতান্ত্রিকতার মাঝে তাকে সহ্য করতে হয় চূড়ান্ত নির্মমতা। কিন্তু গোপন সত্য উন্মোচিত হলে, তার নীরব দৃঢ়তা হয়ে ওঠে সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী প্রতিবাদ।

divorced-parents.title: Doctor's Divorce
