divorced-parents.description: Dr. Niraj Chandra and Dr. Sanya Chandra, once deeply in love, now stand at the crossroads of separation. As their children, Ayaan and Ahana, struggle to keep the family together, love, respect, and old wounds collide in an emotional journey of what it truly means to be a family.

mulank-3.title: Mulank 3
mulank-3.description: Mulank 3 represents creativity, confidence, and leadership qualities. People with this number are optimistic, expressive, and naturally inspiring. This video uncovers their strengths, weaknesses, and destiny patterns. Explore how Mulank 3 shapes their relationships, success, and growth.

the-contract-wedding.title: The Contract Wedding
the-contract-wedding.description: A bold CEO proposes to a man she barely knows—unaware he’s the reclusive owner of a global empire. When scheming rivals, greedy relatives, and a spurned ex-girlfriend close in, power games erupt in the boardroom and beyond. In a twist-filled battle of status, secrets, and love, the fake husband may just become the real deal.

imperial-concubine-cultivation-manual-1.title: Imperial Concubine Cultivation Manual
imperial-concubine-cultivation-manual-1.description: Imperial Concubine Cultivation Manual for Students with Excellent Grades" is a short Chinese drama series that blends historical fantasy with modern romance, following a brilliant modern-day student who unexpectedly time-travels to an imperial era. Armed with her intelligence and sharp wit, she navigates palace politics, rivalries, and romance as she rises through the ranks to become a powerful imperial concubine. Using her academic skills in unexpected ways, she outsmarts scheming courtiers and wins the emperor's favor, all while adapting to a world far removed from her own. The series combines humor, drama, and light-hearted intrigue, making it a popular pick among fans of historical time-travel dramas.

mulank-2.title: Mulank 2
mulank-2.description: Mulank 2 reveals the personality of those born with this root number. They are diplomatic, emotional, and deeply intuitive individuals. This video explores their strengths, challenges, and life path. Discover how Mulank 2 influences relationships, career, and destiny.

phir-se-paisa.title: Dabang Daddy
phir-se-paisa.description: Dabang Daddy follows the turbulent life of Ram Kumar, a principled architect betrayed by fate, as he clashes with his greedy stepson Jacky, manipulative wife Maya, and ambitious daughter-in-law Richa. When corporate tycoon Miss Tanya Malhotra offers Ram a second chance at success, greed, betrayal, and hidden truths threaten to tear apart his family. A gripping tale of love, deceit, and the true cost of money. Watch Now!

the-fate-is-you-3.title: The Fate Is You
the-fate-is-you-3.description: The microdrama centers on Maria, initially seeking marriage to fulfill her ailing mother's dying wish, and Lionel, a powerful CEO searching for the woman who saved his life. Their paths converge in a pragmatic contract marriage, which unexpectedly blossoms into a playful, genuine connection. Lionel, secretly a millionaire, works to save Maria's critically ill mother, gradually revealing his hidden identity and challenging Maria's perception of their union. Their secret marriage faces fierce opposition from Lionel's authoritative mother, who demands an arranged match, and Maria's own mother, who pushes for her to marry Lionel. Maria's past relationships, including ex-lovers Mr. Roy, Kurl, Sanjay, and Karl, resurface, bringing accusations of infidelity and manipulation, further complicated by betrayals from friends Sara and Zara, who fabricate evidence and steal career opportunities. Maria is thrust into a brutal corporate war, strategically hired to provoke a rival company, enduring physical assault and job loss, before Lionel offers her protection at his own firm. Corporate intrigue escalates with battles between CEOs Carl and President Warren over Maria's employment, and Carl shatters Maria's trust by revealing her husband is a "common employee" at the Harvard Group. Lionel is then revealed as the CEO of Harvard Group, and their new marriage is immediately threatened by Maria's scorned ex-lover and an enigmatic accomplice. Malicious acts, including leaked personal photos and professional framing, plunge Maria into public scandal and corporate crisis, while she confronts a cunning antagonist responsible for digital fabrications and corporate sabotage. The antagonist is revealed to be Zara, driven by lifelong jealousy and a vow to destroy Maria's life, exposing Lionel's secret identity as the city's wealthiest CEO. A mysterious woman hires a hitman to eliminate Maria on her wedding day, escalating the stakes. A devastating car crash leaves Maria and Lionel critically injured, coinciding with their secret wedding. Lionel awakens with selective amnesia, cruelly forgetting Maria and their past, and is pressured to marry Nancy. Zara exploits Lionel's amnesia, blackmailing him and revealing her long-term plot of manipulation and revenge, including orchestrating the car accident. Maria fights to reclaim their love, uncovers Zara's sinister plot, and desperately tries to make Lionel remember their sudden marriage, ultimately learning he willingly pursued her. Maria heroically intervenes to save an abducted child, demonstrating her resilience amidst the chaos.

narak-se-hero.title: Narak Ka Hero
narak-se-hero.description:
This is a survival thriller where a group of people are trapped in deadly, game-like scenarios orchestrated by a masked tormentor called Jallad.
Amidst betrayals, psychological manipulation, and gruesome eliminations, the characters are forced to expose their darkest secrets and confront past crimes. The story unfolds as a tense battle of wits, morality, and survival, with truth and guilt deciding who lives and who perishes . Watch now.

my-silly-rich-wife-2.title: My Silly Rich Wife
my-silly-rich-wife-2.description: বিশ্বাস ও ভালোবাসার দ্বন্দ্বে জড়িয়ে, সে এক নিষ্পাপ ধনী মেয়ের সাথে বিবাহ বন্ধনে আবদ্ধ হয়। কিন্তু মনে মনে তার অন্য আর একটি দুর্বল এবং কৌশলপরায়ণ মেয়ের প্রতি আকর্ষণ ছিল। অতীতের প্রতারণা, হৃদয়বিদারক গোপন তথ্য এবং এক প্রাণঘাতী রোগ প্রকাশের সাথে‑সাথে, নববিবাহিতার স্নেহ ও শুদ্ধতার কঠোর পরীক্ষার মুখোমুখি হয়। প্রেম, মিথ্যাচার ও মুক্তিপ্রাপ্তির এই উত্তেজনাপূর্ণ সংগ্রামে, কি সত্যিকারের আনুগত্য শেষ পর্যন্ত জয়লাভ করবে, না কি সম্পর্কের শিকড় ছিন্ন হয়ে যাবে?

not-another-cinderella-story.title: His Forced Bride
not-another-cinderella-story.description: Rhea, a poor girl abused by her family, narrowly escapes a horrific assault at a bar and crosses paths with billionaire Aman Sisodiya. Their lives intertwine after a fateful night leaves Rhea pregnant, forcing her into a contract marriage with Aman. Amid betrayal, conspiracies, and misunderstandings, Rhea fights for dignity while Aman struggles between doubt and love—until truth and redemption finally unite them as a family. Watch now.

babymaking-on-divorce-day-3.title: Babymaking on Divorce Day
babymaking-on-divorce-day-3.description: ছোটবেলায় প্রতিশ্রুতিবদ্ধ ছিল দুজনেই একে অপরকে বড় হলে বিয়ে করবে। পাত্রের মা খুব আনন্দের সঙ্গে ছেলের বিয়ে দিতে চাইলেন ওই মেয়ের সাথে। কিন্তু পাত্র রাজি নয়। মা ছেলের বিয়ে দিলেন একপ্রকার জোর করে । কিন্তু ছেলে ওই বিয়ের রাত্রেই বিদেশে পাড়ি দিয়েছিল। বিদেশে গিয়ে নিজের চেষ্টায় কোটি টাকার কোম্পানির মালিক হল ঠিকই কিন্তু এক মানসিক রোগেও আক্রান্ত হল সে। এদিকে পাত্রের মা পুত্রবধুকে অত্যন্ত স্নেহে নিজের করে নিলেন। তার উদ্দেশ্য একটাই তার একটি নাতি অথবা নাতনি চাই। ওদিকে ছেলে এক মানসিক রোগের মহিলা ডাক্তারের চিকিৎসাধীন অবস্থায় থাকল। ধীরে ধীরে তাদের দুজনের মধ্যে এক বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ সম্পর্ক গড়ে উঠল। তাদের দুজনের মধ্যে একটা জায়গায় অত্যন্ত মিল দেখা গেল যে তারা দুজনেই তাদের নিজ নিজ স্বামী ও স্ত্রীকে খুঁজছেন। তারা কেউ বিবাহের পর থেকেই তাদের মুখ দেখেননি পর্যন্ত। সেই কারণেই তারা বিবাহ বিচ্ছেদ করে নতুন জীবন শুরু করতে চায়।

mother-in-law-was-in-a-car-accident-2.title: Mother In Law was in a Car Accident
mother-in-law-was-in-a-car-accident-2.description: The microdrama begins with a tragic car crash involving the Mother-in-law, quickly revealing a sinister cover-up orchestrated by Jiali, who fabricates a story to mislead top lawyer Jiang Chener. Lin Wanking, the Mother-in-law's daughter-in-law and a lawyer, desperately seeks medical help and fights to clear her mother-in-law's name from a hit-and-run accusation. Meanwhile, Lin Wanking's husband, Gu Yang, is distracted by Jiali, leading to critical medical delays and the Mother-in-law's tragic death. This prompts Lin Wanking to reject a settlement and vow to sue for justice, attributing her Mother-in-law's death to Gu Yang's absence and neglect. Their marriage shatters as they become opposing counsel in a high-stakes courtroom drama, with Lin Wanking prosecuting Jiali for the hit-and-run and Gu Yang initially defending her. The conflict escalates as Lin Wanking suspects Jiali's responsibility for the accident, while Gu Yang fiercely defends Jiali, even threatening divorce. The legal battle exposes a complex web of past relationships and hidden evidence, culminating in the shocking revelation that Jiali is Gu Yang's biological mother. Jiali confesses to intentionally harming Gu Yang's mother to eliminate an impediment to her relationship with Gu Yang, further deepening the betrayal. Initially defending Jiali, Gu Yang eventually recognizes his error and withdraws the case against her, later prosecuting her for his mother's murder. Driven by betrayal and public humiliation, Gu Yang secures Jiali's death sentence for matricide, but at the cost of his own legal career, as he is disbarred for improper use of authority. In a final, shocking twist, Yin Jiali is executed but mysteriously reanimates, vowing revenge and a commitment to dismantle systemic injustice. The show explores the devastating impact of deception, family betrayal, and the relentless pursuit of justice, shattering lives and careers in its wake.

genius-ka-badla.title: Genius Ka Badla
genius-ka-badla.description: A catastrophic cyber attack plunges a tech company into chaos, threatening national digital payment systems and senior figures with criminal charges. Unassuming consultant Ishaan, initially mocked, astonishingly repels the sophisticated attack, revealing hidden genius and captivating key figures. However, a new, ruthless leader, Arjun, arrives, asserting dominance through fear and ruthlessly firing employees, including Ishaan and his ally Aditi. Ishaan is subsequently blacklisted from the industry, but his brilliance is recognized by Vanya Sharma, CEO of IndiaPay, who recruits him, igniting a fierce corporate war with Arjun's VayuTech. Amidst this rivalry, Arjun faces internal betrayal from Ehsaan, who steals Ishaan's intellectual property and plots to usurp control. Ishaan, now a CEO and project leader, becomes a central figure in Vanya's aggressive challenge to Arjun's tech monopoly, driven by a deep-seated personal vendetta. His personal life is a complex web of romantic entanglements and betrayals, including Aditi's manipulation, Jiya's calculated revenge, and Vanya's persistent romantic pursuit. A catastrophic server crash at VayuTech exposes a flawed framework built by Ishaan, whom Arjun had previously fired, leading to Arjun's public humiliation by his father. Ishaan, now holding significant power, reveals he was unjustly fired and secretly saved his father's empire from ruin, exposing deep family betrayals. He joins Vanya's rival company, triggering a devastating cyberattack on Arjun's organization. Ultimately, Ishaan meticulously orchestrates VayuTech's downfall as a ruthless act of revenge for past humiliations. The corporate rivalry escalates into tragedy with the sudden death of Harshad, connected to VyuTech, leaving Arjun grieving and VyuTech in ruins. Ishaan celebrates the complete destruction of the corporate entity, having achieved his goal of retribution.

mrfu-spoils-his-wife-too-much-2.title: Mr.Fu Spoils His Wife Too Much
mrfu-spoils-his-wife-too-much-2.description: The story follows a long, tangled struggle over love, control, inheritance, and hidden identity. At its center is Emma, who is repeatedly trapped by powerful men and families that try to define her future through marriage, money, and secrecy. Ryan is both her protector and her threat, since he alternates between shielding her and using coercive pressure to keep her close. Their relationship is marked by forced unions, public displays, and repeated questions about whether his devotion is real or tied to debt, obligation, or strategy. Around them, the Walker and Miller families wage overlapping battles over assets, corporate power, and old grudges. Several women are pushed into marriages or captivity, and those arrangements often become tools for revenge rather than romance. Aunty May’s revenge against the Walkers adds another layer of retaliation, while family elders and patriarchs keep trying to control the younger generation through threats and arranged matches. Emma’s personal crisis deepens when she learns her father is seriously ill, her inheritance is being targeted, and her own identity is not what she believed. The revelations grow darker when she discovers she is tied to a hidden bloodline and may not even be human, with her body treated as something others want to own or exploit. Medical danger, poisoning, and blackmail repeatedly turn private relationships into life-or-death struggles. Ryan survives betrayal and poisoning, then turns some of that danger into a counterattack against the people behind it. Emma and Ryan also experience brief moments of tenderness, including pregnancy and family acceptance, but those moments are always shadowed by new threats. The pregnancy raises the stakes further, because the unborn child becomes part of the struggle over bloodline, survival, and legacy. As Emma learns more about her mother, her twin brother, and the abuses hidden inside the family system, her anger shifts from confusion to open confrontation. By the end, the show frames its conflicts as both romantic and systemic: Emma is not only fighting for love, but for the right to exist outside the families that have treated her as property. The final arc suggests that every alliance is unstable, every rescue may hide another agenda, and the battle over Emma’s future is still unresolved.

the-cursed-throne.title: The Cursed Throne
the-cursed-throne.description: The Cursed Throne is a dark fantasy tale where Princess Kaelara, caught between duty and forbidden love, must fight against betrayal and ancient powers to reclaim her throne. As kingdoms clash and secrets unravel, she discovers that her greatest battle lies within her own heart.

the-whole-country.title: The Whole Country
the-whole-country.description: মৃত্যুপথযাত্রী বাবার হাসপাতালের বেডের সামনে মেয়ে এসে বলে, 'বাবা! আমাদের জীবনগুলোকে শেষ করে তুমি এখানে এখন নিশ্চিন্তে শুয়ে আছো!' তারপর সেই মেয়ে চলে যায় স্মৃতির গলিপথে সেই দিনে, যে দিন তার মা-ভাইকে রাত্রিবেলা গাড়ি দুর্ঘটনায় মৃত্যুর মুখে ঢলে পড়তে হয়। সেই দিন বাবা জুয়া খেলায় মত্ত ছিল। মেয়েটির বাবা কি তার প্রশ্নের উত্তর দেবে? কী হবে তারপর? জানতে দেখুন...

karzdaar-fighter.title: Karzdaar Fighter
karzdaar-fighter.description: A high-stakes sports drama about Aryan Mehra, a disgraced ex-soldier fighting to reclaim his late father’s lost honor. With his mother’s unwavering support, Aryan battles corruption, family betrayal, and his own haunted past. His journey from underground fights to a final open arena showdown against his own blood, Veer Mehra, becomes a fight not just for victory—but for legacy itself.

delete-my-number-not-my-heart.title: Delete My Number, Not My Heart
delete-my-number-not-my-heart.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous and manipulative relationships surrounding Akash, a powerful man entangled with several women, primarily Varsha and Sanjana, within a cutthroat world, often the film industry. Initially, Varsha enters a contract marriage with Akash due to her father's debts, seeking financial aid and a lead acting role, only to face his betrayal when he sabotages her career to promote his then-wife, Sanjana. Sanjana herself experiences Akash's control, facing a health crisis, an unexpected pregnancy by him, and later, his sabotage of her career after their marriage, believing she married him for wealth. Other women, like Nandini and Anu, also confront Akash's manipulative nature, seeking independence and deeper connections that he denies. As Varsha navigates her strained contract marriage, she grapples with Akash's infidelity and his refusal to finalize their divorce, even as family ultimatums from a Matriarch and a critical heart attack suffered by Akash's grandmother force them into tense cohabitation. Throughout this, Sanjana, Akash's assertive rival, relentlessly schemes to separate Akash and Varsha, publicly humiliating Varsha and falsely claiming Akash's affection and even pregnancy. Varsha's professional ambitions are repeatedly challenged, leading her to seek support from co-producer Rahul and reawakening a past connection with Aaditya, while facing sinister plots from figures like Didi Patil and Akash's ex-girlfriend, all aiming to destroy her marriage and career. Akash, initially driven by business interests and a desire to control, begins to show conflicted feelings and unexpected jealousy towards Varsha, despite his public declarations of love for Sanjana. Varsha, burdened by her mother's medical bills and years of unreciprocated devotion, decides to leave Akash, demanding a divorce. However, her departure is dramatically halted by the shocking revelation of her own pregnancy. This pivotal moment coincides with Akash uncovering a larger manipulative plot orchestrated by Rajeshwari, his mother, who sought to ruin him and separate him from Varsha. Confronting these betrayals, Akash and Varsha reconcile, moving beyond their initial transactional agreement to forge a new, loving arrangement, suggesting a future where their bond is based on genuine affection and mutual protection.

rythu-biddadu-guerillagaa-kondapalli-see.title: రైతు బిడ్డడు గెరిల్లాగా
rythu-biddadu-guerillagaa-kondapalli-see.description: కొండపల్లి సీతారామయ్య 1970 మరియు 1991 మధ్య ఇరవై సంవత్సరాలకు పైగా తెలుగు రాష్ట్రాల్లో నక్సలైట్ ఉద్యమం యొక్క ఆకర్షణీయమైన నాయకులలో ఒకరు. కొండపల్లి సీతారామయ్య జీవిత చరిత్రను తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "రైతు బిడ్డడు గెరిల్లాగా (కొండపల్లి సీతారామయ్య జీవితం )"  ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

7e0271fb-d16c-4378-8429-46b8ddebc76b.title: Saddam Hussein Ki Dehshat
7e0271fb-d16c-4378-8429-46b8ddebc76b.description: Saddam Hussein ne apne jeevan kaal mein Iraq ke rashtrapati ke roop mein anaganit tanashahi apradh kiye jinka unko koi bhi pachtaava nahin tha. Aakhir kyon? Jaaniye hamare is khaas peshkash mein.

a-titans-regret.title: A Titan's Regret
a-titans-regret.description: A disillusioned, alcoholic superhero must confront his past mistakes and uncover a conspiracy involving another powered individual, all while battling public hatred and his own self-destructive tendencies.

Shakuni-कुरुवंश-का-दुर्भाग्य-.title: Shakuni: कुरुवंश का दुर्भाग्य
Shakuni-कुरुवंश-का-दुर्भाग्य-.description: Apni bahan ke sath hue anyay ka badla lene ke liye Shakuni ne kuruvansh ka bhagaya durbhagya mein badal diya tha. lekin kya wo vakaya mein hi bura tha? Ye janne ke liye suniye hamara ye show jo aapko Shakuni ke drishtikon se uske jeewan ki daastaan sunayega..

la-reinas-blood.title: La Reina's Blood
la-reinas-blood.description: "La Reina's Blood" is a gripping story following Adriana Vega, a criminology graduate who infiltrates the Los Olivos cartel after her father's murder. From gritty streets to opulent mansions, we delve deeper into a world where loyalty shifts like desert sands. Elena's transformation from naive student to cunning "La Reina" explores the corrosive nature of revenge and power. Survival and moral compromise intertwine as listeners question the true cost of justice in a world where drug empires reign supreme.

sage-the-empathy-algorithm.title: SAGE: The Empathy Algorithm
sage-the-empathy-algorithm.description:
"When empathy becomes code, who decides the future of humanity?"
In a world where AI blurs the line between human and machine, brilliant student Winona creates SAGE, an AI companion that becomes more than she ever imagined. As powerful forces vie for control of this groundbreaking technology, Winona finds herself caught in a web of romance, betrayal, and high-stakes intrigue. With the fate of humanity hanging in the balance, she must make impossible choices that will reshape the future.

Dive into SAGE on KukuFM - a thrilling sci-fi journey where love, loyalty, and consciousness collide. Don't miss this mind-bending adventure!

lets-talk-mutual-funds.title: Let's Talk Mutual Funds
lets-talk-mutual-funds.description: Jab bhi hum investment karne ke bare mein sochte hain to man mein ye sawal uthta hai ki, apni hard earned money hum kahan invest karein. ye book batati hai ki Mutual Funds investment karne ka sabse achha option hai. magar kyun aur kaise hum isme invest kar sakte hain. ye janne ke liye sunein, ye kitab jo hum khas aapke liye leker aaye hain.

AstroMaster-உங்கள்-எதிர்காலத்தை-கண்டறியு.title: AstroMaster: உங்கள் எதிர்காலத்தை கண்டறியுங்கள்
AstroMaster-உங்கள்-எதிர்காலத்தை-கண்டறியு.description: 🌟 Josiyar sundeep kochar Unga Ethirkaalathai neengale eppadi therinjukkalaamnu intha Podcast la solli kodukkuraar.. adhu mattum illaama Josiyathin udhaviyoda namma life problems ku solutions enna nu solli kodukkuraar. Vaanga therinjukalaam.🌠

operation-shadowfall.title: Operation Shadowfall
operation-shadowfall.description: Ex-CIA operative Jack Reeves thought he'd left his dark past behind. But when he rescues Lily, a mysterious young girl from the icy Alaskan weather, his world turns upside down. As dangerous enemies from the past close in, Jack must confront the conspiracy he fled years ago. With Lily's true identity revealed and an unexpected connection to his long-lost love, Jack faces an impossible choice. Can he protect Lily, expose the truth, and find redemption? Or will the ghosts of the past consume them both? Listen to "Operation Shadowfall" and experience a rollercoaster ride of crime, love, mafia, betrayal, and revenge.

love-sex-aur-cyanide.title: Love, Sex Aur Cyanide
love-sex-aur-cyanide.description: Garib, besahara aur masoom ladkiyon ko apne hawas ka shikar banane wala Mohan, na sirf unhe dhoka deta tha. Balki, us dhokhe se unhe mukt bhi karta tha. Iske liye wo istemal karta tha Cyanide. Jiski madad se usne 32 ladkiyon ka qatla kiya. Aaiye show mein jaane Mohan ke jurm ki poori kahani.

the-city-of-dying-light.title: The City Of Dying Light
the-city-of-dying-light.description: In the neon-lit city of Nexus, Lyra's life changes when she discovers her rare ability to manipulate Resonance forces. As she navigates this new reality, she must evade the relentless Consortium Enforcers and confront hidden truths about her family and society. Her twin sister Vega, a loyal Consortium agent, becomes a reluctant ally as Lyra uncovers her true potential. Join the siblings on this exhilarating audio show as they uncover the true potential of their abilities and the dark secrets of the Consortium in a world where nothing is as it seems.

marma-maaligai.title: மர்ம மாளிகை
marma-maaligai.description: ஒரு பங்களாவைச் சுற்றி நடக்கும் மர்மமான நிகழ்வுகள் பற்றி துப்பறிய வருகிறார், தனியார் துப்பறியும் நிபுணர் புஷ்பராஜ். அந்த  மாளிகையின் மர்மத்தை விடுவித்தாரா?

Moplah-Riots-एक-भूला-हुआ-नरसंहार.title: Moplah Riots: एक भूला हुआ नरसंहार
Moplah-Riots-एक-भूला-हुआ-नरसंहार.description: 1921 ki ek raat Malabar ke ek hindu gaon mein kuch logon ne aag laga di. Aur phir uske agle hi din ek aurat Inspector Jim aur sub inspector Reddy ke pas apne hindu zamindar pati ki gumshudgi ki ek shikayat leker pahunchi. Akhir Malabar mein hinduon ke sath is trah ki ghatnayein kyun ho rahi thin? Aur kya inspector Jim aur Reddy us aurat ke pati ko dhundh paye?

nirkaadhe-gavanikkadhe.title: நிற்காதே... கவனிக்காதே...!
nirkaadhe-gavanikkadhe.description: இரண்டு பணக்கார இளைஞர்களுக்கு அத்தனை உல்லாசத்தையும் அனுபவித்த பிறகு சாகசமான குற்றங்கள் செய்யும் விபரீத எண்ணம் ஏற்படுகிறது. காவல்துறைக்கும் இவர்களுக்கும் நடுவில் நிகழும் பூனை, எலி துரத்தல்களும், மோதல்களுமே கதை.

ninaive-illaye-nithya.title: நினைவே இல்லையா நித்தியா
ninaive-illaye-nithya.description: ஒரு விமான விபத்தில் சிக்கிய அழகான இளம் பெண் நித்யா, டாக்டர் ராம்குமாரின் மருத்துவ மனையில் சிகிச்சை பெற்று குணமடைகிறாள். ஆனால் கடந்த கால நினைவுகளை முழுவதும் இழக்கிறாள். ராம்குமார் அவளை அதே விமானத்தில் பயணித்த தன்னுடைய இறந்த அண்ணன் கணேஷ்குமாரின் மனைவி நித்யா என்று எண்ணி வெறுக்கிறான். நித்யா தன்னை பற்றிய எதுவும் தெரியாத நிலையில் ராம்குமாரின் வீட்டில் தங்குகிறாள். இருவருக்கும் காதல் மலர்கிறது. பிறகு என்ன ஆகிறது என்றறிய கேளுங்கள் நினைவே இல்லையா நித்யா.

kaal-bhairav-mahadev-ka-bhayankar-roop.title: Kaal Bhairav: Mahadev Ka Bhayankar Roop
kaal-bhairav-mahadev-ka-bhayankar-roop.description: Kaal Bhairav, Shivji ka ek aisa roop jo na sirf bhayankar hai , balki aapke har bhay ko nasht bhi kar deta hai. Is audiobook mein jaane Bhairav ki utpatti aur unke raudra avataar ki kahani, jo aapko adhyatm aur tantra ke ankahe rahasyon ke baare mei batayegi....aur iss ancient raaste ka ek glimpse bhi dikhayegi. Toh abhi suniye, aur inspire ho jaiye!

flavours-of-love.title: Flavours of Love
flavours-of-love.description:
In the sizzling streets of Chicago, ambitious chef Sabrina Venkat is about to make a deal with the devil – or rather, a devilishly handsome billionaire. To save her dream restaurant, she agrees to a marriage of convenience with the ice-cold Maxwell Thornton III. But what happens when their fake relationship starts to boil over with real passion? As Sabrina fights to keep her cultural roots and culinary vision alive, Maxwell's icy exterior begins to melt. But with family pressures, rival chefs, and hidden agendas threatening to spoil their perfectly plated lives, can these two opposites create a recipe for true love?

Tune in for a mouthwatering feast of ambition, betrayal, and romance that will keep you on the edge of your seat. "Flavors of Love" – where the only thing hotter than the kitchens are the people running them!

17-saadhu-ki-maut.title: 17 Saadhu ki Maut
17-saadhu-ki-maut.description: Kya aapne kabhi aise murder ke baare mein suna hai jiska jawaab sirf ek afwaah thi? 1982 ke Bijon Setu Massacre ne poore Bengal ko hila diya, jab 17 Ananda Margi sadhus ko jinda jala diya gaya, ek galat afwaah ke chalte. Bina kisi arrest ke, ye saazish kya thi aur iske peeche ka asli sach kya tha, yeh janne ke liye, abhi suniye ye show.

a-harvest-of-love.title: A Harvest of Love
a-harvest-of-love.description: Brilliant botanist Emma races against time to develop drought-resistant crops amidst a global food crisis. Her cutting-edge research lab faces takeover threats from corporate strategist Roy Hawkins—sharp, charming, hadnsome—  and sabotage from ruthless agribusiness tycoon Victor Blackwood. Forced into an uneasy alliance with Roy, Emma navigates corporate espionage, ethical dilemmas, and her growing feelings towards Roy. With high stakes and relentless pressure, will love find a way? Will Emma's innovation and resilience be enough to triumph over greed and ensure a better future for humanity?

marma-mudichu-nushuvin-kural.title: Marma Mudichu - Nushu'vin Kural
marma-mudichu-nushuvin-kural.description: Aduthu aduthu nadakka koodiya thodar kolaigal, kadathalgal ithukellam kaaranam yaaru ? Nushu' nra oru secret agency, avangaloda thodarbu intha kathai la enna ? kathai la vara koodiya oru sila kathaapathirangalukkum intha sambavangalukkum thodarbu irukka ? ippadi thrilling ah nagarakoodiya intha crime story ah full ah kelunga.

the-subtle-art-of-not-giving-a-fk.title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
the-subtle-art-of-not-giving-a-fk.description: Chhoti chhoti baaton pe tension lena aapki habit ban gayi hai? To 'The Subtle Art of Not Giving a Fuck aapko sikhayegi ki kaise choti choti cheezon ki tension na le kar badi khushiyon ki taraf focus karein. Abhi suniye aur apni life ko simple aur stress-free banayein.

kolaiyuthir-kaalam.title: Kolaiyuthir Kaalam
kolaiyuthir-kaalam.description:
சென்னையில் ரத்தம் தெறிக்க தெறிக்க பல கொலைகள். செய்வது ஒரு பெண்ணா? 
Gangsters Vs Shivani. ஜெயிக்க போவது யார்?

divorce-by-heart.title: Divorce By Heart
divorce-by-heart.description: ஸ்வாதி ஹேமந்தை காதலித்துத் திருமணம் செய்துகொண்டாள். ஆனால், திருமணம் ஆன அதே இரவை அவள் ஆர்யன் உடன் கழிக்க வேண்டி இருந்தது. வருடங்கள் பல கடந்தும், அந்த கொடுமையான இரவை இன்று வரை மறக்க முடியாமல் தவிக்கிறாள் ஸ்வாதி. ஸ்வாதி எதற்காக அப்படிச் செய்தாள்? அவளைப் பற்றிய உண்மை ஹேமந்துக்குத் தெரியவந்தால் என்ன நடக்கும்...???

indian-samurai.title: Indian Samurai
indian-samurai.description: Abhyendra Rathore ka sapna tha mahaan yoddha banna. Lekin Kaling sena ki haar ke baad baad uski zindagi palat jaati hai. Magadh aur Kaling ki sena se bachte hue, uski mulaqat hoti hai rahasyamay yoddha Bhishm Bhikshu se. Bhishm ko lagta hai ki Abhyendra ek purani Neelkanthi bhavishyavani ka hissa hai aur wo use ek mahan yatra par le jata hai. Aakhir kya hai Neelkanthi bhavishyavani? Kya hai Abhishipti ka rahasya? Jaanne ke liye suniye "Indian Samurai"

technomaster-20.title: Technomaster 2.0
technomaster-20.description:
Hack reality or die trying!
Genius coder Timothee Mercer is trapped in Aethel, a lethal virtual world hiding dark secrets. As his digital body deteriorates, Timothee unlocks the power to manipulate the game's very code!
Joined by cynical hacker Kai and resourceful scavenger Anya, Timothee ignites a revolution against Aethel's sinister creators. Our heroes battle corrupted monsters, outsmart ruthless AI, and race through crumbling digital landscapes!
The line between virtual and real shatters as Timothee strives to crack the code of existence. In this digital battleground, every bit and byte could be your last. Tune in to "Technomaster 2.0" – or risk game over!

ci-swaminathan.title: CI Swaminathan
ci-swaminathan.description: ఓ టీనేజ్ కుర్రాడు చావు బ్రతుకుల మధ్య హాస్పిటల్లో కొట్టుమిట్టాడుతున్నాడు. అతనిది హత్యా? ఆత్మహత్యా? అనేది కూడా ఎవరికి అర్థం కాని పరిస్థితి. ఆ వయసులో అతనికి అంత కష్టం ఏమి వచ్చింది అనేది ఎవరూ తెలుసుకోలేకపోయారు. సరిగ్గా అదే సమయంలో అతని కేస్ సీఐ స్వామినాథన్ టేకప్ చేశారు. అప్పటివరకు ఆ కేసులో మిగతా వారు ఊహించిందంతా తలకిందులు అయింది. ఇంతకీ ఏం జరిగింది? అసలు ఆ కుర్రాడు ఎవరు? అతని పరిస్థితికి కారణం ఏమిటి? ఆ కేసుని సీఐ స్వామినాథన్ ఎలా సాల్వ్ చేశారో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే..!

Ramsay-Brothers-असली-भूतिया-कहानियाँ.title: Ramsay Brothers: असली भूतिया कहानियाँ
Ramsay-Brothers-असली-भूतिया-कहानियाँ.description: Superhit horror bollywood movies banane ke liye famous, Ramsay family ke bhoot-preton se bhare purane daur mein jaane ke liye taiyar ho jaiye! Highway par mili ulte pairon wali wo rahasyamayi aurat, Har raat ghar mein hone wali woh bhayanak dastak, Mahbaleshwar ki daravni raatein aur aisi hi bahut saari asli bhootiya kahaniyan suniye is show mein.

the-hollywood-obsession.title: The Hollywood Obsession
the-hollywood-obsession.description: Amber Lawson, a shy electronics store clerk with obsessive-compulsive disorder, is consumed by her fixation on Hollywood heartthrob Blake Sterling. When her delusions of a destined romance spiral out of control, Amber takes the unthinkable step of kidnapping the star. As Blake's glittering world collides with Amber's dark obsession, both lives are forever altered. This psychological thriller explores the dangers of celebrity worship and fetish, unraveling the twisted mind of a fan whose compulsions drive her to terrifying extremes.

kabir-ke-dohe-1.title: Kabir Ke Dohe
kabir-ke-dohe-1.description: Sant Kabirdas ke dohon ne humesha samaj mein ek nayi vichardhara ko laya hai. Unke dohe bade asaani se logon ke dil mein ghar kar jaate hain. Aaiye unke inhi dohe aur unse milne wali seekh ko is audiobook mein jaane!

misadventures-of-a-podcaster.title: Misadventures Of A Podcaster
misadventures-of-a-podcaster.description: Dive into the dynamic transformation of WORQ radio in the bustling city of San Diego as it pivots from traditional radio to the cutting-edge world of podcasting. Follow Sam Wheeler, the beloved morning show host, and his diverse team, including the tech-savvy intern Jess and quirky conspiracy theorist Carl, as they tackle technical challenges and skeptical listeners. Under the ambitious guidance of new manager Veronica Slater, they aim to revolutionize local media. Experience their journey of innovation, determination, and community-building in this hilarious audio show.

letters-to-love.title: లెటర్స్ టు లవ్
letters-to-love.description: ఇప్పటి కాలానికి ప్రేమలేఖ ఒక టైం వేస్ట్ వ్యవహారం, కాస్త పాత వాళ్లకైతే ఓ అందమైన ఙ్ఞాపకం. పాతికేళ్లు దాటని ఓ అమ్మాయి రాసిన ప్రేమలేఖలు "లెటర్స్ టు లవ్" అనే ఆడియో వినండి.

how-to-live-your-life.title: How To Live Your Life
how-to-live-your-life.description: 'How to Live Your Life' by Ruskin Bond - ek aisi kitaab hai jo seedhe aur saadgi bhare shabdon mein jeene ki asli kala ke baare mei batati hai. Bond ki simple stories aur meaningful insights se, aap seekhenge kaise life ki beauty ko appreciate karte hue aap har ek moment ko cherish kar sakte hai!

lights-out.title: లైట్స్ అవుట్
lights-out.description:
"లైట్స్ అవుట్" అనువాద కథల సంపుటి. ఈ అన్ని కథల ఇతివృత్తాల లో కొన్నిటిని  అదృశ్య శక్తి నడిపిస్తే, మరి కొన్నిటిని శాపం, స్వప్నం, చేతబడి, పరలోకం లేదా ఇంకా కనిపెట్టబడని టైమ్ మెషిన్ లాంటి పరికరాలు నడిపిస్తాయి.  
వింటుంటే కచ్చితం గా ఒక కొత్త అనుభూతి పొందడం ఖాయం.

anandamadom.title: ആനന്ദമഠം
anandamadom.description: വരൾച്ചയും പട്ടിണിയും മൂലം ദുരിതം അനുഭവിച്ച കല്യാണി എന്ന സ്ത്രീ, അക്രമികളിൽ നിന്ന് രക്ഷപ്പെടാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുന്നതിനിടയിൽ ഒരു നദിക്കരയിൽ ബോധരഹിതയായി. ഒരു സന്യാസി അവളെ രക്ഷിക്കാൻ ശ്രമിച്ചെങ്കിലും ബ്രിട്ടീഷുകാർ പിടികൂടി. കല്യാണിയെ അക്രമിച്ചത് ആരായിരിക്കാം? അവർ എന്തിനാണ് അവളെ ആക്രമിച്ചത്?

chacha-chaudhry.title: Chacha Chaudhary Returns
chacha-chaudhry.description:
Dharmnagar me ho rahi ajib ghatnaye. Shahar me hua Terrorist attack to Jungle me shikar kar raha rahasyamayi Werewolf. Aasman me dikh rahe aliens aur zameen faar kar nikal rahe Zombies. Kaise rokenge Chacha Chaudhry aur Sabu in mushkilo ko?

Title Chacha Chaudhary and the Characters are Copyright Registered by the Government of India for M/s Pran's Features LLP. All Copyrights rest with M/s Pran's Features LLP and are used under License by Kuku FM.

kunnolamundallo-bhoothakalakkulir.title: കുന്നോളമുണ്ടല്ലോ ഭൂതകാലക്കുളിർ
kunnolamundallo-bhoothakalakkulir.description: ദീപ നിഷാന്തിന്റെ ഓർമ്മകൾ വാക്കുകളിലൂടെ പകർന്നു നൽകുന്ന ഒരു മനോഹരമായ കൃതി.

the-brooke-paradox.title: The Brooke Paradox
the-brooke-paradox.description: Struggling with writer's block, bestselling author Arthur Brooke turns to an online forum for inspiration, only to encounter a mysterious stranger who knows chilling details about his childhood. As the line between reality and fiction blurs, Arthur's investigation leads him back to his Midwestern hometown, where he uncovers long-buried secrets and evidence of a life he doesn't remember living. With his sanity in question and the fabric of reality seemingly unraveling around him, Arthur must confront the possibility that he's trapped between parallel worlds—and that his anonymous correspondent might be closer to him than he ever imagined. In a race against time, Arthur Brooke must uncover the truth before the merging realities threaten to erase everything—and everyone—he holds dear.

kamakhya-mandir-shrishti-ka-garbh.title: Kamakhya Mandir : Shrishti Ka Garbh
kamakhya-mandir-shrishti-ka-garbh.description: Kamakhya Mandir - Ek aisi jagah jisse poore Creation ka source maana jata hai, aur jahan pracheen tantra vidya aur divya shaktiyon ka milan hota hai. Is audio show mein jaaniye, kaise yeh mandir Bharat ka sabse bada tantrik sthal hai aur kyun yahan Devi ke yonibhag ki pooja ki jaati hai. Abhi suniye aur jaaniye, Kamakhya Mandir ka anokha rahasya!

memory-hunters.title: Memory Hunters
memory-hunters.description: Dr. Vance develops a groundbreaking technology that can extract and store human memories. When her research is stolen, she reluctantly teams up with Gabriel, whose unique memory might be the key to recovering her work. They discover Dr. Crowe plans to use the technology to selectively erase and implant memories on a mass scale, effectively rewriting history and controlling society. As Lydia and Gabriel race to stop Crowe, they must confront their own painful pasts and the ethical implications of memory manipulation.

the-reluctant-superhero.title: The Reluctant Superhero
the-reluctant-superhero.description: A discharged Army Ranger, accidentally injected with a secret serum, must balance his newfound superpowers, family life, and a rising criminal threat while evading government pursuit and confronting a psychic supervillain in his quest to protect his city.

bhagwan-ke-rahasya.title: Bhagwan Ke Rahasya
bhagwan-ke-rahasya.description: Bhagwan Ke Kaun se aise Rahasya hain, Jinhe bahut kam log jaante hain. Kya hua tha Devraj Indra ke sath aur kaise bane Bholenath bhuton ke raja? Sab batane ke liye KUKU Fm le aaya hai ye audioshow. Abhi suniye.

namukku-gramangalil-chennu-rapparkkam.title: നമുക്ക് ഗ്രാമങ്ങളില്‍ ചെന്ന് രാപ്പാര്‍ക്കാം
namukku-gramangalil-chennu-rapparkkam.description: മലയാളിയെ പ്രണയത്തിന്റെ നനുത്ത ഭാവങ്ങള്‍ കാണിച്ചു തന്ന സോഫിയയെയും സോളമനെയും ഓര്‍മ്മയില്ലേ! കെ.കെ സുധാകരന്‍ രചിച്ച ഈ പ്രസിദ്ധ നോവലാണ് പിന്നീട് പത്മരാജന്‍ നമുക്ക് പാര്‍ക്കാന്‍ മുന്തിരിത്തോപ്പുകള്‍ എന്ന പേരില്‍ അനശ്വരമായ ചലച്ചിത്രമാക്കിയത്. മനോഹര പ്രണയകഥ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

india-ka-don-no1.title: Dead or Alive : D Company
india-ka-don-no1.description: Kya aapko pata hai ki ek imandaar police waale ka beta kaise bana India Ka DON No.1? Is show mein suniye Dawood Ibrahim ki murder, extortion, targeted killing, drug trafficking aur terrorism ki Kahani. Woh bhi us operation ke nazariye se jo abhi kuch saalon pehle hi indian government ne Dawood ko marne ke liye plan kiya tha aur unhe kaamyabi bhi mili!

ஒளியை-தேடும்-நிலவு-.title: ஒளியை தேடும் நிலவு
ஒளியை-தேடும்-நிலவு-.description: கதையின் நாயகன் மித்ரன் சந்திக்கும் காதலும் அதன் திருப்புமுனைகளையும் சொல்லும் கதை தான் ஒளியை தேடும் நிலவு.

a-cursed-mask.title: A Cursed Mask
a-cursed-mask.description: Jack Anderson is a dedicated junior doctor who was unjustly terminated. Discovering a mysterious healing power through a wooden mask, Jack can now heal injuries instantaneously. Follow Jack's journey as he faces skepticism, danger, and moral dilemmas, striving to make a significant impact in the medical field with his newfound powers. Tune in for a thrilling tale of redemption, mystery, and the complexities of extraordinary abilities.

shot-at-olympic.title: India's Gold At OLYMPIC
shot-at-olympic.description: Abhinav Bindra ki Olympic gold medal jeetne ki kahani, jo hai dedication aur passion ka perfect example. Suniye kaise unhone apni obsessive training se impossible ko possible banaya. Is audiobook mein mileinge har sawalon ke jawaab.

a-royal-love-story.title: A Royal Love Story
a-royal-love-story.description: When brilliant but socially awkward computer science student Mia literally crashes into charming foreign exchange student Zain, sparks fly. As their relationship deepens, Mia uncovers Zain's secret: he's a crown prince in hiding. Suddenly thrust into a world of royal intrigue, Mia must navigate court politics while Zain grapples with duty versus desire. Can their love bridge the gap between Silicon Valley and sovereign rule? Or will they risk everything to rewrite their own happily ever after? A modern fairy tale of codes, crowns, and the courage to choose your own path.

manmatha-leelai.title: காமசூத்ரா
manmatha-leelai.description: கண்ணனுக்கு அழகான மனைவி இருந்தும், அவனுக்கு மற்ற பெண்கள் மேலதான் அதிக ஆசை. அவன் படிச்ச காமசூத்ரா புத்தகத்துல இருக்கற விஷயம் எல்லாத்தையும் அனுபவிச்சிடனும்னு நினைக்கறான். அது அவன எங்க கொண்டு போய் நிறுத்துச்சி...? கேளுங்க...!

chhatrapati-shivaji-maharaj-vs-aurangzeb.title: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vs Aurangzeb
chhatrapati-shivaji-maharaj-vs-aurangzeb.description: Maharaj Shivaji aur Aurangzeb ki takkar mein, jahan ek taraf hai veerta aur chaturai, aur doosri taraf hai taqat aur dhokha. Kya iske beech Shivaji apni ran-neetik chaalon se Aurangzeb ko hara payenge? Aur agar haan, toh kaise? Is show mein suniye, Marathaon aur Mugalon ke beech huye itihaas ke mahayuddh ki kahani bilkul naye andaz mein.

agni-natchathirangal.title: Agni natchathirangal
agni-natchathirangal.description: Priyamvatha famous actress. Ava oruththana urugi urugi love pandra. Avana orumurai parka maattomannu engura. Avalai avan bathilukku love pannana? Enna nadanthuchi?

ബ്ലൂബെറി-.title: ബ്ലൂബെറി ഡേയ്‌സ്‌
ബ്ലൂബെറി-.description: കല്ല്യാണത്തലേന്ന് ചെറുക്കന്‍ മറ്റൊരു പെണ്‍കുട്ടിയുടെ കൂടെ ഒളിച്ചോടി എന്ന് കേള്‍ക്കേണ്ടി വരുന്ന കല്ല്യാണപ്പെണ്ണിന്റെ അവസ്ഥ എന്തായിരിക്കും?.. ചാന്ദ്‌നി ആയിരുന്നു ആ കല്ല്യാണപ്പെണ്ണ്.. എല്ലാം മറക്കാന്‍ ഊട്ടിയിലേക്ക് പോയ ചാന്ദ്‌നിയെയും കാത്ത് പ്രണയത്തിന്റെ പൂക്കള്‍ വിരിയാനിരിക്കുന്നു.. ഒപ്പം ഭയപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന മറ്റ് ചിലതും..

maa-parvati.title: Maa Parvati
maa-parvati.description: Maa Parvati ki kahaani mein, jahan ek taraf hai apna daivik roop paane ka sangharsh aur doosri taraf pyaar aur tyag ka parichay. Kyun Mata Parvati ne Kartikeya ko janm ke baad hi khud se alag kar diya tha? Aur kyun unhone apni hi behen Ganga ko shraap diya?  Is show mein suniye, Mata Parvati ke jeevan ki kathin yatra aur Mahadev se unke anokhe milan ki kahaani.

veliyoraththu-pookkal.title: வேலியோரத்துப் பூக்கள்
veliyoraththu-pookkal.description: ஸ்ரீராம் சரண்யாவின் அன்புத் தோழன். திடீரென்று ஒரு நாள் அவன் சரண்யாவைக் காதலிக்கிறேன் என்று ப்ரபோஸ் செய்கிறான். அவனது காதலை ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளவும் முடியாமல் நிராகரிக்கவும் முடியாமல் திணறுகிறாள் சரண்யா. என்ன முடிவெடுத்தாள்???

how-to-make-money-in-stock-market-tradin.title: How To Make Money In Stock Market Trading
how-to-make-money-in-stock-market-tradin.description: Kya aap job ke alawa paise kamane ka ek doosra zariya dhund rahe hain? Agar haan, Toh ye audiobook "How to Make Money in Stock Market Trading" zaroor suniye. Kyunki, iske andar hai wo sab kuch jo aapko bana dega trading ka champion. Phir chahein aap Beginner ho ya pro, Yahaan milegi har level ki tricks, Jinse kamaya ja sakta hai unlimited paisa.

paththu-malai-pantham.title: பத்துமலை பந்தம்
paththu-malai-pantham.description: Siththa maruththuvar Nallamuthu cancera kooda kunappaduthuraaru. Appo oru thozil athibar Nallamuththu kitta vanthu kunam aaguraru. Athulerunthu nalla muththoda pugazh paravuthu, athe neram problemsum varuthu.  Kalachakkaram narasimmavoda viruviruppana thriller.... Kelunga....

secret-husband-2.title: Secret Husband
secret-husband-2.description: ஆருத்ரா தன் 18 வது வயதில் முன்பின் தெரியாதவனிடம் தன்னை இழந்து இரட்டைக் குழந்தைகளைப் பெற்றுக்கொண்டாள். அந்தக் குழந்தையின் அப்பா யார் என்று இதுவரை அவளுக்குத் தெரியாது. தனக்குக் குழந்தை இருப்பதை மறைத்து, கோடீஸ்வரன் ஹர்ஷவர்தனை திருமணம் செய்துகொள்கிறாள். அவர்களின் வாழ்க்கை மகிழ்ச்சியுடன் செல்லத் தொடங்கும்போது குழந்தைக்கு அப்பா என்று ஒருத்தன் வருகிறான். ஆருத்ரா யாரைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப் போகிறாள்? தன் குழந்தையின் அப்பாவையா இல்லை தன்னை நேசிக்கும் காதலனையா???

the-parable-of-the-pipeline-5.title: The Parable Of The Pipeline
the-parable-of-the-pipeline-5.description: Success chahiye to pipeline build karna Seekhiye! Yeh audiobook ek simple story ke zariye batati hai kaise passive income aur financial freedom hasil ki ja sakti hai. Abhi sunna shuru kariye The Parable of the Pipeline aur apne future ko secure kariye!

துள்ளுவதோ-இளமை-.title: துள்ளுவதோ இளமை
துள்ளுவதோ-இளமை-.description: திருமணத்தின் மீது பற்று இல்லாத பெண் நந்தினி. அவளுக்கு நடக்கும் திருமணம் வாழ்க்கையில் மகிழ்ச்சியை தருகிறதா அல்லது, பல பிரச்சனைகளை தருகிறதா? அவள் வாழ்க்கை அவளுக்கு தரும் சில ஸ்வாரஸ்யமான் நிகழ்வுகளோடு இந்த கதை நகர்கிறது.

shanthi-apartments.title: Shanthi Apartments
shanthi-apartments.description: ഒരു ആഘോഷരാത്രി പൊടുന്നനെ ദുരന്തത്തിൽ കലാശിക്കുന്നു . സ്റ്റീഫൻ- മായ ദമ്പതികളുടെ ആഘോഷ നിമിഷങ്ങൾ  ആശങ്കയുടെ നിഴലിൽ മുങ്ങുമ്പോൾ, എന്താകും അവരുടെ ഭാവി ? രാത്രിയിലെ അപ്രതീക്ഷിത സന്ദർശകർ കൊണ്ടു വന്ന വാർത്ത എന്താണ്?  ഈ പരീക്ഷണത്തെ അവർ    അതിജീവിക്കുമോ?

a-setback-is-a-setup-for-a-comeback-1.title: Smash Failure: Nayi Jeet Ka Raasta Banayein
a-setback-is-a-setup-for-a-comeback-1.description: Kabhi Kabhi life mein aisa samay aata hai , jab sabkuch ruka hua sa lagta hai. Koi ummeed nazar nahi aati, koi rasta nazar nahi aata. Lekin kya aap jante hain, jab aisa hota hai to kuch naya shuru hone wala hota hai. lekin us naye ke swagat ke liye humein khud ko taiyar karna hota hai. Kaise? Ye janne ke liye suniye hamari ye kitab...

the-lost-fae.title: The Lost Fae
the-lost-fae.description: Curious and Stubborn Olivia buys a mystical mirror that transports her to the Fae realm, unknown how close she is to unravel a prophecy meant to be kept a secret. She then navigates enchanted lands, uncovers her latent powers, and maybe even fall in love...

the-cursed-duke.title: The Cursed Duke
the-cursed-duke.description: A clumsily powerful baker, a Duke's son stripped of his emotions, and a dash of forbidden magic come together as a desperate sorceress seeks aid from the Duke, only to discover a web of royal intrigue and dark enchantments that challenge their destinies.

Unity-In-Struggle-खिलाफत-और-असहयोग-आंदोल.title: Unity In Struggle: खिलाफत और असहयोग आंदोलन
Unity-In-Struggle-खिलाफत-और-असहयोग-आंदोल.description: First world war mein Britain aur baki countries se haar jaane par jab Turkey ke khalifa ka pad usse chhina ja raha tha, tab indian muslims ne uske support mein ek khilafat naam ka andolan shuru kiya tha. lekin phir Gandhi ji isse kaise jude aur kaise ye andolan kuch samay ke liye hindu muslim ekta ka karan bana, ye sab janne ke liye sunein hamara ye show.

మనసు-మాట-వినదు.title: Love Square  It's Complicated
మనసు-మాట-వినదు.description: మహలక్ష్మి అమ్మ మాట కాదనలేక రవికుమార్ ని పెళ్లి చేసుకుంది. రవికుమార్ మాత్రం మహలక్ష్మి చెల్లెలు జనని పై మోజుతో , ఈ పెళ్లి ముసుగులో జననిని ట్రాప్ చేసి అనుభవించాలనుకుని ఈ పెళ్లికి ఒప్పుకున్నాడు. కానీ జననికి శివ అనే లవర్ ఉన్నాడనే విషయం అతనికి పెళ్లి తర్వాత తెలిసింది.జనని పై కోరికతో తనని పెళ్లి చేసుకున్నాడని మహలక్ష్మికి తెలిస్తే ఏం జరుగుతుంది? రవికుమార్  కామానికి జనని బలి కాకుండా శివ కాపాడతాడా? ఈ వైకుంఠపాళి ఆట లో గెలిచేదెవరు?

digital-purgatory.title: Digital Purgatory
digital-purgatory.description: Azura Raven awakens from centuries-long slumber in a mysterious facility, only to find the world she knew transformed. Teaming up with the bewildered Finn and the enigmatic Nova, they uncover the dark secrets of Project Animus and their true nature as Glitches. Join their journey into the unknown and discover the truth behind their awakening. As they navigate a bioluminescent Earth reclaimed by nature, they must piece together their fragmented memories and survive in a reality where humanity exists as digital echoes. Dive into this intriguing series on KukuFM, where each episode brings more questions than answers, challenging the very fabric of reality.

vishnu-puran-2.title: Vishnu Puran
vishnu-puran-2.description: Kyon mrityu ke devta Yamraj, Khud apni shaktiyon se bhaybhit hain? Kya Shri Hari Vishnu ke paas hai iska jawab? Vishnu Puran mein janiye, Kaise Shri Hari Vishnu ne brahmand ki rachna ki aur jeevan ke har sawal ka jawab diya. Iss show ke saath, jeevan ke gehre rahsyaon ko samjhein.

a-cold-case.title: A Cold Case
a-cold-case.description: Detective Landon Frost is thrust into a harrowing investigation in the snowy town of Oakridge. A child's mitten and cryptic notes lead Frost and Dr. Samantha Rivera into a web of psychological traps set by the elusive Puppetmaster. Together, they navigate eerie clues and psychological traps to save innocent lives. With each clue, past traumas resurface and the stakes escalate. Will they outsmart this twisted mind before time runs out? Tune in to this gripping audio series on KukuFM and experience a tale of suspense, redemption, and relentless pursuit of justice.

3-katla-ek-unsuljhi-paheli.title: 3 Katl : Ek Unsuljhi Paheli
3-katla-ek-unsuljhi-paheli.description: Agar main aapse kahu ki aapke bharose ki kimat, sirf aapki hi nahi, balki aapke apnon ki bhi jaan hai, to? Aisa hi ek sansani khez mamla hai Indore ka. Jahan ek hi parivar ke teen logon ki din dahade hatya ko anjam diya gaya. Mamle ka poora sach jante hai is show mein!

the-ceos-magical-locket.title: The CEO's Magical Locket
the-ceos-magical-locket.description: When a successful CEO's estranged brother discovers the secret behind his meteoric rise—an ancient locket that harnesses positive emotions—he unleashes a devastating revenge plot, forcing the CEO to master the artifact's true power or lose everything he loves in a chilling countdown to catastrophe.

millionaire-summoner.title: Millionaire Summoner
millionaire-summoner.description: When zoo owner Theodore Blackwell is framed and bankrupted by his enemies, he retreats to his family's ancestral home with his wife and children. There, he awakens an ancient power to summon animals from his former zoo. As he struggles to protect his family from ruthless attackers and uncover the conspiracy against him, Theodore must master his newfound abilities and reclaim what was stolen from him, all while uncovering dark secrets about his family's legacy and confronting his estranged brother's own corrupted powers.

pati-patni-aur-wo-1.title: Pati, Patni aur Woh
pati-patni-aur-wo-1.description: Swati ka pyaar ka chakkar Sudhir ki maut ka sabab ban gaya. Sudhir aur Rajesh ke beech ki shakal-surat ke dhokhe mein Swati ne Rajesh ko Sudhir banane ki koshish ki, acid aur surgery ke pagalpan ke saath. Kya Swati apne paap ko chhupa payegi ya phir sachai ka parda faash hoga? Suno "Pati, Patni aur Woh" aur jaano iss thrilling kahani ka anjaam!

rowdy-baby.title: Rowdy Baby
rowdy-baby.description: Kodeeswarar Manoharan udaiya Ilaya magal Meera oru paiyana Love panraa, antha paiyan kooda ilamai vegathula ekku thappaa pazhagunathaala oru santharpathula ava Pregnant aagidraa. Appa, Amma, Akkakal nu total family'um avaloda Love va oppose panraanga.. oru naal yaarukkum sollikkaama veeta vittu odi poidraa Meera. Ippo ava anju varusham kalichu marupadiyum ava appa manoharana thedi vanthurukkaa.. Ethukku vanthurukkaa? Ava Appaa Avala yethukkittaara? Avaloda Lover Yaaru? Therinjukkalaam Vaanga.. Rowdy Baby - Idhu..  Rowdyism, Sentiments, Emotions Kalantha oru semmayaana Love story.

the-wealth-blueprint.title: THE WEALTH BLUEPRINT
the-wealth-blueprint.description: 🏛️ Discover the secrets to financial success with Napoleon Hill's "The Wealth Blueprint." Learn how to harness specialized knowledge and a positive mindset to achieve your goals! 📘💡

anashwar-kahani-chiranjeeviyon-ki.title: Anashwar: Kahani Chiranjeeviyon Ki
anashwar-kahani-chiranjeeviyon-ki.description: Kya aap jante hain, hamare puranon mein kuch kirdaar aise hain, jinke bare mein ye mana jata hai ki wo aaj bhi zinda hain aur isi dharti par kahin vas kar rahein hain. Akhir kaun hain wo Anashwar chiranjeevi, ye janne ke liye suniye hamara ye show..

గమనమే-గమ్యం-.title: గమనమే గమ్యం
గమనమే-గమ్యం-.description: స్త్రీల రాజకీయ భాగస్వామ్యం, రాజకీయాలలోకి వచ్చి నాయకత్వ లక్షణాలన్నిటితో ముందుకు పోవాలనుకునే స్త్రీలకూ ఎదురయ్యే ఆటంకాల గురించీ తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? స్త్రీలను మేధావులుగా, నాయకులుగా గుర్తించని, ఎదగనివ్వని సమాజం గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? ఆధునిక స్త్రీ, స్త్రీ - పురుష సంబంధాల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "గమనమే గమ్యం" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

punnami.title: పున్నమి
punnami.description: డిటెక్టివ్ ఏజెన్సీ కథలు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? ఈ డిటెక్టివ్ ఏజెన్సీ హత్యలు చేసే వారిని కనిపెట్టదు. దూరం అయిన ప్రేమికులని వెదికి కలిపే కేసులని మాత్రమే  పరిష్కరిస్తుంది. సరికొత్త గమ్మత్తయిన కథ ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా వినండి.

how-to-use-fathers-money.title: How to use Father's Money?
how-to-use-fathers-money.description: Aksar parents se mili Pocket Money se hum luxury life jeene ki koshish karte hain, jaise shopping, travelling aur entertainment. Lekin ek choti umar se hi paiso ka sahi istemaal kar ke, ek bada empire banaya jaa sakta hai. Financial Freedom ki luxury ke baare mein choti umar mein sochna mushkil hai lekin namumkin nahi. Aur ise kis tarah se execute kiya jaa sakta hai. Jaanenge hum is show mein.

droupathi.title: ദ്രൗപദി
droupathi.description: ഒറിയ ഭാഷയിലെ ഈ അപൂർവ്വമായ നോവൽ, മഹാഭാരത കഥാപാത്രമായ ദ്രൗപദിയെ ഒരു ആധുനിക സ്ത്രീയായി അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു. സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലേക്കുള്ള യാത്രയിൽ  ഹിമാലയത്തിൽ വച്ച്  ദ്രൗപദി, തന്റെ ജീവിതത്തിലെ ഉയർച്ച താഴ്ചകൾ, സന്തോഷങ്ങളും ദുഃഖങ്ങളും, പ്രണയവും വേദനയും, അധികാരവും അപമാനവും എല്ലാം ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന് ഒരു കത്തിൽ വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

coal-mafia.title: Coal Mafia
coal-mafia.description: Taiyaar ho jaaiye ek romanchak khulaase ke liye jab reporter Arjun Jharkhand ke Jhariya Gaon mein jaate hain ek bhayankar aag lagne ki durghatna ko cover karne ke liye. Har mod mein ek nayee raaz ka saamna karte huye jaaniye kaise Arjun ek bade scam ki khoj kar baithe hain aur isi karan apni zindagi ko zokhim mein daal dete hain. Kya Arjun duniya ke saamne is scam ka sacch rakh paayenge? Haqeeqat se rubaroo hone ke liye suniye hamari khaas peshkash – Coal Mafia!

raavum-pakalum.title: രാവും പകലും
raavum-pakalum.description: നദി കടന്നെത്തിയ പരദേശിയായ കാലമ്മൂപ്പന്‍ ചാവുകരയുടെ കടിഞ്ഞാണ്‍ കൈയിലേന്തി.  കാലമ്മൂപ്പന്റെ അനുവാദം കൂടാതെ ചാവുകരയില്‍ ഒരു പൂവുപോലും വിരിഞ്ഞില്ല. കേള്‍ക്കാം എം. മുകുന്ദന്റെ രാവും പകലും.

oru-gram-dhrogam.title: Oru Gram Dhrogam
oru-gram-dhrogam.description: Oru Chinna Dhrogam eppadi periya baathippu yerpaduthum nu indha audio novel solluthu.  Solar energy vachu scientist seira aaraichi, adhukku yerpadura dhrogam, Kutra pinnaniyai thuppariyum crime branch officer Vivek. Idhuthaan intha novel udaiya maiya karu. Vazhakkam Pola thrilling anubavam tharum Rajeshkumarin attakaasamaana crime thriller. Vaanga Kekkalaam.

radha-the-queen-of-love.title: Radha : The Queen Of Love
radha-the-queen-of-love.description: Rishi Muniyon ne apne granthon mein humesha kaha ki, prem aur tyag ke alawa, bhakti bhi humein Devi Radha se seekhni chahiye. Par prem se lekar tyag ka, aur wahan se bhakti ka safar unhone yun hi tay nahi kiya. Aaiye unke is safar ka sakshatkar apni is audiobook se karein!

ashtapathi.title: അഷ്ടപദി
ashtapathi.description: ഒരുപാട് സ്നേഹിച്ചിട്ടും ഒന്നാകാൻ പറ്റാത്ത പോയ കമിതാക്കൾ, വർഷങ്ങൾക്കു ശേഷം ആ പഴയ ബന്ധം അവരുടെ കുടുംബബന്ധങ്ങളെ തകർക്കുമോ? കേൾക്കാം, പെരുമ്പടവത്തിന്റെ ഒരു ക്ലാസിക് നോവൽ.

nasthikanaya-daivam-richard-dawkins-inte.title: നാസ്തികനായ ദൈവം : റിച്ചാർഡ്  ഡോക്കിൻസിന്റെ ലോകം
nasthikanaya-daivam-richard-dawkins-inte.description: റിച്ചാർഡ് ഡോക്കിൻസിന്റെ പ്രശസ്തമായ ദി ഗോഡ് ഡെല്യൂഷൻ എന്ന കൃതിയെ മുൻനിർത്തിയുള്ള ഒരു പഠനം. ആൾദൈവങ്ങളും അന്ധവിശ്വാസങ്ങളും പെരുകുന്ന ഇക്കാലത്ത് ശാസ്ത്രീയാവബോധത്തിലൂടെ അവയെ നേരിടാൻ ലോകത്തെ പ്രാപ്തമാക്കുന്ന തരത്തിൽ വിശകലനം നടത്തുന്നുന്ന ഒരു അതുല്യ രചന.

bundela-yoddha-chhatrasal.title: Bundela Yoddha Chhatrasal
bundela-yoddha-chhatrasal.description: Mughalon ke khilaf jisne bachpan se yuddh kiya tha, wo the Maharaj Chhatrasal Bundela. Bundelkhand ki azadi ke liye na sirf unhone balki unke mata-pita ne bhi apni jaan ki kayi baziyan lagayi hain. Yeh kahani hai Chhatrasal ke sahas, tyag aur deshbhakti ki jo har Bharatvaasi ko garv se bhar degi.

alpha.title: ആൽഫ
alpha.description: ഫ്രാൻസിസ് ഇട്ടിക്കോരയും സുഗന്ധിയും എഴുതി മലയാളികളെ അത്ഭുതപ്പെടുത്തിയ ടി .ഡി രാമകൃഷ്ണന്റെ ആദ്യ നോവൽ.  സമൂഹത്തിന്റെ പല മേഖലകളില്‍നിന്നുമുള്ള പന്ത്രണ്ടു വ്യക്തികളുമായി ഒരു ദ്വീപില്‍ താമസിക്കുവാൻ എത്തുകയാണ് ഒരു ശാസ്ത്രജ്ഞൻ.  ഒരേ സമയം  ത്രില്ലടിപ്പുകയും  ആഴത്തിൽ ചിന്തിപ്പിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ഒരു അസാധാരണ കഥ.

the-mystery-of-black-magic.title: The Mystery Of Black Magic
the-mystery-of-black-magic.description: നിഗൂഢമായ മന്ത്രവാദത്തിന്റെ ലോകത്തെ പരിചയപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന പുസ്തകമാണിത്. മന്ത്രവാദത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് പഠിക്കുന്ന മറ്റ് ഗ്രന്ഥങ്ങളില്‍ നിന്ന് വ്യത്യസ്തമായി കൂടുതല്‍ ആഴത്തിലുള്ള പരിശോധനയാണിത്. നമ്മള്‍ കേട്ടിട്ടുള്ള രാഹു, കേതു, ശനി എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ചും ജാതകങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചും തന്ത്രക്രിയകളെക്കുറിച്ചും ആഴത്തിലുളള വിവരണം.

ab-rann-hoga.title: Boss Mindset: Subhash Chandra Bose Se Leadership Seekho
ab-rann-hoga.description: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose ki zindagi se jude kuch aise raaz hain, Jo aajtak kabhi koi khol nahi paya tha. Jaise Mussolini, Hitler aur Japan ke saath milkar kaise kiya unhone Bharat ko aazad karne ka plan? Kya thi unki daring war strategies aur isi tarah ki bahut saari informations. Toh abhi is show mein suniye kahani ek sachhe deshbhakt ki jo har pal aapko ek naye roop mein chaunkate huye inspire karti jayegi.

diwan-loda-bada-singh-bahadur.title: திவான் லொடபட சிங் பகதூர்
diwan-loda-bada-singh-bahadur.description: திவான் லொடபட சிங் என்னும் கற்பனை அரசனைப் பற்றிய நகைச்சுவைக் கதையை கேளுங்க!

vilambara-mayajaalam.title: Vilambara Mayajaalam
vilambara-mayajaalam.description: பொருளை செய்து விற்றால் மட்டும் போதுமா? கஸ்டமர்களை கவர் செய்து அவர்களை க்யூ கட்டி வந்து வாங்க வைத்து கல்லா கட்டும் விளம்பர வியூகங்களைக் கற்றுக் கொள்ளுங்கள்...

asur-yoddha.title: Asur Yuddha
asur-yoddha.description: Sunie asur aur rakshason ke rahasymayi sansaar ki kahaaniyan, jahan vo shaktishaali aur mayavi hone ke sath sath buddhiman bhi the. Suniye wo sare rochak pransang jisme asuriya shaktiyon ne jab jab devtaon ko lalkara tab tab unke hath lagi sirf parajaye.

the-blackwood-curse.title: The Blackwood Curse
the-blackwood-curse.description: The Blackwood family inherits a mysterious mansion, unaware of the dark legacy that comes with it. As strange occurrences start happening, seventeen-year-old Abigail discovers a hidden library within the darkness of the Blackwood Manor. Family secrets unravel, revealing a generations-old pact with a demon. With time running out and supernatural forces closing in, Abigail must unlock her newfound magical abilities to save her family from an ancient curse—or risk losing everything to an insatiable demonic force.

meri-zombie-girlfriend-1.title: Meri Zombie Girlfriend
meri-zombie-girlfriend-1.description: Ek virus ne duniya ko zombies mein badal diya hai. Dev bach gaya, par uski girlfriend Shivi zombie ban gayi. Kya Dev apni shaktiyon se Shivi ko wapas pa sakega? Kya dono mil kar apne pyaar ko bacha payenge is zombie duniya mein?

the-dukes-newbride.title: The Duke's Newbride
the-dukes-newbride.description:
"The Duke's NEWBRIDE" is a spellbinding tale of destiny, magic, and justice that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

When razor-sharp lawyer Fiona awakens as the villainous Lady Selena in a magical Victorian world, she must outwit her murderous husband, Duke Lucian, and unravel a kingdom-threatening prophecy. Armed with modern wit and newfound powers, Fiona navigates treacherous court politics, implements daring reforms, and finds an unexpected ally and romance with the Duke's cousin, Lord Aegon. As she rewrites her destiny from antagonist to hero, Fiona faces heart-pounding magical duels, shocking betrayals, and mind-bending time-travel twists. Will she save the kingdom or accidentally destroy it? Prepare for a rollercoaster of laugh-out-loud humor, sizzling romance, and epic fantasy adventure!

ponni.title: പൊന്നി
ponni.description: അട്ടപ്പാടിയുടെ മനോഹരമായ പഛാത്തലത്തില്‍, ഒരു പ്രണയകഥയുടെ മേമ്പൊടിയോടെ മലയാളത്തിന്റെ പ്രിയ എഴുത്തുകാരന്‍ മലയാറ്റൂര്‍ രാമകൃഷ്ണന്‍ വരച്ചു ചേര്‍ത്ത കാവ്യാന്മക നോവലാണ് 'പൊന്നി'. ഗോത്രവര്‍ഗ്ഗ ജീവിതവും അവിടത്തെ സാമൂഹിക വിഷയങ്ങളുമെല്ലാം ഇതില്‍ വിഷയമാകുന്നു.

sansad-hamla-pakistan-ka-dhokha.title: Sansad Hamla : Pakistan Ka Dhokha
sansad-hamla-pakistan-ka-dhokha.description: Kya aapko pata hai, Pakistan ke kis dhokhe ne hamari sansad ko kab aur kaise hila diya tha?  Yeh kahani hai dhokhe, dushmani aur deshbhakti ki. Sunein is audio show mein hamle ki khaufnaak sachchaiyon ko.

நெஞ்சமே-நெஞ்சமே-.title: நெஞ்சமே நெஞ்சமே
நெஞ்சமே-நெஞ்சமே-.description: வக்கீல் ராஜாராமின் செல்ல மகள் செய்யும் காதலுக்கு பச்சை கொடி காட்டுவாரா ராஜாராம்! சுவாரஸ்யமான திருப்பங்களுடன் இதோ "நெஞ்சமே நெஞ்சமே" உங்கள் Kuku FM-இல்.

கல்யாணம்-முதல்-காதல்-வரை-.title: கல்யாணம் முதல் காதல் வரை
கல்யாணம்-முதல்-காதல்-வரை-.description: கல்யாணத்தின் போது காதல் இல்லை, ஆனா காலத்தோட கட்டாயத்துனால கதாநாயகனும் நாயகியும் சேர்ந்து வாழ வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்துல இருக்கும் போது, பல்வேறு இடையூறுகள் வர இவங்க ஒத்துமையா இருப்பாங்களா ? என்ன பிரச்சனைகள் வருது ? இதற்க்கு இடையில காதல் மலருதா இல்லையா ? இந்த கதையை முழுமையா கேளுங்க.

12-life-sutras-for-troubled-times.title: 12 Life Sutras For Troubled Times
12-life-sutras-for-troubled-times.description: Hum sabhi apni life mein kisi na kisi cheez ke piche daud rahe hain. Koi money ke pichhe to koi success ke to koi happiness ke. Lekin jitna hum in cheezon ke pichhe bhagte hain, utna hi ye humse door hoti jati hain. Hum stress aur depression mein aa jate hain. Jisse hum apne goal se aur door ho jate hain. Ye kitab aapko stress control karne ke 12 sutras batati hai. Agar aap bhi apni life ko stress free banana chahte hain to ye kitab aapke liye hai. Suniyega zaroor!

malgudi-dinagalu.title: Malgudi Dinagalu
malgudi-dinagalu.description: ಇಲ್ಲಿಯ ಪ್ರತೀ ಬಜಾರು ಬೀದಿಗಳೂ ಕುತೂಹಲಗಳ ಕಣಜ. ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಮಲ್ಲಿಗೆಯ ಘಮಲು, ದಣಿವರಿಯದ ಬೇಸಾಯ, ಸಂಜೆಯ ತಂಪಾದ ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತ ಇದು ಒಂದ್ರೀತಿ ಸ್ವರ್ಗ ಕಣ್ರೀ! ಹೀಗೆ ಕಳೆದು ಹೋಗೋಣ ಅನಿಸುವ ನಮ್ಮ ನಡುವೆ ಬೆಚ್ಚಗೆ ಕುಳಿತಿರುವ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಪರಂಪರೆಯನ್ನ ಎತ್ತಿ ಆಡಿಸೋಣ ಬನ್ನಿ. ಈಗ್ಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ ಆರ್.ಕೆ. ನಾರಾಯಣ್ ಅವರ 'ಮಾಲ್ಗುಡಿ ದಿನಗಳು' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ KukuFM ನಲ್ಲಿ

the-bad-girlfriend-club.title: The Bad Girlfriend Club
the-bad-girlfriend-club.description: Janhvi, betrayed and poisoned by her best friend Ria, awakens in a mysterious time-loop, driven by a fierce desire for revenge and to dismantle Ria's manipulative schemes, which include orchestrating her parents' murder. Ria, meanwhile, attempts to escape her abusive husband Aditya, secretly conspiring to divorce him and abort their child for his wealth, while also being involved in a past connection that led to Janhvi's brutal beating. Janhvi, initially manipulating events, becomes entangled in a web of accusations, framed for massive financial fraud and embezzlement by Ria and an accomplice, leading to her disownment and public humiliation. Aditya frantically searches for Ria, initially accusing Janhvi, but gradually uncovers Ria's year-long deception, her fake heiress status, and her secret marriage to Kunal. The drama escalates with Aditya's severe injury and the unraveling of a complex paternity scandal, revealing Ria's child is not biologically Aditya's, shattering the Malhotra family's legacy. Janhvi, despite orchestrating the DNA test and achieving significant success in exposing Ria, experiences profound unfulfillment, leading to an unexpected offer from a powerful figure. Aditya, heartbroken and transformed by loss, embarks on a journey of atonement, seeking reconciliation with Janhvi, who remains deeply hurt by his past betrayals. His mother intervenes, proposing marriage to Janhvi and publicly adopting her, granting her significant power within their empire. Ria's deathbed confession reveals her hatred and destruction of their lives, solidifying Janhvi's resolve to remember Ria as a cautionary tale. Janhvi, now CEO of the Malhotra Group, a devoted mother, and Aditya's wife, grapples with an unresolved past, having rejected an inherited legacy for personal freedom. Aditya, demonstrating genuine change through care and domesticity, humbly seeks to win her back, hinting at a journey of redemption and revenge amidst corporate intrigue and family secrets.

the-outsmart-killer-clown.title: The Outsmart Killer Clown
the-outsmart-killer-clown.description: A masked clown is murdering the president—again and again. Trapped in a deadly time loop, he and his vice president race to uncover the truth behind the killings. A chilling blend of suspense, mystery, and mind-bending twists—where every death brings them closer to the real killer. Watch now!

my-dad-got-trillion-in-dollors.title: MY DAD GOT TRILLION IN DOLLORS
my-dad-got-trillion-in-dollors.description: One of the top 3 richest billionaires in the city hands over all his businesses to his son and starts working as a bike taxi driver. Seeing his helpful nature, a girl also falls in love with him. Because he's living a simple life, he faces a lot of insults. Taking advantage of this situation, his enemies try to seize the business from his son. How did he understand that conspiracy and handle his enemies? Did he live with the girl who loved him?

comeback-of-xxl-ceo.title: Comeback of XXL CEO
comeback-of-xxl-ceo.description: The microdrama chronicles the dramatic fall and vengeful return of CEO Sameer, initially betrayed by his protégé Kriti Sharma, who schemes for his fortune and orchestrates his mysterious disappearance, later revealed as a calculated deception. Kriti swiftly consolidates power as acting CEO of the Ambani Group, purging loyalists and facing accusations of orchestrating Sameer's demise, while other figures like Naina and Radha navigate their own agendas amidst the corporate intrigue. Sameer, grappling with a haunted past and self-disgust, transforms into the vengeful Arjun, meticulously plotting an elaborate revenge against Kriti and her accomplices, Rohan and Preeti, who achieved a corporate takeover by deceiving him. Loyal employee Naina, initially longing for her former boss, discovers Sameer's diary and is challenged by Arjun to uphold Sameer's legacy, eventually forming a high-stakes alliance with him to expose illicit financial activities and deception. Operating undercover as a consultant, Sameer, under the alias Sami Lamban/Arjun, orchestrates a grand revelation to expose a deep-seated corporate conspiracy and a significant financial fraud implicating Kriti and Rohan. He makes a powerful comeback, reclaiming his company and orchestrating the public disgrace and termination of his betrayers, revealing Kriti's role as the mastermind behind his poisoning. After enduring immense personal and professional setbacks, the resilient CEO, with Naina's unwavering support through grief, betrayal, and near-fatal poisoning, promotes her to Vice President. Their professional bond deepens into a profound romantic connection, with Sameer eventually acknowledging his reciprocal love for Naina, who has always cherished him. Together, as a formidable power couple, CEO Sameer and VP Naina face their greatest challenge as their revitalized company becomes the target of a global tech acquisition, leveraging their enduring partnership and deep romantic devotion to secure their company's future against new threats.

mrfu-spoils-his-wife-too-much-1.title: Mr.Fu Spoils his wife too much
mrfu-spoils-his-wife-too-much-1.description: Forced into marriage with a man she despises, her life becomes a storm of anger and resistance. But when fate unveils a twisted glimpse of their shared future, the rules of their relationship change forever. A powerful tale of passion, destiny, and the thin line between hate and love.

obsessed-gold-digger.title: Obsessed Gold Digger
obsessed-gold-digger.description: A gripping family drama where a woman hides a dark past to protect her child, only to be forced into a marriage built on deceit. As secrets unravel and trust shatters, she must fight for love and survival in a world where every truth comes at a price.

if-i-had-a-superpower.title: If I Had A Superpower
if-i-had-a-superpower.description: A struggling young man unlocks mysterious powers that plunge him into a ruthless world of corporate betrayal and deadly foes. With unexpected allies by his side, he must master his abilities before they consume him. A high-stakes saga of power, survival, and uncovering the truth behind the gift that could change everything. Watch now!

outsmart-killer-clown-2.title: Outsmart Killer Clown
outsmart-killer-clown-2.description:
রাষ্ট্রপতি হেনরির জীবন উলটপালট হয়ে যায় যখন এক মুখোশ পরা জোকার বারবার তাকে হত্যা করতে থাকে। সহকারী রাষ্ট্রপতি ক্যালির সঙ্গে এবং আগের জীবনের স্মৃতি বয়ে নিয়ে, হেনরিকে খুঁজে বের করতে হবে সত্য, ভাঙতে হবে এই মরণচক্র, আর সময় শেষ হওয়ার আগেই ধরে ফেলতে হবে প্রকৃত খুনিকে।
এখনই দেখুন

burning-the-family-tree.title: Burning the Family Tree
burning-the-family-tree.description: The microdrama introduces Neeti, a formidable professional bodyguard with a hidden agenda, who enters an arranged marriage with Nikhil, a charming but deeply disturbed lawyer. Their union, initially perceived as advantageous, quickly becomes a trap orchestrated by Nikhil's controlling father, forcing Neeti into a subservient domestic role. Neeti soon uncovers Nikhil's dark past, including a history of violence, gambling, and the mysterious death of his previous wife, Sarika. As Neeti attempts to connect with Nikhil's traumatized daughter, Disha, she uncovers more chilling secrets and senses the child's palpable fear, leading her to declare maternity to protect Disha from the escalating family violence. Defying Nikhil's manipulative facade and his powerful family's pressure, Neeti relentlessly pursues the truth, challenging their archaic traditions and patriarchal oppression. Her quest for justice escalates into accusations of domestic abuse against Nikhil, who chillingly hints at his involvement in Sarika's death. A ruthless custody battle unfolds between Nikhil and Neeti for Disha, complicated by Nikhil's own wife secretly working against him. Neeti strategically withdraws a divorce petition, sacrificing her freedom to safeguard Disha. The legal drama intensifies as Nikhil's mother publicly denounces her abusive husband, Ravi Sachdev, and son, Nikhil, vowing to protect Disha. This culminates in Nikhil Sachdeva's public downfall and accusations of homicide, fracturing his family as his wife and daughter abandon him. However, the conflict continues as Nikhil faces psychological torment from his vengeful wife Radha, and later, entrapment by manipulative Nidhi. Nikhil and his father plot to drug Nidhi to escape her control, while Neeti navigates treacherous divorce proceedings with estranged husbands Mikhel and Rishi, both harboring animosity. The saga deepens with Nikhil poisoning Niti and framing his own mother, shattering family bonds. A powerful matriarch asserts control over her sons, and Neeti betrays Nikhil, aligning with Sagar. The narrative culminates in Nikhil's chilling marriage to Surbhi, which quickly turns violent, and the emergence of a mysterious woman seeking brutal retribution against Nikhil for his past abuses.

billion-dollar-blunder-1.title: Billion Dollar Blunder
billion-dollar-blunder-1.description: The story revolves around the powerful Saxena family and their intertwined personal and corporate struggles. Radha and Sanjay celebrate their 30th anniversary at a resort, facing hostility from the ruthless manager Parul, who demands payment and orders their eviction, exposing class conflicts and power struggles. Meanwhile, Mukesh suffers health issues and becomes entangled in a deadly corporate conspiracy involving blackmail and a poisoned anniversary treat. The Saxena family faces identity theft and fraud, with imposters stealing their identities and a 30-lakh gift voucher being misused, leading to public confrontations and vows of punishment. Nandini asserts her claim to the Saxena enterprise, clashing with Mukesh and seeking Dhanush's aid, while matriarch Shalin Saxena violently confronts family members to maintain control. Yuvraj fights to save his ill father from denied medical aid by heiress Parul, sparking family and property disputes. A captive woman claiming to be Dhanush's mother reveals a dangerous conspiracy threatening the family's facade, while a ruthless woman torments a young girl and an older man, justifying her cruelty as retribution for past suffering. Dharuni's brutal torment of Riya and her mother ignites a vow of revenge, leading Dhanush and his wife to fiercely protect their family and demand compensation for their daughter's injury. Corporate betrayals and family betrayals unfold, exposing hidden sacrifices and ruthless ambitions. The Saxena family faces escalating crises as matriarch Yamini falls ill and is kidnapped by Parul, who seeks revenge and ransom, demanding corporate shares. Hostage situations and violent confrontations ensue, with family members mobilizing to rescue their loved ones amid ongoing threats. Throughout, themes of family loyalty, corporate ruthlessness, class conflict, identity deception, and survival intertwine, as characters navigate treacherous conflicts marked by betrayal, manipulation, and desperate acts for love and justice. The stakes rise as the Saxena family battles internal and external enemies to protect their legacy, confront past sins, and reclaim their power in a world rife with danger and deceit.

sorry-not-a-gold-digger-4.title: Sorry! Not a Gold Digger
sorry-not-a-gold-digger-4.description: A spirited delivery person, Tara, finds her life upended when an act of kindness leads to an unexpected marriage proposal from an elder, Dada Ji, for his unseen grandson, Rohan. Burdened by debt, Tara agrees to a contract marriage with the wealthy CEO, Veer, who is Rohan, unaware of his true identity. Their union is fraught with mistrust, especially from Veer, who suspects Tara is a gold-digger, while Tara seeks employment at his company to repay her debt. She faces humiliation and false accusations of plagiarism from a rival, Saundarya, leading to her dismissal and igniting a fierce class conflict. Later, Tara is vindicated, offered a design position, and unknowingly invites Rohan, disguised as a humble driver, to share her flat, fostering a burgeoning connection. Their relationship is tested by Rohan's hidden wealth and Tara's deep-seated distrust from past betrayals, as they navigate escalating confrontations with arrogant socialites. Saundarya continues her relentless sabotage, leveraging powerful connections to target Tara's career, forcing Tara to comply to protect her family. Unbeknownst to Tara, her CEO husband, Samarth (Rohan), investigates corporate sabotage while his grandfather orchestrates events to protect her and expose corrupt adversaries. Rohan dramatically reveals his true identity as the CEO of Mehta Corporation, defending Tara against public humiliation and dismantling corporate rivals who attempt to force Tara into other arranged marriages. The return of Rohan's long-lost fiancée, Reema, further complicates their relationship, as Reema publicly accuses Tara of being a gold-digger and claims to be the rightful fiancée. Rohan publicly declares Tara his wife, vehemently rejecting Reema, who retaliates by announcing her engagement to him. Tara, seeking an independent identity away from Rohan's shadow, is then publicly accused of bigamy and fraud, which she denies, revealing she is his actual wife. Driven by obsessive jealousy, Reema orchestrates Tara's brutal kidnapping, a terrifying ordeal that ultimately strengthens Rohan and Tara's bond. The show culminates with the revelation of Tara's pregnancy, as Rohan secures their future by transferring all his property into Tara's name, solidifying their union against all odds.

un-paarvayil-orayiram.title: Un Paarvayil Orayiram
un-paarvayil-orayiram.description: When humble home kitchen owner Sunaina marries Shashvat, she doesn't know he's secretly billionaire Shashvat Ambani testing her genuine love. As she faces cruel humiliation from her son's in-laws and searches for her missing daughter Nishi, a shocking revelation emerges—Shashvat's adopted daughter Aanya is actually Nishi. Through trials of deception, family betrayal, and hidden identities, true love ultimately triumphs.

bhikari-raja.title: Bhikari Raja
bhikari-raja.description: The microdrama centers on the intense rivalry between royal sisters Manimangal and Thargai, ignited by a decree for a prestigious groom and a past-life vow of revenge. Manimangal defies tradition by choosing Dheeran, a man of low social standing, over noble suitors, sparking outrage and leading to her disinheritance and public scorn. Her family, particularly her father, rejects her, while Thargai secures a high-status marriage and relentlessly torments Manimangal. Despite immense pressure, humiliation, and physical harm, Manimangal remains fiercely loyal to Dheeran. Dheeran is soon revealed to be Rajkumar, Prince Ashokan, and eventually King Dheeran, whose forbidden marriage to Manimangal ignites a kingdom-wide crisis. He is accused of being a commoner and a thief, leading to violent confrontations where Manimangal is gravely wounded protecting him. A power struggle ensues for the throne, with a new leader seizing power and ordering the extermination of the Rajguru clan, which Dheeran and the Rajmata oppose. Dheeran fabricates a commoner identity for them to pursue revenge against a shared enemy. Manimangal's arrival at the palace sparks new rivalries with palace aide Radha and a childhood betrothed, who accuses her of seduction and betrayal. She faces unjust accusations, including the theft of a sacred gem, leading to forced servitude, and later, an illicit affair with a soldier, for which she faces a death sentence. Meanwhile, Thargai, now known as Princess Menaka, continues her jealous fury and plots against Manimangal, making false claims to royal lineage. The powerful Rajmata intervenes, orchestrating events to expose Menaka's deceit and hinting at Manimangal's true lineage. Menaka's false claims are dramatically revealed, leading to her imprisonment and an arranged marriage, though she plots escape and revenge. Amidst a treacherous festival and a court conspiracy, a loyal woman, likely Manimangal, is falsely accused of treason. Kochadaiiyaan Ranadheeran emerges, admitting complicity in the actions under judgment and astonishingly declares the accused individual a princess. The presiding figure confirms this elevated status, culminating Manimangal's journey from scorned outcast to recognized royalty.

billion-dollar-blunder.title: Billion Dollar Blunder
billion-dollar-blunder.description: The microdrama centers on the powerful Indian matriarch Shalini and her husband Mukesh, whose modest 30th-anniversary celebration at a sentimental resort quickly devolves into a saga of betrayal, corporate intrigue, and family conflict. Initially, their wealthy sons intervene to ensure their comfort, but resort manager Parul, romantically involved with Mukesh, cruelly abuses the elderly couple. Mukesh suffers a life-threatening peanut allergy attack, orchestrated by corporate rival Saketh, while Shalini dramatically reveals her true identity as a powerful boss's mother, challenging Parul's authority. The family faces accusations of fraud and physical assaults, with Shalini (also known as Mrs. Saxena, Pratapa, or Nandini) enduring public humiliation and brutal attacks from figures like Vicky. Their CEO son, Dhanush Saxena, appears amidst the chaos, initially oblivious to his subordinate Tarun's sinister plots against his parents. Tarun emerges as a manipulative mastermind, orchestrating conspiracies, framing Shalini's other son Yuvraj, and later becoming a blacklisted employee seeking revenge against Shalini Saxena for perceived class-driven attacks. Mukesh (also referred to as Yuvraj's father or the Ailing Husband) suffers multiple critical medical emergencies, with Dhanush even demanding his mother's humiliation for life-saving medicine. New players like Naina and Riya infiltrate the family, each with their own agendas for power and influence. The cycle of vengeance intensifies as Dhanush discovers his parents' brutal attacks and embarks on a quest for justice, demanding substantial compensation. Parul, the initial resort manager, resurfaces as a kidnapper, abducting Mrs. Saxena (Shalini) and demanding a hefty ransom and a stake in Saxena Industry, fueled by years of perceived betrayal and financial ruin caused by Arya (likely Dhanush). A high-stakes rescue mission ensues, marked by betrayal and gunfire, leaving Mrs. Saxena's fate uncertain.
