Though seemingly safe later, she appoints Naina to a significant managerial position, hinting that the aftermath of violence and the deep-seated conflicts within the powerful Saxena family are far from over.

after-the-breakup-i-lead-my-three-kids-t.title: After the Breakup, I Lead My Three Kids to Conquer All Sides
after-the-breakup-i-lead-my-three-kids-t.description: The microdrama centers on Saira, a young woman who enters a desperate contract to bear a son for the powerful heir Daniel, only to be abandoned with triplets and disowned by her family. Her manipulative sister Annya and brother Sebastian then hold Saira and her children captive, attempting to extort Daniel, who is simultaneously facing Annya's retribution. Saira struggles as a single mother, secretly sheltering her children and facing blackmail, while Daniel, revealed as the powerful Chairman of the Sixo Group, executes a hostile takeover and manipulates Saira into a mysterious arrangement. Accepting a General Manager position, Saira endures public humiliation from vengeful former schoolmates, prompting Daniel to orchestrate brutal retribution against her tormentors. Daniel, after regaining his memories, reveals himself as the biological father of Saira's children, a truth that emerges amidst Saira's family facing severe classist discrimination. Saira fiercely rejects Daniel's attempts at reconciliation, accusing him of abandonment and revealing his "three illegitimate children," demanding a DNA test and seizing corporate finances. Daniel strategically acquires a hotel, dismantling rivals and exposing their schemes, but faces public humiliation with his adopted children, fueling his quest for justice against an arrogant rich man. Saira's manipulative adoptive parents reveal her adoption and attempt to force her into an unwanted marriage with Daniel for financial gain, threatening her children, which Saira defiantly resists. Amidst blackmail, Daniel resolves to publicly acknowledge his three hidden children, while the powerful Sisso Group faces a corporate succession battle, complicated by Saira's past 'mistake' causing injury to the eldest son. Daniel's gravely ill wife, Saira, requires his unique blood for a risky surgery, a decision opposed by his stern patriarch father, Shankaran, who rejects the children. A usurper seizes corporate control, and Daniel's family faces accusations and violence. Shankaran's deathbed revelation of three unknown grandchildren ignites an inheritance battle, culminating in the abduction of Daniel's children by a vengeful former employee. Ultimately, video evidence exposes past betrayals, leading the Patriarch to vindicate Saira and Daniel, embracing them and their children as true family, with the joyous revelation of Saira's pregnancy with triplets.

secretary-rosie.title: Secretary Rosie
secretary-rosie.description: Rosie is a secretary, but she never wanted to remain just that. She dreamed of rising higher, so she made a plan. Did Siddharth and Priya get trapped in her plan? What exactly is Rosie’s true goal? To find out, watch “Secretary Rosie” only on Kuku TV

rebirth-hunting-crimes-album-4.title: Rebirth: Hunting Crimes Album
rebirth-hunting-crimes-album-4.description:
In a remote mountain village, female teachers are being hunted and murdered. When two newcomers arrive, one is haunted by terrifying visions while the other barely escapes the killers’ grasp.
A dark mystery unfolds in a tale of fear, secrets, and the desperate fight to uncover why women are being targeted.

boss-daddy.title: Daddy Danger
boss-daddy.description: Daddy Boss is a high-voltage-family drama where A waiter , saves a rich girl, , from the clutches of a wealthy man. He is actually a secret head of the syndicate , but he has hidden this identity from everyone – even his own son. How will he navigate his life while also fighting his enemies on his journey? Watch Now!

back-to-1994-5.title: Back to 1994
back-to-1994-5.description: One bullet. One betrayal. And he wakes up in 1994. With a single chance to rewrite his fate, he must outsmart the very people who once buried him. A gripping saga of power, lies, and second chances—where the past holds the key to survival. Watch now!

sms-sathvik-manasulo-sneha.title: SMS (Sathvik Manasulo Sneha)
sms-sathvik-manasulo-sneha.description: SMS (Sathvik Manasulo Sneha) is a entertainment show

the-flash-marriage-husband-is-a-billiona.title: Sorry Not a Gold Digger
the-flash-marriage-husband-is-a-billiona.description: When hardworking delivery girl Tara crosses paths with billionaire heir Rohan Mehta through a twist of fate, their unexpected flash marriage sparks a journey filled with secrets, clashes, and unspoken love. As Tara struggles to protect her dignity and dreams, and Rohan hides his true identity, will this unlikely union blossom into real love or collapse under lies and pride? Watch Now!

rebirth-of-the-citys-mad-doctor-4.title: Rebirth of the City's Mad Doctor
rebirth-of-the-citys-mad-doctor-4.description: Once dismissed as a failure, he returns stronger—wielding ancient medical secrets and an unbreakable will. From disgrace to dominance, his journey is one of healing, redemption, and ruthless revenge. Rebirth of the City’s Mad Doctor is a thrilling saga of power, justice, and a man who refuses to stay broken.

hum-tum-aur-baby.title: Hum Tum Aur Baby
hum-tum-aur-baby.description: Deepika's tumultuous marriage to Siddharth unravels amidst betrayals, desperate acts, and a fight for freedom, beginning with her unethical attempt to conceive and the discovery of Siddharth's affair with his pregnant assistant, Aastha. Deepika, also pregnant and a hidden heiress, faces accusations of gold-digging from Siddharth and his family, leading to a dramatic divorce battle complicated by his manipulative attempts to control her. Post-divorce, Deepika navigates a cutthroat business world where Siddharth becomes her rival, while Aastha publicly claims to be "Mrs. Manan" and pregnant with a corporate heir, sparking public scandals and deeper corporate betrayals. Deepika's journey is further complicated by new romantic interests and protectors, including the protective billionaire Anant and powerful CEO Harsh Rathore, who blacklists her ex-husband's company. A secret marriage to Mohit is revealed, followed by Deepika's dramatic collapse and the shocking revelation of her pregnancy, igniting a fierce paternity battle between her ex-husband Sid and childhood friend Mohit, exposing Sid's infidelity. Driven by maternal protectiveness, Deepika blackmails CEO Sanjay to seize control of Sky High Airlines, rejecting Mohit's proposal and Siddharth's pleas for reconciliation, despite his heroic rescue from a fire and his later realization of being framed by manipulative relatives. Aastha continues her sinister machinations, unmasked as an arsonist and perpetrator of a fake photo scandal, publicly announcing her pregnancy with Sid's heir and questioning Deepika's child's paternity. Deepika's possessive brother, Bhaiya, disputes Sid's paternity and threatens his life, though Deepika saves Sid to protect her unborn child from a devastating family truth. The revelation that Deepika's new live-in help, Varun Nimani, is Sid in disguise, attempting to win her back, adds another layer of intrigue. Tragically, Deepika grieves the loss of her child, violently confronting Aastha, whom she blames for the death, while Sid's loyalties are tested between the two women. Despite Deepika's distrust, Sid confesses his profound love, even as Aastha, driven by vengeance, abducts a pregnant Radha and causes Deepika to mysteriously vanish. The show culminates with Sid being critically wounded by a gunshot while protecting an innocent family from Aastha, as his partner Nandini reveals her pregnancy and pleads for his life and a second chance.

bend-the-waist-4.title: Bend the waist
bend-the-waist-4.description:
అనూష అనే అనాధ అమ్మాయిని స్కూల్‌లో ఇతరులు అవమానిస్తుంటారు. ఆమెను రాహుల్ అనే ధనవంతుడు రక్షిస్తాడు. తరువాత అనూష అతనిపై ప్రత్యేకమైన భావాలు పెంచుకుంటుంది.
ఇది ఒక చిన్న ప్రేమ, ఆత్మగౌరవ కథ.

power-couple-tho-aatala.title: Billion Dollar Blunder
power-couple-tho-aatala.description:
ఒక ధనవంతుల జంటను రిసార్ట్‌లో మోసగాళ్లుగా తప్పుడు అనుమానంతో చూడటం ప్రారంభమవుతుంది.
అధికారం కోసం వాడుకుంటున్న మేనేజర్ వాళ్లను అవమానించగా, నిజం వెలుగులోకి రాగానే ఘాటైన ప్రతీకారం ప్రారంభమవుతుంది.
గౌరవం కొనలేని విషయం, ఖర్మ వడ్డీతో తిరిగి వస్తుందని చెప్పే కథ… వెంటనే చూడండి!

rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons.title: Rudraroop - Revenge of Richierich Sons
rudraroop-revenge-of-richierich-sons.description: A single mother raises three remarkable sons while facing constant challenges from her family. When she returns home for her father’s seventieth birthday, she is met with coldness and hostility from her father and younger sisters. Refusing to be broken, she stands tall against their prejudice and finds her own path to happiness.

billion-dollar-wala-blunder-1.title: Billion Dollar Blunder
billion-dollar-wala-blunder-1.description: The Saxena family's 30th anniversary celebration at a resort quickly devolves into a harrowing ordeal for matriarch Shalini and her ailing husband, Mukesh. Their CEO son, Dhanush, initially enlists ambitious resort manager Parul to ensure his parents' safety, unaware of her ruthless agenda. Parul's escalating cruelty, fueled by ambition and a thirst for revenge, leads to physical altercations and threats against the elderly couple. A shocking revelation exposes Shalini's claim of resort ownership and her hidden identity as Parul's mother, dramatically shifting the power dynamics. Parul's traumatic past drives her brutal vengeance against those she perceives as poor or fraudulent, supervising torture and denying medical aid. Amidst this, a complex web of identity theft unfolds, with Mr. and Mrs. Saxena accused of impersonating Dhanush's parents, while imposters brazenly accept lavish gifts. The wealthy Saxena family is plunged into chaos as a mysterious woman claiming a familial connection is silenced, and the patriarch and matriarch are hospitalized after a violent car crash. Imposters like Vish, aided by Parul, attempt to usurp the Saxena identity and assets, leading to public confrontations. Driven by vengeance for her husband's condition, Shalini mobilizes her son, referred to as Abhi, Yuvraj, or UV, to fight for their family's honor and resort. New players like the ambitious Noyona emerge, planning to betray Dhanush Saxena and undermine his influence. A cycle of brutal vengeance and desperate survival ensues, with Dhanush intervening to fight for justice for Riya, who faces torment and abuse. Shalini Saxena, fueled by maternal and spousal fury after her family is attacked, unleashes corporate and personal retribution, blacklisting individuals and demanding astronomical compensation. A desperate Arun seeks to destroy Shalini Saxena for past wrongs, leading to financial ruin and public humiliation for others. Rishi, driven by his family's brutal abuse, meticulously plans a revenge targeting his tormentors' mortality. The narrative culminates when an imposter maid infiltrates the Saxena household, abducts the matriarch, Ma/Shalini, and stages her disappearance. Dhanush Saxena unleashes vast resources for a relentless search, vowing retribution. The abductor, Arun, holds Ma hostage, demanding retribution for past wrongs and escalating his demands to a high-stakes corporate power grab. Ma senses Arun's true intentions, leading to a tragic climax where she is shot, leaving her status uncertain. The situation further escalates into a violent confrontation between Arun and "Madam" and "Sir," leaving their ultimate fate uncertain, while a new manager, Nayana, is championed at Saxena Industries.

the-abundant-son.title: Crorepati Chaprasi
the-abundant-son.description: An abandoned son returns years later with wealth, power, and a burning desire to reclaim his rightful place. But as secrets unravel and loyalties are tested, his journey of revenge collides with the search for love and belonging.

final-bharosa-1.title: Final Bharosa
final-bharosa-1.description: The microdrama centers on the intricate interplay of wealth, class, and the quest for authentic relationships within the powerful Ambani family and those connected to them. Tycoon Abhimanyu, seeking true love beyond his fortune, marries the compassionate divorcee Sunaina, who remains unaware of his immense wealth, leading her to endure cruel public humiliation from his mother, Nandita. Concurrently, Ishaan, a man of more humble origins, is trapped in a devastating class conflict, forced to choose between his wealthy, domineering wife, Zara, who repeatedly demeans his mother, and his filial loyalty. As Sunaina and her husband face accusations of fraud and public shaming, his hidden influence dramatically emerges, leading to the downfall of a corporate mogul and revealing his true power. This husband is later identified as Sashwat Ambani, a formidable CEO who, while concealing his identity, develops a romance with Sunaina and exacts justice for betrayed relatives. Meanwhile, Abhimanyu's adopted daughter, Anaya, navigates her own romantic prospects and later discovers her adoptive status, a revelation that intertwines with a grieving father's search for his missing daughter, Nishi. The narrative intensifies as Zara's manipulative nature escalates, culminating in her chilling deception to coerce Ishaan's selfless mother into donating a kidney for Zara's own ailing parent. Ishaan ultimately ends his marriage, prioritizing his mother and son, and is revealed as CEO Ishan Ambani, subsequently dismissing Zara for her past mistreatment. Sunaina's burgeoning romance with Shashwat Ambani is then threatened by a relentless blackmailer who exposes her traumatic past and demands she leave him, threatening the safety of a child named Nishi. The mystery surrounding Nishi deepens when Anya Ambani discovers she was kidnapped decades ago by her biological father and placed with the wealthy Ambani family. Faced with this profound truth, Anya/Nishi chooses her adoptive father, Shashwat, and her biological mother, Sunaina, as her true family. The series culminates in a poignant ceremony celebrating a significant union and the triumphant reunion of the Ambani family, signifying the restoration of lost honor and the completion of the family for its matriarch.

srimathi-srivaru.title: Srimathi Srivaru
srimathi-srivaru.description: A powerful CEO, Shaswat, challenged by his daughter to remarry for love, embarks on a quest for an authentic connection, secretly posing as an insurance agent. He meets Sunaina, a kind entrepreneur, and their connection deepens, leading to a swift marriage, though Sunaina remains unaware of his immense wealth and true identity as the formidable CEO of the Chaudhary Group. Concurrently, a separate storyline introduces Sara, a wealthy heiress who cruelly dominates her husband, Ishaan, and publicly humiliates his loving mother, fueling a bitter rivalry with Sunaina. Corporate intrigue unfolds as Shaswat, also known as Mihir, faces classist confrontations and the vengeful vow of corporate VP Vijay, who is later banned from the Chaudhary empire. Amidst these conflicts, a distraught mother searches for her missing daughter, Nishi, encountering Shaswat and his adopted daughter, Anya, who bears an uncanny resemblance to the lost girl. Sunaina's past as a divorcee and accusations of being an "unfit mother" are exposed by a blackmailer, threatening her new life with Shaswat and leading to the abduction of her daughter, Nishi. It is revealed that Nishi was kidnapped twenty years prior by Rajiv and now lives as Anya Chowdhary, Shaswat's adopted daughter. Meanwhile, Sara orchestrates a harrowing medical deception, manipulating Ishan and his selfless mother for a kidney transplant, only to be exposed by a protector. Anya grapples with her true identity, ultimately choosing her loving adoptive father, Shaswat, and her biological mother, Sunaina, and brother, Ishan, over her biological father, Rajiv. The show culminates in the formation of a new, unconventional family, with a joyous ceremony symbolizing the profound restoration of their honor and legacy.

maharishi-ka-agman.title: Maharishi Ka Agman
maharishi-ka-agman.description: A young Acharya, Kabir, sets out to avenge his father’s death and his mother’s humiliation, uncovering dark secrets, powerful enemies, and hidden family truths along the way. The story blends revenge, betrayal, love, and mystical powers into a thrilling saga.

one-poor-girl-one-ceos-heart.title: Billion Dollar Waali Shaadi
one-poor-girl-one-ceos-heart.description: A poor but determined girl’s life turns upside down when a powerful CEO from her past forces her into a contract marriage, sparking a storm of secrets, betrayal, and forbidden love. As family rivalries and hidden truths unfold, she must fight for her dignity, her mother’s life, and her own heart.

daughter-of-the-secret-tycoon-3.title: Daughter of the Secret Tycoon
daughter-of-the-secret-tycoon-3.description: The series opens amidst a complex web of corporate intrigue, introducing Rishi Sharma, a powerful Mumbai businessman leading a perilous double life, secretly guarding his daughter Alia's heiress status. Alia, unaware of her true lineage, embarks on a quest to find her rescuer, while the enigmatic vigilante Steel Eagle rescues CEO Geetha Varma, hinting at her ties to the criminal mastermind Fire Phoenix. Ambitious intern Arjun rapidly ascends the corporate ladder, influenced by the formidable CEO Priya, leading to his engagement with Alia. However, this union shatters dramatically when Arjun publicly humiliates Alia and her father, exposing deep-seated class conflicts and manipulative agendas. Following her public rejection, Alia is unexpectedly elevated in status when her powerful father, Rishi, claims her as family, bestowing immense wealth. Rishi's sudden marriage to the enigmatic Ashna complicates Alia's new life, while Arjun's desperate attempts at reconciliation are met with definitive rejection and corporate retribution. Priya, allied with Arjun, vows revenge against the dominant Singhania group, planning strategic moves involving "Fire Phoenix" and "Steel Eagle." The narrative then delves into the mystery of the 'Fire Red Diamond,' initially implicating Alia's father, Sharma Uncle, in theft, before CEO Miss Geetha confesses she gifted it to him, hinting at a profound, hidden relationship. The true identity of Mrs. Rai's husband, Ranjith, is dramatically unveiled as 'The Fire Phoenix' and the powerful owner of the Singhania Group, exposing a vast network of corporate corruption. Ashna, revealed to be a visionary CEO and later Inder Singhania's daughter, fiercely protects Rishi, whose dangerous past as an elite operative resurfaces. Rishi, once mocked, stuns his tormentors by revealing his wife is Archana Rai, CEO of the prestigious Rai Group, challenging perceptions of power and status. The series culminates with Inder Singhania, revealed to be Rishi and 'Fire Phoenix,' entrusting his immense corporate empire to his beloved daughter Ashna, solidifying their formidable partnership and strategic alliances against lingering adversaries. The overarching stakes involve the battle for corporate dominance, the protection of family honor, and the unraveling of deeply buried secrets that connect powerful figures across the criminal underworld and corporate elite.

wifey-on-day-one.title: Wifey On Day One
wifey-on-day-one.description: “Wifey on Day One” is a high-stakes romantic drama with a sci-fi twist, where Yash Malhotra, a food delivery rider, wakes up in a surreal “system game” that casts him as the villain in a love story. Struggling to survive against the true hero Dev Trivedi, navigate tangled relationships with heroines Yuvika and Siya, and outsmart power-hungry tycoons like Bhairav and Mr. Mehra, Yash must balance love, betrayal, and corporate wars while rewriting his own destiny

female-lead-is-the-strongest-mouthpiece-.title: The Female Lead is the Strongest Mouthpiece Substitute
female-lead-is-the-strongest-mouthpiece-.description: A fearless young woman agrees to marry a cold, powerful man as a stand-in bride — but soon proves she's no substitute. As sparks fly and secrets unfold, she turns a fake marriage into a battle of hearts and pride. Watch "The Female Lead is the Strongest Mouthpiece Substitute" now!

the-mistaken-girl-5.title: The Mistaken Girl
the-mistaken-girl-5.description:
She’s bold, impulsive, and wants it all—no matter the cost. But when her stubborn choices spiral into misunderstandings and chaos, life turns into an emotional roller coaster.
A fun-filled tale of ambition, confusion, and heart—where every mistake brings drama and a lesson.

boss-baby-aur-tamasha.title: Boss Baby aur Tamasha
boss-baby-aur-tamasha.description: Kavya, a fiercely independent young woman, discovers she is pregnant after a traumatic encounter, determined to raise her child despite financial hardship and an unknown father. Concurrently, a powerful patriarch, desperate for an heir, initiates a search that leads to a shocking DNA match with a young boy, Rohan, whose mother struggles with poverty and urgent medical needs. This discovery forces the patriarch's son, Mihir, to confront a hidden past and a mysterious romance, as Kavya secures a job as Mihir's executive secretary, where corporate intrigue and a jealous colleague's sabotage intertwine with Mihir's unsettling curiosity about Rohan. As Rohan faces medical crises, including a severe allergic reaction and re-injury, Kavya battles workplace hostility and paternity accusations, desperately seeking medical care amidst financial hardship and hospital bureaucracy. Powerful figures like CEO Mihir and the enigmatic Aryan intervene, hinting at complex past connections and hidden agendas, while Dr. Raj faces a moral dilemma between family duty and professional obligation while treating Rohan. The patriarch, Mr. SK, eventually believes Young Rohan is his long-lost grandson and attempts to integrate Kavya and Rohan into his wealthy world, demanding a contract marriage between his son, Rohan (Father), and Kavya to secure the family lineage. This forced union is complicated by Rohan (Father)'s existing affections and his dismissive attitude towards Kavya's twin pregnancy, while Kavya faces a ruthless rival, Alisha, who attempts to evict her and Young Rohan, fueled by a bitter love triangle involving Mihir. Kavya's unmarried pregnancy is exposed, leading to workplace shaming and a desperate fight for dignity amidst corporate power and family secrets. A shocking revelation confirms Mihir is the father of Kavya's unborn child, leading to a plea for responsibility amidst a demand for abortion, and he is also revealed as the father of Muskaan's son. Mihir's impending marriage to Kavya is complicated by the lingering shadow of his missing past love, Muskaan, and a desperate search for her true identity involves DNA tests at an orphanage, where Kavya herself becomes entangled in a mystery surrounding her own parentage. The narrative culminates in the shocking discovery that Kavya is, in fact, Muskaan, a long-lost amnesiac heiress, plunging their families into turmoil. This revelation ignites a bitter inheritance battle with her jealous sister, Alisha, who believes Muskaan is usurping her legacy, leading to Alisha's expulsion from the family and a chilling vow of revenge. Despite the ongoing conflict, the family celebrates the arrival of new babies, hinting at complex inheritance dynamics and dangerous secrets surrounding Muskaan's disappearance, as themes of class disparity, family legacy, and a mother's unwavering love intertwine with identity and betrayal.

say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-6.title: Say I Love You When We Meet Again!
say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-6.description: Years ago, pregnant Preya sacrificed her love, wealthy heir CS, under pressure from his manipulative mother, believing it would save his life. Unbeknownst to her, a ruthless patriarch, Mr. Gibbs, stole one of her twin newborns, a son named Jacob, and manipulated CS into believing Preya abandoned their family. Five years later, CS returns as a powerful CEO, consumed by a desire for revenge against Preya for her perceived betrayal. Their paths dramatically cross when their critically ill daughter, Eloven, is denied hospital admission by CS, who uses her as leverage. Preya, now using aliases like Freya, struggles to save Eloven while Mr. Gibbs, revealed to be the enigmatic Siass, unleashes a brutal campaign of revenge, forcing her into public humiliation and contract marriages. CS, driven by jealousy and a desire for control, relentlessly pursues Freya, abducting her, blackmailing her, and framing her partner, Henrik, to force her submission. He uses both Eloven and Jacob as pawns, manipulating Jacob against his mother and threatening Eloven's life to ensure Freya's compliance. A shocking paternity reveal confirms CS is Eloven's biological father, leading to an agonizing ultimatum where Freya is forced to sacrifice her relationship with Eloven to save her life. Amidst public shaming and professional sabotage, Mr. Gibbs publicly declares Freya's child is his and proposes marriage, only for a man from Freya's past to interrupt, accusing her of betrayal. As secrets unravel, CS discovers Freya's immense past sacrifices for him, hinting at a deeper, conflicted history. The conflict escalates into violent confrontations, leaving Freya critically wounded. Ultimately, Priya (Miss Rand), seeking retribution for her family's ruin, abducts Freya and CS's beloved Sisi. Siyaas (Mr. Gibbs/CS) is critically wounded in a shootout, prompting Priya to reveal their shared daughter and, after a desperate marriage proposal, mourn his implied death, vowing further retribution.

ultimate-love.title: Bheekh Maange Billionaire
ultimate-love.description: Srijita, a kind-hearted sweet shop owner, endures profound heartbreak and public humiliation when her fiancé, Shekhar, betrays her with her own sister, Anundita. Amidst intense family pressure and her ailing grandmother's dying wish, a mysterious CEO, disguised as a beggar, intervenes, proposing a contract marriage to save Srijita's family honor. Their unconventional union begins with initial awkwardness, but an unexpected connection soon blossoms between them, even as the CEO's hidden identity and a past link to Shekhar are hinted at by a discarded ring. As their fabricated romance is tested, they face relentless classist scorn and public humiliation from wealthy relatives like Laboni and the persistent Shekhar, who publicly accuses Srijita of stalking. The CEO, later identified as Shubhendu Banerjee, dramatically intervenes in these confrontations, hinting at a hidden power and wealth, though he initially faces public shaming when his attempts to impress Anindita's family unravel. Despite these challenges, Shubhendu confesses his true feelings for Srijita, which she reciprocates, solidifying their bond with her mother's blessing. However, their newfound joy is constantly threatened by past grudges, a sinister revenge plot orchestrated by conspirators, and the re-emergence of Srijita's obsessive ex-lover, Manik, who violently interrupts their romantic moments. Shubhendu is critically injured protecting Srijita, deepening their commitment, but a powerful "Boss" emerges, threatening Manik and planning a forced marriage for Srijita, adding a dangerous secret to her uncertain future. Srijita's wedding plans with Shubhendu are further complicated by a perceived betrayal and Shekhar's continued attempts to usurp their venue, only for a mysterious acquisition by Mr. and Mrs. Banerjee to oust Shekhar. Unbeknownst to many, Shubhendu is secretly a powerful CEO who dramatically reveals his true identity by purchasing the entire hotel where their wedding is planned, challenging assumptions about his perceived low status. At a charity auction, Srijita and Shubhendu endure more public humiliation, leading to a high-stakes bidding war where Shubhendu, initially dismissed, ultimately orchestrates a corporate takeover and bankrupts Shekhar for reneging on a public bet. Through these trials, Srijita reclaims her dignity and finds true love, while Shubhendu asserts his power and protects his beloved. Their journey culminates in a triumphant union, overcoming societal prejudice and personal betrayals.

falling-for-my-boss.title: Falling for My Boss
falling-for-my-boss.description: Six years after a fateful one-night encounter, a self-made single mother and a wealthy businessman cross paths again—unaware of their shared past, while jealousy brews, secrets unravel, and the grandfather searches for the heir he never knew existed.

cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-5.title: Cloaked in Power His Secret Identity
cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-5.description: He is no ordinary man; he has a mysterious past where he had superpower. But in the daily life he wishes to live an ordinary life as a driver. He accidentally meets a beautiful woman, a CEO, and that eventually leads to a one nightstand, leading towards thrilling twists and turns.

fake-wife.title: Fake Wife
fake-wife.description: Dev Joshi, stuck in a contract marriage, devotes himself to Rati Kapoor, who never values him. Her heart remains with her first love, Avinash, aided by her scheming siblings Pooja and Prem. After Rati dismissively signs divorce papers, Dev leaves and rebuilds his life into a billionaire researcher. He finds true respect and affection with Shreya Rao, unlike the humiliation he endured with Rati. In the end, Dev rejects Rati’s late realization and chooses a dignified future with Shreya. Watch now.

three-brothers-dote-on-me-5.title: Three Brothers Dote on Me
three-brothers-dote-on-me-5.description: The microdrama begins with the decades-long search by wealthy brothers Lucas and Avery for their missing sister, intertwined with the ruthless betrayal of pregnant Lean by ambitious Caden, who defrauds her and wishes death upon her and their unborn child. Multiple claimants emerge for the missing sister's identity, each with a "heart mark" and a significant necklace, leading to a high-tech biometric test that ultimately confirms Iris as the true heir. Iris, grappling with memory loss, confronts Caden at his wedding, accusing him of past betrayal and abandonment, leading to her public humiliation and a violent altercation. As Iris recovers her memories, she discovers a "heart mark" and reunites with her brothers, Lucas, Avery, and Connor, who vow revenge for her suffering. She is revealed as the long-lost princess of Claudia with extraordinary powers and the true Master of the Eternity Pavilion, a position fiercely contested by rivals like Esme and Sami. Iris strategically navigates a ruthless corporate world, exposing Caden and Esme's deceptions, including their attempts to usurp her identity and inheritance, and destroying crucial designs. Her journey is complicated by her own father's false accusation of fraud and a devastating miscarriage after rejecting a forced marriage. A new, formidable antagonist, Fiona Wood, emerges, orchestrating a hostile takeover to monopolize the market and ruin the Lowell family, driven by personal vendetta against Connor. Fiona publicly shames and kidnaps Iris, and unleashes devastating corporate sabotage against the Lowells, threatening their financial ruin. Amidst these external threats, Iris also faces betrayal from her brother Lucas, who turns vengeful against her and Connor. However, Iris, now fully embracing her identity as the Lowell heiress and Eternity Master, dramatically confirms her authority with the legendary Phoenix Seal. She immediately moves to dismantle Fiona's powerful rival empire, delivering ruthless retribution for corporate betrayals and past attempts to destroy her family. The microdrama culminates with the powerful patriarch, Connor, and other family members confirming their strong bond and unbreakable unity, as Iris reclaims her rightful power and legacy.

ghar-wapsi-ki-yatra.title: Ultimate Sacrifice
ghar-wapsi-ki-yatra.description: As a desperate family fights to save their daughter, they are pulled into a dangerous ritual where sacrifice is the only way out. A child’s kidnapping uncovers a terrifying world of black magic, blind faith, and betrayal. Ultimate Sacrifice is a gripping story of fear, faith, family, and survival that will keep you hooked till the end.

the-call-boy-i-met-in-chennai.title: The Call Boy I Met in Chennai
the-call-boy-i-met-in-chennai.description: The microdrama centers on Riya Sreekantha, an heiress initially mistaking powerful CEO Vishal Subramanyam for a call boy after a one-night stand. Facing a forced marriage and corporate threats, Riya defiantly rejects Ranjith and orchestrates a contract marriage with Vishal to reclaim her corporate legacy and exact revenge on an antagonistic family. Unbeknownst to her, Vishal, secretly smitten, maintains his 'paid husband' deception while navigating high-stakes corporate battles. Riya's investigation into Vishal's true identity nearly exposes him, complicating their relationship built on lies. As Riya is appointed CEO, she immediately faces sabotage from her ex-fiancé Ranjith, threatening her family's legacy, while also dealing with a love triangle involving her supportive friend Vinod and Vishal's growing possessiveness. The narrative deepens as Riya uncovers her manipulative stepfather's auctioning of her deceased mother's diamond necklace, fueling her suspicion of his involvement in her mother's death and prompting a vow for revenge. A mysterious 'Boss' also seeks retribution for the stolen heirloom, and Vishal, despite initial deception, pays off Riya's enormous debt, revealing his immense wealth. Riya then endures a public scandal after being drugged, leading to a tense confrontation between Vishal and Vinoth over her reputation. Amidst amnesia, Vishal claims to be her husband, while Vinoth hints at their shared past, and Riya believes her mother's 'suicide' was murder, with her own father orchestrating a hostile takeover of her company. Riya, a determined leader, uncovers sexual harassment allegations against a senior corporate figure and battles a ruthless corporate coup led by board member John. Simultaneously, she is accused of her mother's murder by her sibling, leading to an interrogation. Supported by Vishal, Riya reopens her mother's five-year-old cold case, alerting powerful adversaries. This investigation takes a terrifying turn when Riya is violently kidnapped, discovering her captor is the very man who murdered her mother. A subsequent violent struggle leaves Vishal gravely injured while protecting her. Plagued by guilt, Riya finds unexpected acceptance from Vishal's mother, Soundarya, who recognizes Vishal's profound love and sacrifice. With her place solidified, Riya and Vishal passionately reaffirm their unbreakable bond, vowing eternal commitment despite past adversities, sealing their destined love.

ceothose-twins-look-like-you.title: CEO,Those Twins Look Like You
ceothose-twins-look-like-you.description:
A young CEO haunted by the mysterious death of his fiancée begins to question everything—especially when he meets two strangers with her exact face.
One enters his home. One roams the streets. Both hold clues to a buried truth. A thrilling tale of love, deception, and dark secrets where every identity hides a twist.

chhoti-si-ladki-tycoon-mamaon-ki-rani.title: Masoom Ka Badla
chhoti-si-ladki-tycoon-mamaon-ki-rani.description: Chhoti Si Ladki, Tycoon Mamaon Ki Rani is a dramatic romantic saga about innocence, power, and destiny. A poor, small-town girl unexpectedly enters the world of her ruthless billionaire uncles, who try to control her life and wealth. But as she learns to fight back with courage and heart, she transforms from a vulnerable girl into the queen of their empire—while finding love in the most unlikely place.

this-girl-is-a-martial-master-3.title: This Girl Is a Martial Master
this-girl-is-a-martial-master-3.description:
A fearless young woman turns her martial arts training into a weapon of vengeance. Driven to protect her family, she takes on enemies with relentless force.
A powerful tale of courage, revenge, and a warrior who stops at nothing to make things right.

no-time-for-caution.title: Ultimate Game of Love
no-time-for-caution.description: In a world of greed, betrayal, and hidden identities, Natasha Nanda battles her stepsister Trisha and her manipulative father while secretly yearning for love from her bodyguard, Jai. Trapped in a web of lies, jealousy, and power struggles, Natasha is torn between sacrifice and survival. As truths unravel, dangerous rivalries push the family toward shocking consequences where love, revenge, and redemption collide. Watch now.

madam-your-ceo-husband-will-save-your-vi.title: Madam, Your CEO Husband Will Save Your Village
madam-your-ceo-husband-will-save-your-vi.description: He’s actually a powerful CEO—living in disguise as a security guard for reasons only he knows. Just as fate would have it, a bold young woman arrives to protect a village… and unknowingly, his heart. A heartwarming tale of secrets, destiny, and a romance that asks: will their bond lead to marriage?

women-can-hold-up-half-the-sky-2.title: Women Can Hold Up Half the Sky
women-can-hold-up-half-the-sky-2.description: Against cruel judgment and tradition, a brave young woman rises to reclaim her place and prove that daughters are no less. Her journey of strength and self-worth leads to healing old wounds—and a father’s heart. A stirring tale of empowerment, resilience, and the unshakable truth that women, too, hold up half the sky.

hidden-rockstar.title: Hidden Rockstar
hidden-rockstar.description: What happens when a broken artist returns stronger than ever? this is a gripping saga of passion, power, and payback, where hidden truths shake the very foundation of fame. Watch Now !

hand-behind-the-scene.title: HAND BEHIND THE SCENE
hand-behind-the-scene.description:
When his grandfather dies under mysterious circumstances, his world shatters. As secrets from the past begin to surface, he suspects his grandfather’s life was far from ordinary.
A haunting tale of legacy, mystery, and the dangerous truth that refuses to stay buried.

wafa-aur-watan.title: Wafa Aur Watan
wafa-aur-watan.description: The show “Wafa Aur Watan” follows a fearless fighter who takes on overwhelming odds single-handedly, battling enemies with unmatched courage and strength. Packed with action and raw determination, it tells the story of a lone warrior who refuses to back down, no matter how impossible the fight.

baby-making-on-divorce-day-1.title: Baby Making on Divorce Day
baby-making-on-divorce-day-1.description: Left heartbroken on her wedding day, a woman crosses paths with the man who once rejected her—now a CEO battling insomnia. Unaware of their shared past, fate draws them together again through an unexpected professional connection. A heartwarming and humorous journey of healing, rediscovery, and love that deserves a second chance.

cursed-by-love-3.title: Cursed By Love
cursed-by-love-3.description: Vaishnavi, a devoted woman, faces heartbreak when her husband betrays and abandons her. But beneath her sorrow lies a shocking truth she is a wealthy heir and a genius ready to reclaim her power. As she rises from humiliation, fate brings her to Vikranth Desai, a commanding CEO who treats her with unmatched devotion. Unlike her cruel past, he showers her with love and respect, standing by her side as she exposes enemies and seeks justice.

a-beam-of-light-in-the-darkness-mothers-.title: A Beam of Light in the Darkness Mother's Love
a-beam-of-light-in-the-darkness-mothers-.description:
A devoted mother refuses to bow to fate when her child’s life is at stake. Against all odds, she fights through heartbreak, sacrifice, and struggle.
A heartwarming tale of unconditional love, courage, and a mother’s unbreakable spirit.

back-to-1994-4.title: Back to 1994
back-to-1994-4.description: একটি গুলি। এক বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা। আর জেসন ঘুম ভেঙে দেখল, সে আছে ১৯৯৪ সালে। সবকিছু হারানোর আশঙ্কা আর একটিমাত্র সুযোগ — সব কিছু বদলে দেওয়ার। কিন্তু সে কি পারবে তাদের চেয়ে এক কদম এগিয়ে থাকতে, যারা তাকে মাটি চাপা দিয়েছিল? দেখতে  এই গল্পটি।

teen-patti-1.title: Teen Patti
teen-patti-1.description: A desperate wife, Priya, confesses to gambling away 50 lakhs, revealing she was a victim of a calculated fraud orchestrated by Mona and her accomplice. Her husband, Raj, fueled by a desire for justice and to protect his family, breaks a solemn vow against card games, leveraging a hidden family legacy of skill to enter the high-stakes world. Despite Priya's desperate warnings and their increasingly strained relationship, Raj embarks on a perilous quest to reclaim their fortune and expose the cheaters. He experiences initial success, even forming a partnership with Dona, but soon realizes his winning streak is a meticulously laid trap by his cunning opponents, including Mona, Jack, and Maya. Consumed by a severe gambling addiction, Raj risks his family's future and home in high-stakes card games, ignoring Priya's desperate pleas. His reckless behavior and manipulative tactics lead to confrontations with various opponents, who frequently accuse him of cheating. The conflict intensifies dramatically when Priya is kidnapped by Jack and used as leverage against Raj, forcing him into a deadly game where her freedom is at stake. Despite his past betrayals and flaws, including an intimate connection with Sam and past infidelity, Raj is fiercely determined to save Priya, vowing to turn the tables on his captors and rivals. Praveen orchestrates a scheme with Mona to expose Raj for cheating, and Mona reveals Priya's abduction as leverage, comparing Raj's pain to her own financial loss. Peter, encouraged by Priya, proposes an alliance with Mona to strategically defeat Raj. Raj, however, proves to be a charismatic gambler whose cunning and deception lead him through a series of intense poker games and power struggles. He faces accusations of cheating and personal ruin, all while Priya's fate hangs in the balance. Raj's rivalry with Jack escalates, culminating in a complex plot where Raj orchestrates Priya's freedom and seeks revenge. The narrative explores Raj's surprising moral compass as he delivers brutal retribution to Mona for cheating, only to entrust his illicit winnings to Priya, Mona's sister, for distribution to those in need. The ultimate outcome of the high-stakes standoff, where Raj's and Priya's safety are leveraged, remains uncertain.

the-return-of-the-heiress-discernment-of.title: The Return of the Heiress: Discernment of Pearls
the-return-of-the-heiress-discernment-of.description: একজন নববধূ পিতামহ, অন্যজন লু জুই—তারা লিন পরিবারের সম্পত্তি লুটে নিল বেকায়দা দূরবৃত্তের মতো। এখনই দেখুন The Return of the Heiress: Discernment of Pearls–এ বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা ও রাজনীতির উত্তেজনাপূর্ণ যাত্রা!

billion-dollar-wali-school.title: International School of Blunders
billion-dollar-wali-school.description: Trying to get admission for their son in the most elite school of Delhi, a billionaire's family is unknowingly insulted and bullied by the principal and rich parents of other spoilt students. What follows is a story of sweet revenge where elitism and nepotism are brought down and social justice is restored.

drop-alert-mr-nan.title: Drop Alert Mr. Nan
drop-alert-mr-nan.description: The microdrama centers on fashion designer Tang Jiao Bai, who is thrust into a world of corporate scandal and generational vendettas. Initially, she is publicly humiliated and forced into a strategic contract marriage with powerful CEO Nan Yiheng, a relationship fraught with personal history and corporate objectives. Tang Jiao Bai's professional life is relentlessly sabotaged by rivals and complicated by accusations of plagiarism, while she strives to prove her talent and integrity in a cutthroat design industry. Simultaneously, she uncovers deep-seated family secrets, including her own mother's career-ending controversy and a devastating warehouse fire that implicates the influential Nan family. A fierce corporate war erupts, with Jiang Chen, a manipulative rival and potential love interest, actively orchestrating the destruction of Mr. Nan's company through betrayal and aggressive poaching. Tang Jiao Bai finds herself caught in a complex love triangle, navigating her evolving feelings for Nan Yiheng and Jiang Chen, whose affections are often intertwined with corporate power plays. The core conflict stems from a bitter, generations-old feud between the Nan matriarch and Tang Jiao Bai's mother, both seeking revenge for past wrongs, stolen inheritances, and family tragedies. As the Nan family faces financial ruin and internal strife, Tang Jiao Bai fights to protect her grandmother and dismantle the empire, while also discovering she holds hidden shares. The escalating animosity leads to shocking revelations, desperate measures, and personal betrayals, culminating in a strategic truce and another contract marriage, hinting at the enduring complexities of power, love, and revenge.

the-arrival-of-the-young-lady-1.title: The Arrival of the Young Lady
the-arrival-of-the-young-lady-1.description: Rosie stands at the center of a long-running family and power struggle that keeps widening from private secrets into public conflict. Early on, an urgent search for a missing child and a major financial loss hints that the family’s troubles are tied to deeper hidden history. Rosie’s discovery of a hidden room, inherited clues, and a ring pushes her closer to the truth about her place in the Jonas family. At the same time, a missing young woman, a suspicious fire, and talk of deliberate wrongdoing show that the family’s past is still actively shaping the present. Jack remains tied to Rosie through romance and conflict, but their bond is repeatedly strained by mistrust, public pressure, and competing claims about identity and loyalty. Across the story, elders and family leaders try to restore order, yet their efforts are complicated by grief, secrecy, and shifting authority. Rosie is repeatedly praised for her intelligence and instincts, but she is also challenged over whether she truly belongs and whether her identity is being accepted or fabricated. The drama expands beyond the family into business disputes, stock battles, and territorial fights over streets, buildings, and valuable assets. A ring becomes a recurring symbol of legitimacy, linking Rosie to lost family ties and to larger questions of inheritance. Several characters are forced to confront hidden losses, including money lost in stock deals and older incidents that may have caused later financial crashes. Public confrontations become more intense as Rosie is humiliated, accused, and pressured to accept roles others choose for her. She resists proposals, rejects forced marriage, and refuses to let tradition or business strategy decide her future. Allies such as Remo, Elena, and other supportive figures help her endure the pressure, even when the truth remains unstable. The story also brings in communal and organizational conflict, with women-led resistance, street fights, and challenges to abusive men. As the stakes rise, old loyalties and family honor collide with modern power struggles over markets, property, and leadership. By the later stretch, the conflict turns darker, with kidnapping, captivity, and violence exposing how far the hidden plots have spread. Rosie continues to oppose manipulation and expose wrongdoing, even as rivals try to control her identity, inheritance, and future. The arc culminates in a major shift of power, with Rosie emerging as a stronger leader who can challenge entrenched families and push reforms.

toxic-rich-baby.title: Lady Nova
toxic-rich-baby.description: Toxic Rich Baby follows Ojal Mehra, a woman betrayed by her husband Arnav, mocked by his brother Rutvik, and humiliated by the powerful Ranjit and cunning Avani. But beneath her scars lies the secret identity of Lady Nova Vale a fearless warrior with power, dignity, and unbreakable spirit. With the loyal Jai by her side and the mysterious Vikram reentering her life, Ojal rises from heartbreak to reclaim her inheritance, her honor, and her destiny.

women-can-hold-up-half-the-sky-3.title: Women Can Hold Up Half The Sky
women-can-hold-up-half-the-sky-3.description:
এক এগিয়ে যাওয়া নারী। ছোটবেলায় তাকে আর তার মাকে বাড়ি থেকে তাড়িয়ে দেওয়া হয় শুধুমাত্র সে মেয়ে বলে। সে তার মায়ের সঙ্গে  মামার বাড়িতে বড় হতে থাকে। এবং উচ্চ শিক্ষা লাভ করে ফিরে আসে তাদেরই কোম্পানির চেয়ারম্যান হয়ে। ওদিকে তার বাবা ,সৎ মা ও সৎ ভাইকে নিয়ে সুখে স্বাচ্ছন্দে বসবাস করতে থাকে। তার বাবা সৎ মা ও সৎ ভাই এবং বাকি পরিবার এটা মেনে নেয় না। অনেক সংঘর্ষ করতে হয় তাকে এই চেয়ারম্যান হয়ে থাকার জন্য। 
শেষ পর্যন্ত কি তার বাবার পরিবার তাকে গ্রহণ করবে  চেয়ারম্যান হিসেবে ? তার বাবা কি তাকে মেয়ে হিসেবে মেনে নেবে?

billionaire-bete.title: Ba****d Billionaire
billionaire-bete.description: Raj, a wealthy CEO, initially finds unexpected joy and love with a humble tea stall owner, Geet, leading him to embrace a simpler existence. This happiness is shattered when he is revealed as the adopted son of the powerful Chaudhary empire, facing discrimination and a fierce battle for his inheritance against his biological brother, Sameer Chaudhary. His adoptive father, Yuvnath Chaudhary, disowns Raj for his forbidden love with Geet, publicly shaming him and attempting to force a lucrative marriage. Raj rejects this, is banished, and his caretaker hints at a hidden truth about his origins, while Yuvnath orchestrates the destruction of Geet's business and attacks her father, fueling Geet's vow for revenge. Later, Raj declares his love for Anushka, leading to further disownment, banishment, and immense debt from patriarchs like Yuvraj, Shivnath, and Umesh Chaudhary. Raj and Anushka are cast out, facing severe financial hardship and eviction, prompting Anushka to vow revenge as Raj embarks on a daunting journey to rebuild their lives. Tragedy strikes when a heavily pregnant Anushka is electrocuted, critically endangering her and their unborn child, forcing Raj into a desperate race for funds. Concurrently, Raj's past resurfaces with Rima, a former love, and his estranged family, facing corporate collapse, desperately seeks his return. Raj's younger brother, Karan (Sam Malhotra), infiltrates Raj's current life with his wife Radha, hoping to reconcile, but Raj, hardened by past betrayals, reacts violently to any mention of family. This culminates in a furious confrontation between Raj and Sameer Choudhary, exposing deep-seated deceit and severing their already fractured bond. Raj is reluctantly drawn back into the crumbling Chaudhary empire, facing a hostile takeover by Kavita, a scorned heiress, who exposes massive embezzlement. Despite saving Yuvnath's life, Raj faces his father's unwavering disdain, is forced to work as a mere employee, and is demoted to a servant with his wife, Sunanda, and son upon returning to their ancestral estate. Raj and his family endure relentless degradation, prompting Sunanda to reveal the shocking truth that Raj is Vayumnath's biological son, not adopted. This revelation is complicated by a caretaker's confession about Vayumnath's past affair and a mysterious woman's demand for a DNA test, all while Kavita schemes to use Raj's paternity to seize the family's assets. A public DNA test further questions Raj Chaudhary's legitimacy, sparking a corporate power struggle for his father's company, now owned by a vengeful heiress, who attempts to dismantle Raj's marriage to Anushka. Amidst these external threats, Raj reconciles with his estranged father, and a plan is devised to save the Chaudhary Group from a hostile takeover. The series culminates as Radha's attempted corporate takeover is thwarted by Raj's secret ownership, and Prateek masterfully exposes Kavita and Sanjay as the true architects of the fraud, bringing their treachery to light and ensuring justice.

dragon-arm.title: Dragon Arm
dragon-arm.description: "ড্রাগন আর্ম"  এমন একটি সিরিজ ,যেখানে দেখানো হয়েছে ,শক্তিশালী  প্রাচীন অস্ত্র এবং প্রাচীন অনেক শিল্পকর্ম  ,যেসব  ড্রাগনের মতো শক্তির সাথে সংযুক্ত।  এই অস্ত্রগুলির উৎপত্তি এবং  ড্রাগনের প্রভাব দ্বারা ,এই বিশ্ব ব্রহ্মান্ড কতটা কলুষিত ; তার  ভয়াবহতাও নিয়েও,এই গল্পটি বিরাট  দৃষ্টান্ত স্থাপন করেছে।

her-love-my-victory.title: Her Love, My Victory
her-love-my-victory.description: Abhi, gravely injured and betrayed by her ex-lover Aadhi, dies after he denies her life-saving treatment and she transfers her company to him. Miraculously, she is sent eight years back in time, armed with foreknowledge of her tragic past and now an heiress. She embarks on a calculated revenge against Aadhi and his manipulative fiancée Rakshita, asserting her dominance and reclaiming her power. Abhi also re-evaluates her past choices, realizing she foolishly rejected a pre-arranged marriage with the "gem" Mithun, and seeks a second chance with him, sparking a new love triangle. The conflict escalates as Abhi, now a powerful heiress, publicly humiliates Aadhi and his father, exposing his past financial exploitation and asserting her true identity. Aadhi, shamed, vows retribution. Amidst this, Abhi undergoes a profound academic transformation, defying expectations by excelling in exams despite being accused of cheating, and dramatically vindicating herself. She receives a dire warning from her future self about Aadhi causing her father's death and seizing their fortune. Fueled by past grievances, Abhi orchestrates further public humiliation for her rivals, while Aadhi faces severe financial distress, betrayal, and a brutal assault. Abhi volunteers to "rescue" Aadhi, but her true intent is to inflict retribution for his past betrayal, all while finding solace and a burgeoning romance with Mithun. Her rise to student representative is met with public accusations of foul play and transactional sex, leading to widespread shaming. However, her father, Chairman Sundara Rajagopalan, dramatically intervenes, revealing himself as the man in the scandalous photo and defending his daughter's honor. The series culminates with Mithun, revealed to be far wealthier than perceived, proposing to Abhi, solidifying their fated connection.

the-substitute-sister.title: The Substitute Sister
the-substitute-sister.description: The Substitute Sister is a gripping family drama of betrayal, sacrifice, and forbidden love. When poor and innocent Anaya is forced to replace her wealthy twin sister Shanaya in a powerful marriage, she becomes trapped in a web of lies, greed, and emotional torture. But as she starts falling for Ishaan—the husband meant for Shanaya—truths unravel, loyalties shift, and destiny tests the limits of blood, love, and survival.

empire-1.title: Empire
empire-1.description: The microdrama begins with Ajay's hostile corporate takeover, leaving Dharma and his daughter Satya devastated and stripped of their business. Satya quickly rises as a formidable Vice President, asserting her authority through strategic hires and firings, only to face an unexpected challenge when employee Arav is mysteriously declared the majority owner by a 'Royal Mail' decree. This ignites an intense battle for control, marked by accusations of forged documents, violent confrontations, and shifting alliances involving figures like Pratap and Pradeep. As the corporate war escalates, Satya is ousted from leadership by her former ally Kalyan, who aligned with a powerful 'Royal Head,' prompting Satya to plot her retribution. Concurrently, Arav, now revealed as a strategic mastermind with combat skills and an enigmatic past, leverages a 'royal letter' and the backing of the 'Royal Head' to challenge authority and orchestrate corporate purges. The narrative deepens with the resurfacing of long-buried secrets, including a twenty-year mystery, a long-lost son, and controversial fortune transfers, blurring the lines between corporate warfare and familial bonds. Aarav, fighting to maintain control of his empire, faces challenges to dissolve the board but reveals his unshakeable 51% stake and the 'Royal Head's' backing. Ultimately, a determined woman declares Aarav the rightful heir to a powerful entity, leading to a DNA test and the shocking revelation that a visionary CEO is Aarav's true father, a truth concealed by his mother to protect him from power's corrupting influence. Despite Sathya's betrayal, stealing Aarav's groundbreaking idea for her corporate ascent, a hint of mutual affection remains, with Aarav even offering his cure formula for her redemption, suggesting a complex interplay of revenge and potential reconciliation amidst the quest for belonging and justice.

she-was-always-pure.title: Betrayed Heiress
she-was-always-pure.description: Sakshi, who sacrificed everything for love, faces betrayal from her husband Vansh and his family. Humiliated and deceived, she rises with courage, reveals her true identity as the heir of SB Group, and reclaims her dignity and power.

madam-dont-run-4.title: Madam, Don't Run!
madam-dont-run-4.description: Disgraced heiress Yamini returns to her opulent family after five years with a child, only to be publicly shamed and banished by her cousin Yashna and the matriarch, Thatha, for a scandalous past. Her company faces collapse amidst corporate espionage and personal vendettas. Powerful CEO Arun Raj emerges, initially seeking revenge but also revealing a hidden past connection with Yamini and intervening to protect her. A child's injury dramatically reunites them, leading to Arun's shocking paternity claim over Yamini's daughter, Naira. A DNA test confirms Arun as Naira's father, prompting him to fiercely defend Yamini and Naira against family judgment and societal stigma, publicly declaring Yamini his wife and Naira his rightful heir. This declaration ignites intense family conflicts and a corporate war against the Yan family. The Yan Corp becomes embroiled in a bitter family feud as Yamini confronts Yeshna, who unjustly seized control, leading to Yeshna's public humiliation and expulsion by the matriarch. Simultaneously, Arun battles another heiress, Quincie/Ken, for control of her family's company, while Quincie seeks to reclaim her past relationship with him. Yeshna's dangerous obsession with Arun escalates, as she orchestrates sinister plots to drug, frame, and kidnap Yamini to sabotage her engagement. Yamini's own forbidden love with Vikram is exposed, leading to her father's furious disapproval. Amidst these betrayals, Yamini is kidnapped by her jilted ex-fiancé, Mr. Lee, and further betrayed by Yalan, who hands her over to Prashanth, leaving her in a terrifying predicament. Arun Raj is then presumed dead in a plane crash, leaving his company vulnerable to a hostile takeover. Yamini, now his wife, must fight to prevent this, vowing to protect Arun's legacy and reclaim her own family's. However, Arun dramatically returns, thwarting his manipulative Uncle's hostile takeover of Few Corp. He exposes his Uncle's orchestration of the plane crash and a deep-seated corporate espionage plot, leading to the Uncle's confession and arrest. Arun also clears Ken's reputation and publicly commits to helping her, while reaffirming his unwavering bond with Yamini and planning their formal union, despite lingering threats and intrigues.

qingyi-legend.title: Qingyi legend
qingyi-legend.description: A young man sets out to lay his father’s ashes at the ancestral grave, but destiny pulls him into a storm of secrets and betrayal. Along the way, he meets a fierce girl whose father was branded a traitor. As truth unfolds, a ruthless martial artist rises to seize Qingi. Bound by love, honor, and legacy, the young warrior must face his greatest trial — to protect his people and accept his destiny as the next clan leader.

my-cold-blooded-alpha-king-5.title: My Cold Blooded Alpha King
my-cold-blooded-alpha-king-5.description: The cold blooded alpha king Logan meets the naturally alluring she-wolf Anya. But Logan, with his solitary nature, resists letting Aniya get close. The forbidden love between beauty and beast breeds desire amid reluctance, as both sides gradually fall into the depths of destined love. Watch "My Cold Blooded Alpha King" now!

a-deal-signed-in-love-4.title: A Deal Signed in Love
a-deal-signed-in-love-4.description: Diya is not an ordinary girl. But her sister, wanting to keep her normal, ruined her marriage. For the sake of property, Diya made a big decision. What was it? Find out in "A Deal Signed in Love", only on your Kuku TV.

flash-marriage-to-the-presidentmrs-gu-is.title: Flash Marriage to the President：Mrs. Gu is Actually a Hidden Tycoon
flash-marriage-to-the-presidentmrs-gu-is.description: হঠাৎ বিয়ে প্রেসিডেন্টের সাথে: গু-ম্যাডাম আসলে এক গোপন ধনকুবের!

three-lives-ring-4.title: Three Lives Ring
three-lives-ring-4.description:
"তিন জীবনের আংটি" একটি কল্পকাহিনি-ভিত্তিক রোমান্টিক নাটক, যেখানে একটি রহস্যময় আংটি তিন প্রেমিক-প্রেমিকার ভাগ্যকে তিনটি জন্মজুড়ে একসূত্রে বেঁধে রাখে। অতীতের ক্ষোভ ও গোপন সত্য একে একে উন্মোচিত হলে, প্রতিটি পুনর্জন্মে ভালোবাসা, বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা এবং নিয়তির মুখোমুখি হয় তারা।

চাইলে এটাকে আরও কাব্যিক বা নাটকীয়ভাবে রূপান্তর করা যায় – আপনি কী ধরনের টোন পছন্দ করছেন?

single-mothers-counterattack-with-adorab.title: Single Mother's Counterattack with Adorable Twins
single-mothers-counterattack-with-adorab.description:
নিজের বোনের ছলনায় এক রাতের সম্পর্কে জড়িয়ে পড়ে এক তরুণী। সেই সম্পর্কের পরিণতিতে সে গর্ভবতী হয়ে পড়ে, এবং সমাজের চাপে ও পারিবারিক অপমানের মুখে তাকে বাড়ি থেকে তাড়িয়ে দেওয়া হয়। সাত বছর পর, তার প্রাণবন্ত যমজ সন্তানরা—যারা এখনো জানে না তাদের জন্মের পেছনের যন্ত্রণাদায়ক গল্প—একটি মিশনে নামে: তারা নিজেদের মা-বাবাকে একসাথে ফেরাতে চায়।
মা যখন সেই পুরোনো দুঃসহ স্মৃতিগুলোর মুখোমুখি হন, যখন আবারও সামনে আসে সেই ছলনা, অপমান ও ভাগ্যের নির্মমতা—তখন তাকে সাহস নিয়ে লড়াই করতে হয়।
ভালোবাসা, সম্মান আর সন্তানদের জন্য এক নিরাপদ ভবিষ্যৎ—এই তিনটি ফিরে পেতে সে শুরু করে জীবনের সবচেয়ে বড় সংগ্রাম।

pyaar-ka-pastry.title: Secret Billionaire Delivery Lover
pyaar-ka-pastry.description: A billionaire tycoon disguises himself as a delivery boy to find Kavya, the girl who once gave him hope. Kavya, an aspiring singer trapped in a toxic household, struggles to hold on to her dreams while the world pushes her down. As emotions grow and lives intertwine, secrets, power, and love clash in ways that will test them both. A gripping tale of hidden identity, ambition, and passion that will keep you hooked till the very end.

hidden-love-surges-7.title: Hidden Love Surges
hidden-love-surges-7.description: A young woman learns the man she deeply loved is about to marry someone else. Unable to bear the pain, she decides to express the love she never dared to reveal one last time. Overcoming her fears, she reaches his wedding, unshaken. As the auspicious instruments play and the hall buzzes with celebration, she stands before him and pours out the love buried deep in her heart. This is her final attempt… a last journey to touch his heart, to reclaim her love.

ceo-ki-chhupi-shaadi.title: CEO Ki Chhupi Shaadi
ceo-ki-chhupi-shaadi.description: When powerful CEO Shaurya Singh secretly marries the spirited Ananya, their hidden bond sparks a storm of love, betrayal, and boardroom battles—testing loyalty, ambition, and the true meaning of partnership.

the-shalini-show-wanitha-ashok-jothe.title: The Shalini Show - Wanitha Ashok Jothe
the-shalini-show-wanitha-ashok-jothe.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರು ಕನಸು. ತಾವು ಇಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸ್ಬೇಕು, ನೇಮು-ಫೇಮು ಗಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋರು ಕೆಲವೇ ಮಂದಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ಇಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಅವರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಪಾಠ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಾಧಕರ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ‌.. The Shalini Show..! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರು ಆ್ಯಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. Watch Now!!

the-mysterious-master-chef-5.title: The Mysterious Master Chef
the-mysterious-master-chef-5.description: Rohan, who has been passionate about cooking since childhood, dreams of becoming a great chef despite growing up in poverty. He believes all he needs is a chance to showcase his talent. An unexpected twist enters his life with the Royal Hotel. Will Master Chef Anirudh, who works there, be in a position to give Rohan a chance? Who will emerge as the winner in this game among the chefs?

billionaire-ki-legacy-meri-kokh-se-shuru.title: Secret Raat
billionaire-ki-legacy-meri-kokh-se-shuru.description: In Billionaire Ki Legacy, Meri Kokh Se Shuru Hui, the fate of the powerful Mehta Empire rests on unexpected shoulders. Anaya, a simple yet determined woman, finds herself entangled in the lives of Samar Mehta, the heir to a vast fortune, Kabir, her past love with disruptive ambitions, and Sonia, the cunning rival who will stop at nothing for power. As secrets, betrayal, and love collide, Anaya’s womb becomes the beginning of a legacy that could redefine the empire’s future. Watch Now!

the-mistaken-girl-4.title: The Mistaken Girl
the-mistaken-girl-4.description: This is a story centered around an impulsive and passionate young woman, whose fierce determination to get what she wants often lands her in trouble. Her rash decisions and the misunderstandings they lead to create chaos, turning the narrative into an emotional roller coaster. A lighthearted tale woven with humor, drama, and emotions, offering both entertainment and heartfelt moments.

price-of-love-3.title: Price of Love
price-of-love-3.description: A raw, emotional journey of two souls torn apart by secrets, betrayal, and ambition, only to collide years later with scars, unspoken truths, and a love tested by hidden sacrifices, a fragile child, and financial ruin. As passion reignites, destiny dares to heal what pride and pain once destroyed—but will love survive the cost?”

miss-gu-dont-let-me-go-1.title: Miss Gu Don't Let Me Go
miss-gu-dont-let-me-go-1.description: সে জানতে পারে তার পেটের ক্যানসার হয়েছে। আর মাত্র তিন মাস বেঁচে থাকতে পারে। তখনই সে সিদ্ধান্ত নেয়, বাকি সময়টা আনন্দের সাথে এবং অত্যন্ত স্বাধীনভাবে কাটাবে। ঠিক তখনই তার প্রাক্তন স্বামী ফিরে আসে এবং সবকিছু বদলে যেতে শুরু করে। জীবনের এই নতুন মোড়ে এসে সে কি সুখ খুঁজে পাবে? আনন্দে সে কি মৃত্যুকে হার মানাতে পারবে?

flashback-fiancee-have-we-met-6.title: Flashback Fiancée: Have We Met?
flashback-fiancee-have-we-met-6.description: The show centers on a web of romance, debt, identity confusion, and family power struggles that repeatedly turn private feelings into public crises. Across the story, women are often trapped between wealthy men, family expectations, and humiliating social exposure, while they struggle to keep their dignity and make their own choices. Leanne/Lian and Lily are both tied to hidden or recovered identities, and the question of who is truly who drives much of the emotional tension. Alex stands at the center of the romance thread, sometimes controlling, sometimes protective, but consistently linked to the women through promises, marriage pressure, and unresolved memory. Early conflicts revolve around debt, contracts, and status, with money used as leverage in relationships and public scenes designed to shame or control. Family members and patriarchs repeatedly push arranged or strategic marriages, while the women resist being treated as property or bargaining chips. The missing or absent Lily becomes a recurring emotional anchor, shaping love triangles, family guilt, and the fear that the wrong person may be chosen or replaced. Public humiliation is a constant threat, whether through hotel confrontations, livestream scandals, auditions, or staged spectacles that expose private arrangements. Several characters are accused of kidnapping, tampering with reports, or hiding the truth, and these accusations deepen the sense that the family history has been manipulated. DNA reports, missing parents, and mistaken identities suggest that the central mystery is not only romantic but also rooted in long-buried family secrets. As the story progresses, Alex increasingly acts as a protector, especially when danger, traps, or false reports threaten the women he cares about. At the same time, the women are not passive; they push back against control, defend their reputations, and demand real work, real respect, or real answers. Corporate settings add another layer of conflict, where jobs, company image, and authority become entangled with romance and betrayal. Roger remains a destabilizing figure, tied to contracts, suspicion, and shifting loyalties that keep the workplace and love life unstable. The emotional core repeatedly returns to reunion and separation, with childhood promises, memory recovery, and vows of marriage offering hope amid chaos. Yet every step toward commitment is shadowed by outside pressure, jealousy, and the possibility that the past has not been fully uncovered. By the end of the batch digests, several bonds are affirmed, but the wider network of lies, substitutions, and family conflict remains unresolved.

bend-the-waist-3.title: Bend the waist
bend-the-waist-3.description: Priyanka, a resilient yet shy student, repeatedly crosses paths with the enigmatic and wealthy Ajay, who initially defends her from bullying. Their connection is complicated by Ajay's aloofness, his forgotten past as her childhood friend, and a significant social disparity. As Priyanka grapples with growing feelings, a man from her past, Karthik, resurfaces with a mysterious photograph, while other rivals like Woman 1 and Kiran, who possesses unexpected magical powers, emerge. Despite warnings about Ajay's playboy reputation, Priyanka is drawn to his unexpected kindness, leading to a tumultuous romance marked by thoughtful gestures and escalating conflicts. Their relationship faces challenges from past secrets, misunderstandings, and the re-emergence of Ajay's past connections like Stella and Meera, alongside new admirers for Priyanka such as Naresh and Sunil. A terrifying turn occurs when Ajay falls gravely ill, manifesting aggressive behavior and electronic glitches, hinting at a supernatural element, while multiple women, including Divya, Radha, and Meera, care for him. Priyanka's world is further entangled by Daniel, a dangerous figure from her past who bullies her and later ambushes her, fueling Ajay's protective instincts. Stella publicly proposes to Ajay, causing Priyanka heartbreak and suspicion, yet Ajay passionately denies it and heroically rescues Priyanka from Daniel's attacks, vowing justice. Simultaneously, Ajay is plunged into a high-stakes family battle for his inheritance against his pregnant aunt, Chithi, forcing him to adopt a ruthless persona. Despite Priyanka's insecurities about their social class divide, Ajay reaffirms his profound love, solidifying their intense bond amidst these external threats and family drama. Their romance becomes a public sensation, amplified by social media, but is tested by Priyanka's hidden secrets, including a three-month agreement and a concealed identity for Ajay. Renugand, Priyanka's ambitious friend, discovers her long-standing romance with Ajay, feeling betrayed by the secrecy. Ajay, through manipulative charm and public declarations, pursues Priyanka intensely, eventually introducing her to his loving grandparents who bless their union. A devastating car crash and Priyanka's unexplained fear during dates hint at deeper vulnerabilities. Ultimately, an arranged marriage, sanctioned by Priyanka's ailing uncle, blossoms into a deeply romantic union when Ajay discovers Priyanka's long-held secret crush on him through a resurfaced high school love letter. Despite a tense confrontation over hidden truths and Priyanka's fear of rejection, their love is reciprocated, with Ajay helping her confront past loss and proposing marriage, which she joyfully accepts, embracing a future transformed by true love and resilience.

security-dad-stands-out-from-the-crowd.title: Security dad stands out from the crowd
security-dad-stands-out-from-the-crowd.description: Security dad stands out from the crowd.

substitute-bride.title: Substitute Bride
substitute-bride.description: একজন চঞ্চল মেয়ে তার সৎমায়ের আদেশে গ্রামের বাড়িতে পাঠানো হয়। সেখানে গিয়ে সে গোপনে রহস্যময় বিদ্যার চর্চা শেখে। তবে একদিন দুষ্টুমিতে গুরু রুষ্ট হয়ে তাকে আশ্রম থেকে বের করে দেন। ফিরে আসার পথে, সে এক ছেলেকে দুর্ঘটনা থেকে বাঁচায়—আর তখনই জানতে পারে, এই ছেলেটাই তার বিয়ের জন্য ঠিক করা পাত্র, যার জন্য তার বাবা-মা ১০০ কোটি টাকা নিয়েছেন। মেয়ে বিয়েতে রাজি হয়, যদিও তার ব্যবহার বেশ ছটফটে ও অদ্ভুত। তবুও ছেলেটি তাকে প্রত্যাখ্যান করে না। কিন্তু তার মনে এক অদ্ভুত প্রশ্ন খেলা করতে থাকে

from-zero-to-hero-breaking-the-chains-of.title: From Zero to Hero: Breaking the Chains of Fate
from-zero-to-hero-breaking-the-chains-of.description: দারিদ্র্যতার সঙ্গে কঠিন লড়াই চালিয়ে যেতে হচ্ছে নায়ককে। সেই সঙ্গে তার মা অসুস্থ, শয্যাশায়ী। পরিবারকে সাহায্য করার জন্য নিজের স্বপ্নকে জলাঞ্জলি দিতে হয় তাকে। অসামান্য প্রতিভার অধিকারী সেই ছেলেটি দেশের অন্যতম নামজাদা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে পড়াশোনা করার সুযোগ পায়। আর তখনই সে জীবনটাকে অন্যভাবে উপভোগ করতে থাকে।

the-daughter-of-a-secret-tycoon-1.title: The Daughter of a Secret Tycoon
the-daughter-of-a-secret-tycoon-1.description: A girl lived a quiet life—until a scandal forced her into the spotlight and the arms of powerful CEO. But when secrets about her true identity surface, everything changes. Daughter Of The Secret Tycoon is a tale of hidden legacies, unexpected romance, and a girl who went from overlooked to unstoppable. Watch Now!

siddha-secrets-the-6-body-parts.title: Siddha Secrets: 6 Body Parts That Reveal Hidden Diseases
siddha-secrets-the-6-body-parts.description: Ungaloda Noi arigurigala kaattum 6 Body Parts pathi therinjukonga.

en-kanavan-en-thozhan.title: En Kanavan... En Thozhan...
en-kanavan-en-thozhan.description: நிவேதிதாவுக்கு நேத்து ராத்திரி என்ன நடந்துச்சி, எப்படி நடந்துச்சின்னு எதுவுமே ஞாபகம் இல்ல. அந்த ரூம்கு எப்படி போனான்னும் தெரியல. எந்த பொண்ணும் இழக்கக் கூடாதத, முன்னபின்ன தெரியாதவன் கூட இழந்துருந்தா. நிவேதிதா இந்த ட்ராஜெடிலேருந்து எப்படி தப்பிக்கப் போறா?

game-of-god.title: Game of G.O.D
game-of-god.description: Aaj se ek hazaar saal baad Prithvi tabaah hone ki wajah se Dhruv ko ek space research center par janm lena pada. Jo insaani nasl ka aakhri waaris hai. Kya space mein tanha zindagi jee raha Dhruv, manavta ka wajood brahmand mein zinda rakh payega? ya G.O.D ki baat sunkar khud hi mar jayega? kaun hai ye G.O.D? Dost ya Dushman? Jaanne ke liye, suniye... Game Of G.O.D

my-psycho-lover-1.title: My Psycho Lover
my-psycho-lover-1.description: சந்தியா நர்ஸா வேலை பார்க்கற ஹாஸ்பிடலுக்கு அவன் சிகிச்சை பெற வந்தான்.  அவன் ஹாஸ்பிடல்ல இருந்த வரைக்கும் சந்தியாவ அப்யூஸ் செஞ்சி டார்ச்சர் செஞ்சான்.  அந்த நாட்கள சந்தியாவால மறக்கவே முடியாது. திடீர்னு அவன் அவளோட வாழ்க்கைலேருந்து காணாம போய்ட்டான். ஆறு ஆண்டுகளுக்கு பிறகு சந்தியா போலீஸ் அதிகாரியா வர்ரா. அப்போ அவ அந்த மோசமானவன சந்திச்சா என்ன நடக்கும்???

4aa9ca33-2f40-4ae9-a7a0-1cecc0c50172.title: Don 1983
4aa9ca33-2f40-4ae9-a7a0-1cecc0c50172.description: Raghav apni zindagi se haar chuka tha, lekin ek raat galti se time travel karke 40 saal pichhe chala gaya. Wahaan uska samna apne hi naam aur shakal wale ladke se hota hai, jo Mumbai ke ek gang ka hissa tha. Kya Raghav bhi banega ek futuristic gangster? Kya woh kabhi apne waqt me wapas laut payega, ya kisi ka pyar use hamesha ke liye qaid kar lega?

the-last-odyssey.title: The Last Odyssey
the-last-odyssey.description:
Prepare for "The Last Odyssey,"- a bone-chilling voyage into terror that'll make you think twice about your next vacation. When a deadly virus turns a luxury cruise into a floating nightmare, survival becomes a blood sport.

Noah, a lowly sweeper, and Lily, a dancer with a dark past, are thrust into a hellish battle against hordes of infected passengers. But in this nightmare at sea, the undead are just the tip of the iceberg. As they navigate dark corridors and deadly secrets, they'll face heart-stopping terror, gut-wrenching betrayals, and mind-bending conspiracies that stretch far beyond the horizon.
Will they uncover the truth or become another grisly headline? Where paradise becomes purgatory, and your worst nightmares are just the beginning.

train-your-brain.title: Train your brain
train-your-brain.description: ഓർമ്മശക്തി മെച്ചപ്പെടുത്താനും,  നിങ്ങളുടെ ബ്രെയിൻ എപ്പോഴും ആക്റ്റീവ് ആക്കാനും, പഠനത്തിലും ജോലിയിലും ദൈനംദിന ജീവിതത്തിലും മികവ് കാണാനും നിങ്ങൾ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നുണ്ടോ? "Train Your Brain" എന്ന ഈ പുസ്തകം നിങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതാണ്!

महाकवि-कालिदास-1.title: महाकवि कालिदास
महाकवि-कालिदास-1.description: Kya aap jaanna chahte hain Bharat ke mahaan kavi Kalidasa ki zindagi ki kahani? Agar haan, toh zaroor suniye ye show. Unke jeevan ke ankahe qisson aur rachnaon se jud kar aap prachin Bharat ke adbhut yug ko phir se jee sakte hain.

the-master-of-truthstone.title: The Master of Truthstone
the-master-of-truthstone.description:
Her guardian, her love: a romance that defies the boundaries of existence.

When Grace Chen receives a mysterious jade pendant, her world plunges into supernatural chaos. This Truthstone reveals hidden intentions and bends wills, but at what cost? As dark forces close in, Grace must master her newfound powers while unraveling the secret behind her enigmatic guardian angel's devotion. Dive into "The Master of Truthstone" on KukuFM. Will Grace's power unlock her destiny, or doom two realms to darkness?

Craving more? Leave a comment! Your feedback fuels the mystical forces shaping Grace's journey.

secrets-of-millbrook-high.title: Secrets of Millbrook High
secrets-of-millbrook-high.description: In the small town of Millbrook, the drowning of high school star athlete Jake Thompson in the school's swimming pool shatters the community's tranquil facade. As Detective Sarah Reeves investigates, she uncovers a web of secrets, lies, and hidden rivalries. With students receiving mysterious blackmail threats and evidence they try to conceal, Sarah must navigate treacherous waters to uncover the truth. But in a town where everyone has something to hide, the search for answers threatens to expose long-buried secrets that could destroy lives and tear Millbrook apart.

rakt-raatri.title: Rakt Raatri
rakt-raatri.description: Jab Hasnain ko achanak naukri se nikaal diya jaata hai, toh uske upar apne parivaar ko sambhaalne ki chinta usey ek tantrik baba ki or le jaata hain jahan. Baba ki sandehjanak kriyaein uski kismat mein chaar chaand laga dete hain jiske chalte Hasnain andhvishwaas mein leen ho jaata hai. Par ye latt ek khoonkaar roop lene lagti hai jab wo apni soojh boojh bhoolkar yakin karne lagta hai ki ek kriya se jannat naseeb ho sakta hai.

love-to-hate-you.title: Love to Hate you...
love-to-hate-you.description: இனியாளுக்கு அவளோட அழகுதான் சாபம். தற்செயலா அவ ஆதியோட வாழ்க்கைல அடியெடுத்து வச்சது முதல், அவளோட வாழ்க்கையே தலைகீழா மாற ஆரம்பிச்சது. கோடீஸ்வரன் ஆதியோட காதலியா இருக்கறது இனியாளுக்கு வரமா இல்ல சாபமா?

Aakasamlo-Sagam--ఆకాశంలో-సగం.title: ఆకాశంలో సగం
Aakasamlo-Sagam--ఆకాశంలో-సగం.description: ఈ నవలకి " ఉదయం"వారపత్రిక 1990 నవలలో పోటీలో ప్రథమ బహుమతి లభించింది. "ఆకాశంలో సగం" ఈ కథ మీరు విన్న క్షణం నుంచి మీ సంతోషంలో సగం అవుతుంది. దయచేసి మీరు మీ కాలాన్ని ఖర్చుపెట్టి ఒక అందమైన జ్ఞాపకంగా ఈ కథ ద్వారా మార్చగలరు అని ఆసిస్తూ ఈ audiobook ని అందిస్తున్నాము.

magic-war.title: Magic War
magic-war.description: Naasik ke ek sadharan se magic school mein padhne waali aabha ki life le leti hai ek unexpected mod jab use pata chalta hai apne future ka sach. Aakhir future ein aisa kya hone wala hai Aabha ke saath jaanane ke liye suniye poori kahani sirf KUKU FM par.
