maranam-pathiyirikunna-thazvara.title: മരണം പതിയിരിക്കുന്ന താഴ്‌വര
maranam-pathiyirikunna-thazvara.description: കോടമഞ്ഞിന്റെ തണുപ്പിൽ ഡിറ്റക്റ്റീവ് പുഷ്പരാജ് നായകനായെത്തുന്ന ഒരു ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലെർ.  കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥ് എന്ന അതുല്യ കഥാകൃത്തിന്റെ തൂലികയിൽ നിന്നും പിറന്ന ആവേശോജ്വലമായ കഥ!

karthavinte-namathil.title: കര്‍ത്താവിന്റെ നാമത്തില്‍
karthavinte-namathil.description: സഭയെ പിടിച്ചുലച്ച ഒരു കന്യാസ്ത്രീയുടെ ആത്മകഥ. ക്രൈസ്തവ സഭയിലെ കൊള്ളരുതായ്മകള്‍ക്കെതിരെയും പൗരോഹിത്യ മേധാവിത്വത്തിനെതിരെയും ലൈംഗിക അരാജക്വത്തിനെതിരെയും തുറന്ന് എഴുതുകയും പ്രതിഷേധിക്കുകയും സമരം ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്ത ലൂസി കളപ്പുരയുടെ ജീവിതാനുഭവങ്ങളാണ് ഈ പുസ്തകത്തില്‍.

200-aurton-ka-badla.title: 200 Auraton ka Badla
200-aurton-ka-badla.description: Kya aapne kabhi socha hai 200 auraton ne milke ek aadmi ka Murder kyun kiya? Yeh kahani hai sachai aur insaaf ke talash ki. Is " 200 Auraton Ka Badla" True crime docu-drama ke har episode mein khulenge wo raaz jo aapke hosh udaa denge. Toh abhi suniye aur janiye is hairatangez kahani ke peechhe chhipe sach ko.

Veelani-Em-Cheddam-వీళ్ళనేం-చేద్దాం.title: వీళ్ళనేం చేద్దాం?
Veelani-Em-Cheddam-వీళ్ళనేం-చేద్దాం.description: మనిషి తన వృత్తి, అతని కుటుంబం మరియు అతని చుట్టూ ఉన్న ప్రజల పట్ల కలిగి ఉండవలసిన విలువలను గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? ప్రజలు తమ పిల్లల గురించి ఎందుకు తప్పుడు నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకుంటున్నారో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే "వీళ్ళనేం చేద్దాం?" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

divya-rakshak.title: Maha Sangram
divya-rakshak.description: Agar tum mujhse ye fight jeet gaye to main zindagi bhar tumhari slave bankar rahungi, lekin agar tum haar gaye to tumhe hamari shaadi todni hogi,” Sonia ki dhamki se Vivaan hairan rah jaata hai. Kabhi poore planet ke sabse powerful warrior Vivaan ke paas aaj muh dikhane layak powers bhi nahi hoti hain, jiski wajah se uski apni hi mangetar use thukra deti hai. Haara hua Vivaan kaise ladega Sonia se? Kya wo wapas pa sakega apni khoyi hui izzat aur taakat? Kya hoga planet Nebula par Maha Sangram?

yuttha-saththam.title: யுத்த சத்தம்
yuttha-saththam.description: Police Station முன்னால் வைத்து கொல்லப்படும் பெண். யார் கொலையாளி? ராஜேஷ் குமாரின் மற்றுமொரு திரில்லர்.

iraval-sorgam.title: இரவல் சொர்கம்
iraval-sorgam.description:
ஒரு நள்ளிரவு நேரத்தில் ஒரு தனியார் மருத்துவமனையில் நடக்கும் சட்ட விரோதமான சம்பவங்களைக் கொண்ட விறுவிறுப்பான ஒரு த்ரில்லர்.
மழை பெய்கிற ஒரு நள்ளிரவில் இளம்பெண் ஒருத்தி நெஞ்சுவலியால் அவதிப்படும் தன்னுடைய அப்பாவைக் கூட்டிக்கொண்டு ஆட்டோவில் பயணப்பட்டு அந்த மருத்துவமனைக்கு வருகிறாள். இரண்டு ட்யூட்டி டாக்டர்களின் காமப்பார்வை அவள் மேல் விழுகிறது. அந்தப் பெண் அவர்களிடம் இருந்து தப்பித்தாளா இல்லையா என்பதும், அதற்குப் பிறகு நடக்கும் எதிர்பாராத திடுக்கிடும் சம்பவங்கள் நிறைந்தது இந்த இரவல் சொர்க்கம்.

kabaad-se-jugaad-in-8-steps.title: Kabaad Se Jugaad In 8 Steps
kabaad-se-jugaad-in-8-steps.description: Har idea ko business mein implement karne ke liye innovation ki zaroorat hoti hai. Lekin uske baad bhi invemtion tak ki duri tay karne ka safar bahut lamba hota hai. Is audiobook mein hum innovation aur invention ke bich ki isi duri ko asani se tay karna sikhenge!

vivek-irukka-bayamen.title: விவேக் இருக்க பயமேன்
vivek-irukka-bayamen.description: தழிழ்நாட்டில் அதிரடியான ஒரு அரசியல் மாற்றம் நிகழ்வதற்காக திரைமறைவில் சதி பின்னும் வேலை நடக்கிறது. அதற்காக டெல்லியிலிருந்து ஒரு விபரீதமான திட்டத்தோடு எம்.பி. ஒருவர் சென்னைக்கு வருகிறார். அந்த திட்டத்தை நிறைவேற்றுவதற்குள் அடுக்கடுக்காய் அதிர்ச்சி சம்பவங்கள், எதிர்பாராத மரணங்கள் அரங்கேறுகின்றன. உண்மைகளைக் கண்டறிய விவேக் களம் இறங்குகிறான். அவன் உண்மையை வெளிக்கொண்டு வந்தானா? ராஜேஷ் குமாரின் அதிரடியான அரசியல் த்ரில்லர் இது… .

the-regret-hunter.title: The Regret Hunter
the-regret-hunter.description: Former prodigy Marcus Vega, now a janitor at Chronos Innovations, uncovers the company's sinister plot to create superpowered "Players" for world domination. Stealing a dimensional device, he escapes to Alternate Earth—a mirror world where unfulfilled potential manifests as Regret Beasts. Pursued by his ruthless ex-mentor Dr. Eliza Noir and her enhanced Players, Marcus must learn to hunt these creatures and absorb their talents. As he battles across two worlds, Marcus races to master his awakening abilities, confront his past demons, and thwart Chronos' scheme. With both Earths at stake, can Marcus unlock his true potential before it's too late?

ace-against-odds.title: Ace Against Odds
ace-against-odds.description: Doubles Mein World No. 1 aur Grand Slam mein title jitne wali India ki Tennis Star, Sania Mirza ne ek lambe samay tak lakhon dilon par raz kiya aur unhein inspire kiya. Lekin wo is mukam tak kaise pahunchi? Bachpan se leker tennis player banne tak ka unka safar kaisa tha, ye janne ke liye aaiye chalte hain is kitab ke sath unke jeewan ke adventures safar par..

kavalu.title: ಕವಲು
kavalu.description: ಎಸ್.ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ ಕವಲು  ಕನ್ನಡದ ಸಾಂದರ್ಭಿಕ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿ, ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧುನಿಕ ಜೀವನ ಶೈಲಿಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಒಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಕಥೆಯಾದರೂ, ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗತ ಜೀವನ, ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ಅರ್ಥದ ಕುರಿತು ಸುಕ್ಷ್ಮ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊರಹಾಕಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕತೆಯು ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿನ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಸಮಾಜದ ಪರಿಷ್ಕಾರದ ಯತ್ನಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಚಿಂತನೆಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ದ್ವಂದ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯಬದ್ಧ ಗಡಿಗಳನ್ನು ಉಲ್ಲಂಘಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಹೊಸ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳು, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ನೈತಿಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಇವು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. "ಕವಲು" ಒಂದು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ವಿಮರ್ಶೆಯಂತಿದ್ದು, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ತಳಜಾತಿಯ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುವ ನಾಟಕೀಯ ಕತಾಹಂದರವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ.ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಭಾವನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ನಡುವಿನ ಪಾತಿವೃತ್ತಿಯ ಕನ್ನಡಿ ನೀಡುವ, ಆಳವಾದ ಚಿಂತನೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

exiled-to-earth.title: Exiled to Earth
exiled-to-earth.description:
Brace for "Exiled to Earth," a breathtaking sci-fi survival thriller where twenty extraordinary teens become humanity's last hope. Crash-landing on a nuclear-ravaged Earth, they face mutant beasts, warring tribes, and hidden dangers. As they unravel the mysteries of glowing crystals and lost civilizations, alliances crumble and betrayals abound.

Led by the brilliant Alice and fierce Angela, our heroes navigate a treacherous world where nothing is as it seems.

With each heart-stopping episode, the stakes soar higher, and the line between ally and enemy blurs. Can these teens uncover Earth's darkest secrets and save humanity, or will they become pawns in a cosmic game? Buckle up for an adrenaline-fueled journey that will keep you on the edge of your seat!

mumbai-ki-murder-mystery.title: Mumbai Ki Murder Mystery
mumbai-ki-murder-mystery.description: Ek high-profile party mein hui murder ki pehli parat khul rahi hai! Mysterious call, dark secrets, aur dangerous chase ke beech, kya journalist Maya Rao pata kar payegi asli haqiqat ka pata?

saartha.title: ಸಾರ್ಥ
saartha.description: "ಸಾರ್ಥ" ಎಸ್.ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ, ಧರ್ಮ, ತತ್ತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮದ ಸುತ್ತ ತಿರುಗುವ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ. ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಹೆಸರಿನಂತೆ "ಸಾರ್ಥ" ಅಂದರೆ "ಸಫಲ" ಅಥವಾ "ಸಾರ್ಥಕ", ಈ ಕಥೆ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಜೀವನಯಾನವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಗುಪ್ತ ವಂಶದ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ಈ ಕಥೆ, ಮಾನವ ಬದುಕಿನ ಅರ್ಥದ ಹುಡುಕಾಟ, ಧರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ಮದ ನಡುವೆ ನಡೆಯುವ ಸಂಘರ್ಷ, ಜ್ಞಾನ ಹಾಗೂ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮದ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಯಾತ್ರೆಯನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಭಾರತದ ವಿವಿಧ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಾದ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕತೆ, ಬೌದ್ಧ ಧರ್ಮ, ಜೈನ ಧರ್ಮ, ಚಾರ್ವಾಕ ತತ್ತ್ವ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿಗಳ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಂಬಂಧ, ಮತ್ತು ಆ ಕಾಲದ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಕ್ಕು, ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ವಿಶಾಲ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋಣವನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. "ಸಾರ್ಥ" ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಒಂದು ನಿರ್ಣಾಯಕ ಕಾಲಘಟ್ಟವನ್ನು ಸಂಶೋಧಿಸುತ್ತಾ, ಆಧುನಿಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಅನುಭವಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗೆ ಆಹ್ವಾನ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

sunkar-dekho-jagannath-mandir.title: Sunkar Dekho: Jagannath Mandir
sunkar-dekho-jagannath-mandir.description: Swagat hai aapka is khaas teerth yatra mein jahaan hum aapko lekar chalenge Hindu dharm ke chaar dhaam mein se ek vishesh dhaam mein - Odisha ke Puri mein stith Sree Jagannath Mandir. Mehsoos kijiye Prabhu Jagannathe ke mandir ke alokik vatavaran ko aur jaaniye usse judi kuch dilchasp kisse. Saath hi mein anand lijiye Ratha Yatra ki aur darshan paaye Prabhu Jagannath, unke bhai Prabhu Balabhadra, aur unki behan Mata Subhadra ki, aapke mann ki gehraai mein.

bheemasenan.title: ഭീമസേനന്‍
bheemasenan.description: ഇതിഹാസ പുരാണങ്ങളെ അധികരിച്ചുളള കഥകളും സാഹിത്യകൃതികളും ഇഷ്ടപ്പെടുന്നവര്‍ക്കായി ഒരു ഗ്രന്ഥം. പാണ്ഡവരില്‍ ഒരുവനായ ഭീമസേനന്റെ ശക്തിദൗര്‍ല്യങ്ങളും മോഹങ്ങളും പൊങ്ങച്ചങ്ങളുമെല്ലാം നോവലില്‍ അനാവരണം ചെയ്യപ്പെടുന്നു. പാണ്ഡവരുടെ ദുരിതനാളുകളില്‍ കൃഷ്ണന്‍ വഴികാട്ടിയായി അവരോടൊപ്പം എങ്ങനെയാണു നിന്നതെന്ന് കൃതിയില്‍ കാണാം.

the-empathy-protocol.title: The Empathy Protocol
the-empathy-protocol.description: "The Empathy Protocol" follows the groundbreaking journey of Dr. Evelyn Marsh, a neuroscientist developing a treatment to instill empathy in psychopaths who are completely devoid of any emotions. Her first human trial is on a convicted serial killer Mark Harris. As her work shows promise in rehabilitating criminals, Evelyn faces ethical dilemmas and unexpected consequences becoming a victim of her own research. The series explores the fine line between healing and playing god, as the treatment's effects ripple through society. Evelyn must navigate the dangers of such experiments, questioning the nature of emotion and free will while confronting her own childhood trauma that led her to develop the device.

the-life-divine.title: The Life Divine
the-life-divine.description: "The Life Divine" by Sri Aurobindo ek mahatvapurn granth hai jo adhyatmik sahitya mein pramukh hai, jo manav chetna ke vikas aur prithvi par divya jeevan ki sambhavnayein ko khojta hai. Yeh pustak jatil darshanik aur adhyatmik vishayon ko prastut karti hai, jo purvi aur pashchimi vichar ko milaati hai. Yeh astitva ki prakriti, jeevan ka uddeshya, aur adhyatmik parivartan ki sambhavnayein ko samjhati hai. Sri Aurobindo manavta ke bhavishya ka ek darshan prastut karte hain, jahan uchit chetna ko prapt kiya ja sakta hai, aur ek pragatisheel duniya ko janm diya ja sakta hai. Unki rachnayein bhautik aur adhyatmik ke beech ke sambhandh mein gahri soch pradaan karti hain, jo satya ki talash mein lage logon ke liye ek gahra aur parivartanatmak pad hai.

perfume.title: Perfume
perfume.description: Will you marry me?  സ്ത്രീകളുടെ വീക്നെസ്സ് ആയ ബിസിനസ്സുകാരൻ റോയ് പുത്തൂരാനോട് അത്ര സുന്ദരിയല്ലാത്ത ഒരു പെൺകുട്ടി ഇത് ചോദിച്ചപ്പോൾ എല്ലാവരും ഞെട്ടി. എന്നാൽ, പ്രണയത്തിന്റെ കൊടുമുടിയിൽ തന്നെ കൊണ്ടെത്തിക്കാൻ അവൾക്ക് കഴിയും എന്ന് അവനു മനസ്സിലാകുന്നു. നിലക്കാത്ത ട്വിസ്റ്റുകളും അതിതീവ്രമായ പ്രണയനിമിഷങ്ങളും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു റൊമാന്റിക് സീരീസ്!

Detective-హంసలేఖ-2.title: Detective హంసలేఖ Season  2 & 3
Detective-హంసలేఖ-2.description: హంసలేఖ మరో కొత్త కేసును చేధించడానికి మీ ముందుకు వచ్చేసింది. ఆద్యంతం ఆకట్టుకునే థ్రిల్లర్ కథ వినేయండి మరి.

battle-of-brothers.title: Dev Asur
battle-of-brothers.description: Aarav or Viraj Judva bhai the or dono hi cricket me ek no. Lekin Viraj Aarav se poore 2 minute bada tha or isiliye vo hamesha apne chhote bhai ki raksha bhi karta tha, ek din jab school ke bully ne Aarav ko pareshaan kiya to Viraj ne cricket bat uthaaya or us bully ke sar pe itni zor se bat maara ki uske parkhachche ud gaye. Us din se se Viraaj ko jail ho gai lekin us din se uske andar ka raakshas jaag chuka tha. Ushe koi rok sakta tha to vo tha sirf Aarav... Par iske liye Aarav ko jagaani hongi apne andar ki shaktiyan.. Kya Aarav muqaabla kar paayega apne bade bhaai ka? Kya do bhaaiyon ka ye yuddh duniya ko tabaahi ki or le jaayega? Aakhir kiski jeet hogi? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye "DEV-ASUR"

మన్మథబాణం-.title: Love You Baby
మన్మథబాణం-.description: మనసులను దోచే హృద్యమైన ప్రేమకథ, పంతానికి, పట్టుదలకు ప్రేమ లొంగుతుందా? ఆడ, మగ ఒకరి మీద ఒకరికి అధికారం ఉండాలా లేక మమకారమా?

communicating-your-way-to-success-2.title: Communicating your way to Success
communicating-your-way-to-success-2.description: Confident taa communicate panni success sa adaiyaruthu eppadi nu intha audiobook solluthu. Vaanga Kekkalaam. 💬✨📚

e3eb37e1-fd39-4d45-9d87-8d49205a0c5d.title: Shikari
e3eb37e1-fd39-4d45-9d87-8d49205a0c5d.description: 48 ghanton mein kya Inspector Maya bachayegi MLA ki beti ko? Jaane kaun hai woh 'Shikari' jo masoom ladkiyon ka shikaar kar raha hai!

re-script-your-life.title: Re-Script Your Life
re-script-your-life.description: Ellaam namma thalai ezhuthu nu sornthu poidaatheenga.. namma vidhiya thiruthi ezhuthura sakthi nammakitta irukku ✨ adhu eppadi nu yosikkireengala🤔.. Vidhiya maathi ezhuthuradhu eppadi nu  indha audiobook🎧📖 kathukodukkuthu  therinjukalaam vaanga💪

zannie-khooni-pyaas.title: Zannie : Khooni Pyaas
zannie-khooni-pyaas.description: Apni shaktiyon se anjaan Nita, kya waqt rehte us Raaz ka pata laga payegi jisse wo zannies ko kaali ke diye shrap se mukt Kara sakti hai ! Ya us Raaz tak pahuchane se pahle hi wo apni maa ke kabze mein aa jayegi ,  Jo apni beti ki shaktiyon ka istemal karke zannies ki duniya par hukumat Karna chahti hai ?

vaishnava-divya-deshalu.title: వైష్ణవ దివ్యదేశాలు
vaishnava-divya-deshalu.description: ప్రపంచంలో ఎక్కడ లేని అద్భుతాలు భారతదేశపు చరిత్రకే సొంతం, ఎన్నో రహస్యాలు, ఎన్నో దివ్యకరమైన విషయాలు తెలుసుకోవడానికి విన్నండి

Adhunika-Bharata-Charitra-ఆధునిక-భారత-చర.title: ఆధునిక భారత చరిత్ర
Adhunika-Bharata-Charitra-ఆధునిక-భారత-చర.description: భారత దేశ చరిత్ర  కి  సంబంధించిన లోతైన విషయాలు తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా  ? అయితే బిపిన్ చంద్ర రాసిన  "ఆధునిక చరిత్ర"  ఆడియో బుక్ తప్పకుండా వినండి.

ebace2d1-5d73-4319-98a1-fa5ae0f29865.title: Ravan Ka Poorna Satya
ebace2d1-5d73-4319-98a1-fa5ae0f29865.description: Ravan ke asli chehre ko dekhiye, jaanein uske bhayankar paap aur krur krityon ke peeche ka sach. Kya aapne kabhi socha hai ki jo Ravan mahimandit kiya jata hai, wo asal mein kaisa tha?

noor-jahan.title: ನೂರ್ ಜಹಾನ್
noor-jahan.description: ನೂರ್ ಜಹಾನ್ - ವಿಜಯ ಸುಬ್ಬ ರಾವ್ ಅವರ ಚಿರಸ್ಮರಣೀಯ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೂರ್ ಜಹಾನ್ ಎಂಬ ಹಸ್ತಕ್ಷೇಪಕಾರಿ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಬದುಕು ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಪ್ರಗತಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಈ ಮಹಿಳಾ ನಾಯಕಿ ತನ್ನ ಬಾಳಿನ ಹಲವು ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ತ್ಯಾಗ, ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಧೈರ್ಯಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮುಗ್ಧತೆಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯತ್ತ ಸಾಗುವ ಈ ನೂರ್ ಜಹಾನ್ ಪಾತ್ರವು ತನ್ನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಧೀಮಂತ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾ, ತನ್ನ ಸುತ್ತಮುತ್ತಲಿನ ಸಮಾಜದ ಕಟ್ಟುಕಟ್ಟಾಗಿದ್ರೂ, ತನ್ನ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವವನ್ನು ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸುವ ಯತ್ನವನ್ನು ತೋರ್ಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಆಕೆಯ ಬಾಳಿನ ಮೇಲ್ಕಡೆಯೋಲಾಟಗಳು, ಆಂತರಿಕ ಸಂಘರ್ಷಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವಳ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಮನದಾಳದ ಅನ್ವೇಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

muru-darigalu.title: ಮೂರು ದಾರಿಗಳು
muru-darigalu.description: "ಮೂರು ದಾರಿಗಳು"ಎಂಬ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಯಶವಂತ ಚಿತ್ತಾಲ ಅವರ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಮಾನವ ಜೀವನದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಸಂಘರ್ಷ, ನೈತಿಕತೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಮುಖ್ಯಪಾತ್ರಗಳ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಾಗುವ ತಮಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯದ ದಾರಿಗಳು, ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳು, ಹಾಗೂ ತೀರ್ಮಾನಗಳು ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರಬಿಂದು. ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆ, ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸ್ಥೈರ್ಯ, ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಗಾಢತೆಯನ್ನನುಭವಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. "ಮೂರು ದಾರಿಗಳು" ಕೃತಿಯು ಆಧುನಿಕ ಬದುಕಿನ ವ್ಯಥೆಯನ್ನ, ಮನಸ್ಸಿನೊಳಗಿನ ದಾರಿಯನ್ನ ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

5fba778c-6b24-428e-9217-c949b0f74353.title: Shiv Jee Ke Sabse Shaktishaali Avtaar
5fba778c-6b24-428e-9217-c949b0f74353.description: Shiv Puran mein varnit 19 avtaaron mein se jaaniye Shiv jee ke 6 pramukh avtaaron ki bhaktipoorna kahaani.

scandal-to-stardom.title: Scandal to Stardom
scandal-to-stardom.description:
"What if you could rewrite the villain's story?"

Acclaimed actress Aria Clarke awakens as Bella Evans, a novel's notorious villain and bratty heiress. Thrust into Bella's world of scandals, a crumbling career, and a secret loveless marriage, Aria races to avoid her character's tragic fate. As she strives to redeem the spoiled socialite's reputation, unexpected romance blossoms and dangerous secrets surface.

 Can Aria transform this reviled heiress and escape her doomed ending, or will the predetermined plot prove impossible to change? 

Dive into "Scandal to Stardom," exclusively on KukuFM, and discover if a villain's destiny can truly be rewritten.

whispers-on-the-airwaves.title: Whispers on the Airwaves
whispers-on-the-airwaves.description: When a mysterious radio station begins broadcasting people's deepest secrets, the community in the idyllic town of Silverlake is thrown into turmoil. At the center of the unfolding chaos is Emily Harper, a determined local journalist who takes it upon herself to uncover the truth behind the broadcasts while grappling with the skeletons in her own closet. The radio's revelations expose long-buried family secrets, ignite personal struggles, and test the bonds of relationships. As these broadcasts continue, the line between truth and manipulation blurs, and the very fabric of Silverlake's society begins to unravel. Emily's investigation leads her down a dangerous path, uncovering a conspiracy that goes far beyond simple gossip, and forcing her to confront the question: in a world where all secrets are exposed, what truths are worth protecting?

the-power-of-forgiveness.title: The Power Of Forgiveness
the-power-of-forgiveness.description: Iss show mein hum forgiveness ki importance ko samjhenge. Seekhenge kaise sahi tareeke se maafi maang kar aur maaf kar ke hum apni zindagi ko behtar aur rishton ko mazboot bana sakte hain.

ci-swaminathans-case-diary-season-2.title: CI Swaminathan's Case Diary - Season 2
ci-swaminathans-case-diary-season-2.description: മലയാളത്തിന്റെ പ്രിയനടൻ സിദ്ദിഖ് വീണ്ടും സി. ഐ. സ്വാമിനാഥനായി നിങ്ങളുടെ മുന്നിലേക്ക്! കാരക്കോണത്ത് നടന്ന വൃദ്ധ ദമ്പതികളുടെ നടുക്കുന്ന ഇരട്ടക്കൊലയാണ് ഇത്തവണ പോലീസിന് വെല്ലുവിളി ഉയർത്തുന്നത്. രഞ്ജു കിളിമാനൂർ രചിക്കുന്ന ക്രൈം സീരീസ് നിങ്ങളെ ആകാംഷയുടെ മുൾമുനയിൽ നിർത്തും!

death-circle.title: Death Circle
death-circle.description: പാറക്കെട്ടിനടുത്ത് സുന്ദരിയായ ഒരു യുവതിയുടെ മൃതദേഹം കണ്ടെത്തിയത് അന്വേഷിച്ചു പുഷ്പരാജ് ചെന്നെത്തുന്നത് കേരളം മുതൽ ബോംബെ വരെ പരന്നു കിടക്കുന്ന പെൺവാണിഭ  മാഫിയയിലേക്കാണ്. സസ്പെൻസ് ത്രില്ലറുകളുടെ രാജാവ് കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥ് രചിച്ച ഡിറ്റക്റ്റീവ് പുഷ്പരാജ് സീരിസിലെ ഒരു അതുഗ്രൻ നോവൽ

sarfira-jasoos.title: Sarfira Jasoos
sarfira-jasoos.description: Zahir achanak se ek detective ke sharir mein paata hai apne aap ko. Uske paas hain sirf purani zindagi ki yaadein aur ek mysterious miracle system jo har din deta hai naye powers. Kya Zahir apne pehle sharir ko dhoondh paayega aur  apne asli shareer ko paakar sabse bada detective ban payega?

shikaari.title: ಶಿಕಾರಿ
shikaari.description: "ಶಿಕಾರಿ" ಯಶವಂತ ಚಿತ್ತಾಲ ಅವರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ, ಇದು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಜೀವನದ ವಿವರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ಮುಂದೆ ತಾನೊಬ್ಬ ಬೇಟೆಯಾಳು ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನ, ಆತ್ಮನಿಷ್ಠೆ, ಸಂವೇದನೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ನಡೆಯುವ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಚರ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮನಃಸ್ಥಿತಿ, ಆತನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುವ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. "ಶಿಕಾರಿ" ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ಗೊಂದಲಗಳು, ಅವನ ಆತ್ಮವಿಲೋಮಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸ್ಪಂದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎಂಬುದರ ಕುರಿತು ವಿಮರ್ಶಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ವಿಮರ್ಶಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

my-weak-wife-is-a-war-goddess.title: Roohi Ya Roohani
my-weak-wife-is-a-war-goddess.description: Roohi Or Roohani hospital me ICU bed pe thi...  Dono ki zindgai me haadsa hua or unka marna tay tha lekin tabhi hua kudrat ka karishma or dono ki jaan bach gai lekin inme se ke ka shareer nahin bach saka... Aakhir kyon khela tha kismat ne ye naayaab khel? Kya poora hoga inhen mile doosre mouke ka maksad? Kya duniya jaan payegi Roohi or roohani ka raaz... Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye!

suheldev-bharathavanu-rakshisida-dore.title: ಸುಹೇಲ್ ದೇವ್ : ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿದ ದೊರೆ
suheldev-bharathavanu-rakshisida-dore.description: ಸುಹೇಲ್ ದೇವ್ - ಅಮೀಶ್ ತ್ರಿಪಾಠಿ "ಸುಹೇಲ್ ದೇವ್" ಅಮೀಶ್ ತ್ರಿಪಾಠಿಯವರ ಮಹತ್ವಾಕಾಂಕ್ಷಿ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಪುರಾತನ ನಾಯಕ ಸುಹೇಲ್ ದೇವ್ ಅವರ ಕುರಿತು ಬೆಳಕು ಚೆಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವರ ಶೌರ್ಯ, ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ, ಮತ್ತು ದೇಶದ್ರೋಹಿಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಹೋರಾಟವು ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಅಂಶವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸುಹೇಲ್ ದೇವ್ ಅವರ ನಾಯಕತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತವು ಮುಸ್ಲಿಂ ಆಕ್ರಮಣವನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿದ, ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಕಾಯ್ದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ನಡೆಸಿದ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಯುದ್ಧವನ್ನು ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಎತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ಎಳೆದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣ ಕತಾವಸ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಚಿತ್ರಣವು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟತೆಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

robot-romeo.title: Robot Romeo
robot-romeo.description: City’யின் Top Businessman விக்ரமிற்கு பெண்கள் என்றாலே Allergy. அவனை பொது இடத்தில் வைத்து எல்லோர் முன்னிலையில் முத்தமிடுகிறாள் மேகா. மேகாவின் காதல் வலையில் விழுவானா விக்ரம்?

samudri-lootere.title: Samudri Lootere
samudri-lootere.description: Luv ek naay looteraa nikal pada hai apne bade bade sapne lekar samundar ki taraf. Sapnon ko poora karne ke liye usey chahiye ek behatarin crew, jiski talash usey isi samudri safar par karni hogi. Is khoj mein usey kai pareshaaniyon ka saamna karna hoga, jisme kai atrangi aur jadui taakat wale Lootero se hoga uska muqabla. Kya Luv apne liye ek accha crew khoj paaya? Kya wo un sabhi jadui taakat wale pirates se takraate hue apni jaan bacha paayega? Jaanne ke liye suniye, Samudri Lootere.

anveshanachovva.title: അന്വേഷണച്ചൊവ്വ
anveshanachovva.description: അടുത്ത സുഹൃത്തുക്കള്‍ ആണ് അനന്തു, നന്ദന്‍, ധ്രുവന്‍ എന്നിവര്‍. 35 ആയിട്ടും വിവാഹിതനാവാത്തതില്‍ ദുഃഖിതനായ അനന്തുവിന്റെ ജീവിതത്തിലേക്ക് സ്‌റ്റെല്ല എന്ന പെണ്‍കുട്ടി കടന്നു വരുന്നതും തുടര്‍ന്നുണ്ടാവുന്ന മാറ്റങ്ങളുമാണ് ഈ ത്രില്ലര്‍ നോവല്‍ പറയുന്നത്.

ente-sathyanweshana-pareekshanangal.title: എന്റെ സത്യാന്വേഷണ പരീക്ഷണങ്ങൾ
ente-sathyanweshana-pareekshanangal.description: 1927-ൽ ഗുജറാത്തി ഭാഷയിൽ ആദ്യമായി പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ച ഈ പുസ്തകം, ഗാന്ധിജിയുടെ കുട്ടിക്കാലം മുതൽ 1921 വരെയുള്ള ജീവിതത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് വിവരിക്കുന്നു. ഒരു മഹാത്മാവിന്റെ രൂപപ്പെടലിന്റെ അടയാളപ്പെടുത്തലായ ഈ ഗ്രന്ഥം അതിനാൽ തന്നെ ലോകമെമ്പാടും വായിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു.

Bhagawat-Puran-दुख-और-डर-से-मुक्ति-.title: Bhagawat Puran: दुख और डर से मुक्ति
Bhagawat-Puran-दुख-और-डर-से-मुक्ति-.description: Kya aap kalyug ke asar se bachne ka tareeka jaan-na chahte hain? Agar haan, toh zaroor suniye Heera aur Panna ke saath Shrimad Bhagwat Puran ki yeh anokhi katha. Samajhiye kaise kalyug ke paap aur dukh se mukti payi ja sakti hai. Sath hi, jaaniye purane yugon ke wo rahasya jo dikhayenge shanti aur samriddhi ka marg, Jis par chalkar badal jayega aapka jeevan.

marana-mrudanga.title: Marana Mrudanga
marana-mrudanga.description: ಭಯದ ನೆರಳಿನಿಂದ ಧೈರ್ಯದ ಬೆಳಕಿಗೆ ಜಿಗಿಯುವ ಹುಡುಗಿಯರಿಬ್ಬರ ಕಥೆ 'ಮರಣ ಮೃದಂಗ'ದ ಜೀವಾಳ. ಅನುಷಾ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ಪಲಾ ಇವರಿಬ್ರು ತದ್ವಿರುದ್ಧ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವಗಳಾದ್ರೂ ಜೀವದ ಗೆಳತಿಯರು. ಆದರೆ ಇದೇ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರ ಜೀವಕ್ಕೂ ಕಂಟಕನಾಗ್ತಾನೆ ಮಾಫಿಯಾ ದೊರೆ ವಸಂತ ದಾದಾ. ಅನುಷಾ ತನ್ನ ಕೆಲಸದ ಕಾರಣದಿಂದ ಮಾಫಿಯಾ ವ್ಯೂಹದೊಳಗೆ ಬಿದ್ರೆ, ಉತ್ಪಲಾ ತನ್ನ ತಮ್ಮ ಬರೆದ ಒಂದು ಪತ್ರದ ಮೂಲಕ ಈ ವಿಷ ಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಬಿಳ್ತಾಳೆ. ಹಾಗಿದ್ರೆ ಮುಂದೇನಾಗುತ್ತೆ? ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ಷಣವೂ ರೋಚಕತೆಯಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿರುವಂತಹ ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ‘ಮರಣ ಮೃದಂಗ’ದ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ!

the-unwanted-bride-1.title: The Unwanted Bride
the-unwanted-bride-1.description: Autumn Rivera and Atticus Fawn, two youngsters from affluent business families are forced by their parents to marry each other. A union purely motivated by a business merger. Atticus being the eldest among the three brothers must agree to this deal. While Autumn is in love with Atticus, he is madly in love with Autumn's best friend Anya. Will Autumn confess her feelings for Atticus? Will they both agree to this marriage for the sake of their families, while someone tries to sabotage their every decision? Listen to the Unwanted Bride to discover the journey of love, friendship, jealousy, and ambition as Autumn and Atticus discover their feelings.

revolver-raja.title: Revolver Raja
revolver-raja.description: Khooni Registan, Zinda Murde aur Kali shaktiyan. Chote bacche Anirudh ke liye Musibatein kam nahi ho rahi thi ki tabhi uske picha laga ek Rakshas Pretraj. Aur fir Masiha ban ke aaya Bhairav jiski bandooke karti thi in sabhi shaitano ka khaatma. Kya Bhairav bachha payega us bacche ko in haiwano se? Kyun laga hai Pretraj Anirudh ke piche? Janne ke liye sune Revolver Raja.

hadina-reke-sadu.title: ಹದ್ದಿನ ರೆಕ್ಕೆ ಸದ್ದು
hadina-reke-sadu.description:
"ಹದ್ದಿನ ರೇಖೆ ಸದ್ದು"- ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್
ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಒಂದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಗೋಜುಗಳು, ಸಂಕೋಲೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಣಯಗಳ ಗಂಭೀರ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳನ್ನು ಕುರಿತಾದ ಸಾಂವೇದನಶೀಲ ಕಥೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್ ಅವರ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ಪೀಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾದ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡ, ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಬಂದು ಹೊಚ್ಚ ಹಾದಿ ಹುಡುಕುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಪಯಣವನ್ನು ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಜೀವನದ ಜಟಿಲ ಸತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿಸುವ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟಿರುವ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ, ಓದುಗರಲ್ಲಿ ಆಳವಾದ ತತ್ತ್ವಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

level-up.title: Level UP
level-up.description: Shahar mein khulne lage rahasyamayi gates, Aur Har taraf Monsters ne macha di hai tabahi! Tarun, sabse kamzor hunter, kaise badlega apni kismat, aur kaise karega unse samna ? Suniye ye kahani, jahan har kona hai raaz se bhara  aur har kadam  hai Jung ka maidan!

the-dark-moon-1.title: The Dark Moon
the-dark-moon-1.description:
In this thrilling supernatural romance, Thea's ordinary life is shattered when she's thrust into a world of werewolves, vampires, and witches. After a terrifying attack, she discovers her new friends, including the mysterious, enigmatic, and irresistible Grayson, are part of this mystical world. As Thea grapples with her newfound reality, she learns she's Grayson's destined mate, complicating her feelings and fears. The story intensifies as Thea navigates dangerous supernatural politics, life-threatening spells, and the complexities of werewolves' pack dynamics. Her relationship with Grayson – the powerful Alpha – deepens amidst these challenges, exploring themes of trust and betrayals, desire and vulnerability, alliances and heart-stopping confrontations as Thea adapts to her role as Luna and tries to balance her new life with her old.
In this realm where love and danger are two sides of the same coin, one question burns brighter than the rest: Will Thea emerge as the master of her new destiny, or will the dark forces swirling around her extinguish the fire of her humanity forever?

twinkle-rosayum-panthrandu-kamukanmarum.title: ട്വിങ്കിൾ റോസയും പന്ത്രണ്ട് കാമുകന്മാരും
twinkle-rosayum-panthrandu-kamukanmarum.description: ഇതാണ് ട്വിങ്കിള്‍ റോസയുടെ പുണ്യാളന്‍ ദ്വീപ്. ഇവിടെ യഥാര്‍ത്ഥമല്ലാത്തതൊന്നും ഇല്ല. ഇവിടുത്തെ സ്വപ്നങ്ങള്‍പോലും സത്യമാണ്. ആര്‍നോള്‍ഡ് വാവയും ഡോള്‍ഫിന്‍ കാമുകനും പ്രേതവള്ളവും പശപ്പറ്റും ശരിക്ക് ഉള്ളതാണ്. ട്വിങ്കിള്‍ റോസയും സത്യമാണ്.

zindagi-milegi-dobara.title: Zindagi Milegi Dobara
zindagi-milegi-dobara.description: Zindagi mein safal hone ke liye acchi qismat hona zaroori hota hai, Lekin sachhai ye bhi hai ki humari apni qismat apne haath me hi hoti hai. Aur iska full proof deti hai is show mein sunai gayi kahani. Jismein Shiva apni himmat aur akalmandi se badal deta hai ravi ki taqdeer. Abhi suniye aur janiye ki, Mushkilon ka samna karte huye woh kis tarah safal hota hai, aur seekhiye kaise aap bhi tough financial conditions se ladke financially strong ban sakte hain.

ulakam-chuttum-80-dinangal.title: ഉലകം ചുറ്റും 80 ദിനങ്ങൾ
ulakam-chuttum-80-dinangal.description: അതിവേഗ വിമാനത്തുമ്പികളും ലോകത്തെ വിരൽത്തുമ്പുകളിലേക്കൊതുക്കുന്ന ഇന്റർനെറ്റ് സംവിധാനങ്ങളും ഇല്ലാതിരുന്ന കാലത്ത് മനസ്ഥൈര്യവും നിശ്ചയദാർഢ്യവും കൈമുതലാക്കി നടത്തിയ സാഹസികയാത്രയുടെ  കഥ .

గుండెల్లో-ఏముందో.title: Miracle Doctor.!
గుండెల్లో-ఏముందో.description: ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయి చేసిన మోసం, డాక్టర్ చదువుతూ జనాలకి మంచి చేయాలనే ఆలోచనతో ఉన్న అభిరామ్. అనుకోకుండా అభిరామ్ కి ఎన్నో శక్తులు వస్తాయి. ఆ శక్తుల వల్ల అభిరామ్ కి వచ్చే ప్రమాదం ఏమిటి?  దానివల్ల అభిరామ్ ప్రాణానికి ఏమైనా ప్రమాదం ఉందా? అది తెలుసుకోవాలంటే మీరు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే.!

bite-the-bullet-1.title: Bite The Bullet
bite-the-bullet-1.description: Iss show hum janenge self-control ke baare mein aur samjhenge kyun yeh humare jeevan mein bahut zaruri hai.

uyirai-urasathe-urave.title: Uyirai Urasathe Urave
uyirai-urasathe-urave.description: Namma life la irukka koodiya sila per, avanga kooda iruntha azhagaana naatkal, manasa vittu ennaikum neengathu. Appadi namma manasa varuda koodiya oru kathal kathai dhaan indha audio book. Kudumbam, kathal, kamam, natpu nu ellatha pathiyum vazhkai'yoda ondri sollapatta kathai dhaan intha "Uyirai urasathe urave".

ప్రేమంటే-ఇదేనా-.title: ప్రేమంటే ఇదేనా ?
ప్రేమంటే-ఇదేనా-.description: ప్రేమ ఒక మనిషిని ఎలా అయినా మారుస్తుంది అది పెళ్లి చేసుకున్న సరే. అయితే ఈ కథలో ఇద్దరు అమ్మాయిలు ఒకే అబ్బాయిని ప్రేమిస్తారు, ఇద్దరి ప్రేమ తో సతమతం అవుతున్న అబ్బాయి జీవితం ఎలా మారబోతుంది అనేదే ఈ కథ ఇంకా పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

job-search-mastery-mastering-resumes-lin.title: Job Search Mastery - Mastering Resumes, LinkedIn, and Interview Techniques
job-search-mastery-mastering-resumes-lin.description: Are you ready to transform your job search and land the career of your dreams? Welcome to The Complete Job Search Bootcamp, your ultimate guide to navigating the job market with confidence and skill. This course is meticulously designed to equip you with the strategies and tools needed to create compelling resumes, build a powerful LinkedIn profile, and excel in job interviews.

Mr-ഫ്രോഡ്-.title: Mr. ഫ്രോഡ്
Mr-ഫ്രോഡ്-.description: തെന്നിത്യൻ സിനിമയിലെ പുത്തൻ താരോദയമാണ് അഴകിന്റെ റാണിയായ അലീഷാ മരിയ തോമസ്. ഉദയ് ചന്ദ്രശേഖർ എന്ന വമ്പൻ സ്രാവിന്റെ പിറന്നാൾ പാർട്ടിക്ക് ക്ഷണം ലഭിച്ചപ്പോൾ അലിഷാ ഒരിക്കലും കരുതിയില്ല, അത് അവളുടെ ജീവിതം  തന്നെ മാറ്റിമറിക്കുമെന്ന്!  കോളിളക്കം സൃഷ്‌ടിച്ച ഒരു യഥാർത്ഥ കേസിനെ ആസ്പദമാക്കി രചിച്ച, പ്രണയവും വഞ്ചനയും പ്രതികാരവും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു  സീരീസ്!

thimirukku-marupeyar-neeyo.title: Thimirukku marupeyar neeyo
thimirukku-marupeyar-neeyo.description: Engagement mudinjathum Aarathaya sollikkama Amerikkavukku kilambi poidara. Kalyanam ninnu ponathaala maappillai Krishkuku avamaanam aagiduthu. Aarathayava pazhi vaanganumnu Amerikka poraan. Pona idaththula avalai pazhi theerththana illa avaloda kaathalla vizhunthana?

9355a229-29bc-4f35-ab3d-07c5e02a4c17.title: Vaidik Kaaleen Rishi Agastya
9355a229-29bc-4f35-ab3d-07c5e02a4c17.description: Bharat hamesha se rishiyon aur tapasviyon ki dharti raha hai. Hamari sanskriti ki jaden in mahaan santon ke gyaan aur tapasya mein basi hain. Unme se ek jinka yogdaan ati mahatvapoorn raha hai, wo hai Rishi Agastya. Is show mein hum lekar aaye hain Rishi Agastya se judi kuch anokhi kahaniyaan jo siddh karti hai unki aseem divyata ko.

the-book-of-motivation.title: The Book Of Motivation
the-book-of-motivation.description: Life la oru Motivation Boost venum nu nenaikkira ovvorutharukkum indha audiobook oru gift🎁. Kulappam, Kavalai, sogam nu sombi kedakkura manasukku puthunarchi koduthu motivation panna intha audiobook ka kelunga🎧.

kaalkshetra.title: Secrets of Kaalkshetra
kaalkshetra.description: Kabir ki kahani tab naya mod leti hai jab uska samna hota hai Kaalkshetra ki bhavishyavani se, jo ek khaas shaktiyo wale Ekam ke baare me baat karti hai. Ekam jo duniya ki rakhsa karega. Trikal, jo Ekam ka vinaash karke firse  Kaalkshetra par kabza karna chahta hai, Kaalchakra ki qaid se riha ho jata hai. Kya Kabir Trikal ko rok payega aur bacha payega duniya ko? Aur aakhir kaun hai Ekam? Janne ke liye sunein, "Kaalkshetra".

the-miracle-of-right-thought-5.title: The Miracle Of Right Thought
the-miracle-of-right-thought-5.description: 🚀Unga Life 'ah Semmayaa maatha neenga ready ya? "The Miracle of Right Thought" audiobook unga ennangala sariyaanathaa maathi unga kanavugalaiyum latchiyangalaiyum adaiya ungaluku help pannum.  vaanga kekkalaam..🎧  Life 'ah semmayaa maathalaam🌟

kunjalithira.title: കുഞ്ഞാലിത്തിര
kunjalithira.description: കുട്ട്യാലി മരയ്ക്കാരും, കുട്ടിപോക്കറും, പട്ടുമരയ്ക്കാരും, മുഹമ്മദ് മരയ്ക്കാരും അറബിക്കടലിലെഴുതിയ വീരേതിഹാസം പുനര്‍ വായിക്കപ്പെടുകയാണ് കുഞ്ഞാലിത്തിരയിലൂടെ. കേള്‍ക്കാം രാജീവ് ശിവശങ്കര്‍ രചിച്ച കുഞ്ഞാലിത്തിര.

spiritual-practices-for-better-sleep.title: Spiritual Practices For Better Sleep
spiritual-practices-for-better-sleep.description: Iss show mein jaaniye spiritual practices kaise aapki sleep ko enhance aur improve kar sakti hain!

pranasanchaaram.title: പ്രാണസഞ്ചാരം
pranasanchaaram.description: ആനന്ദിന് ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നവരെയും മരിച്ചുപോയവരെയും ഒരുപോലെ കാണാം. എന്നാല്‍ ആരാണ് മരിച്ചതെന്നോ ജീവിച്ചിരിപ്പുള്ളതെന്നോ തിരിച്ചറിയാന്‍ കഴിയില്ല. പ്രമേയം കൊണ്ടും ആഖ്യാനം കൊണ്ടും വ്യത്യസ്തത പുലര്‍ത്തുന്ന രാജീവ് ശിവശങ്കറിന്റെ നോവല്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

oduvil-aarum-avaseshichilla.title: ഒടുവിൽ ആരും അവശേഷിച്ചില്ല
oduvil-aarum-avaseshichilla.description: ഒഴിഞ്ഞു കിടക്കുന്ന ഒറ്റപ്പെട്ട ദ്വീപിലെ  കൊട്ടാരത്തിലേക്ക് അസാധാരണമായ ഒരു ക്ഷണം ലഭിക്കുകയാണ് ഒരു പറ്റം അതിഥികൾക്ക്. എന്നാൽ അവിടെ അവരെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നത് വലിയ അപകടങ്ങളാണ്. അഗത ക്രിസ്റ്റിയുടെ ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലെർ.

north-korea-dharti-ka-nark.title: North Korea : Dharti Ka Nark
north-korea-dharti-ka-nark.description: Kaisa hota hai North Korea jana? Kaisi hoti hai wahan rehne walon ki zindagi? Kya tourist visa par North Korea har koi ja sakta hai? Kya North Korea tourist safe aur tourist friendly country hai? North Korea ke inhi ground realities ko hum janenge humari is audiobook mein !

tenali-ramalingadi-kathalu.title: తెనాలి రామలింగడి కథలు
tenali-ramalingadi-kathalu.description: ఆబాల గోపాలాన్ని అలరించిన తెనాలి రామలింగడి నీతి కథలు, గమ్మత్తయిన కథలు మీకోసం. వెంటనే వినండి.

parayipetta-panthirukulam.title: പറയിപെറ്റ പന്തിരുകുലം
parayipetta-panthirukulam.description: എല്ലാവരും ഒന്നെന്ന കഥ പാടുന്ന കേരളത്തിന്റെ മഹനീയ പുരാവൃത്തമായ പന്തിരുകുലത്തിന്റെ കഥ. മേഴത്തോള്‍ അഗ്‌നിഹോത്രി മുതല്‍ നാറാണത്തുഭ്രാന്തന്‍, പാക്കനാര്‍ വരെ നീളുന്ന പന്ത്രണ്ടുപേരുടെയും കുലങ്ങളുടെയും സംഭവഹുലമായ കഥ കുട്ടികള്‍ക്കായി പുനരാഖ്യാനം ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നത് കേള്‍ക്കാം.

ghar-ghar-ki-kahani-3.title: Ghar Ghar Ki Kahani
ghar-ghar-ki-kahani-3.description: Kya aap roz ke tensions aur zindagi mein aksar aa jane wale dukh-dard se pareshan rehte hain? Agar haan, Toh zaroor suniye ye show 'Ghar Ghar Ki Kahani', Kyunki ismein sunaai gayi Rekha, Santosh aur unki family ki kahaniyon se aapko milega sukoon aur zindagi se chinta-shok mitaane ka ek behtareen tareeka.

என்னில்-உன்-பாதி--.title: Yaaro Avan !?!
என்னில்-உன்-பாதி--.description: Charlotte ku annaiku night enna nadanthuthu ? Yaar avala pregnant aakuna nu theriyama, kuzhanthai ah sumanthuttu sambantha patta aal ah thedittu irukkum tharunathula, ava vaazhkkai la "Love" nra chapter open aaguthu. Ini enna nadakkum ?

mann-kasturi.title: Maa Ganga Ka Beta
mann-kasturi.description: Umar ke badhne ke saath saath kuch cheezein peeche chooth jaati hain. Par kya hoga jab aap apne ghar se hi bhaag jaayein? Benaras ke ghaat kinaare se le kar Hairdwar tak ke safar ne hamaari kahaani ke kirdaar Gaurav ko kaafi kuch seekha diya tha. Aur is transformational journey ne kis tarah se uske mann ko shaant kar diya tha? Janne ke liye sunein Ganga Maiya se juda ye show, Mann Kasturi.

రాజ-రాజ-చోర-.title: రాజ రాజ చోర
రాజ-రాజ-చోర-.description: ఒక్కపుడు గొప్ప రాజుగా వెలుగొందిన శివ, ఇప్పుడు దొంగగా మారాడు. రాజుల దగ్గరే దోచుకుని పేదలకు సహాయం చేసే మనసు అతనిది. కానీ ఎంత మంచి పని చేసినా, చివరికి వెళ్ళేది కటకటాల వెనుకకే. అతని ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయే, పోలీసులకు పట్టిస్తుంది. ఆమె ఎందుకు ఆ పని చేసింది? శివ తన ప్రేమ కథలోని నిజానిజాలు తెలుసుకోవాలంటే, ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే.

secret-husband-1.title: Secret Husband
secret-husband-1.description: పుట్టినప్పుడే అనాధగా మారి ఎన్నో బాధలు అనుభవించిన అన్షిక 18 సంవత్సరాలకే.. తెలియని వ్యక్తి చేతిలో రేప్ కి గురై తొమ్మిది నెలల తర్వాత కవలలకు జన్మనిచ్చింది.  అందరూ మాట్లాడే హీనమైన మాటలు, చూసే చులకన చూపులు తట్టుకుని నిలబడిన ఆమెకి.. ఆరు సంవత్సరాల తర్వాత అత్యంత ధనవంతుడైన అగస్త్య అతని జీవితంలో చోటిచ్చాడు. సంతోషంగా సాగిపోతున్న వారి జీవితంలో.. అన్షిక కన్న పిల్లలకు తండ్రినంటూ ఒక తుఫానుల వచ్చాడు విశ్వ. ఆ విశ్వ మరెవరో కాదు స్వయాన అగస్త్య తమ్ముడు. ఇప్పుడు అన్షిక అడుగు ఎటువైపు? తనని పెళ్లి చేసుకున్న అగస్త్య వైపా? తనతో పిల్లల్ని కన్నా విశ్వ వైపా? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వింటూనే ఉండండి సీక్రెట్ హస్బెండ్.

whispers-of-chanderi.title: Chanderi ke Raaz
whispers-of-chanderi.description: Sanskritik Viraasat kahi jane wali  Chanderi mein achanak ho rahin hain ajeebo-n-gareeb rahsyamayi ghtanaayein jisne sabko chaunka diya hai. Museum ke artifacts ka ek ke baad ek kar ke gaayab hona aur fir Laashon ka milna. Kya hai inke peeche ki wajah jaanane ke liye suniye 'CHANDERI KE RAAZ' sirf KUKU FM par.

പ്രണയസന്ധ്യ.title: പ്രണയസന്ധ്യ
പ്രണയസന്ധ്യ.description: ജീവന് തുല്യം സ്‌നേഹിച്ച ഭാവിവരന്‍ ഹേമന്തിന്റെ കുടുംബത്തെ രക്ഷിക്കാന്‍ മറ്റൊരാളുമായി ഒരു രാത്രി കഴിയാന്‍ നിര്‍ബന്ധിതയായവളാണ് ഗൗരി. എന്നാല്‍ വിവാഹ ശേഷം തനിക്ക് കിട്ടേണ്ടതെല്ലാം ഹേമന്ത് മറ്റൊരുവള്‍ക്ക് നല്‍കുന്നു. സ്‌നേഹം നിഷേധിക്കപ്പെട്ട, വഞ്ചിക്കപ്പെട്ട ഗൗരി ഇനി എങ്ങോട്ട്...

രുദ്രയാമം.title: രുദ്രയാമം
രുദ്രയാമം.description: നെടുമ്പാല ഗ്രാമത്തെ അടക്കിവാഴുന്ന അതിശക്തനായ ദുർമന്ത്രവാദിയാണ് സത്യവ്രതൻ. എന്നാൽ കാവൂട്ട് പൂരത്തിന്റെ ഒന്നാം നാൾ ക്ഷണിക്കപ്പെടാത്ത ഒരു അതിഥി അവിടേക്ക് എത്തുന്നു. എന്താണ് അയാളുടെ ഉദ്ദേശം? പ്രണയവും  കാമവും മന്ത്രതന്ത്രങ്ങളും പ്രതികാരവും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു ഹൊറർ ത്രില്ലർ. വിനോദ് നാരായണൻ രചിക്കുന്ന രുദ്രയാമം!

hellbound-with-you.title: Zindagi Ban Gaye Ho Tum
hellbound-with-you.description: “I want to fall in love once before I die—but with someone who doesn’t love me back.” Mahi, who has only a few days left to live, wants to experience everything she missed in her 21 years of life. In that search, she grows close to Vikram—a cold, mysterious man who changes women like clothes. But as Mahi gets closer, she realizes he is nothing less than a monster. What will happen if this monster falls in love with Mahi?

my-ghost-husband.title: My Ghost Husband
my-ghost-husband.description: Aadhira yaara love pannalum avunga iranthudaraanga. Avala oru aathma vidama thuraththikittu irukkuthu. Antha aathmakitterunthu avalala thappikka mudinjitha?

anbile-avan-raatchasan.title: Anbile Avan Raatchasan
anbile-avan-raatchasan.description: Toxic husbandaala baathikkappatta kayal oru social media appla oruththana meet pandra. Avana meet pannathukku apram avaloda life eh maarip poiduthu. Kayal miss pannuna happyness avankitta kidaichitha illa again toxic relationship la maattikittala?

how-to-deal-with-stress-anxiety.title: How To Deal With Stress & Anxiety
how-to-deal-with-stress-anxiety.description: Aaj ki bhaag daud bhari duniye mein ek stress-free life jeena bahut mushkil hai, aur aapki issi mushkil ko asaan banane ke liye laaye hain hum yeh khaas show.

rental-love.title: Rental Love
rental-love.description: Thannoda Kodikanakkaana Properties ku Vaarisu illainu varuthapattutu iruntha Adhithyaku, Doctor Shrushti oru arumaiyaana idea kodukkuraanga..athukkapuran thaan ellaa prachnaiyum aarambam aaguthu.. apdi enna thaan nadanthuchu Vaanga therinjukalaam.

rebirth-70-year-old-doctor-spicy-daughte.title: Rebirth, 70-year-old doctor, spicy daughter-in-law
rebirth-70-year-old-doctor-spicy-daughte.description: A witty and heartwarming drama where a renowned doctor is unexpectedly reborn into old age. Struggling with family chaos and a sharp-tongued daughter-in-law, he must balance wisdom with humor to heal not just patients, but also his own household.

my-mother-is-a-royal-guard-2.title: My Mother is a Royal Guard
my-mother-is-a-royal-guard-2.description: একজন কঠোর মা, যিনি প্রভাবশালী প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলোর জন্য কাজ করার পাশাপাশি নিজের মেয়েকে কঠোরভাবে প্রশিক্ষণ দেন, ধীরে ধীরে তাকে মানসিক ও শারীরিকভাবে ভেঙে ফেলেন। কিন্তু যখন এক ভয়ঙ্কর বিপদ সামনে আসে, তখন তিনি নিজের নিষ্ঠুর নিয়োগকর্তাদের বিরুদ্ধেও অবস্থান নেন — শুধু সেই মেয়েকে রক্ষা করার জন্য, যাকে একসময় তিনি কঠিনভাবে শাসন করতেন। ইস্পাতের মায়া এক তীব্র আবেগের  — কঠিন ভালোবাসা, প্রতারণা আর এক মায়ের শেষ আত্মবলিদানের কাহিনি।

shelter-in-mafia.title: Shelter in Mafia
shelter-in-mafia.description: After losing everything to her cheating husband, Tasha finds unexpected kindness from a taxi driver named Ken. Though fate pulls them apart, Ken keeps returning — and a deep romance begins to bloom. But behind his gentle smile lies a secret: Ken is the son of a mafia boss, chasing shadows from his past.

foresee-the-future-from-the-live-broadca.title: Foresee the future from the live broadcast
foresee-the-future-from-the-live-broadca.description: Heartbroken delivery boy John discovers supernatural premonitions after his fiancée's betrayal, compelling him to protect heiress Lena from a sinister plot by rival Sam. Lena, facing corporate ruin from her father's gambling, is forced into a reluctant alliance with Sam, escalating into a high-stakes "stone gambling" match. John heroically intervenes, saving Lena from Sam's schemes and later saving President Sara's children, earning a mysterious "Dragon pattern card." Amidst these events, John experiences bizarre transformations, gains wealth, and acquires military-grade weapons, culminating in a nuclear explosion. John forms an alliance with Sara to outmaneuver the powerful Van family in corporate auctions, publicly humiliating them and declaring war. He navigates a complex romantic dilemma, ultimately choosing Lina, and defends his mother's villa from greedy relatives. John rises as a formidable figure in digital finance, clashing with Sam over daring investments and eventually orchestrating Sam's catastrophic financial ruin. A fake relationship with Sara to deter a suitor hints at genuine feelings, but Zen Julius, whom John previously swindled, resurfaces as Sara's new boyfriend, vowing retribution. The conflict intensifies when Sara and Lina are violently kidnapped by Zen Julius, who demands a forced marriage for power, forcing John into a desperate rescue and a brutal test of self-sacrifice. John endures torture by Julius to protect Lena and Sara, surviving assaults via a mysterious 'Life Donation System' activated by loyal associates. His relationships with Lena and Sara deepen, culminating in an unconventional polyamorous marriage proposal, despite a sinister plot to drug him and the fading of his 'experience card' power. John later collapses from a mysterious illness, experiencing amnesia and unsettling visions. This leads to a terrifying transformation into a dangerous entity. Declaring himself a "time god," John promises revenge and ultimate control over destiny, setting the stage for a new reign of terror. The show explores themes of betrayal, corporate intrigue, family loyalty, and the escalating stakes of John's supernatural abilities, as he fights to protect loved ones and grapple with his own evolving, god-like powers and their terrifying implications.

a-beam-of-light-in-the-darkness-mothers-.title: A Beam of Light in the Darkness: Mother's Love
a-beam-of-light-in-the-darkness-mothers-.description: It's a heartwarming story of a mother who fights against fate to save her child.

alvida-bhai.title: Villain Buaa Ka Khooni Khel
alvida-bhai.description: Villain Buaa Ka Khooni Khel is a powerful crime drama about loyalty, betrayal, and redemption. Raghav, once the most feared gangster of Mumbai, decides to leave the underworld after a tragic loss. But as rivals close in, allies turn traitors, and his own brother rises against him, Raghav must fight one last bloody battle—between the man he was and the man he wants to be.

বড়লোক-বরের-কেনা-বউ.title: বড়লোক বরের কেনা বউ
বড়লোক-বরের-কেনা-বউ.description: আকাশ এবং নীলম স্বামী-স্ত্রী, বিয়ের পরে আকাশের মনে ভালবাসা জন্মালেও, সুখ টেকে না। আকাশ বিশ্বাস করে ভুল মানুষকে। নীলমের প্রতি ভালোবাসা হারায়। ফলাফল—ভেঙে যায় সংসার, হারিয়ে যায় তাদের সন্তান।

the-mistaken-girl-3.title: The Mistaken Girl
the-mistaken-girl-3.description: এই সিরিজটি একজন অতি-দৃঢ়প্রতিজ্ঞ মেয়ের হাস্যকর এবং অপ্রত্যাশিত দুর্ঘটনার কাহিনী অনুসরণ করে, যার চাওয়া পাওয়ার আগ্রহ প্রায়শই তাকে সমস্যার মুখে ঠেলে দেয়। তার আবেগঘন সিদ্ধান্ত, নাটকীয় ভুল বোঝাবুঝি এবং এরপরের বিশৃঙ্খলা একটি মজাদার এবং আবেগঘন রোলারকোস্টার তৈরি করে।

betrayal-after-sleep.title: Bloodline Betrayal
betrayal-after-sleep.description: Bloodline Betrayal is a suspenseful romantic drama about love, trust, and shocking secrets. Rhea, who wakes up from a two-year coma, finds her world shattered—her husband married to her best friend and her identity almost erased. As she pieces her life back together, betrayal turns into vengeance, and love into a dangerous game where nothing is as it seems.

the-mysterious-master-chef-4.title: The mysterious master chef
the-mysterious-master-chef-4.description: Rohan, who has been passionate about cooking since childhood, dreams of becoming a great chef despite growing up in poverty. He believes all he needs is a chance to showcase his talent. An unexpected twist enters his life with the Royal Hotel. Will Master Chef Anirudh, who works there, be in a position to give Rohan a chance? Who will emerge as the winner in this game among the chefs?

tech-ka-samrat.title: Tech Ka Samrat
tech-ka-samrat.description: What if you got a second chance to rewrite your destiny? Tech Samraat follows Arjun Malhotra, a genius inventor who travels back in time to save his father, his company, and his future. A high-octane story of betrayal, ambition, and the power of technology. Watch Now!

the-mistaken-girl-1.title: The Mistaken Girl
the-mistaken-girl-1.description: The microdrama begins with businessman Vamshi's engagement to Anshika, which is immediately thrown into turmoil by the online appearance of intimate photos of Vamshi with another woman. Anshika, driven by a ruthless desire for Vamshi's vast fortune and fueled by intense jealousy, vows brutal revenge against this 'other woman,' later identified as Vanshika. Anshika's manipulative and violent tendencies escalate rapidly, leading to public assaults and profound humiliation of Vanshika, even after discovering Vanshika's pregnancy. A shocking twist reveals Vanshika to be Vamshi's sister, not his lover, clarifying the initial misunderstanding but leading to tragic consequences, including the severe injury and loss of Vanshika's unborn child due to Anshika's brutality. This revelation ignites Vamshi's fury and a vengeful pursuit by Vanshika's protector, Rajeev, while Anshika's true intentions to infiltrate the Varma family for wealth, along with her secret relationship with Raj, are exposed. Consequently, her engagement is annulled, and she faces expulsion from the affluent family, her reputation in tatters. The very future and legacy of the Varma family hang in the balance amidst these escalating betrayals. Despite facing accusations of deception and significant paternity doubts regarding her own pregnancy, Anshika desperately seeks to secure her child's future and her place within the powerful Varma family. She attempts to gain the approval of the patriarch, Janakidas, seeing an upcoming family event as her last desperate hope to regain status. Operating as CEO Navya Varma, Anshika navigates intense public scrutiny and corporate rivalries, facing challenges from cunning opportunists like Nivya who scheme to seize Janakidas's empire. The hidden paternity of Anshika's child, potentially linked to an incarcerated father, remains a critical secret, adding another layer to her complex deceptions. She attempts to secure her position through lavish, but ultimately fraudulent, gifts to the patriarch, and audaciously claims her unborn child is Vamshi's to gain control of his assets and family position. However, the astute Navya (Vamshi's sister), who reveals her own hidden identity as a powerful real estate magnate, repeatedly exposes Anshika's elaborate schemes and counterfeit offerings, publicly discrediting her. A conclusive DNA test and a revealing video transmitted by Anshika's secret boyfriend, Raj, ultimately unravel Anshika's entire web of lies, proving her child is not Vamshi's and confirming her manipulative plot to attribute Raj's child and Vamshi's assets to Vamshi. The drama culminates with Vamshi decisively severing all ties with Anshika and her parent, apologizing to Navya for past events, as the family begins to heal and move towards a new phase of resolution, having overcome Anshika's destructive influence and secured their legacy.

daughter-of-the-secret-tycoon-2.title: Daughter of the secret tycoon
daughter-of-the-secret-tycoon-2.description: Ms.Rai  lived a quiet life—until a scandal forced her into the spotlight and the arms of powerful CEO Rishi. But when secrets about her true identity surface, everything changes. Daughter Of The Secret Tycoon is a tale of hidden legacies, unexpected romance, and a girl who went from overlooked to unstoppable. Watch Now!

silver-love.title: Silver Love
silver-love.description: Initially, Sarika, concerned for her father Harshvardhan Mehra's future solitude after her own medical emergency, orchestrates a 'swayamvar' for him, only for him to reveal he has already found someone. Concurrently, Nandita, a humble mother-in-law, endures relentless humiliation and abuse from her arrogant daughter-in-law, Preeti, and financially dependent son, Raghav, eventually leading to Raghav's violent outburst and Nandita's homelessness. Unbeknownst to Nandita, Harshvardhan, a powerful CEO, initiates a meticulous investigation into her past, eventually preparing to meet her under the assumed identity of 'Vijay the electrician,' a deception Nandita is aware of. Nandita's compassionate nature often leads to personal complications, causing her to miss a crucial date with Vijay, who struggles to maintain his facade of a humble electrician while also navigating a budding romance with Jia, who suspects his exaggerated claims. Vijay, secretly Harshvardhan, proposes marriage to Nandita, who grapples with the decision, balancing her desire for happiness with loyalty to her son. Her secret remarriage to the electrician ignites a firestorm of ageist and classist hostility from her daughter-in-law and family patriarch. Preeti and Raghav cruelly exploit Nandita, plotting her public humiliation under the guise of a family celebration, though a compassionate young man emerges as her protector. The narrative also introduces Riiti, who faces similar familial prejudice and endures brutal expulsion from her home. The conflict escalates dramatically when Nandita, visiting her grandson, is brutally assaulted and falsely accused of theft by Preeti and a male accomplice, facing public shaming and threats. Harshvardhan Mehra dramatically intervenes, revealing his true, powerful identity and retaliating against Preeti and her accomplice. Devastated by this deception and the foundational lie in their marriage, Nandita leaves Harshvardhan and their daughter. However, their daughter falls critically ill due to psychological stress, drawing Nandita back. Nandita confronts Harshvardhan, demanding an absolute promise of honesty as a condition for their fragile reconciliation, highlighting the high stakes of trust and truth.

betrayed-heiress-vengeance-reborn-4.description: A girl defies her adoptive parents and returns to her birth family, only to find her place taken by another beloved girl. She is harassed and nearly killed in a car accident. With her dying breath, she vows never to repay anyone’s debts again. Sent back into the past, she faces the same betrayals — but this time, she rises strong and ruthless, ready to claim revenge against all wrongs. Watch "Betrayed Heiress: Vengeance Reborn" now!

saas-ko-shock.title: Saas Bahu aur Drama
saas-ko-shock.description: The microdrama centers on Meera, a woman initially facing public humiliation and accusations of infertility from her formidable mother-in-law, Sunita. Meera bravely reveals her husband Rajiv's infertility, challenging patriarchal judgment, only to uncover Sunita's sinister plot to replace her with Anamika, a woman from Rajiv's past. This investigation leads to the devastating discovery that Rajiv has a hidden child with Anamika, a secret meticulously concealed by Sunita, shattering Meera's marriage and exposing Sunita's long history of deception driven by "family honor" and class prejudice. As Meera endures relentless abuse, she defiantly vows to prove her worth, achieving professional success as a businesswoman, which ignites Sunita's jealousy and a vow for revenge. Sunita orchestrates Meera's downfall through forgery, leading to a massive loan and a reopened fraud case, resulting in Meera's arrest. Amidst these challenges, Rajiv supports Meera, revealing his own secret about their childless status to protect her, and Meera launches a women's empowerment initiative, "Meera's Second Chance." The narrative deepens as Rajiv investigates a corporate forgery, leading to the shocking discovery of his adoption and that Sunita is not his biological mother. His true biological mother, Kusum Mishra, re-emerges after decades, exposing Sunita's deception, including stealing Rajiv and institutionalizing Kusum. Rajiv, forming an alliance with Meera, confronts Sunita about her manipulative schemes and disinherits her. Concurrently, Meera confronts her ex-lover, Rohan, accusing him of professional sabotage. However, Meera's life is further shattered by a conspiracy orchestrated by Sunita and Rohan, involving "fake relationship certificates" and false accusations of sexual harassment, publicly ruining Meera's reputation. Rajiv initially questions Meera's loyalty, accusing her of infidelity, pushing him to despair. Meera, abandoned, finds an unexpected ally and meticulously orchestrates Rohan's public downfall, exposing his deceit, though Rajiv is violently attacked, leaving his fate uncertain. Anamika, Rajiv's past love and mother of his child, forms an unlikely alliance with Meera to seek revenge on Sunita and Rohan, launching a viral social media exposé that dismantles their reputations. Meera selflessly attempts to reunite Rajiv with Anamika, believing her to be his true love, but Rajiv, burdened by self-hatred, eventually confesses his deep love for Meera. Ultimately, Rajiv reunites with Anamika and discovers their secret son, with Anamika accepting his marriage proposal under the condition of avoiding his antagonistic mother-in-law. The mystery culminates with escalating threats to Meera's career, including blackmail and arson, linked to a cryptic clue and Rajiv's forgotten childhood. A posthumous letter from Rajiv's father, Rajendra, reveals a shocking history of forbidden love with Kusum, tragically thwarted by Sunita's insidious black magic and manipulative control over Rajendra. Rajendra, long presumed dead, returns, exposing Sunita's sinister web of deceit and delivering an ultimatum that forces Meera and Rajiv to confront a legacy of betrayal and a powerful family struggle.

he-comes-from-the-mountains.title: He comes from the mountains
he-comes-from-the-mountains.description: The microdrama begins with the tragic accidental drowning of young Michael, leaving his younger brother Leo burdened by profound survivor's guilt and their parents, Sam and Radha, heartbroken. Years later, a devastating fire separates the family, prompting a now successful adult Leo to embark on a relentless quest to find his missing parents. Simultaneously, Leo cultivates a fabricated elite image, preparing for his wedding to Mia and hiring impersonators to maintain his facade of social standing. Unbeknownst to him, Sam and Radha, now elderly and ailing, arrive in the city, struggling financially but determined to reunite with their son without burdening him. The situation culminates in a heartbreaking confrontation at the wedding where Leo publicly denies Sam and Radha, introducing the impersonators as his true family. Secretly, Michael, who was presumed dead, has returned as a powerful CEO, orchestrating a grand family reunion and seeking justice for his parents. He is revealed to be the "Mr. Clark" or "God of Money" who systematically dismantles the Smith family's empire, into which Leo desperately seeks to marry, and confronts other ruthless exploiters of his biological parents. Leo faces an intense identity crisis when his biological parents dramatically confront him, presenting irrefutable proof of their relationship. DNA evidence conclusively confirms his true parentage, leading to a violent confrontation and his disownment by both his biological father and his adoptive parents, whom he also rejects. Michael, fiercely protective of his vulnerable true parents, intervenes in these conflicts, even suffering severe injury while defending them. As his fabricated elite image shatters, Leo struggles with his ambition and past deceptions, facing public humiliation. His biological father initially disowns him, but his mother, Radha (also referred to as Rani), relentlessly pleads for reconciliation and recognition. Eventually, Leo, facing his father's anger but his mother's unwavering forgiveness, desperately seeks and receives forgiveness from Michael. The family attempts to heal their fractured bonds, navigating the destructive power of long-held secrets and class struggle. The series culminates with Michael entrusting Leo with the care of their elderly parents and his fortune before an overseas trip, hinting at a fragile peace and lingering threats to their newfound unity. This complex journey explores profound themes of identity, betrayal, and the arduous path towards redemption and familial unity.

there-is-none-under-heaven-to-equal-her-.title: There is none under heaven to equal her
there-is-none-under-heaven-to-equal-her-.description: The series begins amidst a period of intense martial arts conflict and cultural struggle, as young prodigies like Appu and Yonor emerge, driven by vengeance and a desire to protect their people and traditions against tyrannical foes and foreign invaders. Revered masters face betrayal and the erosion of their heritage, often making great sacrifices to preserve their legacies. As the conflict escalates, defiant individuals challenge established powers, uncovering sinister plots against their nations and confronting formidable adversaries, while others embark on quests for revenge against powerful networks. Themes of family honor and legacy become central, with characters striving to reclaim stolen inheritances, expose decade-old conspiracies, and forge strategic alliances to restore their families' standing amidst prejudice and political maneuvering. A mysterious young woman dramatically seizes control of a realm, while others navigate complex family feuds and high-stakes competitions. A pivotal figure, initially accused of disrespecting revered authorities and claiming divine power, ignites widespread outrage across the martial world. This young woman, often from the Song family, faces demands for her and her lineage's annihilation, yet defiantly refuses to yield. Her true identity is dramatically revealed as the genuine War God and Divine Master, unleashing devastating retribution against those who transgressed. She embarks on a perilous, divinely-mandated quest for justice and truth, seeking to reunite with her exiled mother and expose a century-old legacy of betrayal and internal strife within powerful families. The narrative culminates in a sprawling conspiracy to destroy the prominent Song family and seize powerful artifacts, leading to desperate struggles for survival and vengeance. Heroes like Divine Guru Xiao launch high-stakes rescue missions, while formidable warriors are ambushed, igniting fierce quests for retribution. Characters confront the formidable War God Yudha Deva, who holds loved ones hostage and demands sacred ancestral artifacts, forcing impossible choices and ultimate sacrifices. Amidst brutal wars and supernatural threats, survivors fight to rebuild their decimated lineages, with an Emperor even taking unprecedented steps to restore the disgraced Song family, hinting at a larger, unfolding power struggle for the fate of the martial world and its ancient traditions.

divorced-single-mother-7.description: Radhika, an estranged and humble daughter, returns to her wealthy mother Mira's 70th birthday, immediately igniting deep-seated family tensions and class conflicts. Her modest gift, a necklace, is met with cruel humiliation and accusations of theft from her materialistic sisters and mother. However, the necklace is dramatically revealed to be an ancient artifact valued at hundreds of crores, shocking the family and sparking accusations of fraud. As Radhika grapples with past betrayals and new threats, her sons, initially dismissed as failures, emerge as immensely wealthy and successful tech entrepreneurs and medical innovators, systematically vindicating their mother against jealous relatives and socialites. This newfound status is challenged by Radhika's wealthy ex-husband, Rakesh, who publicly humiliates her and attempts to force his way back into her life. Radhika's CEO son, Gaurav, vows revenge against his estranged father, uncovering Rakesh's corrupt dealings and orchestrating his downfall with the help of his loyal assistant, Aarti. Amidst corporate intrigue, a romance blossoms between Gaurav and Aarti, whose father is secretly a powerful CEO crucial to Gaurav's business deals. Radhika herself finds new love with Anil, a powerful tech CEO, but their romance is violently interrupted by Rakesh, who exposes Radhika's secret identity as the mother of billionaires. A deadly corporate conspiracy then targets Anil and Gaurav's father, leading to Gaurav heroically rescuing Anil and securing a major merger between their companies. The series culminates with Gaurav and Aarti balancing their professional ambitions with traditional family expectations for their impending marriage, as Radhika's family navigates their rise to power, confronting themes of honor, betrayal, and social perception.

doctor-vs-billioniares.title: Doctor Vs Billionaires
doctor-vs-billioniares.description: A playful prank between young Arya and her grandfather, Dadu, tragically leads to Arya's sudden collapse and a critical medical emergency, setting off a desperate fight for her life. As Arya battles for survival, her family faces immense challenges: her mother plans a surprise birthday unaware of the crisis, and her father is involved in a car crash. Dedicated physicians, including Kunal, are repeatedly obstructed by an arrogant heiress, Nivedita, delaying urgent medical attention for Arya. The situation escalates when Arya's father, Dr. Raghunath, a renowned child specialist, is brutally held captive by ruthless extortionists demanding exorbitant sums, preventing him from reaching his critically ill daughter who battles a rare disease. Dr. Raghunath is further coerced by a cunning Young Man and Preeti into a false confession and promises a hefty sum, hinting at a deeper conspiracy that delays his critical treatment. Arya's distraught grandfather, Paresh, struggles with communication after a devastating car crash leaves Arya critically injured, and is scammed into paying for her surgery under false pretenses. Arya's parents, Nilima and Roshan, initially dismissive, embark on a frantic search, fueled by blame and anger, leading them to Arya's critical bedside where a grim prognosis is delivered amidst institutional denial and a past vendetta. Financial demands and a shocking claim of paternity further complicate their anguish. A tragic misidentification occurs when an 11-year-old child dies, and Arya's parents mistakenly confirm her as their daughter, only for a mysterious man to claim paternity. Miraculously, Arya, long presumed dead, is found alive but injured, and Dr. Raghunath ultimately saves her life. However, his heroism makes him the target of a mysterious antagonist, prompting Roshan's son, Munna, to vow vengeance. Later, Arya's life is again in critical danger, with her parents, Sanjay and Jia, unknowingly obstructing the doctor, and a guilt-ridden Ankit linking her suffering to his past actions. Ankit, after achieving justice, experiences a brief peace shattered by a sudden, devastating car crash, plunging his world into new tragedy. The show explores the desperate fight for life against callous privilege, ruthless deception, and escalating violence, with Arya's fate and her family's future hanging precariously amidst a web of conspiracies and personal vendettas.

the-wonderful-life-after-a-flash-marriag.title: The Wonderful Life After a Flash Marriage
the-wonderful-life-after-a-flash-marriag.description: The series begins with Jian Miyan, an intern doctor, entering a contract marriage with the wealthy bank executive Dr. Gu to settle her father's gambling debts. Despite their union, their relationship is fraught with suspicion, as Dr. Gu, also known as Gu Jinzhang, accuses Jian Miyan of infidelity and carrying another man's child, leading to marital strain and his prolonged absence. Amidst her struggles with exhaustion and professional duties, Jian Miyan is inexplicably drawn to Dr. Gu, who is also the new hospital president and owner, and he consistently protects her from harassment, dramatically revealing his true identity as a powerful corporate heir. As their complex connection deepens, a series of misunderstandings and hidden identities unfold. Jian Miyan, sometimes referred to as Jiang Mian or Jung Man, faces public humiliations and perceived betrayals, often being mistaken for others or impersonating friends at high-stakes events. Dr. Gu repeatedly intervenes, publicly claiming her as his wife and validating her status, even as he grapples with his own romantic assumptions and a desire to divorce his unseen spouse to pursue a new love, Jung Mi-yeon. A significant turning point occurs when Jiang Mian suffers amnesia after an accident, falling prey to Dr. Gu's manipulative younger brother, Gu Jingcheng, who impersonates his sibling to claim her. This period of deception further complicates their already strained relationship. However, the truth eventually unravels: Dr. Gu realizes that the woman he loves, Jung Man, is his long-unseen legal wife, revealing their secret contract marriage. Despite Jung Man's pregnancy with another man's child, Dr. Gu defiantly refuses to finalize their divorce, confessing his profound romantic feelings for her and resolving to win her heart. Their professional relationship evolves into an intimate, albeit tense, shared experience, as they become stranded and fight for survival, hinting at deeper feelings. The series culminates in Dr. Gu's dramatic public confession of his long-held, forbidden love for Zheng Mian (Jung Man/Jiang Mian), challenging her existing marital vows. After grappling with her commitments, she ultimately agrees to explore their deep connection, affirming a shared future together and reflecting on their intriguing past connection forged at a hospital.

my-crorepati-husband-2.title: My Crorepati Husband
my-crorepati-husband-2.description: The microdrama opens with Arjun, a struggling husband, facing immense marital strain with Sushmita due to financial difficulties and the manipulative interference of Sushmita's wealthy childhood friend, Jagan, and her formidable mother. Arjun endures public humiliation, accusations of deceit, and demands for divorce, yet defiantly stands by his character. A dramatic turn reveals Arjun's hidden fortune, stunning his detractors and offering a chance at redemption, though also hinting at a calculated revenge. The narrative then plunges into a tumultuous family and corporate world, marked by Jagan's return and his persistent attempts to marry Sushmita, intensifying a complex love triangle. Power struggles unfold amidst lavish gatherings, with Arjun's growing influence clashing with established figures. Arjun, initially framed for theft and facing divorce, begins to navigate a web of corporate intrigue and personal rivalries, fiercely defended by Sushmita and unexpectedly aided by a powerful heiress, Ananya Madam. He vows deadly revenge against his family for past betrayals, revealing himself to be a figure of immense power despite his current struggles. Defying public humiliation attempts, Arjun asserts his authority, rising to become the new Chairman and challenging established hierarchies. He ruthlessly dismantles corruption within the company, clashing with former classmates and rivals like Jagan and his father, Raghuram, who expose Arjun's past as a "useless son-in-law." The conflict escalates into brutal power struggles, with Arjun physically confronting Jagan and Ashwin, another rival pursuing Sushmita. His elite status is challenged, but he remains resolute in his quest for retribution and protection of his loved ones. A shocking revelation unveils Ashwin as the Chairman of WinCorp, only for Ananya Ravi to dramatically declare Arjun as the true Chairman, flipping the power dynamic. The series culminates in Sushmita discovering her husband, Arjun, is secretly the powerful Chairman of a major organization, a revelation that exposes a marriage built on concealed truths. lovely-baby-came-to-the-door.title: Lovely Baby Came to the Door
lovely-baby-came-to-the-door.description: The microdrama centers on Meera, a woman whose life is irrevocably altered by a heart-wrenching sacrifice for her ailing mother, a sacrifice that ultimately proves futile with her mother's death. This tragedy leads her into a complex relationship with the wealthy Krishna, who later re-enters her life. Years later, Meera, now a renowned designer, returns, unknowingly drawing closer to Krishna and a shared, hidden past involving her stolen child, Varun. Varun, repeatedly running away from his "bad woman" mother, Neela, is eventually found by Meera, sparking a mutual recognition with Krishna and hinting at a profound, unspoken connection. As Meera navigates corporate intrigue, facing false accusations and predatory advances, a deeper conspiracy unfolds around Varun's true parentage. Krishna, initially suspicious of Meera, gradually becomes her protector, especially as Varun expresses a strong desire for Meera to be his mother, leading to a platonic contract marriage for the child's well-being. This arrangement, however, is fraught with jealousy and manipulation from Neela, who claims Varun as her biological son and orchestrates attacks and schemes against Meera. The truth slowly unravels: DNA evidence confirms Meera as Varun's biological mother, shattering her long-held belief of a stillbirth and exposing Neela's elaborate deception. Krishna confesses to orchestrating Meera giving birth to Varun, revealing a profound conspiracy. Simultaneously, Meera investigates her mother's suspicious death, uncovering a connection to the powerful Rao family and the matriarch Noormoy, who is implicated in both her mother's murder and a recent attempt on Meera's life. Meera discovers that Rao, Noormoy's husband, is her estranged father, who abandoned her pregnant mother years ago. Despite this painful revelation, Krishna stands by Meera, proposing a genuine marriage that she accepts, transforming their contractual bond into a true union. The series culminates in a final confrontation with Neela, who has kidnapped Varun, and the revelation of a fated connection between Meera's mother and Krishna, linked by a mysterious pendant. The show explores themes of protective love, hidden identities, corporate power struggles, and the enduring quest for truth and family.
