On her birthday, he was humiliated and thrown out by her greedy sister and scheming allies. Just then, his true identity is revealed… and his powerful fiancée makes a dramatic entrance! What Next? Watch Now!

married-my-boss-by-mistake.title: Married My Boss by Mistake
married-my-boss-by-mistake.description: The microdrama centers on Jia, an aspiring designer initially trapped in a secret contract marriage with powerful CEO Arjun, whose possessive nature frequently threatens to expose their hidden relationship and undermine her independence. As Jia, known by various aliases including Minal and Jiya, strives for professional autonomy, she faces relentless challenges from rival designers Rehana and Renuka, who hint at a mysterious past and accuse her of plagiarism. The conflict with Renuka intensifies dramatically as Jia battles to reclaim her rightful ownership of a luxurious villa and expose Renuka's fraudulent claims of property and a fabricated connection to Arjun. Through public confrontations and viral revelations, Jia successfully reclaims her identity and property, supported by Arjun, whose initial marriage of convenience begins to evolve into a genuine romantic pursuit, culminating in his public acknowledgment of their union. However, Jia's professional journey remains fraught with corporate intrigue and betrayal. She navigates a cutthroat luxury design world, battling accusations of design theft and plagiarism, even from a male competitor, and facing sabotage from jealous rivals like Meena. The stakes escalate with a mysterious substantial debt and threats linked to her past, while a shocking revelation exposes Arjun himself as actively plotting against her, trapping Jia in a complex web of corporate espionage and personal vendettas. Despite these betrayals, Jia perseveres, eventually rising to become a fashion CEO. Years later, her brand faces new plagiarism accusations, hinting at unresolved past transgressions. The series culminates with powerful CEO Siddharth dramatically unveiling his hidden marriage to Jia, who fiercely asserts her professional identity as a talented designer and brand ambassador, striving for independence amidst a complex corporate romance and her ongoing quest for truth and recognition.

divine-level-war-doctor-1.title: Divine-Level War Doctor
divine-level-war-doctor-1.description:
He wasn’t an ordinary doctor—he possessed supernatural powers. But the path he chose changed everything, blurring the line between healing and destiny.
Discover how one extraordinary man rewrote the rules of life itself.

my-mom-is-a-secret-don.title: My Mom is a Secret Don
my-mom-is-a-secret-don.description: The microdrama centers on Sanjana Malhotra, a formidable matriarch driven by an unyielding quest for vengeance and the protection of her daughter, Isha. Initially, Sanjana, and other mothers like Savi and Suhasini, face brutal threats and abductions targeting their daughters by powerful, ruthless families like the Raichands. Sanjana's own daughter, Isha, is repeatedly attacked, targeted with illness, and brutally kidnapped, igniting an 18-year vendetta against the influential Raichand dynasty. Transforming into a fierce warrior, Sanjana confronts patriarchs like Rajnath and scions like Rajat, defying their power and asserting her resolve. Her mission expands as she uncovers a sinister conspiracy involving Rajnat, who is implicated in causing Isha's illness and murdering Sanjana's grandfather. The stakes escalate dramatically when Isha is held captive and slated for auction by the ruthless Shetty crime syndicate, intended as a 'trump card' in a human trafficking operation. Sanjana, aided by allies like Neel and Dev, infiltrates dangerous compounds and high-stakes auctions, engaging in brutal combat to rescue Isha. However, Dev's protective instincts eventually shatter into betrayal, complicating Sanjana's path. Driven by a burning desire for retribution for her parents' murder and her daughter's repeated kidnappings, Sanjana systematically dismantles the Shetty Group empire. She orchestrates a hostile corporate takeover, using it as bait to draw out her elusive rivals. Ultimately, Sanjana executes a meticulously planned retribution, seizing control of the Shetty Group and declaring herself the new head of a combined entity. Her journey culminates in establishing herself as a powerful new leader, ready to protect her people, having avenged her family and secured her daughter's future amidst a world of betrayal and power struggles.

hero-of-the-construction-site-2.title: Hero Of The Construction Site
hero-of-the-construction-site-2.description: Amid construction site dangers and hardships, two families—owners and laborers—find their lives deeply intertwined. A widowed labor leader’s courage and honesty win the heart of the company’s lady owner, bringing hope and healing to a struggling child. A heartfelt tale of love, resilience, and unity rising from the dust and toil of the construction world.

the-runaway-groom.title: The Runaway Groom
the-runaway-groom.description: On his wedding day, a groom vanishes without a trace, leaving behind heartbreak and unanswered questions. As secrets unfold, love, betrayal, and destiny collide in a race to uncover the truth.

my-dads-got-trillions-of-dollars-in-asse.title: My dad's got trillions of dollars in assets
my-dads-got-trillions-of-dollars-in-asse.description: Initially appearing as an elderly, humble driver, Peter heroically saves a child but is unjustly accused of harm and fraud, an incident that begins to unravel his hidden past as a self-made business mogul. This revelation complicates his relationship with his CEO son, Leo, who is navigating a crucial business deal, while Peter's burgeoning connection with Sabrina, who defends him against her arrogant arranged suitor Jacob, deepens. Peter orchestrates Jacob's downfall, but this leads to a high-stakes corporate war with John Victor, Peter's vengeful former business partner, who attempts a hostile takeover of Leo's company. Peter dramatically reveals his true identity as the Chairman of Sigma International, saving Leo's company and preparing for an intense corporate battle against Victor's fraudulent empire. The conflict escalates into a fierce struggle for control of Supreme Company, where Peter strategically outmaneuvers Victor, exposing his financial manipulation. However, a new threat emerges with Alice from Race Company, who manipulates Victor against Peter, culminating in the violent abduction of Peter's children, Sabrina and Leo, by the powerful Race family. Peter's wife and son are held hostage by Alice, an enforcer for Morgan Chada, demanding Peter surrender to the Reis family, fueling Peter's vow of vengeance against the influential Rays/Race family. Amidst this, Alice, revealed as a cunning heiress, offers Peter a strategic contract marriage to clear his massive debt and protect his family, blurring the lines between enemy and potential savior. Simultaneously, Peter confronts a manipulative Mayor over corruption, dramatically exposing him for land fraud and publicly revealing his true corporate identity as the formidable Chairman of Sigma. Peter then seeks to marry Sabrina, facing intense opposition from her traditional family, but uses his influence and a legendary painting to secure reluctant consent. The show culminates with a mysterious figure from Peter's past subtly blackmailing him, hinting at a hidden transgression that threatens his newly established life and family, leaving his future uncertain.

the-westward-1.title: The Westward
the-westward-1.description: An epic fantasy adventure inspired by Journey to the West, where gods, demons, and mortals clash in a world of magic and destiny. Season 1 follows the unlikely band of heroes as they set out on a perilous journey, testing their courage, loyalty, and bonds while uncovering the secrets of the heavens and the underworld.

rebirth-hunting-crimes-album-3.title: Rebirth : Hunting Crimes Album
rebirth-hunting-crimes-album-3.description: 'Rebirth: Hunting Crimes Album' tells the story of a girl, a former assassin reborn with supernatural abilities and a new life as a teenager. She faces accusations of murder and hacking, but her unique skills attract the attention of a military officer, leading to a proposition of marriage in exchange for clearing her name. The narrative explores themes of revenge, redemption, and the complexities of navigating a new life with a dark past.

my-junior-sister-went-mad-1.title: My Junior Sister Went Mad
my-junior-sister-went-mad-1.description: Once a devoted disciple of Kunlun Mountain, NANCY faces betrayal from her sect, rejection from her master, and humiliation by her peers. When her loyalty is shattered and her spirit crushed, she declares war on those who wronged her—including her so-called junior sister, SONIYA. My Junior Sister Went Mad is a fierce tale of vengeance, broken bonds, and a woman reclaiming her power at any cost.

the-dragon-returns-to-his-homeland-2.title: The Dragon Returns to His Homeland
the-dragon-returns-to-his-homeland-2.description: They called him "The Dragon" – a force of nature driven from the land he once protected. Now, a desperate plea from his ravaged homeland ignites a burning resolve within him. Returning to a kingdom teetering on the brink of collapse, he finds his people oppressed and his family's legacy tarnished. With a path paved by brutal enemies and forgotten allies, The Dragon must unleash his dormant power and reclaim his rightful place, not just for vengeance, but to forge a new destiny for his shattered land.

mother-in-law-was-in-a-car-accident-1.title: Mother In Law was in a Car Accident
mother-in-law-was-in-a-car-accident-1.description: A car crash. A courtroom. A marriage on the brink. When a public confrontation erupts between husband and wife during his mother's accident trial, the fight for justice becomes a fight for their very survival as a couple.

mrfu-spoils-his-wife-too-much.title: Mr.Fu Spoils His Wife Too Much
mrfu-spoils-his-wife-too-much.description: He forced her to marry him. She hated his new husband to the core. But when fate shows their twisted future, everything changes. Will love win or will they fail?

dil-se-gareeb-bank-balance-se-king.title: Beghar Billionaire
dil-se-gareeb-bank-balance-se-king.description: Armaan Raheja, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kashish, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

dont-come-im-fine-4.title: Don't Come, I'm Fine
dont-come-im-fine-4.description: A couple deeply in love builds a happy family with their young son. But doubt creeps in—he begins to suspect the child isn’t truly his. This is a gripping tale of trust, suspicion, and the hidden truth that will finally come to light.

villain-bana-hero.title: Villain Bana Hero
villain-bana-hero.description: A struggling delivery boy dies in an accident but wakes up inside a novel as its villain, forced to survive against the all-powerful hero. With wit, sarcasm, and unexpected charm, he twists fate while juggling danger, romance, and betrayal.

hidden-love-surges-6.title: Hidden Love Surges
hidden-love-surges-6.description: The series opens with Liya's world shattering as her long-term boyfriend, Robin, betrays her by announcing his engagement to heiress Reema, despite Liya's profound sacrifices for his career. Her public confrontation at the lavish ceremony leads to further humiliation as Robin manipulates her with false promises and later orchestrates her public shaming as a gold-digger to protect his ambition. Desperate to save her ailing father, Liya finds herself abandoned by Robin, who vanishes when crucial medical funds are needed, pushing her to a presumed suicide attempt. However, supported by her loyal friend Teena, Liya undergoes a profound transformation, moving from victim to a formidable fighter, seeking justice against Robin's malicious online posting of intimate photos. A male confidant vows to bring her tormentor to justice, setting the stage for a powerful fight for dignity and retribution. As Liya rebuilds, her path intertwines with Edwin, who steps in as her protector against Robin's significant debts and threats, sparking a complex, on-again, off-again romantic tension. Concurrently, Teena's marriage to Edwin faces immense strain due to his controlling nature, external pressures, and his own burgeoning affairs with other women, including Leah and Amrutha, leading to marital implosion and a bitter divorce. Teena, initially a supportive friend, evolves into an ambitious corporate executive, navigating a cutthroat environment where she faces professional sabotage from rivals like Albert, who exploits her personal life and seeks to undermine her career. The narrative escalates into a fierce corporate battle, with Teena and Leah (often referred to interchangeably with Liya) becoming bitter rivals for professional dominance and Edwin's affection. Leah, harboring a long-standing love for Edwin, forms alliances to challenge Teena, leading to physical altercations and manipulative tactics in their intense fight for a manager position. Teena's ambition grows ruthless, culminating in her promotion to General Manager, where she wields tyrannical control, subjects Leah to relentless psychological torment, and orchestrates Edwin's firing as an act of revenge for past betrayals and perceived conspiracies. However, Teena's triumph is short-lived as she faces accusations of unethical career advancement, public denouncement, and her own dramatic downfall due to a damaging video and betrayal by a trusted confidant, Rayan. Stripped of everything and publicly humiliated, Teena descends into despair, yet a fierce spark of defiance ignites, setting her on a thrilling path of revenge. In a separate, dark turn, Leah suffers a brutal acid attack from a jealous rival, Gina, highlighting the extreme consequences of the show's intense personal vendettas and long-held resentments. The series explores themes of profound betrayal, relentless ambition, escalating revenge, and the blurred lines between personal and professional loyalties, as characters are pushed to their limits in a desperate fight for dignity, power, and survival.

payback-time.title: Contract Wali Mohabbat
payback-time.description: What happens when a marriage is just a contract, but the heart refuses to follow the rules? Payback Time is a gripping tale of desire, deception, and a woman’s determination to fight for her love. Watch Now !

saas-bahu-billionaire.title: Billionaire Parents ki Bezzati
saas-bahu-billionaire.description: The microdrama begins with Sanjay and Pratha's 30th wedding anniversary, which is abruptly interrupted by an urgent family matter. Simultaneously, their daughter, Lisa, a dedicated resort manager, is offered a significant promotion by CEO Rahul Lamba, unaware that the VIP guests she must impress are her own parents. This professional opportunity quickly devolves into a shocking family reunion and escalating conflicts, as Lisa, revealed to be the sadistic Ananya, begins to torment her parents, Sanjay and Pratha, and other guests like Sajan and Gauri. The resort transforms into a battleground of class disparity, ambition, and revenge, culminating in a chilling trap set for Sanjay and Pratha, and violent confrontations. As the torment intensifies, Sanjay and Pratha are subjected to brutal physical and psychological abuse, desperately claiming to be "Mr. and Mrs. Lamba," parents of a powerful figure, to escape their aggressors. This struggle intertwines with a ruthless power play involving a vengeful employee, Jia, and a manipulative partner, Priya, amidst corporate ambition and a chilling conspiracy. The Lamba family's identity and legacy come under relentless attack, with the matriarch, Bimla, and her husband held captive and tormented by the menacing Roohi, while their sons, Rahul and Arjun, grapple with the crisis. Neena and Sanjay Lamba face accusations of being imposters, forcing Neena into humiliating apologies to protect her vulnerable husband. CEO Rahul Lamba initially prioritizes company image over reports of assault, but his perspective shifts when his father, Mr. Lamba, falls critically ill, prompting his mother's plea against his vengeful impulses. His ambitious girlfriend, Sanjita, schemes for social ascent while Rahul makes a high-stakes play for CEO. The narrative takes a dark turn when Rahul publicly accuses his mother, Mrs. Lamba, of theft, inciting a violent mob from which his children, Simran and his son, bravely defend her. The truth unravels as Rahul discovers his parents were brutally tortured and framed by a manipulative employee, Manav, prompting him to intervene, reveal their true identity, and ultimately fire those responsible in a dramatic corporate confrontation. However, the conflict is not fully resolved. Simran faces destitution and jail time, pressured to sell her mother's flat for redemption, only to be refused forgiveness by the CEO of the Lamba Group, who reveals Simran and her associate hospitalized her husband. Rahul ultimately battles a ruthless Liza to rescue his captive mother and Simran, though Simran resists, blaming "the group" for ruining her life, hinting at deeper, unresolved conflicts and a continuing struggle for justice and identity within the powerful Lamba dynasty. The show explores themes of familial betrayal, the corrupting influence of power, and the desperate fight for dignity and survival against relentless adversaries.

restarting-life-from-zero.title: Restarting Life From Zero
restarting-life-from-zero.description: Restarting Life From Zero" follows Nikhil, a shrewd businessman betrayed by his greedy wife Sushma and her family, as he loses everything but discovers hope again with Deepika, a selfless young woman who teaches him love and resilience. Amidst Sushma’s schemes, her foolish son Nihal, brother Mitesh, and manipulative mother Bharti, Nikhil fights to rebuild his world from scratch turning betrayal into strength, and revenge into a new beginning. Watch Now!

a-heartbeat-away-4.title: A Heartbeat Away
a-heartbeat-away-4.description: এক সময় ছিল প্রেমিক-প্রেমিকা, এখন তারা নির্মম কর্পোরেট দুনিয়ার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী। কিন্তু পুরোনো আগুন আবার জ্বলে ওঠে, আর লুকানো সত্য উঠে এলে ক্ষমতার খেলা হয়ে ওঠে একান্তই ব্যক্তিগত।

my-silly-rich-wife.title: My Silly Rich Wife
my-silly-rich-wife.description: MY SILLY RICH WIFE RICH AND POWERFULL FAMILY

nerd-billionaire.title: Employee se Empire Tak
nerd-billionaire.description:
Kabir Malhotra, a poor peon in the mighty Singhania Empire, is humiliated every day for his poverty but when Meher Singhania, the owner’s daughter, sees something different in him, his life begins to change.
From a chaprasi to a social media star and finally a billionaire, Kabir's journey is of dignity, love and unstoppable rise.

the-devil-wears-desire-4.title: The Devil Wears Desire
the-devil-wears-desire-4.description: తన ప్రియుడిని కాపాడేందుకు ఒక యువతి CEOకు రహస్య ప్రేయసిగా మారుతుంది. కానీ పరిస్థితులు ఆమెను ఒక క్రైం లార్డ్‌తో బలవంతపు వివాహంలోకి నెట్టేస్తాయి. కిడ్నాప్ అయ్యిన ఆమెను రక్షించేందుకు ఆమె గత ప్రేమికులు కలుస్తారు.

maids-plan.title: Maids Plan
maids-plan.description: A sharp-witted young woman and her brother initiate a scheme to infiltrate wealthy households, setting the stage for a complex drama within the affluent Hinduja family. Initially, the family's long-serving maid, Rani, is framed for theft by the trusted tutor, Sarah, revealing early betrayals and hidden agendas. Further domestic tensions arise when Mrs. Hinduja is discovered impersonating a maid, hinting at deep marital discord and financial secrets within the seemingly perfect household. Rani, after an attempted assault, becomes a pawn in Mrs. Hinduja's larger agenda, agreeing to a payout to pursue the responsible driver. Concurrently, a cunning mastermind orchestrates a tax evasion plot to seize the Hinduja house and business, involving his own family in the scheme. New tutor Pari arrives, quickly sensing hidden conflicts and witnessing violent outbursts, while facing flirtations and professional challenges from the arrogant heir, Aryan. Mrs. Hinduja hires Pari to discipline Aryan, leading to clashes over values, though Pari is later pressured to return to him. A powerful CEO, identified as Mr. Hinduja, tasks his son Sonu with mentoring Aryan for succession, while also testing Sonu's loyalty to his moral breaking point. Sara, a former tutor, faces banishment and accusations of theft from Mrs. Sinduja, hinting at a past betrayal and the influence of an unseen

the-return-of-the-heiress-discernment-of.title: The Return of the Heiress: Discernment of Pearls
the-return-of-the-heiress-discernment-of.description: The microdrama centers on Lily, a talented jeweler with a hidden past and multiple identities, navigating a treacherous world of corporate intrigue and personal betrayal. Initially, she is entangled in a conspiracy with CEO Tom to seize a company and divorce his heiress wife, while simultaneously emerging as a visionary in the high-tech and jewelry industries. Her life becomes further complicated when she enters an arranged marriage, possibly with Max or Arjun, to reclaim her lost home, all while operating as the enigmatic "Masked Goddess." Lily faces relentless challenges, including accusations of fraud, corporate espionage, and a sinister plot by her ex-husband and adopted sister, Flora, who murdered her parents to seize her legacy. Amidst these dangers, a complex romance blossoms with Max, who becomes her protector against assassins and corporate rivals. Their relationship is tested by Max's authoritative father, who forces an engagement, and by the manipulative Jacinta, Max's childhood sweetheart and corporate rival, who schemes to sabotage Lily's career and relationship. Lily uncovers a billion-dollar fraud involving Tom and Flora, leading to Tom's company's downfall and Max's hostile takeover, with Lily ultimately reclaiming control of her family's jewelry empire. The conflict escalates as Tom, fueled by humiliation, orchestrates Lily's violent abduction, from which she is dramatically rescued. However, Flora, Lily's adopted sister, confesses to orchestrating a devastating car crash and a history of sabotage driven by deep-seated envy. Following this, Lily vanishes and is presumed dead, leaving Max heartbroken. She is revealed to be alive, held captive and psychologically tormented by an obsessive individual who orchestrated her disappearance. Max embarks on a desperate, covert mission to find her, battling technical hurdles and false evidence of his betrayal. Eventually, Max discovers Lily is alive, leading to a dramatic confrontation and the apprehension of her tormentors. Lily returns home, weakened but reunited with Max, as they commit to their future, though a mysterious command from Lily hints at new challenges ahead.

mrs-pei-wants-to-return-to-the-countrysi.title: Mrs. Pei Wants to Return to the Countryside
mrs-pei-wants-to-return-to-the-countrysi.description: Sophia, fleeing an arranged marriage and a mysterious threat, arrives in the city seeking independence, unknowingly stepping into a destiny intertwined with powerful CEO Mr. James. James, desperately searching for a woman entrusted with a family locket, his "future Mrs. James," repeatedly crosses paths with Sophia, sparking an inexplicable connection despite her initial ambition to marry him for wealth. Sophia faces exploitation and danger at work from manipulative managers like John, but James frequently intervenes, growing increasingly protective of her. A locket eventually reveals Sophia's true identity as Nidhi, a hidden heiress to the James family, unfolding a shared past and deepening their bond. However, Sophia's best friend Rosie, who appears to have a hidden past with James, manipulates Sophia into sacrificing her feelings for him, claiming to be his fiancée and eventually marrying him. Rosie's escalating jealousy and possessiveness lead her to become obsessed with Sophia, whom she perceives as a rival, even attempting to replicate Sophia's scent and orchestrating schemes for her downfall. James struggles to conceal his growing feelings for Sophia from Rosie, eventually confessing his forbidden love, which Sophia initially rejects due to his engagement. James's powerful mother, the Matriarch, disapproves of Rosie, eventually orchestrating James's abandonment of Rosie and revealing a pre-arranged marriage, while subtly attempting to matchmake James and Sophia. Amidst these complex entanglements, Sophia discovers she is pregnant, sparking a paternity mystery as Jimmy claims fatherhood, but Sophia rejects him, determined to raise her child independently. The situation escalates with a hit ordered on Sophia and a car crash critically injuring her, leading James to discover a scar that confirms his paternity. Rosie's elaborate schemes, including a fake pregnancy, impersonation of Sophia, and attempts on Sophia's life, are ultimately exposed. The show culminates in a dramatic love triangle where Arun ultimately chooses Sophia, leaving Rosie abandoned and pregnant with Arun's child, while James prioritizes Sophia and their shared future, signaling a profound shift in his priorities and the triumph of true love and identity.

hansi-aur-virah.title: Hansi Aur Virah
hansi-aur-virah.description: A story where love meets sacrifice, and laughter hides deep pain. Hansi Aur Virah takes you through Mohit and Akshita’s journey of broken trust, lost time, and tough choices. Will love survive when reality hits harder than dreams? Watch Now !

emperor-yan-3.title: Emperor Yan
emperor-yan-3.description: A fearless and clever maid enters the Forbidden City, determined to uncover her sister’s murder. Surrounded by palace intrigue, betrayals, and unexpected love, her quest for justice transforms her destiny. From servant to powerful consort, this is a tale of ambition, survival, and unbreakable will.

enemies-with-benefits-the-ceos-matchmake.title: Enemies with Benefits- The CEOs Matchmaker Strikes
enemies-with-benefits-the-ceos-matchmake.description: Juliet, stripped of her family legacy and seeking revenge on CEO David, incurs a massive debt to his cousin Joshua, forcing her into a desperate matchmaking role and later into impersonating an heiress for a forced marriage with him. Concurrently, Joshua, a wealthy CEO, faces an ultimatum from his ailing grandfather to marry immediately for life-saving surgery, leading him to a manipulative Riya who becomes his reluctant fiancée. Juliet's secret identity as a graffiti artist and matchmaker is exposed, leading to blackmail and entanglement in corporate power struggles. As Joshua relentlessly pursues Riya and hires Juliet as his 'love coach,' their professional boundaries blur, igniting forbidden chemistry. The past connections between Juliet, Joshua, and Riya resurface, creating a complex love triangle, and Juliet uncovers a terrifying secret, leaving her trapped. Riya, under various aliases including Juliet, navigates Joshua's family drama, facing public humiliation and an arranged marriage orchestrated by his judgmental aunt. Joshua fiercely protects Juliet/Riya amidst property disputes and sinister schemes, while a mysterious man from Riya's past vows revenge. Despite the deceptions, Joshua falls deeply in love with Juliet, breaking up with Riya for her. Juliet's true identity as a matchmaking intern is exposed, leading to accusations of impersonating 'Rhea' to seduce Joshua, culminating in a violent confrontation with his mother and public exposure of her fabricated heiress identity. Joshua accepts Juliet's past deceptions, and they declare mutual love. Despite vehement rejection and humiliation from other influential family members, Joshua, backed by his grandfather, asserts his ultimate authority over the family empire. He transfers substantial assets to Juliet, warns hostile relatives, and is declared the sole heir. Joshua passionately proposes marriage to Juliet, which she accepts, solidifying their future amidst intense corporate power struggles and a battle for inheritance.

in-search-of-jade-3.title: In search of jade
in-search-of-jade-3.description: The show unfolds as a complex saga of intertwined powerful families, royal lineages, and corporate empires, all driven by long-held secrets, profound betrayals, and a relentless pursuit of power and revenge. At its core is Ann Maria, initially trapped in a loveless marriage with Abhimanyu (William), whose discovery of his infidelity and a paternity secret ignites her meticulous plot for vengeance against his powerful family, often aided by figures like Mr. Wulan. Concurrently, the mysterious 'Madam,' later identified as Liana/Leana/Eliana, a woman with a hidden past and royal connections, is abducted, her carefully constructed new life shattered by agents and a sinister revenge plot orchestrated by Maya, further complicated by the disappearance of her 'Darling' and later, her own daughter. A pivotal six-year-old secret involving a hotel incident and the alleged paternity of a child, particularly Liana's daughter Anna, becomes a central mystery, connecting many characters and fueling accusations of manipulation and fraud. As Ann Maria's influence rises, she becomes a key player, both plotting against a powerful 'Master' and being accused of framing the Princess (Liana) and Prince for treason, while simultaneously being investigated by William, who seeks to expose her past identity and masterminding of vast conspiracies. The struggle for a royal throne intensifies, with the Master (Princess) battling her cunning brother, the Prince, who allies with Ann Maria to publicly disgrace the Master by revealing the true father of her child. Children, including Anna and Liana's daughter, are frequently abducted or become pawns in these high-stakes power struggles, their true parentage a constant source of conflict and leverage. William, a recurring figure, is poisoned, leading to a desperate search for an antidote and the revelation of Ann Maria's past manipulations, while the 'Master' is eventually revealed to be Ann Maria's long-lost father, having searched for her for six years. The narrative culminates in a ruthless coup where Sam poisons his father, the King, to seize the throne, threatening Ann Maria's magically marked daughter and setting him against his Elder Sister. Ultimately, figures like Leana, believed dead, strip Sam of his power in an act of calculated revenge, hinting at a dangerous, unconventional romance between them despite their violent past. The show explores the devastating impact of hidden identities, familial deception, and the lengths individuals will go to protect their legacies, reclaim their rightful places, or exact retribution, all against a backdrop of corporate intrigue and royal succession. The stakes involve not just personal vendettas but the control of powerful empires and the very future of royal lineages.

three-lives-ring-3.title: Three Lives Ring
three-lives-ring-3.description: ఒకరి మీద ప్రేమ ఎన్నిరోజుల వరకు ఉంటుంది? యుగయుగాల వరకూ ఉంటుందా..? మూడు ప్రాణుల ఉంగరం చెప్పే అద్భుతమైన కథ..  చూడండి మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

badla-legacy.title: Badla Legacy
badla-legacy.description: Framed for a crime he never committed, Arjun Choudhary is betrayed by his own family and abandoned by his fiancée Ritika Bajaj. Stripped of his powers and hunted by his brother Ravi and father Rajveer Choudhary, Arjun must rise from ashes with the help of allies like Dhaani Bajaj and the mysterious Amar Betaal. Caught between love, loyalty, and vengeance, Arjun’s battle will decide not just his honor—but the fate of the entire Choudhary legacy. Watch Now!

divine-level-war-doctor.title: Divine-Level War Doctor
divine-level-war-doctor.description: তিনি কোনো সাধারণ ডাক্তার ছিলেন না। অতিপ্রাকৃত ক্ষমায় সম্পন্ন, তিনি এমন একটি পথ বেছে নিয়েছিলেন যা সবকিছু বদলে দিয়েছিল। কীভাবে? জেনে নিন।

dont-think-about-it-lady-1.title: Don't Think About it Lady
dont-think-about-it-lady-1.description:
A bold young woman navigates office pressures, misunderstandings, and personal doubts. As feelings for a colleague grow, her imagination soars—but so do the challenges she must face.
This is a heartfelt story of honesty, determination, and a journey toward love and self-confidence.

three-brothers-dote-on-me-4.title: Three Brothers Dote on Me
three-brothers-dote-on-me-4.description: ఈ కథలో ముగ్గురు అన్నయ్యలు తమ చెల్లెలు మీద అమితమైన ప్రేమతో, ఆమెకు అన్యాయం చేసినవారిపై ఆమె ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకునేందుకు సాయపడతారు.

boss-babe-bond.title: The CEO's Secret Bodyguard
boss-babe-bond.description: When fiery CEO Navya Kapoor fakes a relationship with the mysterious and charming Aarav Deshmukh to escape a forced engagement, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and bullets blaze. But what happens when her contract boyfriend turns out to be a deadly secret agent with a mission of his own? Watch Now!

my-top-secret-desire-1.title: My Top Secret Desire
my-top-secret-desire-1.description: "র"একাডেমিতে এক সংগ্রামরত ট্রেনির জন্য একজন কঠোর পরামর্শদাতা নিযুক্ত করা হয়। সেই মহিলা আসলে ওই ট্রেনির দিদির বন্ধু। তার চেয়ে বয়সে অনেকটাই বড়। শেষমেশ দিদির বয়সী মহিলার সাথে প্রেমেই পড়ে সেই ট্রেনি ছেলেটি। তারপর?

crorepati-ki-jhaadu.title: Crorepati Ki Jhaadu
crorepati-ki-jhaadu.description: CROREPATI KA JHADU is a gripping drama about hidden power, betrayal, and redemption. Raghav, a humble janitor in an NGO, secretly carries the past of being the director of one of the world’s biggest finance companies. As conspiracies, family tensions, and corporate rivalries close in, his quiet life unravels—forcing him to reveal his true identity and rise against those who tried to bury him.

the-fate-is-you-1.title: THE FATE IS YOU
the-fate-is-you-1.description: Rescued by a stranger when his life is in danger, he sets out to find and thank the mysterious helper. Meanwhile, on the other hand, there is intense tension in a family—where a youngster is threatened with punishment to obey the orders of the elders. Mystery, emotion, and family chaos blend together in this story. The entire story weaves suspense and emotion in equal measure as it weaves between gratitude, searching for someone significant, and family conflict.

if-i-had-a-super-power.title: If I had a super power
if-i-had-a-super-power.description:
కష్టాల మధ్య ఆఫీస్‌లో పనిచేస్తున్న ఒక యువకుడు, తనను దోపిడీ చేస్తున్న వాతావరణంలో అనుకోకుండా ఒక అంతర్లీన శక్తిని అందుకుంటాడు — ఎలాంటి అవమానాన్ని తట్టుకునే, దోపిడీని ఎదుర్కొనే, మానసికంగా గెలిచే శక్తి.
రోజువారీ అవమానాలు, సమస్యల్లోనూ, తన గౌరవాన్ని కాపాడుతూ, చుట్టూ ఉన్నవారిని కూడా రక్షిస్తాడు. తన సహన ప్రయాణం, త్యాగం చివరకు ఒక సామాన్య ఉద్యోగిని అందరికీ ఆదర్శంగా నిలిచే నాయుకుడిగా మారుస్తుంది.

jassi-jaisi-koi-nhi.title: Invisible Jassi
jassi-jaisi-koi-nhi.description: assi is a sweet, innocent, yet highly intelligent girl who longs for genuine friendships. However, she's constantly ignored and humiliated by those around her simply because she doesn't fit society's conventional standards of beauty. With braces on her teeth, a unique sense of style, and an unconventional haircut, Jassi is often judged by her appearance rather than her character.

every-holiday-i-miss-my-wife-2.title: Every Holiday I miss my wife
every-holiday-i-miss-my-wife-2.description: Every festival day, while the world celebrates, he quietly mourns—lost in memories of his late wife. Surrounded by joy, his heart carries the wound of a love gone too soon. A poignant tale of grief, love, and the silent shadows that linger behind celebration.

jungle-se-aya-mera-dost.title: Death Countdown
jungle-se-aya-mera-dost.description:
What if you could see the exact moment someone will die?
Uday Mehra, an ordinary man, has a terrifying gift, he can see a death countdown of people. When he warns strangers about their fate, no one believes him… until a shocking plane crash proves him right.Now, caught between destiny and his desperate attempts to save her lover, Uday finds himself battling time, love, betrayal, and a deadly conspiracy. The clock is ticking. Will he save them… or lose everything? Watch now!

patience-will-lead-to-a-brighter-outcome.title: Patience will lead to a brighter outcome
patience-will-lead-to-a-brighter-outcome.description:
A billionaire’s surprise gift—a law firm for his wife—shocks everyone. Amid corporate politics, manipulation, and betrayal, she fights to protect her dignity and rise above the chaos.
As hidden truths emerge, a battle for respect, redemption, and second chances begins.

this-medical-saint-is-not-to-be-provoked.title: This Medical Saint is Not to Be Provoked
this-medical-saint-is-not-to-be-provoked.description:
A gifted healer and his magical box bring hope to the helpless—until betrayal changes everything. His ambitious junior’s treachery twists a miracle into a deadly curse.
A gripping tale of magic, power, and the devastating cost of playing god. Watch now!

dulhan-se-darling.title: Dulhan Se Darling
dulhan-se-darling.description: Dulhan Se Darling is a fiery romantic drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Kritika Reddy, heiress of a billion-dollar empire disguised as a cleaning staff, crosses paths with ruthless billionaire Rihaan Bhatt, sparking a storm of clashes, secrets, and undeniable attraction. But when her duplicitous fiancé and his mistress plot against her, Kritika must rise from humiliation to power—finding both revenge and unexpected love.

the-dragon-returns-to-his-homeland-1.title: The Dragon Returns to His Homeland
the-dragon-returns-to-his-homeland-1.description: Elvin gave up everything for love, even his own dreams. To win a better future, he sent his younger brother away to study, while their parents sacrificed everything to support that hope. A decade later, the brother returns as a billionaire, ready to repay the debt of love and loyalty. But just when Elvin is finally ready to marry the woman who waited for him all these years, a powerful rival named Christopher threatens to steal everything.

girls-all-around-me.title: Girls All Around Me
girls-all-around-me.description: What happens when an ordinary guy stumbles upon a phone that can make any girl fall in love with him? Girls All Around Me is a rollercoaster of love, power, and chaos where every click changes Yash’s destiny. Dive into this thrilling mix of romance, drama, and secrets! Watch Now !

a-beautiful-women.title: A Beautiful Women
a-beautiful-women.description: In a remote tech center, a few people are forcibly confined, their memories erased, and their identities altered through experiments. Among them, a young woman begins to recall not only her true self but also the lost memory of her sister. Caught between betrayal, fear, and control, her fight is not just for freedom — but for family, identity, and justice too.

no-me-ames.title: No me ames
no-me-ames.description: No me ames" es una serie romántica que gira en torno a la química juguetona entre los protagonistas. Llena de coqueteos, malentendidos tiernos y momentos intensos, la historia explora cómo el amor puede nacer a través de bromas, desafíos emocionales y atracción constante. Es una mezcla de romance ligero, humor y tensión sentimental que mantiene al lector enganchado desde el principio.

langda-sher.title: Langda Sher
langda-sher.description: The microdrama chronicles Avyaan's tumultuous journey as a determined student with a physical disability, navigating the prejudiced environment of Xavier's College. His admission sparks fierce opposition from his sister, Kiara, who fears for her reputation and actively works to humiliate him, even orchestrating his public downfall. Avyaan faces relentless bullying, unjust rustication, and betrayal, but defiantly embraces his individuality and vows to reclaim his place, supported by his mother and a new ally, Myra. A manipulative playboy, Neel, and a mysterious conspirator add layers of complexity and danger to his fight for acceptance and justice. Avyaan undergoes a fierce transformation, returning to expose corruption within the educational institution and demanding justice for his mother. Meanwhile, Kiara faces devastating betrayal when Neel manipulates and blackmails her with an explicit video, demanding money and threatening public humiliation. Haunted by past humiliation, Avyaan prepares to confront Neel, while Kiara's family rallies to protect her. Kyara, rejecting Avyaan's initial protective intervention, transforms into a reluctant leader, inspiring others wronged by Neel and orchestrating a public 'silent march' against him. She defiantly confronts Neel about his predatory past, vowing to expose his dark deeds. The conflict escalates when Avyan intervenes to protect Kyara from Neel's blackmail, leading to a violent confrontation that leaves Avyan critically injured, and Kyara confesses to her father, 'I pushed him.' A long-buried secret is revealed: Avyan sacrificed his leg to save Kiara years ago, fueling her guilt as he battles a critical illness. Kiara reconciles with Reya, uniting for vengeance against those responsible for their suffering. Avyan and Abhyaan meticulously plan Neel's public downfall, with Avyan hacking his devices for incriminating evidence. Kiara bravely exposes Neil for harassment and digital exploitation at a 'truth circle' event, leading to his arrest. However, a dramatic twist reveals Aavyan as the true mastermind behind a plan against Kiara, forcing him on a journey of self-discovery and acceptance of his imperfections. The narrative culminates in a heartwarming familial reconciliation, as the mother, son, and daughter rediscover their deep bond, transforming their house into a true home and celebrating enduring family connection.

pyaar-aur-fareb-2.title: Amor y Engaño
pyaar-aur-fareb-2.description: Aarohi needs money and is forced to marry a man who hides his true identity. What she doesn't know is that little by little, love will grow between them.

finding-us-again-2.title: Finding Us Again
finding-us-again-2.description: While Ajay is still waiting for his childhood love Aradhya to come back into his life whom he met 20 years ago on a tragic day in both of their Lives, But Aradhya is moved on in her Life and she has her own struggles. When Ajay and Aradhya accidentally meet again their Love Life starts to blossom in an unexpected way and the life has other plans on how they both should get together after these many years. Watch “Finding Us Again” Micro Drama Series only on KUKU TV.

kiss-and-switch-the-cursed-vampire-6.title: Kiss and Switch - The Cursed Vampire
kiss-and-switch-the-cursed-vampire-6.description: এক প্রাচীন অভিশপ্ত ভ্যাম্পায়ার রাজা একটি নির্দোষ মানুষের সাথে আকস্মিক সাক্ষাতের পরই মুক্তি খুঁজে পান। এই অপ্রত্যাশিত প্রেম হয়তো তার অভিশাপ ভাঙার একমাত্র উপায় অথবা তাদের দুজনকেই ধ্বংসের দিকে নিয়ে যেতে পারে। তাহলে কোনটা হতে চলেছে?

global-announcement.title: GLOBAL ANNOUNCEMENT
global-announcement.description: A show that unravels the catastrophic cycle threatening our planet. From record-breaking heatwaves to mass extinctions, it exposes how human actions push Earth closer to collapse, and what must be done before it’s too late. Highlights how different countries come together to control the disaster.

say-you-remember-say-you-love-5.title: Say You Remember, Say You Love
say-you-remember-say-you-love-5.description: পরিবারের দেউলিয়া হওয়ার পর এলিজাবেথ আবার যোগাযোগ করে তার প্রথম প্রেম জেসনের সঙ্গে, যে ইতোমধ্যে বিশ্ববিখ্যাত এক ফুটবল তারকায় পরিণত হয়েছে। একসময় তার দেওয়া যন্ত্রণার স্মৃতি ভুলতে না পারলেও, জেসনের সাফল্য, উপস্থিতি ও আকর্ষণের টান থেকে নিজেকে আর সরিয়ে রাখতে পারেনি এলিজাবেথ।

cultivating-the-heartless-path-my-junior.title: Cultivating the Heartless Path, My Junior Sister Went Mad
cultivating-the-heartless-path-my-junior.description: এক বোন চায় জোড় করে সবার ভালোবাসা কেড়ে নিতে। আর অন্য বোন চায় ভালোবাসা দিয়ে ভালোবাসাকে জয় করতে। কিন্তু শেষমেশ প্রতিশোধের পথ বেছে নিতে হয় তাকে।

reborn-the-doctors-second-chance-at-love.title: Reborn- The Doctor's Second Chance at Love
reborn-the-doctors-second-chance-at-love.description: A touching romantic drama about a brilliant doctor who dies with regrets but is reborn with the chance to rewrite destiny. This time, while saving lives, he also heals his own heart and discovers a love he once lost.

the-westward-anime-season-2-3.title: The Westward Anime Season 2
the-westward-anime-season-2-3.description: The story follows Tang San Zang and his disciples on a sacred westward pilgrimage that is repeatedly interrupted by battles over a contested relic and the right to control it. At first, the group moves through celestial and hostile realms while trying to recover or protect Qiojing, but heavenly authorities demand the object be surrendered. Sun Wukong becomes the main point of conflict because he refuses divine control and insists on resisting injustice. Tang San Zang is forced into a painful position, using a controlling mantra to subdue Wukong in order to preserve order and the mission. That choice fractures the group, and Wukong is even declared dead after the alliance collapses under punishment and obedience. The pilgrimage does not end there, because Tang San Zang redirects the journey toward the Western Heaven and keeps the mission moving. The story then widens into personal wounds, especially around Bajie, whose hidden family troubles become part of the larger struggle. Bajie is tied to the imprisonment of his wife Kuilan, and the conflict around her exposes humiliation, resentment, and the collapse of marital trust. A demon king mocks Bajie’s lost honor and past glory, while Kuilan rejects him, deepening his emotional defeat. Even so, Bajie chooses to continue west with his master and promises to return after ten years, showing that duty still competes with shame. In the later arc, the focus shifts to rescue and identity, especially around Wukong, whose trapped spirit must be recovered from seals, prisons, and dragon-ruled strongholds. Tang Sanzang leads repeated attempts to free him, even when the path requires underwater travel because he cannot swim. Dragon family conflict complicates the rescue, as princes and guardians argue over loyalty, humiliation, and whether cooperation with heaven is possible. Memory loss and identity confusion also shape the conflict, especially for a dragon-human warrior whose past ties are uncertain. Hidden swords, broken seals, and body transfer become important signs that Wukong’s return is possible, but only through escalating danger. By the end of the batch, Wukong is restored enough to reenter the struggle, yet old betrayals remain unresolved and the war over destiny and authority is still expanding. The reunion of the group after many years briefly suggests healing, but it quickly turns into another custody dispute over a protected young dragon, followed by a heavenly attack that pushes the conflict into open war. The show ends with the pilgrimage still unfinished, the bonds between master and disciples strained but not broken, and the struggle for sacred power, identity, and freedom still unresolved.

a-beam-of-light-in-the-darkness-mothers-.title: A Beam Of LIght In The Darkness : Mother's Love
a-beam-of-light-in-the-darkness-mothers-.description: A deeply moving family drama that celebrates the strength of a mother’s love. When life throws unbearable challenges at her children, she becomes their guiding light, proving that even in the darkest times, a mother’s love can heal, protect, and transform destinies.

a-beautiful-woman-2.title: A Beautiful Woman
a-beautiful-woman-2.description: একটি দূরবর্তী টেক সেন্টারে কিছু মানুষকে জোরপূর্বক আটক করে, তাদের স্মৃতি মুছে ফেলে, এবং তাদের পরিচয় পরিবর্তনের পরীক্ষা চালানো হয়। তাদের মধ্যেই একজন তরুণী রয়েছে, যে তার আসল স্বরূপ ও হারানো বোনের স্মৃতি ফিরে পায়। বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা, ভয় ও নিয়ন্ত্রণের মাঝখানে সে লড়াই করে—শুধু স্বাধীনতার জন্য নয়, পরিবারের, পরিচয়ের ও ন্যায়ের জন্যও।

the-rise-begins-with-perspective-2.title: The Rise Begins With Perspective
the-rise-begins-with-perspective-2.description: একজন তরুণ হঠাৎ করে অসাধারণ ক্ষমতা অর্জন করে। এই শক্তিগুলোর সাথে তার জীবন পুরোপুরি বদলে যায়। এক জন সাধারণ তরুণ থেকে অসাধারণ নায়ক হিসেবে রূপান্তরের যাত্রা।

arrange-mein-romance.title: Arranged to Love
arrange-mein-romance.description: A billionaire businessman, Vikram Singhania, has to enter into an arranged marriage with Dr. Bhoomi Arora because of family pressure. What starts as a cold, forced marriage slowly transforms into an unexpected journey of trust, passion, and love. Arranged to Love is a romantic drama where duty collides with desire, and two strangers must decide if their hearts can truly meet.

divorced-but-doted-upon-by-the-trio-3.title: Divorced But Doted Upon by the Trio
divorced-but-doted-upon-by-the-trio-3.description: একজন কৃতজ্ঞ উত্তরাধিকারিনী সেই ব্যক্তির সাথে বিবাহ বন্ধনে আবদ্ধ হন, যিনি তাঁর প্রাণ বাঁচিয়েছিলেন। কিন্তু স্বামীর অবদান ভুলে গিয়ে তিনি পরকীয়ায় মত্ত হয়ে পড়েন এবং তাঁকে ডিভোর্স দিতে বাধ্য করেন। ওই ব্যক্তির কোনো ধারণাই ছিল না যে, তাঁর স্ত্রী এত বিরাট কোম্পানির মালকিন। তিন ভাইয়ের আদরের নয়নমণি। তারপর কী হয়...?

the-forbidden-kiss.title: Pyar ya Vyapar
the-forbidden-kiss.description:
Tina, a rising model, is shattered when her boyfriend betrays her with her best friend and her agency humiliates her. But fate brings her to Rajdeep Rai, a powerful CEO. What begins as a fake boyfriend act soon spirals into a whirlwind of passion, betrayal, and redemption. Together, they battle conspiracies, family feuds, and painful pasts in search of a love worth everything.
Will their story end in heartbreak… or forever? Watch Now!

double-life-ceo-chasing-love-5.title: Double Life CEO : Chasing Love
double-life-ceo-chasing-love-5.description: On her wedding day, a stranger takes the groom’s place — and marries her instead. No one knows who he is or why he did it, but his silence hides a stormy past. What begins as a shocking twist unravels into a tale of secrets, fate, and forbidden love.

067d25d3-1450-4364-afc2-ed3054b30f18.title: Niksen : The Art of Doing Nothing
067d25d3-1450-4364-afc2-ed3054b30f18.description:
|Key Insights - Stress Reduction, Mental Relaxation, Creativity Boost|
Aaj ki bhaag daud bhari zindagi mein kuch na karna bhi ek art ho sakti hai, jise Netherlands mein "Niksen" kehte hain. Is art ka matlab hai bilkul kuch na karna aur apne dimaag ko freely bhatakne dena. Dutch culture mein isse stress kam karne aur creativity badhane ke liye bahut importance di gayi hai. Jaaniye is behtareen kala ke baare mein hamaari is khaas show mein.

manaamiyangal.title: மனாமியங்கள்
manaamiyangal.description: மரபான மனங்களுக்கு அவ்வளவாக உவப்பில்லாமல் இருக்கலாம். ஆனால் மரபின் போர்வையில் மறைக்கப்பட்ட ஓர் உலகம் வெளியாகும்போது பொங்கிப் பெருகும் உடைப்பைத் தவிர்க்க இயலாது. இந்நாவலில் நிகழ்வதும் அத்தகைய ஒரு பிரவாகம்தான்.

nandu-1.title: நண்டு
nandu-1.description:
நம் உயிர் நிலையற்றது. உலகம் அனைத்தும் வியாதி, அகங்காரம் இவைகளுக்கு ஆளாகியதென்றும்; சோகத்தால் பீடிக்கப்பட்டதென்றும் நீ உணர்ந்து இந்த ஸம்ஸார ஸாகரத்திலிருந்து விடுபட கோவிந்தனை தியானிப்பாயாக - என்கிறார் ஸ்ரீ ஆதி சங்கரர், தன் பஜகோவிந்தத்தில். நான் சாதாரணப் பெண். பெரிய தத்துவத்தையோ, இல்லை உலகத்துக்கு இதுநாள் தெரியாத உண்மையையோ 'நண்டு' மூலம் எடுத்துரைக்க முன்வரவில்லை என்றாலும் ஒரே ஒரு உண்மையை மட்டும் உங்களுடன் பகிர்ந்து கொள்ள விரும்புகிறேன்.

நண்டு ஒரு நிஜக்கதை

7a530b4c-12b4-4219-b3fc-7eaa4aeaecff.title: Ultimate Guide to Inner Peace and Self-Worth
7a530b4c-12b4-4219-b3fc-7eaa4aeaecff.description: Ghar se bahar ki duniya ka pressure ho ya dil ka dard, KUKU FM ke is show mein paaye apne inner peace ka raasta. Har episode mein seekhiye apne andar ka sukoon aur self-love banane ke tarike. Ab aap bhi ban sakte hain apne khud ke hero aur savior!

narudu.title: నరుడు
narudu.description: ఒక సామాన్య మనిషి జీవితంలోని వాస్తవ సంఘటనలను ఆవిష్కరించే కల్పిత కథ. ఒక మారుమూల ప్రాంతం లో  పుట్టిన ఒక మాదిగ యువకుడు ఎదిగి చదువులో ముందంజ వేసి జెన్నీఫర్ అనే మహిళ చెంత చేరతాడు. చిన్న నాడు తమ ఊరి పురోహితుని దగ్గర మూర్తి జీవితం ఎలా ముందుకు సాగింది అనేది ఈ 'నరుడు' అనే కథ.

endrum-penn.title: என்றும் பெண்
endrum-penn.description: விதியின் வசத்தால் குணமும் அன்பும் நிறைந்த அப்பாவை தவிர்த்து விவாகரத்தில் தாயுடன் செல்கிறாள் 14 வயது சிறுமி கிருத்திகா. அம்மாவின் ஏக்கமும் மறுபக்கமும் புரிய, தன் தாயின் வாழ்வில் நிலையற்றவர்களை சந்திக்கும் அவள், யாரையும் விமர்சிக்காமல் எல்லோரையும் அவரவர் கோணத்திலிருந்து பார்க்கக் கற்றுக்கொள்ளும் மனமுதிர்ச்சியும் அறிவுக்கூர்மையும் நிறைந்தவளாகவும், வெளிப்படையாய் மனம் திறக்காமல் வளர்கிறாள் கிருத்திகா. இலக்கியம் படித்து கதை, கவிதை, கட்டுரையில் தேர்ந்தவளாகவும், புகழ்பெற்ற நூலகத்தில் உத்யோகம் தேடிக்கொண்டு, தாயை பிரிந்து 20 வயது பெண்ணாக விடுதியில் வாழும்போதுதான் ராமகிருஷ்ணனை சந்திக்க நேரிடுகிறது. கிருத்திகாவின் நேர்மையும், புத்திகூர்மையும், உணர்வுகளும் அவள் வாழ்க்கையை எவ்வாறு கொண்டு செல்கிறது என்பதை அறிய மேலே கேளுங்கள் என்றும் பெண்.

yeh-ishq-hai-risky.title: Yeh Ishq Hai Risky
yeh-ishq-hai-risky.description: Pyaar mein tuta Dil liye Naina jab Solo Trip ke liye Manali pahunchi, to vahaan use mila uske bachpan ka pyaar Neel. Magar 10 saal baad Neel ki zindagi aise mod le chuki ki ab vo relationship se darta tha aur vo Naina ke pyaar ke baare mein kuch janta bhi nahin tha. Lekin Naina aaj bhi Neel ko tutkar pyaar karna chahti hai Jaise bachpan mein chahti thi. Aaj bhi Neel ke saamne aate hi uski dil ki dhadkanein ruk jaati hain. Kya vo Neel ko apna banaa payegi? Kya Neel Naina ke pyaar ko accept karega? Jaanne ke liye suniye Yeh Ishq Hai Risky.

velvithee.title: வேள்வித் தீ
velvithee.description: சௌராஷ்டிரா சமூகத்தைப் பற்றிய நாவல் இது. ஒரு திறமையான நெசவாளியான கண்ணன் வாழ்வில் நடக்கும் சம்பவங்களே “வேள்வித் தீ”

detective-kuruvila.title: Detective Kuruvila
detective-kuruvila.description: സമയം രാത്രി 12 മണിയോടടുക്കുന്നു. പ്രശസ്ത വ്യവസായിയായ അർജുൻ തന്റെ മകൾ മീരയുടെ പതിനെട്ടാം പിറന്നാൾ ആഘോഷിക്കുകയാണ്. എല്ലാവരും ആകാംക്ഷയോടെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു സർപ്രൈസ് അർജുൻ ഒരുക്കിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. പക്ഷേ, പെട്ടെന്ന്, ഒരു നിലവിളിയും വീഴ്ചയുടെ ശബ്ദവും കേൾക്കുന്നു. ഞെട്ടിത്തിരിഞ്ഞ ജനങ്ങൾ കാണുന്നത് മീരയെ രക്തത്തിൽ കുളിച്ചു കിടക്കുന്നതാണ്!

e56935fc-e20a-4778-b753-1f2fdc8ae8c8.title: The Path To Prosperity
e56935fc-e20a-4778-b753-1f2fdc8ae8c8.description: Iss show mein jaaniye kaise mushkilen aur burai humari life mein enter hoti hain aur hume majbooti sikhati hain. Jaaniye ye kaisi humari improvement mein bhi role play karti hain?

art-of-buying-house-property.title: Art of Buying House Property
art-of-buying-house-property.description: Ee pusthakam Indian real estate vipaniyekurichulla rahasyangal ningale padipikunnu. Niyamangal manassilaakanum ettavum mikacha sthalam thiranjedukanum, ningalude swapna bhavanam oru labhakaramaya nikshepamaki maattanum ee pusthakam ningale sahayikkum.

oru-kanyakayude-suvishesham.title: ഒരു കന്യകയുടെ സുവിശേഷം
oru-kanyakayude-suvishesham.description: നാട്ടിലെ മനോഹരമായ് ഹിമ്മല്‍ വില്ലയില്‍ ഒന്നിനുപുറകെ ഒന്നായി ദുരൂഹമരണങ്ങള്‍ നടക്കുന്നു! ഒടുവില്‍ പത്രങ്ങളില്‍ ഒരു വാര്‍ത്ത വരുന്നു. ഹിമ്മല്‍ വില്ലയില്‍ 24 മണിക്കൂര്‍ കഴിയുന്നവര്‍ക്ക് 500000 രൂപ ഇനാം!  ആ ചെകുത്താന്റെ കോട്ടയിൽ  ഒറ്റയ്ക്ക് താമസിക്കേണ്ടി വന്ന അകിര എന്ന പെണ്‍കുട്ടിയുടെ കഥ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

83d65777-d763-4927-a240-27b64a0df139.title: The Criminal Lover
83d65777-d763-4927-a240-27b64a0df139.description: Ek beautiful nurse ka brutal murder, ek journalist ka daring investigation, aur ek shocking secret jo badal dega sab kuch! Dekhiye 'The Criminal Lover' ki spine-chilling kahani.

dravidakallu.title: ദ്രാവിഡകല്ല്
dravidakallu.description: ദ്രാവിഡക്കല്ല് തേടി ഇറങ്ങുന്ന സുഹൃത്തുക്കളുടെ കഥ.  ജനിമൃതികള്‍ക്കിടയില്‍ മോക്ഷമാര്‍ഗ്ഗം പോലെ നീണ്ടു പരന്നു കിടക്കുന്ന കഥാഗതി വേദകാലത്തെ മഞ്ഞു പുതച്ച കൈലാസ ശൃംഗങ്ങളില്‍ നിന്നും തുടങ്ങുന്ന ദ്രാവിഡയാത്ര. കേൾക്കാം, കാലദേശാന്തരങ്ങളെ അതിജീവിക്കുന്ന വിസ്മയപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന മാന്ത്രിക നോവൽ!

vyom-ek-anokha-yoddha.title: Vyom - Ek anokha Yoddha
vyom-ek-anokha-yoddha.description: Ek average ladke ki zindagi mein aaya,ek aia twist jisne uski zindgi badal di ! Pyaar mein dhoka kha kar marne ki soch raha Rohit achanak ban gaya ek alg duniya ka sabse powerful warrior. Kaise achanak badal gayi Rohit ki zindgi ? Ab kaise deal karega Rohit in powers ke saath? Jaanane ke liye suniye poori kahaani  Vyom EK ANOKHA YODDHA sirf KUKU FM par.

parimala.title: ಪರಿಮಳ
parimala.description: "Parimala" - A novel by Yandamoori Veerendranath, delves into the complexities of human emotions and relationships. The story centers around the protagonist Parimala, exploring her journey through life's myriad challenges and personal growth. The novel intricately portrays her struggles, triumphs, and the profound impact of love and betrayal. With its deep emotional resonance and compelling narrative, "Parimala" offers readers a profound insight into the human psyche and the transformative power of resilience and self-discovery.

అనూహ్య.title: అనూహ్య
అనూహ్య.description: అనూహ్య ... ఎంత అందం గా ఉంటుందో అంత మొండిది కూడా. అదే మొండితనం తో ... తన మీద విపరీతం గా  వున్న బామ్మ ఇన్ఫ్లుయెన్స్ తో తన అందమైన జీవితాన్ని గందరగోళం చేసుకుంటుందా ? లేదా జీవితాన్ని తనలో ఉన్న ప్రేమతో అందం గా మార్చుకుంటుందా?తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

67b8b641-4107-4686-bdc9-8b02dea446e5.title: Kyu Lete Hai Jain Sanyaas
67b8b641-4107-4686-bdc9-8b02dea446e5.description: Kyu paise ka moh chhodkar log kaise bann jate hain Sanayasi! Jaanein unki mushkil raah aur kyun ladkiyan ladkon se 3 guna zyada chun rahi hain sanyaas. Suniye humare show mein, kaise hoti hai diksha ki tayaari aur unka kathin jeevan!

ఆలింగనం.title: ఆలింగనం
ఆలింగనం.description: చదువు,ఫ్రెండ్స్,ఫామిలీ,ప్రేమ ... వీటన్నిటి మధ్యా తాను నాలిగి పోతుందా లేక జీవిత పాఠo నేర్చుకుంటుందా ? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

the-bhagavad-gita-for-millennials.title: The Bhagavad Gita For Millennials
the-bhagavad-gita-for-millennials.description: ഹിന്ദുമതത്തിലെ പ്രധാന ഗ്രന്ഥങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നായ ഭഗവദ്ഗീത, ജീവിതം നയിക്കാനും നമ്മുടെ കടമകൾ നിറവേറ്റാനുമുള്ള പ്രധാന പാഠങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്നുണ്ടെങ്കിലും, ഇന്നത്തെ തലമുറയ്ക്ക് ഇത് വളരെ പഴയതോ മനസ്സിലാക്കാൻ വളരെ സങ്കീർണമോ ആയി തോന്നിയേക്കാം. ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ, ബിബേക് ദേബ്രോയ യുവതലമുറയെ ലക്ഷ്യം വെച്ച് ഭഗവദ്ഗീതയെ സരളവും സമഗ്രവുമായ രീതിയിൽ പുനരാവിഷ്കരിക്കുന്നു.

8613776e-a460-42e6-bab3-c7d176a5b077.title: 6 Secret Tax Saving Tips You Must Know
8613776e-a460-42e6-bab3-c7d176a5b077.description: Waise toh humein apni tax kam karne ke liye Income Tax ke relevant sections ka knowledge hai par unhi sections ke andar aise kuch aur bhi tareeke hain jisse hum apni tax savings aur bhi zyada kar sakte hain. Jaaniye kaise hamaare is khaas show mein.

kathasarithsagaram.title: കഥാസരിത്സാഗരം
kathasarithsagaram.description: പഞ്ച തന്ത്രകഥകള്‍, വിക്രമാദിത്യകഥകള്‍, ഹിതോപദേശകഥകള്‍, ജാതക കഥകള്‍, തുടങ്ങി എക്കാലത്തെയും ഏതുതരം വായനക്കാരെയും ആകര്‍ഷിച്ച കഥകള്‍ക്ക് അടിസ്ഥാനമായ മഹദ്ഗ്രന്ഥം.

love-trap.title: Love Trap
love-trap.description: ദുബായിൽ ബിസ്സ്നസ് ചർച്ചക്കായി ക്രിസ്റ്റി തരകൻ എന്ന കോടീശ്വരനെ കാണാൻ എത്തിയതാണ് നികിത. എന്നാൽ അവൾക്ക് വിശ്വസിക്കാൻ പോലും കഴിയാത്ത കാര്യങ്ങളാണ് പിന്നീട് സംഭവിക്കുന്നത്. പ്രണയവും പ്രതികാരവും അമ്പരപ്പിക്കുന്ന ട്വിസ്റ്റുകളും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു റൊമാന്റിക് ത്രില്ലർ!

f1d41f1b-562c-4fea-afcd-98806d1d4ddc.title: Advait Vedant Ka Marm: Adhyatmik Yatra Shankarcharya Ke Path Par
f1d41f1b-562c-4fea-afcd-98806d1d4ddc.description: Karan aur Vikram ke saath shuru hui ek adbhut yatra, jismein woh apne itihas ko unhi raaston pe chal kar samajhne nikle hain, jahan se adi Shankaracharya ne apne dharmik safar ki shuruaat ki thi. Suno unki anokhi kahani, kaladi se Omkareshwar tak, sirf KUKU FM par.

జీవితమే-ఒక-ఢమాల్.title: జీవితమే ఓ ఢమాల్
జీవితమే-ఒక-ఢమాల్.description: I DIE, YAMA, re life gave..  సరే నా దరిద్రం ఇంగ్లీష్ లో చెప్పడం కన్నా తెలుగు లోనే ఏడవడం మేలు, వినండి. నేను సచ్చిపోయాక యమధర్మ రాజు వారు మంచి graphics use చేసి entry ఇచ్చి నన్ను కోమలి అనే అమ్మాయి శరీరంలో పడేసారు. దాని తర్వాత నా జీవితం అయ్యింది అన్నా! twistలు, chasingలు, attackingలు వరస్సుగా వస్తానే ఉన్నాయి!  అదేంటో నువ్వు ఓ చెవి విసిరి వినే బ్రో, description లోనే అంతా చెప్పలేను..

1274e098-655f-400a-a93c-59d9480ef224.title: The Magic of Believing
1274e098-655f-400a-a93c-59d9480ef224.description:
Iss show mein, jaaniye kaise Claude M. Bristol ki book "The Magic of Believing" se inspired lessons aapki soch aur belief ko transform kar sakte hain. Positive mindset aur self-belief se apni life ko kaise behtar bana sakte hain, suniye aur seekhiye.

Link- https://kukufm.com/show/69d0f3be-f89a-4b29-a45c-2c3e1433a0ff?utm_source=upsell

എതിര്‌.title: എതിര്‌
എതിര്‌.description: ദളിതനായതിന്റെ പേരില്‍ മാറ്റിനിര്‍ത്തപ്പെട്ട കുട്ടിക്കാലത്ത് നിന്നു പൊരുതിക്കയറി വന്ന വ്യക്തിയാണ് സാമ്പത്തിക വിദഗ്ദനും അധ്യാപകനും ദളിത് ചിന്തകനുമായ പ്രൊഫ. എം കുഞ്ഞാമന്‍. അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ജീവിത വഴിത്താരകളെ അടുത്തറിയാം..

రమణ-మహర్షి-బోధనలు.title: రమణ మహర్షి బోధనలు
రమణ-మహర్షి-బోధనలు.description: రమణ మహర్షి తన అనుచరులతో తన నమ్మకాలు మరియు బోధనల యొక్క సన్నిహిత చిత్రపటంలో చేసిన అనేక సంభాషణలను కలిపిస్తుంది. ఈ సంభాషణల ద్వారా, పాఠకులు మహర్షి యొక్క స్వీయ విచారణ యొక్క సరళమైన క్రమశిక్షణను కనుగొంటారు: తనను తాను తెలుసుకోవడం మరియు నిజమైన అవగాహన మరియు జ్ఞానోదయానికి మార్గంగా లోపలికి చూడటం. ఈ అన్ని విషయాలు తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే.

tata-nano-success-se-failure-ki-kahaani.title: Tata Nano: Success se Failure ki Kahaani
tata-nano-success-se-failure-ki-kahaani.description: Duniya ki sabse sasti Car kyun fail ho gayi? Kya product decide karne se pehle uski marketing decide karni zaroori hoti hai? Jaaniye is show mein ki Ratan Tata ka ek anokha sapna kaise ek galat business strategy ke chalte fail ho gaya. Suniye abhi Tata Nano: Success se Failure ki Kahaani.

ఆకుపచ్చని-జ్ఞాపకం-.title: ఆకుపచ్చని జ్ఞాపకం
ఆకుపచ్చని-జ్ఞాపకం-.description: కోటిపల్లి రైలుమార్గం, గోదావరి ప్రయాణం, హంపీ సౌందర్యం వంటి యాత్రా కథలను సైతం వంశీ, కళాత్మకంగానూ ఆర్తితోనూ రాయగలడని అవి చదివిన కొద్దిమంది పాఠకులకయినా తెలుసు. ఆయనకున్న సంగీత పరిజ్ఞానం తక్కువేం కాదని సినీరంగంలో ఉన్నవారికి మాత్రమే తెలుసు...ఇంకా చాలామందికి చాలా రకాలుగా వంశీ తెలుసు. కానీ వంశీకున్న సమాజాన్ని వీక్షించే దృష్టికోణం గురించి,మానవ సంబంధాల పట్ల ఆర్తిగా స్పందించే గుణం గురించి అతి కొద్ది మందికే తెలుసు. ఆ కొద్ది మందికి తెలిసిన లక్షణాలు ఈ కథా సంపుటం ద్వారా అందరికీ తెలిసిపోతాయి. ఒక్కమాటలో వంశీని సమగ్రంగా దర్శించడానికి ఈ కథా సంపుటం చాలు.. ముప్ఫై ఒక్క కథలు, ఒక నవలిక - ఇది ఈ ఆకుపచ్చని జ్ఞాపకం

సంపూర్ణ-వాల్మీకి-రామాయణం.title: సంపూర్ణ వాల్మీకి రామాయణం
సంపూర్ణ-వాల్మీకి-రామాయణం.description: రామాయణం గానం చేసినా, పఠించినా సుమనోహరం.. మానవ జీవితాన్ని సంస్కరించి మనిషిని మనిషిగా తీర్చిదిద్దేదే రామాయణం. అనంతమైన సుగుణాలకు నెలవైన శ్రీరామచంద్రమూర్తి జీవనం గురించి వివరించినదే రామాయణం.

1f505549-8ca0-4f3e-bbf1-67c9aeab37ad.title: Mamta Ki Khoj Mein : Ek Dukkhad Kahaani
1f505549-8ca0-4f3e-bbf1-67c9aeab37ad.description: Thriller ke andaaz mein ye show ek dukh bhari kahaani hai jo Delhi ke Chandni Chowk mein college jaane wala Chetan aur uski maa Vaishali ke beech ke tanaav ko batlaatee hai. Vaishali apne bete se hamesha zyada ummeedein rakhti thi aur uspar atyachar karti thi, jisse tang ho kar Chetan ek  aisa bhayankar kadam utha deta hai jisse uski zindagi narak ban jaati hai.

appanna-sardaar.title: అప్పన్న సర్దార్
appanna-sardaar.description: ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మన పవిత్ర ప్రజాస్వామ్యం జోకర్లు తో మరియు మోసగాళ్ళతో ఎలా నిండిపోయిందో తెలియచేస్తుంది. మన కథకు మూలం సర్దార్ అప్పన్న ఈయన ఇందులో మంత్రి. సీఎం కావడానికి అప్పన్న సర్దార్ చేసిన పనులు ఏంటి? పదవి కోసం అప్పన్న సర్దార్ ఎం చేసాడో ఒకసారి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

gelupu-sare-batakatam-ela.title: గెలుపు సరే, బతకడం ఎలా?
gelupu-sare-batakatam-ela.description: కుల, మత, సాంస్కృతిక, రాజకీయ, కార్పోరేట్ గురువుల చేతుల్లో పడి సామజిక కూర్పు అంతా అస్థవ్యస్థమైపోతున్న తరుణంలో , గెలుపే జీవితంగా ఓటమి మరణంగా వ్యాఖ్యానితమవుతున్న దశలో పతంజలి ఒక భిన్నమైన కోణం నుంచి జీవితాన్ని వ్యాఖ్యానించారు. అది ఎలానో ఇది విని తెలుసుకోండి.

khiladiyon-ka-khiladi.title: Khiladiyon ka Khiladi
khiladiyon-ka-khiladi.description: Akshay maut ko chookar tak se wapas aa sakta hai. Par uski khoj Maya par jakar atki hui hai. Samrat ne bhi maut ko hara diya hai par wo Akshay se haar jata hai. Kya hai Akshay aur Samrat ki ranjish ka karan? Kya hai Maya ka raaz? Kya hai amrit ki boondon ka rahsay? Janne ke liye sunein, Khiladiyon ka Khiladi…

swapnangalude-vyakhyanam.title: സ്വപ്‌നങ്ങളുടെ വ്യാഖ്യാനം
swapnangalude-vyakhyanam.description: മനഃശാസ്ത്ര ലോകത്തെ വിപ്ലവമാണ് സ്വപ്‌നങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള സിഗ്മണ്ട് ഫ്രോയ്ഡിന്റെ പഠനങ്ങള്‍. ഉറക്കത്തില്‍ നാം കാണുന്ന സ്വപ്‌നങ്ങള്‍ക്കെല്ലാം നമ്മുടെ ജീവിതവുമായി അഭേദ്യമായി ബന്ധമുണ്ട്. നമ്മുടെ അനുഭവങ്ങള്‍, ചെറുപ്പകാലം ഇവയെല്ലാം അതിനെ സ്വാധീനിക്കും.

akkapporinte-irupathu-nasrani-varshangal.title: അക്കപ്പോരിന്റെ ഇരുപത് നസ്രാണി വർഷങ്ങൾ
akkapporinte-irupathu-nasrani-varshangal.description: ആടുജീവിതത്തിനു ശേഷം ബെന്യാമിൻ എഴുതിയ ഒരു അതിശയിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ചരിത്ര നോവൽ. രണ്ടു ക്രിസ്തീയ സമുദായങ്ങൾ തമ്മിലുള്ള സംഘർഷത്തിന്റെ ഉദ്വേഗം നിറഞ്ഞ ഈ കഥ ഒരു കാലഘട്ടത്തെ മനോഹരമായി അടയാളപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു.

secret-yoddha.title: Secret Yoddha
secret-yoddha.description: Raj ki duniya, kab games mein badal gayi, use pata hi nahi chala. Par asal jindagi mein Raj ko games ke level nahi cross karne hai, balki Universe ke realms ko cross karna hai? Par Raj ye kaise karega? Kitne realms hai is Universe ke? Kaun hai in sabke peeche? Janne ke liye suniye, Secret Yoddha

Tuphaanu--తుఫాను.title: తుఫాను
Tuphaanu--తుఫాను.description: జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే "తుఫానులను" ఎలా ఎదుర్కోవాలో  తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? మన జీవితంలో సంఘర్షణలను మరియు భావోద్వేగాలను సమర్థవంతంగా ప్రతిఫలింపజేశారు అడివి బాపిరాజు.

b753bbf7-04c9-48e4-9954-6b4a018c6dbf.title: The Magic Story
b753bbf7-04c9-48e4-9954-6b4a018c6dbf.description: Iss show mein, jaaniye kaise positive thinking aur self-belief se aap apni kismat badal sakte hain. Yeh show aapko dikhayega kaise inner transformation aur determination se aap apne goals achieve kar sakte hain. Apni life ko better banane ke liye zaroor suniye.

Tatwasastram-Chinna-parichayam-తత్వశాస్త.title: తత్వశాస్త్రం చిన్న పరిచయం
Tatwasastram-Chinna-parichayam-తత్వశాస్త.description: తత్వం అంటే ఒక భావం, అభిప్రాయం. ప్రకృతినీ, సమాజాన్నీ అర్థం చేసుకోవాలనే ఉత్సుకతతో ప్రారంభమైన శాస్త్రమిది. క్రీస్తుపూర్వం నాటి తత్వవేత్తలు, ఆధునిక తత్వవేత్తలు, మానవ చరిత్ర, చారిత్రక భౌతికవాదం వంటి ఇందులోని 48 భాగాలు ఎంతో ఆసక్తి ని కలిగిస్తాయి.

kashmir-vyadha.title: కాశ్మీర్ వ్యధ
kashmir-vyadha.description: ఎన్నో ఏళ్లుగా కాశ్మీర్ సమస్య ఉంది. కాశ్మీర్ సమస్య నడుమ ఆనాటి రాజకీయ పరిస్థితులని, స్థితిగతుల్ని, ఆజాద్ కాశ్మీర్ అంశాన్ని స్పష్టంగా విశ్లేషిస్తూ ఎం.వీ.ఆర్ శాస్త్రి రాసిన "కాశ్మీర్ వ్యధ" అనే చారిత్రాత్మక నవల విని తెలుసుకోండి.

dead-or-alive.title: Dead or Alive
dead-or-alive.description: Ek rahasyamayi kitaab ke zariye 'murda laash' ko 'zinda insaan' banane ka junoon 'Anand' ke liye tab 'ghatak' saabit hota hai, jab uske haathon 'zinda' hua 'ek murda shakhs' maut ka taandav shuru karta hai aur duniya ke aakhri kone tak 'Anand' ko talashata hai. Aakhir kya hota hai kudrat ke niyam ko badlne ka anjaam? Aayiye sunte hain hamare show 'Dead or Alive' me...

Good-Parent--గుడ్-పేరెంట్.title: గుడ్ పేరెంట్
Good-Parent--గుడ్-పేరెంట్.description: పిల్లలను ఎలా పెంచాలి ? పిల్లల్లో స్నేహపూరిత భావాన్ని, మానవత్వాన్ని  ఎలా తీర్చిదిద్దాలి ?  పిల్లల హృదయాన్ని ఎలా హత్తుకోవాలో  రచయిత బి.వి పట్టాభిరామ్ రాసిన  ఈ "గుడ్ పేరెంట్" ఆడియో ద్వారా విని తెలుసుకోండి.

avan.title: அவன்
avan.description: பள்ளி படிப்பை முடித்து கல்லூரியில் கால் பதிக்கும் பிரேம், பரத், அப்பு இவர்களின் வாழ்க்கையை புரட்டி போடும் அளவிற்கு என்ன நேர்ந்தது? பிள்ளைகள் செய்யும் தவறுகளில் பெற்றோர்களுக்கும் பங்கு உண்டு என்று மாதவனும், ரேவதியும் உணர்ந்தார்களா? இன்றைய சமுதாயம் எதிர்நோக்கி உள்ள மிகப்பெரிய பிரச்சினையை காண 'அவன்' கேளுங்கள்.

8ac62c6f-cc49-4bf9-8ded-aebbadeaab77.title: Maa Alakshmi: Durbhagya Ki Devi aur Maa Lakshmi Ki Badi Bahen
8ac62c6f-cc49-4bf9-8ded-aebbadeaab77.description: Mata Lakshmi dhan aur samriddhi ki devi hain, ye toh aap sabhi ko pata hoga. Par kya aap unki badi behan Maa Alakshmi ke baare mein jaante hai, jinhe durbhagya, gareebi, rog aur vivad ki devi maana jaata hai? Iss show mein suniye Maa Alakshmi se judi anek pauaranik gaathayein aur jaane kyon samaaj mein santulan banaye rakhne ke liye Maa Alakshmi ka hona anivarya hai.

death-valley.title: Death Valley
death-valley.description: ഗൂഡല്ലൂരിലെ മനോഹരമായ താഴ്വരയിൽ സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്ന ആത്മാനന്ദ ആശ്രമം, ഒരു പുലർച്ചെ  ആ കാഴ്ച കണ്ട്  ആശ്രമവാസികൾ സ്തബ്ദ്ധരായി. ആശ്രമത്തിനു സമീപം ഒരു യുവതിയുടെ ശവം!  താഴ്വരയിലെ നിവാസികളെ ആകെ ഭീതിയിലാഴ്ത്തി പിന്നെയും പല ദുരൂഹ മരണങ്ങൾ അവിടെ  സംഭവിക്കുന്നു. കുതിരക്കൊല്ലിയിലെ കൊലപാതക പരമ്പരയുടെ ചുരുൾ നിവരുന്ന ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലർ കേൾക്കാം!

ashtamangalyam.title: അഷ്ടമംഗല്യം
ashtamangalyam.description: സമ്പത്തുകൊണ്ടും സൗന്ദര്യംകൊണ്ടും എല്ലാം തികഞ്ഞ ഗൗരിയുടെ വിവാഹം മുടങ്ങിയപ്പോഴാണ് അവൾ ആ ഞെട്ടിക്കുന്ന സത്യം മനസ്സിലാക്കുന്നത്. മുൻജന്മത്തിലെ  ഭർത്താവിനെ മാത്രമേ അവൾക്കു വരിക്കാനാവൂ. കേൾക്കാം...ഏറ്റുമാനൂർ ശിവകുമാറിന്റെ ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കഥ- അഷ്ടമംഗല്യം!

power-of-the-super-mind.title: Power of the Super Mind
power-of-the-super-mind.description: Insaan chahe to kya nahin kar sakta. Uski ichha shakti mein bahut dum hota hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain, uski ye ichha shakti use ameer bhi bana sakti hai? Ji haan, aap agar Ameer hone ka soch lein to aap bhi ameer ho sakte hain. Magar kaise? Isi Rahasay ka pata lagane ke liye suniye hamari ye kitab...

sethuvinte-naalu-novellakal.title: സേതുവിന്റെ 4 നോവെല്ലകൾ
sethuvinte-naalu-novellakal.description: മലയാളത്തിന്റെ പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട കഥാകാരൻ സേതുവിൻറെ നാല് നോവെല്ലകളുടെ സമാഹാരം. മനുഷ്യജീവിതത്തിലെ വികാരതലങ്ങളെ ഒപ്പിയെടുക്കുന്ന മനോഹരമായ കഥകൾ!

the-hindu-way-3.title: The Hindu Way
the-hindu-way-3.description: Freedom se oneness tak ka safar kaise tay kiya jaaye? Is show mein Hindu philosophy ke through, seekhiye apne mann aur aatma ko kaise ek karna hai. Toh der kis baat ki, abhi suniye aur apni spiritual journey ko start kariye!

antharmukhi.title: ಅಂತರ್ಮುಖಿ
antharmukhi.description: **ಅಂತರ್ಮುಖಿ** ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ತೆಲುಗು ಲೇಖಕ ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ ಅವರ ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಮತ್ತು ಆಳವಾದ ಪುಸ್ತಕವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಆತ್ಮಶೋಧನೆ, ಅಂತರ್ದರ್ಶನ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆಗಳ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ನಾಯಕನ ಅಂತರಾಳದ ಪ್ರಯಾಣವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾವನೆಗಳ ಆಳಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಓದುಗರನ್ನು ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಭಾವನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಲು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಮಾನವ ಮಾನಸಿಕತೆಯ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

kathe-kathe-karana.title: ಕಥೆ ಕಥೆ ಕಾರಣ
kathe-kathe-karana.description: Vaidehi's feminist sensibility is not only about women's lives. About all human beings. It has always been objected by some that he did not write anything about women of the lower classes. After reading the stories of 'Baki Itihasa' and Manjammajji, what can be the level of life of those women? Vaidehi's approach is not to try to answer the questions that arise from all sorts of theoretical readings.

97dae016-1339-4d46-9b53-7a89e9d01385.title: उपासना की विधियाँ: उद्धव गीता
97dae016-1339-4d46-9b53-7a89e9d01385.description: Uddhava Geeta par aadharit iss show mein jaaniye ki sahi upasana vidhi kaise aapki prarthanaon ko aur bhi jyada prabhavshaali bana sakti hai.

salma-mathu-surabhi.title: ಸಲ್ಮಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸುರಭಿ
salma-mathu-surabhi.description: Salma and Surabhi focuses on the deep bond of friendship between two women from different backgrounds and their struggles and triumphs in navigating societal expectations and personal aspirations. The novel portrays the intricacies of their relationship and the challenges they face in a traditional society.

election-effect-on-stock-market.title: Election Effect On Stock Market
election-effect-on-stock-market.description: തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പ് ഫലം ഓഹരി വിപണിയെ എങ്ങനെ സ്വാധീനിക്കുന്നു? വോട്ടെണ്ണലിന് മുമ്പുള്ള കുതിപ്പും ഫലം വന്നതിന് ശേഷമുള്ള ഇടിവും - നിങ്ങളുടെ നിക്ഷേപങ്ങൾ സുരക്ഷിതമാക്കാൻ വഴികൾ അറിയാം!

01f4e849-def7-41c7-b5cb-76a0c0a4af67.title: काशी की ओर: आध्यात्मिक यात्रा-शंकराचार्य के पथ पर
01f4e849-def7-41c7-b5cb-76a0c0a4af67.description: Itihas ki gehraiyon mein doobe Karan aur Vikram ki romanchak yatra ki shuruaat! Jaane kaise Adi Shankaracharya ne magarmach ke changul se khud ko chhudaya aur maa ki aakhri iccha poori ki. Is adbhut yatra mein jude rahiye humare saath.

kibulu.title: ಕಿಲುಬು
kibulu.description: Famous author Kum. Veerabhadrappa's unique satirical novel 'Kilubu'. About this novel R. Dodde Gowda said 'Politics in this work extends from district to state, from state to nation, from nation to the whole world. Kumvi has unveiled the various faces of politicians, governors, bureaucrats, lawyers in a scathingly satirical style.

enter-the-dragon.title: ಎಂಟರ್ ದಿ ಡ್ರ್ಯಾಗನ್
enter-the-dragon.description: Kum Vee ever popular novelist, storyteller. Veerabhadrappa hails from Kottur in Kudligi taluk of Bellary district. Born on 1st October 1953. Kum Vee  jumped the fences of the polite heritage of Kannada literature through the short story 'Beli and Hola'. Veerabhadrappa captivated the readers with his unique linguistic experiments and phrasing.

474a6ba1-4535-44d9-a2de-e707cdd3ff87.title: Wabi Sabi : Embracing The Beauty of Imperfection
474a6ba1-4535-44d9-a2de-e707cdd3ff87.description:
|Key Insights - Beauty of Imperfection, Natural Loving Attitude, Guaranteed Bliss|
Doston, kya aapne kabhi socha hai ki hamari zindagi mein imperfections khoobsurat hoti hai?  Hum apne naye show mein aapko ek aisi Japanese concept se rubaroo karayenge jise jaan kar aap apni khaamiyon ko dekhne ka nazaaria hi badal denge aur khud ko aur apni zindagi ko ek nayee raah par le jaayenge jahan har kadam par aapko khushi, prem aur santushti hi haasil hogi.

నిన్నే-ప్రేమిస్తా-.title: నిన్నే ప్రేమిస్తా
నిన్నే-ప్రేమిస్తా-.description: అసలు కావ్య ఎవరు? ఒక బార్ డాన్సర్ గా పరిచయం అయిన కావ్య వెనుక కోటీశ్వరుడు అయిన కార్తీక్ ఎందుకు పడుతున్నాడు? కావ్య ని ఎందుకు హింసిస్తున్నాడు? అది ప్రేమా? ద్వేషమా? లేక పంతమా?

the-almanack-of-naval-ravikant-6.title: The Almanack Of Naval Ravikant
the-almanack-of-naval-ravikant-6.description: பணம், மகிழ்ச்சி, ஆரோக்கியம் . இந்த மூனையும் அடைஞ்சு செம்மயா வாழணும்னா வாழ்க்கையோட அடிப்படைகள நாம புரிஞ்சுக்க வேண்டியது அவசியம். அதத்தான் இந்த Audiobook கத்துக்கொடுக்குது. வாங்க தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம்.

bali-yug-yuagantar-pratishodh.title: Baali
bali-yug-yuagantar-pratishodh.description: Terrorist attack ke bad wapas active hua ek secret organisation. Aur tab samne aaya prachin Bharat ka ek aisa yoddha jisne Desh ke sath Puri duniya Ko hila Diya. Jiski chahat thi badla jo maut ke baad bhi khatam nahi hui. Sune Baali, Pratishodh ki wo gatha jo ladi jaa rahi hai yugo-yugo se.

kaviyaaga-nee-pizhaiyaaga-naan.title: Kaviyaaga Nee... Pizhaiyaaga Naan...
kaviyaaga-nee-pizhaiyaaga-naan.description: கவிதா பெரிய நிறுவனத்துக்குச் சொந்தக்காரி. மல்டி மில்லினியர். ஆனால், அறிவு எளிய கிராமத்தைச் சேர்ந்த முரட்டு வாலிபன். இருவருக்கும் இடையே தெய்வத்தின் அருளால், இருவருமே எதிர்பாராத நிலையில் திருமணம் நடந்துவிடுகிறது. இருவரின் திருமணமும் கரைசேர்ந்ததா?

business-ke-5-powerful-moves-by-mark-zuc.title: Business Ke 5 Powerful Moves by Mark Zuckerberg
business-ke-5-powerful-moves-by-mark-zuc.description: Mark Zuckerberg ke safalta ke raaz! Kya aap bhi unke jaise successful banna chahte hain? Is KUKU FM Byte ko suno aur jaaniye junoon, mission aur perfect team ki importance.

andhapuram-pogathe-arinjaya.title: Andhapuram Pogathe Arinjaya
andhapuram-pogathe-arinjaya.description: சோழ நாட்டின் இளவரசன் அரிஞ்சய சோழன். அவன் அந்தப்புரம் சென்றால் இறந்துவிட்டுவான் என்றும், அவனைக் கொல்ல அந்தப்புரத்தில் ஒரு பெண் காத்திருக்கிறாள் என்றும் ரகசியத் தகவல் கிடைக்கிறது. அதையும் மீறி அரிஞ்சயன் அந்தப்புரம் செல்கிறான். அவன் உயிர் தப்பினானா?

ghost-gang.title: Ghost Gang 1 & 2
ghost-gang.description: ஊரில் ஒதுக்குப்புறமாக, ஹைவேயில் தனித்து இருக்கும் வீடுகளைக் குறிவைத்துக் கொள்ளையடிக்கிறது ஒரு கூட்டம். பேய் போல வந்து, தடயமே இல்லாமல் கொன்று, கொள்ளையடித்துவிட்டுச் சென்றுவிடுவதால் அதற்கு கோஸ்ட் கேங்க் என்று பெயர். Ghost gang திருடர்கள் சிக்குவார்களா?

how-to-grow-your-own-money.title: How To Grow Your Own Money
how-to-grow-your-own-money.description: Kya aap bhi apni spare money ko kahin invest karne ka soch rahe hain?. Lekin market mein available multiple options jaise savings accounts, shares, bonds ya phir property, in sab mein se kaun sa aapke liye sahi hai ye aapko samajh nahi aa raha, right? In mein se kab, kis mein aur kis adhar par investment karni chahiye, apne in sab sawalon ke jawab janne ke liye hamara ye show suniye.

unnil-vanjam-kondenadaa.title: Unnil Vanjam Kondenadaa
unnil-vanjam-kondenadaa.description: மீரா சுதந்திரமா வாழணும்னு நினைக்கறவ. அப்போ தான் அவளோட வாழ்க்கைல கவின் வரான். அவன் மீது கொண்ட காதலால, அவளையே மாதிக்கறா. ஆனால், கவின் ரொம்ப டாக்சிக்கா பிகேவ் பன்றான். மீரா என்ன செய்ய போறா? காதலுக்காக அவனோட டாக்சிக்க அனுபவிப்பாளா இல்ல துணிஞ்சி முடிவு எடுப்பாளா?

ennaruge-nee-irunthaal.title: Ennaruge Nee irunthaal
ennaruge-nee-irunthaal.description: தன் தாய் தந்தையின் பிரிவால் திருமண பந்தத்தில் நம்பிக்கை இல்லாத நாயகன்,  தன் தாய் தந்தையை போல் காதலோடு திருமண வாழ்க்கையை வாழ நினைக்கும் கதாநாயகி. இருவரும் காதலில் விழுகின்றனர். இவர்கள் காதல் திருமணத்தில் முடியுமா? இல்லை பிரியுமா?

da814edc-5f52-4630-890e-024de1e81471.title: The Go-Getter: A Story That Tells You How To Be One
da814edc-5f52-4630-890e-024de1e81471.description: Iss show mein jaaniye kaise self-belief aur determination se aap kisi bhi mushkil ko paar kar sakte hain. Yeh kahani aapko sikhayegi ki haar maanne se pahle humesha ek aur koshish jarur karni chahiye

theendaatha-thee-neeye.title: Theendaatha Thee Neeye
theendaatha-thee-neeye.description: மர்மத் தீவில் அணையாக நெருப்பாக சுடர் விடும் மரணத் தீயில் சிறைவைக்கப்பட்டிருக்கிறாள் நித்திலா. அவளுடன் கொள்ளையர்களின் புதையலும் மறைத்து வைக்கப்பட்டிருக்கிறது. அந்த மரணத் தீயைக் கைப்பற்ற மந்திரவாதி ஒருத்தனும், புதையலைக் கைப்பற்ற கடற்கொள்ளையன் ஒருத்தனும் முயற்சிக்கிறார்கள். இவர்களிடம் சிக்கிக் கொள்கிறான் வசந்தகுமார். அவர்களின் நோக்கம் நிறைவேறியதா?

vanjam-theerkka-vaarayo.title: Vanjam Theerkka Vaarayo..!
vanjam-theerkka-vaarayo.description: ரத்னபுரியில், இரவு எட்டு மணி கடந்து எந்த ஆண் மகன் வீட்டை விட்டு வெளியே வந்தாலும் அவனது உயிருக்கும் கற்புக்கும் கடவுளால் கூட உத்தரவாதம் கொடுக்க இயலாது. அந்த ஊர் ஜமீன்தாரின் மகனது உயிரைக் குடிக்க நூற்றாண்டுக்கும் மேலாக குருதித் தாகத்துடன் காத்திருக்கிறாள், சூலினி. அவளது குருதித் தாகம் அடங்கியதா, சூலினியின் ஜென்மப் பகைக்குக் காரணம் என்ன? மரணங்களுக்குப் பின்னணியில் இருக்கும் மர்ம முடிச்சு தான் என்ன?

the-art-of-money-getting-3.title: The Art Of Money Getting
the-art-of-money-getting-3.description: Yeh show aapko financial success aur independence dilane mein madad karega. Har episode mein practical tips aur strategies share ki jayengi jo aapki life ko financially stable aur prosperous banane mein helpful hogi.

జరుగుతున్నది-జగన్నాటకం-.title: జరుగుతున్నది జగన్నాటకం
జరుగుతున్నది-జగన్నాటకం-.description: ముగ్గురు స్నేహితులు ఒక రోజు రేవ్ పార్టీకీ వెళ్లారు, ఆ రోజు డ్రగ్స్ తీసుకుని ఆ మత్తులో ముగ్గురులో ఒకడు ఒక అమ్మాయిని కలిసాడు. హఠాత్తుగా అతను ఒక విచిత్రమైన దీవి లో మేలుకున్నాడు, అతను ఎవరో ఏంటో అతనికే గుర్తులేని పరిస్థితిలో పడ్డాడు. ఆ చోటులో ఎవరికీ దేశం పేరు కూడా తెలియదు, అసలు రేవ్ పార్టీ నుంచి వేరే ప్రపంచం లోకి ఎలా వెళ్ళాడు? అక్కడ ఎలాంటి పరిస్థితి ఎదురుకున్నాడు.

manzil-ya-maut.title: Manzil ya Maut ?
manzil-ya-maut.description: Tower ke upar pahunchkar mil sakta hai jo kuchh bhi insaan chahta hai. Lekin uske liye paar karne honge zindagi aur maut ke test. Kya Saksham apne se kai guna shaktishali monsters ko harakar dhoondh paayega apni roshni ko aur pardaafaash kar paayega tower ke rahasya ka?

రాముని-కృష్ణుని-రహస్యాలు.title: రాముని కృష్ణుని రహస్యాలు
రాముని-కృష్ణుని-రహస్యాలు.description: రాజ్యాంగ రూపకర్త అంబేద్కర్ రామాయణ-మహాభారతాల పై ఎన్నో విమర్శలు చేసారు. అలంటి విమర్శలు చేసి రాసిన పుస్తకమే ఈ  “రాముని కృష్ణుని రహస్యాలు”. ఇందులో అంబేద్కర్ రాముని, మరియు కృష్ణుని యొక్క వ్యక్తిత్వాన్ని ఉదాహరణలు ఇస్తూ విమర్శిస్తాడు. రాముని పాత్ర చాలా నిస్సారమయిందనే వాదన తో పాటు కృష్ణుడి కుటిల నీతిని అంబేద్కర్ ఇందులో ప్రస్తావించారు. ఇంకా పూర్తిగా తెసుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

వంశీ-కి-నచ్చిన-కథలు--.title: వంశీ కి నచ్చిన కథలు
