వంశీ-కి-నచ్చిన-కథలు--.description: ఈ కథలు ఎప్పటికైనా ఏ భాషలోనైనా ఎల్లలు లేనివి. ఎప్పటికీ ఆస్వాదించతగ్గవి. నన్ను ఏళ్ళ తరబడి వెంటాడుతుండేవి. నాకెందుకు అంతగా నచ్చాయో ప్రతి కథ చివరా అయిదారు వాక్యాల్లో చెప్పడానికి ప్రయత్నం చేసాను- వంశీ.

45fc655b-af37-4dfe-8216-ffb687665f64.title: Billionaire Madam Ki Hatya
45fc655b-af37-4dfe-8216-ffb687665f64.description: Raat ke sannate mein ek high-profile socialite ka murder, aur Mumbai Police ke ek officer ki jaan ko khatra! Kya Raghav Joshi uncover kar paayega is raaz ko? Dekhiye kaise ek mysterious case banta hai tension-filled investigation, sirf KUKU FM par.

జీనా-హైతో-మర్‌నా-సీఖో--జార్జ్-రెడ్డి-.title: జీనా హైతో మర్‌నా సీఖో - జార్జ్ రెడ్డి
జీనా-హైతో-మర్‌నా-సీఖో--జార్జ్-రెడ్డి-.description: కేవలం పాతిక సంవత్సరాలు మాత్రమే జీవించి, ఉస్మానియా కేంద్రంగా జార్జి, అతని స్నేహితులు సాగించిన పోరాటం తెలుగునాట విప్లవ ప్రజాస్వామిక ఉద్యమాలకు కొత్త ఊపిరులూదింది. సునిశితమైన మేధ, సమాజాన్ని మార్చాలన్న తపన, ఆర్ధ్రమైన హృదయం, అంతులేని సాహసం వీటన్నింటి కళ కలిపితే జార్జి రెడ్డి. ఆయన గురించి మీకు తెలియని ఎన్నో విషయాల గురించి తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

uyirukkul-oru-kural.title: Uyirukkul Oru Kural
uyirukkul-oru-kural.description: ஜிவா கணவனைப் பிரிந்து தனியே வாழும் இளம் பெண். பக்கத்து வீட்டு இளம் தம்பதியினர் சந்தோஷமாக வாழ்வதை பார்க்கும் பொழுது, தன் கடந்த காலத்தை நினைத்து ஏங்குகிறாள். திடீரென்று ஒரு நாள் இரவில், பக்கத்து வீட்டிலிருந்து அலறல் சத்தம் கேட்கிறது. அன்றிலிருந்து, பக்கத்து வீட்டு பெண் தொலைந்து போய்விட்டாள். ஜிவா  இந்த குழப்பங்களுக்கான விடையைக் கண்டுபிடிப்பாளா? கடந்த காலத்தை மறந்து, தன் வாழ்க்கையை சீரமைத்துக் கொள்வாளா?

secret-agent-couples.title: Mr. & Mrs. Agent
secret-agent-couples.description: Have you ever imagined a secret spy game unfolding in the streets of Patna? Agent Aryan, also known as Rajveer, accidentally causes the death of a little girl during a mission. Broken by guilt, he leaves the spy world and returns to his hometown, Patna. But his life takes a strange turn when he is forced to marry a kidnapped girl, Nikita. Neither of them knows that the other is a secret agent. What will happen when the truth comes out? Listen to Mr. & Mrs. Agent, only on Kuku FM.

ceos-marriage-proposal.title: CEO's Marriage Proposal
ceos-marriage-proposal.description: Six years after a life-altering night, Melissa Drake and powerful businessman Matthew Jackson are reunited, sparking memories and new tensions. Raised by the mistreating Drake family, Melissa shines despite her past, now thrust into a contract marriage with Matthew. Amidst the glamour of Los Angeles, their marriage faces secrets, love, and betrayal. As Melissa navigates her concealed truths and challenging future, can their bond withstand the revelations to come? Dive into CEO's Marriage Proposal to explore a story of resilience, romance, and hidden passions.

your-right-to-be-rich-2.title: Your Right to be Rich
your-right-to-be-rich-2.description: 💵 நெறயா பணம் சம்பாதிக்கணும்னு ஆசைப்படுறீங்களா? அப்போ நீங்க, உலகப்புகழ் பெற்ற எழுத்தாளர் Napoleon Hill பணம் பற்றி சொல்லி இருக்குற இந்த விசயங்கள கண்டிப்பா தெரிஞ்சுக்கணும்.  Your Right to be Rich ஆடியோ புத்தகத்த இப்பவே கேளுங்க🎧. உங்க பணப்பிரச்சினைகள சரி செய்ங்க💰.

the-master-of-achievement.title: The Master of Achievement
the-master-of-achievement.description: Har target ko hit karne ki strategy aur effective planning techniques janiye The Master of Achievement mein. Yeh show aapko banayega real achiever. Toh abhi suniye aur apne achievements ko next level pe le jayiye!

acres-of-diamonds.title: Acres of Diamonds
acres-of-diamonds.description: 💬 Russell H. Conwell எழுதுன "Acres of Diamonds" உங்களுக்கான செல்வ செழிப்பான வாழ்க்கைய நீங்க தேடி கண்டடைய உதவுற வழிகாட்டி. இது உங்க கனவுகள நெஜமாக்க நீங்க பயணம் செய்ய வேண்டிய பாதைய உங்களுக்கு நிச்சயம் காட்டும் 🌟

madam-billionaire.title: Madam Billionaire
madam-billionaire.description: Middle class life ji rahi Disha ka dil toot jaata hai, jab uski life ka pahla boyfriend Vishwas, uski chhoti bahin Khushbu ke saath mil ke ushe dhokha de deta hai. Vo faisla leti hai ki Khushbu ki birthday ke din vo Vishwas ko sabke saamne expose kar degi, lekin poori family hi Disha ke khilaaf khadi ho jaati hai. Disha ke saamne aata hai ek aesa sach, jise vo bardaasht nahin kar paati. Ghar-baar chhod ke vo chal padti hai kuch ajnabiyon ki talaash me... Aakhir kya tha Disha ka vo bhayanak sach? Aakhir kaise Disha banegi Madam Billionaire?

golden-rules-for-living-your-best-life-1.title: Golden Rules For Living Your Best Life
golden-rules-for-living-your-best-life-1.description: உங்களோட Best life- அ வாழ ! Swami Mukundananda சொல்ற இந்த வாழ்வியல் வழிமுறைகள் உங்களுக்கு நிச்சயம் உதவும். பணம் சம்பாதிக்கிறதுல இருக்குற மன சிக்கல்கள சரி செய்றதுக்கான வழிகளையும், மகிழ்ச்சியா, மனநிறைவா, ஆரோக்கியமா வாழ்றதுக்கான Easy யான practical செயல்முறைகளையும் இந்த Audiobook மூலமா கத்துக்கலாம் வாங்க.

nuvve-kaadu.title: నువ్వే కాదు
nuvve-kaadu.description: ఆ ప్రమాదం సృష్టించబడిందా లేక సహజం గా జరిగిందా? ఎందుకు ఒక సాధారణ హౌస్ వైఫ్ నుంచి గవర్నమెంట్ అఫీషియల్స్ దాకా పరుగులు పెడుతున్నారు ఆ ప్రమాదం చుట్టూ? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

robaroo-khud-se-pehchaan.title: Robaroo: Khud se Pehchaan
robaroo-khud-se-pehchaan.description: Zindagi ki bhaag daud mein hum khud ko hi bhool jaate hain. Hamari zindagi ka concentration ye decide karta hai ki hamaara jeene ka tareeka kaisa hoga. Aur ye show aapko seekhayega ki sahi spiritual practices ke saath ek acha aur safal jeevan kaise jeeya jaata hai. Toh der kis baat ki? Abhi sunna shuru karein 'Robaroo: Khud se Pehchaan.'

vimukta-volga.title: విముక్త
vimukta-volga.description: సీత పురుషోత్తమ రామునిచే విడిచిపెట్టబడిన తరువాత, స్వీయ-సాక్షాత్కారానికి కష్టతరమైన ప్రయాణాన్ని ప్రారంభించింది. దారిలో, భర్తలు, కుమారులు మరియు వారి కోరికలు, అందం మరియు పవిత్రత వంటి వాటి నుండి విముక్తి పొందిన అసాధారణ మహిళలను ఆమె కలుసుకుంటుంది. ఇంతకీ ఎవరు ఆ మహిళలు  తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే "విముక్త" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ తప్పకుండా వినండి.

reflections-swami-vivekananda.title: Reflections : Swami Vivekananda
reflections-swami-vivekananda.description: வாழ்க்கை, தனி மனித முன்னேற்றம், யோகம், ஆன்மீகம் பற்றி சுவாமி விவேகானந்தர் செய்த சொற்பொழிவுகள், நடத்திய வகுப்புகள் இந்த தொகுப்புல ஆடியோ வடிவத்துல இருக்கு. இந்த Audiobook ஆன்மீகப் பாதைல நாம முன்னேறிச்செல்ல நிச்சயம் உறுதுணையா இருக்கும்.

14c7e7c8-82db-46e9-a90b-c8b28faf576c.title: Shree Dattartreya Ki Rochak Kahaaniyan
14c7e7c8-82db-46e9-a90b-c8b28faf576c.description: Janiye Shree Dattatreya ke kahaaniyon se unki mahima aur shaktiyon ke raaz jo na hi sirf rochak hai par hamare jeevan ko ek saral aadhyatmik disha mein le jaane mein paripoorna hain.

sreekrishna-kadhakal.title: ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണ കഥകൾ
sreekrishna-kadhakal.description: എത്ര കേട്ടാലും  മതിവരാത്ത കൃഷ്ണകഥകൾ. ശ്രീകൃഷ്ണന്റെ അവതാരം മുതലുള്ള കഥകൾ മലയാളത്തിന്റെ പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട കഥാകാരി സുമംഗല പൂർണരൂപത്തിൽ ആദ്യമായി അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

sivamayam-2.title: சிவமயம் - Part2
sivamayam-2.description: ஆகாச லிங்கத்தை தேடி, ஆபத்து நிறைந்த சிவன் மலைக் காட்டிற்குள் ஒரு திகில் பயணம்!

ed23d584-d2f9-4044-824b-2bd64fe4ad8b.title: Apna Sapna Money Money
ed23d584-d2f9-4044-824b-2bd64fe4ad8b.description: Abhishek ki boring life tab badal jaati hai jab wo ek lottery jeet jata hai. Kya ye paisa uski life mein khushi laayega ya naye problems? Jaanne ke liye suniye humara yeh show.

sivamayam-1.title: சிவமயம் - Part1
sivamayam-1.description: ஆகாச லிங்கத்தை தேடி, ஆபத்து நிறைந்த சிவன் மலைக் காட்டிற்குள் ஒரு திகில் பயணம்!

engae-en-kannan.title: எங்கே என் கண்ணன்
engae-en-kannan.description:
'கடவுள் இருக்கிறாரா? இல்லையா?' எனும் கேள்விக்கான பதிலைத் தேடி ஒரு நீண்ட பயணம். 
கேளுங்க இந்திர சௌந்தர்ராஜனின் விறுவிறு ஆன்மிகத் த்ரில்லர்...

agnirathi-vinash-aur-yudh.title: Agnirathi: Vinash aur Yudh
agnirathi-vinash-aur-yudh.description: Yoddha Kaustubh jo vishwa shanti ke liye Meghpuram ko apna lakshya banakar nikal pada ek khatarnak safar par. Jahan uska saamna hua rahasyamai jadugaro aur khoonkaar vanvasiyon se. Kya yudh bhumi, aur dusht sainiko ko kaat kar Kaustubh apne lakshya ko pa saka? ya dushmano ke shadyantra ka ban gaya shikar? Janne ke liye sune Agnirathi: Vinash aur Yudh.

karnan-2.title: കർണൻ
karnan-2.description: കർണൻ എന്ന ഇതിഹാസ നായകന്റെ യഥാർത്ഥ ജീവിതകഥ. ജീവിതകാലം മുഴുവനും  മാനുഷികവും ദൈവികവുമായ വെല്ലുവിളികള് ആത്മധൈര്യത്തോടെ നേരിട്ട കർണന്റെ ജീവചരിത്രം നിങ്ങളെ വിസ്മയിപ്പിക്കും.

my-cold-blooded-alpha-king-4.title: My Cold Blooded Alpha King
my-cold-blooded-alpha-king-4.description: She isn’t just an ordinary girl — her blood holds the cure to the cursed Magnums. To protect her comes a ruthless Alpha King, whose rules are as deadly as his name. In this world of fiery romance and fierce revenge, one wrong move could cost a lifetime of regret.

haseeno-ka-deewana.title: Haseeno Ka Deewana
haseeno-ka-deewana.description: Kabir, an aspiring content creator, grapples with generational conflict and financial instability, leading him to acquire a mysterious phone with a forbidden 'Attract Beauty Mode.' His professional ambitions are repeatedly thwarted by powerful executives, including Sonia, who recognizes him from a past as 'Saumya,' and his fiancée Sheena, who prioritizes financial security. As he enters the corporate world, Kabir faces ruthless power struggles with aggressive colleagues like Ria, who is later revealed as CEO, and manipulative figures such as Aarohi, the head of finance. Amidst these challenges, Kabir's past connection with Aarohi resurfaces, and he navigates tumultuous relationships, including a breakup with Sheena and finding support from friends like Anu and Neeti. Concurrently, a dangerous corporate war unfolds, with CEO Aarohi fiercely defending her company against menacing shareholder Karan and his sinister alliance with Mr. Shah, who harbors an obsessive desire for her. Kabir becomes embroiled in uncovering a major investment fraud by the powerful Roy Group, secretly investigating while his loyalty to Aarohi is tested by Karan's demands for his sacrifice. Aarohi, in turn, fiercely defends Kabir against corporate rebellion and accusations of a romantic entanglement, highlighting their complex bond. A shocking revelation exposes Kabir's mysterious influence over powerful heiress Kirti, transforming him into a figure of hidden sway. His life is further upended when his live-in partner, Tanya, is revealed to be Kirti Roy, a wealthy heiress and fiancée to the powerful Arjun, implicating Kabir in corporate schemes. Despite this betrayal, Kabir, as a loyal subordinate, helps CEO Aarohi save her company from financial collapse by spearheading a successful live-streaming sales event. This professional triumph, however, thrusts Kabir into a complex love triangle, with Kirti proposing marriage, an ex-lover seeking reconciliation, and Neeti harboring unrequited affection. Haunted by dreams of conditional love, Kabir grapples with the temptation of an easy path offered by a mysterious futuristic phone, yearning for a genuine connection beyond his newfound success. The show explores themes of corporate treachery, class struggle, and the blurring lines of reality as Kabir fights for his passion, self-determination, and genuine connection amidst dangerous power dynamics.

farewell-to-old-love-6.title: Farewell to Old Love
farewell-to-old-love-6.description: A woman abandoned by her husband rises to power, but behind her composed exterior lies a storm of pain and pride. When their paths cross again, will the past consume her or set her free?

dont-think-about-it-lady.title: Don't think about it, lady
dont-think-about-it-lady.description:
ఒక ధైర్యసాహసాలనుగల యువతి ఆఫీసు ఒత్తిడులు,  అపార్థాలు, వ్యక్తిగత అనుమానాలను ఎదుర్కొంటుంది.
అతడిపై పెరుగుతున్న భావాలను తలచుకుంటూ, చాలా ఎక్కువగా ఊహించుకుంటూ సవాళ్లను అధిగమిస్తుంది.
తన నిజాయితీ, పట్టుదల ద్వారా ప్రేమ, ఆత్మ విశ్వాసంతో ఆమె ఏం సాధించింది అన్నదే కథ.

after-being-released-from-prison-big-guy.title: After being released from prison, big guy Mommy is exploding all over the world
after-being-released-from-prison-big-guy.description: సంవత్సరాల జైలు జీవితం తరువాత, ఒక తల్లి బయటకు అడుగు వేస్తుంది. రహస్యాలు ఒక్కొక్కటిగా వెలుగులోకి వస్తున్నప్పుడు, ఆమె తన బిడ్డను, తన గౌరవాన్ని, తన శక్తిని తిరిగి సంపాదించడానికి ఈ ప్రపంచాన్ని వణికిస్తుంది.

return-of-the-doctor-4.title: RETURN OF THE DOCTOR
return-of-the-doctor-4.description: She lost everything… but refused to stay down. Haunted by the past, she now faces a choice: pursue revenge or embrace forgiveness. A gripping, emotional drama where every moment brims with tension—don’t miss it, watch now!

brother-taken-by-greed.title: Brother Betrayal
brother-taken-by-greed.description: Alok Upadhyay, a noble elder brother, sacrifices everything to secure a bright future for his younger brother Rohan. But as Alok rises to power with the support of his devoted wife Anita and strong-willed daughter Aditi, Rohan, twisted by greed and fueled by his arrogant wife Diya, betrays the very family that gave him everything. A tale of sacrifice, ambition, and the tragic downfall of brotherhood.

virajitha-swayamvaram.title: Virajitha Swayamvaram
virajitha-swayamvaram.description:
A wealthy girl’s marriage is arranged through a swayamvaram (a traditional ceremony where many suitors gather). Among the many grooms who arrive, there is also a poor young man. The girl chooses him, but her father disapproves of his poverty. He sets a condition: “First become rich, then I will agree to the marriage.”

The story then follows the young man’s journey to achieve wealth, the challenges he faces along the way, and the secrets that unfold.

meri-aashiqui-ab-tum-hi-ho.title: Meri Aashiqui Ab Tum Hi Ho
meri-aashiqui-ab-tum-hi-ho.description: Meri Aashiqui Ab Tum Hi Ho is a heartbreaking romantic drama of eternal love, sacrifice, and fate. Meera’s world shatters when she discovers Arjun’s betrayal, unaware he is hiding a fatal illness and pushing her away to protect her dreams. As secrets, scandals, and destiny collide, their love is tested to its final breath—where passion meets tragedy in the most unforgettable way.

tales-from-the-no-mans-land-3.title: Tales from the No-Man's Land
tales-from-the-no-mans-land-3.description:
পথের মাঝে দুই তরুণী তাদের লিফটের অনুরোধ করে। কাকা এক তরুণীকে কু-ইচ্ছা নিয়ে দেখেন, কিন্তু তাকে রক্ষা করতে চায় একটি ছেলে
তবে, যে মেয়েটি বাইরে থেকে ভীত ও অসহায় মনে হচ্ছে — সে আদৌ কি সত্যিই ভয় পেয়েছে? সে আসলে কার সঙ্গে এসেছে? তার মুখে যেটুকু দেখা যায়, তার আড়ালে কি লুকিয়ে আছে কোনো গভীর রহস্য?

the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.title: The Daughter-in-Law Who Married Far Away
the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.description:
একজন ধনী ও ক্ষমতাশালী মা জানতে পারেন যে, তার প্রিয় মেয়ে এক নির্যাতনকারী কিন্তু মোহনীয় স্বামীর হাতে নীরবে কষ্ট পাচ্ছে।
যেখানে বিচার হয় না আদালতে, বরং নীরবতায়, কৌশলে, এবং এক মায়ের অপ্রতিরোধ্য প্রতিশোধে।

prince-gone-rogue.title: Sanyaas vs Shararat
prince-gone-rogue.description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

three-lives-ring-2.title: Three Lives Ring
three-lives-ring-2.description: The microdrama weaves together ancient magic, corporate intrigue, and fated love, primarily following a man known as both Alexander and Justin, and the extraordinary healer Alice. The story begins with King Alexander's execution, sparking a ruthless queen's hunt for the "Three Lives Sword," an artifact promising immortality. His true love, Elizabeth, grapples with his sacrifice and the burden of a mystical Longevity Ring. In a parallel, contemporary narrative, Justin, a Young Master, battles intense surveillance, family pressures, and corporate power struggles to reclaim his inheritance. His life is complicated by a forbidden romance and an interrupted arranged marriage to Sophie, who later makes a dark pact with the sorceress Clara for power and restored honor. As Justin faces betrayals, corporate espionage, and assassination attempts, he falls gravely ill with a mysterious, untreatable allergy. This leads to the arrival of Alice, a mysterious Longovite healer whose unique abilities become both a miracle and a dangerous target. Alice's selfless acts to cure Justin draw the attention of a powerful group obsessed with immortality, believing her blood holds the key to eternal life, making her a hunted figure. This creates a complex love triangle around Justin, Alice, and others, while Alice's brother discovers her fate is intertwined with interdimensional stability, with black holes appearing when children are in peril. The narrative deepens with revelations of past lives, connecting Justin/Alex to Princess Clara, whose past sacrifice of Alexander for her kingdom's peace is unveiled. This reveals a profound, multi-generational karmic entanglement. Clara, often driven by jealousy and a desire for mystical artifacts like the "Three Lives Sword," emerges as a recurring antagonist, manipulating Sophie and repeatedly poisoning Alice. Alice, revealed to be immortal, makes profound sacrifices, absorbing deadly poisons to save Justin, tragically limiting her own lifespan. As malevolent forces, including a death-defying Possessor and Kiran, relentlessly attack the fated lovers, Alice unleashes latent powers. The show culminates in Alice making a final, ultimate sacrifice within a surging magical portal to correct past mistakes, prompting Justin to finally confess his deep love for her. Their intertwined destinies highlight the profound stakes of love, power, and survival against both human and otherworldly adversaries across lifetimes, as ancient magic collides with modern threats.

baby-by-contract.title: Galti se mistake
baby-by-contract.description: mbitious and independent Ananya Sood finds her life turned upside down when a clinic mix-up leaves her unexpectedly pregnant. Facing judgment, secrets, and corporate politics under the sharp-eyed CEO Kabir Singh, she must choose between fear and courage. As hidden truths bind them together, Ananya learns that love, trust, and family aren’t accidents they’re choices made against all odds. Watch Now!

the-shalini-show-neethu-vanajakshi-jothe.title: The Shalini Show - Neethu Vanajakshi Jothe
the-shalini-show-neethu-vanajakshi-jothe.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹಲವರು ಕನಸು. ತಾವು ಇಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ, ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸ್ಬೇಕು, ನೇಮು-ಫೇಮು ಗಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಆ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋರು ಕೆಲವೇ ಮಂದಿ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅವರು ಇಟ್ಟ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ವು? ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇನು? ಅವರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಕಲಿಯುವ ಪಾಠ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಾಧಕರ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನ‌.. The Shalini Show..! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರು ಆ್ಯಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ. Watch Now!!

yama-ling-2.title: Yama Ling
yama-ling-2.description: A boy becomes the target of a deadly conspiracy, but he narrowly escapes with his life. Seeking refuge in a distant mountain, he disappears from the world. Over the next ten years, he immerses himself in intense Tantric practices, purifying his body and soul to gain divine powers. Once awakened with mystical strength, he descends the mountain—returning to confront those who wronged him and to take revenge for the betrayal against him and his family. Watch "Yama Ling" now!

billionaire-overnight.title: Billionaire Overnight
billionaire-overnight.description: A young, humble woman, Ira Kapoor, initially faces dismissal from a corporate interview at "Glam Diva" due to class prejudice, setting the stage for her dramatic entanglement with the very company that scorned her. Her 18th birthday is marred by an arrest linked to Glam Diva, leading to the shocking discovery that her long-believed-dead father is the incapacitated CEO of the company. Through a series of unexpected events, she is appointed the new CEO, a decision vehemently opposed by her ruthless uncle, Gajendra, her manipulative aunt, Shilpa, and other senior management. As Ira navigates treacherous corporate politics, hostile takeover attempts, and an income tax raid orchestrated by her scheming relatives, she must fight to prove her competence and uncover hidden truths. Her mother, who has kept secrets about her father, initially opposes her taking the CEO role, adding to the complex family drama. Ira faces immense pressure, including being framed for corporate malfeasance and manipulated into considering resignation, while her brother Vardhan falls into a coma. She uncovers a deep-seated conspiracy orchestrated by Gajendra and Shilpa, involving corporate espionage, stolen designs, and false accusations of data theft. Despite initial self-doubt and being forced to sell a significant portion of the company, Ira transforms into a determined leader, guided by her mother's wisdom and her father's legacy. Her resolve for vengeance intensifies with the discovery that her father, Vedant/Abhimanyu, was slowly poisoned. Ira confronts her relatives with irrefutable evidence of systematic corporate fraud and fiercely reclaims control of Glam Diva from treacherous family members. Her loyal ally, Arjun, whose initial actions seemed deceptive, becomes a crucial supporter and romantic interest. The show culminates with the unexpected awakening of her father, Abhimanyu, who seeks reconciliation and entrusts her with the CEO role, solidifying her hard-won victory and securing her family's legacy against overwhelming odds and deep-seated betrayal.

the-wonderful-life-after-a-flash-marriag.title: The Wonderful Life After a Flash Marriage
the-wonderful-life-after-a-flash-marriag.description: They married on a whim, knowing little about each other—just a leap of faith and a signed paper. What begins in awkwardness slowly transforms into something real, as love blooms amid chaos, laughter, and life’s little tests. The Wonderful Life After a Flash Marriage is a heartwarming romantic drama about unexpected love, second chances, and growing together.

sharabi-fighter-1.title: Sharaabi Fighter
sharabi-fighter-1.description: Sharaabi Fighter is a martial arts action-drama about hidden power, redemption, and destiny. Bablu, a ridiculed drunkard handyman at a legendary Kung Fu academy, secretly possesses the strength of the mythical “Iron Head.” As enemies challenge the academy and imposters claim his glory, Bablu must decide whether to keep hiding in the shadows—or rise as the true legend who can save them all.

married-but-available-perfume-and-moon-6.title: Married But Available: Perfume And Moon
married-but-available-perfume-and-moon-6.description: Alpha Arthur's return marked a grand estate feast where he rescued Chloe, the butler, from noble Eileen's insults. Despite Chloe's engagement for her grandfather's sake and Arthur's subsequent departure, she silently worked at William Manor to cover medical expenses. Arthur, captivated by Chloe's talent, defied opposition and annulled the engagement. In a surprising twist, Chloe's awakened werewolf genes unveiled her as Arthur's destined mate. Watch "Married But Available: Perfume And Moon" Now!

dont-mess-with-the-blind-heiress-4.title: Don't Mess With the Blind Heiress
dont-mess-with-the-blind-heiress-4.description: The president of Stewart Group dies mysteriously at home, leaving his daughter Florence blind. Determined to uncover the truth, she suspects her father's protector, Walt, might be the culprit. Through her investigation, she unravels the mystery and finds love. Watch "Don't Mess With the Blind Heiress" Now!

ishq-bhootiyapa.title: Twin Trouble
ishq-bhootiyapa.description: Twin Trouble is a thrilling romantic drama laced with secrets, betrayal, and supernatural twists. Kajal, desperate to save her ailing mother, is forced into a shocking deal by her estranged twin Diya—to live as her and enter a dangerous contract marriage with the mysterious billionaire Ali Mittal. But as Kajal’s path collides with Shaurya, a man tied to her past in ways she doesn’t yet know, love, lies, and haunting truths spiral into a storm she cannot escape.

divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-6.title: Divorce A Billionaire To Marry Him
divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-6.description:
అమ్మాయి జీవితంలో అనుకోకుండా పెళ్లి జరిగి తన భర్త ఎవరు ఆమెకే తెలియకపోతే... తర్వాత అతనే ఆమె బోస్ గా ఆమె ఉన్న ఆఫీస్ కి అడుగు పెడితే.!
అందమైన ప్రేమ కథ మనసారా చూడాలనుకుంటే వెంటనే ఈ షో చూడండి

khamma-ghani-1.title: Final Bliss
khamma-ghani-1.description: When billionaire industrialist Hardeep Singh Oberoi tries to shield his daughter Mahima from heartbreak, she launches “Mission Daddy Ki Dulhan” to find him a bride. Fate brings them to the warm-hearted Srikavita Nair, whose simple values clash yet connect with Hardeep’s guarded world. But as secrets of Srikavita’s past and her abusive ex-husband Rajeev Menon surface, relationships are tested, identities are shaken, and love, trust, and family bonds must stand the ultimate test. Watch Now!

flash-marriage-to-the-president-mrs-gu-i.title: Flash Marriage to the President: Mrs. Gu is Actually a Hidden Tycoon
flash-marriage-to-the-president-mrs-gu-i.description: A father driven by vengeance, a son haunted by a family tragedy, and a wedding that ends in public humiliation. As secrets behind a deadly past unravel, forced alliances begin to crack under emotional strain. This is a story of legacy, betrayal, and choices that defy tradition—where love, revenge, and honor collide.

bend-the-waist.title: Bend the waist
bend-the-waist.description: In the heart of campus life, a young university student experiences love for the very first time. Between lectures, late-night chats, and awkward confessions, emotions run deep and dreams begin to shift. This is a tender coming-of-age romance where youth, vulnerability, and love collide under the college sky.

at-30-i-have-a-lot-of-pocket-money.title: At 30, I Have a Lot of Pocket Money
at-30-i-have-a-lot-of-pocket-money.description: Just as he steps into his thirties, a man with endless pocket money dives into the city’s chaos, chasing opportunity and ambition. From street stalls to business empires, his rise is marked by misunderstandings, betrayals—and moments that force him to confront his true self. At 30, I Have a Lot of Pocket Money  is an urban short drama about wealth, transformation, and the price of growth.

main-thi-main-hoon.title: Dear Husband
main-thi-main-hoon.description: Ruhi apne daagon ko chhupate-chhupate pyaar, dhokhe aur dushmanon ki saazishon mein ulajh jaati hai. Har mod par Arjun ke saath uska rishta ek nayi kasauti se guzarta hai.

the-rise-begins-with-perspective-1.title: The Rise Begins With Perspective
the-rise-begins-with-perspective-1.description: An ordinary young man unexpectedly gains extraordinary powers. With his life turned upside down, he’s thrust into a world of danger, choices, and transformation. This is the journey of a common man becoming an uncommon hero.

ultimate-dangal.title: Ultimate Dangal
ultimate-dangal.description: Ultimate Dangal is a gripping tale of fallen champion Bajrang Pandey, once hailed as “King,” who now lives in the shadows of his broken past. When his fiery daughter Yuvika Pandey steps into the brutal MMA world against ruthless fighters like Garima “The Shark” Sharma and the cold-blooded champion Kaali, Bajrang must confront his own demons and rediscover his legacy. Watch Now!

the-hand-behind-the-scenes-3.title: The Hand Behind the Scenes
the-hand-behind-the-scenes-3.description: The Hand Behind the Scenes - Telugu

say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-5.title: Say I Love You When We Meet Again
say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-5.description: Two lovers, separated by fate, cross paths again—carrying the weight of heartbreak and hidden truths. Years may have passed, but the feelings haven’t faded. This is a story of lost love, second chances, and the courage to confront the past.

secret-samrat-1.title: Secret Prince
secret-samrat-1.description: The Eternal Champion follows the rise of Mehul Singhania, a man of unshakable resolve who battles betrayal, power struggles, and hidden agendas. Torn between his ex-wife Natasha, his loyal confidante Aaisha, and his destined fiancée Padmini, Mehul faces off against ruthless business tycoons like Cyrus Daruwala, Rushaad, and the influential Mittals. In a world where loyalty shifts like shadows, Mehul stands unbroken the one man destined to change the game forever.

your-wife-has-released-a-new-design.title: Your Wife Has Released a New Design
your-wife-has-released-a-new-design.description:
ఒక ఫ్యాషన్ డిజైనర్ తన కలలను సాధించేందుకు చేసిన పోరాటం,
అదే సమయంలో తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణానికి ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకునే రక్తగాధ —
ఇది విజయానికి, న్యాయానికి, మరియు అసాధారణ సంఘర్షణలకు నిదర్శనమైన కథ!

the-billionaire-security-guard.title: Billionaire Security Guard
the-billionaire-security-guard.description: This Billionaire man lives a low life to find enjoy simple pleasures of life. However all this changed one day.

outsmart-killer-clown-1.title: Outsmart Killer Clown
outsmart-killer-clown-1.description: ప్రెసిడెంట్ హెన్రీ జీవితంలో ఉల్లాసం కోల్పోయింది. ఒక మాస్క్ ధరించిన జోకర్ అతన్ని పదే పదే హత్య చేస్తున్నాడు. ప్రతి మరణం తరువాతా, హెన్రీకి తన గత జన్మల జ్ఞాపకాలు వెంటాడుతుంటాయి. ఆయనకు తోడుగా వైస్ ప్రెసిడెంట్ కల్లి ఉంటాడు. ఈ రక్తపాతం ఎప్పుడు ఆగుతుంది? అసలు హంతకుడు ఎవరు? హెన్రీ సత్యాన్ని తెలుసుకొని, ఈ ప్రాణాంతక చక్రాన్ని చెరిపేయగలడా? సమయం తక్కువ. నిజాన్ని కనిపెట్టి, హంతకుడిని బయటపెట్టే హెన్రీ పోరాటం చూడండి – ఇప్పుడే!

ek-anjana-ek-anjani.title: Ek Aur Anjaani Shaadi
ek-anjana-ek-anjani.description: “Ek Aur Anjaani Shaadi" is a light-hearted romantic drama series about Arjun and Suhani, two strangers forced to pose as a married couple to achieve their professional goals. What begins as a fake arrangement soon spirals into comic situations, emotional clashes, and unexpected chemistry. As they juggle family pressures, nosy landlords, jealous rivals, and high-stakes business deals, their pretend marriage slowly transforms into a journey of real love, destiny, and happy chaos. Watch now!

madam-dont-run-3.title: Madam Don't Run
madam-dont-run-3.description: A young woman travels abroad and becomes intimately involved with someone, leading to an unexpected pregnancy. She gives birth to a daughter and raises her alone. Many years later, the man from her past suddenly reappears, stirring a new storm in her life.

how-to-catch-your-cheating-partner.title: Bewafa Wife
how-to-catch-your-cheating-partner.description: How to Catch Your Cheating Partner” follows Pawan, a suspicious husband, as he spirals into obsession over his wife Noori and her best friend Mayank. What begins with a single strand of hair soon unravels into a tense web of traps, paranoia, and shocking revelations, blurring the line between truth and delusion. Watch Now!

dont-come-im-fine-3.title: Don't Come, I'm Fine
dont-come-im-fine-3.description: A man and a woman start loving each other, and they have a son. But after some time, the man starts doubting whether the child is actually his. Even though they had a very loving relationship, this doubt creates distance between them. The real mystery of the story is why this doubt arose and how the truth eventually came out.

road-to-regret.title: Jab We Married
road-to-regret.description: Road to Regret is a passionate romantic drama of betrayal, sacrifice, and unexpected love. Esha, a spoiled heiress, gets trapped in a toxic engagement with cunning Rohit, while her father’s failing health forces her into a sudden marriage with the loyal Aditya Suri. Bound by duty but torn between pride, manipulation, and growing emotions, Esha must decide whether love can truly rise from regret—or if it’s already too late.

the-wonderful-life-after-a-flash-marriag.title: The Wonderful Life After a Flash Marriage
the-wonderful-life-after-a-flash-marriag.description: বিয়ের পরের রঙিন জীবন রোমান্টিক, নাটকীয়, না কি হিউমারাস? গল্পটি জানতে হলে দেখুন

billion-dollar-love.title: Billion Dollar Love
billion-dollar-love.description: A struggling event planner is forced into a marriage with a man she believes to be a poor ex-convict, only to discover he is a secret billionaire. Between betrayal, power games, and unexpected romance, their fiery bond challenges fate and family.

my-crorepati-husband.title: My Crorepati Husband
my-crorepati-husband.description: Namma Hero Rich ilanu therinja udane avara divorce panna mudiva panra wife ku sema twist onnu wait pannitu iruku. My Crorepati Husband - Watch Now!

the-end-of-us-1.title: The End of Us
the-end-of-us-1.description:
ధ్రువ తన భార్య స్వప్నతో చేసిన 10 ఏళ్ల ఒప్పంద వివాహాన్ని ముగించాల్సిన సమయంలో,
తన వ్యక్తిత్వాన్ని అడ్డుకున్న అనేక బంధాల్నీ తెంచుకోవాల్సి వస్తుంది.
ఈ వివాహ ఒప్పందం వెనుక ఉన్న నిజం ఏమిటి? గత 10 ఏళ్ల త్యాగానికి అతడిని ఎదురు చూస్తున్న ఆశ్చర్యం ఏంటి?

hona-hi-tha.title: Hona Hi Tha
hona-hi-tha.description: When dreams clash with reality, how far can love and courage take you? Hona Hi Tha is a gripping tale of Niyati, a dancer fighting against betrayal, survival, and an unexpected bond with the powerful Veer Gujral. A story of passion, sacrifice, and destiny you just can’t miss. Watch Now !

the-end-of-us-2.title: The End of us
the-end-of-us-2.description: When Dhruva has to end his 10 year marriage contract with his Wife Swapna, he has to end many things which had stopped him to be on his own, why did he get into this contract marriage in first place and what surprise awaits him for all the sacrifice he has done for the past 10 years.watch  "The End of Us" only on KUKU TV.

my-crush-my-kidnapper.title: My Crush, My Kidnapper
my-crush-my-kidnapper.description: The microdrama centers on Sneha, a young woman navigating personal struggles, budding romances, and artistic aspirations, whose life is violently upended by a malicious cyberbullying plot. This initial threat quickly escalates into a terrifying ordeal when she is blackmailed with a compromising video, forcing her into illicit tasks and ultimately leading to her mysterious disappearance. Her distraught father, Arvind, embarks on a desperate search, facing dismissive authorities and veiled threats, as Sneha is revealed to be a pawn in a sprawling criminal syndicate. At the heart of this network is the powerful Lord Amit Gothi, to whom the arrogant Rahil is deeply indebted, orchestrating a drug debt scheme that implicates Sneha. Amidst this danger, Sneha finds a poignant connection with Amit, Lord Amit Gothi's son, who struggles to protect her from his father's pervasive influence. However, Sneha is kidnapped, becoming central to various revenge plots and debt collections, with figures like Batla Bhai and a mysterious 'Ruthless Boss' manipulating events. Rahil, surprisingly, later teams with Arvind in a violent mission to retrieve Sneha, though their efforts are only partially successful. As the web of crime tightens, Sneha is blackmailed into delivering fake money and held captive by another crime boss, Dhruv's father, while Dhruv himself pleads for her release. Ultimately, Sneha finds herself desperately fleeing unseen forces, with 'The Lord,' an enigmatic underworld master, ordering her capture. In a desperate bid to ensure her safety, Sneha's father makes a pact with this powerful and morally ambiguous figure, entrusting his daughter's protection to him. This pact hints at a complex and potentially dangerous destiny for Sneha, leaving her future uncertain amidst the pervasive control of the criminal underworld.

a-beautiful-woman-1.title: A Beautiful Woman
a-beautiful-woman-1.description:
“In a remote tech center, a few people are forcibly confined, their memories erased, and their identities altered through experiments.
Among them, a young woman begins to recall not only her true self but also the lost memory of her sister.
Caught between betrayal, fear, and control, her fight is not just for freedom — but for family, identity, and justice too.

billionaires-broken-granddaughter.title: Billionaire’s Broken Granddaughter
billionaires-broken-granddaughter.description: The microdrama unfolds a relentless cycle of betrayal, humiliation, and the desperate quest for dignity and revenge, primarily centered around Namit Jain, Akanksha, and Akshay. Initially, various male protagonists, including Namit, face profound personal ruin through complex and destructive relationships with Akanksha and her powerful family, marked by financial subjugation, public humiliation, and marital betrayal. Namit, feeling unloved and humiliated, decides to divorce Akanksha, facing mockery from her family. However, Namit Jain dramatically reveals himself as the sole heir to Jain Industries, asserting his dominance and publicly confronting those who previously scorned him. He orchestrates Akanksha's brother's arrest to force her to sign divorce papers, claiming retaliation for years of family humiliation, despite Akanksha hinting at a complex, unresolved past and secretly grieving. Concurrently, Namit's newly claimed empire faces a severe threat from a rival faction using media manipulation and scandal. Namit then launches a lawsuit against the Bansal Group, exposing their cyber defamation and orchestrating the arrests of Rishi and Akshay. Akanksha, initially caught in her family's web, eventually aligns with Namit, defending him, breaking off her engagement with Akshay due to his dangerous obsession, and forming a corporate joint venture with Namit. Akshay, heartbroken and consumed by vengeance, injures Namit and goes on the run, later orchestrating Namit's abduction and brutal assault. Akanksha, driven by love and guilt, races to rescue Namit, becoming a captive herself, and their shared ordeal solidifies their protective bond when Namit intervenes to save her from Akshay's knife attack. Their newfound peace is shattered by Akshay's escape from custody, promising continued danger. The conflict culminates with Akshay's strategic marriage publicly shattering due to kidnapping accusations, and Namit, as the true heir, demanding justice for Akshay's crimes, which escalates into a violent altercation where Akasha is gravely injured protecting Akshay from a new antagonist, Amit, who vows chilling revenge. The narrative concludes with the introduction of a new bride, Daksha, into the Jain Mansion, hinting at new beginnings amidst unresolved tensions and potential future confrontations.

desperate-husbands-revenge-3.title: Desperate Husband's Revenge
desperate-husbands-revenge-3.description: The microdrama begins with William, formerly Dr. Sanjay, uncovering a calculated plot by his wife, Julie, and her ex-partner, Robin, to steal his fortune, prompting him to meticulously plan his revenge. He orchestrates a public anniversary surprise, exposing Julie's infidelity with Robin on a live stream, leading to her public humiliation and familial condemnation. Despite William's escalating quest for retribution, Robin's counter-claims imply Julie's deeper complicity, further complicating William's understanding of the betrayal. The conflict intensifies with William's wrongful arrest and Julie's confession of love for Robin, leaving William reeling from a multi-layered betrayal. Julie, driven by greed and a desire for Robin, abandons William, revealing she married him for money and terminated their pregnancy, leading to her apparent death orchestrated by William. However, Julie's death is later revealed to be faked as part of an elaborate scheme for financial gain, involving blackmail and further attempts to defraud Robin. Robin, a central figure in these deceptions, is entangled in a web of bigamy, property fraud, and betrayals involving multiple women, including Angel, Maya, Anjali, and Riya, all while plotting to seize fortunes. As the intricate schemes unravel, Julie, now known as Juli, finds herself double-crossed by Robin, who is revealed to be an undercover agent. In a surprising turn, Juli, seeking justice against Robin's extensive frauds, allies with William, who provides crucial evidence. The series culminates in Robin's apprehension and a potential life sentence for his criminal activities, while Juli rewards William for his assistance, enabling him to embark on a new life with his fiancée, Reethu.

my-dangerous-husband-tamil.title: My Dangerous Husband
my-dangerous-husband-tamil.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous and often secretive relationship between Dr. Alex and Andy, whose bond is forged amidst immediate challenges and deep-seated family conflicts. Initially, Alex warns Andy about her dangerous fiancé, Prabhu, leading to Andy's impulsive marriage to Alex, which is met with fierce disapproval from Alex's powerful family and undermined by rivals. Their union is repeatedly tested by accusations of fraud against Alex, corporate intrigue, and a brutal physical assault on Andy, prompting Alex's fierce quest for retribution. Andy's life is further complicated by recurring amnesia, which conceals a hidden past, including a prior engagement to Chris, and a web of family secrets meticulously hidden by Alex. She discovers her sister, Akka, is a primary antagonist, orchestrating a near-fatal car accident and an inheritance scheme, forcing Andy to reclaim her identity and stolen fortune. Alex's own past is revealed to be manipulative, involving secret arrangements and past loves, further straining their already fragile marriage. As Andy grapples with fragmented memories and the chilling possibility of ultimate familial betrayal, she is torn between her rekindled feelings for Alex and her commitment to Chris, her protective rival. The narrative unravels a complex conspiracy surrounding Andy's identity, wealth, and multiple attempts on her life, often involving Alex's ambiguous role as both protector and deceiver. Ultimately, Andy must confront Akka's crimes and a vengeful figure from her childhood, fighting to expose the truth, secure her autonomy, and determine the fate of her complex, possibly contractual, marriage to Alex amidst a relentless struggle for justice and survival.

too-late-husband.title: Too Late, Husband
too-late-husband.description: Manvi's seven-year marriage to Karthik crumbles as she confronts his emotional unavailability and demands a divorce, feeling their life has become a "fake drama" fueled by his alleged obsession with business partner Chitra. Feeling invisible and marginalized, Manvi decides to sever ties with her affluent past, liquidating assets and disappearing, serving Karthik divorce papers. She then embarks on a high-stakes corporate comeback, revealing her hidden talents as a brilliant interpreter and English professor, challenging corporate rivals and societal expectations. Her professional resurgence brings her into contact with Karthik's corporate rival, Harvinder Sahani, for whom she flawlessly interprets, saving a crucial deal and igniting professional rivalry and romantic tension. Karthik reappears, asserting their legal marriage and demanding her return, sparking a dangerous love triangle with Harvinder, which culminates in an impulsive physical act. A tumultuous divorce and custody battle over their daughter, Preeti, ensues, complicated by Chitra's manipulative interference. Chitra, initially appearing as a devoted caregiver to an ill Preeti, is exposed for her malicious actions, leading to furious family confrontations. Despite Manvi's determination to divorce Karthik and pursue her career, he betrays her, leading to her arrest based on damning evidence. The reappearance of Karthik's ex-wife, Anupama, further complicates the family dynamics. Manvi faces a marriage proposal from Arjun, who shockingly claims her as his wife, and later from Ashwinder, while a mysterious man warns her against repeating past regrets. Manvi rejects a colleague's decade-long confession of love, prioritizing her career and autonomy. Karthik eventually grants Manvi full custody of Preeti, acknowledging her deep maternal love. Manvi grapples with a UN job offer requiring travel versus her maternal love for Preeti, and must make a life-altering decision about her future and family, potentially involving Harvinder, with whom she shares a significant past and undeniable feelings. The show explores Manvi's fight for independence, professional ambition, and the well-being of her daughter amidst corporate intrigue, domestic conflict, and betrayal.

damn-youre-hot-professor-4.title: Damn! You're Hot, Professor
damn-youre-hot-professor-4.description: A determined college student finds herself irresistibly drawn to her stern yet magnetic professor. Their burgeoning connection ignites a secret affair, unfolding amid mounting academic expectations and familial turmoil. But as their relationship deepens, the stakes escalate—placing both their futures in jeopardy. Watch "Damn! You're Hot, Professor" Now!

the-proud-woman-i-married.title: Revenge of my fake bride
the-proud-woman-i-married.description: Revenge of my fake bride follows Laila, a proud young woman betrayed on her wedding day and thrown out of her home. Rescued by Nakul, her fiancé’s rival with a hidden vendetta. She is drawn into a storm of love, power, and revenge. As loyalties shatter and enemies close in, will Laila remain a pawn in their game, or rise as the queen who rewrites it all? Watch now!

she-is-not-ugly.title: She is Not Ugly
she-is-not-ugly.description: She gave up everything for her son—only to be met with cruelty and rejection. But when the man she once saved returns to stand by her, the tables begin to turn. This is a stirring tale of maternal strength, redemption, and the downfall of pride.

why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry-4.title: Why Must the Boss Contractually Marry
why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry-4.description: Why Must the Boss Contractually Marry

devils-match.title: Devil Se Shaadi
devils-match.description: A fearless woman crosses paths with a ruthless yet charming mafia boss, igniting a dangerous game of power and desire. As enemies close in, their fiery bond blurs the line between love and destruction.

super-can-pickup-the-missing-king.title: Super Can Pickup the Missing King
super-can-pickup-the-missing-king.description: A strange superhero janitor, with amnesia, finds himself in the company of a missing king. Their unlikely bond leads them on a crazy journey—to reclaim not only their throne, but their true identity. Watch Now!

advocate-anand-awasthi.title: Advocate Anand Awasthi
advocate-anand-awasthi.description: A once-legendary and morally unyielding lawyer, Anand, is discovered in profound destitution by his former interns, sparking a quest to uncover his dramatic fall from grace. Concurrently, a woman named Devika bravely attempts to report rape and domestic abuse, only to face ridicule, gaslighting, and physical assault from a corrupt police force, who try to institutionalize her. Anand himself endures brutal humiliation, wrongful arrest, and severe police brutality by Inspector Raghav, who attempts to frame him for various crimes. The situation dramatically shifts when higher officials reveal Anand's true identity as a powerful Barrister, forcing Raghav to confront his abuse of authority. However, Devika's fight intensifies as she is abducted, confined, and later accused of fabricating charges for extortion, becoming the target of a powerful antagonist lawyer who orchestrates a devastating media smear campaign against her. Amidst this, other victims like Amrita, Kiran, and Rajni emerge, defying powerful families to expose sexual violence and seek justice against overwhelming odds. Rajni's brutal assault and subsequent fight for justice become central, with crucial evidence mysteriously destroyed and her life threatened by a criminal mastermind and antagonist Pathak. Barrister Anand Awasthi re-emerges as a key legal figure, offering aid to victims and challenging the pervasive corruption within the legal system. The overarching antagonist, Advocate Abhay Pathak, is revealed to be deeply involved in discrediting accusers, orchestrating smear campaigns, and even hiring a contract killer to murder his own sister, Rajni, and orchestrating a prior murder. The narrative culminates in a high-stakes courtroom confrontation where Pathak's bribery schemes and murder plots are exposed through brave witnesses, video evidence, and confessions from his former colleague and the contract killer. Rajni, presumed dead, dramatically returns to testify, solidifying the case against Pathak. The prosecuting lawyer ultimately orders Pathak's death in the courtroom, bringing a violent end to his illicit empire. This brutal form of justice underscores the show's exploration of individual courage against systemic corruption, the arduous fight for truth, and the blurred lines of justice in a deeply corrupt society.

black-widow-4.title: Black Widow
black-widow-4.description: A secret experiment mutates a girl's genes, giving her a powerful magnetic field within her body. When she's attacked and escapes the lab, she gets hit by a car. The boy inside the car rescues her and brings her home. But as time passes, he realizes she's not just a test subject—she's the key to something far more dangerous.

life-swapping.title: Life Swapping
life-swapping.description: Life Swapping is a magical, emotional drama about rivalry, identity, and second chances. Gautam, a shy gamer constantly overshadowed by his arrogant brother Manit, stumbles upon a mysterious globe that grants his wish—to be like Manit. But when their souls are swapped for ten days, both brothers are forced to live each other’s lives, facing love, humiliation, and truth in ways they never imagined.

miss-lasya-dont-let-me-go.title: Miss Lasya, Don't Let me go
miss-lasya-dont-let-me-go.description: Diagnosed with terminal cancer, Lasya defiantly rebels against her tyrannical boss, Arjun (CEO), sparking an employee walkout against corporate exploitation. Unbeknownst to her, Lasya is already in a mysterious, unloved marriage with Arjun (CEO), who initially seeks divorce. A manipulative family elder forces Arjun (CEO) to publicly acknowledge Lasya, leading him to abduct her and coerce her into a fake marriage to secure his corporate empire. As an undeniable attraction develops between them, their charade is dramatically exposed by Rekha, who claims to be Arjun's true intended. Despite the family patriarch confirming Lasya's marriage, a shocking inheritance revelation forces Lasya to admit her "fake wife" status. The patriarch then confines Lasya and Arjun (CEO), demanding a great-grandchild, prompting Lasya to demand temporary corporate control in exchange for a fake intimacy charade. Lasya transforms from an accused employee to a defiant CEO, exacting swift revenge on those who wronged her, including a cunning deception against a debt-ridden manager. Her true identity as a wealthy heiress is unveiled, coinciding with the rise of Arjun Varma, a powerful CEO who exposes corruption and acquires the company. Arjun Varma rescues Lasya from an assault, and later, an Arjun reveals Lasya to be his sister, exposing a "swapped at birth" secret that establishes Lasya as the true heiress to a vast fortune. This revelation fuels the fury of Rekha, who vows vengeance, while Lasya endures public shaming, accusations, and a fraudulent marriage plot orchestrated by a mysterious "Boss" to strip her of her inheritance. Throughout these trials, she is fiercely protected by her newly discovered brothers, Lokesh and Vinay, who work to secure her rightful place. Lasya's attempt to divorce her estranged husband is interrupted by Arjun's confrontation, quickly followed by her abduction. She is then blamed for a family business's collapse and targeted for brutal revenge by Yama Dharmaraju and his brother, who demand her "heart." While Deepak desperately searches for Lasya, believing her to be his long-lost wife, Arjun fiercely intervenes to protect his sister from Yama Dharmaraju's deadly vendetta. Concurrently, Bangaroo awakens from a coma, learning her terminal illness is treatable, and embarks on a new life with Arjun, culminating in an emotional first meeting with her parents.

the-westward-anime-season-02.title: The Westward Anime: Season 02
the-westward-anime-season-02.description: What if the legendary Westward Journey was a grand conspiracy scripted by heaven itself? As armies hunt for a sacred scripture lost for decades, a new journey begins—not for glory, but for redemption. “Westward Deception” is a mythic saga where sin, salvation, and rebellion collide in a battle against divine control. Watch Now!

the-immortal-emperor-returns-my-wife-pul.title: The Immortal Emperor Returns - My Wife Pulled Out My Oxygen Tube
the-immortal-emperor-returns-my-wife-pul.description: The Immortal Emperor Returns - My Wife Pulled Out My Oxygen Tube

silenced-wife.title: Saazishon Ka Sasural
silenced-wife.description: Leher, a mute newlywed, enters the powerful Mehta household and is met with cruelty from her mother-in-law Devika and her husband Aryan’s obsession with his ex, Mehak. As humiliations turn violent and a gang war erupts, Leher must outlast conspiracies to claim her life back—and her voice.

the-return-of-the-heiressdiscernment-of-.title: The Return of the Heiress: Discernment of Pearls
the-return-of-the-heiressdiscernment-of-.description: Heiress Radha's world shatters when her family's jewelry empire is seized by her ex-boyfriend, Joseph John, who betrayed her with her own sister, leading to her parents' tragic deaths and fueling her desire for vengeance. Adopting aliases like the "Masked Woman" and "Chief Appraiser," Radha enters a strategic alliance, hinting at a contract marriage, with the enigmatic Mr. Jerome to reclaim her legacy. She navigates a cutthroat corporate world, challenging rivals and using her unconventional gem-cutting and appraisal skills to make audacious bids and uncover truths. Radha, also known as Rizia and Jessica, becomes entangled in high-stakes corporate conflicts, facing accusations of theft, particularly concerning the "Blue Rhythm Star" diamond, and is framed for its substitution. Her life is constantly threatened, with multiple attempts on her inheritance and person, forcing her to operate in a hazardous environment while seeking justice for her mother's past. Her complex relationship with Mr. Jerome evolves from a strategic partnership to a public declaration of love and cohabitation, though it is frequently challenged by external forces, including his past lovers and her own perceived betrayals. Jerome often acts as her protector, intervening against assassins and corporate rivals, even as he recovers from injuries. However, their bond is tested by a love triangle involving Evangeline/Quangline, who is consumed by jealousy and plots against Jessica. Jessica, presumed dead multiple times after a fire and a car crash, miraculously reappears, often with a new identity or under the protection of others. A cunning manipulator, driven by a deep-seated vendetta, orchestrates elaborate schemes to seize assets and destroy powerful groups, with Jessica often at the center of these plots. Ultimately, Jessica's pursuit of justice for a past car accident leads to Joseph's arrest, but also ignites a mastermind's vow of revenge. In a shocking turn, Jessica is revealed to be alive after a presumed death, held captive by an obsessed Jerome, who faked her demise to possess her. He attempts to gaslight her with fabricated evidence of abandonment, but she fiercely resists, while Arjun actively searches for her, facing obstruction. The series culminates with Arjun and Mariam rescuing Jessica from a vengeful Josh, who accuses her of betrayal, leaving her fighting for freedom and the truth amidst a web of deception and possessive love.

ek-janam-aur.title: Ek Janam Aur
ek-janam-aur.description: Ek Janam aur is an emotional tale of love, betrayal, and second chances. When Esha Chaudhary is betrayed by her closest ones and dies tragically, fate grants her a second life. With memories of her painful past intact, she resolves not to repeat old mistakes - this time, she will live for herself, chase her dreams, and choose freedom over toxic love. As her journey unfolds, she must navigate between destiny, ambition, and the haunting pull of her past relationships.

mrs-pei-wants-to-return-to-the-countrysi.title: Mrs. Pei Wants to Return to the Countryside
mrs-pei-wants-to-return-to-the-countrysi.description: One day, a big rich guy, while drunk, misbehaves with a poor girl in a village. A few days after this happened, because of her family situation, the girl leaves the village and comes to the city. Meanwhile, that rich guy is searching for the girl to marry her. She gets a job at a star hotel. While she's working there, her younger sister and the rich guy who misbehaved with her, come in as a couple... and he's also the owner of that star hotel. Did that rich guy find out that she's the girl he was looking for? How did that poor girl's sister end up with him? What happened next in their lives?

nazar-ka-devta.title: Shraapit Ishq
nazar-ka-devta.description: Ek shraapit devta ki nazar jismein jo dekhe uski kismat badal jaati hai, insaan aur bhagya ke beech ka khel hai. Jab mohabbat aur shraap takraate hain, to har rishta ek imtihaan ban jaata hai .

mr-ji-see-clearly-im-your-bodyguard-3.title: Mr. Ji, See Clearly, I'm Your Bodyguard
mr-ji-see-clearly-im-your-bodyguard-3.description: Mr. Ji, See Clearly, I'm Your Bodyguard

became-the-ex-wifes-white-moonlight-afte.title: Ex-Wife's White Moonlight After My Death
became-the-ex-wifes-white-moonlight-afte.description: সে ভালোবাসার জন্য ভিক্ষা করে যাচ্ছিল। কিন্তু তার স্বামীর সে দিকে খেয়ালই ছিল না। ডায়না চলে গিয়েছে। সব সত্য ফাঁস হয়ে গিয়েছে। বেঞ্জামিনের মন ভারাক্রান্ত, বেজার মুখ করে দাঁড়িয়ে রয়েছে সে। সেই নারীকে সে পাত্তা পর্যন্ত দেয়নি, যে তার সুখে-দুঃখে সবসময় পাশে থেকেছে। হৃদয়বিদারক সেই গল্প কঠোর নীরবতার মধ্যে দিয়ে এগিয়ে যায়! তারপর...

love-lies-strategy.title: Mera Gumshuda Lover
love-lies-strategy.description: Childhood promises bind Tara and Aditya, two lost souls torn apart by fate. Sixteen years later, Tara now a powerful CEO searches endlessly for the boy who once protected her, while Aditya, burdened by betrayal and amnesia, fights to reclaim his identity. Between Jatin’s cunning schemes, Jiya’s manipulative love, and a highstakes corporate game of power and deception, their story unfolds a battle of love, lies, and strategy. Watch Now!

patience-will-lead-to-a-brighter-outcome.title: Patience Will Lead To A Brighter Outcome
patience-will-lead-to-a-brighter-outcome.description: বিয়ের এক বছর পর জেনি আর মেসন আবার মুখোমুখি - একজন বস আর অন্যজন সেক্রেটারি রূপে। কিন্তু তারা জনেই না যে তারা আসলে স্বামী স্ত্রী। এই সত্যিটা কি জেনি আর মেসন কখনও জানতে পারবে?

my-killer-wife-season-2.title: My Killer Wife Season - 2
my-killer-wife-season-2.description: The deadly game of love and lies continues, this time darker, deeper, and more dangerous. My Killer Wife Season 2 takes betrayal and obsession to the next level. Watch Now !

the-hand-behind-the-scenes-2.title: The Hand Behind the Scenes
the-hand-behind-the-scenes-2.description: কলিং -এর জীবনের সত্যতা কি, ছেলেটি  রহস্যজনকভাবে মারা যাওয়ার পর কি হতে চলেছে, জানতে হলে দেখুন

blossoms-2003-3.title: Blossoms 2003
blossoms-2003-3.description: বাবার ভুলের মাশুল গুনে চলতে হচ্ছে এক তরুণীকে। সেরকমই একটা ভুলের কারণে তার মায়ের মৃত্যু হয়েছে। ভালোবাসা, নিষ্ঠুরতা ও দায়িত্বের মধ্যে আটকে সে চুপে থাকলেও অন্তরে অপরাধবোধের ভার বহন করে চলে। কঠিন বাস্তবতা ও বাধ্যতামূলক পরিস্থিতি তাকে এমন এক গভীর মানসিক পরিবর্তনের মুখোমুখি এনে দেয়—যেখানে নিরবতা ভাঙে ও নতুন জীবন শুরু হয়।

revenge-after-freeze.title: Frozen Betrayal
revenge-after-freeze.description: Sacrificing everything for her brothers she gets frozen for decades, she wakes up to a world that’s moved on, but everything is changed. Revenge After Freeze is a thrilling tale of power, betrayal, and payback that never expires.

billionaires-love.title: Billionaire's Love
billionaires-love.description:
Kamal is a talented mechanical engineer, but his skills have never received the recognition they deserve. Ramya is an influential corporate magnate, a young woman whose only focus is expanding her business empire. Renu, a simple HR professional, lives quietly while hiding many bitter memories in her heart.

Though their lives run on separate paths, a small flaw — a car’s malfunctioning AC — brings the three of them together in one place. What begins as a chance encounter soon unravels the secrets of two of the nation’s most powerful business families, turning their lives upside down in a storm of revelations.

joru-ka-ghulam.title: Joru ka Ghulam
joru-ka-ghulam.description: Paarth Singh is the new MD of Singh Group but he has hidden his identity from everyone, even from his wife and in-laws. He visits them for his father in-law’s birthday celebration where they demean and insult him. Will he finally reveal his true identity during this crisis? Watch Now!

three-lives-ring-1.title: Three Lives Ring
three-lives-ring-1.description: Three Lives Ring is a fantasy romance drama where a mystical ring binds the fates of three lovers across lifetimes. As past grudges and hidden truths unravel, love, betrayal, and destiny collide in each reincarnation.

wake-up-dad-wedding-time-5.title: Wake Up, Dad! Wedding Time
wake-up-dad-wedding-time-5.description: Laila is kicked out of her home after an unexpected pregnancy. Years later, the father of her child, Roman, shows up, revealing he is the world's richest man. To get medical treatment for her son, Laila agrees to a contractual marriage with Roman. However, as they get to know each other, they gradually break the contract and fall in love.

the-mistaken-child.title: The Mistaken Child
the-mistaken-child.description: When a child goes missing, secrets unravel and lives collide. The Mistaken Child is a gripping tale of love, betrayal, and the desperate search for truth. Every moment pulls you deeper into the mystery. Watch Now !

gone-yet-loved-by-him-6.title: Gone, Yet Loved By Him
gone-yet-loved-by-him-6.description: For three years, Bellway Zouch loved Eason Gold — but she was only a substitute for his childhood sweetheart. When the truth breaks her, she decides to leave the country, giving herself one month to let go. Just as she finds the strength to move on, Eason realizes too late that his true love was Bellway all along. Watch Now!

bhookha-bhediya-boyfriend.title: Vampire Ka Khooni Ishq
bhookha-bhediya-boyfriend.description: A starving vampire hides his true identity while falling in love with a human girl. But his hunger and dark world threaten to destroy their fragile romance.

a-beautiful-woman.title: A Beautiful Woman
a-beautiful-woman.description:
ఒక దూరపు టెక్ సెంటర్‌లో కొంతమందిని బలవంతంగా నిర్బంధించి, వారి జ్ఞాపకాలు తుడిచిపెట్టుకుని, గుర్మాతులు మార్చే ప్రయోగాలు చేస్తారు.
వారి మధ్యలో ఓ యువతి, తన నిజమైన స్వరూపంతో పాటు కోల్పోయిన సోదరి జ్ఞాపకాన్ని గుర్తు తెచ్చుకుంటుంది.
ద్రోహం, భయం, అదుపు మధ్య ఆమె పోరాటం — స్వేచ్ఛకోసం మాత్రమే కాదు, కుటుంబం, గుర్తింపు, న్యాయం కోసం కూడా.

risky-ishq-3.title: Risky Love
risky-ishq-3.description: One late-night rescue sparks a storm of emotions between a fearless student and her brother’s enigmatic best friend. As college games turn cruel and her secrets go public, the fallout is brutal—until he stands by her. "When Vivaan Stepped In" is a tale of heartbreak, hidden desire, and the fierce power of unexpected loyalty.

madam-president-begins.title: Madam President Begins
madam-president-begins.description: One girl, two lives, and countless twists. This show blends love, betrayal, and supernatural chaos as Khushi fights to control her strange new destiny. Every episode is packed with suspense, laughter, and shocking revelations. Watch Now !

risky-love-2.title: Risky Love
risky-love-2.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous, fated connection between headstrong Anita and the formidable Vikram, who is initially summoned by her protective brother, Aryan, for a dangerous rescue after Anita is attacked. Vikram becomes Anita's enigmatic protector, leading to immediate friction due to his guarded nature and her fierce independence, yet a simmering romantic tension quickly develops. Their dynamic is complicated by external threats, including manipulative socialites targeting Aryan, a vengeful Sonia, and Trustee's Son Tara, who publicly exposes Anita's stolen diary, revealing her shocking, forbidden crush on Vikram. As Vikram asserts increasing control, even trapping Anita under the guise of protection, their relationship blurs the lines between safety and captivity, further tested by a car crash and corporate intrigues. Anita struggles for independence from her toxic ex, Nakul, whose violent assaults provoke Vikram's brutal fury and intent to kill, though Anita intervenes to save a life. Despite Vikram's suspicion that Anita's vulnerabilities are part of an "Operation Seduction," their bond deepens through shared challenges, including Anita confronting her hydrophobia and making a bold romantic confession. Their conflicted romance is marked by Vikram's perplexing rejections, warnings about his dangerous nature, and fierce rivalries with other women, culminating in Vikram's protective rescues and accusations of attempted murder. Anita devises a plan to make Vikram jealous, which spirals into a terrifying ordeal requiring his intervention, revealing his intense jealousy and wealth amidst a high-stakes corporate war and a powerful, unseen conspiracy. The narrative climaxes when Nakul kidnaps Anita, planning to ruin Vikram's corporate empire, prompting Vikram to retaliate by crippling Nakul's business and confessing his profound love for Anita during a brutal confrontation. Anita's fiercely protective brother initially assaults Vikram, but ultimately accepts their deep mutual affection and entrusts Vikram with Anita's protection. The show concludes with Anita achieving professional success as a photographer, and Vikram solidifying their shared future and commitment by presenting her with a key to a new home, despite a new romantic complication from his business partner, Sheela.

forced-to-love.title: Forced to Love
forced-to-love.description: Naina, driven by desperation to save her critically ill mother, enters a perilous agreement with Mr. Rathore, later identified as Karan, who holds a secret from her past as leverage. He initially demands Naina herself in exchange for her mother's life-saving treatment, threatening to expose their history to Nakul, Naina's boyfriend. Naina makes profound personal sacrifices, agreeing to his sinister terms, only to discover Nakul's own manipulative plot to exploit her mother's illness, shattering their relationship. Karan then orchestrates Naina and Nakul's breakup, making Naina's mother's survival dependent on him and trapping Naina in a chilling arrangement where her freedom and dignity are sacrificed for her mother's life. As Naina navigates this high-stakes world, Karan's comatose fiancée, Kashish, awakens, becoming suspicious of Karan's fidelity and vowing revenge against any woman who came near him, particularly Naina. Kashish, obligated to Karan for saving his life, manipulates him into hiring Naina as their live-in maid, then falsely accuses Naina of poisoning, plunging her into a fight for her innocence. Despite Kashish's relentless schemes to humiliate Naina and turn Karan against her, Karan intervenes to protect Naina from various threats and eventually orchestrates her mother's life-saving operation, creating a complex debt and unspoken obligation. Karan, torn between his love for Naina and an 'ehsaan' to marry Kashish, suspects Kashish's manipulation. At the altar, Karan dramatically confesses his love for Naina and refuses to marry Kashish, leading to Kashish's vengeful pursuit and a shocking gunshot. Karan is gravely injured, and Naina, his protector, accepts his unexpected marriage proposal, intertwining their destinies amidst ongoing threats and betrayals.

my-billionaire-bodyguard.title: My Billionaire Bodyguard
my-billionaire-bodyguard.description: A billionaire husband, betrayed and left for dead, returns in disguise as his wife’s bodyguard. In a world of love, lies and hidden truths, can Karan protect Seema while reclaiming his empire? When every glance hides a secret and every touch could be a betrayal, the battle between heart and survival begins.

pehle-badla-phir-mohabbat-3.title: Love & Revenge
pehle-badla-phir-mohabbat-3.description: On her anniversary, she was betrayed, discarded, and humiliated—until the truth shattered their illusion. They thought she was nothing, but she was the heiress behind everything they owned. Now reborn with power, wealth, and a dangerous ally, she’s back to turn the tables—for good.

fa4677bf-d8ea-440a-b90e-e1bcf7f6c696.title: Men and Systems By James Allen
fa4677bf-d8ea-440a-b90e-e1bcf7f6c696.description: Iss show mein janiye jawab apni sabhi mushkilo ka! Jaane kaise aapke apne actions banate hain aapki destiny aur seekhein kaise system ko samajhkar aap badal sakte hain apni life!

eanippadikal.title: ഏണിപ്പടികൾ
eanippadikal.description: അധികാരത്തിനായി എന്തും ചെയ്യാന്‍ മടിയില്ലാത്ത കേശവ പിള്ള എന്ന സർക്കാർ ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥന്റെ ഉയർച്ചയും താഴ്ചയും പ്രണയവും വഞ്ചനയും നിറഞ്ഞ ജീവിതയാത്രയാണ് ഏണിപ്പടികൾ.

amen.title: ആമേൻ
amen.description: തിരുസഭയിലെ പുരോഹിതന്മാരും കന്യാസ്ത്രീകളും നേരിടുന്ന പ്രശ്നങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് ഒരു മുൻ കന്യാസ്ത്രീയായ സിസ്റ്റർ ജെസ്മി എഴുതിയ പുസ്തകമാണ് "ആമേൻ". കൃസ്തുവിലുള്ള അചഞ്ചലമായ വിശ്വാസവും സ്നേഹവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നിട്ടും, മഠത്തിൽ നിന്ന് പുറത്തുകടന്ന ശേഷമുള്ള ജീവിതത്തിൽ അവർ നേരിട്ട വെല്ലുവിളികളെക്കുറിച്ചും അവർ എഴുതുന്നു.

naayak-reborn.title: Naayak Reborn
naayak-reborn.description: Ek sadharan ladka jiska punarjanm hua uske hi favourite novel ki kahani mein aur wo ban gaya tantrikon ke khaandaan ka sabse Chhota beta. Kaise tantrikon ke  pariwar ka sabse bekar yoddha samjha Jane wala Aditya achanak ban jayega sabse bada hero jaanane ke liye suniye puri kahani sirf KUKU FM par.

madhavikkuttiyude-3-novelukal.title: മാധവിക്കുട്ടിയുടെ മൂന്ന് നോവലുകൾ
madhavikkuttiyude-3-novelukal.description: മാധവിക്കുട്ടിയുടെ മൂന്നു ലഘുനോവലുകളുടെ സമാഹാരം- രുഗ്മിണിക്കൊരു പാവക്കുട്ടി, രോഹിണി, അവസാനത്തെ അതിഥി.  സ്ത്രീജീവിതങ്ങളിലെ പ്രണയവും കാമവും നഷ്ടവും പ്രതീക്ഷകളും  മനോഹരമായി ആവിഷ്കരിച്ച കഥകൾ.

Subhas-Chandra-Bose--సుభాష్-చంద్రబోస్.title: సుభాష్ చంద్రబోస్
Subhas-Chandra-Bose--సుభాష్-చంద్రబోస్.description: భారత స్వాతంత్ర్య పోరాట ప్రధాన ఘట్టాలు, వాటిలో చంద్రబోస్ పాత్ర గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? నేతాజీ దేశం నుంచి తప్పించుకు పోయిన ఎడ్వెంచర్ ను ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

aadamkhor-shaher.title: Aadamkhor Shaher
aadamkhor-shaher.description: Ek din, puri duniya adamkhoron ki bhookh mein badal jaati hai. Zay ke haath lagta hai ek rahasyamayi 'Blood Crystal.' Uski shaktiyan aur shaap ke beech, kya Zay adamkhoron ke shahar ko bacha payega aur apne andar ke raakshas ko rok payega?

edi-charitra.title: ఏది చరిత్ర
edi-charitra.description: గతం తెలియనిదే వర్తమానం అర్థం కాదు. భవిష్యత్తుకు దారీ దొరకదు.అసలైన భారతీయ మహా పురుషులను దుష్టులుగా చిత్రించిన కుహనా చరిత్రకారుల బండారాన్ని బయటపెట్టే అపూర్వ సంచలనాత్మక గ్రంథం "ఏది చరిత్ర" తప్పకుండా వినండి.

Jayam--జయం.title: జయం
Jayam--జయం.description: అర్థం అంటే ఏంటి, పరమాత్మ అంటే ఏంటి అనే తత్వాన్ని చాలా సులువుగా, స్పష్టంగా, అర్ధ వంతంగా మల్లాది రాసిన నవల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? ఆధ్యాత్మిక చింతన ఉన్న వారు కచ్చితంగా ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

d0cae746-7949-4216-84bc-588aec2409b7.title: Hotel Ka Raaz
d0cae746-7949-4216-84bc-588aec2409b7.description: Lower-middle class ladki Minakshi ke sapne aur himmat ne badal di uski zindagi! Hotel Prince mein job milte hi khuli kayi raato ke raaz!

Maatlade-Gynpakalu-మాట్లాడే-జ్ఞాపకాలు.title: మాట్లాడే జ్ఞాపకాలు
Maatlade-Gynpakalu-మాట్లాడే-జ్ఞాపకాలు.description: ఇళయరాజా, వేటూరి,బాపు, రమణ ఇలా ఎందరో మహానుభావులతో అనుభవాలని పెనవేసుకున్న వంశీ తన జ్ఞాపకాలకు అక్షర రూపం ఇస్తూ, గోదారి నది సంగతుల నుంచి చెన్నై నగర విశేషాల దాకా పాఠకులకి అందించారు. ఈ "మాట్లాడే జ్ఞాపకాలు" ఆడియో బుక్ తప్పకుండా వినండి.

ashtavakra-aarambh-ki-gatha.title: The Legend of Ashtavakra
ashtavakra-aarambh-ki-gatha.description: Ashtavakra, Bharat ke ek vidvan sant the, lekin kya aapko pata hai ki unka viklangpan unke gyaan ka parinam tha? Haan, unhe ye shraap apne pita se mila, jo Ashtavakra ke janm se pehle hi gayab ho chuke the! Jab Ashtavakra ko apne pita ke laapata hone ki khabar mili, to wo bina kisi dwesh ke unhe dhundne nikal pade. Is yatra mein unka samna kayi chunautiyon se hua! Kya Ashtavakra apne pita ko pa sakenge? Kya wo kabhi shraap se mukt ho payenge?

irumbu-pattampoochigal.title: இரும்பு பட்டாம்பூச்சிகள்
irumbu-pattampoochigal.description: இந்த சமுதாயத்தில் நடக்கும் அவலங்களைத் தட்டிக் கேட்கும் பொறுப்பு ஆண்களுக்கு மட்டும் இல்லை, பெண்களுக்கும் உண்டு என்று சொல்ல வருகிற கதையம்சம் கொண்ட நாவல் இது. பெண்கள் உடலளவில் மென்மையானவர்களாக இருக்கலாம். ஆனால் பெண்களில் பலர் உள்ளத்தளவில் வலிமை வாய்ந்தவர்கள். அப்படிப்பட்ட பெண்களுக்குப் பெயர் இரும்புப் பட்டாம்பூச்சிகள். அந்த இரும்புப் பட்டாம்பூச்சிகளில் ஒருத்திதான் இந்த நாவலின் நாயகி.

Maanavi--మానవి.title: మానవి
Maanavi--మానవి.description: కూతురిగా తండ్రిచాటు బిడ్డగానే ఉండి పోయింది వసంత. పెళ్ళి పేరుతో మరో జీవితంలోకి అడుగు పెట్టి ఇరవయ్యేళ్ల బానిస జీవితంలో తనకంటూ ఒక అస్తిత్వం ఉందని కూడా మర్చి పోయే దశలో మేల్కొన్న వసంత జీవితం ఈ కథ. నిజానికి ఈ కథ ఏ గుర్తింపుకూ నోచుకోని మహిళల గొంతుక. ఇది వసంత కథ మాత్రమే కాదు ఎన్నో నిజమైన జీవితాలకి కథా రూపం.

small-town-murderer.title: Small Town Murderer
small-town-murderer.description: Choti si Shaadi ka Sapna, Bada sa Rahasya! Kya Anaya Sharma ko Mumbai bhag kar mila pyar ya maut ka paigaam? Jaaniye humare iss show mein.

Maate-Mantram-మాటే-మంత్రం.title: మాటే మంత్రం
Maate-Mantram-మాటే-మంత్రం.description: పలుకే బంగారం అంటారు. మాటే మంత్రం అంటారు. అటువంటి మాటని ఎప్పుడు, ఎక్కడ, ఎలా ఉపయోగించాలో చెప్తూ, ప్రపంచాన్ని కూడా మాటతో జయించ వచ్చు అనే విషయాన్ని పట్టాభిరామ్ ఈ 'మాటే మంత్రం' ఆడియో బుక్ లో విశదీకరించారు.

-చింతకింది-మల్లయ్య-ముచ్చట.title: చింతకింది మల్లయ్య ముచ్చట
-చింతకింది-మల్లయ్య-ముచ్చట.description: ఒక చక్కటి పల్లెటూరు. ఆ పల్లెటూరిలో జరిగే చిన్ని చిన్ని కథలు. పల్లెటూర్లు మాయమై పట్నాలుగా మారిపోతున్న ఈ రోజుల్లో మరి ఆ రోజుల నాటి పల్లె ముచ్చట్లు తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

making-life-a-masterpiece-author-name-or.title: Making Life A Masterpiece
making-life-a-masterpiece-author-name-or.description: Janiye kaise sirf teen shabdon 'Love Conquers All' se aap apni zindagi ko ek masterpiece bana sakte hain! Mahatma Gandhi se lekar aapke apne relations tak, pyaar ka jaadu aur iski taqat ki sachai ko explore kijiye. Suniyega 'Make Life a Masterpiece' sirf Kuku FM par!

12th-fail-12.title: 12th Fail
12th-fail-12.description: True events sa adippadaiya konda indha kathaila 12th Fail aana Manoj eppadi IPS Officer aaguraaru nu therinjukalaam vaanga. Intha Kathai.. Nambikkai, Vidamuyarchi moolam oru saatharana nabarum vetri adaiya mudiyumnu solra practical example.

great-truths-that-set-us-free.title: Great Truths That Set Us Free
great-truths-that-set-us-free.description: Joseph Murphy rachicha ee pusthakathil positive chinthayude shakthiyum subconscious mindinte kazhivukalum upayogich engane lakshyam nedam ennum velluvilikale marikadakam ennum namme padipikkunnu.

billionaires-choice.title: Billionaire's Choice
billionaires-choice.description: Prateek works part-time at a bar to pay his college fees and secretly loves Parthi, but he is too afraid to confess his feelings. One day, Parthi discovers that Prateek is actually the son of the world’s richest Oberoi family. After saving his mother’s life, she makes him sign a contract to live with her for two years, turning his life upside down. But why does Prateek continue to live like a poor man despite being a billionaire? And will Prateek ever take over the Oberoi empire?

moby-dick-2.title: മോബി ഡിക്ക്
moby-dick-2.description: ഒരു തിമിംഗലത്തിന്റെ ആക്രമണത്തിൽ തന്റെ കാൽ നഷ്ടപെട്ട ക്യാപ്റ്റൻ ആഹാബ്, മൊബി ഡിക്ക് എന്ന ആ തിമിംഗലത്തെ കണ്ടെത്തി പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യാൻ യാത്രപുറപ്പെടുകയാണ്, അപകടം നിറഞ്ഞ ആഴക്കടലിലേക്ക്! ലോകത്തുടനീളം വായനക്കാരെ വിസ്മയിപ്പിച്ച സാഹസിക നോവൽ - മോബി ഡിക്ക്!

payyan-kathakal.title: പയ്യന്‍ കഥകള്‍
payyan-kathakal.description: കേന്ദ്രസാഹിത്യ അക്കാദമി അവാര്‍ഡ് നേടിയ വികെഎന്നിന്റെ കൃതി. പയ്യനെ കേന്ദ്രീകരിച്ചുള്ള 73 കഥകളടങ്ങിയ ഈ കൃതി വികെഎന്നിന്റെ രചനാ വൈഭവം കൊണ്ട് അവിസ്മരണീയമായ അനുഭവം നല്‍കുന്നു.

82d78ea0-ba61-4f2b-9c76-07d79ade2073.title: खुशियों की चाबी
82d78ea0-ba61-4f2b-9c76-07d79ade2073.description: College ke pehle din ki excitement ko kaise ek prank ne badal diya tension mein? Shikhar ki emotional journey aur us "Khushiyon ki Chabi" ka raaz, jo uske life ke toughest moments ko bhi bana gayi memorable. Don't miss this thrilling story!

giradiyavara-sanakathegalu.title: ಗಿರಡ್ಡಿಯವರ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಥೆಗಳು
giradiyavara-sanakathegalu.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

275e9f2c-0d41-423e-89bd-19f4df64ce5b.title: Scott Allan Se Jaane Kyon Plan B Hoti Hai Bekaar
275e9f2c-0d41-423e-89bd-19f4df64ce5b.description:
|Key Insights - Fearless Motivation, Increased Self-confidence, Assured Success|
Har goal ko achieve karne ke liye sirf ek hi plan chahiye - Plan A! Plan B - matlab aapka backup plan - sirf aapka dhyaan bhatkaata hai,  confidence girata hai, aur aapko kamzor banata hai. Scott Allan ki kitaab "No Punches Pulled" se seekhiye kyun Plan B hamesha bekar hota hai, sirf Kuku FM par.

manasukharayana-manasu.title: ಮನಸುಖರಾಯನ ಮನಸು
manasukharayana-manasu.description: When we look at the books in the collection, what memories can they dig up and stop in front of us? What ideas can pass before our eyes and make our eyes misty? If you are a collector of old books, the names written on them or some sentences or the year of publication of that book can evoke ripples in our imagination.

eesadatava-jeeva.title: ಈಸಾಡತಾವ ಜೀವ
eesadatava-jeeva.description: Esadatava Jiva' is a collection of stories by Sridhara Balagara. Authors who depict situations and characters authentically with thick details have created their stories with the ambition to touch upon the nature of contemporary civilization and its diverse effects through the life situations they construct. Touching the subtle to the gross, the local to the global, the stories here are qualitative additions to contemporary fiction.

india-vs-china-1.title: India Vs China
india-vs-china-1.description: Ye Audiobook apko le chalega uss barso purani jhagde ki aur, jisne 1962 ke yuddh ko janam dia tha. Aakhir kya hai iss political rivalry ki wajah, aakhir kyun rishton mein esi darar aa gayi - ki 'Hindi-chini' ab bhai bhai naa rahe. Janne ke lie suniye 'India Vs China'

kappu-2.title: ಕಪ್ಪು
kappu-2.description: **ಕಪ್ಪು** - ಇದು ಕನ್ನಡದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಕಾರ **ಕೂಂ. ವೀರಭದ್ರಪ್ಪ** ಅವರ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು. ಕಪ್ಪು ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿನ ಅಸಮಾನತೆ, ಜಾತಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ, ಬಡತನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಅನ್ಯಾಯಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಒಂದು ಗಾಢವಾದ ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧವಾಗಿ ಮೂಡಿ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಥೆಯ ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ಅಸಮಾನತೆಯ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿತ್ಯದ ಸಂಘರ್ಷಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾ, ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸಮಾಜದ ಬಡವರು ಮತ್ತು ಅಸಮಾನತೆಯೊಳಗೆ ನಿಂತು ಹೋರಾಡುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಜಗತ್ತು ಕಪ್ಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ, ಮಾನವೀಯ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಧೀನತೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧದ ಹೋರಾಟಗಳ ಮೌಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

the-secret-adversary.title: The Secret Adversary
the-secret-adversary.description: "The Secret Adversary" takes you on a suspense-filled journey with Tommy and Tuppence, two daring friends who stumble upon a treacherous plot. Can they navigate the twists and turns to reveal the mastermind behind the chaos?
