69d0f3be-f89a-4b29-a45c-2c3e1433a0ff.title: Character Building Thought Power
69d0f3be-f89a-4b29-a45c-2c3e1433a0ff.description:
Yeh show aapke liye ek strong aur fulfilling life ka guide hai. Suniye ye show jahan hum positive thinking ki power, self-mastery ki importance, aur Law of Attraction ke incredible impact ko explore karenge. Sikhiye apna character kaise shape karna hai, bad habits ko kaise break karna hai, aur apni pasand ki life kaise create karni hai!

Link- https://kukufm.com/show/the-concept-of-mind-1?utm_source=upsell

സീതാകല്യാണം.title: സീതാകല്യാണം
സീതാകല്യാണം.description: ഹോട്ടൽ മുറിയിലേക്ക് തന്റെ കാമുകനെ കാണാൻ ചെന്ന സീതയുടെ ജീവിതം ആ ഒറ്റ രാത്രി കൊണ്ട് തകിടം മറിയുന്നു. എല്ലാവരുടെയും സ്വപ്നപുരുഷനായ ശ്രീകാന്ത് അവളെ സ്വന്തമാക്കുമോ? അതോ കുടുംബത്തിന് വേണ്ടി അവൾ ഒരു മധ്യവയസ്കന്റെ  രണ്ടാം ഭാര്യയാകുമോ?

rebecca.title: റബേക്ക
rebecca.description: പത്തേക്കർ വീടും അതിലെ ഒരേയൊരു താമസക്കാരിയായ റബേക്ക ടീച്ചറും നാട്ടുകാർക്ക് എന്നും ഒരു ദുരൂഹതയായിരുന്നു. കേരളത്തെ ഇളക്കിമറിച്ച ഒരു കേസിനെ ആസ്പദമാക്കി രാജീവ് ശിവശങ്കർ രചിച്ച ഒരു അതുഗ്രൻ ത്രില്ലർ- റബേക്ക!

titans-ka-singhasan.title: Throne of Titans
titans-ka-singhasan.description: Yeh kahani hai samay ki shuruaat ki, jab purane devtaon ne apne pitah Uranus ko Gaia ki sahayata se parast kiya. Ek bhavishyavaani jo kehti hai, Chronos bhi apne bete ke haathon haar jayega. Dhokhe, rajneeti aur shakti ka khel, jahan ant mein tay hoga asli devta kaun.

randitangazhi.title: രണ്ടിടങ്ങഴി
randitangazhi.description: മലയാളികൾ ഒരിക്കലെങ്കിലും കേട്ടിരിക്കേണ്ട തകഴിയുടെ ക്ലാസിക്. പട്ടിണിപ്പാവങ്ങളായിരുന്ന കർഷകത്തൊഴിലാളികളുടെ മേൽ  ഭൂവുടമകൾ അടിച്ചേൽപ്പിച്ചിരുന്ന ക്രൂരതകളുടെ കഥകൾ കുട്ടനാട്ടിലെ കുടുംബങ്ങളുടെ പശ്ചാത്തലത്തിൽ തകഴി വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

bgmi-history-of-battlegrounds.title: BGMI - History of Battlegrounds
bgmi-history-of-battlegrounds.description: Erangel ka lone survivor aur Battleground ki jung. Violence aur Survival par bani ek underground empire ki kahani. Kya Battleground ka ye khatarnak khel sirf ek kahani hai, ya phir ek bhayanak haqiqat? Janne ke liye sune History of Battlegrounds.

avasthe.title: ಅವಸ್ಥೆ
avasthe.description: ಅವಸ್ಥೆ ಯು.ಆರ್. ಅನಂತಮೂರ್ತಿಯವರ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಸಮಾಜದ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನದಿಂದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಜೀವನದ ಜಟಿಲತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಅವನ ನೈತಿಕ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಥೆಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿರಿಯ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ನಾಯಕನೊಬ್ಬನ ಜೀವನವಿದೆ, ಅವನ ಜೀವನದ ಕೊನೆಯ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಮಾಡಿರುವ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನರ್ವಿಮರ್ಶಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ನೈತಿಕತೆ, ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ನಂಬಿಕೆಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ಮೇಲೆ ರಾಜಕೀಯದ ಪ್ರಭಾವವನ್ನು ಬಹುಶಃ ಸಮಾನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಕಠಿಣ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಒಪ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. "ಅವಸ್ಥೆ" ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಜೀವನದ ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕತೆ, ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ದುರುಪಯೋಗ, ಮತ್ತು ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕತೆ-ನೈತಿಕತೆ ನಡುವಿನ ದ್ವಂದ್ವದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.

kaarirul-kolaigal.title: Kaarirul Kolaigal...  1 & 2
kaarirul-kolaigal.description: காதலர்கள் இருவர் தனிமையில் இருக்கலாம் என்று பாழடைந்த பங்களாவுக்குச் செல்கிறார்கள். அவர்களின் அதிஷ்டம் அங்கு இரண்டு பேர் இறந்து கிடக்கிறார்கள். கொலை செய்யப்பட்டவர்கள் யார்? காதலர்கள் இருவரும் பழியில் இருந்து தப்பித்தார்களா?

792e212e-d6d9-458a-96b9-bb34766d27d7.title: How To Travel On A Budget
792e212e-d6d9-458a-96b9-bb34766d27d7.description:
|Key Insights - Budget Travel, Smart Accommodation, Transport Hacks|
Kya aap budget mein travel karna chahte hain? Toh aap sahi jagah aaye hain. Jaaniye kaise kam kharch mein aap desh ke kone-kone ka anand le sakte hai hamare is show mein jahan aapko planning, accommodation, transportation aur sightseeing ke best tips aur hacks milenge.

kamathenuvin-muththam.title: Kamathenuvin Muththam
kamathenuvin-muththam.description: காமேஷ் ❤️ தேனுகா  இடையே காதல் தோன்றிவிட, அவர்களது முதல் முத்தம் பெரிய பிரச்னையை ஏற்படுத்திவிடுகிறது. தெய்வீகம் அவர்களது காதலுக்கு எதிராக இருக்கிறது. மனித சக்தி, தெய்வீக சக்தி ஆகியவற்றைக் கடந்து அவர்களது காதல் நிறைவேறியதா?

అమ్మమ్మ-ఇంట్లో-వేసవి-కాలం.title: అమ్మమ్మ ఇంట్లో వేసవి కాలం
అమ్మమ్మ-ఇంట్లో-వేసవి-కాలం.description: అమ్మమ్మ ఇల్లు అంటే అందరికీ ఇష్టమే, అమ్మ, ఆవకాయ్, అమ్మమ్మ ఎప్పుడూ బోర్ కొట్టవు. మిమ్మల్ని మరో కొత్త ప్రపంచంలోకి తీసుకెళ్లే అమ్మమ్మ చెప్పే కథలు మీకోసం.

the-master-key-system-4.title: The Master Key System
the-master-key-system-4.description: Subconscious Mind னு சொல்லப்படுற ஆழ்மனசோட உதவிய பயன்படுத்தி நமக்குத் தேவையான விசயங்கள அடையுறது எப்படி? செல்வசெழிப்பான, மகிழ்ச்சியான வாழ்க்கைய வாழ்றது எப்படி? வாங்க The Master Key System Audiobook மூலமா தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம்.

the-science-of-being-well-2.title: The Science of Being Well
the-science-of-being-well-2.description: ஆரோக்கியமான வாழ்க்கைய அடையறதுக்கான ஆன்மீகம் மற்றும் அறிவியல் என்ன அப்டிங்க்றத தெளிவா விளக்கி சொல்லுது இந்த 'The Science of Being Well' Audiobook. வாங்க கேக்கலாம்.

kabir-the-vision-of-wisdom.title: Kabir : The Vision Of Wisdom
kabir-the-vision-of-wisdom.description: Kabir: The Vision of Wisdom’ mein suniye Kabir ke deep insights jo aapko denge ek naye nazariye se jeene ki taaqat. Yeh audiobook hai ek safar self-discovery ka, Khud ko sach mein pa lene ka jo aapki zindagi ko bana dega meaningful.

love-medicine.title: Love Medicine
love-medicine.description: కరోనా కాలం లో ఆయుర్వేదం ద్వారా ఔషధం కనిపెట్టిన సుమంత్ ని ఎలా అయినా సరే మెడికల్ మాఫియా ఆపాలి అనుకుంటుంది, దానికి చంపడానికి కూడా వెనుకాడదు. అలాంటి సమయంలో అక్కడే మెడికల్ క్యాంపు కు వచ్చి సుమంత్ ప్రేమలో పడిపోయిన  డాక్టర్ అనన్య మరియు అనంతపల్లి ప్రజలు సుమంత్ కు ఎలా దగ్గరయ్యారు, తనకి ఎలా సహాయపడ్డారనేది కథ !

ബ്ലാക്ക്-ബെൽറ്റ്.title: ബ്ലാക്ക് ബെൽറ്റ്
ബ്ലാക്ക്-ബെൽറ്റ്.description: വയറ്റിലേക്ക് തറഞ്ഞിറങ്ങിയ കുപ്പിയിൽ പിടിച്ചു കൊണ്ട് വില്യംസിന്റെ ഭാര്യ പിടഞ്ഞു. അതിനു കാരണക്കാരനായ കൊലപാതകി ഒരിക്കലും കരുതിയില്ല, വർഷങ്ങൾക്കു ശേഷം അവരുടെ മകൻ പ്രതികാര ദാഹിയായി അയാളെ തേടിയെത്തുമെന്ന്. ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലറുകളുടെ രാജാവ് ബാറ്റൺ ബോസ് രചിച്ച ഒരു അതുഗ്രൻ നോവൽ- ബ്ലാക്ക് ബെൽറ്റ്!

3e994e4c-021f-4a65-975b-76b8762fa853.title: उन्नति के तीन मार्ग: उद्धव गीता
3e994e4c-021f-4a65-975b-76b8762fa853.description: Suniye Shree Krishna aur Uddhav ke beech ka ye adbhut samvaad jahan Shree Krishna Uddhava ko btate hain unnati ke teen marg.

Andamaina-Jeevitam-అందమైన-జీవితం-.title: అందమైన జీవితం
Andamaina-Jeevitam-అందమైన-జీవితం-.description: ప్రియతమ్ తన జీవించిన కొద్దిపాటి అందమైన జీవితాన్ని తన స్నేహితురాలితో చెప్తూ ఆమె ఊహల్లో తన భార్యని పిల్లల్ని చూసుకొంటూ , జీవితం అంటే కార్లు , డబ్బు కాదు చిన్న చిన్న ఆనందాలు అంటూ వెల్లడించే అరుదైన పుస్తకం  ఈ "అందమైన జీవితం".

rakta-charitra.title: Death Angel
rakta-charitra.description: Shehar mein hua hai ek aur katl. Ye katl bhi thik waise hi hua hai, jaise Ved ki family ka hua tha. To kya Ved ki family is serial killing ka pehla case thi? Kya Ved aur katl hone se rok payega? Kaun hai in serial killing ke peeche? Janne ke liye sunein Death Angel

indhiya-neram-2-am.title: Indhiya Neram 2 AM
indhiya-neram-2-am.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

Manchi-Chedu--మంచిచేడు.title: మంచీ - చెడూ
Manchi-Chedu--మంచిచేడు.description: మధ్య తరగతి కుటుంబాల మధ్య ఉండే సమస్యలని, ఆశలని, అత్యాశలని అన్నిటినీ "మంచీ - చెడూ" అనే కథ ద్వారా విని తెలుసుకోండి.

zomato-taste-aur-tech-ka-fusion.title: Zomato: Taste Aur Tech Ka Fusion
zomato-taste-aur-tech-ka-fusion.description: Kya aap janna chahte hain Zomato kaise bana zero se hero level ka brand? Agar han, Toh is show mein suniye  startup ki shuruaat se lekar duniya ke top food delivery brand banne tak ka poora safar. Janiye founder Deepinder Goyal ki mehnat aur dedication kaise ban gayi har entrepreneur ke liye misaal. Miss mat kariyega kyunki Ye show aapko apne startup ke sapne ko sach karne ka tareeka bhi batayega.

kaatru-kaatru-uyir.title: Kaatru Kaatru Uyir
kaatru-kaatru-uyir.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

ini-minmini.title: இனி மின்மினி
ini-minmini.description: நியூயார்க்கில், வீடு வாங்க முயற்சிக்கும் ஒருவர் எதிர்பாராத சிக்கல்களை சந்திக்கிறார், அதேநேரம் கோவை கலெக்டரிடம் காணமல் போன ஒருவரைக் கண்டுபிடிக்க சொல்லிக் கொடுக்கப்பட்ட மனுவிலிருந்த புகைப்படத்தைப் பார்த்து கலெக்டர் அதிர்ச்சி அடைகிறார். இந்த இரு சம்பவங்களும் ஒரு புள்ளியில் இணைகின்றன. விவேக் மற்றும் விஷ்ணுவின் விசாரணையில் மர்மங்கள் அம்பலமாகின்றன. கோவை மற்றும் நியூயார்க்கில் நடக்கும் மர்மங்கள் என்ன?, அவற்றின் ரகசிய பின்னனி என்ன? ராஜேஷ்குமாரின் எழுத்தில் பரபரக்க வைக்கும் இந்த  த்ரில்லர் கதையை கேட்டு தெரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள்.

astra-warrior.title: Astra Warrior
astra-warrior.description: Kahani ek sadharan ladke ke khaas banane ki. Jhuggi jhopadi mein rehne wala ek gareeb ladka kaise bna sabse shaktishali superhero aur kaise kiya usne bade bade monsters ka bahaduri se samna.  Jaanane ke liye suniye puri kahani sirf KUKU FM par.

alli-alli-tharuven.title: அள்ளி அள்ளி தருவேன்
alli-alli-tharuven.description: 35 வயதாகியும் திருமணமாகாத ஒரு இளைஞன். அவனை மணக்க விரும்பும் ஒரு விவாகரத்தான பெண். இந்த பெண்ணால் விவாகரத்து செய்யப்பட்டவரே நமது 35 வயது ஹீரோவின் அக்காவை மணக்க முன்வருகிறார். இந்த திருமணங்கள் நடக்கலாமா? நடந்தால் அந்த உறவுகளுக்கு என்ன பெயர்?

moodu-pani-nilavu.title: மூடு பனி நிலவு
moodu-pani-nilavu.description:
யமுனா ஒரு Innocent பெண்.
அவள் மீது ஒரு கொலைப் பழி சுமத்தப்படுகிறது.
உண்மையில் கொலையாளி யார்? ஒருவேலை யமுனாவே செய்திருக்க கூடுமா?
இது ராஜேஷ் குமாரின் “மூடு பனி நிலவு”

snitch-redefining-mens-fashion.title: Snitch: Redefining Men's Fashion
snitch-redefining-mens-fashion.description: Jaaniye Siddharth Dungarwal ki inspiring life journey.... Kaise unhone apni mehnat aur passion se ek chote se idea ko ek leading men's fashion brand mein badla ? Yeh show hai unke struggles, strategies aur success ki kahani, jo har young entrepreneur ke liye ek inspiration banegi.

Parusavedi--పరుసవేది--The-Alchemist.title: The Alchemist
Parusavedi--పరుసవేది--The-Alchemist.description:
"పాలో కోయెల్హో రాసిన పరుసవేది తన పాఠకుల జీవితాలను శాశ్వతంగా మారుస్తూనే ఉంది. పాలో కోయెల్హో యొక్క మాస్టర్ పీస్ అండలూసియన్ గొర్రెల కాపరి బాలుడు శాంటియాగో యొక్క మాయా కథను చెబుతుంది, అతను ఎప్పుడైనా దొరికినట్లుగా విపరీతమైన ఒక ప్రాపంచిక నిధిని వెతకడానికి ప్రయాణం చేయాలని ఆరాటపడుతున్నాడు.
 "మరియు, మీకు ఏదైనా కావాలనుకున్నప్పుడు, విశ్వం అంతా దాన్ని సాధించడంలో మీకు సహాయం చేయడంలో కుట్ర చేస్తుంది."" - పాలో కోయెల్హో"

karm-aur-gyan-kaand-mein-antar.title: Karm aur Gyan Kaand Mein Antar
karm-aur-gyan-kaand-mein-antar.description: Janam se le kar mrityu tak, har karm ka ek hi maqsad - Ishwar ki prapti! Karm aur Gyaan ke beech ka sach kya hai? Jaane in dono raaston ka asli mahatva!

chavukadal.title: ചാവുകടൽ
chavukadal.description: അഞ്ചലോസും എമിലിയും ഒന്നാകാൻ തീരുമാനിച്ചപ്പോൾ അവർ കരുതിയില്ല അത് വലിയ ദുരന്തങ്ങളുടെ തുടക്കമാകുമെന്ന്‌. ആർത്തിരമ്പുന്ന കടലിന്റെ പശ്ചാത്തലത്തിൽ ജോസി വാഗമറ്റം  രചിച്ച സൂപ്പർഹിറ്റ് തില്ലർ - ചാവുകടൽ!

nalvar-sanghathile-maranakanakk.title: നാൽവർ സംഘത്തിലെ മരണകണക്ക്
nalvar-sanghathile-maranakanakk.description: ഒരു ഗ്രാമത്തിലെ പുഴയിലൂടെ ഒഴുകിവന്ന ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ തല. വർഷങ്ങൾക്കു ശേഷം ആ പുഴയിലൂടെ തലയില്ലാത്ത ഒരു ശരീരം ഒഴുകി വരുന്നു . ഞെട്ടിക്കുന്ന ഒരു  കൊലപാതക പരമ്പരയുടെ ചുരുളഴിക്കാൻ ശ്രമിക്കുകയാണ് ഒരു പോലീസ്  ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥൻ.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

poetry-killer.title: പോയട്രി കില്ലർ
poetry-killer.description: എഴുത്തുകാരെ മാത്രം തേടിയെത്തുന്ന ഒരു സീരിയൽ കില്ലർ! സമർത്ഥനായ ഒരു പൊലീസ് ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥൻ ഇവയുടെ രഹസ്യം തേടിയിറങ്ങുകയാണ്. കേൾക്കൂ...പോയട്രി കില്ലർ!

janmadinam.title: ജന്മദിനം
janmadinam.description: ജന്മദിനത്തിലെ പട്ടിണിയിലൂടെ, സമൂഹത്തിന്റെ കപടവും അടിസ്ഥാന ആവശ്യങ്ങളുടെ നഗ്നതയും വരച്ചു കാട്ടുന്നു ബഷീർ.

etf-karobar-investment-ki-nai-duniya.title: ETF KAROBAR – INVESTMENT KI NAI DUNIYA
etf-karobar-investment-ki-nai-duniya.description: Kya aap bhi duniya ka safest aur tezi se grow hone wala investment option dhoondh rahe hain? Toh hamaara ye show aapko batayega ki kis tarah ETF ki duniya mein invest kar ke, aap long term mein compounding ka fayda utha sakte hain. Ek aisa investment method, jo bahut hi kam logon ko pata hota hai. Suniye abhi.

karunalu-ba-belake-vol-1.title: ಕರುಣಾಳು ಬಾ ಬೆಳಕೆ (ಭಾಗ-1)
karunalu-ba-belake-vol-1.description: "ಕರುಣಾಳು ಬಾ ಬೆಳಕೆ  ಡಾ. ಗುರುರಾಜ ಕರಜಗಿ ಅವರ ಮನಸೂರೆಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕೃತಿ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಹೃದಯಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿ ಲೇಖನಗಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಯ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಹಾಗೂ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಪವಿತ್ರತೆಯ ಒಳತತ್ವವನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕರುಣಾಳು ಬಾ ಬೆಳಕೆ  ಕೃತಿಯು ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯ ಬೆಳಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸುವ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಲೇಖಕರು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾನವ ಬದುಕಿನ ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕತೆ, ಜೀವನದ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿನ ಸತ್ಯಾಸತ್ಯತೆಗಳನ್ನು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ತತ್ವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕತೆ ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯನ್ನೂ, ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಬೆಳಕನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಹಾಯಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

manjeena-hoomale.title: ಮಂಜಿನ ಹೂಮಳೆ
manjeena-hoomale.description: **ಮಂಜಿನ ಹೂಮಳೆ** ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ ಅವರ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯ, ಮಾನವೀಯ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು, ಜೀವನದ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆ ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೊಳಗಿನ ಸಾಂವಿಧಾನಿಕ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಪರಿಚಯ ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಅವರ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಹೋರಾಟಗಳು ಕಥೆಯ ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ತೀವ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಸಣ್ಣ ಘಟನಾವಳಿಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಬೃಹತ್ ಜೀವನದ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಆವಿಷ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತಾ, ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಅಮೃತತತ್ತ್ವವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.

33779704-d0a0-4247-aae0-e4e4a7ab2e4e.title: Unlock Your Lemonade Life
33779704-d0a0-4247-aae0-e4e4a7ab2e4e.description: Kya aap bhi apni dream life ko achieve karna chahte hain? Is story ke zariye jaaniye kaise innovative mindset se apni life ko lemonade ki tarah sweet banaya ja sakta hai. Har episode mein milega ek naya key idea jo aapki success ke raaste kholega!

mamookoya.title: മാമുക്കോയ
mamookoya.description: മലയാളിക്ക് മാമുക്കോയ എന്നാല്‍ നല്ല അസ്സല്‍ കോഴിക്കോടന്‍ ചിരിയുടെ അഡ്രസാണ്. മാമുക്കോയ പറഞ്ഞാല്‍ മാത്രം ചിരി വരുന്ന തമാശകള്‍ നമുക്കറിയാം. അതുപോലെ അദ്ദേഹം കടന്നുവന്ന ജീവിതവും കഥകളും കേട്ടാലോ..

ghachar-ghochar-1.title: ಘಾಚರ್ ಘೋಚರ್
ghachar-ghochar-1.description: **ಘಾಚರ್-ಘೋಚರ್** - ವಿವೇಕ ಶಾನುಭಾಗರ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ, ಇದು ಒಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಬಣ್ಣಿಸುವ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕತೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅದರ ಆಳತೆ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಗಹನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಮಧ್ಯಮವರ್ಗದ ಜೀವನದ ಗಡಿಬಿಡಿ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಏರಿದಾಗ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಜಟಿಲ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗತ ಭಾವನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮವಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ."ಘಾಚರ್-ಘೋಚರ್" ಎಂಬ ಶಬ್ದದ ಅರ್ಥವೇ ಗೊಂದಲವಿರುವ ಅಥವಾ ಬಿಗಿದಿರುವ ಅವಸ್ಥೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಕಥೆಯು ಬಳಸಿದ್ದು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಜೀವನದ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಲು. ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಹಣದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆದಿದೆ. ವಿವೇಕ ಶಾನುಭಾಗರು ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಒಳಗಿನ ಸಂಘರ್ಷ, ಅಸಹ್ಯತೆ ಮತ್ತು ತಮ್ಮ ಬದಲಾದ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿಯ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಗೊಂದಲವನ್ನು ಚಲನಚಿತ್ರದ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಂಬಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

yashasvi-jaiswal-aam-ladke-ki-khaas-kaha.title: Yashasvi Jaiswal: Aam Ladke Ki Khaas Kahani
yashasvi-jaiswal-aam-ladke-ki-khaas-kaha.description: Kya aapko pata hai Yashasvi Jaiswal ki kahani? Ek ladka jo Mumbai ki galiyon mein pani puri bechta tha, Aur aaj hai Indian cricket ka star. Abhi is show mein suniye, Apne sapnon ko sach karne ke liye, Kaise uske struggle aur determination ne uska saath diya. Yeh kahani aapke dil ko chhoo legi aur apne sapne poore karne ke liye junoon se bhar degi.

anantha-geetha.title: ಅನಂತ ಗೀತಾ
anantha-geetha.description:
**ಅನಂತ ಗೀತೆ** - ಅನುಪಮಾ ನಿರಂಜನ ಅವರ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಹೃದಯಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿ ಕಥಾವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಣ್ಣಿನ ಜೀವನದ ಸಂಘರ್ಷ, ತಾಳ್ಮೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ನಂಟುಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕಥೆಯ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಆಂತರಿಕ ತೊಂದರೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧದ ಸಂಕೋಲೆಗಳು ಯಾವ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಆವಿಷ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೃದಯದ ಭಾವನೆಗಳು, ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ನಂಬಿಕೆಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೋಜ್ಞವಾಗಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಅಂತರಂಗದ ಒತ್ತಡಗಳ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಹೋರಾಟದ ಗಾಢತೆಯನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

empower-your-confidence-1.title: Empower Your Confidence
empower-your-confidence-1.description: Kya aap hamesha confident feel nahi kar paate? Agar haan, Toh abhi suniye yeh audiobook aur seekhiye Scott Allan se apne andar unbreakable confidence ko develop karna. Yani ki ab waqt aa gaya hai Negative thoughts ko bhoolane ka, self-doubt ko haraane ka, aur apni life ko full confidence ke saath jeene ka.

ikigai-the-japanese-secret-to-a-long-and.title: Ikigai: The Japanese Secret to a Long and Happy Life
ikigai-the-japanese-secret-to-a-long-and.description: Ikigai enna Japanese vaakinte artham jeevitham lakshyam ennanu. Ee pusthakam dheerkhayussum santhoshavum niranja jeevitham nayikkunathinulla Japanese rahasyangalum thathwangalum vivarikkunnu. Jeevithathil ningalude Ikigai kandethanum athu pinthudarunumulla vazhikaatiyanu ee pusthakam.

താരാപഥം.title: താരാപഥം
താരാപഥം.description: സംഭവബഹുലമായ ആ രാത്രിയ്ക്ക് ശേഷം താരയുടെ ജീവിതം കീഴ്‌മേല്‍ മറിഞ്ഞു. പബ്ബില്‍ വെടിയുതിര്‍ത്ത് താരയെ ആനന്ദിന്റെ ആള്‍ക്കാര്‍ എന്തിനാണ് പിടിച്ചുകൊണ്ടുപോയത്?  തന്റെ ലൈഫിലേക്ക്  ഒരു പെണ്ണിനെ പോലും അടുപ്പിക്കാത്ത ആനന്ദ് താരയെ എന്ത് കൊണ്ടാണ്‌ കൂടെ നിര്‍ത്തുന്നത്. കേള്‍ക്കാം താരാപഥം..

hot-romance-with-the-vampire.title: Yaksh Ki Khoj
hot-romance-with-the-vampire.description: Rakshita ne apni purani haveli mein kadam rakhte hi galti se ek aisi aatma ko jaga diya jo hazaro saalo se qaid thi. Wo aatma koi insaani aatma nahi, balki ek Yaksh ki aatma thi. Kya hoga jab sone ke khazane ki raksha karta Yaksh apni shaktiyon se phasa lega Rakshita ko apne jaal mein? Kya is jaal mein phasne ki keemat chukayegi wo apne shareer se?

സുഗന്ധി-എന്ന-ആണ്ടാൾ-ദേവനായകി-.title: സുഗന്ധി എന്ന ആണ്ടാൾ ദേവനായകി
സുഗന്ധി-എന്ന-ആണ്ടാൾ-ദേവനായകി-.description: ഫ്രാൻസിസ് ഇട്ടിക്കോരക്കു ശേഷം ടി ഡി രാമകൃഷ്ണൻ രചിച്ച ഒരു മിസ്റ്ററി ത്രില്ലർ! ശ്രീലങ്കൻ യുദ്ധത്തിന്റെ പശ്ചാത്തലത്തിൽ, സിനിമ നിർമ്മാണത്തിനായി എത്തുന്ന പീറ്റർ ജീവാനന്ദം തന്റെ നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട പ്രണയിനിയായ സുഗന്ധിയെ തേടുകയാണ്. ചരിത്രവും മിഥ്യയും ഇടകലരുന്ന ഈ നോവൽ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് ഒരു അവിസ്മരണീയ അനുഭവം സമ്മാനിക്കും!

deva-ragasiyam.title: Deva Ragasiyam
deva-ragasiyam.description: மரணப் படுக்கையில்,கோமாவில் கிடக்கும் முதல்வர் திடீரென்று கண் விழிக்கிறார். அங்கு சுத்தம் செய்துகொண்டிருந்த ஆயா அம்மாவிடம் ஒரு ரகசிய்த்தை சொல்லிவிட்டு இறந்து போகிறார். பலரின் வாழ்க்கையைப் புரட்டிப் போடும் அந்த ரகசியம் என்ன?

shaheed-udham-singh.title: Shaheed Udham Singh
shaheed-udham-singh.description: Kya aapko pata hai, kis tarah Udham Singh ne angrezo ki neend haram kar di thi? Is show mein hum leke aaye hain unki pratishodh yatra, jisne desh ko Jalianwala Bagh ka badla dilaya. Aakhir mein, ek deshbhakt ki kahani jo har Bharatiya ko sunni chahiye. Toh, taiyar ho jaiye aur suniye ye zinda dil kahani.

the-richest-man-in-babylon-16.title: The Richest Man In Babylon
the-richest-man-in-babylon-16.description: நெறயா பணம் சம்பாதிக்க, அத பாதுகாப்பா சேர்த்து வைக்க,  முதலீடு செஞ்சு பல மடங்கா பெருக்க பாபிலோனின் மிகப்பெரிய பணக்காரர் சொல்ற ரகசியங்கள கதை வடிவுல இந்த Audiobook-ல தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம் வாங்க🏛️💵.

khaaki-vanam.title: ఖాకీవనం
khaaki-vanam.description: పోలీసులు, అందులోనూ కింది స్థాయి ఉద్యోగుల జీవితాల్లో ఉండే వెట్టి చాకిరీ, కష్టాలు, ఇబ్బందులు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? యదార్ధ సంఘటనల సమాహారం "ఖాకీవనం"

mastering-excel-basic-to-advanced.title: Mastering Excel: Basic To Advanced
mastering-excel-basic-to-advanced.description:
This comprehensive course spans 21 hours, combining 12 hours of basic Excel training and 9 hours of advanced techniques. It is designed for individuals looking to elevate their Excel skills from foundational to expert level.

the-master-mind-transforming-your-though.description: உலகப்புகழ்பெற்ற Best seller எழுத்தாளர் நெப்போலியன் ஹில்  இந்த  ஆடியோபுக்-ல உங்களோட எண்ணங்கள  பயன்படுத்தி வாழ்க்கைல நீங்க நெனச்சத அடைய என்ன செய்யணும்னு கத்துக்கொடுக்குறாரு. உங்க லட்சியங்கள அடைய இந்த Audiobook நிச்சயம் help பண்ணும். 🏆🚀

krishnadaasi.title: Krishnadaasi
krishnadaasi.description: தாசி குலத்தில் பிறந்துவிட்ட கிருஷ்ணவேணி அதிலிருந்து மீண்டு சுயமரியாதையோட வாழவிரும்புகிறாள். அவளை மணக்க யாரும்தயாராயில்லை. ஒருவன் கூட மணக்க முன்வரவில்லை. ஒருவன் மட்டும் ஒரு வாரிசை தரமுன் வருகிறான், அவளும் கருவுறுகிறாள். இவ்வேளை பிரபல உபன்யாசகர் ஒருவர்- தீட்சிதர் அவர். இவருக்கு 8 பெண்பிள்ளைகள். ஆண்வாரிசுக்காக தவமிருப்பவர், இதனால் தீட்சிதர் மனைவியும் கருவுருகிறாள். இருவரும் ஒன்றாய் பிள்ளை பெறுகின்றனர். தாசிக்கு ஆண்பிறக்கிறது, தீட்சிதற்கு பெண்! தந்திரமாய் குழந்தைகள் இடம்மாறுகின்றன. அதன் பின்….? பரபரப்பான கதை இது.

spiritual-minimalism-solve-your-problems.title: Spiritual Minimalism: Solve Your Problems with Zen Principles
spiritual-minimalism-solve-your-problems.description: Soch rahe ho apni life problems kaise solve karein? "Spiritual Minimalism" mein har episode mein hamaare Saadhu aapko batayenge Zen principles ke zariye har mushkil ka solution. Toh kya aap bhi apni life ko simplify karna chahte ho? Abhi suno aur apni zindagi badlo!

ragasiyamaga-oru-ragasiyam.title: ரகசியமாக ஒரு ரகசியம்
ragasiyamaga-oru-ragasiyam.description: சித்தர்பட்டியில் உள்ள சித்தேஸ்வரர் ஆலயத்தில் ஒரு மரணம் நிகழ்கிறது. அதற்கு காரணம் சித்தர்களாக இருக்கும், இறைவனின் சக்தியாக இருக்கும் என ஒரு பக்கம் கருத்து நிலவ, மறுபக்கம் அது மனிதர்களுடைய வேலை தான் என சிலர் கூறுகின்றனர். இதற்கெல்லாம் காரணம் யார்?

sila-nerangalil-sila-manitharkal.title: சில நேரங்களில் சில மனிதர்கள்
sila-nerangalil-sila-manitharkal.description: இது எழுத்தாளர் ஜெயகாந்தன் எழுதுன புகழ்பெற்ற நாவல். இந்த கதைல வர  இளம் பெண் கங்கா, யாருனு தெரியாத யாரோ ஒருத்தன் கிட்ட தன்னோட கற்ப இழந்துடறா, அதுக்கப்புறமா அவளோட வாழ்க்கைல நடக்குற சம்பவங்கள் அவளோட வாழ்க்கையைவே புரட்டிப்போடுது. அப்படி என்ன தான் நடந்தது? வாங்க தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம்.

7bc460c8-5524-49bf-b639-d54f3b3a1522.title: Itihaas Ki Goonj: Battlefields of 1857
7bc460c8-5524-49bf-b639-d54f3b3a1522.description: 1857, Bharat ki azaadi ki pehli ladai thi. Mangal Pandey, Rani Lakshmibai, Nana Saheb, Tatya Tope jaise veer swatantrata senaniyon ne is kranti ki mashal jalayi thi. Is show mein hum aapko un khatarnaak aur jazbati ladaiyon ke beech le chalenge, jahan talwaron ki jhankar, bandookon ki awaaz, aur golon ke dhamakon ke beech aap khud ko jung ke maidan mein payenge.

ஒரு ஊரில் தேவசேனை என்ற ஒரு மோகினிப் பேய் ஒருத்தி இருக்கிறாள்.

the-metamorphosis-3.title: The Metamorphosis
the-metamorphosis-3.description: Franz Kafka's "The Metamorphosis" begins with Gregor Samsa's shocking transformation into an insect, exploring themes of alienation and disgrace. This dark yet absurdly comic novella delves into human feelings of inadequacy and isolation, establishing itself as a pivotal work reflecting the existential predicament of modern life. Explore the endless realms of fiction exclusively on Kuku FM

brahma-srishti-ki-rachna-ka-rahasya.title: Brahma: Srishti Ki Rachna Ka Rahasya
brahma-srishti-ki-rachna-ka-rahasya.description: Kya aap apni life ki choti choti pareshaaniyon ka solution chahte hain? Iske saath hi, Brahma ji ki ansuni kahaniya aur facts aapki soch ko ek nayi disha bhi denge taki ek behtar jeevan jiya ja sake.

yaarendru-mattum-sollathe.title: யாரென்று மட்டும் சொல்லாதே
yaarendru-mattum-sollathe.description: வழக்கம் போலவே ஒவ்வொரு அத்தியாயமும் தொடர்கதைகளுக்கே உரிய பரபரப்புடன் அமைந்தது. இதன் முக்கிய கருப்பொருளாக நாக மாணிக்ககல் அமைந்தது. வாசகர்களும் விரும்பி வரவேற்றனர். கதை போகும் போக்கை வைத்து பலரும் இதை அமானுஷ்ய நாவலாகவே கருதினர். ஆனால் இதன் க்ளைமாக்ஸ் அதை அப்படியே புரட்டிப் போட்டுவிட்டது.

Theta-Healing-खुशहाल-जीवन-की-कुंजी.title: Theta Healing: खुशहाल जीवन की कुंजी
Theta-Healing-खुशहाल-जीवन-की-कुंजी.description: Kya aapko zindagi ke raste mein negativity ka daldal mil gaya hai?  Aur usmein fans bhi gaye ho? Toh pareshan hone ki zaroorat nahi hai. Bas abhi is show ko suniye aur Theta Healing Technique ko seekh kar apply karna shuru kardijiye. Phir dekhiye kaise aapki zindagi positive changes se bhar jayegi.

neela-nilaa.title: Neela Nilaa
neela-nilaa.description: நீல நிலா நாவல் இரண்டு ட்ராக்குகளில் பயணம் செய்கிறது. ஒரு ட்ராக்கில் சிவசங்கர், நவநீதன், பிரதிபா தில்லைராஜன் கதாபாத்திரங்கள். மற்றொரு ட்ராக்கில் புரபசர் பத்ரி நாராயணன் ஒரு ஆராய்ச்சி சம்பந்தமாய், வருண், சபா, சுந்தர், மேகலா, பொன்மணி, ரமா என்கிற இளைஞர் குழுவோடு காட்டில் உள்ள காணாதது கண்டான் கோட்டைக்குப் போகிறார். இரண்டு ட்ராக்குகளிலும் அடுக்கடுக்காய் அதிர்ச்சியளிக்கும் சம்பவங்கள்.

thik-thik-thilaga.description: Bold and beautiful Yamuna while trying to set her as a model in glamorous advertising world, found herself in deep trouble.

pregnant-by-my-boss.title: Pregnant By My Boss
pregnant-by-my-boss.description: Komal's world shatters as she faces public humiliation and financial ruin, deliberately orchestrated by the vengeful Ritika, igniting a desperate quest for survival and justice, compounded by her mother's urgent medical needs. Amidst this turmoil, Kabir, grappling with his own infertility and societal pressures, emerges as an unexpected protector, intervening during Komal's bullying and developing deep feelings for her, even offering crucial financial aid. A powerful CEO, Aman, also briefly appears as a guardian, hinting at a past connection and romantic tension. Following an intimate encounter, Komal discovers she is unexpectedly pregnant with twins, a revelation complicated by Kabir's devastating infertility diagnosis, though a paternity test ultimately confirms him as the father. Kabir proposes marriage, but his family, particularly his mother and cousin, vehemently oppose Komal, accusing her of being a manipulative "gold-digger" and demanding a DNA test, subjecting her to public shaming. Despite this intense familial rejection and accusations, Kabir defiantly stands by Komal, declaring her his future wife and vowing to protect her and their unborn children. Komal's arrival at Kabir's opulent mansion brings new challenges, as she immediately faces hostility from his sister, Shanaya, and struggles for acceptance amidst deep-seated class conflict and the matriarch Mummy Ji's initial opposition. The situation is further complicated by the introduction of Isha as Kabir's "intended bride" and Komal's developing a forbidden attraction to the married Sameer. Returning to college, Komal becomes the target of a vicious smear campaign, facing gossip, digital harassment, and physical assault, all orchestrated by her jealous rival, Ritika, who publicly accuses her of prostitution. Kabir, now a new board member, dramatically intervenes, publicly exposing Ritika's malicious campaign, and Komal skillfully turns the tables on her rival by revealing Ritika's secret benefactor. However, the threats persist; Komal's pregnancy is challenged by Shanaya, leading to her expulsion, and Isha resurfaces, alleging Kabir's fertility issues and a manipulative agenda. Komal then vanishes, kidnapped by her estranged convict brother, Sunny, who aligns with Ritika to destroy her and her unborn children. The harrowing journey culminates in a life-threatening childbirth, where Komal miraculously delivers healthy twins, ultimately overcoming relentless betrayal, danger, and societal prejudice to secure her family's future.

saat-pengkhianatan-menjadi-awal-kebangki.title: Saat Pengkhianatan Menjadi Awal Kebangkitan
saat-pengkhianatan-menjadi-awal-kebangki.description: Betrayed by his sworn brother Kush, Luv — a fallen martial artist with no memory — rises from the streets to reclaim his true identity as the rightful leader. In a world of deadly rivalries, Luv, Emma, and Mr. Roy fight to restore honor against the corrupt forces led by Kush and Yuvaan.

the-marshal-wife.description: Watch "The Marshal Merciless Wife" Now! Only On KUKU FM!

the-strongest-curse-master-4.title: The Strongest Curse Master
the-strongest-curse-master-4.description: In a chaotic fight, Zhang Cheng was betrayed by his brother Zhao Zipeng and girlfriend Yang Bingbing. He was gravely injured. At this moment, a descendant of an ancient mystic sect saw him and taught him curse magic. Years later, Zhang Cheng returned as a master of this magic. On the roadside, he saw a group of ruffians bullying a woman named Shi Sanniang. Zhang Cheng stepped in to help, and his powerful magic caught Shi Sanniang's attention. Later, he unexpectedly ran into his former class beauty, Song Jia. The wealthy second-generation classmate Zhao Zipeng was also at the scene, not only harassing Song Jia but also mocking Zhang Cheng for his lack of accomplishment. He publicly insulted Zhang Cheng, who is no longer who he used to be and vowed to make everyone who belittled him recognize his strength.

you-are-like-a-star.description: Watch This Beautiful Show Called "You are Like A Star" Now. Only On Kuku FM!

tales-from-the-no-mans-land-2.title: Tales from the No-Man's Land
tales-from-the-no-mans-land-2.description: A truck. Two men. Two mysterious hitchhikers. As desire clashes with conscience, a dark game unfolds—because the girl they picked up isn’t who she seems. This journey hides chilling secrets, where every mile peels back layers of lies, danger, and twisted intent.

kiss-and-switch-the-cursed-vampire-5.title: Kiss and Switch The Cursed Vampire
kiss-and-switch-the-cursed-vampire-5.description: Sophie, an orphan, is thrust into a perilous supernatural conspiracy after her fiancé, Paul, abandons her at the altar while she's pregnant, substituting her for a "Hambar woman" in a 600-year-old Bloodmoon curse. A mysterious blood transfusion links Sophie to the ancient 'Amber' family, causing an identity crisis and revealing her destiny is irrevocably tied to Leo, a powerful and tormented Vampire King. Leo, initially imprisoned, is supernaturally bound to Sophie's pain and discovers his ancient curse demands marriage to her for freedom. Despite Sophie's fierce independence and quest for revenge against Paul, she is forced into a contract marriage with Leo, whose possessiveness intensifies as he realizes she is key to his redemption. Their cohabitation is fraught with tension, yet Leo finds himself inexplicably drawn to her. Sophie grapples with profound grief after losing her child, while a mysterious rival emerges, plotting to eliminate her and claim Leo. Her life escalates into a web of supernatural threats and manipulation, as she undertakes morally compromising work and is poisoned, only to be rescued by the possessive Vampire King who reveals a dark magical bond. Sophie discovers her own latent precognitive and 'vampire lord' powers. Leo, now a billionaire CEO, further intertwines their complex destinies, alternately declaring her his lover, dismissing her, and holding her captive, believing she holds the key to breaking his ancient affliction. Their relationship is thrust into public scrutiny, complicated by Paul's re-entry and Sophie's past. She faces violent attacks, abductions, and academic sabotage from rivals. Amidst these dangers, an undeniable attraction grows between Sophie and Leo, hinting at a deeper, unresolved connection and a brewing love triangle. Sophie uncovers the murder of her parents, igniting a fierce quest for revenge, which is tied to the overarching conspiracy. A powerful Villain, responsible for past crimes, emerges, seeking to seize power from the true, contained Vampire Lord, using Sophie as unwilling leverage. The Villain issues a chilling ultimatum where Sophie's safety dictates the fate of others. The show culminates with Sophie embracing her newfound independence and powers, confronting the Villain, as Leo's true identity and the nature of the curse are fully revealed, leading to a high-stakes confrontation that will determine the outcome of the ancient conflict and Sophie's ultimate destiny.

love-of-life-time.title: Love of Life Time
love-of-life-time.description: Watch "Love of Life Time" Only On Kuku TV!

return-of-the-doctor-3.title: Return of the Doctor
return-of-the-doctor-3.description: This is the story of Dr. Shreya. She lost everything, but she stood back up bravely. As the past haunts her – will she seek revenge? Or will she choose forgiveness as her path? Don't miss this drama that becomes more suspenseful with every passing minute. Watch now!

pearless-son-in-law.description: Watch "Pearless Son in Law" Only on Kuku Fm. Now!

from-blind-date.title: FROM BLIND DATE
from-blind-date.description: Emma, an independent woman, is initially pressured into a fake contract marriage with the arrogant yet powerful CEO, Ethan, to escape her mother's matchmaking and an ex-boyfriend's extortion. Their arrangement, initially for convenience, quickly becomes complicated by public confrontations, hidden identities, and escalating family disapproval. Ethan's true power and wealth as the CEO of Walker Group are gradually revealed as he orchestrates elaborate deceptions to expose greedy adversaries. Emma navigates a complex web of corporate intrigue, facing blacklisting and threats, while also dealing with a shocking love triangle or bigamy involving Zoe, who claims to be Ethan's fiancée, and Miss Sara, another alleged wife. Ethan dramatically reveals Emma as his hidden wife, silencing workplace bullies and fiercely defending her against Zoe's classist insults. Emma grapples with the true nature of their marriage, initially believing it to be one of convenience, but Ethan passionately refuses her divorce request and declares his love. As Emma prepares to meet Ethan's formidable grandmother, Dadi, a rivalry ignites between Emma and Zoe, especially concerning identical jade gifts. Emma faces public humiliation when a jade carving she gifts Dadi is challenged as a fake by Zoe, but a shocking revelation unveils Emma as Master Mason's secret student and sole heir, dramatically shifting her standing. The conflict escalates with continued public humiliation and threats from rivals, including Zoe's manipulative schemes to force Ethan to divorce Emma. Emma's mother is kidnapped by a vindictive daughter and her powerful father, seeking revenge, but Emma defiantly refuses their demands for divorce. It is later revealed that Emma is the mastermind behind a corporate takeover, orchestrating her own father's arrest. The show culminates with Emma's eccentric billionaire father, Master Ji, transferring his entire fortune to Ethan, entrusting him with Emma's protection and warning of an impending conflict with the 'Walker family'.

fleeing-husband-please-love-me-all-over-.title: Fleeing Husband Please Love Me All Over Again!
fleeing-husband-please-love-me-all-over-.description: After deciding to divorce from the business tycoon Alexis due to her inability to tolerate their contractual marriage, the wealthy heiress Vylina fell into the lowest point of her life. Yet, after enduring the heavy blows of life's darkest moments, she ultimately achieved abundant success in both her career and love life. Watch Now!

super-dad-and-son.title: Pitaji : The BOSS
super-dad-and-son.description: A humble security guard hides a mysterious past while his son shines as a rising CEO. But when old enemies resurface, father and son must face shocking truths that test family, power, and loyalty.

why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry-3.title: Why Must the Boss Contractually Marry
why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry-3.description: একজন ধনী উত্তরাধিকারী নিজেকে প্রতিবন্ধী হিসেবে উপস্থাপন করেন, যেন নিজের পরিবারের ভেতরের চুরি-জালিয়াতির রহস্য উন্মোচন করতে পারেন। পরিস্থিতির চাপে পড়ে তিনি বিয়ে করেন এক মহিলাকে, যিনি পর্দায় "আদর্শ স্ত্রী"র চরিত্রে অভিনয়ের জন্য পরিচিত। এই চুক্তিভিত্তিক বিয়ে আস্তে আস্তে বাস্তব ভালোবাসায় রূপ নেয়, যখন তিনি ধীরে ধীরে পরিবারের বিশ্বাসঘাতকদের মুখোশ খুলে দেন এবং নিজের উত্তরাধিকার পুনরুদ্ধার করেন।

double-trouble-fiance.title: Double Trouble
double-trouble-fiance.description: Shanaya walked away from Dhruv, the man who truly loved her, and chose an abusive husband hiding another marriage. What she thought was a winning choice soon turned into regret, while the man she abandoned rose to become a billionaire, finding love and happiness again. One Last Chance is a gripping story of betrayal, regret, and the price of choices.

my-ex-husbands-breakdown-after-divorce-4.title: My Ex-Husband's Breakdown After Divorce
my-ex-husbands-breakdown-after-divorce-4.description: The show centers on the tumultuous and intertwined lives of CEO Jack and the enigmatic Vinnie, navigating a complex web of corporate power struggles, multiple marriages, and deep-seated personal betrayals. Jack, a powerful CEO, is initially depicted in a series of crumbling marriages and affairs, facing divorces from Meera (who is secretly pregnant), Sumbul (accusing him of impregnating another), and Jade. Concurrently, Vinnie, known by various names including Meera, Radha, Bini, Penny, and Winnie, is introduced as a woman entangled in Jack's orbit, often as a target of his manipulation or a victim of corporate machinations. Their relationship is fraught with conflict: Vinnie desperately seeks divorce from Jack, who obstructs the process, uses a necklace as leverage, and is accused of bigamy due to an affair with a rival claiming pregnancy. Vinnie herself faces accusations of infidelity and corporate espionage from Jack's family and the persistent antagonist, Susan, who harbors an obsessive desire for Jack and attempts to destroy Vinnie's reputation with fabricated evidence and paternity claims. Amidst these personal battles, corporate rivalries intensify, with Jack engaging in hostile takeovers, design leaks, and power struggles against figures like Fernand and an Elder Man, often with Vinnie's secret identity as "Mr. Jade" or her strategic importance in corporate espionage at stake. A central mystery revolves around Vinnie's pregnancies and paternity. She is secretly pregnant with Meera, later revealed to be pregnant with a child whose biological father is Helen, whom she claims is her brother, not Jack. This paternity scandal, coupled with Jack's past affairs and a terminated pregnancy with a "Mysterious Woman," adds layers of deception and emotional turmoil. Despite the animosity, Jack's feelings for Vinnie evolve, leading to his defense of her against his family and Susan, and a dramatic public confession of love, which Vinnie initially rejects. The narrative culminates in a desperate struggle for Vinnie's life and freedom. She is gravely ill, guarding a secret, and is kidnapped by the obsessive Susan, who attempts to kill her. Jack makes a desperate, self-sacrificing act to save Vinnie, sustaining severe injuries. Ultimately, Jack and Vinnie reconcile, discovering their marriage was predestined by a heroic rescue years ago, solidifying their fated connection amidst the lingering threats and unresolved corporate intrigues.

once-upon-a-divorce-the-double-life-of-l.title: Once Upon a Divorce: The Double Life of Lady Diana
once-upon-a-divorce-the-double-life-of-l.description: Once Upon a Divorce: The Double Life of Lady Diana

veer-aam-aadmi.title: Maharakshak
veer-aam-aadmi.description: The microdrama unfolds in a realm under the tyrannical grip of Rana Lanka, an antagonist responsible for the massacre of Meera's family and seeking to control Uttamnagar. Meera, a hidden heiress with erased memories, is destined for vengeance, her divine lineage as Bhaskar Shakti beginning to awaken. Concurrently, Maharaj Siddharth of Uttamnagar fiercely resists Rana Lanka's demands for a forced marriage and territorial control, while navigating his forbidden love for Ujala. Ujala, Siddharth's beloved, becomes a primary target, her honor threatened and later, she is captured and used as a pawn to break Siddharth's spirit. As the conflict escalates, Siddharth is gravely wounded, igniting Meera's quest for justice and prompting Ujala to unleash her own divine-like powers. The antagonist, often referred to as Kasa, employs sorcerous attacks, mind control, and black magic, even betraying and absorbing his own brother for power. Ujala, discovering her true heritage as a divine heir, undergoes a spiritual quest guided by Devi Ma, regaining her memories and vowing revenge for Siddharth's curse. She unites loyal warriors, including Durga, who also discovers her divine lineage and protects Ujala. Meera, meanwhile, faces personal trials, including the corruption of her parents by Anish and the tragic death of her father, Pitaji, at the hands of Kalpesh. Burdened by her father's dying wish, Meera transforms into a formidable warrior, identified as Maharaj and the divine heir of Baas Devata. The intertwined destinies of Meera and Ujala converge as they confront the multifaceted antagonist. Ujala defiantly refuses Kasa's ultimatum for surrender, setting the stage for a final battle. Ultimately, Meera confronts and defeats the monstrous Darinde, ending his reign of terror and achieving justice for her family and the realm after eighteen years. The show depicts a relentless struggle for freedom, the reclamation of divine destinies, and the triumph over overwhelming tyranny.

my-dads-got-trillions-of-dollars-in-asse.title: My Dad's got trillions of dollars in assets
my-dads-got-trillions-of-dollars-in-asse.description: "డబ్బుతో ప్రేమను కొనలేరు" – ఇది ఒక వయస్సు తేడా ఉన్న ప్రేమకథ. డేవిడ్ మరియు డైసీ ఇద్దరి మధ్య ప్రేమ అనేక అడ్డంకులను దాటి ఎలా ఇద్దరు మనసులను దగ్గరగా తీసుకొచ్చింది అనే కోణంలో కథ తిరుగుతుంది.

exs-on-double-date.title: Ex's on Double Date
exs-on-double-date.description: When Megha unexpectedly runs into her ex, Raghav, on a double date with Bhavna and Kabir, buried emotions, jealous sparks, and old wounds collide turning one night into a dangerous game of love, betrayal, and unfinished business. Watch Now!

my-mother-is-a-royal-guard-1.title: My Mother is a Royal Guard
my-mother-is-a-royal-guard-1.description: My mother is a royal guard - Telugu

a-vow-of-joy-and-sorrow-5.title: A Vow of Joy and Sorrow
a-vow-of-joy-and-sorrow-5.description: Mr. Fernandez, a powerful magnate, is afflicted by a deadly "bhen-poison" and faces certain death by New Year's Eve unless he unites with a fated woman bearing a unique mark. His desperate search leads him to Geena, a compassionate nurse, whom he initially rejects despite her attempts to help, even as she is trapped by her uncle's greed into a forced marriage. Fernandez intervenes, eventually proposing a contract marriage to Geena, which she accepts as an alternative to another forced union. However, their union is revealed to be a perilous ritual: intimacy on New Year's Eve will cure Fernandez but could potentially cost Geena her life. Despite these life-threatening stakes, Fernandez maintains a transactional approach, while Geena grapples with the forced arrangement and endures abuse from his patriarchal family. An astrological "Blood Moon" prophecy further complicates their bond, revealing that only one of them can survive, forcing Fernandez to make a life-or-death choice. Sophia, a rival, manipulates the situation, revealing that intimacy with Jeena will lead to Jeena's death, and her demise is the only cure for Fernandez's mysterious ailment. Jeena, despite the fatal consequences, falls deeply in love with Fernandez, the man she was meant to save. Tragically, Jeena suffers irreparable cardiac damage and dies, with the shocking revelation that her family sold her body. Fernandez then discovers he has a daughter he never knew existed. Seven years later, Fernandez is haunted by the absence of his wife, Gina, and their unseen daughter. A young girl, Achu/Ammu, desperately searches for her father to save her critically ill mother, Sheethal Jeena/Gina, who is revealed to be Fernandez's long-lost wife, having awakened from a seven-year coma, blind and critically ill. Fernandez initially denies any connection, accusing Achu of theft and impersonation, even resorting to violence, but a shocking voice recognition and haunting doubt reveal their deeply intertwined past. His survival, and Gina's cure, hinges on forgiving Fernandez, whose past secrets are crucial, requiring a deadly sacrifice from him on a Blood Moon night. To secure entry into a high-stakes New Year's Eve competition for Gina's eye treatment, Fernandez dramatically steps in as Ammu's "father," initiating a reluctant deception that blurs with unexpected emotions. A shocking revelation unveils that Fernandez, in a desperate attempt to cure his rare disease, tragically bound Geena to the same fate through a deceptive "cure," with an informant declaring only one can survive. Geena, having miraculously regained her sight, confronts Fernandez, refusing to forgive him for this profound past betrayal, despite their complex emotional attachment. The narrative culminates in a New Year's Eve celebration shattered by the news of young Jeena's critical condition, forcing Fernandez to undertake a perilous, life-threatening medical intervention to save her, driven by love and profound remorse, highlighting the devastating consequences of his mistakes and the ultimate fight for family.

secret-boss-mera-baap.title: Baap Beta Aur Billion
secret-boss-mera-baap.description: A son discovers his simple father is secretly a powerful business tycoon controlling everything from the shadows. As truth unfolds, love, loyalty, and betrayal clash in a high-stakes family drama.

say-you-remember-say-you-love-4.title: Say You Remember, Say You Love
say-you-remember-say-you-love-4.description: ఆమె కుటుంబం దివాళా తిన్న తరువాత, ఎలిజబెత్ తన మొదటి ప్రేమ అయిన జేసన్‌ను మళ్లీ కలిసింది. అతను అప్పటికే ప్రపంచ ప్రఖ్యాతి గాంచిన ఫుట్‌బాల్ స్టార్ అయ్యాడు. ఒకప్పుడు అతను కలిగించిన నొప్పిని ఆమె ఎప్పటికీ మర్చిపోలేకపోయినా, అతని మహత్తులో ఆమె ఆకర్షితురాలై పోయింది.

raaz-wale-darwaze.title: Raaz Wale Darwaze
raaz-wale-darwaze.description: Ishan Verma returns to his wealthy family's haveli, compelled by a mysterious force and suspicions about their fortune, which are intensified by his ailing biological mother's cryptic hints about a long-buried secret before her death. His fiancée, Leela, faces scrutiny from his powerful father, Papa, who demands sacrifices for the family's legacy, before she mysteriously vanishes. Ishan frantically searches for Leela, confronting manipulative family members and hiring an investigator, uncovering initial clues linking her disappearance to his family's shadowy, illicit dealings and a mysterious locked door. He realizes his authoritarian father is orchestrating abductions and holding his long-lost mother, Laila, captive, while also concealing a hidden daughter. Ishan discovers his family's immense wealth and power stem from a unique, blood-based substance called "Rakth-phool" or "Rakth Pushp," which can cure illnesses but also makes his family a target for ruthless groups. He learns that Leela, whom he loves, has been manipulating him to steal this formula, which is tied to the blood of Verma daughters-in-law, to save herself and a child from a curse. Ishan faces profound moral dilemmas as he navigates betrayals, including from Esha, who is tasked with transforming him for an unknown purpose, and violent confrontations with his father and other antagonists seeking the formula. Family members, like Rukmani, make sacrifices to protect the sacred legacy from falling into the wrong hands. Ultimately, Ishan is left tortured and burdened with this dangerous gift and a chilling condition, continuing his perilous journey to expose the full truth of his fragmented past and protect his family's perilous legacy.

ruthless-comeback-of-the-reborn-heiress-.title: Ruthless Comeback of the Reborn Heiress
ruthless-comeback-of-the-reborn-heiress-.description: Ruthless Comeback of the Reborn Heiress

boss-ya-bhediya-2.title: Boss Ya Bhediya
boss-ya-bhediya-2.description: মুম্বইয়ে একজন সাহসী তরুণী আইনজীবী একটি অতিপ্রাকৃতিক হামলার তদন্ত করাকালীন, অজান্তেই ক্ষমতাধর এক ওয়্যারউলফ্-এর সঙ্গে বিবাহবন্ধনে আবদ্ধ হয়ে যায়। ভালোবাসার মায়াজালে পড়ে তিনি যখন চূড়ান্ত বিপদের সম্মুখীন হতে যান, তখন তার সামনে দাঁড়ায় একটি বড় সিদ্ধান্ত। এখন তিনি সংহতির পথে হাঁটবেন, নাকি সেই অদৃশ্য এবং রহস্যময় জগতকে আলিঙ্গন করবেন?

mother-of-two-spoiled-by-ceo.title: Pati Patni aur Woh
mother-of-two-spoiled-by-ceo.description: A strong mother steps into the ruthless corporate world to protect her sons, who have grown into spoiled CEOs. Between power, betrayal, and family ties, she must teach them the true meaning of love and responsibility.

tales-from-the-no-mans-land.title: Tales From The No-Man's Land
tales-from-the-no-mans-land.description:
ఒక మామ, మేనల్లుడు ట్రక్కు డ్రైవ్ చేస్తూ ఉంటారు. మార్గంలో ఇద్దరు అమ్మాయిలు లిఫ్ట్ అడుగుతారు.
మామ – ఒక అమ్మాయిని వేదించాలనుకుంటాడు... మేనల్లుడు – ఆమెను రక్షించాలనుకుంటాడు.
కానీ భయపడుతూ నటించిన ఆ అమ్మాయి ఎవరు? ఆమె వాస్తవంగా ఎవరితో వచ్చింది?
వెళ్లే దారి, ఆ ట్రక్కు, ఆ అమ్మాయి... అన్నిటికీ వెనుక ఒక గాఢమైన రహస్యముంది!

pyar-aur-paisa.title: Love After Custody
pyar-aur-paisa.description: When warehouse worker Meera Sachdev crosses paths with billionaire heir Krish Malhotra, a night of fate binds them together forever. Torn between love and money, they must fight past secrets, family betrayals, and society’s judgment to protect their unborn child and discover what truly matters.

a-lament-for-troubled-times.title: A Lament For Troubled Times
a-lament-for-troubled-times.description:
యుద్ధం మరియు రాజకీయాల మధ్య తారుమారు అయిన రాజ్యంలో, ఒక యువ సేనాధిపతికి బలవంతంగా పెళ్లి జరుగుతుంది, కానీ అతడు తన కోల్పోయిన ప్రేమను రహస్యంగా వెతుకుతూనే ఉంటాడు.
ద్రోహాలు, దాగిన గుర్తింపులు, భావోద్వేగ గాయాలతో అతడి ప్రపంచం వ్యక్తిగత నష్టంతో పాటు రాజకీయ పరాజయంతో కూలిపోతుంది.

baby-aur-blunder.title: Agni aur Amrit
baby-aur-blunder.description: it is a mystical drama that blends spirituality, love, and revenge. The story follows Arjun, a rough but kind-hearted man, and Suhani, the heiress of the powerful Mehra family, whose lives intertwine after a mysterious night.

my-mother-is-a-royal-guard.title: My mother is a royal guard
my-mother-is-a-royal-guard.description: A strict mother, who trains her daughter while working for powerful firms, pushes her child to the brink — but when danger strikes, she defies her ruthless employers to protect the daughter she once seemed so harsh on. An intense audio story of tough love, betrayal, and a mother’s ultimate sacrifice.

billionaire-beta-waiter-bahu.title: Billionaire Beta Waiter Bahu
billionaire-beta-waiter-bahu.description: The microdrama begins with young Aadya's desperate quest to find her estranged, wealthy father, Raj, while her mother, Niharika, endures severe financial hardship and defiantly rejects immoral offers. The narrative quickly reveals Raj as Aadya's father, a truth Niharika had concealed for six years, just as Niharika is coerced into a forced marriage by her manipulative relatives. Raj races against time to confirm his paternity and rescue Niharika, ultimately protecting her, confessing his love, and proposing marriage, though Niharika remains hesitant due to past wounds. Their subsequent marriage, orchestrated by Dadi, is immediately fraught with Niharika's struggles with past trauma and her recoiling from Raj's attempts at closeness. She faces public humiliation and physical assault when a rival exposes her alleged claim as Raj's wife, leading to her father's intervention. The plot thickens with Raj's determined efforts to protect Niharika amidst escalating family drama, culminating in her brutal kidnapping by her own brother, Vidhaan, and manipulative aunt, Kaamini Chachi, who sought to disinherit her and harm her infant daughter. Niharika returns with vengeance, confronting her betrayers and forcing a deadly ultimatum to reclaim her rightful inheritance. A new antagonist emerges in Shivani, an orphan raised in Raj's family, who fiercely claims Raj as her own and poisons his ailing mother, falsely accusing Niharika. Raj, unwavering in his trust, uncovers surveillance footage proving Shivani's guilt, leading to her arrest. The climax unfolds with Shivani's vengeful kidnapping of Aadya, forcing Raj into an impossible choice between his child and his wife, and resulting in Niharika sustaining a bullet wound while protecting Aadya. This harrowing event reveals Aadya's "illegitimate" parentage as the daughter of Raj and the mysterious Vanshika. The story concludes with matriarch Mansi falling into a "pseudo coma" after confronting her son about Vanshika, and Vanshika herself returning home, seeking forgiveness and reconciliation, hinting at mending fractured family ties amidst unresolved conflicts and deep-seated secrets.

the-fate-is-you.title: THE FATE IS YOU
the-fate-is-you.description: తన ప్రాణాలు ప్రమాదంలో ఉన్నప్పుడు ఓ అన్యుడి ద్వారా రక్షించబడిన వ్యక్తి, ఆ రహస్య సహాయకుడిని కనుగొని కృతజ్ఞత తెలపాలని పట్టుదలతో సాగిపోతాడు. ఇదే సమయంలో, మరోవైపు ఓ కుటుంబంలో తీవ్ర ఉద్రిక్తత నెలకొంటుంది—అక్కడ ఒక యువకుడు/యువతి, పెద్దల ఆదేశాలను తప్పకుండా పాటించాలని, లేకపోతే శిక్ష పడుతారని బెదిరింపులకు లోనవుతాడు. ఈ కథలో రహస్యత, భావోద్వేగం, కుటుంబ అస్తవ్యస్తత కలిసి మిళితమవుతాయి. కథ మొత్తం కృతజ్ఞత, ఎవరో ముఖ్యమైన వ్యక్తిని వెతకడం, మరియు కుటుంబ విభేదాల మధ్య నడుస్తూ సస్పెన్స్‌ని, ఎమోషన్‌ని సమపాళ్లలో నడిపిస్తుంది.

finding-billioanire-daddy.title: Finding Billioanire Daddy
finding-billioanire-daddy.description: The microdrama centers on Priya, an independent single mother, and her tumultuous journey through family secrets, corporate intrigue, and a relentless fight for her children and autonomy. Initially, her children, Tara and Chintu, attempt to reunite her with CEO Gautam Singhania, unaware of the complex history and corporate machinations at play. Gautam is reluctantly engaged to heiress Pooja, who secretly orchestrates a forced marriage for Priya as part of a larger corporate deal, while Priya grapples with her past as an unmarried mother disowned by her family. A scandalous one-night stand between Gautam and Priya comes to light, threatening Gautam's engagement and Pooja's family honor, further complicated by Pooja's abortion and a paternity mystery. Gautam eventually enters a marriage of convenience with Pooja, only to be confronted by Priya, hinting at unresolved entanglements. Priya dramatically returns as a wronged heiress, crashing Pooja's engagement to Gautam and revealing a hidden agenda to reclaim her late father's corporate empire. She seeks retribution against Gautam and his family, confirming Gautam's paternity of her son, Dhruv, and shattering Gautam and Pooja's engagement. Now a powerful corporate heiress, Priya is thrust into a high-stakes custody battle with Gautam over Dhruv, fiercely guarding the secret of her other child, Tara, from him. She defiantly rejects Gautam's attempts to buy her off, threatening to expose his past, while battling corporate challenges and plots from Gautam's mother and son. The narrative intensifies when Gautam discovers he is the biological father of both twins, Tara and Dhruv, whose existence Priya had concealed for five years. This revelation ignites a complex family drama, with Gautam asserting his paternal rights and an elder urging reconciliation for the children's sake, despite Priya's anger over his past neglect. However, their efforts are complicated by a new, deadly vendetta against Priya by a ruthless older woman and her jealous daughter, who accuse Priya of stealing their father's love and property. The conflict escalates dramatically as Pooja, now an obsessive ex-lover, kidnaps Priya and blackmails Gautam into a forced marriage. Gautam publicly rejects Pooja, declaring his love for Priya, which ignites Pooja's vengeful fury. Priya is abducted by a mysterious antagonist, leading to a violent confrontation and a tragic shootout. Amidst the chaos, Pratap heroically saves Priya, confessing his love and proposing marriage, which she accepts, solidifying a new family unit with her child already present, bringing a semblance of peace after years of turmoil and danger.

this-medical-saint-is-not-to-be-provoked.title: This Medical Saint is Not to Be Provoked
this-medical-saint-is-not-to-be-provoked.description:
A gifted healer with a magical box that cures the sick becomes a legend among the helpless. But when his ambitious junior betrays him to steal the power for himself, the miracle turns into a curse.

Watch the gripping tale of magic, betrayal, and the price of playing god, Now!

miss-gu-dont-let-me-go.title: Miss Grace don't let me go
miss-gu-dont-let-me-go.description: Grace, a hardworking woman, is diagnosed with terminal cancer, prompting her to seek resignation from a ruthless employer who denies her request. She bravely exposes her corrupt manager and rejects a predatory client, before revealing her terminal illness and a forced, financially motivated marriage to her demanding family. Grace discovers her unknown husband is Pramod, a wealthy heir whose powerful family insists she honor their contract marriage. Their fabricated union is publicly exposed by Sharmi, who claims to be Pramod's rightful wife, while Suriya also enters an arranged marriage with Pramod, feeling her life is inauthentic. Simultaneously, Grace is revealed as a new corporate heiress, swiftly asserting her power by humiliating her former manager, who is later exposed as an embezzler. She becomes central to a powerful man's revenge plot against Sarmiee, who has usurped his deceased sister's identity, hinting at Grace's true heir status. A terminally ill Grace dramatically declares herself CEO Lee's wife, a revelation that bewilders him but sparks a connection. This bond is immediately challenged by Shermy, an ambitious heiress who publicly claims Lee, only to be exposed as an imposter switched at birth with Grace, making Grace the true heiress. Grace faces public humiliation and accusations of fraud from the disinherited Shermy, strategically unveiling a video to expose Shermy's deception. Amidst these revelations, Grace confronts her manipulative estranged husband, who admits to altering her medication, and is brutally abducted and interrogated by vengeful brothers seeking retribution. Her protective husband, Partha, unleashes a fierce quest for revenge against an antagonist who attacked Grace. Grace, believing she has a terminal illness, receives a marriage proposal from Arjun, only for a dramatic revelation to shatter her misconception and offer a new beginning, suggesting her illness may not be terminal after all. The show explores Grace's fight for survival, identity, and love amidst corporate ruthlessness, family secrets, and a complex web of betrayals and alliances.

the-billionaire-trap.title: The Billionaire Trap
the-billionaire-trap.description: A fearless idli seller with a hidden empire. A ruthless betrayal that ignites a high-stakes game of power, love, and revenge. In this dramatic saga, Dia Singhania returns to claim what’s hers—and no one will see it coming. Watch Now !

ek-thi-villain-3.title: The Villain
ek-thi-villain-3.description: "ISO scientist Anjali worships the dark demon and sacrifices children, but to win her 'soul-mate' Vikram Sharma during the Mars mission, she goes to the extent of bloodshed, accusations, and black magic. What will happen when another scientist, Priya, comes in the way of Anjali and Vikram?"

the-bracelet-girl.title: The Bracelet Girl
the-bracelet-girl.description: Naina Verma, an iconic model, endures relentless emotional abuse from her family, who shame her for her natural appearance and darker complexion, constantly comparing her to her supermodel sister, Ria. Despite public acclaim, Naina is treated as a burden and faces constant criticism. A potential modeling interview, meant to be an escape, turns into further humiliation when a security guard dismisses her and a ruthless CEO, Veer, her former classmate, accuses her of fraud and mocks her past appearance. Desperate for change and fueled by a desire for revenge against superficial beauty standards, Naina (also known as Yati/Seema) receives a magical bracelet that reveals her hidden power. With the aid of a friend, she transforms into the captivating and ambitious persona of Alia/Aaliya, embarking on a dangerous mission. As Alia, she infiltrates the corporate world, quickly securing a position and captivating CEO Dax, while also sparking a fated, supernatural connection with Veer. Veer, initially rejecting her, now frantically pursues her, offering a job and apologizing for past incidents, though Naina remains distrustful. Her new identity brings internal conflict, public scrutiny, and professional ostracization from rivals like Kiara and Daksh, who accuse her of job theft and prejudice. Alia becomes instrumental in Veer's company's success, even saving a critical presentation with an inclusive "asli beauty" pitch. However, a charming man pursues her, sensing her hidden identity and a looming time-sensitive secret. Alia's carefully constructed new identity begins to unravel, leading to public shaming and the dramatic revelation that she is, in fact, Naina. Accused of scandalous behavior and drugged, Naina fights to clear her name, publicly defying her mentor Daksh, accusing him of drugging her, and presenting digital evidence of his actions. Learning the profound truth of Naina's suffering and her use of the mystical artifact for transformation, Veer severs ties with his childhood friend Daksh and fires him, along with complicit employee Kiara, for betrayal and defamation. Naina ultimately sheds her alter ego, finding acceptance and love with Veer, who sees beyond her appearance. Veer publicly declares his love, affirms her authentic identity, and challenges societal beauty standards, celebrating unconditional love and authentic beauty.

tales-from-the-no-mans-land-1.title: Tales from the No Man's Land
tales-from-the-no-mans-land-1.description: The series begins with Chander traveling with his cynical Uncle Chen, who preys on vulnerable female travelers, trapping young women like Tan Sumi and Sume on an isolated, lawless island. Chander grapples with a profound moral dilemma, witnessing his uncle's sinister methods firsthand and eventually confronting him in a violent struggle. Concurrently, a determined woman, later identified as Sumi, embarks on a perilous journey to find her long-lost sister, Suhaan, whose disappearance is soon linked to Uncle Chen's human trafficking operation. Sumi is forced into a contract marriage by her tyrannical father-in-law, Uncle Chen, and, along with Jia Chen, becomes a captive, attempting perilous escapes from his ruthless control. Uncle Chen enforces a brutal "obey or die" rule on the island, coercing subordinates and exploiting vulnerable individuals within his expanding criminal network. The narrative reveals Sumi as a police officer, driven by a relentless quest for vengeance against Kalaithenkage and Uncle Chen for her sister's brutal murder. She navigates dangerous games, using her wit to outsmart adversaries and protect allies like Linchwan, who becomes entangled in her complex plans. Sumi's personal vendetta involves high-stakes confrontations and a strategic pursuit of justice against the formidable Uncle Chen. Amidst this, Linchwan faces profound family tragedy, while Sumi makes an unexpected and assertive marriage proposal, hinting at a future where duty and personal justice intertwine. The overarching stakes involve the fight against a pervasive human trafficking ring, the desperate search for missing loved ones, and the personal cost of defying a powerful, exploitative force.

the-lost-heir-rises-2.title: The Lost Heir Rises
the-lost-heir-rises-2.description: The microdrama centers on Maya, a devoted woman struggling financially to find an expensive miracle cure for her ailing partner, Raj. While Maya faces severe poverty and pressure for an arranged marriage with the wealthy Rudra Pratap, a powerful CEO, Shakuntala Vardhan, searches for her missing heir, Rajkumar, offering a massive reward. Raj awakens from a three-year coma, determined to protect Maya and his family and seek revenge against those who wronged them, particularly Rudra and the ruthless businessman Pankaj, who attempts to exploit Raj and buy Maya's affection. The narrative intensifies as Maya is held captive by Rudran, an enforcer, leading to violent confrontations. Raj's true identity is dramatically revealed as Rajkumar Vardhan, CEO of Vardhan International and a hidden royal heir, publicly disgracing Pankaj and his father. Rajkumar then acts as a benefactor, clearing debts and promising a positive future for Maya, while multiple revenge plots unfold among the powerful figures. Rudra brutally assaults Maya, igniting a fierce battle for justice led by Raj and Pratap, and Vikram awakens from a coma, vowing retribution for insults to himself and Maya. Raj's royal lineage as the son of Maharaja Arjun Vardhan is revealed, unleashing his wrath when his family is disrespected. A lavish engagement is arranged between Raj and Maya, born out of gratitude for her care, yet it is constantly disrupted by hostile relatives and former associates. Rajkumar, initially perceived as a "beggar" and accused of fraud, fiercely defends Maya and her brother against classist family members and vengeful figures like Reshma, who publicly humiliate them and question his wealth. The escalating conflict exposes accusations that Rajkumar is an imposter controlling an empire while the true owner lies comatose. Raj confronts his manipulative aunt and uncle, rejecting their betrayals and asserting his power and wealth to protect Maya's family. He solidifies his position by elevating Rakesh within his corporation and publicly evicting his greedy uncle. The show culminates with a prominent family figure designating Raj as the successor to a family lineage, cementing his legacy and love amidst high-stakes corporate and familial battles, though hints of deeper secrets and ongoing power struggles remain.

love-by-chance-2.title: Double Life of a Secret Billionaire
love-by-chance-2.description: Double Life of a Secret Billionaire is the passionate story of Shruti, a young woman forced into a marriage of compromise, and Yash Shetty, a mysterious man with a dark past. What begins as a deal soon turns into a journey of secrets, betrayal, and unexpected love, where fate keeps testing whether Shruti and Yash are bound by chance or destined forever. Watch Now!

after-dumping-that-scumbag-my-three-elde.title: MY THREE ELDER BROTHERS SPOIL ME LIKE CRAZY
after-dumping-that-scumbag-my-three-elde.description: After walking away from a toxic relationship, she swore she'd never depend on anyone again. But her three over-the-top elder brothers step in, showering her with outrageous love and protection. Between chaos, comfort, and sibling drama, healing has never been this entertaining.

naagin-ka-badla.title: Naagin Ka Badla
naagin-ka-badla.description: Ek gareeb phool bechne wali se vishwasghaat karke usse zinda dafan kar diya jata hai aur sath hi uske premi ko maar diya jaata hai. Punarjanam lekar Naagin bankar woh Thakur parivaar se apne prem aur apmaan ka badla lene lautti hai.

losing-my-virginity-5.title: Losing My Virginity
losing-my-virginity-5.description: For just one night, the fiery Anusha — daughter of a housemaid — forces the innocent Rashmi to impersonate her in a scheme to deceive billionaire Aditya. But that night spirals into a dangerous illusion — of deceit, desire, and mistaken identities. Because in that world, falling in love... could be fatal!

became-the-ex-wifes-white-moonlight-afte.title: Became the Ex-Wife's White Moonlight After My Death
became-the-ex-wifes-white-moonlight-afte.description: She begged for love. He stayed too busy to listen. Now, with Diana gone and her truth revealed, Benjamin is left shattered, haunted by memories of the woman he took for granted. Become The Ex-wife's White Moonlight After My Death is a story of heartbreak that arrives only after silence. Watch Now !

pyaar-bhari-dushmani.title: Pyar Bhari Dushmani
pyaar-bhari-dushmani.description: Radhika, ek girti hui zindagi se ladti hai aur apna ghar wapas paane ke liye ek khatarnaak deal karti hai. Uski takraar Samrat, ek arrogant billionaire se hoti hai, jahan nafrat aur pyaar ke beech ek dangerous khel shuru ho jaata hai

fleeing-husband-please-love-me-all-over-.title: Fleeing Husband Please Love Me All Over Again
fleeing-husband-please-love-me-all-over-.description: After deciding to divorce from the business tycoon Alexis due to her inability to tolerate their contractual marriage, the wealthy heiress Vylina fell into the lowest point of her life. Yet, after enduring the heavy blows of life's darkest moments, she ultimately achieved abundant success in both her career and love life.

rented-a-rich-boyfriend.title: Rented a Rich Boyfriend
rented-a-rich-boyfriend.description: Rented a Rich Boyfriend is a dramatic romance filled with betrayal, secrets, and unexpected twists. Aditya, a simple middle-class man, is humiliated and abandoned by his fiancée Nandita when she chooses money and power over love. But fate ties him to Isha Raheja, a fierce billionaire heiress, sparking a fake marriage deal that slowly unravels shocking truths, hidden identities, and a love story no one saw coming.

this-medical-saint-is-not-to-be-provoked.title: This Medical Saint is Not to Be Provoked
this-medical-saint-is-not-to-be-provoked.description:
একজন অলৌকিক ক্ষমতাসম্পন্ন চিকিৎসক, একটি রহস্যময় বাক্স—যেখানে বন্দী পৃথিবীর সমস্ত ব্যাধি।
একটা মিথ্যে অপবাদে হারিয়ে গেল  বিশ্বাস, চুরি হল সেই শক্তি যা বাঁচাতে পারত হাজারো প্রাণ।
প্রেম, প্রতারণা আর মৃত্যুর ছায়ায় দাঁড়িয়ে, অভিযুক্ত রায়ান কি ফিরিয়ে আনতে পারবে নিজের সম্মান , সে কি পারবে মৃত্যুর মুখ থেকে রক্ষা করতে বেঈমান নগর বাসী দের জীবন ? নাকি ধ্বংস হবে সবকিছু?

out-of-mercy.title: CEO's Forbidden Love
out-of-mercy.description: A young girl battles betrayal, cruelty, and the dark secrets of her family while chasing her dreams of independence. Out of Mercy is a gripping tale of survival, resilience, and the fight for identity. Watch Now !

first-light-of-love-5.title: First Light Of Love
first-light-of-love-5.description: সম্পর্কের সুন্দর একটি গল্প, যেখানে অপ্রত্যাশিত একটা সম্পর্ক কঠিন সময়ে, ভালোবাসার মায়ায় খুবই পরিচিত হয়ে ওঠে। সেই সম্পর্ক কীভাবে প্রতিটা মানুষের জীবন বদলে দিতে পারে, তা পরতে-পরতে উপভোগ করার মতো।

dont-come-im-fine-2.title: Don't Come, I'm Fine
dont-come-im-fine-2.description: A man and a woman start loving each other, and they have a son. But after some time, the man starts doubting whether the child is actually his. Even though they had a very loving relationship, this doubt creates distance between them. The real mystery of the story is why this doubt arose and how the truth eventually came out.

crypto-king.title: Bitcoin Billionaire
crypto-king.description: Yash Narayan's life collapses after his mother's death, leading to a bitter divorce from Shree, a custody battle for Saisha, and betrayal by his friend Kumar. After public humiliation and losing everything, Yash attempts suicide but miraculously awakens ten years in the past, viewing this as a divine second chance to rewrite his destiny. In this new timeline, he immediately faces challenges, including securing a perilous loan from Dillu Bhai by mortgaging his family home to invest in cryptocurrency, all while his mother is diagnosed with aggressive Stage 4 cancer. His high-stakes gamble pays off, clearing his family's debts, and he aligns with visionary tech CEO Viren Desai to transform the digital world. However, his old rival Kumar violently reappears, attempting to humiliate Yash, only to be thwarted by Yash's burgeoning romance with Sonia. Now a charismatic entrepreneur with newfound wealth, Yash secretly harbors a deep-seated vendetta against Kumar, who is disowned by his powerful father and plots a deceptive comeback. Yash's ambitious ventures draw suspicion from old friends and he is targeted by a manipulative former friend, Shri, and a vengeful CEO, Sagar, who recognizes Yash's schemes as notorious past scams. Despite making bold acquisitions, Yash's arrogance leads to a catastrophic market collapse, devastating magnate Viren and his son Ansh. A powerful, shadowy figure then orchestrates the systematic destruction of Yash's digital empire through a devastating cyberattack, costing his company 700 crores and forcing him to seek help from expert Viraj. Amidst this, Yash embarks on a perilous solo mission to rescue Shri from a ruthless blackmailer, blending digital espionage with a desperate personal quest. He confronts and kills an antagonist who threatened his career and harmed Shri, ensuring her safety. Subsequently, Yash faces a profound choice between his empire and Sonia, the "love of his life," whom he cannot bear to lose again. Jia, instrumental in Yash's success and with whom he shares a past, makes a heartbreaking sacrifice, withdrawing from their relationship to secure Yash's future with Sonia. The series concludes with an enigmatic man, recently released from prison after a decade for kidnapping and extortion, resurfacing to declare intense love for a wary woman, hinting at a dark, fated past and raising questions about his true intentions, leaving Yash's ultimate fate and the full implications of his past and present choices unresolved.

kiss-and-switch-the-cursed-vampire-4.title: Kiss and Switch The Cursed Vampire
kiss-and-switch-the-cursed-vampire-4.description: A powerful vampire king has been struck by a mysterious curse. His only hope to be freed from this dark curse lies in a chance encounter with an innocent human maiden whom he meets unexpectedly. Will the forbidden love that grows between them break the ancient curse and grant freedom to the vampire king? Or will their dangerous bond push them both to the brink of destruction?

second-innings-life-ki.title: Second Innings Life Ki
second-innings-life-ki.description: A widow’s sacrifice, a businessman’s guarded heart, and a daughter’s determination bring two strangers together in life’s second innings. Will love blossom from a contract marriage? Discover a journey of emotions, resilience, and unexpected connections. Watch Now !

mistaken-millionaire-husband-4.title: Mistaken Millionaire Husband
mistaken-millionaire-husband-4.description: Ms. Sriram na boyfriend Deepak kodsida dhokakkeinta kuda, Rohit Muralitharan na preeti nijavagittu. Ee chanda love story nodi enjoy maadi!

jack-of-all-cons-3.title: Jack of all Cons
jack-of-all-cons-3.description: A shadowy gambler enters the city’s deadliest casino—but he’s not here to play, he’s here to settle scores. In a world where every hand deals betrayal and every bluff could be your last, the stakes are brutally personal. Jack Of All Cons is a pulse-pounding ride through crime, vengeance, and the ultimate con. Watch now!

future-se-aaya-kaun.title: Future Se Aaya Kaun
future-se-aaya-kaun.description: The microdrama unfolds a complex narrative of revenge, corporate intrigue, and time-travel, centered on preventing a predetermined tragic future. It begins with Savi, a time-traveling future version of Lata, warning her mother, Shivranjani, to divorce her husband and flee to prevent their predetermined deaths. Simultaneously, Karan, a manipulative philanderer and corporate fraudster, becomes the target of multiple women's retribution. His wife, Radhika, discovers his decade-long infidelity and meticulously plots his strategic downfall, enlisting Charu to seduce him as part of an elaborate scheme. Radhika, initially vulnerable, transforms into a formidable force, systematically dismantling Karan's life and reclaiming her stolen company and assets. A cunning manipulator named Simran, later revealed to be Future Lata, orchestrates many events from behind the scenes. Simran guides Radhika through high-stakes property deals and corporate takeovers, subtly reinforcing Karan's ego while ensuring his spectacular ruin. Karan's schemes, including siphoning company funds and orchestrating a destructive fire, are exposed as his empire collapses. He faces public humiliation, financial devastation, and is ultimately exposed as a con artist and money launderer by Charu, whose "intense romance" with him was a calculated ruse. As Karan's threats escalate, holding young Lata captive and questioning her paternity, Future Lata (as Simran) explicitly reveals her time-traveling identity and mission to save Radhika and her past self, Lata. The combined efforts of Radhika and Simran (Future Lata) ensure Karan's complete comeuppance, avert the tragic destiny, and secure a second chance for the family. The stakes involve reclaiming justice, preventing predetermined deaths, and rewriting a family's tragic past.

cold-revenge-4.title: Cold Revenge
cold-revenge-4.description:
Once a wealthy young man, he returns to college—not as a victim, but as a storm. Betrayed by childhood love, destroyed by those he trusted, and left for dead, he rises again with a new purpose.
This is a tale of revenge, redemption, and reclaiming identity—where every step forward burns with buried pain.

riyasat-ka-raaz.title: Riyasat ka raaz
riyasat-ka-raaz.description: A gripping tale of betrayal, rebirth, and rivalry where two sisters fight for power, love, and legacy. Secrets from a past life resurface, sparking a dangerous battle for identity and control in the glamorous yet cutthroat world of fame and fortune.

the-girl-who-chases-the-wind.title: The Girl Who Chases the Wind
the-girl-who-chases-the-wind.description: A mysterious trend of female cyclists and wealthy young men draws Joseph into a captivating yet sinister world, where "The Cycling Woman" becomes the target of a meticulously planned deception orchestrated by "The Organizer." This scheme culminates in a terrifying "Blind Box" game, stripping women of agency and treating them as prizes. Joseph, initially a reluctant participant, eventually becomes a compassionate supporter of The Cycling Woman, unknowingly involved in a larger plot connected to her bedridden sister's accident. However, this seemingly isolated incident is part of a vast criminal enterprise led by a ruthless gang leader also named Joseph, who extorts, inflicts violence, and maintains tyrannical control. The Cycling Woman, later identified as Radha and Stella, discovers a direct link between her sister's tragic death and her captors, igniting a burning quest for vengeance. She and her romantic partner, Siddhu, defy the tyrannical Joseph, embarking on a desperate escape that leads them into the clutches of an organ trafficker, revealing a wider criminal network. Stella becomes a central figure in a high-stakes battle for a crucial video, which holds incriminating evidence against the crime boss and his treacherous associates. She endures brutal assaults and betrayals, even from those she once trusted, and is forced to participate in dangerous contests with humiliating conditions to protect this vital recording. Charles, a rival to the criminal Joseph, attempts to aid her in exposing the syndicate's illicit activities. Ultimately, Stella, revealed as Sonia's sibling, undergoes intensive training, transforming into a formidable avenger. She enlists an ally, embarking on a relentless journey of retribution to dismantle the corrupt system and secure justice for her sister's murder, confronting the powerful figures who orchestrated their suffering. The series chronicles her evolution from a targeted victim to a determined warrior fighting for dignity, survival, and profound justice.

mistaken-millionaire-husband-3.title: Mistaken Millionaire Husband
mistaken-millionaire-husband-3.description: Anamika Sriram, an estranged heiress, finds her life upended when her struggling boyfriend Deepak receives a financial windfall from her wealthy family, prompting her re-entry into her opulent world. Her relationship with Deepak dramatically ends as he chooses Sarah, leaving Anamika publicly humiliated and vowing revenge. Simultaneously, Anamika becomes entangled with arrogant CEO Rohit Muralidharan, initially rejecting his transactional contract marriage proposal but later engaging in a charade as his fiancée, unaware of his true identity as a wealthy scion. Deepak returns as a powerful CEO, leading to confrontations, while Rohit's deceptive facade crumbles, leaving Anamika caught between the two influential men. Anamika eventually discovers Rohit's true identity, transforming her status and thrusting her into a world of corporate intrigue and social scrutiny.
