His formidable mother, Mrs. Oberoi, swiftly confirms Ayan's identity and enforces his pre-arranged marriage to Shanaya, a union born from a past, high-stakes bet. Ayan accuses Ira of manipulating his love and fortune, leading to her banishment and the termination of her father. He unleashes devastating revenge, destroying Ira and her associate's music careers, before finally embracing Shanaya, fulfilling a parental preference and an 18-year anticipation. The narrative explores themes of betrayal, class conflict, and the pursuit of justice across lifetimes.

tu-mera-saiyaara.title: Tu Mera Saiyaara
tu-mera-saiyaara.description: Superstar singer Raj Mathur ka life tab badal jaata hai jab uski girlfriend Julie usse dhoka deti hai, aur heartbroken hoke woh red-light area mein Rani se milta hai - ek prostitute jisme singing ka hidden talent hai.  Contract marriage se shuru hoke real love tak ka ye journey hai, lekin jab Raj ki jealous billionaire music producer Shanaya ko pata chalta hai, toh woh Rani ko kidnap karke torture karti hai - kya Raj apni pregnant wife Rani ko bacha payega aur Shanaya se badla le payega?

mayakkamenna.title: Mayakkamenna
mayakkamenna.description: On our third wedding anniversary, my husband humiliated me and threw me away for his mistress. They thought I was powerless but they didn’t know I’m the daughter of the richest man in the country. His entire fortune came from me. That same day, fate led me to a powerful billionaire who changed everything. Now, I have wealth, influence, and a new identity. Let the tables turn.

bas-ek-raat.title: One Last Chance
bas-ek-raat.description:
One Last Chance is a gripping tale of love, choices, and the price of regret. A woman walks away from true love, only to realize later what she lost - as the man she left behind rebuilds his life in a deeply loving and affluent relationship. Passion, heartbreak, and high-stakes emotions collide in this drama that will keep you hooked at every turn.

An emotional rollercoaster and one of the most interesting watches of the year.

watan-ka-sauda.title: Forgotten Hero
watan-ka-sauda.description: India’s top scientist, considered a national asset, comes home after years of service only to be betrayed by his own wife and son. As family bonds shatter and power games unfold, greed threatens to turn even the nation into a watan ka sauda. Forgotten Hero serves high drama, betrayal, and ambition - making it one of the most entertaining and unmissable watches of the year.

return-of-the-doctor-2.title: Return of the Doctor
return-of-the-doctor-2.description: ఇది డాక్టర్ శ్రేయ కథ. ఆమె తన సర్వస్వం కోల్పోయింది, కానీ భలంగా తిరిగి నిలబడింది. గతం వెంటాడుతున్నప్పుడు – ఆమె ప్రతీకారానికి పయనిస్తుందా? లేక మన్నింపునే తన మార్గంగా ఎంచుకుంటుందా?  ప్రతి నిమిషం ఉత్కంఠగా మారే ఈ డ్రామాను మిస్ అవ్వకండి. ఇప్పుడే చూడండి!

late-love-5.title: LATE LOVE
late-love-5.description: After her daughter dies in a tragic school collapse, a woman discovers her husband chose to save another child — the daughter of his first love. Betrayed and grieving, she files for divorce and begins her calculated descent into revenge.

billionaires-talaaq.title: Ultimate Divorce
billionaires-talaaq.description: Billionaire’s Tallaq is a gripping romance-drama of mistaken identities, betrayal, and second chances. Vaidehi, a struggling village girl, unknowingly becomes the secret wife of billionaire heir Armaan Sharma after saving his life, only for him to abandon her and flee abroad. Five years later, when fate brings them face to face again, lies, misunderstandings, and love collide—forcing them into a dangerous game of marriage, divorce, and destiny.

risky-ishq-1.title: Risky Ishq
risky-ishq-1.description: বড়লোক আরিয়ানের একমাত্র আদরের বোন আনিয়া। আরিয়ান নিজের বেস্টফ্রেন্ড ভিভানকে বোনের প্রোটেকশনের জন্য পাঠায় । ভিভান আনিয়াকে সব সমস্যা থেকে বাঁচায়।একসাথে থাকতে থাকতে আনিয়া আর ভিভান একে অপরের প্রেমে পড়ে । আরিয়ান কি মেনে নেবে এই সম্পর্ক?

flash-marriage-to-the-president-mrs-gu-i.title: Flash Marriage to the President: Mrs. Gu is Actually a Hidden Tycoon
flash-marriage-to-the-president-mrs-gu-i.description: జెస్సికా జూబ్లీ హాల్ వారసత్వాన్ని సాధించాల్సిన నాన్న ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోవాలని భావిస్తాడు. ఇతను తన కన్నవాళ్లను ఎవరు చంపారో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటాడు. మరోవైపు, జోష్ పెళ్లి రోజునే పెళ్లికూతురు పారిపోవడంతో కుటుంబం అవమానానికి గురవుతుంది. పెద్దలు జెరోమ్‌కు ఎస్తర్‌ను పెళ్లి చేయాలని నిర్ణయిస్తారు కానీ అతనికి ఇష్టం ఉండదు. చివరికి, పెళ్లికూతురు కూడా తాను ఇష్టంలేకుండా పెళ్లి చేసుకోలేనని చెప్తూ పెళ్లి రద్దవుతుంది.

married-in-a-minute.title: Married In A Minute
married-in-a-minute.description: Married in a Minute is a supernatural romantic drama filled with magic, curses, and destiny. Ananya, the last heiress of the Mystic Magic Guild, is bound by a blood pact to marry Kabir, a wealthy heir cursed with a deadly fate. As love, rivalry, and family secrets collide, their sudden magical marriage becomes a battle between power, survival, and forbidden truths.

ennuyir-neeyadi.title: Thandavam
ennuyir-neeyadi.description: Anjali, a top scientist at ISO, secretly worships the dark deity Kaal Asur and sacrifices children in his name. But her obsession isn’t limited to the occult — she uses blood rituals, blame games, and black magic to possess her “soul-mate,” Vikram Sharma, a fellow Mars mission scientist. Just when everything seems within her grasp, another brilliant scientist, Priya, enters the scene. Will she become the final obstacle in Anjali’s twisted path, or the key to Vikram’s salvation?

immoral-proposal.title: Immoral Proposal
immoral-proposal.description: When Ananya Rathore, a strong yet vulnerable young woman, is crushed under Aarav Thakur’s cruelty, she unexpectedly crosses paths with the powerful Rivan Singh Raizada. Between betrayal, debt, and a battle for dignity, Ananya must decide if her broken pieces can turn into her greatest strength or her deepest downfall. Watch now!

objection-your-honor.title: Objection, Your Honor!
objection-your-honor.description: After my mother-in-law was in a car accident, my husband and I had a confrontation in the courtroom. Now let's see who's gonna win the Case!

you-are-my-ultimate-taste-in-the-world-1.title: You Are My Ultimate Taste in the World
you-are-my-ultimate-taste-in-the-world-1.description: Its a sweet romantic story where a passionate chef and a charming restaurant manager clash and connect through flavors, secrets, and sparks in the kitchen. As their culinary competition heats up, so does their unexpected love story, blending humor, tension, and heart.

love-to-hate-you-6.title: Love to Hate You
love-to-hate-you-6.description: The microdrama centers on the fated and tumultuous love story of Nandini and CEO Yash, repeatedly torn apart by tragic circumstances, selfless sacrifices, and relentless external forces. Their initial passionate romance, marked by a marriage proposal and the joy of impending parenthood, is shattered by a devastating car crash and Nandini's terminal cancer diagnosis. Driven by a profound love, Nandini makes the agonizing decision to hide her illness and sever ties with Yash, leading to a period of deep misunderstanding and heartbreak for both. Years later, Nandini re-enters Yash's life, sparking a complex, unresolved tension, further complicated by the possessive fiancée Mallika, who relentlessly sabotages Nandini's career and reputation with false accusations and corporate schemes. Nandini endures public humiliation, financial ruin, and brutal attacks, all while battling her hidden, life-threatening illness. Yash, initially disillusioned and manipulated by others, gradually uncovers the truth about Nandini's sacrifices and the conspiracies against her, including Mallika's falsification of medical records and her abduction. As Yash's protective instincts ignite, he faces immense pressure from his powerful father and Mallika, who attempts to force him into marriage through blackmail and threats against Nandini's life. Amidst these escalating dangers, Nandini's contract marriage with Rahul is exposed as a scheme, and other rivals like Shalini and Amrit emerge, further complicating their path. Despite being critically injured in a car crash, battling rapidly spreading cancer, and facing an agonizing choice between her own life and their unborn child, Nandini miraculously gives birth. The show culminates in Yash and Nandini's emotional reconciliation and fervent vows for an unbreakable future, having overcome immense adversity, though a subtle digital glitch hints that their newfound peace may still be precarious.

divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-3.title: Divorce a Billionaire to Marry Him!
divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-3.description: Alex Blackwell and Lydia Bale were 'married by decree.' After signing a contract, they had no further connection. A year later, Lydia was assigned to Alex as a personal assistant. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually husband and wife. As they gradually developed feelings for each other, they found themselves drifting apart due to their married status. Watch Now!

dadd-powerful-secret.title: Delivery Wala Billionaire
dadd-powerful-secret.description: Aditi, a determined manager from a 500-crore company, initially seeks to confront a powerful CEO, Arjun, but her path unexpectedly intertwines with Abhimanyu, a struggling delivery boy. Abhimanyu, initially mistaken for an intruder, is later revealed to be Arjun's independent father and a 'stock market genius' with hidden influence. When Aditi's company faces a market crash, Abhimanyu provides crucial financial advice, saving her from ruin. Intrigued, Aditi offers him a job, which he declines, leading her to propose a fake romantic relationship to deter her meddling relatives. Despite classist judgments from her friends and family, their connection deepens, and Abhimanyu, now often referred to as Shikhar, confidently faces her relatives' challenges, hinting at his true capabilities and mysterious wealth. Their evolving relationship is challenged by corporate rivals, Aditi's mother's strong disapproval based on class differences, and the revelation of Shikhar's hidden identity as a powerful CEO and owner of 'Monarch.' Aditi also faces a terrifying encounter with Zahani, who, after rejection, vows a sinister plan of revenge and forced control. Concurrently, a criminal mastermind named Tony, a former associate of Shikhar, targets a corporate titan and his son for past grievances, leading to kidnappings and Shikhar confronting Tony over corporate fraud. Shikhar's powerful father, who secretly lived as a humble delivery man, thwarts a cunning betrayer's plot and reveals his immense power, protecting his son. The narrative takes a tragic turn when Tony brutally terrorizes Shikhar's young son, Tej, leading to Tej's death, shattering Shikhar and shifting his focus from immediate retribution to uncovering a broader criminal network. The patriarch's true identity is dramatically unmasked, revealing a dangerous legacy to his son, while an impending marriage hints at new family dynamics. The show explores themes of class conflict, hidden identities, corporate power struggles, personal vendettas, and the lengths individuals will go to protect family and honor amidst complex romantic and corporate entanglements.

farewell-to-old-love-5.title: Farewell to old Love
farewell-to-old-love-5.description: A woman abandoned by her husband rises to power, but behind her composed exterior lies a storm of pain and pride. When their paths cross again, will the past consume her or set her free?

lucky-dragon-heavenly-fortune-2.title: Lucky Dragon Heavenly Fortune
lucky-dragon-heavenly-fortune-2.description: একজন মিলিয়নেয়র নিজেকে সাধারণ খাবার ডেলিভারি কর্মী ভেবে উপস্থাপন করে। তিনি তার সত্য পরিচয় প্রকাশের পর তার হারানো সম্পদ পুনরুদ্ধারের চেষ্টা করেন। কিন্তু তার আত্মীয়স্বজন, তার পুনরুত্থান ও ক্ষমতা ফিরে পাওয়া নিয়ে শঙ্কিত। তারা তাকে বাধা দিতে গভীর ষড়যন্ত্রও করে। এই উত্তেজনাপূর্ণ সংগ্রামের মাধ্যমে গল্প এগোতে থাকে। শেষ পর্যন্ত কে জয়ী হবে?

fake-girlfriend.title: Fake Girlfriend
fake-girlfriend.description: Fake Girlfriend is a powerful drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. Anika Malhotra, secretly the billionaire owner of Redrock, returns to India after ten years to reunite with her old love Ritwik, only to find him arrogant and greedy. When the truth of her identity shatters those who once humiliated her, Anika chooses self-respect, stands by true love, and redefines power on her own terms.

after-being-dumped-i-married-a-rich-heir.title: After Being Dumped, I Married a Rich Heir in a Flash
after-being-dumped-i-married-a-rich-heir.description: Rejected and unloved, she gets divorced and suddenly marries a wealthy man. This unexpected decision brings surprising twists. With those twists begins a new life — filled with intrigue and unexpected truths.

the-boss-game-2.title: Pyar Dhoka or Promotion
the-boss-game-2.description:
In the glamorous yet cutthroat world of corporate power, secrets are the ultimate currency. Simran and Purab, two high-profile executives, are bound by a marriage they keep hidden from the very empire they run thanks to strict company policies. But behind closed doors, their relationship is on the verge of collapse.

Enter Veer and Tanya, ambitious new interns who quickly realize that charm can be just as powerful as talent.

divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-4.title: Divorce a Billionaire to Marry Him
divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-4.description: Alex Blackwell and Lydia Bale were 'married by decree.' After signing a contract, they had no further connection. A year later, Lydia was assigned to Alex as a personal assistant. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually husband and wife. As they gradually developed feelings for each other, they found themselves drifting apart due to their married status...

why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry-2.title: Why Must The Boss Contractually Marry
why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry-2.description: తన కుటుంబంలో జరుగుతున్న దొంగతనాలను బయటపెట్టేందుకు, ఓ ధనవంతుడైన వారసుడు అంగవైకల్యం ఉన్నవాడిగా నటిస్తాడు. సినిమాల్లో భార్యల పాత్రలు పోషించే ఓ మహిళతో ఒప్పంద పెళ్లిలోకి వెళ్లాల్సిన పరిస్థితి వస్తుంది. మొదట నకిలీగా మొదలైన ఈ సంబంధం నిజమైన ప్రేమగా మారుతుంది, అతడు తనపై జరిగిన ద్రోహాలను బయటపెట్టి, తన వారసత్వాన్ని తిరిగి పొందే పోరాటంలో నిలిచిపోతాడు.

mistaken-millionaire-husband-2.title: Mistaken Millionaire Husband
mistaken-millionaire-husband-2.description: Ms. Sriram boyfriend Deepak ichina dhokkani kante kuda, Rohit Muralitharan prema nijamaina di. Ee andamaina love story ni chusi enjoy cheyyandi!

love-ka-second-dose.title: Love Ka Second Dose
love-ka-second-dose.description:
Ishita and Aarav were once lovers who were murdered by an anonymous killer on a fateful night. Ishita is given a second chance at love by Yamraj, but this time as a poor girl, and her love Aarav having no memory of her, and moreover, married to someone else.
One thing leads to another, and Ishita bumps into Aarav, eventually getting closer to her. Things take a dramatic turn when Ishita has strong suspicion of Aarav’s wife being the killer earlier.

the-westward-anime-season-2-1.title: The Westward Anime Season 2
the-westward-anime-season-2-1.description: పశ్చిమ యాత్ర అసలే స్వర్గం పన్నిన ఒక కుట్ర. దశాబ్దాలుగా మాయం అయిన పవిత్ర గ్రంథాన్ని వెతకడానికి తన సేనలను పంపుతుంది. అయితే ఆ గ్రంథం మళ్లీ స్వర్గం చేతుల్లో పడకుండా ఆపేందుకు, పాప మోచన కోసం యాత్ర మరోసారి ప్రారంభమవుతుంది.

blood-lies-and-secrets.title: Blood, Lies and Secrets
blood-lies-and-secrets.description: Siddharth apni adopted behen Zara ke pyaar mein itna andha hai ki usse apni saggi behen Ruhi dikhayi hi nahi deti. Lekin ek accident ke baad uske guilt aur uski zindagi mein aisa toofan aata hai jo sab kuch badal deta hai. Uss accident ke baad jab police Ruhi ki maut ko ek saazish batati hai, Ruhi ki atma sach dikhane wapas aati hai. Zara ke innocence ke peeche chhupa hai ek dangerous game of lies, betrayal and revenge. Kya Siddharth Zara ka sach payega? Ya ek aur maut ko anjam degi Zara.

rented-boyfriend-1.title: Rented Husband
rented-boyfriend-1.description: A mysterious billionaire hides his true identity and agrees to a contract marriage with a woman trying to save her family business, only to face relentless humiliation from her greedy relatives. But as secrets unravel, the tables turn in this emotional rollercoaster of pride, love, and revenge.

jack-of-all-cons-2.title: Jack Of All Cons
jack-of-all-cons-2.description: Mona's world is shattered when her husband, Sameer, gambles away their savings, imperiling his family and drawing the attention of aggressive debt collectors, including the Russian mafia. Sameer's protective friend, Kabir, intervenes, first with violence, then by defiantly stepping into a dangerous gambling world to clear Sameer's massive debt. Kabir, a master of deception, initially feigns incompetence in high-stakes card games against Sameer's betrayers, Ravi and Imtiaz, but his actions are part of a cunning plan for retribution. He masterfully exposes Ravi's cheating, escalating the stakes and drawing the attention of powerful figures and the enigmatic 'Poker Club.' Kabir's quest to understand the legendary master Walmek Ustad leads him to lose an heirloom to a formidable casino queenpin, whom he rejects, instead demanding to meet the elusive Phantom, a destructive force dismantling the industry. He forms a dangerous alliance with the queenpin and the casino owner's son to gain access to Phantom. The narrative deepens as Phantom systematically targets the powerful heiress Natasha's empire and personal dignity, revealing a vendetta rooted in past events involving her father and Kabir's deceased father. Jay Malhotra, Natasha's champion, suffers a devastating defeat and mutilation at Phantom's hands, leading to Natasha's public humiliation and the loss of her casino. Kabir, driven by his own quest for justice and revenge for his father's death—a death covered up by Natasha's father due to mafia threats—steps forward to challenge Phantom. He confronts Siddhu, accusing him of murdering his father, Valmiki Ustaad, two decades prior and orchestrating the cover-up. Flashbacks reveal Valmiki, an 'artist of risk,' made a fateful wager with Phantom, betting his life, and a remorseful man (likely Siddhu) confessed to cheating Valmiki, leading to his death. Kabir meticulously orchestrates a devastating revenge against the cheater, stripping him of everything. Despite Natasha's concerns, Kabir prepares for a final, perilous 'game' to confront Phantom and lay his father's 'ghost' to rest, risking everything to protect their world from this destructive force and achieve ultimate justice.

medicine-fate-sinful-sea-2.title: Medicine Fate, Sinful Sea
medicine-fate-sinful-sea-2.description: The microdrama begins with Kunal, a resilient blind man, enduring brutal torture, a consequence of a generational vendetta against his healing family. Miraculously resurrected by an ancient sage, he gains supernatural powers and embarks on a mission for justice, soon entering a contract marriage with the enigmatic Tia. He is thrust into the hostile Scott family as a son-in-law, facing constant humiliation and forced servitude, yet secretly his mysterious magical abilities awaken, vowing to transform his and his wife's lives. Operating as Dr. Thomas, the 'Divine Doctor,' he defies conventional medicine, performing 'medical miracles' and saving critically ill patients, including a formidable matriarch, often seeking a mysterious jade stone as payment. His unconventional methods and rising influence attract both allies, like Miss Olivia, and powerful enemies, leading to fierce professional rivalries and accusations of incompetence and poisoning. Amidst escalating corporate power struggles within wealthy families, Thomas navigates betrayal, accusations of infidelity, and complex romantic entanglements, including a loveless marriage to CEO Elena Scott and the affections of Woman 2. He becomes embroiled in high-stakes jade auctions and corporate sabotage, facing cunning rivals and digital smear campaigns orchestrated to destroy his reputation and discredit traditional medicine. A deeper conspiracy involving hidden gold and the framing of innocent families comes to light, further entangling him in a web of intrigue. The narrative culminates in Thomas's critical injury, betrayal by his sister-in-law, and financial ruin, leading to his public humiliation and brutal subjugation by Lucas. Stripped of everything, Thomas transforms into a ruthless avenger, vowing retribution against Eliana Scott and Olivia Jackson for his downfall, setting the stage for a fierce quest for vengeance.

return-of-the-doctor-1.title: Return of the doctor
return-of-the-doctor-1.description: This is the story of Dr. Shreya. She lost everything, yet she rose again, stronger than ever. When the past comes back to haunt her — will she choose the path of revenge or forgiveness? Don’t miss this gripping drama where every moment keeps you on edge. Watch it now!

revenge-in-second-life-2.title: Revenge In Second Life
revenge-in-second-life-2.description: ఒక పాత మానసిక ఆసుపత్రిలో, ఓ తల్లి తన చిన్న కుమార్తె ముందే మరణిస్తుంది. ఆమె లేఖల పెట్టె , మోసం, విడిపోయిన ప్రేమ, దొంగ గుర్తింపు వంటి హృదయవిదారక నిజాలను వెలుగులోకి తీసుకొస్తుంది. చివరకు భర్తకి నిజం తెలిసినప్పుడు, తన అసలైన కుమార్తెను ఒక కుట్రపూరిత మహిళగా మారిపోయిందని తెలుస్తుంది. అయితే ఆ దురుద్దేశాలన్నింటినీ బహిర్గతం చేయడానికి, మరణించిన తన తల్లిని పోలిన మహిళ తిరిగి వచ్చి నిజాన్ని బయటపెడుతుంది.

prema-desham-yuvarani.title: Prema Desham Yuvarani
prema-desham-yuvarani.description: థర్డ్ యానివర్సరీ రోజున భర్తకు తన గురించి నిజం చెప్పాలనుకుంది అనన్య. కానీ అంతలోనే ఆమె భర్త షాకిచ్చాడు. దాంతో, ఆమె జీవితంలో కొత్త మార్పు వచ్చింది? ఆ మార్పు ఏంటి? ఆమె జీవితం ఎలా మారింది? చూడండి. "ప్రేమదేశం యువరాణి" మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

billionaire-groom-returns.title: Billionaire Groom Returns
billionaire-groom-returns.description: Watch This special Series "Billionaire Groom Returns" Now!

rented-husband-1.title: Rented Husband
rented-husband-1.description: తన నిజ రూపాన్ని దాచుకుని, కుటుంబ వ్యాపారం కోసం కాంట్రాక్ట్ పెళ్లికి ఒప్పుకుంటాడు. కానీ ఈ నిర్ణయం అతని జీవితాన్ని ఎన్నో అవమానాలకు గురి చేస్తుంది. ఎందుకంటే డబ్బు కోసం ఎప్పుడూ పరిగెత్తే బంధువులు అతన్ని ఎప్పుడూ తక్కువ చూపుతూనే ఉంటారు.

looser-damad-bana-billioanire.title: Loser Damad Bana Billionaire
looser-damad-bana-billioanire.description: A humiliated son-in-law, living as a delivery boy, shocks everyone when his hidden identity as a billionaire heir is revealed. Betrayals, power struggles, and family wars ignite as he rises to claim his destiny.

risky-love-1.title: Risky Love
risky-love-1.description: ప్రేమ కోసం ఎంత రిస్క్ తీసుకుంటారు? అసలు ప్రేమించడమే రిస్క్ అయితే ఎలా..? ఈషా తన ప్రేమ కోసం ఎలాంటి రిస్క్ తీసుకుంది? ఆమె ప్రేమ పెళ్ళికి దారి తీసిందా? తెలియాలంటే చూడండి "Risky Love"  కుకు టీవీలో.

the-awakening-4.title: The Awakening
the-awakening-4.description:
ప్రాచీన శాపాలు ఈ కాలంలోకి వచ్చినప్పుడు, ఓ మరచిపోయిన యోధుడు మళ్లీ మేల్కొంటాడు. గతజన్మ శక్తులు కోల్పోయిన రాఘవ ఇప్పుడు తిరిగి జన్మించినప్పుడు, రాజకీయ యుద్ధాల మధ్య తన ప్రేమికురాలిని రక్షించాల్సి వస్తుంది.

కానీ భవిష్యత్తును రక్షించాలంటే, ముందు అతను తనకే తెలియని చీకటి గతాన్ని ఎదుర్కొని గెలవాలి.

generals-reborn-heiress-living-carefree.title: General's Reborn Heiress- Living Carefree
generals-reborn-heiress-living-carefree.description: The microdrama begins with Queen Alice seeking fiery revenge against Prince John for usurping her father's throne and betraying her, navigating a tumultuous journey marked by a magical assassination attempt and a subsequent rebirth. She finds a burgeoning romance with Prince Edward amidst a perilous escape, only to face public humiliation and a shocking betrayal by Prince John and her own sister. Alice uncovers John's dangerous conspiracy to overthrow her father, leading her to seek justice with loyal allies while protecting Princess Jennifer. She fiercely rejects a forced marriage to Prince John after discovering his infidelity with a pregnant Jennifer, sparking a power struggle within her family and deepening her connection with Edward, a commoner who challenges royal expectations. Alice asserts her independence, rebelling against John's mistreatment and secretly training as a warrior, while Edward leads an undercover mission to expose royal embezzlement. Their relationship is strained by accusations of Edward's infidelity, even as conspiracies to frame Alice and force her into engagements with others, like Sanjay, emerge, jeopardizing her reputation. Alice reclaims her ancestral property and her true identity as a rightful heiress, but her Queen guardian forbids her marriage to Edward, forcing an arranged union with Prince John and imprisoning her. Despite this, Alice, now a powerful operative, engages John in a dangerous game of espionage, even as he investigates her family's mistreatment out of concern. Her fierce independence leads her to reject John's attempts at reconciliation, demanding public humiliation, and she defiantly moves into Edward's private quarters, initiating his rigorous training. Edward is gravely poisoned while protecting Alice, revealing his selfless love, and as he recovers, their unspoken romance blossoms, with Alice determined to secure their marriage. A grand conspiracy by the ruthless Maharani to secure tyrannical rule is exposed, revealing her treacherous schemes and the murder of Edward's mother. Edward, revealed as the King's hidden son with ancient powers, confronts the Maharani, who is imprisoned but vows vengeance. As Alice and Edward prepare for their wedding, Prince John plots a violent coup to usurp the throne, crashing their ceremony, claiming Alice, and declaring his intent to assassinate the kingdom's leader. However, Alice and Edward cunningly use their wedding as an elaborate trap, thwarting John's coup without bloodshed and strategically capturing him. Alice orchestrates John's public humiliation rather than his death, leading to his banishment for high treason by his father, the Maharaj. In a surprising turn, the Maharaj later proposes a new marriage for John, who privately confesses a profound, multi-lifetime love to Princess Alice.

patience-will-lead-to-a-brighter-outcome.title: Patience will lead to a brighter outcome
patience-will-lead-to-a-brighter-outcome.description: Patience will lead to a brighter outcome

the-little-trouble-maker-with-super-powe.title: The Little Trouble Maker with Super Powers
the-little-trouble-maker-with-super-powe.description: The Little Trouble Maker with Super Powers-:Is a story of a mischievous kid with extraordinary superpowers stirs up chaos wherever they go.While causing trouble, they also end up solving problems in the most unexpected ways..

every-holiday-i-miss-my-wife-1.title: Every Holiday I Miss My Wife
every-holiday-i-miss-my-wife-1.description: Sona's life is brutally upended when she is falsely accused of infidelity, publicly shamed, and disowned by her abusive husband and in-laws. Enduring a cruel marriage, a miraculous "reset" empowers her to defy her tormentors, demand a divorce, and leave her marital home, facing destitution. She finds a second chance with Naren, an influential man, and embarks on an entrepreneurial journey, launching a successful food stall that evolves into a catering empire. Meanwhile, her former in-laws, initially dismissive, soon realize her crucial role in their family assets and desperately attempt to force her return, even pressuring her ex-husband, Imman (also known as Albert/Aman), into an arranged marriage for financial stability. Sona, now a shrewd and successful woman, plans high-stakes ventures, driven by a past connection and a desire for retribution against the corrupt family, admitting her fabrications were a calculated act of revenge. Her former family faces escalating financial ruin, crippling debt, and public ostracization for their past mistreatment. The Patriarch falls critically ill, expressing a desperate desire to see Sona, but she refuses to engage, asserting her independence. A web of financial deceit involving Sona and her ex-husband is exposed, shattering the Patriarch's trust. Concurrently, Sanjay becomes entangled in an organ trafficking scheme orchestrated by Chinnamma, who also defrauds his elderly parents, and Imman mysteriously vanishes after finalizing his divorce from Sona. Sona is tasked with protecting "Anna" from a vengeful family, hinting at a larger conspiracy. Through dramatic confrontations, Sona reveals her true influence as a "company boss," challenging her ex-husband's skepticism and exposing the family's betrayal. Ultimately, a Corporate Antagonist is arrested for fraud, and Aman seeks Sona's forgiveness and reconciliation, acknowledging her long-term financial support. The show culminates with Sona's triumphant rise to power, presiding over a formal signing ceremony, having achieved financial success, freedom, and a form of retribution against those who wronged her.

sultan-mirza.title: Billion Dollar Waiter
sultan-mirza.description: On the day of her wedding, Riya Kashyap’s world shatters when she discovers her fiancé cheating with her step-sister, who wants to steal both her love and her family empire. A year later, destiny leads Riya to Vedant Mehra — India’s richest businessman disguised as a simple waiter. What begins as a desperate lie soon turns into a high-stakes contract marriage, where love, betrayal, and hidden identities collide.

cold-revenge.title: Cold Revenge
cold-revenge.description: ఒకప్పుడు సంపన్నుడైన యువకుడు, మళ్లీ కాలేజీలో అడుగుపెట్టి, తనను మోసగించిన వాళ్లను బహిర్గతం చేయాలని, తన నిజమైన గుర్తింపును తిరిగి సంపాదించాలని, మరియు తనను నాశనం చేసిన వారిపై ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోవాలని చిన్ననాటి ప్రేమతో ద్రోహం చేసి, మరణానికి కారణమైన వారిని పగతో మళ్లీ జీవించడానికి తిరిగొచ్చాడు.

sathuranga-vettai.title: Sathuranga Vettai
sathuranga-vettai.description: When a mysterious gambler walks into the city’s most dangerous casino, the game isn’t just about cards, it’s about legacy, deception, and revenge. Jack Of All Cons is a gripping tale where every move hides a secret and every bet is life or death. Step into the world of high-stakes crime, where only one con can outplay them all. Watch Now!

ek-shaadi-do-dil-aur-ek-khaas-kismat.title: Rum Ne Bana di Jodi
ek-shaadi-do-dil-aur-ek-khaas-kismat.description: Fiercely independent Priya and arrogant businessman Kabir Malhotra enter into a marriage of convenience bound by fate, not love. But as their hearts clash and hidden emotions rise, destiny plays its own game. In a world of contract vows, secret pasts, and family pressures, will their accidental marriage turn into a forever bond? Watch Now!

marupiravi-1.title: Marupiravi
marupiravi-1.description:
Ira is a cunning and selfish woman. She takes advantage of Ayaan's love and seizes all his wealth. But Ayaan is reborn—this time with only one goal: to take revenge on Ira.
Will Ayaan be able to teach Ira a lesson she’ll never forget? And will he finally find true love?

kismat-ki-kitaab.title: Kismat ki Kitaab
kismat-ki-kitaab.description: The story begins with a man, initially condemned as Sarla's cursed infant son, then struggling as Uday, and later rising as Raghav, enduring extreme poverty and public humiliation. His life takes a dramatic turn with the discovery of an ancient, wish-granting book, propelling him into the corporate world as CFO of Malhotra Enterprises. There, he uncovers a sinister organ trafficking operation, orchestrates the CEO's downfall, and assumes leadership, systematically confronting those who wronged him, including a ruthless landlord and an arrogant socialite. This newfound power, however, leads to the revelation of his long-lost sister, Didi/Siya, and a deadly family prophecy foretelling one sibling killing the other, intrinsically linked to the "Kismet Ki Kitaab." Their quest for the true "Book of Fate" and a legendary two-part key is fraught with challenges, including the loss of a crucial family ring and the discovery that their current book is a counterfeit, draining Raghav's life force. He learns of an insidious family curse of greed threatening the book's power, a curse rooted in a centuries-old struggle involving Manvendra's destructive misuse and Shri Baleshwar's efforts to seal its power. Raghav's manipulative sister, Aditi, driven by jealousy, orchestrates their mother's death and unleashes cataclysmic magical events in her pursuit of immortality and absolute dominion. Ultimately, Raghav discovers he is the prophesied pure-hearted chosen one, destined to wield the book for good. A deep deception is unearthed, igniting a magical battle that awakens the book's dormant divine power, changing the world. Raghav makes an unbreakable oath to God to protect and wield this formidable power solely for humanity's welfare. Concurrently, a mysterious vigilante emerges, fighting systemic inequality and exposing corruption, leading to speculation about the arrival of a Kalki Avatar, a divine vigilante perceived as humanity's last hope, whose arrival is heralded by extraordinary cosmic events.

rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-4.title: Rebirth My Cheat Code Life
rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-4.description: Charan, a man with a shadowy past and illicit activities, navigates a complex web of family betrayals and dangerous alliances, striving to protect his daughter, Lili, and his partner, Amrutha. His journey begins with the shocking revelation of his partner's dark deeds and a brutal reincarnation, leading him to uncover a deeper conspiracy involving the formidable 'Yodha Group' and ruthless adversaries like the 'Tiger Lord.' Desperate to secure his family's future, Charan takes high-stakes loans and defies financial advisors, investing heavily in volatile markets, which initially brings public humiliation but ultimately leads to significant financial gains. This success escalates into a cutthroat financial duel with Anand, a powerful rival, fueled by a vendetta for his daughter's kidnapping. Charan's return as a wealthy financier immediately embroils him in family strife, facing demands from his mother and manipulative attempts by Amrutha's sister, Priya, and aunt to separate them. The conflict intensifies dramatically with the kidnapping of Lili, revealing Priya as the mastermind driven by greed, and Anand aligning with Priya's family against Charan, hinting at Charan's own hidden identity. Charan rises within the Yodha Group, partnering with CEO Vani on a controversial real estate venture that unveils a shocking government secret, propelling the company to immense wealth despite internal power struggles. Amidst this, Vani confesses her secret love for the married Charan, which he firmly rejects, reaffirming his devotion to Amrutha. The couple's newfound success is challenged by past rivalries and public humiliation, with Charan defending his family against accusations and threats. The Yodha Group faces imminent collapse under Amrutha's leadership, but Charan, now endowed with the unique ability to foresee the future, uses his extraordinary foresight to acquire crucial confidential information, reversing the company's trajectory and transforming it into a corporate powerhouse. As CEO, Amrutha celebrates their immense success and deep romantic connection, acknowledging Charan's pivotal role. The show culminates with Charan and Amrutha solidifying their professional and personal bond, establishing a business partnership, and joyfully anticipating a well-deserved family vacation, blending supernatural gifts with heartwarming romance and familial harmony.

son-of-an-mp-3.title: Son of an MP
son-of-an-mp-3.description: The microdrama centers on the pervasive political corruption and manipulative schemes of Nandini Pathak, a powerful politician who exploits individuals for her own gain. She targets vulnerable orphans, Sakshrata/Sakshara and Radhika, using blackmail and orchestrating forced engagements to further her political and financial ambitions. Her son, Akshat, initially an arrogant heir involved in cruel bets, finds himself entangled in her machinations and a dramatic love quadrangle. However, Akshat gradually defies his mother, driven by a burgeoning desire to protect those she seeks to control, particularly Sakshrata/Sakshara and Radhika, with whom he forms complex romantic bonds. Both Sakshrata/Sakshara and Radhika, initially facing public humiliation and eviction, embark on journeys of self-discovery, eventually revealing their true identities as long-lost heiresses to influential magnates. This newfound status intensifies Nandini's sinister plots, as she attempts to exploit their wealth and connections. Simultaneously, Ani, an adopted son entangled in Nandini's schemes, uncovers a larger conspiracy surrounding his adoption, further exposing the depth of her deceit. The series builds to a dramatic climax where Akshat publicly denounces and exposes his mother's corruption, leading to her conviction and his own entry into politics. Ultimately, the show culminates in Sakshrata/Sakshara's reconciliation with her wealthy father and Ani asserting his independence, signaling a new era for those who resisted Nandini's oppressive reign, though the shadow of political manipulation and fractured family legacies persists.

aa-dekhe-zara.title: Aa Dekhe Zara
aa-dekhe-zara.description: Fated Flame is a show about a legendary agent forced into hiding is drawn back into the world of violence when her son’s passion for boxing collides with a deadly underworld syndicate. As secrets unravel, a mother must fight both enemies and fate to protect her family.

the-lost-heir-rises-1.title: The Lost Heir Rises
the-lost-heir-rises-1.description: After a tragic accident leaves Raj paralyzed, his once-promising life shatters. But his wife Maya refuses to give up. Battling poverty, prejudice, and her own fears, she becomes his unwavering pillar of strength. Through her relentless efforts and unconditional love, Raj finds the courage to fight back  and when he finally rises, it's not just a recovery, but a victory forged by her resilience and devotion.

ek-ceo-do-dulhan.title: Ek CEO Do Dulhan
ek-ceo-do-dulhan.description: Gushab, after losing her beloved Veer to a formidable demonic entity, is mystically transported to the realm of death where Yamraj offers a second chance at life, but curses her with a destructive touch and a monetary limit, forcing her into a squalid existence. Returning to Earth as Khusha, she is rescued by the affluent CEO Rahul, whose seemingly benevolent job offer hides a chilling, elaborate scheme. Her presence immediately sparks intense jealousy from Simran Oberoi, Veer's fiancée, who is revealed to be a dangerous antagonist, plotting a corporate takeover and even Veer's murder. Amidst corporate power struggles and damaging media leaks, Khusha confesses her possessive love for Veer, vowing to protect him from Simran, who had previously shot him. Veer publicly chooses Khusha over Simran, driving Simran to a deadly obsession and revenge plot against Khusha. The narrative then delves into a complex mystery surrounding Khusha's true identity, as multiple individuals, including Arjun and Veer, claim her as a long-lost sibling, though a DNA test disproves her biological relation to Arjun. Despite this familial confusion, Khusha develops an affectionate relationship with Veer, while also being a "devoted partner" to Arjun. Following a shared near-death experience, both Khusha and Veer acquire unique mind-reading and strength abilities, which Khusha embraces to protect her loved ones. However, a powerful 'Boss' launches an obsessive investigation into Khusha, and criminal conspiracies target her and Arjun. Veer heroically protects a distressed young woman, leading to his incapacitation and a tragic sacrifice. A divine administrator intervenes to break a tragic reincarnation cycle for two fated souls, shifting them to a modern world, introducing CEO Rohan and a woman concerned for "Veer," suggesting a new beginning for their intertwined destinies. Yet, the past's shadows persist as Khusha is forced to make a deadly choice between Arjun and Veer, resulting in a violent confrontation. Arjun, consumed by a vengeful dual personality, kidnaps Khusha and Sanjay, planning their agonizing demise due to past betrayals and his unrequited love for Simran, who chose Veer. Further complicating matters, non-matching DNA reports shatter a man's identity and his relationship with his elder sister, exposing a secret about his origins and hinting at a complex web of deceit. The show explores themes of destiny, betrayal, love, and the relentless pursuit of identity and revenge across multiple lives and timelines.

rebirth-of-citys-mad-doctor.title: Rebirth of City's Mad Doctor
rebirth-of-citys-mad-doctor.description: জুয়ার নেশায় মত্ত স্যান তার সব কিছু হারিয়ে ফেলেছিল। টাকা, স্ত্রী এবং সর্বোপরি তার আত্মসম্মানও। কিন্তু ভাগ্য তাকে আর একটা সুযোগ দেয়। জীবন ফিরে পায় সে। মাটিতে পা পরে তার। আগের করা সমস্ত ভুলগুলোর এক-এক করে ক্ষমা চাইতে থাকে সে। অতীত বদলাতে না পারলেও তার দগদগে ঘা ভুলতে সে শুরু করে নতুন জীবন।

after-divorce-the-ex-wife-of-the-big-sho.title: After Divorce, the Ex-wife of the Big Shot Stirs up the World
after-divorce-the-ex-wife-of-the-big-sho.description: বিবাহবিচ্ছেদের পরে সেই নারী যে এক সময় সম্পূর্ণভাবে তার স্বামীকে উৎসর্গ করেছিল,  সে এবার সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী অবস্থানে ফিরে আসে। নিজের প্রতিদ্বন্দীদের ছিন্নভিন্ন করে দিয়ে তার অদম্য শক্তির দ্বারা অভিজাত সমাজকে হতবাক করে দেয়। কিন্তু খুব শীঘ্রই তার প্রাক্তন স্বামী বুঝতে পারেন, ওই স্ত্রীকে ছেড়ে দেওয়া ছিল তার জীবনের সবচেয়ে বড় ভুল।

secret-samrat.title: Secret Samrat
secret-samrat.description:
Saanvi has fought for years to earn the title of Agasthiyo ki Devi, protector of the earth but the moment she achieves her dream, she divorces her simple, unremarkable husband Rishi. Hurt by his distance and absence, Saanvi convinces herself she no longer loves him and instead surrenders her heart to the mighty and mysterious Samrat of the Agasthi.
What she doesn’t know is the truth that binds her fate: Rishi and the Samrat are the same man. The husband she rejected is the very lover she now worships.
As secrets unfold, Rishi silently shields Saanvi from betrayal, lust, and enemies plotting her downfall. Bound by love but hidden behind a mask, he sacrifices his own happiness to protect the woman who wants nothing to do with him.

travel-back-in-time-1991-4.title: Travel Back in Time 1991
travel-back-in-time-1991-4.description: নায়ক তার মনের মানুষকে বিয়ে করতে প্রস্তুত। কিন্তু ঠিক সেই সময়ে, তার অতীতের জীবনের স্মৃতি তাকে তাড়া করতে থাকে। তার মনে পড়ে যায়, সেই জীবনেও তাকে তার সবচেয়ে কাছের মানুষগুলো প্রতারিত করেছিল। সেই ব্যথা ও বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা আবার তাকে নাড়া দিতে থাকে। আগের জন্ম থেকে শিক্ষা নিয়ে এই জীবনে সে কি সিদ্ধান্ত নেবে?

delivery-girl-ka-secret-empire.title: Delivery Girl Ka Secret Empire
delivery-girl-ka-secret-empire.description: What if every doorstep delivery carried a bigger story? Not Just a Delivery Girl reveals the struggles, hopes, and resilience of a woman redefining her life. Watch Now !

the-crowned-consort-of-the-empress-5.title: The Crowned Consort Of The Empress
the-crowned-consort-of-the-empress-5.description: উত্তর সীমান্তে সাম্রাজ্যের রক্ষাকবচ হিসেবে দায়িত্বরত প্রতিভাবান সেনানায়ী নাদিয়া। তার বাহ্যিক ভাবাদর্শ দৃঢ় এবং কঠোর হলেও তার নীচে লুকিয়ে আছে কোমল হৃদয়। তার ঠিক বিপরীতেই অ্যাবিস রাজ্যের সম্রাজ্ঞী অরোরা তার সাহস, দৃঢ় সংকল্প ও নির্ভীক প্রেমের মানসিকতায় তাদের সম্পর্ককে নতুন প্রাণ দান করে। পুনর্জন্মে, তারা বাহ্যিক হুমকি ও ভুল ধারণার মধ্যে দিয়ে যাত্রা করলেও প্রেমের শক্তিতে অটল থেকে একসাথে প্রতিটি বাধা পার হয়। এই নিয়ে গল্প এগোতে থাকে নানাবিধ ঘাত প্রতিঘাতে।

revenge-from-a-gold-digger.title: Revenge from a Gold Digger
revenge-from-a-gold-digger.description: Beautiful and ambitious Tanya Verma is labeled a gold digger when she marries billionaire widower Kunal Malhotra a man twice her age. But as dark secrets, jealous rivals, and family conspiracies threaten to expose her, Tanya must prove she’s more than just a pretty face with a motive. In a world where love, money, and betrayal collide, who's really using whom?

say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-4.title: Say I Love You When We Meet Again
say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-4.description: এই গল্পটা দুজন প্রেমিক আর প্রেমিকার , যাদের ভাগ্য আলাদা করে দেয়, কিন্তু বছর খানেক পর আবার দেখা হয়—অপূর্ণ অনুভূতি আর কষ্টের গোপন সত্য নিয়ে। পুরনো অতীতের মুখোমুখি হয়ে, ওরা ভাবতে বাধ্য হয়: প্রেম কি দ্বিতীয় একটা সুযোগের যোগ্য?

flashback-fiancee-have-we-met-4.title: Flashback Fiancee Have we met?
flashback-fiancee-have-we-met-4.description: This microdrama centers on Leena, a woman entangled in a web of betrayal, debt, and a profound identity mystery, whose path intertwines with Arun, a man relentlessly searching for his lost love, Lily. Leena's initial quest for retribution against her cheating boyfriend, Rajan, and his heiress lover, Meera, quickly escalates as she faces financial ruin and is drawn into a forced alliance with Arun. Their complex relationship evolves from a contract marriage, fraught with suspicion and burgeoning affection, as Arun increasingly suspects Leena might be his presumed-dead beloved, Lily, who vanished seven years prior. Meanwhile, Meera, revealed to be Lily's sister, becomes a formidable antagonist, driven by jealousy and an obsessive desire for Arun, orchestrating kidnappings, blackmail, and even murder attempts against Leena. As Leena rises to become a powerful CEO, she navigates corporate sabotage, the re-emergence of Rajan seeking revenge, and intense family betrayals. Her journey is marked by a gradual recovery of traumatic memories, revealing her true identity as Lily Shekar, a long-lost heiress, and exposing a dark family conspiracy involving her cruel brother and a mother who replaced her with Meena. The narrative culminates in the unraveling of deep-seated secrets, including a medical professional's involvement in Lily's disappearance and a web of deceit. Ultimately, Meena meets a tragic end, while Arun and Leena, bound by a profound love and a shared past, overcome external threats and powerful patriarchs to solidify their commitment through a secret wedding, escaping the dangers that plagued their intertwined lives.

revenge-on-my-ex-the-ultimate-comeback.title: Revenge on My Ex: The Ultimate Comeback
revenge-on-my-ex-the-ultimate-comeback.description: Revenge on My Ex: The Ultimate Comeback-Story follows broken hearts turning into bold triumphs, as scorned lovers plot dramatic payback while reinventing themselves. It’s a fiery mix of betrayal, transformation, and the sweetest form of revenge success,

clouds-by-the-sea-3.title: Clouds by the sea
clouds-by-the-sea-3.description: The microdrama unfolds a tumultuous saga centered on multiple resilient women trapped in coercive contract marriages and entangled in the ruthless power struggles of influential families and corporations. Protagonists like the initial 'Protagonist,' Ms. Zion, Wan-wan, Eun, Yun, and Van, often battle terminal illnesses or unwanted pregnancies while striving for independence from controlling husbands and patriarchs. These powerful men, including various 'CEO Husbands' and 'Mr. Jiangs,' frequently leverage their positions to force compliance, orchestrate divorces, or assert ownership over their wives and children. The narrative is rife with hidden secrets, including concealed terminal conditions, secret heirs, and paternity mysteries that ignite fierce inheritance battles and corporate intrigue. Women are subjected to brutal attacks, captivity, forced medical procedures like hysterectomies or abortions, and public humiliation, often accused of infidelity or ulterior motives. Love triangles, unrequited affections, and past romantic connections further complicate the already strained relationships. Amidst this web of betrayal and manipulation, alliances are formed, and characters like Zion-Won find protection, while others, like Madam, are driven by a profound thirst for vengeance for tragic losses. The stakes are consistently high, encompassing personal freedom, the survival of unborn children, the revelation of long-buried truths, and the fight for a rightful legacy. Despite facing overwhelming odds, these women repeatedly defy their oppressors, making desperate stands and seeking justice. The overarching conflict explores themes of survival, loyalty, the devastating consequences of concealed truths, and the enduring fight for autonomy against formidable, often ruthless, forces. The resurfacing of figures believed dead and shifts in family leadership suggest an ongoing, complex struggle for power and truth.

the-westward-anime-season-2-4.title: The Westward Anime Season 2
the-westward-anime-season-2-4.description: The Westward Anime Season 2-As their journey continues, the westbound group reunites with the Bull Demon King and battles alongside the Bison Clan while confronting dark forces that threaten to overwhelm their world.

unexplained-science.title: Unexplained Science
unexplained-science.description:
Hessdalen Lights – Norway’s glowing orbs in the sky, still unexplained.
Science.

toofaan.title: Toofaan
toofaan.description: Toofan is a passionate romantic drama about desire, power, and unexpected love. Atharv Khurana, a billionaire CEO cursed with an inability to feel intimacy, is pushed by family pressure to find an heir or lose everything. But when a simple nurse, Aaradhya, awakens emotions in him that no one else could, their worlds collide—leading to obsession, betrayal, and a storm of love that could change both their destinies.

tangled-ties-and-tipsy-vows-5.title: Tangled Ties and Tipsy Vows
tangled-ties-and-tipsy-vows-5.description: Carol Evans is initially blackmailed by her ruthless stepmother, Sophia, into a contract marriage with the powerful Gracen Walker to save her critically ill father. Complicating matters, Carol is still in love with her first love, Winston, and confronts CEO Vincent Alva about his connection to her father's tragic past. Meanwhile, her sister Chloe (Arya) is in her own contract marriage with Grayson, but her past with ex-lover Dylan resurfaces, and Gracen Walker pursues Chloe for past transgressions, leading to Carol becoming a replacement bride for Gracen. Dylan Winston, revealed to be Carol's CEO, orchestrates her employment as his assistant, fueled by a past betrayal and a desire for revenge, further entangling Carol in a devastating love triangle when he reveals his relationship with her sister, Rose/Preethi. Carol faces corporate sabotage and accusations from Dylan's powerful mother, while Grayson, despite Carol's admission of using him, offers unwavering devotion and protection. Carol's past as a manipulative figure is exposed, and her father, Mr. Evans, is mysteriously moved from the hospital, then disappears, prompting Sneha to suspect foul play from Sophia. Grief-stricken by her father's tragic death, Carol publicly accuses Dylan of murder at his memorial, igniting a quest for justice. Grayson's love for Carol escalates into a dangerous obsession, leading him to confront her about suspected infidelity with Dylan, confine her, and isolate her from the outside world, trapping her as his captive. Dylan, driven by a deep personal stake, investigates a suspicious accident and cover-up, ultimately orchestrating Grayson's financial ruin and exile, burdened by guilt for his past role in Carol's suffering, and vows to safeguard her. Carol finds solace with Dylan, but her step-brother confesses to murdering her father and framing Dylan to possess her, attempting to silence Carol. After Dylan suffers a near-fatal injury and falls into a coma, Carol's unwavering devotion helps him recover, leading to their reconciliation after a five-year separation caused by trauma and her step-family's mistreatment. Ultimately, Carol reclaims her inheritance with Dylan's help, and they share a heartfelt wedding ceremony.

the-boss-game-1.title: God Of Teen Patti
the-boss-game-1.description: God of Teen Patti is a high-stakes thriller about deception, destiny, and the rise of a legend. Babban, a humble waiter with a hidden genius for cards, secretly holds the power to outwit the city’s most ruthless gamblers. As lies, greed, and betrayal swirl around him, the question remains—will he reveal himself as the true God of Teen Patti or stay hidden in the shadows?

supreme-master-asks-you-to-believe-in-sc.title: Supreme Master Asks You to Believe in Science
supreme-master-asks-you-to-believe-in-sc.description: Supreme Master Asks You to Believe in Science

alien-task.title: Alien Task
alien-task.description: Ek alien girl jo brahmand ke grahon mein jakar karti thi apna task complete, par is baar Human Energy ke chakkar mein woh ulajh baithi hai ek maanav robo Ankit se. Kya yeh takraav usse uska maha yoddha hone ka khitaab cheen lega?

frankenstein-2.title: Frankenstein
frankenstein-2.description: Frankenstein" by Mary Shelley uncovers the horrors that follow when a man tries to play God, creating life that turns against him. A cornerstone of Gothic literature and science fiction. 📘👹

beyond-good-and-evil-4.title: Beyond Good and Evil
beyond-good-and-evil-4.description: Beyond Good and Evil" by Friedrich Nietzsche offers a profound critique of established philosophies and empowers you to redefine ethics on your own terms. This work encourages a deep examination of personal and societal values, urging a break from conventional thought. 📘🚀💡

psychology-of-success.title: Psychology Of Success
psychology-of-success.description: Success ka measurement sirf paison se nahi hota. Asli safalta to wo hai jisme insaan apne jivan ke har pehlu mein safal ho, phir chahe wo career ho, ya paisa, ya zindagi jeene ka tarika. Isi baat ko samjhane ke "Psychology of Success" mein kuch aise examples diye hai, jise jankar aapko bhi success ka sahi matlab pata chal jayega!

anger-management-the-troubled-diplomatic.title: Anger Management: The Troubled Diplomatic Relationship between India and Pakistan
anger-management-the-troubled-diplomatic.description: Anger Management" tells the story of two countries, India and Pakistan, who often don't get along, much like neighbors arguing over a fence. The book shares stories from a top Indian diplomat Ajay Bisaria who saw many ups and downs, big fights, and small moments of peace. It's a look at how tough talks can sometimes lead to hope for friendlier times.

oru-puliya-marathin-kathai.title: ஒரு புளியமரத்தின் கதை
oru-puliya-marathin-kathai.description:
இந்தக் கதையின் ஹீரோ ஒரு புளிய மரம்.
அட ஆமாங்க…
நாகர்கோயிலில் உள்ள ஒரு புளியமரத்தின் கண் வழியே அந்த ஊரிலே நடக்கும் நிகழ்வுகளைக் கேட்கலாம் வாங்க!

kinnar-gatha.title: Kinnar Gatha
kinnar-gatha.description: British rule se pehle Kinnaron ka alag samaj nahi tha, unki situation British shasan ke baad kharab hui. Aaj bhi Kinnaron ki sthiti bahut sympathetic hai. Kayi experts ka manna hai ki is situation ke liye British sarkar ke alawa, humara desh ka jaativaad bhi iske liye zimmedar hai. Aaiye is audiobook mein hum Kinnaron ki sthiti par nazar daalein.

thottiyin-magan.title: Thottiyin Magan
thottiyin-magan.description: நவீன மலையாளப் புனைவெழுத்தில் அனல் காற்றைப் படரச் செய்த ஆரம்பகாலப் படைப்புகளில் முக்கியமானது ‘தோட்டியின் மகன்.’ தகழி சிவசங்கரப் பிள்ளை 1947இல் எழுதிய நாவல். இலக்கியத்தில் மட்டுமல்ல; சமூகப் பார்வையிலும் அதிர்வுகளை ஏற்படுத்தியது.

47-naatkal.title: 47 Naatkal
47-naatkal.description:
47 நாள்ல ஒருத்தவங்க வாழ்க்கைல நம்மப முடியாத அளவுக்கு மாற்றங்கள் வருமா ? அப்படி பட்ட கதை தான் இந்த 47 நாட்கள். சுவாரசியம் நிறைந்த இந்த கதைய இந்த ஒலி  புத்தகம் வழிய கேளுங்க.

will a person's life change within 47 days ? If that happens then thats the utmost thrilling life one can have. This novel is one such thrilling life story.

byomkesh-bakshi-ki-romanchak-kahaniyan.title: Byomkesh Bakshi ki Romanchak Kahaniyan
byomkesh-bakshi-ki-romanchak-kahaniyan.description: Byomkesh Bakshi ki Romanchak Kahaniyan ek adbhut audio show hai jo Bharat ke famous jasoos Byomkesh Bakshi ke kisse aur kahaniyon ko zinda karta hai. Is show mein, sunne wale Byomkesh ke sath unke jasoosi safar par chalenge, jahan har mod par unhein nayi paheliyan aur raaz ka samna karna padega. Toh taiyaar ho jaiye, kuch aise raaz se parda uthane ke liye jo aapko apni kursi se bandhe rakhega.

anuragathinte-dinangal.title: അനുരാഗത്തിന്റെ ദിനങ്ങൾ
anuragathinte-dinangal.description: ഹിന്ദുവായ സരസ്വതിയുടെയും മുസൽമാനായ ബഷീറിന്റെയും സുന്ദരമായ പ്രണയ കാവ്യം. പ്രണയിച്ചവരും ഒരിക്കെലെങ്കിലും പ്രണയിക്കാൻ ആഗ്രഹമുള്ളവരും കേട്ടിരിക്കേണ്ട ബഷീറിന്റെ ആത്മകഥാശമുള്ള ഗംഭീര കഥ- അനുരാഗത്തിന്റെ ദിനങ്ങൾ!

video-editing-mastery-course.title: Video Editing Mastery Course
video-editing-mastery-course.description:
Master the art of video editing with our Premiere Pro Mastery Course. This is a basic to advanced level course, and upon completion, you will become a professional video editor.

anubhavangal-paalichakal.title: അനുഭവങ്ങൾ പാളിച്ചകൾ
anubhavangal-paalichakal.description: കുട്ടനാടിന്റെ തൊഴിലാളി വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്റെ കഥ സുന്ദരമായി അവതരിപ്പിച്ച തകഴിയുടെ ക്ലാസിക് നോവൽ. ഓരോ മലയാളിയും കേട്ടിരിക്കേണ്ട അതുല്യ കൃതി - അനുഭവങ്ങൾ പാളിച്ചകൾ!

koolamathari.title: கூளமாதாரி
koolamathari.description:
பெருமாள் முருகனின் எழுத்தில் வெளிவந்த ஒரு கிளாசிக்.
மிகவும் ஒடுக்கப்பட்ட சமூகத்தைச் சேர்ந்த ஆடு மேய்க்கும் குழந்தைகளின் வாழ்க்கையைப் பற்றிய பதிவே இந்த “கூளமாதாரி”.

how-to-invest-at-different-life-stages.title: How To Invest At Different Life Stages
how-to-invest-at-different-life-stages.description:
|Key Insights - Strategic Investment, Better Money Management, Smart Decisions|
Zindagi ke har mod par, sahi financial decisions lena bahut zaroori hota hai. Isliye hum laaye hai aapke liye hamari ye khaas show jahan aapko milenge life ke har stage ke investments ke funde. Early career se lekar retirement tak, hum hai aapke saath!

oru-manithanin-kadhai.title: Oru Manithanin Kadhai
oru-manithanin-kadhai.description:
சிவசங்கரி எழுதிய இந்த நாவல், அதிக விற்பனையான பல ஸ்வாரசியங்கள் நிறைந்த புத்தகம். இந்த புத்தகத்தோடு ஒலி வடிவத்தை மிஸ் பண்ணாம கடைசி வரை கேளுங்க. 

This book is one of the bestseller written by shivashankari. The story has been featuring on a famous tamil magazine for many years. Now you can listen to it entirely through this audio book.

యమదూత.title: యమదూత
యమదూత.description: విజయ్, ఉద్యోగం లేక సమాజాన్ని ఎదురుకోలేక మందు తాగి, చనిపోదాం అనుకుంటాడు. అలాంటి సమయంలో యముడు వచ్చి ఓ ఉద్యోగం ఇస్తాడు. యముడు ఉద్యోగం ఇవ్వడం ఏంటి అని ఆలోచిస్తున్నారా? అయితే పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో స్టోరీ వినండి.

empower-your-best-habits-1.title: Empower Your Best Habits
empower-your-best-habits-1.description: Empower Your Best Habits  ke sath rozana ki aadaton ko dein nayi raah. Is audiobook se seekhiye ki kaise chhoti-chhoti habits se badi success hasil ki jaa sakti hai. Aur fir aap bhi ban jaaiye Successful.

Ai-ప్రేమ-గాథ.title: Ai ప్రేమ గాథ
Ai-ప్రేమ-గాథ.description: శిరీష్ నంద, విపరీతమైన పిరికివాడు . ఎదుటి మనిషితో మాట్లాడటానికి భయం. అమ్మాయిలతో అయితే  ఇక చెప్పక్కర్లేదు, అలాంటి సమయంలో అతనికి డేటింగ్ చేసే ఒక ఛాన్స్ వచ్చింది, అది కూడా AI ప్రియురాలితో, ఆమె పేరు జాహ్నవి! నిజంగా జాహ్నవి Ai ఆ? ఆమె తో ప్రయాణం ఎలాంటి మార్పులు వచ్చాయి, ఆమెతో కలయిక శిరీష్ జీవితంలో ఎలాంటి మలుపులు తీసుకుని వచ్చింది?

విప్లవ-గీతం-.title: విప్లవ గీతం!
విప్లవ-గీతం-.description: "మనందరం కాలేజీ లో చేరినప్పుడు ఎన్నో ర్యాలీ లు, ఉద్యమాలు చూసే ఉంటాం, అందులో పాలు పంచుకుని ఉంటాం, విశ్వజిత్ అనే స్టూడెంట్ యూనియన్ మీద హత్య కేసు మోపపడతాది, ఆ కేసు నుంచి తప్పించుకోగలడా..? " - నా పేరు గాలి సుందరయ్య, నేను అదే కాలేజీ లో ఒక విగ్రహాన్ని!

the-joy-of-missing-out-1.title: The Joy of Missing Out
the-joy-of-missing-out-1.description:
|Key Insights - Better Living, Improved Health, More Contentment|
Kya aap bhi FOMO - Fear of Missing Out - ke chalte apni zindagi mein tanaav aur insecurities ke shikaar ho chuke hain? Toh waqt aa gaya hai apne aapko dobara banane ka, bina koi bahaari dabaav ke. Chhodiye FOMO aur apnaiye JOMO - Joy of Missing out. Toh chaliye hamari is show ki madad se shuru karte hain FOMO se JOMO ka safar.

ultimate-marketing-strategies.title: Ultimate Marketing Strategies
ultimate-marketing-strategies.description: ഈ ഓഡിയോബുക്ക് നിങ്ങളുടെ ബിസിനസ്സിനെ അടുത്ത ഘട്ടത്തിലേക്ക് കൊണ്ടുപോകാൻ രൂപകൽപ്പന ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്നതാണ്. ഏറ്റവും പുതിയ മാർക്കറ്റിംഗ് ട്രെൻഡുകളും തന്ത്രങ്ങളും ഉപയോഗിച്ച് മത്സരത്തിൽ മുന്നേറാനും വിൽപ്പന വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കാനും ഉപഭോക്താക്കളെ ആകർഷിക്കാനുമുള്ള വിജയകരമായ രീതികൾ ഈ ഓഡിയോബുക്ക് പരിചയപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു.

a4778c92-e766-4129-8c3b-64f08c843020.title: 4 Dhuno Se Mood Refresh Karein
a4778c92-e766-4129-8c3b-64f08c843020.description: Sunne ke liye taiyar ho jao aisi 4 Dhunein jo aapke din bhar ke mood aur energy ko boost karti hain. Morning ki freshness se lekar night ki serenity tak, har time ke liye ye dhunein hai khaas!

vipasana-ella-dhyanareethikaludeyum-anth.title: വിപസ്സന: എല്ലാ ധ്യാനരീതികളുടെയും അന്തഃസത്ത
vipasana-ella-dhyanareethikaludeyum-anth.description: വിപസ്സന എന്നത് ഒരു പുരാതന ധ്യാന സമ്പ്രദായമാണ്, മനസ്സിനെയും ശരീരത്തെയും ശാന്തമാമാക്കി ആത്മസത്തയെ കുറിച്ചുളള ഉൾക്കാഴ്ച നേടാൻ ഈ രീതി നിങ്ങളെ  സഹായിക്കുന്നു. ഈ ധ്യാന രീതിയെ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് പരിചയപ്പെടുത്തുന്നത് മറ്റാരുമല്ല, വിഖ്യാത ഗുരു ഓഷോ ആണ്.

kaali-gandaki.title: കാളി ഗണ്ഡകി
kaali-gandaki.description: ചരിത്രവും മിത്തും യാഥാര്‍ത്ഥ്യവും കെട്ടുപിണഞ്ഞ് കിടക്കുന്ന കാളി ഗണ്ഡകി ഇന്ദുഗോപന്റെ പതിവ് ശൈലിയില്‍ നിന്ന് വേറിട്ടൊരു രചനയാണ്. നമുക്ക് മുന്നില്‍ ഒരു ഭ്രമാത്മക ലോകം സൃഷ്ടിക്കുന്ന കാളി ഗണ്ഡകി കേള്‍ക്കാം.

shikhandi.title: Shikhandi
shikhandi.description: Janiye kaun tha wo yoddha jisne mahapratapi Bhishm ko maut ke ghaat utaar diya  ,  Suniye pyaar aur badale se bhari ek anokhi kahani.

-మేడం-C.title: మేడం C
-మేడం-C.description: ఇండియన్స్ ఎంతో ఇష్టపడే ఆటల్లో క్రికెట్ మొదటి స్థానం లో ఉంటుంది. అయితే అందులో కష్ట నష్టాలూ, పాలిటిక్స్ కూడా భారీగానే ఉంటాయి. క్రికెట్ లోని మేజిక్ తో పాటు దానిలోని లోటుపాట్లు కూడా తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

chattakkari.title: ചട്ടക്കാരി
chattakkari.description: മലയാള സിനിമയിലെ എക്കാലത്തെയും മികച്ച ഒരു റൊമാന്റിക് ക്ലാസിക്കിന്റെ മൂലകൃതി. ആംഗ്ലോ ഇന്ത്യനായ ജൂലിയുടെയും ഹിന്ദുവായ ശശിയുടെയും വികാരതീവ്രമായ പ്രണയകഥ. കേൾക്കൂ...ചട്ടക്കാരി!

all-the-corpses-that-spoke.title: Aakhiri Suraag
all-the-corpses-that-spoke.description: Ek Jane-maane  businessman ka achanak gaayab hona aur uske baad hi gayab hona uska pura pariwar. Investigation ka ek aisa rahasyamay case jise Britain ke itihas ka sabse mehanga case maana gaya. Suniye Murder or investigation ki chaunkane wali kahani sirf KUKU FM par.

janaki-vimukti-2.title: జానకి విముక్తి - 2
janaki-vimukti-2.description: జానకి తన భర్తకు వ్యతిరేకంగా చట్టపరమైన పోరాటం ఏ విధంగా చేసిందో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? ఆమె ఒక ఉద్యోగం సంపాదించుకుని, తనకు తానుగా జీవించడం ఎలా నేర్చుకుంటుంది ? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "జానకి విముక్తి - 2" (రెండవ భాగం) అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

sravana-sandhya.title: శ్రావణ సంధ్య
sravana-sandhya.description: ఇద్దరు క్రూర మృగాల లాంటి మగాళ్ల మధ్య నలిగిపోతూ, ప్రాణ స్నేహితురాలి చేతిలోనే మోసపోయిన మిధున కథ గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ?  మిధున జీవితం ఏయే మలుపులు తిరిగింది? ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "శ్రావణ సంధ్య" కథ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

kingfisher-the-king-of-bad-times.title: Kingfisher: The King of Bad Times
kingfisher-the-king-of-bad-times.description: Kingfisher - Ek udaan, jo ban gayi disaster ka karan. Vijay Mallya ke un decisions ko suniye, jo le doobe unhe aur unki company ko. Is drama series mein jaanenge ki ek business ke liye smart decisions kaise liye jaate hain. Toh phir der kis baat ki? Suniye 10 hazaar crores ka loan le kar United Kingdom bhaag jaane wale India ke sabse bade Fugitive ki kahaani.

coffee-house.title: കോഫി ഹൗസ്
coffee-house.description: ഒരു കോഫി ഹൗസില്‍ ഒരു രാത്രിയില്‍ ദുരൂഹമായ 5 കൊലപാതകങ്ങള്‍! അതിന്റെ പേരിൽ വധശിക്ഷ കാത്തുകിടക്കുകയാണ് ബെഞ്ചമിന്‍. ഉദ്വേഗം ജനിപ്പിക്കുന്ന സംഭവങ്ങള്‍ തുടര്‍ന്ന് അരങ്ങേറുന്നു. കേള്‍ക്കാം ലാജോ ജോസിന്റെ കോഫി ഹൗസ്.

Vishnu-Vaani-सफल-जीवन-का-पाठ.title: Vishnu Vaani: सफल जीवन का पाठ
Vishnu-Vaani-सफल-जीवन-का-पाठ.description: Kya aap janna chahte hain ki kaise Bhagwan Vishnu apni leelaon se sansar ko santulit rakhte hain? Agar han, Toh zaroor suniye ye show, Ismein aapko milengi  unke har avatar aur unki shaktiyon ki deep insights! Jinse aap bhi Seekhenge, Ki kaise apni life ko balance kar ke ek bada badlaav laya ja sakta hai.

nooru-simhasangalu.title: ನೂರು ಸಿಂಹಾಸನಗಳು
nooru-simhasangalu.description:
ನೂರು ಸಿಂಹಾಸನಗಳು ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯನ್ನು ಕೆ. ಪ್ರಭಾಕರನ್ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇದು ತೀವ್ರ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕತೆಯ ಆಧಾರವನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಬರೆಯಲಾಗಿದೆ.
ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಹಂಬಲದಿಂದ ನಾಶವಾಗುವ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿಸ್ತಾರವಾಗಿ ಚರ್ಚೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕಥೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಸಿಂಹಾಸನಗಳು ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಸಂಕೇತವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಪಾತ್ರವೂ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಉದ್ದೇಶಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಆಸೆಯಿಂದ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಪಾತ್ರಗಳು ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಆಟದಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಂತೆ, ಕತೆ ಆಳಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ ರಾಜಕೀಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಹೋರಾಟಗಳನ್ನೂ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

savaari-giri-giri.title: ಸವಾರಿ ಗಿರಿ ಗಿರಿ
savaari-giri-giri.description: **ಸವಾರಿ ಗಿರಿ ಗಿರಿ** ಎಂಬ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಸಂತೋಷ ಆನಂತಪುರ ಅವರ ಸೃಜನಶೀಲ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಜೀವನದ ಪ್ರಸಂಗಗಳನ್ನು ತಮಾಷೆಯ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕತೆಗೂ, ಪಾತ್ರಗಳಿಗೂ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಜೀವನದ ಯಥಾರ್ಥತೆ ಇದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಕಥೆಯು ಹಾಸ್ಯಮಯ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಡಿಬರುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಪಾತ್ರವು ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟವಾದ ದರ್ಶನವನ್ನೂ, ವೈಚಾರಿಕತೆಯನ್ನೂ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಒಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ, ಗಂಭೀರ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಸಹ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಹಾಸ್ಯಯುಕ್ತವಾಗಿ ನಿರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಇದರಿಂದಲೇ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ತನ್ನ ಓದುಗರ ಮೇಲೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪ್ರಭಾವವನ್ನು ಬೀರುತ್ತದೆ.

prime-minister-vp-singh-kaise-badla-bhar.title: Prime Minister VP Singh: Kaise Badla Bharat?
prime-minister-vp-singh-kaise-badla-bhar.description: Mandal Commission laagu karne ki andar ki kahani! Janiye VP Singh ki daring move se desh mein kaise aaya bawaal!

colonelge-yaaru-bareuvude-illa.title: ಕರ್ನಲ್ ನಿಗೆ ಯಾರೂ ಬರೆಯುವುದೇ ಇಲ್ಲ
colonelge-yaaru-bareuvude-illa.description: ಇದು ಕೊಲಂಬಿಯಾದ ಬರಹಗಾರ ಗೇಬ್ರಿಯಲ್ ಗಾರ್ಸಿಯಾ ಮಾರ್ಕ್ವೆಜ್ ಬರೆದ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಬಡ, ನಿವೃತ್ತ ಕರ್ನಲ್, ಸಾವಿರ ದಿನಗಳ ಯುದ್ಧದ ಅನುಭವಿ, ಸುಮಾರು ಹದಿನೈದು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ತನಗೆ ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡಿದ್ದ ಪಿಂಚಣಿಯನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಬೇಕೆಂದು ಆಶಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ.

-ఐదు-కాళ్ళ-మనిషి.title: ఐదు కాళ్ళ మనిషి
-ఐదు-కాళ్ళ-మనిషి.description: రకరకాల మనుషులు ... వాళ్ళ జీవితాలు ... ఆ జీవితాల్లో ఏదో మూల కనిపించే మన జీవితానికి సంబంధించిన నీడలు ... అరే ఈ కథ మన జీవితానికి దగ్గరగా ఉందే అనిపించే కథల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

paapo-se-mukti-ashtavakra-geeta-ke-sath-.title: Paapo Se Mukti: Ashtavakra Geeta Ke Sath
paapo-se-mukti-ashtavakra-geeta-ke-sath-.description: Kya aap jaante hain aap bhi roz paap ke bhagi ban rahe hain? Janiye kaise bacha jaye in paapon se, sirf is show mein!

great-expectations.title: Great Expectations
great-expectations.description: Charles Dickens's "Great Expectations" narrates the story of Pip, an ambitious boy navigating the challenges of love, wealth, and social expectations, set against a rich backdrop of 19th-century societal contrasts 🌁👦📘.

manyam-rani.title: మన్యం రాణి
manyam-rani.description: ఈనాటి సమాజంలో ఎవరూ ప్రకృతికి విలువ ఇవ్వడం లేదు. స్వార్థ పూరితంగా జనులందరూ ప్రకృతిని నిర్వీర్యం చేస్తున్నారు. మానవీయ విలువలకు పట్టంకడుతూ ప్రకృతిని స్త్రీ మూర్తిలా ఎలా గౌరవించాలో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే "మన్యం రాణి" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

goswami-tulsidas.title: Tulsidas
goswami-tulsidas.description: Jiska paida hona hi ashubh mana gaya, kaise ki usne mahan granth Ramcharitmanas ki rachna? Jo Tulsi apni patni Ratnawali ke pyar mein pagal the, kaise mila unhe ishwar ke raasta? Tulsidas ke jeevan ki adbhut kahani, aaiye sunte hain is khas peshkash mein.

janaki-vimukti-1.title: జానకి విముక్తి - 1
janaki-vimukti-1.description: జానకి అనే మహిళ తనని హింసిస్తున్న భర్త చెర నుండి ఎలా విముక్తి పొందాలని నిర్ణయించుకుందో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే "జానకి విముక్తి - 1" (మొదటి భాగం) అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

zen-mind-beginners-mind-7.title: Zen Mind, Beginner’s Mind
zen-mind-beginners-mind-7.description: Zen Mind, Beginner’s Mind is a transformative guide to understanding Zen and achieving peace through meditation 🌀💫.

aapki-jeet.title: Jeet Ka Mindset Banao
aapki-jeet.description: Kya aap life mein jeetne ke naye tareeke khoj rahe hain? Jig Jiglar ke saath har kadam par, yeh show aapko sikhaayega kaise jeetne ke liye khud ko taiyar karein. Tune in aur bano unbeatable har challenge mein.

tao-te-ching-7.title: Tao Te Ching
tao-te-ching-7.description: Tao Te Ching" offers deep insights into leading a balanced, peaceful life by aligning with the Tao 🌐🌿

chanakya-neeti-15.title: Chanakya Neeti
chanakya-neeti-15.description: Chanakya Neeti aur Sutra, do powerful tools jo aapko successful bana sakte hain. Is show mein explore karenge Chanakya ki un timeless strategies ko jo aapki personal aur professional life ko transform kar sakte hain. Tune in now!

guns-thighs-the-story-of-my-life.title: Guns & Thighs: The Story of My Life
guns-thighs-the-story-of-my-life.description:
இது Guns, Gangsters, Sex & Violence நிறைந்த சுயசரிதை!
Listen to the Story of ”The Controversial Filmmaker - Ram Gopal Varma”

14-hours-an-insiders-account-of-the-2611.title: 14 Hours: An Insider's Account of the 26/11 Taj Attack
14-hours-an-insiders-account-of-the-2611.description:
November 26th, 2008 - Taj Hotel, Mumbai
ஹோட்டலின் உள்ளே என்ன நடந்தது?
தீவிரவாதிகளிடம் இருந்து தப்பிப் பிழைத்தவர்கள் சொல்லும், மனதை உறைய வைக்கும் உண்மைச் சம்பவங்கள்.

srikanth-bolla-true-story-of-blind-indus.title: Srikanth Bolla: True Story Of Blind Industrialist
srikanth-bolla-true-story-of-blind-indus.description: Andha hone ka tag lagne par bhi, Srikanth Bolla ne sabko dikhaya ki sapne dekhne ke liye aankhon ki nahi, Himmat ki zaroorat hoti hai aur phir kaise us himmat ko mehnat mein badal kar safalta hasil ki ja sakti hai. Is show mein janiye kaise ek chhote gaon se nikal kar Bolla ne MIT se padhai ki aur ban gaye eco-friendly empire ke CEO.

everyday-happiness-mantras.title: Everyday Happiness Mantras
everyday-happiness-mantras.description: Namma life la happy ah irukka nammaloda health namakku rombave mukkiyam. Intha book neenga happy ah iruka thevayaana Mantras ah ungalukku kathu kudukkum.

dollar-desam.title: Dollar Desam
dollar-desam.description: எழுத்தாளர் ✍🏼 பா.ராகவன் எழுதுன இந்த "டாலர் தேசம்" ஆடியோ புத்தகம் அமெரிக்காவோட 400 வருச  வரலாற்றை விறுவிறுனு சுவரஸ்யமா சொல்லுது. வாங்க கேக்கலாம் 🔊🎧.

4-hour-deep-sleep-music.title: 4-Hour Deep Sleep Music
4-hour-deep-sleep-music.description: Deep Sleep show mein suniye Ocean sounds se bhare tracks, jo aapko denge deep sleep ka experience: pehla ghanta, shant samudri lehren; dusra ghanta, whale ke soothing songs; teesra ghanta, deep sea ke calm sounds mein doobna; aur chauthe ghanta, raat ke samay ki gentle waves ka music.

oru-manithan-oru-veedu-oru-ulagam.title: ஒரு மனிதன் ஒரு வீடு ஒரு உலகம்
oru-manithan-oru-veedu-oru-ulagam.description:
இது ஜெயகாந்தனின் Classic!
என்ன இனம், என்ன சாதி என்று எதுவும் தெரியாத ஒருவனே இக்கதையின் ஹீரோ!
 அந்த ஹீரோ செல்லும் பயணத்தில் நீங்களும் இணைந்து வாழ்வின் இரகசியத்தை தெரிந்து கொள்ளுங்கள்!

moovaayiram-thaiyalgal.title: Moovaayiram Thaiyalgal
moovaayiram-thaiyalgal.description: இந்நூலில் இடம்பெற்றுள்ள, மனித இயல்பின் அழகையும் அவலத்தையும் திரை விலக்கிக் காட்டுகின்ற ஒவ்வொரு கதையும் சிறப்பாக வாழப்பட்ட ஒரு வாழ்க்கையைப் பிரதிபலிக்கிறது. பல சமயங்களில், துணிச்சலாக மேற்கொள்ளப்படுகின்ற சாதாரண நடவடிக்கைகள்தான் மற்றவர்களுடைய வாழ்வின்மீது அளப்பரிய தாக்கம் ஏற்படுத்துகின்றன. இன்ஃபோசிஸ் அறக்கட்டளையின் பணிகள் வாயிலாகவும், தன்னுடைய சொந்த இளமைப்பருவம், குடும்ப வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் பயணங்கள் வாயிலாகவும், சுதா மூர்த்தி, இத்தகைய பல கதைகளைத் தன் வாழ்வில் எதிர்கொண்டுள்ளார். உலக அளவில் இந்தியத் திரைப்படத்தின் வீச்சைக் கண்டுகொண்டதிலிருந்து கிடைத்த மகிழ்ச்சி, இந்தியக் காய்கறிகளின் மூலாதாரங்கள் ஆகியவற்றில் தொடங்கி, தோற்றத்தைக் கொண்டு மற்றவர்களை எடைபோடும் மேலோட்டமான பார்வைவரை, இக்கதைகள் அன்றாடப் போராட்டங்களையும் வெற்றிகளையும் வெளிப்படுத்துகின்றன.

kuwait-fire.title: Nasra ka inteqam
kuwait-fire.description: Pati ki bwafai ke gusse mein Nasra ne uthaya ek aisa qadam jiske liye pura Saudi Arab ne maangi uski Saza-e-maut. Kya hai Nasra Yusuf ki puri kahani suniye sirf KUKU FM par.

nee-mattum-nizhalodu.title: நீ மட்டும் நிழலோடு...
nee-mattum-nizhalodu.description: படித்துவிட்டு வேலை தேடும் ஓர் இளைஞனுக்கு வீட்டிலும், சமூகத்திலும் கிடைக்கும் மரியாதைகளும், அவனுடைய ஆசைகளும், நிராசைகளும், மனப் புழுக்கங்களும் ஆழமாக அலசப்பட்ட நாவல் இது...

bihar-murder-mystery-shilpi-gautam-hatya.title: Bihar Murder Mystery: Shilpi-Gautam Hatyakand
bihar-murder-mystery-shilpi-gautam-hatya.description: Bihar ka ek aisa rape or hatyakaand jiski kadiyan seedhe us samay ke CM se jud rahi thi. Jurm aur siyasat ka ek aisa meljol jisne Bihar k puri satta ko hilkar rakh Diya tha. Suniye jurm aur Satta ki sansanikhez kahani sirf KUKU FM par.

adhu-mattum-ragasiyam.title: அது மட்டும் ரகசியம்
adhu-mattum-ragasiyam.description: புகழின் உச்சியில் இருக்கும் ஒரு பாடகிக்கும் , ஒரு பிரபல புள்ளிக்கும் ரகசிய தொடர்பு இருப்பதாக ஒரு செய்தி ஆதாரத்துடன் வெளியாகிறது. கணவனுக்கு சந்தேகம் ஏற்பட, தான் களங்கமற்றவள் என்பதை கணவனுக்கு எப்படி நிரூபித்தாள் என்பதே கதை.

operation-venus.title: ஆபரேஷன் வீனஸ்
operation-venus.description: மூன்றாம் உலக நாடுகளில் ஜனநாயகம் தழைத்திட லட்சியத்திற்கும் லட்சங்களுக்கும் இடையில் நடக்கும் யுத்தத்தில், தன் நேச உறவுகளையும், நெஞ்சின் உரத்தையும் சதா உரசிக்கொண்டே இருக்கும் துஷ்ட சக்திகளை மீறி தன் லட்சியத்தை அடைய ஆகாஷ் என்னும் தேசப்பற்று ததும்பும் நவநாகரீக இளைஞனின் பயணமே ஆபரேஷன் வீனஸ்

the-desi-crime-podcast-2.title: The Desi Crime Podcast
the-desi-crime-podcast-2.description: Kya aapko true crime stories sunna pasand hai? Aur ye bhi lagta hai ki aap kabhi bhi aise crimes ke victim nahi ban sakte? Agar haan! Toh zara ekbar aur sochlo! Kyunki crime kabhi bhi kisi ke saath bhi ho sakta hai, Yakeen nahi hota toh is 'Desi Crime Podcast' ki kahaniyon ko sunlo aur aaj se hi savdhaan rehna shuru kardo.

fbi-varalaaru.title: FBI Varalaaru
fbi-varalaaru.description: அமெரிக்க உளவுப்படையான FBI  உடைய கதை அதிரடி சினிமாவவிட அட்டகாசமா இருக்கும். சுவாரசியமான இந்த கதைய  கேக்கலாம்  வாங்க..

pasitha-maanidam.title: பசித்த மானிடம்
pasitha-maanidam.description: நவீனத் தமிழ் இலக்கியத்தில் ஓரினப் புணர்ச்சியை கையாண்ட முதல் நாவல் பசித்த மானுடம். தமிழில் அதிகம் பேசப்பட்ட இந்நாவல் நுட்பமான பல விஷயங்களை லாவகமாகக் கையாள்கிறது. முட்டி மோதி வாழ்க்கையில் மேலே வரும் மனிதர்கள், பல்வேறு இன்பங்களைத் துய்த்த பின் கடைசியில் அடைவது என்ன என்னும் கேள்வியை பரவலாக எழுப்புகிறது இப்படைப்பு.

ayurveda-simplified.title: Ayurveda Simplified
ayurveda-simplified.description:
|Key Insights - Better Lifestyle, Holistic Health, Natural Treatment|
Agar aaj ki iss tanaav bhari zindagi mein aap sehatmand rehna chahte hain toh Ayurveda apnayen, jo na sirf bimariyon ka ek prakritik ilaaj hai, balki ek swasth jeevan shaili bhi.

business-psychology.title: Business Psychology
business-psychology.description:
பிசினஸ் ன்றது, வெறும் வித்தியாசமான ஐடியாவை சார்ந்தது இல்ல, அத கையாளக்கூடிய யயுக்தியைதான் முதல்ல தெரிஞ்சிக்கணும்னு இந்த புத்தகத்தை எழுதிய எழுத்தாளர் சொல்லி இருக்காரு. வெற்றிகரமா உங்க பிசினஸ்-அ நடத்த பல குறிப்புகளை பகுர்ந்து இருக்காரு கேட்டு பயனடையுங்க. 

a successful business is not just about that unique idea, its also about how you smartly balance it. This book's author has share a lot of insights and tips to understand marketing.

abaaya-malli.title: அபாய மல்லி
abaaya-malli.description: திகிலும் காதலுமான மர்மக்கதை. ஆவிகள் உண்மையா? ஆவிகளை விட கொடியவர்கள் துரோகிகள். ஒரு ஆவியுலக ஆய்வு கொண்ட பரபரப்பான புதினம்.

bite-the-bullet.title: Bite The Bullet
bite-the-bullet.description: Dimag mein aate hain kayi ajeeb khayal? Solutions dundhane mein hoti hai pareshani? Badhana chahte hain apni life ki productivity? To ye "BIte The Bullet" Audiobook aapke liye hi hai jo aapko success ki taraf le jayegi.

vibarithathin-vilai-vidhya.title: விபரீதத்தின் விலை வித்யா
vibarithathin-vilai-vidhya.description: மனோகரின் இளமைக் கால காதல், தெய்வ நாயகத்துடனான தொழில் வகை மோதல், அவனது அன்பு மனைவி வித்யாவின் விபரீதமான செயல்கள் ஆகிய அனைத்தும் சேர்ந்து மனோகரின் வாழ்க்கையை புரட்டிப் போடுகின்றன.  அதிலிருந்து எப்படி மீண்டான்? பட்டுக்கோட்டை பிரபாகரின் அசத்தலான நாவல்...

గుండె-జారి-గల్లంతయ్యిందే.title: గుండె జారి గల్లంతయ్యిందే
గుండె-జారి-గల్లంతయ్యిందే.description: ఆద్య అనుకోకుండా ఓ రోజు సిద్ధూ అనే హ్యాండ్సమ్ అబ్బాయిని కలిసింది.ఇద్దరూ డిన్నర్ కి వెళ్ళారు. డిన్నర్ తర్వాత కాస్త ఆల్కహాల్ కూడా పుచ్చుకున్నారు. ఆ మత్తులోనే హోటల్ కి వెళ్ళారు. తర్వాత అక్కడ ఏం జరిగిందో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే వినండి "గుండె జారి గల్లంతయ్యిందే" ఆడియో సిరీస్.

lifestyle-inflation.title: How Lifestyle Inflation Is Affecting You?
lifestyle-inflation.description:
|Key Points- Rising Expenses, Peer Pressure & Social Media Influence|
Kya aap jaante hain ki aapki badhti hui salary aur badhte kharche kaise aapke financial future ko affect kar sakte hain? Iss show mein hum aapko iss challenge ko face karne ke tarike bataenge jisse aap financial stability achieve kar sakte hain.

kachithamaina-javabhu.title: కచ్చితమైన జవాబు
kachithamaina-javabhu.description: సీతారామయ్య మరియు జానకిరామయ్య మేనత్త మేనమామ బిడ్డలు. ఒక రోజు అనుకోకుండా ఇద్దరూ చామర్లకోట ప్లాటుఫారం మీద కలుస్తారు. సీతారామయ్య ఒక వితంతువుని పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటున్నాడని తెలిసి ,అలా చెయ్యొద్దని సలహా ఇస్తాడు జానకిరామయ్య. తర్వాత ఏమి జరిగిందో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే "కచ్చితమైన జవాబు" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

operation-kashmir-princess.title: Operation Kashmir Princess
operation-kashmir-princess.description: Bharat ke ek plane mein hua hai blast. Is plane mein jane wale the Chinese premier Zhou Enlai. Kya Bharat mein kisi ne rachi thi ye saazish? Kyo hua ye dhamaka? Kya R.N Kao is saazish ka pata laga payenge? Janne ke liye sunein, Operation Kashmir Princess

aayilyamkaavu.title: ആയില്യംകാവ്
aayilyamkaavu.description: മകൾ നാണിക്കുട്ടിയോടൊപ്പം ശയിക്കാൻ എത്തിയ നമ്പൂതിരിയെ നേരിടുമ്പോൾ ശേഖരപിള്ള കരുതിയില്ല, അത് വലിയൊരു യുദ്ധത്തിന് വഴിയൊരുക്കുമെന്ന്. ചാത്തന്മാരെയും ഭൂതപ്രേതാദികളെയും പ്രത്യക്ഷപെടുത്തുന്ന അതിശകതരായ മാന്ത്രികരുടെ പോരാട്ട കഥ. കേൾക്കൂ, ഏറ്റുമാനൂർ ശിവകുമാറിന്റെ മാന്ത്രിക നോവൽ- ആയില്യംകാവ്!

thaskaranmaniyanpillayude-athmakadha.title: തസ്കരൻ - മണിയൻപിള്ളയുടെ ആത്മകഥ
thaskaranmaniyanpillayude-athmakadha.description: ഒരു കള്ളന്റെ കുമ്പസാര കഥ! ഇരുളിന്റെ മറവിൽ ജീവൻ പണയപ്പെടുത്തി ചെയ്ത തൊഴിലിലെ സാഹസിക കഥകൾ മണിയന്പിളള വിവരിക്കുന്നു. അതിൽ നേരംപോക്കുണ്ട്,  കണ്ണീരും വേദനയുമുണ്ട്. കേൾക്കാം അനേകായിരങ്ങൾ വായിച്ച ഈ കഥകൾ.

bharatiya-bhooton-ki-ajeeb-dastan-1.title: Bharatiya Bhooton Ki Ajeeb Dastan -1
bharatiya-bhooton-ki-ajeeb-dastan-1.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

oru-theruvinte-katha.title: ഒരു തെരുവിന്റെ കഥ
oru-theruvinte-katha.description: ഒരു ദേശത്തിന്റെ കഥ എന്ന ക്ലാസിക്കിന് ശേഷം എസ്.കെ പൊറ്റക്കാട് രചിച്ച മനോഹരമായ നോവൽ. ഒരു തെരുവിന്റെ ചരിത്രം മുഴുവൻ മനുഷ്യരാശിയുടെയും കഥയായി മാറുന്ന എസ്.ക്കെയുടെ മാസ്റ്റർപീസ്  ആസ്വദിക്കു.

ithente-rakthamanithente-mamsamanetuthuk.title: ഇതെന്റെ രക്തമാണിതെന്റെ മാംസമാണിതെടുത്തുകൊള്ളുക
ithente-rakthamanithente-mamsamanetuthuk.description: പൊള്ളുന്ന യാഥർത്ഥ്യങ്ങളുടെ തുറന്നെഴുത്താണ് ഈ ആത്മകഥ. ആണധികാരത്തിന്റെ പൊയ്മുഖങ്ങളെ ചീന്തിയെറിയുന്ന ഉർജ്‌ജമാണ്‌ ഈ എഴുത്തിന്റെ കാതൽ. കേൾക്കാം ഏറെ ചർച്ച ചെയ്യപ്പെട്ട എച്ച്മുകുട്ടിയുടെ തുറന്നെഴുത്ത്.

mahakrantikari-mangal-pandey.title: Mahakrantikari : Mangal Pandey
mahakrantikari-mangal-pandey.description: Is audiobook mein suniye kis tarah se ek sipahi ne Bharat ki azaadi ki pehli ladai ki shuruat ki. Mangal Pandey ki veergatha aapko inspire karegi aur dikhayegi ki kaise ek vyakti ke sahas se itihaas badal sakta hai. Toh der kis baat ki? Suniye aaj hi.

-మా-నాయన్నాకు-సెప్పిన-కథలు.title: మా నాయన్నాకు సెప్పిన కథలు
-మా-నాయన్నాకు-సెప్పిన-కథలు.description: చిన్నప్పుడు అందరికకీ ఇంట్లో నాన్నో, అమ్మో ఎవరో ఒకరు కథలు చెప్తుండేవారు. అలానే ఈ కథలో ఓ కొడుక్కి వాళ్ళ నాన్న ఎన్నో కథలు చెప్పాడు. ఆ కథలు అతని మీద ఎలాంటి ప్రభావం చూపించాయి అనేది మీరు కూడా విని తెలుసుకోండి.
