-చుక్కల్ని-చూద్దాం-రండి.title: చుక్కల్ని చూద్దాం రండి
-చుక్కల్ని-చూద్దాం-రండి.description: ఖగోళ రహస్యాలు తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా? చుక్కల వెనక దాగి ఉన్న కొత్తలోకం విశేషాలు తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

sawaal-jawaab-sexpert-ke-saath.title: Sawaal Jawaab Sexpert Ke Saath
sawaal-jawaab-sexpert-ke-saath.description:
|Email : sexpert@kukufm.com|
Koi bhi sawaal sharmanak nahin hoti, khaaskar tab jab wo sex se judi ho. Toh chaahein aapke sawaal serious ho ya atrangi, bilkul bejijhak hokar hame poochiye. Hum apne sex experts ke jawaab aapke saamne laayenge aur aapki sex life ko yaadgaar banane mein koi kasar nahin chhodenge.

భూదేవి.title: భూదేవి
భూదేవి.description: ఓపెన్ కాస్ట్ భూ నిర్వాసితుల పోరాట గాథ గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? బొగ్గు కోసం బుగ్గి పాలైన ఊర్ల గోస గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "భూదేవి" కథ వినండి.

golden-rules-for-living-your-best-life.title: Golden Rules for Living Your Best Life
golden-rules-for-living-your-best-life.description:
|Key Insights - Better Living, Better Awareness, Enhanced Happiness|
Jeevan ki chunautiyon ko sweekaar karne aur apne aapko sarvottam banane ke liye Swami Mukundananda ke anmol niyamon ko jaaniye.
Har din ko behtareen banaye Swamiji ki aadhyaatmik aur preranadayak antardrishti ke saath.

നികുതി-ദായകർ-അറിയേണ്ടതെല്ലാം.title: നികുതി ദായകർ അറിയേണ്ടതെല്ലാം
നികുതി-ദായകർ-അറിയേണ്ടതെല്ലാം.description: എന്റെ നികുതി ബാധ്യത കുറയ്ക്കാൻ എന്തെങ്കിലും മാർഗങ്ങൾ ഉണ്ടോ? ജിഎസ്ടി റിട്ടേൺ ഫയൽ ചെയ്യുന്നത് എങ്ങനെയാണ്? എന്റെ വസ്തുവകകൾക്ക് ഞാൻ എത്ര സ്വത്ത് നികുതി അടയ്ക്കണം? നിങ്ങളുടെ നികുതി സംബന്ധമായ എല്ലാ സംശയങ്ങൾക്കും ഈ ഷോയിൽ ഉത്തരം ലഭിക്കും.

revenge-3.title: റിവഞ്ച്‌
revenge-3.description: അപസര്‍പ്പക നോവലുകളിലൂടെ മലയാളിയുടെ മനസിനെ കിടിലം കൊള്ളിച്ച കോട്ടയം പുഷ്പനാഥിന്റെ ത്രില്ലര്‍ നോവല്‍ റിവഞ്ച് കേള്‍ക്കാം!

motivation-307.title: Motivation
motivation-307.description: Life mein naukri ya business karne wale insaan ke liye sahi raasta aakhir kya ho sakta hai? Ye show aapko batayega ki management style ko perfect kar ke apni prouductivity kis tarah se maximise ki jaa sakti hai. Suniye abhi.

danthasimhasanam.title: ദന്തസിംഹാസനം
danthasimhasanam.description: ചരിത്രം ഇവിടെ ഒരു കഥ പോലെ ആകര്‍ഷകമാകുന്നു. തിരുവിതാംകൂ രാജവംശത്തിന്റെ ചരിത്രവും അധികാര ഇടനാഴികളിലെ ബലാബലങ്ങളും അവസാന റാണിയായിരുന്ന സേതുലക്ഷ്മിബായിയുടെ ജീവിതത്തെ കേന്ദ്രീകരിച്ച് അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്ന മനു എസ് പിള്ളയുടെ ഏറെ അപൂർവ്വതകളുളള ഒരു ചരിത്ര  ഗ്രന്ഥം.

the-business-school-4.title: The Business School
the-business-school-4.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

cricket-tandoori-with-kuku-fm.title: Cricket Tandoori with Kuku FM
cricket-tandoori-with-kuku-fm.description: IPL ki duniya se le kar T20 World Cup tak. Cricketing duniya ke funny updates jaaniye ab Bunty Singh ke saath. Yahan aapko milega entertainment, knowledge aur thoda roast. Suniye Cricket Tandoori on Kuku FM.

fearless-finances-1.title: Fearless Finances
fearless-finances-1.description: డబ్బు ఆదా చేయలేకపోతున్నారా? సంపాదించిన డబ్బును సరిగ్గా ఎలా వాడాలో తెలియట్లేదా? అయితే తప్పకుండా మీరు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే.

maryada-ramanna-charitra-samasyalu-teerp.title: మర్యాద రామన్న - చరిత్ర - సమస్యలు - తీర్పులు
maryada-ramanna-charitra-samasyalu-teerp.description: మర్యాద రామన్న అంటే నిజాయతీకి ప్రతిరూపం. ఆయన సమస్యలను ఎలా పరిష్కరించేవాడు? ఆయన తీర్పును ప్రజలు ఎందుకు గౌరవించేవారు? ఆసక్తిగా సాగే రామన్న చరిత్ర మీకోసం.

the-prophet-7.title: The Prophet
the-prophet-7.description: Pyaar kya hai? Dharm kya hai? Dhokha, Daya aur Hinsa kya hai? Janana hai aise sawalon ke jawab to suniye "Kahlil Gibran" ki likhi famous book "The Prophet".

cure-mental-illness.title: Cure Mental Illness
cure-mental-illness.description: మానసిక ఆరోగ్యాన్ని ఎలా పెంపొందించుకోవాలి? మానసికంగా ధృడంగా ఎలా అవ్వాలి? సంపూర్ణ మానసిక ఆరోగ్యానికి సలహాలు, సూచనలు మీకోసం.

rahasya-naganche.title: Rahasya Naganche
rahasya-naganche.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

colonel-jim-corbett.title: Colonel Jim Corbett
colonel-jim-corbett.description: Kaise ek shikari bana wildlife conservation ka hero? Is audio book mein milenge jawab, sath hi, dher saari adventures, jo aapke dil ko dhadka de! Toh bina waqt gawaye, shuru karte hain ek wild aur inspirational journey, Jim Corbett ke saath!

antharangada-putagalu.title: ಅಂತರಂಗದ ಪುಟಗಳು
antharangada-putagalu.description: ಅಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗದ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆಯನ್ನು ಭಾಷೆಗೆ ತುರುಕುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಗದ್ಯ ಲೇಖಕರದು. ವೈದೇಹಿ ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಬರೆದೂ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣವಾದ ಭಾಷೆ ಸಾಧಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಮಾಸ್ತಿಯವರ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಥೆ ಕಾರಂತರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಗಳ ಹಿರಿಮೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿದ್ದ ಈ ಗುಣವನ್ನು ಪ್ರಜ್ಞಾಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಮೈಗೂಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಥೆಗಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ವೈದೇಹಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು. ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯರ ಜೀವನದ ನೋಟಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಥಾ ಸಂಕಲನ.

red-heifer-prophecy.title: Red Heifers: Dharm Ya Yuddh?
red-heifer-prophecy.description: Kya aapne kabhi suna hai Red Heifers ke baare me? Kya role hai inka Israel aur Palestine ki beech ki ladai me? Kya ye ek ishara hai Jews ke third temple ki taiyari ka Ya hai bas ek aur Dharmyuddh? Aaiye sunte hain.

krouncha-pakshigalu.title: Krouncha Pakshigalu
krouncha-pakshigalu.description: "ಕನ್ನಡದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಥೆಗಾರ್ತಿ ವೈದೇಹಿ ಅವರ ಹೊಸ ಹುಡುಕಾಟಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸುವ ಸಂಕಲನ ಇದು. ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ‘ಗಂಡು’ ‘ಹೆಣ್ಣು’ಗಳು ಕೂಡಿರುವ ಒಂದು ಲೋಕವಿದೆ; ಆ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಥುನವಿರುವಂತೆಯೇ ವಿಚ್ಛೇದವೂ ಇದೆ; ಸ್ವಾರಸ್ಯದ ಮಾತುಗಾರಿಕೆಯಿರುವಷ್ಟೇ ಗಾಢವಾದ ವಿಷಾದದ ಮಂದ್ರಸ್ಥಾಯಿಯೂ ಇದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಉಲ್ಲಾಸದ ಉಬ್ಬರ ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಮೊರೆದು ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡರೆ ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಹಿಂಸೆಯ ನೆರಳು ಚಾಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

mara-gida-balli.title: ಮರ ಗಿಡ ಬಳ್ಳಿ
mara-gida-balli.description: "ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದ ಈ ಹದಿನಾಲ್ಕು ಕಥೆಗಳು, ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕವಾದ ಅನಾತುರದ ದೃಢ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಲೇಖಕಿ ಬಹು ಸಹಜವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತ ಬಂದುದನ್ನುಸ್ಫುಟವಾಗಿ ಮನಗಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಅನುಭವಗಳನ್ನು ಕಥಾರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಳುಗಟ್ಟಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದ ಜತೆಜತೆಗೇ, ಕಥೆಕಟ್ಟುವ ಚಾತುರ್ಯಕ್ಕೇ ಬಲಿಗೊಟ್ಟು ಕೊಳ್ಳದೆ, ಕಥೆಯ ಸೆರೆಯಿಂದ ಬಿಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲೂ ಹವಣೆಸುವಂಥ ಬಿಗುಪಿನ ಹದ; ತನ್ನದೇ ಸಾಚಾ ಅನುಭವಗಳನ್ನು, ಇವು ಕ್ಷುಲ್ಲಕವೆನಿಸಿಯಾವೋ ಎಂಬ ಸಂದೇಹ ಸಂಕೋಚಗಳಿಂದ ಬಾಧಿತವಾಗದೆ, ನಿಷ್ಠೆಯಿಂದ ಆಧರಿಸುವ ಹಾಗೂ ಈ ಸ್ವಂತಿಕೆಯ ಮಿತಿಯಲ್ಲೇ ತನ್ನತನವನ್ನು ಮೀರಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುವ ಸೃಜನಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆ - ಮುಂತಾಗಿ ಹಲವು ಅಪರೂಪದ ಗುಣಗಳ ಬೆಳೆವಣಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಈ ಸಂಕಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು. ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮಂದ್ರಶ್ರುತಿಯ ಸೊಬಗು ಗದ್ದಲವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಸೆಳೆಯುವಂಥದು."

royal-betrayal-3.title: Royal Betrayal
royal-betrayal-3.description: In the chaos of a deadly warzone, a woman crosses paths with the royal heir who shattered her heart — now forced to trust him for survival. As danger closes in, love and revenge collide in a race against death.

boss-intern.title: Boss Intern
boss-intern.description: She joined as an intern, never expecting to be tied to the boss by marriage. Between corporate chaos and marital secrets, every day is a test of loyalty, ambition, and love. A gripping tale where office politics meet heart politics. Watch Now!

raakasi.title: Raakasi
raakasi.description: ISO శాస్త్రవేత్త అంజలి కాళాసురుడికి పూజలు చేస్తూ, పిల్లల బలిని సమర్పిస్తుంది. కానీ ఆమె ప్రియుడు  విక్రమ్ శర్మను పొందాలని తపనతో రక్తపాతం, నిందలు, చీకటి మంత్రాల వరకూ వెళ్తుంది. ఆ సమయంలో మరో శాస్త్రవేత్త ప్రియా అంజలి–విక్రమ్ మధ్యలో అడ్డు వస్తే ఏం జరుగుతుంది? తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? మారికేందుకు ఆలస్యం వెంటనే వినండి రాకాసీ, మీ కుకు టివి లో.

mother-in-law-was-in-a-car-accident.title: Mother-in-law was in a car accident
mother-in-law-was-in-a-car-accident.description: గాయపడిన అత్తను కాపాడే ప్రయత్నంలో ఓ మనసున్న కోడలు హత్య ఆరోపణకు గురవుతుంది. భర్త మాత్రం అనుమానంతో దూరంగా ఉంటాడు. చిన్న తప్పు… కానీ భారీ శిక్ష. ప్రేమ, చట్టం, ద్రోహం మధ్య ఒంటరిగా ఆమె పోరాడుతుంది — న్యాయంకోసం… అతనికోసం.

khufiya-rishte.title: Undercover Delivery Boy
khufiya-rishte.description: When love, power, and betrayal collide, one woman rises against all odds to claim the ultimate seat of authority. Madam President is a dramatic saga of ambition, sacrifice, and destiny. Watch Now !

the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.title: The Daughter-in-Law Who Married Far Away
the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.description: ఒక శక్తివంతమైన ధనవంతురాలు, తన ప్రియమైన కుమార్తె ఆకర్షణీయంగా కనిపించే, కానీ హింసాత్మకమైన భర్త చేతుల్లో మౌనంగా నలుగుతోందని గమనిస్తుంది. ‘మదర్ ఆఫ్ రెవెంజ్’ — న్యాయం కోర్టులో కాదు… మౌనంలో, తల్లి కోపంలో అందుతుంది.

ultimate-revenge.title: Ultimate Revenge
ultimate-revenge.description: When sharp-tongued Siya Sharma’s tangled past with ruthless tycoon Kabir Malhotra resurfaces, she finds herself in the most scandalous role of her life as the mother-in-law to the man she once loved. Watch Now!

billionaire-daddy-the-hunt-is-on-6.title: Billionaire Daddy, The Hunt is On!
billionaire-daddy-the-hunt-is-on-6.description: అతను ఆమె కోసం ఎంతగానో వెదుకుతున్నాడు. ఆమె ఎలా ఉంటుందో తెలీదు. అయినా వెతుకుతున్నాడు. వాళ్ళిద్దరు కలిసారా? చూడండి Billionaire Daddy, The HUnt is on! . మీ KUKU TV లో

dear-ceo-goodbye.title: Dear CEO, Goodbye
dear-ceo-goodbye.description: A powerful CEO and his devoted secretary are bound by a secret contract and forbidden love, even as his fiancée enters the picture. Their passion, betrayal, and past secrets ignite a battle between love, loyalty, and ambition.

ek-thi-villain-1.title: Ek Thi Villain
ek-thi-villain-1.description: ISRO-র বিজ্ঞানী অঞ্জলি "কাল অসুর"-এর পূজা করে এবং বাচ্চাদের বলি দেয়। এমনকি মঙ্গল মিশনে তার "সোলমেট" বিক্রম শর্মাকে পাওয়ার জন্য রক্তপাত থেকে শুরু করে কালো জাদু পর্যন্ত করতে শুরু করে অঞ্জলি! কী হবে যখন প্রিয়া নামক আরও একজন বিজ্ঞানী এসে দাঁড়াবে অঞ্জলি ও বিক্রমের মাঝখানে?

jack-of-all-cons-1.title: Jack Of All Cons
jack-of-all-cons-1.description:
যখন এক রহস্যময় জুয়াড়ি পা রাখে শহরের সবচেয়ে ভয়ংকর ক্যাসিনোতে, তখন খেলা আর শুধু তাসের থাকে না — শুরু হয় উত্তরাধিকার, প্রতারণা আর প্রতিশোধের নিঃশব্দ যুদ্ধ।
Jack Of All Cons এক দারুণ টানটান উত্তেজনায় মোড়া কাহিনি, যেখানে প্রতিটি পদক্ষেপে লুকিয়ে থাকে অসীম ছলনা, আর প্রতিটি বাজি হয়ে ওঠে জীবন আর মৃত্যুর মাঝের সূক্ষ্ম রেখা।
চলে আসুন সেই অন্ধকার জগতে, যেখানে প্রতারণাই একমাত্র নিয়ম, আর শেষ হাসি হাসে সেই, যে সকলকে ঠকিয়েও থেকেও যায় রাজার আসনে।

emperor-yan-1.title: Emperor Yan
emperor-yan-1.description: తన identity ని గౌప్యంగా ఉంచి తన ప్రియురాలిని ఇష్టపడి పెళ్లిచేసుకున్నాడు ఓ యువకుడు, ఆ అమ్మాయి ఎదుగుదలకు వెన్నంటే ఉండి శ్రమించాడు, కానీ చివరకు అతనికి నిరాశే మిగిలింది, ఆ అమ్మాయి తన పుట్టినరోజున అతన్ని అవమానించడమే కాకుండా తన చెల్లెలు స్నేహితులతో కలిసి అతన్ని అవమానించింది. అప్పుడే ఆ యువకుడి ఎవ్వరూ అన్న నిజం బయటపడుతుంది.

the-ultimate-boss.title: The Ultimate Boss
the-ultimate-boss.description: Vedant, a hidden billionaire, sacrifices his identity for love—only to be betrayed by the very woman he trusted most. Fate binds him to powerful businesswoman Tara in a contract marriage, where love, revenge, and secrets collide. In this storm of emotions, emerges… The Ultimate Boss.

give-me-a-hug-3.title: Give me a Hug
give-me-a-hug-3.description:
After fleeing an abusive home as a child, a young girl disappears without a trace. Her elder brother, bound by love and regret, spends twenty years searching for her and finally brings her back.
But the home she returns to has changed. Her mother, younger brother, and foster sister reject her presence, unwilling to accept the past she carries. This is a story of enduring love, painful reunions, and the quiet resilience of a family learning to heal one fractured bond at a time.

star-moon-romance-rejected-and-reborn-as.title: Star Moon Romance : Rejected And Reborn As Alpha
star-moon-romance-rejected-and-reborn-as.description: She lost her parents, was rejected by her brother, and had her heart shattered by Asta — the one who once called her “Luna.” Branded a loser and treated like nothing more than a blood bank, she rose when the Moon Goddess awakened the Alpha within her. Star Moon Romance is a fierce tale of transformation — from rejection to redemption, and a girl’s rise to become the Alpha no one saw coming.

four-seas-3.title: Four Seas
four-seas-3.description: In a world where poverty, gambling, and broken dreams collide, one man fights to redeem himself and rebuild his family. Four Seas is an emotional rollercoaster about second chances, resilience, and the price of mistakes. Tune in to witness a journey of loss, hope, and transformation across time. Watch Now!

revenge-in-second-life-1.title: Revenge In Second Life
revenge-in-second-life-1.description: The microdrama centers on Abira, a child whose identity is shrouded in mystery from birth, having been orphaned and replaced while her biological mother, Meghna, endured years of captivity. Unaware of Abira's existence, Varun, her biological father, later receives thousands of letters detailing her secret birth and arduous life. Upon their eventual encounter, Abira claims Varun as her father, leading to a profound, inexplicable paternal bond despite initial challenges like foster care intervention and Varun's health crisis. However, Varun's partner, Tushita, vehemently denies Abira's claims, hinting at a hidden past, while manipulative figures like Pallavi work to erase memories of Abira's mother. Abira is later abandoned and subsequently endures relentless emotional abuse and domestic servitude from her stepmother, Sambhabana, and stepbrother. False accusations lead to Abira's expulsion from her home and Varun disowning her, believing she is not his biological daughter, as a 'New Child' vies for his affection. Abira's biological mother, Pulokit, emerges, vowing to uncover the truth behind the 'other Abira' and Sambhabana's sinister plot to marry Varun. Varun's life is further complicated by the appearance of Lakshita, Tushita's identical twin, who seeks to uncover the truth behind her sister's mysterious death, casting suspicion on Varun and Abira. Amidst these revelations, Abira becomes a target in a revenge plot, while a mysterious protector emerges for her. Varun's critically ill condition leads Sambhabana to make a horrifying sacrifice to secure a heart for him, prompting Varun's mother to demand their marriage. Driven by Abira's plea and obligation, Varun agrees, but their wedding is dramatically halted by an uninvited guest and the threat of a DNA test. Sambhabana's manipulative deceptions are exposed, revealing paternity fraud and her framing of Lakshita for murder, all while obsessively pursuing Varun and targeting his children. Varun grapples with guilt over past rejections of his biological daughter, Abira, and ultimately sacrifices himself to protect his brother, Abir, leaving his fate uncertain. The narrative culminates in the shocking revelation that Varun had abandoned Tushita to a mental asylum on their wedding day, causing years of separation from their daughter, Amira. A confession from Tushita's Aunty reveals she orchestrated this separation, leading to Varun's medical crisis. Miraculously, Varun recovers, reunites with Tushita and Amira, and seeks heartfelt forgiveness, offering a second chance at their love and family amidst the unraveling conspiracies and a desperate search for truth and redemption.

ek-pregnancy-mera-dil-le-gayi.title: Love By Chance
ek-pregnancy-mera-dil-le-gayi.description: When 19-year-old Isha discovers she is mysteriously pregnant, her own family abandons her. A chance encounter with billionaire Shikhar Ahuja changes her fate, but living under his roof draws her into scandal, betrayal, and danger — until his son Dhruv becomes the unexpected protector of her unborn children… and her heart.

the-awakening-3.title: The Awakening
the-awakening-3.description:
When ancient curses bleed into modern chaos, a forgotten warrior awakens. Raghav, reborn with lost powers, must protect the woman he loves amid a storm of betrayal and political war.
But to save the future, he must first conquer the shadows of a past he can barely remember.

the-lost-heir-rises.title: The Lost Heir Rises
the-lost-heir-rises.description:
Paralyzed in body but not in spirit, Raj lay broken — but Maya stood tall, unyielding. She battled fate, poverty, and pride, carrying his hope through every closed door and sleepless night.
And when he rose again, it wasn’t just a miracle — it was a tribute to her unshakable love.

operation-queen-fall.title: College Wala Love
operation-queen-fall.description: When elite intelligence officer Major Rudra Pratap Singh uncovers a covert threat to national security, he must lead Operation Queen Fall—a high-risk mission to dismantle an international espionage ring led by the enigmatic and deadly Aaliya Raza. As betrayals surface and loyalties are tested, Rudra races against time to stop a catastrophe that could rewrite global power dynamics.

i-am-the-women-of-the-jianghu.title: I AM THE WOMEN OF THE JIANGHU
i-am-the-women-of-the-jianghu.description: I AM THE WOMEN OF THE JIANGHU

my-cold-blooded-alpha-king-3.title: My Cold Blooded Alpha King
my-cold-blooded-alpha-king-3.description: Anya, an adventurous heiress, discovers her blood holds a unique antidote, making her a target for menacing creatures and a formidable enemy named Magnus. Rescued by the powerful Alpha King Logan Roy, Anya finds herself under his ruthless protection, a situation she initially resents despite his past interventions. Her protective father, desperate for her safety, forces her into a reluctant alliance with Logan, leading to a contract-like arrangement. As Anya struggles for independence against Logan's possessive dominance, she uncovers a blood-stained painting of her late father in Logan's chambers, hinting at a deeper, mysterious past connecting them. Meanwhile, Logan grapples with a hidden "Wolf" identity, a family secret, and his dying father's command to embrace ruthlessness and secure his pack's legacy amidst a deadly virus affecting werewolves. Their fated mate bond develops, but Logan fiercely resists it due to his leadership responsibilities, further complicated by accusations from Jacob regarding Anya's father's death. Anya is assigned rigorous training to become a warrior, striving for survival and strength in this demanding world. The relationship is challenged by the dramatic return of Catherine, Logan's powerful and obsessive ex-flame, who schemes to claim him through pack politics and ancient rituals. Alpha Larry, a relentless rival, orchestrates Logan's grave poisoning with a magical virus, forcing Anya to race against time to find a cure, deepening their bond. However, Catherine successfully manipulates events, leading Logan to publicly cast Anya aside for her, influenced by a potion and strategic alliances. Heartbroken and with fragmented memories, Anya is abducted by a destructive faction, while Logan grapples with the betrayal and vows to uncover the truth orchestrated by the enigmatic Kaadaran. Logan confronts Catherine about her jealousy and betrayal, and she is captured by a demon who reveals the deception surrounding her past with Logan. As an impending war looms, Alpha Larry declares conflict against Logan's group, betraying multiple packs and seeking strategic alliances. Alpha King Logan fiercely protects Luna/Anya and their community from the devastating virus and rival Alpha factions, solidifying their evolving bond and his unwavering leadership.

mr-santa-i-want-you-2.title: Mr. Santa, I Want You!
mr-santa-i-want-you-2.description: A young woman named Bridget meets a mysterious man who claims to be Santa Claus. Bridget is struggling with her financial situation and the expectations of her family, while "Mr. Santa" offers her a glimpse into a different, more magical reality. The film explores themes of love, fate, and finding happiness even amid life's challenges.

verrbhumi-the-cursed-princess.title: Verrbhumi & The Cursed Princess
verrbhumi-the-cursed-princess.description: For centuries, Princess Ishani has guarded Veerbhumi, cursed to lose her powers in every battle—awaiting her Divine Emperor. Her search ends when fate ties her to Arihant, an ordinary man with a fiery daughter. But as demons rise and his own brother turns against him, Arihant’s hidden destiny awakens. From betrayal to death itself, he rises to destroy the darkness, claim his crown, and unite with Ishani as the prophesied Divine Emperor.

ruthless-comeback-of-the-reborn-heiress-.title: Ruthless Comeback Of The Reborn Heiress
ruthless-comeback-of-the-reborn-heiress-.description: తన చెల్లెలు చేత మోసపోయి, అన్యాయంగా నిందించబడిన గ్రేస్ బ్రేలన్ బాధతో మరణిస్తుంది. కానీ తీవ్రమైన నొప్పితో మళ్ళీ పుడుతుంది.  ఆమె హృదయంలో రగులుతున్నది ఉన్నది ఒక్కటే — ప్రతీకారం.

desh-ki-beti.title: Desh ki Beti
desh-ki-beti.description:
In a world where love and betrayal walk hand in hand, one girl’s journey transforms her from innocence to unstoppable power.
Her past is filled with pain, her present with determination, and her future with destiny.
She rises against all odds not just to survive, but to conquer.
A story of sacrifice, resilience, and revenge… where every secret has a price, and every truth changes everything.

you-are-like-the-wind-passing-by-my-pill.title: You Are like the Wind Passing by My Pillow
you-are-like-the-wind-passing-by-my-pill.description:
Stella adored her husband George — until love turned into betrayal. While she trusted blindly, he lived a double life of lies, crime, and secret affairs, using her as a perfect cover.
But when the truth unravels, Stella must decide seek revenge or vanish — leaving George to face the storm he created.

say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-3.title: Say I Love You When We Meet Again
say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-3.description: ఈ షో, ఒకటి కాకుండా విడిపోయిన ఓ ప్రేమజంట కథను చెబుతుంది. కాలానికీ, పరిస్థితులకీ బలి అయిన వారిద్దరూ, ఏళ్ల తరబడి విడిపోయిన తర్వాత, విస్మరించలేని ప్రేమను మరియు బాధతో నిండిన రహస్యాలను మళ్లీ ఎదుర్కొంటారు. గతాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటున్న ఈ జంట, ప్రేమకి రెండో అవకాశమివ్వాలా వద్దా అనే నిర్ణయం తీసుకోవాల్సి ఉంటుంది.

stop-pretending-miss-gu-will-expose-ever.title: Stop Pretending! Miss Gu will Expose Everything
stop-pretending-miss-gu-will-expose-ever.description: Chitra enters the jewelry world determined to earn respect through work rather than rely on the Alluri family name. That choice places her inside a status-obsessed workplace where identity mix-ups, gossip, and class prejudice quickly shape how others treat her. Jenny repeatedly benefits from confusion around who is the real heiress, while Chitra is left to defend her dignity and prove she belongs. Early conflicts over sketches, bracelets, and workplace authority establish a pattern of public humiliation and private resentment. The story expands into luxury spaces such as cafes, storage rooms, wine cellars, and boutique settings, where expensive objects become symbols of control and hidden truth. Chitra is repeatedly linked to missing or disputed items, including a bottle tied to her grandfather and marriage vow, a jade pendant, and design drafts that others claim as their own. At the same time, the show introduces a romantic and emotional mystery around Manoj, whose protection of Chitra is mixed with suspicion, authority, and unresolved history. Flashbacks and clues suggest a childhood promise between them, making their present conflict feel personal as well as professional. Public accusations of drugging, contract sabotage, plagiarism, and immoral behavior keep pushing Chitra into defensive battles. Manoj often steps in as both protector and investigator, but his role is not always clear, and his closeness to Jenny adds further tension. Jenny’s position also becomes unstable as her background, her connection to Manoj, and her use of status are exposed in stages. Corporate and family power struggles widen the conflict, with committees, executives, and elders all trying to control the narrative. Design contests and jewelry competitions raise the stakes, turning creative work into a battlefield for reputation and inheritance. Several public events briefly elevate Chitra, including recognition as a winner, but each victory is followed by renewed challenge or accusation. Threats grow darker as blackmail, violence, and a drugged-car trap enter the story, showing that the struggle is no longer only social but dangerous. By the end of the batch digests, truth is still contested, alliances remain unstable, and the central fight over identity, ownership, and trust is unresolved.

immortal-for-3000-years.title: Immortal for 3000 Years
immortal-for-3000-years.description: Immortal for 3000 is a supernatural action drama where ancient Indian mythology collides with the modern world. The story follows Rishi Vedant, a yogi who awakens after 3000 years of penance, only to find himself in the chaos of Kalyug. Gifted with divine powers, Vedant must confront dark forces, black magic, and betrayal while protecting humanity from rising evil. As he navigates modern society and forms unexpected bonds, his true test begins—facing both external demons and the shadows hidden in human greed and desire.

the-rise-begins-with-perspective.title: The Rise Begins With Perspective
the-rise-begins-with-perspective.description: ఒక యువకుడు అనుకోని విధంగా అసాధారణ శక్తులు పొందుతాడు. ఆ శక్తులతో అతని జీవితం పూర్తిగా మారిపోతుంది. ఇది ఓ సాధారణ యువకుడి నుంచి ఒక అసాధారణ కథానాయకుడిగా మారిన ప్రయాణం.

married-to-a-mystery-1.title: Married to a Mystery
married-to-a-mystery-1.description: Janya, a spirited jewelry designer, is compelled into an arranged court marriage with the unassuming Raj Agarwal due to her mother's feigned terminal illness, despite her yearning for true love. Unbeknownst to Janya, Raj is secretly Raj Singhania, the powerful CEO of Supernova Industries, meticulously concealing his immense wealth and identity. Their unconventional union is immediately challenged by Janya's arrogant ex-boyfriend, Abhishek, who, fueled by jealousy, disparages Raj and vows revenge, later discovering Raj's true identity and facing ruin. As Janya grapples with fragmented memories and a past accusation of design theft, Raj subtly orchestrates events to bring her talents into his company, while his brother and friend Divya navigate the dangerous web of deception surrounding Raj's true identity and Janya's forgotten history. Janya's career at Supernova is marked by confrontation with her boss and an intervention against arrogant heir Rohit Kapoor, who becomes obsessed with her. This obsession leads to Janya's abduction, prompting Raj Singhania to unleash brutal revenge on Rohit, unknowingly igniting a corporate war with Rohit's father, Ronit Kapoor. Throughout these conflicts, Raj Singhania secretly protects Janya, who remains unaware of his true power and their secret marriage. A blackmailer threatens to expose Janya's scandalous past, including a pre-marital affair and a hidden child, but Raj masterfully neutralizes the threat. Janya, rising to Chief Designer after exposing a plagiarist, suffers an accident, leading to the devastating discovery of infertility and the truth about a child she doesn't remember, given away by her mother. Janya and Raj confront their deepest secrets, including Raj's knowledge of the blackmail and Janya's past, ultimately strengthening their bond. Janya eventually discovers her husband's true identity as the CEO of Supernova. They confront the foundational deception in their marriage, leading to Raj's confession and a re-proposal. The couple embarks on a hopeful path towards rebuilding their bond on honesty, while the search for Janya's lost child looms.

my-ex-husbands-breakdown-after-divorce-3.title: My Ex-Husband's Breakdown After Divorce
my-ex-husbands-breakdown-after-divorce-3.description: When she walked away, he thought she’d crumble. But as she flourished, his world collapsed. My Ex-Husband's Breakdown After Divorce is a raw tale of toxic love, missed chances, and a man haunted by the woman he let go. Watch Now!

lucky-dragon-heavenly-fortune.title: Lucky Dragon: Heavenly Fortune
lucky-dragon-heavenly-fortune.description: A millionaire working undercover as a food delivery man tries to reclaim his wealth after revealing his true identity, but his relatives try to stop him. The story unfolds around who ultimately wins in the end.

parcel-to-paradise.title: Parcel to Paradise
parcel-to-paradise.description: The series opens in a chaotic urban warzone, introducing CEO Vivaan Mehra and single mother Diksha, both pressured into arranged marriages. To escape their families, Vivaan proposes a one-month contract marriage to Diksha, who eventually accepts, unaware of his immense wealth and his secret quest for a mysterious woman from his past. Vivaan, while maintaining a hidden identity, subtly influences Diksha's career, leading to her mysterious advancement despite professional hurdles. Their fragile arrangement is complicated by the unexpected appearance of a young girl, Pihu, whose paternity is questioned, leading to tension with Vivaan's mother. Diksha's suspicions grow as she investigates the elusive CEO of Mehra Group, who shares her companion's name. The deception shatters when Diksha discovers her 'salesman' husband is the powerful CEO, and a public confrontation reveals she was a pawn in his corporate schemes. Humiliated and betrayed, Diksha leaves Vivaan and his company, attempting to reclaim a simple life, but finds herself trapped by his influence. Pihu then faces a life-threatening medical emergency requiring expensive surgery and a rare blood transfusion, forcing Diksha to reluctantly accept Vivaan's financial and blood donation. During this crisis, Vivaan proposes a paternity test, while another man also proposes to Diksha, creating a complex love triangle. The narrative escalates when a desperate businessman, Prakash, kidnaps Diksha and the critically ill Pihu for ransom, blaming Vivaan for his company's downfall. This forces Vivaan into a desperate race against time to save his family, during which his own dark past as a 'gunda' is exposed. A shocking paternity test confirms Vivaan is Pihu's biological father, and Diksha is revealed to be the mysterious woman from his past. The series culminates in a violent confrontation with Prakash, leading to Vivaan's confession to Diksha about their shared history and Pihu's parentage, ultimately uniting their family amidst the resolved deceptions.

destined-to-meet-you-5.title: Destined to Meet You
destined-to-meet-you-5.description: The microdrama centers on the intertwined fates of Rachel, her son Isaac, and the powerful Smith/David family, all entangled in a web of stolen identities, hidden parentage, and a mysterious ancestral locket. The narrative begins with Rachel's desperate escape from the Lobo family, who target her for disgrace, and her acquisition of a significant locket, which becomes a focal point for future conflicts. Concurrently, the lives of twin boys, Isaac and Yuvraj/Ethan, separated at birth, are introduced through escalating schoolyard disputes that expose deep-seated class struggles and power imbalances, with Ethan's privileged father, CEO Smith David, manipulating the system against Isaac. The return of Isaac's protective father, David/Peter, who refuses to marry Isaac's mother until the locket is found, hints at a profound, concealed history. As the story progresses, a bitter feud erupts between Rachel and Sarah over the locket, unearthing accusations of child theft and challenging Isaac's paternity. David, recalling a past encounter with Rachel and the locket, begins to suspect Isaac is his son due to a striking resemblance, leading him to orchestrate a paternity test. The truth unravels with the shocking revelation of a baby swap between Ethan and Sarah's son, Isaac, born on the same day, and the discovery that David's partner, Sarah, stole Rachel's identity and kidnapped one of their twin sons, Ethan, years prior out of jealousy. Rachel suffers critical injuries in a raging inferno, falling into a coma, and later learns she had twins, Ethan and Isaac, and that Sarah orchestrated Ethan's abduction at birth. The emotional fallout for Ethan, upon discovering his abduction and facing rejection from Isaac, further fractures the family. Sarah/Sara, a cunning and manipulative figure, continues her schemes, attempting to frame Isaac for theft and even murder, coercing Ethan into her plots to secure inheritance. Amidst these betrayals, Smith David fiercely protects his sons and uncovers Sara's elaborate ruses. Rachel, recovering, battles prejudice and fights to reclaim her stolen child, while a guilt-ridden Isaac seeks redemption by helping her. The series culminates in David defending his true wife, Rachel, and legitimate son, Isaac, against Sara's slander, ultimately exposing her deceit. Isaac, having slowly accepted Smith David, intervenes to protect Rachel during Sara's rampage and proposes marriage, solidifying their bond amidst the chaos and the family's journey towards healing and reclaiming their rightful places.

paralysed-dulha.title: Paralysed Dulha
paralysed-dulha.description: The microdrama centers on Kavya, a woman forced into a contract marriage with the comatose CEO Abhinav Goyal to save her family from financial ruin and secure her ailing father's medical treatment. Upon Abhinav's awakening, he is enraged by the forced union and his mother's corporate manipulations, leading to a fierce power struggle within the family and company. Abhinav's manipulative brother, Daksh, emerges as an antagonist, accusing Kavya of mercenary motives and attempting to expose her past, while Kavya's true intentions are tragically misinterpreted as greed. Despite the transactional nature of their union and Abhinav's initial cynicism, Kavya's unexpected loyalty and defiance begin to shift his perception, hinting at a complex and evolving relationship. It is later revealed that Abhinav faked a disability to expose a family conspiracy and reclaim his rightful position from his CEO uncle, Naresh, who is also known as Mama Ji. Kavya, also known as Swati, uncovers a dark conspiracy behind a revolutionary AI project linked to her father's murder and a missing prototype. This discovery further tests her fragile trust in Abhinav, as she questions if their marriage was part of a larger plot. An audio recording exposes Naresh/Mama Ji and Yuvraj's wife's conspiracy, revealing a murder and a plot against Abhinav. United by their shared history of betrayal and a growing bond, Abhinav and Swati embark on a relentless quest for vengeance and justice against their wrongdoers. They execute a power play to reclaim a family home and expose Mama Ji's past betrayals and attempted murder. The narrative culminates with Abhinav and Swati declaring their love and committing to building a future together, while Swati's groundbreaking AI firm merges with CEO Daksh's corporate empire, hinting at new professional and romantic entanglements.

a-vow-of-joy-and-sorrow-4.title: A Vow of Joy and Sorrow
a-vow-of-joy-and-sorrow-4.description: Roger Nandalal, an abstinent CEO, cannot survive New Year's Eve because of his Yang body. However, he unexpectedly discovered that Brenda Cameron, a poor college student, was the only person in the world who can cure his Yin body. To survive, Roger married Brenda domineeringly. After learning that Brenda's life would be in danger after curing him, Roger, who slowly fell in love with Brenda, was faced with a painful choice between life and death. Watch Now!

jerk-punishment-club-3.title: Jerk Punishment Club
jerk-punishment-club-3.description: A young woman, known for her bravery, forms a secret society to punish those who mistreat women, to avenge the injustice done to her older sister.

hidden-love-1.title: Mera Shaitaan Boyfriend
hidden-love-1.description: Shanaya ki zindagi ek mod leti hai jab wo ek rahasyaamay aur shaitani quwat wale aadmi, Arjun, se takraati hai. Uski zindagi pyaar, darr aur andhere ke aise khel mein ulajh jaati hai jahan har jazba usse aur gehra kheenchta hai.

the-devil-wears-desire-3.title: The Devil Wears Desire
the-devil-wears-desire-3.description: Anna becomes CEO Ian’s secret lover to save her boyfriend, Louis, but is abandoned by Ian and later dates playboy David. After being forced into marriage with crime lord Domenico, Anna is kidnapped, prompting Ian and Louis to team up and rescue her. Amid dark secrets and intense rivalries, Anna must choose between four men to find true love.

the-heiress-returns.title: The Heiress Returns
the-heiress-returns.description: The Heiress Returns is a gripping drama about a woman who comes back to reclaim her family’s legacy after years of betrayal and loss. Her return shakes old secrets, ignites rivalries, and sets the stage for revenge and redemption.

the-arrogant-tyrants-runaway-wife-5.title: The Arrogant Tyrant's Runaway Wife
the-arrogant-tyrants-runaway-wife-5.description: The microdrama begins with Myra, a pregnant woman, publicly shamed and abandoned by her fiancé, John, who denies paternity, leading to her presumed death and an unresolved mystery. Five years later, Myra resurfaces under various identities, a single mother determined to find the biological father of her twins. Her quest leads her to CEO Jack Wilcox, a powerful figure who soon encounters a young boy bearing an uncanny resemblance to him, hinting at a secret child. Myra infiltrates Jack's corporation, sparking a tense power struggle with him and ambitious heiress Tina, while navigating corporate sabotage and public humiliation. As their complex relationship deepens, Jack discovers he is the biological father of Myra's children, often using them as leverage to force Myra into a volatile marriage, demanding her compliance through debt and threats. Myra is caught between Jack's possessive control, John's obsessive return, and the vengeful schemes of ex-lover Nigel, all while defying a powerful Godfather figure. A critical medical crisis arises when their daughter, Luna, is diagnosed with blood cancer, forcing Jack to secretly donate bone marrow, a sacrifice that ultimately reveals his true paternity and hidden devotion. Despite betrayals and manipulation, Myra consistently fights for her children's safety and her own agency, orchestrating escapes and counter-schemes. Their tumultuous journey culminates in the rekindling of their love, the revelation of their secret marriage, and Jack's ultimate sacrifice of his company to secure his family's future and gain acceptance from Myra's powerful, traditional father. The series explores themes of hidden identities, paternity mysteries, corporate intrigue, and the enduring fight for family and freedom against overwhelming odds.

rented-boyfriend.title: Rented Husband
rented-boyfriend.description: একজন রহস্যময় কোটিপতি তার আসল পরিচয় গোপন করে এবং তার পারিবারিক ব্যবসা বাঁচানোর চেষ্টায় একজন মহিলার সাথে চুক্তিবদ্ধ বিবাহে সম্মত হয়, কিন্তু তার লোভী আত্মীয়দের কাছ থেকে অবিরাম অপমানের মুখোমুখি হয়। কিন্তু রহস্য উন্মোচিত হওয়ার সাথে সাথে, গর্ব, ভালোবাসা এবং প্রতিশোধের এই আবেগঘন রোলারকোস্টারের পটভূমিতে ঘটে যায় এক বিপুল পরিবর্তন ।

post-divorce.title: Post Divorce
post-divorce.description: The microdrama begins with Reet, an ordinary woman, whose life is upended by her husband's betrayal and divorce, leading her to accept a contract marriage with wealthy CEO Vihan Kapoor. Vihan, battling depression and seeking to avoid an arranged union, finds unexpected solace and a deepening connection with Reet, despite his heart initially belonging to an online love, Navvi. Their fragile bond is immediately tested by formidable rivals like Khushi Wadhwa, who relentlessly attempts to separate them through public humiliation, high-stakes auctions, and manipulative schemes, sparking dangerous family feuds and corporate intrigues. Concurrently, Reet navigates a strained relationship with her controlling father and struggles to conceal her true identity as the elusive artist 'Miss Nayab,' facing intense opposition from Vihan's family who view her as a gold-digger. As Vihan fiercely defends Reet against his family's manipulative schemes and attempts to force him into another marriage, their connection strengthens, hinting at a hidden past. However, Reet's identity as "Miss Nayab" and the adopted daughter of the powerful Bundela family is publicly exposed, leading to her shaming and expulsion. It is then revealed that Reet and Vihan (formerly Veer) share a fated past, having unknowingly inspired each other through art, which culminated in their contractual marriage. Their relationship faces further peril when Reet is violently abducted by Khushi's captors, who demand she divorce Vihan, disbelieving their marriage is merely a contract. Corporate intrigue escalates as Vihan's company faces sabotage, his brother is forced to sacrifice his legacy, and Rajat seizes control of the Kapoor empire through betrayal. The secret of Vihan and Reet's contractual marriage is publicly exposed, causing corporate shares to plummet and igniting a fierce family battle led by Vihan's imposing mother, who blames Reet for their losses. Despite losing everything, Vihan fiercely defends Reet, refusing separation and reaffirming her irreplaceable importance in his life. The narrative shifts as heiress Reet reluctantly returns to lead the Bundela Group, immediately confronting a bitter sibling rivalry and thwarting Vishal's elaborate plot to usurp Vivaan's (Vihan's) life and business. Unbeknownst to Vivaan, Reet is secretly the powerful heiress his formidable mother demands he marry to save their family, orchestrating a dangerous game against her manipulative CEO father. This deception culminates in Reet's return to reclaim her legacy, where Mr. Kapoor (Vihan), initially part of her father's "fake marriage" test, defies the patriarch by declaring his genuine love for Reet, risking his business and family. The show concludes with Reet challenging Mr. Kapoor to transform their pragmatic arrangement into a real union, leading to a heartfelt public proposal and joyous acceptance, signifying their triumph over betrayal, corporate machinations, and familial opposition.

pehle-badla-phir-mohabbat-1.title: Pehle Badla Phir Mohabbat
pehle-badla-phir-mohabbat-1.description: তৃতীয় বিবাহবার্ষিকীতে আনন্দের আয়োজন হঠাৎ এক শাস্তির দৃশ্যে পরিণত হয়। স্বামী জনসমক্ষে স্ত্রীকে অপমান করে তুচ্ছ করে। কিন্তু এই স্ত্রী আসলে ছদ্মবেশধারী। তিনি শহরের সবথেকে ধনী ব্যক্তির কন্যা, এতদিন ছিলেন নিজের পরিচয় লুকিয়ে। আর তার পরিবারেরও আসল সম্পদের উৎস তিনিই। এক ঝটকায় তিনি অদৃশ্য হয়ে যান, ফিরে আসেন এক নতুন পরিচয়ে। তারপরই গল্প মোড় নিতে থাকে অন্য এক দিকে।

sharabi-fighter.title: Cheater No.1
sharabi-fighter.description: Smooth-talking conman Karan Malhotra lives by one rule—cheat before you get cheated. But when he targets bold and brainy Naina, things don’t go according to plan. As Karan juggles lies, identities, and a growing attraction, he finds himself trapped in a hilarious and dangerous game where love might just be the biggest scam of all. Watch Now!

the-hidden-dragon-returns-to-the-village.title: The Hidden Dragon Returns to the Village
the-hidden-dragon-returns-to-the-village.description: The Hidden Dragon Returns to the Village - Telugu

my-mother-is-a-royal-guard-3.title: My Mother Is A Royal Guard
my-mother-is-a-royal-guard-3.description: A strict mother, who trains her daughter while working for powerful firms, pushes her child to the brink — but when danger strikes, she defies her ruthless employers to protect the daughter she once seemed so harsh on. An intense audio story of tough love, betrayal, and a mother’s ultimate sacrifice.

time-travelling-cute-baby.title: Time-Travelling Cute Baby
time-travelling-cute-baby.description: At the moment of a wealthy tycoon's wedding, a group of children suddenly appears, claiming to be his offspring. The astonished man cannot recall anything, but they identify themselves as his twin children. This dramatic revelation unveils a mysterious past that changes everything.

the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.title: The Daughter-in-Law Who Married Far Away
the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.description: A wealthy and powerful mother discovers that her beloved daughter is silently suffering under the hands of a charming but abusive husband. Watch Mother of Revenge — where justice isn’t served in court, but in silence, strategy, and a mother’s unstoppable rage.

dad-love-me-again-1.title: Dad, Love Me Again
dad-love-me-again-1.description: A palace maid with a mysterious past rises through the imperial court, navigating love, betrayal, and political intrigue. As secrets unfold, she must choose between loyalty to the empire and her own survival.

the-arrival-of-a-young-lady.title: The arrival of a young lady
the-arrival-of-a-young-lady.description: The arrival of the young lady

silent-shadow.title: Silent Shadow
silent-shadow.description: The microdrama centers on Abhay, an orphaned Rajput noble raised as the skilled warrior Aarav, whose destiny intertwines with Alia, an independent heiress. Alia defies patriarchal traditions and an arranged marriage to Vikrant, orchestrated by her manipulative uncle. Aarav, despite his humble origins, repeatedly protects Alia from threats like the ruthless Rana, revealing a hidden strength and a personal vendetta, all while a conspiracy brews around the "Gatka Super Power Energy." Alia is unwittingly drawn into a dangerous web of corporate intrigue and family secrets, primarily orchestrated by her guardian, Harshvardhan, who manipulates both her and Aarav. Harshvardhan schemes to control Alia's life and business, subtly turning them against Rekha Tai, a mysterious healer believed to harbor vital secrets connected to "GSP energy" and the Rathore legacy. Aarav transforms into an investigator, uncovering a sinister conspiracy involving Rekha and the powerful Rathore family, realizing with Alia that their wills are being controlled. A forbidden love emerges between Alia and Aarav amidst these revelations, even as Alia is forced to betray Aarav under duress, planting a device. Harshvardhan's intricate plans to uncover "Shakti ka raaz" are compromised by an unknown adversary, leading to a high-stakes tournament where Aarav strategically escalates his rivalry with Vikrant. Aarav, revealed as the last scion of the Rathore clan, awakens electrifying powers and Gatkabazi skills, becoming a prime target for a powerful, shadowy organization seeking his elimination. As Aarav faces severe injury and relentless pursuit, Aaliya and the healer Rekha race against time to protect him, forging deep bonds of loyalty. Aaliya is brutally captured and tortured by an obsessive man but fiercely refuses to betray Aarav, prompting Aarav to resolve to rescue her. The Rathore family saga intensifies as the formidable matriarch, Amma (also referred to as Buaji/Bua Dadi), faces challenges to her tyrannical reign, having murdered Aarav's father and attempted to kill his mother for power. Radha, a survivor, returns to expose Amma's betrayals. Aarav and Alya are compelled to flee by his mother's ultimate sacrifice during a brutal conflict, leading Aarav to train in the sacred Gatka martial art. He ultimately confronts and defeats his power-hungry matriarch, asserting his inner strength over her tyrannical ambition and protecting the Gatka legacy, though a larger war against formidable enemies is implied.

cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-4.title: Cloaked In Power : His Secret Identity
cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-4.description: He is no ordinary man; he has a mysterious past where he had superpower. But in the daily life he wishes to live an ordinary life as a driver. He accidentally meets a beautiful woman, a CEO, and that eventually leads to a one nightstand, leading towards thrilling twists and turns.

mr-ji-see-clearly-im-your-bodyguard-2.title: Mr. Ji, See Clearly, I'm Your Bodyguard
mr-ji-see-clearly-im-your-bodyguard-2.description: పెళ్లి అనవసరమని భావించిన ఆమె, అర్ధరాత్రి ఇంటినుంచి పారిపోయింది. పొట్టకూటికై పురుషుడిగా బాడీగార్డ్ గా చేరుతుంది. ఆమె కాపాడే వ్యక్తే… అసలైన వరుడు అన్న విషయం తెలియదు!

chehre-aur-naqaab.title: Ek Anokha Rishta
chehre-aur-naqaab.description: Cold-hearted billionaire Vikram Mehra and struggling singer Sunita are forced into a sudden contract marriage under unexpected circumstances. As their worlds collide, one of wealth, secrets, and control, the other of dreams, resilience, and warmth this unlikely bond sparks real emotions. But when fake vows start feeling real, love becomes the most unpredictable twist of all.

a-heartbeat-away-3.title: A Heartbeat Away
a-heartbeat-away-3.description: The microdrama begins with Katy's materialistic rejection of Shaun Curry, her fiancé, for the wealthy Sonu, a decision that immediately leads to Katy's subsequent pregnancy and a harsh confrontation with Sonu's domineering mother, Elaine. This early betrayal sets a painful precedent, leaving Shaun heartbroken and fueling his future ambition. Years later, Shaun, now a powerful CEO, resurfaces, driven by the profound heartbreak of their past and his own burning ambition, setting the stage for a dramatic reunion with Katy, now an intern, and revealing their deeply unresolved history. Shaun, operating under various aliases such as Kari and Sean, initially targets Katy's company and subjects her to demeaning tasks, openly revealing a deep-seated personal vendetta and a calculated post-breakup revenge. However, his actions are profoundly complex; he simultaneously fiercely protects her from manipulative superiors, promotes her after discovering her hidden design talent, and dramatically intervenes to declare himself her sole protector, hinting at a profound and conflicted romantic tension that defines their dynamic. Katy, often denying their past connection and navigating a secret romance with her boss, Sean, finds herself entangled in his complex personal life, which includes a tense marriage and an impending engagement to another woman. She endures public humiliation, corporate espionage, and profound personal betrayals, including a tragic miscarriage and later, her father's corporate downfall, which leads to her public disgrace and disappearance. The stakes for Katy are high, as she fights to protect her career, her reputation, and her personal life amidst relentless pressure. Shaun, relentless in his pursuit, orchestrates an opulent reunion, showering her with lavish gifts to win her back, and after a terrifying car accident, confesses his enduring love, revealing his entire rise to success was solely to find her. He eventually proposes marriage, offering his immense fortune and a simple ring, which Katy accepts, signifying a pivotal turning point in their tumultuous relationship and a commitment to a shared future. Their journey is fraught with high-stakes corporate battles, dangerous conspiracies, and violent interruptions to their attempts at reconciliation, forcing them into a fight for survival against formidable adversaries. Amidst these relentless challenges, Katy unexpectedly rises to become the new CEO of Seagull Wedding Dresses, demonstrating her own formidable strength and resilience in the cutthroat corporate world. Their rekindled romance receives a heartfelt blessing from a mother figure, solidifying their commitment with a cherished family heirloom and tickets for a post-nuptial journey. The narrative culminates in their engagement and the joyous revelation that they are expecting twins, signifying an unbreakable bond and a future filled with profound commitment and happiness, even as the lingering hints of future corporate and personal challenges suggest their complex story is far from truly over. The show explores themes of love, betrayal, ambition, and redemption, as two individuals navigate a world where personal and professional lives are inextricably intertwined.

scandal-with-ceo.title: Scandal with CEO
scandal-with-ceo.description: Heartbroken after a humiliating divorce from Rahul Mishra, simple yet talented chef Khushi Mehra hides a powerful secret, she is heir to one of India’s richest families. When ruthless business tycoon Aryan Singhania enters her life with a contract marriage, Khushi faces betrayal, corporate rivalries, and shocking family feuds. In a journey of love, revenge, and self-discovery, she proves she can shine brightest rich without him. Watch Now!

cubicle-cupids-twist-3.title: Cubicle Cupid's Twist
cubicle-cupids-twist-3.description: One wedding… Two breakups… The boss's life takes an unexpected turn with the entry of a third girl!" A middle-class designer, is fighting for her grandmother's life while paying off a debt of three lakhs. At the same time, the entry of a new boss, Queen, becomes a hot topic in the office. The story of a couple who got married but did not live together is confusing between scenes. That boss is no one… her husband! Obstacles, wrongdoers, betrayals in love, company stakes, design competitions – how did a smart girl face it all? Did the truth come out in the design theft case? Did she find love?

draculas-kiss-spellbound-by-a-doppelgang.title: Dracula's Kiss: Spellbound by a Doppelganger
draculas-kiss-spellbound-by-a-doppelgang.description: Flora’s heartbreak leads her to Vito Morelli — a vampire whose past is tied to her face. When love, revenge, and supernatural secrets collide, it sparks a romance that breaks hearts and takes lives. Watch Dracula’s Kiss, where one kiss changes everything.

chuppa-rustom-damad.title: Chuppa Rustom Damad
chuppa-rustom-damad.description: Ritesh, a powerful CEO, initially conceals his immense wealth from his high-society wife, Kavya, and her family, enduring relentless public humiliation and accusations of poverty. Kavya, unaware of his true status, initially criticizes him and is pressured by her mother and others to divorce him in favor of her wealthy childhood friend, Rocky or Sanjay. Ritesh attempts to subtly reveal his financial standing through significant gestures, but these lead to accusations of theft and fraud from his in-laws. The escalating family conflict culminates in Ritesh's forcible apprehension, leaving Kavya torn between marital duty and familial loyalty. Rocky dramatically reveals Ritesh's capture, deepening the mystery surrounding his true identity and the corporate intrigue. Ritesh is then dramatically revealed as the formidable new Chairman, asserting his dominance in the corporate world despite continued humiliation and challenges from Rocky. The rivalry intensifies with public confrontations, threats, and physical altercations, exposing hidden agendas and deep-seated class tensions. Ritesh, sometimes under an alias, strategically dismantles Rocky's family's corporate standing. Kavya finds herself under severe pressure, including threats from her mother, to divorce Ritesh and enter a deceptive charade as Sanjay's fiancée. Despite this, Kavya begins to suspect Ritesh's humble facade and questions his true identity, eventually defending him against her family's accusations. Ritesh unexpectedly arrives at social events where Kavya is with his rivals, demonstrating a formidable hidden power. He declares himself Chairman of Star Flash Industries, initiating a ruthless corporate takeover against Sanjay and his father, driven by a desire for revenge. Ritesh systematically dismantles his adversaries' illicit corporate empire, exposing fraud and bringing in law enforcement. His three-year hidden identity is fully unveiled to Kavya's family, leading to an emotional reconciliation. The show culminates in Ritesh's triumph and Kavya proudly asserting his esteemed position to a mocking acquaintance, solidifying their bond.

dont-mess-with-my-handome-bodyguard.title: Don't Mess with my Handsome Bodyguard
dont-mess-with-my-handome-bodyguard.description: Spoiled rich girl Suhani thinks she’s got the perfect groom, until her sassy, middle-class father Tough Daddy pulls the plug on her wedding just days before the big day. What follows is a hilarious war of egos, culture clashes, and unexpected emotions as Suhani and her stubborn dad clash over love, freedom, and family honor. In this chaotic rollercoaster, cancelling the wedding might just be the best thing that ever happened.

the-end-of-us.title: The End of Us
the-end-of-us.description: When Dhruva has to end his 10 year marriage contract with his Wife Swapna, he has to end many things which had stopped him to be on his own, why did he get into this contract marriage in first place and what surprise awaits him for all the sacrifice he has done for the past 10 years. Watch Kannada's First Micro Series "The End of Us" only on KUKU TV.

love-tease-2.title: Love Tease
love-tease-2.description: కాలేజీలో ప్రేమించి విడిపోయిన రోహన్‌–అనన్యలు ఎనిమిదేళ్ల తర్వాత మళ్లీ కలుస్తారు — మధ్యలో ఒక రహస్య బిడ్డ. రోహన్ ఇప్పుడు స్టార్ క్రికెటర్, కానీ అనుకోని నిజం అతడిని ఎదురు చూస్తోంది. ప్రేమ, అపరాధభావన, రెండవ అవకాశాల మధ్య... వారిద్దరూ ప్రేమను మళ్లీ సంపాదించగలరా?

grace-in-turbulent-times.title: Grace in Turbulent Times
grace-in-turbulent-times.description: In a chaotic era, a sharp yet free-spirited county magistrate navigates power struggles, corruption, and hidden agendas. With wit and charm, she turns political turbulence into opportunities to protect her people and rewrite her destiny.

son-of-an-mp-2.title: Son of an MP
son-of-an-mp-2.description:
Heir to a corrupt dynasty. She, the orphaned firebrand with a hidden legacy. When Akshat and Saksharta collide, love ignites a war against power, privilege, and buried truths.
From campus battles to courtroom wars, they fight not just for justice — but for a generation silenced too long.

the-billionaires-secret-face.title: Nakli Pati Nikla Crorepati
the-billionaires-secret-face.description: The microdrama begins with Tanya, disoriented after a forgotten night, escaping a stranger, Lakshya Oberoi, and leaving behind a sandal that sparks his relentless search for her. Simultaneously, Tanya faces a cruel stepmother and a scheming 'Auntie' who threatens her inheritance, pushing her to secure a crucial business deal to save her family firm from ruin. Under immense pressure to marry or lose her company to her ruthless rival, Mayra, Tanya dramatically declares Lucky, a humble peon who is secretly Lakshya Oberoi in disguise, as her husband, initiating a complex contract marriage. This charade quickly escalates as Tanya discovers Lucky's true identity as a powerful figure from the formidable Oberoi Group. Unbeknownst to her, his formidable grandmother has initiated "Operation Princess" to find him a suitable partner, unknowingly targeting Tanya, the very woman he seeks. As their fake marriage blurs with genuine feelings, Tanya battles relentless corporate rivals like Vandana, Lata, and Anirudh for control of her company. She also faces a severe blackmail plot for her shares and a valuable heirloom ring, crucial to her family's legacy. Her mysterious past at the "Blue Light Night Club" hints at a shared, hidden history with Lucky, deepening the intrigue surrounding their connection and his undercover mission to investigate her. The manipulative Varun, Tanya's powerful ex-flame, reappears, orchestrating elaborate schemes to ruin her, including faking illness and stealing her designs, driven by possessive jealousy and a desire to reclaim her. Concurrently, Myra Goenka plots to seize Tanya's assets through a staged divorce and incriminating photos, escalating her rivalry into outright betrayal and a quest for ultimate power. Tanya, believed dead after Myra's machinations and confessions of double murder, returns seeking vengeance against Myra for her father's murder, only to be further betrayed and framed. She endures abduction and torture by the sadistic Varun, but is dramatically rescued by Sameer, who reveals himself as her husband, Lakshay Oberoi. Lakshay, fiercely defending Tanya from public humiliation and corporate antagonists Jia and Sanjay, faces a severe attack that leaves him critically injured, putting their future in jeopardy. While desperately tending to Lucky, Tanya uncovers his true identity as Lakshya, entangled in "Operation Princess," and makes the poignant discovery that he had been searching for her, his own wife, all along, revealing their fated connection. Their journey culminates in a pursuit of justice for Tanya's father's murder by a trusted family member, solidifying their bond against a backdrop of corporate intrigue, personal betrayals, and the ultimate triumph of their fated love.

dumping-mrbillionaire.title: DUMPING MR.BILLIONAIRE
dumping-mrbillionaire.description: Trisha, a defiant LLB student burdened by debt and a painful past, dedicates herself to becoming a top lawyer, vowing to use her skills against those who oppress her. Her path dramatically shifts when she saves Akash, a brilliant tech visionary and scion of the powerful Birla empire, after he is critically injured. This act draws the attention of Akash's manipulative mother, the Matriarch, who, leveraging Trisha's financial distress and sick grandmother, coerces her into a strategic contract marriage with Akash to protect her son and the corporate legacy. Initially unaware of the full arrangement, Trisha signs the documents, while Akash, focused on his AI project, remains oblivious to his mother's machinations and vehemently rejects the marriage upon its revelation. As Akash demands a swift divorce, Trisha, secretly instructed to refuse and seeing a "jackpot," leverages their past and a mysterious "love bite" to gain advantage. Their crumbling arranged marriage is marked by neglect and emotional distance, leading Trisha to rekindle a forbidden romance with her past love, Abhimanyu, while Akash himself becomes embroiled in an illicit relationship with Neha and a bitter corporate rivalry with Mahesh. Neha, aspiring to become Akash's legitimate partner, is even approached by Mahesh with a dangerous proposition to eliminate Akash. Further complicating matters, a figure identified as Lakshmi (later Priya) employs manipulative tactics, including drugging Akash and attempting to trap him with a calculated pregnancy, while Mahesh blackmails her with a past secret. The conflict escalates when Mahesh kidnaps Trisha (referred to as Trishaa/Priya), forcing Akash into a high-stakes confrontation to protect his wife. Akash desperately searches for Priya, rescuing her from abduction, only for her to not recognize him, hinting at a forgotten past or the nature of their contract marriage. He fiercely defends her during a second abduction attempt, sustaining severe injuries. Priya's emotional plea for Akash to live, coupled with his recovery, leads to a long-awaited confession of their love. It is then revealed that the powerful Matriarch (Ma'am) meticulously designed the entire "game" of manipulation and abduction over three years to unite Akash and Priya, believing in their destined love. The show concludes with Akash declaring Priya his "boss" to ensure more time together, and Priya's ongoing struggle to save her ailing grandmother, underscoring the strategic underpinnings of their intertwined fates.

love-me-again-1.title: Love Me Again
love-me-again-1.description:
एक निषिद्ध विवाह, छल और धमकियों की परछाइयों में आकार ले रहा है।
वचन बनने से पहले ही उन्हें तोड़ने के लिए गुंडे बुलाए जाते हैं।
एक माँ अपने नन्हे बच्चे की हिफ़ाज़त में जान की बाज़ी लगाती है, तभी अतीत की डरावनी परछाइयाँ लौट आती हैं।
प्यार, फ़रेब और जीने की जद्दोजहद में—किसी का भी अंजाम पक्का नहीं।

maayavan.title: Maayavan
maayavan.description: A simple, kind-hearted poor villager is betrayed by his longtime lover, who leaves him for a wealthy man. Blessed with divine powers, the villager transforms into a rich and handsome man — and returns to take revenge on his former lover.

the-awakening-2.title: The Awakening
the-awakening-2.description: In a world where ancient curses and modern power collide, a mysterious warrior named Raghav reawakens with forgotten powers to protect the woman he loves. As politics, betrayal, and destiny intertwine, he must confront his past to shape the future of an entire Generation.

khoon-ka-rishta.title: Khoon Ka Rishta
khoon-ka-rishta.description: When blind but brilliant photographer Zoya crosses paths with brooding businessman Yug Singhania, sparks fly in unexpected ways. As love blossoms through secrets, emotional wounds, and societal barriers, Zoya becomes Yug’s guiding light and he becomes her strength. Together, they discover that true vision comes not from the eyes, but from the heart.

iruvar.title: Iruvar
iruvar.description: Akshat Pathak, the troubled son of powerful MLA Nandani Pathak, is trapped beneath a legacy of emotional abuse and political expectations. But everything changes when he crosses paths with Saksharta, a fierce and self-made orphan from a foster home whose only family is her younger brother, Anay. Their connection sparks a series of confrontations — with class, love, identity, and the rotten roots of systemic power. As secrets unravel, Saksharta discovers her true lineage — she is the long-lost daughter of political tycoon Vishwas Singh, making her the unexpected heiress in a game ruled by lies and leverage. What begins as schoolyard taunts and broken hearts escalates into campus campaigns, leaked scandals, public takedowns, and courtroom showdowns. Former lovers turn enemies, and enemies become allies. With Akshat ultimately choosing truth over blood and exposing his own mother’s corruption, he and Saksharta take a stand — not just for themselves, but for a generation fighting to be heard.

where-love-fades-away-2.title: Where Love Fades Away
where-love-fades-away-2.description: A woman is diagnosed with brain cancer. She tries to call her husband to share the news, but he refuses to listen. Ironically, her husband is the world’s leading brain cancer specialist. When the nurses take the woman to him—his own wife—he refuses to even look at her. After enduring this emotional abuse from her husband for days, the woman decides to separate from him. Later, the husband realizes his mistake and wants to return to her. But can he truly come back?

agnyaathavaasi.title: Agnyaathavaasi
agnyaathavaasi.description: ఒక ఘోర రోడ్డు ప్రమాదం తర్వాత, రాజ్ రాథోడ్ పక్షవాతానికి గురవుతాడు. ఇటువంటి క్లిష్ట పరిస్థితుల్లో, మాయ అతనికి తోడుగా నిలుస్తుంది – ఎదురైన ప్రతి సమస్యతో ధైర్యంగా పోరాడుతుంది. రాజ్ చికిత్స కోసం ఆమె ఎన్నో పనులు చేస్తూ, ఊరంతా తిరుగుతుంది. చివరికి, ఆమె అచంచలమైన విశ్వాసమే విజయం సాధిస్తుంది – రాజ్ తిరిగి లేచి జీవించడమే కాదు, మాయ ప్రేమకు దాసోహంగా మారిపోతాడు.

its-showdown-time-im-the-global-billiona.title: It's Showdown Time, I'm the Global Billionaire's Daughter
its-showdown-time-im-the-global-billiona.description: It’s Showdown Time, I’m the Global Billionaire’s Daughter is a high-stakes drama about a woman who discovers her true identity as the heir to a global empire. Thrown into a world of power struggles, envy, and love, she must fight to claim her place and protect everything that’s hers.

royal-village-girl-1.title: Royal Village Girl
royal-village-girl-1.description: A girl names Raksha arrives in the city from her village with her mother to stay with her sister Nisha, but Nisha refuses to acknowledge them due to social status. Hiding her true identity, Raksha reinvents herself as a wealthy heiress. An old pendant leads Rksha to Mrs. Patel, the mother she lost long ago. When an attack on her mother unfolds, secrets come to light—and a DNA test reveals the truth: Raksha is the real CEO. Nisha’s lies are exposed before the media, and Raksha regains her true identity, mother, and dignity.

ceo-ka-chatpata-piyar.title: CEO Ka Chatpata Pyaar
ceo-ka-chatpata-piyar.description: A cold, ailing CEO finds warmth in the most unexpected place—her dumpling shop. As flavors spark feelings, business and romance get deliciously tangled. A heartwarming tale of love, healing, and second chances. Watch Now !

love-tease-3.title: Love Tease
love-tease-3.description:
Rohan and Ananya, college sweethearts turned strangers, reunite after eight years — with a secret child between them. Now a star cricketer, Rohan faces a truth he never saw coming.
In a world of love, guilt, and second chances… can they reclaim what was lost?

migrant-workers-love-story-4.title: Migrant worker's love story
migrant-workers-love-story-4.description: She was the heiress of an empire; he, a nameless migrant. Their love hit the family like a storm hits still waters — sudden, fierce, and unrelenting. In its wake, it shook boardrooms, broke headlines, and tested the foundations of legacy itself.

the-big-shots-wife.title: The Big Shot’s Wife
the-big-shots-wife.description: When a bride catches her groom cheating moments before the wedding, she shockingly marries a stranger only to discover he’s more than he seems. The Big Shot’s Wife is a gripping saga of betrayal, identity, and empowerment set against the backdrop of Mumbai’s high society. Secrets unravel, loyalties shift, and one woman finds her voice in the chaos. Watch Now !

the-royal-betrayal-1.title: THE ROYAL BETRAYAL
the-royal-betrayal-1.description: The microdrama chronicles the six-year tumultuous journey of compassionate doctor Anjali and soldier-prince Harshavardhan, whose tender romance is abruptly severed by an emergency, preventing him from revealing his royal identity and her from sharing her pregnancy. Anjali faces immense challenges alone, including her father's life-threatening illness and manipulative blackmailer Mayur, who threatens her family to keep their daughter Misha's paternity a secret. Their paths dramatically cross again, leading to a tense reunion where Harshavardhan discovers Misha is his daughter, forcing him to confront the life he unknowingly abandoned and his profound sense of betrayal. A ruthless "Boss" emerges, orchestrating assassination attempts on Anjali, who is relentlessly pursued and tragically shot during a forbidden rescue mission led by Harshavardhan. Simultaneously, a dangerous K-Virus epidemic, linked to a medical cover-up, threatens lives, with Harshavardhan making a profound sacrifice to save Anjali. Despite his efforts, Harshavardhan is forced into an arranged marriage with Mitali/Mithali, unaware Anjali secretly has their child and battles the K-Virus herself, fabricating a new life to push him away. Anjali seemingly dies but mysteriously reappears, declaring a "game" of revenge and facing new crises as her father's treatment is threatened and she becomes the target of a shadowy mastermind. The mystery of Mishu's paternity deepens with Abhimanyu's investigation, while Harshavardhan uncovers Anjali's six-year deception about their past separation. Their rekindled connection is complicated by powerful rivals and a vengeful antagonist who kidnaps Anjali and rigs her with a ticking bomb. Amidst this peril, Harshavardhan proposes to Anjali, solidifying their bond. Ultimately, Anjali's unwavering devotion is tested by Harshavardhan's powerful patriarch father, who eventually accepts their love, leading to a family reunion where Misha bridges the rift between Harsh and his estranged father.

the-billionaires-secret-girl.title: The Billionaire's Secret Girl
the-billionaires-secret-girl.description: The microdrama follows Pankhuri, an ambitious young woman, as she navigates a treacherous corporate world and a series of intense, manipulative relationships. Her journey begins with a humiliating job interview that unexpectedly leads to her hiring by enigmatic CEO Aditya, immediately sparking corporate jealousy and a tense power struggle. Aditya exhibits possessive control, which Pankhuri fiercely resists, even threatening to quit, before she is abducted and thrust into a dangerous underworld. Aditya urgently searches for her, hinting at a mysterious prior connection, and later ruthlessly evicts her and attempts to control her career, revealing a vengeful motive, yet a "devil's kiss" awakens a complex desire within her. Pankhuri then finds herself entangled with Vivan, another possessive CEO, who traps her in a fake assistant role and publicly claims her as his girlfriend to deflect corporate inquiries, further blurring their professional and personal lives. Amidst these struggles, Pankhuri grapples with Vivan's presumed death, refusing to accept it and clinging to the belief he is alive, even as a ruthless new CEO attempts to seize control of his company. Vivan, later identified as Sujan, dramatically returns from the dead, revealing he faked his demise to unmask his killer, shifting suspicion to his own uncle. This revelation plunges Pankhuri and Sujan into a deadly confrontation with his vengeful uncle, Vikram, who confesses to murdering Sujan's parent over inheritance. Sujan offers his own life for Pankhuri's safety, but Vikram rejects it, leading to a violent standoff where Pankhuri is tragically lost, leaving Sujan in profound despair. A guilt-ridden Vikram then offers Sujan a fortune and a solemn vow to "take care of her," giving Sujan a new, undefined purpose. Sujan attempts a fresh start, proposing marriage to a skeptical woman, but his dark past and a profound betrayal resurface, challenging their potential future. The series ultimately explores Pankhuri's relentless fight for independence and truth against powerful, controlling forces, and Sujan's quest for justice, love, and a new beginning amidst profound loss and lingering shadows.

hollywood-staged-romance-live-247-6.title: Hollywood Staged Romance Live 24/7
hollywood-staged-romance-live-247-6.description: What happens when a fake relationship between a struggling actress and a billionaire turns into something real? Get ready for drama, lies, love, and a whole lot of showbiz chaos. Hollywood Staged Romance Live 24/7 is your next obsession. Watch now!

dumping-mr-billionaire-2.title: Dumping Mr Billionaire
dumping-mr-billionaire-2.description: తనకే తెలియకుండా ఎవరైనా పెళ్ళి చేసుకుంటారా..? ఒకవేళ అలా చేసుకుంటే ఏమవుతుంది? తెలియాలంటే చూడండి "Dumping Mr Billionaire"  మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

divorcee-ka-swayamvar.title: Divorcee Ka Swayamvar
divorcee-ka-swayamvar.description: "Divorced and Desired" is a fiery tale of betrayal, ambition, and reinvention. When Ishita is dumped for power and prestige, she doesn’t just bounce back—she builds an empire and makes her ex beg for mercy. This drama-packed audio series is your front-row seat to revenge, romance, and ruthless success. Watch Now!

secret-billionaire-villager-2.title: Secret Billionaire Villager
secret-billionaire-villager-2.description: ఒక సాధారణ, దయగల పేద గ్రామీణుడిని అతని దీర్ఘకాల ప్రియురాలు మోసం చేస్తుంది, ఆమె అతన్ని ధనవంతుడి కోసం వదిలివేస్తుంది. దైవిక శక్తితో దీవించబడిన ఆ గ్రామస్థుడు ధనవంతుడు మరియు అందమైన వ్యక్తిగా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు - మరియు మాజీ ప్రేయసిపై ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోవడానికి తిరిగి వస్తాడు.

billionaires-unknown-son.title: Billionaire's Unknown Son
billionaires-unknown-son.description: Mihir sacrifices his childhood for his mother… 20 years later, Tina betrays his love, and fate brings Ragini back for revenge.

the-crowned-consort-of-the-empress-4.title: The Crowned Consort of the Empress
the-crowned-consort-of-the-empress-4.description: The story of a woman who rises from a lower position in the palace to become the Empress's consort, a journey of ambition, love, and political maneuvering.

secret-billionaire-villager-3.title: Secret Billionaire Villager
secret-billionaire-villager-3.description: The microdrama begins with Raghu, a hopeful lover, experiencing a devastating fall from grace when his romantic surprise for Nikita is shattered by her cruel betrayal with another man. He endures brutal public humiliation and assaults from Nikita, her new lover, and her family, who mock his social status and appearance, leaving him jobless, homeless, and contemplating self-harm. His childhood friend, the wealthy CEO Mahika, intervenes, confessing her long-held love and orchestrating a mystical transformation that grants Raghu a glamorous new identity as Raghav, empowering him to enact a calculated revenge. Transformed, Raghav infiltrates Nikita's corporate empire as her personal assistant, meticulously planning her downfall by making her fall deeply in love with him before delivering a devastating lesson. The corporate landscape becomes a battleground as Raghav, aided by accomplice Bheeka and later Mahika, conspires to sabotage Nikita's crucial projects and frame rivals like Laksh. Laksh, initially an antagonist to Raghav, discovers Raghav's true identity as a wealthy scion with powerful connections, leading to a complex web of accusations, counter-accusations, and shifting alliances, with Laksh eventually allying with Nikita against Raghav and Mahika. Raghav's hidden connection to the influential Khanna family is revealed, further complicating his manipulative pursuit of Nikita, who, despite her mother's initial opposition, begins to reciprocate his feelings and plans to leave her husband, Laksh, for him. The escalating corporate war culminates in a devastating tech stock crash, orchestrated in part by Raghav and Mahika, which plunges Nikita's family into financial ruin. In the aftermath, Laksh swiftly divorces Nikita and publicly announces his engagement to Mihika, leaving Nikita's life shattered and Raghav's intricate revenge seemingly complete, though the full extent of his and Mahika's manipulations and the ultimate consequences remain to be seen.

my-brother-you-cant-afford-to-mess-with-.title: My Brother, You Can't Afford to Mess with?
my-brother-you-cant-afford-to-mess-with-.description:
My Brother- You can't afford to mess with :  The rich elder brother is like a shadow to his younger brother. He did a lot of good for the people in his brother's village—pretty much changed their lives. He was like a king to them. But then, because of his brother's enemies, trouble started coming his way. He dealt with those who caused problems, got his revenge, and finally found some peace.But just when things seemed settled, a huge unexpected tragedy hit him.
What was it? And what happened next?

soothing-souls.title: Oops, Not A Gold Digger
soothing-souls.description: When spirited delivery girl Disha rescues feisty Suman Dadi from a taxi spat, she has no idea it will lead to an accidental marriage with charming yet mysterious Vikrant, a man she thinks is just a broke caretaker, but who’s actually heir to a billionaire empire. Between office politics, spoiled rivals like Tia, hidden identities, and Dadi’s matchmaking mischief, Disha must protect her dreams, her dignity, and maybe her heart. Watch Now!

ravan-leela.title: Ravan Leela
ravan-leela.description: Ravan: Ek Mahagyani Pandit se Maharakshas tak ki Yatra ! Jisme unke gyan aur ahankar ki kahaniyon ka bejod mishran hai. Suniye Ravan Leela !

agni-mattu-male.title: ಅಗ್ನಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಳೆ
agni-mattu-male.description: ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ಕಥಾವಸ್ತು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ’ಅಗ್ನಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಳೆ’ ನಾಟಕವು ಕಾರ್ನಾಡರ ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ನಾಟಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು. ಅಗ್ನಿ ಪೂಜಿಸುವ ಒಂದು ಸಮೂಹ. ನೀರು-ಮಳೆಯನ್ನು ಆರಾಧಿಸುವ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಡುವ ನಾಟಕ. ನಿಷಾಧರ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ’ನಿತ್ತಿಲೆ’ ಈ ನಾಟಕದ ಜೀವ-ಜೀವಾಳ. ಯಜ್ಞದ ಸುತ್ತ ಕತೆ ಹೆಣೆಯಲಾಗಿದೆಯಾದರೂ ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೇ ಸೀಮಿತವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ನಾಟಕೀಯ ಅಂಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಈ ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊರತೆಯೇನಿಲ್ಲ. ತೋರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತರ್‌ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಖಾಮುಖಿ ಆಗಿಸುವ ನಾಟಕ ಗಿರೀಶರ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹಿಡಿದ ಕೈಗನ್ನಡಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.

hayavadana.title: Hayavadana
hayavadana.description: ಹಯವದನ ಕಾರ್ನಾಡರ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಗಮನಾರ್ಹ ಕೃತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ. ಹಯವದನ ಕಥಾವಸ್ತುವು "ಕಥಾ ಸರಿತ್ ಸಾಗರ" ದಿಂದ ಬಂದಿದೆ, ಇದು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪುರಾತನ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಸಂಕಲನವಾಗಿದೆ. ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿನ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಘಟನೆ- ದೇವದತ್ತ ಮತ್ತು ಕಪಿಲನ ಕಥೆಯು "ಬೇಟಲ್ ಪಂಚಬಿನ್ಸತಿ" ಯ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದೆ.

mrityunjay-hi.title: Mrityunjay Hi
mrityunjay-hi.description: Yuddh jiske janm se hi uski Niyati ban gayi. Jise janm lete hi tyag diya gaya. Jo siksha prapti ke liye dar-dar bhatka.
