Wo jisne agyanta me apne hi bhayiyo ko apna shatru samjh liya. Wo jo sabkuch jante huye apni bhayiyon se tab tak yuddh karta raha jab tak mrityu ne use apne gale se nahin lgaa liya. Wo veer tha, ek aisa yuddha jiske samksha mrityu aane se ghabrati thi. Suniye gatha us Mrityunjay ki jo janm se apni mrityu tak nirantar yuddh ladta rha.

thuglaq.title: ತುಘಲಕ್
thuglaq.description: ಗಿರೀಶ ಕಾರ್ನಾಡರ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹತ್ವದ ರಂಗಕೃತಿ ’ತುಘಲಕ್;. ಭಾರತೀಯ ರಂಗಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಈ ನಾಟಕಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಶೇಷ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಇದೆ. ಹಲವು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಭಾಷೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನುವಾದ ಆಗಿರುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ರಂಗಕ್ರಿಯೆ-ತಾತ್ವಿಕತೆ-ಕಟ್ಟಿರುವ ಕ್ರಮದ ಕಾರಣದಿಂದಾಗಿ ’ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ ಪೀಸ್’ ಎಂದು ಗುರುತಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

bokya-satbande-part-2.description: Step into a world of fun and learning with Kuku FM's children's stories. Our audiobooks are full of adventures and lessons about friendship courage and curiosity. They're perfect for young listeners making learning exciting and storytelling a joy. Listen now Kuku FM for stories that spark imagination and teach important values in a simple enjoyable way.

kahaniyan-jo-jeena-sikhayen.description: Kya aapki zindagi puzzles se bhari padi hai? Aur unhe solve karne ka tareeka dhund rahe ho? Agar han, Toh is audiobook mein Jolly uncle ke saath jaaniye, Kaise har challenge ko aasan banakar jeeta jaye aur khushiyon ke saath zindagi ko jiya jaye.

pakistan-mail.description: Partition, Wo daur jab Insaniyat ek tarah se khatm ho gyi thi. Dange logo ki jaan le rahe the. Balatkar har dharam ke logon ka hathiyar ban gaya tha. Pakistan Mail, Kahani 1947 ke dauran huye dango ki, jisne desh ko baatne ke sath-sath use dango ki aag me jhauk diya.

secret-husband.title: Secret Husband
secret-husband.description: ഫിലിം പ്രൊഡ്യൂസർ നിരഞ്ജൻ വർമ്മയുടെ മുറിയിൽ നിന്നും ഒരു ഞെട്ടലോടെയാണ് മംമ്ത  ഇറങ്ങിവന്നത്. ആറ് വർഷങ്ങൾക്കു മുൻപുള്ള ആ രാത്രിയിൽ...അത് ഇയാൾ ആയിരുന്നോ? തീവ്രമായ പ്രണയത്തിന്റെ വൈകാരിക മുഹൂർത്തങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു റൊമാന്റിക് ത്രില്ലർ! കേൾക്കൂ...സീക്രട്ട് ഹസ്ബൻഡ്!

raavan-aryavartacha-shatru.title: Raavan Aryavartacha Shatru

Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

basics-of-indian-stock-market.title: Basics Of Indian Stock Market
basics-of-indian-stock-market.description: Kaise karein share market mein invest aur kaise banayein zyada profit? Kaise lein history se sabak aur kamayein munafa? Sab janiye is Audiobook "Basics of Indian Stock Market" mein.

why-to-invest-in-ipos-1.description: IPO-കളിൽ നിക്ഷേപം നടത്തുന്നതിന്റെ രഹസ്യങ്ങളും തന്ത്രങ്ങളും പഠിക്കൂ!

iconic-moments-of-indian-politics-in-con.title: Iconic Moments of Indian Politics - in conversation with Muthukumar
iconic-moments-of-indian-politics-in-con.description:
நம்ம சுதந்திரத்தோட மகத்தான விஷயமே, குடியரசு நாடானது தான். மக்களால் மக்களுக்காகன்னு இருக்கக்கூடிய இந்திய ஆட்சி அதுக்கு பின்னாடி நடந்த சில முக்கிய நிகழ்வுகளை நம்ம கூட பகிர்ந்துக்க கெஸ்ட்ஆ வந்து இருக்காரு "முத்துக்குமார்". அவரோட பார்வையில சில சுவாரசியமான தகவல்களை இந்த ஒலி புத்தகத்துல சொல்லி இருக்காரு. 

The most unique part of our independence is our country being a democratic nation. Its not that easy to run such a diverse nation. There has been a lot of incidences that brought us down here as co exist with this administration. "Muthukumar" our guest for this audio book shares his thoughts on the most iconic moments of indian politics.

sunkar-dekho-shirdi-sai-baba.title: Sunkar Dekho : Shirdi Sai Baba
sunkar-dekho-shirdi-sai-baba.description: Agar ham aapse kahein ki duniya ke kisi bhi kone se Shirdi ke Sai Baba ke darshan kar payenge, toh shayad aap hamein shaq ke nigahon se dekhenge. Isliye hum lekar aaye hain hamari ye khaas peshkash jisse na sirf aap Sri Saba ke darshan kar paayenge, balki Shirdi Sai Baba Dhaam ke alokik vaatavaran ko Sai Baba ke anginit manmohak qisson ke saath mehsoos bhi kar payenge. Toh deri kis baat ki? Apne apne headphones daaliye aur iss anokhi anubhav ko sunkar dekhiye!

the-road-less-traveled-3.title: The Road Less Traveled
the-road-less-traveled-3.description: Jeevitayathrayil puthiya vazhikalum snehathinteyum valarchayudeyum rahasyangalum thediyulla yathra - "The Road Less Traveled".

black-money-indias-hidden-wealth.description: Ee kallappanam evide ninnanu varunnath? Athu nammude sambath vyavasthaye engane baadhikunu? Ithinethire namukk enthu cheyyanakum ennivayekurichulla kannu thurappikkuna vivarangalum anubhavangalum ee showil kelkam.

excel-english-speaking-course.description: Kya aap fluent English bolna chahte hain? Agar haan, Toh "English Speaking Course" book ka explanation zaroor suniye. Kyunki Ismein sikhaya gaya hai, Sahi pronunciation karna, Aasaani se grammar use karna, Har situation ke liye perfect sentences kya honge se lekar vo sabkuch jo perfection ke saath english bolne ke liye humein chahiye hota hai.

moongil-kottai.title: மூங்கில் கோட்டை
moongil-kottai.description: பாண்டிய மன்னன் நெடுஞ்செழியனால் மூங்கில் கோட்டையில் சிறைவைக்கப்பட்ட சேர மன்னன் எப்படித் தப்பித்தான்? அத்தியாயத்துக்கு அத்தியாயம் விறுவிறுப்புடன் கூடிய சாண்டியல்யனின் மாஸ்டர் பீஸ்...!

its-all-in-your-head-m-1.title: It's All In Your Head, M
its-all-in-your-head-m-1.description: Kya aapko apni sabse badi taqat pata hai? Agar nahii, Toh yeh book explanation sun kar zaroor pata chal jayega. animal-farm-2.description: உலகப் புகழ் பெற்ற எழுத்தாளர் George Orwell எழுதின Animal Farm அப்டிங்க்ற இந்த கதை, அடக்குமுறைக்கும், அதிகாரத்துக்கும் எதிரா எழும்புன ஒரு புரட்சிக் குரல். விலங்குகள கதாபாத்திரங்களா வச்சு அரசியலையும், புரட்சிக் கருத்துக்களையும் சொல்ற மாதிரி வடிவமைக்கப்பட்ட இந்த கதைக்கு உங்க அரசியல் பார்வைய திருப்பிப் போடுற வல்லமை இருக்கு! இது நிச்சயம் நீங்க கேக்க வேண்டிய ஒன்னு!🐷🚩

art-of-life-timeless-wisdom-from-the-git.title: Art of life: Timeless Wisdom from the Gita
art-of-life-timeless-wisdom-from-the-git.description: Baghavat Gita solla koodiya Vaazhkai thathuvangalai oru Audio book aah ungalukku kudukurom. Vaanga Vaazhkaiyoda Paadangalai kettu therinjukalaam.

आत्मा-की-8-शक्तियां.title: सफलता के लिए जरूरी 8 शक्तियां
आत्मा-की-8-शक्तियां.description: Kya aapne kabhi socha hai ki kuch log mushkil halaton mein bhi kaise muskura lete hain? Ye show aapko aatma ki unn shaktiyon se milwaega jo aapko bhi har paristhithi mein sambhale rakh sakti hain aur aapke chehre se bhi muskurahat kabhi gum na hogi.

10-things-that-keep-you-poor-forever-1.title: 10 Things That Keep You Poor Forever
10-things-that-keep-you-poor-forever-1.description:
Oru Audiobook ketta Panakkaran aaga mudiyuma? Sathiyama Mudiyadhu!
Aana neenga yen innum middle class ah ve irukeenga nu kandipa therinuka mudiyum!
Kelunga “10 Things That Keep You Poor Forever”

phoolan-devi-1.title: Phoolan Devi
phoolan-devi-1.description: Phoolan devi - Intha Perai kettale oru nimisham elaarukkum romba poorippaa irukkum. Oru Rape Victim Member of Parliment aana kathaiyai kettu therinjukalaam vaanga.

15-mins-relaxing-self-care-special-asmr-.title: Luxury Self-Care Sounds: Special ASMR Show
15-mins-relaxing-self-care-special-asmr-.description: Aaj hum aapko ek sukoon bhare self care routine ka audio experience karayenge. Aankhen band karein, aaraam se baith jaayein aur keval apne kaano se iss anokhe safar ki har ek awaaz ko mehsoos kijiye.

The-Secret-of-Nagas--నాగ-రహస్యం--Naga-Ra.title: నాగ రహస్యం
The-Secret-of-Nagas--నాగ-రహస్యం--Naga-Ra.description: అసలు ఈ నాగాస్ ఎవరు? వాళ్ళు మిగిలిన వాళ్లకి ఎందుకు దూరం గా వుంటారు, మిగిలిన వాళ్ళని ఎందుకు ద్వేషిస్తారు? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-draupadi.title: Mahabharat ke Amar Patra Draupadi
mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-draupadi.description: Ek rajkumari, Ek mahan samrajya ki kulvadhu, Wo jiska janm divya rup se hua, Jise dharam ke marg ko prasasth karne ke liye chuna gaya, Dyut krida ne jise apmanit kiya aur jiske badale ki aag ne sampurn kaurav vansh ka nash kar diya. Sune katha Mahabharat ke Amar Patra Draupadi ki, wo Stri jiske kaurav sabha me dyut ke dauran huye apman ne rakhi Mahabharat yuddh ki neev.

ntuppuppakkoranendarnnu.title: ന്റുപ്പുപ്പാക്കൊരാനേണ്ടാര്‍ന്ന്‌...!
ntuppuppakkoranendarnnu.description: കുഞ്ഞിപ്പാത്തുമ്മയുടെ കണ്ണിലൂടെ ലോകത്തെ വരച്ചിടുന്ന ബഷീര്‍ സമൂഹത്തിലെ പുഴുക്കുത്തുകളെ കാട്ടിത്തരികയും പുതിയ ലോകത്തേക്ക് വാതില്‍ തുറന്നിടുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. ചിരിയോടൊപ്പം ചിന്തയുമുണര്‍ത്തുന്ന ബഷീറിന്റെ നോവല്‍.

-షేమ్-షేమ్.title: షేమ్.. షేమ్... పప్పీ షేమ్!
-షేమ్-షేమ్.description: నిజం కోసం పోరాడే ఓ కమ్యూనిస్ట్ ఇంటికి వచ్చాక  భార్యతో పోట్లాటలు, మనస్పర్ధలు, అత్తా -కోడళ్ళ గొడవలు.... ఇవన్నీ ప్రతీ ఇంట్లో జరిగే చిన్ని తీపి గొడవలు. "షేమ్.. షేమ్.. పప్పీ షేమ్ - దేశరాజు కథలు" అనే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ ద్వారా  మీ ఇంట్లో జరిగినవన్నీ మీరు మళ్ళీ నూతనంగా నెమరు వేసుకోవచ్చు.

mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-ashwatthama.title: Mahabharat ke Amar Patra Ashwatthama
mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-ashwatthama.description: Wo jise Mrityu maar nahin sakti thi, wo jo dhanurvidya me arjun se bhi shreshtha tha, wo jise bramhastra ka gayaan tha, uske yuddh kaushal ke aage rathi-maharathi sab natmastak ho jaate the, wo jisne pandavo ke vansh ko lagbhag purn rup se samapat kar diya, sune katha Mahabharat ke Amar Patra Ashwatthama ki, jo ek mahan yoddha hone ke bawjud shrapit ho kar srishti me dar-dar bhatakne ko majbur ho gaya.

cafe-coffee-day-the-revival.title: Cafe Coffee Day: The Revival
cafe-coffee-day-the-revival.description: ഈ ബൈറ്റ്‌സ് തുറക്കുമ്പോള്‍ കഫേ കോഫി ഡേയുടെ കഥ എന്തുകൊണ്ട് ഞാന്‍ കേള്‍ക്കണം എന്ന് നിങ്ങള്‍ ചിന്തിക്കുന്നുണ്ടാകാം. കാരണം ഈ കഥ വിജയത്തിന്റെ മാത്രം കഥയല്ല, വീണിട്ടും വിജയിച്ചവരുടെ കഥയാണ്.

learn-to-earn-10.title: Learn to Earn
learn-to-earn-10.description: Panavum nikshepavum - ivayekurich schoolil padippikkaatha adisthaana karyangal padikkan ningalkk aagrahamnundo? Ningalude sambadhyam valarthanulla vazhikalum ohari vipaniye engane manassilaakamennum ee show ningale padipikkunnu.

dmk-vs-aiadmk-kaun-hai-asli-raja-7.title: DMK VS AIADMK : Kaun Hai Asli Raja
dmk-vs-aiadmk-kaun-hai-asli-raja-7.description: Kyun haarti hai Tamil Nadu mein BJP? Kyun Hota hai vahan Local Parties ka shasan? Aur 2024 mein Kya hoga nateeza? Janiye  sirf "DMK VS AIADMK : Kaun Hai Asli Raja" mein.

interview-thippalu.title: Interview తిప్పలు
interview-thippalu.description: మీరు కూడా ఇంటర్వ్యూ అటెండ్ అయ్యే ఉంటారు కదా, అది ఒక మర్చిపోలేని జ్ఞాపకం. వివిధ రకాల వ్యక్తులు వారి ఇంటర్వ్యూ లలో ఎదుర్కొన్న సవాళ్ళను హాస్యంగా మలిచి మీ ముందుకు Kuku Tales రూపంలో తీసుకువచ్చాము. విని నవ్వుకోండి.

Nallagonda-kathalu--నల్లగొండ-కధలు.title: నల్లగొండ కథలు
Nallagonda-kathalu--నల్లగొండ-కధలు.description: రచయిత చిన్న నాడు చూసిన నల్లగొండ టౌన్, దాని చుట్టూ అల్లుకున్న అతని బాల్యం. తాను ఎదుగుతూ వస్తూండగా చూసిన మార్పులూ. చుట్టూ ఉన్న మనుషులూ ఇవే కథా వస్తువులు. అమాయకమైన బాల్యం, అప్పటి కష్టాలూ, సంతోషాలూ వంటి అంశాలను ఈ పుస్తకంలో రచయిత చాలా అందంగా వర్ణించాడు. అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "నల్లగొండ కథలు" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

shivsena-bala-saheb-se-aditya-thackeray-.title: Shivsena : Bala Saheb Se Aditya Thackeray Tak
shivsena-bala-saheb-se-aditya-thackeray-.description: Kaise bani Shivsena aur kaise Bala Saheb Thackeray ban gaye ek bada naam. Thackeray pariwar ki Narendra Modi se dosti aur Maharshtra chunav ki poori kahani bata rahe hain "Shivsena : Bala Saheb Se Aditya Thackeray Tak" mein

നഗ്നരും-നരഭോജികളും.title: നഗ്നരും നരഭോജികളും
നഗ്നരും-നരഭോജികളും.description: ഒരു മുന്നൊരുക്കവുമില്ലാതെ തിരുവനന്തപുരം മുതല്‍ ഒഡീഷ വരെ പ്രസിദ്ധ സിനിമാറ്റോഗ്രാഫറും സംവിധായകനുമായ വേണു നടത്തിയ യാത്രയുടെ ഓര്‍മ്മകള്‍. കേരള സാഹിത്യ അക്കാദമി അവാര്‍ഡ് നേടിയ കൃതി കേള്‍ക്കാം.

avoid-these-in-2024-2.title: Avoid These In 2024
avoid-these-in-2024-2.description: 2024 లో మనం వేటిని వదిలేయాలి ? దేన్ని వదిలేస్తే మనం సంతోషంగా, ఆరోగ్యంగా బ్రతకవచ్చు ? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

modi-ki-vijay-yatra.title: Modi Ki Vijay Yatra
modi-ki-vijay-yatra.description: Kaise 2024 ke Loksabha Chunav Se pehle hi jeet liya tha BJP ne chunav? Kya thi ranneeti aur kaise janta ne BJP ko fir se chuna? Sab janiye is khas show "Modi KI Vijay Yatra" mein.

5-sacrifices-to-become-rich-2.title: 5 Sacrifices To Become Rich
5-sacrifices-to-become-rich-2.description: జీవితంలో మీరు అనుకున్నది సాధించడానికి చేయవలసిన ఐదు ముఖ్యమైన త్యాగాలు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? ఆర్థిక లక్ష్యాలను సాధించడంలో సహాయపడే విషయాలను నేర్చుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా ఈ కుకు ఎఫ్ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

connect-with-nature-in-15-mins-special-a.title: Connect with Nature in 15 Mins: Special ASMR Show
connect-with-nature-in-15-mins-special-a.description: 15 minute mein hum aapko ek virtual forest walk ka experience karayenge. Aankhen band karein aur keval apne kaano se is jungle ki sari awaazein suniye.

thottavarkkum-jayikkam.title: തോറ്റവർക്കും ജയിക്കാം
thottavarkkum-jayikkam.description: മലയാളത്തിലെ പ്രശസ്ത എഴുത്തുകാരനായ മധു ഭാസ്കരൻ രചിച്ച തോറ്റവർക്കും ജയിക്കാം എന്ന പുസ്തകം ജീവിതത്തിലെ പരാജയങ്ങളെ നേരിടാനും അവയിൽ നിന്ന് പഠിക്കാനും വിജയം നേടാനും സഹായിക്കുന്ന ഉപദേശങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്നു.

Peka-Medalu-పేక-మేడలు.title: పేక మేడలు
Peka-Medalu-పేక-మేడలు.description: రంగనాయకమ్మ ఎవరు? ఆవిడ రచనలకి ప్రత్యేకమైన గుర్తింపు ఎందుకు? తెల్సుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

sunkar-dekho-a-day-in-new-york-city.title: Sunkar Dekho: A Day In New York City
sunkar-dekho-a-day-in-new-york-city.description: New York. Iss bemisaal shehar ka anubhav kaun nahin lena chahta hai par har kisiko ye mauqa kahaan naseeb hota hai? Sapnon ka ye shehar kaafiyon ke liye sirf ek sapna ban kar hi reh jaata hai. Par ab nahin. Apne headphones ko banaiye apna passport aur Kuku FM ki iss khaas peshkash ke zariye sair kijiye New York ki lajawaab aur rangeen jagahon ki. Mehsoos karein New York ki dhadkan apne kaanon mein aur anand uthayein uski shaan ki. Sunkar toh dekhiye.

Nallanchu-Tella-Cheera-నల్లాంచు-తెల్లా-చ.title: నల్లంచు - తెల్ల చీర
Nallanchu-Tella-Cheera-నల్లాంచు-తెల్లా-చ.description: ఫ్యాషన్, బ్యూటీ రంగంలో విజయం సాధించిన ఓ యువకుడి కథ. ఓ మర్డర్ అతని జీవితాన్ని ఎలా మారుస్తుంది? యండమూరి కలం నుంచి జాలువారిన లవ్ అండ్ మర్డర్ మిష్టరీ "నల్లంచు - తెల్లచీర" ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి...

kashum-keeshayum.title: കാശും കീശയും
kashum-keeshayum.description: ചിട്ടിമുതൽ എസ്.ഐ.പി.യും ക്രിപ്റ്റോ കറൻസിയും വരെയുള്ള വിവിധ സാമ്പത്തിക ഉപകരണങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചും അവ എങ്ങനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തെ മാറ്റിമറിക്കാം എന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചും ഈ പുസ്തകം പരിശോധിക്കുന്നു.

buddh-ka-gyaan-part-6.title: Mrityu Ka Shok Kyun?
buddh-ka-gyaan-part-6.description: Maut se judi har ghar ki kahani! Suniye kaise Buddh ne samjhaya maut ka asli matlab aur kaise hum is dukh se ubar sakte hain.

rambha-urvashi-menaka.title: రంభ ఊర్వశి మేనక
rambha-urvashi-menaka.description: రంభ, ఊర్వశి, మేనక ఎవరు? వాళ్ళ విధులు ఏమిటి? వాళ్ళని దేవకన్యలు అని ఎందుకు అంటారు? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

daivathinte-vikruthikal.title: ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വികൃതികൾ
daivathinte-vikruthikal.description: മയ്യഴിയിയിലെ മാന്ത്രികൻ അൽഫോൻസോ അച്ഛന്റെയും അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ മകൾ എൽസിയുടെയും  കഥ.  എം മുകുന്ദന്റെ വശ്യസുന്ദരമായ ആഖ്യാനം. കേൾക്കൂ, ദൈവത്തിന്റെ വികൃതികൾ!

amroha-murder-case.title: Ishq Saazish aur Saza
amroha-murder-case.description: Pyar, pagalpan aur junoon ki ek aisi kahani Jo aapko sochne par majboor kar degi. Ek ladki jisne apne boyfriend ke sath ki pure pariwar ki hatya. Uske baad Jo anzaam hua wo aithasik tha. Suniye is sanak bhare pyar ki puri kahani sirf KUKU FM par.

the-power-of-gratitude.title: The Power of Gratitude
the-power-of-gratitude.description: గ్రాటిట్యూడ్ (కృతజ్ఞత) అనేది ఈ రోజుల్లో చాలా రేర్ గా కనిపించే ఒక విలువైన వజ్రం. మరి ఈ వజ్రాన్ని మన జీవితం లో ఒక భాగం గా ఎలా చేసుకోవాలి? మన రెగ్యులర్ లైఫ్ లో ఈ కృతజ్ఞతని ఎలా వ్యక్త పరచాలి? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ ని వినండి.

the-master-key-system-3.title: The Master Key System
the-master-key-system-3.description: Zindagi mein safalta hasil karne ka tareeka dhundh rahe ho? Agar haan, Toh ye Book Explanation aapke liye bilkul perfect destination hai. Ismein author Charles Haanel ne batayein hain success achieve karne ke vo lessons, Jihne Bill Gates ne bhi apni life mein apply kiya aur aaj unki achievements sabko pata hain. Isiliye abhi suniye aur aap bhi apni journey shuru kariye.

stress-management-solutions.title: Stress Management Solutions
stress-management-solutions.description: ఈ రోజుల్లో ప్రతివాళ్ళ లైఫ్ లోనూ కామన్ గా కనిపించే శత్రువు పేరే ఒత్తిడి. మరి రెగ్యులర్ లైఫ్ లో ఈ ఒత్తిడి ని జయించటం ఎలా? అసలు స్ట్రెస్ మేనేజ్మెంట్ ని ఎలా ఫాలో అవ్వాలి? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ ని వినండి.

lokotharakathakal-fyodor-dostoevsky.description: വിഖ്യാത റഷ്യൻ സാഹിത്യകാരൻ ദസ്തയേവ്സ്കിയുടെ ഹൃദയഹാരിയായ കഥകൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കായി അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു Kuku FM.  ഇയോബിന്റെ പുസ്തകം സിനിമ കണ്ടിഷ്ട്ടപെട്ട നിങ്ങൾ ദസ്തെയ്‌വ്സ്കിയുടെ ക്ലാസിക് കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാൻ മറക്കരുത്!

become-successful-right-now-1.title: Become Successful Right Now
become-successful-right-now-1.description: Kya ab aapse safalta hasil karne ke liye aur intzaar nahi hota? Toh pareshan mat hoiye. Kyunki waqt aa gaya hai un final steps ko lene ka, Jo ki is Book explanation mein bataye gaye hain. Isme hai success achieve karne ki powerful insights. Isiliye abhi suniye aur unhein jaankar apni life mein apply karna shuru kariye.

kanneerum-kinavum.title: കണ്ണീരും കിനാവും
kanneerum-kinavum.description: കഴിഞ്ഞ നൂറ്റാണ്ടിന്റെ നവോത്ഥാന നായകരിൽ ഒരാളായ ശ്രീ. വി.ടി. ഭട്ടതിരിപ്പാടിന്റെ ആത്മകഥയാണ് "കണ്ണീരും കിനാവും". ആചാരങ്ങളാൽ തളച്ചിടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്ന തന്റെ സമുദായത്തെ പ്രകാശത്തിലേക്കും നന്മയിലേക്കും നയിക്കാൻ സ്വന്തം ജീവിതം സമർപ്പിച്ച ഒരു മഹാന്റെ ജീവിതകഥയാണിത്.

rama-ikshvaku-kulatilaka.title: Rama - Ikshvaku Kulatilaka
rama-ikshvaku-kulatilaka.description: ಇತರರು ತನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೇರುವ ಕಳಂಕದಿಂದ ರಾಮ ಮೇಲೇರುತ್ತಾನಾ? ಸೀತೆಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಅವನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯು ಅವನ ಹೋರಾಟದ ಮೂಲಕ ಅವನನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆಯೇ? ತನ್ನ ಬಾಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ನಾಶಪಡಿಸಿದ ರಾಕ್ಷಸನಾದ ರಾವಣನನ್ನು ಅವನು ಸೋಲಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆಯೇ? ಅವನು ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿನ ಹಣೆಬರಹವನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸುವನೇ?  ಕೇಳಿರಿ ​​ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKUFM ನಲ್ಲಿ
