the-couple-came-from-hell-3.description: The Couple Came From Hell - Telugu

kyunki-tum-hi-ho-1.title: Kyunki Tum Hi Ho
kyunki-tum-hi-ho-1.description: At the center is Shanaya Mehra, a woman trapped between a toxic husband Arjun Raichand and the scheming Rhea Malhotra, who will do anything to take her place. Every episode unfolds with high-voltage confrontations, tears, and shocking revelations—where loyalty is tested, lies unravel, and survival becomes Shanaya’s only fight.

draculas-kiss-spellbound-by-a-doppelgang.title: Dracula's Kiss : Spellbound by a Doppelganger
draculas-kiss-spellbound-by-a-doppelgang.description: After her boyfriend Neil’s betrayal, Flora seeks revenge by impulsively marrying his enigmatic elder relative, Vittorio. But Vittorio is no ordinary man — he’s a vampire with a dark past and a secret obsession. In his study, Flora finds a photo of a woman who looks exactly like her… taken eighty years ago.

the-westward-anime-season-01.title: The Westward Anime: Season 01
the-westward-anime-season-01.description: The Western Journey is a conspiracy in heaven. After Sutra had been missing for over ten years, heaven decided it must not fall into their hands again, and so it sent its army to Earth. To protect Sutra, the Western Journey began once more.

stop-pretending-miss-gu-will-expose-ever.title: Stop pretending! Miss Gu will expose everything
stop-pretending-miss-gu-will-expose-ever.description: একটা প্রতিষ্ঠিত ব্যবসায়ী পরিবারের একমাত্র উত্তরাধিকারিণী, স্বাধীনচেতা তরুণী, যে ভবিষ্যতে একজন জুয়েলরি ডিজাইনার হতে চায়। কিন্তু তাঁর আসল পরিচয় কেউ যেন না জানতে পারে—যতক্ষণ না পর্যন্ত সে তার নিজের দক্ষতা ও প্রতিভায় নিজেকে প্রতিষ্ঠিত করে তুলতে পারছেন। তবে স্বপ্ন পূরণের পথে একের পর এক বাধা আর বিপত্তি এসে দাঁড়ায়। তাকে মুখোমুখি হতে হয় নানা চ্যালেঞ্জ, শারীরিক ও মানসিক প্রতিবন্ধকতা। সব বাধা কাটিয়ে কি তিনি পূর্ণ আত্মবিশ্বাস নিয়ে নিজেকে সত্যিকার অর্থেই একজন সফল জুয়েলরি ডিজাইনার হয়ে উঠতে পারবেন?

the-strongest-car-model.title: The Strongest Car Model
the-strongest-car-model.description: A fearless woman rises from showroom beauty to motorsport legend, shattering every limit in a male-dominated world. In this high-octane story, speed isn’t her only strength, willpower is.

mistaken-millionaire-husband.title: Mistaken Millionaire Husband
mistaken-millionaire-husband.description: Ms. Sriram oda boy friend Deepak senja betrayal ah vida Rohit Muralitharan oda love true aanathu. Intha Alagana love story ah paathu enjoy pannunga

rishi-bhrigu-and-lord-vishnu-ego-vs-love.title: Rishi Bhrigu and Lord Vishnu – Ego vs. Love
rishi-bhrigu-and-lord-vishnu-ego-vs-love.description: Rishi Bhrigu and Lord Vishnu – Ego vs. Love

my-fake-girlfriend.title: My Fake Girlfriend
my-fake-girlfriend.description: A promise of love turns into a storm of betrayal, violence, and revenge. When Priya, pregnant with her husband Ruhan’s child, is mistaken for a mistress, she’s dragged into a brutal web of public humiliation and personal vendettas. Will truth and justice prevail, or will hatred destroy everything? Watch Now !

the-couple-came-from-hell-4.title: The Couple Came From Hell
the-couple-came-from-hell-4.description: The microdrama begins with the tragic suicide of SN Group President Lumer, falsely accused of scandal, leaving Chin devastated. After a mysterious "rebirth" following a car crash, Chin encounters Lumer again in a new reality, immediately battling a ruthless rival for his estate and uncovering corporate conspiracies. A pervasive theme of planned pregnancies emerges, as multiple women, including Stacy and Shwetha, scheme to secure wealth and status by targeting powerful men like Lumer and Arjun, leading to public accusations and paternity scandals that threaten influential family legacies. Amidst this, Lumer and Chin are forced into a contract marriage to secure a family inheritance, facing constant sabotage from jealous rivals. Chin's journey is further complicated when she is publicly exposed as a "low-class imposter" with a scandalous past, leading to her dismissal from the family lineage by the matriarch, who then introduces a pregnant Stacey as the new successor. This public humiliation intertwines with a deeper narrative of hidden identities, as an amnesiac Chinni is caught between conflicting claims and accusations of murder. It is revealed that Chinni is the long-lost daughter of powerful CEO Emily Scott, who uncovers a sinister conspiracy by the Zon family, responsible for her elder daughter's death and now targeting Chinni. Chinni is dramatically unmasked as the true heiress of a corporate empire, shattering a long-held deception. Concurrently, Chin Scott is forced into a contract marriage with Lumer Smith to prevent a corporate takeover, quickly asserting her dominance. She orchestrates the expulsion of rivals and declares a hostile takeover of the Smith Group after Lumer's family betrays him. Chin faces brutal kidnapping by Cameron, who seeks revenge for a generational feud, but she meticulously plans a trap to expose his deceit. The series culminates with Lumer taking the helm of the Smith Group and Chin being appointed family matriarch, though immediately challenged by an imprisoned rival claiming to be the true heir, leaving the future of their corporate empire and family legacy uncertain amidst ongoing quests for justice and vengeance.

the-legend-of-kaal-kund.title: The Legend of Kaal Kund
the-legend-of-kaal-kund.description: The microdrama unfolds in the chaotic realm of Kaalkund, where the formidable warrior Samarth establishes a brutal new order, compelling opponents to punish themselves. Amidst this, the legendary warrior Ranbir is captured and tormented by Kalkund and his subordinate, Samar. Samar undergoes a transformative journey of atonement within Kalkund, emerging with a desperate mission to reclaim his past love, Kavya, who faces a forced marriage. Disowned by his maternal family, Samar reclaims his identity as Samar Libani and emerges as 'Vaidya Raj,' a reluctant traditional healer. He orchestrates the complete downfall of the powerful Khanna family as payment for healing their patriarch, leveraging the healed Industrialist's allegiance to seize their ancestral home. Samar, now Vaidyaraj, uses his newfound financial power to overcome class prejudice, proving his worth to Kavya's class-conscious father and securing her hand despite challenges from a wealthy suitor. His meticulous revenge also brings the Malhotra family to financial ruin for past caste discrimination. However, a powerful new threat emerges in the form of the Singhania family, who engage in corporate sabotage and repeatedly kidnap Kavya. Samar defies pleas and rushes into deadly traps to save her, even making a dramatic return after being presumed dead to rescue Kavya from a time bomb. It is then revealed that Vaidyaraj deliberately incapacitated a Singhania son, Armaan, as punishment for disrespecting his fiancée, refusing to heal him and declaring his intent to destroy the entire Singhania dynasty. Concurrently, Arjun, a hero with 'siddhis,' discovers his true destiny and connection to the legendary realm of Kaalkund through his mentor, Gurunath. Arjun learns he is destined to become a teacher in Kaalkund after fulfilling current world responsibilities, a destiny immediately thrust upon him when his beloved Kavya is brutally kidnapped by the Singhania family. With Gurunath's guidance, Arjun, alongside the formidable warrior Rishi, is tasked with reclaiming destabilized ancient lands and restoring order, realizing this is just the beginning of a fated series of conflicts that intertwine personal vengeance with a larger, mystical struggle.

the-royal-betrayal.title: The Royal Betrayal
the-royal-betrayal.description: In the chaos of a deadly warzone, a woman crosses paths with the royal heir who shattered her heart — now forced to trust him for survival. As danger closes in, love and revenge collide in a race against death.

maayam-seithayo.title: Maayam Seithayo
maayam-seithayo.description: What happens when a bold girl with a past full of struggle crosses paths with a billionaire groom she never agreed to marry? Dumping Mr. Billionaire dives deep into a world of secret agendas, fake wives, and real emotions. This is not your regular love story. This is revenge with a twist of romance.

son-of-an-mp-1.title: SON OF AN MP
son-of-an-mp-1.description: ক্ষমতাশালী বিধায়ক নন্দনী পাঠকের ছেলে অক্ষত পাঠক মানসিক নির্যাতন এবং রাজনৈতিক প্রত্যাশার উত্তরাধিকারের নীচে আটকা পড়ে। কিন্তু সবকিছু বদলে যায় যখন সে সাক্ষর্তার সাথে দেখা করে, একজন উগ্র এবং স্ব-নির্মিত অনাথ, একটি পালিত গৃহ থেকে আসা যার একমাত্র পরিবার তার ছোট ভাই অনয়। তাদের সংযোগের ফলে শ্রেণী, প্রেম, পরিচয় এবং পদ্ধতিগত ক্ষমতার পচা শিকড় নিয়ে একের পর এক সংঘর্ষের সূত্রপাত হয়। গোপন রহস্য উন্মোচিত হওয়ার সাথে সাথে, সাক্ষর্তা তার আসল বংশ আবিষ্কার করে - সে রাজনৈতিক টাইকুন বিশ্বাস সিংয়ের দীর্ঘ-হারিয়ে যাওয়া কন্যা, যা তাকে মিথ্যা এবং লাভ দ্বারা শাসিত একটি খেলায় অপ্রত্যাশিত উত্তরাধিকারী করে তোলে। স্কুলের উঠোনের কটূক্তি এবং ভাঙা হৃদয় ক্যাম্পাস প্রচারণা, ফাঁস হওয়া কেলেঙ্কারি, জনসাধারণের প্রত্যাখ্যান এবং আদালতের শোডাউনে পরিণত হয়। প্রাক্তন প্রেমিকরা শত্রু হয়ে ওঠে এবং শত্রুরা মিত্র হয়ে ওঠে। অক্ষত শেষ পর্যন্ত রক্তের চেয়ে সত্য বেছে নেওয়ার এবং তার নিজের মায়ের দুর্নীতি প্রকাশ করার সাথে সাথে, সে এবং সাক্ষর্তা একটি অবস্থান নেয় - কেবল নিজেদের জন্য নয়, বরং একটি প্রজন্মের জন্য লড়াই করার জন্য।

kanave-kalaiyaathe.title: Kanave Kalaiyaathe
kanave-kalaiyaathe.description: A powerful CEO’s pregnant wife faces brutal humiliation, betrayal, and violence at the hands of a jealous secretary who schemes to steal her place. But when the truth shatters the lies, she rises for justice, determined to expose the real villain.

revenge-on-cheating-wife.title: Revenge on Cheating Wife
revenge-on-cheating-wife.description: A rich and loving husband, Abhimanyu, builds his world around his beautiful wife Nandita. But Nandita betrays him, fakes her death, frames him in fraud, and runs away with a greedy lover. Left broken and left for dead, Abhimanyu rises again, reborn with power and determination. This is an unlike ever seen before story of revenge.

secret-billionaire-villager-1.title: Secret billionaire Villager
secret-billionaire-villager-1.description: A simple and innocent poor villager is cheated on by his long-term girlfriend for a rich man. With the help of a divine power, the villager becomes rich and handsome, and returns to take revenge on his unfaithful girlfriend.

dont-mess-with-blind-heiress-1.title: Don't Mess with Blind Heiress
dont-mess-with-blind-heiress-1.description: The president of Stewart Group dies mysteriously at home, leaving his daughter Florence blind. Determined to uncover the truth, she suspects her father's protector, Walt, might be the culprit. Through her investigation, she unravels the mystery and finds love.

billionaire-biwi-betrayal.title: Billionaire Biwi Betrayal
billionaire-biwi-betrayal.description: The microdrama centers on Vivan, a billionaire heir living under a false identity, and Meera, a shy college student with career ambitions and materialistic ideals. Their initial romance is complicated by Vivan's secret wealth and his overbearing mother's demands, while Meera prioritizes her professional goals. Vivan's true identity is eventually exposed, shattering Meera's trust, and she accepts a proposal from wealthy Arjun, though she later marries Vivan and enters the affluent Roy family. Meera's new life becomes a gilded cage, as she faces suffocating control, classist prejudice, and relentless psychological warfare from her formidable Mother-in-law and the family patriarch, who forbid her from working. Despite Vivan's initial struggles with divided loyalties, Meera endures public humiliation and accusations of being a gold-digger. Her past as a brilliant fashion tech major clashes with her forced role as a housewife, especially when Vivan's influential friend, Kabir Ahuja, offers her a job, igniting Vivan's possessive jealousy. This opportunity becomes a strategic entry point for Meera's hidden scheme, but tension escalates dramatically when 20 lakh rupees entrusted to her mysteriously vanish. Vivan, influenced by his manipulative mother, shockingly betrays Meera by branding her a thief and expelling her from the estate. However, Vivan's loyal friend, Kabir, intervenes, uncovering evidence that Vivan's mother orchestrated the theft and framed Meera to end their relationship. This revelation shatters Vivan's trust in his mother, leading to a furious confrontation where he defends his love for Meera and exposes his mother's lifelong obsession with control. Despite Vivan desperately seeking forgiveness and acknowledging his mother's scheme, Meera's trust remains deeply broken. Overwhelmed by the family's constant disrespect and lack of freedom for women, Meera makes the heartbreaking decision to leave Vivan. Grief-stricken, Vivan confronts his parents, blaming his mother for the loss, and vehemently asserts Meera's importance. He ultimately defies his aristocratic family, making the ultimate sacrifice by abandoning his home and rigid expectations to pursue his forbidden love and fight for personal dignity alongside Meera, setting the stage for a journey of rebellion and self-discovery.

royal-village-girl.title: Royal Village Girl
royal-village-girl.description:
Aksha arrives in the city with her mother, only to be shunned by her status-conscious sister, Isha. She hides her identity, rises as a wealthy heiress, and follows a pendant’s clue to her true past.
A shocking DNA reveal exposes Isha’s lies, as Aksha reclaims her real name, her mother, and her honor.

hero-ghar-jamai.title: Hero Ghar Jamai
hero-ghar-jamai.description: Hero Ghar Jamai is a heartwarming dramedy that flips traditional roles, following a man who takes pride in running his home while his ambitious wife builds her career. Through humor, love, and everyday struggles, the show explores themes of equality, modern relationships, and breaking stereotypes. With relatable characters and witty moments, it celebrates partnership, resilience, and the evolving definition of family.

damn-youre-hot-professor-3.title: Damn You’re Hot, Professor
damn-youre-hot-professor-3.description: A struggling college student falls for her intimidating yet irresistible professor, sparking a risky romance amid academic pressure and family drama. Their growing bond puts both their futures on the line.

rowdy-ramulamma.title: Rowdy Ramulamma
rowdy-ramulamma.description:
ఆకర్షణీయమైన పల్లెటూరి నుండి వచ్చిన అక్షా, తన తల్లి తో కలిసి నగరానికి వస్తుంది, అక్కడ తన సోదరి ఇషా ఉంటోంది. కానీ నగరంలో స్థాయి కోసం ఇషా, అక్షా మరియు ఆమె తల్లిని తాను తెలిసినవారిగా చెప్పడానికి నిరాకరిస్తుంది.

అక్షా తన నిజమైన గుర్తింపును దాచేసి, తాను ధనిక వారసురాలిగా మారిపోతుంది. అప్పుడే ఒక పాత పెండెంట్ ఆమెను తన విడిపోయిన తల్లి అయిన మిసెస్ పటేల్ వద్దకు తీసుకెళ్తుంది.

తల్లి మీద హత్యాయత్నం జరిగాక, కొన్ని పెద్ద రహస్యాలు బయటపడతాయి. డిఎన్‌ఏ పరీక్ష ద్వారా అసలైన విషయం వెలుగులోకి వస్తుంది — అక్షానే అసలైన షానా పటేల్ అని తెలిసిపోతుంది.

మీడియా ముందు ఇషా చెప్పిన అబద్ధం బహిరంగమవుతుంది. చివరికి, అక్షా తన నిజాన్ని, తల్లిని, మరియు గౌరవాన్ని తిరిగి సంపాదించుకుంటుంది.

ex-ka-badla.title: Ex Ka Badla
ex-ka-badla.description: Once a humble house help in the Malhotra mansion, Anaya’s world shattered when arrogant heir Daksh Malhotra broke her trust and dignity. Years later, she returns transformed into a confident, powerful woman to infiltrate his world, unmask his secrets, and make him pay for every wound he left behind. Watch Now!

mothers-love.title: Mother's Love
mothers-love.description: ఇంట్లో తండ్రి సరిగ్గా లేకపోతే పిల్లల జీవితం కష్టాల పాలు అవుతుంది. అలా కష్టాలు పడే కూతురుకు అమ్మ ప్రేమ దొరికితే.. చూడండి.. మదర్స్ లవ్. కుకు టీవీలో.

vishwaroop-father-of-3-bigshots.title: Vishwaroop - Father of 3 Bigshots
vishwaroop-father-of-3-bigshots.description: Raghav returns home for his father's 70th birthday, hoping to mend familial ties, but his arrival immediately ignites deep-seated conflicts and exposes profound class disparities. His mother, Sneha, openly humiliates him over his divorce and perceived financial shortcomings, contrasting his humble gift with his sisters' lavish offerings. Raghav endures emotional abuse and feels isolated as his parents favor his successful sisters, Priya and Meghna, who conspire to expose his claims about a valuable gift. This leads to Priya uncovering her father's deception regarding an expensive wine, culminating in Sneha striking Raghav amidst public accusations of fraud. However, Raghav's young son reveals the wine's true worth, setting the stage for a high-stakes challenge with Priya. The conflict escalates as Raghav faces constant scorn and accusations of deception, particularly regarding a rare wine bottle, and is publicly accused of gifting a fake antique. Despite being labeled a "thief" and facing technological fraud allegations, Raghav, with his son Rishabh's help, proves the authenticity of a valuable wine. After winning a bet, he demands apologies from his sisters. In a shocking turn, Raghav reveals he is the owner of the powerful "Royal Group," despite public accusations of impersonation, asserting his integrity and vowing his children will claim their rightful place. The drama expands into corporate dealings, with Raghav facing fraud allegations and his mother, Meghna, being revealed as the CEO's mother, hinting at deeper family and corporate entanglements. Entrepreneur Sanjay's world is shattered by corporate betrayal, while a family patriarch, Papa, is stunned to learn his sons are secretly powerful CEOs. The series culminates with Raghav, now a revealed powerful figure, preparing to leave his affluent family home. His remorseful parents desperately beg for his forgiveness for past cruelty, but Raghav maintains a stoic front, hinting at a complex path towards reconciliation or revenge. The show explores the high stakes of honor, acceptance, and familial power against a backdrop of wealth, status, and deep-seated resentments.

my-ex-husbands-breakdown-after-divorce-1.title: My Ex-Husband's Breakdown After Divorce
my-ex-husbands-breakdown-after-divorce-1.description: హెన్రీ లినాను ఎంతో ప్రేమించేవాడు, కానీ ఒలివియాకు కారణంగా ఒక అపోహ ఏర్పడింది. లినా బాధపడి అతన్ని వదిలేసి వెళ్లిపోయింది మరియు విడాకులు కోరింది. మొదట్లో హెన్రీ ఆ విషయాన్ని అంతగా పట్టించుకోలేదు, కానీ లినా వెళ్లిపోయిన తర్వాత అతను తీవ్రమైన పశ్చాత్తాపంలో మునిగిపోయి, ఆమెను తిరిగి పొందడానికి విపరీతంగా ప్రయత్నించాడు

pyar-ki-agnee.title: Love Ka Ultimate Test
pyar-ki-agnee.description: A chance encounter between the vulnerable Suman and the mysterious mechanic Nivaan blossoms into a profound romance, leading to a heartfelt proposal. However, their idyllic love story takes a dramatic turn when Suman's wealthy family, particularly Kunal and Raghav, vehemently oppose the union due to class prejudice, deeming Nivaan unworthy. Nivaan, an earnest outsider, faces intense hostility, insults, and physical threats, but stands firm in his unwavering love. He accepts a humiliating challenge to live as a servant for six months to prove his devotion, enduring demeaning conditions to defy class barriers and win Suman's hand. During this period, Nivaan endures brutal abuse and false accusations from Raghav, who relentlessly seeks to destroy his forbidden love with Suman. Suman defiantly stands by Nivaan, but is eventually publicly shamed and confined by her father Dhameeja and brother Raghav, who accuse Nivaan of being a gold-digger. Despite the systematic destruction of his life's work and public humiliation by Raghav, Nivaan, a talented mechanic, finds renewed purpose through his mother's support. He triumphs in a high-stakes wager, successfully repairing a luxury car and silencing his wealthy detractors, proving his worth. The narrative takes a significant turn with the dramatic collapse of the Dhamija empire due to Raghav's multi-million dollar fraud, leading to the patriarch Sanjay's arrest and the seizure of all family assets. Amidst this downfall, Nivaan, now a successful entrepreneur, dramatically reveals his ownership of the Dhamija family mansion, turning the tables on the once-powerful family and challenging their arrogance and class distinctions. Suman, now released from confinement, fiercely confronts Raghav for his past cruelty and fraud against Nivaan, demanding justice. Ultimately, the stern patriarch, Raghav's Father, is moved by Nivaan's integrity and accepts him into the family, leading to a reconciliation with Raghav's Mother and blessings for Nivaan and Suman. However, Raghav's refusal to apologize results in his expulsion and a vow of revenge, casting a shadow over the family's newfound harmony and hinting at lingering threats to their hard-won future.

married-but-available-perfume-and-moon-5.title: Married But Available Perfume And Moon
married-but-available-perfume-and-moon-5.description:
আলফা আর্থারের প্রত্যাবর্তনে এক জাঁকজমকপূর্ণ প্রাসাদে উৎসবের আয়োজন হয়, যেখানে তিনি সম্ভ্রান্তশালী এলিনের অপমান থেকে দাসী ক্লোয়েকে উদ্ধার করেন। দাদার অনুরোধে ক্লোয়ে অন্যত্র বাগদান সেরে ফেললেও, আর্থারের বিদায়ের পর সে নিঃশব্দে উইলিয়াম ম্যানসনে কাজ করতে থাকে, চিকিৎসার খরচ জোগানোড় জন্য। কিন্তু ক্লোয়ের প্রতিভায় মুগ্ধ হয়ে আর্থার সমস্ত বিরোধিতা অগ্রাহ্য করে সেই বাগদান বাতিল করেন।
তবে হঠাৎ গল্পের মোড় ঘুরে যায়, যখন ক্লোয়ের ভেতরে সুপ্ত নেকড়ে-মানব জিন জেগে ওঠে, আর প্রকাশ পায়—সেই আর্থারের ভাগ্যনির্ধারিত সঙ্গিনী।

overcoming-obstacles-the-counter-attack-.title: Overcoming Obstacles: The Counter attack On The Twin Babies
overcoming-obstacles-the-counter-attack-.description: এক তরুণী মা প্রতারণায় বিমর্ষ হয়ে তার নবজাতক যুগল সন্তানের থেকে বিচ্ছিন্ন হয়; সন্তানরা ধরে নেয় তারা হারিয়ে গেছে। বছর পরে, তারা ফিরে আসে—মিষ্টি হাসি, সাহসী মন নিয়ে, এবং সত্য ও ন্যায়ের প্রতি দৃঢ় সংকল্প নিয়ে। ভালোবাসা ও ন্যায়ের তাগিদে, তারা সত্য অনুসন্ধান করে এবং একটি সহানুভূতিশীল অপরিচিতের সাহায্য পায়। একসাথে, তারা শুরু করে এক শক্তিশালী যাত্রা। মায়ের অটুট বন্ধনের এক অপরাজেয় গল্প।

last-chance-for-love.title: Sky High Love ✈️
last-chance-for-love.description: For ten long years, Shivani's heart beat only for Mohit. A contract marriage and an unexpected child promised a fairytale life — until destiny struck. When Mohit's past returned to claim him, Shivani's world crumbled. Shattered and betrayed, she walked away… only for Mohit to realise, too late, that he had lost the love of a lifetime.

cold-blooded-alpha-king.title: Cold Blooded Alpha King
cold-blooded-alpha-king.description: রক্তশূন্য ও নির্দয় আলফা রাজা লোগান সাক্ষাৎ করে আকর্ষণীয় শে-উলফ অনিয়া’র সঙ্গে। কিন্তু একাকী স্বভাবের লোগান অনিয়াকে কাছে আসতে বাধা দেয়। কিন্তু প্রেম বাঁধা মানে না! সৌন্দর্য ও পশুত্বের এই নিষিদ্ধ প্রেম একদিকে অনিচ্ছা, অন্যদিকে আকাঙ্ক্ষার জন্ম দেয়—আর ধীরে ধীরে দু’জনেই ভেসে যায় নিয়তির গভীর প্রেমে।

wake-up-dad-wedding-time-4.title: Wake Up, Dad! Wedding Time
wake-up-dad-wedding-time-4.description: The story follows a long chain of family crises that keep turning into battles over survival, inheritance, and control. It begins with Lila facing a dangerous pregnancy and refusing her father’s demand that she end it, even as she is thrown out and a mysterious man rushes in to stop her from leaving. From there, the conflict widens into a corporate family war where hidden affairs, secret children, and succession rules threaten a powerful company. Roman emerges as a central force in that struggle, moving between boardroom pressure, family rivalry, and the mystery surrounding Daniel and his mother. Daniel becomes the emotional center of the show, with illness, surgery, disappearance, and kidnapping accusations repeatedly raising the stakes. Laila is pulled into a marriage arrangement with Roman that is framed as temporary, but it quickly becomes tied to custody, reputation, and family leverage. Nora repeatedly challenges Laila’s place, using Daniel and household authority to force obedience and reopen old romantic wounds. Grayson remains a rival presence throughout, sometimes acting as an ally and sometimes as part of the larger contest for power and affection. The show also expands into a public scandal around hidden pregnancies, paternity claims, and a revealed past romance that keeps destabilizing every alliance. Roman’s attempts to control the situation often collide with his own feelings, making his relationship with Laila both protective and unstable. As the pressure rises, family members are pushed into humiliating compromises, forced signatures, and public confrontations. A fashion and design storyline then adds another layer of competition, where plagiarism accusations and stolen sketches become another form of control and sabotage. Laila’s ambition to study and work in fashion survives even while she is trapped inside family conflict and marriage politics. The competition exposes coercion behind the scenes, suggesting that several victories are built on pressure rather than merit. Meanwhile, the romance and scandal threads keep feeding each other, with rumors, jealousy, and public shame shaping every major decision. In the final stretch, the conflict escalates into hostage-style leverage, company-share blackmail, and armed standoffs that force Roman to choose between power and the woman he loves. A presumed-dead figure later reveals hidden control over events, showing that the struggle has been manipulated from deeper in the background. The tone then shifts toward a more tender resolution, with proposal and family acceptance replacing some of the earlier hostility, though the show’s core tension between love, control, and survival remains.

the-mysterious-noble-husband.title: The Mysterious Noble Husband
the-mysterious-noble-husband.description: A humble bride discovers her ordinary husband is actually a powerful, hidden nobleman. In this romantic story, love deepens as secrets unravel and dangers close in.

fall-into-sweet-trap-5.title: Fall Into Sweet Trap
fall-into-sweet-trap-5.description: কেটলিন অফিসের নোংরা পলিটিক্স আর তার প্রাক্তন স্বামীর বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা থেকে বাঁচার জন্য কঠিন লড়াই করে চলেছে। সাইমন তার পরিবারের ব্যবসা আবার দারুণভাবে চালু করার চেষ্টা চালিয়ে যাচ্ছে। ভাগ্য তাদের নিয়ে আসে একটা চুক্তিভিত্তিক বিয়েতে—প্রেম নেই, শুধু বাস্তবিক প্রয়োজনে সেই বিয়ে। কিন্তু একসাথে সময় কাটাতে কাটাতে তাঁদের দুজনেরই মন একটু একটু করে নরম হতে শুরু করে। শেষমেশ এই বিয়ে কি কাগুজে চুক্তির মধ্যেই সীমাবদ্ধ থেকে যাবে নাকি তারা সত্যিকারের ভালোবাসায় জড়িয়ে পড়বে?

twisted-flames.title: Twisted Love
twisted-flames.description:
After a traumatic encounter where Yash forcibly impregnates Roshni, her life takes a darker turn when her own stepmother sells her to a wealthy aristocrat. The cruel irony? This powerful man is none other than Yash's estranged brother, Vikram.
While Vikram acquires Roshni merely as a plaything to torment, Yash undergoes an unexpected transformation - he genuinely falls in love with his victim. Torn between guilt and devotion, Yash devises a desperate plan: he finds and trains a Roshni lookalike to take her place.

rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-3.title: Rebirth: My Cheat Code Life
rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-3.description:
এক নারীর বহু বছরের ত্যাগ আর প্রেমকে পিষে এগিয়ে যায় চেং শুয়ান।
স্বীকৃতি না পেয়ে, সে প্রকাশ করে এক লুকানো সত্য—অপহরণ, বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা, এমনকি খুনের দায়।
যে জীবনটাকে সে ‘ভাবনাহীন’ বলেছিল, সেটাই ছিল ষড়যন্ত্রে মোড়া এক ছলনা।

once-upon-a-divorce-the-double-life-of-l.title: Once Upon a Divorce: The Double Life of Lady Diana
once-upon-a-divorce-the-double-life-of-l.description: The story follows a long-running web of mistaken identities, public humiliation, and family power struggles centered on Henry Maxwell, Diana, and the rival Silas and Redman circles. It begins with marriage confusion that quickly turns into accusations, divorce threats, and a corporate contest over who truly controls the Maxwell name and its business interests. Henry repeatedly shifts between asserting authority and protecting Diana, while others try to use marriage, money, and public pressure to force outcomes in their favor. Diana is repeatedly placed under scrutiny, sometimes as Henry’s wife and sometimes as an impostor, and she resists being bought, controlled, or quietly removed. Around them, auctions, elite gatherings, and family events become stages for status battles, where bids and public claims carry as much weight as private truth. A separate romance thread introduces a man trying to escape an unwanted arrangement while admitting he loves someone he has only known online, leading to a temporary marriage that remains unstable. Another emotional thread follows Blue and Maxwell through supportive messages and fragile trust, with warnings about medication and loneliness underscoring how vulnerable these bonds are. As the story develops, Blue becomes a major mystery, with signed cards, paintings, and hidden claims suggesting that identity and ownership are tied together. The conflict deepens when Blue’s identity is disputed, then openly claimed by others, turning the question of who is real into a public feud. Diana is repeatedly accused of impersonation or of standing in for someone else, while family figures and witnesses are called in to verify the truth. The auction and art disputes widen the battlefield, with altered lists, missing items, and suspicious proof hinting at a larger cover-up. Henry’s relationship with Diana grows more intimate at moments, but it is constantly interrupted by scandal, business pressure, and hostile relatives. At one point, the truth behind hidden names like Blue and Wheat is revealed, confirming that Henry and Diana had been searching for each other all along. That revelation does not end the conflict, because corporate sabotage, kidnapping, and share extortion soon force Henry into painful sacrifices to protect Diana. Jenny is drawn into the chaos as a fake wife and bait in coercive schemes, showing how easily people are used as leverage in this world. The Maxwell family’s internal strain grows worse as stock collapses, takeover threats, missing valuables, and demands for divorce pile up. By the later stretch, Henry and Diana’s contract marriage breaks down under pressure, even as family opposition and arranged-marriage threats continue to close in. Blue’s hidden identity is eventually exposed in another emotional turn, and departures, denied entries, and public showdowns leave several characters fighting for belonging. Across the whole arc, the central stakes are love versus control, truth versus impersonation, and whether any of the characters can keep their identity, marriage, and family standing intact.

sweet-deal-deadly-man.title: Risky love
sweet-deal-deadly-man.description: Nurse Ananya Sharma’s life takes a shocking turn when a deal to save her brother’s life binds her to ruthless mafia kingpin Robin Shetty in a one-year contract marriage. As betrayals, rival gangs, and deadly secrets close in, Ananya must navigate love, fear, and the dangerous world of a man who will kill to protect her. Watch Now!

dual-plants-decission.title: DUAL PLANTS DECISSION
dual-plants-decission.description: The story follows a long fantasy conflict driven by revenge, prophecy, hidden power, and shifting loyalties. It begins with a wounded survivor blaming the Feng family for destroying his clan and seeking a rare cure under strict conditions from a mysterious gatekeeper. Around him, clinic battles, revenge attacks, and sudden displays of hidden strength show that ordinary healing spaces are already part of a larger war. As the conflict widens, supernatural allies like Yin enter the story and identify a greater threat, Tu Siao, while barriers, ancient races, and mystical weapons suggest that the struggle is tied to fate itself. Another thread follows a grieving young man whose destiny is linked to Neville and to four crystals that can awaken a powerful weapon. The middle of the story becomes more unstable as accusations, soul-exchange rituals, and magical coercion pull couples and rivals into uneasy alliances. Liya is repeatedly shown as central to the conflict, sometimes weakened by supernatural strain and sometimes forced to stand against powerful challengers like Prabhu. At the same time, Cyrus, Lia, Joe, and others are caught in curses, body swaps, and rescue attempts that make personal survival inseparable from the larger magical war. The plot then expands into palace intrigue, where rulers, crown princes, and advisors fight over authority, immortality, and forbidden objects. A ruler’s obsession with immortality and a touchstone, along with the removal of trusted allies, pushes the court toward betrayal and collapse. Neville remains a major force throughout, exploiting misunderstandings, threatening innocents, and deepening distrust between allies. Several battles hinge on bloodline claims, cursed bonds, and the need to unite multiple powers before a greater force can be unleashed. Even after apparent victories, the story refuses to settle, because magical objects, hidden locations, and unresolved curses keep pulling the characters back into danger. Romance also remains unstable, with charged moments, uncertain promises, and separations that are framed as sacrifices. Leah’s bond with Syrus becomes especially tragic, since love and duty repeatedly force them apart. By the end, the characters are still trapped between war and fragile peace, with revenge, destiny, and supernatural control continuing to shape every choice.

princess-of-medicine.title: Princess of Medicine
princess-of-medicine.description: When Ananya Rathore returns from the dead to reclaim her legacy, she must outwit power-hungry rivals, face her treacherous uncle Dinesh, and spar with her dangerous yet magnetic husband Rudra in a game where love, revenge, and survival collide. Watch Now!

cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-3.title: Cloaked in Power: His Secret Identity
cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-3.description: এই  গল্পটি এমন এক রহস্যময় চরিত্রের, যে নিজের রাজকীয় পরিচয় গোপন রাখে। এই গল্পে রয়েছে জটিল রাজনৈতিক বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা এবং আইনের বিরুদ্ধে রুখে দাঁড়ানো এক প্রেমকাহিনি। মোহময় মোড়কে ভরপুর এই গল্পটির প্রতিটি মুহূর্তে রয়েছে চমক!

after-the-breakup-i-lead-my-three-kids-t.title: After the Breakup, I Lead My Three Kids to Conquer All Sides
after-the-breakup-i-lead-my-three-kids-t.description: After the Breakup, I Lead My Three Kids to Conquer All Sides

game-of-crowns.title: Game of Crowns
game-of-crowns.description: When spirited journalist Meera Kapoor is forced into a marriage with cold and powerful business tycoon Arjun Malhotra, love becomes both her captor and her only escape. Watch Now!

cute-baby-assists-i-help-my-mom-marry-th.title: Cute Baby Assists: I Help My Mom Marry the President Tycoon
cute-baby-assists-i-help-my-mom-marry-th.description:
জিউজিকে অপহরণ করে মুক্তিপণ দাবি করে একদল অপরাধী, সময়সীমা বেঁধে দেয় পরদিন পর্যন্ত।
মায়ের কান্না আর অনুনয়ে মন গলেনা, বরং হুমকি আরও ভয়ঙ্কর হয়ে ওঠে—পুলিশ জানালে মৃত্যুর মুখে পড়বে জিউজি।
তবে জিউজি হাল ছাড়ে না, সুযোগ পেয়ে লড়াই শুরু করে, তৈরি হয় টানটান উত্তেজনা।

stages-of-gen-z-love.title: Stages of Gen Z Love
stages-of-gen-z-love.description: Gen Z love, influenced by technology and evolving social norms, features unique terms and approaches to relationships. These include situationship, a blend of friendship and romance without clear boundaries, and ghosting, the abrupt end of communication. Other terms like "love bombing," "breadcrumbing," and "benching" describe specific behaviors within these relationships. Gen Z also navigates concepts like "cuffing season," where they seek temporary partners, and "orbiting," where someone continues to engage with a former partner's social media. Get exciting information on "Stages of Gen Z Love" exclusively from KUKU FM!

how-to-handle-break-up.title: How to Handle Break-Up?
how-to-handle-break-up.description: "How to Handle Break-Up?" refers to navigating the emotional and practical challenges that arise after a romantic relationship ends. It involves coping with feelings of sadness, loss, and potential anger, while also making necessary adjustments to daily life and building a new sense of self. Get exciting information on "How to Handle Break-Up?" exclusively from KUKU FM!

sinful-ties.title: Veil of Vows
sinful-ties.description: Veil of Vows is a dark romantic drama filled with betrayal, family pressure, and dangerous love. The story follows Shruti Khurana, a young woman forced into an arranged marriage with Karan Mehra, an arrogant and controlling man. Trapped between her family's rigid expectations and Karan’s abusive behavior, Shruti finds herself in a suffocating world where love is a weapon and trust is a gamble.

hidden-love-surges-2.title: Hidden Love Surges
hidden-love-surges-2.description: একজন তরুণী বুঝতে পারে যে, যাকে সে প্রাণপন ভালোবাসছিল, সেই মানুষটি আর এক মেয়েকে বিয়ে করতে যাচ্ছে। এই বেদনা সহ্য করতে না পেরে সে ঠিক করে একবার নিজের ভালোবাসার কথা খুলে বলবে। ভয় কাটিয়ে, সে তার ভালোবাসার মানুষের বিয়েতে চলে যায়। সে তার সামনে দাঁড়ায়—তার মনের গভীর থেকে লুকানো ভালোবাসা উজাড় করে। শেষমেশ সে কী তার ভালোবাসা ফিরে পাবে?

the-final-betrayal.title: The Final Betrayal
the-final-betrayal.description: 💃💃💃 During Navratri in Ahmedabad, street vendor Sejal is betrayed by boyfriend Prateek who leaves her for cousin Nandini. Mysterious beggar Shivam proposes a fake marriage to fulfill her dying grandmother’s wish. As they grow closer, Sejal discovers Shivam is actually Shah Industries’ billionaire CEO who went undercover. Despite initial hurt over his deception, true love ultimately prevails and they marry.

blossoms-2003-2.title: Blossoms 2003
blossoms-2003-2.description: The microdrama opens with intense personal and corporate turmoil, as Priya confronts her father over her mother's death, and Akkin's dire warnings of a catastrophic fire are ruthlessly dismissed, leading to widespread devastation and accusations. Amidst this chaos, Leo emerges as a protector, first rescuing Chellam from kidnappers, then heroically saving lives during a suspicious fire, which inadvertently draws him into the dangerous corporate world of Daniel. Leo, facing severe financial hardship and threats to his wife Veena and their daughter from ruthless moneylenders, begins a remarkable transformation into a brilliant financial strategist, later known as Shiva. His audacious investments and sudden accumulation of immense wealth, including the acquisition of a prestigious villa, shock his detractors but also create deep suspicion and tension with his wife, Beena, who fears his involvement in illegal activities and faces pressure from her manipulative sister, Maya. As Leo solidifies his influence, he forms a strategic partnership with the powerful businesswoman Miss Lily, who herself is embroiled in a cutthroat corporate war against the ruthless CEO Sebastian. Lily faces immense pressure, including threats to her family's legacy and fortune, and is eventually forced into an arranged marriage with Sebastian to save her family's projects. Throughout these escalating conflicts, Leo acts as Lily's mysterious ally and protector, gradually revealing his formidable hidden identity as the "11th Emperor," directly challenging Sebastian's dominance and exposing betrayals within powerful conglomerates. The narrative culminates with Leo, now an ambitious CEO, launching a major e-commerce venture with Lily, continuing their high-stakes battle against Sebastian, who systematically dismantles rival empires but faces his own shocking challenges from a man he believed dead. The show explores themes of grief, betrayal, corporate espionage, family loyalty, and the relentless pursuit of power and justice against overwhelming odds.

rising-after-silence.title: The CEO’s Endgame
rising-after-silence.description: After years of silence, she’s ready to fight back. A story of resilience, courage, and finding your voice against all odds. Witness a powerful journey from darkness to unstoppable strength. Watch Now !

when-silence-breaks-1.title: When Silence Breaks
when-silence-breaks-1.description:
ఒక శక్తివంతమైన CEO భార్య, గర్భవతిగా ఉండగానే, ఈర్ష్యతో ఊగిపోతున్న సెక్రటరీ వల్ల అవమానం, ద్రోహం, హింసను ఎదుర్కొంటుంది. ఆమె స్థానాన్ని దక్కించుకోవాలనే కుట్రతో ఆ సెక్రటరీ అడుగులు వేస్తుంది. అసలైన దోషిని బహిర్గతం చేయాలని సంకల్పంతో,
ఆమె నిజం కోసం న్యాయం కోసం  నిలబడుతుంది.

lapata-vaaris-rise-of-the-fallen.title: Lapata Vaaris
lapata-vaaris-rise-of-the-fallen.description: এক ভয়াবহ দুর্ঘটনার পর, রাজ রাঠোড় — শক্তিশালী রাঠোড় ইন্টারন্যাশনালের একমাত্র উত্তরাধিকারী — পক্ষাঘাতগ্রস্ত হয়ে পড়ে, তার স্বপ্ন ভেঙে যায় এবং তার শরীর অসহায় হয়ে পড়ে। পৃথিবী যখন এগিয়ে যেতে শুরু করে, তখন একজন ব্যক্তি তাকে ছেড়ে যেতে রাজি হয় না — মায়া, তার অটল বান্ধবী। ভালোবাসা এবং দৃঢ় ইচ্ছাশক্তির আবদ্ধ হয়ে, সে দিনরাত তার পাশে দাঁড়িয়ে থাকে, প্রতিটি ঝড়ের সাথে লড়াই করে এমন এক নীরব শক্তির সাথে যা ভাগ্যও কাঁপাতে পারে না। রাজের চিকিৎসার ক্রমবর্ধমান খরচ বহন করার জন্য, মায়া শহর জুড়ে দৌড়াদৌড়ি করে — কাজকর্ম চালায়, প্রতিটি দরজায় কড়া নাড়ে এবং নিজেকে তার সীমা ছাড়িয়ে যায়। এমন একটি পৃথিবীতে যেখানে তার সংগ্রামকে উপহাস করা হত, সে অটল ছিল। এবং শেষ পর্যন্ত, তার অটুট বিশ্বাসই অলৌকিক হয়ে ওঠে — রাজ আবার জেগে ওঠে, কেবল বেঁচে থাকার জন্য নয়, বরং তার পায়ে প্রেমে পড়ে, তার সম্মানের জন্য এবং সেই মহিলার গৌরবের জন্য যিনি কখনও তাকে হার মানেননি।

immortal-cultivation.title: Immortal Cultivation
immortal-cultivation.description: Immortal Cultivation follows the story of Li Shen, a powerful cultivator, who discovers that his wife, Liu Fei, has been betraying him and plotting against him with their enemies. Heartbroken and enraged, Li Shen divorces her, triggering a series of events that force him to grow stronger in his cultivation journey. As he rises in power, Liu Fei seeks revenge, and Li Shen must navigate a world of betrayal, power struggles, and immortality to find his redemption.

after-being-dumped-i-married-a-rich-heir.title: After Being Dumped, I Married a Rich Heir in a Flash
after-being-dumped-i-married-a-rich-heir.description: ప్రేమ లేకుండా తిరస్కరించబడిన ఆమె, విడాకులు తీసుకుని ఒక్కసారిగా ఓ ధనవంతుడిని పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటుంది. ఈ అనూహ్య నిర్ణయం ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన మలుపులను తెస్తుంది. ఆ మలుపులతో కొత్త జీవితం మొదలవుతుంది — ఆసక్తికరంగా, అనుకోని నిజాలతో నిండిన విధంగా.

you-got-the-wrong-person.title: You Got The Wrong Person
you-got-the-wrong-person.description: You Got The Wrong Person is a story of a humble new student is mistaken for a poor nobody, she becomes the target of the elite’s cruelty.But Eva has secrets, and she’s not the one they should be underestimating.A fiery school drama where status, lies, and revenge collide.

dumping-mr-billionaire-1.title: Dumping Mr. Billionaire
dumping-mr-billionaire-1.description: এক সাহসী মেয়ে যার অতীত জুড়ে শুধুই সংগ্রাম, এক আকাশ ইচ্ছা তার দেশের সবথেকে বড় আইনজীবী হওয়ার। অনিচ্ছা সত্ত্বেও তার বিয়ে হয় এক ধনবান ব্যক্তির সঙ্গে। সেই অনিচ্ছার বিয়ের পরিণতি কী হয়? পরিবারের মানুষজনের লুক্কায়িত উদ্দেশ্য, ভুয়ো স্ত্রী এবং সত্যিকারের এক আবেগের দুনিয়ায় পরিভ্রমণ করে গল্প। কোনো সাধারণ প্রেমকাহিনি নয়। প্রতিশোধ আর ভালোবাসার এক দুমড়ানো ও মুচরানো কাহিনি।

palace-secrets.title: PALACE SECRETS
palace-secrets.description: The microdrama begins amidst a series of impending high-society weddings for wealthy CEO Arjun, involving women like Riya Kapoor, Sivani, and Meghna, all seemingly driven by financial ambition rather than genuine connection. His elder sister, Akka, senses underlying complexities and prays for his well-being. Defiant figures, particularly Indrani, emerge to expose the perceived gold-digging motives of these brides and the arrogance of powerful families like the Kapoors and Rathores. Indrani endures public humiliation and classist taunts from the Kapoor family, including Riya, fueling her quest for justice and revenge. She orchestrates a "Royal Sting" to expose Riya's intentions, while Arjun returns with a hidden identity, also seeking revenge for past humiliation. A sinister conspiracy unfolds concurrently, involving Sanjay and his father attempting to hide a still-living body, later identified as Kumari, who desperately calls out for Arjun. Bride Nithya and her mother Savithri are implicated in covering up Kumari's incapacitation, hinting at a dangerous secret. Indrani, revealing herself as Arjun's sister, crashes a Kapoor family event, leading to further brutal humiliation, false accusations of theft, and physical torment by Riya, the Kapoor Matriarch, and Anita Kapoor. Arjun frantically searches for his missing sister, challenging the injustice against her, unaware of Riya's potential involvement in the conspiracy. Indrani mysteriously disappears from a family celebration, and Arjun discovers chilling evidence of her violent abduction, eventually finding her severely injured in a locked storeroom. His resolve for justice intensifies as he uncovers deceit and resistance from figures like Anita and Radha. At Arjun's wedding, a mysterious man dramatically exposes his fiancée, Riya, as a manipulative gold-digger with a secret affair, revealing the Kapoor family's bankruptcy and their "contract marriage" scheme for wealth. Arjun's world shatters as he learns Riya and her debt-ridden family orchestrated the plot and were involved in harming Indrani, with a trusted maid providing secret surveillance recordings. Fueled by his sister Indraani's brutal assault and public humiliation, Arjun embarks on a relentless quest for justice and retribution. He systematically exposes the Kapoor family's deceit, financial insolvency, and their complicity in the attacks on Indraani. Arjun confronts his wife, Riya, for her role in shaming his sister and orchestrates the public downfall of the Kapoor family, including Riya's secret lover and manager, Karan. The show culminates in Arjun delivering severe, untraceable internal injuries to his sister's tormentors before they face legal consequences, ensuring a chilling lesson in vengeance and family honor.

dad-let-me-clean-the-house.title: Dad, Let Me Clean The House
dad-let-me-clean-the-house.description: When a young daughter insists on cleaning the family home, she uncovers a hidden past her father tried to bury forever. A simple chore becomes a turning point that changes their relationship and their lives forever.

nenjam-marappathillai.title: Nenjam Marappathillai
nenjam-marappathillai.description: The microdrama centers on Aksha, a diligent village girl who moves to the city, unknowingly entangled in a web of deceit and hidden identities. Initially, her social-climbing sister, Usha, faces financial ruin and the termination of her relationship with wealthy CEO Vishal after her lies about her humble origins are exposed. Concurrently, Vishal is on a quest to find his lost childhood fiancée, Shana, an amnesiac heiress whose identity has been usurped by an impostor. Aksha, meanwhile, grapples with her own forgotten past, linked to a mysterious pendant and a looming abduction threat, while Usha ruthlessly attempts to manipulate her mother for a strategic marriage, even at Aksha's expense. As Aksha begins working for Vishal, their paths intertwine, and Vishal is impressed by her integrity, even defending her against harassment and injustice. A mysterious connection between Aksha and Vishal, hinted at by identical pendants, sparks Aksha's desperate search for her unknown past. Shana, revealed to be Vishal's presumed fiancée and the long-lost heiress, grows increasingly jealous of Vishal's burgeoning affection for Aksha, leading her to manipulate others and plot sabotage against Aksha's professional advancements. Aksha's professional life flourishes despite false accusations and sabotage, leading to her promotion and Vishal confessing his love for her, further fueling the rivalry with Woman 2, who is obsessed with Vishal. The drama intensifies with Aksha's brutal abduction, only for her to awaken in Vishal's home under unsettling circumstances, complicating her engagement to another man. Further revelations expose Aksha's true parentage and the shocking truth that her sister, Isha, is not biological and has orchestrated an elaborate scheme to usurp Aksha's identity within the prestigious Pawan family. Isha, who publicly disavows her past, discovers her fiancé, Vishal, is the son of the very woman she shamed, escalating their conflict. The series culminates in a fierce confrontation where Radha, claiming to be the true daughter, is exposed by Vishal for heinous crimes including attempted murder and abduction. Vishal, demonstrating loyalty to his mothers, proposes to Shana, while Radha promises a vengeful return, leaving a looming threat over the intertwined destinies.

masoom-dil-shahi-jazbaat.title: Like, Share and Destroy
masoom-dil-shahi-jazbaat.description: When innocent village girl Meher is thrust into the opulent but treacherous world of Prince Ayaan, love blossoms amid royal politics, hidden agendas, and a fight for the truth. Watch Now!

damn-youre-hot-professor-2.title: Damn you're hot, Professor
damn-youre-hot-professor-2.description: ఆర్థికంగా కష్టాలు ఎదుర్కొంటున్న ఓ కాలేజీ విద్యార్థిని, కఠినంగా కనిపించే కానీ ఆకర్షణీయమైన ప్రొఫెసర్‌పై మనసు పడుతుంది. చదువులో ఒత్తిడి మరియు కుటుంబ సమస్యల మధ్య, వారిద్దరి మధ్య ఏర్పడిన ప్రమాదకరమైన ప్రేమ సంబంధం, వారి భవిష్యత్తును దెబ్బతీసే పరిస్థితికి తీసుకెళ్తుంది

royal-affair-2.title: Royal Affair
royal-affair-2.description: రియాను పెళ్ళి చేసుకుని సెటిల్ అవ్వాలనుకుంటాడు అర్జున్. ఆ సమయంలో తన అక్క ఇంద్రాణికి అవమానం జరుగుతుంది? ఆ తర్వాత ఏం అయ్యింది. చూడండి రాయల్  ఎఫైర్ కుకు టీవీలో.

romeo-akbar-walter.title: Romeo Akbar Walter.
romeo-akbar-walter.description: The story unfolds as a broad spy-and-war drama set against the upheaval of 1971 and the surrounding intelligence battles. It begins with a divided nation under oppression, where mass death, unrest, and the push for self-rule create a constant sense of danger. Against that backdrop, ordinary public figures are revealed to be covert assets, and private lives are repeatedly pulled into national duty. Duniya is forced to hide her assignment from her dependent mother, showing how espionage demands sacrifice at home as well as in the field. Romeo is recruited, watched, and trained for a mission that grows more dangerous as surveillance, gunfire, and explosions close in around him. Aman is also drawn into clandestine work, first through a Karachi network and later through a mission that leaves him vulnerable to betrayal and disavowal. Akbar Malik becomes one of the central figures in the covert struggle, moving through shifting identities, urgent instructions, and high-risk operations tied to arms, locks, and hidden targets. His rise is repeatedly threatened by suspicion, coercion, and interrogation, and he is eventually pushed into a fabricated identity that demands survival through hatred and secrecy. Around him, senior figures debate loyalty, leaks, and the danger of insiders, suggesting that the greatest threat may come from within the system itself. Nawab Afridi’s orbit adds another layer of family betrayal, as he survives an attack and suspects his own son may be involved. The conflict widens into military planning, with covert strikes, disguised attacks, and warnings of a looming massacre that must be exposed before it is too late. Journalists and diplomats are pulled into the effort to reveal atrocities and force international pressure, showing that information itself becomes a weapon. At the same time, several characters are arrested, interrogated, or tortured as authorities try to extract real names and hidden loyalties. The repeated demand for identity underscores the show’s central tension: who someone truly is versus the role they are forced to play. As the war escalates, personal grief and political catastrophe move together, with mothers, sons, and families left behind while operatives disappear into secret missions. The later arc turns even harsher, with leaks, public blame, and open pursuit turning covert conflict into direct violence. By the end, the story has expanded from hidden recruitment and family pressure into a full-scale struggle of espionage, betrayal, and wartime survival, where every alliance is fragile and every identity may be a mask.

the-billionaires-revenge.title: The Billionaire's Revenge
the-billionaires-revenge.description:
Divya risks everything to protect her fiancé Mihir, who suffers from amnesia. Their love is tested when a vengeful don, Rana, reveals dark secrets from Mihir’s hidden past.
As Mihir’s powerful lineage resurfaces, they triumph—but a deeper conspiracy still looms.

thackeray.title: Thackeray
thackeray.description: Watch the latest movie "Thackeray" only on KUKU tv.

royal-betrayal-2.title: Royal Betrayal
royal-betrayal-2.description: ఘోర యుద్ధం మధ్యలో, ఓ యువతి – తన హృదయాన్ని చీల్చిన రాజవంశ వారసుడిని మళ్లీ ఎదుర్కొంటుంది. బ్రతికేందుకు ఇప్పుడు అతనిపై నమ్మకం పెట్టుకోవాల్సి వస్తుంది. ప్రాణహానికీ ముందే, ప్రేమా–ప్రతీకారాలు ఒకే మార్గంలో ఢీకొంటాయి

minnale.title: Minnale
minnale.description: A struggling college student falls for her intimidating yet irresistible professor, sparking a risky romance amid academic pressure and family drama. Their growing bond puts both their futures on the line.

you-will-miss-me.title: Rakhi Ke Bandhan Ko Nibhana
you-will-miss-me.description: The series opens with Vikram and Seema's marital tensions during a medical emergency, leading to the joyous birth of their daughter, whose happiness is immediately threatened by a mysterious woman and subsequent disappearance from the hospital. A decade later, they reunite with Ananya, a girl from an orphanage, but Vikram falsely declares a DNA match to protect Seema, building their happiness on a profound secret. This deception unravels when a mysterious figure hints at the lack of DNA testing, culminating in a woman crashing Ananya's 18th birthday, claiming to be the true Bhardwaj daughter. This woman, Jaanvi, challenges Ananya's identity, prompting the Patriarch to confess to faking a DNA test, revealing Ananya is not his biological daughter, but Jaanvi is. Jaanvi, seeking revenge for a past kidnapping by Ananya's mother, infiltrates the family, leading to Ananya's ostracization and unjust blame for various incidents. A devastating crisis strikes when Yash suffers kidney failure, and Ananya selflessly donates a kidney to save him, yet her recovery is sabotaged, and the family is led to believe Jaanvi made the sacrifice. Ananya's attempts to reveal her true donation are met with disbelief and public humiliation, orchestrated by Jaanvi, who frames Ananya for pushing Vikram Bhardwaj into a coma, resulting in Ananya's unjust imprisonment for ten years. Upon her release, Ananya faces a sinister plot by her ex-fiancé, Yash, and public shaming from her family, while also demonstrating professional skill that saves Yash's career. Her past resurfaces with Siddharth's illicit proposal, igniting her sister's jealousy, and a new protector, Viraj, emerges amidst corporate scandal. The drama intensifies as Siddharth marries Janvi in an act of revenge, but Ananya intervenes, desperately trying to stop the union. Siddharth's critically ill father, the Patriarch, awakens from his coma, becoming Janvi's target for his fortune. Ananya's timely intervention exposes Janvi as a manipulative imposter and confirms Ananya as the Patriarch's true daughter. The shocking truth of Ananya being Yash's life-saving kidney donor, deliberately concealed by Janvi, is finally revealed. The series culminates in a poignant family reconciliation, as Ananya's parents and brother confront their past cruelty and seek her forgiveness, forging a new path towards unity and healing.

nee-thanae-en-pon-vasantham.title: Nee Thanae En pon vasantham
nee-thanae-en-pon-vasantham.description: The microdrama chronicles the tumultuous love story of Rohan and Ananya, beginning with their forced separation due to Rohan's career ambitions and his manipulative uncle's interference, which leads to Ananya's secret pregnancy. Eight years later, Rohan returns as a successful cricketer and CEO, completely unaware of the son he shares with Ananya, who is now a struggling single mother. Their paths dramatically cross again when Rohan hires Ananya as his personal assistant, reigniting old feelings and unresolved tensions. The explosive truth of their hidden child, Ishaan, is revealed when the young boy innocently calls Rohan 'Appa,' forcing Rohan to confront a past he never knew existed. Rohan's deep-seated bitterness over Ananya's past betrayal resurfaces, leading to volatile confrontations and a demand for answers about Ishaan's paternity, which is later confirmed by a shared birthmark. Ananya, a resilient single mother, fiercely guards the secret of Ishaan's parentage amidst financial hardship and public humiliation, while Rohan's protective instincts emerge. A mysterious woman, Maya, driven by obsession and class prejudice, orchestrates sinister schemes to destroy Ananya's reputation and strip Rohan of his paternity rights, adding further layers of intrigue and conflict. Rohan also discovers his own father, Appa, pressured Ananya to abort their child years ago to protect Rohan's career, leading to a strained relationship and a refusal of forgiveness. Despite these challenges, Rohan and Ananya reconcile, rekindling their romance, and Rohan commits to his newfound family. The series culminates with Rohan achieving a significant career milestone, proposing to Ananya with a ring held for eight years, and the family embarking on a hopeful new chapter, symbolizing their deep commitment and a new beginning.

dangerous-dad.title: Dangerous Dad
dangerous-dad.description: A cleaner, Aaryan, saves a rich girl, Avni, from the clutches of a wealthy man. Aaryan is actually a secret head of the syndicate and is called Ghost, but he has hidden this identity from everyone – even his own son. How will he navigate his life while also fighting his enemies on his journey? Watch now!

the-awakening-1.title: The Awakening
the-awakening-1.description: এই বিচিত্র পৃথিবীতে সংঘর্ষ চলেই  যাচ্ছে ,প্রাচীন অভিশাপ এবং আধুনিক শক্তির।  "রাঘব" একজন রহস্যময় যোদ্ধা। তার প্রিয় নারীকে রক্ষা করার জন্য , ভুলে যাওয়া শক্তি নিয়ে পুনরায় সে জেগে ওঠে।পারিবারিক  রাজনীতি, বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা আর  নিয়তি যখন একে অপরের সাথে মিশে যায়, তখন তাকে একটি সম্পূর্ণ "প্রজন্মের ভবিষ্যৎ" গঠনের জন্য ,তার অতীতের মুখোমুখি হতে হয়।

not-the-bride.title: Not the Bride
not-the-bride.description: Ishita, ek khubsurat aur samajhdaar ladki, shaadi se kuch din pehle apne pyaar Jay ka dhokha khati hai jab woh Shanavi aur uski maa ke behkave mein aakar shaadi tod deta hai. Beizzati ke baad, Ishita himmat se apne liye naya dulha dhoondh leti hai. Jay ki shaadi ke din, Ishita bhi apni shaadi rakh kar usse hamesha ke liye alvida keh deti hai, yeh samjhaate hue ki ab waqt hai aage badhne ka.

legend-3.title: Legend
legend-3.description: Krish, a struggling young man, is initially humiliated by his manager but gains incredible supernatural strength after a mysterious woman's pronouncement. This newfound power quickly draws the attention of his manager and later, the wealthy heiress Sneha. However, Krish's life takes a devastating turn when his girlfriend, Dhanya, betrays him for the arrogant champion Karthik, stealing his family's ancient Ayurvedic medicine. Karthik repeatedly humiliates Krish and his supervisor, escalating their rivalry as Krish embraces his strength to defend his family's honor. Sneha emerges as his protector, revealing a mysterious three-year association and knowledge of his hidden abilities, eventually recruiting him to save her company from Karthik's corporate ruin during the high-stakes "Maha Sangamam" competition. Krish's meteoric rise, fueled by the mystical "Sakthishila" medicine, intensifies Karthik's jealousy, leading to accusations of cheating and doping. As Krish becomes a champion, he faces formidable opponents and corporate intrigue, with Sneha fiercely defending him and navigating a complex, sometimes transactional, partnership that hints at romance. His personal life becomes complicated by a proposal to Mahi, manipulation by a former lover, and mysterious calls, while he must protect his vulnerable brother from various threats and blackmail for the 'Shaktishila formula' he may not possess. Krish is caught in a ruthless corporate power struggle, facing rivals like CEO Madam and Vikas, who orchestrates a hostile takeover. He forms alliances, demands guarantees for his assistance, and is offered high-level positions, all while navigating a love triangle and continuous challenges to his leadership and integrity. Throughout, Krish transforms from an underdog to a champion, fighting to protect his loved ones, his legacy, and his allies amidst a web of hidden motives, powerful adversaries, and the ongoing mystery of his own enhanced abilities and the potent medicine.

rebirth-of-the-citys-mad-doctor-1.title: Rebirth of the City's Mad Doctor
rebirth-of-the-citys-mad-doctor-1.description: When San became addicted to gambling and lost all his money, his daughter's life was at stake. His wife was not able to tolerate the situation, attempted suicide, and died. Heartbroken, San also dies, but only to find out he got another chance to change his destiny. Will his fate change?

baazaar.title: Baazaar
baazaar.description: Rizwan Ahmed, an ambitious young man, abandons his humble family and traditional values for the high-stakes world of Mumbai finance, despite a fierce generational clash with his father and a heartfelt promise to return. Concurrently, Shakun Kothari ruthlessly ascends from illicit operations to a powerful magnate, orchestrating corporate coups and challenging India's business elite, even pursuing a romantic interest in his former mentor's heiress daughter, Mandra. Rizwan, possessing valuable insider information, is drawn into Shakun's orbit, initially confronting him for opportunities and later being enlisted to spearhead a strategic acquisition in the telecom industry. Rizwan launches SkyCom, achieving unprecedented success and finding profound romantic love, seemingly on a meteoric rise. However, this success is a facade for a larger corporate and political conspiracy orchestrated by Shakun, who manipulates Rizwan as a pawn. Shakun orchestrates a sophisticated misinformation campaign and a sudden shift in license allocation, leading to SkyCom's devastating downfall, financial ruin for Rizwan's community, and his subsequent arrest for a 400-crore insider trading scandal. Facing relentless interrogation, Rizwan is accused of a massive financial scam and given a critical deadline to expose the true culprits, including Shakun, who betrayed him. Meanwhile, Shakun continues to navigate impending exposés, manipulating others like Gagan to divert regulatory attention and dismissing past tragedies. An investigator begins to unravel Shakun's untraceable bribery scandal, focusing on his anachronistic habits and a clandestine banking system, leading to a high-stakes train journey involving a political diamond bribe and an SEBI raid. Shakun's intricate plans are complicated when his pawn, Priya, develops a romantic connection with Rizwan, threatening Shakun's schemes. Ultimately, Rizwan, fueled by deep personal pain, confronts Shakun for profound betrayal and Mandara for her inaction, accusing them of sacrificing traditional values for unchecked ambition. Shakun Kothari is eventually arrested in a colossal financial scam, with reports indicating betrayal by his own "disciple," while Priya emerges as a pivotal witness, confessing her betrayal to Rizwan but asserting her deep connection to him. The narrative explores themes of moral decay, shattered trust, and the relentless quest for truth and justice in a world driven by wealth and ambition.

too-heavy-to-handle-3.title: Too Heavy To Handle
too-heavy-to-handle-3.description: ఇది ప్రియా అనే ఓ యువతీ కథ. బరువు ఎక్కువగా ఉందని పక్కన పడేశారు… చిరాకుపడ్డారు… ప్రేమించామనుకునే వారు వెనక్కి తిప్పారు… బంధువులు, సమాజం—all turned against her. కానీ… ఆ అవమానాల మధ్యనే పుట్టుకొచ్చింది అవని.

valentines-day-forced-into-marriage-by-t.title: Valentine's Day: Forced into Marriage by the CEO
valentines-day-forced-into-marriage-by-t.description: A ruthless CEO claims her as his bride on Valentine’s Day—not out of love, but for a hidden agenda. What begins as a cold contract soon sparks a dangerous game of passion, power, and revenge.

jerk-punishment-club-2.title: Jerk Punishment Club
jerk-punishment-club-2.description: The series begins with Sneha's miraculous return from presumed death, disoriented but possessing a powerful locket that grants her enhanced abilities. She quickly transforms into a vigilante, aiding Keerthi against Jeevan's financial fraud and forming a club to fight injustice. Simultaneously, a larger corporate conspiracy unfolds, with bank employee Chandrashekhar falsely accused, only for Sneha to expose the true mastermind, Chandra, and his extensive money laundering. Her quest for justice leads her to infiltrate the Shah Group, targeting the serial predator Ranga and his complicit network, including CEO Lingam Pandey and Shyam. She endures humiliation and physical threats before publicly exposing Ranga with investigator Sunny's help. Amidst these battles, Sneha uncovers a devastating personal betrayal: her husband Chandu's involvement in corporate fraud and marital deceit. This revelation, coupled with her friends Veda and Honey's struggles with abusive partners, fuels Sneha's resolve to fight for all wronged women. Her own marriage to Chandu deteriorates into verbal abuse and physical confrontation over his hidden activities, leading to false accusations of her infidelity and her contemplation of divorce, despite parental opposition. The truth emerges that Chandu is a manipulative schemer who secretly mortgaged their home, leading to Sneha's eviction and an attempted murder plot against her. Seeking refuge with her old flame Sunny, Sneha faces new challenges from his family and a jealous rival, Sony, as a long-standing misunderstanding between them is revealed to be an elaborate orchestration. The betrayals deepen when Sneha discovers her own brother orchestrated her deceitful marriage to Pranay, and her pregnant sister Neha is brutally attacked, with her grandfather prioritizing patriarchal lineage over justice. These events solidify Sneha's transformation into a formidable force, vowing vengeance against corrupt high society. Ultimately, Sneha, sometimes operating as Vedha, publicly exposes her philandering husband Chandrasekhar's plot to seize assets, revealing her identity as his missing wife on a global stage. Accused of corporate fraud herself, she uncovers profound betrayals by her rival Sunny and her 'best friend' Kanchana, who harbored unrequited love and orchestrated schemes against her. Reconciling with her estranged father, Sneha takes over the powerful 'Phantom Group' company, champions women's empowerment, and exposes a deadly plot by her former lover, Jeevan, reclaiming her power and seeking justice for all the wrongs committed against her and others.

secret-mrs-ceo-4.title: Secret Mrs CEO
secret-mrs-ceo-4.description: After a painful divorce shatters her quiet domestic life, Natasha reinvents herself as the bold and brilliant CEO of a rising startup. As she battles betrayal, fierce rivals, and her own inner doubts, Natasha’s journey from heartbreak to boardroom power becomes a stirring tale of grit, ambition, and transformation.

batwara.title: Batwara
batwara.description: The microdrama chronicles the harrowing journey of several elderly couples, including Fauji and Biji, and later Nath and Rajni, whose golden years are brutally disrupted by the relentless greed and disrespect of their biological children. Upon retirement, the patriarchs face immediate threats to their life savings and homes, exacerbated by their sons' failed ventures and the children's schemes to seize inheritance. The elderly parents are subjected to emotional abuse, financial exploitation, and even proposals of abandonment in old age homes, with their dignity constantly undermined. Forced into separation, the couples endure profound distress, neglect, and physical hardship, yearning for reunion while their health and financial stability are dismissed by their callous offspring. Amidst this turmoil, figures of loyalty emerge, such as an adopted son, Prem, and his partner, Priya, who initially offer support and seek to heal family rifts, even helping a patriarch find happiness in a new home. However, the narrative also reveals a complex past where a powerful patriarch, Amarendra, who may be connected to one of the previously exploited mothers, Rajni, once suffered familial betrayal and expulsion, only to rise as a successful hotel owner and CEO. This Amarendra, previously treated as a subservient chef, later confronts his ungrateful relatives, including Prem and Priya, who are now depicted as desperately seeking his forgiveness for their past disrespect and expulsion from his home. The show explores the profound erosion of familial values, highlighting the stark contrast between the children's materialistic ambitions and the parents' yearning for love and respect. As the elderly couples fight for their dignity and the sanctity of their bonds, one patriarch mysteriously vanishes, prompting his wife to embark on a solitary quest. Another patriarch's hidden culinary talent hints at a potential new path, while the dramatic return of an estranged father unleashes bitter accusations and physical conflict. The series culminates in a reckoning where past betrayals are exposed, and the powerful Amarendra definitively rejects his ungrateful family, leaving the future of true familial connection uncertain amidst lingering shadows of deception and the desperate pursuit of wealth.

too-heavy-to-handle-4.title: Too Heavy To Handle
too-heavy-to-handle-4.description: When Priya, once ridiculed for her weight, disappears from the world that shamed her, she returns years later as Avni—a bold, unrecognizable force of power. Fueled by heartbreak and reborn through resilience, Avni sets out to reclaim her worth and rewrite the rules. A gripping tale of transformation, revenge, and raw empowerment, Too Heavy to Handle is an emotional thrill ride where every wound becomes a weapon.

rockstar-billionaire.title: Rockstar Billionaire
rockstar-billionaire.description: Vikas, once mocked as a broke “loser boyfriend,” secretly lives a double life — as the mysterious Secret Rockstar and the viral sensation Guitar King. When his gold-digging ex Aastha teams up with a rival to publicly humiliate him, Vikas shocks everyone by revealing his true identity on a grand stage. The rags-to-riches twist turns heartbreak into triumph, winning back his true love Meenal while leaving his enemies stunned and disgraced

hero-of-construction-site.title: Hero of Construction Site
hero-of-construction-site.description: Zhong Lin, in order to recover the unpaid wages of his coworkers, agrees to Mr. Jiang's condition to take the blame for his son, Jiang Yuan, who caused an accident while drunk. Five years later, after being released from prison, Zhong Lin discovers that his family has been persecuted and gone missing. To find his wife and daughter, he arrives in Picheng and starts working as a construction worker, using every moment he has to search for them. However, he soon faces new troubles, as various crises begin to emerge one after another.

migrant-workers-love-story-3.title: Migrant Workers Love Story
migrant-workers-love-story-3.description: The microdrama begins with wealthy heiress Rosie defying her traditional grandfather's demands for an arranged marriage, leading her to coerce financially struggling construction worker Sanjay into a contract marriage. Their relationship is complex and contradictory, with Rosie sometimes hiring Sanjay as her 'husband' and at other times Sanjay, having mysteriously acquired wealth, presenting Rosie as his 'contract wife.' Rosie navigates new romantic interests, including Professor John, and a mysterious ex-military man, all against a backdrop of corporate intrigue and family secrets. As the narrative progresses, John's true identity is revealed to be tied to an artifact conspiracy involving Rosie's grandfather, and he battles unseen forces. Rosie suspects sabotage within her family empire, investigating her ex-military aide and developing a playful, then romantic, dynamic with him. An ambitious social climber, Santhosh, repeatedly attempts to falsely claim kinship and marriage to Rosie, while a cunning protagonist engages in financial deception, sometimes with Rosie's complicity. Rosie is declared the sole heir of the formidable Liu Group, becoming CEO and strategically terminating her contractual marriage with John, yet unexpected feelings develop between them. John becomes her strategic assistant, navigating internal family conflicts with Rosie's ambitious siblings and her grandfather's opposition to their romantic union. The stakes escalate dramatically when Rosie is abducted, revealing a deeper family betrayal orchestrated by her uncle and a jealous grandson/villain. John, revealed as a former special forces operative, launches a desperate rescue mission, aided by their son, confronting a sinister predator and an ambushing former friend. During the violent confrontation, John is gravely injured, and Rosie's fate becomes uncertain after multiple gunshots. The Grandson/Villain confesses to the abduction and a murder, driven by jealousy for Rosie and a desire for inheritance. Rosie ultimately chooses her critically injured love, John, over her corporate throne, leading her opportunistic brother to seize control. Years later, Rosie is summoned back by her grandfather, who, after a reconciliation, accepts John into the family. The grandfather shocks the family by appointing John as the new CEO, entrusting him with Rosie's protection and the family's legacy, despite family opposition.

right-into-your-arms.title: Right Into Your Arms
right-into-your-arms.description: The series begins with the abrupt end of a tender romance between aspiring pilot Nikhil and Tara, orchestrated by the manipulative heiress Sophia, who blackmails Tara into a selfless sacrifice to secure Nikhil's pilot dreams. Unbeknownst to Tara, Nikhil was secretly a wealthy airline owner. Years later, Tara, now a podcaster and single mother to Tani, re-enters Nikhil's life, finding him involved with Sophia. A fierce rivalry ignites between Tara and Sophia, fueled by past betrayals and Sophia's obsessive devotion to Nikhil. The drama intensifies with a shocking paternity mystery surrounding Tani, as Tara declares Nikhil is her father, a claim she later denies to protect secrets and spite Sophia. Nikhil, injured while protecting Tara, investigates her hidden life and the truth of Tani's parentage, which is complicated by conflicting paternity tests and the involvement of another wealthy man, Aryan. Sophia relentlessly pursues Nikhil, leading to violent confrontations with Tara and professional attacks on her digital empire. Nikhil, now revealed as an industrial heir, returns to Tara's life, seeking forgiveness and offering protection, confessing years of devotion. The truth eventually emerges through a medical emergency and Tara's confession: Nikhil is Tani's biological father, a secret Tara had kept for years. This revelation solidifies Nikhil's paternal bond with Tani and rekindles his deep connection with Tara. The conflict culminates as Nikhil dramatically exposes Sophia's corporate misconduct, revealing her past role in separating him and Tara and even kidnapping Tani, leading to Sophia's public disgrace and a vow for revenge. Despite Sophia's lingering threats and a perilous mission Nikhil undertakes, he and Tara overcome their past, get engaged, and Tara reveals her pregnancy. Seven years after their initial heartbreaking separation, Nikhil and Tara finally marry, embracing a second chance at love and family.

the-love-that-kills-5.title: The Love That Kills
the-love-that-kills-5.description: "The Love That Kills" is a gripping drama that follows the unraveling of Raghav's family due to the unchecked entitlement of his son Sid and father Vijay, sparked by Sid's destructive act at a luxury hotel. As tensions with Raghav's boss Srishti  escalate, the series explores accountability, family dynamics, and the devastating cost of pride.

punarjanm-ghar-ki-hukumat.title: Punarjanm - Ghar Ki Hukumat
punarjanm-ghar-ki-hukumat.description: A fearless grandmother from the past wakes up in a modern body and returns to reclaim her family, fix their flaws, and set the Oberoi empire straight. Watch her outwit scheming in-laws, tame spoiled grandsons, and bring old-school wisdom into today’s world. A rollercoaster of family drama, humor, and heart that proves age is just a number. Watch Now!

bleed-for-this-4.title: Bleed for This
bleed-for-this-4.description: রাগে অন্ধ হয়ে নিজেকে সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী ভাবলে কখনোই কাউকে অপমান করো না — কারণ তোমার চেয়েও শক্তিশালী কেউ তোমাকে শিক্ষা দিতে প্রস্তুত থাকতে পারে। প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীর বিরুদ্ধে প্রতিশোধ নেওয়া উচিত প্রতিযোগিতায়, বাস্তব জীবনে নয়।

how-i-became-the-alpha-queen-6.title: How I Became The Alpha Queen
how-i-became-the-alpha-queen-6.description: দুই নেকড়ে বোনের মধ্যে শুরু হয় এক তীব্র প্রতিযোগিতা—নিজেদের প্রজাতির মধ্যে সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী হওয়ার জন্য। উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষায় অন্ধ হয়ে, একজন তাদের বাবা-মাকে হত্যা করে এবং এক শক্তিশালী পুরুষ নেকড়েকে বিয়ে করার ষড়যন্ত্র করে। কিন্তু তার বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা ব্যুমেরাং হয়ে ফিরে আসে। নাটকীয় এক মোড়ে, যে বোনকে সে শেষ করে দিতে চেয়েছিল, সে ফিরে আসে এবং যথাযথভাবে তার প্রজাতির প্রকৃত নেত্রীর স্থান অধিকার করে।

supreme-7.title: Supreme
supreme-7.description: একজন প্রতিভাবান তরুণ নায়ক অদ্ভুত এক যাত্রায় বের হয়, যার উদ্দেশ্য হলো সেলেস্টিয়াল আর্টসের মাস্টার হওয়া। পথে সে জাদুতে পরিপূর্ণ চ্যালেঞ্জ ও ভয়ানক শত্রুর সম্মুখীন হয়, প্রাচীন গুপ্ত রহস্য আবিষ্কার করে এবং এই সবের মাঝেই একটি সুন্দর ভালোবাসা জন্ম নেয়। সেই ভালোবাসা তার ভিত্তি হয়ে ওঠে, যা তাকে পরিণত করে এক প্রকৃত সেলেস্টিয়াল মাস্টারে।

revenge-of-the-hidden-waris.title: Revenge of the Hidden Waris
revenge-of-the-hidden-waris.description: "Revenge of the Hidden Waris" is an emotional family drama that uncovers the dark secrets of the Mehra household. Wrongfully imprisoned for hurting his grandmother, Jinesh Mehra returns years later to expose shocking truths — including his brother Vikram’s deceitful plan to steal his identity and inheritance. As betrayal, revenge, and redemption collide, the show reveals how greed and lies can destroy families, but truth always prevails.

100-baggers.title: 100 Baggers

Why couldn't the Indian Cricket team touch a trophy in the last decade ? This is the most debated question of recent times. We have a social media cricket influencer and commentator Arjun giripal as a guest to discuss on what the past present and future of our team is like.
