alibaba-40-dongalu.description: ఆలీబాబాకి మాత్రమే తెలిసిన రహస్యం ఏంటి? ఆలీబాబాకు ఎంత ఖజానా దొరికింది? ఆ 40 దొంగలు ఎవరు? వినడానికి సిద్ధమవ్వండి. అలీబాబా కు స్వర్ణఖడ్గం దొరికిందా?

utthamanga-alochiddam-randi.title: Magic Of Positive Thinking
utthamanga-alochiddam-randi.description: ఎల్లప్పుడూ పాజిటివ్ గా ఆలోచించడం సాధ్యమేనా? పాజిటివ్ గా ఆలోచించడం వల్ల కలిగే లాభాలేంటి? రండి.. ఉత్తమంగా ఆలోచించడం ఎలాగో నేర్చుకుందాం.

mohabbat-maut-aur-pakistan.title: Mohabbat Maut aur Pakistan
mohabbat-maut-aur-pakistan.description: 45 saal ke mohmmad Iqbal ke Ishq aur affair ki sansanikhez  kahani.  Pehle patni ki hatya aur fir 20 saal ke premika ki mob lynching. Suniye Mohabbat,Affair aur Murder ki puri kahani sirf KUKU FM par.

dheerubai-ambani.title: ధీరూభాయ్  అంబానీ - విజయగాథ
dheerubai-ambani.description: ఒక సామాన్య వ్యక్తి ప్రపంచంలోనే అత్యంత ధనవంతుడిగా ఎలా ఎదిగాడు? ధీరూభాయ్ అంబానీ వ్యాపార జీవితం ఎలా మొదలయ్యింది? ఆటుపోట్లను ఎదుర్కొని నిలిచిన శ్రమజీవి కథ మీకోసం.

hari-singh-nalwa.title: Hari Singh Nalwa
hari-singh-nalwa.description: Maharaj Ranjit Singh ne Multan se Kashmir tak Khalsa ka jhanda buland kar diya tha. Par in ladaiyon ko jitane ka shrey ek shaks ko jata hai, Hari Singh Nalwa. Kaun the Nalwa jinhe 19th century ka sabse bada commander bhi kaha gaya hai. Janne ke liye sunein Hari Singh Nalwa…

meditations-by-marcus-aurelius-3.title: Marcus Aurelius Meditations
meditations-by-marcus-aurelius-3.description: Marcus Aurelius எழுதின இந்த Meditations உங்கள உங்களுக்குள்ள கூட்டிட்டுப் போயி உங்கள உங்களுக்குக் காட்டும்🚶‍♂️🕊️. உங்க வாழ்க்கைய புரிஞ்சுக்க உங்களுக்கு உதவும்✨.

kodiyankulam-incident-1995.title: Kodiyankulam Incident 1995
kodiyankulam-incident-1995.description: Kodiyankulam la 1995 la nadantha oru miga periya kalavarathukku pinnadi enna thaan nadanthathu ? Karanan padathula kaatuna vishayangal thaan nijamave nadanthatha? Vanga kettu therinjukalam

ustad-bismillah-khan.title: Ustad Bismillah Khan
ustad-bismillah-khan.description: Ek aam si gumnam Shehnai ko Ustad ki jaadugari ne itna lokpriya bana diya ki poora Bharat uski meethi dhun me kho gaya. Chaliye chalte hain Dharmo ki nafrat ko apni kala se mitane wale, Banaras ko aakhiri saans tak chahne wale, Bharat Ratn Ustad Bismillah Khan ke jiwan ki is surmayi yaatra par.

Vijaya-Rahasyalu-secret-of-success-విజయ-.title: విజయ రహస్యాలు
Vijaya-Rahasyalu-secret-of-success-విజయ-.description: మీరు మీ జీవితం లో విజయాన్ని అందుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? కానీ దాన్ని ఎలా చేరుకోవాలో తెలుసుకోలేకపోతున్నారా ? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.!

Antharmukham-అంతర్ముఖం.title: అంతర్ముఖం
Antharmukham-అంతర్ముఖం.description: మనిషి లోపల మనిషి గురించి ఎప్పుడైనా విన్నారా? మానవ సంబంధాల లోతులు తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

asli-khiladi.title: Asli Khiladi
asli-khiladi.description: Sajish aur dhokha, Maut ka khel, kya sach aur kya jhuth, rahsya the kayi jo the ansuljhe, jinka na suljhna kayi logon ki maut ka karan ban gaya, sune Asli Khiladi, kahani ek aise khel ki, jisme har ek tha us khel ka khiladi.

love-smuggler.title: Love smuggler
love-smuggler.description: Oru aboorva village la irukka makkal ellarum thideernu kaanama poranga! iranthu poranga! athukku pinnadi aazhamana kaadhal onnu irunthurukku! Kaadhal senja kaanama povangala? Thrillana love story ithu!

the-aryan-invasion-into-india.title: The Aryan Invasion Into India
the-aryan-invasion-into-india.description:
யார் நம் நாட்டின் உண்மையான பூர்வகுடிகள்?
திராவிடர்களா? ஆரியர்களா? 
Professor Mehta மற்றும் அவரது மாணவர் Anand, என்ன சொல்றாங்கன்னு கேட்கலாம் வாங்க!

shakuni-paason-ka-maharathi.title: Shakuni : Paason Ka Maharathi
shakuni-paason-ka-maharathi.description: Kahani us yoddha ki jiska ekmatra astra tha uska Paasa. Wo paasa jiski shahayta se usne us yuddh ki neev daali jise Panchve ved tak ki sangya de di gyi. Wo jise hmesha khalnayak ke rup me prastut kiya gya, lekin vastav me wo kaun tha, kyu usne Mahabharath yuddh ki neev rakhi, kyu usne kuru-vansh ka sarvanash karna chaha, janne ke liye sune Shakuni : Paason Ka Maharathi, written by Ashutosh Nadkar.

the-first-men-in-the-moon.title: The First Men in the Moon
the-first-men-in-the-moon.description:
Oru Businessman, Oru Scientist - Ivanga rendu perum Moon ku edhuku poranga? 
Aliens ah meet pannangala? Thirumba uyiroda earth ku return aavangala?
Fasten Your Seat Belts! You’re about to leave the Earth!

signs-of-depression.title: Signs Of Depression
signs-of-depression.description: Santhoshathinteyum sankadathinteyum koodikkalaral aanu jeevitham. Ennal Palarudeyum jeevitham kevalam sankadam ennthum kadannu vishadathil etharund. Vishadathe engane thirichariyam? Kelkkoo..

veer-satyaki.title: Veer Satyaki
veer-satyaki.description: Mahabharat yudh ke veer yodha, Veer Satyaki, jinke parakram ka koi jawab nahi. Shri Krishna ke mitra aur Yadav sena ke senapati, Satyaki ne Arjun ke samkaksh kauravon ko dhool chatai. Suniye kahani Veer Satyaki ki, jinhone veerta aur samarpan se itihas racha.

-ഈശ്വരാ--വഴക്കില്ലല്ലോ.title: ഈശ്വരാ  വഴക്കില്ലല്ലോ
-ഈശ്വരാ--വഴക്കില്ലല്ലോ.description: മലയാളികൾക്ക് പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട സലിം കുമാറിന്റെ നർമ്മത്തിൽ ചാലിച്ച ഓർമ്മക്കുറിപ്പുകൾ. അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ജീവിതത്തിലെ രസികൻ അനുഭവങ്ങളും കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളും വിവരിക്കുന്ന ഈ ഓഡിയോ ഷോയ്ക്കു മമ്മൂട്ടി എഴുതിയ ആമുഖവും കേൾക്കാം!

a-death-in-karachi-mustafa-zaidi-murder-.title: A Death in Karachi-  Mustafa Zaidi Murder Case
a-death-in-karachi-mustafa-zaidi-murder-.description: Hotel ke kamre mein mili Ek Popular writer aur CSP officer ki dead body aur uske bagal mein behosh pdi ek khubsurat ladki jiska jikr unke kavitaon mein tha. Kya hai iski puri kahani suniye sirf KUKU FM par.

mahabharatha-padangal.title: മഹാഭാരത പഠനങ്ങള്‍
mahabharatha-padangal.description: ചിന്തോദ്ധീപകങ്ങളുടെ കഥകളുടെ മഹാസാഗരമാണ് മഹാഭാരതം. ആ കടലിലേക്ക് ഒന്ന് കാലെടുത്തു വെക്കാം. മഹാഭാരതത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള സമഗ്രമായ അപഗ്രഥനമായ ഇരാവതി കാര്‍വെയുടെ ഗ്രന്ഥം പ്രിയ കവി ബാലചന്ദ്രന്‍ ചുള്ളിക്കാടിന്റെ സ്വരത്തില്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

Abhilasha-అభిలాష.title: అభిలాష
Abhilasha-అభిలాష.description: ఆ హత్య చేసింది ఎవరు? చిరంజీవికీ ఆ హత్యకీ సంబంధం ఏంటి? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

that-one-girl.title: That One Girl
that-one-girl.description: Khyaati ka Sambhav pe bachapn se crush tha lekin vo to uski best friend Ananya se pyaar karta tha. Kismat kuch yoon daanv khelti hai ki Khyaati ki shaadi Sambhav se tay ho jaati hai. Khayati ko surprise tab hota hai jab Sambhav bhi shaadi ke liye haan kar deta hai. Ab kya karegi Khyaati? Dosti ko chunegi ya fir apna crush? Kya Ananya ye sadma bardaasht kar paayegi? Jaane ke liye sunte rahiye 'That One Girl'

life-lessons-from-sundarkanda.title: Life Lessons From సుందరకాండ
life-lessons-from-sundarkanda.description: మీ జీవితంలో శాంతి లేదా? స్థిరమైన ఆలోచన శక్తి లేదా? మీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించే దివ్య ఔషధాన్ని తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా  "లైఫ్ లెసన్స్ ఫ్రం సుందరకాండ" అనే కుకు ఎఫ్ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

unwinding-anxiety-2.title: Unwinding Anxiety
unwinding-anxiety-2.description: ఆందోళన అంటే ఏమిటి ? దాని లక్షణాలు ఎలా ఉంటాయి ? అసలు ఆందోళన ఎందుకు కలుగుతుంది? దానిని పోగొట్టుకోవడానికి మనం చేయవలసిన ప్రయత్నం ఏమిటి ? ఈ ప్రశ్నలన్నిటికీ సమాధానాలు తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

an-alpha-affair.title: An Alpha Affair
an-alpha-affair.description: Vardan ke mutabik 20ve janmdin par Mohini apne jeevansathi se milne wali thi, saath hi saath ushe milti tilismi shaktiyan lekin uski saari khushiyan gham me badal gyi jab usne apne jeevansathi Abhay, ko chhoti bahin Kamini ke sath bistar mein dekha. Aakhir kismat ne kyon khela Mohini ke sath ye ganda khel ? Abhay ne uske sath aisa kyun kiya tha ? Kya mohini abhay ko maaf karegi?  Janane ke liye sunte rahiye 'An Alpha Affair'

i-will-teach-you-how-to-be-rich-1.title: I Will Teach You How To Be Rich
i-will-teach-you-how-to-be-rich-1.description: మీరు మీ డబ్బును పెంచుకోవాలనుకుంటే చాలా స్మార్ట్‌గా ఆలోచించి ఇన్వెస్ట్‌ చేయాల్సి ఉంటుంది. ఖర్చు చేసే విషయంలో కూడా స్మార్ట్‌గా ఉండాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా ఈ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

index-trading.title: Index Trading
index-trading.description: Ohari vipaniyil vijayikkan aagrahikunnavark oru aakashakamaya optionanu Iindex trading. Ee audiobook index tradinginteyum nikshepathinteyum adisthana karyangal muthal vipulamaya thanthrangal vare vishatheekarikunnu.

the-secret-door-to-success-1.title: The Secret Door To Success
the-secret-door-to-success-1.description: Har kisi ke paas hota hai ek guardian angel, aapka kahan hai? Janiye kaise payein unka saath humare iss show mein!

jail-diary-of-bhagat-singh-1.title: Jail Diary Of Bhagat Singh
jail-diary-of-bhagat-singh-1.description: ബ്രിട്ടീഷ് സാമ്രാജ്യത്വത്തിനെതിരെ പൊരുതി തൂക്കിലേറിയ ഭഗത് സിംഗ് കൊളുത്തിയ തീ ഇന്നും ഹൃദയങ്ങളില്‍ ജ്വലിക്കുന്നുണ്ട്. തൂക്കിലേറ്റപ്പെടുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ്, 1929 സെപ്റ്റംബറിനും 1931 മാര്‍ച്ചിനും ഇടയില്‍ ഭഗത് സിംഗ് എഴുതിയ ഡയറിക്കുറിപ്പുകള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

amir-khusrau.title: Amir Khusrau: The Poet of Hindustan
amir-khusrau.description: ‘Chhaap tilak sab chheeni tose naina milaai ke’ - aisi timeless poetry likhne wale Khusrau ko kyon poet of Hindustan kaha jata hai? Kya ristha tha Nizamuddin Auliya aur Khusrau ke beech? Khusrau kaise bane ‘Amir Khusrau’? In sawalon ke jawab ke saath hi suniye Khusrau ki bemisal shayari, dohe aur paheliyan, is khas peshkash mein.

my-life-apj-abdul-kalam.title: My Life
my-life-apj-abdul-kalam.description: ഇന്ത്യയുടെ തെക്കേയറ്റത്തുള്ള ഒരു കടലോര ഗ്രാമത്തില്‍ ജനിച്ച് വളര്‍ന്ന് നക്ഷത്രങ്ങളെ സ്വപ്‌നം കാണുകയും അത് സാധിച്ചെടുക്കുകയും ചെയ്ത കുട്ടിയുടെ കഥ. മുന്‍ രാഷ്ട്രപതി എപിജെ അബ്ദുള്‍കലാമിന്റെ ജീവിതം കേള്‍ക്കാം.

light-house-1.title: లైట్ హౌస్
light-house-1.description: సుమేర్ ఒక లైట్ హౌస్ గార్డియన్. ఓ రాత్రి ఆకాశం నుండి రాలుతున్న తోక చుక్క అందమైన అమ్మాయిగా మారడం చూస్తాడు సుమేర్. ఆమె, సుమేర్ దగ్గరకు ఎందుకు వచ్చింది?  వీళ్ళ ప్రేమ, భూమిని ఎలాంటి ప్రమాదంలో పడేస్తుంది? వినండి “లైట్ హౌస్” ...

tinder-murder-a-modern-age-true-crime.title: Tinder Murder- A Modern Age True Crime
tinder-murder-a-modern-age-true-crime.description: Jhooth se shuru hui hai ek Tinder Date jo bani Dushyant ke liye maut ka paigam. Kya hai is KHOONI DATE ki puri kahani suniye sirf KUKU FM par.

MInd-Power-No-1-Avatam-Ela-మైండ్-పవర్-నె.title: మైండ్ పవర్ - నెంబర్ వన్ అవడం ఎలా?

the-science-thats-behind-tamil-culture-a.description:
தமிழ் மட்டும் இல்ல நம்ம தமிழ் கலாச்சாரம் ரொம்பவே தொன்மை வாய்ந்தது. ஒவ்வொரு தமிழ் கூற்றுக்கு பின்னாடியும் ஒரு அறிவியல் இருக்குனு பெரியவங்க சொல்லுவாங்க அத பத்தியும், பல்லாயிரம் வருஷம் பழமைவாய்ந்த நம்ம கலாச்சாரத்தின் சில சொல்லப்படாத கருத்துக்கள் மற்றும் தகவல்களை நம்மகூட பகிர்ந்துக்க சிறப்பு விருந்தினரா "பருதி' இணைஞ்சு இருக்காரு. வாங்க கேப்போம்.  

Every year the archeologists prove with an example that our tamil culture is ancient and rich by its means. Our special guest MR.Parithi who is a Tamil enthusiast and a social media influencer, has researched over his interests on knowing our roots. Lets listen to a lot more that we may not know of our tamil culture , life and its science behind that existed.

why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry-1.title: Why Must the Boss Contractually Marry
why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry-1.description: The microdrama series unfolds a complex narrative centered on powerful families, corporate intrigue, and the intricate web of forced and contract marriages. Numerous protagonists, often young women like Nivetha, Radha, Kavya, Geetha/Yichen, and Jia, find themselves ensnared in these unions, driven by debt, protection of loved ones, or strategic maneuvering. These marriages frequently serve as pawns in larger power struggles, with figures like Master Hu, Master Fu, Mr. Fu, and Fu Yichen orchestrating events to reclaim corporate empires, seek vindication, or uncover hidden truths. A recurring and pivotal element is a mysterious heirloom bracelet, which consistently links characters, reveals long-buried family secrets, and often dictates destinies. The series explores themes of hidden identities, with characters like Radha and Jia embarking on quests to understand their true origins, sometimes complicated by the shocking possibility of familial ties within their forced relationships. Corporate battles are fierce, involving blackmail, strategic alliances, and accusations of embezzlement, as various factions vie for control of powerful organizations. Characters like Fu Yichen meticulously plan their returns to power, exposing corruption and betrayal within their own families. Amidst the deceit and manipulation, personal relationships are tested, with some evolving into genuine affection despite their unconventional beginnings, while others are fraught with resentment and revenge plots. The stakes are high, encompassing not only corporate dominance and financial security but also personal freedom, the unraveling of intergenerational secrets, and the pursuit of justice against tyrannical patriarchs and manipulative rivals. Ultimately, the narrative weaves together forbidden love, corporate warfare, and the relentless quest for truth and identity, all propelled by the enigmatic power of the heirloom bracelet.

pyaar-dhokha-aur-badla-2.description: এক বড়লোক পরিবারের মেয়ে প্রিয়া। তবে তার আসল পরিচয় কেউ না জানায় তাকে অপমান করে চলে কলেজের সকলে। তার প্রেমিকও মিথ্যে ভালোবাসার জালে ফাঁসিয়ে ব্যবহার করতে থাকে প্রিয়াকে ক্রমাগত। তবে এমন ভুলে একটি জন্ম চলে গেলে, জীবন যদি দ্বিতীয় জন্ম হিসেবে সুযোগ ফিরিয়ে দেয় সব প্রতিশোধ নেওয়ার! তাহলে কি সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারবে প্রিয়া? সেকি খুঁজে পাবে তার সত্যি ভালোবাসাকে?

travel-back-in-time-1991-3.title: Travel Back in Time: 1991
travel-back-in-time-1991-3.description: భూమి మీద ఉన్న మనం కాలచక్రంలో ముందుకు వెళ్ళలేం, అలాగే వెనక్కి కూడా వెళ్ళలేం.. కానీ అనుకోని సంఘటనల కారణంగా వెనక్కి వెళ్తే ఎలా ఉంటుంది? అది తెలియాలంటే Travel back in Time:1991 సిరీస్ చూడాల్సిందే.

the-despots-awakening.title: The despot's awakening
the-despots-awakening.description: The Despot’s Awakening is a story of a boy who begins to question his own tyranny after an unexpected event shakes his certainty, setting him on a path toward self-reflection and change.

royal-betrayal-1.title: Royal Betrayal
royal-betrayal-1.description: মরণঘাতী যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রের হাহাকারে, এক নারী মুখোমুখি হয় সেই রাজকীয় উত্তরাধিকারীর, যে একসময় তার হৃদয় ভেঙে ছিল। এখন বাঁচার তাগিদে তাকেই বিশ্বাস করতে বাধ্য হয় সে। চারদিক থেকে যখন মৃত্যু ধেয়ে আসে, ভালোবাসা আর প্রতিশোধের দ্বন্দ্বে শুরু হয় এক অনিবার্য ছুটে চলা।

my-wife-is-a-drama-queen.title: My Wife Is A Drama Queen
my-wife-is-a-drama-queen.description: Alina, an estranged heiress, is drugged by her sister Kelly, framed for her grandmother's murder by her fiancé Boris, and becomes a pregnant fugitive. After a near-fatal incident, she loses her memory and is presumed dead. Six years later, she resurfaces as Angel, a celebrated actress known by various aliases, including Lexi, Isha, Isla, Jia, and Anju. Her hidden identity is threatened when she encounters Daniel, a wealthy CEO, whose son, Jerick, repeatedly recognizes her as his "Mommy." Alina grapples with her amnesia and the shocking possibility of being Jerick's mother, pursuing DNA tests to uncover her true identity and connection to a deceased heiress, Original Alina. She faces relentless opposition from Daniel's powerful grandmother, Dadi, his arrogant fiancée, and corporate rivals like Lexi Grey and Ms. Linux, who sabotage her career and attempt to harm her. Concurrently, Daniel, who has been searching for Jerick's mother, becomes entangled with Alina, their complicated past and romantic tension reigniting despite his initial pursuit of contract marriages for corporate revenge against the Lennox family, who were complicit in Alina's framing. As Angel's memory slowly returns, she confirms her identity as Jerick's biological mother and the "girl" a powerful man sought, shattering the long-held belief that she was dead. She fights to reclaim her son and expose a six-year-old conspiracy involving her framing for murder and the theft of her inheritance. The truth unravels amidst family feuds, corporate takeovers, and public betrayals. Ultimately, after her father's death and the arrest of Mrs. Lennox for past crimes, Alina discovers through a DNA test that she is indeed a biological mother. Daniel, feeling deceived by her past amnesia, proposes marriage to her as a "punishment," which she accepts, setting the stage for a complex and strategic union to navigate their intertwined destinies and secure justice.

secret-billionaire-villager.title: Secret Billionaire Villager
secret-billionaire-villager.description: একজন সহজ-সরল ও সৎস্বভাবের গরিব গ্রামের যুবককে তার দীর্ঘদিনের প্রেমিকা ঠকিয়ে চলে যায় এক ধনী পুরুষের সঙ্গে। এক দিব্য শক্তির আশীর্বাদে সেই যুবক রূপান্তরিত হয় এক সম্পন্ন ও রূপবান পুরুষে। অতঃপর সে ফিরে আসে—প্রতারণার প্রতিশোধ নিতে তার সেই বিশ্বাসঘাতক প্রেমিকার কাছে।

royal-affair-1.title: Royal Affair
royal-affair-1.description: বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা যখন ডিজাইনার লেহেঙ্গা আর রাজকীয় হাসির আড়ালেই লুকিয়ে থাকে, একজন নারী সাহস করে সে সত্য ফাঁস করে দেন। 'দ্য রয়্যাল অ্যাফেয়ার' —এটি প্রতিশোধ, গোপন তথ্য, এবং ক্ষমতার লড়াইয়ের এক রোমাঞ্চকর গল্প, যা একটি ‘পারফেক্ট’ বিয়ের পটভূমিতে আবর্তিত। দেখুন কিভাবে বিশ্বাস ভেঙে পড়ে এবং মুখোশগুলো একে একে খুলে যায়।

the-spoiled-billionaire.title: The Spoiled Billionaire
the-spoiled-billionaire.description: The world sees her as a pampered heiress, but one viral leak shatters the illusion revealing a secret life that could ruin her family. Now, she must fight to reclaim her name before the truth destroys everything she loves.

a-beam-of-light-in-the-darkness-mothers-.title: A Beam of Light in the Darkness: Mother's Love
a-beam-of-light-in-the-darkness-mothers-.description: A Beam of Light in the Darkness

pyaar-paisa-parivaar.title: The Billionaire Intern
pyaar-paisa-parivaar.description: After 8 years in a coma, a hidden billionaire returns to win back his love and take revenge on those who thought he was just an intern. He came to live among the common man to find true love… but before he could tell Suhana the truth, a freak accident left him unconscious.

love-lies-and-revenge.title: Love Lies and Revenge
love-lies-and-revenge.description: After being betrayed and left to die by the man she loved, Priya is mysteriously sent back eight years in time. Now, with knowledge of the future, she plots revenge against those who destroyed her—starting with her ex-fiancé Arjun.

the-hand-behind-the-scenes-1.title: The Hand Behind the Scenes
the-hand-behind-the-scenes-1.description: When Enchansang's grandpa died mysteriously, his whole reality collapsed. he doubts that there is a secret behind his grandpa's life, now it starts to interfere in his life.

the-layoff-that-shook-the-company.title: The Layoff That Shook the Company
the-layoff-that-shook-the-company.description: In a high-stakes world of corporate power and betrayal, former tech prodigy Ethan finds himself caught between loyalty and revenge. As the mighty Blackwell Group crumbles due to internal politics and personal vendettas, Ethan must decide whether to save the empire that wronged him—or let it burn. A gripping tale of ambition, heartbreak, and redemption in the ruthless tech industry.

cute-baby-assists-i-help-my-mom-marry-th.title: Baby Assists: I Help Mom Marry President Tycoon
cute-baby-assists-i-help-my-mom-marry-th.description: A cute baby becomes Cupid and helps his mom get married to a billionaire daddy. will the cutie succeed?

bicky-ban-gaya-gentleman.title: Bicky Ban Gaya Gentleman
bicky-ban-gaya-gentleman.description: Poor Bihar student Vikram "Bicky" Jha enters elite college on sports scholarship. He falls for wealthy Kishika Ambani, who uses him then marries another for business. Heartbroken, Bicky quits sports and focuses on education. Years later, English teacher Preeti helps him secure educational grants. Kishika returns dying, reveals their son Arav. Bicky becomes Sports Minister, marries Preeti, and raises Arav.

love-tease-1.title: LOVE TEASE
love-tease-1.description: রোহন এবং অনন্যার প্রেমের গল্পের উপর ভিত্তি করে একটি আবেগঘন রোম্যান্টিক গল্প। প্রেমের শুরু কলেজ থেকে, সেখান থেকে ব্রেক-আপ। তাদের একটি গোপন সন্তানও থাকে। কিন্তু তা সত্ত্বেও বিচ্ছেদ। গল্পটি প্রেম, প্রতিশোধ, অপরাধবোধ এবং দ্বিতীয় সুযোগের বিষয়বস্তু অন্বেষণ করে যেখানে রোহন, এখন একজন সুপারস্টার ক্রিকেটার, ফিরে আসে এবং তার ছেলের সম্পর্কে একটি লুকানো সত্যের মুখোমুখি হয়। গল্পটি প্রেম এবং দ্বন্দ্বের সাথে জড়িত তীব্র আবেগে পরিপূর্ণ। অনন্যা আর রোহনের সম্পর্ক কি আবার জোড় লাগবে?

damn-youre-hot-professor-1.title: Damn You're Hot, Professor
damn-youre-hot-professor-1.description: সুদর্শন এক বদমেজাজী প্রফেসরের প্রেমে পড়ে যায় তাঁরই কলেজের এক ছাত্রী। একদিকে তার ভালোবাসা, আর একদিকে পড়াশোনা, সেই সঙ্গে পারিবারিক টানাপোড়েন। ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ এই প্রেম নিয়ে চলতে থাকে নানান অনিশ্চয়তা। দুজনের অসমবয়সী প্রেমের বন্ধন দুজনেরই ভবিষ্যতকে রিস্কের মধ্যে ফেলে দেয়। তারপর?

begging-for-my-return.title: THE LOVE AFFAIR
begging-for-my-return.description: Love Affair is a story about two lovebirds who fight the world in the name of love.

royal-gaonwali-1.title: ROYAL GAONWALI
royal-gaonwali-1.description: The microdrama centers on Isha, a young woman who cruelly dismisses her rural family to impress her wealthy boyfriend, Amol, only for her deceit to be exposed, ending their relationship. Her family's unexpected arrival and mounting debt lead her father to sacrifice an heirloom, while CEO Vishal Obroy searches for his long-lost fiancée, Sana. Diligent waitress Aksha unknowingly impresses Vishal, setting the stage for their intertwined paths, as she is revealed to be the true Sana, an affluent heir adopted by Isha's mother. Isha cunningly impersonates Sana, deceiving Vishal and plotting to exploit Aksha for financial gain, causing deep family conflict. Aksha's budding romance with Vishal is complicated by her discovery of his pendant, identical to her family heirloom, sparking an investigation into his past. Meanwhile, the imposter Sana (Isha) discovers Vishal's growing infatuation with Aksha, fueling her jealousy and prompting sabotage. Aksha navigates professional challenges, including a catastrophic event and public humiliation, but is championed by Vishal, leading to a promotion that ignites Mrs. Oberoi's fury. Aksha's romantic world is shattered when Vishal confesses love for another, and she is brutally abducted by Isha, then manipulated by her boss, Eishaan, after being drugged. Aksha, suffering from amnesia, navigates forbidden romances and family secrets, with her true identity as Mrs. Patel's adopted daughter threatened. Vishal ends his engagement, realizing it was based on a mistaken identity, while Mrs. Patel's biological daughter attempts to kill her mother after revelations about Aksha's adoption. Mrs. Patel is critically injured, and a silent message implicates her adopted daughter, Isha (Aksha), as the assailant. A shocking DNA test reveals Sara is not Mrs. Patel's daughter, exposing Isha as a manipulative imposter who tormented Sara and usurped her place. Mrs. Patel orchestrates retribution, publicly revealing Aksha as the true Patel heir and exposing Isha's elaborate deception. Isha's past betrayals against her brother Vishal and their mother come to light, leading to Vishal proposing to Miss Shana Patel. Isha vows fierce revenge, threatening Vishal and Miss Shana Patel's newfound happiness.

clouds-by-the-sea-1.title: Clouds by the Sea
clouds-by-the-sea-1.description: The story follows Sophia, James, Samson, and Emily through a long spiral of marriage conflict, family pressure, and shifting loyalties. It begins with a cold marriage that James says was entered out of duty, and his wish for divorce collides with Sophia’s refusal to quietly disappear. Emily’s arrival as a new director deepens the tension, because rumors link her to James and turn the household and workplace into one shared battlefield. Sophia pushes back against being replaced, while James repeatedly sides with Emily or uses his authority to force apologies and punish resistance. As the conflict grows, family elders and company power are used to control the women’s choices, and public humiliation becomes part of the struggle. Samson reenters Sophia’s life through an orphanage-linked past, and his confession of love creates another painful triangle, even as Sophia insists she sees him only as a brother. The marriage crisis is complicated by memory loss, hidden identity, and unanswered questions about Sunny, Peter, and the forgotten past. Sophia’s position becomes even more fragile when inheritance and family honor are dragged into the dispute, but she also gains leverage when half of the family estate is revealed to belong to her. The story then turns sharply toward medical danger, with doctors warning that Sophia’s pregnancy may not survive and that treatment decisions could cost her life or her baby. Sophia refuses to surrender control of her body, while James is accused of using the pregnancy to pressure her and his family. The unborn child becomes the center of a paternity fight, with Samson suddenly claiming the baby as his and James reacting with anger and suspicion. Hidden pregnancy, secret documents, and family coordination around the truth make trust collapse inside the house. Later, the conflict widens into divorce threats, protection bargains, and violent confrontations over who has the right to decide Sophia’s future. A fatal heart diagnosis raises the stakes further, making love and reconciliation feel like a race against time. Revenge enters the story when Emily admits poisoning James’s drink, and Sanjay’s attacks push the family into open crisis and grief. By the end, the truth about Sophia’s condition, the child, and the betrayals around them leaves James shattered and the family fractured. In the final turn, Samson’s farewell becomes a sacrifice, and Sophia steps forward publicly to claim herself as his widow and demand recognition.

the-rebith-let-my-wife-love-me-again.title: The Rebith: Let My Wife Love Me Again
the-rebith-let-my-wife-love-me-again.description: After a tragic end, a man is reborn with a second chance to win back the wife who once loved him. In this emotional story, fate hands him time, but not without new trials of the heart.

ratchasi.title: Ratchasi
ratchasi.description: Too Heavy to Handle is a dramatic revenge saga that follows Priya, a woman mocked and betrayed for her weight, who transforms into the fierce and confident Avni to reclaim her dignity and bring down those who wronged her. Blending emotion, transformation, and empowerment, the show is a rollercoaster of heartbreak, healing, and high-stakes drama.

cute-baby-assists-i-help-my-mom-marry-th.title: Cute Baby Assists : I Help my Mom Marry the President Tycoon
cute-baby-assists-i-help-my-mom-marry-th.description: When a charming and clever baby takes matters into his tiny hands, he becomes the ultimate cupid, orchestrating his single mom’s romance with a powerful billionaire president tycoon. With heartwarming antics and witty schemes, this adorable little matchmaker brings love, laughter, and unexpected twists to the world of high society. Will his master plan succeed in uniting two worlds—and two hearts—against all odds?

overcoming-obstacles-the-counter-attack-.title: Overcoming obstacles - The counter attack of twin babies
overcoming-obstacles-the-counter-attack-.description: Born into hardship, a pair of twin babies grow up plotting to reclaim the life stolen from them. In this twist-filled story, innocence becomes the sharpest weapon for revenge.

triumphant-returns.title: Triumphant Returns
triumphant-returns.description: The story revolves around a wealthy younger brother who discovers his sister-in-law’s secret affair. In retaliation, the sister-in-law uses her lover to take revenge on him.

rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-2.title: Rebirth: My Cheat Code Life
rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-2.description: After a bitter divorce, a once-submissive wife rises from the ashes—crushing enemies and shocking the elite world with her fearless power. But her ex-husband soon realizes… letting her go was the biggest mistake of his life.

bepanah-ishq-4.title: Bepanah Ishq
bepanah-ishq-4.description: When love turns into an unbreakable obsession, every choice becomes a matter of life and death. This is a thrilling tale of passion, betrayal, and the dangerous lengths one will go to for the one they can’t let go. A heart-pounding journey where romance and revenge walk hand in hand. Watch Now !

time-traveling-cute-baby-3.title: Time-Traveling Cute Baby
time-traveling-cute-baby-3.description: Time-Travelling Cute Baby is a fantasy show where a mysterious baby from the future appears in the heroine’s life, claiming to be her child. As she unravels the truth, secrets of love, destiny, and a powerful father's identity are revealed.

the-blind-date-destiny.title: The Blind Date Destiny
the-blind-date-destiny.description: The microdrama centers on Richa, a resilient woman haunted by the loss of her daughter, Chiku, taken by child protective services eight years prior. Abandoned by her brother, Richa finds an unexpected connection with young Tanisha and her father, Aditya Mittal, a wealthy CEO who initially conceals his true identity as a humble driver. Their marriage, born from Tanisha's desire for a mother, is immediately fraught with classist judgment and public humiliation from Aditya's relatives, particularly Kajol. Amidst these struggles, Richa encounters Akash, who hints at a shared past and a fated quest for their lost daughter. Richa's world further unravels as she faces harassment, blackmail from her past, and the shocking revelation that her husband, Aditya, is a powerful CEO living a double life. Akash Sharma, seeking revenge against the Mittal family, retaliates by severing business ties and evicting them, adding to Richa's mounting challenges. The stakes escalate when Richa and Raghu are kidnapped for ransom, with her daughter's photo used as cruel leverage, and Radha is abducted for debt. In a dramatic turn, Aditya is forced to reveal his true identity as the formidable Aditya Mittal, using his immense power to protect Richa and resolve the crises. Richa grapples with her husband's hidden life and the disappearance of Tanisha, while also confronting her manipulative uncle. The narrative culminates in a series of confrontations where Aditya, also known as Rahul, divorces Kajal due to her betrayal and classist insults, leading to his public firing, which he then dramatically overturns by fully revealing his CEO identity. Finally, Aditya proposes to Richa, and in a miraculous twist, a DNA test confirms that Tanisha, Aditya's adopted sister, is Richa's long-lost daughter, Cheekoo, transforming their impending marriage into a joyous family reunion.

the-last-recipe-4.title: The last recipe
the-last-recipe-4.description: The last recipe - Aryan, a talented yet underestimated cook, as he battles personal struggles and a fierce culinary competition to save Zaika, a restaurant tied to his past. Amidst sabotage, betrayal, and a rekindled romance with Naina, Aryan’s journey culminates in a dramatic showdown proving his mastery and integrity.

my-doctor-boyfriend.title: My Doctor Boyfriend
my-doctor-boyfriend.description: বাবার প্রাণ বাঁচাতে নিজের ওভাম পর্যন্ত বিক্রি করতে উদ্যত হয় মেয়ে। সেই মেয়ের জীবনে দেবদূত রূপে হাজির হন এক ডাক্তার। তিনি বিবাহিত, তা সত্ত্বেও এই মেয়েটির প্রেমে পড়ে যান বেমালুম। পারিবারিক কর্তব্য আর অন্তরের আকর্ষণের দ্বন্দ্বে মেয়েটিকে এক অসম্ভব পরিস্থিতির মুখোমুখি হতে হয়। আত্মত্যাগ, ভালোবাসা ও নৈতিক দ্বন্দ্বের টানাপোড়েন গল্পের মোড় ঘুরিয়ে দেয়।

doorstep-billionaire-delivered.title: Doorstep Billionaire Delivered
doorstep-billionaire-delivered.description: When struggling baker Ananya Sharma finds mysterious billionaire Kabir Raichand at her doorstep, an unexpected arrangement sparks a whirlwind of romance, secrets, and life-changing choices. Watch Now!

power-punch-2.title: Power Punch
power-punch-2.description: Ordinary laborer Yash is suddenly gifted with extraordinary strength, turning him into a local legend. But admiration turns to betrayal when his girlfriend Tanya schemes to steal his family’s secret formula. With his mentor in danger, Yash must rise — not just with power, but with purpose — to reclaim his honor.

the-chosen-one.title: The Chosen One
the-chosen-one.description: When carefree Aarav Malhotra’s impulsive marriage to the strong-willed Anaya spirals into a battle of love, pride, and destiny, he must rise from an unlikely husband to the man fate has chosen him to be. Watch now!

losing-my-virginity-4.title: Losing My Virginity
losing-my-virginity-4.description: A complex saga begins with Alisha, pregnant and deceitful, blackmailing Rohi, also pregnant by Alisha's husband, into impersonating her to ensnare the wealthy Aadithya. Rohi, desperate to save her ailing mother, is trapped in this high-stakes deception, navigating a dual life while a forbidden romance blossoms between her and Aadithya, challenging his strategic marriage. As Aadithya becomes increasingly drawn to Rohini, he proposes, further entangling them in lies. Ruhi is then brutally coerced into a temporary marriage with Aditya to secure a business merger and save her mother, only to discover she is a dupe for Alisha. Despite the deceptive origins, a genuine love develops between Ruhi and Aditya, complicated by Alisha's sudden reappearance, claiming to be Aditya's wife and pregnant. Aditya fiercely protects pregnant Ruhi from his family's demands for an abortion, leading to a corporate power struggle. Shocking revelations unfold as Ruhi discovers Alisha is her twin sister, given away at birth, and uncovers a dark family secret involving their mother's past and a manipulative Employer's Widow who coerced Alisha's adoption. The conflict escalates with Alisha's manipulative schemes, including kidnapping Ruhi's mother and demanding Aditya as payment for a life-saving kidney. Aditya secretly sacrifices his entire company to Alisha's mother, Mrs. Chawla, to save Ruhi's mother, who ultimately passes away. Ruhi and Aditya then ally to orchestrate Mrs. Chawla's downfall through corporate maneuvering and a paternity scandal, publicly exposing Alisha's faked pregnancy and paternity claims. The series culminates in Ruhi confronting her mother and Alisha, revealing a profound conspiracy involving an abortion and manipulation, leading Ruhi to deliver a harsh judgment. Ultimately, Ruhi and Aditya decide to adopt Alisha's abandoned newborn, envisioning a loving family for both children and hinting at a past event that shaped their bond.

the-matrimonial-trap.title: The Matrimonial Trap
the-matrimonial-trap.description: Vikram married Ananya for her wealth, not love. With his lover Rhea, he plotted a perfect crime — a fake marriage that ended in cold-blooded murder. But when Ananya’s twin sister Avni steps in to claim the inheritance and uncover the truth, the hunter becomes the hunted. As secrets unravel and vengeance burns, only one will emerge victorious — the deceiver or the avenger.

pregnant-with-billionaires-child.title: Pregnant With Billionaire’s Child
pregnant-with-billionaires-child.description: She disappeared after that night, carrying a secret that could shatter his empire. Now, the billionaire wants answers and maybe her heart. Pregnant With Billionaire’s Child is a fiery tale of love, betrayal, and a baby that changes everything. Watch Now!

arabian-husband.title: Arabian Husband
arabian-husband.description: దివ్య తన జ్ఞాపకాలు కోల్పోయిన బాగ్దత్త మిహిరను రక్షించేందుకు అన్ని త్యాగాలు చేస్తుంది. కానీ రానా అనే ప్రతిష్టాత్మక అండర్వర్ల్డ్ డాన్ వారిద్దరినీ చీకటి కుట్రలతో బెదిరిస్తాడు. ఒకవైపు ప్రేమ, మరోవైపు కుటుంబ గోప్యాలు, ప్రతీకారం, మిస్టరీల మధ్య ఈ కథ తిరుగుతుంది.

if-i-could-see-you-again.title: If I Could See You Again
if-i-could-see-you-again.description: If I Could See You Again is story of a grieving soul gets a miraculous chance to meet a lost loved one once more. But the reunion forces them to choose between holding on to the past or letting go for the future.

power-punch-1.title: Power Punch
power-punch-1.description: యష్ ఒక సామాన్యుడు. తినడానికి డబ్బులు లేక వడపావ్ తిని బతికేస్తుంటాడు. ఫుడ్ సరిగ్గా తినకపోవడం వల్ల బలహీనంగా అవుతాడు. అలాంటి యష్ జీవితంలో ఒక అద్భుతం జరిగింది. అది జరిగిన తర్వాత అతన్ని ప్రేమించిన తన్య ఏం చేసింది? ప్రపంచం ఎలా ఆశ్చర్యపోయింది..? తెలియాలంటే చూడడండి పవర్ పంచ్.. మీ కుకు టీవీలో.

the-disappeared-her-the-millionaire-daug.title: The Disappeared Her: The Millionaire Daughter's Return
the-disappeared-her-the-millionaire-daug.description: The Disappeared Her: The Millionaire Daughter's Return is the story of years after vanishing without a trace, the only daughter of a wealthy family suddenly reappears—changed, determined, and holding secrets that could shatter the empire built in her absence. But is she here to reclaim her rightful place… or to destroy those who once betrayed her?

my-secret-billionaire-boyfriend-3.title: My secret Billionaire Boyfriend
my-secret-billionaire-boyfriend-3.description: నిజమైన ప్రేమను కనుగొనాలని కోరుకున్న ఒక కోటీశ్వరుడు, తన అసలైన గుర్తింపును దాచేసి ఒక బిచ్చగాడిలా జీవించటం ప్రారంభిస్తాడు. ఇంతలో, కుటుంబ ఒత్తిడితో ఓ అహంకారపూరిత కోటీశ్వరుడిని పెళ్లి చేసుకోవాల్సిన పరిస్థితిలో ఉన్న ఓ ధనవంతురాలితో నకిలీ సంబంధంలోకి చేరతాడు. కానీ ఈ నటన ప్రేమగా మారుతుందా? లేక నిజాలు బయటపడతాయా?

too-heavy-to-handle-2.title: Too Heavy to Handle
too-heavy-to-handle-2.description: "Too Heavy to Handle" is a dramatic revenge saga that follows Priya, a woman mocked and betrayed for her weight, who transforms into the fierce and confident Avni to reclaim her dignity and bring down those who wronged her. Blending emotion, transformation, and empowerment, the show is a rollercoaster of heartbreak, healing, and high-stakes drama.

off-limits.title: Off Limits
off-limits.description: When disciplined army officer Kabir Rathore falls for his best friend’s spirited sister, Aisha Mehra, duty and desire clash in a forbidden romance neither of them can walk away from. Watch Now!

bleed-for-this-1.title: Bleed for this
bleed-for-this-1.description: When you're blind with rage and think you're the strongest, never insult anyone — because someone even stronger than you might be ready to teach you a lesson. You should take revenge against a rival in competition, not in real life..

murder-at-the-in-laws.title: Murder at the In-Laws
murder-at-the-in-laws.description: The microdrama begins with prominent businesswoman Ananya marrying Vikram, unaware that he and his accomplice, Riya, have orchestrated a "contract marriage" to seize her vast inheritance and harm her father. Ananya, swayed by Vikram's assurances, transfers control of her assets to him, unknowingly walking into his meticulously planned trap. Vikram then stages a deadly "accident" during a storm, leading to Ananya's apparent death and her father's attack. However, Ananya's will reveals a previously unknown twin sister, Avani, as the sole heir, bypassing Vikram entirely. Avani arrives, grief-stricken and determined to find her sister's killer, but her uncanny resemblance to Ananya immediately draws Vikram's intense suspicion, leading him to relentlessly test her, convinced she is Ananya in disguise. As Avani systematically exposes Vikram's dark secrets and orchestrates his downfall, Vikram, aided by Riya, becomes increasingly paranoid and desperate, even plotting Avani's murder while being tormented by the spectral presence of Ananya. It is later revealed that Avani is, in fact, Ananya, who faked her death to seek revenge against Vikram and Riya for their betrayal and attempted murder. Ananya, under the alias Avani, meticulously orchestrates Vikram's downfall, exposing his manipulative nature and his elaborate plot with Riya, leading to his arrest and the seizure of his corporate empire. Despite Vikram's desperate pleas, Ananya remains resolute in her pursuit of justice, though she grapples with the lingering pain of Riya's betrayal. Vikram eventually escapes jail, consumed by vengeance, and confronts Riya, whom he believes abandoned him. His escape escalates into a deadly confrontation with Ananya and her protector, Sameer, who is gravely injured. Ultimately, a transformed and defiant Ananya faces Vikram alone, defeating him and reclaiming her destiny, having found inner strength through her journey of self-discovery.

after-becoming-a-queen-i-beheaded-the-sc.title: After becoming a queen, I beheaded the scumbag
after-becoming-a-queen-i-beheaded-the-sc.description:
ఒక యువతి తన ప్రియుడి ప్రేమను నమ్మి జీవితం మొత్తం అతనికి అంకితం చేస్తుంది. కానీ అతను ద్రోహం చేస్తాడు. ఆమె గుండెపోటుతో రోడ్డుపై పరుగెత్తుతూ ఒక రోడ్డు ప్రమాదానికి గురవుతుంది. తలకి గాయమై అవచేతన స్థితిలోకి వెళుతుంది. కొంతకాలానికి ఆమెకి జ్ఞానం వస్తుంది... కాని చుట్టూ ఉన్నదంతా భిన్నంగా కనిపిస్తుంది.

ఆమె పక్కన సేవకులు, తలపై శిరోభూషణాలు, రాజభవనం చుట్టూ వందలాది సైనికులు. అప్పుడు ఆమెకు అర్థమవుతుంది – ఇది ఇప్పటి కాలం కాదు. ఆమె ఒక రాజ్యంలో ఉంది. మరియు ఆమె రాణి!

dil-dhokha-aur-dna.title: Dil, Dhokha Aur DNA
dil-dhokha-aur-dna.description: She loved him, married him, and woke up to find him gone. Now, after eight long years, Meher Chaudhary returns fearless, fierce, and ready to confront Arjun Singh Rathore. But in this high-stakes game of lies and loyalty, nothing is as it seems. Watch Now!

ancient-appetites.title: Ancient Appetites
ancient-appetites.description:
What if your dusty shop became the last hope of a war-torn dynasty? A mysterious back door, ancient gold, and a soldier desperate to save his people—this is no ordinary retail drama.
Get ready for a gripping ride through time, trust, and tactical biscuits. Watch Now !

the-westward-anime-season-2.title: The Westward Anime Season 2
the-westward-anime-season-2.description: The journey to the West was a conspiracy of heaven. After Sutra went missing for more than a decade, Heaven sent its army to search, in order not to let the Sutra once again fall into the hands of heaven, the journey to West begin again.

emperor-yan.title: Emperor Yan
emperor-yan.description: Lingesh, a hidden business prodigy and secret king, endures constant humiliation as a humble mechanic and disdained son-in-law to the powerful Chen family. Despite public scorn and accusations of worthlessness from his wife, Lingshan, and her relatives, Lingesh gradually reveals glimpses of his immense power, first by defying arrogant VIPs and ruthless crime bosses, then by demonstrating mastery of a royal martial art. His three-year "trial" in the mortal world culminates in his return to reclaim his throne and purge corruption. As a powerful Madam investigates his true identity and a manipulative Master Zhu plots against the Chen family, Lingesh asserts his true role as the architect of their success, setting the stage for dramatic confrontations and demands for divorce. Publicly humiliated and divorced by his powerful heiress wife, Ling San, Lingesh is dramatically claimed by a formidable woman from the Chen family and swiftly elevated to CEO. He reveals himself as a hidden powerhouse, forcing his former family into public reparation and exposing their false claims of supporting him. Now a powerful figure, Lingesh launches a corporate war against influential families, including his ex-wife's, and plots revenge against those who wronged him, aiming to secure monumental deals. He navigates complex situations, including a woman claiming to be his fiancée, Chin-Chee-Han, who later forms a strategic alliance and contract marriage with him to save her empire from a sinister conspiracy. Lingesh's deception as a mechanic is exposed by a heartbroken partner, escalating into a power struggle where his true, powerful identity is dramatically revealed. He asserts absolute corporate authority, receiving a "Cloud Pattern Gold Card" and systematically orchestrating the financial ruin of powerful, generational families who opposed him. He declares himself "King Yan" and later "Raja" at exclusive corporate gatherings, challenging established authority. His fiancé fiercely defends him, revealing his corporate and potentially royal connections. The enigmatic Raja orchestrates a massive corporate coup, dismantling major business empires overnight. The narrative culminates in Lingesh's formal reinstatement and coronation as King Yan/Raja, the visionary founder of the formidable Vanxen Group. Despite facing scorn and accusations of massive financial losses, he defiantly moves to consolidate his power. As King Yan, ruler of Hoo Desam, he unmasks treacherous plots against his reign, asserting immense power and influence. He fiercely vows to protect his fiancée, Miss Qin, from any harm, and their unwavering love blossoms, culminating in a heartfelt proposal and acceptance, promising a future of justice and enduring romance as he declares an end to misrule.

rebirth-of-the-citys-mad-doctor.title: Rebirth of the City's Mad Doctor
rebirth-of-the-citys-mad-doctor.description: When San became addicted to gambling and lost all his money, his daughter's life was at stake. His wife was not able to tolerate the situation, attempted suicide, and died. Heartbroken, San also dies, but only to find out he got another chance to change his destiny. Will his fate change?

contract-pregnant-wife-4.title: Contract Pregnant Wife
contract-pregnant-wife-4.description: After a one-night stand with a billionaire who insists he’s infertile, a young woman finds herself pregnant with twins. As hidden truths surface and powerful enemies emerge, love and betrayal ignite a battle of destiny and desire.

defying-destiny-4.title: Defying Destiny
defying-destiny-4.description: এক সংকল্পবদ্ধ তরুণ শিষ্য অথর্ব, যে ৪০০ বছরের ব্যর্থতার পরেও তার গুরুর চেয়ে আগে পৌরাণিক সঞ্জীবনী প্রস্তুত করতে সফল হয়। তবুও, তাকে গুরুকুল থেকে বহিষ্কার করা হয় এবং সে এক রূপান্তরমূলক যাত্রায় বের হয়, যেখানে সে ধীরে ধীরে তার নিজের পরিচয় এবং মহাবিশ্বের গোপন সত্য উদঘাটন করে। পথ চলতে চলতে সে একজন প্রভাবশালী ব্যক্তিকে জীবনদান করে, একজন প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী পাত্রের সঙ্গে দ্বন্দ্বে জড়িয়ে পড়ে এবং অলৌকিক পরীক্ষার মাধ্যমে সামাজিক শ্রেণী-ব্যবস্থাকে চ্যালেঞ্জ জানায়। অবশেষে, চক্র-উৎকর্ষতার শীর্ষে পৌঁছে, অথর্ব ভাগ্যের বিরুদ্ধে লড়ে ঈশ্বরসম মর্যাদা অর্জন করে।

divorced-dangerous.title: Divorced & Dangerous
divorced-dangerous.description: After a bitter split from her manipulative ex-husband Karan, fiercely independent Rhea Kapoor is drawn into a high-stakes web of secrets, revenge, and passion where trusting the wrong man could be deadly. Watch Now!

shelter-in-the-mafia-5.title: Shelter In The Mafia
shelter-in-the-mafia-5.description: একজন ভয়ংকর মাফিয়া আবারও প্রেমে পড়ে তার শৈশবের ভালোবাসার প্রতি—এমন একজন নারী, যাকে তার স্বামী প্রতারণা করেছে, বিবাহবিচ্ছেদ হয়ে গেছে। সেই মাফিয়া নীরবে সেই নারীর শিল্পের স্বপ্নকে সমর্থন করে এবং তাকে এক নিরাপদ আশ্রয় দেয়। অবশেষে নিজের পরিচয় প্রকাশ করে এবং অপরাধের জগৎ ছেড়ে ভালোবাসাকে বেছে নেয়। আন্ডারওয়ার্ল্ডের জীবন ত্যাগ করে, সে তার এবং তার মেয়ের সঙ্গে এক শান্তিপূর্ণ নতুন জীবন শুরু করে।

the-ceos-favorite.title: The CEO’s Favorite
the-ceos-favorite.description: Raj Bansal, ek ameer aur powerful businessman, aur Simran Rai, ek simple waitress jinki zindagi mushkilein aur beizzatiyon se bhari hai. Ek anjaani mulaqat, ek raat ka faisla, aur ek sach jise duniya chhupana chahti hai—lekin taqdeer likh chuki hoti hai ek naya rishta. Jab class, past aur badla ek hi kahani ka hissa ban jaate hain, tab shuru hoti hai ek emotional safar… jahan izzat, pyaar aur sach ke liye ladna padta hai sabse.

got-you-mr-always-right-6.title: Got You Mr Always Right
got-you-mr-always-right-6.description: এক গরীব মেয়ে এক ধনী পুরুষের সঙ্গে ভুয়ো সম্পর্কে জড়িয়ে পড়ে। যখন তার নিষ্ঠুর বাগদত্ত এবং তার প্রেমিকা, সেই গরীব মেয়েটির বিরুদ্ধে ষড়যন্ত্র শুরু করে, তখন নায়ক এগিয়ে আসে, তাদের মিথ্যে ফাঁস করে দেয় এবং পুরো পরিস্থিতি উল্টে দেয়। চূড়ান্ত মোড়ে, সে তাদের অপরাধ ফাঁস করে দেয়, যার ফলে বাগদত্ত ও তার বাবাকে জেলে পাঠানো হয় এবং সেই গরীব মেয়েটি বেঁচে যায় ।

braced-up-girl.title: Ugly Bani Paramsundari
braced-up-girl.description: When your first day at college turns into a battlefield of bullies, betrayal, and blurred lines, how do you fight back? Braced-Up Girl is a fierce ride through the chaos of campus life, self-respect, and the search for identity. This isn’t just a teen drama—it’s Kanika’s war for dignity. Watch Now!

mr-santa-i-want-you-1.title: Mr Santa, I Want You
mr-santa-i-want-you-1.description: ব্রিজেট নামের এক তরুণীর সাথে দেখা হয় এক রহস্যময় পুরুষের যে নিজেকে সান্তা ক্লজ বলে দাবি করে। ব্রিজেট তার আর্থিক অবস্থা এবং তার পরিবারের প্রত্যাশা নিয়ে লড়াই করছে, অন্যদিকে "মিস্টার সান্তা" চরিত্রটি তাকে এক ভিন্ন, আরও জাদুকরী বাস্তবতার এক ঝলক দেখায়। চলচ্চিত্রটি জীবনের চ্যালেঞ্জের মধ্যেও প্রেম, ভাগ্য এবং সুখ খুঁজে পাওয়ার বিষয়বস্তু অন্বেষণ করে।

double-life-ceo-chasing-love-4.title: Double Life CEO: Chasing Love
double-life-ceo-chasing-love-4.description: "ডাবল লাইফ সিইও: চেজিং লাভ" এমন এক মহিলার গল্প, যিনি তার পরিবারের পছন্দের একজন পুরুষকে বিয়ে করতে প্রস্তুত। তবে, শপথের ঠিক আগে, একজন অপরিচিত ব্যক্তি বরের স্থলাভিষিক্ত হন এবং তাকে বিয়ে করেন। এই অপ্রত্যাশিত মোড়টি গোপনীয়তা, ভাগ্য এবং নিষিদ্ধ প্রেমের একটি গল্পকে গতিশীল করে তোলে যখন সে এবং রহস্যময় অপরিচিত ব্যক্তি একসাথে তাদের জীবন শুরু করে। অপরিচিত ব্যক্তিকে একজন শান্ত এবং গভীর ভাবে বর্ণনা করা হয়েছে যা সম্পর্কে কেউ জিজ্ঞাসা করার সাহস করে না। সে গোপনীয়তা রাখে এবং তার কাজগুলি একটি রহস্যময় অতীত দ্বারা চালিত হয়।

hooked-on-you.title: Hooked On You
hooked-on-you.description: Aaryan, a mysterious stranger, saves Mehar from a brutal attack, drawing her into a dangerous web of secrets, betrayal, and buried truths. my-mommy-the-millionaire.title: My Mommy, the Millionaire
my-mommy-the-millionaire.description: Gayatri, a fiercely independent cafe owner, is dramatically revealed as the long-lost heiress to the powerful Goenka empire, forcing her to confront her estranged father, Gopal Goenka. Initially, she refuses reconciliation to protect her daughter, Roshni, from their complicated past. However, a manipulative scheme involving Roshni's abusive husband, Rahul, draws the family into the corporate world. Rahul exploits Roshni for his career, leading to a brutal divorce and public humiliation orchestrated by his new lover, Sana. Gayatri, initially dismissed, dramatically reclaims her identity as Gayatri Goenka, turning the tables on Rahul and asserting her family's legacy. The ailing patriarch, Gopal Goenka, then publicly declares Gayatri and her granddaughter Piya as the rightful heirs, igniting a fierce inheritance battle complicated by Rahul's vengeful machinations and a bitter custody dispute for Roshni's children. Roshni relentlessly fights for her children and dignity against Rahul's domineering mother, Apeksha, and the cunning Sana. A mysterious protector, Sanjay, later revealed as Vikram, intervenes to shield Roshni from Rahul's attacks and eventually becomes her husband and ally. Roshni uncovers Sana's manipulative history of fake pregnancies, though Sana's dramatic announcement of a male heir temporarily sways the family against Roshni. Roshni's hidden identity as Mr. Goenka's granddaughter is revealed, transforming the personal dispute into a high-stakes clash of family legacies. Undercover, Roshni infiltrates her powerful grandfather's company, facing immediate sabotage attempts from Rahul and Sana, who frame her for corporate errors. Vikram, secretly the CEO of Singhania Industries, acts as her bodyguard and primary protector, developing a burgeoning romantic connection with her. As Rahul and Sana intensify their plot, Vikram prepares a strategic counter-move to reveal Roshni's true identity and power, promising to shatter their schemes. Roshni is appointed CFO, sparking fury, and later forms a dark alliance with Rahul, leveraging her pregnancy for mutual financial gain and seeking retribution against those who wronged her. The narrative takes a tragic turn with the violent abduction of Roshni's young daughter, Piya, by Rahul, who demands humiliation and claims paternity. Piya tragically dies, fueling Roshni's brutal quest for vengeance against Rahul, whom she blames for her child's death and a past betrayal. Amidst this chaos, Roshni saves an injured Vikram, who confesses his profound, long-held love, revealing she saved his life years ago and has been his sole purpose since. Their mutual devotion is declared, setting their powerful bond against a backdrop of tragic loss and escalating danger.

i-will-find-you.title: I Will Find You
i-will-find-you.description: The microdrama centers on Bella, a doctor with a mysterious past, and her tumultuous relationship with powerful CEO Bruce William, amidst a web of family secrets, corporate intrigue, and a desperate fight for her children. The story begins with Maya's life-threatening childbirth and Elisa's manipulative plot to replace her and awaken Bruce, who later becomes a grieving CEO. Six years later, Bella, searching for Bruce, becomes the anonymous specialist for his critically ill son, Jeffrey, leading to a tense confrontation that hints at their shared history. A secret switch occurs when Jeffrey's identical twin, Travis, discovers his wealthy "Papa's" mansion and takes his brother's place for medical care. As Jeffrey's health deteriorates, Bella, now revealed as a mysterious healer, becomes his only hope, forging a complex connection with Bruce. Bella's life takes a dramatic turn after a life-saving but protocol-breaking surgery leads to her professional downfall and severe injury, making her a target of multiple antagonists. Despite initial hostility, Bruce develops undeniable feelings for Bella, whose resemblance to his deceased wife and ex-fiancée suggests a fated connection. The narrative deepens with the revelation that Bella (also known as Erica) is searching for her children, abducted by Aunt Mary, while Bruce orchestrates a contract engagement with Bella to defy his mother and uncover secrets. The children, Jeffrey and Travis, discover they are biological siblings, believing Bruce and Bella are their parents, which triggers a sinister plot by Aunt Mary, who suspects a presumed-dead twin. Mr. William (Bruce) kidnaps the boys, forcing Bella into a sadistic "game." Bella then discovers Bruce is her brother's powerful rescuer, shattering their marriage, as Madam William and Mary (presumed dead) resurface, both claiming children with Bruce and asserting control. Bella faces a bitter paternity dispute over the twins and plans a desperate escape from the matriarchs' mistreatment. Her life is further complicated by a forbidden romance with Bruce, his engagement to Becky, and her subsequent adoption by magnate Richard Roy, making her an heiress and igniting a corporate war. Bella faces public humiliation but retaliates fiercely, with Bruce unexpectedly becoming her protector. The climax involves Bella and her daughter Elena's abduction, forcing William (Bruce) to choose, leading to Bella's presumed death and Elena's revelation as William's daughter. Injured and betrayed, Bella endures a tragic miscarriage due to Bruce's malicious act. Grief-stricken and targeted, Bella transforms, vowing fierce revenge against those who ruined her life, while Bruce faces a critical medical emergency, hinting at a fated recovery.

When a fearless small-time YouTuber, known only as Common Man, exposes the Chief Minister’s right-hand goon in a viral sting, he ends up face-to-face with the state’s most powerful politician. What starts as a publicity stunt quickly turns into a gripping, high-stakes battle against corruption, red tape, and the very system he set out to question. From confronting shady contractors to exposing deadly negligence, Common Man’s single day in power forces him to choose between playing politics and saving lives — while the real CM, his cunning aides, and political enemies watch closely, waiting for him to fail.

why-i-killed-the-mahatma-2.description: గాడ్సే గాంధీని హత్య చేయాలనే అంత ద్వేషం ఎందుకు కలిగింది ? మహాత్మా గాంధీ హత్య గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా ఈ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి

rbi.title: RBI
rbi.description: RBI Bharat ke banks ko regulate karta hai. Banking regulations ke alawa, RBI currency issue karna, payment systems ko manage karna aur economic development ko bhi support karne jaise kaam bhi karta hai. Par RBI ki shuruat hui kaise? Kab aur kisne ise shuru karne ke baare mein socha? Janne ke liye sunien, RBI...

the-procrastination-cure-3.title: The Procrastination Cure
the-procrastination-cure-3.description: మీరు మీ పనిని సమయానికి పూర్తి చేయలేకపోతున్నారా? ఈ రోజు చేయాలనుకున్న పనిని రేపటికి వాయిదా వేసే అలవాటును మానేయాలని ఉందా ? అయితే "ది ప్రోక్రాస్టినేషన్ క్యూర్" అనే కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

how-to-sell-your-way-through-life-5.title: How To Sell Your Way Through Life
how-to-sell-your-way-through-life-5.description: వివిధ సేల్స్ టెక్నిక్స్ గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? సేల్స్ పర్సన్ యొక్క మానసిక స్థితి మరియు శ్రద్ధ వహించాల్సిన  అంశాలు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా ఈ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

safalta-aapki-mutthi-mein.title: Safalta Aapki Mutthi Mein
safalta-aapki-mutthi-mein.description: Kya aap bhi apne lifestyle decisions aur buri aadaton se pareshaan hain? Ye show humein batata hai ki kuch easy steps mein aap khud par poori tarah se control kaise paa sakte hain. Aur ye control hi aapki success journey mein poori tarah contribute karega. Suniye aur jaaniye ki Success ko aakhir aap kaise apna bana sakte hain.

only-justice-1.title: ഒൺലി ജസ്റ്റിസ്
only-justice-1.description: ലോകത്തെ അനീതികൾക്കെതിരെ  പോരാടുന്ന ഒരു രഹസ്യ സംഘടന.  മിഷൻ  ഇമ്പോസ്സിബിൾ സിനിമകളെ വെല്ലുന്ന ഒരു ക്രൈം ആക്ഷൻ എന്റർറ്റൈനെർ - അജിത്  ഗംഗാധരന്റെ  ഒൺലി  ജസ്റ്റിസ്!

thiruda-thiruda.title: തിരുടാ തിരുടാ
thiruda-thiruda.description: ഒരു മോഷ്ടാവ് ആത്മകഥയെഴുതിയാല്‍ എങ്ങനെയുണ്ടാവും എന്ന് ചിന്തിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടോ. എന്നാല്‍ അങ്ങനൊന്നുണ്ട്. കുപ്രസിദ്ധ മോഷ്ടാവ് ആട് ആന്റണിയുടെ ഉദ്ദ്വേഗവും കൗതുകവും നീറഞ്ഞ ജീവിതം കേള്‍ക്കാം.

aapka-waqeel-kya-kehta-hai.title: Aapka Waqeel Kya Kehta Hai?
aapka-waqeel-kya-kehta-hai.description:
|Calling number: 011-411-98004 / Email: waqeel@kukufm.com|
Life mein kayi situations aisi aati hain, Jab humein legal action lene chahiye. Lekin jaankari na hone ki wajah se ya toh hum aisa nahi kar paate ya phir galat actions lekar problems khadi kar lete hain. Toh ab aisa nahi hoga, Kyunki is show mein aapko waqeel ke zariye saari jankariyan bhi milengi aur aap khud apne sawal bhi unse puchh payenge.

keralathinte-kuttatanweshana-charithram.title: കേരളത്തിന്റെ കുറ്റാന്വേഷണ ചരിത്രം
keralathinte-kuttatanweshana-charithram.description: ഡോ. ബി. ഉമാദത്തൻ രചിച്ച "കേരളത്തിന്റെ കുറ്റാന്വേഷണ ചരിത്രം" എന്ന പുസ്തകം, കേരളത്തിലെ കുറ്റാന്വേഷണ സംവിധാനത്തിന്റെ വളർച്ചയുടെയും പരിണാമത്തിന്റെയും ഒരു വിശദമായ വിവരണം നൽകുന്നു.

up-ka-chunavi-rath.title: UP ka Chunavi Rath
up-ka-chunavi-rath.description: Center mein government form karne ke liye UP jeetna jaruri ho jata hai. Par yahan ki rajneeti kayi factors par nirbhar karti hai. Baat chahe political equations ki ho ya bahubali dumkham ki, UP hamesha se ek X factor raha hai. Kya hoga is baar ka result? Kya ek baar phir UP bhagwa rang se rang jayega? Janne ke liye sunein, UP ka chunavi rath...

newsroom.title: ന്യൂസ് റൂം: ഒരു മാധ്യമപ്രവര്‍ത്തകന്റെ അനുഭവക്കുറിപ്പുകള്‍
newsroom.description: മാധ്യമ പ്രവര്‍ത്തന രംഗത്ത് നീണ്ട ഏഴ് പതിറ്റാണ്ടുകളുടെ അനുഭവം സ്വന്തമായുളള ബി ആര്‍ പി ഭാസ്‌ക്കർ തൻ്റെ വ്യക്തിയനുഭവങ്ങൾ തുറന്നെഴുതുകയാണു ഇവിടെ. ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ചരിത്രത്തിലെ അതിനിർണ്ണായകങ്ങളായ അനവധി ഏടുകൾ അവയിൽ വസ്തുനിഷ്ഠ്മായി പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്നു.

padinjarekollam-chorakkalam.title: പടിഞ്ഞാറെക്കൊല്ലം ചോരക്കാലം
padinjarekollam-chorakkalam.description: ഒരു സിനിമ പോലെ ദൃശ്യപരവും ആകർഷണീയവുമാണു ഇന്ദുഗോപൻ്റെ രചനകൾ. വായനക്കാരുടെ പ്രശംസ നേടിയ പടിഞ്ഞാറെക്കൊല്ലം ചോരക്കാലം എന്ന കൃതി കേള്‍ക്കാം.

election-after-370.title: Election after 370
election-after-370.description: Article 370 Kashmir ka abhinn ang tha. Isko lekar dashakon se vivaad chala aa raha tha. Par 5 August 2019 ko, Bharat sarkar ne ise raddh kar diya. Kya Article 370 ko hatana jaruri tha? Iske hatne ke baad, hone wale is pehle aam chunav par kya asar padega? Janne ke liye sunein, Election after 370...

గజేంద్ర-మోక్షం-.description: త్రికూట పర్వత విశేషాలు ఏంటి?  శ్రీమహావిష్ణువు గజేంద్రుడిని రక్షించడానికి వచ్చాడా ?  పరీక్షిత్తు మహారాజుకు గజేంద్ర మోక్షం కథను ఎవరు చెప్పారు? వినండి గజేంద్ర మోక్షం గాథ.

జార్జ్-రెడ్డి-.description: జార్జి రెడ్డి ఉద్యమనాయకుడు ఎలా అయ్యాడు? ఉస్మానియా యూనివర్సిటీలో ఆయన చేసిన ఉద్యమాలు ఏంటి? యూనివర్సిటీలో జార్జి రెడ్డిని హత్య చేసింది ఎవరు? వినండి ఉద్యమనాయకుడి వీరగాథ.

7-habits-to-be-more-effective.title: 7 Habits To Be More Effective
7-habits-to-be-more-effective.description:
|Key Points- Habit Building, Lifestyle Transformation & Increased Efficiency|
Jaanein kaise choti choti aadatein aapki life ko aur behtar bana sakti hain. Apni daily activities mein laya gaya ek chota sa badlav aapki life badal sakta hai. To phir intezar kyun karna? Abhi suniye humara ye show aur jaaniye wo 7 simple habits jo banaengi aapko aur bhi jyada effective. 

Link- https://kukufm.com/show/believe-in-yourself-9?utm_source=upsell

secret-billionaire-6.title: Secret Billionaire
secret-billionaire-6.description: College student Damon Hemsworth has been brought up by his poor mother. Mocked by his peers and dumped by his girlfriend because of his poverty, Damon doesn't have much to look forward to. Until, one day, a phone call changes his life. Damon finds out that his father runs the Serafino family business which is by far the richest in the world.  Damon receives ten million dollars from his father and the trajectory of his life changes. Join us on an exhilarating audio journey as we unravel Damon's extraordinary tale. Embark on a rollercoaster ride of intrigue, power games, self-discovery as Damon navigates the complexities of his newfound wealth, family dynamics, and the expectations that come with his prestigious lineage. From humble beginnings to the lap of luxury, Damon's story is a gripping narrative of self-discovery and adaptation. As he grapples with his dual identity and adjusts to the opulent lifestyle of his birthright, Damon must confront the challenges of his newfound fortune. Will being a secret billionaire be a boon or a curse? To find out, listen to 'Secret Billionaire', exclusively on KUKU FM.

aarachar.title: ആരാച്ചാർ
aarachar.description: ചേതന എന്ന യുവതി തന്റെ പിതാവിനെ പിന്തുടർന്ന് ഒരു ആരാച്ചാർ (executioner) ആകാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു. പുരുഷന്മാർക്ക് മാത്രം അനുവദനീയമായ ഒരു തൊഴിൽ ആയതിനാൽ അവൾക്ക് നിരവധി വെല്ലുവിളികൾ നേരിടേണ്ടി വരുന്നു. സമൂഹത്തിന്റെ എതിർപ്പും കുടുംബത്തിലെ സംഘർഷങ്ങളും അവൾക്ക് അതിജീവിക്കണം.

kahaniyan-jo-genius-banaye.title: Kahaniyan Jo Genius Banayein
kahaniyan-jo-genius-banaye.description: Soch rahe hain ki zindagi mein kaise aage badha jaye? Abhi suniye is Audiobook ko, Jismein batayi har ek kahaani aapko ek nayi soch, ek naya nazariya aur zindagi ko behtar banane ka ek naya tareeka sikhaayegi. Is safar me shamil ho, aur khud ko taiyaar karein zindagi ke har mod par vijayi hone ke liye.

pithamahan.description: വി. കെ. എൻ എന്ന മാസ്റ്ററിന്റെ തൂലികയിൽ വിരിഞ്ഞ, ആക്ഷേപഹാസ്യവും  ചരിത്രവും ഇടകലരുന്ന ഒരു ക്ലാസിക് നോവൽ!

stephen-hawking-sampoorna-jeevacharithra.title: സ്റ്റീഫൻ ഹോക്കിങ്: സമ്പൂർണ്ണ ജീവചരിത്രം
stephen-hawking-sampoorna-jeevacharithra.description: ഇരുപത്തിയൊന്നാം വയസ്സിൽ എമിയോട്രോഫിക് ലാറ്ററൽ സ്ക്ലീറോസിസ് (ALS) എന്ന അസുഖം ബാധിച്ചപ്പോൾ സ്റ്റീഫൻ ഹോക്കിങ്ങിന് മുന്നിൽ രണ്ട് വഴികളേ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നുള്ളൂ -  മരണത്തിന് കീഴടങ്ങുകയോ അസുഖത്തെ വെല്ലുവിളിച്ച് ജീവിതം നേടിയെടുക്കുകയോ. ഹോക്കിങ് തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തത് രണ്ടാമത്തെ വഴി. സമാനതകൾ ഇല്ലാത്ത ആ അതിജീവനകഥ കേൾക്കൂ..

shakuntala-1.title: Shakuntala
shakuntala-1.description: Uski aankho me prem ko paane aur duniya ko dekhne ki iksha thi, par jindagi ne uske liye kuch aur soch rakha tha, sune Shakuntala, kahani ek nishpaap Stri ki.

pandavapuram.title: പാണ്ഡവപുരം
pandavapuram.description: പാണ്ഡവപുരത്തു നിന്നുമുള്ള തന്റെ ജാരനായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്ന ദേവിയുടെ കഥ.  സ്ത്രീലൈംഗികതയെ മനോഹരമായി ആവിഷ്കരിച്ച സേതുവിൻറെ ക്ലാസിക് നോവലായ 'പാണ്ഡവപുരം' ആസ്വദിക്കൂ, Kuku FMൽ!

bjp-vs-india.title: BJP VS INDIA : Kaun Kis Par Bhari
bjp-vs-india.description: 2024 mein Modi banayenge sarkar ya Rahul karenge palatwar? Kaun jeetega 2024 ka election? Janiye "BJP VS INDIA : Kaun Kis Par Bhari" show mein.

karnanin-kadhai.title: கர்ணனின் கதை
karnanin-kadhai.description: கர்ணனின் பிறப்பு ரகசியம், தேரோட்டியின் மகனாக வளர்வது, வில்வித்தையை அர்ஜுன்னுக்கு நிகராக கற்றுத் தேர்வது, துரியோதனனின் நட்பு கிடைத்து அரசனாவது, மகாபாரதப் போர் நடக்கும் பொழுது தன் பிறப்பின் ரகசியம் தெரிகிறது. ஆனாலும் துரியோதனன் பக்கம் நின்று தன் சகோதர்ர்களான பாண்டவருக்கு எதிராக போர் புரிகிறான். கிருஷ்ணரின் சூழ்ச்சியால் போரில் இறக்கிறான். ஆனால் கர்ணனின் கதை என்ன?

killing-of-lacey-fletcher.title: Sabse Bhayanak maut
killing-of-lacey-fletcher.description: Ek ladki jo mari aisi maut jise sunane tak se bhi linsaan ki rooh kaanp jaaye aur uske maut ka kaaran bane uske hi mata pita. Kyun khud  mata pita ne di apni beti ko itni bhayanak maut? Kya hai is rooh kanpa dene wali maut ke peeche ki poori kahani suniye sirf KUKU FM par.
