paisaasam.title: பைசாசம்
paisaasam.description: பன்னிரண்டாம் நூற்றாண்டு. பாண்டி நாட்டுக் கிராமமான கோளக்குடியில் அமானுஷ்யமான சில சம்பவங்கள் அடுத்தடுத்து அரங்கேறுகின்றன. அவற்றை எதிர்கொள்ள விழையும் ஊர்க் காவலன் திருவரங்கனைத் தடுமாறச் செய்வது ஒரு முக்கியமான கேள்வி. இது மனிதர்களின் வேலையா? அல்லது ஏதேனும் பிசாசுகளின் லீலையா?

toxic-positivity.title: Toxic Positivity
toxic-positivity.description:
|Key Insights - Balanced Living,  Better Self-Awareness, Assured Contentment|
Positive rehna acchi baat hai lekin agar aap apne positivity ke chalte  sacchai ko andekha karna shuru kar dete hain toh aap ek beemari ke shikaar ho jaate hain, jise toxic positivity kaha jaata hai. Issey na sirf aapka balki aapke chaaron oar sabhi ka nuksaan hota. Iss show ke madad se jaaniye kab aapki positivity toxic ban jaati hai aur kaise aap khud ko balanced rakh kar life ko puri tarah se jee sakte hain.

udhayabanu-panithirai.title: உதயபானு - பனித்திரை
udhayabanu-panithirai.description: காலம் 11ம் நூற்றாண்டு. பலமான யோசனைகளுக்குப் பிறகு திருவிடைமருதூரில் ஆடல் கற்பிக்கும் தலைக்கோலி நக்கன் மதுரவாசகி, தஞ்சையில் மாமன்னர் இராஜராஜர் கட்டிக் கொண்டிருக்கும் பெரிய திருக்கற்றளியில் சென்று பணியில் அமர முடிவு செய்கிறாள். அவளது எண்ணம் நிறைவேறியதா?

payanigal-gavanikkavum.title: பயணிகள் கவனிக்கவும்
payanigal-gavanikkavum.description: ஏர்போர்ட் வெடி விபத்தில் கணவன் இறந்தால் ஜார்ஜினாவுக்கு வேலை கிடைக்கிறது. கணவனின் நண்பன் சத்யநாராயணாவுக்கும் ஜார்ஜினாவுக்கும் காதல் ஆரம்பமாகி திருமணம் செய்ய முடிவு செய்யும் போது ஏற்படும் பிரச்சினைகளும் , அதை எப்படி தீர்த்து கல்யாணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள் என்பதும் தான் கதை.

arranged-marriage-ka-khooni-ant.title: Arranged Marriage Ka Khooni Ant
arranged-marriage-ka-khooni-ant.description: 15 saal baad, ek phone call ne kaise khola murder mystery ka raaz? Suniye kaise ek arranged marriage ka khooni ant hua!

sales-success-tamil-virpanayil-vetri.title: விற்பனையில் வெற்றி
sales-success-tamil-virpanayil-vetri.description: ஏன் ஒருசில விற்பனையாளர்கள் மட்டும் பிறரைவிட அதிக வேகமாகவும் எளிதாகவும் அதிகப் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கின்றனர், அதிக எண்ணிக்கையில் விற்பனை செய்கின்றனர்? பெரும்பாலான விற்பனையாளர்கள் தங்கள் சக்திக்குக் குறைவான சாதனைகளை நிகழ்த்திக் கொண்டிருக்கும்போது, அந்த ஒரு சிலர் மட்டும் ஏன் அதிக அளவில் வெற்றி பெறுகின்றனர்? கேளுங்கள் விற்பனையில் வெற்றி. நீங்களும் விற்பனையில் வெற்றி பெறலாம்!

abki-baar-kiski-sarkar-north-edition.title: Abki Baar, Kiski Sarkar? North Edition
abki-baar-kiski-sarkar-north-edition.description: Election 2024 mein BJP ko sabse jyada ummid north se hai. Par sabse jyada Political hulchal bhi north mein hi hai. Phir chahe Farmer's protest ho, Haryana aur Punjab ki rajneeti ho ya AAP ke netaon ke ghar ED ka chapa aur CM Kejriwal ki giraftaari ho. Kya north BJP ko 400 paar karayega ya phir koi surprise BJP ka wait kar raha hai? Janne ke liye sunein, Abki Baar, Kiski Sarkar ka North Edition...

5-laws-to-master-life-1.title: 5 Laws To Master Life
5-laws-to-master-life-1.description: നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതം തന്നെ മാറ്റിമറിച്ചേക്കാവുന്ന അഞ്ച് നിയമങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചാണ് ഈ ബൈറ്റ്‌സ്. ജീവിതത്തില്‍ കൃത്യമായ റോഡ്മാപ്പ് സൃഷ്ടിക്കാനും കൂടുതല്‍ മുന്നേറാനും ഇത് മനസിലാക്കുന്നതിലൂടെ നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് കഴിയും.

the-daily-laws-1.title: The Daily Laws
the-daily-laws-1.description: 🌞📘This Kuku Byte is your daily companion for achieving greatness, navigating the complexities of power, love, and the quest for a meaningful life ⚡❤️🧭.

abki-baar-kiski-sarkar-central-and-west-.title: Abki Baar, Kiski Sarkar? Central and West Edition
abki-baar-kiski-sarkar-central-and-west-.description: Maharashtra aur Gujrat agar Bharat ke corporate hubs hain to Madhya Pradesh aur Rajasthan Hindi belt hain. In charon states mein clean sweap kiye bina BJP ka 400 paar ka sapna adhura hi reh jayega. Par kya yahan clean sweap karna itna asan hoga? Kya hoga Central aur West India ka haal, janein Abki Baar, Kiski Sarkar mein...

who-killed-jessica-jessica-lal-murder-ca.title: Who Killed Jessica ? Jessica Lal Murder Case
who-killed-jessica-jessica-lal-murder-ca.description:
Amongst many nerve wracking murder cases that we have read in news, Jessica lal murder case is one of the most popular trials in indian crime history. This audio documentary share the insights about this case. 
இந்திய வரலாறுல நம்மள புரட்டி போட்ட பல படுகொலைகள்ல மிக முக்கியமான சம்பவம் ஜெசிகா லால் படுகொலை வழக்கு. உண்மையில என்ன நடந்ததுன்னு இந்த ஆடியோ தொகுப்புல கேளுங்க.

the-obstacle-is-the-way-7.title: The Obstacle is the Way
the-obstacle-is-the-way-7.description: தடைகளை உடைத்து சாதனை படையுங்கள்💪. Master the art of turning roadblocks into opportunities with timeless Stoic wisdom.🎨🚀📚

management-1.title: Management
management-1.description: Kya aap banna chahte hain apni company ka sabse kimti asset? Agar haan, Toh iske liye apni manager wali skill ko boost karna hoga. Jo ki aasani se kiya ja sakta hai, Bas uske liye is show mein batayi gayi managerial skills" ki insights ko samajh kar, Apni life mein apply karna hoga.

dark-fantasy.title: ഡാർക്ക് ഫാന്റസി
dark-fantasy.description: ഒരു കൂട്ടക്കൊലപാതകത്തിന്റെ ദുരൂഹതയഴിക്കുന്ന, ഉദ്വേഗവും ഭയവും സാഹസികതയും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലർ.  കേൾക്കൂ- ജിസ ജോസിന്റെ 'ഡാർക്ക് ഫാന്റസി' !

നികുതി-ലാഭിക്കാൻ-വഴികൾ-.title: നികുതി  ലാഭിക്കാൻ വഴികൾ
നികുതി-ലാഭിക്കാൻ-വഴികൾ-.description: നിങ്ങളുടെ വരുമാനത്തിൽ നിന്ന് ഈടാക്കുന്ന നികുതി കുറയ്ക്കാൻ നിരവധി വഴികളുണ്ട്. ഈ ഷോയിൽ, നികുതി ലാഭിക്കാൻ നിങ്ങളെ സഹായിക്കുന്ന ചില ലളിതവും ഫലപ്രദവുമായ തന്ത്രങ്ങൾ ഞങ്ങൾ പരിശോധിക്കും.

ed-cbi-chunavi-tota-hain.title: ED & CBI : Chunavi Tota?
ed-cbi-chunavi-tota-hain.description: ED & CBI ka ho raha hai misuse? "Ya sach mein hua hai "Sharaab Ghotala"? Kya saare hi neta chor hain? Janiye Sab kuch Is khas show "ED & CBI : Chunavi Tota?" mein.

V-ഫോര്‍-വിയറ്റ്‌നാം.title: V ഫോര്‍ വിയറ്റ്‌നാം
V-ഫോര്‍-വിയറ്റ്‌നാം.description: വിയറ്റ്‌നാം സന്ദര്‍ശിക്കാതെ തന്നെ അവിടെ പോയി വന്ന ഫീല്‍ തരുന്ന യാത്രാനുഭവം. മിത്ര സതീഷിന്റെ വിയറ്റ്‌നാം ഒരു സോളോ യാത്രയുടെ അനുപമമായ ആഖ്യാനമാണു, കേള്‍ക്കാം.

తాజ్-మహల్--ప్రేమ-చిహ్నం-.title: తాజ్ మహల్ - ప్రేమ చిహ్నం
తాజ్-మహల్--ప్రేమ-చిహ్నం-.description: భారతదేశంలో ఉన్న ప్రేమికుల స్మారక చిహ్నం, అద్భుత శిల్పకళా నిర్మాణం మన తాజ్ మహల్ . ఈ తాజ్ మహల్ వెనుక ఎన్నో రహస్యాలు దాగి ఉన్నాయి. అవి ఏంటో తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో విని.!

1921-the-forgotten-tragedy-of-moplah.title: 1921: The Forgotten Tragedy of Moplah
1921-the-forgotten-tragedy-of-moplah.description:
|Key Insights - True Event, Forgotten History, Conflicting Opinions|
1921 mein ghati Moplah durghatna ko koi Britishers ke khilaaf vidroh ka naam dekar sammanit karta hai toh koi Hinduon ka narsanhaar jata kar uski kadi se kadi ninda karta hai. Aakhir kyon hamara itihaas banta hua hai? Kyon hamse sach chhipaaya gaya hai? Itihaas ko chhipaana matlab itihaas ko dohraana. Toh aaiye iss show ke maadhyam se itihaas ke ek sharmanaak sach ko jaante hain aur usey sweekaar kar apne vartamaan aur bhavishya ko behtar banaate hain.

the-first-black-president-of-america-bar.title: బరాక్ ఒబామా
the-first-black-president-of-america-bar.description: ఓ నల్లజాతి వ్యక్తి అమెరికా అధ్యక్షుడు ఎలా కాగలిగారు? ఒబామా అమెరికా సమాజంపై ఎలాంటి ప్రభావం చూపించారు? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.!

mandir-vs-masjid.title: Mandir Vs Masjid
mandir-vs-masjid.description: BJP ko khada karne mein Ram Mandir ka aham yogdan raha hai. Usi ke chalte aaj wo 400+ ka sapna dekh pa rahi hai. Par ab Ram Mandir ke baad kya? Kya Mandir aur Masjid ki rajneeti Kashi aur Mathura bhi pahunchegi? Kya bina communal taqat ke BJP ki rajneeti nahi chal sakti? Janne ke liye sunein, Mandir Vs Masjid...

kannadi-kanavugal.title: Kannadi Kanavugal
kannadi-kanavugal.description: Appa, ammavai izhantha mirthula thannoda veettai kaappaththa bharaniya contract kalyanam senjikara. But, ivunga rendu perum lifela onnu sera koodaathunnu ninaikkara rathna. Avaloda thittam jeyichitha?

chidambara-rahasyam.title: Chidambara Rahasyam
chidambara-rahasyam.description: Noottaandukaludey Pazhakkamulla Rahasyangal Kandethaanulla Oru Saahasika Yathrayilekk Swagatham. Chidambara Rahasyam Enna Ee Showil Charithravum Eitheihyangalum Kathakalayi Paranjuporunnu.

2024-vs-2019.title: 2019 Vs 2024
2024-vs-2019.description: Modi nahi to kaun? BJP ne is sawal ko apna brahmashtra bana liya hai. Isi sawal ka jawab dhundhte 2024 mein opposition ko ekjut hokar ladna pad raha hai. Phir bhi unhe apna PM face ka chehra nahi mil raha. Wahi BJP ne Modi ko aage karke mehngai, berojgaari jaise muddon ko peeche dhakel diya hai. To kya alag hai 2019 se 2024 ke chunav mein? Janne ke liye sunien 2019 Vs 2024...

എവറസ്റ്റ്--കീഴടക്കിയ-ഇന്ത്യക്കാർ.title: എവറസ്റ്റ്  കീഴടക്കിയ ഇന്ത്യക്കാർ
എവറസ്റ്റ്--കീഴടക്കിയ-ഇന്ത്യക്കാർ.description: ലോകത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും ഉയരം കൂടിയ പർവതമായ എവറസ്റ്റ് കീഴടക്കിയ ഇന്ത്യൻ സാഹസികരുടെ അസാധാരണമായ കഥകളാണ് ഈ ഷോയിൽ പറയുന്നത്.

brain-exercises-to-improve-memory-and-co.title: Brain Exercises to Improve Memory and Concentration
brain-exercises-to-improve-memory-and-co.description: Shareeram Poley Thanne Vyaayam Athyavaashyamaanu Ningaludey Thalachorinum. Memory, Concentration Enniva Vardhippikkan Nirbandhamaayum Cheythirikkenda Anchu Brain Exercises Aanu Innathey Kuku Bytesil Avatharippikkunnath!

waiting-for-love-4.title: Waiting for Love ❤️
waiting-for-love-4.description: A lonely billionaire hides his identity to test a woman’s love. She’s a resilient food stall owner, scarred by betrayal and loss. But what begins as a spark of love leads her to the daughter she lost five years ago.

billionaire-bana-fake-boyfriend.title: Billionaire Bana Fake Boyfriend
billionaire-bana-fake-boyfriend.description: একজন ধনকুবের সত্যিকারের ভালোবাসা খুঁজে পেতে ভিখারীর ছদ্মবেশ ধারণ করে। পরে সে এক প্রতিষ্ঠিত অন্য আর এক পরিবারের উত্তরাধিকারিণীর সঙ্গে ছদ্ম সম্পর্ক তৈরি করে, যার পরিবার তাকে এক চাটুকার ধনকুবেরের সঙ্গে বিয়ে করার জন্য জোরজবরদস্তি করছে। সেই ছদ্ম সম্পর্কই সত্যিকারের ভালোবাসায় মোড় নেয়। কী হয় শেষ পর্যন্ত?

i-remember-i-am-rich.title: Gumnaam Billionaire
i-remember-i-am-rich.description: After losing his memory in a murder attempt by his own wife, this billionaire falls in love again — only to be humiliated by the powerful family of the woman he loves. But when a public business event reveals his true identity as the founder of their entire empire, he returns not for revenge… but to reclaim his name!

ceo-those-twins-look-like-you-2.title: CEO Those Twins Look Like You
ceo-those-twins-look-like-you-2.description:
ఒక యువత సీఈఓ, తన గతం మిగిల్చిన బాధను మర్చిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ జీవిస్తున్నాడు. అతడి నిశ్చితార్థమైన అమ్మాయి అనుమానాస్పద స్థితుల్లో మృతి చెందింది. అది ప్రమాదమని ప్రపంచం నమ్మినా, అతడి మనసు మాత్రం ఒప్పుకోలేదు.

ఒక రోజు అతను తేడా మనస్తత్వంతో ఉన్న యువతిని త‌న ఇంట్లో ఆశ్రయం ఇస్తాడు. ఆమె ముఖం అతని మరణించిన ప్రేయసి ముఖానికి సరిగ్గా దొర్లుతుంది. ఇంకా దానికి ముందు, అతను రోడ్డుపై తిరుగుతున్న మరో అమ్మాయిని చూస్తాడు – ఆమె కూడా అదే ముఖం కలిగిన Twin!

అతను నిజాన్ని వెలికితీయడానికి ప్రయాణం ప్రారంభిస్తాడు. ఎవరు ఈ అమ్మాయిలు? అతని ప్రేయసి నిజంగా చనిపోయిందా? లేదా ఇది ముందుగా పన్నిన స్కెచ్?

saga-ya-sautela.title: Saga Ya Sautela
saga-ya-sautela.description: In the affluent Shekhawat family, patriarch Rajveer's shocking decision to name his illegitimate son Kabir as heir instead of his legitimate son Aryan triggers a devastating chain of events. Aryan's jealousy drives him to orchestrate failed murder attempts on Kabir, manipulate and ultimately cause the death of his pregnant girlfriend Meera, and eventually murder his own father with a lethal injection. As the family unravels, a hidden diary reveals the ultimate truth - Kabir is actually Gayatri's biological son from a rape by Rajveer's deceased brother, making him the true Shekhawat heir. The revelation culminates in Gayatri shooting Aryan to protect Kabir, leaving the family destroyed but the truth finally exposed.

love-and-deceit.title: Love and Deceit
love-and-deceit.description: When ambitious architect Aarohi is betrayed on her engagement day, a mysterious stranger offers her a new beginning — with strings attached. As secrets unravel and love clashes with deception, her journey turns into a rollercoaster of power, betrayal, and redemption.

the-love-that-kills-4.title: The Love that Kills
the-love-that-kills-4.description: A gripping drama that follows the unraveling of Raghav Malhotra's family due to the unchecked entitlement of his son Sid and father Vijay, sparked by Sid's destructive act at a luxury hotel. As tensions with Raghav's boss Srishti Mehra escalate, the series explores accountability, family dynamics, and the devastating cost of pride.

friendships-betrayal.title: Friendship's Betrayal
friendships-betrayal.description: When betrayed by her best friend Shivani and husband Lalit, Dhvani dies, only to wake up six months in the past with one chance to rewrite her fate. Armed with vengeance and cunning, she exposes lies, confronts Yakshit, and turns the deadly game of love and betrayal on its head. Watch Now!

my-secret-billionaire-boyfriend-1.title: Kanden Kathalai
my-secret-billionaire-boyfriend-1.description: A billionaire disguises himself as a beggar to find true love and ends up in a fake relationship with a wealthy heiress, who’s being forced by her family to marry a spoiled billionaire.

billion-dollar-brother.title: Billion Dollar Brother
billion-dollar-brother.description: When the arrogant and wealthy Aditya Paswan returns to his hometown after years abroad, he hides his billionaire status behind a simple identity. But when he meets the fiery and independent Jhanvi, his past secrets, family wounds, and unresolved rivalries resurface. In a clash of pride, love, and redemption, Samar must choose between ego and heart before it's too late. Watch Now!

avanum-naanum.title: Avanum Naanum
avanum-naanum.description: Divya sacrifices everything to save her amnesiac fiancé, Mihir, only to face a vengeful underworld don, Rana, who threatens their love with dark family secrets. As Mihir’s powerful lineage emerges, their fight for survival ends in triumph, shadowed by a hint of a sinister conspiracy behind his accident.

secret-husband-6.title: Secret Husband
secret-husband-6.description: Kabir, once dismissed as ordinary, hides a powerful secret. When his true identity as a global tycoon is revealed, his in-laws are left stunned. A tale of pride, deception, and redemption unfolds — where the underestimated becomes unstoppable.

contract-pregnant-wife-3.title: Contract Pregnant Wife
contract-pregnant-wife-3.description: After a one-night stand with a billionaire who insists he’s infertile, a young woman finds herself pregnant with twins. As hidden truths surface and powerful enemies emerge, love and betrayal ignite a battle of destiny and desire.

alpha-playboy.title: Alpha Playboy
alpha-playboy.description: Heiress Tara's vast inheritance and impending engagement are thrown into disarray by a blackmailer, leading to the dramatic intervention of the mysterious Ronnie D'Souza, who declares his intention to marry her. Facing a three-day deadline to secure her fortune and leadership of the powerful Birla Group, Tara enters a contract marriage with Ronnie, unaware he is a powerful figure who secretly orchestrated their union, believing her to be his fated soulmate with a hidden agenda against the Birla Group. As Tara assumes leadership of the Birla Group, she confronts fierce corporate power struggles and internal sabotage, while her secret marriage to Ronnie is dramatically exposed, leading to her disinheritance. She later realizes Ronnie's manipulative role in a larger corporate scheme, even as another man, Man 2, shockingly declares himself her legal husband at an auction. Tara is drawn into the opulent world of Mr. DeSouza, later revealed as Ronny D'Souza, her secret admirer and a powerful corporate heir, and their burgeoning romance is complicated by a love triangle and corporate conspiracies orchestrated by her own father and a rival. A shocking revelation emerges that Tara and Ronny share a deceased mother, whose suicide is linked to corporate corruption, forcing Tara to blackmail Ronny for help in her investigation. Despite these conflicts, Ronny and Tara commit to a genuine marriage, though their union faces scrutiny. Tara's investigation into her mother's death takes a dark turn, uncovering Naman's family's sinister involvement, leading to her kidnapping and a dramatic rescue by Ronnie. Amidst this, Tara is diagnosed with a rare, terminal hereditary illness, mirroring her mother's tragic fate, giving her only six months to live. Grappling with her mortality, Tara keeps her illness secret and attempts to divorce her devoted husband, Raj, to protect him, despite his unwavering refusal. Her aunt's dying wish further complicates Tara's emotional landscape, urging her towards a future with Ronnie, while Raj desperately seeks a cure and investigates her mother's two-decade-old murder against Tara's pleas. Estranged lovers Ronny and Tara grapple with their separation, with Ronny embarking on a six-year quest to reunite with his long-lost soulmate, only for their tender moment to be abruptly interrupted. The show explores themes of hidden truths, possessive love, and the severe consequences of past actions, as Tara fights for her inheritance, her life, and the truth behind her family's dark secrets.

cute-baby-assists-i-help-my-mom-marry-th.title: Cute Baby Assists : I Help My Mom Marry the President Tycoon
cute-baby-assists-i-help-my-mom-marry-th.description: A cute baby becomes the cupid and gets his mom married to a billionaire.

secret-baby-3.title: Secret Baby
secret-baby-3.description: Leena, working as the secretary to CEO Sameer under a secret identity, is deeply in love with him. When the company faces a cyber attack, she takes matters into her own hands, secretly handling the crisis. But her world shatters when she learns of Sameer’s engagement to Maya, leaving her torn and awestruck by the unexpected turn of events.

chori-chori-chupke-chupke.title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
chori-chori-chupke-chupke.description: A heartbroken software engineer returns home to propose to his girlfriend, only to discover she’s already engaged to a millionaire. Crushed by betrayal, his life takes a sudden turn when a mysterious, wealthy girl offers him a one-month contract marriage — to stop her ex-fiancé and expose the truth. Their fake marriage starts with revenge, but where will it end?

hollywood-staged-romance-live-247-4.title: Hollywood Staged Romance Live 24/7
hollywood-staged-romance-live-247-4.description: A young woman, initially suffering from amnesia and known as Ruby, finds her life dramatically altered by a public scandal after powerful CEO Charles claims they spent a night together. Her burgeoning acting career is derailed, and she is publicly branded "Deva" amidst accusations of pregnancy and corporate espionage. Under intense family pressure to secure his inheritance, Charles manipulates Ruby into a series of fabricated relationships, including a "special partner," a contract wife, and a live-streamed "love life," forcing her into intimate cohabitation. As Ruby struggles to maintain the charade and reclaim her identity, a mysterious "Sir" observes her every move, hinting at a pre-planned agenda behind the unfolding drama. The lines between genuine emotion and calculated performance blur as Ruby develops feelings for Charles, despite his manipulative actions and her own desire for independence. The arrival of Frederick Spike, Charles's half-brother and Ruby's past mentor, complicates matters, creating a dangerous love triangle and unearthing deep-seated family secrets and corporate rivalries. Ruby navigates a complex web of professional ambition, confronting manipulative figures like producer David and facing hostile takeovers orchestrated by Frederick Spike and other rivals. Charles, revealed to have hidden past identities as "Nova" and "Noah," desperately seeks to make Ruby remember a profound, forgotten past they share, indicating a deeper, pre-existing connection. Amidst corporate battles for control of the Spike Group and family inheritance disputes, Ruby's career fluctuates, and she faces betrayals and sabotage. Despite the transactional nature of their initial agreement, Charles relentlessly pursues Ruby, blurring professional lines and challenging their contractual boundaries. Ultimately, Ruby accepts a public, contract-based marriage proposal from Charles, signifying a complex relationship built on both strategic necessity and evolving genuine affection, while corporate and personal conflicts continue to unfold.

royal-obsession.title: Royal Obsession
royal-obsession.description: Lily Ghosh, an undercover journalist posing as a social media manager who infiltrates the royal Raj Mahal to expose Prince Aryan's alleged scandals. Initially sent by vengeful ex-employee Mukul to destroy Aryan's reputation, Lily finds herself drawn into a complex web of palace intrigue involving the mysterious return of Aryan's supposedly dead brother Rishan after 15 years. As Lily navigates between her journalistic mission and growing feelings for Aryan, she uncovers shocking secrets:

the-westward-anime-season-1-2.title: The Westward Anime Season 1
the-westward-anime-season-1-2.description: The Western Journey is a conspiracy in heaven. After Sutra had been missing for over ten years, heaven decided it must not fall into their hands again, and so it sent its army to Earth. To protect Sutra, the Western Journey began once more.

alpha-she-wasnt-the-one-6.title: Alpha, She Wasn't the One
alpha-she-wasnt-the-one-6.description: In a world where ordinary Annie, who comes from a vastly different background, meets Leon, the leader of the werewolves, they are brought together by the prophecy of the Moon Goddess. However, for the tribe's survival, Leon's father chooses to hypnotize a few people, leading Leon to mistakenly identify Annie's sister as Luna. After losing their memories, they return to their roles as boss and subordinate, but through their daily interactions, they fall in love. Ultimately, true love overcomes obstacles, and as their memories are restored, they resolve all misunderstandings and express their genuine feelings for each other. With the Moon Goddess's blessing, Annie gains the unique ability foretold in the prophecy, integrating into the werewolf tribe and finding lasting happiness.

the-final-badla.title: The Final Badla
the-final-badla.description: Final Badla tells the story of a single mother who returns to her family home for her father's birthday, where old criticisms about her single motherhood and life choices immediately resurface. Despite raising three accomplished sons on her own, she faces renewed judgment and hostility from relatives. Through courage and determination, she stands up to the toxic family dynamics and discovers her own pathway to fulfillment and joy.

the-substitute-bride-unveiling-her-count.title: The Substitute Bride: Unveiling Her Countless Secrets
the-substitute-bride-unveiling-her-count.description: A village girl arrives as a mere substitute bride, but with each passing moment, secrets emerge that have the power to upend lives. In a web of love, betrayal, and political intrigue, the true bride remains a mystery—who will emerge victorious in this high-stakes game? Watch as every hidden truth unfolds, revealing shocking twists at every turn.

the-love-trap.title: The Love Trap
the-love-trap.description: A girl forced to become her sister’s shadow enters a world of betrayal, ambition, and stolen love. But revenge burns quietly. Will she take back everything… or lose herself in the process? Watch Now !

the-price-of-betrayal.title: The Price of Betrayal
the-price-of-betrayal.description: For three long years, Ellie Scott awaited a heart transplant for her son, Howie. However, her husband, Dr. Zack Scott, shattered her hopes by giving the heart to his ex-lover Rachel Shields' son, Jason. Devastated by Howie’s death, Ellie confronted Zack, who blamed her and moved Rachel and Jason into their home. Ellie demanded a divorce, but Zack refused. In desperation, Ellie caused a scene at the hospital, leading to Zack's suspension and Rachel's dismissal. Realizing his grave mistake, Zack was consumed with regret. Ellie forced Rachel to face Howie's portrait, exposing her deceit. In a final act of redemption, Zack sacrificed his life to save Ellie, and Rachel was imprisoned.

magical-lipstick.title: Magic Lipstick
magical-lipstick.description: What if one lipstick could change your life? Mahi Roy returns to the past to expose traitors, claim her legacy, and awaken a forgotten prince. The Lipstick Empire is a rollercoaster of deceit, ambition, and unexpected power. Watch Now !

three-brothers-dote-on-me-1.title: Three Brothers Dote on Me
three-brothers-dote-on-me-1.description: Iris Turner is a rich lady. Iris gets lost and loses her memory when she’s a kid. She’s adopted and becomes the master of Eternity Pavilion. Then, Iris is betrayed and hurt badly. Kayden Ford saves her but abandons her later. Iris finds her brothers and exposes Kayden. Kayden fails to make a comeback. Fiona Wood holds Iris is dating Iris’s third brother, so Fiona tries to get revenge. Iris stops her, and the Wood family goes bankrupt. Iris and her brothers live happily ever after.

the-price-of-betrayal-1.title: The Price of Betrayal
the-price-of-betrayal-1.description: Ellie Scott’s world shatters when her husband, Dr. Zack Scott, gives their son’s heart to his ex-lover Raichel’s son, leading to Howie’s death. Devastated, Ellie fights for justice, causing Zack to confront his mistake and make a final sacrifice to save her. In the end, Rachel is exposed and imprisoned, while Ellie’s grief gives way to redemption.

beta-ban-gaya-billionaire.title: Beta Ban Gaya Billionaire
beta-ban-gaya-billionaire.description: When elderly parents travel to surprise their son in the city, they uncover a world of lies, betrayal, and buried truths. Man from the hills is an emotional rollercoaster that explores love, pride, and the dark cost of ambition. How far can a son go to erase his roots?  Watch Now !

hollywood-staged-romance-live-247-5.title: Hollywood Staged Romance: Live 24/7
hollywood-staged-romance-live-247-5.description: রুবি, পেশায় একজন অভিনেত্রী যার কেরিয়ার কঠিন সংকটের মধ্যে রয়েছে। হঠাৎই সে আলোচনায় আসে স্পাইক গ্রুপের ক্যারিশমাটিক সিইওর সঙ্গে এক আকস্মিক সাক্ষাতের পর। নিজের ব্র্যান্ডের প্রচারের জন্য সে রুবিকে একটি ভুয়ো সম্পর্কে জড়াতে প্রস্তাব দেয়। কিন্তু গল্পটি নাটকীয় মোড় নেয় যখন রুবি জানতে পারে, ছয় বছর আগে যে ব্যক্তি তার জীবন বাঁচিয়েছিল, সে-ই এই মানুষটি। ভালোবাসা ধীরে ধীরে গড়ে ওঠে, আর তারা একসাথে লড়ে সেই সৎ মায়ের ষড়যন্ত্রের বিরুদ্ধে। শেষ পর্যন্ত তারা এক শক্তিশালী ও প্রিয় বাস্তব জীবনের জুটি হিসেবে আত্মপ্রকাশ করে।

jamai-on-emi.title: Jamai on EMI
jamai-on-emi.description: Betrayed on her engagement day, Maira Ramani impulsively fakes a relationship with Naksh, the charming hotel owner with secrets of his own. What begins as a deal to save face and secure family inheritances soon spirals into a complicated web of emotions, lies, and unexpected love. Will their fake marriage turn into something real?

dibalik-cinta-tersembunyi-pengkhianatan-.title: Dibalik Cinta, Tersembunyi Pengkhianatan dan Dosa Lama
dibalik-cinta-tersembunyi-pengkhianatan-.description: “Dibalik Cinta, Tersembunyi Pengkhianatan dan Dosa Lama” mengikuti kisah Rajveer Singhania, yang hidupnya berubah menjadi kekacauan ketika tunangannya, Veda Mehta, salah paham dan mengira iparnya yang sedang hamil, Shanaya Birla, sebagai selingkuhannya. Yang awalnya hanya kesalahpahaman saat acara pertunangan, berkembang menjadi kisah kelam yang penuh dengan pengkhianatan, kekerasan, dan kebenaran mengejutkan.

three-brothers-dote-on-me-2.title: Three Brothers Dote on Me
three-brothers-dote-on-me-2.description: একজন ধনী উত্তরাধিকারিণী শিশু অবস্থায় স্মৃতি হারিয়ে ফেলে। দত্তক পেয়ে বড় হয়ে এক সুমহান প্রতিষ্ঠানের নেতৃত্বে ওঠে। ঠকানো ও আহত হবার পর, এক পুরুষ তাকে বাঁচিয়ে রেখে যায়। সত্য উদঘাটন করে, সে তার ভাইদের খুঁজে পায় ও প্রতারককে মুখোশ উন্মোচন করে। তার প্রত্যাবর্তন আর সম্ভব হয় না। প্রতিশোধ নিতে চাওয়া কোনো পরিকল্পনা ব্যর্থ হয়, আর সেই পরিবার দেউলিয়া হয়। শেষ পর্যন্ত, সে ও তার ভাইদের সুখী জীবন শুরু হয়।

secret-life-of-billionaire.title: Secret Life Of Billionaire
secret-life-of-billionaire.description: The microdrama chronicles the tumultuous marriage of high-society businesswoman Rakshita and the seemingly humble Kshitij, which quickly devolves into a battle of class, corporate intrigue, and personal betrayal. Kshitij initially harbors a hidden agenda to infiltrate Rakshita's corporate empire, while their relationship is challenged by her influential family, who favor the wealthy Akhil. Public humiliations and accusations of infidelity escalate, culminating in a video revealing Kshitij's own betrayal and an affair with Kareena, leading to a demand for divorce. Kshitij is forced into a year of exile to claim his corporate legacy, during which Rakshita, manipulated by her mother, vows psychological torment. Upon his return, Kshitij is revealed as the heir of Maurya Enterprises, embracing a ruthless path fueled by his father, and orchestrates a public declaration of dominance and revenge against Rakshita. Their divorce proceeds after Rakshita reveals her pregnancy with another man's child, confirmed by her mother. Rakshita's business faces bankruptcy, forcing her to seek aid from the powerful Maurya family, where she endures humiliation from Kshitij and faces a formidable rival in Kareena Maurya. Kshitij unexpectedly seizes control of Maurya Enterprises, thwarting Akhil and Rakshita's corporate plans. Rakshita, now genuinely pregnant with Kshitij's child, is caught in a love triangle with Akhil and blackmailed by Kshitij, who threatens to expose her hidden pregnancy and ruin her company. Kshitij orchestrates Rakshita's complete corporate downfall, leading to the loss of her business and financial accounts as an act of revenge for a past romantic betrayal. Financially ruined, Rakshita plans to expose their secret child at Kshitij's public introduction, using his paternity as a weapon. Shitij Maurya is dramatically unveiled as a ruthless CEO and heir, confronting Rakshita about her pregnancy. A bitter paternity dispute ensues, with Rakshita presenting DNA proof, which Shitij initially dismisses due to a past false pregnancy. Despite initial disbelief, Shitij eventually accepts paternity, but Rakshita is then abducted by a blackmailer seeking to extort the Maurya family. The child tragically dies, with Shitij accusing Rakshita of causing the death due to her selfish ambition. Rakshita confesses to a lifetime of manipulation, including exploiting the child, but Shitij rejects her plea for forgiveness, declaring their marriage shattered by unforgiveness and betrayal.

my-brother-you-cant-afford-to-mess-with-.title: My Brother, You Can't Afford to Mess With

oops-it-was-my-husband.title: Oops, It Was My Husband
oops-it-was-my-husband.description: Three years after a contract marriage, ambitious designer Isha Shrivastava unexpectedly crosses paths with her estranged husband, billionaire Nitin Mehta the man she never really knew. What begins as a fake relationship to escape family debts spirals into real emotions, shocking secrets, and a second chance at love neither of them saw coming. Watch Now!

dual-plants-decision-1.title: Dual Plants' Decision
dual-plants-decision-1.description: A powerful man's inner journey unfolds between the fall of an empire and his eternal return, where silence speaks louder than glory and the true reward lies beyond victory.

chinese-new-year-the-hidden-dragon-retur.title: Chinese New Year: The Hidden Dragon Returns to the Village
chinese-new-year-the-hidden-dragon-retur.description: Chinese New Year: The Hidden Dragon Returns to the Village is a thrilling tale of mystery, legacy, and redemption. Set against the backdrop of tradition and change, it promises emotion, intrigue, and unforgettable moments.

happily-ever-legal.title: Happily Ever Legal
happily-ever-legal.description: Lara Khuraana faces the worst day of her life when her parents give her an ultimatum to marry, she loses her job and her boyfriend leaves her for another girl. She then meets a dashing billionaire with hidden identity, who wants her to donate bone marrow for his brother’s life. In exchange for helping him, Lara demands a fake marriage with Rahul Saxena. They both live in the same house and slowly start liking each other. Rahul secretly helps Lara with her job interviews. She soon finds out that Rahul is a successful businessman and just when everything seems fine, Rahul’s lover and ex-fiancee creates a scene. Because of her interference, Rahul and Lara break apart for a while but soon, Rahul goes public and announces that he wants Lara back in his life. She returns to him and they marry each other in front of their families.

too-heavy-to-handle-1.title: Too Heavy To Handle
too-heavy-to-handle-1.description: 'টু হেভি টু হ্যান্ডল' আসলে প্রতিশোধের গল্প বলে। এক নারীর ভারিক্কী ওজন নিয়ে উপহাস করা হয়। তার সাথে বিয়ে করার পরেও তার স্বামী তাকে ডিভোর্স দেয়। ঘনিষ্ঠ হয় অন্য আর এক নারীর সাথে। সেই বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা থেকেই শিক্ষা নিয়ে প্রিয়া নামের ওই নারী নিজেকে আমূল পরিবর্তন করার দৃঢ়সংকল্প নেয়। বদলে যায় সে। ছিপছিপে গড়ন নিয়ে ফিরে আসে। তার এই রূপান্তর সকলকে চমকে দেয়। চরম নাটকীয় মুহূর্তে ঘটনা ধীরে ধীরে চমকে মোড় নিতে থাকে। প্রিয়া কি বদলা নেবে?

sasural-murder-ka-1.title: Sasural Murder Ka
sasural-murder-ka-1.description: বিক্রম, একজন লোভী চরিত্রের পুরুষ। সফল উদ্যোগপতি অনন্যাকে বিয়ে করে, কিন্তু তার আসল উদ্দেশ্য ছিলো অনন্যার বিপুল সম্পদ হাতিয়ে নেওয়া। অনন্যারই বান্ধবী রিয়ার সঙ্গে মিলে সে অনন্যার সাথে একটি সাজানো বিয়ের আয়োজন করে। এই রিয়া এবং বিক্রম দুজনে ষড়যন্ত্র করে অনন্যাকে হত্যা করে। তারপরই ঘটনার আসল রহস্য উন্মোচিত হয়। কোথা থেকে উড়ে এসে জুড়ে বসে অনন্যার আপন যমজ বোন অবনী। তারপর?

arabpati-ka-badla-1.title: Arabpati Ka Badla
arabpati-ka-badla-1.description: দিব্যা তার স্মৃতিভ্রংশ বাগদত্তা মিহিরকে বাঁচানোর জন্য সর্বস্য ত্যাগ করে। অন্যদিকে  প্রতিশোধপরায়ণ আন্ডারওয়ার্ল্ড ডন, রানা , তাদের হুমকি দিতে থাকে। একদিকে ভালোবাসা  অন্যদিকে অন্ধকার পারিবারিক গোপন রহস্য....... তারপর?

rich-kid-poor-family.title: Rich Kid Poor Family
rich-kid-poor-family.description: One disappeared. One turned bitter. Now, two brothers are about to collide. “The Man from the Wild” brings you a gripping tale of love, lies, and legacy. Watch Now !

waiting-for-love-2.title: Waiting for Love ❤️
waiting-for-love-2.description: The microdrama begins with formidable CEO Aditya Deshpande, whose daughter, Sanvi, pressures him to find love, leading him to a deceptive setup with independent caterer Arohi. Skeptical of love, Aditya tests Arohi's intentions by posing as a struggling carpenter, yet their connection deepens, culminating in a marriage proposal. Concurrently, Arohi, a resilient mother, is searching for her adopted daughter, Sanvi, and becomes entangled in the hostile family machinations of Rohit and his wife, Teena, facing public humiliation. Arohi later discovers Aditya's shocking secret wealth and his connection to the powerful 'Deshpande groups,' shattering her perception of their marriage and revealing a complex web of deceit. As the narrative unfolds, Aditya's high-stakes corporate deals become intertwined with the personal struggles of humble families, including Arohi's, who face relentless classist humiliation orchestrated by figures like Teena and her son, Vikram. Arohi battles emotional wounds and financial exploitation from manipulative relatives, while a dangerous conspiracy surrounding her identity as a long-lost adopted child emerges. Aditya, initially disguised as a humble carpenter and factory owner, deeply cares for Arohi and begins to seek justice against her abusive family and those who wronged her. He exposes Teena's cruel deception regarding a kidney donation for her ailing mother, leading to Rohit's divorce and Teena's public humiliation. The conflict escalates as Arohi's ex-lover, Vikas, vows revenge upon rejection, threatening her family. In a dramatic turn, Aditya reveals his true identity as the powerful CEO, turning the tables on his adversaries. He confronts his manipulative ex-partner, exacting revenge for past betrayals and fraud, permanently expelling her and her family from his life. Free from his tumultuous past, Aditya proposes marriage to Arohi, who accepts, setting the stage for a blended family. The show culminates in Aditya and Arohi's poignant search for their lost daughter, Maya, leading to an emotional reunion that completes their broken family.

major-madam.title: Major Madam
major-madam.description: Dipika loved Major Rahul with all her heart, but he didn’t feel the same. She left everything behind and joined the army. Now she’s back - as Major Dipika - strong, proud, and no longer his. Watch this story of love, rejection, and a comeback like never before. Watch now!

gulab-ka-raaz.title: Gulab Ka Raaz
gulab-ka-raaz.description:
Ek raaz ne do zindagiyan ujaad di — ek asli beti jise uski maa ne anjaane mein kho diya, aur doosri, jinhone uski jagah chura kar jee li ek raajkumari ki zindagi. Gauri, ek gareeb maali ki beti jaisi pali, jise kabhi nahi pata tha ki uske gale ka ek pendant uski asli pehchaan ka saboot hai. Aarvi, ek ameer khandaan ki laadli jo har mod par Gauri ko mitane ki koshish karti hai — use kabhi yeh andaza nahi tha ki uska poora jeevan ek jhooth par bana hai.
Jab sach samne aata hai, toh ek maa do betiyon ke beech ulajh jaati hai. Dard, dhokha, DNA reports aur ek jalte ghar ki yaadein — sab kuch laut aata hai. Aur tab shuru hoti hai asli beti ke haq ki ladai.

aval-varuvaala.title: Aval Varuvaala
aval-varuvaala.description: Aditya Singhania is a wealthy yet lonely businessman, and Roohi Bhatia is a self-made woman who runs a food stall, battling broken relationships, a cruel daughter-in-law, and painful memories of past humiliation. Their paths cross through Aditya’s daughter, Taanvi, where a simple matchmaking attempt turns into a profound story. Aditya hides his true identity to see whether Roohi loves him for who he is or for his wealth. But for Roohi, this relationship goes far beyond love — on this journey, she also reunites with the daughter she lost five years ago.

madan-dont-run.title: Madan Don't Run
madan-dont-run.description: ఒక గమ్మత్తైన మహిళ కథ. ఆమె గతంలో జరిగిన ఓ దారుణమైన సంఘటన కారణంగా కుటుంబం ఆమెను వదిలేసింది. సమాజం ఆమెను తీర్పు చెప్పింది. కానీ లీసా తలవంచలేదు. ఓ వైపు గదిలో తాళం వేసిన కుటుంబ గోప్యాల్ని ఎదుర్కొంటూ, మరోవైపు నమ్మినవారి ద్రోహంతో గుండె పగిలిపోయిన సందర్భాల్లోనూ, ఆమె ప్రేమను మళ్లీ తెలుసుకుంటుంది. అయినా ఆమె వెనక్కి తగ్గదు. ప్రేమ, క్షమాపణ, పునరుద్ధరణ అనే భావనలతో ఆమె మళ్లీ ఎదుగుతుంది.

revenge-trap.title: Revenge Trap
revenge-trap.description: When poor and desperate Radhika struggles to pay for her mother’s treatment, the cunning and wealthy Janvi offers her a shocking deal  to impersonate her and deceive Sameer. What begins as a lie spirals into a web of love, revenge, and secrets where the line between real and fake blurs dangerously. Watch Now!

fearless-son-in-law.title: Fearless Son-in-law
fearless-son-in-law.description: A humble village man returns as the powerful CEO of a billion-dollar company, only to have his truth questioned and his family turn against him. A web of lies begins to unravel, threatening to destroy everything he’s built. With honor, love, and a secret weapon, he must fight to reclaim his dignity and expose the real imposter behind it all.

mera-handsome-bodyguard.title: Mera Handsome Bodyguard
mera-handsome-bodyguard.description: Mera Handsome Bodyguard is a high-stakes romantic thriller that follows Aarohi Mehta, a sharp and confident CEO, whose life takes a dramatic turn when she hires Kabir Rana, a mysterious hotel security guard, as her personal bodyguard. What begins as a fake marriage for reputation soon blossoms into real love, but secrets from Kabir’s hidden past resurface—revealing him as an ex-army intelligence officer with enemies still at large. Together, they battle corporate sabotage, personal betrayals, and a deadly conspiracy led by Raghav Thakur, a corrupt former officer and Kabir’s nemesis. At the heart of it all is Gudiya, Kabir’s daughter—and the key to a national scandal. With love, loyalty, and truth on the line, will this trio survive the storm?

waiting-for-love-3.title: Waiting for Love ❤️
waiting-for-love-3.description: A wealthy CEO, Aditya, embarks on a quest for genuine love, adopting a humble carpenter's disguise to test potential partners. He marries Ruhi, a kind food stall owner, while concealing his immense wealth, a deception that eventually raises suspicion. Simultaneously, a deep family rift unfolds as Rohit's humble mother endures cruel accusations and public humiliation from his imperious wife, Tina, who is the daughter of a powerful VP. Rohit initially sides with Tina, deepening the conflict, but her escalating malice, including obstructing help for their choking son and orchestrating a deceptive kidney transplant for her own mother, eventually leads him to forcibly remove and divorce her. Tina, supported by her CEO father, then orchestrates Rohit's professional ruin. Amidst these personal dramas, Aditya, secretly a powerful corporate figure, intervenes to protect his relatives and bring down arrogant individuals like Vikram, who had humiliated Ruhi and the disguised Aditya. Ruhi, initially unaware of her husband's true identity, vows revenge for past injustices and discovers a shocking revelation about her lost daughter, a theme echoed in other characters' searches for missing children. Her ex-lover, Bikash, attempts to rekindle their romance and plots against Rohit, forcing Ruhi to consider separation to protect her husband. Aditya, revealing his true identity as Mr. Singhania, unleashes his power to protect Ruhi, exposing her family's fraud and abuse against her, and orchestrating the downfall of his manipulative ex-wife and her accomplice for past deceptions. He becomes an unexpected ally for Rohit, punishing his tormentors and helping him seek justice. The narrative culminates with Aditya proposing to Ruhi, disclosing his past as a divorcee with an estranged daughter, Myra. The poignant reunion of Myra with her long-searching mother, Rohini, brings a sense of completion to Aditya's family, resolving intertwined sagas of hidden identities, class conflict, and the search for belonging.

my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-5.title: My Call Boy Billionaire Daddy
my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-5.description: Ines's life is irrevocably shattered on her engagement day by her fiancé's betrayal, swiftly followed by her CEO father's suicide, corporate ruin, public disgrace, and an unexpected pregnancy. Driven by a fierce vow of revenge, her initial quest for retribution against her deceiver quickly transforms into a desperate fight for survival and her child's future amidst overwhelming odds. She navigates a treacherous corporate world, facing a vengeful ex-colleague, Bob, who orchestrates her public humiliation and financial ruin, even attempting murder. Simultaneously, Ines confronts a wealthy and powerful figure, often referred to as the "Hot Cowboy," Arjun, Lewis, or Mr. Richmond, whom she blames for her past downfall and demands responsibility for her son, Charlie. This complex figure becomes both a tormentor and an unexpected protector, ensnaring Ines in binding contracts and secretly investigating her son's paternity. As Ines rises from a humiliated cleaner to a formidable heiress and "Boss," she uncovers a deeper conspiracy surrounding a mysterious "chip" and her father's suspicious death, which she believes was murder. Her son, Charlie, unknowingly holds a vital clue to this "chip," making him a target. Ines engages in complex power struggles, using transactional relationships and even a fake boyfriend ruse with Mr. Richmond to escape threats, though these deceptions take an emotional toll, leading to vows of revenge against him. She fiercely defends her child's paternity and seeks justice for her stolen inheritance, confronting manipulative family members and powerful adversaries. The narrative explores her relentless determination to expose hidden truths, reclaim her fortune, and secure her son's future against a backdrop of corporate intrigue, past betrayals, and dangerous alliances, all while battling a web of powerful enemies and a looming, dangerous conspiracy.

kho-gaye-hum-kahan.title: Kho Gaye Hum Kahan
kho-gaye-hum-kahan.description:
Alia Kapoor, ek self-made jewellery store worker hai, jo apne khoye hue bachpan aur toote rishton ke dard ke saath jeeti hai. Karan Oberoi, ek ameer businessman, apni asli pehchaan chhupa kar rehta hai. Dono ki mulaqat hoti hai ek jhoothi blind date par, jahan Karan ke do chhote bache — Ayan aur Kiyan, Alia ko apni maa bana dete hain.

Ek jhooth se shuru hui shaadi, ek chhupi hui identity, aur beete hue raaz — sab kuch ulat jaata hai jab sach saamne aata hai. Lekin jab Ira — Karan ki obsessed purani chaahat — Alia ke maa banne ke sach ko nishana banati hai, tab shuru hoti hai ek maa ki asli jung.

say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-2.title: Say I Love You When We Meet Again
say-i-love-you-when-we-meet-again-2.description: Say I Love You When We Meet Again - The show tells the story of two lovers torn apart by fate, only to reunite years later with unresolved feelings and painful secrets. As they face their past, they must decide if love deserves a second chance.

contract-saiyaan.title: My Disabled CEO Husband
contract-saiyaan.description: Vidhi, a spirited woman shackled by secrets, finds herself trapped in a marriage of convenience with Varun Acharya, a wheelchair-bound billionaire hiding a devastating truth. What begins as a deal for survival turns into a storm of betrayal, revenge, and rediscovered strength as Vidhi battles manipulative relatives, buried pasts, and her own heart — only to rise as the unlikely pillar behind an empire. Watch Now!

pyaar-aur-fareb-1.title: Pyaar Aur Fareb
pyaar-aur-fareb-1.description: আর্কিটেক্ট আরোহী তার এনগেজমেন্টের দিনেই বড় ধাক্কা খায়! ঠিক সেই সময়ে এক অজানা লোকের সাথে দেখা হয় তার। অজ্ঞাত সেই ব্যক্তি তাকে নতুন করে সব কিছু শুরু করার প্রতিশ্রুতি দেয়। যদিও সেই নতুন জীবনের কিছু শর্ত আরোহীর উপরে চাপিয়ে দেওয়া হয়। সেখান থেকেই বেরিয়ে আসতে থাকে কিছু লুকনো সত্য, আরোহী জড়িয়ে পড়তে থাকে ভালোবাসা আর মিথ্যার জালে। রোমাঞ্চকর হয়ে ওঠে আরোহীর জীবন আর যাপন। আচম্বিতে সব কিছু যেন বদলেও যেতে থাকে।

crorepati-electrician.title: Crorepati Electrician
crorepati-electrician.description: When Rasha breaks off her engagement and impulsively marries Nakul overnight, she finds herself bound to a powerful CEO whose world of wealth, secrets, and control changes her life forever. Watch Now!

romance-with-my-vampire-brother-5.title: Romance with My Vampire Brother
romance-with-my-vampire-brother-5.description: ఓ గ్రాడ్యుయేట్ యువతి, తన ప్రియుడి ద్రోహాన్ని తెలుసుకొని బాధలో ఉంటుంటే, ఆమె కొత్తగా చేరిన కంపెనీలో ఒక గంభీరమైన,  CEOని కలుస్తుంది — అతను ఆమె బాస్ మాత్రమే కాక, ఆమె స్టెప్‌ఫాదర్‌ కుమారుడూ. అపార్థాలు, కార్యాలయ ఘర్షణల మధ్య, వాళ్లిద్దరి మధ్య నిషేధితమైన ప్రేమ తలెత్తుతుంది... ఇది మోసంతో ముడిపడిన అనుచిత సంబంధం.

adhuri-yaadein.title: Adhuri Yaadein
adhuri-yaadein.description: Meera, a resilient woman with a mysterious past, and Kunal, a powerful businessman torn between logic and destiny. When twin children appear with an uncanny connection to Meera, a chain of emotional upheavals, hidden truths, and shifting loyalties unfolds. As family secrets unravel and trust is tested, Meera and Kunal must confront their pasts to protect their future.

waiting-for-love-1.title: Waiting for Love ❤️
waiting-for-love-1.description: Love will happen at any time, Singhania waiting for his love. Did he meet his love ?

every-holiday-i-miss-my-wife.title: Every Holiday I Miss My Wife
every-holiday-i-miss-my-wife.description:
ప్రతి పండుగ రోజు, ఒక వ్యక్తి తన భార్యను తలుచుకుంటూ ఓకటిగా కన్నీటి నీడలో జీవిస్తాడు.
తన చుట్టూ పండుగ సందడి ఉండగా, అతడి హృదయంలో మాత్రం కోల్పోయిన ప్రేమ గాయం మిగిలి ఉంటుంది.

the-boy-who-beat-the-board.title: The Boy Who Beat The Board
the-boy-who-beat-the-board.description: When chess grandmaster Mukesh Tandon dies tragically in a plane crash, his soul awakens in the body of a 13-year-old boy, Mukul. As he navigates a second life, Mukul reunites with his grieving wife Juhi, battles rival prodigies like Vikram and Zakir, and faces dark conspiracies from Kiara and King. With unmatched strategy and an unbreakable will, Mukul fights to reclaim his legacy and protect Juhi, proving that genius and love can transcend even death. Watch Now!

blossoms-2003-1.title: Blossoms 2003
blossoms-2003-1.description: A young girl struggles with the guilt of her father's mistakes that caused her mother's death, caught between love, cruelty, and responsibilities. The tragic events and forced circumstances in her life ultimately lead her to a profound emotional turning point.

return-of-the-missing-son.title: Return of the Missing Son
return-of-the-missing-son.description: A shattered empire. A fallen prince. A name erased from history—until vengeance breathes life into forgotten embers. Dive into a tale of power, betrayal, and one man's fight to reclaim his destiny. Watch Now !

secret-baby-1.title: Secret Baby
secret-baby-1.description: Leena, working as the secretary to Sameer Singhlania under a secret identity, is deeply in love with him. When the company faces a cyber attack, she takes matters into her own hands, secretly handling the crisis while disguised as Dr. Sen. But her world shatters when she learns of Sameer’s engagement to Maya Agarwal, leaving her torn and awestruck by the unexpected turn of events.

hidden-love-surges.title: Hidden Love Surges
hidden-love-surges.description: ఒక యువతి… తాను మనసు పెట్టి ఎంతగా ప్రేమించిన మనిషి మరో అమ్మాయిని పెళ్లి చేసుకోవడానికి సిద్ధంగా ఉన్నాడన్న నిజాన్ని తెలుసుకుంటుంది. ఈ వేదనను తట్టుకోలేక, తాను ఎప్పటికీ చెప్పలేకపోయిన ప్రేమను చివరిసారిగా బయటపెట్టాలని అనుకుంటుంది. అంతే… ఆమె ఆపకుండా తన మనస్సులోని భయాల్ని తొలగించి, అతని పెళ్లికే చేరుతుంది. మంగళవాయిద్యాలు వినిపిస్తున్న వేళ, ఆ సందడి మధ్యలో… ఆమె అతని ముందు నిలబడి, తన గుండె లోతుల్లో దాచిన ప్రేమను ఉప్పొంగిస్తూ చెబుతుంది. ఇది ఆమె చివరి ప్రయత్నం… ఒక్కసారైనా అతని హృదయాన్ని తాకేందుకు, తన ప్రేమను తిరిగి గెలుచుకునేందుకు వేసిన ఒక చివరి ప్రయాణం.

secret-baby-2.title: Secret Baby
secret-baby-2.description: Leena, working as the secretary to CEO Sameer under a secret identity, is deeply in love with him. When the company faces a cyber attack, she takes matters into her own hands, secretly handling the crisis. But her world shatters when she learns of Sameer’s engagement to Maya, leaving her torn and awestruck by the unexpected turn of events.

contract-love-1.title: Contract Love
contract-love-1.description:
Mohini and Karan Walia are two ambitious individuals who both want control of their family businesses. But there’s one condition standing in their way, their parents have made it clear that they’ll only hand over the business if they get married. To solve the problem, Mohini and Karan decide to fake a marriage.
Mohini thinks Karan is just a sweet, struggling waiter. What she doesn’t know is that he’s actually a billionaire. Karan hides his real identity because he knows Mohini hates rich, arrogant men, and he doesn’t want to ruin the connection they’re building. As they live together pretending to be husband and wife, things start getting complicated. Karan’s friend and Mohini’s stepsister both try to break them apart. But despite everything, Mohini and Karan begin to grow closer, and eventually, they fall in love for real. In the end, what started as a lie turns into something true, and their fake marriage becomes the beginning of a real one.

dangerous-in-laws.title: Dangerous In-Laws
dangerous-in-laws.description: What happens when loving in-laws turn into your worst nightmare? A luxurious vacation becomes a trap, where status games, identity theft, and abuse collide. This isn't just a family drama—it’s a fight for survival. Watch Now!

my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-4.title: My Call Boy Billionaire Daddy
my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-4.description: నాలుగు సంవత్సరాల క్రితం పరారైన తర్వాత, ఒక తల్లి తన కొడుకుతో తిరిగి వస్తుంది—పగ తీర్చుకోవాలన్న సంకల్పంతో. స్కై క్లబ్‌లో, గతంలో తనను మోసగించిన ఒక ఎస్కార్ట్‌ను ఎదిరించి, అతనిని బాకీ తీర్చమని గట్టిగా నిలదీస్తుంది. ఇదిలా ఉండగా, ఆమె CEO తనకు తెలియని ఒక రహస్యంపై ఆధారపడి, నిశ్శబ్దంగా బదులు మొదలుపెడతాడు.

rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-1.title: Rebirth : My Cheat Code Life
rebirth-my-cheat-code-life-1.description: After a bitter divorce, a once-submissive wife rises from the ashes—crushing enemies and shocking the elite world with her fearless power. But her ex-husband soon realizes… letting her go was the biggest mistake of his life.

taken-by-the-mafia.title: Taken by the Mafia
taken-by-the-mafia.description: Simran Sharma’s life is turned upside down when her father’s hidden debts force her into the grasp of mafia boss Rudra Singh, who claims her as collateral. As she’s pulled into his dark world, a dangerous power struggle unfolds — only to reveal Rudra’s true identity as an undercover agent entangled in a much deeper conspiracy.

married-but-available-perfume-and-moon-4.title: Married But Available: Perfume and Moon
married-but-available-perfume-and-moon-4.description: ఒక యువతి తన కుటుంబాన్ని రక్షించేందుకు ఓ అజ్ఞాత వ్యక్తిని వివాహం చేసుకుంటుంది. తర్వాత తెలిసేది ఏమిటంటే, అతను ప్రాణాంతక శత్రువులు కల శక్తివంతమైన CEO. కథ లోతులోకి వెళ్తే, ఆమెలో నిద్రిస్తున్న వెర్ వోల్ఫ్ లక్షణాలు మేల్కొంటాయి — మరెన్నో అంతు చిక్కని రహస్యాలు తెలుస్తాయి.

saviour-piya.title: Saviour Piya
saviour-piya.description: Desperate to save her critically ill mother, Jia is coerced into a contract marriage with Hiten Shah, the enigmatic "illegitimate son" of a powerful empire, by her manipulative stepmother. This union is a pawn in a ruthless "game plan" orchestrated by Hiten's domineering matriarch, involving corporate intrigue and a dark revenge plot. Jia faces immediate humiliation and tyrannical duties within her new household, questioning Hiten's true identity amidst his gentle demeanor and notorious past. Despite the initial transactional nature, their relationship evolves as Hiten displays both possessiveness and fierce protectiveness, sparking a complex romance. Jia, yearning for independence, attempts to forge a career, only to uncover massive financial fraud at her firm and a dangerous corporate conspiracy involving Hiten's family. A global pandemic further complicates matters, as businessman Mukesh Shah schemes to launch a fraudulent vaccine, which Hiten and Dr. Sushant race to counter. The return of Jia's half-sister, Aliya, ignites a dangerous rivalry, as Aliya allies with Mrs. Mugdhashah to remove Jia from Hiten's life. Simultaneously, Jia discovers a hidden connection between her father and Hiten's father, revealing a deep-seated corporate fraud that implicates both their families. Hiten, revealed to be orchestrating a clandestine operation, works to expose his uncle Mukesh and Goverdhan, who framed his father a decade ago for criminal negligence regarding a deadly vaccine. As Jia acts as a mole, sabotaging Mukesh's operations, Hiten dramatically reveals himself as the true chairman, presenting irrefutable evidence against his corrupt relatives. He completes a corporate takeover, expelling Mukesh and Goverdhan, and appoints Jia as CFO. Their contract marriage transforms into a profound love and an unbreakable alliance, with Jia teaching Hiten the value of connection over vengeance. Together, they embark on a global vaccine distribution mission, committed to absolute transparency, even as Mukesh and Govardhan vow revenge.

dabangg-damad.title: Dabangg Damad
dabangg-damad.description: ছাপোষা এক গ্রামের ছেলে হঠাৎ করেই এক বিশাল কোম্পানির সিইও হয়ে যায়। সবাই তার পরিচয় নিয়ে সন্দিহান, এমনকি তার নিজের পরিবারও তার বিরুদ্ধে চলে যায়—আর মিথ্যাচারের এক জাল তাকে ও তার সংগঠনকে ধ্বংসের পথে ঠেলে দেয়। কিন্তু তার আছে সম্মান, অন্য বহু মানুষের নিঃস্বার্থ ভালোবাসা, আর এক গোপন অস্ত্র। এই সব নিয়েই সে লড়ে যাবে—নিজের মর্যাদা ফিরে পেতে এবং আসল কেলেঙ্কারির পর্দা ফাঁস করতে।

time-travel-4.title: Time Travel
time-travel-4.description: The microdrama centers on Rahul Singhania, a man whose life is upended by betrayal and class conflict, leading to his family's financial ruin and his mother's critical illness. Initially, he faces a deceptive arranged marriage orchestrated by Vidya and the vengeful Chetan, who obstructs his mother's medical treatment and demands a horrifying price from his sister, Latika. Rahul, possessing uncanny precognitive and astrological abilities, begins to navigate a complex world of corporate intrigue and personal vendettas. He forms a crucial alliance with the enigmatic businesswoman Alya Agnihotri, who challenges Chetan's authority and becomes a romantic interest. Together, they establish a real estate and steel business, leveraging Rahul's foresight for audacious investments. However, Rahul's rise attracts the obsessive Pankaj Ramvilas, a ruthless rival from his past who aggressively pursues Alya and attempts hostile corporate takeovers. Rahul is framed for bribery and arrested, igniting a war against the corrupt Ram Vilas family. His journey is further complicated by unreliable memories from a "punar janam," hinting at a deeper mission to expose Chetan's master plan. Rahul strategically uses his insights and compassion, even towards Pankaj's enforcer Shera, to protect his loved ones and dismantle criminal enterprises. As the corporate battles intensify, Rahul faces accusations of fraud and blackmail, while his family is plunged into crisis. A corporate takeover plan involves a forced marriage proposal to Alya, and Latika is held hostage by Pankaj. Rahul manipulates a rushed wedding to Alia to seize control of the Royal Group, only for his own wedding to be interrupted by an ex-lover accusing him of kidnapping. Ultimately, Rahul, now CEO of Royal Group, finds himself blackmailed by Pankaj and Ramvilas, who hold his parents captive, demanding his resignation, while Pankaj himself faces a formidable, bloodthirsty antagonist.

come-home-our-heart-4.title: Come Home, Our Heart
come-home-our-heart-4.description: The microdrama begins with the tragic separation of young Julie from her mother, who desired sons, leaving Julie to endure a childhood of severe abuse under a tyrannical stepfather. Sixteen years later, a desperate search for Julie ignites hope with sightings of a girl bearing a distinctive charm and scar, while parallel narratives expose Joel's deceptive life, leading to a forced marriage and betrayal. Julie herself is violently coerced into a contract marriage, desperately fighting for freedom amidst Joel's reappearance and mysterious interventions. Her struggle intensifies as she faces exploitation, public humiliation, and false accusations, even being disowned by her adoptive parents who reveal she was 'bought as a child.' Powerful figures like CEO Suvin and Mr. Frey begin to suspect her true identity, hinting at a deeper family mystery. The narrative then introduces an ambitious imposter, Jia, who infiltrates a wealthy family, usurping Julie's identity and plotting to seize the family fortune. Julie battles relentlessly to expose this deceit, enduring blackmail, physical assaults, and being framed for theft, while her identity is constantly questioned. Her brothers, Kevin and Chris, initially suspicious, gradually become allies in her fight to prove she is the true daughter. As the rightful heiress, Julie is initially outcast and branded a liar, but she systematically exposes Jia's elaborate charade, leading to the imposter's banishment and a tearful reconciliation with her mother. Julie reluctantly joins the family company, facing prejudice and corporate sabotage due to her past as a 'servant,' yet she is unexpectedly protected by senior executives who recognize her mysterious importance. Her true identity as the privileged daughter of influential Brice is dramatically revealed, setting the stage for a fierce social and corporate rivalry with Jia. She is consistently vindicated against accusations of corporate theft and deception by the powerful CEO, Mr. Frey, who fiercely defends her. The series culminates with Julie's mother, Amma, publicly naming Julie as the true heir, exposing and banishing the imposter. Julie reclaims her authority, confronting her estranged ex-husband and father about past betrayals, and faces new threats from vengeful paternal relatives, but finds protection and justice, hinting at a quest for a sacred family heirloom.

love-ignition.title: Love Ignition
love-ignition.description: She married for duty. He stayed for guilt. But when the truth erupts, who will survive the fire? Love Ignition is a gripping tale of heartbreak, betrayal, and second chances. Watch Now !

phoenix-rising-5.title: Phoenix Rising
phoenix-rising-5.description: Phoenix Rising - After years in a mysterious slumber, she awakens to a world she no longer recognizes. Memories of betrayal and love slowly return as she searches for the truth. Phoenix Rising is the story of a woman reborn, ready to face those who once destroyed her.

my-tycoon-husband-spoils-me-5.title: My Tycoon Husband Spoils Me
my-tycoon-husband-spoils-me-5.description: সে সিইওর স্ত্রী, কিন্তু এক রাতের জন্য প্রেমে পড়ে সে জানতে পারে, তার সেই অচেনা প্রানপ্রিয় ব্যক্তি হচ্ছেন তার স্বামী—যাকে সে তিন বছরের দাম্পত্যে একবারও দেখেনি। পরদিন সকালে ঘুম থেকে যখন সে জেগে ওঠে, স্বামী তাকে একেবারেই চিনতে পারেনি এবং মুহূর্তেই ডিভোর্স চেয়ে বসে।

Abhi Dekhna Shuru Karein aur Bhagwan Ram Ki bhakti mein leen Ho Jaaiye. Watch Now!

silent-power-2.description: When legendary CEO Dhruv Kapoor takes over a powerful group and plans to invest in agriculture in his small hometown, he must navigate corporate rivalries, hidden agendas, and personal wounds as he fights to fulfill his vision and reunite with his estranged family.

Will Anjali’s new identity save her or destroy everyone around her? Watch Now!

cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-1.title: Cloaked in Power: His Secret Identity
cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-1.description: He is no ordinary man; he has a mysterious past where he had superpower. But in the daily life he wishes to live an ordinary life as a driver. He accidentally meets a beautiful woman, a CEO, and that eventually leads to a one nightstand, leading towards thrilling twists and turns.

losing-my-virginity-2.title: Losing my virginity
losing-my-virginity-2.description: The microdrama centers on Roohi, a woman forced into a life of deception and servitude under the powerful Mrs. Chawla, initially to save her ailing mother. Roohi finds herself entangled with Aditya, a wealthy heir, and Alisha, both claiming pregnancy with Aditya's child, though Roohi's past with him is shrouded in mystery. Blackmailed into a contract marriage with Aditya to save her critically ill mother, Roohi struggles with a hidden identity while Aditya, despite his arranged marriage to Alisha, develops an undeniable connection with her. Their fragile bond is challenged by escalating conflicts, including Alisha's relentless torment and claims of being Aditya's wife. A shocking revelation unveils that Alisha is Roohi's twin sister, given away at birth due to the manipulative Chawla family and their mother's tragic past, unraveling a complex web of deceit. Roohi's mother tragically dies after Alisha cruelly demands Aditya, then Roohi's unborn child, as the price for a kidney. In a desperate act, Aditya sacrifices his entire company to the Chawla family, vowing revenge for the loss. A scandalous public fake marriage between Aditya and Roohi, orchestrated to save his career, is dramatically exposed by Alisha, who accuses Roohi of theft and forced abortion. Aditya then orchestrates Mrs. Chawla's corporate downfall and arrest, revealing hidden clauses in the company transfer. Roohi uncovers a shocking paternity betrayal, revealing Alisha's daughter is not Aditya's, and hints at deeper family secrets, including past sexual violence against her mother. Alisha publicly confesses to a pregnancy with the family butler and issues chilling threats, further complicating the web of deceit. In a high-stakes legal battle, Roohi, empowered by Aditya, confronts Alisha and Alekhya, accusing them of conspiracy and past crimes. Alisha ultimately abandons her newborn child. The series concludes with Roohi and Aditya deciding to raise both their own child and Alisha's abandoned baby together, hinting at a mysterious past connection that binds them all.

ormakkurippukal-ajitha.title: ഓര്‍മ്മക്കുറിപ്പുകള്‍ - അജിത
ormakkurippukal-ajitha.description: 1960-70കളിൽ ഇന്ത്യയിൽ വിപ്ലവത്തിൻ്റെ ഇടിമുഴക്കം തീർത്ത  പ്രസ്ഥാനമാണു നക്സൽബാരി. നക്സല്‍ എന്ന വാക്ക് കേള്‍ക്കുമ്പോള്‍ മലയാളിയുടെ മനസിലെത്തുന്ന പേരാണ് അജിത. അവരുടെ കനല്‍ച്ചൂടുള്ള ഓര്‍മ്മകള്‍ പങ്കുവെക്കുന്ന വിഖ്യാത രചന.

सफलता-के-9-Common-Principles.title: सफलता के 9 Common Principles
सफलता-के-9-Common-Principles.description: Aapko success kyun nahi mil pa rahi pata hai? Kyunki usko achieve karne ke process ko bahut complicated bana kar rakha hai. Jabki ye toh ekdam simple hai. Bas is show mein bataye gaye in 9 principles ko Samajh kar, Apni life mein apply kar do.

attupokatha-ormakal.title: അറ്റുപോകാത്ത ഓര്‍മ്മകള്‍
attupokatha-ormakal.description: മതമൗലികവാദികളാല്‍ കൈപ്പത്തി മുറിച്ചുമാറ്റപ്പെട്ട ഒരു അധ്യാപകന്റെ അറ്റുപോകാത്ത ഓര്‍മ്മകളാണീ പുസ്തകം. സമാനതകളില്ലാത്ത തീക്ഷ്ണമായ അനുഭവങ്ങള്‍ നമ്മെയും പൊളളിക്കും.

meesa.title: മീശ
meesa.description: കേരള സമൂഹത്തില്‍ വിവാദത്തിന്റെ തീക്കനലുകള്‍ കോരിയിട്ട നോവല്‍. എതിര്‍പ്പുകള്‍ക്കിടയിലും ആസ്വാദക പ്രശംസ പിടിച്ചു പറ്റിയ എസ്. ഹരീഷിന്റെ ആദ്യ നോവല്‍. കേള്‍ക്കാം മീശ.

election-effect-on-the-stock-market.title: Election Effect on the Stock Market
election-effect-on-the-stock-market.description: Kya aap jante hain ki elections ka Indian Stock Market par kya asar padta hai? Historical trends aur expert analysis ke saath, hum batayenge ki kaise aap is knowledge ko apne investment decisions mein laa sakte hain. Suniye hamara exclusive show aur sikhiye ki elections ke dauran kaunse sectors mein investment karke aap apni wealth ko multiply kar sakte hain. Aaiye, samjhe aur ameer bane!

chemmeen.title: ചെമ്മീന്‍
chemmeen.description: മലയാളി എക്കാലവും താലോലിക്കുന്ന ക്ലാസിക്. കറുത്തമ്മയെയും പരീക്കുട്ടിയെയും അറിയാത്ത മലയാളിയില്ല എന്ന് തന്നെ പറയാം. പ്രണയത്തിനും വിരഹത്തിനും പുതിയ ഭാവുകത്വം സമ്മാനിച്ച തകഴിയുടെ ചെമ്മീന്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം..

pon-magal-vanthaal-latha-saravanan.title: Pon Magal Vanthaal
pon-magal-vanthaal-latha-saravanan.description: Industrialist sivaramanuku rendu family! abi nu oru ponnum irukka! intha vishiyam vaarisu illatha muthal manaivi mohini ku theriyathu! vishiyam theriyum munne sivaraman  kolla paduraru! avar saavu la periya marmam ezhuthu!  antha marmatha kandupidikka kathai kulla vara pon magal! yaaru antha pon magal? yaaru sivaramana konnathu? Ragasiya maga abi enna aana?

mastery-of-self-for-wealth-power-and-suc.title: Mastery of Self for Wealth, Power and Success
mastery-of-self-for-wealth-power-and-suc.description: Apne aap ko master karna seekho, aur zindagi mein wealth, power, aur success ko attract karein. Is audio show mein, hum explore karenge law of magnetism ke through kaise aap apne life goals ko achieve kar sakte hain. Agar aap bhi chahte hain life mein bade changes, toh ye show aapke liye hai. Suniye abhi!

meluhayile-chiranjeevikal.title: മെലൂഹയിലെ ചിരഞ്ജീവികൾ
meluhayile-chiranjeevikal.description: ഇന്ത്യയിൽ ഉടനീളം തരംഗം സൃഷ്‌ടിച്ച അമീഷിന്റെ  പ്രശസ്തമായ കഥ നിങ്ങൾക്കായി അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു Kuku FM. ഇതിഹാസം ഈശ്വരനാക്കി മാറ്റിയ ശിവൻ എന്ന മഹാപുരുഷന്റെ വിസ്മയ കഥ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് മറക്കാനാവാത്ത ഒരു അനുഭവം സമ്മാനിക്കും!

evms-vs-ballot-paper-5.title: EVM Vs Ballot
evms-vs-ballot-paper-5.description: EVM aur Ballot Paper ke beech jung barso se chali aa rahi hai. Har baar opposition wale EVM hack hone ka hi bahana karte hain. Par kya sach mein EVM hack ho sakti hai? Kya satta mein baithi party EVM control karti hai? Kya hai EVM ki kahani? Janne ke liye sunein, EVM Vs Ballot...

oru-deshathinte-katha.title: ഒരു ദേശത്തിന്റെ കഥ
oru-deshathinte-katha.description: ജ്ഞാനപീഠവും കേന്ദ്രസാഹിത്യ അക്കാദമി അവാർഡും ലഭിച്ച ഹൃദയഹാരിയായ ഒരു ക്ലാസിക്! എസ് കെ പൊറ്റക്കാട്ടിന്റെ അനുപമമായ രചനശൈലിയിലൂടെ അറിയാം അതിരാണിപ്പാടവും ജീവിതങ്ങളും.

bram-stokerinte-judjiyude-bhavanavum-mat.title: ബ്രാം സ്‌റ്റോക്കറിന്റെ ജഡ്ജിയുടെ ഭവനവും മറ്റ് ഭീകര കഥകളും
bram-stokerinte-judjiyude-bhavanavum-mat.description: രക്തമൂറ്റിക്കുടിക്കുന്ന ഡ്രാക്കുളയിലൂടെ പ്രേക്ഷകരെ വിറപ്പിച്ച ബ്രാംസ്റ്റോക്കറിന്റെ മറ്റൊരു ഭീകര കഥ കേള്‍ക്കാം. ഒപ്പം ആര്‍തര്‍ കോനന്‍ ഡോയല്‍, വാഷിങ്ടണ്‍ ഇര്‍വിങ്, എച്ച് ജി വെല്‍സ് തുടങ്ങിയ മഹാരഥന്മാരുടെ ഭീതി ജനിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കഥകളും.

rich-mindset-rich-life.title: Rich Mindset, Rich Life
rich-mindset-rich-life.description: Kya aap bhi sapnon ki ameeri ki zindagi jeena chahte hain? Lekin mehnat karne ke bawajood bhi manzil tak nahi pahunch pa rahe? Samasya kahin aapki strategy mein toh nahi? Hard work ke saath, smart work ki bhi zaroorat hoti hai, Lekin yeh smart work hai kya? Toh Iska Jawab aapko milega is Book Explanation mein, Toh abhi suniye aur karlijiye apna har sapna sakar.

francis-itticora.title: ഫ്രാൻസിസ് ഇട്ടിക്കോര
francis-itticora.description:
ടി.ഡി രാമകൃഷ്ണന്റെ അതിശയിപ്പിക്കുന്ന മിസ്റ്ററി ത്രില്ലർ! ചരിത്രവും മിത്തും ദുരൂഹതകളും കെട്ടുപിണഞ്ഞു കിടക്കുന്ന കഥാകാലം. അനുപമമായ ആഖ്യാനം.
കേരളത്തിന്റെ അറിയാത്ത ചരിത്രത്തിലേക്ക് ഇറങ്ങി ചെല്ലുന്ന ഫ്രാൻസിസ് ഇട്ടിക്കോര.

get-smart-4.title: Get Smart!
get-smart-4.description: Get Smart!: Success through smart thinking! 🧠🏆. Shift your thinking, unlock your potential. Wealth and creativity await! 🔄🔓🏆

maa-brahmacharini-bytes.title: Devi Brahmacharini
maa-brahmacharini-bytes.description: Suniye shakti ke doosre roop ka varnan jisne shiv bhakti aur shiv praapti ke liye kiya shaastron varsh ka kathor tap. Shiv tattva se juda Navdurga ka wahi swaroop jinki pooja navratri ke dusre din hoti hai, “Devi Brahmacharini”

aliens-anyagraha-jeevikal-sathyamo-mithy.title: ഏലിയന്‍സ്: അന്യഗ്രഹജീവികള്‍ സത്യമോ? മിഥ്യയോ?
aliens-anyagraha-jeevikal-sathyamo-mithy.description: ഭൂമിയെ ഏതാണ്ട് കാല്‍ച്ചുവട്ടിലാക്കി എന്ന് കരുതുന്ന മനുഷ്യന്  ഇപ്പോഴും പിടിതരാത്ത അനേകം രഹസ്യങ്ങളുടെ കലവറയാണ് ഈ പ്രപഞ്ചം. ഭൂമിക്ക് പുറത്ത് ജീവനുണ്ടോ എന്നത് ഇന്നും ദുരൂഹം. അന്യഗ്രഹജീവികളുടെ സാന്നിധ്യം ആരോപിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന സംഭവങ്ങൾ നമ്മുക്ക്  പരിശോധിക്കാം, ഏലിയൻസ് ഉണ്ടോ എന്നറിയാം.

kaathal-oruvanaik-kaippidiththen-latha-s.title: Kaathal Oruvanai Kaippidiththen
kaathal-oruvanaik-kaippidiththen-latha-s.description: Nila - Bharani rendu perum love senji kalyanam pannikaraanga. But, kalyaanaththukku aprama bharanikku love kuraiyuthu. Ithanala problems varuthu. Lovela jeyichavanga vaazhkaila jeyichangala?

im-a-killer.title: I'm A Killer
im-a-killer.description: Police station me macha harkamp, jab ek masoom si ladki ne confess kia apni maa ka murder. Kya sach me wo ek killer hai? Us Aurat ki jiski kabhi koi beti hi nahi thi? Janne ke liye sune ye suspenseful story- "I'm A Killer".

theeppidiththa-thendral-latha-sravanan.title: Theepiditha Thendral
theeppidiththa-thendral-latha-sravanan.description: விமலின் அப்பா இறந்துவிடுகிறார். போலீசார் அவனைக் கைது செய்கிறார்கள். அவனது சொத்துக்கள் முடக்கப்படுகின்றன. அனைத்துக்கும் காரணம் யார் என்று தேடினால் பதில் அவனது மனைவி என்று கிடைக்கிறது. விமலின் மனைவி ஏன் துரோகம் செய்தாள்???

scott-allan-se-paye-zindagi-mein-clarity.title: Scott Allan Se Paye Zindagi Mein Clarity
scott-allan-se-paye-zindagi-mein-clarity.description:
|Key Insights - Clarity, Focus, Success|
Zindagi mein kisi cheez ko haasil karne se pehle lagan aur mehnat se badhkar clarity ki zaroorat hoti hai. Agar aap apne goals ko lekar clear nahin hai, toh aapki har mehnat bekaar jaayegi. Isiliye success paane ki pehli seedi hai clarity. Aur is show mein aap jaanenge 5 aise technqiues jisse aap aasani is seedi ko chad kar apni kamyabi ko haasil kar paayenge.

how-not-to-spend-your-money-1.title: How Not To Spend Your Money?
how-not-to-spend-your-money-1.description: Panathai eppadilaam selavu panna koodathunu therinjukittale nammalaala athiga panathai save panna mudiyum. Ithai panrathu eppadinu therinjukka intha content ungalukku uthavum.

retire-with-10-crore-1.title: Retire With 10 Crore+
retire-with-10-crore-1.description: చిన్న వయసులోనే రిటైర్మెంట్ తీసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? రిటైర్మెంట్ తర్వాత అవసరమయ్యే డబ్బులు ఎలా సిద్ధం చేసుకోవాలో తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా ? అయితే వినండి " రిటైర్ విత్ 10 క్రోర్ ప్లస్ " అనే కుకు ఎఫ్ఎమ్ బైట్స్ ని.

modi-vs-democracy.title: Modi VS Democracy
modi-vs-democracy.description: Modi sarkar ki image hamesha se autocratic rahi hai. Aise mein kayi logo ka manna hai ki ye ek healthy democracy ke liye sahi nahi hai. Par BJP ka stand hai ki aaj free speech ko jyada jagah milti hai bajay Congress Govt. ke. To kya hai sach? Janne ke liye sunein Modi Vs Democracy...

mithran.title: Mitran
mithran.description: Koodangulam, kalpaakkaththula nadantha anu ulai vedippunaala Tamilnade azhinji pochi. Antha vibaththa thaduththu niruththa Time travel senji kadantha kaalaththukku vara Neha. Avalala anu ulai vedippa thadukka mudinjitha?

ithayaththai-thirudathe.title: Ithayaththai Thirudathe
ithayaththai-thirudathe.description: IIT la padichi periya velaila irukravan ravi kumar. Avanukku 10th padicha ponna paarthu katti vachidaraanga. Avanukku avanoda wife ah suththama pudikkala. Avungaloda life enna aachu?

maharana-pratap-haldighati-kuku-bytes.title: The Legend Of Maharana Pratap
maharana-pratap-haldighati-kuku-bytes.description: Haldighati ke maidan mein Mahrana Pratap ki sena haari to zaroor par Akbar unhe kabhi pakad nahi paya. Phir kaise wapas mila Pratap ko unka rajya? Aur kyon unki maut par roya Akbar bhi? Aaiye sunte hain is short byte mein.

7-mindsets-for-success-happiness-and-ful.title: 7 Mindsets For Success, Happiness And Fulfilment
7-mindsets-for-success-happiness-and-ful.description: Intha 7 manthirathai follow pannunaa unga life la neenga kandippa success ah paakalaam. Vaanga antha 7 manthirathai therinjukalaam.

khasakkinte-ithihasam.title: ഖസാക്കിന്റെ ഇതിഹാസം
khasakkinte-ithihasam.description: ഓരോ മലയാളിയും കേട്ടിരിക്കേണ്ട മലയാളസാഹിത്യത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും മികച്ച ക്ലാസിക് നിങ്ങൾക്കായി അവതരിക്കുന്നു Kuku FM!   കേൾക്കാം, ഓ.വി വിജയൻറെ ഖസാക്കിന്റെ ഇതിഹാസം!

criminals-in-election-1.title: Criminals : At 2024 Election
criminals-in-election-1.description: Kya aapke shahar ke political neta Criminal bhi hain? Janana chahte hain un netaon ke bare mein jinka hai apraadh ki duniya mein bada naam? To abhi suniye Kuku FM ki ye shandaar peshkash "Criminals : At 2024 Election".

grow-rich-with-peace-of-mind-4.title: Grow Rich! With Peace of Mind
grow-rich-with-peace-of-mind-4.description: తెలివిగా ఖర్చు చేసే అలవాటును ఎలా పెంపొందించుకోవాలి ? ఆర్థిక లక్ష్యాలు మరియు మానసిక శాంతి గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే వినండి " గ్రో రిచ్! విత్ పీస్ ఆఫ్ మైండ్ " అనే కుకు ఎఫ్ఎమ్ బైట్స్ ని.

law-of-success-4.title: Law of Success
law-of-success-4.description: విజయ రహస్యాలు మరియు గోల్డెన్ రూల్స్ గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? "లా ఆఫ్ సక్సెస్" అంటే ఏమిటి అని తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా ? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా ఈ కుకు ఎఫ్ఎమ్ బైట్స్ ని వినండి.

maa-shailputri-bytes.title: Devi Shailaputri
maa-shailputri-bytes.description: Suniye  shakti ke uss roop ka varnan jisne sansaar ke uddhaar aur Mahadev ke liye , liya ek Naya janam. Navdurga ka wahi swaroop jinki pooja Navratri ke pehle din hoti hai. "Devi Shailaputri".

sigma-male-mindset-4.title: Sigma Male Mindset
sigma-male-mindset-4.description: సిగ్మా మేల్ అంటే ఏమిటి ? సిగ్మా మేల్ ఆలోచనా విధానం మరియు వ్యక్తిత్వం గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా " సిగ్మా మేల్ మైండ్‌సెట్ "అనే కుకు ఎఫ్ఎమ్ బైట్స్ ని వినండి.

the-legend-of-amrapali.title: The Legend Of Amrapali
