cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-2.title: Cloaked in Power: His Secret Identity
cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity-2.description: The show is built around overlapping conflicts of class, family honor, hidden relationships, and public humiliation. One thread begins with Sham in a fantasy battlefield, where he defeats an invading force and then tries to leave war behind for a quieter city life. In the modern world, however, he keeps getting pulled into trouble, from rescuing a mysterious Madam to clashing with bosses, guards, and powerful families. Another major thread follows Regina, whose private life becomes a public scandal as she struggles to hide a past marriage and survive pressure from hostile relatives and elite circles. Her connection to Suriya and later to Michael is repeatedly framed by others as a matter of status, obedience, and family reputation rather than personal choice. Across the story, drivers and workers are mocked as disposable, yet they keep demanding wages, dignity, and the right to speak back. Shyam repeatedly refuses to accept humiliation, whether he is being fired, denied entry, or ordered to stay away from women he cares about. His confrontations with Michael become a central rivalry, with apologies, threats, proposals, and public insults all feeding the tension. Regina is caught between protection and control, as men around her promise safety while also trying to decide her future for her. Family elders and matriarchs intensify the pressure by invoking honor, arranged marriage, and obedience, often turning private matters into public punishment. Several women are also shamed or struck when rumors, videos, or overnight misunderstandings spread through their families. The story keeps widening from domestic arguments into business disputes, legal pressure, and even violent chases and armed attacks. In those larger conflicts, hidden alliances and secret arrangements are revealed only in fragments, leaving motives uncertain and trust fragile. Shyam’s hidden past as a fighter or soldier is eventually exposed, but he still insists on remaining an ordinary protector rather than a celebrated hero. Leo emerges as another major force of control, tied to business power, family pressure, and escalating violence. Even when characters briefly find safety, a call, a rumor, or a new confrontation quickly breaks the peace again. By the end of the batch material, no one has fully escaped the web of class conflict, family control, and unresolved love.

adhure-se-hum.title: Adhure se Hum
adhure-se-hum.description: The microdrama centers on Dr. Meher, a woman burdened by debt, who is coerced into a secret contract marriage with the wealthy and obsessive Aarav to care for his ailing mother. Her early success in curing his mother prematurely ends their arrangement, plunging Meher into financial distress. To secure income, Meher, with her friend Saba's help, assumes a false identity as a tutor, leading her back into Aarav's orbit, who, initially, does not recognize her. This deception becomes increasingly complex as Meher, now working for Aarav under an alias, finds herself trapped by a massive contract penalty, making divorce financially ruinous. Aarav, however, is inexplicably drawn to her, sensing a forgotten connection, and begins to investigate her. Meher's dual identity as a doctor and a teacher, along with her shifting name (Saba/Meher), creates confusion and suspicion among those around her, including protective figures like Raj and students like Shaan and Ishan. Corporate intrigue and personal betrayals further complicate the narrative, as Aarav's manipulative nature is revealed through his interactions with employees and friends. The secret of Aarav and Meher's contract marriage gradually comes to light, adding layers of tension and danger to Meher's precarious situation. As the web of deceit unravels, Meher is caught in compromising situations, and her true past identity is exposed. She eventually vanishes, prompting Aarav to embark on a desperate quest to find her, driven by a desire to understand their shared history and untangle the misunderstandings. During his search, Aarav confronts his estranged wife, Nina, who attempts to frame him, further complicating his efforts. Ultimately, Aarav reveals a profound secret about Meher's past and confesses his enduring love. The series culminates in the reunion of Aarav, Meher, and Shaan, with Aarav proposing to Dr. Meher, who accepts, solidifying their modern family unit as Shaan joyfully accepts Meher as his mother.

the-substitute-bride-unveiling-her-count.title: The Substitute Bride: Unveiling Her Countless Secrets
the-substitute-bride-unveiling-her-count.description: Sujun, a spirited disciple with ancient magical powers, leaves her mountain sanctuary to navigate modern society, while powerful CEO Luke, confined to a wheelchair, seeks vengeance against a rival family. His grandmother's public quest for a new bride leads to Sujun, his actual wife, discovering the bizarre situation and deciding to claim the promised fortune. Luke publicly annuls his engagement and forces a transactional marriage with Sujun, who secretly begins treating his incurable leg injury as the legendary "medicine goddess" his aide seeks. Despite initial clashes and strict marital rules, Sujun's unconventional methods restore sensation and movement to Luke's legs, though his condition later worsens, necessitating a desperate search for the elusive Divine Doctor Wood. As Luke recovers, Sujun faces intense suspicion and envy from his family and ambitious rivals like Sara, who scheme to discredit her and claim Luke. Sujun's hidden medical genius, extraordinary calligraphy talent, and prodigious gem-cutting abilities are publicly revealed through audacious bets and challenges, solidifying her reputation. The narrative intertwines high-stakes "stone gambling" with corporate intrigue, family loyalty, and a bitter feud between the powerful Lee and Lu families, intensified by a paternity scandal. The quest for the Divine Doctor Wood becomes central, revealing Sujun as the true disciple and "Goddess of Medicine," while imposters, notably Michael Sara, fraudulently claim her identity and sacred pendant. Michael (Sara) blackmails the Luke family, exploiting Susan's secret discipleship, and Doctor Wood dramatically disapproves of Susan's marriage, hinting at a forbidden connection. Accusations of infidelity and betrayal lead to a dramatic, violent confrontation between Luke and Susan. Muyan (Luke) endures life-threatening poisonings, lethal drugs, and attacks, with his devoted wife Sosse (Sujun) desperately seeking cures and unlocking magical abilities to save him. Amidst these personal struggles, Luke's grandmother pressures for an heir, only for Sosse to reveal Muyan's inability to have children. The series culminates in the true Divine Doctor Wood's revelation, exposing the imposter's lies, and Susan confronting her former disciple Sarah, who seeks revenge against CEO Michael Boling, her father, who cruelly denies her. Sarah, healed by Susan, then makes a shocking and intimate demand for repayment, blurring professional and personal lines in a complex battle for legacy and identity.

This rescuer, Randheer, an Alpha, is banished for seeking his fated mate, leading him to Geetha. They enter a secret contract marriage, driven by Geetha's desperate need to escape her past and Randheer's requirement for a temporary mate. Their developing connection is complicated by the revelation of Sangeetha as Randheer's designated "true mate," who then suddenly marries the formidable Ranveer, sparking a fierce rivalry. Geetha, also known by other names like Sangeetha, becomes an investigator tasked with uncovering "man-shaped wolves." Her investigation leads to dangerous confrontations, injuries, and the shocking realization that a device designed to detect these creatures points to her primary client, or even herself. Randheer, suffering memory loss and bewildering shifts in demeanor, grapples with a hidden past and a potentially broken "mate bond." A sinister villain plots revenge against Randheer, using Geetha/Sangeetha as a pawn in a larger scheme. Geetha navigates intense office politics, facing fierce jealousy from Trisha, while also uncovering Randheer's manipulative nature and dangerous secrets. She experiences a tumultuous journey marked by car crashes, attacks, and betrayals from figures like Robin, who is revealed as a ruthless manipulator. Despite initial prejudice, Geetha feels an undeniable pull towards Ranveer, who admits his "monstrous nature" as a "human wolf," challenging her perceptions. The show explores a complex web of fated connections, contractual obligations, and hidden supernatural identities. Characters are ensnared in perilous love triangles and power struggles, with trust constantly fractured. The overarching stakes involve Geetha's survival, the truth about "human wolves," and the resolution of these intertwined destinies. Ultimately, the narrative culminates in shocking revelations and dangerous situations as characters navigate a world of deceit and supernatural elements.

the-knight-in-shining-armour.title: The Knight In Shining Armour
the-knight-in-shining-armour.description: Once living a humble life as a street sweeper, Rudra Randhawa hides a powerful secret. He is the legendary Supreme Leader, a man who once shaped nations. When his new wife Maanvi Chauhan and her daughter Anika are drawn into a web of betrayal, greed, and family feuds, Rudra steps out of the shadows to protect them, revealing his true power and rewriting their destinies. Watch Now!

a-vow-of-joy-and-sorrow-2.title: A Vow of Joy and Sorrow
a-vow-of-joy-and-sorrow-2.description: Emperor Nandhilal is cursed with a deadly Yang poison — a fate that promises death before New Year’s Eve unless he shares intimacy with a mysterious girl marked by a mole on her lower neck. Desperate to survive, slowly fate leads him to Brindha — a humble, kind-hearted nursing student who bears the mark. When Nandhilal proposes marriage, Brindha is stunned and hesitant. Why would a mighty emperor want a girl like her?

pyaar-paisa-aur-raaz.title: Pyaar, Paisa aur Raaz
pyaar-paisa-aur-raaz.description: When billionaire CEO Rudra Raychand’s one-night encounter with spirited lawyer Akanksha leads to a forgotten past, secret parentage, and ruthless betrayals from her sister Ekta, their worlds collide in a storm of power, love, and revenge. As hidden truths surface and family bonds are tested, Rudra and Akanksha must fight for love, legacy, and the daughter they never knew they shared. Watch Now!

the-final-boss-4.title: The Final Boss
the-final-boss-4.description: Abhiraj Singh Rathore, the secret Raja of Rajputana Corporation and the wealthiest man on Earth, returns from battle only to be ruthlessly rejected by his childhood sweetheart, who believes he's nothing more than a fool. Now, as the King of all men, he’s determined to make her regret her decision in a way she never saw coming.

virgin-dulhan-1.title: Virgin Dulhan
virgin-dulhan-1.description: রুহি মেধাবী হওয়ার সত্বেও মায়ের কথা রাখতে ও মায়ের চিকিৎসার জন্য লোকের বাড়িতে কাজ করতে থাকে। সেখানে তার দেখা হয় আদিত্যর সাথে। রুহিকে দেখে আদিত্যর খুব চেনা চেনা লাগে। রুহিও সব জেনেও মায়ের কথা ভেবে চুপ করে থাকে। আদিত্য আস্তে আস্তে বুঝতে পারে সেই রাতে রুহির মালকিন মিসেস চাওলার মেয়ে আলিসার বদলে রুহি ছিলো আদিত্যর সাথে। আদিত্য পুরো খেলা বুঝতে পেরে মিসেস চাওলার সাথে তাঁদের বিজনেস ডিল ক্যানসেল করে ও আলিসার সাথে বিয়ে করতেও অস্বীকার করে। মিসেস চাওলা এটা মেনে নিতে না পেরে রুহির মা কে কিডনি দেওয়ার বদলে আদিত্য দের পুরো ব্যবসা নিজের নামে করে নেয়।

laut-aayi-vaaris.title: The Hidden Heiress
laut-aayi-vaaris.description: The series begins with young Trisha's profound devotion to her critically ill mother, leading Trisha to sacrifice her future education for her mother's life-saving surgery. Before or during the surgery, her mother makes a poignant request for Trisha to become a medicine researcher to create affordable cures. Tragically, the mother's health deteriorates further while frantically searching for her missing daughter, Trisha, post-surgery, leading to her presumed death and Trisha's disappearance. Fifteen years later, a powerful corporate head, identified as the missing Trisha's mother (Rashika Goenka), launches a massive search for her lost heiress and a cure for her own rare disease. Simultaneously, an adult Trisha, now a brilliant scientist, develops a groundbreaking medicine but faces betrayal from her fiancé, Rohan, who attempts to exploit her work and savings. Rohan publicly steals Trisha's intellectual property, crediting Sandy Khanna, igniting Trisha's quest for justice and revenge amidst public humiliation and physical assault. As Trisha fights to reclaim her work, a DNA test hints at a profound family secret regarding her parentage, with the ruthless matriarch Rashika Goenka emerging as a protective figure, believing Trisha is her daughter. Trisha's mother (Rashika) initiates a corporate revenge drama, accusing Rohan and the Kapoor family of stealing Trisha's research and betraying her. Trisha herself publicly confronts Rohan and his father over the stolen formula, vehemently rejecting Rohan's opportunistic marriage proposal after she gains wealth. The narrative reveals Rashika Goenka's true formidable identity as a corporate heiress and major shareholder, with Trisha also revealing her status as a major shareholder, dismantling those who underestimated them. A young woman's search for identity culminates in the discovery of her long-lost father, and fragmented memories resurface, leading to an emotional reunion with her long-lost mother. The series culminates with a powerful patriarch announcing the return of his long-lost daughter, the true heiress and new CEO of Goenka Industries, whose revolutionary medical breakthrough solidifies her leadership, confirming Trisha's identity and her reunion with her mother.

silent-power-1.title: Fearless Son in Law
silent-power-1.description: When legendary CEO takes over a powerful group and plans to invest in agriculture in his small hometown, he must navigate corporate rivalries, hidden agendas, and personal wounds as he fights to fulfill his vision and reunite with his estranged family.

my-amnesiac-puppy-boyfriend.title: My Amnesiac Puppy Boyfriend
my-amnesiac-puppy-boyfriend.description: After a car accident, a cold and powerful CEO loses his memory and turns into a sweet, obedient "puppy-like" boyfriend. But as his memories return, so do the secrets that could tear their love apart.

true-and-false-dragon-commander-2.title: True and False Dragon Commander
true-and-false-dragon-commander-2.description: রাজা অতিথ্য তার ঘনিষ্ট বন্ধুবান্ধবের বিশ্বাসঘাতকতায় এক পর্বতের অতলে পড়ে যায়। সবাই তাকে মৃত বলে মনে করে। কিন্তু চমৎকারভাবে, তিনি মৃত্যুর পরও চোখ মেলে থাকে। সত্যিই তিনি মারা যাননি। নিজেকে নতুন জীবন উপহার পেয়ে আত্মহারা হয়ে যান। নতুন জীবনের সন্ধান পেয়ে রাজা প্রতিশোধ নিতে চান। অমূল্য সুযোগকে কাজে লাগিয়ে তিনি প্রত্যেক শত্রুকে চিহ্নিত করতে নিজের পরিচয় গোপন রাখেন।

my-dads-got-trillions-of-dollars-in-asse.title: My dad's got trillions of dollars in assets
my-dads-got-trillions-of-dollars-in-asse.description: "টাকা দিয়ে ভালোবাসা কেনা যায় না" এক অসমবয়সী ভালোবাসার গল্প। ডেভিড আর ডেইজির ভালোবাসা কিভাবে হাজারও বাধা পেরিয়ে দুটো মনকে কাছাকাছি নিয়ে এলো, তা নিয়েই গল্পের মোড় ঘোরে।

ziddi-ishq.title: Ziddi Ishq
ziddi-ishq.description:
Trisha — ek ladki jiska dil kab ka kisi aur ke liye dhadak chuka hai, aur jiska artificial heart sirf uske sacrifice ki yaad hai. Saat saal baad woh wapas aayi hai — ek pendant, ek sach, aur ek hisaab ke liye. Rohit, jise usne zindagi di thi, aaj usi zindagi ko barbad kar raha hai.
Pyaar tha… badla ban gaya. Ab sawaal ye hai — kya Trisha is baar apna dil bacha payegi?

where-love-fades-away.title: Where Love Fades Away
where-love-fades-away.description: এক মহিলার ব্রেন ক্যান্সার হয়। তিনি তার স্বামীকে ফোন করে এই খবরটা জানাতে চান, কিন্তু তিনি তা শুনতে চান না। সেই স্বামী, যদিও বিশ্বসেরা ব্রেন ক্যানসার বিশেষজ্ঞ। নার্সরা যখন ওই মহিলাকে নিয়ে স্বামীর কাছে যান—তাঁর স্ত্রী—তখন সেই বিশেষজ্ঞ স্বামী তাকে দেখতেই না। এভারে দিনের পর দিন স্বামীর মানসিক অত্যাচার সহ্য করতে না পেরে ওই মহিলা স্বামীর থেকে আলাদা হয়ে যান। পরবর্তীতে স্বামী তার নিজের ভুল বুঝতে পেরে আবার স্ত্রীর কাছে ফিরে আসতে চান। তিনি কি ফিরে আসতে পারবেন?

secret-legend.title: Secret Legend
secret-legend.description: When humble masseur Veer Jindal is humiliated by his wife Simran and her family, they have no idea he is secretly the billionaire chairman of the powerful Choksi Group. As betrayals unfold and family ties are tested, Veer’s hidden identity shakes their world, exposing greed, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Watch Now!

this-girl-is-a-martial-master-2.title: This Girl Is a Martial Master
this-girl-is-a-martial-master-2.description: A young woman, with her martial arts skills, relentlessly attacks her enemies. She steps onto the battlefield to save her family. Her only goal is to settle the feud. In that pursuit, she becomes an unstoppable force.

dual-plants-decision.title: Dual Plants Decision
dual-plants-decision.description: A cosmic struggle for ultimate power ignites with the pursuit of mythical "amrutham" and the arrival of a mysterious "mandal." Young warrior Tarasuraj, driven by vengeance for his annihilated family, is thrust into this conflict, facing formidable foes like the banished divine twin Bhairava and the unseen antagonist Bhairavi. Guided by a wise mentor, Suraj embarks on a perilous quest to gather legendary "soul powers" and master the ancient Maya Khadgam, while a manipulative Master plots world domination. The narrative escalates with powerful transformations, deceptions, and the pursuit of ancient "shakthi," leading to desperate alliances and profound sacrifices, including body-swaps and soul-merging propositions. Suraj's fragile romantic connection with Tara is repeatedly tested by accusations of past betrayals and a forceful kiss, shattering his trust and fueling his quest for vengeance as Tara grapples with a forgotten past and alleged complicity in a family massacre. The malevolent Bhairav unleashes destruction, prompting the chosen healer Chandra to seek ancient power. Bhairava orchestrates a sinister plot to poison Dharani and frame her, while Tara and Suraj embark on a mission to rescue Varun, whose tragic death fuels Tara's vow for profound revenge. King Prabhu relentlessly pursues ultimate power, and Bhairava seizes control of souls, eliminating the Guru. A ruthless conqueror, Bhaira, besieges a royal palace, leading to the Maharaja's demise and usurpation of the throne. Tara makes a heart-wrenching sacrifice, transferring her core energy to Suraj, who is tasked with retrieving "three souls," only for Tara to become Bhaira's captive, revealing an elaborate deception by a hidden mastermind. Suraj sacrifices his blood to save Tara, triggering her powerful magical transformation, making her a target for Prabhu and Bhairava who seek mystical souls. Suraj and Tara acquire the legendary "Maaya Katti" to defeat Bhairava, who is revealed to have betrayed Suraj's father. Prince Suraj faces relentless assaults and betrayals, vowing revenge for his family's destruction by the tyrannical Rudra. Tara battles a corrupted Suraj and makes selfless sacrifices to protect him. Despite reclaiming his lost powers, Suraj and Tara are separated, vowing eternal love. Their joyous royal wedding is dramatically halted by a dire warning and the return of the malevolent Bhairav, who claims the Chakravarthi title. Suraj confronts Bhairav in magical battles but suffers a devastating defeat, leaving his fate and the kingdom's hanging in the balance. In a tragic cycle, Suraj and Tara are captured by a tyrant, with Suraj sacrificing himself for Tara, and in a subsequent life, Tara sacrificing herself for the Bahubali royal family, hinting at a complex, tumultuous past and a potential revenge plot as a mysterious Tara re-emerges.

defying-destiny-3.title: Taakatwar Yoddha
defying-destiny-3.description: An ambitious disciple accidentally unlocks the path to immortality, challenging centuries of sacred traditions. As his powers grow, so do the forces determined to silence him forever.

love-kites.title: Love Kites
love-kites.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous and deceit-ridden relationship between Captain Jay Mehra, a pilot and CEO, and Prerna, a young woman entangled in his complex life. Initially, Jay juggles an emotionally distant relationship with Prerna, a secret affair with Kiran, and an engagement to his past love, Mehak, whose return exposes his clandestine affairs. Prerna, facing familial pressure and an unexpected pregnancy with Jay's child, defiantly asserts her autonomy, leading to Jay's shocking proposal of a forced marriage. Their contractual marriage is fraught with challenges, as Jay's past is further complicated by his estranged wife Ritu and another woman, Radha, who also becomes pregnant with his child. Concurrently, Prerna navigates financial hardship, a medical ethics crisis involving tampered reports, and the possessive jealousy of her contractual husband, Karan, while also encountering Dr. Roy. As their fragile bond strains, Prerna delivers a divorce ultimatum, citing Jay's perceived irresponsibility and divided loyalties, especially with the persistent presence of Mihika. A devastating car crash results in Prerna's miscarriage, leading her to suspect foul play and demand a divorce from Jay, who grapples with guilt and discovers his current partner, Megha, built their romance on a lie about his past with Prerna. Shocking revelations further unravel their lives: Prerna admits to targeting Jay for his wealth, and Zoya dramatically exposes herself as Jay's secret legal wife, shattering the facade of his relationships. Despite the betrayals and the loss, a mid-flight emergency fatedly reunites Captain Jay Mehra with Prerna, now a heroic doctor. Haunted by regret, Jay realizes his past mistakes cost him their genuine connection and commits to building the loving home Prerna always dreamed of. Prerna, melancholic but seeking a new beginning and resolution, arrives in Mumbai, leaving their future uncertain but hinting at a potential reunion.

alpha-she-wasnt-the-one-5.title: Alpha, She Wasn't the One
alpha-she-wasnt-the-one-5.description: Annie, an ordinary girl, crosses paths with Leon, a werewolf leader, bound by a prophecy from the Moon Goddess. Mistaking her sister for his fated mate, Leon falls for Annie as boss and subordinate. When Annie’s memories and powers awaken, their love is tested by secrets, fate, and the truth of her true identity.

kalaapa-kadhala.title: Kalaapa Kadhala
kalaapa-kadhala.description: When ambitious architect Aarohi is betrayed on her engagement day, a mysterious stranger offers her a new beginning — with strings attached. As secrets unravel and love clashes with deception, her journey turns into a rollercoaster of power, betrayal, and redemption.

secret-husband-5.title: Secret Husband
secret-husband-5.description: তুচ্ছ-তাচ্ছিল্য ও হেয় করে রাখা বাড়ির জামাই, সকলের কাছেই ঠাট্টার পাত্র হয়ে থাকে। কিন্তু তার আসল সত্যিটা হলো - সে একজন কোটিপতি ব্যবসায়ী। কোটি টাকার কোম্পানি সন কর্পোরেশনের চেয়ারম্যান সে। আসল সত্যিটা সকলের সামনে কি আসবে? আর এলেও বা সকলের কি পরিণতি হয়! সেই নিয়েই গল্প।

billionaire-husband-on-rent.title: Billionaire Husband on Rent
billionaire-husband-on-rent.description:
Tara Rampal — ek fierce army officer, jise apne baap ki jaidad sirf ek shart par mil sakti hai: shaadi! Majboori mein uski mulakaat hoti hai Jeet se — ek sadak chhapar bhikhari jaisa dikhne wala ladka, jo asal mein hai ek billionaire aur political kingmaker! Par Tara ko iss raaz ka pata nahi. Ek jhoothi shaadi, asli jazbaat, aur dushmano ka chakravyuh — iss kahani mein pyaar, politics, aur revenge sab kuch milega!
Jab sach samne aayega… kya rahega sirf pyaar ya sab kuch bikhar jaayega?

the-love-that-kills-2.title: THE LOVE THAT KILLS
the-love-that-kills-2.description: THE LOVE THAT KILLS - is a gripping drama that follows the unraveling of Raghav Malhotra's family due to the unchecked entitlement of his son Sid and father Vijay, sparked by Sid's destructive act at a luxury hotel. As tensions with Raghav's boss Srishti Mehra escalate, the series explores accountability, family dynamics, and the devastating cost of pride..

medical-saint-is-not-to-be-provoked.title: Medical Saint Is Not To Be Provoked
medical-saint-is-not-to-be-provoked.description: Watch this intersting show named "Medical saint is not to be provoked" Now!

pyaar-dhokha-aur-badla-1.title: Pyaar, Dhokha Aur Badla
pyaar-dhokha-aur-badla-1.description: The series opens with Priya, a gravely ill heiress, inexplicably sent back eight years in time, granted a second chance to rewrite a tragic past where her ex-lover, Arjun, betrayed her and infected her with AIDS. Now in the past, Priya discovers Arjun as her family's driver's son and her tutor, initiating a complex journey of revenge and self-discovery. She orchestrates public humiliations for Arjun, challenging his arrogance and social standing, while navigating a burgeoning love triangle involving Arjun, herself, and her returning former fiancé, Chirag. Priya's resolve for retribution intensifies with the shocking revelation of a past life where Arjun caused her father's death and seized her family's legacy, fueling her determination to protect her loved ones and rewrite history. As Priya gains power, she publicly exposes Arjun's financial dependence on her family, leading to his public humiliation and financial ruin, even with the secret help of his girlfriend, Kavya. Arjun, deeply wounded, attempts to assert dominance through lavish displays, but Priya, empowered by her connection with Chirag, defiantly counters his threats. Their conflict escalates into high-stakes academic challenges and corporate battles, with Priya asserting her independence by hiring Chirag as her tutor, sparking Arjun's intense jealousy. Arjun, facing severe debt due to his manipulative, gambling father, is manipulated into a forced marriage proposal with Priya, unaware of her deeper machinations. Priya, driven by her past-life conviction, unleashes a relentless revenge plot, orchestrating Arjun's torment, including his kidnapping and brutal beating, yet exhibiting a twisted, possessive concern for his appearance. She financially traps Arjun's father, revealing her chilling intent to systematically make Arjun's life hell. Arjun attempts to reconcile, confessing his love, but Priya violently rejects him, explicitly aligning herself with Chirag, whose blossoming romance fuels Arjun's jealousy. The narrative culminates as Priya, now a student representative, faces public accusations of a scandalous affair from her rival Kavya, who presents visual "proof." Priya defiantly hints at a deeper truth, and her powerful father, CEO Ajay Saxena, intervenes, leveraging his corporate and trustee status to expel those responsible for his daughter's distress. Amidst the chaos, Chirag, revealed to be immensely wealthy, debunks malicious lies about Priya controlling him and vows unwavering protection. The show concludes with Chirag proposing marriage to Priya, solidifying their destined love and commitment despite past sorrows and ongoing conflicts, as Priya successfully navigates her revenge and secures her future.

the-crowned-consort-of-the-empress-2.title: The Crowned Consort of the Empress
the-crowned-consort-of-the-empress-2.description: The microdrama unfolds across multiple lifetimes, centering on a Princess grappling with fragmented memories and a destiny intertwined with betrayal and love. Initially, a Princess awakens, commanded to choose a husband through a sacred Swayamvaram, only to be ruthlessly betrayed by Commander Quanteous, who seeks the throne. This betrayal reveals a manipulative plot and the selfless loyalty of her protector, Naadiya, to whom the Princess vows eternal love in their next life. Reincarnated as Princess Pallaadu/Ilavarasi/Aurora, she returns with a burning desire for vengeance against Quanteous, who continues his manipulative schemes. Her journey is marked by intense pressure to conform to royal expectations regarding marriage, often defying tradition for a forbidden love, frequently identified as Nadi or Nadia. She uncovers Quantes's repeated deceptions about past rescues and faces public humiliation and betrayal from others. Amidst royal competitions for her hand, she experiences a deep, possessive love with her loyal commander Thalapathy, and a passionate, yet often interrupted, romance with Nadia. The narrative introduces a time-traveling Prince attempting to save her, further complicating her entanglements with multiple political marriages and past-life connections. As the Princess navigates a treacherous path of duty, forbidden love, and betrayal, she confronts manipulative figures like her Queen Mother and various rivals vying for power. Conspiracies target her fated love, and she is often a pawn in larger schemes for control across kingdoms. Reincarnated lovers, such as Prince Yuvaan and Maula, strive to rectify past tragedies and protect their destined partners, facing formidable rivals and betrayals. The overarching conflict culminates in violent confrontations and desperate bids for control, with the Princess and her true love fighting to reclaim their realm from treacherous ministers and ambitious princes, highlighting the enduring impact of past lives on present conflicts.

imperial-master-2.title: Imperial Master
imperial-master-2.description: Imperial Master follows the journey of a skilled strategist who rises from humble beginnings to become the most powerful figure in the empire. Amid political intrigue, betrayal, and romance, he must navigate dangerous alliances to protect the empire and secure his legacy.

divorced-single-mother-2.title: DIVORCED SINGLE MOTHER
divorced-single-mother-2.description: Radhika returns to her estranged, materialistic family for her mother's 70th birthday, hoping for reconciliation but instead facing hostility and public humiliation over her modest gift. Defiantly, she proposes a high-stakes bet, and her humble offering is dramatically revealed by an expert's appraisal to be a priceless, ancient heirloom, shifting family dynamics but also igniting accusations of deception and revenge. Despite her initial vindication, Radhika is later falsely accused of fraud concerning a diamond necklace, with her protector, CEO Gaurav, attempting to clear her name. Her son, Arjun, then arrives, revealing their immense wealth and temporarily silencing her critics, though new conflicts emerge as Sanju accuses Radhika of discrediting his achievements and a dispute arises over a revolutionary medicine. Shockingly, Radhika betrays her son, Arjun, over a counterfeit necklace, shattering his ambitions and leading to his immediate financial ruin when CEO Gaurav Khanna cancels a crucial investment. Meanwhile, Radhika's other son, Gaurav, fiercely defends his mother from his abusive estranged father, Rakesh, who publicly humiliates Radhika. Radhika, in turn, reveals Gaurav's success as CEO of Galaxy Corp Finance, and Gaurav orchestrates the spectacular downfall of Rakesh's corrupt corporate empire, bringing justice. Amidst these family and corporate battles, Radhika navigates a personal journey, encountering a charming scammer who is exposed and arrested. She finds an unexpected ally and developing romantic interest in Anil, the elusive CEO of Miracle EV Tech, who is also Aarti's father and a past benefactor. The vengeful Rakesh Kapoor resurfaces, violently kidnapping Radhika and Anil, torturing Anil and accusing Radhika and her sons of ruining his life due to a past rejection. Despite his torment, Anil passionately confesses his deep, long-held love for Radhika, while Rakesh also exposes Radhika's secret identity as a wealthy matriarch with a CEO son. A violent attack by a mysterious aggressor targets Anil and Gourav's father, but Gourav and his mother heroically save Anil, leading to a powerful corporate alliance between Anil's and Gourav's companies. However, Gourav's matriarchal mother demands that Gourav and Aarti fulfill a prior promise of marriage, forcing the ambitious couple to balance personal desires with family duty.

mortal-to-immortal.title: Mortal To Immortal
mortal-to-immortal.description: Watch This Intersting story Named "Mortal to Immortal" Now!

my-ceo-made-me-pregnant-1.title: My CEO Made Me Pregnant
my-ceo-made-me-pregnant-1.description: একজন উজ্জ্বল প্রযুক্তি প্রতিভা জানতে পারেন, তিনি তার সিইওর সন্তানের মা হতে চলেছেন। মিথ্যা, বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা ও গোপন ঘটনাচক্রে ভরা কর্পোরেট যুদ্ধের মাঝে, তিনি তার নিজস্ব পরিচয় ফিরে পেতে ও গর্ভের শিশুকে নিরাপদ রাখার জন্য লড়াই করে যান। বিনিয়োগ, ষড়যন্ত্র ও মিথ্যার জালে তিনি নিজেকে আবিষ্কার করেন এবং সেই ব্যক্তির মুখোমুখি হন, যাকে একসময় বিশ্বাস করেছিলেন ও ভালোবাসতেন।

boss-vs-wolf.title: Boss vs Wolf
boss-vs-wolf.description: A fearless young lawyer unknowingly marries a powerful werewolf while investigating supernatural attacks. As love, danger, and destiny collide, she must choose between justice and a mysterious world hidden in the shadows.

mera-piya-ghar-aaya.title: Mera Piya Ghar Aaya
mera-piya-ghar-aaya.description: The story centers on Ananya, a single mother whose life is repeatedly shaken by family pressure, public shame, and hidden ties to Kabir. She resists an arranged marriage and later faces cruel judgment over her past and her child, but she keeps fighting to protect her dignity. Kabir enters as a powerful CEO and fighter who is searching for his lost parents and is also drawn into a long mystery from his own past. His path crosses Ananya’s through chance meetings, medical crises, and a growing sense that she is connected to something he has been seeking for years. A child in the story repeatedly becomes the emotional center, trying to defend her mother, ask for family unity, and expose the unfairness around her. The family and social world around Ananya is harsh, with insults, accusations, and classist attacks used to pressure her into submission. At one point, her past and child are publicly exposed, and a humiliating marriage demand is tied to apologies and property, showing how deeply others want to control her. Kabir gradually shifts from uncertainty to protection, defending Ananya when she is falsely accused and later insisting on the truth behind the pendant and her identity. The pendant becomes a key symbol linking Ananya to Kabir’s eight-year search and to the hidden history neither of them fully understands. Medical danger also drives the plot, as Ananya’s memory loss worsens and Kabir’s life is threatened until a mysterious young woman saves him with an unexplainable healing method. That healer is recognized as someone Kabir met eight years earlier, which deepens the sense that the past is returning in fragments. As the family conflict intensifies, Kabir’s sister Nandini repeatedly tries to undermine Ananya and push the household toward rejection and divorce. Kabir answers by publicly defending Ananya, restricting Nandini’s interference, and exposing deceit within the family. The revelation that Kabir and Ananya share a secret marriage changes the stakes, because their bond is no longer only emotional but already binding. Their child’s happiness briefly softens the conflict, but suspicion remains because Ananya’s memory loss leaves important parts of the past unresolved. By the end of the batch, the central struggle is no longer whether Kabir and Ananya are connected, but whether their family can accept the truth and stop fighting against it.

the-couple-came-from-hell-2.title: The Couple Came from Hell
the-couple-came-from-hell-2.description: After her husband Lumor’s tragic rooftop fall, Chinn was killed in the chaos — only to be reborn with memories of it all. With a second chance, she uncovers the dark conspiracies of Stacy and Camor. Armed with truth and determination, Chinn fights back to rewrite her fate and protect the one she loves.

love-your-lies.title: Love your Lies
love-your-lies.description: When Naina Kothari returns home after two years, she finds her world shattered, her boyfriend Mukund is now engaged to her sister Kavya. In a bold act of revenge, Naina impulsively marries Rohan Seth, only to discover unexpected love, betrayal, and redemption as forgotten bonds resurface. Watch Now!

why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry.title: Why Must the Boss Contractually Marry
why-must-the-boss-contractually-marry.description: Why Must The Boss Contractly Marry

mun-jenma-paavam-nee.title: Mun Jenma Paavam Nee
mun-jenma-paavam-nee.description: After being betrayed and left to die by the man she loved, Priya is mysteriously sent back eight years in time. Now, with knowledge of the future, she plots revenge against those who destroyed her—starting with her ex-fiancé Arjun.

shaadi-by-mistake.title: Shadi by Mistake
shaadi-by-mistake.description: Ayesha, ek dabee-kuchli si ladki jo apni asli shaktiyon se anjaan hai, galti se uss khandan mein shaamil kar di jaati hai jahan taqat hi sab kuch hai. Prince Karan, ek arrogant magician hai jiske dil ke kone mein sirf ek hi jagah hai—apne bachpan ki yaadon ke liye. Jab Ayesha uski zindagi mein vaapas aati hai, ek rishte ka natak sach ban jaata hai. Lekin yeh sirf pyaar ki kahani nahi—yeh hai saazish, dhokha aur khoon se bhara badle ka silsila. Jab sach samne aata hai, toh sirf ek sawal rehta hai—kya pyaar jeetega ya prachin shaktiyon ka hungama iss kahani ka the end likhega?

does-bhagavad-gita-give-everything-back.title: Does Bhagavad Gita Give Everything Back?
does-bhagavad-gita-give-everything-back.description: Does Bhagavad Gita Give Everything Back?

pyaada-bana-wazir.title: Pyaada Bana Wazir
pyaada-bana-wazir.description: World-famous chess grandmaster MK mysteriously vanishes at the peak of his career—only to find his soul reborn in the body of a timid, orphaned boy tormented by his cruel relatives. As MK’s sharp intellect and fearless spirit begin to surface, the boy gains the strength to stand up for himself. Teaming up with a young fan from MK’s past, they uncover a sinister plot: MK was kidnapped and kept unconscious by a rival desperate to steal his place in the global chess arena. In a dramatic final showdown, MK regains his body, defeats his rival, and breaks the mystical bond—setting both himself and the boy free.

billionaire-daddy-the-hunt-is-on-5.title: Billionaire Daddy, the Hunt is On!
billionaire-daddy-the-hunt-is-on-5.description: Miranda, a dedicated single mother, works hard to support her son, but constantly clashes with her cold, distant boss, Lemon. Little does she know, he’s actually the boy’s biological father—and beneath his tough exterior, he’s hiding a warm heart.

bahu-vs-gold-digger.title: The Hidden Heiress
bahu-vs-gold-digger.description: In the glittering world of the Rathods, billionaire heiress Avantika lives undercover as house staff, hiding her power from husband Sheel. When scheming Rutuja plots a hostile takeover, Avantika must reveal her true identity to reclaim her empire—and exact revenge in a high-stakes battle of queens.

mr-santai-want-you.description:
ఒక యువతిని ఆమె బాయ్‌ఫ్రెండ్ మోసం చేసి వదిలేస్తాడు.
కాని ఆ తర్వాత ఆమెకు  ఒక వెరువుల్ఫ్ తో పరిచయం అవుతుంది.

blossoms-2003.title: Blossoms 2003
blossoms-2003.description:
ఒక చిన్నారి తన తల్లి మరణానికి కారణమైన తండ్రి తప్పులకు బాధపడుతూ, ప్రేమ, దౌర్జన్యం, బాధ్యతల మధ్య చిక్కుకుంటుంది.
ఆమె జీవితంలో జరిగిన దుర్మార్గ సంఘటనలు, బలవంతపు పరిస్థితులు చివరికి ఒక గాఢమైన భావోద్వేగ తీరానికి తీసుకెళ్తాయి.

bachpan-ka-pyaar.title: Bachpan ka Pyaar
bachpan-ka-pyaar.description: Aarav, a powerful CEO, is determined to divorce his estranged childhood wife, Preeti Sharma, unaware that she is about to become his new employee. Their arranged marriage, a pact between their mothers, left Aarav haunted by unresolved feelings, despite his insistence on moving on. Preeti, considering the marriage a mere formality, unknowingly steps into his corporate world, where Aarav finds himself drawn to her while simultaneously searching for his "lost" wife. His grandmother, Dadi, suspects his animosity towards Preeti masks deeper emotions, further complicated by Preeti's engagement to Amit and the revelation of her family's mysterious past. Aarav hires Preeti as his assistant, despite their past connection and his secret marriage, leading to a complex web of fated connections and hidden truths. Preeti navigates a cutthroat corporate environment, facing misogynistic attacks, but finds an unexpected protector in Aarav, who champions a respectful workplace. This act sparks a complex, forbidden attraction between them, complicated by Aarav's past childhood marriage and his increasingly possessive declarations of love. A matriarch, believing in destiny, attempts to facilitate a union between Aarav and Preeti, as their professional boundaries blur. A traumatized Rupali is left in Preeti's care, while Aarav and Preeti begin to suspect they are long-lost childhood sweethearts, Bittu and Preeti. However, Preeti's existing marriage and the emergence of Payal Sharma, who claims to be Aarav's original "Preeti" from a childhood engagement photo, complicate their reunion. Payal issues a dangerous warning, and Aarav grapples with his feelings for her, believing she is his destined love, leading to volatile behavior towards Preeti at work. Despite this, Aarav's tender care for an injured Preeti sparks a burgeoning romance, prompting him to decide to divorce his wife, Payal. Payal is devastated and reveals her marriage to Aarav was one of convenience, rejecting a significant alimony. Preeti discovers her childhood husband, Bittu, is the powerful CEO Aarav Gupta, and learns their childhood marriage was legally non-binding. A client, implied to be Aarav, offers Preeti substantial alimony for a formal separation, which she accepts. During subsequent divorce proceedings, Aarav (also referred to as Milan) initially denies Preeti's identity, but a shared childhood memory sparks recognition. A new mystery unfolds as Milan questions Preeti's identity, revealing an imposter living under her name, who is also his legally wedded wife. It is revealed that Milan's Dadi orchestrated this scheme involving the imposter to steer him towards another partner. Ultimately, Aarav and Preeti reaffirm their deep, fated bond, choosing to overcome past disagreements and embrace their unbreakable connection despite the deceptions.

gone-yet-loved-by-him-3.title: Gone Yet Loved by Him
gone-yet-loved-by-him-3.description:

ఆమె వెళ్లిన తర్వాత మాత్రమే అతడు తన నిజమైన భావాలను గ్రహిస్తాడు.
విపరీతమైన బాధ,  అతని లోపల దాగిన ప్రేమ ఆమె గమనం తరువాత మెల్లగా బయటపడుతుంది.

the-blind-billionaire.description:
After a crash leaves her brother in a coma, Shambhavi sells all she has for surgery funds. A blind billionaire offers to pay if she marries him and becomes his eyes. What’s waiting for her now? Will this be the start of something new or does this man have a hidden agenda?
Attaching reference images too.

Armed with memories of her tragic past, she vows to change her fate, protect her loved ones, and outwit royal conspiracies, while Alice still schemes for power at any cost. Watch Now!

the-devils-wears-desire.title: The Devils Wears Desire
the-devils-wears-desire.description: এক নারীর ভালোবাসা, রহস্য এবং বেঁচে থাকার লড়াই— নানা রকম আবেগের চার ভিন্ন পুরুষকে আকর্ষণ করে। তারা সবাই ওই নারীর প্রতি গভীর ভাবে আকৃষ্ট হয়। অ্যানা আটকে যায় তার প্রথম প্রেমিক—যিনি স্মৃতিভ্রষ্ট, এক প্রবীণ—যিনি বিলিয়নেয়ার, এক চালাক উত্তরাধিকারী, এবং একজন অপরাধ সিন্ডিকেটের সঙ্গে মিশে থাকা ডন—যার জীবন ও হৃদয়ে লুকিয়ে আছে এক রহস্যময় ট্রান্সপ্লান্ট।

rebirth-hunting-crimes-album-1.title: Rebirth: Hunting Crimes Album
rebirth-hunting-crimes-album-1.description: In a secluded mountain village, women working as schoolteachers are being brutally murdered. Andria and her friend Sasha are newly appointed teachers in the same village. Soon after they arrive, Andria begins having unsettling dreams that seem to reveal the horrors unfolding around them. As fear closes in, Andria is caught by a group targeting female teachers while Sasha narrowly escapes. But the mystery deepens: who are these ruthless killers, and why are they hunting women in this isolated village?

false-promises-true-love.title: Fake Promise True Love
false-promises-true-love.description: He promised her a future, then vanished like a lie. What starts as heartbreak turns into a gripping quest for justice and love. False Promise, True Love is a raw, emotional ride through betrayal, courage, and redemption. Watch Now !

siddha-secrets-the-6-body-parts-that-rev.title: Siddha Secrets: The 6 Body Parts That Reveal a Health Problems Before It Happens
siddha-secrets-the-6-body-parts-that-rev.description: Siddha Secrets: The 6 Body Parts That Reveal a Health Problems Before It Happens

triplets-of-vengeance.title: Triplets of Vengeance
triplets-of-vengeance.description: After being betrayed by her own family, Sanya returns six years later with her twins, Ayan and Ahana, seeking justice—and her stolen third child. As she crosses paths with Ishaan, the man unknowingly connected to her past, secrets unravel, and her triplets become the center of a storm involving love, lies, and revenge. With Riya—the woman who tried to destroy her—still plotting, Sanya must fight to reclaim her children and her destiny. Watch Now!

rebirth-hunting-crimes-album-2.title: Rebirth: Hunting Crimes Album
rebirth-hunting-crimes-album-2.description: The microdrama unfolds a complex narrative of individuals entangled in dangerous situations, often stemming from past traumas, debts, and hidden conspiracies. Mishri survives an assassination attempt, sparking a quest for identity and revenge, while Sreeshee unmasks a child kidnapper with a personal connection to his past crimes. Shreoshi is abducted into a sinister organization, prompting her protector Shovan to vow revenge, as Sreeshi, reborn, seeks justice for a violent past life. An undercover team, including Shreoshi, faces exposure in a conspiratorial village, where trust is tested and past threats resurface. Central to the unfolding drama is Riya, an estranged heiress, who uncovers a vast criminal enterprise led by the powerful Prodhan, initially through a murder conspiracy and family secrets. Her friend's abduction and her own targeting for a forced marriage to bear an heir propel Riya into a relentless quest for justice. She infiltrates dangerous underworlds, interrogating subordinates and confronting various captors, while navigating betrayals and suspicious alliances, particularly with the enigmatic Gourav/Sourav. The narrative introduces themes of reincarnation, as Riya reveals Rubel as a murderer to Sreeyoshi, and later, Riya herself manifests burgeoning supernatural powers. Riya's journey culminates in a direct confrontation with Prodhan/Pradhan, exposing his exploitation of women under the guise of tradition. With her sister Shreyoshi, Riya prepares for a final stand, leading to a tense standoff broken by a granary fire set by her protector, Sourav, which exposes Pradhan's corruption. Simultaneously, a police unit raids a human trafficking operation, rescuing numerous women and dismantling a larger criminal network. The show ultimately depicts a fierce heroine's fight for liberation, justice, and the dismantling of oppressive systems, as she orchestrates revenge against those who exploited her and others.

toot-gaya-rakhi-ka-bandhan.description: When betrayal and jealousy shatter the deep bond between Aryan and his sisters Ishita, Myra, and Ruhi, Samar’s entry sparks a storm of lies and heartbreak. ‘Toot Gaya Rakhi Ka Bandhan’ is the emotional journey of love, sacrifice, and a brother’s fight for acceptance. Watch Now!

pyaar-ka-dose.title: Pyaar Ka Dose
pyaar-ka-dose.description: She came to treat wounds, but ended up healing her own. Treated with Love is an emotional rollercoaster of second chances, silent heartbreaks, and an unexpected connection that changes everything. Watch Now!

cloud-by-sea.title: Cloud By Sea
cloud-by-sea.description: নায়ক-নায়িকার তিন বছরের কন্ট্র্যাক্টচুয়াল বিয়ে—না সন্তান, না ডিভোর্স। হঠাৎ নায়কের ছোটবেলার বান্ধবী, এখন কোম্পানির ডিরেক্টর, ফিরে এসে ওকে বিয়ে করতে চায়। এদিকে নায়িকা এই বন্ধন থেকে বেরিয়ে আসতে চায়। শুরু হয় জটিল মানসিক টানাপোড়েন।

lucifer-my-boyfriend-from-hell-5.title: LUCIFER, MY BOYFRIEND FROM HELL
lucifer-my-boyfriend-from-hell-5.description: “LUCIFER, MY BOYFRIEND FROM HELL” follows the King of Hell, Lucifer, who makes a daring wager with his brother Gabriel over humanity’s fate at the turn of the millennium. When God sides with Gabriel, Lucifer is punished—his soul scattered across the Earth. One fragment embeds itself in a baby girl born in an orphanage at that exact moment. The story unfolds as Lucifer, now fragmented, struggles to reclaim his lost powers, and the girl—unaware of the cosmic force within her—grows up caught between the ordinary world and something far more sinister. Their intertwined destinies drive a tale of supernatural conflict, identity, and redemption.

mrs-pie-wants-to-return-to-the-countrysi.title: Mrs. Pie Wants To return to the countryside
mrs-pie-wants-to-return-to-the-countrysi.description: After years in the city, Mrs. Pie longs for the peace of her rural hometown. But when she returns, buried secrets and old rivalries threaten her simple dream of a fresh start.

flash-marriage-with-a-big-shot-2.title: Flash Marriage with a Big Shot
flash-marriage-with-a-big-shot-2.description: Shona is trapped at the center of a family bargain when her manipulative step-mother uses the location of Shona's missing children to force her into marriage. The marriage links her to Jiang Daqiang, a powerful man with old grudges and a complicated household, and she enters the union under clear duress. At first, the arrangement looks like another prison, because Shona is still secretly searching for her children and hiding the desperate deal that brought her there. Yet Jiang Daqiang's children quickly warm to her, call her Mummy, and even help produce the marriage certificate, turning the forced union into an unexpected emotional bond. Their loyalty also suggests that the children are trying to protect their own home and their mother's place in it. Public ridicule follows when outsiders mock the marriage and spread rumors about Jiang Daqiang's looks and poverty. Those lies are later exposed when his true appearance and status come to light, showing that the family has been living under deliberate deception. As the truth surfaces, Jiang Daqiang steps in to shield the children from attack and to defend the fragile family he is trying to hold together. The conflict widens beyond one household into repeated public confrontations, status games, and family humiliation, with rivals, exes, and stepfamily members all trying to seize control. In parallel, other women are pushed into domestic bargains, contract marriages, or shelter arrangements, showing a wider world where survival often depends on compromise. Several stories revolve around children being used as leverage, whether through custody threats, hidden parentage, or emotional manipulation. One thread reveals a woman with inherited divine strength, adding a separate layer of identity and legacy to the show's web of secrets. Another thread follows corporate and social power struggles, where hidden CEOs, borrowed villas, and public exposure repeatedly overturn appearances. The search for abducted or missing children becomes one of the strongest emotional engines in the show, tying together guilt, secrecy, and the hope of reunion. Across the batch digests, mothers, fathers, and children keep colliding with lies about identity, ownership, and belonging. Even when a family seems to win back power, the victory is fragile because another secret, ultimatum, or warning is always waiting. By the end of the available material, the central stakes remain unresolved: Shona still wants her children back, the marriage remains both refuge and trap, and every family bond is under pressure from deception and control.

the-mysterious-ceo.description: Born to Be the Final Boss

nee-varuvaai-ena.title: Nee Varuvaai ena
nee-varuvaai-ena.description: The microdrama opens with Kabir Mehra's tumultuous return after a three-year absence, immediately thrusting him into a battle for his marriage and reputation. He faces aggressive demands for divorce from his formidable mother-in-law and ambitious suitor Rohit, while his own father harbors deep resentment over a past tragedy. Kabir is publicly humiliated and accused of theft by an executive, leading to his dramatic arrest. However, a shocking twist occurs when powerful CEO Ms. Singhania reveals Kabir's true identity as the esteemed Chairman of a rival company, exposing a profound, undisclosed connection between them. This revelation marks the beginning of Kabir's calculated revenge against those who wronged him, as he systematically dismantles the empires of figures like Malhotra and Manav. Amidst corporate power plays and public confrontations, Kabir asserts his authority, declaring himself the new Chairman and claiming Roohi as "the Chairman's wife." Roohi, initially viewing him as "useless," undergoes a transformation in her perception as she discovers his secret power. A complex love triangle involving Kabir, Roohi, and rivals like Manav and Mana emerges, testing Roohi's loyalty and forcing her into uneasy alliances. Kabir's vendetta is driven by a desire to protect his sister, expose hidden family truths to his father, and seek vengeance for past injustices, including a past assault and forced divorce. The conflict escalates with high-stakes confrontations at elite events, threatening to unravel powerful empires and long-held secrets. As Kabir and Roohi navigate their transforming relationship, a formidable female antagonist emerges with a vengeful agenda against them, adding another layer of peril. The series explores ambition, betrayal, and social class dynamics as Kabir reshapes their elite world through his ruthless ascent and quest for vindication.

you-are-like-the-wind-passing-by-my-pill.title: You Are like the Wind Passing by My Pillow
you-are-like-the-wind-passing-by-my-pill.description: Stella's seemingly perfect eight-year marriage to Bharath unravels as she uncovers a devastating web of infidelity and financial deception. Her initial suspicions, sparked by trivial details, solidify into conviction despite dismissals from her friend Soumya. Stella discovers Bharath has systematically transferred their wealth to a mysterious woman, is having affairs with his model Zia, and even her own assistant, Vendy. Betrayed and isolated, Stella resolves to seek retribution, meticulously planning a dramatic confrontation. Her investigation deepens, revealing a complex network of deceit, with Soumya emerging not as an ally but as Bharath's mistress and a cunning antagonist. Through hidden cameras and intercepted communications, Stella gathers undeniable proof of Bharath's secret double life and his manipulation of Soumya in corporate schemes. The conflict escalates into fierce corporate rivalry as Stella uncovers a conspiracy by Bharath, Soumya, and Vendy to destroy her and her company. Vendy, initially a mole, becomes a double agent for Stella, providing crucial intelligence. Stella dramatically exposes Bharath and Soumya's affair, imposing a strict "probation period" on Bharath, fueled by distrust and a quest for redemption. However, the betrayal continues as Stella, also known as Deepa, discovers Bharath's affair with Laila, who is also involved in their daughter Meena's mysterious injuries. Fueled by a desire for vengeance and to protect Meena, Stella, aided by allies, uncovers irrefutable evidence of Bharath's lavish spending on Laila. Stella then forms an alliance with Soumya, who, having been manipulated and abused by Bharath, seeks her own vengeance. Together, they orchestrate an elaborate corporate and financial trap, strategically dismantling Stella's own career to protect assets and using a high-stakes art exhibition to financially ruin Bharath. The bitter divorce and custody battle for their sick daughter, Meena, intensifies, revealing a chilling plot by Bharath, Laila, and Bharath's mother to harm Meena for financial gain, leading to her abduction and a sinister plan to drown her. Stella relentlessly pursues revenge, uncovering Layla's criminal past and hidden pregnancy, using this information to orchestrate further financial ruin for Bharath's family. Her manipulative schemes culminate in framing Layla for infidelity, leading to Layla's miscarriage, and ultimately exposing Bharath's betrayals to force a divorce. In the aftermath of the scandal, Stella, having suffered personal losses but reclaimed her power and fortune, navigates single motherhood. She finds an unexpected second chance at happiness and a complete family with her steadfast childhood friend, Sanjay.

jamai-no-1.title: Jamai No. 1
jamai-no-1.description: Aarav, a "ghar jamai," endures constant humiliation from his wife Priya's family, who scorn his perceived lack of wealth and ambition, while actively pushing Priya towards the affluent Vikram. Despite Priya's attempts to defend him, Aarav remains stoic, secretly harboring a meticulously planned scheme for revenge and corporate dominance. His true power is dramatically revealed when he inherits the vast Mittal Global Empire, declaring "The game has begun," signaling a dramatic shift in power. Priya finds herself caught between her family's materialism and her love for Aarav, facing immense pressure and distress. The Mehta family business later faces imminent financial ruin due to betrayal, prompting Priya's mother to consider a forced marriage between Priya and Vikram, who offers to save their assets. However, their massive debt is inexplicably cleared by an unknown entity, sparking confusion. Simultaneously, a mysterious tycoon, A. Mittal, claims Priya as his wife, leading to public scrutiny and a violent confrontation where Arav, Priya's companion, is dramatically revealed as a secret billionaire. Aarav, initially accused of theft and betrayal, is then dramatically unmasked as Mittal, the long-lost heir to a powerful global empire, his hidden identity part of a calculated revenge plot. Priya grapples with this devastating betrayal, questioning Aarav's true intentions and the foundation of their three-year relationship, yet her love and trust in him persist despite her family's warnings. Aarav Mittal, now a ruthless CEO, systematically decimates the empires of figures like Vikram Singh Rathod and the Mehta family, igniting their desperate quests for retribution. Vikram, feeling wronged, plots extreme measures against Priya and seeks to expose Aarav as an impostor. At a high-stakes corporate party, Aarav is publicly accused of fraud by Mr. Rathore but defiantly claims ownership, with a powerful corporate titan inexplicably deferring to him. Vikram's world crumbles as his father reveals their empire's ruin and impending arrest, blaming Vikram. Ultimately, Aarav Mittal, after three years of living anonymously, returns to reclaim his position, introducing his wife Priya as co-chairperson, hinting at a past of betrayal and a future built on redemption and a formidable partnership.
