జమున--వెండితెర-సత్యభామ.description: వెండితెర సత్యభామగా వెలిగిన జమున సినీ ప్రయాణం? తన సినీ జీవితంలో ఎదురైన సవాళ్లు ఏమిటి? వాటిని ఆమె ఎలా అధిగమించింది? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

the-truck-stop-killer.title: The Truck Stop Killer
the-truck-stop-killer.description: Truck Stop Killer AKA Robert Benjamin Rhoades, ka 18-wheeler truck ban gaya ek mobile torture chamber ya yu'n kahe maut ka naya ghar. Zanjeer, hathkadiyaan, aur khatarnaak auzaaron se lais, usne kayi mahilaon ko apne kabze mein liya aur torcher kiya. Aakhir kaise aur kyon karta tha wo ladkiyo'n ka shikaar? Suniye, is khaufnak shikari ki sachchi kahani sirf Kuku FM par!

jimmy-george-the-god-of-indian-wolleybal.title: Jimmy George: The God Of Indian Volleyball
jimmy-george-the-god-of-indian-wolleybal.description: അകാലത്തില്‍ പൊലിഞ്ഞുപോയ വോളീബോള്‍ ഇതിഹാസത്തിന്റെ ഓര്‍മ്മകളിലൂടെ ഒരു യാത്ര. മലയാളത്തിന്റെയും ഇന്ത്യയുടെയും അഭിമാനമായ ഒരേയൊരു ജിമ്മി ജോര്‍ജ്ജിനെ അടുത്തറിയാം.

చార్లీ-చాప్లిన్-.title: చార్లీ చాప్లిన్
చార్లీ-చాప్లిన్-.description: చార్లీ చాప్లిన్ ప్రపంచ సినిమా చరిత్రలోనే అత్యంత ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన నటుడు. ట్రాంప్ వేషంలో ప్రపంచాన్ని మంత్రముగ్ధులను చేసాడు చార్లీ చాప్లిన్. ఈ కామెడీ బ్రహ్మ గురించి ఇంకాస్త తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

defying-destiny-2.title: Defying Destiny
defying-destiny-2.description: An ambitious disciple accidentally unlocks the path to immortality, challenging centuries of sacred traditions. As his powers grow, so do the forces determined to silence him forever.

my-2-fiances-3.title: My 2 Fiances
my-2-fiances-3.description: As Iris and her wealthy boyfriend Rick prepare to marry after seven years together, she sees news of him announcing marriage to another woman. Is Rick being manipulated, or is there more to the story?

goli-soda-or-natural-juice-stall.title: Goli Soda or Natural Juice Stall
goli-soda-or-natural-juice-stall.description: Goli Soda or Natural Juice Stall

if-i-had-superpowers.title: If I Had Superpowers
if-i-had-superpowers.description: A struggling young man stumbles upon mysterious superpowers, thrusting him into a world of corporate betrayal, dangerous enemies, and unexpected allies. As he learns to harness his new abilities, he must fight not just for survival, but for the people he cares about and the truth behind his powers. Watch Now!

overcoming-obstacles-the-counter-attack-.title: Overcoming Obstacles: The Counter attack On The Twin Babies
overcoming-obstacles-the-counter-attack-.description: Once torn apart by betrayal, a young mother and her newborn twins were left to face a cruel fate. Thought to be lost, the children survive  growing up far from the love they deserved. But destiny has other plans. Years later, the twins return. Behind their innocent smiles lie brave hearts filled with love for the mother they never knew  and a quiet determination to make things right. As they search for the truth and fight for justice, they cross paths with a kind stranger who becomes their strongest ally.This is a heartfelt journey of hope, healing, and the unbreakable bond between a mother and her children  told through the eyes of two remarkable little souls who refuse to let go of love.

tangled-ties-and-tipsy-vows-4.title: Tangled Ties and Tipsy Vows
tangled-ties-and-tipsy-vows-4.description: Carol Evans is initially blackmailed by her manipulative stepmother into a contract marriage with powerful CEO Grayson Walker, using her ailing father's life as leverage. Her stepsister, Rose, complicates matters by pursuing Carol's first love, Dylan Winston, and later Grayson himself, fueling a bitter sibling rivalry. Adopting the identity 'Carol' to protect her father, she becomes entangled with Dylan, who, driven by a past betrayal, seeks revenge by making her his executive assistant. Amidst corporate intrigue and accusations of gold-digging, Carol navigates a burgeoning, yet forbidden, connection with Grayson, while also facing the vengeful obsession of CEO Sanjay. Her father's mysterious disappearance and transfer to a mental institution by her stepmother, Sophia, further destabilize her life, leading to her dispossession and being fired. Carol's past manipulation of Grayson is exposed, and she endures cruel shaming and physical abuse from various figures, including Grayson, who becomes increasingly possessive. She attempts to assert independence but is caught in a mercenary plot orchestrated by Grayson, who holds financial control over her. Eventually, Grayson holds Carol captive, subjecting her to physical violence and psychological torment, accusing her of betrayal involving Dylan. Feeling responsible, Dylan, now a powerful CEO, launches an investigation into a hospital incident connected to Carol and initiates a ruthless corporate takeover against Grayson to rescue her. After her father's tragic death, Carol confronts Kiran, who admits involvement in the murder, while Rose confesses to murdering Dylan's father and schemes to separate Carol and Dylan. Dylan is gravely injured, and Carol fakes a coma to expose his loyalty and uncover truths. Despite these betrayals and life-threatening challenges, Carol and Dylan reconcile, acknowledging their enduring love and past support. They reclaim Carol's ancestral home with the help of an ally and ultimately marry, vowing to overcome all obstacles together, finally finding safety from Grayson's sinister threat and their manipulative families.

superstar-naukar.title: Superstar Naukar
superstar-naukar.description: The microdrama begins with Anmol, an orphan rescued by industrialist Devendranath Asthana, who becomes a loyal servant and develops a deep bond with the family, especially Devendranath's sister, Nandini. When Devendranath faces critical liver failure, Anmol selflessly donates his liver, saving his life and prompting Devendranath to alter his will, granting Anmol a significant inheritance and declaring him 'same blood.' This act, coupled with Anmol's burgeoning romance with Nandini, ignites a ruthless inheritance plot by Devendranath's greedy brother Mahendra and his wife Lalita, who also push for Nandini's pre-arranged marriage. A passionate, forbidden romance blossoms between Anmol and Nandini, but Anmol is conflicted between his loyalty and his love. A sinister conspiracy emerges to frame Anmol for harassment, orchestrated by unseen antagonists and involving Nandini's entitled prospective groom, Pranay. Despite Anmol's brave defiance against the forced marriage, Nandini ultimately betrays him, conspiring to frame him for greed and class prejudice, fearing his inheritance. Accused of dishonor and betrayal by Nandini and Devendranath, Anmol is banished, stripped of his legacy, and left destitute, facing public humiliation and assault. However, a dramatic turn sees Anmol heroically save the life of powerful film mogul Bhosale Bhau, who offers him a new beginning as a line producer in the film industry. Anmol accepts, seeking redemption and to unravel the mystery behind his unjust downfall, transforming into a superstar producer. He embarks on a calculated quest for revenge rooted in his forgotten past and stolen inheritance. Concurrently, Devendranath, now ruined and remorseful, awakens from a coma to find his fortune stolen by his closest family and a former servant, forced into servitude as a destitute beggar. Anmol, discovering Devendranath's plight, accepts his plea for forgiveness and vows to reclaim their lost honor. He masterminds an elaborate corporate revenge, using a cunning trap involving a fabricated investment deal to reclaim Devendranath's stolen business and assets from the treacherous adversaries. After successfully humbling the antagonists and legally transferring the business back, Anmol assumes leadership of Devendranath's production house, preparing to forge his own path while upholding his mentor's legacy, ready to launch his inaugural film. The show explores themes of loyalty, betrayal, class struggle, and the pursuit of justice and redemption.

billionaire-playboys-replacement-bride-4.title: Billionaire Playboy's Replacement Bride
billionaire-playboys-replacement-bride-4.description: মায়ের চাপের মুখে সে অচেনা এক মানুষের সাথে বিয়ে করে। দায় ও বিষণ্ণতায় কাতর, এক রাশ নিরাশা নিয়ে সান্ত্বনার খোঁজে একজন সহানুভূতিশীল মানুষের কাছে আশ্রয় নেয়। বিয়ের সকালে, অবাক হয়ে দেখে যে তিনি সেইই বর—এভাবে বাধ্যতাবশত বিয়েটি পরিণত হয় অপ্রত্যাশিত এক ভালবাসার গল্পে, যেখানে জেগে ওঠে আশা ও দ্বিতীয় একটা সুযোগের আলো।

papas-perfect-match.title: Papa's Perfect Match
papas-perfect-match.description:
Samar Oberoi, ek billionaire hai jise duniya Mr. Oberoi ke naam se jaanti hai, lekin apne 6 saal ke beta Ansh ke liye woh kuch bhi kar sakta hai—even if it means hiding his true identity. Riya Singh, ek strong aur self-made single mother hai, jo apni beti Nimi ke saath har din zindagi se ladti hai—bina kisi sahare ke. Ek din takraata hai Ansh Riya se aur kehta hai—"Aap meri mummy ban jao."

Isi masoomi aur jazbaat se shuru hoti hai ek kahani—jahan jhooth aur sach ke beech banti hai ek nayi family. Samar apni asli pehchaan chhupata hai, Riya apne toot chuke khwaabon ko phir se jeena seekhti hai. Par jab Riya ko pata chalta hai ki Samar hi hai asli Mr. Oberoi, sab kuch badal jaata hai.

got-you-mr-always-right-5.title: Got You! Mr. Always Right
got-you-mr-always-right-5.description: When Jane's ex and rival invite her to their engagement just to humiliate her, she hires a fake husband — charming driver Mike. What she doesn’t know: Mike is secretly wealthy and already knows who she is. As Jane steps into high society, love, jealousy, and family secrets collide in a whirlwind of drama.

bhagavad-gita-14.title: Bhagavad Gita
bhagavad-gita-14.description: మన జీవితానికి సంబందించిన ఎన్నో అనేక విషయాలు మనకి భగవద్గిత చెప్పింది.! మీరు కూడా తెలుసుకోండి ఈ వీడియో లు చూసి . !

the-little-pool-master.title: The Little Pool Master
the-little-pool-master.description: When world-renowned pool champion Akhil Gulati dies in a tragic accident, his soul mysteriously enters the body of a shy schoolboy, Arjun Sehgal. With goons threatening the Sehgal family's legacy, Arjun stuns everyone by becoming a pool prodigy overnight—guided by Akhil’s unmatched skill. As Akhil helps win the decisive match, he suddenly wakes up in his original body, realizing it was all a coma-induced miracle. A silent smile shared between Akhil and Arjun hints at an unbreakable, mystical bond.

my-ex-husbands-breakdown-after-divorce.title: My Ex-Husband's Breakdown After Divorce
my-ex-husbands-breakdown-after-divorce.description: হেনরি লিনাকে খুব ভালোবাসত, কিন্তু অলিভিয়ার কারণে একটা ভুল বোঝাবুঝি হয়। লিনা দুঃখ পেয়ে তাকে ছেড়ে চলে যায় এবং বিবাহবিচ্ছেদ চায়। শুরুতে হেনরি গুরুত্ব দেয়নি, কিন্তু লিনা চলে যাওয়ার পর সে গভীর অনুশোচনায় পড়ে এবং তাকে ফিরে পাওয়ার জন্য আপ্রাণ চেষ্টা করে।

fallen-angel-treasure-huntress-steals-he.title: Fallen Angel
fallen-angel-treasure-huntress-steals-he.description: FALLEN ANGEL TREASURE HUNTRESS STEALS HER VICTIMS HEART

talent-in-the-shadows.title: Talent in the Shadows
talent-in-the-shadows.description: Once the revered principal of India’s top martial arts school, Dharmesh is betrayed and poisoned by his best friend, left for dead. Six months later, he’s found alive—with no memory but instincts that saved him. Taken in by a kind father-daughter duo at Eden Fight Club, he starts a quiet life as a helper, until flashes of his past resurface. As Dharmesh pieces together his identity and the betrayal he suffered, a growing bond with Geet, the daughter, gives him strength. With his memories restored and purpose reignited, he prepares to confront the enemies who tried to erase him.

how-i-became-the-alpha-queen-4.title: How I Became The Alpha Queen
how-i-became-the-alpha-queen-4.description: Lilith was set to lead the Silver Claw pack, but her sister Serena betrayed her, killing their parents and framing Lilith to steal the Alpha title. Branded a rogue, Lilith finds safety—and love—with Tristan, the kind Alpha of the Starlight pack. Together, they uncover Serena’s lies, bring her down, and unite their packs.

my-boss-is-my-vicky-donor.title: Boss Daddy
my-boss-is-my-vicky-donor.description: Anjali's journey begins with public humiliation and betrayal by her fiancé, Rohan, prompting her decision to embrace single motherhood. Unbeknownst to her, her life is entangled in a web of deception, with Rajat secretly desiring to be the biological father of her child, and a mysterious orchestrator using Arun's genetic material to impregnate her, creating a donor mix-up. Amidst this, Anjali's CEO develops deep, unacknowledged feelings for her, leading to a burgeoning romance after a dramatic confession and shared near-death experience. However, her secret pregnancy becomes the subject of intense office scrutiny and malicious gossip, with a colleague plotting her exposure, while her traditional mother disapproves. As Anjali navigates societal pressures and corporate expectations, her CEO publicly defends her against paternity rumors, though he misinterprets her desire for independence as a rejection of romance. Simultaneously, Rajat confesses his profound love for Anjali, publicly claiming her child as his own to protect her from public humiliation and paternity accusations. This protection is crucial as a ruthless corporate rival, Shanaya Kapoor, conspires with Rajat's manipulative mother to sabotage Anjali's career and target her unborn child, exploiting a "system override" in her medical donor file. Anjali faces a life-threatening medical emergency during her pregnancy, revealing a rare blood type that becomes central to a larger conspiracy. Despite initial misunderstandings and Anjali's rejections, Rajat consistently demonstrates his commitment, even sacrificing his corporate empire for her. Shanaya, however, manipulates an engagement with Rajat, exploiting his matching rare blood type. The narrative culminates in Anjali's critical childbirth, with Rajat racing to save her and their child, only to be interrupted by a dramatic crash. Post-birth, Rajat, believing he has no place in Anjali's life, decides to leave and marry Shanaya. However, he soon uncovers the shocking truth: the baby is his biological daughter, due to Arun's misguided betrayal of switching donor samples. Rajat confronts and disowns his manipulative mother for endangering Anjali and their newborn. Anjali, simultaneously learning of Rajat's selfless actions and his paternity, desperately seeks his return. Her ultimatum, threatening to bring their child to him, prompts his immediate return, leading to a confrontation, a heartfelt marriage proposal, and the solidification of their family unit, despite hints of ongoing complexities.

in-search-of-jade.title: In search of Jade
in-search-of-jade.description: A young noblewoman secretly raises her child while concealing her true identity from a world that would exploit it. As enemies close in, determined to uncover and steal her lineage, she fights to protect the life she’s built in the shadows.

gita-gyaan-shlok-main-mile-samadhaan.title: Gita Gyaan: Shlok main mile Samadhaan
gita-gyaan-shlok-main-mile-samadhaan.description: The show follows Pandit Ji Brijbhushan as a steady spiritual guide who repeatedly enters ordinary lives in crisis and reframes them through the Bhagavad Gita. Across the stories, people come to him burdened by failure, grief, anger, greed, family conflict, and fear of death. He first helps an exam aspirant recover discipline after repeated failure, showing that action matters more than attachment to results. He then comforts a widower after his wife’s death and explains the separation of body and soul to soften grief. In family life, he guides a son whose frustration during lockdown has turned into rude behavior, teaching that anger destroys memory, judgment, and conduct. He also counsels a wife facing neglect and a daughter-in-law struggling to lead a factory when the family matriarch is bedridden. The show repeatedly contrasts outer success, ritual, or status with inner peace and right conduct. A wealthy merchant learns that charity and ceremony cannot calm a restless mind if he still seeks public recognition. A land dispute between brothers and pressure on a mother’s ancestral property are framed as duty conflicts, not just legal fights, and Pandit Ji urges righteous action without violence. In another thread, he remembers a former mentor whose calm professionalism and selfless work embody karma yoga in a modern office setting. A chemist’s life of comparison, financial loss, inheritance betrayal, and his wife’s cancer pushes him toward spiritual reflection and writing about Geeta wisdom. A senior civil servant trapped in a corrupt marriage is told to keep doing the right thing without fear and to let wrongdoing face its own consequences. Family tensions also surface in a reunion where a son must mediate between his wife and mother while his father is weakened by illness. A grieving hotel worker and an elderly widower both face loss and old age through the same teachings on acceptance and the soul’s endurance. The show also exposes ego in the workplace, where shallow display of knowledge is challenged by quieter, deeper understanding. In another family, inherited land and a father’s sacrifice reveal that greed and anger often hide behind claims of justice. A sweet-shop family’s growth brings conflict and regret when a younger relative’s final wish to visit Banaras is denied. At a cancer clinic, patients confront mortality, and Pandit Ji offers the Gita’s assurance that the soul is eternal. Even an orphaned boy raised in a printing press becomes part of the larger pattern, as jealousy and suspicion test the bonds of care and trust. Overall, the arc presents Pandit Ji’s guidance as a constant effort to restore humility, restraint, and duty in homes, workplaces, and moments of suffering, ending with his lessons passed on to children as a next generation of listeners.

travel-back-in-time-1991-2.title: TRAVEL BACK IN TIME : 1991
travel-back-in-time-1991-2.description: The microdrama centers on Andrew, a CEO betrayed by his brother, wife, and adopted son, who time-travels twenty years into the past to rewrite his tragic future. Armed with future knowledge, he immediately intervenes, disrupting his adopted son Christopher's engagement to protect his sister Akka and prevent a foreseen tragedy. Andrew navigates a complex web of deceit, as Christopher and Jessie attempt to frame him for paternity and seize corporate control, while he simultaneously races to save his critically ill mother, Saradha, from a corrupt medical system. He strategically aligns himself with the powerful Annie Madam, leveraging his foresight to expose fraud and secure employment. As Andrew's journey progresses, he undergoes a mysterious transformation, gaining prophetic abilities that he uses to attract success and challenge established powers. His past betrayal by a fiancée fuels a quest for revenge, leading him to partner with Annie, the General Manager of the powerful Soo family, to launch "Pan Asia Real Estate," an ambitious venture that challenges corporate giants. This endeavor unearths shocking family secrets, including a mysterious union between Annie and Andrew's brother. Andrew orchestrates his brother's marriage to Annie Madam to secure his family's future and pursues a high-stakes plan to dominate the city's real estate and industrial landscape. A fierce rivalry emerges with the ruthless Richard Leo, who seeks Annie's wealth and plots Andrew's elimination. The conflict escalates into corporate warfare and family feuds over property and power, with Andrew's true identity questioned and Richard Leo's family exposed for massive corruption. Andrew forms a dangerous pact with Robert, who is later revealed to be his brother, promising a cure for Robert's gravely ill mother in exchange for a familial bond. Despite this, Andrew faces continuous threats and assassination plots, with his family often held captive as leverage. The narrative culminates in a dramatic confrontation as Andrew, presumed dead, returns to stop Annie's forced marriage to Richard Leo, who holds Annie's parents and Andrew's family hostage. Andrew confronts Richard, rejecting his claims of corporate control and vowing devastating financial revenge. With his parents still captive and an Elder Man challenging his authority, Andrew prepares for a comprehensive battle against Richard and the powerful Leo family, setting the stage for an all-out war for his family, legacy, and love.

dont-come-im-fine-1.title: Don't Come, I'm Fine
dont-come-im-fine-1.description: একজন নারী ও একজন পুরুষ একে অপরকে ভালোবাসতে শুরু করেন এবং তাদের একটি পুত্রসন্তান জন্মায়। কিন্তু কিছু সময় পর পুরুষটি সন্দেহ করতে শুরু করে যে, সেই সন্তান আদৌ তার নিজের কিনা। একসময় খুব ভালোবাসার সম্পর্ক থাকলেও, এই সন্দেহ তাদের মধ্যে দূরত্ব তৈরি করে। কেন এই সন্দেহের জন্ম হল এবং কীভাবেই বা সত্যটা সামনে এল, তা নিয়েই গল্পের আসল রহস্য।

delivery-boy.title: Billionaire Delivery Boy
delivery-boy.description: Raghav, a struggling delivery boy in Mumbai, hides a secret past while racing through the city’s underbelly to support his family. But when he crosses paths with Priya, a bold journalist chasing a human trafficking ring, Raghav’s routine deliveries spiral into a dangerous mission — forcing him to choose between survival and justice. Watch Now!

forbidden-bonds-with-my-brothers-5.title: Forbidden Bonds with My Brothers
forbidden-bonds-with-my-brothers-5.description: এক অনাথ মেয়ে তার অপ্রত্যাশিত সম্পর্ক খুঁজে পায় একটি শক্তিশালী পরিবারের সাথে, যা কর্পোরেট কেলেঙ্কারিতে জড়িত। তার ভাইদের মধ্যে তীব্র প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বিতায় জড়িয়ে পড়ে, সে বিশ্বাসঘাতকতার মুখোমুখি হয় এবং ন্যায়বিচারের সন্ধান করে। তার এই যাত্রা তাকে পরিচয় পুনরুদ্ধার এবং পারিবারিক সম্পর্কের জটিলতা নিয়ে গভীর অনুসন্ধানের মধ্যে দিয়ে নিয়ে যায়।

fighter-ceo.title: Fighter CEO
fighter-ceo.description: The series introduces Samrat, a decorated military officer and secret CEO, who returns to Mumbai with a hidden agenda: to declare his love for entrepreneur Tanika, whose career he secretly funded. However, his plans are complicated when Tanika, driven by materialistic ambitions, cruelly dismisses him, unaware of his true identity and his role as her secret benefactor. Simultaneously, Samrat encounters the formidable CEO Priya Chopra, who boldly declares him her future husband, setting the stage for an unexpected romance amidst corporate intrigue. As corporate crises unfold, Samrat, operating under various aliases, strategically intervenes to save Priya's company while meticulously orchestrating his revenge against Tanika. Their relationship evolves from a pragmatic contract marriage, proposed by Priya to escape family pressure, into a genuine partnership as they navigate intense corporate power struggles and the vehement classist rejection from Priya's wealthy family. Samrat dramatically unveils his true identity as Major Samrat Ashok Raj Singh, a powerful billionaire CEO, shocking Tanika and leading to the collapse of her career. Despite her desperate attempts to reconcile and manipulative tactics, including public declarations and a staged suicide attempt, Samrat firmly rejects her, solidifying his bond with Priya. Together, Sameer and Priya emerge as united co-CEOs, forming a formidable power couple with ambitious corporate plans. Tanika, consumed by her dangerous obsession, eventually embarks on a journey of self-discovery through therapy, learning to prioritize self-worth and acknowledging the happiness of Sameer and Priya. The series culminates with Tanika's redemption and the celebration of Mrs. Raj Singh (formerly Tanika) and Raj Singh (formerly Sameer) as the "Business Couple of the Year," their inspiring partnership forged through overcoming painful lessons and past struggles.

billionaire-daddy-the-hunt-is-on-4.title: Billionaire Daddy The Hunt Is On
billionaire-daddy-the-hunt-is-on-4.description: মিরান্ডা নামের এক মা তার ছেলেকে বড় করার জন্য কিং পরিবারের কাছে গৃহকর্মীর কাজ নেন। কিন্তু তিনি জানেন না যে, সুদর্শন বিলিয়নেয়ার রেমন্ড কিং আসলে তার সন্তানের বায়োলজিক্যাল বাবা। ধীরে ধীরে সেই গোপনীয়তা উন্মোচিত হয়, যা অপ্রত্যাশিত এবং জটিল আবেগের দিকে নিয়ে যায়।

solo-dance-on-glass-shoes-1.title: Solo Dance on Glass Shoes
solo-dance-on-glass-shoes-1.description: The story follows a long chain of family betrayal, hidden parentage, and desperate attempts to control love, children, and inheritance. At its core are several mothers fighting to protect sick or missing children while powerful men, matriarchs, and rivals use marriage pressure, blackmail, and surveillance to force outcomes. A protective mother is trapped by blackmail, while another woman is pushed into a humiliating social position when her status is exposed. Across the show, romantic bonds repeatedly collapse under family pressure, with lovers rejecting each other, returning from the past, or turning vengeful when old wounds are reopened. A rebellious heiress cuts ties with her lover and family, showing how little room there is for personal choice in these households. Elsewhere, a betrayed man discovers a critically ill infant and demands urgent help, setting off a search for the child’s mother and a wider conflict over responsibility. Shono is also pulled between family pressure and a dangerous secret, suggesting that hidden truths are central to the larger crisis. Several women are harassed, rescued, or monitored by men who appear helpful at first but are later revealed to have their own agendas. The hospital becomes a major battleground, where illness, money, and identity are all used as leverage. One mother’s struggle to save her child leads to blackmail, secret payments, and a binding agreement that leaves her indebted even after the child survives. Another thread reveals a concealed child linked to a powerful family, and that revelation triggers outrage, forced separation, and threats of punishment. A matriarch tries to sever a young woman from her son, while a patriarch begins to suspect that the child’s medical crisis is tied to a larger conspiracy. The show repeatedly returns to mothers being told to give up their children or disappear from their lives, but they resist whenever possible. Corporate sabotage and business collapse run alongside the domestic drama, showing that power struggles extend beyond the home. Revenge also escalates into kidnapping, hostage-taking, torture, and violence, with several confrontations ending in uncertainty rather than resolution. Even when characters offer help, that help is often conditional and controlling, turning rescue into another form of captivity. By the end, the emotional stakes remain tied to survival, truth, and whether any family can be held together without sacrifice.

his-stolen-heiress.title: His Stolen Heiress
his-stolen-heiress.description:
Kayara Malhotra, ek billionaire ki beti hai, lekin apni asli pehchaan chhupakar ek intern ke roop mein zindagi jee rahi hai — ek aisi internship jahan ek galti uska sab kuchh chheen sakti hai. Office ke ek charming coffee boy Aryan se uski dosti hoti hai, jo khud bhi ek raaz chhupa raha hai. Do jhooti pehchaanein, ek asli virasat — aur beech mein ek aisi ladki Ria, jo Kayara ki zindagi, izzat aur pyaar sab kuchh chura lena chahti hai.
Kya Kayara apni asli pehchaan sabke saamne laa paayegi? Ya uski virasat kisi aur ke naam likh di jaayegi?

the-westward-anime-season-1-1.title: The Westward Anime Season 1
the-westward-anime-season-1-1.description: একটি নতুন যাত্রা শুরু হয়, যেখানে একটি দল পবিত্র ধর্মগ্রন্থ সংগ্রহের উদ্দেশ্যে রওনা হয়। মূল তীর্থযাত্রা ব্যর্থ হয়েছে, এবং দেবতারা, যারা দুর্নীতিগ্রস্ত ও অক্ষম, তাদের সেনাবাহিনী পাঠিয়েছে যাতে এটি পুনরায় না শুরু হয়। একটি রহস্যময় চরিত্রের সঙ্গে, দলটি অজানা পথে যাত্রা করে, চিরন্তন অগ্নি ও রহস্যময় চরম আনন্দের পবিত্র নগরী খুঁজে বের করার উদ্দেশ্যে।

ek-anjaani-shaadi.title: Just Married
ek-anjaani-shaadi.description: The microdrama begins with the professional intertwining of Arjun, an arrogant CEO, and Priya Nagaraj, a dutiful wife suffering from amnesia, who becomes his personal assistant. A mysterious past connection between them is hinted at, leading to growing romantic tension. The truth is dramatically revealed by Arjun's grandfather: Priya is Arjun's estranged wife, a fact unknown to both due to Priya's amnesia and Arjun's prior neglect, leaving them in disbelief. Consumed by suspicion after witnessing Priya with another man, Arjun files for divorce, despite his friend's defense. Battling severe alcoholism, Arjun is assigned Priya as a caregiver, leading to an undeniable chemistry despite his initial resistance and a profound dislike for her name, hinting at a complex past and possibly a contract marriage. Priya's career is then jeopardized by manipulative Nikhil's false accusations and a fabricated public scandal. Arjun faces pressure from his family to enter a contract marriage with heiress Anusha, but he vows to protect Priya and severs family ties. Arjun initiates divorce proceedings against Priya, causing her deep emotional turmoil, and she mysteriously vanishes after a harrowing accident. Priya's ailing grandfather, Tata, uncovers the truth of her strained marriage and empowers her to seek independence. Arjun, consumed by guilt, vows to protect Priya from an unseen adversary, and their unspoken feelings become undeniable after a reunion. Their developing relationship faces external threats from Arjun's possessive ex, Aditi, and his fiercely protective sister, Preethi. A high-stakes power struggle ensues when Arjun's mother attempts to remove Priya, prompting Priya to expose a shocking family secret about Arjun's biological parentage. The marriage is revealed to be a hidden, pre-arranged pact between their grandfathers, and Priya discovers her boss, Arjun, is her estranged husband, a fact she was completely unaware of. Despite her shock and initial desire to end the marriage, Arjun, now aware of his past misjudgments and her history, withdraws the divorce petition and embarks on a determined quest to win her back and mend their broken, mysterious marriage. The series culminates with Priya confronting Arjun about the authenticity of his love, but after a friend reveals Priya's own long-held, unspoken feelings for Arjun, they reconcile, affirming their mutual love and journey from doubt to the enduring power of love.

could-this-be-my-son.title: Could this be my son?
could-this-be-my-son.description: What if the child you rescue becomes the reason your world falls apart? This Could Be My Son is a chilling psychological drama where empathy, obsession, and hidden truths collide. Dive into a gripping tale of blurred boundaries and buried trauma. Watch Now!

the-final-boss-2.title: The Final Boss
the-final-boss-2.description: A secret Raja of the largest corporation and the richest man on Earth returns from the battlefield, only to be dumped by his childhood sweetheart, who thinks he's a clown. How will the King of all men make her regret it?

pyaar-ki-race.title: Pyaar Ki Race
pyaar-ki-race.description: When runaway bride Vani crashes into the world of mysterious racer Shaurya, sparks fly amidst high-speed chases and deadly secrets. As past wounds resurface and dark truths unravel, their intense bond is tested by betrayal, danger, and love that defies all odds. "Racing for Love" is a fiery romance-thriller where every heartbeat echoes like a revving engine. Watch Now!

draculas-kiss-spellbound-by-a-doppelgang.title: Dracula's Kiss: Spellbound by a Doppelganger
draculas-kiss-spellbound-by-a-doppelgang.description: After her boyfriend Neil’s betrayal, Flora seeks revenge by impulsively marrying his enigmatic elder relative, Vittorio. But Vittorio is no ordinary man — he’s a vampire with a dark past and a secret obsession. In his study, Flora finds a photo of a woman who looks exactly like her… taken eighty years ago.

shelter-in-the-mafia-3.title: Shelter in the Mafia
shelter-in-the-mafia-3.description: After losing everything to her cheating husband, Tasha finds unexpected kindness from a taxi driver named Ken. Though fate pulls them apart, Ken keeps returning — and a deep romance begins to bloom. But behind his gentle smile lies a secret: Ken is the son of a mafia boss, chasing shadows from his past.

falling-for-the-prince.title: Falling for the Prince
falling-for-the-prince.description: Yuvraj Kapoor, a prince with a hidden identity, enrolls in college as a commoner to help Sara take revenge on her deceitful boyfriend, blurring the lines between royalty and everyday life.

alludu-adhurs.title: Alludu Adhurs
alludu-adhurs.description:
ఒక ఊరి మామూలు వ్యక్తి… బిలియన్ డాలర్ కంపెనీకి CEOగా తిరిగివచ్చినప్పుడు…

అతని నిజాయితీ ప్రశ్నించబడుతుంది, కుటుంబం背 తిరుగుతుంది, మరియు అబద్ధాల జాలం అతను నిర్మించిన ప్రతిది ధ్వంసం చేయడానికి సిద్ధంగా ఉంది. కానీ గౌరవం, ప్రేమ, మరియు ఒక రహస్య ఆయుధంతో, అతడు తిరిగి తన గౌరవాన్ని సాధించాలి… అసలైన మోసగాడెవరో ప్రపంచానికి చూపించాలి.

love-and-betrayal.title: Love and Betrayal
love-and-betrayal.description: When ambitious architect Aarohi is betrayed on her engagement day, a mysterious stranger offers her a new beginning — with strings attached. As secrets unravel and love clashes with deception, her journey turns into a rollercoaster of power, betrayal, and redemption.

once-in-1998.title: Once in 1998
once-in-1998.description: Rehan, a betrayed husband on his deathbed, is granted a shocking second chance: he wakes up in 1998, determined to rewrite his fate. As he navigates love, betrayal, and ruthless power games, Rehan uses his future knowledge to protect Simran and build a business empire into a gripping time-travel saga.

marriage-as-a-debt-of-gratitude.title: Marriage as a Debt of Gratitude
marriage-as-a-debt-of-gratitude.description: On her wedding day, An Ran is betrayed by her fiancé and family — and loses everything, including her life. Reborn with vengeance in her veins, she forces her enemy’s rival into marriage to begin her path of revenge. But as love unexpectedly blooms, An Ran must choose between justice and the new future she never saw coming.

my-ceo-made-me-pregnant.title: My CEO Made Me Pregnant
my-ceo-made-me-pregnant.description:
ఎమోషనల్, హై-స్టేక్ రొమాంటిక్ డ్రామా

శక్తివంతమైన రహస్యాలు, మోసాలు, దాచిన గుర్తింపులు ఒక్కసారిగా ఢీకొన్నప్పుడు... లీనా అనే మెరుగైన టెక్ జీనియస్ తన స్థానం తిరిగి పొందటానికి, మరియు తాను మోసుతున్న శిశువు రక్షణ కోసం పోరాడుతుంది. కార్పొరేట్ యుద్ధాల మధ్య, భావోద్వేగ తుపాన్లలో, ఆమె ఎన్నో అబద్ధాలనూ బహిర్గతం చేయాలి, కుట్రల నుంచి తప్పించుకోవాలి – మరియు గతంలో ప్రేమించిన మనిషికే ఇప్పుడు ఎదిరించాలి.

misty-medical-immortal-5.title: Misty Medical Immortal
misty-medical-immortal-5.description: A small-town healer with secret powers enters a world of chaos, conspiracies, and cold-blooded betrayal. But in the fight for truth and love, can Henry—descendant of divine medicine—heal what fate has shattered? Dive into this gripping saga of strength, science, and spiritual legacy.

gone-yet-loved-by-him-2.title: Gone, yet loved by him
gone-yet-loved-by-him-2.description: For three years, Bellway Zouch loved Eason Gold — but she was only a substitute for his childhood sweetheart. When the truth breaks her, she decides to leave the country, giving herself one month to let go. Just as she finds the strength to move on, Eason realizes too late that his true love was Bellway all along.

love-at-50-tu-hi-hai-ibadat.title: Love at 50 - Tu Hi Hai Ibadat
love-at-50-tu-hi-hai-ibadat.description: A wealthy businessman, Vikram Singh Rathod, is caught off guard when his daughter invites a group of women to his office, hoping he’ll choose a life partner. To escape, he falsely claims to be married. Meanwhile, Avni Verma, pressured by her daughter-in-law to marry into wealth, also lies about her marital status. Seeking a fake marriage certificate, they meet and agree to a no-strings-attached union, with Avni concealing her identity. But fate intervenes—Vikram accidentally injures Avni, who reenters his life a year later as a cleaner in his office. As Vikram’s daughter insists on meeting her “stepmother,” Avni steps in to play the part, still unaware they are legally married. Amid mistaken identities and emotional chaos, they develop genuine feelings for each other. Eventually, as they attempt to formally divorce and end the charade, they realize they had been truly married all along.

the-officer-fell-for-me-4.title: The Officer Fell For me
the-officer-fell-for-me-4.description: Lorenzo finds a photo of Jane in a fallen comrade’s belongings and vows to protect her, mistaking her for a war widow. Misunderstandings, jealousy, and betrayal drive them apart — until Jane uncovers a deadly conspiracy. When she’s trapped seeking revenge, Lorenzo returns, saves her, and proves their love can survive even the battlefield.

ragasiya-snegithane.title: Ragasiya Snegithane
ragasiya-snegithane.description: A woman starts falling for her charming male boss while adjusting to a new job, but a hidden truth complicates everything. She’s already married to a man she barely knows. Their rare encounters have left their relationship a forgotten shadow of a commitment.

return-of-heiress.title: Return of Heiress
return-of-heiress.description: The microdrama begins with the mysterious disappearance of four-year-old Natasha, whose grandfather inexplicably transfers his vast fortune to her, setting off a chain of family greed and betrayal. Two decades later, a cunning woman named Dolly is coached to impersonate the long-lost heiress, successfully infiltrating the wealthy Randhawa family, though the patriarch, Mr. Randhawa, harbors doubts. Concurrently, a street-smart Natasha, bearing a distinctive birthmark, encounters Rahul Randhawa and his Uncle, who suspects a hidden family connection to her. Natasha faces repeated public humiliation and false accusations from Dolly and her accomplice, Viren, at high-society events, highlighting stark class conflicts. A dramatic love triangle emerges as Kunal Nanda, Dolly's fiancé, defies his manipulative mother and societal expectations to defend Natasha, escalating tensions. As Natasha navigates corporate intrigue, she faces public demotion and attempts by Dolly to steal credit for her designs, while a crucial financial contract mysteriously vanishes. Kunal fiercely defends Natasha against his formidable matriarch mother, who opposes their forbidden love and demands an arranged marriage for him, even as he grapples with the revelation of his adoption. A ruthless 'Boss' orchestrates a sinister plot to manipulate Rahul into transferring his property, hinting at deeper family secrets. The corporate rivalry intensifies when Dolly frames Natasha for theft, but CEO Vikram reinstates Natasha and soon suspects she is his biological daughter, a revelation later confirmed by DNA tests. This discovery threatens his empire and prompts a desperate search for Natasha, who is also dealing with her mother Malti's critical injury and seeking financial aid from Kunal, who secretly harbors manipulative corporate ambitions against Rahul. A critical misunderstanding shatters Natasha and Kunal's trust, leading to a forced separation orchestrated by the powerful Mrs. Randhawa to save Natasha's critically ill mother. Rahul's controversial decision to save Malti ignites a fierce family war, resulting in his poisoning. Natasha is unknowingly revealed to be Mrs. Randhawa's long-lost daughter and the true heiress, making her a target for her manipulative uncle, Vikrant, who confesses to poisoning her father and plans to use her as a pawn. Kunal is subjected to sadistic torture by Rohit and Dolly, forcing his aunt to sign away everything to save him and Natasha. Dolly's world is shattered by Natasha's true heir revelation, igniting Dolly's vengeful plot to destroy Natasha's life. Natasha uncovers a profound lie underpinning her past suffering, forcing her to confront a fabricated reality, while Dolly maliciously drugs Kunal to frame him for infidelity. Despite these ongoing conflicts and deceptions, and Kunal's grave injury and subsequent manipulation for commitment, Natasha and Kunal eventually become engaged, though a bittersweet comment from Natasha's father hints at unresolved past heartbreaks.

star-moon-romance-rejected-and-reborn-as.title: Star Moon Romance: Rejected And Reborn As Alpha
star-moon-romance-rejected-and-reborn-as.description: মা-বাবা খুনের মিথ্যা দোষে অভিযুক্ত হয়ে নিরপরাধ উল্ফলেস ফোবিকে তার পুরো পরিবার ত্যাগ করে। যার ওপর সে ভরসা করেছিল, সেই এসটাও মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয়, সঙ্গী হিসেবে তাকে অস্বীকার করে। ভালোবাসা ভেঙে গিয়ে, সে একা পড়ে যায়… কিন্তু ভাগ্য এখনও শেষ কথা বলেনি।

rented-girlfriend.title: Rented Girlfriend
rented-girlfriend.description: Shivi, a strong-willed woman with emotional scars, and Avi, a billionaire entangled in family power games. What begins as a pretend relationship spirals into a complex web of emotional conflicts, buried secrets, and shifting loyalties. As personal agendas collide, both must navigate truth, trust, and their evolving connection.

migrant-workers-love-story-2.title: Migrant Worker's Love Story
migrant-workers-love-story-2.description: The microdrama centers on Shankar, a struggling construction worker, whose life takes an unexpected turn when the wealthy heiress Miss Lily offers him a contract marriage for a substantial sum to appease her traditional grandfather, Dadu. This transactional union, initially a high-stakes charade to maintain family standing and escape Dadu's demands, thrusts Shankar and his skeptical son into a lavish world of deception. Their forced proximity ignites a battle of wills, hinting at an unexpected connection amidst the scrutiny from Dadu and a sneering antagonist, while a corporate sabotage plot looms. It is soon revealed that Shankar, also known as Titan, is not a common laborer but a former CEO and Dadu's youngest grandson, who had been posing as an impoverished worker. His hidden identity unravels amidst corporate intrigue and family betrayals, as he subtly manipulates events and faces public humiliation and accusations of fraud, with Lily implicated as his accomplice. Lily, now CEO of the Lawrence Group, initially dismisses Titan and terminates their contract, asserting her authority. However, Titan, seeking vindication, initiates a hostile takeover of the Lawrence empire, while Lily's manipulative second brother engages in insidious internal sabotage. The conflict escalates dramatically when Lily is lured into a dangerous trap and kidnapped, prompting Titan to reveal his past as a highly trained operative to lead her desperate rescue. Their mission is complicated by betrayal from a figure named Danny, who attempts to murder Lily, only for a mysterious figure, Ronaldo, to intervene. Ultimately, Dadu reconciles with the couple, naming Katy (Lily) as the new head of the Lawrence family and Titan as CEO, solidifying their intertwined destinies within the family empire and transforming their initial deceptive union into a powerful partnership.

divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-1.title: Divorce A Billionaire To Marry Him
divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-1.description: ওরা ছিল "আইনগতভাবে বিবাহিত" — একটি চুক্তির বন্ধনে, আবেগের নয়। সই করার পরই দুজন চলে যায় আলাদা পথে। এক বছর পর, ভাগ্য আবার মিলিয়ে দেয় ওদের — এবার একজনে বস, আর অন্যজন তার ব্যক্তিগত সহকারী। কেউই জানে না যে ওরা আসলে আগে থেকেই স্বামী-স্ত্রী। একসাথে কাজ করতে করতে সম্পর্কের সীমারেখা মুছে যেতে থাকে, আর ধীরে ধীরে গড়ে ওঠে অনুভবের এক নতুন বন্ধন। কিন্তু তাদের এই গোপন বিয়ে দাঁড়িয়ে যায় এক মানসিক দেয়াল হয়ে। যতই সম্পর্ক গভীর হয়, ততই প্রশ্ন জাগে — ওরা কি অতীতের মুখোমুখি হয়ে নিজেদের অনুভূতির কথা স্বীকার করবে, নাকি নিরবতা ও দূরত্ব ওদের আরও আলাদা করে দেবে?

ishq-mera-risky.title: Ishq Mera Risky
ishq-mera-risky.description: Ek 21 saal ki ladki… ek 40 saal ka professor… aur ek raaz jo sab kuch badal dega! Kya ye sirf mohabbat hai, ya kisi bade toofan ki shuruaat?

super-can-pick-up-the-missing-king-2.title: Super Can Pick up The Missing King
super-can-pick-up-the-missing-king-2.description: ఒక విచిత్రమైన సూపర్‌హీరో జనిటర్, జ్ఞాపకశక్తి కోల్పోయి, తప్పిపోయిన రాజును చూస్తాడు. అనూహ్యంగా ఏర్పడిన ఈ బంధం వారిని ఒక క్రేజీ యాత్రలోకి నడిపిస్తుంది—తమ సింహాసనం మాత్రమే కాదు, నిజమైన గుర్తింపును కూడా తిరిగి పొందేందుకు.

revenge-of-jewel-queen.title: Revenge of Jewel Queen
revenge-of-jewel-queen.description: From the opulent halls of Khanna Jewels to the power corridors of Mehra Diamonds, Aarti Khanna’s story as Rashmi Verma is one of ambition, heartbreak, and self-discovery. “Ummeed” brings you a tale where one woman’s truth changes everything.

the-immortal-emperor-returns-my-wife-pul.title: The Immortal Emperor Returns My Wife Pulled Out My Oxygen Tube
the-immortal-emperor-returns-my-wife-pul.description: The Immortal Emperor Returns My Wife Pulled Out My Oxygen Tube

the-couple-came-from-hell-1.title: The Couple Came From Hell
the-couple-came-from-hell-1.description: যখন এক নিখুঁত দম্পতির পিছনে লুকিয়ে থাকে একটা অন্ধকার সত্য, তখন প্রতিটা সম্পর্ক, প্রতিটা সত্য মিথ্যে মনে হতে থাকে। এই যুগলের গল্প শুধু ভালোবাসার নয় — এটা প্রতিশোধ, প্রতারণা আর মানসিক খেলায় ভরা এক টানটান থ্রিলার। দেখুন এই গল্প, যেখানে প্রতিটি চরিত্রে লুকিয়ে আছে একেকটা ভয়ানক রহস্য।

at-30-i-have-a-lot-of-pocket-money-2.title: Gareeb Bana Billionaire
at-30-i-have-a-lot-of-pocket-money-2.description:
A spoiled rich heir lives a carefree life at 30, still relying on generous pocket money from his powerful family.
But when his wealth is suddenly cut off, he’s forced to face the real world for the first time.

got-you-mr-always-right-4.title: Got you! Mr. Always Right
got-you-mr-always-right-4.description: When Jane's ex and rival invite her to their engagement just to humiliate her, she hires a fake husband — charming driver Mike. What she doesn’t know: Mike is secretly wealthy and already knows who she is. As Jane steps into high society, love, jealousy, and family secrets collide in a whirlwind of drama.

love-mafia.title: Love Mafia
love-mafia.description: Don Kabir’s world is turned upside down after a mysterious night with Sanya leads to an unexpected pregnancy. As secrets unravel and enemies close in, love, blood ties, and betrayal collide in this gripping saga.

bought-for-a-billion.title: Bought For A Billion
bought-for-a-billion.description: Anika was auctioned like property—only to be claimed by ruthless billionaire Kabir, a man with secrets as dark as his past. What begins as a forced contract soon turns into a fiery war of emotions, power, and unexpected passion. Bought for a Billionaire is a stormy tale of possession, love, and the price of one woman's freedom. Watch Now!

solo-dance-on-glass-shoes.title: Solo Dance on Glass Shoes
solo-dance-on-glass-shoes.description: Hazel was blackmailed with fake inappropriate photos to stop her wedding with Henry. Terrified, she lied that she was bored of him and walked away—secretly pregnant with his child. Years later, Henry runs into her and is stunned to see a little boy who looks just like him. what happens next?

fall-into-sweet-trap-3.title: Mannipaaya
fall-into-sweet-trap-3.description: A contract marriage, two hearts drawing closer. Caitlin, struggling to survive office politics and her ex-husband's betrayal. Simon, tasked with revitalizing his family's business. When fate leads them into a loveless marriage, will they continue to abide by the contract or bravely pursue their true feelings?

my-beggar-billionaire-husband.title: My Beggar Billionaire Husband
my-beggar-billionaire-husband.description: The microdrama centers on Naina, a single mother with a mysterious past linked to a distinctive ring, whose life dramatically intertwines with Akash, a man on a quest for truth and the same ring. Initially trapped in a cruel contract marriage with the arrogant CEO Arav, Naina defiantly marries his estranged brother, Akash, revealing him as a hidden heir to a powerful legacy. Their union, built on defiance and a secret, faces immediate challenges from class prejudice, false accusations, and family estrangement, while a slow-burn romance blossoms amidst corporate intrigue. Naina navigates workplace harassment and retribution plots, finding an unexpected protector in Akash, who is also a high-ranking company President. Simultaneously, Akash embarks on a five-year plan to expose his treacherous uncle's role in his mother's murder and reclaim the Kapoor Group, facing public shaming and banishment by his formidable Dadi. The paternity of Naina's daughter, Naira, becomes a central mystery, with Naira innocently identifying Akash as her father, and Naina eventually revealing Naira was born from a one-night stand. Arav, initially Naina's fiancé and later a rival, complicates matters further, sabotaging Naina's career, kidnapping Naira, yet also, at times, protecting Naina and Naira from other antagonists, hinting at a complex battle for what he perceives as his. Akash's relentless pursuit of corporate power culminates in him exposing his uncle and reclaiming leadership of the Kapoor Group, but his hidden past and deceptions strain his relationship with Naina. Ultimately, the mysterious ring leads to a dramatic reunion where Akash recognizes Naira as his daughter, and Naina confirms his biological paternity, revealing their shared past and secret child. The series explores themes of reclaiming dignity, uncovering deep-seated truths, navigating corporate power struggles, overcoming betrayal, and protecting family amidst a backdrop of hidden identities and intertwined destinies.

married-but-available-perfume-and-moon-3.title: Married But Available: Perfume And Moon
married-but-available-perfume-and-moon-3.description: Alpha Arthur returns and defends Chloe, a humble butler, from cruelty at a grand feast. He’s drawn to her strength and breaks off his engagement to be with her. Soon, Chloe’s hidden werewolf genes awaken revealing she is his true mate.

the-billionaire-gigolo.title: The Billionaire Gigolo
the-billionaire-gigolo.description: The microdrama centers on Anushka, a pregnant heiress whose life unravels amidst profound betrayal and corporate power struggles, setting the stage for a high-stakes quest for justice and control. This narrative is woven with pervasive themes of hidden agendas and the relentless fight for honor. Her marriage to Ansh collapses due to his affair with her manipulative step-sister, Khushi, leading to a devastating divorce and a severe health crisis. This betrayal culminates in the tragic loss of her unborn child, deepening her resolve. Disinherited from Ahuja Industries by her father, who appoints Khushi as CEO, Anushka faces public shaming and her stepmother's relentless schemes, fueling her fierce battle to reclaim her rightful legacy and honor. Forced to seek employment, Anushka takes a secretary position under the formidable CEO Riyansh, a man with whom she develops a complex, fated connection, despite initial rejections and his notoriously strict nature. While navigating her professional struggles and secretly plotting Khushi's systematic downfall, Anushka confronts her unfaithful ex-husband, Kunal, who attempts to rekindle their romance, which she firmly rejects, stating their past is irreparable. Her journey intensifies when her father suddenly falls into a coma, and Anushka is unjustly declared the prime suspect, accused of attacking him for his wealth and jeopardizing her future. Desperate to uncover the truth and clear her name, she seeks crucial CCTV footage, which shockingly reveals a deeper family betrayal: her own mother and another relative attempted to kill her father and manipulated him against her. Fueled by this profound revelation and a chilling quest for vengeance, Anushka vows to seek justice for her father and herself, setting the stage for a high-stakes confrontation. She dramatically seizes control as the new CEO, stunning Riyansh, her former boss, and expelling her own sister, driven by a mysterious agenda and an unyielding thirst for revenge. Anushka suspects Khushi and Khushi's mother of attempting to murder her father, forming a strategic alliance with Riyansh, who also seeks vengeance against Khushi for her past betrayals against him, including administering a substance and sending private images. As part of their intricate scheme, Riyansh publicly proposes marriage to Khushi, but this is a deception designed to orchestrate her public humiliation, though he initially accuses Anushka of his father's attempted murder. However, working together, Anushka and Riyansh ultimately unearth irrefutable evidence proving Khushi is responsible for a death, leading to Khushi's arrest, despite her vows of future retaliation. With justice served, her family honor restored, and her corporate legacy reclaimed, Anushka's strategic alliance with Riyansh blossoms into a deep romance, and he is welcomed into her family, promising to protect her from any further threats and solidify their future together.

fake-boyfriend-6.title: Fake boyfriend
fake-boyfriend-6.description: A powerful CEO, mistaken for a waiter at his girlfriend’s family gathering, faces ridicule from her relatives. But by the end of the night, he earns their respect and wins her love.

vicious-son-in-law-dont-mess-with-me-5.title: Vicious Son In Law Don't Mess With Me
vicious-son-in-law-dont-mess-with-me-5.description: After losing her daughter and son-in-law in a tragic twist, a grieving woman is betrayed once again—this time by the very family that caused her pain. As they scheme to steal her property, she rises with unshakable courage. In a battle for justice and dignity, she fights not just for what’s hers—but for her soul’s redemption.

backstabbed-by-my-sisters.title: Backstabbed By My Sisters
backstabbed-by-my-sisters.description: Backstabbed By My Sisters follows Aaditya, a scarred orphan rescued by three sisters who raise him as their own. Together, they build a billion-dollar empire—until one fateful night, they betray him and leave him for dead. But Aaditya survives, reborn with the divine power of the mystical Trinetra Stone. As he rises from the ashes, he must confront love, revenge, and destiny to take back everything that was stolen. A gripping tale of betrayal, rebirth, and unstoppable justice. Watch Now !

ek-anjani-shadi-1.title: Ek Anjani Shaadi
ek-anjani-shadi-1.description: Aditi, later known as Suhani, enters a cold, arranged marriage with Arjun, who promptly leaves. She soon discovers her new, demanding CEO, Mr. Shikhavat, is likely her absentee husband, a fact unknown to Arjun. Despite her professional denials, Suhani finds herself inexplicably drawn to Arjun, while he, unaware of her true identity, is pressured by his grandfather to reconcile with his estranged wife. Their planned reunion is tragically derailed by a car crash, and Arjun's hidden criminal past resurfaces with the vengeful return of Vishal. Arjun, returning from the UK, mistakenly believes Suhani is living with another man, leading him to resolve to divorce her despite his grandfather's pleas. As Suhani becomes Arjun's personal assistant, their professional boundaries blur through drunken confessions and intimate tasks related to his medical recovery, sparking an unexpected emotional intimacy. Suhani faces malicious harassment at work and a public scandal, jeopardizing her career, prompting Arjun to demand she clear her name. She eventually confesses her romantic feelings for Arjun, but their developing connection is complicated by his bitter divorce and a forced arranged marriage proposal with heiress Avani Roy, orchestrated by a manipulative family member. Suhani herself grapples with her unhappy marriage, culminating in a mysterious accident and disappearance. Publicly humiliated, Suhani finds an unwavering protector in Arjun, whose focus shifts entirely to her after her hospitalization, despite his own marriage to Aswathy and pursuit of Gauri. A fierce confrontation with Arjun's mother reveals a shocking family secret: Arjun is not her biological son, escalating a high-stakes power struggle. Their burgeoning love faces external threats from a jealous Avni and Arjun's disapproving adoptive mother, while Arjun's life-threatening illness reveals his unconfessed feelings for Suhani. A bitter family feud erupts over Suhani's inheritance from her ailing grandfather, Muthachan, who wishes for Suhani to reunite with her estranged husband, Aju (Arjun). The central revelation unfolds when Suhani and Arjun, both seeking divorce, shockingly discover they are already married to each other, a fact unknown to them. This discovery, coupled with Arjun's realization of Suhani's hidden struggles as an orphan caring for Muthachan, transforms his perspective, leading him to withdraw his divorce petition and earnestly pursue reconciliation. Despite Suhani's initial rejection and bewilderment, a supportive friend encourages her to acknowledge her own long-standing love for Arjun. This intervention sparks a profound realization, leading Suhani to confess her love, culminating in a powerful reunion and mutual declaration of love between them, strengthening their connection.

wife-on-papers.title: Wife on Papers
wife-on-papers.description: When revenge meets romance, chaos is inevitable. A fierce woman, a cold-hearted lawyer, and a marriage contract that changes everything. Dive into this gripping tale of power, passion, and deception. Watch Now !

the-westward-anime-season-1.title: The Westward Anime Season 1
the-westward-anime-season-1.description: పడమటి యాత్ర అనేది స్వర్గంలోని ఓ కుట్ర. సూత్ర పదేళ్లకు పైగా అదృశ్యమైన తర్వాత, అది మళ్లీ స్వర్గానికి చిక్కకూడదని, స్వర్గం తన సైన్యాన్ని భూమికి పంపింది. సూత్రాని కాపాడేందుకు పడమటి యాత్ర మళ్లీ ప్రారంభమైంది.

naayagi.title: Naayagi
naayagi.description: A young woman defies patriarchal traditions to master an ancient martial art and reclaim her family's lost honor. Maya's journey from a silenced daughter to the revered leader of the Akhara is one of courage, rebellion, and destiny.

a-vow-of-sorrow-and-joy.title: A Vow Of Sorrow And Joy
a-vow-of-sorrow-and-joy.description:
ఒక వ్యక్తి – జీవితం చివర దశలో. ఒక అమ్మాయి – స్వేచ్ఛ కోసం కలలుగంటోంది.

ఈ ఇద్దరూ ఒక 7 రోజుల పెళ్లి ఒప్పందంపై సంతకం చేస్తారు. మొదట్లో అన్నీ నియంత్రణలో ఉన్నట్లే అనిపిస్తుంది. కానీ కొత్త సంవత్సర రాత్రి, "ఖూనీ చంద్రుడు" కింద, వారి నిజ జీవితం తెరచిక్కుతుంది.

ఒక తప్పు శారీరక సంబంధం... ఎవరికో మరణంగా మారుతుంది.

“A Vow of Joy and Sorrow” – ఇది ఒక డార్క్, ఎమోషనల్, సస్పెన్స్‌తో నిండిన కథ.

flashback-fiancee-have-we-met-3.title: Flashback Fiancee : Have we Met
flashback-fiancee-have-we-met-3.description: జ్ఞాపకాల్ని కోల్పోయిన ఓ వారసురాలు…తన మొదటి ప్రేమను కలవగా, ఆ ప్రేమ ఆమెకు గుర్తు లేకపోయినా… అతడు ఆమెను మళ్లీ ప్రేమలో పడేయడమే లక్ష్యంగా ఒక ఆట ఆడతాడు. ఒక ఒప్పంద వివాహంతో మొదలైన బంధం, కాలక్రమేణా నిజమైన ప్రేమగా మారుతుంది.

khoon-ke-badle-bewafayi.title: Khoon Ke Badle Bewafayi
khoon-ke-badle-bewafayi.description: Jia, battling terminal cancer, is ensnared in a deadly contract marriage with Kartik, forced to donate blood to the critically ill Ayesha, Kartik's true love. Kartik, driven by his obsession with Ayesha, manipulates Jia, openly flaunting his affair, wishing her dead, and orchestrating a corporate takeover that ruins Jia's company and leads to her father's arrest. Jia faces betrayal from her best friend and abuse from her father, yet finds a glimmer of hope in Dr. Dhruv, who vows to save her. As Jia seeks divorce and fights for her legacy, she discovers Kartik married her solely for her blood, and he blackmails her, demanding her father remain imprisoned if she seeks separation. Her father dies under mysterious circumstances, which Jia initially attributes to Kartik, only to later learn Ayesha orchestrated his demise by exposing him to a video of Jia's assault. Ayesha, Kartik's manipulative ex-fiancée, relentlessly plots against Jia, moving into their home, faking injuries, and ultimately planning Jia's murder. Amidst this turmoil, Jia discovers she is unexpectedly pregnant and reconnects with Viren, a man with a forgotten past connection who becomes a protector. Despite Jia's public declaration of love for Kartik under duress, she secretly plots revenge, suspecting his role in her family's downfall. Kartik, despite his cruelty, grapples with unexpected feelings for Jia, refusing to abandon her even as her health deteriorates. However, Jia is violently kidnapped, and Kartik's desperate search reveals her pregnancy and aggressive Stage 4 cancer. Caught in a dangerous crossfire, Jia ultimately succumbs to her injuries, leaving Kartik, who is declared a victor in a conflict, haunted by profound regret. The show chronicles Jia's relentless struggle for survival, freedom, and justice against overwhelming betrayal and a tragic fate.

final-boss.title: FINAL BOSS
final-boss.description: অভিরাজ সিং রাঠোর হলেন ,রাজপুতানা কর্পোরেশনের সিক্রেট  রাজা , আর  পৃথিবীর সবচেয়ে ধনী ব্যক্তিও , কিন্তু যখন তিনি যুদ্ধক্ষেত্র থেকে ফিরে আসেন, তখন তার শৈশবের প্রেমিকা তাকে একজন জোকার ভেবে নির্মমভাবে পরিত্যাগ করে। সমস্ত জনগণের  রাজা কীভাবে প্রেমিকাকে অনুশোচনা করাবেন?

unwed-but-pregnant-an-unexpected-husband.title: Unwed but Pregnant An Unexpected Husband
unwed-but-pregnant-an-unexpected-husband.description: After getting pregnant with the empire’s heir, a young woman faces surprising challenges and growing affection from everyone. Suddenly, she's at the center of attention, caught between love and political intrigue.

crowned-in-love-the-mother-of-three-bigs.title: Crowned in love. The mother of three bigshots
crowned-in-love-the-mother-of-three-bigs.description: As a single mother, May Judd raises three exceptional sons on her own, despite the challenges posed by her family. On her father’s seventieth birthday, her mother invites her to return home for a gathering. However, during her visit, May encounters unwarranted hostility from her father and younger sisters. Undaunted, she stands up to their biases and ultimately discovers her own path to happiness

aakhri-alvida.title: Aakhri Alvida
aakhri-alvida.description: Raghav Malhotra has just months to live, but he doesn’t want pity—he wants to rewrite his legacy. Enter Kiara Singh, a headstrong woman with her own battles. What begins as a contract marriage turns into a journey of healing, unexpected love, and one final shot at happiness. Last Goodbye is a deeply emotional tale of letting go, holding on, and the kind of love that outlives time. Watch Now !

amaran-1.title: Amaran
amaran-1.description: An ambitious disciple accidentally unlocks the path to immortality, challenging centuries of sacred traditions. As his powers grow, so do the forces determined to silence him forever.

groom-a-billionaire.title: My Groom A Billionaire
groom-a-billionaire.description: A runaway groom and a jilted bride cross paths in a twist of fate, sparking an unexpected marriage built on secrets and misunderstandings. As their worlds collide his wealthy identity hidden and her pride wounded—they navigate love, deception, and redemption in this romantic drama.

ghar-aaja-mere-laal.title: Ghar Aaja Mere Laal
ghar-aaja-mere-laal.description: A heart-wrenching tale of a mother's wait, a child's lost identity, and the power of love that defies decades. What happens when the truth confronts power, and blood ties test the strength of destiny? Discover an emotional rollercoaster that redefines family and belonging. Watch Now !

chinese-new-year-the-hidden-dragon-retur.title: Chinese New Year: The Hidden Dragon Returns
chinese-new-year-the-hidden-dragon-retur.description: "চাইনিজ নিউ ইয়ার: দ্য হিডেন ড্রাগন রিটার্নস টু দ্য ভিলেজ" একটি উত্তেজনাপূর্ণ গল্প—রহস্য, উত্তরাধিকার ও মুক্তির।

you-are-mine-1.title: Big Bull Hai Mera Aashiq
you-are-mine-1.description: At her own engagement party, Ananya Joshi uncovers her fiancé Rohan Rathore’s betrayal with her cousin Rhea. Determined to reclaim her power and dignity, she forms an unlikely alliance with the ruthless tycoon Vikram Singh Rathore, Rohan’s formidable uncle. But as their revenge game turns into a whirlwind of power, passion, and family warfare, Ananya must choose between vengeance and love in a battle that could destroy them all. Watch Now!

a-vow-of-joy-and-sorrow-1.title: A Vow Of Joy And Sorrow
a-vow-of-joy-and-sorrow-1.description: একজন পুরুষ, যার জীবন শেষের পথে, আর একজন মেয়ে, যে কেবল স্বাধীনতা চায়। যখন তারা ৭ দিনের এক বিয়ের চুক্তিতে স্বাক্ষর করে, তখন মনে হয় সবকিছু নিয়ন্ত্রণে আছে। কিন্তু নতুন বছরের রাতে, "রক্তচাঁদ" এর আলোয়, তাদের জীবনের আসল সত্য সামনে আসে। যেখানে একটি ভুল শারীরিক সম্পর্ক কাউকে মৃত্যুর মুখে ঠেলে দিতে পারে। অন্ধকার, আবেগঘন এবং রহস্যে মোড়া গল্প, যেখানে প্রতিটি সিদ্ধান্তের জন্য চরম মূল্য দিতে হয়।

alpha-she-wasnt-the-one-3.title: Alpha She Wasn't The One
alpha-she-wasnt-the-one-3.description: অ্যানি, এক সাধারণ মেয়ে, হঠাৎ জড়িয়ে পড়ে ওয়্যারউলফ নেতা লিয়নের সঙ্গে, যিনি চাঁদের দেবীর ভবিষ্যদ্বাণীতে বাঁধা। ভুল পরিচয় আর লুকানো স্মৃতির মাঝে, লিয়ন প্রেমে পড়ে অ্যানির বোনকে সঙ্গিনী ভেবে। কিন্তু সত্য প্রকাশ পেতেই অ্যানির ভিতরে জেগে ওঠে চাঁদের দেবীর শক্তি। এখন, কি টিকে থাকবে তাদের ভালোবাসা?

my-crorepati-husband-1.title: My Crorepati Husband

divine-level-war-doctor-3.title: Divine-Level War Doctor
divine-level-war-doctor-3.description: Ethan returns after eight years under a hidden identity, driven by a need to protect Sophie and confront the cruelty around her. He first enters her family’s matchmaking spectacle and shocks everyone by asking to marry her, even accepting humiliating financial terms without backing down. From the start, his promise is not just to claim the marriage, but to stand by Sophie and help heal the scars that her family treats as shameful. A healer becomes part of that effort, and Sophie’s recovery is tied to both emotional trust and a mysterious treatment. As the story expands, the marriage is pulled into family greed, class prejudice, and corporate warfare, with Sophie repeatedly forced to prove her worth in boardrooms and public launches. She secures major business value, but older relatives still try to strip her of authority and push her toward divorce. Ethan keeps supporting her, though his hidden status and unresolved past create tension around their bond. Rival men and women use business leverage, rumors, and public humiliation to pressure Sophie and destabilize the marriage. At the same time, buried crimes from eight years earlier surface, linking multiple families to fire, death, and revenge. Separate avengers and survivors enter the conflict, turning the show into a wider reckoning over old atrocities and present-day power. Corporate disputes over contracts, formulas, and credit become inseparable from family betrayal and succession fights. Sophie’s product efforts bring both public success and accusations of theft, making every victory fragile. Ethan’s secret influence is gradually exposed, but each revelation also draws stronger enemies toward him. The romance is repeatedly tested by jealousy, divorce threats, and mistaken loyalties, especially when other women are pulled into Ethan’s orbit. Later, Ethan’s identity crisis deepens through memory loss, ring disputes, and false accusations that threaten to erase him again. Even so, he continues to choose Sophie, and she continues to fight for his place in her life. By the end of the batch, the central stakes are clear: love, inheritance, corporate control, and revenge are all colliding around Ethan and Sophie, with no side able to fully secure victory.
