my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-3.title: My Call Boy Billionaire Daddy
my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-3.description: ওয়ার্ড পরিবারের প্রতারণায় ইনেস এক রাতের জন্য এক এসকোর্টের সঙ্গে জড়িয়ে পড়ে—যা ছিল তার কাজিনের ফাঁদ। ওই রাতেই আত্মহত্যা করেন তার দেউলিয়া বাবা। অপমান সয়ে লস অ্যাঞ্জেলেস ছেড়ে যায় ইনেস। চার বছর পর ছেলেকে নিয়ে সে ফিরে আসে। স্কাই ক্লাবে ইনেস চিনে ফেলে সেই এসকোর্টকে, ট্যাটু দেখে, আর তাকে বাধ্য করে ঋণ শোধে। এদিকে, তার CEO লুইস যেন তাকে উদ্দেশ্য করেই টার্গেট করছে—কিন্তু কেন? তাদের পুরনো সম্পর্ক কি লুকিয়ে আছে এর পেছনে?

ai-shorts-se-reel-viral-banayein.title: Ai Shorts Se Reel Viral Banayein!
ai-shorts-se-reel-viral-banayein.description: Ai Shorts Se Reel Viral Banayein!

ruthless-comeback-of-the-reborn-heiress-.title: Ruthless Comeback Of The Reborn Heiress
ruthless-comeback-of-the-reborn-heiress-.description: Wrongfully accused and betrayed by her demon-cultivator sister, Grace Braylon dies — only to be reborn through excruciating pain. She leaves her sect and emotions behind to walk the ruthless Path of Merciless cultivation. With vengeance in her heart, every step forward is a battle against the past.

tulsi-bahu-ka-bewafa-husband.title: Tulsi Bahu ka Bewafa Husband
tulsi-bahu-ka-bewafa-husband.description: Tulsi's loveless marriage to Aman Modi shatters when his manipulative friend Tanvi frames her for attempting to murder Baa. Cast out and humiliated, Tulsi transforms herself with childhood friend Bhavin's help, becoming a successful designer. When Aman discovers Tanvi's treachery—fake pregnancy, murder plots, and stolen designs—he publicly exposes her and reunites with Tulsi, finally recognizing her true worth.

after-divorce-the-ex-wife-of-the-big-sho.title: After Divorce , the ex-wife of the big shot  stirs up the world
after-divorce-the-ex-wife-of-the-big-sho.description: The microdrama begins with the abrupt unraveling of John and Jessie's four-year contractual marriage, initiated by CEO John as a cold, calculated divorce. Initially heartbroken and bewildered, Jessie transforms into a formidable and strategic force, uncovering deceit behind their union and fighting for her identity against John's family and rivals. She orchestrates a stunning power reversal, becoming a powerful corporate boss and the 'Princess of Chinese Medicine,' demanding a staggering billion-dollar settlement. Despite their separation, John's life remains intertwined with Jessie's, as he navigates corporate power struggles and family crises, while also attempting to rekindle their complicated romance. Their relationship is further complicated by external threats, including Jessie's kidnapping by crime boss Godwind, and John's father's life-threatening illness. John's manipulative cousin, Betty, emerges as a persistent rival, staging injuries and orchestrating schemes to win John's affection and undermine Jessie. Jessie faces blackmail from her manipulative father, forcing her into a critical operation for the mysterious Martin, who later claims her as his property. As John attempts reconciliation, his secrets unravel, revealing a mysterious illness linked to "Miss West" and his knowledge of Jessie's mother's death, leading to a crucible of distrust. The narrative intensifies with Betty's obsessive love for John, leading her to poison Jessie and attempt to claim John as her "wife," while John mysteriously vanishes. Jessie races against time to save John, only to face betrayal. An expert investigator uncovers a vast conspiracy involving mind-controlling substances by "North Wing groups," adding a layer of intrigue. Ultimately, Jessie and John realize they were both drugged and suffered memory loss as part of a larger plot orchestrated by a criminal mastermind, Mr. Zack, who is also linked to a 13-year-old lab fire cover-up involving Jessie's father. With this revelation, John and Jessie confront their past and vow fierce revenge against those who manipulated their lives, setting the stage for a corporate war and a quest for justice.

my-2-fiances-2.title: My 2 Fiances
my-2-fiances-2.description: এই গল্পে ফুটে উঠেছে মনোরোগ বিশেষজ্ঞ আইরিস মিলারের জীবন, যা বদলে যায় যখন সে জানতে পারে তার বাগদত্ত ঋক ব্যাসের ডিসোসিয়েটিভ আইডেন্টিটি ডিসঅর্ডার রয়েছে —একদিকে প্রেমিক ঋক দ্য লাইট, অন্যদিকে কর্পোরেট দানব ঋক দ্য শ্যাডো। লস অ্যাঞ্জেলেসের ঝলমলে অথচ প্রতিযোগিতামূলক পরিবেশে গড়ে ওঠা এই কাহিনিতে প্রেম, মানসিক স্বাস্থ্য, পরিবারিক ষড়যন্ত্র ও আত্মপরিচয়ের টানাপোড়েন তুলে ধরা হয়েছে।

billion-dollar-wala-blunder.title: Billion Dollar Wala Blunder
billion-dollar-wala-blunder.description: A wealthy couple, Shalini and Mukesh Saxena, are mistaken for frauds during a resort getaway, triggering a storm of humiliation and cruelty by a power-hungry manager. But when the truth about their identity explodes, it sets off a dramatic reckoning proving that respect can’t be bought, and karma comes with interest. Watch Now!

mr-ji-see-clearly-im-your-bodyguard-1.title: Mr. Ji, See Clearly, I'm Your Bodyguard
mr-ji-see-clearly-im-your-bodyguard-1.description: Jeni’s family forces her into an engagement with a stranger. Refusing to be a pawn, she escapes before the wedding, determined to reclaim her freedom. But her defiance turns dangerous—her own family hunts her down, ready to drag her back. To survive, Jeni disguises herself as a man and takes an unexpected job as a bodyguard to a wealthy businessman. She has no idea he’s the same man she was supposed to marry.

forever-my-prince.title: Thukra ke mera pyaar
forever-my-prince.description: Crown Prince Aarav is forced into a royal marriage with fierce commoner Mira, triggering chaos in the royal palace. As political games unfold and past secrets surface, their clash turns into chemistry, while Rajmata's manipulations threaten to destroy it all. Forever My Prince is a royal romance where duty, love, and rebellion collide. Watch Now!

secret-naukrani.title: JALLAD CEO
secret-naukrani.description: Riya, a kind-hearted young woman betrayed by her own family and thrust into a world of cruelty and deception. Just when all hope seems lost, fate brings her into the orbit of Aryan, a mysterious and powerful businessman with a buried past. As their paths collide, both love and vengeance ignite, setting off a chain of gripping events that will test every bond.

madison-county-picked-up-a-billionaire-2.title: Madison County picked up a billionaire
madison-county-picked-up-a-billionaire-2.description: একটি গরীব মেয়ের অপ্রত্যাশিত বিয়ের গল্প উঠে এসেছে, যে জানতোই না তার স্বামী আসলে একজন সুদর্শন ও প্রভাবশালী প্রেসিডেন্ট! সহজ-সরল জীবনের মাঝেই শুরু হয় রাজকীয় ভালোবাসা, গোপন পরিচয় আর নতুন জীবনের উত্তেজনাময় অধ্যায়।

commander-shourya.title: Commander Shourya
commander-shourya.description: Hawaldar Shourya is docile, obedient and powerless in front of his superiors and local goons. In a village scarred by corrupt officials and violent criminals, school teacher Indira becomes Shourya's catalyst as she awakens the hidden Commander inside the Hawaldar. Putting behind his traumatic past, Shourya transforms into the force that saves the lives of countless children from the evils of Raka and his axis of evil.

aunt-is-not-easy-to-provoke-2.title: Aunt is not easy to provoke
aunt-is-not-easy-to-provoke-2.description: এক সাহসী, বুদ্ধিমতী এবং দুর্দান্ত মহিলা গল্প, যাকে হেয় করা বা উসকানো একেবারেই সহজ নয়। শত্রুদের কড়া জবাব, সমাজের দ্বিচারিতার মুখোশ উন্মোচন এবং পরিবারে নিজের জায়গা তৈরি করে নেওয়ার এই গল্প রোমাঞ্চে ভরপুর ও অনুপ্রেরণামূলক।

the-love-that-kills-1.title: The Love That Kills
the-love-that-kills-1.description: "The Love That Kills" is a gripping drama that follows the unraveling of Raghav Malhotra's family due to the unchecked entitlement of his son Sid and father Vijay, sparked by Sid's destructive act at a luxury hotel. As tensions with Raghav's boss Srishti Mehra escalate, the series explores accountability, family dynamics, and the devastating cost of pride.

the-karate-legend.title: The Karate Legend
the-karate-legend.description: The Karate Legend - Krish is the legend Karate student who has been living in the shadow. He has been facing humiliation from his family for being weak and is always ignored. In the next years tournament he will show everyone who is the real karate genius.

fallen-into-sweet-trap.title: Fall Into Sweet Trap
fallen-into-sweet-trap.description: ఒక విడిపోయిన భార్యాభర్తల మధ్య జరిగిన గొడవలో, భర్త ఐదు రోజుల్లోనే మరో మహిళను పెళ్లి చేసుకున్నట్టు తెలుస్తుంది. మొదటి భార్య క్యాటలిన్ షాక్‌కు లోనవుతుంది. ఆమె తన త్యాగాలు గుర్తుచేస్తూ, ఇల్లు తనదేనని చెబుతుంది. కానీ భర్త ఇల్లు కొత్త భార్య పేరుకు మార్చినట్టు చెబుతాడు. చివరికి క్యాటలిన్ కోర్టులో కేసు వేస్తానంటూ, అతడు ఆమెను అనాధగా ఎగతాళి చేస్తూ, ఆమె తాను ఎదుర్కోలేదంటూ తేల్చిచెబుతాడు.

nenu-naa-raakshasi.title: Nenu Naa Raakshasi
nenu-naa-raakshasi.description: తనను ప్రేమిస్తానని మోసంచేసి, చచ్చిపోవాలని వదిలేసిన అర్జున్ చేతుల్లో ప్రియా బలైపోతుంది. కానీ అదృష్టం ఆమెకు ఇంకో అవకాశం ఇస్తుంది—అనుకోకుండా ఆమె ఎనిమిదేళ్ల క్రితం గతంలోకి వెళ్తుంది. ఈసారి, భవిష్యత్తు జ్ఞానం ఆమె చేతిలో ఆయుధం. తన జీవితాన్ని నాశనం చేసిన ప్రతి ఒక్కరిపై ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోవాలని నిశ్చయిస్తుంది. ఆ ప్రతీకారం... మాజీ నిశ్చితార్థుడు అర్జున్‌తో మొదలవుతుంది.

ek-anjani-shadi.title: Ek Anjani Shaadi
ek-anjani-shadi.description: এক নারী যখন নতুন চাকরিতে ধীরে ধীরে মানিয়ে নিচ্ছে, তখন তার হৃদয় ঝুঁকে পড়ে মুগ্ধকর এক বসের প্রতি। কিন্তু এক অজানা সত্য সবকিছু জটিল করে তোলে — সে ইতিমধ্যেই বিবাহিত, সেই পুরুষের সঙ্গে যাকে সে প্রায় চেনেই না। তাদের মাঝে খুব কমই দেখা হয়েছে, আর সেই সম্পর্ক যেন প্রতিশ্রুতির এক ভুলে যাওয়া ছায়ামাত্র।

nerd-queen.title: Nerd Queen
nerd-queen.description: Aspiring designer Naina initially faces brutal cultural bias and mockery for her Indian-inspired collection, finding an unexpected defender in a powerful industry figure. Her entry into an annual fashion competition sparks a fierce rivalry with the arrogant Kartik Randhawa, who cruelly dismisses her. Naina finds an ally and partner in Rohan, but their budding romance is threatened when Kartik, after a public rejection, orchestrates a manipulative plan to steal Naina's valuable designs by feigning romantic interest. Naina, initially drawn to Kartik's charm, defends him against Rohan's warnings, only to discover Kartik's deceit and double life, leading to public humiliation and heartbreak. Betrayed and accused of plagiarism by Kartik, Naina seeks a path to reclaim her stolen designs and artistic recognition. She forms a dangerous alliance with the reclusive and vengeful former designer, Vikram, who becomes her demanding mentor, training her to become a weapon in his quest for retribution against Jyotika Randhawa, who destroyed his career. Under Vikram's intense guidance, Naina undergoes a dramatic physical and mental transformation, shedding self-doubt and embracing inner strength. Naina rises from an unknown "Mystery Muse" to a formidable "Queen," orchestrated by Vikram Sharma, attracting Kartik's obsessive attention and Malvika's wrath. She transforms into a calculating force, driven by revenge, engaging in corporate espionage and forming deceptive alliances to dismantle rival empires, ultimately using a feigned romance with Kartik as a tool for her meticulously planned retribution. Naina, alongside Vikram Sharma, orchestrates a public exposé to dismantle industry titan Jyotika's empire, accusing her of design theft and exploiting her creative team. Concurrently, Malvika, publicly discarded by CEO Kartik, embarks on her own path of revenge, exposing unethical corporate practices and publicly confronting Kartik. Amidst these battles, a deep bond and potential romance blossom between Naina and Vikram Sharma as they launch their new brand, "Naina Johra," built on artistic integrity. Kartik attempts to reconcile with Naina, claiming genuine feelings, but she rejects him. The show culminates with Naina Prabhu establishing a revolutionary design institute to empower overlooked talent, with Naina herself becoming a co-founder, while Rohan finds love and proposes marriage, though their happiness is immediately threatened by an unknown observer, hinting at ongoing challenges and the perilous consequences of past actions.

my-cold-blooded-alpha-king-2.title: My Cold Blooded Alpha king
my-cold-blooded-alpha-king-2.description: My Cold Blooded Alpha king - Telugu

oops-i-married-a-billionaire-uncle.title: Oops! I Married a Billionaire Uncle
oops-i-married-a-billionaire-uncle.description: Oops! I Married a Billionaire Uncle

once-upon-a-divorce-the-double-life-of-l.title: Once Upon a Divorce - The Double Life of Lady Diana
once-upon-a-divorce-the-double-life-of-l.description: The series opens with Diana's world shattering after her husband's infidelity and a demand for divorce, leaving her vulnerable and alone. Wealthy CEO Henry Maxwell, needing a contract spouse to appease his parents, offers Diana the role. However, he initially pursues an online acquaintance also named Diana, creating a complex dynamic. Their pragmatic arrangement soon blurs as Henry, battling deep depression, finds unexpected solace and genuine connection with Diana, unaware of her protective secrets and her hidden identity as 'Blue.' This burgeoning bond immediately ignites fierce opposition from Henry's formidable family. His scorned fiancée, Maggie, also becomes Diana's relentless rival in high-stakes corporate and social arenas, including tense art auctions. Henry publicly defies his family, dramatically canceling an arranged engagement and revealing his secret marriage to Diana. This bold move risks his corporate empire and subjects them to intense public scrutiny. Diana, fiercely independent, rejects multi-million dollar offers to dissolve their union, further escalating her rivalry with Maggie and solidifying her commitment to Henry. The mystery surrounding the enigmatic artist 'Blue' deepens, eventually revealing Diana as the true 'Blue,' the rightful heir to the powerful Silas legacy. This revelation plunges Diana into a dangerous corporate feud between the Silas and Maxwell families. She battles to reclaim her stolen identity, artistic persona, and inheritance from her cunning adopted sister, Novia, who poses as the false 'Blue' with the support of powerful figures. Amidst these escalating power struggles, Diana uncovers corporate theft and a dangerous cover-up orchestrated by Henry's manipulative brother, Mark Maxwell. Mark attempts to disinherit Diana and even orchestrates attacks against her. Henry consistently demonstrates unwavering devotion, making significant sacrifices, including losing his entire corporate empire to save Diana from kidnapping and hostile takeovers. Despite immense family pressure, corporate ruin, and Diana's guilt, Henry reaffirms his profound love. He reveals Diana saved him from depression and highlights their deep, seven-year connection. Diana, a resilient and strategic woman, ultimately exposes Mark's past crimes and dismantles his empire. After strategically proposing divorce to legitimize their bond, she accepts a marriage proposal from a supportive Henry, signaling a hopeful new beginning amidst reclaimed legacies and solidified love.

na-umr-ki-seema-ho.title: Na Umr Ki Seema Ho
na-umr-ki-seema-ho.description: A wealthy yet lonely ex-army man, Siddharth Kapoor, crosses paths with Sana, a resilient food stall owner grappling with heartbreak, family strife, and a painful past. Brought together by Kapoor’s adopted daughter in a chance matchmaking attempt, their story unfolds into a deep emotional journey. Kapoor conceals his identity to test Sana’s sincerity, but for Sana, this bond transcends romance — ultimately leading her to an unexpected reunion with the daughter she lost five years ago.

forbidden-bonds-with-my-brothers-3.title: Forbidden Bonds with My Brothers
forbidden-bonds-with-my-brothers-3.description: Vera, the wealthy daughter of the Smith Group, loses her memory in a mishap and is taken in by a poor family. Years later, she reenters the Smith Group workforce as Samantha, a financially struggling woman. Samantha faces constant hardships from her brother Bert and biological mother due to her humble background. Fate plays a hand as she falls in love with her brother Joseph. However, as Samantha's true identity slowly emerges, the future of this taboo love becomes uncertain...

divorced-but-doted-upon-by-the-trio-2.title: Divorced But Doted Upon By The Trio
divorced-but-doted-upon-by-the-trio-2.description:
తనకే తెలియకుండా… అనస్తాసియా అనే యువతి AS గ్రూప్ అనే ప్రముఖ వ్యాపార సామ్రాజ్యానికి ఏకైక వారసురాలు.
ఆమెకి ముగ్గురు అన్నలు ఉన్నారు – అందరిలోనూ ఒకడు, తన ప్రాణాలకంటే ఆమెను ఎక్కువగా ప్రేమిస్తాడు!
ఇది ప్రేమ, నమ్మకద్రోహం, కుటుంబ బంధాల మధ్య సాగే ఓ హృదయాన్ని కదిలించే భావోద్వేగ ప్రయాణం.
ఇప్పుడే వినండి!

flash-marriage-with-a-big-shot-3.title: Flash Marriage with a Big Shot
flash-marriage-with-a-big-shot-3.description:
Ek zabardasti ki shaadi. Khoye hue judwa bachche. Aur ek aisa pati jo dikhta gareeb… par nikla billionaire!

Rachel ne sirf ek deal ke liye shaadi ki thi — apne bachchon ka pata paane ke liye. Par jis aadmi se usne shaadi ki, uske paas hai ek bada raaz... woh hai ek ameer CEO jo duniya ke liye sirf ek mask pehne baitha hai!
Jab sach samne aayega, toh kya badlegi Rachel ki duniya?
Kya woh apne bachchon tak pahunch payegi... ya usse mil jayega woh pyaar jise usne kabhi chaha hi nahin tha?
Suno ek aisi kahaani jo shuru hoti hai jhooth se... aur le jaati hai dil tak.

dont-come-im-fine.title: Don't Come, I'm Fine
dont-come-im-fine.description: జయా మరియు నిహాల్ ప్రేమలో పడతారు. వారికి విహాల్ అనే కుమారుడు ఉంటాడు. కానీ నిహాల్ మాత్రం విహాల్ తన కుమారుడే కాదని అనుమానిస్తుంటాడు. ఎంతో ప్రేమించుకున్న ఈ జంట మధ్య ఈ అనుమానం ఎందుకు వచ్చిందో, నిజం చివరకు ఎలా బయటపడిందో అనేదే ఈ కథలో అసలైన మర్మం.

trillionaire-ki-baazi.title: Trillionaire ki Baazi
trillionaire-ki-baazi.description: The microdrama centers on Abhideep Raichand, an elite pilot who leaves the military to lead Raichand Defense Systems, driven by a vow to make it the world's number one defense company. Simultaneously, Shruti Jai Shankar, CEO of her family's empire, faces imminent financial collapse due to overwhelming debt and a "bad loan default" orchestrated by Neil. Desperate to save her legacy, Shruti encounters the affluent Abhideep, who offers a substantial investment to revive her company in exchange for a one-year contract marriage, explicitly defined as a business transaction. Shruti accepts, but their arrangement is immediately tested by her family's fierce class prejudice, particularly from her brother Neil. Abhideep dramatically reveals his true identity as a decorated ex-fighter pilot and powerful CEO, shocking Shruti and challenging her family's skepticism. As Jai Shankar Industries faces an imminent auction, Abhideep steps in to save it, navigating corporate challenges, though Shruti grows suspicious of his intense interest in her family's historical documents. A figure from Shruti's past, Rajesh, returns, claiming her as his fiancé and initiating a ruthless corporate takeover plot in collusion with Shruti's brother. Under immense family pressure, Shruti is urged into a strategic engagement with Rajesh, but she uncovers his sinister plan to seize her company and mansion. She dramatically reveals her secret marriage to the influential Mr. Raichand, turning the tables on her adversaries. However, Shruti's trust in Abhideep is shattered when she witnesses his morally ambiguous and ruthless business tactics. Abhideep, now acting as an investigator, uncovers a vast conspiracy involving military-grade secrets and the hostile takeover of Jayshankar Industries, exposing Neil's embezzlement and Rajesh's manipulation. Together with Shruti, he devises a sting operation to unmask an internal traitor. Abhideep Raichand, a powerful defense magnate, then faces an assassination attempt orchestrated by his corporate rival, Rajesh Singhania. Abhideep unleashes a devastating financial war against Rajesh, revealing a chilling revenge plot for Rajesh "messing with the wrong family," specifically Shruti's. The narrative culminates with Rajesh Singhania's arrest for corporate fraud. Ultimately, Shruti announces a groundbreaking corporate merger, and her contract marriage with Abhideep transforms into a genuine, lifelong commitment, formalized by a wedding.

how-i-became-the-alpha-queen-3.title: HOW I BECAME THE ALPHA QUEEN

villa-paradise-2.title: Villa Paradise
villa-paradise-2.description: Villa Paradise -  A group of friends reunites at a secluded island villa, only to face a deadly game of revenge and betrayal as dark secrets unravel, leading to a chilling series of murders.

final-bharosa.title: Final Bharosa
final-bharosa.description: When humble home kitchen owner Sunaina marries Shashvat, she doesn't know he's secretly billionaire Shashvat Ambani testing her genuine love. As she faces cruel humiliation from her son's in-laws and searches for her missing daughter Nishi, a shocking revelation emerges—Shashvat's adopted daughter Aanya is actually Nishi. Through trials of deception, family betrayal, and hidden identities, true love ultimately triumphs.

how-i-became-the-alpha-queen-2.title: HOW I BECAME THE ALPHA QUEEN
how-i-became-the-alpha-queen-2.description: Lilith was set to lead the Silver Claw pack, but her sister Serena betrayed her, killing their parents and framing Lilith to steal the Alpha title. Branded a rogue, Lilith finds safety—and love—with Tristan, the kind Alpha of the Starlight pack. Together, they uncover Serena’s lies, bring her down, and unite their packs.

the-billionaire-wife-returns.title: The Billionaire Wife Returns
the-billionaire-wife-returns.description: Dinesh hides his true identity from his wife, Vartika, initially investing secretly in her fashion start-up out of genuine love. Their relationship faces severe turmoil when suspicions of infidelity and deception arise, primarily involving Monty, who becomes entangled in their lives, further complicating matters.

jerk-punishment-club.title: Jerk Punishment Club
jerk-punishment-club.description: A fearless young woman forms a secret club to punish the jerks who mistreat women, seeking vengeance for the injustice suffered by her sister.

defying-destiny-1.title: Defying Destiny
defying-destiny-1.description: An ambitious disciple accidentally unlocks the path to immortality, challenging centuries of sacred traditions. As his powers grow, so do the forces determined to silence him forever.

the-secret-doctor-mommy.title: The Secret Doctor Mommy
the-secret-doctor-mommy.description: Dr. Meera, a brilliant physician living a double life as a devoted mother and secret doctor. As her carefully hidden identity begins to surface, tensions rise with Ranvijay, a powerful figure from her past, and Dadi, whose instincts sense the truth. With love for her child and loyalty to her profession clashing, Meera must protect her secret while navigating emotional stakes, complex relationships, and a world that’s closing in.

ruthless-comeback-of-the-reborn-heiress.title: Ruthless Comeback of the Reborn Heiress
ruthless-comeback-of-the-reborn-heiress.description: Wrongfully accused and betrayed by her demon-cultivator sister, Grace Braylon dies — only to be reborn through excruciating pain. She leaves her sect and emotions behind to walk the ruthless Path of Merciless cultivation. With vengeance in her heart, every step forward is a battle against the past.

the-forgotten-master.title: The Forgotten Master
the-forgotten-master.description: Vyom was left for dead by his own brother, but destiny had other plans. As his true self resurfaces, he takes on corrupt masters, brutal fighters, and inner demons to become the legend he once was. Vision Unleashed is a tale of power, memory, and one man’s ultimate comeback. Watch Now!

unscripted-romance-in-love-with-my-subst.title: Unscripted Romance: In Love With Substitute Wife
unscripted-romance-in-love-with-my-subst.description: Yvette Taylor agrees to marry into the powerful Jones family in place of her sister, setting off a journey of sacrifice and self-discovery. Caught in a web of family duty and unexpected love, she forms a complicated bond with her new husband. Spanning 100 episodes, this romantic drama explores identity, resilience, and the pursuit of true affection.

from-zero-to-hero-breaking-the-chains-of.title: From Zero to Hero: Breaking the Chains of Fate
from-zero-to-hero-breaking-the-chains-of.description: Martin, a devoted father, faces profound grief and financial ruin after his critically ill wife, Kathaline, is taken off life support, leading to his brother-in-law John's vengeful destruction of his home. Desperate, Martin and his children, Alvin and Rose, are ruthlessly swindled out of their family home by Ketan, the Chief's son, who exploits their vulnerability. Alvin, a brilliant student, mysteriously fails a crucial exam, shattering his father's dreams, while Rose sacrifices her education and faces predatory demands from Ketan, culminating in her abduction and the family's complete destitution. A ruthless criminal, also known as Kethen/Kadan/Antony, returns to assert dominance, revealing a vendetta against Rose's family for his past incarceration, leading to the burning of their home and forced dispossession from ancestral land. Rose suffers a devastating hit-and-run injury, leaving her severely injured and her family burdened by medical debt. She is then forced into a series of deceptive and abusive arranged marriages, orchestrated by powerful figures like Peter and the Eric family, who seek to control her, use her for corporate acquisition, and demand she bear an heir, facing sexual abuse and a shocking cover-up by her own family. Simultaneously, Alvin, despite initial setbacks, is recognized for his genius, makes sacrifices for Rose, and is recruited by corporate heiress Elina for a top-secret AI project, achieving corporate success as a CDO at Horizon Corps. Alvin returns to his ancestral village as a director, confronting Ketan/Kedan/Antony, who is exploiting residents and acquiring properties, including his family home and mother's grave. With Elina, revealed as Horizon Corp's heiress, Alvin fights to protect his ancestral land and community from illegal demolitions and corporate malfeasance. Mr. Manuel, an incorruptible official, investigates Horizon Corp's scandal, exposing Mr. Eric's corporate malfeasance and personal betrayals, leading to his incarceration. Alvin, supported by his CEO sister Selena, battles Kedan and Manuel to protect his land and legacy. Rose, making a miraculous recovery from her injuries, supports her younger brother's pursuit of higher education. The story culminates with Alvin's successful return to his grateful community, distributing significant resources, and reflecting on his family's journey from tragedy to triumph as justice is finally served against those responsible for their past wrongs, including grave desecration and Rose's injury.

where-love-fades-away-3.title: Where Love Fades Away
where-love-fades-away-3.description: Sandra, battling terminal brain cancer and facing profound neglect from her neurosurgeon husband, Oliver, initiates a divorce, serving him papers during a tense meal. Oliver, initially in disbelief and rage, denies her illness and later her supposed death, which he vehemently rejects as a manipulative ploy. Convinced she faked her death, he embarks on an obsessive search, only to find her coffin empty, reinforcing his belief she is hiding. Despite his earlier disdain, Oliver eventually saves Sandra from a life-threatening crisis, but she vanishes again, leaving him consumed by an intense, unacknowledged search. As Sandra recovers from a critical operation under the care of the influential Mr. Gale, who makes a playful marriage proposal, Oliver spirals into self-destruction, consumed by grief and guilt over her presumed death. A shocking revelation suggests Sandra is alive, leading Oliver to confront Gale Senior, accuse him of faking her death, and vow to protect her. Facing professional ruin and public scandal, Dr. Oliver desperately seeks reconciliation and forgiveness from Sandra, planning a public apology. However, Sandra, scarred by his past emotional neglect, repeatedly rejects his attempts, feeling trapped and manipulated, and states their relationship is concluded. Learning of her engagement, Oliver, with a friend's help, plans an extravagant proposal, his possessive love growing even after a brutal attack by a rival. The narrative culminates with Sandra battling a terminal illness and despair, believing death is her only escape. Oliver, refusing to lose her, orchestrates a desperate wedding plan, hoping for a second chance at love and redemption. Haunted by a past mistake, Oliver meticulously plans a grand proposal for his beloved Sandra, desperate for her forgiveness and acceptance. Despite warnings about a manipulative influence, Oliver's romantic anticipation is shattered when he discovers Sandra is tragically gone. Plunged into an abyss of grief and denial, Oliver experiences an emotional breakdown, rejecting the idea of her departure, and makes a chilling declaration of possession and an expressed intent to join her.

unscripted-romance-in-love-with-my-subst.title: Unscripted Romance: In Love With My Substitute Wife

janam-janam-ka-badla.title: Janam Janam Ka Badla
janam-janam-ka-badla.description: When two brothers, Rohit and Virat, challenge the tyranny of land baron Vishambhar, their fate ends in brutal betrayal and death. But destiny has other plans, decades later, reborn as Daksh and Laksh, the brothers slowly reclaim lost memories, unravel truths, and prepare to end Vishambhar’s reign of terror once and for all. With their mother Durga’s prayers burning through time, revenge rises again. Watch Now!

bhaag-arjun-bhaag.title: Bhaag Arjun Bhaag
bhaag-arjun-bhaag.description: Arjun begins as a fallen superstar runner, haunted by a public collapse and forced into menial work at a sports facility while new athletes prepare for trials. At the same time, his ill mother is harassed by the moneylender Thakur over a debt tied to the family home, so Arjun’s struggle is never only about sport. He tries to protect his family’s honor while also chasing a return to the track. Early rivalries with Karan turn personal, especially when race stakes, romance, and pride become tangled together. Karan and Arjun’s friendship breaks after a race outcome and a love triangle, and what once looked like brotherhood hardens into open enmity. Rekha remains central to Arjun’s emotional life, but her situation becomes more complicated when she is later shown living with Karan in a family-approved arrangement for money. Arjun is repeatedly humiliated by his fall from grace, his injury, and the way others use his status against him. Even at the academy, where he works as a cleaner, his past success is mocked and his attempts to help or train others are suppressed. A coach-like figure refuses to let him surrender and keeps reframing his hardship as a source of strength rather than defeat. Mishra Ji also recognizes Arjun’s character after a robbery and calls him a precious diamond, giving him a fragile new beginning. Arjun’s instinctive speed and courage during a chase convince those around him that his talent is still alive. He then enters a grueling comeback phase, rebuilding his body and resolve through training, diet, and repeated effort. As his recovery becomes visible, the danger around him deepens, because powerful figures at the academy see his return as a threat. The story also reveals that Karan, once trusted in a mentoring role, has been secretly sabotaging Arjun with harmful supplements and isolation. This exposes Arjun’s decline as something more than bad luck and gives his struggle a darker edge. When Arjun enters the Commonwealth qualifiers, he refuses to throw the race even when Karan offers to clear his debts. He insists that the track must decide honor, and his victory exposes the corruption around him. In the end, Karan is arrested for fraud and attempted murder, and the academy is blacklisted, while Arjun’s comeback is finally tied to both personal redemption and public justice.

back-to-1994-1.title: BACK TO 1994
back-to-1994-1.description: When Pengyang discovers his wife in another man's arms, his world shatters. Reeling from betrayal, he demands a divorce and drowns his sorrows in alcohol—only to be stabbed by his furious mother-in-law, who blames him for everything. As his vision fades, he believes his story is over… But fate has other plans. Pengyang wakes up in 1994, decades before the heartbreak, betrayal, and bloodshed. Armed with knowledge of the future and a second chance at life, can he rewrite his destiny? Will he seek revenge—or redemption?

feast-of-desire.title: Feast of Desire
feast-of-desire.description: When soft-hearted chef Aanya crosses paths with ruthless billionaire Ishaan, her world spirals into a dark game of identity, betrayal, and forbidden love. Trapped by her dying mother’s medical needs, Aanya is blackmailed by her sinister lookalike Simran into impersonating Ishaan’s estranged wife. What begins as a desperate act spirals into emotional chaos, hidden truths, and dangerous obsessions—forcing Aanya to choose between survival, justice, and the children who begin calling her "mumma."

say-you-remember-say-you-love-3.title: Say You Remember, Say You Love
say-you-remember-say-you-love-3.description: The series begins with the brutal shattering of young lovers Jason and Elizabeth Bell's romance, orchestrated by Elizabeth's formidable father due to class differences. Jason, publicly humiliating Elizabeth by revealing their love was a dare, disappears, fueling his ambition for revenge and success. Five years later, Jason, now a celebrated public figure, returns to his hometown, secretly vowing to uncover the truth behind Elizabeth's family's downfall, which has left her a "fallen heiress" working as a journalist. Their paths intertwine professionally when a struggling media company forces Elizabeth to investigate Jason's "first love story," and Jason demands she interview him, compelling them to confront their unresolved past. Jason, plagued by guilt, believes his past actions contributed to Elizabeth's family tragedy, including her father's suicide and mother's addiction, and embarks on an urgent search for her to make amends. He subjects Elizabeth to impossible tasks as his assistant, while secretly investigating a powerful family, possibly hers, and is also manipulated by Mr. Clooney. Elizabeth grapples with financial struggles and is tormented by a manipulative ex-lover who spreads rumors and blames her for her family's ruin. Amidst these challenges, Jason orchestrates a surprise birthday celebration for Elizabeth and makes grand public declarations of unwavering love, despite her distress and past scandals. However, Elizabeth, deeply scarred by their history, initially rejects his pleas for reconciliation, believing their past is irreparable. A deeper family secret emerges as Jason confronts his unstable mother, who blames his deceased father for their ruin and hints at Jason's hidden identity. Eventually, Elizabeth discovers that Jason's past public disdain was a protective charade, orchestrated by her own powerful family to keep them apart. Other women, like Vivian and Leila, also learn their mothers sabotaged their relationships with Jason due to class distinctions. Amidst corporate intrigue and personal heartbreak, Jason makes a dramatic public comeback, denying accusations of drug use and harm. He then makes a shocking live confession of love to Elizabeth on a morning show and publicly proposes, which she joyously accepts, signifying a potential reconciliation and the overcoming of past betrayals and class barriers. The show explores the collision of ambition and personal history, the cost of fame, and the enduring impact of betrayal and hidden truths, ultimately questioning if love can truly be rekindled after such devastating lies.

reborn-as-kid-dads-own-mastermind.title: Reborn as Kid
reborn-as-kid-dads-own-mastermind.description: An 8-year-old boy returns with memories of his past life, driven by a single purpose — to change his father’s destiny. This emotional thriller weaves together love, revenge, and the high-stakes world of the stock market into one gripping narrative

my-dads-got-trillions-of-dollars-in-asse.title: My dad's got trillions of dollars in assets
my-dads-got-trillions-of-dollars-in-asse.description: A poor boy suddenly discovers that his estranged father is a secret billionaire with unimaginable wealth. Thrust into a world of luxury and danger, he must prove himself worthy of the family name.

pellaina-kottalo.title: Pellaina Kottalo
pellaina-kottalo.description: ఒక మహిళ కొత్త ఉద్యోగానికి అలవాటు పడుతూ, తన ఆకర్షణీయమైన బాస్‌ను చూసి మెల్లగా ప్రేమలో పడుతుంది. కానీ ఒక దాచిన నిజం అంతా సంక్లిష్టం చేస్తుంది — ఆమె ఇప్పటికే ఒక విదితమైన వ్యక్తితో పెళ్లి అయింది, అతడిని ఆమె కష్టంగా గుర్తుపట్టగలుగుతుంది. వారి అరుదైన కలయికలు, ఆ సంబంధాన్ని ఓ మరిచిపోయిన నీడలా మార్చేశాయి — నిబద్ధత ఉన్నా, అనుబంధం లేని బంధంగా.

ceo-those-twins-look-like-you-1.title: CEO those twins look like you
ceo-those-twins-look-like-you-1.description: A young CEO who discovers that two twins, one he is caring for and the other he finds on the street, look remarkably similar to his late fiancée. This discovery leads to a series of events that unravel the past, including the circumstances surrounding his fiancée's death and the mysterious connection between the twins and his life

patience-will-lead-to-a-brighter-outcome.title: Patience will lead to a brighter outcome
patience-will-lead-to-a-brighter-outcome.description: After being wronged and humiliated, a resilient woman endures countless hardships in silence. With patience and inner strength, she finally turns the tables and reclaims her happiness and dignity.

a-heart-beat-away.title: A Heartbeat Away
a-heart-beat-away.description: షాన్ ధనవంతుడు కాకపోవడం వల్ల కేటీ అతనిని తక్కువగా చూసి, నిస్సహాయంగా వదిలేసింది. సంవత్సరాలు గడిచిన తరువాత, షాన్ ఓ యువ సీఈఓగా ఎదిగి ఆమె ముందుకు వస్తాడు. తనను వదిలిన తప్పు ఆమెకు అవగతం కావాలని కోరుకుంటాడు. కానీ కొంతకాలానికి షాన్ అర్థం చేసుకుంటాడు – తన ఎదుట ఉన్న ఈ అమ్మాయి నిజంగా ఎప్పటి నుంచో అతనిని హృదయపూర్వకంగా ప్రేమిస్తూ వచ్చినదని.

my-husband-my-boss.title: My Husband My Boss
my-husband-my-boss.description: Meher Verma enters a secret contract marriage to escape her toxic family—only to unknowingly cross paths with her mysterious husband two years later, as her new boss. In a world of ambition, hidden identities, and simmering tension, Meher must protect her heart and her secrets. But as sparks fly and buried truths threaten to surface, she’s forced to choose between love, loyalty, and freedom.

the-officer-fell-for-me-2.title: The Officer fell for me
the-officer-fell-for-me-2.description: The Officer fell for me - Telugu

contract-wife.title: Contract Wife
contract-wife.description: Vidhi, facing a terminal heart condition, enters a secret contractual relationship with powerful CEO Ayaan, only to be abruptly abandoned when he terminates their arrangement for his fiancée, Pihu. Heartbroken and rejecting life-saving treatment, Vidhi asserts her independence, but soon becomes entangled with manipulative bar owner Daksh, who exploits her past with Ayaan for corporate gain, leaving her publicly humiliated and blackmailed. Desperate for funds for her treatment, Vidhi's world further collapses when her sole support, Yuvi, is gravely injured, revealing a mysterious past connection to Ayaan and prompting Vidhi to seek his help. Simultaneously, Vidhi secretly prepares her best friend for her impending death, while a possessive CEO cares for her, growing jealous of her calls for Yuvi. Vidhi's attempts to resign are dramatically rejected by Ayaan, who exhibits possessive interest, sparking a love triangle with Pihu, his fiancée. Her past connection with client Yuvi resurfaces, leading to accusations of betrayal from Ayaan, her guardian, as both Yuvi and Ayaan are inexplicably compelled to save her. Vidhi confronts an amnesiac Yuvi, believing him to be her lost love, Shurveer, while his adoptive mother, Neelam (Mrs. Singhania), fiercely opposes their bond, manipulating Yuvi's memories and even plotting Vidhi's death. In a desperate act, Vidhi sacrifices herself by entering a new contract with CEO Ayaan to fund Yuvi's life-saving surgery, tragically leading to her presumed death. Unbeknownst to Ayaan, his mother, Mrs. Singhania, orchestrated Vidhi's

the-return-of-the-kingtriumphant-return.title: The Return of the King：Triumphant Return
the-return-of-the-kingtriumphant-return.description: The series opens amidst widespread corporate corruption and social injustice, where ruthless industrialists exploit workers and families face betrayal. Mysterious figures begin to intervene, challenging established power structures. Soon, the true identity of a formidable leader, known by various names including Jihan, Jian, and Chen Jian, is revealed as the head of powerful conglomerates like the Kingsung, Chiang Seng, and Strong Nation Groups. He asserts his authority by exposing corrupt managers and executing hostile takeovers, often with a ruthless hand. Amidst these corporate battles, personal dramas unfold. Jian seeks justice for his ailing mother, abandoned by his estranged brother, while Shawa is forced into an arranged marriage to secure funds for her critically ill mother, only to defy humiliation and reject the proposals. Chen Jian's past is hinted at, involving a "Jo Shawa" and a corporate conspiracy. His personal life is further complicated by the betrayal of his wife, Jholli/Jhouli, leading to a demand for divorce and fueling his drive for retribution. As his power grows, Chen Jian faces escalating conflicts from corporate rivals, criminal masterminds like Dada, and vengeful figures from his past, such as Ouzi Yang and Wang Deshun, whom he systematically dismantles through public humiliation and strategic attacks. His journey is marked by both calculated retribution and deep personal stakes. He fiercely defends his family and associates, intervening to save those denied medical care and protecting his brother from accusations. A significant romantic relationship develops with Lee (also referred to as Meina), a loyal confidante and secretary, who stands by him as he navigates treacherous plots, including being framed for molestation. The stakes reach a peak when Lee is brutally kidnapped, forcing Chen Jian into a desperate race against time. He endures humiliation, illicit transactions, and brutal torture, ultimately making a profound sacrifice to protect her. The series concludes with Chen Jian's recovery and a marriage proposal to Lee, as police investigate the complex abduction, solidifying their bond amidst lingering mysteries and the aftermath of his relentless pursuit of justice and power.

emperor-yan-2.title: Emperor Yan
emperor-yan-2.description: Leo, a man of humble status, shocks Riverdale by claiming successful heiress Chloe as his wife, hinting at a hidden marriage, only to face immediate ridicule and violent challenges. Despite enduring public humiliation and scorn from Chloe and her family, Leo defiantly fights back, unleashing forbidden martial arts and revealing immense power, hinting at his true identity as the formidable Fire Emperor Sean. He audaciously claims to be the true source of their family's prosperity, leading to a shocking divorce ultimatum from Chloe. Cast out, Leo, a mysterious magnate and the secret architect of their wealth, finds a powerful ally in Sara Shen, an influential heiress, igniting a fierce corporate war against the Chen family for years of humiliation. Amidst these battles, Leo is unexpectedly claimed as Sara Shen's fiancé, leading to an arranged marriage, while Chloe harbors a burning vendetta. Leo, bound by this promise, fiercely protects Sara from rivals, simultaneously exposing Chloe's new suitor, Mr. Hug, as a deceptive imposter, leading to public humiliation for Chloe and her family. Despite being publicly scorned and underestimated, Leo subtly defies his detractors, hinting at his true, powerful identity as the 'Supreme Ruler of China' or 'Emperor.' He dramatically unveils his hidden influence, forcing powerful CEOs to kneel and apologize, and agrees to save Sara Shen's Azure Group from a larger plot. A ruthless corporate power struggle ensues, with Chris Clark aggressively targeting the Central Plains Chambers of Commerce and Sara Shen's company. Leo, still dismissed as 'useless,' begins to reveal his hidden power, culminating in his dramatic self-revelation as the legendary 'Fire Lord Emperor' at a corporate conference. This shocking reveal is met with challenges, but Leo systematically dismantles established corporate dynasties like the Clark, Willow, and Jiang families in a calculated revenge plot. The Emperor consolidates absolute power, initiating a ruthless purge of influential families and elevating the Shen family. Leo, now fully unmasked as the formidable 'Emperor Sahab,' confronts Chloe and her family over a devastating betrayal that led to his financial ruin, rejecting their pleas for reconciliation. Having secretly elevated their corporate entity for three years, he now seeks justice for their perceived mistreatment. He asserts his absolute power in the corporate world, fiercely protecting the prestigious Azure Group and declaring unwavering protection over Miss Shen, ultimately proposing marriage to her, blending corporate dominance with a tender romantic arc.

fleeing-husband-please-love-me-all-over-.title: Fleeing Husband Please Love Me All Over Again
fleeing-husband-please-love-me-all-over-.description: The microdrama centers on Vindhya, an heiress trapped in an unconsummated, strategic marriage to the powerful CEO Ajay, who abandoned her on their wedding night. Years later, Ajay's dramatic return with another woman, Pooja, shatters Vindhya's life, prompting her demand for divorce. However, Ajay, revealed as manipulative, refuses, financially trapping her with a pre-nuptial agreement, while her adoptive uncle discloses her marriage was a family strategy. Vindhya fiercely begins a fight for autonomy, honor, and independence, seeking a career as a journalist. As Vindhya pursues professional success, her life intertwines with Ajay's complex world of corporate intrigue and hidden motives. Ajay makes public declarations of love for Vindhya, even purchasing an expensive diamond, yet his affections often mask strategic 'other purposes,' and he is revealed to be in a loveless contract marriage with Srujana. The dramatic return of Ajay's ex-lover, Jyotsna, eight years later, ignites a fierce love triangle, as she blackmails Ajay and relentlessly provokes Vindhya, leading to a violent confrontation and public scandal. Ajay prioritizes corporate image over Vindhya's truth, shattering their trust. Further complications arise with Ajay's shocking 'swapped at birth' confession, revealing a forced identity change and a corporate revenge plot against Jyotsna. Vindhya, now a reporter, investigates corporate malfeasance, leading to a building collapse that critically injures her. Her devoted husband, Vinay, rushes to her side, while the 'real' Ajay Rathborn arrives to claim Vindhya through a contract marriage, only to discover her heart belongs to Vinay. The narrative escalates as Ajay orchestrates events to draw Vindhya back, leading to public confrontations and a love triangle involving Vinay. Ajay faces a devastating corporate scandal and an ultimatum, while Vindhya secretly allies with a mysterious man for retribution against shared enemies. Despite Ajay's abrupt departure amidst corporate recall and divorce proceedings, and his implication in a bribery scandal orchestrated by CEO Vinay, Vindhya works to clear his name. Their tumultuous decade-long connection, marked by trust issues and manipulation by Jagan, ultimately leads them to seek to redefine and rekindle their profound bond, embracing a second chance amidst ongoing vendettas and corporate espionage.

bend-the-waist-1.title: Bend the waist
bend-the-waist-1.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous and evolving romance between Zoe (later Zoey) and George, a powerful scion. Their story begins with Zoe's secret first love for George, who once rescued her, dramatically resurfacing when she discovers his connection to her roommate Emily's online romance. Initially, George, now a famous "Prince George," doesn't recognize Zoe, challenging her to bridge the gap of their forgotten past. Despite his aloof exterior and public claims of disinterest in romance, George gradually reveals a caring and protective side, drawing Zoe deeper into a complicated connection. Their burgeoning relationship is fraught with challenges, including George's casual recollection of their shared history contrasting with Zoe's deep emotional investment, and subtle betrayals of Emily. As their bond strengthens, George's possessive nature becomes evident, and he navigates a complex web of other potential romantic interests, publicly rejecting many for an "unseen girlfriend" who is implicitly Zoe. Their romance faces external threats from the menacing Tony, a rival from George's past who stalks Zoe and seeks retribution, forcing George to consistently act as her protector, uncovering abduction plots and offering her a home. Simultaneously, George is embroiled in high-stakes family drama, battling his manipulative father and pregnant stepmother over his ailing grandfather's will and the family legacy, vowing to protect his loved ones and inheritance. The relationship deepens through chivalrous acts, tender moments, and George's eventual public declaration of Zoe as his girlfriend, leading to her acceptance by his family. However, George's manipulative tendencies also surface, as he at one point forces Zoe into a "trial period" relationship built on lies. Zoe, a gifted calligrapher, also navigates her own challenges, including a rivalry with Emma and a burgeoning career, while George's possessiveness escalates with the appearance of new romantic interests in her life. Their journey culminates in a profound understanding of their shared history, as a lost, undelivered love letter from Zoe to George from their school days is discovered, revealing a long-unspoken affection and affirming their current bond. Zoey, initially guarded, confronts her orphaned past and fragmented memories, finding unwavering love and solace in George. Their once-secret campus romance is publicly revealed, solidifying their status as a power couple, with George demonstrating unwavering protective devotion. The series concludes with George's romantic proposal and Zoey's acceptance, signifying a commitment to their future where new love triumphs over past sorrow.

ceo-those-twins-look-like-you.title: CEO, Those Twins Look Like You
ceo-those-twins-look-like-you.description: Dr. Amy Lou, a brilliant brain surgeon, lives under a hidden identity, having once been Nio, a heavily pregnant woman pursued by the powerful Lu family for an abortion. A mysterious intervention saved one child, and she later discovered she was still pregnant with another. Years later, her past resurfaces when her young son, Zian, repeatedly calls her "Mummy," unknowingly revealing their connection. This revelation ignites a desperate fight against the manipulative Luo, who has abused Zian, held Dr. Amy's grandmother hostage, and claimed her daughter, Sheen. Concurrently, Yun-Han, a powerful member of the Lu family and Zian's father, frantically searches for the elusive Dr. Amy to save his ailing grandfather, unaware of her true identity and their complex, intertwined history. Their encounters are marked by accusations, power struggles, and a developing romantic tension, as Dr. Amy Lou guards explosive secrets about Zian's parentage and her own identity. She faces public humiliation, unjust dismissal, and captivity while fighting to reclaim her family legacy and uncover the truth behind her mother's suspicious death. The critically ill family patriarch requires urgent brain surgery, and Dr. Amy Lou is revealed as the only specialist capable of saving him, dramatically exposing her hidden identity as Luo Ming. After successfully performing the life-saving surgery, she wins a significant bet, and the recovering patriarch attempts to orchestrate a romantic pairing between her and Yun-Han. However, new antagonists emerge, manipulating Yun-Han and kidnapping her daughter, setting the stage for further high-stakes conflict. Dr. Amy Lou also confronts her estranged father about his role in a past plot against her mother, leading to a path of forgiveness and the transfer of a family legacy. The show culminates in wedding preparations between Ya-Ya and Yun-Han, symbolizing hope for new beginnings amidst unearthed betrayals and ongoing power struggles.

secret-chronicles-of-the-republic.title: Secret Chronicles of the Republic
secret-chronicles-of-the-republic.description: The story begins with supernatural judgment, as a mysterious woman is accused of deception and forced back into penance by a stern divine enforcer. From there, the show expands into a world where ordinary problems like rent, deliveries, and family pressure are constantly interrupted by ghosts, curses, and divine вмешательство. A shopkeeper’s money troubles briefly turn hopeful when a mysterious delivery reveals a family-linked object, suggesting hidden help or fate at work. Across the early arc, several men are warned, pursued, or tested by unseen forces, while romantic claims and jealousy make personal relationships unstable. One ghostly woman insists that a man belongs to her and will marry her, while another man is told he must survive a curse by crossing a mysterious threshold. At the same time, a wealthy suitor openly proposes marriage and tries to reshape a woman’s life, showing how romance in this world often comes with control and power. The tone then deepens into darker romance and karmic revenge, as a guarded woman resists a powerful man’s pressure and a late-night exchange ends in a crash. Another man is trapped by accusing female voices, and Ronita’s story reveals how a marriage promise led to betrayal, abuse, and exploitation. Grief and vengeance become central when a woman returns to confront those tied to her children’s deaths, while a monk performs a ritual of air, fire, earth, and water to bring judgment and rebirth. The supernatural thread keeps widening as souls are saved from punishment, bodies are returned to life, and divine forces intervene over who deserves to live. Apu wakes in a strange house and is told he has been chosen for an unknown purpose, while another woman acts as if she already shares a bond with him. Surjo becomes a recurring protective figure, first warning of a restless spirit and later fighting through hostile confrontations while admitting his feelings. Rumors, humiliation, and rivalry spread around women who are accused of ghostly attachments, theft, or replacement, keeping social conflict tied to the supernatural. Romantic pursuit remains persistent but rarely simple, as one suitor is rejected for his lower status and another confession is mocked by a ghost. The show also introduces bargains that blur love and survival, including a desperate request for help against child ghosts and a bargain involving marriage and a child. Family danger grows sharper when a son seeks occult help to save his mother from a ghostly affliction, only to learn that sacrifice and ritual rules may be required. That thread expands into cursed houses, moonless-night warnings, holy-water protection, and the idea that only one chosen person can face a haunting. In the later stretch, the food-shop setting becomes another site of supernatural pressure, with a sharp-tongued woman enforcing rules and threatening destruction if standards are not met. The business world is then overtaken by darker forces, including a soul-devouring creature, dangerous tasks, and a stolen lifespan that throws the afterlife into chaos. Finally, the story turns inward again to family suspicion and bodily curse, as Jhumjhum’s condition leads priests and healers to search for both supernatural and human causes. By the end, accusations, rituals, and dreamlike confusion remain unresolved, leaving the larger struggle over fate, love, and cosmic order still open.

the-dragon-returns-to-his-homeland.title: The Dragon Returns to His Homeland
the-dragon-returns-to-his-homeland.description: Driven by a decade-long vow of vengeance for his parents' murder by industrialist Glen Gomes, Alex Warner sacrifices his chance at love with Alice, dedicating himself to empowering his brother, John, and meticulously planning retribution. Alice is tragically forced into an arranged marriage with Glen, leading to Alex crashing the wedding to expose Glen's sinister plot against her, resulting in a brutal confrontation where Alex is battered and Alice risks her life to save him. Following Alex's injury and disappearance, John Warner takes up the mantle, transforming into a powerful corporate figure to systematically dismantle Glen's empire. The conflict escalates with the desecration of the Warner family graves by Glen's thugs, forcing Alex and John to fiercely defend their family's honor against public accusations of patricide and betrayal. Glen's powerful brother, Eric, emerges, freeing Glen and revealing a deeper, decades-long vendetta against the Warner family, intensifying the corporate and criminal warfare. John orchestrates Eric's financial collapse, forcing him to betray Glen and exposing their extensive corporate crimes and exploitation. Meanwhile, Alex and Alice face new challenges, including class prejudice and accusations of fraud over a gifted luxury home, navigating a complex web of hidden wealth and a mysterious benefactor. Alex eventually transforms into a billionaire, becoming engaged to Alice, while Emma, a powerful matriarch and John Warner's fiancée, asserts her influence. The Warner brothers achieve significant victories, reclaiming their family's standing and exposing their adversaries, though new threats emerge as 'The King' (Alex) vows vengeance for Alex and Jia's assault. The show explores themes of fierce family loyalty, the pursuit of justice against corruption, and the fight to reclaim honor and dignity amidst escalating power struggles.

mafia-se-mohabbat-1.title: Mafia se Mohabbat
mafia-se-mohabbat-1.description: Don Kabir’s world is turned upside down after a mysterious night with Sanya leads to an unexpected pregnancy. As secrets unravel and enemies close in, love, blood ties, and betrayal collide in this gripping saga.

the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.title: The Daughter-in-Law Who Married Far Away
the-daughter-in-law-who-married-far-away.description: The Daughter-in-Law Who Married Far Away

my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-2.title: My Call Boy Billionaire Daddy
my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-2.description: The narrative centers on Inas, a woman entangled in a labyrinth of corporate intrigue, personal betrayals, and family secrets. Initially humiliated by her cheating fiancé Chris, Inas embarks on a path of revenge and survival within a ruthless corporate world dominated by powerful figures like Mr. Richmond and Bob. As Inas navigates workplace harassment, blackmail, and violent confrontations, she uncovers a mysterious chip linked to dangerous conspiracies and a hidden child, Charlie, whose innocence contrasts with the surrounding chaos. The story reveals complex relationships, including Inas's fraught ties with her sister Flora, who betrays her by stealing her fiancé, and the enigmatic Mr. Richmond, whose possessive control blurs professional and personal boundaries, culminating in a tense, ambiguous romance. Parallel arcs involve a fallen heiress seeking justice for her father's suspicious death and financial ruin, rejecting conditional offers from Mr. Richmond to reclaim her family's honor independently. Meanwhile, characters like Luis and Neidhan engage in deadly power struggles and forbidden romances, further complicating the corporate and familial dynamics. The pursuit of a valuable corporate chip triggers violent home invasions, manhunts, and high-stakes missions, drawing in innocent parties and escalating tensions. Throughout, themes of power imbalance, deception, and survival intertwine as Inas and others confront their pasts, challenge patriarchal control, and strive for autonomy amid a web of manipulation and revenge. The arc culminates in Inas's alliance with a determined investigator, the unraveling of family betrayals, and the precarious balance between love and control within the shadowy corporate empire. Stakes remain high as characters grapple with loyalty, identity, and the cost of reclaiming dignity in a world rife with danger and duplicity.

the-rise-begins-with-perspective-3.title: The Rise Begins With Perspective
the-rise-begins-with-perspective-3.description: Young Leo's life dramatically changes after an injury awakens his clairvoyant "purple gold eyes," granting him the ability to see through objects. This extraordinary gift becomes crucial when his mother's urgent surgery creates a crushing medical debt, forcing him to leverage his vision in high-stakes gambling to secure the necessary funds. His consistent wins, however, quickly spark accusations of cheating and draw unwanted attention. Discovering he can also pick winning lottery tickets, especially with his companion Zoe, Leo uses this new ability to fund Zoe's ailing sister's medical treatment, deepening their bond. His ambition grows, leading him to work for heiress Megan, whom he protects from the manipulative Adam Paul, further solidifying his connection with her. Leo's powers are enhanced, allowing him to expose Adam Paul's elaborate deception involving a fraudulent antique, challenging powerful elites. He transitions from a struggling stall proprietor to a man navigating complex relationships and high-stakes conflicts, acquiring wealth through "stone gambling" and treasure hunts, often alongside Mia. As his influence expands, he faces ruthless property disputes and public disparagement from figures like Megan's snobbish cousin, Sasha, but is fiercely defended by Megan, revealing a deep connection. The rivalry with Adam Paul intensifies, culminating in high-stakes gem appraisal challenges where Leo, using his "purple gold eyes," defeats Adam and his uncle, the "Gambling King of the North," to protect Megan's honor. Leo's triumphs attract the perilous attention of powerful, shadowy groups like the Viper Gang, sparking bidding wars for his priceless jade and hinting at a darker world of corporate dynasties. He asserts dominance in the Indian business world, forcing rivals to apologize and exposing more fraudulent art, leading to high-stakes wagers involving rare artifacts. Amidst these challenges, Leo finds himself entangled in budding romances with Megan, Mia, Alice, and Roya, facing pressure from influential patriarchs like Mr. Cage, who attempts to orchestrate a contractual marriage to leverage Leo's expertise. He also discovers "space powers" and makes strategic multi-billion dollar bids for raw jade, hinting at a larger agenda or preparation for an "apocalypse." His journey takes a romantic turn with Megan and her grandfather, Dadaji, who challenges Leo to repair a valuable blue glaze bowl, leading to a public triumph over artifact experts. However, his burgeoning romance with Megan is shattered by an abrupt arranged marriage request from a powerful magnate, leaving him caught between two powerful families and their heiresses, Megan Cage and Sia Smith. The conflict with Adam Paul reaches a peak when Leo strikes him for threatening Megan's family, leaving Adam's fate ambiguous. Ultimately, Leo makes an unconventional choice to pursue relationships with both Megan Smith and Alice Cage, setting the stage for a complex love quadrangle within elite circles, as he continues to navigate a world of power, wealth, and dangerous rivalries.

the-crowned-consort-of-the-empress.title: The Crowned Consort Of The Empress
the-crowned-consort-of-the-empress.description: The show is a palace-centered romance and power struggle built around public selection rituals, dynastic pressure, and repeated betrayals. It opens with a ruthless court process where noble candidates are inspected and rejected, while the newly crowned Yuvarani wakes confused and is forced to oversee a selection she barely understands. From the start, the court treats love as a political test, and refusal is met with humiliation, punishment, or silence. Yuvarani is pulled between duty and desire as she confronts men who claim loyalty, protection, or love, yet whose motives remain uncertain or openly hostile. Siddharth stands at the center of much of the conflict, sometimes appearing protective and sometimes controlling, while Yuvarani increasingly sees him as a rival rather than a safe choice. The story deepens when Yuvarani remembers a past-life betrayal and vows revenge, turning their present clashes into something larger than a simple courtship. Around her, other figures are dragged into similar struggles, including a former lover who reveals his illegitimate birth and resentment, and a warrior-prince whose sacrifice is recognized only too late. The selection itself becomes a battlefield of pride, jealousy, and authority, with officials, queens, and senior royals pressuring women to choose husbands for the sake of family honor and political order. Arnav and other contenders repeatedly enter these contests through trials, endurance tasks, and public challenges, trying to prove worth while also competing for Yuvarani’s trust. Several relationships are marked by mistaken rescue, hidden identity, or delayed truth, which keeps affection tied to regret and suspicion. In one thread, a royal woman is forced to confront a man she once trusted, only to learn that the person who saved her was someone else. In another, a prince is sent back in time for a second chance at love, only to find that rivalry and old misunderstandings still block the path forward. The court also weaponizes marriage proposals, dowries, and succession claims, making romance inseparable from statecraft. As the pressure rises, coercion becomes more extreme, with threats, drugs, poison, and confinement used to force obedience. Mona’s storyline pushes this pattern further, as she is repeatedly pressured to choose among suitors, while family and royal authority threaten consequences if she refuses. Her arc ends in tragedy and upheaval, with her death throwing the kingdom into chaos and shifting power to Avanthika. Even after that collapse, the struggle does not end, because Siddharth, Arnav, and the remaining royals are still caught in war fears, inheritance disputes, and unresolved loyalties. Across all these threads, the central stakes remain the same: who gets to choose love, who controls the throne, and whether any bond can survive the court’s demands.

justice-the-beast.title: Justice & The Beast
justice-the-beast.description: While investigating a brutal attack in Mumbai, a fearless young lawyer unexpectedly steps into a hidden world. Without her knowledge, she ends up marrying a powerful werewolf. Now, she stands at a crossroads should she choose the path of justice, or embrace the shadowy realm of love and destiny? A thrilling tale of courage, secrets, and forbidden love.

the-westward.title: The Westward
the-westward.description: The journey to the West was a conspiracy of heaven. After Sutra went missing for more than a decade, Heaven sent its army to search, in order not to let the Sutra once again fall into the hands of heaven, the journey to West begin again.

the-wronged-husband.title: The Wronged Husband
the-wronged-husband.description: Jab behra Rudra apni sunne ki shakti wapas paata hai, tab uske rishte, uska pyaar aur uska vishwas sab uske khilaaf nikalte hain. Uski perfect wife Suhani aur chhote bhai Vivaan milkar use maarne ka plan banate hain. Lekin ek failed murder ke baad, Rudra apne maut ka natak karta hai aur secretly comeback karta hai, apna sab kuchh wapas paane ke liye.

unscripted-romance-in-love-with-my-subst.title: Unscripted Romance: In Love With My Substitute Wife
unscripted-romance-in-love-with-my-subst.description: Her stepfather abused Shiyononova. To save her mother, she agreed to marry Jiyaan, who is a handsome coma patient. She plans to enjoy Jiyaan's money after his death. But when Jiyaan unexpectedly wakes up on their wedding night, Shiyononova's life changes forever.

say-you-remember-say-you-love-2.title: Say You Remember, Say You Love
say-you-remember-say-you-love-2.description: After her family went bankrupt, Elizabeth reconnected with her first love, Jason, who had become a world-renowned football star. Despite never forgetting the pain he once caused her, she couldn't resist being drawn to his brilliance.

wonder-boy-parth-5.title: Wonder Boy Parth
wonder-boy-parth-5.description: The series opens with Parth, a gravely ill and blind man, discovering his wife Jasmine's cruel betrayal with Raj Talwar, a revelation that transforms his selfless act of donating his sight into a chilling vow of revenge. Empowered by a mysterious locket, Parth gains extraordinary abilities, which he immediately uses to expose deceptions, including a fake artifact presented by the powerful Payal Taneja. Concurrently, CEO Maya faces a corporate conspiracy led by Rani, who later seeks to dismantle Raj Talwar's empire after he defrauds her in an art deal. Parth, now known as Aryan and having regained his sight, enters a dangerous bet with rival Aaditya over an ancient sword, while Jasmine endures public humiliation, hinting at a complex love triangle. Payal investigates her father's mysterious collapse, suspecting a conspiracy, and Rishi (implied to be Aryan) cures him of an affliction linked to a painting, though greed prevents full resolution. Raj Talwar aggressively claims Parth and Maya's home, leading to violent confrontations and a war with city Don Anil Thaneja, culminating in a near-fatal attack on Aryan/Rishi by a jealous Man 1. Later, Parth, revealed as a brilliant doctor, businessman, and wealthy mall owner, develops a passionate romance with Jasmine despite public shaming and class conflicts orchestrated by his ex-lover. When Jasmine suddenly loses her sight due to a menacing villain, Parth becomes her protector, simultaneously racing to find a crucial missing ingredient for an ancient, revolutionary product amidst intellectual property disputes. The narrative then shifts to Parth uncovering a dark magic plot by Aryan (Antagonist) against his mother, Sanvi Khandelwal, who enlists Parth to expose her son's treachery and reclaim her inheritance. A malevolent spirit, Kanthira, is linked to a wealthy family's treasure, as Saanvi battles for her valuable mines against Aryan (Antagonist), who asserts a dark romantic claim. Aryan (Protector) emerges as Saanvi's powerful guardian against Aryan (Antagonist) and his tantric allies. Aryan (Antagonist) consolidates power, becoming a political tyrant, and forces Parth to reveal the secrets of an ancient, demon-trapped ring for absolute dominion. The series culminates in Aryan (Protector) rising to challenge the tyrant's oppression, rekindling a past romance, and becoming a target in a high-stakes collision of ancient magic, corporate greed, and personal vendettas.

divorced-wife-turns-boss-lady.title: Divorced Wife Turns Boss Lady
divorced-wife-turns-boss-lady.description: Jai Mehra thought his wife was just another housewife—until the divorce unlocked something far more dangerous. Love, deception, and a woman’s silent storm… the truth is only just beginning to unfold.

the-devil-wears-desire-2.title: The Devil Wears Desire
the-devil-wears-desire-2.description: Anna becomes CEO Ian’s secret lover to save her boyfriend, Louis, but is abandoned by Ian and later dates playboy David. After being forced into marriage with crime lord Domenico, Anna is kidnapped, prompting Ian and Louis to team up and rescue her. Amid dark secrets and intense rivalries, Anna must choose between four men to find true love.

secret-marriage-2.title: Secret Marriage
secret-marriage-2.description: Tanya, ek simple gaon ki ladki, Mumbai aati hai kaam ke liye. Billionaire Rajvir ki jaan bachane ke baad, uska pota Dev, jo ek strict CEO hai, Tanya se ek secret contract marriage karta hai. Tanya office mein cleaner ban kar kaam karti hai, jahan use Lavanya se jhelna padta hai. Dheere-dheere woh apni mehnat aur imaandari se sabka dil jeet leti hai. Blackmail, kidnapping, aur dukhon ke baad bhi, Dev uska saath deta hai. Tanya boss ban jaati hai, pregnant hoti hai, aur sabke saamne Dev usse apni wife ke roop mein accept karta hai.

my-groom-a-billionaire-3.title: My Groom A Billionaire
my-groom-a-billionaire-3.description: A runaway groom and a jilted bride cross paths in a twist of fate, sparking an unexpected marriage built on secrets and misunderstandings. As their worlds collide—his wealthy identity hidden and her pride wounded—they navigate love, deception, and redemption in this romantic drama.

my-groom-a-billionaire-2.title: My Groom A Billionaire
my-groom-a-billionaire-2.description: ಒಂದು ಕಡೆ ಮದುವೆ ಬೇಡ ಅಂತಾ ಓಡಿ ಬಂದ ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್, ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಕಡೆ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಿಯಕರನಿಂದಲೇ ಮೋಸಕ್ಕೊಳಗಾದ ಹುಡುಗಿ! ಹೀಗೆ ಎರಡು ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಗ್ತಿದ್ದವರು ಜೊತೆಯಾಗೋ‌ ಕಥೆಯೇ 'My Groom : A Billionaire'

theres-none-under-heaven-equal-to-her.title: There's None Under Heaven Equal To Her
theres-none-under-heaven-equal-to-her.description: Raised by Master David and gifted with unmatched martial skills, Julie sets out to defend her fallen homeland, Daxia, from foreign invaders and deep-rooted betrayal. With her past cloaked in tragedy and her future carved in vengeance, she’s not just a fighter—she’s the legend her enemies fear. There’s None Under Heaven Equal to Her is a tale of legacy, loyalty, and one woman’s unstoppable rise. Watch Now!

the-noble-her.title: The Noble Her
the-noble-her.description: Widowed but unbroken, Lara takes charge of the powerful Global Finance empire—and the war it brings. With bodyguard Marty by her side and enemies circling within, she must uncover buried truths, avenge her daughter Rose, and outplay the cunning men trying to bring her down. The Noble Her is a sharp, stylish tale of power, secrets, and a woman too fierce to fall. Watch Now!

office-la-reels-pannalaamaa.title: Office-la Reels Pannalaamaa ?
office-la-reels-pannalaamaa.description: Office-la aadi.. paadi.. Reels Pannalaamaa ? Appadi pannunaa Termination kodukka management-ku rights irukkaa ?

a-heartbeat-away-1.title: A Heartbeat Away
a-heartbeat-away-1.description: Katie dumped Sean years ago, judging him for his lack of money. But now, Sean is a young CEO, standing in front of her. He’s ready to make her regret her decision, but as he looks at her, he starts to realize something—she’s always loved him, even back then.

meghnad-saha.title: Forgotten Star: Meghnad Saha
meghnad-saha.description: Genius scientist Meghnad Saha ko poori duniya ‘Darwin of Astronomy’ ke naam se jaanti hai, lekin apne desh mein hi unhe bhula diya gaya. Physics ko stars tak le jaane wale Meghnad Saha ek chhote dukandar ke ghar paida hue the. Phir kaise bane wo India ke greatest scientist? Aaiye sunte hain is show mein.

how-to-sell-your-way-through-life-3.title: How to Sell Your Way Through Life
how-to-sell-your-way-through-life-3.description: How to Sell Your Way Through Life - Indha book moolama author thannoda personal experience vachu nammapersonal finance pathina pala useful tips share panni irukaru. Konjam planninga irundha podhum kadan illadha oru peaceful financial life ah eppadi lead panradhu nu indha book la kelunga.

durga-bhabhi.title: Fearless Durga: Bhagat Singh Ki Saathi
durga-bhabhi.description: Rang De Basanti mein Soha Ali Khan ne Durga Bhabhi ka character play kiya hai. Bhagat Singh ki wife bankar Durga bhabhi ne kaise diya tha angrezon ko chakma? Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev aur Rajguru kyon bulate the unhe ‘post-box’? Aaiye sunte hain fearless revolutionary Durga Bhabhi ki kahani.

జానపద-కథలు.title: జానపద కథలు
జానపద-కథలు.description: మన జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సమస్యలను ధైర్యంగా ఎదుర్కోవడానికి సహాయపడే కథల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా ? అయితే "జానపద కథలు" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ ని తప్పకుండా వినండి.

wisdom-tales.title: Wisdom Tales
wisdom-tales.description: జ్ఞానాన్ని మరియు వ్యక్తిత్వ వికాసాన్ని పెంపొందించే కథల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే "విస్డం కథలు" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ ని  వినండి.

sawai-jai-singh-ii.title: Sawai Jai Singh
sawai-jai-singh-ii.description: Apne pita ki mrityu ke baad, 11 saal ke chote se Vijay Singh ne Amer ki rajgaddi sambhal li aur Kachwaha vansh ke 29 we Rajput Raja ban gaye. Mughal badshah Aurangjeb ko apni hazir jawabi se kayal krne wale Vijay Singh kaise Sawai Jai Singh bane aur gulabi shehar Jaipur ki neev rakhi...Aayiye jante hain is audio show me.

చిట్టి-పొట్టి-కథలు-1.title: చిట్టి పొట్టి కథలు
చిట్టి-పొట్టి-కథలు-1.description: ధైర్యంగా, తెలివిగా బ్రతకటం నేర్పే కథల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "చిట్టి పొట్టి కథలు" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ ని లేట్ చేయకుండా వినండి.

திவான்-லொடபடசிங்-பகதூர்.title: Diwan Lodabadasingh Bahadhoor
திவான்-லொடபடசிங்-பகதூர்.description: Avan Samaiyalkaranaga irunthum oruvelai sappattukke thindadukiran. Athanaal migapperiya thittam ondraith theettukiraan. Avanukku vetri kidaiththathaa?

bharat-ka-cinema-itihaas.title: Bharat ka Cinema Itihaas
bharat-ka-cinema-itihaas.description: Bollywood har kisi ke fascination ka hissa hai. Cinema ki chaka-chaundh, sitaron ka craze aur rupahle parde par khud ko bhula dene wali duniya. Par kaise shuru hua tha ye cinema ka safar? Kaun the iske founding fathers? Kya thi Cinema jagat ki shuruaati dikkatein? Janne ke liye sunien, Bollywood ka Cinema Itihaas...

அப்பா-பிள்ளை.title: Appa Pillai
அப்பா-பிள்ளை.description: Ethirparatha vithamaga appa maganagavum, magan thanthaiyagavum maarividukiraargal. Ethanal? Enna nadanthathu?
