daughter-of-the-secret-tycoon.title: Daughter Of The Secret Tycoon
daughter-of-the-secret-tycoon.description: The microdrama begins with Rishi Sharma, a seemingly humble single father and daily wage laborer, who is secretly connected to the powerful "Steel Eagle" organization and rescues heiress Aalia from "Fire Phoenix." Rishi's life takes an unexpected turn when powerful CEO Ashna Rai, after a public act of revenge, surprisingly proposes marriage to him, despite their social disparity. Their hasty marriage unravels as Ashna discovers Aalia's secret engagement to Arjun, an intern in her company, leading to Ashna's manipulation of the situation. Further complicating matters, Aalia's wealthy friend Priya also harbors affections for Arjun and actively works to separate him from Aalia, culminating in Arjun's public betrayal and the shattering of Aalia's engagement. Publicly humiliated, Aalia and her father vow retribution, leading to Aalia's sudden inheritance and a connection to the enigmatic Rishi. Aalia finds new love with CEO Rishabh, who retaliates against Arjun and Priya, only for Priya to unveil her formidable ties to a rival empire, escalating the conflict with the introduction of Shera, an assassin linked to the powerful "Steely Eagle." Corporate intrigue deepens with the mysterious "Fire Red Diamond," leading to accusations against Rishi and hints of his hidden identity as "Fire Phoenix." Ashna's secret marriage to Rishi ignites her powerful father Prakash Rai's fury, resulting in violent confrontations and Rishi's public humiliation at a college reunion. However, Rishi dramatically reveals his wife is Aashna Raai, the CEO of the formidable Raai Group, instantly reversing the power dynamic. Ashna then fiercely defends Rishi in high-stakes corporate battles, crippling a former friend's business and facing traps set by vengeful adversaries. The series culminates with Rishi revealing his true identity as the powerful CEO Randheer Singhania, a secret millionaire who had hidden his status to test Ashna's love and forge his daughter Aalya's character. The show concludes with Randheer publicly reaffirming his bond with Ashna, appointing Aalya as Chairman of the Singhania Group, and forging a strategic alliance between their corporate groups, bringing their complex journey of love, revenge, and corporate power to a resolution.

dark-web-pyaar-ya-paap.title: Dark Web - Pyaar Ya Paap
dark-web-pyaar-ya-paap.description: डॉ. त्रिशा, एक 35 वर्षीय मनोवैज्ञानिक जो अपने अपमानजनक पति देवराज के साथ एक असफल विवाह में फंसी हुई है, और विवान नाम के एक रहस्यमय 21 वर्षीय युवक के साथ उलझ जाती है जो उससे मिलने के लिए एक दुर्घटना का नाटक करता है। जो एक वर्जित प्रेम कहानी के रूप में शुरू होता है, वह एक अंधेरे मोड़ ले लेता है जब त्रिशा को पता चलता है कि दोनों पुरुष "डार्क वेब बार" से जुड़े हुए हैं, जो एक अपराधिक संस्थान है जहाँ महिलाओं को नशे में धुत्त करके तस्करी की जाती है। शुरुआत में त्रिशा को लगता है कि विवान ही शिकारी है, लेकिन बाद में उसे पता चलता है कि वह वास्तव में "शक्ति फोर्स" का नेता है, एक न्यायप्रिय संगठन जो उसके अपने पति देवराज द्वारा चलाए जा रहे तस्करी के जाल का भांडाफोड़ करने के लिए काम कर रहा है। सीरीज़ का चरमोत्कर्ष एक नाटकीय बचाव अभियान में होता है जहाँ विवान और उसकी टीम त्रिशा को ऑनलाइन नीलामी से बचाती है, जिससे देवराज की गिरफ्तारी होती है और उसके पीड़ितों को न्याय मिलता है। यह शो रोमांस, क्राइम थ्रिलर और सामाजिक टिप्पणी के तत्वों को मिलाता है, वैवाहिक हिंसा, मानव तस्करी और धोखे पर आधारित रिश्तों की जटिल प्रकृति के विषयों की खोज करता है, जबकि अंततः यह संदेश देता है कि प्रेम बुराई पर विजय पाता है।

the-counterattack-of-the-twin-babies.title: The Counterattack of The Twin Babies
the-counterattack-of-the-twin-babies.description: Lavanya’s story begins with public humiliation and personal injury, as Ganesh blocks her from a corporate event and strips away her status at work. Their relationship quickly collapses into a bitter marriage crisis marked by mistrust, accusations, and a demand for divorce. A buried betrayal from years earlier resurfaces, and the conflict turns more dangerous when a drink is tampered with and someone begins choking. From there, the drama expands beyond the marriage into a family mystery involving children, missing relatives, and disputed parentage. Lavanya repeatedly fights to reach a child kept away from her, while Ganesh and other family members try to control who can see whom and what truth can be spoken. The children become the emotional center of the story, especially when they refuse food, panic in hospitals, or beg to see their mother. A boy who resembles Lavanya’s lost son Saket deepens her grief and hope, while another child, Sujan, becomes tied to the larger secret around the family. The show also folds in a corporate struggle over a smart chip, patents, and control of Lavanya’s work, making her private and professional battles inseparable. Ganesh often stands between Lavanya and the children, but he is also pulled into the search for answers and the fallout from old misunderstandings. Public shame spreads through viral footage, edited videos, and community gossip, turning the family’s pain into a social scandal. Lavanya accuses others of exposing and harming her son, while others blame her return for the unrest. The mystery deepens when hidden family separations are revealed, including the suggestion that one son was thought dead and another was secretly alive. As custody fears, kidnapping claims, and blackmail pile up, the household fractures further. Ganesh’s mother also enters as a force of rejection, publicly treating Lavanya as an outsider and challenging her place in the family and company. Yet Ganesh later defends Lavanya’s research role and the child-related work, showing that the conflict is not simply one-sided. The revelation that Saket has been kidnapped by Suma pushes the story into a rescue crisis and confirms how dangerous the hidden resentments have become. By the end, the family is still divided, the children remain at risk, and the truth about parentage, betrayal, and loss is only partly uncovered.

my-groom-a-billionaire-1.title: My Groom A Billionaire
my-groom-a-billionaire-1.description: The microdrama begins with Megha, publicly humiliated after a failed wedding, entering a strategic contract marriage with Jay, a powerful CEO who is fleeing his own arranged union with Diya. Initially driven by mutual desperation and hidden agendas, their relationship unexpectedly evolves into a genuine romantic connection. However, Jay conceals his true identity as a wealthy CEO, even posing as a humble chef, to seek an authentic bond, leading to corporate intrigue and widespread rumors. Megha eventually uncovers Jay's deception, causing profound betrayal, though a fragile reconciliation occurs as Jay confesses his love and defies his family's corporate ambitions. Their fragile peace is shattered when Jay is held captive by Diya and his manipulative parent, who plot to dissolve his marriage to Megha for a corporate deal. Megha embarks on a desperate mission to rescue him, learning a forgotten contract is key to his freedom, while Jay is forced to sign papers under duress. Amidst these threats, Megha discovers she is pregnant, a secret she kept from Jay, further complicating their dangerous situation. An obsessive man, later revealed to be an accomplice to Gouri, orchestrates Megha's kidnapping and Jay's disappearance, issuing ultimatums to separate the couple. Jay's manipulative mother also schemes against them, faking a heart attack to trap her son. The couple faces relentless opposition and chilling death threats from Jay's powerful family, who attempt to sever their romance with money and intimidation. Jay, determined to protect Megha and their unborn child, offers to abandon his entire business empire. The true mastermind behind Megha's kidnapping, Gouri, is exposed, with an accomplice seeking redemption by vowing to bring her to justice. The series culminates with the arrival of Jay's estranged parents, seeking forgiveness for past manipulations, yet Jay remains suspicious of their motives, particularly concerning the gender of their unborn child, leaving the couple's future uncertain amidst ongoing threats.

tangled-ties-and-tipsy-vows-2.title: Tangled Ties and Tipsy Vows
tangled-ties-and-tipsy-vows-2.description: After years apart, Carol is forced by her stepmother and stepsister to marry playboy Grayson instead of her stepsister. A chance encounter with her childhood love Dylan, who now resents her for a past betrayal, complicates things. Dylan pretends to date Carol's stepsister to torment her, but as truths emerge, their tangled relationships take unexpected turns.

alpha-she-wasnt-the-one-1.title: Alpha, She Wasn't the One
alpha-she-wasnt-the-one-1.description: Annie’s story begins with survival pressure, as eviction and poverty push her to the edge before a mysterious candy and other strange encounters hint that her life is being steered by fate. Around her, a man who resists an unwanted match is repeatedly pulled toward a woman he is told is destined for him, establishing a world where ordinary choices seem overridden by unseen forces. That supernatural pressure soon collides with a fake-girlfriend setup inside a wealthy family home, where Annie is introduced as Leon’s partner and drawn into expectations she never chose. The arrangement grows more intimate and more unstable through domestic tension, family scrutiny, and the suggestion that Leon is hiding a nonhuman identity. As the story expands, Annie is pulled into a corporate setting where her intended designer role is replaced by assistant work, and she is forced to navigate a harsh office hierarchy. There, accusations, humiliation, and power plays make it clear that status and control matter as much as romance. Leon remains central in both worlds, appearing as a company owner or powerful figure who can protect, pressure, or confuse Annie depending on the moment. Their connection is repeatedly framed as formal on the surface but emotionally charged underneath, with both of them trying to manage what others think. The drama also introduces rivalries over design ownership and workplace recognition, showing that Annie’s struggle is not only romantic but professional. At the same time, other women and men around Leon are caught in misunderstandings about engagement, marriage, and who belongs with whom. Several scenes suggest that Leon is bound by duty or public expectation even when his feelings point elsewhere. The romance becomes more openly supernatural again through moon-ring bonds, alpha and luna destiny, and references to werewolf identity. Annie is repeatedly asked to accept a role she does not fully understand, while she resists being forced into it. Memory loss, hypnosis, and warnings about hidden enemies deepen the sense that her reality has been manipulated. Leon alternates between protector, pursuer, and wounded lover, and his behavior often intensifies the conflict rather than resolving it. Annie, meanwhile, tries to protect herself and the people she cares about, even when that means creating distance from Leon. By the later part of the arc, love, duty, and danger are all colliding at once, and the story closes with the central bond still unresolved and under threat.

my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-1.title: My Call Boy Billionaire Daddy
my-call-boy-billionaire-daddy-1.description: The microdrama unfolds as several women, including Aynas, Iris Carson, and Ines/Innas, are thrust into public humiliation, betrayal, and financial ruin, often by men from their past. Aynas vows revenge after a public betrayal, while Iris grapples with a media scandal, her father's suicide, and a secret pregnancy. Ines, a single mother, faces blackmail and is forced into transactional cohabitation, while Innas Carson's hidden identity is exposed by Bob, leading to financial entrapment. These initial quests for justice and retribution soon intertwine with a deeper corporate conspiracy involving a mysterious "chip." A powerful CEO, Lewis, also known as the "Black Viper," is hunted for this stolen chip, which is hinted to be critical for global catastrophe. As the narrative progresses, Ines/Innas becomes increasingly entangled with the enigmatic and powerful Richmond, who is revealed to be her boss, a former "call boy," and eventually her manipulative lover. Their relationship is fraught with power struggles, humiliation, and unexpected protection against slander. Ines/Innas investigates her father's suspicious death and the collapse of her family's company, suspecting a cover-up and her uncle's embezzlement. Simultaneously, a paternity mystery surrounding Ines's child emerges, with Mr. Ward investigating its origins. Other characters like Matilda are drawn into manipulative arrangements with Mr. Richman, highlighting his pervasive influence. The stakes escalate as characters face brutal attacks, and the "chip" becomes a central focus for various factions, including a precocious boy named Charlie who inadvertently possesses a linked item. Ines ultimately confronts Mr. Richman, realizing his intricate manipulation of her life and his connection to her family's downfall and her father's murder, despite his declaration of emotional attachment. The show explores themes of revenge, hidden identities, corporate espionage, and the complex, often destructive, nature of power and relationships, culminating in a desperate struggle for truth and survival amidst a web of personal and global threats.

migrant-workers-love-story-1.title: MIGRANT WORKERS LOVE STORY
migrant-workers-love-story-1.description: A powerful Heiress Protagonist, Jing Jing, faces immense pressure from her traditional Patriarch to enter an arranged marriage, but defiantly seeks alternative unions, often through lucrative yet controlling contract marriages. These arrangements frequently involve a financially desperate Male Protagonist, Tian Yu, leading to complex power dynamics and unexpected romantic tension. Initially, Tian Yu endures humiliation and sacrifices his dignity, often for his dependent son's future, while Jing Jing asserts her independence with ruthless tactics amidst corporate intrigue and class conflict. However, Jing Jing's perception of Tian Yu shifts as he reveals hidden talents and becomes embroiled in corporate power struggles, prompting her to investigate his true identity. Concurrently, her powerful grandfather prepares to transfer his corporate empire to her, expressing dissatisfaction with her manipulative brothers. Tian Yu, despite his humble facade, uncovers corporate sabotage and defiantly challenges authority, leading to an intense, unconventional dynamic with Jing Jing. A disgraced magnate orchestrates a complex revenge scheme against Tian Yu and Jing Jing, causing corporate crises and internal sabotage. The narrative escalates dramatically when Jing Jing is kidnapped for a three-billion ransom, revealing a deep-seated family betrayal orchestrated by her ambitious brother, Wei. Tian Yu heroically intervenes in her rescue, saving her in a violent confrontation, though he is later brutally attacked and left for dead, only to recover. Wei confesses to his crimes, driven by jealousy over inheritance, and Jing Jing vows chilling direct revenge against him. Amidst these conflicts, Jing Jing ultimately accepts a co-leadership role in the 'Leo Group' alongside Tian Yu, whose union is blessed by the Patriarch. Despite this resolution, the family's power struggles persist, hinting at ongoing internal conflicts within the dynasty. The show explores the high stakes of corporate control, personal freedom, and the evolving relationship between the heiress and her enigmatic partner.

With each shocking revelation, she fights to restore her name, dignity, and the love she truly deserves.A tale of masked identities, betrayal, and fierce redemption where the crown isn’t given, it’s earned.

woman-can-holdup-half-the-sky.title: Woman can holdup half the sky
woman-can-holdup-half-the-sky.description: శ్రావ్య చిన్నతనంలోనే తల్లి పావనితో పాటు ఇంటి నుండి గెంటివేయబడుతుంది. దీనికి కారణం ఆమె తండ్రి విజయ్ వేరే మహిళతో పెట్టుకున్న అక్రమ సంబంధం. చాలా రోజుల తరువాత, శ్రావ్య చదువు కోసం ఆమె తల్లి తన తండ్రి విజయ్‌ను సహాయం కోరుతుంది. అయితే, దానికి శ్రావ్య సవతి తల్లి కుట్రలు చేసి చిచ్చు పెడుతుంది. ఇన్ని సమస్యల మధ్య, శ్రావ్య తన చదువును పూర్తి చేసి మంచి ప్రయోజకురాలిగా మారతుందా?

no-way-back.title: No Way Back
no-way-back.description: The microdrama centers on Aman, an outsider with a complex past, who is disinherited from the affluent Chopra family after a shocking poisoning event and a prophecy foretelling his destruction of their empire. Despite an initial empathetic connection with heiress Alisha, Aman faces public humiliation and classist cruelty from matriarch Charvi, leading to his dramatic renunciation of his family and surname. Accused of theft by his brother and challenged to repay all past debts, Aman, supported by his friend Sujeet, begins to rebuild his life, demonstrating sharp intellect. However, his financial success is quickly overshadowed by a formidable debt to Chopra, whose investigation reveals perplexing "zero expense" bank statements, and his disappearance is followed by accusations of theft, while his father searches for him amidst looming corporate secrets. Years later, Aman resurfaces, consumed by vengeance and fueled by a history of profound abuse and neglect, including severe malnutrition, forced confinement, and false accusations by various family members. Now a brilliant UI/UX genius, Aman is unjustly fired and publicly humiliated by his powerful family, who reveal his identity as the butler's son and blacklist him from the corporate world. He defiantly leaves, determined to build his own tech empire and dismantle the Chopra family's operations using his superior intellect and foresight into future technologies. His return sparks a high-stakes corporate confrontation, as he defiantly rejects offers to rejoin Chopra's Industry and orchestrates a "very big project" to challenge their empire. Aman confronts his cruel Patriarch father, various mothers (Charvi, Radha, Isha), and sisters (Alisha, Chandrika, Nisha) for their complicity in his suffering, emotional abandonment, and past betrayals, including Alisha's false accusations and attempts to ruin his life. As Chopra Industries faces financial collapse due to Aman's new venture, "Miraculous Era," he engages in a fierce corporate rivalry with Alisha, dismissing her traditional innovations with his own groundbreaking, socially conscious AI for rural communities. Amidst corporate sabotage, vanishing personnel, and the suspicious actions of Vakeel and Sujit, Aman's career is systematically destroyed, and he is framed for theft by Alisha. However, a determined woman uncovers the truth of Alisha's manipulative actions, eventually clearing his name. Despite his hidden heroism in saving Radha and Sneha from a fire, Aman, now a ruthless CEO, adamantly refuses to forgive or rejoin his family, even as his desperate patriarch father and Charvi plead for his return to save their crumbling company. Hardened by a history of exploitation and deception by his own kin, Aman declares a metaphorical rebirth, vowing to prioritize himself and exact fierce justice on his tormentors, leaving a woman's anguished cry hinting at a deeper, unresolved emotional connection from his painful history. The stakes are high: Aman seeks to reclaim his honor and dismantle a corrupt empire, while the Chopra family fights for its very survival against the son they once cast out.

fallen-angel-treasure-huntress-steals-he.title: Fallen Angel
fallen-angel-treasure-huntress-steals-he.description: Controlled by a deadly chip and forced to obey the Viper crime syndicate, Agent Bertha infiltrates the nation's grandest wedding to steal a legendary diamond ring. But a shocking secret affair between the groom’s best friend and the bride throws her mission into chaos. When the betrayed groom catches them—and mistakes Bertha for a guest—he cancels the wedding and declares she will be his new bride.

betrayed-by-my-beloved-wife.title: Betrayed By My Beloved Wife
betrayed-by-my-beloved-wife.description: A timid musician, Arjun, gets wrongfully accused of a crime and falls from love into ruin at the hands of his once-adoring wife, Tanya, now his cruel tormentor. Humiliated and broken, Arjun finds an unexpected lifeline in Rhea, a kind surgeon who believes in his forgotten talent. As Tanya’s obsession spirals and dark secrets begin to surface, Arjun must reclaim his voice—and his life—in this gripping tale of betrayal, resilience, and redemption.

revenge-of-the-loyal-bf.title: Revenge Of My Fake Boyfriend

my-beast-billionaire.title: My Beast Billionaire

hollywood-staged-romance-live-247-1.description: ఓ నూతన నటి కెరీర్ ప్రారంభంలోనే సమస్యలు ఎదుర్కొంటుంది. తాగినPARTYలో ఓ ప్రముఖ సీఈఓను ముద్దిచేసి వైరల్ అవుతుంది, దాంతో ఫేక్ రిలేషన్‌షిప్ కాంట్రాక్ట్‌కి ఒప్పుకుంటుంది. కానీ ఆ నటనలో ప్రేమ నిజమవుతుంది… చివరికి అతడు ఆమె కోసం ఆరేళ్లుగా వెతుకుతున్నాడని తెలిసాక ఆమె జీవితం మలుపుతిరుగుతుంది.

double-life-ceo-chasing-love-2.description: On her wedding day, a stranger takes the groom’s place — and marries her instead. No one knows who he is or why he did it, but his silence hides a stormy past. What begins as a shocking twist unravels into a tale of secrets, fate, and forbidden love.

the-royal-secret-1.title: The Royal Secret
the-royal-secret-1.description: ఐశ్వర్యవంతురాలు అయిన ఇషిత తన అసలైన గుర్తింపును దాచుకుంటూ, తన ప్రతిభపై జీవితం నిర్మించుకోవాలని అనుకుంటుంది. కానీ ప్రేమలో మోసం, మిత్రుల కుట్రలు ఎదురైనప్పుడు, ఆమె తన పేరును, గౌరవాన్ని తిరిగి పొందేందుకు పోరాటం ప్రారంభిస్తుంది.

cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity.title: Cloaked in Power: His Secret Identity
cloaked-in-power-his-secret-identity.description: Rahul, a formidable warrior seeking peace in a modern city, is drawn into a dangerous urban mystery after rescuing a distressed woman, Deepika. Deepika, a powerful corporate VP and heiress, navigates treacherous family politics and a manipulated engagement to the ruthless Vinod. Their complicated past and vast class differences ignite a bitter power struggle, further complicated by Vinod's public shaming of Deepika, accusations of an illicit affair with Rahul, and attempts at abduction. Rahul fiercely intervenes to protect Deepika, sparking a dangerous class conflict and a vow of protection. Deepika, ensnared in a perilous forced marriage to Vinod, defiantly refuses and reveals her secret love for Rahul, leading to severe repercussions from her family, including threats to Rahul's life and a scandalous video. Rahul is unjustly fired by Vinod, vowing retribution and revealing a complex past between them. Despite family pressure, Deepika proposes a strategic marriage to Vinod, while Rahul unexpectedly appears as another heiress's boyfriend, leading to public confrontations and physical altercations with Vinod. As Rahul's influence grows, he violently asserts control over powerful families, facing death threats and declarations of war from Vinod and the newly introduced Jagadeesh Kumar, who seeks to force Deepika into marriage. Rahul continues to protect Deepika, defying powerful figures and securing crucial business projects despite impossible challenges from her family. Deepika ultimately faces disownment and physical abuse for her love, culminating in her abduction by the predatory Naveen, orchestrated by a vengeful Madhavan. Rahul embarks on a desperate search, revealing his hidden past as an orphaned martial arts expert with extraordinary powers, and confronts Naveen to rescue Deepika. He unleashes dark justice against corrupt entities, rejecting powerful government roles to protect common people and eradicate injustice, leading to the downfall of powerful families and a life-altering decision for Deepika. The show explores love defying societal norms, the fight for family honor, and a terrifying struggle for survival against powerful enemies, as Rahul's legendary past and future adventures unfold.

love-by-chance-1.title: Love By Chance
love-by-chance-1.description: Aarohi, a radiant bride-to-be, faces devastating heartbreak when her fiancé abandons her for her best friend on their wedding day. Simultaneously, powerful CEO Vihan Malhotra is given a 24-hour ultimatum to marry or lose his vast inheritance to opportunistic cousins. Desperate for mutual benefit and revenge, Aarohi proposes a contract marriage to Vihan, a strictly business alliance complicated by her past in the cutthroat fashion industry, where she was manipulated by her boyfriend/manager Vinay and star model Priya Mehra. As Aarohi, initially known as 'Stumble,' faces dismissal, Vihan intervenes, hinting at a deeper connection and orchestrating her rise to stardom, displacing an "established" rival. Their burgeoning romance is thrust into the spotlight, leading to media speculation and Aarohi's suspicion of Vihan's motives, while her ex-fiancé Aryan and Priya plot revenge. Amidst this, Aarohi's career faces systematic sabotage, prompting Vihan to protect her and clear her name from a rival's orchestrated scandal, deepening their professional dynamic into an unexpected romance. Their contract marriage is immediately challenged by Priya Mehra, who publicly accuses Aarohi of attempted murder and faked pregnancy, leading to a vengeful counter-attack by a mysterious figure. Aarohi, armed with proof, delivers an ultimatum to Priya and Vineet, threatening to expose their fraudulent activities. As their six-month contract nears its end, unspoken feelings emerge, complicated by the scrutiny of Vihan's father and a scorned woman's plot to sabotage their union. The narrative intensifies as Priya, initially desperate and pregnant, becomes a manipulative accuser, faking a miscarriage and orchestrating revenge plots against Aarohi, leading to police involvement and public humiliation. Vihan, despite initial doubts, uncovers a dangerous family conspiracy involving his brothers and Priya, seeking reconciliation with Aarohi and forming an alliance for retribution. Vihan's childhood friend, Sahiba, grows suspicious of Aarohi, while other Malhotra family members openly express hostility. Aarohi walks into a meticulously planned trap by Priya and Vihan's brothers, publicly accused of infidelity and carrying another man's child by Arjun, who presents fabricated evidence. However, Vihan fiercely defends Aarohi, revealing his apparent downfall was a meticulously planned trap to expose a deeper conspiracy orchestrated by Arjun, ambitious cousins, and Priya to seize the family's wealth and destroy their marriage. An audio recording confirms Priya's involvement, leading to the public vindication of Aarohi and the banishment of the conspirators from the family and company. The family patriarch apologizes to Aarohi, recognizing her as the rightful successor. Ultimately, Vihan and Aarohi's strategic contract marriage transforms into a bond of undeniable love and trust, as they commit to a future beyond past betrayals, rejecting further contractual agreements for a true marriage.

double-life-ceo-chasing-love-1.title: Double Life CEO: Chasing Love
double-life-ceo-chasing-love-1.description: The microdrama begins with Shweta, a desperate bride, entering an impromptu contract marriage with a mysterious stranger after her groom's public no-show, a union initially met with classist scorn. Her seemingly humble husband soon reveals himself as a powerful CEO, shocking her family and complicating their arrangement with the revelation that he was originally intended for Shweta's sister. As Shweta navigates this high-stakes marriage, she attempts to assert her own status, even orchestrating deceptions to counter social challenges and public humiliation. The narrative quickly plunges into a cutthroat corporate world, where Shweta battles to reclaim her mother's company and her father's legacy against ruthless rivals like Jagadish and Rohit. Her husband, Vinay Varma, emerges as a central, enigmatic figure, a powerful corporate 'vampire' with a hidden identity and a complex past, including a secret alliance with Honey, who is also his wife and Jagadish's fiancée. Their relationship evolves from a strategic alliance to one where Shweta develops genuine feelings for Vinay, despite his manipulative nature and his suspected role in her family's past betrayals. Vinay, in turn, dramatically reveals his immense wealth and power, turning the tables on those who humiliated him and fiercely protecting Shweta from manipulative in-laws and corporate adversaries. The show escalates into a full-blown corporate war, with Jagadish orchestrating elaborate schemes, including hostage situations and corporate sabotage, to destroy Vinay and Shweta. Amidst these intense conflicts, betrayals run deep, and hidden identities unravel, particularly around Vinay Varma, whose true connection to Shweta's family's downfall is exposed. The couple faces immense pressure and threats to their company and their lives, ultimately hinting at a profound, albeit tumultuous, romantic commitment forged in the crucible of corporate and personal turmoil.

fight-for-love.title: Fight For Love
fight-for-love.description: Burdened by crushing debt, Pooja, also known as Anika, is blackmailed by the ruthless Maddy into corporate espionage, tasked with infiltrating CEO Vikram's company to sabotage his merger bid. Her mission takes a dangerous turn as she uncovers Vikram's secret life as an underground MMA fighter, leading to initial animosity and his suspicion of her being Maddy's spy. A complex dynamic emerges after she saves his life during a collapse, prompting Vikram to propose she become a double agent against Maddy. Caught between Maddy's threats, Vikram's demands, and the jealousy of rivals like Maya and Sonia, Anika navigates a perilous world of corporate intrigue and hidden identities. Their professional alliance deepens into a burgeoning romance, despite Vikram's attempts to keep her at a distance due to his past traumas, including the tragic death of his former love, Vedika, and his sister's brutal murder, which fuels his quest for revenge. Anika, meanwhile, discovers her own handler murdered her parents, transforming her mission into one of personal vengeance. As she operates as an informant, her loyalties blur, and her handler, Sanjay, suspects her attachment to Vikram. Corporate rivals like Alex and Sonia deploy moles and schemes to dismantle Vikram's empire and frame Anika for espionage. The discovery of Anika's pregnancy with Vikram's child further complicates her double life, leading to Vikram's dramatic intervention to protect her from arrest. Sonia, now allied with Maddy, escalates her schemes by kidnapping the pregnant Anika to blackmail Vikram into withdrawing from a crucial corporate acquisition. Vikram's secret life as an underground fighter is exposed, adding immense pressure as he faces a decisive MMA combat. Anika's life and the fate of the merger depend on Vikram's victory in the brutal fight. Ultimately, Vikram triumphs, securing the corporate merger and a new role, while protecting Anika and their unborn child. However, his victory is immediately shadowed by the emergence of a vengeful villain who confesses to his parents' murder and threatens his new family. This villain is swiftly apprehended by law enforcement, bringing a temporary resolution to the immediate threats.

revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend.title: Revenge Of My Fake Boyfriend
revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend.description: Rajat, a humble and loyal guy, is publicly humiliated and dumped by his ambitious girlfriend for not having status or money. He returns to India, but everyone is shocked to learn that he is the husband of the country's most powerful and beautiful CEO. Watch "Revenge of My Fake Boyfriend" – a unique tale of love, betrayal, and revenge!

revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend-1.title: Revenge Of My Fake Boyfriend
revenge-of-my-fake-boyfriend-1.description: রজত, এক সাধারণ ও বিশ্বস্ত ছেলেটি, তার উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষী প্রেমিকার হাতে প্রকাশ্যে অপমানিত ও পরিত্যক্ত হয়, কারণ তার কাছে না ছিল অর্থ, না ছিল সামাজিক মর্যাদা। সে ভারতে ফিরে আসে, কিন্তু সবাই অবাক হয়ে যায় যখন জানতে পারে—সে দেশের সবচেয়ে প্রভাবশালী ও অপরূপা CEO-র স্বামী! দেখুন "রিভেঞ্জ অফ মাই Fake বয়ফ্রেন্ড"—ভালোবাসা, বিশ্বাসঘাতকতা আর প্রতিশোধের এক অনন্য গল্প!

rebirth-of-a-mafia-queen.title: Rebirth Of A Mafia Queen
rebirth-of-a-mafia-queen.description: Once a pawn in the mafia game, she’s now back as the one pulling the strings. With every step, she rewrites the rules of the underworld. “Rebirth of a Mafia Queen” is a ruthless tale of revenge, loyalty, and a crown forged in chaos. Watch Now!

wonder-boy-parth-4.title: Wonder Boy Parth
wonder-boy-parth-4.description: In a tale of betrayal and redemption, a visually impaired man named Parth harnesses ancient mystical powers from his mother’s locket to seek justice against those who wronged him, uncovering priceless treasures and battling dark forces in a city ruled by greed and deception.

the-substitute-bride-2.title: The Substitute Bride
the-substitute-bride-2.description: A mysterious woman takes her sister’s place in an arranged marriage to save her family. Behind her calm façade lies a past full of secrets, deception, and hidden strength. As she steps into a world of power, betrayal, and love, her true identity begins to unravel. Each revelation shakes the lives of those around her—and the man she was never meant to marry.

the-mysterious-master-chef.title: The Mysterious Master Chef 🌶️
the-mysterious-master-chef.description: Rohan, who has been passionate about cooking since childhood, dreams of becoming a great chef despite growing up in poverty. He believes all he needs is a chance to showcase his talent. An unexpected twist enters his life with the Royal Hotel. Will Master Chef Anirudh, who works there, be in a position to give Rohan a chance? Who will emerge as the winner in this game among the chefs?

supreme-master-asks-you-to-believe-in-sc.title: Supreme Master Asks You to Believe in Science
supreme-master-asks-you-to-believe-in-sc.description: The microdrama centers on Xiao Fan, later known as Agni, a powerful protector descending from a mountain retreat, initially bound by an unwanted arranged marriage to the independent heiress Lin Jia, also known as Protima. He arrives seeking vengeance for his family's destruction, a quest that quickly intertwines with the internal struggles of the Jiang family, who face a patriarch's critical illness and a ruthless corporate power struggle. As Agni protects Protima from various threats, including corporate takeovers and coercive agreements orchestrated by the formidable Rai family, his true nature and immense power begin to surface. He is revealed to be a 'Supreme Heavenly Master,' a 'disciple of an ancient warrior,' and eventually a 'Grandmaster' and 'ancient Immortal.' Agni defiantly declares war on the powerful Rai family, whom he holds responsible for the annihilation of his own lineage, the Sen family, a decade prior. This deep-seated vendetta escalates dramatically when Agni murders Rahul Rai, prompting the Rai matriarch, Damini Rai, to swear personal revenge and mobilize an army. Amidst this escalating conflict, Protima's loyalty is tested as she grapples with her husband's ruthless ambition and his plans to dismantle her family's structure, even as he fiercely protects her. The narrative further intensifies with the murder of Agni's son, fueling his relentless pursuit of retribution against the Rai family. Agni, now asserting himself as the 'true emperor' and 'Imperial Master,' confronts and defeats powerful elders and rivals, seizing control and unleashing devastating vengeance upon the Rai family for their past sins. His divine mission to unite heavenly lords begins to unfold, intertwined with a nascent romance with his devoted protégé, Jia. The show culminates in an all-out war, driven by cycles of violence, ancient legacies, and an unyielding pursuit of justice and ultimate power.

hidden-talent-3.title: Hidden Talent
hidden-talent-3.description: ತನ್ನ ಜ್ಞಾಪಕ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ, ತನ್ನ‌ ಸತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅರಿಯಲು ಬೀದಿಬೀದಿ ಅಲೆಯುತ್ತಿರ್ತಾನೆ. ತಾನೊಬ್ಬ ಮಾರ್ಷಲ್ ಆರ್ಟ್ ಆರ್ಟಿಸ್ಟ್ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಅವನಿಗೆ ನೆನಪಿಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾ? ಆತನ ಈ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು ಅನ್ನೋದೇ 'Hidden Talent' ಸ್ಟೋರಿ. ನೋಡಿ ಎಂಜಾಯ್ ಮಾಡಿ.

ye-ishq-nhi-asaan.title: Ye Ishq nhi asaan
ye-ishq-nhi-asaan.description: On the day of her wedding, Vamika’s world crumbles when she catches her fiancé with her best friend, but a chance encounter with the mysterious and charming Shaurya offers an escape — one wild night that deepens into something more. As Vamika finds solace and growing affection in his presence, she’s faced with an unexpected proposition: to stay, she must sign a contract built on submission and trust. Just as she begins to fall, a shocking revelation turns her world upside down — Shaurya isn’t just a stranger, but someone intricately tied to her past. A gripping tale of betrayal, desire, secrets, and forbidden love.

a-revenge-of-loyal-boyfriend.title: Revenge Of My Fake Boyfriend
a-revenge-of-loyal-boyfriend.description: Rajat, a humble and loyal guy, is publicly humiliated and dumped by his ambitious girlfriend for not having status or money. He returns to India, but everyone is shocked to learn that he is the husband of the country's most powerful and beautiful CEO. Watch "Revenge of My Fake Boyfriend" – a unique tale of love, betrayal, and revenge!

betrayed-heiress-vengeance-reborn-2.title: Betrayed Heiress Vengeance Reborn
betrayed-heiress-vengeance-reborn-2.description:
అడవి లో దాగిన గూఢరహస్యం: ఒక అమ్మాయి తన గతాన్ని మర్చిపోయి ప్రేమలో పడితే… దాని పరిణామం ఏమవుతుంది?

ఇది ఓ మాయల ప్రపంచంలోకి తీసుకెళ్లే కథ. జ్ఞాపకశక్తిని కోల్పోయిన యువతి మంజు, అడవిలో ఒంటరిగా కనిపిస్తుంది. ఆమెను చూసిన ఓ అనామక యువకుడు, ఆమెపై మనసు పడి, తన ఇంటికి తీసుకెళ్లి రక్షించేస్తాడు. కానీ మంజు ఎవరు? ఆమెకు గతం ఉందా? ఒక్క ఆలోచన కూడా గుర్తుకు రావడం లేదు!

the-substitute-bride-unveiling-her-count.title: The Substitute Bride: Unveiling Her Secrets
the-substitute-bride-unveiling-her-count.description: The Substitute Bride: Unveiling Her Countless Secrets

happily-never-after-4.title: Happily Never After
happily-never-after-4.description: রাজবীর, যিনি ছোটবেলা থেকে দাদা-বৌদির কাছে মানুষ হয়েছেন, আজ একজন সফল ব্যবসায়ী। এনগেজমেন্টের দিন তিনি নিজে গিয়ে বৌদিকে এয়ারপোর্ট থেকে নিয়ে আসেন, কারণ তিনি তাঁকে নিজের মায়ের মতো মনে করেন। কিন্তু রাজবীরের ফিয়ান্সের মা বিষয়টি ভুল বুঝে বসেন—তিনি ভাবেন রাজবীর ওই মহিলার সঙ্গে সম্পর্কে জড়িত। রাজবীর যখন বৌদিকে নিজের ফ্ল্যাটে নিয়ে আসেন, তখন তার ফিয়ান্সে হঠাৎ সেখানে এসে বৌদির সঙ্গে এমন দুর্ব্যবহার করেন যে তাদের সম্পর্ক ভেঙে যাওয়া ছাড়া উপায় থাকে না।

double-life-ceo-chasing-love.title: Double Life CEO: Chasing Love
double-life-ceo-chasing-love.description:
She was all set to marry the man her family had chosen — the mandap was decorated, the rituals had begun.
But just before the final vows, the wedding came to a shocking halt. In the chaos, a stranger stepped forward… and within moments, she was married to him instead.
No one knew who he was — only that he carried a quiet intensity and a past no one dared ask about. What began as a mistake soon turns into a tangled story of secrets, fate, and unexpected love.

boss-bani-maid.title: Boss Bani Maid
boss-bani-maid.description: Pratima Oberoi, 28-year-old MBA graduate, returns as CEO to save her grandfather’s failing hotel chain. Disguised as a maid, she uncovers corruption by managers Ruchika, Nancy, and Mohit with help from COO Dev, her college friend. Facing harassment and danger, she exposes their crimes, saves the business, promotes honest staff like Shweta, and finds love when Dev proposes.

real-life-munna-bhai-ki-story.title: Real Life Munna bhai Ki Story
real-life-munna-bhai-ki-story.description: Real Life Munna bhai Ki Story

imperial-concubine-cultivation-manual-fo.title: Royal Ranks & Romance
imperial-concubine-cultivation-manual-fo.description: ఆధునిక కాలంలో ఉన్న మేధావి విద్యార్థిని అనుకోకుండా సామ్రాజ్య యుగానికి టైం ట్రావెల్ చేస్తుంది. ఆమె బుద్ధి, తెలివితేటలతో రాజమహల్‌ రాజకీయాలు, పోటీలు, ప్రేమను తెలుసుకుంటూ, సామాన్య యువతిగా మొదలై అధికారం పొందిన రాజకన్యగా ఎదుగుతుంది. పాఠశాలలో నేర్చుకున్న స్కిల్స్‌ను వినూత్నంగా వినియోగిస్తూ ఆమె రాజవంశాన్ని ఆకట్టుకుంటుంది.

flash-marriage-with-a-big-shot-1.title: Flash Marriage with a Big Shot
flash-marriage-with-a-big-shot-1.description: The microdrama centers on Su Yao, a determined village girl, who enters a contract marriage with a man she believes to be a humble security guard, Boan. Her secret agenda is to seek revenge against the powerful CEO responsible for her ancestral village's destruction. Unbeknownst to Su Yao, Boan is, in fact, the very CEO she targets, President Fu, who is in disguise to avoid an arranged marriage and for other undisclosed reasons. Their initial transactional cohabitation in a dilapidated home unexpectedly sparks an unconventional romance, as Su Yao's pragmatic nature and resilience charm President Fu. As their relationship deepens, President Fu's hidden identity becomes increasingly precarious, with a marketing manager and other corporate figures suspecting his true status. Su Yao, meanwhile, faces relentless public humiliation, classist attacks, and sabotage from jealous rivals and manipulative family members who seek to undermine her and President Fu's position. She bravely infiltrates the corporate world, often being framed or falsely accused, but is subtly protected by President Fu, who uses his hidden power while meticulously maintaining his disguise. A central conflict emerges around the impending demolition of Su Yao's ancestral village, which she fiercely defends against corporate greed and betrayal, highlighting her deep connection to her heritage. The truth about President Fu's identity is dramatically revealed, often by his powerful mother, exposing his direct connection to Su Yao's target and the village's plight. This shocking revelation forces a profound confrontation of past deceptions and the complex, intertwined history between them. Despite the initial animosity and the heavy weight of his past actions, President Fu seeks Su Yao's forgiveness, dedicating himself to her and her community's prosperity and development. Their professional alliance and burgeoning romance evolve into a strong, undeniable familial bond, as they unite to defeat powerful adversaries and secure their shared legacy. This journey culminates in their engagement, solidifying a redefined relationship that bridges their disparate worlds and promises a future built on truth and mutual respect.

divorced-but-doted-upon-by-the-trio.title: Divorced But Doted Upon by the Trio
divorced-but-doted-upon-by-the-trio.description: Anastasia, an heiress who abandoned her wealthy family for Leonardo, faces profound betrayal and public humiliation when Leonardo, influenced by his mother Amma, divorces her to marry Drusilla. Accused of being a fraud and enduring threats, Anastasia dramatically reveals herself as the true heir of a powerful family, presenting a contract as proof of her claim. Her journey is complicated by a forbidden romance with Sebastian, who is later revealed to be her son and the true heir, igniting a fierce battle for legacy against Leonardo and his manipulative allies, including Drusilla/Drizella and Anna, who impersonate and sabotage her. Despite enduring public humiliation and physical assaults, Anastasia defiantly asserts her claim, supported by a mysterious Hidden Protector, later identified as Sebastian, and powerful family figures like Chairman Elara/Miss Hugh and her protective 'brothers.' She fights for control of her family's company, navigating complex alliances and rivalries, and declares war when Sebastian is harmed. The narrative reveals Anastasia as a vengeful 'Ivan's doll,' confronting rivals with shocking revelations about lineage and exposing conspiracies, including one orchestrated by Driscoll. As Anastasia uncovers that her marriage to Leonardo was built on a lie and he was a pawn, Sebastian, who has secretly loved her for years, emerges as her unwavering protector. Their complex bond, initially perceived as sibling-like, transforms into a lasting romance when Sebastian makes a heartfelt confession and proposes marriage, which Anastasia accepts, solidifying her vindication and finding true love amidst the chaos of her reclaimed identity and inheritance. The stakes involve Anastasia reclaiming her rightful identity, securing her vast inheritance, achieving justice against those who wronged her, and ultimately finding genuine love and family amidst betrayal and corporate warfare.

my-homeless-billionaire-husband.title: My Homeless Billionaire Husband
my-homeless-billionaire-husband.description: Amid Diwali’s chaos, Aditi meets Sameer, a quiet, mysterious man living on the streets. When her life spirals after a brutal betrayal, Sameer steps in with a shocking offer—one that feels both dangerous and inevitable. But behind his worn clothes lies a secret far bigger than she imagines. As their worlds collide, buried truths, hidden enemies, and a shadowed past begin to surface. In this high-stakes game, trust is a risk—and love might be the trap.

fake-boyfriend-5.title: Fake Boyfriend
fake-boyfriend-5.description: Akruthi, a business heiress, finds herself ensnared by a ruthless forced marriage proposal from the powerful Viraj Suryavanshi, threatening her family's failing business. To escape this predetermined fate and her class-conscious mother's disapproval of her true love, Dev, Akruthi devises a plan to hire Dev as her "fake boyfriend." This arrangement quickly escalates into a complex love triangle and fierce class conflict, leading to Akruthi's mother disowning her. Initially perceived as a man of modest means, Dev repeatedly reveals immense, hidden wealth, first in cryptocurrency and later as a hotel owner, dramatically shifting power dynamics and silencing his detractors. Akruthi's wise grandfather emerges as an unexpected ally, blessing her union with Dev amidst her father's strong opposition. The humble waiter, Shakti, is dramatically revealed as Dev Patil, a wealthy hotel owner, and subsequently the true CEO of Patil Weaponaries, accused of high-stakes fraud by the powerful Vardhan family. Dev confidently denies wrongdoing, hinting at a grand scheme to dismantle their empire and vowing chilling revenge against his corporate rivals. Akruthi defiantly rejects Viraj's lavish proposals despite immense family pressure, strategically declaring Dev a fake to escape a forced marriage and forming an alliance that ignites a high-stakes corporate battle. The conflict intensifies into a fierce corporate rivalry between Dev Patil and the Suryavamshi family, culminating in the collapse of Virat Suryavanshi's empire and his sudden death. His grieving son vows vengeance, seeking to uncover the truth behind his father's demise. Amidst this turmoil, a vengeful rival accuses the protagonist of murder and infiltrating their affluent family under false pretenses, casting intense scrutiny on his true identity and past. The show thus weaves a complex tapestry of corporate warfare, class struggle, hidden identities, and a gripping murder mystery, all driven by love, revenge, and the pursuit of power.

after-divorce-the-ex-wife-of-the-big-sho.title: After Divorce, the Ex-wife of the Big Shot Stirs up the World
after-divorce-the-ex-wife-of-the-big-sho.description: After Mike divorced her following his grandfather's death, Emma revealed her true identity — she was, in fact, a millionaire and the head of Smith's Group.

love-mera-fast-furious.title: Love Mera Fast & Furious.
love-mera-fast-furious.description:
Neha is torn between caring for her ailing mother and surviving her abusive stepfather.
 To make ends meet, she secretly works as Maya, a dancer at illegal street races.
 There, she meets Lucky - a masked, underground racer who sweeps her into a night of passion…
unaware that he’s going to stay at her home soon.

the-immortal-emperor-returns.title: The Immortal Emperor Returns
the-immortal-emperor-returns.description:
నలభై ఏళ్ల క్రితం మోసపోయి మరణించిన సమ్రాట్ వాన్ ఎంఫైర్, తన ప్రాణశక్తితో సామ్రాజ్యాన్ని కాపాడతాడు. ఇప్పుడు అతను సాధారణ యువకునిగా మళ్లీ జన్మించి, తన గతజ్ఞాపకాలను గుర్తు చేసుకుంటూ, శక్తులను తిరిగి పొందుతూ, మోసగాళ్లపై ప్రతీకారం తీర్చేందుకు ముందడుగు వేస్తాడు. చీకటి శక్తులకు వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, సమర్థ సామ్రాజ్యం నిర్మించేందుకు సంకల్పిస్తాడు.

అతని పునరాగమనం ఈ ప్రపంచాన్ని ఎలా మార్చబోతోందా?

operation-ex-lover.title: Operation Ex-Lover
operation-ex-lover.description: Six years ago, Mansi chose to break up with her boyfriend Rahul to avoid hindering his promising military career due to her overwhelming debt. Six years later, they reunite in a different city, Rahul is now a commanding officer, while Mansi is a single mother. Their chemistry reignites, but their bonding faces uncertainties of their class differences and pressure from people around them. This time, will they find their way back to love again?

the-princess-married-to-my-waistcoat-can.title: The princess married to my waistcoat can not stop
the-princess-married-to-my-waistcoat-can.description: এক রাজ্যের রাজকুমারী এক প্রতারকের ফাঁদে পড়ে মায়ের মৃত্যু ও রাজ্যের বিপর্যয়ের সাক্ষী হয়। রাজ্যের সেনানায়ক, যাকে সে ভালোবাসত, তাকে রক্ষা করতে গিয়ে প্রাণ হারায়। মৃত্যুর আগে সেনানায়ক রাজকন্যাকে পালাতে বলে। রাজকন্যা পালানোর চেষ্টা করলেও এক দুর্ঘটনায় সে ভবিষ্যতে পৌঁছে যায়। সেখানে এক কর্পোরেট ইভেন্টে সে হঠাৎ এক জেনারেল ম্যানেজারকে চিনে ফেলে—সে-ই তার প্রিয় সেনানায়ক। সে দৌড়ে গিয়ে তাকে জড়িয়ে ধরে বলে, “তুমি বেঁচে আছো!”

mera-dilwala-rakshak.title: Mera Dilwala Rakshak
mera-dilwala-rakshak.description: Aditi, a woman with a traumatic past, begins as a fugitive desperately escaping a possessive man, only to be rescued by the protective Jassi. Their complex relationship develops amidst her being framed for a crime by Ranjeet Chauhan, the son of a corrupt police commissioner, forcing Jassi to confront powerful forces. Despite initial tensions and forced cohabitation, a tender romance blossoms between Aditi and Jassi, offering comfort and a sense of belonging. However, their burgeoning love and Jassi's cherished 'dream palace' are threatened by a vengeful antagonist, Jaspreet (later identified as Ranjeet), who attempts to manipulate the police with false accusations against Aditi. Jassi is initially cleared, but Ranjeet resurfaces, threatening to expose secrets about Jassi's deceased former lover, Meera, and destroy his bond with Aditi. Aditi, consumed by suspicion regarding Meera's death and Jassi's evasiveness, briefly leaves him, only to be brutally attacked by Ranjeet, who also frames Jassi for robbery. A chilling revelation emerges as Aditi discovers she shares a distinctive body mark with Meera, hinting at a deeper, fated connection, and Jassi confesses to causing Meera's death. Ranjeet, leveraging his father's power, attempts to blackmail Aditi into returning to him, demanding she choose him to save Jassi's land and secure a crucial loan. Aditi fiercely defends Jassi against accusations and rejects Ranjeet's manipulative schemes, reaffirming her commitment. The sudden reappearance of Meera, revealing Jassi's secret child, Rashi, shatters Aditi's world, creating a devastating love triangle. Their bond is immediately tested by the murder of Jassi's grandmother, Mary, for which Aditi is wrongly accused and arrested. Ranjeet exploits Aditi's vulnerability, attempting to force her into marriage and blackmail her, while Jassi fights desperately to clear her name. Rashi is kidnapped by the vengeful Priya, leading to a violent confrontation where Jassi is critically injured, forcing Aditi into a desperate bargain with Ranjeet, ultimately revealing Rashi's true parentage as Ranjeet's child. Aditi, driven by a desire for justice, finds unwavering support from Jassi, forgiving Meera for past betrayals. She forms a new family unit with Jassi, considering adopting Meera's daughter and eventually marrying Jassi and welcoming their own baby, fulfilling her dream of a family. Their newfound bliss is abruptly shattered by an ominous event, leaving their future uncertain.

supreme-master.title: Supreme Master asks you to believe in Science

fake-boyfriend-4.title: Fake boyfriend
fake-boyfriend-4.description: নিজের কোম্পানিকে বাঁচাতে অরুনিমা বাধ্য হয়ে এক পাত্রের সঙ্গে ডেট করতে যায়, কিন্তু তার অভদ্র আচরণে বিরক্ত হয়ে ওঠে। ছেলেটির একটি মন্তব্যে ক্ষুব্ধ হয়ে সে তার মুখে ড্রিংকস ছুড়ে মারে। তখনই অরুনিমা অন্য এক ছেলেকে দেখে, যাকে সে গরিব ওয়েটার ভেবে ফেক বয়ফ্রেন্ড বানাতে চায়। পরে তাকে বাড়িতে নিয়ে গেলে পরিবারের অপমান সত্ত্বেও ছেলেটি একটি বড় অংকের চেক ও দামি উপহার দিয়ে সবাইকে অবাক করে। অরুনিমা বুঝতে পারে, ছেলেটির পরিচয় সম্ভবত অনেক বড় কিছু।

supreme-master-1.title: Supreme Master
supreme-master-1.description: The show follows Adam as a seemingly ordinary but increasingly impossible man whose hidden power keeps overturning every family and corporate conflict around him. Early on, he is introduced through fantasy feats, including defeating a dragon-like threat and being punished with humiliating labor, which frames him as powerful but still under discipline. At the same time, another thread follows a desperate family seeking a guru and a cure for a severe illness, only to discover that healing, faith, and family loyalty are all tied to hidden debts and promises. That healing story turns into a struggle over inheritance and credit, and it ends with the family rejecting the spiritual bargain and severing the promised union. Across the larger arc, Adam becomes entangled with the Thomas and Jacob families, where marriage, business control, and revenge all collide. He is bound to a woman through an arranged marriage, but that relationship is repeatedly strained by suspicion, resistance, and the sense that his motives are larger than romance alone. The Thomas side is pulled into hostile takeovers, public humiliation, and internal betrayal, while Adam keeps revealing that he is far stronger than his enemies assume. His enemies escalate from corporate pressure to direct violence, and Adam answers by defeating fighters, protecting Lily, and openly challenging the Jackson family. As the conflict widens, his identity becomes more extraordinary, with revelations that he is tied to a surviving noble lineage and to a hidden martial or spiritual authority. The Jackson family responds with financial warfare, retaliatory force, and attempts to seize leadership, but each move only deepens the feud. A mysterious statue and the promise of City Hall support briefly shift the balance, suggesting that Adam’s struggle is connected to larger powers beyond the family war. Even then, the promised protection arrives unevenly, leaving his allies exposed and uncertain. Adam’s wife and other close allies repeatedly doubt him, defend him, or try to understand him, which keeps the emotional stakes personal even as the battles become public. By the later episodes, Adam’s power is no longer deniable, and his victories force officials, rivals, and family elders to acknowledge him. The show builds toward a broader leadership struggle tied to the Dragon conference, where rival claimants, martial masters, and the Jackson family all converge. In the end, the central stakes are survival, legitimacy, revenge, and whether Adam’s hidden identity will protect the people tied to him or drag them deeper into war.

this-girl-is-a-martial-master.title: This Girl Is a Martial Master
this-girl-is-a-martial-master.description: ஒரு இளம் பெண், தானறிந்த மார்ஷல் ஆர்ட்ஸின் மூலம் எதிரிகளுக்கு நிமிட ஓய்வும் இல்லாமல் செய்கிறாள். தனது குடும்பத்தை காப்பாற்ற போர்க்களத்தில் கால் வைக்கிறாள். பகையை தீர்த்துக்கொள்வதே அவளது ஒரே இலக்கு. அந்த நோக்கத்தில், அவள் தடுக்க முடியாத சக்தியாக மாறுகிறாள்.

slay-madam-2.title: Slay Madam
slay-madam-2.description: The series opens with Sharmi, a newly discovered granddaughter, escaping an imposter, Merlyn, who has stolen her identity and threatened her life. Five years later, Sharmi returns with a hidden identity, a secret daughter named Mary, and a burning vendetta against the Len Group, a plan complicated by Jack, who discovers he is Mary's father. They enter a contractual marriage to provide Mary with a stable facade, but their fragile peace is constantly threatened by public accusations and corporate rivalries. Sharmi endures public humiliation and navigates a resentful "agreement marriage" with Ivan, while secretly orchestrating her revenge. Concurrently, Jack, also known as Jaami, a powerful CEO, emerges as Sharmi's fierce defender, and their burgeoning romance is tested by corporate power struggles and accusations of art forgery. A formidable matriarch, Amma, relentlessly attempts to orchestrate Jack's marriage to Gauthami and claim Mary as her granddaughter, while Jack grapples with his hidden past and connection to Sharmi. Jack, revealing his formidable, hidden power, fiercely defends Mary against classist bullying and false accusations at school, escalating a schoolyard dispute into a ruthless family feud. The stakes rise dramatically when Mary collapses from drug-induced myocarditis due to school poisoning, her survival dependent on a doctor controlled by Jack's family, highlighting stark class divides. The narrative intensifies with a custody battle for Mary, revealing Sharmi's potentially sinister intentions towards the child, while Jack becomes fiercely protective. Past figures like Fernandez, Sharmi's protector, re-emerge, creating a complex love triangle and further rivalries. Manipulative schemes by characters like Jami and Radha attempt to force Jack into unwanted marriages, but Jack defiantly rejects these, publicly declaring his unwavering love for Sharmi. The series culminates in the exposure of Radha's criminal past and manipulative actions, leading to her rejection by the patriarch. Ultimately, Jack reaffirms his unwavering love for Sharmi, promising a future free from deceit for their reunited family, despite the initial family conflict surrounding their sudden marriage.

happily-never-after-2.title: Happily Never After
happily-never-after-2.description: Happily Never After follows Rajveer Singhania, whose life spirals into chaos when his fiancée Veda Mehta mistakes his pregnant sister-in-law Shanaya Birla for his mistress. What starts as a misunderstanding at an engagement turns into a dark, twisted tale of betrayal, violence, and shocking truths.

the-hidden-hero.title: The Hidden Hero
the-hidden-hero.description: When a principled ex-commander hiding as a humble café worker saves a ruthless yet elegant CEO from a late-night assault, she tests his character with a fake marriage to uncover his weakness—but as secrets surface and enemies close in, their staged relationship turns into a high-stakes game of power, loyalty, and unexpected love.

baby-making-on-divorce-day.title: Baby making on divorce day
baby-making-on-divorce-day.description:
On her wedding day, Megha Shetty was left heartbroken when her husband Aditya rejected her, leaving a deep wound in her life.
Three years later, Aditya, now a successful CEO struggling with insomnia, contacts Megha for treatment through a friend’s recommendation.
Unaware of their shared past, they re-enter each other's lives.
With the help of their friends, their journey unfolds in a heartwarming and humorous way.

sugar-daddy.title: Sugar Daddy
sugar-daddy.description: Ananya, a young heiress, finds herself thrust into a world of escalating dangers and personal conflicts after her father's infidelity and abandonment. Her father dispatches Vikram, a loyal friend and business partner, to protect her, establishing a complex and often contentious guardian-ward dynamic marked by power struggles and an undeniable, yet forbidden, attraction. Ananya fiercely struggles for independence against her controlling father and Vikram's extreme methods, even as her private life, including a secret crush on Vikram, is publicly exposed by social rivals Maya and Rashi. She uncovers a shocking secret linking Vikram to her own life and his role as her guardian, further complicating their intense relationship. Their burgeoning romance is repeatedly tested by Vikram's self-doubt, the appearance of other women, and the violent interference of Ananya's possessive ex, Sam, prompting Vikram to fiercely protect her and initiate self-defense training. The threats escalate with Simi, an obsessive rival, attempting to drown Ananya, leading Vikram to vow corporate revenge against Simi's father. Academic sabotage by Maya and Rohan is thwarted, while a looming conspiracy involving Ananya's father's business partner is revealed. Ananya then discovers Vikram's involvement in dangerous illegal activities, and her safety becomes precarious when she is kidnapped by a villain seeking revenge on her father, Arjun. Vikram heroically intervenes, saving Ananya and solidifying their deep connection. Their secret romance is dramatically discovered by Arjun, who, despite initial rage and feelings of betrayal, eventually reconciles with Ananya and accepts Vikram, albeit with a stern warning. Vikram, haunted by his past, confesses his dangerous secrets and illegal activities to Ananya, promising protection and a fresh start in a new, legitimate venture, which Ananya accepts with unwavering trust, signaling a new chapter for the couple.

farewell-to-old-love-2.title: Farewell To Old Love
farewell-to-old-love-2.description: రఘు – ఓ గొప్ప కుటుంబానికి చెందిన యువకుడు. పెళ్లికి ఒప్పుకున్నా, తరువాత మాయమాటలు చెప్పి వెళ్లిపోయాడు. సారిక – అతని భార్య, కానీ ఆమె జీవితంలో మాత్రం యుద్ధం కొనసాగుతోంది – ప్రేమకోసం, గౌరవంకోసం, కుటుంబం కోసం. సారిక ఇప్పుడు భారీ కంపెనీని నడిపే శక్తివంతమైన మహిళ. కానీ ఆమె ఎదుట కనిపించే ప్రతీ నవ్వు వెనుక రఘు పట్ల ఉండే బాధ, అసహనం కనిపించకుండా ఉంటుంది. ఒకప్పుడు అతని భార్య, ఇప్పుడు అతనికి స్ట్రేంజర్ లా కనిపించాల్సిన పరిస్థితి వచ్చిందా?

the-substitute-bride-unveiling-her-count.title: The Substitute Bride: Unveiling Her Countless Secrets
the-substitute-bride-unveiling-her-count.description: a mysterious woman takes her sister’s place in an arranged marriage to save her family. Behind her calm façade lies a past full of secrets, deception, and hidden strength. As she steps into a world of power, betrayal, and love, her true identity begins to unravel. Each revelation shakes the lives of those around her—and the man she was never meant to marry.

the-girl-with-hidden-face.title: The Girl With Hidden Face
the-girl-with-hidden-face.description: Behind the veil lies a truth too painful to reveal. As her masked life collides with a man who sees her soul, the past threatens to surface. The Girl With Hidden Face is a journey of healing, courage, and a love that sees beyond scars.

boss-and-the-sweet-wife-2.title: Boss And the Sweet Wife
boss-and-the-sweet-wife-2.description: The microdrama centers on the tumultuous, fated connection between a powerful CEO, known by various names including Lin Chen, Ling Sinian, and President Leng, and a talented woman, who appears as a cleaner, perfumer, and employee under aliases like Liang Wang, Leo, Man Man, and Wan Wan. Their journey begins when the CEO's chronic insomnia is miraculously cured by a chance encounter with the cleaner, sparking an immediate, almost obsessive, desire to marry her, despite hints of a mysterious shared past. Their relationship quickly devolves into a complex, often secret or forced, marriage, constantly under siege from external forces. Throughout the series, the female lead's unparalleled olfactory genius is revealed, leading to her promotion as a lead perfumer, but also making her a target. She is repeatedly accused of corporate sabotage, framed for various misdeeds, and faces relentless schemes from manipulative rivals, ambitious fiancées, and disapproving family members who seek to separate her from the CEO or force her into other arranged marriages. The CEO, despite his initial abruptness, becomes fiercely protective, consistently defending her and recognizing a unique scent that links them to their hidden history. Their union is further complicated by a web of corporate intrigue, power struggles, and personal betrayals, including the CEO being ousted from his company and facing public scandals. Paternity disputes, both genuine and fabricated, emerge, adding layers of deception and doubt. The female lead is kidnapped, targeted by explosions, and endures physical assaults, while the CEO makes profound sacrifices to protect her and their unborn child. Manipulative family matriarchs orchestrate divorces and demand corporate control, while the male lead searches for his "Queing Queen" and the truth about his "true rescuer" linked to a bracelet. Ultimately, after navigating a decade-old mystery, a forced marriage, and numerous attempts to tear them apart, including a faked near-death experience by the CEO to prevent divorce, the couple confronts their true feelings. The CEO makes an extravagant gesture, purchasing ten mountains for her perfumery passion, and re-proposes, solidifying their renewed and passionate commitment. Their reconciliation is sealed with a humorous vision of a large family managing their vast new property, signifying the triumph of their love over adversity and the unraveling of their intertwined destinies.

mohabbat-manzil.title: Mohabbat Manzil
mohabbat-manzil.description: माधुर, एक आत्मीय लेकिन आत्मविश्वासहीन संगीतकार है, और स्नेहा, एक होटेल ट्रेनी मैनेजर, जो अपने सपनों को साकार करने की कोशिश में है। होटल कोहिनूर की चमक-धमक, वर्गभेद, महत्वाकांक्षा और चालबाज़ियों के बीच उनका रिश्ता धीरे-धीरे परवान चढ़ता है। जहाँ माधुर अपने संगीत और प्रेम के लिए लड़ता है, वहीं स्नेहा समाज की अपेक्षाओं और अपनी आत्म-सम्मान की लड़ाई में उलझी होती है। तीव्र टकरावों, संगीत के संघर्षों, वर्गीय विभाजन और दिल छू लेने वाले बलिदानों के साथ, “सेंसेशन” साहस, प्रेम और आत्म-परिवर्तन की एक मार्मिक कहानी पेश करता है।

happily-never-after-3.title: Happily Never After
happily-never-after-3.description: 'ರಾಜ್ ವೀರ್ ಮತ್ತು ವೇದ' ಒಬ್ಬರನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರು ತುಂಬಾ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸೋ ಜೋಡಿ. ಆದ್ರೆ ರಾಜ್ ವೀರ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮೂಡಿದ ಒಂದೇ ಒಂದು ಸಂಶಯದಿಂದ ಇವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಬಿರುಕು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತೆ‌. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ರಾಜ್ ವೀರ್ ಮುಚ್ಚಿಟ್ಟಿರೋ ಆ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ಏನು? ಮುಂದೆ ವೇದ ಏನ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಳೆ? ನೋಡಿ 'Happily Never After' ಶೋ.

there-is-none-under-heaven-to-equal-her-.title: Sudari: The wildfire
there-is-none-under-heaven-to-equal-her-.description: To protect a valuable bracelet, Minu and her uncle (Papa Babai) confront a gang of thugs. Babai risks his life to save Minu. In the end, Minu bravely stands up and is ready to do whatever it takes to save her uncle.

my-top-secret-desire.title: My Top Secret Desire
my-top-secret-desire.description: A struggling trainee at RAW Academy is assigned a tough mentor — his sister’s fierce and hot best friend who is older than him — and as they clash and grow closer, they uncover secrets and fall in love with each other.

the-divorced-billionaire-heiress-3.title: The Divorced Billionaire Heiress
the-divorced-billionaire-heiress-3.description: ಕಥಾನಾಯಕಿ 'ಮೋರ್', ಆಗರ್ಭ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತೆ. ಆಕೆಯ ಗಂಡ 'ಕಾರ್ಸನ್' ಅಂದ್ರೆ ತುಂಬಾನೇ ಇಷ್ಟ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಕಾರ್ಸನ್, ದುಡ್ಡಿಗಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಪತ್ನಿಗೆ ಮೋಸ ಮಾಡ್ತನೆ. ಈ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಚಯ ಆಗುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೇ 'ರಾಯನ್ ಜೇಕಬ್ಸ್'. ಈ ಮೂವರ ಬದುಕಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಏನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ? ಮೋರ್ ತನ್ನ ನಿಜವಾದ ಐಡೆಂಟಿಟಿಯನ್ನ ಯಾಕೆ ಮರೆ ಮಾಚಿದ್ಲು ಅನ್ನೋದೇ 'The Divorced Billionaire Heiress' ಕಥೆ.

the-hidden-king.title: The Hidden King
the-hidden-king.description: Legendary agent Aarav, also known by aliases like Arnav and Arun, is called back from retreat to confront a terrorist threat, but his mission takes a profound personal turn when his sister, Dr. Roshni, is found dead under suspicious circumstances. Convinced she was murdered for a vital secret discovered within a prison, Aarav orchestrates his own incarceration to infiltrate the brutal facility, immediately clashing with inmates and corrupt authorities. Inside, he protects an influential old inmate and begins to uncover a vast, illicit organ trafficking ring, orchestrated by a ruthless boss identified as Siddharth, the corrupt Warden, and Sera. Aarav's quest for justice and revenge leads him through daring escapes from prisons and medical facilities, often aided by inside connections, while being relentlessly hunted by the authority figure Chauhan. He forms alliances with figures like Kavya, who repeatedly risks her life to protect fugitives and uncover conspiracies, and Rohan, his sister's protective brother, who also seeks to expose the truth. Dr. Kavya finds herself repeatedly in peril, mirroring Dr. Roshni's fate, as she becomes entangled in the same dangerous conspiracy, prompting Aarav to protect her from the ruthless antagonists. The narrative intensifies with a relentless cycle of vengeance, betrayal, and corruption, as Aarav, now identified as Sher Pathan, orchestrates a master plan to seize control of the facility. He engages in a direct, violent confrontation with the corrupt Warden, revealing his motive: vengeance for his sister's suffering and the dismantling of the illegal organ trading business. Sher Pathan successfully dismantles the illicit operation, bringing an end to the brutal trade. His sister, Dr. Roshni, is posthumously honored with an award for her initial groundwork in exposing the criminal enterprise, recognizing her sacrifice. The show culminates in a hard-won victory for justice, but not without profound personal cost and a relentless fight against systemic corruption.

supreme-4.title: Supreme
supreme-4.description:
Supreme  is a fantasy-romance tale of an aspiring hero’s journey to become a celestial master. He faces powerful enemies, overcomes mystical challenges, and discovers ancient secrets.
Amidst it all, love blossoms, shaping his destiny in unexpected ways.

from-failure-to-topper-inspirational-sto.title: From failure to topper - Inspirational stories of exam success
from-failure-to-topper-inspirational-sto.description: ఎగ్జామ్స్ లో ఫెయిలైన వాళ్ళు టాపర్ గా ఎదిగిన సంగతి మీకు తెలుసా..? ఎగ్జామ్స్ ముందర మీలో మోటివేషన్ పెంచుకోండి.

brain-foods-for-exam-what-to-eat-for-bet.title: Brain foods for exam - What to eat for better focus and memory

Par paap ki is duniya me entry ki keemat sirf paisa hai, ya Guruji ke sabse kareeb pahunchne ke liye Vibhu ko apni jaan-izzat tak daav par lagani padegi?
