black-kiln-dragon-3.description: Relationship secrets, old enemies, and a mythological dragon—what happens when they all collide? This show reveals how inner secrets and external threats shape your journey. It's not just drama; it's a full-powered fantasy experience.

insta-reels-se-youtube-pe-kamaai.title: Insta Reels Se YouTube Pe Kamaai
insta-reels-se-youtube-pe-kamaai.description: Insta Reels Se YouTube Pe Kamaai

black-widow.title: Black Widow
black-widow.description: నంబర్ సెవెన్ అనే మ్యూటెంట్ గల్లంతమవడం, వెన్నెల అనే అమ్మాయి ఔషధ శక్తులు కలిగి ఉండటం, నంబర్ ఫైవ్ గాయపడటం వంటి పరిణామాలతో క్వీన్ ఫ్యామిలీ శత్రువుల కుట్రలు, శాస్త్రీయ ప్రయోగాలు, రాజకీయ ఒత్తిళ్లు మధ్య సంక్షోభాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటుంది, ఫ్యామిలీ భవిష్యత్తు ప్రమాదంలో పడుతుంది. శత్రువుల అసలు ఉద్దేశం ఏమిటి? క్వీన్ ఫ్యామిలీ ఈ ఒత్తిడిని ఎలా ఎదుర్కొంటుంది?

ishq-with-boss.title: Ishq With Boss
ishq-with-boss.description: A diligent woman, Alya, has a spontaneous one-night stand with a charming stranger, who she later discovers is Advait Patel, her new CEO. This immediate complication leads to her abrupt termination, but Advait, confessing an uncontrollable attraction, offers her a dangerous challenge: keep her job if she can resist his deliberate attempts to seduce her. This initiates a high-stakes corporate "game" where Advait's manipulations blur professional and personal lines, revealing a past intimate connection and a hidden bet. Alya navigates this treacherous environment, facing professional sabotage, accusations of infidelity, and the interference of rivals like Poonam, while also attempting a brief, ill-fated relationship with Shan. Advait persistently pursues Alya, demanding a "compromise" for an unspecified past misstep and arrogantly declaring her his own, hinting at deeper, unresolved stakes tied to a mysterious "Sworth office." Their forbidden romance escalates, drawing scrutiny and leading to public confrontations and a desperate struggle for commitment. A shocking revelation emerges about Advait's deceased wife, Roshni, who was pregnant at the time of her 'untimely demise,' transforming their love story into a mystery. Alya's surprise birthday celebration for Advait is violently interrupted by a catastrophic event, leading to Advait's sudden withdrawal and subsequent termination of their relationship, leaving Alya heartbroken. Haunted by a perceived curse and past tragedy, Advait pushes Alya away, causing her to resign and plan to leave Mumbai. Despite Advait's desperate confession of love, Alya, deeply wounded by perceived manipulation, initially rejects him. An enigmatic woman attempts to intervene and reunite the estranged lovers. Ultimately, Advait overcomes his fears, steps down as CEO, and makes a grand public declaration of love and a marriage proposal to Alya. Alya accepts, dedicating her life to him, and together they forge a powerful professional partnership. Their journey culminates in them becoming co-CEOs and owners of "Patel Finance," transforming their fragile, unspoken connection into an enduring romantic and professional bond.

the-last-recipe-2.title: The Last Recipe
the-last-recipe-2.description: এক সময়ের জনপ্রিয় জাইকা রেস্টুরেন্ট এখন দুর্দশাগ্রস্ত। এক নতুন কর্মচারী সেখানে কাজে যোগ দিলে অন্যরা তাকে হেয় করে। হঠাৎ একদিন ফুড ইন্সপেক্টর এসে ভিন্নধর্মী খাবার তৈরি করতে বলেন। নতুন ছেলেটি সাহস করে তা রান্না করে, কিন্তু তার প্রেজেন্টেশন নিয়ে সবাই উপহাস করে। তবে রেস্টুরেন্টের মালিক খাবারটি চেখে দেখে প্রশংসা করেন। এরপর একটি প্রতিযোগিতা শুরু হয়, যা এক নতুন মোড় নিয়ে আসে।

desperate-husbands-revenge-2.title: Desperate Husband's Revenge
desperate-husbands-revenge-2.description:
ఒక కుర్రాడు ఛాతిలో నొప్పితో ఆసుపత్రికి వెళ్తాడు.
కానీ డాక్టర్ ఫోన్‌లో బిజీగా ఉండటాన్ని చూసి అతను కోపంతో పోలీసులకు ఫిర్యాదు చేస్తానని హెచ్చరిస్తాడు.
అప్పుడు డాక్టర్ చెబుతాడు — తాను తన ఇంటి సీసీటీవీ ఫుటేజ్ చూస్తున్నానని.
ఆ వీడియో చూశాక ఆ కుర్రాడు షాక్‌కు లోనవుతాడు…

ultimate-khiladi.title: Ultimate Khiladi
ultimate-khiladi.description: After Sameer, the biggest tech hotshot in all of Bangalore, gets sacked by his CEO's son Arnav, he joins forces with Sayyeda the beautiful CEO of his old company's competitor. This causes his former employer to go bankrupt, and when Arnav realizes he's fired the wrong guy, it's already too late.

happily-ever-after.title: Happily Never After
happily-ever-after.description:
Happily Never After follows Rajveer Singhania, whose life spirals into chaos when his fiancée Veda Mehta mistakes his pregnant sister-in-law Shanaya Birla for his mistress. 
What starts as a misunderstanding at an engagement turns into a dark, twisted tale of betrayal, violence, and shocking truths.

happily-never-after-1.title: Happily Never After
happily-never-after-1.description: Happily Never After follows Rajveer Singhania, whose life spirals into chaos when his fiancée Veda Mehta mistakes his pregnant sister-in-law Shanaya Birla for his mistress. What starts as a misunderstanding at an engagement turns into a dark, twisted tale of betrayal, violence, and shocking truths.

my-husband-locked-me-in-a-underwater-pri.title: My Husband Locked Me in a Underwater Prison
my-husband-locked-me-in-a-underwater-pri.description: When Hana is murdered by her husband and his lover John, her long-lost twin sister steps in. Disguised as Hana, she seeks to uncover the truth behind the betrayal. A journey of deception, revenge, and justice begins.

supreme-master-asks-you-to-believe-in-sc.title: Supreme Master Asks You to Believe in Science
supreme-master-asks-you-to-believe-in-sc.description: In a mystical land where ancient traditions clash with modern ambitions, a powerful narrative unfolds across generations, driven by prophecies, betrayals, and a relentless quest for retribution. The story begins with an Old Guru and his Young Hero disciple navigating challenges, while a desperate family seeks divine healing for their Ailing Patriarch, igniting conflict between faith and skepticism. Simultaneously, an ancient prophecy and a pre-arranged marriage threaten a powerful family's modern aspirations, leading to a high-stakes drama of destiny versus personal desire. A cataclysmic event and a Saint's prophecy unleash divine retribution on a powerful business family, the Sajens, for a profound past betrayal, leading to financial ruin and a family member's collapse. A mysterious hero, Arjun, emerges, saving the patriarch but is cursed with a limited lifespan, leading to a reluctant arranged marriage with heiress Sneha. As sinister plots shatter prominent families and heiresses are violently targeted, formidable heroes with superhuman abilities rise to protect their loved ones and seek retribution against corrupt organizations. An otherworldly husband reveals his supernatural nature, escalating domestic drama into high-stakes corporate and magical conflicts, culminating in an all-out war against ruthless adversaries. A central figure, the enigmatic Master, is revealed to be an immortal 'second guru' and 'supreme heavenly master,' bound by a decade-long vendetta for his family's annihilation. He orchestrates a brutal campaign of elimination against those responsible, navigating betrayals and uncovering a deep conspiracy that implicates a third group as the true killers. Amidst these escalating conflicts, a power vacuum at a mountaintop temple ignites a ruthless struggle for control, leading to assassinations and a high-stakes war between powerful dynasties. The struggling Sajan Group faces financial ruin, forcing an heiress to choose between her husband and a treacherous corporate alliance. Ultimately, the Master unleashes his divine wrath, systematically eliminating his enemies and fulfilling his quest for vengeance, paving the way for a tender romance and a new future.

mohabbat-ka-sauda.title: Dil Ka Sauda
mohabbat-ka-sauda.description: A woman strikes a deadly bargain to save the man she loves, only to be trapped in a game of fate where love, betrayal, and sacrifice collide. As dark secrets unravel, their innocent daughter becomes the pawn in a battle of greed and obsession.

betrayed-heiress-vengeance-reborn-1.title: Betrayed Heiress: Vengeance Reborn
betrayed-heiress-vengeance-reborn-1.description: Raised by kind stepparents, Josline one day found out about her birth parents. They are rich and very influential people in the city. Her birth parents want her back. But what if they torture her, and kill her, she gets another chance to live.

mistaken-millionaire-husband-1.title: Mistaken Millionaire Husband
mistaken-millionaire-husband-1.description: Ms. Sriram ka boyfriend Deepak ne jo betrayal kiya usse bhi zyada sachcha pyaar Rohit Muralitharan ka tha. Is khoobsurat love story ko dekhkar enjoy kijiye!

destined-to-meet-you.title: Destined to Meet You
destined-to-meet-you.description: Blessy was betrayed by her sister, spent one night with a stranger, and gave birth to two kids. But when her sister finds out that the father of those kids was so rich and handsome, she abducted one kid without blessy knowing. years after when blessy finds truth, what will she do

the-substitute-bride-1.title: The Substitute Bride
the-substitute-bride-1.description: A lively girl is sent to the village by her stepmother and learns mystic arts there. After a playful mischief, her guru expels her. On her way back, she saves a boy from an accident—only to discover he's her arranged groom, for whom her parents have taken 100 crores. She agrees to the marriage, and despite her quirks, the boy doesn't reject her. But a strange thought lingers in his mind.

desperate-husbands-revenge-1.title: Desperate Husband's Revenge
desperate-husbands-revenge-1.description:
A young man goes to the hospital with chest pain.
But seeing the doctor busy on the phone, he angrily threatens to complain to the police.
Then the doctor says — he is watching CCTV footage from his home.
After watching the video, the young man is shocked…

use-and-throw-boyfriend.title: Use and Throw Boyfriend
use-and-throw-boyfriend.description: Aru wanted revenge, Rudra wanted control. But when their paths collide in a blaze of secrets and power, hatred turns into something dangerously passionate. Falling for Fire is the explosive story of Aru and Rudra, two enemies bound by fire, fate, and forbidden desire. Watch Now!

guardian-angel-mom-on-the-move-1.title: Guardian Angel: Mom on the Move
guardian-angel-mom-on-the-move-1.description: Yara was tricked into having a child with Yusuf, but her sister Yulia took the baby and lied about its death. Years later, Yara returns and reunites with Yusuf and the child. When Yulia's abuse of the child is uncovered, she causes a car accident in a panic. Yusuf then learns that Yara is the biological mother, and the family comes together to live happily.

single-mothers-counterattack-with-adorab.title: Single Mother’s Counterattack with Adorable Twins
single-mothers-counterattack-with-adorab.description: After being deceived into a one-night stand orchestrated by her own sister, a young woman finds herself pregnant and disowned by her family. Seven years later, her spirited twin children—unaware of the circumstances of their birth—set out on a heartwarming mission to bring their long-lost parents back together, but as their mother confronts painful memories and the cruel twists of fate that shaped her past, she must brave overwhelming odds to reclaim love, dignity, and a future for her children.

future-se-aaya-boyfriend.title: Future Se Aaya Boyfriend
future-se-aaya-boyfriend.description: A princely man, Rohan Agarwal, is dramatically transported from his time into a perilous matriarchal world, immediately facing accusations of espionage and threats of execution. He quickly leverages his modern knowledge and artistic skills, rising from a condemned artist to a celebrated chef and then to Princess Prema's chief advisor by solving a kingdom-wide crisis. His newfound status is complicated by a manipulative romantic entanglement with General Shakuntala and a dangerous rivalry with the tyrannical Raja Saleem, who seeks to claim the Princess's hand and kingdom. Rohan's initial attempt to claim the Princess's hand is rejected, revealing her strategic use of him, and he is caught attempting to flee, leaving his fate uncertain. Despite this, he miraculously cures Princess Prema's sister, Sharmila, prompting Prema to defy Raja Salim and invalidate their forced marriage pact. Rohan, a time-traveler, secretly seeks mystical "mohars" to return home, successfully completing impossible tasks like creating a perfume and solving a salt shortage, earning Prema's admiration and fueling Salim's fierce rivalry. He becomes entangled in a dangerous love quadrangle involving Prema, Sharmila, and Senapati, while consistently thwarting powerful figures. Accused of treason, Rohan unveils a daring counter-strategy, exposing Villainmani as a spy for Raja Salim and thwarting an assassination attempt on Princess Prema. He and Princess Prema form an alliance, developing advanced firearms to counter Raja Salim's growing threat, even as Princess Sharmila plots a coup against her sister. The return of Prema's ex-lover, Jai Singh, further complicates loyalties, escalating personal conflicts amidst political intrigue. The kingdom then faces a brutal, multi-front siege by Raja Salim, forcing Rohan and Princess Prema into a desperate last stand for survival. Rohan's innovative "bandook" weapons decimate enemy forces, leading to the defeat of Chief Minister Jai Singh and the establishment of a new order with Princess Prema. However, Rohan's reality is shattered when a vivid dream of saving Princess Prema from the treacherous Maharani Padmini proves terrifyingly real, blurring time and placing him in a dangerous struggle for existence. He grapples with the unsettling truth of his existence amidst political intrigue and magic, his ultimate destiny uncertain.

madam-your-ceo-husband-will-save-your-vi.title: Madam, Your CEO Husband Will Save Your Village
madam-your-ceo-husband-will-save-your-vi.description:
మన హీరో అసలైతే ఓ పెద్ద కంపెనీ సీఈఓ.
కానీ ప్రత్యేక కారణాలతో, ప్రస్తుతం సెక్యూరిటీ గార్డ్‌గా జీవితం సాగిస్తున్నాడు.
అతని జీవితంలో ఓ మలుపు అదే సమయంలో వస్తుంది — ఒక గ్రామం రక్షణ కోసం వచ్చేసిన హీరోయిన్ రూపంలో. వాళ్ళు పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటారా?

supreme-son-in-law.title: Supreme Son-In-Law
supreme-son-in-law.description: Samay married into one of the country's most powerful families, only to be dismissed as a mere ghar jamaai—dependent and insignificant. But behind his quiet smile hid the Supreme Leader, a shadowy force controlling parliament, media, and money. As the elite scramble to protect their power, buried secrets erupt and alliances collapse. Samay's revenge unfolds silently, not through violence but with absolute dominance. In this ruthless game of kursi, love is leverage, loyalty is a lie, and the true king is the one no one saw coming.

the-last-recipe-telugu.title: The Last Recipe
the-last-recipe-telugu.description:
“MasterChef కాదు ra బాబోయ్ – ఇది pure drama, betrayal & kitchen wars!” 🔥💔
Food tho love build chestharu... but friendship tho fights, plating tho plotting... aa vanta lo trust melt aipothundi!

👉 Idhi just cooking show kaadu – full-on emotions, fake smiles, savage eliminations, and unexpected kitchen gossip!

flash-marriage-with-a-big-shot.title: Flash Marriage with a Big Shot
flash-marriage-with-a-big-shot.description: Flash Marriage with a Big Shot -  Telugu

judwa-ka-khel.title: Judwa Ka Khel
judwa-ka-khel.description: The microdrama centers on Disha, an adopted heiress, who endures a relentless series of betrayals and personal losses, including the tragic suicide of her sister Isha due to her manipulative sister Avni's schemes. Initially battling Avni and ex-fiancé Yash for control of her family company and reputation, Disha transforms from a victim into a strategic avenger. She enters a complex contract marriage with CEO Nishant, who initially seeks to resolve his own family crisis but secretly investigates her true identity, while also harboring a mysterious connection to her family. As Disha rises to become CEO, she faces continuous corporate sabotage from rivals like Avni and Vaishali, and her past is complicated by the reappearance of Yash and accusations of plagiarism. A significant turning point reveals that Disha was manipulatively adopted by Avni's father for her design talent, leading to the theft of her creations and a deeper quest for justice. Nishant emerges as her protector and romantic interest, his own past intertwined with a secret marriage to Naina and the tragic loss of a twin sister also named Disha. The narrative escalates with abductions, attempted murders, and the unveiling of hidden family secrets, as Disha navigates multiple identities and alliances. Her journey is further complicated by a mysterious 'Heart of Twins' artifact and a powerful necklace, both holding profound personal meaning. Ultimately, Disha fights to reclaim her inheritance, expose a larger conspiracy, and seek retribution against those who wronged her, all while her evolving relationship with Nishant becomes central to her perilous quest for truth and redemption amidst fractured relationships and uncertain futures.

the-world-in-my-grasp-2.title: The World in my grasp
the-world-in-my-grasp-2.description: Funny begins as a poor office worker and laborer who is mocked at work, pressured by his boss, and trying to save money for marriage. A mysterious wish changes everything by making everyone else far weaker and leaving him with overwhelming strength. At first, he is stunned by his own new body and senses, but his power quickly surfaces in heavy labor and public tests that no ordinary worker could survive. His strength draws the attention of senior company figures, who want to know who he really is and whether he can be controlled. At the same time, his personal life collapses when Vaishnavi publicly ends their relationship and reveals that her interest was tied to his family medicine inheritance. She turns toward Rana, a wealthy fighter and heir, and this pushes Funny into a wider rivalry over pride, status, and humiliation. The conflict spreads from the workplace into championship arenas, where family representatives, onlookers, and rivals keep challenging his legitimacy. Funny is repeatedly accused, tested, and mocked, yet he keeps proving himself through impossible feats of strength. The story also introduces a larger struggle around a mysterious power pill formula, which becomes tied to hidden strength, manipulation, and family pressure. Elderly guardians are bullied for the secret, while younger defenders step in to protect them and keep the formula from being taken. As the Power Championship approaches, several families treat the contest as a battle for honor and survival rather than just sport. Funny, sometimes called Phani or Fani in the digests, is pulled deeper into this conflict by offers of money, marriage, recruitment, and blackmail. He resists being used as a solution for other people’s problems, even when allies insist he is their last hope. Accusations of doping and cheating then threaten to destroy his reputation, and official testing briefly leaves him exposed to punishment. That scandal later begins to unravel when he is cleared, but the victory only intensifies suspicion that his strength comes from some hidden enhancement. Rana and Vaishnavi try to recover the pill through trust and romance, while other powerful figures try to recruit or pressure him into surrendering it. Inside Power Hall, authority struggles, threats, and shifting loyalties turn the fight over the pill into a broader contest for control. By the end of the batch, Funny’s rise from mocked underdog to celebrated powerhouse has made him both admired and targeted, and the central stakes remain his dignity, his relationships, and control over the secret power behind his strength.

shehzaada.title: Shehzaada
shehzaada.description: Devraj thought he had buried Arjun forever but ghosts don’t stay dead for long. Fueled by loss and betrayal, Arjun returns to take down the kingdom that turned its back on him. Shehzaada is a dark, thrilling ride through vengeance, power, and redemption. Watch Now !

the-girl-is-a-martial-master.title: The Girl Is A Martial Master
the-girl-is-a-martial-master.description:
ఓ యువతి తాను నేర్చుకున్న మార్షల్ ఆర్ట్స్‌తో శత్రువులకు కంటిమీద కునుకు లేకుండా చేస్తుంది.
తన కుటుంబాన్ని కాపాడేందుకే ఆమె యుద్ధానికి దిగుతుంది.
ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోవడమే లక్ష్యంగా ఎదురులేని శక్తిగా మారుతుంది.

false-promise.title: False Promise
false-promise.description: A young woman who was raised by a rich family and has dreams of marrying one of the two heirs of the family. But those two brothers despise her as they believe she’s ill-mannered towards their close friend. The close friend is in fact the woman who is after the money of the two brothers and wants to replace the young woman by framing her for misdeeds.

madam-your-ceo-husband-will-save-your-vi.title: Madam, Your CEO Husband Will Save Your Village
madam-your-ceo-husband-will-save-your-vi.description: Madam, Your CEO Husband Will Save Your Village

the-arrival-of-the-young-lady.title: The Arrival of the Young Lady
the-arrival-of-the-young-lady.description: The Arrival of the Young Lady

dragon-xiang-the-eternal-healer.title: Dragon Xiang : The Eternal Healer
dragon-xiang-the-eternal-healer.description: এক বিশেষ ক্ষমতাসম্পন্ন তরুণ, স্ত্রীকে অন্য পুরুষের সঙ্গে দেখে মানসিকভাবে ভেঙে পড়ে এবং দুর্ঘটনার শিকার হয়। তাকে এক অজানা বাড়িতে আশ্রয় দেওয়া হয়, যেখানে সে একজন বৃদ্ধের স্নায়ুর অবস্থা দেখে তার দীর্ঘদিনের অসুখ শনাক্ত করে। চিকিৎসার প্রস্তাব দেয় সে, কিন্তু সেই বৃদ্ধের নাতনী তার ক্ষমতা না জানায়, এবং ভয় বা সন্দেহে একটি বিপজ্জনক কাণ্ড ঘটিয়ে ফেলে।

secret-rishta.title: Secret Rishta
secret-rishta.description: Ye kahani hai ek aisi ladki ki jisne paise ki bhook mein aakar ek pavitra maa bete ke rishte ko bhi buri nazar se dekha aur apni hi shaadi ke din apni hone wale pati ki saas ko bohot torcher kiya.

gumshuda-billionaire-bengali.title: Gumshuda Billionaire
gumshuda-billionaire-bengali.description: এক যুবক তার গার্লফ্রেন্ডকে অন্ধভাবে বিশ্বাস করে, তার সমস্ত খরচ বহন করে এবং নিজের ড্রিম প্রজেক্টের ডিজাইনও তাকে দিয়ে দেয়। বিয়ের ঘোষণার দিন মেয়েটি মঞ্চে এক অজানা ছেলেকে ডেকে নেয় এবং সমস্ত কৃতিত্ব তার নামে ঘোষণা করে। ছেলেটি প্রতিবাদ করতে গেলে মেয়েটি তার দিকে আক্রমণাত্মকভাবে এগিয়ে আসে—ঠিক সেই মুহূর্তেই একটি গুলি ছুটে আসে, আর ভিড় স্তব্ধ হয়ে যায়।

the-immortal-doctor-dragon-xiang-nine-da.title: The Immortal Doctor Dragon Xiang Nine Days
the-immortal-doctor-dragon-xiang-nine-da.description: This is a story of a doctor who possess super natural powers.

the-lost-billionaire.title: The Lost Billionaire
the-lost-billionaire.description: "The Lost Billionaire" follows Rohit, a boy from the slums of Dharavi, who rises from poverty and betrayal to reclaim his legacy as the heir to Kulkarni Industries, wielding a mysterious power to protect his family from ruthless enemies. This gripping tale of resilience, revenge, and reunion unfolds over decades, blending emotional drama with supernatural intrigue.

flash-marriage-to-the-president-mrs-gu-i.title: Flash Marriage to the President: Mrs. Gu is Actually a Hidden Tycoon
flash-marriage-to-the-president-mrs-gu-i.description: Flash Marriage to the President: Mrs. Gu is Actually a Hidden Tycoon

raising-a-kid-or-a-cultivator.title: Raising a kid or a Cultivator

divorced-billionaire-heiress-4.title: Divorced Billionaire Heiress
divorced-billionaire-heiress-4.description: On our third wedding anniversary, my husband humiliated me and threw me away for his mistress. They thought I was powerless—but they didn’t know I’m the daughter of the richest man in the country. His entire fortune came from me. That same day, fate led me to a powerful billionaire who changed everything. Now, I have wealth, influence, and a new identity. Let the tables turn.

clocked-in-power-his-secret-identity.title: Clocked in Power, His Secret Identity
clocked-in-power-his-secret-identity.description: The microdrama centers on Thia, a powerful heiress, whose life is irrevocably altered by an unexpected intimate encounter with her driver, Luther, igniting a public scandal. Thia's fiancé, Oliver Wilson, retaliates brutally, initiating a campaign of blackmail, public humiliation, and attempted abduction. Luther emerges as Thia's fierce protector, defiantly defending her against Oliver's escalating violence and threats. Thia faces immense pressure from her formidable King family, including her matriarch mother and patriarch Grandpa King, to uphold their reputation and secure their struggling business through an arranged marriage, often to a powerful heir named Oliver White. While one batch dramatically reveals Luther's true identity as this formidable Master Oliver White, subsequent events consistently portray Oliver White as a distinct and relentless antagonist, pursuing Thia and clashing with Luther. Their forbidden romance deepens amidst this high-stakes conflict, with Thia eventually defying her family's rigid expectations for Luther. A corporate war erupts between the King and White families, further entangling their fates and raising the stakes. Luther, revealed to possess a violent past and battle-hardened skills, undertakes dangerous challenges to protect Thia and seek justice, often against figures like Director Will and Jaden Nisson, who also seek revenge or control. He wields immense, mysterious powers that cause him physical distress, hinting at a deeper, perhaps ancient, destiny. Thia, often a pawn in these power struggles, ultimately severs ties with her manipulative family, choosing unwavering loyalty to Luther. The narrative culminates in Luther's dramatic rescues and confrontations, as he rejects a destiny as a 'chosen one' in favor of an ordinary life with Thia, even as ancient forces collide with their modern world, leaving the true source of his power a dangerous secret.

the-last-recipe-1.title: The Last Recipe
the-last-recipe-1.description: The Last Recipe follows Aryan, a talented yet underestimated cook, as he battles personal struggles and a fierce culinary competition to save Zaika, a restaurant tied to his past. Amidst sabotage, betrayal, and a rekindled romance with Naina, Aryan’s journey culminates in a dramatic showdown proving his mastery and integrity.

enemies-with-benefits-the-ceos-matchmake.title: Enemies with Benefits The CEO’s Matchmaker Strikes
enemies-with-benefits-the-ceos-matchmake.description: Story is all about love and betrayal.

hollywood-staged-romance-live-247.title: Hollywood Staged Romance: Live 24/7
hollywood-staged-romance-live-247.description: Ruby, a rookie actress, faces career turmoil when frozen out by her company, then creates a sensation by drunkenly kissing Charles, the Spike Group CEO. He offers her a love contract: a fake relationship to promote his brands. With director Federico's aid, Ruby becomes an overnight sensation, showcasing her true self. Despite the facade, Charles and Ruby's feelings become real. Ruby later discovers Charles had been searching for her for six years, leading to unexpected revelations.

fake-boyfriend-2.title: Fake Boyfriend
fake-boyfriend-2.description: ఒక పెద్ద కంపెనీకి సీఈవో అయిన అబ్బాయికి గర్ల్ ఫ్రెండ్ ఫ్యామిలీ నుండి అవమానాలు ఎదురవుతాయి. వాళ్ళు చేసిన అవమానాలు ఏంటి? ఆమె నిజంగానే అతన్ని లవ్ చేసిందా..? అతను నిజంగా పెద్ద కంపెనీకి సీఈవోవనా.. వినండి Fake Boyfriend..  మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

one-last-kiss-1.title: One Last Kiss
one-last-kiss-1.description: The microdrama centers on Simran, a terminally ill woman entangled in a contract marriage with Amit, a man with a dark past linked to Jia Mokshi's unsettling funeral photoshoot. Simran's life is a web of deceit and manipulation, initially driven by her estranged, critically ill half-sister Roma, who exploits Simran's illness and past sacrifices while vying for Amit's affections. Simran faces blackmail from her abusive mother, forcing her into secret financial dealings that fuel Amit's initial suspicions and accusations of betrayal. Amidst this turmoil, a shocking revelation emerges: Simran is pregnant, not terminally ill, a truth she desperately tries to conceal while enduring abuse and poisoning. Amit's feelings shift from suspicion to remorse and protection as he uncovers Simran's selfless actions to support her mother, leading him to vow to protect her. However, Roma intensifies her psychological warfare, claiming Amit and their home, leading to Simran's mysterious disappearance and continued suffering. Simran's struggle culminates in a critical hospital stay, where she tragically dies during childbirth after saving Amit's life, leaving him with profound regret and a newborn daughter. Amit then uncovers Roma's ultimate betrayal: she never saved his life but instead callously stole Simran's kidney. Driven by a thirst for justice and revenge, Amit meticulously plots against Roma, demanding the return of the stolen organ. Overwhelmed by immense loss, Amit ultimately sacrifices his business empire to honor his promises to Simran and dedicate his life to raising their daughter, Poorna, who finds support in Dr. Ajay.

supreme-2.title: Supreme
supreme-2.description:
కథ ప్రధానంగా ఓ యువ కథానాయకుడి చుట్టూ తిరుగుతుంది, అతను ఒక పరమ పవిత్రమైన సెలెస్టియల్ మాస్టర్ అవ్వాలనే లక్ష్యంతో తన యాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తాడు.

ఈ ప్రయాణంలో అతడు అనేక సవాళ్ళను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు. శత్రువులు, భయంకరమైన శక్తులు, మరియు ఆధ్యాత్మిక బంధాలు అతని మార్గాన్ని అడ్డుకుంటూ ఉంటాయి. కానీ ఈ యాత్రలో అతను ప్రేమ, బలహీనత, ధైర్యం, మరియు త్యాగం వంటి భావోద్వేగాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

ఈ కథలో మాయాజాలం, దేవతల ప్రపంచం, మరియు రహస్య శక్తుల మేళవింపుతో పాటు, ఒక ప్రేమకథ కూడా నెమ్మదిగా వికసిస్తూ సాగుతుంది.

revenge-of-the-heiress-1.title: Meri Behen ka Badla
revenge-of-the-heiress-1.description: Meera, a mistreated maid, discovers she’s the real heiress of the powerful Kapoor family. Stripped of identity and dignity by the cruel Rhea, who falsely claims her place, Meera is cast out, humiliated, and betrayed. But she rises from the ashes as Phoenix, a mysterious designer set on reclaiming her name. While Rhea clings to stolen power through lies and manipulation, Meera begins a quiet, calculated revenge. Secrets unravel, loyalties shift, and the battle between truth and deception erupts

enemies-with-benefits-the-ceos-matchmake.title: Enemies With Benefits: The CEO's Matchmaker Strikes
enemies-with-benefits-the-ceos-matchmake.description: To save her home, matchmaker Emma disguises herself as the wealthy billionaire Chase's dating prospect. But she never expected that he would fall for her, relentlessly pursuing her and refusing to let her go.

sinister-squad-1.title: Sinister Squad
sinister-squad-1.description: When a supernatural cult threatens Earth, Alice must assemble a team of fairy tale villains to face the literal forces of Death.

rise-of-the-ruthless-queen.title: Agent Maa Returns
rise-of-the-ruthless-queen.description: Betrayed. Broken. But not defeated. She rose from ashes to claim a throne built on fire. Rise of the Ruthless Queen is a fierce tale of revenge, power, and one woman’s unstoppable journey to reign. Watch Now!

dont-mess-with-super-dad-3.title: Don't Mess with Super Dad
dont-mess-with-super-dad-3.description: The show centers on public power struggles where marriage, family status, and corporate authority are constantly used as weapons. Early on, a murder investigation hangs over Shayantika, while the police chief’s hesitation leaves her safety uncertain. Her blind-date encounters with low-paid divorced fathers and their children establish a recurring tension between elite women and vulnerable single parents. In these meetings, questions about income, divorce, and a child’s future turn romance into a negotiation over protection and status. That same pressure appears in other scenes where powerful women offer stability, housing, or a better life in exchange for marriage or family recognition. A corporate director’s bullying of a guard and his daughter shows how easily institutional power becomes personal humiliation. The conflict escalates when a powerful woman publicly fires the man who insulted her family and asserts a new parental claim over a child. Another thread follows a father figure trying to secure a young girl’s future through housing and school admission, only to be confronted by a hired enforcer demanding a signature on a government-linked project file. He refuses, insisting he has spent years preparing the project, which turns the dispute into a fight over labor, ownership, and legitimacy. Meanwhile, a woman under pressure refuses to surrender an important “order” to the Black Dragon Society, even when money is offered and her secretary is threatened. Public weddings become another arena for these battles, with arrivals mocked as beggars, struck, or expelled when they are seen as unworthy of the ceremony. One man is beaten after saying he came only to fulfill his deceased mother’s last wish, while his spouse pushes back by invoking her own mother’s executive status. Another wedding reveals that son-in-law status itself is a contested prize, with the bride openly declaring that her mother controls both the family and the corporation. Rejected suitors and humiliated men are not simply dismissed; allies step in and retaliation is hinted at, keeping the conflict alive beyond the ceremony. Kin’s protective stance becomes especially important as his refusal to back down draws a boss’s vengeance. The stakes rise further when a magical power reveal changes the balance of the conflict, suggesting that the struggle over family, loyalty, and control is entering a new phase. Across the batch, marriage is never just personal: it is tied to inheritance, legal protection, corporate succession, and public honor. The show’s arc is driven by repeated confrontations in which the powerless are shamed and the powerful try to convert intimacy into authority, only for resistance to keep reopening the fight.

bada-pachtaoge.title: Bada Pachtaoge
bada-pachtaoge.description: She was the housemaid everyone mocked. But when a shocking revelation crowns her as the true heiress, tables turn and masks fall. Outcast Becomes Heiress is a gripping saga of payback, pride, and a queen reclaiming her throne. Watch Now!

7-assasins.title: 7 Assasins
7-assasins.description: When gold goes missing in ancient China, royal guards entrusted with its recovery realize they are not the only people in pursuit.

the-ardent-scholar-from-a-poor-family-2.title: The Ardent Scholar From A Poor Family
the-ardent-scholar-from-a-poor-family-2.description: A humble girl, a mystery man, and two clever kids spark a chain of chaos and charm. As identities unfold and emotions deepen, The Ardent Scholar from a Poor Family is a rollercoaster of love, lies, and second chances.Watch Now!

gumshuda-billionaire-1.title: Hidden Billionaire
gumshuda-billionaire-1.description: "గుమ్షుదా బిలియనీర్" – ధారావిలోని పేదవాడైన రోహిత్, ద్రోహం మరియు పేదరికాన్ని అధిగమించి, కుల్కర్ణి ఇండస్ట్రీస్ వారసత్వాన్ని తిరిగి పొందేందుకు ఒక సంకల్పంతో బయలుదేరతాడు. కుటుంబాన్ని నాశనం చేయాలని చూస్తున్న క్రూర శత్రువుల నుంచి తనవారిని కాపాడేందుకు అతను ఒక రహస్యమైన శక్తిని ఉపయోగిస్తాడు. ఇది వినాశం, ప్రతీకారం, పునర్మిళనం కలసిన దశాబ్దాలుగా సాగే హృద్యమైన కథ – మనోభావాల బలాన్ని, అతని ఎదుగుదల పయనాన్ని మరియు అదృష్టాన్ని తిరిగి పొందే పోరాటాన్ని చూపుతుంది.

supreme-master-asks-you-to-believe-in-sc.title: Supreme Master Asks You to Believe in Science
supreme-master-asks-you-to-believe-in-sc.description: పది ఏళ్ల క్రితం జరిగిన అన్యాయానికి ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోవాలని సుప్రీం మాస్టర్ అయిన క్రిస్టియన్ సంకల్పిస్తాడు. అతని గురువు, ద్వేషాన్ని మరిచి ప్రేమను గుర్తు చేసేందుకు పెళ్లి సంబంధాన్ని సూచిస్తాడు. అనుకోకుండా జియాంగ్ కుటుంబంలో అల్లుడిగా స్థానం సంపాదించిన క్రిస్టియన్, చివరకు తన శత్రువులైన జావో కుటుంబాన్ని ఎలా ఓడించాడో తెలుసుకోండి.

return-of-the-pearl-heiress.title: Return of the Pearl Heiress
return-of-the-pearl-heiress.description: The Return of the Heiress: Discernment of Pearls

betrayed-heiress-vengeance-reborn.title: Betrayed Heiress: Vengeance Reborn
betrayed-heiress-vengeance-reborn.description: এক মেয়ে দত্তক বাবা-মায়ের অমতে নিজের জন্মপরিবারে ফিরে আসে। কিন্তু সেখানে তার জায়গা দখল করে বসেছিল অন্য একটি মেয়ে, যাকে সবাই ভালোবাসত। আসল মেয়েটিকে হেনস্তা করা হয়, এবং গাড়ি চাপা দিয়ে মারার চেষ্টা করা হয়। মৃত্যুর সময় সে প্রতিজ্ঞা করে, আর কারও কাছে ঋণ শোধের চেষ্টা করবে না। এরপর সে অতীতে ফিরে যায়, যেখানে পুরনো ঘটনার পুনরাবৃত্তি হতে শুরু করে। তবে এবার সে দুর্বল নয় — অন্যায়ের বিরুদ্ধে সে নিজেই হয়ে ওঠে নির্মম ও প্রতিশোধপরায়ণ।

you-are-my-ultimate-taste-in-the-world.title: You Are My Ultimate Taste In The World
you-are-my-ultimate-taste-in-the-world.description: Its a sweet romantic story where a passionate chef and a charming restaurant manager clash and connect through flavors, secrets, and sparks in the kitchen. As their culinary competition heats up, so does their unexpected love story, blending humor, tension, and heart.

dont-mess-with-super-dad-2.title: DONT MESS WITH SUPER DAD
dont-mess-with-super-dad-2.description: Chu Tao, a former Dragon General turned single father and security guard, navigates secrets of the past while entering a contractual marriage with Lin Wan'er, an ambitious leader seeking vengeance.

the-princess-married-to-my-waistcoat.title: The Princess Married to My Waistcoat
the-princess-married-to-my-waistcoat.description: సాగరిక తన భర్త చరణ్‌ను తిరిగి పొందేందుకు వస్తుంది. ఇద్దరి మధ్య అపోహలు ఉన్నా, ప్రేమను కోల్పోరు. కుటుంబ సభ్యులు వారిని విడదీయాలని ప్రయత్నించడంతో, కంపెనీ పరిరక్షణ కోసం ఫేక్ డివోర్స్ నటిస్తున్నారు. బిజినెస్ అబద్ధాలు, కుటుంబ ఒత్తిళ్లు ఉన్నా, సాగరిక చరణ్‌పై నమ్మకాన్ని కొనసాగిస్తుంది. చివరికి ప్రేమ గెలుస్తుంది.

the-return-of-the-king-triumphant-return.title: The Return of the King: Triumphant Return
the-return-of-the-king-triumphant-return.description: The Return of the King: Triumphant Return

star-moon-romance-rejected-and-reborn-as.title: Star Moon Romance: Rejected And Reborn As Alpha
star-moon-romance-rejected-and-reborn-as.description: Wolfless Phoebe was wrongly accused of murdering her parents and was ostracized by the whole pack. Even her lover Asta rejected her as his mate. Crushed, Phoebe left her pack and became a rogue. However, in her despair, she awakened the formidable Moonshadow Wolf. Two years later, Phoebe emerged as a renowned female Alpha, just when a distress call from her former lover Asta reached her. As she stared back at her past in the face, the truth about her parents' tragic death began to surface.

jail-ka-dulha-billionaire-nikla.title: Forced to Marry a Prisoner
jail-ka-dulha-billionaire-nikla.description: He’s rich, ruthless, and hiding a life no one knows about. But when she stumbles into his secret world, both their lives spiral out of control. Dive into The Billionaire’s Secret Life—a story of lies, love, and the cost of truth. Watch Now!

flashback-fiancee-have-we-met.title: Flashback Fiancée: Have We Met
flashback-fiancee-have-we-met.description: Amnesiac heiress Nina unexpectedly reunites with her first love, the overbearing CEO Alex, and falls into the romantic "trap" he sets for her. They embark on a contractual marriage, leading to a sweet story of love blossoming after marriage.

fall-into-sweet-trap.title: Fall Into Sweet Trap
fall-into-sweet-trap.description: Caitlyn Darcy, recently divorced and financially ruined by her ex-husband Jimmy and his new wife Andrea, finds herself homeless and betrayed. Her path converges with wealthy heir Simon Williams, who faces an ultimatum to marry or lose his inheritance, leading to a transactional marriage of convenience. Caitlyn, a TV reporter, also faces a career-defining ultimatum to interview the elusive CEO of the Bill Group, a corporation mysteriously connected to her new husband. Simon dramatically reveals his immense corporate power, fiercely protecting Caitlyn from adversaries, yet their relationship is strained by his hidden identity and her desire for divorce. Simon's formidable grandmother orchestrates schemes to ensure lineage, while his disapproving mother views Caitlyn as a "gold digger" and demands their divorce. Caitlyn is further embroiled in a dangerous debt scheme by Jimmy, leading to her being offered as collateral to a ruthless crime boss, from whom Simon heroically rescues her, solidifying their bond. As Mrs. Williams, Caitlyn faces intense pressure from her aristocratic mother-in-law and rivals like Monica Taylor, who deem her unsuitable. Her past as an orphan with debt and an abusive ex-husband is revealed to Simon, deepening their connection amidst high society challenges. Corporate power struggles intensify as Caitlyn is accused of being CEO Mr. Williams' mistress, further straining his public marriage. A suspected pregnancy threatens to violate a mysterious "Lawrence contract" forbidding children, adding immense pressure to their union. Simon's old acquaintance, Monica, also pregnant, moves into his home, manipulating situations and straining his relationship with Caitlyn, with Simon's mother Mariana actively scheming to replace Caitlyn with Monica. Caitlyn becomes the target of a vicious online smear campaign, but Simon fiercely defends her, publicly declaring his unwavering love. The escalating conflict culminates in a violent confrontation between Simon and Monica, critically injuring a pregnant Caitlyn. Rushed to the hospital, her unknown pregnancy and rare blood type prompt Mr. Lawrence to demand a DNA test, unraveling a shocking truth. The DNA report confirms Caitlyn is Mr. Lawrence's long-lost daughter and heiress, revealing his "love story" with her was a fabricated facade. Upon awakening, Caitlyn accepts her newfound father, and Simon proposes marriage, envisioning a real wedding and their future family.

ek-thi-villain.title: Ek Thi Villain
ek-thi-villain.description: ISO ki scientist Anjali Kaal Asur ki puja karti hai aur bacchon ki bali chadati hai par Mars mission par apne “soul-mate” Vikram Sharma ko haasil karne ke liye khoon, blame aur kala jadoo tak karti hai. Kya hoga jab dusri scientist Priya aayegi Anjali aur Vikram ke raaste?

yes-mr-ceo-we-have-a-baby.title: Yes Mr. CEO, We Have A Baby!
yes-mr-ceo-we-have-a-baby.description: Six years ago, Shirley was drugged and framed at her promotion party, leading to a scandal. Returning to her hometown with her illegitimate son, she seeks the truth. Working at her sister's fiancé Neil's company, she and Neil form a bond, and her son feels a strange connection to him. Shirley is determined to find out who the man was that night and unveil the truth.

ishq-bana-junoon.title: Ishq Bana Junoon
ishq-bana-junoon.description: Eight years after a painful breakup, Nisha and Suraj are thrown together again—this time as almost in-laws. With dark secrets, power games, and raw emotions at play, will they fight fate or surrender to it? Watch Now !

single-mothers-counterattack-with-adorab.title: Single Mother’s Counterattack with Adorable Twins
single-mothers-counterattack-with-adorab.description: Deepika, wrongfully disowned by her manipulative sister and father, embarks on a new life, unaware that Arjun, driven by a past betrayal, is relentlessly searching for her. After seven years, Arjun, now a powerful CEO, proposes a contract marriage to Deepika, a single mother, who mistakes him for a man named Asok/Ashok/Anand/Rahul. She reluctantly agrees to a paid paternal role for her children, harboring distrust due to his perceived humble background and financial deceptions. Arjun's manipulative grandmother attempts to force him into an arranged marriage, leading Arjun to reveal his secret marriage to Deepika and the existence of their children. A medical emergency involving Arjun's grandmother further entangles their lives when Deepika saves her, prompting the grandmother to insist Deepika marry Arjun despite her aversion to wealth. Deepika, an acupuncturist, rapidly ascends as a physician, unaware Arjun secretly owns the hospital where she works. His hidden wealth and hospital ownership are accidentally revealed, and Deepika faces false accusations of misconduct, which Arjun intervenes to clear. Arjun harbors a mysterious past, leading to blackmail and attempts to hide from an unseen threat. Later, Arjun's grandmother, Baama, falls critically ill, and Deepika, now a doctor, is accused of malpractice when Baama initially dies under her care. Arjun dramatically intervenes, defending Deepika, who then miraculously revives Baama using unconventional methods. Arjun's formidable grandmother discovers his secret life with Deepika and their children, and Arjun attempts to forcibly take the children. Deepika's dream of opening her own clinic faces challenges from her antagonistic sister and a powerful CEO, but Arjun, using aliases like Ashok and Tharun, orchestrates elaborate charades to conceal his immense fortune and secretly uses his wealth to protect Deepika's dignity and secure her professional aspirations. His charade of poverty is eventually exposed by Deepika's two brilliant sons, revealing their own secret skills and a past trauma. Deepika discovers her family's secret wealth and her husband Ashok's orchestrated deception, leading her to confront them, walk out, and declare her intent to divorce Ashok for past betrayal, returning a symbolic ring. Ashok seeks help from his formidable matriarch grandmother, Nanamma, who devises a plan for reconciliation. Deepika attends Nanamma's high-society birthday, confronting Arjun, the 'President' and Nanamma's grandson, revealing a complex past and a hidden marriage, where she is formally introduced as his wife. A vengeful villain orchestrates Arjun's kidnapping, and Arjun is critically wounded while protecting an abducted woman. He miraculously recovers, leading to a heartfelt reconciliation with Deepika and a renewed commitment to their family, promising a fresh start after their harrowing experiences.

the-devil-took-me-home.title: The Devil Took Me Home
the-devil-took-me-home.description: What if your safe place is where the devil waits? Pulled into a world of strange voices, chilling visions, and a love that feels cursed, she must uncover the truth before it consumes her. Step inside Devil Took Me Home, where evil wears a familiar face. Watch Now!

the-princess-married-to-my-waistcoat-can.title: The Princess Married to my Waistcoat can not stop
the-princess-married-to-my-waistcoat-can.description: A modern-day girl accidentally time-travels to a mysterious, beastly realm and is forced to marry the cold, mysterious Wolf King. While trying to find a way back home, she gradually falls in love with him. Amid palace politics, secrets, and a unique fantasy world, their love story unfolds with humor, magic, and unexpected twists.

my-tycoon-husband-spoils-me-1.title: My Tycoon husband Spoils Me
my-tycoon-husband-spoils-me-1.description: She's the CEO's wife, and her one-night stand turns out to be her husband whom she's never met in their three-year marriage. But when she wakes up, he doesn't recognize her at all and asks for a divorce...

mrsanta-i-want-you.title: Mr.Santa, I Want You!
mrsanta-i-want-you.description: The series begins with Bridget's heartbreak and betrayal by her materialistic boyfriend, David, prompting her to seek revenge with a 'fake' new partner, the enigmatic Alpha Howard. This impulsive decision thrusts Bridget, also known as Lily Morrison, into a dangerous supernatural world of rival packs, revealing her as the fated Luna of Alpha Howard, leader of the powerful Night Shadow Pack. Despite this destiny, their union is forbidden due to Bridget's human nature, and Howard faces immense pressure from his mother to secure a Luna for his pack. Initially, Howard reluctantly agrees to a temporary arrangement with Bridget, but his possessive nature quickly traps her in a monitored, controlling relationship, leading her to fear a sinister cult. Bridget, facing academic expulsion and financial woes, attempts to infiltrate Howard's company for an interview, only to discover a deep, unresolved connection and her own emerging magical powers. Accused of corporate fraud, she proposes a fake-dating scheme to Howard to charm his parents and resolve her issues, navigating a complex web of corporate intrigue and family betrayals. During this period, Bridget experiences a budding connection with Jackson, a charismatic delivery worker, creating a tense love triangle as Howard publicly claims Bridget as his girlfriend and exerts absolute control over her. The relationship between Bridget and Howard escalates into violent confrontations, with Howard revealing his true identity as a werewolf Alpha. Despite Jackson's heartfelt proposal, Bridget finds herself caught between the two men. Howard cruelly rejects Bridget as his fated mate and Luna, shattering her trust and leading to her seeking solace and protection with Jackson. Howard's own reputation unravels as his arranged marriage to Miss Wilson is exposed as a sham, and he faces accusations of profound betrayal. However, an ancient prophecy and his father's unconventional love story inspire Howard to defy ancient norms, realizing true love transcends prophecy. He discovers his "Moon Spirit ring" is fake, hinting at deeper deceptions. Consumed by regret, Howard races to find Bridget, making a desperate confession, apologizing for his past mistakes, and declaring his overwhelming love. After a heartfelt reunion marked by a "magical chime" and the declaration that "Jing has returned," Howard asks Bridget to be his Luna, which she joyfully accepts, embarking on a journey to integrate her new identity into his family and embrace their fated, yet hard-won, connection.

harvest-of-ambition-a-ceos-odyssey.title: Harvest of ambition, a CEO's odyssey
harvest-of-ambition-a-ceos-odyssey.description:
In the ruthless tides of the corporate world, success is never an accident.
This is the story of a self-made man who, armed with vision, resilience, and relentless ambition, rises from humble beginnings to become the leader of a global empire.

Amid a battlefield of wealth, power, and betrayal, he must navigate not only fierce competitors but also the shadows within his own heart. Every decision he makes is a gamble — one that could either build an empire or tear it all down.

This is a journey of growth, strategy, and redemption — a tale of a CEO who dares to chase greatness, only to discover the true cost of ambition.

In the end, will he claim glory — or be left with only solitude?

the-runaway-ceo-has-two-babies-1.title: The Runaway CEO has Two Babies
the-runaway-ceo-has-two-babies-1.description: After divorcing his ex-wife, he never got involved with any other woman. He refused to acknowledge that he had once loved her. However, upon reuniting, he realized that, both physically and emotionally, his true love was his ex-wife, not his first love

pyaar-ke-liye.title: Pyaar Ke Liye
pyaar-ke-liye.description: A devoted wife makes a dark bargain to restore her husband’s lost success, only to face betrayal, heartbreak, and a deadly price. But when fate gives her a second chance under a new identity, she must protect her daughter and reclaim her place.

let-me-go-my-queen-1.title: Let Me Go, My Queen!
let-me-go-my-queen-1.description: Jack Dawson, a skeptical man, is unexpectedly transported from his reality into a vibrant, historical matriarchal society after a mysterious pendant activates. Captured by the ruthless General Antonia, he faces interrogation and the threat of execution, but his artistic skills offer a desperate chance at survival under the formidable Maharani Cesario. He is tasked with creating a portrait, navigating a treacherous court where artistic failure means death, and becomes entangled in intrigue and a dangerous love triangle. His true identity is revealed, and despite being appointed Chief Painter, his attempts to escape and prove his intentions lead to him being identified as an imposter and facing elimination. As Jack navigates this perilous world, he proves his ingenuity by solving a food crisis and transforming a poisonous creature into a delicacy, catching the attention of powerful figures like Cesario and Queen Cleopatra. He finds himself in a forbidden romance with General Radha, while also being manipulated by a Princess and condemned to a prolonged execution by Cesario. Cesario, facing an impossible choice, marries Cleopatra to save his critically ill sister, Octavia, who is later miraculously revived by Marc Antony. Jack, having saved Octavia, rejects her proposal and declares his love for Queen Cesario, facing accusations of treason but ultimately saved by Cesario's trust. Revealed as an enigmatic time-traveler, Jack's true mission unfolds as he defies the King of Egypt and Cesario, seeking three mythical "Golds" to return to his own time. He feigns loyalty to Cesario, cunningly extracting information about the artifacts, one held by Cleopatra and another by Herald. He strengthens his bond with Cesario but faces threats from enraged rivals, claiming to synthesize "pure salt" in a high-stakes power struggle. Driven by love for his wife Antonia, Jack undertakes a perilous experiment to combine "beta" and "theta" gold, realizing a crucial third material is missing, and reveals a cunning deception to outwit rivals. The kingdom plunges into political intrigue and technological warfare as Jack is lauded for containing a dragon but then accused of being a spy. His true identity and hidden powers are gradually revealed through his exposure of Cassius's ties to the 'Cleopatran' organization and his invention of a revolutionary laser gun. Leader Cesario secretly develops a devastating weapon, while Jack attempts to gain Cesario's trust, sparking a romance with Julia, who later conspires to usurp the throne. Queen Cleopatra launches a full-scale invasion, accusing Julia of treachery, leading to Julia's kingdom facing an impossible ultimatum and her profound act of self-sacrifice. Cleopatra's army invades Cesaria, and Jack's defense is initially sabotaged, but a brilliant inventor unleashes a mysterious weapon that decimates Cleopatra's forces. Jack, revealed as an advisor from another time, uses anachronistic weapons and strategic innovation to decisively defeat a numerically superior rival army. Royal Julia makes the ultimate sacrifice, abdicating her kingdom for her beloved Jack. However, Jack awakens questioning if their romance was real or a dream, only to be confronted by the enigmatic Queen Cyrus, leaving the ultimate reality of his journey ambiguous and transcending eras.

karzz.title: Karzz
karzz.description: Betrayed by his childhood love and left to die, a once-wealthy Ayan returns to life with a second chance — and a burning desire for revenge. Now back in college, he must unmask the lies, reclaim his identity, and destroy those who destroyed him.

Avangalukku naan power illa-nu ninaichanga—but avangalukku theriyala, naan dhan indha country-oda richest man-oda ponnu-nu. Avanoda ella wealth-um ennoda sothu dhan. Andha naale, en vazhkai-la oru powerful billionaire vandhu entry kudutharu, ellaame maathitaru. Ippo enakku dhanam irukku, power irukku, oru pudhu identity irukku. Idho, game ipo dhan start aagudhu!

the-wrong-womb.title: The Wrong Womb
the-wrong-womb.description: Devoted wife Shivi's world is upended by a shocking series of betrayals and medical errors. Initially overjoyed by her pregnancy via artificial insemination, she soon discovers her husband, Ajay, is having an affair with her best friend, Aarti, who also claims to be pregnant. The betrayal deepens when Ajay cruelly dismisses Shivi, and it's revealed that Aarti's baby isn't Ajay's, but belongs to the enigmatic billionaire Vikrant Kishore due to a critical sperm mix-up. Facing public humiliation and a demand for divorce, Shivi learns Ajay is infertile, exposing Aarti's pregnancy claim as a lie. Driven by a sense of debt to her childhood friend, Dr. Kyra, Shivi makes a desperate sacrifice, agreeing to be a surrogate for Mr. Kishore, igniting a path of revenge fueled by past secrets. Cast out and accused, Shivi enters a world of high-society contracts, first with CEO Viren, then with Vikrant Kishore, navigating constant surveillance and public scrutiny. She endures further humiliation from Ajay and Aarti, who publicly accuse her of infertility, leading to physical altercations. Despite the transactional nature of her initial engagement with Vikrant, romantic tension unexpectedly ignites between them. Shivi fabricates a pregnancy to navigate Vikrant's suspicious family, and he dramatically outbids Ajay for her deceased mother's heirloom, solidifying his protective feelings. However, their burgeoning relationship is challenged by Vikrant's glamorous ex-fiancée, Deepika Shah, who attempts to diminish Shivi and orchestrates a deeper conspiracy involving Ajay. Shivi's past resurfaces with Ajay, who threatens to expose her alleged infertility, only for Shivi to reveal his own condition. Amidst this, Shivi becomes pregnant with Ajay's child via artificial insemination while engaged to Vikrant. The drama culminates in Shivi's violent abduction by Ajay, who holds her captive, asserting paternity over her unborn child. Vikrant dramatically rescues Shivi, leading to her revelation of pregnancy and a confrontation about Deepika's manipulative betrayals. Vikrant passionately confesses his love and proposes marriage. Shivi, now identified as Mukti, then reveals a profound secret: she became Vikrant's surrogate due to an accident, but later admits she lied about being the surrogate to protect the child's biological mother. Despite these complex revelations, Vikrant embraces their unconventional bond, and as past betrayals are resolved, their love blossoms, and justice is administered. Shivi's journey transforms from a victim of deceit to a woman who finds love, family, and justice, protecting her child and uncovering her true identity.

snehadooth-1.description: കണ്ണിൽ പ്രണയവും ചുണ്ടിൽ ചിരിയും ഒളിപ്പിച്ച സുന്ദരിയായ അമല. ഒരു ദിവസം അരുതാത്തതു സംഭവിക്കുന്നു. പ്രണയവും സസ്‌പെൻസും നിറഞ്ഞ,  ആരാധക ഹൃദയങ്ങൾ കീഴടക്കിയ ജോയ്‌സിയുടെ  ജനപ്രിയ കഥ ആസ്വദിക്കൂ,  കുക്കു എഫ്.എമ്മിൽ.

കടല്‍-ഒറ്റയ്ക്ക്-ക്ഷണിച്ചപ്പോള്‍.description: അഭിലാഷ് ടോമിയുടെ സാഹസികവും ധീരവുമായ സമുദ്രയാത്രയ്ക്ക് കൂട്ടുപോകാം Kuku FMലൂടെ. കടലിലൂടെ ഒറ്റയ്ക്ക് ലോകം ചുറ്റിയ ആദ്യ ഇന്ത്യാക്കാരനായ കമാന്‍ഡര്‍ അഭിലാഷ് ടോമിയുടെ ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന, കിടിലം കൊള്ളിക്കുന്ന ഓര്‍മ്മകള്‍ നിങ്ങളിലെ സാഹസികനെയും തൊട്ടുണര്‍ത്തും. വിജയത്തിന്റെ കരുത്തിന്റെ കഥ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

essential-vivekananda.title: Essential Vivekananda: The Monk Who Inspired Millions
essential-vivekananda.description: Swami Vivekananda ne apne jeevan kaal mein hi Bharat ko ek nayi disha dikhayi. മായപുരാണം-.title: മായാപുരാണം
മായപുരാണം-.description: സ്നേഹലതയുടെയും സദാശിവന്റേയും മായാപുരത്തിലെ വശ്യമായ ജീവിതം ആസ്വദിക്കാം ഈ കുക്കു എഫ്.എം ഷോയിൽ. മനുഷ്യർ പരസ്പരം സ്നേഹിച്ചു രമിച്ചും പ്രകൃതിയോട് ഇണങ്ങിയും ജീവിക്കുന്ന മായാപുരം എന്ന സ്വപ്നഭൂമിയിലേക്ക് സ്വാഗതം.

ranger-1.title: റേയ്ഞ്ചർ
ranger-1.description: കാടിനേയും നാടിനേയും വിറപ്പിക്കുന്ന കൊടുംഭീകരനെതിരെ ധീരനായ ഒരു റേയ്ഞ്ചറുടെ പോരാട്ടം! പ്രതികാരവും ആക്ഷനും പ്രണയവും നിറഞ്ഞ,ബാറ്റൺ ബോസിന്റെ റേയ്ഞ്ചർ നിങ്ങളെ ആകാംക്ഷയുടെ മുൾമുനയിൽ നിർത്തും.

breaking-bad-habits-with-subconscious-tr.title: 9 Steps Mein Buri Aadatein Chhodna Seekho
breaking-bad-habits-with-subconscious-tr.description: Apni Buri Aadaton ko chhodna chahte ho? Agar haan, Toh pehle ye pata karna hoga ki yeh aadatein padti kaise hain, Kyunki tabhi toh inhein jad se mitaya ja sakega. Aur vo kaise karna hai? Iska step by step process bataya gaya hai is show mein.

shubhayathra.title: ശുഭയാത്ര
shubhayathra.description: മലയാളിക്ക് അടുത്ത വീട്ടിലോ ചേട്ടനെപ്പോലെയാണ് ജയറാം. രസികന്‍ കഥകള്‍ പറയുന്ന നമ്മളെ പൊട്ടിച്ചിരിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഏത് നാട്ടിടവഴികളിലും കാണുന്നത് പോലൊരാള്‍. ശുഭയാത്ര എന്ന ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിലൂടെ തന്റെ യാത്രാനുഭവങ്ങള്‍ പങ്കുവെക്കുകയാണ് ജയറാം. അതിന്റെ ചിരി മാത്രമല്ല, നൊമ്പരങ്ങളും ചിന്തകളുമെല്ലാമുണ്ട്.

indrajith-the-crown-prince-of-lanka.title: Indrajith The Crown Prince of Lanka
indrajith-the-crown-prince-of-lanka.description: ఇంద్రజిత్ రావణుడికి , మండోదరికి పుట్టిన మొదటి కుమారుడు. ఇంద్రజిత్ పుట్టినప్పుడు అరిచిన అరుపు మేఘం ఉరిమిన పిడుగు శబ్దంలా ఉండటం వల్ల ఇతనికి మేఘనాధుడు అని పేరు పెట్టారు. తన తండ్రి రావణాసురుడు,రాక్షస గురువు శుక్రాచార్యుడి దగ్గర అస్త్ర, శస్త్ర విద్యలు నేర్పుకొని, వేదాలను సైతం అవపోసన పట్టాడు. మేఘనాధుడు పుట్టే సమయంలో రావణుడు అన్ని గ్రహాలను అనుకూలంగా మార్చాడు. అసలు ఈ మేఘనాధుడికి ఇన్ని శక్తులు ఎలా వచ్చాయి, ఇన్ని శక్తులు ఉన్న మేఘనాధుడు లక్ష్మణుడి చేతిలో ఎందుకు మరణించాడు. వంటి మరెన్నో విషయాలు ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ లో వినండి.

india-today-india-tomorrow.title: India Today, India Tomorrow
india-today-india-tomorrow.description: Apne Desh ko nayi uchhaiyon tak le jaane ke liye, Uski har ek sthiti ko samajhna bahut zaroori hai. Yeh Book Explanation aapko India ke har aspect ko samjhaane mein madad karegi aur aapko batayegi vo strategic approach jinse India world mein ek naya aayam chhu sakta hai. To abhi suniye aur jaaniye India ka aane wala kal.

think-and-grow-rich-54.title: Think And Grow Rich
think-and-grow-rich-54.description: Lokamake kodikkanakkinalukal vayicha, assanghyam aalukal jeevithathilek pakarthi vijayam kaivaricha manthrika granthamaanu Think And Grow Rich. 20 Varshathinidayil vividha mekhalakalil vijayicha 500il adhikam vyakthikale padichanu vikhyathanaya Napoleon Hill ee pusthakam rachichirikkunnath.

coming-out-of-middle-class-trap.title: Coming out of Middle Class Trap
coming-out-of-middle-class-trap.description: മിഡിൽ ക്ലാസ്സിന്റെ മടുപ്പ്‌ അവസാനിപ്പിക്കാം. ഉയർന്ന വരുമാനം, സാമ്പത്തിക സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യം എന്നിവ നേടി അപ്പർ ക്ലാസ്സിലേക് ഉയരാനുള്ള രഹസ്യങ്ങൾ, നിങ്ങളുടെ കൈപ്പിടിയിൽ. ഈ കുക്കൂ എഫ് എം ഷോ തീർച്ചയായും നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതം മാറ്റിമറിക്കും.

dark-web-murder.title: DARK WEB MURDER
dark-web-murder.description: Dark Web ke gehre galiyaron mein ek bazaar hota hai, jahaan maut bhi bikti hai. 'Besa Mafia', jahan khatarnaak contract killings aur blackmail ka khel chalta hai. Suniye, kaise bitcoin ban gaya apradh ki nayi currency. 'Dark Web Ke Raaz', ek audio byte jo kholegi internet ke sabse andhere kone ki kahaniyan.

അക്കരെ-താമസിക്കുന്ന-സ്ത്രീ.title: അക്കരെ താമസിക്കുന്ന സ്ത്രീ
അക്കരെ-താമസിക്കുന്ന-സ്ത്രീ.description: ആൺ-പെൺ ബന്ധത്തിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനഘടനകൾ പര്യവേക്ഷണം ചെയ്യുന്ന പന്ത്രണ്ട് കഥകളാണ് ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ ഉള്ളത്. ഈ ചെറുകഥാ സമാഹാരം സ്ത്രീകളുടെ അന്തസ്സും സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യവും പ്രണയവും ലൈംഗികതയും പോലുള്ള വിഷയങ്ങൾ പര്യവേക്ഷണം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

അമ്മിണി-.description: പച്ചയായ ജീവിതങ്ങളെ, പ്രത്യേകിച്ച് സ്ത്രീ ജീവിതങ്ങളെ താളുകളിലേക്ക് പകര്‍ത്തുന്നതില്‍ ഉറൂബിന്റെ കഴിവ് അനന്യമാണ്. അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ തൂലികയില്‍ പിറന്ന മികച്ചൊരു സൃഷ്ടിയാണ് അമ്മിണി. തന്റേടിയും സുന്ദരിയുമായ അമ്മിണിയെയും അവളുടെ ഓര്‍മ്മകളെ ഹൃദയത്തിലേറ്റിയ നളിനിയെയുമെല്ലാം അതിഭാവുകത്വമില്ലാതെ ഉറൂബ് വരച്ചിടുന്നു. ഹൃദയസ്പര്‍ശിയായ നോവല്‍ വായിക്കാം.

mafia-1.description: അടുത്തതെന്ത്! അടുത്തതെന്ത്! എന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ച് ഒരു ക്ലൂവും തരാത്ത എന്നാല്‍ കൃത്യമായ പോയിന്റുകളില്‍ ഞെട്ടിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ട്വിസ്റ്റുകള്‍ തരുന്ന കിടിലന്‍ ത്രില്ലര്‍ സിനിമകള്‍ നമ്മള്‍ക്കിന്ന് അന്യമല്ല. എന്നാല്‍ ഇതിനെല്ലാം മുന്‍പ് മലയാളിയെ ഞെട്ടിപ്പിച്ച പേരാണ് ബാറ്റണ്‍ബോസ്! അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ, ത്രില്ലടിപ്പിക്കുന്ന മാഫിയ എന്ന നോവല്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം Kuku FMലൂടെ.

yamadharma-raja.description: యముడంటే ఎవరు? మనుషులు చనిపోతే స్వర్గానికి పోవాలా నరకానికి పోవాలా అనేది యముడే డిసైడ్ చేస్తాడా? ఇవన్నీ తెలియాలంటే యమధర్మ రాజు కథ తెలుసుకోవాల్సిందే...

sree-sakaracharya.title: Sree Shankaracharya
sree-sakaracharya.description: ഒരേയൊരു മകനെ സന്ന്യാസത്തിന് അയക്കാന്‍ വിമുഖതയുണ്ടായിരുന്ന അമ്മയ്ക്ക് ചില നിമിത്തങ്ങള്‍ക്കൊടുവില്‍ അതിന് സമ്മതിക്കേണ്ടി വന്നു. വീടുവിട്ടിറങ്ങിയ ആ വേദാന്തിയെ കാലം അടയാളപ്പെടുത്തിയത് ഇതിഹാസ പുരുഷനായിട്ടായിരുന്നു. അദ്വൈത ദര്‍ശനത്തിന് അടിത്തറ പാകിയ ആദിശങ്കരന്റെ ജീവിതം കേള്‍ക്കാം.

battle-of-the-babes.title: Battle of the Babes
battle-of-the-babes.description: The microdrama centers on a fierce college rivalry between Anjali, a manipulative imposter, and Arohi, the true heiress of the powerful Purohit family, who initially lives undercover. Anjali orchestrates an elaborate deception, falsely claiming the 'Rajkumari Purohit' title to infiltrate elite social circles and assert dominance. Her attempts involve lavish parties and public displays, often at Arohi's expense, who is initially a victim of bullying and pranks. However, Arohi, possessing knowledge of the real family, strategically challenges Anjali's fabricated identity, planning retribution and eventually transforming into a determined combatant. As the conflict escalates, Anjali's facade begins to unravel. Arohi cunningly exposes Anjali's lies, revealing her true parentage as a maid's daughter and her false age through public confrontations, AI-generated audio, and talent show humiliations. Anjali's own associates, like Riya and Aryan, contribute to her downfall by exposing her deception, while her regretful father even enlists a strategic woman, Pragati, to orchestrate his daughter's demise. Amidst this, a romance blossoms between Arohi and Akash, further complicating the social dynamics and providing Arohi with an ally. The narrative builds to Arohi's dramatic revelation of her secret identity as the true 'Rajkumari Purohit' heiress. With newfound resolve and the support of Akash and Anjali's father, Arohi plans to publicly unmask Anjali's bullying and deception at a major college event. The climax sees Arohi dramatically interrupting a competition, publicly exposing Anjali's fabricated identity and academic record, which is confirmed by the Principal. Anjali is officially dethroned and accused of widespread fraud and the theft of a priceless family heirloom. The series culminates with Arohi triumphantly crowned 'College Queen,' vowing chilling revenge and ensuring Anjali's social ostracization, as justice is served and the true heiress reclaims her rightful place. The stakes involve not only social standing and reputation but also the reclamation of identity, family legacy, and the triumph of truth over deceit.
