as-you-wish-6.title: As you wish
as-you-wish-6.description: Susan and Peter’s story begins in immediate danger, with violence, debt, and pursuit forcing them to rely on fragile loyalty and sudden interventions. Peter’s past is repeatedly tied to criminal debt and revenge, while Susan keeps trying to protect him even as the cost of that devotion grows. Michael repeatedly appears as a powerful figure who can stop threats, manage exposure, and reshape outcomes through leverage rather than simple kindness. A supernatural or wish-based thread enters through the Wishing Wine, linking sacrifice, altered memory, and the possibility that desire can be bought at a terrible price. As the story moves into offices and households, personal history becomes public, and Susan’s connection to Peter is used against both of them in reputational and corporate battles. Vivian and Jennifer emerge as major rivals and pressure points, each caught in struggles over status, authorship, and who truly belongs beside Peter. The workplace conflict is repeatedly disrupted by missing files, deleted evidence, blackout sabotage, and accusations that someone inside the company is manipulating events. Domestic scenes are no safer, since marriage, motherhood, and inheritance are all treated as weapons in the fight for control. Peter’s mother and other family figures intensify the pressure by pushing status-driven marriages and humiliating those they see as beneath them. Susan’s own role shifts from loyal partner to strategic player, as she tries to gain influence inside Peter’s household and later turns toward uncovering wrongdoing. Jennifer’s position is especially unstable: she is praised, disguised, compared to Susan, accused, arrested, and then drawn back into Peter’s orbit through contracts and financial entanglements. Vivian’s arc is marked by suspicion and danger, including public humiliation, threats, injury, and a near-drowning that suggests someone is willing to silence her. The corporate plot keeps widening into criminal territory, with illicit market operations, adulterated wine, and money trails all pointing back to Peter’s hidden dealings. Several characters are forced into silence through threats, blackmail, or the promise of protection, showing that survival often depends on who controls the evidence. At the same time, the story keeps returning to questions of identity, with impersonation, uncertain backgrounds, and mistaken loyalties making every alliance unstable. Peter himself becomes increasingly trapped by the consequences of his own power, as he is exposed, beaten, manipulated, and forced to beg for forgiveness while still trying to control the narrative. By the later stretch, visions, hallucination-like warnings, and revenge choices suggest that guilt and sabotage have begun to collapse the boundary between emotional and physical danger. Across the whole arc, love, marriage, money, and survival are never separate; each one becomes a tool for leverage, betrayal, or rescue.

clouds-by-the-sea.title: Clouds By The Sea
clouds-by-the-sea.description:
A young woman who marries a wealthy man. On their wedding day, he informs her of his intent to divorce her in three years to protect his family's reputation. She has a serious, undisclosed heart condition.
For two years, he mistreats her. She becomes pregnant, but his girlfriend, aided by family members, forces her to abort the baby. A traumatized survivor, she is rescued by a childhood friend, now an influential figure, who offers support and proposes marriage. She declines, knowing her impending death and not wanting him to suffer. Watch Now !

the-shadows-counter-attack-4.title: The Shadows Counter attack
the-shadows-counter-attack-4.description: This microdrama revolves around a volatile struggle over identity, pregnancy, marriage, and status, with Chris at the center of several competing claims. Early on, family honor is threatened by a hidden medical complication tied to an engagement with Chris, leading to disownment, frantic deception, and efforts to stage normalcy before truths can surface. At the same time, powerful elders treat women’s bodies and futures as bargaining tools, pressuring Lily and another pregnant woman into arrangements involving marriage, childbirth, and surrendering a child for elite family interests. Public humiliation becomes a recurring weapon, as accusations, slaps, inspections, and staged performances are used to control vulnerable women and test their worth. Amy and Chris appear to share a genuine bond in private, but that relationship is repeatedly destabilized by jealousy, class tension, and schemes built around appearances. A pregnancy claim becomes a major source of leverage, with a matriarch determined to use the unborn child to secure an arranged marriage and later seize custody, even as trust around the pregnancy itself begins to crack. Chris repeatedly tries to delay or manage revelations, including a blood test that could expose a hidden secret, suggesting that truth itself is dangerous to multiple sides. Meanwhile, Lily moves into a new public identity as Amy and is pushed into the film world, where reinvention offers opportunity but also deepens the confusion around who she really is. Her rapid success in auditions and contracting brings fame within reach, yet the entertainment track mirrors the family drama by surrounding her with coercive contracts, threats, and punishing expectations. Across both domestic and public spaces, wealthier figures attempt to script the lives of others through money, intimidation, and reputation. The identity conflict sharpens when Susi emerges as a rival figure claiming belonging and legitimacy within the family sphere, forcing Chris and the patriarchal authority around him to confront contradictory versions of the truth. What had seemed like hidden manipulation then breaks into open scandal when a woman who had surgically altered herself to resemble the famous heiress Amy is exposed as an impostor. Her revelation reframes earlier assumptions about romance, status, and marriage, especially because Chris had been preparing to marry her. She pleads for forgiveness and denies pursuing Amy’s identity for status, but the damage is already public and severe. The real Amy then appears to assert that she is the genuine woman and the rightful prospective bride, turning private deception into a direct legitimacy battle. By this stage, the show’s central stakes converge: who is truly Amy, who can claim Chris, whether pregnancy and marriage have been manipulated for power, and whether any relationship can survive the layers of coercion and performance. The patriarch’s denunciation of the duplicate gives public force to the exposure, but it does not fully settle the emotional and social fallout. In the end, the series presents a melodramatic arc in which love, family recognition, bodily autonomy, and public identity are all contested under the pressure of wealth and revenge, with the final marriage claim left unresolved.

bleed-for-this-2.title: Bleed for This
bleed-for-this-2.description: Bleed For This is a heartwarming drama that follows the ups and downs of a multi-generational family as they navigate love, conflict, and tradition under one roof. Amid trials and misunderstandings, they learn that unity and understanding are the true foundations of happiness.

busaba-bold-and-beautiful.title: Busaba Bold And Beautiful
busaba-bold-and-beautiful.description: The show moves through a chain of public crises where ordinary plans keep collapsing under pressure from money, crime, and reputation. It begins with a film shoot that cannot stay under control, as a staged chase is exposed and the crew is forced to keep improvising while the producer worries about rising costs. That same sense of chaos carries into a robbery that turns unexpectedly into a childbirth, when two intruders enter a house for valuables but end up helping deliver a baby girl. One of the thieves is shaken enough to promise he will leave crime behind, suggesting that even criminals can be forced into responsibility by circumstance. Elsewhere, two noodle sellers struggle to keep their business alive while an eccentric hustler presses them for money and police pressure makes even ordinary street trade feel precarious. The batch also follows a man whose quiet life is threatened by old criminal ties and suspicion around a diamond or sapphire-related scheme, showing how past wrongdoing keeps resurfacing. A jewelry-showroom storyline then turns romance into humiliation, as flirtation, class anxiety, and a public confrontation expose the boyfriend’s lack of money and trigger a slap-filled scandal. Another thread centers on a contested jewel, with family members arguing over whether the original was switched and when it was handled, so trust becomes as valuable as the object itself. That dispute widens into questions of marriage and honor when a younger woman asks to leave because someone intends to marry her. Power shifts abruptly when a forceful outsider arrives, attacks someone, and declares himself administrator, making it clear that control in this world is often seized rather than earned. The tone then turns toward younger men talking about college, parental pressure, and an arranged marriage, but even that more intimate setting is shattered by gunfire near their car. What follows is a frantic chase toward the airport, with arguments over ownership, commands to shoot, and a stalled car after a barricade collision. At the airport, a traveler named Chulbul is confronted by a dominant local powerbroker who uses accusations, cash, and threats to dominate the situation. The final stretch shifts again to Bangkok, where a glittering diamond-like object and renewed accusations over a shooting keep the tension unresolved. Across these stories, private disputes repeatedly spill into public view, and every attempt to manage appearances only makes the crisis larger. The stakes are survival, money, family standing, and the fragile hope that someone might still choose responsibility over escalation.

time-traveling-cute-baby-2.title: Time-Traveling Cute Baby
time-traveling-cute-baby-2.description: Time-Travelling Cute Baby is a fantasy show where a mysterious baby from the future appears in the heroine’s life, claiming to be her child. As she unravels the truth, secrets of love, destiny, and a powerful father's identity are revealed.

disappeared-wife-1.title: Disappeared Wife
disappeared-wife-1.description: The show revolves around a family-business empire thrown into chaos by betrayal at sea, disputed deaths, and relentless fights over who truly owns both the company and the marriage at its center. It begins with a wife who joyfully announces her pregnancy and transfers company responsibility to John, only for him to drown her during a scuba outing and reveal that their seven-year marriage was a calculated scheme to seize her property and inheritance. What should have been a private crime quickly expands into a public scandal as missing women, damaged notes, falling share prices, and press scrutiny turn personal betrayal into a corporate crisis. At the same time, other branches of the family are already battling over remarriage, estate claims, and succession, making every disappearance or return immediately suspect. John repeatedly tries to convert confusion into power, using the missing-wife scandal and stock turmoil to justify taking control of the company despite objections from relatives, directors, and legal authorities. But the presumed death does not stay settled: a woman believed drowned reappears, and her claim to be the real wife ignites fierce arguments over a cage at sea, a key, a shoe, a suicide note, a pendant, fingerprints, DNA, scars, and a birthmark. Each new proof seems to settle the matter for a moment, only for fresh contradictions to reopen the question of whether she is the rightful wife, an impostor, or part of a twin-based deception. As the identity battle moves from the shoreline into the household and boardroom, marriage itself becomes evidence, leverage, and a legal weapon in the struggle for chairmanship and inheritance. Rival claimants, elders, executives, and family members split into factions, alternately validating and denouncing the woman’s status while succession meetings collapse into humiliation, threats, and public spectacle. John’s authority rises and falls with these disputes: he is announced or acts as chairman in some confrontations, yet his legitimacy is constantly challenged by former spouses, rival heirs, and returning women who claim longer and truer rights than his own. The conflict deepens when accusations broaden beyond fraud to attempted murder, abuse, coercive divorce, shareholder theft, and the death of a child, turning John from ambitious husband into a man repeatedly confronted with the human cost of his schemes. Anna emerges as the central force opposing him, accusing him of trying to kill her at sea, rejecting his remorse, and refusing to let staged gestures of love erase violence and manipulation. Around her, siblings, brothers, sisters, allies, and rescuers repeatedly intervene, showing that family loyalty can still resist the corporate machinery built on fear and secrecy. Meanwhile, rival business houses and inheritance claimants exploit the turmoil, using leaked recordings, social-media allegations, diverted contracts, and boardroom maneuvers to press their own claims to authority. The show’s middle and later arcs keep returning to the same core uncertainty: if identity can be forged, hidden, or split between twins, then every marriage contract, share transfer, and succession decision may rest on a lie. John responds to that instability with escalating control tactics, including threats, physical restraint, hostage-taking, armed intimidation, and plans to disguise murder as accident, but these moves only intensify resistance and public exposure. By the end of the synthesized arc, the central marriage has collapsed under the weight of seven years of deception, and Anna publicly exposes John, refuses to kill him, and ends the relationship even as legal, familial, and corporate consequences close in. Yet the larger struggle remains unsettled, because inheritance, chairmanship, and even the true identities of key women are still under dispute. The show’s overarching stakes are therefore not just who inherits a company, but whether truth can survive in a world where love, lineage, and survival are all repeatedly weaponized for control.

waking-up-together.description:

क्या अवनी और एहसान अपने प्यार को बचा पाएंगे, या ताकत और विरासत की लड़ाई उन्हें अलग कर देगी?

shaitaan-ki-baahon-mein.title: Shaitaan ki Baahon Mein
shaitaan-ki-baahon-mein.description: Trisha, falsely accused of murder by her ex-lover Aniket, is thrust into a harrowing ordeal, first captured and delivered to Rosie Madam's brothel, then held captive by Angad Dhawan, who blames her for his sister's death and subjects her to torment and drugging. She fights for her innocence and dignity against systemic corruption, personal vendettas, and Angad's relentless pursuit, while his brothers, Siddharth and Gautam, introduce further complications and rivalries. Angad emerges as a central antagonist, orchestrating schemes that bind women through manipulation and forced surrogacy, with Trisha facing the devastating possibility of an unwanted pregnancy and a fractured marriage to him. Despite her efforts to keep her pregnancy secret, it is revealed, sparking a fierce battle over paternity, which Alya manipulates with a false DNA report, leading Angad to disbelieve Trisha and threaten their unborn child. Following the child's tragic death, Trisha, now aware of Alya's deception, vows revenge against Angad, forming an alliance with Gautam, who is also driven by personal vendetta and frames Angad for drug supply amidst corporate battles. The narrative unravels a complex web of familial betrayal, corporate warfare, and deep-seated vendettas, as Trisha is repeatedly targeted and framed by Aliya and Vardhika for past tragedies and conspiracies to seize Angad's property. Angad, though driven by revenge, is also compelled to protect Trisha, creating a tumultuous dynamic between them. Intense confrontations ensue, marked by mutual accusations of murder and betrayal, culminating in Trisha's shocking confession to Angad's murder, only for him to miraculously survive. Later, Angad's presumed-dead rival, Neil, returns, revealing Angad faked his death and imprisoned him, further complicating the Dhawan empire's internal conflicts. It is uncovered that Aliya, Trisha's former friend, harbored a decades-long, envy-fueled obsession, systematically destroying Trisha's life, including killing her parent, to separate her from Angad. The show culminates in a violent confrontation where Trisha makes a heartbreaking sacrifice for Angad's safety, leaving their star-crossed destiny uncertain. Throughout these trials, Trisha struggles for personal agency, survival, and justice against powerful forces seeking to control and destroy her.

confrontation-in-the-courtroom.description: She stood against her own husband in court after a shocking accident tore their family apart. the-sage-doctor-2.title: The Sage Doctor
the-sage-doctor-2.description: This microdrama weaves together several desperation-driven conflicts in which money, illness, and status become tools of humiliation and control. At its core, vulnerable people are repeatedly pushed into coercive bargains when urgent medical crises leave them with no safe options. One early thread follows a security guard or similarly struggling man who is driven by the need to fund an operation, only to be degraded through transactional propositions and then shattered when his wife returns with a wealthier man, serves divorce papers, and reveals that even their wedding money is gone. That same atmosphere of cruelty expands into hospital-centered extortion, where access to treatment is tied to cash, influence, and threats that loved ones can be removed, declared dead, or otherwise destroyed by those in power. A central victim is publicly slapped and pressured into signing divorce papers under threats to a sister, showing how family vulnerability is weaponized across both domestic and institutional spaces. After a car crash, however, a strange turning point emerges when this figure gains an uncanny power linked to healing and the ability to detect hidden value. That supernatural thread begins to shift the balance, allowing hidden truths to surface through medical insight and antique appraisal alike. In parallel, Astha enters as a wealthy but embattled defender whose problems begin with a broken vase meant for her grandfather and widen into repeated confrontations with abusive authority. Her connection with a security guard and later with Pankaj grows through attempts to replace damaged valuables, identify genuine artifacts, and recover losses in the antique market. These antique disputes are never just about objects: fake and genuine pieces become proxies for pride, credibility, and social dominance, leading to wagers, public insults, and revelations that supposed treasures may be replicas while overlooked items may hold immense value. Rajat and other powerful antagonists repeatedly exploit wealth, family influence, and hospital authority to retaliate against Astha and Pankaj, especially when a priceless artifact and a critically ill elder become entangled. Elderly relatives such as Dida and Mr. Malhotra are placed at the center of the stakes, as their survival depends on decisions made amid extortion, intimidation, and competing medical claims. Astha consistently resists this abuse, intervening when vulnerable women and elders are humiliated, even when she herself is slapped or threatened. The medical storyline intensifies when Astha, desperate to save her grandfather, offers a contract marriage to doctor Aditya if he can cure him, only for rival medical voices to clash over diagnosis, treatment, and whether a potent remedy is healing or endangering the patient. Mr. Malhotra’s apparent improvement offers hope, but the disagreement over his true condition keeps the outcome uncertain and raises the cost of every choice. Elsewhere, workplace power games mirror the same pattern of domination, with false accusations, forced apologies, sexual coercion, and impossible financial demands crushing low-status employees. In response, characters repeatedly turn to antiques, hidden expertise, or miraculous healing as their last chance to reclaim dignity and money from systems rigged against them. Across the show, the central stakes are survival, family protection, and self-respect in a world where the rich and connected can rewrite truth, medicine, and justice to suit themselves. The arc builds from humiliation and betrayal toward confrontation and partial empowerment, but many outcomes remain unresolved, especially around the elders’ fate, the contested treatments, and whether hidden truth can finally overcome entrenched power.

rented-husband.title: Rented Husband
rented-husband.description: Desperate heiress Myra enters a high-stakes contract marriage with the enigmatic Terence to save her family's failing business and escape an unwanted arranged marriage to the arrogant Mark. Initially, Terence, posing as a humble salesman, endures relentless scorn and humiliation from Myra's formidable mother, Josephine, and Mark, who brand him a manipulative gold-digger. Despite the class divides and family expectations, Terence's unexpected generosity and hints of immense wealth begin to challenge their assumptions, and Myra finds herself unexpectedly falling for him. As Myra fiercely defends Terence against her family's escalating pressure to divorce him for the wealthy Mark, Terence, secretly a magnate, begins to reveal his true identity. This culminates in a public gift-giving challenge against Mark, where Terence displays extravagant wealth, though his newfound status is immediately met with accusations of theft and fakery. A family matriarch eventually confirms the authenticity of his riches, vindicating him amidst the escalating drama. The conflict intensifies when Mark frames Terence for theft, leading to Terence's abduction by a criminal gang. Myra bravely attempts to rescue her husband, during which Terence's true identity as a global arms magnate, also known as Terence D'Souza or Reddy, is fully revealed, turning the tables on his captors and Mark. In gratitude for Myra's heroism, Terence diverts a multi-crore corporate deal to her struggling company. However, a new crisis emerges as Myra's grandmother suffers a critical heart attack, prompting her manipulative cousin Yash to demand Myra divorce Terence and marry Mark for financial aid. Terence once again proves his worth by saving Nani's life, but faces further accusations of fraud and attempted murder from greedy relatives over inheritance. He dramatically reveals his true identity as the powerful heir to a corporate empire, stunning the family who had previously scorned him. With his identity fully established, Terence systematically targets Mark Cabrel's company for destruction, driven by past transgressions and a mysterious "girl." Mark, in a desperate attempt to save his collapsing empire, proposes a contract marriage to Myra to secure a crucial deal with Mr. D'Souza. Ultimately, Mr. DeSouza, reflecting on Myra's unwavering loyalty through all their trials, proposes marriage to her, transforming his ruthless demeanor with a heartwarming gesture as Mark's empire crumbles.

marriage-a-debt-3.title: Marriage: A Debt
marriage-a-debt-3.description: The story world is driven by marriages, family leverage, and corporate power struggles that repeatedly override personal choice. Women are pushed into weddings, divorces, and public marital claims as relatives and business rivals treat marriage like a tool for control. Lisa is forced toward divorce and share-transfer papers under pressure tied to an ailing patriarch and threats involving her child, showing how wealth and custody are used as weapons. Ran’s wedding is repeatedly destabilized, first by a substitute-marriage pact with John and later by challenges from the original groom and from relatives who want to turn the union into a bargaining chip. John often appears as both protector and claimant, defending Ran publicly while also trying to manage the scandal and the unstable legal status of their marriage. Other women face similar humiliation and pressure, including Jenny being ordered to produce a marriage certificate and another bride enduring objections about her past before the couple proceeds with vows. Marriage is also used strategically, as Kai and Ann enter a marriage-of-convenience contract tied to shares, revenge, and a powerful adversary. Across these conflicts, certificates, vows, gifts, and public announcements become proof of status and instruments of coercion. The family battles spill into corporate warfare, where rival companies, hidden transfers, and contested leadership reshape the balance of power. A patriarch’s decision to appoint a younger daughter CEO deepens sibling rivalry and triggers legal threats, slaps, and accusations of betrayal. A junior employee who claims credit for a flagship project is sidelined and resigns after alleging collusion, reinforcing the sense that merit is being crushed by factional politics. One revenge-driven figure creates a rival company under a nominal founder and begins buying assets and shares to strike back at a family empire. Public legitimacy can be manufactured as well, since a secret marriage is later explained away through a false love story and rewarded with gifts and shares. The tone darkens further when suspicion, surveillance gaps, and retaliatory threats surround a banquet crash and a possible poisoning or drugging incident. Jiya wakes drugged and disoriented, with John acting as a protective presence while also vowing revenge on whoever harmed her. Vikram confronts her, demands answers, and takes compromising photographs while she struggles to remember what happened. With no usable surveillance footage and an internal investigation underway, blame remains uncertain and retaliation threatens to escalate. By the end of the batch, the drama has widened from marital coercion into a broader atmosphere of blackmail, abduction risk, and unresolved revenge.

깊은-숲에서-나는-은은한-향기.title: 깊은 숲에서 나는 은은한 향기
깊은-숲에서-나는-은은한-향기.description:
회사 회식 자리에서 술에 취한 임서연은 실수로 상사의 방에 들어가고, 뜨거운 밤을 보내게 된다. 진수혁은 여자에게 무심하고 냉혹한 성격이며, 그와 엮인 여자는 반드시 불행해진다는 소문이 떠돈다. 안전을 걱정한 임서연은 그날 밤의 일을 비밀로 묻어두기로 결심한다.
하지만 그녀의 오래된 친구가 그녀를 사칭해 진수혁의 저택에 들어가 버린다. 그리고 두 달 후, 임서연은 임신 테스트기의 결과를 보고 가장 먼저 떠오른 생각은 ""도망쳐야 해!""였다.
그러나 그녀가 도망칠수록, 진수혁은 더욱 집요하게 그녀를 쫓아온다. 임서연에게 도망칠 길은 없다!

mohini-ka-shraapt-pyar.title: Mohini Ka Shraapit Pyar
mohini-ka-shraapt-pyar.description: She was never just a girl. He was never just a man. "Return Of The Forgotten Heart" is a supernatural saga where love, revenge, and ancient powers battle for control. What happens when the heart remembers what the mind has forgotten? Watch Now.

신의-왕이-복수를-위해-돌아온다.description: 옥 패 한 개를 둘러싼 음모 속에서, 구빈은 누명을 쓰고 감옥에 갇히고 만다. 그동안 그의 어머니마저 교묘한 계략에 희생된다. 진실을 밝히기로 결심한 구빈은 자신의 신분을 감추고, 독자적인 세력을 키우기 시작한다. 복수의 길을 걸으며 악인들을 처단하고 점점 더 강해지는 그는, 수많은 여신들의 존경과 사랑을 받게 된다. 그러나 그가 끝까지 마음에 품은 단 한 사람은, 어린 시절부터 함께한 단 하나의 사랑이었다.

chhalawaa.title: Chhalawaa
chhalawaa.description: Can an accidental touch heal old wounds or open new ones? The Silence of Touch dives into the fragile intimacy between a widowed writer and a blind therapist, unraveling a raw, forbidden bond that challenges what it means to truly feel. Watch Now.

my-handsome-bodyguard-4.title: My Handsome Bodyguard
my-handsome-bodyguard-4.description: Chu Tao, a former Dragon General turned single father and security guard, navigates secrets of the past while entering a contractual marriage with Lin Wan'er, an ambitious leader seeking vengeance.

one-night-stand-with-my-boss.title: One Night Stand With My Boss

royal-affair.title: Royal Affair
royal-affair.description: The microdrama centers on the impending arranged marriage between corporate scion Arjun and social media influencer Riya Kapoor, a union secretly orchestrated by Riya and her mother, Anita, as a strategic financial collaboration to save their bankrupt family. Arjun's protective sister, Indrani Rathore, harbors deep suspicions about Riya's true intentions, fueled by past grievances and a sense of class conflict. Indrani, also known by various aliases, orchestrates a complex plan involving surveillance to expose Riya's manipulative and gold-digging nature before the lavish "Royal Wedding." Concurrently, a mysterious "Ma'am" also plots revenge against the Kapoor family, installing surveillance to expose their "fake glory." As Indrani intensifies her efforts, she dramatically confronts Riya and her family, revealing herself as Arjun's long-lost sister, leading to a brutal public confrontation where she is accused of theft and physically assaulted by the ruthless matriarch, Sunita (Anita). Despite enduring relentless interrogation and abuse, Indrani defiantly vows revenge. Subsequently, Indrani mysteriously disappears and is later found critically injured, sparking Arjun's desperate quest for truth. His investigation quickly uncovers a web of deceit and a family cover-up orchestrated by his fiancée, Rhea (Riya/Pinky), and her associates, Anita and Rajat. Arjun learns that Rhea's manager and a mysterious man expose her secret four-year relationship and her true motive: to marry Arjun for his wealth to save her bankrupt family. The conspiracy deepens with the revelation that Indrani was mistreated when she tried to expose their scheme. Ultimately, Arjun receives Indrani's meticulously gathered evidence, including recordings that expose the Kapoor family's financial manipulation, Rhea's disdain for him, and her direct involvement in his sister's abuse. Fueled by betrayal and a vow of revenge, Arjun dramatically halts his "royal wedding" to Pinky (Riya/Rhea), publicly exposing her family's ruthless scheme to exploit his dynasty's wealth and their role in harming his sister. He orchestrates public humiliations for those involved, forcing Anita Kapoor to perform a traditional apology and confronting her scheming father, Rajat Kapoor, exposing their deceit, financial manipulation, and physical abuse towards his sister. Further revelations expose Pinky's secret lover, Karan, as the brutal attacker of Indrani, leading Arjun to vow legal action and personal retribution. Arjun systematically dismantles the reputations of those who wronged his sister, ensuring they face the grim reality of their actions before the law intervenes, seeking justice for Indrani and dismantling the Kapoor family's corrupt facade.

atomic-habit-6.title: Atomic Habit
atomic-habit-6.description: అలవాట్లు మారితే జీవితం మారుతుంది, మరి అలవాట్లను ఎలా అలవాటు చేసుకోవాలో ఆటామిక్ హ్యాబిట్స్ ద్వారా తెలుసుకోండి.

royal-betrayal.title: Royal Betrayal
royal-betrayal.description: The microdrama chronicles the tumultuous, secret-laden romance between Prince Harshvardhan, a soldier, and Dr. Anjali, a compassionate young woman. Their initial attempts to confess their hidden identities—his royal lineage and her secret pregnancy with his child—are repeatedly thwarted by duty and family crises. Anjali faces immense personal struggles, including her father's critical illness and professional exploitation, leading her to push Harshvardhan away, believing she's protecting him. Six years later, their paths dramatically intertwine on a critical mission, complicated by Harshvardhan's engagement to Dr. Mitali and his denial of knowing Anjali. The central secret of their daughter, Misha, remains hidden, causing profound misunderstandings and heartbreak, as Harshvardhan slowly begins to piece together the truth. Anjali is repeatedly thrust into perilous situations, including a kidnapping, with Harshvardhan becoming her primary protector, reigniting their complex romantic history. A ruthless antagonist, Mitali, driven by jealousy, orchestrates multiple attempts on Anjali's life and blackmails her using her ailing father's hospital care to force her to abandon Harshvardhan. Anjali's career is sabotaged by Mitali, forcing Harsh to agree to a strategic marriage to save Anjali, unaware she secretly harbors their daughter, Mishu. Amidst these challenges, Anjali secretly battles a deadly, man-made K-virus she contracted, while Harsh uncovers Mitali's family's blackmail scheme. The paternity secret surrounding Anjali's daughter, Mishu, is revealed as Mishu addresses Harsh as her father. Harshvardhan faces the grave illness of his wife, Anjali, leading to her tragic sacrifice to save him from the virus. Harshvardhan grieves and embarks on a mission against the terrorist group responsible for the virus. Later, Anjali, consumed by obsessive passion, shoots Harsh, but then, as a skilled doctor, is forced to save him. Harshvardhan's powerful family patriarch initially offers Anjali money to end their relationship, but Misha's presence ultimately heals the estrangement between Harsh and his father, leading to the patriarch's acceptance of Anjali and Harsh, culminating in a marriage proposal that solidifies their family.

lapata-vaaris.title: Lapata Vaaris
lapata-vaaris.description:
After a devastating accident, Raj Rathod — the only heir of the mighty Rathod International — is left paralyzed, his dreams shattered and his body unresponsive. While the world begins to move on, one person refuses to let go — Maya, his unwavering girlfriend. Bound by love and sheer will, she stands by his side day and night, fighting every storm with a quiet strength that even fate cannot shake.
To afford the mounting cost of Raj's treatment, Maya races across the city — running errands, knocking on every door, and pushing herself far beyond her limits. In a world that mocked her struggle, she remained unshaken. And in the end, it was her unbreakable faith that became the miracle — Raj rises again, not just to live, but to fall at her feet in love, for her honor, and for the glory of the woman who never gave up on him.

ghost-killer-vs-bloody-marry-1.title: Ghost Killer vs Bloody Marry
ghost-killer-vs-bloody-marry-1.description: The show weaves together a horror-thriller arc in which staged hauntings, viral content schemes, and institutional cover-ups steadily collapse into undeniable supernatural and human violence. Much of the story centers on schools and abandoned school spaces, where mirror rituals, Bloody Mary rumors, and ghost-hunting productions begin as performances for attention, profit, or revenge but repeatedly trigger real injury, panic, and death. Early on, students and organizers treat hauntings as material to be filmed, manipulated, or sold, while administrators and production leaders try to contain fallout or turn it into publicity. That fragile control breaks down as a student is marked after a mirror ritual and falls into a coma, a school blast forces survivors into improvised shelter, and screams and collapses interrupt attempts to frame events as harmless spectacle. Multiple crews, investigators, and explorers then enter supposedly haunted locations expecting staged scares, only to face failed communications, entrapment, physical attacks, and signs that the entity they invoked or exploited is real. Across these threads, Bloody Mary and related revenant figures emerge less as a simple legend than as a recurring force tied to mirrors, blood, revenge, and the exposure of guilt. Characters repeatedly argue over whether to fight, flee, rescue others, or hide the truth, and those choices are complicated by distrust, old grievances, and competing motives such as fame, money, and self-protection. The school principal and other authority figures try to preserve order and reputation, yet each effort to manage the narrative is undercut by fresh evidence of danger. At the same time, darker human crimes run alongside the supernatural threat: captives are restrained, humiliated, filmed, blackmailed, or assaulted, and recorded images become weapons in their own right. Several storylines emphasize people trapped behind doors, in bathrooms, or inside sealed spaces, pleading for rescue while others dismiss the danger as a prank or performance until it is too late. Survivors and uneasy allies eventually learn that the haunting may no longer be confined to a single mirror or bathroom, forcing them to search schools and corridors for missing people, exits, weapons, and proof. One crucial discovery suggests that mirror glass itself can be used against Bloody Mary, turning the symbol of the curse into a possible means of resistance. Even so, confrontations remain chaotic and brutal, with storms, metallic struggles, distorted screams, and unresolved clashes leaving survival uncertain. Parallel media and TV-channel threads reinforce the same theme: ghost content made for ratings or commercial deals invites consequences that cannot be edited away. Public narratives also keep reversing, as supposed heroes or ghost-killers are recast as frauds or suspects once officials challenge the footage and motives behind it. By the later arc, coercion and spectacle become inseparable, with victims forced into humiliating roles while rumors announce that “Lady Mary” has returned and schoolyard prank plans spiral into official scrutiny. The overall stakes are both immediate and moral: characters are trying not only to survive a spreading supernatural menace, but also to escape the lies, exploitation, and revenge cycles that helped unleash or sustain it. Taken together, the show presents a world where every attempt to fake fear for clout, profit, or control risks summoning something far more destructive than anyone can manage.

agent-ki-dulhan.title: Agent Ki Dulhan
agent-ki-dulhan.description: The series begins with Agent S infiltrating Janardhan Thakur's corporation, aiming to expose a multi-crore financial scandal, while several heiresses, including Janvi, navigate forced marriages and defy their powerful fathers. Janvi initially marries against her father's wishes, disrupting a corporate takeover, but soon finds her father, Janardhan Thakur, arrested for the scandal. She is then coerced into a contract marriage with Prithvi, a secret agent, who blackmails her using her father's safety to prevent her from exposing corporate corruption. Janvi fiercely fights for divorce and to uncover the conspiracy that framed her father, all while navigating Prithvi's controlling behavior and mysterious agenda. Later, she is blackmailed into another strategic marriage with Rishabh to save her father and company, only for Rishabh to seize control and reveal their divorce was never finalized. Amidst these deceptions, Agent S, operating under various aliases like Shaurya and Aryan, becomes deeply intertwined with Janvi, tasked with exposing an elusive target and insider trader. Their burgeoning romance is repeatedly tested by his hidden identity and dangerous missions, especially as Janvi discovers his true role as an agent investigating her father's illicit activities. Despite accusations of betrayal and a crisis of trust, their love deepens through thrilling escapes and confrontations. Shaurya works to expose a powerful criminal empire led by Vikrant Rana, eventually uncovering damning evidence against him, promising justice for Janvi's unjustly imprisoned father. However, a sudden cryptic phone call signals new, immediate danger. Janhvi is then blackmailed by Rana to retrieve a crucial drive from Shaurya, containing evidence against a corrupt Minister, to save her father's life. Shaurya makes a devastating sacrifice, transferring the drive to Janhvi and seemingly collapsing after a gunshot. Janhvi, now with the device, attempts to negotiate her father's release from Rana, who holds him captive. Shaurya dramatically returns to rescue Janhvi and her father, leading to an explosive confrontation with Rana, who reveals their marriage might be a sham. Amidst constant danger and rescues, their contractual marriage begins to transform into a genuine, affectionate bond, with Janhvi's father expressing approval. The series culminates with Shaurya retaliating against Rana, issuing a chilling threat, and asking Janhvi to trust him, as they continue their fight for justice.

truth-or-dare-3.title: Truth or Dare
truth-or-dare-3.description: The show begins as a tightly connected social circle is destabilized by ambition, romantic uncertainty, and status anxiety. Paul’s prestigious legal opportunity, which would take him away for six months, immediately strains his bond with Jimma/Gemma/Jemma and sets career ambition against emotional loyalty. Around him, Felix hesitates to act on his feelings for the same woman, and his vulnerability is repeatedly exposed in private conversations, public party games, and humiliating confrontations. Gossip about breakups, wealthy families, and reputations spreads through the group, making every romantic choice feel socially dangerous as well as personal. Early tensions sharpen when Chris publicly attacks Felix over a perceived romantic threat, while Radha tries and fails to regain control of her relationship with Paul. What first looks like messy youth drama then darkens at a birthday gathering for absent Felix, where unease, rumor, and unexplained behavior give way to the shocking revelation that Felix died by suicide in the very house where the group is assembled. From that point on, grief and suspicion fuse, and later deaths or injuries are treated not as isolated tragedies but as possible staging, retaliation, or cover-up. A mysterious postcard becomes the central object around which blame circulates, linking old grievances, family secrets, and conflicting accounts of what really happened. Truth-or-Dare, once a vehicle for flirtation and embarrassment, is transformed into a recurring mechanism of coercion, forced confession, and psychological torture. Captivity scenarios multiply as armed figures bind people, confiscate phones and keys, force accusations, and push victims toward impossible choices in the name of extracting truth. Chris, Jama, Sanjay, Jam, Luke, and others are drawn into these spirals of interrogation and survival, while trust collapses so completely that even confessions only deepen uncertainty. The postcard’s origin is repeatedly contested and partially rewritten, with references to Spain, Eleanor, and a mother suggesting buried family history without fully resolving it. Parallel to this, a broader criminal underworld emerges through Russian-roulette threats, staged deaths, metal-room imprisonments, and family-led concealment meant to protect honor. Luke becomes a key volatile figure across these crises, tied variously to escape attempts, coercion, postcard delivery, and a confession that he killed Chance. Felix’s name and household continue to carry weight even after his reported death, implying that his absence or legacy still drives fear, retaliation, and hidden agendas. Paul also descends into a more desperate state, begging Luke for drugs and later blocking a frantic woman from reaching Phoenix, who is said to be paralyzed and in a coma. Meanwhile, Justin’s willingness to use an intimate recording as blackmail to save his family company shows how thoroughly the group’s moral boundaries have eroded under pressure. By the final stretch, murder cover-ups, violent transport, and unresolved party incidents leave nearly every relationship contaminated by secrecy, leverage, or blame. The overall arc traces a fall from romantic rivalry and social gossip into a noir-like web of death, coercion, addiction, and family-protected violence, where each attempted revelation only exposes deeper damage and raises the stakes of survival.

anything-for-love.title: Bagawat: Anything For Love
anything-for-love.description: After betraying Kavya and ruining her life, Dhruv disappears from her world. In the midst of her pain, Kavya crosses paths with Om—but Om’s entry into her life also hides a secret motive. He places a condition before Kavya that she cannot refuse, no matter how hard she tries. What is Om hiding? And what deal has he forced Kavya to accept? Will Kavya be able to take revenge for Dhruv’s betrayal? To find out, keep listening to *Bagawat: Anything For Love*.

heal-yourself-with-harsharaj.description: Indha audio oda Guest Harsharaj Oru Mental health therapist. Ivaroda experience la pala makkaloda problems kaana solution ah find out panni oru better mental wellbeing ku help panni irukaaru. Indha audio moolama simple ah eppadi namakku irukkura mental problems ah solve pannalam, Happy and healthy life style ah eppadi adaiyalam, namma goals ah eppadi achieve pannalam nu ithu pola pala kelvigalukku badhil solli irukaaru. Definately idhu namma ellarukume useful ah irukum. So, Miss pannama full ah kelunga.

the-exceptionals-how-the-best-become-the.title: The Exceptionals
the-exceptionals-how-the-best-become-the.description: Banana hai Sabse alag? Aur karna hai kuch sabse best? To abhi suniye ye Audiobook " The  Exceptionals" aur kar gujariye vo kaam jis se duniya mein hoga aapka naam.

the-10-rules-of-success.title: The 10 Rules Of Success
the-10-rules-of-success.description: Jeevithathil vijayam nedanulla vazhi thirayunna ethoraalkum ithoru anivaaryamaya audio bookanu. The 10 Rules Of Success enna ee audiobook, lalithavum prayogikavumaaya 10 thathwangaliloode ningalude swapnangal saakshaathkarikkanum lakshyangal kaivarikkanum upadeshangal nalkunnu.

the-metamorphosis-2.title: The Metamorphosis
the-metamorphosis-2.description: Oru naal thideernu neenga oru Cockroach ah marittaa neenga enna pannuveenga? Appadi maaruna orutharoda kathaiyai thaan intha audiobook la neenga ketka poreenga. Vaanga Visithiramaana payanathukulla pogalaam.

detective-ragini-gangs-of-kidnapper-1-to.title: Detective Ragini : Gangs of Kidnapper
detective-ragini-gangs-of-kidnapper-1-to.description: Detective Ragini ne kiya Delhi mein chal rahe child trafficking ka bhandafod  , sarkari mahakmon ke shirsh adhikariyon ka khulasa. Jinhe bachchon ki hifazat karni thi, unhi ne banaya hawas ka shikar. Ek aur jabaanz karnama, jisne hila di bade bade logon ki kursiyan.

master-your-emotions-10.title: Master your Emotions
master-your-emotions-10.description: Entha nerathula eppadi irukkanum apdingratha naama thaan choose pannanum ! Antha visayatha Sutru Suzhalum , Mathavangalum Choose panna Koodaathu. Adhu than Gethu ! Appadi Getha Vazhanum na namma Emotions ku naama Raja Va Irukanum. Adhu eppadi nu therinjuka intha Kuku Byte ta Kelunga.

easy-money.title: Easy Money
easy-money.description: Cryptocurrency la Invest panrathu, Trading panrathu, Ithellam thaandi.. Intha Kuku Byte Ungalukku Crypto Currency Pathina completely different aana innoru view point ta kodukkum ! Cryptocurrency unmailaye Legal money system thaana ? illa adhu oru Digital Scam ma ? apdingratha neenga intha Kuku Byte ta muzhusaa ketta piragu Purinjukuveenga. Vaanga Kekkalam.

theory-of-money-and-credit.title: The Theory of Money And Credit
theory-of-money-and-credit.description: "Mises ki yeh kitaab, jismein paiso ki kahani aur unka bazaar mein asli role bataya gaya hai, ek aisi rahasyamayi yatra hai jo aapko har kadam par chaukaayegi. Kaise ek majboot arthvyavastha without inflation sambhav hai? Taiyar rahiye, kuch aisa seekhne ke liye jo aapka nazariya badal de."

how-to-save-tax-legally.title: How To Save Tax Legally?
how-to-save-tax-legally.description: Indiayil nikuthi nalkunnath nirbandhamaanenkilum, niyamaparamaayi nikuthi laabhikkunathinulla niravadhi vazhikalund. Ee audiobook ningale ath engane cheyyamennu padippikkuka mathramalla, ningalude panathinte kooduthal bhaagam ningalkk nilanirthanum saambathikkamaaya surakshithathwam kaivarikkanum sahayikkunnu.

dealing-with-rejections.title: Dealing With Rejections
dealing-with-rejections.description: Jeevithathil rejections ozhivaakanavatha bhagamanu. Jolikku vendiyulla apekshakal niraskarikkappedumbol, pranayam prakadippikkumbol niraskarikkappedumbol, nammude aashayangal niraskarikkappedumbol ellam namukk nirashayum vedhanayum anubhavappedunnu. anti-biotic-dawaiyon-ke-nuksaan.title: Anti Biotic Dawaiyon ke Nuksaan
anti-biotic-dawaiyon-ke-nuksaan.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki galat tareeke se li gayi antibiotics aapko aur bhi beemar bana sakti hain? Bharat mein badhte antimicrobial resistance se jude khataron ko samajhaate hue, yeh show aapko batayega ki aap kaise apni health ka best tareeke se dhyaan rakh sakte ho. Suniye abhi.

be-positive-think-positive-1.title: Be Positive Think Positive
be-positive-think-positive-1.description: Ellaam nanmaike apdingra positive mindset nammala failure la irunthu motivate pannum, Ilakkugala adaiya nambikkai kodukkum, Vazhkaiya Azhagaa Maathum. Intha ‘Be Positive Think Positive’ audiobook Positive mindset ta adaiyurathukaana elimaiyaana , Powerful practical vazhimuraigal la solli kodukkuthu. Vaanga Therinjukalam.

byte-mayong-the-land-of-black-magic.title: Mayong: The Land of Black Magic
byte-mayong-the-land-of-black-magic.description:
Apne kaale jaadu ke liye duniya bhar me mashhoor, Assam ka Mayong gaon, apne bheeter chupaye baitha hai bahut se kaale raaz. Khud anubhav karein is adbhut aur rahasyamayi duniya ka.

ullam-kollai-pona-tharunam.title: Ullam Kollai Pona Tharunam
ullam-kollai-pona-tharunam.description: Kallangabadamatra naayagi, eppothum thannai azhavaikkum naayagan mel kaathal kolkiraal. Itharkidaiye naayaganaik kolai seyya muyarchikkiraan arakkan oruththan. Antha arakkan yaar? Avan avargalaik kolai seyya muyalak kaaranam enna?

the-power-of-positive-attitude-1.title: The Power Of Positive Attitude
the-power-of-positive-attitude-1.description: Positive attitude irundha life la edha venum naalum saadhikkalam nu indha book oda author solraaru. 5-lessons-for-a-life-you-love.description:
|Key Learnings- Self-Care, Mindfulness & Life Audit|
Ye show aapko sikhayega chhoti-chhoti khushiyon ki value pehchan kar kaise apni zindagi ko happy aur balanced banaein. Suniye aur jaaniye, kaise apne sapno ko saakar karein bina kisi samjhauta ke.

world-war-1-1.title: World War 1
world-war-1-1.description: 1914 la oru Austrian Prince Death la arambicha oru sandai, Worldwide war ah maari ulaga naadugal ellam rendu team ah pirinju sandai senjanga. Indha sandai edhukaga nadanthuchu? Iruthi la yaar jeicha? Indha War la yaaruku laabam? Yaaruku nashtam? Kelunga “World War 1”

sentinel-island-uncontacted-island-2.title: Sentinel Island - Uncontacted Island
sentinel-island-uncontacted-island-2.description: ఇప్పటి వరకు నాగరిక ప్రపంచం తెలీని ఆటవిక మనుషున్నారా ? అవును వున్నారు. మరెక్కడో కాదు అండమాన్ నికోబార్ సమీపంలో.... సెంటినల్  ఐలాండ్. క్రూరమైన, అనాగరికమైన సెంటినల్ తెగ గురించి ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ లో మరిన్ని విషయాలు తెలుసుకుందాం.

bharat-ratna-karpoori-thakur-heroes-of-e.title: Bharat Ratna Karpoori Thakur
bharat-ratna-karpoori-thakur-heroes-of-e.description: Bharat ka wo ratna, jo emergency mein bhesh badal kar ghoomta tha.  Lekin jab wo CM bana to usne aise faisle liye jinhe lene ki himmat aaj koi neta nahi kar payega. Kabhi village school teacher rahe Karpoori Thakur ne education minister ke Bihar mein aisi kya education policy lagayi ki unke naam se ‘Karpoori Division’ famous ho gaya? Apni simplicity ke liye famous Karpoori Thakur ko kyon mila Bharat Ratna? Karpoori Thakur ki bemisal kahani, aaiye sunte hain is show mein

ahom-dynasty.title: Ahom Dynasty
ahom-dynasty.description: 13th-century nundi 19th-century varaku india loni Assam lo Ahom rajyanni palinchina Ahom rajavamsham vaari palana sthiratvam samsrutika , Ardika, abhivruddhi mariyu vaasthu shilpalu, adhunika papripalana vyavastha kalgina e rajyanni Moghla dandayatralu kuda odinchalekapoyayi. Aaru Shatabdala paatu tiruguleni rajyamga velasillina ee rajyam 19th century starting lo Barmis Dandayatralaku Odipoyi Barma Akramanalaku guraindi.

fathers-pregnancy-guide-1.title: Father's Pregnancy guide
fathers-pregnancy-guide-1.description: దాంపత్య జీవితంలో స్త్రీ పురుషులిద్దరూ సమానమైన బాధ్యత తో మెలిసినప్పుడే ఆ సంసారం సుఖమయం, ఆనందమయం అవుతుంది. తండ్రిగా  ఒక భర్త  చెయ్యాల్సిన పనులేంటో  విని తెలుసుకొని మీరు కూడా మంచి భర్తగానే కాక మంచి తండ్రిగా కూడా అవ్వండి మరి.

khoon-ka-nasha.title: Khoon ka Nasha
khoon-ka-nasha.description: Black dress pehni ladkiyon ka gayab hona police ke liye sir dard ban gya. Na mili unki laash naa mangi gayi unki families se firauti. To fir kya wajah thi unke gayab hone ki? Kya tha us kale rang me jo unke gayab hone ki wajah ban raha tha? Janne ke liye sune “KHOON KA NASHA” vartman se itihash ke panne ko chhuti ye kahani.

solve-your-modern-problem-with-vedas-1.title: Solve Your Modern Problem With Vedas (తెలుగు)
solve-your-modern-problem-with-vedas-1.description: మన సమస్యలు అన్నింటికీ వేదాల్లో సమాధానాలున్నాయా ? రండి అవేంటో తెలుసుకుందాం....

what-women-want-3.title: What Women Want
what-women-want-3.description: Janani hai ladkiyon ke dil ki baat aur unke man mein Chhupe raaz? Samjhna chahte hain Unki chahat aur zarooraton ko ? To bina der kiya sun lijiye ye kamaal ki audiobook " What Women Want".

nanda-devi-peak-and-nuclear-mystery.title: Nanda Devi Peak And Nuclear Mystery (తెలుగు)
nanda-devi-peak-and-nuclear-mystery.description: Bharathiya Himalayalalo unna oka gramam lo Nanda devi parvatha shikharam lo manchu shilala kinda oka Anu parikaram khananam cheyabadindani prajalu nammutharu. Idantha 1965 lo jarigina oka pramadam tharvatha jarigindi. Anu parikaram ippatiki churukuga undani mariyu idi desham lo vipatthunu kaligisthundani prajalu bhavisthunnaru. Itevali Chamoli varadalu ee Nuclear divice valle sambhavinchinatlu prajalu bhavisthunnaru. Asalu akkada dagi unna Mystery yento meeru kuda thelusukondi mari.

siddhartha-1.title: Siddhartha
siddhartha-1.description: Hermann Hesse Ezhuthuna Siddhartha -  Oru ulaga petra Novel. Gautama Buddhar Kaalathula Vaazhntha Siddhartha apdingra oruthan gnanam adaiyurathukkaana paathaiya thervu senju athula payanam seiya aarambikkiraan. Avan Pora paathaiyil Pala thadaigal avanukku varuthu.. adhellaam thaandi avan gnanam adainjaana apdingrathu thaan Siddhartha Noveloda Kathai. Intha ulaga pugazh petra Novelai Eliya Tamilil Kelungal ! Ungal Kuku FM il Mattume.

agni-ansh.title: Agni Ansh
agni-ansh.description: Ek bhooli bisri train, bhagte fugitives, aur ek mysterious ladki. Inki kahani hai ek adventure se bhari. Raj apne dost ke saath jail se bhaag nikla par haalat aise paida huye jahan uska samna hua apne ateet ke raaz se. Abhi sunein Agni Ansh.

how-to-raise-your-own-salary-2.title: How to Raise Your Own Salary
how-to-raise-your-own-salary-2.description: Sambalam athigama vaanganumnu namma elaarukkum aasai irukkum. But namma salary ah eppadi increase panrathu ? Athuku namma enna pannanum ? Ithelam intha audiobook la kettu therinjukonga.

the-money-book.title: The Money Book
the-money-book.description: Panathai semikka pala vazhigal irukku, aana edhu nammaloda vaazhviyalukku porundhum nu yosichu thittamidanum. Ovvuru panam saarndha thittagal pathina vilakkam, athnoda payangal enna nu indha book oda author namakka kuduthurukkaru, adhu mattum illa neriya money saving  tips indha book la ungalukku iruku so miss pannama full ah kelunga

beyond-the-life.title: Beyond The Life
beyond-the-life.description: Ek kidnapping jo badal degi Avya ki zindagi, ek raaz se bhare Chief se mohabbat, aur ek khatarnaak saazish. Kya Avya ka sach saamne aayega? janne ke liye sunein Pyar, dhokhe aur insaaf ki ye dastan.

honeymoon-killer.title: Honeymoon Killer
honeymoon-killer.description: అన్నే దేవానిని హత్య ఆరోపణలపై తన భర్త శ్రియాన్ ను దక్షిణాఫ్రికా పోలీసులు ఎందుకు అరెస్ట్ చేశారు? ప్రేమించి, పెళ్లి చేసుకుని తన డ్రీమ్ హనీమూన్ కి భార్యతో సహా వచ్చిన శ్రియాన్ మీద పోలీసులు హత్యా నేరం ఎందుకు మోపారు? శ్రీయాన్ కి ఏం జరిగింది?

2047-preview.description: 2045-il chennai, merinavil oru vedivibaththu erpadukirathu. Atharguk kaaranam enna endra visaranaiyil theeviravathigalin athirchikaramaana thittam theriyavarukirathu. Robots moolam kodiya virus kirumiyaip parappa ninaikkiraargal. Avargalin sathithittam eppadi muriyadikkappattathu?

bridges-across-humanity.title: Bharat Ki Aastha Aur Ekta
bridges-across-humanity.description: Kashi ke ghaat se shuru hokar duniya ke vividh dharmik sthalo tak, "Bharat Ki Aastha Aur Ekta" hume  batati hai ki kaise alag-alag dharm hume vishwas, prem, ekta aur manavta ka sandesh dete hai.

gantaravam.title: ఘంటారావం
gantaravam.description: వేగంగా మారుతున్న రాజకీయ పరిణామాల మధ్య 1830ల పారిస్‌ను చిత్రీకరిస్తూ, విక్టర్ హ్యూగో ఈ నవలలో ఫ్రెంచ్ సంస్కృతి మరియు సాహిత్యాన్ని గురించి చెప్పాడు. నోట్రే-డేమ్ కేథడ్రాల్ యొక్క వికృతమైన బెల్ రింగర్ క్వాసిమోడో మరియు అందమైన నర్తకి లా ఎస్మెరాల్డా పట్ల అతని ప్రేమను కథ కేంద్రీకరిస్తుంది తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "ఘంటారావం" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

prema-yudhham.title: Prema Yuddham (ప్రేమ యుధ్ధం)
prema-yudhham.description: చరిత్రలో ఎన్నో ప్రేమకథలను చూశాం... విన్నాం.. చదివాం.. అద్భుతం.. అని ఆశ్చర్యపోయాం..  మురిసిపోయాం.. మెచ్చుకున్నాం..  ప్రేమను పొగిడాం.. ప్రేమంటే.. అనే ప్రశ్నను ఎవరికి వారే సంధించుకున్నాం..  ప్రేమ ఒక మధురమైన భావోద్వేగం..  అది ఎప్పుడు, ఏ క్షణంలో, ఎవరిని చూసి పుడుతుందో ఎవ్వరూ చెప్పలేరు..  అలా జరిగిపోతుందంతే.. అని సర్దిచెప్పుకున్నాం..  రోడ్డుపై, కాలేజీల్లో, విరిసే ప్రేమ కుసుమాలెన్నో..  ఆఖరికి యుద్ధంలో విరిసిన ప్రణయ కథలెన్నో.. అవి గమ్యాన్ని చేరుతాయా? లేదా? అన్నది తరువాతి విషయం.

सफ़र--सपनो-के-सच-होने-का.title: Sapno Ko Sach Mein Badlo
सफ़र--सपनो-के-सच-होने-का.description: Yeh audiobook aapko sikhaayegi ki mehnat, lagan, aur sakaratmak soch se kaise koi bhi sapna sach ho sakta hai. Isme aap jeevan ke mahatvapurna moolyon jaise samay ki bachat, swasthya, aur achhi neend ki importance ko bhi samjhenge, jo aapke personal aur professional vikas ko boost dete hain

sampadinchakunda-dhanavanthulavvandi.title: అధిక సంపాదన లేకుండానే ధనవంతులవ్వండి
sampadinchakunda-dhanavanthulavvandi.description: Dabbu andariki avasram, ee srustilo dabbu lekunda ey pani kuda jargadhu. Aithe manam adhikanga sampadinchakundane manam danavanthulam avvachu ane vishayam meeku telusa? nijame ekkuva sampadinchakunda kuda meeru dhanavanthulu avvachu adhi elano telusukovalante meeru ee audio book vinalsindhe.!

door-asmaan-mein.title: Bhagwan, Kahan Miloge?
door-asmaan-mein.description: Kaisa ho ki aapko Ishwar se milna ho par uske raste naa pata ho? Kaisa ho ki samaaj ke bataye raste par chalkar Ishwar nahi bas afsoos mile? Milan ke saath kuch aisa hi hua. Kaun hai Milan aur uski spirituality ki yatra mein usne kya jaana? Janne ke liye suniye ye behad khaas audiobook. Ye audiobook  jeevan ke gahre arth ki ek yatra hai, jo aapki bhi kahani ho sakti hai.

breathe-believe-balance.title: Breathe Believe Balance
breathe-believe-balance.description: Ee Audiobook Mee Life ni deep ga examine cheyadamlo meeku sahayapadutundi. Human nature yokka scientific Analysis ni andistu enno chikku prashanalaku samadhanalnu andistu mee life ni ela balance chesukovalo cheptundi. Ee Audiobook self-transformation  and personal mastery develop chesukovadamlo help chestundi.

how-to-become-successful-7.title: How To Become Successful
how-to-become-successful-7.description: Jeevitham lo prathi okkaru payiki edagalani praythinisthune untaru, manchi peru techukovali ani kuda ashapaduthu vuntaru, aithe danikosam anni velala manchi nirnayalu Tesukovalsi vuntundhi, entho kashtapadithe kani manam jeevitham lo success avvalem. Aithe ee audio book meeku success avvadaniki sambandinchina aneka vishayalu teliyachesthundi. Mari inkenduku late ventane ee audio book vinandi.

10-steps-mein-bano-mentally-strong.title: 10 Steps Mein Bano Mentally Strong

9-ചിരഞ്ജീവികള്‍.description: ചിരം ജീവിക്കുന്നവനാണ് ചിരഞ്ജീവി. ചിരം എന്നാല്‍ അനശ്വരമെന്നും ഏറെക്കാലമെന്നും ഒക്കെയാണ് അര്‍ത്ഥം. ഹിന്ദു മിത്തോളജി പ്രകാരം ലോകാവസാനം വരെ, മഹാപ്രളയംവരെ ഭൂമിയില്‍ ജീവിക്കാന്‍ വിധിക്കപ്പെട്ടിട്ടുള്ളവര്‍ മാത്രമാണ് ചിരഞ്ജീവികള്‍. സാമാന്യ മനുഷ്യര്‍ക്ക് അതിന് സാധിക്കുകയില്ല. വിധി നിയോഗത്താല്‍ അസാമാന്യരും അമാനുഷ്യരുമായിത്തീര്‍ക്കുന്നവരാണ് ചിരഞ്ജീവികള്‍ ആയിമാറുന്നത്. മനുഷ്യരായി ജനിച്ച് കാലങ്ങളെ മറികടന്ന് ജീവിച്ചു കൊണ്ടിരിക്കുന്നവര്‍. വിവിധങ്ങളായ പുരാണങ്ങളില്‍ നമുക്ക് ഈ ചിരഞ്ജീവികളെ കാണാം. ചിരഞ്ജീവികളെ കുറിച്ച് അറിയാന്‍ ഒരു കൗതുകം തോന്നുന്നില്ലേ? എത്ര ചിരഞ്ജീവികളുണ്ട്? അവരാരൊക്കെയാണ്? കേള്‍ക്കാം ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്കിലൂടെ.

divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-2.title: Divorce A Billionaire To Marry Him
divorce-a-billionaire-to-marry-him-2.description: Lydia enters a cold contract marriage with CEO Alex, only to discover he is her new boss, igniting a complex dynamic. Alex, "The Shark," appoints her as his assistant, leading to forced proximity and a burgeoning romance, despite his existing marital status. A catastrophic accident leaves Alex's life in the balance, and Lydia's compassionate care forges a deep emotional connection, complicated by the revelation of his marriage. A complex web of mistaken identities unfolds as Lydia, Alex's assistant, is confused with his estranged wife, also named Lydia. Their budding romance is challenged by Alex's powerful grandfather, who opposes his divorce, and public accusations of infidelity against "Lydia," leading Alex to declare his "rushed marriage" over. Lydia faces public shaming and professional fallout from false accusations, but Alex fiercely defends her, uncovering a corporate betrayal. Their tender connection deepens, but is exposed by Mrs. Blackwell, Alex's manipulative mother. A catastrophic car crash, orchestrated by a powerful family, critically injures Alex and targets Lydia, forcing them into a dangerous quest for truth and justice. Despite his injuries, Alex, aided by Lydia, vows to uncover the conspiracy, while Lydia is targeted for poisoning by Mrs. Blackwell. Lydia's vengeful ex-lover reappears, blackmailing her and claiming Alex's wife as his own, further escalating the threats. A dangerous kidnapping attempt leaves Lydia injured, solidifying her bond with Alex and leading to a clandestine romance. However, their future is immediately threatened by Mrs. Blackwell, who demands Lydia leave her son. Ultimately, Alex discovers Lydia Bell is his estranged wife, the professional he's been interacting with, and declares his profound love, determined to win back her trust despite her skepticism. To fulfill her ailing grandfather's wish, Lydia convinces Alex to pretend they are still married, culminating in a poignant deception to secure familial approval.

my-brother-you-cant-afford-to-mess-with.title: My Brother, You Can't Afford to Mess With
my-brother-you-cant-afford-to-mess-with.description: The microdrama unfolds in a world where the sanctity of weddings is repeatedly shattered by various forms of exploitation, violence, and tyrannical control. Initially, a tech-enhanced hero, Saviour, is ambushed, while dowry demands escalate into physical assault, and wealthy heiresses face kidnapping plots. A pervasive pattern emerges as figures like Mr. Shawn systematically disrupt weddings, extorting grooms, tormenting brides, and orchestrating sadistic "wedding games." This oppressive environment sees individuals like Emily and Anjali subjected to grotesque forced ceremonies and abductions by tormentors such as Shaan and Vicky. As the narrative progresses, a powerful, multifaceted tyrant, known by various names including Mr. Hook, Mr. Hug, and Anil, asserts absolute control over communities, exploiting villagers and demanding humiliating acts of submission. The protagonist, Seon, and his wife, Emily, become central targets, enduring brutal physical and psychological abuse, often tied to past transgressions or the tyrant's demand for Emily. Seon makes desperate sacrifices to shield Emily and his community from further harm, engaging in deadly games and challenges. Concurrently, other protagonists like James embark on perilous quests, such as rescuing his abducted brother, Rivers, from a sadistic Villain and his aggressive son, leading to high-stakes urban pursuits and dangerous competitions. Another James, a CEO, uncovers and exposes a massive embezzlement scheme, demanding justice. The overarching conflict reveals a society where personal slights are met with extreme violence, and powerful patriarchs manipulate individuals and family dynamics, fueling long-standing rivalries and hinting at sinister agendas. The struggle for liberation sees moments of community uprising, like Z-Boss MP liberating a factory, but these victories are often met with renewed instability, suggesting the deep-seated nature of the tyranny and the unresolved grievances that fuel its relentless torment. The fate of many, including Beta, who is forced into humiliating roles and brutal "wedding games" by figures like Sir, remains precarious, highlighting the ongoing battle for survival and freedom.

나는-내-아내의-마음을-읽을-수-있다-1.description: ซีอีโอของบริษัทเทคโนโลยีชีวภาพ ฮยอนจินโฮ ได้รับการวินิจฉัยว่าป่วยในระยะสุดท้าย และได้ตกลงทำสัญญาแต่งงานกับคู่ปรับในมหาวิทยาลัยและรักข้างเดียวอย่างอีมินยอง การแต่งงานที่ครั้งหนึ่งเคยเย็นชากลับร้อนระอุขึ้นเมื่อจินโฮได้รับความสามารถในการอ่านใจคนอื่นหลังจากอุบัติเหตุที่เกี่ยวข้องกับชีวิตและความตาย ฉันเพิ่งรู้ว่ามินยองที่ฉันคิดว่าเป็นภรรยาที่ทุ่มเท กำลังมีความสัมพันธ์ลับๆ อยู่! การแต่งงานของพวกเขาเป็นสัญญาที่ไร้ความรักหรือเป็นแผนสมคบคิดที่วางแผนอย่างรอบคอบ? ผู้ชายที่กำลังจะตายกับภรรยาที่นอกใจของเขาจะสามารถหาความรักได้หรือไม่? ความลับจากอดีตและปัจจุบันปะทะกัน และการต่อสู้อันชาญฉลาดก็เริ่มต้นขึ้น

supreme-lord-1.title: Supreme Lord
supreme-lord-1.description: The story follows Lin Fan and Yanran through a long chain of captivity, revenge, and power struggles that keep widening beyond any single family feud. It begins with a revered Great Warrior arriving in the Dragon Empire and being courted by powerful clans, but political alliances quickly collapse when news about Yanran and an elderly woman pulls him into a personal crisis. Yanran is repeatedly seized, auctioned, and used as leverage by rival families, while Lin Fan keeps stepping in to protect her and challenge those who control her fate. The Lu family becomes a major enemy, and the conflict grows into open revenge, hostage threats, and vows to destroy entire lines of power. A secret unit called Hu-Long later appears, suggesting that the destruction of the Lin family three years earlier is part of a larger war of retribution and legitimacy. As the battle expands, Lin Fan is also drawn into interrogations, hidden identities, and clues pointing toward masterminds behind Ghost Hand and other operatives. He repeatedly shows hidden strength, whether confronting captors, outbidding rivals, or overturning humiliations that were meant to break him. Yanran remains at the center of the struggle, caught between family pressure, corporate coercion, and attempts to force her into unwanted alliances or marriages. The story also moves into hospital and loan crises, where money, status, and access to care are used as weapons against vulnerable families. Lin Fan and his allies answer these pressures with force, threats, and evidence, often exposing corruption only after enemies have already escalated the conflict. Corporate warfare becomes another front, with hostile takeovers, blacklisting, loan sabotage, and boardroom seizures reshaping who holds power. Lin Fan’s status is repeatedly denied in public, then confirmed by executives, contracts, or sudden reversals that force arrogant rivals to apologize or retreat. His hidden authority tied to Beijing and later to the Dragon Lord identity changes the balance of power and makes enemies fear him more openly. Su Yanran also emerges as a serious counterforce, using evidence and leadership to challenge takeover attempts and stabilize her company. Family pressure remains relentless, with mothers, brothers, stepmothers, and elders trying to control marriages, inheritances, and reputations for money or status. Public humiliation becomes a recurring weapon, whether through accusations of seduction, altered photos, or claims of extortion. Yet each time the protagonists are cornered, the story turns on a rescue, a revelation, or a violent reversal that restores their standing. By the end, Lin Fan’s authority is openly recognized, Yanran takes on greater control, and the final stakes shift toward retaliation, restitution, and the protection of their marriage and personal lives.

madam-wants-to-sell-fish-3.title: Madam Wants to Sell Fish
madam-wants-to-sell-fish-3.description: The story follows Sophie as she is pulled from one crisis into another, first as a poor fish seller trying to protect her paatti and keep her household afloat, and later as a worker moving through hotels, kitchens, and corporate spaces where status is constantly contested. Early on, she shelters a wounded outsider who is being hunted, and their uneasy dependence grows into a bond shaped by caregiving, secrecy, and mutual risk. Around them, debt collectors, goons, and local toughs keep tightening the pressure, making money, medicine, and even a leaking room feel like urgent threats. Sophie repeatedly refuses coercion, whether it comes as debt pressure, workplace humiliation, or men who try to control where she lives and who she stands beside. Harry remains the most persistent force around her, sometimes as a protector and sometimes as a controlling figure, but always tied to larger secrets and power struggles. Their connection is repeatedly tested by public scrutiny, rumors, and schemes that force Sophie to perform roles she does not fully accept. In the hotel and restaurant world, Sophie’s competence begins to surface through cooking, and her fish-ball recipe earns praise, promotion, and mentorship. Yet every step upward brings a new struggle over who really controls the kitchen, who gets credit, and who is allowed to stay. A contamination scandal, accusations of sabotage, and quiet suppression show that success in this world is fragile and politically dangerous. At the same time, Harry’s hidden identity and authority emerge more clearly, linking Sophie’s personal life to larger battles over inheritance, ownership, and leadership. Family conflict keeps widening the stakes, with fathers returning, debts resurfacing, and relatives arguing over duty, ambition, and survival. Ravi’s arc adds another layer of pressure, as he is torn between family loyalty, corporate ambition, and the demands placed on him by stronger forces. The household itself is never stable for long, because illness, extortion, and even demolition threats keep turning home into a battleground. Later, Sophie’s life becomes even more precarious when she learns she is pregnant, turning her relationship and future into something fragile that must be protected. That pregnancy brings celebration, but also more control, as others immediately begin planning around her body, her marriage, and her child. Across the whole arc, the central tension is Sophie’s struggle to keep her dignity while surviving systems that want to use her, manage her, or define her. The show builds its stakes through a constant collision of romance, crime, family obligation, and workplace power, with Sophie and Harry’s bond surviving only by passing through repeated danger and mistrust.

काली-विद्या-सच-या-सिर्फ-डर.title: काली विद्या: सच या सिर्फ डर?
काली-विद्या-सच-या-सिर्फ-डर.description: This show is a folk-horror and documentary-style exploration of black magic, tantra, and the fear they inspire across rural and urban India. It begins by presenting kaali vidya as a hidden practice tied to mantra, tantra, and yantra, and then follows cases where illness, misfortune, and strange events are interpreted as occult attack. In one thread, a schoolteacher named Ravinder suffers mysterious paralysis that doctors cannot explain, and his mother turns to a tantrik for help. The tantrik claims a woman’s shadow and witchcraft are controlling him, and after months of ritual remedies Ravinder recovers, leaving villagers to credit kali vidya. Another thread follows Neha as she visits Tarapith to observe Maa Tara worship, tantric practice, and night rituals, showing how devotion and fear overlap at sacred sites. The show also moves into places already marked by legend, such as Bhangarh Fort, which is framed as a cursed ruin tied to Singhia’s failed attempt to win a princess through black magic. At Bhangarh, investigators and skeptics debate whether the strange activity is paranormal or can be explained naturally, keeping the question unresolved. The arc widens further into sacrifice traditions and ritual murders linked to tantric practice, suggesting that occult belief can turn violent. It also shows that these beliefs are not confined to the past, since modern politicians and businessmen are depicted seeking occult help for advantage or protection. A viral CCTV ritual clip reinforces the idea that such practices still circulate in public view. The tone remains uncertain throughout, repeatedly asking whether these forces are real supernatural powers or human systems of belief used to explain suffering and exert influence. Later, the show turns to Mukesh Bhavan, an abandoned mansion in Hyderabad that became infamous after the Mukesh family died by suicide there in the 1980s. Locals describe ghostly sounds, strange smells, falling utensils, and even the scent of fresh rotis, while some say intruders lose their sanity. A student’s documentary attempt reportedly failed when equipment was damaged, adding to the legend. The mansion is treated as restricted by the government, but the episode still leaves open whether the place is haunted by spirits or linked to an old tantric ritual. The final stretch broadens into a set of unresolved cases, reinforcing the show’s larger pattern of investigation without certainty. Across all of it, the central stakes are emotional and social: fear, grief, belief, and the need to explain what cannot easily be explained.

married-to-the-enemy.title: Kambakht Ishq
married-to-the-enemy.description: Maya's life is shattered when Rohan and his fiancée Ritika publicly humiliate her, leading to her ostracization and disownment. Fueled by a friend's suggestion of vengeance, Maya targets Rohan's powerful and enigmatic uncle, Hardik. She boldly proposes marriage to the cynical Hardik, who, despite his initial rejection, surprisingly agrees to an immediate wedding. Their transactional marriage begins with Hardik's coldness and secrecy, as he meticulously hides his true identity and maintains emotional distance. Maya, determined to transform their distant union, navigates a new life in his luxurious home while their relationship slowly evolves from tense cohabitation to moments of playful affection and burgeoning romantic tension. Amidst this, Hardik secretly investigates Maya, and a mysterious woman, later revealed as Neha, and Misha, Hardik's pregnant daughter, appear, hinting at deeper secrets. Professionally, Maya prepares to launch her architecture firm but faces significant challenges. She is publicly humiliated and accused of plagiarism in a corporate conspiracy orchestrated by her sister Kritika and ex-boyfriend Rohan Agarwal, leading to peril from which she is rescued by a protective figure. Maya also receives funding from a powerful, anonymous investor. However, their intimate moments are violently interrupted, and Maya confronts Hardik, accusing him of corporate sabotage and stealing her designs, vowing revenge. Their relationship deteriorates amidst these accusations and Hardik's perceived coldness. The profound deception is revealed when Hardik's true identity as an imposter or powerful business heir comes to light, and he confesses their marriage was a calculated contract to escape an arranged union. Maya discovers her firm was secretly funded by this anonymous investor, who is eventually revealed to be Hardik himself. Despite the betrayal and crisis of trust, Hardik confronts Maya, transferring his possessions and declaring his overwhelming love, clarifying his past actions as a belated proposal. Stunned by the depth of his devotion, Maya reciprocates his declaration, leading to their reconciliation and a new beginning.

the-stars-know-my-heart-2.title: The Stars Know My Heart
the-stars-know-my-heart-2.description: The show is a continuous family melodrama built around wealth, coercion, and desperate medical need. At its core, a child or young woman named Sana becomes the center of repeated fights over identity, belonging, and survival. In one thread, Supriya’s urgent kidney-transplant crisis exposes a patriarchal household where mercy is rejected in favor of bloodline and control. In another, a missing daughter is searched for through a locket, a scar, a pendant, and later DNA reports that both confirm and unsettle family claims. The search for Sana is repeatedly complicated by public humiliation, accusations of theft, and relatives who use money or status to decide who deserves dignity. Medical emergencies keep colliding with family power, as doctors warn that surgery, transfusions, or organ donation cannot wait while relatives argue over consent. Several wealthy figures try to force outcomes through cash, threats, security guards, or public disgrace, turning hospitals and parties into battlegrounds. Poorer or vulnerable family members respond with pleas, resistance, and occasional violence, but they are usually overpowered. The story also widens into workplace humiliation, where cleaners and junior employees are shamed, punished, or threatened under the protection of higher-ups. These scenes reinforce the same pattern: authority is used to control bodies, silence objections, and rewrite truth. Identity becomes unstable as pendants, school photos, scars, and DNA tests compete to prove who belongs to whom. At times, a report or heirloom briefly seems to settle the question, only for another test or accusation to reopen it. The family that raised Sana and the family that may have given birth to her are both pulled into the conflict, and neither side fully trusts the other. Meanwhile, another household faces organ-trafficking pressure, with a mother trying to protect her daughter from men demanding a kidney. The stakes keep rising because every solution seems to demand sacrifice: a child’s body, a parent’s health, or a family’s honor. By the end of the batch digests, the central mysteries remain unresolved, but the emotional cost is clear. The show closes on a world where love is real but constantly weaponized, and where survival depends on resisting people who treat kinship as property.
