madam-your-ceo-husband-will-save-your-vi.description: Yansi, a pragmatic woman, enters an arranged marriage with Sam Felcher, the CEO of Brown Group, secretly seeking revenge for threats to her ancestral village. Unbeknownst to her, Sam is disguised as a lowly security guard to deter the union, creating an enemies-to-lovers dynamic built on deception. Their initial cohabitation sparks disdain, but Yansi's resilience begins to unravel Sam's elaborate ruse. As Yansi pursues her agenda against the "ruthless" CEO, she secures a job at his company, facing corporate prejudice, false accusations, and the machinations of her resentful sister, Laura, and other rivals. Sam, under various aliases, covertly uses his immense corporate power to protect Yansi, dramatically revealing his true identity during a crisis where Yansi is framed. This revelation intensifies corporate conflicts, championing Yansi's village-centric business aspirations, particularly her "flower-base project" to save her community from demolition. Yansi navigates workplace envy, manipulative plots, and escalating rivalries with figures like Niyati and Ansh. The powerful matriarch of the Brown Group, Sam's mother, orchestrates tests of Yansi's loyalty, eventually declaring her the rightful heiress, turning the tables on her tormentors. However, Yansi grapples with Sam's manipulative attempts to control the family empire and the unsettling discovery of his past betrayals, including deception about her ancestral village. Her trust is severely tested as she uncovers a history of abandonment and betrayal orchestrated by her own family. Despite these intrigues, Yansi passionately defends her sustainable vision for Greenland Village, ultimately securing its future with Sam's intervention. The show culminates in Yansi preparing to leave Sam due to his deceptions. A remorseful Sam dedicates three years to transforming her village into an exhibition site, earning back her trust. Their journey, fraught with hidden identities, corporate battles, and personal betrayals, ultimately leads to Yansi proposing marriage to Fletcher, signifying a hard-won reconciliation and a new beginning for their complex relationship and her community.

flash-marriage-the-all-purpose-dad-1.title: Flash Marriage : The All Purpose Dad
flash-marriage-the-all-purpose-dad-1.description: In a wealthy household, a patriarch pushes a five‑crore marriage deal with the Morgan family to secure political and financial advantage. His heiress openly resists being sold into that alliance, refusing the staged introductions and humiliating promises of the presented suitor. The family’s concern for reputation intensifies when a frantic pregnant stranger in labor arrives seeking refuge, forcing urgent decisions about help and discretion. The patriarch and his advisers repeatedly prioritize alliance management and cover‑ups over transparent care, even as a fevered woman shouts, "give me back my baby." A protective partner, Sayan, insists on medical attention and calls a doctor, setting up a conflict between care and concealment. Parallel to the household drama, an executive at a corporate office is ordered to rapidly produce a bride to seal a business alliance with the Morgans. The candidate presented, Rita, rejects the arrangement and collapses, derailing the business negotiation and exposing the cruelty of transactional marriage plans. A man’s impulsive proposal leads to an immediate registry marriage that is soon complicated when his hidden authority—labeled a 'Boss' identity—triggers a frantic search for a missing person. In another public shock, Sarah announces she is already married; the family head strikes her, cuts her financial access, and advisers scheme to hide her status to protect the deal. Arpita tries to manufacture proof to end an unwanted match by buying expensive rings, but her card is declined and her escape plan collapses. Class and financial pressure thread through these choices as a CEO, hamstrung by a father’s frozen accounts, scrambles to secure symbols of marriage and faces classist insults. The CEO’s violent outburst toward an employee ultimately coincides with his public identification as Mr. Morgan, revealing a concealed social standing that redraws power lines. Those revelations ripple through both household and corporate spheres, forcing previously private bargaining into public confrontation. As cover‑ups deepen and alliances teeter, the characters must weigh personal freedom against family honor and financial necessity. The stakes become clearer: marriages are not merely personal choices but instruments of power, class mobility, and protection of reputation. Rebellions, secret weddings, and urgent searches heighten risk for anyone who defies the arranged bargains, and medical crises expose the moral costs of concealment. By the close of the arc, identity revelations and public confrontations sharpen the central conflicts over marriage, power, and autonomy without easy resolution.

got-you-mr-always-right-3.title: Got You! Mr. Always Right
got-you-mr-always-right-3.description: The story follows Evelyn Grant, a successful woman trapped in a failing marriage. After ending her three-year union, she hires a handyman to pose as her boyfriend for a day, only to discover that he is a powerful CEO in disguise. This unexpected twist leads to a journey of self-discovery and genuine love.

madam-wants-to-sell-fish-2.title: Madam Wants To Sell Fish
madam-wants-to-sell-fish-2.description: The story follows Gauri through a long stretch of danger, humiliation, and reluctant support from the people around her. Early on, wounded men and fugitives repeatedly enter her orbit, and caregiving becomes the first bridge toward trust, whether she is nursing Raja after robbery and collapse or helping protect others who are being hunted. At the same time, Gauri’s home life is under constant pressure from debt, threats, and local bullies, forcing her family and allies to bargain, fight, and sacrifice what little they have. Raja gradually becomes the most important protector in her life, but his presence is unstable, sometimes tender and sometimes suspicious, and his fate is repeatedly tied to hidden enemies and secret schemes. Their bond is tested by public rumor, workplace scrutiny, and social humiliation, especially when Gauri is pushed into fake dating, public appearances, and situations where her dignity is openly attacked. The romance grows through crisis rather than comfort, with Raja stepping in to defend her reputation, ask for forgiveness on her behalf, and make increasingly bold claims in public. Gauri’s work life becomes another battlefield, moving from restaurant pressure to kitchen sabotage, where she is blamed for contaminated food, publicly shamed, and forced to prove her worth again and again. Allies such as Vikram, Chandu, Sanjay, and others help her survive, but every gain seems to trigger a new backlash from managers, rivals, or hidden manipulators. The story also widens into family mystery, with hidden heirs, parentage revelations, and old betrayals surfacing around Jaggu, Holika, and other relatives. These revelations are never just emotional; they are tied to ownership, shares, and control of businesses and property. Corporate conflict grows steadily more dangerous, with hotel deals, board pressure, sabotage, and takeover attempts turning family loyalty into a weapon. Raja is pulled into these power struggles as both heir and defender, while Gauri is repeatedly caught between his world and her own responsibilities. The ancestral home and the hotel spaces become linked symbols of survival, status, and inheritance. Even moments of celebration, such as public blessings, proposals, parties, or baby preparations, are shadowed by threats of arrest, kidnapping, or eviction. By the later stretch, the stakes are no longer only romantic or domestic but also legal and financial, with shares, contracts, and property used as leverage against the couple and their families. Gauri’s pregnancy and domestic hopes add a fragile thread of future life, but that hope is constantly threatened by the surrounding chaos. The overall arc is a slow-burn mix of rescue, shame, loyalty, and power struggle, with love emerging as something the characters must defend rather than simply feel.

내-억만장자-여자친구-1.title: เศรษฐีของฉัน แฟนสาว
내-억만장자-여자친구-1.description: The show follows a widening struggle in which corporate power, family loyalty, and public humiliation keep colliding. It begins with gangsters extorting a company and forcing executives into a violent confrontation, establishing a world where business disputes are settled through intimidation as much as contracts. Ha Su-yeon and Chairman Jin then become central to a separate conflict involving a hospital incident, a canceled supply contract, and a fight over access and compensation. As investors, villagers, and family-linked figures enter the picture, business plans become public contests of pride and influence. Jin-ung is repeatedly pushed to prove himself through funding promises and village obligations, but each attempt is met with ridicule, pressure, or outright humiliation. Rural gatherings and sponsored events expose how quickly status can be weaponized, especially when accusations, rumors, and family reputation are at stake. Several women are targeted by efforts to silence them, and the story repeatedly frames truth-telling as dangerous in a system built to protect power. At the same time, He Feifei becomes a major obstacle to corporate takeover attempts because her company holds vital technology and a controlling stake. Xu Zong and his allies escalate from negotiation to blackmail, password theft, planted operatives, and physical force, but resistance and sabotage keep disrupting their plans. The conflict spreads into hospitals, villages, boardrooms, and public stages, showing that no space is safe from coercion. Chen and other executives are pulled between corporate crises and local obligations, while arranged matches and old relationships are used as leverage. Feifei is repeatedly pressured through ex-boyfriends, ex-lovers, and hostile rivals, yet she refuses to be manipulated into surrendering her company or her dignity. As the struggle intensifies, hidden identities and family revelations reshape the balance of power, including a public reveal that overturns humiliation and exposes false authority. That revelation also deepens the emotional stakes, because status differences begin to strain a growing connection between Chen Jiawei and He Feifei. Meanwhile, hostage threats, kidnappings, and rescue attempts push the story into even darker territory, with children, fathers, and spouses used as bargaining chips. Corporate collapse, stock crashes, leaked technology, and takeover attempts make the business war feel existential rather than merely competitive. By the end, public apologies, forced deference, and strategic marriages suggest that survival often depends on submitting, bargaining, or forming uneasy alliances. Even so, the final tone remains unstable, with accountability still contested and every victory seeming temporary.

ek-anjani-shaadi.title: Ek Anjani Shaadi
ek-anjani-shaadi.description: A woman starts falling for her charming boss while adjusting to a new job, but a hidden truth complicates everything — she’s already married to a man she barely knows. Their rare encounters have left their relationship a forgotten shadow of a commitment.

mom-is-not-ugly-2.title: Mom is not Ugly
mom-is-not-ugly-2.description: The show is a family melodrama driven by sacrifice, hidden parentage, and the crushing pressure of social status. It begins with a mother laboring brutally to fund her son Keshav’s education, hoping his success will lift the family out of hardship. But the wider story quickly reveals that upward mobility comes with shame, because several families are forced to hide or deny the very mothers who sustained them. Stephen, in particular, tries to pass as someone with a cleaner background, even disguising his mother as an aunt and asking her to remain hidden to protect his standing with Lily and her relatives. That concealment spreads through the household as older women are reduced to servants, visitors, or gatecrashers, while family members police who may enter, speak, or be acknowledged. A separate thread follows Amma, George, and Julie, where a red scarf and George’s return stir up a buried past that refuses to stay buried. Across the middle of the story, a missing ring becomes a symbol of suspicion and reputation, triggering accusations, slaps, invasive searches, and threats of police action against vulnerable women. The conflict then widens into elite social events where invitations, gatekeeping, and public humiliation become weapons used to control family narratives. At one gathering, an uninvited woman is dragged out until a male voice stops the scene, while another exclusion is overturned when an invitation signed by a senior matriarch proves the household’s authority can be challenged. George increasingly emerges as a powerful force who can expose lies and shift the balance of power, especially when corporate stakes enter the conflict. He uses a birthday celebration and a major investment as leverage, turning family celebration into a battlefield over loyalty and business control. Stephen responds by trying to contain every scandal, but his efforts only deepen the humiliation around him. The story then turns more openly into a family-business thriller, with George slapping and denouncing Stephen over identity and lineage and ordering contracts and investment support withdrawn. As pressure mounts, Stephen is forced into apologies, pleas, and desperate attempts to preserve his place in the family. Meanwhile, caregiving and food become instruments of control, with suspicious soup, choking, and forced compliance exposing how unsafe the home has become. The emotional center of the show remains the older women, who insist on dignity even when they are accused of theft, denied entry, or cast out as imposters. Eventually, the truth about Stephen’s biological mother is revealed, overturning the accusations that had been used to shame her. That revelation also exposes Stephen’s cruelty and denial, and it links him to a deeper hidden history that George recognizes from the past. The exposure destroys Stephen’s marriage and brings open conflict with Lily’s side of the family, who demand he repair the dishonor or face divorce. By the end, Stephen is left in grief and self-loathing, while his mother urges him to think of his child before making a final break. The show closes on the wreckage of reputation, family loyalty, and inheritance, with every relationship strained by the cost of hiding the truth.

the-wronged-mother-4.title: The Wronged Mother
the-wronged-mother-4.description: Kaylene Larsen's dream finally came true: beautiful twins from an in vitro procedure. But when Kaylene needs home care, the nurse she hires is none other than the egg donor herself -- and the crazy woman has come to claim "her" babies.

사랑이-당신-앞에-있습니다-1.title: ความรักอยู่ ข้างหน้าคุณ
사랑이-당신-앞에-있습니다-1.description: The show follows a relentless collision of family duty, class cruelty, and hidden identity. Early on, a hospital emergency and a rare blood-type crisis expose how a powerful family treats its own as resources, with Yuna’s survival and an elder’s life tied to obedience and sacrifice. At the same time, poorer families are pushed into humiliation over unpaid wages, hospital bills, and debt, and money disputes repeatedly spill into violence and medical danger. So-young and her father are dragged through public shame, threats, and injury as they try to survive under employers who use power to silence them. A dying father later reveals to So-young that she was adopted, leaving her a jade pendant and a photo as clues to her birth family and turning her struggle into an identity mystery. Across the corporate and household worlds, Hu Xiao Ya is repeatedly framed, searched, dismissed, and accused, while her father’s worsening condition forces her into desperate searches for money and treatment. Her refusal to accept cruel bargains, including a cornea-for-surgery deal, marks her as someone who insists poor people still deserve dignity. The story then deepens into a missing-daughter investigation, with tests, rumors, and rare panda blood suggesting Hu Xiao Ya may be connected to a wealthy family. That possibility does not bring safety at first; instead, it makes her more valuable, more watched, and more vulnerable to jealousy and manipulation. Wealthy figures alternately protect and control her, using her blood, her belongings, and her possible lineage as leverage. A recurring pendant or necklace becomes a symbol of both proof and accusation, drawing suspicion whenever it appears or disappears. Meanwhile, other women in the story are also trapped in cycles of public blame, forced labor, and class contempt, showing that the same system harms many different families. The emotional center remains the same throughout: daughters trying to save fathers, fathers trying not to burden daughters, and families trying to hold together under pressure. By the later episodes, the stakes have widened from survival to truth itself, as hidden parentage, inheritance, and bodily autonomy all become battlegrounds. The batch ends with the sense that every act of protection creates a new threat, and every clue to the past may also deepen the danger in the present.

old-man-returns-3.title: Old Man Returns
old-man-returns-3.description: The story centers on a widening struggle over money, power, and public legitimacy that keeps spilling from private disputes into open conflict. It begins with Mohit refusing extortion and fighting back, which exposes a sabotage campaign tied to a larger corporate rivalry. Bohur madam is brought into that conflict and chooses retaliation over police action, pushing the situation toward street-level violence. In a separate thread, Mohor meets Rohan after he defeats a gang with unusual skill, and his secrecy makes their connection tense but intriguing. Mohor is drawn toward him even as he seems to be hiding a past affiliation older than his current life. Another crisis erupts when Tarika’s father is badly injured in a car crash, and the emergency becomes a public spectacle under cameras and phones. Around the same time, Baba is pulled into repeated confrontations over retirement, corporate involvement, and a proposed factory investment, but he resists being pushed out of his humble independence. Village development and family pride become entangled as crowdfunding, apology, and collaboration are all used as leverage. The conflict then expands into public fundraising and civic gatherings, where a man dismissed as a vendor shocks the crowd by promising a huge sum for village revitalization. His claim is mocked and challenged, but he privately reveals access to corporate money, making his legitimacy even more contested. Local powerbrokers try to shame him, demand proof, and force him off the stage, turning the meeting into a test of status and credibility. A woman repeatedly pleads for mercy as the crowd hardens against him, showing how quickly public sympathy can collapse. The tension rises further when a young woman is seized in public and accused by a wealthy patron’s son. A corporate patriarch backs the son and uses threats and influence to control the narrative, while a local defender challenges that version of events. The young woman speaks against the son, saying he tried to seduce or exploit her, and the crowd splits over what to believe. A sudden display of evidence stops the assembly in shock, but the larger struggle over truth is still unresolved. In the aftermath, another organizer claims outside money has corrupted the event and uses that accusation to target a different young woman and her father with legal threats, humiliation, and mob pressure. Across all these threads, the show builds a world where hidden money, family loyalty, and public performance decide who is believed and who is crushed.

mom-is-not-ugly-1.description: A self-sacrificing mother confronts her ungrateful son and his disdainful family, with help from the man she once saved, leading to a powerful lesson in humility and redemption.

old-man-returns-2.title: Old Man Returns
old-man-returns-2.description: The series opens with street‑level violence and an extortion ring that drags small proprietors, market vendors and civic crowds into a spiraling fight over reputation and funds. Wealthy benefactors, flashy connectors and corporate managers are pulled into a contested civic revival when rural crowdfunding efforts intersect with public spectacles and violent reprisals. Early incidents — a café brawl, a market fight and a car crash — force CEOs and entrepreneurs into hands‑on damage control, hospital visits and public apologies. Priyanka’s quiet assistance to an injured executive triggers CCTV scrutiny and a background probe that sets off corporate suspicions about loyalties and access. Simultaneously family pressure and succession battles fracture younger figures like Rohit and Rohita, with patriarchal ultimatums and arranged‑marriage pressures complicating every tactical choice. Donors and patrons turn public honors into weapons: Jonty’s onstage humiliation, contested pledges and a wealthy chair’s intervention escalate class tensions and invite outside gatekeepers like Mr. Paul. Crowdfunding allegations mutate into a criminal conspiracy — fraud, a desperate kidnapping plot, arrests, prosecutions and the later remorseful return of a conspirator named Kaiki. Behind the scenes a calculated corporate takeover is mounted: heiress Bhanumathi and her emissaries weaponize romance, blackmail and bought investors to seize Comet Technology’s assets. Abhi, Priyanka’s ex, is deployed as a lever of coercion; charm, sexual threats and an ambush in a hospital lead to Priyanka’s abduction and a high‑speed rescue chase. The takeover expands into a digital front when a planned cyber‑raid and demands for administrator credentials transform the fight into blackmail, strikes and midnight ultimatums. A decade‑spanning proprietary dossier, file X523, emerges as the contested McGuffin and the focal point of boardroom maneuvers, stolen copies and assassination plotting. Rohit and Prasanna forge secret alliances to protect X523 and the company, while investor short‑selling, market panic and explosive sieges of headquarters turn corporate warfare into street battles. Venkat resurfaces as a personal and financial antagonist, engineering investor chaos and issuing a brutal vendetta that threatens Prasanna, claims custody of Revathi, and deepens the moral stakes. Political quid pro quos, delivery‑room bargaining and hospital cliffhangers link questions of parentage and custody with corporate leverage and life‑or‑death coercion. Rohit shifts to public gambits — an open‑source broadcast and explicit threats — to deter Venkat and expose rival plots, but the reprisals include attempted assassinations and a disappearing child. Amid gunfire, bomb blasts and mob sieges many players resort to ruthless tactics—blackmail, espionage and physical violence—that force impossible choices between family safety and corporate control. The show’s arc closes ambiguously: legal verdicts and some convictions follow, Kaiki’s remorse surfaces, Priyanka stubbornly refuses buyouts and demands protection, and a wounded Rohit is hurried toward a pressured, arranged marriage by his sister Akka with the company and family future left uncertain.

Don’t blink… kyunki agla moment hi sabse bada dhamaka ho sakta hai.

the-bodyguard-of-the-female-ceo-1.title: My Handsome Bodyguard
the-bodyguard-of-the-female-ceo-1.description: The microdrama introduces Chandan, a security guard with hidden combat skills and a mysterious past, who, alongside his daughter Shona, becomes a target amidst corporate intrigue and social conflicts. He endures public humiliation and a bitter family feud with his estranged brother Ranjan, while CEO Nisha Roy proposes a strategic contract marriage. Chandan's true, powerful identity is eventually revealed, forcing him into a loveless marriage with Nisha and making him a pawn in a corporate war. He emerges as a formidable protector, defending his family and others from threats like the Black Dragon and the enigmatic Dey family. The enigmatic Miss Sen's reappearance, demanding Chandan as her bodyguard, hints at a deeper, shared past, further intertwining his personal life with dangerous corporate and criminal underworlds. As conflicts escalate, Nisha faces ruthless corporate rivals and a powerful crime boss, while Chandan's past as "Chandan Sir" and "Dragon Brother" connects him to an urban underworld and a quest for revenge. Nisha's investigation into her sister's death uncovers a deadly military conspiracy and a national security crisis involving a drone virus, which Chandan helps resolve after being falsely accused. He also pursues a deep-seated personal vendetta against a former friend. Chandan dramatically reveals himself as the ultimate power behind the formidable Dong Yu Group, protecting Nisha's company from the Dey family's hostile takeover, which includes the death of CEO Ronita. The series culminates in the exposure of the Dey family's ultimate villainy, including the brutal murder of Nisha's sister, Joyita, by Dev and the "Temple of Gods" for absolute power. Chandan is unmasked as the legendary "God Slayer" and "Dragon Commander," embarking on a brutal quest for vengeance against the tyrannical Dey family for the murder of his beloved and Nisha's suffering. Amidst national chaos, war hero General Sudip, long thought dead, dramatically reclaims his identity, challenging the corrupt establishment. Chandan shatters his seven-year secret identity, vows brutal revenge against those who attempted to assassinate him, and, as the Dragon Commander, declares an imminent, high-stakes war to utterly annihilate his foes and ensure justice for a seven-year-old injustice. The fate of corporate empires, national security, and the lives of Chandan's loved ones are at stake.

where-is-home-3.title: Where is Home
where-is-home-3.description: The story begins with a stormy emergency birth that immediately fractures a family, as a curse or threat separates a mother from her newborn daughter and sets revenge and forced separation in motion. From there, the drama repeatedly returns to vulnerable women and children being punished for secrets they did not create. Mary’s parents are falsely accused and beaten, and Mary sacrifices herself into servitude to protect them. A hidden-heir blackmail conflict follows, with a servant threatening to expose a switched-at-birth truth before the confrontation turns violent and ends in uncertainty. Across the household, accusations keep escalating into public humiliation, jail threats, and coercive searches, while Daisy and other powerful figures use status to control servants and daughters. A missing diamond ring becomes one of several tools used to justify abuse, though its later discovery weakens the accusation against the servant. The conflict spreads beyond the mansion into hotels and restaurants, where vulnerable workers are pressured, shamed, or threatened with eviction and disgrace. In parallel, a long-silent housemaid begins to remember a past assault, suggesting buried violence inside the family and prompting attempts to silence her. Medical crises deepen the stakes as injured relatives, expensive surgery, and repeated collapses keep the household in panic. Daisy is repeatedly tied to blame and intimidation, while Mary is alternately accused, detained, and later pushed into the role of avenger. A masked attack on the young master and the disappearance of CCTV evidence intensify suspicion and make truth harder to prove. As the story moves forward, coercion becomes more organized, with threats against parents, bribes, and ultimatums used to force obedience. Spiritual explanations and ritual intervention enter the conflict when a hidden presence, a coma, and an ancient curse are invoked to explain the family’s misfortune. Mary is then pressured to revive the comatose Tom and prove her loyalty or face consequences, showing how even rescue becomes another form of control. Tom eventually wakes and begins investigating the accidents, heart attacks, and missing DNA evidence that point to a deeper family secret. His search uncovers a concealed note and signs of a violent delivery-room incident, pushing the mystery back into the past. The climax of the arc is a devastating DNA revelation: Mary is declared not to be Ben’s biological child, Daisy is identified as the biological daughter, and Madam Lily admits to a decades-old baby swap. That truth threatens inheritance, loyalty, and family honor, leaving the household’s relationships shattered and the emotional fallout unresolved.

where-is-home-2.title: Where Is my Home
where-is-home-2.description: ఈ కథ పుట్టుక సమయంలో మార్పిడి చెందిన ఇద్దరు అమ్మాయిల జీవితాలను అనుసరిస్తుంది. ఆ మార్పిడి కారణంగా, ఒకరు తల్లిదండ్రుల దగ్గర నుంచి దూరమై విభిన్న జీవితం గడుపుతుండగా, మరొకరు ప్రతీకారంతో రగిలిపోతుంటారు. నిజం వెలుగులోకి వస్తుండగా, వారి జీవితాలు ప్రేమ, ప్రతీకారం, మరియు చాలా కాలంగా దాచిపెట్టిన రహస్యాలతో ముడిపడి ఉంటాయి.

bhagavad-gita-lessons-in-modern-time.title: Bhagavad Gita Lessons In Modern Time
bhagavad-gita-lessons-in-modern-time.description: Bhagavad Gita Lessons In Modern Time

전사-1.title: นักรบ
전사-1.description: ผู้ฆ่าพระเจ้า ความชั่วร้ายที่ซ่อนเร้น ครอบครัวที่ถูกปกคลุมไปด้วยความลับ ซุนเซียวเหยาคิดว่าการต่อสู้บนภูเขาคุนหลุนสิ้นสุดลงแล้ว แต่การต่อสู้ที่แท้จริงเพิ่งจะเริ่มต้นเท่านั้น ในขณะที่กำลังตามล่าเหล่าเทพเจ้าอันแหลกสลายของโลกมนุษย์ เขาพบว่าตัวเองติดอยู่ในกับดักแห่งความสงสัยและการวางแผนอันล้อมรอบแพคกาผู้มีอิทธิพล ซุนเสี่ยวเหยา ผู้มีสร้อยข้อมือลึกลับที่เก็บกุญแจไว้ จะต้องเปิดเผยความจริงก่อนที่มันจะสายเกินไป แต่จะเกิดอะไรขึ้นถ้าคนทรยศอยู่ใกล้กว่าที่คุณคิด?

the-art-of-public-speaking-6.title: The Art of Public Speaking
the-art-of-public-speaking-6.description: Pesum kalaiya kathukka aasa padravanga ellorukkum intha Kuku Byte oru Gift. Ithula sollirukka visayangala follow seiya aarambichaale podhum neenga oru sirantha pechaalar aagirlaam ! Innaiku date ku Public speaking kathukitta internet la, Social media la nallaa speeches koduthu Panam kooda sambathika mudiyum ! innamum enna yosanai, intha Kuku Byte ta udane kelunga.

this-is-why-you-are-poor.title: This Is Why You Are Poor
this-is-why-you-are-poor.description: Ningalude Saambathika sthithi mechappeduthanum sambannathayilekulla patha kandethanum ningale sahaayikkunna oru mikacha Kuku Bytesanu 'This Is Why You Are Poor'. Ee showil sambathika karyangalil nammal sthiramayi cheyyunna thettukal choondi kanikkukayum, sambathth srishthikkunathinum athu sheriyayi samrakshikkan namme sahayikkunna sheelangalum thanthrangalum parichayapeduthukayum cheyyunnu.

dogmania-1.title: Dogmania
dogmania-1.description: Police se jaan bachaa kar bhaag rahe kuch khoonkhar criminal ek mysterious dog ki help se pahunch gaye ek secret island pe. Jahan wo fir phanse ek aur bhayanak jaal mein.  Kya tha wo jaal? Kaise wo kutta unhen us island pe le aaya? Janne ke liye sune DOGMANIA. Gurrahat maut ki.

the-art-of-war-7.title: The Art Of War
the-art-of-war-7.description: War Tactics pathi 5th century BC la Sun Tzu nu oru Chinese General eluthina book oda Tamil version idhu. War tactics ellam therinjukittu sandai seiyava poga mudiyum nu dhane ninaikureenga? Indha book la iruka strategies ah real life situations la kooda use pannalam. Epdi nu therinjuka kelunga “The Art of War”

the-science-of-getting-rich-12.title: The Science of Getting Rich
the-science-of-getting-rich-12.description: Panakkarar aaganumnu ninaikira ellorukkum oru sulabamana Ariviyal poorva vazhimuraiya solli kodukkuthu intha Kuku Byte. Ulaga mulukka Pala per intha vazhimuraigala avangaloda life la apply panni success adainjurukkaanga. Selva Sezhippu neranja rich aana vazhkaiya adaiya enna seiyanum nu therinjukalam vaanga.

hyderabad-heist.title: Museum Heist
hyderabad-heist.description: Janmashtami ki raat, Nizam Museum se hui karoron ki chori aur police ko nahi mila koi bhi suraag. Kisne aur kaise banaya ye master plan? Kya police jaan payegi unka naam? Jaan'ne ke liye suniye hamara ye show,  sirf Kuku FM par.

mastering-your-money-game.title: Mastering Your Money Game
mastering-your-money-game.description: Money ah achieve panradhu oru game dhaan. Adhukana thiran ah valarkkuradhu onnum periya vishyam illa. Correct aana vishyangala correct aana time la seyal paduthuradhum balance panradhum dhaan. Andha vagaiyla indha audio ungalukku payanulladha irukum.

yakkai-kavavum-azhanam-athu.title: Yakkai Kavavum Azhanam Athu
yakkai-kavavum-azhanam-athu.description: இறந்து பிறந்த குழந்தைய தகனம் செய்யும்போது அதுக்கு உயிர் வந்துடுச்சி. அமானுஷ்ய சக்திகளோட பிறந்த குழந்தைனால நடந்தது என்ன?

ashtavakra-gita-maha-gita-part-5.description:

varuven.description: ”Neenga thappu senjiruntha Ashok nichchayam unga munnadi vanthu nippaaru. Appo ungalukku rendu choice thaan irukkum. Oora vittu odidunga, illanna neengale tharkolai pannittu seththudunga". Phonil vantha pathilaik kettuth thidukkittaar JP. Avar enna seithaar? Tharkolai seythukondara allathu oorai vittu odinara?

break-hai-zaroori.description: Kya aap bhi apni busy life mein ek break ki talaash mein hain lekin mil nahi paa raha hai? Hustle Culture aur Overtime Work karne se aapki Physical, Emotional, Mental aur Social Well Being par kaafi asar padta hai. Isliye suniye ye show, jo aapko batayega ki aap apni life mein regular breaks kaise plan kar sakte hain.

raasaththee.description: Rasaththiyaik kondre theeruven endru jenma jenmangalaai virattukirathu oru aavi. Antha aavi yaarudaiyathu? Jenma jenmamaai needikkum theeraatha pagaikkuk kaaranam enna? Kodooramaana aavikku raasaaththi paliyagiraalaa? kaappatrappattaala?

how-to-become-rich-5.description: Indian Vedas and Puranangal moolam ah panam sambadhikira vazhi muraigal ah namakku detailed ah explain pannirukaru author Devdutt Pattanaik. Hindu Kadavulgal pala per economics pathi enna sollirukanga nu therinjuka kelunga “How to Become Rich”

what-is-communism.description: Communism pathi therinjuka entha books laam padikanumnu yosikureengala ? Kavalaya vidunga intha audiobook ungaluku Communism pathina muzhu theliva kodukkum. Vaanga varalaatru payanathukkula pogalaam.

vasco-da-gama-a-villain-for-india.title: Vasco Da Gama - A Villain For India ?
vasco-da-gama-a-villain-for-india.description: Europe la irundha India ku sea route ah kandupidichathu yaarunu namma ellarukum theriyum. Aana ethukaga avaru India ku vandharu nu theriyuma? Avara anupi vechathu yaar theriyuma? Avar naala India naatuku evlo prachanaigal vandhuchu nu theriyuma? Indha kelvigal ku badhil therinjuka kelunga “Vasco da Gama - A Villain for India?”

azamgarh.description: Kahani ek aise shakhs ki, jo Azamgarh mein ek sadharan jeevan jeete jeete, jurm ki duniya ka betaj badshah ban gaya. Pyar, dhokha, aur bhavnaon ki aandhi mein, kaise badalte hai kismat ke khel. Suniye 'Azamgarh', ek aisi kahani jismein pyar aur apradh ka mel hai, jo aapko bandhe rakhegi ant tak.

tiny-tech-the-marvels-of-nanotechnology.description: Nano technology Vivasayathula aarambichi Vinveli varaikum poyaachu. Ini vara koodiya kaalakattathula, makkaloda vaazhviyalukku eppadi ellam udhavi ah irukka pogudhu, enna maari munnetrangala kondu vara poguthu nu indha audio la therinjikonga.

bhetala-prashnalu.title: బేతాళ ప్రశ్నలు
bhetala-prashnalu.description: చార్టర్డ్‌ ఎకౌంటెంటుగా, ఎన్నో ఇంటర్య్వూ బోర్డుల్లో మెంబరుగా ఉన్న అనుభవంతో, ఏ ప్రశ్నలకు ఎలా సమాధానాలు చెప్పి ఉద్యోగం సంపాదించాలో వివరిస్తూ, యువకుల్లో లేటరల్‌ ధింకింగ్‌ని పెంచటానికి చక్కటి లెక్కల రూపంలో శ్రీ యండమూరి వీరేంద్రనాథ్‌ తయారు చేసిన అంతరంగ వికాస పుస్తకం ఈ బేతాళ ప్రశ్నలు. సాయంత్రం పూట కుటుంబమంతా సరదాగా కలిసి కూర్చుని ఆడుకోవడానికి ఎన్నో ఇంటెలిజెంట్‌+ఫన్నీ పజల్స్‌తో మొదడుకి వ్యాయామం నేర్పే ఇటువంటి పుస్తకం ఇంతవరకూ తెలుగులో రాలేదని చెప్పటానికి ఏ సందేహమూ లేదు.

the-witness-of-mahabharata-barbarik-1-to.description: Shri Krishna ke Mahabharat yuddh jeet lene ke sawal par jab veeron ne apni-apni jeet ki samay seema batayi to ek anjaan awaaz ne sabko chauka kar rakh diya . Janiye Barbarik ka wo rahasya , jo ek pal mein  Mahabharat yudh ka ant kar sakta tha par kyon aisa ho na saka ?

the-science-of-getting-rich-11.title: The Science of Getting Rich
the-science-of-getting-rich-11.description: Panakkarana aaganum nra vazhimurai ku pinnadi oru science irukku nu indha book oda author solraaru. Panam sambathikkanum nra yenna irundha mattum pothadhu, adhai seyal paduthi adaiya sila yukthigala therinjikkanum. Adhukkana guide dhaan indha book.

art-of-self-discipline.title: Art of Being a Millionaire
art-of-self-discipline.description: Income, Lifestyle aur Wealth ko aap ek saath apni life mein aage badha sakte hain aur ameer ban sakte hain. Ye show batayega aapko aise life hacks, jo bade bade businessmen se le kar investors tak, apni routine life mein istemaal karte hain. Suniye aur badhaaiye ek kadam Rich Mindset ki taraf.

അനിമല്‍-ഫാം.title: ആനിമല്‍ ഫാം
അനിമല്‍-ഫാം.description: വിഖ്യാത എഴുത്തുകാരന്‍ ജോര്‍ജ് ഓര്‍വെല്ലിന്റെ ആനിമല്‍ ഫാം ലോകത്ത് ലക്ഷക്കിന് ആളുകളെ ചിരിപ്പിക്കുകയും, ചിന്തിപ്പിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന അനശ്വര സൃഷ്ടിയാണ്. ഒരു ഫാമില്‍ മനുഷ്യരുടെ ചൂഷണത്തില്‍ നിന്നു മോചിതരാകുവാനും സ്വതന്ത്രരാജ്യം കെട്ടിപടുക്കുവാനും മൃഗങ്ങള്‍ സ്വപ്നം കാണുന്നു. സമൂഹത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും, അധികാരത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും, വിപ്ലവത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും ഈ നോവല്‍ ഉള്‍ക്കാഴ്ചകള്‍ നല്‍കുന്നു. ഫാന്റസിയും രാഷ്ട്രീയ - സാമൂഹ്യ ആക്ഷേപ ഹാസ്യവും ഇടകലര്‍ന്നിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ രചനയ്ക്ക് സമാനതകളില്ല. കേള്‍ക്കാം ഈ ക്ലാസിക് Kuku FMലൂടെ.

the-essence-of-kamasutra.title: The Essence Of Kamasutra
the-essence-of-kamasutra.description: Kamasutram sthreekalum purushanmarum orupole vayikkenda pusthakam aanu. Mrudula vikaramayanu Rishi Valsyayanan ee grandhathil laingeekathaye adayalappeduthunnath. Pathinja ridhathil thudangi athu uchasthayiyil ethunnu. Sringara rasathinte kavyathmaka bhangi laingeekathayk undennu samarthikkappedunnu. Kamasutrathinte satha chorathe churukki avatharippikkukayanu ee Kuku Bytesilude.

perfect-family-man.title: 9 Values Of A Perfect Family Man
perfect-family-man.description: Kya aapki family life uljhi hui hai? Agar han. Toh phir aap ek perfect family man nahi hain. Lekin is show ko sunkar ban zaroor sakte hain. Kyunki isme 50 saal ke family life experience se ye bataya gaya hai ki, Humein kya karna chahiye aur kya nahi.

emotional-intelligence-12.title: Emotional Intelligence
emotional-intelligence-12.description: Nammude Jeevithathil nammal edukkunna ella pradhanapetta theerumanangalilum nammude emotionsinu valiyoru sthanam und. Ee Lokathe manasilaakanum pradhanappetta pala theerumanangal edukkunnathinum namme nammude emotions sahayikkunnu. Emotions ningalude jeevithathil cheluthunna swadheenathekkurich Daniel Goleman ezhuthiya 'Emotional Intelligence' enna pusthakathinte samgraham aanu naam ee Kuku Bytesilude kelkkan pokunnath.

how-upi-works.title: How UPI Works?
how-upi-works.description: Nammalil aaranu ippol kayyil orupad panam kondu nadakkarullath. Ikkalath kooduthal aalukalum UPI Paymentukal thanneyanu nadatharullath. Oru Kadayil poyi shop cheyyumbol, vandikk petrol adikkumbol, allenkil suhruthinu panam kodukkumbol ellam UPI enna Technology thanneyanu sahayathinu ethunnath. Ennal bhooribhagathinum UPI ennathinte full form polum ariyilla. Ee Kuku FM Bytesilude naam kelkkan pokunnath UPIyude ariyalokathe kurichaanu.

kya-sikhate-hain-jagatguru-rambhadrachar.title: Kya Sikhate Hain Jagatguru Rambhadracharya
kya-sikhate-hain-jagatguru-rambhadrachar.description:

Jagatguru Rambhadracharya Ji ke jeevan se seekhiye ki kaise kisi bhi chunauti ko jeetne ke liye sirf dridh sankalp ki zarurat hoti hai. Unki kahani hai adhyatm, sanskriti aur shiksha ka anokha sangam.

ഹരിനാമ-കീര്‍ത്തനം.title: ഹരിനാമ കീര്‍ത്തനം
ഹരിനാമ-കീര്‍ത്തനം.description: എഴുത്തച്ഛന്റെ രചനയായ ഹരിനാമകീർത്തനം ഭക്തിയും ജ്ഞാനവും കലർത്തി എഴുതിയിട്ടുള്ള ഒരു കൃതിയാണ്.  ഭഗവാൻ വിഷ്ണുവിന്റെ നാമങ്ങൾ സ്തുതിക്കുന്ന ഈ കീർത്തനം  പല ക്ഷേത്രങ്ങളിലും വീടുകളിലും പതിവായി ആലപിക്കാറുണ്ട്. ഹരിനാമകീർത്തനം മലയാള അക്ഷരമാലയിലെ അക്ഷരങ്ങളുടെ ക്രമത്തിലാണ് എഴുതിയിരിക്കുന്നത്. ഓരോ ശ്ലോകവും "ഹരിനാരായണായ നമഃ" എന്ന് അവസാനിക്കുന്നു.

guruvayurappan.title: ഗുരുവായൂരപ്പന്‍: ഭക്തരുടെ അഭയം
guruvayurappan.description: എന്റെ ഗുരുവായൂരപ്പാ!..ഗുരുവായൂരപ്പനാണേ സത്യം! എന്നിങ്ങനെ ജീവിതകാലത്ത് എപ്പോഴെങ്കിലും സംസാരത്തിനിടയില്‍ പറയാത്ത വിശ്വാസികള്‍ ചുരുക്കമായിരിക്കും. ആയിരം നാമങ്ങളുള്ള ഭഗവാന്റെ, ആ ആയിരത്തില്‍പ്പെടാത്ത ഈ നാമം നമുക്ക് പക്ഷേ ചിരപരിചിതവും പ്രിയപ്പെട്ടതുമാണ്. 'ഭൂമിയിലെ വൈകുണ്ഠം' എന്ന് പ്രസിദ്ധമായ ഗുരുവായൂരിലേക്ക് ഒരു തവണയെങ്കിലും ഭഗവാനെക്കാണാനെത്താത്ത വിശ്വാസികള്‍ ഉണ്ടാവില്ല. ആ ഗുരുവായൂരിനും ഗുരുവായൂരപ്പനും പറയാന്‍ നിരവധി കഥകളുണ്ട്.

the-torture-mother.title: The Torture Mother
the-torture-mother.description: Ek narak se bhi bhayanak Torture home aur wahan ek ladki par hoti rongte khadi kar Dene wali kroorta. Aakhir Kyu ek maa ban gayi 'The Torture mother's. Kya hai Is Torture home ki poori kahani suniye sirf KUKU FM par.

ചെറിയ-ചെറിയ-ഭൂകമ്പങ്ങൾ-.title: ചെറിയ ചെറിയ ഭൂകമ്പങ്ങൾ
ചെറിയ-ചെറിയ-ഭൂകമ്പങ്ങൾ-.description:
കുഞ്ഞാത്തോലും  കരിനീലിയും കൊത്തങ്കല്ലു കളിക്കാൻ കൂടുന്ന
ജാനകിയ കൂട്ടിയുടെ മായിക ലോകം. യാഥാർത്ഥ്യവും സ്വപ്നവും തമ്മിലെ വേർതിരിവുകൾ ഭേദിക്കുന്ന എം.ടിയുടെ മറ്റൊരു മാസ്റ്റർപീസായ ജാനകിക്കുട്ടിയുടെ കഥ കേൾക്കാം..

ഓപ്പോൾ-.title: ഓപ്പോൾ
ഓപ്പോൾ-.description: മലയാള സാഹിത്യത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രഗത്ഭവും ബഹുമുഖവുമായ എഴുത്തുകാരിൽ ഒരാളായ എംടി വാസുദേവൻ നായരുടെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രശസ്തമായ കൃതികളിലൊന്നാണ് ഓപ്പോൾ. ഒരു കുട്ടിയായ അപ്പുവിന്റെയും അവന്റെ മൂത്ത സഹോദരിയെന്ന് അവൻ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്ന അവന്റെ അമ്മ മാലുവിന്റെയും ദുരന്തകഥയാണിത്. കഥ അപ്പുവിന്റെ വീക്ഷണകോണിൽ നിന്നാണ് പറയുന്നത്. മലയാളത്തിന്റെ പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട നടിയും, ശബ്ദകലാകാരിയും ആയിരുന്ന കെപിഎസി ലളിതയുടെ ശബ്ദത്തിലൂടെയാണ് അപ്പുവിന്റെ നിരപരാധിത്വവും മാലുവിന്റെ വൈകാരിക വേദനയും കേൾവിക്കാരന് പകർന്നു നൽകുന്നത് .

murder-before-shivratri.title: Mahashivratri Murders
murder-before-shivratri.description: Mahashivratri se theek pehle ho gayi shehar ke ek bade minister aur unke bete ki hatya aur ilzaam aa gaya ek bade dharmguru Maharaj Baleshwar par. Kya Baleshwar Maharaj ne sach mein ki koi hatya ya iske peeche hai koi chaal? Janne ke liye sune ye romanchak audio show.

മഞ്ഞ്‌.title: മഞ്ഞ്‌
മഞ്ഞ്‌.description: പ്രണയത്തിന്റെയും കാത്തിരിപ്പിന്റെയും സുഖവും വിഷാദവും വായനക്കാരന് പകര്‍ന്നു നല്‍കുന്ന എംടിയുടെ അതുല്യമായ കൃതിയാണ് മഞ്ഞ്. വായിക്കുന്ന ഓരോരുത്തരിലേക്കും മഞ്ഞു പെയ്തിറങ്ങുന്ന അനുഭൂതിയുണര്‍ത്താന്‍ കഴിയുന്നത് എം.ടിയുടെ മാത്രം മാന്ത്രികത. ഉള്ളിലെന്നും പ്രണയം സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നവര്‍ക്ക് ഒരു ആര്‍ദ്രമായ മഞ്ഞുതുള്ളി പോലെ നനുത്ത സ്പര്‍ശം ബാക്കിയാക്കുന്ന നോവല്‍.. മലയാളത്തിന്റെ പ്രിയപ്പെട്ട ജോൺസൺ മാസ്റ്ററുടെ സംഗീതത്തിന്റെ സ്പർശത്തോടെ.

9-principles-of-personal-finance-managem.title: 9 Principles Of Finance Management
9-principles-of-personal-finance-managem.description: Financial growth ki best advice leni hai? Agar haan, Toh iske liye Warren Buffett ke investment partner Charlie Munger se behtar aur koi nahi ho sakta. Isiliye abhi ye show suniye, Aur unke bataye hue tareekon ka istemaal kar ke, Shuru kariye apne paison ka increment.

കുട്ട്യേടത്തി.title: കുട്ട്യേടത്തി
കുട്ട്യേടത്തി.description:
ആര്‍ക്കും കുട്ട്യേടത്തിയെ ഇഷ്ടമല്ലാത്തപ്പോഴും വാസുവിന് കുട്ട്യേടത്തിയെ വലിയ ഇഷ്ടമായിരുന്നു. കുട്ട്യേടത്തിയുടെ വാലില്‍ തൂങ്ങിയേ നടക്കുകയുള്ളൂ. മാവില്‍ വലിഞ്ഞ് കയറാനും മാങ്ങ എറിഞ്ഞിടാനും പേടിയില്ലാതെ ഊരുചുറ്റാനും കുട്ട്യേടത്തിയായിരുന്നു കൂട്ട്. 
ജാന്വേടത്തിയുടെ അഭിപ്രായത്തില്‍, തൊട്ടു കണ്ണെഴുതാവുന്നത്രയും കറുപ്പുളള കുട്ട്യേടത്തി. അവരുടെ സങ്കടങ്ങള്‍ ആരുമറിഞ്ഞതോ ഗൗനിച്ചതോ ഇല്ല.. എംടിയുടെ തൂലികയില്‍ നിന്ന് വിരിഞ്ഞ് മലയാളി ഏറ്റെടുത്ത കുട്ട്യേടത്തി എന്ന കഥ കേള്‍ക്കാം മലയാളത്തിന്റെ ഇതിഹാസ നടി കെപിഎസി ലളിതയുടെ ഭാവസാന്ദ്രമായ ശബ്ദത്തില്‍ Kuku FMല്‍.

being-reshma-3.title: Being Reshma
being-reshma-3.description: Acid akramanathe athijeevich anekare prajodippikkunna jeevithathinu udamayaya Reshma Qureshiyude jeevitham aanu Being Reshma enna pusthakam. Tania Singinoppam Reshma ezhuthiya pusthakathil ee sambhavam thante jeevitham mattiyath engane ennum pinneed samooha namaykkayi iragithirichathine kurichum vivarikkukayanu Reshma. 2014il 17aam vayassil aanu Reshmayk thante bandhuvil ninnum acid akramanam undayath. Mukhavum kaikalum polliya Reshmayude oru kannu poornamayum nashtappettu. Athmahathyayude vakkath ninnum jeevithathilek nadannadutha Reshmayude jeevitha kadha ellavarkkum prajodanam nalkunnathaanu.

political-panchayat-2024-mein-kaun-phase.title: Political Panchayat: 2024 Mein Kaun Phasega?
political-panchayat-2024-mein-kaun-phase.description: Kuku FM presents Political Panchayat show mein janiye ki kaise jis Desh mein har vote ki apni ek awaaz hai, waha hum pata lagayenge ki kiske sir sajega iss baar vijay ka taaj!

chordarvaja.title: Chordarvaja
chordarvaja.description: Indulge in the sensual and tantalizing world of passionate romance and passionate relationships on Kuku FM. Our carefully curated stories of passion and desire are designed to ignite your imagination and awaken your deepest fantasies. Experience tales of love lust and everything in between told with elegance and sensuality. Listen and let your senses be overwhelmed by the art of seduction

godfather-2.title: The Godfather
godfather-2.description: മാര്‍ലന്‍ ബ്രാന്റോയും അല്‍പാച്ചീനോയും നിറഞ്ഞാടിയ ക്രൈം ഡ്രാമകളുടെ ബൈബിൾ ആയ സിനിമ. ലോകത്ത് ഏറ്റവും കൂടുതൽ ഭാഷകളിൽ പുനരവതരിപ്പിക്കപ്പെട്ട ചിത്രവും ഗോഡ്ഫാദർ തന്നെ . ഇതിഹാസസമാനമായ ആ സിനിമയുടെ മൂലകഥ  Kuku FM നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് മുന്നിലെത്തിക്കുമ്പോള്‍ കേട്ടില്ലെങ്കില്‍ നഷ്ടം നിങ്ങള്‍ക്കാണ്!

the-game-of-life-and-how-to-play-it-4.title: The Game Of Life And How To Play It
the-game-of-life-and-how-to-play-it-4.description:
|Key Learnings- Resilience, Persistence & Improvement|
Janiye kaise iss show mein batayi gayi strategies apnake aap bhi apni zindagi ke game mein har baar jeet sakte hain, har challenge ko ek nayi opportunity mein badal sakte hain. To kya aap taiyar hain apne sapno ko jeet ka roop dene ke liye?


Link- kukufm.com/show/the-power-of-concentration-1/?utm_source=upsell

mahabharatham-4.title: മഹാഭാരതം
mahabharatham-4.description: ഭാരതത്തിന്റെ ഇതിഹാസകൃതിയായ മഹാഭാരതം കുട്ടികള്‍ക്കായി അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കൃതിയാണിത്. മലയാളത്തിന്റെ പ്രിയകവി സുഗതകുമാരിയാണ്  മഹാഭാരതത്തെ സാരാംശം ഒട്ടും ചോര്‍ന്നു പോകാതെ ഈ കൃതി രചിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്.

india-gandhiku-sesham.title: ഇന്ത്യ ഗാന്ധിക്ക് ശേഷം
india-gandhiku-sesham.description: ഇന്ത്യാ ഗാന്ധിക്ക് ശേഷം, പ്രശസ്ത ചരിത്രകാരൻ രാമചന്ദ്ര ഗുഹ എഴുതിയ ഇന്ത്യാ ചരിത്രത്തിൻ്റെ രണ്ടാം ഭാഗമാണു. 1947, ആഗസ്റ്റ് 15നു ഇന്ത്യ സ്വതന്ത്രമാകുന്നത് മുതൽക്കുളള സ്വതന്ത്ര ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ചരിത്രമാണു ഇതിൽ പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്നത്. ലോകത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ജനാധിപത്യ രാഷ്ട്രത്തിൻ്റെ ചരിത്രത്തിലെ നാൾവഴികളിലൂടെ ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്കിനൊപ്പം നിങ്ങൾക്കും സഞ്ചരിക്കാം.

neera-arya-azadi-ki-keemat.title: For Freedom: Neera Arya
neera-arya-azadi-ki-keemat.description:
India ki pehli female spy jisne desh ke liye apne hi husband ka murder kar diya tha. East India Company ke officer ki wife hone ke baad bhi Neera ne kaise bachai thi Subhash Chandra Bose ki jaan? Bhagat Singh ne kya kaha tha Neera se? Aaiye sunte hain is romanchak show mein. 
(Disclaimer: Some characters have been fictionalised for dramatic effect.)

vaidyathinte-smrithi-saundaryam.title: വൈദ്യത്തിൻ്റെ സ്മൃതിസൗന്ദര്യം
vaidyathinte-smrithi-saundaryam.description: ഒരു ന്യൂറോളജിസ്റ്റിന്റെ ഹൃദയസ്പര്‍ശിയായ വൈദ്യാനുഭവങ്ങള്‍ പങ്കുവയ്ക്കുന്ന പുസ്തകമാണ് വൈദ്യത്തിന്റെ സ്മൃതിസൗന്ദര്യം. പ്രശസ്ത ന്യൂറോളജിസ്റ്റ്  ഡോ: കെ. രാജശേഖരൻ നായർ എഴുതിയ അനുഭവക്കുറിപ്പുകളാണു ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൻ്റെ ഉളളടക്കം. വൈദ്യശാസ്ത്രത്തെ മാനവികതയുടെ പ്രായോഗികമൂര്‍ത്തികരണമായി കണക്കാക്കുന്ന ഒരാളുടെ മനോവിചാരങ്ങളെ ഇതിൽ കാണാൻ കഴിയും.

the-death-of-prince-santharam.title: Dil, Dhandha aur Dhoka
the-death-of-prince-santharam.description: Kodaikanal mein mila Santharam ka shav, ek ameer vyavsayi se juda ek khooni raaz. P. Rajagopal, ek swavlambi restaurateur, jisne pyar, saazish aur hatya ki ek ghaatak kahani buni. Suniye, kaise Rajagopal ne Jeevajothi aur uske premi Santhakumar ki zindagi mein toofan la diya, aur kaise ek adalat ki kahani ban gyi headline!

katha-ithu-vare.title: Katha Ithu Vare
katha-ithu-vare.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. song-of-transformation-3.title: Song of Transformation
song-of-transformation-3.description: The show follows Shakthi, Vishakha, Aadhya, and related figures as they struggle to survive and succeed inside a ruthless entertainment world where every opportunity seems tied to control, leverage, or humiliation. Early on, Shakthi is pushed toward major performances while powerful men offer help that also functions as pressure, especially when money for her mother’s medical care becomes urgent. Her attempts to secure support are repeatedly blocked by rivals, business interests, and debt collectors, forcing her into desperate choices and public vulnerability. The story keeps widening from career conflict into family crisis, with hospital bills, ransom threats, and emergency fundraising shaping the stakes around her. At the same time, backstage jealousy and office politics introduce newcomers and rivals whose singing opportunities are judged, delayed, or denied by those already in power. Vikram stands at the center of much of this, alternately acting as mentor, gatekeeper, lover, and threat, while UV and other allies try to protect the women from violence and exploitation. As the show progresses, the industry’s cruelty becomes more explicit through coercive contracts, threats to replace voices with AI, and public humiliation designed to control reputations. Aadhya’s rise is repeatedly entangled with accusations, surveillance, and attempts to expose wrongdoing, turning her career into a battle over truth as much as talent. Vishakha’s position also collapses under scandal, with lip-sync accusations, demands to sing live, and claims that her image has been manufactured or protected by management. The conflict deepens when recordings, viral clips, and leaked videos become weapons for blackmail, revenge, and internal investigations. Romantic ties are never separate from the professional struggle, since kisses, breakups, public declarations, and contract talks all feed the same cycle of leverage and mistrust. Several characters believe hidden accidents, fabricated accounts, and even a death are tied to the same network of abuse, though the full truth remains contested. Investigations repeatedly run into missing records, scrubbed files, and people who refuse to talk, suggesting a system built to erase evidence. Even when allies organize witness searches, mass texting, or public provocations, the powerful respond with intimidation, staged apologies, and damage control. The pressure eventually spills into physical danger, including assaults, choking struggles, sabotage, and staged crashes that make exposure riskier. By the later stretch, the women are no longer only trying to win roles or songs; they are trying to survive a larger pattern of coercion that links family honor, corporate power, and personal betrayal. The ending state across the batch digests is unresolved but volatile, with revenge, blackmail, and the fight for authorship and agency still driving the story forward.

my-handsome-bodyguard.description:
చు తావో, ఒకప్పుడు గొప్ప డ్రాగన్ జనరల్‌గా పేరు పొందిన యోధుడు, ఇప్పుడు ఓ తండ్రిగా, సెక్యూరిటీ గార్డుగా సాదాసీదాగా జీవనం సాగిస్తున్నాడు. తన గడచిన రోజుల్లోని రహస్యాలు అతనిని వెంటాడుతూనే ఉంటాయి.

ఇదిలా ఉండగా, అతను లిన్ వాన్'ర్‌తో ఒక ఒప్పంద వివాహంలోకి అడుగుపెడతాడు. లిన్ వాన్'ర్ ప్రతిభావంతురాలైన నాయకురాలు, కానీ ఆమె హృదయంలో నిండినది ప్రతీకారం. తన గమ్యాన్ని చేరుకోవడానికి ఆమెకు చు తావో సహకారం అవసరం, మరికొందరిపై తన పగ తీర్చుకోవడంలో అతని అనుభవం కీలకమవుతుంది.

ఈ క్రమంలో చు తావో తన గతాన్ని ఎదుర్కొంటూ, తన కుమారుని కోసం సుస్థిరమైన జీవితం అందించేందుకు ప్రయత్నిస్తాడు. ఈ కథ లో ప్రేమ, ప్రతీకారం, మరియు కుటుంబ సంబంధాల మధ్య ఉన్న సున్నితమైన బంధాలు ఆవిష్కరించబడతాయి.

love-is-right-in-front-of-you.title: Love Is Right In Front Of You
love-is-right-in-front-of-you.description: The story follows a working-class young woman, Keerthi, whose life is repeatedly pulled into the orbit of wealthy families, medical crises, and public humiliation. Early on, the drama establishes a brutal hierarchy: Deepa is treated as expendable when she is the only rare-blood match for a wealthy grandson, and the patriarch orders the boy saved at any cost. Around the same time, Keerthi is shamed by Vikram and pressured to apologize for defending her father, but she refuses to submit. Her father later reveals that she is not his biological child and gives her a locket and money, turning her struggle for dignity into a search for identity. Across the show, money, inheritance, and family status are used as weapons, and Keerthi is repeatedly threatened with job loss, expulsion, or worse whenever she resists. The workplace is just as hostile as the home, with supervisors and powerful figures using caste insults, surveillance, and false accusations to force obedience. Keerthi is accused of theft, bribery, and disloyalty, yet the evidence against her is often uncertain or manipulated, and she is repeatedly denied the chance to explain herself. Her father remains a steady source of protection, even as his own health becomes a crisis that others exploit. Medical emergencies intensify the stakes, especially when Keerthi is pushed toward dangerous blood donation and other bodily sacrifices to save powerful men. At one point, doctors warn that she has already reached an unsafe donation limit, but family members still demand more from her. The hospital becomes a battleground where class power, secrecy, and family loyalty collide, and Keerthi’s quiet payment of bills only deepens the sense that she is carrying everyone else’s burden. A missing jade or chain locket becomes a recurring symbol of belonging, suspicion, and hidden kinship. That mystery expands into a larger identity plot when a company screening and DNA testing suggest that Keerthi may be connected to a wealthy family’s long-lost daughter. Even as some figures begin to defend her and acknowledge her past sacrifice, others continue to treat her as an outsider who must be controlled or removed. The revelation that she once donated rare blood to save Vikram creates a life debt, but it does not end the hostility around her. The show keeps returning to the same painful pattern: Keerthi is needed when others are in danger, then discarded when power reasserts itself. By the end, the search for truth about her origins, her locket, and her place in the family remains tangled with violence, inheritance, and unresolved mistrust.

dont-touch-my-daughter-2.title: Don't Touch My Daughter
dont-touch-my-daughter-2.description: The story follows Olivia, a young woman whose quiet attempt to live and work among ordinary people is repeatedly overturned by hidden lineage, elite abuse, and state power. She begins as an intern in a hotel, where class humiliation and corporate control keep her and other low-status workers sidelined. Her identity is then dragged into the open when a powerful patriarch unexpectedly claims her as his daughter, turning a workplace slight into a struggle over honor, legitimacy, and public acknowledgment. That revelation does not protect her for long, because the chairman and allied insiders try to contain the scandal through coercion, threats, and silence. Olivia is isolated, forced into a performative apology, and then sexually assaulted, with blackmail and threats against her mother used to keep her from speaking out. As pressure mounts, she becomes withdrawn and tries to resign, but the danger only deepens as anonymous threats and attempted violence continue around her. Her mother repeatedly urges caution and legal action, while Olivia is torn between endurance, escape, and protecting the people she loves. The conflict widens beyond the hotel into public ceremonies, where powerful figures try to manage titles, promotions, and family standing while suppressing the truth. Instead of disappearing, Olivia eventually storms a major ceremony and publicly accuses the powerful men and families responsible, forcing the issue into the open. Around her, commanders and patriarchs clash over justice, succession, and revenge, and the story repeatedly shifts from private abuse to open institutional confrontation. In parallel, military and court conflicts expose corruption, extrajudicial punishment, and the use of authority to crush weaker families. Several powerful households are investigated, punished, or stripped of status, but each reckoning also triggers new retaliation and factional violence. Olivia’s own safety remains tied to larger struggles over inheritance, dowry claims, and family honor, so even when she is revealed as the daughter of a commander, that status becomes another battleground rather than a simple rescue. The narrative also introduces hospital and school settings where Olivia is shamed, bullied, and threatened by privileged people who exploit institutional power. In those spaces, doctors and other protectors sometimes intervene, but the abuse keeps resurfacing through exams, expulsions, and public demands for submission. A separate emotional thread develops around Senior Shen, whose removal from his post turns his bond with Olivia into a political and personal crisis. Olivia trusts him because he helped her through earlier trauma, but her mother suspects him and even accuses him of being an enemy spy, breaking trust within the family. By the end of the batch, the show has become a broad saga of a woman fighting to survive humiliation, coercion, and betrayal while powerful families, commanders, and officials battle over truth, control, and revenge.

sage-doctor.title: Sage Doctor
sage-doctor.description: A humble security guard, Sanjay, faces a desperate struggle when his critically ill grandmother requires a costly operation. His world crumbles as his wife, Lily, betrays him with the wealthy Oscar, demanding a divorce and revealing she used his dowry money for her new lover. Humiliated and blackmailed, Sanjay's despair awakens extraordinary ancestral powers, including X-ray vision and healing, prompting him to vow retribution. He encounters Emily, an heiress whose priceless vase he accidentally breaks, but then uses his newfound abilities to help her identify valuable antiques and heal her chronic illness, sparking a reluctant romance. Revealed as a wealthy connoisseur, Sanjay (later known as Vikandar, Ryan, Riyan) enters a high-stakes antique wager with Oscar, with Emily's freedom on the line. As his grandmother and Emily's grandfather (Dada ji/Patriarch) fall critically ill, the protagonist faces further blackmail and manipulation, including from a separate antagonist also named Sanjay, who denies medical treatment and makes indecent proposals. Emily, revealed as a formidable heiress, defiantly intervenes, asserting her authority and even proposing a contract marriage to secure the protagonist's help for her ailing grandfather. The protagonist, now Ryan, exposes charlatans attempting to cure his grandfather and, despite public humiliation and financial ruin orchestrated by his ex-wife and rivals, rises as an uncredentialed expert in antiques and healing. He gains powerful allies like Mr. Morgan and Christopher, who fiercely protect him. Oscar, disowned and banished after his manipulative past and alleged poisoning attempts are exposed, vows revenge, kidnapping Ryan's friend Nancy. Ryan heroically rescues Nancy, but then faces a terrifying blackmail plot, forcing an impossible choice between his family and estranged wife. Christopher Morgan uncovers the mastermind behind the corporate extortion. Amidst these trials, Ryan and Emily's romance deepens as they work to heal her grandfather with a rare jade, only for him to suffer a sudden medical collapse. A mysterious, unlicensed healer (Ryan) emerges, causing conflict but ultimately leading to a shocking revelation: Ryan is the long-lost biological son of the Patriarch and Samely. Reunited with his biological parents, Ryan introduces his fiancée, Emily, to his newfound family, culminating in their heartwarming wedding.

dil-vs-duty.title: DIL VS DUTY
dil-vs-duty.description: A powerful CEO, Aryan Sindhitya, returns to Malhotra Industries, where new employee Garima begins her job, sparking an unsettling familiarity and tension between them. Unbeknownst to Aryan, Garima is his estranged wife, who does not recognize him and is involved with another man, possibly due to amnesia. This revelation shatters Aryan's attempts at reconciliation, leading to his escalating suspicions of infidelity and a decision to divorce her. The divorce proceedings inadvertently entangle his personal secretary, also named Garima, whose shared name fuels rumors and corporate drama. Aryan, fiercely protective of his assistant Garima, begins to develop strong feelings for her, unaware she is the very wife he is divorcing. His controlling father attempts to drive the assistant Garima away, launching a ruthless campaign of blackmail and manipulation, further complicating their dynamic. Garima faces corporate sabotage and personal turmoil, including the reappearance of her estranged husband, Neeraj, who demands a divorce. A family crisis involving Garima's critically ill uncle forces her and Neeraj (who is later revealed to be Aryan) into a temporary charade of a happily married couple. This charade further entangles their already tumultuous relationship, as an elder relative, Mama ji, senses the discord and uncovers the secret of their impending divorce. The narrative builds to a dramatic courtroom confrontation where Garima arrives for her divorce from Neeraj. Initially unaware of their marriage, Neeraj (Aryan) dramatically cancels the proceedings upon seeing her, refusing her freedom and launching an investigation into her past. The shocking truth is then revealed: Garima's powerful CEO boss, Aryan Singha, is secretly her husband, who has been orchestrating events, eliminating threats, and providing hidden protection. Garima, receiving a marriage certificate, finally discovers her employer, Aryan Singha, is her unknown spouse. A remorseful Aryan confronts Garima, confessing his regret for publicly accusing her of infidelity. He vows to love her intensely and rebuild their marriage from the heart, seeking forgiveness and a second chance. The show explores a complex web of mistaken identity, amnesia, corporate intrigue, and the profound journey of two individuals rediscovering their connection amidst external pressures and internal turmoil.

boss-ya-bhediya.title: Boss Ya Bhediya
boss-ya-bhediya.description: A sharp-witted lawyer, Gita, initially trapped by a menacing supernatural entity, escapes her abusive stepfather by adopting a new identity and moving to Mumbai. Concurrently, Randhir, a powerful Alpha heir, defies his family's demand for an arranged marriage, believing he has found his fated mate. Destiny brings Gita to Randhir's legal practice as his new assistant, leading them into a contract marriage to appease his family and provide Gita an escape from her past. Their union is complicated by Randhir's hidden supernatural world and his relentless quest for his true mate, which eventually reveals Gita as that fated individual. This development ignites a complex love triangle with Aditi, another powerful lawyer who believes she is destined for Randhir, and creates a venomous workplace rivalry for Gita. As their fake marriage progresses, genuine feelings begin to blossom, but their elaborate deception is threatened by Gita's relentless father, culminating in a shocking gunshot. The narrative intensifies as Gita, under various identities, is plunged into a web of hidden secrets and supernatural threats. She is accused and brutally interrogated as a "human wolf" by an Inventor using a mysterious device, forcing her to fight to prove her humanity amidst corporate intrigue and ancient mythology. A "human wolf" who once saved Gita declares and then cruelly rejects a fated "mate bond" with her, causing heartbreak and a determination to sever the connection. Further complicating her life, Gita reunites with police officer Kunal, sparking a forbidden romance that clashes with Randhir's revelation of a ten-year marriage contract binding Gita and his fierce vendetta against Kunal. Randhir, revealed to be a "human wolf" and a powerful Alpha, faces professional ruin and is gravely injured protecting Gita from dangerous foes. Their profound bond deepens through these trials, leading to mutual confessions of love, even as Gita uncovers the dangerous implications of his true nature. Jealous rivals, including Shweta, orchestrate deadly plots to eliminate Gita, creating dangerous three-way conflicts. The constant threats and misunderstandings test their relationship, fueled by Randhir's jealousy and Gita's secret connections. The narrative culminates in a deadly confrontation where Randhir tragically dies, a discovery made by a distraught Geeta. However, their profound love ultimately prevails over these immense challenges, leading to a joyous reconciliation and the announcement of an impending birth, cementing their enduring bond and promising a growing family.

unlock-me.title: মাই হাসব্যান্ড Locked Me
unlock-me.description: The show centers on a Bengali family whose private celebrations repeatedly collapse into betrayal, disappearance, and fights over power. It opens with Ananya and John’s seventh anniversary, but the night turns into a childbirth crisis and a shocking struggle over the Tong estate. From there, the story widens into a public scandal when a spouse goes missing during a scuba dive and is presumed dead after a press conference frames the event as an accident. Behind the public grief, lovers and relatives quietly discuss living together, binding finances, and positioning themselves around company assets. As the inheritance battle deepens, a young heiress is forced to confront a ruthless stepmother who openly admits she married for money and claims the family estate. The family’s sense of reality keeps breaking as women believed dead return to accuse husbands or relatives of locking them away and staging their deaths. These returns make every earlier loss feel suspicious rather than final. Identity becomes a major weapon in the conflict, with birthmarks, anniversary letters, and memory gaps used to challenge who is really who. One returned wife is even tested by a birthmark inspection at a coastal property, showing how far the family will go to verify or deny the truth. Another confrontation pits Rita against Sona, where a shared birthmark and a forgotten anniversary letter raise more doubts about identity and loyalty. The emotional center remains unstable because grief, greed, and romance are all tangled together. A grieving sibling and skeptical relatives argue over whether the missing and returned are victims or opportunists. The brother’s vow suggests that revenge is becoming as important as truth. Meanwhile, Maina washes ashore with no memory, only to face an unseen threat and be pushed into household labor by an older woman. Her arrival adds another layer of uncertainty, because even survival does not guarantee safety or recognition. Across the show, domestic intimacy keeps turning into corporate and psychological warfare. By the end of the batch, no disappearance feels settled, no identity feels secure, and every family bond seems vulnerable to manipulation.

mafia-se-mohabbat.title: Mafia Se Mohabbat
mafia-se-mohabbat.description: Don Kabir’s world is turned upside down after a mysterious night with Sanya leads to an unexpected pregnancy. As secrets unravel and enemies close in, love, blood ties, and betrayal collide in this gripping saga.

여성-CEO의-경호원.title: 여성 CEO의 경호원
여성-CEO의-경호원.description: The show is built around repeated clashes between the powerful and the vulnerable, where status, money, family ties, and hidden authority are constantly weaponized. One thread follows Gyeongbin, who protects ordinary people from extortion and reveals supernatural force strong enough to draw armed authorities into the conflict. Another follows a former military leader working as a security guard while secretly investigating his wife’s death, only to keep colliding with elite figures who underestimate him. Across the story, marriages and family bonds are often treated as strategy rather than romance, with proposals, conditional support, and divorce plans tied to business or protection. Public gatherings become arenas for humiliation, as children defend parents, poverty is mocked, and people are forced to kneel or apologize in front of others. Hidden power repeatedly flips the balance, especially when figures like Im Bo-gyeong reveal commanding authority and punish those who insult their family. Corporate struggles run alongside these domestic battles, with promotions, takeovers, and inheritance disputes exposing how quickly loyalty can shift when control is at stake. Several arcs center on women refusing to surrender work, children demanding a place in a family, or heirs trying to protect a company claim against stronger rivals. Violence escalates from intimidation to armed standoffs, ambushes, and revenge fights, while rescues and unexpected interventions repeatedly interrupt what looks like a decisive defeat. The show also widens into cyber and organizational crises, where a virus, a countdown to containment, and a lone hacker’s intervention threaten massive losses. In those moments, accusations of betrayal and demands for punishment show how quickly leadership turns on its own people. School and banquet scenes echo the same pattern, with elite prejudice, expulsion threats, and ceremonial authority used to shame those without status. Hidden identities matter everywhere: a promoted executive seems to carry secret power, a mysterious woman is recognized only later, and several characters are revealed to have deeper ties than they first admit. Revenge becomes a driving force whenever old deaths, missing relatives, or past betrayals resurface. By the later stretch, the conflicts expand into military conspiracies, clan warfare, and public accusations of treason, suggesting that private grudges and institutional power are part of the same system. Even apparent deaths and defeats are unstable, since survivors return, identities are exposed, and old obligations force new rescues. The final movement pushes these tensions into open war, with rulers challenged, families shattered, and commanders choosing vengeance or defense over compromise. Overall, the show’s stakes are survival, legitimacy, and the right to claim family, power, or truth in a world where every hierarchy can be overturned in an instant.

ithayaththl-ethovondru.description: Gautham’s attempt to publicly commit to Aishu collapses when his mother rejects the match and a compromising incident involving Renu turns into a scandal. The fallout grows worse after a hotel video leaks, dragging the family and company into a reputational and corporate crisis. Under pressure from his parents and the board, Gautham agrees to a six-month contract marriage with Renu as damage control. Aishu does not fully let go, and the emotional triangle remains active even as the marriage is meant to contain the scandal. The new marriage is unstable from the start, with Gautham treating Renu coldly while still maintaining secret contact with Aishu. At the same time, Gautham begins looking into Renu’s background, suggesting that her role in the scandal is more complicated than it first appeared. Rumors and accusations intensify around a party where several people claim they were drugged and framed. Renu becomes the center of mounting suspicion, especially as an unknown caller appears to be coercing her through a missing friend. The public pressure escalates into a media attack accusing Gautham of abusing Renu, forcing her into a damaging press situation. She first denies the accusation and then says their love is mutual, but the moment ends in public humiliation when Gautham strikes her. Aishu later learns that Gautham is married, confirming how far the situation has moved beyond the original engagement. Meanwhile, Renu’s health becomes a serious concern when she suffers bleeding and is hospitalized during pregnancy. Evidence later shifts the blame away from Renu, suggesting Gautham was drugged rather than acting knowingly. That revelation weakens the earlier narrative that had made Renu the obvious culprit. Even so, the danger around her does not disappear, because her hidden identity and blackmail situation remain unresolved. She is eventually revealed to be a hidden heiress, which explains why others may have been targeting her. The pregnancy is confirmed, raising the stakes for both her safety and the future of the marriage. By the end of the batch, the story has become less about a simple broken engagement and more about a tangled fight over reputation, coercion, family control, and survival.

jouno-rog-theke-banchben-kivabe.title: Jouno Rog Theke Banchben Kivabe?

maa-ganga.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki Bhagwat Puran ki ek katha ke anusar Maa Ganga Saraswati Mata ke shraap ke karan dharti par nadi ban kar aai? Lekin Maa Ganga ka shrap insano ke liye vardaan sabit ho gaya. Purano mein Maa Ganga ki kai kahaniyan hai. Sabse rochak kahaniyan, aaiye sunte hain is show mein.

நம்புங்கள்-நீங்களும்-கோடீஸ்வரர்தான்--உதய.title: நம்புங்கள் நீங்களும் கோடீஸ்வரர்தான்
நம்புங்கள்-நீங்களும்-கோடீஸ்வரர்தான்--உதய.description: உயர்ந்த எண்ணங்களை உங்களின் எண்ணங்களோடு உரசிப் பாருங்கள்; உள்வாங்கிக் கொள்ளுங்கள். அவற்றை வாழ்க்கையில் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். இவை வெற்றிக்கான நிரூபிக்கப்பட்ட வழிமுறைகள். இவற்றை உங்கள் வாழ்க்கையில் கடைப்பிடித்தால், ‘அபார வெற்றி’ கிடைப்பது உறுதி.

கனவுப்-பிரதேசங்கள்--அனுராதா-ரமணன்-.title: கனவுப் பிரதேசங்கள்
கனவுப்-பிரதேசங்கள்--அனுராதா-ரமணன்-.description: கல்லூரி காலம் நம் அனைவரின் வாழக்கையின் வசந்தகாலம்.. தங்கள் எதிர்காலத்தை பொற்காலமாக்க கல்லூரிக்கு படிக்க வரும் இளம் மாணவர்கள் தவறான பாடங்களை படிக்க நேர்ந்தால்..? நல்ல பாதைகள் பல இருக்க போதையை பாதையாக்கினால்..? அவர்களின் வாழ்க்கை என்னவாகும்? இன்றைய சில கல்லூரி அவலங்களை தோலுரிக்கும் உண்மைக்காவியமே இந்தக் கனவுப்பிரதேசங்கள். இது உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்எம். கற்பனை உலகின் கதவு.

the-russia-ukraine-conflict-1.title: The Russia Ukraine Conflict
the-russia-ukraine-conflict-1.description: Russia aur Ukraine, aakhir kyu chal rahi hai in dono Deshon ke bich Ladai? Kya hai iss war ki asli wajah? Aakhir kab khatam hongi salon se chalti aa rahi ye Ladai? Aur iska kya asar hoga India par? Janne ke liye suniye ye Audio show “The Russia Ukraine Conflict”.

the-science-of-self-discipline-the-willp.title: The Science of Self-Discipline: The Willpower, Mental Toughness, and Self-Control to Resist Temptation and Achieve Your Goals
the-science-of-self-discipline-the-willp.description: Self Discipline ba swasrinkhola ba willpower ba ichyashokti nijer modhye thakar jonno kothin jinish guli korar khomota thakar proyojon. how-to-enjoy-your-life-and-your-job-2.description: How to Enjoy Your Life and Your Job ane pusthakam Dale Carnegie garu rachincharu. Indulo aayana vyakthigatha sangatalanu , vyakthigatha sadhanalanu merugu parchadam kosam aneka suchanalu aayana icharu. Anthekakunda Manishi thana jeevitham lo santhosham ga untu thanu cheese panilo kuda ela santhosham ga undali anedani gurinchi kuda klishtamaga teliyaparicharu. Meeru kuda mee jeevithani mariyu pani ni balance chesukovali anukutunara aithe meeru ee audiobook vinalisindhe.

shree-krishna-vani-samasyaon-ka-samadhan.description: Har roz zindagi humare saamne ek naya problem rakhti hai, hume roz uss problem ka solution khojna padta hai. விடவே-விடாது-.description: பனிமலையில் விடியல் தேடி ஒரு அமானுஷ்யத் திகில் பயணம். புத்தரும் துர்க்கையும் ஏற்றிய ஒளிவிளக்கில் விடையாக கிடைத்தது, வினைகள் விடவே விடாது என்ற அரிய புதிய ஞானம். விடவே விடாது. விடாமல் கேளுங்கள் உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்எம் ல்...

தங்க-திரிசூலம்-.title: தங்க திரிசூலம்
தங்க-திரிசூலம்-.description: லட்சுமி அம்மாவின் ஒரே மகன் கஜேந்திரன். படிப்பை முடித்துவிட்டு நல்ல உத்தியோகத்திற்கு செல்லத் தொடங்கினான். அவன் அலுவலக வளாகத்தினுள் ஒரு வேப்ப மரமும் அதன் முன் திரிசூலம் ஒன்றும் அமைந்திருந்தது. அந்த திரிசூலம் எப்படியோ அவனுக்கு முடிவைத் தர முயல்கிறது. அவன் மட்டுமல்ல கஜேந்திரனின் அப்பன், பாட்டன் ஆகியோருக்கும் திரிசூலம் தான் வெவ்வேறு ரூபத்தில் வந்து முடிவைத் தந்தது. இது அவன் குடும்பத்தைப் பிடித்த சாபம். இந்தச் சாபத்தில் இருந்து கஜேந்திரன் மீண்டு வருவானா? இதற்கு விமோச்சனம் தான் என்ன?

--சந்தியா-காலத்துச்-சலனங்கள்-.title: சந்தியா காலத்து சலனங்கள்
--சந்தியா-காலத்துச்-சலனங்கள்-.description: ரகுபதி தன் 16 வயதின் வேகத்தில் செய்த தவறால் சொந்த ஊரை விட்டு ஓடுகிறான். பின், தன் முதுமையை அடைந்தவுடன் மனைவியுடன் சொந்த ஊருக்கே வருகிறான். அங்கு அவன் ஊரார்கள் யாரும் அவனை ஏற்றுக் கொள்ளவில்லை. பல வருடமாக குழந்தையின்மை காரணமாக ஒரு குழந்தையை எடுத்து வளர்க்கிறான். யார் அந்த குழந்தை? ஊரார்கள் ஏற்றுக் கொள்ளாததற்கு காரணம் என்ன? வாருங்கள் கேட்டு தெரிந்து கொள்வோம்.

புதுசாய்-போட்ட-கோலம்-.title: புதுசாய் போட்ட கோலம்
புதுசாய்-போட்ட-கோலம்-.description: நர்மதா தன் அக்கா சீதாவின் வீட்டில் தங்கி படித்து வந்தாள். அங்கு தன் அத்தானின் நடவடிக்கை சரியில்லாமல் போகவே, நர்மதா அவனின் செயல்களை ஆராய்கிறாள். நர்மதா திடுக்கிடும் அதிர்ச்சியான தகவல்களை அறிகிறாள். தன் அக்காவின் வாழ்வில் ஏற்பட இருக்கும் புயலை எப்படி அடக்கினாள்?

நான்-ராமசேஷன்-வந்திருக்கேன்-.title: நான் ராமசேஷன் வந்திருக்கேன்
நான்-ராமசேஷன்-வந்திருக்கேன்-.description: ராமசேஷன் ஒரு வயோதிகப் பிராமணர். மனைவியை இழந்தவர். ஒரே மகள் தான் அவருக்கு… அவளுக்குத் திருமணம் செய்து கொடுத்துவிட்டு அவளது அரவணைப்பில் வாழ வழியில்லாமல் தனிமையில் அவர் படும்பாடும், அதை உடைக்க அவர் மகள் செய்யும் முயற்சிகளும் தான் இக்கதை. தன் மகளுடன் சேர்ந்தாரா?

invest-according-to-your-rishi.title: Invest According To Your Rashi
invest-according-to-your-rishi.description: Agar main Aapse Puchun ki aapko apne Rashi ke hisab se kab, kitna aur kahan Invest karna chahiye to shayd aap soch mein pad jaayen, isilye apni Rashi ke Hisab se Invest Karne ke liye tayyar ho jaieye kyuki iss Audio Show "Invest According To Your Rashi" mein aapko pata chalega ki kaise Rashi influence karte hai humare investment choices ko aur kya hai stock market aur stars ke bich ka connection.

முதல்-சக்தி-.title: முதல் சக்தி
முதல்-சக்தி-.description: அஷ்டாம சித்திகளில் முதலாவது சித்தி “அணிமா” சித்தி. இறை நம்பிக்கையின்றி, எதையும் கேள்விக் கணையோடு எதிர்நோக்கும் பாண்டியன், திருப்பதிக்கு சென்ற பின் அங்குள்ள திருமலைச்சாமியின் அருளால், அவரின் வாழ்வில் பல்வேறு மாற்றங்கள், மற்றும் அதிசயங்கள் ஏற்படுகின்றன. இறுதியில், பாண்டியனின் நிலை என்ன ஆனது?

இரண்டாம்-சக்தி-.title: இரண்டாம் சக்தி
இரண்டாம்-சக்தி-.description: வெளிநாட்டிலிருந்து திரும்பும் தன் கணவன் கிரிதரை வரவேற்க விமான நிலையத்தில் காத்திருக்கிறாள், அகிலா. ஆனால், அவனுடன் டையான எனும் அமெரிக்கன் பெண்மணி ஒருத்தி வந்திருந்தாள். அவள் யார்? எதற்காக வந்திருக்கிறாள்?   அமானுஷ்யமும் ஆன்மீகமும் மெய்ஞானமும் கொண்ட த்ரில்லர் கதையை உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்எம் ல் கேளுங்கள்.

धर्मराज-युधिष्ठिर-.title: Dharm Raj : Yudhishthir
धर्मराज-युधिष्ठिर-.description: Dharmraj kehlane wale Yudhishthir ne na keval apne bhaiyon ke jeevan ki raksha ki, balki unhone Mahabharat ke yuddh mein dilai dharm ko vijay. Par wo kyon chup chap dekhte rahe Draupadi ka cheer haran? Kyon kiya unhone Dronacharya ke saath dhokha? Aur in aaropon ke baad bhi wo kyon kehlaye Dharmraj? Aaiye jaante hain is show mein

money-19.title: Money: Know More, Make More, Give More
