money-19.description: Yeppudu kuda mee sampadana prakaram mee kharchulanu plan chesukuntu undali. Financial ga strong undalante enno rakala konni tips patinchadam valla money ni save chesukovachu. Bhavishyath lo elanti samasyalu rakunda untayi. Mari aventi vatini ela patinchalo thelusukundam.

ncert-class11th-geography-part-2.title: NCERT Class 11th Geography Part 2
ncert-class11th-geography-part-2.description: Yeh Class 11th ki NCERT Geography book ki complete explanation hai. Ise sun kar aap Physiography, Climate, Natural Hazards and disasters jaise topics ko achhe se samajh jaayenge. Ismein har topic se jude examples aur important questions bhi bataye gaye hain, jo aapko exam ki taiyari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge. Agar aap UPSC ki taiyaari kar rahe hain toh yeh information aapke liye kaafi helpful rahegi.

how-to-sell-your-way-through-life-napole.title: How To Sell Your Way Through Life
how-to-sell-your-way-through-life-napole.description: How to Sell Your Way Through Life by Napoleon Hill is a timeless guide to sales and persuasion that can be applied to any industry or endeavor. Hill reveals the universal principles of selling that can help you build relationships with potential customers, close deals, and overcome objections. Whether you're a salesperson, entrepreneur, or simply want to get ahead in your career, this book will teach you how to sell yourself, your ideas, and your products or services more effectively.

kanalaadi.title: കനലാടി
kanalaadi.description: 'എഴുതാതിരിക്കാന്‍ കഴിയാത്തതിനാല്‍ മാത്രമാണ് ഞാനീ നോവല്‍ പൂര്‍ത്തിയാക്കിയത്. എഴുതി തീര്‍ന്നപ്പോഴോ എന്നില്‍ നിന്ന് എന്തോ ഒഴിഞ്ഞ് പോയത്‌പോലെ.' എന്നാണ് ഷുക്കൂര്‍ പെടയങ്ങോട് കനലാടി എന്ന തന്റെ നോവലിനെക്കുറിച്ച് പറയുന്നത്. എവിടെയും അടയാളപ്പെടുത്താതെ പോയ മനുഷ്യരെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള കഥകളും നോവലുകളും തേടിപ്പോയി ഉള്ളിലുറങ്ങിക്കിടന്ന എഴുത്തിനെ ഉണര്‍ത്തിയ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ കനലാടി എന്ന നോവല്‍ കേട്ട് തുടങ്ങാം Kuku FMലൂടെ.

class-11th-history.title: NCERT Class 11th History
class-11th-history.description: Yeh Class 11th ki NCERT History book ki complete explanation hai. Ise sun kar aap Early Societies, Empires, Changing Traditions jaise topics ko ache se samajh jaayenge. Ismein har topic se jude examples aur important questions bhi bataye gaye hain, jo aapko exam ki taiyari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge. Agar aap UPSC ki taiyaari kar rahe hain toh yeh information aapke liye kaafi helpful rahegi.

secret-murder.title: സീക്രട്ട് മര്‍ഡര്‍
secret-murder.description: ആദിമദ്യാന്തം നിഗൂഢത നിലനിര്‍ത്തി അടുത്ത നിമിഷം എന്താണ് സംഭവിക്കാന്‍ പോകുന്നതെന്ന ആകാംക്ഷ സൃഷ്ടിക്കുന്ന രചനകള്‍ ത്രില്ലര്‍ പ്രേമികളുടെ ലിസ്റ്റില്‍ എന്നും മുന്നിലാണ്. അത്തരമൊരു പുസ്തകം കേട്ട് തുടങ്ങിയാലോ. പേരു വെളിവാക്കുന്നത് പോലെ തന്നെ ഒരു ഇന്‍വെസ്റ്റിഗേറ്റീവ് ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലറാണ് ദിനോജ് സി രചിച്ച സീക്രട്ട് മര്‍ഡര്‍ എന്ന പുസ്തകം. ആര്‍ദ്ര ഐപിഎസ് എന്ന യുവ പോലീസ് ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥയുടെ അന്വേഷണാത്മക കരിയറിനെ ചുറ്റിപ്പറ്റി വികസിക്കുന്ന കഥകളാണിതില്‍. രണ്ട് കൊലപാതകങ്ങളുടെ ചുരുളഴിക്കുന്ന ത്രില്ലിങ് അനുഭവം കേട്ടറിയാം.

രാച്ചിയമ്മ.title: രാച്ചിയമ്മ
രാച്ചിയമ്മ.description: മനസ്സിന്റെ വേദനകളെ ചൂടും ചൂരും ആറാതെ പകര്‍ത്തുന്ന  കഥകള്‍.  മനുഷ്യജീവിതങ്ങളുടെ ബാഹ്യപ്രകൃതിയേക്കാളുപരി ആന്തരികവ്യാപാരങ്ങളെ ഒപ്പിയെടുത്ത രചനകള്‍. രാച്ചിയമ്മ എന്ന മലയാള സാഹിത്യ ലോകത്തെ ഏറ്റവും മിഴിവുറ്റ സ്ത്രീകഥാപാത്രം.  നഷ്ടപ്പെടലിന്റെയും ആശാഭംഗങ്ങളുടെയും നീറ്റലും, നോവും പരക്കുന്ന കഥാ പശ്ഛാത്തലങ്ങളിലും അതിജീവനത്തിന്റെ തരിവെട്ടം കെടാതെ കാക്കുന്ന ശക്തരായ കഥാപാത്രങ്ങള്‍. ഉറൂബിന്റെ  കഥാപാത്ര സൃഷ്ടിയുടെ ആഴവും പരപ്പും വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന അഞ്ച് മികച്ച കഥകള്‍.

ramayan-33.title: Ramayan
ramayan-33.description: Maa Sita aur Prabhu Shri Ram ki adbhut mahagatha hai Ramayan. Pehli baar kaise mile Sita aur Ram? Ram kyon kehlaye maryada-purushottam? Sita ko kyon deni padi agni pariksha? Hanuman hain kis dev ka avtar?  Jaane is khas peshkash mein

israel-palestine-conflict.title: Israel - Palestine Conflict
israel-palestine-conflict.description: Kaalangalayi lokam sakshyam vahikkunna bhouma rashtreeya sangharshamanu Palestinum Israelum thammil ullath. Charithraparavum Mathaparavumaaya kaaranangale thudarnnu aarambhicha ee sangharsham innu aayirangalude jeevan eduthittum theerathe rookshamayikkondirikkunnu. Loka rashtrangalude rashtreeya achuthandine thanne swadheenikkunna prashnamayi maarikazhinja ee sangharshathinte charithram, moola kaaranangal, valarcha, nilavile sthithi gathikal enniva ee showyilude kettariyam.

താവോയുടെ-പുസ്തകം-.title: താവോയുടെ പുസ്തകം
താവോയുടെ-പുസ്തകം-.description: Puraathana Chinayile vikyatha thathwachinthakan aayirunna Lao-Tsuvinte Tao Te Ching enna classic thathvachintha pusthakathinte Malayala Vivarthanamanu ' Taoyude Pusthakam' enna ee audiobook.

the-last-dream-2.title: Aakhiri Sapna
the-last-dream-2.description: Kya hoga jab aapke darawane sapne hi aapki wo sachayi ban jayenge, jisse aap humesha bhaagne ki koshish karte ho? Jiya ki kahaani bhi kuch aisi hi hai, jo har subah ek daravane sapne ke saath uthti hai aur phir din mei, usi sapne ko jeeti hai. Jiya ke is sapno ke shehar mei judne ke liye, abhi sunna shuru karein, Aakhiri Sapna urf The Last Dream.

how-to-enjoy-your-life-and-job.title: How To Enjoy Your Life and Job
how-to-enjoy-your-life-and-job.description: Prashastha American ezhuthukaranum interpersonal skilla adhyapakanumaaya Dale Carnegie rachitha pusthakamaya 'How To Enjoy Your Life and Job' ningalude jeevithathil ninnu anxiety akattanum mikacha work life balance engane nedamennu manasilakkanum lakshyamidunnu. Ee pusthakathil vivarichirikkunna karyangal pinthudarunnathiloode oru vyakthikk sampthripthavum manasilakamayi samadhanaparavumaya jeevitham nayikkan sahayikkunnu.

duryodhana.title: Duryodhana
duryodhana.description: దుర్యోధరుని జన్మ రహస్యం మీకు తెలుసా? కర్ణుడికి, ఇతనికి మధ్య స్నేహం ఎలా ఏర్పడింది? చివరకు ఇతను ఏమయ్యాడు? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో.

the-royal-scandal-2.title: The Royal Scandal
the-royal-scandal-2.description: Yeh Kahaani England Ke Angrez James Aur Hyderabad Ke Sayeeda Musalman Parivaar Ki Khair-Un-Nisa Ki Hai. Yahaa’n Ishq Ka Khumar Toh Chadhta Hai Magar Muqammal Nahi Ho Paata! Do Alag Dharmo'n Ke Premi, Dono Ki Umr Alag. Wo Jab Milte Hain, Tab Sara Zamaana Unke Khilaaf Saazishein Rachne Lagta Hai, Rajneeti Hone Lagti Hai. Wo Tootte Hain, Bikharte Hain, Lekin Phir Khade Ho Jaate Hain. Is Prem Kahani Mei'n Maut Bhi Apni Jagah Banaati Hai, Magar Kaise? Kya Ye Dono In Saazisho'n Se Bach Paayein Ya Phir Inka Pyaar Duniya Ki Rasmo-Riwaazo'n Ki Bali Chadh Gaya? Ek Aisi Mohabbat Ki Daastaan Jisne British Bharat Mei Satta Ki Gateesheelta Ko Badal Diya.

scandals-of-sukesh-chandrashekar.title: Scandals of Sukesh Chandrashekar
scandals-of-sukesh-chandrashekar.description: Pala Kodi rubaai pana mosadi, Cinema Nadigaigal udan thodarbu nu Kudiyum gummaalamumaa adambara vazhkai vazhntha Mosadi Mannan Sukesh sa pathi ungalukku theriyuma ? Solrathu ellaam Poi, Seirathu ellaam Fraud nu vaazhntha real life sathuranga vettai hero Sukesh senja Pala Kodi Rubaai mosadigal la pathiyum, atha avar eppadi senjaru apdinum intha audio series la therinjukalam Vaanga.

jallianwala-bagh-massacre-2.title: Aazadi Ka Laal Rang - Jallianwala Bagh
jallianwala-bagh-massacre-2.description: 13 April 1919 ko, "Jallianwala Bagh Hatyakand" ne humare desh ke itihaas mein gehre dard ke nishaan chhod diye. Angrezon ki goliyon ne masoom logon ki zindagi ko chheena, aur ek andhkaar mein humein chhod diya. Lekin kya un angrezon ne kabhi bhi apne zulm ke liye maafi maangi hai? Aakhir kya tha iss hatyakand ke piche ka karan, janiye iss audioshow mein

life-story-of-sane-guruji.title: Sane Guruji Jeevan Katha
life-story-of-sane-guruji.description: Shyamchi Aai ya sarkhya anek Prasidha Pustakanche Lekhak Pandurang Sadashiv Sane Mhanjeh Arthat Aple Sane Guruji.  Sane Guruji fakta uttam Lekhak Navhte te ek samaj sudharak, samajat jagruti nirman karnare pan hote. Tyani aplya mansana adhikar milvun denyasathi uposhan dekhil kele. Sane guruji khup sadhe ani emotional hote. Asa Mhantla Jata Nathuram godse yani jevha Gandhi jincha vadh kela, aplyach mansane Gandhijincha vad kela  Mhanun tyana vait vatlaani tyani ana panyacha tyag kela. Tar dusri kade asa hi mhantla jata ki tyancha mrutyu heart attack mule jhala. Kay ahe tyancha Sanegurujinchya Death magcha karan Chala Janun gheuyat Sane gurujin vishayi detail mahiti Sane Guruji Jeevan katha.

rss-1.title: RSS- Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangha
rss-1.description: RSS- Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangha Ha Bhartatil Sarvat Juna Sanga Ahe. Agadi Britishanchya kala pasun ya sanghane Bhartachya Swatantrya sathi ani nantar hindu lokanmadhye janajagruti karnyacha kam kela ahe. RSS chi sthapana kashi jhali, Tyancha Karya kay, Tyanchyavar kon konte allegations lavli thodkyat Rss Mhanje kay yavar neutral pratikriya ya show madhye mandanyat ali ahe.

suchana-ka-adhikar.title: Suchna Ka Adhikar
suchana-ka-adhikar.description: Is desh mein sabhi tax bharte hai. Yahan gareebi rekha se niche rehne wala insaan bhi direct na sahi, lekin chizein kharidte waqt indirect tax zaroor bharta hai. Isi wajah se sabhi apne diye tax ka hisaab janna chahte hai. Wo janna chahte hai ki humari sarkar logon ke tax ka istemal kab, kaise aur kyun karti hai. Isliye democracy mein RTI yani 'Suchna Ka Adhikar' ek basic right hai, jispar sabka haq hai. Lekin iska istemal aap kaise kar sakte hai? Aur iske laagu hone ki wajah kya thi? Ise jante hai is audiobook mein!

ramai-dr-ambedkarancha-adharstambh.title: Ramai-Dr. Ambedkarancha Adhar stambh
ramai-dr-ambedkarancha-adharstambh.description: Pratyek yashasvi purshamage ek stree ubhi aste asa mhantat. Ghataneche Shilpakar DR. BR Ambedkar Yanchya yasha mage tyanchi patni Ramabai Ambedkar yancha shreya ahe. kashta Sosat, Sansar Sambhalat tya babasahebachya pathishi ubhya rahilya hota. Babasaheb Ambedakrancha uccha shikshan gheun backwordclass sathi ubhe rahile te Ramabai yanchya Mulech. Br. Ambedkar tyana premane ramu mhanun hak marat asat.  Ramabai Ambedkar yanchya vishay far kami mahiti ahe chala ya show dware apan janun gheuyat kon ani kasha hotya ramabai.

thamizhaga-mudhalamaichargal.title: Thamizhaga Mudhalamaichargal
thamizhaga-mudhalamaichargal.description: Namma Thamizh naata aanda Mudhalamaichargal lam yaaru, avangaloda sirappugal enna nu indha audio book la kelunga.

prabandhan-ke-gurumantra.title: Management Ke Mantra
prabandhan-ke-gurumantra.description: Manager banna aur management karna do alag baatein hoti hai. Management ek aisi quality hai jiska manager se koi relation ho ya na ho, lekin har kisi ke personality se iska relation zaroor hai. Management ke 100 tarike log ek baar mein bata dete hai, lekin kya aapko unme se ek bhi sahi samay pe yaad hote hai? Nahi ! Inhi tarikon ko aapko asaani se yaad karwane ke liye, aur aapki life mein inki importance batane ke liye, pesh hai, Management ke Mantra ki ye audiobook!

dhanushkodi.title: Dhanushkodi
dhanushkodi.description: 1964 la vantha oru Puyal la Tamil naatoda kadai kodi nagaram aana Dhanushkodi mothama azhinju pochu. Oru Kaalathula epdi irundha oor theriyuma? Srilanka ku direct ah train connectivity kooda irundhurku. 1964 Puyal ku aprm anga irundha makkal enna aananga? Andha oor la pei, aavi nadamaattam irukuradha solradhu’lam unmaiya? Therinjuka kelunga “Dhanushkodi” on Kuku FM

the-ferment-youth-unrest-in-india-2.title: The Ferment - Youth Unrest In India
the-ferment-youth-unrest-in-india-2.description: “My birth is my fatal accident”. Idhu JNU student Rohit Vemula ezhudiya suicide note. Oru pakkam technology, development nu India valarchi paadhai la ponaalum, innum caste based discriminations ah thodarchiya namma makkal sandhichuttu dhan irukaanga. Adhanaala pona pala uyirgal la Rohit’um oruthar. JNU, IITs madhiri prestigious institutions la Underprivileged students face panra issues ah pathiyum, adhukku edhir ah poraadiya voices pathiyum therinjuka kelunga “The Ferment - Youth Unrest In India” only on Kuku FM

shrimad-bhagwad-geeta-business-ka-gyaan.title: Shrimad Bhagwad Geeta: Business Ka Gyaan
shrimad-bhagwad-geeta-business-ka-gyaan.description: Sabse best Business Guide hai humaari Bhagwad Geeta. Par iske gyaan ko business wisdom ke drishtikon se dekhne ki kala honi chahiye. Suniye yeh special audioshow aur paaiye business ki saari mushkilon ke samadhan.

a-step-by-step-guid-to-your-own-startup.title: A Step By Step Guid To Your Own Startup
a-step-by-step-guid-to-your-own-startup.description: Sonthama thozhil aarambikkanum nra oru aasai innaiku kalakattathula perugi varudhu. Adhanala yega patta competition um iruku. Idhukku madhiyila sulabama oru thozhil aarambikkuradhukku sila mukkiya tips indha audio book la iruku. Full ah kelunga.

khwabon-ka-dream-11-1.title: Khwabon ka Dream11
khwabon-ka-dream-11-1.description: 25 billion dollar ki fantasy gaming industry ke boom ka credit jata hai Dream11 ke founders Harsh Jain aur Bhavit Sheth ko, jinke big dreams ne almost har cricket fan ka fantasy sports ka shaukeen bana diya. Aaj Dream11 8 billion dollar ki company hai aur fantasy sports duniya ka fastest growing sector. Par Harsh aur Bhavit ne kaise hasil ki ye safalta? Aur iske liye unhe kin mushkilon aur controversies se gujarna pada? Aaiye jaante hain is show mein

kisan-credit-card-kivabe-byabohar-korben.title: Kisan Credit Card Kivabe Byabohar Korben?
kisan-credit-card-kivabe-byabohar-korben.description: Kobe shuru hoyechilo Kisan Credit Card er prokolpo? Amader sarkar amader krishak bondhuder jonno ekta special scheme niye eseche ei scheme er dara krishokder arthik sahajyo tader fosol utpadoner khetre somosto badha dur korte chaye. Kisan Credit Card er byapare bistarito bhabe jante, ki ki bhabe tar labh bhog kora shombhob, koto taka porjonto loan newa sombhob, ba hotath mrityu te koto takar khotpuran dei ei Kisan Credit Card, jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

10-better-2.title: 10% Better
10-better-2.description: Jeevitham lo Manam roju aneka panulu chesthu untam, Konni alochinchi chestham konni alochinchakundane chestham aithe mana jeevitham lo alochinchi chesina panulu manam anukunnatte jaruguthayi kani alochinchakunda cheese vatiki anukoni avantharalu eduruavuthayi. Aithe ee pusthakam manaki manishi thanani thanu ela control chesukovali, thanu chese tappulani ela correct chesukovali ila enno aneka vati gurinchi teliyachesthundi. inkenduku mari late ventane ee audio book vinandi.

fidel-kastro-by-vk-singh.title: Fidel Castro
fidel-kastro-by-vk-singh.description: Fidel Castro ! Cuba ki Kranti Ka Leader. Fidel Castro ! Cuba Mein Nayi Chetna Lane Wala Leader . Aur bhi bahut sare introduction hain Fidel ke. V. K. Singh Ji ki likhi Is kamal ki Audiobook mein hum aapko fidel ke Har rang se rubaru karwane ja rahe hain. Batayenge Fidel ka bachapan jisne unhe ek revolutionary banaya. Batayenge ki kaise Fidel ne apni sena banayi. Kaise logon ka bharosa jeeta aur kaise Cuba ko vikas ki nayi disha di. Har kahani se uthega parda is khas Show "Fidel Castro" mein .

ved-saranubad.title: Ved: Saranubad
ved-saranubad.description: Iswar e ei jogot sangsarer probortok, tini prithibi kivabe cholbe tar ekti nirdeshika diyechen ar shei nirdeshika holo Ved. Ved er ortho holo gyan, ar jhornadharar moto neme esche jug jug dhore ei gyan, amader prokrito Hindu dharma ba sasthro ar Ved somporke alochyo bishoy gulo niye bistarito bhabe jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

athichanallur-keezhadi-agazhaivugal.title: Keeladi
athichanallur-keezhadi-agazhaivugal.description: Keeladi, Aathicha Nallur pondra idangalil kidaitha Pandai Kaala porutkal, Kalvettugal, Olai chuvdigal, seppedugal patri vivarangalai eduthu koorukirathu intha audio puthagam. Thamizhagathil nadantha agazh aaivugal patriya thagavalgalai vilakki koorum Audio puthagam idhu.

make-the-right-choice-3.title: Make The Right Choice
make-the-right-choice-3.description: Hum sab life mein decision lete hain aur usi ka fal hame baad mein milta hai. Fir chahe vo carrier se related ho, life partner se related ho ya apni family se related ho. Lekin sabse zyada mayne rakhta hai ki aap kaise sahi cheezein choose karte hain . Ek galat choice bhi life ko kharab kar deti hai. Isiliye hum aapke liye le aaye hain "Make The Right Choice" Book ki Audiobook vo bhi Hindi mein. Jahan aap janege ki kaise sahi cheezon ko choose karein aur successful hon.

rendu-gundela-chappudu.title: రెండు గుండెల చప్పుడు
rendu-gundela-chappudu.description: సుభాషిణి చుట్టూ అల్లుకున్న ఆసక్తికరమైన సంఘటనలు ఏమిటి? రాష్ట్రపతి హాల్ లో జరిగిన సంఘటన సుభాషిణి మీద ఎలాంటి ప్రభావం చూపింది? ఆసక్తికరంగా సాగే యండమూరి కథ మీకోసం.

free-to-focus-10.title: Free To Focus
free-to-focus-10.description: Free To Focus ane pusthakam manishiki okka manchi Personal guide ga panichesthundi. Prathi okka Manishiki jeevitham lo focus anedi chaala Mukhyam. Ee pusthakam manaki focus ni ela penchukovali, time management ela chesukovali anthe kakunda mananni manam ela meruguparchukovali ane vishyala gurinchi chebuthundi mari inkenduku late ventane ee audio book vinandi.

the-perfect-murder-3.title: The Perfect Murder
the-perfect-murder-3.description: 2048 ki Crime free duniya mein ho gaya hai Murder! Wo bhi us shaqs ka jisne is World ko Crime free banaya tha. Kya Vijay Gupta qaatil ko pakad payega? Kaise hua hoga ye murder jahan crime ke thoughts detect hote hi alarm generate ho jata hai? Kaun hai in sab ke peeche? Janne ke liye suniye…. The Perfect Murder!

mar-chrysostom-vishwapouran.title: മാര്‍ ക്രിസോസ്റ്റം: വിശ്വപൗരന്‍
mar-chrysostom-vishwapouran.description:
വിശ്വാസികള്‍ക്ക് പുറമേ പൊതുസമൂഹത്തിന്റെ ഇഷ്ടവും നേടിയെടുത്ത മതപുരോഹിതര്‍ കേരളത്തില്‍ നന്നേക്കുറവാണ്. നര്‍മ്മത്തിന്റെ മേമ്പൊടിയുള്ള പ്രസംഗങ്ങളിലൂടെയും ചിരിയുണര്‍ത്തുന്ന വര്‍ത്തമാനങ്ങളിലൂടെയും മലയാളിയുടെ ഹൃദയത്തില്‍ ഇടം നേടിയ പുരോഹിത പ്രമുഖനായിരുന്നു ഡോ. ഫിലിപ്പോസ് മാര്‍ ക്രിസോസ്റ്റം. കേരളത്തിന്റെ സാമൂഹിക സാംസ്‌കാരിക രംഗത്തെ നിറസാന്നിധ്യം.
കരുതലും സ്‌നേഹവും നിറഞ്ഞ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ജീവിതത്തിലൂടെയുള്ള യാത്രയാണ് ഈ പുസ്തകം.

godse-gandhijiye-konnath-enthinu.title: ഗോഡ്‌സെ ഗാന്ധിജിയെ കൊന്നത് എന്തിന്?
godse-gandhijiye-konnath-enthinu.description: ഇന്ത്യ ഹൃദയത്തിലേറ്റു വാങ്ങിയ മുറിവാണ് ഗാന്ധിവധം. വെടിവെച്ച് കൊന്നിട്ടും അണയാത്ത ജ്വാല പോലെ ഗാന്ധിയുടെ ഓര്‍മ്മകളും ആദര്‍ശവും തലമുറകളിലേക്ക് പടര്‍ന്നു. ഗാന്ധിവധവും അതിന് പിന്നിലെ രാഷ്ട്രീയ ഗൂഢാലോചന സംബന്ധിച്ച ചരിത്രവും പാഠപുസ്തകങ്ങളില്‍ നിന്ന് മായ്ച്ച് കളയാന്‍ ശ്രമം നടക്കുന്ന കാലത്ത് ഗാന്ധി വധത്തിന് പിന്നിലെ കാരണവും ഗൂഢാലോചനയും അതിന് പ്രേരിപ്പിച്ച ആശയത്തെയും ഈ കൃതി പരിശോധിക്കുന്നു.

evergreen-stocks-for-life.title: Evergreen Stocks For Life
evergreen-stocks-for-life.description: Aaj ke waqt mein hum sab stock mein investment ke zariye paise kamana chahte hain par sabse bada sawal ye hai ki aakhir kaun se stocks hamare liye best hain? Konse stocks hume zyada se zyada profit denge, aur aakhir kaha se aur kaise pata chalega ki ye Stocks hamare liye best hai? In saare sawalon ke jawaab jaane ke liye suniye ye show "Evergreen Stocks For Life".

nilamuttam.title: നിലാമുറ്റം
nilamuttam.description: മലയാള സാഹിത്യത്തിലെ ഒഴിച്ചു കൂടാനാവാത്ത അധ്യായമാണ് കവി ഒളപ്പമണ്ണ. സാഹിത്യത്തിന് പുറമേ സാംസ്‌കാരിക രംഗത്തും നിറഞ്ഞു നിന്നിരുന്നു കവി. പതിനാറാം വയസില്‍ കവിയുടെ ജീവിത സഖിയായെത്തിയ ശ്രീദേവി ഒളപ്പമണ്ണ നിലാമുറ്റം എന്ന ഈ ഓര്‍മ്മക്കുറിപ്പിലൂടെ പങ്കുവെക്കുന്നത് കേവലം കവിയുടെ ഓര്‍മ്മകള്‍ മാത്രമല്ല. അത് ഒരു നാടിന്റെ ഒരു കാലത്തിന്റെ ഓര്‍മ്മകളുടെ കൂടി ശേഷിപ്പാവുകയാണ്. തന്റെ പേരക്കുട്ടികളോട് ഒരു മുത്തശ്ശി പറയുന്ന കഥകള്‍ പോലെ സരളമാണ് ഈ ഓര്‍മ്മക്കുറിപ്പ്.

गॉड-ऑफ-वॉर-कार्तिकेय.title: The God of War: Kartikey
गॉड-ऑफ-वॉर-कार्तिकेय.description: Mahadev ke putra aur devon ke senapati Kartikey kaise bane yuddh ke devta Murugan? Shiv ke putra hote hue bhi kailash mein kyon nahi rehte Kartikey? Mahabalshali Tarakasur ko kaise haraya Kartikey ne? Aaiye jaante hain is khas peshkash mein

7-money-rules-for-life-5.title: 7 Money Rules For Life
7-money-rules-for-life-5.description: Vidhyabhyasaparamayi ettavum munnilayirinittu polum palarkkum panam kaikaryam cheyyunnathine kurich valiya pidiyonnumilla. Nammude kaikalil ethi cherunna panam engane bhudhipoorvam kaikaryam cheyyunnu ennath jeevithathil valare pradhanamaanu. Ethra panam kayyil ethi cherunnu ennathil alla athu ethra mathram phalapradhamayi kaikaryam cheyyunnuvennanu kooduthal pradhanyam arhikkunnath. Mary Hunt ezhuthiya 7 Money Rules For Life enna pusthakathile 7 pana niyamangalkk ningalude jeevitham thanne maatti marikkan sadhikkum.

niththam-oru-yuththam.title: Niththam Oru Yuththam
niththam-oru-yuththam.description: Meendum oru marma noi... Moolai urainthu  palar maranamadaigiraarkal. detective jegathalap prathabanum theeya sakthi scientist Jadayuvum aadum aadupuli aattaththinaik kettu magizhungal...

the-rise-and-fall-of-an-empire-1.title: Shahjahan: The Rise and Fall of an Empire
the-rise-and-fall-of-an-empire-1.description: Kya Shahjahan ka Taj Mahal banwana Mughal dynasty ki sabse badi galti thi? Taj Mahal mein khoye Shahjahan ko na hi shahi khazane ka dhyan raha, na hi apne beton ka. Kya hua jab Shahjahan ke beton ne hi kar di bagawat? Kaise mili Aurangzeb ko gaddi? Kaise hua Mughal Empire ka ant? Aaiye jaante hain is show mein.

rise-of-isro-3.title: Rise of ISRO - The Pride of India
rise-of-isro-3.description: August 23 2023 Roji ISRO (Indian Space Research Organization)ne Pathavlelya Chandrayan -3 ne soft landing kela ani ek navin Itihas rachla.  Bharat Ha Chandrachya Southside Var Soft Landing Karnara Pahila Desh Tharla. Aaj Bhartacha Saglikade Kautuk Hot Ahe. Pan ISRO Aaj Jya Thikani Ahe Tya Thikani Jayla Tyala Kiti Mhenat Ghayvi Lagli ? Kay Kay Parisharam Karayla Lagle Hey Apan Janun Gheuyat Rise of ISRO Ya Show Dware.

life-changing-lesson-sudha-murty.title: Life changing Lesson From Sudha Murthy
life-changing-lesson-sudha-murty.description: Infosys Chya Chairperson Sudha Murthy ek asa nav ahe jyanchya ayushaytun shiknyasarkha barach kahi ahe. Tyanacha success chya kahi stories apan ya show dware janun ghenar ahot. tyancha pratyek story madhun aplyala kahi tari shikayla milta ek motivation milta. Kuku fm Var aikuya Life changing Lessons from sudha murty.

ncert-class-10th-geography.title: NCERT Class 10th Geography
ncert-class-10th-geography.description: Class mein first aana ho ya UPSC ki taiyari karni ho ya phir kisi competitive exam mein achhi Rank laani ho, Shuruaat to NCERT book utha kar padhne se hi karni hogi. KUKU fm par yeh original series apke isi problem ka solution hai. Jise sun kar aap Resources and Development, Agriculture, Manufacturing Industries jaise topics ko achhe se jaan jaayenge aur saath hi inse jude examples aur important questions aapko exam ki taiyari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge.

kom-betone-bari-kenar-secret.title: Kom Betone Bari Kenar Secret
kom-betone-bari-kenar-secret.description: Ei bishal prithibir chotto ekta kone bari bananor ba kenar shopno amader sokoler e ache. Kintu kivabe pabo ba kena jabe nijeder shopner bari shimito rojgare. Amader desher jono sonkhar 31% holo odhyobitto, ebong ekhokar barti khorocher modhye ki kore shombhob ekti pochonder ba shopner bari kena ba toiri kora? Kom betone bari kenar secret alochyo bhabe jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

grow-rich-with-peace-of-mind.title: Grow Rich! With Peace Of Mind
grow-rich-with-peace-of-mind.description: "Grow Rich!: With Peace of Mind" by Napoleon Hill is a guide to achieving both material wealth and inner tranquility. Building on the principles from Hill's classic "Think and Grow Rich," this audiobook explores how to accumulate riches while maintaining peace in your life and provides practical insights and actionable strategies for using your mind's power to achieve prosperity. With Hill's wisdom, you'll learn to overcome obstacles, break limitations, and not only attain financial wealth but also find contentment and balance. This audiobook is your path to wealth and inner peace.

satya-ke-sath-mere-prayog.title: The Story Of My Experiments With Truth
satya-ke-sath-mere-prayog.description: Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, ek bete, ek pati aur ek pita....lekin uske baad bane Rashtrapita! Ye kaise hua iski khabar kisi ko nahi thi, sivayein unke. Khud kacchi umar mein shaadi karne ke baad bhi, unhone bal vivah ka humesha virodh kiya. Kyun? Aur kaisi thi unki is dauran journey? Kaisa ho agar is baat ka jawab aapko khud Mahatma Gandhi khud dein. Jee sahi sun rahe hain aap! Ye audiobook Mohandas Gandhi ki biography hai.Jisme unhone khud apni har journey ke baare mein bataya hai. Aaiye The Story of my experiements with Truth ki ye audiobook sune!

52-red-pills-2.title: 52 Red Pills
52-red-pills-2.description: Ithu oru 52 week habits challenge, Ovvoru vaaramum neenga follow panna vendiya habit pathina vilakkathaiyum, atha neenga follow panrathukaana kaaranathaiyum paarambariya vazhakkangal matrum naveena aaraichigal adipadai la sollirukanga. Vaanga healthy, wealthy and happier life ku thevaiyana habits sa follow panna aarambikalaam.

class-10-history-1.title: NCERT Class 10th History
class-10-history-1.description: Class mein first aana ho ya UPSC ki taiyari karni ho ya phir kisi competitive exam mein achhi Rank laani ho, Shuruaat to NCERT book utha kar padhne se hi karni hogi. KUKU fm par yeh original series aap ke isi problem ka solution hai. Jise sun kar aap "The Napoleonic Code of 1804", "Religion and anti-colonialism", "The Rowlatt Act", "The Print Revolution and its impact" jaise topics ko achhe se jaan jaayenge aur saath hi inse jude examples aur important questions aapko exam ki taiyari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge.

osho-the-spiritual-controversial-guru.title: OSHO: Ek Controversial Dharma Guru
osho-the-spiritual-controversial-guru.description: OSHO he naav aikala, ki Controvercial Dharama Guru' ashich pratima dolyasamor ubhi rahte. Tyanchi Mysterious Death sudha anek prashna ubhe karte. Sex ani Spirituality' ya donhichi sangad ghalat lokana Life lessons denarya Oshoncha Satya nemka ahe tari kay?  Chala janun gheuya kayam 'Breaking News' madhe rahilelya Vadgrasta Dharm Guru chi rahasyamayi kahani fukta aplya Kuku FM war...

swami-vivekanandanche-prernadayi-vichar.title: Swami Vivekanandanche Prernadayi Vichar
swami-vivekanandanche-prernadayi-vichar.description: Swami Vivekananda yani aplyala sadhya sopya bhashet, Jeevan sukhar karnyacha marga sangitla ahe. Tyani sangitlele Life Lessons aplyala keval Motivate karat nahit, tar Success cha nava marga dakhvtat, tya margat yenare adthale door karnyachi Energy detat. Chala mag aikuya, Vivekanandanche inspiration thoughts arthat Prernadayi vicahr ya khas show dware...

safal-udyami-kaise-banane-final.title: Kaise Banein Successful Entrepreneur
safal-udyami-kaise-banane-final.description: Har koi accha businessman ya phir businesswoman banna chahta hai. Jo thik bhi hai, paisa kamana aur use badhana sabke bas ki baat hoti bhi nahi hai. Lekin isi dauran sabhi successful log ye bhul jaate hai ki paisa acchi zindagi ki basic zarooraton ko poora karta hai. Kisi ko acchi zindagi jeene ka sabak nahi deta. Uske liye aap mein kuch moral values ka hona zaroori hota hai. Ye audiobook isi intention se banayi gayi hai ki business man ya woman sirf business ke sector mein successful na ho. Balki wo apni society aur apne logon ke liye bhi apne morals se successful ho.

life-lessons-to-take-from-vedas-and-upan.title: Vedas ani Upanishade
life-lessons-to-take-from-vedas-and-upan.description: Apan anekda  gharatil wadildahrya lokankadun aikla asel ki, ''Aplya Vedas ani Upanishada madhe jeevnacha saar sangitla ahe''... Pan aajcha Modern Life madhil Busy Routine madhe he vachayla ani samjun ghyeyla vel konakde ahe? Mhnunch amhi yaamdhe sangitlelya Life Lessons cha soppa artha amhi tumcha sathi audio searupat gheun alo ahot. Mag chala Knowledge cha ya mahasagrat ek dubaki apanhi maruya ani janun gheuya Vedas ani Upanishadas madhil 'Life Hacks'

irular-pazhangudi-maruthuvam.title: Irular Pazhangudi Maruthuvam
irular-pazhangudi-maruthuvam.description: Irular Pazhangudi makkal kadai pidikkum Maruthuva muraigal patri virivaga therinthu kolla uthavum audio puthagam ithu. Aacharyamoottum avargalin maruthuva muraigal patri arindhu kollalaam vaarungal.

mrityu-ke-devta-yamraj.title: Yamraj: Mrityu Ke Devta
mrityu-ke-devta-yamraj.description: Kya aapko pata hai Yamraj ki bhi mrityu hone wali thi? Par kaun lena chahta tha Yamraj ki jaan? Sabki mrityu nischit karne wale Yamraj kaise bane the Mrityu ke devta? Kyon Yamraj nahi le paye Rishi Markandeya ke praan? Aur kis kisne haraya tha Yamraj ko? Aaiye jaante hain is khas peshkash mein

no-ball.title: No Ball
no-ball.description: No Ball ante enti anedi mana andariki telusu.! Denini cricket lo bowler banthini chaala pyiki visirinappudu danini no ball ga prakatistharu. Kani mana rachyatha ikkada cricket lo jarigina enno match fixing la gurinchi dani valla nashanam ayina endho mandhi cricketers jeevithala gurinchi ee pusthakam lo vivarana icharu. inkenduku late ventane ee audio book vinandi.

kailash-porboter-rohosyo.title: Kailash Porboter Rohosyo
kailash-porboter-rohosyo.description: Kailash Holo Emon Ek Porbot Ja Aaj Porjonto Keu Joy Korte Pareni, Emonki Kothito Aache Mohadev Tar Poribar Niye Ekhane Bas Koren. Sotyi Ki Thaken Tini Ekhane? Rohosye Ghera Ei Porbot Niye Nana Kahini Bola Hoyechhe Ei Audio Show-Te Ja Ritimoto Shihoron Jagay.

o-cortico-1.title: O Cortiço
o-cortico-1.description: Nesta obra acompanhamos a vida cotidiana dos curiosos moradores do cortiço de João Romão, na cidade do Rio de Janeiro.  E é nesse amontoado de casas humildes e conhecemos as histórias de diferentes pessoas, entre pedreiros, lavadeiras, portugueses, negros e mestiços, representando a miscigenação do povo brasileiro.

நானென்றால்-அது-நானல்ல--திவாகர்-.title: நானென்றால் அது நானல்ல
நானென்றால்-அது-நானல்ல--திவாகர்-.description: மனிதனின் குணம் ஒரு நேரம் போல் ஒரு நேரம் இருப்பதில்லை. மனிதன் மட்டுமல்ல இயற்கையும் அப்படித்தான். உலகில் இயற்கையைப் போல தகுந்த நேரம் பார்த்து மாறும், மாற்றிக்கொள்ளும் மனிதர்களின் வாழ்வை பிரதிபலிக்கும் கண்ணாடியாக நானென்றால் அது நானல்ல எனும் சிறுகதை தொகுப்பை படைத்துள்ளார் திவாகர். இந்தச் சிறுகதைகளை உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்எம் ல் கேட்டு மகிழுங்கள்.

iracema.title: IRACEMA
iracema.description: A obra relata a história de amor entre a índia Iracema, "a virgem dos lábios de mel" e o europeu Martin. É uma representação da formação do povo brasileiro, imaginada pelo autor José de Alencar.

காதல்-வைபோகமே-.title: காதல் வைபோகமே
காதல்-வைபோகமே-.description: பவானி புயலுக்கு நடுவே பூத்த பூவாக வாழ்பவள். ஓய்வுப் பெற்ற அப்பா, துணி தைக்கும் அம்மா, பாவமான அக்கா, சீர் கேட்டு தொல்லை செய்யும் அக்கா கணவன் என மிகவும் ஏழ்மையான குடும்பத்தை சேர்ந்தவளாக இருந்தாலும் படித்து முன்னேறும் லட்சியத்துடன் கல்லூரி படிகள் ஏறுகிறாள். அப்போது அவள் வாழ்க்கையில் வாழ்த்து அட்டை  ஒன்றின் மூலமாக நுழைகிறது காதல் அத்தியாயம். காதலும் கடமையும் பவானியை எங்கு கொண்டு சென்று நிறுத்தியது?

bari-kinben-naki-vara-neben.title: Bari Kinben Naki Vara Neben?
bari-kinben-naki-vara-neben.description: Aamder Oneker Mone Ekta Proshno Ghore Je Bari Kena Valo Naki Vara Neoya? Sei Kotha Bistarito Vabe Janate KUKU FM Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audio Show, Ja Aapnar Mathay Ghurte Chola Buy Or Rent Related Jabotiyo Proshner Uttor Debe. Cholun Tahole Shune Neoya Jak.

university-patna-politics-aur-pyaar-1.title: University - Patna, Politics aur Pyaar
university-patna-politics-aur-pyaar-1.description: 1990 Ka wo daur jahaa'n bihar me student politics apne poore varchasv par tha. Kai Bade Bade Raajnetaaon Ki dukaan bhi Chhatra Rajneeti se hi chalti thi. Yahi wo waqt tha jab bihar ke patna mein jaatiwad jaisi bimari khuli hawa mein saans le rahi thi. Isi dauran lower middle class aur caste discrimination se tabaah 21 saal Ke Suraj ki entry hoti hai Patna Janta Vishwavidyalaya mein aur phir shuru hota Hai Rajneeti ka ganda khel. University ne Suraj ke marzi ke bina hi use student politics ka Poster Boy bana diya tha. Kaun tha is University Ka King aur kis pyade ne macha di poore system mein Khalbali? Kya Suraj ki Mohabbat bhi jaati vyawastha ka shikhar hogi? Kya Suraj jaisa ordinary student is pratishodh ki mehengi Raajneeti ko karara jawab de payega? Suniye Chhatra-Rajneeti Ki Mind Blasting Political Thriller Kahani Jisme Suspense, Romance, Action, Addiction aur Revenge Ka lga hai Bharpoor Tadka. Aaiye Chalte Hain University Ke Andar!

the-art-of-war-4.title: The Art of War
the-art-of-war-4.description: Yuddakala Unnavaade Vijayam Sadhisthadu! B.C 500 lo Old China lo sun tzu ee book rayadam Jarigindi. Sainyamloni Goppa Generals,Commanders War Feild lo Ela undalo, losses ni ela tagginchukovali mariyu shatruvulanu ela odinchali vanti prashanalaku ee book lo answers untayi. War feild lone kakunda Life War lo kuda Ela gelavali ane vishayalanu Ee audiobook lo vivarinchadam jarigindi.

யாருக்காக-அழுதான்-.title: யாருக்காக அழுதான்
யாருக்காக-அழுதான்-.description: தன் மனைவியின் விருப்பத்தைப் புரிந்து கொண்டு அவளுக்கு ஏற்படுகிற காதலை மதித்து அந்தக் காதலுக்குரியவனோடு திருமணம் செய்து வைக்கிறான் ஜோசப். அன்பின் அறம் என்ன என்பதை அறிந்துகொள்ள வேண்டுமா? கேளுங்கள்...

ncert-class-9th-economics.title: NCERT Class 9th Economics
ncert-class-9th-economics.description: Class mein first aana ho ya UPSC ki taiyaari karni ho ya phir kisi competitive exam mein acchi Rank lani ho, Shuruaat to book utha kar padhne se hi karni hogi. Lekin bookish language ko samajhna thoda sa mushkil ho jata hai. KUKU fm par yeh original series apke isi problem ka solution hai. Jise sun kar aap People as Resource, Poverty as a Challenge aur Food Security in India jaise topics ko bahut hi achhe se samajh jaayenge aur saath hi inse jude examples aur important questions aapko exam ki taiyaari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge.

செஞ்சோற்று-கடன்-.title: செஞ்சோற்றுக் கடன்
செஞ்சோற்று-கடன்-.description: கொடை வள்ளல் கர்ணன் சேராத இடத்தில் சேர்ந்ததைக் குறிப்பது அல்ல செஞ்சோற்றுக் கடன். தன்னை சோறிட்டு எந்த எதிர்பார்ப்புமின்றி வளர்த்த தேரோட்டி தந்தைக்கு செய்ய வேண்டிய தானத்தை குறிப்பதாகும்...

வம்ச-விருத்தி-.title: வம்ச விருத்தி
வம்ச-விருத்தி-.description: வம்ச விருத்தி'யில் உள்ள கதைகள் பல, தமிழுக்குப் புதிது. இதுவரை தமிழ் எழுத்தாளர்கள் அறிமுகப்படுத்தாத புதிய கதைக் களங்களையும், கதைப் பொருளுக்கான புதிய அக்கறைகளையும் இத்தொகுதியின் மூலம் தமிழ் இலக்கியத்திற்கு அ. முத்துலிங்கம் அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளார். வாங்க கேட்போம்...

osho-the-guru-of-spirituality-sex-and-co.title: OSHO: The Guru of Spirituality, Sex And Controversy
osho-the-guru-of-spirituality-sex-and-co.description: "Mai pagal hun aur jab tak tumhen pagal na kar dun tab tak ye dosti bani hi nahi". Ye shabd hain Osho ke, ek aisa insan jisne iss desh hi nahi puri duniya ko apne vicharon se hila kar rakh diya tha, ek aisa insaan jisne America mein jaake apne naam ka sheher basa diya, ek aisa insaan jo shadi jaise pavitra bandhan par bhi sawal khade karta tha, jisne sex aur spirituality ko alag dhang se pesh kiya. Aakhir kya hai isa Insan ki kahani? kyu aaj bhi log inke vicharon ko sunkar prabhavit ho jaate hain? aur aakhir kaise hui thi inki mrityu janne ke liye suniye “Osho: The Guru of Spirituality, Sex and Controversy” Ka ye Show.

ம்ம்ம்-.title: ம்...
ம்ம்ம்-.description: ஒரு கிராமத்துப் பெண்ணைப் திருமணம் செய்ய நிச்சயம் செய்கிறான் ஒரு பணக்கார இளைஞன். தன் கடந்தகால காதலியை மறக்க அவளைக் காதலிக்கத் தொடங்குகிறான். ஆனால், பிரிந்து சென்று வேறு ஒருவனை மணந்த அந்த முன்னாள் காதலி இப்போது தன் கணவனை விவாகரத்து செய்யும் சூழலில் கதாநாயகனைச் சந்திக்கிறாள்... பிரச்சினைகள் தொடங்குகின்றன. அவளின் முரட்டுக் கணவன் திருமண சூழ்நிலையைப் பயன்படுத்தி ஒரு பெரிய தொகையை அடைய திட்டமிடு கிறான். அவன் திட்டம் ஜெயித்ததா , தோற்ற... கேளுங்கள்... ம்ம்ம்...

-ஐந்து-வழி-மூன்று-வாசல்-.title: ஐந்து வழி மூன்று வாசல்
-ஐந்து-வழி-மூன்று-வாசல்-.description: ஒரு அற்புதமான வைரத்தை தனக்கெனக் கொள்ளும் ஆசை உடைய மனிதர்களைப் பற்றிய கதை இது.  ஆனால், ஆசை இரண்டு காலக் கட்டங்களிலும் ஒரே மாதிரியாய் - பேராபத்து விளைவிக்கும் பேராசையாய் இருக்கிறது. ஐந்து வழி மூன்று வாசலில் பயணித்து அந்த வைரத்தை அடைய நாமும் முயற்சிப்போம்...

ronaldo-nazario-nada-para-esse-fenomeno.title: Ronaldo Nazario, nada para esse fenômeno
ronaldo-nazario-nada-para-esse-fenomeno.description: Esta é uma biografia cativante que mergulha na vida, carreira e na importância do lendário atleta brasileiro Ronaldo, conhecido como "Fenômeno". Com um foco especial em sua carreira no futebol, este show oferece aos ouvintes uma perspectiva única sobre a jornada extraordinária de um dos maiores jogadores de todos os tempos. Conheça os momentos mais icônicos da carreira de Ronaldo, desde sua passagem pelo Cruzeiro e PSV Eindhoven, até suas atuações marcantes no Barcelona, Inter de Milão, Real Madrid e Corinthians. Você será levado aos estádios, vai sentir a emoção e a habilidade do jogador através das palavras.

embrace-sip-ditch-ppf-1.title: Embrace SIP, Ditch PPF
embrace-sip-ditch-ppf-1.description: "Embrace SIP, Ditch PPF" is your roadmap to financial prosperity. This original show demystifies investment strategies, focusing on the power of Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) versus traditional methods like the Public Provident Fund (PPF). Learn how SIPs can outperform, providing a robust shield against inflation and a path to achieving your financial dreams. With expert guidance, you'll gain the confidence to navigate the dynamic world of investments. Say goodbye to outdated strategies and embrace the future of finance with SIPs!

concursos-publicos-project.title: Além Dos Livros: O Lado não acadêmicos dos concursos públicos
concursos-publicos-project.description: Em meio a tantas dificuldades de inserção no mercado de trabalho, os concursos públicos surgem como uma verdadeira luz no fim do túnel. Mas fazer um concurso vai muito além de se inscrever e responder uma prova. Se você se interessa pelo universo dos concursos, essa série foi feita para você!

memory-how-to-develop-train-and-use-it-1.title: Memory: How to Develop, Train, And Use It
memory-how-to-develop-train-and-use-it-1.description: "Memory: How to Develop, Train, And Use It" by William Walker Atkinson is a practical guide to unlocking the full potential of your memory. In a world inundated with information, a sharp memory is a priceless asset. This audiobook offers accessible and effective methods for memory improvement. Whether you're a student, professional, or simply looking to boost your memory, this audiobook offers structured methods for improvement. Elevate your memory and your life with the wisdom found in this comprehensive guide.

1971-birth-of-bangladesh.title: 1971: Birth of Bangladesh
1971-birth-of-bangladesh.description: Travel back to the pivotal year of 1971 with "1971: Birth of Bangladesh." This captivating original show delves deep into the events that led to the formation of Bangladesh. It expertly portrays the political complexities, the fight for freedom, and the unwavering determination of a people seeking independence and paints a vivid picture of the heroes, battles, and emotions that defined this momentous chapter in history. Whether you love history or are simply curious, this audioshow offers an engaging glimpse into the birth of a nation.

sirf-tumhari-alice-1.title: Sirf Tumhari A.L.I.C.E.
sirf-tumhari-alice-1.description: Apni Girlfriend ke jaane ke baad, apna akelapan dur karne ke liye, Robotic Expert Arun ne banaya ek aisa robot, jo bilkul uski girlfriend jaisi dikhti aur behave karti thi. Jiska sirf ek hi maksad tha apne creator ko pyaar karna. Lekin Robot ki Artificial Intelligence ne khud ko is duniya ke according update kar liya. Is wajah se Alice ka Arun ko pyaar karne ka junoon, hadh paar kar gaya. Sabhi ki nazar Arun ki is qaatilana technology par thi, magar Arun ke liye ye sab ek khel tha. Is junoon se bhare khatarnak khel ko janne ke liye abhi sunein, “Sirf Tumhari A.L.I.C.E.”.

skanda-puranatil-ranjak-goshti.title: Skanda Puranatil Ranjak Goshti
skanda-puranatil-ranjak-goshti.description: Skanda Puranatil Hey keval puran nasun Shiv Paravti yancha premachi goshta ahe. Shiv, Devancha dev adiyogi, veer, sarva shaktiman , kshant ragavnara parantu titkach premal. Shivachya ayushyatun sati nighun gelyavar, tichya athvanit ved jhalela shiv punha premat padto. to jichya premat padto ti mhanje himalyachi mulgi ninata sundar ashi, satichech dusre rup asleli girija, ani ya doghanchya milanatun janmala yeto toh devnayak, devbhumicha rakshankarta, veer ani sarva shastranche dnyan aslela skanda kumar joh pudhe jaun atyachari ani drushta tarkasuracha  vadh karun kharya arthane devnayak aslyacha siddha karti ani ithun suru hote Skandakumarachi hi Mahagatha' Skandapuran.

ശബ്ദങ്ങളുടെ-കാലത്തെ-നിശബ്ദത.title: ശബ്ദങ്ങളുടെ കാലത്തെ നിശബ്ദത
ശബ്ദങ്ങളുടെ-കാലത്തെ-നിശബ്ദത.description: അടിസ്ഥാനപരമായി എനിക്കല്‍പം നിശബ്ദത വേണമെന്നുള്ള തിരിച്ചറിവില്‍ ഞാനതിന് വേണ്ടിയുള്ള തിരച്ചില്‍ ആരംഭിച്ചു. നിരത്തിലെയും മസ്തിഷ്‌കത്തിലെയും കോലാഹലങ്ങള്‍ക്കപ്പുറം സംഗീതത്തിന്റെയും യന്ത്രങ്ങളുടെയും താളങ്ങളെ കടന്ന് ഐ ഫോണിന്റെയും മഞ്ഞു കോരികളുടെയും ആരവങ്ങളില്ലാത്തിടത്ത് അത് എന്നെ കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നുണ്ടായിരുന്നു. നിശബ്ദത.... എര്‍ലിംഗ് കാഗേയുടെ 'ശബ്ദങ്ങളുടെ കാലത്തെ നിശബ്ദത', നിശബ്ദതയെക്കുറിച്ച് ഒരു പുസ്തകമാണ്. കേട്ട് തുടങ്ങാം...

Ashwatthama--खूनी-चक्रव्यूह.title: Ashwatthama : खूनी चक्रव्यूह
Ashwatthama--खूनी-चक्रव्यूह.description: Main hoon Guru Drona Putra ‘Ashwatthama’. Ye naam sunte hi jab kisi ki kalpana mei mera darawana shareer aata hai toh uski aatma andar tak dahal jaati hai. Har koi is naam se bach kar dur bhaagna chahta hai, par koi hai; jise mere mile shraap ka koi dar nahi. Balki use mere Junoon ki chahat hai. Wahi junoon, jismei maine apne Pita ke Pratishodh mei bhaagya palatne ki himmat ki thi. Theek waisa hi sahas aur pagalpan is waqt Mani par sawar hai, jisne apne pratishodh ki aag mei ab tak ka sabse bhayanak खूनी चक्रव्यूह rach daala hai. Abhi sunein ‘Ashwatthama: खूनी चक्रव्यूह’.

നിലാവുള്ള-രാത്രിയിൽ--ക്ലാസിക്-പ്രണയകഥകൾ-.title: നിലാവുള്ള രാത്രിയിൽ - ക്ലാസിക് പ്രണയകഥകൾ
നിലാവുള്ള-രാത്രിയിൽ--ക്ലാസിക്-പ്രണയകഥകൾ-.description: വി. രവികുമാർ വിവർത്തനം നടത്തിയ 13 ക്‌ളാസ്സിക് പ്രണയകഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരമാണ് “നിലാവുള്ള രാത്രിയിൽ”. ജർമ്മൻ കവിയായ ജോർജ്ജ് ഹെയിം, ആന്റൺ ചെക്കോവ്, മോപ്പസാങ്ങ്, മാക്സിം ഗോർക്കി, അൽഫോൺസ് ദോദെ ,  സ്റ്റെഫാൻ സ്വെയ്‌ഗ്‌, ക്ളാരിസ് ലിസ്പെക്റ്റർ, ഐസക് ബാഷെവിസ്, സിംഗർ, ഓസ്കാർ വൈൽഡ് ,ഒക്ടേവിയോ പാസ്, ഇവാൻ ബുനിൻ എന്നീ ലോക പ്രശസ്‌തരായ 11 എഴുത്തുകാരുടെ പ്രണയകഥകളാണ് പുസ്തകത്തിൽ ഉൾക്കൊള്ളിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്. ഓരോ കഥകളും ഒന്നിനൊന്ന് വ്യത്യസ്തതമായ അനുഭവം സമ്മാനിക്കുന്നു.

sera-tin-vuture-golpo.title: Sera Tin Vuture Golpo
sera-tin-vuture-golpo.description: Emon Kichhu Kando Kokhono Kokhono Aamder Songe Ghote Jar Kono Uttor Aamder Kachhe Thake Na, Jegulo Aamra Sadharonoto Vuture Kando Bole Thaki. Emoni Tantan 3te Shihoron Jagano Golpo Diye Sajano KUKU FM-Er Ei Bishesh Audio Show. Aasun Shune Neoya Jak Ruddhoswas Seisob Vuture Kando, Aar Hyan Voy Paben Na Jeno.

pakistan-crisis-is-this-the-end-of-pakis.title: Pakistan Crisis: Is This The End Of Pakistan
pakistan-crisis-is-this-the-end-of-pakis.description: Pakistan mein Economical Crisis ki wajah se hazaaron log sadkon par aa gaye hain. Desh mein ek-ek roti ke liye maramaari chal rahi hai. Aise mein pakistani military abhi bhi badi shaan ke saath apni life jee rahi hai. Kyun Pakistan ka crisis wahan ki military tak nahi pahunch saka? Aur aaj Pakistan ke aise halaat kyun hai? Is Original series mein aapko in saare sawaalon ke jawab mil jayenge. Chaliye samajhte hain Pakistan Crisis ki poori kahani ko.

breathe-believe-balance-a-guide-to-self-.title: Breathe Believe Balance :A Guide to Self-discovery and Healing
breathe-believe-balance-a-guide-to-self-.description: Unga vazhkaiya vera level la vazhanum nu aasa padureenga la ? apdina intha audio book ungalukku aanathu thaan. Work, Personal Life, Relationship ipdi vazhkaila pala nilaigal la balanced da vazhrathu epdi nu practical la solli kudukura audiobook ithu. Vaanga vera level la namma vazhkai ya vazhrathu epdi nu kathukalam.

voices-of-pride-journey-of-the-lgbtq-com.title: Voices Of Pride: Journey Of The LGBTQ Community In India
voices-of-pride-journey-of-the-lgbtq-com.description: Humari society aaj bhi homosexuals ko ek mazak aur ek gaali ki tarah dekhti hai. Lekin kya aapko maalum hai homosexuals ka itihas kabhi bhi aisa nahi tha? Phir aisa kya hua jo waqt ke saath homosexuals ek bimari ke taur par dekhe jaane lage? Aur kaise inhone apne haq ke liye awaaz uthaai? Is Original Series mein hum jaanege LGBTQ Community ke isi itihas aur homosexuals ke rights ke poore sangharsh ki kahaani.

tamil-varalaru.title: Tamil Varalaru
tamil-varalaru.description: Tamil varalaroda sirappugal, indrum maraiyaadha arupudhangal pathi indha audio book la kelunga.

7-money-rules-for-life-how-to-take-contr.title: 7 Money Rules For Life : How to Take Control of Your Financial Future
7-money-rules-for-life-how-to-take-contr.description: Taka Uparjon Korlei Hoy Na, Jante Hoy Setake Niyontron Korar Upay. Aar Ei Niyontron Korte Parlei Aapni Paben Ek Sundor Vobishyot. Sei Niyontroner Kichu Niyom Jante Aapnake Mon Diye Shunte Hobe '7 Money Rules For Life : How to Take Control of Your Financial Future'- Audio Book-Ti Ebong Egiye Jete Hobe Ek Sundor Ortho Somriddho Jiboner Dike.

become-a-smart-investor.title: Become A Smart Investor
become-a-smart-investor.description: Stock Market ek aisi market hai jise samajhna koi asaan baat nahi hai, saalon ka experience rakhne waale traders bhi apne aap ko ek learner hi kehte hain aur market ko khud se bada batate hain. Lekin jo is market ko samajh lete hain unke liye stock market mein profit earn karna koi badi baat nahi. Aise hi logon ko hum aksar "Smart Investor" bulate hain. Humare is Original Audio Show mein aap jaanenge ki aap bhi kaise ek "Smart investor" ban sakte hain aur market ko samajh sakte hain. Agar aapko 'Intelligent Investor' Jaisi books pasand hain to ye show zaroor sunein.

chandi-mangal-sarsonkhep.title: Chandimangal: Sarsonkhep
chandi-mangal-sarsonkhep.description: Bangali der modhye Manasa Mangal ar Chandimangal khub e procholito. Mangal kabyogulir modhye manasa mangaler porei ashe chandimangal kabyo. Mangal kabya dharar onyotomo holo chandimangal kabyo, ei kabye devi chandir mahatyo o morte tar puja prochar kivabe hoyeche tar prochar kora hoyeche, ei Chandimangal kabya asole ki, ebong tar koti khondoi ba royeche, ebong puraner debi chandi ar chandimangaler debi chandi ek kina ei shob bistarito bhabe jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

gorur-puran-pouranik-itihas.title: Gorur Puran : Pouranik Itihas
gorur-puran-pouranik-itihas.description: Gorur Puran Niye Nana Munir Nana Mot Aache, Oneke Bolen Eta Jibito Obosthay Pora Uchit Noy To Aabar Oneke Bolen Eta Barite Rakhle Osuvo Hoy. Kintu Aasole Ki Lekha Aache Ei Purane? Cholun Sei Kotha Jene Neoyar Chesta Korbo Ei Bisesh Audio Show Theke.

kissan-credit-card.title: Kisan Credit Card
kissan-credit-card.description: Kya Aap kheti karte hain? Ya fir karne ki soch rahein hain? Agar haan, to ye khaas audio show “Kisan Credit Card” zaroor sunein. Yeh show aapko batayega ki kaise behad kam interest rate par aap government se kheti ke liye fund yani paise ki help sakte hain. Is fund ko lekar aap apni kheti se jude expenses pe bachat bhi kar sakte hain. Aapko yeh guide karega ki kaise aap apne local bank mein Kisan Credit Card ke liye apply kar sakte hain. Saath hi aap samajh payenge un saari formalities aur documents ke baare mein jo aapko ye fund dila sakti hai

vijayaniki-ayidu-metlu.title: విజయానికి అయిదు మెట్లు
vijayaniki-ayidu-metlu.description: మిమ్మల్ని మీరు ఉన్నతులుగా తీర్చిదిద్దుకోవటం కోసం, మీ మానసిక బలహీనతల్నీ, సమస్యల్నీ అధిగమించడం కోసం, మీ అంతర్గత శక్తులు పటిష్ఠం చేసుకోవడం కోసం, మానవ సంబంధాలు మెరుగు పర్చుకోవటం కోసం, టెన్షన్, బోర్, నిరాసక్తత పారద్రోలటం కోసం , ఆర్థికంగా నిలదొక్కుకోవడం కోసం, అంతిమ విజయం సాధించటం కోసం, అందరికీ అర్థమయ్యే రీతిలో రూపొందించబడిన వ్యక్తిత్వ వికాస పుస్తకం.

manassu.title: മനസ്സ്
manassu.description: "സെൻസിയും ഞാനും", "എന്റെ മാതാപിതാക്കളും ഞാനും", "സെൻസിയും അവന്റെ നിയമവും" എന്നിങ്ങനെ മൂന്ന് ഭാഗങ്ങളായി തിരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഈ നോവൽ ഏകാന്തതയുടെയും ഒറ്റപ്പെടലിന്റെയും പ്രമേയങ്ങളെ പര്യവേക്ഷണം ചെയ്യുന്നു. ആദ്യ ഭാഗത്തിൽ, ആഖ്യാതാവ് സർവകലാശാലയിൽ ചേരുന്നു. അവിടെ അദ്ദേഹം "സെൻസി" എന്ന് മാത്രം അറിയപ്പെടുന്ന ഒരു മുതിർന്ന മനുഷ്യനുമായി ചങ്ങാത്തത്തിലാകുന്നു. നോവലിന്റെ രണ്ടാം ഭാഗത്തിൽ, ആഖ്യാതാവ് കോളേജിൽ നിന്ന് ബിരുദം നേടി, പിതാവിന്റെ മരണത്തിനായി വീട്ടിലേക്ക് മടങ്ങുന്നു. നോവലിന്റെ മൂന്നാം ഭാഗം "സെൻസി" യിൽ നിന്ന് ആഖ്യാതാവിന് ലഭിക്കുന്ന ഒരു കത്ത് വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

godman-that-kills-the-shakereh-khaleeli-.title: Godman That Kills - The Shakereh Khaleeli Murder Case
godman-that-kills-the-shakereh-khaleeli-.description: Khud ko Swami kehne wale Shraddhanand ko Police usi ki wife Shakereh Khaleeli ke murder ke jurm mein arrest karti hai. Par police ke paas is crime ka koi evindence nahi hota. 1994 mein Police ko Shakereh ki body ek box mein band milti hai, aur uske andar scratch marks milte hain. Kab aur kaise hua tha Shakereh ka khoon? Aur kaise pakda gaya Shraddhanand? Aur kyon kiya usne apni hi wife ka murder? Jaane is show mein.

ente-panchara-orange-maram.title: എന്റെ പഞ്ചാര ഓറഞ്ച്മരം
ente-panchara-orange-maram.description: റിയോ ഡി ജനീരയ്ക്ക് അടുത്തുള്ള ബൻഗു എന്ന ചെറു പട്ടണത്തിൽ ആണ് ഈ കഥ നടക്കുന്നത്. അഞ്ചു വയസ്സു കഴിഞ്ഞ സെസേയാണ് കഥാ നായകൻ. അവൻ കുഞ്ഞാണ്, ആരും പറയാതെ അക്ഷരമാല പഠിച്ച മിടുമിടുക്കൻ. അപാരമായ ഭാവനയുള്ള അവന്റെ കൂട്ടുകാരൻ സംസാരിക്കുന്ന ഒരു കൊച്ചു ഓറഞ്ചുമരമാണ് . കുസൃതിയും അലിവും ഒന്നിനൊന്നു മത്സരിക്കുന്ന സ്വഭാവ പ്രകൃതമാണ് സെസ്സെയുടെത് .അവൻ ഒരു സുഹൃത്തിനെ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നതോടുകൂടി അവന്റെ ജീവിതം മാറിമറിയുന്നു.

how-to-attract-money.title: How to Attract Money
how-to-attract-money.description: డబ్బు పుట్టిన ప్రతి మనిషికి అవసరం, డబ్బు లేకుండా ఒక్క పని కూడా అవ్వదు. కానీ మనం డబ్బు ని అట్రాక్ట్ చేయవచ్చు అనే విషయం మీకు తెలుసా? తెలియకపోతే ఒకసారి ఇది విని తెలుసుకోండి.

gautam-buddh-aur-unke-upadesh.title: Gautam Buddh Aur Unke Updesh
gautam-buddh-aur-unke-upadesh.description: Buddh ne kaha hai ki mai Tumhe kya Sikhaun, satya kabhi Sikhaya nahi jaa sakta, Satya ko Apnaya jata hai. Is Audio Book mein Gautam Buddh ke dwara diye gaye wo Updesh hain jise sunkar shayad aapki zindagi badal jae. Kuch aise baate jo hum jaante to hain par use khud par apply kaise karte hain wo nahi jaante. Kya hai Bhagwaan Buddh ke Sidharth se Buddha banne ki kahani aur kyu sab chor kar wo chal pade the Nirwan ki raah par janne ke liye suniye ye Audio Book jiska naam hai "Gautam Buddh Aur Unke Updesh".

how-to-use-the-power-of-prayer-a-motivat.title: How To Use The Power of Prayer : A Motivational Guide to Transform your Life
how-to-use-the-power-of-prayer-a-motivat.description: Joseph Murphy rasina ee pusthakam lo manam mana jeevitham lo enno aneka samasyalo tho bhadapaduthu vuntamu kani andulo nunchi baytaiki ravadaniki kavalsina margalanu matram kanugonalem aithe, ee pusthakam lo manam Scientific ga prardhana chesthe manaki kalige bavana gurinchi teliyajesthundi inkenduku mari late ventane ee audio book vinandi.

memorias-postumas-de-bras-cubas-2.title: Memórias Póstumas de Brás Cubas
memorias-postumas-de-bras-cubas-2.description: Nesta obra clássica, você vai conhecer a morte e da vida do curioso Brás Cubas,  narrada por ele mesmo após sua morte.

the-success-code-3.title: The Success Code
the-success-code-3.description: Ennathaan Maangu Maangunu hard work panninaalum Velaila promotion kidaikka maatenguthu, Salary increment aaga matenguthu nu feel panreengala ? apdi na intha audio book ungalukku thaan. Professional & Personal life la mass kaatti mathippum mariyathaiyum vazhrathukkaana athanai ideas um intha audio book la irukku. Vaanga Therinjukalam.Vetri Payanathai Start pannalam.

காற்றாய்-மாறிவிடு-.title: காற்றாய் மாறிவிடு
காற்றாய்-மாறிவிடு-.description: அஷ்டமாசித்து வரிசையில் நான்காவது சித்தான அணிமா பற்றி சிந்தித்து பின் அதற்கேற்ப கதை காலத்துடன் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்ட விறுவிறுப்பான நாவல் தொகுப்பு...

zivame-an-intimate-story.title: An Intimate Story of Zivame - Richa Kar
zivame-an-intimate-story.description: Black polythene mein chhipa kar bechi jane wali ladies undergarments ab aap online kharid sakte hain, iska credit jata hai Richa Kar ko, jinhone apni revolutionary website Zivame.com se lingerie shopping ko online aur comfortable bana diya. Par iske liye Richa ko kya kya problems face karni padi? Unke is decision par unke parents ka kya reaction tha? Kabhi Bra-panty bechne wali ladki ke naam se badnam Richa Kar kaise bani star entrepreneur? Aaiye jaante hain is show mein

satya-sai-baba-mahathyam.title: Satya Sai Baba Mahathyam
satya-sai-baba-mahathyam.description: Bharathiya adhyathmikavttha. Ithanini guruvu ani Vedanthi ani, Bhagavanthuni Avatharam ani, Shiridi Sai Baba ye marala Satya Sai Baba ga avatharinchadani vishvashistharu. Ithani mahimala patla chala mandiki aparamaina vishwasam undi.

how-to-motivate-yourself-in-difficult-ti.title: How To Motivate Yourself In Difficult Times
how-to-motivate-yourself-in-difficult-ti.description: Nammalude shakthiyum dourbalyavum nammalekkal nannayi ariyunna mattoru aalilla. Athukond thanne oru prathisandhi samayath nammale nammalekkal motivate cheyyan kazhiyunna mattoralum illa. Enthu paranjanu oru veezhchayil ninnu uyaran aavuka ennariyan urappayum ee show ningale sahayikkum. Prashnangaleyum prathisanthikaleyum tharanam cheyyan aadhyam cheyyendath nammal ipol kadannu pokunnath mosham avasthayilude aanennu swayam angeekarikkukayanu. Enkil mathrame athine face cheyyuka enna adutha step edukkan kazhiyukayullu. Athengane ennu ee show kettu kazhiyumbol ningalk manasilavum.

kjs-dhillon-indian-army-ki-sachhai.title: Indian Army ki Sachhai : LT. GEN. KJS Dhillon
kjs-dhillon-indian-army-ki-sachhai.description: Chaliye sunte hain ek aise insaan se jinki kahani apko inspire karne ke saath saath hairaan bhi bahut kregi. Hum baat kar rahe hain India ke ek aise hero ki jisne apni life ka zyadatar samay Kashmir mein bitaya. One and the Only, Retd. Lt. Gen. KJS Dhillon Sir. Aaj is audiobook mein vo apne jeevan ke kuch khas pehlu hamare saath share karte hain aur baat karte hain apni kitaab “Kitne Ghazi Aaye, Kitne Ghazi Gaye” ki.

ബോണ്‍സായ്‌.title: ബോണ്‍സായ്‌
ബോണ്‍സായ്‌.description: സമൂഹത്തിന്റെ പല തട്ടിലുള്ള പല അവസ്ഥകളിലുള്ള മനുഷ്യരുടെ കഥ പറയുന്ന പത്ത് കഥകളാണ് ബോണ്‍സായ് എന്ന ഈ കഥാസമാഹാരത്തില്‍ ഉള്ളത്. പ്രണയം, പ്രതികാരം, കുറ്റബോധം എന്നിങ്ങനെ എല്ലാതരം മാനുഷികാവസ്ഥകളെയും എഴുത്തുകാരിയായ ഹര്‍ഷ മോഹന്‍ സ്പര്‍ശിച്ചു കടന്നു പോകുന്നു. സമകാലിക സ്ത്രീ അവസ്ഥയെ തികഞ്ഞ ഉള്‍ക്കാഴ്ചയോടെ അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നുണ്ട് ഹര്‍ഷ. ഈ കഥകള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കുമ്പോള്‍ പല തരത്തിലുള്ള വികാര വേലിയേറ്റങ്ങളിലൂടെ ശ്രോതാക്കളും കടന്നു പോകുന്നു.

dashaavtar-vishnu.title: Dashaavtar Vishnu
dashaavtar-vishnu.description: Bhagwad Geeta Madhye Shri krishna Arjunala vachan detana mhanala Hoyta Ki Jevha Jevha Bhu lokavar mhanjech Pruthvilokavar Anyay ani Adharma vadhel tevha tevha Vishnu Avtar gheil ani punha Dharmachi Sthapana karel. Shri Vishnuche ekun 10 Avtar ahet mhanjech Dashaavtar ahet jyatil 9 avatar  Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Narasimha, Vamana, Parashurama, Shri Rama, Shri Krishna, Buddha ani shevatcha avtar Kalki. Kalki Avtar ya yugachya shevati mhanjech aaj pasun javalpas 4.30 lakh varshane pragat hoil. Kalki Avtar ala ki hey jag sample ani punha satya yugachi Sthapana hoil. Chala Shri Vishnuchya 9 Avtaran magchi katha janun Gheuyat ani 10 avatar kalaki avtar kasa asel ani tyachi kay lakshana astil? Janun gheuyat Dashaavtar Vishnu vishayi kuku fm var.

sea-hawk-1.title: Sea Hawk: Safar Maut Ka
sea-hawk-1.description: Apne business ko loss se bachane ke liye Mr. Batra Old ship ko new Cruise ship mein transfer karte hai. Lakin ye ek Shapit Ship hai jo tabahi ka tufan lekar aati hai. Iss baat se anjaan log New year ki party Celebrate karne phuchte hai Sea Hawk ship per aur phir shuru hota hai khaufnaak ghatnaye aur maut ka khel. To kya hoga jab siren karegi sab ka sikar? Bech samundra mein kaise bachayenge log khud ko? Jaanane ke liye sune puri kahani ‘Sea Hawak: Safar Maut ka’ sirf Kuku FM per.

muhammad-nabi.title: Muhammad Nabi
muhammad-nabi.description: Deivam thante sandheshangal manushya raashik ethikkunnath deivadhoothanmariloodeyanu ennanu vishwasam. Islam vishwasam anusarich, attharam deivadoothanmar lokathinte ella bhaagangalilum manushya samoohathe nayikkan vannitundennanu. Ee parambarayile avasanatha kanniyanu Muhammad Nabi. Enthayirunnu Muhammad Nabiyude savishesha vyakthithwam? Vishadhamayi ariyam 'Muhammad Nabi' enna ee audio showiloode.

falcon-journey-beyond-the-galaxy-1.title: Falcon: Journey Beyond The Galaxy
falcon-journey-beyond-the-galaxy-1.description: Kehte hain ki Folchraydous naam ke planet ke jeevon ke liye Prithvi kisi zehreele gole ki tarah hai. Phir bhi hyperspace se ek naya ajnabee; Falcon, ek khaas cheez ki talaash mei prithvi par aaya tha. Prithvi se nafrat karne ke bawajood Falcon kaise survive karega yahan? Aakhir kis maqsad ko poora karne ke liye use is nayi duniya mei aana pada? Jaaniye Falcon ka safar aur uska sach. Sirf Kuku FM par.

india-automated.title: India Automated
india-automated.description: Oru dhashalakhshathil adhikam aalukal oro maasavum jolikk thayyaredukkunna oru rajyathy, automation ennathu drishyamakunathinekal vegathilum aazhathilum valarunnu. Ee vardhana ishtapedatha maattamayo manushyarude upajeevanathinu bheeshiniyayo prethyekshapettekam ennu cpalaru vishwasikkunnu. Ennal yatharthyam enthanu? Pranjal Sharma rachicha 'India Automated' enna pusthakathiloode ningalkk ivaye kurichellam vishadhamayi manasilaakam. Kelku 'Indian Automated' enna audiobook.

8-chiranjeevi.title: Ashta (8) Chiranjeevi Rahsya
8-chiranjeevi.description: Ashtha (8) Chiranjeevi na aplya Hindu dharmat mahtwache sthan ahe. Pan he 8 Chiranjeevi nemake kon ahet? Tyana Amaratva ka bara milala ahe? Kalki yuga madhe tyanche karya kay? ani mulat he Fact ahe ki Myth? Chala janun gheuya ya prashnanchi uttara, Mystery of 8 Immortals arthat 8 (Ashtha) Chiranjeevinche Rahsta ya aplya khas show madhun...

how-to-save-more-money-in-2023.title: How To Save More Money In 2023
how-to-save-more-money-in-2023.description: Apni daily life mein agar aap extra savings karna chahte hain toh ye show aapke liye hi hai. Humari daily life mein kayi aisi habits hoti hai jo humse extra expenses karwati hain but agar hum un extra expenses ko sahi se track kar sakein toh yahi extra kharch humari savings ban sakti hai. Toh chaliye bina deri ke hum apne pehle episode ki taraf badhte hain.

shri-krishner-10ti-bani-diye-jibon-bodla.title: Shri Krishner 10ti Bani Diye Jibon Bodlan
shri-krishner-10ti-bani-diye-jibon-bodla.description: Ajker bartaman somoy amra protyeke byasto, ebong amade rmodhye manoshik chaap ba stress kromosho barche, tar songe bhobishyoter chinta, otiter dukkho amader ke bhito kore dei. Nijeder manoshik chaap mukto korte amra doctor er kache jayi botei kintu amra anek somoy e ei chaap e jorjorito hoye pori. Apnarao nijeder jiboner sokoler somoshyar somadhan korte chan ba Shhri Krishner dekhano pothe cholle apni jemon apnar jibone asha biboder mokabila korte parben temoni apnar jibon ke dekha drishti bhongi bodle jabe, tai ar deri na kore shune nin ei audio story ti.

dabbu-minus-dabbu.title: డబ్బు మైనస్ డబ్బు
dabbu-minus-dabbu.description: ప్రేయసి పుట్టిన రోజున కనీసం ఫోన్‌ చేసి విషెస్‌ చెప్పడానికి కూడా రూపాయి లేని ఓ యువకుడు, ప్రేమకు డబ్బుల రెక్కలు కట్టి ప్రేయసితో ఆకాశపుటంచుల్లో విహరించి – స్విట్జర్లాండ్‌ ప్రకృతి సౌందర్యాన్ని ఆస్వాదిస్తూ రాసలీలా రమ్య శోభిత రసడోలికల్లో తేలియాడడం ‘కల’లో సాధ్యమేమోగానీ – ‘ఇల’లో కాదు. అసాధ్యాలను సుసాధ్యాలుగా మలచగల రచయిత యండమూరి వీరేంద్రనాథ్‌ వినూత్న సృష్టి – నేటి బ్యాంకింగ్‌ సిస్టమ్‌ లొసుగుల నేపధ్యంలో ప్రేయసి కోసం లక్షలకు లక్షలు ఆర్జించిన ఓ జీనియస్‌ లవర్స్‌ లవ్లీ టేల్‌ ఆఫ్‌ లవ్‌ ‘డబ్బు మైనస్‌ డబ్బు’.

sardar-patel-1.title: Sardar Patel Tatha Bhartiya Musalman
sardar-patel-1.description: Sardar Patel ne apne poore jivan mein Bharat ko sanyukt desh banane ki koshish ki. Wo humesha chahte the ki hum sabhi ke beech bhaichara yunhi bana rahe. Lekin azadi ke waqt jab Hindu - Musalman ko alag kiya ja raha tha, us dauran unki ye soch kitni rang laayi? Kya Bharat aur Pakistan ko alag nahi karne ke liye Sardar Patel ne wakayi sangharsh kiya tha? Aur aakhir kyun unka naam itihaas mein bahut sochne ke baad yaad aata hai? Janenge is audiobook mein.

lock-up.title: Lock Up
lock-up.description: During the peak of the Corona lockdown, this incident Shocked  the entire Tamil Nadu. John and Stephen, who were living happily with their own business and having a good respect in the town, one day  taken to the police station for an enquiry. That event turns their lives upside down. What happened to John and Stephen? Listen on your Kuku FM.

டம்ளர்-.title: டம்ளர்
டம்ளர்-.description: 15 நாட்கள் வெளியூர் செல்லும் கணவனிடம் அவர் மனைவி தன் ஞாபகமாக ஒரு டம்ளரை கொடுத்து அனுப்புகிறார். அந்தக் கணவனுக்கு அந்த டம்ளரின் மூலம் கிடைத்த அனுபவங்களையும், அதைப் பற்றிய நினைவுகளையும் அழகாக நம் கண்முன் கொண்டு வருகிறார் பாலகுமாரன்...

the-secret-to-living-your-best-life-now.title: The Secret To Living Your Best Life Now
the-secret-to-living-your-best-life-now.description: Doston, Yeh Zindagi hamein dobara nahi milegi to kyon na isi Zindagi ko best banayein. Suniye ye khaas audioshow aur jaaniye un secrets ke baare mein jo aapki khushiyaan, aapka success aur aapke confidence ko transform karegi. Agar aapko "Change your Life Now" jaisi life changing books pasand hain, to yeh show aapko zaroor pasand aayega.

வெற்றிக்-குதிரை-.title: வெற்றிக் குதிரை
வெற்றிக்-குதிரை-.description: ஒரு நல்ல பத்திரிகையாளனாக வர வேண்டும் என்ற லட்சியத்துடன் சென்னை வரும் கதாநாயகனுக்கு ஒரு அரசியல்வாதியின் அறிமுகம் கிடைக்கிறது. அவருக்கு மேடைப் பேச்சுகள் தயாரித்துக் கொடுக்கிறான். அந்த அரசியல்வாதி அவனைப் பகடைக் காயாக்கி தன் அரசியல் எதிரியைப் பழி வாங்கத் திட்டமிடுகிறார். அதை அறியாத அப்பாவி கதாநாயகன் அவரின் சதியில் சிக்கிக்கொள்கிறான். பெரும் பெரும் முதலைகளின் நடுவே சிக்கிக்கொள்ளும் அப்பாவி கதாநாயகனின் நிலை என்ன ஆனது? தன்னை ஆபத்தில் சிக்க வைத்த அரசியல்வாதியைப் பழித் தீர்த்தானா? பரபரப்பான இக்கதையை உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்எம் ல் கேளுங்கள்.

தயங்காதே-தப்பில்லை-.title: தயங்காதே தப்பில்லை
தயங்காதே-தப்பில்லை-.description: இரண்டு டிராக்குகளில் பயணம் செய்யும் துப்பறியும் கதை இது. ஒன்றுக்கொன்று தொடர்பு இல்லாதது போலத் தொடங்கி கடைசியில் இரண்டு கதைகளுக்கும் சரியான, காரண காரியங்களுடன் தொடர்பை வெளிப்படுத்தும் யுத்தியில் எழுதப்பட்ட இந்த தயங்காதே, தப்பில்லை!' கதையில் ஒரு அடையாளம் தெரியாத பிணத்தைக் கைப்பற்றும் ஒரு காவல் அதிகாரி அந்த வழக்கைத் துப்பறிவார். மற்றொரு டிராக்கில் ஒரு சினிமா கதாநாயகியின் வாழ்க்கைப் பின்னனியும், அதில் படரும் மர்ம முடிச்சுகளும் பிரதானமாக இடம் பெறும். புதிர்கள் அவிழும் தருணத்தில் பல ஆச்சர்யங்கள் காத்திருக்கும். கேளுங்கள் உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்எம் ல்...

mahabaharat.title: Mahabharat
mahabaharat.description:
Mahabharat, Hindu dharm ke pramukh grantho mein se ek. Dekha jaye toh Mahabharat sirf ek granth hi nahi, balki woh itihaas hai jo har kisi ke kal aaj aur ane wale kal ka hissa hai. 
shree Krishan ki sikhaye uddesh, Mahabharat me hone wala har ek vakya hume zindagi jeene ke kai trike sikhata hai. 
Usi mahan granth ki gatha le kar pesh hai kuku FM aap sabhi ke leye ek romanchak trike se.

ரங்கூன்-பெரியப்பா-.title: ரங்கூன் பெரியப்பா
ரங்கூன்-பெரியப்பா-.description: சிறு வயதிலேயே ஊரை விட்டு ரங்கூனுக்கு ஓடிப்போகும் வீர ராகவ ஐயர், ரங்கூனில் கடினமாக உழைத்து, தொழில் செய்து பெரும் செல்வந்தராக முன்னேறுகிறார். பிறகு தான் சம்பாதித்த செல்வங்களுடன் தனது ஊருக்கு திரும்புகிறார். ஊர் திரும்பிய அவருக்கு தனது தம்பிகள் இல்லையென்றும் அவர்களின் மகன்களான சந்தருவும் கல்யாணமும் தான் தனக்கு இருக்கும் இறுதி ரத்த சொந்தம் என்பதும் தெரிய வருகிறது. இருவரில் யாருக்கேனும் ஒருவருக்கு தனது சொத்துக்களை எழுதி வைக்க வீர ராகவ ஐயர் எண்ணுகிறார். சந்தருவும் கல்யாணமும் ரங்கூன் பெரியப்பாவின் சொத்துக்கு ஆசைப் படுகிறார்கள். போட்டியும் நடக்கிறது. இறுதியில் ரங்கூன் பெரியப்பாவின் சொத்து யாருக்குச் சென்றது? கேளுங்கள் உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்எம் ல்.

o-alienista.title: ALIENISTA de Machado de Assis
o-alienista.description: Esta obra de Machado de Assis conta a história de dr. Simão Bacamarte, um respeitado médico que criou um um hospício na cidade de Itaguaí, para aprofundar seus estudos sobre a loucura. Mas o que parecia ser uma boa ideia, começou a causar pânico na cidade, após  uma série de internações questionáveis por parte do doutor.

மூன்றாம்-சக்தி-.title: மூன்றாம் சக்தி
மூன்றாம்-சக்தி-.description: ஏழை குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த அய்யனாருக்கு, தாய் மற்றும் மூன்று சகோதரிகள். நகைக் கடைகளில் சீட்டுப்பணம் வசூலிப்பவன், அட்சய திதியன்று வசூலித்த பணத்தை முத்துலிங்க அடியாட்கள் திருடிய பின் அவனுடைய வாழ்க்கையே மாறிப் போகிறது. நண்பன் கணேசனின் உதவியால் வாழைக்காய் சித்தரைச் சந்திக்கிறான். சந்தித்தப்பின் அவனுடைய வாழ்வில் ஏற்பட்ட மாற்றங்கள் என்னென்ன?

history-zone.title: History Zone
history-zone.description: Oru cheriya thuramukham Kozhikode aayi valarnath enganeyanen ningalk ariyamo? Archival and research project co-founder Sruthin Lal vivarikkunna History Zone enna showiloode Kozhikode-inteyum Saamothirimarudeyum charithra kadha thrassippikkunna roopena kelku. Vividha charithrakarenmare ulpeduthi charithra padanangalilooni vikasippichedutha ee show thudangunnath keralolpathi grandhathile aitheehya kadha parenjanu.

agent-vyom-from-russia-with-love.title: Agent Vyom: From Russia with Love
agent-vyom-from-russia-with-love.description: Ek khaas mission ke chalte ek R&AW agent, KGB spy aur Telepathic bachchi family ki tarah ek saath rehne lagte hain. Lekin unke piche padi hai duniya ki sabse khatarnak Terrorist Organization. Kya teenon sahi salamat apne mission ko poora kar payenge? Janne ke liye sunein Agent Vyom: From Russia with Love, sirf Kuku FM par.

shree-ganpati-puja-vidhi-ganesh-chaturth.title: Shree Ganesh Puja Vidhi
shree-ganpati-puja-vidhi-ganesh-chaturth.description: Khas aplyasathi Kuku FM war gheun alo ahot, Shree parthiv Mahaganpati Pooja. Shri Ganeshachi Prana Pratishtha Pooja, Vidhi, Pujeche Sahitya, Tayari tasech Visarajan purvichi Uttar Pooja, Aarti ani Mantra pushpanjali he sara kahi milwa ek click war.

chanakya-nithi-kautilaya-arthashastra-en.title: Chanakya Niti & Kautilaya Arthashastra
chanakya-nithi-kautilaya-arthashastra-en.description: Delve into the profound wisdom of Chanakya, the renowned scholar and strategist, through this audiobook. It encapsulates his three major works - 'Chanakya Neeti,' 'Chanakya Sutras,' and 'Kautilya Arthashastra.' In this insightful guide, the secrets of success, knowledge, excellence, and Chanakya's strategies are beautifully interpreted. This audiobook offers in-depth discussions on achieving success and mastering the art of effective governance. Explore Chanakya's timeless teachings, benefiting both individuals and those in positions of leadership.

श्री-कृष्ण”--Heart-of-the-Universe.title: श्री कृष्ण : Heart of the Universe
श्री-कृष्ण”--Heart-of-the-Universe.description: “Shree Jagannath Mandir Puri” mei is waqt ha-ha-kaar macha tha. Duniya bhar mein andhera chaa gaya tha aur Antriksh se Dharti tak bhayanak aawazein aa rahi thi. Barish, toofan, bijli aur bhookamp se Dharti pareshan thi aur ek jhatke mei bijli ke dheron device dhwast ho gaye. 12 saal baad, aaj Bhagwan Shree Jagannath Ji ki moorti se wo “Brahma-Padarth” badla jaana tha, jise is poori duniya ka dil, Shree Krishna ka dil kaha jaata tha. Theek usi waqt Mandir ke Pujari se hui ek aisi galti, jisne poori duniya mein tabahi macha di. Shree Krishna ke dil se nikli wo “Brahma-Shakti” gayab thi aur us dil ko Shaitani taaqaton ne apne kabze mei le liya tha. Aakhir kya hai bhagwan Shree Krishna ke dil ka ye raaz, jiske gayab hote hi duniya Trahi -Trahi karne lagi?  Abhi sunein “श्री कृष्ण“: The Heart of the Universe”

be-your-own-sunshine-part-2-foundation-s.title: Foundation Stones To Happiness And Success
be-your-own-sunshine-part-2-foundation-s.description: Uncover the path to genuine happiness and success with "Foundation Stones to Happiness and Success" by James Allen. This audiobook offers profound insights that guide listeners toward self-discovery and purposeful living. Delve into the core principles of personal growth, positive thinking, and resilience as Allen explores the keys to lasting contentment. Embark on a transformative journey to holistic success as you embrace the foundational principles presented in this inspiring audiobook.

agadhanadhi.title: അഗാധനദി
agadhanadhi.description: ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ അര്‍ഥവും ബന്ധങ്ങളിലെ സങ്കീര്‍ണതകളും മതം ഈശ്വരന്‍ എന്നിവകളുടെ പൊരുളും തേടുന്ന നോവലാണ് എന്‍ദോ ഷൂസാകു എന്ന ജാപ്പനീസ് എഴുത്തുകാരന്റെ അഗാധനദി. ഒരു ജാപ്പനീസ് യാത്രാസംഘത്തോടൊപ്പം ഇന്ത്യ സന്ദര്‍ശിക്കുന്ന, കൃത്യമായ യാത്രോദ്ദേശ്യമുള്ള വ്യത്യസ്തരായ നാലുപേര്‍...അവര്‍ ഗംഗാനദിയുടെ പരിസരങ്ങളില്‍ തങ്ങളുടെ ഇന്നലെകളെ പൂര്‍ത്തീകരിക്കുന്നതിനായുള്ള എന്തൊക്കെയോ തിരയുകയാണ്. ദൈവം എന്നത്, പ്രകൃതിയിലും മനുഷ്യനിലുമെല്ലാം കുടികൊള്ളുന്ന ഒരു ആന്തരികശക്തിയാണെന്ന തിരിച്ചറിവിലേക്ക് അവര്‍ എത്തിച്ചേരുന്നു.

class-9th-geography.title: NCERT Class 9th Geography
class-9th-geography.description: Class mein first aana ho ya UPSC ki taiyaari karni ho ya phir kisi competitive exam mein acchi Rank lani ho, Shuruaat to book utha kar padhne se hi karni hogi. Lekin bookish language ko samajhna thoda sa mushkil ho jata hai. KUKU fm par yeh original series apke isi problem ka solution hai. Jise sun kar aap Climate, India Size and Location aur Drainage System jaise topics ko bahut hi achhe se samajh jaayenge aur saath hi inse jude examples aur important questions aapko exam ki taiyaari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge.

lic-investment-kashi-karavi.title: LIC Investment Kashi Karavi
lic-investment-kashi-karavi.description: LIC Investment Tip and Trick Jar tumhala hi janun ghyachya ahet? Life insucrance konta kontya veli kadhava yachi mahiti havi ahe tar ha show tumchya sathi ahe. LIC chi jeevan bima yojan, LIC pension scheme ya ani ya sarkhya baraych scheme baddal tumhala ya show madhye mahiti milel. Thodkyat Ya show dware tumhla LIC chi ABCD shikayla milnar ahe.

diet-plan-to-lose-weight-with-nutritiona.title: Diet Plan To Lose Weight - With Nutritional Expert
diet-plan-to-lose-weight-with-nutritiona.description: Busy Life mein weight loss karne aur khud ko fit aur healthy rakhne ke liye Gym jaane se zyada important hai healthy diet lena. Is Original series mein aap Nutrition & Fitness Expert Varnit Yadav ki help se kuch aise hi tips aur knowledge jaan jaayenge jisse easily aap healthy way mein weight loss bhi kar sakte hain aur saath hi ek healthy life bhi jee sakte hain.

rohoshyomoy-morgan-house.title: Sunday Thriller Stories: Rohoshyomoy Morgan House
rohoshyomoy-morgan-house.description: Amra Bangali ra kom beshi sokolei Darjeeling, Kalimpong bohu baar ghure esechi, ar ei sokoler priyo Kalimpong e ekti bohu purono jayega ache jar name Morgan House. Loke Kalimpong e ghurte gele anekei ei bari te thakte chaye, ebong thakar prodhan karon holo oshoririder aach pawa. Ei Morgan House jemon tar brihot itihas, soundorjer jonnyo porichito, thik temoni porichito ei jayegar aloukik shob ghotona, jodi apnio ghurte jawar aage ekbar shei shob aloukik ghotonar byapare jante chan, tahole ar deri na kore shune nin Sunday Thriller Stories er ei audio story ti.

kivabe-apnar-sontan-ke-competitive-exam-.title: Kivabe Apnar Sontan Ke Competitive Exam Er Jonno Ready Korben?
kivabe-apnar-sontan-ke-competitive-exam-.description: Keu doctor, ba engineer, ba keu onyo kichu, chhele meye ra joto na chintay thake, baba maa ra taar thekeo beshi chintito thake. Ar ekhonkar somoy tao onyo, ekhon aage kar moto ghore ghore sorkari chakri jote na sokoler, tai sobai kei adaa jol kheye shob rokomer competitive exams er jonno prostuti nite hoi. Apni ba apnar chele meyeo jodi competitive exam er jonno prostuti nite chaye tahole ar deri na kore shune nin ei audio story ti.

class-9-history-1.title: NCERT Class 9th History
class-9-history-1.description: Class mein first aana ho ya UPSC ki taiyari karni ho ya phir kisi competitive exam mein achhi Rank laani ho, Shuruaat to NCERT book utha kar padhne se hi karni hogi. KUKU fm par yeh original series apke isi problem ka solution hai. Jise sun kar aap The French Revolution, Socialism in Europe and the Russian Revolution, Nazism and the Rise of Hitler jaise topics ko achhe se jaan jaayenge aur saath hi inse jude examples aur important questions aapko exam ki taiyari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge.

just-fcking-do-it-2.title: Just F*cking Do It
just-fcking-do-it-2.description: Meeru Alochinche vidhananni marchadam dvaara mariyu Prapancham tho paraspara charya cheyadam dvaara mathrame nijamaina vyakthigatha abhivruddhi sadhinchabaduthundi. Think it, Get it ane hit Podcast srustikartha rasina ee pusthakam, Mee jivithanni meruguparachadaniki uddeshapurvaka mariyu Acharanathmaka dashalatho patu, Aakarshana niyamanni upayoginchadam dvaara mee vijayanni mariyu Aanandanni rettimpu chese shakthi meeku undani nirupisthundi.

my-life-i-decide-19-thought-provoking-id.title: My Life I decide: 19 thought provoking ideas to change your life
my-life-i-decide-19-thought-provoking-id.description: Unga vazhkaiya neenga vazhrathuku thadaiyaa irukkura ellathayum adichu norukki unga vaazhkaiya neenga vaazhradhukku neenga enna pannanumnu vazhi solluthu intha audiobook. Thadaigala odachu tharamaana vaazhkaiya vaazha intha audiobook ka kelunga.

kaise-banein-sip-se-ameer.title: Kaise Banein SIP Se Crorepati
kaise-banein-sip-se-ameer.description: Agar main aapse kahun ki mere paas ek scheme hai jisse aap rato raat Ameer ban sakte hain to shayad aap meri baat par yakin na karen, lekin jab mai aapse kahunga ki Rich Dad Poor Dad book ki tarf mai bhi aapko wo sare upay bataunga jisse aap Ameer ban sakte hain tab shayad aap meri baat par zaroor yakin karenge. Hum sab jante hain ki Investment se ye sab mumkin hai lekin sath he Agar aap SIP Mutual Fund ke kuch rules ko follow karenge to aapko jaldi he Ameer banne se koi nahi rok sakta. Is Audio Book "Kaise Banein SIP Se Crorepati" mein hamne un sare formula ke bare mein baat ki hai jo aapke Crorepati banne ke Journey mein aapki madad karegi.

hathras-gonodhorshon-ek-samajik-lojja.title: Hathras Gonodhorshon: Ek Samajik Lojja
hathras-gonodhorshon-ek-samajik-lojja.description: 2020 saale, 14th September ki emon holo Hathras e ja bodle dilo gota bharatbarsher bhabna chitna, mohila o amader somaj byabosthar opor? Keno gono dhorshon korlo shei 4ti uchu jaater lok shei Dalit meyeti ke? Shei 4 obhijukto ki ekhono jail e, naki khub sohojei chaara peye gechilo dhorshoner obhijog theke, shei nirdosh dalit meyetir e ba ki holo, ei shob jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

gorvo-nirodhok-ki-khotikarok.title: Gorvo Nirodhok Ki Khotikarok?
gorvo-nirodhok-ki-khotikarok.description: 2023 e dariye ekhon kintu sokolei nijeder jibon niye khub e socheton, shey arthik dik diye hok, manoshik ba sharirik. Tai ekhon sobai bojhe je ekti poribar shuru korar aage anek gulo jinish e mathaye rakha proyojon, aage jemon anekei hut haat gorvo nirodhok kheye nito sabdhanoto bojaye rakhar jonno, ebong aneke jantou na tar khotikarok diker somporke. Ekhon puro bishoitai anek ta bodleche, gorvo nirodhok koto ta khoitkarok, ba adou khotikarok kina ei shob bishoy jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

prashuram.title: Lord Parashurama
prashuram.description:
Kya pata hai apko ki Parashurama ne kyun aur kaise kiya tha kshatriyaon ka vadh?
Is show mein apko pata chalega ki kaise ek sadharan dikhne wale Brahmin ne apni ek kulhadi se kai kitabon mein apna naam darz karwa diya.
Parashurama ko mile vardan, unki vidya, unki takat ki kahani hai apko ek romanchak safar par le jayegi..

rankavi-mahanor.title: Na dho Mahanor
rankavi-mahanor.description: Rankavi kinva Nisarga Kavi ashi olakh aslele, Maharashtrache ladke divangat sahityik mhanje Na.Dho.Mahanor. Mahanorani Kala, Sahitya kshetra sobatch Rajkaran ani Samajkarnathi khup mothe karya kele ahe. Aikuya tyancha Prernadayi Jeevan parawas

saint-namdev.title: Santa Namdev Maharaj
saint-namdev.description: Santa Namdev Maharajanchi mahati varnavi kiti... Maharashtra cha santa paramparetil ek agragnya naav. Nissim Vitthal bhakta aslelya Santa Namdevanche Abhanga aplyala Sukhi Jeevanache saar sangtat. Aikuya, Bhakti margatun Loka kalyancha prasar karnare ani Bhagwat dharmache pranete Shri santa Namdev maharaj yanchi Jeevngatha. Vitthal Vitthal, jay hari Vitthal

biografia-pele.title: Rei Pelé, eterno
biografia-pele.description:
"Rei Pelé, Eterno" conta a extraordinária história de vida de Edson Arantes do Nascimento, conhecido mundialmente como Pelé. Considerado por muitos o maior jogador de futebol de todos os tempos, Pelé transcendeu as fronteiras do esporte e se tornou uma figura icônica e inspiradora para pessoas do mundo todo.
Junte-se a nós e conheça essa história surpreendente e inspiradora!

vinno-swader-sera-10-chhoto-golpo.title: Vinno Swader Sera 10 Chhoto Golpo
vinno-swader-sera-10-chhoto-golpo.description: Bangla Sahityo Jogot Nana Lekhoker Nana Ghoranar Golpo Dwara Somriddho. Kuku Fm Er Ei Bisesh Audio Show-Te Emon Bachhai Kora Kichu Namkora Lekhoker 10Ti Vinno Ghoranar Golpo Neoya Hoyeche Ja Aapnar Valo Lagbe. Tahole Aar Deri Na Jhotpot Shune Nin.

fd-vs-sip.title: FD vs SIP
fd-vs-sip.description: Jab bhi hum investment karne ke baare mein sochte hain to bahut saare investment options humare man mein aane lagte hain, jaise SIP karein ya FD? Koi kehta hai ki SIP mein accha interest milega to koi kehta hai FD mein paisa safe hai? Ab aap kya choose karein? Is sawal ka jawab milega is Original Show mein. Toh der kis baat ki, chaliye sahi investment option choose karne ki tarafh badhte hain.

mee-budget-ni-rupondinchi-anusarinchandi.title: Mee Budget Ni Rupondinchi, Anusarinchandi
mee-budget-ni-rupondinchi-anusarinchandi.description: Budget ee padam mana andariki telusu, friends tho trip vellinappudu lekapothe shopping ki vellinappudu manam budget ane padam vadutham, budget lo chaala rakalu kuda untayi ane vishyam meeku telusa? state Budget, central budget ane samavesha lu kuda meeru vine untaru, kani ee budget ane danini ey pranalika tho chestharu, inka indulo unna types enti ila aneka vishayalu telusukovadaniki meeru ee audio book vinalsindhe.

gadima-babuji-geeta-ramayan.title: Padadyamagil Geetramayan
gadima-babuji-geeta-ramayan.description: Ga. Di. Madgulkar ani Sudheer Phadke yanni Rachlel "Geetramayan' ha marathi manacha halava kopra ani abhimanaspad theva ahe. Valmiki Ramayanapasun tya nantarchya kalat rachali geleli anek ranayane, hee Ovibaddha, Shlokbaddh hoti. Pn Gadimanni rachlel 'Geetramayan' hee geet rupatli pahilich Ramkatha ahe. 'Geetramayan' sakar hot astana paddyamage nakki kay kay ghadat hot, aikuya kuku FM sobat, 'Padadyamagil Geetramayan' madhye.

usando-os-gatilhos-mentais-para-fazer-se.title: Usando os gatilhos mentais para fazer seu negócio crescer
usando-os-gatilhos-mentais-para-fazer-se.description:
Está precisando de ajuda para fazer mais sucesso no seu negócio e, também, nos relacionamentos? Então este livro é pra você! Aqui, explicamos o que são os gatilhos mentais e fornecemos orientações sobre como usar os principais gatilhos de forma eficaz.
Por meio de exemplos e estudos de caso, você vai descobrir o poder da comunicação, melhorar sua capacidade de se conectar com os outros e ter sucesso em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

how-billionares-think.title: How Billionaires Think?
how-billionares-think.description: “Adhiga Panam nimmathi ku kedu nu solravanga ellarume periya panakkaran ah dhan irukeenga” nu Jagame Thanthiram Suruli solluvan. Adhu epdi panakkaran mela mela panakkaran aagite irukaan. Middle class aalunga ellarum apdiye irukom? Orey oru periya vithyasam dhan, Thought Process. Billionaires yaarume nammala madiri yosikiradhu illa. Avanga thinking ellam vera level la irukum. Apdi enna dhan yosipanga nu therinjuka kelunga “How Billionaires think?” on Kuku FM

dasbodh.title: Shree Dasboadh Nirupan
dasbodh.description: Shri Ramdas Swami yani lihilela, mahan Hindu dhrama grantha mhnje 'Dasboadh'. Ha Grantha jari hajaro varashnpurvi lihila gela asla, tari tya madhe agdi ajcha modern kalatil samsyanvarhi upay sapdtat. Chala tar mag aikuya, Dashbodhatun aplyala milaleli Shikvan...

vishwa-itihas-ki-bhumika.title: Vishwa Itihas Ki Bhumika
vishwa-itihas-ki-bhumika.description: Aakhir ye duniya kitni purani hai shayad hazaron lakhon saal aur naa jaane in hazaron salon mein is duniya mein kitne badlav aaye, par aakhir in sab ki shuruat kaise hui? Kahan se shuruat hui manav jaati ki, Dharm ki? Kaise shuruat hui Sabhyataon ki aur kaha se shuru huwa Islam ka uday? Kya hai is Vishwa Itihas ki Bhumika aur Aakhir kisne rakhi iski neev janne ke liye Suniye ye Audio Book.

andal.title: Andal
andal.description: Andal Oda mahimai mattum illama sila mukkiya amsangal kondadhu dhaan indha audio book.
