kanthamala-charitham-2-arolakadinte-raha.title: കാന്തമല ചരിതം രണ്ടാം അദ്ധ്യായം - അറോലക്കാടിൻ്റെ രഹസ്യം
kanthamala-charitham-2-arolakadinte-raha.description: നൂറ്റാണ്ടുകളായി കേൾക്കുന്ന മിത്തുകളുടെ യാഥാർഥ്യം തേടിയിറങ്ങിയ മിഥുന്റെ യാത്രകൾ തുടരുകയാണ്. പുരാതന ഈജിപ്തിലും പഴങ്കഥകളിലെ ശബരിമലയിലും തമിഴ്‌നാടിന്റെ പ്രാചീനചരിത്രത്തിലും കെട്ടുപിണഞ്ഞു കിടക്കുന്ന ആ അടരുകളെ അതിസൂക്തമമായി കോർത്തിണക്കുന്ന  നോവലാണ് കാന്തമല ചരിതം രണ്ടാം ഭാഗമായ ആറോലക്കാടിന്റെ രഹസ്യം.

mini-habits-2.title: Mini Habits : Smaller Habits, Bigger Results
mini-habits-2.description: "Chhoti - Chhoti Magar Moti Baatein". Aapne agar 90 ke dashak mein agar TV serial Shaktiaman dekha hai to ye line bhi suni hi hogi. Aur ye bhi jaante honge ki chhoti aur achchi habits ka impact bahut bada aur achcha hota hai jo aapko bade Aim tak pahunchane mein madad karta hai. Isilye KUKU Fm le aaya hai Stephen Guise ki likhi kitab Mini Habits: Smaller Habits, Bigger Results ki Audiobook vo bhi hindi mein.

how-to-own-the-world.title: How to Own the World
how-to-own-the-world.description: Intha Ulagathai namma vasathula vachuka namma konjum smart ah irukka vendiyathu avasiyam. Ungalukkana smart aana investment tips ah intha book ungalukku kodukkum. Vaanga vetrikkana payanathai nokki pogalaam.

a-biblia-sagrada.title: A Bíblia Sagrada
a-biblia-sagrada.description:
O livro do Êxodo faz parte do Antigo Testamento da Bíblia e relata eventos significativos na história do povo de Israel.
O nome ""Êxodo"" significa ""saída"" ou ""partida"" em grego, referindo-se à saída do povo de Israel do Egito. O livro começa descrevendo a opressão e a escravidão dos israelitas no Egito. Moisés, o personagem central do livro, é escolhido por Deus para liderar o povo de Israel em sua libertação.

panniru-aalvargal.title: Panniru Aalvargal
panniru-aalvargal.description: Maha Vishnuvai vazhipadum Vainava mathathin mukkiya angathinargalaana Panniru Aazhwaargalin vaazhkaiyai azhagu Thamizhil azhagaai vilakkugirathu intha audiobook. Vaarungal bakthi rasam sottum intha pathivai kettu aazhwaargalin arulai peruvom.

7-vallalgal.title: 7 Vallalgal
7-vallalgal.description: Alli alli kodukuravungala Vallal parambarai nu solluvom. Appadi patta Vallalgaloda Varalaarai ungalukku eduthu solra oru Audio Book thaan ithu. Vaanga 7 Vallalgalai pathi therinjukalaam.

medicine-in-motion.title: Medicina em movimento: um guia passo a passo para se tornar um médico
medicine-in-motion.description: Você sabe o que é necessário para conquistar a tão sonhada carreira de medicina no Brasil? Descubra as respostas na nossa série especial  Medicina em Movimento.

tao-te-ching-2.title: Tao Te Ching
tao-te-ching-2.description: Tao Te Ching ane pusthakam Laozi ane rachaytha 1868 lo rachinchadu. Idhi china ki oka pavitram grandham. Ee grandham lo manava jeevitham, samajam, shasthralu mariyu samasyalaki sambadinchina enno aneka vishyala gurinchi rachayatha teliyaparichadu. meeru Kuda a vishayala gurinchi telusukovalante ee audio book vinalsindhe.

the-mastery-of-destiny.title: The Mastery of Destiny
the-mastery-of-destiny.description: " ది మాస్టరీ అఫ్ డెస్టినీ " ... ఆలోచన శక్తి,, ఆత్మ విశ్వాసం మీ సొంతం చేసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? కానీ ఎక్కడ, ఎలా మొదలు పెట్టాలో అర్ధం కావట్లేదా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

dreams-to-dollar-startup-adventures-1.title: Dreams To Dollar: Startup Adventures
dreams-to-dollar-startup-adventures-1.description: Business mein apne dosto se mile dhoke ke baad Aman tut jata hai. New business shuru karne ke liye apne papa se help mangta hai lekin vo mana kar dete hai. Carless, nikamma Aman kaise khud ko proof karega ki vo jaisa dikhta hai vaisa hai nahi. Apne new business mein kya  Aman success ho payega. Bina finance ya funding ke kaise vo apne business ko sambhalega? Janane ke liye suniye kahani 'Dreams to Dollar: startup Adventures' sirf Kuku FM per.

career-crush-1.title: Career Crush

ஆகாயத்தில்-ஆரம்பம்-.description: கிரண், ராவ், அலெக்ஸ்   ஆகிய மூவருக்கும்  ஒரு பிரபல விஞ்ஞானியைக் கடத்தவேண்டும் என்கிற வேலை தரப்படுகிறது. அதைத் தடுப்பதற்கு காவல்துறையின் துப்பறியும் மூளைகள் களத்தில் இறக்கிவிடப்படுகின்றன. விஞ்ஞானியைக் கடத்த மூவர் போடும் சாமர்த்தியமான திட்டங்கள் ஜெயித்தனவா, இல்லை அவை போலீஸ் போடும் திட்டங்களால் முறியடிக்கப்பட்டனவா? பரபரப்பான இந்தக் கதையை கேளுங்கள்...

Nation-First--हिन्दुस्तान-की-कसम-1.title: Nation First : हिन्दुस्तान की कसम
Nation-First--हिन्दुस्तान-की-कसम-1.description: Covid 19 ke baad ek baar phir Hindustan ki hawa me jahar ghola gaya tha aur ye jahar is baar Atankwad ka wo bhayanak bomb tha jise Bio-War kahte hain. Desh me marne walon ki sankhya 100 hui 1000 hui aur dekhte hi dekhte lakhon mein hone lagi par Government aur experts kuch nahi kar sake. Indian intelligence Officer Abhijeet ko shaq tha ki ye zaroor Hindustan ko dahlane ki ek sajish hai aur ab Aatankwad ki dhamki ke baad ye proof bhi ho gaya. Desh ki Sarkar , Bade Officers aur Junta sannate me aa gayi kyon ki is Bio-War ko rokne ki shart Jammu & Kashmir ke kuch hisse the. Par kahte hai na jahan 1 rasta band hota hai wahin 10 raste bhagwan aur khol deta hai aur wo rasta tha ek saccha deshbhakt Intelligence ka sher Abhijeet. Aakhir kaise jitega  Abhijeet Desh hit ki ye ladai ? Suniye Nation First : हिन्दुस्तान की कसम.

you-can-8.title: You Can
you-can-8.description: "Enik ath cheyyan kazhiyilla" allenkil "enikk ini munnottu pokan kazhiyilla" ennu ningal eppozhengilum madichitundo? Ellavarudeyum jeevithathil itharam sahacharyangal undakarund. 'You Can' enna pusthakathinte ee Malayalam audiobook ningalk enthum nedanulla nirnayakamaya aantharika shakthi kandethan sahayikkum.

bhishma-dharma-aur-vachan-ki-pratigya.title: Bhishma - Dharma Aur Vachan Ki Pratigya
bhishma-dharma-aur-vachan-ki-pratigya.description: Ganga putra Devvrat jinko log Bhishma ke naam se jante hai, unhone apne pita Shantanu ke sukh ke liye jeevan bhar bhramcharya apnane ka faisla liya tha. Unki is pratigya se khush ho kar unke pita ne unhe iccha mrityu ka vardaan diyatha. Par Shanatanu ke bade bete hone ke baad bhi Bhishma kyu nahi bane the Hastinapur ke raja? Iccha Mrityu ka vardaan hone ke baad bhi Shrikhandi ne kaise liya tha Pitamah ki jaan? Draupadi haran kaise tha Bhishma ko mile shrap se juda hua? Bhishma Pitamah ki zindagi se jude aise hi raaz jane is show mein

as-a-man-thinketh-8.title: As A Man Thinketh
as-a-man-thinketh-8.description: Ningalude chinthakalkk jeevithathil ethra mathram pradhanyam undennu eppozhenkilum aalochichittundo. Chinthayude Shakthi ethra mathram aanennum athu oralude jeevithathe ethratholam swadheenikkunnuvennum namuk James Allente As A Man Thinketh enna classic pusthakathilude manasilakkam. Ningalude chinthakal ningalude swabhavathe roopappeduthukayum, Ningalude pravarthanangale nayikkukayum, aathyanthikamayi ningal anubhavikkunna sahacharyangal srushtikkukayum cheyyunnuvennu James Allen parayunnu.

self-esteem-vadhavnyache-sope-upay.title: Shodha swatah madhil Hero
self-esteem-vadhavnyache-sope-upay.description: Aayushyachya pratyek tappyavar Success milvnyasathi, Self Confidence khup garjecha asto. Pan anek loka Talent asunhi Self doubt kinva low Self Esteem mule mage rahtat, swathala proof karnyat kami padtat. Matra ya khas show madhe asha kahi Tips dilya ahet jya tumcha Self confidence wadhwyla nakkich madat kartil.

job-vs-business-2.title: Job vs Business
job-vs-business-2.description: Aapki Salary kitni hai? Kya aap apni salary se khush hain? Apna khud ka business kyun nahi shuru kar lete? Ye kisi bhi employee se puchhe jaane wale common questions hain. Darasal Job V/s Business humesha se hi ek never ending debate rahi hai lekin ab aur nahi. Kyunki iska clear answer dene aur poori tarah se aapka confusion door karne ke liye KUKU FM lekar aaya hai ye show. Toh phir der kis baat ki, chaliye jaante hain ki bina risk ke job karna sahi option hai ya risk lekar business?

as-a-man-thinketh-9.title: As A Man Thinketh
as-a-man-thinketh-9.description: Discover the timeless wisdom of "As a Man Thinketh" by James Allen. This powerful audiobook explores the connection between our thoughts and our reality. Allen reveals how our mindset shapes our destiny, emphasizing the importance of positive thinking and self-mastery. Unleash your potential and create a life of purpose and fulfillment with this inspirational classic. Let James Allen's teachings empower you to cultivate inner peace, achieve greatness, and live a life of abundance and success.

kivabe-ekta-choto-byabsa-shuru-korben.title: Kivabe Ekta Choto Byabsa Shuru Korben?
kivabe-ekta-choto-byabsa-shuru-korben.description: Kotha e ache, "bangali ra naki byabsa korte jane na", kintu aj ker din e dariye kotha ta koto ta sotti? Sotti kotha bolte gele ekhon puro byapartai bodle geche, ekhon chhoto theke boro sokolei chhoto theke boro byabsa e nijeder ke niyog korche.  Tahole ar deri na kore apnio jodi bhabchen je kono chhoto bybasa diye shuru korben tahole ar deri na kore shune nin ei audio story ti.

chamkila-elvis-of-punjab.title: Chamkila - Elvis Of Punjab
chamkila-elvis-of-punjab.description: 1980s mein emergency ka kaala daur punjab ko ghere huye tha. Logon ki aazadi par sarkar ne pehra laga diya tha. Aise mushkil waqt mein bhi Punjab mein ek aisa singer tha jisne society ka sach likhna, aur gaana band nahin kiya. Wo apni patni ke saath stage par perform karta aur logon ka dil jeetta tha. Lekin ek din achanak use aur uski wife ko din dahaade goliyon se khatam kar diya gaya. Kuch waise hi jaise haal-filhaal mein Siddhu Moose Wala ke saath hua tha. 28 saal ki umar mein Singer Amar Singh Chamkila 100 se zyada gaane bana chuka tha aur apne bebaak andaaz ki vajah se poori duniya mein mashoor ho chuka tha. Aakhir kyun itni chhoti umar mein use maut ke ghat utaar diya gaya aur kisne saazish ki thi uski maut ki ? Jaanne ke liye suniye Kuku FM original Chamkila - Elvis of Punjab.

failure-a-stepping-stone-to-success.title: Failure - A Stepping Stone to Success
failure-a-stepping-stone-to-success.description: Tholvi thaan vetrikku muthal Padi nu solluvaanga. Antha Failure ah paakama Success ah pakurathula ennanga kick irukku. Namma Vaalkaila namma santhikura Tholvigal ellaam namma vera maari shape panni qualified aah maathum. Vaanga munnetrathukana Audio Show kulla pogalaam.

the-power-of-waking-at-500-am.title: The Power of Waking At 5:00 AM
the-power-of-waking-at-500-am.description: వేకువ జామున నిద్రలేవడం వల్ల కలిగే ప్రయోజనాలేంటి? బ్రహ్మ ముహూర్తం అంటే ఏమిటి? కంటి నిండా నిద్రపట్టాలంటే ఏమి చెయ్యాలి? ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

tips-to-earn-extra-income-in-recession.title: Tips To Earn Extra Income in Recession
tips-to-earn-extra-income-in-recession.description: Recession ka samay hai, lekin aapki kamaai band nahi honi chahiye. Issiliye hum lekar aaye hain kuch aise tips jisse aap recession mein bhi extra paisa kama sakte hain. Ghar baithe, kam samay mein aur bina investment ke ! Toh suniye yeh audiobook aur janiye kaise ho sakta hai possible extra paisa kamana, kyunki aaj ki mehnat hai kal ka safe future

lokmanya-tilak-1.title: Lokmanya Tilak
lokmanya-tilak-1.description: Lokmanya Balgangadhar Tilak - Ek dhadiche Freedom Fighter. Deshala British british government cha gulamitun mukta karnyasathi tyani dilela Swatantrya ladha, tyani kelela Rashtriya Shikshnacha Prasar ani Prachar, Kesari - Maratha ya vruttapatratun tyani ghadwleli Kranti.. ya saglyacha adhawa apan ya show madhun ghenar ahot.

puthumai-pithan.title: Puthumai Pithan
puthumai-pithan.description: Tamil Ilakkiya Ulagathin mukkiyamana oruthar Puthumai Pithan. Ivar ezhuthiya pala short stories society la miga periya impact ah create panniruku. Adhu mattum illama pala social reforms um senjurukaaru. Melum pala theriyaadha thagavalgal ah therinjuka kelunga "Puthumai Pithan" on Kuku FM

how-to-live-a-great-life-on-low-salary.title: How To Live A Great Life On Low Salary
how-to-live-a-great-life-on-low-salary.description: Kya aap apni kam salary se pareshan hain aur behtar zindagi ka sapna dekhte hain? Chaliye, sochiye, ek aisi duniya jahan paison ki kami aapki khushiyan nahi rok sakti. Yeh Original Series apki isi soch ko sach karne ke qareeb lekar jaayegi. Is show mein aapko apni salary ko lekar aisi practical strategies janne ko milengi jisse aap aapke financial limitations ke bandhan se mukt ho sakein aur asli khushi ka matlab khoj sakein.

how-to-avoid-loss-earn-consistently-in-t.title: How To Avoid Loss& Earn Consistently In the Stock Market
how-to-avoid-loss-earn-consistently-in-t.description: Ningal oru muzhuvan samaya joliyil erppettirikkunna Stock Marketilude Panam sambadhikkanam ennu aagrahikkunna oral aano. Enthu cheyyanam, Evide thudanganam, Engine nikshepikkanam enna reethiyil ulla samshayangal ningalkkundo. Stock Marketine engane approach cheyyanam enna bhayam ningale nikshepam nadathunnathil ninnum thadayukayano. Pedikkenda. Prasanjit Paul nte How to Avoid Loss and Earn Consistently in the Stock Market enna pusthakam kelkkunnathode ningalude aashangakal ellam aaveshathinu vazhi maarum.

how-to-use-chatgpt-effectively.title: ChatGPT Se Kaam Banao Aasaan: Tricks Jo Aam Log Nahi Jaante
how-to-use-chatgpt-effectively.description: ChatGPT apko job mein replace nahi karega balki ChatGPT ko effectively use karne wale log aapko jobs mein replace karenge. Isiliye aaj ke time mein isko kaise effectively use kiya ja sakta hai, yeh pata hona humare liye bahut important hai aur beneficial bhi. Kyunki yeh na sirf aapke kaam ko asaan banata hai balki aapko easily bahut saara paisa kamakar bhi de sakta hai. Lekin kaise? Aaiye jaante hain is show mein.

ഫാരന്‍ഹൈറ്റ്‌-451.title: ഫാരന്‍ഹൈറ്റ്‌ 451
ഫാരന്‍ഹൈറ്റ്‌-451.description: പുസ്തകങ്ങളെല്ലാം നിരോധിച്ച ഒരു നാടിന്റെ കഥയെന്തായിരിക്കും. അദ്ഭുതം തോന്നുന്നുണ്ടല്ലേ. എങ്കില്‍ വരൂ അതാണ് ഈ നോവല്‍. റേ ബ്രാഡ്ബറിയുടെ പ്രവചനാത്മക നോവലാണ് ഫാരന്‍ഹൈറ്റ് 451. ആ നാട്ടിലെ അഗ്നിശമന സേനയുടെ ജോലി തീ അണയ്ക്കല്‍ ആയിരുന്നില്ല, മറിച്ച് പുസ്തകങ്ങള്‍ കണ്ടെത്തി അതിന് തീയിടുകയായിരുന്നു.്. വായിക്കാന്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞില്ലെങ്കില്‍ നമുക്ക് നമ്മുടെ ഓര്‍മ്മകള്‍ നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടേക്കാമെന്ന് നമ്മോട് പറയുന്ന പുസ്തകം നമ്മുടെ ചിന്തകളെ ഉണര്‍ത്തുമെന്നതില്‍ സംശയമില്ല.

make-the-right-choice-4.title: Make The Right Choice
make-the-right-choice-4.description: Oral ravile ezhunnelkkunnath muthal niravadhi thiranjeduppukal nadathunnund. Avayanu palapozhum jeevithathinte gathi nirnayikkunnath. Make The Right Choice enna pusthakathilude jeevithathil naam nadathunna choicekaleppattiyum athinte savisheshathakaleppattiyum vivarikkukayanu rachayithavaya JP Vaswani. Sadhu Vaswani Missionte sthapakanum athmiya nethavum aaya adheham nammal nammalude thanne suhruth aavendathundennu ee pusthakathilude parayunnu. Namme viswasikkanum kazhivukale athmavishwasathode kaanuvanum namuk kazhiyanam.

the-millionaire-fast-lane.title: The Millionaire Fastlane
the-millionaire-fast-lane.description: Acchi naukri karo! Apni salary ka 10% save karo! Fizool kharche mat karo! Paise badhane aur bachane ke naam pe aisi hi baatein to humein sunayi jaati hai. Lekin ye sab millionaire banne ke wo tarike hai jo slowlane se guzarte hai. In purani techniques ko apnane se aap millionaire to banenge lekin kayi saalon baad. Par agar isi kaam ko aap 10X ki speed se karna chahte hai, to uske liye aapko sunni hogi The Millionaire Fastlane ki ye audiobook. Ise sunne ke baad aap apni financial independence mein champion ho jayenge. Aur ameer aur ameer kaise bante hai iska raaz jaan jayenge!

no-ball-the-murky-world-of-match-fixing-.title: No Ball: The Murky World Of Match Fixing
no-ball-the-murky-world-of-match-fixing-.description: Namukkariyunna Crickettinum aapuram mattoru Cricket und. Panamozhukunna cricket. Adholoka sanghangalum vathuveppukarum Cricketinte pinnambura kadhakalude bhagamayirunnath orupad varsham munponnum alla. Indian cricketine vathuveppum kozha vivadhavum pidichulacha oru kalam undayirunnu. Mun Indian captain Muhammed Azharudhin ulppede niravadhi kalikkarum athilppett career thulachu. Cricketinte ariyatha lokathekkurich ariyan English Journalistum ezhuthukaranum aaya Chandramohan Puppalayude No Ball enna ee pusthakam ningale sahayikkum.

എന്താണ്-ഗരുഡപുരാണം.title: എന്താണ് ഗരുഡപുരാണം?
എന്താണ്-ഗരുഡപുരാണം.description: വേദവ്യാസന്‍ രചിച്ച സാത്വിക പുരാണങ്ങളിലൊന്നായ ഗരുഡപുരാണം ഹിന്ദുമതത്തിലെ 18 മഹാപുരാണങ്ങളില്‍ ഒന്നാണ്. മഹാവിഷ്ണു ഗരുഡന് ഉപദേശിച്ച് കൊടുത്ത രൂപത്തില്‍ എഴുതപ്പെട്ട 8000ത്തോളം ലഘുഗ്രന്ഥങ്ങള്‍ ഉള്‍പ്പെട്ട പുരാണമാണ് ഗരുഡപുരാണം. ദൈവങ്ങള്‍ എല്ലാ മനുഷ്യശരീരങ്ങളിലും വസിക്കുന്നുവെന്ന് ഗരുഡപുരാണം പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നു. മരണത്തിന്റെ രഹസ്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചും മരണശേഷം സംഭവിക്കുന്ന കാര്യങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചും ഗരുഡപുരാണത്തില്‍ പറയുന്നു. ജീവിതത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും മരണാനന്തര ജീവിതത്തെക്കുറിച്ചും ഈ പുരാണം ഉള്‍ക്കാഴ്ചകള്‍ നല്‍കുന്നു.

how-to-live-a-calm-life-in-the-age-of-in.title: How To Live A Calm Life In The Age Of Internet
how-to-live-a-calm-life-in-the-age-of-in.description: Internet ke is daur mein jahan sab kuch high speed mein chal raha hai kya aap waha par thodi si shanti dhundh rahe hain? Agar haan toh ye show aapke liye hi hai, jahan baat ki gayi hai internet se judi aaj ki problems ki jo humein sirf mentally hi nahi physically bhi nuksaan pahuncha rahi hain. Chaliye shuru karte hain humara calm life ke taraf badhne ka safar.

how-to-handle-difficult-conersation.title: Difficult conversation kashi handle karychi?
how-to-handle-difficult-conersation.description: Mitrano ayushyat ahi goshti atishay avghad astat kali kase bolave te damjat nahi tar ashaveli te conversation kase handle karate he apan ya book madly aikuyat. Ha Show Tumhala Shikvel Ki Kathin Prasangat Ghabrun, Shanta basun Nahi Chalalycha Apan Svatasathi Ladhla Pahije Ani Difficult Conversations La Hatala Pahije.

the-shortest-history-of-india-2.title: The Shortest History Of India
the-shortest-history-of-india-2.description: Apnio toh bharaotiyo, tahole ki ki janen bolun toh ei bharat er somporke? hostomoithun-valo-na-kharap.title: Hostomoithun Valo Na Kharap?
hostomoithun-valo-na-kharap.description: Aamder Moddhey Kom-Beshi Sobai Hostomoithun Ba Masturbation Kore Thaken. Kintu Aabar Ei Proshno Mone Ghurpak Khay Je Hostomoithun Valo Na Kharap? Aapnar Sei Proshner Uttor Dite KUKU FM Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audio Show, Ja Shonar Por Aapni Aapnar Sob Proshner Uttor Peye Jaben.

kabir.title: Kehat Kabir
kabir.description: Peshe se bunkar Kabir hamare samaj ke liye aisi vaani bun kar gaye hai jise agar hum aaj bhi mane toh is samaj mein faili nafrat bilkul gayab ho jaye.  Hindu Muslium dange, jaat paat ki rajneeti yahi khatam ho jaye. Ya phir ye bhi ho sakta hai ki ye nafrati samaj Kabir par hi mukadme kar de. Kehte hai Kabir ki vani ne Bharat mein 'Bhakti Movement' shuru kiya tha, aur khud ke andar ke Kabir ko khojne ki muhim bhi. Is show ke zariye aap bhi dhundiye apne andar ke Kabir ko.

post-office-e-taka-jomanor-sohoj-upay.title: Post Office-E Taka Jomanor Sohoj Upay
post-office-e-taka-jomanor-sohoj-upay.description: Aapni Hoyto Bank-E Taka Joman, Kintu Janen Ki Post Office-Er Emon Kichu Scheme Aache Jegulo Bank Er Thekeo Beshi Shud Dai Ebong Songe Dai Tax Theke Chhar Payoar Upay? Emonki Probin Nagorikder Jonyo Royeche Bisesh Subidha. Seisob Scheme Gulo Somporke Bistarito Jante Ebong Taka Jomiye Faida Tolar Upay Jante Aapnake Shune Nite Hobe Ei Audio Show.

azhindhu-pona-tamil-nagarangal.title: Azhindhu Pona Tamil Nagarangal
azhindhu-pona-tamil-nagarangal.description: Namma Tamil nadu thonmai vaaindha kalaacharatha kondadadhu. Adhukku example ah pala mukkiya nagarangal irundhu iruku, aana ippo andha nagarangal illa. Atha pathina oru mukkiya thoguppu dhaan indha audio book.

learn-marathi-through-hindi.title: Learn Marathi Through Hindi
learn-marathi-through-hindi.description: "MUMBAI" Sapno Ka Shahar. Jahan har insan ek bar zaroor jana chahta hai aur kuch vahin bas jana chahte hain. Na sirf Mumbai, Poora Maharashtra India ke lakhon logon ko jobs deta hai. Lekin vahan rahne ke liye aapko aapni chahiye Marathi language. Uske bina survive karna thoda muskil hai boss. Isliye aapke sapano ko udaan dene mein sabse basic madad karne ke liye Kuku Fm le aaya hai "Learn Marathi Through Hindi" ki behatreen Audiobook. To Chaliye seekh lijiye ek aur language.

vijayalakshmi-pandit.title: Vijayalakshmi Pandit
vijayalakshmi-pandit.description: Jawaharlal Nehru oda sister & Motital Nehru oda daughter aana Vijayalakshmi oru mukkiyamana freedom fighter and social reformer. Adhu mattum illama United Nations oda first woman General Secretary ivanga dhan. Melum ivangala pathi therinjuka kelunga “Vijayalaksmi Pandit” on Kuku FM

spoken-hindi.title: Spoken Hindi
spoken-hindi.description: Spoken Hindi kathukkanuma ? appo indha audio book ungalukku dhaan. Sulabamaa Thamizh vazhiya Hindi ah indha audio book mudivula kathukkalam.

ulti-ginti.title: Ulti Ginti
ulti-ginti.description: Covid ka daur wo daur tha jo bhulaye se bhi kabhi bhulaya nahi ja sakta. Is dauran na jane kitne aise log the jinke rozgaar unse chheen gaye the. Natijan log apna ren-basera chhod, apne gaon jaane ke liye majboor ho gaye the. Is sabka asar na sirf logon par, balki, humari economics pe bhi pada tha. Ulti Ginti ki ye audiobook wo aaina hai, jo aapko ye dikhayega ki aaj 3 saal baad humari situation kya hai? Kya humara desh wakayi samay ke sath aage badh raha hai ya wo ab bhi kahin picche chhut raha hai. Aaiye ise sune.

asur-and-monsters-in-indian-mythology-da.title: Asur Ani Bhartiya Puranatil Rakshas
asur-and-monsters-in-indian-mythology-da.description: Shrote ho tumhala mahiti ahe ka ki hindu puranatil rakshas adhi raksha hote. Tyanche mul kam devacha ani samanya mansacha rakshan karnyasathi jhala hota, Pan Nantar kalantarane te rakshas  jhale ani Devancha ani samanya mansancha chal Karayla lagle. Chala janun gheuyat Asur Pasun Te Ravna Paryanta saglya rakshasanchya katha aj apan aiknar ahot.

தனி-ஒருவன்-.title: தனி ஒருவன்
தனி-ஒருவன்-.description: தனது காதலி ஸ்வேதாவை பெண் பார்க்கக் குடும்பத்துடன் செல்கிறான் ஆதித்யா. காரில் செல்லும் அவர்கள் எதிர்பாராமல் விபத்துக்குள்ளாகிறார்கள். ஆதித்யா கோமாவிற்கு செல்கிறான். எப்படியோ அவனது ஆத்மா சக்திலோகம் எனும்  மற்றொரு கிரகத்துக்குச் செல்கிறது! கண் விழிக்கும் ஆதித்யா பல சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறான். அவனுக்கு மாதங்கி எனும் அழகிய காதலியும் அறிமுகமாகிறாள். ஆதித்யா மீண்டும் பூமிக்குத் திரும்பினானா?

how-to-avoid-sucidal-thoughts.title: How To Avoid Suicidal Thoughts
how-to-avoid-sucidal-thoughts.description: Kya hai yeh Depression ? Kyun Suicide karna life ki problems se deal karne se zyada aasaan lagta hai? Kya Suicide ke khayal aur Depression se kabhi baahar nikla jaa sakta hai? Yeh Original series inhi sab sawalon ka jawab hai. Jismein aap suicide aur depression ke sabhi pehluon ko samajhenge aur agar apki life mein bhi depression ghar bana chuka hai to usse free hone ka solution bhi jaan lenge.

sadguru-vamanrao-pai.title: Sadguru Wamanrao Pai
sadguru-vamanrao-pai.description: 'Tuch ahes tuzya Jivanacha Shilpakar' asa prernadayi sandesh denare Adhyatmik guru- 'Sadguru Wamanrao Pai'. Loka kalyanasathi tyani kelele Social work, educational work ani tyani dilele Spiritual Life lessons, ya saglyacha adhawa apan ya show madhun ghenar ahot. Aikuya Wamanrao Pai yanche Amrutmayi vichar...

activate-your-english-brain.title: Activate Your English Brain
activate-your-english-brain.description: English la pesuratha thaandi English laye namma think panna aaramicha thaan, antha language la namma expert aah irukka mudiyum. Intha Audio book ungalukku antha Thinking in English skill ah solli kudukra oru audio book thaan. Vaanga namma english brain ah activate pannalaam.

how-waking-up-at-5-am-can-change-everyth.title: How Waking Up at 5 AM Can Change Everything?
how-waking-up-at-5-am-can-change-everyth.description: Aapki Subah uthne ki aadat aapki poori Life badal sakti hai. Ye aapko achchi sehat deti hai, khud ke liye zyada samay deti hai aur aapko zyada productive bhi banati hai. Lekin kadwa sach ye bhi hai ki hum ye sab jante huye bhi subah nahi uth pate hai. Iski sabse badi wajah hai humari lifestyle, late night tak jagna, zyada screentime, overthinking aur bhi bahut kuch. Is AudioBook mein aapko na sirf subah uthne ke fayde bataye gaye hai balki kuch scientific techniques bhi batai gai hai jinse aap bhi 5AM Club mein shamil ho sakte hai. Robin Sharma ki 5 AM Club Book bhi yahi message deti hai.

atrangarai-nagarigam.title: Atrangarai Nagarigam
atrangarai-nagarigam.description: Ulagathula ella naagarigamum aatrangarai la dhan aarambam aachu naama kelvi patruppom. Kal thondri mann thondraa kaala mootha tamil nagarigangal epdi thondruchu? Adhuku pinnala iruka intetesting thagavalgal ah therinjuka kelunga “Atrangarai Nagarigam” on Kuku FM

tata-steel-ka-ramance-by-rm.title: Tata Steel Ka Romance
tata-steel-ka-ramance-by-rm.description: Ek film ka dialogue jisme kaha gaya hai ki Babumoshai zindagi lambi nahi badi honi chahiye aur ye dialogue Tata Company ke malikon par kya khoob baithta hai. Aaj agar hum apni zindagi ke kisi bhi hisse ko utha kar dekh len to usme Tata ke kisi na kisi Product ka istemal hume zaroor milega, ab chahe wo Tata ki namak ho ya Tata ki gadiyan. Par Aakhir kaise hui Tata ki shuruat, kisne rakhi thi Tata ki neev, Kyun kaha jata hai Tata ko Backbone of India aur kya hai Tata steel ke Romance ki kahani janne ke liye suniye R.M. Lala ki ye Audio Book.

history-of-islam-1.title: History of Islam
history-of-islam-1.description: Ulagin migaperiya religion la onnaana islam eppadi uruvaachu, eppadi ulagam mulukka spread aachu, adhoda adippadaigal enna nu intha audiobook la detail la sollirukanga. Islam maargathin varalaara therinjukka kelunga.

the-power-of-subconscious-mind-5.title: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind
the-power-of-subconscious-mind-5.description: Mee Supthachethana Medadu yokka shakthi meku thelusa? Elanti mandulu lekunda mana Supthachethana medhassu yokka shakthitho anekaneka rogalanu nayam cheyyochani thelusukondi. Mari alanti shakthi andarilo untundi kaani ela melkopalo thelidu. Ee athyadbhutha audio book lo manam aa rahasyanni thelusukovachu. Mari inkenduku alasyam purthi audio book vini mee medadu yokka shakthini melkolpi vijayam yokka ruchi chavi chudandi.

nagaland-ki-controversy.title: The Nagaland Controversy
nagaland-ki-controversy.description: Nagaland ki Khonoma gao mein ek memorial par aaj bhi kyu likha hai-'Nagas are not Indians?' Dogra regiment ke convoy par 2015 mein hua blast kisne kiya tha? Azad Bharat ka hissa Nagaland aaj bhi kyu independent state ki demand karta hai? Indian government ko Nagaland ko baar baar 'disturbed area' kyu declare karna padta hai? AFSPA kya hai? Nagaland ko Kashmir se bhi lambi insurgency kyu kaha jata hai? Aise hi kayi sawalo ke jawab milenge is show par

hazrat-nuh-noah.title: Hazrat Nuh ( NOAH )
hazrat-nuh-noah.description: అల్లాహ్ యొక్క  ప్రవక్త అయిన నూహ్ యొక్క జీవిత కథ. అతను ఈ లోకానికి దైవ రహస్యం ఏం చెప్పాడు? అల్లాహ్ నిజంగా  ప్రజల నుండి ఏం కోరుకుంటాడు?  ఈ విషయాలన్నీ ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ లో వివరించబడ్డాయి.

invention-of-6g-technology.title: Invention Of 6G Technology
invention-of-6g-technology.description: Current times la 5G ke ippo dhaan naama arimugam aanom aana, innoru pakkam 6G vandhachu, adha vachu adutha velayaye aarambichachu nu solraanga. Indha 6G endha vagai la lam payan padum, adhukku pinnani la irukka palveru swarasiyangal lam enna nu indha audio book la therinjikkalam.

the-psychology-of-money-15.title: The Psychology of Money
the-psychology-of-money-15.description: Paise ko kaise manage karein? Kaise invest karein? Apne business decisions kaise le? Iske liye humein bahut saari mathematical calculation karni padti hai, jisme data aur formulas humari madad karte hai. Lekin asal mein, koi bhi apna financial decision spreadsheet ke bharose nahi leta. Wo ya to ye decision dinner table pe leta milega, ya meeting rooms mein. Isi baat ko samjhaane ke liye hum aapke liye The Psychology of Money ki ye audiobook lekar aaye hai. Jisme 19 aisi stories hai jise sunne ke baad paise ko lekar aapna nazariya badal jayega. Aur aapko ye pata chal jayega ki paise ke hone pe uske sath humara behaviour kitna important hota hai!

senthamizhum-siddha-maruthuvamum.title: Senthamizhum Siddha Maruthuvamum
senthamizhum-siddha-maruthuvamum.description: Namma thamizh makkal kadaipidikkira vaazhviyal pazhakkangalaavum , Unavu Muraigalaagavum siddha maruthuvam namma Thamizh kalaachaarathulaye onnoda onnaa kalanthu irukku. Appadipatta namma mannin maruthuva muraiyaana siddha maruthuvam patriya pala ariya thagavalgal la arumaiyaa vilakkuthu intha audiobook. Vaanga Kekkalam.

rise-of-the-foreign-power-in-india-1.title: Rise Of The Foreign Power In India
rise-of-the-foreign-power-in-india-1.description: Okkapudu mana Bharathadesha ardhika vyavastha chaala gormaga undedi kani 2021 reports prakaram mana desham ardhikanga chaala deshala kanna mundhe undhi anedi bayata padindhi. aithe mana desham ardhikanga ela balapaduthundi, foreign companies mana desham lo enduku invest chestharu? ila enno kotha vishyalu telusukondi ee audio book lo.

how-to-achieve-goals-with-patience.title: How to Achieve Goals with Patience
how-to-achieve-goals-with-patience.description: Humein Life mein palak jhapkaate hi success mil jaye aisa nahi hota.  Success ko paane ke Liye hard work aur excellence ke saath-saath patience ki bhi zaroorat hoti hai. Aur KUKU FM par yeh original series yahi Patience ko samajhne aur use develop karne mein aapki help karegi. To chaliye shuru karte hain patience ki paathshaala .

indus-valley-civilization-the-origin-of-.title: Indus Valley Civilization
indus-valley-civilization-the-origin-of-.description: Sindhu nagarikatha kanumarugavadaniki gala karanalu ippatiki mystery gane unnayi. Paryavarana marupulu, videshi Dhandayathralu, leda vaari sontha samajika, ardhika samasyalu karanama? adhi telusukovalanate ee audio book meeru vinalsindhe

mystery-of-7-immortals.title: Mystery of 7 Immortals
mystery-of-7-immortals.description: Kaha jata hai ki jab jab is Dharti par paap badhta hai tab tab Bhagwan Vishnu alag alag roop mein is dharti par Avatar lete hain. Hindu pauranik grantho mein Kahin 7 to kahin 8 Immortals ka zikar hota hai Par kahan hain ye Immortals aur Aakhir kya Uddeshya hain inka, agar ye Jeveet hain to kis Roop mein hain. Kya sach mein inhe Kalki ka intazaar hai, In 7 Immortals ke Pratiksha ki kahani ek aisi daastan hai jo Satyug se shuru hokar Kaliyug ke ant tak chalne wali hai Par kya hai inki kahani aur kon hai Kalki, aapke in Saare Sawalon ka jawab milega humare is show "Mystery of 7 Immortals" mein.

v-shantaram.title: V Shantaram
v-shantaram.description: V.Shantaram hey Hindi Ani Marathi Cine Srushtitil Filmmaker, Producer, Ani Abhinete Hote. Do Ankhen, Pinjra, Navrang, Kunku, Jhanak JhanakPayal Baje Hey tyanch Kahi Famous Chitrapat. Chala Janun Gheuyat Tyanchya Personal Ani Professional Life baddal. Chala Janun Gheuyat Kon Hote V. Shantaram.

the-miracles-of-your-mind-2.title: The Miracles Of Your Mind
the-miracles-of-your-mind-2.description: Unlock the incredible power of your mind with "The Miracles of Your Mind" by Joseph Murphy. This transformative audiobook delves into the limitless potential of your subconscious, guiding you on a journey of self-discovery and empowerment. Joseph Murphy's wisdom offers time-tested principles for personal growth and spiritual enlightenment. Unleash the miracles within your mind and witness life's transformational wonders in this enlightening masterpiece. Discover the keys to abundance and fulfillment.

the-shortest-history-of-india.title: The Shortest History of India
the-shortest-history-of-india.description: UPSC mein sabse zyada sawal is desh ki History ke bare mein pucha jata hai. History, Yani ki itihas. Kaun apna itihas nahi janna chahta. Aur jab baat apne desh ki ho tab to sabhi janna chahenge. Kaise hui thi Bharat desh ki shuruwat? Kaise khooj ki thi is desh ki? Kitne Rajaon ne raaj kiya hai is desh par? Aur aakhir kitna purana hai humare India ka Itihas. Janne le liye suniye Shortest History of India ka ye Audio show jiske Author hain John Zubrzycki.

how-numerology-works-2.title: హౌ న్యూమరాలజీ వర్క్స్
how-numerology-works-2.description: న్యూమరాలజీ అంటే సంఖ్యా శాస్త్రం. ఈ న్యూమరాలజీ కూడా ఒక రకంగా జ్యోతిష్యం లాంటిదే. మరి ముఖ్యం గా ఈ న్యూమరాలజీ ని ఎలాంటి విషయాల్లో ఎక్కువగా నమ్ముతారు?  తెలుసుకోవాలీ అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

mafia-king-dawood-ibrahim-1.title: Mafia King Dawood Ibrahim
mafia-king-dawood-ibrahim-1.description: Arappattiniyude bhoothakalathinu mukalil kuttakrithyangalude perumazha peyyich Mumbaiyile oru balan oru samrajyam kettiyundakki. Aarkkum kaiyyethippidikkan polumaavatha onnu. Oru saadha police constabilinte makanu Mumbaiye muzhuvan kaivellayilaakiya kadha muthashikkadhakal pole avishwasaneeyam. Dawood Ibrahim, athanu ayalude peru. Pazhaya Bombayile theruvil koolithallum kallakkadathum nadathi rajyam kanda ettavum valiya Mafia Don aayi, oduvil rajyathinu thanne bheeshaniyayi theernna Dawood innum pidikittappulli. Ennal lokathinte oro konilum ayalkk kaiyyalundennath parasyamaya rahasyam. Bombay enna mahanagarathinu mukalilekkum valarnna adholoka rajavinte kadha kelkkam Kuku FMilude.

tere-liye-phir-se-1.title: Tere Liye Phir Se
tere-liye-phir-se-1.description: Shy aur introvert Amit ki zindagi mein aati hai sweet si Sonam par Sonam to already married hai. Aur Sonam ka peecha krte huye Amit ko ISI agents pakad lete hain. To kya Sonam aur Amit ka ISI se koi sambandh hai? Ya Sonam koi raj chupa rahi hai? Kya Amit ISI ke attack se India ko bacha payega? Kya Sonam aur Amit ka koi bhavishya hoga? Janne ke liye sunte rahe, “Tere Liye… Phir Se”

mahabharat-jiboner-mohan-sikkha.title: Mahabharat : Jiboner Mohan Sikkha
mahabharat-jiboner-mohan-sikkha.description: Hindu Somprodayer Ek Pobitro Dhormo Grontho Holo Mahabharat. Ei Mahabharat-Er Kichu Choritro Aachen Jara Aamder Onek Sikkha Diye Gechen Tader Kajer Moddhye Diye. Aaj Ei Audio Show Er Moddhey Diye Shunbo Emon Kichu Choritrer Jibon Dorshon Somporke, Ja Ei Koli Juge Dariye Aamder Jibone Cholar Pothe Sikkha Prodan Korbe.

what-if-solar-wind-hits-earth.title: What If Solar Wind Hits Earth ?
what-if-solar-wind-hits-earth.description: Solar wind evalo sakthi vaaindhadhu ? Boomi ah adhu thaakum podhu pala edhirpaaradha maatrangala boomi face pannum adhu enna nu indha audio book la kelunga.

raavan-1.title: Ravana: The Untold Story Of A Shiv Bhakt
raavan-1.description: Kya aapko pata hai Ramayan mein Sita haran karne wale Ravan ko Sri Lanka mein aaj bhi puja jaata hai. Sri Lanka mein aaj bhi unhe ek vidvan, ek mahan raja, aur sabse bada shiv bhakt mana jaata hai. Ravan ne 100 saalon se bhi zyada shiv ki tapasya kar unse vardaan liya tha. Aisa kya vardaan mila tha Ravan ko janane ke liye sune ye show.

ചായ-വിറ്റ്-വിജയന്റെയും-മോഹനയുടെയും-ലോക-സ.title: ചായ വിറ്റ് വിജയന്റെയും മോഹനയുടെയും ലോക സഞ്ചാരങ്ങൾ
ചായ-വിറ്റ്-വിജയന്റെയും-മോഹനയുടെയും-ലോക-സ.description: യാത്രകൾ ചെയ്യാനും സ്ഥലങ്ങൾ സന്ദർശിക്കാനും ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന ആളുകൾക്ക് പ്രചോദനമാണ് ദമ്പതികളായ വിജയനും മോഹനയും.  6 ഭൂഖണ്ഡങ്ങളിലായി കിടക്കുന്ന 25 രാജ്യങ്ങളാണ് മധ്യവയസ് പിന്നിട്ട ഈ ദമ്പതികൾ സന്ദർശിച്ചത്. ചായക്കടയിൽ നിന്നുള്ള വരുമാനത്തിൽ നിന്ന് അവർക്ക് ഇത്രയൊക്കെ സാധിച്ചു എന്നുള്ളത് എല്ലാവർക്കും ഒരു പാഠമാണ്.

maharashtra-ki-mahagatha.title: UPSC Notes: Maharashtra Ki Mahagatha
maharashtra-ki-mahagatha.description: Kya aapko pata hai desh ke economic capital ka naam Maharashtra kaise pada? Ya Maharashtra ki history kis tarah Chakravarti Samrat Ashok se judi hai? Ya kitne dynasty ne aaj tak Maharashtra par raaj kiya? Kya aapko pata hai Islamic Sultanate ne kaise Yadav kul ka yahan naash kiya? Aur kaise Aurangzeb ke vaar ka jawab Chhatrapati Shivaji aur Chhatrapati Sambhaji ne veerta se diya? UPSC mein pucche jane wale inhi sawalo ke jawab jane.

rotno-pathor-ki-vagyo-bodlate-pare.title: Rotno Pathor Ki Vagyo Bodlate Pare?
rotno-pathor-ki-vagyo-bodlate-pare.description: Jyotish Shashtro Mote Rotno Pathor Dharon Korle Naki Jibon Bodle Jay, Bohu Celeb Theke Shuru Kore Sadharon Manush Naki Bodle Felechen Nijer Jibon Ei Rotno Pathor-Er Opor Vor Kore. Jiboner Otha-Nama Sotyi Ki Niyontron Korte Pare Ei Rotno Pathor? Sei Uttor Pete Aapnake Shune Nite Hobe Ei Audio Show.

reasons-behind-men-and-womens-infertilit.title: Infertility- Conceive na honayachi Karana Ani Upay
reasons-behind-men-and-womens-infertilit.description: Shroteho, Aai hone he pratyek streechya ayushyatala atyant anandacha kshan asato. Parantu kahi  jodapyana ha anand sahajasahaji milat nahi. Jodapyatil stree kinva ticha partner yanchyatil konachya tari doshamule streela naisargikritya garbhadharana hot nahi. Hyasathi doghanihi velevar yogya tya sambandhit doctorkade jaun tapasani karun ghyayala havi. Ani tyache nidan ani upachar karun ghyayala havet. Hya series madhun apan stree ani purush yanchyatil 'Infertility' chi karane, tyache nidan, tyavarache upachar ya vishayi savistar mahiti ghenar ahot apalya kuku FM var.

how-to-design-your-dream-retirement.title: How to Design Your Dream Retirement
how-to-design-your-dream-retirement.description: Hum aksar retirement ko itna seriously nahi lete aur sochte hai abhi to bahut time hai, retire hone mein. Par agar retirement ki taiyaari aaj se nahi ki to retirement life guzaar pana mushkil ho sakta hai. To iss audio-show mein hum aapko batayenge ki retirement ki taiyaari kab aur kaise shuru karni chahiye. Kya hai government ki schemes jo ismein aapki madad kar sakti hai aur kaise retirement ke liye ek sahi investment plan decide kiya jaye uspe bhi charcha karenge

jatadhar-bakshi-3ti-rohoshyo-golpo.title: Jatadhar Bakshi 3ti Rohoshyo Golpo
jatadhar-bakshi-3ti-rohoshyo-golpo.description: Rajsekhar Basu rochito Jatadhar Bakshi samagrer kichu golpo jekhane Jatadhar Bakshi ki ki bhabe mawjadar ghotona ghotiyechen onar para theke ashe pasher lokeder songe ta shune nin. Keno Jatdhar Bakshi ei mawjar ghotona ghotalen tar parar lok jon der songe? Ki ki holo ei golpo gulir modhye shune nin ei golpo samagra.

dada-boudir-biryanir-golpo.title: Dada Boudir Biryanir Golpo
dada-boudir-biryanir-golpo.description: Achha bolun toh emon kau ke ki chenen je ekdom Biryani khete pochondo kore na? Na toh, amrao chini na, ar Kolkata'r manush Kolkata'r biryani pele ar ki chaye? Emon e ek biryanir dokan ebong jayegar golpo niye alochona kora hobe, jei jayegata ke amra kom beshi sokolei chini ebong bhalobashi, hai ekdom thik dhorechen, amader sokoler priyo "Dada Boudir Biryani". Ki bhabe "Dada Boudir Biryani" shuru korlo tader jatrapoth theke ei sofolotar shirshe poucholo shei shob bistarito bhabe jante shunte hobe ei audio story ti.

dr-vivek-bindra-motivation-for-millions.title: Dr. Vivek Bindra: Motivation for Millions
dr-vivek-bindra-motivation-for-millions.description: Dr. Vivek Bindra ek aise motivational speaker, business coach aur author hain jinhone apni teachings se lakhon logon ki zindagi badal di hai. Par kya aapko pata hai, Dr. Bindra kaafi struggles face karne ke baad hi yeh maqaam haasil kar paye hain? Is Orginal series mein hum unki isi backstage kahani ko jaanenge, Jise sun kar aap bhi success ke raaste par chal sakte hain.

gangster-state-the-rise-and-fall-of-the-.title: Gangster State: The Rise and Fall of the CPI(M) in West Bengal
gangster-state-the-rise-and-fall-of-the-.description: Gangster state kono byartho rajineetir golpo noi.  Eti lekhok ba sangbadik mane Sourya Bhowmick  somosamoyik  itihaser ekti gurtyopurno ebong challenginge odhyay tule dhorechen ei boi ti te. Bangla e amra jara bash kori ba Banglar bairer lok jon sokolei mota moti amader Banglar rajneeti somporke obogoto, ki bhabe CIP(M) khomota e elo, ba CPI(M) er poton somporke bistarito bhabe jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

autobiography-of-a-yogi-7.title: Autobiography Of A Yogi
autobiography-of-a-yogi-7.description: మన జీవితం లో మనం చాలా మంది గొప్పవాళ్ళ జీవితాల నుంచి ప్రేరణ పొందుతూ ఉంటాం. అలాంటి ఒక గొప్ప వ్యక్తి ప్రముఖ భారతీయ యోగి "పరమహంస యోగానంద" జీవితం గురించిన వివరాలు తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

savitri-bai-phule-1.title: Savitribai Phule
savitri-bai-phule-1.description: Ek Dalit ghar mein janmi ladki jise janam ke baad hi Peshva aur Brahamano ki baat par unke pita khatam kar dena chah rahe the, aage chal kar apne pati ko mukhagni deti hai. Ladkiyon ke liye school kholne par gobar se maar bhi khaati hai, par rukti nahi hai. Savitribai Phule desh ki pehli mahila teacher thi, aur apne pati, Jyotiba Phule ke sath mil kar unhone 3 school khole the. Savitribai ne jaatiwad par hatiyar to uthaya, par wo hatiyar kalam ka tha. Jane unke zindagi aur sangharsh se jude kayi raaz.

nalamudam-vaazhga.title: Nalamudam Vazhga
nalamudam-vaazhga.description: Udal nalam thaan miga mukkiyamaana selvam ! Udal nalam sariyaa  iruntha namma vazhkaiyum Nalama irukkum ! Nalamaana Vazhvukku Naama follow panna vendiya unavu muraigal enna ?, vazhkai muraigal enna nu romba vilakkamaa intha audio puthagam solluthu. Vaanga therinjukalam. Nalamudan Vazhalaam.

siddhartha.title: Siddhartha
siddhartha.description: Yadhartha Sathyamenth enna chodhyathinulla utharam thedi alayunna Siddharthante Kadhayanu Loka sahithyathile ennam paranja classicukalil onnaya Hermann Hesseyude Siddhartha. Buddha darshanathe adisthanappeduthiyulla novel ennal ath appade pakarthukalyalla marich oru sadharanakkaran enna nilayilulla Siddharthante samshayangalum vicharangalum dourbalyangalum thathwa chintha paramayi parayukayum aa sathyanweshiyude jeevithathe asaamanya sarga seshiyode namukk munnil anubhava bhedhyamakkukayumaanu.

class-7-geography.title: NCERT Class 7th Geography
class-7-geography.description: Class mein first aana ho ya UPSC ki taiyaari karni ho ya phir kisi competitive exam mein acchi Rank lani ho, Shuruaat to book utha kar padhne se hi karni hogi. Lekin bookish language ko samajhna thoda sa mushkil ho jata hai. KUKU fm par yeh original series apke isi problem ka solution hai. Jise sun kar aap Natural Vegetation and Wildlife, Tropical and Subtropical regions aur Life in the Desert jaise topics ko bahut hi achhe se samajh jaayenge aur saath hi inse jude examples aur important questions aapko exam ki taiyaari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge.

get-a-good-night-sleep-tips-for-better-s.title: Get a Good Night Sleep : Tips for Better Sleep
get-a-good-night-sleep-tips-for-better-s.description: సరిగ్గా నిద్రపోలేకపోతున్నారు? నిద్ర పోకపోవడం వల్ల కలిగే నష్టాలు మరియు పోతే వచ్చే లాభాలు గురించి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో చెప్పబడింది. లేట్ చేయకుండా వినేయండి.

oppenheimer-father-of-atom-bomb.title: Oppenheimer : Father of Atom bomb
oppenheimer-father-of-atom-bomb.description: "World war 3 ek nuclear war hogi" ye sentence aapne suna he hoga, par kya aap jante hein Atom bomb banane wale J.R. Oppenheimer ko aise khatarnak weapon ki inspiration Indian history se mili thi? chaliye jante hein aise scientist ke baare mein jinhone Modern world ka sabse deadly weapon to banaya par baadme unhe sanatan dharm ke granth se unki galti ka ehsas bhi hua, Chaliye sunte hein Oppenheimer ki kahani.

reduce-risk-of-heart-disease.title: Reduce Risk of Heart Disease
reduce-risk-of-heart-disease.description: Urukula Parugula jeevitham lo prathi okkaru lifestyle ki alavatu padipoyi vaala arogyani patinchukokunda, vichalavidiga tintu, ey Mathram health care tesukokunda brathikesthunaru. Dani vaale Manaki gunde jabbulu kuda vasthunayi, aithe eetivale kaalam lo aithe gunde jabbu ravadam chaala mandhi lo aithe chusthunam.ee gunde jabbu manam mana arogyam meeda sariga shraddha chupinchakpothe jaruguthundi. Mee Gunde ni ela kapadukovalo memu mee kosam ee pratyeka audio book chesam, indulo meeru heart attack rakunda undataniki tisukovalasina aneka paddathulu unayi. mari inkenduku late ventane ee audio book vinandi.

kivabe-valo-kore-ghumaben.title: Kivabe Valo Kore Ghumaben?
kivabe-valo-kore-ghumaben.description: Bortoman Somoy Dariye Beshirvag Manusher Ekta Common Somosya Holo Ghum Na Aasa, Ei Ghumer Jonyo Bohu Lok Medicine Porjonto Nen. Kintu Emon Kichu Upay Aache Ja Mante Parle Aarame Ghumate Parben Kono Bighno Charai. Sei Upayguli Jene Nite Mon Diye Shune Nin Ei Audio Show Ebong Pari Din Ghumer Deshe.

shirdi-the-miracle-city-of-sai-baba.title: Shirdi: The Miracle City of Sai Baba
shirdi-the-miracle-city-of-sai-baba.description: Sai Baba, ek sant aur adhyatmik guru, Shirdi ki nagari mein 50 saal se adhik samay tak rahe. Unke pravachanon mein pyar, daya, aur nirbalon ki madad karne ki shiksha thi. Baba ke bhakton ko vishwas hai ki unhone apne jivan mein anek chamatkar kiye, jaise ki rogiyon ko thik karna, bhookhe logon ko khana khilana, aur pareshaniyon se mukti dilana. Aaj, Shirdi ek tirth sthal hai jahan karodo log Baba ke aashirwad aur margdarshan ke liye aate hai. Unki virasat zinda hai aur unke bhakt duniya bhar mein pyar aur daya ki shiksha ko phailate hain. Kya hai Shirdi se jude chamatkar, jaanenge  KUKU FM ki is exclusive audio series main.

oorkadhaigal.title: Oorkadhaigal
oorkadhaigal.description: Gramangal dhan India vin mudhugu elumbu. Appadi patta Gramangal ulla poi andha makkal oda vazhkai murai, dheiva vazhipaadu, unavu innum pala vishayangal ah therinjukanuma. Idhu Tamil naatil ulla Gramangal patriya kadhai. Kelunga "Oor Kadhaigal" on Kuku FM

rajayogam.title: Rajayogam
rajayogam.description: ‘Aura’ nu oru varthai ah neenga kelvi patrukeengala? Namma manasu nammaloda control la irukanum na enna seiyanum? Indha positive energy, negative energy nu nammala suthi iruka kannuku theriyadha vishayangal ah epdi control panradhu? Idhu pondra pala kelvigal ku badhil therinjuka kelunga “Rajayogam” on Kuku FM

nykaa-success-story-from-zero-to-unicorn.title: NYKAA Success Story: From Zero To Unicorn
nykaa-success-story-from-zero-to-unicorn.description: Nykaa ki safalta ki kahani aisi hai jo business ki duniya mein apna ek naya naam kama rahi hai. Lekin is kahani ke peeche Founder Falguni Nayar ki himmat, lagan aur hard work ka yogdaan hai. Falguni ne na sirf critics se ladaai ki hai, balki har ups and down se apni company ko ubhaar kar unicorn banaya hai. Nykaa ke isi struggle aur success ki story ko hum is original series mein jaanege jo aapko prerna degi aur aapke start up ko successful karne ke liye tareeke bhi bataayegi.

nationalism.title: Nationalism
nationalism.description: "Nationalism" by Rabindranath Tagore, is a thought-provoking exploration of the concept that challenges conventional notions of patriotism and identity. In this influential collection of essays, Tagore delves deep into the complexities of nationalism and its implications for society and the individual. With his eloquent prose and profound insights, Tagore presents a nuanced critique of narrow and divisive nationalism. He emphasizes the importance of universal humanism, emphasizing the celebration of diversity and the power of unity in a world plagued by divisions. "Nationalism" invites listeners on a transformative journey of intellectual exploration. Tagore's visionary ideas resonate even today, provoking introspection and fostering a deeper understanding of the complexities of nationalism. This audiobook offers a timeless perspective that challenges listeners to question and reassess their own notions of identity, patriotism, and the pursuit of a harmonious world.

fidel-castro.title: Fidel Castro
fidel-castro.description: Cuba la oru periya puratchi vedikka kaaranama irundha oru adhi theevira Marxist patriya kadhai dhan idhu. Cuba oda pala sarvaadhikaarigal ah viratti adichu andha naatu makkal ku viduthalai vangi kudutha Fidel Castro, innum pala sirappana tharamana sambavangal ah senjurukaar. Adha pathi innum detailed ah therinuka kelunga “Fidel Castro” on Kuku FM

story-of-acharya-prashant-from-iit-iim-u.title: Story of Acharya Prashant: From IIT, IIM & UPSC To Spirituality
story-of-acharya-prashant-from-iit-iim-u.description: Ye Biography hai Acharya Prashant ki jinhone wo sab haasil kiya jo ek aam insaan apni life mein achieve karna chahta hai. Lekin itna sab achieve karne ke baad bhi aakhir kyu unhone ye saari achievements ko kinare kar ke Spirituality ka raasta chuna? Sirf itna hi nahi unhone apne saath-saath kaise Social Media par ek aisi community create ki jiske baare mein shayad kabhi kisi ne socha bhi nahi tha. KuKu FM ki ye Original Series na keval aapko Acharya Prashant ke jeevan ke baare mein batayegi balki aapko aapke jeevan ko kaise jeena chahiye uski bhi direction degi.

तुम्हीही-यशस्वी-होऊ-शकता--लेखक--स्वेट-मा.title: Swatahmadhil Vijetyala olkha
तुम्हीही-यशस्वी-होऊ-शकता--लेखक--स्वेट-मा.description: World famous Writer ani Motivational speaker- Swett Marden, yani ya audiobook dvare aplyala ayushyat Yashasvi honyache kahi marga sangitle ahet. Successful honyasathi apan kontya goshti kelya pahijet ani kontya talalya pahijet yavishyi tyani aplyala guide kela ahe. Aikuya, Successful life che kahi sope funde...

history-class-7.title: NCERT Class 7th History
history-class-7.description: Class mein first aana ho ya UPSC ki taiyaari karni ho, Shuruaat to book utha kar padhne se hi karni hogi. Lekin bookish language ko samajhna thoda sa mushkil ho jata hai. KUKU fm par yeh original series apke isi problem ka solution hai. Jise sun kar aap Delhi Sultans, Mughal Empire, Tribes, Nomads and Settled Communities jaise topics ko achhe se jaan jaayenge aur saath hi inse jude examples aur important questions aapko exam ki taiyaari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge.

be-a-network-marketing-millionaire-4.title: Be A Network Marketing Millionaire
be-a-network-marketing-millionaire-4.description: Unleash your potential with "Be a Network Marketing Millionaire" by renowned industry expert Deepak Bajaj. Learn the secrets of top achievers and unlock success in any Network Marketing venture. This one-of-a-kind guidebook empowers professionals, business owners, students, and more to achieve their dreams. Discover powerful techniques, social media strategies, and a duplication system for lifelong passive income. Build a strong belief system, multiply income and teams, and create an endless prospect list. With a 90-day game plan and personal branding, turn your business around forever. Master invitation methods and cultivate leaders within your team. "Be a Network Marketing Millionaire" promises remarkable results for dream-seekers looking to be part of the top 1%. Don't just dream; embrace the success of the best, and let this audiobook be your gateway to a thriving Network Marketing career.

കാന്തമല-ചരിതം-ഒന്നാം-അദ്ധ്യായം-അഖിനാതെന്.title: കാന്തമല ചരിതം ഒന്നാം അദ്ധ്യായം: അഖിനാതെന്റെ നിധി
കാന്തമല-ചരിതം-ഒന്നാം-അദ്ധ്യായം-അഖിനാതെന്.description: ഈജിപ്തിലെ പിരമിഡുകളിൽ തുടങ്ങി ശബരിമലയുടെ അറിയപ്പെടാത്ത ചരിത്രത്തിൽ അവസാനിക്കുന്ന ത്രില്ലറാണ് നവാഗത എഴുത്തുകാരനായ വിഷ്ണു എം.സി രചിച്ച കാന്തമല ചരിതം ഒന്നാം അദ്ധ്യായം അഖിനാതന്റെ നിധി എന്ന നോവൽ. കേൾകാം കാന്തമലയുടെ രഹസ്യങ്ങൾ

radha-rani-2.title: Radharani
radha-rani-2.description: Kya aapko pata hai dharti par Radha, Krishna se us raat mili thi jis raat unka janm hua tha? Yahi nahi, pichle kayi janamo se tay tha Radha ka Krishna se dharti par milna bhi aur bicchadna bhi. Ye bicchadna bhi ek shrap tha jo 100 saalon tak vrat karne ke baad bhi Radha ye doori rok nahi payi. Poore gaon ka Radha pe sawal uthane ke baad bhi Krishna ne kaise sabit kiya tha Radha ko sabse pavitra? Janein Radharani ki zindagi ke aise hi kuch raaz

കേരളത്തിൻ്റെ-ആയുർവേദ-പാരമ്പര്യം.title: കേരളത്തിന്റെ ആയുർവേദ പാരമ്പര്യം
കേരളത്തിൻ്റെ-ആയുർവേദ-പാരമ്പര്യം.description: ആയിരം കൊല്ലത്തെ പാരമ്പര്യവും ശ്രദ്ധാപൂര്‍വ്വമായ വികാസവും ഉണ്ട് കേരളത്തിന്റെ ആയുര്‍വേദ ചികിത്സാരീതികൾക്ക്. കേരളത്തിലെ ആയുര്‍വേദ പാരമ്പര്യം എന്നത് രോഗങ്ങള്‍ക്കുള്ള വെറും ചികിത്സാരീതി മാത്രമല്ല ഒരു ജീവിതശൈലി കൂടിയാണ്. കേരളത്തിന്റെ ആയുര്‍വേദ മഹത്വത്തെ കുറിച്ച് വിശദമായി അറിയാം ഈ ഷോയിലൂടെ.

africayude-vibhajanam.title: Is Africa Splitting into Two Continents?
africayude-vibhajanam.description: African bhookhandathile vibhajanam nilavil nadannukondirikkunna oru bhoogarbha prakriyayanu.Ithinu artham Africa poornamaayum pilarum ennano? Angane enkil, ath eppol vibhajikkum? Ee chodhyangalkkulla utharam ariyam ee showiloode.

patanjali-aur-ayurvedic-yoga.title: Patanjali Aur Ayurvedic Yoga
patanjali-aur-ayurvedic-yoga.description: Is Duniya mein badhte shor ke beech humare liye zaroori hai ki hum apne aap ko badhte stress aur kharaab health se bacha kar rakhein. Isiliye KUKU Fm par suniye Patanjali Aur Ayurvedic Yoga kitab ki is Audiobook ko. Jo aapko Patanjali Yoga aur Ayurveda ki importance samjhaayegi aur aapki body ko bimariyon se mukt aur khud ko healthy rakhne ki tips bhi bataayegi.

my-life-i-decide.title: My Life I Decide
my-life-i-decide.description: Vijayathe engane nirvachikkum? Valiya shambalam labhikkunnathiloodeyano? Atho asaadharanamaya valiya veetil thaamasikkunnatho? 19 simple aashayangalilooode  'My Life I Decide' enna pusthakam ningalkk yathaartha vijayam kaivarikkanum asaadharanamaya jeevitham nayikkanum sahayikkunnu. Varu kelkam Rinku Sawhney rachicha  'My Life I Decide' enna pusthakathinte Malayalam audiobook.

how-to-grow-small-business-on-instagram-.title: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn Karel Tumcha Business Grow
how-to-grow-small-business-on-instagram-.description: Tumcha Small business tumhala grow karaycha ahe? Ani Tumcha kade phone madhye social media ahe ? Tar mag Vat kasli baghat ahat tumchya phone madhil social media mhanje Linked In, Instagram, Facebook Dware tumhi tumcha business grow karu shaktat. Tumhala hi social media dware business grow karyacha asel tar aika ha show.

comprehensive-computer-learning.title: Comprehensive Computer Learning
comprehensive-computer-learning.description: Aaj ke daur mein jise computer nahi aata. Use daily life ki bahut saari cheezeon mein bahut mushkil ho sakti hai. Isliye Kukufm Aap ke liye lekar aya hai Yogesh Patel dwara likhi hui kitaab Comprehensive Computer Learning jisme aapko pata chalega ke computer darasal shuru kahan aur kabse hua aur kaise itni jaldi insaani jiwan ka imporant hissa ban gaya. Saath hi saath apko is kitaab mein computer ki madad se hone vaale basic kaam seekhne bhi milenge jaise ke email , google search, etc. To suniye Comprehensive Computer Learning sirf kukufm par.

sharad-pawar-devendra-fadnavis-in-mahara.title: Rajkiya- Arajkiya
sharad-pawar-devendra-fadnavis-in-mahara.description: Maharashtracha Rajkarnat sadhya roj nava natya ghadat ahe. Rajkarnat jase Shatru astat tasech Mitra hi astat. Rajyatle 2 diggaj rajkiya nete- Devendra Fadnavis ani Ajit Pawar yancha ashach Rajkiya ani Arajkiya doticha, tyancha Kamncha ani Rajkiya prawasacha adhawa apan ya show madhun ghenar ahot.

life-lessons-from-balakrishna.title: Life Lessons From Balakrishna
life-lessons-from-balakrishna.description: Balakrishna garu Mana telugu industry ni okka upu upina goppa natudu. Mana Telugu chalanachitram lo mass cinema lu cheyali ante adhi mana balayya gari taruvathane evarina. Cinema career pakkana pedithe mana balayya gari jeevitham gurinchi manaki teliyani enno vishyalu unayi. Avi Manam telusukovadam chaala mukhyam. Avi ento telusukondi mana ee audio book vini.

chanakya-ka-sach-1.title: Chanakya ka Raaz
chanakya-ka-sach-1.description: Chanakya ki nitiyon se bharpur ek kahani, jise sunne ke baad aapko apni zindagi mein chal rahe sabhi sawalon ke jawab mil jayenge. Kya hai Chanakya ki rahasyamayi zindagi ka raaz? Kaise unhone apne jeevan ke har mod par apni chaturai ka istemaal kiya? Aur kya aap bhi unki tarah apne jeevan ke har kadam par apni akalmandi ka istemaal kar sakte hain? Is show mein milenge aapko Chanakya ke anmol vachanon se bharpur sujhav jo apko raah dikhaenge, jisse aap apni zindagi ko aur bhi behtar bana sakte hain. Agar aapko "Chanakya In Daily Life" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

agni-puranam-1.title: Agni Puranam
agni-puranam-1.description: Agni Puranam lo Vishnuvu avatharala gurinchi visheshinchi Ramavatharam, Krishnavatharala gurinchi Pruthvi gurinchi undi. Yaga puja vidhanalu, Jyohthishastra vishayalu, Charithra, Yuddamu, Samskrutha vyakaranam, Yudda Kreedalu vanti aneka shasthralaku sambhandinchina vishayalu indulo chotu chesukunnayi.

morarji-desai.title: Morarji Desai
morarji-desai.description: Desh ke pehle aise rajneta jo bina congress party ke support ke  Prime Minister bane. Unka naam tha Morarji Ranchhodji Desai. Mahan Gandhiwadi aur freedom fighter se lekar PM banane tak ke Morarji Desai  ke safar ko batane ke liye kuku Fm le aaya hai ye special show. Jisme unke bachpan se lekar Indira Gandhi se adavat aur janta paty ke banane se lekar tootane tak ki poori kahani detail mein batayi gayi hai.

telugu-basha-goppatanam-charitra.title: Telugu Bhasha Goppatanam Charitra
telugu-basha-goppatanam-charitra.description: Classical Language Of India, Italian of the east, Desha Bhashalandu Telugu Lessa ani birudulu kaligi, Deshamlo 4 va Sthanam, Prapanchamlo 15 Va Sthanamlo Ekkkuva mandi matlade bhasha Gaa Perunna Mana  Telugu Bhasha Gurinchi Ee Audiobook lo Vianabotunnam. Mana Basha ela puttindi, Ekkada Puttindi, Everevaru Mana Bhasha keertthi ni pencharu vanti munupennadu vinani goppa vishayalu ee audiobook ni poorthiga vini telusukondi.

no-fap-the-ultimate-guide.title: NOFAP- The Ultimate Guide
no-fap-the-ultimate-guide.description: Sadharanamga manam Hasthaprayogam gurinchi peddaga matladamu. Adedo matladakudani vishayamga lonthamandi abhiprayapadatharu. Kaani adi prathi magavanilo inde sahajasidda lakshanam. Kontha mandiki dani gurinchi charchilani unna, Apohalau, Anumanalu unna evarini adagalo theliyadu. Ayithe deeni gurinchi charchinchalsina avasaram undi.

just-f_cking-do-it.title: Just F*cking Do It
just-f_cking-do-it.description: Agar aap apna best version dekhna chahte hai aur asmaan ki bulandiyon ko chhuna chahte hai, to ye audiobook aapke liye hi hai. Kyunki ise sunne ke baad aapke andar apne success ko 10 guna zyada karne ki power aa jayegi. Ye power aayegi 10 practical steps se jise is audiobook mein in-detail bataya gaya hai. Audiobook mein bataye gaye 10 steps ko follow karne ke baad,  aap na sirf chhota sochna band kar denge,  balki, apni life apni marzi ke mutabik jee payenge. Aaiye in steps ko Just F*cking Do It ki audiobook mein jaane! Agar aapko "The Rudest Book Ever" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

train-your-brain-transform-your-future.title: Train Your Brain Transform Your Future
train-your-brain-transform-your-future.description: Nammaloda seyalbaadugal ellaathukum namma Brain thaan mukkiya kaaranam ! Namma Brain power ra mulusaa use panninaa namma Life um nichayam semayaa irukum ! Brain na train panrathu moolamaa namma vazhkaiya vetrikaramaa maathurathu eppadingra ragasiyam intha audio book la iruku. Vaanga therinjikalam.

shri-ram-bhakta-gondavalekar-maharaj-tea.title: Bramhachaitanya Shri Gondavalekar Maharaj
shri-ram-bhakta-gondavalekar-maharaj-tea.description: Nam rangat rangato hari bhajanat dangato krupa kari bramhachaitanya tava charitra gatha sangato jethe nam tithe majha pran asha shabdat bhaktana savtachi  olakh sangnare Bhramachaitanya Gondavlekar Maharaj hey Maharashtra Gondavale ya gavata rahat. Tyani apla ayushya adhyatma Ram bhakti yat guntavla. Tyanchya mhana asaycha ki tumhala seva karyachi asel tar ramachi kara toh nakki tumchya madatila yeil. Tyani gavat ram mandir bandhla ani lokana yogya acharan kay aste yachi shikvan dili chala janun gheuyat Bhramachaitanya shri Gondavlekar Maharajan vishayi fakta kuku fm var

khilji.title: Bakhtiyar Khilji: Bharat Ki Virasat Nalanda Ka Vinash
khilji.description: Bakhtiyar Khilji, ek naam jo Bharat ke itihaas mein khoon ke daag se bhi gehra hai. Nalanda University ko jala kar raakh kar dene ka khel, ek aisa kaand jo aaj bhi Bharatiyon ke dilon dimag mein taaza hai. Lekin kya aap jaante hain, is haadse ke peeche chipa ek aur sach? Is show mein aap jaanenge Bakhtiyar Khilji ki woh haqeeqat, jo unke jeevan ke har mor par hue faislon ki wajah raha. Kya thi unke yudh ke peeche chipi saazishein? Kya thi unki rajneeti? Is show mein aap jaanenge saare sach, aur Bharat ke itihaas ki ek aisi aag ki kahani, jo kayi dilon mein aaj bhi sulag rahi hai.

rathi-rahasyalu.title: రతి రహస్యాలు
rathi-rahasyalu.description: రతిక్రియ అనేది ప్రతి ప్రాణికి అవసరమా? ఆధునిక పోకడలు నానాటికి పెరగిపోతున్న ఈ రోజుల్లో మానవుడు విచ్ఛలవిడి శృంగారాన్నే ఎక్కువగా ఎందుకు ఇష్టపడుతున్నాడు? ప్రతి దానికి నియమాలున్నట్లే శృంగారానికి కూడా కొన్ని నియమాలు ఉన్నాయా?

defining-you-3.title: Defining You
defining-you-3.description: Naan yaar? Who am I? Unga manasukkulle indha kelvi pala murai vandhurukkum. Ungaloda positives and negatives enna nu mathavanga unga kitta solradha vida, neengale self analysis panna mudinja evlo nallarukkum? Andha kelvi ku bathil thedura oru muyarchi dhan indha audiobook. Kelunga “Defining You” exclusively on Kuku FM

practical-guide-to-global-finance.title: Practical Guide To Global Finance
practical-guide-to-global-finance.description: Humne School mein har subject ke baare mein padha par hume kabhi bhi Finance ke baare mein nahi padhaya gaya aur shayad aaj bhi nahi padhaya jata hai, jabki aaj ke waqt mein hume Finance ki bhi utni hi knowledge honi chahiye jitni, doosare subjects ke baare mein hai. Par hume aapki fikar hai isiliye hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain ak aisa Audio show jisme aapko hum global finance se Judi har wo basic jankari denge jo aapke Investment journey ko aane wale waqt mein bahut zyada aasaan bana degi.

rajshekhar-basur-sera-7-choto-golpo.title: Rajshekhar Basu'r Sera 7 Chhoto Golpo
rajshekhar-basur-sera-7-choto-golpo.description: Bangla Sahityo Jogote Rajshekar Basu 'Parashuram'- Naam-e Khyato. Love, Detective, Humour Nana Dhoroner Golpo Likhe Gechen Tini. Kuku Fm Er Ei Bisesh Audioshow-e Tar Lekha Bacchai Kora 7ti Chhoto Golpo Neoya Hoyeche, Ja Aapnader Valo Lagbe.

dark-secrets-of-america.title: Dark Secrets Of America
dark-secrets-of-america.description: America duniya ka sabse bada desh hai, lekin kya ye sachmuch mein itna mahaan hai? Humare iss show "Dark Secrets of America" mein hum aapko batayenge America ke wo raaz jinhe aap pehle kabhi nahi jaante the. Yeh show aapko us America ke baare mein batayega jo aapne kabhi nahin suna hoga. Toh kya aap taiyar hain America ke raaz kholne ke liye ?

you-can-9.title: You Can
you-can-9.description: You can - indha book la enna solli iruku nu indha audio la kelunga.

காமினி-.title: காமினி
காமினி-.description: தன் காதலனுடன் புதுவாழ்வு தேடி பழவேற்காடு துறைமுகத்திற்கு செல்லும் காமினியின் வாழ்க்கையில் எதிர்பாராத பல சம்பவங்கள் நடக்கின்றன! அது அவளை அடிமையாக்கி டச்சு கப்பலில் தள்ளுகிறது.  நடுக்கடலில் பல ஆண்களுக்கு மத்தியில் போராடும் ஒரு பெண்ணின் கதை இது. காமினியின் வாழ்க்கை கரையேறியதா? தமிழ்நாட்டில் பிறந்து ஆப்பிரிக்காவில் அதிகாரம் செலுத்திய க்ரூட் கேட்ரிஜின் எனும் வரலாற்று பெண்ணின் கதையை உங்கள் குக்கூ எப் எம் ல் கேளுங்கள்...

the-scout-mindset.title: Train Your Brain To Think Better
the-scout-mindset.description: Aapko jankar hairani hogi ki duniya mein sirf do tarah ke log nahi hote. Balki unka mindset bhi do tarah ka hota hai. Tabhi to kuch log apne mindset ka istemal kar leader ban jate hai, to kuch bas unke followers bankar reh jate hai. Sawal yahan ye hai ki leader bane logon ke mindset mein aisa kya anokha hota hai, jo humare paas nahi hai. Iska jawab hai Train your Brain to think Better ki is audiobook mein. Ye audiobook aapko batayegi ki kaise sirf apne mindset se aap aadhi jung jeet sakte hai. Agar aapko "Moonwalking with Einstein" jaisi books pasand to ye audiobook aap zaroor sunein.

மரண-புன்னகை-.title: மரணப் புன்னகை
மரண-புன்னகை-.description: எதிர்காலத்தில் மனிதர்கள் மருத்துவத்தின் துணையால் மரணமில்லாத வாழ்க்கையைப் பெறுகிறார்கள். அதனால் மக்கள்தொகை பெருக்கத்தைக் கட்டுப்படுத்த, குழந்தைகள் பெற்றுக்கொள்ள தடை விதிக்கப்படுகிறது. சட்டத்தை மீறி பெற்றுக்கொள்ளப்படும் குழந்தைகள் உடனே கொலை செய்யப்படுகின்றன. அப்படிக் குழந்தைகளைக் கொல்லும் போலீஸ் அதிகாரி தான் ராக்கி. அவனால் கொலை செய்யப்பட்ட குழந்தையின் சிரிப்பு அவனைத் துரத்துகிறது, தூங்கவிடாமல் செய்கிறது. அது அவனுக்கு மரணப் புன்னகையாக மாறுகிறது. அந்த மரணப் புன்னகையிடமிருந்து அவன் எப்படித் தப்பித்தான்?

bogtui-gono-hotya.title: Sunday Thriller Stories: Bogtui Gono Hotya
bogtui-gono-hotya.description: 21st March 2022 Raat-e Birbhumer Bogtui Naam-Er Ek Grame Jyanto Jwaliye Deoya Hoy Kichu Manushke. Kintu Kara Ghotalo Ei Nirmom Kando? Proshner Uttor Pete Aapnake Shunte Hobe Sunday Thriller Stories-E Ei Ghotonar Tantan Natyorup.

pablo-neruda.title: Pablo Neruda: Ek Qaidi Ki Khuli Duniya
pablo-neruda.description: 'Pablo Neruda' ek aisa naam jise duniya ek kavi aur communist ke taur par jaanti hai. Pablo neruda ka jeevan humesha vivadon mein ghira raha lekin vahin sahitya premiyon ke dil mein vo humesha ek khas jagah banane mein safal rahe. Unke jeevan ki isi bikharti kahaani aur unki kavitaaon mein chhipe vichaaron ko janiye is audiobook mein.

smita-patil.title: Smita Patil
smita-patil.description: Ticha bolna, ticha chalna, ticha hasna aani ticha screen var disna- saglach Lajawab hota. Vidushakanchya jagaat vidushi mhanun aaleli ekmevadwitiya ti mhnjech 'Smita Patil.' Smita yanchya Filmy duniyetil madhil kahi unheard kisse, tyancha khasgi ayushtil kahi rahsya ya saglacha ulgada apan ya show madhun karnar ahot. Chala aikuya, eka Mansvichi Jeevan gatha- Tichi Shokantika ani ticha Career chi Yashogatha.

marunthilla-maruthuvam.title: Marunthilla Maruthuvam
marunthilla-maruthuvam.description: Noi illaa vaazhve kuraivatra selvam nu solluvaanga. Nammaloda Udamba nallaa paathukittaale vaalkai la matha ellaa vishayamum kai koodum. Maruthuvam illama nama udalai eppadi aarokiyama vachikurathunu intha book ungalukku soli kodukum.

hindi-sahitya-ka-samgrah-itihas.title: Hindi Sahitya ka Samagra Itihas
hindi-sahitya-ka-samgrah-itihas.description: Hindi bhasha aur hindi kavita ka rutba duniya mein bahut bada hai. Adikaal se lekar Aadhunik yug tak Sahitya ne bharatiye saskriti ko bhavnayon se aandolano tak kayam rakhne mein bada role nibhaya hai. Is kitaab mein apko milega Adikaal se lekar Adhunik kaal tak Hindi Sahitya ki Safar, kahan kahan se hota hua kaun kaun se pattharon se takraya, kahan kahan se isme dharayein judi, kahan se dharayein alag hui aur agar aap Sahitya ke thode bhi shokeen hai to yeh kitaab aap ke liye hai. Suniye "Hindi Sahitya ka Samgra Itihaas" Sirf KukuFM par.

exercises-at-home-simple-and-effective-w.title: Exercises At Home Simple And Effective Workouts
exercises-at-home-simple-and-effective-w.description: Vyayamam Shariraka Arogyam kosame kakunda, manasika Arogyam inka Andaniki kuda chala avasaram. Ayithe vyayamam cheyalante kahchitamag Gym ki vellalane apoha chalamandilo undi. Nijaniki saraina paddathulanu patisthe gym kante kuda intlone perfect ga vyayamam chesukovachhu. Ee Audiobook lo Intlone Untu Vyayamam chala simple and effective paddatulanu cheppadam jarigindi. Ippude ee audiobook ni poorthiga vini gym karchu lekunda intlone perfect vyayamanni cheyandi

maravarman-sundara-pandiyan.title: Maravarman Sundara Pandiyan
maravarman-sundara-pandiyan.description: Thenn India ah aanda maamannargal la Maravarman sundara paniyanukku oru mukkiya idam iruku. Avaroda aatchi mattrum saadhanaigala pathi indha audio book la keppom.

book-summary-9.title: Mantra Rahasya
book-summary-9.description: Duniya mein kayi tarah ke rahasya hain, jaise Ishwar hain ya nhin , Duniya kisne banayi, etc. Aur Aise bhi rahasya hain ki kaise aap khud ko healthy aur energetic rakh sakte hain. Kaise yoga aur mantra ki madad se apni mental health ko fit rakh sakte hain. Aur Indian vedon ka kya hai saar? sab batayenge is Audiobook "Mantra Rahasya" mein.

dravida-india.title: Dravida India
dravida-india.description: Dravidam appadinrathu sithaantham mattum illa, athu oru vaalviyal. Dravida Naagarigathoda mulu varalaaraiyum intha puthagam ungalukku eduthuraikkum. Vaanga Dravida Payanam merkollalaam

dream-job-paise-kamaane-ka-asaan-rasta.title: Dream Job : Paise Kamaane Ka Asaan Rasta
dream-job-paise-kamaane-ka-asaan-rasta.description: Kya aapko bhi apne dream job ki talash hai? Kya aap bhi janna chahte hai, logon ko kaise milti hai unki pasand ki naukri ? To suniye yeh audiobook  “Dream job - Paise kamaane ka asaan rasta". Iss audiobook mein aap sikhenge ki kaise banate hain wo resume aur cover letter, jo companies ko impress karte hain. Saath hi janenge un portals ke baare mein jo job khojne mein aapki madad kar sakta hai.

gnapaka-shakthini-penchukondi.title: Gnapaka Shakthini Penchukondi
gnapaka-shakthini-penchukondi.description: Prathi manishiki entho kontha gnapaka shakthi untundi, Konthamandiki thakkuvagaanu untundi. Ayithe marikontha mani thama chinnanati vishayalu, Thama snehithula perlanu kuda gurthupettukuntaru. Alanti gnapaka shakthi andariki undakapovachu. Ayithe mee gnapaka shakthini kuda aparamga penchukune chitkalu enno unnayi. Avento vini thelsukondi. Mee chinnanati gnapakalnu comments rupamlo rayandi.

ஊம்மை-நெஞ்சன்-கீதம்.title: ஊமை நெஞ்சன் கீதம்
ஊம்மை-நெஞ்சன்-கீதம்.description: காதலன் கொடுத்துவிட்டுச் சென்ற குழந்தையைத் தனியொருத்தியாகப் பாடுபட்டு வளர்க்கிறாள் நாயகி. ஆனால், அவள் எதிர்பாராத வேளையில் அவளது வாழ்க்கையில் மீண்டும் நுழைகிறான் முன்னாள் காதலன். இருவருக்கும் இடையேயான காதல் மீண்டும் துளிர்த்ததா?

stress-free-life-mantra.title: Stress Free Life Mantra
stress-free-life-mantra.description: Kya aap bhi pareshan hai? Kya aapko bhi lagta hai ki zindagi ka bojh, tension, aur stress aapko daba rahe hain? Agar haan, toh "Stress Free Life Mantra" suniye aur apni zindagi ko stress-free banane ke tarike sikhiye. Is audioshow mein, hum aapko batayenge ki kaise aap apni zindagi mein sukoon, chain, aur khushi la sakte hain. Hum aapko relaxation techniques, mindfulness exercises, aur meditation jaise aasan upay batayenge, jo aapki life mein positive changes la payenge.

the-prophet.title: The Prophet
the-prophet.description: Khalil Gibrante thathvachinthaparavum aathmiyavum prachothanathmakavumaya kaavyathmaka lekhanangalude samaharamanu The Prophet. 26 kavyopanyasangal ulla The Prophetinte audiobook ippol Malayalathil Kelku Kuku FMloode.

goverment-schemes-and-investment-process.title: Goverment Schemes And Investment Process
goverment-schemes-and-investment-process.description: Government Schemes Investment Dhokyacha ka Nahi Ha Prashna Tumchya Ani Majha Sarkhya Saglyanchya Manat Yeto. Kon Ti Kagadpatra, Ranget Ubhe Rahanar Pan Me Sangitla Ki Hey Asa Kahi Nasel Tar. Atta Te Kasa Hey Aiknya Sathi Tumhala Ha Show Aikava Lagel. Hya Madhye Apan Atal Yojana, Mahila Balvikas Yojana Ashya Baryach Schemes Baddal Janun Ghenar Ahot.

mera-lahuluan-punjab.title: Mera Lahooluhan Punjab
mera-lahuluan-punjab.description: Punjab! Yani ki vo jagah jahan 5 nadiyon ka pani milta ho. Vo jagah jahan se Harit Kranti ne janm liya, jisne desh ki bhookh ko mitaya. Aur Vo jagah bhi jahan se sabse zyada army ke jawan niklate hain. To fir 70 aur 80 ke dashak mein aisa kya hua ki ye khushhal pradesh aatankwadiyon aur algaav wadiyon ki jamin ban gaya. Aaye din khoon kharebe hue aur fir yahin ke do ladko ne Prime minister ki hatya kar di. Poori kahani batayege famous writer Khushwant singh ki likhi is khash book "Mera Lahooluhan Punjab" mein"

the-forgotten-jain-temples-in-kerala-1.title: The Forgotten Jain Temples in Kerala
the-forgotten-jain-temples-in-kerala-1.description: Jaina matham Keralathile ettavum pazhakam chenna mathangalil onnanu. BC 3am noottandil Chandragupta Mauryan thante bharanathinte 25-am varshathil simhasanam upekshich jainamatham prothsahippikan thudangiyathinu sheshamanu jaina matham Keralathil pracharathil vanathu. Keralathile purathanakalathe Jaina matha swadheenathinu thelivayi Keralathil embadum chithari kidakunna pala jaina kshethravashishtangalum und. Jaina mathathe kurich kooduthal visheshangal kelkam ee showyiloode.

bonalu.title: Bonalu
bonalu.description: Mana Telugu vaari intlo sampradayam prakaram Ashadamlo aadapaduchulu thama puttintiki vastharu. Alaage puttintiki vachina ammavarini bonam tho prasannam chesukoni, aamenu anandaparustharu ani nammakam. 1869 va samvathsaram lo janta nagarala prajalu Malaria vyadhiki guri ayinappudu mahankali ammavariki bonalu samarpistha manchi jarigindi ani nammi appati nundi sampradayanni konasagisthunnaru.

sarabjeet-singh-ki-ajeeb-dastan.title: Sarabjit Singh Ki Ajeeb Dastan
sarabjeet-singh-ki-ajeeb-dastan.description: Ek galti ki saza kitni badi ho sakti hai kabhi socha hai aapne? Saza aisi ki sirf naam ke confusion se aapko faansi ki saza suna di jaaye aur uske saath-saath apne desh bhi na lautne diya jaaye. Yahan tak ki aapka vaqeel aapke liye hi stand na lein toh kya aisi saza koi insaan seh paayega? Aisa hi kuch hua India ke Sarabjit Singh ke sath lekin  kya thi unki poori story? Yeh sunne ko milega aapko humare is show "Sarabjit Singh Ki Ajeeb Dastan" mein. To chaliye shuru karte hain.

how-to-take-care-of-hair-skin.title: Hair & Skin chi kalji kashi ghyavi?
how-to-take-care-of-hair-skin.description: Hair ani Skin he aplya personality madhil mahtvache bhag ahet. Nusta Suder disnya sathich nahi, tar Arogycha drushtine hi Kesanchi ani Twachechi kalji ghena khup garjecha asta. Ya show madhe apan, Hairfall/ Hair Loss kasa thambvaycha, Skin diseases na kasa door thewycha, tyavaril upchar kay ahet, yavishyi aiknar ahot. Ya Health Tips cha tumcha nakkich fayda hoil.

chola-dynasty-2.title: UPSC Notes: A Brief History Of Chola Dynasty
chola-dynasty-2.description: UPSC ka history syllabus aakhir kise asaan lagta hai, lekin agar usi history ke syllabus se Chola Dynasty jaise bade topic ko koi briefly aap tak pahuncha de, woh bhi asaan language ke sath toh kya kahenge aap? UPSC Notes: A brief history of Chola Dynasty, apko knowledge ke sath sath dega ek entertainment wala break.

resume-bananor-sohoj-upay.title: Resume Bananor Sohoj Upay
resume-bananor-sohoj-upay.description: Jibone Hoyto Aapni Bohubar Nana Company-te Resume Joma Korechen Kintu Kichutei Sekhan Theke Feedback Pan Ni. Bar Bar Rejection Er Mukhe Porechen. Aar Ei Rejection Pete Pete Ekta Somoy Por Hotash Hoye Porechen. Kintu Hotash Hoye Porle Hobe Na, Aapnake Aapnar Moner Moto Job Petei Hobe. Kintu Sei Job Pete Gele Jeta Sobar Prothome Dorkar Seta Holo Ekta Valo Aakorshoniyo Resume Banano. Kintu Kivabe Banate Hobe Seta? Aar Chinta Nei Aapnar Proshner Uttor Dite Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audio Show, Jekhan Theke Aapni Shikhe Nite Parben Kivabe Ekta Valo Aakorshoniyo Resume Banano Jay. Tahole Aar Deri Kiser? Jhotpot Mon Diye Ei Audio Show Purota Shune Nin Aar Egiye Cholun Aapnar Swopno Puroner Dike.

think-and-grow-rich-46.title: Think and Grow Rich
think-and-grow-rich-46.description: Ulaga pugazh petra intha puthagam, Panakkaarar aaga neenga seiyya vendiya mukkiyamaana 13 vazhimuraigal la solluthu. Sinthanai moolam Panakaarar aavatharkaana intha vazhimuraigala pala per follow panni nerayaa Panam sambaathichu irukkaanga ! Aprom enna neengalum follow panni panakaarar aagunga !

kaun-hain-bharat-mata.title: Kaun Hain Bharat Mata?
kaun-hain-bharat-mata.description: Kaun Hain Bharat Mata? Kuch saalon pehle Bharat mein ek sawal utha ki aakhir kyun sab log bole "Bharat Mata Ki Jai"? Kuch ko unka dharm allow nhin karta aur kuch apni vichardhara ke karan ye nhin bolna chahte the? Lekin sabse bada sawal ki aakhir hain kaun Bharat Mata? Aur kyun ? Kya Pandit Nehri ji ko sab cheezon ke liye Doshi batana sahi hai? In sabhi sawalon ke jawab aur itihas ka bahut sara gyan hai Purushottam Agrawal ki is kitab "Kaun Hain Bharat Mata" mein. Suniye poori audiobook sirf KUKU Fm par.

success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.title: Success Through A Positive Mental Attitude
success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.description: Ungaloda Vetri Kanavugala nejamaakkanuma ! apdina intha audiobook ungalukkaanathu thaan. 100+ successful persons vazhkaiya alasi aaranju avanga ellarum follow panna antha oru success ragasiyatha kandupidichu namakaaga intha audio book la sollirukanga. Antha ragasiyatha Namma life la follow panni healthy wealthy and happy ya irukalaam vaanga !

just-fcking-do-it-1.title: Just F*cking Do It
just-fcking-do-it-1.description: Ungalukku pidicha maathiri unga vazhkaiya vazhrathukku intha audiobook la sollirukkura  intha visayangala neenga kandippa follow panniye aaganum. ada aamaanga.. Intha visayangala neenga follow panna aarambichaale unga vaazhkai nichayam ungalukku pidicha maathiri maaridum ! eppadi nu therinjuka intha audio book ka kelunga.

modern-letter-writing-course.title: Modern Letter Writing Course
modern-letter-writing-course.description: Ab sikhiye aise letter likhna jo sabko pasand aaye! 'Modern Letter Writing' ka yeh audio course aapko sikhayega ki kaise aap sabhi occasions ke liye perfect letters likh sakte hain. Is course mein aap personal life, business letters aur different types ke letters likhna seekhenge. Ismein aapko sabhi tarah ke letters likhne ke tips milenge, haan, love letters ke bhi.

10-better-1.title: 10% better
10-better-1.description: Innaiku namma vaazhra life ah vida 1% better ah nammala naamale nalaiku improve pannikitaale nammalaala namma ninachathai adaya mudiyum. Intha Book la ungala neenga improve pannikirathuku thevayaana ellaa steps ayum author ungaluku sollirukaanga. Vaanga betterment ah nokki polaam

dhyeyam.title: Dhyeyam
dhyeyam.description: Preminchi Mosam chesina mugguru abbayila meeda paga pattina oka ammayi. Anna Chaduvu kosam Jeevitham Tyagam chesina Maroka Ammayi, Tanakante Pedda Vayasu unna Aunty ni Machhika Chesukunna abbayi, Jeevitham nashanam Ayye situation nundi Sucess ayina inkoka abbayi, Ee naluguri kathalu mana chuttu jarugutunna enno jeevithalaku sakshyanga yandamuri rasina ee beautiful anthology story ni More Interesting ga ee Audiobook lo vinandi.

bhoot-hazir-ho.title: Bhooth Haazir Ho- The Thapa Trial
bhoot-hazir-ho.description: Ek ajooba court case jisme, Ram Bahadur Thapa naam ke helper pe laga tha ek chudail ke maut ka aarop. Ye court case le chalegi aapko 1980 ke Odisha mein jahan har gaon par tha chudailo ka saya, aur tantrik kar rahe the in chudailo ka ilaj.  Aise hi ek gaon mein Thapa payal ki awaz se ghabra kar kar deta hai ek aurat ko ghayal aur doosre ka murder. Kya Thapa bhooth ko haazir kar payega katghare mein?  Kya Thapa sach mein hatya ka doshi hai ya iss kahani mein hai aur bhi bada twist?

tulasi-dalam.title: తులసీ దళం (Relaunch)
tulasi-dalam.description: పదేళ్ళ తులసీ అనే పాపని 21 రోజులలో చంపుతానని - ఓ మాంత్రికుడు వాగ్దానం చేశాడు!  ఆ పాపని రక్షించటానికి ఓ హిప్నాటిస్టు - ఒక డాక్టర్ కలిపి చేసే ప్రయత్నమే - ఈ తులసీదళం!

think-and-grow-rich-45.title: Think and Grow Rich
think-and-grow-rich-45.description: Think and Grow Rich ee pusthakam dwara Naploean Hill kevalam Dhanavantulaku maatrame upayogapadela kaakunda yelanti rangaallo aina churgga untu unnata staayiki yedagaali anukone vaarandarikosam rachincharu, prapancha vyaaptanga ee pustakam chadivina tarwata yendaro thama shaiini maarchukoni success ruchi chusaru.

emerging-players-of-this-ipl.title: Impact Players of Twenty:20
emerging-players-of-this-ipl.description: Kisi ne golagappe beche to kisi ne Canada jaane ki kar le the tayaari, Kisi ne apne pita ke sapne ko kiya sach to kisi ke pita ne chhod di apne bacho ke khatir khud ki Naukari. Par kya hai in khiladiyon ki puri kahani, Kya hai inke safalta ka raaz aur kyun hain aaj ye sabki aakhon ka taara? Kyun inn jaise khiladiyon ke liye badal diya BCCI ne apna rule aue shuru kiya Impact playar ka naya chapter. Janne ke liye suniye ye khaas audio show "Impact Players of Twenty:20".

how-to-raise-money-or-funds-for-startup-.title: Startup sathi Funding kase milval?
how-to-raise-money-or-funds-for-startup-.description: Aajcha Yuvak ha 9 to 5 job cha aiviji, Swatahcha Startup karnyavar adhik bhar detana disto. Startup suru karna he anekancha swapna asta, pan tya sathi lagnara Funding mhnjech bhandwal ubha karna he khara challange asta. Pan ha khas show tumhala yavishayich guide karnar ahe. Buisness sathi Funding milvnyache vividha paryay kote ahet, Startup sathi Loan kasa milu shakta, Investor sathi cha Pitching kasa asva...ya saglyachi mahiti tumhala ya show madhe aikyla milel

12-steps-to-be-successful.title: 12 Steps To Be Successful
12-steps-to-be-successful.description: Iss audio book mein 12 aasan kadam ki baat ki gayi hai, jisse aap apni zindagi mein kamyabi pa sakte hain. Apne sapne haqeeqat mein badal sakte hain. "12 steps to be Successful" ki yeh audiobook aapko sikhati hai ki apni zindagi ke liye plan kaise banaye aur goals kaise achieve kare.
