Isme aapko nayi skills aur naye perspectives ka gyan bhi milega, jisse aap apni zindagi mein nayi uchaiyo tak pahunch sakte hain

maaveeran-wel-paari.title: மாவீரன் வேள் பாரி
maaveeran-wel-paari.description: தன்னை நாடி வருபவர்களுக்கு அள்ளி அள்ளிக் கொடுத்து சிவந்த கைகளையுடைய பறம்பு மலைத் தலைவன் வேள் பாரியின் புகழ் கேட்டு தமிழகமே வியக்கிறது. மதுரை தமிழ்ச் சங்கத்தைச் சேர்ந்த பெரும்புலவர் கபிலரும் பாரியின் புகழ் கேட்டு பறம்பு மலைக்குச் செல்கிறார். பாரியின் நற்குணங்களையும் பண்புகளையும் பாடல்கள் மூலம் தமிழகம் முழுக்க பரப்புகிறார். பாரியின் புகழ் மூவேந்தர்களின் செவிகளை அடைந்து பொறாமை கொள்ளச் செய்கிறது. மூவேந்தர்களும் ஒன்று கூடி பாரியை வீழ்த்த படை திரட்டுகிறார்கள்.  வென்றது யார்? பாரியா அல்லது மூவேந்தர்களா?

self-improvement-sathi-kay-karava.title: Swatha Madhye Badal Kasa Ghadvava
self-improvement-sathi-kay-karava.description: Mitranno apan nehmich ekhadi famous personaity baghun tyancha vagna bolna aikun vichar krto ki apan asa kadhi hou. te kharch shakya ahe ka ? tar ho. aplyat kahi badal karun apan apli personality badlu shakto. tevha tumchya vyaktimatwala ek navi olakh, ek navi unchi, ek navaa ayaam denyasathi ha show nakki aika.

how-to-avoid-loss-in-stock-market.title: How To Avoid Loss And Earn Consistently In The Stock Market
how-to-avoid-loss-in-stock-market.description: Kya Aap bhi Stock Market mein paisa invest kar return kamana chahte hain par aisa ho nahin pa raha hai? Kya Aapne bhi stocks market se related kai books padhin par wo aapke kaam nahi aa rahe? Agar haan, to ye audiobook jaroor suniye. Is khaas audiobook mein bahut hi easy language mein stock market se profit kamane ke tarike bataye gaye hain. Ise sun kar aap stock market se consistently earn karenge aur loss se hamesha bache rahenge. "The Little Book that still beats the Market" jaisi book aapko pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

10-unexplained-mysteries-of-the-universe.title: 10 Unexplained Mysteries Of The Universe
10-unexplained-mysteries-of-the-universe.description: Indha prabanjam romba perusu, adhe pola adhukulla irukkura Marmangalum yeraalam. Sila mukkiya, purinjikka pudhir ah irukka koodiya vishayangal ah indha audio book la keluga.

whole-numbers-and-half-truths-2.title: Whole Numbers And Half Truths
whole-numbers-and-half-truths-2.description: Pulli vivarangal la unmaiyum irukku koodave poiyum irukku ! Pulli vivarangalai vachu unmaiyaana india va purinjukirathu eppadi nu Chennai ya serntha journalist Rukmini intha audio book la azhagaa sollirukanga. Police Station, Needhimandram, Maruthuvam nu pala visayangal la irukkura pulli vivarangalaiyum, athukku pinnadi irukira unmaigalayum, poigalaiyum therinjikittu unmaiyaana india va purinjukalaam vaanga.

free-to-focus-8.title: Free to Focus
free-to-focus-8.description: Zyada mehnat karne par to sabhi ko zyada fal milta hai. Lekin kya aapne kum mehnat ke sath zyada fal ki baat suni hai? Darasal ye saara khel aaapki productivity ka hota hai, jise aksar log apne khali time se jod lete hai. Jabki productivity ka matlab time aur apne kaam mein balance banana hota hai. Is audiobook mein aapko aise hi 9 tarikon ke baare mein bataya gaya hai, jise jankar aap apne goals,  apne relationships, apni health sabke liye sahi tarike se, poori productivity ke sath kaam kar payenge.

thurpu-chalukyula-sahityam-goppatanam.title: Thurpu Chalukyula Sahityam Goppatanam
thurpu-chalukyula-sahityam-goppatanam.description: Badami Chalukhyula Samanthuluga Tama ruling ni start chesina Toorpu Chalukhylu 7&8 centuries Madhya Present Andharapradesh pedavegi ni Vengi Capital ga Andhra Pradesh ni Rule Chesina veeri Great history ni KUKU Fm mana munduku Audiobook Roopam lo teesukuvachindi. Ippude Ee Audiobook ni complete ga vini Toorpu Chalukhyula Ghana Charitra ni telsusukondi

world-war-ii-1.title: World War II
world-war-ii-1.description: Over 70 million people, including civilians and military personnel, lost their lives during the Second World War. This staggering statistic represents the immense human cost of the conflict, and it is just one of the many fascinating and emotional facts that will be explored in our special original series - World War II. We will take listeners on a journey through the war, examining its causes, consequences, and impact on the world. From the rise of fascist regimes to the dropping of atomic bombs, we will delve into the events and decisions that shaped this global catastrophe and explore the experiences of soldiers, civilians, and leaders alike. Join us as we take a deep dive into one of the most consequential events in human history and explore the enduring legacy of the Second World War.

10-better_raw.title: 10% Better
10-better_raw.description: 10% Better AudioBook aapki day to day Life mein bahut help kar sakti hai, Ye AudioBook unke liye bahut jyada beneficial ho hai jo apni khud ki life ko observe karna chahte hai ki kaha mistake ho rahi hai aur use sudharne ke liye vo changes karne ke liye bhi ready hai. Aur genrally dekhe to ye AudioBook aapke Stress door karne, achche se sochne mein, healthy rehne aur kisi bhi goal ko achieve karne mein aapki madad Zaroor kar sakti hai.

manithanin-mahathana-sakthigal.title: Manithanin Mahathana Sakthigal
manithanin-mahathana-sakthigal.description: Ovvoru Manushan kullayum pala mahathaana sakthigal irukku. Intha Book ungalukulla irukka sakthiyai ungaluku unara vaikkum. Gaandha sakthigal pathina thelivaana purithal ungaluku kidaika poguthu. Vaanga namma sakthigalai therinjukalam

azadi.title: Azadi
azadi.description: AZADI KYA HAI? 1947 mein desh ka Azad hona? Zamindari pratha se azad hona? Teen talaq se azadi? Sarkaron ke tax se azadi? Azadi kayi tarah ki ho sakti hai.Lekin sabse badi azadi hai "Vicharo Ki", Jise hum kahte hain "Freedom of Expression". Aur corona ne kaise hume fir se gulaam bana diya tha. Is desh ne kya seekha corona ke un bure 2 saalon wale daur se. Sab sawalon ke jawab milenge aapko Arundhati Roy ki is mashoor kitab "Azadi" ki Audiobook mein.

how-to-boost-your-self-confidence-2.title: How To Boost Your Self Confidence
how-to-boost-your-self-confidence-2.description: Discover "How To Boost Your Self Confidence," an empowering audiobook that guides you on a transformative journey to unlock your true potential. With expert advice and practical strategies, this self-help title offers valuable insights on cultivating unwavering self-confidence in every aspect of your life. Overcome self-doubt, embrace your unique qualities, and navigate challenging situations with poise. Through relatable anecdotes and actionable exercises, you'll develop the tools to conquer social anxiety and step into your full potential. With a warm and encouraging narration, this audiobook serves as your go-to resource for transforming self-doubt into unshakeable confidence. Whether you aspire to excel in your career, build fulfilling relationships, or simply lead a more fulfilling life, "How To Boost Your Self Confidence" empowers you to embrace your inner strengths and unleash your true confidence.

dawood-ibrahim-chota-rajan.title: Dawood Ibrahim & Chota Rajan
dawood-ibrahim-chota-rajan.description: Underworld Mafia Maata Vinagane Mumbai police laku chukkalu chupinchina  Dawood Ibrahim & Chota Rajan Gurthukuvastaru. Gang Murders, Drugs Deals, Blasts,akrama ayudhala sarafara, terrorists tho sambandala tho paatu mumbai lo jarigine pellulla varaku veeru chesina daarunala gurinchi Asalu Ee Dawood & Chota Rajan Evaru, Ekkadinundi Mumbai ki Vacharu? Vella meeda unna case lu inka enno vishyalanu ee Audiobook Poorthiga Vinandi

baba-bagheswar.title: Bageshwar Baba Ki Sachai
baba-bagheswar.description: Bageshwar Baba social media ka ek woh naam jo aaj har ghar mein jana jata hai, har news channel par dekha jata hai, aur Bageshwar Dham mein puja jata hai. Unhi Dhirendra Krishna Shastri ki zindagi mein kuch baatein aisi bhi hain ki unhe sunkar aapke hosh ud jayenge. Unke anubhav aur gyaan se bhari kahaniyan aapke dil ko chu jayengi aur aap unki upasana mein khud ko talashenge. Ye show aapke man ko shaanti aur aatmikta ka anubhav hi nahi, balki kai sawalon ke sath chod jayega.

islam-matha-charitra.title: ఇస్లాం మత చరిత్ర
islam-matha-charitra.description: అసలు ఇస్లాం మత స్థాపన ఎలా జరిగింది? ఇస్లాం పద్ధతులు ఏంటి? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

the-trained-memory.title: The Trained Memory
the-trained-memory.description: "The Trained Memory" by Warren Hilton, is a timeless self-help classic and a groundbreaking book that delves into the art of memory improvement, offering listeners practical techniques to enhance their memory skills and cognitive abilities. With his expertise as a psychologist, Hilton guides listeners through various memory systems, mnemonic devices, and exercises designed to boost memory retention and recall. Whether you struggle to remember names, numbers, or important information, this audiobook provides invaluable strategies to overcome those challenges. Hilton's engaging narrative style and insightful teachings make this audiobook a must-listen for anyone seeking to develop a trained memory. Sharpen your mental acuity, improve your recall, and unlock the full potential of your memory with "The Trained Memory" on Audible. Experience the transformative power of memory training and elevate your cognitive abilities to new heights.

the-success-code.title: The Success Code
the-success-code.description: Yeh audiobook kuch aise raaz kholega jo aapko safalta ki ore le jayenge. Vyavaharik salah, strategies aur inspiring stories se yeh audiobook ek winning mindset develop karne ke baare mein baat karti hai. Agar aap unme se hai jo mehnat karna chahte hai. Apne pure potential ko unlock karna chahte hai. Success hasil karna chahte hai to suniye "The Success Code" ki yeh audiobook.

പെരുമഴയത്തെ-കുഞ്ഞിതളുകള്‍.title: പെരുമഴയത്തെ കുഞ്ഞിതളുകള്‍
പെരുമഴയത്തെ-കുഞ്ഞിതളുകള്‍.description: 2018ലെ പ്രളയവും അതിജീവനവും പ്രമേയമാക്കി പ്രിയ എഎസ് എഴുതിയ ബാലസാഹിത്യ നോവല്‍ ആണ് പെരുമഴയത്തെ കുഞ്ഞിതളുകള്‍. പ്രളയകാലത്തെ ദുരിതാശ്വാസ ക്യാമ്പില്‍ കഴിഞ്ഞ കുട്ടികളില്‍ നിന്നാണ് നോവലിന് ആസ്പദമായ കഥാബീജം പ്രിയ കണ്ടെടുക്കുന്നത്. മികച്ച ബാലസാഹിത്യ നോവലിനുള്ള കേരള സാഹിത്യ അക്കാദമി അവാര്‍ഡും കേന്ദ്രസാഹിത്യ അക്കാദമി അവാര്‍ഡും നേടിയ നോവല്‍ ഏറെ ഹൃദയ സ്പര്‍ശിയാണ്.

അഞ്ച്-നോവെല്ലകള്‍.title: അഞ്ച് നോവെല്ലകള്‍
അഞ്ച്-നോവെല്ലകള്‍.description: പൊള്ളുന്ന ജീവിത യാഥാര്‍ത്ഥ്യങ്ങളിലൂടെ നമ്മെ എരിയിക്കുന്ന പുസ്തകമാണ് അംബികാസുതന്‍ മാങ്ങാടിന്റെ അഞ്ച് നോവെല്ലകള്‍. സംഘര്‍ഷഭരിതമായ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വഴിത്താരയിലൂടെ സഞ്ചരിക്കുന്ന കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളുടെ ഉള്ളിനെ തൊട്ടറിഞ്ഞു കൊണ്ടുള്ള എഴുത്തുകൊണ്ട് കഥ പറച്ചിലുകാരന്‍ നമ്മെ അദ്ഭുതപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു. വായന പുരോഗമിക്കും തോറും നമ്മെ അതില്‍ കൊളുത്തിയിടുന്ന തരം കഥകള്‍ നമുക്ക് കേട്ട് തുടങ്ങാം.

america-2020-ek-banta-hua-desh.title: America 2020: Ek Banta Hua Desh
america-2020-ek-banta-hua-desh.description: America, Duniya ka sabse purana Loktantra aur sabse ameer desh. Fir bhi Kyun ye kayi tareekon se banta hua hai? Kya Barack Obama ke hatne ke baad yahan fir se Musalmano par nayi talwar latakne lagi? 9/11 Ke baad kaise America ne khud ko aur mazboot kiya aur fir saal 2020 tak bhi kya-kya nhin badla. Sab janiye Avinash Kalla ki likhi kitab America 2020 : Ek Banta Hua Desh ki is Audio Book mein.

brief-history-of-a-genius-stephen-hawkin.title: Brief History Of A Genius: Stephen Hawking's Story
brief-history-of-a-genius-stephen-hawkin.description: Shareerathile koshangale thalarthunna apoorva rogam badhichittum thante nischaya dhardyathal nettangalude kodumudiyil ethiya prathibha shaaliyaya Shastrajnan aanu Stephen Hawking. Shasthra lokam kanda maha prathibhakalil oralaaya Bhouthika Shasthrajnan. Adhehathinte 'A Brief History Of Time' enna grantham vikhyathamanu. Prapanjathekkurichum Thamogarthangalekkurichum ulla adhehathinte padanangalum kandethalukalum shasthra lokathinu puthiya disha kaatti.

1993-mumbai-blasts-1.title: 1993 Mumbai Blasts
1993-mumbai-blasts-1.description: 1993 march 12 , Afternoon 1Pm, Bambay stock exchange tho paatu mumbai loni inka 12 paces lo Attacks, 257 deaths, 700 injured. inka 120 ki paiga nindutulu unna case lo  22 years tarwatha pradhana ninditudu yakub Uri teeyadam tho paatu maro 12 mandiki uri shiksha veyadam jarigindi. Mari inthati kallolanni create chesi ee sanghatanalanu, vaati venuka unna vaarevaru, case investigation ela jarigindi vanti interesting vishayalanu ee audiobook lo vinandi.

master-ji.title: Master Ji
master-ji.description: Gharwalo ke virudh jaakar apne sapne ko pura kar Adarsh ban gaya teacher par Dhatura aakar mili usey nayi musibatein. Kaise padhayega wo us school me jahan chhat se tapakta hai paani aur na bacche aate hain aur naa aati hai uski salary? Har kadam par corruption, dhokha, aur musibato se ladta Adarsh kya bana payega gaon walo ko apna dost jab puri school staff aur panchayat ban chuki hai uski dushman? Janne ke liye sune Master Ji sirf kuku fm par. Sune jo man chahe.

rapidex-english-speaking-course-1.title: Rapidex English Speaking Course
rapidex-english-speaking-course-1.description: మీరు ఇంగ్లీషు నేర్చుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే ఇప్పుడు అది పెద్ద సమస్య కాదు. ఎందుకంటే మీరు రాపిడెక్స్ ఆడియో బుక్ విని ఇంగ్లీష్ భాష మీద పూర్తి పట్టు సాధించవచ్చు. ఇక మీదే ఆలస్యం.

thackerary-bhau-by-dhaval-kulkarni-1.title: Thackeray Bhau
thackerary-bhau-by-dhaval-kulkarni-1.description: Ye Saal 1960 tha. Maharashtra  ek alag rajya bana aur fir yahan shuru hui asli rajneeti. Fir kaise shuru hue uttar bharat ke logon ko Maharashtra se nikalane ke liye aur marathi logon ko job dene ke liye pradarshan? Kaise bani Shivsena aur kaise Bala Saheb Thackeray ban gaye ek bada naam. Thackeray pariwar ki poori kahani bata rahe hain "Thackeray Bhau" kitab ki is audiobook mein.

penkalvi.title: Penkalvi
penkalvi.description: Penkalvi oda Mukkiyathuvangal enna nu namakku therinji irukalam, theriyadha pala vishyangala indha audio book la kelunga.

power-of-subconscious-mind-4.title: The Power Of Your Subconscious Mind
power-of-subconscious-mind-4.description: Manushya Jeevithathile vijaya parajayangalkkum sukha dukhangalkkum karanamayi varthikkunnathil nammude ullil urangikkidakkunna upabodha manassinulla pankinekkurich paranjal ningalil ethra perk athu viswasikkanavum. Ithu karya karana sahitham samarthikkukayanu vikhyatha ezhuthukaranum Daiva shasthrathinte prayokthavum aaya Joseph Murphy thante prasidha pusthakam aaya The Power Of Your Subconcious Mind-lude.

value-of-money.title: Value of Money
value-of-money.description: Shayad ye hum sab jaante hain ki aaj ke waqt mein paise se zyada valuable cheez kuch bhi nahi hai. Paise se lagbhag har wo cheez kharidi ja sakti hai jiske baare mein hum soch bhi nahi sakte. Par ye paisa aata kaha se hai? kya hai aisa jo paise ko itna valuable banati hai? Paisa banne ke piche ki kya kahani hai? Paise ka len den ek desh se dusre desh main kaise hota? Aur aakhir kaise hum is paise ko kaam par laga kar aur bhi zyada paise kama sakte hain? Aise hi kai sawalon ke jawaab aur bahut sare Principle’s ke baare mein bataya gaya hai is Audiobook mein. Agar aapko "Why Didn't they teach me this In School" jaisi books pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

asurokkhito-sex-ebong-hiv-theke-bachun.title: Asurokkhito SEX Ebong HIV Theke Bachun
asurokkhito-sex-ebong-hiv-theke-bachun.description: HIV asole ki? Kokhono bhebe dekhechen ki? Naki apnio bhabchen je apni kokhono HIV te akranto hote parben na? Tahole kintu goratei golot ache. Jodi ektu sotorko naa hon jouno miloner somoy tahole kintu seta marattok khotir dike jete pare. Kintu kisher eto bhoy ei HIV niye? Eta ekti virus. HIV immune system ke durbol kore dite pare. Ei virus sonkromoner shobcheye sadharon podhyotir gulo modhye royeche jouno milon ebong aro anek kichu. HIV somporke bistarito bhabe jante ba nijeder ke HIV er haath theke mukto korte ekhoni shune nin ei audio story ti.

upsc-radio-telugu-1.title: UPSC Radio Telugu
upsc-radio-telugu-1.description: సివిల్ సర్వీసెస్ పరీక్ష (UPSC) కు సమర్థవంతంగా ఎలా సన్నద్ధం కావాలి?  దీనికి ఎలాంటి సిలబస్ ఉంటుంది ? ప్రిపరేషన్ ఎలా చేయాలి? అది తెలుసుకోవాలంటే మీరు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే.!

how-to-choose-a-stream-after-10th.title: How to choose a stream after 10th
how-to-choose-a-stream-after-10th.description: Kya aap khud ke liye ya apne bachche ke liye ek achhe career ki talaash mein hain? Ek aisa career jiske raaste par chalne ke baad kabhi regret na ho? Toh abhi is audiobook ko suniye aur apne dream career ke raaste par chalne ke liye perfect stream select kar lijiye. Ye audiobook naye-puraane, har tarah ke careers ke liye ek ultimate guide hai jismein har field ki detailed information ke saath usmein safalta haasil karne ka roadmap hai. Yaad rakhiye perfect stream selection yaani successful Career ki guarantee.

no-ball-the-murky-world-of-match-fixing.title: No Ball: The Murky World of Match Fixing
no-ball-the-murky-world-of-match-fixing.description: Cricket Khela Rajader Khela, Emontai Bola Hoye Thake. Aar Ei Khela Gota Biswey Besh Jonopriyo. Kintu Ei Jonopriyo Khela Bohubar Kolushito Hoyeche Match Fixing Er Kobole. Aar Jonopriyo Cricket League Gulote Ei Match Fixing Kothata Jeno Ekhon Rondhe Joriye Geche. Er Pashapashi Aantorjatik Khelateo Er Provab Royeche. Aar Ei Match Fixing Chokre Joriye Gechen Ekadhik Namkora Kheloyar. Match Fixing Jinista Aasole Ki? Cricket Duniyay Ei Match Fixing Shuru Holo Kobe? Kivabe Joriye Porlen Kheloyar-ra? Kara Niyontron Korten Tader? Eisob Proshner Uttor Royeche Chandramohan Puppala- Er Lekha 'No Ball: The Murky World of Match Fixing'Ei Boite. Ja Janar Por Aapni Obak Hoben. Cholun Aar Somoy Nosto Na Kore Shune Neoya Jak Cricket Duniyar Sei Kolushito Odhaygulo.

udal-ullam-unavu.title: Udal Ullam Unavu
udal-ullam-unavu.description: Namma Udalum Ullamum Unavum onnodu onnu connected aah irukumnu namal la niraya perukku therinjaalum, oru aarokiyaamana vaalkaikaana thedal namma kitta eppovume irukkum. Antha thedal ku vidai thaan intha puthagam. Intha pathivu unga vaalkaiyai aarokyama maathum.

introduction-to-computer.title: Introduction to Computer
introduction-to-computer.description: Computer ka itihas apne aap mein hi bahut mazedar hai. Par kya aapne kabhi ye janne ki koshish ki hai, ki ye aakhir bana kaise? Aakhir iska Software kaise work karta hai? Hardware ka kya kaam hai ? Aur ye WWW yani world wide web ki kya kahani hai? Aakhir Computer se Internet ka kya lena dena hai? In saare sawalon ka jawaab hai humari is Audio book mein jiska naam hai "Introduction to Computer"

bulls-and-bears-of-stock-market.title: Stock Market madhil Bulls & Bears
bulls-and-bears-of-stock-market.description: Stock Market madhe, Bulls and Bears ya 2 khup important concepts astat. Share Market madhe Bulls nemka konala mhatat ani Bear konala mahtat, Market madhe tyanchi kay position aste, trading shi yacha nakki kay sambndha asto kinva Bull ani Bear hi nava nemaki kashi padli? Asha anek prashnanchi uttara ya show madhe ahet. Tumhi Share market madhe jar navin asal tar ha show tumcha sathi nakkich faydeshir tharu shakel.

kingfisher-scam.title: Kingfisher Scam
kingfisher-scam.description: Har acchi chez ka ant toh hona hi hai, King of Good Times- Vijay Mallya ka bhi 2016 mein Endgame ho hi gaya. Bharat ke sabse bade businessman se le kar Bharat ke sabse bade thug banane tak, Mallya ne Bollywood, Politics, Cricket, har kuch kar liya. Aur 2016 mein unhone Bharatiya banko ko 9000 crore ka chakhma laga kar desh chod diya. Sune is rangeen Businessman ki ultra rangeen kahani.

chandragupta-maurya-3.title: Chandragupta Maurya
chandragupta-maurya-3.description: Chandragupta Mauryudu, Maurya Samrajya sthaapakudu. Mana Barathadesham antha yekam chesi rajyani palinchina rajulalo Chandraguptudu entho goppa vyakthi, eeyana enno gurthimpulu pondharu, mana desha charitrani goppa sthayiki teeskelina aayana gurinchi meeku teliyani enno vishyala gurinchi telusukondi ee audio book lo.

who-killed-aditha-karikalan.title: Who Killed Aditha Karikalan
who-killed-aditha-karikalan.description: Aditha Karikalan ah kadambur maaligai la vechu Nandhini kolai senjadha Ponniyin Selvan la padichurupom. Aana unmaiyil enna nadanduchu nu theriyuma? Karikalan maranam kurithu pala conspiracy theories innum suthitu dhan iruku. Idhula edhu unmai? Edhu vadhanthi? Nijathula enna dhan nadanthathu? Varalaaru enna solludhu nu therinjuka kelunga "Who killed Aditha Karikalan?" on Kuku FM

afterlife_-what-comes-next.title: Afterlife: What Comes Next ?
afterlife_-what-comes-next.description: Kya aapne kabhi socha hai ki marne ke baad humari soul kaha jati hai? Usse bhi zaroori yeh ki kya soul jaisa kuch hota bhi hai? Agar nahi to phir yeh energy kaha se aati hai ? Aur baar baar recycle kyun hoti hai ? Universe se jude bahut gehre raaz decode karenge is audio series main jise sun kar aapki human advancement aur spirituality se jude sari hi curiosities par lagega purn viraam.

kaviyarasar-kannadasan.title: Kaviyarasar Kannadasan
kaviyarasar-kannadasan.description: Thannudaiya Kavithai thiramiyaala Tamil Makkal manasula neengatha idam pidicha kavignar Kannadhasan oda motha vaalkaiyavum surukki oru alagiya pathivaa ungaluku samarpikkirathu KUKU FM. Intha pathivu moolamaa Kaviyarasar pathina pala swarasyamana vishayangala neenga kettu therinjukalam

income-tax-old-regime-vs-new-regime-whic.title: Income Tax - Old regime Vs New regime which is better ?
income-tax-old-regime-vs-new-regime-whic.description: India Naattoda ovvoru kudimaganum vari seluthurathu rombave mukkiyam. But namma makkalukku Tax katrathu la niraya doubts irukkum. ITR file panrathula Old Regime kum New Regime kum enna difference, ethu best nu eduthu solra pathivu thaan ithu.

diabetes-control.title: Diabetes Control
diabetes-control.description: Diabetes control karna bahut hi challenging ho sakta hai, par yeh audiobook aapki madad kar sakta hai Diabetes ko acche se samjhne aur use control karne mein. Iss audio book se janiye ki kaise aap apne blood sugar levels ko manage kar sakte hai.  Apni overall health ko improve kar sakte hai. Saath hi, kuch practical advice apni diet ko manage karke apne diabetes ko control mein rakhne ke liye

தீக்குள்-ஒரு-தவம்-.title: தீக்குள் ஒரு தவம்
தீக்குள்-ஒரு-தவம்-.description: சிவகாசி தீப்பெட்டித் தொழிற்சாலையில் வேலை செய்பவர்கள் வள்ளியம்மை மற்றும் அவளின் மூன்று பிள்ளைகளான சத்யன், சேது, குணா. தொழிற்சாலை உரிமையாளரின் மூத்தப் பெண் ஜான்சி சேது மீது காதல் கொள்கிறாள். முதலில் அதை மறுத்தாலும் இறுதியில் சேதுவும் ஜான்சியின் காதலை ஏற்கிறான். சேதுவும் ஜான்சியும் ரகசியமாகத் திருமணம் செய்துகொள்கிறார்கள். அது அவர்கள் வாழ்க்கையில் மிகப் பெரும் திருப்பத்தை உண்டாக்கிறது. உயிர் இழப்புகளும் துரோகமும் பழிவாங்குதலும் அரங்கேறுகிறது. சேதுவின் காதல் என்ன ஆனது? மேற்குதொடர்ச்சி மலையின் சாரலும் தூரலும் சேர்ந்து காதலும் கலவியும் சேர்ந்து துல்லாட்டம் போட வைக்கும் கதையைக் கேளுங்கள்...

shri-gurudev-dutta.title: Shri Gurudev Dutta
shri-gurudev-dutta.description: Om shree Dattatryay namaha! Shroteho, ya khas show madhun apan Shri Datta guruncha Avtar karyavishayi janun ghenar ahot. Shripad Shri Vallabhancha janmapasun te tyancha vvidha leela, tyanche anek Avtaar, tyatil tyanche karya yavishyi mahiti aiknar ahot. Bola, Avdhoot Chintan Shri Gurudev Dutta!!

80-mins-mba-all-episodes.title: The 80 Minute MBA
80-mins-mba-all-episodes.description: Kya aap bhi ek business shuru karna chahte hain ? Lekin apke paas MBA ki padhayi karne layak paise aur waqt nahi hai ? To yeh kitaab aap ke liye hai. The 80 minute MBA mein MBA course ki sabse khaas aur zaroori cheezon ka nichod hai jo apko apni daily life se hi seekhne mil jayengi. Examples ke saath Is kitaab ke authors ne bade hi saleeke se hamare waqton mein business karne ko lekar aam aur khas tippaniyan ki hain. Suniye The 80 Minute MBA exclusively Hindi mein sirf KukuFM par.

the-legend-of-birsa-munda.title: The Legend Of Birsa Munda
the-legend-of-birsa-munda.description: In 19th century India, amidst the state of Jharkhand, the Adivasis suffered under the oppressive colonial regime. Their land, homes, history, traditions, and families were targeted for the benefit of the empire. But when pushed to the brink of erasure, they rose up in rebellion led by Birsa Munda, a courageous twenty-five-year-old warrior. Birsa Munda fought to reclaim their lives, standing against forced conversions and envisioning a fairer society. This forgotten hero mobilized the tribal community, becoming a spiritual guide and healer. The Legend of Birsa Munda pays tribute to his remarkable life, a tale of bravery based on true events. It unveils the untold story of a subaltern tribal hero, often omitted from history books, whose contributions to India's struggle for independence should never fade away. This thrilling account honors Birsa Munda's fight for justice and serves as a reminder of his enduring legacy.

guidance-to-achieve-success-in-career-ac.title: Guidance To Achieve Success According To Your Rashi
guidance-to-achieve-success-in-career-ac.description: Chahe hum maane ya na maane Life mein success humare hard work ke sath sath humare luck pe bhi utna he depend karti hai, Isiliye shayad hum apne Rashi ko lekar kisi na kisi se discuss karte rehte hain, Par aakhir kaise hume apne rashi ke according apna career chose karna chahiye in sab ke baare mein batayenge aapko humare is original show mein jiska naam hai Guidance to Achieve Success According to Your Rashi.

major-terrorist-attacks-that-shook-the-w.title: Major Terrorist Attacks That Shook The World
major-terrorist-attacks-that-shook-the-w.description: Lokathe nadukkiya ettavum pradhanapetta 8 theevravadhi aakramangalum athu athaathu rajyangale bhaadhichathu enganeyellamanennum charcha cheyunna show aanu 'Major Terrorist Attacks That Shook The World'

വീടുവിട്ടു-പോകുന്നു.title: വീടുവിട്ടു പോകുന്നു
വീടുവിട്ടു-പോകുന്നു.description: പച്ചയായ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ നേർ കാഴ്ചയാണ് അഷ്ടമൂർത്തി കഥകൾ. ജീവിതത്തിനിടയിൽ നമ്മൾ എവിടെയൊക്കെയോ വച്ച് ശ്രദ്ധിക്കാതെ പോയ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ മറന്നുപോയ ചില പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട കാര്യങ്ങളുടെയും ആളുകളുടെയും പ്രാധാന്യം തിരിച്ചറിയാൻ 'വീടുവിട്ടു പോകുന്നു' എന്ന പുസ്തകത്തിലൂടെ ഒരുപക്ഷേ കഴിഞ്ഞേക്കും.

bhima-koregaon-1.title: Bhima Koregaon
bhima-koregaon-1.description: UPSC ke Syllabus mein apne aksar Bhima Koregaon ke bare mein suna hoga. IAS aur PCS banne ki mehnat karne wale aaj humare desh ke har chotey bade atihasik kisson ke bare mein jante aur padhte hai. Lekin kya aap jante hai Bhima Koregaon ka pura sach? Kya aap jante hai is Pehchaan aur samaan ke huq ki ladai ke bare mein? Agar nahi toh abhi suniye Bhima Koregaon.

തീക്കടൽ-കടഞ്ഞ്-തിരുമധുരം.title: തീക്കടൽ കടഞ്ഞ് തിരുമധുരം
തീക്കടൽ-കടഞ്ഞ്-തിരുമധുരം.description: മലയാളഭാഷാപിതാവായ എഴുത്തച്ഛന്റെ ജീവിതത്തിലേക്കും മലയാള ഭാഷക്ക് അദ്ദേഹം നൽകിയിട്ടുള്ള സംഭാവനകളിലേക്കും വെളിച്ചം വീശുകയാണ് സി രാധാകൃഷ്ണൻ 'തീക്കടൽ കടഞ്ഞ് തിരുമധുരം' എന്ന പുസ്തകത്തിലൂടെ. മൂർത്തിദേവി പുരസ്കാരം, ഓടക്കുഴൽ അവാർഡ്, അമൃതകീർത്തി അവാർഡ്, സഞ്ജയൻ പുരസ്‌കാരം, ജ്ഞാനപ്പാന അവാർഡ്, കെ. പി. നാരായണപ്പിഷാരടി പുരസ്കാരം തുടങ്ങിയ നിരവധി പുരസ്കാരങ്ങളും ഈ കൃതിക്ക് ലഭിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്.

ഇരട്ടച്ചങ്ക്‌.title: ഇരട്ടച്ചങ്ക്‌
ഇരട്ടച്ചങ്ക്‌.description: കൂടെ ഇരുന്ന് ഒരു കൂട്ടുകാരന്‍ പറയുന്നത് പോലെ കഥകളുടെ കെട്ടഴിക്കുകയാണ് ബിപിന്‍ ചന്ദ്രന്‍. അനുഭവങ്ങളും ഓര്‍മ്മകളും അയത്‌ന ലളിതമായ മലയാളത്തില്‍ അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിലൂടെ കേട്ടിരിക്കുന്നവരും അതിലലിയും. ഇരട്ടച്ചങ്ക് കേള്‍ക്കാം.

sonagachi-ki-lalita-1.title: Sonagachi ki Lalita
sonagachi-ki-lalita-1.description: Sonagachi ki galiyon se nikal kar, Lalita Pune shehar mei apni zindagi ko ek nayi shuruaat dene aayi hai par uske haath toh Fawad ke khoon se range hain.

വാരനാടൻ-കഥകൾ.title: വാരനാടൻ കഥകൾ
വാരനാടൻ-കഥകൾ.description: വാരനാട്‌ എന്ന നാട്ടിലെ സാധാരണക്കാരായ ആളുകളുടെ ജീവിതവും രീതികളും നർമ്മത്തിൽ ചാലിച്ച് അവതരിപ്പിച്ചിരിക്കുകയാണ് എഴുത്തുകാരൻ സുനീഷ് വാരനാട്, 'വാരനാടൻ കഥകൾ' എന്ന പുസ്തകത്തിൽ. മലയാളികളുടെ പ്രിയ നടനായ മോഹൻലാലാണ് ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്കിന് ആമുഖം നൽകിയിട്ടുള്ളത്. ഇതിലെ ചില കഥകൾ നിങ്ങളെ ചിരിപ്പിക്കും, മറ്റു ചിലത് ചിരിക്കുന്നതിനോടൊപ്പം ചിന്തിക്കാനുള്ള വകയും കേൾവിക്കാർക്ക് നല്കുന്നു.

the-american-civil-war-1.title: The American Civil War
the-american-civil-war-1.description: The American Civil War, fought from 1861 to 1865, remains one of the most defining and emotional periods of American history. Even today, over 150 years after the conflict ended, the war still evokes strong emotions among Americans. For many, the war is a symbol of the country's resilience and determination in the face of great adversity. For others, it represents a dark period of division and violence that continues to shape our society in profound ways. In this audio show, we will explore every aspect of the American Civil War, from its origins in slavery and sectionalism to its enduring legacy in American culture and politics. Join us on this journey as we explore the American Civil War in all its complexity and nuance, and seek to understand its enduring impact on our nation.

gupta-dynasty-1.title: The Golden Age Of Gupta Dynasty
gupta-dynasty-1.description: Gupta Dynasty ko Indian history ka golden period mana jata hai. Gupta Dynasty ke dauran maths, science, history, medicine, astronomy mein bahut bade developments hue the. Pie ke invention se le kar, navratano ke khoj tak. Jane aisa kya kiya tha Gupta Dynasty ke rajaon ne? Kya tha Gupta Dynasty ke itihas mein sabse upar ja kar sabse neeche aane ki kahani? Jane UPSC mein Gupta Dynasty pe puche jane wale sare sawalon ke jawab.

‘ഠാ’-യില്ലാത്ത-മുട്ടായികൾ.title: ‘ഠാ’ യില്ലാത്ത മുട്ടായികൾ
‘ഠാ’-യില്ലാത്ത-മുട്ടായികൾ.description: Nadiyum, avatharikayum, ezhuthukaariyumaaya Aswathy Sreekantha rechicha ‘ഠാ’ യില്ലാത്ത മുട്ടായികൾ enna pusthakam niravadhi cherukadhakalaal korthinakkappettathanu. Aswathy thanne shabdam nalkiyittulla ee audio book gramathinte nanmayum, santhoshavum, vedanayum pankuvaikkunnu.

womens-rights-laws-in-india-1.title: Women's Rights & Laws In India
womens-rights-laws-in-india-1.description: Ikkalathum pala sthreekalkkum thangalude avakashangale pattiyum, thangalkku samrakshanam nalkunna niyamangale pattiyum ariyila. Athukondu thanneyaanu athikramangalkku irayakumbozhum palappozhum sthreekal prathikarikkan bhayakkunnathum. 'Women's Rights & Laws In India' enna ee showilude sthreekalude avakashangalum, avare samrakshikkunna niyamangalum enthoke anenu namuku ariyam.

kaise-nikle-middle-class-life-se-bahar-1.title: Kaise Nikle Middle Class Life Se Bahar
kaise-nikle-middle-class-life-se-bahar-1.description: Life ko upgrade karne ki pehli step hai Soch ko upgrade karna. Middle class trap se nikalna toh har koi chahta hai par Risk lene ki himmat har kisi mein nahi hoti. Mindset change ke lessons aur Risk lene ki ability ko badhaane ke liye suniye yeh audio show.

spoken-english-made-easy-1.title: Spoken English Made Easy
spoken-english-made-easy-1.description: ఇంగ్లీష్ నేర్చుకోవటానికి భయపడుతున్నారా?. అయితే ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ వినండి.

how-to-improve-your-email-writing-skills.title: How to improve your Email writing skills
how-to-improve-your-email-writing-skills.description: Email likhte samay hum logon ko words nahi sujhte aur kayi baar to ek chhota sa email likhna bhi 4 page ke essay likhne se zyada mushkil ho jata hai. Par agar aap ye original show sunenge to aap unlogon mein shamil nahi honge, jo email ki jagah whatsapp pe communicate karna easy samajhte hai. Kuku FM ka ye show aapki email writing se judi sabhi problems ko solve karega. Kyunki is show mein subject se lekar email ke tone tak, sab par baat hogi. To aaiye ise sunkar, apne email writing skills ko sudharkar ek better email writer bane.

story-of-my-experiments-with-truth.title: The Story Of My Experiments With Truth
story-of-my-experiments-with-truth.description: Gandhi ji Tana Childhood nundi 1920 Varaku Tana Life lo Jarigina Konni Important Situations ni Cover Chesthu Rasina “The Story Of My Experiments With Truths” Ane Ee Audiobook lo Gandi ji Spiritual Evoution Karanamaina Vishayalatho Paatu Chivaraku Swaraj Udyamaniki Daari teesina Samayam lo Atani Alochanalanu Ee Audiobook Mee Munduku Testundi. Gandhi Yokka inner conflicts, humility, wisdom and Truth Tananu Ela Marchayo Ee Audiobook lo Vinalsinde.

the-success-code-2.title: The Success Code
the-success-code-2.description: SUcces apnar kache ki? Ek ekjoner kache ek ek rokom success. Jemon dhorun ami jodi class e 100/60 petam ami khushi hotam othocho jara 100/80 peto tara aro beshi chaito. Success emon e ekta jinish joto paben aro beshi chaiben. Sofol howa ta kintu onker motoi, jibone safolyo tao onker motoi kotheen, kintu khub sohojei achieve kora shombhob. Apnara sokole jodi success ba safolyer dike egiye jete chaan tahole ei audio story ti bangla shune nin.

ashoka.title: Chakravarti Samrat Ashoka
ashoka.description: Kya aapko pata hai, Bharat ke itihas ke sabse bade raja Chakravarti Samrat Ashok ke pita unhe raja nahi banana chahte the? Yaha tak ki Ashok par unke khoon karne ka bhi arop hai. Ashok ki dasiyon ne jab unke pass aane se inkar kar diya toh Ashok ne unka gala katwa diya tha. Phir aisa kya hua ki krur, chand Ashok ne yudh tyag diya? Unhone dharm ka marg kyon apnaya? Aise hi UPSC mein puche jane wale sawalo ke jawab sune.

what-wikipedia-cant-tell-you-about-stock.title: What Wikipedia Can't Tell you About Stock Market
what-wikipedia-cant-tell-you-about-stock.description: Stock Market la irukura puriyatha pala visayangal la ellorukkum puriyira mathiri elimaiya eduthu solluthu intha audiobook. Stock market la panam invest panni laabam sambathikkanum nu nenaikkiravangaukku intha audiobook nichayam help pannum !

how-radiation-will-affect-india.title: How Radiation Will Affect India
how-radiation-will-affect-india.description: Fossil Fuels Ni Vaadatam Valana Global Warming Avuundani Nuclear Power Ni Tayaru Cheyadam Start Chesam, Telephone lo Matladatam Comfort ga Ledani Cellphone Ni Vadatam Modalupettam.  Ippudu 4G,5G,6G antu inka antu inak munduku Veltunam. Mana Chuttu Oka Radiation Circle Ni Geesukuntu Vellipotunnam. Ee Radiation Valana Kalige Nasthala Gurinchi Telisina Kuda Manam Ee Technology ni Vaadakunda Undalekapotunnam. Mari Deeniki Inka Vere Edaina Maargam Unda?!. Radiation mana Future Generation Health Meeda Entha Prabhavam Chooputndi? Inka Ilanti Interesting Radiation Fatcs and Myths Gurinchi Ee Audiobook lo Vinandi

thok-denge-2.title: Thok Denge
thok-denge-2.description: Aadhi raat ko jab 8 Police walon par achanak goliyan barsi to agle din poore Uttar Pradesh me Dhirendra Shukla ke naam ka atank fail gaya. Na sirf Police headquarters & Political residences me hadkamp macha balki News channel se le kar sadak par Junta ka Aakrosh bhadak utha. Har koi sirf Dhirendra ko salakhon ke peeche dekhna chahta tha kyunki bahadur police jawanon ki maut ka badla har kisi ko chahiye tha. Par Police ek baar phir fail ho gai thi kyunki Dhirendra Shukla jane kahan farar ho chuka tha. Kaun hai ye kukhyat gangster Dhirendra shukla jiske Apradhon ki list me ab police ki bhi hatya shamil ho chuki hai. Kaun dhoondhega  Dhirendra ko aur kaise lega police department milkar  ,  8 shaheed police walon ki shahadat ka badla ? Janne ke liye Abhi sunein poori kahani !

free-to-focus-9.title: Free to Focus
free-to-focus-9.description: Summa varuma success? Life la namma goals ah achieve panna hard work, dedication, smart work idhellam thaandi oru mukkiyamana vishayam thevai. Adhu dhan FOCUS. Andha focus ah epdi develop panradhu nu therinjuka kelunga ‘Free to Focus’ on Kuku FM

enforcement-directorate-cases.title: Enforcement Directorate Cases
enforcement-directorate-cases.description: Amalaakka thuraiyoda mukkiya poruppum pangaluppum enna nra vivarangala indha audio book la kelunga.

ranga-billa.title: Ranga Billa
ranga-billa.description: Ranga Aur Billa. Jurm ki duniya ke do aise naam, jinki darindagi ne pure dilli ko itna naraz kar diya tha ki, insaaf ki is ladai me naraz dilli walon ne Atal Bihari Vajpayee par bhi patharon ki barsat kar di thi.  Aakhir Ranga Billa the kaun? Aakhir aisa kya kiya tha ranga billa ne jo unhe pakadne mein lag gaye the 140 police wale?

learn-english-in-7-days-1.title: Learn English In 7 Days
learn-english-in-7-days-1.description: ఇంగ్లీష్ నేర్చుకోలేకపోతున్నారా? ఎంత కష్టపడ్డా మీతో సాధ్యం అవ్వట్లేదా? నిరాశ చెందకుండా ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి మరి.!

coronary-hridaya-hindi.title: Coronary Hridaya Rog : Bachav evam Upchar Ki Raah
coronary-hridaya-hindi.description: Aaj ki badalti Lifestyle ki vajah se Health issues bahut badh gaye hain. Aaj se 15-20 saal pehle jaha heart attack jyadatar 60 se upar ki age mein hota tha lekin ab ye age nahi dekhta, kisi bhi Age mein ho raha hai. Aaj ke samay ke kuch challenging questions hain jaise, Apne Dil ko kaise Healthy rakhein? Apni Life Style ko kaise theek karein? Apno ko isme kaise help karein? Aur agar kisi ke sath aisi situation ho to use kaise treat karein? In sare sawalon ke jawab aapko is AudioBook mein milenge. Ye ek bahut jaruri AudioBook hai jise aapko ek baar jarur sunna chahiye.

modhyobitto-manosikota-theke-banchben-ki.title: Modhyobitto Manosikota Theke Banchben Kivabe?
modhyobitto-manosikota-theke-banchben-ki.description: Mas Porlei EMI, Electric Bill, Masik Bajar Ityadi Niyei Benche Aachen Modyobittora. Kothay Aache Modhyobitter Sadh Thake Kintu Sadhyo Noy. Eta Ki Sotyi? Naki Kothar Kotha? Ei Shrenir Manushder Mindset Holo ''Aamra To Modyobitto Ogulo Boro Lokeder Jonyo''. Aar Ei Mindset Jibone Unnotir Pothe Bandha Hoye Daray. Ortath Aapnake Ei Mindset Chere Beriye Aaste Hobe, Taholei Jibone Onek Safolyo Pete Paren. Ebar Proshno Holo Kichu Upay Ki Aache Ei Mindset Theke Beriye Aasar? Aapnar Sei Proshner Somadhan Dite KUKU FM Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audio Show, Ja Mon Diye Purota Shunle Jante Parben Kivabe Ei Modyobitto Mindset Chere Beriye Aasa Jay? Tar Songe Jante Parben Dhoni Hote Gele Ki Ki Lage? Tahole Aar Opekkha Kiser? Cholun Shune Neoya Jak.

kuhak.title: Kuhak
kuhak.description: Ei Golper Prodhan Choritro Sajal Biye Korar Theke Shoto Hosto Dure Thakte Chay. Tar Briddha Ma-ke Niye Tar Songsar. Boyos 50 Chuyeche. Kintu Hotath Ekdin Tar Ontorongo Bondhu Anindya Tar Shali Kabita-ke Biye Korar Jonyo Prostab Dey Sajal-ke. Ja Shune Prothome Kichuta Obak Holeo Pore Kobitar Kotha Vabte Thake Se. Hoyto Mone Mone Ebar Thik Korte Thake Biyeta Tahole Kora Jete Pare. Kintu Hotath Ekdin Ekta Ghotonar Kotha Jante Pare Se, Seta Janar Por Jetuku Icche Tar Jagchilo Setao Aar Roilo Na. Ki Sei Ghotona? Aasun Seta Jante Shune Neoya Jak Suchitra Bhattacharya-Er Lekha Ei Golpo 'Kuhak'.

google-my-business-par-listing-kaise-kar.title: Google My Business Par Listing Kaise kare
google-my-business-par-listing-kaise-kar.description: Google my Business par aap apne Business, Product aur Services ko List karke Free mein apne Clients tak directly pahuncha sakte hai. Iske aapko jyada kuch nahi karna hai bas is AudioBook mein bataye gaye instructions ko follow karna hai aur un mistakes ko karne se bachna hai jo Zyadatar log karte hai. Chaliye Safar ki shuruwat karte hai KUKU FM ke sath.

stock-market-er-abcd.title: Stock Market-Er ABCD
stock-market-er-abcd.description: Stock Market Ei Jinista Niye Oneker Aagroho Dekha Jay. Kichu Lok Aachen Jara Bishoy ta Janen Kintu Kivabe Ekhane Taka Barano Jay Seta Janen Na, Aabar Kichu Lok Emon Aachen Jader Stock Market Bishoye Kono Dharona Nei. Tara Bujhte Chan Ei Bishoyta Niye Aar Jara Bojhen Tara Jante Chan Kivabe Aaro Beshi Taka Kamano Jay. Aar Chinta Nei Stock Market Er Jabotiyo Khuntinati Somporke Janate KUKU FM Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audio Show, Ekhan Theke Ekdom Sohoj Bangla Bhashay Aapni Bistaritovabe Jante Parben Stock Market Niye. Tobe Hyan Bistaritovabe Jante Hole Aapnake Mon Diye Purota Shunte Hobe Ei Audio Show.

bhagwad-geeta-1.title: Bhagavad Gita- Samasyanche Samadhan
bhagwad-geeta-1.description: Ayushya ahe tithe Samasya ahet ani samasya ahet tithe tyavar Samdhan dekhil ahe. Asa mhantat ki, Ayushyatil kontyahi Problem cha solution tumhala "SHRIMAD BHAGWAD GEETA'' madhe nakki milta. Kutumbatil Tanaav aso kinva Office madhe boss chi katkat, Navra- Bayko madhil bhandan aso kinva Stress mule nirman zalela Nairashyacha vatavarn...Samsya kontihi aso, ti kashi sodvaychi yacha uttar Shri Krishnani Geetet sangitla ahe. Ani mhnunch amhi tumcha sathi gheun aloy, 'Bhagwad Geetecha' saar agadi sopya bhashet sangnara he khas audiobook. Sarva Chintanvar ekach Samdhan: Bhagwad Geetetil Dnyan!!

ruktapur-by-pushya-mitra-parvez.title: Ruktapur
ruktapur-by-pushya-mitra-parvez.description: Bihar! India Ka aisa state jahan se sabse zyada IAS niklate hain. Jahan ke log aur kai states mein jakar job karte hain aur un rajyon ki economy ko badhte hain. Lekin Bihar vahin ka vahin hai, jaise Ruka hua ho kai sau saalon se. Yahan ki shiksha, jobs aur hospitals sab pichde hue maloom hote hain. Isi Bihar ki kai kahaniyan aur sach batane ke liye KUKU Fm le aaya hai writer Pushyamitra ki likhi famous kitab "RUKTAPUR" ki Audiobook !

theerkatharisi.title: The Prophet
theerkatharisi.description: Ulagin thalai sirantha padaippaaligalil oruvaraana 'Khalil Gibran' ezhuthiya Ulaga pugazh petra 'The Prophet' puthagathin tamil audiobook ithu . Ulagengum 100+ mozhigalil veliyida pattulla intha puthagam Padaippulagin Ucham ena palaraal Kondaada padugirathu !

abdulkalam-kavithaigal.title: Abdulkalam Kavithaigal
abdulkalam-kavithaigal.description: Naattoda munnetrathukaagavum, Makkal nalanukkaagavum avaroda vazhkaiyave arpanaicha arputha manithar namma Abdul Kalam ayya avargaludaiya kavithaigalin thoguppu idhu. Intha kavithaigal sornthu kedakkura namma manasukku oru puthu themba kodukkum, Namma sindhanaigala seer seiyum, Nammala vetri paathaila seluthum. Vaanga kavithaigala Ketkalaam.

hitler-ka-yatna-griha-final-salim-8th-de.title: Hitler Ka Yatna Griha
hitler-ka-yatna-griha-final-salim-8th-de.description: Hitler ke atyachar se aakhir kon waakhif nahi hai, Ek aisa dictator jisne apni taakat ka galat istemal kar aise aise zulam dhaaye ki aaj bhi log uske naam se khoof khaate hain, Lekin isse bhi khoofnak agar kuch tha to wo tha Hitlar ke dwara banwaya gaya wo jagah jise kaha jata tha Hitler Concentration Camp, Par kya thi is jagah ki kahani aur kyu ise kaha jata tha itna khaufnaak. Janne ke liye suniye ye Audio book jiska naam hai “Hitler Ka Yatna Griha”.

ahilyabai-holkar-2.title: Ahilyabai Holkar
ahilyabai-holkar-2.description: Bhartat Asha Kami Ranya Hotya Jyani Raja Kela.Tyatil Ek Nav Prakarshyane Yeta Mhanje Rajmata Rani Ahilyabai Holkar Yancha. Ahilyabaine Nehmi Savta Adhi Jantecha Vichar kela Vel Prasangi Aplya Khasgi Kijoritunhi Paise Kadhun Dile Chala Aikuyat Ahilyabai Holkar Yanchi Jeevan Gatha.

therindhukolvom-thelivuperuvom.title: Therindhukolvom Thelivuperuvom
therindhukolvom-thelivuperuvom.description: Therindhukolvom Thelivuperuvom la pala interesting aana world facts pathi kettu therinjikonga.

goal-setting-1.title: How To Set Goals And Achieve Them
goal-setting-1.description: Aakhir jeevan mein ek maksad hona kyon zaroori hai ? Aap hi sochiye, subah uth ke aapke paas kuch karne ke liye na ho to aapko kya subah uthne ka motivation milega ? Goals hume jeene ka purpose dete hai aur safalta ke aur aage badhne ka direction. To agar aap kuch extraordinary chahte hai ? Apne sapne ko hakikat mein badalna chahte hai to yeh show aapke liye hai jo aapko goal set karne, uss ke liye strategy banane ke kuch golden rules aapko batayegi

uranga-nagarm.title: Uranga Nagaram
uranga-nagarm.description: Chennai eppovume vanthaarai vaazha vaikkum ooraa irunthirukku. Namma chennai ku innoru perum irukku, athu thaan "Uranga Nagaram". Intha book la neenga chennai ah pathi pala swarasyamana thagavalgalai therinjuka poreenga.

partition-3.title: Vibhajan 1947
partition-3.description: Bure sapne, garibi aur lachari ki hakikat se joojhte UPSC student Aryan ko mili Kalpana jisne bheja usey ek special mission par jo tha Bharat ka batwara hone se rokna. Time travel karta Aryan ja takraya kroor british officers, time terrorists aur bhavishya ke Badshah se. Akhir kyun Aryan ko chuna gaya is mission pe? Kya chahta hai Badshah usse? Kya Aryan ban ke rah jayega ek mohra ya kamyab hoga wo rokne me ye Partition? Janne ke liye sune Partition sirf kuku fm par.

chathrapathi-shivaji.title: Chathrapathi Shivaji
chathrapathi-shivaji.description: Chathrapathi Shivaji oda veera vaazhkai varalara pathi indha audio book la kelunga.

yesunathar-varalaru.title: Yesunathar Varalaru
yesunathar-varalaru.description: Jesus oda muzhu varalaaraiyum therinjukka intha book ungalukku uthavum. Vaalkaiyoda miga sariyaana paadangalai nammalaala Yesunaathar oda vaalkaiyila irunthu kathukka mudiyum. Vaanga Yesunathar Varalaaru Ketkalaam.

fortysix.title: Forty Six- India's Rescue Operation Against ISIS
fortysix.description: Salman Khan ki film 'Tiger Zinda Hai' ek sacchi kahani par based hai jaha, Iraq ke Tirkit mein 46 Indian nurses ISIS ke kabze mein aa gayi thi. Is kahani mein janiye kya sach mein Middle East ke naami, Indian origin businessman ne kiya tha nurses ke rescue operation mein help? Kya sach mein Indian governement kar rahi thi ISIS ke terrorists se baat? Kya itni koshishon ke baad nurses aa payi thi India vapas? Aur kya Sushma Swaraj bani thi is kahani ki tiger?

eppavum-nee-raja.title: எப்பவும் நீ ராஜா
eppavum-nee-raja.description: மாப்ள அழகா இருக்கணும்! அறிவாளியா இருக்கணும்! பணக்காரனா இருக்கணும், கொடை வள்ளலா இருக்கணும், ஒரு முறையாவது ஜெயிலுக்கு போனவனா இருக்கணும்’ போன்ற விசித்திரமான சில கண்டிஷன்களுடன் தன் வருங்கால கணவனைத் தேர்வு செய்ய விரும்புகிறாள் பாப்பா. பாப்பாவின் எதிர்பார்ப்புகளை நிறைவேற்றும் மாப்பிள்ளையாகக் கதைக்குள் நுழைகிறான் தம்பி எனும் தம்பிராஜன். காதலிக்கும் பெண்ணின் கண்டிஷன்களை நிறைவேற்றி அவளைத் திருமணம் செய்யப் படாத பாடுபடும் தம்பி ராஜனின் நகைச்சுவை கதையை உங்கள் குக்கூ எப்.எம்.ல் கேளுங்கள்... சிரித்து மகிழுங்கள்...!

thervil-nichayam-vetri-pera.title: Thervil Nichayam Vetri Pera
thervil-nichayam-vetri-pera.description: Nammaloda kalvi thirana test panrathukkana oru vazhimurai thaan Exams. idhu pallikoodam, Kalloori, velai vaaippu nu namma life la neraya edathula thodarnthu vanthute irukku ! Bayam , pathattam illamal Exams sa face panni adhula vetri adaivathu eppadi nu intha audiobook la sollirukanga. Vaanga therinjukalam, Exams la Vetri Peralaam.

hackers-and-painters.title: Creative Process Of Hackers
hackers-and-painters.description: Aajkal bhale hi IT sector ko choose karna ek Secure Career ki nishani maani jati hai. Lekin aisa sabke saath ho yeh zaroori nahi hai. Toh Kab aur Kaise hum IT sector mein jaa sakte hain? Hacker asal mein kaun hote hain? Hacker ya Programmer Banne ke kya fayde hain? kya sach mein IT field choose karna thoda mushkil hai? In sabhi sawalon ke jawab aapko milenge is Original Show mein jise sunne ke baad aap hacking aur IT field se jude kayi facts aur myths ko jaan jayenge.

how-to-understand-women-1.title: How To Understand Women?
how-to-understand-women-1.description: Sthreekale manassilakkan prayasam anennanu pothuve parayappedunnathu. Ennal avar kadannu pokunna sahacharyangale manassilakkiyal avare ariyuka atra budhimuttulla karyamalla. 'How To Understand Women?' enna showyilude ningalude jeevithathile sthreekale aduthariyam.

the-road-to-recovery-breaking-bad-habits.title: The Road To Recovery: Breaking Bad Habits
the-road-to-recovery-breaking-bad-habits.description: Ethra ozhivakkan sramichalum vittupokatha dusheelangal ellavarkkum kaanum. Ningalude lakshyam nedunnathil ninnum mikacha jeevithathil ninnum ningale akattunnath orupakshe aa dusheelam aayirikkam. Swayam nashikkunna oru sheelathil ninnu enthu vila koduthum mukthi nedunnathano aa dusheelathinte loopil pettu jeevitham thanne kaivittu pokunnathano nallath. Dusheelangal maattanum nalla sheelangalilude jeevithathinu dishabodham nalkanum ulla chila nurungu vazhikal ee showyilude kelkkam.

battle-of-barki.title: Battle of Barki
battle-of-barki.description: 1965 main Bharat Pakistan ke yuddh ke beech hone wali sabse important ladai hui Barki ki. Is yuddh main ek se ek yoddha nikal kar aaye , unhe mei se ek they Brig. Kawaljeet Singh jinhione is yuddh main hissa lia aur use anjaam tak pahuchaya . Kis terha lada gaya barki ka yeh nirnayak yuddh. Kin mushkilon ka saamana kiya Bharta ki jaanbaaz fauj ne yeh sari he kahani sunenge is audioseries mein.

bible-understanding-the-10-commandments-.title: Bible: Understanding The 10 Commandments
bible-understanding-the-10-commandments-.description: Kraisthava vishwasikalude vishwasa pramanangalude aanikkallanu pathu kalppanakal athava Ten Commandments. Vishwasikalude jeevitham ee pramanangale anusarichum anugamichumulla yathrayanu. Seenay parvathathil vechu daivam Isarel janavumayi cheytha udambadiyude vyavasthayayi Moshayk nalkiya kalpanakalaanu pathu kalpanakal ennu ariyappedunnath. Kraisthavark purame Yahudarkkum pradhanappettathaanith. Manushya raashiye thinmayil ninnum nanmayilekum thakarchayil ninnum uyarchayilekkum nayikkunnathinulla daiva vachanam thanne aanu Pathu Kalpanakal.

kaatil-baaz-mix-episodes.title: Katil Baaz
kaatil-baaz-mix-episodes.description: 'The Law of Action And Reaction' Ke Karma Ki Dil Dehla Dene Wali Daastaan. Ye Kahaani Hanumaan Ji Ke Brahamchaari Bhakt Ke Ird Gird Ghumti Hai, Jiski Rahasyamayi Tarike Se Maut Ho Jaati Hai, Chasmdeed Gawah Ke Mutaabik Ek Baaz Jo Kaafi Dino Se Un Par Ghaat Lagaye Baitha Tha, Wo Hi Kaatil Hai. Yeh Sach Hai Yaa Yaa Mangadhant Kahani? Jab Is Kahaani Ki Haqeeqat Saamne Aati Hai To Sabke Hosh Ud Jaate Hain. Aakhir Kaise Ek Baaz Katil Ho Sakta Hai? Kyon Wo Us Bhakt Par Apni Nazar Tikaaye Baitha Tha? Kahin Uska Koi Peechle Janm Ka Naata To Nahi...? Suniye Kai Sawalo'n aur Rahasyo'n Se Ghiri Ye Kahani.

വിഷ്‌ണു-പുരാണം.title: വിഷ്‌ണു പുരാണം
വിഷ്‌ണു-പുരാണം.description: 18 മഹാപുരാണങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നായ വിഷ്‌ണു പുരാണം, വിഷ്ണുവിൻറെ കഥകളും, അവതാര ഉദ്ദേശങ്ങളും മറ്റും വിശദമായി സംസാരിക്കുന്നു. നിങ്ങൾക്ക് കേട്ട് പരിചയം ഉള്ളതും ഇല്ലാത്തതുമായ ഒട്ടനവധി കഥകളും സന്ദർഭങ്ങളും 'വിഷ്‌ണു പുരാണം' എന്ന ഈ ഷോയിലൂടെ കേൾക്കൂ.

decoding-premam.title: Decoding Premam
decoding-premam.description: Malayalam cinema kandathil vech ettavum sensational aaya cinemakalil onnu thanneyanu Nivin Pauly nayakanayi Alphonse Puthren samvidhanam cheytha 'Premam'. 2015 May 29 nu theatril ethiya cinema box officil van vijayamayirunnu. Engane Premam ithreyum hit Aayi?

indias-military-heroes.title: Untold Stories from the Indian Army
indias-military-heroes.description: Indian Army, Ye un bahadur veeron ki fauj hai jinki wajah se bharat ka har ek vyakti har waqt apne aap ko surakshit mehsoos karta hai. Ye unki veerta aur sahas ka hi nateeja hai ki Indian Army ko world ki top 5 strongest armies mein se ek mana jaata hai.. Toh aaiye aaj KUKU FM ke is original show mein milte hain un real super heroes se jinke kaarname unke desh prem, strong will power, extra ordinary courage aur bharat ki dharti par mar mitne ke jazbe ka saboot hai.

jogonnath-mandirer-rohoshyo-1.title: Jogonnath Mandirer Rohoshyo
jogonnath-mandirer-rohoshyo-1.description: Amader bangali der modhye khub kom manush ache jara Puri te ghurte jaye ni, ba Jogonnath dorshone jayi ni. Amader nostalgia bolte jemon Howrah, tram e kore Kolkata ghora, Princep ghat, bhaar e chaa khawa, thik temoni Puri r somudro ar Jogonnath dorshon o. Jogonnath mandir e amra kom beshi sokolei gechi, kintu shei mandirer rohoshyer golpo ki sunechi? Ki emon rohoshyo ache ei mandire ja ja baar baar amader phiriye niye jaye shei mandirer dorshone. Jogonnath Deber ei mandir kintu kono dhatu diye toiri noi borong kather toiri. Ei mandire praye protyek bocchor 20 lakh manusher anagona hoi, kintu kokhoni bhog ba prasader obhab hoi na, kintu sheta keno? Ei mandirer nirmaner pechone je prithok itihas ache shei niye aj jana jaak. Prachinotyer pasha pashi dhormiyo mahatyer dik diye ei mandir Bharater ekti otyontyo gurtyopurno sthan grohon kore ache. Ei mandirer anek rohoshyo ache, shei rohoshyer golpo jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

thattya.title: Thattya
thattya.description: Suchitra Bhattacharya r golpo aj ke Monica, Seema ar Surojit ke niye. Monica ar Seema schooler bondhu chilo, ebong tader besh anek bochhor pore rastaye dekha hoy. Schooler Seema ke rastaye dekhe Monica ar somoy noshto na kore kotha bolte shuru kore dei Monica. Oder eto bochhor dekha howar por tader golpo ebong ashol golpo thik kon dishaye egoye? Moncia ba Seema r bondhutyo thik kemon chilo school kale, bondhutyo na nichhok alapcharita? Kei ba ei Surojit? Ei dui mohilar jibone ashlen ki bhabe ei Surojit? EI shob jante shune nin aj ker golpo ti.

detective-vikram-khooni-panne.title: Detective Vikram: Khooni Panne
detective-vikram-khooni-panne.description: Ek shatir serial killer jo kitabo ka sahara lekar logon ko utaar raaha maut ke ghat aur dusri taraf Vikram ka dost Tushar bhi ho chuka lapata. Kya Tushar bhi ban baitha us serial killer ka shikaar ya iske piche chhupa hai koi bada raaz? Detective Vikram kaise suljhayega ye anokha case? Janne ke liye sune Detective Vikram: Khooni Panne sirf kukufm par… sune jo man chahe.

inspector-bapi-sen-murder-case.title: Inspector Bapi Sen: Murder Case
inspector-bapi-sen-murder-case.description: Ki hoyechilo 2002 er New year eve e Kolkata  sohor e? Sobai jokhon 31st December manate byasto, Park Street er moto jomjomat jayega e jokhon sobai udjapon korte byasto, thik tokhon ki emon hoy ekti couple er songe? Ekti khub swabhabik couple 31st December e celebration shesh kore bari pherar pothe 5ti juboker haate hyanostha hote hoi keno? Shei 5ti jubok emon oshobhyota korte jokhon byasto thik shei somoy shei rasta diye travel korchilen Kolkata r traffic police Inspector Bapi Sen. Ghotonasthole pouche shei hyanostha ba oshobhyota thamate giye tar ki emon porinoti holo je aj 21bochhor poreo sara Kolkata sohore ekhono eti ekti alochyo bishoy? Bapi Sen Murder Case er byapare bistarito  bhabe jante ebong shei diner ghotonar bishoy aro obogoto hote shune nin ei audio story ti.

tritiyo-biswa.title: Tritiyo Biswa
tritiyo-biswa.description: Ei Golper Prodhan Dui Choritro Gourango Babu O Namita Debi. Tader Choto Songsar. Chele Biltu Thake Bideshe. Cheleke Niye Khub Gorbo Tader. Parar Lokerao Biltur Gunogan Koren Sob Somoy. Biltu Bidesh Thekei Sob Kichu Pathay Barite. Majhe Majhe Barite Aasey Chuti Niye. Kintu Namita Debi Ekdin Hotath Jante Paren Ekta Kotha, Ja Janar Por Tini Venge Poren. Songe Tar Swami Gourango Babuo Nirobe Kandte Thaken. Kintu Ki Emon Kotha Jante Parlen Namita Debi? Cholun Sei Kotha Jante Shune Neoya Jak Suchitra Bhattacharya- Er Lekha Ei Golpoti.

iit-zombay-2.title: IIT Zombay
iit-zombay-2.description: IIT Bombay ke campus me macha maut ka toofan. Insaan banne lage adamkhor Zombies. Zinda lashe badhne lagi Pawai lake ki taraf jahan se milta hai pure shahar ko peene ka pani. Jahan students bachane me lage hain apni jaan wahin puri Mumbai banne wali hai Kabristaan. Kaun rokega in zinda murdo ko? Janne ke liye sune IIT Zombay sirf kukufm par

the-trial-of-the-maharaja.title: The Trial of the Maharaja
the-trial-of-the-maharaja.description: Poradhin Bharote Britishder Otyachare Jokhon Najehal Bharotbasi, Tokhon Britishder Chokhe Chokh Rekhe Lorai Korechilen Maharaja Nandakumar. Britishder Durnitir Biruddhe Gorje Othen Tini. Protibad Korte Thaken Vul Kajer. Jar Fole British Shasoker Chokkhushul Hoye Othen Tini. Britishra Nana Koushol Koreo Take Domiye Rakhte Paren Ni. Shesmesh British Shasok Dol Lorai Korte Na Pere Maharaja Nandakumar-Er Fansir Aadesh Dey. Kintu Fansir Aadesh Keno Deyoya Holo? Shudhui Ki Tar Songe Lorai Korte Na Para Naki Onyo Kono Karon? Onake Domon Korte Ki Ki Korechilo British Shasok Dol? Kivabe Nijer Lorai Jari Rekhechilen Nandakumar? Aasun Ei Audiobbok Theke Aaj Janbo Ek Maharajar Har Na Mana Lorai-Er Kotha, Ja Itihaser Patay Aajibon Swornakkhore Lekha Thakbe.

mithun-chakraborty-the-disco-king.title: Mithun Chakraborty: The Disco King
mithun-chakraborty-the-disco-king.description: 70 o 80 er doshoker obhineta der kotha bolte gele Mithun Chakraborty r name asbei asbe. Mithun bangali holeo bollywood eo uni ja name kore niyechilen, onake bhalobeshe sokole Bollywood er dada hishebei chenen. Emoni ek obhineta jini prothom chhobitei jite niyechilen jatiyo puroshkar. 300 r o beshi chhobi te obhinoy kore niyechen ei  70 o 80 er doshoker bollywood er samrat. Ki kore hoye uthlen erokom ekhon superstar Mithun? Uttor Kolkatar Gourango theke bollywood er dancing star holen ki bhabe? Spot boy theke ki kore hoye uthlen bollywood er dada?  Mithun dada r cholochitro jibon theke rajnoitik jibon ba paribarik jibon shob kichu niyei jante hole shune nin ei audio story ti.

smriti-mandhana.title: Smriti Mandhana: From Sangli to Stardom
smriti-mandhana.description: Kya aapko pata hai ki kaise India ki top performing women’s cricketer Smriti Mandhana ne  Sangli naam ke chhote sheher se nikal kar  bade-bade khiladiyon ke saath muqabla kiya aur international cricket mein ek khaas pehchaan banayi? Agar nahi toh abhi suniye KUKU FM ka ye original show. Smriti ki ye kahani aaapko batayegi ki zindagi ke us mauke par jab aapko lagta hai ki aap haar chuke hain toh kaise usko aasani se jeet mein badla ja sakta hai.

sunil-chhetri-the-god-of-indian-football.title: Sunil Chhetri : The God Of Indian Football
sunil-chhetri-the-god-of-indian-football.description: Ekta Somoy Chilo Jokhon Bharotiyo Football Onekta Pichiye Chilo. Kintu Sekhan Theke Bortoman Somoy Team- Er Je Poriborton Tar Pichone Ekta Manusher Obodan Vola Jabe Na, Tini Holen Sunil Chhetri. Take Oneke Bolen Captain Fantastic. Tini Bharotiyo Football Ke Niye Gechen Ek Uccho Matray. Ekta Somoy Desher Jersey Pore Sorboccho Goal Er Nirikhe Ronaldo O Messi- Er Porei Chilen Tini. Jubo Kheloyarder Kache Ek Anuprerona Tini. Tar Khela Dekhar Jonyo Mukhiye Thake Gota Desh. Kintu Ekdine Tini Captain Fantastic Hoye Othen Ni. Take Dirgho Lorai Kore Ei Jaygay Aaste Hoyeche. Khelar Jogote Probesh Theke Sonam Er Songe Biye, Tar Jiboner Nana Jana O Ojana Golpo Shune Nebo Ei Audio Show Theke. Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Neoya Jak.

bad-with-money-finances-ko-manage-karne-.title: Finances ko Control karne ke Tarike
bad-with-money-finances-ko-manage-karne-.description: Paisa kamana sabhi jante hai, lekin us paise ko kaise sambhala jaaye ya use kaise bachaya jaaye ye ek skill hai. Kehte hai jis kisi ne bhi is skill mein maharath haasil kar li, usne apne finances ko puri tarah control karna sikh liya. Lekin agar aap is qala se anjaan hai aur apne finances ko lekar aksar 50-50 ki situation mein phans jaate hai, to humari ye audiobook aapke liye hi hai. Ise sunne ke baad aap bhi na sirf paisa kamana, balki use bachana bhi sikh jayenge. Aaiye aapko is qala mein nikhaarein!

mental-illness-signs-symptoms-and-treatm.title: Mental illness Kasa Olkhava ? Lakshane Ani Upchar
mental-illness-signs-symptoms-and-treatm.description: Satat Chid chid Karne, Kamat Laksha na lagne, radavasa, ordavas vatne hi ani ashi barech Mental illness chi lakshane asu shaktat. Atta ti kashi olkhaychi yach sathi kukufm tumchyasathi gheun ala ahe khas show 'Mental illness Kasa Olkhava ? Lakshane Ani Upchar'.

படை-வீடு-.title: படை வீடு
படை-வீடு-.description: தமிழகத்தை அறத்துடன் ஆண்டு வந்த சேர, சோழ, பாண்டிய பேரரசுகள் மூன்றும் 14 - ம் நூற்றாண்டில் ஒன்றுமில்லாமல் போகின்றன. அந்த நேரத்தில், கில்ஜியின் ஏவல் படையுடன் தமிழ்நாட்டிற்குள் நுழைகிறான் கொள்ளைக்காரன் மாலிக் காபூர். தமிழ்நாடு சுல்தானின் படையிடம் சிக்கிக் கொள்கிறது‌. மதுரையில் சுல்தான்களின் ஆட்சி அமைகிறது. இப்போது வளமான தமிழகத்தினை தங்கள் பங்கிற்கு கூறுபோட தெலுங்கு அரசர்களின் விஜயநகரப் பேரரசும் தமிழகத்தினுள் நுழைவதற்கு திட்டமிடுகிறது. அவர்களை எதிர்க்கத் தயாராகிறார்கள் கடைசித் தமிழ் அரச குலமான சம்புவரையர்கள். சம்புவரையர்களின் முயற்சி வெற்றிபெற்றதா? மீண்டும் தமிழ்நாட்டில் தமிழர் கொடி பறந்ததா? விறுவிறுப்பான இந்த சரித்திர காவியத்தை உங்கள் குக்கூ எப்.எம்.ல் கேளுங்கள்...

shootout-the-bihar-chapter.title: Shootout - The Bihar Chapter
shootout-the-bihar-chapter.description:
Bihar jail me orchestra se shuru hui ye kahaani raajneeti ke shikhar tak pahunch gyi. Bihar me is samay kuch aise kaand hue jo pehle kabhi nhi hue the. Apraadh aur Varchasv ki duniya me naya prayog karne wala tha Guddu Tiwari. Zafarpur ke ek middle class parivaar me paida hue Guddu ne kaise khoon aur badle ki aag se likhi apni alag daastaan?
Kaise teen bhaiyon ne bihar ke apraadh jagat me lahraya apna parcham? Ek aisa train kaand jiska kisi apraadhik itihaas me zikr nhi. Kuch aise kisse jinhein koi apni zubaan par bhi nhi laana chahta. Sunein Bihar ke zameen ki dil dehlaa dene wali kahani.

how-to-stay-balanced-in-life-when-nothin.title: How To Stay Balanced In Life When Nothing Goes Right
how-to-stay-balanced-in-life-when-nothin.description: Life ah balance panradhu oru simple vishyam, idha dhaan indha audio book la solli iruku. Kettu Life ah easy ah address pannuvom.

grama-devathalu.title: Grama Devathalu
grama-devathalu.description: Durga matha Hinduvulandariki athyantha preethipathramaina devatha. Amma vaarini bhakthulandaru entho bhakthi shraddhalatho pujistharu. Aadi parashakthiga nammutharu. Adi parashakthi haindava puranala prakaram sarva shakthimanthuralaina devatha. Parabrahma swarupam. Amma vaari aashirvadalu pondadaniki vinandi.

prithvi-raj-chauhan.title: Samrat Prithvi Raj Chauhan
prithvi-raj-chauhan.description:
Bharat ke itihasa mein Samrat Prithviraj Chauhan ke raj ka samay kuch esa likha hai, ki aaj bhi unse judi baatein har Hindustani ka seena garv se choda kar deti hai. 
Is show mein apko shoorveer yoddha Samrat Prithviraj chauhan ki zindagi se judi kayi esi baatein pata chalengi, jo apko apne Bharat ke itehaas par garv karne ke aur bhi jyada prerit karengi.

உன்னில்-தொலைந்து-தேடவா.title: உன்னில் தொலைந்து தேடவா
உன்னில்-தொலைந்து-தேடவா.description: சில வருடங்களுக்கு முன்பு காணாமல் போன தன் மனைவியைத் தீவிரமாகத் தேடிக்கொண்டிருக்கிறான், ஆர்யன். ஒரு நாள், அவனது பள்ளிக்கு தலைமை விருந்தினராக வந்த மாவட்ட ஆட்சியர் மான்யாவைப் பார்த்து வாயடைத்துப் போய்விட்டான். ஏனெனில், அவள் தான் அவன் தேடும் மான்யா. போதப்பொருள் கடத்தல் கும்பலின் கொட்டத்தை அடக்க அந்நகருக்கு மாற்றலாகி வந்திருந்தாள் அவள். இருவேறு துருவமாக மாறிப் போன அவர்களின் வாழ்க்கையின் அடுத்த நிலை என்ன? போதைப் பொருள் கும்பல் ஏற்படுத்தும் பிரச்னைகளை எப்படி முறியடிக்கப் போகிறார்கள்?

என்-இனிய-மோகத்தீயே-Season--1-1.title: என் இனிய மோகத்தீயே
என்-இனிய-மோகத்தீயே-Season--1-1.description: காதலித்து மணந்த மனைவியால் ஏமாற்றப்பட்டு தனிமையில் தவிக்கும் மனோரஞ்சகன், தன் பண பலத்தால் கிருத்திகாவை சிறை பிடிக்கிறான். ஒழுக்கமும் பண்பாடும் நிறைந்த கிருத்திகா அவனது இச்சைக்கு இணங்க மறுக்கிறாள். இரு வேறு துருவங்களான மனோரஞ்சகனும் கிருத்திகாவும் கரை சேர்ந்தார்களா? காதலும் ஊடலும் கூடலும் நிறைந்த பேரின்ப பயணத்தில் மூழ்குங்கள்...

gun-tantra-3.title: Gun-Tantra
gun-tantra-3.description: Dhananjay army se retirement lekar apne kheton ko naxaliyon se bachane ghar to aa gaya par jaldi hi apne poore pariwar se haath dho baitha. Ab Dhananjay ke jeevan ka ek hi maksad hai badla aur iske liye usne banayi Dhananjay Sena. Kya Dhananjay Sena naxaliyon ka khatama kar payegi? Kya Police is muthbhed ko bas dekhti rahegi ya kuch karegi bhi? Kya in sab ke peeche koi rajnaitik sajish bhi hai? In sab sawalon ke jawabon ke liye sunte rahein Bihar ki jatigat rajniti par adharit gatha “Gun-Tantra”

intraday-trading-dware-paise-kamva.title: Intraday Trading- Paise kamva dararoj
intraday-trading-dware-paise-kamva.description: Intraday trading ha share market madhil ek asa prakar ahe, jya dware tumhi agdi roj paise kamavu shakta. Pan he itka soppa nahiye bara ka. Tya sathi tumhala Intraday trading mhanje nakki kay, te kasa kartat, tyache konkonte prakar ahet, tyatun kharach kiti fayda hoto ani tyatil risk factors konte ahet? ya saglyavishyi kiman basic knowledge asna khup avshyak ahe; je apan milvnar ahot ya khas show dware...

the-rise-of-gorakshpeeth-gorakhpur.title: The Rise Of Gorakshpeeth Gorakhpur
the-rise-of-gorakshpeeth-gorakhpur.description: Uttar Pradesh aur yahan ka shahar Gorakhpur jo famous hai “Gorakhnath Peeth” ke liye aur famous hai yahan hone wali politics ke liye bhi. Kaise is math ke santon ne raajneeti mein kadam rakha? Kaise desh ki azadi ke liye ladayi ladi aur kaise isi math ke head Yogi Adityanath bane UP ke mukhyamnatri? Aapko Gorakshpeeth Gorakhpur ka pura itihas batane ja rahe hain is khas show The Rise Of Gorakshpeeth Gorakhpur mein.

mans-search-for-meaning-10.title: Man's Search For Meaning
mans-search-for-meaning-10.description: Randaam loka mahayudha kalathe nazi thadavarayile thante anubhavangal vivarikkunna Victor E Franklinte pusthakamaanu Man's Search For Meaning. Aadhyanthikamayi athijeevanathinte pusthakamanith. Sahikkendi vanna peedanangalekkalum nashtangalekkalum upariyayi ava tharanam cheyyan thanikk labhicha karuthinte srothassine kurichanu ee pusthakathil parayunnathu. Manushyarude samanathakal illatha athijeevanathekkurich kelkkam

what-wikipedia-cant-tell-you-about-stock.title: What Wikipedia Can't Tell you About Stock Market
what-wikipedia-cant-tell-you-about-stock.description: Oro divasavum aayirakanakinu vyaaparikal thangalude bhagyam pareekshikukayum avarude kazhivula pareekshikukayum cheyyunna vipaniyanu stock market. Chila avishwasaneeyamaya vijayam nedukayum muzhuvan samaya traderukal aavukayum cheyyumbol chilarkku nashtam neridukayum aathmavishwasam nashtapedukayum trading upekshikukayum cheyyunnu. Stock marketine kurich orupaad arivu undengilum innu vare tradingiloode laabham nedi edukkan sadhikkatha vyakthi aano ningal? Enkil, pramukha vyapariyum ezhuthukaranumaya Indrazith Shantharajinte  'What Wikipedia Can't Tell you About Stock Market' enna ee audiobook ningale sahayikkum.

7-money-rules-for-life-3.title: 7 Money Rules For Life
7-money-rules-for-life-3.description: Ek survey ke according 50% se zyada log aise hain jinke pas future ke liye koi savings nahi hai aur takreeban 30% log aise hain jinke pas 5 lakh se bhi kam ki savings hain. Aur aaye din layoff ki khabarein sunna toh ab aam baat ho gayi hai. Aise mein ye audiobook humein wo 7 money rules batati hai jinko apni life mein laagu karne ke baad hum har din apne paise par control rakhkar difficult financial situations ke liye poori tarah se taiyaar reh sakte hain.

prem-nazir-the-evergreen-hero.title: Prem Nazir- The Evergreen Hero
prem-nazir-the-evergreen-hero.description: Prem Nazir enna evergreen hero namme vittu poyittu pathichandukal kazhinju enkilum ennum adheham nammude manassil mayathe nilkkunnu. Adhehathe kurichu kooduthal ariyam, 'Prem Nazir- The Evergreen Hero' enna showilude

the-story-of-my-experiments-with-truth-5.title: The Story Of My Experiments With Truth
the-story-of-my-experiments-with-truth-5.description: మహాత్మా గాంధీ గారు మన దేశ స్వాతంత్రం కోసం పోరాటం చేసిన వ్యక్తి. ఆయన వ్యక్తిత్వం, జీవితంలో ఆయన ఎదుర్కొన్న సవాళ్ళు ఈ తరానికి పాఠాలు. గాంధీ గారి గురించిన లోతైన విషయాల కోసం ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే.

improve-your-memory-power.title: Improve your Memory Power
improve-your-memory-power.description: Kya aap kabhi kisi aise insaan se mile hain jiski yaadasht ne apko hairaan kar diya ho? Kya apko pta hai aap bhi vo insaan ho sakte hain? Kaise? Is Audiobook mein aapko milenge memory boost karne ke kai tareeke vo bhi examples ke saath. Suniye Improve Your Memory Power Hindi mein sirf Kuku FM par.

mystery-of-subhash-chandra-bose-death.title: Mystery Of Subhash Chandra Bose Death
mystery-of-subhash-chandra-bose-death.description: Indian Freedom Fight lo Ayana oka Revolutionary Leader. Ahimsa Margamtho Vibhedinchi Sayudha Poratamtho Nrisharlanu Vanikinchina Maro Shivaji.. Two times Indian Congress President position ki kuda resign chesi oka vaipu Desham motham Shanthiyutha Udyamamtho Ahimsa Margam lo Payanistunna.. Ee Taraha Udyamalatho Panulu Jaragavani Gandhi ki Telchi Teppesina Dheerudu. Tana Margam lo Veladi Mandini Payanimpajesi Ajad Hind fouzi Samstha ku Java Jeevalanu teesukuvachina Mahanetha Subhash Chandrabose Puttuka gurinchi tappa Maranam Ippatiki Oka Mistery Ne. Britishers Nundi India ki Militant Style lo freedom tevalane uddeshamtho Indians Ni Solders ga Teerchi Diddina Netha Subhash Chandrabose Death Mistery ni Ee Audiobook lo Clear ga Unveil Cheyadam jarigidi.

nofap-the-ultimate-guide.title: Nofap : The Ultimate Guide
nofap-the-ultimate-guide.description: Nofap Eppadi panrathu ? athula ulla challenges enna ? successful la intha Nofap follow panninaa enna benefits ? ithu maathiri Nofap pathina pala kelvigalukku thelivana muraiyil step by step paa vilakkam solluthu intha audiobook. Idhu Nofap patriya mulumaiyana ultimate guide.

aao-jyotish-seekhein.title: Aao Jyotish Seekhein
aao-jyotish-seekhein.description: Humari abaadi ka 25% hissa Astrology mein bharosa karta hai. Yahi nahi kuch log to jyotish vidya par is tarah yakeen karte hain ki woh use seekhna tak chahte hain. Par sahi guide na mil paane ki wajah se wo ise seekh nahi paate. Lekin agar aap bhi jyotish vidya ko maante hain aur ise seekhne mein thode bhi interested hai to hamari ye audiobook aapke liye hi hai. Ismein aap kundli banane se lekar use padhna tak sab kuch seekh sakte hain. Aaiye ise sunna shuru karein.

how-to-minimize-taxes-and-maximize-savin.title: How To Minimize Taxes and Maximize Savings
how-to-minimize-taxes-and-maximize-savin.description: ఎంత సంపాదిస్తే ఏంటి గవర్నమెంట్ కి టాక్స్ కట్టడం తప్పట్లేదని ఎప్పుడన్నా అనుకున్నారా ?  మీరు కట్టే టాక్స్ లో కొన్ని చిన్న చిన్న వాటిని జమచేస్తే మీరు కట్టే టాక్స్ తక్కువ అయిపోతుంది అనే విషయం మీకు తెలుసా? ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో టాక్స్ కి సంబదించిన అన్ని విషయాల గురించి మీరు తెలుసుకోండి. వెంటనే వినండి.

dhusturi-maya.title: Dhusturi Maya
dhusturi-maya.description: Aamra Jokhon Buro Hoye Jai Tokhon Aamder Oneker Modhye Ei Vabna Aasey Je Jodi Aabar Joubon Fire Paoya Jeto Kotoi Na Valo Hoto. Ei Golper Dui Prodhan Choritro Udhvab Paul & Jogobondhu Ganguly Ontorongo Bondhu. Tader Mone Ei Joubone Fire Jaoyar Icche Jage. Aar Ei Iccher Boshoborti Hoye Tara Fondi Aaten Joubone Fire Jaoyar. Ekta Upay Khunje Pan Ebong Sei Upay Er Opor Vor Kore Joubone Fire Jan Ebong Nijeder Notun Name Porichito Kore Tolen. Kintu Ki Sei Upay? Sei Kotha Jante Hole Aapnake Mone Diye Purota Shunte Hobe Rajshekhar Basu-Er Lekha Ei Osadharon Golpoti. Cholun Shune Neoya Jak.

solve-your-modern-problem-with-vedas.title: Solve Your Modern Problem With Vedas
solve-your-modern-problem-with-vedas.description: Chaar Vedon ke naam to aaj kal sab ko pata hote hai, lekin Chaar Vedon mein likha kya hai ye to hum mein se bahut kam hi logon ko pata hoga. Humare show "Solve Your Modern Problem With Vedas" mein aapko Chaaro Vedon ke baare mein to jaanne ko milega hi lekin uske sath-sath ye bhi pata chalega ki kaise aap vedon ki madad se aaj ke samay ki pareshaniyon ko samajh kar unhein kaise solve kar sakte hain.

basic-guidelines-for-maharashtra-police-.title: Maharashtra Police Bharti- Basic guidance
basic-guidelines-for-maharashtra-police-.description: Mahrashtra Police force join karun aplya Rajyachi, aplya lokanchi seva karavi asa anekanch swapana asta. Police froce madhe jyasathi, Police bharti chi pariksha dena anivarya asta. Mhnunch ya parikshesathi tayari kashi keli pahije, Tya sathi konta Abhyaskram ani Study material follow kela pahije, Physical test, Mental test che konkonte prakar astat...ya saglyacha basic pan important knowledge tumhala ya show madhun milnar ahe.

a-guide-to-enhanve-your-brain-power.title: A Guide To Enhance Your Brain Power
a-guide-to-enhanve-your-brain-power.description: Bhoolana ek aise bimari hai jiske chalte humare kai sare kaam hamper ho jate hain. Humare dimag main din bhar anginat thoughts aate hain jinhe hum koi importance nahi dete aur phir unhe bhul jaate hain. Is audiobook main aapko milega apne brain ko organize karne ka formula. Agar aapka dimaag organised rahega to aapke sare hi kaama aasani se hote chale jaayenge bina kisi confusion ya anxiety ke. Jis tarha hum body ko feed karte hain, zaroorat hai apne dimaag ko bhi healthy feed karne ki taki humari life sorted rahe. To kya hai brain ko align karne ka method aur kaise hum bach sakte hain bhoolne wali bimaari se.  Jaante hai yeh sare secrets is an exclusive audiobook main. Agar aapko "Mindset" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

what-is-pcod-pcos-symptoms-and-ayurvedic.title: PCOD/PCOS Mhanje Kay Ani Ayurvedic Upchar
what-is-pcod-pcos-symptoms-and-ayurvedic.description: Shroteho, aajachi Woman, Superwoman zali aahe pan tari hi tila kahi trasana samore javech lagate. PCOD. ani PCOS he disease striyanmadhye ani kishor vayeen mulinmadhye agadi common zale ahet.Ya disease chi lakshane,karane,parinam,hou naye mhanoon kay kalaji ghyavi yachya tips ani ya ajaravar ayurvedic upachar paddhati ani yogabhyas kasa fayedeshir tharato Yachi mahiti gheuya amachya ya show madhoon. fakt KUKUFM Var...Sune jo maan Chahe!

the-secret-of-manifestation.title: The Secret Of Manifestation
the-secret-of-manifestation.description: Nenachatha adaiyurathukkaana ragasiya vazhimuraigal pathina audiobook ithu ! Ariviyal poorvamaa niroobikka patta intha vazhimuraigala seyalpaduthi ungalukku pidicha vaazhkaiya unga ennam pola amaichukka intha audiobook nichayam help pannum.

who-killed-jessica-mix.title: Who Killed Jessica?
who-killed-jessica-mix.description:
Kya kisi ki jaan ek peg jitni sasti ho sakti hai? 
Is desh mein ho sakti hai. Jessica Lal, hatyakand mein na to sirf ek peg ke liye Jessica ki jaan li gayi, par gaddavar Congressi neta ke bete Manu Sharma ne is case se jude 300 se zyada gavah ko khareed liya. Par Jessica ko insaaf milta hai apni behen Sabreena ki jidd aur media ke sath se. Jane kaise ye case bana UPSC exams mein aane wale topic "Media Trials" ka sabse bada example.

tenali-ramakrishna.title: Tenali Ramakrishna
tenali-ramakrishna.description: తెనాలి రామకృష్ణకు అమ్మవారు ఇచ్చిన వరం ఏంటి? రాయల వారు తెనాలిని ఎందుకు వికటకవి అని పిలిచేవారు? తెనాలి రామలింగడి కథ మీకోసం.

taj-a-thrilling-love-story.title: అక్బర్- సలీం- అనార్కలి
taj-a-thrilling-love-story.description: ప్రేమకథంటే సలీం-అనార్కలిదే అని ఈ రోజుల్లో కూడా చెప్పుకునేలా పాపులర్ అయిన ఆ కథ ఏంటి ? వారి ప్రేమ నిజమేనా? ప్రేమ కథలన్నింటిలోనూ మేటి ప్రేమ కథగా చరిత్రలో నిలిచిపోయిన సలీం - అనార్కలి కథ ని సరికొత్తగా, మీకు వీనుల విందు అందించడానికి కుకు ఎఫ్.ఎం చేసిన ప్రయత్నమే అక్బర్ - సలీం - అనార్కలీ.

retirement-kaise-plan-karen.title: Retirement Planning Kaise Karein?
retirement-kaise-plan-karen.description: Yeh audiobook aapko kuch valuable insights aur tips degi jo aapko apni retirement planning mein help karegi. Chahe aap savings karna shuru kar rahe ho ya pehle se hi retirement age ke qareeb ho, is show mein aapko financial planning, investment strategies aur social security benefits ke bare mein jaankari milegi jisse aap apne retirement ke golden years ko khushi se guzar sakein.

the-new-bjp-4.title: The New BJP
the-new-bjp-4.description: BJP katchi eppadi ethirppugala ethirkondu, aatharavugala saathagamaa payanpaduthi indiavudaiya migaperiya katchiyaa urumaatram adanjaanga nu intha audiobook la virivaa sollirukaanga. Vaanga Therinjikalam.

tamilnadu-viduthalai-padai.title: Tamilnadu Viduthalai Padai
tamilnadu-viduthalai-padai.description: Viduthalai padathula vara train accident karpanai illa. Adhu oru unmai sambavam. Ariyalur la nadantha andha gundu vedippu ku kaaranam, Tamilnadu Viduthalai Padai thalaivar Kaliyaperumal “Vaathiyar” nu solranga. Edhukaaga avar appavi makkal ah kollanum? Nejamave andha sambavam pinnadi viduthalai padai dhan irunducha? Vera edhuvum pinnadi arasiyal sadhi iruka? Therinjuka kelunga “Tamil Nadu Viduthalai Padai” on Kuku FM

better-and-faster.title: Discover Your Potential
better-and-faster.description: Safalta aur asafalta dono ke hi apne apne patterns hote hain, aage badhte hue in patterns ko dekh pana bahut zaroori hai. Aur inhi patterns ko dekhna sikhati hai yeh audiobook. Yeh audiobook aapko sikhayegi ki kaise aap apne aas paas hi chhipe ideas dekh sakte hain. Kya hai vo traps jo humein aage badhne se rokta hai aur aap unse kaise nikal sakte hain aur bna sakte hain ek successful business.

kanavugalin-palangal.title: Kanavugalin Palangal
kanavugalin-palangal.description: Nammaloda kanavugal enna solludhu?! Unamaiyaana ariviyal saardha arthangal enna nu indha audio book la kelunga.

geeta-gyan.title: Geeta Gyan
geeta-gyan.description: Dharm insaan ki sabse zyada madad tab karta hai jab practical duniya mein aapko aapke sawalon ke jawaab ya toh mil nhi paata hai aur agar milte bhi hain toh aap us jawaab se santusht nahi hote hain. Aise waqt mein dharmik gyaan na sirf humein sahi disha deta hai balki hamare akelepan mein hamara sahara bhi banta hai. Insaan chahe kitni bhi tarakki kyu na karle Ishwar ke liye uska lagav use lagataar aage badhte rehne mein madad karta hai. To doston aaiye Geeta gyaan ke saath apne vichar, karm aur apni zindagi ko sahi disha mein le jayein.

how-to-rebuild-yourself.title: How To Rebuild Yourself
how-to-rebuild-yourself.description: Personal transformation nradhu namma body ku mattum illa, namma mind kum dhaan. Adhukkana sila tips and motivating ideas ah inga kelunga.

cricket-stadiums-of-india.title: Cricket Stadiums Of India
cricket-stadiums-of-india.description: Eppovume namma India makkalukkum Cricket kum oru pirikka mudiyaatha bandham irukkum. Athey maathiri cricket players kum, fans kum namma naatula irukka stadiums koodayum oru bond irukum. India voda famous aana cricket stadiums pathi swaarasyamaa eduthu solra pathivu thaan ithu. Vaanga kekalaam!

the-science-of-living.title: Simple Strategies For Perfect Lifestyle
the-science-of-living.description: Kya aapne kabhi ye jaanne ki koshish ki hai ki Science ka hamari lifestyle mein kya mahatva hai? Aakhir humein apne lifestyle ko perfect banne ke liye kin kin chezon ko follow karna chahiye, Aakhir humara routine kaisa hona chahiye ki jisse hum ek balance life ji sakein, Aaiye jaante hain ki aakhir kya hai humari life mein Science ka Mahatva aur kaise hum ise follow kar ke apni life ke easy bana sakte hain. Humare is Audio show  “Simple Strategies For Perfect Lifestyle” mein aise 200 sawalon ke jawaab hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain jise shayad aapki zindagi aur bhi behtar ho jaaegi.

mega-vasool.title: மெகா வசூல்
mega-vasool.description: காதல் தோஷம் கொண்ட காயத்திரி, ஆறுமுகம் எனும் காதலனை அடையப் போராடுகிறாள். அவள் தன் காதலில் வெற்றிபெற்றாளா? தன் காதலை அடையப் போராடும் காயத்திரி எதிர்கொள்ளும் நகைச்சுவை சம்பவங்களை உங்கள் குக்கூ எப்.எம்.ல் கேளுங்கள்...

communication-and-conflict-resolutions-i.title: Communication and Conflict Resolutions in Relationships
communication-and-conflict-resolutions-i.description: Welcome to "Communication and Conflict Resolution in Relationships," an insightful audio show that explores the essential aspects of healthy and effective communication within relationships. Hosted by relationship expert Benjamin, this show offers a compassionate and empowering space for individuals seeking guidance on navigating the intricacies of interpersonal dynamics.

the-archer-1.title: The Archer
the-archer-1.description: Is Duniya mein aisi koi bhi cheez nahi hai jis se hum seekh nahi le sakte hain. band ghadi bhi humein din mein do baar sahi waqt dikhati hai. Author Paulo Coelho ki is Audiobook mein bhi hum teer aur dhanush ko chalane ki qala ko seekhenge jismein cheepe hain humari life ke vo lessons jinhein jaan kar hum apni life mein, career mein successful ban sakte hain aur us success ko umarbhar maintain karke bhi rakh sakte hain. Chaliye seekhna shuru karte hain apni life ke ek behtareen teerandaaz banne ki qala ko.

manaivigal-jakkirathai.title: மனைவிகள் ஜாக்கிரதை
manaivigal-jakkirathai.description: ஸ்டில் போட்டோகிராபரான ராஜா தனக்கென ஒரு ஸ்டூடியோவை அமைத்துக் கொண்டு பிழைப்பு நடத்தி வருகிறான். ஒரு நாள் அவன் கீதா எனும் அழகிய பெண்ணை சாலையில் பார்த்து விடுகிறான். அப்போது அவளை திருட்டுத்தனமாக ஒரு போட்டோவும் எடுத்து விடுகிறான். ராஜாவுக்கு அப்போது தெரியவில்லை. அந்த போட்டோ அவன் வாழ்க்கையைப் பந்தாடப் போகிறது என்று. கீதா மீது ராஜா வைத்த காதல் ஒருதலைக் காதலாகவே முடிகிறது. அதன் பின் வேறொரு திருமணம் செய்து கொண்ட ராஜா தன் மனைவியிடம் கீதாவை பற்றிய நினைவுகளை பகிர்ந்து, பெரும் தவறு செய்கிறான். அவன் செய்த அந்தத் தவறினால் அவன் எப்படியெல்லாம் அலைந்தான், எப்படி எல்லாம் உருண்டு பிரண்டான் என்பதை கேளுங்கள். எஸ்.வி.சேகரின் மனைவிகள் ஜாக்கிரதை எனும் இந்த நகைச்சுவையான நாடகத்தை உங்கள் குக்கூ எப்.எம்.ல் கேட்டு சிரியுங்கள்...

periyappa.title: பெரியப்பா
