how-to-behave-with-special-child.title: Special Children Sobat kasa vagva
how-to-behave-with-special-child.description: Shroteho, Kahi mula hi aplya 4 chaungan peksha jara vegli asatat. Tyanchi mansik va Sharirik drushtya week astat. Tyana 'Special Child' mhatla jata. Asha Mulana Samajacha Acceptance hava asato. Ek Sensitive person ani jagruk nagrik mhnun apan tyanchashi kasa vagayacha, kasa bolycha, jenekarun tyana aplya premachi, mayechi janiv hoi.. yavishayi cha experts cha mat apan ya khas show madhun janun ghenar ahot.

gandhi-ji-book-final-all-pages-with-cove.title: Mahatma Gandhi: Rashtra Pita ki kahani
gandhi-ji-book-final-all-pages-with-cove.description: Rastra Pita - Mahatma Gandhi, itihas me un logon mein se hain jinke vichar duniya ke har kone mein apnaye jaate hain. Par fir bhi nayi generation kahin na kahin aadha sach sunkar unki “leadership, Political, Ahinsa” ki ideology ko nakar deti hai. Chaliye jaante hain Naresh Dadhich ki likhi is kitab mein, Gandhi ji ke struggle se lekar humein azadi dilane tak ki poori journey ko. Jisse hum bhi nayi genration ko humare rastra pita ke baare me bata sake.

is-it-worth-investing-in-real-estate.title: Is It Worth Investing In Real Estate ?
is-it-worth-investing-in-real-estate.description: Sambadhikira panatha edhula invest panlam? Gold’ah? FD’ah? Land’ah? Indha kelvi unga thalaiku ulla oditu iruka? Kavalaiya vidunga! Real Estate la invest panradhula iruka positives, risk factors matrum pala mukkiya key points ah therinjuka kelunga “Is It Worth Investing In Real Estate?” on Kuku FM

life-is-what-you-make-it-1.title: Life Is What You Make It
life-is-what-you-make-it-1.description: Namma kathaiyoda heroine 'Ankita' vaazhkaila ellaame nallapadiyaa thaan poitu irunthuchu padippu, kadhal, avaloda kanavugal.. ippadi ellaame.. thideernu thaan yaarum ethirpaarkaatha antha sambavam nadanthuchu, avaloda vazhkaiyave poratti podura maathiri ! Namma vazhkaila nadakkura visayangalukku nichayamaa naama poruppaaga mudiyaathu, aanaa adha naama eppadi ethirkolrom apdingrathu namma kaila thaan irukku. Ankita vazhkaila nadantha antha ethirpaaraatha sambavam enna? atha ava eppadi ethirkondaa, adhula irunthu eppadi meendu vanthaa nu therinjuka intha audiobook ka kelunga. idhu Indiavin miga sirantha ezhuthaalargalil oruvaraana Preeti Shenoy  ezhuthuna "Life is what you make it" in Tamil audiobook. Azhagaa poittu iruntha Ankita vazhkaila appadi enna thaan nadanthuchunu therinjukalaam vaanga !

12th-pass-1.title: Paisa hi Paisa hoga
12th-pass-1.description: Riyaz, Sachin aur Vinay apni personal problems ke chalte, ek successful company se toxic brotherhood ki journey par kab pahunch jaate hain, unhe pata hi nahi chalta.

history-of-ltte.title: History Of LTTE
history-of-ltte.description:
Nammala kaapathikiradhu ku per “Rowdyism” na, Rowdyism pannuvom.
Ilangai la Tamizhar urimaigal marukkapattu, kodumai ku aal'aana samayam, oru puratchi vedichadhu. Adhu kaatu theeya paravi namma makkal ah kaapathinadhu mattum illama, thappu senjavangala dhairiyama thatti kettuchu. Indha puatchi ku edhu thodakkam? Vidhai yaaru pottadhu? Therinjuka kelunga “History of LTTE” on Kuku FM

ki-kore-manushke-influence-korben.title: Ki Kore Manushke Influence Korben?
ki-kore-manushke-influence-korben.description: Manushke Influence Korte Para Ekta Dokkhota, Aar Jeta Sobar Modhye Thake Na. Kintu Jader Modhye Ei Goon Thake Tara Jekono Poristhitite Nijer Kotha Diye Manushke Influence Kore Beriye Aashte Paren. Tobe Er Jonyo Dorkar Hoy Kichu Dokkhotar. Nishchoi Vabchen Ei Influence Byaprta Ki? Aar Kivabe Manushke Khub Taratari Influence Kora Jay? Aar Ki Sei Dokkhota? Eisob Proshner Uttor Lukiye Aache Ei Audiobook Er Modhye. Aapni Jodi Mon Diye Ei Audiobook-ti Shonen Tahole Khub Druto Aapnio Manushke Influence Korar Tips Jante Parben. Tahole Aar Deri Kiser, Jhotpot Shune Nin Ei Audiobook.

the-curious-parents-season-2.title: The Curious Parent - Season 2
the-curious-parents-season-2.description:
Kaha jata hai "Bache bahut jaldi bade ho jaate hain" lekin yeh sirf parents ko lagta hai. Bachon ke liye to unka bachpan ek bahut khas aur lamba waqt hota hai. Unka yeh waqt behtar banane ke liye kya karein aur kya nahi? Agar yeh sawal aapke mann mein bhi aata hai to suniye parenting researcher Harpreet S. Grover ke dwara  khas aap ke liye tyaar ki gyi yeh audiobook sirf KukuFM par. 

For any questions related to parenting, you may connect with Harpreet on Instagram at harpreet_thecuriousparent or write to him at hello@thecuriousparent.com

spoken-english-made-easy.title: Spoken English Made Easy
spoken-english-made-easy.description: Intha audiobook ka full laa kettu idhula sollirukka visayangala follow pannaale podhum neenga Fluent taa English Pesa aarambichuruveenga, costly aana Spoken English courses edhuvume theva illa ! Ada ipdilaam kooda English kathukka mudiyuma nu neenga aacharyapadra maathiriyaana Easy'aana vazhila panam selavu pannaama English kathukka neraya vazhimuraigal intha audiobook la irukku.  Vaanga Easya English Kathukalaam.

bana-sharemarket-cha-badshah.title: Bana sharemarket cha badshah
bana-sharemarket-cha-badshah.description: Share Market madhye paise Invest karana mhantla ki aplyala bhiti vate. Me invest kelele paise budale tar? Asa prashna tumchya aamchya sarkhya sarvana yeto.  Jasa manus yat shrimanta hoto tasach yat par budun pan jato. Aplya Samor jasti Vait udharna ahet mhanun apan yat invest karayla khabarto. Pan don't worry Bana sharemarket cha badshah ha Kuku fm khas show tumhala shikvel yogya company shares gheun kasa apan badshah banu shakto.

5g-crimes-mix-episodes.title: 5G Crimes
5g-crimes-mix-episodes.description: Siddharth Verma, who starts intra-day trading in lockdown and earns good money. He gets into insider trading and resorts to all illegal ways to secure their family future until Thapriya Brokerage Firm scares him and then Siddharth ends up in jail because of it but leaves a money-making platform for his son, Poorab Verma.

unheard-stories-of-ramayan.title: Ramayanatil Kadhihi Na Aiklelya Goshti
unheard-stories-of-ramayan.description: Atta Apan Anekvela Ramayan Aikla Ahe. Tyatil Ek Ani Ek Goshta Apli  Tondpath Ahe. Pan Ramayanatil Ase Hi Kahi Pailu Ahet Je Sahasa Konalach Mahit Nahi Ahet, Ani Hech Pailu Kuku FM Ramayanatil Kadhi Hi Na Aiklelya Katha Ya Show Dware Tumcha Pashi Gheun Alela Ahe.

the-men-eating-leopard.title: The Man Eating Leopard Of Rudraprayag
the-men-eating-leopard.description: Yeh kahaani Rudraprayag ke itihas ke us daur ki hai jab ek aadamkhor tendua vahan ke logon par kaal banke mandraane laga aur aaye din kisi insaan ka shikaar karne laga. Akhir kaise Rudraprayag ke logon ne is kaal se chhutkara paya aur kaise aadamkhor tenduye ka aatank vahan khatam hua. Jaaniye Kuku FM par Author Jim Corbett ki is full Audiobook mein.

how-to-prepare-for-tamil-nadu-upcoming-g.title: How To Prepare For Tamil Nadu Upcoming Government Exams
how-to-prepare-for-tamil-nadu-upcoming-g.description: Tamil Nadu Government la mattum motham ethanai departments iruku, adhula total ah evlo job postings iruku nu ungaluku theriyuma? Andha jobs la posting aaguradhuku ennana exams clear pannanum, andha exams ku epdi prepare pannanum nu theriyuma? Indha kelvi ellathukum badhil therinjukittu, nalla Govt. job la place aagi, kalyanam kuzhandhai nu settle aaga kelunga “How To Prepare For Tamil nadu Upcoming Government Exams” on Kuku FM

chala-apli-shakti-olkhuya.title: Chala Apli Shakti Olkhuya
chala-apli-shakti-olkhuya.description: Apan kayam aplyatlya kamtartannach baghat asto, aplyakade kay kami ahe hyachach kade apla laksha asta. Pan pratyek mansat kahi na kahi gun astoch, garaj aste tya gunanna olakhnyachi ani tya gunanna apla samarthya banavnyachi. Ha show tumhala tumchyatla tech samarthya olkhaila madat karel.

real-life-money-1.title: Rich Nahi Wealthy Banein
real-life-money-1.description: Paisa Kamane se zyada mushkil hota hai, paison ka sahi dhang se istemal karna. Ab yeh show aapko paisa kamana to nahi sikha sakta, par yeh aapko paise ko sanjona zaroor sikha sakta hai. Yeh show aapko paise manage karne ke kuch aise tarike batayega jiski madad se aap lower middle class ki limited life se nikal ke rich logo ki limitless life mein jeena seekh sakte hain

sidhargal-kanda-vignana-thathuvam.title: Sidhargal Kanda Vignana Thathuvam
sidhargal-kanda-vignana-thathuvam.description: Naveena Ariviyalukku savaalaa irukkura pala marmangalukku sidhargal thathuvathula ariviyal vilakkam irukku ! Sidhargal kandupidicha ariviyal thathuvangala intha audiobook moolam therinjukalaam vaanga

how-to-plan-your-retirement-life.title: How To Plan Your Retirement Life
how-to-plan-your-retirement-life.description: Kadaisi kaala vaazhkai eppadi irukumo nu nenaikkuradha vidha , adha eppadi happy and fulfilling ah vaazhalam nu plan panradhukkana guide dhaan indha audio book.

mystery-of-kohinoor.title: Mystery of Kohinoor
mystery-of-kohinoor.description: Kohinoor, jiski chamak par puri duniya deewani hai, tweeter par kabhi na kabhi aapne “Kohinoor wapis karo” ka trend dekha hi hoga, ek aisa diamond jiski kahaniyan Bhagwan Shree Krishna ke sath jodi jati hain, chaliye jante hain duniya ke sabse popular diamond ke baare me aur kohinoor se jude ek aise shraap ke baare mein jo logon ko kangaal kar deta hai.

ulagai-maatriya-pen-kandupidippalargal.title: Ulagai Maatriya Pen Kandupidippalargal
ulagai-maatriya-pen-kandupidippalargal.description: Ariviyal thurai la Pengalin pangu kammi nu ellaarum solvaanga ! aana athu poi.. ariviyal thurai la saathanai padaichu, ulagai maatriya pudhu ariviyal kandupidipugalai uruvaakkiya singa pengala patriya thoguppu thaan intha audiobook. Ulagai Maatriya pen kandupidipaalargala pathi therinjukalaam vaanga !

mastering-your-subconscious-mind.title: Mastering Your Subconscious Mind
mastering-your-subconscious-mind.description: Ennam Pol Vaazhkai nu solluvaanga, appadi patta ennangalai eppadi positive aah vachikurathunu nammal la pala peruku theriya maatikuthu. Intha Audio pathivu ungaloda Aazh manasai unga control la vachikurathu pathiyum, positive aana vishayangalai manifest panrathu pathiyum ungaluku eduthu sollum. Unga Subconscious mind ah unga control la vachuka intha show ungaluku help pannum.

know-the-humans.title: Know The Humans
know-the-humans.description: Doston, aap humans aur unke evolution ke baare main kitna jaante hain? Kya aap theory of evolution ke process ke bare mein jaante hain. Is audiobook mein hai un saare questions ke answers jo aap shayad kabhi apne aap se pooch bhi na payein ho. Yeh audiobook aapko lekar chalegi ek aise safar par jaha aap samjhenge insani dimaag ki complexities ki kahani usi ki zubaani, sirf KUKU FM par.

how-to-get-a-job-during-recession.title: How To Get A Job During Recession
how-to-get-a-job-during-recession.description: Recession naa enna ? Recession period la ethunaala job secured illama poguthu ? Eppadi intha recession ah overcome panni carrer la success aagurathu ? Intha kelvigalukkum bathil thaan intha Audio show. Ithai kettu unga career la neenga successful aah vum secured aah vum irukurathu eppadi nu therinjukonga.

pilgrims-progress.title: Pilgrim's Progress
pilgrims-progress.description: The Pilgrim's Progress from This World, to That Which Is to Come is a 1678 Christian allegory written by John Bunyan. It is regarded as one of the most significant works of theological fiction in English literature and a progenitor of the narrative aspect of Christian media. Listen to this meaningful audiobook and begin your spiritual journey.

the-story-of-serial-killer-sisters-mix.title: Killer Sisters
the-story-of-serial-killer-sisters-mix.description:
Saal 1990 se 1996 ke beech Kolhapur, Pune, Nashik, jaise kayi shehron mein 40 se zyada bacchon ko kidnap kiya gaya. In bacchon ko kidnap karne ke bad inse kayi apraadh karwaye gaye, aur kaam pura hotey hi inhe rongte khadey kar dene wali maut ke anjaam utar diya gaya. Akhir kyu ek maa ne apni hi betiyon ko is darindgi ke andhere me dhakel diya? 
Aur akhir kaise dono beheno ne is khooni khel ko anjaam diya?
Jaane in maa betiyon ke hila kar rakh dene wale apraadh ki kahani humare show Killer Sisters par.

faces-of-evil.title: Faces Of Evil
faces-of-evil.description: They are the monsters of our nightmares, the tyrants who rule with an iron fist and leave a trail of destruction in their wake. From Adolf Hitler's Nazi Germany to Mao Zedong's China, these despots have inspired fear, awe, and revulsion in equal measure. But who are these men (and occasional women), and what drove them to commit such heinous acts? In this audio show, we will explore the lives and legacies of some of the most notorious dictators in history. We will delve into their early years, their rise to power, and the evil deeds they committed against their own people and others. Join us as we delve into the dark and complex history of dictators and their regimes, and explore the impact they have had on the world.

you-can-be-original-too.title: You Can Be Original Too
you-can-be-original-too.description: Kya Duniya mein har ek idea original hai? Kya ideas ko copy nahi kiya ja sakta? itne bade bade unicorns aakhir kaise ban jaate hain? Kya hai secret original ideas ka aur originality ka. Aaiye humare saath is safar par aur jaaniye kuch dimaag ko hila dene wale concepts jo aapke sochne ke tareeke ko badal denge. To Abhi suniye yeh audiobook sirf KUKU FM par.

mysterious-places-in-india.title: Mysterious Places In India
mysterious-places-in-india.description: Mana Desham Enno Pramukha Smaraka Kattadalaku, Devalayalaku, Charitraka Pradeshalaku, Rahasya Pradeshalaku Nilayam. Ive Kaakunda Mana Deshamlo Enno Bhayankaramaina Pradeshalu Unnayi. Oka Kolanu ninda Emukala goollu Unna Pradesham, Maroka chota Security guards ni Bhayapette Bhootalu, Moropakka Pakshulanni Sucide chesukune Pradesham, Ilantivi Mana Desham lo unnayi. Ee roju Manam ee Audiobook lo Alanti Vintha Mystery Places Gurinchi telusukundam.

the-political-history-of-india.title: The Political History Of India
the-political-history-of-india.description: Lokathile thanne oru nirnayaka shakthiyayi India ennu maari kazhinju. Ennal noottandukal neendu ninna adichamarthalukalude charitramulla oru rajyam engane anu ennu kaanunna avasthayilekku uyarnnathu? Swathanthryanantha India ye kai pidichu uyarthiyathu aarokke aanu? Swathanthryanantha Bharatham anubhavicha prathisandhikal enthokke aanu? Eni etra dooram ee maharajyathinu munnottu pokanundu? Ethelam ariyam, 'The Political History Of India' enna showilude.

secret-of-successfull-communication.title: Improve Your Communication Skills
secret-of-successfull-communication.description: Effective communication life ke har aspect mein kaam aata hai, jaise ki personal relationships, workplace ya public speaking mein. KUKU FM ke is original show mein, doosron ke saath effective communication karne ki apni ability ko badhane ke liye engaging exercises aur practical examples ke zariye hum aisi valuable strategies aur techniques seekhenge jinse common communication barriers ko aasaani se hatakar ek confident aur successful communicator bana ja sakta hai. Agar aapko "How To Talk To Anyone" jaisi books pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

doglapan-the-hard-truth-about-life-and-s.title: Doglapan: The Hard Truth about Life and Start-Ups
doglapan-the-hard-truth-about-life-and-s.description: Shark Tank India Reality Show To Onekei Dkhechen. Ei Show Er Ekjon Bicharok Ashneer Grover Er Kothao Shunechen. Jar Kotha Sokoler Mon Joy Koreche. Kintu Janen Ki Nijer Banano Company Theke Onake Resign Dite Hoyechilo. Shune Obak Holen? Hya Emontai Ghotechilo BharatPe Er Co-Founder Ashneer Grover Er Songe. Til Til Kore Gore Tola Nijer Company Chere Chole Aaste Hoyechilo Take. Kintu Startup E Keno Emonta Ghote? Ki Karon Thake Er Pichone? Kon Aasol Sotyo Lukiye BharatPe Ebong Startupgulor Pichone? Seisob Ghotonagulor Kotha Tini Bolechen Tar Lekha Ei 'Doglapan: The Hard Truth about Life and Start-Ups' Boite. Ja Janle Aapnio Obak Hoben. Aasun Aar Somoy Nosto Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak.

rupam-islam-o-fossils-joy-rock.title: Rupam Islam O Fossils: Joy Rock
rupam-islam-o-fossils-joy-rock.description: Bangla e rock music bolte ektai name mathaye ashe- Rupam Islam. Thik tayi Bangla r sanskriti te rock music introduce korar daityo niyechilen tini. "Jibon cholche na ar soja pothe.." ei gaan ta jemon amder sokoler kachei khub priyo, ei gaaner nirmata ke bhule gele kokhonoi cholbe na.  Ki kore shuru holo onar journey, keno sobai Fossils er songe jhor shobdo ta relate kore thake. Ei shob kichu ar Rupam Islam ar onar band Fossils niye aj ei audio story te bistarito alochona kora hobe. Shunte thakun Rupam Islam O Fossils: Joy Rock.

kya-dark-magic-hota-hai.title: Dark Truth of Black Magic World
kya-dark-magic-hota-hai.description: Kya aap kale jadoo mein yakeen karte hai? Kya apko kale jadoo ki khooni history pata hai? Kya apko pata hai ki kale jadoo ki shururat kab, kaha aur kaise hui thi? Kaise kale jadoo ne insano ki bali chadhane ko ek vidhi ka naam diya tha. Aur kaise isi kale jadoo ki vajah se kyi zindagiyan barbad ho gayi. Aaj hum apko le chalenge India ke us hisse  mein jaha kala jadoo ki manyata  par sawal uthana bhi ek gunha hai.

rabindranath-er-jiboner-nari-ra.title: Rabindranath Er Jiboner Nari Ra
rabindranath-er-jiboner-nari-ra.description: Rabindranath er jibon shara pheleche tar protyek ti sahitye. Tar jiboner bibhinyo somoye je mohilara esechilen tar jibone shei niyei aj ker ei audio story ti. Nari songo chhara aj porjonto kono ppurush shilpo ytoiri korte perechen kina ta bola kothin. Rabindranath Thakur o tar byatikrom non. Kobi gurur kolpona anek beshi ebong tar swadher nari ra bastobe ja ta kolpona e anek beshi dalpala mere chhoriye porechen dur digante. Kobir ei swadher nari kuler modhye royeche tar oshonkho prem. Shei prem ba tar swadher nari der somporke jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

krishnarin-bagavath-geethai.title: Bhagavad Gita
krishnarin-bagavath-geethai.description: Bhagavan Sri Krishnar sonna Bagavath Geethai ya upanyasam mathiri vilakkam solli bore adikaama, Vazhkaiku udhuvura vagaila nadaimurai anubava ariviyalaa intha audio series la solli kodukkuraaru Namma aachariyar ! Pana Kastam, Mana Kastam, Uravu sikkalgal nu andraada vaazhkaila vara koodiya pala prachanaigalukku theervu Bagavath Geethai la irukku. Vaanga Krishnarin Bagavath Geethai ya verum theory ya illaama practical laa kathukalaam.

azim-premji-1.title: Azim Premji : The Man beyond the Billions
azim-premji-1.description: Dil se samaj sevak aur dimag se businessman, ye Azim Premji ke wo gun hain, jinhone unko humesha limelight se dur rakha. Kyunki unka manna raha hai ki insaan ko apni life jitni ho sake utni personal rakhni chahiye. Apni isi moral value ko unhone apni company Wipro mein aur usmein kaam kar rahe logon ki life mein bhi shamil kiya. Azim Premji hamesha se chahte the ki unhone jo kamaya hai, use wo apne logon ko lauta sake. Tabhi to apni kamayi ka lagbhag 70% unhone government ko social cause ke liye de diya hai. Par kyun? Kya unhone apni family ke liye kuch nahi rakha hai? Azim Premji ke jivan se judi aisi aur bhi kayi baatein hai, jinhe aap janenge is audiobook mein. Aaiye ise sunein!

vastu-shastram.title: Vastu Shastram
vastu-shastram.description: Veed undakkan bhoomi thiranjedukkumbol shradhikkenda karyangal enthokkeyanu? Vaastu shastram anusarich graha nirmaanam nadathumbol adisthanamayi paalikendathum pradhanapettathumaya chila vishayangale kurichch aazhathil manasilaaku ee showiloode.

bhavishya-janne-ki-saral-vidhi-hindi.title: Bhavishya Janne Ki Saral Vidhi
bhavishya-janne-ki-saral-vidhi-hindi.description: Yeh Audiobook Insan ke janam ke samay, graho ki sthiti ke kundli par asar ki vistar se charcha karti hai. Iss Audiobook mein 891 Yog ya Graho ki arrangements ke baare mein jankari di gayi hai, jo insan ke jeevan ke alag alag hisse jaise, dhan, career, shaadi aur parivar par asar dal sakte hai. Ismein jeevan mein aane wali problems ko solve karne ke liye bhi solutions diye gaye hain aur vo bhi aasan bhasha mein, toh chaliye apne graho ke khel ko samajhte hain

shikhun-investment-er-a-z.title: Shikhun Investment-Er A-Z
shikhun-investment-er-a-z.description: Aamader Ei Duniyay Emon Lok Khub Kom Hobe Ba Hobe Na Bollei Chole Jara Beshi Taka Income Korte Chan Na. Jar Aache Se Chay Aaro Income Korte, Aar Jar Nei Se To Vebei Cholen Protiniyoto Je Kivabe Taka Uparjon Kora Jay. Taka To Uparjon Korchen Kintu Sei Taka Kivabe Baraben? Obak Holen? Hya Uparjoner Taka Baranor Ekta Poth Holo Sothik Jaygay Investment. Ebar Aapnar Mone Proshno Jagte Pare Investment To Korte Chai Kintu Kivabe Korobo? Kothay Korbo? Aapnar Sei Proshner Somadhan Dite Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Bishesh Audio Show, Jekhan Theke Aapni Shikhte Parben Investment Er A-Z. Aar Ektu Chesta Korlei Uparjon Korte Parben Onek Taka. Nishchoi Jante Icche Korche? Aasun Aar Deri Na Kore Jene Neyoya Jak.

bhunri-komanor-sohoj-upay.title: Bhunri Komanor Sohoj Upay
bhunri-komanor-sohoj-upay.description: Ekta Somoy Chilo Jokhon Bangalira Bhunri Niye Gorbo Korto. Kintu Somoy Joto Egiyeche Ei Bhunri Hoye Dariyeche Ekta Boro Somosya. Train, Bus Jatei Jan Na Keno Ektu Mota Manush Dekhlei Loke Ektu Onyovabe Takay. Emonki Auto Ba Toto Te Uthle Onek Somoy Extra Varao Dite Hoy. Aar Ei Niye Dushchintay Din Katate Thaken Ek Shrenir Manush. Tader Mathay Ghurte Thake Kivabe Ei Bhunri Komano Jay? Aar Ei Dushchinta Dur Korte Kuku Fm Niye Eseche Ei Bishesh Audio Show Jekhane Emon Kichu Tips Bola Aache Ja Follow Korte Parle Aapni Aapnar Bhunri Niyontrone Aante Parben. Nishchoi Janar Jonyo Mon Byakul Hoye Poreche? Tahole Aar Deri Kiser Jhotpot Shune Nin Purota Mon Diye.

normal-isnt-normal.title: Normal isn't normal !
normal-isnt-normal.description: Aaj ki duniya kehne ko to modern hoti ja rahi hai, lekin mental illness ke cases bhi usi raftaar se badh rahe hain. Har kisi ke bade bade ambitions hain. Har koi bhaag daudh main laga hua hai. Kisi ke pass waqt nahi hai, isi ka natija hai ki bahut se log mental illness ka shikar ho jaate hain. Isliye KUKU FM par aaj hum aisi audiobook sunane ja rahe hain jise sunkar aap khud hi apne worry, anxiety ya depression ko door karte hain aur khushhaal zindagi jee sakte hain. To kya wakai jo humein itna normal lagta hai wo normal hai?

bajiprabhu-deshpande.title: Marda Maratha Bajiprabhu Deshpande
bajiprabhu-deshpande.description: Jevha Jevha Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj yancha nav yeta tevha tevha avarjun charcha hote ti maharajanchya swaminishta mavlyanchi. Mharajansathi tyanchya prema khatar anek mavalyani tyancya pranachi ahuti dili. Ya Mavlyanmadhye Ek nav avarjun yeta te mhanje Bajiprabhu Deshpandyancha. Kukufm Gheun ala ahe Yacha Marda Maratha Bajiprabhu Deshpande Yanchi Jeevan Gatha. Maharajanchi Ani Tyanchi Bhet Kashi Jhali, Pavan Khindachi ladha tumhala ya show dware kalanar ahe tyamule ha show shevat paryanta nakki Aika.

vetri-ragasiyangal.title: Vetri ragasiyangal
vetri-ragasiyangal.description: Muyarchi seirathu pala per aanaa vetri adaiyurathu ennavo konja per thaan.. Enna senjaa vetri kedaikkum nu therinjukittu Muyarchi senjaalum kooda ellorukkum vetri kidaikirathu illa ! Appo Nichayamaa Vetri adaiya enna thaan seiyanum ?   Vetri adaiya sila ragasiyangal iruku ! athai therinjukittaa nichayamaa ellorume vetri adaiyalaam. Vetri adanja pala peroda vazhkaiya alasi aaraanju vetri adaiyurathukku thevaiyaana ragasiyangal la ungalukkaga thoguthu intha audiobook la koduthurukkom. Vetriyin Ragasiyangal la therinjukittu vazhkaila vetri peralaam vaanga.

money-is-in-your-mind.title: Dimaag Se Paisa Banao
money-is-in-your-mind.description: Ameer banne aur Paise ko double karne ke liye humein lagta hai ki job ya business karna hi important hai. Magar aisa nahi hai. Paise ko hum apne mindset ke saath bhi double kar sakte hain aur Wealthy ban sakte hain. Agar aap janna chahte hain kaise? to yeh original series aapke liye hi hai. Is Show Ko sunne ke baad aap samajh paayenge ki kaise acchi planning karke aap wealthy ban sakte hain. Chaliye Money Management ki kala ko janna shuru karte hain. Agar aapko "Why We Want You To Be Rich" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

life-lessons-from-shri-krishna.title: Life Lessons by Shri Krishna
life-lessons-from-shri-krishna.description: Bhagwan Shri Krishna he tyancha bhaktansathi kewal Dev nahit, tar tyanche Mitra hi ahet. Jyapramane Shree Krishnani ek Sakha banun Arjunala yuddha bhumit margdrshan kele, tyach pramane tyani Mitratwacha natyane dilele kahi salle aplyala aplya ayushyat hi faydeshir thartat. Aikuya, Shri Krishnanche Life lessons aplya ya khas show madhun...

the-last-supper.title: The Last Supper
the-last-supper.description: The Last Supper is a significant event in the life of Jesus Christ, and it is recorded in the New Testament of the Bible in the Gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John. It was the final meal that Jesus shared with his disciples before his arrest, trial, and crucifixion. According to the Gospel accounts, Jesus and his disciples gathered in an upper room in Jerusalem to celebrate the Jewish holiday of Passover. Listen to this exclusive show to find out what the significance of the last supper is in Christianity.

how-india-can-avoid-srilankan-crisis.title: How India can avoid Sri Lanka Crisis?
how-india-can-avoid-srilankan-crisis.description: Sri Lanka mein aaj Halaat bahut kharab bane huye hai, Sri Lanka Sabse bade Crisis se guzar raha hai, Sri Lanka aur China ki dosti bhi bahut news mein bani hui hai jismein China ka fayda saaf saaf dikh raha hai. Is show mein aaj aise kuch anjaan sawalon ko samjhenge jaise, Sri Lanka mein Crisis kyu aaya? Iski kya vajah thi aur kaun Zimmedar hai iske liye? Aur India ek padosi desh hone ke naate Sri Lanka ki kaise madad kar sakta hai? Aaiye jaante hain.

the-crucifixion.title: The Crucifixion
the-crucifixion.description: The Crucifixion is one of the most important events in the Christian faith, as it is believed to be the moment when Jesus Christ, the son of God, sacrificed himself on the cross to atone for the sins of humanity. The accounts of the Crucifixion can be found in the four Gospels of the New Testament: Matthew 27, Mark 15, Luke 23, and John 19. Listen to this detailed account of the crucifixion of Jesus Christ, its significance in Christianity and relevance even today.

social-reformers-of-telugu-states.title: Social Reformers Of Telugu States
social-reformers-of-telugu-states.description: 19th Century Ending 20th Century Starting Entire Bharateeya Samajaniki Ushodayam. trading-psychology-by-ahmad-ali-khan.title: Trading Psychology - By Ahmad Ali Khan
trading-psychology-by-ahmad-ali-khan.description: Ek achhi physique banane ke liye aapko 20% workout aur 80% diet ki need hoti hai, similarly ek achaa trader banne ke liye 20% strategy and 80% psychology ki zaroorat hoti hai aisa kehna hai hamare Stock market expert Ahmad Ali Khan ka. Is show me humne Trading Psychology se jude aise important aspects ko discuss kiya hai jo aapko ek "Casual Trader" se "Professional Trader" banne me aapki madad karenge.

gold-smuggling-in-kerala.title: Gold Smuggling In Kerala
gold-smuggling-in-kerala.description: Airport vazhiyum alatheyumulla swarnakadathu Malayalikku eppol oru vartha alathayi maarri kazhinju. Noonathanamaya vazhikalanu ennum swarnakadathinayi upayogichittulathu. Nayathantra channel vazhiyulla swarnakadathu Kerala sarkkar ne thanne pidichu kulikkiyathu ee aduthanu. Arinjathilum etrayo valuthaanu swarnakadathine sambhandhichu ariya kadhakal. Atharam vasthuthakalilekku velicham veeshuka aanu 'Gold Smuggling In Kerala' enna ee show.

misbehaving.title: Behavioral Economics
misbehaving.description: As a human humein hamesha se bataya jata hai ki bado se humein respect se baat karni hai aur bacchon ke sath pyaar se. Agar hum aisa nahi karte, to hum misbehave kar rahe hai. Aisa hi kuch economics mein hota hai. Traditional Economics manta hai ki human logical decision leta hai lekin aisa nahi hai. Hum kai baar kuch decisions lene se pehle logical nahi sochte hain aur isse janam hota hai Behavioral Economics jiske baare mein hum is audio book mein charcha karenge

how-to-make-money-as-an-influencer.title: How To Make Money As An Influencer
how-to-make-money-as-an-influencer.description: Social media illama irukkave mudiyadhu nra nelama vandhachu. Edho oru vagai la namma day to day life ah vittu neengadha idam pidichi iruku indha social media. Idha vachu eppadi oru successful career amachukuradhu nu indha audio la kelunga.

sanyukta-maharashtra-chalval.title: Sanyukta Maharashtra Chalval
sanyukta-maharashtra-chalval.description: 1 May 1960 la Marathi bhashik Mahrashtra rajyachi sthapana zali ani Mumbai Marathi mansala milali. Pan he itke sahaj ghadle nahi. Marathi mansacha hakkasathi tyaveli Sarkar virodhat khup mothe Andolan kele gele jyaat 105 lokani aple praan gamavle. Ha ladha hota 'Sanyukta Maharshtracha'. Maharashtracha itihastil kadhi hi na visrta yenari hi ghatna ahe. Nemaki ka zali hi chalaval? kay hote tyamagil uddesh? Aikuya, Samyukta Maharashtra Chalwalicha Jwalant itihas.

how-to-raise-a-successful-child-mix.title: How to raise a Successful Child
how-to-raise-a-successful-child-mix.description: Koi bhi baccha ek baar mein sab kuch nahi seekhta. Use baar baar situation ke hisaab se cheezein seekhani padti hain. Yahi cheezein bacchon ko zindagibhar seekhane mein parents mein patience ki Khas zaroorat hoti hai. Agar parents mein patience ki kami hogi to bahut high possibility hai ki bacche mein bhi patience nahi hoga. Jiska asar uski aane wali zindagi par pad sakta hai. Ek successful bacche ko bada karne ke liye aisi aur bhi kayi baaton ka dhyan maa-baap ko rakhna padta hai, jiski charcha is audiobook mein ki gayi hai. Aaiye is audiobook ko sunein, seekhein aur isse laagu karein.

kailasam-the-myth-and-mystery.title: Kailasam: The Myth and Mystery
kailasam-the-myth-and-mystery.description: Nammude puranangalil ettavum thalayeduppode nilkkunna bhoomikayanu Kailasa Parvatham. Himalayan malanirakalil ettavum pavithramayi kanakkakkappedunnath. Hindu mathathil Shivante vaasasthalam aayanu kailasam kanakkakkappedunnath. Buddha, Jaina mathangalkkum Kailasam punnya sthalam thanne. Kailasa parvathathinte ettavum uyarnna bhagangalil parvatharohakarkk ithuvare ethicheran sadhichittilla. Athrayum dushkaramanath. Kelkkam Kailasathinte kadha.

option-trading-1.title: Options Trading Guide
option-trading-1.description: Stock Market trading la adhigamaana panam sambaathikka udhavura oru arumaiyaana vazhi intha ‘Options Trading’, aanaa itha aduthavanga kodukkura advise &  tips sa mattum nambi seirathu buthisaalithanam kedaiyaathu ! muzhumaiyaa purinjukittu naamale seiyanum, appo thaan namakku nalla laabam kedaikum. Intha Audiobook la Options Trading ga puriyura maathiri elimaiyana muraila, eduthukkaattugaloda explain pannirukkaanga. Vaanga kathukittu kaasu paakalaam !

nehru-cursed-family.title: The Gandhi Family Curse
nehru-cursed-family.description: Kehte hai jo jitna upar hota hai, girne par, utna zyada jor girta hai. Kuch aisa hi hua Gandhi Parivaar ke sath, jo Indira Gandhi ke pradhanmantri banane par bahut upar gaya, phir ek ke baad ek ghatnao aur durghatnaon se ghira hi raha. Bahut se log ise kisi shraap ka asar maante hai ki pehle Indira ke pati Feroze, phir pita Nehru ki mrityu hogayi. Par ye ghatna durghatna ka silsila yahi nahi ruka, isne Sanjay, Indira, aur Rajeev tak ki jaan le li. Kya in durghatnaon ka aapas mein hai koi connection? Kya sachmuch shaapit hai Gandhi parivaar? Agar aapko "India after Gandhi" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

dr-apj-abdul-kalam-7.title: Dr APJ Abdul Kalam
dr-apj-abdul-kalam-7.description: Yuvakkalod Swapnam kananum athinu vendi prayathnikkanum aahwanam cheyyukayum prachodippikkukayum cheytha oru Rashtrapthi Indiayk undayirunnu. India kanda ekkalatheyum mikacha prathibhashalikalil oral. Mikacha Misile sankethika vidagdanum engineerum aayirunnu adheham. Tamilnattile Rameshwarathe sadharana kudumbathil janicha adhehathinte jeevitha yathra aarkkum prachodanavum padapusthakavum aanu. Rajyathinte vikasanathekkurichum nalathe thalamurayekkurichum vishaalamaya kazhchappadukal undayirunna thatwachindakanum adhyapakanum koodiyayirunnu adheham.

how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.title: How to Make Money with Breakout Trading
how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.description: Share Marketil laabham nedan ashtapedunnundo ningal? Breakout Trading enna lalithamaya thanthram parichayapedu. 'How to Make Money with Breakout Trading'  enna audio book ee sankethika vidhyaye kurach vishadhamayi padipikkunnu.

main-hindu-kyu-hun.title: Main Hindu Kyun Hoon
main-hindu-kyu-hun.description: Member of Parliament aur apni high profile english ke liye famous Dr Sashi Tharoor dwara likhi gayi yeh book aapko batayegi Sanatan ke roots. Kyu murti pooja Hinduism ka ek abhinn ang hai, kis tarah Sanatan Dhrama alag hai Abrahamic religions se. Kis tarah dharma parivartan sanatan ka part nahi hai. Kyu Abrahamic religions aur Hinduism main hai bahut bada antar aur yeh antar kaisa hai? In sab, baaton ko jaanane ke liye suniye yeh audiobook " Main Hindu Kyun Hoon " sirf KUKU FM par.

the-oath-of-the-vayuputras.title: வாயுபுத்ரர் வாக்கு : சிவா முத்தொகுதி - 3
the-oath-of-the-vayuputras.description:
சிவன், தன் படைகளைத் திரட்டத் தொடங்கிவிட்டார். நாகர்களின் தலைநகரான பஞ்சவடியை அடைந்தவுடன், தீமையின் உண்மையான சோரூபம், ஒரு வழியாக வெட்ட வெளிச்சமாகிறது. வீரர்களுக்கெல்லாம் வீரர்களாக விளங்குவோர் கூட நெஞ்சு பதறி, குலைநடுங்கும் ஒரு மனிதனுக்கெதிராக, அவரது உண்மையான விரோதிக்கு எதிராக, நீலகண்டர் புனிதப் போர் தொடங்க ஆயத்தமாகிறார்.

ஆழிப்பேரலையைப் போலத் தொடர்ந்து மூழ்கடித்துத் தாக்கும் பல கொடூரப் போர்களால் இந்தியா நிலை தடுமாறுகிறது; தவித்துத் தத்தளிக்கிறது. இந்தப் புனித தேசத்தின் ஆன்மாவைப் பாதுகாக்கும் முயற்சியில் நடக்கும் போராட்டங்களில், பலர் உயிரிழக்கப்போவது நிச்சயம். விலை எப்பேர்ப்பட்டதாக இருந்தாலும், இந்தப் போரிலிருந்து சிவன் பின் வாங்கக்கூடாது; பின் வாங்கவும் போவதில்லை. வழி தெரியவில்லை; பாதை புரியவில்லை. யாரை அணுகுவது? இதுவரை தனக்கு எவ்வித உதவியும் அளிக்காதவர்களையா? ஆயினும், சிவனுக்கு வேறு வழி தெரியவில்லை. இறுதியில், சிவன் சென்றடைகிறார் வாயுபுத்ரர்களிடம்.

அவரது முயற்சிக்கு வெற்றி கிட்டியதா? தீமையை அழிக்கும் பெரும் போராட்டத்தில் இந்தியா - ஏன், அவரது உள்ளம் - இன்னும் எதையெதையெல்லாம் விலையாகக் கொடுக்க வேண்டியிருக்கும்?

விற்பனையில் சாதனை படைத்த சிவா முத்தொகுதியின் இந்த இறுதிப் பகுதியில், மேற்சோன்ன மர்மக் கேள்விகளுக்கெல்லாம் பதில்கள் காத்திருக்கின்றன... கேளுங்கள் வாயுபுத்ரர் வாக்கு...

anand-pal-2.title: Anand Pal Singh- Gangster Or Robinhood?
anand-pal-2.description: Anand Pal Singh, Nagaur jila ka ek aisa criminal tha, jise uski aakhiri sans tak police dhundti rahi, par jab wo mara toh massiah ho gaya. Ek aisa insaan jisne logo ko apni banayi jail mein tadpa tadpa kar maara hai, wo aaj uske marne ke baad logo ka Robinhood kyu bana hua hai? Ye kahani hai police ko ek nahi kayi baar chakhma dene wale, faratedaar angrezi bolne wale, jail se facebook par apna next plan ko batane wale, aur saj dhaj kar hat aur boots mein hi bahar aane wale Gangster ki- Gangster Anand Pal Singh ki.

netaji-subhash-ki-rahasyamaya-kahani.title: Netaji Subhash ki Rahasyamaya Kahani
netaji-subhash-ki-rahasyamaya-kahani.description: Yun to Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose ki maut 18 August 1945 mein, Bharat ko azadi milne se pehle hi ho gayi thi. Us dauran jab unki maut hui tab kayi aise raaz the, jinki sacchai duniya ke samne kabhi aa hi nahi paayi. Lekin agar itihaskaaron ki maane to Bose ki maut se jude kayi raaz hain, jinhe duniya ke samne kabhi laya hi nahi gaya. Is audiobook ko sunne ke baad un sabhi raazon par se parda uthana aapke liye aasan ho jayega. Aur Bose ki maut ka rahasya aapke samne hoga. Aaiye ise sunte hai.

psychological-aspects-of-students-suicid.description: Entha oru problem kume Suicide oru solution aah irukkave mudiyaathu. Ipolaam Students suicide athigamaave nadakkuthu. thanthai-periyar-2.description: Thanthai Periyar ennu oru janatha muzhuvan ennum aradhanayode visheshippikkunna Erode Venkatappa Ramaswamyude jeevitham varanirikkunna oro thalamurayum arinjirikkendathu aanu. how-beauticians-can-start-online-home-se.description: Badalte daur mein aaj kal sabhi ko har service ek click mein chahiye. the-things-you-can-see-only-when-you-slo.title: Why You Need To Slow Down?
the-things-you-can-see-only-when-you-slo.description: Kya aap bhi har faisala zaldibaji mein karte hain? Kya aapko bhi duniya ki race mein peeche chhoot jane ka dar satata hai? how-to-save-yourself-from-recession-in-2.description: Global level se lekar India ke har kone tak ek hi baat ho rahi hai "Recession 2023", aakhir kya hoga is recession mein? Kya ye aam aadmi par aayega ya sirf global level par hi reh jaayega? Aur kya hai is Recession ka ilaaj? In saare sawalon ka jawaab aapko "How To Save Yourself From Recession In 2023" show me milega. To chaliye shuru karte hain.

basics-of-stock-market.title: My Love affair with the Share Market
basics-of-stock-market.description: Share market la invest pannanumnu sonnale, namma makkal neraya per "namakku ethukku thevai illatha vambu" nu yosikiraanga. But Shares la invest panrathula niraya benefits irukku. Nammala guide panna oru nalla mentor irunthaa kandippa nammalum shares la invest pannalaam. Ungalukkana appadi patta guide aah intha Audiobook irukkum. Share market oda basics ah intha pathivu moolama kathukonga.

how-to-choose-your-career.title: Apne Career Ke Boss Bano
how-to-choose-your-career.description: Kya aap khud ke liye ya apne bachhe ke liye ek achhe career ki talash mein hain? Ek aisa career jiske raaste par chalne ke baad kabhi regret na ho? Toh abhi is audiobook ko suniye aur apne dream career ko select kar lijiye. Ye audiobook naye-puraane, har tarah ke careers ke liye ek ultimate guide hai jismein har field ki detailed information ke sath usmein safalta hasil karne ka roadmap hai. Yaad rakhiye sahi career selection yaani successful future ki guarantee.

pcod-ar-pcos-er-somoshya-thek-sohojei-mu.title: PCOD Ar PCOS Er Somoshya Theke Sohojei Mukti Paan
pcod-ar-pcos-er-somoshya-thek-sohojei-mu.description: PCOS ba PCOD ashole ki?  Kader jhuki beshi ebong niramoy e ba ki kore shombhob? Ki ki red alert dekhe bujhte ba jante parbe je tomaro ba tumi PCOS/ PCOD r shikar? Keno meye der modhyei ei roger dekha pawa jaye. Ar ki bhabe er haath theke mukti pawa shombhob ei shob bishoy niye aj shune nao ei audio story te.

power-of-your-subconscious-mind-2.title: Subconscious Mind and It's Power
power-of-your-subconscious-mind-2.description: మనం నిద్రించి ఉన్నప్పుడు మనకు కలలు ఎందుకు వస్తాయి? మనం ఎందుకు కలవరిస్తాము? ఒక చోట ఉంటూ, ఎక్కడికో మన మనసుని ఎలా తీసుకువెళ్తాము? రండి తెలుసుకుందాం.

drug-sex-dhokha.title: Drugs, Sex aur Dhokha
drug-sex-dhokha.description: Bollywood ki sabse badi actress Isha Khanna ko ek fake drug case mei fansane ke baad, Krishna Kapoor apne bete Aryan Kapoor ka badla poora karta hai. Lekin is jhoothe case se Isha ko bachaane ke liye Karan Khanna ek deewar ban kar, Kapoor family aur Shekhar Singh Shekhawat se ladta hai. Kya hoga aage ? Jan'ne ke liye suniye Ye kahani.. Sirf Kuku FM Par !

jallianwala-bagh-massacre-1.title: Jallianwala Bagh Massacre
jallianwala-bagh-massacre-1.description: April 13, 1919 na Jallianwala Bagh meedha maranahomama jarigindi. Entho mandhi Magavallani, Adavallani, akariki chinna  pillalu ani kuda chudakunda nirdhaksanamga champesaru, ee maranahomam Chesindi Colonel Reginald Dyer. Asalu ee maranahomaniki mukhya karanam enti,  deeni venukuna asalu kadha enti telusukondi ee audiobook vini.

srinivasa-ramanujan-an-inspiring-story.title: Srinivasa Ramanujan: An Inspiring Story
srinivasa-ramanujan-an-inspiring-story.description: India lokathinu sambhavana nalkiya prathibhakalude koottathil ettavum aadyamaanu Sreenivasa Ramanujan enna ganitha shaastrajnante sthanam. Pradhamika vidhyabhyasam polum parimithamaya kalath Tamil Nattile Erodile daridra kudumba chuttupadil ninnu ganithathinte athi sangeernnamaya lokathek swaprayathnathal nadannu chenna prathibhaasam aanu adheham. Swantham passionu pinnale paayunna ethoru aalkkum paada pusthakam aanu ee athulya prathibhayude jeevitham.

dont-make-new-year-resolution.title: Don't Make New Year Resolution
dont-make-new-year-resolution.description: Naye saal ke saath nayi umeedein judi hoti hai aur un umeedo ki shuruaat hoti hai ek "New Year Resolution" se, lekin kya ek resolution kaafi hota hai nayi shuruaat ke liye ya ye baatein sirf naye saal ke josh me keh di jaati hai? Humare show "Don't Make New Year Resolution" mein aap janenge ki aap kaise bina naye saal ka intezaar kare, apne liye ek nayi shuruaat kar sakte hain is show me bataye gaye lessons ki madad se. To chaliye shuru karte is safar ko.

shakuntalam.title: Shakuntalam
shakuntalam.description: Vyasa Bhagavanudu Rasina  ‘Panchamavedam’ loni Adiparvam Adharanga Mahakavi Kalidasu Rasina Abhignana Shakuntalanni Anusaristhu Sage Ee Katha Yugalu Marina CHeragani Premakatha. Bharatuni Talli, Dushyantha Maharaju Bharya, Vishwamitrudu,Menaka la Putrika, Kanva Maharshi Dattha Putrika Shakuntala Jeevithamlo Jarigina Aneka Sanghatanalanu Ee Audio Book Prasthavinchadam Jarigindi.

kom-betone-kivabe-sukhi-jibon-kataben.title: Kom Betone Kivabe Sukhi Jibon Kataben?
kom-betone-kivabe-sukhi-jibon-kataben.description: Aapnar Hoyto Beton Khub Samanyo Kintu Khoroch Kore Felchen Onek. EMI Theke Shuru Kore Maser Nana Khuntinati Kaje Beriye Jacche Sob Taka. Khub Dushchintay Din Katche. Khunje Cholchen Ei Kom Betone Kivabe Sukhi Thakte Parben Tar Upay. Aapnar Ei Dushchinta Dur Korte Kuku Fm Niye Eseche Ei Bisesh Audio Show, Ja Apnake Jante Sahajyo Korbe Kivabe Kom Betone Sukhi Thaka Jay Tar Upaygulo. Nishchoi Jante Icche Korche Sei Upaygulo? Tahole Aar Ektuo Somoy Nosto Na Kore Mon Diye Purota Shune Nin Ei Audio Show Ebong Khnje Pan Kivabe Kom Betone Sukhi Jibon Katano Jay Tar Upaygulo.

iit-se-ias-tak.title: IIT se IAS Tak
iit-se-ias-tak.description: Bihar ka rehne wala Ara ka topper Ankur Thakur, jiska sapna hai IIT. Uske paas fees bharne ke paise nahi they, sirf thi gareebi aur mushkile, fir bhi IIT ki preparation ke liye wo Kota ja pahuncha. Par jab beemari, aur pita ki maut ke karan usey wapas ghar jana pada to wo pahunch gaya Jail. Pyaar, dhokha aur dam todti khwaishon se sangharsh kar raha Ankur kya kar payega apne sapno ko pura? Janne ke liye sune IIT Se IAS TAK: Khwaison Ka Safar. Sirf Kukufm Par.

price-action-trading-5.title: Price Action Trading
price-action-trading-5.description: 'Price Action Trading' apdingra Indha trading technique Stock market la nastam adaiyaama risk management pannavum, Laabam Sambaathikkavum ungalukku useful la irukum ! Price Action Trading pathina anaithu visayangalaiyum practical examples moolam intha book solli kodukkuthu. vaanga therinjikalam.

fifa.title: FIFA Scandals
fifa.description: Jab 2018 aur 2022 FIFA ki hosting rights Russia aur Qatar ko mile tab se hi FIFA shak ke daayre mein raha hai.Aur jab 2015 mein FIFA ke 7 officials ko corruption ke charges mein arrest kiya gaya toh cheezein saaf hone lagi. Migrant labours ki maut se le kar homophobic comments tak bahut se daag hai FIFA World Cup par. Jaane kab aur kaise FIFA par lage corruption ke charges?

steve-jobs-4.title: Steve Jobs cha Success Mantra
steve-jobs-4.description: Udyog vishwatil Jadugar ashi olakh aslelya 'Steve Jobs' chi navyane olkh karun dyayla nako. Pan swatahch ek ''Brand'' mhanun navarupala yenya paryntcha steve cha pravas kasa hota, tumhala mahitye ka? Ya audio book dware apan Steve cha agdi Balpanapasun te World famous businessman honya parnytcha pavasa aiknar ahot. Steve ne pahileli Success, Failuers ya vishyi janun ghenar ahot. Aikuya, Steve Jobs cha 'Success Mantra'..

sontan-manush-korar-sohoj-upay.title: Sontan Manush Korar Sohoj Upay
sontan-manush-korar-sohoj-upay.description: Aj amra alochona korbo sontan manush korar kichu sohoj upay. Ki ei upay? Adou ki kono sohoj upay ache sontan manush korar? Ki ki badha bipotti perote hoi sontan manush korte giye? Shey konya sontan hok ba putro sontan. Ki ki kora uchit sontan der kotha mathaye rekhe? Ki korle maa baba der kaj ektu holeo sohoj hoye othe. Aj shei shob bishoy ei audio story te amra shune nebo.

dosa-murder-case.title: Dosa Murder: Adhure Sach Ki Puri Kahani
dosa-murder-case.description: Saravana Bhawan ka Dosa toh hum sabhi ne khaya hoga, lekin kya us Dosa ke peeche ke Dosa King ki Kahani jante hai aap? Agar nahi toh aaj is show mein hum apko batayenge Dosa King yaani ki Saravana Bhawan ke Malik P. Rajagopal ke bare mein. Ussi P. Rajagopal ke bare mein jiske andhvishwas ne unhe ek pal mein tycoon se criminal bana diya. Ek ladki se milne wale inkaar ko na seh pane par apne hi Dosa menu mein murder likhva diya. Aur apko batayenge ek aesi tasveer ka sach jo aapke agli bar Saravana Bhawan jane par apka dhyan jaroor kheenchegi.

kakatiya-samrajyam-1.title: Kakatiya Samrajyam
kakatiya-samrajyam-1.description: Telugu nelanu paripalinchina raja vamshalalo kakathiyulu pramukhulu. Warangal kendramga kakatiyulu rajya palana chesaru. Ide kalam lo modati Telugu padya kavyamga shrimadh andhra mahabharathanni kavithrayam Nannayya, Thikkana, Yerra pragada rasaru. Pratapa charithra, Kondaparthi shasanalu, Veyi sthambhala gudi mukhyamainavi.

the-subtle-art-of-intraday-trading-4.title: The Subtle Art Of Intraday Trading
the-subtle-art-of-intraday-trading-4.description: Stock Market la pala perukku puriyaatha puthiraa irukkura Intraday trading pathina pala nunukkangala thannoda pathu varusha experience la irunthu intha audiobook moolamaa namakkaaga kathu kodukkuraaru intha book ka ezhuthuna 'Indrazith Shantharaj'. Intraday trading moolamaa thodar laabam sambaathikka oru trader kandippaa therinjika vendiya pala mukkiyamana thagavalgal intha audiobook la irukku !. Vaanga Therinjukalam.

get-fit-from-fat-to-flat.title: Get Fit : Your Guide To Live Healthy Life
get-fit-from-fat-to-flat.description: Carrom ramvanu, juice pivanu, majja ni life. Par kya ek acchi aur fit life ke liye itna kaafi hai? Sirf juice, carrom aur kaam hi karte rahenge to fit kaise rahenge ? Fit rehne ki importance hum sab jante hai, par apne busy schedule mein, apni health ke liye time nahi nikal paate, par yeh audiobook aapko batayegi kuch aise tarike jisse aap fitness ki aur apna pehla kadam badha payenge, aur vo bhi apne schedule ko bina affect kiye

anandacha-theva.title: Anandi Ayushyache 7 Marga
anandacha-theva.description: Anandi asane yamage kahi Theory aahe ka? tar Ho. Apan Happy ka rahave? kase rahave? yachi kahi Tatve aahet. Positive asalyane dekhil Happy rahayla madat milate ase disun ale aahe. Apalya kamachya thikani, gharat, family madhe aapan anand kasa nirman karu shakto, Anandi ayushyache 7 marga konte? Aikuya ya khas show madhun...

siraj-1.title: Mohammed Siraj
siraj-1.description: Mohammad Siraj Biography Vinte Andariki Gunde Baruvekki potundi. Entho Pedarikam nundi Vachhina Mohammad Siraj Ippudu Tana Aata tho Yavathu Bharateeyula Manasulanu Geluchukunnadu. 150 kilometers Speed tho Bowling Cheyagalgina veerudu Siraj. Tinadaniki tindi leni rojula nundi , Auto Nadupukune Sthayi Nundi Present Indian Cricket Team lo fast Bowler gaa Edugutunna Mohammad Siraj Jeevitha charitra, Atani jeevithamlo Jarigina Adbutaalu, Inka Atani Pattudala Manalo Oka Inspiration ni Teesukuvastundi.

woh-awara-ladki.title: फरेब
woh-awara-ladki.description: Apne hi uncle ka murder kar Nazia pahuchati hai Shelter home. Jaha uski dosti hoti hai Kamla, Rajjo, Rukhsana aur Priya se. Aur ye sabhi Shelter home se bhag nikalti hai ! lekin Nazia pakdi jaati hai. Inka plan hai Murder karne ka !! lekin kiska? Akhir kyu Shelter Home se bhagti hain ye 5 Ladkiyana? Inspector Chouhan kaise karenge is case ko solve? Janne ke liye sune puri kahani ! sirf Kuku FM par.

great-overseas-players-in-indian-cricket.title: Great Overseas Players In Indian Cricket League
great-overseas-players-in-indian-cricket.description: Indian Cricket League, enno deshala nunchi entho mandhi Cricket players ee league lo participate chestharu kani chaala mandiki videshi atagalla gurinchi telidu anduke memu meekosam ee audiobook ni tesukoni vachamu, inkenduku alasyam ventane vinandi.

வாழ்ந்தால்-உன்னோடு-தான்-மான்சி.title: வாழ்ந்தால் உன்னோடு தான் மான்சி
வாழ்ந்தால்-உன்னோடு-தான்-மான்சி.description: தன்னைப் படிக்கவைத்துக் காப்பாற்றிய தன் முதலாளியின் மகன் மீது காதல் வயப்படுகிறாள் மான்சி.  நாயகன் சத்யனிடம் பரிபூரண காதலை எதிர்பார்க்கிறாள் மான்சி. ஆனால், ஊதாரியாகத் திரியும் நாயகனோ அவளை அடைய நினைத்து சபலம் கொள்கிறான். வெவ்வேறு நோக்கத்துடன் இருவருக்குள்ளும் நிகழும் இந்தக் காதல் போட்டியில் வென்றது ஏழைப் பெண்ணின் காதலா? இல்லை பணக்கார வாலிபனின் திமிரா? வாழ்ந்தால் உன்னோடு தான் மான்சி! எனும் இந்தக் காதல் கதையை குக்கூ எப்.எம்.ல் கேட்டு மகிழுங்கள்.

unusual-villages-of-india.title: Unusual Villages of India
unusual-villages-of-india.description: Bharat Gaanvon ka desh hai jahan 80% se zyada abaadi gaanvon mein hi rehti hai. Lekin kya aapne kabhi kisi aise gaanv ke baaare mein suna hai jahan sab judwa hon? Ya, fir sab crorepati hon? Agar nahi to yeh audiobook aap ke liye hai. Suniye "Unusual villages of India" yaani bharat ke ajeebo gareeb gaanv sirf KukuFM par.

bhagavad-gita-11.title: Bhagavad Gita
bhagavad-gita-11.description: Bhagavad Gita.. Kurukshetra sangramamlo Arjunu thana vaallani ela edurkovaali ane samshayam lo unnappudu sakshatthu Shri Krishna paramathmudu Parthuniki chesina hithabodhane Geeta. Thna karthavyaanni mathram nirvarthinchamani phalitham gurinchi alochinchakudadani, manava mathrulantha nimittha pathradarulenani asalu suthradari thane ani Krishnudu Arjunudiki chesina bhodane Bhagavad Gita.

humans-vs-robots.title: Robots VS Humans
humans-vs-robots.description: Digital yug me hum har din ek technology shift dekhte hain jo roz khud apne aap ko behtar bana rahi hai. Einstein, Stephen Hawking, Elon Musk, Google ke researchers ka kehna hai ke Artificial intelligence yani Robots ka dimag insan ka sabse bada dushman hai. Chaliye sunte hain Insaan ke sabse bade dushman ki kahani aur kaise karega wo insaano ki jobs, career aur humanity ka THE END.

subtle-art-of-intraday-trading.title: The Subtle Art of Intraday Trading
subtle-art-of-intraday-trading.description: Intraday Trading Maata Vinagane Andariki Gurthuvache oka padam cheppamani adigithe vaaru “Dabbu” leda Bhayam antaru. Day Trading lo Dabbu Sampadinchadam Antha Easy Aithe Andaru Adey chesevaaru Nijam cheppalante Intraday trading lo entha dabbu vastundo… Anth Risk untundi. But Indulo Success Avvalante Stalble Practice and techniques Undali. Ippudu Ee Audiobook lo Intraday Trading Techniques gurinchi telsulusukondi.

noboborsher-sekal-ekal.title: Noboborsher Sekal, Ekal
noboborsher-sekal-ekal.description: Noboborsho manei nobo jagoroner pala. Noboborsher shuru manei bangali der notun bochhorer shuru/agomon. Ei utsav amader bangali der kache Durga Pujor theke kono ongshei kom noi. Jemon puro bharatbashi der kache New Year thik temoni Bangali der kache Poila Baisakh ba Noboborsho. Notun jama theke shuru kore shob kichui notun kinte ichey kore amader bangalider nijeder samortho onujayi. Toh kemon chilo aage kar ba sekaler Noboborsho udjapon? Ar ekhoni ba kemon bhabe amra udjapon kori Noboborsho. Ashun shune newa jak aj ker audio story Noboborsher Sekal, Ekal ebong apnadero Noboborsho shuro Kuku Fm diye.

how-to-start-food-business-at-home.title: How To Start Food Business At Home
how-to-start-food-business-at-home.description: Sochiye agar hum maa ke haath ka swadisht khana banane ke hunar ko business mein badal de to? Ghar baithe baithe hum apna business kar payenge. Bas ek Chhota sa effort, ek badhiya business plan, food ki acchi quality, achi managing skills aur kuch chhoti chhoti baaton ko dhyan mein rakhna hoga, jise hum discuss karenge is audio book mein jo aapki madad karega apna khud ka home based food business shuru karne mein

pregnancy-notes.title: Pregnancychya Adhi Darmyan Ani Nantar Kay karava
pregnancy-notes.description: Masikpali suru jhalyapasun te ticha shevat mhanjech menopause paryanta mahilyancha ayushat sharaik manasik badal hot astat. Ya series madhye strichya masik pali pasun, pregnancy madhye ani nantar  tasach menopause darmyan kay kay baddal hotat ani tyala kasa deal karyacha hey tumhala sangnar ahot.

how-to-rebuild-yourself-1.title: How To Rebuild Yourself?
how-to-rebuild-yourself-1.description: Jeevithathil pala veezhchakalum sambhavikkumbol jeevitham avasanippikkananu palappozhum namuku thonnarulathu. Ennal veezhchayil ninnu shakthamayi uyarthezhunelkkuka aanu satyathil nammal cheyendathu. Athu thanneyanu swayam nalkan kazhiyunna ettavum valiya sammanavum. Ennal enganeyanu athu sadhyamavuka? Athariyanaayi kelkku, 'How to Rebuild Yourself?' enna show.

game-game-boom-boom-1.title: Game Game Boom Boom
game-game-boom-boom-1.description: "Game Game Boom Boom" kahani hai Suryav Rathor ki jo ek doosre Surayav Rathor ke jism mein pravesh kar jati hai. Suryav- jo paida toh ladki ki tarah hui thi, par usko kisi ladke ki tarah pala gaya tha. Is soul swap ke baad logon ke saamne ek nayi Suryav aati hai, jise dekhkar saari ladkiyon ke hosh ud jaate hain. Nayi Suryav sirf dikhne me hi smart nahi hai balki ek professional hacker bhi hai aur gaming ki duniya se bhi achchi taraf se waqif hai. To jab wo Force ban kar gaming ki duniya mein kadam rakhti hai to uska samna hota hai Shivay se. Shivay gaming ki duniya ka betaj badshah tha aur suryav ko dekhkar wo bhi hairan reh jata hai. Kya Suryav ki asliyat samne aa payegi? Kya Suryav aur Shivay mein takrav hoga? Kya Suryav aur Shivay ki mulakat ek naya rang layegi? Janane ke liye sunate rahein Game Game Boom Boom, sirf KukuFm par.

vishu-charithravum-kadhakalum.title: Vishu - Charithravum Kadhakalum
vishu-charithravum-kadhakalum.description: Naadu niraye konna poothu oru Vishuvine koodi varavelkkukayanu. Vishuvine kurich namukkellavarkkum ariyam ennal vishuvinu pinne vishwasangale kurichum aitheehyathe kurichum sarvopari ee aaghoshathinte charithrathe kurichum ariyan ellavarkkum thalparyam kanum. Alle? Enkil ee varshathe Vishu aaghoshikunathinu munp, nammude Kuku FMle 'Vishu- Charithravum Kadhakalum' enna show kelku, Vishu enna aaghoshathinte charithram aazhathil manasilaaku.

jallianwala-bagh-massacre.title: Jallianwala Bagh Massacre
jallianwala-bagh-massacre.description: 1919 April 13 - Indiakku marakkanakatha dhinam aanu. Indian swathanthra samara poraatta charithrathile ettavum karutha adhyayamanu Jallianwala Bagh koottakola. Nirayudharaya purushanmarum sthreekalum kuttikalum ulpade niravathi per Britishkarude vedivaipil marichu veenu. Niravadhi varshangalum samarangalum ellam kadannu poittum Jalianwala Bagh innum oru Karutha ormayayi Indiakarude manassil avasheshikkunnu. Raktha rookshithamaya ee koottakolayude charithrathe kurich ariyam ee showiloode.

gujrat-ki-gaddi.title: Gujarat Ki Gaddi: 1960 Se 2022 Tak Ki Chunavi Kahani
gujrat-ki-gaddi.description: 1960 mein Bombey toota to bane Maharashtra aur Gujarat. Vahi Gujarat jo Mahama Gandhi aur Sardar Patel jaise logon ki janmbhoomi hai. To Kya hai iski Politics? Kaise yahan se nikaale gaye do neta “Narendra Modi” aur “Amit Shah” desh ke sarvochh padon par pahunche? Kyu Indira Gandhi ko isi Gujarat ne lohe ke chane Chabwa diye the? Aur kaise bana industry hub? Sab batane ke liye Kuku FM le aaya hai Gujarat Ki Gaddi: 1960 Se 2022 Tak Ki Chunavi Kahani”.

how-to-prevent-heart-attack-1.title: Heart Attack kasa talaycha?
how-to-prevent-heart-attack-1.description: Mitrano, Alikade Heart attack cha praman vadhat challay ashi charcha apan karto. Pan aplya Heart la Healthy thevnyasathi apan pramanik praytna karto ka? Heart attack alyawar upchar karnya peksha to yeuch naye mhnun apan khabrdari ghyayla havi. Aplya Hrudyachi kalji kashi ghyavi, Apla Arogya kasa japawa, Hrusay vikarana door kasa thevava ya vishyicha Tips apan janun ghenarot ya khas Show madhun...

chatbots-vs-humans.title: Chatbots Vs Humans
chatbots-vs-humans.description: Meeku Chatbot ante telusa? Deenini enduku vadathaaro telusa? Chaala mandhiki idi ento telidu kani meeku oka nammaleni nijani cheppalante ranuna rojullo idhi manushulni ani rangaalalo replace chesthundi ante nammuthara. nijamenandi idhi ranuna rojullo manushulni replace chesthundi,Ippudu kuda deenini aneka rangalalo vaduthunaaru, assalu idhi enti, enduku vadathaaru ani alochistunara aithe meeru ee audiobook vinalsindhe.

doglapan-the-hard-truth-about-life-and-s.title: Doglapan: The Hard Truth about Life and Start-Ups
doglapan-the-hard-truth-about-life-and-s.description: “Doglapan” apdi naa Paasaanguthanam nu artham ! Paasanguthanamaana manithargal la kadanthu vetri petra thannoda vazhkai kathaiya intha book moolam namakku solraru “Ashneer Grover”. Vazhkaiya pathi na thelivaana paarvaiyai yum, Avaroda Startup, Entrepreneurship, Business sambanthamaana anubavangalai yum namakaga intha book la solraru Ashneer. Nija Vazhkai Karpanai Kathaigala vida visithiramanathu ! nu solvanga, Ashneer Vazhkaiyum apdithaan nga !  Hero, Heroine , Villain, Ethirpaaraatha Twist nu Intha kathai oru cinima paakura feel la iruku ! Vaanga Avaroda kathai ya kekalam !

guatam-budh-main-sanyasi-nahi.title: Gautam Buddha: Main Sanyasi Nahi
guatam-budh-main-sanyasi-nahi.description:
Hamesha ahinsa aur karuna ka bhav sikhane wale, Bodh Dharm Ki sthapna karne wale Mahatma Gautam Buddha ne kaise kiya tha is gyan ko hassil?
Kaisa tha Gautam Buddha ka bachpan? Aur aisa kya tha jisne unhe moh aur maya se upar uthne ke leye prerit kiya? Gautam Budh ki rakhi gayi Buddhism ki neev kaise apki zindagi badal sakti hai, janne ke liye, Sunein Gautam Buddha: Main Sanyasi Nahi. Agar aapko Buddha's Brain jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

chera-dynasty.title: Chera Dynasty
chera-dynasty.description: Chera rajyathinte vyapthi ippozhum poornamayi paryavekshanam cheyyan charithrakaranmarkk kazhinjittila. Sathyathil Chera rajakanmarude mahathwam enthanu? Chola Rajakanmar valare aaghoshikkapedumbol, Cheranmarude prathapam enthukond adhikam charcha cheyyappedunnilla? Vishadhamayi kelkaam ee showiloode.

hanuman-chalisa-marathi-meaning.title: Shree Hanuman Chalisa- Marathi artha
hanuman-chalisa-marathi-meaning.description: Hanuman Chalisa mahit nahi asa mhannara manus milna jara kathinch. Pan aplyapiki kiti janana Hanuman Chalisa cha Khara artha mahitye? Hanuman chalisa Tulsidasani ka lihila, Tyatun tyana aplyala kay sandesh dyaycha hota, Hanuman chalisatil dohe aplya Ayushyat kase faydeshir thartat. ya vishayi aikuya ya khas show madhun. Aikuya, Hanuman Chalisa Marathi arthasahit.

the-mom-test.title: Kya Aapka Idea Accha Hai?
the-mom-test.description: Hamare dimag mein har din na jaane kitne ideas aate hai aur hum decide nahi kar paate ki wo ideas wakai acche hai ya nahi. Toh hum unhe wahi chhod dete hai ya fir kisi aise idea par kaam karte hai jo shayad accha nahi saabit hota. Magar kya hum in ideas ko test kar sakte hain? Apne customers se kaise baat ki jaaye jisse wo hamare product ke saath loyal rahein? Janenge aise kai sawalon ke jawab is show mein.

hanuman-chalisa-12.title: Hanuman Chalisa
hanuman-chalisa-12.description: Hanuman Ji Holen Gyaner Sagar. Tar Aaradhona Korle Jibone Onek Shanti Payoya Jay. Tar Aaradhonar Onyotomo Ekti Pontha Holo Honuman Chalisa Path Kora. Biswas Rekhe Honuman Chalisa Path Korle Sob Sonkot Mochon Hoye Jay Bole Mone Kora Hoy. Kuku Fm Niye Eseche Honuman Chalisar Sarkotha. Ei Sarkotha Shunle Aapni Jante Parben Honuman Chalisar 40 Ti Pongtir Mane Bistaritovabe Tao Aabar Bangla Vashay. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Nin Ebong Khuje Pan Jiboner Shantir Poth.

effective-communication-skills.title: Effective Communication Chya Tips
effective-communication-skills.description: Mitrano, Prabhvi Bolane he ek skill aahe. Nuste bolne upyogache naste tar Nemake kaay bolave, Kadhi bolave ani apala mudda kassa mandava, he shikana khup garjecha asta. Prabhavi Sanvadachi sutre hya series madhun apan ya vishayich savistar mahiti janun ghenar aahot. Aika, Effective communication cha Easy tips aplya Kuku FM war.

epic-content-writing.title: Win more Customers by Less Marketing
epic-content-writing.description: Aaj ke zamane mein marketing sirf business ki nahi hoti, humein apne aap ko bhi market karna padta hai tab jaake humein serious liya jata hai. Is naye daur mein sirf marketing kaafi nahi, ab content marketing ke bina har marketing adhoori hai. Magar kya hai ye content marketing? Kaise iski madad se zyada customers attract kiye jaa sakte hain? Chaliye jaante hai.

love-marriage-naki-arrange-marriage.title: Love Marriage Naki Arrange Marriage
love-marriage-naki-arrange-marriage.description: Ekta Somoy Chilo Jokhn Prem Kore Biye Koreche Shunlei Somaje Lokjon Onyo Chokhe Dekhto. Kintu Somoy Joto Egiyeche Ei Byparta Puropuri Na Komleo Onektai Komeche. Ekhon Love Ebong Arrange Duto Biyer Khetre Palla Pray Soman Soman. Ebar Proshno Holo Biyer Er 22 Goj E Egiye Ke? Kon Biyete Somporko Beshi Din Tike Jay? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Uttor Jante Aapnake Mon Diye Shunte Hobe Ei Audio Show.

babas-and-indian-politics.title: Babas And Indian Politics
babas-and-indian-politics.description: Baba jisne England ki ek neta se kaha ki tum Prime Minister banogi aur aisa hua bhi. Ek aur Yogi jo hathiyaron ki factory chalata tha lekin police ne use kabhi nahi pakda. Aisa kya tha in dono baba ke pas? Kaun sa tantra- mantra tha jisse desh ke Prime Minister bhi har baat mein inki salah lete the. Ek baba ka naam Chandra Swami aur dusre ka “Dhirendra Brahmachari”. Dusron ki kundali batane wale in dono babaon ki poori kundali aapke samane le aaya hai “Kuku FM” is khas show mein.

pancha-pandavar.title: Pancha Pandavar
pancha-pandavar.description: Mahabhaaratham enna ithihasathile 5 sahodarangal aanu Pancha Pandavar. Kouravarude cheythikalaal raajyam vittu vanavaasathinu pokendi vannu oduvil kurukshetra yudhathil dharmathinayi poruthendi vannavar aanu Pandavar. Yudhishdiran, Arjunan, Bheeman, Nakulan, Sahadevan ennee 5 sahodaranmarude aithihasika jeevitha yathra namuk ee showyilude kelkkam.

small-habits-big-impact-1.title: Small Habits Big Impact
small-habits-big-impact-1.description: chinna maatrangal dhaan  vaazhkai la periya thiruppu munai ah kondu varum. Unga pazhakka vazhakkangala maathi life la periya vishyangala experience panna ready aagunga indha audio book ah kettu.

how-to-deal-with-toxicity-in-the-workpla.title: How to deal with Toxicity in Workspace?
how-to-deal-with-toxicity-in-the-workpla.description: Insaan shayad sab kuch jhel sakta hai, lekin ek toxic workplace uski zindagi barbaad kar sakti hai. Kya hote hain ek toxic workplace ke lakshan aur kaise aap isse bahar aa sakte hain jaanenge iss show ke zariye.

balance-sheet-explained.title: Balance Sheet : Explained
balance-sheet-explained.description: Business la irukravangalum, Stock Market la invest pannavangalum Balance sheet ta read pannavum, atha Analyze pannavum kandippaa kathukanum. Oru company ya profit ta run panradhukku indha balance sheet romba mukkiyam. Balance Sheet apdingra Indha complicated finance concept ta romba elimaya solli kudukura audio book Idhu. Idha Neenga Kathukkitteenga naa Unga Kudumba Kanakku valakka kooda Profit taa run Pannalam !

athisayangal-niraintha-manitha-udal.title: Athisayangal Niraintha Manitha Udal
athisayangal-niraintha-manitha-udal.description: Idhayam, Nurai eeral , Moolai, Ratham, Sathai , Narambu ippadi yeraalaamaana spare parts gal inanju uruvagi irukkum intha manitha udambu karpanaikku yettatha oru iyarkai athisayam. Manitha udalin athisayangal la alaga thoguthu solluthu intha audiobook. Aacharyamoottum Manitha udal la pathi therinjika intha audio book ka kelunga !

kasar-devi-ka-rahasya.title: Kasar Devi Ka Rahasya
kasar-devi-ka-rahasya.description: Uttarakhand desh ka aisa rajya hai jo khud main kai rahasya liye baitha hai. Shiv Bhagwan ke ghar se lekar maa parvati ka mayaka aur sasural sab yahin bataya jaata hai shayad isliye is rajya ko devbhoomi kehte hain. Aisa hi rahasya liye hai Almora ka ek chota sa mandir "Kasar Devi" jahan na jaane desh videsh ke kitne he celebrites ne aakar spritual gyan liya, yahan Swami Vivekanada aaye aur meditation ki, Bob Dylan ne apni best composition yahan aakar likhi, yahan par magnetic fields hone ka dawa kiya jata hai, kya hai is mandir aur jagah se juda rahasya suniye is KUKUFM exclusive audio series mein.

great-overseas-players-in-indian-cricket.title: Great Overseas Players in Indian Cricket League
great-overseas-players-in-indian-cricket.description: India voda Cricket thiruvizha intha Premier League thaan. Intha tournament la world cricket legends elaarume participate pannuvanga. Namma Indian Cricket Premier League la overseas players oda contribution pathiyum avanga senja records pathiyum thaan intha show la ketka poreenga.

2023-joint-entrance-prostuti.title: Joint Entrance Prostuti
2023-joint-entrance-prostuti.description: Shuru hote cholche bharaborshe kothino tomo porikhha gulor modhye ekti, JEE ba Joint Entrance Examination. Chhatro jibon ar career eke oporer poripurok. School jibone sothik career becche newa jekono chhatrer khetre khub e guruttopurno. Motamoti shobai class 9 er por thekei sobai becche nei tara ki niye poroborti somoy porashona korbe. Apnio ki engineering ba medical niye porashona korta chaan? Tahole apnakeo JEE porikkha e boste hobe, ebong ei porikkha e bhalo number rank korleo uccho sharir college/ university te apnio porte parben. Ei shob bishoy aro bistarito bhabe jante, prostuti porbo theke shuru kore baki motamoti shob jante shune nin ei audiostory.

share-bazar-mein-safal-kaise-hon.title: Share Bazar Mein Safal Kaise Hon
share-bazar-mein-safal-kaise-hon.description: Share Bazar covid ke baad se India mein ek naya Kamaai ka zariya ban gya hai, log Share Bazar ke bare mein padhne lage hain, janne ki koshish kar rahe hain. Lekin sahi jaankari ka source mil pana itna aasaan nahi hai hai, bahut se logo ko ismein bahut nuksan bhi hua hai, Share Bazar mein jitni kam jaankari aapko hogi Risk utna jyada hoga. Aapke Risk ko kam karte huye aapke profit ko badhane ke liye hum lekar aaye hai, “Share Bazar Mein Safal kaise hon” ki Full AudioBook, Jiske zariye aap bhi ek safal Investor ban payenge. Agar aapko The Intelligent Investor jaisi book pasand hai ye to audiobook aapko behad pasand aayegi.

how-to-sleep-better-1.title: How To Sleep Better
how-to-sleep-better-1.description: కమ్మటి నిద్ర సొంతం కావాలంటే ఏమి చెయ్యాలి? పడుకునే ముందు చెయ్యవలసిన పనులేంటి? పడక గది ఎలా ఉండాలి? హాయిగా నిద్రపోయేందుకు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోసం.

vasthu-shastram.title: Vasthu Shastram Prayojanalu
vasthu-shastram.description: మీరు ఇంటి నిర్మాణం చేసేటప్పుడు వాస్తు శాస్త్రం పాటిస్తున్నారా ? మన ఇల్లు కట్టే ప్రతి గోడకి వాస్తు అవసరం అని మీకు తెలుసా ? ఒకవేళ తెలియకపోతే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోససమే.!

exercised-the-science-of-physical-activi.title: Why Exercise
exercised-the-science-of-physical-activi.description: Agar baat zyada jeene ki ho, to, yeh wo chiz hai jahan hum duniyabhar ki tarakki karne ke baad bhi pahuch nahi paaye hain. Jabki purane samay mein na itni tarakki hui thi, na insaano ki lifestyle mein koi khaas growth thi. Phir bhi tab log 100-150 saal aaram se bina kisi bimari ke je lete the. Wajah thi unka har waqt active rehna. Lekin aaj ka humara lifestyle aisa hai ki humein 10 tarah ki pareshaniyan rehti hain. Toh aakhir hum apni lifestyle ko sudhaare kaise? Aaiye jante hai iss audiobook mein.

umran-malik.title: Umran Malik
umran-malik.description: Umran Malik chinna vayassulone oka goppa fast bowler ga edigina aatagadu, enno kastalu paddi eeroju mana indian cricket team lo sthanam dhakkinchukunadu. ee audio book lo meeru umran malik ee sthayiki ravadaniki enni kastalu paddadu, intha successful ga ela ayadu ila aneka vishayalu gurinchi meeru ee audio book lo vini telusukovachu.

how-to-start-content-writing.title: How To Start Content Writing
how-to-start-content-writing.description: Aaj ke time mein "Content Writing" ek growing career option hai jiski requirement har industry mein hai, "How To Start Content Writing" show aapko is field ki A to Z knowledge provide karega aur ek road map ki tarah is field se related har aspect ko clear karega. So agar aapka bhi dream career "Content Writing" hai to bina der kiye shuru karte hai. Agar aapko "Bird by Bird" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

jallian-walabagh-massacre.title: Jallian Walabagh Massacre
jallian-walabagh-massacre.description: April 13,1919 anniku Amristar la 379 appavi makkal irandhu ponanga. British General Dyer kudutha shooting order kaaranama palar gundu adi pattu, innum palar nerisal la sikki uyir ilandhanga. Rowlatt Sattam kondu vanthathuku edhiraa amaidhi porattam nadathiya makkal ku ipdi oru nelamai vara mukkiya karanam yaar? Therinjuka kelunga “Jallianwala Bagh Massacre'' on Kuku FM

evolution-of-indian-cricket-after-premie.title: Evolution Of Indian Cricket After Premier League
evolution-of-indian-cricket-after-premie.description: Indian Cricket Premier League nu shesham Indian cricket nu enthokke maatangalanu sambhavichathu? Cricket kuduthal janapiryam aakan Premier League enganeyellam sahayichu? enningane cricket ne kurichu ningal ariyan agrahikkunnathellam kelkku 'Evolution of Indian Cricket after Premier League' enna showilude.

break-toh-banta-hai.title: Break Toh Banta Hai
break-toh-banta-hai.description: Aap ko yaad hoga, school mein 4 lectures ke baad recess milti thi, yeh isliye kyuki humara brain kuch ghanto baad thak jata hai, aur uske liye focus kar pana mushkil ho jata hai. Par jab hum UPSC, IIT jaisi competitive exam ke liye prepare kar rahe hote hai tab breaks lena mushkil jo jata hai aur break ke bina focus karna pana mushkil ho jata hai. To kaise in dono ke bich balance banayein? Kaise effective break lein, jisse humara focus badhe aur hum acche se exam ke liye khud ko taiyaar kar sake, aaiye jante hai.

the-8020-principle-the-secret-to-achievi.title: The 80/20 Principle: The Secret To Achieving More With Less
the-8020-principle-the-secret-to-achievi.description: Kurachu prayathnam kondu kuduthal karyangal jeevithathil nedan sadhikkumennu paranjal ningalkku viswasikkan budhimuttu thonnum alle? Ennal kelkku, 'The 80/20 Principle: The Secret to Achieving More with Less' enna show

how-to-plan-your-monthly-budget.title: Monthly Budget kasa plan karal?
how-to-plan-your-monthly-budget.description: Mitrano, aplya basic garja purna karnya pasun te aplya vayktik haushi purna karnyaparynt garjecha asato to mhanaje paisa. Pan anekda he paishancha ganit bansvtana apli damchak hote. Tya sathi avshyak asta te Monthly budget palnning. Apli Kamai (Income) ani darmaha Kharcha (spendings) yanchi snagad kashi ghalyachi? Paishancha yogya Niyojan kasa karycha? Savings che uttam marga konte? ya saglya vishayi apan janun ghenar ahot 'Monthly Budget kasa plan karal' ya show madhun.

what-the-heck-do-i-do-with-my-life.title: Make Your Way To The Life You Deserve
what-the-heck-do-i-do-with-my-life.description: 20’s mein aate-aate life aur career ki jung shuru ho jaati hai lekin samajh nahi aata kya karein? kahan jayein? kaise career aur life mein settle ho jayein? Kya pados waale sharma ji ka beta jis company mein job kar raha hai vahin join karlein ya kuch aur try karein? Aise hazaaron sawal humare man mein roz aane lagte hain.Aise mein humein sach mein kya karna chahiye jisse hum success ke darwaaze ko khol sakein, inhi sab sawaalon ke jawab apko milenge is Original Show mein jise sunne ke baad aap apne career aur apni life ko aur achhe se samajh paayenge aur kya karna chahiye yeh bhi jaan paayenge. Chaliye chalte hain apni life ko behtar banane ke raaste par.

no-justice-no-peace-1.title: No Justice No Peace
no-justice-no-peace-1.description: Has the killing of George Floyd made any difference in America? Can Black people truly feel safe in the land of the free? Unfortunately, the grim reality is that police brutality and racial injustice still persist in the country. In this riveting series 'No Justice, No Peace', we delve into the heart-wrenching case of Patrick Lyoya and shed light on the urgent need for reform and accountability within law enforcement. Tune in and be a part of the conversation for change."

apali-lagna-sanstha.title: Love Marraige ki Arranged marriage
apali-lagna-sanstha.description: Shroteho, kunachya hi ayushyatali ek mahatvachi ghatana mhanje Lagna. Indian Cultural madh Lagnala far mahatva aahe. Bhartat anek dharm, jati ahet. Pratyek Dharma, Jatiche vegvegale Niyam ahet. Jag kiti hi badalale, pragat zale, tari pan lagn he nehmi paramparik padhatine kele jate. Hya show madhe janun gheu Lagna Kase Julate, kase Riti rivaj palale jatat ani Ak navin Kutumb kase tayar hote. Shroteho, Bhartiya Lagna Sanstha nehmich jagasathi kutuhalache karan banali aahe. Janun gheu tiche kahi tappe hya Show madhun...

1914-hil-gaya-british-raj.title: 1914: Hil Gaya British Raj
1914-hil-gaya-british-raj.description: Khudiram Bose aur Praful Chaki ki maut ke baad se hi Shirish ne thaan liya tha ki wo krantikariyon ke liye hathiyaaron ke ek bade jakheere ka intjaam karega taki angrejon se hone wali muthbhed mein unhe hathiyaaron ki kami ka samna na karna pade. Aur phir viceroy par hamle ke nakaam hone ke baad uska irada atal ho gaya tha. Shirish Paul ne Shirish Mitra ki madad se Rodda & Co. mein sendh lagane ki koshish ki. Kya Paul hathiyaaron ko lootne mein kamyab ho payega? Kya Calcutta CID ka main head Charles Tegart ek baar phir Shirish aur uske sathiyon ko nakamyab karne mein safal ho payega? Kya hoga jab aayenge Tegart aur Shirish Paul amne-samne? Inhi sab rochak aur sachchi ghatnaon ke baarein mein vistaar se janne ke liye sunein 1914: Hil Gaya British Raj.

periodically-speaking.title: Periodically Speaking
periodically-speaking.description: Periodically Speaking is an audio show that aims to de-stigmatize and promote period positivity. Hosted by the Minister of Menstruation (Candice Chirwa), this show explores the physical, emotional, social and political aspects of menstruation. Each episode, Candice and her guests discuss a different topic related to periods, from menstrual hygiene to menstrual activism, providing insights, tips, and strategies to help listeners feel empowered and informed about their bodies. With a focus on inclusivity and intersectionality, Periodically Speaking welcomes a diverse range of perspectives and experiences, creating a space for honest and meaningful conversations about menstruation. Tune in to join the movement towards period positivity and discover the power of menstrual health!

stay-healthy-and-happy-with-yoga.title: Stay Healthy and Happy with Yoga
stay-healthy-and-happy-with-yoga.description: Yun to Yoga aur hum Indians ka rishta sadiyon purana hai. Lekin modernisation ke chakkar mein hum sab ise kahin na kahin bhulte ja rahe hai. Jabki sahi maynon mein dekha jaaye to pehle Yoga ke zariye hi sabhi fit aur healthy rehte huye kayi saalon tak jeete the. Lekin agar aapko aisa lagta hai ki Yoga sirf ek age tak kiya jata hai, to aap galat hai. Is audiobook mein humne aise kayi aasan bataye hain jinhe koi bhi bade aaram se karke healthy aur happy reh sakta hai. Aaiye unhe kaise aur kyun karna hai use jante hai.

20-20-scandals-in-india.title: 20-20 Scandals In India
20-20-scandals-in-india.description: Cricket Khela Aamader Kache Besh Jonopriyo. Biswer Bohu Desh Ei Khelar Songe Jukto. Test, ODI, Twenty Twenty Muloto Ei 3 Format E Khela Hoye Thake. Kintu Bortomane Sob Theke Jonopriyo Format Holo Twenty Twenty. Kintu Bharotiyo Cricket Er Ekti Namkora Tournament E Emon Kichu Scandals Ghote Ja Kolusito Kore Bharoter Cricket Duniya Ke. Aar Ei Ghotonagulor Pichone Jara Aachen Tader Na Janle Ritimoto Chomke Uthte Hoy. Ki Sei Scandals? Kara Jukto Chilen Segulor Songe? Emon Kichu Proshner Uttor Jante Shune Nin Ei Audiobook.

how-to-maintain-relationships.title: How To Maintain Relationships
how-to-maintain-relationships.description: Ee rojullo technology chala developayindi, Maanava sambandaalu merugupadina kuda uda kutumba sambandaalu matram ksheeninchipotunnayi. Amma nannalanu Ashramamlo Pettadam. Bharya,barthala madya dooram pergadam. Pillalaku time ivvakapovadam ila roju rojuki kutumba sambandalu ksheeninchipotunnayi. Mari ee bandalanu tirigi kalupukupovadam ela ane vishayala gurinchi ee audio book lo cheppadam jarigindi.

mukti-bahini-2.title: Mukti Bahini
mukti-bahini-2.description: Apne pyar ki talash mein Binoy bina halaat ki chinta kiye purvi pakistan pahunch jata hai, jahan is samay yuddh jaise halat bane huye hain. Binoy Mukti Bahini ka hissa bankar purvi pakistan pahunchta hai aur is dauran use jung ka bhayanak roop dekhne ko milta hai. Binoy apne is safar mein har kadam par apne sathiyon ko khota ja raha hai. Kya Binoy apni Abha se kabhi mil payega? Kya Abha abhi bhi jinda hai? Kya, apne pyar ko khojta binoy RAW ya apne desh ke kisi kaam aa payega? Kya Binoy yuddh ke ant tak bach payega? Aise hi kayi sawalon ke jawab ke liye aur 1971 ke yuddh ki ansuni kahaniyon ke liye sunein Mukti Bahini.

luka-modric.title: Luka Modric
luka-modric.description: Croatiayudeyum Real Madridinteyum Madhyanirayil swarnathalamudiyumayi paari nadannu alannu muricha passukalumayi ethiralikale vattam karakkunna oru manthravadhiyund. Luka Modric. Nishkalankamaya mukhabhavamanenkilum ethri teamne nishprabham aakkunnathil dayarahithan aaya kalikkaran. Messiyum Ronaldoyum vaazhunna dashaabdathil thantethaya idam kandethi ithiha sthanam nediyedutha Luka Modric nte Kadha Kuku FMilude Kelkkam.

kerala-police-investigation-stories.title: Kerala Police Investigation Stories
