dev-ek-superstar-er-journey.description: Biswa cholchitrer jogote ek somoy Bangla cholochitra jayega kore niyechilo sundor golpo, bhalo porichalok, bhalo obhineta, obhinetrir gune. Ei Bangla cholochitra dekheche Mrinal Sen, Satyajit Ray, ritwik Ghatak er moto porichalokder, temon e peyeche Suchitra Sen, Supriya Devi Uttam Kumar, Soumitra Chattopadhyay er moto obhinetri, obhineta der. Ei bhalo somoy beshi din chilo na, Bangla cinema ek somoy mukh thubre porechilo, kintu dheere dheere tarpor sadharon manush abar shur kore Bangla cinema dekhte shuru koren, tar ek prodhaan karon Deepak Adhikary orfe sokoler Dev. Ke ei Dev? Ki kore holen sadharon manusher eto priyo? Ki ki bhabe nijer journey take toiri korlen? Loker pashe daralen? Ei shob jante shune nin ei audiobook ti.

geo-politics-1.title: Geo Politics
geo-politics-1.description: Oru Mellisana Kodu, idha thaandi neeyum vara koodadhu, nanum vara maaten nu ella naadugalum pakkathu naadu kooda sandai senjute dhan irukanga. Indha puvisaar nilam saarndha prechanai innum pala arasiyal sikkalgalukku vazhi seiyudhu. Vere mozhi pesunalum, vera kalaacharatha follow panravangala irundhalum ellarume nammala madiri manushanga dhane? Aprm yen indha sandai. Idhu naala yaaruku laabam? Therinjuka kelunga “Geo Politics” on Kuku FM

first-hindu-pm-of-britain-rishi-sunak.title: First Hindu PM of Britain - Rishi Sunak
first-hindu-pm-of-britain-rishi-sunak.description: 2022 ki Diwali ki sabse badi khabar ki ek Hindu bana Britain ka Prime Minister, lekin baat yahi khatam nahi hui sawaal utha ki akhir Rishi Sunak ek Indian hai bhi ya nahi? Is sawaal ka jawab aur Rishi Sunak ki inspirational kahani dono hi aapko is show mein sunne ko milegi. To chaliye shuru karte hai.

ugadi-panduga.title: Ugadi Panduga
ugadi-panduga.description: Chaitra Shudda Padyami prakruthi ramaneeyanga maare Vasantha kalam lo vachhe telugu samvatsarapu modati panduga. Ee rojuna Nakshatra gamanaanni Lekkachadam start Avutundi. Telugu  Vaariki Entho ishtamaina panduga , Edu ruchulu kaligina andamaina ee Ugadi Panduga Gurinchi Marinni Vishayalu Ee Audio Book lo Vinandi

the-80-minute-mba-everything-youll-never.title: The 80 Minute MBA: Everything You'll Never Learn at Business School
the-80-minute-mba-everything-youll-never.description: అన్నిటికి షార్ట్ కట్ అనేది ఉన్నట్టుగానే MBA కి కూడా షార్ట్ కట్ ఉంటుందా? బిజినెస్ లో రాణించాలనుకునే వారు ప్రతిఒక్కరు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాలి. ఇందులో రచయిత ఎన్నో ఉత్తమ టిప్స్ ని అందించారు.

how-to-manage-a-long-distance-relationsh.title: How to Manage a Long Distance Relationship?
how-to-manage-a-long-distance-relationsh.description: Kehte hain ki jab rishton ki jadein mazboot ho toh kisi tarah ki doori mayne nahi rakhti hai. Ye statement kis hadd tak sahi hai? Kya ye kaafi hai? Kya trust, insecurity, closeness par doori ka asar nahi padta? Relationship bas apne partners se nahi hoti, balki hamare parents, in-laws, friends se bhi hoti hai. Kaise rakhein in relationships ko doori ke bawajood bhi mazboot? Chaliye jaane. Agar aapko "The Seven Principles of Making Marriage Work" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

parayi-petta-panthirukulam.title: Parayi Petta Panthirukulam
parayi-petta-panthirukulam.description: Ella jaathi mathathil pettavarum thulyar aanennum ore chorayil ninnu piravi kondavar aanennum ulla mahathaya sandesham vilichothunna aithihyam aanu Parayipetta Panthirukulam. Vikramadithyante sadassile mukhya pandithan aaya Vararuchiykku Paraya samudayathilpetta bhaarya Panchamiyil undaya 12 makkal aanu Parayipetta Panthirukulam ennu ariyappedunnath. Ivar ellavarum thangalude mekhalakalil vidhagdharum visishtarum aayi. Maanavika moolyathe uyarthippidikkunna Panthirukulathinte kadha ee showyilude kelkkam.

udham-singh.title: For My Country: Sardar Udham Singh
udham-singh.description: Jallianwala Bagh mein hui rooh dehla dene wali ghatna se janme Sardar Udham Singh ne apni zindagi ke kai saal sirf aur sirf Britishers se apne desh Bharat ke badle me samarpit kar diye. Apne akhiri din tak unhone apni ankho ke samne se vo khaufnaak manjar jane nahi diya. “For My Country”  Punjabi Sikh Revolutionary Sardar Udham Singh ki puri dastan unhi ki jubaani aap tak leke ayi hai, sune aur jaane ki kese Sardar Udham Singh ne apne badle ko anjaam dete hue shaan se apni akhiri sans li.

how-cia-was-exposed-by-edward-snowden.title: How CIA Was Exposed By Edward Snowden?
how-cia-was-exposed-by-edward-snowden.description: Mun CIA agent aayirunna Edward Snowden enthinte perilaanu varthakalil niranjathennu ningalkku ariyamo? Thante rajyamaya America kku vendi aathmardhamaayi joli cheyyanamennu swapnam kandanu Edward Snowden CIA yude bhagamayathu. Ennal adhikam vaikathe thanne agency ude chila njettikkunna pravarthanangal adheham kandethi. Thudarnnu athu lokathinu munnil ethikkukayum cheythu. Eni orikkalum jenichu valarnna nattilekku pokan kazhiyilennu arinjittum adheham thante manasu paranjathinu kathorthu. Lokathe nadukkiya Edward Snowden nte velippeduthalukal enthokke anennu ariyan kelkku, 'How CIA was exposed by Edward Snowden? ' enna show.

kambar.title: Kambar
kambar.description: Namma Tamil makkal kitta Ramayanam ennum kaaviyathai kondu vanthu serthadhu Kambar dhan. Kambar oru padaipaali ah ramar, seethai, ravanan pondra kadhai maandhargala eppadi anugirukkar nu therinuka kelunga “Kambar” on Kuku FM

behad-2.title: Behad
behad-2.description: Bachpan me Eva ki aankhon ke samne uske parents ki goli maar kar hatya karne wale wo log aaj bhi Eva ki aankho me dushman ban kar nachte hain, aur isi trauma ki wajah se eva khel rahi hai apni hi zindagi se... magar Eva ko jaan se jayada chahne wala Ruhan uski safety ke liye kar leta hai usse shadi !! aur uske baad samne aata hai Ruhan ka ek aisa sach jisne Eva ke dil me laga di Ruhan ke liye ek nafrat ki aag!!  Kya hai ye sach? aur ab kya hoga inke salon purane pyar ka? Sunein Abhi !

jnaneswari-express-chokranto-naki-durgho.title: Jnaneswari Express : Chokranto Naki Durghotona ?
jnaneswari-express-chokranto-naki-durgho.description: Jnaneswari Express Durghotana Ekta Somoy Bongo Totha Desher Rajniti Tolpar Kore Diyechilo. Etake Voyaboho Durghotona Bolleo Vul Hobe Na. Pran Giyecilo Bohu Manusher. Shasok-Birodhi Torja Tunge Uthechilo Ei Ghotonake Ghire. Kintu Eti Ki Nichok Durghotona Chilo? Naki Er Pichone Chilo Boro Kono Shorojontro? Shihoron Jagano Sei Kahni Jante Aar Ektuo Somoy Nosto Na Kore Shune Nin Kuku Fm Er Ei Bishesh Audiobook.

your-brain-on-porn-4.title: Your brain on porn
your-brain-on-porn-4.description: పోర్న్ చూడటం వల్ల వచ్చే నష్టాలేమిటి? శరీరం, మెదడుపై పోర్న్ చూపే ప్రభావం ఎలా ఉంటుంది? పోర్న్ అడిక్షన్ నుండి ఎలా బయటపడాలి?

when-genius-failed.title: The Rise and Fall Of Longterm Capital Management
when-genius-failed.description: Bade Bujurg kehte hain ki Jo Admi ghamand mein choor hua vo samjho chaknachoor hua. Aisi hi kahaani hai John meriweather ki jinhone longterm capital management ki shuruaat ki aur use kayi aur businessmen ke saath milkar safal bhi banaaya lekin aisa kya hua ki LTCM loss ke qarib aa gaya, aur Aasman se sidhe zameen pe aake gira. Yahi sab kuch is show ke zariye hum jaanege jise sunkar aap LTCM ki kahaani ke saath-saath  business ke khel ko bhi samajh paayenge aur business aur stock market ki sahi planning kar payenge. Chaliye shuru karte hain Kuku FM par LTCM ki jeet aur haar ki kahani.

iyarkai-maruthuvam.title: Iyarkai Maruthuvam
iyarkai-maruthuvam.description: “Noyatra vazhve Kuraivatra selvam” nu oru thamizh pazhamozhi irukku ! Udambum Manasum arogyama irunthaa thaan namma laala ellaa selvathaiyum muzhusaa anubavikka mudiyum apdingradhu idhoda ullartham. Noi atra vazhkai vazha Follow panna vendiya, Iyarkaiyaana unavu muraiyai ‘um, vazhkai muraiyai ‘um azhaga vilakkuthu intha audio book. Vaanga therinjikalam.

great-characters-of-ramayanam-1.title: Great Characters of Ramayanam
great-characters-of-ramayanam-1.description: Ramayanam bharatha ithihasalalo suprasiddamainadi mariyu pradhanyatha kaliginadi. Ramayanam loni prathi pathra entho goppadi. Thandri matajavadatani Ramudu, Bhartha adugujadallo nadiche Sita, Bharya kosam enthadooramaina velle Bhartha. Anna maata shirasavahinche thammudu ilanti sadgunalanu manam Ramayana pathrala dvaara nerchukovacchu.

reporter-nidhi-chauhan-khoon-se-ranga-ch.title: Reporter Nidhi Chauhan : Khoon se Ranga Chaku
reporter-nidhi-chauhan-khoon-se-ranga-ch.description: Raghav ne apni aukat ke bahar ja kar chalaya kisi Ameerjadi ladki se shadi ka chakkar, aur phans gaya apni hi patni ke murder case me !! magar apni begunahi ko sabit karne ke liye Raghav ne liya Crime Reporter Nidhi Chauhan ka sahara ! ab kaise pahunchegi Reporter Nidhi chauhan Poorvi ke asli Qatilon tak?? Kya mil payega Nidhi ko koi rasta ya Fansi ke fande ka shikar ho jayega Raghav bechara?? Janne ke liye Abhi sunein.

improve-your-digestive-system.title: Improve Your Digestive System
improve-your-digestive-system.description: Present time lo chalamandi kurchoni panichese desk jobs chestunnaru. Daanithopaatu food lo chaala changes vachai. Deeni dwara ee rojullo chalamandiki Digestive problems vastunnayi. Mari ilanti problems ni overcome chesi digestive system ni improve chesukovadaniki , Digestive system lo important things gurinchi Ee Audiobook lo explain cheyadam jarigindi.

surrounded-by-idiots.title: Color Code se logon ki Pehchan
surrounded-by-idiots.description: Kuch logon ki baatein aapko zaroor bore karti hongi aur kabhi kayi baar aap khud ko hi sabse sahi mankar logon se argue karte honge. Yahi nahi bahut baar aapko logon ki baatein gusse mein aag babula tak karti hongi. Lekin kya aapne socha hai ki aisa kyun hota hai? Ya kyu kuch log bas khud ko sahi saabit karne mein lage hote hai? Kuch log to sahi ko sahi aur galat ko galat bolne ki bhi himmat nahi rakhte hai. Par kyun? Aur aise sabhi logon se kaise deal kiya jaaye? Iska jawab hai humari is audiobook mein. Aaiye ise jante hai.

business-behind-20-20-league.title: Business Behind Indian 20-20 League
business-behind-20-20-league.description: Enga kitta 5 Cup iruku nu solra Mumbai, avanga pangali Chennai team ku equal ah varusha varusham ‘Ee Saala Cup Namde’ nu sollitu suthura Banglore team um sambadhichuruku nu sonna ungalala namba mudiyudha? Neenga nambaatiyum adhaan nejam. Franchise Cricket ah porutha varaikum Jeikiromo, Thokkuromo, Modhalla Panam Sambadhikanum adhan mukkiyam. Cricket league pinnadi iruka business ah pathi detailed ah therinjuka kelunga “Business behind Indian 20-20 League” on Kuku FM

niyaabaga-sakthiyai-valarppathu-eppadi.title: Niyaabaga Sakthiyai Valarppathu Eppadi ?
niyaabaga-sakthiyai-valarppathu-eppadi.description: Unga niyaabaga sakthiyai athikarichu vaazhkai la vetri adaiya intha audiobook nichayam uthavi seiyum. Niyaabaga Sakthi patriya suvarasyamana thagavalgal,  Niyaabaga Sakthiyai valathukka seyya vendiya payirchigal, Memory boosting unavugal, marunthugal nu pala visayangal ithula irukku. Marakkaama kelunga !

jhoothan.title: Untouchable's Life
jhoothan.description: Sochiye agar aapko school mein class shuru hone se pehle jhadu lagaane ko keh diya jaaye ya fir khaane mein chawal ka paani pee pee ke guzarna karna pade to kya aap aisi zindagi jeena pasand karenge? Aap ka jawaab "Na" hi hoga lekin kya aapko pata hai isse bhi buri haalat mein ek untouchable ki poori zindagi beet jaati hai. Aaj ke humare is show me aapko hum ek untouchable ki zindagi se rubaru karaenge aur hum yakeen se keh sakte hain ki kuch qisse sun ke shayad aapki ankhon me aansu bhi aajayein. To chaliye shuru karte hai.

kavalaiyatra-vaazhkai-vaazhvathu-eppadi.title: Kavalaiyatra Vaazhkai Vaazhvathu Eppadi ?
kavalaiyatra-vaazhkai-vaazhvathu-eppadi.description: Entha oru pirachanaikum , atha nenachu kavalai padrathu theervaa agathu "Don't worry , Be Happy" nu easy ya sollidlaam, but atha follow panrathu kastam ! aanaa.. athukkaana vazhigal therinja kavalai padaama irukurathum easy thaan ! ada aamaanga ! Intha audiobook “Kavalai illatha vaazhkai” ku follow panna vendiya easy aana vazhigal la  solli tharuthu. Vaanga therinjikalam. Intha kaala makkalukku rombave avasiyamaana oru audiobook ithu !

the-80-minute-mba.title: The 80 Minute MBA
the-80-minute-mba.description: Aapni Hoyto Job Koren, Kintu Job Aapnar Pochondo Noy. Hoyto Aapnar Bybsa Valo Lage. Aar Bybsa Korei Darate Chan. Aabar Hoyto Aapnar Hate Somoy Nei Aar Oto Takao Nei Je MBA Korben. Dishehara Hoye Porechen Je Ki Korben. Upay Khuje Cholchen. Aar Chinta Nei Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei 'The 80 Minute MBA: Everything You'll Never Learn At Business School' Er Audiobook, Ja Aapnar Somosto Mushkil Aasan Kore Debe. Ei Audiobook Mon Diye Shune Aapni Shikhte Parben Bybsar Nana Dik Somporke, Tao Aabar Olpo Somoy Khoroch Kore.Tahole Cholun Aar Deri Na Kore Jhotpot Shune Neyoya Jak.

ten-days-that-shook-the-world.title: Ten Days That Shook The World
ten-days-that-shook-the-world.description: Iss audiobook mein John Reed ne 1917 ki Russia ki October kranti ke baare mein baat ki hai jo first world war ke baad 20th-century ki agli mahan ghatna thi. Ek tarah se dekha jaye to Reed ki ye kitaab Russia mein hui kranti ki sachi kahani batane mein ek safal koshish hai, us samay ki bhavnao ko pakadte hue, Reed ne Bolshevik netao ke saath janta ka mood, Netao ke bhashan ki report, aur darshako ki commentary, sainiko, kisano, sarkar ke patan, winter palace par hamle, inn sab vishyon ke baare mein charcha ki hai

how-to-deal-with-a-toxic-family.title: How To Deal With A Toxic Family?
how-to-deal-with-a-toxic-family.description: Toxic relationships ne kurichu ennu nammal bodhavanmaaraanu. Engane atharam bendhangalil ninnum maari nilkkam? Red flags ennal enthanu? Ethokke ennu namuku ariyam. Ennal toxic family ennu paranjal enthanu? Ningalude family toxic ano ennu engane kandetham? Atharam bendhangal ningale emotionally baadhikathe  engane nokkam? Enningane ulla niravadhi chodhyangalkkulla utharam lebhikkan kelkku, 'How to deal with a toxic family?' enna ee show.

balasaheb-thackeray.title: Balasaheb Thackeray
balasaheb-thackeray.description: Aikuya goshta Hinduhruday Samratanchi, Marathi mansancha hakkasathi ladhnarya sacchya netyachi, aikuya goshta Dilliche takhta hadrwun sodnarya powerful rajakiya netyachi, goshta Maharashtrachya rajkarnatil waghachi arthat adarniya Balasaheb Thackeray yanchi...

flipkart-vs-amazon-1.title: Flipkart vs Amazon
flipkart-vs-amazon-1.description: Sachin aur Binny Amazon chodkar India ki Amazon banane chale hain. Par iske liye fund kahan se aayega? Kya Sachin aur Binny ka sapna sirf sapna reh jayega ya unki company sahi mein Amazon ko takkar degi? Janne ke liye sunein Flipkart vs Amazon.

mrs-chakraborty-vs-norway-true-story-beh.title: Mrs. Chakraborty Vs Norway- True Story Behind Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
mrs-chakraborty-vs-norway-true-story-beh.description: Ek maa er nishphol akrosh karon tar dui sontan ke kere niye jawa hoyechilo, hai erokomi ekta cinema aste choleche, Rani Mukherjee r cinema, kintu eta ki khali cinema? Na eta ekti sottyi ghotona obolombone toiri hoyeche. Kar golpo onuprerona jogalo Rani Mukherjee ke erokom ekta cinema banate ba tate part korte. Ki hoyechilo Norway te? Keno ekti maa ke pronam korte hoyechilo nijer matrityo onnyo ekti desh e giye? Ekti maa ke kenoi ba courtroom e dariye lorai korte hoyechilo? Ki ei maa er golpo? Ei shob ta jante shune nin ei audiobook ti.

what-are-mutual-funds-and-sips.title: What Are Mutual Funds And SIPs?
what-are-mutual-funds-and-sips.description: Mutual fund ennal enthanu? SIP-yiloode engane mutual fundil investment aarambhikkam? Ethokkeyanu 2023-le vividha tharam mutual fundukal? Ivaye kurichokke valare lalithamayi ningalkk vishadhikarichu nalkkan ivide njangal shramikkukayanu.

decoding-black-money.title: Decoding Black Money
decoding-black-money.description: Ek 2012 ki report ke anusar 2002 se 2011 ke beech mein 343 billion dollars black money india se bahar bheja gaya tha aur India sabse jyada Black Money bhejne walon ki list mein 5th country ban gaya. Black Money India ki ek bahut badi problem hai, Swiss Bank mein India ke kitne logo ka paisa Jama hai ye clearly kehna mushkil hai lekin international pressure ki vajah se Switzerland apni nai policy par kaam kar raha hai. Is series mein hum charcha karenge ki, Black Money kya hai? kya Black Money sach mein Indian economy ko khatam kar rahi hai? Hawala system kya hai aur Indian government kaise Black Money ko control kar sakti hai? Aise bahut sare sawalon ke jawab aapko yaha milne wale hai aur aap apne knowledge ko increase karke ek jagruk nagrik ban sakte hai.

keralathile-natturajyangal.title: Keralathile Natturajyangal
keralathile-natturajyangal.description: 600il Adhikam nattu rajyangalayi vibhajikkappettirunna oru bhoopradesham aayriunnu Britishukarude varavinu munpu India. Parasparam vettiyum kollayadichum jeevichu ponnirunna nattu rajyangale orotta rajyam enna nilayilek orumippichath British samrajyathwathodulla virudhathayum swathanthryathodulla abhivanchayum aanu. Kozhikode, Travancore, Thiru Kochi, Kolathu Nadu enningane Keralathilum undayirunnu prabalaraaya natturajyangal. Aa charithrathilek onnupoyi varam.

kitchen-confendetial.title: Undisclosed Stories Behind 5 Star Restaurants
kitchen-confendetial.description: Agar aapko Masterchef show pasand hai ya fir aapka ek restaurant business kholne ka sapna hai to ye show ko aapke liye hi bana hai. Food industry ke peeche ki haqeeqat ho ya fir ek chef ka struggle aapko saare qisse is show me sunne ko milenge. Waise is show ko  agar aap cooking karte hue ya khaana khaate hue sunenge to aur bhi maza aayega, to chaliye shuru karte hai.

2023-apnar-kemon-jabe.title: 2023 Apnar Kemon Jabe?
2023-apnar-kemon-jabe.description: Apni ki bhagye biswas koren? Bhishon bhabe jante chan kalker din ta apnar kemon jabe? Roj khoborer kagojer pata ulte boshe thaken janr jonno bhobishyote ki hobe janar jonno? Amra kom beshi sobai amader bhobishyot niye agrohi, tai amra jante chai je agami din gulo kemon jabe. Tai ar beshi deri na kore shune nin amader ei audiobook ti, ar jene nin apnar 2023 er agami din gulo kemon jete choleche. Kemon hobe apnar chakrir bhagyo, ki ki hobe apnar prem jibone?

malayalam-abhimanam.title: Malayalam Abhimanam
malayalam-abhimanam.description: Malayalathe avaganikkunna Malayali ennal nammude Keralathinu thanne apamanamanu. Pettammakku thulyamaaya nammude mathrubhashaye naam evide aayalum marakaruthennu ee thalamurayum varunna thalamurakalum manassilakendathanu. Nammude mathrubhashayaya amma Malayalathinte pradhanyam namukk manassilakaam ee showiloode.

how-to-develop-self-confidence-and-influ.title: How To Develop Self Confidence And Influence People By Public Speaking
how-to-develop-self-confidence-and-influ.description: Kya aapko bhi stage par aane main darr lagta hai? Kya aap bhi stage fright ke shikar hai? Jab hum koi speech dete hain ya center of attraction bante hai us waqt hamari aawaz main kampan hoti hai aur hum badi mushkil se khud ko shant rakh paate hai, yeh isliye hota hai kyuki humein public speaking ki kala nahi aati hai. Toh Agar aap khud ko aur bhi zyada confident banana chahte hain aur public speaking seekhna chahte hai to suniye yeh audiobook jo aapki madad karegi ek behtar orator banne main.

porokiya-theke-songsar-banchaben-ki-kore.title: Porokiya Theke Songsar Banchaben Ki Kore?
porokiya-theke-songsar-banchaben-ki-kore.description: Bortomane Lokhyo Korle Dekha Jabe Onek Familyte Swami-Strir Moddhey Probol Bibad, Kono Kono Khetre Divorce Porjonto Chole Jay Somporko. Aabar Kono Kono Somoy Khun Er Moto Ghotonao Lokhyo Kora Jay. Aar Ei Sob Er Pichone Thake Sondeho. Aar Ei Sondheher Utpotti Porokiyar Moto Ekta Samajik Byadhi Theke. Eta Emon Ekta Byadhi Ja Gota Familyke Sesh Kore Dey. Eibar Proshno Holo Ei Porokiya Theke Kivabe Nijeke Dure Rakhben? Kivabe Nijer Songsar Banchaben? Eirom Kichu Proshner Somadhan Dite Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audiobook, Ja Shonar Por Aapni Aapnar Sob Proshner Uttor Peye Jaben Oti Sohojei. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shuru Kora Jak.

the-new-bjp-3.title: The New Bjp
the-new-bjp-3.description: Rajnitir bishoy ta bhari odbhut. Ei jogote ke je sotti bole ke mithye kotha bole seta bujhe otha ta ekta bishal kothin kaj. Ei je Bjp somondhye tothyo tollash gulo kotha theke payi bolun toh? News channel theke ba whatsapp theke, ba news paper theke, ashole eikhanei amader somoshya. Rajniti je amader jiboner koto ta gurutyopurno ekta bishoy seta amra anekei bujhi na. Amra Bjp somondhye kototukui ba jani. Aj ke amra ei Bjp er shuru theke jene nebo, bibhinyo jana ojana kotha.

necklace-of-diamond-strategy.title: Diamond Necklace Strategy Of India
necklace-of-diamond-strategy.description: Hum hamesha sunte aa rahe hai ki “china apni debt trap me gareeb desho ko fansa kar, India ke aas paas military position bana raha hai," Lekin future superpower India bhi china ko usi ki game me fasane ki puri planning kar chuka hai. Chaliye jante hai India ki Diamond Necklace Strategy ke baare mein.

the-new-bjp-2.title: The New BJP
the-new-bjp-2.description: Chinna sthayi nundi Ee roju India lo Oka Major Political Party gaa develop ayina Bharatiya Janatha Party Foundation, development, Political development, Alage Ee Party edo oka Family chetilo kakunda Entho mandi goppa nayakulache mundu nadipinchabadina Ee BJP party World’s most prominent political party ga ela maarindi ane vishayalu Political scientist and journalist Nalin Mehta Ee “The New BJP” Audiobook lo manaku cheptunnaru.

பொன்னியின்-செல்வன்-.title: Ponniyin Selvan : Movie Version 1
பொன்னியின்-செல்வன்-.description: சோழ நாட்டைக் கருவறுக்க வேண்டும் என்ற எண்ணத்துடன், நாகப் பாம்பைப் போல பழுவேட்டரையர் மூலம் சோழ நாட்டுக்குள் ஊடுருவுகிறாள் நந்தினி. சோழ நாட்டில் ஆதித்த கரிகாலரையும், இலங்கையில் அருள்மொழி வர்மரையும் கொலை செய்ய வேண்டும் என்று சதித்திட்டம் தீட்டுகிறாள். அவளது சதி நிறைவேறியதா? நச்சுப் பாம்பு நந்தினியின் ஆட்டத்தில் யார் யாருடைய தலைகள் உருண்டன? கேளுங்கள் கல்கியின் பொன்னியின் செல்வனின் சுருக்கமான வடிவத்தை...

you-can-compound-secrets-strategies-and-.title: Magic of Compounding
you-can-compound-secrets-strategies-and-.description: Paise kamana to sabhi sikhate hai, lekin compounding kar us paise ko badhana kaise hai yeh kisi Educational insitute mein nahi batate. Yeh show aapke is aadhe-adhure knowledge ke liye vardan hai. Is show ko sunne ke baad aapko pata chalega ki investment ke process ko sikhte kaise hain, use implement kaise karte hai aur usse profit kaise kama sakte hain. Kyunki yeh show aisi hi secret knowledge ka combination hai. Toh chaliye hum bhi ameer bante hain. Agar aapko "Why We Want You To Be Rich" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

kozhikkodum-orupidi-kadhakalum.title: Kozhikkodum Orupidi Kadhakalum
kozhikkodum-orupidi-kadhakalum.description: Kadhakal urangunna nagaram aanu Kozhikode. Sambannamaya Charithram kondum samskaram kondum verittu nilkkunna nagaram. Malabarinte vanijya thalasthanam ennu ariyappedumbol thanne sahithya kuthukikaludeyum sangeetha priyarudeyum bhakshanapriyarudeyum priyappetta idamanu Kozhikode.

social-media-addiction.title: How to get Free from Social Media Addiction?
social-media-addiction.description: Aaj har ek Indian ka screen time 7 ghante se bhi zyada ho gya hai, Jisme zyadatar samay social media par bitaya jata hai. Toh koi doubt nahi hai ki social media hum sabki life ka sabse bada addiction ban chuka hai. Isi addiction ke chalte aaj bahut se logon ko alag alag mental health issues ka saamna karna pad rha hai. Is show mein jaaniye ki kaise is buri aadat se chhutkara haasil karke aap apni life mein ek healthy balance laa sakte hain. Agar aapko "How to Live a Calm Life in The Age of Internet" jaisa show pasand aaya hai to ye bhi zaroor suniye.

mothe-profit-denare-laghu-udyog.title: Mothe Profit Denare Laghu Udyok
mothe-profit-denare-laghu-udyog.description: Tumhla Ekhada Business Suru Karyacha Ahe Ka? Pan Tumchya Kade Bhandval Nahi Ahe Mhanun Tumhala Toh Suru Karta Yet Nasel Tar Don't Worry, Kami Bhandval Vaprun Pan Tumhi Business Suru Karu Shaktat. Ase Anek Business Ahet Je Kami Bhandvalat Tumhi Suru Karu Shaktat. Atta Te Kasa Hey Apan Mothe Profit Denare Laghu Udyok Ya Series Dware Janun Gheuyat.

the-holy-bible-king-james-version.title: The Holy Bible - King James Version
the-holy-bible-king-james-version.description: The Holy Bible is a collection of religious scriptures that is held to be sacred in Christianity, Judaism, Samaritanism, and many other religions. The Bible provides divine inspiration. The King James Version (KJV), also the King James Bible (KJB) and the Authorized Version, is an Early Modern English translation of the Christian Bible for the Church of England, which was commissioned in 1604 and published in 1611, by sponsorship of King James VI and I.  Noted for its "majesty of style", the King James Version has been described as one of the most important books in English culture and a driving force in the shaping of the English-speaking world.

the-leader-who-had-no-title-1.title: Safalta Ka Raaz: Leadership
the-leader-who-had-no-title-1.description: Kisi bhi jung ko jeetne ke liye sahi plan aur sahi leadership ki zaroorat hoti hai nahi to haar pakki hai lekin kya aapko maloom hai Leadership sirf sarhad ki ladaaiyon mein ya company ko chalaane mein hi kaam nahi aati life ki race ko jeetne ke liye bhi sahi leadership ki zaroorat hoti hai aur is show mein  hum aapko Leadership ki importance aur ek leader kaisa hona chahiye yeh samjhayenge taaki aap apni life aur career mein successful hone ke mission ko poora kar paayein. Agar aapko "The CEO Next Door" aur "Start With Why: How Great Leaders Inspire Everyone" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

success-story-of-famous-ashok-vadapav.title: Ashok Vadapav- Marathi udyojakachi goshta
success-story-of-famous-ashok-vadapav.description: Mumbai ani Vadapav cha nata atoot ahe. Balasaheb Thackeray yani Mumbaitlya Marathi mansala Udyog-Vyavsay karnyasathi Pravrutta kela. Tyach prernetun Shri. Ashok Vaidya yani Vadapav cha vyavsay suru kela ani ''Ashok Vadapv'' tharla mumbaitil Pahila Vadapav. Chala tar mag aikuya Goshta ya pahivlya vahilya Vadapav chi, Eka Yashasvi Marathi udyojakacha Pravasachi.

flying-first-time.title: Pahilya Viman Pravasasathi Tips
flying-first-time.description: Pahila Viman Pravas Ha Saglyansathich Khas Asto. Exitment, Bhiti Asha Baryach Goshtinshi Toh Vyakti Jhunja Det Asto. Ashat Braychda Toh Tyachya Pahilya Viman Pravasachi Tayari Karayla Chukto, Pan Tension Gheu Naka Amhi Tumcha Viman Pravas Sukhakar Karnyasathi Gheun Alo Ahot 'Pahilya Viman PravasasathichyaTips' Ha Khas Show.

nafrat-se-mohabbat-tak.title: Nafrat Se Mohabbat Tak
nafrat-se-mohabbat-tak.description: Apne Rajput Empire ko Number 1 banaane ke liye Avani Rajput ek aise ladke ke saath sauda karne par majboor ho jaati hai, jise ladkiyon se sakht Nafrat hai. Dusri taraf, apne papa ki baat maan kar, Abhimanyu Pratap Singh, ek aisi ladki se shaadi kar baithta hai, jo use bilkul nahi pasand. Kya ye Nafrat, Mohabbat mei badal payegi? Janne ke liye suniye Nafrat se Mohabbat tak.

how-to-make-your-child-successful.title: How To Make Your Child Successful
how-to-make-your-child-successful.description: పిల్లలను విజయవంతులుగా ఎలా తీర్చిదిద్దాలి? పిల్లలకు విషయాలు అర్థం అయ్యేలా ఎలా చెప్పాలి? మీ పిల్లలు విజేతలుగా అవ్వాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

naxalism-and-kerala.title: Naxalism and Kerala
naxalism-and-kerala.description: Keralathil Naxalism verurappichathu enganeyanu? Aarokke ayirunnu Keralathile aadya kaala Naxal nethakkal? Avarude pravarthanam engane ayirunnu? Aa prasthanathinu pinne enthu sambhavichu? Etharam ella chodyangalkkumulla utharamariyaan kelkku 'Naxalism and Kerala' enna show.

the-deficit-myth.title: The National Debt: Sach Ya Jhooth
the-deficit-myth.description: Kya aapko pata hai ki sarkaar jaan bujhkar desh mein mehangayi ko badhaati hai? Agar aapko international politics aur economy mein interest hai to yeh show aapke liye hai. Is show mein apko jaanne milega ki neta kaise economy kharab hone ka reason kisi na kisi cheez ki deficit yani kami ko bataate hain lekin yeh sach nahi hota. Yeh sab world bank ke saamne khud ko debt mein dikhane ke liye kiya jaata hai. Jaaniye international economy kaise kaam karti hai? Hamare is show mein. Agar aapko "Principles For Dealing With The Changing World Order" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

sundori-kone-bou-hoye-othar-a-z-tips.title: Sundori Kone Bou Hoye Othar A-Z Tips
sundori-kone-bou-hoye-othar-a-z-tips.description: Shamnei ki apnar biye? Biyer tarikh o thik thak hoye geche? Tahole kintu ar deri kora jabe na. Lege porte hobe. Biye te nijeke groom korben na? Biye mane shudhui anando ar kajer chaap ta kintu noi. Biyer jonno koto rokom bhabe prostuti nite hobe janen? Biye apnar jiboner ekta bishesh din. Biyer din jaate kono somoshya ba extra head ache nite na hoi shune nin ei audiobook ti.

tax-banchanor-sohoj-upay.title: Tax Banchanor Sohoj Upay
tax-banchanor-sohoj-upay.description: Aapni Chakri Korun Ba Byabsa Hoyto Ekta Chinta Sobsomoy Mathay Ghore, Seta Holo TAX. Ete Aapnar Hoyto Onek Takao Chole Jay. Bujhe Uthte Parchen Na TAX Deyoyar Theke Taka Kivabe Save Korben. Aar Chinta Nei Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audiobook, Jeta Shonar Por Aapni Jante Parben Kivabe Aapnar Taka Aapni Save Korte Parben TAX Deyoyar Theke Ebong Ta Khub Sohoj Kichu Upayer Moddhey Diye. Nishchoi Vabchen Ki Seta ? Tahole Aar Somoy Nosto Na Kore Shune Nin Ei Audiobook.

khud-ke-liye-kaam-karo.title: Khudke Liye Kaam Karo
khud-ke-liye-kaam-karo.description: Aaj ka youth sochta hai ki sirf paisa hi safatla ka maanak nahi hai, balki apne naam ko bada banana aur duniya ke saamne ek accha example set karna success ka sahi matlab hai. Magar kya ye kar paana kisi aur ke liye ki gayi naukri se mumkin hai? Shayad nahi. Magar khud ke liye kaam kaise kiya jaaye? Kahan se hoti hai iski shuruaat aur kaise layein ismein discipline? Bataega ye show! Agar aapko "The Power of Self-Discipline" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

marainthu-pona-tamil-noolkal.title: Marainthu Pona Tamil Noolkal
marainthu-pona-tamil-noolkal.description: Iyarkai seetrangalal aala pala pazham thamizh puthagangal azhinju pochu. Neraya books namma kitta ippo illa ! Azhindu Pona intha puthagangal la eppadi kandupidichanga nu therinjikanum ma? Azhindu Pona.. Maranju Pona.. Sithanju Pona.. Thamizh Puthagangal ennenna nu therinjuka aavala irukka ?  Intha audiobook ka kettu therinjukonga.

history-of-indian-railways.title: History of Indian Railways
history-of-indian-railways.description: India, Duniya ke sabse bade deshon mein se ek hai. Aise mein desh ke Charon kono ke beech rozana aane-jaane ka connection banaye rakhna bahut hi mushkil kaam nazar aata hai. Lekin Indian Railways pichle kai dashakon se lagbhag namumkin nazar aane wale is kaam ko bahut aasani se kar rahi hai. Aur ye itni aasani se ho kaise pa raha hai? Kis tarike se angrezon dwara ki gai railways ki shuruaat aaj poore desh ke logon ki lifeline ban gayi hai aur kaise indian railways aaj poori duniya ke sabse bade railway networks mein se ek ban paya hai? India Railways se Jude Aise sabhi sawalon ke jawab aapko is audio book mein milenge.

the-vietnam-war-1.title: The Vietnam War
the-vietnam-war-1.description: The Vietnam War ended more than forty years ago, yet its memory still looms large in the national consciousness. Our unique series on the terrible struggle offers an illuminating overview of the protracted and deadly conflict that united Vietnam while severing the country in a way that no other conflict had since the American Civil War. In this series, we chart the war that troubled three American presidents and their advisors, starting with the Gulf of Tonkin and the Tet Offensive and ending with Hamburger Hill and the fall of Saigon. Listen to the harrowing story of one of the most brutal conflicts ever.

hold-me-tight-mix-episodes.title: Hold Me Tight
hold-me-tight-mix-episodes.description: Emily gets drunk one unfortunate night and wakes up next to a complete stranger the other day. Emily, engaged to her childhood crush would never cheat on him for a stranger. But she does not stop there, she goes on to marry this stranger leaving his fiance and her family behind. What has happened in a night that Emily is ruining everything for this stranger? Is this marriage even real? Or is Emily in some unknown danger?

aarya-and-the-mystery-of-black-wand.title: Aarya and The Mystery of Black Wand
aarya-and-the-mystery-of-black-wand.description: Anguthi ke hole se Aarya pahochta hai Ek Anjan Duniya mein, Jaha woh kisi ko nahi pehchanta. Waha use milti hai Hina, Jisase uski hoti hai Dosti. Kaun hai hina? Kali chhadi aur Kali Gufa ka kya hai Rahasya? Aarya phas jata hai khatarnak musibat mein, Kaise bachega Aarya? Janane ke liye Sune Kahani "Aarya and The Mystery of Black Wand" Kuku FM par!

american-civil-war.title: The American Civil War
american-civil-war.description: 1861 aani 1865 madhil american civil war madhye ameriketil itar kuthlyahi yudhapeksha jast american marle gele aani hi amerikechya itihasatil sarvat dukkhad ghatna banli. Ya yudhache mukhya karan mhanje gulamgiri chya vistaras parvangi milel ki nahi he hote. Ani yamule gulamgiri suddha namshesh honyachya margavar hoti. Chala janun gheu amerikecha ha raktranjit ani kala itihaas.

plane-crashes-that-changed-aviation.title: Plane Crashes That Changed Aviation
plane-crashes-that-changed-aviation.description: Vyomayana meghalaye thanne maatti maricha vimana apakadangalum athine thudarnnu aa meghalayilundaya mattangalum ariyam 'Plane Crashes That Changed Aviation' enna showilude. Ennum duroohatha vittumaratha vimana apakadangaleyum thirodhanangaleyum kurichu kooduthal ariyan kelkku.

toxic-parents-se-kaise-deal-kare.title: Toxic Parents
toxic-parents-se-kaise-deal-kare.description: Toxic Parents ke sath rehna zindagi ka sabse mushkil task hota hai. Aur kai log  toh itna zyada pareshan ho jaate hain ki majboori mein unhein ghar chhod Kar parents se alag rehna padta hai jisse unke aur unke parents ke rishton mein daraar aa jati hai. Toh agar aap bhi apne toxic parents se pareshan hain lekin ghar chodhkar bhagna nahi balki problem ko solve karna chahte hain toh uske liye is audiobook se perfect aur kuch nahi ho sakta. Kyuki ye aapko step by step toxic parents se deal karne ke tareeke batati hai aur bataur parent bhi agar aapke behavior se aapke bacche preshaan hai toh kya aap apne hi bacchon ke liye toxic hain ye bhi aap is audiobook ke zariye samjh sakte hain aur problem ka solution pa sakte hain.

hiranyakashipudu-prahladudu.title: Hiranyakashipudu Prahladudu
hiranyakashipudu-prahladudu.description: Manam andaram yentho ishtam gaa jarupukone panduga Holi, ee panduga venuka vunna charithra thelusukovaali ante ee Audio Book vinandi.

मादाम-क्युरी.title: The Great 'Madame Curie'
मादाम-क्युरी.description: Poland madhe eka samanya kutumbat janmalelya ''Marie curie'', kasha banlya Jagatil Sarvottam Scientist paiki ek? Kasa hota tyancha Jeevan pravas? Kay hoti Vidnyan kshetratil tyanchi Uttung Kamgiri? Aikuya, 2 vela Nobel Price patkavnarya ''Marie curie'' aka ''Madame Curie'' yanchi Prernadayi Jeevankatha...

journey-indian-media-from-15-min-to-247.title: Journey Of Indian Media
journey-indian-media-from-15-min-to-247.description: Aapke paas mobile hai aur aap jhat se duniya bhar ki sari khabren kuch minute mein jaan lete hain.Lekin ye khabron ka silsila shuru kaise hua? kaise pahuncha har ghar TV?Wo kaun sa gaon tha jahan se shuru hui television kranti?Kaise sirf 15 minute mein duniya bhar ki khabar batane wale show ab 24 ghante ke news channel ban gaye hain aur fir kaise digital media ne har apni pakad sabse mazboot kar li.Pura itihas janane ke liye hi to hai ye khas show Journey Of Indian Media: From 15 Minute To 24*7.

periods-ashole-ki.title: Periods Ashole Ki?
periods-ashole-ki.description: Barir thakur ghor ar rannaghor ei dui e meye der dokholdari chole. Periods er somoy keno bhogobaan ba manush meye der theke mukh phiriye nen? Janen ki keu? Keno tader chhowa lagle noshto hoye jabe shob kichu? Meye der keno protyek mashe oi kodin nirbashone thakte hoi? Bujhtei parchen nischoi ki niye kotha hochhe? Hai Periods, ba writu ba mashik, ba shorir kharap. Jene ni ki ei periods ashole? Keno eta badhar modhye perote hoi meye der ke? Ki emon hoi ei periods er somoy je tader ke batiler khataye phele dewa hoi?

sansad-bhavan.title: Sansad Bhavan To Central Vista
sansad-bhavan.description: Saal 1911, Tab British sarkar ke gulam Bharat ki capital Kolkata se Delhi Shift ki gai to zarurat padi Delhi mein aisi buildings ki jahan se sarkari kaam sahi se ho sake aur fir isiliye ek naya shahar New Delhi basaya gaya.Isi ke tahat banaya gaya tha hamara Sansad Bhavan .Kya hai sansad Bhavan ke banne ki aur fir aage aane wale saal 2026 mein bankar taiyar hone wale Central Vista ki puri kahani aur kyon zarurat padi Central Vista yani naye Sansad bhavan ki?Aapko sab batane ke liye ham le aaye hain “Sansad Bhawan to central Vista”.

keralathe-nadukkiya-rippermar.title: Keralathe Nadukkiya Rippermar
keralathe-nadukkiya-rippermar.description: Iruttine mara pidichu niraparadhikale athikrooramayi konnu thalliya rippermar ee kochu Kerala samoohathilum arangu vaanirunnu. Ratriye pedichu jeevicha oru Malayali samooham ee mannil jeevichirunnu. Ripper Chandran, ripper Jayanandan, ripper Chacko thudangi kolapathakikalude kadha ariyam oppam avar elathakkiya orupadu manushyarudeyum.

why-earthquakes-happen.title: Why Earthquakes Happen?
why-earthquakes-happen.description: Enthukondanu earthquakes athava bhookambam undakunnath? Dhurantham undakum munbe bookambangal pravachichukoode? Bhookambangal undakumbol shraddhikenda karyangal enthokkeyanu? Bhookambathinte pinnile shastravum rasakaramaya kadhakalum kelkaam ee showiloode.

bs-developing-the-leader.title: How to become a Leader
bs-developing-the-leader.description: Ek Manager aur Leader mein kya difference hota hai? Manager woh hota hai jo process ko manage karta hai aur Leader woh hota hai jo logo ko manage karta hai. Leader hone ke bahut sare fayde hai, aap apni Life ko aasani se manage kar sakte hai, apne decisions khud le sakte hai, apni family ko properly manage kar sakte hai, business mein ya job mein aap better perform kar sakte hai, apne finance ko khud manage kar sakte hai. Leadership ek training hai, ek art hai jise practice se seekha ja sakta hai. Suniye iss show ko aur improve kijiye apne Leadership Skills. Agar aapko  "The CEO Next Door" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

nijer-product-er-sell-kivabe-baraben.title: Nijer Product Er Sell Kivabe Baraben ?
nijer-product-er-sell-kivabe-baraben.description: Dhorun Aapni Aapnar Ekta Product Sell Korte Chan, Kintu Kivabe Korben Bujhe Uthte Parchen Na. Emonta Aamder Oneker Songei Hoye Thake. Kothay Ki Bolte Hobe Seta Bujhe Uthte Pari Na. Aar Ei Communication Gap Er Jonyo Nana Somosya Toiri Hoy. Ki Vabchen Emonta Aapnar Songeo Hoy Ebong Aapni Er Somdhan Chaichen. Aar Chinta Nei Sei Somadhan Dite Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audiobook, Eti Aapnake Sikhte Sahajya Korbe Kothay Ki Boleben Ebong Kivabe Nijer Product Er Sell Baraben. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Jhotpot Shune Nin.

babri-masjid.title: Babri Masjid
babri-masjid.description: Indiayude mathethara sankalppangale thachudacha sambham aayirunnu Babri Masjid thakarkkal. Babri Masjid nilaninna bhoomiyil munp Ramakshethram undayirunnu ennu avakashappettu RSSnte nethruthwathil ulla Hinduthwa vadhikal aanu 1992 December 6nu Masjid thakarkkunnath. 3000tholam per annu kollappettu. Ee sambhavam Haindhava vargheeyatha aalikkathikkukayum Rajyathinte Rashtreeya chitram mothathil mattimarikkukayum cheythu.

spy-princess.title: Spy Princess: The Life of Noor Inayat Khan
spy-princess.description: Shrabani Basu Dwara likhi gayi yeh kitaab "Jasoos Shehzaadi" Noor Inayat Khan ki Biography hai jinhe France aur Germany Ke Yuddh ke dauraan dhokhe se taseehe dekar maar diya gya tha. inke pita Hindustani the aur inki maa amreekan. Suniye aakhir yeh massom ladki bag mein pistol lekar kyu ghoom rahi thi. "Spy Princess" ki Audiobook sirf KukuFM par.

genius-baby-mischievous-daddy.title: Love to Hate You
genius-baby-mischievous-daddy.description: Anna wakes up next to a stranger one morning.  She thinks she will never see him again but little does she know, life has another plan. Michael ends up being her boss at her new job. Anna and Michael can't help their attraction to one another. Anna tries to escape from Michael, time and time again, only to find him next to her, yet again. Is this love or lust? Find out in this exclusive romantic drama.

bheeshma.title: Bheeshma
bheeshma.description: భీష్మ ప్రతిజ్ఞ అంటే ఏమిటి? భీష్ముడికి వివాహం జరిగిందా? భీష్మునికి ఉన్న బలాలు- బలహీనతలు ఏంటి? ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి

sardar-2.title: Architect of Modern India- SARDAR
sardar-2.description: Sardar Patel, Azad Bharat ke hone wale pehle Pradhanmantri the. Par, unhone Gandhi ji ke ek ishaare pe Pradhanmantri pad ko tyag diya aur chal pade 565 tukdo mein bante desh ko jodne ki koshish mein. Kahi baat cheet se Rajwado ko bharat mein milaya toh kahi army ka istemal kar Hyderabad ke Nizam se ladai ki. Kashmir ke liye toh Nehru se matbhed bhi kiya par bharat ko tukdo mein batne se rok liya. Desh ke liye itna kuch tyagne wale Sardar ko Gandhi ji ne kyu nahi banane diya Pradhanmantri? Kyu ek chithi mein Gandhi ji ne unhe bhadkau bhashan ke liye fatkar lagayi? Kya sach mein Patel dange bhadka rahe the? Sardar ne kaise kiya tha Bharat ko ekjut? Vallabh Bhai Patel kaise bane the Sardar? Agar aapko "India After Gandhi" jaisi books pasand hain, to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

fitness-habits-2.title: Fitness Habits
fitness-habits-2.description: Ee Rojullo Arogyae Sampada ga Maarindi. Anduku Meeku Manchi Fitness Avasaram. Ee fitness ni Alavatu Chesukovalante Meeru Chinna Chinna Excersise tho Start cheyali. Only 30 days lo meeru fit gaa ela maaragalu ane topic ee Audio book lo untundi. Night Early ga Nidrapovadam, Early Morning Twaraga Levadam, Excersise Alavatu chesukovadam vanti Topics Ee Audio book lo Unnai.

full-payment-or-emi-which-is-better.title: Full Payment or EMI; better kay?
full-payment-or-emi-which-is-better.description: Mitrano, Ekhadi Mothi vastu vikat ghetana anekda apan confuse hoto ki ekdach Full Payment karava ki EMI var ghayav? Hech confusion door karnyacha prayantna ya Show madhe karnyat ala ahe. Full Payment ani EMI che Fayde ani Tote kay asu shaktat, tasech kontya veli - konta option nivadana yogya thau shakta, Credit cards, Loan ya madhe EMI cha kay role asto, ya saglya vishyichi mahiti tumhaka ya show madhun nakki milel.

bachho-ki-pratibha-kaise-ubhaare.title: Bachhon Ki Pratibha Kaise Ubharein?
bachho-ki-pratibha-kaise-ubhaare.description: Aaj bhi kayi aise parents hai jinko lagta hai sports mein career banana bewakufi hai. Kyunki sports mein ya yun keh le unke bachhe ke chune hue kisi mamuli field mein unhe apne bachhe ka accha future nazar nahi aata. Par agar sahi mayno mein dekha jaaye to kisi bhi bachhe ka sabse bada moral support uske parents hi hote hai. Jo unke skills, unke talent ko badha kar unme confidence ko boost karte hai. Parents ko isi baat ka ehsaas dilane ke liye hum lekar aaye hai aapke liye audiobook!

the-burari-death-case-2.title: The Burari Death Case
the-burari-death-case-2.description:
Delhi, 1 July 2018 - Ore Kudumbathai serndha 11 per thookil thongiya padi irandhu kidanthargal. Oru Silar adha kolai nu sonnanga. Innum silar idhu aavi oda velai nu sonnanga.
Unmaiyil enna nadanduchu? Therinjuka kelunga “The Burari Death Case” on Kuku FM

lincoln-the-unknown.title: Lincoln The Unknown
lincoln-the-unknown.description: Chaliye sunte hain, Abraham Lincoln ke zindagi ki aisi ansuni kahani jo 1932 me Dale Carnegie ne likhi thi. Unki family se lekar, White House tak ki struggles, dard bhari shadi aur south ki war aur Lincoln ke hatya ke baad ki unke zindagi ki puri kahani. To chaliye sunte hai, kaise ek kisan bana United States of America ka President.

indian-superfoods-change-the-way-you-eat.title: Indian Superfoods: Change the Way You Eat
indian-superfoods-change-the-way-you-eat.description: Ekta Jinis Aamder Pray Sokoler Moddhey Dekha Jay, Seta Holo Sorir Niye Chinta. Kivabe Fit Thakbo ? Kivabe Ojon Komabo ? Ki Khele Chorbi Hobe Na ? Valo Goon Somponno Khabar Ki Ki ? Emon Kichu Proshno Protiniyoto Ghurpak Khete Thake Aamder Mathay. Kono Bideshi Khabar Noy Aamder Deshei Emon 10 Ti Khabar Aache Ja Eisob Somosyar Somadhan Kore Dey. Nishchoi Ebar Jante Icche Korche Segulo Ki Ki ? Se Uttor Jante Aapnake Shunte Hobe Rujuta Diwekar Er Lekha 'Indian Superfoods: Change the Way You Eat ' Er Audiobook. Jekhan Theke Nijke Fit Rakhar Rosod Khunje Pete Paren. Tahole Aar Deri Kiser ? Aashun Shuru Kora Jak.

gst-explained-in-easy-way.title: GST Explained
gst-explained-in-easy-way.description: Apan saglech anek Products vikat ghetana kinva Hotel, Restaurants cha Bill bhartana GST pay karto. Barechda GST bharava laglyamule Naraj hi hoto. Pan apan kadhi vichar kelay ki ha GST apan nakki ka bharto? Nakki kon kontya goshtinvar ha GST lagu hoto? Government la GST deny madhe apla fayda kay? GST vishayi cha asha anek prashanchi uttara milvnyasathi, 'GST Explained' ha audio show nakki aika.

crime-capital-1.title: Crime Capital
crime-capital-1.description: Desh ke sabse bade jail- Tihar Jail ke bahar koi tokri mein sirkatti lashein rakh raha tha . Ek parivaar ke saare 11 log ek sath fansi laga lete hai. Ek shrapit kuye ke paas se darjano bacche gayab ho jaate hai. Kahi MLA ka beta firing kar bar par khadi Jessica Lal ki jaan le leta hai. Toh koi tandoor mein apni biwi ki lash dal deta hai. Koi bus mein ladki ke sath gangrape kar road par phek deta hai, toh koi bacchon ka murder kar unhe pakka kar kha jata hai. Ye saare crimes aur kahi nahi desh ki rajdhani- Delhi mein hote hai, kabhi raat ke andhere mein to kahi dindahade. Jaanein Delhi ki sansanikhez crimes ke baare mein sirf- CRIME CAPITAL mein.

north-korea.title: North Korea
north-korea.description: North Korea - ulagathoda map la oru chinna naadaa ithu irunthaalum, ulaga arasiyal la intha naatuku oru periya pangu irukku. Matha naadugaloda sernthu illama ella mudivugalaiyum thaniyaave edukura intha North Korea voda mulu history ayum ungalukku eduthu solra muyarchi thaan intha pathivu. Vaanga Vada Korea voda varalaarai therinjukalaam.

google-1.title: Google
google-1.description: Internet Ulagathula Nammaloda thedalgal la elimai paduthura intha google ! eppadi, eppo uruvaachu. Oru search engine naa arimugam aagi migaperiya technology company yaa eppadi intha google valarchi adanjuchu. vaanga therinjikalam.

upsc-success-story-naveen-rattu.title: UPSC Success Story - Naveen Rattu
upsc-success-story-naveen-rattu.description: KukuFm Aaap ke liye laya hai Officer Naveen Rattu Ji Ka Exclusive interview Jisme yeh humein btaati hain UPSC Aur zindagi Ke Baare mein Bahut saari insightful baatein. Agar Aap bhi UPSC clear karna chahte hain to suniye yeh interview sirf KUKUFM par.

tatva-sastram-chinna-parichyam.title: Tatva Sastram Chinna Parichayam
tatva-sastram-chinna-parichyam.description: భారతీయ తత్వశాస్త్రం యొక్క ప్రధాన శాఖలు ఏమిటి? వాటి ప్రత్యేకతలు ఏమిటి? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.!

robinson-street-hotya-rohoshyo.title: Sunday Thriller Stories:  Robinson Street Hotya Rohoshyo
robinson-street-hotya-rohoshyo.description: Diner alo te jake ek rokom dekhte lagto, takei onnyo rokom lagto raater ondhokare. Sanghatik hoye uthto shey. Manusher shob baje dik guloi moner ondhokar dik thekei uthe ashe. Ki kore ashe ei mone ondhokar manusher modhye? Ki emon ondhokare achhonyo hoyechilo ei Robinson Street er basinda? Ki ki hoyehilo ei Robinson Street er bondho janlar barir modhye. Jante hole shune nin  Sunday Thriller Stories er ei audio story ti.

the-second-mountain-1.title: Behtar Zindagi Ka Raaz
the-second-mountain-1.description: Hum Sab Apni Poori Life Paisa, Shauharat aur apni Zarooraton ko poora karne mein guzaar dete hain. Apni Khushiyon ke liye itne matlabi ho jaate hain ki dusre ki khushi ki parwah nahi karte. Yeh Original Show aapko yahi batayenga ki aap apni khushiyon ki jo mountain climb karne ki soch rahe hain vo asal mein chhalawa hai asli khushi khud mein nahi doosron ki help karne mein hai. Chaliye shuru karte hain Behtar Zindagi ko janne ka safar.

barun-biswas-an-unsolved-murder-case.title: Barun Biswas: An Unsolved Murder Case
barun-biswas-an-unsolved-murder-case.description: Kothay Aache Protibadir Mrityu Hoy, Kintu Protibader Noy. Emoni Ek Protibadi Loraku Jubok Chilen Barun Biswas. Peshay Tini Chilen Shikkhok. Tar Grame Bohudin Dhore Cholchilo Nana Opokormo. Jegulo Dekhe Nijeke Aatke Rakhte Paren Ni Barun. Chokhe Chokh Rekhe Lorai Korechilen Manusher Jonyo. Osohay Manushder Kache Tini Chilen Vogoban. Kintu Hotath Ekdin School Theke Bari Ferar Somoy Gobordanga Railway Platform-E Take Guli Kore Hotya Kora Hoy. Kintu Ei Hotyar Pichone Karon Thik Ki Chilo ? Keno Tini Kichu Manusher Chokkhushul Hoye Uthechilen ? Eisob Kichu Romhorshok Sotyer Unmochon Hobe Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye. Tai Aar Somoy Nosto Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak.

achhe-anko-se-pariksha-paas-hone-ke-7-ra.title: Achhe Anko Se Pariksha Pass Karne Ke 7 Rahasya
achhe-anko-se-pariksha-paas-hone-ke-7-ra.description: Exams humari life me bahut bada role play karte hai , sirf padhai ke waqt nahi aage jakar career me bhi ye experiences help karte hai , par koi school ya institution kabhi bhi exam me achhe marks lane ki techniques nahi sikhata , chaliye sikhte hai aisi 7 techniques ko iss audio book me , jo preparation se lekar exam hall tak apki help karegi aur ache mark lane me aapki help karegi.

the-new-bjp-in-marathi.title: The New BJP
the-new-bjp-in-marathi.description: Tumhala kadachit vishwas basnar nahi, pan eke kali Bhartiya Janata Party che astitva na ke barabar hote. 1984 madhe tar keval 2 bhajpacha fukta 2 seats nivdun alya hotya. Pan aaj hach paksha Deshatil sarvat motha ani Sattadhari Paksha banala ahe. Ha chamtkar kasa kay ghadla? Kashi unchavat geli Pakshachi karkirda? BJP cha utkrshat keval PM Narendra Modi yanchach vata ahe ka? Janun gheuya pakshacha jaganghadnicha parvas- ''The New BJP'' ya audiobook madhun...

navodhana-naayakar.title: Navodhana Naayakar
navodhana-naayakar.description: Andha vishwasathinte iruttil ninnu nalloru naaleyilek namuk velicham veeshiyavar aanu Navodhana Nayakar. Sathi, Thottukoodayma thudangi jathi adisthanamakkiyulla asamkhyam anaachaarangalude kootharangayirunna bharathathe samoohya purogathiyilek nayicha orupidi Navodhana Nayakare parichayappedam ee showilude.

a-killer-called-kasab-1.title: A Killer Called KASAB
a-killer-called-kasab-1.description: 26 November 2008 ko aatankwadiyon ne Mumbai jaise surakshit par hamla kaise kiya? Unke es mission ko hamari sena aur Police ke jawanon ne ko kaise apne control mein kiya? Aur es poori ghatna mein jab baki aatankwadi maare gaye to fir Kasab kaise zinda pakda gaya? Jaaniye Kasab aur es aatanki hamle ka poora sach.

the-way-you-kiss.title: The Way You Kiss
the-way-you-kiss.description: A betrayal from her fiance, an accidental long kiss from a stranger, and a family that disowns and snatches all her property away. But she does not give up. She decides to marry the stranger she kissed that night. How is Grace planning to take her revenge by marrying the stranger she kissed? Is revenge the only motive? Or did something more happen between them that night?

உன்-நிழலும்-நான்தானே-1.title: உன் நிழலும் நான்தானே
உன்-நிழலும்-நான்தானே-1.description: தன் முதலாளி கொடுத்த பணத்தை அவனது மனைவி பொய்யான காரணத்தைச் சொல்லி வாங்கிச் சென்றுவிடுகிறாள். பணம் களவாடிய பழி கீர்த்தனாவின் மேல் விழுகிறது. அவளது காதலனும் அண்ணனும் கொலை செய்யப்படுகிறார்கள். தன் முதலாளியின் மகனைக் காதலித்துப் பழி வாங்குகிறாள் கீர்த்தனா. அவளது சதுரங்க வேட்டையில் உருளும் காய்களே, உன் நிழலும் நான்தானே!

chanakya-neeti-6.title: Chanakya Neeti
chanakya-neeti-6.description: Buddhi se paisa kamaya ja sakta hai na ki paise se buddhi hasil ki ja sakti hai. Agar buddhi ki baat ki jaye to Chanakya se behtar aur kaun ho sakta hai ? Aur Chanakya ji ke pass to iska bhandar hai. Life mein kisi bhi problem ko kaise solve kiya jaye aur success ko khud apne paas kaise laya jaye, yeh audiobook aapko inhi ke raaz batane wali hai, Chanakya ke diye gaye sutron se. Agar aapko "Chanakya In Daily Life" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

not-just-a-civil-servant-3.title: I.A.S Officer Anil Swarup
not-just-a-civil-servant-3.description: IAS Officer Yanchi Naukari Bhartatil Sarvat Risky Jobs Paiki Ek Ahe. Tyana Kathin Situations Madhye Quick Decisions Ghyache Astat. Hi Goshta Ahe Lokpriya IAS officer Anil Swarup Yanchi. Kasa Tyani Atankvaidyan, Coal Mafiyacha Samna Kela Te Ya Show Madhye Tumhala Samjel.

education-system-loopholes-in-india.title: Bharotiyo Sikkha Byabosthar Loopholes
education-system-loopholes-in-india.description: Kothay Aache Shikkhai Jatir Merudondo. Kintu Lokhyo Korle Dekha Jabe Sei Merudondo Besh Koyek Bochor Dhore Besh Norbore Hoye Poreche. Kintu Keno Eirokom Hal Holo Shikkha Bybosthar ? Ei Norbore Obosthar Pichone Onek Karon Royeche. Ebar Aapnar Mone Proshno Jagbe Ki Sei Karongulo ? Ei Obosthar Poriborton Ki Somvob ? Eirokom Kichu Gurutwopurno Kothai Tule Dhora Hoyeche Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye. Aasun Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak.

read-people-like-book.title: Read People Like a Book
read-people-like-book.description: Communication ka matlab kya hota hai? Kisi se acche se baat karna? Well, this is not the correct answer. Kyunki isme apni baat ko convey karna bhi shamil hai. Jisme body language, posture, self management jaise na jaane kitne skills shamil hote hai. Inhi skills ko janne ke baad, kisi ke liye agle bande ki baat samajhna asaan ho jata hai. Toh agar aap bhi is skill mein champion banna chahte hai, then sune humari yeh audiobook!

vetri-un-kaiyil.title: Vetri Un Kaiyil
vetri-un-kaiyil.description: Vazhkaila vetri pera enna seyyanum nu adippadai la irunthu solli kudukura audiobook idhu ! Vetri adaiya neenga seyya vendiya mukkiyamana adippadaiyana visayangal ennenna nu therinjuka intha audiobook ka kelunga.

sanchipt-ramayan.title: Sankshipt Ramayan
sanchipt-ramayan.description: Ramayan Prabhu Ram ki ek aisi adbhut gatha hai jise hum sab bachpan se sunte aa rahe hai, jab jab Prabhu Ram ka zikr humare aas paas hota hai man prasannta se bhar jata hai. Bhartiya Itihas ke is mahan granth ko humare purvajo ne bade sahej kar rakha hua hai, Jahan ek taraf Prabhu Ram ek manushya ke taur par shreshth Jeevan jeene ka udahran hai, vahi dusri taraf burai par achchai ki jeet ka ek vishwas hai. prastut sankshipt Ramayan ka moolasrot Vaalmeekikrt ‘Ramaayan’ aur Tulaseedaasakrat ‘Raamacharitamaanas’ granth hee hai, lekin jahaan raamachatimaanas mein saat kaand hain, ‘sankshipt raamaayan’ mein aath kaand samaahit hai. katha mein ramayan ka aadhar bana rahe, isake liye shuru se akhir tak katha ke mukhya prasangon ke shlokon ka beech-beech mein zikr kiya gaya hai.

vastu-tips.title: Vastu Tips
vastu-tips.description: Ghar, Dukan, Plot Vikat Ghetana Apan Sarvat Pahile Je Baghtoh Te Mhanje Vastu. Infact Ghar Set Kartana Dekhil Kontya Dishela Konti Goshta Pahije Hey Hi Apan Baghto Barobar Na? Jar Ka Tumcha Hi Uttar Ho Asel Tar Ha Show Tumhala Vastu Baddal Mahiti Deil Jyamule Tumhala Sukh Milel Ani Tumchi Pragati Hoil.

learn-hindi-through-bangla.title: Learn Hindi Through Bangla
learn-hindi-through-bangla.description: Bangla bhasi ra puropuri Hindi bolte na porte na parleo, kichu ta kom beshi shob bangali paren porte. Ei boite kothin byakaron ke sohoj bhabe boojhano hoyeche. Apnarao ki chan je khub sohoje ebong sabolil bhabe Hindi te kotha bolte chan? Bhabchen Hindi ar jana ba bola hoye uthbe na? Tahole ekhunni shune nin ei fullbook ti ebong khub sohoje shikhe nin Hindi bhasha.

arvind-kejriwal-1.title: Arvind Kejriwal: The Founder Of AAP
arvind-kejriwal-1.description: Arvind Kejriwal ki zindagi ke kuch ankahe kisse hain jo shayad bahut kam logon ko pata hai , unka engineering school se suru hua safar delhi ke CM banane tak aur usse aage ke unki soch kya hai? kaise unke voters unhe vote karte hain? aise kya baatein hain jisse wo raato raat politics main itna bada naam ho gye? aur unke around controversies kya hain? Jaanenge yeh sari ansuni baatein KUKU FM ki iss original audio series main.

neerizhivu-noi-varamal-thaduppathu-eppad.title: Neerizhivu Noi Varamal Thaduppathu Eppadi
neerizhivu-noi-varamal-thaduppathu-eppad.description: Sakkarai Noi pathi namma makkal ta pala poiyana thagavalgal paravi irukku ! Vilaimathikka mudiyaatha udal arogyathai kedukura antha poigal la irunthu nammala kaathukka, Sarkarai Noi patriya unmaigal la therinjukurathu avasiyam ! Sakkarai Noi varaama thadukka vazhimuraigal irukkaa nu thedittu irukkuravangalukkum, sarkarai Noi ya kattupaattula vaachikittu arogyama vazhrathu eppadi nu yosichutu irukkavangalukkum intha audio book nichayam udhavi ya irukkum.

history-of-telugu-literature.title: History Of Telugu Literature
history-of-telugu-literature.description: మన తెలుగు సాహిత్యం కనుమరుగు అవుతుందా? వేల సంవత్సరాల గొప్ప చరిత్ర కలిగిన మన సాహిత్యం తో మనం ఎంతో నేర్చుకోవచ్చు.  మన సాహిత్యాన్ని కాపాడిన ఈ గొప్ప వ్యక్తుల గురించి అందరూ తప్పకుండా తెలుసుకోవాలి. వెంటనే వినండి.

565-princely-state.title: From 565 Princely States To One India
565-princely-state.description: India ko azadi mili to 15 August ko lekin iski ladayi lambi chali thi aur sabse bada kaam to azadi ke baad baki tha.Kaam 565 chhoti-badi riyasaton ko milakar ek Bharat banane ka.Aur is kam mein sabse badi pareshani the Pakistan ko banwane wale Muhammad Ali Jinnah.Lekin Jinnah ke saamne the desh ke 2 mahan Insaan “Sardar Patel Aur VP Menon”.Kaise in dono ne saath milkar Pakistan aur jinnah ki har chal ko nakaam kiya aur kaise 565 riyasaton ko milakar banaya Ek Bharat.Sab batane ke liye hum le aaye hain khas show " From 565 Princely States To One India".

rise-of-china-1.title: Rise of China
rise-of-china-1.description: World Population la mattum China No.1 illa, athayum thaandi pala vishayangal la avanga dhan Super One! America ke tough kudukura pala vithaigala kaila vechutu irukanga. Ipdi ulaga naadu ellathayum bayapada veikra alavuku epdi ivlo powerful nation ah China aachu? Namma Indian Borders ellathayum avanga army vechu nammala threaten panrandha solrangale? Adhu Unmaiya? Therinjuka kelunga “Rise of China” on Kuku FM

karenjit-kaur-the-bold-story-of-sunny-le.title: Karenjit Kaur- The Bold Story of Sunny Leone
karenjit-kaur-the-bold-story-of-sunny-le.description: Yavatthu desha kurrakaurunu kaadu kaadu vayasutho sambhandham lekunda andarini thana andachandalatho, abhinayam tho alarinchi mukhyam gaa kurrakaaru gundelanu kollagottina Sunny Leone jivitham loni aatupotlu, thanu padda kastaalu, edurkonna cheethkaraalu ee audio book lo vini thelusukundam. Asalu thanu shrungara tharaga enduku marindo thana kutumba nepathyam inka enno secrets ni manam ippudu thelusukovacchu.

thackreys-and-shiv-sena.title: Thackerays And Shiv Sena
thackreys-and-shiv-sena.description: 1960 mein Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Ki sarkar ne Bombay Ka vibhajan Kiya aur isse bane do rajya. "Maharashtra" Aur "Gujarat".Lekin ye vibhajan hua Kyun? Kaise Mazdooron aur Daliton Ke liye ladne wale kuch logon ne ise andolan bana diya aur kaise ek kamre mein bani Maharashtra Ki political party Shiv Sena?Bal Thackeray to ek cartoonist the fir kaise ban gaye Maharashtra ke sher.Shiv Sena ke banne aur fir kuch kamzor hone se lekar Eknath Shinde ki bagawat tak sab batane ke liye ham le aaye hain "Thackerays And Shiv Sena".

love-like-fire-1.title: A Love Like Fire
love-like-fire-1.description: Harper Kushner, an innocent woman gets trapped in the domineering Tech CEO Julian Thorne's trap when she accidentally sleeps with him after a wild party night. Now, Julian is obsessed with Harper and he would keep her caged in his rich mansion, not letting her get back to her simple life. Harper tries her best to run away, but she is equally seduced by the powerful man's charms. Her family, her friends, her work, and everyone suffers the wrath of Julian Thorne. Will Harper ever escape his clutches, or will Julian succeed in possessing Harper as his forever prize?

நெஞ்செல்லாம்-நெருஞ்சி-முள்.title: நெஞ்செல்லாம் நெருஞ்சி முள்
நெஞ்செல்லாம்-நெருஞ்சி-முள்.description: உள்ளத்தில் அழுக்கையும் உதட்டிலே சிரிப்பையும் வைத்துக்கொண்டு நடமாடும் மனிதர்கள் உலகத்தில் எத்தையோ பேர் உண்டு. அவர்களிடம் நல்ல மனம் கொண்டவர்கள் மாட்டிக்கொள்ளும் போது என்ன நடக்கும்? அப்போது ஏற்படுகின்ற பிரச்சினைகளை அடிப்படையாக வைத்து எழுதப்பட்டதுதான் ‘நெஞ்செல்லாம் நெருஞ்சி முள்’.

vastushastra-se-badle-apne-zindagi.title: Vastu Shastra se Badle Apne Zindagi
vastushastra-se-badle-apne-zindagi.description: Vastu Shastra kya aapki zindagi ki samasyaon ka hal ban sakta hai? Kya hai vastu shastra ke peeche ka itihas aur logic, janenge KUKU FM ki iss original series mein jahan hum charcha karenge ki kaise aap apne ghar, office aur relationships mein vastu ki kuch simple tricks ke sath sudhar la sakte hain!

the-12-week-fitness-porject.title: The 12- Week Fitness Project
the-12-week-fitness-porject.description: Heere thekeo mohargho bostu ki? Seta hoito apnara bolben sastho. Joto boyosh barbe totoi apnarao bujhte parben je sasthoi sampad. Shorir thik thakle shob e thik thake. Kintu bhabchen je  shorir ba sastho thik rakhte shob bairer khabar tyag korte hobe? Ekebarei na. Fitness somondhye jante, ba ki ki khabar kheye, bhalo mondo kheye nijer shorir o sastho ke sustho o fit kore tulun.

business-ka-launch-plan.title: Business ka Launch Plan
business-ka-launch-plan.description: Aajkal har koi ek chota mota business shuru karke entrepreneur ban jaata hai magar unme se aadhe se zyada businesses chal nahi paate. Kya hai iske karan? Wo hai aise sawal jo hume ek business start karne se pehle sochne chahiye. Kya aapka business chalne layak hai? Kya aapke business idea mein dum hai ki wo market mein survive kar sake? Janenge is launch plan ke baare mein vistaar se. Agar aapko Gary Keller dwara likhi "The One Thing: The Surprisingly Simple Truth Behind Extraordinary Results" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

chat-gpt-and-googles-bard.title: Chat GPT And Google's Bard
chat-gpt-and-googles-bard.description: Ettavum mikacha AI technology avatharippikanulla mathsarathil aanu sankethika rangam. Complex-aaya vishayam lalithamaakan sahayikkuka enna udheshathodeyanu open AI-yude Chat GPT-yum Bard enna peril oru chatbot Google-um avatharipichirikkunnath. Ee puthiya rendu AI sankethika vidhyakale kurichch vishadhamayi ariyam ee showiloode.

anu-mudhal-andam-varai.title: Anu Mudhal Andam Varai
anu-mudhal-andam-varai.description: Anu muthal Andam (Universe) varai ulla ariviyal thagavalai thoguthu vazhangum ariviyal kalanjiyam ithu. Anuvukku ulle olinthirukkum athisayangal ! Viyappoottum Vinveli Ragasiyangal ! nu Pala viyappoottum ariviyal thagavalgal ithil ullana. Aacharyamootum Ariviyal ulagukku intha audiobook moolam oru payanam poi varalaam vaanga.

ro-hitman-sharma.title: Rohit Sharma: The Hitman
ro-hitman-sharma.description: Saal 2010 mein Jab Indian Cricket Team ko South Africa ne haraya toh Panch ODI match ki series mein Rohit Sharma ka score tha 11,9,23,1 aur 5. Jiske baad World Cup 2011 ki team mein Rohit ko jagah nahi mili. Lekin tab kise pata tha ki wahi Rohit Sharma aaj 2022 T20 world cup mein Team India ke Captain honge. Toh Rohit Sharma se The Hitman aur phir Captain of Team India banne ki poori kahani aapko is audiobook mein janne ko milegi.

mean-girls.title: Mean Girls X Next Level- The Skylar Neese Murder
mean-girls.description: A summer after their sophomore year in high school, three 16-year-old teenage girls - Skylar, Rachel, and Sheila who were best friends- snuck out late at night until Skylar went missing. Skylar was the only one who knew what was going on between Rachel and Sheila and was more than just best friends. So, Rachel and Sheila decided to not be friends with the only person who knew their sex secrets. But instead of ghosting her, they thought of a permanent solution to get rid of her. Can best friends actually ever turn this mean? Are there more secrets than just the sexuality of these teenagers at play?

khagolshastra-janun-ghya-sopya-bhashet.title: Khagolshastra janun ghya sopya bhashet
khagolshastra-janun-ghya-sopya-bhashet.description: Aplyapaiki bahutekanna  khagolshastra mhtla ki angavar kata yeto. shalet pn ha vishay aplyala boring vataycha. Mhanunch amhi gheun alot ek khas show khagolshashtra janun  ghya sopya bhashet. Ha show nakki aika ani universe baddhal interesting facts janun ghya.

jadoo-teri-nazar.title: Jadoo Teri Nazar
jadoo-teri-nazar.description: Ladakon se nafarat karne vaali khaamosh tabiyat ki Piya jab Palash ko pehali baar dekhati hai to bina Palash ki marzi ke use jabaradastee kiss kar leti hai. Palash tilmila jaata hai, vo Piya se kahata hai ya to vo sexual hairasament ke liye Jail jane ko taiyaar rahe ya usakee sharten maane. Jail jane se bachane ke liye Piya Palash ki sharten maan leti hai. Lekin Palash ki sharten maanate hi Piya ki zindagi mein toofan aa jaata hai. Uska saamana Maya aur Radhika se hota hai jo Piya ko mitane ke liye kisi bhi had tak tak jaane ke liye taiyaar thin. Aisi kya sharten thi Palash ki jinhen manane ke baad Piya ki zindagi khatre mein pad jaati hai. Piya marate marate bachati hai aur jab Palash plan bana kar Piya se shaadi kar leta hai to Piya ke samne gayab hone ke alawa koi rasta nahi bachata. Kya Palash Piya ko khoj payega? Kahin Radhika aur Maya Piya ko khatm karne mein kamyab to nahi ho jayengi? In sab se kya Piya haar jayegi ya phir samne aakar mukabla karegi? Janne ke liye sunte rahein Jadoo Teri Nazar

dawood-ibrahim.title: Dawood Ibrahim
dawood-ibrahim.description: Velu Naiyaker la arambichu Rocky Bhai varaikum pala Mumbai Dons ah cinema la paathurupom. Aana Indian Government ah pala naal soru thanni illama alaya vitta oru original Gangster ah pathina kadhai dhan idhu. Oru saadharana Head Constable oda paiyan, Bombay Baasha va epdi aanan? Therinjuka kelunga “Dawood Ibrahim” on Kuku FM

cauvery-issue.title: Cauvery Issue
cauvery-issue.description: Thanni prachanai nu sonnale udane namma mind ku varradhu - Cauvery prachanai dhaan. Pala varushama irukkura indha prachanai oda thuvakkam edhu? edhanaala idhu thodarndhu vandhuttu iruku? Cuvery - Tamilnadu oda varalaaru enna nu indha audio book la therinjikalam.

2007-world-cup.title: Story Of India's 2007 World Cup Victory
2007-world-cup.description: 24 September 2007, Vo din jab Young Indian Cricket Team ne South Africa mein hue pehle T20 World Cup ko jeet kar itihaas racha. Is jeet ki ummeed na toh Indian fans ko thi aur na hi khud indian team management ko kyuki usi saal ODI World Cup mein mili sharmnaak haar ke baad Sachin Tendulkar aur Sourav Ganguly jaise bade khiladiyon ne is tournament mein khelne se mana kar diya tha, isiliye ek naye captain aur zyadatar young khiladiyon se bani indian team jisne gine-chune T20 matches hi khele the toh unse koi kaise jeet ki ummeed laga sakta tha. Lekin phir bhi Team India ne kaise vo trophy apne naam ki? iski poori kahani aapko is audiobook mein janne ko milegi.

nobeljoyi-abhijit-banerjee.title: Nobeljoyi Abhijit Banerjee
nobeljoyi-abhijit-banerjee.description: Bangali Jati Biswer Dorbare Nijer Kajer Moddhey Diye Kyati Orjon Koreche. Amartya Sen-Er Pore Abhijit Banerjee Holen Dwitiyo Bangali Jini Orthonitite Nobel Peye Gota Biswer Samne Aaro Ekbar Bangali Jatir Matha Unchu Koriyechen. Obiram Kaj Kore Cholechen Biswer Manusher Daridrota Durikoroner Jonyo. Kintu Tar Ei Jatrapoth Khub Ekta Sugam Chilo Na. Nana Utthan-Potoner Moddhey Diye Tini Gechen. Aaj Aamra Ei Audiobook-Er Moddhey Diye Tar Sei Jatrapoth Dekhe Neyoyar Chesta Korbo. Aasun Shuru Kora Jak.

ek-rahasmayi-duniya.title: Ek Rahasyamai Duniya
ek-rahasmayi-duniya.description: Ek Aisi Rahasyamai Duniya Jahaa'n Har Taraf Bicha Hai Tilism Ka Jaal. Zameen Se Aasman Tak Phaili Hain Divya Shaktiyaa'n. Chaar Dost Achanak Se Insaani Duniya Se Jaadui Duniya Me Qaid Ho Jaate Hain Aur Phir Shuru Hoti Hai Maanav Aur Tilismi Rooho'n Ki Jaddojahad. Suryamani Ko Paane Ke Liye Mahashaktiyon Ke Beech Hogi Bhidant. Kaun Kar Raha Hai Is Nayi Duniya Par Raaz? Chaar Insaani Rooho'n Ko Kaise Milegi Aazadi Aur Kaisi Hai Ye Jaadui Duniya? Janne Ke Liye Sunein Ye Kahani.

annavin-katturaikal.title: Annavin Katturaikal
annavin-katturaikal.description: Thamizhargalin Thanmanathai unarthi , Tharaniyil Thalai nimirnthu nirka seiyum Tharamana katturaigal ivai !  Azhagu Thamizh Adukku mozhiyum, Kaattaaru pondra karuthukkalum  konda Arignar Anna Avargalin katturaigalai audio vadivil kettu magizhungal.

bongobondhu-sheikh-mujibur-rahman.title: Bongobondhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
bongobondhu-sheikh-mujibur-rahman.description: শেখ মুজিবুর রহমান সবার কাছে 'বঙ্গবন্ধু' নামেই পরিচিত। এক লড়াইয়ের নাম তিনি। আমরা যে ভাষা দিবস পালন করি, সেই ভাষা আন্দোলনের মূল চালিকা শক্তি ছিলেন তিনি। তাঁর বলা 'জয় বাংলা' শ্লোগান ঝড় তুলেছিল বাঙালির হৃদয়ে। তিনি চলে গেলেও তাঁর বলা কথা এবং তাঁর কাজ দিয়ে তিনি আমাদের মনে আজীবন অমর হয়ে থাকবেন। আজ এই অডিওবুক এর মধ্যে দিয়ে জেনে নেওয়ার চেষ্টা করব তাঁর জীবনের নানা খুঁটিনাটি। আসুন শুরু করা যাক।

aap-bhi-merit-mein-aa-sakte-hain.title: Aap Bhi Merit Mein Aa Sakte Hain
aap-bhi-merit-mein-aa-sakte-hain.description: Acche Colleges mein admission milne ki baat ho ya kisi sarkari vibhag mein naukri, Merit mein aaye hue students ka number sabse pehle aata hai. Toh ab aap bhi merit mein aa sakte hain aur aasani se safalta ki seediyan chadh kar apni alag pehchan bana sakte hain. Iske liye aapko jyada kuch karne ki zaroorat bhi nahi hai bas is audiobook mein batayein gay asaan tareekon ke anusaar aapko apne daily routine mein kuch badlaav lane hain.

tarun-vayat-taala-ya-chuka.title: Tarun vayat taala ya chuka
tarun-vayat-taala-ya-chuka.description: Asa Mhantla Jata Ki Tarun Vaya Khup Najuk Asta Ani Tya Vayat Jar Ka Apan Yogya Savai Lavlya Nahit Tar Te Vait Margavar Jau Shakto. Asha Kontya Chuka Ahet Tya Tarun Mulani Talalya Pahijet Hey Kukufmcha Khas Show Tarun Vayat Taala Ya Chuka.

rising-strong-1.title: Apayash hi Yashachi Pahili Payri
rising-strong-1.description: Apan kadhi Fail jhalo ki aplya Nashibala kosto pan tya peksha apan swatah kuthe chuklo he apan shodhle pahije. Nirasha, Depression, Failure ya goshti ayushyat yenarch. Pan tyanchashi kasa deal, tyanchawar maat karun progress kasa sadhyacha yacha Tips & Tricks ya show madhun tumhala miltil. Mitrano, Haar manu naka karan 'Apayash hi Yashachi pahili pairi aste'...

hardik-pandya-biography.title: Hardik Pandya : T20 Ka X Factor
hardik-pandya-biography.description: Hardik Pandya currently Indian Cricket Team ka ek bada naam hai, lekin ye naam itna bada itni aasani se nahi bana iske pichhe kayi kahaniyan hain, struggle hai, controversies hain, aur hard work hai jise hum is show mein janenge. To chaliye shuru karte hai 9th fail Hardik Pandya ki "T-20 Ka X Factor" banne tak ki kahani ka safar Sirf Kuku FM par.

ramana-maharshi.title: Ramana Maharshi
ramana-maharshi.description: అసలు రమణ మహర్షి ఎవరు? ఆయన బోధనలకు లక్షలాది మంది ఎందుకు ఆకర్షితులయ్యారు? అరుణాచలం లోనే ఆయన ఎందుకు స్థిరపడ్డారు? వినండి ఆసక్తికర విషయాలు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో

inside-tihar-jail-1.title: Inside Tihar Jail
inside-tihar-jail-1.description: South Asia la iruka jails la miga periyadhu Tihar Jail dhan. Delhi la iruka indha jail complex 1957 la arambichu iniku varaikum pala mukkiya kaidhigal ku thandanai vangi kuduthuruku. Ippadi patta famous jail ulla enna facilities ellam iruku? Ulla kaidhigal ku koduramana treatments ellam kudukuradha solranga? Idhellam unmai dhana? Therinjuka kelunga “Inside Tihar Jail” on Kuku FM

mirabai-chanu.title: The Indestructible - Mirabai Chanu
mirabai-chanu.description: Mira Bai Chanu ek aisa naam hai jo sirf ladkiyon ke liye hi nahi ladko ke liye bhi ek inspiration hai. Ek Chhote se shehar se nikal kar Mira kaise India ke liye Gold jeet ke lekar aayi aur is jeet ke peeche ki struggle ki poori story aapko is show me sunne ko milegi, to bina time waste kiye shuru karte hai.

goutam-buddher-dekhano-pothe-netritwo-di.title: Goutam Buddher Dekhano Pothe Netritwo Dite Sikhun
goutam-buddher-dekhano-pothe-netritwo-di.description: Netritwo Ekta Boro Bypar, Sobai Netritwo Dite Paren Na. Aabar Jibone Sobai Sofolota Pete Chan Kintu Sobai Pan Na. Kintu Emonkichu Pontha Aache Ja Mene Cholte Parle Ekjon Jogyo Neta Hoye Otha Jay Ebong Jibone Sofolota Payoya Jay. Ekhane Goutam Buddher Emonkichu Kotha Byakto Kora Aache Ja Aapnar Jibone Karjokori Bhumika Nite Pare. Ki Sei Omulyo Kothagulo ? Aashun Shune Ni.

short-selling-in-stock-market.title: Short Selling In Stock Market
short-selling-in-stock-market.description: Stock Marketil nikshepam ullavaro nikshepikkan udheshikkunnavaro arinjirikkenda onnanu Short selling. Oru company yude ohari vilayude idivil ninnulla labham ennathanu Short Selling enna Investing Strategy yude adisthana aashayam. Tradermarkku palappozhum upayogapradamaya tool aanenkilum pala apakada saadhyathakalum ithilund. Athinekkurichellam 'Short selling in stock market' enna ee Showyilude ariyam.

career-kaise-badle.title: Career Kaise Badlein?
career-kaise-badle.description: Agar aap jo kaam kar rahe ho usse satisfy nahi ho to kya karna chahiye? “Log kya kahenge?” ye soch kar kya apne bhi apne career options ko taal diya hai? to ye show aapke liye hai , jaha par aapko career change, portfolio building  , job search se lekar  salary negotiation tak ki puri jankari milegi jisse aap bhi bina kisi dar ke apne career ko aage badha sakte ho!

kamasutra.title: Manmadha Sutra
kamasutra.description: Sex pathi velippadaiyaavum, virivaagavum ezhuthappatta mukkiyamaana puthagam idhu. Intha audiobook Azhagu Thamizhil , Elimaiyana vadivil,  muzhumaiyaga uruvakka patta Kamasutra vin latest version ! vaanga oru nalla sex ku enna thevai nu therinjukalam !

jai-jawan-jai-kisan-1.title: Jai Jawan, Jai Kisaan
jai-jawan-jai-kisan-1.description: Desh ke doosre Pradhanmantri - Lal Bahadur Shastri, jo sirf 18 mahino ke liye Bharat ke Pradhanmantri rahe the, unhone logo ke dilo par hamesha raaj kiya.  Shastri ji ki ek lalkar par poore desh ne ek din ka upvaas shuru kar diya tha. Pakistan ne panga lene ki koshish ki toh unhone Lahore ke muh tak sena ko utaar diya. Aur phir ek din Allahabad ki rally mein unhone "Jai Jawan, Jai Kisaan" ka naara diya jo hamesha ke liye amar hogaya. Par phir desh ke aise veer ki jab Tashkent mein, Pakistan ke sath peace treaty sign karne ke bad achanak maut ho gayi, toh Indira Gandhi ne inquiry kyu nahi hone di?

bari-bose-taka-kamanor-upay.title: Bari Bose Taka Kamanor Upay
bari-bose-taka-kamanor-upay.description: Shoishob holo amader jiboner swarnajug karon shei somoy na thake amader aye korar chinta , na thake orther chahida. Kintu jokhoni amra boro hoi ba career ni bhaba hoi tokhoni duschinta aste thake, karon amra bujhte pari na anek somoy e je kon poth ta amader jibon safolyer dike niye jabe? Byabsha na chakri? Ki bhabe khub sohoje aye kora possible? Jodi bola hoi je apni khub sohojei bari bose taka aye korte paren? Hai thike porchen, ki ki bhabe khub sohojei bari bose taka aye kore neben shei shob jante shune nin ei audiobook ti.

social-media-good-or-bad.title: Social Media - Good or Bad?
social-media-good-or-bad.description: Namma ellaroda kailayume oru magic ulagam irukkunu sollalam. Athukku per thaan Social Media. Intha Social Medias naala nammakku ennalaam nallathu irukku, ennalaam thappu nadakka chances irukkunu alasi aaraiyura oru pathivu thaan ithu. Intha pathivu moolama Social media oda pros and cons pathi neenga theliva therinjukalaam. Vaanga makkale Social media ulagathukula pogalaam.

bs-wellness-revolution.title: The Future Of Health And Wellness Industry
bs-wellness-revolution.description: Aaj ke samay mein jahan par hum tarah tarah ke revolution ke saath aage badh rahe hai, isme ek industry hai jo ki iss century mein ek bahut bade revolution ke saath aage badh rahi hai aur wo hai health industry. Subah uthne ke saath istemal hone vale toothbrush aur toothpaste se lekar humare khane tak, sab kuch aaj is industry ka hissa hai jo boom par hai aur audiobook mein hum sikhenge ki kis tarah se hum log sirf user na banke iss mein entrepreneur ki tarah shamil ho sakte hai, kaise invest kar sakte hai aur kaise apne existing business ko badha sakte hai

how-to-become-a-good-leader.title: Kivabe Ekjon Valo Leader Hoye Uthben?
how-to-become-a-good-leader.description: Ekta Company Hok Ba Ekta Jati, Setake Sofolvabe Egiye Niye Jete Dorkar Hoy Ekjon Dokkho Sothik Leader Er. Emonta Noy Je Ekjon Leader Hote Gele Porashona Kore Aashte Hobe. Aamder Sokoler Moddheyi Lukiye Thake Leader Hoyoyar Khomota. Kintu Tar Jonyo Kichu Goon Er Dorkar Hoy, Jegulo Follow Korte Parle Ekjon Dokkho Sothik Leader Hoye Otha Jay. Jodi Aapni Ekhon Vabte Shuru Koren Je Ki Sei Goon? Tar Uttor Dite Aapnar Bondhu Hoye Uthte Pare Ei Audiobook. Ei Audiobook E Bola Kothagulo Mene Cholte Parle Aapnio Ekjon Dokkho Leader Hoye Uthtei Paren. Aasun Shune Neyoya Jak.

kashmiri-panditancha-itihas.title: Kashmiri Panditancha Itihas
kashmiri-panditancha-itihas.description: Kashmiri Panditanvar anek documentary chitrapat nighale ahet. Kashmir madhe kashmiri panditan var je atyachaar zaale tyache katu satya lapavnyacha prayatna zala hi gosth tya katu satya chi ahe. Hi gosth tumchyat suddha jaganyachi ek navin aasha nirmaan karel ani tumcha jaga kade baghnyacha drushitkon badlun taakel.

money-paathshaala.title: 9 Financial Steps To Get Rich
money-paathshaala.description: Agar aap apne financial goal achieve karna chahte hai aur financially independent hona chahte hai to suniye yeh audiobook jise likha hai Vivek ne. Vivek, The Money Book ke author hai aur unhone National Editor, Consumer Affairs, CNBC TV18 ke saath kaam kiya hai. Unhone Economic Times, Business Standard, Financial Express and India Today ke saath bhi kaam kiya hai. Inke baare mein aur janne ke liye aap iss website par jaa sakte hai https://www.moneypaathshaala.com/en

manida-ulaviyal.title: Manida Ulaviyal
manida-ulaviyal.description: Sariyo ! Thappo ! Manithargal seira ovvoru seyalukku pinnadiyum oru kaaranam irukku. Antha karanatha theliva purinjukkurathukku ulaviyal apdingra psychology therinju irukanum. Intha “Manida Ulaviyal” Audiobook la Thani Manitha ulaviyal la irunthu samooga ulaviyal varaikkum Ulaviyal patriya muzhumaiyana thagavalgal irukku. Vaanga therinjikalam.

unavum-udalnalamum.title: Unavum Udalnalamum
unavum-udalnalamum.description: Udal paruman, Mana azhutham ithu mathiriyana naveena kaala udal sikkalgal la kooda unavu murai maatrangal moolam sari panna mudiyum ! Unavu muraigalai seer amaikirathu moolam  noigalai sari seirathu eppadi nu intha audiobook moolam kathukalam. Arogyama irukurathuku enna sapdanum ? Arivu valarchikku thevaiyana brain foods enna ? Muthumaiyai viratti adichu endrum Ilamaya irukka enna sapdanum ? Ulagathulaye sarasari aayul adhigama irukkura japaniyargal kadaipidikkum unavu murai enna ? ippadi.. Unavum Udal Nalamum patriya pala ariya thagavalgalai alli tharum arumaiyana puthagam ithu. Vaanga therinjukalam.

multipliers-1.title: The Leadership Mindset
multipliers-1.description: Infosys ke founder Narayan Murthy ko aaj kaun nahi janta ? Unhone sirf 20 saal ki umar mein company ka bhar sambhala or company ko itni uchai par pahuchaya ki aaj uska revenue lagbhag 1 lakh dollar ke karib hai. Par sawal yeh hai ki Narayan Murthy ne company ko itna safal banaya kaise ? Narayan Murthi ek aise leader the jo apne aaspass ke logo ki buddhi ka upyog karte aur unka samman karte, un ki yogyata ko pehchante. Aaj hum isi vishay par charcha karenge aur samjhenge ki kaise ek successful leader ban sakte hai. Agar aapko Carol S. Dweck dwara likhi "Mindset" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook aapko behad pasand aayegi.

Therinjuka kelunga “Titanic” on Kuku FM

tips-to-become-a-great-manager.description: Je Kotha Shunte Valo Lage Ta Sobsomoy Sotyi Nao Hote Pare. Ei Boite Management Er 'Conventional Beliefs' Er Bipokkhe Kichu Point Bola Aache.
