Aasun Shune Neoya Jak.

subscribed.title: Winning Strategies for a New Era of Business
subscribed.description: Aaj ke zamaane mein hum owner nahi bus user banna chahte hain, aur apni sahuliyat ke hisaab se kisi bhi product ya service ko jab tak man chahe aur jitna chahe bus utna hi use karna chahte hain, aise mein kaise badal rahi hai humari aas paas ki duniya, aur kaise netflix aur zoom cars jaisi companies subscription model se humari zindagi aasaan bana rahi hain, jaaniye is Original Show mein. jise sunne ke baad aap bhi apne business mein subscription model kaise apply kar sakte hain yeh samajh paayenge.

immortals-of-meluha-tamil.title: மெலூஹாவின் அமரர்கள் : சிவா முத்தொகுதி - 1
immortals-of-meluha-tamil.description:
இது ஒரு மனிதனின் கதை. காலம், தெய்வமாய் மாற்றிய ஒரு மாமனிதனின் கதை. 

ஒரு காலத்தில் புகழும் பெருமையுமாய் சிறந்து விளங்கிய மெலூஹாவின் ஆட்சியாளர்களான சூர்யவம்சிகள், பல ஆபத்துக்களைச் சந்திக்கின்றனர். அவர்களது ஜீவநதி சரஸ்வதி, வற்ற ஆரம்பித்து, முற்றுமாய் அழியத் துவங்கிவிட்டது. கிழக்கே வாழும் சந்திரவம்சிகளிடமிருந்து, பயங்கர தீவிரவாதித் தாக்குதல்களையும் சந்திக்கின்றனர். நிலைமையை இன்னும் சிக்கலாக்கும் விதமாய் நாகர்களும் சூர்யவம்சிகளை எதிர்க்கிறர்கள்.

இப்போது சூர்யவம்சிகளின் ஒரே நம்பிக்கை, என்றோ அவர்களிடையே பரவி, வேரூன்றிவிட்ட ஒரு ஆருடம்: ‘தீமை தலை விரித்தாடும் போது; அதன் கொடூரம் எல்லை மீறி, எதிரிகள் முழுமையாய் வென்றுவிட்டார்கள்; இனி, போக்கிடம் இல்லையென்ற நிலையேற்படும்போது - ஒரு வீரன் வருவான்.’

சிவா முத்தொகுதியில் இதுவே முதல் புத்தகம். சாதாரண மனிதன் ஒருவனின் பிறவிப் பயன், அவனை நம் தெய்வங்களுக்கெல்லாம் தெய்வமாய், மகாதேவராய் மாற்றிய கதை இது...

no-excuses-1.title: Excuse Dena Banda Kara
no-excuses-1.description: Aapan  kam na karnyasathi kahi na kahi excuse det asto. kadhi mala vel nahi, tar me mala amuk kam ahe mhanun me tumchi madat nahi karu shakat. Ha show apalyala hich karna ka deu naye yachi karna sangnar ahe.

chapter-1_north-koreathe-hell.title: The Girl Who Escaped North Korea
chapter-1_north-koreathe-hell.description: Azadi hum Indians ke liye kitni mayne rakhti hai ye humse zyada kaun hi jaan sakta hai, lekin aaj ka show ek aisi ladki ke baare me hai jisne khud ko aazad karne ke liye duniya ki sabse dangerous country North Korea se 17 saal ki umar me bhaag nikalne ka decision liya, kaisa tha ye azadi ka safar aur kaun hai ye ladki ye janne ke liye aapka is show ko pura sunna bahot zaruri hai. To bina time waste kiye shuru karte hain.

maha-shivudu.title: Maha Shivudu
maha-shivudu.description: శివుడు  ఎవరు ? తనలో  సగభాగాన్ని  పార్వతి  దేవికి  ఎందుకు  ఇచ్చాడు ? తనకంఠంలో  హాలాహలాన్ని ఎందుకు నిలుపుకున్నాడు ? ఇలాంటి  ఎన్నో  రహస్యాలు  ఆ  పరమాత్మునిలో  దాగి  ఉన్నాయి. రండి మన ఆడియో బుక్ లో శివపార్వతుల మహిమల గురించి  తెలుసుకుందాం.

option-trading-guide-1.title: Option Trading Guide
option-trading-guide-1.description: Indrajith Shantharaj Raasina Ee book lo Option Trading methods, Primary principles, strategies ki samabandinchina tips Ee audiobook lo unnayi. Option trading lo koncham Risk untundi kabatti Ee trading lo enter avadaniki munde Induloni Lotupatlu telusukovadam Manchidi. Ippudippude Trading lo enter avutunna vaariki Ee audiobook ok guide ga use avutundi. Intraday trading, Positional trading gurinchi five important things gurinchi indulo discuss cheyadam jarigindi.

sip-1.title: PPF Nahi SIP Karo
sip-1.description: Warren Buffett ka kehna hai ki agar aaj aap kisi ped ki chhaanv mein baithe hain to saalo pehle kisi ne us ped ke beej ko boya tha, Aur iska matlab ye hai ki agar aap bhi aane wale waqt mein sukoon ki zindagi jeena chahte hain to uski shurwat aaj se hi karni hogi. Aur us khushi ki shuruaat aap SIP se kar sakte hain. Ab aap puchenge ki SIP kise kehte hain? Aakhir SIP karte kaise hain? Kitne tarah ke SIP hote hain? Isse hume kya fayda hone wala hai? Aur aakhir aane waale waqt mein hum isse ameer kaise ban sakte hain? Aapke in saare sawaalon ke jawab hai humare iss show mein jiska naam hai "PPF Nahi SIP karo".

si-and-constable-exam-preparation.title: SI and Constable Exam Preparation
si-and-constable-exam-preparation.description: Chala mandiki Police avalani okka pedda dream untundhi, adhe tama jeevitha lakshaynga petukoni prepare ayye vallu chala varaku untaru, kani ee exams ki ela prepare avali, daniki tagina syllabus enti, Eni exams untayi,  asalu emi emi Chaduvukovali, elanti books prefer cheyali ila miku teliyani enno vishyala gurinchi miru ee audio book lo vini telusukovachu.!

pavendar-bharathidasan.title: Pavendar Bharathidasan
pavendar-bharathidasan.description: Subramaniya Bharathi oda varigal namma ellarukum oru bodhai dhaan. Ivar mela konda adhiga madhippin per la dhaan - Barathi dasan nu per vachukittaram. Bharathi oda varigal ivara rombave inspire pannuchu, adhanaalaye avar pola kavidhaigal , kadhaigal puratchigarama yezhudhi irukaaru. Paavendar Bharathidasan oda vaazhkai varalaaru dhaan indha audio book, kekkalam vaanga !

azad-hind-sarkar.title: Azad Hind Sarkar: Dream Of A Warrior
azad-hind-sarkar.description: Kya aapko pata hai 1947 se pehle bhi desh ke baahar ek sarkar bani thi jiska naam tha - Azad Hind Sarkar? Bharat se hazaro kilometere door is sarkaar ke pass apni fauj, apna bank, aur apni government thi. Subhash Chandra Bose hi Bharat ke is pehle azad sarkar ke, pehle Pradhanmantri, Videshmantri aur Rakshamantri the. Netaji ki sena- Azad Hind Fauj se British Sarkar kanpti thi. Netaji ki leadership mein is sena ne na sirf Britishers ko kayi baar haraya, unhone Bharat ke ek bahut bade tukde ko aazad bhi karwaya tha. Aakhir kaun sa rajya tha wo? Desh se baahar kaise bani thi ye sarkar? Kya tha Netaji ka apni sena se sapna?

visithira-sithargal.title: Visithira Sithargal
visithira-sithargal.description: Oru manithan sitha nilaiyai adaiyurathu avvalavu sulabam illa. Appadi patta sitha nilaiyai adainja visithiramaana sithargal pathina pathivu thaan ithu. Ithula sollapatirukka ovvoru sithar um ovvoru vagaiyila visithiramaanavara iruppanga. Sithargal pathina sirappu payanthula Kuku FM oda sernthu payanikka thayaara makkale ?

the-defining-decade.title: The Secret Game Of 20's
the-defining-decade.description: Bade bujurg humesha humein yahi kehte the “Beta abhi shuruaati dino mein mehnat karlo phir tumhari life set hai”. Lekin aaj ke is daur mein hum is baat ka matlab nahi samajh paate hain. Humein lagta hai ki abhi 20’s ka yeh samay to life ko enjoy karne ka hai hum abhi se itni zimmedariyan kyun lein. Lekin doston 20’s ka daur humari life mein sabse zyada mayne rakhta hai yahi vo daur hai jab hum apni life ko ek naya mod de sakte hain, use bana sakte hai ya bigad bhi sakte hain. Isi baat ko aap is Audiobook mein samajh paayenge aur apne 20’s ko apni life mein useful decade bana paayenge.

komaram-bheem.title: Komaram Bheem
komaram-bheem.description: ఆదిలాబాద్ అడవులలోని గోండు జాతిలో పుట్టిన ఇతని బాల్యం , ఉద్యమ స్పూర్తి, నిజామ్ కు వ్యతిరేకంగా చేసిన ఉద్యమం ఇంకా ఎన్నో విషయాలు ఈ ఆడియో విని తెలుసుకొండి.

yogi-vemana.title: Yogi Vemana
yogi-vemana.description: వేమన జీవితం గురించి ప్రచారంలో ఉన్న కథలు ? వేశ్య లోలత్వం నుండి యోగి గా మారిన వేమన కథ మీరు విన్నారా? ఎందుకు వేమన విగ్రహాలు నగ్నంగా ఉంటాయి? ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి

Agar Aap bhi UPSC clear karna chahte hain to suniye yeh interview sirf KUKUFM par.

maha-shiv-ratrir-ojana-kahini.title: Maha Shiv Ratrir Ojana Kahini
maha-shiv-ratrir-ojana-kahini.description: Sara ta  bochor dhore onusthito 12ti mashik utjaponer modhye shob cheye guruttopurno holo Maha shiv ratri. Ei onusthan ti rate utjapito hoi. Mahashiv ratri ba shivratri holo hindu dhormer sorbochoyo debadideb shiv thakurer pujo. Kenoi ba Shiv ratri te nirjola uposh kora hoi?  Ei Maha SHiv ratri phalgun masher krishnapokhyer chotudoshi tithi te palon hoi. Aj amra Maha Shiv ratri somporke jana ojana kahini shune nebo.

why-and-how-congress-was-formed-1.title: Why and How Congress Was Formed?
why-and-how-congress-was-formed-1.description: Indian National Congress nu oru political party pathi namma ellarukume theriyum. Aana adha first form pannadhu oru British kaarar. India makkal oda social and political awareness kaagavum, namma makkal ku needhi kidaikkavum avar idha start pannirukaru. Innum pala mukkiyamana Indian leaders idhula mukkiya pangu vagichurukanga. Melum pala informations ah therinjuka kelunga “Why and How Congress was formed?” on Kuku FM

hero-of-rezang-la-war-1.description: Major Shaitan singh aur unke sathiyon ne puri veerta ke sath dusman ka samna kiya aur apni jaan ki parvah na karte huve apni antim sas tak ladte rhe. Tirange ki shaan ko barkarar rakha. Aaiye sunte hai Bharatmata ke Veer Saputo ke shourya ki kahani sirf Kuku FM per.

rani-lakshmibai.title: Rani Lakshmibai
rani-lakshmibai.description: ఝాన్సీ రాణి లక్ష్మీబాయి స్వాతంత్య్ర పోరాటంలో ఎలాంటి పాత్ర పోషించారు? ఆమె తెగింపు మన భారతదేశ చరిత్రలో ఎలా నిలిచింది? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.!

kormokhetre-egiye-kara-fresher-na-experi.title: Kormokhetre Egiye Kara Fresher Na Experienced ?
kormokhetre-egiye-kara-fresher-na-experi.description: Prithibi Khub Druto Gotite Bodle Choleche. Tai Somoyer Songe Palla Diye Update Hote Hoy. Ekhetre Purono Experience Niye Thakle Seta Aamader Kono Kono Somoy Egonor Bodole Ki Pichiye Dite Pare ? Kono Jaygay Fresher Hisebe Keu Join Kore Se Ki Valo Perform Korte Parbe ? Fresher Ki Onek Khetre Beshi Subidha Peye Thake ? Naki Experienced-ra Egiye Thaken ? Eisob Proshner Somadhan Khujte Aasun Shune Neyoya Jak Ei Audiobook.

संदीप-माहेश्वरी.title: Sandeep Maheshwari : How the boy of Delhi became a Source of Inspiration
संदीप-माहेश्वरी.description: Sandeep Maheshwari ko kaun nahi janta, Inki ek ek Videos mein itni inspiration hoti hai ki aap himmat to kabhi nahi haroge. Sabne inka Muskurata hua chehra YouTube par dekha hoga, Lekin Inki Life story bhi utni hi Inspiring hai. Ek Normal middle class insan ki tarah Padhai, fir Paiso ki ladai fail hona, uthna fir try karna sab kuch hai, iske sath sath apne andar ki awaaz aur Kuch bada karne ki chahat ne Delhi ke Normal Sandeep ko "Sandeep Maheshwari" bana diya. Aapne Biographies to bahut suni aur dekhi hongi lekin ye aapko aapke ek star se aur upar utha degi, aur aap bhi dil pe hath rakhkar ek baar to kahoge ki "Aasan Hai".

pudhaiyunda-thamizhagam.title: Pudhaiyunda Thamizhagam
pudhaiyunda-thamizhagam.description: Kal thondri man thondra kalathe mun thondriya ulagin mootha kudigal aana thamizhargalin varalaatrai aathara poorvamaaga ulagukku eduthu solbavai agazvaaivugal koorum seithigal thaan. Nila Matrum Aazh Kadal Agazhaivugal moolam kidaitha thol porutkalai kondu Karkala Thamizhagam thodangi  Sangakala thamizhagam matrum Varalatru kaala thamizhagam varaikkum makkalin samuga Porulathara Panpattu nilaiyai aathaara poorvamaaga eduthu solgiradhu indha Audio Puthagam. Puthainthu Pona Varalatrai Therinthu Kolla Ninaikkum Ovvoruvarum Nichayam Ketka Vendiya Audio Puthagam Idhu.

blooming-digital-stars.title: Banein Successful Digital Creator
blooming-digital-stars.description: Aaj apne passion ko profession mein badalne ki opportunity sabke paas hai, bus us opportunity ko kaise grab karna hai ye aana chahiye. Jo ki bahut kam logon ko aata hai kyuki humein humesha, kisi company ka CEO kaise bana ja sakta hai? ya kaise ek A level ki government job hasil ki ja sakti hai ye sikhaya jata raha hai. Lekin agar banna hai ek successful digital creator toh abhi suniye KUKU FM ki ye original audiobook, kyuki isme Bhuvan Bam, Ashish Chanchlani aur Ranveer Allahbadia jaise india ke 11 leading digital creators ki kahani hai, jo humein sikhati hai ki kaise ek akela vyakti apne passion ko profession mein badalkar khud ko brand bana sakta hai.

launch-your-life-to-the-next-level-4.title: Launch Your Life To The Next Level
launch-your-life-to-the-next-level-4.description: నిలకడ మరియు ఖఛితమైన విజయాన్ని కావాలనుకుంటున్నారా? మిమ్మల్ని ప్రేరేపించే కొంతమంది వ్యక్తిగత జీవిత ఉదాహరణలు తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

the-sex-cult-of-keith-raniere.title: The Sex Cult of Keith Raniere
the-sex-cult-of-keith-raniere.description: A cult leader who branded women with his initials, a Hollywood actress that pulled aspirants as new recruits in this cult, and conglomerate heiresses that funded this cult full of sexual and financial fraud. Women were asked to send nudes within a minute, locked in a room for two long years, forced to have sex with the guru, and get abortions whenever he asked. He was involved with you, your sisters, and your mother. But then why was NXIVM so famous? Why was it endorsed by international figures like Dalai Lama?

goa-mukti-sangram.title: Goa Mukti Sangram
goa-mukti-sangram.description: Kya aap manenge ki bhartiya azaadi ke 14 saal baad tak Goa akhand bharat ka hissa nahi balki Portugal ka hissa tha. 1961 mein ek jung chidhi, jise naam diya gaya 'Operation Vijay'. Bhartiya sena ne Goan Dictatorship, Salazar Regime par halla bola diya. 17- 19 December tak ladi gayi is jung mein aakhikaar Goa azaad hua. Goa ke kraantikaariyo ne bhi is sangram mein bhartiya sena ka saath diya. Nehru se lekar VP Menon aur Ram Manohar Lohia jaise leaders ne kaise Goa ki azaadi ka naksha racha, jaanenge is KuKu Original series mein.

காதல்-கசடற-கற்க-.title: காதல்.. கசடற... கற்க..!
காதல்-கசடற-கற்க-.description: முதன் முதலில் கல்லூரிக்குள் நுழையும் ஹரிணியை அவளது சீனியர்கள் ரேக் செய்கிறார்கள். வினோத் எனும் மாணவனுக்கு ரோஸ் கொடுக்கும்படி சீனியர்கள் பணித்ததால் ஹரிணி வினோத்துக்கு ரோஸ் கொடுக்கிறாள். அங்கு ஆரம்பிக்கிறது இருவரின் காதல் பயணம். அன்றிலிருந்து இருவருக்குள்ளும் காற்று போல் திசை மாறி அடிக்கும் காதல் இறுதியில் என்ன ஆனது?

shrimanticha-smart-cut.title: Shrimanticha Shortcut
shrimanticha-smart-cut.description: Shikshan, nokari, vyavsay ani vayachya eka tappyavar retirement. Middle class vyaktichya ayushyache he tin mahatvache tappe ahet. Pan atta kal badalat ahe, ani lokana sarva goshti jhatpat havya ahet. patkab shikshan, jhatpat naukari pan jevha retirementchi vel yete tevha loka palatat. Jar aplyala aple swapna lavkar purna karaycha asel tar aplyala aplyat kahi badal karun ghayve lagatil. Atta ha badal kay ani kasa karyacha? toh yogya dishene jatoy ki nahi? tumchya ya prashnanchi uttara tumhala ya show madhe miltil.

detective-ragini-ye-raat-badi-katil-hai.title: Detective Ragini - Ye Raat Badi Katil
detective-ragini-ye-raat-badi-katil-hai.description: Mujrim ko Phansi tak le jane wale Detective Anuj ko hi is baar lag gaya Choona kisi ki Maut ke ilzam ka. Anamika ki Qatil adaaon me ulajh kar phans gaye hain Anuj babu. Akhir kisne racha hai ye Qatilana khel Detective Anuj ke liye ? Kya Detective Ragini bacha payegi apne guru ko is baar ?

v-s-achuthanandan.title: V S Achuthanandan
v-s-achuthanandan.description: Kerala Rashtreeyathile pon tharakamaanu VS. VS enna radaksharam oru mukhavurakalum illathe thanne parichitham aanu Malayalikku. Karshaka porattathinte kanal eriyunna vazhikalilude valarnnu vanna poraliyaya VS enna communist Kerala rashtreeyathile anishedhya nethavayi valarnna kadha aithihaasikamaanu. Mukhyamanthri aayum Prathipaksha nethavaayum janangale nayicha VSnte jeevitha kadha ariyam ee showyilude.

auroville.title: Auroville
auroville.description: Manitha inathoda otrumai kaga oru nagarame uruvakka pattirukku nu solrapo goosebumps ah irukula! Pondicherry ku pakathula irukka Auroville nagarathoda sirappugalaiyum varalaaraiyum intha pathivu moolama neenga kettu therinjukalaam. Ithai kettu mudicha aprm, namma India vula ippadi oru idamaa nu ungala aachariya pada vaikkum. Vaanga City of Dawn pathi kettu therinjukalaam.

disciplined-entrepreneurship.title: Startup Ko Successful Banane Ke Easy Steps
disciplined-entrepreneurship.description: Jab bhi hum Entrepreneurship aur Business ke baare mein sochte hain to sabse pehle humare man mein khayal aata hai ki aakhir kis cheez ka Business kiya jaaye jo sabse alag aur hat kar ho, Aakhir kaise uss Business ko aage badhaya jae aur aakhir kaise hume usme success milegi, Agar aapke man main bhi yahi saare confusion hain ki konsa Business karna chahiye, Kitne paise lagana chahiye, Aur Business ko aage kaise badhana  chahiye to ye "Startup Ko Successful Banane Ke Easy Steps" ki ye Audio Book bilkul aapke liye hai.

chola-empire-rise-and-fall.title: Chola Empire: Rise and Fall
chola-empire-rise-and-fall.description: 9aam noottand muthal 13aam noottand vare Dhakshina Indiaykkum Padinjaaran Asiaykkum chuttumulla pradeshangale bharichirunna Tamil rajavamsham aayirunnu Chola Rajavamsham. Sainika aadhipathyathilude saamrajyam vikasippicha Cholar Kala, Samskaram, Krishi, Vaasthuvidya ennee mekhalakalkku nalkiya sambhavanakal nisthulamaanu. Cholarude samskaaravum parambaryavum innum Dhakshina Indian samskarathil swaadheenam cheluthunnund.

indian-rebellion-of-1857.title: Indian Rebellion Of 1857
indian-rebellion-of-1857.description: Indiayude charithrathile nazhikakallayirunnu 1857-il nadana onnam Indian swathanthra samaram. Annu India bharichukondirunna English East India Companyude bharannathe kidilam kollicha charithraparamaaya poraatathinte pinnile kaaranangal enthayirunnu? Ee kalaapam parajayapedanulla kaaranangal enthayirunnu? Vishadhamayi ariyam ee showiloode.

the-autobiography-of-charles-darwin.title: The Autobiography of Charles Darwin
the-autobiography-of-charles-darwin.description: Darwin ek aise insaan jo naturalist, geologist, aur  biologist they aur jinki evolution ki theory hum sab ke beech me bahut popular hai , ye audiobook me aap unke mind aur character development ki  yaado ke baare me sunenge , to chaliye sunte hai , unki kahani unhi ki zubani.

gender-discrimination-in-sports.title: Changing The Game - Women in Sports
gender-discrimination-in-sports.description: Even though we are in the 21st century and both genders are considered equals, at least in theory, there are still a number of challenges that women athletes continue to face, including harassment and gender discrimination in sports at all levels of play. While the participation of females in sports has risen significantly, a 2019 study conducted at Purdue University, indicated that the needle on media coverage of women’s sports has only moved a tiny fraction over the past 30 years. So, what are the challenges that female athletes face, what are the positive changes in the world for sport for women, and what more can be done to empower female athletes? Listen to this informative show exclusively on KUKU FM, to find out.

being-mortal.title: Budhape Ki Taiyari
being-mortal.description: Ek kahawat hai ki " Budhapa ek aisa kadwa sach hai jise har kisi ko apnaana hi hota hai" lekin old age mein aajane ke baad bhi aap kayi pareshaniyon ko kaise khud se dur rakh sakte hain yeh sab jaanege hum is original series mein jise sunkar aap apni old age ko kaise gale laga ke hello keh sakte hain aur kaise pehchan sakte hain ki aap young hokar bhi old age ke qarib aa rahe hain. To chaliye jaante hain kya hai kahaani old age ki.

keralavum-kraisthavarum.title: Keralavum Kraisthavarum
keralavum-kraisthavarum.description: Christhumathavum avarude aachara anushdaanangalum Kerala samoohathinu ennu valare suparichithamanu. Ennal Christumatham engane anu Keralathil verurappichathu? Christian missionarykalude aadya kaala pravarthanam engane aayirunnu? Enthokke sambhaavanakalaanu Keralathinu avar nalkiyathu? Aa charitram koodi ulpeduthumbozhe Kerala charitram poorthiyavuka ullu.

history-of-kerala-politics.title: History Of Kerala Politics
history-of-kerala-politics.description: Keralathinte piravi muthal innuvareyulla Kerala rashtreeyathil nadanittula chila pradhaanapetta uyarchakalum thaazhchakalum vijayangalum kolaahalangalum ellam vishadhamaayi ariyu 'History Of Kerala Politics' enna ee showiloode.

the-motivation-myth.title: Say 'NO' To Fake Motivation
the-motivation-myth.description: Jab bhi hum kabhi mayus hote hain humein zaroorat hoti hai thode motivation ki par kya har bar motivation humare liye sahi hota hai? Iska jawab apko milega is Original Show mein. Jismein apko farzi motivation aur sahi motivation ke beech ka antar bataya jayega. Sath hi aap motivation ki sahi definition ko samajh paayenge aur apni situation ke hisab se phir apne aap ko sahi motivate kar paayenge jis se aapke liye aane wala raasta ekdum clear ho jayega.

black-hole-tragedy-of-kolkata.title: Black Hole Tragedy of Kolkata
black-hole-tragedy-of-kolkata.description: Black hole ashole ki? Black Hole holo mohakasher emon ekti jayega jekhane madhyakorshon eto beshi tane je alo ber hote apre na. Madhyakorshon eto shoktishali howar karone podartho guli ekti khudro sthaner modhye chaapa pore jaye. Black hole khali chokhe dekha jaye na. Karon black hole theke kono alo berote pare na. thik erokomi ghotona ghotechilo Bharatborshe. Ki exactly hoyechilo Bharatborshe? Ba Ki exactly hoyechilo amader Bangla e jake Black Holer songe tuloniyo? Shei shob ei audiobook ti theke shune nin.

meluha-mruthyunjayulu.title: Meluha Mruthyunjayulu
meluha-mruthyunjayulu.description: ఒకప్పటి గొప్ప చక్రవర్తి అయిన శ్రీ రాముడు నిర్మించిన మెలుహ  సామ్రాజ్యంలో వారికి జీవనది అయిన సరస్వతి రోజురోజుకీ  ఎండిపోతూ క్షీణిస్తున్న కారణంగా  సూర్యవంశ పరిపాలకులు ఇప్పుడు ఎన్నో కష్టాలను ఎదురుకుంటున్నారు, ఇది కాకుండా తూర్పు దేశంలోని చంద్రవంశీయులు నాగా తెగ వారితో చేతులు కలిపి నిరంతరం ఈ ప్రాంతంపై దాడులు చేసేవారు. ఈ గడ్డు కాలంలో సూర్యవంశీయులకు మిగిలిన ఏకైక విశ్వాసం టిబెట్టు నుండి వలస వచ్చిన శివ అనే యువకుడు. విధి మూలంగా అక్కడికి చేరుకున్న శివ సూర్యవంశ నాయకుడుగా చెడును అంతమొందిస్తాడా? ఒకవేళ చేస్తే ఎలా చేసాడు వంటి ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో వినండి.

ashta-vinayak-ki-teerth-yatra.title: Ashtavinayak Mandiro ki Kahani
ashta-vinayak-ki-teerth-yatra.description: Ashtavinayak ki yatra ko hamare Bharat mein sabse pavitra yatrao mein se ek mana jata hai. Magar kya aap iska karan jante hai? Kyun in 8 hi mandiro ka mahatva hai? Kya hai inki kahaniyan? Chaliye jaane!

long-distance-relationship-bachaben-kiva.title: Long Distance Relationship Banchaben Kivabe ?
long-distance-relationship-bachaben-kiva.description: Ekhnonkar Social Mediar Juge Somporkogulo Jeno Kromosho Dure Sore Jacche. Pashapashi Bose Hat Dhore Golpo Korar Theke Social Media Nirvor Hoye Poreche Somporkogulo. Echarao Chakri Sutre Bideshe Ba Vinrajye Pari Dite Hocche. Erfole Somporko Gulote Kichuta Provab Porche. Dujon Manush Chokher Aaral Holei Bivinno Choto Choto Karone Jhamla Korche Erfole Somporke Chir Dhorche. Kintu Ebar Proshno Holo Long Distance Relationship Kivabe Bachano Jay ? Kivabe Dujonei Happy Thakte Parbe ? Kivabe Bhul Bojhabujhigulo Bondho Kora Jay ? Kivabe Songike Somoy Deben ? Eisob Proshner Uttor Pete Aapnake Shunte Hobe Ei Audiobook.

investment-opportunities-in-kerala.title: Investment Opportunities In Kerala
investment-opportunities-in-kerala.description: Uyarnna saksharatha nirakk, uyarnna aayur dhairkyam, ettavum kuranja janasankhya valarcha, Indiayil ettavum uyarnna sthree-purusha anupatham ennivayulla manushya vikasana soochakangalil uyarnna score-ulla Keralathil orupaad investment opportunities und. Ath ethokeyanenn ariyam ee showiloode.

the-way-of-integrity.title: 4 Steps Towards Happier Life
the-way-of-integrity.description: Integrity ka matlab samjhe to, Imandar hone aur strong moral principles rakhne ka gun aur iss audiobook se hum sikhenge ki Integrity ke sath life kaise jee jaye. Iss audiobook se hum janenge ki kaise hum apni life ko ek rediscovering life bana sakte hai aur kis tarike se apne real version ko find karke ek aisi life jee sakte hai jo hum actually mein jeena chahte hai. Hum yeh bhi samjhenge ki kaise Elon Musk, Milkha Singh ne apne iss gun ke saath apne liye ek alag way of life banai aur life mein success of hasil kiya. Agar aapko "The Rudest Book Ever" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

jeshob-skills-bodle-debe-apnar-bhobishyo.title: Jeshob Skills Bodle Debe Apnar Bhobishyot
jeshob-skills-bodle-debe-apnar-bhobishyo.description: Apnio ki chakri khujte khujte hotash hoye porechen? Ba apni ki ekjon emon chakrijibi jar betone ajker jibone khub samannyo bhabe jibon japon korao khub difficult hoye poreche? Apnar ki mone hoi ekta bhalo chakri pawar jonnyo jei high qualification er dorkar pore seta apnar nei? Ajkal kar dine ekta bhalo chakri pete hole joto na ekta bhalo degree dorkar tar thekeo beshi dorkari holo emon skills thaka jegulo tar ba onnyoder kaje asbe. Ei audiobook ti theke jante parben je kon kon skills sikhe nijer jibon ebong chakri secure korte parben.

kaashi-2.title: Kashi
kaashi-2.description: Ranjhana movie ke Kundan-Zoya ki love story ho ya masaan movie ke Deepak-Shaalu Ki kahani, Bollywood Kashi ki galiyon mein panapti love stories se to waqif karata hi hai. Lekin kashi mein sirf love stories hi nahi basti. Kashi mein basta hai sukoon, shanti, aastha, aur gyaan. Kehte hain bharat mein aastha aur itihas ka asli rang sirf kashi mein ghula hua hai. Aur isi kashi se milaane ke lie hum layein hain Kuku FM par yeh original series “Kashi". jismein hum apko aastha se bhare kashi aur uski galiyon mein baste rehen sehen ke barein mein apko jankari denge. Is show ko sunkar aap kashi ko na sirf achhe se samajh paoge balki Kashi se man se jud jaoge.

bhagat-singh-16.title: Bhagat Singh
bhagat-singh-16.description: Sarfaroshi ki tamanna ab hamare dil me hai.. dekhna hai jor kitna bajue katil me hai. Bhagat Singh vishayi tumhi anek pustke, lekh vachle astil pan tyanchya swaparichay denara saransh amhi tumchya sathi gheun aloy. Bhagat Singh yanchya swaparichaya sathi ha saransh nakki aika

the-great-indian-bustard.title: The Great Indian Bustard
the-great-indian-bustard.description: Son Chiraiya ek aisa bird jo aaj kal to humare aas paas nahi dikhta  , lekin shaadi ke gaano me aur indian culture me iss bird ka mention kafi samay se hota aa raha hai! aksar ghar ki betiyon ko ghar ki son chiraiya kaha jata hai , kyu is bird ko chhod kar peacock ko national bird chuna gaya aur achanak ye chidiya kaise gayab ho gayi? chaliye jante hai KUKU FM original “The Great Indian Bustard” mein.

power-star-pawan-kalyan.title: Power Star Pawan Kalyan
power-star-pawan-kalyan.description: ఇల్లేమో దూరం... దారంతా గతుకులు,  అసలే చీకటి... చేతిలో దీపం లేదు! కానీ నా ధైర్యమే నా కవచం, నా ధైర్యమే నా ఆయుధం!. తన అన్నయ్య సహాయంతో సినిమా రంగానికి వచ్చినా కూడా తనకంటూ ఒక ప్రత్యేక గుర్తింపు , తనకంటూ ఒక ప్రత్యేక అభిమాన సముద్రాన్ని సంపాదించుకున్న నటుడు,రాజకీయ నాయకుడు పవన్ కళ్యాణ్ బాల్యం,సినీ ప్రస్థానం,వ్యక్తిగత,రాజకీయ జీవితం, ఇంకా కొణిదెల పవన్ కళ్యాణ్ గురించి మరెన్నో విషయాలు  ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో తెలుసుకుందాం …

attukal-pongala.title: Attukal Pongala
attukal-pongala.description: Manassu niraye bhakthiyum santhoshavum nirachu Attukal Ammakku pongala arppikkan pongala divasam pathinaayirakkanakkinu sthree janangalaanu Ananthapuriyil ethunnathu. Sthreekalude sabarimala ennu ariyapedunna Attukal Kshetrathinte charitravum pongalayude mahatwavum ariyam 'Attukal Pongala' enna showilude

panchayati-raj-system.title: Understanding of Panchayati Raj
panchayati-raj-system.description: Waise to Panchayati Raj ki shuruaat aazadi ke baad hui hai lekin iski jaden Vedic age se judi hui hai. Aapko ye jaan kar hairani hogi ki jis panchayati Raj ki hum baat kar rahe hain waise hi panchayat ki vyavastha Vedic age mein bhi moujood thi. Par kya hai Panchayati Raj? Kab hui iski Shuruwat? Kisne ki iski Shuruwat?Jaanenge iss Original Audio show "Understanding of Panchayati Raj" mein.

the-science-of-getting-rich-4.title: The Science of Getting Rich
the-science-of-getting-rich-4.description: Eluppathil panam sambhadhikkan aagrahikkunavaranu nammal ellavarum. Nikshepathinu jeevithathil sthanam nalkiyal sambath ningale thedi varumennum namukk ariyam. Pakshe, ningalk ariyamo? Sambannanakan nikshepangal mathram pora! Mattu factors enthanen ariyaan The Science of Getting Rich enna pusthakathinte ee summary kelku.

kono-product-kenar-aagey-eigulo-vebe-dek.title: Kono Product Kenar Aagey Eigulo Vebe Dekhechen ?
kono-product-kenar-aagey-eigulo-vebe-dek.description: Bortomane Bajare Aasa Sob Product Er Eki Golpo Hoy. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Ekkhuni Shune Nin.

sunanda-punshkar-found-dead.title: Sunanda Pushkar Found Dead
sunanda-punshkar-found-dead.description: Taarik 17 January 2014, Aasamaan mein baadal garaj rahe the, bauth zoron ki baarish ho rahi thi, Jahan ek ore baarish rukne ka naam nahi le rahi thi, Wahin doosri ore Police aur Media ki gadi isse bhi tez raftar se ek Hotel ki taraf badh rahi thee, Jis Hotel mein paai jaati hai Sunanda Pushkar ki dead body. Aakhir kya hai iss maut ke piche ki kahani? aur kya Connection hai Congress Leader Shashi Tharoor aur Pakistani Journalist ka iss case se? Iss Death mystery ko Jaanne ke liye suniye humari ye Audio series "Sunanda Pushkar Found Dead".

the-declining-marriage-rate.title: Are Marriages Over Forever?
the-declining-marriage-rate.description: Marriage is a lifelong commitment between two people who have decided to join their lives together forever. It is widely seen as a key to happiness and well-being. But what if this social institution was examined more carefully? In the United States, marriage has undergone a dramatic transformation in recent decades. Across all race and ethnic groups, Americans are waiting longer to get married, with the median age of first marriage surging from 25 in 1980 to 28 today. This decline in the marriage rate in the U.S. impacts the economy, future generations, the population as well as the crime rate in the country. Listen to this exclusive informative documentary.

daily-inspiration-1.title: How To Live An Inspirational Life?
daily-inspiration-1.description: Kabhi Auto-riksha me baithe hai aap? Haan haan ek jagah se dusri jagah jaane ke liye, lekin agar aap se mai kahu ki "How To Live An Inspirational Life?" ki hamari is audiobook me hamare paas ek aisa auto riksha wala hai jo sirf pick and drop hi facility hi nahi balki aapki daily life se judi problems ke solution bhi dega to kya aap iss baat pe yakeen karenge?Toh chaliye bina time waste kiye hamare 1st Episode ke saath apni ride shuru karte hai.

firm-decision-kasa-ghyava.title: FIRM DECISION KASA GHYAVA
firm-decision-kasa-ghyava.description: Konta hi nirnay ghetna apan itke confuse hoto ki apan ghetlela nirnay barobar ahe ka chuk? Apan ghetlelya nirnayache aplyavar ani aplya ajubajuchya mansanvar chukiche parinam tar honar nahit na?  hey sagle prashna aplya manat yetat ani ya sarva prashnanchi uttara aplyala Firm Decision Kasa Ghyava ya Kuku Fmchya khas show madhye milnar ahet.

cash-flow-quadrant-2.title: Cashflow Mantra

he-prince-and-the-rainbow.description: Coming out to one's parents is difficult, even in the best of circumstances. However, a breakdown in the early 2000s sent him on a course that resulted in him becoming one of the nation's top advocates for LGBTQ+ rights and being acclaimed by many as the only openly gay prince in the world. This special presentation explores the life and activism of Manvendra Singh Gohil while taking a dive into the Prince's journey, including his family background, his coming out, and his activism for LGBTQ+ rights in India. The show offers valuable information and insights into the life and activism of Manvendra Singh Gohil and the state of LGBTQ+ rights in India. Through this show, you will gain a deeper understanding of one of the most important and relevant social issues in India today. Tune in to stay informed and educated about this inspiring story of courage and activism.

Biyer jaak jomok kotota hobe tar purotai nirbhor kore budget er por. Ki kore etogulo taka ek sathe jogar jaye? Ki bhabe khub sohojei jak jomoke bhoriye biyer daityo palon kora shombhob. Apnaro jodi biyer budget niye anek proshno theke thake, ba biyer budget er khuti nati jante chaan shune nin ei audiobok ti.

charlie-chaplin-2.title: Charlie Chaplin
charlie-chaplin-2.description: Thirai vazhkaiyin moolam Ulakaiye thanathu nagaichuvai nadippaal sirikka vaitha makkal kalaignan Charlie Chaplin avargalin Nija vazhkai sothanaigalum  thuyarangalum niraintha ondraagave irunthirukirathu, Ethanai idargal vanthalum kalangaamal thunindhu nindru vetri petra oru maberum kalaignanin vazhkai varalatru pathivu idhu. Chaplin avargalin indha vazhkai pathivil avarathu thiraipadangal patriya pala ariya matrum suvarasyamana thagavalgalum irukkirathu. Vaanga kekalam.

bs-the-saint-the-surfer-and-the-ceo.title: How To Live A Peaceful Life
bs-the-saint-the-surfer-and-the-ceo.description: Kya aap apni life se satisfied nahi feel karte, kya aap ye sochte rehte hai ki aapne apni life me jo decisions liye hai wo sahi hai bhi ya nahi ya aapko aisa feel hota ki aapse koi pyaar hi nhi karta, agar ye saare sawaal aapke dimag me ghumte rehte hai to inka jawab aapko is audiobook me milega aur aapke in sawalon ka jawab denge teen "Guru's" jinse aapki mulakat alag alag episodes me hogi. To bina time waste karein shuru karte hai.

khoroch-komanor-sohoj-upay.title: Khoroch Komanor Sohoj Upay
khoroch-komanor-sohoj-upay.description: Aamra Doinondin Jibone Kokhono Kokhono Emon Kaj Kore Feli Jeta Hoyto Na Korleo Cholto. Vabchen Ki Kaj ? Thik Kaj Noy Okaj Bolleo Chole. Ekhane Okaj Bolte Taka Opochoyer Kotha Bola Hocche. Aamder Moddhey Emon Onek Manush Aachen Jara Protiniyoto Eta Kore Thaken. Ebar Proshno Holo Emon Kichu Ki Secret Aache Ja Ei Taka Opochoyer Theke Aatkate Pare ? Aar Chinta Nei Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audiobook, Ja Aapnake Help Korbe Khoroch Komate. Sekhabe Kivabe Kichu Sohoj Upay Diye Khoroch Komano Jay. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak.

subrahmanyam-jaishankar-er-chokhe-aagami.title: Subrahmanyam Jaishankar-Er Chokhe Aagamir Bharat
subrahmanyam-jaishankar-er-chokhe-aagami.description: Bivinno Desh Nijer Ostittwoke Tikiye Rakhe Bivinno Bideshniti Grohon Koreche. Bharoter Ei Poristhitite Dariye Emon Bideshniti Grohon Korte Hobe Ja Porobortite Bharoteke Shoktishali Deshgulor Songe Mokabila Korte Help Korbe. Se Kothai Bolchen Bortoman Bharoter Bideshmontri Subrahmanyam Jaishankar. Prachin Bharot Theke Shuru Kore Bortoman Bharoter Bidehnitir Ek Ruprekha Tini Diyechen Ei Audiobook E. Sonkotkale Desh Kivabe Mokabila Koreche Theke Shuru Kore Aagami Dine Bidesh Nitir Khetre Bharoter Ki Ki Podokkhep Nite Hote Pare Eirokom Kichu Kotha Tini Bolechen Tar Dirgho Oviggota Diye. Aasun Shune Neyoya Jak.

death-served-cold.title: Death Served Cold
death-served-cold.description: iss show me aapko aisi stories sun ne milegi jo aapko sochne par majboor kar degi , “kya aisa sach me hua hoga?” , kuch dangerous women ki kahani jo apko mumkin na lage, to chaliye sunte hai pyaar , affair , passion ,zidd aur murders se bhari ye stories , Sourabh Mukharjee ki likhi “Death served cold” ki audiobook mein.

because-crazy-is-a-compliment.title: Crazy Asnyache Fayde
because-crazy-is-a-compliment.description: Jag ashya lokanni bharlele aahe je udyojagtechya baabtit dhoka patkarnyaas ghabartaat. Pan tumhala motha vichaar karava laagto aani swapna chya pathi dhavava lagta .Hi Series Dware Tumhala Kalel ki kalpananna purna kase karaychya. Ya series madhye kahi mahan leaders chya anubhav sangnyat ale ahet jyatun aplyala barech kahi shikava lagnar ahe.

statue-of-unity.title: Statue Of Unity
statue-of-unity.description: Mana prapancham lone athi pedda statue Sardar vallabhbhai patel garidi. ee vigrahaniki enno Visistatalu unayi. e vigrahaniki chudaniki desha videshala nunchi aneka mandi osthu untaru. asalu e vigrahaniki intha prathyekatha enduku ochindi, sardar garine statue of unity ga enduku petaru, deni venukuna rahasayalu enti illa aneka vishyalu miru ee audio book lo vini telusukovachu.!

smart-calling.title: Improve your Sales with Smart Calling
smart-calling.description: Aapko pata hai “Telecalling” marketing ka ek aise effective way hai jo leads and customers ko reach karne ke liye 1990s se chalta chala aa raha hai and still shayad hi aise koi industry ho jaha telecalling ka use na hota ho, so in saari baaton se aap ek baat to zaroor samajh gaye honge ki Telecalling ek aisa zariya hai jo aapke career aur business dono ke liye hi kaafi profitable saabit ho sakti hai and agar aapko telecalling se related A to Z jo kuch bhi jaan-na hai to wo aapko "Improve your Sales with Smart Calling" ki audiobook ke andar milega, to bina time waste kiye shuru karte hai.

anand-mahindra.title: Anand Mahindra
anand-mahindra.description: ಇವರ ಒಂದು ಟ್ವೀಟ್ ಯಾರಾದರೋ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ...! ಯಾವದಾದರೂ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಪರಿಹಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ...! ಇವರ ಒಂದು ಸಹಾಯಹಸ್ತ ಬಡವನ ಬದುಕನ್ನು ದಡ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ...!ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತಲೇ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಚಮಚ ಬಾಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರೂ, ಅದನ್ನು ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸದೇ, ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಸ್ವಂತ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ ಕಟ್ಟಿದವರು...! ಇವರು ಎಂದರೆ, ಭಾರತದ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಲೋಕದ ದಿಗ್ಗಜ ಆನಂದ ಗೋಪಾಲ್ ಮಹಿಂದ್ರಾ.ಸಿನಿಮಾ ನಟರಾಗಬೇಕಿದ್ದವರು, ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಮ್ಯಾನ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ನಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ಮಹಿಂದ್ರಾ ಕಂಪನಿಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಎತ್ತಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ್ರು ಹೇಗೆ? ಸೋಶಿಯಲ್ ಮೀಡಿಯಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಿನಿಮಾ ತಾರೆಯರಷ್ಟು ಇವರಿಗೆ ಯಾಕೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ಕ್ರೇಜ್? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'ಆನಂದ ಮಹಿಂದ್ರಾ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ KuKuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

story-of-a-baba-who-inspired-steve-jobs-.title: Story Of Baba Who Inspired Steve Jobs & Zuckerberg
story-of-a-baba-who-inspired-steve-jobs-.description: Uttarakhand ke Nainitaal main situated hai ek aisa ashram jo sirf india he nahi balki world main ek special status hold karta hai,  mystery toh yeh hai ki aakhir kyu ek bahut he maamuli, tough himalaya ke godh mein base iss remote ashram mein duniya bhar se log aate hain ? aur kyu yeh jagha unhe attract karti hai?  aakhir kyu iss mamooli se jagha ko duniya ke brilliant tech minds ne visit kiya ? chahe Steve Jobs ho ya Zuckerberg ya phir Larry Page ya eBay ke founder Jeffrey Skoll. Aaiye jaante hain kya hai iss ashram aur guru se judi kahani sirf KUKU FM par .

decoding-raman-raghavan.title: Decoding Raman Raghavan
decoding-raman-raghavan.description: History lo Enno Murders chesaru kani kevalam Chachhe valla Artha chavu kekalu vini Satisifaction pondam kosam intha kiratakanga… elanti reason lekunda 41 mandini murder chesi okappdu Mumbai Prajalaku nidra pattakunda chesina Nararoopa Rakshashudu ‘Raman Raghavan’ gurichi Ee Audio book lo telusukobotunnaru. Raman Raghavan evaru, ekkadi nundi vachhadu, em chestundevaddu, Intha mandini ela murder chesadu , final ga ela police ki dorikipoyadu vanti complete details ee Audio book Meeku Andistunnam. Ee Audio book vinna tarwatha Meeku definite ga Oka Thriller Movie chusiana feeling kalugutundi.

a-guide-to-sex-education.title: A Guide To Sex Education
a-guide-to-sex-education.description: సెక్స్ అంటే బూతు మాట కాదు కదా? పిల్లలకు సెక్స్ ఎడ్యుకేషన్ అవసరమా ? టీనేజ్ నుండి ఓల్డ్ ఏజ్ వరకు అందరూ తెలుసుకోవాల్సిన సెక్స్ విషయాలు మీకోసం.

gustakhiyan-1.title: Gustakhiyan
gustakhiyan-1.description: Apne hi ghar mein sauteli hone ka dard har roz suhana ko maar raha tha, lekin apne bhaai ke ilaaj ke liye wo har dard khushi-khushi piye ja rahi thi. Kya Harsh ke aane se uski zindagi ki har mushkil aasan ho jayegi? Ya wo apne maa baap ke liye saude ka Zariya ban kar rah jayegi? Janane ke liye sunein “Gustakhiyan” sirf KuKuFM par

pallavar-varalaru.title: Pallavar Varalaru
pallavar-varalaru.description: Pallavargal intha Tamil mannai aanda kathai namakku theriyum. Avanga epperpatta aatchiyai nadathunanga, entha maathiriyaana valarchi ellaam kondu vanthaanga, Pallava mannargaloda kalai aarvam eppadi pattathu ? , ithellam therinjukka intha puthagam ungalukku uthaviyaa irukkum. Vaanga Pallavar kaalathai nokki oru payanam seivom.

rocket-scientistder-moto-vabte-sikhun.title: Rocket Scientist-Der Moto Vabte Sikhun
rocket-scientistder-moto-vabte-sikhun.description: Aamra Pray Bole Thake 'Arey Bhai Ei Kajta Etota Kothin Noy Tui Jotota Vabchis, Eta Thori Na Rocket Science'. Konodin Vebe Dekhechen Keno Bola Hoye Thake Ei Kothata? Rocket Science Ki Khub Kothin Bishoy? Prithibite Dariye Chander Onko Solve Koro Jekhane Vul Korar Kono Jayga Nei. Ebar Proshno Holo Kemon Hon Ei Rocket Scientistra? Tarao Ki Aamader Moton Kore Vaben Naki Tader Vabna Chinta Ektu Druto Hoy? Nishchoi Aapnar Jante Icche Korche Ei Bishoyguli. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Nite Hobe Ei Audiobook.

vastu-shastra.title: Vastu Shastra
vastu-shastra.description: Vastu shastra - ek aisa science aur kala ka combination jo kai salo purana hai par itna accurate hai ke aaj bhi builders, designers is script ki madad se ghar banate hai. Chaliye samajhte hai “Vastu shastra” aur sikhte hai ke kaise hum bhi simple steps ko follow karke , Apne ghar ko prosperous aur family member ki health ko acha rakh sakte hai.

ignore-everybody-2.title: Durlaksha kara ani Pragati kara
ignore-everybody-2.description: Ekhadya vyaktila complete ignore karna he tyachasathi insulting asu shakta. Udya aplya sobat hi asa koni kela tar aplyalatras hoil. Pan tumcha Growth sathi jar tumhala konala ingonre karyla sangitla tar. Lekhak mhntat ki, Jya goshtimule kinva mansanmule aplya pragati madhe adhthala nirman hot asro tyancha kade durlksha kara ani pudhe ja. Toxic, Negative ani Dishabhul karnarya goshtina va Mansana ignore karun life madhe pudhe kasa jaycha, apli pragati kashi karychi ya vishayi he audio book tumhala margadrshan karte.

nischit-chakri.title: Nischit Chakri
nischit-chakri.description: Apni ki chakri khujchen? B ja chakri korchen tar theke better chakri khujchen? Apni ki etateo bhabchen je ei desh e ar chakri kothaye? Ki bhabe nijer moner moto chakri paben? Bhabchen je anek kom sikkhya orjon kore chakrir asha korchen. Apnio jodi moner moto chakri pete chan tahole shune nin aj ker audiobook ti.

apne-business-ko-bechna-seekho.title: Apne Business ko Bechna Seekho
apne-business-ko-bechna-seekho.description: Covid ke baad se Startup Industry mein naye naye Idea's bahut dekhne ko mil rahe, Jyadatar log Startup shuru karna chahte hai, Business kholna chahte hai. Startup karna, Khud ka Business kholna bahut achcha bhi sound karta hai lekin kya aap jante hai 95% se jyada business pahle 3 salo mein hi band ho jate hai. Iski badi vajah hai, Sahi Time par sahi Execution ka na hona hai, agar Business ki foundation hi weak hogi to uska grow hona bahut mushkil hai. Is Series mein hum Startup aur Business Foundation ke bare mein achche se janenge ki kaise hum apne Business ko valuable bana sakte hai jisse ki hum bhi ek successful business khada kar paye. Agar aapko Gary Keller dwara likhi "The One Thing: The Surprisingly Simple Truth Behind Extraordinary Results" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

dana-veera-shoora-karna.title: Dana veera Shoora Karna
dana-veera-shoora-karna.description: Mahaa veerudaina Karnuni Jananam nundi maranam varaku, ee Audio Book vinandi.

sant-tukaram.title: Sant Tukaram Maharaj
sant-tukaram.description: Mahrashtrala labhlelya samrudha Santa paramparetil ek thor santa mhaje- Santa Tukaram Maharaj. Tukaram maharajani aplya Abhangan madhun samajala Jeevanacha khara artha sangitla. Sukhi ani samadhani jeevnacha mulmantra tyani lokanparaynt pochavla. Shekado varshanpurvi tyani kelela updesh aajhi tantotant lagu hoto. Chala tar mag janun gheuya, Santa Tuakaramchi prernadayi jeevan gatha. Tuka mhane...

palmistry.title: Palmistry
palmistry.description: Palmistry ke according humari kismat poori tarah se humare hathon mein chapi hoti hai. Yaha tak ki humare hathon ki ekdam bareek rekhaon ki bhi bahut importance hoti hai. Aur in rekhaon ko padh kar apni kismat ka pata lagane ke liye is show se perfect aur kuch nahi ho sakta. Kyuki isme aapke hath ki har ek choti se choti rekha ko bhi detail mein samjhaya gaya hai. Jo ki sirf aam logon ke liye hi nahi balki astrology aur palmistry ke experts ke liye bhi beneficial hai.

how-to-deal-with-the-toxicity-at-the-wor.title: How To Deal With The Toxicity At The Work Space
how-to-deal-with-the-toxicity-at-the-wor.description: మీరు జాబ్ చేసే ప్లేస్ టాక్సిక్ గా ఉందా? కొలీగ్స్ తో సరిగ్గా ఉండలేకపోతున్నారా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోసమే. వెంటనే వినండి

kaise-kholein-apni-dukaan.title: Kaise Kholein Apni Dukaan
kaise-kholein-apni-dukaan.description: Hum kitni bhi acchi job kyu na karlen lekin Apna Khudka business kholne se jyada satisfying aur kuch bhi nahi hota. Fir Chahe vo ek dukaan hi kyon na ho, jiske   bare mein hum aksar sochte toh hai lekin khol nahi pate, kyonki uske liye humare pass iss show jaisa koi guide nahi hai. Ye show har us insaan ke liye bana hai jo apni khudki ek dukaan kholna chahta hai. Planing se lekar use kholne ke baad kaise profit earn karna hai iski ek ek jaankari isme di gai hai.

the-future-of-payments.title: The Future of Payments: How UPI is Changing the Game
the-future-of-payments.description: Unified Payments Interface, developed by NPCI and regulated by the Reserve Bank of India, was launched in 2016. And ever since then, it has seen a significant scale-up in transactions. This mobile-only payment system has revolutionized the Indian economy and is on a path to dominate the world. This special presentation explores the rise of the UPI in India and the impact it is having on the country's financial system and offers a close look into the history and evolution of UPI, its key features, and the ways it is transforming the way people make and receive payments in India. Whether you're interested in finance or just curious about the future of payments in India, this show is a must-listen. It offers valuable information and insights on the evolution of UPI, its key features, and impact on the financial system. Learn about one of the most important and relevant topics in the world of finance today.

the-happiest-man-on-earth-2.title: The Happiest Man On Earth
the-happiest-man-on-earth-2.description: జీవితంలో ఎప్పడూ సంతోషంగా ఉండాలంటే ఏం చేయాలి? మనకు ఎన్ని కష్టాలు ఎదురైనా కూడా ఆనందంగా ఎలా ఉండాలి? ఇవి తెలుసుకోవాలంటే మీరు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే.

how-to-file-tax.title: How to file Tax?
how-to-file-tax.description: Tax ka naam sunte hi logon ke hosh ud jate hai. Wajah? Unhe iss baat ki awareness hi nahi hoti ki Tax wakayi mein hai kya? Aur ise kab kab aur kin kin logon ko chukana padta hai. Kyunki agar log aware hote to unhe ye acche se pata hota ki Tax koi naye zamane ka bojh nahi. Balki yeh saalon se chali aa rahi humari responsibility hai. Issi baat ko samjhane aur logon ko Tax ke baare mein aware karne ke liye, sune humari ye audiobook. Jisme Tax se jude sabhi sawalon ke jawab dene ki humne koshish ki hai.

mullaperiyar.title: Mullaperiyar
mullaperiyar.description: Enthinanu Mullaperiyar dam inte peril Tamil Nadinum Keralathinum idayil ithra tharkangal? 125 varshathilera pazhakkamulla ee daminte constructionil enthanu ithra prethyekatha? Enthanu Mullaperiyar daminte 999-year lease agreementil parenjirikkunna vyavasthakal? Vishadhamayi ariyam ee showiloode.

yakshi-muthal-kuttichathan-vare.title: Yakshi Muthal Kuttichathan Vare
yakshi-muthal-kuttichathan-vare.description: Yakshi, Gandharvan, kutty chaathan, maadan, marudha, thandan, odiyan thudangiya aamanushikatha niranjavare kurichulla pedipeduthunnathum athbhudhapeduthunnathumaya kadhakal kelku.

the-great-sparrow-of-china.title: The Great Sparrow Campaign Of China
the-great-sparrow-of-china.description: 2019 mein Corona Virus ko banane wala China ke lie yeh pehli baar nahi tha jab uski wajah se lakhon logon ko apni jaan ganwani padi ho . China aisa bahut waqt se karta aa raha hai America se apni niji dushmani ke chalte China ne pehle bhi aise decisions liye hain jinse masum logon ko apni jaan deni padi ho. Aisa hi ek daur tha The Great Sparrow Campaign ka jab China ne ek nanhi si chidiya ko maarne ka farmaan jaari kar diya lekin nature ke sath khilwad karne par China ko saamna karna pada aisi khatarnaak bhukhmari ka jis se China mein millions logon ki jaan gayi. Aisa kyun hua aur kyun China ki sarkaar ne chidiya ke namonishan ko mitane ka farmaan jari kar diya yeh sab jaanege hum is original series mein.

kivabe-peroben-jiboner-berajal.title: Kivabe Peroben Jiboner Berajal ?
kivabe-peroben-jiboner-berajal.description: Aamra Jibone Nana Somosyar Moddhey Diya Jai. Kokhn Hya Bola Uchit Kokhn Na Bola Uchit Thik Kore Uthte Pari Na. Oneke Aabar Onyoke Khushi Korte Giye Na Ba Hya Bolen, Ete Tara Nijeder Jibon Otistho Kore Tolen. Nijeke Ekta Simanar Moddhey Aatke Rakhay Barte Thake Hotasha. Ebar Proshno Holo Ei Simana Kivabe Perono Jay? Kivabe Kokhon Hya Aar Kokhon Na Bolte Hoy? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Uttor Pete Aasun Shune Ni Ei Audiobook .

ayyankali.title: Ayyankali
ayyankali.description: Kerala Navodhana charithrathil vyathyasthamaya pathayilude sanjarich mahathmavanu Ayyankali. Adichamarthappettavarude vimochanathinayi padaporuthiya viplavakari aanu adheham. Njangalude kuttikale pallikkoodathil kayattiyillenkil ningalude nellu koyyan manasillennu paranju keralathile aadya karshaka samarathinu nethruthwam nalkiyathum viplavakaramaya villuvandi yathrayum ellamayi aithihasika jeevithamayirunnu Ayyankaliyudeth.

joshi-abhyankar-murder-case.title: The Joshi-Abhyankar Murders
joshi-abhyankar-murder-case.description: Aaj se kareeb 40 saal pehle, Pune shahar ki hawa mein khauf ki lehre faili thi. Weekend ho ya public holiday, har insaan apne ghar se bahar kadam rakhne se katrata tha. Aakhir kya hua aisa jisme Police bhi jaldi kuch na kar saki? Kya tha in bhayanak murders ke piche ka raaz? Janiye ye dil dehla dene wali real life crime story!

the-second-world-war-3.title: The Second World War
the-second-world-war-3.description: Hitler yen Jews inatha mothama azhikanum nu ninaicharu? British army kaaga sandai potta frontline soldiers ellarume namma Indians dhan nu ungaluku theriyuma? Russia kulir la survive panna mudiyatha Nazi Army enna tricks use panni sandai senjanga? Therinjuka kelunga “Second World War” Originals on Kuku FM

happy-money.title: Happiness And Money

her-body-her-choice-_-the-abortion-debat.title: Her Body, Her Choice
her-body-her-choice-_-the-abortion-debat.description: It’s been a long journey for women’s reproductive rights in the U.S. In 1973 the US Supreme Court ruled that abortion was legal in the landmark case Roe v. Wade. Anti-choice activists and politicians had been working to overturn this decision ever since. 2022 was a difficult year for reproductive rights. In the US, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade. A flurry of activity followed as states passed laws banning or seriously restricting abortion. Globally, the news from the United States fired up the anti-choice opposition, who pushed for new restrictions. But there was good news too.  Five US states put abortion on the mid-term ballots, where it was overwhelmingly supported.  The reversals in women’s reproductive rights in the US are out of step with the rest of the world. Since the 1990’s most countries have increased support for reproductive rights. But the struggles experienced in the US have parallels all over the world, as women’s rights activists continue to push for change. Listen to this insightful documentary on the history of women’s reproductive rights in the U.S, from the landmark Roe v. Wade case in 1973 to the overturning of the decision in 2022 and what lies ahead.

cold-war-20_-the-china.title: Cold War 2.0: The China Chapter
cold-war-20_-the-china.description: As four generations of Chinese leaders built their nation at the expense of the US, China has grown economically and militarily, using its financial prowess to spread its influence across continents. The United States and China are currently engaged in a trade war that threatens to devolve into a new Cold War. China has already established itself as a major power throughout Eurasia. Worryingly, China is threatening its neighbors militarily and economically. This exclusive show delves into the current geopolitical landscape and the growing tensions between China and the rest of the world while exploring the economic, military, and political strategies employed by both sides and the potential impact on the global community. This show will give you a deeper understanding of the current geopolitical landscape and the key players involved. Tune in to stay informed and educated about one of the most pressing issues of our time.

blackrock_-the-untold-story-of-global-do.title: Blackrock: The Untold Story of Global Dominance
blackrock_-the-untold-story-of-global-do.description: BlackRock. You've probably never heard of them. But they have an effect on your life and your debt. This American financial company has gone from nothing to the world's largest and most reputable manager of other people's money. Its CEO, Larry Fink, has spent the previous 33 years turning BlackRock into the largest asset manager in the world, with more than $9 trillion under its supervision. This unique presentation explores how BlackRock has risen to become a dominant player in the financial world and the impact it has on global markets, economies, and the lives of individuals and offers valuable information and insights on the history and operations of BlackRock, the impact it has on global markets and economies, and the role it plays in shaping the financial world. Listen to the meteoric rise of the largest and most influential investment management firms in the world.
