ಶಕುನಿ--ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ-ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ಮೈಂಡ್.description: ಆತ ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದ ನಿಪುಣ... ಭಗವಾನ್ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಇಡೀ ಕುರುಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಯುದ್ಧದ ಸೂತ್ರಧಾರಿಯಾಗಿದ್ರೆ, ಈತ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಪೂರ್ವಯೋಜನೆ ರೂಪಿಸಿದ್ದ ಮಹಾನ್ ಕುಟಿಲ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞ... ಪಗಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಳಗಳನ್ನು ಉರುಳಿಸಿ, ಪಾಂಡವರು -ಕೌರವರ ಹಣೆಬರಹ ಬದಲಿಸಿ ಕಾರ್ಯಸಾಧಿಸಿದ್ದ..! ಆತ ಬೇರ್ಯಾರೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ಮೈಂಡ್ ಶಕುನಿ... ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಶಕುನಿ ಯಾರು? ಆತ ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಕೆಟ್ಟವನಾ? ಆತನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಗುಣಗಳು ಇರ್ಲೇ ಇಲ್ವಾ? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಚಾರಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ, 'ಶಕುನಿ : ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ಮೈಂಡ್' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ..!

the-12-week-fitness-project.title: The 12-Week Fitness Project
the-12-week-fitness-project.description: కేవలం 12 వారాల్లో ఫిట్‌గా మరలనుకుంటున్నారా? కానీ ఎలా ప్రారంభించాలో తెలియదా? భారతదేశం యొక్క సుప్రసిద్ధ పోషకాహార నిపుణురాలు మరియు ఆరోగ్య సలహాదారురాలు ‘రుజుతా దివేకర్’ మీకు సహాయం చేస్తుంది. మూడు నెలల చివరి నాటికి, సహజమైన పద్దతులను అనుసరించి మీరు మీ అలవాట్లను పన్నెండు కీలక మార్గాల ద్వారా  మార్చుకుంటారు. ఇక మీరు కొన్ని అంగుళాల బరువు కోల్పోతారు. మంచి ఆరోగ్యాన్ని పొందుతారు. చక్కని నిద్ర కూడా పడుతుంది.

love-at-politics-story-of-jailalitha-mgr.title: Political Love Story : Jayalalithaa & MGR
love-at-politics-story-of-jailalitha-mgr.description: Tamil Nadu cinema ka ek superstar, jo acting ke sath neta ban gaya aur janta se itna pyar mila ki actor se Chief Minister ban gaya.Aur is Chief Minister ne apne se bahut kam umar ki actress se pyar kar liya.Pyar bhi aisa kiya ki antim dam tak sath rahe aur fir uski premika bhi bani Chief Minister. Neta ka naam tha “Marudhur Gopalan Ramachandran” urf  "MGR". Aur premika ka naam “Jayaram Jayalalithaa” urf Amma. Kya thi in dono ki prem kahani jisne Tamil Nadu ki rajneeti ko hamesha ke liye badal kar rakh diya. Aaiye sunte hain Political Love Story : Jayalalithaa & MGR.

real-heroes-of-india.title: Real Heroes of India
real-heroes-of-india.description: Indian Army, Navy kinva mag Airforce yanchavar anek Movies ani Web series banlya ahet. Pan Bhartachi hi 3 pramukh sarnkshak dala nemaki kashi karyarat astat, tyancha mukhya resposbilities kon kontya astat,  ya vishayi khup kami lokanna mahiti aste. Bhartache sujan nagrik mhanun aplyala ya vishayi mahiti asna khup garjecha ahe. ani mhanunch amhi thumcha sathi gheun aloy 'Indian Defense Forces' chya karyacha adhava ghenara ha khas show- ''Bhartache Real Heroes''

yoga-meditation.title: Yoga And Meditation
yoga-meditation.description: Yoga amader hridoy, shorir ebong atma ke ekotrito kore. Bartamane stressful jibon ke kikore anandodayok kora jaye. Dhyan ebong yoga sommondhe amra sobai janleo adote ei shobdo dutir pradhanyo kintu amra sobai di na. Yoga ar meditation er dara sokolei labhoban hote pare. Ei duti healthy jibon jatrar onnyotomo karon hoye uthte pare. Ei shob bishoy e amra aj jene nebo.

the-latte-factor.title: Get Rich Without Earning More
the-latte-factor.description: “Get Rich Without Earning More” audiobook ki main character hai “Zoey” jinke paas ek acchi naukri hai ek acchi family hai but still unhe ye feel hota hai ki financially wo accha nahi kar rahi hai aur na kabhi kar payengi, kya aap Zoey ki situation se relate kar paa rahe hai? Iss audiobook “Get Rich Without Earning More” sun kar aapko pata chalega ki kaise hum apni har khwahish ko pura kar sakte hai chahe humari income jo bhi ho. Saath hi saath aap ko pata chalega ki kaise Zoey ne apni life me small changes kar ke apne liye ek financial freedom wali life create kari.

byabshar-rononiti-safolyer-udaan.title: Byabshar Rononiti Safolyer Udaan
byabshar-rononiti-safolyer-udaan.description: Amra anekei bybasha korte chai, kintu business plan ki kore korte hoi jani na. Byabsha shuru korar agei prothomei byabsha sonkranto plan kore nite hoi. Sothik plan chhara byabsha shuru korle shey byabsha porichalona kora osombhob hoye porbe. Business plan holo apnar byabsha sothik bhabe porichalona kora ebong briddhi korar ektu route map. Protiti company r ekti byabshaik proikolpona thaka uchit.  Aj amra byabsha somodhye shob kichu jene nebo.

1000-little-things-happy-successful-peop.title: Successful log aur unki Aadatein
1000-little-things-happy-successful-peop.description: Is empowering show mein, aapko un sari problems ka solution ek saath milega jiska aap rozmarra ki zindagi mein samna karte hai. Jinmein asafalta par kabu paana, jo hamari pragati rokta hai use chhodna, rishton ko mazboot karna, self care ke liye samay nikalna aur apne andar passion dhundna...ye sab bhi shaamil hai. Aaj hi sunein! Agar aapko "Change Your Schedule, Change Your Life" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

kivabe-korben-nijer-swopnopuron.title: Kivabe Korben Nijer Swopnopuron ?
kivabe-korben-nijer-swopnopuron.description: Dhorun Aapni Nije Ekta Bybsa Shuru Korte Chaichen Ebong Producti Manusher Moddhey Choriye Dite Chan. Kintu Aapnar Product Er Proti Manush Tokhon Aakrishto Hobe Jokhon Seta Manusher Moddhey Choriye Porbe. Ekhon Social Media Er Juge Eta Ekta Valo Platform Hote Pare Choriye Deyoyar Jonyo. Aabar Nijeke Kivabe Sokoler Thekhe Aalada Banaben? Kivabe Nijer Ekta Brand Banaben? Ki Lokhyo Set Korben Passionke Bastobayito korte? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Somadhan Pete Shune Nin Ei Audiobook.

ysrajasekhara-reddy.title: Y.S.Rajasekhara Reddy
ysrajasekhara-reddy.description: Y.S.RAJASEKHARA REDDY garu enno kotla mandhi jeevithalo velugulu nimpina nayakudu, aneka padhakalu tesukochi pedha prajalaki ani andhe laga chusevaru, prajalu baguntene manam baguntam ani namme vkythi eyana. rajashekar Garu ekkada putaru, emi chadvukunaru, asalu rajakiyaloki ela adugupetaru, emi emi kotha padhakalu prevshapetaru ila aneka vishyalu gurinchi miru ee audio book lo vini telsukovachu.!

upsc-success-story.title: UPSC Success Story - IAS Komal Ganatra
upsc-success-story.description: KukuFm Aaap ke liye laya hai IAS Komal Ganatra Ji Ka Excludive interview Jisme yeh humein btaati hain UPSC Aur zindagi Ke Baare mein Bahut saari insightful baatein. Agar Aap bhi UPSC clear karna chahte hain to suniye yeh interview sirf KUKUFM par.

காகிதப்பூ-தேன்.title: காகிதப்பூ தேன்
காகிதப்பூ-தேன்.description: அஜந்தாவும் அவளின் தோழன் பாலமுரளியும் வழுக்குப் பாறை மலைக்குச் செல்கிறார்கள். அங்கு, திடீரென காட்டுவாசிகள் வழிமறித்துத் தாக்கி, பாலமுரளியின் கண்களைக் குருடாக்கி விடுகிறார்கள். அந்த ஆபத்தில் இருந்து இருவரும் தப்பினார்களா? அதற்குப் பிறகு அவர்களின் வாழ்க்கை என்ன ஆனது? Kuku FM ல் கேளுங்கள்.

how-to-manage-social-media-profiles-2.title: How To Manage Social Media Profiles
how-to-manage-social-media-profiles-2.description: Aashaya vinimayam Digital yugathil ethiyirikkunna kaalaghattathil lokam kooduthal parasparam bhandhikkappettirikkunnu. Puthiya lokathinte vinimaya reethikal ellavarkkum prapyamakum vidham oru click akalathilum aanu. Ennal athoru kuttikkali aano? Alleyalla! Samoohathil enna pole Social Mediayil idapedunnathinum chila chittavattangal und. Athinekkurichariyam ee showyilude.

british-economy-policy.title: British Economic Policy In India
british-economy-policy.description: India, Industrial England ke liye Economic Colony ban Gaya tha. British ne Bahut si ladaiyan ladi aur India se dutch, french, portuguese ko bhaga diya aur Mughalon se dosti kar India par kabza kar liya tha. Iske Bad dheere dheere bahut si Policies lagu ki, jisse Britishers Powerful hote gaye. India jo ki bahut bada Business Market aur Raw Material Provider tha use England ka Raw Material supplier bana diya. Is Series mein aap sab kuch detail mein janenge.  Agar aapko 'The Discovery of India' jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook aapko khoob pasand aayegi.

mithali-raj-born-to-bat-1.title: Mithali Raj : Born to Bat
mithali-raj-born-to-bat-1.description: ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಎಂಬ ಪುರುಷ ಪ್ರಾಧಾನ್ಯ ಆಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರೂ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಎನ್ನುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ ಮಿಥಾಲಿ ರಾಜ್. ಬರೋಬ್ಬರಿ 18 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಭಾರತ ತಂಡದ ನಾಯಕಿಯಾಗಿ, ಒಂದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ದಾಖಲೆ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದ 'ಲೆಡಿ ಸಚಿನ್ ತೆಂಡೂಲ್ಕರ್' ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗಿರುವ ಮಿಥಾಲಿ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಲೆಕ್ಕವಿಲ್ಲ!ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಭಾರತ ನೃತ್ಯದ ಕಲಾವಿದೆಯಾಗಬೇಕಿದ್ದ ಮಿಥಾಲಿ ರಾಜ್, ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಉದ್ಯೋಗವನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿದವು ಹೇಗೆ? ಇವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿಜಿ ಏನೆಲ್ಲ ಹೇಳಿದರು?ಕೇಳಿ 'ಮಿಥಾಲಿ ರಾಜ್ : ಬೋರ್ಣ್ ಟು ಬ್ಯಾಟ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ KuKu FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

jallikattu-1.title: Jallikattu
jallikattu-1.description: Namma Thamizhargal Udaiya Veera Vilayattu la romba mukkiyamana onnu intha jallikattu. Jallikattu Pathina Sanga Kaala Padalgal la thodangi sama Kaala Varalaru varaikkum alasi aarayura Virivana Audio Puthagam Idhu. Ovvoru Thamizhanum Kattayam therinjika vendiya Thagavalgal idhula irukku. Kelunga !

rashtrapati.title: Rashtrapati : Bharat Ke Mahamahim Ki Kahaniyan
rashtrapati.description: 15 August, 1947. Azadi ke saath shuru hua is desh ke liye aage ka rasta taiyar karne ka kaam.Bana Bharat ka Samvidhan aur bana desh ka sarvochch pad “Rashtrapati”.Aur fir shuru hui is pad tak pahunchane ki rajneetik daud.Is daud mein jo jeeta vahi bana “Mahamahim”.May, 2022 tak ye desh 14 Rashtrapatiyon dekh chuka hai.Aur in sab ke bachpan se lekar Delhi ke Rashtrapati bhawan tak pahuchne ke dilchasp qisse lekar “KUKU Fm” aur “The lallantop” milkar le aaye hain is audio book mein.1st president Dr. Rajendra Prasad se lekar Shree Ram Nath Kovind ji tak sabke qisse jaan lene ki aa gayi hai baari.Chaliye fir itihas ke is safar mein KUKU Fm ke saath.

chozhar-varalaru.title: Chozhar Varalaru
chozhar-varalaru.description: Chozhargal Varalatra  adipadai ya vachu neraya Varalatru Puthinangal ezhutha pattu iruku, adhula mukkiyamanadhu Ponniyin selvan. Idhu mathiriyana varalatru puthinangal la Karpanai edhu ?, unmai edhu ? nu thelivaa purinjukanum na chozhargal varalara therinjuka vendiyathu avasiyam ! Idhu Chozha Mannargal Patriya muzhumaiyana Varalaara sollura Audiobook. Chozha Mannargaloda Veera theera varalatra therinjukalaam vaanga !

kedarnath-the-ancient-marvel.title: Kedarnath : The Ancient Marvel
kedarnath-the-ancient-marvel.description: Aastha aur dharm ka pratik Kedarnath mandir kisne banaya hai? Kya iska jawab hai aapke paas? Nahi....Accha aap ye to zarur jante honge ki is mandir ke liye ek samay aisa aaya tha, jab mandir pure 400 saal barf mein daba tha. To ispar se barf ki chadar kisne hatayi? Yahi nahi, floods ke baad, aakhir mandir ko dobara kuch hi dinon mein kaise shuru kiya gaya? Aur Kedarnath mandir se jude kaunse kaunse raaz hai, jinke baare mein koi nahi janta? Aaiye unhe jante hai humare is audiobook mein.

do-epic-shit-5.title: Do Epic Shit
do-epic-shit-5.description: Vazhkaila ellathukkum instant formula irukkaa nu thedittu irukkura oru Kala kattathula namma ippo vazhnthuttu irukkom ! Vazhkaila Munnera ethachum formula irukka nu theditu irukkura ovvorutharum kandippa kekka vendiya audiobook ithu. Vetri Tholvi pathina purithal, Uravugala Kaiyaalura Kalai, Panatha Nirvagikkira Vazhimuraigal, Pazhakkangal, Thozhil munaivu  nu vazhkaikku thevayaana Pala mukkiyamana visayangal Intha Audio Book la irukku. Vaanga Therinjukalam.

florence-nightingale.title: Florence Nightingale
florence-nightingale.description: Founder of Modern Nursing nu solla padura Florence, Italy la pirandhu Britian la irukka pala patients ku treatment paathurukanga. Ivangaloda nalla manasu kaagave ivangala 'Lady with a lamp' 'Nightingale' nu pala peyargal solli koopduvanga. Melum therinjika kelunga "Florence Nightingale" on Kuku FM

lamas_the-tibetan-legacy.title: Lamas - The Tibetan Legacy
lamas_the-tibetan-legacy.description: Lama - Ek spiritual leader ka title hai jo Tibetan Buddhism ke Dharm Guru ko diya gaya hai. Tibet ka itihaas aur Lamas ki viraasat yeh sab aapko seekhne milega is show mein. China ke aakraman se pehle Tibet saikdo saalo se ek azaad aur Lama ki aguvaai mein ek spiritual desh tha. Kaise Buddhism ne Tibet mein apni gehri pehchaan paayi, Hindustaan aur Dalai Lama ka special connection aur kya hai Tibetan Lama legacy, sab jaanenge is original series mein.

gautama-buddhar.title: Gautama Buddhar
gautama-buddhar.description: Oru raja kudumba varisu, enaku indha aadambara vazhkai vendam nu thuravu merkonda kadhai dhan idhu. Gauthamar ellathayum vittu Bodhi maram adiyil eppadi gyanam petru Buddhar aanar nu therinjuka kelunga "Gautama Buddhar" on Kuku FM

karmaveerar-kamarajar.title: Karmaveerar Kamarajar
karmaveerar-kamarajar.description: Madhiya Unavu moolam pala yelai manavargaluku kalvi kodutha Tamizhar. Pala thadaigal thaandi Taminaatin Mudhal Amaichar aanavar. Pala nalla thittangalai nam makkaluku vazhangiyavar. Kelungal "Karmaveerar Kamarajar" on Kuku FM

how-to-breast-feed-your-baby.title: How to Breast Feed Your Baby
how-to-breast-feed-your-baby.description: Kya aap jaanate hain ki 70% Indian women find breastfeeding a challenge, Jaha ek taraf world breastfeeding week manaya jaata hai toh doosari taraf aaj bhi public main breastfeed karana ek taboo hai, aaj bhi humare working spaces main lactating mothers ke liye koi infrastructure hai he nahi.  Breastfeeding is a painless and enjoyable process. Aur aap isse na dare isiliye hum aapke liye laaye hai yeh exclusive show joh aapke saare sawaalon ke jawaab de dega. Toh suniye yeh amazing audio series 'How to Breast Feed Your Baby' sirf KUKU FM par.

smart-worker-hoye-uthun.title: Smart Worker Hoye Uthun
smart-worker-hoye-uthun.description: Dhorun Aapni Office E Kaj Korchen Ba Nijer Byabsar Jonyo Kaj Korchen. Onek Somoy Niye Kaj Korlen, Onek Kaj Korlen Kintu Kajti Somponno Korte Parlen Na. Kokhono Vebe Dekhechen Kivabe Aapni Distract Na Hoye Beshi Beshi Kaj Korte Parben? Aapnar Ki Important Projectgulote Focus Korte Impossible Lage? Aabar Vabchen Kivabe Nijer Kajer Productivity Barano Jay Ebong Kivabe Aaro Valo Kore Kaj Kora Jay, Tahole Aapnar Ei Cholar Pothe Bondhu Hoye Uthte Pare Ei Audiobook. Aapnake Guide Kore Dekhate Pare Sothik Pother Disha. Aasun Tahole Shune Neyoya Jak Boitir Saragsho.

field-marshal-k-m-cariappa.title: Field Marshal K. M. Cariappa
field-marshal-k-m-cariappa.description: ಭಾರತಾಂಬೆಯ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಪುತ್ರ ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ಮಾರ್ಷಲ್ ಕೆ.ಎಂ. ಕರಿಯಪ್ಪ. ಇವರು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಭಾರತದ ಮೊದಲ ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ಮಾರ್ಷಲ್ ಆಗಿ ಅಧಿಕಾರ ವಹಿಸಿದ ದಿನದ ಸ್ಮರಣಾರ್ಥ 'ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸೇನಾ ದಿನ' ಆಚರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಕ್ಕಿಂತ ದೇಶ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ನಿರೂಪಿಸಿ ತೋರಿಸಿದ ಕೆ.ಎಂ. ಕರಿಯಪ್ಪ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಅನೇಕ ಯುವಕರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ.ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಕೆ.ಎಂ. ಕರಿಯಪ್ಪ ಅವರ ಸೇನಾ ಯಾನ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು?ಕೇಳಿ, ಕೊಡಗಿನ ವೀರಯೋಧ 'ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ಮಾರ್ಷಲ್ ಕೆ.ಎಂ. ಕರಿಯಪ್ಪ' ಅವರ ಜೀವನದ ರೋಚಕ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ KuKu FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

how-to-manage-money-like-a-pro.title: Baniye Money Management Mein Master
how-to-manage-money-like-a-pro.description: Aaj Kal humari paisa kharch karne ki aadat bahut hi jaldi badal rahi hai, kyunki humare paas easily transaction karne ke liye options available hai, jaise ab market mein credit card aasani se mil jata hai, ghoomne ke liye bhi loan milta hai, no cost emi aa gayi hai aur upi payment bhi hai. Inn sab se hume feel nahi hota ki actual mein hum kitna paisa kharch kar rahe hai. To Aise mein apne paiso ko kaise bachaye ? Kaise unhe invest kare aur kaise humari mehnat se kamaye gaye paise ko acche se manage kare? Janne ke liye suniye yeh audio show. Agar aapko Why Didn't they teach me this In School jaisi book pasand hai to aapko ye audiobook zaroor pasand aayegi.

how-to-select-a-perfect-insurance.title: How To Select A Perfect Insurance
how-to-select-a-perfect-insurance.description: Miku Insurance vundha? asalu Insurance enduku tesukovali, dani valla upayogalu enti ? dani valla manaku emi labalu untayi? illa enno vishyalu challa mandaiki telidu, Insurance lo challa types unayi,  a types ento insrunace valla manaku unna labalu ento illa insurance ki sambadinchina aneka vishyalu ee audio book lo vini telusukondi.!

simple-marketing-plan-for-small-business.title: Paisa Kamao Like A King
simple-marketing-plan-for-small-business.description: Kya aapne bhi apne dimag mein kai baar 'Chalo koi business shuru karte hai' wale khayal ko dimag mein hi maar diya hai? Business shuru toh kar denge magar usko sahi tarike se market kaise kiya jaaye is competition ki duniya mein...kya ye khayal aapko bhi satata hai? Aap ka jawab hai, ye show! Suniye chhote se chhote business ko smartly market karne ke badhiya ways is show mein

what-do-this-generation-students-expect-.title: What do this generation students expect on teachers ?
what-do-this-generation-students-expect-.description: Teachers oda expectation ku etha maathiri students ah tune panni vaikura kaalam maari, ipo students oda expectations ku etha maathiri teachers tune aaga vendiya kaalathin kattayam erpattu irukku. Intha kaala kattathula irukka koodiya students avangaloda teachers eppadiyellam irukkanumnu expect panraanga nu intha pathivula kettu therinjukkalaam vaanga.

sindhutai-sapkal-maayechi-shal.title: Sindhutai... Anathancha Maai
sindhutai-sapkal-maayechi-shal.description: Sindhutai...Hajaro, Lakho anath mulanvar mayechi shaal pangharnari vatslya rupi Aai. Padari Vastvache, Upekshehe nikhare bandhun Samaj karyasathi zatnari Maai. Lokanvar jeewapad Prem karnari ani tyanchach hakkan sathi prasangi Waghin houn ladhnari Maai. Maai tyancha Karya dvare ani Prabhodana dvare nehmich aplya sobat asnar ahet. Eka samnya gharatil Mulgi te Thor Samaj Sevika... kasa hota Maaincha khadtar pan titkach Prernadayi Pravas, chala aikuya aplya ya khas show madhun.

mantoiyat.title: Saadat Hasan Manto
mantoiyat.description: Ek Kahani likhne wala kahanikar jo INDIA mein jiya aur dafan hua Pakistan ke Lahore mein.Jisne marne se pahle hi apni qabr par likh diya tha “Khuda Bada Ya Mai”.Jisne apni kahaniyan samaj mein satai gayin auraton ke naam likhin, Likh daale aise- aise words ki aadhi Zidngi court ke chakkar mein gujari aur aadhi logon ke taane sunane mein. Jail bhi gaye lekin sach likhna nhin chhoda. Film likhi to “National Award” jeeta.Aise Mahan writer “Saadat Hasan Manto” ki life ki kahani KUKU Fm le aaye hai aapke liye.

how-to-say-no-2.title: How to say No ?
how-to-say-no-2.description: Nammalaala panna mudiyaatha vishayangaluku No solrathula entha thappum illa. But inga athula thaan neraya perukku pala prachanai irukku. Unga work la unga thalaikku mela commitment varapo ethukku yes sollanum, ethukku no sollanumnu therinjuka intha pathivu ungalukku help pannum. No solra vithaiya kathuka ready aah makkale !

kfc-the-success-story.title: KFC : The Success Story
kfc-the-success-story.description: ಕೆಎಫ್‌ಸಿ... ಈ ಹೆಸರು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ, ನಾನ್‌ವೆಜ್ ಪ್ರಿಯರ ಬಾಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಬರುವುದಂತೂ ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ! ಈ ಮಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯವಾದ ಕೆಎಫ್‌ಸಿ, ಹಾಟ್ ಫೇವರಿಟ್ ಆಗಿದೆ.ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಕೆಎಫ್‌ಸಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತು? ಕೈ ಹಾಕಿದ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಕೆಲಸದಲ್ಲೂ ಸೋಲು ಕಂಡ ಕೆಎಫ್‌ಸಿ ಫೌಂಡರ್ ಸ್ಯಾಂಡರ್ಸ್ ಅವರಿಗೆ, ಕೆಎಫ್‌ಸಿ ಐಡಿಯಾ 70ರ ಹರೆಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂದಿತೇಕೆ? ಅವರು ಅನುಭವಿಸಿದ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟಗಳು ಏನು? ಕೆಎಫ್‌ಸಿ ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ಹಿಂದಿರುವ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ 'ಕೆಎಫ್‌ಸಿ: ದ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್

money-law-of-attraction.title: Wealth kaise Attract karein?
money-law-of-attraction.description: Kehte hai ki jitna zyada paisa utna zyada tension. Toh fir kya kare? Kya paisa stress ko attract karta hai? Aur agar haan, toh self development kaise ki jaaye? Kaise success ko attract kiya jaye aur kaise chune paise kamane ki sustainable raah jo aapki health bhi sambhale? Janenge is show mein. Agar aapko "Coffee Can Investing: The Low Risk Road To Stupendous Wealth" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook  zaroor sunein.

yoga-guide.title: Yoga Guide
yoga-guide.description: Bharatham janmam nalki lokam muzhuvan ettedutha onnanu Yoga. Shareerathinum Manassinum kadinjan idan Yoga athyuthamam aanennu parakke parayappedunnund. Athma niyanthranathinte angeyattam aayanu Bharatheeya darshanangalil Yogaye kaanunnath. Enthanu Yoga? Enthinanu Yoga? Vishadamayi Ariyam ee Audio Bookilude.

indian-service-medals.title: Indian Service Medals
indian-service-medals.description: Bharathadesham swathanthryam pondina tharuvatha desha shreyassu koraku erpadina rakshana mariyu seva samsthalu ayina military, Navy, ithara border security vibhagallo dhairya sahasalu chupi desha rakshanaku thama pranalanu addupetti poradina sainikulaku ithara rakshana sibbandiki iche award la gurinchi manam ee audio book lo vini thelusukundam. Manavanthu desha seva chesi manamu kuda utthama pourulam anipinchukovadaniki prathi okkaru prayathnam cheyyali.

small-giants-2.title: Paisa Ya Principles - How Company Can Be Great
small-giants-2.description: Ek baar jo maine commitment kardi, phir to mein apne aap ki bhi nahi sunta. Yeh bolna bahut sahi lagta hai, par implement karne me utna hi mushkil hai, khaas kar ke tab, jab aap koi business chala rahe ho aur usko grow kar rahe ho. Kya iss success ke chakkar mein hum kisi tarike se apne principle aur core value ka dhyan rakh pate hai ? Agar nahi to, kaise rakh sakte hai ? Aur yeh zaroori kyon hai ? Jane iss audiobook mein

madhyayuga-bharathadesha-charithra.title: Madhyayuga Bharathadesha Charithra
madhyayuga-bharathadesha-charithra.description: Bharathadesha charithra lo bharatha upakhandam loni charithra poorva sthavaralu, samajalu bhagamga unnayi. Sindhu nagarikatha nundi veda samskruthi rupondinchina indo Aryan samskruthi erparachindi. Vividha bhougolika pranthallo moodu vandal samvathsarala paatu raja vamshalu samrajyalu, europeon varthakaluga private vyakthula aagamanam british india, bharatha swathanthrya udyamam bharathadesha vibhajanaku darithisayi.

beyond-titanic_-the-james-cameron.title: Beyond Titanic: The James Cameron Story
beyond-titanic_-the-james-cameron.description: James Cameron has established himself as the king of science fiction and blockbuster filmmaking. It's a distinction he's earned over the course of a career that has included films like The Terminator, Aliens, Avatar, and Titanic. But who exactly is James Cameron? What school did he attend to learn the craft of filmmaking? How did he create such works of art that have grossed billions of dollars at the box office? This unique series takes an in-depth look at the many facets of this daring creative genius. This show provides an overview of Cameron's work and its significance within cinematic history. Listen to the astounding story of the man considered visionary by his peers, a man regarded as a futurist by critics and reviewers, and the man behind some of the biggest smash hits of all time.

neeraj-chopra.title: Golden Athlete: Neeraj Chopra
neeraj-chopra.description: 7 August 2021 ye tareekh koi kaise bhul sakta hai. Wo ek aisa behtreen din tha jisne iss Desh ka naam itihaas ke panno pe humesha ke liye sunehre aksharon me darj kar diya. Tokyo Olympic mein Bharat ka pehle Gold Medal. Aur inn sab ke piche Bharat ka ek aisa naujawan jisne 23 saal ki umar mein hee apna parcham Puri duniya par lehra diya diya tha. Neeraj Chopra ek aisa naam jo aaj har kisi ke zubaan par hai. Par kya hai iss Athlete ki kahani, kitne Records hain iss Khiladi ke naam aur aakhir kin kin mushkilo ka saamna karna pada tha iss Khiladi ko jaanenge humare iss Original Audio show "Golden Athlete: Neeraj Chopra" mein.

how-to-deal-with-office-politics.title: How To Deal With Office Politics?
how-to-deal-with-office-politics.description: Office politics kaikaryam cheyyunath valare stressful-aaya karyamanu. Palarum ath athijeevikkan kazhiyathe joli polum resign cheyyarund. Pakshe, ningalkk ariyamo? Office politics sheriyaya reethiyil upayogichal ningalkk valiya nettangal elupathil kaivarikkan kazhiyum!

to-boldly-grow.title: Dinner With Adventure
to-boldly-grow.description: Hum sabko lagta hai na ki khana banana bahut hi tough kaam hai. Kabhi-Kabhi to aisa lagta hai ki bas koi khana banane ko na khe aur chahe jo karwa le. Khaskar din bhar thak kar office se ghar aane ka baad. Lekin khana to banana hi padta hai na boss. kab tak bahar ka kahyenge. Isiliye hum aapki is samsya ka ilaaz laaye hain aur vo hai ye show "Dinner With Adventure". jiski madad se aap aasani se badhiya khana bhi bana sakte hain aur chahein to ise apna passion bhi bana sakte hain.

inside-the-mind-of-a-murderer-new-files.title: Inside The Mind Of A Murderer
inside-the-mind-of-a-murderer-new-files.description: Few serial killers have received the same level of attention as Jeffrey Lionel Dahmer. The depravity on the corpses of his victims distinguishes him from famous serial killers, not the number of people he murdered. When the officers arrested Dahmer, they realized they had stumbled onto a "real-life Hannibal Lecter." What could have turned a handsome former tennis player, the son of middle-class parents, into a perverse serial killer whose heinous acts shocked the nation? In this true crime series, you will learn how Dahmer went from loner to serial killer, committing numerous unnatural acts such as necrophilia and cannibalism. You will witness Dahmer's transformation from an alcoholic outcast in high school to a vicious predator who stalked the streets of Milwaukee along with his trial, his jailhouse murder, and the impact of his numerous crimes on Milwaukee. Immerse yourself in Jeffrey Dahmer's bizarre world of bizarre sexual encounters, mutilation, and cannibalism with this thrilling show.

how-to-earn-money-in-dream-11.title: How To Earn Money Through Fantasy Cricket?
how-to-earn-money-in-dream-11.description: మీరు బెట్టింగ్ పెడుతన్నారా? బెట్టింగ్ ఓక క్రికెట్ లోనే ఉంది అని అనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే మీరు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ ఒకసారి వినాల్సిందే.!

the-nomad-shubham.title: Nomad Shubham - The Hitchhiker Story
the-nomad-shubham.description: The Nomad Shubham - Ek backpack aur haath mein camera liye nikal chala yeh naujavaan duniya ki sair karne. Bihar ke ek chote se gaav se nikalkar, minimum travel expense lekar apne kadmo se yeh puri duniya ghumne ka sapna dekhta hai. Russia, Afghanistan, South Africa aur China jaise Kai aur desh inke checklist mein marked hai. Inke travel ko kehte hai 'hitchhiking'! Ab yeh kya hai aur Shubham ka safar kaha se shuru hua aur kab tak chalega, chaliye sunte hai is original series mein.

dr-kashinath-ghanekar.title: Dr. Kashinath Ghanekar
dr-kashinath-ghanekar.description: Marathi Natakacha ek motha kaal gajavnare naav mhanje ‘Dr. Kashinath Ghanekar’. Marathi Ranga bhumicha Badshah! Nile Dole, Gora Varn, Awajavar ani Shabda fekivar jabardast command ani personality shobhtil asha Bindhast, Bedarkar Bhumika. Peshane Dentista asunhi tyancha jeev ramycha to Natkanmadhe. Aikuya, Marathi Natyakalechi ani Rasikanchi Avirat seva kararnya, Marathi Natkana eka veglya unchivar newun thewnarya ya Avliyachi goshta...

small-business-big-profit.title: Small Business Big Profit
small-business-big-profit.description: Have you started a small business but are having difficulty making it profitable? Do you ever wonder where the excitement of running a business went? KukuFm presents a special series that delves into the strategies and techniques that small business owners can use to increase their profits and grow their companies. This show explores the best practices small business owners can adopt, from marketing to finance, to achieve success. Whether you're a small business owner or just curious about the world of entrepreneurship, this show is a must-listen. It offers valuable information and insights on increasing profits, growing your company, and succeeding in your business. Get a better understanding of the strategies and techniques that can help you and inspire you to take action and make the most of your small business.

leadership-and-self-deception-audio-book.title: How To Priorities Things In Personal & Professional Life
leadership-and-self-deception-audio-book.description: Agar mai aapse kahu ki aapka workaholic hona ya apne kaam se bahut zyada obsessed hona and yahi same behavior apne aas paas walo se expect karna aapki professional life ke saath saath aapki personal life bhi damage kar sakta hai! To kya aap yakin karenge? “How Priorities things in Personal & Professional life” ki is audiobook mein Mr & Mrs. Chawla ki kahani ke through bahut ache tarike se ye samjhaya gaya hai ki kaise aap apni professional life me kuch changes laake apni aur apne saath-saath dusro ki life ko behtar bana sakte hai.

women-in-blue-indian-womens-cricket-team.title: Women in Blue: Indian Women's Cricket Team
women-in-blue-indian-womens-cricket-team.description: ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ತಂಡ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಿಯಾಗಿದೆ... ಆದರೆ ಆರಂಭದ ದಿನಗಳು ಅಷ್ಟು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ! ಅನೇಕ ಅವಮಾನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಷ್ಟಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.ಹೀಗಾದರೆ, ಭಾರತೀಯ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ತಂಡ ಆರಂಭವಾದದ್ದು ಯಾವಾಗ? ಆರಂಭದ ದಿನಗಳು ಹೇಗಿತ್ತವು? ಯಾವ ರೀತಿಯ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿದರು? ಆ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ತೊಂದರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಜಯಿಸಿದರು? ಇಂದಿನ ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಈ ತಂಡ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ಏನು?ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ, 'ವಿಮನ್ ಇನ್ ಬ್ಲೂ: ಇಂಡಿಯನ್ ವುಮೆನ್ಸ್ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಟೀಮ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

constitution-of-india-3.title: Constitution of India
constitution-of-india-3.description: ಜನವರಿ 26, 1950... ಇದು ಭಾರತದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಜಾರಿಯಾದ ದಿನ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಭಾರತೀಯನಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಒಂದು ಪವಿತ್ರ ಗ್ರಂಥ. ಇದನ್ನು ಓದಿ, ಅರ್ಥೈಸಿ, ಪಾಲಿಸುವುದು ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯ.ಹೀಗಾದರೆ, ನಮಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನಿಸಿತು ಯಾವಾಗ? ಈ ರಚನೆಯ ಯಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 'ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ' ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಕೈಜೋಡಿಸಿದ ನಾಯಕರು ಯಾರು? ಲಿಖಿತ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಭಾರತದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಕೈಯಾರೆ ಬರೆದವರು ಯಾರು? ಇದರೊಳಗಿನ ಒಟ್ಟು ಭಾಗಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಧಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಏನು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ?ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ, ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಲಿಖಿತ ಸಂವಿಧಾನವಾಗಿರುವ, ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಭದ್ರ ಆಧಾರ ಹಾಕಿದ 'ಭಾರತದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ KuKu FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

chola-dynasty.title: Chola Dynasty : Dynasty that inspired Ponniyin Selvan
chola-dynasty.description: Ponniyin Selvan Kaun hai? Maurya vansh ho ya Mughal saltanat , North india ke kayi samrajyo ne south india ko jitne ke liye kayi baar koshish ki lekin wo jeet nahi paye , wajah "Chol Vansh" aur "Ponniyin Selvan" yaani "Raja Raja chola" jo chol vansh ke sabse favourite raja the , ye vansh ke baare me hume textbook me nahi sikhaya gaya , lekin Bharat ki sabse best navy ke sath chol vansh ne 1500 saal raaj kiya , chaliye sunte hai "Ponniyin Selvan" ki kahani unhi ke time me ja kar.

m-s-subbulakshm.title: M. S. Subbulakshmi
m-s-subbulakshm.description: Muthamizhil Irandam tamizhaana isai tamizhil sathanaigal pala padaitha Isai Arasi M.S. Subbulakshmi avargalin vazhkai Pathivu idhu. Varungal indha isai kuyil avarathu vazhvil santhitha sathanaigalaiyum sothanaigalaiyum patri therinthu kollalaam.

who-says-you-cant-you-do.title: A life without Self-Doubts
who-says-you-cant-you-do.description: Kya aapko pata hai ki aap apni life mein jo bhi achieve karna chahte hain uspar rok lagane wala koi aur nahi balki aap khud hai? Han ye bilkul sach hai aur isko detail mein samajhne ke liye aapko sunni hogi ye audiobook. Kyuki ye aapko ek aisi psychological aur emotional journey par lekar jaane wali hai jiske dauran aapke sare self-doubts clear ho jayenge aur aapka potential bhi poori tarah se unlock ho jayega. Yani ki ye audiobook aapki personal growth ke liye ek ultimate guide hai.

rising-giants-the-evolution-of-brics.title: Rising Giants: The Evolution of BRICS
rising-giants-the-evolution-of-brics.description: The transformation of BRICS from an acronym to a widely recognized term in the field of international politics and its development into a semi-formal political group is one of the most significant developments of the past 10 years in the field of international politics. What are the implications of the rise of powers such as Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa for the future of global order? This special show delves into the rise of the BRICS nations as major players in the global economy while exploring the economic, political, and social developments of these countries and the impact they are having on the world. This show will help you better understand these countries and their role in the world economy. Witness the shift in global power with this informative show.

sara-blakely.title: Sara Blakely - The Michael Jordan of Undergarments
sara-blakely.description: One idea can change your life. Sara Blakely came up with the idea for Spanx in the late 1990s when she was just 27 years old and working as a salesperson, selling fax machines door to door. Around this time, she was invited to a party and wanted to look her best in a white pair of trousers. She took a pair of scissors and cut the feet off of a pair of tights. She loved the way the new undergarment made her look and spent the next two years and $5,000 of her savings traveling to numerous clothing manufacturing plants up and down North Carolina in the name of research. She has had an incredible journey. From getting her idea for the product to developing it, marketing and selling it, she displayed innovation and determination along every step of the way. Listen to Sara’s incredible journey, from salesperson to billionaire.

kareena-kapoor-khan-pregnancy-bible.title: Kareena Kapoor Khan's Pregnancy Bible
kareena-kapoor-khan-pregnancy-bible.description: Agar aap pregnant ho ya aapke aas paas koi pregnant mahila hai to aap ke mann me bahut saare questions honge , chaliye sunte hai Kareena Kapoor Khan ki pregnancy experiences saath hai unko mile expert ki salah , jisse aap bhi apni nanhi jaan ko welcome karne ke liye taiyar rahe.

vibareethangal-inge-virkappadum.title: விபரீதங்கள்  இங்கே  விற்கப்படும்

Prana is the energy that flows through all living things, and it is believed that by arranging buildings, structures, and objects in a certain way, the flow of prana can be regulated and harnessed. The idea behind Vastu Shastra is the integration of functional architectural designs with nature and spiritual beliefs. Listen to this unique documentary to understand how you can incorporate Vastu in your home.

the-unstoppable-rise-of-veganism.title: The Unstoppable Rise Of Veganism
the-unstoppable-rise-of-veganism.description: A vegan lifestyle is becoming increasingly popular. It is something that more and more people are turning to, regardless of their social status. And, with a surge in vegan food products, cafes, and restaurants, making the switch and reaping the benefits is easier than ever. This exclusive show delves into the growing trend of plant-based eating and the reasons behind it. This show explores the many motivations driving more and more people to adopt a vegan lifestyle, from environmental concerns to health benefits. Whether you're a long-time vegan or just curious about the lifestyle, this show is a must-listen. It offers valuable information and insights on the benefits of a vegan diet, as well as the impact it can have on the environment and society. Through this show, you will gain a deeper understanding of this important movement and be motivated to make more conscious choices about the food you eat. So tune in to stay informed, educated, and inspired.

tiktok-exposed.title: TikTok Exposed: The Terrifying Truth
tiktok-exposed.description: If it appears that everyone you know is on TikTok, you may be correct! It is currently the most popular social media platform. In just under five years, the short video-sharing app has amassed billions of views and engagements across the world. Despite its popularity, it is highly contentious and banned in several countries, including India. Our exclusive series, "TikTok Exposed: The Terrifying Truth," delves into the darker side of the popular social media platform TikTok. From data privacy concerns to the spread of misinformation, this show explores the potential risks and dangers of using TikTok. Whether you're a TikTok user or just curious about the platform, this show is a must-listen. It offers valuable information and insights on the potential risks and dangers associated with using TikTok and the impact it can have on individuals, society and the world. The show will offer you a deeper understanding of the platform and its potential risks. It will also help you make more informed decisions about using TikTok. Stay informed, educated, and aware with this fascinating show.

Our special presentation, "Oscar Controversies: Behind the Scenes," takes a deep dive into the most talked about moments in Oscar history. From award snubs to acceptance speeches, this show explores the controversies that have plagued the Academy Awards over the years. Whether you're a film buff or just curious about the Oscars, this show is a must-listen. It offers an in-depth look at the politics and power plays that go on behind the scenes of the biggest night in Hollywood. Additionally, it provides a unique insight into the film industry and the factors that shape the way movies are made, marketed, and recognized. Stay informed and entertained with this exciting show.

elon-musk-twitter-takeover.title: Elon Musk and The Twitter Takeover
elon-musk-twitter-takeover.description: Elon Musk's takeover of Twitter unfolded over months and was nothing short of a saga! The serial entrepreneur's journey to acquiring the social media platform included a lawsuit, layoffs and a chaotic transition. This decision impacted Elon Musk's other venture, Tesla as well as the technology industry, in general. In the months post the takeover, Musk has largely destroyed the equity value of Twitter and much of his personal wealth. He has ­indicated that the company could declare bankruptcy, and the distraction of running it has caused Tesla stock to ­crater, costing Musk $200 billion. So what really happened from the time Elon Musk decided to takeover Twitter? Find out on this detailed, insightful new documentary.

PSLV, GSLV kaise bani? 1963 se 2022 tak pahunchne ka safar easy nahi tha, aapko is series mein hum sab kuch batayenge vistar se.

operation-bawaria.title: Operation Bawaria
operation-bawaria.description: Oru kuripitta inathai serntha kollai koottam ottu motha naatayum athira vachathu. Bawariya inathai serntha kollayargal pathiyum, avanga senja sambavangal pathiyum, avangala pidikka Tamilnadu police edutha muyarchigal pathiyum intha pathivula kettu therinjukalaam. Oru unmai crime sambavathoda varalaarai kekalaam vaanga.

systemic-barriers-to-quality-jobs-among-.title: Racism At Work
systemic-barriers-to-quality-jobs-among-.description: There have always been barriers to black Americans getting quality jobs. These are racial discrimination, a high rate of incarceration of black Americans and diversity program deficiencies, among other reasons. Black Americans comprise 13 percent of the U.S. population. Yet, they are significantly underrepresented in professional roles and leadership positions. Black professionals hold only 3.2 percent of all executive or senior leadership roles and less than 1 percent of all Fortune 500 CEO positions. Listen to this insightful documentary that sheds light on problems and focuses on finding a solution to eliminate biases.

the-value-of-everything.title: Global Economy Kaise Kaam Karti hai?
the-value-of-everything.description: Jaise jaise duniya develop hui insaan ne har cheez ki ek value tay karna shuru kar diya. Aaj humare liye kisi bhi product ki value decide karna jitna easy hai hamesha se ye kaam utna easy nhi hua karta tha. Chaliye waqt mein thoda peeche ja kar dekhte hain ki ye process kaise evolve hua.

kotipoti-hoyoyar-secret.title: Kotipoti Hoyoar Secret
kotipoti-hoyoyar-secret.description: Bortoman Duniyay Sobai Kotipoti Hote Chay. Kintu Kotipoti Bolte Aamader Samne Ekta Dhanona Aache Je Bilasbohun Gari, Bari Thaklei Se Kotipoti. Ekta Kotha Mathay Rakhte Hobe Kotipoti Dekhano R Kotipoti Hoyoa Ek Jinis Noy. Sothikpothe Kotipoti Hote Dorkar Hoy Kichu Jiniser. Ebar Proshno Holo Segulo Ki Ki? Kon Kon Goon Thaka Dorkar Kotipoti Hote Gele ? Sei Uttor Royeche Ei Audiobook E. Aasun Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Ni Ei Audiobook Ebong Egiye Cholun Aapnar Swopner Rastay.

israel-vs-palestine-the-cursed-war.title: Israel VS Palestine - The Cursed War
israel-vs-palestine-the-cursed-war.description: The Cursed War - Jews aur Arabs, pichle 70 saalo se ek aisi nafrat aur khooni ladai lade jaa rahe hai jiska koi ant nahi. World War 2 ke baad, jab saare Jew immigrants Hitler ke aatank se bachkar waapas apne promised land pohche, toh Britain controlled Palestine ke kuch hisso mein unhe aasra mila. Britishers toh laut gaye, magar yeh dono communities ek dusre ke kattar dushman ban gaye. Anek wars, peace accords aur confusing landmap ki vajah hai yeh cursed war jisme na jaane jitne yahudiyo aur Arabs ne apni jaan gavayi. Chaliye samajhte hai iska itihaas.

judicial-conduct-session.title: The Color Of Justice
judicial-conduct-session.description: The systemic issues of discrimination and bias towards the Black community have existed within the judicial system of the USA since the days of the slave trade. More than 150 years have passed since slavery was abolished, but judicial misconduct persists. This exclusive series is an effort to highlight the issue and its impact on the Black community. The show will also cover potential solutions and reforms to address these issues. It will be an essential resource for anyone who wants to be informed and stay updated on the latest developments in this important topic. Moreover, this show will be a powerful tool in raising awareness and fostering change toward a more just and equitable legal system. Be a part of creating an equal and fair society with this compelling show.

anime-fever.title: Anime Fever: The Worldwide Explosion
anime-fever.description: Japanese animation has taken the world by storm. Shows like Dragonball Z, One Piece, and Naruto had a special place in the hearts of almost every 90s kid, but releases like One Punch Man, Attack on Titan, and Demon Slayer have taken the popularity of anime to a different stratosphere. What makes anime so captivating and beloved? From its origins in Japan to its global popularity today, this show will explore the history, cultural impact, and future of anime. Additionally, the show will cover the latest anime releases, trends, and their impact on pop culture, as well as how it addresses social issues and how it became a $25 billion business. Whether you're a lifelong anime fan or new to the genre, this show is a must-listen for anyone interested in understanding the worldwide explosion of anime.

the-cold-hard-1.title: Pyar, Paisa Aur Relationship
the-cold-hard-1.description: Aapne ek baat Suni hogi ki “ Paisa Kamane Se Zyada Badi Baat hai Paise Ko Sahi Se Kharch Karna”. Aur ye baat ek dam sahi hai kyun ki jo insan paisa save karna nahi Janata vo kabhi Success nahi pa sakta. Aur KUKU Fm ka to yahi maksad ha ki aap sab safalata ki raah par aage badhein isliye ham le aaye hain ek kamal ki kitab “Pyar, Paisa Aur Relationship". Ismen aapko bataye gaye hain aise nayaab tareeqe jinki madad se aap apna paisa save bhi kar sakte hain aur fir uska sahi upyog bhi.

urban-gardening-for-noobs.title: Urban Gardening For Noobs
urban-gardening-for-noobs.description: Are you planning to create a tiny garden where you can grow scrumptious fruits, herbs, and vegetables? Would you like to maximize your available space? Or do you simply wish to fill the gap left by years spent in large cities without owning land? If you want to start an urban garden that uses limited space best, let our exclusive show, "Urban Gardening For Noobs," be your guide. With the aid of tried-and-true small-space gardening methods, this show will enable you to maximize productivity while taking up the least amount of area. It not only talks about the different types of gardening, such as vertical, container, and community gardening but also includes guidance on pest management, irrigation, harvesting, storing, and much more. So start building your own beautiful urban garden with this informative show.

things-you-didnt-know-about-hugh-hefner-.title: Things You Didn't Know About Hugh Hefner
things-you-didnt-know-about-hugh-hefner-.description: Hugh Hefner, who created Playboy magazine and spun it into a media and entertainment-industry giant — all the while, as its very public avatar, flaunting attractive young women (and sometimes marrying them) well into his 80s — died in 2017 at his home, the Playboy Mansion, in the Holmby Hills area of Los Angeles at the age of 91. Hefner the man and Playboy the brand were inseparable. Both advertised themselves as emblems of the sexual revolution, an escape from American priggishness and wider social intolerance. Both were derided over the years — as vulgar, as adolescent and exploitative. But Hefner was a success from the moment he emerged in the early 1950s and his life was unique- to put it mildly! Love him or hate him, one couldn’t ignore him. Through this exclusive insightful series, we look at who Hugh truly was, and the unconventional choices and decisions of Hefner’s life.

kuldhara-the-haunted-village.title: Kuldhara Village - The Curse of the Past
kuldhara-the-haunted-village.description: Bhoot pret ki batein ham sabne apni life mein zaroor suni hongi. Rat ke andhere main agar halki si awaz bhi ho to lagta hai mano koi saya peeche khada hai. Aise hi ek kahani hai Kuldhara - The haunted village of India ki jahan aaj bhi shaam ko jana mana hai or aaj bhi uss gaon main koi nahi rehta. Kya hai iske peeche ki sachai? Aaiye jaante hai hamare iss khaas show mein.

death-served-cold-4.title: Death Served Cold
death-served-cold-4.description: 'Death Served Cold' ya audiobook madhil Chitta thararak katha, tumhala Bhartatil srvat kroor Mahila Gunhegaranshi parichay karun detat. Satya ghatnewar adharit ya sarva goshti tumhala vichar karyla bhag padtil ki, ''kharach aplya ajubajucha jagat itke kroor gunhe ghadat astat?''... Chala tar mag nighuya Gunhegarachi Vishwachi Avishvasniya safar ghadvnarya eka Pravasavar. Ya madhe Prem ahe, Naati ahet, Vishvasghat ahe, Dhoka ahe ani ahet 7 bhayank Murders...

noya-poddhotite-biniyog-o-munafa-orjon.title: Noya Poddhotite Biniyog O Munafa Orjon
noya-poddhotite-biniyog-o-munafa-orjon.description: Aamra Ei Kotha Oswikar Korte Parbo Na Je Aamader Somoyer Beshirvag Kete Jay Laptop Hok Ba Mobileke Kendro Kore. Se Laptope Office Er Kaj Hok Ba Mobile E Social Mediate Active Thaka. Eisob Jinisgulo Aamader Jibonke Onek Sohoj Kore Diyeche. eli-cohen-mossad-ka-janbaz-jasoos.title: Eli Cohen- Mossad's Master Spy
eli-cohen-mossad-ka-janbaz-jasoos.description: Aapko kaisa lage agar koi dusre desh ka spy aapke desh mein Vice-President ban jaye ya aapke desh ki yuddh mein haar ki main wajah ho.Vo aapke liye bekar insaan hoga lekin apne desh mein hero hoga na? Israel ka aisa hi ek spy tha "Eli Cohen" jise aaj Israel mein pooja jaata hai kyun ki usi ki bahaduri se Israel ne ek saath 6 deshon ko yuddh mein akele hara diya tha.Duniya ke sabse bade spy kahe jaane wale Eli Cohen ki kahani ham le aaye hain. To der kaisi, Chaliye sune jayein Eli ke karamati mission.

discrepancy-in-health-care-in-the-us.title: Healthcare For Black Americans
discrepancy-in-health-care-in-the-us.description: Research has shown that Blacks and other minority groups in the U.S. experience more illness, worse outcomes, and premature death compared with whites. These health disparities were first "officially" noted back in the 1980s, and though a concerted effort by government agencies resulted in some improvement, recent reports show ongoing differences by race and ethnicity for all measures. This documentary highlights the discrepancy in health care among black Americans, the reasons for the discrepancy, measures that have been taken to reduce it and what more can be done to reduce the discrepancy.  Listen to this exclusive informative, revelatory documentary.

stillness-is-the-key-2.title: How To Improve Your Focus
stillness-is-the-key-2.description: Humara dimag humare sharir ka software hai, aur jis tarah se computer ka software jitna accha aur advance hota hai, utna hi computer fast aur accurate kaam karta hai. Theek usi tarah se agar humara dimag jitna humare control mein rahega aur jitna sahi disha mein kaam karega, humari life utni hi behtar hogi. Aur yeh audiobook aapko aapke dimag ko behtar banane mein help karegi. Aap na sirf yeh janenge ki humara dimag kya kya kar sakta hai, balki yeh bhi janenge ki hum apne dimag ke sath kya kya kar sakte hai

into-the-metaverse.title: Into The Metaverse
into-the-metaverse.description: You have probably already heard that Metaverse is the future. Although it might be accurate, in order to participate in what we refer to as "The New World Of Metaverse," you must know what you are doing. You will learn practically everything there is to know about Metaverse from this special series. Each episode will explore a different facet of the metaverse, including what it is, how it started, how it differs from virtual reality, how it is changing, and whether it represents our new future, and much more. Witness the future unfold with this illuminating show.

key-person-of-influence.title: Kaise Karein Influence?
key-person-of-influence.description: “INFLUENCER” shabd sunte hi aapke dimaag mein Instagram ki kuch profiles jinko "Chamchamata Blue Tick Mila Hota" hai ya kuch bade naami You Tubers ka chehra aankhon ke saamne dikhne lagta hai na? To bas aapke isi kaise ka jawaab dene aur aapko INFLUENCER ke beech apni pehchaan banane ki sateek tips dene ke liye hi to aapka "KUKU Fm" le aaya hai “Kaise Karein Influence"?

mentally-strong-thakar-sohoj-upay.description: Ei Prithibite Emon Manush Kom Aachen Jara Tader Jibone Sukh-Dukkho, Utthan-Poton Er Moto Poristhitigulo Mokabila Koren Ni. pre-independence-history-of-india.title: Pre Independence History Of India
pre-independence-history-of-india.description: Azadi se pehle india mein kai Foreign Powers ne raj kiya, Shakas Rulers, Mughals, Britishers, in sabne apne apne profit ke hisab se India ko loota aur yaha ke logo par apne rules regulations thope. Akhiri me Britishers ne, Parliament process, political system, Job exams system apne Empire ko aur strong banane ke liye banaya. Azadi ke pehle hum kaise rahte the? Humara culture, humara main kamai ka sadhan, humari entertainment industry aur humara Religion kaisa tha? In Foreign Powers ne humare culture aur Talent ko kaise khatam kar diya? Janenge sab kuch detail mein is series ke jariye. Agar aapko The Discovery of India jaisi book pasand hai, to ye audio book bhi aapko behad pasand aayegi.

science-in-different-cultures-and-religi.title: Science in different Cultures and Religions
science-in-different-cultures-and-religi.description: Science nra per ah kettale nammalla neriya per school times la therichi odidivom, kaaranam its difficult nradhu dhaan. Idhu naama paakura kannottathula dhaan iruku, Idhe science namma day to day life la, namma beliefs la eppadi kalandha vaazhviyal ah iruku nu therinjikitta adha rombave enjoy panna aarambippom. Indha audio book la science oda oru different perspective share panni irukaanga kettu science ah enjoy pannunga.

tumcha-vagnukicha-mulanvar-kay-parinam-h.title: Tumcha vagnukicha Mulanvar kay parinam hoto?
tumcha-vagnukicha-mulanvar-kay-parinam-h.description: Lahan mula hi aplya parents kade baghunch changla vait shikat astat. the-man-who-solved-the-market.title: Jim Simons ka Stock Market par asar
the-man-who-solved-the-market.description: Modern financial history mein Jim Simons sabse zyada paise kamane wale vyakti hai. Na Warren Buffet, na Ray Dalio aur na hi Steve Cohen...koi bhi investor Jim ka record nahi chhu paya. Wall Street ke investigative reporter - Zuckerman, ek world class mathematician aur code breaker ki kahani batate hai ki kaise Jim Simons ne Market mein maharat hasil ki jiska andaz duniya bhar mein phail raha hai. Agar aapko "The Little Book that still beats the Market" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

how-to-be-entrepreneur-in-a-small-town.title: How To Be Entrepreneur In A Small Town
how-to-be-entrepreneur-in-a-small-town.description: తక్కువ బడ్జెట్ తో మంచి బిజినెస్ పెట్టాలా? పట్టింది అల్లా బంగారం అవ్వాలా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోసమే

uruguay-plane-crash-_-the-impossible-res.title: Plane Crash : The Impossible Rescue
uruguay-plane-crash-_-the-impossible-res.description: Sal 1972 mein 12 October ko , International rugby players ki team ko lekar jate hue Uruguayan Air Force ka plane Kharab mausam ki Wajah se , Barf se dhaki Andes ki pahadiyon mein Crash ho gaya. Fir 10 Hafton baad  Us plane mein Savaar 45 Passengers mein Se 16 Jinda Passengers ko dhunda gaya Vo bhi tab , Jab Un 16 mein se 2 passengers kisi tarah  himmat dikhakar pahadiyon se neeche utar kar aaye. Is Audibook mein plane ke crash hone se lekar bina Water , Food aur Shelter ke bitaye gay un 10 Hafton ki poori kahani hai, Jo Humein ye bhi sikhati hai ki agar hum Brave  hai toh impossible word humare liye nahi hai.

ayurveda-for-pcos.title: Ayurveda For PCOS
ayurveda-for-pcos.description: Ayurveda is a holistic system of medicine that focuses on treating the root cause of disease and promoting overall health and wellness. Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS) is a common hormonal disorder that affects women of reproductive age. It is estimated to affect as many as 5 million women in the United States. For the treatment of PCOS, Ayurveda prescribes a multi-faceted treatment plan. It uses certain herbs to maintain hormone levels, and it focuses on therapies such as Yoga, breathing exercises and recommends a balanced diet. It also focuses on lifestyle changes such as managing one’s circadian rhythm. Listen to this exclusive informative series.

how-to-sleep-better.title: How To Sleep Better
how-to-sleep-better.description: Aapne kabhi yeh notice kiya hai ki, jab aap raat ko kam soye ho, to dusre din aapko bhukh badh jati hai ? Ye koi coincidence nahi hai. Hamare andar ek hormone hota hai, jo hamare brain ko signal deti hai ki bas, ab pet bhar gaya hai. Agar hum thik se nahi sote to ye hormone ka level gir jata aur pet bhar jane ke baad bhi hum khate rehte hai ? Itna hi nahi, achi neend na mil pane se aur bhi bahut nuksan hote jaise hamari immunity, hamari memory weak hoti hai. Hum thik se kaam nahi kar pate, hamara metabolism weak ho jata hai. To inn sab ko rokne ke liye aur ek achi neend kaise ki jaye, iske fayde kya hai ? Janne ke liye, suniye yeh audiobook

yuktahaar-the-belly-and-brain-diet-1.title: YUKTAHAAR : The Belly and Brain Diet
yuktahaar-the-belly-and-brain-diet-1.description:
ನಮ್ಮ ಆಹಾರ ಏನು ಅನ್ನೋದು ನಮ್ಮ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ತಿಳಿದಿದೆ! ಇದಕ್ಕಾಗಿಯೇ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಲೋ ಕಾರ್ಬ್, ಲೋ ಫ್ಯಾಟ್, ಕೀಟೋ, ವೀಗನ್ ಹೀಗೆ ಹತ್ತು ಹಲವು ಡಯಟ್ ವಿಧಾನಗಳಿಗೆ ಜನರು ಮುಗಿಬಿದ್ದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆದರೆ ಡಯಟ್ ಮಾಡಿರುವ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವಂತರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರಾ? ಖಂಡಿತವಾಗಿಯೂ ಅಲ್ಲ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಏನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋ ಚಿಂತೆ ಇದ್ದಿದೆಯಾ?ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಬಿಟ್ಟು 'ಬೆಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ರೇನ್ ಡಯಟ್' ಮಾಡಲಿ ಎಂಬ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾರೆ ಸೆಲೆಬ್ರಿಟಿ ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರಿಷನಿಸ್ಟ್ ಮುನ್ಮುನ ಗಣೇರಿವಾಲ್. ಇದು ಯಾವ ಹೊಸ ಡಯಟ್? ಈ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಭಗವದ್ಗೀತೆ ಏನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ? ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ನಟಿ ತಾಪ್ಸಿ ಪಣ್ಣು ಅವರ ಫಿಸಿಕಲ್ ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮೇಷನ್‌ಗೆ ಈ ಯುಕ್ತಾಹಾರ ಹೇಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಯಿತು?
ಈ ಎಲ್ಲದಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಸೆಲೆಬ್ರಿಟಿ ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರಿಷನಿಸ್ಟ್ ಮುನ್ಮುನ ಗಣೇರಿವಾಲ್ ಬರೆದ 'ಯುಕ್ತಾಹಾರ: ದ ಬೆಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ರೇನ್ ಡಯಟ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

muthuramalinga-thevar.title: Muthuramalinga Thevar
muthuramalinga-thevar.description: Pothu vaalvukaagave thannoda vaalkaiyai arpanicha oru maaberum thalaivar thaan Pasumpon Muthuramalinga Thevar avargal. Avaroda vaalkaiyila avar kadanthu vantha paathai, avar senja makkal pani, avaroda perumaigal ellathayum intha pathivula kettu therinjukonga. Thevar avargalukkana KuKu FM in samarpanam ithu.

charles-babbage-the-father-of-computer.title: Charles Babbage : Father Of Computer
charles-babbage-the-father-of-computer.description: Agar aapse koi puche ki aap kis cheez ke bina nahi reh sakoge? Aapka jawab hoga aapka mobile phone ya computer , Right? Dosto agar computer na hota to duniya ka vikas utna nahi hota jitna last 50 salon me hua hai , Lekin ye machine banane ka idea ek great mathematician ko kaise aaya? Kaunsi dikkat unhone 1830 ke aas paas face ki jisne hamari zindagi easy banadi? Chaliye sunte hai “Father of Computer - Charles Babbage” ki iss kahani mein.

ravana-lanka.title: Ravana Lanka
ravana-lanka.description: రావణుడు పాలించిన లంకా ఇప్పటి శ్రీలంక రెండూ ఒక్కటేనా? రావణ లంక నిజమే అనడానికి ఉన్న ఆధారాలేంటి? తెలుసుకోండి రావణ లంక రహస్యాలు.

sabarimala-ayyappan-kadhakal.description: സ്വാമി അയ്യപ്പന്റെ ജനനത്തിനു പിന്നിലെ യഥാർത്ഥ കഥ എന്താണ്? ആരാണ് അയ്യപ്പനെ വളർത്തിയത്? എന്തിനാണ് അയ്യപ്പനെ കാട്ടിലേക്ക് അയച്ചത്? എന്തുകൊണ്ടാണ് അയ്യപ്പൻ കൊട്ടാരവും സിംഹാസനവും ആഡംബരങ്ങളും ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചത്‌? കേൾക്കൂ ശബരിമല അയ്യപ്പന്റെ കഥകളും  ഐതീഹ്യവവും!

french-revolution.title: French Revolution
french-revolution.description: Ek tha Raja, Ek thi Rani dono mar Gaye khatam kahani, Kuch aisa he kissa hai French Revolution ka. Lekin Aaj ke waqt mein jab hum France ka naam lete hain to humare dimag mein sabse pehle Paris sheher ka wo Eiffel Tower saamne aata hai. Par kya aapko pata hai ek waqt par France ke Raja khud ko iss Dharti ka bhagwan bataate the, desh ke haalaat itne kharab the ki yaha par log roti ke liye ek doosre ki jaan lene ko bhi tayaar the. Aakhir aisa kya huwa ki France ki janta mein Kranti ki chingari bhadak uthi, Aur kaise khatam hui French Revolution ki kahani jaanenge hum iss Original Audio show "French Revolution" mein.

political-transformation-of-bengal.title: Political Transformation Of Bengal
political-transformation-of-bengal.description: Rajineeti puro bangalir addar kendro bindu te thekeche. Subhash Chandra Bose, Rasbehari Bose, Chittaranjan Das, ba Arobindo r moto biplobi ra ek somoy bharater swadhinotar andolone netrityo diyechen. Banglar rajineetir dike sorbo bharater nojor chilo shob somoye. Aj amra swadhinotar por theke bortaman somoy kal porjonto poshchimbonger rajnoitik itihas ke porjalochona korbo. 1947 saale desh swadhinota paye, Bangla bhenge poschimbongo hoi. Ekhane aj amra swadhin bharater rajyo poshchimbonger jonmo logno theke bortoman kal porjonto rajnoitik obosthar poriborton niye ekti chitro tule dhorar chesta korbo.

mecca-1.title: Mecca
mecca-1.description: మక్కా - ప్రతి ముస్లిం జీవితకాలం లో ఒక్కసారైనా మక్కా వెళ్ళాలి అని కోరుకుంటారు. ముస్లింలు మక్కాను ఎందుకు ఇంతగా ఆరాధిస్తారు? మక్కా గొప్పతనం ఏంటి? ఇలా మీకు తెలియని ఎన్నో కొత్త విషయాలు తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.!

sun-the-creator-of-astrology.title: Sun - The Creator of Astrology
sun-the-creator-of-astrology.description: Ham sabhi ne kabhi na kabhi apni kundli Pandit ji ko jarur dikhai hogi or Pandit ne koi na koi grah ka dosh bhi nikala hoga. Par kya aapko pata hai ki agar hum apni zindagi mein Surya dev ya Sun ko mana le to hamari kundli ke sab dosh dur ho sakte hain? Surya agar aapki rashi main sudhar jae to aapke zindagi mein na to paise ki kami hogi, na hi rishton mein koi man mutav ayega. To apni zindagi ko aasan banane ke liye chaliye jante hain Surya se jude kuch khaas batein.

path-prodorshok-swami-vivekananda.title: Path Prodorshok : Swami  Vivekananda
path-prodorshok-swami-vivekananda.description: Swami Vivekananda Bharot Totha Gota Biswer Kache Ek Omulyo Rotno. Tar Aadorshe Anupranito Koti Koti Manush. Tini Tar Nana Kajer  Moddhey Diye Manusher Mone Jayga Toiri Korechen. Chicagote Giye Tar Sei Vashon Aajo Manusher Mone Sara Jagay. Hindu Dhormoke Sara Biswer Samne Tule Dhorar Khetre Tar Vumika Chilo Onoswikarjo. Tukhor Medha Somponno Ei Mohan Darshoniker Jiboneo Eseche Nana Utthan-Poton. nepoleon-bonapart-by-vimal-kumar.title: Napoleon Bonaparte
nepoleon-bonapart-by-vimal-kumar.description: Ye kahani hai Europe ke sabse mahan military commander ki kahani , jinki zindagi ki shuruaat to aam family me hui , lekin dimag aur strategy ka use kar ke France ke Raja ban gaye. jinke power of desire ne unko wo mukam diya jo sapne se kam nahi. Chaliye sunte hai King Napoleon Bonaparte ke bare me jinhone 35 saal ki umar me khud ko france ka Raja ghoshit kar diya aur jo apne gale par zeher laga kar rakhte the.

yuktahaar-the-belly-and-brain-diet.title: Yuktahaar: The Belly and Brain Diet
yuktahaar-the-belly-and-brain-diet.description: Protidin Diet Mene Cholchen, Exercise Korchen Kintu Kichutei Ojon Komate Parchen Na? Aar Ei Niye Khub Chintay Aachen. Kingba Aapni Tapsee Pannu Er Moto Ovinetrir Body Dekhe Vabchen Thik Ki Korle Eirokom Fit Thaka Jay? Aar Eisob Proshner Uttor Jodi Hya Hoy, Tahole Ei Boi Aapnar Jonyo. Tapsee Pannu Er Dietician Munmun Ganeriwal Er Lekha Ei Boi Theke Aapni Emon Onekkichu Jante Parben Ja Er Aagey Kono Dietician Aapnake Boleni. Shune Nin "Yuktahaar" Er Exclusive Full Audiobook Kuku FM E.

how-we-work-1.title: Work Stress Kasa Kami Karal
how-we-work-1.description: Apan kiti hi prayatna kela ki work cha stress ghyacha tari toh yetoch. Atta ha show tumhala tumcha work stress kasa kami karyacha mhanjech work life kashi balance karaychi hey shikvanar ahe. chala tar kukufm sobat janun gheuyat Work stress kasa kami karyacha te.

the-arab-turks-invasions-in-india.description: Doston jis Bharat mein hum rehte hain isse har daur mein loot ka shikhar hona pada hai yeh loot sirf Angrezi loot tak seemit nhi hai , iss dharti par loot ke kahani to kafi pehele he suru ho gayi, jis waqt Turks aur Arabs ke aankh iss dharti par aa ruki , unhone yaha aakar khub loot paat machaya , mandir tode , libraries jalai, gyan ki bhoomi par khub katleaam kiya aur yaha ke sanskriti mei bhi daal diya zeher , Kaisa ?? little-black-book-of-stunning-success.description: Aplya sarvanach ayushyat ek goshta havi aste ti mhanje Success. Chala tar Success cha adhik javal janyasathi aikuya ''Yashakade nenare Marga'' ha khas show.

discomfort-zone.description: Ek Kahawat suni hai aapne, “Chinta Chita Ke Samaan Hoti Hai”. Chinta matlab tension. Bole to aapka kisi se Discomfort. Yahi vo feeling hai jo aapke bane banaye kaam, rishte aur career ko bigaad deti hai. Lekin hum aapko batate hain ki aap isi Discomfort ko apna sabse bada hathiyar bana sakte hain jaisa pahle bhi kai successful logon ne kiya aur safalta payi. Kaise? Isi sawal ka jawab dene aur safalta ki raah aur saaf karne ke liye KUKU Fm le aaya hai "Discomfort Ko Kahein Bye- Bye".

productivity-baranor-koushol.description: Kono Kaj Korar Jonyo Sobsomoy Byasto Thaka Joruri Noy. Karon Jodi Diner Sheshe Oi Kajer Folafol Sunyo Hoy Tahole Aapnar Puro Somoytai Nosto. ayurvedic-tips-to-boost-immunity.title: Ayurvedic Tips To Boost Immunity
ayurvedic-tips-to-boost-immunity.description: Ayurveda is considered by many scholars to be the oldest healing science. The word Ayurveda translates to “The Science of Life.” Ayurvedic knowledge originated in India more than 5,000 years ago and it is often called the “Mother of All Healing.” This alternative medicine system with historical roots in the Indian subcontinent adopts a holistic approach towards health and immunity. Balance of the body, mind and consciousness is key to Ayurveda. Learn how to use Ayurvedic principles to boost your immunity and overall wellbeing, through this fascinating series.

indian-banking-system.title: Indian Banking System
indian-banking-system.description: Kabhi Socha hai ki Bank dher saara Paisa kyu nhi chaap dete? Kyu sarkar ek baar mein he saara paisa chaaap kar logo mein baat de sari problem he solve? hai naa?  Jab Paisa Paper ka bana hai aur Machines se chaapa jata hai to kyu sare desho ke economy patri par nahi aasakti ek hi jhatke mein? Aise hi kai atpate sawaal aapko bhi aate honge na jab aap paisa , lenden, forex reserve, bank yeh sare heavy terms sunte hain. Aakhir kaise  chalti hai Desh ki Economy ? Kya hai Banks ka role ? circulation of money kis chidiya ka naam hai? Aise he sare saawalo ka jawab aapko milega iss informative audio series Indian Banking System mein .

aging-backwards-2.title: Tarun rahnyache Gupit
aging-backwards-2.description: Utaar vayaat suddha apn tarun disav as pratyekala vatat. Ho he shaky aahe. Divsaatil fukta 30 minutes aapn swatasathi nakkich kaadhu shakto. Aapan nuste tarun disnaar naahi tr aapli health suddha agdi thanthanit raahil. Yaasathi tumhala konta hee kharch karaychi garaj nahi. Agdi mofat suvidhaa aahe. ಬೌದ್ದ-ಧರ್ಮ-ಹಾಗೂ-ಮಾನವೀಯತೆ.title: Bouddha Dharma Haagu Maanaviyate
ಬೌದ್ದ-ಧರ್ಮ-ಹಾಗೂ-ಮಾನವೀಯತೆ.description: ಬೌದ್ಧಧರ್ಮಕ್ಕೂ, ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಗೂ ಅವಿನಾಭಾವ ಬಂಧ...ಶಾಂತಿ, ಸಮಾನತೆ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಯನ್ನೂ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಸಾರಿದ ಧರ್ಮವಿದು... ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ಬೌದ್ಧಧರ್ಮಕ್ಕೂ ಹಾಗೂ ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಗೂ ಇರುವ ನಂಟೇನು? ಮಾನವೀಯತೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬೌದ್ಧಧರ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಳಿರೋದೇನು? ಈ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬುದ್ಧ ಸಾರಿದ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳೇನು ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಬೇಕಾ, ಕೇಳಿ 'ಬೌದ್ಧಧರ್ಮ ಹಾಗೂ ಮಾನವೀಯತೆ ಎಂಬ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ

the-secret-principles-of-genius.title: Habits of Highly Successful People
the-secret-principles-of-genius.description: Insaani dimaag ki Takat ki koi limit nahi hoti. Ispar Yakeen Leonardo Da Vinci, Jane Austen, Albert Einstein, Stephen Hawking, Steve Jobs aur Elon Musk jaise brilliant minds ko dekh kar kiya ja sakta hai. Darsal humare mind ke kuch hidden powers hote hain jinko in sabhi logon ne unlock kardiya hai aur ab usi ka istemal karke ye success ko achieve kar rahe hain. Toh in principles ko janne aur samajhne ke liye ye audiobook ekdam perfect hai. Kyuki ye humein sikhati hai ki, kis treeke se jo poori duniya ko impossible lagta hai vo humare liye  possible ho sakta hai. Agar aapko Charles Duhigg dwara likhi "Power Of Habit" aur "Rich Habits: The Daily Success Habits of Wealthy" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook aapko zaroor sunni chahiye.

side-hustle-build-a-side-business-and-ea.title: Extra Income sathi Tips
side-hustle-build-a-side-business-and-ea.description: Extra Income kamvanyachi, apli arthik sthiti sudharnyachi aplya pratyekachich iccha ahe. Aplya Daily job sobatch ekhada chotasa business karun kinva freelance work karun extra income karva asa aplyala watat asta. Pan tya sathi avhsyak aslela vel kasa kadhava, Rojacha kam sambhalun extra kam kasa karav yacha planning madhe apli gadbad hote. Ya audio book madhe tumhala Extra Income kamvnyacha '27 Days' plan sangitla ahe, jyacha sahyanne tumhi nakkich uttam planning karu shakta ani Extra Income kamvu shakta.

how-to-make-your-resume.title: How To Make Your Resume Standout
how-to-make-your-resume.description: Kya aapko pata hai aapke career ke aage badhne mein 70% haath aapke resume ke behtar hone se badh jata hai. But I am sure yeh baat aapko pata nahi hogi. Aur aap bhi CV aur resume ko ek samajhkar, sab jagah, aise hi apna biodata bhej dete honge. Jee haan!! CV, Resume aur biodata yeh sab alag alag khet ki mooli hain, jinke baare mein detailed jankari milegi aapko humari iss audiobook mein.

vapukale-biography.title: Va.Pu.Kale
vapukale-biography.description: Vasant Purushottam Kale hey Marathi entertainment industry madhil motha nav ahe. te ek prasidha lekhak hote jyani javal javal 60 pekshahi jasta pustaka lihili ahe. Tyanchya Kamacha ulekh karaycha jhalach tr Partner, Vapurza, Hi watt ekatichi ani thikri. te ek utkrushta kathakar dekhil ahet jyani 1600 stage shows kele ahet. chala janun gheuya asha ashtapailu vyaktimatvacha pravas kukufm var.

bachharai-kal-ker-bhobishyot.description: Ei golpo theke amra parenting er byapare anek kichu shikhte parbo. Karon bachharai toh kal ker bhobishyot. scince-of-breath.title: How To Breathe
scince-of-breath.description: Jab bachcha Janam leta hai to Doctor sabse Pehle kya dekhte hain? Yahi ki bachcha saans le raha hai na? Aur fir us bachche ki life shuru hoti hai.Saans hamare liye sabse Zaroori hai ye to hame pata hai lekin kya ye pata hai ki saans zinda rakhne ke saath- saath hamein mental aur physically roop se swasth rakhne mein sabse zyada kaam ki cheez hai. Aapne kabhi Socha hai Saans kya-kya aur karti hai aur iske peechhe kaun sa Science hai? Saans ki isi Science ko aasan bhasha mein samjhane ke liye ham le aaye laye hain “How To Breathe” ki audiobook.

sankranthi-sambaralu-vishistatha.title: Sankranthi Sambaralu- Vishistatha
sankranthi-sambaralu-vishistatha.description: Sankranthi ante Telugu variki oka mukhyamaina panduga. Haridasu, gobbemmalu, Pindi vantalu, Pathangulu.. ila cheppukuntupothe sankranthiki enno vishistathalu prathyekathalu unnayi. Telugu rastrallone kakunda deshavyapthamgaa vividha perlatho jarupukune ee pandaga gurinchi ee audio book lo vini thelusukundam.

being-to-becoming-buddha-4.title: Being To Becoming Buddha
being-to-becoming-buddha-4.description: Siddhartha Gautama, more famously known as the Buddha, was the world's first and most effective missionary. He spent forty-five years traveling and spreading His doctrine to the common people and the educated classes. Buddhism, based on the teachings of Buddha, is the fourth-largest religion in the world, and its popularity has steadily increased in western countries. Although Buddhism has existed in the US since the 19th century, between 1990 and 2000, the number of believers increased by 170 percent. Recent studies indicate that there are almost 3 million practitioners of Buddhism in the US. But who was the Buddha? Although a prince by birth, why did he leave his kingdom and become a monk? How did Buddhism begin and spread across the globe? This exclusive series contains the answers to many such questions. Let us Experience the extraordinary journey of a man who came to be known as 'the enlightened one' with this illuminating show.

mike-tyson-baddest-man-on-the-planet.title: Iron Mike: The Journey
mike-tyson-baddest-man-on-the-planet.description: "Mike Mike Mike” ring ke bahar yeh halla aur tv par live boxing show jahan bas dua ki jaa ri hai mike Boxing ka koi danw pench khele aur jeet jaye. Yeh Flashback Mike Tyson ki Boxing aur unke lie duniya bhar mein craze ko batane ke liye kafi hai. Lekin Boxing mein number one maane jane wale mike asal mein bachpan mein darpok the. Aur unka kaam chori aur daka dalna tha. Aap vishwas karenge? Lekin kehte hain Qismat aur Talent insan ki Zindagi palat kar rakh deti hai. Aur Mike Tyson bhi ek chor se ban gaye Boxing Champion. Yeh audiobook series apko Mike ke isi bachpan se rubaroo karwate hue unki liife ke har pehlu se mulakaat karwayegi aur aap mike tyson ki life journey ko aur bhi achhe se jaan paoge.

area-51-1.title: Area 51
area-51-1.description: The world's most well-known military facility. And it does not exist. Area 51, a complex in the Nevada desert some 75 miles west of Las Vegas, has long captured people's imaginations even though the U.S. government has never confirmed its existence. Due to the tight secrecy surrounding Area 51, there have long been many myths and theories concerning it. Some allege it has nuclear power plants, underground tunnel networks, and alien settlements. Others think that the actual lunar landing was captured on camera there. This unique series decodes the tests and operations that took place in Area 51, from nuclear weapon testing to the construction of supersonic jets, while examining the history and urban legends surrounding the ultra-secretive base. Let's unravel the mystery of Area 51 with this thrilling show.

குபெரன்-.title: மங்காத்தா
குபெரன்-.description: அதிக வட்டிக்கு ஆசைப்பட்டு லட்சம் லட்சமாகப் பணத்தை இழக்கிறார்கள் பொதுமக்கள். நாற்பதாயிரம் கோடி ரூபாயுடன் தப்பிச் சென்ற நரசிம்மனை வலைவீசித் தேடுகிறது சி.பி.ஐ. கல்லூரிப் பேராசிரியராக, மாணவர்களின் ரோல் மாடலாக இருந்த நரசிம்மன் மோசடி மன்னனாக மாறியது ஏன்? மோசடி மன்னனின் கதையைக் கேளுங்கள்...

the-praticing-mind.title: Make Your Mind Perfect
the-praticing-mind.description: Hum sab life mein kya chahate hain? Jawab hai “KHUSHIYAAN”. Lekin Kya hamesha Khush rahte hain? Nahin na. Kyu ki Khushi milti hai success se aur hum har baar Successful bhi nahin hote hain. To kaise apne dimag ko is kaabil banayein ki aap jo kar rahe hain usmen khush rahein.
