the-genius-of-walt-disney.title: The Genius of Walt Disney
the-genius-of-walt-disney.description: The Genius of Walt Disney - Jiski imagination ne janam diya Mickey Mouse ko, jinka jeevan aaj Disneyland mein har din celebrate kiya jaata hai, jaanvar aur insaano ke beech emotions aur kahaniyo ko jodkar is kalakaar ne Animation Industry ko apni pehchaan di. Apne drawing brush aur sketch pencil ki  taaqat se Disney World banane wala yeh Shaks - Walter Elias Disney, ek American pioneer hai. Multiple Academy Awards aur ek unforgettable legacy ke saath aaj bhi hum inke banaye hue animated cartoons aur movies ke deeewane hai. Chaliye jaante hai inka khubsoorat aur inspiring safar, bilkul inki kahaniyo ki tarah.

bharatiya-masalar-itihas.title: Bharatiya Masalar Itihas
bharatiya-masalar-itihas.description: Italian, Thai ba Chinese jotoi amader pochhonder hok na keno, spicy ba masala jukto khabarer name shunle sobar prothome amader bharatiya khabarer name mathaye ashe. Bharater shob khabarer modhye ekta jinish lukiye royeche seta holo masala. Beshirbhaag masalai abiskrito hoyechilo amder desh e. Tobe besh kichu emon masala royeche ja amader desh e abiskrito naholeo amader ekhane ekhon beshi byabohar kora hoi. Bharatiya masalar itihaser byapare bistarito bhabe jate shune nin ei audiobook ti.

fast-food-nation-3.title: Fast Food Shap ki Vardan?
fast-food-nation-3.description: Eric Schlosser yancha fast food nation hey pustak tumhala healthy kasa kahaycha nahi shikvat. Hey pustak Americachya billion dollar khadya sanskruti pathi dadlele bhayaanak gupita ulagadli ahet. Tithe pratyek mintala ek janavar marla jatat ani hajaro undocumented workers hi chain chalavtat ani tumcha samore junk food thevla jata ani apan masta tav marun khato pan, pan tumhala mahiti ahe ka ki eka burger pathi kiti pranyancha jeev jato. Tumcha potat janara ha burger factory pasun te outlet kasa kele jata  hey aiku ya ya pustakachya summary dware.

congress-radio.title: The Secret Congress Radio
congress-radio.description: Azadi ki ladayi mein 1942 bahut important hai kyuki isi saal Gandhi ji ne Quit India Movement chalaya. Lekin ise logon tak pahunchane ka kaam kiya ek chhupi sanstha ne vo bhi radio se. Ise kiya tha naujawan ladkiyon ki ek toli ne jise lead kar rahi thi Usha Mehta. Kaise angreji hukumat se chhup kar alag alag jagahon se is radio ne logon mein azadi ki ladayi ki bhawana jagayi aur kaise Usha Mehta aur unki young brigade ne banaya “Secret Congress Radio”. Sab bata rahe hain “The Secret Congress Radio” mein.

sardar-vallabhbhai-patel.title: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
sardar-vallabhbhai-patel.description: India voda Irumbu Manithar Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Ivar thannoda palli paruvathula irunthe poraatta gunathoda valanthavaru. Ivar kadanthu vantha paathai India la pirantha ovvorutharukkum goosebumps erpaduthum. Ulagathulaye periya silaiyum ivarukku thaan vachirukaanga. Intha Irumbu manitharoda vaalkai payanathai ketka ready aah makkale !

designing-destiny-2.title: Designing Destiny
designing-destiny-2.description: Mitrano, "Niyati kinva Nashib" ya goshti kharch astitvat astat ka? ani astil tar aplya ayushyat nakki kay bhumika nibhawtat? Apan apla Nashib kinwa Prarbdha kharch badlu shakto ka? Tumhala hi he prashana padat astil na... Mhanunch amhi tumcha sathi gheun aloy, Kamlesh D. Patel likhit- ''Designing Destiny'' arthat "Prarbdha chi Rachna" he khas audio book. Jyat ya sarva prashanchi uttara tumhala nakki miltil.

the-cold-war-era-and-its-politics.title: The Cold War Era and Its Politics
the-cold-war-era-and-its-politics.description: Second world war ke baad, U.S, Soviet Union aur unse sambandhit sahyogiyo ke beech Cold War start hua tha. World ki do SuperPower ke beech matbhed ne pure world ka Naksha badal diya. 1947 se 1991 tak Superpower banne ki Race mein Soviet Union khatam ho gaya aur America Eklota superpower bankar ubhra. Aaj ek bar fir se Cold war ke halat ban chuke hai, lekin is baar America ke samne Russia khada hai jo ki kisi bhi mamle America se kam nahi hai. America aur Russia ke beech is Cold war ka world par kya asar pad sakta hai aur India kaha exist karta hai. Is series sab kuchh janenge detail mein.

sant-gadge-maharaj.title: Santa Gadge Maharaj
sant-gadge-maharaj.description: Samjatil Adnyan, Andhashradha, Anishta Rudhi - Parmapara door karnyasathi jyani aple akhe ayushya wechale ase Shree Santa Gadge Maharaj, mhanje maharashtra cha bhumila labhlele Daivatach. Samajat Shananta Pasravnyasathi, Lokanchi Dharmik, Samajik ani Sanskrutik pragati sadhnya madhe Sinhacha wata uchlanrya Gadge babanche sidhant ajhi aplyala khup mothi shikvan detat. Aikuya yach asadharan vyaktimatvacha Prernadayi Jeevan prawas...

wherever-you-go-there-you-are-mindfulnes.title: Meditation : Aapnar Sofolotar Rasta
wherever-you-go-there-you-are-mindfulnes.description: Aamder Sofol Hote Gele Ki Dorkar? Uttor Holo 'Meditation'. Eta Holo Ekta Chabi Ja Aapnar Sofolotar Tala Khule Dey. Kintu Sobcheye Boro Proshno Holo Nijeke Kivabe Ekagro Kora Jay? Jodi Eta Etotai Sohoj Hoto Tahole To Sobai Jibone Sofolota Peye Jeto. Kintu Eta Ototao Kothin Noy. KUKU FM Niye Elo Ei Bishesh Audiobook, Jetar Sahajye Aapni Aapnar Sofolotar Rasta Khuje Paben Kono Bandha Charai. Aasun Shune Neyoya Jak.

bs-see-you-at-the-top.title: How To Be An Exceptional Achiever
bs-see-you-at-the-top.description: Chump jiska matlab murkh hota hai, agar aap usme se "U" nikal kar "A" jod dete hai, to vo Champ ban jata hai yani vijeta. Yeh audiobook aapke andar ki kami ko nikal kar usme acchai bharne ka kaam karegi aur aapko Champ banane mein help karegi. Aapke andar ke vijeta se rubaru karwayegi. Yeh audiobook aapko wo sare tarike batayegi, jo kisi bhi insaan ko top par pahuchne mein madad kar sakte hai

indian-women-who-became-spies.title: Bhartiya Mahila Guptaher
indian-women-who-became-spies.description: Apan aaj je safe ani secure life jagat ahot tyacha shreya jasa police, military la jata titkach alplya guptaherana hi jata. Hey special agents astat je vele agodarach deshavar yenarya sankatanshi donhat kartat. Yea sathi te alplya jeevachi hi parva karat nahi. Yat mahila hi kuthe path in hair bara ka chala yancha baddal adhik janun gheuyat Bharatiya Manila guptaher ya series aware.

basics-of-mutual-fund.title: Basics Of Mutual Funds
basics-of-mutual-fund.description: 'Mutuals Funds are subjected to market risks, please read the document before investing' ye toh kafi baar suna hoga lekin ye mutual funds ke baare mein humesha confusion rehta hai. Toh aaiye sunte hai har vo detail Mutual Funds ke baare mein aur samajhte hai vo har aspect jo humko Mutual Funds ki ek basic understanding dega aur bataega ki hum kaha invest karein. Agar aapko "What Every Indian Should Know Before Investing" jaisi book pasand hai to audiobook zaroor sunein.

narendra-modi-7.title: Narendra Modi
narendra-modi-7.description: ನರೇಂದ್ರ ದಾಮೋದರದಾಸ್ ಮೋದಿ... ಇದು ಕೆವಲ ಒಂದು ಹೆಸರು ಅಲ್ಲ, ಇದು ಒಂದು ಶಕ್ತಿ! ಕೋಟ್ಯಂತರ ಜನರ ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿತ್ತಿದ ಕನಸುಗಾರ... ಸ್ವಾವಲಂಬನೆಯ ಶಕ್ತಿ ತುಂಬಿದ ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನಿ... ಭಾರತದ ಭವಿಷ್ಯವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಿದ ದೃಢ ಆಡಳಿತಗಾರ... ಅದಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಇವರೆಂದರೆ ವಿಶ್ವವೇ ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿ ನೋಡುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಅದ್ಭುತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ! ಒಮ್ಮೊಮ್ಮೆ ಚಹಾ ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ, ಇಂದಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ದೇಶದ ಪ್ರಧಾನಿಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇಂತಹ ಅಪ್ರತಿಮ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಜೀವನಚರಿತ್ರೆಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ 'ನರೇಂದ್ರ ಮೋದಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

motivation-vs-determination-3.title: Motivation vs Determination
motivation-vs-determination-3.description: ప్రేరణ మరియు సంకల్పం కి మధ్య ఉన్న తేడా ఏంటి? నచ్చిన పని చేసేందుకు కావాల్సిన ప్రేరణ ఎలా పొందాలి? సంకల్ప బలం పెంచుకునేందుకు చెయ్యవలసిన కార్యాచరణ ఏంటి?

political-knowledge-required-in-upsc.title: Political Knowledge Required In UPSC
political-knowledge-required-in-upsc.description: Kehte hai, aap bina political knowledge ke Civil Services Exams paas karne ke baare mein soch hi nahi sakte. Lekin ye aasan nahi hai, kyuki Bharat jaise desh mein aapko har gali-nukkad par Cricket, Bollywood ka expert mil jayega magar Law aur politics ke expertise ke liye bina constitution ke baare mein jaane maharath haasil karna mushkil hai. Ye Audiobook aapko UPSC mein zaruri Political knowledge degi.

how-to-build-good-attitude-3.title: How To Build Good Attitude?
how-to-build-good-attitude-3.description: Ningalkku positive  attitude undengil, stressum negative situationsum valare arogyakaramaya reethiyil ningalkku kaikaryam cheyyan kazhiyum. Ingane oru nalla positive manobhavam vikasipikkunnathinu niravadhi margangal und. Ningale sahayikkunna chila eluppa vazhikal itha.

the-us-india-nuclear-deal.title: The US-India Nuclear Deal
the-us-india-nuclear-deal.description: The US-India nuclear agreement, often known as the "123 Agreement," unveiled by George W. Bush and Manmohan Singh on July 18, 2005, marked a turning point in both nations' ties. The Bush administration's implied recognition of India's nuclear arsenal and its abrupt lifting of three decades of sanctions sparked heated discussions in India and the USA. President Bush was criticized by the US anti-proliferation group for dealing with a country that has nuclear weapons but is not a signatory to the NPT and for thereby opening Pandora's box. This unique series investigates what went behind the complex nuclear deal argument, from the initial days of sanctions by the US government on India to the heated dispute in the US Senate regarding the bill to the passing of the Hyde Act by the US House of Representatives. Get the complete detail on probably the most important agreement between the two nations.

daily-ritual-1.title: Creative Habits Of Successful Artists
daily-ritual-1.description: Jab hum koi kaam roz karne lagte hai to hume us kaam ko karne ki aadat hone lagti hai. Dimag aur sharir ek niyamit routine ke hisab se chalne lagta hai. Humari neend roz subah usi samay khulne lagti hai bina alarm ke bhi. Par Kya ek hi niyam "jaldi utho aur kaam karo" se sab kaam chal sakta hai ? Kya hum sab uth ke ek jaisa kaam karte hai ? Kya sabka routine ek jaisa hona chahiye ? Hum apna routine kaise set kar sakte hai aur ek accha routine kise kaha ja sakta hai ? Janiye iss audiobook mein . Agar aapko "Change Your Schedule, Change Your Life" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

make-your-brain-healthy.title: Make Your Brain Healthy
make-your-brain-healthy.description: We seek out strategies to maintain mental acuity throughout our lives so that we can be effortlessly productive. We exert every effort, from exploring the 'best' diet and exercise regimen for the brain to practicing yoga and meditation. Some even resort to playing video games that test memory and processing speed. This unique series offers insights that can help you heighten and protect brain function and maintain cognitive health at any age. Each episode focuses on different aspects of keeping your brain fit while addressing brain diseases, such as Alzheimer's and dementia. Keep your brain young and healthy at any age with this insightful show.

kannagi.title: Kannagi
kannagi.description: Aimperum Kappiyangalil Muthal Kappiyamaana Silapathikaram Chera, Chozha, Pandiyar aagiya mooventhargalin desathilum nigazhum kathaikalathai kondathu. Chozha naatil Pirakkum Kannagi, Maduraikku kanavanudan sendru, angu vidhiyin vasathaal  kanavanai Izhanthu , thaniyoruthi aga Chera nattukku sendru angu deivam aagiraal. Kannagiyin Vazhkai kathai vazhiyaga akkaala moovendar varalatraiyum nammaal arinthu kolla mudikirathu. Silappathikarathin Kaviya thalaivi Kannagi yin vazhkai sarithirathai azhagu thamizhil kathai vadivil koorum intha Audio puthagathai thamizh koorum nallulagu ku perumaiyudan vazhangugirathu Kuku FM. Kelunga !

how-to-start-career-in-freelancing.title: How To Start Career As A Freelancer
how-to-start-career-in-freelancing.description: Corona pandemic ke dauran jab financial crisis ka period chala to kai companies ne apne shutter down kar diye, hazaro logo ki job chali gayi. Aise mein work from home ke naye trend ki shuruaat hui. Logo ne ghar beth ke naya business aur freelancing kaam karna shuru kiya. Lekin abhi bhi bahut aise log hai, jinhe freelancing ke baare mein knowledge nahi hai. Freelancing kya hai ? Ek freelancer ke taur par kaise kaam kiya ja sakta hai ? Kaun kaun se sites freelance kaam dhundhne mein madad kar sakte hai ? Yeh kuch sawal hai, uske baare mein hum aapko batayenge iss audiobook mein

indian-tribes.title: Indian Tribes
indian-tribes.description: Namma India Nattoda aadhi kudimakkal ivanga than nu sollalam. Iyarkaiyoda inainju vazhra intha pazhangudi inangal ta irunthu namma nagareega manithargal kathukka vendiya vishyangal Niraya irukku ! Namma india muzhukka 646 pazhangudi inangal irukanga nu sollranga , adhula 20 mukkiyamana pazhangudi inangal la pathina vivarangal la  intha pathivu la solli irukkom. Kelunga !

mohabiswer-golpo.title: Mohabiswer Golpo
mohabiswer-golpo.description: Bigyan amader chhoto byala thekei akrishto kore. Shey Newton er mathay apple pora hok ba shoru jogoter ostityo. Prithibi ghorara shomoy keno amra chitke pori na, ba keno chader moto prithibi te bheshe thakte pari na, gravity, blackhole, galaxy, ulkapat, ei shob kichu niyeie chhoto thekei odomyo koutuhol. Chhoto theke4i Einstein name tar sathe amader porichoy hoi. Gota universe swomondhye jante ei golpo ti shune nin.

bombay-talkies.title: Bombay Talkies
bombay-talkies.description: Apna Cinema yeh Bombay Talkies - Lights, Camera, Action ka voh jadoo jisne Bombay ko 1930 se 1950 ke dashak ke beech maayanagri mein badal diya. Sapno ka shehar aur Hindi film industry ki yeh anokhi duniya ki shuruaat hui thi ek studios se jiska naam tha Bombay Talkies! Pati-Patni ke is creative jodi ne, Ashok Kumar, Dilip Kumar, Raj Kapoor, Dev Anand aur Madhubala jaise sitaaro ko celluloid par larger than life superstars bana diya. Chaliye chalte hai Hindi cinema ke classic daur mein aur jaante hai hindustaan ke pehle advanced film making studios ki kahaani.

indian-red-cross-society-1.title: Indian Red Cross Society
indian-red-cross-society-1.description: Namma indiavudaiya Migapperiya Sevai amaipaa irukkura Indian Red Cross Society (IRCS) Eppadi uruvachu, athoda kolgaigal seyalpadugal laam enna ?, Avanga senja mukkiyamana sevaigal enna ? athula member aagurathukku enna seyyanum ? Ippdai Indian Red Cross Society Sambathamana ella kelvigalukkum vidai kodukkura muzhumaiyaana pathivu ithu.Vanga IRCS pathi therinjukalam.

mat-rahna-school-ke-bharose.title: Mat Rahna School Ke Bharose
mat-rahna-school-ke-bharose.description: Kya school mein top kar lene se aapka ya aapke bacchon ka future set ho jaega? Kya school mein zindagi mein kamyab hone ki sabhi zaroori tarkeebein sikhai jaati hain? Aaiye jaante hain Dr. Abrar Multani ki likhi is kitaab mein.

how-to-invest-in-mutual-funds.title: How To Invest In Mutual Funds
how-to-invest-in-mutual-funds.description: మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్స్‌లో ఎలా పెట్టుబడి పెట్టాలి? మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్స్ అంటే ఏమిటి?సరైన ఫండ్ ఏది? మ్యూచువల్ ఫండ్స్‌ గురించి సమగ్ర వివరణ మీకోసం.

motivation-vs-determination-2.title: Motivation vs Determination
motivation-vs-determination-2.description: Oru pakshe namuku chinthikkano manassilakkano pattunnathinum apuramanu prachodanam, dridanishchayam enne vaakkukalkku nammude jeevithathil kondu varan saadhikkunna avishwasaneeyamaya maattangal. Athine patti valare vishadamayi thanne manassilakkam  'Motivation vs Determination' enna showilude.

the-fifth-discipline.title: Business Ki Fast Growth Ka Secret
the-fifth-discipline.description: Ek successful organization bana paana asaan baat nhi hai chaahe aap kitni hi planning ya strategy bana lo aapko apne har naye kadam par ek nayi problem ya uncertainties ka saamna karna pad sakta hai, jisme aapki madad karegi "Business Ki Fast Growth Ka Secret" audiobook jo aapko batayegi ki organization ka system kaise work karta hai, organization ka vision kya hona chahiye aur ek successful organization ka fifth discipline kya hota hai. Agar aapko Gary Keller dwara likhi "The One Thing: The Surprisingly Simple Truth Behind Extraordinary Results" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

how-rakesh-jhunjhunwala-became-the-big-b.title: How Rakesh Jhunjhunwala Became "The Big Bull Of India"
how-rakesh-jhunjhunwala-became-the-big-b.description: Rakesh Jhunjhunwala is well-known for his bullish outlooks and stock market forecasts. He had the Midas touch as an investor. This genius's life tale, which began from nothing, is nothing short of extraordinary. But how did he become a billionaire? And how did he make profitable investments? This special series is about the famed ace investor referred to as the Warren Buffet of India and follows the life of a beloved, devoted father and husband, as well as the philosophy of a billionaire. This show will help you discover how Rakesh made his riches and made wise bets in everything from stock markets to Bollywood. Learn the craft of stock trading and investment from the master and get inspired to build an empire like Rakesh Jhunjhunwala with this show.

सबकॉन्शस-माइंडची-जादू.title: The Power of your Subconscious Mind
सबकॉन्शस-माइंडची-जादू.description: Mitrano, he pustak tumhala tumcha manatil Shakticha, Shrimanticha anubhav karun dete. Apan aple Subconscious Mind arthat Supta Man kinva Achetan Man yogya prakare waprle, tar tyache kay Positive parinam aplyala miltat he ya pustakat sangitle ahe. Manachi Shakti kashi olkhaychi, ticha madatine aplya daily life madhil samsyanvar kashi maat karyhci, Supta manacha sahayane Pragati kashi sadhaychi ya saglya vishayi jar tumhala janun gheychi iccha asel, tar he audio book tumcha sathi uttam guide ahe. Aika ani anubhava Tumcha Subconscious Mind chi Jadu...

boost-your-self-esteem-in-30-days.title: Self-Esteem Badhane Ke Easy Rules
boost-your-self-esteem-in-30-days.description: “Phir Hera Pheri” movie to har kisi ne dekhi hogi. Aapko uska dialogue yaad hai “21 din mein paisa double”. Nahi is show mein hum aapko kisi aise bank ke baare mein nahi bata rahe hain lekin 30 din mein apni self-esteem ko boost karke aap kaise successful ban sakte hain vo zaroor is show mein jaanege. Kuku FM par is Original Series mein aap self-esteem ki apni life mein zaroorat aur usko boost karne ki saari tricks ko samajh jayenge. chaliye bina chakkar khaye is series ko shuru karte hain aur khud ki self-esteem ko boost karte hain.

mecca.title: Mecca
mecca.description: MECCA - Muslim galoda intha punitha sthalam manithargal uruvaagurathukku munnadiye uruvaanathunu solraanga. Intha Mecca ku pinnadi irukka varalaaraiyum, Mecca payanam evvalavu punithamaanathu num intha pathivula kettu therinjukalaam. Intha Audio pathivu moolamaa punitha payanam seiyalaam vaanga.

how-to-plan-a-family-budget.title: How to Plan a family budget ?
how-to-plan-a-family-budget.description: Namma financially independent aah irukka kandippa budget romba mukkiyam ! Intha pathivula ungalukku varra income vachu eppadi sariyaana budget podalaamnu neenga kettu therinjukalaam. Sikkanam panrathu pathi neraya per solirupaanga, but sikkanathai eppadi plan panni panrathu nu naanga ungalukku solla porom.

nambi-narayanan.title: Nambi Narayanan - A Victim of ISRO Spy Scandal
nambi-narayanan.description: Ye ek Aise Insan ki Kahani hai jo ISRO ke Great scientist mein se ek reh chuke hai, Inhone NASA ke offer ko thukra kar apne desh ke ISRO ko chuna, Inka Naam bhale hi aap shayad pehli baar sun rahe ho lekin aaj, humare space research centre ISRO ki success mein bahut bada yogdan inka bhi hai. Dr. Nambi Narayanan ko jhute spy Scandal mein fasa diya gaya tha, jiski vajah se inka career hi khatam ho gaya. Aaiye jaante hai inki kahaani

how-to-fight-pcod-3.title: How to fight PCOD?
how-to-fight-pcod-3.description: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಎಂಬುದು ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯ.! ಆದರೆ ಇತ್ತೀಚೆಗೆ ಹಲವಾರು ಕಾಯಿಲೆಗಳು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿವೆ. ಅದರಲ್ಲೂ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ದೈಹಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರುತ್ತಿರುವ PCOD ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, PCOD ಅಂದರೆ ಏನು? ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಜತೆಗೇ PCOS ಅಂದರೆ ಏನು? PCOD ಬಂದರೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲವೇ? ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವುದಾದರೂ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯಿದೆಯೆ? ಇದನ್ನು ಆಹಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಬಹುದೆ ಎಂಬುದು ನಿಜವೇ? ಯೋಗ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದರೆ ಅದರಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಲಾಭವೇನು? ಇಂತಹ ಹಲವು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಉತ್ತರ! ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಫೈಟ್ PCOD?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ ನಿಮ್ಮ KukuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.

alan-turing.title: Alan Turing : Decrypting Germans
alan-turing.description: 2nd World war mein Hitler ki nazi army ne aadha Europe jeet liya tha, wajah thi ek secret code machine "Enigma", jiski wajah se England ki pareshani badhne lagi thi. Tab ek genius ne aisi machine banayi jis se raato raat saare nazi attacks fail hone lage. Iss Super Hero ka Naam tha " DR. Alan Turing ". Chaliye Sunte hai Artificial Intelligence ke Pita ki kahani jinki waje se world war 2 saal pehle khatam ho gaya aur humari mordern technology ka invension hua.

therindha-manidhargalin-theriyatha-katha.title: Therindha Manidhargalin Theriyatha Kathaigal
therindha-manidhargalin-theriyatha-katha.description: Namakku Therinja famous aana thalaivargal vazhkai la nadantha, namakku theriyatha kathaigalin thoguppu thaan intha pathivu. Suvarasyam Aacharyam kalantha pala thagavalgal idhula irukku kandipa kelunga.

history-of-nato-vs-russia-2.title: History Of NATO Vs Russia
history-of-nato-vs-russia-2.description: 2 Loka mahayudhangalk saakshyam vahicha ee lokathil innum yudha kaahalangal muzhangunnund. Natoyude sainika neekkangalkkethire Ukrain nu ethire yudham prakhyapichirikkukayanu Russia. Loka Police chamanju America mattoru bhagath. Adhikara vadamvalikalum adhinivesha manobhavavum thudarunnidatholam kalam yudhangal avasanikkumennu thonnunnilla. NATO - Russian kombu korkkalukale kurich vishadamayi ee Showyilude ariyam.

100-crore-money-heist.title: 100 Crores Bank Heist
100-crore-money-heist.description: Bank Robbery ki kahaniyan to aapne bohot suni hongi aur shayad Money Heist web series bhi aapne zarur dekhi hogi. Par kya aapne iss desh ke sabse bade Bank Robbery Ki kahani suni hai, Aur iss mastermind ke piche kiska haath hai, kya ye jaanne ki koshish ki hai? Humare iss Original show "100 Crores Bank Heist" mein aapko ek aise Bank Heist ke baare me jaanne ko milega jo shayad kisi Hollywood film ki kahani se kum nahi hai.

bangla-theater-er-itihas.title: Bangla Theater Er Itihas
bangla-theater-er-itihas.description: Theater er jonmo prachin Greece. Theater shobdo ti eseche muloto greek shobdo 'theatron' theke jar ortho 'A place of seeing and expressing the whole part' orthat emon ekta sthan jekhane dekha ebong prokash dui somohimay birajomaan thake. Theater ba natok amader jibon ba jogot ke bhinnyo bhabe dekhte sahajyo kore. Bharatborshe natyo chorchar itihaser dike takale dui sroshtar name uthe ashe tara holen, Kaalidas oh Vyas. Sanskrito natoker onyotomo boishisto holo chhonder madhyome kothopokothon toiri kore bibhinyo drishyo o choritro bojhano. Ei shob nana rokomer itihas aj amra jene nebo ei audiobook ti theke.

privileges-we-get-when-we-start-a-new-bu.title: Privileges We Get When We Start A New Business
privileges-we-get-when-we-start-a-new-bu.description: Saadhyathakalude valiyoru lokam namuk munnil thurakkappedukayanu oru business thudangunnathilude sambhavikkunnath. Start Up kal aarambhikkunnavark munnil niravadhi saadhyathakal sarkkarukal thanne thurannidunnu. Oru Business thudangunnathinu munpu arinjirikkenda karyangal enthokke aanu. Businessinte oro ghattathilum namuk undakunna nettangal enthokke aanu. Ellam ee showyilude namuk ariyam.

book-the-thin-green-line.title: Paison Ka Sahi Istemaal Kaise Karein
book-the-thin-green-line.description: Iss duniya me aisa kon nahi hoga jo bauth saare paise kama kar khoob ammer aur successful banna chahta hoga, Par log paisa to kama lete hain par usee kaise manage karna hai, Kitni savings karni hai, Kaha kitna invest karna hai aur hume apne zaruraton ko kaise Kam karna hai shayad ye har koi nahi samajh pata. Lekin ab aap bilkul mat ghabraiye kyuki hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain "Paison Ka Sahi Istemaal Kaise Karein" Ki ye audio book jise sun kar aap apne paiso ko sahi tarike se manage kar uska sahi istamal karna sikh paayenge.

do-epic-shit-4.title: Do Epic Shit
do-epic-shit-4.description: Famous Entrepreneur, Motivational speaker ani Author- Ankur Warikoo tyacha 'Do Epic Shit' ya pustakatun, Ayushay adhik Changla kasa ghadvata yeil ya vishayi aplyala kahi sopya tips detat. Ayushyatil problems na kasa face karycha, Aplya Habits cha aplya life var kay prabhav padto, Apla jeevnakade baghnyacha drushtikon kasa asava...asha anek muddyanavr tyani ya audio book madhe charcha keli ahe. He audio book aikalyavar tumhala uttam Motivation milel he nakki.

காற்றின்-நிறம்-கருப்பு.title: காற்றின் நிறம் கருப்பு
காற்றின்-நிறம்-கருப்பு.description: போபால் விஷவாயு சம்பவம் விபத்தா அல்லது சதியா என்பது இன்னமும் புதிராகவே இருக்கிறது. விபத்தாக இல்லாமல் சதியாக இருந்தால் என்கிற கற்பனைக் கேள்விக்கு பதிலாக அமைந்துள்ளது இந்த நாவல். நிமிடத்துக்கு நிமிடம் பரபரப்பும் திகிலும் இழையோடக் கேளுங்கள் காற்றின் நிறம் கருப்பு...

what-your-customer-wants-and-cant-tell-y.title: Business mein customers ko kaise retain karein?
what-your-customer-wants-and-cant-tell-y.description: Ye book summary economics ke theoretical knowledge ke beyond jaa kar aapko business ke practical insights degi. Ki kaise real mein bade bade businessmen apne companies ko behtar banane ke liye kai methods ka istemaal karte hai aur jaan lete hai ki naye customers ke saath saath purane customers bhi kaise retain kiye jaaye. Agar aapko "Built To Last" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

how-to-multiply-your-savings-1.title: How To Multiply Your Savings ?
how-to-multiply-your-savings-1.description: పెట్టుబడులు ఎక్కడ పెట్టాలి? బంగారం మీద పెట్టుబడి పెట్టడం మంచిదేనా? తక్కువ పెట్టుబడితో ఎక్కువ లాభాలు ఎలా పొందాలి? ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

how-to-say-no-1.title: How to say No?
how-to-say-no-1.description: ಯಾವುದೇ ವಿಚಾರಕ್ಕೆ "ಹೌದು" ಅನ್ನೋದು ಸುಲಭ, ಆದರೆ "ಬೇಡ" ಅಥವಾ "ಇಲ್ಲ" ಅನ್ನೋದು, ಅದು ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಜೀವನವಾಗಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಜೀವನವಾಗಲಿ, ತುಂಬಾ ಕಷ್ಟ. "ಇಲ್ಲ" ಅನ್ನೋದಾದರೆ ನಾವು ಎಲ್ಲಿಯೊ ಸರಿಯದೇ ಇದ್ದೇವೆ ಅಥವಾ ನಮ್ಮ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಏನಾದರೂ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು ಎಂಬ ಭಯವೇ ಇದರ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಾರಣ. ಆದರೂ, ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನಗತ್ಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳು ಆಗಬಾರದೆಂದರೆ, "ಇಲ್ಲ" ಹೇಳಲು ಕಲಿಯುವುದು ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಯಾವ ವಿಚಾರಗಳಿಗೆ "ಇಲ್ಲ" ಹೇಳಬೇಕು? ನಿಮ್ಮಿಂದಾಗದ ಕೆಲಸಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ವಿನಯಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಬೇಕು? ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಸೆ ನೊ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.

legendary-advice.title: Extraordinary Tips to Increase Your Income, Wealth And Lifestyle
legendary-advice.description: Paise se bhale hi har khushi na aati ho par paisa har uss cheez ke liye zaruri hota hai jisse khusi aati hai. Shayad aapne bhi apni zindagi me kabhi na kabhi to paiso ki kami jarur mehsoos ki hogi. Par is Audio Book mein Author ne bohot sare aise tips ko share Kiya hai jise use kar aap apne job ke sath sath aur bhi alag alag tarikon se paisa kama sakte hain aur sirf paisa he nahi balki apne health ke kis tarah se dhayan rakhna hai un topics par bhi charcha ki hai. Agar aapko "Coffee Can Investing: The Low Risk Road To Stupendous Wealth" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook  zaroor sunein.

china-and-india-1.title: China And India
china-and-india-1.description: Lokathile thanne vanshakthikal aanu innu Indiayum Chinayum. Vaideshika sakthikaludeyum raaja bharanathinteyum chooshanangalkk adippett ottum nallathallatha bhoothakalam ulla iru rajyangalum pakshe innu ella rangathum lokathe swadheena shakthikal aanu. Iru rajyangaludeyum valarchayude vividha ghattangalum nettangalum nilavile avasthayum bhaviyum ee showyilude ariyam.

game-plan-for-dividing-india.title: Game Plan For Dividing India
game-plan-for-dividing-india.description: February 1947, British Prime Minister Clement Attlee apne office men baith kar India ke viceroy Mountbatten ko chitthi likh rahe the.Chitthi India pahunchi aur usi chitthi men likhe order ke baad Mountbatten ne eilaan kar diya ki Bharat Ko Azad kar diya jayega.Kya likha tha us chithi men, Kyu British sarkar ne jaldibazi men bharat ko chhodane ka plan banaya aur kaise jaane se pahle poori planning ke saath India ko do tukdon men baant diya gya? Ye sab Batane aur is planning ka poora itihas batane ke liye ham le aaye hain “Game Plan For Dividing India”.

zen-and-the-art-of-happiness-1.title: Zen ani Anandi Rahnyachi Kala
zen-and-the-art-of-happiness-1.description: ''Zen and the Art of Happiness'' he pustak tumhala Anandi, Sukhi ani Samadhani Ayushya jagnyacha 'Kanmantra' dete. World famous 'Zen' pranali madhe sangnyat aleli Happy Life chi sankalpana yaat samjavun sangitli ahe. Ayushyat Successful bananyasathi kay karave, konte marga nivdavet ani kontya chuka talavyat ya vishayi he pustak tumhala guide karte. Tumhala tumcha ayushya ajun changla banvychi iccha asel tar he pustak tumhi avarjun aiklach pahije...

the-new-bjp-1.title: The New BJP
the-new-bjp-1.description: The BJP has consistently outperformed the opposition in elections since 2014, both at the federal and state levels, showing that it has expanded beyond its traditional Hindu constituency. Political scientist and journalist Nalin Mehta investigates the growth of the BJP into the largest political party in the world in this fascinating book. He goes beyond the typical account of the party's Hindutva policies to show how, under Narendra Modi, it used its particular style of social engineering to transform the Indian democracy. "The New BJP" is full of startling new perspectives on how the party and the nation function. It contains new insights into the BJP's growth regions, such as the Northeast, women voters, and South India, which are supported by previously untapped historical documents, exclusive conversations with party leaders, and thorough reporting from around India. This is not just a book; it is a clear, unbiased analysis of the BJP and contemporary India.

the-assassinated-once.title: The Assassinated Ones
the-assassinated-once.description: Itihaas hamein batata hai ki Jab do vichardhara yaani alag-alag opinion ke logon ke beech disagreements badhte hain, to wo ek khooni roop le lete hain. Es series app sunenge kuch aisi hi sachhi kahaniyan jinmein darz hain itihaas ke wo qisse jahan aawaz ko dabane ke ke liye Assassination yani qatl ka raasta chuna gaya.

how-to-format-your-body-clock-1.title: How to format your Body Clock?
how-to-format-your-body-clock-1.description: ಕಾಲ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾ ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿಯೂ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಇದರ ಪರಿಣಾಮವಾಗಿ, ಮೊದಲು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ 80-90 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಾಳುವುದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ, ಇತ್ತೀಚೆಗೆ 60 ದಾಟುವುದು ಕೂಡ ಹಲವರಿಗೆ ಕಷ್ಟವಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದರೂ, ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಹ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ನಾವು ಮುಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಂಡರೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿರುವುದು ಪಕ್ಕಾ. ಹೀಗಾಗಿ, ಹಾಳಾಗಿರುವ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿಯನ್ನು ಸರಿಮಾಡಲು ನೀವು ಕೈಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತೀರಾ? ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಫಾರ್ಮಾಟ್ ಯೂರ್ ಬಾಡಿ ಕ್ಲಾಕ್?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗಿರಿ!

bangla-o-bangalir-gorbo-mamata-banerjee.title: Bangla O Bangalir Gorbo: Mamata Banerjee
bangla-o-bangalir-gorbo-mamata-banerjee.description: Poschim bonger prothom mohila mukhyomontri holen ar keu noi, sokoler Mamata Banerjee. Poschimbonger itihash ke poriborton korar khomota ar karur chilo na, ei bonger jonno dorkar chilo ekjon dokkho mukhyomontri. Onar haat dhorei rochito hoi notun bonger itihash. Kibhabe nari hoyeo nijer lorai ke bachiye rakha jaye, nijeke jono somajer kache ujjibito kora jaye tar kach theke sekha jaye. Tini manusher mone notun asha, notun bhorsha sonchar korte perechen. Tar odhine aj bonger nari ra surokhhito onubhob koren. Tini ajker juger nari der kache shokti swarupa. Ashun mukto mona ei rajnitibider somporke kichu jene nin.

chauri-chaura.title: Chauri Chaura Andolan
chauri-chaura.description: Chaura Chauri Andolan ? and not an incident, aisa shayd he kise ne suna ho, jis ghatna ko humne apne History books mein ek Violent Incident samajh kar padha,  kya sach mein wo bas ek incident tha ya usse kahin jyada tha? aakhir kaise seedhe saadhe Kisaan itne violent hogaye ke unhone poora Police Station hi jala daala ? Gandhi jee ke iss incident par kya rai thi? Kya wakai jo hume padhaya gaya wo he sacchai hai? inn sab questions ke aapko detail mein jawab milenge humari iss informative audio series mein.

buddhadeb-bhattacharya.title: Buddhadeb Bhattacharya : The Unsung Hero
buddhadeb-bhattacharya.description: Onekta Somoy Periye Giyeche, Sokriyo Rajniti Theke Onek Dure Royechen Poshchimbonger Prakton Mukhyomontri Buddhadeb Bhattacharya. Dirgho 11 Bochor (2000-2011) Mukhyomontritwer Dayitwo Samlechen Tini. Tar Shasonkalei Singure Tata Nano Aasey, Jodio Sei Prokolpo Nana Karone Rupayon Kora Somvob Hoye Othe Na. Rajnitir Pashapashi Tini Ekjon Sahityiko Bote. Jubo Somajke Dekhiyechilen Notun Disha. Oneker Kache Aadorsho Hoye Uthechilen Tini, Dol Nirbisheshe Bohu Loker Icon Tini. Byakti Hisebe Kemon Chilen Tini ? Kivabe Elen Rajnitir Aanginay ? Tar Shasonkale Ki Ki Bitorker Sristi Hoyechilo? Aaj Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye Buddhadeb Bhattacharya Er Somporke Emon Kichu Jana- Ojana Kotha Janar Chesta Korbo.

how-to-move-on-from-past-relationship-1.title: How To Move On From Past Relationship?
how-to-move-on-from-past-relationship-1.description: మీరు మీ పాస్ట్ రిలేషన్శిప్ నుండి బయటపడాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? మీరు మీ పాత అనుబంధాల నుండి బయటపడటానికి ట్రై చేస్తున్నారా? మిమ్మల్ని వెంటాడుతున్న మీ పాత రిలేషన్షిప్స్ యొక్క ఆలోచనల నుండి బయటపడి మీ  ప్రస్తుత మరియు ముఖ్యమైన బంధాల మీద ఫోకస్ పెట్టేలా చెయ్యడానికి మీకు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ హెల్ప్ చేస్తుంది.

The-हिटलर-way.title: The Hitler Way
The-हिटलर-way.description: Ek aisa vyakti jiski vajah se duniya ko itihaas ki sabse badi jung dekhne ko mili... EK mamuli sa ladka jo bada hokar ek bereham dictator ban jaata hai, kaise kiya usne ye? Kaise puri duniya ko apni edi ke nok par laa kar rakh diya tha is dictator ne? Jaanenge itihaas ki ye kahani is show mein

how-to-be-a-good-public-speaker.title: How To Be a Good Public Speaker?
how-to-be-a-good-public-speaker.description: అందరిలాగే మీరూ స్టేజి మీద నిలబడి మాట్లాడలేకపోతున్నారా? భయపడకుండా స్టేజ్ పై నిలబడి చక్కగా మాట్లాడాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? ఇంకెందుకు ఆలస్యం మరి వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

neil-armstrong-the-moon-walk.title: Neil Armstrong - The Moon Walk
neil-armstrong-the-moon-walk.description: "That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind." - Yeh woh alfaaz hai, jinhe Neil Armstrog ne chaand par kadam rakhte hi kahe the. Yeh pehle insaan bane jinhone chaand par kadam rakha. NASA aur American government ne International Space Race mein ek naya mukaam haasil kar liya. Aur yeh mumkin hua tha is naujaavan ke jazbe se jiska safar ek aeronautical engineer, naval aviator se hokar Korean War mein ek fighter pilot aur aage chalkar legendary Astronaut par aa ruka jisne maanav itihaas mein apna naam hamesha ke liye darz kara liya. Chaliye jaante inka chaand tak ka safar.

cbi-central-bureau-of-investigation-1.title: CBI ( Central Bureau of Investigation )
cbi-central-bureau-of-investigation-1.description: CBI anedhi oka investigation agency, mana india lo enno crimes ni, Aviniti ni apadaniki modalayina oka agency, veellu police chetilo parishkaram dorkani enno case lanu solve chesthuntaru. Villaku e state government tho sambadam undadhu.Bhopal gas tragedy lo cbi chaala pedda pathra poshinchindi, asalu ee cbi ante enti? idhi ela putindi? ila inka enno vatiki miku samadanam kavali ante ventane e audio book ni vinandi.

how-to-join-indian-armed-forces-2.title: How to Join Indian Armed Forces
how-to-join-indian-armed-forces-2.description: Indian Armed forces lo join ayyi deshaniki seva chayalanedi enthomandi bharateeyula dream. But Army lo join ayye avakashalu,margalu chalamandiki teliyavu. Alanti vaari kosam “How to join Indian Armed Forces” Audio book ni Kuku fm mee munduku teesukuvachindi. Ikkada Indian Army lo Unna Avakashalu, Elagaina Aa post nu fdakkinchukune margala gurinchi clear ga explain cheyabadutundi.

tiny-little-things.title: The Confusion Free Life
tiny-little-things.description: Kya aapne kabhi kisi interview mein kisi insan ki life ki situation ko suna aur kaha hai  "are yeh hubahu mere sath bhi tha lekin mujhe samajh nahi aaya ki main us situation mein kya karun?" To yeh Original Show apke liye hi hai jismein hum aapko alag-alag logon ki problems ke letters ko unke solution ke saath batayenge jinmein apki life ya love story bhi kahin chhupi mil jaayegi. To chaliye shuru karte hain letters ke is safar ko aur jaaniye kiski Life Story ya letter apka bhi letter hai.

how-to-say-no.title: How to Say NO
how-to-say-no.description: Mee personal and professional life chalasarlu NO cheppadam chala imporatant. Mee professional and personal growth ni improve cheyadaniki ee audiobook oka guid laga untundi.  Inka mee life ni positive ga marchi feedback and critical analysis chesukoni normal nundi greter position ki velldaniki help chestundi

malayali-and-beef.title: Malayali and Beef
malayali-and-beef.description: Malayalikalude beef priyam rajyam muzhuvan famous aanu. Beefum porottayumanu Malayalikalude dheshiya bhakshanamennu palarum thamasha roopena polum pareyarund. Enthukondanu Malayalikalkku mathram beefinod ithra priyam? Ariyam 'Malayali and Beef' enna ee showiloode.

the-earned-life.title: Aap Kaisi Life Chahatein Hain?
the-earned-life.description: Aaj har koi apni life ko balanace karna chahta hai aur uske liye hum alag alag logon se unke suggestions lete hai, youtube par videos dekhte hai aur sab kuch plan bhi kar lete hai, but jab baat aati hai inn saari cheezon ko apni real life me execute karne ki to hum khudko aur zyada confused paate hai, "Aap Kaisi Life Chahatein Hain" audiobook aapke inn saare confusions ka ek clear cut answer hai. Aap har episode ke saath apni life ko balance karna aur khush rehna dono jaan jaayenge.

history-of-genghis-khan-1.title: History Of Genghis Khan
history-of-genghis-khan-1.description: Genghis Khan's Mongol army ruled over more areas and people in 25 years than the Romans did in 400. The Mongols brought an unparalleled surge in intercultural dialogue, increased trade, and the emergence of civilization to practically every nation they invaded. Genghis Khan was far more progressive than his European or Asian contemporaries; he outlawed torture, provided absolute freedom of religion, and overthrew aristocratic feudal structures. This unique audio series tells the epic tale of how the modern world came to be, from the tale of his ascent from tribal society to the explosion of civilization that the Mongol Empire unleashed. Discover the astonishing true story of how one extraordinary man from a far-off land built an empire that propelled humanity into the modern era.

chanakya-niti-20.title: Chanakya Neeti
chanakya-niti-20.description: Kautilya, or Vishnu Gupta, generally referred to as Acharya Chanakya, was the author of the historic Indian political book known as Arthasastra. He is regarded as the father of political science and economics in India, and his work is regarded as a crucial forerunner to classical economics. The ideal method of living is discussed in Chanakya Neeti, which demonstrates Chanakya's thorough research into Indian culture. The special series illustrates his niti-sutras, beliefs, and concepts in many contexts—situations that are still relevant today—and discusses the behaviors and patterns one should exhibit when interacting with other people. Transform your life with the wisdom of one of the greatest teachers in history.

make-your-own-luck.title: Aapki Kismat Ke Taale Ki Chabi
make-your-own-luck.description: Hum aksar apne failure ko badluck bolke sochte hain ki humara kuch nahi ho paayega. Is Original show ko sunne ke baad aapko samajh mein aayega ki hum apna luck khud hi bana sakte hain aur apne luck ko apne tareeqe se use bhi kar sakte hain. humara luck aur koi nahi sirf hum hi apni qismat ko banate hain. to chaliye shuru karte hain apni Qismat ko unlock karne ke safar ko.

vijay-tendulkar.title: Vijay Tendulkar
vijay-tendulkar.description: Vijay Dhondopant Tendulka hey marathi kalasrushtitil ek prasidha nav ahe. Tendulkarani anek natak, chitrapat ani durdarshan lekhak, sahitya nibhandkar, rajkiya patrakar anu parmukhyane marathitil samajik bhashyakar hote. Vijay  Tendulkar yanchya prasidha nakatanchya yadit 'Shantata - court chalu ahe', 'Ghashiram kot val' ani Sakharam baindar'. Tyanchi natak hi vastavik ani samajik vishayanvar adharit hoti ya janun gheuyat tyanchya jeevana baddal.

கர்ணன்-துரோகங்களை-வென்றவன்-.title: கர்ணன் -துரோகங்களை வென்றவன்
கர்ணன்-துரோகங்களை-வென்றவன்-.description: மாதா, பிதா, குரு, தெய்வம் ஆகிய நால்வரும் தான் ஒருவரின் வளர்ச்சிக்கும் காரணமாக இருப்பார்கள். ஆனால், கர்ணன் தன் வாழ்வில் அனைவராலும் கைவிடப்பட்டு வஞ்சிக்கப்பட்டவன். துரோகங்களால் வீழ்த்தப்பட்டவன். அவன் எப்படி துரோகங்களை எதிர்கொண்டான்?

how-we-work.title: How To Manage Your Work Load
how-we-work.description: Hum subha jaldi kaam par jaate hain aur shaam hote-hote frustrate ho jaate hain. Humein lagta hai ki hum itni mehnat karte hain lekin phir bhi kaam ka load roz ban jaata hai. To humein sabse pehle kaam ko kaise karna hai yeh samajhne ki zaroorat hai. Kuku FM par is original series ko sun kar  aap  apne kaam ko sahi direction aur guidance ke saath kar ke apni aur company ki productivity badha sakte hain. Saath hi aap kaam ko sahi tarike se karna seekh jayenge aur apne aap ko khush bhi rakh payenge.

how-to-build-good-attitude-1.title: How to build Good Attitude ?
how-to-build-good-attitude-1.description: ಜೀವನ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿರಬೇಕೆಂದರೆ ಗುಡ್ ಅಟಿಟ್ಯೂಡ್ ಇರಬೇಕೆಂದು ಕೇಳಿರ್ತೀರ, ಅಲ್ವಾ? ಹೀಗಾದರೆ, ಈ ಗುಡ್ ಅಟಿಟ್ಯೂಡ್ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನು? ಇಂತಹ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅಟಿಟ್ಯೂಡ್ ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಈ ಗುಡ್ ಅಟಿಟ್ಯೂಡ್ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ನಡೆಸಲು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕೆ? ಹೀಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಕೇಳಿ, 'ಹೌ ಟು ಬಿಲ್ಡ್ ಗುಡ್ ಅಟಿಟ್ಯೂಡ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯ.

history-of-ahom-dynasty.title: Ahom Dynasty
history-of-ahom-dynasty.description: Humne school ki kitabon mein humesha Mughal Badshah ke bare me padha hai , lekin yeh kahani aise logon ke baare me hai, jinhone sirf ek ya do baar nahi balki 17 baar mughalo ko haraya hai , Ye ansuni kahani India ke North East ke Ahom Rajao ke baare me hai jinhone logo ke Dharma aur culture ke liye badi sena ko baar baar haraya.

motivation-vs-determination-1.title: Motivation Vs Determination
motivation-vs-determination-1.description: Oru velaiya start panna namakku thevai Motivation. Adhe velaiya successful ah senju mudikka namakku thevai Determination. Indha rendume correct proportion la irundha dhan namma life ah successful ah kondu poga mudiyum. Epdi Motivated ah Determined ah irukuradhu? Therinjuka Kelunga “Motivation Vs Determination” on Kuku FM

jesus-christ-1.title: Jesus Christ
jesus-christ-1.description: యేసు క్రీస్తు దేవుడా? క్రైస్తవ మతం ఎక్కడ పుట్టింది? యేసు ప్రభువు గురించి ఆసక్తిని కలిగించే విషయాలు మీకోసం.

chhota-bussiness-bada-profit.title: Chota Business Bada Profit
chhota-bussiness-bada-profit.description: Apne Chote se Business ko profitable banane ke liye hum humesha se Conventional accounting ka istmal karte aaye hain , Yani ki Sales - Expenses = Profit. Jo ki ek logical formula hai. Lekin yaha problem ye hai  ki chote businesses zyadatar humans dwara hi chalaye jate hain aur hum humans har baar logical nahi hote. Toh aise mein apne chote  business se bada profit nikalne ke liye humein apne andar ek nai tarah ki approach develop karni hogi taki hum har samay sirf is formulae ke hisab se hi na sochte rahen. Aur is approach ko develope karne  ke liye is book summary se accha kuch bhi nahi ho sakta, kyuki ye humein sikhati hai ki kaise hum apne business par attack karne wale in cash eating monsters ka khatma karke apne chote business se bahut bada profit earn kar sakte hain.

how-to-convert-your-time-into-money.title: How to Convert your time into Money ?
how-to-convert-your-time-into-money.description: Nerathai veenadika koodathunu ellarum solluvaanga, aana nerathai ubayoga paduthi panam sambaathikkurathu eppadi nu neraya peru solla maattanga. Intha pathivu la unga time ah panamaa neenga convert panna enna pannalaam nu ungalukku solla muyarchi pannirukom. Intha pathivai kettu neengalum unga nerathai selavu panni panathai sambaadhikka kathukonga. Enna kekka aaramikalaama !

life-tragedy-of-charlie-chaplin.title: The Life And Tragedy Of Charlie Chaplin
life-tragedy-of-charlie-chaplin.description: Charlie Chaplin, the international comedy icon, is still well-remembered for his endearing portrayal of a "tramp" in his comedic works. He immediately comes to mind as the tramp at the mere mention of his name. Charlie Chaplin, one of the most influential figures in early Hollywood's silent era, created comedies that made people laugh and cry. People are really curious about his life and body of work because he is a mystery to the globe. This unique audio series aims to explain the numerous facets of his life and his struggles. Experience the happiness and the despair, the controversies and the acclaim of this legendary performer.

mission-sagarmatha.title: Mission Sagarmatha
mission-sagarmatha.description: Karseva me police ki ho rahi beijjati se pareshan Vanshi ko Sanket ki lash milati hai jo karseva mein maare gaye logon se alag thi. Vanshi is ki tehkikat me lag jata hai aur milne wale surag Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose se jud jaate hain. Kaun hai Sanket ki maut ke peeche? Sanket kyon Netaji ke baare me janna chahata tha? Kya Gumnami baba hi Netaji the? Kyon KGB aur CIA bhi Netaji se judi diary hasil karna chahati hai? Aisi hi kayi saare sawalon ke jawab liye hazir hai KUKU FM ki sansanikhej peshkash, “Mission Sagarmatha”. Suniye “Mission Sagarmatha” aur janiye bharat ke itihas me chipi kayi unsuljhi kahaniyan jo aaj bhi hamare beech jinda hai!

thakare-vs-shivsena.title: Thackeray ani Shiv Sena
thakare-vs-shivsena.description: Pandit Nehru yancha sarkarne 1960 madhe, Bombay shahrache vibhajan kele ani tyatun "Maharashtra" ani "Gujarat" ashi don swatantra Rajya janmala ali. Yaach kalat Maharashtar ''Shivsena'' ha pradeshik paksha kasa udayala ala, Balasaheb Thackeray yani to kasa Motha kela, kasa hota pakshacha ajvarcha pravas, chala janun gheuya Shiv Senecha Itihas. Sobatch tevha pasun te Aaj parynt Shiv-Senet hoat gelelya badlancha ani Rajkiya ghadamodincha adhava gheuya ''Thackeray ani Shiv Sena'' ya aplya khas show madhun...

motivation-vs-determination.title: MOTIVATION vs DETERMINATION
motivation-vs-determination.description: ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ ಸಿಗೋದು ಅಲ್ಲ. ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಠಿಣ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮ ಬೇಕು. ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಗುರಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ದೃಢ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರವನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಸದಾ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ಅತ್ಯಗತ್ಯ! ನೀವು ಕೂಡ ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ಆದರೆ ಈ ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಅಡೆತಡೆಗಳು ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾಯಿತೆ? ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಮುಖ್ಯ? ನಮ್ಮ ಸಂಕಲ್ಪ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಬಲ ಎಂದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಳಿ ಆಲೋಚನೆ ಇದೆಯಾ? ಚಿಂತೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಕೇಳಿ 'ಮೊಟಿವೇಶನ್ ವಿ/ಎಸ್ ಡೀಟರ್ಮಿನೇಶನ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ಇದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತಮ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಗಿಫ್ಟ್! ಹ್ಯಾಪಿ ಲಿಸನಿಂಗ್!

intrinsic.title: How To Become Self-Motivated
intrinsic.description: Kya aapko apni life me "khushi" wala part missing lag raha hai? Kya aapke din ki shuruaat to bahut achhi hoti hai but kuch der baad hi aap fir se negativity ke khyaalon me kho jaate hain? Agar haan to humari audiobook "How To Become Self-Motivated" aapko batayegi ki kaise hum apni life me constantly Khush reh sakte hain chahe baat work, career, relationships ya parenting ki ho ye audiobook aapki life ke har hisse mein khushiya laane ka kaam karegi.

how-to-follow-food-cycle.title: How to follow Food Cycle?
how-to-follow-food-cycle.description: "ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ"ಎಂಬ ಮಾತು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿದೆ, ಅಲ್ವಾ? ನಿಜವೇ, ನಮ್ಮ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ನಮ್ಮ ಇಂದಿನ ಆಹಾರ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ನಾವು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ, ಸರಿಯಾದ ಊಟವನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಶಾರೀರಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಎರಡೂ ಉತ್ತಮವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೀಗಾದರೆ, ಎಷ್ಟು ನೀರು ಕುಡಿಯಬೇಕು? ಯಾವ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ, ಯಾವ ಆಹಾರ ಸೇವಿಸಬೇಕು? ಕಾಯಿಲೆ ಇದ್ದಾಗ ಪರಫೆಕ್ಟ್ ಡಯಟ್ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಸೆಲೆಬ್ರಿಟಿಗಳು ಅಷ್ಟು ಫಿಟ್ ಆಗಿರುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು? ಇವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಉತ್ತರ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಫಾಲೋ ಫುಡ್ ಸೈಕಲ್?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ KukuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

the-energy-bus-2-1.title: Positivity Badhane Ke 10 Secrets
the-energy-bus-2-1.description: Aksar hum life mein aane wali pareshaniyon se deal karte-karte yeh bhul jaate hain ki hamare andar se positivity khatam hoti jaa rahi hai.  Hum duniya se to negativity khatam nahi kar sakte lekin apne nazariye ko badal kar apni reality khud create kar sakte hain kyuki hamari zindagi ki haqeeqat hamari soch se hi to banti hai. To chaliye is Original Show ke zariye khudko positivity se bharne ki koshish karte hain aur seekhte hain ki kaise negativity se bach kar humein life ko khushnuma banana chahiye.

dr-br-ambedkar-3.title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
dr-br-ambedkar-3.description: సామాజిక న్యాయం కోసం డాక్టర్ బి.ఆర్. అంబేద్కర్ గారు చేసిన పోరాటం నుండి నేటి సమాజం నేర్చుకోవాల్సిన పాఠాలు ఏమిటి? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.!

kargil-war-1.title: Kargil Juddho
kargil-war-1.description: Kargil Juddho Itihaser Patay Obisworoniyo Hoye Aache. 1999 Sale Bharat Ebong Pakistan Er Moddhe Ghote Kashmirer Kargil Simante. 'Operation Vijay (1999)' Name Ei Abhijan Shuru Hoy. Dirgho Loraiyer Por Joylav Kore Bharat. Ei Juddho Lorte Giye Pran Jay Bohu Birer. Bharotiyo Militaryder Pashapashi Pran Jay Pakistan Militarydero. Kintu Keno Ghotlo Ei Juddho? Ke Chilen Vikram Batra? Ei Juddhe Ki Bhumika Chilo Tar? Ei Kargil Juddher Nana Jana-Ajana Kahini Shune Nebo Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye.

indian-share-market-for-beginners.title: My Love Affair With The Share Market
indian-share-market-for-beginners.description: Kya aapne kabhi socha hai kuch log badh rahi share market se paisa kmaate hain lekin kuch gir rahi market dekh kar khush hote hain. Aisa kyu hota hai ? Kya hai aakhir share market aur isme paise kamaane ka raaz kya hai ? suniye "My Love Affair With Share Market" jisme aapko asaan bhasha mein share market se jude har swaal ka jawaab milega sirf KukuFM par.

history-of-china-vs-taiwan.title: History Of China vs Taiwan
history-of-china-vs-taiwan.description: China oda varalaru la avanga mela neraiya criticism pala kaalama irundhu vandhurukku. Avangaloda varalaru la oru mukkiya pagudhi ah pathi indha audio book la kekkalam vaanga !

how-to-follow-your-passion.title: How To Follow Your Passion ?
how-to-follow-your-passion.description: Endha vayasu ah serndhavangala irundhalum, ellarukume passion nu solla koodiya namakku romba pidicha vishyam irukum. Aana nenachadha nenacha padi seiyuradhu easy ah? definite ah illa. Unga passion ah  challenges thaandi eppadi approach panni achieve panradhu nu indha audio book la kelunga.

better-than-before.title: Kaise Badlein Apni Buri Aadatein?
better-than-before.description: Hum sabne suna hai Achhi Habits banao, Achhi Habits hume successful banati hai. Lekin jab inhe sach me build karne ki bari aati hai to Jyadatar log fail ho jate hai, iska sabse bada karan hai ki hum khud ko theek se jan nahi pate hai. Starting me hi humari expectation bahut high ho jati hai, lekin jab vaisa result nahi aata hum quit kar jate hai aisa isliye hota hai kyonki, aap kis Type ke insan hai? aapka kya mental status hai? Strength kya hai? ye sab ki jankari hi sahi se nahi hoti. Is Original Audio Series me aap kuch strategies ki Help se asani se Achhi Habits bana payenge aur khud ko samjhne me aapko bahut madad milegi.

how-to-join-indian-armed-forces.title: How to join Indian Armed Forces?
how-to-join-indian-armed-forces.description: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸೇನೆ ಸೇರುವುದೂ, ದೇಶಸೇವೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ಸಿಗುವುದೂ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಭಾರತೀಯನ ಕನಸು...! ಆದರೆ ಈ ಕನಸು ಕೆಲವರಷ್ಟೇ ನನಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಉಳಿದವರಿಗೆ ಕನಸು ಮಾತ್ರ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಸೇನೆಗೆ ಸೇರುವ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಥವಾ ಸೇನೆ ಸೇರುವ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಕ್ಕಮಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅಂತಹವರಿಗಾಗಿ KuKuFM ತಂದಿದೆ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಜಾಯಿನ್ ಇಂಡಿಯನ್ ಆರ್ಮ್ಡ್ ಫೋರ್ಸಸ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸೇನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುವ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಆ ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅಲಂಕರಿಸಲು ಇರುವ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

পরমহংস-দেব-রামকৃষ্ণ.title: পরমহংস দেব: রামকৃষ্ণ
পরমহংস-দেব-রামকৃষ্ণ.description: Taka mati-mati taka, ei chotto duti uktir modhye diye koto kichu uni bujhiye diye gechen ja amader moto ortholobhi manusher pokhye onudhabon kora hoito oto sohoj noi. Mati ebong taka ei duti shpbder byabohare tini hoito amader eta bojhate cheyechen je takar pechone na chhute, nijer matir kodor kora uchit. Ba hoito bojhate cheyechen je takar moto matir o gurutto oporishim, tai shei mohapurusher kothai bolte hoi je joto mot toto poth. Tai aj amra shune nebo Paramhansa Deb Ramkrishna ke niye.

super-thinking-the-big-book-of-mental-mo.title: How to Think Like a Genius
super-thinking-the-big-book-of-mental-mo.description: Hum sabki life mein decision making humesha ek sabse bada task hota hai. Aur humesha better decisions lene ke liye aapko apni professional aur personal life, dono mein consistently correct rehna hoga. Jo ki kisi ke liye bhi aasaan kaam nahi hai. Lekin aisa bhi nahi hai ki hum ye kar nahi sakte , ise karne ke liye bas humein apne mental models ko samjhna hoga. Lekin In Mental Models ko samjha kaise jaaye? Toh abhi suniye KUKU FM ki ye Audiobook kyuki ismein in mental models ko ekdam bareekee se samjhaya gaya hai.

death-served-cold-indias-most-dangerous-.title: Sunday Thriller Stories: Death Served Cold: India’s Most Dangerous Women Murderers

Kintu Ei Bharoter Konay Konay Emonkichu Murder Er Ghotona Ghoteche Ja Janle Aapni Shiure Uthben, Rokto Diye Himel Shrot Vese Jabe. Thik Emon Kichu Sotyo Ghotona Niye Lekha Ei Boi. Aasun Shune Ni Sunday Thriller Stories-Er Ei Audio Show Theke.

indira-gandhi-3.title: INDIRA GANDHI
indira-gandhi-3.description: ಭಾರತ ಕಂಡ ಮಹಾನ್ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ನಾಯಕರಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂದಿರಾ ಗಾಂಧಿ ಅವರ ಹೆಸರು ಅಗ್ರ ಸಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ದೇಶದ ಮೊದಲ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಪ್ರಧಾನಿಯಾಗಿ ಇಂದಿರಾ ಗಾಂಧಿ, ಜಗತ್ತೇ ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿ ನೋಡುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು. ಚೀನಾವನ್ನು ಹಿಮ್ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಸಿ, ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಇಬ್ಬಾಗದ ಬಿಸಿ ಮುಟ್ಟಿಸಿ, ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯರ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಅಷ್ಟು ಧೈರ್ಯ ತೋರಿಸಿದವರು, ಇವರೆಂದರೆ ತಪ್ಪಾಗಲಾರದು. 80ರ ದಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ "ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಇಂದಿರಾ, ಇಂದಿರಾ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ" ಎಂಬುದು ಜಗಜ್ಜಾಹಿರವಾಯಿತು! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಇಂದಿರಾ ಪ್ರಿಯದರ್ಶಿನಿ ಅವರ ಬಾಲ್ಯ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಈ ಮಹಾನಾಯಕಿಯ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಜೀವನ, 1975ರ ಎಮರ್ಜೆನ್ಸಿ ಕಾಲ, ಹಾಗೂ ಆಪರೇಷನ್ ಬ್ಲೂ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಇಂದಿರಾ ಗಾಂಧಿ ಅವರ ಜೀವನದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಇವತ್ತಿಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಳಿ ಇದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಇಂದಿರಾ ಗಾಂಧಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ KukuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

article-370-1.title: Article 370
article-370-1.description: 5 August 2019 ka Din, Aisa Kya Hua Iss Tarikh Mein Ke Yeh Ek History Ka Chapter Ban Gya?  Poore Desh Mein Do Kheme Ban Gye Kuch Favour Mein Toh Kuch Against Mein , Kisi Ne Iska Khulla Virodh Kiya Toh Kahi Iske Samarthan Mein Naarebaazi Hui, Politicians Ne Isse Apne  - Apne Hisab Se Janata Ko Samjhaya Par Article 370 Ko Lekr Asal Sacchai Kya Hai ? Kyu Joda Gya Yeh Article Samvidhan Mein?  Kya Hai Iss Ek Article Se Judi Controversy? Jaanenge Detail Mein Humari Iss Audio Series Mein ,Taki Aap Tak Aaye Poora Sach.

live-like-bill-gates-1.title: Live Like Bill Gates
live-like-bill-gates-1.description: Bill Gates is one of the world's great businessmen, best known for his role in the founding of the ubiquitous computer software company Microsoft. Creating software language was only the beginning of a journey that would eventually see Gates become the world's wealthiest man, eventually turning away from the computer screen to combat injustices and start his own charity. This special audio series reveals the key motivations, decisions, and philosophies that helped Gates become a household name, as well as how he honed his business acumen, faced down all competitors, overcame adversity, and stood strong in the face of overwhelming odds. Learn from Bill Gates how to think big, manage your business, compete with the best, and stay ahead of your competitors through this amazing show only on KukuFM.

redesign-your-life-in-15-days.title: Start Over
redesign-your-life-in-15-days.description: Sahi guidance ke kami se youth mein confidence ki kami paayi jaati hai aur wo hamesha ek confused state mein jeete hai. Aise mein sahi faisle nahi liye jaate. Ye book summary yuvao mein aatmavishwas bharti hai aur unhe unki shaktiyon aur capacities se parichit karvati hai, taaki ve jeevan mein aage badhne ke liye sahi disha mein prayas kar sake.

puratchiyalar-che-guevara.title: Puratchiyalar Che Guevara
puratchiyalar-che-guevara.description: Thaan Pirantha nattirkaga matumindri , Pira nadugalukugavum Poradiya dhesa ellaigal kadantha Maaperum Puratchiyalar Ivar. autobiography-of-a-stock.description: Stock market ha shabda aikala ki aplyala bhiti vatte ani stock market nako re baba kiti risk asa aplya manat vichar yeto. oil-power-war.title: Oil, Power and War
oil-power-war.description: Yeh kahani ek aise vastu ki hai, jiski khoj apne aap mein itihaas hai. Lekin iss aetihasik vastu ki khoj mein na jaane kitni politics huyi thi. Yeh ek aisi vastu hai jiske naam par aaj bhi duniya mein logon ko exploit kiya ja raha hai. Yeh vastu Oil hai jiski khoj ne yun to duniya ko aadhunik banaya, lekin iski khoj ne hi logon ko dominate karna bhi sikha diya. Humari iss audiobook mein oil ke naam par huyi politics, culture change, duniya mein chhide World War I aur World War II jaise bade-bade wars, in sabhi ka zikra hai.

you-are-your-own-gym-2.title: Bana svatachech fitness coach
you-are-your-own-gym-2.description: Mitraho aajchya tanavachya jagat aplya shariracha arogya japna khup garjecha ahe. Apala sharir jarka healthy asel tar apan changle asu apli manasthiti hi changli rahte ani apla atmavishvashi vadhtoh. Pan fitness mhanje kahi 6 pack abs kinva bipses nastat, Fitness mhanje aplya sharirachi core strength changli ashna, apli antarik urja ani rog pratikarak shakti changli ashna hoy ani ti changli karnyasathi apanach apla fitness coach jhala pahije. so aikuya yach sambandhit khas show Bana svatachech fitness coach.

காதலின்-புரியாத-பிரிவு.title: காதலின் புரியாத பிரிவு
காதலின்-புரியாத-பிரிவு.description: தாரணியை உயிருக்கு உயிராகக் காதலிக்கிறான் ஆகாஷ். தன் காதலன் மீது சந்தேகமும் கோபமும் கொண்ட தாரணி, அவனை விட்டுப் பிரிகிறாள். அதுவரை உயிருக்கு உயிராக வாழ்ந்தவர்கள் இரு துருவங்களாக வாழத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள். அவர்களுக்கு இடையே வருகிறாள் ஆதிரா. அதற்குப் பிறகு என்ன ஆனது? காதலர்கள் இருவரும் சேர்ந்தார்களா?

have-a-little-faith.description: Hum sabhi ki life mein kabhi na kabhi ek aisa waqt aaya hai jab humne koi galat kaam kiya ho aur upar wale se prathna ki ho ki bas is baar bacha lo, dobara jeevan mein kabhi yeh galti karunga. Kai logo ka to yeh roz  ka kissa hota hai. Bhagwan hume baar baar maaf kar dete hai, par  hum sudharte nahi. Aisi hi kahani hai yeh audiobook ki jo do sawalon se shuru hoti hai. how-to-multiply-your-savings.title: How to Multiply your Savings?
how-to-multiply-your-savings.description: ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ನಡೆಸಬೇಕು, ಬೇಕಾದ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು, ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೂ ಮೊಮ್ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೂ ಬೇಕಾದಷ್ಟು ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು... ಇದಕ್ಕಾಗಿದ್ದು ಹಣವೇ! ಆದರೆ ಇರುತ್ತಿರುವ ಆದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಖರ್ಚು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಕಾಸು ಉಳಿಸುವುದೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿದೆ ಅನ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆಯಾ? ಟೆನ್ಷನ್ ಬೇಡ! ಆ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಕಾಸನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೇಗೆ ಬಳಸಿದರೆ 'ಆರ್ಕಾಸಾಗುತ್ತೆ' ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಡಬಲ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ನಾವು ಹೇಳುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಕೇಳಿ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಮಲ್ಟಿಪ್ಲೈ ಯೋರ್ ಸೇವಿಂಗ್ಸ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

ys-jagan-mohan-reddy.title: YS. Jagan Mohan Reddy
ys-jagan-mohan-reddy.description: YSR congress party Founder, Present Andhra Pradesh state ki Chief Minister Yeduguri Sandinti Jagan Mohan Reddy Balyam nundi ,kutumba nepadyam, chaduvu, Political Entry, Abhiyogalu, Abhinandalanu, padayatra ila prasthutam  mukhyamantri padavi gelichina varaku YS jagan jeevithamlo jarigina pramukha sanghatanala gurinchi ee audio book lo vivarinchadam jarigindi

story-of-sundarbans.title: Story Of Sundarbans
story-of-sundarbans.description: Ek aise jagah jaha Nadi sirf har din 6 ghanto ke liye dikhai deti hai aur phir agle 6 ghanto ke liye gayab ho jaati hai. Jahan Chandramma din ke 4 bje se he dikhai padne lagta hai. Sundarbans, jiske baare me sabne suna toh hoga aur socha bhi hoga ki kitni khoobsurat jageh hai par kya aap iss sundarban ke khaufnaak aur daraavne sach ko jaante hain? Aakhir kyu yaha ke log har din apni kismat ke bharose jite hain. Aakhir kyu Jangal ke bahari log yaha aane ki koshish to karte hain par Waapas nahi Jaa paate. Kya hai is Sundarban ki kahani jaanenge hum iss Orginal Audio show "Story Of Sundarbans" me.

1992-indian-stock-market-scam.title: 1992 Indian Stock Market Scam
1992-indian-stock-market-scam.description: India la nadantha miga periya stock market oozhal ithu thaan nu solranga ! Ithula sambathapatta motha Panam Approximate taa 5000 crores. 1982 la Mumbai la irukkura Dalal street la oru middle class kudumbathai serntha sathaarana nabaraa kaaladi eduthu vaikkira Harshad Mehta, 10 varushathula athaavathu 1992 la Ambani ya vida athigama income tax kattura oru nabaraa maaruraaru ! Eppadi avar stock market la Kodi kanakkula Panam sambaathichaaru ?, Avaru senja oozhal enna ? Atha avaru eppadi senjaru ? Harshad Mehta vin Valarchiyum Veelchiyum, 1992 la avar senja  oozhal pathiyum vaanga therinjukalam !

creation-of-bangladesh.title: Creation of Bangladesh
creation-of-bangladesh.description: 26 March 1971 ko elaan kiya gaya tha ki, bangladesh ab ek swatantra desh hai. Par kya unhe swatantra mili ? Agar haan to kaise ? Swatantrata milne se pehle kya hua tha ? Aakhir Bangladesh banne ki kya wo wajah thi ? Wo kaun tha jisne Bangladesh ki neev rakhi ? Yeh jaan ne ke liye suniye creation of Bangladesh ki yeh kahani !

jamtara-jaliyatder-theke-sabdhan.title: Jamtara : Jaliyatder Theke Sabdhan

how-to-handle-the-stress-and-pressure.title: How To Handle The Stress And Pressure?
how-to-handle-the-stress-and-pressure.description: సైకోసొమాటిక్ సమస్యలు అంటే ఏమిటి? మానసిక ఒత్తిడి ఎక్కువైతే వచ్చే సమస్యలేంటి? ఒత్తిడికి లోనవకుండా ఎలాంటి జాగ్రత్తలు తీసుకోవాలి? వెంటనే విని తెలుసుకోండి.

the-code-of-the-extraordinary-mind-4.description: Zindagi men hum sabhi successful hona chahte hain aur har haal mein hona hi chahate hain. gender-neutral-parenting.title: Gender Neutral Parenting
gender-neutral-parenting.description: Lingaparamaaya stereotypukalkku atheethamaya gender neutral parenting enna vishayam Indiayil ippozhanu ithra sajeevamayi charcha cheyyunnath.  Enthanu ee gender nautral parentinginte sheriyaya meaning? Kooduthal ariyam ee showiloode.

dr-anandi-gopal-joshi.description: He goshta ahe eka samanya gharat janma la alelya eka asamanya mulichi. Jichya mahattwakankshechya garud jhepene tatkalin strichya samaaj jeevnaat amulagra badal ghadawun anala...Junaat rudhi paramparawaadi marathmolya samanya gharapasun te Americatlya eka mothya vidyalayat jaun Doctor chi padawi gheun Bharatat ek mahila Doctor banun mothya sanmanane paratane...ha sagla khadtar pravas kasa hota he ya show madhun apan aiknar ahat.

वियतनाम-युद्ध.title: The Vietnam War

Is ankahe aitihasik yudh mein ek taraf tha South Vietnam aur North Vietnam ke bich chalne wala yudh, to dusri taraf tha America aur North Vietnam ke bich ka yudh. Jisne kul milakar 31 lakh logon ko maut ke ghat utara tha. Lekin is yudh ki wajah kya thi? Aur aakhir is yudh ke itne lambe chalne ki wajah kya thi? Jante hai humare is audiobook mein.

freedom-251.description: India me smartphone aur internet ki kranti 2016 me saste internet ki wajeh se aayi. tab ek aisi company bhi popular hui jisne sabko promise kiya tha ke "Hum duniya ka sabse sasta smart phone launch karenge jo ₹251 ka hoga , jis se india me harr hath me ek smartphone hoga" par jaise hum sab jante hai ke wo ek ponzi scheme thi , chaliye jante hai kaise hua itna bada scam jisne india ki janta,technology industry aur communication department ko shock me daal diya"

shivaji-maharaj-2.title: Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj
shivaji-maharaj-2.description: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj was a great warrior and skilled administrator who founded the great Maratha Empire and instilled a sense of Maratha identity in his people. At a time when the Mughal Empire was at its peak, Shivaji was the only one who dared to challenge Emperor Aurangzeb's might. With the help of a disciplined military system, a well-structured administrative organization, and a deeply traditional society, the Maratha force quickly became India's only military force of consequence against the Mughals. This special presentation is an enlightening and insightful look at a warrior king whose tales of victory and valor have inspired the nation for centuries. This series tells the incredible story of this self-made military hero, who began as a teenage rebel with great foresight and daring and ended up crowning himself king of an independent Maratha state after altering the political map of his native Deccan. Listen to the extraordinary life story of arguably the greatest Maratha who ever lived.

gorkha-regiment-1.title: Gorkha Regiment
gorkha-regiment-1.description: Their fury and loyalty are legendary, and their regimental histories are filled with heroic deeds and selfless sacrifices. The Gorkhas have a distinct reputation for being fierce warriors, and the mere threat of one of their kukri knives has made enemies around the world cower in fear. The Gorkhas have been fighting on the frontlines for over 300 years, and these small but incredibly tough fighters have proven their bravery in battles ranging from the Indian Mutiny to Afghanistan to Kosovo. The Gorkha soldiers have been forged by the fires of history to become what they are today. This special series portrays the rich history and culture of Gorkhas in all its vibrancy while also glancing at the struggles this gallant community faces. Listen to the astounding story of one of the world's most ferocious, competent, and efficient military units.

bs-developing-the-leaders.title: Finding New Leaders in Your Company
bs-developing-the-leaders.description: Agar aap kisi bhi organization ke leader hain toh ek leader hone ke sath sath aapki ye bhi responsibility honi chahiye ki mujhe jitne ho sake utne aur bhi potential leaders ko taiyaar karna hai. Taki aapke organization mein, jarurat padne par achanak kisi nay leader ki talash na karni pade aur lagatar growth hoti rahe. Lekin humein in leaders ko taiyaar karna kaise hoga? Toh Iske liye ye book summary ek perfect guide hai. Jo ki humein apne aas-pas ke aur leaders ko develope karne ke liye proper planning karna , sahi samay par sahi decisions lena aur strategies banana sikhati hai. Agar aapko "Start With Why: How Great Leaders Inspire Everyone" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

வெற்றி-வாகை.description: எழுத்தாளனாக வேண்டும் என்ற கனவுக்காக, கை நிறைய சம்பளம் வாங்கும் ஐடி கம்பெனி வேலையை உதறுகிறான் அருண். தன் குடும்பத்தாரின் எதிர்ப்பையும் மீறி அவன் தன் கனவுக்காக உலகம் முழுவதும் சுற்றுகிறான். எழுத்தாளனாக வேண்டும் என்ற அவனது கனவு நிறைவேறியதா? அவன் சாதித்தானா?

the-blue-ocean-strategy.description: Tumcha kade ekhadi "Business Idea" ahe ka? Jar Ho, tar ti idea Market madhe successful tharu shakte, Market madhil competition madhe tag dharun rahu shakte ase tumhala watte ka? Tumcha business idea la eka Successful Buiness madhe convert karnyachi tumchi iccha ahe ka? tar mag ha show nakki aika ani tumchi Buisness idea yogya ahe ka, ti successful kashi banwta yeil, Yashasvi businessman bannyachi sutra koni he sara kahi janun ghya..

the-story-of-titanic.title: The Story of Titanic
the-story-of-titanic.description: Toh aakhir kya hua tha us raat jisne duniya ke sabse bade sea accident ko anjaam diya tha? history-of-india-in-fifa-1.title: History of India in FIFA
history-of-india-in-fifa-1.description: ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರೀಡೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಜನರು ಹೆಸರಿಸೋದು ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಮಾತ್ರ.! ಆದರೆ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಬಿಟ್ಟರೆ, ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಲವಾರು ಕ್ರೀಡೆಗಳಿವೆ, ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಿದವರಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅಂತಹ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರೀಡೆ ಎಂದರೆ 'ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್'. ಇವತ್ತು ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಹೂಡಾಟ ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಕಿಚ್ಚಿನಂತೆಯೇ ಹಬ್ಬಿದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಭಾರತ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅರ್ಹತಾ ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಾಗಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ! ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು? ಇಂಡಿಯನ್ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ತಂಡದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಹೇಗಿದೆ? ನಮ್ಮ ಜೆರ್ಸಿಯ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಥೆಯೇನು? ಇದರ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹಿಸ್ಟರಿ ಆಫ್ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಇನ್ ಫೀಫಾ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ KukuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.

legendary-advice-2.title: 101 Tips Borolok Howar
legendary-advice-2.description: Jibone cholar pothe shob kichur jonno takar proyojon. Taka diye shob kena na geleo shob kinte gelei taka lage. Manush ke jonmanor jonno taka lage. Takar opor nirbhor korei manusher byabohareo poriborton chole ashe. Safolyo ke taka diyei mapa hoi. Safolyer jonno taka ki bhabe kamaben shune nin ei sarangsho theke.

outsiders.title: Corporate Rules Ko Todkar Safal Hue CEOs
outsiders.description: Aapke hisab se degree zyada matter karti hai ya experience ? Actually humare society mein ek bahut hi bada myth hai ki jis field ki aap padhai karte ho, aapko sirf usi mein kaam karke success milegi. Lekin agar aisa hota to shayad Dhirubhai Ambani Reliance ko itna successful nahi bana paate. Kyuki na unke paas MBA ki degree thi na koi business background. Inke jaise kai aur logo ne yeh prove kiya jiske baare mein hum iss audiobook mein charcha karenge aur janenge ki aakhir wo konsi quality hai jo bina degree, bina experience ke insaan ko successful banati hai

how-to-earn-by-making-memes-2.title: How to Earn by Making Memes
how-to-earn-by-making-memes-2.description: ಮೀಮ್ಸ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯಾರಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ ಹೇಳಿ? ಇವತ್ತಿನ ಸೋಶಿಯಲ್ ಮೀಡಿಯಾ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀಮ್ಸ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಮನರಂಜನೆಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲ ಎಂಬಂತಾಗಿದೆ! ಆದರೆ, ಮೀಮ್ಸ್ ಮನರಂಜನೆಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸೀಮಿತವೇ? ಖಂಡಿತವಾಗಿಯೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಮೀಮ್ಸ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಣವೂ ಗಳಿಸಬಹುದು! ಮೀಮ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಇವತ್ತಿಗೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳಿವೆ. ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಜನ ನೌಕರರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹೀಗಾದರೆ, ಮೀಮ್ಸ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಣ ಗಳಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಇರುವ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳು ಯಾವವು? ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯನು ಮೀಮ್ಸ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹಣ ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳ ಉತ್ತರಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಅರ್ನ್ ಬೈ ಮೇಕಿಂಗ್ ಮೀಮ್ಸ್' ಎಂಬ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ KuKuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.

मेरिलिन-मुनरो-.title: Marilyn Monroe - The Blonde Bombshell
मेरिलिन-मुनरो-.description: Marilyn Monroe - Ek American actress, singer aur model. Inkha khitaab 'blonde bombshell' inhe kai dumb-blonde aur sexy characters nibhaane par mila. America ki sabse mashoor sex symbols, 1950s aur 1960s ke dashak mein as an actress and photoshoot model, inka boht bolbaala tha. Ek aam parivaar mein Norma naam se janm lekar kaise yeh khubsoorat ladki voh phenomena bani jise aaj puri duniya 'Marilyn' ke naam se jaanti hai. Chaliye sunte hai inki legendary but tragic story.

how-to-invest-wealth-in-a-useful-way.description: ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ದುಡಿದು ಹಣ ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದರೆ ದುಡಿಯುವ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತರಾಗೋದು ಸಾಧ್ಯವೇ? ಖಂಡಿತವಾಗಿಯೂ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯ. ನಾವು ಗಳಿಸುವ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಸರಿಯಾದ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅದು ನಮ್ಮಗಾಗಿ ದುಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ! ಇದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಬೇಕೆ? ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಇನ್ವೆಸ್ಟ್ ವೆಲ್ತ್ ಇನ್ ಎ ಯೂಸ್ಫುಲ್ ವೇ?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಅನ್ನು, ನಿಮ್ಮ KukuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ. ಹ್ಯಾಪಿ ಇನ್ವೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್!

fathers-pregnancy-guide.description: Kehte hai ki dharti par maa bhagwan ka roop hoti hai, jo ek jeevan ko janam deti hai. Par iss jeevan ke liye pita ka role bhi utna hi important hota hai. the-story-of-best-bus.title: Mumbaichi BEST Bus
the-story-of-best-bus.description: Mumbaichi jeev ki pran mhanje BST Bus jyachyashivay mumbaikarancha pan suddha halat nahi.1926 roji pahili  bus mumbaichya rastyavar dhavli. pahile ya sevecha nav "Bombay Electric Supply & Transport (BEST)" asa hota ani 1995 la te badlun "Brihanmumbai Electric Supply & Transport (BEST)" asa thevnyat ala. kal lotun gela mumbai sobat mumbaichi bus dekhil pragat hot geli. chala janun gheuya aplya ladkya buscha pravas  fakta kukufm var.

ambedkars-india.title: Ambedkar’s India
ambedkars-india.description: Bharat Ke Samvidhan Ki Reedh Ki Haddi Kahe Jane Wale Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar Ne Na Sirf Humein Hamara Constitution Diya Balki India Ko Ek Behtar Civilized Society Banne Ke Liye Buniyadi Cheezein Bhi Sikhai. kanye-west.description: Ye, jinhe commonly Kanye West, is naam se jaana jaata hai ek American rapper, record producer, entrepreneur, aur world renowned fashion designer hai. how-to-come-out-of-depression-2.title: How to Come Out of Depression?

Bharoter Namkora Shohorgulote Kono Ek Oggato Karone Grihohin Manushguloke Matha Thetle Khun Kora Hocchilo. Aar Protita Khuner Style Eki. Pathor Diye Matha Thetle Deyoya Hocchilo. how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.title: How To Make Money With Breakout Trading
how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.description: People who dabble in trading markets understand that it is not a money-making machine and that investing blindly with insufficient knowledge can be risky. "How to Make Money with Breakout Trading" is a practical book for beginners who want to start trading, but it can also be useful for people who already have market knowledge and experience. The central idea of this book is the concept of breakout trading. Author Indrazith Shantharaj presents the nitty-gritty of the trading system very efficiently and in a detailed manner while discussing the proper strategies for entry and exit with risk management factors. Whether you are a newbie in this game, an average Joe working 9 to 5, or a seasoned trader, this book will help you understand the fundamentals, the concept of a breakout, and how to proceed according to plan.

the-second-world-war-2.title: The Second World War

Veruppinte prathyaya shashthrangalk veroonnunnathinum mooladhana thalparyangalkkumayi laksha kanakkinu manushya jeevan kuruthi kodukkendi vanna charithrathile ee mahasambhavam nammal arinjirikkanam. Innu nam nilkkunna pathayil ethan lokam ozhukkiya chorayude kadha, Randam Loka Mahayudhathe ariyam ee audio bookilude.

mental-toughness-a-hand-book-by-damon-za.title: Mental Toughness Badhane Ke Asaan Tareeke

ಕಾವೇರಿ-ವಿವಾದ.title: Kaveri Vivada
ಕಾವೇರಿ-ವಿವಾದ.description: ಕನ್ನಡನಾಡಿನ ಜೀವನದಿ ಕಾವೇರಿ.! ಪರಮ‌ ಪಾವನೆಯಾಗಿ ಸಪ್ತನದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿರೋ ಕಾವೇರಿಗೆ ಪುರಾಣ ಕಾಲದಿಂದ್ಲೂ ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನವಿದೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ತನ್ನ  ಸೊಬಗಿಗೆ, ಭುವಿಯನ್ನ ತಂಪಾಗಿಟ್ಟು ಫಲವತ್ತಾದ ವ್ಯವಸಾಯ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನ ನೀಡಿರೋದಕ್ಕೆ, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾ ದಿವ್ಯಜ್ಯೋತಿಯಾಗಿರೋ ಕಾವೇರಿ ಇಂಥ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯಗಳಿಂದ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿಯಾಗಬೇಕಿತ್ತು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅಂತರ್ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಜಲವಿವಾದ ಕಿಡಿಯಿಂದಾಗಿ ಈ ಪುಣ್ಯನದಿ, ಧಗಧಗಿಸುವಂತಾಗಿದೆ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಲ್ಲುವ ಕಾವೇರಿಯ ಸುತ್ತ ಯಾಕಿಂಥ ವಿವಾದ.? ಈ ಸಂಘರ್ಷದ ವಿವರದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಕಾವೇರಿಯ ಮಹತ್ವ ಸಾರುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ‌ ನಮ್ಮದು‌. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಕಾವೇರಿ ವಿವಾದ' ಕನ್ನಡ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.! ನಿಮ್ಮ 'ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ'ನಲ್ಲಿ.!

gst-explained.title: GST Explained
