simple-techniques-for-glowing-skin-and-l.description: Iss digital world mein har koi apne photos upload karne ke liye  Sundar aur jawan dikhna chahta hai. Par iss pollution aur market mein moujood chemical products ke istmaal se hum kahin na kahin waqt se pehle he anti- aging ke shikar hote ja rahe hain. Lekin ab aapko fikar karne ki koi jarurat nahi hai iss Original show me hum aapke liye wo sare gharelu tips and techniques lekar aaye hain jo aapke chehre ko bedaag, Sundar aur jawan banane me madad karega aur aap humesha khubsurat aur Confident dikhenge.

how-to-stop-worrying-and-start-living-6.title: How to Stop Worrying and Start Living
how-to-stop-worrying-and-start-living-6.description: Ulkanda ennathu ningalude jeevithathinte thanne thaalam thettikkuka anenkil ningal theerchayayum Dale Carnegie ude 'How to Stop Worrying and Start Living: Time-Tested Methods for Conquering Worry' enna pusthakam arinjirikkanam. Ulkanda, sammardham ennivayokke jeevithathil ninnu thudachu neekkan ee audio summary ningale sahayikkum.

how-to-come-out-of-depression-1.title: How To Come Out Of Depression?
how-to-come-out-of-depression-1.description: Depression allenkil vishada rogam ennathu pothuvayi charcha cheyappedunna vishayamayi maari kazhinju. Ennal sherikkum enthanu depression? Kurachu neramo allenkil kurachu divasangalayo ningal anubhavikkunna vishamam allenkil aswasthatha depression ano? Nammal manassilakki vachirikkunnathu ano satyathil depression enna avasthayude lakshanangal? Etharam ella chodyangalkkum ningalkku utharam lebhikkum 'How to come out of depression?' enna showilude

iran-vs-iraq.title: Iran Vs Iraq
iran-vs-iraq.description: Middle East aur Jung - Yeh kahaani boht puraani hai, magar iske ghaav aaj bhi unki awaam ke beech taza hai. Saddam aur Khomeini, do aise supreme leaders jo jann kranti se Iran aur Iraq ka chehra bane. Magar kyun lalach, taaqat aur siyaasat ke is bhadde se khel ne pure Irani-Iraqi belt ko war crisis mein daal diya. Oil corporations aur world politics ne kaise isme apna faayda uthaaya, Kuwait ke saath dhoka, America ka khela har daav aur ek tanashah ka anth. Sab samjhenge is audiobook 'Iran vs Iraq' mein.

the-lucifer-effect.title: Bhalo O Kharaper Ashol Rohoshyo
the-lucifer-effect.description: Bhalo ar kharap niye prithibi nijer gothon boichitro ke dhore rekheche. Tob ei bhalo o kharaper songa ti amader kache porishkar bhabe dhora dite pare ni. Tobuo ki sotti r sathe porichiti labh korte pari ki? Pari na. Nijer bichar dharar poribortoner modhye diyei bhalo o kharaper songa ke bodle dite parbo. Shune nin aj ker ei boi tir sarangsho.

rishi-sunak-uk-pm-from-indian-origin-2.title: Rishi Sunak- UK PM from Indian Origin
rishi-sunak-uk-pm-from-indian-origin-2.description: ಸದ್ಯ ಜಗತ್ತಿನಾದ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರತಿಧ್ವನಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಹೆಸರು ಋಷಿ ಸುನಾಕ್! ಇವರು ಬ್ರಿಟನ್ ಪ್ರಧಾನಿಯಾಗಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಾಗಿರುವುದು ವಿಶ್ವದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ದೇಶಗಳಿಗಿಂತಲೂ ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದೇಕೆ? ಋಷಿ ಸುನಾಕು ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ಇರುವ ನಂಟು ಏನು?ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಈ ಋಷಿ ಸುನಾಕ್ ಯಾರು? ಬ್ರಿಟನ್ ಪ್ರಧಾನಿಯಾಗಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಾದ ಈ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ‘ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಅಳಿಯ’ ಆಗಿದ್ದಾರೇ? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'ಋಷಿ ಸುನಾಕ್ - ಭಾರತೀಯ ಮೂಲದ ಬ್ರಿಟನ್ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೂಕುFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲೇ!

sex-education.title: A Guide To Sex Education
sex-education.description: Kaafi lambe samay se sex ke baare mein baat karna taboo maana gaya hai, kai schools mein toh teachers reproduction ka chapter hi miss kar dete aur youth aadhe adhure knowledge ke saath zindagi ke race mein lag jaate hai. Adhura knowledge sabze zyada ghatak hota hai. Ye audiobook aapko sex education ke basics samjhaegi

ramayana-vishavruksham.title: Ramayana Vishavruksham
ramayana-vishavruksham.description: Ee Book Telugu Sahithi Prapanchamlo Andariki Parichayame. Ranganayakamma Ramayana Maha Grandanni Visha Vrukshamga Prasthavisthu Tana Alochanalanu jodinchina Vidhanam Enno Vimarshakulaku Daari teesindi. Anthe kakaunda Ee book loni 3rd Part lo Ranganayakamma Oka Enimidi mandi Critics ni , vaaru ramayanam meeda chesina CComments ni Udaharisthu tana Abhiprayalanu Vellabucharu. Narla Venkateshwara rao Daggara nundi Periyar Varaku Aavida palu Vimarshakula Rachanalani Ee 3rd part lo mention chesaru.

mary-kom.title: Mary Kom
mary-kom.description: Namma naatukke boxing moolama perumai thedi thantha Mary Kom oda varalaaru thaan ithu. Ivanga thannoda vaalkaila evvalavu thadaigalaiyum, tholvigalaiyum thaandi intha nilaikku vanthaanganu therinjukitta ungalaukku athu bayagara inspiring aah irukkum. Vaanga intha singapenn ah pathi therinjukalam.

homi-jahagir-bhabha.title: Homi Jahagir Bhabha
homi-jahagir-bhabha.description: Homi Jahangir Bhabha - Indian nuclear physicist, founding director aur Tata Institute of Fundamental Research mein Physics ke professor. Inhe India ko nuclear science ki race mein laane ka shrey diya jaata hai. Cambridge se apni padhai kar, India ke nuclear program ka chehra bankar inhone UN conference mein pehli baar peaceful uses of atomic energy par apna view rakha. Indian nuclear program inhi ki den hai. Bharat ko nuclear science ki den aur world map par laakar inki legacy amar hai. Chaliye inka adbhoot jeevan au tragic end se khudko educate kare.

how-to-do-budget-travelling-1.title: How to do Budget Travelling
how-to-do-budget-travelling-1.description: 96 padathula varra Vijay Sethupathi maathiri namma ellarukume travel pannanumnu aasai irukkum, but budget thaan namma travel panrathukku thadaiyaa irukkum. Intha pathivu moolama ungalukku pidicha tourist spots ku budget la eppadi travel pannalaamnu kekka poreenga. Enna makkale budget potralaamaa ???

azhagu-muthu-kone.title: Azhagu Muthu Kone
azhagu-muthu-kone.description: Makkalukkaga Por senju uyir neetha oru maaveeranoda varalaarai thaan kekka poreenga. Ivaroda ennangalum, seyalbaadum ethirigalai mirala vachathunu kooda sollalaam. Azhagu Muthu Kone avargaloda veera varalaarai unga sevigalukku samarpikkirathu KUKU FM.

bs-seven-mindsets-for-success.title: Successful Hone ke 7 Rules
bs-seven-mindsets-for-success.description: Humare Thoughts aur feelings agar humare attitude ko hard bana dein ya badal dein, aur vo bhi kafi lambe samay ke liye toh humare andar ek secondary mindset, yaani ki wrong mindset develope ho jata hai. Ye mindset humein ek alag raste par chalne ko kehta hai , lekin  hum use ignore karke apne andar 7 aeyse mindsets develope kar sakte hai jo humein success ke raste par lekar jayenge taki hum ek extraordinary life jee sake. Aur ye kaise hoga? janne ke liye aapko ye audiobook sunni hogi.

inspiring-ias-stories.title: Inspiring IAS Stories
inspiring-ias-stories.description: Oro varshavum lakshakanakinu IAS aspirantsanu civil service exams ezhuthunnath. IAS aakuka ennath maathramanu avarude manassilulla eka swapnam. Angane swapnam kaanunavarkkayi itha oru special show - Keralathilninulla 5 IAS officersinte inspiring success stories.

match-fixing.title: Cricket Match Fixing in India
match-fixing.description: Early 1880s se Lekar Aaj tak Cricket ne Jis tarah se Public ko deewana karke rakkha hai, vo koi aur sport nahi kar paya hai. Aur iska ek karan Cricket  mein hone wali Match fixing bhi raha hai. Match Fixing ka silsila shuru hua tha saal 2000 mein aur Uske bad IPL jisne Spot-Fixing ko janam diya. Toh Kaise hue Cricket Matchfixing ke itne bade khulase? kaise hoti hai Cricket Match fixing aur kya hai ispar fullstop lagane ka tarika? Janne ke liye Suniye ye audio show.

how-to-fight-infertility-1.title: How to Fight Infertility
how-to-fight-infertility-1.description: Marriage chesukunna prathi couple ki Parents Avvalani anukuntaru. Kanee edaina Reason valana Santhanam Kalaganappudu varilo manasika andolana jarugutundi. Parents kaleka potunnamane badha varini ventadutundi. Ee Audio book lo Santhana Lemi ni ela Edurkovali, inka family members vaaripatla ela behave cheyali ane vishayalanu prasthavinchadam jarugutundi.

arundhati-bhattacharya.title: Arundhati Bhattacharya
arundhati-bhattacharya.description: Hailing from a humble background, Arundhati Bhattacharya never dreamed she would one day become the chair[person of India's largest bank. A woman banker with a family in a frequently transferable job does not have an easy life. There were times in Arundhati's life when she considered quitting her job but did not give up. Instead, she approached her challenges with humor and optimism, viewing each assignment as a new chapter in learning and adapting. This audiobook tells the story of Arundhati's life as a banker and the challenges she faced in a male-dominated environment, beginning with her childhood and early education, progressing to Kolkata for her college education, and finally to the State Bank of India, where she began her career. Listen to the life story of an 'indomitable' woman that will inspire you to embrace challenges, break down barriers, push forward, and reach new heights.

unsung-warrior-sehmat-khan.title: Unsung Warrior Sehmat Khan
unsung-warrior-sehmat-khan.description: Saal 1971 mein jab India aur Pakistan ke bich tanav chal raha tha, usi waqt ek college jane wali ladki Sehmat ne apne desh aur apne pita ki aakhri icha ke liye apne sapno aur apne prem ki kurbani de kar apna jeevan desh ke naam kar diya. Kaun thi wo ladki ? Aur kaha se us mein itni himmat aayi ki pure desh ke liye wo akeli lad gayi aur itihas ko badal kar rakh diya ? Jane iss audiobook mein

how-to-make-your-baby-sleep-1.title: How To Make Your Baby Sleep
how-to-make-your-baby-sleep-1.description: Every parent on this planet has at least one thing in common: "How do I get my child to sleep?" Almost every single parent has spent countless sleepless nights trying to figure out the solution to this problem. So, why do most sleep methods fail? According to experts, the key is addressing both the parent's and the child's emotional needs. This special audiobook is the ultimate bedside companion for parents, filled with tips and tricks to build a stronger connection with your children. This audiobook offers a revolutionary approach to achieving longer naps and better night sleep with fewer wakings while empowering parents to tune into their instincts and understand a child's cues so that bedtime battles, cranky days, and sleepless nights are a thing of the past.

mudhal-pagal-corrected.title: முதல் பகல்
mudhal-pagal-corrected.description: ஆறு வயதில் தன் கண் பார்வையை எதிர்பாராமல் இழந்துவிடுகிறாள், பூர்ணிமா. இருட்டாகிப் போயிருந்த அவளது வாழ்க்கையில் நுழையும் மாமா பையன் ராகுலால் அவள் மீண்டும் சிரிக்கத் தொடங்குகிறாள். ஆனால், மீண்டும் அவளது விதி அவளைப் பிரச்னையில் சிக்க வைக்கிறது. அதிலிருந்து அவள் எப்படி மீண்டு மீண்டும் தன் பார்வையைத் திரும்பப் பெற்றாள்?

the-lifestyle-investor.title: Investment - Ek Lifestyle
the-lifestyle-investor.description: Kya aap bhi investment ki aadhi adhuri jaankari hone ki wajah se invest karne se katraate hai? Ye book summary aapke liye guide hai jo na sirf aapko stock market samjhayegi balki investment ko apne lifestyle mein add karke cashflow or returns kaise badhaye ye batayegi. Aaj hi sune!

ಕಾಲಜ್ಞಾನಿ-ವೀರಬ್ರಹ್ಮೇಂದ್ರ-ಸ್ವಾಮಿ.title: Kaalagnani Veerabrahmendra Swami
ಕಾಲಜ್ಞಾನಿ-ವೀರಬ್ರಹ್ಮೇಂದ್ರ-ಸ್ವಾಮಿ.description: ನೂರಾರು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಇವ್ರು ಬರೆದಿಟ್ಟ ಅದೆಷ್ಟೋ ಮಾತುಗಳು ನಿಜವಾಗಿವೆ, ಇಂದಿಗೂ ನಿಜವಾಗುತ್ತಲಿವೆ..! ಇಂದಿನ ಜೀವನ ಅಂದೇ ಬರೆದಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರು ಈ ಕಾಲಜ್ಞಾನಿ..! ಜಗತ್ತಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದೇನಾಗಬಹುದು? ಏನೇನು ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಸಂಭವಿಸುತ್ತೆ ಎಂಬ ಕಾಲಜ್ಞಾನದ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನು ತಾಳೆಗರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದಿಟ್ಟ ಜ್ಞಾನಿಯೇ ವೀರಬ್ರಹ್ಮೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಾಮಿಗಳು...ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಾಲಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಾದ ವೀರಬ್ರಹ್ಮೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಾಮಿಗಳ ಜೀವನ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಇವರಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂತಹ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾದ್ರೂ ಹೇಗೆ? ಇವ್ರು ಬರೆದಿಟ್ಟ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳು ಯಾವುವು?  ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಬೇಕಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಕಾಲಜ್ಞಾನಿ ವೀರಬ್ರಹ್ಮೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್...

spark-joy-an-illustrated-guide-to-the-ja.title: 10 Ti Tips Ghor Porishkar Rakhar
spark-joy-an-illustrated-guide-to-the-ja.description: Erokom ki hote pare je apnake roj roj bari porishkar o korte hochhe na kintu apne aap apnar bari porishkar hoye jachhe? Hai hotei pare khali apnake jante hobe bari r jinish ke ki ki bhabe arrange kora jaye ar ei shob apni shikhte paren amader ei sarangsho ti theke. Ekhane tidying related shob rokomer important roles er byapare jante parben khub sohoje.

medical-medium-cleanse-to-heal.title: Detox And Heal Your Health
medical-medium-cleanse-to-heal.description: Har koi chahta hai ki wo healthy rahe. Par Kaise ? Aaj ke time mein, poisonous pathogens humare food mein hi hote hai, jo humare janam se pehle hi humari health ke liye khatra paida kar dete hai. To aise mein hum kaise apni health ka khyal rakhe jo hume internal level se cleansing mein help kar sake ? Yahi janenge hum iss audiobook mein. Iske alawa hum intermittent diet, food combinations aur health ke liye kya suitable hai un sab ke bare mein janenge

ಏಲಿಯನ್ಸ್-ಲೋಕ-1.title: Aliens Loka!
ಏಲಿಯನ್ಸ್-ಲೋಕ-1.description: ಅನಾದಿ‌ ಕಾಲದಿಂದ್ಲೂ ಅನ್ಯಗ್ರಹ ಜೀವಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕೌತುಕ ಇದ್ದೇ ಇದೆ. ಒಂದಷ್ಟು ಜನ ನಾವ್ ಏಲಿಯನ್ಸ್ ನೋಡಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ, ಇನ್ನೊಂದಷ್ಟು ಜನ ನಾವ್ ಏಲಿಯನ್ಸ್ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತೇ ಆಡಿದ್ದೀವಿ ಅಂತಾರೆ. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ಕೆಲವ್ರು ಇದೆಲ್ಲಾ ಮೂಢನಂಬಿಕೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಹೌದು . ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಯಾವ್ದು ನಿಜ.? ಭೂಮಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಅನ್ಯಗ್ರಹ ಜೀವಿಗಳು ಇರೋ ಸ್ಥಳ ಯಾವ್ದು.? ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ಇದೇ ವರ್ಷ ಏಲಿಯನ್ಸ್ ಬರ್ತಾವೆ ಅನ್ನೋ ಸುದ್ದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸತ್ಯವಿದೆ.? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಎಲ್ಲದಕ್ಕೂ ಉತ್ತರ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಏಲಿಯನ್ಸ್ ಲೋಕ!' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

the-talent-code.title: Find Your Own Talent
the-talent-code.description: "Hamare Padosi Ka Bachha Ekdum Dumb Tha Lekin Kamal Kar Gya” Aapne kai baar ye baat suni hogi. Lekin us bachche ne kamal kiya to kaise? Aur Aap ya Aapke bachche kaise apna chhipa talent pahchane? Ye sawal bhi aapke man me aata hi hoga.To Doston! Aapke in sawalon ke jawab aur Aapke andar ke talent ko baahar nikalne ke kai tareeqon se bhari “Find Your Own Talent” book hum Aapke liye hi to laye hain.

how-to-file-your-income-tax-1.title: How to File Your Income Tax
how-to-file-your-income-tax-1.description: Tax Ani vintene Janam Shock Avutaru. Kanee Nijaniki Andulo Antaga Shock avadaniki emi undadu. Saraina Awareness Lekapovadame deeniki Karanam.  Asalu Income Tax Ante emiti?, Income Tax Enni rakalu?,  Daaniki Ela Calucate cheyali, Ela Tax save chesukovali Vanti vishayalanu ee Meeru Audio book lo Vini New Financial Knowledge and Plan ni pondandi.

india-russia-relationship-1.title: India & Russia Relationship
india-russia-relationship-1.description: India swathantra rajyam akunnathinum munne thanne thudangiyathanu annathe Soviet Union um India um thammilulla nayathantra bendham. Nirnayaka ghattangalil polum India ye sahayikkan munnottu varikayum etrayo varshangalayi aa bendham kaathu sookshikkukayum cheyunna rajyamanu Russia. Engane anu etharamoru nayathantra bendham eru rajyangaludeyum edayil sthapikkapedathu? Etharamoru sahakaranathilude enthoke nettangalanu eru rajyangalum nediyathu? Nilavile Ukraine- Russia yudhathil India ude nilapadil mattam sambhavikkumo? Enningane ella chodyangalkkumulla utharam 'India & Russia Relationship' enna show lude ningalkku lebhikkum.

beyond-the-blues.title: A Guide to Mental Wellness During Pregnancy
beyond-the-blues.description: 'Beyond the Blues' humein risk factors, diagnosis, treatment aur pregnancy ke dauran mood disorders ko kaise prevent karen iski ek-ek jaankari deti haiin. Ye audiobook summary sirf pregnant mahilaon ke liye hi nahi balki unke liye kafi helpful hai jo pregnancy ke dauran maa ke sath rehkar unki dekhbhal karte hain. Iss book summary mein baby ke born hone baad maa ko hone wali mental problems ke bare mein bhi baat ki gai hai. Shoshana S. Bennett dwara likhi gai kitaab Beyond the Blues' humein risk factors, diagnosis, teatment aur pregnancy ke dauran mood disorders ko kaise prevent karen iski ek-ek jaankari deti haiin.

2611-terror-attacks.title: Remembering 26/11 Attacks
2611-terror-attacks.description: Mumbait zalela 26/11 cha to Terrorist Attack, tharvun suddha koni visru shaknar nahi. Tya Ratri anek Nishpapani aple pran gamavle, anek veerani aple balidan dile. Te 72 taas ya Mayanagri Mumbai cha hi kayam lakshat rahtil. Aaj 14 varshani punha ekda tya ghatnela ujala det, aple Praan panala lawun ladhlelya, Shahid zalelya aplya Police bandhavana ani itar saglyach Shur-Virana Salute karuya.

making-life-a-masterpiece-1.title: Making Life A Masterpiece
making-life-a-masterpiece-1.description: We are all scared of failing. Most of us give up when we fail to do or achieve something. However, we can only be successful after encountering failure in some form. Orison Swett Marden, an American writer associated with the New Thought movement, wrote "Making Life A Masterpiece" in the late 19th century. Marden instructs us in this book to explore our potential, seek out chances, and find our calling in life without letting setbacks get in the way. You will learn from this audiobook that failures are nothing more than lessons to be learned on the way to greater successes.

zen-yoga.title: Yoga : The way Of Life
zen-yoga.description: Ham Sab Jante hain ki Yoga hamari life me bahut zaroori hai lekin karte fir bhi nhin.Kyu ki hame bas ye ek simple si exercise lagti hai.Lekin yahan aap galat hain.Yoga aapke jeewan ko poori taraf badal sakta hai aapke vicharon ko saaf kar sakta hai.Isiliye ham aapke liye laaye hain ek kamaal ki Kitab “Yoga : The way Of Life”. jo aapke dimag ki uthal puthal ko shant karne ke tareeqe batati aur sikhati aut tension se door rahna vo bhi yoga ki madad se.

cities-you-should-visit-before-you-die-1.title: Cities You Should Visit Before You Die
cities-you-should-visit-before-you-die-1.description: Andariki enno kottha pranthalu chudalani akkada enjoy cheyyalani, manasuki nachina places ki velli happy ga gadapalani untundi. Manaku thelisina places kante theliyani places ee prapancham lo chaala unnayi. Alaanti best places yokka information mee andari kosam memu ee Audio book lo andisthunnam. Randi happy ga vini enjoy cheyyandi.

the-story-of-titanic-3.title: The Story of Titanic
the-story-of-titanic-3.description: The sinking of the Titanic has captivated the public imagination like no other modern-day tragedy. The special series not only recounts the harrowing events of April 14, 1912, when the British ocean liner went down in the North Atlantic Ocean, but takes the exploration further, revealing information about the circumstances before the ship set sail, its last hours, and the aftermath. Was the vessel actually christened before embarking on its inaugural voyage? Why did the wireless operators on the ship perform so poorly? Why was the ship's speed not reduced despite multiple warnings? Why did the nearby Californian not come to the rescue? Get the answers to these questions and witness the vivid and gripping account of the ship deemed as 'unsinkable'.

wild-at-heart.title: Understanding The Man's Heart
wild-at-heart.description: Humne ye aksar suna hai ki Ladke nahi rote, Ladke to humesha strong hote hain par kya kabhi humne ladkon ya purushon ke dil me jhanke ki koshish ki hai? Kya kabhi humne purushon se ye puchne ki koshish ki? Ki aakhir tum kyu pareshan ho aakhir tumhare dil mein kya chal raha hai, tum kya chahte ho. To aaiye aise he kuch sawalo ke jawaab aur purushon ke atmavishvas aur saahas ko pehchanne ke nuskhe ko jaante hain.  Agar aapko "The Rudest Book Ever" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

naga-rahasyam.title: నాగా రహస్యం
naga-rahasyam.description: మెలుహన్ సామ్రాజ్యం గురించిన కొన్ని లోతైన రహస్యాలను శివ ఎలా వెలికి తీస్తాడో ఈ పుస్తకం చెబుతుంది, ఇక్కడ ఒక మత్తు పదార్థానికి  రాజ కుటుంబీకులు ఎలా   బానిసలయ్యారు, దాని కోసం వారు హత్యలు చేయడం లేదా యుద్ధం చేసే స్థాయికి కూడా వెళతారు.నాగా రహస్యం పుస్తకం 2013లో ప్రచురించబడింది.  నాగ రహస్యం  కనుగొనడానికి మరియు చుట్టూ ఉన్న లెక్కలేనన్ని రహస్యాలను ఛేదించడానికి భారతదేశం అంతటా శివుడు చేసిన  ప్రయాణం గురించి తెలియజేస్తుంది

stan-lee-2.title: Stan Lee : The man who created Super Heroes
stan-lee-2.description: Duniya ke koi bhi ek Comic book creator ka naam bataiye? aur aapke man me sirf ek he naam ata hai aur wo hai "The MAN" yaani " STAN LEE ". Spiderman , Iron man , Thor, Black panther jaise kai Super Heroes ko Banane wale Lee,  Jab bhi Movie me 10 second ke liye bhi aate hai tab unke fans taaliyaan bajane se thakte nahi, Chaliye Jante hai Marvel studios ke main Hero Stan Lee aur unki super heroes ki army ke baare me iss audiobook me

top-ten-playmakers-of-all-time.title: Top Ten Playmakers Of All Time
top-ten-playmakers-of-all-time.description: Mythanath njodiyidayilulla neekkam kondu theerumanam kond kaliyude vegavum thalavum niyanthrikkunna resultine maattimarikkunna footballermare ningal kandittille. Bhavana sambannaraya aa playmakermaranu Footballinte hrudayam. Ithihasa thulyaraya 10 kalineythukare namuk ee showilude aduthariyam.

sreesanth.title: Sreesanth
sreesanth.description: International Cricket il Keralathinteyum Indiayudeyum abhimanam uyarthiya tharam aanu S Sreesanth. Nalla samayam mosham samayavum Sreeyude careerilum jeevithathilum undayi. Vivadangalude thozhan enna aaropanangal uyarnnappozhum sreeyude prathibhayude karyathil viral choondan aarkkum aavumayirunnilla. Ithihasa tharangale vare thante panthumayi virappicha Sreesanthinte jeevitha kadha kelkkam ee showilude.

psychology-of-money-2.title: The Psychology of Money
psychology-of-money-2.description: Aksar hamare mann mein ye sawal aata hai ki bill gates itne ameer kaise hue? Kaise warren buffett ne apni jyadatar wealth 50 se 60 ki age mein bnai? kya inh logon ne iske liye mehnat ki ya fir ye log sirf lucky the? Aur ameer banne ke liye humein kya karna hoga? Aaiye sunte hain is book summary ko aur jaane kaise sirf apna behaviour badalne se aap ameer ban sakte hain.

தென்றல்-வரும்-ஜன்னல்.title: தென்றல் வரும் ஜன்னல்
தென்றல்-வரும்-ஜன்னல்.description: மிகப் பிரபலமான கவர்ச்சி நடிகை வசியாபூரி. அவள் தன் உடலில் மாற்றத்தை உணர ஆரம்பித்து பதற்றத்தில் தன் குடும்ப மருத்துவரை அழைத்து உதவி கேட்கிறாள். மருத்துவர் வீடு சேர்வதற்குள் ரத்த நாளங்கள் வெடித்து மரணமடைகிறாள், வசியா பூரி. அவளது மரணத்துக்குக் காரணம் என்ன? இது உண்மையில் தென்றல் வீசும் ஜன்னலா அல்லது புயல் வீசும் தென்றலா?

davood-ibrahim.title: DAWOOD IBRAHIM
davood-ibrahim.description: ದಾವೂದ್ ಇಬ್ರಾಹೀಮ್ – ಭಾರತದ ಭೂಗತ ಲೋಕದ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗ್ರಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಹೆಸರು... ಅಪರಾಧ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಕುಖ್ಯಾತಿಯಾದ ಈ ದಾವೂದ್, ಇಡೀ ಜಗತ್ತು ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಿರುವ ಮೋಸ್ಟ್ ವಾಂಟೆಡ್ ಕ್ರಿಮಿನಲ್! ಸಣ್ಣ ದರೋಡೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ಜೈಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ, ಪೊಲೀಸರ ಮಗನಾಗಿದ್ದ ದಾವೂದ್, ಮುಂಬೈನ ಡಾನ್ ಆಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಕಥೆ ಅಪರೂಪದಷ್ಟೇ ರೋಚಕವೂ ಹೌದು. ಮುಂಬೈನ ಬೀದಿಯೊಂದರಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ಈ ಗ್ಯಾಂಗ್‌ಸ್ಟರ್, ಭೂಗತ ಡಾನ್ ಆದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'ದಾವೂದ್ ಇಬ್ರಾಹೀಮ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೂಕುFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲೇ!

hallyu-the-korean-wave.title: Hallyu - The Korean Wave
hallyu-the-korean-wave.description: Apne gangnam style par kabhi na kabhi dance kiya he hoga, ya fir squid game ya BTS band ke gaane bhi sune honge,  Corona wave ke baad sabse badi wave hai wo hai "HALLYU" jo hai korean cultural wave , to chaliye jante hai South Korea ki kahani jo desh 20 saal pehle ekdam garib tha to achanak aisa kya hua ke aaj duniya ke log unke gaane, unke movies , unka food aur unki skincare and lifestyle follow karne lage.

rishi-sunak-uk-pm-from-indian-origin.title: Rishi Sunak: UK PM from Indian Origin
rishi-sunak-uk-pm-from-indian-origin.description: India vamsavali la piranthu valarnthu  British naatoda pirathamar ra pathavi yethurukka Rishi Sunak patriya suvarasyamana matrum muzhumaiyana varalatru thoguppu idhu. Rishi Sunak kadanthu vantha paathaiyai yum, British Pirathamar ra avar sandhikka irukkura savaalgalai yum therinjukka indha padhiva kelunga.

ten-best-strikers-of-all-time-in-footbal.title: Ten Best Strikers Of All time In Football
ten-best-strikers-of-all-time-in-footbal.description: Prapancha vyapthamgaa entho peruganchina Foot Ball aatalo manaku theliyani aatagaallu endaro unnaru andulo konthamandi aatagalla gurinchi ee audio book lo thelsukundam. Ee audio book lo cheppe aatagalla story lu manaku entho prerananu kaligisthayi.

bermuda-triangle-an-ancient-mystery.title: Bermuda Triangle - An Ancient Mystery
bermuda-triangle-an-ancient-mystery.description: Bermuda triangle se judi aapne kai kahaniyo ko suna hoga, Ye Smudri duniya ka ek Aisa raj hai jaha 2000 se jyada Jahaj aur 200 se Jyada Viman isme dfan ho chuke hai. Unme se bahuto ka to Namo Nishan bhi nahi mila. Is series me Bermuda Triangle se judi har ek jankari aap tak pahunchayenge  aur is Mysrery se parda uthayenge. Akhir kitna sach hai is kahani me aur kitna jhunt? Janenge detail me.

israel-vs-palestine.title: Israel Vs Palestine
israel-vs-palestine.description: Indha ulagam romba chinnadhu nu sonnalum, adhukku pinnadi irukura varalaaru therinjikka therinjikka mudiyadha onnu dhaan. Israel and Palestine makkal oda evolution, avangaloda pinnani enna, edhanaala war vandhuchu nu pala swarasiyangal neranja audio book dhaan idhu.

shoe-wars.title: Puma VS Adidas - The Story Of 2 Shoe Dogs
shoe-wars.description: Adidas and Puma are two of the most well-known athletic footwear brands on the planet. Adi and Rudi Dassler launched their shoe business in their mother's laundry room, which was almost immediately successful. However, by the end of World War II, the Dasslers had been torn apart by a vicious feud, which had split up their business and their family and sent each down separate, frequently contentious paths. Two rival sneaker companies emerged from the flames of their rivalry. These companies would revolutionize the world of professional sports by inspiring amazing behind-the-scenes deals, stunning advertising campaigns, and multimillion-dollar contracts for professional athletes, from Muhammad Ali to Virat Kohli. Listen to this fascinating series based on the true story of sibling rivalry.

super-safalta-ke-25-super-niyam.title: Super safalta ke 25 Super Niyam
super-safalta-ke-25-super-niyam.description: Boond boond se sagar bharta hai, aur jab baat gyaan ke boond ki ho, to ye ek aisa dariya ban jata hai, jisme har gyaan ki boond ka alag hi mahattva hota hai. Isi baat ko samjhaane ke liye, lekhak ne alag alag gyaani logon se mulaqat ki, aur phir unke sabhi gyaan ko ek jagah ikattha kiya. Ye wo gyaan hai, jisko agar koi apne jivan mein dhaaran kar le to use safal hone se koi nahi rok sakta. Is gyaan ke sahare insaan tamam unchaiyon pe pahuch sakta hai. Toh agar aap bhi, duniya bhar ke mahaan gyaaniyon ka gyaan ek jagah, paana chahte hai, toh suniye humari ye audiobook.

maharashtrache-badalte-rajkaran.title: Maharashtratil Rajkiya Drama
maharashtrache-badalte-rajkaran.description: Maharashtracha Rajkarnat gelya kahi warshat zalelya Natyamay Ghadamodinche apan sarvach sakshidar ahot. Pan ya ghatna ghadnya mage nakki kon konti karana hoti, Eka pathun ek itaki Rajakiya vadala nakki ka ali, Kasa hota Maharashtracha Rajkiya Itihas ani Teva ani Ajcha Rajkarnat nakki kay farak ahe, ya saglyavishayi apan charch karnar ahot 'Mahrashtratil Rajkiya Drama' ya aplya khas show madhun

pregnancy-notes-before-during-after-1.title: Pregnancy Tips: Do's and Don'ts.
pregnancy-notes-before-during-after-1.description: “Maa Banne Ka Ehasaas Hota Hai Sabse Khas”. Aur isi ehsaas ko aur surakshit banane ke liye hum laaye hain “Pregnancy Tips: Do's and Don'ts. Yahan aapko un 9 mahinon ke rahan sahan ke baare mein bahut detail me bataya gaya hai ki kaise aap apna khayal rakh sakti hain aur bache tatha khud ki dekhbhaal kar sakti hain. Aap ki Pregnancy ke samay ke liye healthy diet se lekar sahi exercise tak sab ke notes hamne kar diye hain taiyar, to ab aapko hai kis baat ka intzaar. Chaliye suna jaaye..

evolution-of-mobile-phones.title: Evolution of Mobile Phones
evolution-of-mobile-phones.description: Innaiku irukka kaala kattathula mobile phones nama udambula oru paguthi maathiri irunthuttu irukku. Intha mobile phones oda parinaama valarchiyai pathi thaan intha pathivu la namma kettu therinjukka porom. Mobile phones oda kathaiyai unga mobile phone la kekka ready aah ???

creative-confidence-unleashing-the-creat.title: Creativity Orjon Korte Sikhun
creative-confidence-unleashing-the-creat.description: Byastota manei kintu creative ba productive howa na. Creativity shobdo ta shune apni ki bhabchen? Apni hoito music, dance, ba painting. Jekono manush e creative, tar bhabna,chinta shob tai creative. Ei creativity amader gene er modhyei thake. Ei creative manush hobo ki kore? EI creativity anek ta obhyasher moto, anek ta orjon korte hoi. Ei shob bishoy aro jante shune nin ei boi tir sarangsho.

the-obstacle-is-the-way-1.title: Turning Obstacles into Opportunities
the-obstacle-is-the-way-1.description: Apne attitude mein ek simple change laane se kab badi se badi mushkilein opportunities mein badal jayengi aapko pata bhi nahi chalega. Iska seedha example is kitaab ke lekhak Ryan Holiday khud hai. Jinhone 19 saal ki umar mein, aadhi padhai karne ke baad hi  apne college ko alvida keh diya tha aur aaj vo Billion-dollar brands ke Media consultant hain. Ye book hume sikhati hai ki  ek mushkil jo success tak pahuchne ke humare raste ko rok rahi hai vo kaise humare liye  ek naya aur behtar rasta ban sakti hai. Agar aapko "Who moved my cheese" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

european-football-1.title: European Football
european-football-1.description: European Football ante prapancha vyapthamgaa entho mandi abhimanulanu kaligi unna club. Prapancha vyapthamgaa peruganchina aatagallu andaru ee deshalalone unnaru. Indulo vividha club lu unnayi. Asalu ee club la visheshaalu, aatagaalla sangathulu anni indulo vindaam.

google-scratch-to-cloud.title: Google: Scratch To Cloud
google-scratch-to-cloud.description: Google illatha oru divasathe kurich namuk innu chinthikkan kazhiyumo. Illa alle? Nammude enthu chodhyathinum otta clickinu appuram utharavumayi nilkkunna ee manthrikacheppinte valarchayude pinnile kadha ambarappikkunnathanu. Oru garage il thudangi innu lokam muzhuvan vyapich Manushya rashiye thanne matti maricha Google kadhakelkkam ee audio bookilude.

apple-success-story-1.title: Apple Success story
apple-success-story-1.description: Sabke Chaheete Mobile Aur Laptop Brand "Apple" Ke Peeche ki Success Story Bahut Hi Romanchak Hai. Apple ko Successful Hone ke liye bahut zyada badi team ki zarurat nhi padi. Naa hi Bahut Zyada paise Kharch krne ki. Lekin Fir Kaise Bnaya Apple ne itna bada brand Jo ki DUniya Bhar Ka Chaheeta Ho gya. Suniya AudioBook Apple Ki Success Story Sirf KukuFM Par.

boycott-bollywood.title: BOYCOTT BOLLYWOOD
boycott-bollywood.description: Boycott Bollywood ha vichar sampurna internetvar trend karat ahe, ji Bollywood chya bhavishasathi changali goshta nahi. Ya vichardharemule Lal Singh Chadda madhla Amir Khan, Rakshabandhan madhla Akshay Kumar Shamshera madhil Sanjay Dutt Ya Sarkhe A lister Celebritieschya kamit ghat hotana dista ahet. Pan ha trend nakki kadhi ani kasa suru jhala ya magcha karan kay hey janun gheuyat #boycottbollywood ya khas show dware fakta kukufmvar.

lionel-messi-4.title: Lionel Messi
lionel-messi-4.description: Lionel messi fans - Ungalukkana Audio book dhaan idhu. Namma ellaroda favourite Lionel messi, avaroda journey of life into football and why he is a football legend nu indha audio book la therinjikka poreenga. Happy listening !!

mcdonalds-success-story.title: McDonald's Success Story
mcdonalds-success-story.description: Duniya mein kuch hi brands aise hai jo har country mein pehchaane jate hai, Aur McDonald's bhi unhi chuninda brands mein se ek hai. Aur fir chahe vo globalization ka virodh karne wale samajik karyakarta ho, Sarkari svasthya adhikari ho ya fir bachho ke motape aur bimariyon ko lekar chintit rehne wale mata-pita , McDonald's in sabka pasandita raha hai. Lekin iske piche ka karan kya hai? aese kaunsi strategy hai jisne iss brand ko aaj safalta ki is uchai tak pahucha diya? Iska javab iss audibook se accha aur koi nahi de sakta hai. Kyuki isme McDonald's ki Success ke ek ek step ko bariki se samjhaya gaya hai.

what-is-illuminati.title: What Is Illuminati?
what-is-illuminati.description: Ee Lokathinte niyanthranavum nammude oro neekkavum ajnathamaya etho shakthikalude kayyil aanenna ghoodalochana siddhanthangal orupad naalayi nammude samoohathil und. Ee shakthikale Illuminatikal ennanu goodalochana siddhanthakkar vilikkunnath. Yadrichikamennu thonnunna pala sambhavangalum nigoodamam vidham bhandham undennu ivar pracharippikkunnu. Illuminatiyude nigooda vazhikal kettariyam.

arundhati-bhattacharya-sbi.title: Arundhati Bhattacharya
arundhati-bhattacharya-sbi.description: Kya aapko pata hai Bharat me sabse jyada jis sector me Job Application bhare jate hai vo hai Banking Sector aur Banking Sector me sabse successful mahila jinhone apni safalta ke jhande gade hai unka naam hai Arundhati Bhattacharya. Inhone apne Career ki shuruvat Bank PO ki Job se ki thi aur haal hi me abhi SBI Women Chairperson se Retire hui hai. Forbes ki List me Sabse Powerful Mahila ki List me bhi shamil ho chuki hai. Lakho Females ke liye Inspiration ban chuki Arundhati Bhattacharya ne ye safar kaise tay kiya janenge is series me.

ganpat-patil.title: Ganpat Patil
ganpat-patil.description: Marathi cinematil ‘Ganpat Patil’ alis ‘Nachya’ haa marathi kalakar mahit nahi asa prekshak viralach! Ek kalakar, ek manus mhanun kasa hota he aapan jaun gheuya KUKUFM chya hya show madhun. Shroteho, kalakar mhanun milaleli prasidhhi aani paristitiche chatake ekach veli sahan karane kay asate te hya show madhun tumhala kalel. Trutiy panthi bhumika manapaasun nibhaun ha manus ek movie housefull karu shakaycha. Hya kalakarache aayushya janun gheu hya show madhun…Tumhi ekat ahat KUKUFM…Sune jo man chahe!

-ಕಂಬಳ--ಕರಾವಳಿ-ಕ್ರೀಡೆ.title: Kambala : Karavali Kreede
-ಕಂಬಳ--ಕರಾವಳಿ-ಕ್ರೀಡೆ.description: ಕರಾವಳಿ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯ ತವರೂರು...ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಊರಿಗೊಂದು ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯವಿದೆ, ಮನೆಗೊಂದು ಆಚಾರವಿದೆ...ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ ಇಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಆಚರಣೆ, ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಬೇರೆಲ್ಲೂ ಕಾಣಸಿಗದು. ಅಂತಹ ಪಾರಂಪರಿಕ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಕಂಬಳ..! ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ತುಳುನಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಷ್ಟೇ ಕಾಣಸಿಗುವ ಈ ಕಂಬಳದ ಇತಿಹಾಸವೇನು? ಕಂಬಳ ಹೇಗಿರುತ್ತೆ? ಇದನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ನಡೆಸಲಾಗುತ್ತೆ? ಎಂಬ ಕುತೂಹಲ ನಿಮಗಿದ್ಯಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ, 'ಕಂಬಳ : ಕರಾವಳಿ ಕ್ರೀಡೆ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕುಎಫ್ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.

ltte-and-prabhakaran-1.title: LTTE and Prabhakaran
ltte-and-prabhakaran-1.description: Bharat na apne ek kabil politician Rajiv Gandhi ko LTTE or Prabhakaran ke hathon kho diya tha. Par sawal ata hai ki civil war toh Sri Lanka main chal raha tha, aur Prabhakaran ne LTTE ki sathapana Sri Lanka main ki thi, toh aisa kya hua ki bharat ko apna ek neta khona pada? kyon iss civil war main bharat ne apni Indian Army ko Sri Lanka bheja? aur aakhir kiss tarah Sri Lanka main iss khooni ladai ka ant hua,? Aaiye pata lagaate hai iss audiobook se. Agar aapko India after Gandhi jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

ronaldo-1.title: RONALDO
ronaldo-1.description: ಕ್ರಿಸ್ಟಿಯಾನೋ ರೊನಾಲ್ಡೋ – ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಲೋಕದ ಸುನಾಮಿ..! ಚಿರತೆಗಿಂತಲೂ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಓಡುವ ಕಲಾವಿದ..! ಈತನ ಆಟ ನೋಡಲು ಈ ಜಗತ್ತೇ ಫಿದಾ..!ಒಮ್ಮೆ ತಾಯಿಯ ಕರುಣೆಯಿಂದ ಉಳಿಯಬೇಕಾದವನು, ಇವತ್ತು ಕ್ರೀಡಾ ಲೋಕದ ದಿಗ್ಗಜನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳಗಿರುವುದು ಒಂದು ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕಥೆ. ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಲೋಕದ ಸುಲ್ತಾನನಾಗಿರುವ ರೊನಾಲ್ಡೋನ ಜೀವನಕಥೆ ಚಿತ್ತಾಕರ್ಷಕವಾಗಿದೆ.ಈ ಮಹಾನ್ ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ‘ರೊನಾಲ್ಡೋ’ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೂಕುFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲೇ!

neerja-bhanoth.title: Neerja Bhanoth
neerja-bhanoth.description: నీర్జా భానోత్ ప్రాణత్యాగం వెనుక ఉన్న కథ మీకు తెలుసా? ఉగ్రవాదులు ఫ్లైట్ ని ఎలా హైజాక్ చేసారు? వినండి ఉత్కంభరితమైన ఆడియో బుక్

the_emyth_revisited.title: Small Businesses ko Fail hone se kaise Rokein?
the_emyth_revisited.description: Ye kalpana ki chhote businesses shuru karne wale log entrepreneurs hi hote hai, ya ye dhaarna ki jise thoda bohot bhi technical knowledge ho wo ek tech based business chala sakta hai. Aisi kai saari galat dharnao se hum ghire hue hote hai jiske karan hum mein se kai log business tricks samajh nahi paate. Inhi dharnao ko clear karegi ye book summary.

how-to-start-investing-your-wealth-in-a-.title: How to Start Investing your Wealth in a Useful Way?
how-to-start-investing-your-wealth-in-a-.description: Panatha sambadhicha mattum podhaadhu. Adha epdi sethu veikanum nu therinja dhan life nalla irukum. Namma Indian government la iruka savings schemes ennanna? Adha epdi namma use panradhu nu therinjuka kelunga “How to Start Investing your Wealth in a Useful Way?” on Kuku FM

cristiano-ronaldo-3.title: An Inspiring story of Ronaldo
cristiano-ronaldo-3.description: CR7 mhantla ki ekach nav aplya dolya samor yeta te mhanje Cristiano Ronaldo. Ronaldola Football Madhla Best Player samajla jata. lokani ani media ne tar tyala ya baheril dunyetil manusha ahe ashi upama deil ahe. shrote ho ya jagavikhyat khiladu Cristiano Ronaldo yachi footballchi journey kadhi kuthe ani kashi suru jhali hey apan janun gheuyat An inspiring story of "Cristiano Ronaldo" ya khas show madhye.

vyaktitva-ka-sampoorna-vikas-by-swami-vi.title: Vyaktitva ka Sampoorna Vikas
vyaktitva-ka-sampoorna-vikas-by-swami-vi.description: Ravindra Nath Tagore ne ek baar kaha tha yadi aap Bharat ko janna chahte hain to Vivekananda ko padhiye. 39 year's ke apne Jevan kaal me Swami Vivekananda jo kaam kar gaye wo shayad aane wali peedhi na kar paaye. Wo kewal ek sant nahi the, Ek mahan Deshbhakt, ek ache speaker, ek ache writer aur ek achi soch rakhne wale insan bhi the. Swami Vivekanandaji ka Bharat desh ko ek naya Bharat banane me kitna yogdan raha hain insab ke baar me aapko Puri jaankari milegi is full Audio book me jiska nam hai "Vyaktitva Ka Sampoorna Vikas"

ten-best-strikers-of-all-time.title: Ten Best Strikers Of All Time
ten-best-strikers-of-all-time.description: Football kaliyil ettavum mikacha prakadanam kaazhcha vecha strikers aarokkeyanennu nirvachikkan orikkalum eluppamulla karyamalla. Ennirunalum njangal select cheythitulla lokathe ettavum mikacha strikersinte list showil kelkku. Njangalude listinod ningal yojikkunundo enn comment boxil pareyu.

how-to-better-understand-your-child.title: How To Better Understand Your Child?
how-to-better-understand-your-child.description: Pothuve ella mathapithakkaleyum kuzhapikkunna oru karyamanu thangalude makkalude vikara-vicharangale krityamayi manassilakkuka ennathu. Oro prayathilum kuttikalude chinthagathi engane aayirikkum, deshyam vannu erikkumbol avare engane karyangal paranju manassilakkam, maanasika- shareerika vaikalyangal ula kuttikale engane manassilakkam enningane niravadhi chodhyangalkkulla utharamanu ‘How to Better Understand Your Child?' enna show lude ningalkku lebhikkunnathu.

laut-aayi-chhaya-3.title: Laut Aayi Chhaya
laut-aayi-chhaya-3.description: Parimal Ghosh aur Chhaya ki ek aisi prem kahani jise sunkar aapke rongte khade ho jaayenge. Ek aisi mohabbat ki daastaa'n jismein maut ke baad zindagi ki shuruaat hoti hai. Kya hoga jab prem kisi shareer se nahi aatma se ho jaaye? kya chhaya ki maut ke baad parimal ghosh ki duniya me kisi aur ka chhaya padega? Mohabbat ki is daastaa'n ko poora karne ke liye kya badal jaayega prakirti ka vidhi vidhaan ya phir parimal ki zindagi me laut aayegi chhaya?

zinedine-zidane.title: Zinedine Zidane
zinedine-zidane.description: Angu France thottu engu kochu Keralam vare Football aradhakarude manassil sthiramayi sthanam pidicha prathibha aanu Zinedine Zidane. Theevramaya jeevitha anubhavangalilude kadannu poya idheham aa ormakalil ninnu prajodanam ulkondu kalikkalathile thee ayi marunnathu albhuthathode lokam nokki ninnittundu. Kalikkalathil munneriyum kalahichum loka sredha pidichu pattiya Zinedine Zidane enna French desheeya nayakane kurichu kooduthal ariyam ee audio bookilude

charles-sobraj-the-bikini-killer-1.title: Charles Sobhraj - The Bikini Killer
charles-sobraj-the-bikini-killer-1.description: Ek aisa killer jiske crimes par documentaries aur na jaane kitni movies ban chuki hai, interviews liye jaa chuke hai. Ek aisa killer jo har jail se nikal bhaagne ka paitra jaanta tha, jiske looks se koi use criminal nahi maan sakta tha. Jisne 1960s ke hippie culture ka rukh badal kar rakh diya aur itne muyrders kiuye jiska use khud aakda yaad nahi. Kya hai iski kahani? Kaha hai ye abhi? Jaanenge is dilchasp audiobook mein

shiridi-mahimalu.title: Shiridi Mahimalu
shiridi-mahimalu.description: Shiridi Sai Baba ante bhakthula palita kalpavruksham, thana vaddaku vache bhakthula korikalanu theerche daivam. Bhakthula kastaalanu pogoduthu thana divya aashissulatho sakalajanulanu puneethulanu chesthunna shiridi sai baba jivitha charithra mariyu shiridi punyakshethra visheshalu ee audio book lo vindam.

lionel-messi-3.title: Lionel Messi - The legend of Football
lionel-messi-3.description: Apan Football kinva FIFA world cup vishayi boltoy ani Lionel Messi cha naw ala nahi asa honarch nahi. Career mhnun Football chi niwad karnychi asa Messi ne tharwala ani Mehanaticha jorawar tyane apla swapna satyat utravala. Ya paravasat alelya anek problems samore jaat, Ajarpanashi zunja det Messi ne apla Goal achive kela. Aikuya Argentina cha ya world best footballer chi Inspirational Story..

wo-beguna-thi.title: Wo Begunah Thi
wo-beguna-thi.description: Drug supply ke ilazam mein phasi ek ladki jo chikh-chikh kar khud ko Begunah sabit kar rahi thi. Par police mahkame aur duniya walo ko uspar yakin nahi tha. Uski madad karne ko samne aaya ek aadmi Rahul Verma jo na jasoos tha aur na hi vakil. Uska shaukh tha jasoosi kahaniya padhna to aise mein apne samne aayi sajish ko woh kaise jane deta? Kya yeh nausikhiya us ladki ko bacha paya ya khud phas gaya kisi jaal mein? Ek Khoobsurat jaal par aadharit bilkul alag tarah ki kahani jo panne panne par aapko sochne majboor kar degi ki kya woh wakahi thi gunegar ya "Wo Beguna Thi"?

personality-development-15.title: Personality Development Course
personality-development-15.description: Ei boi ti ullekh kora hoyeche je pathok sreni ki ki bhabe labhobaan hoben. Apni apnar ichey ke ki bhabe bikoshito korte parben. Er jonno apnake kolpona korte hobe je apni ei boi ti pore ba shune, lok ke apon kora shuru kore diyechen. Nijeke proshno kora, jokhoni apnar kono ukti mone dhore tahole seta beshi mon diye shune nin ba likhe nin. Ei boi ti pore ba shune apni nijer jiboner personality ki kibhabe aro bariye tulte parben shikhe nin.

history-of-indian-football.title: History of Indian Football
history-of-indian-football.description: Football vilayattu namma nattukulla eppo, eppadi vanthuchu nu theriyuma?  Cup mukkiyam bigilu nu vilayadi jeyicha Indian Football in Nijamaana Singa Pen na pathi Ungaluku theriyuma ? Idhu ponra pala interesting aana vishayangal indha pathivu la irukku.  Idhu Indian football patriya oru Suvarasyamana varalatru thokuppu ! Vaanga therinjukalam.

neera-arya.title: Neera Arya - First Lady Spy
neera-arya.description: Neera Arya jisne Ek deshbhakt Krantikar ko bachane ke liye apne Pati ko Maut ke ghat utar diya tha. Akhir Neera Arya kon thi jise Indias First Spy bhi kaha jata tha? Neera ka Jeevan kaise tha? Inko Neta ji ne apni Rani jhansi sena ki kaman kyon di thi? Neta ji ke sath desh ki azadi me inka kya connection tha? In sare sawalo ke javab aapko hamari is series me milenge. deshbhakti se Oot-Prot is series ko suniye jo aapko ek sachce deshbhakt ki yaad dilayegi jise kai salo pahle bhula diya gaya tha. Neera Arya - First Lady Spy Jisne bharat ki azadi me Neta Ji subhash chandra ka sath diya aur Neta ji ki jaan bachane ke liye Apne Suhag ko Maut ke ghat utar diya.

jesus-christ_-the-son-of-god.title: Jesus Christ - The Son Of God
jesus-christ_-the-son-of-god.description: The biblical account of Jesus Christ's life has captivated people's imaginations around the world more than most other tales. The Last Supper, the Sermon on the Mount, the Nativity, and the Resurrection are all stories that artists frequently return to, exploring their dramatic, symbolic, and religious meanings. This unique series retraces the life of the Nazarene, elaborating the major episodes of his life till his death and resurrection and its effects while aiming to shed new light on the life of one of the world’s most influential figures. Listen to the compelling and awe-inspiring tale of the man known as the "Son of God".

உயிர்-திருடர்கள்.title: உயிர்த் திருடர்கள்
உயிர்-திருடர்கள்.description: எந்த ஒரு அரசியல்வாதி சுயநலத்தைத் தள்ளி வைத்துவிட்டு பொதுநலவாதியாக மாறுகிறானோ, மக்களால் அவன் தலைவனாக ஏற்றுக் கொள்ளப்படுகிறான். மற்றவர்கள் தண்டிக்கப்படுகிறார்கள். இந்த ஒரு வரி உண்மைக் கதையே ‘உயிர்த்திருடர்கள்’.

ted-bundy-the-most-infamous-serial-kille.title: Ted Bundy - The Most Infamous Serial Killer
ted-bundy-the-most-infamous-serial-kille.description: Kya Aap Jaante Hain Duniya Ka Sabse Mashoor Hatyara kaun Hai ? Aur Kyu Vo Itna Mashoor Hai ? KukuFM Aap Ke Liye Laya Hai Yeh AudioBook Jisme Usek Baare Mein Aise Aise Facts Btaye Gye Hain Jinhe Sun Kar Aap Dang Reh Jayenge. Suniye " Ted Bundy - The Most Infamous Serial Killer" Sirf Kuku FM Par.

ten-best-strikers-of-all-time-in-footbal.title: Ten Best Strikers Of All Time In Football
ten-best-strikers-of-all-time-in-footbal.description: Football Fans unga favourite Player indha football ulagathula eppadi patta mukkiya idatha pidichi irukaanga. Ethana vaati goal adichi victory ah namakku parisaa kuduthu irupaanga. Appadi nammala ovvoru vaatiyum football ah rasikka vecha top 10 players pathi indha audio book la kelunga.

el-chapo.title: The Story of Drug Lord EL Chapo
el-chapo.description: Pure World mein Drugs ka Zehar Gholne wale Drug Lord El Chapo ki ye kahani kisi film se kam nahi hai. Sirf ek ya do nahi balki dashko tak EL Chapo ne duniya ke chote se chote aur bade se bade desho mein Drugs ki Smuggling ki . Jisme se cocaine, marijuana, heroin, meth, aur fentanyl ki smuggling sabse jyada rahi. Sirf yahi nahi chapo ne apne is dhandhe ko chlane ke liye apne virodhiyo ke khilaf Mexico mein jung shuru kardi thi , aur hayrani ki baat ye rahi ki us jung mein mexico ki kafi janta unka sath bhi de rahi thi. Iske sath sath EL Chapo do bar is trah se jail se bhaga ki use sadi ki sabse badi jail break bhi kaha ja sakta hai. Aur ye sabkuch kab aur kaise hua, ye is audiobook mein ekdum bariki se bataya gya hai.

how-to-fight-infertility.title: How to fight Infertility?
how-to-fight-infertility.description: ಮದುವೆಯಾದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೋಡಿಗು ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಒಂದೇ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ – ‘ಗುಡ್ ನ್ಯೂಸ್ ಯಾವಾಗ?’ ಅಂತಾ. ಆದರೆ ಇದು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ ಸರಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯಾಗಿರೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಬಂಜೆತನ ಅನ್ನೋ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ, ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಆಗದ ನೋವು ಅನೇಕ ಜನರನ್ನ ಕಾಡುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಣ್ಣು-ಗಂಡು ಅನ್ನೋ ಬೇಧವಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದ್ರೆ, ಬಂಜೆತನ ಶಾಪವಲ್ಲ, ಪಾಪವಲ್ಲ. ಇವತ್ತು ಮೆಡಿಕಲ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವು ಬಹಳ ಮುಂದು ಸರಿದಿದೆ. ಇಂದು ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಸಾಧ್ಯ! ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಬಂಜೆತನದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡಬೇಕು? ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಆಗಲು ಯಾವೆಲ್ಲ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳು ಇವೆ? ಎಷ್ಟೆಲ್ಲ ಸೈಡ್ ಎಫೆಕ್ಟ್ಸ್ ಇವೆ? ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ವಿಚಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೇಳಿ ಹೌ ಟು ಫೈಟ್ ಇನ್‌ಫರ್ಟಿಲಿಟಿ? ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ಕೂಕು FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

wow-momo-success-story.title: Wow Momo Success Story
wow-momo-success-story.description: Khawa ba Khawanor alochona e bangalir agroho to akash chowa kintu ta diye jodi kotha hoi koti taka chhowar. Aj chole jai ekta pahari khabare kintu shey shudhu ar pahare nei. Ar sheta holo momo, ar aj amra kotha bolchi Wowo Momo r kotha. Ki bhabe holo ei Wow Momo brand tir utpotti ar ki ki bhabe holo eto jonopriyo ebong protyek ti bangalir mukhe ba puro desh jure sobar mukhe ektai name holo ki bhabe aj ei golpe shune newa jabe.

pythagoras.title: Pythagoras
pythagoras.description: Pythagoras 500 Isa purva mein janme Yunan ke vikhyat ganitagya the. Sukrat, Pluto aur Sikandar bhi unse prabhavit rahe. Pythagoras ne jo bhi sandesh diya, ganit ki jitni bhi gataaye thi, maukhik ki. Unhone apne haatho se ek bhi shabd nahi likha, kai log unke students bane. Jaane gyan-vigyan ki anek shakhao ke jaankar - vidvan Pythagoras ki jeevan kahani

maradona-1.title: MARADONA
maradona-1.description: ಮೆರಡೋನ.! ಈ ಒಂದು ಹೆಸರು ಸಾಕು ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಅಭಿಮಾನಿಗಳ  ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ. ಕ್ರೀಡೆಯಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲದೆ ವಿವಾದಗಳಿಂದಲೂ ಸದ್ದು ಮಡಿದ ಹೆಸರಿದು. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ಇವ್ರನ್ನ 'ಹ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಓಫ್ ಗಾಡ್' ಅಂತ ಕರೆಯೋದ್ರ ಹಿಂದಿರೋ  ಕಥೆ ಇಡಿಯಲ್ಲ ಅದು ರೋಮಾಂಚಕ. ಸಾವಲ್ಲೂ ಕಾಂಟ್ರವರ್ಸಿ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಇವ್ರನ್ನ ಬಿಡ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಅವ್ರ ನಂಬರ್ '10' ಜೆರ್ಸಿಗಿದ್ದ ಪವರ್ ಎಂಥದ್ದು.? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರನ್ನು ಕಾಡುವ ಆಟಗಾರ 'ಮೆರಡೋನ' ಅವ್ರ ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್. ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕು FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.

ten-best-strikers-of-all-time-in-footbal.title: Ten Best Strikers of all time in Football
ten-best-strikers-of-all-time-in-footbal.description: ವಿಶ್ವದಾದ್ಯಂತ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಗೆ ಇರೋ ಎಷ್ಟೋ ಕ್ರೇಜ್ ಬೇರೆ ಯಾವ ಆಟಕ್ಕೂ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅದೇ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲವರು ಬೆಸ್ಟ್ ಸ್ಟ್ರೈಕರ್ ಆಗಿ ಆಟವನ್ನು ಗೆಲ್ಲಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪಾತ್ರವನ್ನು ಪೋಷಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬೆಸ್ಟ್ ಸ್ಟ್ರೈಕರ್ ಗಾಲ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ ಕುಕು FM ಕನ್ನಡಲ್ಲಿ

detective-ragini-samne-hai-maut-khadi.title: Detective Ragini - Samne Hai Maut Khadi
detective-ragini-samne-hai-maut-khadi.description: Detective Ragini ke hath aaya hai Mishti naam ki ek ladki ke loot ke dauran katl ka case. Is case ke prime suspect hai Mishti ke pita aur paati jinhe Mishti ke bisexual hone se dikkat thi. Case ki saari kadiyan in dono ko mujrim thehrati hai par kya Ragini dekh payegi sabooton ke peeche ka asli sach? Ya Mishti ki maut ke peeche hai koi aur bada raaz?

the-autobiography-of-a-stock-1.title: How To invest In Stocks
the-autobiography-of-a-stock-1.description: Ortho amader moulik proyojon gulir modhye ekti. Juger songe songe amder jibon japoner poddhoti o bodlachhe. Jegulo aage luxury ba bilasita hishebe gonyo hoto sheguloi ekhon amader proyojoniota hoye utheche. Sadharon modhybityo poribaarer  kache gari ebong ac r moto sadhon thakata motei aschorjo noi, juger sathe amader orther proyojoniyota bartei thake. Bharatborshe modhybityor bash anek beshi. Beshirbhaag modhyobityor kache financial knowledge na thakar karone tara dhoni hote pare na, sobai fixed deposit ba recurring deposit chhara jane na. Kintu egulo te dhoni howa oto sohoj noi, aj amra ei boi er sarangsho niye kotha bolbe sekhane amra jante parbo ki bhabe stocks e biniyog kora jaye khub sohoje.

bermuda-triangle-an-ancient-mystery-1.title: Bermuda Triangle - An Ancient Mystery
bermuda-triangle-an-ancient-mystery-1.description: Baffling and mysterious, the Bermuda Triangle is the birthplace of many interesting stories and incidents, some believable and some outright bizarre. For generations, this infamous site has made headlines and bemused scientists, meteorologists, investigative agencies, and ordinary folk. This unique series takes a closer look at the events and legends related to this iconic spot, drawing on reports and testimonies and exploring possible explanations to challenge our assumptions about the Devil's Triangle. Get on this gripping journey as we decode the manufactured mystery of one of the most well-known urban legends.

shah-rukh-khan.title: Badshah Of Bollywood
shah-rukh-khan.description: Yeh kahani hai uss middle class ladke ki jisne sapne dekhne ki himmat ki aur uss sapne ko pura bhi kiya aur yeh sabit kar diya ki kisi cheez ko shiddat se chaho to puri kaynat tumhe usse milane ki koshish mein lag jati hai. Yeh kahani hai Shahrukh Khan ki. Delhi ki galiyon se bollywood tak ki inki journey hume sapne dekhne ki himmat deti hai aur inki isi journey ko hum janenge iss audiobook mein

sunil-chhetri.title: Sunil Chhetri
sunil-chhetri.description: Indian football oda adayaalama ivaru thaan irukkaru nu sollalaam. Ulagathulaye athiga goals adicha Indian ah pathina pathivu thaan ithu. Sunil Chhetri kadanthu vantha paathai kandippa nammala bayangarama inspire pannum. Ivaroda goals ku pinnadi irukka kathaigal namma goals ah achieve panrathuku oru boost kodukkum.

how-to-come-out-of-depression.title: How To Come Out Of Depression
how-to-come-out-of-depression.description: Namma life la pala dark times irundhurukkum, siladhu handle panna mudiyum, siladhu handle panna mudiyadhu. Mudiyadhu nra podhu stress varum adhu thodarndhuchu naa Depression la poi mudiyum. Depression pala per ah pala mosamaana mudivugala edukka vachurukku, indha nelamai ah maatha mudiyum. Adhu eppadi nu indha audio book la kelunga.

career-mein-safalta-ke-21-mantra-1.title: Career Mein Safalta Ke 21 Mantra
career-mein-safalta-ke-21-mantra-1.description: Career mein Successful kaun nahi hona chahta lekin kaise? iska jawab bahut logon ko nahi malum. Lekin ab iska jawab aapko Brian Tracy ki is audiobook mein mil jayega. Jahan unhone career mein successful hone ke 21 mantron ke bare mein bataya hai jin ko sun kar aap apne Career mein aa rahi Problems ko Solve kar paenge.

brazil-1.title: Brazil
brazil-1.description: World Football Map lo Brazil ki oka pratyeka sthanam undi. Uncountable style, Skilled Team players unna Brazil Aidu World Cup geluchukunna Brazil team gurinchi ee audiobook lo vindam.

avachetan-man-ki-shakti.title: Power of your Subconscious Mind
avachetan-man-ki-shakti.description: Avchetan man , ya subconscious mind ki power insaan ko jo chahiye wo dila sakti hai , jise hum inner power bhi kehte hai , " agar aap kisi chiz ko chaho , to puri kaaynaat use tumse milane ki sazish me lag jaati hai" ye dialogue to aapne suna he hoga . yahi hai subconscious mind ki power . to chaliye jante hai , kaise aap apne mind ki power se apke career, relationships aur health ko control karke ek achhi life jee sakte hai. Agar aapko "The Secret - Hero" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

argentina-3.title: అర్జెంటినా
argentina-3.description: ఫుట్ బాల్  అంటే ఇష్టపడేవారు చాలామందే ఉంటారు. మన ఇండియా లో క్రికెట్ కంటే తక్కువే కానీ పశ్చిమ , యూరోప్ దేశాల్లో మాత్రం క్రికెట్ కంటే  ఫుట్ బాల్ కే వీరాభిమానులు ఎక్కువ. మీరూ అలాంటి వీరాభిమానుల్లో ఒకరా? లేదంటే అలాంటి వీరాభిమానులు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే  చురుకైన ఆర్జెంటినా నేషనల్ ఫుట్ బాల్  టీమ్ గురించి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో వినండి.

how-to-understand-children-psychology-2.title: How to Understand Children Psychology
how-to-understand-children-psychology-2.description: Don Appa nalla daddy ah? Illa Santhosh Subramaniyam daddy nalla appava? Rendu perume illa. Romba strict ah pasangala control panni naama nenaikiradha seiya veikiradhu kids oda future ah rombave affect pannum. Apo nee venalum panniko nan kandukka maaten nu irukanuma nu ketta, adhuvum koodadhu. Pinne epdi dhan namma kids ah vazhakkanum? Avangala epdi purinjikiradhu? Therinjuka kelunga “How to understand children psychology” on Kuku FM.

william-shakespeare.title: William Shakespeare
william-shakespeare.description: Zyadatar log aisa mante hai ki kisan ka beta kisan, doctor ka beta doctor aur soldier ka beta soldier banta hai. Par shakespeare ke saath aisa nahi hua. Shakespeare ke parivar ka lekhan se koi lena dena nahi tha, unke pita kisan the, lekin Shakespeare ne bachpan mein natak dekh ke ye tay kar liya tha ki ve ek natakkar banenge aur unhone apna yeh sapna pura kiya. Aaj lagbhag 400 saal baad bhi unke natko ki prashansa hoti rehti hai aur yeh audiobook unhi ke jeevan ki ek jhalak hume deti hai aur saath hi un mahan natko se humara parichay karvati hai

how-to-live-a-fulfilling-single-life-1.title: How to live a fulfilling Single Life?
how-to-live-a-fulfilling-single-life-1.description: 'ಬೀಯಿಂಗ್ ಸಿಂಗಲ್ ಐಸ್ ಬೆಟರ್ ಥೇನ್, ಬೀಯಿಂಗ್ ವಿಥ್ ರಾಂಗ್ ಪರ್ಸನ್' ಎಂಬ ಮಾತಿದೆ... ಈ ಮಾತು ಅಕ್ಷರಶ ಸತ್ಯ..! ಖುಷಿ, ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯೇ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರುವ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳಿಗಿಂತ, ಸಿಂಗಲ್ ಆಗಿಯೇ ಹ್ಯಾಪಿ ಆಗಿರೋದ್ ಎಷ್ಟು ಉತ್ತಮ. .! ಆದ್ರೆ, ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನವ್ರು ನಂಬಿರೋದು  'Single Life andre boring life' ಅಂತ! ಇದು ತಪ್ಪು... ಸಿಂಗಲ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದುಕೊಂಡೇ  ಹ್ಯಾಪಿ ಆಗಿ, ಪೀಸ್ ಫುಲ್ ಆಗಿ ಒಂದು ಮೀನಿಂಗ್ ಫುಲ್ ಲೈಫ್ ಲೀಡ್ ಮಾಡಬೋದು..! ಅದು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಂತ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕಾ? ಕೇಳಿ 'How to live a ಫುಲ್ಫಿಲ್ಲ್ಲಿಂಗ್ ಸಿಂಗಲ್ ಲೈಫ್?' ಎಂಬ ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್, ಓನ್ಲಿ ಆನ್  ಕುಕು FM...

indian-banking-system-1.title: Indian Banking System
indian-banking-system-1.description: Bank namok protisthan ti ekta sunischit o morjada purno songsthan hoye utheche ta bolai jaye. Amra toh praye sokolei bank e jai, taka paisa sonchoy kori, songroho kori, egulor jonnyo amader account thake bank e. Kintu banking ashole ki jinish, ba kobe theke shuru hoyechilo, bortomane bank name protisthan ti ki bhabe eto unnoti korlo? Bank bolte ashole ki bojhaye? Ei shob aro nana bishoy jante shune nin ei audiobook ti.

nlp-handbook-1.title: NLP Handbook
nlp-handbook-1.description: Kya hum humare jeevan ko zyada khoobsurat aur  anandmay bana sakte hai ? Kya humari kamzori vijay payi ja sakti hai ? NLP ek aisi takneek hai jisse yeh mumkin hai. Iss audiobook mein hum NLP ki inhi taknik ke baare mein janenge jo hume positive badlav ki aur le jayegi

do-epic-shit-3.title: Do Epic Shit
do-epic-shit-3.description: అంకుర్ వారికూ ఒక వ్యవస్థాపకుడు మరియు కంటెంట్ సృష్టికర్త, డబ్బు మరియు పెట్టుబడి, స్వీయ అవగాహన మరియు వ్యక్తిగత సంబంధాలపై లోతైన, చమత్కారమైన ఆలోచనలు అతనిని భారతదేశపు అత్యుత్తమ వ్యక్తిగత బ్రాండ్‌లలో ఒకటిగా చేశాయి. ఇది చదవాల్సిన, మళ్లీ చదవాల్సిన పుస్తకం, దీని వాక్యాలను  మీరు అండర్‌లైన్ చేసి మళ్లీ మళ్లీ ఆలోచించే పుస్తకం, మీరు మీ కుటుంబం మరియు స్నేహితులు మరియు అపరిచితులకు ఇచ్చే పుస్తకం.

how-to-make-your-resume-stand-out.title: How to Make Your Resume Stand Out?
how-to-make-your-resume-stand-out.description: Oru velaiku apply panrathuku modhal la namma seira vishayam, Antha company ku nammaloda resume ma anuppurathu ! Apidi nama anupura resume antha velaiku apply panna nootru kanakaana resumes la pathoda pathinonnu illama, Velai kodukkuravangal la attract panra mathiri thanithuvamana irukanum na.. athuku nama enna pannanum ? vaanga therinjukalam ! Idhu resumes pathi na muzhumaiyaana pathivu.

archimedes.title: Archimedes
archimedes.description: Bachpan men padhi gai ek kahaani yaad hai na aapko.Jismen scientists nahate hue achanak kuch khoj leta hai aur Yureka! Yureka! chillata hua raja ke mahal ki taraf bhagta hai. Us mahan scientists ka naam tha Archimedes. Archimedes jisne duniya ko pani ke kai siddhanton ko samjhaya aur khoje naye- naye auzaar.Is audio book men ham aapke liye laaye hain Pracheen yunaan vaigyanikon aur vahan ki sabhayataon ke vikaas ki poori kahani.janane ke liye Yunaan aur Archimedes ka itihas aap bane rahiye is audio book aur kuku fm ke saath.

cashflow-quadrant-3.title: Rich Dad's Cashflow Quadrant
cashflow-quadrant-3.description: జీతం తో బ్రతికే జీవితం మీకు విసుగు పుట్టించిందా?, వ్యాపార ప్రపంచంలో ఆర్థికంగా స్వేచ్ఛగా మారడానికి మీరు ఎటువంటి పాత్రను పోషించాలో తెలుసుకోండి. వ్యాపార ప్రపంచాన్ని రూపొందించే నాలుగు రకాల వ్యక్తులు ఉన్నారు, కానీ వ్యాపార యజమానులు మరియు పెట్టుబడిదారులు తమ ఆస్తుల ద్వారా తమ కాష్ ఫ్లో ను వేగవంతం చేసి తమ సంపదను పెంచుకుంటారు.మీ సంపదను వేగవంతం చేయడానికి కొత్త మార్గాలను అన్వేషించడంలో వాల్ స్ట్రీట్ జర్నల్ బెస్ట్ సెల్లర్, రిచ్ డాడ్ పూర్ డాడ్ సీక్వెల్‌ “రిచ్ డాడ్స్ క్యాష్‌ఫ్లో క్వాడ్రంట్” బుక్ మీకు సహాయం చేస్తుంది.

mannat-1.title: Mannat
mannat-1.description: Ek raat Aditya aur Mannat ek dusare se mile, Aur bina kisi pahchan ke un donon ke bich woh hua jo hona nahi chahiye tha, Us raat ki galati se mannat ki zindgi aur Sapne sab uthal-puthal ho jate hai, Wahi dusri aur jab aditya ko mannat se juda sach pata chalata hai to woh apni shadi tod kar mannat ko apne ghar le aata hai. Kya hoga jab aditya ko para chalega mannat ka asli sach? Kya aditya ke ghar wale apna payenge mannat ko? Kya mannat ke sapne udaan bharne se pehle ki bikhar jayenge? Janane ke liye sune "Mannat : Ek Anchahi Dua" sirf Kuku FM par.

how-to-talk-to-your-child-about-good-tou.title: How To Talk To Your Child About Good Touch And Bad Touch
how-to-talk-to-your-child-about-good-tou.description: Lokathinte bhaavi kuttikalaanu. Oro kuttiyum vyathyastharanu. Kuttikalude valarchayude oro ghattathilum rakshithakkalkk athi pradhanamaya pankund. Athil onnanu nalla sparshatheyum mosam sparshatheyum patti avare bodhavanmar aakkuka ennathu. Kuttikale Ishtappedunnavre pole thanne avare chooshanam cheyyunnavarum namukk chuttilum und. Atharam sahacharyangale dheerathayode neridan nammude kuttikale praptharakkan ee audio book ningale sahayikkum.

maandavan-kattalai.title: மாண்டவன் கட்டளை
maandavan-kattalai.description: தன் தந்தையின் மரணத்துக்குப் பழி வாங்க,  தலையை வெட்டிக் கொலை செய்யத் தொடங்குகிறான் ஒருத்தன். அவனைக் கண்டுபிடித்தே தீருவேன் என்று தேடுகிறான் காவல் அதிகாரி. கொலையாளியைக் கண்டுபிடித்தானா? பரபரப்பும் அதிரடித் திருப்பமும் நிறைந்த கதைக் களம் தான், ‘மாண்டவன் கட்டளை...’

safalta-ke-liye-13-sarvasreshtha-aadatei.title: Safalta Ke Liye 13 Sarvasreshth Aadatein
safalta-ke-liye-13-sarvasreshtha-aadatei.description: Life mein har koi successfull hona chahta hai par uss success ko haasil kaise kiya jaye ? Kaise hum apni aadaton mein badlav la sakte hai ? Yahi hum janenge iss audio book mein jise likha hai Napoleon Hill Ne. Yeh audio book aapko apni aadaton ko sudhar kar jeevan mein safal hone ka vyavahrik gyaan dengi.

jawaharlal-nehru-2.title: Jawaharlal Nehru
jawaharlal-nehru-2.description: ಇವ್ರು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ 'ಚಾಚಾ'... ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಭಾರತದ ಮೊದಲ ಪ್ರಧಾನಿ...ದೇಶ ಕಂಡ ಅಪ್ರತಿಮ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ರು... 'ನವಭಾರತದ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ' ಎಂದೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಿಯಾಗಿರುವ ನಮ್ಮ ಪಂಡಿತ್ ಜವಾಹರ್ಲಾಲ್ ನೆಹರು ಬದುಕಿನ ಕಥೆಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕು FM ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಜವಾಹರ್ಲಾಲ್ ನೆಹರು' ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್ .

parenting-tips-for-new-parents-2.title: Parenting Tips for New Parents
parenting-tips-for-new-parents-2.description: Oru Kuzhandai edhukaga azhudhu nu namma paati thatha ellarum correct ah solluvanga. Namma generation parents ku adha purinjika rombave kashtam. Adhukunu kuzhandai azhugurapo keela subtitles ah poda mudiyum? Parents, newborn kids ah epdi paathukanum nu therinjuka kelunga “ Parenting Tips for New Parents” Originals on Kuku FM

sentinel-island-uncontacted-island-1.title: Sentinel Island - Uncontacted Island
sentinel-island-uncontacted-island-1.description: Duniya ki ek aisi Place jaha ke baare achche se kisi ko kuchh nahi pata jise most Dangoures Island ke naa se bhi jana jata hai, aur vo koi dusre planet me nahi hai isi Earth me. Insano ka pichle kai hajaro salo me bada transformation hua ha, ham Janglon se shehro tak aa gye. Lekin is Island par rahne vale logo me koi changes nahi aaye, ye abhi bhi vaisa hi jeevan jee rahe hai. ise connect karne ki bahut koshish ki gai but baat nhi bani. is series me ham is Island ke sare secrets janege, to chaliye sunte hai is shandar series ko.

how-to-respond-to-your-childs-embarrassi.title: How To Respond To Your Child's Embarrassing Questions?
how-to-respond-to-your-childs-embarrassi.description: Njan Enganeya Undaye? Achanum Ammaykkum enne enganeya kittiyath? Enningane kuttichodhyangalum aayi varunna kunjungalum avarkku munnil kuzhanju pokunna achanammamarum ella kalatheyum kazhchal aanu. Kuttikalude samshayangal angane chumma vittu kalayendathano? Kuttikalude valarchayil aa chodhyangalkkum nammude utharangalkkum ulla praadhanyam valare valuthanu. Varoo kuzhaykkuna kuttichodhyangalude lokathekku..

cr7-the-goal-machine-of-football.title: CR7: The Goal Machine Of Football
cr7-the-goal-machine-of-football.description: Christiano Ronaldo name tukui bhoktokuler modhye beshamal adrenalin rush er karon hishebe jothestho. Apnader anek tai jana Ronaldo r somporke, anekei anektai jane, anek tai abar dhowasha e roye giyeche. Ottonyto sojotne khub beshi lok jana jani howa theke shamle rekhe diyeche shey, tar jibon ar pachta manusher moto sadharon noi. Ronaldo r obhijaaner songi hote shunne nin ei audiobook ti. Ekti sadharon dip theke CR7 hoye othar jatra aj amra shune nebo.

wright-bandhu.title: Wright Bandhu
wright-bandhu.description: Aaj hum ko aakash mein jo Aeroplane dekhte hai, hawai yatra karte hai, iska pura shrey Wright brothers ko jata hai. Wright brothers bachpan se hi hawa mein udne ke concept ki aur attracted the aur saal 1900 mein pehli baar biplane banane se lekar 17 december 1903 ko ek successful udaan tak ka unka yahi safar hum janenge iss audiobook mein

keralavum-kaalpanthum.title: Keralavum Kaalpanthum
keralavum-kaalpanthum.description: Malayalikku jeevavayu aanu Football. Koythu kazhinja padathum ozhinja parambilum beachilum panth thattiya nammal ariyatha nadukalile manushyare athe vikarathinte peril nenjilettukayum athinte peril kombukorkkukayum cheyyunnu. Messiyum Ronoyum kallimund uduth nattuvazhiyil kanan pattunna thottu ayalvakkakkarane pole aanu Malayalikku. Malayaliyude Football premathinte kadhakal paranjal theerilla.

chandamama.title: Chandamama
chandamama.description: Chandamam rave jabili Rave Antu Pillalku Annam Tuinipistham, Inka Premikulaku Vennela Ratri Oka Swargam, Kavulaku Adoka Goppa Source ila manam Chandamamanu nu ela polchukunna, piluchukunna kuda science ki matram adoka satillite matrame . Ee Sattilite gurinchi ippativaraku manaku teliyani konni interesting facts Ee Audio book lo telusukundam.

business-secrets.title: Business Secrets
business-secrets.description: Business Secrets Ki is AudioBook bahut hi anokhe tarike se design kiya gaya, jaha aapko jyada Theory part nhi milega balki kuch aisi kahavte aur statements milegi jo aapki life ko ek alag hi disha dikha sakti hai. Writer ke alag believe hai is lekhan ko leakr, vo kahte hai ki kabhi kabhi kuch famous statements logo ke liye trigger ka kaam kar jate hai aur Action ho jata hai. isme aise bahut sate Suktiyo yani Axioms ko sajha kiya gaya hai, kuchh famous successful logo ki hai aur kuchh khud writer ke dwara likhi hui. aaiye is AudioBook ka lutf uthaiye.  Business Secrets ki is AudioBook me Life changing Statements milengi jo aapke business sense or Purpose ko aur clear banayengi.

jawaharlal-nehru.title: Jawaharlal Nehru
jawaharlal-nehru.description: Kuzhanthaigal Meedhaana anbin kaaranamaaga thanathu Pirantha Naalai Kuzhanthaigal dhinamaa Kondaada sonna thalaivar ! Suthanthira indiavin Mudhal Pirathamar Bharata Ratna Jawaharlal Nehruvin muzhumaiyaana vazhkai varalatrai intha pathivu la azhagaa sollirukanga. Vaanga Kekalam.

4-martyn-luther-king.title: Martin Luther King
4-martyn-luther-king.description: "I Have a Dream" - Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. ke bhaashan se in alfaazo ne usi din unki aur America mein barso se shoshit kiye jaa rahe, Black Communities ki taqdeer badal di. A Civil Rights Leader, Gandhi ki soch rakhne wale, equal rights activist aur ek Black Messiah. Yeh har racism se ghaayal hue insaan ki prerna the. Inhone logo ko apni identity, apna etihaas aur apne culture ko apnakar sar uthaakar jeena seekhaaya. Inke leadership mein, America ne pehli baar Black Power ko mehsoos kiya. Chaliye sunte hai yeh show aur inke mahaan jeevani se kuch seekhte hai.

great-indian-rivers.title: Great Indian Rivers
great-indian-rivers.description: Yugaluga India loni Rivers Aneka Genrations ki Jeevana adharamga unnayi. Hindi Puranalalo Kuda ee nadula Prasthavana Undi. Inka Koni Puranalu, kathalu, Kuda Ee Nadula Adharamgane Puttayi kuda. Bharathadeshamlo Prathi nadiki oka katha untundi. Kondaru veetini devathalauga poojistharu, marikondaru nature wonder ga enjoy chestru. Edi emina ee nadulaku oka goppa charitra undi. Konni nadulo himalayala nundi , marikonni, parvathala nundi, adavala nundi puttayi. Andulo mukhyamaina Ganga, Sindhu, Yamuna, Godavari, Krishna, Narmada, Brahmaputra, Kaveri Inka Itara NAdula Gurinchi Ee Great Indian Rivers Audio Book lo Vinandi.

how-to-understand-children-psychology-1.title: How to understand Children Psychology
how-to-understand-children-psychology-1.description: "ಇಂದಿನ ಮಕ್ಕಳೇ ನಾಳಿನ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳು".! ಹುಟ್ಟುವಾಗ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಒಂದೇ ತಾರಾ ಜನಿಸ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಸುತ್ತಮುತ್ತಲಿನ ಪರಿಸರ, ಕುಟುಂಬ, ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಪ್ರಭಾವದಿಂದ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವ ರೂಪುಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ. ಹೀಗಿರವಾಗ ಪೋಷಕರಿಗೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಸೋದು ಅನ್ನೋ ಚಿಂತೆ ಸಹಜ.! ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ನೀವು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮನಸನ್ನ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಬೆಸ್ಟ್ ಕೈಪಿಡಿ 'How to understand ಚಿಲ್ಡ್ರನ್ ಸೈಕಾಲಜಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್ . ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕು fm ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ .!

how-to-talk-so-kids-will-listen.description: Aksar parents ko lagta hai ki vo apne bacchon ko ache se samajh rahe hain lekin aisa nahi hota. Lihaza Bacche unki baat manna band kar dete hain. ಅಂಜನಿಪುತ್ರ-ಹನುಮ.title: Anjaniputhra Hanuma
ಅಂಜನಿಪುತ್ರ-ಹನುಮ.description: ಹಿಂದೂ ಪುರಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ದೇವರಿಗೂ ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನವಿದೆ. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ವಾಯುಪುತ್ರ ಆಂಜನೇಯನೆಂದ್ರೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಭಕ್ತಿ. ಹನುಮ ಮಹಾಭಕ್ತನಾಗಿ, ಧೈರ್ಯಶಾಲಿಯಾಗಿ, ಮಹಾಪರಾಕ್ರಮಿಯಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನಸ್ಸಲ್ಲಿ ಅಚ್ಚಳಿಯದ ಜಾಗವನ್ನ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಇಂಥ ಮಹಾವೀರನ ಜನನ ಹೇಗಾಯ್ತು? ರಾಮಭಕ್ತನಾದ್ರೂ ಯಾಕಾಯ್ತು ರಾಮಾಂಜನೇಯರ ಯುದ್ಧ.? ಮಾರುತಿಯ ಬೆವರಿಗಿರೋ ಆ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಸಪ್ತಚಿರಂಜೀವಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬನಾಗಿ ಈ ಕಲಿಯುಗದಲ್ಲೂ ಆ ಭಜರಂಗಿ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಿರೋ ಪವಾಡ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಹನುಮಂತನನ್ನ ಪೂಜಿಸಿದ್ರೆ, ಶನಿ ಕಾಟ ಕೊಡೋದಿಲ್ವಾ.? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಭಾರತದಿಂದ, ಬರಾಕ್ ಒಬಾಮವರೆಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಪೂಜಿಸೋ ವಜ್ರಕಾಯ 'ಅಂಜನಿಪುತ್ರ ಹನುಮ'ನ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್. ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

share-market-ki-41-tips-book.title: Stock Market Mein Safal Hone ke 41 Tips

Beginner ko kya kya dhyan mein rakhna chahiye? Stocks Kaise select kare? Kitna Amount kab aur kaha lagana aur nikalna chahiye? Entry Kab leni hai? Exit kab leni hai? Movement kya hota hai? Jawaharlal-Nehru--স্বাধীন-ভারতের-রূপকার-.title: Jawaharlal Nehru : স্বাধীন ভারতের রূপকার

Bharoter Ei Swadhinota Aandolone Je Manushtir Obodan Kokhono Oswikar Kora Jabe Na Tini Holen Pondit Jawaharlal Nehru. Tini Swadhin Bharoter Prothom Prodhanmontrio Chilen. Desher Jonyo Nijke Utsorgo Korechilen Ei Manushti. Bohubar Somalochito Hoyechen, Kintu Tini Dome Jan Ni. Tar Lokhye Tini Chilen Obichol. cleopatra.description: Cleopatra, etrayokke noottandukal kadannu poyittum kaalathinu maayichu kalayan sadhikatha peru. pakeezah-begum.title: Pakeezah Begum
pakeezah-begum.description: Deewan khandan ke upar hai uski maalkin Ameena ka kaala saaya. Ameena ne apne ateet ki chhahton ko pura karne ki lalach mein tham liya hai kale jaadu ka hath. Kya hoga jab Ameena ko pata chalega Pakeezah banane wali hai Deewan khandan ki nayi Begum? Aise mein kya Ameena hone degi ye niqah? Ya wo kisi aur ko Begum bana bacha legi apni zindagi?

shivakumara-swamiji.title: Shivakumara Swamiji -The Walking God
shivakumara-swamiji.description: ಇವ್ರು 'ನಡೆದಾಡುವ ದೇವರು' ಎಂದೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಿ..! ಜಾತಿ, ಮತ, ಅಂತಸ್ತುಗಳ ಭೇದವಿಲ್ಲದೆ, ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ನದ  ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಅಕ್ಷರವನ್ನು ನೀಡಿದ 'ತ್ರಿವಿಧ ದಾಸೋಹಿ'..! ಯವ್ವನದಲ್ಲೇ ತಮ್ಮ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಜೀವನ ತ್ಯಾಗ ಮಾಡಿ, ಸುಮಾರು ೮೦ ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಗೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಾಲ, ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸೇವೆ ಮಡಿದ ಸಿದ್ಧಪುರುಷರು...ಇವ್ರೇ ನಮ್ಮ ಸಿದ್ಧಗಂಗೆಯ ಪರಮಪೂಜ್ಯ ಶಿವಕುಮಾರ ಸ್ವಾಮೀಜಿ... ಈ ಮಹಾನ್ ಪುರುಷರ ಅಚ್ಚರಿಯ ಜೀವೆನಕಥೆಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ, 'ಶಿವಕುಮಾರ ಸ್ವಾಮೀಜ್  - ದಿ ವಾಕಿಂಗ್ ಗಾಡ್ ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ...
