ಗೋಕಾಕ್-ಚಳವಳಿ.title: Gokak Chaluvali
ಗೋಕಾಕ್-ಚಳವಳಿ.description: ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರು ಎಷ್ಟು ವಿಶಾಲ ಹೃದಯಿಗಳೋ, ಭಾಷೆಯ ವಿಚಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದ್ರೆ ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನಿಗಳು‌! ಈ‌ ಮಾತಿಗೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಪರ ಅದೆಷ್ಟೂ ಚಳವಳಿಗಳು ನಡೆದಿವೆ. ಇಂಥ ಹೋರಾಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು 'ಗೋಕಾಕ್ ಚಳವಳಿ‌'. ಹಿರಿಯರು ಹೇಳಿದಂತೆ "ಎನ್ನಡ, ಎಕ್ಕಡದ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಸ್ವಲ ಕನ್ನಡ" ಇದ್ದ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಮ್ಮ ಭಾಷೆಯ ಉಳಿವಿಗೆ ಟೊಂಕ‌ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ನಿಂತದ್ದು ನಮ್ಮ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರು. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಏನಿದು ಗೋಕಾಕ್ ಚಳವಳಿ.? ಈ ಹೋರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಣ್ಣಾವ್ರು ಡಾ. ರಾಜ್ ಕುಮಾರ್ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಹಲವು ದಿಗ್ಗಜರು ಕೈ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದ ಪರಿ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು.? ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರಾದ ನಮ್ಮ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ಏನು.? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಈ ಎಲ್ಲದಕ್ಕೂ ಉತ್ತರವಾದ 'ಗೋಕಾಕ್ ಚಳವಳಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ' ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.!

albert-einstein-6.title: Albert Einstein
albert-einstein-6.description: Ajkal kar juge choto bachharao gravity somporke jane. But aage byaparta eto sohoj chilo na. Bigyan somporke manush ke obogoto koran ekjon bigyani. Jini tar mrityur eto bochor poreo manusher hridoy ek bistirno onchol jure royeche. Kichu kichu bigyani onake bigyaner itihashe bhogoban bole mone kore. Ei shera bigyanir name Albert Einstein. Ini ja gyan prodan korechilen ja aj porjonto kono bigyani korte paren ni. Onar byapare aro bistarito bhabe jante shune nin ei audiobook ti.

history-of-gulf-war.title: History Of Gulf War
history-of-gulf-war.description: Ek Taanashah ki taanashahi, Persian Land se Islamic Replublic of Iran aur Kuwait ki zameen par oilfields ki laalach mein direct ground attack. Etihaas ke har pehlu ko aapke saamne laakar, jung, darindagi aur aam janta par hue dardnaak sach ko aapke saamne pesh karta hai 'The Gulf War'. Khaadi yuddha ke baare mein sab jaaniye is audiobook se. Saddam ki dadagiri aur galtiyaa, Shah se hatkar Khomeini ka Sharia kanoon wala Iran aur is par kheli gayi matlabi world politics. Abhi sune aur samjhe - The Gulf War.

lm-10-the-magician-of-football.title: LM 10 : Footballer Jadukor
lm-10-the-magician-of-football.description: Bortomane Biswer Sera Football Kheloyarder Dole Jar Name Ekdom Oporer Dike Royeche Tini Holen Lionel Messi. Tar Khelar Jadute Moje Biswer Koti Koti Somorthok. Take Ekbar Sporsho Korar Jonyo Mukhiye Thaken Tar Anugamira.Tobe Tar Ei Vokto Somagom Kintu Ekdine Hoyni. Dirgho Loraiyer Moddhey Diye Tini Aaj Biswasera. Kivabe Tini Elen Khelar Jogote? Jibone Ki Ki Bitorke Joriyechen Tini? Egiye Ke Messi Na Ronaldo? Echarao Tar Jibone Ghota Emonkichu Ghotona Ja Konodin Samne Aaseni, Seisob Kahini Jante Aapnake Shuntei Hobe Ei Audiobook.

how-to-easily-crack-upsc.title: How to easily crack UPSC
how-to-easily-crack-upsc.description: "ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂದೆ ಏನ್ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ಕೊಂಡಿದೀಯ.?" ಈ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ತುಂಬ ಕಾಮನ್.! ಇದಕ್ಕೆ "ನಾನು ಐಎಎಸ್ ಆಫೀಸರ್ ಆಗತೀನಿ ಅಂತ ಅಂದವರು ತುಂಬ ಜನ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಎಲ್ರು ಐಎಎಸ್, ಐಪಿಎಸ್ ಆಫೀಸರ್ ಆಗೋದು ಅಷ್ಟೊಂದು ಸುಲಭನಾ.? ಖಂಡಿತಾ ಇಲ್ಲ.! ಆದ್ರೆ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ ಸಧ್ಯ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಯಾವ್ದ್ ಇದೆ .?  ಯು ಪಿ ಯಸ್ ಸಿ  ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇರೋ ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಉತ್ತರ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ 'How to easily ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಕ್  ಯು ಪಿ ಯಸ್ ಸಿ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.

business-kohinoor-ratan-tata-1.title: Business Kohinoor Ratan Tata
business-kohinoor-ratan-tata-1.description: Business Ki Duniya Humesha Se Limelight Me Rahi Hai. Aksar Log Apne Business Ko Kaamyab Banane Me Sahi Aur Galat Ka Farq Bhulkar Sab Kuch Daanv Par Laga Dete Hain. Desh Ke Sabse Safal Business Tycoon Ratan Tata Ne Business World Ki Paribhasha Hi Badal Di Hai. Life Aur Entrepreneurship Ko Ek Saath Build Karne Wale Ratan Tata Ki Is Ansuni Kahani Se Aap Ho Jaayenge Motivate. Toh Aaiye Sunte Hain Is Audiobook Ko Aur Shaamil Hote Is Romanchak Safar Me.

ek-hota-lakshya-1.title: Ek Hota Lakshya...
ek-hota-lakshya-1.description: Laxmikant berde yana kon nahi olkhat.. Ashi Hi Banwa Banwi, Zapatlela, Changu Mangu, Maine pyar kiya, Hum apke hai kaun...ya sarkhya Superhit Hindi-Marathi Cinematun zalklela ek vinodi chehara mhnje sampurna Maharshtracha ladka Lakshya. Pan pratyek hasrya chehryamage, successful mansamage dadleli aste tyacha sangharshachi katha. Laxmikant Berde yanchi hich katha apan janun ghenar ahot. Aiknar ahot tyancha jeewan prawas aplya ya khas show madhun...

cbi-central-bureau-of-investigation.title: CBI: Central Bureau Of Investigation
cbi-central-bureau-of-investigation.description: കൈപുറകില്‍ കെട്ടി ബിജിയത്തിനൊത്ത് ഹീറോയിക് ആയി നടന്നു വരുന്ന സേതുരാമയ്യര്‍ എന്ന മമ്മൂട്ടി കഥാപാത്രത്തിലൂടെയാണ് സിബിഐ എന്ന അന്വേഷണ ഏജന്‍സി മലയാളിയ്ക്ക് ചിരപരിചിതമായത്. വാലും തുമ്പും കിട്ടാത്ത അനവധി കേസുകളില്‍ നേര് കാട്ടിത്തന്ന സിബിഐയെ കേരളത്തിന് വലിയ കാര്യമാണ്. സിനിമകളില്‍ കാണുന്നത് പോലെയാണ് സിബിഐ. ശരിക്കും എങ്ങിനെയാണ് അവരുടെ അന്വേഷണ രീതികള്‍.. സിബിഐയുടെ വഴികളിലൂടെ നമുക്കൊന്ന് സഞ്ചരിക്കാം.

jharkhand-ka-vidroh-1.title: Jharkhand Mein Vidroh Ka Itihas
jharkhand-ka-vidroh-1.description: Is Full Audio Book "Jharkhand me Vidroh ka Itihas" me 1767 se lekar 1914 angrezo ke khilaf hue ladai ka zikar hai. Jharkhand me sekdon salon se Aadiwasi samaj ke log niwas karte aa rahe hain aur British sarkar ne inpar khub atyachar kiya hai. Aur waha ke bauth sare krantikari ne is Vidroh me apni jaan gawai hai par afsos ki baat ye hai ki itne bade andolan ke bawajood bhe logo ko is itihas ke baare me kuch nahi pata hai. Virsa Munda, Tikka Manjhi jaise bauth se mahan krantikariyon ka zikar milega aapke is Full Audio book me jo is desh aur apne haq ki ladai ke liye Sahid ho gye.

jawahar-lal-nehru.title: Jawaharlal Nehru
jawahar-lal-nehru.description: భారత దేశానికి స్వాతంత్య్రం తీసుకురావడంలో నెహ్రూ పాత్ర? ఆయన తీసుకువచ్చిన సంస్కరణలు ఏమిటీ? నెహ్రూ జీవిత విశేషాలు మీకోసం.

bundelkhand-ke-agradoot-1.title: Bundelkhand Ke Agradoot
bundelkhand-ke-agradoot-1.description: Aaj Har Career mein respect Aur Paisa hai lekin Aaj se kuch sal pehle aeysa nahi tha. fir bhi us samay kuch logo ne Sahitya, Kala aur Khel ko Chuna aur Jeejaan Lagakar Mehnat karte rahe. Aur Jab Hum Aese Logo ki Bat Kar Rahe Hain toh  Munshi Premachnd, Major Dhyanchand, Maithili Sharan Gupt , Mirza Ghalib jaise Bundelkhand Ke Agradooton  Ko Koi Sapne  Mein Bhi Nahi Bhul Sakta hai. Ye Audiobook aapko Bundelakhnd ke Sabhi Agradooton Ke Sangharsh ki Kahani Sunayegi , Jinhe Jaankar aapko pata chlega ki Superstar Sirf Filmy duniya  mein hi nahi hote.

oscar-winner-satyajit-ray-1.title: Oscar Winner Satyajit Ray
oscar-winner-satyajit-ray-1.description: Satyajit Ray, one of the most prolific figures of world cinema, gave Indian literature, music, art, and film a distinctive aesthetic expression. His writings are regarded as treasure troves that have largely gone undiscovered, particularly his thoughts on screenwriting, filmmaking, and notable figures from the worlds of art, literature, and music. This particular series offers a thorough and instructive examination of Ray's various personas, both as a filmmaker and as a person. We learn about his upbringing, relationships, struggles, and final days as we attempt to understand his sense of cinema, instinctive understanding of musical nuances, and propensity for casting non-actors. Listen to the phenomenal and inspiring life story of the man who knew too much.

ঈশ্বরের-রূপকার-গুরু-নানক.title: Iswarer Ar Ek Rup Guru Nanak
ঈশ্বরের-রূপকার-গুরু-নানক.description: Sikh der itihash boroi joteel. Sikh itihasher sathe jorito name gulo amader anektai sosti prodan koreche, tobe er gobheere lukiye chilo ekadhik rohoshyomoy tothyo. Guru Nanaker jonmo ebong poroborti jibon rohoshyo ke khuje baar kora sottyi kotheen. Amra ekadhik  boi poreo moha sumodrer khoj lagate parbo na.  Nanaker sathe joriye thaka ei sokol rohoshyer sutra paat hoyechilo kothaye? Nanak ke chilen, ei bishoyta niye somolochonar shesh nei. Keu bolechen tar kono ostityoi chilo na, keu keu bolen tini naki Sikh dhormer probortok e non. Nanaker somondhye aro bistarito bhabe jante shune nin ei audiobook ti.

everest-par-taringa.title: Everest Par Tiranga
everest-par-taringa.description: World ka sabse uncha parvat, jaha har Parvtarohi ka sapna hota hai ki ek baar to vaha jarur jay. Har sal saikdo Adventures log Parvat par chadne aate hai lekin kuchh hi log safal ho pate hai. inka safar bahut mushkilon se bhara hota hai, jaan ki baji lagani padti hai. Is AudioBook me Shuruwat se lekar Manjil tak pahunchne ki sachci kahani detail me sunai gai hai. kitni mushkilo ka samna karna padta hai?  parivar ki kya bhumika hoti hai? kin kin Trainings se gujarna padta hai? sab kuchh. AAp bhi is safar me hamare sath jud sakte hai aur jankari hasil kar sakte hai. duniya ki sabse Adventures Trip ka.

how-to-become-good-public-speaker.title: How To Be A Good Public Speaker?
how-to-become-good-public-speaker.description: Oru valiya sadassine abhisambhodana cheyth samsarikkanum avare kayyileduth kayyadi nedanum kothikkatha aarund lokath. Ennal Stageil keran vare muttu viraykkunnavar aanu kooduthalum. Prasangam oru kalayanu alle. Nalloru prasangakan allenkil Public Speaker aavuka ottum eluppamalla. Arivu mathram pora athinu. Pinneyum vere chilathund. Athu enthokke aanu ennariyan ee audio kelkkam.

1962-cuban-missile-crisis-1.title: 1962 Cuban Missile Crisis
1962-cuban-missile-crisis-1.description: Nearly 30 years after the end of the Cold War, world leaders today are breaking nuclear disarmament agreements, increasing their nuclear arsenals, and exchanging nuclear war threats. If we are to survive this new atomic age, we must rediscover the lessons from the most perilous period of the Cold War - the 13 days of the Cuban missile crisis, considered by many as one of the most terrifying events of the mid-twentieth century. This unique series seeks to explain the attitudes and conduct of the Soviets, Cubans, and Americans while focusing on the people at the heart of the crisis as well as the tension and heightened fears of countless innocent bystanders whose lives hung in the balance. Learn the riveting tale of the global crisis which made the world stand still.

english-class.title: Aalim sir ki English Class
english-class.description: Koi bhi Bhasha sikhna aasan ban sakta hai , aur isi baat ke liye Aalim sir kaafi popular bhi hai. Iss audiobook me aap Basic english aur vakya rachna sikh sakte hai aur wo bhi ekdam filmy tarike se. Let's learn.

history-of-earth-1.title: History of Earth
history-of-earth-1.description: Namma Ulagam eppadi uruvaachu ? Kadantha kaalathula intha ulagathula ennenna maatrangal ellam nadanthuruku ? Ithayellam therinjukka ovvoru manushanukkum alavatra aarvam irukkum. Antha aarvathukku theeni poda koodiya pathivu thaan ithu. Namma ulagathoda varalaarai therinjukalaama makkale !

how-to-do-small-scale-business.title: How to do Small Scale Business?
how-to-do-small-scale-business.description: ಎಲರಿಗೂ ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋ ಕನಸು ಇದ್ದೆ ಇರುತ್ತೆ.! ಆದ್ರೆ ದುಡ್ಡು ಇನ್ವೆಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಭಯ.! ಬೈ  ಚಾನ್ಸ್ ಹಾಕಿದ ಹಣ ವಾಪಾಸ್ ಬರ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ ಅನ್ನೋ ಚಿಂತೆ.! ಇನ್ನೊಂದಷ್ಟ ಜನಕ್ಕೆ ತಮ್ಮಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ಯಾಲೆಂಟ್ ಇದ್ರೂ ಇದೆಲ್ಲ ವರ್ಕೌಟ್ ಆಗುತ್ತಾ ಅನ್ನೋ ಯೋಚ್ನೆ ಕೂಡ.! ಇಂಥವರಲ್ಲಿ ನೀವು ಒಬ್ರ.? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಇನ್ನು ಆ ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ಬೇಡ. ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಕುಳಿತು ಹಣ ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಮಾಡೋಧೆಗೆ.? ನಿಮಗೂ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಮಾಡೋ ಐಡಿಯಾ ತುಂಬಾ  ಇದ್ರೆ ಬೆಸ್ಟ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ  'How to do ಸ್ಮಾಲ್ ಸ್ಕೇಲ್ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.!

socrates.title: Socrates
socrates.description: Aap me se shayad hi koi aisa ho jisne Sukraat ya Socrates  ka naam na sun ho. Yunaan ka vahi prasiddh darshnik jisne jeewan ke bade se bade rahasya ko apne quotes ke madhyam se logon ko samjhaya.Jisne Jeewan aur use jeene ka sahi maksad logon ko bataya.Jisne logon ko prem ka sahi matlb samjhaya.Aise mahaan Philosopher ki jeewani ham aapke liye Audio book form me laaye hain.To aaiye jaante hain  Socrates ke baare men kuch unjaani baaten.

how-to-do-budget-travelling.title: How to do Budget Travelling
how-to-do-budget-travelling.description: ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ಲಿಂಗ್..! ಯಾರಿಗೆ ತಾನೇ ಇಷ್ಟ ಇಲ್ಲ ಹೇಳಿ..? ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರ ಕನಸು ಇದು...ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ ಕನಸು ನನಸು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋರು ಕೆಲವರಷ್ಟೇ..! ಇನ್ನುಳಿದವರು ' ದುಬಾರಿ' ಎನ್ನುವ ಒಂದು ವಿಚಾರ ಇಟ್ಕೊಂಡು, ತಮ್ಮ ಅಸೆ-ಕನಸುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮನಸಲ್ಲೇ ಸಮಾಧಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿರ್ತರೆ..! ಆದ್ರೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಖರ್ಚಾಲ್ಲೂ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಡ್ರೀಮ್ ಡೆಸ್ಟಿನೇಷನ್ ಗೆ ಟ್ರಿಪ್ ಮಾಡಬೋದು ಎಂಬುದು ನಿಂಗೊತ್ತಾ?! ಹೌದು... ಅದು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಂತ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕು FM ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ  'How to do ಬಜೆಟ್ ಟ್ರಾವೆಲ್ಲಿಂಗ್' ಎಂಬ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

isro-mars-1.title: Women Who Took India To Mars
isro-mars-1.description: Aksar log yeh kehte hain ki space science females ke liye nahi hai. Lekin Mars orbiter mission ke zariye India ke best scientist ne ye prove kar dikhaya hai ki space science mein females ke liye bhi utni hi jagah hai. Aur iss audiobook mein hum un mahilao ki baat karne wale hai jinhone India ko pehli baar Mars tak pahuchne mein bahut hi aham bhumika nibhai hai Iss AudioBook Mein Hum Unn Mahilo Ke Baarein Mein Baat Karne Vale Hai Jinhone India Ko Pehli Hi Baar Mein Mars Tak Pohchane Mein Bahut Hi Ahem Bhumika Nibhayi Hai.

ramanujan.title: Ramanujan
ramanujan.description: Tamilandu lo janminchina Srinivasa Ramanujan Bharathadeshapu Atyantha Goppa Mathametics scientist ani manandariki telisina vishayame, nijaniki manalo chalamandiki anthavarake telusu. Kanee atani jeevitham ok dramatic story, Hospital Bed meeda padukoni oka taxi car number nundi Appatikappudu oka Kotha formula ni  kanipettina great and inspiring Ramanujan Jeevithamloni Mari konni visheshalanu ee Audiobook lo Vinandi

the-heart-to-start-stop-procrastinating-.title: Sofolotar Mul Mantra Jene Nin
the-heart-to-start-stop-procrastinating-.description: Safollo kono akoshik byapar na, eta amader monobhab. Sofolota amader nijeder opor nirbhorshil. Byarthotar por sofolota ashe. Sofolotar mul montro holo porisrom o ichya shokti. Sottikarer safollo holo kromagoto byarthotar por o driro monobol dhore rakha.

bharat-ke-mahan-sant.title: Bharat ke Mahan Sant
bharat-ke-mahan-sant.description: Bharat apni sabhyata aur mahan ituhaas ke liye jaana jaata hai. na jaane kitne santo aur mahapurushon is dharti par janam lekar iska uddhar kiya hai. Inke kashto, sangharso ki kahani se both lena bhi kismat ki baat maani jaati hai. Aaiye jaane in santo ki kahaniya aur chale parmarth ki raah par

விடைதேடும்-விபரீதங்கள்-Season--1.title: Vidai Thedum Vibareethangal
விடைதேடும்-விபரீதங்கள்-Season--1.description: சுவாமிஜி ஆத்மநாம் ஆசிரமத்தைச் சுற்றிலும்  அடுத்தடுத்து பல மரணங்கள் மர்மமான முறையில் நிகழ்கின்றன. கொலைகளுக்கான காரணங்களை விசாரிக்கும்போது பல பூதாகரமான உண்மைகள் வெளிவரத் தொடங்குகின்றன. உண்மையில் சுவாமிஜி ஆத்மநாம் என்பவர் யார்? அவருக்கும் அந்தக் கொலைகளுக்கும் என்ன தொடர்பு? மர்மங்களின் முடிச்சு அவிழ்ந்ததா?

maradona.title: Maradona
maradona.description: మారడోనా బాల్యంలో ఎదుర్కొన్న కష్టాలు మీకు తెలుసా? ఆయన కెరీర్ ఎలా మొదలయ్యింది? ప్రేరణ కల్పించే మారడోనా జీవిత కథ మీకోసం.

masti-badmash-company-2-1.title: Masti- Badmash Company 2
masti-badmash-company-2-1.description: Disney Bank lootne ke liye Dadua ki khas aurat Salina ne Masti, uski gang aur baki sab ke sath milkar taiyar kiya hai ek master plan, magar loot se pehle hi shuru ho gayi hai team mein hi jaalsaaji. Sabke liye mushkil hai bank se looti 500 crore ki rakam tak pahunchna. Dadua ke khauf mein Salina kar rahi hai gaddari magar gaddar to aur bhi hain, par kaun? Kaun hai ye Dadua aur kahan hai iska adda? Aakhir kahan gayi loot ki rakam aur kaise ho gaya sab golmal? Kya is case ko suljhane mein lagi police pahunch payegi Badmash Company tak? Aur kaun hoga is Badmash Company ka aakhiri zinda sardar?

che-guevara-2.title: Che Guevara
che-guevara-2.description: సాయుధ విప్లవం ద్వారా లాటిన్ అమెరికా మరియు ఇతర అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న దేశాలని  ఏకం చేయడమే అతని ఆశయం గా  బ్రతికిన వ్యక్తి ఎవరో తెలుసా?  స్వేచ్ఛ యొక్క చిహ్నంగా మారి ఒక ఖండం అంతటా మోటార్‌సైకిల్‌ పై ప్రయాణించిన ఆ  ఆడంబరమైన వ్యక్తి గురించి  తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

messi.title: MESSI
messi.description: ಲಿಯೋನೆಲ್ ಮೆಸ್ಸಿ...! ವಿಶ್ವದಾದ್ಯಂತ ಅಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಅಭಿಮಾನಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಗ್ರೇಟೆಸ್ಟ್ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್ ..! ಈತ ಮೈದಾನಕ್ಕಿಳಿದರೆ ನೋಡುಗರ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಹಬ್ಬ ... ಗೋಲ್ಗಾಗಿ ಈತ ಬಳಸುವ ಒಂದೊಂದ್ ಸ್ಕಿಲ್ಸ್ಗಳು ರೋಮಾಂಚಕ ..! ಬಾಲ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನ್ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಬಳಲುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಬಾಲಕ, ಮುಂದೆ ಜಗತ್ತು ಮೆಚ್ಚುವಂತಹ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್  ಆಟಗಾರನಾಗಿದ್ದು ಒಂದು ರೋಚಕ ಕಥೆ ! ಈ  ಕಥೆಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕು FM  ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ  'ಮೆಸ್ಸಿ 'ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್ ..!

dark-side-of-silicon-valley.title: The Dark Side of Silicon Valley
dark-side-of-silicon-valley.description: Har koi apni life main successful, ameer or famous hona chahta hai or kabhi kabhi ye chahat kae logon ko galat kam karne pae bhi majboor kardete hai. Iss audio main aap sunenge Elizabeth Holmes kae bare main jiss main successful hone kae sare gun the par patience nahi tha, tabhi jaldi ameer hone ki cha main unhone racha Silicone Valley ka sabse bada scam. Kya tha aisa scam, kaise thi unki journey or aj kahan hain Elizabeth Homes ye sab janne kae liye suneye The Dark Side of Silicone Valley.

how-to-move-to-us-for-studies-2.title: How To Move To US For Studies
how-to-move-to-us-for-studies-2.description: America vellalane korika manalo chalamandiki untundi. America lo chaduvukovalane korika entho mandi vidyarthulaku oka kala. Meeru kaani leda mee intlo evaraina America vellali anukuntunte meeku ee Audio book chaala upayogapaduthundi. Mari inkenduku alasyam ventane vinandi America vellandi.

indian-air-force.title: Indian Airforce
indian-air-force.description: Namma indiya vimaana padai oda sirappu amsangal enna, Namma perumai padra alavukku vimaana padai veerargal enna saadhanai padachurukaanga adhu mattum illa por kaalangal pathiyum share pannudhu indha audio book.

warren-buffett-ke-management-sootra.title: Warren Buffett Ke Management Sootra
warren-buffett-ke-management-sootra.description: Top 10 billionaires mein se ek Warren Buffet ke baare mein hum sab jante hi hai, ve na sirf ek Long Term Investor hai par ek unique business manager bhi hai. In dono hi roop mein Buffet ki safalta ka mool mantra hai Sahi vyavsaay ko chunna. Inke Business Management ke yahi gyaan ko hum janenge is audiobook mein jise likha hai Pradeep Thakur ne. Agar aapko The Warren Buffet Way naam ki kitab pasand hai to is audiobook ko zaroor sunein.

bharathan-effect.title: Bharathan Effect
bharathan-effect.description: Chila prathibhakale maranathinu polum tholppikkan kazhiyilla. Avarude Mahatwam varshangal kadannu pokumthorum vardhikkukaye ulu. Angane oral thanne anu Bharathan enna Mahaprathibha. Adhehathinu matram sadhikkunna aa Bharathan touch adhehathinte cinemakalile oro shot lum vyakthamanu. Athukondu thanneyanu Bharathane ennum Malayalikal miss cheyunathum. Etrayokke prathibhashalikal Malayala cinemakku sambhavichalum adhehathinte kasera ozhinju thanne kidakkum. Bharathaneyum adhehathinte cinemakaleyum oppam cinemayekkal nadakeeyamaya adhehathinte jeevithatheyum aduthariyam ‘Bharathan Effect’ enna audio bookilude.

all-marketer-are-liar.title: The Power of Storytelling in Marketing
all-marketer-are-liar.description: Aaj Market mein har ek product ki ek Story hai , Jo us product ki company dwara hi sabke samne lai jati hai aur uspar hum badi asani se believe karlete hain,fir us product ko kharid lete hai.  Isiliye successful Marketers kabhi bhi apne product ke features aur benefits ki baat nahi karte hain,vo toh bas us product ke piche ki ek story taiyaar karte hain aur use hi  sunate rehte hain. Ye Book summary aapko yahi btati hai ki aajke samay mein consumers ki asli demand kya hai. Toh agar aap ek Marketer hain ya fir Consumer, aap dono ke  liye hi ye janna behad jaruri hai.

how-cia-was-exposed.title: How CIA Was Exposed By Edward Snowden
how-cia-was-exposed.description: Is Edward Snowden a hero, a traitor, an informant, or a snitch? Public opinion on the former IT analyst has been split since his 2013 NSA leak. This particular series examines the Snowden scandal, detailing everything from the day he left his girlfriend in Hawaii to the weeks he spent spilling state secrets in Hong Kong, his fight for asylum, and his exile in Moscow while trying to figure out why it occurred, how it happened, and its consequences. If you want to understand domestic spying, national security, what Snowden's revelations mean for the United States and Russia, and what is at stake for all of us in the digital age, then this show is for you.

meditation-and-its-practice.title: Dhyaner Practice
meditation-and-its-practice.description: Anek gopon kaushal ebong dhyaner poddhoti gulir jonnyo guide hishebe lekha hoyeche. Ei boi ti te jog byam somporke tothyo dei, jar madhyome apni nijeke dhyan onushiloner songe porichoy korate paren. Hajar hajar bochor dhore ei dhyaner biggan sikkhar bishoy hoye utheche. Dhyan apnake apnar upsthit buddhi ebong dokkhota unnoto korar khomota debe. Sudhu matro dhyan emon kichu korte pare ja kono niyom ba poddhoti dara orjon kora jaye na. Ei shob byapare bistarito bhabe jante shune nin ei boi tir sarangsho.

business-success-ki-chabhi-hai-technolog.title: Business Mein Success Ki Chabi Hai Technology
business-success-ki-chabhi-hai-technolog.description: Aapka Business Chahe kisi bhi prakar ka ho Lekin Usko successful banane ke liye Sirf ek Chiz ki jarurat hoti hai , Aur Vo hai Technology. Aajke Yug mein Jaha lagatar Logon ke Andar patience ki kami hoti ja rahi hai , Toh Aese mein Technology ke sahare se hi har kam ko Minto mein kiya ja sakta hai. Aaj Internet ki Wajah se Kisi bhi tarah ke Business ko Duniya ke Kisi bhi kone tak pahuchaya ja sakta hai. Aur Ye Audiobook Hme Yahi Samjhati hai ki alag alag parakar ke business kaise technology ke chalte Badi Asani se Uchaiyon ko Chu Sakte hain.

agalyaavin-aayul-regai.title: அகல்யாவின் ஆயுள் ரேகை
agalyaavin-aayul-regai.description: திடிரென்று, ஒரு நாள் இரவு கோவை மாநகர் முழுவதும் ஒரு போஸ்டர் ஒட்டப்படுகிறது. அதில், ’அகல்யாவின் ஆயுள் ரேகை இனி வளருமா? இல்லை... தேயுமா?’ என்று எழுதப்பட்டிருந்தது. போஸ்டரின் இடது பக்க ஓரத்தில் வளையல் அணிந்த ஒரு பெண்ணின் கை வரையப்பட்டு அந்த உள்ளங்கையில் ஒரு கத்தி சொருகப்பட்டிருந்தது. போஸ்டரின் கீழ்ப்பகுதி முழுவதும் ரத்தத் துளிகள்... யார் அந்த அகல்யா? இந்த போஸ்டரை ஒட்டியது யார்?

cities-you-should-visit-before-you-die.title: Cities You Should Visit Before You Die
cities-you-should-visit-before-you-die.description: Jeevithathile ettavum manoharamaya sangathikalil onnanu yathrakal. Orikkalum Orikkalum boradikkatha paripadi. Orupad yathra cheyyan aagrahikkatha aaranu undavuka. Pala Rajyangal karangunnavare asooyayode nokkunnavaranu nammal. Ellavarkkum athinu pattillallo. Enkilum oro naadukale kurich ariyan namuk ishtamanu alle. Enkil varoo pettennu chuttiyadich varam.

adolf-hitler-1.title: Adolf Hitler
adolf-hitler-1.description: Austria Mein Janma Adolf Hitler Barah Varsho Tak Germany Ka Shashak Raha Aur Uske Hi Shashak Mein Dusre Vishv Yuddh Ki Shuruaat Hui Jisme Laakho Log Maare Gaye. Yahi Karan Hai Ki Aaj Tak Ke Itihass Mein Uski Ginti Sabse Dusht Vyatio Mein Ki Jaati Hai Aur Bisve Sadi Ke Issi Insaan Ke Baare Mein Bahut Hi Jane - Anjane Pehalu Aur Rahasyo Ke Baare Mein Hum Iss Audiobook Mein Janenge.

ಅನಂತ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.title: Anantha Rahasya
ಅನಂತ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.description: ಕೇರಳದ ಅನಂತಪದ್ಮನಾಭ ದೇವಾಲಯ..! ಅದೆಷ್ಟೋ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ತನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಬಚ್ಚಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡಿರುವ ದೇವಾಲಯವಿದು..! ಇಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನು ವಿಶ್ವದ ಚರಿತ್ರೆಯ ಪುಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇದುವರೆಗೆ ಯಾರೂ ಕಂಡಿರಲಿಕ್ಕಿಲ್ಲ..! ಆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಆ ಒಂದು ಕೋಣೆ ಇಂದಿಗೂ, ಈ ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ನಿಗೂಢ..! ಒಂದು ಅಂದಾಜಿನ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಒಂದು ಲಕ್ಷ ಕೋಟಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯಕ್ಕಿಂತಲೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನು ತನ್ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದೆಯಂತೆ! ಇಂತಹ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಕುರಿತು, ಅದರ ನಿಗೂಢತೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬೆಳಕು ಚೆಲ್ಲುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂ ಹೊತ್ತು ತಂದಿದೆ'ಅನಂತ ರಹಸ್ಯ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್...

how-to-prepare-for-upsc.title: How to Prepare for UPSC
how-to-prepare-for-upsc.description: Indian youngsters pala peroda kanavu UPSC exams ah crack panradhu dhan. Indha process la pala struggles irukum. Idhellam epdi easy ah tackle pannanum, endha time la enna syllabus cover pannanum, leisure time ah epdi use pannanum pondra pala tips ah therinjuka kelunga “How to prepare for UPSC”on Kuku FM

air-india-1.title: Air India
air-india-1.description: Haal Hi Mein Air India Ki Ghar Vapisi Hui Hai Aur Duniyabhar Ki Nazarein Tiki Hui Hai Tata Group Par, Har Koi Is Waqt Soch Raha Hai Ki Kya Air India ko Wapis Indian Aviation Industry Mein Wahi Muqam Mil Payega Jo JRD Tata Ki Leadership Ke Daurana Air India Ke Pass Hua Karta Tha? Chaliye Kuch Waqt Peeche Chal Kar Air India Ki Kahani Ko Shuru Se Sunte Aur Samjhte Hain Saath Hi Jaante Hain Kyu Aur Kab Bani Tata Airlines Air India?

how-to-study-in-abroad.title: How to Study In Abroad
how-to-study-in-abroad.description: విదేశాలకు వెళ్ళి చదవాలంటే ఉండవలసిన అర్హతలేంటి? మన దేశంలో బ్యాంకు లు ఎటువంటి సహకారాలు అందిస్తున్నాయి? మీ విదేశీ కల నిజమవ్వాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే

1947-ke-baad-ka-bharat.title: 1947 Ke Baad Ka Bharat
1947-ke-baad-ka-bharat.description: Bharat ko Azaad huye 70 se zyada saal ho chuke hain aur 1947 se lekar ab tak bahut lamba safar teh kiya hai hamaare desh ne. Is Kitaab 1947 ke Baad Ka Bharat mein aapko Swantantra Bharat ki har Major Ghatna ki Soochi Year-wise Praapt Hogi. Aisi Aisi cheezein apne desh ke baare mein jo shayad aapne kabhi kahin padhi suni nhi hongi. Ayiye Suniye Yeh Audio Book SIrf KukuFM Par.

rani-rudrama-devi.title: Rani Rudrama Devi
rani-rudrama-devi.description: Male domination ni edhirinchi 30 years successful ga kakatteya samrajyanni rule chesina Rani Rudramadevi childhood nundi , Pelli, friendship, vennupotu, wars, ila vivida visheshalatho koodina tana jeevitha charitranu ee audiobook lo vinandi.

the-heartfulness-way-3.title: The Heartfulness Way
the-heartfulness-way-3.description: Jokhon Aamra Jiboner Aasol Mane Bujhe Jai Tokhon Jibon Anek Sohoj Hoye Jay. Konodin Vebe Dekhechen Ekjon Sadhur Kache Kichu Na Thekeo Kivabe Tar Kache Sobkichu Aache? Karon Tara Jiboner Mane Hyoto Khuje Peye Gechen. Bondhura Aapnarao Jodi Jibonke Onyovabe Chaliye Jiboner Mane Khunje Pete Chan Tahole Aapnake Ei Audiobook Anekta Help Korbe Heartfulness Er Concept Bojhar Jonyo Ebong Meditation Er Moddhey Diye Kivabe Relux Thaka Jay Ebon Moner Vitorer Sob Jonjal Porishkar Kora Jay. Tahole Aar Deri Kiser, Shuru Kora Jak.

getting-to-yes.title: Negotiation Se Safal Banein
getting-to-yes.description:
Ghaate Ko Munaafe Mein Chahate Hain Badlna To zaroori Hai Ye Show Sunna.
Aapne kabhi Negotiation yani mool-bhaav kiya hai? Kiya hi hoga.Ya apni mummy ko sabji wale se ya market mein karte dekha hoga. Kabhi baat ban jaati hai aur kabhi- kabhi nahin banti. Isi na banne wali baat aur aapko ghata khane se bachane ke liye hi to hum laaye hain aapke liye "Negotiation Se Safal Banein". Jismen aapko batayeinge Negotiation ke best tareeqe aur kuch aisi tips ki saamne wali party aapki Deal ko na nahin bol payegi.

avishwasaneeyamaya-narabalikal.title: Avishwasaneeyamaya Narabalikal
avishwasaneeyamaya-narabalikal.description: Oru naadine muzhuvan nadukkiya kolapaathakam! Anthavishwasathinte peril randu sthreekale moovar sangham arumkola cheythuvennu ulkollan eniyum kazhinjitila Kerala samoohathinu. Samoohyaparamayi munnilanennu ahangarikkunna nattilanu enganeyoru heena krityam nadanathu. Ennal ethu Keralathi nadakunna etharathilulla aadya kolapathakam alla. ‘Avishwasaneeyamaya Narabalikal’ enna audio bookilude Elanthooril Roselin, Padmam ennivarkku enthanu sambhavichathennum, Shafi, Laila, Bhagaval Singh ennivar enthinanu etharamoru krooramaya vazhi thiranjeduthathennum ariyam.

ravichandran-ashwin.title: Ravichandran Ashwin
ravichandran-ashwin.description: Namma Tamil nadu oda suzhal king Ashwin pala thadaigalai thaandi cricket ulagula pala saathanaigalai pannirukaaru. Avaroda intha vetri paathaiyai intha pathivula pinnokki paakalaam. Namma Ash oda kathaiyai kekka ready aah makkale ?

cases-that-india-forgot.title: The Cases that India Forgot
cases-that-india-forgot.description: I will see you in court.....yeh woh chand shabd hai, jise nyay pe bharosa rakhne wale sabhi insaan ne kabhi na kabhi kaha hoga. Kyunki humara constitution hi India ke sabhi citizen ke rights ko protect karta hai. Halanki jab constitution bana tab isme kayi loopholes the. Unhi challenges mein aise cases shamil hai, jisne na sirf Supreme Court ko, balki pure India ko uss law ke against sochne par majbur kar diya tha. Unhi kuch cases ke baare mein janenge hum iss audiobook mein.  Agar aapko "India after Gandhi" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

money-wise-1.title: Money Wise
money-wise-1.description: Ningal investment thudangan plan cheyyunundengil, ee pusthakam ningalkkullathanu. Alla, ningal ithinakam already investments thudangiya vyakthi aanengil, ee pusthaka samgraham kelkunnathiloode ningalude financial status mechapeduthan saadhikkum.

spb-the-legend.title: SPB - The Legend
spb-the-legend.description: Ethana Emotions ! Ethana Paadalgal ! Inbamo.. Thunbamo.. Vazhkaiyin ella emotions kum ivaroda pattu iruku 'nga ! Paatukku Thalaivan naa adhu  namma S.P.B thaanga , 16 Languages la Ivar paaduna motha paadalgal 40,000 ! Adengappa nu nammala aacharya pada vaikkum oru asaathiya paatu kalaignan Ivaru. Vaanga Intha Pathivu la Paattu Thalaivan S.P.B in Cinema Sagaptha ‘tha therinjukalam.

tribe.title: A Guide to Effective Leadership
tribe.description: Ek Company Ya Community ko successful hone ke liye Humesha  ek acche leader ki zaroorat hoti hai. Aur ye zaroori nahi ki Leader wahi ho jisne us Group ko banaya ho. Hum sab leader ban sakte hain. Lekin humein koi banayega nahi balki uske liye humein Leadership ki Qualities ko apne andar develope karna hoga aur lead karne ki ek choti si opportunity ko bhi miss nahi karna hoga. Aur agar aapko ye lag raha hai ki ye sirf Aasan lagta hai lekin aeysa krna kaafi jyada mushkil hai toh abhi Suniye KUKU FM ki ye Audibook. Kyuki ye humein Sikhati hai ki agar aapke andar leadership ka passion hai toh aajke  modern world mein aapko leader banne se koi nahi rok sakta.

gst-explained-3.title: GST Explained
gst-explained-3.description: Since its implementation in 2017, GST has had an impact on almost every citizen of India. But it is no ordinary tax. There are several aspects of GST such as Supply, Input Tax Credit, IGST for inter-state trade, the Business Processes like Registration, Returns-filing, etc., along with associated subjects like Composition Levy, Reverse, Charge Mechanism, and many more. This special series aims to empower listeners with every little detail about GST as well as its impact on various economic groups and applications in various sectors. Get all the information and details about GST with this enlightening series.

volodya-story-of-putin.title: Putin - A Spy Turned President
volodya-story-of-putin.description: Who exactly is Vladimir Putin? As the world grapples with a more assertive Russia, understanding the formidable and ambitious Vladimir Putin has never been more important. On the one hand, Putin's numerous domestic reforms have contributed to the reshaping of millions of Russians' potential. On the other hand, Putin has created a new authoritarianism that is unyielding in its repression of criticism as well as a political and military assertion in places like Crimea and the Middle East. This exclusive series tells the story of Putin's rise to power while also looking back at his childhood in Leningrad, his rise through the ranks of the KGB, and his eventual consolidation of power in the Kremlin. Listen to the mind-boggling life story of the man who earned the monicker of 'Universal Ruler' from the people of his country.

be-your-own-sunshine.title: Be Your Own Sunshine
be-your-own-sunshine.description: Samay ke sath aage kaun nahi badhna chahta, lekin aage badhne ke liye, insaan ko kayi chizon se ladna padta hai. Jiske kayi tarike hai, aur inhi tarikon ko chaar alag alag kitaabein mein bataya gaya hai.Inki sikh, zindagi mein agar amal ki gayi toh humari zindagi mein roshni bharne wala aur koi nahi, hum khud honge. Unhi kitaabon ka saar milega humein ek kitaab mein, jiska naam hai Be your own Sunshine. Iss audiobook mein diye gaye moral ke adhaar aur bataye gaye tarikon se hum apne jivan ko vyavsthit, insightful aur balance kar sakte hai.

ವಿಶ್ವಮಾನವ-ಕುವೆಂಪು.title: Vishwamanava Kuvempu
ವಿಶ್ವಮಾನವ-ಕುವೆಂಪು.description: ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷೆ ಅಂತಾ ಬಂದಾಗ ನಮಗೆ ಅದೆಷ್ಟು ಆತ್ಮೀಯತೆ, ಅಭಿಮಾನ ಮೂಡುತ್ತೆ ಅಲ್ವಾ.! ಕನ್ನಡ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಬರಿ ಭಾಷೆ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಕೇವಲ ಹೆಸರೂ ಅಲ್ಲ.. ಅದೊಂದು ಮಂತ್ರ, ಶಕ್ತಿ, ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ತಾಯಿ.. ಕನ್ನಡದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮಾತಾಡ್ವಾಗ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆನೂ ಮಾತಾಡ್ಲೇಬೇಕು.. ಅವರು ಕನ್ನಡಕ್ಕೆ ಕನ್ನಡದ್ದೇ ಆದ ಸಾತ್ವಿಕ ತಾಕತ್‌ ಇದೆ ಅಂತಾ ಸಾಧಿಸಿ ತೋರಿಸಿದವ್ರು.. ಅಲ್ಪ ಮಾನವನನ್ನ ವಿಶ್ವ ಮಾನವನನ್ನಾಗಿಸೊ ಕನಸು ಕಂಡವ್ರು, ಅವರೇ ಕುವೆಂಪು.! ಕನ್ನಡದ ಮೊದಲುಗಳು ಅಂತಾ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಹೋದಾಗ ಅದೆಷ್ಟು ಕಡೆ ಕುವೆಂಪು ಅವ್ರು ಬರ್ತಾರೆ.? ಅವ್ರ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಸೋ, ಆರಾಧಿಸೋ ಮಂದಿ ಇವತ್ತಿಗೂ ಅದೆಷ್ಟು ಜನ ಸಿಕ್ತಾರೆ.? ದಶಕ ದಶಕಗಳೆ ಉರುಳಿದ್ರು ಅವರು ಹೇಳಿರೋ ವೈಚಾರಿಕತೆಯ ಪಾಠ ಇನ್ನೂ ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಕಿವಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಮೊಳಗ್ತಿದೆ.? ಕೇಳಿ 'ವಿಶ್ವಮಾನವ ಕುವೆಂಪು' ಆಡಿಯೋ‌ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ 'ಕುಕು ಎಫ್‌ಎಂ'ನಲ್ಲಿ

shivaji-ke-management-sutra.title: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaja Ke Management Sutra
shivaji-ke-management-sutra.description: Aaj ke competitive world mein agar koi businessman nahi ban sakta, to use ya to leader banna padega ya phir administrator ya manager. Is drishti se hum iss audiobook mein samjhenge Shivaji Maharaj ke management sutra ko jinke safal management ne hume azad kiya. Unke bataye management sutra aaj bhi utne hi relevant aur influencing hai aur aaj ke samay mein bhi hum uska upyog kar sakte hai

banglar-local-trainer-itibritto.title: Banglar Local Trainer Itibritto
banglar-local-trainer-itibritto.description: Local Train Aamader Jiboner Songe Otoprotovabe Joriye Aache. Sokale School, College, Office Jayoya Theke Shuru Kore Ek Shrenir Uparjoner Prodhan Madhyom Hocche Ei Local Train. Kotoi Na Kando Dekha Jay Ei Local Traine Uthle. Aaj Aamra Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye Jene Nebo Local Train Er Chaka Kobe,  Kivabe Cholte Shuru Korlo Banglay, Echrao Aaro Nana Jana-Ajana Golpo. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak.

rani-ahilya-bai-the-forgotten-queen.title: Rani Ahilyabai - The Forgotten Queen
rani-ahilya-bai-the-forgotten-queen.description: Rani Ahilyabai is a name that every Indian associate with reverence. Though she departed a long time ago, she lives on in our hearts because of her dedicated service to humanity. She was a Lady who, in every way, was ahead of her time, who abandoned the false attachment of snobbery and strived to do justice until her last breath. This series is a humble attempt to explore the journey of the woman who etched a special place in history not only through her altruistic work but also through her unparalleled developmental work. We will try to learn not only about her benevolence as a ruler but also about her vision, her strategies, and her policies. Witness the remarkable life story of the greatest Maratha queen, fondly referred to as 'Devi.'

universe-in-a-nutshell.title: Universe Ko Crack Karo
universe-in-a-nutshell.description: Bachpan se Aapke man me bhi aasman ko dekhkar ye sawal aata hi hoga ki kaise bana hai hamara universe? Tare kya hote hain? Prithvi kyu ghoomti hai etc. Aur in sab sawalon ke jawab mile aapko Science mein. Lekin abhi bhi universe se jude bahut se jawab aap ko nahin pata honge isiliye to hum aapke liye laaye hain Decoding Universe  ki book summary. To fir aaiye, jaante hain apne sawalon ke jawab.

amirtham-endraal-visham-1.title: அமிர்தம் என்றால் விஷம்
amirtham-endraal-visham-1.description: அடுத்தடுத்து ஆறு பேர் கொலை செய்யப்படுகிறார்கள். ஆறுபேரின் உடலிலுமே அமிர்தம் என்றால் விஷம் என்று பச்சை குத்தப்பட்டிருக்கிறது. இந்த ஆறு பேரையும் கொலை செய்தவன் யார்? அதற்கான காரணங்கள் என்ன? கேளுங்கள்... அமிர்தம் என்றால் விஷம்..!

ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ-ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳು.title: Karnataka Samrajyagalu
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ-ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳು.description: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ... ಈ ಹೆಸರೇ ರೋಮಾಂಚಕ..! ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಕಾಲದಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು, ಇಂದಿನ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಸರ್ಕಾರಗಳವರೆಗೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಎನ್ನುವುದು ಇಡೀ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಅಚ್ಚರಿಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರಬಿಂದು. ಕರುನಾಡಿನ ಈ ನೆಲ ಹಲವು ಪಲ್ಲಟಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡಿದೆ, ಹಲವು ಸಾಧನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮೆರೆದಿದೆ. ಭವ್ಯಾತಿಭವ್ಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದೆ. ಇಂತಹ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಕರುನಾಡನ್ನು ಆಳಿದ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಳೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳು' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

share-market-shabdakosh.title: Share Market Shabdakosh
share-market-shabdakosh.description: Kya aapke sath bhi aisa hota hai ki aapke kuch dost share market ke baare men baat karte hain aur aap bas unke bade bade angreji ke shabdon ko sunte reh jate hain. Abse aisa nahi hoga kyuki hum leke aaye hain aapke liye "Share Market Shabdkosh" ki Audiobook. Chaliye hamare saath gyan ki is audiobook mein dubki lagaate hain aur apne share market Shabdakosh ko badhate hain.

article-370-2.title: Article 370
article-370-2.description: Ee Audio book lo Jammu & Kashmir Rajyangamloni Arictle 370 Gurinchi poorthi Vivaraalu, Inka Jammu Rajyangamloni Interesting facts, Inka Article 370 cancel labhalu, nashtalu inka Indian Government enduku ee Article ni raddu chesindi Ane poorthi vivaralu ee Audio book lo meeru telusukovachhu.

the-burari-death-case.title: Sunday Thriller Stories: The Burari Death Case
the-burari-death-case.description: 1st July 2018 ek mormantrik ghotona e akranto hoi Delhi sohorer Burari onchol. Shei din shob kichu swabhabik holeo swabhabik chilo na shei diner sokal. Ek gogon bhedi attochitkar tochnoch kore dei Delhi sohorer ghum. Ei golpo kono mon gora, roopkothar golpo noi. Ei golpe jei poribarer kotha bola hochhe tara chilo ottontyo sukhi ek poribarer. Ki hoyechilo sei din ei poribarer songe ar kenoi ba ghotechilo ei ghotona, ei shob jante shune nin Sunday Thriller Stories-Er ei Audio Show.

microsoft-success-story.title: Microsoft Success Story
microsoft-success-story.description: Yeh Kahani Hai Bill Gates Aur Unke Dost Paul Allen Ki Jinke Computer Ke Prati Prem Aur Junoon Ne Ek Multinational Company Ko Established Kiya Jiska Naam Hai Microsoft .Aur Computer ki Duniya mein ek naya Evolution Create Kiya.lekin Kya Apni Soch Ko Sach Banane Ka Bill Gates aur Unke Dost Ka Yeh Safar Asaan Raha? Aur kyun Baad mein Paul Allen ne Microsoft se Naata Tod Diya ? Yeh Sab Jaanege Aap Is Audiobook “Microsoft Success Story” mein Sirf Kuku FM Par.

money-wise.title: Money Wise
money-wise.description: Panam sambathika yaaruku dhan pudikathu? Ulagathulaye romba easy aana vishayam panam sambathikiradhu dhan nu sonna pala per kovam kooda pada vaaipu iruku. Yen na nammal la pala per ku panatha epdi save pannanum, evlo productive ah invest pannanum nu endha techniques um theriyadhu. Idhellam therinjukittu overnight la epdi Obama aagalam nu solli thara book dhan “Money wise”.

education-system.title: Indian Education System : Beginning and Development
education-system.description: Sabse bada daan shiksha daan....yeh slogan bhale adhunik ho, lekin hum Indians iss slogan ko itihaas se hi follow kar rahe hai. Tabhi to duniya ko zero se lekar trignometry tak sab kuch humne hi diya hai. Yahi nahi, humare granthon mein universe ko lekar jo baatein batayi gayi hai, usse ab NASA jaise bade research centre bhi sahi maan rahe hai. Toh agar humara education system shuruaat se hi itna strong raha hai, phir aakhir kyun aaj duniya ki top literate countries mein India ka naam nahi hai? Kya iski wajah humari gheesi-petti policies hai? Agar nahi, toh India Education system mein kya-kya badlav aaye hai? Janne ke liye suniye humari yeh audiobook.

che-guevara-1.title: Che Guevara
che-guevara-1.description: Argentina la rendu vishayam romba famous. Onnu Football. Innonnu Che Guevara. Che apdina nanban nu artham. Unmai dhan. Che Guevara indha motha ulagathukum oru nanban ah pola dhan irundhar .Innum irukkar. Argentina la pirandhu Cuba makkalukkaga poraduna Che, pinnal la epdi ulagame kondaadura oru thalaivan ah aanaru nu therinjuka kelunga “Che Guevara - Originals” on Kuku FM

simple-marketing-plans-for-small-busines.title: Simple Marketing Plans For Small Businesses
simple-marketing-plans-for-small-busines.description: Tharamaana Product and service ungakitta irundhaalum kooda Marketing correct ta illainaa business dull aaidum !  Unga Kitta irukkura porul allathu sevaiya sariyaana customers tta kondu serthu avangala vaanga vaikkiradhukkaana oru seyal thittatha uruvaakkuradhukkaana step by step vazhimuraigal la intha audio series la neenga kathuka poreenga ! Ungaloda thozhilukku Etra mathiri oru Marketing Plan na amaikiradhu eppadi nu intha pathivu la therinjukonga. Unga Business success adaiya KUKU FM in anbana Vazhthukkal.

pro-kabaddi.title: Indian Kabaddi League
pro-kabaddi.description: Kabaddi India ka sadiyo purana Game, jise aaj kal ki young genration bhulti ja rahi thi. Isko jarurat thi to naye look ki, naye naam ki, naye platform ki jo ise Pro Kabaddi League yani PKL ke jariye. PKL India ka IPL ke baad sabse jyada dekhe jane vala game hai. Teams divided hai, Celebraties jud chuke hai or iska market bahut baa ho chuka hai. Isi Popularity ke chalte ham aapke liye lekar aaye Kabadi Kabaddi yani full masti vale Game ki complete series.

soviet-union-rise-and-fall.title: Soviet Union: Rise And Fall
soviet-union-rise-and-fall.description: 1917il nadanna Russian Viplavathinteyum 1918 muthal 21 vare nadanna aabhyanthara kalapangaludeyum falamayi Tsar chakravarthiye adhikarathil ninnu purathakki roopam konda Socialist Republickalude koottaymayanu Soviet Union. Lokacharithrathil Samanathakal illatha socialist mathruka pakarnnu nalki 1991ode Soviet Union thakarukayum Vikhadich Swanthanthra rashtrangal aavukayum cheythu.

malabar-rebellion.title: Malabar Rebellion
malabar-rebellion.description: Indian Swanthanthrya samara charithrathil samanathakal illatha viplava porattamaanu Malabar Kalapam. Malabarile adhinivesha virudha poraattangalile thilangunna edanith. Thaazhnna Jathiyil petta daridra karshakarum karshika vrithiyil erppettirunna Malabarile muslingalkkum nikuthiyude peril valiya chooshanangal neridendi vannu. Ithu Kalapathinu vazhivechu.

dil-beparwah-2.title: Dil Beparwah
dil-beparwah-2.description: 3 saal baad Aarohi Delhi loutti hai. Bridge pe vo ek ajnabi ko khudkhushi karne se bacha leti hai. Tabhi 3 gunde vahan aa jata hain. Agle din Aarohi ki neend khulti hai to vo khudko us ajnabi ke bistar par paati hai. Kya mahanga padega Aarohi ko, is ajnabi ki jaan bachana? Aakhir kaisi uthal puthal hai ye Aarohi ki zindgi me, jaane ke liye sunte rahiye Dil Bepahwah

karupu-vaanavil.title: கருப்பு வானவில்
karupu-vaanavil.description: தந்தை இல்லாத அரவிந்த்தான் குடும்பத்தின் தூண். கல்லூரிப் படிப்பை முடித்து வேலை தேடி ஒரு பெரிய நிறுவனத்துக்கு இண்டர்வியூக்குச் செல்கிறான். அவனுக்கு வேலை கிடைத்துவிடுகிறது. ஆனால், ஒரு நிபந்தனை. மிஸ் இந்தியா பட்டம் பெற்ற பெண்ணைக் கொலை செய்ய வேண்டும் என்பதே! அந்தக் கொலையை அரவிந்த் செய்தானா? காதலும், கிரைமும் கலந்த ஒரு சரிவிகிதக் கலவைதான் இந்தக் 'கருப்பு வானவில்...'

how-to-stay-fit-in-our-busy-life-2.title: How to stay fit in our busy LIFE ?
how-to-stay-fit-in-our-busy-life-2.description: Machine maathiri odittu irukka intha busy life la nammala fit aah vachukka enna pannanumnu therinjukanumaa ? Intha Audio pathivu ungalai day to day fit aah vachikka panna vendiya workout pathiyum mental health pathiyum thaan. Enna makkale aaramikalaama ?

the-daily-stoic-ryan-holiday-and-stephen.title: Meditation Tricks For Self Analysis
the-daily-stoic-ryan-holiday-and-stephen.description: Hamari aaj kal ki modern lifestyle thodi si difficult hai aur thodi si mazedaar. Bilkul ek roller coaster ki tarah jisme maza bhi aata hai aur dar bhi lagta hai. Lekin ab is ride mein ghabraane ki zaroorat nhin hai. Bilkul bhi nhi. Kyun ki hum aapke liye laaye hain “Meditation Tricks For Self Analysis” kitab. jo batayegi apko ki kaise apne dar se paayein nizaat. To chaliye sunte hain.

dinesh-karthik-the-comeback-king-2.title: Dinesh Karthik : The Comeback King
dinesh-karthik-the-comeback-king-2.description: Idu obba cricket aatagaarana kathe.! Badukalli sothu sothu geddavana kathe.! aa cricket aatagaara 2004ralli India para modala match aadtaare. 2007ralli T20 vishwacup gedda tandadalloo irtaare. Ade aatagaara 15 varshagala nanthra matthondu vishwa cup aadthare. Munde Cricket bittu commentator aagthare. Adre chala bidada aa aatagara matte kreedanganadalli gharjisutthiro pari idiyalla, adu prathiyobbara manasalli visheshavada sthana padedide. Naavu heloke horatiro story yardu gotta.? Keli 'Dinesh Karthik : The Comeback King' Audio book. Nimma KukuFM nalli.!

story-of-indias-2007-t20-cricket-world-c.title: Story of India's 2007 T20 Cricket World Cup Victory
story-of-indias-2007-t20-cricket-world-c.description: ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಇಂದು ಕೇವಲ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರೀಡೆಯಾಗಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿದಿಲ್ಲ, ಅದು ಒಂದು ಎಮೋಶನ್ ಆಗಿ ಬದಲಾಗಿದೆ! ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಟೀಂ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಗೆದ್ದರೆ ಖುಷಿಯಿಂದ ಕುಣಿದು ಕುಪ್ಪಳಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಸೋತರೆ ಬಿಕ್ಕಿ ಬಿಕ್ಕಿ ಕಣ್ಣೀರಿಡುತ್ತೇವೆ! ಇದು ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಅನ್ನೋ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಆಟಕ್ಕಿರುವ ಶಕ್ತಿ! ಇಂತಹ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್, 2007ರಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತೀಯರಿಗೆ ನೋವು-ನಲಿವು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿತು. ಭಾರತ ಯಾವ ವರ್ಷ ಏಕದಿನ ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೋತು ಅವಮಾನ ಅನುಭವಿಸಿತೋ, ಅದೇ ವರ್ಷ T20 ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್ ಗೆದ್ದು ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಬರೆದಿತು! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು ಆ ರೋಚಕ ವಿಶ್ವ ಸಮರ? ಧೋನಿಯ ಯೋಜನೆ ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ಸೆಂಟರ್ ಆಫ್ ಅಟ್ರಾಕ್ಷನ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಆ ಪಂದ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಿಂಚಿದ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗನ ಆಟ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಯುವರಾಜ್ ಸಿಂಗ್ ಸಿಡಿಸಿದ ಆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಆರು ಸಿಕ್ಸರ್‌ಗಳು ಯಾವ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದವು?  ಎಲ್ಲದರ ಉತ್ತರ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ! ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಗಳ ಫೆವರಿಟ್ 'Story of India's 2007 T20 Cricket World Cup Victory'  ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ! ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFM ನಲ್ಲಿ! 🎧🔥

bundelkhand-ke-agradoot.title: Martial Arts Champion Bruce Lee
bundelkhand-ke-agradoot.description: Jeet Kune Do Ke Founder Ke Naam Se Jaane Jaane Wale Bruce Lee Jo Bachpan Mein Ek Professional Dancer Banna Chahte The Unhe Zindagi Kisi Aur Muqaam Pe Lekar Jana Chahti Thi. Apne Kaam Se Duniya Ko Apna Fan Bnane Ke Baad 32 Saal Ki Kam Umar Mein Unhone Duniya Ko Alwida Keh Diya, Lekin Aaj Bhi Wo Apne Fans Ke Dilon Mein Zinda Hain. Chaliye Sunte Hain Bruce Lee Ke Shangharsh Se Shikhar Tak Pohanchane Ki Kahani.

virat-kohli-1.title: Virat Kohli
virat-kohli-1.description: Modern-day cricketile ettavum mikachcha thaarangalil oraalanu Virat Kohli. Thante dedicationum, hardworkum kondu oraalkk consistently ettavum best performances kaazhchavekkan sadhikumenn prove cheytha aadhyatha batsman orupakshe adheham aayirikum. Kelkaam, Cricket lokathu valiya aaradhaka pinthuna ulla Viratine kurichch.

volodya.title: Volodya - Story of Putin
volodya.description: Volodya ek aisa Soviet shabd hai jiska meaning hota hai "Sabka Raja" , jo use hota hai Russian President Vladimir Putin ke liye, jo apne decisions ke liye pure world me famous hai , chaliye sunte hai kahani ek gareeb pariwar me janme ladke ki jo ek khatarak Spy ban gaya , aur fir waqt ke palatne se Mayor se Russian President ban gaya. deepavali-sambaralu.description: దీపావళి పండుగ ఎందుకు జరుపుకుంటారు? దీపావళి నాదే బాణాసంచా ఎందుకు కాలుస్తారు? ఈ పండుగ యొక్క విశేషాల సమాహారం మీకోసం.

nano-the-forgotten-car.title: Nano - The Forgotten Car
nano-the-forgotten-car.description: India me aapne baar baar ye nazara dekha hoga ke ek bike par 5 jan ki family jaa rahi hai , aisa he ek scene Padma Vibhushan Ratan Tata ne bhi dekha tha aur decide kar liya ke indian family ke liye Tata motors ek aisi car design karenge jo sabse sasti hogi. Nano ka naam india ke logo ko to kya Us Precident Barak Obama ko bhi pata tha. to chaliye jante hai nano ki making , planning aur wo galtiya jinki waje se aaj nano ka production bandh ho gaya aur kya Nano wapis india ke rasto par ayegi?

யாதரிய--காதல்.title: யாதறியா காதல்
யாதரிய--காதல்.description: தன் கணவனால் ஏமாற்றப்பட்ட கதாநாயகி தேசத் துரோக வழக்கில் கைது செய்யப்படுகிறாள். அவளை விசாரிக்க வரும் அதிகாரி அவளை ஒரு தலையாகக் காதலித்தவன். செய்யாத குற்றத்துக்காக சிறையில் அடைக்கப்பட்டுள்ள தன் தோழியை எப்படிக் காப்பாற்றப் போகிறான்?

thol-thirumavalavan.title: Thol Thirumavalavan
thol-thirumavalavan.description: Makkal pani apdinrathu romba sulabamaana velai kidaiyaathu. Athai seirathukku nalla manasum, samoodathai purinjukura aatralum venum. Dr. Thol Thirumavalavan avargal makkalukkaga senja mahathaana sevaigal patriyum avar kadanthu vantha arasiyal paathai patriyum intha pathivula theliva paakkalam.

greatest-rivalries-in-cricket.title: Greatest Rivalries in Cricket
greatest-rivalries-in-cricket.description: Kisi bhi Sport mein Cricket jaisi baat nahi hai. Early 1880s se Lekar Aaj tak Cricket ne Jis Tarah se audience ko apne sath joda hua hai, vo koi aur sport nahi kar paya hai. Aur iska ek karan Cricket ko khelne wali Teams aur Players ke beech ki Rivalry bhi hai. Ye Audiobook Sunke aapko cricket ki kuch aise hi Greatest Rivalries ke bare mein Pata chalne wala hai , jinko janne ke baad Cricket mein aap ki dilchaspi aur bhi jyada badh jayegi.

indira-gandhi-1.title: Indira Gandhi
indira-gandhi-1.description: India voda Irumbu Penmani aana Indira Gandhi thannoda vaalkaiyila kadanthu vantha paathaiyai therinjukka intha pathivu ungalukku uthaviyaa irukkum. Avangaloda Arasiyal vaalkai, thayiriyamana mudivugal, saamarthiyamaana thittangal, ethirkonda vimarsanangal ellathayum unga sevigalukku samarpikkum muyarchi thaan ithu. Vaanga Varalatru payanathai thodangalam.

how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.title: How to make Money with Breakout Trading
how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.description: Trading la laabathai nokki ellarum oduvaanga, But Nastathai eppadi samaalikkanum nu ungalukku yaarachu solirukkangalaa ? Intha book summary la romba saamarthiyamaana muraiyila trading panrathukkana pala valigalai ungalukkaga naan kondu vanthurukkom. Trading panrapo neenga follow panna vendiya sila mukkiyamana self rules pathi kettu therinjikalam vanga.

simple-technique-writing.title: Simple techniques to boost writing, learning and thinking
simple-technique-writing.description: Hum kai baar apneaap ko communication ya likhawat mein kamzor paate hai. Kya koi jhatpat tarkeeb hai jisse hum sudhar laa sake? Bilkul nahi, there is no shortcut to success. Magar smartly hum apne aap mein communication ko leke chhote choote sudhar laa sakte hai. Kaise? Aaiye janein. Agar aapko "Bird by Bird" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

the-world-for-sale.title: Byabsha Sonkranto Shob Kichu Jene Nin
the-world-for-sale.description: Jug je bhabe egiye choleche tai mone hoto amra anek ta pichiye ar duniya egiye choleche, ei shob e chilo lekhok der moner bhaab. Amader ogrogotir pechone mul kandari kintu prokriti. Poribortoner songe palla diye kadhe kadh miliye palla diyeche amader bigyan. Amra ekhon egiye giyeche eto tai je duniya ekhon hater muthoy. Byabsha sonkranto bhoy katate ei sarangsho ti sune nin

all-about-cartoons.title: All About Cartoons
all-about-cartoons.description: Cartoons patriya varalaru matrum suvarasyamana thagavalgal la thoguthu valangura oru interesting gaana pathivu dhaan “All About Cartoons”. Kuzhanthaigal Cartoons pakalama? Idhu varai edukappatta cartoon movies la all time favourite ta irukura 10 movies edhu? Cartoons thuraiyil velai vaipugal matrum adharkana padippugalum enna? ippadi cartoons sambandhamana pala thagavalgal la therinjukka indha padhiva kelunga !

the-speed-of-trust-by-stephen-r.title: Positive Effects of Trusting People Around You
the-speed-of-trust-by-stephen-r.description: Is baat se koi inkaar nahi kar sakta ki duniya sirf bharose aur vishawas par chal rhai hai, Chahe hum kisi rishtey ki baat karen, Kisi team, Pariwar ya is Desh ki he baat kar lijiye sabkuch bharose pe he to chal rha hai, Aur shayad bharosa he hata diya jae to sab  kuch ek pal me bikhar sakta hai aur is Audio Book " Positive Effects of Trusting People Around You" mein hume inhe chezoo par discuss Kiya hai, Ki aap kaise kisi par bharosa kar sakte hain, kaise kisi ka bharosa Jeet Sakte hain aur aapko aise kon kon se habits apnani chahiye jisse log aap par bharosa kare. Aur sath he sath us bharose ko kaise barkarar rakhna hai un sabke bare mein zikar hai is Audio show mein. Agar aapko "The Secret - The Power" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

tips-and-tricks-to-handle-newborn-babies.title: Tips And Tricks To Handle Newborn Baby
tips-and-tricks-to-handle-newborn-babies.description: It is both terrifying and exciting to become a parent. You'll have a million questions, from how to feed your kid to what to expect in terms of growth and what vaccines the baby needs. It's easy to become overwhelmed. 'Helpful advice' is frequently confusing, and the internet can be a cause of panic. However, parenting is mostly learning on the job, and a little help goes a long way.. Through this series, we aim to help thousands of parents who struggle with these questions and help them figure out the correct ways of handling their bundle of joy. Each episode is dedicated to basics such as sleep, breastfeeding, common ailments, parenting styles, and more. Make baby-rearing fun with this show.

wework.title: The Epic Rise And Fall Of WeWork
wework.description: We Work, ek coworking space jo itni popularity ke bawajood struggle se hote hui guzri hai. Magar aaj bhi standard bilkul kam nahi hua. Kya hai iski kahani? Kaise build kiya gaya ise? jaanenge We Work is rise or fall ke baare mein is audiobook mein

dadasaheb-phalke.title: DADASAHEB PHALKE
dadasaheb-phalke.description: Bhartiya Chitrapat sruchtiche janak arthat Father of Indian Cinema mhnje 'Dadasaheb Phalke'. Aikuya Goshta, tyancha sangharshmayi pan titkyach ranjak prawasachi ani bhartiya cinema cha nirmitichi..

how-to-be-pro-in-money-management.title: How to be Pro in Money Management?
how-to-be-pro-in-money-management.description: ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನ ಟೆನ್ಷನ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಸಾಗಬೇಕಾದರೆ, ಹಣ ಸಂಪಾದನೆಗಿಂತ, ಕೈಗೆ ಬಂದ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್ ಮಾಡೋದು ಗೊತ್ತಿರಬೇಕು... ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಹಣ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್ ಮಾಡೋದು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನು? ಯಾವ ರೀತಿ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಂಡರೆ ಫೈನಾನ್ಷಿಯಲ್ ಪ್ರಾಬ್ಲಂಸ್ ಬರೋದಿಲ್ಲ? ತಿಳಿಯಲು 'How to Pro in Money Management' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ!

vijay-nagar.title: Vijay Nagar Empire
vijay-nagar.description: Vijay Nagar Empire - 300 Years ka vo Itihas jo India ki Samaradhhi Aur khyati ko batata hai, Is Kahani me ham ye bhi Janenge ki 14th Cetury me kaise Vijay Nagar ki Shuruvat Hui aur kitne Vans ke Emperor ne yaha kitne samay tak shashan kiya? Vijay Nagar ki Ek best Historical Place Humpi  hai jiske Temples aur Hindu sanskriti ki Mahanata ke kai saboot yaha aaj bhi Maujud hai. Duniya ke Alag Alag logo ne Vijay Nagr ka Jikar kiya hai. Itna Sab kuchh hone baad bhi Vijay nagar Barbad kaise hua Janne ke liye Aap hamari is AudioBook ke sath jud sakte hai.

kalikadevi-vijayam.title: Kalikadevi Vijayam
kalikadevi-vijayam.description: Thanthrika yogam lo kalika pradhana pathra poshisthundi. Nirvana thanthram prakaram thrimurthulanu kali maatha srustinchindi. Nirutthara thanthram, pichila thanthram prakaram kali matha manthralu maha shakthivanthamainavi gaa perkontayi. Kali vidyalanu mahadevi avatharamgaa chebuthayi.

moghalula-charithra-1.title: Moghalula Charithra
moghalula-charithra-1.description: Shah Jahan kreesthu shakam 1630, 1653 madhya thana bharya muntaz gnapakarthamga, prasiddhiganchina Taj mahal kattinchalani sankalpinchadu. Muntaz thana 14 va bidda prasava samayam lo maraninchindi. 1700 natiki samrajyam 40 lakshala chadarapu kilometer la mera vistharinchi uddahan sthithiki cherukunnadi.

business-adventure.title: Mastering The Marketplace
business-adventure.description: "Mastering the Marketplace" Is Original Series mein kuch Business case studies share kiye gaye hai jo business build karne me kaafi madad kar sakte hai. Business ko Shuru karne mein aur Profitable banane mein kaafi alag approach lagti hai, alag mindset aur alag learning ki Zaroorat hoti hai. Aapko Humari ye series Past ke practical experience se bahut kuch sikhayegi jisse aap apne business mein Successful ban sake aur Yadi aap History ko samajh kar business ki shuruvat karenge to un galtiyo ko aap dobara nahi karenge jo already ho chuki hai.

how-to-sell-anything-to-anybody.title: Sales Er Jogote Career Gore Tulun
how-to-sell-anything-to-anybody.description: Sales er bybasha e achen anek din dhore? Kintu bhalo phol pachhen na, ba ei bybasha somoporke kono bhabe asha hoto hoyechen, tahole aj ker sarangsho ti apnar jonnyo.  Sales er jogote jodi apni career gore tulte chaan tahole jhot pot ei boi tir sarangsho ti shune nin.

deepavali-puranagadhalu.title: Deepavali Purana Gadhalu
deepavali-puranagadhalu.description: సత్యభామ నరకాసురుణ్ణి ఎందుకు వధించింది? దేశంలో వివిధ ప్రాంతాల్లో దీపావళి చుట్టూ అల్లుకున్న కథలేంటి? మరిన్ని ఆసక్తికర విషయాలతో ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోసం.

complete-baby-care-guide.title: 0 to 1 Complete Baby Care Guide
complete-baby-care-guide.description: Kisi bhe insaan ke liye parents banna ek bauth badi khushi hoti hai, Parents banne ke ehsaas aapko ek nayi zindagi ki taraf lekar jata hai, wo kehte hain na ki bacche bhagwan ka roop hote hain aur aisa isliye kaha jata hai kyuki jab ek baccha Janam leta hai tab wo hume duniya me sabse pyara lagta hai har koi use pyar karna, uske sath waqt bitan aur khelna chahta hai. Lekin baccho ka dekhbhal karna koi aasan kaam nhe hai ek bacche ko sambhalne me raaton ki neend udd jaati hai, Ek parents ko apne baccho ka care karte waqt bauth sari chezoo ka dhyan rakhna padta hai isliye hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain Audio Book "0 to 1 Complete Baby Care Guide" jisme aapko ek bacche ke duniya me aane se pehle aur uske is duniya me aane ke baad tak ki puri tayari ke baare me bataya gaya hai.

tough-times-never-last-but-tough-people-.title: Jiboner Somosyaguloke Kivabe Overcome Korben ?
tough-times-never-last-but-tough-people-.description: Aamader Jibone Onek Somosya Thake. Keu Hoyoto Chakri Pacche Na, Keu Chorom Hotasay Vughche, Keu Keu Ekakitwye Vugche, Aabar Keuba Shariririk Somosyay. Aar Egulo Jibone Thakbei, Eguloke Overcome Korte Hobe. Ebar Aapnar Mone Proshno Jagbe Kivabe Overcome Korben? Ki Ki Solution Royeche Eisob Somosyar? Eisob Proshner Uttor Pete Aapnake Shuntei Hobe Ei Audiobook.

how-to-become-the-best-manager.title: How To Become the Best Manager
how-to-become-the-best-manager.description: Indha ulagathula Manushanga thaan romba complex saana uyirinangal, andha complex saana uyirinangal la manage panrathu romba challenging aana vishayam thaan. Manithargala handle panra intha magathana kalaiya kathu vachukitta,  Top level la irunthu ella employees kum ungala pidikkum. Neenga solra velaiya virumbi seivaanga. Employees kum ungalukkum karuthu verupadu varave varaadhu. Sirantha Manager ra irukka ennalam seiyanum ennalam seiya kudathu nu intha pathivu ungala guide pannum. Makkal sambathappatta thozhil la irukkura ovvorutharum therinjika vendiya Pala vishayangal idhula irukku. Kelunga !

masti-badmash-company.title: Masti- Badmash Company 1
masti-badmash-company.description: Charsi , Ganjedi aur Bewde ki Chaukdi ka sardar Mastikhor Masti aaj poore 6 mahine ke baad Jail se choot ke aya tha. Magar paison ka khel aur loot ki lalach ne Masti aur uski paltan ko Daduwa ke jaal mein phasa diya , Bank se 50 lakh ki loot me shamil Masti ab kaise bachayega apni Badmash Company ko Daduwa ke Jaal se ?

surer-jogote-barmans-jadu.title: Surer Jogote Burman's Jadu
surer-jogote-barmans-jadu.description: Surer Jogote Ek Aalada Matra Jog Korechilen Burman's Family. S. D. Burman Er Hat Dhore Ei Jatra Shuru Hoy. Ei Jatra Aaro Egiye Niye Cholen Tar Sujogyo Putro R.D. Burman. Ekgheyemi Ganer Bodole Notunvabe Ganer Sure Vasiye Chilen Aamader. Tader Srishti Gangulo Aajo Aamader Moner Monikothay Royeche. Kivabe Tara Shuru Korlen Ei Jatrapoth? Thik Ki Ki Poriborton Enechilen Surer Jogote? Asun Eirokom Kichu Golpo Shune Ni Ei Audiobook Theke.

home-schooling.title: Homeschooling Guide
home-schooling.description: Puri Duniya mein ab jyadatar parents Apne bacchon ko public aur private schools mein bhejne ke bajaye homeschool mein padhana pasand kar rhe hain. In sabhi parents mein ek chiz common hai ki vo apne bacche ko acchi education dena chahte hain. Aur Iske liye in sabhi parents ko homeschooling ke process ko samajhna jaruri hai. Jo ki is Audiobook ko sunke bahut asani se kiya ja sakta hai.

what-does-your-religion-preach-1.title: What Does Your Religion Preach
what-does-your-religion-preach-1.description: Namma madham unmaiyave enna solludhu athoda aazhamana karuthu enna nu indha audio book la kelunga.

separation-of-burma-from-india.title: Separation of Burma from India
separation-of-burma-from-india.description: Nammaloda varalaaru la nadandha mukkiya silla kaala kattangalla onnu dhaan Burma - India separation. Adha pathi detailed indha audio book la therinjikalam.

execution-the-discipline-of-getting-thin.title: How to Turn Your Ideas into Reality
execution-the-discipline-of-getting-thin.description: Aap chahe ek company ke Malik ho ya kisi company ke ek employee, Apne har Kaam se accha result nikalne ke liye us kaam ko khud karne ya kisi se karwane ka tarika pata hona aur uske liye sahi log chunna bhut zaroori hai.  KUKU FM ki is Original Audiobook mein strategy, leadership development, aur innovation jaise Disciplines ki baat ki gai hai, Jo ki successful banne ke liye Most Important hai. Agar aapko "The Power of Self-Discipline" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

road-to-qatar-history-of-world-cup-footb.title: History of Football World Cup
road-to-qatar-history-of-world-cup-footb.description: ಇಗೀಗ ಎಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಿದರೂ FIFA ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಜ್ವರ ಶುರು ಆಗಿದೆ! ⚽🔥 ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೆಯ ಸಂಕೇತವಾಗಿ ಬಲಾಡ್ಯ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಗಳು ಕ್ರೀಡಾಂಗಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾದಾಡಲು ರೆಡಿಯಾಗಿವೆ! ಆದರೆ, ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್ ಆರಂಭವಾದದ್ದು ಯಾವಾಗ? ಇಷ್ಟು ಕ್ರೇಜ್ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿರುವ ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್ 12 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕಾಲ ನಡೆಯದೆ ಇರುವುದು ಯಾಕೆ? ಇಲ್ಲಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿಯ ಗರಿ ಮುಡಿಗೇರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಗಳು ಯಾವವು? ಈ ಬಾರಿಯ ಕತಾರ್ ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶೇಷತೆಗಳೇನು? ಇವೆಲ್ಲಾ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕಾದರೆ, ಕೇಳಿ 'History of Football World Cup' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

bahubali.title: BAHUBALI
bahubali.description: ಪ್ರಪಂಚದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಧರ್ಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜೈನ ಧರ್ಮವೂ ಒಂದು. ಈ ಧರ್ಮದ ಮೆರು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವವೆ ಬಾಹುಬಲಿ.! ತ್ಯಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಹೆಸರು ಎಂದರೆ ಬಾಹುಬಲಿ.! ಅನ್ಯರಾಜರನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಿ, ಅವರ ತಮ್ಮನನ್ನೇ ಗೆದ್ದರು, ಕೊನೆಗೆ ತನ್ನ ತಾನೇ ಗೆಲ್ಲಲು ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ತ್ಯಜಿಸಿ ನಿಂತ ಬಾಹುಬಲಿಯ ಜೀವನ ರೋಚಕ! ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಆದರ್ಶಪ್ರಾಯನಾದ ಭಗವಾನ್ ಬಾಹುಬಲಿ ಕುರಿತ ಕಥೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ, KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'BAHUBALI' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

kasba-ek-mahashakti.title: Kasba : Ek Mahashakti
kasba-ek-mahashakti.description: Prithvilok par basa ek aisa kshetra jismein mahashakti ka vaas hai. Is kshetra me aise kai aaqa hain jo duniya ko apne ishaare par nachaana jaante hain. Aghori babaao'n se lekar baahubaliyon tak ko is mahashakti ki talaash hai jisse wo dharti par raaj kar sake. Is Jung me jab zameen aur aasman bhi takraayenge to nazara behad khaufnaak hoga. Kya hoga jab in divya shaktiyon ke beech ek anjaani si mohabbat bhi saans legi? Janne ke liye sunein Kuku FM par ye kahani!

krishnuni-vijayam.title: Krishnuni Vijayam
krishnuni-vijayam.description: Sri maha vishnuvu thana srustiloni jeevulaku badhalu hechinappudu, lokam lo papam haddu meerinappudu, dustulanu shikshinchi shishtulanu rakshinchadam kosam jivula rupamlo avatharinchi dusta shikshana, shista rakshana chesthu untadu. Ee vidhamgaa avatharinchadanni leevatharam antaaru. Ilanti leelavatharaalu bhagavatham prakaram bhagavanthuniki 22 unnayi. Sri maha vishnuvu avatharamlo 22 va avatharam sri krishnavatharam.

akashatil-ajube-1.title: Akashatil Ajube
akashatil-ajube-1.description: Shrote ho aple akash khup gudh ani anokhe ahe. Dar divashi aplyala akashat navin navin chakit karnarya goshti baghayala miltat. Kadhi pivala kadhi lal tar kadhi jambhalya rangacha disnara Akash  hey kalya rangacha ahe hey tumhala mahiti ahe ka. Jhalatna shock pan don't worry kukufm tumchya sathi khas series gheun ala ahe jyacha nav ahe Akashatil Ajube.

raakh.title: Raakh
raakh.description: Shahar me ek ke baad ek milti laashon ne police ke hosh faakhta kar diye. Katl kisne kiye aur kyun? jali laashein, ansuljhe rahasya aur lapata katil ki khoj me nikle Inspector Ranveer jise suraag paane ke liye karna pada maut ka chakravyuh paar aur jiske haath saboot ke taur par lagi sirf "Raakh".

losing-my-virginity.title: Jiboner Romancho Ke Samlanor 10 Ti tips
losing-my-virginity.description: Romacho kebol shobdo shudhu na. Er modhye lukiye ache jiboner obhighyotar kotha. Onischoyotar pothe ogroshor howa manei egiye chola noi khali. Manush somriddho hoi badha bipottir pothe hete egiye giye. Apni na chaileo apni badha bipotti te bhora o romache bhora experience er sakhhi hon. popular-places-of-karnataka.description: ಅರಬ್ಬಿ ಸಮುದ್ರದ ಅಲೆಗಳಿಂದ ತಾಯಿ ಚಾಮುಂಡಿ ನೆಲದವರೆಗೆ… ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡರು ಕಟ್ಟಿದ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಿಂದ ಬಹಮನಿ ಸುಲ್ತಾನರು ಆಳಿದ ಬೀದರ್ ವರೆಗೆ… ವಿಜಯನಗರದ ಗತ ವೈಭವ ಸಾರುವ ಹಂಪಿಯಿಂದ ಹೊಯ್ಸಳರ ಶಿಲ್ಪಕಲೆ ಅರಳಿದ ಬೇಲೂರು-ಹಳೇಬೀಡಿನವರೆಗೆ… ಬಂಡೀಪುರ ನ್ಯಾಷನಲ್ ಪಾರ್ಕ್‌ನಿಂದ ರಂಗನತಿಟ್ಟು ಪಕ್ಷಿಧಾಮದವರೆಗೆ… ಹೀಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲು, ನುಡಿಯಲು ಕನ್ನಡದ ಕಂಪು ಹರಡುವ ನಮ್ಮ ಕರುನಾಡು, ಒಂದು ರಾಜ್ಯ, ಹಲವಾರು ಜಗತ್ತುಎಂಬಂತೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ! ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವೆಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರವಾಸಿ ತಾಣಗಳಿವೆ? ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಎಂಬ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಉತ್ತರ! ಕೇಳಿ 'Popular Places of Karnataka' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್! ಬನ್ನಿ, ನಮ್ಮೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಸುತ್ತಿ! 🎧🔥

iaf-indian-air-force.title: IAF : Indian Air Force
iaf-indian-air-force.description: ನಾವು ಇಂದು ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸಲು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕಾರಣ ನಮ್ಮ ಭಾರತೀಯ ರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಪಡೆ! ಶತ್ರು ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಗಳು ಎಷ್ಟು ಕುತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದರೂ, ವೈರಿಪಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೆಲಕ್ಕುರಳಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಸೇನೆ ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ರಕ್ಷಣಾ ಪಡೆಯ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಅಂಗವಾದ ಭಾರತೀಯ ವಾಯು ಸೇನೆಯ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ಅಪ್ರತಿಮ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ವಾಯು ಸೇನೆ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಯಾದದ್ದು ಯಾವಾಗ? ಇದರ ಮೊದಲ ಹೆಸರು ಏನು ಗೊತ್ತಾ? IAF ಮತ್ತು ನಮ್ಮ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿಗೆ ಇರುವ ಸಂಬಂಧವೇನು? ಸೇನೆ ಸೇರುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇಕಾದ ಅರ್ಹತೆಗಳೇನು? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'IAF: Indian Air Force' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

climate-change-a-bigger-problem-2.title: Climate Change - A Bigger Problem
climate-change-a-bigger-problem-2.description: As the discussion over the consequences of changes in the Earth's climate has increased, the phrase climate change has evolved to refer mostly to recent changes and those anticipated to occur in the future, generally as a result of human action. So how we can save the planet? Recycle. Fly less. Eat less meat. These are some of the ways that we've been told can slow climate change. But that is just the tip of the iceberg. The last few decades have been disastrous for our planet. In 2021, the highest-ever percentage of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere was recorded. The 2010-2020 decade was the hottest in the last 125 thousand years. In this series, we explore the ways to make real change as we take a closer look at the existing climactic problems. Get informed and join the battle for our planet with this eye-opening series.

the-basics-of-bitcoins-and-blockchains.title: Shikhe Nin Bitcoins and Blockchains Duniyar Khuntinati

Eirokom Kichu Bishoyer Uttor Paben Ei Boite. Jara Ei Bicoin, Blockchains Cryptocurrency Bishoyguli Somporke Kichui Janen Na Tader Ei Boi Anekkichu Jante Help Korbe. ಸ್ವಾಮಿ-ಕೊರಗಜ್ಜ.title: Swami Koragajja
ಸ್ವಾಮಿ-ಕೊರಗಜ್ಜ.description: ಕರಾವಳಿಯ ಮಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಈ ಹೆಸ್ರೇ ಒಂದು ಶಕ್ತಿ, ಒಂದು ಧೈರ್ಯ, ಒಂದು ನಂಬಿಕೆ..! ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಈ ಹೆಸ್ರು ಕೂಗಿದ್ರೆ, ಎಂತಹ ಕಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಕ್ಷಣಾರ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರ ನಂಬಿಕೆ..! ಶತಶತಮಾನಗಳಿಂದಲೂ, ತುಳುನಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದೈವಿಶಕ್ತಿಯ ದರ್ಶನ ಮಾಡಿಸ್ತಿರೋ ಆ ನಂಬಿಕೆಯ ದೈವವೇ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಕೊರಗಜ್ಜ... ಮಾನವನ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ 'ಕೊರಗತನಿಯ', ಮಾಯವಾಗಿ, ದೈವೀ ರೂಪ ಪಡೆದು ಕೊರಗಜ್ಜನಾದ ಎಂಬುದು ಪ್ರತೀತಿ. ಹೀಗೆ ಧರ್ಮ, ಸತ್ಯದ ಪ್ರತೀಕವಾಗಿ, ನಂಬಿದವರಿಗೆ ಇಂಬು ನೀಡುವ ಕೊರಗಜ್ಜರ ಮಹಿಮೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪವಾಡ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ, 'ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಕೊರಗಜ್ಜ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ...

கண்ணிமைக்க-நேரமில்லை-.description: ஒரு பெண்ணைக் காப்பாற்றப் போய், பெரும் சிக்கலில் மாட்டிக் கொள்கிறாள் நந்தா. அதைத் தொடர்ந்து பல கொலை வழக்குகளில் அவள் சிக்கிக் கொள்கிறாள். அவளைக் காப்பாற்ற வருகிறான் விவேக். நந்தாவைப் பல்வேறு கொலை வழக்குகளில் சிக்கவைத்தது யார்? ஒவ்வோர் அத்தியாயத்திலும் பிரச்னைகள் விஸ்வரூபம் எடுக்கும்போது நாமும் இமைக்க மறந்து திகைக்க வேண்டியிருக்கிறது...

royal-enfield.title: History of Royal Enfield
royal-enfield.description: Aapko jankar hairani hogi ki aap sabki favourite motor cycle company Royal Enfield joh bhale aaj India ki sadkon par shaan se ghumte nazar aati hai, lekin originally ye Indian company nahi hai. Balki, iske nirmata to woh hai, jinhone pehle suyi banane se apni shuruaat ki thi. Aur phir dekhte hi dekhte, iss company ne World Wars ko survive karte huye, khud ko, duniya ka leading motor cycle brand bana liya. Par ye sab Royal Enfield ke itihas ki ek jhalak thi. Sui banane se motor cycle banane aur India mein sabke dilon mein apni jagah banane ka iska yeh safar kafi romanchak tha. Aaiye chalte hai Royal Enfield ke safar pe.

Is book summary ke jariye aapko investment ki sahi aur proper jaankari milegi, to chaliye le chalte hain aapko Investment ki duniya me Safal banane.

options-trading.title: Options Trading Guide
options-trading.description: Do you think that big players are the only ones who can use option trading strategies? Do you struggle to understand the terminology used in options trading and other trading techniques? One of the most thrilling and lucrative stock market scenarios is options trading. However, the majority of traders can't find all the information in one place and struggle to process all the information. Many traders believe that trading options only involves purchasing Call Options when you anticipate an increase in price and buying Put Options when you anticipate a decrease in price. Options trading is more than that, though. This book, "Options Trading Guide," by Indrazith Shantharaj teaches you the options basics and 5 important strategies in options so that you can start trading with confidence.

share-tips-and-tricks-for-anti-ageing.title: Tips And Tricks For Anti- Aging

Lekin is Audio Book me humne un sare tips and tricks ke bare zikar kiya hai jo aapko anti aging ki samasya se chutkara dilayega aur is tricks ko apply kar aap apne chehre ko aue nikhar sakte hain. Anti-aging ki problem se Chutkara Paane ke liye ye Audio Book aapke liye hai.

ಗಾಂಧೀಜಿ-ಮತ್ತು-ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಜಿ.description: ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ನಂತರ ಭಾರತ ಕಟ್ಟೋ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲೂ ಅನೇಕ ನಾಯಕರು ಭದ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಭವ್ಯ ಬುನಾದಿಯನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಪೈಕಿ ಕೇಳಿಬರೋ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಹೆಸರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೋಹನ್‌ದಾಸ್ ಕರಮ್‌ ಚಂದ್ ಗಾಂಧಿ, ಲಾಲ್ ಬಹದ್ದೂರ್ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಿ ಹೆಸರುಗಳು ಅಗ್ರ ಪಂಕ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ತವೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಆಶಯಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ಅವರ ತತ್ವಗಳು ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಆಚರಣೆಯಾದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ, ಅದು ಪೀಳಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ ಪಸರಿಸೋಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯ. ಗಾಂಧೀಜಿಯ ಆಶಯಗಳೇನಿತ್ತು ಎನ್ನುವುದನ್ನು ನಾವು ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ ಅರ್ಥೈಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು.. ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಜಿಯ ಕಲ್ಪನೆಯ ಭಾರತ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು ಎನ್ನುವುದನ್ನು ನಾವು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು! ಅದನ್ನು ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಗಾಂಧೀಜಿ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಜಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್!

ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ-ಮುಕುಟ-ಮಣಿ-ವಿಧಾನ-ಸೌಧ.title: Karnatakada mukutamani Vidhanasoudha
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ-ಮುಕುಟ-ಮಣಿ-ವಿಧಾನ-ಸೌಧ.description: ದೇಶದ ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಣೀಯ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧ ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು...ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧವೆಂದರೆ ಒಂದು ರೀತಿಯ ಮೆರಗು..! ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಮ್ಮೆಯಾದ್ರೂ, ಈ ಭವ್ಯ ಸೌಧದೊಳಗೆ ಹೊಕ್ಕಿ ಬರಬೇಕು ಎನ್ನುವವರು ಅನೇಕರು... ನಾಡಿನ ಆಡಳಿತ ಕೇಂದ್ರವಾಗಿರುವ ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಕಟ್ಟಡದಂತೆ, ಹುಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡ ಕಟ್ಟಡವಲ್ಲ... ಇದರ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸುಮಾರು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕನಸಿದೆ...ದೂರದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿದೆ... ಹಠವಿದೆ...ಛಲವಿದೆ...ನೂರಾರು ಖೈದಿಗಳ ಬೆವರಿದೆ...ಇದೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಬೇಕಾ ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ಕೇಳಿ 'ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಮುಕುಟ ಮಣಿ ವಿಧಾನ ಸೌಧ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕುಎಫ್ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ...

interesting-history-of-kerala-temples.title: Interesting History Of Kerala Temples
interesting-history-of-kerala-temples.description: Keralam ennu kelkkumbol thanne manassilekku odi varunnathu ambalangalum, kavukalum, athumayi bendhapetta viswasangalum, kadhakalumakum. Niravadhi kshetrangalal sambhannamanu Keralam. Sree Padmanabhaswami kshetram, Guruvayur Sreekrishna kshetram, Kodungallur kshetram, Sabarimala Ayyappa kshetram thudangiyava avayil chilathu matram. Keralathile pradhanapetta kshetrangalude charitram kelkkam ee audio bookilude.

china-and-india_asias-emergent.title: The Rise of China and India
china-and-india_asias-emergent.description: 1947 Me India Azad hua Aur 1949 me China Azad hua, In dono countries me ek lambi gulami ke baad Bahut sare up and down dekhne ko mile chahe vo political level pe ho ya Economical level par. Jaha India ek Democratic desh hai vahi China Ek Communist  itni Asamantao ke bavjood india china me kaafi kuch similarities hai. China- India aaj world level kaha stand karte hai? Inhone aisa kya kiya ki aaj Asia ki emerging power ban gai? Aise bahut sare point par discussion kiya gaya hai.

bhagat-singh-15.title: Bhagat Singh
bhagat-singh-15.description: Bhagat Singh - the man who holds a heroic status in the annals of the Indian freedom struggle. We have all read about him in our history books and probably seen the movies too. But who exactly is he? Many people are willing to create entirely new narratives about his life and even more are eager to believe them. This special series is a broad look at Bhagat Singh's life, beginning with his family and his early years till his demise and examining along the way the role that various events, policies, and people played in shaping the identity of a legendary revolutionary, as well as taking a glimpse into his opinions on important issues and people of the time. Listen to the incredible life story of the gallant Shaheed-e-Azam.

road-to-qatar.title: Road To Qatar
road-to-qatar.description: Lokam muzhuvan oru kaalpanthinu pirake odunna kalamanu Football lokacup kaalam. Malayalikku mattoru aaghosha kaalam aanu Football lokacup. 4 Varshathe kaathirippinoduvil Qatar Lokacup Padivathilil ethi nilkkumbol namukkariyende Loka Cuppinekkurichum Athinte Charithrathe kurichum. Ipol allenkil pinne epozhanu. Appoppinne thudangamalle? Etha Team? Argentinayo? Brazilo?!!

aakhiri-kitaab-joh-aapki-zindagi-badal-d.title: Aakhiri Kitaab Jo Aapki Zindagi Badal De
aakhiri-kitaab-joh-aapki-zindagi-badal-d.description: Ek insan Zindagi me bahut kuchh karna chahta hai, kamyab hona chahta hai par jab paristhitiyan uske hisab se nahi hoti to vo pareshan ho jata hai, khud ko akela mahsus karta hai, aise me yadi use koi sahi margdarshan de aur ye samjhaye ki ab aage kya karna hai to fir se khada ho jata hai, aur fir se Try karta hai. "Aakhiri Kitaab Jo Aapki Zindagi Badal De" Ye AudioBook aapke sare question solve kar degi aur aapko Real Practical raste sujhayegi.

keralavum-kalakalum.title: Keralavum Kalakalum
keralavum-kalakalum.description: Malayalakkarayude mahatwam loka janathayude munnil ethichathil kalakalude pangu valare valuthanu. Nammude samskarathinteyum parambaryathinteyum prathiphalanamanu thanathu kalakal ennu parayunnathil athishayokthiyila. Kathakali, Theyyam, Mohiniyattam, Koodiyattam, Chakyar koothu angane niravadhi kalakalude charitravum resakaramaya ariya kadhakalum manassilakkam ee audio bookilude.

வெள்ளை-நிறத்தில்-ஒரு-வானவில்-.title: வெள்ளை நிறத்தில் ஒரு வானவில்
வெள்ளை-நிறத்தில்-ஒரு-வானவில்-.description: ஒரு திறமையான இளம் வழக்கறிஞர் கிருஷ்ணகுமார் தன் மனைவி லத்திகாவுடன் கோவையில் அழகான வாழ்க்கை வாழ்ந்து கொண்டிருக்கிறான். அப்போது நண்பனின் குடும்ப பிரச்சினை உருவில் ஒரு சிக்கல் வருகிறது. அதற்கு தீர்வைக் கண்டறிய பெங்களூருக்கு தனியாக செல்கிறான். அங்கே பலவித ஆச்சரியங்கள், அதிர்ச்சிகள் காத்திருந்தன. அவற்றை எப்படி எதிர்க்கொண்டான்... எப்படி சமாளித்து மீண்டான்? நண்பனின் பிரச்னை தீர்ந்ததா?

never-eat-alone.title: The Power of Connections
never-eat-alone.description: Agar zindagi mein koi humse pucche ki aap kaun hai, toh sabhi log main ke sath uss sawal ka jawab dete hai. Par hum yeh bhul jate hai ki humari zindagi mein har chiz ka credit sirf humara hi nahi hota. Isme humare aas paas ke logon ka bhi contribution hota hai. Lekin un logon se contact banaye rakhn humare liye time consuming hota hai, isliye, aage badhne ki race mein hum unhe picche chhod dete hai. The Power of connections ki book summary mein hum yahi janenge ki kin baaton par dhyan dekar hum apne social relationship ko majbut bana sakte hai.

chottanikkara-bhagavathy-temple.title: Chottanikkara Bhagavathy Temple
chottanikkara-bhagavathy-temple.description: Aithihyangalaal sambhannavum prasidhavumaanu Ernakulam jillayile Chottanikkara Bhagavathi Kshethram. Guruthipooja ividuthe pradhaana vazhipaadu aanu. Kumbha maasathile aaraattum makam thozhalum aanu chottanikkara kshethrathile visheshangal. 'Jyothi aanayicha kara' aanu pinneed lopich chottanikkara aayath. Orupad kadhakalum aithihyangalum kettupinanju kidakkunna Chottanikkara kshethratheyum Bhagavathiyeyum arinju thudangam..

queen-elizabeth-2-1.title: Queen Elizabeth 2
queen-elizabeth-2-1.description: France Rajavayirunna Louis XIV inu shesham ettavum kooduthal kaalam simhasanathil irunnath Queen Elizabeth 2 aanu. 7 pathittandolam adhikaarathilirunna ee rajniye kurich nammuk aduthariyam Kuku FMiloode.

detective-vikram-1.title: Detective Vikram
detective-vikram-1.description: Shahar mein achanak maut ka koharam mach gaya hai. Ek hi pariver ke logon ko utara ja raha hai maut ke ghat. Serial Killer ke khooni tandav se har taraf machega hahakar ya phir detective vikram ke master plan se sach aayega samne? Kya hai serial killer ki asli pehchan aur kya hogi uski aakhri manzil? Janane ke liye sune Kuku FM par yai Suspense bhari Kahani.

the-heartfulness-way-2.title: The Heartfulness Way
the-heartfulness-way-2.description: Kashtapaadukale marikkadakanum sampthrupthi nedanum swayam roopantharapedanumulla nurungukal Dhaaji enna spiritual leaderude sambhashanangaliloode rachayithavu ee pusthakathil charcha cheyyunnu.

ayurvedic.title: Ayurvedic Home Remedies
ayurvedic.description: Explore kijiye ek anokha show jo aapke liye ek guide ki tarah kaam karega, aur aapko western treatment ke badle ayurvedic upayon ke ke baare mein batayega. Sardi, flu, gale mein kharash, muhase, high cholesterol aur anxiety jaisi aam bimariyon ke liye ayurvedic upaay kya hai? Ye jaane ke liye is special show ko zaroor sunein.

51-shakti-peeth.title: Pujo Barshiki Special: 51 Shakti Peeth
51-shakti-peeth.description: 51 Shakti Peeth Niye Nana Munir Nana Mot Royeche. Ek Ek Jaygay Ek Ek Songkhar Ulleyekh Royeche. Kichu Kichu Jaygay Abar Upopeeth Er Ulleyekh Royeche. Kivabe Srishti Holo Ei Peeth Er? Peethgulite Ki Ki Rupe Pujita Hoye Thaken Debi? Eirokom Kichu Ajana Kahini Shune Nebo Ei  Durga Pujo E Puja Barshiki r Audiobook Theke.

களவொடு-கற்ற-காதல்-.title: களவோடு கற்ற காதல்
களவொடு-கற்ற-காதல்-.description: ஒரு மேல் தட்டு வர்க்கத்தின் பழி வாங்கும் படலத்தின் தொடக்கமாய் நகரும் கதையில் நடக்கும் ஒரு கொலை, அந்தக் கொலைக்கான பின்புலம், அதன் காரண காரியம் என ஆராயும் ஒரு லாயரின் கதையில் கதாசிரியரின் வழக்கமாய் மிளிறும் ஒரு அழகான காதல், அந்தக் காதல் நிறைவேறுமா என்ற கலக்கம் என பலவேறுபட்ட கோணங்களில் நகரும் கதை இது...

the-great-indian-diet.title: Magic Of Indian Diet
the-great-indian-diet.description: Indian Diet! Matlab hamara-aapka desi khana. Vahi jo poori duniya ke muh mein paani la deta hai. Aur jab yahi Indian khana sahi tareeqe se khana aa jaaye to khud ko fit karne ke liye isse behtar kuch nhin. suniye Bharat ke khane ke jaadu ke baare me "Magic Of Indian Diet" mein.

chernobyl-1986-2.title: Chernobyl 1986
chernobyl-1986-2.description: ಅದು ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಂತಿದ್ದ ನಗರ..! ಆದರೆ, ಅಂದು ನಡೆದ ಘೋರ ದುರಂತವು ಆ ನಗರವನ್ನು 'ಸಾವಿನ ನಗರ'ವಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸಿತು..! ಹೌದು, ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಪುಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕರಾಳ ದಿನಗಳ ಪೈಕಿ ಒಂದು 'ಚರ್ನೋಬಿಲ್ ದುರ್ಘಟನೆ'. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಆ ದುರ್ಘಟನೆ ಹೇಗೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು? ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು? ಅದರಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾದ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳೆನು? ಕೇಳಿ 'CHERNOBYL 1986' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

ರಾವಣ--ನೀವರಿಯದ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.title: RAVANA  Neevariyada Rahasya
ರಾವಣ--ನೀವರಿಯದ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.description: ಲಂಕಾಧಿಪತಿ ರಾವಣ! ಈ ಲಂಕಾಸುರ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ್ದೇ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ವಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ. ಮಹಾನ್ ಶಿವಭಕ್ತ.. ವೇದಜ್ಞಾನಿ.. ಅದ್ಭುತ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಿ.. ಮಹಾ ಪರಾಕ್ರಮಿ.. ಹತ್ತು ತಲೆಗಳ ವೀರ.. ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ಭುಜಗಳ ಶೂರ.. ಇಂಥ ಸಕಲ‌‌ ಕಲಾ ವಲ್ಲಭ ಸೀತೆಯನ್ನ ಅಪಹರಿಸಿದ್ದು ಯಾಕೆ? ತನ್ನ ಕರುಳಿನಲ್ಲೇ ವೀಣೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಶಿವನನ್ನ ಒಲಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ್ರೂ, ಕೊನೆಗಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾರನ್ನೂ ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳದೇ ಇರೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು?  ರಾಮ ರಾವಣರ ಯುದ್ಧ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ರಾವಣ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯವನಾ? ಕೆಟ್ಟವನಾ? ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ನಿಮ್ಮದು. ಕೇಳಿ 'ರಾವಣ: ನೀವರಿಯದ ರಹಸ್ಯ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್!

the-aspirants.title: A Guide to Self Discovery
the-aspirants.description:
Is bat ka aapki life mein kitna fark padta hai, ki aap vo nahi ban pae jo banna chahte thy?
Ye ek bhut hi Personal Saval hai jiska Javab  aapko ye Book Summary Sunne ke baad badi hi Asani se mil jayega . Ye ek Aaise Ladke ki kahani hai jo Bachapan se hi  ek Carmelite monk banna chahta tha, Usne iske liye Apna ghar bhii chodh diya tha  lekin Bad mien Vo ek civil Servant ban jata hai. Aur ek Monk banne ke safar ne hi use ye rasta dikhaya.

vandhiyathevan.title: VANDHIYATHEVAN
vandhiyathevan.description: Kalki inn ponniyin selvan nra indha brammanda padaippu la arimuga kadhapaathiram dhaan vandhiyathevan. Kadhai oda aarambathula sila mukkiya tharunangalla kadhai ah nagarthi selra oru interesting aana kadhaapaathiram. Ponniyin selvan la vandhiyathevan oda mukkiya tharunangala indha audio book la kelunga.

shanta-shelake-ek-jeevan-gaane.title: Shanta Shelke
shanta-shelake-ek-jeevan-gaane.description: Jyeshta Kavayitri, Geetkar, Lekhika, Pradhyapika... Shanta bai shelkenchi anek rupa. Gathishi aslela Samrudha anubhav ani Afat Shabda sampatti cha takdivar, Shanta baini Sahitya vishwat ek adhal sthan nirman kele. Baal geetanpasun te Kolo gitanparynt tyancha vyasang hota. Aplya Likhanatun, Kavitan cha madhyamatun tyani aplyala Sahityacha samrudha khajina bahal kela. Ya khas show madhun aikuya, Shana bainchi Jeevan gatha

network-marketing-ke-bhagwad-geeta.title: Network Marketing Ki Bhagwad Geeta
