network-marketing-ke-bhagwad-geeta.description: Mahabharat ke yuddh ki shuruaat me Arjun ko bohot saare confusions aur questions the aur Shri Krishna ne un sabhi ko solve kiya, jo bani Humari Bhagawat Geeta! waise he Network Marketing ki field me agar aap apna pehla step bhar rahe ho to aap ko bhi bohot saare questions honge, usi ko solve karne ke liye ye kitab aapki apne network marketing career me bhagwad geeta ke adhyay ke mutabik help karegi! to chaliye sunte hai

how-to-become-a-rj.title: How to become a RJ ?
how-to-become-a-rj.description: RJ aganumnu aasai padra elaarum thedittu irukka oru vishayathai thaan KuKu FM ungalukkaga kondu vanthurukku. Future la neenga oru sirantha RJ aagurathuku thevayaana all in all tips and suggestions intha pathivu la irukku.

jesus-christ.title: Jesus Christ - The Son of God
jesus-christ.description: Jesus, ek yahudi nav-yuvak jisne first century mein aise chamatkar dikhaye jinke baare me soch pana bhi mushkil tha. Insano ko ishwar se milwaya aur unko negativity se door kiya. Jesus ne ek mare hue ko zinda karke ye saabit kiya ki wo ek aam insaan nahi the. Yahudio ne jo dharm ki paribhasha banai hui thi uske khilaf awaaz uthane wale Jesus Christ hi the. Aaj Christianity sabse zyada follow kiya Jane wala religion hai. Aakhir Jesus ne yahudi religion ke khilaf awaz kyo uthayi aur kaise itne bade religion ko nakar ke ek naye religion ki neev rakhi? Jesus, Jesus Christ kaise bane? Janenge in saare sawalon ke jawab is audiobook me.

padmarajan-vellithirayile-gandharvan.title: Padmarajan Vellithirayile 'Gandharvan'
padmarajan-vellithirayile-gandharvan.description: Malayalam chalachithra samvidhayakan, thirakadhakrithth, saahithyakaran ennee mekhalakalil ellam prashasthanaya P. Padmarajan ariyapedunnath kaalathinte kannu thattatha kalakaaranaayitanu. Padmarajan enna Vellithirayile 'Gandharvane' kurichch kooduthal ariyam. Kelkuu KukuFM.

unsung-warrior-sehmat-khan-1.title: Unsung Warrior Sehmat Khan
unsung-warrior-sehmat-khan-1.description: The year is 1971. Tension is brewing between India and Pakistan. When a young college-age Kashmiri girl learns of her dying father's final wish, she has no choice but to succumb to his love and patriotism and pursue the road he has painstakingly mapped out. And so her journey from a regular girl to a dangerous spy began. She carried out her missions with extreme courage and bravado, never seeking any glory and choosing to remain anonymous till the end. But who was she? Listen to this thrilling series that brings to life the story of this unsung heroine of war.

network-marketing-kya-hai-revised.title: Network Marketing Kya Hai?
network-marketing-kya-hai-revised.description: Network Marketing Ke Baare Mein Hum Sabhi Ne Kabhi Na Kabhi Toh Zaroor Suna Hoga. Ye Ek Aisa Topic Hai Jiske Baare Mein Abhi Bhi Bohut Se Logon Ko Poori Knowledge Nahi Hai. Is Audiobook Mein Aap Janenge Isse Judi Sabhi Aeham Baatein Jaise Ki Ye Exactly Kya Hai? Kya Humein Ise Karna Chahiye Aur Akhir Ye Itni Badnaam Kyu Hai? Toh Chaliye Jante Hain Apne Sabhi Sawalon Ke Jawab.

designing-destiny-1.title: Designing Destiny
designing-destiny-1.description: Jeevithathil nammal pinthudarenda moolyangale kurichum pularthenda sameepanangalekkurichum Designing Destiny enna pusthakathiloode Kamalesh D Patel vivarikkunnu. Nammude Swabhavam, Jeevithashaili, Manobhavam, Athmav,Sneham, Parinamam, ennivayekkurichellam vyathyasthamaya veekshanangal munnottu vekkunna pusthakam aanithu. Aathyandhikamayi swayam kandethuka, nalla manushyaravuka enna lakshyathilekkethan ee pusthakam namme sahayikkum.

how-to-boost-your-self-confidence-1.title: How to boost your self confidence
how-to-boost-your-self-confidence-1.description: Unga mela neenga vachirukka confidence thaan unga vaalkaiyoda adutha kattathukku ungalai nagarthum. Appadi patta self confidence ah develop pannikka intha pathivu ungalukku uthaviyaa irukkum.

a-random-walk-down-walk-street.title: Story of Bear and Bull
a-random-walk-down-walk-street.description: Stock Market Duniya ki sabse competitive Field mani jati hai. Aur tabhi is field mein Kadam rakhne se pehle hazar bar sochna  padta hai. Lekin A Random Walk Down Wall Street, Paise Se kharidi ja sakne wali Stock Market ki ek sabse acchi investment guide hai. Isko Sunke aap  badi Aasani se 'Wall Street' ki basic terminology ko sikh sakte hain. Iske sath  ye aapko user-friendly, long-range investment strategy ki madat se Street ko navigate karna bhi sikhati hai.

the-rise-of-chennai-and-contribution-by-.title: The Rise of Chennai and contribution by Kalaignar Karunanithi
the-rise-of-chennai-and-contribution-by-.description: India voda nagarangalukku eduthukaattaa chennai innaiku valarnthu nikkuthu. Ippadi patta chennai ah uruvaakka Kalaignar Karunanithi perum pangu vagichirukaaru. Chennai oda valarchi pathiyum athukku kalaignar kodutha pangalippayum intha pathivula kelunga.

how-to-start-career-as-freelancer.title: How to Start Career as Freelancer?
how-to-start-career-as-freelancer.description: ನಿಮಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿರೋ ಆದಾಯ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಲೈಫ್ಸ್ಟೈಲ್‌ಗೆ ಸಾಕಾಗ್ತಾ ಇಲ್ಲವಾ? ಆಫೀಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಸ್ ಕಿರಿಕಿರಿ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಆಗ್ತಿದ್ಯಾ? ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ನೀವೇ ಬಾಸ್ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕಾ? Don't worry... ನಿಮಗಾಗಿಯೇ ಇದೆ Freelancing ಅವಕಾಶ..! ಇಲ್ಲಿ ನೀವೇ ಬಾಸ್, ನೀವೇ ವರ್ಕರ್! ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಈ Freelancing work ಹೇಗೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು? ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವೆಲ್ಲಾ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳಿವೆ? ಅಂತ ಯೋಚನೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೀರಾ? 'How to Start Career as Freelancer' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ

the-american-civil-war.title: The American Civil War
the-american-civil-war.description: 1861 aur 1865 ke beech North America Mahaadveep par bhadake Amerikee grhayuddh mein kisi bhi dusre yuddh ki tulana mein Jyada Amerikiyon kee Jaan gai thi,ye America ke  poore itihaas ki sabse bhayanak  ladai thi. ek Insan ko sampatti ke roop mein rakhane ki naitikata  ke samarthan mein aur amerikee adaalaton aur satta mein virodh karane vaalon ke beech kanuni ladaee ban gai.Aur jabaki ladaee lambe samay se khatm ho gaee hai, par America mein aaj bhi sanskrti aur nasl jaise muddon par grhayuddh ke prabhaav ko mahasoos kiya ja sakta hai. to, aaie ham America ke itihaas ke us kaale adhyaay ko janenge jisme kaiyon ka khoon samaya hua hai.

anil-kumble.title: ANIL KUMBLE
anil-kumble.description: '10 ವಿಕೆಟ್' ಅಂತ ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ನೆನಪಾಗೋ ಹೆಸರು ಸ್ಪಿನ್ ಮಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಅನಿಲ್ ಕುಂಬ್ಳೆ! ನಮ್ಮ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಸಾಧಕರಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಾದ ಅನಿಲ್ ಕುಂಬ್ಳೆ, ಅಂತಾರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಿರುವುದು ಅತ್ಯದ್ಭುತ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅನಿಲ್ ಕುಂಬ್ಳೆ, ಜಂಬೋ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಫಾಸ್ಟ್ ಬೌಲರ್ ಆಗಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹೋರಾಟ ಮಾಡಿದ ಅನಿಲ್, ಸ್ಪಿನ್ನರ್ ಆಗಿ, ಆ 10 ವಿಕೆಟ್ ಗಳಿಸಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಈ ಗೂಗ್ಲಿ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್ ಕ್ಯಾಪ್ಟನ್ ಆದಾಗ ಯಾವೆಲ್ಲ ಸವಾಲುಗಳು ಎದುರಾದವು? ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಬಿಟ್ಟೂ ಅವ್ರ ಬೇರೆ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟ್ ಏನು? ಎಲ್ಲದರ ಉತ್ತರ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ! ಕೇಳಿ 'ಅನಿಲ್ ಕುಂಬ್ಳೆ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್! 🎧🔥

how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.title: How to make money with breakout Trading
how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.description: Breakout Trading Seekh Kar Agar Aap Stock Market Mein Munafa Kamana Chahte Hain Toh Ye Audio Book Khaas Aapke Liye Hai. Famous Stock Market Trader Indrazith Shantharaj Ki Ye Kitaab Breakout Ke A-Z Sabhi Pehlu Cover Karti Hai.

shakthi-peetaalu.title: Shakthi Peetaalu
shakthi-peetaalu.description: Okappudu dakshudu bruhaspathi yagam chesinappudu andarini aahvanisthadu kaani kuthuruni alludini pilavadu endukante dakshuni kumarthe thana mataku viruddhamgaaa shivudini pelladindi. Puttinti vaaru pilavala enti ani satheedevi, shivudu varinchina pramadaganalanu venta pettukoni yaganiki vellindi. Akkada avamananiki gurayyindi. Aame avamananiki agnilo ddoki bhasvamayyindi. Shivudu yagashalanu dhvamsam chesthadu. Sathi viyoga dhukham veedani shivudu aame mrutha shareeraanni antipettukuni undi thana jagadrakshakaryaanni manivesadu. Devathala prarthanalu manninchina vishnuvu sudarshana chakram tho aa dehanni khandaalugaa chesi shivudini vimukthi chesadu. Sathidevi sharera bhagalu padina sthalalu shakthi peetalugaa mukhyam gaa thanthra sadhakulaku aaradhana sthalalugaa ayinayi.

how-was-andhra-pradesh-formed.title: How Was Andhra Pradesh Formed
how-was-andhra-pradesh-formed.description: India ki Independence vachhina tarwatha kuda Telugu, Tamil Prajalaku kalipi Andhra Rashtram ga undedi. Kaani Mana Telugu Prajalaku, Telugu Bhashaku Saraina Respect undedi kaadu. Ekkada choosina Telugu Nayakulaku, Kavulaku, Kalakaarulaku Insults Jarugutundevi. Aa tarwatha Telugu vaariki separate State Kavalni Endaro Udyamakaarulu chepattina Udyamala Tarwatha Telugu prajala kosam 1956 lo Separate Andhra Pradesh Form Ayindi. Mari Separate state kosam Jarigina Udyamalu, Udyamakarula Tyagalu, Nayakula Krushi, Inka Aanati Paristhutulanu Kallaku kattinattu Ee Audio Book lo Neeku Vivarinchabadutundi.

remarkable-engineers_-from-riquet-to-sha.title: Engineers Jinhone Badli Duniya
remarkable-engineers_-from-riquet-to-sha.description: Kahawat hai ki Bengaluru shahar mein agar aap hawa me pathar uchaloge to wo jaakar kisi na kisi Engineer ko he lagega, kehne ka matlb ye hai ki us shahar mein bauth he jyada sankhya mein Engineers hain. Agar aaj se kuch salon pehle ki baat kare to har 2 mein se ek bacha yhai kehta tha ki use bhe Aage chal kar Engineering he karni hai. To chaliye le chalte hai aapko "Engineers Jinhone Badli Duniya"  ke Audio Book ke safar par jisme  duniya ke un tamam Engineers ke baare me zikar kiya gaya hai jinki wajah se aaj humari zindagi bauth he aasan ban chuki hai.

neera-arya-1.title: Neera Arya - First Lady Spy
neera-arya-1.description: 5th March 1902. In the unassuming town of Khekra, a girl was born who would later become the first female spy of an army striving to free their motherland.  A staunch patriot till the bitter end, who did not even hesitate to kill her husband for the sake of her country. A fierce loyalist who suffered unimaginable atrocities at the hands of British officials but never betrayed her comrades and leader. What is her story? What were her struggles? Why is she not a popular figure like Gandhi or Bhagat Singh? Listen to the extraordinary story of a forgotten freedom fighter who lived and died for her nation but never received the praise which she certainly deserved.

ರಾಜರತ್ನ.title: RAJARATHNA
ರಾಜರತ್ನ.description: ಎಷ್ಟು ವರ್ಷ ಬದುಕ್ತೀವಿ ಅನ್ನೋದಕ್ಕಿಂತ, ಹೇಗೆ ಬದುಕ್ತೀವಿ ಅನ್ನೋದು ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯ‌. 'ಅಭಿಮಾನಿಗಳೇ ದೇವರು' ಎಂದ ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನ, ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವವನ್ನ'ಅಭಿಮಾನಿಗಳ ದೇವರಾಗಿ' ಪೂಜಿಸ್ತಾರೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅದು ನಿಜವಾದ ಸಾರ್ಥಕತೆ ಅಲ್ವಾ? ಈ ಮಾತಿಗೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಾಗಿರೋದು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ರತ್ನ, ದೊಡ್ಮನೆ ಕುಡಿ, ಪವರ್ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ ಪುನೀತ್ ರಾಜ್‍ಕುಮಾರ್. ನಮ್ಮೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇಂದು ಅಪ್ಪು ದೈಹಿಕವಾಗಿ ಇಲ್ಲದಿರ್ಬಹುದು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಇವರು ಹಾಕಿಕೊಟ್ಟ ದಾರಿ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಅಜರಾಮರ. ಇದನ್ನ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದೇ ನಾವು ಪುನೀತ್ ಅವರಿಗೆ ನೀಡುವ ಬಹುದೊಡ್ಡ ಗೌರವ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ರಾಜರತ್ನ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್. ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

india-vs-china-1962.title: India vs China (1962)
india-vs-china-1962.description: "Hindi Chini bhai bhai" ye quote to sab ne suna hoga, par jab wahi bhai aapki zamin hadapne ki koshish kare to? indo sino war ek bure sapne ki tarah aaj bhi sare indians ko yaad hai. chaliye dekhte hai itihaas ke wo panne jaha china ne apna aasli rang dikhaya aur indian political confusions, late decisions , leadership changes ne humari army ko confuse kiya par fir bhi humare veer javano ne apne aakhri saans tak jung ladi.

the-conscious-parent-2.title: Parenting Er Jana Ojana Secrets
the-conscious-parent-2.description: Parenting kono course ba degree noi, ekta boro daittyo. Ekta manusher kache tar career joto ta important, parenting maa baba r kache thik toto tai guruttopurno. Bachha der jogot ta thik temon e hoi, jemon tar baa maa era dekhaye. Ekmatro socheton parenting e ekta sundor bhobishyot gore tulte pare. Ei boi tir sarangsho theke apnara parenting er byapare nana jana ojana tothyo shikhte parben.

bhopal-gas-tragedy-1.title: Bhopal Gas Tragedy
bhopal-gas-tragedy-1.description: It was the late hours of December 2, 1984. In the ancient city of Bhopal, a cloud of toxic gas escaped from the Union Carbide pesticide plant, killing thousands and maiming lakhs of people. The worst industrial disaster in history occurred when the toxic clouds lifted. It has been more than 35 years but the correct data, facts, and its many vital aspects are still shrouded in mystery. In the pursuit of learning the harrowing tale of this tragedy, we have compiled the first-hand accounts of the man who was the District Magistrate of Bhopal and the chief coordinator of rescue, relief, and rehabilitation operations at the district level in this series. Witness the extraordinary story of deceit and lies, resilience and survival through this show.

techniques-in-prayer-therapy.title: The Art Of Prayer Healing
techniques-in-prayer-therapy.description: Is Original show mein hum aapke liye laaye hai proven techniques of praying jiske use se duniya ke kayi logon ko madad mili hai. Isme aapko real-life examples se yeh samajh aayega ki sahi tarike se pray karke logon ne apne toote ghar ko sambhala hai, dukh se bahar nikle hain aur chhote-mote problems ko bhi solve kiya hai

janata-raja.title: Shivrayanche athvave Roop
janata-raja.description: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj mhanje pratyek Marathi Mansacha sarth abhiman. Shivaji maharajanchya katha aiktch apan lahanache mothe zalo. Tyancha veergatha aplyala nehmich Prerana det alya. Ata wel aliye apla ha Gaurvashali Itihas pudhcha pidhi parynt pohchvaychi. Chala, Chatrapati Shivrayancha itihas aikuya ani navya pidhila aikvuya eka navya rupat!

roja-mul-dhrogam-1.title: ரோஜா முள் துரோகம்
roja-mul-dhrogam-1.description: எயிட்ஸ் நோயாளியான 42 வயது யதுநந்தன் தன் மிச்ச நாட்களை மகிழ்ச்சியாகக் கழிக்க ஏழைப் பெண்ணான வைஜெயந்தியை மணந்து கொள்ள முடிவெடுக்கிறான். இதில் விருப்பம் இல்லாத வைஜெயந்தி திருமணத்திற்கு முதல்நாள் தன் காதலனைத் தேடிச் சென்று விடுகிறாள். ஆனால், வைஜெயந்தி மர்மமான முறையில் கடத்தப்படுகிறாள். அவளைக் கடத்தியது யார்?

badla-3.title: Badla
badla-3.description: Ek accident or Diya ne apni yaaddaasht ke saath saath apni saari property bhi kho deti hai. Majboori use uske Ex-husband ke paas le Jaati hai, Jahan use Qatl karaaz pata chalta hai or seedhi saadi Diya badla lene ka man bana leti hai. Kya ye badli hui Diya apna Badla poora kar paayegi? Aakhir koun hai jo Diya ke peeche pada hua hai?  Jaanne ke liye sunte rahein "Badla Season 1"!

bathukamma-festival.title: Bathukamma Festival
bathukamma-festival.description: Bathukamma panduga Telanganalo jarupukune oka pedda panduga prakruthitho mamekamaina Telangana prajala jivitham entho goppadi. Prakruthini aaradinchadam Telangana prajala samskruthi sampradayam. Theerokka poolatho kutumba sabhyulatho chinna pedda kalisi jarupukune ee panduga gurinchi vindam.

mindsight-the-new-science-of-personal-tr.title: Mindfulness Ki Best Exercises
mindsight-the-new-science-of-personal-tr.description: Yeh Original Show aapko Mind and Body ke beech ke Connection ko Explain Karta Hai. Aur batata hai ki hamare Past Experiences, hamare Present ke Behaviour ko kaise Effect karta hai.  Ise Sunne ke bad aap khud se aur connected feel karne lagenge, aap apne kaam ko mindfulness ke sath karne lagenge aur Apne Mind ko kaise balance rakhein, seekh sakte hain.

nandhini.title: NANDHINI
nandhini.description: Kalki inn ponniyin selvan la sila mukkiya kadhapaathirangal kadhai ah romba interesting ah vazhi nadathi selraanga. Indha audio book la NANDHINI nra kadhaapathiram seidha soozhchi ku kaaranam enna mattrum mukkiya tharunangala ah dhaan kekka poreenga.

how-to-select-perfect-insurance.title: How to Select Perfect Insurance
how-to-select-perfect-insurance.description: Indha Insurance plan na vaangunga, Andha Insurance Plan na vaangunga nu koovi koovi vikkaama.. Endha Insurance Plan ungalukku correct taa irukkum nu neengale mudivu edukka indha audio book ungalukku help pannum.Insurance pathina athanai kelvigalukkum indha Book la answer irukku. Ada ! Insurance la ivlo visayangal irukkaa? nu aacharyamaa irukku'nga. Insurance Pathina muzhumaiyaana indha thoguppu ungalukkaaga ! Kelunga.

the-goa-inquisition-the-terrible-tribuna.title: The Dark History of the Goa Inquisition
the-goa-inquisition-the-terrible-tribuna.description: Goa Inquisition, Jisme Roman Catholic Church ke dwara banaye gaye niyam anusar unki astha ke alawa baki sari Prathaye Hypocrisy Mani jati thi. Aur Jo iss hypocrisy ko mante the unhe search karke mara jata tha. Iss original audio show mein Goa ke Inquisition ki poori detail mein charcha ki gai hai.

chernobyl-012340.title: Chernobyl
chernobyl-012340.description: 26th April 1986 enna theeyathi loka charitrathile thanne oru theeranovayi ennum avasheshikkunnu. Chernobyl aanava durantham nadanna dinamanu athu. Ennum aa duranthathinte avasheshippukal bakki nilkkunna nagarathilude rechayithavaaya Andrew Leatherbarrow nadathunna yatrayudeyum oppam aa duranthathinte thanne ner chitravum ningalkku  'Chernobyl 01:23:40: The Incredible True Story of the World's Worst Nuclear Disaster' enna pusthakathilude lebhikkum.

maveeran-karnan.title: Maveeran Karnan
maveeran-karnan.description: Petra udaneye avanai anaadhai aakki vidugiraal avanadhu thaai. Valarum bodhu keli, kindal, avamathippu. Kalvi karkkum idathil kulathai kaaranam kaatti kalvi muzhumaiyaaga katru kodukka padavillai. Vanjanaigalaalum, keligalaalum, Sadhigalaalum thodarndhu avanai adakki odukki vanjikkave samoogam paarkkiradhu. Adakku muraigal anaithaiyum vendru maaveranaaga ezhundhu nirkiraan Karnan. Kodai vallalaaga, Natpin Ilakkanamaaga, Aanmai thavaraadhavanaaga Vaazntha  maaveeran Karnanin Kadhai idhu !

drive-3.title: Self Motivated kaise rahein?
drive-3.description: Aaj ki duniya mein high performance aur satisfaction ka big secret hamare apni zindagi ka control khud apne haath mein hona hai. Apneaap ko nayi chize sikhane ki itni zarurat padti hai magar is chiz ke liye andar se drive kaha se laaye? Kya aap bhi apneaap mein ye cheez missing paate hai? Toh suniye ye book summary aur jaane nayi cheezein!

think-and-grow-rich-29.title: Think And Grow Rich
think-and-grow-rich-29.description: Best-selling author Napoleon Hill's book "Think and Grow Rich," a guide to success, was first released in 1937, at the end of the Great Depression. It was accepted right away as a remedy for difficult times and remained a best-seller for decades. Many people still consider its positive thinking philosophy and its detailed methods for acquiring riches to be both relevant and life-changing. According to Hill, our thoughts shape our reality. He provides a strategy and set of guidelines for turning thoughts into riches, including visualization, affirmation, the formation of a Master Mind group, setting goals, and planning. Still a best-seller after 80 years of its initial release, this book has garnered the reputation of being a textbook for concrete ideas that can help anyone improve at anything.

en-uyir-maansi.title: என் உயிரே மான்சி
en-uyir-maansi.description: அலட்சியமும் ஆடம்பரமுமாக வாழும் ஆணும், ஒழுக்கத்தை உயிராக எண்ணும் பெண்ணும் இணைந்தால் என்ன நடக்கும்? விறுவிறுப்பான காதல் கதையைக் கேளுங்கள்...

burari-case.title: The Burari Death Case
burari-case.description: Burari Case –  Ek Hi Privar ke 11 logo ki Maut Ek sath, Burari Case Pure desh ki vo ghatna jiske bare me jankar man me kai saval uth jate hai. Aapne bhi jarur is ghatna ko TV par ya Mobile par dekha hoga, dukh hua hoga Aur kafi kuchh janne ki koshish bhi ki hogi. Is ghatna ko ham bariki se samjhenge, Unki Family kaisi thi? Dosto ka kya kehna tha? Relative’s ka kya kehna tha?  or sach ka pata lagane ki koshish karenge.

was-netaji-alive.title: Was Netaji Alive ?
was-netaji-alive.description: Ratham kodungal suthanthiram vaangi tharugiren nu sonnavaroda vaazhkaiyai therinjukanumaa ? Netaji ku enna thaan aachu ? . Intha kelvigalukellam vidai thaan intha pathivu. Yuttha Sarithirathai kekka ready aah ?

kashi-ram.title: Kanshi Ram - Bahujan Nayak
kashi-ram.description: Kanshiram – Dalit samaj ko Ek Rajneetik Samaj Inhone banaya, Kashiram kahte agar Dalit samaj ka Udhhar karna hai to Power to lani hogi aur Power satta me aane se milti hai. BSP Yani Bahujan Samajvadi, BAMCEF Jaise bade bade samudayo ki inhone sthapna ki Aur Dalito ko ek Pahchan di. Inki Life ka Ek hi Lukshya Tha Dalit samaj ka Vikas jiske liye inhone apna sab dav par laga diya. Ambedkar ke bad inhe Dalit samaj ka mashiha kaha jata hai. Is Journey me aap Kanshiram ke Apar sangharsh aur unke Jeevan hare k pahlu ko janege.

recent-advancements-in-automobiles.title: Recent Advancements in Automobiles
recent-advancements-in-automobiles.description: Automobile industry la nadantha evloution um revolution um intha modern age la namma ellaroda vaazhkailaiyume oru periya thaakathai erpaduthiruku. Antha kaalathula irunthu intha kaalam varaikum Automobile industry la nadantha maatrangalai intha pathivu moola kettu therinjukonga.

karl-marx.title: Karl Marx
karl-marx.description: Therinjo theriyamalo ivarukku namma ellarume nandri solla kadamai patrukom. Ethunaala nu therinjukanumaa ? Intha pathivu unga kelvikkana bathil aah irukkum. Communism pathiyum Karl Marx pathiyum pala interesting aana vishayathai kettu therinjukonga.

ruk-jana-nhi-1.title: Competitive Exams Ko Crack Karo
ruk-jana-nhi-1.description: Competitive exams yaa civil services exams ki taiyari karne wale youngsters ke liye ye kitaab ek guiding light ki tarah hai. Apne career ko ek positive roop se dekhne ke liye aur wo tamam chhote chhote life secrets jisse aapki personality behtar bane, aapko is book summary mein milengi. Shuru kare ye sunna aur laaye apne zindagi mein badlaav

narendra-modi-5.title: Narendra Modi
narendra-modi-5.description: Sila peroda saathanaigalukku pinnadi kadumayaana sothanaigalum vidaa muyarchiyum irukkum. Ivaroda saathanai payanam kandippa ungala mattum illa intha naattaye inspire pannum. Modi avargalai pathi theriyaatha pala vishayangalai intha pathivu mooolama therinjukonga.

the-compound-effect-11.title: The Compound Effect
the-compound-effect-11.description: Nissaramennu thonnunna pravarthanangalkku kaalakremena valiya maattangal nammude jeevithathil kondu varan sadhikkumennulla aashayamanu compound effect athava samyuktha prabhavam. Ella divasavum jeevithathil cheriya matangal varuthi nokku, ningal polum pratheekshikatha mattangal jeevithathil sambhavikkum. Athu engane anennu ariyan Darren Hardy de 'The Compound Effect' enna pusthakam kelkku.

what-wikipedia-cant-tell-you-about-stock.title: What Wikipedia Can't Tell You About Stock Market
what-wikipedia-cant-tell-you-about-stock.description: Stock Market ek aisa bazaar hai jaha roz logo ki kismat banti aur bigadti hai! Kaafi logo ka ye Primary source of income hai...Trading ke shuruaati din kaafi confusing hoti hai aur jaise har skill ko sikhne ke liye ek mentor zaruri hota hai. ye audiobook bhi apke Stock Market journey ka aisa pehla mentor banegi jisse aap bazaar ki hulchul ko kaafi aasan language me samaj sakte ho...to chaliye sikhte hai Stock Market & Trading kya hoti hai aur kese savdhani se use sikha aur azmaya jaye...

the-biography-of-albert-einstein.title: Albert Einstein
the-biography-of-albert-einstein.description: How did his mind work? What made him so brilliant? How the rebellious aspects of his psyche gave rise to his scientific imagination. His intriguing tale serves as proof of the link between freedom and creativity. In this series, we learn how a creative, impertinent patent clerk became the unlocker of the mysteries of the cosmos and the key to the secrets of the atom. His achievement came from questioning conventional wisdom and wondering at the mysteries that others considered banal. This led him to embrace morality and politics based on respect for free minds, free spirits, and free individuals. Listen to the exciting and complex life story of one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time only on KukuFM.

joseph-stalin-1.title: Joseph Stalin
joseph-stalin-1.description: Joseph Vissarionovich Stalin, a Georgian revolutionary turned Soviet political leader, exercised supreme power in the Soviet Union from 1929 until his death in 1953. First as the General Secretary of the Communist Party then as a Chairman of the Council of Ministers in the Soviet Union, Stalin redefined communism and redesigned Russia. But during his rule, he caused the imprisonment and execution of a million Soviet citizens per year. What drove him toward such ruthlessness? This series aims to offer an unprecedented, fine-grained portrait of Stalin - the man and dictator. Learn about the life of a dictator and enormously popular Soviet hero who induced fear and disgust but also respect and admiration through this exclusive series.

prerit-karne-ke-mission-ki-or-agrasar.title: Prerit Karne Ke Mission Par Agrasar
prerit-karne-ke-mission-ki-or-agrasar.description: Aajkal Hum Kaam Ki Jis Jaldbaazi Mein Rehte Hain Uske Beech Inspiration Aur Motivation Dhoodhne Ka Na Toh Hamare Pas Time Hai Aur Na Hi Himmat. Ye Audiobook Aapko Apne Har Ek Chapter Ke Zariye Zindagi Ke Alag Alag Rang Dikhaegi Aur Aapko Positivity Se Bhar Degi. Chaliye Sunte Hain Chhoti Chhoti Motivational Kahaniya Aur Koshish Karte Hain Zindagi Ko Aur Jyada Zindadilli Ke Saath Jeene Ki.

ಮಹಿಷಾಸುರ-ಮರ್ದಿನಿ.title: Mahishasura Mardini
ಮಹಿಷಾಸುರ-ಮರ್ದಿನಿ.description: 'ಮೈಸೂರು' ಅಂದಾಕ್ಷಣ ನೆನಪಾಗೋದು ಚಾಮುಂಡಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟ. ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಾಯಿಯ ದರ್ಶನ‌ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಮೂಲೆ ಮೂಲೆಯಿಂದ ಜನ ಬರ್ತಾರೆ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಈ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಮಹಿಷಾಸುರ ಮರ್ದಿನಿ' ನೆಲೆಸಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಮೈಸೂರಿಗೂ, ಮಹಿಷನಿಗೂ ಹಾಗೂ ಈ ದೇವಿಗೂ ಇರುವ ನಂಟೇನು? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವಾದ ಚಾಮುಂಡಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಮಹಿಷಾಸುರ ಮರ್ದಿನಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌. ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.!

narayan-murti.title: Corporate Gandhi - Narayan Murthy
narayan-murti.description: Jagatil ajachi ek aghadichi company mhanje Infosys. 1981 madhe Narayan Murthy yani tyancha patni Sudha Murty yanchakdun 10,000 rupaye udhar ghetale ani ya company chi suruvat keli. Prachand mehanat ani chikatichya joravar, anek sankatancha samna karat, nav-navin business strategies develop karat  Murthy yani Infosys la worl'ds top brand banvla. Chala, Ya audio book dvare janun gheuya Corporate Gandhi- Narayn Murthy yancha prernadayi prvas.

mossad-1.title: Mossad - The Greatest Mission of the Israeli Secret Service
mossad-1.description: Jasooso aur khufiya sevao ki duniya humesha se hi parde ke piche, duniya se dur rahi hai. Unke operations aur thikane humesha khufiya hi hote hai. Par yeh audio book "Mossad" The Greatest Mission Of The Israeli Secret Service" iss khufiya agencies ki andheri duniya ko expose karti hai. Iss audio book mein hum Israeli Gupt Seva, Mossad aur unke alag alag peheluo, khufiya gatividhio ke baarein mein janenge saath hi Syrian Atom Service ke naash, Black September aur kaafi prasiddh aur mulyavan Adolf Eichmann par kaise kabza hua Iss ke baarein mein bhi janenge.

ನಮ್ಮೂರು-ಮೈಸೂರು.title: Nammooru Mysuru
ನಮ್ಮೂರು-ಮೈಸೂರು.description: ಮೈಸೂರು... ಇದು ಕೇವಲ ಊರಲ್ಲ, ಅದೊಂದು ಭಾವನೆ! ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಬಾರಿ ಭೇಟಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟರೂ, ಬೇಸರ ಮೂಡಿಸದ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೈಸೂರು ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು..! ಅಂಬಾರಿ, ಅರಮನೆ ಹೊರತುಪಡಿಸಿ, ಮೈಸೂರು ಅಂದಾಗ ನೆನಪಾಗೋದೇ ಮೈಸೂರ್ ಪಾಕ್, ಮೈಸೂರು ಮಲ್ಲಿಗೆ, ಮೈಸೂರು ಸಿಲ್ಕ್ ಸೀರೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಲವು... ಆದ್ರೆ ಇವೆಲ್ಲವೂ ಮೈಸೂರಲ್ಲೇ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು? ಅದರ ಹಿಂದಿರುವ ಇಂಟ್ರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಕಥೆಗಳೇನು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಅನೇಕರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿದಿಲ್ಲ. ಈ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನೀವೂ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಬೇಕಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ, 'ನಮ್ಮೂರು-ಮೈಸೂರು' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್, ಓನ್ಲಿ ಓನ್ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂ...

the-everything-store_hindi.title: The Everything Store : Jeff Bezos and the Age of Amazon
the-everything-store_hindi.description: Amazon ki shuruaat book home delivery se hui thi par founder Jeff Bezos is cheez se satisfied nahi the! wo chahte the ke Amazon me sab kuch mile! jisme price lower ho aur ekdam sahuliyat se bhara experience ho! ye audiobook aapko aisi intresting secrets batayegi jise aaj tak koi bhed nahi saka! to chaliye jante hai Amazon kaise ek chhote se startup web se ek bada retail legend bana aur humare jivan ka tarika badal diya

ಜಂಬೂ-ಸವಾರಿ--ಇದು-ಅರಮನೆ-ಆನೆಗಳ-ಕಥೆ.title: Jamboo Savari : Idu Aramane Aanegala Kathe
ಜಂಬೂ-ಸವಾರಿ--ಇದು-ಅರಮನೆ-ಆನೆಗಳ-ಕಥೆ.description: ಜಗತ್ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಮೈಸೂರು ದಸರಾ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನೆನಪಾಗೋದು ವೈಭವಯುತ ಜಂಬೂಸವಾರಿ... ಜಂಬೂಸವಾರಿ ಅಂದಾಕ್ಷಣ ಕಣ್ಣ ಮುಂದೆ ಬರೋದು ರಾಜಗಾಂಭೀಯದಿಂದ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಹಾಕುವ ಗಜಪಡೆ...! ಅಂಬಾರಿ ಹೊತ್ತ ಆನೆ ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಹಾಗೂ ಅತನ ಸಂಗಡಿಗರ ಜೊತೆಗೆ  ಸಾಗುವ ಜಂಬೂ ಸವಾರಿ ನೋಡೋದೇ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಹಬ್ಬ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ಈ ಆನೆಗಳ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಹೇಗಾಗುತ್ತೆ? ಗಜಪಡೆಗೆ ನೀಡುವ ತಾಲೀಮು ಹೇಗಿರುತ್ತೆ? ಆನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಲಂಕಾರ ಮಾಡುವವರಾರು? ಇದೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನು ತಿಳ್ಕೋಳೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ' ಜಂಬೂ ಸವಾರಿ- ಇದು ಅರಮನೆ ಆನೆಗಳ ಕಥೆ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

kumartulir-shilpo.title: Pujo Barshiki: Kumartulir Shilpo
kumartulir-shilpo.description: Dheere dheere jonmo niyechilo Kolkatar Kumorpara ,mane Kumartuli. Kono peshar name e naam rakha elakao je eto bikhyato hote pare, tar jolonto example holo Kumartuli. Kumorder du haater dosh anguler jadute mati theke til til kore gore othen maa Durga. Sara bochorer por nijer bari pheren Maa Durga. Ei Kumartulir kumorder bohu jana ojana golpo janar jonno shune nin ei Puja Barshiki r Kumartulir Shilpo.

on-writing-a-memoir-of-the-craft.title: How to Become a Writer?
on-writing-a-memoir-of-the-craft.description: "On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft" Stephen King ne is book me writing ki Techniques aur Success Formulas bataye hai jo ek writer ko apni skills ko professionally grow karne liye bahut helpful hai. agar aap writer hai ya writer banna chahte hai to aapko ye book summary jarur sunna chahiye.  Agar aapko "Bird by Bird" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

బడ్జెట్-ట్రావెలింగ్.title: బడ్జెట్ ట్రావెలింగ్
బడ్జెట్-ట్రావెలింగ్.description: Early Morning Lechinappatinundi Nidrapoye Varaku Sampadana kosam Kashtapade Ee urukula Parugula Jeevitham Nundi Kaastha Rest Kosam Edain Tour ki vellalanipistundi. Kanee Present Situtaions ki Budget Chooste Vammo! Ippudu Ee Tour ki velladam Intha Dabbu Kharchu Cheyadam Avasarama Inkeppudaina Veldam le Ani Postpone chestuntam. Ayithe ippudu Aa Avasaram ledu. Ee Audio Book lo Cheppina Konni Vishayalanu Follow Ayyi Mee Tour ni Chakkaga Plan chesukoni Happy ga konni Rojulu Edaina Tour ki velli Prashanthamga gadipesi malli Mee Routeen life ki Vacheyandi.

india-russia.title: India-Russia
india-russia.description: ఇండియా- రష్యా మిత్రులుగా మారడానికి కారణాలేంటి? అంతరిక్షం, రక్షణ రంగాలలో రష్యా మనకు ఏ విధంగా సహాయపడింది? వినండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో.

detective-ragini-1.title: Detective Ragini- Bachna Hai Mushkil
detective-ragini-1.description: Detective Ragini haazir hai! Apne boss Detective Anuj ki kami ko pura karne aur ek bahut uljhi murder mystery ko suljhane aa rahi hai Delhi ki one of the best private investigator- Ragini. Detective Ragini ke hath laga hai apne parivar ke murder ke ilzam mein jail mein band Shweta ka letter. Kaise suljhayegi Ragini uljhe hue rishton ka khooni affair? Kya investigation se sach samne ayega? Ya Ragini ke pehle case par hi milegi kisi begunah ko gunah ki saza??

how-to-move-to-canada.title: How To Move To Canada
how-to-move-to-canada.description: Canada oka andamaina desham anthe kaadu avakashalaku peddillu. Endaro bharathiya vidyarthulu enno deshalaku chadavadam kosam velthuntaru annitlo Canada desham mana bharatheeya vidyarthulaku manchi udyoga, vidya avakashalanu kalpisthondi. Inka Canada gurinchi marinni vishayalu ee audio vini thelsukundam.

nehru-bose-parallel-lives-1.title: Jawaharlal Nehru Ar Netaji Subhas Chandra Er Kahini
nehru-bose-parallel-lives-1.description: Pandit Jawharlal Nehru ar Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose ei dujoneri e Indian politics ar Indian freedom struggle e jogdan asheem. Kintu apnara ki janen dujoner e political ideologies sompurno bhabe alada chilo? Ar dujoner ei  alada moter jonnyo dujoner somporkei anek dhoroner badha o durotto toiri hoi. Ar ei shob kichur byapar e Mahatma Gandhi r ki raye chilo shei shob jante shune nin ei boi tir sarangsho

ईटिंग-हैबिट्स-2.title: Veg vs Non-Veg. Which is better?
ईटिंग-हैबिट्स-2.description: Vegetarianism aur non vegetarianism mein kai sadiyon se debate hai. Magar aisa kyun hai ki kuch janwaro ko khaane ki society se maanyata milti hai magar baakiyo ki nahi? Kya hume ye decision lene ka adhikar hai? kYa hai dono ke fayde aur nuksan? Chaliye jaane

ಪಟ್ಟದರಸಿಯರ-ಪರಾಕ್ರಮ.title: Pattadarasiyara Parakrama
ಪಟ್ಟದರಸಿಯರ-ಪರಾಕ್ರಮ.description: 'ತೊಟ್ಟಿಲು ತೂಗುವ ಕೈ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನೇ ಆಳಬಲ್ಲದು' ಎಂಬ ಮಾತಿದೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಮಹಾರಾಣಿಯರು, ರಾಜಮಾತೆಯರು. ಅಂದಿನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲೇ ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಚುಕ್ಕಾಣಿ ಹಿಡಿದು, ಅದನ್ನ ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿದ ಕೀರ್ತಿ ಇವರಿಗೆ ಸಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಮಹಾರಾಜರಿಗೆ ಬೆಂಗಾವಲಾಗಿ ನಿಂತು, ಮೈಸೂರು ಸಂಸ್ಥಾನದ ಏಳಿಗೆಗಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರೋಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ ಸಹಕರಿಸಿದ ಅನೇಕ ಮಹಾರಾಣಿಯರು ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಪುಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇಂತಹ ಧೈರ್ಯವಂತ ಮಹಾರಾಣಿಯರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಳೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಪಟ್ಟದರಸಿಯರ ಪರಾಕ್ರಮ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

dulhan-on-run-1.title: Dulhan On Run
dulhan-on-run-1.description: Nivanya khush hai kyunki uski pasand ke ladke se uski shaadi ho rhi hai. Dulhan bani Nivanya aaj phere lene ke liye bekarar hai lakin agle hi pal vo shaadi ka joda utaar black hoodi mein ghar se bhaagne ke liye tyaar hai aur iss kaam mein uski madat karte hain Kaali charan ji. Jab sab kuch  Nivanya ke iccha ke anusaar ho rha tha to kyu ghar se bhagi vo? koun hai Kaalicharan, aur kyu  bhagne mein madat ki? Janane ke liye sune puri kahani 'Dulhan on Run' sirf Kuku FM per.

ರಾಜಯೋಗಿ-ಜಯಚಾಮರಾಜೆಂದ್ರ-ಒಡೆಯರ್.title: Rajayogi Jayachamarajendra Wadiyar
ರಾಜಯೋಗಿ-ಜಯಚಾಮರಾಜೆಂದ್ರ-ಒಡೆಯರ್.description: ಮಹಾರಾಜ ಜಯಚಾಮರಾಜೆಂದ್ರ ಒಡೆಯರ್... ಹೆಸರೇ ಹೇಳುವಂತೆ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ 'ಜಯ'ವನ್ನೇ ಕಂಡ ರಾಜಯೋಗಿ...! ಮಹಾರಾಜನೆಂಬ ಹಮ್ಮಿಲ್ಲದೇ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪ್ರಜೆಯಾಗಿ ಬೆರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಪ್ರಜಾವತ್ಸಲ..! ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಇವರೊಬ್ಬ ಉತ್ತಮ ದಾರ್ಶನಿಕ, ಸಂಗೀತ ಪ್ರೇಮಿ, ಕಲಾರಾಧಕ, ದೈವರಾಧಕ, ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ರಾಯಭಾರಿಯೂ ಹೌದು...ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನ ರಾಜತ್ವವನ್ನು ವಿಲೀನಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಪ್ರಜಾಕೋಟಿಯೊಡನೆ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಬೆರೆತ ಸ್ಥಿತಪ್ರಜ್ಞ...!  ಯದುವಂಶದ 25ನೇ ಹಾಗೂ ಅಂತಿಮ ದೊರೆಯಾಗಿ ಮೈಸೂರು ಸಂಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನಾಳಿದ ಜಯಚಾಮರಾಜೆಂದ್ರ ಒಡೆಯರ್ ಬದುಕು ಹಾಗೂ ಅವರು ನಾಡಿಗೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಅಪೂರ್ವ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಳೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ರಾಜಯೋಗಿ ಜಯಚಾಮರಾಜೇಂದ್ರ ಒಡೆಯರ್' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

the-creative-habit-learn-it-and-use-it-f.title: Kivabe Jibonke Creative Banaben ?
the-creative-habit-learn-it-and-use-it-f.description: Aapni Jodi Ei Kotha Vebe Chintay Thaken Je Jibonke Kivabe Creative Kora Jay, Kivabe Nijer Vetorer Creativityguloke Baire Aana Jay, Tahole Ei Audiobook Ti Aapnar Bondhu Hoye Uthte Pare. Ei Boite Emon Kichu Kotha Bola Aache Jegulo Aapni Follow Korte Parle Aapni Nijer Creativityguloke Baire Aante Parben Ebong Pritibite Aapnar Sunam Choriye Dite Parben. Tahole Aar Na Vebe Shune Nin.

life-and-tragedy-of-charlie-chaplin.title: The Life and Tragedy of Charlie Chaplin
life-and-tragedy-of-charlie-chaplin.description: Sar par kaali topi aur pehne hue kaala coat. Haatho ki ungliyon mein ghumti hui ek chhadi aur apne atrangi karnaamo se logo ko hasa-hasa kar lotpot kardene wale is kalakaar ko puri duniya - Charlie 'The Tramp' Chaplin ke naam se pujti hai. Bade sitaare aaye aur naa jaane kitne aayenge, magar Chaplin jaisa visionary aur daring artist naa toh kabhi tha aur naa hi hoga. America ki film industry ko mazboot shuruaat dene wala yeh England born immigrant boht hi takleefo aur parivaarik pareshaaniyo se joojhkar aisi shaksiyat bana jiski zindagi ka drama unke marte dum tak unke saath raha. Bina kuch kahe puri duniya ko hassaya aur apne ek monologue se Hitler aur capitalism ke khilaaf jung chedi. Chaliye sunte hai is legendary creative genius ki jeevan gaatha.

samrat-ashok-1.title: Samrat Ashok
samrat-ashok-1.description: Chakravarti Samrat Ashok - Itihasatil ek motha naav. Ek Shaktishali Raja te Baudha dharmacha prasarak ani pracharak.. asa Samrat Ashokancha preranadayi pravas, apan ya khas show madhe aiknar ahot. Samrat Ashokancha jeevnatil vividha prasang, chadh-utar ani rahasya janun ghenyasathi aikuya Kuku FM cha ha khas show.

how-to-stay-fit-in-our-busy-life-1.title: How To Stay Fit In Our Busy Life
how-to-stay-fit-in-our-busy-life-1.description: మన నిత్య జీవితం లో ఫిట్ గా ఉండాలంటే ఏమి చెయ్యాలి? ఏమి తినాలి? మనం తీసుకునే ఫుడ్ మనకు అన్ని పోషకాలను ఇస్తుందా? మరి మనలో పోషకాహార లోపం రాకుండా ఉండాలన్నా, మన బాడీ కి అన్ని విటమిన్ లు అందాలన్నా, ఏమి చెయ్యాలో వినండి.

1962-cuban-missile-crisis.title: 1962 Cuban Missile Crisis
1962-cuban-missile-crisis.description: 1962 mein do aise insaan hue, jinke haath mein is puri duniya ki taqdeer thi. American President John F. Keneddy banaam Soviet Union Leader Nikita Krushchev. Cuba, us waqt ek newly liberated communist nation bana. Fidel Castro ki leadership aur U.S.S.R ka support, America ko apne island se itne nazdeek raas nahi aaya. Global level par dominance ki race multiple conspiracies aur internal politics in dono desho ko is kagaar par le gaya jaha yeh ek dusre ke khilaaf nuclear hathiyaar lekar tainaat the. Kya hua tha 1962 mein, CIA aur KGB ka kya yogdaan tha is missile crisis ki taraf aur duniya nuclear exhaustion ke kitne kareeb aa chuki thi, sunenge is original audiobook mein.

ನವಶಕ್ತಿ-ವೈಭವ.title: Navashakthi Vaibhava
ನವಶಕ್ತಿ-ವೈಭವ.description: ದುಷ್ಟರ ಸಂಹಾರಕ್ಕಾಗಿ, ಶಿಷ್ಟರ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗಾಗಿ ನವ ಅವತಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ರೂಪಿಣಿಯೇ ದುರ್ಗಾದೇವಿ. ಈ ದುರ್ಗಾದೇವಿಯ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ದಿನಗಳ ಆರಾಧನೆಯೇ ನವರಾತ್ರಿ... ಈ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ದುರ್ಗೆಯ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ರೂಪಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂಜಿಸೋದು ವಾಡಿಕೆ... ಈ ಒಂದೊಂದು ರೂಪದ ಹಿಂದೆಯೂ ಒಂದೊಂದು ಕಥೆಯಿದೆ..! ಒಂದೊಂದು ಮಹತ್ವವಿದೆ..! ದುರ್ಗಾದೇವಿಯ ನವ ಅವತಾರಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಆರಾಧನೆ ಹಿಂದಿರುವ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಳೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ನವಶಕ್ತಿ ವೈಭವ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್...

joshi-abhyankar-hatyakand.title: Joshi Abhyankar Hatyakand
joshi-abhyankar-hatyakand.description: Hi ghatna ahe 1983 salatil. Jevha 4 serial killers ni Pune shahrala akshrshah hadrawun sodla hota. Samanya lok jyachi  kalpana dekhil karu shakat nhi ase he bhayanak hatykand tya weli Punyat ghadle. Nakki kay hoti hi sampurna case? Aikuya anagvar shahara annari ek chittathararak katha- 'Joshi Abhyankar Hatyakand'

the-happiest-man-on-earth.title: The Happiest Man On Earth
the-happiest-man-on-earth.description: "The Happiest man on Earth" ek aise Insan ka sansmaran hai jisne apni life me bhayanak vipreet paristhiti ka samna kiya, unke sare apno ko unse door kar diya gaya. Book Second world war se pahle ki Life ke saath shuroo hotee hai, belgium/jarmanee se door jaane aur Australia mein rahne se pahle Camps mein unke Experiences. Apni aankho ke samne logo ko marte dekhna, aur insaniyat ka sabse bura aur khaufnak scene dekhna unke liye ek seekh ban gaya. Lekin itna sab hone ke baad bhi vo khud ko duniya ka sabse "Khus insan mante hai" Inki Audiobook aapko himmat degi aur khush rahne ke liye bar bar inspire karegi.

moneyball-the-art-of-winning-an-unfair-g.title: Kom Budget E Bhalo Baseball Player Hoye Uthun
moneyball-the-art-of-winning-an-unfair-g.description: Billy Gene holen Oakland Athletics er general manager ebong Moneyball er prodhan nayok, ebong tar shobcheye boro somosya chilo ki bhabe game e jeta jaye tao abar khub e kom budget e. Ei Moneyball boi tir sarangsho ti shunle apnara jante parben je koto sohojei kom budgget e baseball game e jeta shombhob ebong jiboneo egiye jawa shombhob.

the-design-of-everyday-things-4.title: Kivabe Customer Tanben Aapnar Product-Er Dike ?
the-design-of-everyday-things-4.description: Steve Jobs Software Er Thekeo Nijer Banano Producter Design Er Opor Beshi Kheyal Rakhten. Jate User Jokhon Tar Product Use Korbe Tokhon Valo Kichu Feel Koren. Aar Etai Holo Design Namok Concept Er Jadu . Etai Kono Userke Product Kenar Jonyo Aakrishto Kore. Ekta Valo Design Ekjon User Er Songe Communicate Korte Sahajyo Kore, Aabar Ulto Dike Ekta Baje Design Sei Communication Na Korte Diye Venge Dey. Ei Audiobook E Aapni Sikhte Parben Kivabe Ekti Valo Design Kora Jay Ebong User Er Songe Valo Communicate Kora Jay. Aasun Tahole Shune Neyoya Jak Ei Audiobook.

the-little-book-of-hygge.title: Khush Rehne Ke Tareeke
the-little-book-of-hygge.description: Jeevan mein hum sab khush rehna chahte hai par khush rehne ke liye aisa kya karna chahiye ? kis tarah se hum hamesha khush reh sakte hai ? Denmark mein mausam kharab hone, tax rate high hone ke bawajud waha pe log sabse khush hai to iska karan kya hai ? Iss audiobook mein hum inhi pe charcha karenge aur janenge khush rehne ke formula ke baare mein jo hume madad karega humari khushiyan badhane mein

the-laws-of-success-1.title: The Laws of Success
the-laws-of-success-1.description: అసలు  విజయం  సాధించాలంటే  మనకు  తెలియాల్సిన  సూత్రాలు  ఏమిటి ? విజయం  మన  వశం  అవ్వాలంటే మనం  ఎలాంటి  మార్గం  లో  నడవాలి ? విజేతలవ్వడం  మీ  లక్ష్యమా  అయితే  మన  రోజు  దినచర్యలో  మన  జీవితకాలం  పాటు  మనం  చెయ్యవలసిన  పనులు  ఏమిటో  అవి   ఎలా  చెయ్యాలో  విందాం.

the-subtle-art-of-intraday-trading.title: The Subtle Art of Intraday Trading
the-subtle-art-of-intraday-trading.description: Har din Intraday Trading se paisa kamana ek kala hai, aur sahi guidance ke bina yeh kalaa nuksan mein bhi badal sakti hai. Isliye laaye hain hum aapke liye yeh khaas audio show, jismein aapko milenge Intraday Trading ki sahi techniques aur Money Management ke expert rules. Suniye aur banaaiye apne trading ka har din profitable.

rajendra-chozhan-kadarpadai.title: Rajendra Chozhan Kadarpadai
rajendra-chozhan-kadarpadai.description: Ulagin Mudhal Kappal Padaiyai uruvaakkiyavar  thamizh mannar Rajendra chozhan ! Thamizhanin Perumaiyai Kadal Kadandhu nilainaattiya Kadaaram Kondaan Rajendra chozhanin kadarpadaiyai patriya oru mulumaiyaana thoguppu idhu. Kelungal ! Thamizhargalin perumaiyai Viyandhu Potrungal !

black-tornado-the-three-sieges-of-mumbai.title: Black Tornado: The Three Sieges of Mumbai 26/11
black-tornado-the-three-sieges-of-mumbai.description: 26/11 Mumbai Terrotsit Attacks. Enganeyaanu Theevravaadikal Athu Nadappilakkiyathu? Enganeyaanu Nammudey Suraksha udyogasthar Bheekararey Keezhadakkiyathu? Orumaadu Jeevanukal Polinja Mumbai Bheekara Aakramanathinte Katha Ningalkku Shwaasam Adakkipidichu Maathrame Kelkkaan Kazhiyoo.

buffetology.title: Buffettology
buffetology.description: Top 10 Billionaires mein se ek Warren Buffett ka naam to aapne suna hi hoga. Warren Buffett duniya mein sabse successful investors mein se ek hai aur hum sab ko kabhi na kabhi yeh prashna to hua hi hoga ki kya hai unke trade secrets ? Kis stocks mein unke investment hai ? Unka approach kya hai ? Kaise bane wo vishwa ke dhani mein se ek ? Yeh sawalo ke jawab aap ko milenge iss audiobook mein. Agar aapko "The Intelligent Investor" jaisi books pasand hain, to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

women-on-mars.title: Women On Mars
women-on-mars.description: Mars Orbiter Mission Kinva Mom Ya Prakalpaantaragat Bharatachya I.S.R.O Ya Sausthene Avakashat Sodele Mangalyaan He Bhartache Pahilech Interplanetary Mission Hote . ISRO Ne Hey Hollywood Chya Eka Moviechya Nirmitisathi Yenarya Kharchapekshahi Kami Kharchat Yashasvi Karun Dakhavle. ISROche Hey Mangal Mission Succesfuly Honya Pathi Mahilancha Bahumolya Vatta Ahe. Yach Mahilani Mangalyan Projectmadhe Dilela Yogadanabaddal ani Tyani ISROchya Itarahi Projectmadhye Kelelya Mahatavpurna Kamagirbaddal Apan 'WOMEN ON MARS" Ya Original Series Madhye Ghenar Ahot. Hi Series Aiklyavar Mahilana Avkash Vidyan Ksehtrat Sanshodhan Ani Abhyas Karanchi Sphurti Nakkich Milel.

the-gifts-of-imperfection-1.title: Nijeke Bachiye Rakhun Vulnerability, Dukkho, Courage Diye
the-gifts-of-imperfection-1.description: Dr. Brene Brown nijer boi The Gifts Of Imperfection e bolechen je ki bhabe 10ta poddhotir dara khub e sohoj bhabe mon khule jibbon e bacha shombhob o jibon ke bhalo bhabe upobhog kora shombhob. Nijeder vulnerability, courage, dukkho, ityadir modhye diye nijeder ke ki bhabe jagiye rakha possible shob kichui ei boi er sarangsho te pawa jabe.

bs-dont-lose-your-mind-lose-your-weight.title: The Mindful Way To Weight Loss
bs-dont-lose-your-mind-lose-your-weight.description: Doston ek healthy brain niwas karta hai ek healthy body mein aur body ko healthy banana matlab apne wajan par kaabu karna, agar aap bhi apna weight control karna chahte hain aur shape main aana chahte hain wo bhi bilkul naturally aur bina paise waste kiye .To abhi suniye yeh super informative content sirf KUKU FM par.

un-vaanam-en-arugil.title: உன் வானம் என் அருகில்
un-vaanam-en-arugil.description: ராகினியைப் போன்ற பெண்கள் இந்த சமுதாயத்தின் சில பக்கங்களில் இருக்கத்தான் செய்கிறார்கள். 'எடுத்தேன் கவிழ்த்தேன்' என்று செயல்பட்டு சில நிமிட வானவில்களாய் வாழ்ந்து மறைந்துபோய்விடும் பெண்களும் உண்டு. அதுமாதிரியான பெண்களை எச்சரிக்கும் வகையில் எழுதப்பட்ட நாவல்தான் 'உன்வானம் என் அருகில்!'

victory-of-vijay-sankeshwar.title: VICTORY OF VIJAYA SANKESHWAR
victory-of-vijay-sankeshwar.description: ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಎಂಬ ಶಿಖರವನ್ನು ಏರುವುದು ಅಷ್ಟು ಸುಲಭವಲ್ಲ... ಕಷ್ಟ – ಅವಮಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸಿ, ಬೆಳೆದು ನಿಂತು ತೋರಿಸುವುದು ಆತ್ಮಬಲ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾದವರಿಗಷ್ಟೇ ಸಾಧ್ಯ..!  ಇಂತಹ ಮಾದರಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಅಪರೂಪದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು ವಿಜಯ್ ಸಂಕೇಶ್ವರ್..  ಸಾರಿಗೆ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ದಿಗ್ಗಜ, ಪತ್ರಿಕೋದ್ಯಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಸ ಆಯಾಮ ನೀಡಿದ ಸಾಧಕ, ರಾಜಕೀಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೈ ಎನಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ನಾಯಕ, ಮಧ್ಯಮ ವರ್ಗದ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ, ಇಡೀ ಜಗತ್ತೇ ತನ್ನತ್ತ ತಿರುಗಿ ನೋಡುವಂತೆ ಬೆಳೆದ ಈ ಸಾಧಕನ ಜೀವನಕಥೆ ಕೇಳಲು, KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ Victory of Vijay Sankeshwar ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ!

price-action-trading.title: Price Action Trading
price-action-trading.description: Agar Aap bhi Stock Market Ki Duniya Mein Naye Hain Lekin Trading Ki Alag Alag Techniques Ko Seekh Kar Paisa Kamana Chahte Hain Toh Ye Audiobook Aapke Liye Hain. Chaliye Seekhte Hain Price Action Trading Aur Jante Hain Trading Ke Unh Pillar Ko Jo Bnayenge Aapko Ek Successful Trader.

mkstalin.title: M.K.Stalin
mkstalin.description: Indraiya Tamilnadu Mudhal Amaicharum Dhravida Munnetra Kazhagathin Thalaivarum  aana M.K.Stalin avargalin arasiyal payanam kuritha oru paarvai. Kelunga "M.K.Stalin" on Kuku FM

management-lessons-from-iconic.title: Top Brands Se Success Seekho
management-lessons-from-iconic.description: Aaj India mein har koi start up karna chahta hai magar iska success rate kaafi kam hai. Toh kaunse aise points hai jo young Indian Entrepreneurs miss kar jaate hai? Janenge hamare apne kuch brands se jo India mein bane aur success ki sidhi chadhte chadhte duse desho tak pohoch gaye! Suniye is audiobook mein...

the-god-delusion-3.title: Bhogoban Ki Adou Achhen ?
the-god-delusion-3.description: Ei duniya te na kono isswar achen na kono super natural powers. Shune hoito odbhut lagtei pare kintu etai biswas koren Richard Dawkins, ar onar likhito The God Delusion boi er sarangsho ti shunle apnarao bujhte parben. Karon uni jodi hoten tahole onar existence er khobor o amra bujhte partam. Duniya ba jogot e bhogobaaner theke beshi science er proman ache.

ಸಾಯಿ-ಬಾಬಾ-ಚರಿತ್ರೆ.title: SAI BABA CHARITHRE
ಸಾಯಿ-ಬಾಬಾ-ಚರಿತ್ರೆ.description: ವಯಸ್ಸಾದ ಶರೀರ, ಮೈಮೇಲಿನ ಹಳೆಯ ಶ್ವೇತವಸ್ತ್ರ, ಕಣ್ಣಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಜ್ವಲಿಸೋ ದಿವ್ಯ ತೇಜಸ್ಸು.. ಇದು ಬಾಬಾ ಅಂದಾಕ್ಷಣ ಕಣ್ಮುಂದೆ ಬರುವ ಚಿತ್ರ. ಹೀಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಗುರುವಾರ ಆಯ್ತು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನೆನೆಯೋದು 'ಶಿರಡಿ ಸಾಯಿ ಬಾಬಾ' ಅವರನ್ನ‌.‌ ದೇವಮಾನವ ಅಂತಾನೇ ಸುಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧರಾದ ಬಾಬಾ, ತಮ್ಮ ಪವಾಡಗಳಿಂದಲೇ ಚಿರಪರಿಚಿತರು. ಜಾತಿ, ಧರ್ಮ, ಆಸ್ತಿ, ಅಂತಸ್ತನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದ ಭಕ್ರವೃಂದ ಬಾಬಾ ಅವರಿಗಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಹಿಂದೂ-ಮುಸ್ಲಿಂ ಐಕ್ಯತೆ ಸಾರಿದ, ಸಾಯಿ ಬಾಬಾ ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಯಾರು? ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬಾಬಾ ಅವರ ಪವಾಡಗಳಿಗೆ ಶರಣಾಗಿರೋದು ಯಾಕೆ?  ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಭಕ್ತರ ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಪವಾಡ ಪುರುಷ, ಸಾಯಿ ಮಹಾರಾಜ ಅಂತಾನೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧರಾದ 'ಸಾಯಿ ಬಾಬಾ ಚರಿತ್ರೆ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

an-indian-approch-to-learning-the-talent.title: The Talent Sutra
an-indian-approch-to-learning-the-talent.description: Yeh audiobook Devdutt Pattanaik ke influencer best seller Business Sutra se derive ki gayi hai jo workplace pe Creativity, Talent aur Teamwork ke importance ke baare mein baat karti hai. Isme lekhak real life example aur mythological stories ke examples se kai aise techniques batate hai, jo life mein successful hone ke liye humari help kar sakti hai

queen-elizabeth.title: Queen Elizabeth - II
queen-elizabeth.description: Elizabeth II  1952 nundi 2022 varaku Unted Kigndom mariyu 14 commonwealth rajyala rani. Aame 22 endlake britan raniga bhadhyathalu chapatti britan rajarika charithralo athyadika kalam 70 endlu palinchina ranigaa 2015 lo record srustinchindi.

queen-elizabeth-2.title: Queen Elizabeth -2
queen-elizabeth-2.description: ಕ್ವೀನ್ ಎಲಿಜಬೆತ್ II... ಈ ಹೆಸರು ಯಾರಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ ಹೇಳಿ? ಏಳು ದಶಕಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಬ್ರಿಟನ್‌ನ ಮಹಾರಾಣಿಯಾಗಿ ಮೆರೆದ ಈ ಮುಖ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಚಿರಪರಿಚಿತ...!  ಆದರೆ ಅವರ ಜೀವನ, ಸಾಧನೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಜನರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿದಿಲ್ಲ. ಒಬ್ಬ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಗುವಾಗಿ, ಚಿಕ್ಕ ವಯಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ಚುಕ್ಕಾಣಿ ಹಿಡಿದು, 70 ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕಾಲ ರಾಜ್ಯಭಾರ ಮಾಡುವುದೆಂದರೆ ಸುಲಭದ ಮಾತೇ ಅಲ್ಲ..!  ಇಂತಹ ಅದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಿದವರು ಮಹಾರಾಣಿ ಎಲಿಜಬೆತ್ II. ಸಮಾಜ ಸೇವೆ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜಕೀಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸದಾ ಮುಂಚೂಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ ಬ್ರಿಟನ್ ರಾಣಿ ಎಲಿಜಬೆತ್ II ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ, KuKuFM ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'Queen Elizabeth II' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್!

awaken-the-giant-within-2.title: Successful Life Ka Blueprint
awaken-the-giant-within-2.description: Hum Sabke Andar Ek Hero Chhupa Hota Hai Jo Rozmarra Ki Uljhano Mein Kahin Kho Jata Hai. Aapne Bohut Baar Suna Hoga Ki Insaan Jis Cheez Ko Bhi Dil Se Chaahe  Wo Use Hassil Kar Sakta Hai Lekin Ye Baatein Humein Bohut Hi Filmy Si Lagti Hain Aur Hum Maan Lete Hain Ki Hum Khudko Aur Apni Zindagi Ko Nahi Badal Sakte. Aayiye Is Book Summary Ke Saath Apne Andar Ke Hero Ko Jagane Ki Koshish Karte Hain.

sudha-murty-simplicity-behind-the-succes.title: SUDHA MURTY : Simplicity behind the Success
sudha-murty-simplicity-behind-the-succes.description: ಸುಧಾ ಮೂರ್ತಿ! ಈ ಹೆಸರು ಕೇಳಿದರೆ ಸಾಕು, ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದರೆ ಇವರು ಮಾಡಿದಂತೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು, ಬದುಕಬೇಕಾದರೆ ಇವರು ತೋರಿಸಿದ ಸರಳ ಜೀವನದ ಮಾರ್ಗವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಹಲವರು ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. TATA Motorsನ ಮೊದಲ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್ ಎಂಬ ಹೆಗ್ಗಳಿಕೆಗೆ ಪಾತ್ರರಾದ ನಮ್ಮ ಸುಧಾ ಮೂರ್ತಿ, Infosys ಕಟ್ಟಲು ನಾರಾಯಣ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಅವರ ಬೆನ್ನಿಗೆ ನಿಂತು ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಗುರುತನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡರು. ಆದರೆ, ಅವರ ಸಾಧನೆ ಇಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೇ ಸೀಮಿತವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸೇವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮನ್ನು ತಾವು ಗುರುತಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು, 3,000ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ದೇವದಾಸಿ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯೊಳಗಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಕಥೆ ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ರೋಚಕವಾಗಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಸುಧಾ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಅವರ ಈ ಅದ್ಭುತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಥೆಯೇನು? ಸಮಾಜಕ್ಕೆ ಅವರು ನೀಡಿರುವ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳೇನು? ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'SUDHA MURTY: Simplicity Behind the Success' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿ!

ಕೃಷಿಋಷಿ-ಯಶಸ್ವಿ-ರೈತರಿಗಾಗಿ.title: Krushi-Rushi : Yashaswi Raitharigagi
ಕೃಷಿಋಷಿ-ಯಶಸ್ವಿ-ರೈತರಿಗಾಗಿ.description: ನಿಮಗೇನಾದರೂ ಕೃಷಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಯೋಚನೆ ಇದ್ಯಾ ಅಥವಾ ಕೃಷಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಆಗಲು ದಾರಿ ಕಾಣದೇ ಒದ್ದಾಡ್ತಿದ್ದೀರಾ??? ಚಿಂತೆ ಬಿಡಿ, ಕೃಷಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿ ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲಾ ಗೊಂದಲಗಳ ಪರಿಹಾರಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಕೃಷಿ-ಋಷಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್. ನೀವೂ ಸಹ ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ರೈತರಾಗಿ..!

the-purpose-driven-life-what-on-earth-am.title: The Christian Life: A Journey Toward Purpose
the-purpose-driven-life-what-on-earth-am.description: Hamari zindagi ka asali maqsad kya hai aur hum yahan es dharti par kis liye aaye hain? Ye ek aisa sawal hai, jo har samjhdaar insan khud se puchta hai. Agar aap bhi jeevan ko gehraai se samjhna chahte hain to ye special show zaroor sunein.

kothashilpi-sarat-chandra.title: Kothashilpi Sarat Chandra
kothashilpi-sarat-chandra.description: Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay Bangla Totha Bharotiyo Sahitye Tar Lekhonir Moddhey Diye Chap Fele Gechen. Take 'Kothashilpi' Name Abhihito Kora Hoy. Tar Lekhonir Moddhey Ek Advut Style Chilo. Tar Lekha Pore Kadeni Emon Lok Khub Kom. Tar Sristiguli Diye Nana Movie, Web Series, Serialo Hoyeche. Lekhar Pashapashi Tini Swadhinota Songrame Tar Chap Rekhe Giyechen. Ei Lekhoker Jiboneo Emonkichu Utthan-Poton Eseche Ja Hyoto Amader Aneker Jana Nei. Seisob Kahini Jante Shunte Hobe Audiobook 'Kothashilpi Sarat Chandra'.

beyond-good-and-evil.title: Beyond Good And Evil
beyond-good-and-evil.description: "Beyond Good and Evil," by Friedrich Nietzsche, dramatically rejects the tradition of Western thought with its notions of truth and God, good and evil.  With wit and energy, he turns from his critique of Western beliefs and convictions to a philosophy that celebrates the present and demands that the individual imposes their own 'will to power' upon the world. This book explores Nietzsche's ideas about the free spirit, the virtues of European culture, nationalism, and the moral concepts of good and evil, in addition to criticizing Western morality and philosophers' conceptions of truth and advancing Nietzsche's philosophical insights into human psychology. This book has influenced various philosophers, thinkers, and writers. It continues to be regarded as a classic work of art.

reasons-to-stay-alive.title: Reasons to Stay Alive
reasons-to-stay-alive.description: Duniya mein har 5 mein se ek insaan depression se jujh raha hai, unme se ek Matt Haig bhi the. Lekin, unhone depression ko apne aap ko khatam nahi karne diya. Ulta Matt ne har roz, har minute, iss bimaari se ladayi ladi. Apni iss kitaab mein, writer ne yahi bataya hai ki, kaise depression hone ke baad, aapke paas sirf 2 choices hoti hai, ya toh aap usse khud ko puri tarah conquer karne de, ya fir usse ladkar, apne aap, chhoti chhoti khushiyon ke liye zinda rakhe. Chaliye jante hai ki, iss impossible ko Matt Haig ne kaise possible kiya.

the-miracle-of-right-thought-1.title: The Miracle Of Right Thought
the-miracle-of-right-thought-1.description: Discover the profound impact of positive thinking with "The Miracle of Right Thought" by Orison Swett Marden. This audiobook unveils the transformative power of our thoughts in shaping success and happiness. By exploring the connection between thoughts, emotions, and actions, this audiobook offers a roadmap to break free from self-limiting beliefs, enhance resilience, and create a life of purpose. Whether you're seeking personal growth, professional success, or improved relationships, "The Miracle of Right Thought" equips you with the tools to harness the miracles that positive thinking can bring into your life.

dhyan-sadhana-ka-saral-abhyas.title: Meditation and It's Practice
dhyan-sadhana-ka-saral-abhyas.description: Yadi aap dhyan ya meditation practice karna chahte hai par aap ko pata nahi ki use kaise kiya jaye, to yeh audiobook aapke liye ek guide hai jo step by step iske baare mein samajhti hai. Yeh audiobook aapko dhyan ka abhyas karne ka ek exact idea deti hai aur saath hi saath meditation ki shuruaat mein aane wale challenges aur unke solutions ke baare mein bhi batati hai. Agar aapko Deepak Chopra dwara likhi gayi "Total Meditation" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

practicing-the-power-of-now-1.title: Jibone Active Hoye Bachar Upay
practicing-the-power-of-now-1.description: Amader ei roj kaar jibone ki bhabe active thaka jaye bujhte parchen na? Khub e osubidhe hochhe doinondin jibon e khushi o active rakhte nijeke? Tahole ar deri na kore ei boi tir sarangsho shune nin ar jene nin ki bhabe bhalo kore active hoye bacha jaye.

never-split-the-difference-5.title: Negotiation Ebong Communication-Er Modhye Basic Parthokyo
never-split-the-difference-5.description: Aamader Ei Lomba Jibone Kotha Bolte Parata Ekta Boro Odhyay. Ei Odhyay Aamra Chotobela Theke Sikhte Shuru Kori. Kivabe Kotha Bola Uchit, Kon Kotha Bola Uchit Eirokom Kichu. Kintu Negotiation Holo Emon Ekta Jinis Jeta Ekjon Ekjonke Dekhe Sekhe. Sobai Thikthakvabe Negotiation Korte Paren Na. Ebar Tahole Proshno Holo Kivabe Seta Kora Jay? Kivabe Kotha Bola Uchit? Kon Kotha Kon Poristhitite Bola Uchit? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Somadhan Pete Aapnake Shunte Hobe Ei Audiobook.

hero-ki-kahani.title: Hero ki Kahani: Chaar Bhaiyon Ka Audhyogik Chamatkaar
hero-ki-kahani.description:
Ye kahani unn bhaiyo ke bare me hai jinki company ka naam har indian ko pata hai “Hero” , 4 munjal bhai jinhe partition ke baad pakistan me apna ghar chhod ke india ana pada, bank se loan lekar cycle ke parts ka buisness shuru kiya aur kadi mehnat se apne buisness aur india ki automobile industry ko mazboot kiya , to chaliye sunte hai
”HERO” ki kahani

biography-of-dr-br-ambedkar.title: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
biography-of-dr-br-ambedkar.description: Bharat Ratna Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar is a timeless inspiration, and his life continues to be significant for societies, particularly those that are dedicated to advancing humankind. His legacy as a socio-political reformer had a deep effect on modern India. This show intends to draw attention to the crucial part Ambedkar played in enhancing the lives of untouchables as well as the proactive and inspirational role he played in creating modern India. We bring you the story of his greatest accomplishments in creating India's constitution and his contribution to the advancement of the oppressed. Learn more about the idealistic life and works of Babasaheb Ambedkar.

draupadi-murmu-the-president-of-india.title: Droupadi Murmu - The President of India
draupadi-murmu-the-president-of-india.description: A tribal woman as the President of India. What would be your reaction to this statement? In 2022, this seems plausible. But what about ten years ago? Her election as the 15th President of India was not only a moment of celebration but also made her an inspiration for people all across the globe. She is the second woman to hold the position after Pratibha Patil and the first member of a tribal community to do so. Additionally, she is also the first President to be born after independence and is the youngest to occupy the top post. But the road to the President's office has not been easy for her. Through this show, we will learn about her struggles and her rise as a politician to the position of the President of India.

कैसा-ये-प्यार-है-1.title: Kaisa Ye Pyaar Hai
कैसा-ये-प्यार-है-1.description: "Aadri ki duniya mein emotions aur pyar ke liye koi jagah nahi hai. Papa ke kehne par India aata hai, Kuch dino ke liye likin Shija se milne ke bad uski duniya badal jaati hai. Pyaar ki feelings se Aadri Aur Shija dono anjan hai aur aadri wapas USA chala jata hai. Dooriyaan dono ko unke pyar ka ahsas karati hai. To kya yai pyaar pura hoga? Janane ke liye sune puri kahani "Kaisa Yai Pyaar Hai" Only on Kuku FM !

veermata-jijau-aaisaheb.title: Rajmata Jijau Aaisaheb
veermata-jijau-aaisaheb.description: Chatrapati Shivjai Maharajan sarkhya waghala janma dearya, Rajmata mhanje Jijau aaisaheb. Hindvi swarajya ghadvnarya Shivbala jyani ghadvle, Aikuya, goshta tya rajmata Jijaunchi..

சிவகாமியின்-சபதம்-பாகம்4--சிதைந்த-கனவு.title: சிவகாமியின் சபதம் - 4
சிவகாமியின்-சபதம்-பாகம்4--சிதைந்த-கனவு.description: புலிகேசியுடனான போரில் மாமன்னர் மகேந்திரர் வீர மரணமடைகிறார். தந்தைக்குப் பிறகு முடிசூடிய நரசிம்மவர்மர் சாளுக்கியரைப் பழிவாங்கும் நோக்கில் படையெடுத்து, சாளுக்கியர்களின் தலைநகரான வாதாபியை அழித்துத் தீக்கிறையாக்குகிறார். இதற்கிடையே சிவகாமியைக் காதலித்த பிஷூவின் காதல் என்ன ஆனது? சிவகாமியின் மீதான நரசிம்மரின் காதல் என்ன ஆனது? கேளுங்கள்...

har-lamha-ek-upahar.title: The Gift : 12 Lessons to Save Your Life
har-lamha-ek-upahar.description: ZIndagi sukh dukh ka combination hai jaha sab apne purane bad experience ko humesha sath le kar chalte hai . Ye kahani holocaust survivor Edith Eger ki hai ke kese unhone apna bachpan nazi concentration camps me bitaya apne aapko sambhala aur psychology padhkar dusro ki madad ki , ye kitab ek ultimate healing guide hai , jo aapke liye ek achhe dost ki tarah apko zindagi ki positive side dikhayega, to chaliye sunte hai...

gst-explained-2.title: GST EXPLAINED
gst-explained-2.description: ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರ ನಿದ್ರೆ ಕದಡಿದ ವಿಚಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ GST ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು..! ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಈ GST ಅಂದರೆ ಏನು? ಅದು ಯಾಕೆ ಮಹತ್ವದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ? ಇದರಿಂದ ಯಾವ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನಗಳು? ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಯಾವ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರತಿಶತ GST ಇದೆ? ಇವೆಲ್ಲಾ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕಾ? ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಕೇಳಿ, KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ 'GST EXPLAINED' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್!

educated-tara-westover.title: The Power Of Education
educated-tara-westover.description: Bill gates recommended yeh audiobook aapko samjhayegi ki Education aur Freedom kitna important hai aur kaise ek acche education se aap apna jeevan badal sakte hai. Kabhi na kabhi jeevan mein mushkil sabko aati hai jo ek Insaan ko puri tarah se tod deti hai, par un mushkilo se lad kar unpe jeet hasil karne wale ko hi sacha vijeta kehte hai aur aisi hi kahani ki charcha karenge hum is audiobook mein

rakesh-jhunjhunwala.title: RAKESH JHUNJHUNWALA
rakesh-jhunjhunwala.description: India oda unmaiyaana Business Magnet yaaru theriyuma? Adhu mattum illa Stock market oda king nu ivara solraanga. Ivaru yaaru, Appadi ennalam senju panam sambaadhichaaru nu indha audio book moolama therinjikka poreenga.

why-nations-fail-3.title: Ki Ki Karone Shob Desh Sofol Ba Bifol Hoi
why-nations-fail-3.description: Apnara ki kokhono lokkho kore dekhechen je anek somoy anek boro bor desh o goreeb hoi aro anek choto choto desh successful hoi. Etar ashol karon ta ki? Emon ki ki karon thake ja ei desh gulo ke successful ba unsuccessful toiri kore tole? Kukufm e ei boi tir sarangsho shunle apnar thik jante pere jaben ki ki karone ekti desh successful ba unsuccessful hoi.

tera-suroor-1.title: Tera Suroor
tera-suroor-1.description: Tooti shaadi ke dard se sambhal rahi Sameera ki zindagi tab palat jaati hai jab uske pita dhokhe se uski shaadi mashhoor business tycoon Rehan Singhaniya se kar dete hain. Rehan ka handicapped hona bhi Sameera ko uske kareeb aane se nahi rokta. Par ek raat uske pregnant hone ka sach sab kuch hila deta hai. Kya Rehan apna payega is anjaane bacche ko? Dhokhe ki is shaadi ka kya hoga anjaam?

how-to-talk-to-anyone-2.title: Kotha Diye Biswajoyer Secret
how-to-talk-to-anyone-2.description: Jibone Hoyoto Aapni Emon Poristhitite Porechen Aapnar Paser Mansuhti Confidence Er Songe Kotha Bolche, Kintu Aapni Parchen Na. Aabar Office Er Kono Meeting E Aapnar Boss Ba Kono Sohokormi Kotha Bolchen Kintu Aapni Kotha Bolar Confidence Pacchen Na. Hoyoto Aapni Ekjon Sofol Byakti Kintu Thikvabe Communicate Korte Parchen Na Sobar Songe. Kivabe Communication Skill Barano Jay? Kon Poristhitite Kon Kotha Bola Uchit? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Uttor Pete Aapnake Shunte Hobe Ei Audiobook .

ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್-ಪೇಮೆಂಟ್-ಎಷ್ಟು-ಸೇಫ್.title: Digital Payment: Eshtu safe?
ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್-ಪೇಮೆಂಟ್-ಎಷ್ಟು-ಸೇಫ್.description: ನಿಮ್ಮ‌ ಅಕೌಂಟಲ್ಲಿ ದುಡ್ಡಿದ್ದು, ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಫೋನ್ ಇದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು. ನೀವು ಇಡೀ ದೇಶವನ್ನೇ ಸುತ್ತಾಡ್ಬಹುದು. ಯಾಕಂದ್ರೆ ಇದು 'ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಯುಗ'. ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪೇಮೆಂಟ್ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸೇಫ್? ಇದ್ರಿಂದ ಯಾವೆಲ್ಲಾ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿವೆ? ಯಾವುದೇ ತೊಂದರೆಗಳಿಲ್ಲದೇ, ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪೇಮೆಂಟ್ ಮಾಡೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸಾಕ್ಷನ್ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ಕಂಪ್ಲೀಟ್ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಪೇಮೆಂಟ್: ಎಷ್ಟು ಸೇಫ್' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್!

trading-in-the-zone-2.title: Stock Market mein Risk kaise lein?
trading-in-the-zone-2.description: Ye book summary stock market mein chal rahe myths se parda uthane ke liye, traders ko apne judgement se pare dekh paane ke liye aur asli maaynbe mein risk aur probability kya hoti hi ye samjhane ke liye hai! Agar aapko "The Little Book that still beats the Market" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

heavenly-life-2.title: The Heavenly Life
heavenly-life-2.description: In "The Heavenly Life," James Allen, one of the most popular inspirational writers in the early 20th century, shows the path to inner peace amid a noisy and cluttered world. This book is a summary of thoughts, calling man to a higher and purer way of living while elevating the necessary discipline of the inner man that makes him an otherworldly person. His advice is spiritual and practical - be in the moment, seek simplicity, and push past the clutter to find your inner goodness. He presents an interesting and peaceful philosophy of how to live and what it means to be a good person. These words are as valuable today as when they were first written and provide a welcome balm to uneasy souls in an uncertain world.

heartfulness.title: ది హార్ట్ ఫుల్ నెస్  వే - దాజి కమలేష్ డి పటేల్
heartfulness.description: Elanti savaalulonaina munduku sagadaniki oka margaanni kanugonadaniki mariyu athyantha klistaparisthithini kuda edagadaniki oka avakashamgaa chusenduku manaku spoorthinisthundi. konni sadharana abhyasaalu, uthsaham tho nindina hrudayam mariyu vistharamaina spruhatho manamandaram mana samarthyanni mariyu manam neraverchadaniki janminchina vidhini kanugonagalamani daaji chepparu.

little-book-common-sense-investing.title: Trading aur investment ka Manual
little-book-common-sense-investing.description: Long run mein Wealth banane ke liye kya hai sabse easy aur simple strategy? Kya mutual funds labhdayak hai? Iska maximum fayda kaise kare? Jaane aise kai saare trade secrets is book mein! Agar aapko One Up On Wall Street jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

the-power-of-regret-1.title: Bhul Thik Kore Sothik Pothe Hatar Secrets
the-power-of-regret-1.description: Apnio ki regret theke mukti chan? Tahole ar beshi deri na kore ekhoni shune nin ei boi tir sarangsho. Anek somoy hoi je amader jiboner purono bhul gulo niye amra bhabte thaki je amra shei bhul gulo nao korte partam, kintu jodi apnader bola hoi je shei shob bhul thekei notun kichu shuru korar sujog paben, tahole kemon hoi? Ekdom e tai 'The Power Of Regret' boi tir sarangsho ti shunle apnara khub sohojei nijeder bhul ke notun ebong positive bhabe dekhte shikhben.

the-curious-parent.title: The Curious Parent
the-curious-parent.description: Har roz hum bachon ke saath samay bitate hai. Hamara har bitaya hua samay bachon pe ek chhoti si chhap chhod deta hai. In choti choti chaapon se guzar kar bacha bada hota hai. Har chaap ka bachey par asar hota hai. Chaliye thodi baatein karte hai bacchon aur parenting ke baare mein. For any questions related to parenting, you may connect with Harpreet on Instagram at harpreet_thecuriousparent or write to him at hello@thecuriousparent.com

911-attack.title: 9/11 Attack
911-attack.description: Yavatthu prapanchaanni digbhranthiki lonayyela chesina sangatana. Athi samanya prajalu dadilo pranaalu kolpoyaaru. Asalu 9/11 naadu emi jarigindi elaa jarigindi aa dadiki suthradarulu evaro ee audio book lo vindam.

ತಾಲಿಬಾನ್-ರಕ್ತಚರಿತ್ರೆ.title: Taliban Rakthacharithre
ತಾಲಿಬಾನ್-ರಕ್ತಚರಿತ್ರೆ.description: ತಾಲಿಬಾನ್ ಅಂದಾಕ್ಷಣ ನೆನಪಾಗೋದು ಕ್ರೌರ್ಯ, ಹಿಂಸೆ, ನೋವು, ಭಯ... ಆದರೆ ಈ ತಾಲಿಬಾನ್ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡಿರೋ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದಿತ್ತು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನೀವು ನಂಬ್ತೀರಾ??! ಹೌದು, ಜನರ ಒಳಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡ ಈ ಒಕ್ಕೂಟ, ಮುಂದೆ ಹಿಂಸಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ ಬೆಳೆಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಅಂದಹಾಗೇ ಈ ತಾಲಿಬಾನ್ ಅಂದ್ರೇನು? ತಾಲಿಬಾನಿಗಳು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಯಾಕಿಷ್ಟು ಭಯ? ಇದೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಬೇಕಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ  'ತಾಲಿಬಾನ್ ರಕ್ತಚರಿತ್ರೆ'  ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

tough-times-never-last-but-tough-people-.title: How To Deal With Tough Times
tough-times-never-last-but-tough-people-.description: Aap sirf apna problem bataiye aur yeh Original Show aapko uska solution batayega. Jitne bhi problems kyun na ho aap apne aap ki self image kaise bana sakte hain yeh aap iss show ko sun kar sikhenge. Unemployment, poor  health, loneliness, jitne bhi problems zindagi mein aaye aap apna highest potention life mein achieve kar sakte hain.

theriyadha-manidhargalin-therindhukolla-.title: Theriyadha Manidhargalin Therindhukolla Vendiya Kadhaigal
theriyadha-manidhargalin-therindhukolla-.description: Google la kooda ivanga names sa naama thedi thaan kandupidikka mudiyum ! Miga periya saadhanaigala senjuttu yaarukum theriyaama maranju irukkura theriyaadha manidhargalai patriya oru ariya thoguppu thaan indha padhivu ! Indha real life heros kadhaigal ungalukkum inspiration na irukkum, Kelunga !

the-magic-of-thinking-big-13.title: Nijer Opor Biswas Rekhe Sofolota Pan
the-magic-of-thinking-big-13.description: Jibone Sofolota Pete Gele Nijeke Vabte Hobe. Apnar Postive Vabnai Aapnake Ene Debe Safolyo. Nijer Byarthotake Vule Aabar Uthe Darate Hoy. Nijer Opor Aatmobiswas Rakhte Hobe. Ebar Aapnar Mone Proshno Jagbe Kivabe Nijeke Sthir Rakha Jay? Kivabe Sothik Vabna Vaba Jay? Kivabe Nijer Opor Aatmobiswas Barano Jay? Srijonshil Chintadhara Kivabe Somvob? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Somadhan Pete Apnake Shuntei Ei Audiobook .

the-5-love-languages.title: Jaane apne Partner ki Love Language
the-5-love-languages.description: Pyaar mein padna aasan hai, par use nibhana mushkil. Demands, struggles aur daily life ki boriyat ke beech apne rishte ko fresh aur grow kaise kare? Bohot saare aise secrets leke aayi hai ye summary book aapke liye!

varalatril-chennai.title: Varalatril Chennai
varalatril-chennai.description: Namma Chennai oda paarambariyamaana varalaaru rombave perusu. Vanthaarai Vaazhavaikkum Chennai oda swarasyamaana varalaarai intha pathivu moolama kelunga.

narendra-modi-4.title: Narendra Modi
narendra-modi-4.description: టీ అమ్ముకుంటూ జీవితం సాగించే వ్యక్తి భారతదేశానికి ప్రధానమంత్రి ఎలా అయ్యాడు? అంచెలంచెలుగా ఎదిగి, నేడు ప్రపంచాన్ని శాసిస్తున్న మోడీ గురించి విని తెలుసుకోండి.

how-to-boost-your-self-confidence.title: How To Boost Your Self Confidence
how-to-boost-your-self-confidence.description: Kuch Log Academics Mein Toh Ustaad Hote Hain Lekin Jab Baat Aati Hai Job Interview Ki Toh Wahan Wo Low Self Confidence Ke Chalte Fail Ho Jate Hain Similarly Kuch Log Zindagi Bhar Apne Pyar Ka Izhaar Nahi Kar Pate, Khud Ko Sahi Tarah Se Express Nhi Kar Pate Lekin Dusri Taraf Hum Dekhte Hain Kuch Log Na Hi Academics Mein Bahut Acche Hote Hain, Na Hi Unmein Koi Dusra Talent Hota Hai Lekin Fir Bhi Unka Self Confidence Dekh Kar Aisa Lagta Hai Ki Jaise Ye Log Duniya Hi Jeete Lenge. Toh Chaliye Jante Hain Ki Aakhir Kaise Aap Bhi Aisa Hi Duniya Jeet Lene Wala Self Confidence Hasil Kar Sakte Hain.

the-daily-stoic-2.title: Sikhe Nin Bhoy Ke Joy Korar
the-daily-stoic-2.description: Ekhonkar modern jibon japon manei ektu mawja ar ektu shaja. Bola jaye ekebare roller coaster er moto, jekhane mawja o hoi abar bhoy o. Kintu ei jatra poth e ar bhoy pawar doarkar nei karon apnader jonnyo ana hoyeche 'The Daily Stoic' er sarangsho jeta shune khub sohojei shikhe jaben bhoy ke joi korar upay.

ഓണം-സൂപ്പർ-ഹിറ്റുകൾ.title: Onam Super Hits
ഓണം-സൂപ്പർ-ഹിറ്റുകൾ.description: പൂക്കളത്തിൻ്റെയും പുത്തനുടുപ്പിന്റെയും സദ്യയുടെയും മാത്രമല്ല തിയേറ്റര്‍ നിറഞ്ഞ കൈയ്യടികളുടെയും ആരവങ്ങളുടേയും കൂടിയാണ്‌ ഓണക്കാലം. മലയാളി നെഞ്ചേറ്റിയ വന്‍ഹിറ്റുകളുടെ കൊയ്‌ത്തുകാലം. ഇന്നും ഓണറിലീസ്‌ മാത്രം ലക്ഷ്യം കണ്ട്‌ നിര്‍മ്മിക്കുന്ന ചിത്രങ്ങളുണ്ട്‌ മലയാളത്തില്‍. അത്തരത്തില്‍ കണ്ട്‌ മറന്ന നൊസ്‌റ്റാള്‍ജിയകളിലേക്കുള്ള ഒരോട്ടപ്പാച്ചിലാണ്‌ ഇത്‌.

emotional-intelligence-1.title: Mastering Your Emotions
emotional-intelligence-1.description: Is competitive duniya mein shanti aur safalta se bhari zindagi jeene ka ek asaan tarika hai - apne emotions ko niyantrit rakhna. Lekin apne emotions ko kaise control karte hain? Is kala ko bina kisi ki sahayata ke kaise sikhte hain? In sab sawaalon ke jawab ke liye suniye yeh special show!

ನಟಸಾರ್ವಭೌಮ.title: Natasarvabhouma
ನಟಸಾರ್ವಭೌಮ.description: 'ಅಭಿಮಾನಿಗಳನ್ನೇ ದೇವರು' ಎಂದ ದೇವತಾ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಇವ್ರು.. ಹುಟ್ಟಿದರೆ ಕನ್ನಡನಾಡಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಹಾಡುತ್ತಾ, ಬಾನಂಗಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾರಿದ ಬಂಗಾರದ ಮನುಷ್ಯ..! ಬೇಡರ ಕಣ್ಣಪ್ಪನಾಗಿ ಗಂಧದಗುಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಗಿದ ಬಹದ್ದೂರ್ ಗಂಡು..! ಸಂಪತ್ತಿಗೆ ಸವಾಲ್ ಹಾಕಿ, ಬಡವರ ಬಂಧುವಾಗಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಗಳ ಜೀವನ ಚೈತ್ರವಾಗಿಸಿದ ನಟಸಾರ್ವಭೌಮ ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ವರನಟ ಡಾ.ರಾಜ್ ಕುಮಾರ್...! ಐದು ದಶಕಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಕನ್ನಡ ಚಿತ್ರರಂಗದ ಅನಭಿಷಕ್ತ ದೊರೆಯಾಗಿ ಮೆರೆದು, ಸರಳ, ಸಜ್ಜನಿಕೆಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಮೂಲಕ ಸರ್ವರಿಗೆ ಮಾದರಿಯಾಗಿ ಬದುಕಿದ ಈ ಮಹಾನ್ ಕಲಾವಿದನ ಬದುಕಿನ ಕಥೆಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ನಟಸಾರ್ವಭೌಮ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್...

the-diary-of-a-young-girl-1.title: The Diary Of A Young Girl
the-diary-of-a-young-girl-1.description: Second World War Ke Dauran Hilter Ki Tanashahi Ke Chalte Jewish Community Par Hue Zulmon Ke Bare Mein Kaun Nahi Jaanta. Apni Jaan Bchane Ke Liye Bohut Se Jews Parivar Apna Ghar-Bar Sab Chhod Kar Safe Jagahon Par Jakar Chhup Gaye The. Anne Frank Ki Is Diary Ki Shurwat Uske 13th Birthday Par Hui Aur Fir Achanak Anne Ke Parivaar Ke Pakde Jaane ke Baad, 1 August 1944 Mein Ye Diary Khatam Ho Gayi. War Ke Us Daur Mein Jews Logon Ki Zindagi Kaisi Thi Aayiye Jaante Hain Is Full Book Mein.

greatest-temples-in-telangana.title: Greatest Temples In Telangana
greatest-temples-in-telangana.description: Prapancha prakhyathiganchina enno devalayalu kaligina mana Telangana loni devalayala gurinchi manamu ee audio book lo vindaam. Yadadri, vemulawada, inkaa marenno prasiddha devalayala vishleshana mee kosam.

മഹാബലി-അസുര-രാജാവ്.title: Mahabali: Asura Rajavu
മഹാബലി-അസുര-രാജാവ്.description: ശരിക്കും ആരാണ് മഹാബലി? എന്തുകൊണ്ടാണ് നമുക്ക് അദ്ദേഹത്തോട് ഇത്ര സ്നേഹം? കേൾക്കാം നീതിമാനായ മഹാബലിയുടെ  കീർത്തിയും വേറിട്ട കഥകളും.

option-trading-guide.title: Option Trading Guide
option-trading-guide.description: Option Trading guide new traders ke saath saath Option trading pehle se use karne waale traders ke liye kaafi useful hai. Jinhe lagta hai ki Option Trading ek risk hai unka confusion bhi yeh audiobook dur karegi aur profit kamaane ke chance badhayegi. Chaliye investment ki iss safar par

itihaser-patay-singur.title: Itihaser Patay Singur
itihaser-patay-singur.description: Bongo Rajnitite Bohu Chorchito Name Holo Singur. Dirgho 34 Bochorer Bamsashon Er Poton Ebong Trinamool Congress Goverment Er Khomotay Aasa Er Songe Name Joriye Thakbe Singur Aandoloner, Ja Chitro Bodle Diyechilo Bongo Rajnitir. Kintu Keno Holo Ei Aandolon? Tata Group Keno Fire Gelo? Keno Holo Na Industry? Bortoman Ki Obosthay Ache Singur? Eirokom Kichu Jana-Ajana Kahini Jante Ekkhuni Shunte Hobe Ei Audiobook.

ಕೃಷ್ಣಂ-ವಂದೇ-ಜಗದ್ಗುರುಂ.title: Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum
ಕೃಷ್ಣಂ-ವಂದೇ-ಜಗದ್ಗುರುಂ.description: 'ದೇವನೊಬ್ಬ ನಾಮ ಹಲವು' ಎಂಬ ಮಾತಿನಂತೆ, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವ ಹಲವು ಎನ್ನುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನೇ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ... ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಎಂಬುದು ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವ...! ಒಬ್ಬೊಬ್ಬರ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಒಂದೊಂದು ರೀತಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಭಕ್ತರಿಗೆ ದೇವನಾಗಿ, ರಾಧೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಿಯತಮನಾಗಿ, ರುಕ್ಮಿಣಿಗೆ ಪತಿಯಾಗಿ, ಅರ್ಜುನನಿಗೆ ಗೆಳೆಯನಾಗಿ, ಇಡೀ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ಭಗವದ್ಗೀತೆಯನ್ನು ಸಾರಿದ ಗುರುವಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಇಂತಹ ಮಹಾನ್ ಗುರುವಿನ ಜೀವನಪಾಠಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಳೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಕೃಷ್ಣಂ ವಂದೇ ಜಗದ್ಗುರುಂ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

the-serious-guide-to-joke-writing.title: Comedian banna Chahoge?
the-serious-guide-to-joke-writing.description: Ye book summary aapka guide hai aisi techniques sikhne ke liye jo aapko funny aur orioginal material likhne mein madat karega. Fir chaahe ho wo political ho, monologue ho, tv, stage radio ya scripts aur office ka presentation ho. Apne bolne ke andaz mein aisa funny touch jisse sunkar aapki audience khush hojaye

pothuluri-veera-brahmendra-swamy.title: Pothuluri Veera Brahmendra Swamy
pothuluri-veera-brahmendra-swamy.description: కాలజ్ఞానం అంటే ఏమిటి? బ్రహ్మం గారు కాలజ్ఞానం ఎలా రాయగలిగారు? బ్రహ్మం గారు చెప్పినవి చెప్పినట్టు ఎలా జరుగుతున్నాయి? ఆసక్తికరంగా సాగే ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోసం.

വള്ളംകളി.title: Vallamkali
വള്ളംകളി.description: വള്ളംകളി എന്ന് കേൾക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നെ അടങ്ങാത്ത ആവേശമാണ് നമ്മുടെ ഓരോരുത്തരുടെ ഉള്ളിലുണ്ടാകുന്നത്. കേരളത്തിൻറെ സ്വകാര്യ അഹങ്കാരമായ ചുണ്ടൻ വള്ളങ്ങളും, അതിയായ ആവേശത്തോടെ കായലോളങ്ങളിൽ തുഴയുന്ന തുഴച്ചിലുകാരും, അവരുടെ ആർപ്പു വിളികളും, അത്ഭുതത്തോടെ ഇതെല്ലാം കണ്ട് നിൽക്കുന്ന കാണികളും ഇതെല്ലാമാകും വള്ളംകളിയെ പറ്റി ഓർക്കുമ്പോൾ തന്നെ ഓരോ മലയാളിയുടെയും മനസ്സിൽ തെളിഞ്ഞു വരിക. എന്നാൽ നമ്മൾ ഇനിയും അറിയാത്ത രസകരമായ ഒരുപാട് കഥകളുണ്ട് വള്ളംകളിക്ക് പിന്നിൽ. അതെല്ലാം അറിയാം ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബൂക്കിലൂടെ.

seven-principles-of-making-marriage-work.title: The Keys to a Successful Marriage
seven-principles-of-making-marriage-work.description: Kehte Hai Rishte Aasman Se Ban Kar Aate Hain Lekin Kuch Couple Ko Dekh Kar Aisa Lagta Nahi Hai. Jaise Jaise Honeymoon Period Khatam Hota Jata Hai Waise Waise Logon Ko Shadi Ka Dursa Roop Dikhne Lagta Hai Jise Dekh Ke Aisa Bilkul Nhi Lagta Hai Ki Ye Rishta Aasman Mein Bana Hoga. Jokes Apart, Ek Shadi Ko Kamyab Banana Kitna Mushkil Hai Ye Hum Sab Jaante Hain Isliye Hum Lekar Aaye Hain Aapke Liye Ye Damdaar Book Summary Jahan Aap Jaanenge Un 7 Principles Ke Baare Mein Jo Aapki Madad Karenge Aapki Shadishuda Zindagi Ko Aur Mazboot Aur Khushnuma Bnane Mein. Agar aapko "The Seven Principles of Making Marriage Work" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

bharat-ratna-s-radhakrishnan.title: Bharat Ratna S Radhakrishnan
bharat-ratna-s-radhakrishnan.description: Sekhar kono shesh nei, jibon bhor amader sikhhya cholte thake. Amra shob somoy kichu na kichu shikhi. Amra jokhon e jar kach theke kichu sikhte pari, tinio amader sikhyok. Jiboner prothom sikhyok holen amader baba maa, bharat e shikhyok dibosh palon kora hoi 5th September. Dr. S. Radhakrishnan er jonmo diboshi amra shikhyok dibosh hishebe palon kore thaki. Ei diner gurutyopurna, ebong S. Radhakrishnan er byapare bistarito bhabe jante ei sarangsho ti shune nin.

tere-mere-darmiyaan-lineup.title: Tere Mere Darmiyaan
tere-mere-darmiyaan-lineup.description: Corporate world ka shark Rishabh Bajaj masoom si Ishika Deewan se roz raat le raha hai apni pregnant wife ke murder ka badla. Rishabh ke hath mein hai Ishika ke papa ki zindagi. Aur wo har halat mein Ishika se apna baccha wapas lena chahta hai . Kya Rishabh apna badla poora karne ke liye lega kisi Contract Marriage ka sahara? Kya Ishika degi Rishbah ke bacche ko janam? Ya khatam ho jayega Deewan parivaar? Kya Ishika ne sach mein kiya tha ek pregnant aurat ka murder?

qeaf.title: Onam: Malayaliyude Pookkalam
qeaf.description: Malayali ennennum nenjodu cherkkunna ormakalude pookkalam aanu onam. Jathi matha verthirivukal illathe Malayali evide undo avide ellam Onam und. Ella velikkettukalum polich orumich undum uduthum kazhichum pookkalam ittum Malayali Onam aaghoshikkunnu.

dr-apj-abdul-kalam-5.title: Dr. A.P.J Abdul Kalam
dr-apj-abdul-kalam-5.description: ಕನಸು ಕಂಡರೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕನಸನ್ನೇ ಕಾಣಿ ಎಂದು ಮಹಾನ್ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಡಾ. ಎ.ಪಿ.ಜೆ. ಅಬ್ದುಲ್ ಕಲಾಂ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ನುಡಿದಂತೆ ನಡೆದ ಭಾರತದ ಮಹೋನ್ನತ ಸಾಧಕರೂ ಕೂಡ ಹೌದು. ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಏರೋಸ್ಪೇಸ್ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಯಾಗಿ, ಭಾರತದ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಪತಿಯಾಗಿ, ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸರಳ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದಿಂದ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಆಚ್ಚುಮೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಗುರು ಆಗಿ, ವಿಶ್ವಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗಿರುವ ಡಾ. ಎ.ಪಿ.ಜೆ. ಅಬ್ದುಲ್ ಕಲಾಂ ಅವರ ಜೀವನ ಚರಿತ್ರೆಯ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ, ಕೇವಲ KukuFMನಲ್ಲಿ!

-ज्वाला-.title: Jwala
-ज्वाला-.description: पुराने ज़माने का एक राजकुमार जंगल में शिकार को निकलता है और वहीं उसकी मुलाकात होती है एक वनवासी से! ये वनवासी उनकी पूरी ज़िन्दगी बदल के रख देती है। मिथ्य और साहसिक पे आधारित ये पुस्तक आपको एक रोमांचक दुनिया में भेज देगी।

the-theft-of-india-3.title: Bharoter Ek Ojana Kalo Itihas
the-theft-of-india-3.description: Vasco Da Gamar Europe Theke Bharote Aasar Somudropoth Aabiskarer Porer Tin Sotabdite Europio Shoktiguli Bharoter Kolpito Sompod, Moshla, Sona, O Rotnogulor Jonyo Ekta Belline Tairi Korechilo. Pore Ei Poth Dhorei Shuru Hoy Byapok Luthpath. British, Forasi, Dutch Ebong Portugueseder Moddhye Shuru Hoy Lunthoner Protijogita. Bharoter Sob Sompod Tara Nijeder Deshe Niye Jete Ogrosar Hoy. Jarfole Byapok Baje Provab Porechilo Bharote. Thik Ki Ki Ghotechilo Se Somoye? Bharoter Ek Ajana Itihas Lukiye Royeche Ei Audiobook E. Aasun Shune Neyoya Jak Sei Itihas Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye.

the-power-of-concentration.title: The Power Of Concentration
the-power-of-concentration.description: Being able to concentrate effectively is a crucial component of success. To make the greatest success of anything you must be able to concentrate your entire thought upon the idea you are working on. "The Power of Concentration" is a book of lessons intended to help the reader increase their powers of concentration. This book is considered by experts as thought-provoking and offers the readers a greater insight into the potential that appears to lie sleeping within each and every human being. It shows how to open the door to all the possibilities that exist in the wider realm of our lives. Written more than a century ago, its tenets are just as relevant today as they were 102 years ago. You will see the actual benefit of being able to focus on anything after reading this book.

many-lives-many-masters-1.title: The Journey Through Multiple Lifetimes
many-lives-many-masters-1.description: 1980 Mein famous Psychiatrist Doctor Brian Weiss Ke Pass 27 Saal Ki Catherine Naam Ki Ek Ladki Aayi. Jisse Milne Ke Baad Doctor Brian Ki Zindagi Poori Tarah Se Badal Gayi. Science Par Vishwas Hone Ke Chalte Brian Ke Liye Inh Sab Baaton Par Believe Karna Bahut Mushkil Tha. Lekin Sach Unki Aankhon Ke Samne Tha. Akhir Catherine Naam Ki Ye Ladki Jo Unhse Kuch Din Pehle Hi Mili Thi Wo Ye Kaise Janti Thi Ke Brian Ke Bete Ki Paida Hone Ke Kuch Din Baad Hi Maut Ho Gayi Thi? Catherine Ke Past Mein Uske Saath Aisa Kya Hua Tha Jiski Vajah Se Wo Depression, Anxiety Aur Panic Attack Jaisi Problems Se Guzar Rahi Thi? Kya Brian Catherine Ka Treatment Kar Payenge? Janne Ke Liye Suniye hamara ye show.

dr-sarvepalli-radhakrishnan.title: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
dr-sarvepalli-radhakrishnan.description: Bharathadeshapu motta modati upa rastrapathi, rendava rastrapathi. Bharathiya thathvika chinthanalo paaschathyathathvaanni praveshapettarani prathithi. Rendu paryayalu uparastrapathi padavi chepatti, tharuvatha rastapathiga oka paryayam padavini chapatti bharathadeshapu athyantha klistakalamlo pradhanulaku marganirdeshakam chesaru.

azim-premji-the-man-beyond-the-billions.title: Azim Premji: Ek Anuprerona
azim-premji-the-man-beyond-the-billions.description: Aajke Je Wipro Eto Name Koreche Tar Pichone Ek Manusher Kothin Loraiyer Golpo Ache. Azim Premji Namer Sei Byaktiti Jini Ei Wipro Protistha Korechilen. 2019 Sal Er Hisebe Tini Chilen Biswer Doshom Dhoni Byakti, Jar Aanumanik Sompod $7.2 Billion. Family Er Business Er Hal Dhorar Dayitwo Tar Hate Ese Pore Khub Kom Boyose. Kivabe Tini Ei Business Samle Eto Boro Ekta Songstha Banalen? Family Er Support Ki Tini Peyechilen?
