Bharoter Baire Byabsar Prosar Kivabe Ghotalen? Manush Hisebe Kemon Chilen Tini. Echarao Tar Jiboner Nana Loraiyer Ebong Sofolotar Kahini Jene Nebo Ei Audiobook Theke.

why-i-am-an-atheist-1.title: Why I Am An Atheist
why-i-am-an-atheist-1.description: 23 Saal Ki Umar Mein Haste Hue Fansi Par Chadne Wale Bhagat Singh Jab Lahore Jail Mein The Tab Unhone Jail Ke Andar Se Likhna Shuru Kiya, Unke Likhe Essays Unhki Soch Ka Ek Aaina Hai. Akhir Kyu Ek Religious Ladka Itni Kam Umar Mein Nastik Ho Gya? Ye Sawal Humein Se Bohut Logon Ke Mann Mein Aata Hai. Bhagat Singh Is Soch Ko Kareeb Se Jaanne Aur Samjhane Ke Liye Suniye Unki Likhi Kitaab Ki Ye Audiobook.

poovukkul-puthaintha-bookambam.description: சூனியக்காரிகளின் இளவரசி நுவலி, மனித இனத்தைத் தங்களுக்கு அடிமையாக்க எண்ணி மக்களை அழிக்கத் தொடங்குகிறாள். அவளிடமிருந்து மக்களைக் காக்க முயற்சி செய்கிறான் ஆரோன் எனும் எளிய கிராம வாசி. அவளை அழித்து ஆரோன் பஞ்ச நிலத்தின் மாமன்னனாக முடிசூடும் சாசகப் பயணமே, ‘பூவுக்குள் புதைந்த பூகம்பம்’.

Crime scene par hi arrest kar liye jaane ke baad ek saal tak chale mukadme ke wakt Nathuram Godse ne ye kitaab likhi jisme uske statement hain. Jiske baad use fansi ki saza sunai gayi. Aakhir Kyun ki Godse ne Mahatma Gandhi ki hatya? Sab janenge is audiobook mein.

how-to-use-your-mind.title: How To Use Your Mind
how-to-use-your-mind.description: "How to Use Your Mind" is an incredibly useful guide on how you can use your mind more effectively to achieve better results and improve your academic performance. According to many experts, this book is among the best and most concise books you can find for achieving greater thinking and learning ability. It addresses the fundamentals of understanding and memorization and illustrates practical uses of memory in learning, providing value to both students and teachers. Among the subjects discussed are how to increase focus and memory, think logically, motivate yourself to work, and live a healthy and energetic lifestyle.  Written by Harry D. Kitson, a Professor of Psychology, in 1921, it is just as relevant today as it was then.

dr-b-r-ambedkar.description: ಭಾರತದ ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನೆನಪಾಗೋದು ಡಾ. ಬಿ.ಆರ್. ಅಂಬೇಡ್ಕರ್ ಎಂಬ ಮಹಾನ್ ಚೇತನ! ಮೇಲ್ಜಾತಿಯ ದಬ್ಬಾಳಿಕೆಗೆ ಒಳಗಾಗಿ, ಅದರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಡಿ, ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಶದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಅಂಗವಾದ ‘ಸಂವಿಧಾನ’ ರಚನೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಸುಲಭವಲ್ಲ..! ಆದರೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರು ‘ಸಂವಿಧಾನ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ’ ಹೇಗಾದರು? ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ‘Dr. B.R. history-of-genghis-khan.description: Mongol ke kabeelo mein pala badha Temujin aage chalkar Genghis Khan ban jaayega, aisa bhala kaun soch sakta tha. The Great Alexander ka empire bhi Genghis Khan ke saamrajya ke saamne chota saabit hota hai. Mongol ke khule maidaano aur khatarnaak mahol se hokar yeh kabeelayi sardaar aakhir puri duniya mein sabse bada parcham haasil karega, yeh namumkin ko mumkin karne wali jeevani hi ho sakti hai. Toh aaiye sunte hai etihaas mahaan Changez Khan, jinki takdeer Temujin se badalkar har jung mein khoon ki nadiyaa bahadene wale Genghis Khan mein badal gayi!

how-cia-was-exposed-by-eric-snowden.title: How CIA was exposed by Edward Snowden
how-cia-was-exposed-by-eric-snowden.description: Ex-CIA agent Russia federation ke assylum mein! Sunkar kuch baat jami nahi na. Afterall, yehi toh mystery hai. Edward Snowden, ek naujawaan CIA agent jo apne desh America ke liye honest service dene mein vishwaas rakhta tha. Magar Obama administration ke dauraan unhone apne sarkaar ki kuch aisi khufiyaa magar illegal activities ko trace kiya jise jaankar unke pairo ke neeche se zameen khisak gayi. Unhone khulaasa kiya aur pura vishwa America ki taraf ungli utha raha tha aur sawaalo ke katghare mein tha Snowden. Toh aaiye sunte hai yeh thriller, jo aapko CIA Agent Edward Snowden ke jeevan kaaryakaal se rubaroo karvaayega.

Balance Na Thakle Nana Asubidha Dekha Dey. Ei Boite Emon Kichu Kotha Bola Hoyeche Jegulo Mene Cholte Parle Aapnar Sofolota Keu Aatkate Parbe Na. Jiboner Tintivagei Aapni Balance Kore Cholte Parben. Ei Chanakya Nitigulo Bodle Dite Pare Aapnar Jibon. Thik Ki Ki Bola Hoyeche Ei Audiobook E ? Asun Shune Neyoya Jak.

rakesh-jhunjhunwala-biography.title: How Rakesh Jhunjhunwala became "The Big Bull of India"
rakesh-jhunjhunwala-biography.description: Agar Aap Bhi Stock Market Mein Invest Karna Chahte Hain Lekin Aapki Life Mein Motivation Ki Kami Hai Ya Aapko Lagta Hai Ki Stock Market Investment Sirf Bade Aur Ameer Logon Ke Liye Hi Hai Toh Hum Aapko Motivate Karne Ke Liye Lekar Aaye Hain Ye Mazedar Original Series Jismein Aap Sunenge Rakesh Jhunjhunwala Ke Ek Aam Aadmi Se Dalal Street Ke Don Aur India Ke Big Bull Banne Tak Ki Kahani. Agar aapko "Why We Want You To Be Rich" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

pakistanatil-ganapati.title: Bappa Moraya
pakistanatil-ganapati.description: Mitrano, Pakistan mhatla ki kattar shatrutva athavata ani Ganpati bappa mhatla ki manat Prem jaga hota. Donhi agadi Virodhabasi shabda. Pan tumhala mahitye, Pakistanat hi Ganeshotsav sajra kela jato. Itkach nahi tar Dubai, France, England asha anek deshat hi to sajra kela jato. Kashi aste tithlya utsvachi gammat? aikuya aplya ya khas show madhun. Sobatch janun gheuya Bappa vishayicha kahi paramparik dharna ani Sanklpna..

how-to-invest-money.title: How To Invest Money
how-to-invest-money.description: Author George Henry was a veteran photographer and investment banker. His book "How To Invest Money," first published in 1908, is considered by many as one of the foremost literary pieces of the early 20th century on personal finance and investment. The purpose of this book is to provide readers with a functional understanding of the many classes of securities that are accessible as investments and their relative adaptability to diverse demands. It also aims to present the basic concepts of investing in an understandable manner. This book was inspired by the writer's personal experience as an investment banker.

history-of-alexander.title: History of Alexander
history-of-alexander.description: Macedon ke Alexander III, jinhe Alexander the Great ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai, ne akele hi ek decade se bhi kam samay mein Pracheen Duniya aur uske iteehas ko badal diya. Alexander ko Militar geniys maante the aur woh humesha example se lead karte the, haalaanki jaan ki chinta na karte hue woh aksar apane aur apane sainikon ke jeevan ke saath laaparavaah the. Aaiye sunte hai issi great leader ki kahaani

സദ്യ-മുതൽ-ഓണത്തല്ല്-വരെ.title: Sadya Muthal Onathallu Vare
സദ്യ-മുതൽ-ഓണത്തല്ല്-വരെ.description: മലയാളികൾ ഓണത്തിനായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നത് പോലെ മറ്റൊരു ഉത്സവകാലത്തിന് വേണ്ടിയും ഒരുപക്ഷേ ഇത്രയധികം ഒരുക്കങ്ങൾ നടത്തി കാത്തിരിക്കാറില്ല. സമൃദ്ധിയുടെയും ഒത്തൊരുമയുടെയും ഓണക്കാലം ലോകത്തെവിടെ ആയാലും മലയാളികൾ ആഘോഷിക്കാൻ മറക്കാറുമില്ല. പുത്തൻ ഓണക്കോടി ഉടുത്ത്, പൂക്കളവും ഒരുക്കി മഹാബലിയുടെ വരവിനായി കാത്തിരിക്കുന്ന ഓണക്കാലത്തിൻറെ കൗതുകത്തിന്  ഒരു കുറവും സംഭവിച്ചിട്ടില്ല. എന്നാൽ ഓണം സംബന്ധിച്ച് പ്രചാരത്തിനുള്ള ഒട്ടനവധി ആചാരങ്ങളും വിശ്വാസങ്ങളും കലാരൂപങ്ങളുമുണ്ട്. ഒരു പക്ഷേ ഇതിൽ പലതും പുതിയ തലമുറക്ക് പരിചിതവും ആയിരിക്കില്ല. ഓണത്തിനെ കുറിച്ച് നിങ്ങൾ അറിയാതെ പോയ എന്നാൽ അറിയാൻ ഏറെ ആഗ്രഹിച്ച എല്ലാ കാര്യങ്ങളും ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബൂക്കിലൂടെ അറിയാം.

charlie-chaplin-life-and-tragedy.title: CHARLIE CHAPLIN - Life and Tragedy
charlie-chaplin-life-and-tragedy.description: ಅದ್ಭುತ ನಟನೆ, ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಮ್ಯಾನರಿಸಂ, ಹಾವಭಾವಗಳಿಂದ ಇಡಿ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನೇ ನಕ್ಕು ನಲಿಸಿದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಚಾರ್ಲಿ ಚಾಪ್ಲಿನ್..! ಭಾವನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಭಾಷ್ಯ ಬರೆದ, ನಗುವಿನ ರಾಯಭಾರಿ ಚಾರ್ಲಿಯ ಜೀವನ ಅಷ್ಟೂ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಜೀವನದ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳನ್ನು ಗೆಲುವಿನ ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡ ಈ ಮಹಾನ್ ಕಲಾವಿದನ ಬದುಕು, ಸೋತವರಿಗೂ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ! ಬಡವನಾಗಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ, ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳಲ್ಲೊಬ್ಬನಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಚಾರ್ಲಿ ಚಾಪ್ಲಿನ್ ಅವರ ಜೀವನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'CHARLIE CHAPLIN – LIFE AND TRAGEDY' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್! 🎧🔥

declutter.title: The Mindful Way to a Clear Mind
declutter.description: Hum Sab Kabhi Na Kabhi Apni Haalat Se Pareshan Aa Kar Apni Kismat Ko Kosne Lagte Hain. Humein Lagta Hai Ki Buri Kismat Ki Vajah Se Hi Hum Depression Mein Hai Aur Isi Ke Chalte Humara Kaam-Kaj, Rishte-Naate Sab Nakamyab Ho Rahein Hain Lekin Agar Hum Aapse Kahein Ki Aapki Har Pareshani Ka Karan Aapke Khud Ke Vichaar Hain Toh Aap Kahenge Ki Maine Kabhi Aisa Kuch Nahi Chaha. Suniye Ye Show Aur Janiye kaise Aapke Vichaar Aapki Zindagi Bnate Hain.

how-to-ace-an-interview.title: How To Ace An Interview
how-to-ace-an-interview.description: రెసుమె ఎలా ఉండాలి? మన చదువుకు తగిన ఉద్యోగం ను ఎలా ఎన్నుకోవాలి? ఇంటర్వ్యూ లో పాటించాల్సిన చిట్కాలు ఏంటి? వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి

ashtpailu-pula.title: Ashtpailu Pu.La.
ashtpailu-pula.description: Purushottam Lakshman Deshpande arthat sampurn maharashtrache ladke P. L. Deshpande ya navachi olakh vividhangi ahe. Ek manus mhnun ani ek kalakar mhnun tyanchya vyaktimatvala vegvegle pailu ahet. Lekhak, Sangeetkar, Natakkar, Kotyadhish hee tyanchi anek rupe ulgadnar ahet, ‘Ashtapailu Pul’ ya maliket.

how-china-got-rich.title: How China Got Rich
how-china-got-rich.description: Hab sabhi ke ghar mein aaj ek na ek 'Made In China' product toh zaroor hoga, magar kya aap jaante hai ki bas kuch saalon pehle tak China kal naam pichde hue deshon mein aata tha? Toh aakhir aisa kya kiya China ne jisse unki tarakki din duguni raat chauguni hogai? Kaise puri duniya apna varcharsva jamaya is desh ne? Aaiye jaante hai

bill-gates-4.title: BILL GATES
bill-gates-4.description: ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡೋದಾದರೆ ಅದು ಇವ್ರಂತೆಯೇ ಇರಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಕನಸು ಕಂಡವರು ಅದೆಷ್ಟೋ ಮಂದಿ..! ಇವತ್ತಿಗೂ ಇವರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಒಂದು ಅಚ್ಚರಿ ಇದೆ. ಇವರು 'World's Richest Man' ಆಗಿ, ಸಮಾಜ ಸೇವೆಗೆ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ನೀಡಿದ, ಸಾಫ್ಟ್‌ವೇರ್ ಲೋಕದ ದಿಗ್ಗಜ – 'BILL GATES'! ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಸ್ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಆಗಿರೋ 'BILL GATES' ಅವರ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

daily-life-vivekananda.title: Daily Life Vivekananda
daily-life-vivekananda.description: Swami Vivekanand ke jeevan ke har pahelu ne apne vicharo se puri duniya ko raah dikhayi hai. Ye audiobook hamare jeevan ke har pahelu ko jaise career, finance, health, relations, success...sabhi ke baare mein Vivekanand ke nazariye se hume sikhayegi. Aaiye jaane

athishayam-ee-malayala-cinema.title: Athishayam Ee Malayala Cinema
athishayam-ee-malayala-cinema.description: Prathibhadhanaraya orupidi samvidhayakar avarude kaimudra charthiya Cinemakal kond namme athisayappeduthiyittund. Malayala Cinemayude abhimanamayi maari lokathinu munnil kalathivarthiyayi nilanilkkunna Cinemakalil chilathinekkurich nammal charcha cheyyukayanu ivide.

how-to-win-friends-and-influence-people-.title: How to Win Friends and Influence People
how-to-win-friends-and-influence-people-.description: Ningalude bandhangalum aashayavinimaya naipunyangalum mechappetuthan sahayikkunna oru self-help pustakamanu ithu. Aalukal ningale ishtapedunnathinum, sangharshangal kaikaariyam cheyyanathinum, mattullavare positive reethiyil swaadhinikkunnathinum praayogika upadesham nalkunnu.

victorious-atttitue.title: The Victorious Attitude
victorious-atttitue.description: Your altitude is defined by your attitude - Jaisi soch, vaisa hi life aapko returns deti hai. Jeetna koi ittefaq nahi, balki ek aadat si hoti hai. Aur is aadat ko lagane ki sahi chaabi ka naam hai - Victorious Attitude. Matlab jeetne ki aadat aur soch ka positivity ki taraf jhukaav. Agar aap ucha sochenge, toh baaz ki hi tarah ucha udenge. Lekn agar aapka attitude haar yaa negative vichaaro ki taraf jhuka ho, toh koi udta hua cheel aapka shikaar kar le jaayega. The attitude of victory separates winners from losers. Chunaav aapko karna hai aur kaise, voh yeh audiobook samjhaayegi.

the-freedom-of-life.title: The Freedom Of Life
the-freedom-of-life.description: Author Annie Payson Call was from Waltham. She contributed articles to the Ladies' Home Journal and authored several books. Her work frequently addresses mental health. This mind-opening book, "The Freedom of Life," by the author discusses many of the issues that people typically experience both physically, mentally, and psychologically. It presents the reader with a range of viewpoints on how to approach the mind and life. Call's brand of commonsense and straightforward advice can help the readers follow their chosen path with dignity and serenity. By the time you reach the book's conclusion, you will undoubtedly have a clear comprehension of your issues.

rahul-dravid-the-wall-of-cricket.title: Rahul Dravid- The Wall of Cricket
rahul-dravid-the-wall-of-cricket.description: ಇವರು ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಜಗತ್ತು ಕಂಡ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಬ್ಯಾಟ್ಸ್‌ಮನ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರು… ದಾಖಲೆಗಳ ಸರದಾರ…! ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕುವರ…! ಇವರು ಬೇರೆ ಯಾರೂ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಕನ್ನಡ ನಾಡಿನ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಕಲಿ, 'ದಿ ವಾಲ್' ರಾಹುಲ್ ದ್ರಾವಿಡ್…!  ದ್ರಾವಿಡ್ ಅವರ ಜೀವನದ ರೋಚಕ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'RAHUL DRAVID – The Wall of Cricket' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ 🎧🔥

guru-nanak.title: Guru Nanak Dev Ji
guru-nanak.description: Samaj Ki Kuritiyon Se Pareshan Ho Kar Ishwar Ko Talashne Wale Guru Nanak Dev Ji Ka Jeewan Manavjati Ke Liye Ek Misaal Hai. Is Audio Book Mein Suniye Unke Jeewan Ki Kuch Aisi Kahaniyan Jo Aapko Bhi Apna Astitva Talashne Pe Majboor Kar Dengi.

you-are-your-own-gym-1.title: Healthy Life Er Somporke Jene Nin
you-are-your-own-gym-1.description: Apnar ki janen je apnader shorir e apnader gym? Hai ekdom tai. Puro duniya e kintu gym, exercise, supplements egulor jonnyo pagol, ar edike apnar gym apnar songe shob somoy e thake, hai apnar body weight ja diye apni jokhon ichey effective workout korte paren. Simple kintu effective workout, ei shob workouts ar healthy lifestyle er somporke jante shune nin ei sarangsho ti.

what-does-your-religion-preach.title: మీ మతం ఏమి చెబుతుంది?
what-does-your-religion-preach.description: మతం మానవాళికి ఏమి నేర్పిస్తుంది? అన్ని మతాల సారాంశం శాంతి, సమానత్వమేనా? మనిషి ఖచ్చితంగా ఏదైనా ఒక మతాన్ని స్వీకరించాలా? అసలు మతం అంటే ఏంటి?

how-america-became-a-superpower.title: How America became a Superpower
how-america-became-a-superpower.description: United States of America - The land of Opportunities. Duniya ka sabse shaktishaali desh aur aadhunik vigyaan ki race mein sabse advanced. Azaadi se jeena, apne haq ke liye sangharsh karna aur namumkin ko mumnkin kar dikhana is desh ki khaasiyat hai. World's oldest democracy jisne apni azaadi Britain ke khilaaf jung kar haasil ki aaj world politics mein iska sikka sabse mazboot bolta hai. George Washington ke president banne se lekar Barack Obama pehle colored president bane, aise etihaasik pal America ne duniya ko diye hai. Science, sports, cinema aur warfare sabhi mein avval number par apni jagah banaye hue aaye jaante hai ki yeh sanyukt raaj kaise bana vishwa shakti - A Super Power!

the-game-of-life-and-how-to-play-it.title: The Game Of Life And How To Play It
the-game-of-life-and-how-to-play-it.description: Florence Scovel Shinn made a name for herself as one of the most pragmatic, helpful, and down-to-earth prosperity writers of her day with the publication of her classic book "The Game of Life and How to Play it." Her novels are still regarded as the pioneers of prosperity literature today because of their ageless message and capacity to convey success concepts and how they work in a fun way. This little book, which was first released in 1925, has helped thousands of individuals all over the world discover a sense of meaning and community. It shows that life is not a struggle but a game of giving and receiving and is as as relevant today as it was when it was first written. This book will demonstrate how you can transform your life, let go of your regrets, and forge your own brilliant future.

tribal-freedom-fighters.title: TRIBAL FREEDOM FIGHTER
tribal-freedom-fighters.description: ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಪರಕೀಯರನ್ನು ಹೊರದಬ್ಬುವಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಂಧಿ, ಭಗತ್, ತಿಲಕರಂಥ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಶ್ರಮ ಎಷ್ಟಿತ್ತೋ, ಆದಿವಾಸಿ ಅಥವಾ ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ಜನಾಂಗಗಳ ಕೊಡುಗೆಯೂ ಅದೇ ಮಟ್ಟದ್ದಾಗಿದೆ..! ಆದ್ರೆ, ಇವರನ್ನು ನೆನಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ತೀರಾ ಅಪರೂಪ.!  ಸಸ್ಯಶ್ಯಾಮಲೆಯ ಮಕ್ಕಳಾಗಿ, ಅಡವಿ ದೇವಿಯನ್ನು ಆರಾಧಿಸಿ, ಅಲ್ಲೇ ಜೀವನ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡ ಆದಿವಾಸಿಗಳು ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಪಾಲ್ಗೊಂಡಿದ್ರು ಅಂತಾ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕಾ? ಕೇಳಿ TRIBAL FREEDOM FIGHTER ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್

change-your-schedule-change-your-life.title: Aapka Schedule kaisa hona Chahiye?
change-your-schedule-change-your-life.description: Khana chhodna, jab conveninet ho workout kar lena fir chaahe wo koi bhi wakt ho, productivity badhane ke liye der raat tak kaam karna aur fir weekend par nind puri karna...kya aapko lagta hai ye hamari body ka natural cycle hai? Kya aap jaante hai ki aapke body mein bhi ek clock hota hai? Jaane apni body ke baare mein ayurved ki madat se

the-iron-man-sardar-patel-1.title: The Iron Man - Sardar Patel
the-iron-man-sardar-patel-1.description: 'ಭಾರತದ ಉಕ್ಕಿನ ಮನುಷ್ಯ' ಅಂದರೆ ನೆನಪಾಗೋ ಏಕೈಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ 'ಸರ್ದಾರ್ ವಲ್ಲಭಭಾಯಿ ಪಟೇಲ್'.! ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಇವರ ಹೆಸರು ಶಾಶ್ವತ.! ನವಭಾರತದ ನಿರ್ಮಾಪಕನಾಗಿ, ಧೈರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಪೂರ್ತಿಯ ಸಂಕೇತವಾಗಿ ನಿಂತ ಪಟೇಲರು ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ನೀಡಿದ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ಅಪಾರ..!  ಇವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು, ಕೇಳಿ ಸರ್ದಾರ್ ವಲ್ಲಭಭಾಯಿ ಪಟೇಲ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್!

lean-start-up.title: Apna Empire Banao: Successful Startup Formula
lean-start-up.description: Startups toh kai launch hote hai magar successful chand hi ho paate hai. Aakhir aisa kya hai jo successful startups failure startups se alag karte hai? Kya elaborated plan hona zaroori hai yaa hamare vision ko lagatar change karne ki aavashyakta hai? Jaanenge is book summary mein!

jamtara.title: Jamtara
jamtara.description: Idi bharathadesham yokka phishing rajadhaniga koodaa pilavabaduthundi. Ee chinna pattanam Kendra binduvugaa desha vyapthamgaa aneka phishing sangatanalu jariginanduna deeniki ee peru vachindi. April 2015 mariyu March 2017 maddhya rendu samvathsarala vyavadhilo, 12 bharathiya raastrala nundi police lu Jamtaraku aneka case la vishayallo vellarani thelisindi.

leaders-eat-last-3.title: Leader Hoye Othar Niyom
leaders-eat-last-3.description: Achha bhabun to emon anek employee ache jara sara din khub khatni kore kaj korte bhalobasche, roj beshi beshi kore kaj kore bari phirche khusi hoye ebong kormojibon e khub e khushi thakche. Hai eta kono shopno ba banano ghotona na. Emon anek companies ache jekhane leaders ra eto ta cooperative, positive ar motivating je employee ra khushi khushi kaj kore jachhe ebong jibone successful o hocche. Ei shob kichur byapar e janar jonnyo shune nin ei sarangsho ti.

bin-phere-shadi-1.title: Bin Phere Shaadi
bin-phere-shadi-1.description: Apne bachpan ke pyaar SHAAN ko dhoondane ke liye ISHIKA apni shaadi ke din  ghar se bhaag jaati hai. Usi raat ISHIKA ko SHAAN mil bhi jaata hai, par ISHIKA ko wo pehchaan nahi pata. ISHIKA gusse mein zabardasti SHAAN ki dulhan ban kar SHAAN ke  sath uske ghar chali jaati hai. Kaise react karenge SHAAN ke ghar waale ISHIKA ko vaha dekh kar? Kya hua aisa jisese SHAAN bhool gaya hai apni ISHU ko?

vochidambaram.title: VO Chidambaram
vochidambaram.description: British Government ku edhira Tamilnaatu vanigargal ellarayum ondru thirati, Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company aarambicha oru real life hero oda varalaaru - "Kappalottiya Tamizhan - V.O.Chidambaram"

dont-keep-your-day-job-2.title: Nijer Creativity Dekhate Sikhun
dont-keep-your-day-job-2.description: Manusher Moddhey Lukiye Thake Onek Goon. Ja Sobsomoy Prokash Pay Na. Nijer Swapnoke Sothik Disha Dekhate Pare Na Sobai. Nijer Passionke Bastobayito Korte Byartho Hon Onekei. Kintu Ei Audiobook E Bola Aache Emon Kichu Kotha Ja Aapnar Jibon Bodle Dite Pare. Ei Audiobook Aapnake Nijer Passionke Kivabe Sothik Pothe Niye Jete Paren, Kivabe Profit Hobe, Kivabe Nijer Swapno Puron Korben, Kivabe Ekjon Sofol Manush Hoben. Eirokom Sobkichui Sekkhabe. Audiobook E Bola Techniques Ebong Ponthagulo Mene Cholte Parle, Aapnar Sofolota Keu Aatkate Parbe Na. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak .

the-miracle-morning.title: Badle Din Subah ke 6 Min mein
the-miracle-morning.description: Doston zara sochiye ki aapko kaisa mehsus hoga jab ek din aap subah uthein aur aapki zindagi mein sab kuch badal chuka ho. Aapki zindagi aur behtar ho gayi ho. Aap apni zindagi mein zyada khush ho, swasthya ho, aur stressed bhi nahin ho. Aisi Miracle wali subah ke liye aapko kuch acchi aadton ke baare mein janna hoga. Aapko seekhna hoga ki subah zaldi uth kar uska sahi istemaal karne waale log zyada khush kyon rahte hain. In baaton se judi sabhi jaankari hum aapko is audiobook mein denge. Agar aapko The 5 AM Club jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

reminiscences-of-a-stock-operator-1.title: Reminiscences Of A Stock Operator
reminiscences-of-a-stock-operator-1.description: "Reminiscences of a Stock Operator," first published in 1923, is regarded by many as one of the most read and recommended investment books ever. Adapted from a series of Saturday Evening Post articles written by Edwin Lefevre in the 1920s, this book narrates the story of Livermore's rise as the most powerful trader on Wall Street. Although Livermore's experiences take up a big portion of the book, Livermore also imparts trading knowledge and guidelines through Lefevre. Every new generation of traders and investors continues to find value in the ideas and lessons of Livermore and have discovered that it can teach them more about people and markets than years of experience. This is a classic tale that will not only improve your life but also your skills and knowledge.

rani-of-jhansi.title: Rani of Jhansi
rani-of-jhansi.description: 'ಝಾನ್ಸಿ ರಾಣಿ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಬಾಯಿ' – "ದತ್ತು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಹಕ್ಕಿಲ್ಲ" ಎಂಬ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರ ನೀತಿಗೆ ವಿರುದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ದಿಟ್ಟ ಮಹಿಳೆ..! ಗಂಡನನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡು, ಏಕಾಂಗಿಯಾಗಿ, ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹೋರಾಟ ನಡೆಸಿದ ಈಕೆಯ ಧೈರ್ಯ, ಪರಾಕ್ರಮ ಮೆಚ್ಚಲೇಬೇಕು..! ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಪುಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಜರಾಮರಳಾದ 'ಝಾನ್ಸಿ ರಾಣಿ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಬಾಯಿ' ಅವರ ಸಾಹಸಗಾಥೆ ಕೇಳಿ.

you-are-a-badass-2.title: Apni Asli Power Jagao
you-are-a-badass-2.description: Zindagi mein aage badhne ke liye Self Awareness hona bohot jaroori hai. Self aware hote hi aapko pata chal jayega ki aakhir aapko zindagi mein kya chahiye? Usse haasil karne ke liye aapko kya karna hai? Iss book summary mein aapko yeh saari cheezen sikhne milegi, aur haan, logon ki opinion ko kaise ignore karna hai, iski training bhi milegi.

the-india-way-strategies-for-an-uncertai.title: The India Way: Strategies for an Uncertain World
the-india-way-strategies-for-an-uncertai.description: 2008-il thudangunna saambathika prathisandhi muthal 2020-le korona pandemic vareyulla prathisandhikal lokathe ere baadhichu. Anthaarashtriya bandhangal palappolum marikkondirikkunnu. India-ye engane baadhichu, ini engane neeridum ennathu Dr. S. Jaishankar ezhuthiya ‘The India Way’ enna pusthakathil parayunnu.

the-secret-the-power.title: Positive approach - Ek shakti
the-secret-the-power.description: Agar hume khud par vishwas hai aur positive approach ke saath hum jeevan ko dekhte hai, toh hum maximum success prapt kar sakte hai. Ye hi hamari power hogi. Positive transformation attract karna ek power hai aur is kitab se hum jaanenge ki is power ko haasil kaise kiya jaaye!

when-breath-becomes-air-6.title: Jibon Juddho Joy Korte Sikhun
when-breath-becomes-air-6.description: Ei sarangsho ti ashole Stanford University r Paul Kalanithi r golpo. Uni cancer e akranto hon jokhon uni 30-35 bochorer chilen. Ei sarangsho ti theke amra jante parbo je ki  bhabe uni haste haste mrityu ke apon kore niyechilen. Ebong jiboner songe songe egiye giyechilen.

psycho-cybernetics-4.title: Mon O Mostishko Niyontroner Upay
psycho-cybernetics-4.description: Aatmwo Bishleshone Nijeke Somriddho Korar Upay Ki? Negetive Chinta Theke Nijeke Ber Kore Kivabe Positive Chinta Kore Sofol Hoyoya Jay? Jibone Byartho Hole Ki Kora Uchit? Mon, Mostishko Ke Niyontrone Rekhe Kivabe Nijer Productivity Barano Jay? Lokhyopuroner Jonyo Ki Ki Kora Uchit? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Uttor Khunje Paben Ei Audiobook E. Aapnar Jiboner Sukh Prapti O Nijer Lokkheye Pouchote Apnar Bondhu Hye Uthte Pare Ei Audiobook. Cholun Shune Neyoya Jak .

albert-einstein-1.title: Albert Einstein
albert-einstein-1.description: E=M(C)square. Is formula ne puri duniya ki history badal kar rakh di. Albert Einstein, the great scientist , unhone ise pehli baar izaad kiya tha jise aaj tak duniya bhar mein log nuclear warheads banane ke kaam mein laate hai. Bachpan se hi sabse alag, mathematics aur physics se mohabbat karne wala is bade sar ke ladke ke peeche puro duniya deewani thi. German-American citizen, Israel ki umeed se lekar duniya ke liye acchi soch rakhne wala ek accha insaan. Kahi inpe shaq kiya ki yeh Hitler ke jasoos hai yaa future Jewish leader. Sab sunenge aur inki life ka equation solve karenge, KuKu FM ke saath. Yeh hai kahaani - ALBERT EINSTEIN.

subramaniya-bharathiyar.title: Subramania Bharathiyar
subramaniya-bharathiyar.description: Mahakavi Subramaniya Barathiyar patri ariyappadaadha pala ariya thagavalgalin suvarasiyamaana indha thoguppai  unguladan perumaiyudan pakirndhu kolkiradhu KUKU FM.

dev-manus.title: Dev Manus
dev-manus.description: Devmanus banun gavkaryana lootnara, Striyancha fayda gheun tyanchi nirghun hatya karnara to naradham mhanje Santosh Pol. Bogus Doctor aslelya santosh ne anek baykanche khoon kele, gavkaryana loobadle. Ha Haivan akher kasa pakdla gela, nakki kon hota ha 'Devmanus'? Aikuya Maharashtrat ghadleli ek tharar katha

ishq-nai-asaan.title: Ishq Nahi Aasan
ishq-nai-asaan.description: Apni hi shaadi se bhaag kar, Aayushi aa jaati hai Delhi apne sapno ko poora karne ke liye. Apnon se door yaha use Rudra se pyaar ho jaata hai. Kya yeh ishq, Aayushi ke apnon ke bina hoga aasan?

hair-care-remedies-1.title: Hair Care Remedies
hair-care-remedies-1.description: Thalai Mudi kottura prachnaikku enna thaan theervu nu thedittu irukkuravangalukku, veetla irukkura porutkala use panniye  ezhimaiyaana vazhimuraigal moolamaa mudi kottura prachanaiya sari seyya vazhi solludhu indha padhivu. vaanga therinjukalaam !

dr-br-ambedkar-1.title: DR. B.R. AMBEDKAR
dr-br-ambedkar-1.description: Kotheen lorai, cheshta, drirotar ar ek naam e holo Dr. B.R.Ambedkar. Uni nijer prapyo ti kokhonoi shei orthe bharatborshe paan ni jeta tini biswa jure peyechilen. Onar sokol revolutinary chinta bhabna puro jatibaad ke bodle rakhar bhabna puro bharatborsho ke nariye diyechilo. Emon ki Gandhi jir kotha e, "He was the greatest challenge to Hinduism". Emoni kichu jana ojana itihash jante shune nin ei sarangsho ti.

uri-attacks.title: Uri Attacks
uri-attacks.description: Jammu Kashmir mein 20 saalo mein Bhartiya Sena ko sabse zyada nuksan hua jab 18 Sitambar, 2016 ko 4 atankwadi bhaari hathiyaro ke saath ghuse aur Uri ke ek camp par grenade se hamla kar diya. Kaise hua ye hatsa? Kya hua hamare jawano ke saath aur kaise humne unhe muh tod jawab diya? Aaiye, sune ye dil dehla dene wali dastaan.

make-time-5.title: Somoyke Nijer Niyontrone Aante Sikhun
make-time-5.description: Saradiner Kajer Chape Nijer Jibon Thikthak Upovog Kore Hoye Otha Hoy Na. Aapnar Jibone Je Jinista Gurutwopurno Tar Jonyo Jayga Ber Korte Hobe. Time Spending Ke Bondho Kore Timeke Making Korte Hobe. Laser-Focus Techniques Aur Regular Short Breaks Er Sahajye Aapni Aapnar Jibone Khuv Valo Space Create Korte Paren. Ebar Proshno Holo Sothik Time Ki Kore Ber Korben? Ki Kore Time Making Korben? Protidin Sothik Bishoygulote Kivabe Focus Korben? Nijer Kajer Proti Monojog Deyoyar Koushol Ki? Ei Sob Khuntinati Jante Parben Ei Audiobook Theke. Aasun Tahole Shune Neyoya Jak .

crime-stories-1.title: Indian Crime Stories
crime-stories-1.description: Aplya Deshat Ase Anek Gunhegar Janmala Ale Ahet Jyani Kruratechi Hadda Par Keli Ani Apan Vichar Pan Karu Shaknar Nahi  Ase Gunhe Kele. Te Doctor Death Aso kinva Karnataka chi Cyndie Women Aso. Janun Gheuya Yani Asa Kay Kela Jyamule Tyanche Nav Ghetle Tari Loka Thar Thar Kapaychi. Aika Indian Crime Stories.

nikola-tesla.title: Nikola Tesla
nikola-tesla.description: Nikola Tesla ek Serbian-American inventor, Electric engineer, Mechanical engineer aue ek futurist the. Inhe Physics ka wizard aur electricity se khelne wala daredevil maana jaata hai. Edison ki company se nikalkar inhone kaise khudki 'Tesla Electric Company' ki buniyaad rakhi aur saath hi saath DC Current ko AC Current se badalkar pure maanavjaati ka kalyaan kiya ab jaanenge inki jeevani mein. Din mein 20 ghante kaam karne wale, Swami Vivekananda se milne wale aur duniya ka bhavishya badalkar rakh dene wale is mahan vaigyaanik ke jeevan kaal ko samjhenge KuKu FM par.

thilakan.title: തിലകന്‍
thilakan.description: Malayala Cinemayude aakashath udichuyarnna thilakakkuri aanu asaamanya abhinaya prathibhayaya Thilakan enna Surendra Nath Thilakan. Nadakathilude Cinemayil ethi abhinaya sadhyathakalude attam kanda Thilakan, Malayalikalude abhimanamaya nadan aanu.

measure-what-matters-2.title: Track Your Progress Daily
measure-what-matters-2.description: Apne food parcel se leke apne parcel tak hum sab track karte hai but life mein apne progress ko kaise track kare? Is Original Show mein aap seekhenge ki apni company ka ya aapka khudka progress kaise record karein, accountable kaise banein aur apne goals ki taraf badhna asaan kaise banayein. OKR is bohot hi amazing technique ko aap is audio mein seekhenge.

how-to-start-my-own-business.title: How To Start My Own Business
how-to-start-my-own-business.description: Oru business kaana idea va eppadi select panradhu nu aarambichu, andha idea va eppadi Business saa maathuradhu 'ngra varaikkum miga thelivaa indha padhivula sollirukkaanga. Ungaloda business kanava nenavaakka indha padhiva kelunga !

jagathy-avasanamillatha-nadanam.title: Jagathy: Avasanamillatha Nadanam
jagathy-avasanamillatha-nadanam.description: Oru nadante thirichu varavinayi Malayali etra adhikam prarthanayode kathirunnitundenkil orupakshe athu Jagathi Sreekumar nte thirichu varavinu vendi matramayirikkum. Car apakadathe thudarnnu 10 varshatholamayi chikilsayil kazhiyunna adhehathe poorna arogyavanayi screenil kanananu oro Malayaliyum ennu agrahikkunnathu. Jagathy Sreekumar enna prathibhaye kooduthal aduthariyam ee audioyilude.

unsolved-mysteries-of-india.title: Unsolved Mysteries of India
unsolved-mysteries-of-india.description: Ek Raaz ki baat batau? Aisa hum na jaane kitni baar sunte hai. Aise unsuljhi raaz ki baatein, jise na aap sach maan sakte hai aur naa hi jhooth nakaar sakte hai. Inke peeche koi science nahi, sirf inka vajood hai jo sadiyo se logo ne sirf mehsoos kiya hai. Aiye sunte hai aise hi kuch 'Unsolved Mysteries of India'

veer-savarkar.title: Veer Savarkar
veer-savarkar.description: ವೀರ ಸಾವರ್ಕರ್ - ಹೆಸರೇ ಹೇಳುವಂತೆ 'ವೀರತ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಹೆಸರು'! ತಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನೇ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಮುಡಿಪಾಗಿಟ್ಟ ಮಹಾನ್ ನಾಯಕ! ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟ, ಹಿಂದೂತ್ವದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇವರು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದ ದೃಢ ನಿಲುವುಗಳು ಇಂದಿನ ಯುವಕರಿಗೆ ಸ್ಪೂರ್ತಿದಾಯಕ! ಇಂತಹ ಮಹಾನ್ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಆಸಕ್ತಿದಾಯಕ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು, ಕೇಳಿ ವೀರ ಸಾವರ್ಕರ್ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್!

everybody-lies-3.title: Manus Khota Ka Bolto
everybody-lies-3.description: Aaj Chya Digital Yugat , Pratyek Mansus Khota Boltoh. Ani Apla Data Basech Fakta Khar Bolto. The New York Times Che Best Seller, Book Of The Year Every Body Lies He Pustak Ya Kalatil Human Mind Varil Sarvart Advanced Research Ahe. Seth Stephens0 Davidwoitz Ne Ya Pustaka Dware Modern Psyche Ani Mansachya Khota Bolnyachya Tendency La Sangtat.

21-sadi-mein-daren-ya-laden.title: 21st Sadi Mein Darein Ya Ladein
21-sadi-mein-daren-ya-laden.description: 21st Century mein har koi apne khwab pure karne ki iccha rakhta hai, lekin kyun kuch log hi safal ho pate hain? Iss audiobook mein jaaniye un samasyaon ke solutions jo safalta ke raste mein rukawat ban sakti hain.

success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.title: Success Through a Positive Mental Attitude
success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.description: Aalukalkku idayil valare cheriya vyathyasame ullu, ennal aa cheriya vyathyasam valiya maattam undakkunnu. Ah cheriya vyathyasam aanu 'attitude'. Athu positive aano atho negative aano ennathanu valiya vyathyasam.

rich-dads-success-stories-3.title: Sofol Byabshayi Der Golpo
rich-dads-success-stories-3.description: Ei boi tir sarangsho theke jana jaye ki bhabe ki bhabe bibhinnyo bybashai ra sofol hoyechen Rich Dad Poor Dad er financial principle apply kore ebong nijeder financial startegies er bodol kore.

understanding-of-metaverse.title: Understanding of Metaverse
understanding-of-metaverse.description: Kya aapne socha hai ki aap apne sofa pe baithke school ya office jaasakte hai, games khel sakte hai, store mein jaake shoping kar sakte hai. Bhagwaan ne is duniya ko aur insaan ko banaya par ab insaan apni hi ek nayi duniya banaraha hai. Aaiye jaante hai iss duniya ke baare mein

dwaraka-nagaram-1.title: Dwaraka Nagaram
dwaraka-nagaram-1.description: కృష్ణుడు జరాసంధుని బారినుండి తప్పించుకునేందుకు ఈ నగరాన్ని నిర్మించినట్లు పురాణాల ద్వారా తెలుస్తుంది. అది నిజమేనా ?  శ్రీకృష్ణుని ద్వారకా నగరం సముద్రగర్బంలో ఇంకా ఉందా? ద్వారకా రహస్యాలు మీకోసం

the-secret-door-to-success.title: Success Ka Secret Darwaaza Kholna Seekho
the-secret-door-to-success.description: Kya adhyatm se samruddhi paayi jaa sakti hai? Kya gyaan se mukti aur positive affirmations se life successful ban sakti hai? Spirituality aur uske kai siddhant se roobaroo karvaegi ye kitab, Secret Door To Success!  Agar aapko "The Secret" jaisi books pasand hain, to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

shri-krishna-bhagavanudu.title: Shri Krishna Bhagavanudu
shri-krishna-bhagavanudu.description: శ్రీ కృష్ణుడు చూపిన జీవన విధానమేంటి? కృష్ణుడి నుండి నేర్చుకోవాల్సిన విషయాలేమిటి? వినండి కృష్ణుని లీలల గురించి సంపూర్ణ ఆడియో బుక్ .

major-sandeep-unnikrishnan.title: MAJOR SANDEEP UNNIKRISHNAN
major-sandeep-unnikrishnan.description: 26/11 ಮುಂಬೈ ಅಟ್ಯಾಕ್ ಭಾರತವನ್ನೇ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸ್ತು. ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಶದ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿಶ್ವದೆಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು ಮೂಡಿದ್ವು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಇಂತಾ ವಿಷಮ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯಲ್ಲೂ ಎದೆಗುಂದದೇ, ವೈರಿಗಳ ರುಂಡ ಚೆಂಡಾಡೋಕೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಯೋಧರು ಸಜ್ಜಾಗಿದ್ರು. ಹೀಗೇ ತಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಾಣವನ್ನೇ ಪಣಕ್ಕಿಟ್ಟು ಹೋರಾಡಿದವರಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ನೆನಪಿನಲ್ಲೇ ಇಟ್ಕೋಳ್ಬೇಕಾದ ಹೆಸ್ರು ಒಂದಿದೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ವೀರ 'ಮೇಜರ್ ಸಂದೀಪ್ ಉನ್ನಿಕೃಷ್ಣನ್'. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ  ಸಂದೀಪ್ ಅವರ ಹೋರಾಟದ ಕಿಚ್ಚು ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಕೇಳಿ 'ಮೇಜರ್ ಸಂದೀಪ್ ಉನ್ನಿಕೃಷ್ಣನ್' ಹೋರಾಟದ ಕಥೆ.

ajab-sa-ishq-1.title: Ajab Sa Ishq
ajab-sa-ishq-1.description: A five-year-old buried secret, two innocent children, and an incomplete love story. Escaping her past, Kaajal starts a new life in Delhi with her two kids. But when Armaan Oberoi discovers the truth about the children, a storm of emotions and hatred erupts. The truth of one night is about to change everything. Will this secret awaken love—or destroy lives?

steal-like-an-artist-1.title: Shilpir Moto Churi Korte Sikhun
steal-like-an-artist-1.description: Ei boi tir sarangshe amra jante parbo je apnake ekti genius hote hobe na,apni khali nijer moto holei jothesto. Apni jodi ekjon lekhoker theke churi koren take plagiarism bole kintu apni jodi aneker theke churi koren take research bole. Churio kono kono somoy  shilper jayega e giye pouchoy. Ei sarangsho theke jante parbo je successful hote gele creative hote hobe, ebong nijer shilpo ke sobar shamne khub special bhabe represent korte hobe.

velu-nachiyar.title: Velu Nachiyar
velu-nachiyar.description: Oru Penmani British'ku edhiraaga padai thiratti, avanga ilandha thanoda naatai 8 varusham kaathirundhu meetedutha kadhai - "Velu Nachiyar".

acres-of-diamond.title: Acres of Diamond
acres-of-diamond.description: Sadi ki sabse badi pustak ke darze ke saath saath, effective speech ka sateek model aur philosophy ka bharmaar hai 'Acres of Diamond'. Lekhak Russel Conwell ke bahumulya lectures ki series jo aapko awsar prapt kar use safalta mein kaise badla jaaye. Aur apne karmo se paaye hue fal ko lok kalyaan mein lagana seekh apne hard work ki paribhaasha badle aur ek altruic vision ko paida kare. Suniye yeh bhavya aur vishaal lessons se bharpoor eye opener jaha aap samjhenge heeron ki kheti ka matlab.

ntr-biography.title: NTR Biography
ntr-biography.description: నందమూరి తారక రామారావు పేరు వింటే వెంటనే గుర్తొచ్చేది తెలుగు వాడి ఆత్మ గౌరవం. తెలుగు వాడి గౌరవాన్ని దేశ వ్యాప్తంగా పెంచిన నాయకుడు ప్రతి తెలుగు వాడు మెచ్చిన నటుడు మన అన్న గారు రామ రావు గారు. పేదవాడి ఇళ్లల్లో ఆనందాలను నింపిన ఆ మహనీయుడు గురించి తెలుసుకుందాం.

the-financial-diet-6.title: Kivabe Nijer Financial Plan Sajaben ?
the-financial-diet-6.description: Sobai To R Beshi Taka Income Korte Pare Na, Keu Keu Kom Poisatei Sontusho Thaken. Ebar Proshno Holo Kivabe Kom Salary Income Koreo Valo Thaka Jay? Kivabe Budget Plan Korte Hoy? Kivabe Invest Korte Hoy? Aapnar Bondhur Songe Financial Matter Kivabe Aalochona Korben? Kivabe Nijer Taka Manage Korte Hoy? Kivabe Taka Niyontron Korte Hoy? Kon Kon Ingredients Kichen E Rakha Uchit? Eisob Proshner Uttor Jana Jabe Ei Audiobook  Theke. Asun Tahole Shune Neyoya Jak.

मायावती-.title: Mayawati
मायावती-.description: Sarvajan Hitaay Sarvjan Sukhaay ka naara deke UP mein chaar baar CM reh chuki Shree Mayawati ji ki kahaani bohot hi inspirational hai. Equality ke liye unka struggle aur unki political journey ko experience karte hai iss audio mein

the-master-key-system.title: The Master Key System
the-master-key-system.description: Charles Haanel covers a wide range of topics in The Master Key System, from how to feel well to how to get wealthy. Haanel demonstrates how to get what we want most by employing exact logic and a consistent, rational framework. The Master Key System is rumored to be what inspired Bill Gates to leave Harvard and start Microsoft. This book will not only leave you 'feeling' good but also 'thinking' good.  If you wish to improve your personality and develop the confidence to achieve any worthy personal purpose and enjoy life's beauty and wonder, this is a must-read for you.

maratha-empire-in-india.title: Maratha Empire in India
maratha-empire-in-india.description: Jai Shivaji - Jai Bhavani!! Yeh jaighosh jaha jaha, Maratha vaha vaha. Marathi zubaan bolne wale, puran poli aur bhaakri khaane wale aur ghaat ke kinaare rehne wale yeh shoorveer Marathe, waqt aane par dhaal aur hathiyaar dono utha sakte hai. 1674 se Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj ke rajyabhishkeh ke saath Maratha Empire ke golden era ki shuruaat hui, jisne Shahu Maharaj aur Peshwai vanshaj ko janm diya. Bharat ki dharti par kesariya jhande ka sabse bada pratik, deccan ke yeh veer maratho ne Mughal, Angrez aur Portuguese sabhi se apne Swarajya ke haq ke liye ladte reh aur asli Maratha kya hota hai yeh puri duniya ko batlaaya! Chala aiku yaa gaatha 'Maratha Samrajaanchi'!

savarkar-ek-krantikari-chalval.title: Savarkar - Ek Krantikari Chalval
savarkar-ek-krantikari-chalval.description: Bhartanchya swatantrya ladhyat jyancha molacha vata ahe te mhanje savtryanta veer Vinayak Damodar savarkar. Tyanchi vichar shakti tyanche tatva ani strategy ya sathi olakh ahe. Svarkar yancha ayushche barech paillu apan savarkar ek krantikari chalval ya series dware apan aiknar ahot fakta kukufmvar.

partition-of-india-pain-and-wounds.title: Partition Of India; Pain And Wounds
partition-of-india-pain-and-wounds.description: Rajyam swathanthramayappol undaya aaghoshathinteyum aaswasathinteyum maruvasathu murivukalum vedanakalum kanaam, vibhajanathinte. Nammal nediya swathanthryam charithrathile ettavum valiya palayanathekkurichulla ormappeduthal koodiyanu.

ruhani-mohabbat-2.title: Ruhani Mohabbat
ruhani-mohabbat-2.description: Apni shadi ke din ruhi ghar se bhagne ko bekarar hai magar uske ashiq Akash ne de diya dhokha …Majboori me akhir ho hi gai ruhi ki shadi avinash se…Ek doosre se anjaan in dono ke rishton me aag bhadkane ka kaam kar raha Akash jiska maksad hai Avinash se apne  dad ka badla lene ka kya is sajish me majboori ki shadi ke baad bhi hoti mohabbat ko grahan lagne wala hai ?                                                        `

bhagat-singh-14.title: Bhagat Singh
bhagat-singh-14.description: Indian swaathanthra samara charithrathile dheera viplavakaariyayirunnu Bhagat singh. Kolamarathinu munnilum bhayakkathe, mugham karutha thunikond moodan anuvadhikaathe, 'Inquilab Zindabad, saamrajyathvam thakaratte, Britishukar India viduka' enni mudhravaakyangal muzhakkikond sadhairyam maranam varichcha Bhagat Singhinte ormakal ennum namme prachodhipikkum.

trading-in-the-zone-7.title: ട്രേഡിങ്ങ് ഇൻ ദി സോൺ
trading-in-the-zone-7.description: ട്രേഡിങിലൂടെ സ്ഥിരമായ വരുമാനം ഉണ്ടാക്കാൻ നിങ്ങൾ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നുണ്ടോ? എങ്കിൽ ഈ പുസ്തകം നിങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളതാണ്. ആത്മവിശ്വാസത്തോടെയും അച്ചടക്കത്തോടെയും വിജയിക്കുന്ന മനോഭാവത്തോടെയും വിപണിയിൽ പ്രാവീണ്യം നേടുന്നതിന് ഈ പുസ്തകം നിങ്ങളെ തീർച്ചയായും സഹായിക്കും.

chhatrapati-shivaji-maharaj.title: Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj
chhatrapati-shivaji-maharaj.description: Ek taraf jaha pita Shahji Bhosle Adilshahi ke Changul mein phase hai, wahi dusri taraf unhi ke bete Shivaji Hindvi swarajya ke sapne boonte hai. Apni bhoomi ko Mughal shasan se mukt karne ke is sapne mein laakhon maratha aur malve inke saath jud jaate hai aur saamna hota hai Auranzeb jaise kai khunkar shasako se! Jaane itihaaski sabse mahan gaatha, Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj ki katha!

significance-of-august-15th.title: Significance Of August 15th
significance-of-august-15th.description: Varshangalolam neendu ninna sahana samarathinte phalamanu oro bharatheeyanum ennu anubhavikkunna swathanthramenna amoolya nidhi. Rajyam 75-mathu swathanthra dinam aghoshikkumbol namuku abhimanathode thirinju nokkam suryan asthamikatha samrajyathe muttu kuthicha India enna maharajyathinte charithram.

the-theft-of-india-the-european-conquest.title: The Theft of India:The European Conquests of India
the-theft-of-india-the-european-conquest.description: Kachavadathinte peril vannu prakruthi vibhavangalal sambannamaya nammude nadine oduvil samrajyathwathinte kalkkeezhilaakki kattum konnum kollayadichum sambathum samrajyavum kettippaduthavarude Kadha.

what-if.title: What If?
what-if.description: Corona iss duniya se kabhi khatam hi na ho toh? World War 3 kal agar shuru ho jaaye toh? Internet hi band ho jaaye toh? Aise kahi sawaal hai joh humesha apne dimaag mein ghumte rehte hai. Iss series mein hum aise hi sawaalon ke jawaab leke aaye hai. Toh aaiye chalte hai Possibilities ki duniya mein

kranthiveera-sangolli-rayanna.title: KRANTHIVEERA SANGOLLI RAYANNA
kranthiveera-sangolli-rayanna.description: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ವೀರ ಯೋಧರ ಶೌರ್ಯ ಅಪ್ರತಿಮವಾದುದು. ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ 'ಸಂಗೊಳ್ಳಿ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ'ನ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಚಿನ್ನದ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯಲಾಗಿದೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಅತಿಶಯೋಕ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೆ ಇಂತಹ ಜಗಜ್ಯೋತಿಯನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಲು ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರು ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಕುತಂತ್ರ.! ಶೌರ್ಯಶಾಲಿ ಸಂಗೊಳ್ಳಿ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ ಅವರ ಜೀವನ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು.? ಇಂತಹ ಪರಾಕ್ರಮಿಯ ಬೆನ್ನಿಗೆ ಚೂರಿ ಹಾಕಿದವರು ಯಾರು ಎಂಬ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕಾ? ಕೇಳಿ 'ಕ್ರಾಂತಿವೀರ ಸಂಗೊಳ್ಳಿ ರಾಯಣ್ಣ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

panjab-kesari.title: Panjab Kesari
panjab-kesari.description: 'ಪಂಜಾಬ್ ಕೇಸರಿ' ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನೆನಪಾಗೋದು ಲಾಲಾ ಲಜಪತ್ ರೈ..! ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರನ್ನ ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಹೊರಹಾಕಲು ನಡೆದ ಹೋರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಇವರ ಪಾತ್ರ ಅವಿಸ್ಮರಣೀಯ! ಇವರ ಧೈರ್ಯ, ದೃಢ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಹಾಗೂ ಉಗ್ರ ಸ್ವಭಾವದಿಂದ 'ಪಂಜಾಬಿನ ಸಿಂಹ’ ಎಂದೇ ಖ್ಯಾತರಾದರು. ಇಂತಹ ಸಾಹಸಮಯ ನಾಯಕನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'PANJAB KESARI' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿ! 🎧🔥

shaheed-uddam-singh.title: Shaheed Udham Singh
shaheed-uddam-singh.description: Yeh kahaani hai ek revenge ki. Jiss revenge ka janam hua Jallianwala Baug Hatyakand se. Kaise Uddam Singh ne British Empire ke jad tak jaakar yeh badla liya aiye suntte hai issi rochak audio biography ko

indian-independence-movement-1857-1947.title: INDIAN INDEPENDENCE MOVEMENT 1857-1947
indian-independence-movement-1857-1947.description: 1857ರಲ್ಲಿ 'ಸಿಪಾಯಿ ದಂಗೆಯ' ನಂತರ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟದ ರಣಕಹಳೆ ಮೊಳಗಿತು. ಹೀಗಾಗಿ 1857-1947ರ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಹೋರಾಟಗಳು ನಡೆದವು. ಬ್ರಿಟೀಷರ ಸದೆಬಡಿಯಲು ವೀರ ಯೋಧರು ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿ ನಿಂತರು. ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಕೋಟಿ ಕೋಟಿ ಜನ ತಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಾಣತ್ಯಾಗ ಮಾಡಿದರು. ಹೀಗೆ ವಿಶ್ವದ ಯಾವ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಕಾಣದೆ ಕೇಳರಿಯದ ಮಹೋನ್ನತ ಹೋರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ ವಿಜಯೀಶಾಲಿಯಾಯಿತು. ಇದನ್ನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಎಳೆಎಳೆಯಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಯುವ ಕುತೂಹಲ ನಿಮಗೆ ಇದೆಯಾ? ಕೇಳಿ 'INDIAN INDEPENDENCE MOVEMENT 1857-1947' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.!

bhopal-gas-tragedy.title: Bhopal Gas Tragedy
bhopal-gas-tragedy.description: BHOPAL, is shehar ka apna ek alag hi mizaz hai. Nawabiyat se bhara itihas aur harfanmaula shaukin log. Magar isne ek aisi kaali raat dekhi, jisne iski khubsurti ka gala ghont diya aur pure desh par ek kala saya sa chaa gaya. Voh waqt tha 2 December, 1984 ka jab Union Carbide India Limited pesticide plant se leaked 'Methyl isocyanate' zehrili gas se bekhabar soye hue Bhopaliyo ko hamesha ke liye maut ki need sula diya. Saans nahi li ja rahi thi, khoon ki ulti ho rahi thi. Aisa manzar jo kisi ne bure se bure khwab mein nahi socha hoga. Sarkar aur aam janta dono lachar mehsoos kar rahe the. Aakhir kon tha zimmedaar is haadse ke peeche aur gayi masoom jano ka kya? Kaise yeh shehar ek sath khade hokar is dardnak tragedy se ubhara, aaiye samajhte hai is show mein!

indian-cricket-team-in-2007.title: Indian Cricket Team in 2007
indian-cricket-team-in-2007.description: Innaiku ulaga cricket la India oru asaikka mudiyaatha team ah irukka pala kaaranangal iruku. But 2007 Indian Cricket team ku oru mukkiyamaana thiruppumunai varushamaa amanjathu. Appadi antha varusham ennalaam nadanthathunu intha pathivu la kelunga.

mangal-pandey.title: MANGAL PANDEY
mangal-pandey.description: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸಂಘರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ವೀರ ಯೋಧರ ಬಲಿದಾನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಅಧಿಕೃತವಾಗಿ ಮೊದಲನೇ ನೆತ್ತರು ಹರಿಸಿದ ಅಪ್ರತಿಮ ದೇಶಪ್ರೇಮಿ 'ಮಂಗಲ್ ಪಾಂಡೆ'. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಸೇನೆಯಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಮಂಗಲ್ ಪಾಂಡೆ ಅವರ ರಕ್ತ ಕುದಿಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಆ ಘಟನೆಯಾದರು ಯಾವುದು? ಇವರ ಒಂದು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸಂಘರ್ಷದ ದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನೇ ಬದಲಿಸಿತು ಹೇಗೆ? ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಮಂಗಲ್ ಪಾಂಡೆ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

atal-bihari-bajpyaee.title: Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Bajpyaee
atal-bihari-bajpyaee.description: Bhartiya janasangh ke shuruaatee sadasyon mein se ek, joh aage jaake pehli Non-congress sarkar ke head bane. Aur is saarvajanik vyaktitv ke peechhe ek asamanya vyaktigat jeevan tha, jisse unhone bohot hi dignity se conduct kiya. Aaiye sunte hai iss Bharat Ratna ki kahaani

the-psychology-of-investing.title: Janun Investing-Er Psychology
the-psychology-of-investing.description: Jibone Sofolota Pete Sobai Chay. Kintu Sei Sofolotar Sothik Poth Konti? Ei Boite Bola Aache Monobigyanira Kivabe Aamader Siddhantoke Provabito Kore. Ei Audiobook E Psychology Er Koyekti Dik Bornona Kora Aache. Ei Pothgulo Anusoron Korle Jibone Aamra Sofolota Pete Pari. Biniyoger Khetreo Ekta Dharona Dey Ei Audiobook. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak.

leader-in-you-1.title: The Leader In You
leader-in-you-1.description: The Leader In You examines how world leaders were able to achieve performance in their personal and professional life by forming meaningful connections and achieving greater levels of productivity through a proactive, upbeat mindset. It offers a collection of stories and insightful lessons from influential leaders from around the world who achieved great success in part because of their exceptional communication abilities. Start reading if you're ready to put the information in this book into practice.

the-magic-path-of-intuition.title: The Magic Path Of Intuition
the-magic-path-of-intuition.description: Ek aisi kitab jo aapka adhyatmik vikaas karegi, aapko positivity ki aur le jayegi ur apne lakshya mein Vishwas rakhne ki kshamta degi. Kisi bhi tarah ke dar ko overcome kar kaise apne aap par Vishwas kare ye sikhayegi. Agar aapko Rhonda Byrne dwara likhi gayi "The Magic" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

how-to-stop-worrying-and-start-living-5.title: How To Stop Worrying And Start Living
how-to-stop-worrying-and-start-living-5.description: “How to Stop Worrying and Start Living” Ane ee Book Evarithey pratidaaniki Aandolana chendutu Maanasika, Shareeraka samasyalanu koni techukuntaro vaariki andolana vidichi anandamga jeevinchadam elago chala easy and practicle methods lo explain chestundi. Ee book ni “Dale Carnegie” Rasaru. Sel improvemnt vanti pustakalu modata prachurinchina writers lo okaru.

the-power-of-the-spoken-word.title: Jibone Positive Changes Anar Upay
the-power-of-the-spoken-word.description: Amader mukh theke berono shobdo amder jibon bodlanor khomota rakhe. amra je bhabe boli ar thik ei karonei amra shei bhabei bhebe thaki. Amra egulor opor ektu concentrate kore poristhiti bodlate sokhhom hote pari. Ei sarangsho ti jodi apni shonen tahole eti apnar jibone positive changes ante khub e easily help korbe.

champions-of-83.title: Champions of 83
champions-of-83.description: 83 mein betting karne waale bhi 66:1 offer kar rahe the for India winning the worldcup. Saare odds ke khilaap ladke, Kapil Dev ki inspirational captaincy ne India ko apna pehla Worldcup dila hi diya. Aaiye sunte hai Underdogs se Worldcup ke lions banne ka yeh safar.

netaji-1.title: Netaji
netaji-1.description: భారత దేశానికి స్వాతంత్య్రం తేవడంలో ముఖ్య భూమిక ను పోషించి దేశ శ్రేయస్సు కోసం అనుక్షణం పరితపించిన మహనీయుడు మన నేతాజీ. ఇప్పుడున్న ఇండియన్ మిలిటరీని స్థాపించిన ఆయన గురించి ఇంకా ఆయన చేసిన త్యాగాలు, పోరాటాల గురించి విందాం.

the-little-book-that-still-beats-the-mar.title: Stock Market Genius Baniye
the-little-book-that-still-beats-the-mar.description: Ek successful find manager  se share bazar ke liye , case studies, background information aur stock market genius banne ke liye aavashayak sabhi tools se bhari hui ye summary book aapko top investment opportunities ke baare meinn batayegi! Agar aapko "The Little Book that still beats the Market" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

mee-vijeta-honarach.title: Me Vijeta Honarach
mee-vijeta-honarach.description: Successful honyasathi pratyek jan dhadpadat asto, pan saglech yashsvi hoat nahit. Yashasvi honyasathi nakki kontya dishene praytna karavet? aple Goals kase set karavet? Winner bannyasathi konti Skills aplya madhe asli pahijet? ya sarva prashanchi yogya uttra tumhala miltil- Orison Swett Marden yancha 'Me Vijeta Honarch' ya pustkat. Nakki aika..

the-discovery-of-india-6.title: The Discovery of India
the-discovery-of-india-6.description: Ahmed Nagar kottayile Jail vasa kalath Jawahar Lal Nehru ezhuthiya ee grandham Indiayude Charithratheyum Samskaratheyum kurichulla kurippukal aanu. Indiayude aathmavu thediyulla Nehruvinte anweshanam.

the-magic.title: Dhunde apne Jeevan ka Maksad
the-magic.description: Hum sab kabhi na kabhi hamare jeevan ke purpose ko jaane ki koshish karte hai magar jaan nahi paate. Zindagi bilkul sahi chal rahi hoti hai fir bhi kuch kami mehsoos hoti hai. Kho jaane aur idhar udhar bhatakne ki ye bhavna aksar bina kisi wajah ke aur isse kaise deal kare ye samajhne ke liye, ye book summary aap hi ke liye bani hai!

financial-crisis.title: FINANCIAL CRISIS
