no-excuses-the-power-of-self-discipline-.description: Banglay Ekta Kotha Aache, Sobtheke Boro Hath Holo Ajuhath. Aar Ei Hath Aapnake Jibone Konodin Sofol Hote Dey Na. Aapni Dekhchen Aapnar Paser Manushti Sofolotar Churay Kintu Aapni Parchen Na, Etar Karon Ajuhath Hote Pare. Jibone Sofolotar Churay Pouchote Gele Self-Discipline Hoyoya Khub Joruri.  Etai Aapnake Jibone Sofolotar Poth Dekhay. R Ei Self-Discipline Mantei Hbe Kono Ajuhath Cholbe Na. Kivabe Ei Self-Discipline Gore Tola Jay Se Kotha Bola Aache Ei Audiobook E. Aasun Tahole Shune Neyoya Jak.

inteqam-ki-raat.title: Inteqam Ki Raat
inteqam-ki-raat.description:
Jahan Ek traf haveli me saalon bad Varish ke ane ki khusi ka jashn manaya ja raha tha. Wahi dusri traf ek kala saya sare gaon ko khud me samete ja raha tha. Kya hoga jab thakur ko pata chalega bacche ke gayab hone ke peeche ka raaz?
Kya hoga jab dayan ka inteqaam lega ese hi kai aur masoomo ki jaan aur mita kar rakh dega pure gaon ki pehchaan. Jaane ke leye sune “Inteqaam Ki Raat”

attitude-is-everything-10.title: Attitude Toiri Kora Sikhe Nin
attitude-is-everything-10.description: Thik kore jodi dekhen, tahole bujhben attitude kintu shob kichu. Apnar bhalo attitude jemon apnake anek dur niye jete pare, bhul attitude er khetre kintu puroi ulto. Manusher ei personality manush ke anek sahajyo kore ebong jibone anek dur egiye niye jaye. Attitude e apnar jiboner altitude toiri korte pare. Tahole aj amra shune nebo Jeff Keller er lekha Attitude Is Everything er book summary.

india-vs-pakistan-1971-1.title: INDIA vs PAKISTAN 1971
india-vs-pakistan-1971-1.description: Indha ulagathula punniya boomi naa adhu namma Bharatha thirunaadu dhaan. Nammaloda thalaivargal mattrum thalaivigaloda thiyagathin mudivu namakku kidaitha sudhandhiram. Athoda ellam mudinjiduchu nu arrambichi poittu irundha oru kaalakattathula udhithadu dhaan india pakistan pirivu. Athoda kadhai ah dhaan inga neenga kettu therinjikka poreenga. Jai hind..!

love-beat-3.title: Love Beat
love-beat-3.description: Apne Bachpan Ke Sapno Me Rang Bhartey Ye Doctors internship ke liye desh ke sabse bade hospital Chiranjeevi Tak To Phuch Jatey Hai. Lekin Pehle Hi Din Unka Samna Hota hai Ek Ese controversial case Se Jo Unki Zindagi  Ka Faisla Tay Karega. Akhir kya karenge ye doctors? Kya Ye Nayi Shurat Leke Ayi Hai Kisi Ant Ka Sath?

mammootty-enna-vismayam.title: Mammootty Enna Vismayam
mammootty-enna-vismayam.description: Malayala cinemayil innuvare undayittullathil ettavum vyathyasthamaaya characters sammanichirikunnath Megastar Mammootty thanne aayirikkum. Innu yuvaakalkoppam Malayala Cinemayude munpanthiyil thanne adheham thilangumbozhum Mammootty enna nadan puthiya pareekshanangal thanneyanu thedunnath.

brain-chip.title: Brainchip
brain-chip.description: Ek chip, jo brain me fit ho kar deti hai tabaahi ho gayi hai chori! RAW Agents lad rahe hain is mystery ko suljhane me. Kya woh samay par rok payenge us desh drohi ko?

75-years-of-independence-day.title: 75 Years of Independence Day
75-years-of-independence-day.description: Suthanthiram kidachu 75 varusham aagirukku. Intha 75 varusha Freedom namakku kidaikka ethanayo varushangal pala vithamaana poraattangal nadanthirukku. Varalaarai konja neram thirumbi paakalaam vaanga.

attitude-is-everything-9.title: Attitude is Everything
attitude-is-everything-9.description: Nalla attitude nediyedukkan nammal enthoke cheyanam enninganeyulla ningalude ella samshayangalkkumulla utharamanu Jeff Keller ezhuthiya 'Attitude is Everything' enna krithiyil ullathu.

deep-work-3.title: Focused rehne ke Effective Rules
deep-work-3.description: Kya aap bata sakte hai ki last time kab aapne apna phone bina check kiye ghanto tak focus karke apna kaam kiya tha? Iss social media ki duniya mein hum khudko ek kaam mein immerse karna bhul gaye hai. Iss book summary ke jariye aap aise hi kuch techniques ko sikhenge joh aapko focus karne aur complex task mein fully immerse karna sikhayengi.

chernobyl-1986-1.title: Chernobyl -1986
chernobyl-1986-1.description: 90,000 perin uyirai bali vaangiya, 1986 il Nadandha Chernobyl anu ulai vedippin urukkamaana unmai kadhaiyai neralai vadivil indha padhivin vazhiye ketpom vaarungal !

en-vazhi-thani-vazhi.title: En Vazhi Thani Vazhi
en-vazhi-thani-vazhi.description: Cricket ulagathoda Thala Dhoni thannoda career la amazing aana pala magic pannirukaaru. Ethunaala avaru legend aah kondaada paduraarunu therinjikka intha pathivai mulusaa kelunga. Ithu Dhoni Vazhi Thani Vazhi.

the-death-an-inside-story-by-sadguru.title: Jeevan aur Mrityu ke beech ka safar
the-death-an-inside-story-by-sadguru.description:
Aastik ho ya avishwasi, bhakt ho ya nahi. siddh sadhak ho ya sadharan vyakti, ye audiobook har kisi ke liye hai jiska shareer ek na ek din is sansar ko chhod kar jaane wala hai. 
Ek vyavharik drishtikon se,  koi apne mrityu ke liye kya taiyari kar sakta hai, hum kisi aise vyakti ki sahayta kaise kar sakte hai jo mar raha hai aur hum mrityu ke baad bhi unki yatra ka samarthan kaise jaari rakhe.

ego-is-the-enemy-6.title: Ego Theke Nijeke Bachan
ego-is-the-enemy-6.description: Ekbar jibone success er swad peye gele odbhut ohonkari hoye pori amra sokolei. Ar ei ohonkar theke beriye asha khub e difficult hoye jaye. Lokhyo kore dekhben amader ego amader jibon ke shob dik theke noshto kore dei. Ei ego theke beche berono khub e koshtokor kintu impossible noi. Ei shob tips er byapar e jante shune nin Ego Is The Enemy.

parenting-tips-for-indian-parents-1.title: Parenting Tips For Indian Parents
parenting-tips-for-indian-parents-1.description: Ee “ parenting tips for indian parents” book meeru biddanu kanalani anukunnapptinundi bidda teenage lo adugu pette varaku talette samasyalanu gurinchi vivaristundi. Idi physical,emotional, Abigna vikasaniki sambandinchi vividha dashala growth&development ni ardam chesukovadamlo sahayapadutundi. Idi practicle parenting , second child kosam prepare avadam, single child vanti samasyalatho vyvaharinchadam, teenage samasyalanu artham chesukovadamtho paatu telivitetalu mariyu vyakthitwatti artham chesukovadam vanti vishayalapai lotuga vishleshananu andistundi.

the-amazing-secrets-of-the-yogi.title: The Amazing Secrets of the Yogi
the-amazing-secrets-of-the-yogi.description: Ek spiritual journey ka dwaar sirf ek click door hai. Aisa saaransh jo aapko apne shareer, mann aur aatma ko santulan mein laana seekhayega. Swasthya se jude har chote se lekar bade rahasyo ko aapke saamne ujaagar karega. Suniye Charles F. Haanel ke kalam se nikli aur Rj karan Sharma ki aawaaz me kewal kuku fm par. Saans andar le, saans bahar nikale aur sawaar ho jaaye is adhyaatmik safar par. Agar aapko Autobiography of a Yogi jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

increasing-human-efficiency-in-business-.title: Increasing Human Efficiency In Business
increasing-human-efficiency-in-business-.description: While we've created machines to increase company efficiency, people are still people, and people are inefficient. However, must it always be that way? Walter Dill Scott, a renowned business psychologist, asserts that managers can assist employees in locating the moment at which they surpass their earlier boundaries and perform at their very best. In this book, Scott investigates how to foster success-oriented motivation. He considers elements including imitation, rivalry, loyalty, and focus. In order to uncover wider horizons of profitable action," he seeks to uncover each employee's latent abilities and secret energy reserves. A must-read for anyone willing to improve the effectiveness of human resources in their business.

how-to-crack-an-interview-1.title: How to Crack an Interview
how-to-crack-an-interview-1.description: Job Interview dyayla bhiti watte? Mag ata ajibat tension gheu naka. Interview madhil prashnana uttara kashi dyaychi? Interview crack karnysathi kay tayari karychi? Ya saglya vishayi soppya tips milwa, How to Crack an Interview ya book summary madhun.

communicating-your-way-to-success.title: Communicating Your Way To Success
communicating-your-way-to-success.description:
Zaroori nahi ki communication skills inborn ho. Ye baad mein bhi acquire kiye jaa sakte hai. Bas zarurat hai toh willingness determination ki. 
Ye audiobook aapke maukhik aur likhit communcation ko behtar banae ke rannitiya banatyegi jo aapke jeevan ke har pahelu mein safalta ki aur badhne ka ek bada kadam hoga.

limitless-3.title: Limitless Success Peye Jaan
limitless-3.description: Apnio nischoi chan shob limit cross kore jibone limitless success pete. Sottyi kotha bolte amra sokolei borolok hote chai, ar shei chawa ta ekebarei bhul noi. Ami promotion cha,apnio chan, khali chakri te promotion na, somoporkeo khushi hote chan, ar majhe majhei hoito bhaben je egulo hoito possible e na. Emon anek somoy eseche jibon e jokhon kichu acheive korte giyei mone hoyeche je shegulo acheive kora possible e na. Jodi apnader o emon mone hoi, tahole ei book summary ti shune nin ar shikhe nin jibone ki ki bhabe limitless success pawa shombhob

success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.title: Success Through A Positive Mental Attitude
success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.description: 100 successful logon ko interview karne ke baad Napollean Hill iss kitaab se Happiness aur Dream life jeena ka secret share kar rahe hai. Toh is classic self help audiobook ko abhi sunein. Agar aapko "The Secret - The Power" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

mini-habits-1.title: Choto Ovyes Boro Folafol
mini-habits-1.description: Kothay Aache Manush Ovyeser Das. Protita Kaj Choto Choto Ovyes Diye Shuru Hoy. Beshi Porishrom Na Kore Ei Choto Choto Kichu Ovyes Aapnake Safolyo Ene Dey. Ei Boite Lekhok Kichu Ghotona Bornona Korechen Nijer Bastob Upolobdhi Diye. Tini Bohubar Byartho Holeo Bar Bar Choto Ovyes Er Moddhey Diye Sofolota Peyechen. Nishchoi Jante Icche Korche Segulo Ki Ki? Kivabe Choto Choto Ovyes Aapnar Jibon Bodlate Pare? Aasun Tahole Shune Neyoya Jak Ei Audiobook .

suicide-prevention.title: Suicide Prevention
suicide-prevention.description: ಆತ್ಮಹತ್ಯೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಮಹಾಪಾಪ...! ಮನುಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿರುವ ಈ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯವಾದ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಖುಷಿ-ಖುಷಿಯಾಗಿ ಕಳೆಯಬೇಕು. ಅದನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು, ಆತುರದಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ತಾನೇ ಅಂತ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಎಷ್ಟು ಸರೀ??? ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕೇಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಆತ್ಮಹತ್ಯೆಗೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕಾರಣವೂ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ...! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ನಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಆತ್ಮಹತ್ಯೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಪ್ರಚೋದಿಸುವುದು ಏನು? ಇದನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಲು ನಾವು ಏನು? ಕೇಳಿ 'Suicide Prevention' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

money-making-league.title: Money Making League
money-making-league.description: Har kisiko entrepreneur banne ki iccha hai, har koi apna startup chahta hai. Stock market ko samjhna chahta hai, cryptocurrency mein invest karna chahta hai. Iss audio course mein aapko money related saare sawaalon ke jawaab aasani se milenge. Toh Paisa kamao aur paisa badhaao. Agar aapko "One Up On Wall Street" jaisi books pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

the-discovery-of-india-5.title: The Discovery of India
the-discovery-of-india-5.description: The Discovery of India 1946 lo Modati sariga prachurinchabadinappati nundi oka classic hodanu pondinadi. Nehru yokka adbhuthamaina medassu, lothaina manavathvam mariyu spastamaina shaili The discovery of India nu bharathadesham patla aasakthi unna prathi okkariki, daani gatham mariyu prasthutham rendintini chadavataniki thodpaduthundi. Jawahar lal Nehru Ahmdnagar kotalo khaidu cheyabadinappudu ayidu nelala paatu vrasinadi, The Discovery of India.

yoga-for-health.title: Yoga for Health
yoga-for-health.description: ಯೋಗ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ದೇಹ, ಮನಸ್ಸು, ಮತ್ತು ಆತ್ಮವನ್ನು ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡೋ ಅದ್ಭುತ ವಿಧಾನ. ಇದನ್ನು "ಯುಜ್" ಎಂಬ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ಪದದಿಂದ ತಗೊಂಡಿದ್ದು, ಅರ್ಥ "ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿಸುವುದು", ಅಂದರೆ ದೇಹ-ಮನಸ್ಸು-ಆತ್ಮ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡೋದು! ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

the-power-of-subconscious-mind-1.title: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind
the-power-of-subconscious-mind-1.description: Tera mann jo soche vahi teri sacchai! Is book summary mein aap jaanenge ki insaani dimaag apne aap mein kitna bada karishma hai. Aur subconscious mind ki madad se aap apne har lakshya, khwaab aur jeevan mein aane wale har padhaav ko safalta ke saath asliyat mein badal sakte hai. Jaaniye Joseph Murphy ke dwaara likhi hui yeh kitaab jo aapke mann ke aise dwaar khol degi, jisse aap ab tak anjaan hi rahe - The Power of Subconscious Mind!

malayala-cinemayude-charithram.title: Malayala Cinemayude Charithram
malayala-cinemayude-charithram.description: Cinema enna vyavasaayam Malayalikalkku avarude jeevithathil ninnu maati nirthan kazhiyaatha onnayi maari kazhinju. Ennal Vigathakumaranil thudangi ennathe new generation cinema vare ethi nilkkunna Malayala cinema charithram nammalil etra perkku ariyam. Malayala cinema vyavasayam ennu kanunna reethiyil ethikkunnathinte pinnil etrayo perude thyagavum adwanavum kashdapadumundu. Ethelam ariyam ee audioyilude.

what-i-know-for-sure-1.title: Jibon Sikhha Oprah Winfrey Er Kothae
what-i-know-for-sure-1.description: Ei book summary theke amra jante pari ki bhabe Oprah Winfrey nijer jiboner hardships overcome korechen, ar jibone sofolotar dike egiye gechen. Jibone jotoi protikulota ashuk na keno ki bhabe matha uchu rekhe bachte hoi ei sokol secrets jante shune nin What I Know For Sure er book summary.

kalpana-chawla-biography.title: Kalpana ki Udaan
kalpana-chawla-biography.description: Sapno ki udaan ka naam hai Kalpana. Hindustaan ka gaurav aur antriksh amar gaatha! Ek Indian American astronaut jinka janm hua tha Karnal mein aur jinka jeevan har mahila ke liye prerna daayak hai jo apne sapno ko dekh unhe jeene ki umeed rakhti hai. Space Shuttle Columbia, 1997 mein shuruaat aur dusri udaan STS - 107, saal 2003 mein hamesha ke liye amar. Seat belets baandh lijiye, kyunki udaan bharte hai Kalpana ke saath unki inspiring duniya mein!

tharaniyai-vendra-tamizhargal.title: Tharaniyai Vendra Tamizhargal
tharaniyai-vendra-tamizhargal.description: Tharaniyai vendra thamizhargal pathi therinjukalaam vaanga

amitabh-bachan-the-shehanshaa.title: The Shehenshah - Amitabh Bachchan
amitabh-bachan-the-shehanshaa.description: Amitabh Bachchan bollywood ka ek anivarya hissa hai. Magar is industry mein wo jagah banane ke liye aisi kya kya cheeze karni padi Bachchan ji ko? Kya hai unke ateeth mein aur kaise kai baar gir kar bhi ve ubhre hai? Aaiye jaante hai!

hampi.title: HAMPI
hampi.description: ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಲೆಗೆ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಹೆಸರೇ ಜಗತ್ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಹಂಪಿ..! ಈ ಪದ ಕೇಳಿದಾಕ್ಷಣ ಕಣ್ಮುಂದೆ ಬರೋದು ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಸಾರೋ ಕಟ್ಟಡಗಳು, ಸ್ಮಾರಕಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳು... ಇಲ್ಲಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಕಲ್ಲು ಕೂಡ ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಪರಂಪರೆಯನ್ನು ಪುನಃ ಪುನಃ ಸ್ಮರಿಸುತ್ತೆ..! ಇದಕ್ಕಾಗಿಯೇ ಯುನೆಸ್ಕೋ 'ವಿಶ್ವ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ತಾಣಗಳ' ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಂಪಿ ಹೆಸರು ಸೇರಿದೆ! ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ ಹಂಪಿಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅಥವಾ ಅಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳ ವಿಶೇಷತೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿದಿರೋರು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಂದಿಯೇ. ನಿಮಗೂ ಇದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕೆ? ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಕೇಳಿ, Kuku FMನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಹಂಪಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್...

mughalmatdini-tararani.title: Mughalmardini Tararani
mughalmatdini-tararani.description: 'Samar Saudamin'i, 'Mughal Mardini'- 'Tararani' mhanje Marathyancha itihasatil adhal 'TARA'. Murabbi Rajkarni, Mutsadi Ladhvayya, Dhairyashil Patni ani Savendanshil Maata...asha anek pailuni samrudha Tarabincha mahima atulniya ahe. Swarajyasathi khambirpane Mughlanshi ladha denarya, tyana jeris ananarya- Maharani Tarabaincha jeevan pravas janun gheuya ya show dware.

how-to-win-friends-and-influence-people-.title: How To Win Friends and Influence People
how-to-win-friends-and-influence-people-.description: Ek accha first impression banane ke liye sirf ek smile kaafi hoti hai. Aise hi kahi saare countless principles aapko iss book mein milenge jisse aap ek likable person ban sakte hai aur relationships ko acche se handle kar sakte hai. Dale Carnegie ke dwara likhi gayi iss best selling kitaab ko abhi suniye

price-action-trading-1.title: PRICE ACTION TRADING
price-action-trading-1.description: Price action trading is a kind of trading in which the trader analyses the chart and bases his or her decisions solely on price movements, without considering any other considerations or technical indicators. This book is a comprehensive instruction manual for those new to price action trading. Sharing in-depth knowledge on price action trading, a distinctive way to understand the relationship between price and volume, and tips on how to transition to full-time trading are the main topics. The concepts that you will learn here will help you to switch to full-time trading or help you do it with a regular 9-to-5 job. It is a must-read for people who trade in the stock market or who want to do so in the near future.

live-like-bill-gates.title: Live Like Bill Gates
live-like-bill-gates.description: Bill gates nra peyara namma vaazhkaiyila irunthu namma thavirkkave mudiyaathu. Eppadi Bill Gates ippadi oru business monster aah irukkaru apdinratha pathiyum avaroda ennangal pathiyum intha pathivula paakalaam vaanga.

lifes-amazing-secrets.title: Behtareen jeevan jeene ke raaz
lifes-amazing-secrets.description: Life mein 4 principals bohot his important hote hai khush rehne ke liye, personal life, relationships, work life aur social contribution. Inn chaaron mein balance rakhna bohot jaroori hai, iss balance se aap apni zindagi mein values aur khushiyaan add kar sakte hai. Issi ke baare mein baare mein iss book summary mein bata rahe hai Guar Gopal Dasji. Aaiye suntte hai

droupadi-murmu-the-president-of-india.title: DROUPADI MURMU: The President of India
droupadi-murmu-the-president-of-india.description: ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಮುರ್ಮು! ಇಂದು ಈ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದರೆ, ಈ ದೇಶವೇ ಎದ್ದು ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಬುಡಕಟ್ಟು ಜನಾಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಗಳಾದ ಅವರು ಇಂದು 'ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಥಮ ಪ್ರಜೆ' ಆಗಿರುವುದು ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಸಂಗತಿ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಅವರು ರಾಜಕೀಯಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಈ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಅವರನ್ನು ಕಾದಿದ್ದ ದುರಂತಗಳ ಸಾಲು ಎಷ್ಟು ಗಂಭೀರವಾಗಿತ್ತು? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರು ಕೇಳಬೇಕಾದ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ 'ದ್ರೌಪದಿ ಮರ್ಮು: The President of India'. ಕೇಳಿ ಕೇವಲ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

business-adventures-3.title: Business Build Korar Golpo
business-adventures-3.description: Ei book summary te apni at least 12ta business case studies paben, jegulo business build korte anektai help korbe. Business Adventures boi ti khub e popular ekti boi. Bill Gates ke prothom baar Warren Buffet ei boi ti gift korechilen. Bill Gates khub e impressed chilen ei boi ti pore. Jodi apnara thik kore ei boi ti poren ar properly bojhar cheshta koren tahole apnader aagekar kono bhul  r repeat hobe na.

shanti-ka-maarg.title: The Way of Peace
shanti-ka-maarg.description: Jeevan mein ek insaan ko aakhir saare anubhav bhogne ke baad kya chahiye - Shaanti! Mann ki shaanti hi param shaanti hai. Shaanti ki praapti parmeshwar ke dwaar kholti hai. Dhyaan aapke andar shaanti ke niswaarth aur param punya abhaav ke vyaktitva ko ujaagar karega. Agar jeevan mein shaanti ka marg chahiye, toh aaye hum sab sune is audiobook ko jo hame dikhaayegi - The Way of Peace!

why-i-am-an-atheist-3.title: Why I am an Atheist
why-i-am-an-atheist-3.description: "Why I am an Atheist" by Bhagat Singh, is an introspective exploration of faith, reason, and personal conviction. In this compelling autobiographical work, Bhagat Singh, the iconic Indian freedom fighter, delves deep into his journey towards atheism, offering profound insights into his rejection of religious beliefs. This intriguing audiobook invites listeners on a profound introspective journey. Bhagat Singh's unwavering commitment to truth, justice, and rationality shines through as he dismantles religious dogmas and advocates for a society rooted in reason and equality. "Why I am an Atheist" presents a thought-provoking and timely exploration of faith and atheism, offering a compelling perspective on religion and its role in society. Bhagat Singh's intellectual rigor and unyielding quest for truth make this audiobook a captivating listen for those seeking to challenge their own beliefs and engage in meaningful discourse about religion and personal conviction.

the-science-of-being-well.title: The Science Of Being Well
the-science-of-being-well.description: Kya wakai mein positive thinking ki shakti aapke swasthya ko  behtar bana sakti hai? Ye practical guide aapko swasthya ke siddhanto ka pata lagane mein madad karegi aur aapko ek swasthya, khush-haal jeevan ki aur le jayegi.

science-of-being-well.title: The Science Of Being Well
science-of-being-well.description: The Science of Being Well comes from the acclaimed American author Wallace D. Wattles. Wattles advises the readers to think and act in a specific way. The Science of Being Well uses the potential of optimistic thinking to achieve and sustain good health. This useful manual will assist you in learning about health principles and direct you toward a healthier, happier version of yourself. This book is for you if you're looking for ways to stay healthy and improve your health.  Learn how the power of positive thinking can enhance your health on the pages that follow.

goals-4.title: Kivabe Jiboner Lokhyo Sthir Korben ?
goals-4.description: Lokkhyo Korle Dekhben Sob Manush Kintu Jibone Sofol Hote Paren Na. Kichu Manush Aabar Shunyo Theke Shuru Kore Sofolotar Churay Pouchechen. Eibar Proshno Hocche Ki Sei Karon? Uttor Hocche Tara Tader Jiboner Goalke Chinnito Kore Egiyechen Ebong Kothin Porishrom Korechen. Ebar Aapnar Mone Proshno Jagbe Ki Sei Goal? Aar Kivabe Sofolotar Sirshe Pouchono Jay? Ei Boite Brian Tracy Emon Kichu Poth Ullekh Korechen Ja Follow Korle Aapnio Aapnar Goal Set Kore Sofol Hote Paren. Mathay Rakhben Sofolotar Jonyo Nijer Goal Set Kora Ebong Kothin Porishrom Kora Khub Joruri. Kivabe Segulo Korben? Tar Poth Dekhano Aache Ei Boite. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Nin Ei Audiobook Ebong Goal Set Kore Pouche Jan Sofolotar Sirshe.

raj-kapoor-the-greatest-showman.title: Raj Kapoor: The Greatest Showman
raj-kapoor-the-greatest-showman.description: Kisi ki muskuraahato pe ho nisaar, kisi ka dard mil sake toh le udhaar, kisi ke vaaste ho tere dil mein pyaar, jeena isika naam hai. Shabd kam pad jaayenge inki legacy ko bayaan karte hue. Toh aaiye sunte hai, hindustaani Charlie ki kahaani unki filmo ki zubaani. The Greatest Showman - RAJ KAPOOR!

blink-7.title: Life E Fast Decisions Nite Sikhun
blink-7.description: Ei book summary ti apnader fast decision nite help korbe. Ekdomi kom somoy waste kore ki kore khube taratari proper life decisions ba aro bibhinyo decisions neowa possible ei summary ti theke amra shune nebo.

keralathe-njetticha-kuttakrithyangal.title: Keralathe Njetticha Kuttakrithyangal
keralathe-njetticha-kuttakrithyangal.description: സിനിമകളില്‍ മാത്രം കണ്ടിട്ടുള്ള, അപസര്‍പ്പക നോവലില്‍ മാത്രം വായിച്ചിട്ടുള്ള ക്രൂരകൃത്യങ്ങള്‍ കേരളത്തില്‍ നമ്മുടെ തൊട്ടടുത്ത് നടന്നത് കേട്ട് നമ്മള്‍ ഞെട്ടിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. മനസ് മരവിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. കേരളത്തെ നടുക്കിയ, പൊതുജന രോഷത്തിനും വിലാപത്തിനും സംവാദത്തിനും ഇടയാക്കിയ ഞെട്ടിക്കുന്ന കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങൾ കേൾക്കൂ ഈ ഷോയിലൂടെ.

mental-chemistry.title: Mental Chemistry
mental-chemistry.description: Aap aur aapke vichaar aapke aas-paas ki duniya ko kaise shape dete hai aur aap apne life mein hone waali ghatanaon ko control karane ke liye apni maanasik kshamataon ka upayog kaise kar sakte hai.Complex theories ko iss book mein bohot hi asaani se samjhaya hai. Aur isse padke aap ek positive zindagi ki taraf aapki journey shuru kar sakte hai

kayamkulam-kochunni.title: Kayamkulam Kochunni
kayamkulam-kochunni.description: Malayaalikal oru kallane maravikku vittukoduthitilenkil athu Kayamkulam Kochunniye matramakum. Nallavanaya kallanennum, socialist ennumellam eppozhum aalukal snehathode vilikkunna vyakthi. Ennal Kayamkulam Kochunni charitramano atho verum mithu matramo? Athu ariyan ee audio kelkku.

the-rudest-book-ever-7.title: Jibone Practical Hote Sikhe Nin
the-rudest-book-ever-7.description: Amader sokoler life emon ekta bondhu ache je khub e rude, kintu shob theke beshi sottyi kotha bole ebong mukher opor bole. Life e amader practical hote gele sottyi ta jante hobe dorkar porle shob theke kotheen poddhoti te, kintu jante hobe. Shwetabh gangwar er lekha The Rudest Book Ever book er book summary ti apnar life shei rude bondhu ti, je ampnake apnar life e practical hote ar jibone sokhyom hote sekhabe.

the-story-of-my-experiments-with-truth.title: My Life's Experiments And Reflections
the-story-of-my-experiments-with-truth.description: Har koi janana chahta hai ki Gandhiji ka bachpan kaisa tha, Unka apni patni aur parivaar ke saath rishta kaisa tha, Unki padhai, South Africa jaana aur wapas aake apne desh ki azaadi ki jung chedna. Kaise hua yeh sab? Aaiye sunte hai Satya ke Prayog Ka yeh Original Show sirf KUKU FM par.

nadaprabhu-kempegowda.title: NADAPRABHU KEMPEGOWDA
nadaprabhu-kempegowda.description: ಇವತ್ತು ಐಟಿ ಸಿಟಿ, ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್ ಸಿಟಿ, ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ ಸಿಟಿ ಹೀಗೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಹೆಸರುಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತವಾಗಿರುವುದು 'ನಮ್ಮ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು'. ಹಸಿವು ಅಂತ ಊರು ಬಿಟ್ಟು, ಈ ಕನಸಿನ ನಗರಿಗೆ ಬಂದವರ ಕೈಯನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟಿಲ್ಲ ಈ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು. ಇಂತಹ ಜಗತ್ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾದ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಅಂದಾಗ ನಮಗೆ ನೆನಪಾಗೋ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಹೆಸರು 'ನಾಡಪ್ರಭು ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡರು'! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಇಂತಹ ಅದ್ಭುತವಾದ ನಗರವನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಲು ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡರು ಹಾಕಿದ ಅಡಿಪಾಯ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಇದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯೋ ಕುತೂಹಲ ನಿಮಗೂ ಇದೆಯಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ನಾಡಪ್ರಭು ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

yadadri.title: Yadadri
yadadri.description: Yadagirigutta laskhmi narasimha swamy koluvu deerina divya kshethram. Andari paapalanu kadigivesenduku, sakala janulaku santhoshalu andinchenduku aa lakshmi narasimhudu yadagiri gutta meeda koluvu deeraadu. Telangana rastram lo prasiddha punya kshethralalo okatigaa koniyaduthunna Yadadri kshethram gurinchi marinni vishayalu thelsukundaam.

gita-gyaan-aur-cricketers-ki-kahaniyaan.title: Gita Gyaan aur Cricketers ki Kahaniyaan
gita-gyaan-aur-cricketers-ki-kahaniyaan.description: Bhagvad Geeta ke aadarsh aur sidhaant hum jaane anjaane mein follow karte hai. Aise hi kuch seekh ko azmaaye hai humaare kuch famous cricketers mein. Kaise? Aaiye sunte hai iss audio show mein

the-black-swan-the-impact-of-the-highly-.title: Jiboner Protikulota Kivabe Peroben ?
the-black-swan-the-impact-of-the-highly-.description: Emonkichu Ghotona Thake Ja Manush Aagey Theke Kokhno Anuman Korte Paren Na. Se Stock Markete Crash Hok Ba Dui Desher Moddhey Hothath Juddho Lege Jayoya. Eirokom Anumanhin Ghotonaguloke Black Swan Bola Hoye Thake. Aabar Mone Korun Eisob Ghotonagulo Jodi Manush Aagey Theke Jante Pare Tahole Tader Moddhey Aaro Voy Toiri Hote Pare Ebon Decisions Nite Problem Hote Pare. Kintu Eibar Proshno Hocche Eirokom Poristhitite Porle Ki Kora Uchit ? Eirokom Kichu Tips Deyoya Aache Ei Audiobook E. Tahole Aasun Shune Ni .

beemariyan-harengi.title: Bimariyan Harengi
beemariyan-harengi.description: Bimariyan insaan ko sabse zyada haani pahuchaati hai. Yaha haani mann ki bhi hoti hai aur tann ki bhi. Insaan saari moh maaya ko tyaagkar sirf yehi manata hai ki uska sharir dobara swastha ho jaaye, bhale hi iske liye usse koi bhi keemat kyun na chukani padhe. Toh sabse badi daulat kya hui - humara swaasthya aur humara shareer. Is audio book mein jaaniye apne shareer ke dwaara aap kaise hara sakte hai khatarnaak bimariyon ko. By Dr. Abrar Multani!

the-magic-path-of-intuition-1.title: The Magic Path of Intuition
the-magic-path-of-intuition-1.description: A talented educator, Florence Scovel Shinn helped to shape the areas of spiritual development and human transformation. Numerous people were given the opportunity to accept their inner guidance and overcome obstacles thanks to her direct, practical attitude. This straightforward yet moving book, which includes original, previously written writing, can assist you in making positive changes in your life. You can learn how to develop your intuition and let go of any resistance, fear, or doubt by using effective affirmations.

கொஞ்சம்-இஷ்டம்-கொஞ்சம்-கஷ்டம்-.title: கொஞ்சம் இஷ்டம்... கொஞ்சம் கஷ்டம்..!
கொஞ்சம்-இஷ்டம்-கொஞ்சம்-கஷ்டம்-.description: மும்பை மாநகருக்குப் பல்வேறு எதிர்காலக் கனவுகளுடன் செல்கிறாள் நாயகி. அங்கு அவளது நிறுவன முதலாளியுடன் யதார்த்தமான காதல் ஏற்படுகிறது. அவளுக்குப் பிடித்திருந்தாலும், குடும்பத்தின் சூழ்நிலையைக் கருத்தில் கொண்டு அவள் விலக நினைக்க, விடாப்பிடியாக அவளைத் துரத்துகிறான் காதலன். கொஞ்சம் இஷ்டமும் கொஞ்சம் கஷ்டமும் நிறைந்த அழகிய காதல் கதையைக் கேளுங்கள்...

indian-paisa-league.title: Indian Paisa League
indian-paisa-league.description: Kya kabhi socha hai duniya ki sabse badi cricketing league ka business model kaise hoga? Itna kharcha karne ke baad bhi teams ka profit kaise hota hoga? Iss audio show mein jaaniye Business of Cricket. Kaise shuruvaat hui India ki iss cricketing league ki aur kaise bani woh duniya ki sabse badi league aur jaaniye iske saare business secrets.

kargil-kathana.title: KARGIL KATHANA
kargil-kathana.description: ಕಾರ್ಗಿಲ್! ಈ ಹೆಸರು ಕೇಳ್ತಿದ್ಹಾಗೇ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಭಾರತೀಯನ ನರನಾಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಸಂಚಾರವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ನಮ್ಮ ತಾಯ್ನಾಡಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೆಚ್ಚೆದೆಯ ಹೋರಾಟ ಮಾಡಿದ ವೀರ ಯೋಧರು ಕಣ್ಮುಂದೆ ಬರ್ತಾರೆ. ಶಕ್ತಿ-ಯುಕ್ತಿ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಬಳಸಿ ಇತಿಹಾಸ ಬರೆದ ಕಾರ್ಗಿಲ್ ಯುದ್ಧ ಇಂದು ವಿಜಯದ ಸಂಕೇತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಕಾರ್ಗಿಲ್ ಯುದ್ಧ ಯಾಕಾಯ್ತು? ಇದನ್ನು ಗೆಲ್ಲಲು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಮಾಡಿದ ಹರಸಾಹಸವೇನು? ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ 'ಕಾರ್ಗಿಲ್ ಕಥನ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

keralathe-kaatha-shailaja-teacher.title: Keralathe Kaatha Shailaja Teacher
keralathe-kaatha-shailaja-teacher.description: Lokam muzhuvan Corona enna mahamaarikethire poradiyappol Keralathe cherthu nirthi mikacha pravarthanangal kazhcha vechcha munnil ninnu nayicha nethavanu Shailaja Teacher. Pothupravarthaka enna nilayilum vanitha nethavu enna nilakkum pothujanaarogyathinayi nadathiya Shailaja Teacherude sevanangal globally sradhdha labichirunnu. Kelkaam 'Keralathe Kaatha Shailaja Teacher' enna njangalude special show.

मोटापे-से-ब्रेकअप-.title: Motape se breakup
मोटापे-से-ब्रेकअप-.description: Sabhi umr ke logo ke liye lakshit, ye audiobook bhaartiya logo mein motape ke main karano ke mul siddhanto aur samadhano ka nishkarsh hai. Khaane ke alawa aisi kaunsi chize hai jo aap ka motape se breakup hi nahi hone deti? Jaanenge aisi kai chize isme!

the-four-agreements-2.title: Bhalobeshe Bachar 4Te Agreement
the-four-agreements-2.description: The Four Agreements boi ti amader jibon e bhalo bhabe bacha ebong bhalobeshe bachar onubhuti shekhaye. Ei boi ti te emon anek poddhoti royeche  jegulo apnar nijer opor shob doubts clear korte help korbe, shei sokol poddhoti janar jonnyo shune nin Don Miguel Ruiz er lekha The Four Agreements.

the-everything-store-jeff-bezos-and-the-.title: Amazon App Ki Kore Shuru Holo
the-everything-store-jeff-bezos-and-the-.description: Apnader sokoler phone ei Amazon er app ta ache nischoi,aj kal kar dine bajaar e giye kena kati korar somoy karur hatei ar nei ei muhurte, tai Amazon e best upaye. Such suto theke shuru kore shob rokomer gadgets pawa jaye ei Everything store e. Kintu apnara ki janen ei mind blowing business start ki kore hole, ar kei ba start korlo? Ei startup er ki ki challenges chilo ar ki bhabe etto ta successful hoi daralo ei startup,shob kichu jante shune nin ei book summary ti.

ishq-tamasha-zindagi-e01.title: Ishq Tamasha Zindagi
ishq-tamasha-zindagi-e01.description: Sapno ki duniya mein gum Pankhuri ghar aaye NRI Rajan se kar baithti hai pyaar. Par Rajan ke sath engagement ke bad Pankhuri ki zindagi hamesha ke liye badal jaati hai. Wo usi raat Rajan ko apni behen Mehak ke sath bistar par paati hai. Kya is dhokhe ki maar, khtam kar degi pankhuri ka pyar ? Kya tooti Pankhuri de payegi apne sapno ko udaan? Sune Pankhuri ke pankh lagne ki kahani.

how-to-enjoy-your-life-and-your-job.title: How to Enjoy Your Life and Your Job
how-to-enjoy-your-life-and-your-job.description: Since the majority of us spend the majority of our lives at work, we should be making the most of it. Life is very much what we make it. Even if you enjoy your job, you probably have days when very nothing goes according to plan. Dale Carnegie, a best-selling author, demonstrates how to add excitement and satisfaction to each day. You'll learn skills you didn't know you had thanks to this book and develop a fresh perspective on people and life. You can always make the best of yourself with the guidance of Dale Carnegie. Start enhancing your life today by developing your unique talents and qualities!

samrat-ashoka.title: Samrat Ashoka
samrat-ashoka.description: Humaare tirange ka chakra, national emblem, Non-violence ke prati humaara lagaav in sabhi mein Samrat Ashoka ki chaap milti hai. Ek fearsome warrior se ek ardent follower of Buddhism ki unki journey ko mehsus karte hai iss audiobook mein.

100-worlds-greatest-speeches-3.title: Mohan Byaktider Bani Ja Bodlabe Aapnar Jibon
100-worlds-greatest-speeches-3.description: Sobder Moddhey Ekta Aalada Sokti Thake. Thik Kore Guchiye Sobde Kotha Bolley Ekjon Manush, Emonki Ekta Desher Vobissyot Porjonto Bodle Jete Pare. Ei Boite Emon Kichu Manusher Speech Bornito Aache Ja Somaj Bodoler Dak Diyechilo, Loraiyer Sokti Jugiyechilo. Ki Chilo Sei '100 World's Greatest Speeches'? Asun Shune Ni.

goshta-guru-shishyachianokhya-natyachi-1.title: Goshta Guru Shishyachi...Anokhya Natyachi
goshta-guru-shishyachianokhya-natyachi-1.description: Guru Parmatma Pareshu’ ashi gurunchi mahati aaplyakde sangitali jate. Prachin, Ved kalapasun chalat aleli Guruparampara aajchya Adhunik Yugatahi japali Jat ahe. Yachich sangati sadhun Adhunik yugatil , vividh kshetratil prasiddh vyaktimatve ani tyanchya gurunshi tyanche aslele nate, ya vishayee chi khaas malika ‘Gosht Guru-Shishyachi…Anokhya Natyachi.

man-ke-rahasy.title: Mann Ke Rahasya
man-ke-rahasy.description: Insaan ka mann apne aap mein ek brahmaand hai. Ek aisa brahmaand jiski ab tak hum sirf parat hi choon paaye hai aur jiski gehraai ka aadam zaat ko ab tak koi andaaza nahi. Theek usi tarah humare mann ki gehraaiyo mein bhi aise anginat rahasya chupe hai, jinhe jaan aur samajhkar insaan ek naye jeevan ke darwaaze ko khol sakta hai. Suniye is naayab audiobook ko, jise likha hai Dr. Abrar Multani ne. Jaaniye, 'Mann ke Rahasya'.

the-millionaire-fastlane-3.title: Easy Ar Fast Way Te Taka Ay Korun
the-millionaire-fastlane-3.description: Apni jodi taka aye korar shob purono ideas ebong methods theke bore hoye gechen, ar bhabchen ki ki notun upaye ache, tahole apnake ei book summary ta shunte hobe. Anek notun dhoroner ideas ar methods diye easy ar fast way te ortho aye korte chaile shune nin The Millionaire Fastlane.

i-am-malala-2.title: Malala : Ek Loraiyer Name
i-am-malala-2.description: Eta Ek Pakistani Meye Malala Er Jibon Songrame Er Golpo. Ei Audiobook E Tule Dhora Hoyeche Emon Kichu Ghotona, Ja Shiure Othar Moto. Ekahne Ekjon Meyer Jibon Songramer Golpo Bola Holeo, Aasole Eta Protita Chele-Meyer Songrameke Represent Kore, Jara Aawaj Tole Adhikar Rokkhar Jonyo. Ei Golpo Notun Kore Bachte Sekhay, Lorai Korte Sekhay. Thik Ki Ki Ghotechilo Malala Er Jibone? Kivabe Se Hoye Uthlo Bishwer Ek Protibadi Mukh? Asun Shune Ni .

garbhavastha-aur-shishu-dekhbhal.title: Garbhavastha Aur Shishu Dekhbhal
garbhavastha-aur-shishu-dekhbhal.description: Jab couples physically, mentally aur financially fit ho jaate hai, tab woh Family aage badhaane ka sochte hai. Iske liye kuch tayariyaan bohot important hai. Iss audiobook mein aap step by step jaanenge ki aapko Preganancy mein aur Child birth ke baad kaise khayaal rakhna hai

the-compound-effect-9.title: The Compound Effect
the-compound-effect-9.description: Manam vijyam sadhinchadaaniki edi avasaramo, Edi mukhyamo telusukunentha knowledge ee book meeku andistundi.

chatrapati-sambhaji-maharaj.title: Chatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj
chatrapati-sambhaji-maharaj.description: Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj yanche putra- Dharmavir Chatrapti Sambhaji maharaj mhnje pratyek Marathi mansacha abhiman. Sahasi, Parakarami, Anek bhashanvar prabhutva aselel Vidvan, Dharambhimani asha Chatrapati Sambhaji Maharajana manacha Mujara karuya ani aikuya, tyancha ayueshyache vividha pailu ulgadnara ha khas show, fakt aplya Kuku FM var.

dil-bechara.title: Dil Bechara
dil-bechara.description: Nashe me sirf ek raat Sonal ki poori zindgi badal daalti  hai. Apne bachpan ke pyar ko chod kar use ek ajnabi ke sath shaadi karni pad jaati hai. Lekin is shaadi ki hain bhayanak shartain Akhir kahan le jayegi Sonal ko ye Zindgi? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Dil Bechara sirf Kuku FM per!

ayurved-todays-lifestyle.title: Ayurved & Today's Lifestyle
ayurved-todays-lifestyle.description: Ayurved he aplyala labhlele ek uttam vardaan ahe. Sadhyacha dhavpalicha jagat apla barechda arogyakade durlksha hota. Matra ya fast life madhe hi Ayurvedic jeevan padhati aplya health chi uttam kalji gheu shakte. Ayurvedic aahar konta? Tyache sharirala kay fayde ahet? Anek Aajar, Vikar yavar konte Ayurvedic upchar labhdayak thartat? ya saglya vishayi janun ghenyasathi nakki aika- Ayurved & Today's lifestyle ha khas show.

-பொன்னியின்-செல்வன்-பாகம்5--தியாக-சிகரம்.title: பொன்னியின் செல்வன் -5 : தியாகச் சிகரம்
-பொன்னியின்-செல்வன்-பாகம்5--தியாக-சிகரம்.description: பொன்னியின் செல்வனின் ஐந்தாவது பாகம், தியாகச் சிகரம். பாண்டிய ஆபத்துதவிகள் சோழப் பேரரசர் சுந்தர சோழர், பட்டத்து இளவரசர் ஆதித்த கரிகாலர், இளவரசர் அருள்மொழி வர்மர் ஆகியோரைக் கொலை செய்ய சதித்திட்டம் தீட்டுகிறார்கள். இவர்களின் சதித் திட்டத்துக்கு பலியானது யார்? தப்பியது யார்? தனக்கு நடைபெற்ற பட்டாபிஷேகத்தை அருள்மொழிவர்மன் ஏற்றுக்கொண்டானா?

jeena-sikha-dengi-100-kahaniya.title: Jeena Sikha Dengi 100 Kahaniya
jeena-sikha-dengi-100-kahaniya.description: Kahaniyaan humme rasta dikhaati hai. Ek kahaani apne aap mein ek guru hoti hai. Kahaniyaan haste aur rote hue humme kuch aise life lessons sikhaati hai joh apne jeevan ko asaan aur mahaan banadete hai. Aiye sunte hai aisi hi kuch kahaaniyaan iss kitaab ke jariye.

-பொன்னியின்-செல்வன்-பாகம்-4-மணிமகுடம்.title: பொன்னியின் செல்வன் - 4 : மணிமகுடம்
-பொன்னியின்-செல்வன்-பாகம்-4-மணிமகுடம்.description: பொன்னியின் செல்வனின் நான்காவது பாகம் மணிமகுடம். சோழப் பேரரசர் நோய் வாய்ப்பட்டுள்ள சூழலில் அரியணையைக் கைப்பற்ற மிகப்பெரிய சதி நடக்கிறது. அதற்கு பழுவேட்டரையர்கள், சம்புவரையர்கள் உள்ளிட்ட குறுநில மன்னர்கள் துணை போகிறார்கள். இதைக் கேள்விப்பட்ட ஆதித்த கரிகாலன் வெகுண்டெழுகிறான். சதியாலோசனை நடைபெறும் கடம்பூர் மாளிகைக்கு ஆதித்த கரிகாலனை செல்லவிடக் கூடாது என்று பலர் தடுக்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், விதி யாரை விட்டது?

leader-in-you.title: The Leader In You
leader-in-you.description: Hum mein se har ek vyakti ek accha leader ban sakta hai/ Bohot se logon ko abhi bhi leadership ki sahi se samjh nahi hai. Leadership humesha leader banne ke baad shuru nahi hoti, leadership ki shuruaat bohot pehle se hi insaan ke andar hoti hai jab woh safalta ki seedheyaan chadhta hai. Iss kitaab mein aap aise hi leadership lessons aur manav sambhandhon ke baare mein sikheng. Agar aapko  "The CEO Next Door" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

mithali-raj.title: Mithali Raj
mithali-raj.description: Bharatha desham ki garvakaranam gaa nilichina cricketer oka mahila cricketer mana Mithali. Bharatha desha ammayilalo entho aathma vishwasaanni nimpina spoorthi daatha mana mithali. Purushula cricket ku deetugaa mana mahilaa team ni thayaru chesi enno antharjathiya vedikala meeda mana desha thrivarna pathaakanni reparepaladinchina neti mahila gurinchi thelsukundaam.

what-india-should-do-to-avoid-the-srilan.title: What India Should Do To Avoid The Srilankan State
what-india-should-do-to-avoid-the-srilan.description: Srilanka mana porugu deshamaa? Leka mithra deshama? Ee prashnalaku rendu avunane untayi. Ee desham manatho konni vishayaallo dagudu muthalu aaduthune untundi. Ippati srilanka paristhithi mathram dayaneyamgaa undi. Sri lanka ee dusthithiki karanalu? Charithra, Bharatha desha pathra mariyu karthavyam gurinchi thelusukundam.

man-ke-liye-amreet-ki-boondien.title: Mann Ke Liye Amrit Ki Boondein
man-ke-liye-amreet-ki-boondien.description: Hamara swasthya is par nirbhar karta hai ki hum kaisa sochte-vicharte hain. Jis tarah sakaratmakta haume khushi se bhara aur utsahit rakhti hai, nakaratmakta uska ulta kar deti hai. Jaane maane chikitsak Dr. Abrar Multani is audiobook mein swashtya rehne ke behtareen nuskhe batati hai.

jyoti-basu-the-untold-story.title: Jyoti Basu : The Untold Story
jyoti-basu-the-untold-story.description: Bongo Totha Bharotiyo Rajnitite Ek Ujjwal Nokhtro Holen Jyoti Basu. Rajnitite Tar Obodan Anoshikarjo. (1977-2000) Dirgho 23 Bochor Chilen Poshchimbonger Mukhyomontri. Kivabe Tini Elen Rajnitir Anginay? PM Hoyoyar Sujog Thakleo Keno Tini Holen Na? Keno Feralen 'Bharotrotno' Puroskar? Echarao Soisob Theke Shuru Kore Tar Jiboner Nana Jana-Ajana Kahinir Kotha Shune Nebo 'Jyoti Basu : The Untold Story'- Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye.

the-secret-door.title: The Secret Door To Success
the-secret-door.description: Each of us has a door to success within of us. The ability to succeed makes the difference between those who do and those who fail. Let Florence Scovel Shinn's timeless work instruct you on how to locate and open the door to the hidden principles of success. The book concentrates heavily on wisdom and help from the scriptures, along with anecdotes. You can and will achieve success!

bargad-ka-ped.title: Bargad Ka Ped
bargad-ka-ped.description: Pichle janam ki adrishya shaktiyon ke karan gao ke do ladke pad jaate hai Bargad ke ped ke maya jaal mein. Isi Bargad ke ped ke dehshat mein hai pura gao. Kya ye do ladke bacha paenge apne gao ka astitv? Ya ye Bargad ka Ped khatam kar dega ek pura gao. Janane ke liye sune kahani, "Bargad ka Ped"

beating-the-street-3.title: Kivabe Invest Korle Valo Return Paben ?
beating-the-street-3.description: Aamra Sobai Emon Ekta Jibon Chai Jekhane Swadhinota Aache. Songe Chai Aarthik Soccholota. Kintu Jiboner Doure Dourate Giye Seta Hoye Othe Na. Ebar Proshno Holo Emontai Ki Sarajibon Cholbe? Middle Class Ra Ki Konodino Aarthik Soccholota Paben Na? Nijer Uparjoner Taka Kothay Biniyog Korle Valo Return Payoya Jabe? Kar Kach Theke Neben Poramorsho? Mutual Fund Ki? Eisob Proshner Uttor Jante Apnake Suntei Hbe Ei Audiobook.

the-business-of-the-21st-century-3.title: Financially Update Howar Tips
the-business-of-the-21st-century-3.description: Financially independent howar shopno amra sobai dekhi, kintu exactly ki kore sheta ayotye ana jaye? Anek er e mone hoi je chakri bodlate thaklei hoito borolok howa jaye, kintu Robert Kiyosaki r boktobye wealth gothon korar jonnyo aage amader nijeder mindset, kaj korar dhoron bodlate hobe ar tar songe byabshar idea o toiri korte hobe. Ei book summary te aj amra jene nebo 21st century r business er byapar e, ja amader ke borolok korte help korbe.

the-science-of-getting-rich.title: The Science of Getting Rich
the-science-of-getting-rich.description: Ameer banne ka formula jaante ho? Agar nahi maloom aur pata karne ki iccha rakhte ho toh abhi suniye, is vigyaan ke gyaan ko. Wallace D. Wattles ki likhi yeh bestseller 100 saalo se bhi zyaada aaj tak logo ko ameer banane ka vigyaan samjha rahi hai. Jaldi kariye, kahi aap is formula ko samajhne mein peeche na reh jao, aur aapki jagah koi aur ameer banne ki raah par nikal pade. Agar aapko "Rich Habits: The Daily Success Habits of Wealthy Individuals" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

मधुमेह--रक्तदाब--हृदयविकार--लठ्ठपणा.title: Aajar ani tyavaril Upchar
मधुमेह--रक्तदाब--हृदयविकार--लठ्ठपणा.description: Sadhyacha fast life, Apuri zop, Ayogya Aahar ani Aniyamit Exercise.. ya mule Diabetes, Blood Pressure, Heart Problems, Obesity ya sarkhya ajar lahan vayatch aplyala ghertat. Matra ya aajaranshi don haat kase karyche? Arogya uttam thevnyasathi kay kalji ghyaychi? Yogya aahar kasa asava? yavisahyi he audio book tumhala nakkich margdarshan karel.

facebook-nirmata-mark-zuckerberg.title: Facebook Nirmata  Mark Zuckerberg
facebook-nirmata-mark-zuckerberg.description: Internet ne humaari duniya ko bahut hi chota bana diya hai. Social media age mein aaj aapka parivaar aur kahi saare dost aapse dur hoke bhi kitne pass hai. Mark Zukerberg, college se dropout hone waale ek bacche ne apni hi ek anokhi duniya ko janam diya aur lakhon logon ko apni awaaz rakhne ke liye manch diya. Aaiye chalte hai unki College drop out se duniya ka sabse trending insaan banne ke safar par.

veembudaiyanin-vithaarakali.title: வீம்புடையானின் வித்தாரக்கள்ளி
veembudaiyanin-vithaarakali.description: தன் குடும்பத்துகாக திருமணமே செய்யாமல் தியாகியாய் வாழ்கிறாள் நாயகி. அவள் தான் எனக்கு வேண்டும் என்று வீம்புக்காய் அதிரடியாய் திருமணம் செய்கிறான்  நாயகன். இருவேறு துருவங்களான நாயகியும் நாயகனும் எவ்வாறு ஒன்று சேர்கிறார்கள்? அதிரடி திருப்பங்கள் மட்டுமல்லாமல் திகட்டத் திகட்டக் காதலோடு பயணிக்கும் காதல் கதை வீம்புடையானின் வித்தாரக்கள்ளி...

azim-premji.title: Azim Premji
azim-premji.description: Vaazhkai namakku niraya paadangalai kathukodukkum nu solluvaanga. Sila nerangal la nammaloda vaalkai mattum illainga mathavunga vaalkaiyila irunthu niraya paadangalai namma kathukkalaam. Antha vagayila Azim Premji oda vaalkai namakku nalla paadamaa irukkum.

indra-nuyi.title: Indra Nooyi
indra-nuyi.description:
Indra Nooyi ke safalta ko duniya ke har akhbaar aur vyapar patrika ne chart kiya hai, lekin hum mein se kitne log chhavi ke peeche ke vyakti ko jaante hai? Ye biography hume Nooyi ke jeevan, unke bachpan ke vikalpon, unke dwara kiye gaye sangharshon aur shikhar par pohochne ke dauran unke dwara seekhe gaye sabak ke baare mein batayegi ki aakhir Nooyi ne ye kaise kiya? Unki prerna kya thi? Duniya mein dusra sabse bada khadya aur pey vyavsaay chalane ke dauran uaayi chunautiya ka saamna karte hue ghar aur chulha kaise sambhala? 
Aaiye, jaane!

cyber-security.title: Cyber Security
cyber-security.description: Innaikku irukka kaalakattathula privacy apdinra vishayam konjam konjamaa alinjittu varuthu. Digital ulagathula nadakkura cyber crimes pathiyum athula irunthu nammala kaappathura cyber security pathiyum intha pathivula kekalaam vaanga.

ignited-minds-2.title: Kalamer Chokhe Aagamir Bharat
ignited-minds-2.description: Bharot Rotno Dr. Apj Abdul Kalam Er Khyati Gota Biswajure. Tini Chilen Bharoter Prakton Rastrapoti. Aaj Amra Sunbo Tar Durosorshita Somporke. Desh Niye Ki Bhabten Tini? Desher Aagami Projonmo Niye Ki Bhabten Tini? 2020 Er Bharotke Tini Kibhabe Dekhte Cheyechen? Bigyan O Aadhyatikota Niye Tar Dristivongi Kemon Chilo? Eirokom Kichu Kotha Janbo Ei Audiobook Theke. Aasun Shune Neyoya Jak.

jeetne-ki-zid.title: Jeetne Ki Zid
jeetne-ki-zid.description: Agar aap iss audiobok ko sunn rahe hai toh aap nishchit taur par apna vyaktigat vikas karne ki disha mein kadam utha rahe hai. Ye audiobook na keval ye batati hai ki aapko kya malum hona chahiye, balki ye bhi ki apne jeevan mein aap jo chahte hai, use aakarshit karne ke liye aapko kya karna hoga. Aapko apne sapno, lakshyon aur icchaon ko spasht karne ki disha mein ek ek kadam aage badhaegi. Toh suniye ye audiobook aur lijiye apne sapno ki taraf ek kadam aage!

trading-in-the-zone-5.title: Trading Er Jabotiyo Tips
trading-in-the-zone-5.description: Trading In The Zone book summary theke jante parben je ekjon notun byabshai r kache notun challenge holo ortho uparjoner upay khuje ber kora. Kroi ba bikroi ke nyay songoto korar onnyanyo upaye guli kaj kore na. Sofol bhabe trading korte hole apnake ja korte hobe sheguli holo kichu niyom follow kora. Byabshai ra usually shob ortho hariye phelen prothom bochhore. Ekjon byekti ke byabshai er manoshikota orjon korte hoi, shei sokol tips shikhe neowar jonnyo shune nin ei book summary ti.

success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.title: Success Through A Positive Mental Attitude
success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.description: Mee manasulo rahasya adrushya shakthi undi. Oka vaipu Positive Mental attitude aksharaalu mariyu Negative mental attitude ane aksharaalu chekkabadi unnayi. Sanukula dhrukpatham sahajamgaa manchi inka andamaian vatini aakarshisthundi. Prathikula vaikhari jivithaanni viluvainadigaa maarche annitini dochukuntundi.

girgit.title: Girgit - Season 1
girgit.description: पृथ्वी  से गायब होते लोग | सुने एक ऐसी अजीब दास्तान जहाँ गुंडे की बेटी हो जाती है एक नौजवान के साथ धरती से गायब।  क्या एलियंस छोड़ेंगे इन दोनों को ज़िंदा? क्या लौट पाएंगे यह दोनों पृथ्वी पर वापस?

ikigai-10.title: Dirgho Jibon Katanor Secret
ikigai-10.description: 'Igigai' Sobdotir Moddhey Ekta Rohosyo Lukiye Ache. Ja Apnake Aapnar Jibon Somporke Dharona Dey. Ei Dharonati Japan Theke Eseche. Japane Okinawa Name Ek Jayga Ache, Jekhankar Manushra Anekdin Bachen. Tara Ei 'Igigai' Ke Follow Koren. Sobar 'Igigai' Alada Alada Hoy. Apni Jodi Apnar Jiboner 'Igigai' Khunje Na Pan Apnar Mishon Hbe Setake Khonja. Ebar Aapnar Mone Proshno Jagbe, Seta Kivabe Khunje Paben? Aapnar Sei Khonjar Pothe Bondhu Hote Pare Ei Audiobook. Kivabe Sukhi Jibon Katano Jay, Kivabe Dirgho Jibon Otibahito Kora Jay Eirokom Kichu Mantra Lukiye Royeche Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey. Aasun Tahole Shune Ni.

the-almanack-of-naval-ravikant.title: Tips Ja Life E Growth Er Jonno Help Korbe
the-almanack-of-naval-ravikant.description: Amader anek somoy emon lage je amra jodi beshi somoy dhore kaj e invest kori beshi ghonta kaj kori tahole anek beshi taka aay korte parbo. Kintu famous Indian- American entrepreneur ebong investor Naval Ravikant er mote amader somoy khub gurutyopurno ebong khub bhebe chinte amader somoy byabohar kora uchit. Ar khali taka paisa e noi life er teen te boro jinish jegulo holo, happiness, health, ar wealth keo thik  bhabe prioritize kora uchit. Ei book summary te shune nin kichu darun mantras jegulo apnake life e growth er jonnyo bibhinyo bhabe help korbe.

how-i-raised-myself-from-failure-to-succ.title: Sales ka successful formula
how-i-raised-myself-from-failure-to-succ.description: 29 ki umar mein Frank Bettger ek failed insurance salesman the. Jab woh 40 saal ke hogaye toh unke pass bohot saari sampatti thi aur woh retire ho sakte the. Selling ke aise kaunse raaz hai jinhone Bettgar ke jeevan ko haar se saphalta ki taraf badhaya aur America ka highest-paid salesman banaya? Iske saare uttar aapko iss kitaab ki summary aur explaination mein mil jayenge.  Agar aapko "The Greatest Salesman In The World" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

police-complaint-authority.title: Police Complaint Authority
police-complaint-authority.description: Namakku ethaavathu prachanai vanthaa Police kitta Complaint koduppom. Police ae ethaavathu prachanai pannunaa yaaru kitta complaint pannanum ? . Police Complaint Authority pathina virivaana thoguppu itho ungal kuku fm il.

jack-ma.title: Jack Ma
jack-ma.description: Duniya ke pramukh bussinessmen mein shaamil alibaba group ke sansthapak Jack Ma ki sampatti 14 arab rupaye hai par Jack Ma apne college mein 3 baar fail hochuke hai aur china ke kahi companies ne unhe ayogya kahkar naukri nahi di. Job dhunde se lekar duniya mein sabse successful bussiness man  banne ki kahaani ko suniye iss kitaab ke jariye. Agar aapko "Built To Last" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

charminar-1.title: Charminar
charminar-1.description: Charminar (Nalugu Minaarlu) bharathadesham lo ni Hyderabad lo unna smaraka chihnam. Idi naalugu minaarlu kaligina oka kattadamu. Ee pradesham bharathadesham loni athyantha gurthimpu pondina nirmanalantho koodina jabithalo Hyderabad Global Icon gaa avatharinchindi. Idi Hyderabd lo unna pracheena kattadaalalo okati.

veerapandiya-kattabomman.title: Veerapandiya Kattabomman
veerapandiya-kattabomman.description: British kaarargalukku Edhiraaga Poraadiya Veerapandiya Kattabomman avargalin vaazhkai varalaaru ! Veeram kalantha Azhagu Thamizhil ungalukaaga !

msdhoni-captain-cool.title: M.S.Dhoni Captain Cool
msdhoni-captain-cool.description: Dheeraj rakho, aasan hone se pehle sabhi cheezen mushkil nazar aati hai, kisse pata tha ki ek mamuli parivaar ka mamuli sa ladka Shaikh Saadi ki iss baat ko apni zindagi mein utaarkar cricket jagat mein halchal paida kar dega. Par iss halchal paida karne se pehle uss mamuli se ladke ko khud kai gair mamuli halchalon se guzarna pada. Aaiye iss audiobook mein experience karte hai aisi hi adbhut captain cool M.S.Dhoni ki kahaani ko

ukraine-russia-yudham.title: Ukraine Russia Yudham
ukraine-russia-yudham.description: 2022 February 24 inaanu Ukraine il Russiayude kadannu kayattamundayathu. Russian Aakramanam Aarambhicha annu muthal ithuvare aayirakanakinu aalukalanu kollapettathu. Samaadhana charchakal palakonilum nadakkunundenkilum, charchakalil karyamaaya purogathi undayittilla. Enthinaayirunnu ee yudham?

active-parenting.title: Active Parenting
active-parenting.description: Parenting patthina pala santhegangalukku vidai thaan intha Active Parenting Book. Kulandhainga kitta enthentha situation la eppadi nadanthukkanumnu author namakku theliva solraaru. Intha book summary ah kelunga neengalum Active Parenting ah pathi therinjikonga.

bill-gates-ke-management-sutra.title: Bill Gates Ke Management Sutra
bill-gates-ke-management-sutra.description: 20 saal ki umar ne jiss ladke ne duniya ki sabse badi companiyon mein se ek ki sthapana ki. 30 saal ki umar mein joh sabse kam umra ke arabpati bane aur 39 saak ki umra mein unhone tab ke sabse amir vyakti Waren Buffet ko peeche choda. Bill Gates kabhi aapke aur mere jaise ek sadharan vyakti the, lekin unhone apni pratibha aur kadi mehnat ke bal par microsoft ki sthapana ki aur tab unhe wah sabkuch mil gaya, jiski ve haqdaar the, Dhan, Shakti aur Vishwasaniyata

purananuru-koorum-nanerigal.title: Purananuru Koorum Nanerigal
purananuru-koorum-nanerigal.description: Thamizhargalin Aram, Veeram, Kodai , Panbaadu, Naagareegam Patriya Pala Ariya Thagavalgalai alli tharum karuvoolaamaana Nam Sangathamizh Ilakkiyam Purananooru koorum Nannerigalai Indha Padhivin moolam kettu magizhungal !

சொர்ணபுரி--ஒரு-மர்ம-தேசம்-Season--1.title: சொர்ணபுரி - ஒரு மர்ம தேசம்
சொர்ணபுரி--ஒரு-மர்ம-தேசம்-Season--1.description: சபிக்கப்பட்ட சொர்ணபுரி மாளிகையை இப்போதும் மிர்துளா தேவி காவல் காக்கிறாள் என்று நம்புகிறார்கள் கிராம வாசிகள். அதற்குள் இருக்கும் புதையலைத் தேடிச் செல்லும் அனைவரும் மாயமாகிறார்கள். அதை செய்வது ஆவியா? சாமியா? ஆசாமியா? என்று எதுவும் தெரியாமல் அனைவரும் குழம்பிப் போயிருந்த சமயம், துணிச்சலுடன் அந்த மர்ம முடிச்சுகளை அவிழ்க்கக் களமிறங்குகிறாள் நாயகி. அவள் தேடல்களுக்கான பதில் கிடைத்ததா?

autobiography-of-a-yogi-1.title: Autobiography of a Yogi
autobiography-of-a-yogi-1.description: Autobiography of a Yogi yeh kitaab Pramahansa Yoganandaji ki Adhyatmeek logon ke saath hone waale Purvi aur Pachimi deshon ke parichay ke baare mein batati hai. Pustak unake bachapan ke paarivaarik jeevan se shuroo hotee hai, unake guru ko khojane se lekar ek sadhu banane aur kriya yoga meditation ki shiksha ko sthaapit karane tak ke pure safar ko bohot hi acche se darshaati hai

power-of-spoken-words.title: The Power of Spoken Words
power-of-spoken-words.description: Our words have the ability to alter our lives. We can improve our circumstances by paying more attention to how we speak, and thus how we think. The Power of the Spoken Word will assist you in making the positive changes you've always desired. If you wish to learn valuable lessons about taking control of your life and destiny, then this book is meant for you. Teachings of the author on self-help, spirituality and New Thought.

success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.title: Positive Attitude se success paane ki Techniques
success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.description: Vo log jo aapne jeevan mein thak gye hain, jinhe self motivation ki jarurat hai, ese logon ke liye Success Through A Positive Mental Attitude book ek guide ki tarah kaam karegi. Iss kitab mein positive aur negative vicharon ko lekar kayi example diye gye hain aur bataya gya hai ki kaise do logon ke pass kaam ek samaan hi hai lekin positive motivation ke sath kaam karane vaala vyakti har kaam ko achhi tarah se kar sakta hai. Isme PMA or NMA  ko leker ese principle btaye gye hain jinko jaanane ke baad aap kaam karane ke Approach ko sahi tarike se sahi disha mein lga sakate hain. Yah ek best self help type kitab hai.

history-of-royal-enfield.title: History of ROYAL ENFIELD
history-of-royal-enfield.description: Ithai Vandi nu solratha vida Itanthira Kuthirai nu sollalaam. Itntha bike mela irukka craze ah explain panna vaarthaigale illai. Royal Enfield niruvanathoda mulu varalaarayum ungalukkaga kondu vanthurukku KuKu FM.

climate-change-4.title: Climate Change
climate-change-4.description: Bheekaramaaya climate change lokamembaadum sambhavichukondirikkunnu ennu ellavarkum ariyavunna parasyamaaya rahasyamaanu. Samoohathiludaneelam aavashyamaaya parivarthanangal nadathan ippol samayam athikramichirikkunnu. Kelkaam 'Climate Change'.

mahabharat-ka-maharathi-veer-abhimanyu.title: Mahabharat ka Maharathi - Veer Abhimanyu
mahabharat-ka-maharathi-veer-abhimanyu.description: Adharm ke viruddh ladhi gayi ye dharm ki kahani, aakhir kyun ek balak ke parakram ko itna maanti hai ki use Veer bulati hai? Kaun hai Abhimanyu aur kaisa tha uska parakram? Jaanne ke liye zaroor sune.

avasaanikatha-sreedhana-maranangal.title: Avasaanikatha Sthreedhana Maranangal
avasaanikatha-sreedhana-maranangal.description: Pathittaandukalayi avarthikappedunna samoohika vipathanu sthreedhana maranangal. Etrayokke jeevanukal polinjittum ennum sthreedhanam vangiyum nalkiyumanu mikavarum kalyanangal nadakunathu. Niyamaparamayi thettanenu arinjittum engane enthukondu ee puthiya kaalaghattathilum sthreedhanam nilanilkunnu ennathu prasakthamayoru chodyamanu.

india-vs-pak-1971-2.title: India vs Pak (1971)
india-vs-pak-1971-2.description: ಭಾರತದ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ 1971ರಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಭಾರತ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ನಡುವಿನ ಯುದ್ಧವು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಈ ಯುದ್ಧ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂಭವಿಸಿತು? ಇದರ ಹಿಂದೆ ನಿಜವಾದ ಕಾರಣಗಳೇನು? ಯುದ್ಧವು ಈ ಎರಡು ದೇಶಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರಿತು? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಅತಿ ಮುಖ್ಯ.! ಬನ್ನಿ, 'India vs Pak 1971' ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾರಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಕೇಳೋಣ!

jhansi-ki-rani.title: Jhansi Ki Rani Lakshmibai
jhansi-ki-rani.description: Yeh ek rani, ​​​​maa aur ek mahila ko shraddhaanjali hai jinki gaatha bhartiya svatantrata sangraam ki neev thi. Jhaansi ki Rani Lakshmi Bai ko 1857-58 ke bhartiya vidroh ke dauraan unki veerta ke liye yaad kiya jaata hai. Lakshmi Bai 1843 se 1853 tak Maharaj Gangaadhar Rao ke patni ke roop mein Jhansi ki maratha riyaasat ki mahaarani thi. Woh 1857 ke bhaaratiya vidroh ke pramukh hastiyon mein se ek thi aur bhaartiya raashtravaadiyon ke liye British Raaj ke pratirodh ka prateek ban gayi.Lakshmi Bai ne hamalaavar taakaton ka kada pratirodh kiya aur apanee antim saans tak kabhi bhi aatmasamarpan nahin kiya.

sahitya-samrat-bankim-1.title: Sahitya Samrat Bankim
sahitya-samrat-bankim-1.description: Photographic memory er byapare amra anek shuni ar thik ei photographic memory chilo amder sahitya samrat Bankim er. Calcutta University r prothom snatok amader Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay. Aj amra emon bibhinno tothyo shune nebo onar byapar e.

agneepath-2.title: Agneepath
agneepath-2.description: Kendram thisukuvachina agneepath project enduku yuvathanu meppinchaleka poyindi. Entho mandi yuvakulu enduku deshaanni attudikelaa chesaaru. Prathipakshaalu nijame chputhunnayaa? Army adhikaarula manasu lo emundi? Ilaanti niyamaka padddhathulu ithara deshaallo unnaya? Randi thelsukundaam.

andhwishwaas.title: Superstitions
andhwishwaas.description: Superstitions ne iss desh ko aise jakad ke rakha hai ki uski aad mein kahi saaron ki zindagiyaan barbaad hogayi hai. Aisi hi satya ghatanaao pe aadharit kahi saari kahaniyon se bhari hai yeh kitaab joh aapko Andhavishwaas ke kaale sach ko aapke saamne layegi

unshakeable-your-financial-freedom.title: Aarthik Unnotir Secret
unshakeable-your-financial-freedom.description: Share Markete Biniyog Korar Icche Aneker Thake. Bohu Manush Ete Taka Invest Koren. Keu Keu Prochur Taka Uparjon Koren , Aabar Keu Keu Taka Loksan Koren. Ei Markete Taka Niyog Jhunkio Royeche. Tahole Ebar Mone Proshno Jagbe Kothay Biniyog Kora Uchit? Sothik Biniyoger Poth Konta? Kothay Beshi Taka Lav Hobe? Kivabe Biniyog Korle Taka Loksan Hobe Na? Kivabe Graph Otha-Nama K Bujhhte Hobe? Jara Prochur Taka Uparjon Koren Tara Kon Koushol Obolombon Koren? Biniyoger Bapare Karor Theke Ki Poramorsho Neyoya Uchit? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Uttor Pete Shune Neyoya Jak Ei Audiobook.  Sune Nin Kivabe Sothik Biniyog Kora Jay

swami-vivekananda-2.title: Swami Vivekananda
swami-vivekananda-2.description: 'Keralam oru bhraandhalayamanu' enna paraamarshathilude Keralathinte kannu thurappikan sremicha mahatmavine Malayalikalkku orikalum marakkan saadhikkila. Vedhantha thatwa sastrathinte shakthanaya vakthavum aatmeeya guruvumaya Swami Vivekananda ne kurichu kooduthal ariyam ee audioyilude

जेआरडि-टाटा.title: J R D Tata - A Man of Many Talents
जेआरडि-टाटा.description: Jokim uthaane wale aur sapno ko sakar karke desh ko nayi bulandiyon ko pohochaane wale JRD Tata, aakhir kaise kiya ye sab? Kaise ek chhote se business ko desh-videsh mein khyati dilayi? Aaiye jaante hain.

the-laws-of-human-nature-2.title: Human Nature Bujhe Otha
the-laws-of-human-nature-2.description: Robert Green amader shikhiyechen ki bhabe nijeder bhabna theke nijeder dure rakhte hoi ar ki atma- niyontron e darun gyan orjon kora jaye. Nijeder onubhuti ki kore ayotye rakha jaye, lok jon pichone kathi kora, office e boss pichone kathi kora, egulo te amra hut hat react kore boshi, ei shob kichu niyontrone anar jonnyo shune nin Robert Green er lekha The Laws Of Human Nature.

ar-rehman.title: AR Rahman - The Mozart of Madras
ar-rehman.description:
S Dilip Kumar se AR Rahman banne tak ka safar, Majboori mein shuru kiya kaam kaise Oscar mein badal gaya? 
Jaane Rahman ki inspiring gaatha!

the-business-school-1.title: The Business School
the-business-school-1.description: Rich Dad Poor Dad Book ka ezhuthuna Robert Kiyosaki in Matrumoru vetri padaippu "The Business School". Oru vetrikaramaana Business sa kattamaikka nenaikkira ovvorutharum avasiyam therinjuka vendiya paadangala Network Marketing Moolama Vilakki sollum Puthagam Idhu. Kelunga

-சிவகாமியின்-சபதம்-பாகம்-3-பிக்ஷுவின்-கா.title: சிவகாமியின் சபதம் - 3
-சிவகாமியின்-சபதம்-பாகம்-3-பிக்ஷுவின்-கா.description: அமரர் கல்கியின் சரித்திரப் புதினம் சிவகாமியின் சபதம். சாளுக்கியர்களுக்கும் பல்லவர்களுக்கும் நடைபெற்ற போரில் காஞ்சி முற்றுகையிடப்படுகிறது. சாளுக்கியர்களால் கோட்டையைக் கைப்பற்ற முடியவில்லை. இறுதியாக அமைதி ஏற்படுகிறது. புலிகேசியுடனான விருந்தில், மகேந்திரர் சொல்லக் கூடாத ரகசியத்தை சொல்லி விடுகிறார். அதனால், அவமானமடைந்த புலிகேசி புறப்பட்டுச் செல்லும்போது காஞ்சியையே ரணகளமாக்கிவிடுகிறான். அத்துடன் மட்டுமே சென்றான், சிவகாமியையும் தூக்கிச் சென்று விடுகிறான். அவள் தப்பித்தாளா? அவளுக்கு என்ன ஆனது?

being-to-becoming-buddha-2.title: Being to becoming Buddha
being-to-becoming-buddha-2.description: Aakhir kaise ek raj-parivar mein janma balak sinhasan ko chhodkar dharm ka maarg apnata hai? Kaise ek naye dharm ki sthapna karta hai jiski khyati desh-videsh tak pohochti hai? Jaanenge is audio mein! Agar aapko 'Buddha's Brain' jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

shiledar-swarajyache.title: Shiledar Swarajyache
shiledar-swarajyache.description: Chhatrapati Shivaji maharajanch ‘Swarajyach’ swapn sakarat astana te tya swapnpurtisathi anek veer yoddhyanni, rayatetlya anek lahan mothya ghatkanni aaplya Prananchi baji lavali. Ashya parichit, aparichit mavlyanchi, tyanchya veergathanchi Malika mhnje ‘Shiledar Swarajyache.

why-didnt-they-teach-me-this-in-school-3.title: Nijer Orthoke Niyontron Korte Sikhun
why-didnt-they-teach-me-this-in-school-3.description: Aamader School, College E Je Sikkha Deyoya Hoy Ta Kebol Matro Chakrir Poth Bole Dite Pare. Ortho Uparjoner Rasta Dekhay. Kintu Ei Uparjoner Skill, Bandha Somporke Aamader Obogoto Kore Na. Emonki Money Management Somporkeo Aamader Schoole Porano Hoy Na. Ei Bishoyguli Niye Ei Audiobook Lekha. Ei Audiobook Er Vetor Lekha Bishoyglo Aapnake Konodin Sekahno Hoy Ni. Tar Lekha Kothagulo Kishore- Kishori Theke Shuru Kore Grihobodhuder Aarthik Niyontroner Poth Dekhabe. Ei Upayguli Janar Por Aapni Aapnar Orthoke Sundorvabe Niyontron Korte Parben. Asun Shune Neyoya Jak. Sune Nin Artho Niyontroner Upayguli

babylone-ka-sabse-ameer-aadmi.title: Babylon Ka Sabse Amir Aadmi
babylone-ka-sabse-ameer-aadmi.description: Aap jitna kamaate hai uska 10 percent hissa aapko humesha save karna chahiye. Yeh kitaab aise hi kuch Paison ke baare mein 7 simple rules aapko samjhaati hai. Yeh timeless rules har koi apna sakta hai aur financial freedom pa sakta hai.

dishya-careeierchya.title: Disha Career chya
dishya-careeierchya.description: Sadharan 10th kiwa 12th Standard cha result lagala ki, Vidyarthi ani tyanche palak yancha samor- Career niwdhicha ek motha prashna ubha rahto. Career niwdiche nakki kay nikash asavet? Aplya sathi konta career yogya ahe he kase olkhave? Carrer che kon konte options available ahet nai tya paiki apan konta nivadla pahije? ya vishayi Experts cha tips aika, Disha Career cha ya audio book dware.

the-little-book-of-common-sense-investin.title: Invest Korar Kichu Tips
the-little-book-of-common-sense-investin.description: Ei boi ti prithibi jure somosto investors der jonnyo khub e important. Amader protyek er e uchit sonchoy o biniyog somporke ideas collect kora. Long run e shompod toiri korar shob theke easy way ki, shei shob kichu tips je newar jonnyo shunte thakun, The Little Book Of Common Sense Investing.

elon-musk-ki-success-secrets.title: Elon Musk Ke Success Secrets
elon-musk-ki-success-secrets.description:
The real life Iron Man - Elon Musk! Yeh audiobook listeners ke liye ek vishesh blueprint hai jo Elon Musk ke rahasyon ko jaanna chaahte hain aur unki pratibha ki antardrashti seekhna chaahte hain. Elon Musk ek entreprenuer aur business magnet hain. Wah SPACE X ke FOUNDER, CEO aur chief engineer hain.

Tesla ink. ke ek praarambhik charan ke niveshak, CEO aur product architect. Wah 'The Boring Company' ke sansthaapak aur Neuralink and OpenAI ke co-founder bhi hain. Ek karodpati, Musk duniya ke sabse ameer logo mein se ek hai. Aaiye jaante hain unki kahaani aur mangal par maanavta ko lekar unka sapna.

malala.title: Malala - An Inspiration
malala.description: Ek samanya Pakistani mulgi Malala Yousafzai ne Mulincha shiknasathi Asamanya ani Atulniya karya kele ahe. Itkach nahi tar jagatil sarvat krur ani takadwar Atankvadi Sanghtane virudha na ghabrta ladha dila. Jagat Shantata prasthapit vhavi ani Mulina tyancha Shikshnache sarva hakka milawe, yasathi pranachi parva na karta ladhnarya ani Shantatecha Nobel Purskarchi Mankari tharlelya eka asadharan strichi Prernadayi Goshta.

the-monk-who-sold-his-ferrari-2.title: 7 secrets of living a Perfect Life
the-monk-who-sold-his-ferrari-2.description: The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari is about a fictional character named Julian Mantle. Julian is a successful lawyer but is struggling with stress and work pressure. The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari describes the Seven Virtues required for a life of inner peace, joy, and a wealth of spiritual gifts

மதிவதனி-நான்-மதனின்வதனி.title: மதிவதனி நான் மதனின்வதனி
மதிவதனி-நான்-மதனின்வதனி.description: அமானுஷ்ய கதைகள் என்றாலே பயம் மட்டுமே இருக்க வேண்டியதல்ல.. சிரிக்கவும் சிந்திக்கவும் உடையதாகவும் இருக்கலாம் என்பதை என் மதிவதனி உணர்த்துவாள்..படியுங்கள்... வெறும் கதையாய் இன்றி வதனியின் வாழ்க்கையில் நீங்களும் உள்ளே சென்று வாழ்ந்து வருவீர்கள்... அதோடு வயிறு குலுங்க சிரித்தும் மகிழ்வீர்கள்...

subhas-chandra-bose-1.title: Subhas Chandra Bose
