ஏலியன்-மாமா.title: ஏலியன் மாமா
ஏலியன்-மாமா.description: வீட்டை விட்டு ஓடிப் போய் காதல் திருமணம் செய்து கொண்ட வந்தனா; பல வருடங்களுக்குப் பிறகு, கிராமத்திலிருந்து அவளைப் பார்க்க வரும் அவளது அண்ணன்; டெக்னாலஜி பற்றி ஒன்றுமே தெரியாத தனது மாமாவை ஓர் ஏலியனைப் போல் பாவிக்கும் வந்தனாவின் குழந்தைகள்; மாமாவிற்கும் குழந்தைகளுக்கும் ஏற்படும் நகைச்சுவையான உரையாடல்களும், மாமாவுடன் அவரது ஊருக்குச் செல்லும் குழந்தைகளின் புத்துணர்ச்சி அளிக்கும் சேட்டைகளும் சுவாரசியம். மாமாவால் குழந்தைகளின் சேட்டைகளை சமாளிக்க முடிந்ததா? வந்தனாவை அவளது பெற்றோர் மன்னித்தார்களா? குழந்தைகள் மாமாவை புரிந்து கொண்டார்களா? இறுதியில் அனைவரும் ஒன்றாய் இணைந்தார்களா என்பதெல்லாம் மீதிக் கதை!!! இது குக்கூ எஃப்எம் கேட்போம் கேளாததை ...

safalta-paane-ke-5-steps-by-md-motivatio.title: Safalta Paane Ke 5 Steps by MD Motivation
safalta-paane-ke-5-steps-by-md-motivatio.description: Aap apni zindagi ko maalik bankar bitana chahate hain ya fir naukar bankar. Jayaj si baat hai koi naukar banna kyu pasand karega. Safal hona kaun nahin chahta? Is duniya main aisa koi bhi nahi hoga jo apni zindagi me kuchh bada karna na chahta ho, aur iske wah liye kya kuchh nahi karta? Par bada banna sirf sochne jitna aasan nahi hai. Iske liye athak prayas, dradnishchay, sankalp aur kathor parishram ka hona bahut zaroori hai. Lekin usse bhi jyada zaroori kuchh hai, to wo hai sahi disha. Kathor parishram agar sahi disha me nahi kiya gaya, tonwah vyarth hai. Aisi hi aur bhi anekon baatein hain, jo dhyan me rakhna atiaavashyak hai. Hamare platform Kuku FM par safalta ki prapti k liye ek audiobook maujood hai, jisme aapko jeevan mein safal banne aur khushnuma jeevan vyatit karne ke liye good mantra batae gae hain. Inhe aaj hi sune.

kutra-parambarai.title: Kutra Parambarai
kutra-parambarai.description: மனித குலத்தின் வரலாறுகளை வரலாற்று ஆசிரியர்கள் மட்டுமே எழுதிவிட முடியாது மனிதர்களின் வாழ்கையை தலைமுறைகளின் வல்வை இலக்கியம் மட்டுமே உண்மையாய் பிரதிபலிக்கமுடியும். பல ஆண்டுகளுக்கு முன் மார்க்வெஸின் ஒரு நூற்றாண்டு தனிமையும் மற்ற லத்தின் அமெரிக்க இலக்கியங்களையும் நான் படித்து பிரமித்திருக்கிறேன். குற்ற பரம்பரை நமக்கு ஒரு நூற்றாண்டு வல்வை நமக்கு உயிரோட்டமாய் உணர்த்துகிறது. கதை கரு என்பது வெறுமனே வாழ்விலிருந்து மட்டும் பெறபடுவதில்லை வாழ்வியலோடு படைப்பாளியால் பரிசோதிக்கப்பட்டு வாசகனுக்கு தரப்படுகின்ற அம்சமாகும் நூறாண்டுகளுக்கு முன்பு இருந்த வாழ்வின் விசயங்களில் இருந்து கதை கருவை உருவாக்கி வாசகனுக்கு தருவது லேசுபட்ட விசயமல்ல அனுபவப்பட்ட மனிதர்களிடம் இருந்துதான் கதை கரு எடுக்க படுகிறது. நான் ஒரு மனிதன் மனித தன்மையுள்ள எதையும் எனக்கு தொடர்பற்றதாக கருதவில்லை என்பது கார்ல் மார்க்சுக்கு மிகவும் பிடித்தமான வாசகம். வாழ்வில் காணும் சொற்ப அழகாய் மிகை படுத்தி பேரழகாய் காட்டும் போது அழகியல் வெற்றியடைகிறது. மேலும் இப்புத்தகத்தில் கிராமிய வாழ்வின் அழகாய் பிரதி பலிப்பதொடு வேலாவின் கலை நின்று விடுவதில்லை அழகை உருவாக்கவும் செய்கிறார் என்பதை ஒவ்வொரு பக்கத்திலு, நம்மால் உணர முடிகிறது. அதிலும் கொடூரமும் மூர்கத்தனமும் நிறைந்த கள்ளர்கள் பற்றிய நாவலில் இதை உருவாக்குவதில் வேலாயுதம் வெற்றி பெற்றுள்ளார்.

भगवद-गीता.title: Yatharth Bhagvad Geeta
भगवद-गीता.description: Yatharth Geeta yani Swami Adgadanand Ji Maharaj ke dwara likhi gayi Geeta. Unhone isme keval Geeta ke shlok ko dohraya nahi hai, balki Geeta Ki aantarik bhavnao ko vyakt kiya hai. Isme charcha ki gayi hai ki Geeta ka updesh dete samay Shri Krishna ki aantarik bhavnaye kya thi.

learn-hindi-through-telugu.title: Learn Hindi Through Telugu
learn-hindi-through-telugu.description: Hindi Idi mana National language, Mana desham lo ekkadiki vellina kuda easy ga communicate aye language Hindi ey anamata, aithe idi mana basha kakapoyina manam ee bashani nerchukunte entho kontha ekkado okka dhagara manaki ee basha upayoga paduthundi. Mari Inkenduku late ventane hindi nerchukondi, dani kosam meeru ee audio book vinte chaalu.!

रामायण-3.title: रामायण
रामायण-3.description: Rama, the prince of Ayodhya, goes into exile due to his father's promise. Later, Ravana kidnaps Sita and Rama wages a war against him to rescue her and returns to Ayodhya to be crowned king.

rabindranath-tagore-1.title: Rabindranath Tagore
rabindranath-tagore-1.description: Rabindranath Tagore - the man behind our national anthem. Ivaroda vaazhkai varalaru pathi indha audio book la kelunga.

the-afghan-conflict.title: The Afghan Conflict
the-afghan-conflict.description: Did you know that the U.S. war in Afghanistan is the longest war in American history, spanning over 20 years? This fact alone is enough to evoke a complex mix of emotions among many Americans, from sadness and frustration to confusion and even anger. In this audio show, we will take you on a journey through the history of the war, exploring the key events and individuals that have shaped it. We will explore the reasons behind the U.S. invasion of Afghanistan, including the 9/11 attacks and the hunt for Osama bin Laden. We will also examine the impact of the war on Afghan society and the human cost of the war. So join us as we explore this long and complex conflict, and grapple with the emotions and ideas it has stirred in us as Americans.

the-seventh-ask.title: The Seventh Ask
the-seventh-ask.description:
Alice thought marrying David Morozov meant joining a powerful family. She was wrong. At the
Morozov estate, every dollar comes with a price: seven humiliating public pleas to the ruthless
patriarch, Vasily. But Alice refuses to kneel. Armed with a sharp mind and fearless attitude, she begins exposing the family's hidden debts, fraud, and secrets while David risks everything to stand beside her. As their empire starts to crumble, Alice discovers the greatest danger isn't losing the inheritance...

la-reina-loba-del-rey-vampiro.title: La Reina Loba del Rey Vampiro
la-reina-loba-del-rey-vampiro.description: Después de que sus dos crueles compañeros lobos destruyen a su bestia y la abandonan en un páramo congelado, una marginada sobrevive al sellar un pacto de sangre con el rey vampiro. Convertida en una poderosa híbrida, regresa para reclamar su destino y ver cómo quienes la traicionaron se arrodillan ante ella suplicando perdón.

from-street-girl-to-billionaires-queen.title: From Street Girl to Billionaire's Queen
from-street-girl-to-billionaires-queen.description: Billionaire Sameer Jindal hides as a homeless man to uncover corruption in his family, finding unexpected kindness in food-stall owner Naina. After her fiancé betrays her for a richer woman, Naina agrees to a temporary marriage with Sameer to fulfill her dying grandmother’s wish. Their fake relationship soon turns into real love, but as Naina is mocked for marrying a “beggar,” Sameer’s secret becomes harder to hide—because her homeless husband is actually a billionaire CEO.

car-wale-ki-makkar-biwi.title: Car Wale Ki Makkar Biwi
car-wale-ki-makkar-biwi.description: Tech genius Rahul adopts orphan Kittu and marries schemer Leela, who secretly steals his AI formula for a mystery man. She nearly kills Kittu under hypnosis, tricks Rahul into signing divorce papers, seizes his company Astra Motors, and has an affair with Rudra. Years later, disguised as a humble rickshaw-driver, Rahul reveals himself as the firm's real founder, exposes Leela's betrayal publicly, revokes her power of attorney, and reclaims his empire and his daughter's trust.

pyaar-ki-deadline.title: Pyaar Ki Deadline
pyaar-ki-deadline.description: Lin Wanyi enters a five-year marriage with Gu Nanchen, unaware that their relationship began as a bet and that he has loved her all along. When Nanchen chooses to disappear from her life, Wanyi finally realizes how deeply she loves him. But by then, he has already moved on. As betrayal, fate, and a predetermined story collide, Wanyi must face the painful consequences of realizing love too late.

masale-aramane.title: Masale Aramane
masale-aramane.description:
Kabir is a small-town cook with magic in his hands but no fancy degree. Thrown out of a roadside dhaba, he lands at Mumbai's most elite restaurant armed with nothing but his dead father's old knife. The staff mocks him. The chef humiliates him. The manager wants him out.
But his father wasn't just a cleaner here. He had a secret — and so does this kitchen.
This is a story of a boy who came to cook, but stayed to uncover the truth.

the-three-pointer-king.title: The Three-Pointer King
the-three-pointer-king.description: Mohit Kapoor is a talentless substitute on the Delhi's North University basketball team who accidently activates an omnipotent, celestial digital interface:the 100% Success Rate system. The system awards him exactly ten guaranteed shots per day. With zero baseline athletic fundamentals, Mohit leverages these ten daily miracles to shock arrogant starters.

little-study-god.title: Little Study God
little-study-god.description: Seven-year-old Kabir Shastri grows up in poverty with his grandmother but possesses an extraordinary mind. After topping a national talent exam, he enters Delhi’s elite Apex Science Institute and uncovers a conspiracy linked to his late father’s stolen research and mysterious death. Framed and threatened, Kabir fights back, completes his father’s unfinished clean-energy proof on live television and restores Dr. Vikram Shastri’s stolen legacy.

el-mago-desterrado-la-reclama.title: El Mago Desterrado la Reclama
el-mago-desterrado-la-reclama.description: Nacido bajo la Luna Rota, Ethan Vale es un Devorador de Almas, un ser prohibido capaz de consumir magia, recuerdos y vidas. Tras años oculto gracias a un brazalete que suprime su poder, su verdadera naturaleza despierta en la Academia de Medianoche. Cuando la talentosa duelista Violet Asta descubre su secreto, deberá elegir entre protegerlo o entregarlo al mundo mágico que juró destruirlo.

majnu-mafia.title: Majnu Mafia
majnu-mafia.description: Betrayed by Devansh, who used her as a shield, Avni is forced into marriage with comatose mafia heir Vikram. After a horrific miscarriage caused by Devansh’s cruelty, Avni chooses Vikram, whose awakening reveals him as her true savior. Devansh uncovers the truth and begs for mercy, but Avni rejects his toxic obsession. Choosing Vikram, she embraces a life of dignity, leaving a broken Devansh to face his own destruction.

mechanic-annayya-20.title: Mechanic Annayya 2.0
mechanic-annayya-20.description: A simple mechanic by appearance, he quietly watches as his sister is humiliated by powerful elites. What nobody knows is that beneath the grease-stained clothes hides one of the most influential men in the world. When his sister’s dignity is destroyed, he unleashes a ruthless takedown that exposes the true difference between wealth, power, and respect.

jab-salman-met-zara.title: Jab Salman met Zara
jab-salman-met-zara.description: Zara flees a forced wedding with toxic Rehan to find her father in Lucknow. She meets Salmaan, a humble man treated like a servant by his aunt, Hamida. While Rehan subjects Salmaan to brutal humiliations, Salmaan secretly uses his billionaire status to protect Zara. After exposing Rehan’s crimes and saving Hamida’s life, Salmaan’s true identity is revealed, and the two finally unite in love.

anandvan-kothi.title: Anandvan Kothi
anandvan-kothi.description: During a violent monsoon storm, Vaidehi is trapped inside Anandvan Kothi as her brother-in-law Devraj and mother-in-law Gayatri pressure her to surrender Aditya’s property. Refusing to sign forged papers, she searches for the truth behind his will and the Kothi’s strange secrets. With help from Meera, Vaidehi secretly records the family searching the house for valuables—but just as she tries to escape, Devraj catches her, leaving her trapped once again.

billionaire-ni-babal.title: Billionaire Ni Babal
billionaire-ni-babal.description: Ek billionaire CEO potani asli identity chhupavi ne true love shodhva nikle chhe, pan Vaani Kapoor sathe nu fake relationship jaldi j love, revenge ane corporate secrets ni dangerous game bani jaay chhe. Badha na hidden secrets saamne aavta, asli game kon rami rahyu chhe?

ultimate-minister-3.title: Ultimate Minister
ultimate-minister-3.description: புதிய சுகாதார அமைச்சர் தன் முதல் காதலியைப் பார்க்கப் பத்து வருடங்களுக்குப் பின் சொந்த ஊருக்குத் திரும்புகிறான். ஆனால், அவள் ஒரு ஊழல் எம்.எல்.ஏ மகனுடன் நிச்சயிக்கப்பட்டு அவனை நிராகரிக்கிறாள். அங்குள்ள சட்டவிரோத மருத்துவமனை மோசடியை அம்பலப்படுத்த முயலும்போது கொடூரமாகத் தாக்கப்படுகிறான். ஆனால், அவனது உண்மையான அடையாளம் அந்த மொத்த ஊழல் அமைப்பையே புரட்டிப்போடப் போகிறது.

the-mafia-queens-secret-heiress.title: The Mafia Queen's Secret Heiress
the-mafia-queens-secret-heiress.description: Framed for corporate embezzlement by her cruel stepmother and abusive stepsiblings, a sharp accountant matchmakes her estranged tailor father with Chicago's most feared mob queen, gaining an adoring syndicate family and deadpan muscle to clear her name in high-society style.

pretty-thief-lover-of-the-mafia-boss-1.title: Pretty Thief Lover of the Mafia Boss
pretty-thief-lover-of-the-mafia-boss-1.description: Yash, a feared mafia heir known for his ruthless justice, never expects his life to be disrupted by Khushi—a fearless chaiwali, pickpocket, and caretaker of an orphanage who steals the one thing he values most: his dead mother's watch. Forced into his world by a dangerous secret, Khushi moves into Yash's mansion to betray him, only to discover that beneath the monster everyone fears is a lonely man starved of love.

billionaire-on-bus.title: Billionaire On Bus
billionaire-on-bus.description:
Rahul is a billionaire who boards a luxury bus in a cleaner's clothes — no bodyguards, no status. The staff mocks him, humiliates him and throws him out like a stray. Nobody knows who he really is.
But they are about to find out.
This is a story of a man who had everything — but chose to hide it, until he couldn't anymore.

ageless-alphas-secret-bride.title: Ageless Alpha's Secret Bride
ageless-alphas-secret-bride.description: Rahul saves Suvarna from goons, but she—forced by her dying father's medical bills—curses him into old age via black magic. Guru ji reveals only true love's kiss can reverse it, and secrecy is vital. As "Mohan," aged Rahul meets Suvarna (now "Shruti"), guides her to modeling stardom while battling his greedy uncle Girish's schemes to seize his inheritance. Love blooms, magic reverses, and family loyalty triumphs over betrayal in this supernatural romance.

kisan-vs-billionaires.title: Kisan vs Billionaires
kisan-vs-billionaires.description: Vivek Rao, an AI engineer in America, quits after opposing an unethical project draining rural water. Back home, he transforms his drought-hit village using AI irrigation and soil tech. When the govt secretly appoints him MD of a $175B AI Data City, tycoon Vikram Rathod tries seizing village land, repeatedly humiliating the unrecognized farmer. With reporter Deeksha's help, Vivek survives captivity, exposes Vikram's crimes, and reclaims stolen lands, proving character always triumphs over money.

golden-eyes-ab-kuch-nahi-chupega.title: Golden Eyes - Ab Kuch Nahi Chupega
golden-eyes-ab-kuch-nahi-chupega.description: Drugged, stripped of his kidney, and sold into a brutal Panna diamond mine by his treacherous fiance, an artisan's son awakens a divine mineral vision to out-gamble the local mining mafia, reclaim his ancestral land, and seize control of the billion-rupee mineral corridor.

bollywood-star-ka-cook-kaise-banein.title: Bollywood Star Ka Cook Kaise Banein ?
bollywood-star-ka-cook-kaise-banein.description: Bollywood Star Ka Cook Kaise Banein ?

hop-kaed-aletekal.title: Hop Kaed Aletekal
hop-kaed-aletekal.description: Love Under Arrest - Hop Kaed Aletekal

boxing-king.title: Boxing King
boxing-king.description:
Roku, a seemingly weak servant, secretly possesses god-like fighting powers.  
When deadly Titans threaten to destroy his village’s legendary boxing arena, he is forced to reveal his true strength.  
Haunted by his past, Roku must finally embrace the warrior within him.

adishakti-ki-prem-kahani.title: Adishakti Ki Prem Kahani
adishakti-ki-prem-kahani.description: Following Sati’s self-immolation, Shiva withdraws into deep meditation on Mount Kailash. Reborn as Princess Parvati, Sati carries an unshakable longing to reunite with Mahadev. As the demon king Tarakasur terrorizes the three worlds, only Shiva’s son can defeat him. Rejecting royal proposals, Parvati undertakes severe penance to win Shiva’s heart. When even Kamadeva’s arrow fails, her pure devotion finally awakens Shiva’s love, leading to the sacred union of Shiv and Shakti.

billionare-daughter.title: Billionaire Family Betrayal
billionare-daughter.description: A betrayed billionaire must rebuild his life from nothing after his returned wife and estranged daughter steal his empire, only to discover a bitter patriarch brainwashed them both in a decades-long vendetta—forcing him to bring down the true mastermind and save the family he loves.

blood-on-the-river-ganga.title: Blood on the River Ganga
blood-on-the-river-ganga.description: Ex-commando Samar returns to his Mirzapur village on the Ganga to protect his sister Vandana from loan sharks serving Thakur Digvijay Singh, a feudal Bahubali running sand mafia, gun workshops and corrupt cops. Taking a security job with heiress Roshni Roy, who is fighting the Thakur's grab of her carpet docks, Samar is pushed too far when Vandana is kidnapped. He unleashes his combat skills, crushes the Bahubali's army and reveals his true rank to end the nexus.

my-husbands-secret-wife.title: My Husband's Secret Wife
my-husbands-secret-wife.description: When five-year-old Ruhi is injured in South Delhi hit-and-run, her mother Avantika finds the teen driver, Natasha, shielded by socialite Simran and Avantika's husband, Mahesh. Unaware the dying child is his daughter, Mahesh blocks Ruhi's surgery to protect his secret family. Avantika drops her quiet facade, seizes control of the Suryavanshi Diamond Conglomerate and freezes Mahesh out. When he tries to frame Simran and Natasha, Simran joins Avantika to destroy him at Delhi's Grand Diamond Summit

ye-ishq-nahi-aasan.title: Ye Ishq Nahi Aasan
ye-ishq-nahi-aasan.description: Wheelchair-bound Akash, ek baar college mein bullies ka shikaar, das saal baad desh ka sabse ameer aadmi ban jata hai — par uska dil aaj bhi uss ladki ko dhoondh raha hai jisne ek baar uski jaan bachayi thi. Ek arranged contract marriage mein use milti hai Riya — jo asliyat mein wahi "Ruhi" hai, par apni pehchan chhupa leti hai. Bua ki saazish, ek nakli Ruhi ka dhoka, aur ek anjaane pyaar ki kahani — jab do adhe pendant mil kar ek poora dil banate hain, tab sach saamne aata hai.

almilioner-swar-ka-badle.title: Almilioner Swar Ka Badle
almilioner-swar-ka-badle.description: Billionaire Sasur Ka Badla - Almilioner Swar Ka Badle

the-triple-crown-2.title: The Triple Crown
the-triple-crown-2.description: After a fatal accident, a delivery boy is reincarnated as a weak scholar in an ancient village. Guided by a stylish genie, he must navigate a new life while married to a princess, a warrior, and a merchant’s daughter. Using modern knowledge and magical boons, he protects his home from bandits and corrupt soldiers. As he wins his wives' devotion, he transforms from a "mad bookworm" into a powerful, beloved ruler.

ravi-the-secret-chef.title: Ravi The Secret Chef
ravi-the-secret-chef.description:
Ravi is a simple tiffin-wala dismissed by his status-obsessed wife — and India's most beloved anonymous food fraud investigator with 20 million subscribers. When betrayal, stolen credit, and a public humiliation push him to the edge, he risks everything to reveal his true identity at a live expose event — proving to a world that judged him by his apron that no work is small, and no secret stays buried forever.
Watch Now

mera-pati-sniper-no1.title: Mera Pati Sniper No.1
mera-pati-sniper-no1.description: A disgraced NSG master sniper hiding under a homeless alcoholic cover enters a contract marriage with the Prime Minister's commando daughter—who fanatically worships his ghost alter-ego without knowing he is her ragged husband—to expose his decorated stepbrother for murdering his wife and avert a massive terror attack on the capital.

masala-cafe.title: Masala Cafe
masala-cafe.description:
Kabir is a small-town cook with magic in his hands but no fancy degree. Thrown out of a roadside dhaba, he lands at Mumbai's most elite restaurant armed with nothing but his dead father's old knife. The staff mocks him. The chef humiliates him. The manager wants him out.
But his father wasn't just a cleaner here. He had a secret — and so does this kitchen.
This is a story of a boy who came to cook, but stayed to uncover the truth.

the-dog-date-2.title: The Dog Date
the-dog-date-2.description: மறக்கப்பட்ட கடந்த கால நினைவுகளால் தவிக்கும் கோடீஸ்வரன் மயூர், தன் அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து வாழ்கிறான். கொடூரமான மைத்துனனிடமிருந்து தப்பிக்கத் துடிக்கும் தைரியமான செல்லப்பிராணி கடைக்காரியான காவ்யாவுடன் மூன்று மாத ஒப்பந்தத் திருமணத்தில் இணைகிறான். இந்த போலித் திருமணம் உண்மையான காதலாக மலரும் வேளையில், புதைந்த ரகசியங்களும் அவர்கள் இருவருக்குமான மர்மமான கடந்த காலமும் அவர்களைப் பிரிக்க அச்சுறுத்துகின்றன.

band-baja-billionaire.title: Band Baja Billionaire
band-baja-billionaire.description:
Sania is being sold off as a business deal — a bride gifted by her greedy family to save their sinking empire. Rishab is the billionaire groom who never wanted this wedding either.
When Sania escapes mid-baarat and stumbles straight into a band-baaja van — she has no idea the stranger hiding her from her family's guards is the man she just ran away from.
This is a story of Sania and Rishab — two people who ran from the same wedding, and somehow ended up running toward each other.

shaadi-on-dulha-gone.title: Shaadi On, Dulha Gone
shaadi-on-dulha-gone.description:
A RAW agent on a secret mission to stop a bomb at a five-star hotel takes a shortcut — straight into a lavish wedding. The mandap blocks his only route. The wedding planner won't budge. The minister is hostage. The bomb is ticking. And somewhere in the chaos, the groom has vanished.
This is a story of one man, two hours, and the most chaotic wedding India has ever seen.

mahadev-ka-asli-waaris.title: Mahadev Ka Asli Waaris
mahadev-ka-asli-waaris.description:
In a world where a warrior’s worth is defined by his Brahma Chakra, Aryan possesses none—but carries Mahadev’s supreme Trishul Shakti.  
Searching for his lost family, he intervenes to save Princess Chandni from a deadly demonic attack.  
But revealing his divine power risks drawing the dark forces that have hunted it for centuries.  
Now, Aryan must uncover his origins while embracing his destiny as the world’s protector.

jaan-bach-gayi-billionaire-ri.title: Jaan Bach Gayi Billionaire Ri
jaan-bach-gayi-billionaire-ri.description: Aryan ar Vedika ro byaav ho walo hai ee khatir Aryan ri behan Mitali kayi saala baad pachi ghar aave hai. Aryan apni Mitali jiji ne dekhkar bahut khush hove hai. pan galatfemiya ar jalankhori ke chaalte Vedika galat kadam uthave hai ar Mitali ne buri tarah su torture kare ar jaan su marwa ri koshish kare hai pan jad tak Aryan ne Vedika ri ee harkat re baare me pato chalto bahut der ho chuki hi pan Aryan jhutho prem ro nahi aapni behan mitali jiji ro sath deve hai ar vedika ne saza dilawe hai.

last-190-minutes.title: Last 190 Minutes
last-190-minutes.description: A minister survives an assassination attempt but urgently needs a heart transplant. With flights grounded, a brilliant yet controversial doctor has just 190 minutes to deliver the donor heart. But ego, revenge, and unexpected obstacles threaten the mission. As time runs out, can he save a life? Watch now!

pretty-thief-lover.title: Pretty Thief Lover
pretty-thief-lover.description: preety thief lover of the mafia boss

i-became-the-king-of-monsters.title: I Became the King of Monsters
i-became-the-king-of-monsters.description: When a betrayed junior scientist survives a lethal viral infection and discovers his blood can absorb monster abilities and command a bio-weapon swarm, he wages brutal war against the cynical corporation and corrupt government that manufactured the apocalypse.

mamla-illegal-hai.title: Mamla Illegal Hai
mamla-illegal-hai.description:
Hemant Sharma, a ruthless lawyer known for delivering justice, hides a lifelong wound—the loss of his twin brother Harsh in childhood. After 17 years, he finally finds him, only to see Harsh brutally attacked by a powerful legal heir. As Harsh lies critical, Hemant assumes his identity to infiltrate the corrupt system, seeking evidence, justice, and revenge against those who destroyed his brother’s life.
Watch now!

sariq-al-bank-al-milyardir.title: Sariq Al-Bank Al-Milyardir
sariq-al-bank-al-milyardir.description: Billionaire Bank Chor - Sariq Al-Bank Al-Milyardir

big-bank-chori.title: Big Bank Chori
big-bank-chori.description:
A wealthy NRI. A locked house in Dharavi. A mother who remarried and moved on.
Armaan has everything — except the truth about where he came from. When he traces his roots back to Mumbai, he steps into a world of power, secrets, and people who have too much to lose.
This is a story of a young man who went looking for his past — and stumbled into something far bigger and more dangerous than he ever imagined.

hasta-los-ganadores-pagan.title: Hasta los Ganadores Pagan
hasta-los-ganadores-pagan.description: Un mariscal suplente obtiene un antiguo sistema sobrenatural que le concede diez lanzamientos perfectos al día, pero cada uno destruye sus nervios. Para salvar su brazo, deberá confiar en su inteligencia, descubrir el oscuro destino de los usuarios anteriores y enfrentarse a una red corrupta. Con el tiempo en contra, liderará a un equipo de Texas hacia el título estatal antes de quedar incapacitado para siempre.

la-novia-proscrita-se-venga.title: La Novia Proscrita se Venga
la-novia-proscrita-se-venga.description: En un mundo devastado, la ley exige sobrevivir en pareja o morir solo. Obligada a casarse, Christine elige a un misterioso hombre marcado por la guerra para compartir un hogar en un cañón estéril. Él ignora que ella puede extraer agua y cultivos de la tierra envenenada. Mientras cree proteger a una exiliada indefensa, Christine construye en secreto un imperio que el señor de la guerra está decidido a destruir.

ironfang-bastion.title: Ironfang Bastion
ironfang-bastion.description: In the frozen north, Kestrel disguises herself as a male recruit to infiltrate a brutal vampire academy and rescue her enslaved sister, Cora. Surviving deadly trials, she catches the eye of King Theron, who discovers her secret after claiming her as his Golden Guard. As forbidden passion ignites, they retreat to heal and train before joining forces to overthrow the ruthless Warlord Calder, free Cora, and seize the northern throne.

she-refused-the-don-2.title: She Refused the Don
she-refused-the-don-2.description: மும்பையின் கொடூர தாதாவின் உயிரைக் காப்பாற்றும் துணிச்சலான பெண் மீது அவனுக்குக் காதல் பிறக்கிறது. ஆனால், அவளது காதலன் துரோகம் செய்து, கட்டாயத் திருமணம் நடக்கவிருக்கும் தருணத்தில், அவன் அவளைக் காப்பாற்றிக் கரம் பிடிக்கிறான். பாதாள உலகை ஆள்வதை விட, தன் மனைவியின் இதயத்தை வெல்வதுதான் உலகிலேயே மிகக் கடினமான காரியம் என்பதை அவன் விரைவில் உணர்கிறான்.

the-cylinder-ceo.title: The Cylinder CEO
the-cylinder-ceo.description: Vedant, a wealthy petroleum CEO, disguises as a cylinder delivery boy to expose an LPG scam. He marries Meera, a poor girl, in a contract marriage. When she discovers his true identity, she feels betrayed. Forced to marry corrupt MLA Mehta's daughter Riya, Vedant's mother tricks Meera into signing divorce papers. But Meera finds evidence of the MLA's cylinder hoarding scheme and exposes it. She replaces Riya at the wedding; the MLA is arrested. Vedant and Meera's marriage is confirmed.

the-cursed-dragon-is-my-baby-daddy.title: The Cursed Dragon is My Baby Daddy
the-cursed-dragon-is-my-baby-daddy.description: Half-dragon Wren mines dangerous Sunstones to save her dying grandfather. When her touch calms cursed Dragon Prince Ronan’s fatal fire-fever, one night leaves her carrying three pureblood heirs. Ronan offers a contract marriage and royal care, but Wren must survive brutal trials and hostile nobles. As enemies plot against them, their true mate bond awakens, leading them to defeat a royal coup and claim Drakoria’s throne together.

seven-years-to-find-you.title: Seven Years to Find You
seven-years-to-find-you.description: Seven years after being deceived into believing his human wife died, the mighty Lion King Agasthya discovers she is alive—blind, hunted, and secretly raising their half-lion twins in poverty. As forgotten love, royal conspiracies, magical enemies, and a kingdom that rejects their bloodline collide, Agasthya must fight to reclaim his family before the people who tore them apart destroy them forever.

mirror-of-deceit.title: Mirror of Deceit
mirror-of-deceit.description: Chloe uses a magic mirror to take the face of Vivian, an heiress who secretly fled abroad to escape her uncle and duties. Chloe discovers Vivian's greedy uncle, Victor, has frozen her personal accounts to force her back. Meanwhile, Julian, a cold billionaire, must secure a family alliance to protect his CEO position. Chloe (as Vivian) agrees to marry Julian to help him, demanding a $100,000 personal loan in return to pay for her mother's surgery.

billion-dollar-sindhoora.title: Billion Dollar Sindhoora
billion-dollar-sindhoora.description:
Kiara, a runaway bride with a sindoor box and a threat — forces Karan, a simple halwai, to fill her maang at a wedding he's just catering at. One desperate moment. One accidental husband.
But Karan is not who he seems — and neither is the world Kiara just dragged him into.
This is a story of Kiara and Karan — two strangers bound by a chutki of sindoor, and everything that comes with it.

the-secret-king-revenge-of-betrayed-husb.title: THE SECRET KING : REVENGE OF BETRAYED HUSBAND
the-secret-king-revenge-of-betrayed-husb.description: Steve Blackwell arrives in Hawaii to surprise his pregnant wife Nancy, only to discover her affair with Alex, who now controls her resort. After Alex humiliates Steve and destroys his 300-year-old family crown, a livestream exposes Steve’s true identity and Alex’s crimes. Billionaire Samantha Roy withdraws Nancy’s funding, Alex reveals her unborn child is his, and Nancy, Alex, and Emma are arrested as Steve reclaims his legacy.

planet-of-the-mechas.title: Planet Of The Mecha's
planet-of-the-mechas.description: Cassian Vale, a disgraced Mecha champion, loses everything after exposing a conspiracy threatening Aurelia, the galaxy’s last living planet. Exiled and presumed broken, he awakens the Blood of Nature, a legendary biomechanical Mecha powered by Aurelia itself. Reborn as Echo, Cassian fights his way back to reclaim his identity, expose High Duke Malrec, and stop him from draining his homeworld of life forever.

soldier-daddy.title: Soldier daddy
soldier-daddy.description: When terror network Al-Sarkar targets his daughter, ex-commando Vikrant sheds his chef disguise. He exposes terror-funding elites, defuses bombs across Mumbai, and defeats Zubair — reclaiming his soldier's identity while never losing his father's heart.

cole-and-buddy.title: Cole and Buddy
cole-and-buddy.description: When a struggling musician's viral rise to fame sparked entirely by his scruffy rescue dog's accidental howling tempts him to trade that dog for a polished, "industry-ready" purebred replacement, the loyal stray who gave him everything is framed, isolated, and finally abandoned to die waiting for a man who never comes back until strange, unexplainable signs force Cole to confront the truth and reclaim the one thing fame nearly cost him: the friend who loved him before anyone was watching.

reborn-old-hero-in-new-body.title: Reborn: Old Hero In New Body
reborn-old-hero-in-new-body.description: A battle-worn veteran wakes up in the body of an unranked freshman at a corrupt corporate hero academy, using veteran tactical memory, an illegal dorm-room combat agency, and a federal military override to destroy the weapons monopoly exploiting his classmates.

my-lucky-star-3.title: My Lucky Star
my-lucky-star-3.description: தன் அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து ஏழை கேட்டரிங் ஊழியராக நடிக்கும் ஒரு பெரும் தொழிலதிபர், எதிர்பாராதவிதமாக ஒரு திறமையான கிராமத்து சமையல் கலைஞரைத் திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்; அதன்பின் உண்மையான அன்பைக் கண்டறிவதோடு, அவளது சொந்த ஊரையும் காப்பாற்றுகிறார்.

babasaheb.title: Babasaheb
babasaheb.description: Adapted from his autobiography, Waiting For A Visa, Babasaheb follows Ambedkar’s formative years. Born Bhimrao Sakpal into a society that denies him water, education and dignity, each humiliation strengthens his resolve to learn. With the love and sacrifice of his father and family, he pursues knowledge against all odds. Sailing to America, he carries the hopes of millions denied equality—a journey that will lead him to become Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, chief architect of the Indian Constitution.

my-husband-is-a-monster.title: My Husband is a Monster
my-husband-is-a-monster.description:
She married into one of the city’s most powerful families, believing she’d found the perfect life. But behind the wealth, influence, and picture-perfect marriage lies a darkness she was never meant to see.
And when the doors of the Cross dynasty finally close behind her, Valerie realizes she may have married into something far more dangerous than she ever imagined.

motu-champion.title: Motu Champion
motu-champion.description:
Rohan, a cheerful overweight boy from a small village, wins his first Badminton district championship — and walks straight into the worst night of his life.
The girl he loved humiliates him in public. The weight he never saw as a weakness becomes the only thing the world sees.
This is a story of Rohan — a champion who was broken in front of a crowd, and what he does next.

sarkari-bahu.title: Sarkari Bahu
sarkari-bahu.description: An ambitious IPS officer secretly enters crime-ridden Birpur as a newlywed bahu to expose a powerful kingpin who controls villagers through government schemes. As she educates them about their rights and benefits, she becomes their “Sarkari Bahu”—and the nexus’s biggest threat.

കോടി-തിളക്കം.title: കോടി തിളക്കം
കോടി-തിളക്കം.description: Ansh, secret CEO of Gulati Empire, spends a decade living as a humble rag-picker to pay for his father’s sins. He adopts two orphans, Nisha and Disha. Loyal Nisha grows hardworking, but arrogant Disha disowns him to social-climb with her corrupt boyfriend, Kunal. Concluding his penance, Ansh launches a corporate battle that exposes Kunal’s fraud and Disha’s treachery. Kunal is arrested, and Disha is expelled. Revealing his identity, Ansh names Nisha the new CEO, securing their future.

billionaires-quadruplet-trap.title: Billionaire's Quadruplet Trap
billionaires-quadruplet-trap.description: Five years after being drugged and framed by a jealous socialite, Clara Evans runs a beloved heritage café while secretly raising four genius quadruplets. Billionaire tech mogul Damian Prescott discovers the children through a street tarot reading just as his family trust's strict succession deadline threatens his CEO seat, prompting him to offer Clara a multi-million-dollar buyout.

the-tigress-strikes-back.title: The Tigress Strikes Back
the-tigress-strikes-back.description: Fifteen years ago, young Brooke was thrown off a speeding freight train by syndicate enforcers who attacked her father, David Sterling. Today, she is a lethal underground fighter searching for him. Her search leads her to the ruthless Vance family, who kidnapped her father to seize his valuable land. She takes a job as a bodyguard on their sprawling estate to bring them down from within, but falls for the boss's son, Cole, who despises his father's violent empire.

revenge-of-the-loyal-boyfriend.title: Revenge Of My Fake Boyfriend
revenge-of-the-loyal-boyfriend.description: Rajat, ek humble aur loyal ladka, jise uski ambitious girlfriend ne status aur paisa nahi hone ke wajah se publicly embarrass karke chhod diya, wapas India aata hai. Lekin sab log shock ho jaate hain jab pata chalta hai ki woh desh ki sabse badi company ki khoobsoorat aur powerful CEO ka pati hai. Dekhiye "Revenge of My Fake Boyfriend" - pyaar, dhokha aur nafrat ki ek anokhi kahani!
revenge-of-the-loyal-boyfriend.//_comment: 🛑 Bot 2 Reverse (Bottom to Top) start hai aur is show per aate hi ye ruk jayega

phantom-of-theatre.title: Phantom Of Theatre
phantom-of-theatre.description: ఒక దెయ్యాల థియేటర్ లో, పదమూడేళ్ల క్రితం ఒక అగ్ని ప్రమాదంలో హతమైన ఒక దురదృష్టవంతమైన నాటక బృందం యొక్క ప్రతీకారపూరిత ఆత్మలతో నిండి ఉంది. ఈ థియేటర్ లో మళ్ళి కొత్త షో వేయబోతున్నారు, ఇంకో బృందం కూడా చనిపోబోతుందా? లేక ఏమి జరుగుతుంది? తెలుసుకోండి ఇది చూసి.

unforgivable-1.title: ছোটলোক হাসব্যান্ড
unforgivable-1.description: The drama follows a long chain of betrayals inside marriages, families, and workplaces, with mothers and wives repeatedly forced to fight for children, money, and dignity. It begins with a child’s medical emergency that exposes a husband’s refusal to help and a household that treats the child’s suffering as leverage. The wife is pushed further into despair by a mother-in-law who shames her for not producing a male heir and withholds support. As the pressure grows, private cruelty is overheard, and the betrayed women begin turning grief into revenge. The story then widens into workplace conflict, where romantic rivals, public humiliation, and corporate sabotage become another arena for the same power struggles. Several schemes are exposed as staged or manipulated, including fake affection, image swaps, and public disgrace designed to control reputations. Lalit emerges as a repeated source of betrayal, using lies, humiliation, and financial control to dominate the women around him. Moumita’s fight becomes especially central as she faces disgrace, custody conflict, and the loss of assets while trying to protect her child. Family members on the paternal side repeatedly use the child as a weapon, including taking the child away, denying medicine, and escalating the conflict into public outrage. The domestic war spills into legal battles over divorce, custody, property, and control of the home. Lawyers and allies become important as some characters try to recover stolen assets or delay divorce long enough to expose fraud. Financial manipulation grows more severe, with property deals, hidden debts, and illegal house schemes threatening to ruin multiple families. In parallel, several men pursue wealth through romance or marriage, only to be exposed by sharper women who refuse to stay silent. Public shame becomes a recurring tactic, but it often backfires and reveals the deception underneath. The stakes rise further when Moumita is critically injured in a car crash and the fight shifts to who has the right to make medical decisions for her. Even in that vulnerable state, she is not safe, because others appear ready to exploit her condition for money or control. Across the later arc, hidden motives are uncovered, revenge plots collapse, and alliances form among betrayed women and their supporters. By the end of the batch digests, the show has become a high-stakes battle over survival, truth, and who gets to claim family, love, and property.

exploring-udaan-scheme-for-youth-in-kash.title: Exploring Udaan Scheme For Youth In Kashmir
exploring-udaan-scheme-for-youth-in-kash.description: Exploring Udaan Scheme For Youth In Kashmir

forever-love-2.title: Forever Love
forever-love-2.description: Shalini’s story unfolds as a sustained fight against coercion, where marriage, money, and corporate control are repeatedly used against her. Early on, she is pressured into an engagement that is clearly tied to a takeover motive, and she responds by arranging a temporary fake fiancé to block the match. The public confrontation around that engagement exposes the groom’s real intent, and the fallout spreads through family accusations, threats, and attempts to force her back into compliance. As the conflict widens, secret footage, public humiliation, and even an infant used as leverage turn private family pressure into open destabilization. The Ahuja-linked business struggle becomes inseparable from the personal one, with demands for shares, chairpersonship, executive power, and urgent financing all traded like bargaining chips. Shalini is also pulled into a harsher world of surveillance, harassment, and physical danger, including an assault that leaves her injured and urged to seek police help. Around her, allies and rivals keep shifting, with some figures trying to protect her while others use her vulnerability to gain leverage. Vikram’s search for Shalini collides with gang violence, showing that the threats around her are not limited to boardrooms or family homes. At the same time, corporate meetings become battlegrounds where shareholders question marriages, investors impose deadlines, and internal sabotage threatens the company’s stability. Nisha Ahuja’s rise to GM is challenged by suspicion that her marriage could mask a takeover, and she insists on keeping her private life separate from business. Elsewhere, status disputes, crude propositions, and public insults reinforce how often women in this world are treated as objects of control rather than decision-makers. Romantic tension also remains unstable, with Korno/Karno’s evasiveness, jealousy, and interruptions feeding another layer of emotional conflict. The show repeatedly links intimacy to power, making love, marriage, and desire feel like tools that can be weaponized. Scandals deepen through leaked photos, media scrutiny, police inquiry, and accusations of bribery or sabotage. Even art, charity, and project work become arenas for humiliation and restitution demands. By the end of the batch, the central stakes are clear: Shalini and the people around her are fighting to preserve dignity, safety, inheritance, and control in a world where every relationship can be turned into leverage.

kaunsa-zodiac-sign-banega-2025-mein-cror.title: Kaunsa Zodiac Sign Banega 2025 Mein Crorepati?
kaunsa-zodiac-sign-banega-2025-mein-cror.description: Kaunsa Zodiac Sign Banega 2025 Mein Crorepati?

becoming-light-1.title: Becoming Light
becoming-light-1.description: A naive girl is betrayed by her own father, who conspires with her stepmother to throw her and her mother out of their home. When she pleads for help to save her ailing mother, her father sets a cruel condition—she must marry a thug in exchange for 3 lakh rupees. But fate takes an unexpected turn when she mistakenly proposes to a wealthy businessman, thinking he is the thug!

song-of-transformation-1.title: Song Of Transformation
song-of-transformation-1.description: Follow the journey of a young musician as she navigates the world of black soul music, striving to make her mark in the industry despite the challenges.

the-last-recipe.title: The Last Recipe
the-last-recipe.description: The Last Recipe follows Aryan, a talented yet underestimated cook, as he battles personal struggles and a fierce culinary competition to save Zaika, a restaurant tied to his past. Amidst sabotage, betrayal, and a rekindled romance with Naina, Aryan’s journey culminates in a dramatic showdown proving his mastery and integrity.

s32-tamil-tv.title: Mr. Idiot, Hero Husband
s32-tamil-tv.description: The microdrama begins with Priya, a manipulative heiress, attempting to publicly humiliate and divorce her seemingly simpleton husband, Rudran. Her scheme backfires dramatically when Rudran, long underestimated due to a five-year mystical curse that caused perceived madness, reveals formidable hidden power and intelligence. As Rudran regains full awareness, he secretly plots revenge against those who exploited him, including Dev, who aggressively pursues Rudran's wife, Maya, for a corporate alliance. Despite immense family pressure to divorce Rudran, Maya fiercely defies her family and stands by him, asserting her connection. This defiance ignites a violent power struggle between Rudran and Dev, with Rudran often feigning madness to execute intricate plans. The conflict escalates as Rudran faces threats from Dev, dark magic from Swamyji, and corporate conspirators, but also demonstrates uncanny abilities, curing Mr. Karthik and gaining a powerful ally. Rudran, leveraging his unsigned divorce from Maya, integrates into the powerful Sesha family, drawing the ire of new rivals like Vishwa and Deva, who even commission his assassination. He survives ambushes, exacting revenge on gang leader Walter for past harm to Maya, and reveals himself as an appraisal master by exposing fake antiques. Amidst corporate battles, Rudran's medical genius is unveiled when he miraculously saves Meera's father, Sheshadri, after a financial betrayal. Rudran dramatically declares Maya his wife, forming an unexpected alliance with Walter, who champions Rudran's claims of theft against Joshua at a family ceremony. A sinister poisoning plot against the family patriarch, Godwin, emerges, with Rudran and Maya falsely accused by Joshua; however, Rudran's "poison" is revealed as a miraculous rejuvenator, shifting family dynamics. The narrative culminates in a maelstrom of corporate intrigue and personal vendettas. Joshua Jr., dismissed from the family company, plots revenge against Maya and Rudran, who are appointed to lead. A public scandal erupts, accusing the company of a product-related death, further destabilizing their position. Mr. Dev and the manipulative Mr. Miller orchestrate a hostile takeover, exploiting the family's financial vulnerability. Rudran and Meera's bond deepens as they investigate intertwined mysteries, while Maya fights to protect her family's legacy and claim leadership in a high-stakes auction. The show chronicles Rudran's journey from a cursed, underestimated "madman" to a strategic genius, fighting to protect his wife, reclaim his family's honor, and secure their corporate empire against a web of powerful enemies and betrayals.

the-heart-1.title: The Heart
the-heart-1.description: తన చేసిన తప్పులకు మరియు తన గుండె మార్పిడి ఆపరేషన్ ఖర్చులకు చెల్లించడానికి, టాన్ కై మరొకసారి తన బాక్సింగ్ గ్లోవ్స్ వేసుకుంటాడు.

the-exchange-1.title: The Exchange
the-exchange-1.description: "జో చికిత్స కోసం  money exchange ని దోచుకోవడానికి జో మరియు మే ప్రణాళిక చేసుకున్నారు. వారి దోపిడీ సమయంలో, ప్రొఫెషనల్ నేరగాళ్లు బందీలను చేసుకొని, అందరినీ లోపల బంధించారు. దోపిడీదారులు మరియు దోపిడీ చేయబోయే వారి మధ్య జరిగే సంఘర్షణే మన ఈ కథ.

twenty-8k-1.title: Twenty 8K
twenty-8k-1.description: ఒక యువకుడు నైట్‌క్లబ్ బయట గన్ షూటింగ్‌లో చనిపోతాడు, మరొక యువతి హిట్ అండ్ రన్ ఘటనలో చనిపోతుంది, ఇవి రెండు సంబంధం లేని మరణాలుగా కనిపిస్తాయి. దీవా జానీ, తన సోదరుడు విపోన్‌ను నిర్దోషిగా చూపించడానికి తన ఇంటికి వస్తుంది ఆ తరువాతే ఈ మరణాల వెనుక దాగి ఉన్న కుట్రలు తెలుసుకుంటుంది.

arabpati-ka-badla.title: Arabpati ka Badla
arabpati-ka-badla.description: Divya sacrifices everything to save her amnesiac fiancé Mihir, only to face a vengeful underworld don, Rana, who threatens their love with dark family secrets. As Mihir’s powerful lineage emerges, their fight for survival ends in triumph, shadowed by a hint of a sinister conspiracy behind his accident.

om-crush-on-me-1.title: Om Crush On Me
om-crush-on-me-1.description: "సగం థాయి మరియు సగం జపానీస్ రక్తం కలిగిన ర్యోసు తన తప్పిపోయిన తల్లిని వెతకడానికి అయుత్తాయా నగరానికి వస్తాడు. అక్కడ, అతను ఓర్-సోయ్‌ అనే అమ్మాయిని ప్రేమించడం మొదలుపెడుతాడు, కానీ మాయాజాలం చేయగల ఓ ప్రభువు ఆమెను తన దాసీ భార్యగా కొనుగోలు చేస్తాడు. ఆమెను దాస్యం నుండి విడుదల చేయాలని నిర్ణయించుకొని, ర్యోసు తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి ఒక బృందాన్ని ఏర్పాటు చేస్తాడు. ఆ తరువాత ఎం జరిగింది ఇది చూసి తెలుసుకోండి.

spy-girl-2.title: Spy Girl
spy-girl-2.description: The show weaves together romance, media ambition, and criminal investigation around nightlife spaces where access to truth is tightly controlled. It begins with fragments of danger and longing: a violent pursuit, lonely reflections on partnership and family, and a tarot warning that love may be fated yet still end in isolation. That emotional uncertainty carries into a hesitant bond between a seeker and a younger junior, while elsewhere a young aspiring reporter falls for a law-enforcement officer who rejects romance in favor of duty. Their personal tension is overtaken by a darker case when a public crisis leads police to a young woman’s suspicious death, with no CCTV and links to an entertainment venue serving influential patrons. As investigators and media workers circle the case, the venue emerges as a place where young women are drawn by promises of status, renamed, ranked, and controlled by gatekeepers. A TV presenter reconnects with a former crush through work, while a radio presenter is pressured into going undercover inside the high-security nightclub. The investigation grows more dangerous as protectors and fixers promise safety, violently force information from enforcers, and trace the hierarchy behind the club’s restricted spaces. Entry into the most secret room becomes a central obstacle, requiring precise timing, fingerprint access, and finally a grotesque severed finger to breach the barrier. Inside this world, discoveries that should trigger justice are repeatedly diverted into spectacle by producers more interested in content than truth. Evidence tied to Julie’s death, including a platinum ring, is turned into ritualized broadcast material and childish prize games even as others protest that the original death must be investigated. At the same time, the exploitation behind the glamour becomes more explicit through April’s storyline, as promises of promotion, travel, and celebrity collapse into violence, threats, and confinement. Her ordeal confirms that the nightlife machine is not merely corrupt but coercive, treating vulnerable women as commodities. In response, a rescue operative pulls a tortured victim to safety and gathers proof that the venue and its associates are part of a trafficking front. Undercover identities, infiltration, and a raid then widen the story from one suspicious death to a broader criminal network. That escalation leads to action against the nightclub-linked gang and the arrest of a major leader, suggesting a partial victory against the system of abuse. Yet the show does not resolve into simple triumph, because its criminal breakthroughs are shadowed by emotional damage and unresolved relationships. Confessions of love are rejected or left hanging, sacrifices are made, and work repeatedly overrides intimacy. Across the full arc, the central stakes are both external and personal: whether hidden exploitation can be exposed despite media manipulation and institutional obstruction, and whether people drawn together by danger can protect one another without losing themselves.

iron-lord-1.title: Iron Lord
iron-lord-1.description: పదకొండవ శతాబ్దంలో, రష్యాలోని రొస్తోవ్ నగరాన్ని పరిపాలిస్తున్న యువరాజు యారోస్లావ్, తన రాజ్యం సరిహద్దులను విస్తరించడానికి డాకాయితదారులు మరియు బందీ వ్యాపారుల గుంపులతో పోరాడాల్సి వస్తుంది.

lord-hanuman-ki-unknown-stories.title: Hanuman Ji Ki Unsuni Kahaniya (99% Hinduo Ne Nahi Suni)

treasure-inn-1.title: Treasure Inn
treasure-inn-1.description: The show moves through a chain of escalating conflicts where sacred objects, hidden weapons, and family loyalties keep colliding. Early on, authorities and enforcers investigate relic thefts, murders, and bloodless deaths, but every attempt to stabilize the truth is disrupted by threats, coercion, and sudden violence. A stolen sacred stone tied to honor and gold draws a warlord into a deadly recovery campaign, while an imperial arrival threatens to expose a secret arrangement. Investigators also confront a disturbing pattern of bodies found without visible wounds, leading them to suspect an acoustic force or a hidden Tang weapon. As the danger widens, disguises and mistaken identities complicate confrontations, including a moment when a presumed young man is revealed to be a woman and others claim to be police in disguise. Temple authority then pulls fighters into a new mission to recover a sacred statue during a festival, showing how religious duty and profit are intertwined. Another thread follows a patrol that discovers more bloodless corpses and turns to a famed fighter to face an uncanny threat that people describe in supernatural terms. Sound becomes an active weapon when a girl uses song to attack, forcing a central man to shield others while enduring escalating sonic assaults tied to long-buried anger. In parallel, a medical practitioner-warrior pursues both treasure and a specific person, suggesting that personal history is as important as the hunt itself. The later episodes shift toward Linglang, a guarded territory leader whose authority is repeatedly tested by suitors, bodyguards, thieves, and outside threats. Around her, flirtation, marriage pressure, and vows of devotion mix with plots to steal a sacred silpam and warnings that a red sky and the return of the Silver Shield Army signal larger danger. Distrust deepens when a doctor is said to use mental manipulation, making even protection feel unstable. The story also branches into domestic and survival crises, including jealousy over commitment, a snake-filled rescue, and a dangerous antivenom attempt that only raises the stakes. A separate desert raid for a warded ratha adds another layer of relic-hunting and fear of what may be sealed inside. Near the end, a chaotic fight, a storm-trapped basement standoff, and arguments over an explosive show how quickly the show turns from personal conflict to life-or-death survival. Across all these threads, the same pressure keeps returning: characters must choose between loyalty and survival, while the truth about relics, family legacy, and hidden power remains unstable.

the-gaelic-king-1.title: The Gaelic King
the-gaelic-king-1.description: యుద్ధాలతో నిండిన క్రీస్తుశకం 800లోని స్కాట్‌లాండ్‌ను నేపథ్యంగా చేసుకొని, **ది గేలిక్ కింగ్** సినిమా యోధుడైన రాజు అల్పిన్ మాక్ ఈచ్డాచ్ గాధను చెప్పుతుంది. అతని తమ్ముడు అపహరించబడినప్పుడు, అల్పిన్, పురాతన శక్తిని దాచిపెట్టిన చెదిరిన అడవిలో అపహరణకారులను వెంబడించాల్సి వస్తుంది.

the-dark-soul-1.title: The Dark Soul

tabbaliyu-neende-magane.description: *ತಬ್ಬಲಿಯು ನೀನೆನಾದೆ ಮಗನೇ* ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಲೇಖಕ ಎಸ್.ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಭಾರತದ ಸಮಾಜದ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆಯ ಬಿಂಬವನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿಸುತ್ತಾ, ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಣಿ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪುಟ್ಟ ಅನಾಥ ಹುಲಿಯ ಒಡನೆಯಾಗಿ ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಮೌಲ್ಯ, ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ನಂಬಿಕೆಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವುಗಳಿಗೆ ತಾಗುವ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಬದ್ಧತೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಘರ್ಷವು ಕಥೆಯ ಮುನ್ನೋಟವಾಗಿದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವುದರೊಂದಿಗೆ, ತಾತ್ವಿಕ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

anchu.title: ಅಂಚು
anchu.description: "ಅಂಚು" ಬಿ.ವಿ. ಶೃಂಗ ಅವರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ, ಸಮಾಜದ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಕಟ್ಟಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುವ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಬದ್ಧತೆಯನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷಗೊಳಿಸುವ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಕೃತಿ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಕಥೆಯು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನಿಯಮಗಳು, ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಂದರೆಗಳು, ದ್ವಂದ್ವಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ತೊಂದರೆಗಳಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರುವ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂವಾದವನ್ನೆತ್ತುತ್ತದೆ. ಕುಟುಂಬ, ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಜೀವನದ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಓದುಗರ ಮುಂದೆ ತೆರೆದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.

i-ran-away-with-a-hidden-ceo-1.description: Heiress Ananya initially hires struggling actor Devansh to pose as her fiancé, aiming to secure her inheritance and protect her family from a corporate takeover and a forced marriage. This deception quickly unravels as Ananya publicly rejects powerful investor Aryamaan, exposing his infidelity and revealing their shared secret child, transforming their rivalry into a deeply personal conflict. Amidst this, manipulative relatives and ambitious rivals like Arthi scheme for control of the Dhanraj Group, while Ananya's past contract marriage with Devansh resurfaces, complicating her present. CEO Aditya, initially a protective admirer, becomes a menacing tormentor, abducting Ananya for revenge against her father, forcing her into a perilous journey through captivity and betrayal. Ananya rises to a General Manager position, securing her company with a mysterious investment from Aditya, who then relentlessly pursues her, hinting at a deeper, possibly contractual connection. She clashes with arrogant CEO Devansh, initiating a fierce rivalry that evolves into a complex romantic entanglement, as he often intervenes to protect her from attacks and corporate sabotage. Their secret marriage ignites outrage from Devansh's family patriarch and challenges his arranged bride, Naina, leading to public scandals and corporate espionage orchestrated by Naina and Ananya's sister Bharti. The Dhanraj family faces a tumultuous inheritance battle, sparked by the patriarch's critical illness, with Ananya accused of ruthless ambition and illegal actions to seize control. A powerful rival forces Ananya into a coerced marriage to save her uncle, shattering her marriage to Devanshu and igniting a fierce corporate war as Devanshu vows revenge. Amidst massive financial fraud and false accusations of patricide and blackmail, Ananya makes defiant choices to protect her family and dignity. Devansh and Ananya's contract marriage dissolves into a divorce agreement, but a family elder warns of dire consequences, revealing a deeper strategic alliance. Aryaman, fueled by revenge against the powerful Roy family, meticulously plans to reclaim his corporate empire through strategic marriages, including one with Ananya, and plots to frame Naina. His schemes culminate in a devastating car crash, critically injuring Devansh, prompting Ananya to fiercely fight for his survival and reaffirm her deep, protective love, leading to her acceptance into his family. Later, Devanshu faces arrest for a 'fake case' orchestrated by Naina, while his father requires an urgent kidney transplant. Devanshu, leveraging global connections, arranges a swift international kidney donation, confessing his love to Ananya and solidifying their committed relationship amidst hints of underlying secrets and compliance.

blood-brothers.title: Blood Brothers
blood-brothers.description: The show unfolds as a grim spiral of coercion, family pressure, and violent secrets. It begins with Douglas being brutalized by a dominant criminal hierarchy and pushed toward self-mutilation as punishment, with drugs and keys used as leverage over his body and choices. That early cruelty establishes a world where power is exercised through humiliation, addiction, and fear. At the same time, the story opens a domestic thread around Amma, whose disturbing vision is treated by Charles and Thomas as possibly madness, prophecy, or a fractured memory. Their attempts to interpret her condition sit beside a broader pattern of control, as Thomas repeatedly tries to direct Charles’s behavior and decisions. The show also places Charles and Thomas in threatening social encounters where women are objectified and boundaries are crossed, making their world feel unsafe even outside overt criminal scenes. As the plot expands, organized violence becomes more explicit, including plans for abduction, sexual assault, and ritualized murder. Charles and Thomas increasingly split over responsibility, with Thomas pushing a harsher ideology while Charles hesitates, rationalizes, or tries to preserve his own position. A quieter but fragile countercurrent appears in Janvi’s hospital-night conversation with a protective suitor, offering brief tenderness before duty and danger interrupt it. Later, Thomas pressures Charles to marry and take responsibility for a woman and her young daughter, turning family obligation into another form of coercion. That pressure gives way to a captivity-and-assault arc in which Charles is tied to violence against Jenly, while Thomas reinforces the demand that the captive be finished. The aftermath is morally unstable, with Charles claiming consent and Thomas rejecting that account, leaving guilt and justification in conflict. The story then widens into a murder investigation after a mutilated woman is found, and Detective Homer Call begins tracing clues through interviews, staff, and suspicious inconsistencies. Suspicion spreads rather than resolves, touching the questioned men and even the investigator’s own conduct. Brief moments of intimacy and romance surface, but they collapse into confrontation, panic, and interruption. The final stretch turns toward supernatural dread and death-cult imagery, ending with captivity, an unexplained atma-like presence, and a farewell that feels both hallucinatory and unresolved. Across the whole show, the central stakes are survival, truth, and whether anyone can escape the systems of violence that bind family, desire, and crime together.

divorced-billionaire-heiress.description: Isabella, a secretly wealthy heiress, initially seeks a simple life with her husband, Carson, but her family's corporate machinations disrupt her peace. Carson cruelly divorces her, publicly humiliating her despite her contributions to his success, pushing Isabella into a high-stakes contract marriage with the enigmatic CEO Ryan Jacobs. As Isabella navigates elite society, she uncovers layers of deception, including questions about Ryan's true identity and Carson's entanglement in a larger scheme. Her own hidden wealth and past as the legendary Chef Cecilia, also known as the formidable Miss Moore, gradually come to light, challenging perceptions and asserting her power. Their union sparks fierce opposition from Ryan's family, particularly his grandmother Dadimaa, and rivals like Kiara and Baron Robin, who attempt to force an arranged marriage for Ryan and accuse Isabella of manipulation. Amidst these corporate and social battles, Isabella and Ryan solidify their bond, defying expectations and protecting their marriage. However, past betrayals resurface, with Carson and Sara, publicly humiliated and blacklisted, vowing retribution. Sara, driven by debt and revenge, kidnaps Isabella and blackmails Ryan for corporate shares, revealing Isabella's own calculated revenge plot against Carson, orchestrated with Sara. The Jacobs Group faces a ruthless power struggle as Ryan is disinherited, and his brother Chris is declared the new head, further complicating matters with the re-emergence of Cecilia/Miss Moore, who is involved in a corporate scheme to support Ryan. Isabella's influential father also attempts to push her towards another romance, adding to the personal and corporate pressures. Despite the overwhelming odds and a ruthless mastermind, Ryan makes significant sacrifices to protect Isabella, issuing chilling ultimatums to rivals. The narrative culminates with Isabella rejecting a wealthy former lover and, in a powerful assertion of her agency, proposing marriage to Ryan Jacobs, who joyfully accepts, signaling a new beginning for the couple as they face ongoing challenges to their love and corporate empire.

battle-of-wits.title: Battle of Wits
battle-of-wits.description: ఈ కథ చైనా వారింగ్ స్టేట్స్ కాలంలో జరిగిన యుద్ధాన్ని ఆధారంగా తీసుకుంది, ఇది 3వ శతాబ్దం క్రీస్తుపూర్వం వరకు సాగిన పౌర యుద్ధాల శ్రేణి. ఈ కథ ఒక ప్రసిద్ధ జపనీస్ మాంగా ఆధారంగా రూపొందించబడింది. ఈ కథని పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకోండి ఈ వీడియో చూసి.

7-assassins.title: 7 Assassins
7-assassins.description: ప్రాచీన చైనాలో బంగారం మాయమవుతుందే, ఆ బంగారాన్ని వెతుకుతామని రాజసాంఘ రక్షకులు భరోసా ఇస్తారు, ఆ వెతికే క్రమం లో వాళ్ళు ఎదురుకోబోయే సమస్యలు ఏంటో ఈ వీడియో చూసి తెలుసుకోండి.

alpha-wolf-1.title: Alpha Wolf
alpha-wolf-1.description: వర్జీనియా మరియు ఆమె భర్త జాక్, తెలుగు గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతంలో ఒక long వీకెండ్ గడపడానికి వెళ్ళినప్పుడు, వారు ఒక భయంకరమైన ప్రాణిని ఎదుర్కొంటారు, అది వారి జీవితాలను తలకిందులు చేస్తుంది. ఆ తరువాత ఎం జరిగిందో ఇది చూసి తెలుసుకోండి.

6-enemies-of-your-mind-1.title: 6 Enemies Of Your Mind
6-enemies-of-your-mind-1.description: Your mind is your greatest asset—but it also has enemies that silently hold you back. Fear, doubt, procrastination, negativity, overthinking, and distractions can drain your potential and stop you from achieving greatness. In this episode, we’ll uncover these 6 enemies of your mind and learn powerful strategies to defeat them. Ready to break free and unlock your full potential? Let’s dive in!

남편이-나를-수중-감옥에-가두었습니다-1.title: สามีของฉันขังฉันไว้ใน คุกใต้น้ำ
남편이-나를-수중-감옥에-가두었습니다-1.description: The show is built around a repeating cycle of betrayal, identity crises, and fights over wealth and family power. It opens with a trusting heiress whose husband turns a wedding anniversary dive into an apparent murder attempt, trapping her underwater and setting off public mourning and private scheming. Once she is presumed dead, spouses, stepmothers, executives, and relatives rush to seize homes, titles, and company control while pretending to grieve. Across multiple households, grief quickly becomes accusation, violence, and inheritance warfare, with storms, gunshots, broken glass, and desperate demands for answers marking the fallout. A revenge-minded woman also emerges, determined to uncover who was framed, silenced, or made to disappear and to force repayment. The central mystery deepens when a woman believed dead returns alive, only to be denied, accused of being an impostor, and tested by the very people who claimed to love her. Her legitimacy is challenged through birthmarks, scars, fingerprints, DNA, jade, and family markers, turning identity into a public and corporate trial. In one branch of the story, a woman refuses humiliation and a forced marriage alliance, then fights to reclaim the Tong family home and authority. That struggle expands into boardroom warfare as directors, elders, and rivals try to strip her of status while she counters with legal and physical proof of who she is. Elsewhere, staged divorces and marriage arrangements are used as tools to satisfy wills, unlock inheritances, and seal corporate alliances. These schemes repeatedly expose that some partners were never loyal, but were instead using love, marriage, or closeness to gain money, authority, or company control. Several women discover that the men beside them have hidden motives, false devotion, or direct responsibility for death and disappearance. Confessions often arrive too late, followed by rejection, arrest, or a final severing of ties. The emotional stakes keep rising as families weaponize duty, honor, and bloodline to control women’s futures. At the same time, allies, siblings, and loyal associates step in to defend the wronged women, expose lies, and keep them alive. By the end of the batch, survival itself depends on proving identity, surviving coercion, and refusing to surrender power to those who betrayed them.

헉-알고보니-우리-아기-아빠가-억만장자-1.title: โอ้พระเจ้า! ปรากฎว่าพ่อของลูกฉันคือ มหาเศรษฐี
헉-알고보니-우리-아기-아빠가-억만장자-1.description: Across the batch digests, the drama is built on repeated collisions between family control, hidden identity, and public shame. Many characters are pushed toward arranged marriages, contract marriages, or strategic alliances, while others resist being treated as bargaining pieces. Romantic relationships often begin under pressure, through mistaken identity, rushed proposals, or secret spouses being exposed in front of relatives and coworkers. Class prejudice and reputation anxiety keep turning private feelings into public crises, especially in homes, offices, hospitals, and ceremonial gatherings. Several women are humiliated or threatened when their background, pregnancy, or marriage status becomes known. Several men also conceal who they are, whether by hiding wealth, pretending to be poor, or keeping a past relationship secret. Corporate settings add another layer of danger, with hiring disputes, plagiarism accusations, sabotage, and power struggles over promotions and design work. In more than one thread, a senior executive or powerful family figure overrides ordinary rules to protect someone they care about. Family elders repeatedly try to control marriages and inheritance, using money and approval as leverage. At the same time, children often become the emotional center of the story, accidentally exposing secrets or pulling adults back together. Some arcs lean into comedy or awkward domestic warmth, but those moments are usually interrupted by gossip, suspicion, or a sudden crisis. The show keeps returning to the idea that love cannot stay private for long when status and family pressure are involved. Hidden children and disputed parentage deepen the stakes, making truth itself something people must fight to prove. In the later material, revelations about paternity and past connections begin to resolve some of the confusion, but only after intense confrontation and institutional chaos. Across the whole arc, marriage is both a trap and a refuge, depending on who controls the truth. By the end of the digests, the central tension remains whether these couples can claim each other openly without losing family, status, or safety.

mini-habit.title: Mini Habit
mini-habit.description: Big changes start with small steps! Mini habits are tiny, daily actions that create powerful, lasting transformations over time. Whether it’s reading one page, doing a single push-up, or writing a sentence, these small wins build momentum and rewire your brain for success. No pressure, no burnout—just effortless progress. Want to achieve more with less effort? Let’s unlock the power of mini habits!

my-mafia-boss-is-my-secret-lover.title: My Mafia Boss is my Secret Lover
my-mafia-boss-is-my-secret-lover.description: Stella begins as a servant pulled into Don Vincent’s mansion after her mother disappears, and the household’s warnings about vanished staff make every task feel dangerous. She is told to stay away from Vincent’s study, yet his attention keeps drawing her into his orbit through coercion, suspicion, and constant testing. As she is watched more closely, Stella discovers hidden files and private spaces, which only deepens the sense that the mansion is built on secrets and control. Vincent’s public decision to place her under his protection does not free her; instead, it marks her as even more tightly bound to him. Pamela and other power players treat Stella as a threat, while Enzo’s loyalty tests force her to choose between escape and staying. Stella refuses the offer of a new identity and money, and Vincent later confirms that she is still being evaluated. When Vincent falls ill and rejects outside doctors, Stella is reassigned as his personal caretaker, pushing her from servant work into intimate dependence. That closeness becomes more dangerous as she starts to feel emotionally attached to him. At the same time, Vincent’s recovery from injury pulls her deeper into his criminal world rather than back out of it. Rival pressure from the Rivieras exposes how fragile Vincent’s position has become, and Stella watches him shift from wounded man to ruthless commander. He responds to threats with retaliation, ordering strikes on rival shipments and locations as violence escalates around the mansion. A raid, sirens, and urgent warnings make clear that the conflict is no longer contained. Stella is repeatedly told to stay safe, but the danger keeps reaching her anyway. The rivals eventually abduct her, using her as leverage to demand control and ransom. Vincent answers with a rescue and counterstrike, proving that Stella has become part of the war around him. By the end of the arc, Stella has chosen to stay aligned with Vincent, even though that choice binds her to both attraction and coercion. The show’s central stakes are survival, loyalty, and whether Stella can remain herself inside a world that keeps trying to claim her.

the-3-newspaper-trap-why-more-sources-ki.title: The '3 Newspaper' Trap: Why More Sources Kill Your Chances
the-3-newspaper-trap-why-more-sources-ki.description: Learn why relying on too many sources can harm your UPSC prep and discover the secret to extracting maximum value from minimal sources.

나를-판-약혼자-1.title: คู่หมั้น ที่ขายฉัน
나를-판-약혼자-1.description: ในเรื่องนี้ บริษัทของซ่งหมิงเจ๋อล้มละลาย และเขามีหนี้สินล้นพ้นตัวกับเจ้าหนี้เงินกู้นอกระบบ เขามีความต้องการที่จะชำระหนี้ให้หมดสิ้น จึงตัดสินใจที่น่าตกตะลึงด้วยการขายคู่หมั้นของเขาโจวชิงให้กับมาเฟียและกลายมาเป็นเมียน้อยของพวกเขา

profitable-dabba-business-shuru-karo.description: Get the ultimate guide to starting a profitable food business and learn how to create a successful tiffin business.

내-남편의-다른-아내-1.title: ของสามีฉัน ภรรยาคนอื่น
내-남편의-다른-아내-1.description: แม่ของซู่หยานหรานไว้ใจแม่เลี้ยงของเธออย่างซื่อๆ อย่างจ้าวเหมยเฟิง เมื่อพ่อของซู่หยานหรานมีสัมพันธ์กับจ้าว พวกเขาวางแผนขับไล่ซู่หยานหรานและแม่ของเธอออกไป ทำให้แม่ของเธอป่วยหนัก เพื่อช่วยแม่ของเธอ โซยอนลันจึงขอเงินพ่อของเธอ แต่พ่อของเธอใช้เธอเป็นเหยื่อล่อ โดยเสนอเงิน 300,000 ดอลลาร์ให้เธอเพื่อแต่งงานกับนักเลงให้กับน้องสาวของเธอ ทายาทผู้ร่ำรวย ฟู่ฮั่นซุง จากไปเมื่อได้ยินว่า ฟู่ หยานหยาง หลานชายที่ห่างเหินกันของเขาเสียชีวิตที่สลัม สอบสวน. ในวันที่เขามาถึง ซู่หยานหลานซึ่งสวมชุดแต่งงานที่ยืมมาเข้าใจผิดว่าเขาเป็นอันธพาล ฟู่ฮั่นเซิงทำงานร่วมกันเพื่อค้นหาความจริงเกี่ยวกับการตายของหลานชายของเขา ยิ่งพวกเขาใกล้ชิดกันมากขึ้น พวกเขาก็ตกหลุมรักและมีความสุขร่วมกันในที่สุด

노래하기-위해-두-번-태어났다-1.title: เกิดมาสองครั้ง เพื่อร้องเพลง
노래하기-위해-두-번-태어났다-1.description: เมื่อ 5 ปีก่อน Gurou มีความสัมพันธ์อย่างไม่คาดคิดกับผู้ชายคนหนึ่ง และตั้งครรภ์และให้กำเนิดลูกคนหนึ่ง เพื่อปกป้องเกียรติยศของตระกูลเก่า แม่เลี้ยงของเธอจึงหลอกครูให้เชื่อว่าเด็กคนนั้นตายแล้ว ห้าปีต่อมา ตระกูลทงกดดันให้ Gu Rou แต่งงานแบบคลุมถุงชนกับคุณชายหนุ่มผู้ฉาวโฉ่ของตระกูล Shen เนื่องจากค่าสินสอดที่แพงเกินจริง Gu Rou ผู้ไม่ได้ทำตามเรื่องนี้ จบลงด้วยการแต่งงานแบบฉับพลันกับ Shen Li ผู้พยายามหลบหนีการแต่งงานแบบคลุมถุงชน เซินหลี่รู้จัก Gu Rou ในฐานะผู้ช่วยชีวิตของลูกชายของเขา และตกหลุมรักเธอตั้งแต่แรกเห็น เขาปฏิบัติต่อเธอด้วยความเมตตาและความรักใคร่ ปิดบังตัวตนในฐานะซีอีโอของตระกูลเซิน และแต่งงานกับเธออย่างเร่งรีบ และคอยสนับสนุนเธออย่างเงียบๆ เมื่อเธอกำลังมีช่วงเวลาที่ยากลำบาก พวกเขาค่อยๆตกหลุมรักกัน...

나는-운명을-바꾸기-위해-억만장자와-결혼했다.title: แต่งงานกับมหาเศรษฐี เพื่อเปลี่ยน โชคชะตาของฉัน
나는-운명을-바꾸기-위해-억만장자와-결혼했다.description: The show follows a sprawling melodrama in which marriage, inheritance, and corporate control become weapons inside elite families. It begins with betrayals around pregnancy, greed, and succession, as lovers reject responsibility, relatives exploit the fallout, and public ceremonies are turned into forced or substitute marriages under family pressure. What should be private romantic decisions quickly become legal and financial battlegrounds, with marriage registrations, contract terms, and cohabitation used to lock people into alliances they did not freely choose. Across these early conflicts, several women resist humiliation and coercion even as powerful heirs, chairmen, and relatives try to dictate their futures. Se-eun’s reluctant bridal status and later promotion into a high executive role deepen the struggle, because her rise triggers sibling resentment, public confrontations, and renewed fights over who controls both family honor and business succession. At the same time, suspicious money transfers, hospital cliffhangers, and revenge plans suggest that the marriage disputes are tied to broader schemes inside the conglomerates. A major thread centers on An Ran, who emerges as a woman repeatedly targeted by her own family’s corruption yet determined to expose more than a single crime. Evidence accumulates around drugging, hidden recordings, erased surveillance, and staged accusations, revealing a pattern in which favored relatives are protected while victims are silenced, restrained, or hidden away. As An Ran pushes back, the conflict expands from domestic abuse and family cover-ups into full corporate warfare, with rumors, investor panic, smear campaigns, and public appearances used to manage collapsing reputations. Romantic bonds offer intermittent protection, but they are rarely simple: marriages may be contractual, affection is entangled with obligation, jealousy repeatedly destabilizes trust, and lovers are often forced to prove whether they are allies or opportunists. The series keeps linking intimate vulnerability to public power, showing assaults, missing persons, and reputational scandals feeding directly into boardroom struggles and succession fights. After a patriarch’s death, the stakes rise further through conflicting wills, disputed shares, and proof that key testament evidence was forged, turning grief into another arena for manipulation. An Ran is then pushed into an even darker phase as rumor campaigns, a suspicious crash, and evidence of murder-for-hire make her both a witness and a likely target. Her search for truth also uncovers buried ties, leverage over old family secrets, and unresolved bonds that complicate the lines between rival, protector, and lover. Meanwhile, parallel household and workplace stories echo the same pattern of coercion, hidden motives, and sudden danger, reinforcing a world where no alliance is secure for long. The climax of the known arc centers on open succession warfare over An Shi, as rival patriarchs and heirs attempt to seize control through marriage, adoption, documents, and forced votes while An Ran fights to preserve what remains of her family’s position. That struggle turns violently personal when her father is revealed as the mastermind behind her kidnapping, blaming past schemes and financial ruin on her and other relatives. Even in captivity, An Ran tries to redirect the threat into a ransom strategy to protect the family fortune, while her husband and allies race to trace her location. Overall, the show presents a sustained battle over who gets to define family, love, and legitimacy in a world where every vow, scandal, and secret can be converted into power.
