வேங்கை-நங்கூரத்தின்-ஜீன்-குறிப்புகள்.description: சிந்துவெளியில் கண்டுடெடுத்த எழுத்துக்களும் தமிழ்நாட்டின் சில பகுதிகளில் கண்டெடுத்த எழுத்துக்களும் ஒன்றுபோல இருப்பது ஏன்? இடைப்பட்ட மூவாயிரம் கிலோ மீட்டர்களும் மூவாயிரம் ஆண்டுகளும் என்ன ரகசியத்தைச் சுமந்து நிற்கின்றன? தென்கோடி தமிழ் நாட்டில் இருந்து மெசபடோமியா, கிரேக்கம் என நடந்த வர்த்தகம் என்ன சேதியைச் சொல்கிறது? நினைவிலே தமிழ் உள்ள மிருகமாக நாம் இருக்கிறோம். ‘வேங்கை நங்கூரத்தின் ஜீன் குறிப்புகள்’ கதை அதைத்தான் பேசுகிறது...

creation-of-israel-1.title: Creation Of Israel
creation-of-israel-1.description: Embark on a compelling journey through history with "Creation of Israel" This meticulously crafted original series delves into the heart-pounding narrative of Israel's remarkable birth. From the fervent debates in international forums to the valiant struggles on the ground, this audiobook vividly captures the challenges and triumphs that marked this historic endeavor. Prepare to be transported through time, as you witness the awe-inspiring rise of a nation within the turbulent backdrop of the 20th century's global events. This is history at its most vibrant and visceral.

mahatma-ke-kasturba-se-rishte-mix-files.title: Mahatma Ke Kasturba Se Rishte
mahatma-ke-kasturba-se-rishte-mix-files.description: Desh Videsh ke liye 'Mahatma' bane Gandhi ji ne ek bar apni hi patni Kasturba ko South Africa mein ghar se bahar nikal diya tha. Kasturba ke liye apne pati ko 'Bapu' bante dekhna mushkil tha, par Satyagrah se lekar unke Brahmacharya ke faisle tak unhone Gandhiji ka sath diya. Par jab Kasturba aakhiri sansein le rahi thi tab Gandhi ne aisa kya kiya ki wo khud ko Kasturba Gandhi ke maut ka zimmedar manane lage? Mahatma aur Kasturba ke rishte se jude aisi kuch ankahi baatein sunein is show mein.

weight-loss-remedies.title: Weight loss Remedies
weight-loss-remedies.description: Ee rojullo baruvu taggadam anedi pedda samasyaga marindi. Daanikosam entho dabbuni kharcgupedutunna kuda kontamandilo marpu kanipinchatledu. Konthamandi exceesice chestaru, konthamandi yoga, konthamandi steroids kuda teesukuntaru. Kaani saraina paddthathi follow aithene saraina phalithaalu untai. Ee audiobook lo alanti saraina paddathula gurinchi vivarinchadam jarigindi.

money-saving-tips-from-the-worlds-riches.title: Money Saving Tips From The World's Richest
money-saving-tips-from-the-worlds-riches.description: Sambannar enganayeanu panam sambadhikkunathum chelavakunnathum? Avar enganeyanu nammil ninnum vyathyastharaakunnath? Ee chodhyangalkkellam utharam ningalkk ee showiloode labhikkum. Panam sambadhikkunnathum chelavakkunnathum sambandhichch ningalude chinthagathi maattunnathinum sambathikka swathanthram nedunnathinum ee show ningale theerchayayum sahayikkum.

swami-vivekananda-jaisa-jeevan-kaise-jiy.title: Swami Vivekanand: Jaisa Jeevan Kaise Jiye
swami-vivekananda-jaisa-jeevan-kaise-jiy.description: Kehte hain baatchit karte rehni chahiye apki problems ka solution yuhin mil jata hai. Isiliye yeh show ek baatcheet hai ek professor aur student ke beech, jisko sun kar aap Swami Vivekananda ki life se kuch aise lessons jaanenge jo aapko zindagi jeene ka ek behtar aur meaningful tareeka sikhayenge. Toh chaliye shuru karte hain.

sunday-thriller-stories-narkandar-voutik.title: Sunday Thriller Stories: Narkandar Voutik Kando
sunday-thriller-stories-narkandar-voutik.description: Bondhu Lolit-Er Songe Narkanday Ghurte Giye Odvutvabe Mrityu Hoy Ajay-Er, Narkandar Jongol Theke Mele Tar Lash. Kintu Kon Shihoron Jagano Karon Royechhe Ei Mrityur Pichhone? Tantan Uttejonay Vorpur Sei Rohosyomoy Kahini Jante Aapnake Shunte Hobe Sunday Thriller Stories-Er Ei Golpoti.

soul-lover.title: Soul Lover
soul-lover.description: Ek galat experiment ke karan Samay har din ek nayi body mein jaagta hai. Apni actual body mein jaane ki koshish mein Samay ki mulakat hoti hai scientist Tithi se. Dheere dheere Samay aur Tithi ek dusre ke pyaar mein pad jaate hain. Kya Tithi, Samay ko uski actual body mein wapas pahuncha payegi? Janne ke liye sunein, Soul Lover sirf Kuku FM par!

narakavathil.title: നരക വാതില്‍
narakavathil.description: നരക വാതില്‍ എന്ന ഓഡിയോ ബുക്കില്‍, റുഡോള്‍ഫ് ഹോസ്സ് എന്ന ആഷ്വിറ്റ്സ് കോണ്‍സന്‍ട്രേഷന്‍ ക്യാമ്പ് കമാന്‍ഡന്റ് തന്റെ അനുഭവങ്ങള്‍ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. 60 ലക്ഷം യഹൂദന്മാരും മറ്റു ജനവിഭാഗങ്ങളും കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ട ആ ക്യാമ്പിലെ നരകതുല്യമായ ജീവിതം അദ്ദേഹം വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു. ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്ക് കേള്‍ക്കുമ്പോള്‍ നമ്മള്‍ അനുഭവിക്കുന്ന ഞെട്ടലും വേദനയും വാക്കുകളില്‍ വിവരിക്കാന്‍ കഴിയില്ല. അതേസമയം, ഈ വേദനയുടെ ചരിത്രം മറക്കാതിരിക്കാനും, ഭാവിയില്‍ ഇത്തരം സംഭവങ്ങള്‍ ആവര്‍ത്തിക്കാതിരിക്കാനും നമുക്ക് ഓര്‍മ്മിക്കേണ്ടത് അനിവാര്യമാണ്.

നൈല്‍-ഡയറി.title: നൈല്‍ ഡയറി
നൈല്‍-ഡയറി.description: നൈല്‍ ഡയറി മലയാളത്തിലെ സഞ്ചാര സാഹിത്യത്തിന്റെ അഗ്രഗാമിയാണ് എസ്.കെ.പൊറ്റക്കാട്. തന്റെ യാത്രകളെ തികഞ്ഞ വാങ്മയ ചാരുതയോടെ പകര്‍ന്നു നല്‍കുന്നതിനൊപ്പം, അവിടങ്ങളിലെ ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ ആത്മാവും എസ്.കെ അനുവാചകനിലേക്ക് പകരും. ഹൃദ്യമായ ഭാഷയില്‍ അതത് ഭൂമികകളുടെ ചരിത്രവും, സംസ്ക്കാരവും, സാമൂഹ്യ യാഥാര്‍ത്ഥ്യങ്ങളും അദ്ദേഹം അവതരിപ്പിക്കും. ലോക വിസ്മയങ്ങളില്‍ ഒന്നായ നൈല്‍ നദിയിലൂടെയുളള യാത്ര അനുഭവങ്ങളുടെ വിവരണമാണ് നൈല്‍ ഡയറി. ആഫ്രിക്കയുടെ വിരിമാറിലൂടെ ഒഴുകുന്ന നൈലിന്റ്റെ വന്യവശ്യതയെ തെല്ലും ചോരാതെ ഈ രചനയിലേക്ക് ആഹാഹിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു, അതില്‍ പ്രകൃതിയും, മനുഷ്യര്യം, ജന്തുക്കളും എല്ലാം ഉള്‍ച്ചേരുന്നു.

finding-zen.title: Finding Zen
finding-zen.description: Khud se judne ka raasta kuch aisa hai jo kai sanskritiyon mein milta hai. Kya aapko pata hai, Zen aur Bharatiya vicharon mein ek gehra rishta hai? Jan ne ke liye suniye "Finding Zen" ka yeh audioshow

the-black-death.title: The Black Death
the-black-death.description: Journey back in time to one of the darkest periods in human history with "The Black Death," an immersive audiobook that delves into the heart-wrenching account of the deadliest pandemic to ever grip Europe. This gripping narrative takes you through the harrowing events of the 14th century, tracing the origins of the Black Death, its relentless spread, and the catastrophic consequences it brought to society.  Prepare to be transported to a time when survival meant everything and hope was the ultimate currency.

malayali-on-moon-s-somanath.title: Malayali On The Moon - S. Somanath
malayali-on-moon-s-somanath.description: ISRO nadathiya ottere paryaveshanangalkk supradhana pankuvahicha aalanu ippozhathe ISRO chairman S.Somanath. ISRO Chairman ennathinu purame bahiraakasha vakupp secretary koodiyanu adheham. Rajyathe shaastraparyaveshanathinu munpanthiyil nilkunna adhehathe kurichch kooduthalayi ariyam Kuku Bytesiloode.

learn-business-from-chanakya.title: Chanakya Se Seekhein Business Ki 5 Tips
learn-business-from-chanakya.description: Yeh to sach hai ki Chanakya ki neeti ke zariye Chandragupt ne Mauryan Empire khada karke itihas rach diya tha. To zara sochiye ki usi Chankya neeti ka use kar aap apne business ko kitna successful bana sakte hain! Yeh Original show aapko Chanakya ke diye wisdom ke baare mein batayega aur saath hi aap unke tareekon ka use apne business mein kaise kar sakte hain, yeh samjhenge.

life-changing-lessons-from-ma-yusuf-ali.title: Life Changing Lessons From M.A Yusuf Ali
life-changing-lessons-from-ma-yusuf-ali.description: M. A. Yusuf Ali enna vyakthiye aarkum prethyegam parichayapeduthenda karyamilla. Keralathil janichch lokathile thanne ettavum shradheyamaaya businessukalil oraalayi mariya aalaanu Yusuf Ali. Lulu hypermarket enna business valarthunnathinoppam jeeva karunya pravarthanangalilum adheham shradha kodukarund. Yusuf Aliyude vijayathinteyum jeevithathinteyum rahasyam namukk ee showiloode ariyam.

the-magic-ladder-to-success-3.title: The Magic Ladder To Success
the-magic-ladder-to-success-3.description: "The Magic Ladder To Success" by Napoleon Hill is a timeless guide to achieving your dreams and reaching the pinnacle of success. In this audiobook, you'll discover the secrets of some of history's most successful individuals and learn how to apply their strategies to your own life. Hill's profound insights on the power of positive thinking, goal setting, and perseverance will empower you to overcome obstacles, master your finances, and lead a more fulfilling life. Get all the tools, motivation, and guidance to help you climb the ladder to success one rung at a time with this empowering audiobook.

arjun-singh-ek-shayaatri-itihaas-ka.title: Arjun Singh : Ek Sahayatri Itihaas Ka
arjun-singh-ek-shayaatri-itihaas-ka.description: Yeh Kahani hai Arjun singh ki jo 1980 ke dashak mein do bar Madhya Pradesh ke chief minister banein aur sath hi unhone us waqt do bar human resource development ke union minister banke bhi kaam kiya. Magar kaisa tha inka rajneetik safar? aur kya thi inki rajneta banne ke peeche ki wajah? Jaanege humari is Audiobook “Arjun Singh Ek Shayaatri Itihaas Ka” mein.

ichirikkadhakal.title: ഇച്ചിരിക്കഥകൾ
ichirikkadhakal.description: ചെറിയ ജീവിതത്തിൽ ചിരികൾ വിടർത്തിയ ഇത്തിരിക്കഥകളാണ് ഇച്ചിരിക്കഥകൾ. ഭാവനയിൽനിന്നുണ്ടായവയല്ല, ജീവിതത്തിൽ പ്രസക്തമായ മാറ്റങ്ങളുണ്ടാക്കിയ ചില മുഖങ്ങൾ, അത്ഭുതങ്ങൾ, വേദനകൾ, കൺനിറവുള്ള പുഞ്ചിരികൾ ഇവയാണ് ഇച്ചിരിക്കഥകളുടെ കാതൽ.

bharat-evam-vishwa-ka-bhoogol.title: Bharat Evam Vishwa Ka Bhoogol
bharat-evam-vishwa-ka-bhoogol.description: Kya aapne kabhi socha hai, Bharat aur Vishwa ke bhoogol ke rahasya ke baare mein ? Is audiobook mein aap khud hi explore karenge, kaise dharti ki khoj aur uske bhoogolik roop ko samjha ja sakta hai. Yahan tak ki aap yeh bhi samjhenge ki kaise kaam karti hai jal-vayu pranali. To suniye 'Bharat Evam Vishwa Ka Bhoogol' aur badhaiye apne gyaan ki duniya ko!

അഞ്ചു-പെണ്ണുങ്ങള്‍-.title: അഞ്ചു പെണ്ണുങ്ങള്‍
അഞ്ചു-പെണ്ണുങ്ങള്‍-.description: ഒരു സ്ഥലത്ത് ഉത്ഭവിച്ച നദി പല കൈവഴികളിലായി പിരിയുന്നതുപോലെ മനുഷ്യബന്ധങ്ങളിലുണ്ടാകുന്ന വിചിത്രമായ പരിണാമങ്ങളുടെ ആകർഷകമായ ചിത്രങ്ങളാണ് അഞ്ചു പെണ്ണുങ്ങൾ എന്ന ഈ നോവലിൽ കൃതഹസ്തനായ തകഴി വരച്ചു കാട്ടുന്നത്.

sun-tzu-and-the-art-of-business.title: Sun Tzu And The Art Of Business
sun-tzu-and-the-art-of-business.description: Business lokam oru yudhakkalam poleyanu. Oru yudham nadakkunnund - Upabokthakkalkkum, Drishya parathaykkum, Vipani medhavithwathinum vendi. Sun Tzu And The Art Of Business enna ee krithi purathana Chinese General Sun Tzuvinte Classic grandham aayi The Art Of War, Aadhunika businessile athimalsara anthareekshathinu engane yojikunnu ennu vishadeekarikkunnu. Sun Tzuvinte yudha thanthrangale swantham business padhathikalude vipani aadhipathyathinayi engane samanwayippikkan kazhiyumennu ithilude manasilakkam.

the-art-of-war-5.title: Sun Tzu and the Art of Business
the-art-of-war-5.description:
Six Strategic Principles :
For Anyone who wants to Run a Business
[Key Ideas in 15 min]

magic-ladder-to-success.title: Magic Ladder To Success
magic-ladder-to-success.description: Samrambhakarudeyum Sthapana medhavikaludeyum vijaya rahasyangal adangiya magic ladder to success enna pusthakathilude vijayathilekkulla govanikal engine chavittikkayaram ennu vishadeekarikkukayanu rachayithavaya Napoleon Hill. Jeevithathinte Oro ghattathilum namme munnot pokanum vijaya thrishna uyarthanum sahayikkunna pusthakam aanith.

splitting-africa-into-two-1.title: Splitting Africa into Two
splitting-africa-into-two-1.description: Africa Rendu Mukkalu Avutunda??!! Continental Drift Kaaranam ga Africa Rendu Mukkluga Cheelipotundani Scientists Guess Chesinantha Ashcharyam Emundi? Teravenuka Jarige Science facts& Africa Treditional vishayala gurinchi ee audiobook lo poorthiga telusukondi.

eklavya.title: Eklavya: The True Warrior
eklavya.description: Mahabharat mein chhipi hai ek sachche dhanurdhari yoddha ki aisi kahani, jo Guru Dronacharya ki mahanta par sawal uthaati hai. Eklavya ko Guru Drona ne dhanurvidya sikhane se mana kar diya kyonki Eklavya nishad putra the. Lekin Dronacharya ne guru dakshina mein Eklavya ka angootha kyon manga? Bina angoothe ke Eklavya ki dhanurvidya ka kya hua? Aaiye jaante hain is show mein.

the-millionaire-fast-lane-3.title: The Millionaire Fast Lane
the-millionaire-fast-lane-3.description: Peru, Panam, Prashasthi ennee 3 karyangal ellavarum aagrahikkunnu. Cheriya prayathil thanne vijayam neduka ennath ethoru yuvavinteyum swapnam aanu. Cheru prayathil thanne orupaad nettangal undakkiyittulla palareyum ningal chuttilum kandittundavum. Athupole thanne kadinadhwanam cheythittum aagrahicha vijayam nedan kazhiyatha aalukaleyum ningal kandittundavum. Cheruppathile vijayikal aakunna aalukal athinayi mattu vazhikal enthenkilum sweekarikkunnundo. Atho avarude pravarthana reethi mattullavaril ninnu vyathyasthamano. Kettariyam ee Bytesilude.

the-everything-store-2.title: The Everything Store: The Story Of Amazon
the-everything-store-2.description: 1994il Viralil ennavunna aalukalkk mathrame Internetinte bhavi sadhyathakal manasilayullu. Annu Bezos, Shaw and Co enna Hedge Fund D.E kku vendi joli cheyyukayayirunnu. Avide adhehavum mattu chila sahapravarthakarum oru online company sthapikkunnath swapnam kandu. Orikkal athu nirmmathavum upabokthavum thammil ulla idapadinte kendramayi maarukayum sooryanu keezhil ulla ella ulpannangalum vilkkukayum cheyyum ennavar pratheekshichu. Athanu nammal innu kaanunna Amazon enna Billion Dollar Company.

stop-overthinking-3.title: Stop Overthinking
stop-overthinking-3.description:
"Aaiye ! Overthinking Ko Door Bhagayein Aur Zindagi Saral Banayein". 
 kya hain overthinking rokne ke tareeqe? Kaise isse bacha ja sakta hai aur khud ko mentally healthy rakha ja sakta hai? Sab batayenge "Nick Trenton"  ki likhi is kamal ki Audiobook "Stop Overthinking" mein.

the-art-of-public-speaking-4.title: The Art Of Public Speaking
the-art-of-public-speaking-4.description: Aadhyamayi Ningal oru sadassine abhimukheekarikkumbol chilappol pedi thonniyekkam. Pakshe Vishamikkenda. British Rashtra thanthrajnan William Gladstone muthal American purohithan Henry Ward Beechar vareyulla niravadhi prabhashakarkk polum thangalude stage fear orikkalum ozhivakkan sadhichittilla. Ennal oru prasangam nadathuka ennath ningalude bhayathe illathakkan ulla karyamalla, bhayathe niyanthrikkan ullathanu.

vinoba-bhave.title: Vinoba Bhave
vinoba-bhave.description: Vinoba Bhave samajat asnarya asamanate sathi ladhle. Tyani Sarvoday moment (Progres for all) suru keli. Tyani Women Development sathi ek chotishi community suddha suru keli jyacha nav Brahma Vidya Mandir Thevnyat ala. 1951 madhye bhave yani Pochampally, Telangana yethe Bhoodan Moment sur keli. Survatichya kalat Bhave hey Tilakanche follower hote pan jashi tyanchi Mahatma Gandhin shi bhet jhali te tyanche follower jhale. Chala aikuyat kukufm var Samajsudharak Acharya Vinoba bhave yanchi jeevan katha.

liabilities-ko-assets-mein-kaise-badlein.title: Liabilities Ko Assets Mein Kaise Badlein ( Advance )
liabilities-ko-assets-mein-kaise-badlein.description: Kya Aapko pata hai ki hum apne Liabilities ko Assets mein kaise badal sakte hain? Aakhir kaise Pehchane hum apne Liabilities ko? Wo kon kon se Financial problems hai jise Samajh kar hum use Aane wale waqt mein Assets mein badal sakte hain? Janne ke liye suniye ye Audio Show.

improve-your-memory-power-2.title: Improve your Memory Power
improve-your-memory-power-2.description: Tumhi kadhi asha vyaktila bhetlayt ka, jyachi Smaran Shakti pahun tumhu tumhi chakit zala ahat? Ashi memory power mazi pan asti tar kiti fayda zala asta asa tumhala watlay ka? Tar mag he pustak 100% tumcha faydyacha ahe. Memory power kashi wadhwychi, tyache fayde konte, Uttam Smaran shakti tumchya jeevnat kasa badal ghadvu shakte he sara kahi janun ghya 'Improve your Memory Power' ya audiobook madhun...

heer.title: Heer
heer.description: Heer aur Anhad ko jab tak samajh aaya ki unhe ek doosre se pyaar hai tab tak bahut der ho chuki thi. Kya shadi shuda Heer ki zindagi mein Anhad toofan ban kar aayega? Kya Anhad apne pyaar ke liye apne career ko daav par laga dega? Kya haasil hoga Anhad ko, pyaar ya shohrat? Janne ke liye sunein Heer, Kuku FM ki Musical Love Story.

finding-the-gaps.title: Finding The Gaps
finding-the-gaps.description: Umpiring, coaching, training, administration ennivayile mikacha career Simon Taufeline jeevithathil onnam sthaanath ethanum avide thudaranum enthanu vendathu ennu padipichu. Ee pusthakathiloode Simon Taufel aa padangalum soft skillukalum pankidunnu. Ee paadangal aarkum allenkil ethu thozhililum prayogikkan kazhiyum.

how-family-relations-are-changing-in-thi.title: How Family Relations are Changing in this Generation
how-family-relations-are-changing-in-thi.description: మీ కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో మీరు సరిగ్గా ప్రవర్తిస్తున్నారా? మీ కుటుంబంలో అందరి మధ్య మంచి వాతావరణం ఉందా? మీ కుటుంబం సంతోషంగా ఉండాలంటే మీరేమి చెయ్యాలో ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో తెలుసుకోండి.

chandra-tamas.title: Chandra Tamas
chandra-tamas.description: Apsara Chandraprabha aur Rakchas Tamas ke jeevan ka ek hi lakshya hai jisme devraaj Indra shaamil hai. Ek aisi maayavi duniya jahaan har taraf chunauti hai. Chandraprabha ko apsara se manushya banne ka shraap kyon mila? Tamas ki devraaj Indra se aisi kya shatruta hai jo wo devta banne ke liye bhi taiyaar hai? Kya hai rahasyamayi maniyon ka matlab? Ateet ka wo kaun sa rahasya hai jo Chandraprabha aur Tamas ke bhavishya ko badal dega? In sabhi sawaalo'n ke jawab se parda uthaayegi ye kahani jiska naam hai "Chandra-Tamas"!

step-by-step-guide-to-your-own-start-up.title: A Step by step guide to your own Start up
step-by-step-guide-to-your-own-start-up.description: Startup ni munduku teesukuvelladam antha easy pani kaadu, already industry lo unna pedda pedda companies idea ni dobbeyavachu inka salaries, marketing, scaleup , funding antu chala vishayalu untayi. Ivanni tattukoleka chala startups start chesina konni years lone close avutuntayi. Ee Audiobook lo ilanti avarodhalu enni vachhina tattukoni Startup ni successfull gaa ela munduku teesukuvellalo vivarinchadam jarigindi, audiobook ni poorthiga vini ee roje mee startup journey ni start cheyandi.

prema-3.title: ప్రేమ

conscious-uncoupling.description: Conscious Uncoupling  ಇದು ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮಾಧಾನಕರವಾಗಿ ಅಂತ್ಯಗೊಳಿಸುವ ಕಲೆಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಪ್ರೇಮ, ದೌರ್ಬಲ್ಯ, ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕತೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾಗೃತಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಮಾಧಾನವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಸವಿಸ್ತಾರವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೆ. ಸಂಬಂಧದ ಕಷ್ಟ, ನೋವು, ಮತ್ತು ತೊಂದರೆಯನ್ನು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿ, ಸ್ನೇಹಸಂಬಂಧ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಗೌರವವನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸುವ ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಇದು ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ ಪ್ರೇಮ, ಸಮಾಧಾನ, ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಆರಂಭಗಳತ್ತ ದಾರಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಪ್ರೇರಣಾದಾಯಕ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸಮತೋಲನಕ್ಕೆ ಪೂರಕವಾಗಿದೆ.

maybe-you-should-talk-to-someone-1.description: "Psychologist Toh Dimaag Padh Skte Hai!" 587d9d43-f625-4c0f-9cfd-0936904ca9bf.description: தப்பு என்பதே ஒரு தப்பான விஷயம். அந்தத் தப்பையே தப்புத் தப்பாய் பண்ணினால் எப்படியிருக்கும் ? குற்றம் செய்தவர்கள் சட்டத்தின் பார்வையிலிருந்து தப்பித்துக் கொண்டாலும், நீதி தேவதை ஏதாவது ஒரு வடிவில் வந்து அவர்களைத் தண்டிப்பது காலத்தின் கட்டாயமாக மாறுகிறது. இது ஒரு சோஷியோ க்ரைம் த்ரில்லர்.

jai-bharat-jai-jagat-bhag-2-strivaad.description: Dive into the world of Non-Fiction with Kuku FM where real stories and groundbreaking ideas come to life. Our collection spans intriguing topics from history and science to culture and personal development. Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

mayong-the-land-of-black-magic.title: Mayong: The Land of Black Magic
mayong-the-land-of-black-magic.description: Apne kaale jaadu ke liye poori duniya me famous, Assam ka Mayong village yahaan aane waale logon ko aaj bhi romanch se bhar deta hai. Jaane kitne hi rahasya chhupe hain Mayong mein. Mahabharat ka yuddh ho ya fir Ahom samrajya ke aage Aurangzeb ki haar! Har ek mayavi vijay ke peeche hai isi Mayong ka chamatkar. To der kis baat ki? panam-pei.title: Panam Pei
panam-pei.description: 200 கோடி மதிப்புள்ள நகைகளை கொள்ளையடிக்க ஐந்து பேர் போடும் திட்டம், எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தால் ஆபத்தான விளையாட்டாக மாறுகிறது. போலீஸ் அவர்களைத் தேட, நகைகளை மறைத்துவிட்டு தப்பிக்க நினைக்கும் கும்பலுக்குள் சந்தேகம், துரோகம், பேராசை உருவாகிறது. ஆனால் அவர்கள் அறியாத மிகப்பெரிய ரகசியம், அந்த பணமும் நகைகளும் அவர்களின் வாழ்க்கையை தலைகீழாக மாற்றப்போகிறது.

jala-deepam-part-1.title: Jala Deepam -Part 1
jala-deepam-part-1.description: சாண்டில்யன் எழுதிய "ஜலதீபம்" — 1700களின் மராட்டிய பின்னணியில் விரியும் அற்புத சரித்திர நாவல். தமிழ் வீரன் இதயசந்திரன் இரகசிய பணியில் மராட்டியம் சென்று கொள்ளையர் தலைவன் ஆகும் கதை, நான்கு காதல்கள், போர்க்கள காட்சிகள் — மூன்று பாகங்களில் விறுவிறுக்கும் காவியம்!

love-junction.title: Love Junction
love-junction.description: 20 ವರ್ಷದ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಹುಡುಗಿ ಅಶ್ವಿನಿ, ತನ್ನ ಅತ್ತೆಯ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕ್ರೂರ ಪ್ಲಾನ್‌ನಿಂದ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ವತ್ತನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅದೇ ರಾತ್ರಿ, ಆಕೆ ಅಕಸ್ಮಾತ್ತಾಗಿ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್‌ಮ್ಯಾನ್ ವಿಕ್ರಮ್ ವಾಸುದೇವನ್‌ ಅವರನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರು ಹೆಲ್ಪ್ ಮಾಡೋ ಮ್ಯಾರೇಜ್ ಡೀಲ್ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಶ್ವಿನಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮರಳಿ ಸಿಗಲು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಕ್ರಮ್‌ಗೆ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿ ಪತ್ನಿಯ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಪೂರೈಸಲು ಈ ಡೀಲ್‌ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದಿಂದ ಶುರುವಾಗ್ತಾ, ಸ್ಲೋ ಆಗಿ ಎಮೋಶನಲ್ ಲೆವಲ್ಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತಾ ಅಥವಾ ದೂರ ಆಗೋ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳು ಎದುರಾಗ್ತಾವಾ ? ಈ ಕಥೆ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ತಪ್ಪದೇ ಕೇಳಿ KukuFM.

how-food-is-a-culture-in-india.title: How Food is a Culture in India
how-food-is-a-culture-in-india.description: Hindustaan aur yaha ka khaana, apne aap mein hi ek prem kahaani hai bhaiyaa. Aur ghat-ghat par yaha ka paani aur khaane ka swaad badalte rehta hai yaa keh lijiye aur zyada nikharta hai. Kashmir se Kanya Kumari aur Gujarat se Bengal, khaane ki shakal-surat, naam-dhaam aur swaad pehchaan bilkul hindustaan ke anek rango ki tarah hai. Jo iski vividhata mein ekta ki paribhaasha dete hai. Har khaane ke peeche ek etihaas hai aur isi etihaas se bana ek culture. Toh chaliye, pet aur dimag pooj kar aate hai is KuKu FM Originals ko sunkar!

swapna-saraswata.title: Swapna Saraswata
swapna-saraswata.description: ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಲೇಖಕ 'ಗೋಪಾಲಕೃಷ್ಣ ಪೈ' ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ಸ್ವಪ್ನ ಸಾರಸ್ವತ' ಕನ್ನಡದ ಮೇರು ಕಾದಂಬರಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು. ಭಾರತದ ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಕರಾವಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ, ಗೋವಾದಿಂದ ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನ ದಕ್ಷಿಣಕ್ಕೆ ಪಸರಿಸಿದ್ದ 'ಸಾರಸ್ವತರು' ಎನ್ನುವ ಸಮುದಾಯದ ವಲಸೆ ಕಥೆಯಿದು! 'ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಅಕಾಡೆಮಿ' ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಗೆದ್ದಿರುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ‌‌‌.‌

first-things-first-2.description:

manusmriti-burning-movement.title: Manusmṛiti Burning Movement
manusmriti-burning-movement.description: When Dr. B.R. Ambedkar set fire to the Manusmriti in 1927, he was not simply burning a book—he was challenging centuries of caste and gender inequality. This series traces the battle behind that historic fire and its lasting impact on India's struggle for equality, dignity, and justice.

i-kissed-my-doctor-now-heaven-wants-reve.title: I Kissed My Doctor, Now Heaven Wants Revenge
i-kissed-my-doctor-now-heaven-wants-reve.description: Elijah is an ancient divine being tied to karma who has spent centuries forgotten, until a mortal call draws him back into the human world. He arrives weak but still powerful, and the rule that answering a mortal prayer will bind him to mortal soil hangs over everything he does. Very quickly, his path becomes tied to Evelyn, a mistreated heiress trapped inside a hostile family and a fight over her inheritance. Elijah chooses to stay beside her, and what begins as rescue and secrecy grows into a protective alliance that is increasingly hard to hide. Evelyn is not only fighting for money or status, but for her mother’s legacy and for the truth behind the cruelty surrounding her. Victoria, Lucas, Richard, and other family forces use humiliation, legal pressure, boardroom control, and public manipulation to keep her powerless. Elijah repeatedly reveals impossible abilities, from bending danger away to exposing hidden wrongdoing, and each display makes the family war more dangerous. Evelyn slowly realizes that Elijah knows far more than he should, including details that suggest he has lived through centuries of history. Their bond deepens as he protects her from attackers, public disgrace, and the schemes meant to separate them. At the same time, Elijah’s interventions carry a cost, because using his power to save Evelyn draws divine punishment closer. The God of Karma closes in after Elijah breaks a sacred rule, making his protection of Evelyn both a blessing and a threat. The family conflict expands beyond personal cruelty into corporate theft, shell companies, hidden trust money, and old records that challenge the legitimacy of the takeover. Evelyn refuses to surrender her mother’s trust and uses older charters and hidden documents to fight back in public. A doctor’s findings and the revelation of deliberate poisoning suggest that her long illness was not natural, but part of a larger scheme. That discovery turns the inheritance battle into something darker, where betrayal inside the family may also be tied to supernatural judgment. When the board restores brutal old succession laws and forces claimants into trials, Evelyn enters a dangerous contest to reclaim control of the estate. She survives the opening ordeal with Elijah at her side, even as her weakness, the blood contract, and the hidden curse make every step harder. By the end of the arc, Evelyn is still fighting through the trials, while Elijah’s ancient power, his bond to her, and the family’s lies all threaten to collide.

rajput-deal.title: Rajput Deal
rajput-deal.description: Bani Singh's life changes forever after a cruel twist leaves her pregnant with billionaire heir Atharv Rajput's twins. To protect herself and her babies, she accepts his contract and enters his dangerous world. As ruthless enemies, family betrayals, and deadly conspiracies close in, a relationship built on obligation slowly turns into an unexpected love worth fighting for.

burn-with-me.title: Burn With Me
burn-with-me.description: New York Times best-selling author Kristen Proby brings you Burn with Me a With Me in Seattle novella. Bailey Whitworth is a charity event organizer and a woman exploring her sexuality. Kevin Welling and Gray McDermitt are firefighters and best friends who share everything. Bailey always knew her sexual appetite was different but she had no idea that she could fall in love with two men at once. What will she do when she has to choose between them? Or will she have to choose at all?

the-poor-billionaire.title: The Poor Billionaire
the-poor-billionaire.description: A billionaire hiding behind a janitor's uniform transforms a struggling single mother's life through an unexpected contract marriage.

the-cipher-manual.title: The Cipher Manual
the-cipher-manual.description: A determined detective must unravel a cryptic manuscript and confront a secretive organization to prevent a global catastrophe orchestrated by a ruthless antagonist, all while battling government secrecy and personal threats.

chellame.title: Chellame
chellame.description: நாய்க்கும் மனுஷனுக்குமான நெருக்கம் நீண்ட நெடிய வரலாற்றுத் தொடர்பு உடையது. வேட்டைச் சமூகமான மனிதர்களுக்கு வேட்டையனா செயல்பட்டது நாய்ங்க தான். என் பேர் ரவி. எங்கிட்டயும் ஒரு வேட்டையன் இருந்தான். அவன் பேர் கருப்பி. அவனோட கதை தான் இந்த செல்லமே.

stimita-nakshatra.title: Stimita Nakshatra
stimita-nakshatra.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

the-legend-of-birsa-munda-1.title: The Legend Of Birsa Munda
the-legend-of-birsa-munda-1.description: British hukumat ke khilaf jung chhedne wale Birsa Munda ki kahani, jo har Hindustani ke liye garv ki baat hai. Janiye kaise ek aam aadmi adivasiyo ka masiha ban gaya. Suniye is show mein Birsa Munda ki veerta aur balidaan ki kahani.

random-acts-of-fantasy.title: Random Acts of Fantasy
random-acts-of-fantasy.description: Do you ever really think that you will win the lottery? Meet Mr. Right? How about two Mr. Rights? Somehow the universe is handing me everything I want (except for that lottery part...) and I don't like it. Not one bit. Because just when you get all your dreams handed to you on a silver platter that's when an airplane dumps its sewage on your house. Or your mama's diabetes takes a bad turn. Or your mobile phone gets stuck in your hoohaw. (What? It happens…) Boring old average me got everything I wanted already moving from small-town Ohio to big-city Boston to follow my heart. So when the fancy invitation offering me a pile of money to come with the band Random Acts of Crazy to perform on an island resort and be their manager arrived, I thought it was a cosmic joke. Enough money to help my mama get what she needed. And five days in sunny paradise and a shot at greatness for the band? Unreal. One big shoe was waiting to drop. On my head. Just like no one really ever finds a naked man wearing only a guitar standing by the side of the road hitchhiking and ends up falling in love with him and his friend and moving halfway across the country for true love, no one gets an invitation to come to what turns out to be a resort where people make what me and Joe and Trevor do together look like a chaste peck on the cheek. But... Well. I guess these things do happen. To me.

mysteries-of-udayagiri.title: Mysteries of Udayagiri
mysteries-of-udayagiri.description: ఉదయగిరి కోటలో దాగిన భైరవుని రహస్యాన్ని తెలుసుకోడానికి ఆర్కియాలజిస్ట్ విజయ్, శివని, రుద్రవీర్, గురుప్రసాద్ కలిసి చేసిన ప్రయాణం ఇది. ఆ కోట లో దాగున్న ఈ అద్భుత రహస్యాన్ని చేదించాలంటే ధైర్యం ఒక్కటే కాదు, ధర్మం కూడా కావాలి!    భైరవుని ఖడ్గాన్ని అందుకునే ప్రయత్నంలో, మాయలు, మంత్రాలు, ద్రోహాలు దాటుకుని వెళ్ళిన వాళ్లకు తిరిగి వచ్చే అవకాశం ఉందా? తెలియాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ సిరీస్ వినండి.

sikhandi.title: శిఖండి
sikhandi.description: కొన్ని అధ్యయనాలు స్త్రీల కంటే మగవారు గొప్పవారు అని చెబుతున్నాయి. ఆడవాళ్ళు మగవాళ్ళు ఇద్దరూ సమానమే అని ఫెమినిస్టులు అంటున్నారు. అయితే మన దేవదత్ పట్టానాయక్ గారు రాసిన ఈ పుస్తకం దీని గురించి ఏమి చెబుతుంది అనేది మనం ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో విని తెలుసుకుందాం.

sivagamiyin-sabatham-part-4.title: Sivagamiyin Sabatham - Part 4
sivagamiyin-sabatham-part-4.description: கல்கியின் "சிவகாமியின் சபதம்" — 7ஆம் நூற்றாண்டு பல்லவ சாம்ராஜ்யத்தின் அற்புத வரலாற்றுக் காவியம். சாளுக்ய மன்னன் புலிகேசி II உம் பல்லவ மன்னர்கள் மகேந்திரவர்மன், நரசிம்மவர்மன் உம் மோதும் போர்க்களத்தில் சிவகாமியின் சபதம் எதிரொலிக்கிறது — காஞ்சி முதல் வாதாபி வரை!

c2484f78-adad-4f39-8806-01b2c9bd141e.description: When an ambitious fashion design graduate's family arranges her marriage to a wealthy businessman, she must choose between following her dreams of entrepreneurship and yielding to family expectations, all while the persistent suitor refuses to take no for an answer.

namma-ooruina-rasikaru.title: Namma Oorina Rasikaru
namma-ooruina-rasikaru.description: ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಜೀವನವೇ ಒಂದು ರೀತಿ ಸುಂದರ ಅನುಭವ. ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಮುಗ್ಧ ಜನ, ಅವರ ಹುಸಿ ಕೋಪ, ನಿಷ್ಕಲ್ಮಶ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಅಪರೂಪದ ಆಚರಣೆಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ತುಂಬಾ ಆತ್ಮೀಯ ಎನಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಇನ್ನು ಮನರಂಜನೆಗೆ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ನೋಡೋ ಪ್ರಮೇಯವೇ ಇರೋದಿಲ್ಲ. ಸುತ್ತಮುತ್ತಲೇ ನಡೆಯೋ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಘಟನೆಗಳು ನಗೆಗಡಲಲ್ಲಿ ತೇಲಿಸ್ತವೆ. ಇಂಥ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶಗಳನ್ನ ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಲೇಖಕರಾದ 'ಗೊರೂರು ರಾಮಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಅಯ್ಯಂಗಾರ್' ಅವರು 'ನಮ್ಮ ಊರಿನ‌ ರಸಿಕರು' ಪುಸ್ತಕ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ‌ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.! ಕೇಳಿ.. ಆನಂದಿಸಿ!

my-boyfriend-is-a-robot.description: A highly advanced humanoid robot falls in love with a human woman, forcing him to fight for survival when his creators try to shut him down.

chandrakanta-santati-book-5.title: Chandrakanta : 5
chandrakanta-santati-book-5.description: Chandrakanta ki is kahani ko sunte hi, aap ek aise tilismi raaj aur aiyyari ke khel mein kho jaayenge jo prem aur wafadari ki nayi paribhasha deti hai. Chandrakanta sun kar aapko ek thrilling adventure ka maza milega jo aapke dil-dimag par gahra asar chhodta hai. To abhi suniye poori audiobook.

b57a391b-d982-40de-b800-e7bbfa5e7df2.title: Mahabharatham Part - 2
b57a391b-d982-40de-b800-e7bbfa5e7df2.description: நமது சான்றோர் மஹாபாரதத்தை ஐந்தாவது வேதம் என்கின்றனர். இதை ஒவ்வொரு காலகட்டத்திலும் சிறப்பாக உள்வாங்கி அக்கால நிலைகளுக்கும் , நடப்புகளுக்கும் ஏற்ப பதிவு செய்துவிட்டு சென்றிருக்கின்றனர் நமது சான்றோர்கள். அவர்தம் வழியில் எழுத்தாளர் இந்திரா சௌந்தர்ராஜன் அவர்களின் படைப்பான மஹாபாரதத்தை கேட்டு மகிழுங்கள்.

21-top-secrets-for-business-life.title: 21 Top Secrets For Business & Life
21-top-secrets-for-business-life.description: Business aur life mein success ke shortcuts chahiye? Yeh show aapko batayega un top secrets ke baare mein jo aapki performance aur personal growth dono ko next level par le jayenge. Toh abhi sunna shuru karein aur apni journey ko accelerate karein.

the-monk-who-sold-his-ferrari-11.title: The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari
the-monk-who-sold-his-ferrari-11.description: தன்னோட Costly யான கார வித்துட்டு துறவியா மாறுன ஒரு பணக்கார Lawer உடைய இந்த கதை.. 🚗❌🧘‍♂️உங்க Life-அ முழுமையா வாழ உங்களுக்கு நிச்சயம் help பண்ணும் ✨

race-ka-king.title: Race Ka King
race-ka-king.description: Ten years after a devastating crash ends his career, legendary F1 racer Kabir lives quietly as a mechanic in Manali. When his old team DreamRacers faces collapse, owner Dhanraaj asks him to return. Hiding his identity, Kabir joins as a mechanic and endures humiliation from star driver Maqbool, until dangerous challenges reveal him as the legendary God of Racing. With Isha, his mentor's daughter, by his side, he must beat the corrupt Vipers, expose those behind his crash and reclaim his crown.

सजा-नहीं-इनाम-है-फांसी--लेखक--संतोष-भट्ट.title: सजा नहीं इनाम है फांसी
सजा-नहीं-इनाम-है-फांसी--लेखक--संतोष-भट्ट.description: पेट की भूख, घरवालों की ज़िम्मेदारी ये सब किसी से भी कुछ भी करवा सकती है। पर सवाल उठता है कि क्या इसकी कोई सीमा होती है? मजबूरियों से जूझते गोविंद ने ऐसा क्या किया की हो गई उसे फांसी! पर हमारा गोविंद तो खुश है? आखिर क्यों ये उसके लिए सज़ा नहीं ईनाम है फांसी! जानने के लिए सुनिए संतोष भट्ट द्वारा लिखी ये कहानी।

leadership-alchemy-book-summary.title: Leadership Alchemy : Transform Your Life Through Spirituality
leadership-alchemy-book-summary.description: Hum apne dimag ko tez aur calm kaise rakh sakte hain? Kaise hum khud ko har roz aur behtar bana sakte hain? Kis tarah Spirituality ki madad se hum wo sab paa sakte hain jo pana chahte hain? Janne ke liye suniye ye Audio book.

blue-eyes-blonde-hairs.title: Blue Eyes Blonde Hair
blue-eyes-blonde-hairs.description: An Indiana Fertility Specialist, Doctor Donald Cline, for nearly 30 years secretly used his own sperm to conceive women who visited his clinic for IVF treatment. At least 94 children were born as a result of this bizarre crime. These children now have to deal with who their father really is, learning that their conception was the result of a fraud and that they have around 100 half-siblings in a 20-mile radius. All that is common between these half-siblings is an autoimmune disease and blue eyes, and blonde hair

mattu.title: മാട്ട്
mattu.description: നാറാണത്തു ഭ്രാന്തന്റെ മലയിലെ  പൂജാരിയുടെയും , സംസ്‌കൃതപണ്ഡിതൻ അച്യുതവാര്യരുടെയും, മാപ്പിളപ്പാട്ടുകാരി ആച്ചിയുടെയും, കൂടല്ലൂർ പുഴയിലെ കുഞ്ഞാടിയുടെയും,  ചേർത്തലയിലെ ആന്ത്രപ്പേർ കൊട്ടാരത്തിലെ മുത്തശ്ശിയുടേയും, സ്വയം കഥകളെഴുതി  അച്ചടിച്ച് വീടുതോറും വിൽക്കുന്ന പരപ്പനാട് ഗോപാലകൃഷ്ണന്റെയുമെല്ലാം കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം. സമാഹരണം- പ്രശസ്ത നടൻ വി.കെ. ശ്രീരാമൻ.

main-milkha-singh.title: Main Milkha Singh!
main-milkha-singh.description: 1947 ke bantware mein lakhon pariwar gharon se beghar ho gaye. Kuch logon ko apni jaan bacha kar bhagna bhi pada tha. Par ek shaks aisa bhi tha jisne is bantware ke dard se bhagne ke liye daud ko hi jindagi bana li. Sunein ye khas dastan khud Milkha Singh ki nazar se, Main Milkha Singh mein..

biryani.description: വായനക്കാരെ അത്ഭുതപ്പെടുത്തിയ സന്തോഷ് ഏച്ചിക്കാനത്തിന്റെ അതുല്യമായ ഏഴു ചെറുകഥകൾ നിങ്ങൾക്കായി അവതരിക്കുന്നു Kuku FM . ഓരോ മലയാളിയും കേട്ടിരിക്കേണ്ട കഥകൾ!

shera-bhoy.description: Embark on extraordinary adventures with Kuku FM's Fantasy & SciFi collection. From epic quests in magical realms to interstellar explorations our shows offer an escape into worlds beyond imagination. Meet intriguing characters mythical creatures and face challenges that defy the laws of nature. Perfect for dreamers and adventurers tune in to start your journey into the unknown.

son-in-laws-secret-identities.description: Six years ago, Aiden was exiled from his country and forced to separate from the love of his life to a carve a new path for himself. The years have passed, and now the prodigal son-in-law returns to protect his wife and child. But a lot has changed, with him and with the people around him.

legal-loophole.description: Kanoon ki duniya ki uljhano mein, 'LEGAL LOOPHOLE' kholega nyay ke naye dwar. Advocate Arjun aur Jitendra ke saath kijiye har chunauti ka samna, sirf Kuku FM par.

നിഴൽക്കോട്ട.title: നിഴൽക്കോട്ട
നിഴൽക്കോട്ട.description: ജോലിയുടെ മടുപ്പിൽ നിന്ന് താത്ക്കാലിക വിടുതി തേടിയാണു ആ അഞ്ച് കൊളീഗ്ഗുകൾ ജുവാർത്ത എസ്റ്റേറ്റിലേക്ക് ആ രാത്രിയിൽ പോയത്. എന്നാൽ മനസ്സിൽ  ഗൂഢരഹസ്യങ്ങൾ ഒതുക്കി ആ ദുരൂഹ ലോകം അവരെ കാത്തിരിക്കുകയായിരുന്നു. അവർക്കിടയിലെ സൗഹൃദത്തിൻ്റെയും വിശ്വാസത്തിൻ്റെയും പരീക്ഷണവേദി അവിടെ ഒരുങ്ങുകയായിരുന്നു, ഭയവും ഭീതിയും ഉത്ക്കണ്ഠയും നിറഞ്ഞ വിനാഴികൾക്ക് തുടക്കമാകുക ആയിരുന്നു.

वापसी-.title: वापसी
वापसी-.description: Do dost Neel aur Dev Malaysia jaane ke liye Thailand ka tourist visa lete hai. Unhe agent ne bataya tha ki Malaysia ka visa thailand jaate hi mil jaayega, to kya dono doston ko aage ka visa mila? Kya vah malaysia ja sake ya phir bane dhoke ka shikar? Jaan ne k liye bane rahiye Kuku FM k saath.

uchalaya.title: Uchalaya
uchalaya.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

nasa-jwst.title: NASA JWST
nasa-jwst.description: Idhuvara vinvelikku anuppa patta telescope laye Powerful  laana Telescope 'NASA' oda 'James Webb Space Telescope (JWST)'.Andha Telescope enna laam idhuvara kandupidichurukku, Ini ennalaam kandupidikka pogudhu nu  JWST patriya Indha Virivaana Padhivula therinjukalaam.

bijapur.title: Bijapur
bijapur.description: Bahamani sultanate 5 hisson mein bant chuka tha. Deccan par ek baar phir khatron ke badal mandra rahe the. Aise mein wahan janmi ek nayi nijam shahi, jisne Deccan ke itihas ko ek naya mod diya. Kya tha ye naya mod? Kaun si thi ye nijam shahi? Janne ke liye sunte rahein, Bijapur

suryudi-yedo-gurram.title: సూర్యుడి ఏడో గుర్రం
suryudi-yedo-gurram.description: మాణిక్ ముల్లా జీవితంలో ఎదురైన ముగ్గురు స్త్రీల చుట్టూ తిరిగే కథల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? వీటన్నిటి నేపథ్యం ప్రేమ అని మాణిక్ ముల్లా చెప్తాడు కాని వాటి వెనుక ఉన్న జీవిత రహస్యాలు తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "సూర్యుడి ఏడో గుర్రం"  అనే ఆడియో బుక్ ని వినండి

seven-pillars-of-wisdom.title: Seven Pillars of Wisdom
seven-pillars-of-wisdom.description: இந்த ஆடியோபுக் முதல் உலகப்போர் நடந்துட்டு இருந்த சமயத்துல, பிரிட்டிஸ்  இராணுவ வீரர் T.E. Lawrence துருக்கிய பேரரசுக்கு (Ottoman Empire) எதிரா 1916-1918 காலகட்டத்துல எழுந்த அரேபியப் போர் பற்றி எழுதின நினைவுக்குறிப்புகளோட தொகுப்பு. போர்க்காட்சிகள கண்ணு முன்னாடி காட்டுற வகைல எழுதப்பட்ட இந்த புத்தகம் வரலாற்றுல மிக முக்கியமான ஒன்னு.

postman.title: പോസ്റ്റ്മാന്‍
postman.description: വിവിധങ്ങളായ മനുഷ്യാവസ്ഥകളെ വിഷയമാക്കിയ ബെന്യാമിന്റെ മികച്ച കഥകളാണ് ഈ കൃതിയിലുള്ളത്. ആലീസ് ഇന്‍ വണ്ടര്‍ലാന്റ്, ബുക്കാറാമിന്റെ മകന്‍, ഗുലാം ഹുസൈന്‍, മാര്‍കേസ്, നീലേശ്വരം ബേബി, പോസ്റ്റ്മാന്‍, സോലാപ്പൂര്‍, പുസ്തകശാല എന്നിങ്ങനെ ശ്രദ്ധേയങ്ങളായ എട്ടു കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരം.

gorakhpur-murder-conspiracy.title: Pyar paap aur Paheli
gorakhpur-murder-conspiracy.description: Shikha ke laash ka postmartum kar rhi police ko achanak pta chalta hai ki shikha dubey Zinda hai. Fir kiski hai shikha jaisi dikhne wali laash? Kya hai ye poori kahani janane ke liye suniye pura show PYAR, PAAP AUR PAHELI sirf KUKU FM par.

terrorism.title: Terrorism
terrorism.description: Sontrasbaad shobdo ta shunle amader chaar pash bhoy kepe othe. Sontrasbaader songaa jeneo aj o bohu manush haate bondhuk tule nei, daak dei gono hotyar. Ure jaye juddho biman. Sontrasbaad aj nichhok ekti shobdo matro noi. Sontrasbaad ba Terrorism sommondhye bistarito bhabe shune nin ei audio story ti.

ராசாவே-உன்ன-நம்பி-.title: ராசாவே உன்ன நம்பி
ராசாவே-உன்ன-நம்பி-.description: ராஜ் மற்றும் திவ்யா ஒரு அன்பான ஜோடி. இனிமையாக செல்லும் அவர்களது வாழ்க்கையில், அவர்கள் புதிய வீட்டிற்கு மாறிச் சென்றதும் பயங்கரமான பிரச்சினை ஒன்று துவங்குகிறது. முன்பு ராஜின் காதலியாக இருந்தவள், தன்னை கொலை செய்தது யார் என்பதை ராஜ் அறிந்துகொள்ளவும், தன்னை கொன்றவனை பழிவாங்கவும் மீண்டும் பேயாக திரும்பி வருகிறாள். கதையுடன் நம்மை பிணைக்கும் வகையில் ஒரு அற்புதமான திகில் கலந்த காதல் கதையை எழுதியிருக்கிறார் ஆசிரியர்.

reservationlu-prajaswamika-drukpatham.title: రిజర్వేషన్లు ప్రజాస్వామిక దృక్పథం
reservationlu-prajaswamika-drukpatham.description: దళితులు, గిరిజనులు, మైనారిటీలు తమ హక్కులను పరిరక్షించడం మరియు రక్షించుకోవడం కోసం పోరాటంలో రిజర్వేషన్ల విధానానికి అనుకూలంగా భారతదేశంలో అభ్యుదయవాద అభిప్రాయాన్ని సున్నితంగా విశ్లేషించి, వాదనాత్మక సాధనాలను అందించిన మొదటి మరియు అగ్రగామి బాలగోపాల్. భారతదేశంలో కుల/మత ఆధారిత 'రిజర్వేషన్ల' గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

ही--वाट-दूर-जाते.title: Hi Vaat door Jate
ही--वाट-दूर-जाते.description: अनुश्री आज बँकेतून जरा लवकरच घरी आली... लवकर येणार तो दिवस स्वतःसाठी द्यायचा हे तिने ठरवलं होतं... आज उगाच तिला मनातून उदास वाटत होत... गाणी ऐकताना स्वताचे जुने अल्बम चालत असताना तिला तिचाच एक जुना फोटो सापडतो जो बघून तिला असे वाटते ती पार बदलली आहे..

pather-daabi.title: Pather Daabi
pather-daabi.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Our shows celebrate love in all its forms from the first flutter of attraction to the deep bonds that withstand the test of time. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

karala-garbha.title: Karala Garbha
karala-garbha.description: ಪತ್ತೇದಾರ ವಿಜಯ್ ದೇಶಪಾಂಡೆಗೆ, ಖ್ಯಾತ ಕಿರುತೆರೆ ನಟಿ‌ ಮೃದುಲಾ ಹೊಸಮನಿ ತನಗದ ಜನ್ಮ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ತಂದೆ-ತಾಯಿಯನ್ನ ಹುಡುಕಿಕೊಡೋ‌ ಕೆಲಸ ವಹಿಸ್ತಾಳೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ 35 ವರ್ಷದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಆಕೆಯನ್ನ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ದತ್ತು ಕೊಟ್ಟವರನ್ನ ಅರಸಿ ಕರಾವಳಿಗೆ ಹೊರಟ ವಿಜಯ್ ಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ್ದು ಕೊಲೆ ಬೆದರಿಕೆಯ ಬಳುವಳಿ! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಮೃದುಲಾ ಜನ್ಮ ರಹಸ್ಯವೇನು? ಕೊಲೆ ಸಂಚಿನ ಹಿಂದಿರೋ ಆ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಾರು? ಇದಕ್ಕೆಲ್ಲಾ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನ ವಿಜಯ್ ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ತಾನಾ? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕ 'ನಾಗೇಶ್ ಕುಮಾರ್ ಸಿ. ಎಸ್' ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರೋ ರೋಚಕ ಕಥೆ 'ಕರಾಳ ಗರ್ಭ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ!

empower-your-mornings.title: Empower Your Mornings
empower-your-mornings.description: നേരത്തെ എഴുന്നേല്‍ക്കുന്നതിൽ ഇപ്പോഴും മടി ഉള്ളവരാണോ നിങ്ങൾ??അലസതയോടെയും നിരാശയോടെയും ഒരു ദിവസം തുടങ്ങുന്നത് മാറ്റി ഒരു അടിപൊളി ദിവസം തുടങ്ങാൻ ഇതാ ചില പൊടിക്കൈകൾ...

nayanmargal-3.title: Nayanmargal - Part 3
nayanmargal-3.description: hindhu kadavul shivavai vazhipattu 3-8 century ce la vazhndha 63 pulavargal/thuravigalaana nayanmaargalai patriya pathivu

iyal-isai-nadagam-andru-mudhal-indru-var.title: Iyal Isai Nadagam Andru Mudhal Indru Varai
iyal-isai-nadagam-andru-mudhal-indru-var.description: Thamizh Koorum Nal ulagukku Muthamizhin Varalaatrai Perumaiyudan Samarpikkiradhu ungal Kuku FM. Ippadhivin Moolam Thamizhannaiyin Seer Ilamaiyai Thiram Viyandhu Potruvom, Vaarungal !

agalya.title: அகல்யா
agalya.description: அகல்யா கணவனை இழந்தவள். அவளை மணக்க விருப்பம் தெரிவிக்கும் சிவசு. அகல்யாவுக்கு சிறார் பள்ளி நடத்த ஆசை. சிவசுவுக்கு சமூக சேவை செய்ய ஆர்வம். இவர்களின் மணவாழ்க்கை எவ்வாறு அமைகிறது என்பதை உணர்ச்சிக்காவியமாய் சொல்லும் கதை அகல்யா.

yelu.title: ಏಳು
yelu.description: "ಏಳು" ಎಂಬ ಕುತೂಹಲಕಾರಿ ಕಥೆಯು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಹದನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುವ ಭಯಾನಕ ಮನಃಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಕತೆ. ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಆಂತರಿಕ ಹೋರಾಟ, ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಅನಿಸಿಕೆಗಳ ಉದ್ದೇಶವನ್ನು ಕುರಿತು ಬೆಳಕು ಚೆಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ನಾಯಿ, ಒಂದು ರಾತ್ರಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಶಂಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದ ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಜೀವನದ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನು ತುಂಬಿ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ವಿಶೇಷ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

cashless-opd-insurance.title: Cashless OPD Insurance
cashless-opd-insurance.description: Janiye OPD Insurance se aapke Medical kharche kaise kam ho sakte hain aur kyu har parivaar ke liye kyun zaroori hai OPD Insurance.

dost-jeetne-ke-10-tarike.title: Your friendship guide
dost-jeetne-ke-10-tarike.description: How to Win Friends and Influence People, 1936 mein prakashit  Dale Carnegie dvara likhit ek swa-sahayata pustak hai. duniya bhar mein 30 million se adhik copies bik chuke hain, jisse yeh ab tak ke sabse adhik bikne wale pustakon mein se ek ban gayi hai. 2011 mein Time Magazine ke 100 sabse prabhavashali kitabon ke suchi mein yah 19 number par tha. Iske audio coursebook abhi sunen!

why-same-sex-marriage-is-frowned-upon.title: Why Same-Sex Marriage Is Frowned Upon?
why-same-sex-marriage-is-frowned-upon.description: Samoohyaparamayi munnilanennu avakashappedunna oru janatha enthinanu eppozhum swavarga vivahathe ethirukkunnathu allenkil bhayappedunnathu? Ee ethirppu swavarga vivahathe allenkil swavarga pranayathe chuttipattiyulla abadhadhaaranakal karanamakam. Ethine marikkadakkan orotta margameyullu. Janangalkku edayil swavarga vivahathe sambhandhichu avabodham srishdikkuka ennathanu athu.

digantam.title: దిగంతం
digantam.description: "దిగంతం" కథనం ఆద్యంతం వినూత్నంగా ఉంటుంది. కథానాయకుడు అనుకోని పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకొని, అనేక సంఘటనలను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు. ఈ సంఘటనలు అతని జీవితంలో కీలక మార్పులు తీసుకువస్తాయి. అతని ప్రయాణంలో ప్రేమ, బాధ, ఆనందం, ఆశ, నిస్పృహ, విజయాలు, అపజయాలు వంటి అనేక భావోద్వేగాలు నడుస్తాయి.

red-sandalwood.title: BLOODWOOD HUNT
red-sandalwood.description: శేషాచలం అడవుల్లో ఎర్రచందనం స్మగ్లింగ్‌కు వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడే యువకుడు రంగడు, తన గ్రామం కోసం నిజాలు బయటపెట్టే ప్రయత్నంలో ప్రాణాలను పణంగా పెడతాడు. అంధకారపు అడవుల్లోని తుపాకుల చప్పుళ్ల మధ్య, న్యాయం కోసం సాగిన ఇతని యాత్ర అనేక ఆవేదనల కథగా మారుతుంది.

Baba-Dharanand-धर्म-या-धंधा.title: Baba Dharanand: धर्म या धंधा?
Baba-Dharanand-धर्म-या-धंधा.description: Kya Baba Dharanand waqai dharm ke sacche margdarshak hain ya unke pravachanon ke peeche ek bada dhandha chhupa hai? Gareebon ke uddhar ke naam par chal rahe aashram ki asli sachchai ka khulasa karta yeh show, har episode mein suspense aur romanch se bhara ek naya raaz kholta hai. Abhi suniye yeh show aur jaanein kaise Baba apni shaktiyon ka galat istemaal kar rahe hain aur bhole bhakton ko apni chaal mein fansa rahe hain.

as-a-man-thinketh-kukubyte.title: As a Man Thinketh
as-a-man-thinketh-kukubyte.description:
Apni Soch se badlo Apni Zindagi
[International Bestseller]

indian-red-cross-society.title: Indian Red Cross Society
indian-red-cross-society.description: Ekkadithe Help Avasaram untundi Akkada Red Cross Untundi, Edaina Natural disasters leda road accident lo blood need unnavaariki ee red cross society help cheyadaniki mundu untundi. Ee Samstha International ga chala deshallo tana sevalanu andistundi. Alage India lo kuda Indian red cross socity tho sevalanu andistundi. Ee red cross socity ela puttindi, evaru start chesaru , inka ee red cross sevala gurinchi Ee Audio book lo vini telusukoni Apadalo Unnavariki Meeruu Sahayam Andinchandi.

तुम-ही-आना-.title: Tum Hi Aana
तुम-ही-आना-.description: देवों की भूमि बनारस और उसी भूमि पर जन्मी एक प्रेम कहानी, यह प्रेम कहानी तो थी पर एक तरफा थी, इंसान अपने सपने को पूरा करने की जिद में इस कदर और इस हद तक गिर जाता है कि उसे दूसरों के दुख तकलीफों का एहसास होना बंद हो जाता है, कुछ ऐसा ही हुआ था इस प्रेम कहानी में ,पंडित अंबर शास्त्री जो कि बनारस के अस्सी घाट पर पूजा पाठ करके अपना जीवन यापन करता था और एक गरीब इंसान था, अंबर को प्यार हो जाता है एक अमीर लड़की अवनी अग्रवाल से जो एक सिंगर बनने का सपना अपने दिल मे लिए घूम रही है,और यह प्यार कोई ऐसा वैसा प्यार नहीं था ,जब अंबर पहली बार अवनी को देखता है तभी उसे अपना दिल दे बैठता है और उसके लिए अपनी जान भी खतरे में डालता है पर क्या अवनी भी अंबर को उस हद तक प्यार कर सकती है जिस हद तक अंबर अवनी को करता है...? क्या अंबर को अपना प्यार मिल पाएगा...? क्या अंबर अपने प्यार का इजहार अवनी से कर पाएगा ...? और क्या अवनी अंबर के प्यार को अपना लेगी...? क्या अवनी अपने सपनों को भुलाकर अंबर से प्यार करने लगेगी ...? या फिर अवनी के मन में और कुछ चल रहा है...? इन सब सवालों के जवाब के लिए आप सुनिए लकी शर्मा द्वारा लिखित एक अद्भुत प्रेम कहानी जिसका नाम है तुम ही आना एफ एम पर...!!!

em-cheppayee-vedhaalu.title: ఏం చెప్పాయి వేదాలు ?
em-cheppayee-vedhaalu.description: "ఏం చెప్పాయి వేదాలు" అనే ఆడియో పుస్తకంలో రంగనాయకమ్మ గారు వేదాలను సున్నితంగా, విశ్లేషణాత్మకంగా విమర్శిస్తూ మానవీయ కోణంలో పరిశీలిస్తారు. వేదాలు, వాటి వచనాలు, మతపరమైన భావనలను సమాజపరంగా, సాంఘికంగా ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తున్నాయో తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? ఆమె వేదాలను కేవలం మత గ్రంథాలుగా కాకుండా, సామాజిక సంబంధాలను మార్గనిర్దేశం చేసే పద్ధతిగా చూడటం, వాటి నుంచి వచ్చిన అనేక సాంప్రదాయాలపై ప్రశ్నించటం ఈ ఆడియో పుస్తకంలో ముఖ్యాంశం.

khudiram-ek-spordhar-naam.title: Khudiram : Ek Spordhar Naam

rakshak-shadow-of-kaalashm.title: Rakshak : Shadow Of Kaalashm
rakshak-shadow-of-kaalashm.description: ये कहानी है आर्यव की... एक ऐसे योद्धा की, जिसकी किस्मत दो हज़ार साल पुराने शाप से जुड़ी हुई है। जब रहस्यमयी जादुई पत्थर 'कालाश्म' दोबारा जागता है, तो उसके साथ लौट आती है एक ऐसी साज़िश, जो पूरे राज्य को तबाह कर सकती है। अपने पिता पर लगे गद्दारी के दाग, राजमहल के खौफनाक रहस्यों और अपनी रहस्यमयी शक्तियों के बीच फँसा आर्यव क्या सच तक पहुँच पाएगा... या कालाश्म की शैतानी ताकत सब कुछ निगल जाएगी?

droupadi-murmu.title: Droupadi Murmu
droupadi-murmu.description: Oka Tribal women  BharathaDesha RashtraPathi Ayindi Ani Vinagane meeku Emanipinchindi? 2022 lo Idi Possible Anipinchi undochu, but 10 years back situations emiti? India’s 15th President ga Ame Ennika Oka Celebration Matrame Kaadu. Prapanchavyapthamga unna Entho Mandi Mahilalaku Oka Sporthi ni Ichindi. Prathibha Patil Tarwatha Ee Position ni Chepattina Second Women and First  Tribal Women Ee Droupadi Murmu. Anthe Kakunda Swatantryam VAchhina Tarwatha Present Padavini Adirohinchina Yougenst Women Kuda.  But Ee Journey antha easy ga jaragaledu. aariwa.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

bs-turn-setbacks-into-greenbacks.description: Kehte hai ki zindagi mein aayi takleefon ko avsar mein badalna chahiye. Magar kya ye karna itna aasan hai? Hamare saath hi aisa kyun hota hai, kya is khayal se bachkar aage badh paana mumkin hai? Kaise failures ko maat dekar sahi rasta chunein? Jaane ye sabhi baate is show mein

old-regime-vs-new-regime.description: Old Regime and New regime, ee rendu vinte evarikaina gurthuochedi Income Tax. meelo entha mandhiki veeti madya differences telusu? edi choose chesukunte meeru Income tax lo dabbu adha cheyagalgutharu? ila  kotha Income tax rules gurinchi enno vishyalu telusukondi ee audio book vini.

story-of-indias-2007-t20-cricket-world-c.title: Story Of India's 2007 T20 Cricket World Cup Victory
story-of-indias-2007-t20-cricket-world-c.description: మన అందరికి గుర్తిండిపోయే ఒక జ్ఞాపకం ఏంటో చెప్పాలా? అదే అండి మన టీం ఇండియా క్రికెట్ జట్టు 2007 లో గెలిచిన ట్వంటీ ట్వంటీ వరల్డ్ కప్. ఆ విజయాన్ని ఎవరు మర్చిపోతారు? రండి ఇప్పుడు మనం ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ ద్వారా ఆ జ్ఞాపకాలని తిరిగి గుర్తుకు తెచ్చుకుందాం .

mahanaya-alexander.description: ലോകം കീഴടക്കിയ അലക്സാണ്ടർ ചക്രവർത്തിയുടെ  കഥ! ഗ്രീക്ക് സാഹിത്യ ഇതിഹാസം കസാൻദ്സാകീസ് രചിച്ച ചരിത്ര നോവൽ, പ്രൊഫസർ അലിയാറിന്റെ മാസ്മരിക ശബ്ദത്തിലൂടെ ആസ്വദിക്കൂ!

my-journey-transforming-dreams-into-acti.title: My Journey: Transforming Dreams into Actions
my-journey-transforming-dreams-into-acti.description: Dr. Kalaaminte Prashasthamaya  'My Journey: Transforming Dreams into Actions "  Enna Pusthakamaanu Innathey Kuku Bytesil Charcha Cheyyunathu. Ethoru Saadharanakkaranum Athishayippikkunna Jeevitha Vijayangal Nedaanulla Rahasya Thanthrangal Ee Episodukalil Ningalkku Kelkkaan Saadhikkum.

ai-ningalude-joliye-badhikkumo.title: AI Ningalude Joliye Badhikkumo?
ai-ningalude-joliye-badhikkumo.description: Artificial Intelligencinte aavirbhavathinteyum vikasathinteyum parinamathinteyum falamayi sameepa bhaviyil sankethika vidhya nammude ellavarudeyum jolikaleyum prathisandhiyil aakum enna aasanka vardhich varikayanu. Enthellamaanu ee aasankayude adisthanam. Sharikkum AI Sankethika vidhya manushyanu velluvili uyarthumo. Kettariyam ee bytesilude.

kibhabe-youtube-ba-insta-star-hobe.title: Kibhabe Youtube Ba Insta Star Hobe?
kibhabe-youtube-ba-insta-star-hobe.description: Apni kono financial advice chan, fashion hacks jante chan, ba cooking sommondhye ba onnyo kichu, shob kichur jonnoi ekhon one step solution hochhe digital platforms jemon youtube ba onnyo kono social media platform. Kothaye ache, "You never get bored with Youtube", ar ekhon amader personal ba professional life chharao digital life ache. Apnar talent hok ba business apni tao youtube e promote korte paren. Youtube ke ditiyo brihottoro search engine hishebe jana geche. tahole ki apnio bhabchen Youtube ba instagram e nijer career toiri korben? Tahole ar beshi deri kora thik hobe na. Ekhoni shune nin ei audiostory ti, shune nin ar jene nin ki ki bhabe youtube ba instagram theke aye korben ar safolyo orjon korben.

be-your-own-sun-shine.title: Be Your Own Sun Shine
be-your-own-sun-shine.description: Alochanalu manishiki entho mukhyam. Mana alochanalanu ela upayoginchali, Mana alochanalu mana jivitham meeda ela prabhavam chuputhayi. Alochanala dvaarane manishiki santhosham, Anandam labhisthundani miku thelusa. Manchi alochanala dvaara meeru bhoomi meedane swargam nirminchukovachu. Manchi alochanalu cheyyandi, Mee alochanalu meeru alochisthane vasthayi avi ekkadi nundo oodipadavu. Anduke manchi alochanalu cheyyandi mee jivithanni anandabharitham, Sukhavanthamga cheskondi.

disha-case-act-2021.title: Disha Case & Act 2021
disha-case-act-2021.description: Disha case, ee rape case Deshani motam vanikinchidi, oka ammaayakuralaina ammayi ni kondaru istam vachinatu rape chesi kalichi velipoyaru. ilanti vallu entho mandhi inka mana chuttu tirguthune unaru alanti valla kosame government pravshepetinde ee act. Asalu aa roju emi jargindi ameki enduku ala jargindi, a taruvatha government elanti nirnayalu tesukundi, mahilalanu rakshinchadaniki elanti cheryalu tesukundi ilanti aneka vishyalu gurinchi meeru ee audio book lo telusukovachu.

the-royal-affair.title: The Royal Affair
the-royal-affair.description: Alisha, ek brilliant hacker, jab Yatharth ke dhokhe aur Mihika ke chaalon ka shikaar banti hai, uski duniya bikhar jaati hai. Yatharth bina sach jaane Alisha ka bharosa tod deta hai, aur usse us waqt akela chhod deta hai jab use sabse zyada uski zarurat thi. Jab maut ke saamne Alisha apne asli raaz se rubaroo hoti hai, toh apne hone wale bachhe ko bachane aur apni khud ki pehchaan paane ke liye ek nayi ladaai shuru hoti hai. Kya Yatharth apni galti ka saboot mitaa paayega? Kya Alisha apne liye ek nayi zindagi chunegi ya Yatharth ke paas chali jaegi?

passive-income-er-sohoj-upay.title: Passive Income Er Sohoj Upay
passive-income-er-sohoj-upay.description: 2023 eshe geche, new year resolutions to sobai niyechilo,kintu tarpor?  Dheere dheere shegulor proti commitment kome esheche toh? Ete kintu apnar kono dosh nei, etai hoye thake. Kintu erokom e hote thakle 2023 e apnar bhagyer khub ekta poriborton asbe na. Apnara nischoi apnader priyo youtuber der vlog dekhen, koto darun darun jayega ghure berachhen tara, koto taka kamchhen tara. Apnarao nischoi chan bhalo bhabe jibon e bachte, bilash bohul bhabe thakte, tahole ar deri na kore, jene nin ki ki bhabe passive income korle, ba sonchoy korle apnio nijer priyo youtuber der moto bilash bohul jibon katate parben.

|Key Points- Awareness, Imagination & Thought Influence|
Iss show mein hum baat karenge ki kaise hamara mind hamari daily life ko shape deta hai. Janein ki apki soch apke actions aur emotions ko kaise control karti hai aur kaise aap iss knowledge ko use kar ke apni life ko behtar bana sakte hain.
