chengalva-poodanda.title: చెంగల్వ పూదండ
chengalva-poodanda.description: ఓ యువకుడు అన్యాయంగా, సమాజంలోని దుష్టశక్తుల కుట్రకు జైలు పాలయ్యాడు. అక్కడే ఒక మహోన్నత విప్లవ మూర్తి తారసపడి సమాజం గురించి విప్లవాల గురించి సమగ్రంగా నూరి పోసి అతడిని చైతన్యవంతుడ్ని చేశాడు. తరువాత జైలు నుంచి విడుదలై వచ్చాక అతడు ఏం చేశాడో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? వెంటనే ‘చెంగల్వ పూదండ’  ఆడియో వినండి.

dele-de-corpo-e-alma.title: Dele, de Corpo e Alma
dele-de-corpo-e-alma.description: Nascido sob a Lua Partida, Ethan Vale esconde um segredo: ele é um Devorador de Almas, um ser proibido que consome magia, almas e memórias. Por anos, um bracelete conteve seus poderes. Mas na Academia da Meia-Noite, sua verdadeira natureza desperta. Quando Violet Asta, uma duelista prodígio, vê Ethan devorar a alma de um monstro, ela precisa escolher: proteger o segredo mortal dele ou o mundo mágico que jurou destruí-lo.

marcos-republic-day.title: MARCOS: Republic day
marcos-republic-day.description: Ek anokha vidhvansakari hathiyar jise China mein banakar Australia ke raaste aise anokhe tareeke se India laya gaya ki kisi ko uski bhanak tak na lagi. Aur yeh sab kiya gaya India ke Republic Day par bhayanak tabahi machane ke liye... lekin us tabahi aur us bhayanak hathiyar ke beech mein aa khada hua Marcos Commando Virat. Phir kya hua? Jaanne ke liye suniye jabardast deshbhakti aur jasoosi se bhari yeh kahani Marcos Republic Day sirf kuku FM par!

theranos.title: Theranos
theranos.description: Aj ka waqt startup's ka waqt hai, aj startup industry badi tezi sae boom kar rahe hai, or aisa hi ek startup tha Theranos, jisne duniya ko chaunkaya bhi or ek bahut bada scam bhi diya. Iss startup ki founder Elizabeth Holmes ki chah nae unhe arsh sae farash par la giraya, par kya tha ye startup or kaisa bana ye duniya ka ek sabse bada medical scam, to ye janne kae liye sunte hain Theranos ki kahani.

meerabai-krishnana-paramabhakte.title: Meerabai: Krishnana Paramabhakte
meerabai-krishnana-paramabhakte.description: ಶ್ರದ್ಧೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭಕ್ತಿ ಅನ್ನೋ ವಿಚಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತೀಯ ನೆಲದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳು ಚರಿತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಗಮನಾರ್ಹ ಅಂಶಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ಅದರಲ್ಲೂ ತುಳಸೀದಾಸ, ಕಬೀರ, ಬಸವಣ್ಣರಂತಹ ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಮಾಡಿದ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳು ನಮ್ಮ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸವನ್ನ ಗಟ್ಟಿಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಂತಹ ಅಗ್ರಜರ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀರಾಬಾಯಿ ಕೂಡ ಒಬ್ಬರು! ರಾಜಸ್ಥಾನದ ರಾಜಮನೆತನದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಮೀರಾಬಾಯಿ ಲೌಕಿಕ ಸುಖಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿ ಹೋಗದೇ, ಶ್ರದ್ಧೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭಕ್ತಿಯ ಮೊರೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದು ಎಂಥವರಿಗೂ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿದಾಯಕವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಭಗವಾನ್‌ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಪರಮಭಕ್ತೆ ಮೀರಾಬಾಯಿಯ ಭಜನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಜ್ಞಾನವು ಪ್ರಸಕ್ತ ಕಾಲಘಟ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಅನ್ವಯಯಾಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅತಿಶಯೋಕ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲ. ಕೃಷ್ಣಭಕ್ತೆ ಮೀರಾಳ ಜೀವನ, ಭಕ್ತಿಮಾರ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ಅವರ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಜ್ಞಾನದ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಸುಂದರ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "ಮೀರಾಬಾಯಿ: ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಪರಮಭಕ್ತೆ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

blood-hunt-1.title: Blood Hunt
blood-hunt-1.description: Delhi mein achanak se 6-14 age group ke bacche gayab hone lagte hai. Jab unki dead body milti hai to bus unke pure sharir se blood nikala huva rehta hai. Aur unki body per triangle ka mark bana hota hai. Akhir kaun kar rha hai ye sab? Delhi police bhi nakam hai iss case ko solve karne mein. to phir kaise hoga iss crime ka khulasa? Kaun hai in sab ke piche aur kyu masum baccho ki zindagi se khel rha hai? janane ke liye sune puri kahani 'Blood Hunt' sirf Kuku FM per.

amargarh-ka-chhupa-yodha.title: Amargarh Ka Chhupa Yodha
amargarh-ka-chhupa-yodha.description:
When a demon army attacks Amargarh, a seemingly ordinary village boy becomes its last hope.
Trained by a rishi, Gaurav can channel divine energy powerful enough to destroy demons.
But his first real battle forces him to confront the self-doubt threatening his strength.
With innocent lives at stake, he must unleash his power and rise as Amargarh’s hidden warrior.

ef3964ca-1373-4712-9774-690c9a3dba07.title: The Commissioner’s Secret
ef3964ca-1373-4712-9774-690c9a3dba07.description: காவல் கமிஷனரான தன் தந்தையின் அறையில் கிடைத்த ரகசிய லாக்புக், அனன்யாவின் உலகையே தலைகீழாக மாற்றுகிறது. துறைமுகக் கடத்தல், கறுப்புப் பணம், கொலை என தந்தையின் இருண்ட சாம்ராஜ்யம் வெளிவர, அவரது மரணத்திற்குப் பிறகு அனன்யாவும் அந்த சதிவலையில் சிக்குகிறாள். உண்மையை கண்டுபிடிக்க அவள் போராடும் நேரத்தில், காதலும் பழிவாங்கலும் அவளது வாழ்க்கையை மாற்றுகின்றன.

कैसे-करें-दीवाली-पूजन-.title: Kaise karein Lakshmi Pujan?
कैसे-करें-दीवाली-पूजन-.description: Diwali par sabhi ke man mein jo sawal ghar kar raha hota hai woh hai Lakshmi Pujan karne ki sahi vidhi. Sabhi chahte hai ki us din unse koi bhi aisi bhool na ho, jiski wajah se Lakshmi Mata unse naraz ho jaaye. Aapke man ke isi sawal ka jawab aur aapki pareshani ke hal ke roop mein hum lekar aaye hai yeh audiobook. Jise sunne ke baad aapko Lakshmi Pujan se judi kahaniyan, unki pujan vidhi aur unka mahattva sabki jankari milegi. Aaiye shuru karte hai yeh safar!!

nyayanga-vyavasthe-12-failure-stories.title: Nyayanga Vyavasthe: 12 Failure Stories
nyayanga-vyavasthe-12-failure-stories.description: ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವವನ್ನ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾದ ಭಾರತ ದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಂಗ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯು ಕಾನೂನಿನ ರಕ್ಷಕನಾಗಿ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅಂತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ನಮ್ಮ ಭಾರತ ದೇಶವು ಕಾನೂನು ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಡವಿದ ನಿದರ್ಶನಗಳು ಸಾಕಷ್ಟಿವೆ. ಅಪರಾಧ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೊಂದವರಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಸಿಗದೇ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಕೇಸ್‌ಗಳು ಬಾಕಿ ಉಳಿದಿರೋದು ದುರದೃಷ್ಟಕರ. ಈ ಕುರಿತ ಅಂಕಿ-ಅಂಶಗಳು ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಲೇ ಇವೆ. ಅವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದೇಶವನ್ನೇ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸಿದ ಕೆಲವು ಹೀನ ಅಪರಾಧಗಳನ್ನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಂಗ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯು ವಿಫಲವಾದುದರ ಕುರಿತು ಈ ಸಂಚಿಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕಾನೂನು ಸುವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಹದಗೆಟ್ಟಾಗ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಂಗವು ಹೇಗೆ ಬಲಹೀನವಾಗುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಕುರಿತ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "ನ್ಯಾಯಾಂಗ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ: 12 Failure Stories" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

srimad-bhagavatam.title: Srimad Bhagavatham
srimad-bhagavatam.description: Bhagavatham Hindu puranalalo sampradayalalo, Sahithyam lo, alochana vidhanam lo mukhyamaina prabhavam kaligina oka puranam. Bhagavanthuni leelamruthamgaa, Sharanaagathulaina bhakthula gathaga, Bhakthi yogaanni chaati cheppe prachina granthamga prasiddhi chendindi. Pradhanamga Krishnudi leelau, Srihari avatharala gurinchi ee granthamlo untayi.

അപസര്‍പ്പകന്‍.title: അപസര്‍പ്പകന്‍
അപസര്‍പ്പകന്‍.description: അറുപത്തിയാറു അംഗങ്ങള്‍ മാത്രമുള്ള ഒരു രഹസ്യ സംഘടനയുടെ തലപ്പത്ത് അവിചാരിതമായി എത്തിപ്പെട്ടപ്പോള്‍ മുതലാണ് അനില്‍ ശ്രീനിവാസ് തന്റെ ജീവന് ഭീക്ഷണി ഉണ്ടെന്ന വസ്തുത തിരിച്ചറിയുന്നത്. തന്റെ സീക്രട്ട് ഗ്രൂപ്പിന്റെ പൂര്‍വ്വകാല രഹസ്യങ്ങള്‍ കണ്ടെത്തുവാനായി അയാള്‍ റിസ് വാന്‍ ഖാന്‍ എന്ന അപസര്‍പ്പകന്റെ സഹായം തേടുന്നു.

सर्जिकल-स्ट्राइक--लेखक--अमित-खान.title: सर्जिकल स्ट्राइक
सर्जिकल-स्ट्राइक--लेखक--अमित-खान.description: Sultan Fauji- Ek Kashmir Atakwadi. Usne Mumbai mei ek badi Atakwadi ghatna ko anjaam diya, Jisme Sekdorh Nirdosh mare gaie. Sultan Fauji Pakda gaya. Ek itihasik fesla mei usse 26 January ke din Fasi ki Saaja Di jaani thi, Taaki puri duniya dekhti ki hum Deshdrohi ke saath kya karte hei. Lekin Usse pehle hi sultan faugi jail todkar Pakistan bhaag Nikla. Tab yah mission saopa gaya Commander Karan Saxena Ko. Commander jisne Sultan Fauji ko pakistan mei hi ghuskar maara. Waahi apne haatho se fasi ki saaja di usse

autobiography-of-benjamin-franklin.title: The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin
autobiography-of-benjamin-franklin.description: Duniya ke sabse influential logon mein se ek Benjamin Franklin ki autobiography mein suniye kaise bane wo ek humble press worker se United States of America ke founding father, scientist, philosopher aur, aur bhi bahut kuch, unke apne words mein. Ye kahani hai seekhne ki, khud par bharosa karne ki aur bade se bhi bade sapne sach kar dikhane ki!

ishqbaaz-major.title: Ishqbaaz Major
ishqbaaz-major.description: 23 June 2018, dopeher 1 bajkar 28 minute par dilli chawni ilaake ke pass sadak par ek khoobsurat mahila khoon se lathpath milti hai aur phir wahaan se shuru hota hai junooni ishq aur maut ka khel. fauji afsar ki patni, ektarfa pyaar aur shaadishuda major ki khooni mohabbat. Abhi suniye is qatl ki poori daastaan sirf Kuku FM par!

irattai-kuzhandhaigal.title: Irattai Kuzhandhaigal
irattai-kuzhandhaigal.description: பதினைந்து ஆண்டுகள் குழந்தைக்காக காத்திருந்த ராஜ் மற்றும் பிரியா, IVF சிகிச்சையின் மூலம் இரட்டைக் குழந்தைகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள். ஆனால் ஆறு மாதங்களுக்குப் பிறகு ஒரு தாயின் சந்தேகம் DNA பரிசோதனைக்கு வழிவகுக்கிறது. அந்த முடிவு, இரண்டு குழந்தைகளும் அவர்களுடையதல்ல... அதுமட்டுமல்ல, அந்த இரு குழந்தைகளும் ஒருவருக்கொருவர் இரட்டையர்களே இல்லை என்ற அதிர்ச்சி உண்மையை வெளிக்கொண்டு வருகிறது. உண்மையைத் தேடும் அவர்கள், ஒரு பிரபல IVF மருத்துவமனையின் பின்னால் மறைந்திருக்கும் கொடூரமான சதியை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்கள்.

broadcast-24.title: Broadcast 24
broadcast-24.description: A suspended cop discovers a mysterious radio that broadcasts crimes exactly 24 hours before they happen. At first, Ranvijay uses this impossible power to save lives and stop criminals. But every change he makes creates a deadly new future. Now the radio predicts his wife Meera’s murder—and names Ranvijay himself as the killer. With only 24 hours to stop the future, can he defeat a fate that already knows his every move?

good-vibes-good-life-2.title: Good Vibes Good Life
good-vibes-good-life-2.description: ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಮನೋಭಾವದಿಂದ ಉತ್ತಮ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ ನಿಮಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣಾ ಶಕ್ತಿಯ ಸುರಿಮಳೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ತರಲು ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಚಿಂತನೆ, ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಆಂತರಿಕ ಶಾಂತಿಯನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸುವ ದಾರಿಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ. Good Vibes, Good Life ಮೂಲಕ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಿ, ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ, ಸಂತೋಷಪೂರ್ಣ ಜೀವನ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವೆಂದು ಅನುಭವಿಸಬಹುದು. ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮದಿಂದ ದೇಹದಾರ್ಢ್ಯವರೆಗೂ, ಸಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಜೀವಿತದ ಮಾರ್ಗವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲು ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ!

autobiography-of-a-yogi-kuku-bytes.title: Autobiography of A Yogi
autobiography-of-a-yogi-kuku-bytes.description:
Mastering The Kriya Yoga - Paramhansa Yogananda
[Key Ideas Explained]


Full AudioBook -

accidental-chef.title: Accidental Chef
accidental-chef.description: Mushkil se apni behen ki fees aur maa ki dawaiyon ka intzam karne wali Simran ko ek din Desh ki sabse badi company Goenka Corporation ki malkin ek aisa offer deti hain jise wo thukra nahi paati hai – CEO Rihan Goenka ki Personal nutritionist banne ka offer. Lekin jab Simran wo job accept kar leti hai tab use pata chalta hai ki Rihan use sirf apni chef nahi balki apni girlfriend bhi banana chahta hai. Tabhi Simran ki life mein aata hai Varun, jise Simran bachpan se pyar karti hai. Ab kya karegi Simran, kya wo apne pyar Varun ko chunegi ya apni job ko, aur kaise niptegi wo apne khadoos boss Rihan se?

rakt-pralay.title: Rakt Pralay
rakt-pralay.description: Ek chhote gaav ke jungle mein kati-phati laashein mili, jahan police officer Ragini aur uska saathi Shaurya ek gehri jaanch mein utare. Tahqiqat ke dauraan samne aaya ki kuch prachin tanrik rakshas Brahmashirastra prapt karne ke liye laut chuke the. Ragini ka sambandh Devi Shakti ke roop se juda, aur uske andar ki divya shaktiyon ka rahasya khulne laga. Ek aisa yudh chhid gaya jahan manavta, vishwas aur shakti ke beech bhayanak takraav gaya. Kya Ragini apni asli pehchaan samajh paayegi? Kya woh rakshason se takraakar Brahmashirastra ko bachaa paayegi? Aur kya Shaurya uske saath ek sacha rakshak ban kar khada raha?

1113afa8-dc62-4c4d-860e-70e46d8daeb7.title: काशी का शास्त्रार्थ: आध्यात्मिक यात्रा-शंकराचार्य के पथ
1113afa8-dc62-4c4d-860e-70e46d8daeb7.description: Suniye Kashi ki galiyon mein chupi zabardast kahaniyan aur shaastraarth ki rochak ghatnayein. Jaanein Advait Vedant ke raaz aur moksh ki nagri mein Karan aur Vikram ke anubhav.

kiran-dutta-theke-the-bong-guy.title: Kiran Dutta Theke The Bong Guy
kiran-dutta-theke-the-bong-guy.description: Bangla ba Bangalir kache Kiran Dutta ba The Bong Guy name ta khub e porichito. Amader banglar khub e porichito ebong jonopriyo ekjon Youtuber jar journey ba protibhar golpo bole ba likhe shesh kora shombhob noi. Ekhon science er student, engineering porashona korte korte ki kore ekjon successful youtuber hoye uthlen? Kiran Dutta Theke The Bong Guy hoye othar golpo jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

mahasamar-6-prachanna.title: Mahasamar 6: Prachanna
mahasamar-6-prachanna.description: Twelve years of exile are nearly over, but Duryodhan isn’t done. He plots to humiliate the Pandavas, and Jayadrath tries to abduct Draupadi. Then comes the hardest test: a full year in hiding at King Virat’s court, where one slip means another twelve years in exile. Bhim faces Keechak, Arjun fights as Brihannala, and the Kauravs march on Matsya. Mahasamar 6 is the story of heroes forced to hide who they are, until the moment they can’t anymore.

chamatkari-nadi.title: Chamatkari Nadi
chamatkari-nadi.description: Kya hai 1500 kilometre nadi ke, behte-behte achanak gayab hone ka rahasya? Kaise hua tha dharti par unka janm? Kya us nadi ke gayab hone ke picche hai koi pauranik shrap, ya hum jaisi manav jaati hai uski zimmedar? Sabhi sawalon ke jawab hai is audiobook mein!

argentina-1.title: Argentina
argentina-1.description: Loka footballinte bhoopadathil ennum samanathakal illatha peranu Argentina. Prathibha dharalitham kond football charithrathil aazhnnirangiya naadu. Maradonna, Messi ennee ithihasangaludeyum enniyal odungatha prathibhashalikalaya kalikkarudeyum naadu. Malayalikk Argentina ennal ayal veedu pole parichayam. Ariyam Argentinayude Football charithravum ariyaakadhakalum.

फिर-मुलाक़ात-होगी.title: Fir Mulaqaat Hogi
फिर-मुलाक़ात-होगी.description: Mumbai ke famous Medical College mein pyaar aur nafrat ke sath naye drame roz hi ho rahe hain. Jaha Arnika hai khubsurati aur ameeri ki misaal wahi Palak laa aa rahi hai uski zindagi mein bhuchaal. Par college president Aarav hai sabka saviour! Kya Palak ki nafrat ke aage khil payega Aarav aur Arnika ke pyaar ka phool?

sivagami-sabadham.title: Sivagami Sabadham
sivagami-sabadham.description: சிவகாமி சபதம் என்பது தொல்லியல், மறுபிறவி, காதல், வரலாறு மற்றும் மர்மம் கலந்த பிரம்மாண்டமான காதல்-த்ரில்லர். மாமல்லபுரத்தில் அகழ்வாராய்ச்சி மேற்கொள்ளும் தொல்லியலாளர் அஞ்சலிக்கு, தீப்பற்றி எரியும் பழங்காலக் கோவிலும் மர்மமான காப்பும் பற்றிய கனவுகள் தொடர்ந்து வருகின்றன. அந்தக் கனவுகளின் உண்மையைத் தேடும் அவளது பயணம், அதே நிலத்தில் ஆயிரம் கோடி ரூபாய் திட்டத்தை உருவாக்க நினைக்கும் தொழிலதிபர் விக்ரமுடன் மோதச் செய்கிறது.

ek-thug-ki-dastan.title: Ek Thug Ki Dastaan
ek-thug-ki-dastan.description: "Ek Thug ki Dastaan" ek aisi kahani hai jo aapko thriller aur adventure ke safar par le jaayegi aur fir sach ka saamana bhi karwayegi. Suniye ye audio show aur jaanein ek thug ki zindagi ke anokhe kisse aur uske daring escapades.Sirf Kuku FM par.

looser-lalit.title: Loser Lalit
looser-lalit.description: Lalit, ek bekaar aadmi, achanak ek doosre grah par pahuch jaata hai aur ek aise mission mein phans jaata hai jo usne kabhi nahi chuna. Ab, is nayi Zygons ki duniya mein, kya Lalit kuchh badlega, ya aur musibat mein phas jaayega apna Loser Lalit?

the-power-of-intention-3.title: The Power of Intention
the-power-of-intention-3.description: உங்க வெற்றிக் கனவுகள நெஜமா மாத்துறதுக்கான ரகசியம் இந்த Kuku Byte ல இருக்கு💭✨ வாங்க தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம்.🚀

vizhi-vazhiye-idhayam-niraindhai-1.title: விழி வழியே இதயம் நிறைந்தாய்
vizhi-vazhiye-idhayam-niraindhai-1.description: கருப்பாகப் பிறந்த ஒரே காரணத்தால் பெரும்பாலானவர்களால் ஒதுக்கப்படும் கதையின் நாயகியின் வாழ்க்கையில் எட்டிப்பார்க்கும் காதலும், அதன்பின் நடக்கும் சம்பவங்களும் தான் இந்தக் கதை...

shiva-brahmandada-yodha.title: Shiva : Brahmandada Yodha
shiva-brahmandada-yodha.description: ಅದು ಭೂಮಿಯಿಂದ ಸುಮಾರು 4 ಲಕ್ಷ ಬೆಳಕಿನ‌ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ಜಗತ್ತು.! ಅಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಹೊಸ ಗ್ರಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಟ್ಲಾಂಟಿಸ್ ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು.! ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಅಪರೂಪದ  ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಮಾನವರು ಜೀವಿಸ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿಗೊಂದು 'ರಾಯಲ್ ಅಕಾಡೆಮಿ' ಇದೆ. ಈ ರಾಯಲ್ ಅಕಾಡೆಮಿ ಶೌರ್ಯದ ಸಂಕೇತ.‌ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿ, ನಡೆಯೋ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆದ್ರೆ, ಇಡೀ ಅಟ್ಲಾಂಟಿಸ್ ಗ್ರಹದಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜಮರ್ಯಾದೆ! ಇದೇ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡ ಶಿವ ಈ ಕಾಂಪಿಟೇಷನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ‌ ವಿಶೇಷವಾದ ಬ್ಲಡ್ ಲೈನ್ ಸೀಕ್ರೆಟ್ ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತೆ! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಯಾರು ಈ ಶಿವ? ಇವನ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಎಂಥದ್ದು? ಕೇಳಿ ಸಖತ್ ಫ್ಯಾಂಟಸಿ ಸೀರೀಸ್ 'ಶಿವ : ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಂಡದ ಯೋಧ'! ಓನ್ಲಿ ಆನ್ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ.

khwaab.title: ఖ్వాబ్
khwaab.description: కథానాయకుడు తన జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సవాళ్లను, ప్రేమలోని మార్పులను, మరియు తన కలలపై సాధించే విజయాలను అద్భుతంగా వివరించారు. వెంటనే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "ఖ్వాబ్" అనే ప్రేమ కథను వినండి.

the-magic-of-faith.title: The Magic of Faith
the-magic-of-faith.description:
|Key Insights - Prayer, Manifestation, Faith|
Joseph Murphy ki iss khaas kitaab se jaanein aastha ki amulya taaqat ki aur banaaye apne aadhyaatmik jeevan ko aur bhi mazboot.

-അഴിയാക്കുരുക്കുകള്‍-കേരളാ-പോലീസിനെ-വലച്.title: അഴിയാക്കുരുക്കുകള്‍; കേരളാ പോലീസിനെ വലച്ച കേസുകള്‍ - Part 2
-അഴിയാക്കുരുക്കുകള്‍-കേരളാ-പോലീസിനെ-വലച്.description: എത്ര വലിയ ക്രൈമും കണ്ടുപിടിക്കുന്നതില്‍ ലോകത്തിലെ തന്നെ മികച്ച സംവിധാനങ്ങളിലൊന്നാണ് കേരള പൊലീസ്. എന്നാല്‍ പല കാരണങ്ങള്‍ കൊണ്ടും ചില കേസ്സുകള്‍ കേരള പോലീസിന് ഇന്നും അഴിയാക്കുരുക്കുകളാണ്. അത്തരം ചില കേസുകളുടെ ചരിത്രവും, നാള്‍വഴികളും, പിന്നാമ്പുറ കഥകളും കേള്‍ക്കാം, പ്രശസ്ത അവതാരകന്‍ പ്രൊഫ: അലിയാരുടെ ഘനഗംഭീര ശബ്ദത്തില്‍.

man-who-killed-100-children.title: Man Who Killed 100 Children
man-who-killed-100-children.description:
|Key Points- Serial Killer, Justice & Investigation| 
Pakistan ka ek aisa serial killer jo bachchon ko apna shikar banata tha, unke saath itni jyada batsalooki karta tha ki pakistan ki court ko aisi saza sunani padi jo kabhi nahi sunai thi.

magajastro-1.title: Magajastro
magajastro-1.description: ফেলু মিত্তিরের সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী অস্ত্র — তাঁর মগজ! বিজ্ঞান, ইতিহাস, সাহিত্য এবং ভূগোলের অজানা তথ্যে ভরপুর কৌশিক মজুমদারের "মগজাস্ত্র" পাঠকের মনকে জাগিয়ে তোলে। চোখ বন্ধ করে কান পাতুন — মগজের এক অসাধারণ যাত্রা শুরু হোক!

4bfb463d-599d-405b-84b8-6541da373e9c.title: Kismat Reloaded
4bfb463d-599d-405b-84b8-6541da373e9c.description: Mini begins as a reborn princess trying to adapt to an ordinary family life while working in a supply store, but her old memories make her unusually capable and hard to ignore. On her first day, she quickly spots a rice-shipment code mistake, and that early success earns her respect from the manager and coworkers. Her practical thinking later helps save the store through a sales-and-delivery plan that improves revenue. As Mini becomes more visible, admiration from some men is matched by jealousy from coworkers and pressure from a deputy director who keeps trying to pursue her. She rejects those advances and stays focused on work, which only increases the hostility around her. The workplace conflict turns into open sabotage, including a tea trap and a false theft-style accusation, but Mini repeatedly exposes the schemes and turns them back on her rivals. Her younger brother’s sudden collapse then pulls her away from the store and raises the emotional stakes at home. Lun Tai supports her through the hospital emergency and helps bring in top medical care, strengthening their bond. Jhao’s attempts to look heroic are exposed as fake, and his standing falls further. After her brother improves, Mini returns to work and faces a new round of public pressure through a hotel bedding shortage and a live-selling event. Tian Yao proves highly capable in these crises, and Mini grows more drawn to him, sensing a mysterious connection. Their teamwork also draws attention from Lun Tai, who watches their closeness with concern. Mini’s success in public sales makes her more famous, but that fame also deepens Bai Lily’s jealousy. A malicious complaint and other disruptions threaten the store, yet Mini uses official documents to clear the business and expose the sabotage. Jhao is punished and transferred away, but the conflict does not end there. A strange sci-fi turn brings an Alien Prince who proposes marriage, and Mini refuses him politely. That public moment makes her even more visible, which pushes Bai Lily and Director Zhao into a revenge plot. Mini is then kidnapped and held captive, and the story shifts into a rescue struggle as she tries to escape and others move to save her. By this point, Mini’s main stakes are no longer just work success, but protecting her reputation, her family, and her freedom while navigating several competing romantic paths.

maro-hiroshima.title: మరో హిరోషిమా
maro-hiroshima.description: Bruhaspathi Ane Telivaina oka Kurradini Tana Telivitetalu Tattukoleka intlonchi vellagottaru. Ala intlonchi vellina Bruhaspathi ki Adavilo Hatathuga Tanaku Poorva Janma Gurthukuvastundi. Poorva Janmalo Tanu Oka Bandipotu Dingaina Mangal Singh Ani telusukunnadu. Aa Rojullo Tanathopaatu dongatanalu chesina Mugguru Dongalu Ippudu Central Minister Ani Telusukunndu. Appudu Bruhaspathi Em chesadu? Present Political Situations pai Sarcastic Novel ey Ee “ Maro Hiroshima” most  Interesting Audioboook ni Kuku Fm Mana Munduku Teesukuvachindi.

the-dark-side-of-love.title: The Dark Side Of Love
the-dark-side-of-love.description: తన ప్రేమను నిజంగా అర్థం చేసుకునే వారిని కోల్పోయిన శివాని నిశ్చలమైన నవ్వుల వెనక దాచిన అనుభవాలు ఏవో వేదనగా మారాయి. ఓ అనుభవం ఆమెను నరకానికి తోలేసింది... చీకటి గదిలో మొదలైన ఒక అమాయక యువతికి జరిగిన భయంకరమైన సంఘటన. కుటుంబాన్ని కాపాడుకోవాలన్న తపనలో శివాని చేసిన త్యాగం

the-age-of-pandemics.title: The Age Of Pandemics
the-age-of-pandemics.description: 1817 se 1920 ke beech, India epicenter tha cholera, plague aur influenza jaise pandemics ka. 'The Age of Pandemics' aapko le jaayega un dino ke ehaaas mein, jab millions ne apni jaan gawaayi thi. Jaane kaise unse mili hui seekh aaj bhi COVID jaise challenges se nipatne mein madadgar ho sakti hai.

DraupadiKrishna-दोस्ती-प्रेम-या-प्रपंच.title: Draupadi-Krishna: दोस्ती, प्रेम या प्रपंच?
DraupadiKrishna-दोस्ती-प्रेम-या-प्रपंच.description: Kya Draupadi aur Krishna ka rishta dosti se badhkar tha? Is rehasya se parda uthega is show mein. Satyabhama ke sawaal aur Draupadi ke jawab mein chhipe hain kuch ankahe raaz, Jo prem aur mitrata ki seemaayein dhundhli karte hain aur indono ke rishte ko ek nayi paribhasha dete hain. Suniye aur samajhiye, Krishna aur Draupadi ke beech ke is anokhe bandhan ko!

son-of-the-thundercloud.title: Son of the Thundercloud
son-of-the-thundercloud.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

room-no-308.title: Room no. 308
room-no-308.description: When a stranded traveler checks into the mysterious Room No. 308 of an isolated hill lodge, he awakens to discover the room—and even the third floor—never existed. As terrifying secrets buried for twenty years begin to resurface, he must uncover the truth about his own identity before time traps him forever.

गोदान-.title: Godan
गोदान-.description: Ek kahani jo aaj bhi hum sabse man mein basi hai, jiska nayak hai Hori. Hori jo sahukar ke bojh se daba hai, kheti bhi rehan par rakhi hai lekin sab uska shoshan kar rhe hain. Kaise hua Hori ka ant aur fir Godan. sab bataya gaya hai Munsi premchand ke likhe is upanyas "Godan" mein. Jiski Audiobook le aaya hai KUKU Fm.

choose-your-destiny.title: Choose Your Destiny
choose-your-destiny.description: Namma Vithiyai namma thaan design pananum ! Unga fate ah productive aah maatha intha book ungalukku help pannum.

aankhein-the-blind-future.title: Aankhein: The Blind Future
aankhein-the-blind-future.description: Ek taraf hai mahamari aur dusri taraf hai bhaai ko khojne ki jimmedari. Aise mein Dr. Saina ne tay kar liya hai ki wo apne bhai ko khojne ke liye kisi bhi had tak jane ko taiyar hai, phir chahe unhe maujooda sarkar se hi kyon na ladna pade. Aise mein uski mulakat hoti hai Masha se jo Kurenai naam kii sanstha se judi hai. Kurenai ek lambe arse se sarkar ke khilaf jung lad rahi hai. Masha Saina ko batati hai ki ye bimari Kurenai ne hi phailayi hai aur is bimari ko khojne wala koi aur nahi balki uska bhai hi hai. Kya Masha sach bol rahi hai? Kya Saina ka masoom bhaai koi bimari khoj kar use mahamari bana sakta hai? Kya ye sab sach hai? Kaun si duniya ki kahani hai ye? Janne ke liye sunein “Aankhein: The Blind Future”

credit-card-traps.title: CREDIT CARD TRAPS
credit-card-traps.description: Credit cards aren't inherently bad. In fact, they can be powerful financial tools. But why do so many people fall into debt? This show explores the psychology behind spending, how credit card companies influence behavior, and how consumers can use credit intelligently.

serial-killer.title: Development Of A Serial Killer
serial-killer.description: Kabhi socha hai aisa kya beet ta hoga un logon ke saath jo bewajah katal krne pr utr aate hain ? Jaaniye Bharat aur duniya bhar ke Sainkdon Serial Killers ke baare mein aur jaaniye ke aakhir aisa kya tha unke mann mein jo unhe logon ko maarne par majboor krta tha. Suniye KukuFM Originals ‘Development of a Serial Killer’ sirf KuKuFM par. Step By Step Anatomy of Development of a Serial Killer

the-political-ideas-of-rabindranath-tago.title: The Political Ideas of Rabindranath Tagore
the-political-ideas-of-rabindranath-tago.description: "Rabindranath Tagore " ek naam jo sirf sahitya tak hi simit nahi hai. Unke vichar aaj bhi humein inspire karte hain, chahe wo ho rajneeti, samaj ya arthvyavastha. Is audio show mein hum Tagore ji ki liberal vichardhara ko samjhege, jo unhone apne essays aur patro mein vyakt kiya. Suniye aur jaaniye ki kaise Tagore ji ka yeh gyan aapki soch ko nayi disha de sakta hai."

phoenix.title: Phoenix
phoenix.description:
As per his grandfather's command, Surya hides his immense wealth and works as a call taxi driver in another state. He's drawn to the actions of Aarthi, a passenger in his car, and discovers she's from a poor family. Because of this, he keeps his true identity hidden from her. Meanwhile, his wealthy grandfather is searching for Surya, trying to figure out where he is.
Before marriage, Aarthi and Surya become intimate both emotionally and physically. Aarthi gets pregnant, and Surya loses consciousness in an accident, falling into a permanent coma. Did they ever unite? What happened to Aarthi's child? Did his grandfather find Surya?

what-are-mutual-funds-and-sip.title: What Are Mutual Funds And SIP
what-are-mutual-funds-and-sip.description: Podhuvaa nammala suthi irukkuravanga Mutual funds la invest pannunga, SIP plan panni irukeengala nu keppanga, adha pathi pesavum seivanga. Panatha invest panradhu nu varum podhu, enga namma pana pogudhu adhu endha murai la evalo return aagudhu nu therinjikkanum. Indha audio book la mutual funds and SIP pathi detailed ah kekkalam.

bhut-bongola.title: Bhut bongola
bhut-bongola.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

sales-leadership.title: Banein ek acche Sales Leader
sales-leadership.description: Imagine karein ki ek workplace hai...bina kisi dar, stress, ya chinta ke chal raha hai smoothly. Infact, aisi jagah jaha aap valued feel karte ho, jaha aapko khushi mile aur jo balanced life de. Ajeeb lag raha hai? Magar ye possible ho sakta hai aur kai organizations mein aisa hi hai. Magar Sales leaders ko ek alag tarah ke coaching ki zarurat hoti hai jo kahi nahi milti. Ye show aapko apne team ko kis tarah ki leadership deni chahiye, ye batayega.  Agar aapko "The Greatest Salesman In The World" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

shaurat.title: Shauhrat
shaurat.description: Kaamyabi haasil karne ke liye kis tarah kuch models kisi bhi had tak gir jaati hai, lekin galat raaste par chalkar kab tak khud se nazare mila payengi aise ladkiya? Ye kahani usi modeling ki duniya ki ek ladki ki hai jiska naam hai Akira, ek khubsoorat ladki jo ek mashhur model ban na chahti hai, par uske raaste mein hai kayi pareshaniya. Is kahani mein villain ki kami nahi hai, ek taraf hai ek paagal aashik, jo Akira ko har haal mein haasil karna chahta hai, uske alawa Akira ka dost Suraj, jo ki use pasand karta hai, lekin Akira ka hero toh koi aur hi hota hai. Is kahani mein aapko dekhne ko milega struggle, ek dusre ke prati jalan ki bhaavna, rishto ka maayajaal, pyaar mein pagal hue aashiqo ka alag alag roop, aur shoharat ke chakkar mein apne rishte aur parivar mein kis had tak neeche girkar log khatre mein aa jaate hai, inhi sab cheezo se bharpur kahani hai Shohrat. Kya Akira itni saari saajeesho ka Shikar hone ke baad bhi saphal ko payega? Kya Akiar ko apna pyaar mil jaayega? Sabhi sawaalo ke jawaab pane ki liye aap suniye Shohrat.

dharti-aaba-bhagwan-birsa-munda-1.title: Dharti Aaba: Bhagwan Birsa Munda
dharti-aaba-bhagwan-birsa-munda-1.description: 15 November 1875 ko janme Birsa Munda ne apni zindagi ko British Hukumat aur Zamindari Pratha ke khilaf aawaaz uthane mein samarpit kar diya tha. Jal, Jungle aur Zameen se bedakhal kiye jane ke bad bhi unhone kabhi haar nahi mani, balki apne atmavishwas aur himmat se har ladai ko jeet unhone na sirf khud ke leye balki apne sath jude har insaan ke leye uska future badal diya tha. Lekin kese bane Birsa Munda logo ke Dharti Aaba? kyun log aaj unhe “Bhagwan”Birsa Munda mante hai? Aur akhir kese ki thi unhone British Sarkaar par jeet hasil? perfect-house-the-affair.title: Forbidden Affair
perfect-house-the-affair.description: The show centers on a modern domestic romance where marriage, friendship, and old love keep colliding inside the same home. Sachin and Janvi are first presented as a warm couple, with small gestures, teasing, and shared routines suggesting a stable life. That stability is shaken when Kanishk appears unexpectedly, and Janvi’s immediate tension makes it clear that their past is not settled. Sachin tries to keep the household together, but Kanishk is pulled closer to the family space, turning a private issue into a constant emotional pressure. As the story continues, the couple’s affection is repeatedly tested by secrecy, hidden messages, and near-exposure moments that suggest Janvi is concealing something from Sachin. Their relationship remains intimate, but it is also marked by suspicion, hurt feelings, and the fear that old feelings may still have power. Sachin alternates between playful romance and suspicion, while Janvi tries to protect what she has now without fully reopening what was left behind. Kanishk keeps pressing for a renewed connection, but Janvi increasingly refuses to return to that past. The wider ensemble adds parallel tensions, including flirtation, boundary struggles, and other unresolved romantic histories that echo the main conflict. Some characters pursue love openly, while others hide their feelings or test each other through teasing and jealousy. The domestic setting keeps these emotions close to home, so even ordinary moments like breakfast or an anniversary become charged with mistrust. At one point, Sachin realizes Janvi forgot their anniversary, showing how affection and disappointment sit side by side. The show also introduces supportive friendships and practical help, especially around work and emotional reassurance, which briefly soften the tension. Yet those calmer moments do not erase the larger pattern of betrayal and divided loyalties. In the later stretch, the conflict sharpens into open confrontation when Sachin discovers Janvi’s affair with Kanishk. Janvi responds by rejecting Sachin’s claim on her and asserting control over the house, making the breakup feel both emotional and material. Across the batch digests, the central stakes remain clear: whether present commitments can survive the return of an abandoned past, and whether love in this household can outlast secrecy, resentment, and betrayal.

sidelining-my-point-guard-boyfriend.title: Sidelining My Point Guard Boyfriend

As her ex-boyfriend Jaxon faces regret and rivals plot her downfall, Avery fights to reclaim her confidence, dreams, and future—proving her worth goes far beyond appearances.

unakkul-naaney.description: மருத்துவ மாணவியான சாரு, தனது பேராசிரியர் விஜய்யுடன் ஒரு தீவிரமான காதலில் விழுகிறார். விஜய் வேறொரு பெண்ணை மணந்த புகைப்படத்தைக் கண்டுபிடிக்கும் போது அவர்களின் தீவிர உறவு முறிந்து விடுகிறது. மனம் உடைந்த அவள், நல்ல நடத்தை கொண்ட தொழிலதிபர் அதர்வாவை மணக்க தயக்கத்துடன் ஒப்புக்கொள்கிறாள், ஆனால் அவளுடைய உணர்ச்சி கொந்தளிப்புடன் போராடுகிறாள். இறுதியில், தொடர்ச்சியான நிகழ்வுகள் அவள் உணர்வுகளின் உண்மையை எதிர்கொள்ள வழிவகுக்கிறது, மேலும் விஜய் மீதான தனது அன்பின் ஆழத்தை உணர்ந்த அதர்வா, தன்னலமின்றி அவர்கள் மீண்டும் இணைவதற்கு உதவுகிறான் , அவள் உண்மையிலேயே விரும்பும் வாழ்க்கையைத் தொடர அனுமதிக்கிறான் .

duronto-dosyu.title: Duronto dosyu
duronto-dosyu.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

bharat-12-jyotirlinga.title: Bharatatil 12 Jyotirlinga
bharat-12-jyotirlinga.description: Devanche dev mahadev, jyanna veg veglya navane olakhla jaata, yancha hindu dharmat sarvat mahatvacha sthan ahe. pratyek hindu dharm granthat, puranat, yancha ullekh ahech. tumhi 12 jyotirlingan baddhal aikla aselach. pan he jyotirlinga nemke kase ani koni bandhle ? ya mage kahi scientific karne ahet ka ? he ani ase anek interesting facts apan ya show madhe aiknar ahot.

the-tech-phoenix-satyams-100-day-turnaro.title: The Tech Phoenix: Satyam's 100 - Day Turnaround
the-tech-phoenix-satyams-100-day-turnaro.description: Is audiobook mein, pehle toh hum dekhege kaise shuru hui thi yeh company aur phir uske andar chhupe raaz, jinka khulasa hua jab dhoka saamne aaya. Hum explore karenge uss samay ke challenges, revival ki koshisho ko, aur ant mein, hum janenge Satyam ke relaunch ko.

khomai-porom-sotyo.title: Khomai Porom Sotyo
khomai-porom-sotyo.description: Ei Prithibite Sob Manush Kichu Na Kichu Bondhone Bandha Hoye Aache. Kichu Bondhone Manush Mon Theke Bandha Pore Aabar Kichu Bondhon Golamir Bondhon. Mon Theke Pora Bondhone Manush Khushi Thake Kintu Golamir Bandhay Manush Mukti Chay. Sei Bandha Theke Beriye Keno Tara Mukti Chay? Sei Bondhon Theke Beriye Pranvore Swas Niye Kemon Anuvob Koren? Taderke Jara Golam Baniye Rekhechilo Tader Ki Tara Khoma Korte Paren? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Uttor Lukiye Royeche Ei Audiobook E. Aasun Shune Neyoya Jak.

मैं-मौत-हूँ-तेरी---लेखक--अनिल-गर्ग-.title: मैं मौत हूँ तेरी
मैं-मौत-हूँ-तेरी---लेखक--अनिल-गर्ग-.description: Jab woh apne pati ke athyachar seh nahi paie to usne apne pati ko Maar Daala. Lekin pati ki hatya ke bad ghar se bahar nikalte hi woh ek ek badh ek musibath mei fasti chali gaie. Suniye Apke rongte khade kar deni waali ek Abla nari ki aisi Dastaan jab usne hatiyaar uthaie to samaj ke thekedar usse khud pahna mangne lage.

-నల్లా-పిల్లన-గ్రోవి.title: నల్ల పిల్లన గ్రోవి
-నల్లా-పిల్లన-గ్రోవి.description: ఇక్కడి గ్రామీణ జీవితాలని వీలయినంత సాహిత్యంగా పొందుపరచాలి అనుకున్నాను. దీన్ని నేను రికార్డింగ్ అనుకోవడం లేదు. రచన పట్టణ మధ్య తరగతి నుంచి గ్రామీణ సన్నకారు ప్రజల వైపు మళ్లటం లాంటిది అనుకుంటాను. ఈ మాట చెబుతున్నాను అని ఈ మల్లింపుకి నేనే మొదటివాణ్ణని చెప్పుకోవడం కాదు. కథా రచనలో నా అవగాహనను తెలుసుకోవడం కోసం మాత్రమే.

laws-and-rights-every-indian-should-know.title: Laws And Rights Every Indian Should Know
laws-and-rights-every-indian-should-know.description: Indiayil sthithi cheythirikkunna hotelukalile washroom ningalkk sowjanyamayi upayogikkamennu ariyamo? Allenkil ningalkkoru gas cylinder apakadam undayal eluppathil nashtapariharam labhikkumenn ariyamo? Ningal oru Indian pourano thaamasakarano aanenkil, ningalude niyamaparamaaya  avakashangal enthanennu ningal arinjirikkanam!  Ee avakashangale kurich ariyanum manassilakanum aashaya kuzhapam undakam, ennal ee audio showiloode ningal theerchayayum arinjirikenda chila basic rights lalithamayi vishadheekarikkunnu.

unwanted-son.title: Unwanted Son
unwanted-son.description: “Agar mere ek bete ko marna hi tha to tu kyon nahi mar gaya?” Apne papa ke muh se ye baat sunkar Zayn Kapoor ka dil toot jata hai. Apne bade bhai Rehan ki maut ke baad, Zayn apne mummy papa ki care karne ke liye, apni 50 lakh ki naukri chhod kar ghar chala to aata hai, par badle mein use sirf unki nafrat hi milti hai. Unke behavior ki wajah se Zayn ki girlfriend bhi usse shaad karne ke liye mana kar deti hai. Lekin jab Zayn ko pata chalta hai ki uske papa ne uska sara business idea chura kar bech diya hai, toh use ek tough decision lena padta hai. Kya apne toxic parents ko maaf karega Zayn ya chunega apne liye ek nayi zindagi? Kaise hui thi Rehan ki maut aur uske liye uske papa kyon blame karte hain Zayn ko? Kya kabhi Zayn ko milega uske mummy papa ka pyar?

gilles-de-rais.title: Gilles de rais : Killer King
gilles-de-rais.description: France ka ek shoorveer Raja jisne jeete Kai yuddh. Ek aisa king jo  ek safal commander bhi tha or jisne hmesha chtaai dushman ko dhool. Magar aisa kya hua ki itihas mein use uske Jeet ke  liye nahin balki  htyaon ke liye yaad rakha gaya. Kyun yeh Raja karta tha chote bacchon ki berahmi se htyaein? Chote bacchon ko maarke use kya milta tha? Kya is Serial Killer King ki puri kahani suniye KUKU FM par!

alpha-male.title: Alpha Male
alpha-male.description: Casanova, Alpha Devil, Great Entrepreneur అని పేరు పొందిన ఆరవ్ ఇంతవరకు అమ్మాయిలతో లవ్ లో పడింది లేదు. అలాంటి ఆరవ్ యాక్సిడెంటల్ గా చూసిన ఆద్య అనే అమ్మాయిని ఆమె అనుమతి లేకుండానే ఫ్లాష్ మ్యారేజ్ చేసుకున్నాడు. ఎందుకు? ఎలా? ఆ తర్వాత కథ ఎటు వైపు వెళ్ళింది? అసలు అతనికి ఇన్ని పేర్లు ఎందుకు వచ్చాయ్? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ప్లీజ్ listen టు “Alpha Male” ఓన్లీ ఆన్ KUKU FM.

what-women-want.title: వాట్ విమెన్ వాంట్
what-women-want.description: డైలీ లైఫ్ లో విమెన్ ఏ రకం గా సఫర్ అవుతోంది. వర్క్ ప్లేస్ లో, ఫామిలీ లో తన పార్టిసిపేషన్ ని ఎంత వరకూ ఎదురుచూడాలి ? చుట్టూ వున్న సొసైటీ తనకి ఏ రకం గా సపోర్ట్ ఇవ్వాలి? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

the-light-in-all-is-one-guru-nanak.title: Guru Nanak Ka Gyan: सत्य और सेवा का मार्ग
the-light-in-all-is-one-guru-nanak.description: "Guru Nanak Ka Gyan" Show mein, aap janenge Guru Nanak Dev ji ke anmol vicharon ko, jo unhone apne adbhut safar ke dauraan sikhaaye. Ye show aapko sikhayega kaise Sachchai, vishwas aur prem ke marg par chal kar jeevan ko sarthak banaya ja sakta hai.

एक-झुंज-शर्थीची--लेखक--ईश्वर-त्रिंबक-आगम.title: एक झुंज शर्थीची
एक-झुंज-शर्थीची--लेखक--ईश्वर-त्रिंबक-आगम.description:
लेखकाने या कथेमध्ये इतिहासातील सत्य घटनांना कल्पनेची जोड देऊन त्या मांडण्याचा प्रयत्न केला आहे. ऐकूया, एक वीर रसाने भरलेली कथा

Writer - ईश्वर त्रिंबक आगम
Voiceover Artist - RJ Paritosh

fleeing-husband-please-love-me-all-over-.title: Fleeing Husband Please Love Me All Over Again
fleeing-husband-please-love-me-all-over-.description: After deciding to divorce from the business tycoon Alexis due to her inability to tolerate their contractual marriage, the wealthy heiress Vylina fell into the lowest point of her life. Yet, after enduring the heavy blows of life's darkest moments, she ultimately achieved abundant success in both her career and love life.

talaash-1.title: Talaash
talaash-1.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

mahashunya.title: Mahashunya
mahashunya.description: सदियों से भटकता एक गूंगा अमर यात्री, जिसकी यादें टुकड़ों में बिखरी हुई हैं, एक निडर चोरनी के साथ तब जुड़ता है जब एक प्राचीन पन्ना भूली हुई भविष्यवाणी को जगा देता है। अब दोनों को राजा देवव्रत के रहस्य और महाशून्य की भयावह शक्ति का सच पता लगाना होगा, इससे पहले कि लौटते हुए ड्रैगन तीनों लोकों को विनाश में झोंक दें।

sea-glass-summer.title: Sea Glass Summer
sea-glass-summer.description: Recovering from a painful divorce Sarah Draycott has moved to the picture-postcard village of Sea Glass on the Maine coast and is soon caught up in the lives of its inhabitants. As she helps elegant but troubled widow Gwen cope with her desperately ill son and assists nine-year-old orphan Oliver in uncovering the secrets surrounding the mysterious Cully Mansion, Sarah's broken heart begins to heal. She isn't looking for new romance - but love finds a way of seeking someone out just when they least expect it...

biography-anna-hazare.title: Anna Hazare
biography-anna-hazare.description: Insaan ke roop mein aandhi, maano jaise dusra Gandhi. Anshan aur protest ki aatma ko dobara zinda karne wale is parakrami lokneta ke baare mein jitna kaho utna kam hai. Jantar Mantar se apne sandesh ko pure desh tak pohchaate hue inhone sarkaar ki jade hila di thi. Ek aam naagrik ko unki taaqat ka ehsaas dilaaya. 'Lokpal' aur 'Satyagraha' inki do sabse badi taaqat. Desh aur samaaj ki seva hi inka dharm. Chaliye sunte hai, Anna Hazare ka jeevan aadarsh!

athmakatha.title: ആത്മകഥ
athmakatha.description: ചിരിയും ചിന്തയും സമന്വയിപ്പിച്ച അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ വീക്ഷണം സമുദായത്തിന്റെയും മതത്തിന്റെയും വേലിത്തടകൾക്കുള്ളിൽ ഒതുങ്ങിനിന്നില്ല. ജാതി, മത വ്യത്യാസങ്ങൾക്കതീതമായി, ചുറ്റുമുള്ള ജനങ്ങളോടൊപ്പം നിന്ന് ഏത് പ്രശ്നത്തിനും അദ്ദേഹം സ്വന്തം ശൈലിയിൽ ഉത്തരം നൽകി. ഈ പുസ്തകം ഒരു ആത്മകഥ മാത്രമല്ല, ക്രിസോസ്റ്റം എന്ന യോഗിവര്യന്റെ കർമ്മപഥവും ജീവിത വീക്ഷണവും ചിന്താധാരകളും എന്നെന്നേക്കുമായി രേഖപ്പെടുത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.

मौत--एक-रहस्मई-कहानी--लेखक--करन-राजपूत.title: मौत - एक रहस्मई कहानी
मौत--एक-रहस्मई-कहानी--लेखक--करन-राजपूत.description:
यमलोक के बारे में आपने सुना तो बहुत होगा मगर इस कहानी में हम आपको सच मे यमलोक की सैर कराएंगे।और दिखाएंगे की कैसे एक सीधा-साधा इंसान यमलोक में फंस जाता है और कैसे मौत के मुंह से निकलकर बाहर आया..
Voiceover Artist: Shreekant Sinha
author: Karan Rajput

the-double-man-army.title: द डबल ए आर्मी
the-double-man-army.description: Ladkiyoh ko injection kuch hi samay baad sabhi ladkiyan jaambhi ki tarah ek dusre ko maare kaatne lahi.. kya tha is injection mein? Kaun hai jo is maasum ladkiyo ki zindagi se khilwaad kar raha tha. Jaan ne k liye sune Action aur romanch se bharpur kahani 'The Double A Army' kewal Kuku FM par.

kaun-thi-woh-ladki.title: Kaun thi woh ladki
kaun-thi-woh-ladki.description: Mr. Singhania is hunted down by gunmen hired by his extended family and a girl saves his life and leaves a locket behind. She loses her memory and so does he. They both meet afterward and the girl falls in love with Mr. Singhania who is still looking for the woman who saved his life.

humdard-saathi.title: Humdard Saathi
humdard-saathi.description: Pyar me dhokha khaa chuki Kritika ko apni jindagi me aaye Sudarshan me dikha sachcha Hamdard. Lekin kyu sath nibhayega Sudarshan us Kritika ka jisne apna sabkuch pehle hi lutaa diya tha kisi or ke bistar pe. Sune Hamdard sathi, kahani pyar ke us ehsas ki jo jismani nahi balki Bhawnatmak thi.

manitha-vazhvil-marangal.title: Manitha Vazhvil Marangal
manitha-vazhvil-marangal.description: Manithanoda vazhvu la marangaloda pangalippu enna nu indha audio book la therinjikonga.

arthika-swathanthryam-pondadam-ela.title: ఆర్థిక స్వాతంత్య్రం పొందడం ఎలా ?
arthika-swathanthryam-pondadam-ela.description: ఖర్చులను నియంత్రించి, పొదుపు పెంచడం ద్వారా ఆర్థిక స్వాతంత్య్రం సాధ్యమేనా? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

kia.title: Kia Motors - How It Entered Indian Market
kia.description: Ek taraf jahan automobile companies apne shutter gira rahi thi, wahi Kia India mein apna production badhane ke tarike dhund rahi thi. India mein entry lete hi Kia motors ekdum successful ho gayi. To aakhir Kia ne India mein aisa kya kiya ? jisse vo itne successful hue aur baki automobile companies ki nind uda di, janiye is audiobook mein.Agar aapko "Built To Last" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

puwoti-tora.title: Puwoti Tora
puwoti-tora.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Our shows celebrate love in all its forms from the first flutter of attraction to the deep bonds that withstand the test of time. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

shri-hanuman-ravan-samvaad.title: Shri Hanuman-Ravan Samvaad
shri-hanuman-ravan-samvaad.description:
Is samvaad mein humein "Shri Hanuman aur Ravan" ke beech hue vivaad se Dharm, Nyay, aur Bhakti ki ek mukhya seekh milte hain, aur sath hi adharm ke khilaf savdhan rehne aur dharm ki or wafadaar rahne ka message bhi milta hai.


Link- https://kukufm.com/show/life-lessons-from-sundarkand?utm_source=upsell

kalpana-chawla-indias-first-woman-astron.title: Kalpana Chawla: India's First Woman Astronaut
kalpana-chawla-indias-first-woman-astron.description: ഹരിയാനയിലെ ഒരു ചെറിയ ഗ്രാമത്തില്‍ ജനിച്ച് അനന്ത വിഹായസ്സ് ലക്ഷ്യമാക്കി പറന്ന ഇന്ത്യയുടെ അഭിമാന പുത്രിയാണ് കല്‍പ്പന ചൗള. ഒന്നുമൊന്നും തന്റെ സ്വപ്‌നങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് മുന്നില്‍ തടസ്സമല്ലെന്ന് കരുതിയ കല്‍പനയുടെ കഥ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

hold-me-tight-2.title: Relationship 101
hold-me-tight-2.description: Hamari zindagi mein bahut sare rishte hote hai aur har rishte ko banaye rakhne ke liye pyaar ki sabse jyaada zarurat hoti hai. Par aajkal pyar ka matlab badal sa gaya hai or har taraf rishte bikharte ja rahe hai. To is show mein hum janenge ki kaise apne relationship ko happy or jawan banaya ja sakta hai. Agar aapko "The Seven Principles of Making Marriage Work" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

aaborir-akash-aru-prithibi.title: Aaborir Akash Aru Prithibi
aaborir-akash-aru-prithibi.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Our shows celebrate love in all its forms from the first flutter of attraction to the deep bonds that withstand the test of time. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

tips-tricks-to-handle-new-born-baby.title: Tips & Tricks To Handle New Born Baby
tips-tricks-to-handle-new-born-baby.description: Agar aap naye parents hain ya fir zaldi hi parents banne wale hain to ye audioshow aapke liye hai, "Bacche ko sahi dhang se handle karne ka tareeka kya hai? Kin baaton ka hamein bacchon ke saath zyada khyal rakhna chahiye aur kin chizon se apne bacchon ko bachana chahiye? Aise kai saare sawalon ke jawab aapko es special show milenge.

the-history-of-el-clasico.title: The History Of El Clasico
the-history-of-el-clasico.description: El Clasico ennal football premikale sambandhich theeparunna oru yudhamanu. Kaalu kondu mathralla chilappol vashiyum veerum koodumbol kaiyyankaliyilekkum neelunna ithihaasa thulyamaya porattamanu oro El Clasicoyum kaanikalkk sammanikkuka. Ere charithramulla lokathile thanne ettavum valiyathum kaanikal ullathumaya malsarangalil onnanu Real Madridum Barcelonayum thammil ulla ee football porattam. Ronoyum Messiyum koodu vittenkilum puthu thalamura veerum vaashiyum kedathe kakkunnund. El Clasicoyude charithrathekkurichum vaashiyeriya porattangalekkurichum Kuku FMilude kettariyam.

reset-your-diet.title: Reset Your Diet
reset-your-diet.description: Health is Wealth nu solluvaanga. Unga health ah yum Physique ayum pucca vaa vachukka diet romba mukkiyam. Unga Diet ah reset panni life ah change panrathu eppadinu therinjukalam vaanga

make-the-right-choice-2.title: Make the Right Choice
make-the-right-choice-2.description: Sokale Otha Theke Rate Ghumate Jaoyar Aage Porjonto Aamder Samne Hajar Rokom Choice Ba Pochhondo Thake. Kichu Choice Emon Ja Aapnar Jibon Sesh Kore Dite Pare Aabar Kichu Choice Emon Ja Aapnar Jibon Bodle Dite Pare. Jibone Valo Thakte Gele Ebong Sofolotar Chabi Pete Gele Sothik Choice Kora Khub Gurutwopurno. Aapnakei Beche Nite Hobe Sothik Pochhondo. Kintu Kivabe Thik Korben Sothik Pochhondo? Kon Pothe Gele Milbe Sukh Ebong Safolyo? Eisob Proshner Uttor Pete Gele Aapnake Mon Diye Purota Shunte Hobe J. P. Vaswani-Er Lekha 'Make the Right Choice'-Boiti. Mari padmavathiki yemaindi mari vaaru malli ela kalusukunnaru?

1000-uthai-vaangiya-aboorva-sigamani.title: ஆயிரம் உதை வாங்கிய அபூர்வ சிகாமணி
1000-uthai-vaangiya-aboorva-sigamani.description: கிராமமே புகார் சொல்லும் அளவு ஊரெல்லாம் வம்பு தும்பு செய்கிறான், சிகாமணி. அவன் அப்பாவும் அம்மாவும் எவ்வளவோ சொல்லியும் அவன் கேட்காத காரணத்தால் சிகாமணியின் குடும்பம் மெட்ராஸில் இருக்கும் ஜோதிட நண்பரின் வீட்டுக்கு குடி பெயர்கிறது. அங்கேயும் சிகாமணி வால் தனம் செய்து அலம்பல் செய்கிறான். அந்நேரத்தில் சிகாமணி தன்னை திருமணம் செய்து கொண்டார் என்று குடும்பத்திற்குள் நுழைகிறாள் காவேரி. அதன் பின் சிகாமணியின் வாழ்க்கையில் ஆயிரம் உதைகள் விழுகின்றன. போலி மருத்துவர், எம்.எல்.ஏ என சிகாமணி பல ஆள் மாறாட்ட வேலைகளிலும் ஈடுபடுகிறான். இறுதியில் என்ன நடந்தது? யார் அந்த காவேரி? எம்.எல்.ஏ ஆக ஆள்மாறாட்டம் செய்த சிகாமணி சிக்கினானா? எஸ்.வி. சேகரின் நகைச்சுவை நாடகமான ஆயிரம் உதை வாங்கிய அபூர்வ சிகாமணியை உங்கள் குக்கூ எப்.எம்.ல் கேளுங்கள்...

my-second-wife.title: My second wife
my-second-wife.description: சந்தியா வாடகைத் தாயாக இருந்து குழந்தை பெற்று ஒரு பணக்கார குடும்பத்துக் கொடுக்கிறாள். குழந்தையைக் கொடுத்த சில வருடங்களுக்குப் பிறகு, அவளுக்கு இனிமேல் குழந்தை பிறக்காது என்று தெரியவருகிறது. அவள் தனது குழந்தையை மீண்டும் பெற போராடுகிறாள். அவள் தன் குழந்தையை மீண்டும் பெற்றாளா?

zindagi-jeene-ke-10-best-tareeke.title: Zindagi Jeene ke 10 Best Tareeke
zindagi-jeene-ke-10-best-tareeke.description: Har kisi ki zindagi mein challenges aate hain, lekin 'Zindagi Jeene ke 10 Best Tareeke' aapko sikhayega ki kaise in challenges ka samna karein aur har kshetra mein aage badhein. vishakanyaka.title: വിഷകന്യക
vishakanyaka.description: "വിഷകന്യക" എന്ന നോവൽ, കേരളത്തിലെ കുടിയേറ്റത്തിന്റെ ഇരുണ്ട വശം വരച്ചു കാട്ടുന്നു. കൃഷിഭൂമി തേടി തിരുവിതാംകൂറിൽ നിന്ന് മലബാറിലേക്ക് പലായനം ചെയ്ത കർഷകരുടെ കഥയാണ് ഇത്. കഠിനാധ്വാനം ചെയ്ത് തരിശുഭൂമി കൃഷിയോഗ്യമാക്കുന്ന കർഷകരും അവരുടെ ജീവിതസമരങ്ങളും നോവലിൽ വരച്ചുകാട്ടുന്നു.

kulsee.title: Kulsi - Ek Anokhi Dastaan
kulsee.description: एक राजकुमारी और राजपाठ | सुने एक ऐसी राजकुमारी की कहानी जिसको राज महल की चार दीवारी का सुख नहीं मिलता।  जिसके पिता करते है उससे लड़की होने की वजह से नफरत। क्या राजा कभी कर पाएंगे उसे स्वीकार? या लेगी वो इस नफरत का बदला और लड़ेगी अपने  हक़ के लिए.?

pal-pal-dil-ke-paas.title: Pal Pal Dil Ke Paas
pal-pal-dil-ke-paas.description: Siya ek anath ladki hai, jisne apna sab kuch Veer ke pyaar mein daav par laga diya. Lekin jab Veer ka heart fail ho jata hai, toh Siya uski zindagi bachane ke liye apni jaan ko sacrifice karne ka faisla karti hai. Apni jaan se bhi pyaare Veer ko bachane ke liye, Siya usse apna rishta tod deti hai aur uske liye apna dil donate karne ka decision leti hai, bina usse yeh bataye ki woh uske bacche ki maa banne wali hai. Toh kya Veer ko pata chalega ki uske seene mein dhadak raha dil asal mein Siya ka hai? Kya hoga jab sacrifice, pyaar aur guilt aamne saamne honge?

celebration-of-deepavali.title: Celebration of Deepavali
celebration-of-deepavali.description: രാജ്യത്തെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ആഘോഷങ്ങളിലൊന്നായ ദീപാവലിക്ക് ഓരോയിടത്തും ഓരോ കഥകളാണ്. നരകാസുര വധം മുതല്‍ വര്‍ധമാന മഹാവീര നിര്‍വാണം വരെ അവ നീണ്ടു കിടക്കുന്നു. തിന്മയുടെ സംഹാരത്തിനൊടുവില്‍ നന്മ ജയിക്കുമെന്ന വിശ്വാസമുള്‍ക്കൊണ്ട് നാടെങ്ങും ദീപങ്ങളാല്‍ അലങ്കരിക്കപ്പെട്ടുകൊണ്ടുള്ള വര്‍ണാഭമായ ആഘോഷം ഉത്തരേന്ത്യയില്‍ അഞ്ച് ദിവസത്തോളവും ദക്ഷിണേന്ത്യയില്‍ ഒരു ദിവസവും ആണ് ആഘോഷിക്കുന്നത്. ദീപാവലിയുടെ ആഘോഷ കഥകള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

my-billionaire-daddy.title: My Billionaire Daddy
my-billionaire-daddy.description:
Ek masoom bachcha, Tanmay, jise duniya sirf ek single maa ka beta samajhti hai. Ek powerful business empire ka waris, Rohan, jise khud nahi pata ke uski ek chhoti si galti, kisi ki poori duniya ban chuki hai. Aur ek majboot maa, Smita, jo har mushkil se ladkar apne bete ke liye ek achha kal chah rahi hai, bina jaane ke uske Tanmay ki ragon mein kiska khoon daud raha hai. Jab ek DNA report sach ka darwaza kholti hai, toh teen zindagiyon mein aisa toofaan aata jo sirf rishton ko nahi, pehchaan ko bhi jadd se hila deta hai. Kya ek maa apne bete ko uska haq dila paayegi, ya usse usi duniya se ladna padega jo sirf paisa aur khoon ko pehchanti hai?
Aur jab Rohan ka sach Smita ke saamne aayega, toh kya tutega bharosa, ya judega ek naya rishta?

my-million-dollar-app.title: My Million Dollar App
my-million-dollar-app.description:
They say there's an app for everything, but Kevin never expected one for becoming a millionaire.
When his smartphone starts dishing out quests and rewards, Kevin's ordinary life in New York City takes a sharp turn into the extraordinary. Suddenly, he's dodging mobsters, outsmarting federal agents, and unraveling conspiracies that run deeper than the city's subway system.
With each completed task, the stakes—and the rewards—grow higher. But in a game where the rules keep changing, can Kevin stay ahead without losing himself?
Get ready for a thrilling ride where one swipe could mean the difference between striking gold and sleeping with the fishes.

the-power-of-cold-emailing.title: The Power of Cold E-mailing
the-power-of-cold-emailing.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki aap duniya mein kisi se bhi connect kar sakte hain bas ek e-mail ke dum par? Aur yeh ek e-mail aapke liye sunehre avsaron ke raaste khol sakta hai. lekin wo e-mail kya hona chahiye, use kaise likhna hai aur kaise bhejna hai, yeh bahut zaroori hai aur is original show mein hum inhi muddon par charcha karenge.

how-to-easily-crack-upsc-2.title: How To Easily Crack UPSC?
how-to-easily-crack-upsc-2.description: Indiayile ettavum abhimanakaramaaya sevanangalil onnaaya civil service pareekshakku enganaeyanu thayyaredukkendath? Oro udhyogarthikalum arinjirikkenda karyangal enthokkeyanu? Vishadhamayi ariyam ee showiloode.

yandhira-jaalam.title: யந்திர ஜாலம்
yandhira-jaalam.description: கடவுள், மந்திர தந்திரம் என மனித சக்திக்கு அப்பால் இருக்கும் பல அமானுஷ்ய சம்பவங்கள் கெளரி வாழ்க்கையில் நடக்கிறது. இது ”யந்திர ஜாலம்”

shikast.title: Shikast
shikast.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

amrutvel.title: Amrutvel
amrutvel.description: प्रीती म्हणजे केवळ यौवनाची वासना नव्हे — ती सार्‍या संसाराचा आधार आहे. जेव्हा वासनेला खोल भावनेची जोड मिळते, तेव्हाच प्रीती अमृतवेल बनते. पण जेव्हा ती आत्मकेंद्रित होते, तेव्हा त्याच वेलीवर विषारी फुलं उमलतात. प्रेमाचा खरा अर्थ उलगडणारी वि. स. खांडेकर यांची अमृतवेल — सागर कदम यांच्या आवाजात

नील-.title: Neel
नील-.description: मोहब्‍बत में टूटे नील को जब नलिनी का सहारा मिलता है तो उसके जीवन में एक नया रंग भर जाता है…. लेकिन रिश्‍तों के अधेड़ बुन में उलझा नील का जीवन मझधार में गोते खा रहा है। क्‍या सच में नील को नलिनी से मोहब्‍बत है? या फिर दर्द को भुलाने के लिए वह नलिनी का पेन किलर की तरह इस्‍तेमाल कर रहा है? आज के आधुनिक समाज में रिश्‍तों की अहमियत को कितना बदल दिया है जानने के लिए सुनें पूरी कहानी।

the-dance-of-shiva-fourteen-essays.title: The Dance of Shiva: Fourteen Essays
the-dance-of-shiva-fourteen-essays.description: Bharatiya kala aur darshan ki khoj karte hue, “Dance of Shiva” aapko ek mystical journey pe le jaata hai. Is audio show mein dekhiye kaise Shiva ka tandav puri duniya ki cyclical nature ko define karta hai. Har step mein ek naya secret! Jud jaiye iss timeless journey mein aur Shiva ke nartak roop se apni zindagi ko ek naye roop mein dekhiye!

unusual-temples-of-india.title: Unusual Temples Of India
unusual-temples-of-india.description: Bharat deviyon devtayon ka desh hai. Yahan ki aastha aur yahan ke teerth asthaano jaisa duniya mein kuch nahi. Yeh show aapko ek aise anokhe safar par lekar jayega ke aapki hairat ka koi thikaana nahi rahega aur saath hi saath aapko aastha ke tamaam rangon se rubaru bhi karvayega. Is show mein hum darshan karenge Bharat ke aise 10 anokhe mandiron ka jinmein se koi apne prasad ki vajah se anokha hai, to koi apne pooja ke tareeke ki vajah se, aur koi bas mandir ke peeche ki kahani aur maanyta ki vajah se. Yakeen maaniye yeh safar aap sab ke liye ek badi yaadgaar hoga. To dil thaam kar baithein aur chalein hmaare saath bharat ke anokhe mandiron ke safar par.

biponno-bismoy-khel.title: Biponno bismoy khel
biponno-bismoy-khel.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

the-art-of-start-20-1.title: Startup Ani Social Media
the-art-of-start-20-1.description: Pratyek jan navin business suru karnyacha swap a baghtoh ek yashasvi business suru karnyasathi aplyala jida, dhadas, chikati lagtech pan tya sobatch important asta te mhanje margadarshan. Aple utpadhan grahaka paryanta kase pochavta yeil. Tya sathi kay tools lagtil hey sarva kahi amhi tumhala sangnar a hot startup ani social media ya series madhye.

അവിചാരിതം.title: അവിചാരിതം
അവിചാരിതം.description: മുരളിയും അനുരാധയും തമ്മിലുളള വിവാഹം വാസ്തവത്തിൽ ഒരു നാടകമായിരുന്നു, പക്ഷേ വിധി ആ ബന്ധത്തെ  പ്രണയവും ചതിയും തമ്മിലുളള ഒരു പോരാട്ടത്തിലേക്ക് വഴിതിരിച്ചു വിടുന്നു. സത്യത്തിനും വഞ്ചനയ്ക്കും ഇടയിൽ നിന്നുകൊണ്ട് അനുരാധക്ക്  ഒരു തീരുമാനമെടുത്തേ തീരൂ- മുരളിയുടെ ഭാവിയെ നിർണ്ണയിക്കുന്ന തീരുമാനം. ഏതാകും അവൾ തെരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക- സ്വന്തം സ്വപ്നങ്ങളെയോ, അതോ ഉള്ളിൽ  നീറി പുകയുന്ന പ്രതികാരത്തേയോ?

mrradha-kalagakkaranin-kadhai.title: எம்.ஆர்.ராதா : கலகக்காரனின் கதை
mrradha-kalagakkaranin-kadhai.description: தன் மனதில் பட்டதைத் தயக்கமின்றிச் சொன்னவர் எம்.ஆர்.ராதா. தான் நினைத்தபடி வாழ்ந்தவர். அதனால் கலகக்காரன் என்று பெயர் இவருக்கு. இவரது வாழ்க்கை வரலாற்றை விறுவிறுப்பும், சுவையும் சிறிதும் குன்றாமல் நமக்குத் தந்திருக்கிறார் முகில்.

sira.title: సిరా
sira.description: ఫేమస్ ఇన్స్టిట్యూట్‌లో అనుమానంగా అనిపించే కుర్రవాళ్ళ ఆత్మ హత్యలు, వాటి వెనక వున్న రహస్యం ఛేదించాలని సిద్ధపడ్డ యంగ్ లాయర్ రామ్. తనకి ఎదురుగా కేసు వాదిస్తున్నది ఇండియాలో నెంబర్ వన్ లాయర్, తన గురువు మూర్తి సర్. ఇద్దరు ఇంటిలిజెంట్, స్మార్ట్ లాయర్స్... ఒకరిది టెక్నికల్లో బ్రిలియెన్సు.. ఒకరిది ఎమోషనల్ ఫోర్సు.. ఒకరు ఓటమి తెలియని గురువు.. ఒకరు గెలిచి తీరాలి అనుకునే శిష్యుడు ... కోర్ట్ లో ఇద్దరూ కసిగా యుద్ధం మొదలు పెట్టారు.చివరికి ఏమైందో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "సిరా" అనే కథను వినండి.

entrepreneurs-who-built-india.title: Entrepreneurs Who Built INDIA
entrepreneurs-who-built-india.description: Desh ke top entrepreneurs ka safar, jo sirf sapne nahi, apna ek brand banane ka junoon rakhte the. Inki inspiring kahaniyan suniye aur janiye kaise inhone India ko global business map par pehchaan di. Abhi suniye aur apne sapnon ko reality banaiye.

shoe-dog-11.title: Shoe Dog
shoe-dog-11.description: Kabhi schools ke baahar saste se joote bechne wale Phil Knight ne aakhir kaise bana daali duniya ki sabse badi shoes company ? Ji haan, ye wahi Phil Knight hain jinki banayi huyi company 'Nike' ke joote hum sabke favorite hain. To chaliye sunte hai Phil Knight ke life ki puri kahani unhi ke words mein.

operation-bazooka.title: Operation Bazooka
operation-bazooka.description: 112 goliyaan, din dahade, koi kaise ek posh Lucknow area mein chala sakta hai? Shriprakash Shukla jaise khaufnaak gangster ne sirf yahi nahi, aise anekon kaand ko anjaam diya hai.Aaiye Operation Bazooka mein uski aur uske pakde jaane ki poori kahani jaane.

gayatri-mantra-mind-reprogramming-ka-ved.title: Gayatri Mantra: Mind Reprogramming Ka Vedic Secret
gayatri-mantra-mind-reprogramming-ka-ved.description: Is the Gayatri Mantra merely a prayer, or an ancient framework for transforming the mind? This series explores the traditional significance of the Gayatri Mantra through engaging storytelling, relatable examples, and practical insights. Discover how it has long been associated with clarity, focus, discipline, resilience, and inner growth while examining themes such as stress, distraction, confidence, visualization, and mindful living in today's fast-paced world.

goyenda-indranath-rudra-samagra-1.title: Goyenda Indranath Rudra Samagra 1
goyenda-indranath-rudra-samagra-1.description: আমরা একজন ডিটেক্টিভের কাছে নায়কোচিত গুণাবলীর প্রত্যাশা রাখি। শখের গোয়েন্দা ইন্দ্রনাথ রুদ্র — দামী পাঞ্জাবি, ধুতির ফুল-কোঁচা আর ল্যাভেন্ডারের সুবাসে এক আকর্ষণীয় হিরো। ঝকঝকে চেহারা, তুখোড় বুদ্ধির ইন্দ্রনাথ মেগাস্টার না হয়ে হয়েছে গোয়েন্দা। অপরাধ জগতের আতঙ্ক, কিন্তু অসহায়ের পরম বন্ধু। তার রহস্য উন্মোচনের গল্প শুনুন লেখক বন্ধু মৃগাঙ্কের কাছে। শুধুমাত্র Storytel-এ।

buddhajaya.title: Buddhajaya
buddhajaya.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

the-8020-principle-2.title: The 80/20 Principle
the-8020-principle-2.description: Business kum Seri, Life kum Seri oru unique philosophy eppovume thevai padum. Endha business ah venalum irukkattum, 80% revenue vara karanam ah irukuradhu verum 20% customers dhan nu sonna unga naala namba mudiyudha? Idhe madiri vera engellam 80/20 principle mukkiya role play pannudhu nu therinjuka kelunga “The 80/20 Principle: The Secret to Achieving More with Less” on Kuku FM

geo-politics.title: Geo Politics
geo-politics.description: Miku Geo Politics ante ento telusa ? Asalu Geo Politics ante enti ? akkada ekkado yuddalu jargithe mana desham lo ratelu enduku perguthunayi ,danitho manaku emi sambadam untundhi, present perge daralaki vere deshala ki emana sambadam vuntundha ? mana desham vere deshalatho opandalu enduku kudurcukutundi? asalu yudhalu enduku jarguthayi ? Ila Enno vatiki miku samadanam kavalante ventane ee  audio book vineyandi.

విరహ-ప్రేమ-గాథలు-.title: Lust Stories
విరహ-ప్రేమ-గాథలు-.description: రెండక్షరాల ప్రేమ, ఒక జంట మధ్య ఏర్పడితే అది ఒక తీయని అనుభవం అవుతుంది. మనసును హత్తుకునే  ప్రేమ గాథలు మీ కోసం.

uff-ye-ashiqui.title: Uff Ye Ashiqui
uff-ye-ashiqui.description: Om ne apni college crush Tamanna ke liye apne papa ke dost ki beti Radhika ke sath shaadi karne se mana kar diya. Is faisle ne dono parivaron ke beech dushmani paida kar di. Om ne pehle hi Radhika ko Tamanna ke baare mein sach bata diya tha. Tamanna ke doosre dharm ke hone ke bawjood Om ne dono pariwaro ko iss rishte ke liye raazi kar liya.  Par shaadi ki tareekh nazdeek aate hi, Om ko ehsaas hua hai ki uska asli pyaar Tamanna nahi, balki Radhika hai.  Ab kya Om sab kuch theek kar payega?  Kya woh Tamanna aur uske parivaar se door hone ke liye koi chaal chalega?  Kya woh apne parivaar, Radhika aur uske gharwaalon ko is naye rishte ke liye raazi kar payega?

crime-file-2.title: ക്രൈം ഫയല്‍
crime-file-2.description: അനിതര സാധാരണമായ എട്ട് കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരമാണ് സുനില്‍ ഗോപാലകൃഷ്ണന്‍ രചിച്ച ക്രൈം ഫയല്‍. വശ്യമായ ഭാഷകൊണ്ടും വേറിട്ട ആഖ്യാന ശൈലി കൊണ്ടും എട്ടു കഥകളും വേറിട്ടു നില്‍ക്കുന്നു. കണ്ടു പരിചയിച്ചിട്ടില്ലാത്ത കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളും ഭൂമികകളും മെനഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നതിനൊപ്പം തന്നെ കൗതുകം മുറ്റി നില്‍ക്കുന്ന രചനാ വൈദഗ്ദ്യം കൊണ്ട് അനുവാചകനെ സുനില്‍ വഴി നടത്തുകയാണ്. നിശ്ചയമായും കേട്ടിരുന്നു പോവുന്ന കഥകള്‍.

achieve-more-succeed-faster.title: Achieve More Succeed Faster
achieve-more-succeed-faster.description: Career me success paane ke liye log saalo ki mehnat aur personal time laga dete hai, par safalta paane ke liye ek aisa tested mantra hai jo kum samay me aapko wahi safalta dila sakta hai.aapka career ek marathon hai but marathon ko aap kese ek sprint race ki tarah intresting bana kar jaldi se apni position le hai . Success ki sidi par pehla kadam lene ke liye suniye ye audiobook "Achieve more suceed faster". Life mantra to achieve success quickly in your life.

siruvargalukku-arivoottum-ulaga-neethika.title: சிறுவர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டும் உலக நாடுகளின் நீதிக்கதைகள்
siruvargalukku-arivoottum-ulaga-neethika.description: Ulaga naadugalil irunthu arivoottum neethi kathaikal

behrupiya-baadshah.title: Behrupiya Baadshah
behrupiya-baadshah.description: After witnessing his warrior parents’ brutal deaths, ten-year-old Arjun is given three final commands: guard his ancestral home, vanish from the world for four years, and master a mysterious breathing technique. Feigning madness, he endures betrayal, poverty, and humiliation while secretly cultivating his hidden power. When his trial nears its end, a mysterious brass badge points him toward a destiny that could shake the entire realm.

pankaj-tripathi-with-kuku.title: Pankaj Tripathi Ke Sath "The Making of Atal"
pankaj-tripathi-with-kuku.description: Pankaj Tripathi Kholenge 'Main ATAL Hoon' Ke Raaz! Suniye Kaise Banein Pankaj "Atal Ji"! Iske sath-sath hum janenge Behind-The-Scenes ke Qisse, Challenges Aur Unki Personal Journey humare iss special show mein.

manavachya-shodhachi-kahani.title: Manavachya Shodhachi Kahani
manavachya-shodhachi-kahani.description: Dive into the world of Non-Fiction with Kuku FM where real stories and groundbreaking ideas come to life. Our collection spans intriguing topics from history and science to culture and personal development. Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

kashi-pattanam.title: Kashi Pattanam
kashi-pattanam.description: Bharathadeshapu Athi Prachina Nagarallo Kashi Nagaram Okati. Varana,Asi Ane redu Nadulu Ee Nagaram Vadda Ganga Nadilo kalavadam valana ee Nagaraniki Kashi Ane Peru Vachindi. Chalamandi Hinduvulu Ikkada Chanipothe Moksham Labhistundani namaakam. Poorvam Ikkada 72 thousand Temples Undevata. Saptha Moksha Margallo Okataina Ee kashi Nagarapu Visheshalanu, Ippati Varaku Meeru Ekkada Vinani Enno Rahasyalanu ee Audio book lo telusukondi.

kailasa-parvatham.title: Kailasa Parvatham
kailasa-parvatham.description: Ee parvatham meeda enno vinthalu, visheshalu pracharam lo unnayi. Alage sakshyalu kaligina nijalu unnayi. Moodu vandala kotla mandiki paiga aaradhinche ee parvatham gurinchi konni asakthikaramaina vishayalu thelusukondi. Ee parvatham yokka ethu 6.6 kilo meter lu. Avunu etthu gurinche matladuthunnam. Prapancham loni etthaina parvathalalo idi kuda okati.

অঘোরীর-অভিশাপ--লেখিকা--রিমা-গোস্বামী-দাস.title: অঘোরীর অভিশাপ | লেখিকা - রিমা গোস্বামী দাস

virgin-killings.title: Virgin Killings
virgin-killings.description:
రహస్యాలను రహస్యంగా ఉంచకుండా అందరికీ తెలియజేయాలనే ఇంట్రెస్ట్ ఉన్న పార్థు.. తన యూట్యూబ్ ఛానల్ ద్వారా పల్లెటూర్లలోని రహస్యాలను చెబుతుంటాడు. అలా ఒకరోజు ఫ్రెండ్స్ తో కలిసి రుద్రవనం వస్తాడు. రుద్రవనంలో అతనికి భస్మప్రేత గురించి తెలుస్తుంది. భస్మప్రేత ఎవరు? భస్మప్రేత వల్ల ఊరికి జరుగుతున్న నష్టం ఏంటి? రుద్రవనం రహస్యాలను పార్థు పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకున్నాడా..? క్షణ క్షణానికి ఉత్కంఠకు గురిచేసే "Virgin Killings" షో వినండి.. మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.  Parthu, who just can't keep secrets to himself, loves sharing mysteries with the world through his YouTube channel. He often explores the secrets hidden in remote villages. One day, along with his friends, he visits a place called Rudravanam. There, he learns about a mysterious entity called Bhasma Preta.

But who is Bhasma Preta?
What kind of harm is it causing to the village?
Did Parthu uncover all the secrets of Rudravanam?

Tune in to the edge-of-your-seat thriller "Virgin Killings", only on Kuku FM.

thru-namaatra.title: Thru Namaatra
thru-namaatra.description: ಕನ್ನಡದ ದಿನಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾದ 'ಉಳನ್ನದಿ ಅಡಿಗಳ' ಸಾಲಿನ ನಾಲ್ಕನೇ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊನೆಯ ಕೃತಿಯಿದು. ತ್ರಿನಮ್ರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 141 ಲೇಖನಗಳಿದ್ದು, ಲೇಖಕರ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದೈವ, ದೇಹಗಳ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಸಂವೇದನಾಶೀಲ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತೆರೆದ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದ ಬರೆಯಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಓದಲು ಸುಲಭವಾದ ಈ ಲೇಖನಗಳು ಮನನೀಯ, ಚಿಂತನಶೀಲ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕರ್ಷಕವಾಗಿವೆ. ಬಸ್ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಮಲಗುವ ಮೊದಲು ಒಂದು 'ಗುಳಿ'ಯಂತೆ ಓದಬಹುದು.

khunira-panchjon.title: Khunira Panchjon
khunira-panchjon.description: Jump into a world of diverse tales with Kuku FM's Short Stories. Perfect for listeners on the go our short stories offer quick escapes into fictional worlds. From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

bilupannu-kappu-maduvudu.title: ಬಿಳುಪನ್ನು ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡುವುದು
bilupannu-kappu-maduvudu.description: ನವಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಕಿರಿಯರ ಕಥಾಮಾಲೆ‘ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕಟವಾಗಿರುವ ಜಾಣ ಕಥೆಗಳು, ವಿವಿಧ ಲೇಖಕರ ಆಯ್ದ ಉತ್ತಮ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ. ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಸರಳ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದು ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಕುತೂಹಲ ಕೆರಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಮನರಂಜನೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ, ನಕ್ಕು ನಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಹಿರಿಯರಿಂದ ‘ನೀನು ಜಾಣ ಅಥವಾ ಜಾಣೆ’ ಎನ್ನಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹಂಬಲಿಸುವುದು ಸಹಜವಾದುದು. ಸದಾ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಿಡಿಮಿಡಿಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ತಂದೆ ತಾಯಿಯರು, ಮಕ್ಕಳು ನಿಜವಾದ ಜಾಣತನ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಿಸಿದಾಗಲಾದರೂ, ತಮ್ಮ ಜಿಪುಣತನ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಅವರ ಜಾಣತನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಾರೀಫು ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂಬ ಸಂದೇಶ ಸಹ ಈ ಕಥೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

global-warming.title: Global Warming
global-warming.description: గ్లోబల్ వార్మింగ్ అంటే ఏంటి ? ఈ ప్రమాదం గురించి మనకి ఎంతవరకు తెలుసు ? ఈ గ్లోబల్ వార్మింగ్ నుంచి బయట పడాలి అంటే మనం ఏం చెయ్యాలి ? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

mitti.title: Mitti
mitti.description: In the blood-soaked Partition of 1947, two lovers, Veer and Preet, are torn apart forever. Abducted across the border, Preet is stripped of her identity, forced into a new name, and trapped in a marriage she never chose. On the other side, Veer refuses to believe she is dead and spends years searching for the woman he loves, sacrificing everything in the process.  Will love triumph over history's deepest wounds, or will destiny bury their story forever in the very soil that once united them?

Mr-and-Miss-perfect--लेखक--गौरव-कुमार-.title: Mr and Miss perfect
Mr-and-Miss-perfect--लेखक--गौरव-कुमार-.description: अनुज-प्रभा की मुलिकात़ फेसबुक पर होती है। मिलते-मिलते इनके संबंध इतने गहरे हो जाते है कि वे एक-दूसरे के घर के सदस्य जैसे बन जाते है। तभी अनुज की लाइफ में एक लड़की आती है 'आशीष', जो अनुज की गलफ्रैंड बन जाती है।अनुज के साथ प्रभा का होना आशीष को खटकने लगता है, तो वहीं दूसरी ओर प्रभा को अनुज के साथ आशीष का होना खटकता है। अनुज अब दो पाटन के बीच फंस गया था। अनुज कैसे इस समस्‍या को दूर करेगा? इस लव ट्रायंगल में किसका प्‍यार जीतेगा और कौन होगा दूर? अनुज का दिल किसके लिए धड़कता है? जानने के लिए सुनें पूरी कहानी। .

corporate-salaga.title: Corporate salaga
corporate-salaga.description: The story is a corporate and romantic power struggle built around Mukherjee and Sons, where business control, family duty, and personal loyalty keep colliding. It begins with a short-selling attack and takeover pressure that threaten the company’s stability and force everyone into defensive moves. Jaiveer is repeatedly pulled into the conflict as both an insider and an outsider, while Sonia tries to protect the company without losing authority. Ronak remains a major rival figure, competing for credit, influence, and Sonia’s trust, and his role is repeatedly questioned as deals, bids, and alliances unravel. The conflict spreads through boardroom humiliation, public firings, and accusations of manipulation, bribery, and stolen recognition. A damaged watch, a disputed laptop, and other business losses become symbols of how personal pride turns into financial warfare. Sonia and Jaiveer’s relationship is strained by repeated rejection, broken engagement, and the sense that business decisions are shaping private feelings. At the same time, Naina emerges as another central emotional force, first tied to hidden feelings and later to a marriage proposal framed as a business merger. Her claim that she was being forced toward another marriage is eventually revealed to be false, and that confession shifts the emotional balance around Jay and the others. Jaiveer’s own loyalties remain divided between revenge over old wrongs and the people he has protected. Sonia admits that her feelings for him changed after he protected her from Raunak, but she also urges him to move beyond revenge. The company itself stays under pressure from contract battles, suspected fraud, and threats of dismissal or jail. As rivals expose one another and authority figures tighten control, the struggle becomes less about one deal and more about who deserves credit, power, and trust. By the end of the batch, the corporate war is still active, old resentments are unresolved, and the romantic ties remain tangled with business consequences. The show’s stakes are therefore both emotional and financial: whoever loses control of the company may also lose love, reputation, and future security.

trading-mein-hera-pheri.title: Trading Mein Hera Pheri
trading-mein-hera-pheri.description: Kya aap bhi minton mein crorepati banne ka sapna dekhte rehte hain? Agar han, Toh is show mein suniye, Kaise Dilraaj, Ashish aur Doctor Gujjar ne trading ke zariye, Jab apne is sapne ko sach karna chaha toh unke sath kya kya karname hue! Miss mat kariyega kyunki ye hai Real-life trading strategies aur shocking twists se bhara hua drama.

the-new-neighbor.title: The New Neighbor
the-new-neighbor.description:
After fifteen years of playing the same lottery numbers with unwavering dedication, Aidan Marlowe finally hits the jackpot—on the day he buries his wife. As he grapples with the whiplash of devastating loss and sudden astronomical wealth, Aidan sees the money as a chance to shield his young twins from their grief. A fresh start in a new town, a sprawling house far from painful memories—it seems like the perfect escape.
But wealth, Aidan discovers, is a spotlight that illuminates the darkest corners of his life. As his family settles into their lavish new existence, unsettling signs suggest they haven't left their past behind at all. Someone has followed them, someone who knows the painful secrets they're running from. As the shadows around them deepen, Aidan realizes that his lottery win wasn't a stroke of luck—it was the beginning of a meticulously orchestrated nightmare. And this mysterious watcher will methodically dismantle everything he has left, piece by piece.

मिरर-मैन--लेखक--प्रशांत-शर्मा.description: Raghav Apni Pehli Wedding Anniversary celebrate karne ke liye Samundra ke kinare ek shandhar party rakta hei. party mei ek bhayanak saaya asmaan mei mandrane lagta hei. matha.description:
"ಮಠ", ಗುರುದತ್ತ್ ಅವರ ನಿರ್ದೇಶನದ ಸೊಗಸಾದ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ, ಇದು ನಮ್ಮ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ವರ್ತನೆ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ವಂದ್ವದ ಅನಾವರಣವನ್ನು ಕರುಣೆಯೂ ಹಾಸ್ಯದಿಂದಲೂ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ಈ ಕಥೆಯು ಮಠದ ಒಳಗಿನ ಗೊಂದಲ, ಗುರು-ಶಿಷ್ಯರ ಸಂಬಂಧ, ಹಾಗೂ ಧರ್ಮದ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ವ್ಯಂಗ್ಯಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಕಟುಕವಾದ ಘಟನಾವಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದೆ. 
ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ಹೊರಗಿನ ಧೂಳಾದ ಆಕರ್ಷಕ ಚಿತ್ರಣ ಮತ್ತು ಒಳಗಿನ ಸತ್ಯದ ನಡುವಿನ ತಾರತಮ್ಯವನ್ನು ಬಿಂಬಿಸುವ "ಮಠ" ನಮ್ಮ ಸಮಾಜಿಕೆಯ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯನ್ನು ಹಾಸ್ಯದ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತಲುಪಿಸುವ ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ.

mahaveer-ansh.title: Mahaveer Ansh
mahaveer-ansh.description: The story centers on a widening conflict between the sacred ascetics of Gandhamadana and the Agnipankhi royal dynasty that seeks to seize the mountain’s spiritual power. Rudra and other ascetic figures repeatedly refuse to bow, surrender their robes, or abandon their tapasya, turning every royal demand into a test of dharma against force. Prince Yuvraj Suryabhan answers resistance with soldiers, fire rituals, poison, and increasingly destructive formations. Devavrat serves as a key military figure in the royal camp, but he is repeatedly shaken by what he sees and warns that arrogance and brute force will not secure victory. The royal side’s plans grow darker as hidden massacres, life-force draining tactics, and the use of tapasvis as fuel for power are exposed. A mysterious ascetic emerges as the central obstacle to royal domination, surviving attacks that should have destroyed him and revealing a strength beyond ordinary human limits. The conflict expands from isolated confrontations into a full siege that traps the vanvasi people inside Gandhamadana. The royal army attempts to break the resistance through the twelve pillars attack and other ritual formations, but these efforts repeatedly fail or turn unstable. Devavrat also uncovers hidden interference and secret missions around the sacred south pillar, suggesting that the battle is being undermined from within as well as resisted from without. As the prince grows more desperate, he orders harsher punishments and another round of ritual assault. Yet each escalation only deepens the sense that the ascetic side cannot be subdued by ordinary violence. The mysterious ascetic is eventually shown to have taken control of the intended weapon, reversing the royal plan against its makers. When the final formation is activated, the trapped ascetic does not break, but absorbs its divine energy instead. That shocking survival raises the stakes even higher and leaves the royal forces facing an enemy they still do not understand. The struggle then moves into a more formal arena, where sacred law and public judgment begin to challenge royal authority. At Gandhamadana, a trial is declared to decide legitimacy and rule, showing that the conflict is no longer only military but also spiritual and political. By the end of the batch, a new outsider steps in to confront the ruler directly, interrupting the prince’s attempt to dominate the contest and keeping the outcome unresolved.
