Swadhinotar jonnyo bharater lorai ebong atytyager shuru ei ghotona theke, ei alipore boma kando theke. Ei boma hamlar bhoybohota jemon desh bashi ke ek kore diyechilo temon anupreronao jogiye diyechilo. Ki ki hoi ei AAlipore boma kande? Bhatrater swadhinotar lorai ki bhabe shuru hoi, British somrajyobaader theke nijeder kibhabe bachalen bharat, jante shune nin ei auido story ti.

investment-in-precious-metals-gemstones.title: Investment in Precious Metals & Gemstones
investment-in-precious-metals-gemstones.description: Kya aapko bhi Stock Market investment se dar lagta hai, kyuki ye investment method aapke risk appetite ko suit nahi karta? Agar aap ye risk lena nahi chahte aur koi safe aur accha return dene wala investment ka tareeka dhund rahe hain, toh ye show aap hi ke liye hai. Stock Market ke mushkil niyamo se alag ek aisa investment ka zariya jo sadiyon se chala aa raha hai. Chaliye ise acche se samjhte hain. Agar aapko One Up On Wall Street jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

how-to-earn-by-creating-meme.title: How To Earn By Making Memes
how-to-earn-by-creating-meme.description: Beete kuch saalo mein meme making sirf ek shauk hi nahi reh gaya hai, balki ab yeh ek profession ke taur pe bhi seriously liya ja raha. Kabhi sirf entertainment ka part rahi meme, aapke samne ab ek meme creator ke profession ka darwaja bhi khol rahi hai kyuki aaj har badi company memetic marketing ko apna rahi hai. To agar aap creative hai aur meme banana jante hai to iss talent ko profession mein kaise convert karna hai, janiye iss audiobook mein

albert-einstein-3.title: Albert Einstein
albert-einstein-3.description: Ariviyal Medhai Albert Einstein avargalin vaazhkai varalaatraiyum , avaradhu kandupidippaana E=MC^2 in thelivaana Vilakkathaiyum Indha Padhivil kelungal, ungal KUKU FM il.

panama-papers-1.title: Panama Papers Explained
panama-papers-1.description: Panama Papers ek esa sach jisne 3 April 2016 ko, 1 crore 15 lakh ese documents ko duniya ke samne la kar rakh diya tha, jisse sirf aam insaan hi nahi balki, desh videsh ki kai jaani mani hastiyaan bhi hairaan reh gayi thi. International Journalists ke banaye gaye ek secretive group ne is investigation ko kuch is trah anjaam diya ki isme aane wale naam aur isse farq padne wali companies aaj bhi ubhar nahi pai hai. Panama papers se Jude har naam, corruption aur dusre gair kanooni sach ko janne ke leye sunne, “Panama Papers Explained” Sirf KUKU FM par.

a-kite-of-farewell-stories-from-nagaland.title: A Kite of Farewell: Stories from Nagaland
a-kite-of-farewell-stories-from-nagaland.description: A captivating collection of stories rooted in the landscapes, traditions and lives of Nagaland. “A Kite of Farewell” explores themes of relationships, memories, separation, hope and the changing world through deeply human experiences. Each story offers a glimpse into the culture, society and emotions of Northeast India, bringing its people and their journeys to life. This audiobook takes listeners into a world where every character carries a unique memory, a personal struggle and a story worth remembering.

bhul-koreo-ei-bhabna-gulo-mathay-anben-n.title: Bhul Koreo Ei Bhabna Gulo Mathay Anben Na
bhul-koreo-ei-bhabna-gulo-mathay-anben-n.description: Amara dara kichu hobe na. AMi kichu korei uthte pari na. Ami holam sokoler bojha. Ashole ami kono kichur joggyo noi. Amake keu bhalobase na. Boddo eka lagche. Kichhu bhalo lageche na amar. Ei protyekta kothayi amader sokoleri kokhono na kokhono mone hoyeche. Amader sokoleri mone hoyeche je amaderi jeno kono khamti ache,amra anek kichur jonnyoi depression e chole jayi, nijeder ke opoya hishebe dhore ni. EI chinta bhabna jodi apnadero hoye thake, tahole shune nin ei audiostory ti.

the-kings-obsession.title: THE KING'S OBSESSION
the-kings-obsession.description:
London heiress Ananya travels to the misty hills of Munnar to settle a family dispute, but instead falls into the hands of Devan, a ruthless plantation lord with a dangerous grudge.

When betrayal tears her family apart, Ananya discovers that the only man powerful enough to protect her is the same man she once feared. Now Devan must leave his mountain kingdom, destroy her enemies and claim their love before Kerala’s powerful dynasties tear them apart.

gandhi-banaam-ambedkar-jaati-ka-sawaal.title: Gandhi Banaam Ambedkar Jaati Ka Sawaal
gandhi-banaam-ambedkar-jaati-ka-sawaal.description: Gandhi Banaam Ambedkar Jaati Ka Sawaal

the-memory-game.title: The Memory game
the-memory-game.description: விபத்தில் சிக்கி நினைவுகளை இழந்ததாக நினைக்கப்படும் சுருதியை, அவளது கணவன் அர்ஜுனும் தோழி தர்ஷனாவும் பொய்களால் கட்டுப்படுத்துகிறார்கள். அப்போது விக்ரம், தான்தான் சுருதியின் உண்மையான கணவன் என்கிறார். உண்மை என்ன என்பதைத் தேடும் சுருதிக்கு துரோகம், சொத்து மோசடி, கொலைச் சதி என பல ரகசியங்கள் தெரியவருகின்றன. ஆனால் சுருதியும் ஒரு ரகசிய விளையாட்டை ஆடிக்கொண்டிருக்கிறாள்—அவள் உண்மையில் எல்லாவற்றையும் மறக்கவில்லை.

doctors-vs-billionaires-6.title: Doctors vs Billionaires
doctors-vs-billionaires-6.description: अब्जाधीश नीलिमा आणि रोशन यांच्या रस्त्यावरील उद्धटपणामुळे एक तज्ज्ञ डॉक्टर त्यांच्याच गंभीर आजारी मुलीवर उपचार करण्यासाठी वेळेवर पोहोचू शकत नाही. किरकोळ अपघातावरून डॉक्टरला अपमानित करणे, कागदपत्रे जाळणे आणि ५० लाखांची खंडणी मागणे अशा गंभीर घटना घडतात. मुलीचा जीव धोक्यात असल्याचे सत्य उघड झाल्यावर, डॉक्टर आणि वेळेची शर्यत त्यांना त्यांच्या गर्वाच्या भयानक परिणामांची जाणीव करून देते.

the-power-of-rhythm.title: The Power Of Rhythm
the-power-of-rhythm.description:
రితమ్ అనేది జీవన గమనం, క్రమం, మరియు సరళితని ప్రతిబింబించే ఆధ్యాత్మిక మూలం. ఇది కేవలం శబ్దాల సమాహారం లేదా గమనికల సమన్వయం కాదు, మన ఆత్మలోని గుండెచప్పుళ్ల నుంచి విశ్వంలోని నక్షత్రాల చలనాల వరకు, ప్రతీ ప్రక్రియలో దాగి ఉన్న శక్తి.

రితమ్ శక్తి అనేది అనుసంధానం యొక్క గమ్యం – అది భిన్న భావనలను, భావోద్వేగాలను ఒకే స్రవంతిలో ఉంచి, మన లోతుల్లో ఒక స్థిరత్వాన్ని సృష్టిస్తుంది. ఇది శరీరంలో రక్తం ప్రవహించే పద్ధతికి, మనస్సులో ఆలోచనల క్రమానికి, మరియు ఆత్మలో ప్రేరణ పొందే సంగీతానికీ సమానంగా పనిచేస్తుంది.

రితమ్ మన అంతరంగానికి ఒక నడక సూత్రం, ఇది ప్రతి చర్యను తక్కువ శక్తితో ఎక్కువ ఫలితాన్ని సాధించడానికి మలచుతుంది. ఇది ప్రాణశక్తికి, మనసు స్థితికి, మరియు శారీరక చలనలకు మధ్య సమతుల్యతను నెలకొల్పుతుంది. ఈ క్రమం మనలో స్థిరమైన శక్తిని, సృష్టి శక్తిని, మరియు సంతృప్తిని జాగృతం చేస్తుంది.

hotel-paradise.title: হোটেল রয়াল প্যারাডাইস | লেখিকা - রিমা গোস্বামী
hotel-paradise.description: ছোটবেলা থেকে কষ্ট করে বড় হওয়া হর্ষবর্ধন ও তার বোন শুভ্রাঙ্গী এখন বিশাল হোটেল রয়েল প্যারাডাইসের পার্টনার। কিন্তু অতীত কারনে হর্ষ বিবাহিত জীবনকে ঘৃণা করে। শুভ্রাঙ্গী হোটেলের কর্মী ফারহাদের সঙ্গে বেশি মিশলে তা হর্ষবর্ধনের চোখে পড়ে আর তার কিছুদিন পরেই ভ্যালেন্টাইনস ডের দিন ছাদ থেকে পড়ে মৃত্যু হয় ফারহাদের।

bloody-teddy-4.title: Bloody Teddy
bloody-teddy-4.description: Silicon Valley of India  “Bengaluru” me Serial Killer “Bloody Teddy” ki dahshat se koi nahi bacha , Har ek subah naya murder case aur unhi dead bodies ke tukdon me alag hue  body parts is baat ka saboot the ki shahar me Law & Order fail ho chuka hai. Evidence ke naam pe sirf dead bodies ke kate hue parts aur unpe likhe “Bloody Teddy” ke naam ke alawa Killer ke khilaaf kuch bhi nahi mila. Police se le kar Junta tak me bas yahi sawal dahshat macha rakha hai ki Aakhir Kaun hai ye Serial  Killer “Bloody Teddy” Kyun hai ye itna beraham qatil aur kab tak iske hanthon bekasooron ka Qatl aur unki body ke sath khooni khel khela jayega ?

pecularism.title: పెక్యులరిజం
pecularism.description: మైనారిటీలకున్న రాజ్యాంగ హక్కులకు మెజారిటీ హిందువులు నోచుకోరా? ఎందుకీ వివక్ష ? ఎక్కడుంది లోపం? ఎం.వి.ఆర్. శాస్త్రి విశ్లేషణ పెక్యులరిజం దేశ హితాన్ని కోరే ప్రతి భారత పౌరుడూ వినాల్సిన సరికొత్త ఆడియో బుక్.

hogi-baa-magale.title: Hogi Baa Magale
hogi-baa-magale.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

kitne-chaurahe.title: Kitne Chaurahe
kitne-chaurahe.description: Travel back in time with Kuku FM's History shows. Explore ancient civilizations pivotal moments and the people who shaped our world. Our engaging storytelling brings history to life making the past relevant and exciting. From legendary battles to cultural revolutions enrich your knowledge of the human saga. Listen and connect with the stories that define us

best-places-to-retire-and-settle-in-indi.description: Oru planning illathe ningal retirementilek kadannal, ningalude swapna thulyamaaya suvarnna varshangal athra suvarnnamayirikkilla. Sthira thaamasamakanum santhoshakaranamaya neenda viramikkal jeevitham aaswadhikkanum Indiayile chila mikacha sthalangale kurichch kelku.

kamala-das.description: Kamala Das aka Madhavikutty aka Aami, Indiayile ettavum priyappettathum vivaadhaparavumaaya saahithyrakaril oraalanu. Pranayatheyum Aagrahatheyum kurich oru aathmakadhaparamaya cult classic ezhuthiya aadhya Indian vanithayayi avare vaazhthapedukayum aakshepikkapedukayum cheythu. Aaradhakar avale visheshipichath The First Feminist Emotional Revolutionary of Our Time" and 'The Love Queen of Malabar' ennum aanu.

digital-pralay.title: AI - Beyond Humanity
digital-pralay.description: AI jisne hmaare saare kaam ko aasaan kar diya hai jo hmaare day to day life ka ek hissa ban gaya hai kya ho agar wo  insaaniyat ke hiton ko bhool jaaye, to kya insaan aur AI ek saath jee paayenge? Kya hoga Agar AI ne kiya is duniya pe rule jaanane ke liye sunein poori kahaani sirf KUKU FM par.

sardar-patel-2.title: Sardar Patel
sardar-patel-2.description: Ye biography aapko batayegi Sardar Patel ke asadharan yogdan, Gandhi ke satyagraphon aur Bhartiya swatantrata sangram ko unke athak samarthan se, ek majboot, united Bharat ke nirman mein unki doordarshi aur sahsi drishtikon ke liye! Agar aapko India after Gandhi jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunien.

ten-principal-upanishads.title: Ten Principal Upanishads
ten-principal-upanishads.description: ചോദ്യങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞ ജീവിതത്തിനു, ഉത്തരങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞ ഉപനിഷത്തുകൾ. ലളിതമായ മലയാളത്തിൽ, ആയിരം വർഷങ്ങളുടെ ജ്ഞാനം നിമിഷങ്ങൾക്കുള്ളിൽ നേടൂ, കുക്കൂ എഫ് എമ്മിൽ!

qatal-ki-wo-raat.title: Qatal Ki Wo Raat
qatal-ki-wo-raat.description: Ek politician ek din achanak se apne kamre mein mara hua milta hai. Ghar walon ke alawa koi us ghar mein nahin aaya tha. Phir kisne mara tha use? Aur kyun?  Ye janne ke liye sunein rahasay aur romanch se bhara hamara ye show....

the-father-of-hindutva-veer-savarkar.title: The Father of Hindutva - Veer Savarkar
the-father-of-hindutva-veer-savarkar.description: Yeh kahaani hai ek aise freedom fighter ki jinhone congress se 20 saal pehle complete independence ke naare lagaaye but Quit India Movement mein shaamil nahi hue. Yeh kahaani hai unpe hue angrezon ke atyaachar ki, unke kalam se nikali kavitaon ki aur ek sacche Hindutva ki.

వేమన-పద్యాలు.title: వేమన పద్యాలు
వేమన-పద్యాలు.description: సమాజంలో ఉండే మంచి విషయాలను చిన్న పిల్లలు, చదువులేని వారు కూడా అర్థం చేసుకొనే విధంగా చిన్న చిన్న పదాలతో రాసిన పద్యాలను గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "వేమన పద్యాలు" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ ని వినండి.

మెట్రో-ముచ్చట్లు.title: మెట్రో ముచ్చట్లు
మెట్రో-ముచ్చట్లు.description: కీర్తి.. మేఘన.. రిషి.. అర్జున్.. ఎన్నో ఆశలు మరెన్నో ఆశయాలతో  MBA ప్రయాణంలో కలుసుకున్న ఓ నలుగురు స్నేహితులు. ఆ మెట్రో సిటీ లో వాళ్ళ మధురమైన జ్ఞాపకాలు, మరచిపోలేని అనుభవాలు, అల్లుకున్న బంధాలు, పంచుకున్న కష్టాలు,  నేర్చుకున్న పాఠాలు, మీరు కూడా తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో సిరీస్ వినాల్సిందే.!

ben-stokes.description: 2016, 20-20 WC Last Over la Carlos Brathwaite adicha 4 sixer la England oda world cup kanavu norungi pochu. Andha last over ah bowl pannadu Ben Stokes. make-yourself-layoff-proof.description:
|Key Learnings- Upskilling, Networking & Adaptability| 
Job security ki guarantee chahiye? Humesha demand mein rehna hai? Ye show aapko batayega kaise! Seekhiye adaptability aur branding ke master tips aur baniye LAYOFF PROOF.

indias-most-cruelest-serial-killers.title: India's Most Cruelest Serial Killers
indias-most-cruelest-serial-killers.description:
ഇരുട്ടിന്റെ മറവില്‍ കൊലപാതക പരമ്പരകള്‍ നടത്തി സമൂഹത്തിനെ ഭീതിയിലാഴ്ത്തുന്ന സീരിയല്‍ കില്ലര്‍മാരെ നാം സിനിമകളില്‍ കണ്ടിട്ടുണ്ട്. എന്നാല്‍ എത്ര റിയല്‍ ലൈഫ് സീരിയല്‍ കില്ലര്‍മാരെക്കുറിച്ച് നിങ്ങള്‍ കേട്ടിട്ടുണ്ട്. അവരുടെ ക്രൂരകൃത്യങ്ങള്‍ സമൂഹത്തെ ഭയത്തിന്റെ മുനയില്‍ നിര്‍ത്തിയത് എങ്ങിനെയാണ്. എന്താണ് ഇവരുടെയെല്ലാം മോട്ടീവ്.
നമ്മുടെ ഇന്ത്യൻ ജനതയെ ഞെട്ടിച്ച ചില സീരിയല്‍ കില്ലേഴ്സിന്റെ ക്രൂരമായ കുറ്റ കൃത്യങ്ങളെ കുറിച്ച് കേൾക്കാം .

lights-camera-action-indian-cinema.title: Lights Camera Action - Indian Cinema
lights-camera-action-indian-cinema.description: Manalo chaala mandhiki cinema ante istam, istam ani kakunda picchi ani kuda cheppukovachu. manaki emi unna lekapoyina cinema lekunda matram undalemu aithe meelo entha mandhiki mana cinema ela puttindi anedi telusu? evari vaalla cinema prarambham ayindi? cinema vallaki iche awards evaru modalu pettaru ila chaala vishyalu manalo aneka mandhiki aithe telidu anduke memu meekosam ee audio book tesukonivachamu.!

অদৃশ্য-শিকল--লেখিকা--শেলী-ভট্টাচার্জী.title: Adrishya Shikal
অদৃশ্য-শিকল--লেখিকা--শেলী-ভট্টাচার্জী.description: Gobhir prem hoi neshar moto, bichhedeo shey joriye thake adrishyer shikole. Corporate companyr uchhopode chakrirotot Aniruddha hotath solo trip e beriye pore Vizag, songe sudhu tar otit romonthon. Kothaye palachhe shey ebong kar thekei ba palachhe jante hole shune nin Love genre er ei audio story ti.

കുഞ്ഞാലി-മരക്കാർ--ധീര-രക്തസാക്ഷി.title: കുഞ്ഞാലി മരക്കാർ - ധീര രക്തസാക്ഷി
കുഞ്ഞാലി-മരക്കാർ--ധീര-രക്തസാക്ഷി.description: കടലിന്റെ തിരമാലകളേയും കൊടുങ്കാറ്റുകളേയും സാക്ഷിയാക്കി, രാജ്യത്തിന്റെ സമ്പത്തു കൊള്ളയടിക്കാൻ  വന്ന ശക്തികൾക്കെതിരെ പൊരുതിയ മഹാനായ പോരാളി.പോർച്ചുഗീസുകാരെ ചെറുത്ത പടനേതാവ്, ആധിപത്യശക്തികൾക്കെതിരെയുള്ള പ്രതിരോധത്തിന്റെ പ്രതീകം. ചരിത്രം മറന്ന ഈ വീരനെ നാം വീണ്ടും ഓർക്കുമ്പോൾ,  അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ അജയ്യമായ ധൈര്യവും രക്തസാക്ഷിത്വവും നമ്മുടെ മനസ്സിൽ പടർന്നൊഴുകും.

oru-koorvaalin-nizhalil.title: Oru Koorvaalin Nizhalil
oru-koorvaalin-nizhalil.description: இது ஒரு போராளியின் கதை. ஐநூறுபேர் கொண்ட படையணியை வழிநடத்திய அரசியல் துறைப் பொறுப்பாளரின் கதை. பெருமதிமிக்க போராளியின் ஒப்புதல் வாக்குமூலம்.

red-flags-and-rising-voices-a-labour-day.title: Red Flags and Rising Voices: A Labour Day Legacy
red-flags-and-rising-voices-a-labour-day.description: బానిసత్వం వ్యతిరేకంగా, శ్రమదోపిడీని ఎదురిస్తూ కార్మిక లోకం కీలక హక్కులు సాధించుకున్న దినం మే డే. శ్రమకు తగిన గుర్తింపు, సరైన వేతనం, రోజుకు 8 గంటల పని హక్కును కార్మికులు పోరాడి సాధించుకున్న ఈ రోజు(మే 1)ను ఇండియా సహా వందలాది దేశాలు ప్రపంచ కార్మిక దినోత్సవంగా జరుపుకొంటాయి.

in-plain-sight.title: In Plain Sight
in-plain-sight.description: Mumbai ki chakachaundh ke peeche chhipi crime ki ek rongte khade kar dene wali kahani. Shahar mein ek ke baad ek sansanikhez murder hone lagte hain aur police ke saamne ek shaatir kaatil ki chunauti khadi ho jaati hai, jo har baar saboot mita deta hai. Tab young reporter Rohan sach ki tah tak pahunchne ke liye apni jaan jokhim mein daal deta hai. Kya Rohan aur police milkar is anjaane kaatil ko benakaab kar paayenge? Sunein 'In Plain Sight' sirf Kuku FM par!

how-to-invest-in-real-estate.title: ₹500 Se Karo Real Estate Investment
how-to-invest-in-real-estate.description: Aajkal investment ke bahut saare options hain lekin agar ek kum risk aur zyada profit dene wale investment option ki baat karein toh vo hai real estate. Bas Investment se pehle real estate se judi har ek jaankari aapke paas honi chahiye, Jo ki aapko KUKU FM ke is original show mein milne wali hai.

boss-ya-bhediya-1.title: Boss Ya Bhediya
boss-ya-bhediya-1.description: Jab ek simple si ladki Sangeeta jungle se guzarte waqt ek bhediye ka shikaar banne se bachti hai, usse kya pata tha ki uski zindagi ek aise khel ka hissa banne wali hai jahan jaan, izzat aur dil — sab kuch daav par lagne wala hai. Bhediye se bachate waqt uska saamna hota hai Randhir, ek dangerous aur dashing alpha jiske apne bhi raaz hain. Sangeeta chahti hai apni normal zindagi, lekin Randhir ke secrets aur ek anjaani attraction se woh bandh jaati hai. Jab desire aur danger ke beech Sangeeta ka sach se saamna hota hai, toh kya woh apni aazadi bacha payegi ya ban jaayegi is dark khel ka permanent hissa?

how-to-manage-money-like-a-pro-1.title: How To Manage Money Like A Pro
how-to-manage-money-like-a-pro-1.description: "How to Manage Money Like a Pro" is your essential guide to mastering personal finance. In this comprehensive audiobook, you'll discover the secrets to achieving financial security, making smart investments, and building a prosperous future. From budgeting and saving to investing and retirement planning, you'll gain the knowledge and confidence needed to take control of your finances. Start your journey toward financial mastery today with this invaluable resource.

chanakya-in-daily-life.title: Apnaye Chanakyaneeti har roz
chanakya-in-daily-life.description: Hamare dainik jeevan ke saath corporate jeevan k prabandhan kaise kare, workplace aur ghar ka balance kaise banaye rakhe. baccho ke saath values kaise jode aur ghar ko kaise sambhale. Aise 360 degree mein margadarshan karne wali ye book summary zaroor sunein! Agar aapko "Chanakya In Daily Life" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

jayalalitha-puratchithalaiviyude-katha.title: ജയലളിത - പുരട്ച്ചിത്തലൈവിയുടെ കഥ
jayalalitha-puratchithalaiviyude-katha.description: പുരുഷാധിപത്യം കൊടികുത്തിവാഴുന്ന രണ്ടുമേഖലകളാണ് സിനിമയും രാഷ്ട്രീയവും. ഈ രണ്ടിടങ്ങളിലും തന്റെ ആത്മവിശ്വാസം, എതിര്‍പ്പുകളെ നേരിടാനുള്ള ചങ്കുറപ്പ് എന്നിവകൊണ്ട് തനിക്കുള്ള സിംഹാസനം വലിച്ചിട്ട്, കാല്‍ മേല്‍ കാല്‍ കയറ്റിവച്ച് കയറിയിരുന്ന് അരങ്ങുവാണ ഒരത്ഭുത വനിതയുടെ കഥ.

rise-of-the-foreign-power-in-india.title: Rise of the Foreign Power in India
rise-of-the-foreign-power-in-india.description: India 1947 la sudhanthiram vanguradhuku munnadi varaikum, namma naatu selvangalai pala veli naatu mannargal kollai adichutu pona kadhaigal pala naama ketrupom. Mughals mudhal East India Company varai, India'vai aatchi seidha velinaatu sakthigal patri therindhu kolla kelunga "Rise of Foreign Powers in India" on Kuku FM

the-nationalist.title: Anil Naik: The Man Behind L&T’s Legacy
the-nationalist.description: Kaise Anil Naik ne L&T ko global technology powerhouse banaya, jabki Ambanis aur Birlas jaise industrial giants bhi is par nazar lagaaye baithe the? Yeh audiobook aapko ek aise leader ki soch aur strategy sunayegi, jinhone apni nationalism aur leadership skills ka istemaal karke impossible ko possible banaya. Agar aapko business aur leadership se inspire hona hai, toh yeh audiobook aapke liye hai!

mahasamar-3-karma-1.title: Mahasamar 3: Karma
mahasamar-3-karma-1.description: After escaping the fire at Varnavat, the Pandavas live in hiding. They have no kingdom and no name, only their deeds. They wander the forests fighting to survive, reach Draupadi’s swayamvar, and then build Indraprastha out of the wasteland of Khandavaprastha. Karma, the third book of Narendra Kohli’s Mahasamar, asks: when fate turns its back, is action all a person has left?

uppu-kanakku.title: உப்பு கணக்கு
uppu-kanakku.description: வேதாரண்யம் உப்பு சத்தியாக்கிரகம் தொடங்கி பாகிஸ்தான் பிரிவினை வரையிலான பின்னணியில் அழகான குடும்பக் கதையோடு காதலும் கலந்து சொல்லப்பட்டிருக்கும் உன்னத படைப்பு. நம் சரித்திரத்தை அறிந்து கொள்ள அவசியம் படிக்க வேண்டிய புதினம் இது.

focus-coffeehouse-jazz-hop.title: Focus: Cafe Beats
focus-coffeehouse-jazz-hop.description: Warm café-inspired beats and ambient sounds that create a cozy atmosphere for studying, working, and staying focused.

notes-on-a-nervous-planet-1.title: Internet Aamader Kivabe Provabito Kore ?
notes-on-a-nervous-planet-1.description: Ei Audiobook E Aapni Jante Parben Society, Culture,Technology, Science Ebong Internet Er Provab Somporke. Songe Jante Parben Manusher Bikash Somporkeo. Jante Parben Kivabe Dhoirjyo Rekhe Sob Poristhiti Samlaben. Echarao Onek Jana- Ojana Kotha Bola Royeche Ei Boite. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak.

marmayogi-nostradamus.title: Marmayogi Nostradamus
marmayogi-nostradamus.description:
9/11 Attack, சுனாமி, உலகம் அழியப் போற நாள் உட்பட பல சம்பவங்களை 16ஆம் நூற்றாண்டு’லயே கணிச்சவர் தான் இந்த Nostradamus.
யார் அவர்? பெரிய ஜோசியகாரரா? ஹூம்ம்...அதுக்கும் மேல. கேளுங்க “Marmayogi Nostradamus”

joy-of-missing-out.title: Joy Of Missing Out
joy-of-missing-out.description:
FOMO Se Zyada Maza, JOMO Mein Hai!
{Key Ideas Explained}

a-revenge-so-good.title: A Revenge So Good
a-revenge-so-good.description: "A battered wife flees her abusive, wealthy husband with the help of a supportive friend, only to discover she's entangled in a web of family secrets, corporate scandals, and unexpected betrayals that threaten to pull her back into the gilded cage she desperately tried to escape."

badrachalam.title: Badrachalam
badrachalam.description: Poorvam Bhadrudu ane bhakthudu Sri Ramudi kosam thapassu chesi, thanu oka kondagaa maari thanapai Sri Ramudu velase vidhmgaa varam pondadani antaaru. Aa kondaku Bhadhrudu peru meeda Bhadragiri ani tharuvatha Bhadrachalam ani peru vachindi.

modala-hejje.title: Modala Hejje
modala-hejje.description: 'ಮೊದಲ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ' ಕನ್ನಡದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಲೇಖಕಿ ತ್ರಿವೇಣಿ ಅವರ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಮಾನವ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜದ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಓದುಗರಿಂದ ಉತ್ತಮ ವಿಮರ್ಶೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆದಿದೆ.

the-silent-war-under-the-sea.title: The Silent War Under The Sea
the-silent-war-under-the-sea.description: Beneath the world's oceans, a silent battle is unfolding. Submarines, underwater cables, surveillance systems and naval powers are competing for strategic advantage in a battlefield the public rarely sees. The Silent War Under the Sea explores the hidden technology, military strategy and geopolitical rivalries beneath the surface—and reveals why control of the oceans could shape the future of global power.

start-a-side-business-in-2025.title: Start a Side Business in 2025
start-a-side-business-in-2025.description: Starting a side business in 2025 means launching a business venture alongside your primary job to generate extra income, pursue passions, or build a potential future career, while also allowing you to test the viability of your ideas. Get exciting ideas on "Start a Side Business in 2025" exclusively from KUKU FM!

ಊರ್ಮಿಳ.title: Urmila
ಊರ್ಮಿಳ.description: ಶ್ರೀ ವಾಲ್ಮೀಕಿ ರಾಮಾಯಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕವಿ ಕಡೆಗಣಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠವಾದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವವೆಂದರೆ ಊರ್ಮಿಳೆ! ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಣನು ಪ್ರಭು ಶ್ರೀರಾಮಚಂದ್ರನ ೧೪ ವರ್ಷದ ಸುಧೀರ್ಘ ವನವಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಜೊತೆಯಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಸಹೋದರ ಧರ್ಮವನ್ನೇನೋ ಮೆರೆದ. ಆದರೆ ಅರಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತು ಅಂತರಂಗದಲ್ಲೇ ಕಠೋರ ವನವಾಸ ಮಾಡಿದ ಊರ್ಮಿಳೆಯ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್ "ಊರ್ಮಿಳ" ಕೇಳಿ Kuku FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

trending-music-stories-poduvadhu-eppadi.title: Trending Music Stories Poduvadhu Eppadi ?
trending-music-stories-poduvadhu-eppadi.description: Music vachu trending stories poduradhu eppadi nu kathukka indha video va paarunga

aakhiri-mission.title: Aakhiri Mission
aakhiri-mission.description: Ek anjaan sheher Montenegro ki thandi hawaaon mein, fearless secret agent John apne sabse khatarnak mission par hai. Kanchan, ek rahasyamay aur chalak target, ke peeche bhagte hue, wo sajishon aur dhokebazon ke jaal mein ulajh jata hai. Kya woh Kanchan ke khatarnak raazon ka parda faash kar paayega, ya khud ek saazish ka shikar ban jayega? Suniye hmare is thrilling show ‘Aakhiri Mission’ me.

why-discipline-is-so-hard.title: Why Discipline Is So Hard
why-discipline-is-so-hard.description: What if you're not lazy and your lack of discipline isn't the real problem? Why does one notification steal your focus? Why does five minutes of scrolling turn into an hour? And why do we keep choosing comfort over our long-term goals? Why Is Discipline So Hard? breaks down the science of attention, dopamine, habits and self-control through simple stories and practical insights. No guilt, no motivation hacks—just a better understanding of how your mind works and how to make it work for you.

pratikar.title: Pratikar
pratikar.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

doglapan-by-ashneer-grover-1.title: Doglapan: The Hard Truth about Life and Start-Ups
doglapan-by-ashneer-grover-1.description: Shark Tank India madhil ek judge, jyane aplya Tikhat Comments ni sampurna India che laksha swatahkade wedhun ghetle. Pan teva tyancha ayushyat ek weglach Vadal gongavat hota. Ka tyana swtachach Companytun baher padava lagla? BhartPe ne ratorat ka tyanche sarva adhikar hiskavun ghetle? Kay hote Satya je jagasamor alech nahi? “Doglapan: The Hard Truth about Life and Start-ups” ya audio book dvare aikuya, Entrepreneur Ashneer Grover yanchi kahani- tyanchach Jubani.

the-magic-ladder-to-success.title: The Magic Ladder to Success
the-magic-ladder-to-success.description: Large Businessmans, Investors Vaari Business Sucess Kosam em chestaru? Vaari Business ni New heights ki Teesukelladaniki Vaalu Vade Formula Emiti? Deenikosam Emaina Magic Ladder unda? Ute Mari A Magic ni ela Cheyali? nDanikosam Manam Marchukovalsina Vishayala gurinchi Ee book lo Vivarinchadam Jarigindi.

how-memes-changed-political-movements.title: How Memes Changed Political Movements
how-memes-changed-political-movements.description:
పోలిటిక్స్ అంటే ఓటు కాదు బ్రదర్... ఇప్పుడు ఫార్వర్డ్ అయ్యే మీమ్‌ ఎంత వైరల్ అయ్యిందన్నదే విషయమవుతోంది!
రాహుల్ గాంధీ నుంచి మోడీ వరకూ, పార్టీ జెండాల నుంచి ట్రోలింగ్ పేజీల దాకా — ఎవ్వరూ తప్పించుకోలేని నవ్వుల తిరుగుబాటే ఇది.
'How Memes Changed Political Movements' – నవ్వుతూ దేశాన్ని మార్చిన మీమ్‌ల గుట్టు విప్పే ఓ బోల్డ్, ఫన్నీ జర్నీ!

india-automated-1.title: India Automated

Jaanlewa Barish
The uniqueness of the thriller genre is that it keeps you guessing about what next! Your heart keeps on racing and you get zoned into their deranged story plots that hours and hours of listening feels like a few minutes. And one such story is Jaanlewa Barish, where suspense plays its role so that it can make your heart beat race. The story revolves around the city of Kolkata, like any other day the people of Kolkata were busy in their day to day activity when suddenly it started to rain, but the shocking thing was it was raining in just a market in Kolkata. It was not a normal rainfall but it was raining dogs and cats with heavy winds. The rainfall was so deadly that it killed 100 people in just 5 minutes, and then stopped. This was not something natural, and hence scientists started researching the reason of such an unnatural phenomena. Was it nature’s way of telling something or there is a conspiracy behind it , to know listen to Jaanlewa Barish in Hindi. You can listen to Jaanlewa Barish online or download it either from the app or from the website.
थ्रिलर जॉनर की विशेषता यह है कि यह आपको आगे के बारे में अनुमान लगाने में व्यस्त रखता है! आपका दिल दौड़ता रहता है और आप उनकी विक्षिप्त कहानी के प्लॉटों में झोंक देते हैं और घंटों-घंटों तक कुछ-कुछ सुनने का मन करता है। और ऐसी ही एक कहानी है जानलेवा बारिश की, जहाँ सस्पेंस अपनी भूमिका निभाता है, ताकि यह आपके दिल की धड़कन को बढ़ा सके। यह कहानी कोलकाता शहर के इर्द-गिर्द घूमती है, किसी और दिन की तरह कोलकाता के लोग अपने दिन भर की गतिविधि में व्यस्त थे, जब अचानक बारिश होने लगी, लेकिन चौंकाने वाली बात यह थी कि कोलकाता के सिर्फ एक बाजार में बारिश हो रही थी। यह सामान्य बारिश नहीं थी लेकिन भारी हवाओं के साथ तूफानी बारिश हो रही थी। बारिश इतनी घातक थी कि इसने महज 5 मिनट में 100 लोगों की जान ले ली और फिर रुक गई। यह कुछ स्वाभाविक नहीं था, और इसलिए वैज्ञानिकों ने इस तरह के अप्राकृतिक घटना के कारण पर शोध करना शुरू कर दिया। क्या यह कुदरत के कुछ कहने का तरीका था या इसके पीछे कोई साजिश है, जानलेवा बैरिश को हिंदी में सुनने। आप जानलेव बारिश ऑनलाइन सुन सकते हैं या इसे ऐप से या वेबसाइट से डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।

flatmate-404-not-found.title: Flatmate 404: Not Found
flatmate-404-not-found.description: The series begins with a backdrop of dark rituals and urban crime, as Anurag experiences terrifying supernatural events, leading to his friend Pratham's disappearance and later, Pratham's inexplicable paralysis amidst shifting realities. Following a catastrophic event, Anurag discovers a mysterious thermos and moves into a new flat, where the enigmatic Shruti becomes his flatmate, hinting at a fated connection. Soon, his flatmate Sudhanshu perceives Shruti as a malevolent entity, a 'dayan,' tormented by a mysterious smell and unsettling visions, culminating in a brutal attack. Despite Sudhanshu's desperate warnings and accusations of black magic, Anurag becomes deeply infatuated with Shruti, dismissing claims of her sinister nature and ignoring his friend Prithvi's warnings. The line between reality and delusion blurs as Shruti's supernatural powers manifest, silencing Sudhanshu's video evidence and enchanting Anurag. The conflict escalates with the discovery of a severed human hand in their garden, leading Sudhanshu to accuse Shruti of black magic and human sacrifice, while Anurag attempts to cover up the crime and protect her. Sudhanshu uncovers unsettling truths, including the revelation that 'Shruti' is an imposter named Pratigya, a discovery intertwined with his past trauma of public humiliation. Anurag's unwavering protection of the imposter leads to a dramatic severance of ties with his associate. He is then severely injured and abandoned at his home, where a chilling female voice emerges from the darkness. Subsequently, Anurag is abducted by an unseen threat, prompting Sudhanshu into a desperate fight to save him. An obsessive rival also vows to eliminate Shruti and claim Anurag, unleashing dark supernatural forces. As Sudhanshu invokes powerful spiritual forces to protect Anurag, the line between protector and captor blurs when Anurag fiercely fights for his freedom. The series culminates in Sudhanshu's chilling act of vigilante justice for Anurag, revealing an unsettling, obsessive protective love and a declaration of 'forever.'

declutter-your-mind-2.description: Doinondin Jibone Aamra Bivinnovabe Chape Thaki, Sei Chap Thekei Bivinno Negative Chinta Dana Bande. Aar Ei Negative Chinta Theke Kokhono Kokhono Aasey Chorom Hotasha. Aamra Tokhon Nijer Vagyoke Dosh Dite Thaki. Aar Ei Poristhitite Amader Kaje, Somporke Khub Baje Provab Pore. Kivabe Positive Thinking Korben? Kivabe Valo Thaka Jay? Kivabe Nijer Productivity Barano Jay? Eisob Proshner Uttor Pete Aapnake Shunte Hobe Ei Audiobook .

sangakala-thamizh-makkal.title: Sangakala Thamizh Makkal
sangakala-thamizh-makkal.description: Veli naattu makkal, nagarigam adaiyaatha kaatu miraandigalaa vaazhntha kalathulaye..  Seerum Sirappum maa Nagarika vazhkai vazhnthavanga namma Tamizhargal ! raman-raghav-indias-first-serial-killer.title: Raman Raghav - India's First Serial Killer
raman-raghav-indias-first-serial-killer.description: Ek aise insaan ki kahaani jo Mumbai ki mill mein kaam karne aaya, aur dekhte - dekhte 41 murders kar baitha. Listen to the heart wrenching documentary of India's first documented serial killer - Raman Raghav!

hoovu.title: ಹೂವು
hoovu.description: ಗಿರೀಶ್ ಕಾರ್ನಾಡ್ ಅವರ ‘ಹೂವು’ ಕೃತಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ನಾಟಕ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾದದ್ದು. ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಜೀವನದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನು, ಮಾನವಿಯ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ಗಾಢತೆಯನ್ನು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಬಾಂಧವ್ಯಗಳ ಸುತ್ತ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ. ಒಂದೇ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಶ್ವರತೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅಸ್ಥಿರತೆಯ ಪ್ರತೀಕವಾಗಿರುವ ಹೂವಿನಂತೆ, ಮಾನವನ ಬದುಕು ಕೂಡ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಕೃತಿ ನಿರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಇನ್ನು ದೈವಭಕ್ತಿ ಹಾಗೂ ವೇಶ್ಯೆಯೊಬ್ಬಳ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ನಡುವೆ ಸಿಲುಕಿರುವ ಪೂಜಾರಿಯ ಕಥೆಯೇ ಈ ‘ಹೂವು’. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ

getting-smart-about-your-private-parts-1.title: Getting Smart About Your Private Parts
getting-smart-about-your-private-parts-1.description:
మీ ప్రైవేట్ పార్ట్స్ గురించీ అవగాహన పెంచుకోండి
ఈ ప్రదర్శనలో, మన శరీరంలోని ప్రైవేట్ భాగాలపై సరైన జ్ఞానాన్ని పొందండి.
మీ ఆరోగ్యం, సురక్షితత, మరియు శ్రద్ధ వహించాల్సిన అంశాలను చర్చించటానికి జతకడుతున్నాము.
మీ లైంగిక ఆరోగ్యాన్ని మెరుగుపరచుకోడానికి, మేము మీకు అవసరమైన మార్గదర్శకతను అందిస్తున్నాం.

fareb-1.title: Fareb
fareb-1.description: Embark on extraordinary adventures with Kuku FM's Fantasy & SciFi collection. From epic quests in magical realms to interstellar explorations our shows offer an escape into worlds beyond imagination. Meet intriguing characters mythical creatures and face challenges that defy the laws of nature. Perfect for dreamers and adventurers tune in to start your journey into the unknown.

the-last-passenger.title: The Last Passenger
the-last-passenger.description: A tired cab driver's final passenger disappears into thin air after warning him about a deadly conspiracy—only for the police to reveal she had died three days earlier. Trapped between impossible evidence and a ruthless corporate cover-up, he must uncover the truth before he becomes the next victim

chanakya-neeti-11.title: Chanakya Neeti
chanakya-neeti-11.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

how-to-move-abroad-for-job.title: How to move Abroad for Job
how-to-move-abroad-for-job.description: ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಓದಿ, ವಿದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಪಡೆದು ಸೆಟಲ್ ಆಗಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದು ಅನೇಕರ ಕನಸು. ಆದರೆ, ಅಷ್ಟು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ವಿದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ನಿವಾಸಿ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ದೇಶಕ್ಕೂ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಹೋಗಲು ಬೇರೆಬೇರೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಇವೆ. ಕೆಲವೊಂದು ಅರ್ಹತೆಗಳೂ ಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ವಿದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಯಾವ ಯಾವ ದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ವೀಸಾ ಅಪ್ಲೈ ಮಾಡುವುದು? ಕುಟುಂಬದವರನ್ನು ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಕರೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋಗಲು ಏನಿರುತ್ತವೆ ನಿಯಮಗಳು?ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ ‘ವಿದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಹೇಗೆ?’ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೂಕುFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲೇ!

launch-your-life-to-the-next-level-3.title: Launch Your Life To The Next Level: It's Time to Find a New You
launch-your-life-to-the-next-level-3.description: Kotoi Na Valo Hoto, Jodi Jibone Ja Chaichen Sobkichu Peye Jeten. Sofolota Jodi Khub Sadharon Jibon Japon Diye Hoye Jeto Kemon Hoto ? Kintu Sofolota Oivabe Aasey Na, Sofolota Pete Korte Hoy Kothin Porishrom . Nijer Kajer Upor Focus Rakhata Khub Joruri. Echarao Aapni Hoyto Etao Vabte Paren Jibonta Ekgheye Hoye Utheche Ektu Poriborton Dorkar, Jibonke Next Level E Niye Jete Chan. Kintu Kivabe Niye Jaben Sei Poth Khuje Cholechen. Aar Chinta Nei Kuku FM Niye Elo 'Launch Your Life To The Next Level: It's Time to Find a New You | A step by step guide to tap into your hidden potential' - Boiti, Ei Audiobook Aapnar Jiboner Onek Somosyar Somadhan Kore Debe Ebong Jibonke Next Level E Niye Jete Help Korbe . Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Nin Ei Audiobook .

अधूरा-क्रश--लेखिका---अर्चना-ठाकुर-कनक.title: Adhura Crush
अधूरा-क्रश--लेखिका---अर्चना-ठाकुर-कनक.description:
अनंत कॉलेज के समय से मन ही मन अन्विता को चाहता है लेकिन वो इस बात से पूरी तरह अनजान थी। अन्विता की शादी हो जाती है और अनंत अपनी एक अलग दुनिया में जीने लगता है। लेकिन किस्‍मत सालों बाद उन्‍हें मिलाती है। तब अन्विता को पता चलता है कि उसे प्‍यार करता है। लेकिन यह मिलन अधूरा रह जाता है। दोनों ही एक अलग दुनिया में पहुंच जाते हैं, जहां संसार का कोई नहीं है। प्‍यार, सर्मपण और त्‍याग की कहानी है अधूरा क्रश।
Voiceover Artist : Neha Niharika
Author : Archana Thakur “Kanak”

long-march.title: లాంగ్ మార్చ్
long-march.description: తెలంగాణ ప్రత్యేక రాష్ట్ర సాధన కోసం జరిగిన ఉద్యమంలో ఒక మైలురాయిగా నిలిచిన "మిలియన్ మార్చ్ " గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

jobless-to-employed-sirf-7-din-mein.title: Jobless to Employed: Sirf 7 Din Mein
jobless-to-employed-sirf-7-din-mein.description: Kya aap ek nayi naukri ki talaash mein hain? Toh aap sahi jagah aaye hain. Is audiobook mein bataye gaye practical aur actionable steps ke zariye jaaniye kaise aap sirf saat din mein khud ko ek nayi job ke liye ready kar sakte hain.

overcome-your-failure.title: Overcome Your Failure
overcome-your-failure.description:
தோல்விய பாத்து பயப்பட வேண்டாம், தைரியமா எதிர்கொள்ளணும்னு நம்ம மனசு நமக்கு சொன்னாலும், மூளை பயப்படுறத தவிர்க்குறது  இல்லை. இந்த ஒலிப்புத்தகம் சுலபமா நீங்க வெற்றிய நோக்கி பயணம் செய்ய உதவும்.

Our heart always has the courage to face our failures but our mind refuses to do so. This audio book helps you to tackle and balance with failure and progressively move on towards success.

chorashastram.title: ചോരശാസ്ത്രം
chorashastram.description: ഒരു പ്രോഫ്ഫസറുടെ വീട്ടിൽ മോഷണത്തിനായി കയറിയ ഒരു കള്ളന് ഏതു പൂട്ടും തുറക്കാൻ പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്ന  ചോരശാസ്ത്രം എന്ന പ്രാചീനഗ്രൻഥം ലഭിക്കുന്നു. വി. ജെ. ജെയിംസ് എന്ന അതുല്യകഥാകൃത്തിന്റെ അതിശയിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കഥ!

Upanishad--एकोऽहं-बहुस्याम्.title: Upanishad : एकोऽहं बहुस्याम्
Upanishad--एकोऽहं-बहुस्याम्.description: Kya aap adhyatma ki khoj mein hain? to abhi ye audiobook "Upnishad" suniye aur janiye jeevan ke sachaiyon ko. Is journey mein shamil hokar, apne astitva ka mool samjhiye.

phoolan-devi-chambal-se-parliament-tak.title: Phoolan Devi- Chambal se Parliament Tak!
phoolan-devi-chambal-se-parliament-tak.description: Bandit Queen, Chambal Ki Rani, Beehad ki Devi aur aise kitne hi naamo se pehchani jaane wali Phoolan Devi ki kahani atyachar, sangharsh, jurm, aur vidroh se bhari hai. Kisi ke liye Phoolan jaati sangharsh ki masiha hai to kisi ke liye maut ka farman. Rape survivor se lekar Bandit Queen banne aur jail se wapas aakar Parliament mein chune jane tak, Phoolan ki zindagi kisi action film se kam nahi. Suniye Phoolan Devi ki kahani Kuku FM ki is khas peshkash Phoolan Devi: Chambhal se Parliament Tak mein

ahunika-bharadesha-charitra.title: Adhunika Bharatadesha Charitra
ahunika-bharadesha-charitra.description: మరుగున పడిన మన భారతదేశ చరిత్ర, మోడ్రన్ హిస్టరీ గురించి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్  ద్వారా వినండి.

behind-the-business-aavin.title: Behind the Business – Aavin
behind-the-business-aavin.description: தமிழ்நாட்டின் கோடிக்கணக்கான மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையின் ஒரு பகுதியாக மாறிய ஆவின், எப்படி மாநிலத்தின் மிகவும் நம்பகமான பிராண்டுகளில் ஒன்றாக உருவானது? இந்த நிகழ்ச்சி, அதன் கூட்டுறவு அமைப்பு, மிகப்பெரிய விநியோக வலையமைப்பு மற்றும் வெற்றியின் பின்னணிக் கதையை ஆராய்கிறது. ஒரு பால் நிறுவனமாகத் தொடங்கி, தமிழ்நாட்டையே இயக்கும் பிராண்டாக ஆவின் எப்படி வளர்ந்தது என்பதை அறிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள்.

kalvanin-kadhali.title: கள்வனின் காதலி
kalvanin-kadhali.description: கல்கி கிருஷ்ணமூர்த்தி ஆனந்த விகடனில் பணியாற்றிய போது எழுதிய தொடர் நாவல் 'கள்வனின் காதலி'. இது ஒரு சமூக நாவலாகும். உலகில் உறுதியானது, உண்மையானது, அழிவில்லாதது ஒன்று உண்டு; அது அன்பு. தீய செயல்களுக்குங்கூட அன்பே தூண்டுகோல் என்ற கருத்தினை இந் நாவல் விளக்குகிறது

विक्रांत-कालचक्र--लेखक--प्रवीण-सिंह-नेगी.title: विक्रांत कालचक्र
विक्रांत-कालचक्र--लेखक--प्रवीण-सिंह-नेगी.description: Helicopter par Missile se hamla hota hei aur waha crash hokar jungke mei jaa girta hei, Lekin Ussmei baithe Vikrant aur kamal surakshit bach jaate hei. Dooni ek ghane jungle mei hei jaha unhe bhari Kaadh- Kaati ke doo log milte hei, Jyo dekhne mei insaan aur jaanwar ka mishrit roop hei. Vikrant Ek mission ke tehet uss jungle mei gaya hei. Kya heu Vikrant ka mission? Kon Hei kaalchakra? Jisse jungke ke kabile waali khauf khate hei. Jab  Vikrant aur Kaalchakra ka amna samna hota hei, toh yudh ki sithi baan jati hei. Akhir kyon? Rahasya aur Romanchak se bhari iss kahani ko sunne ke liye aap bhi Betaab ho jayenge.

jaago-ayodhya-jaago.title: Jaago Ayodhya Jaago
jaago-ayodhya-jaago.description: टैक्‍सी में एक लड़की भूल जाती है अपना मोबाइल और अगले ही पल सरेआम होता है उसका मर्डर। किसने किया यह मर्डर? टैक्‍सी ड्राइवर के पास है उस लड़की का मोबाइल, तो अब क्‍या होगा? क्‍या करेगा टैक्‍सी ड्राइवर? पुलिस के पास जाएगा या फंस जाएगा किसी मुसीबत में? एक अनजान शख्‍स की नजर हमेशा उस ड्राइवर को फॉलो करती है, कौन है वो इंसान? मर्डर मिस्‍ट्री और रिश्‍तों के प्रेम की कहानी बयां करती जागो अयोध्‍या जागो सुनें केवल Kuku FM पर।

kumayonile-narabhojikal.title: കുമയോണിലെ നരഭോജികള്‍
kumayonile-narabhojikal.description:
20ാം നൂറ്റാണ്ടിന്റെ തുടക്കത്തില്‍ ഇന്ത്യയിലെ കുമയോണ്‍ മേഖലയില്‍ നരഭോജിക്കടുവകള്‍ 400ലധികം മനുഷ്യരുടെ ജീവനെടുത്തു. ഒടുവില്‍ അവയെ വകവരുത്താന്‍
വിഖ്യാത വേട്ടക്കാരനായ ജിം കോര്‍ബറ്റ് എത്തി. നരഭോജിക്കടുവകളെ വേട്ടയാടുന്നതിനിടയില്‍ അദ്ദേഹത്തിനുണ്ടായ ത്രില്ലടിപ്പിക്കുന്ന അനുഭവങ്ങള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം..

life-and-death.title: Life And Death
life-and-death.description:

kacheri-arambam.title: Kacheri Arambam
kacheri-arambam.description: The story follows Sanya, a young heiress caught between family control, business pressure, and her own need for dignity. Her relatives treat marriage as a tool to save a failing deal, and she refuses to be traded like a transaction. In response, she runs, improvises, and eventually enters a contract marriage with Rishabh, a man who first appears to be only a band member or bodyguard. Their union is meant to protect her from exposure and family interference, but it quickly becomes tangled in secrecy and mistrust. Rishabh keeps hidden parts of his identity, and that concealment repeatedly threatens the fragile bond between them. At the same time, Sanya tries to build an ordinary life, taking on household work and later a receptionist job to support the family. Those efforts bring new tensions, including workplace discomfort, possessive reactions, and arguments over whether she has the right to choose her own path. Outside the home, the couple is pulled into wider conflicts involving harassment, extortion, public humiliation, and business rivalries. Rishabh repeatedly steps in as a protector, confronting bullies, exploiters, and men who try to control women through money or force. The stakes rise further when Sanya is linked to a missing-person crisis, falling shares, and a broader family panic over reputation and business loss. Her emotional life deepens as she speaks about losing her mother and finding a kind of family in Rishabh's home. Yet that comfort is shaken when Rishabh admits he has hidden something from her, and later when his true identity as a billionaire heir is exposed. The revelation turns private trust into public scandal and puts both their relationship and a business deal at risk. Even so, the romance does not end there, because the contract marriage has already grown into genuine attachment. Sanya's painful childhood explains why she longs for a fresh start and complete trust, while Rishabh insists his love became real and lasting. After a betrayal breaks her trust, he apologizes, accepts the blame, and prepares to leave if she cannot forgive him. In the end, Sanya stops him before he goes, showing that their bond is still alive and that their future together remains unresolved but possible.

Kya Latika apne is maksad me kaamyaab hogi? Kaun hai vo jisne Mansi ka murder kiya hai? Aakhir kyun Viraj ne hatya ka ilzaam apne sir le liya? sanju-samson.description: Oru bat um ball um ayi veedinu aduthulla parambil kalikkan poyirunna nammal ororutharum Indian Cricket Team enna swapnam kandirunnu. investment-er-khuntinati-1.description: Investment Bishoyti Niye Bohu Loker Mone Nana Proshno Ghurte Thake. Kothay Invest Kora Uchit ? Kivabe Invest Korle Fayda Beshi Hobe ? Stock Market Ki ? manglik-dosh-paisa-kyun-rukta-hai.title: Manglik Dosh: Paisa Kyun Rukta Hai?
manglik-dosh-paisa-kyun-rukta-hai.description: Money comes in, but never stays. Businesses fail despite hard work. Loans keep growing, promotions never arrive, and every financial breakthrough slips away. Is it just bad luck, poor decisions, or could Manglik Dosh play a hidden role? Manglik Dosh Aur Dhan explores ten real-life financial struggles through the lens of Vedic astrology, blending traditional beliefs with practical money wisdom.

sbi.title: SBI
sbi.description: SBI Bharat ki Personal aur Financial Banking ki reedh ki haadi jaise hai. SBI desh ke kone-kone mein faile ek bade customer base ko banking ki suvidha muhaiyya karata hai. Par kaise shuru hua tha ye SBI? Kaise ye Bharat ka sabse bada bank ban gaya? Janne ke liye sunein, SBI bytes...

jasmine-kaur-tragedy.title: Jasmine Kaur Tragedy
jasmine-kaur-tragedy.description: Ek young nursing student Punjab se, jo Canada apne sapne poore karne gayi thi, lekin vahan uska murder kar diya gaya, allegedly by someone she trusted. Uski laash jali hui haalat mein mili, jo sabko hila kar rakh diya. Ye case sirf ek murder nahi, balki toxic relationships, immigrant struggles aur delayed justice ka kala sach hai. Jasmine ki kahani ek warning hai — pyaar jab obsession ban jaaye, toh anjaam bhayanak ho sakta hai.

f85fd2e3-0379-4ae0-a62f-816c5ca3798b.title: Sunkar Dekho: Mount Everest
f85fd2e3-0379-4ae0-a62f-816c5ca3798b.description: Kya aapne kabhi socha hai Mount Everest ki unchaiyon ko choone ka? Sunkar Dekho mein hum lekar aaye hain apni khaas prastuti , jahan aapko milega ek romanchak yatra ka anubhav, seedha Himalayas se. Suniye, mehsoos kijiye aur pahunchiye us oonchai par jahan se sab kuch sambhav hai.

how-to-own-the-world-2.title: How To Own The World
how-to-own-the-world-2.description: Life mein financial freedom ki stage par pahunchne ke liye, apne paison se aur paise banana aana chahiye. Iske liye best option hai, us power istemal karo jo har ameer aadmi karta hai. Yani ki power of Compound Interest. Lekin kya hai compund interest? Aur  iska istemal kaise kiya ja sakta hai? Yahi bataya gaya hai is audiobook mein.

saavi-in-multiverse.title: Saavi in Multiverse
saavi-in-multiverse.description: "Sach, Khojne Waalon Ke Liye Hota Hai!" Ye Kehte Hue Saavi Ne Aankhein Kholi Aur Uske Saamne Ek Nayi Duniya Thi...Parallel World! Alice in Wonderland Ki Tarah Saavi Ab Yahaan Pahunch Gayi Thi.  Sadiyon Se Chhupe Reflections Ne Apne Tarike Se Uska Swagat Kiya Tha. In Reflections Ki Duniya Dekhkar Aapki Rooh Kaanp Uthegi Magar Aapko Lagega Ye Sab Yahin isi Original World Me Ho Raha Hai. Kya Hai Parallel World Ka Raaz? Kya Hai Multiverse Ka Angle? Ek Cliff Par Bana Hai Warmhole Jisse Judti Hai Teen Duniya. Sabke Hai Apne Usool Aur Sab Ke Hai Apne Kanoon. Kaisa Hoga Ye Safar? Is Anokhi Duniya Ko Dekhne Liye Abhi Sunein Humari Ye Khaas Peshkash...

bokya-satbande-part-1.title: Bokya Satbande Part 1
bokya-satbande-part-1.description: Step into a world of fun and learning with Kuku FM's children's stories. Our audiobooks are full of adventures and lessons about friendship courage and curiosity. They're perfect for young listeners making learning exciting and storytelling a joy. Listen now Kuku FM for stories that spark imagination and teach important values in a simple enjoyable way.

gain-your-financial-freedom-with-the-1-f.title: Gain Your Financial Freedom With The 1% Formula
gain-your-financial-freedom-with-the-1-f.description: 9-5 ജോലികളില്‍ നിന്നും എന്നെന്നേക്കുമായി മോചനം നേടി സ്വപ്‌നങ്ങളുടെ പിന്നാലെ പോകാന്‍ കൊതിക്കുന്നുണ്ടോ. പക്ഷേ അപ്പോഴും പണമില്ലെങ്കില്‍ പെടുമെന്നുള്ള ചിന്തയാണോ. ഒന്നിനെയും ഭയക്കാതെ ഫിനാന്‍ഷ്യല്‍ ഫ്രീഡം അച്ചീവ് ചെയ്യുന്നത് എങ്ങനെ എന്നതാണ് ഈ പുസ്തകം നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് പറഞ്ഞു തരുന്നത്.

the-miracle-of-right-thought.title: The Miracle of Right Thought
the-miracle-of-right-thought.description: Aap apne mastishk mein right thought ko kaise develop kar sakte hai? Hum sabhi positive thouht aur uski shakti ke baare mein aksar sunte hue aaye hai. Lekn kuch hi chuninda log hai jo sahi mein sahi soch ko jeevan mein apnane ka raasta jaante hai. Aur yeh raasta sirf sahi vichaar ke jadoo se hi samajh aa sakta hai.  Aur voh right thought ka jadoo humari life aakhir kaise badlega. Orison Swett Marden ki yeh behtareen rachna ko sunkar apne mann mein sahi vichaar ko paida karna seekhe. Right thought ka chamatkaar aapki zindagi ko badal kar rakh dega. Toh aaiye sunte hai, 'The Miracle of Right Thought'.

kirdaar-1.title: Kirdaar
kirdaar-1.description: Jiya Kapoor, a struggling actor in Mumbai, is battling financial hardship while desperately trying to save her ailing mother. One night, she crosses paths with the enigmatic billionaire Vivek Malhotra, who presents her with a dangerous proposition—to assume the identity of Meher Singhania, the late wife of business tycoon Armaan Singhania. But this isn't for a film; it's for real life. Can she survive the role of a lifetime, or will she lose herself forever?

how-to-read-people.title: How To Read People
how-to-read-people.description: People reveal far more than they say. In How to Read People, learn the hidden psychology behind first impressions, body language, facial expressions, voice cues, fake confidence, lies, and manipulation. Discover why some people feel trustworthy, how gaslighting works, and what genuine connections actually look like. By the end of this series, you'll be able to decode human behavior, protect yourself from manipulators, and understand people like never before.

kargilnalli-hadinelu-dinagalu.title: Kargilnalli Hadinelu Dinagalu
kargilnalli-hadinelu-dinagalu.description: ಕಾರ್ಗಿಲ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹದಿನೇಳು ದಿನಗಳು ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದ ಮಗ ಗೆದ್ದು ಬರಲಿ ಅಂತ ಹಾರೈಸಿ ಅವನಿಗಾಗಿ ಕಾಯುತ್ತ ಹೊಸ್ತಿಲ ಬಳಿ ಕುಳಿತೇ ಇದ್ದಾಳಲ್ಲ?ಆ ಅಮಾಯಕ ತಾಯಿಗೆ,ಮತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯ ಗೊತ್ತಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಳ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ಬಿಕ್ಕುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾಳಲ್ಲ?ಆ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಅರ್ಪಿತ.

makkala-kathe-bhaaga-1.description: ಜೀವನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನ ಚಿಕ್ಕಂದಿನಿಂದಲೇ ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ರೆ, ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಉತ್ತಮ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ‌‌. ಪುಟಾಣಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುವ ರೀತಿ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ-ಪಕ್ಷಿಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಬದುಕಿನ  ಸಂದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಿರುವ 'ಸಾಧನ ಪಬ್ಲಿಕೇಷನ್' ಅವರ 'ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಕಥೆ ಭಾಗ - 1' ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ!

famous-vinayaka-mandapas-in-india.description: వినాయక మండపాల వెనుక ఉన్న చరిత్ర ఏంటి? ఖైరాతాబాద్ గణేశుడే దేశంలో పెద్ద వినాయకుడా? మండపాల నిర్వహణలో తీసుకోవాల్సిన జాగ్రత్తలేంటి? పూర్తి సమాచారం మీ కోసం.

moshayude-pusthakam.title: മോശയുടെ പുസ്തകം
moshayude-pusthakam.description: ഈജിപ്തിലെ അടിമത്തത്തിൽ നിന്ന് ഇസ്രായേല്യരെ മോചിപ്പിച്ച്, അവരെ ദൈവ മാർഗ്ഗത്തിലക്ക് നയിച്ച് അടിച്ചമർത്തലിന്റെയും അനീതിയുടെയും കാലത്താണ് മോശ ജനിക്കുന്നത്. അസാധാരണമായ സാഹചര്യങ്ങളെ അഭിമുഖീകരിക്കുകയും, ദൈവവിശ്വാസത്തിന്റെ പിൻബലത്തോടെ ഇസ്രായേലിരൂടെ വിമോചകനായി മാറിയ യഹൂദ നായകനായ മോശയുടെ  ജീവിതകഥയാണ്, തോമസ് പുതുപ്പറമ്പിൽ എഴുതിയ മോശയുടെ പുസ്തകം ഓഡിയോ ബൂക്കിലൂടെ നമ്മൾ കേൾക്കാൻ പോകുന്നത്.

mobile-aapko-garib-bana-raha-hai.title: Mobile Aapko Garib Bana Raha Hai
mobile-aapko-garib-bana-raha-hai.description: Subah aankh khulte hi phone. Raat ko sone se pehle phone. Aur beech mein… bas ek aur reel. Lekin kya tum phone use kar rahe ho, ya phone tumhe? Dopamine, algorithms, infinite scroll aur attention economy ka yeh dangerous game tumhari focus, sleep, habits aur thinking ko kaise badal raha hai? MOBILE AAPKO GAREEB BANA RAHA HAI kholta hai ek aisi reality, jahan sabse mehngi cheez paisa nahi… tumhara potential hai.

large-hadron-collider.description: Dosto kya aapne bhi 2012 me ye afwah suni thi ke “europe me ho rahe ek experiment ki wajah se duniya ka ant hone wala hai”. Large hadron collider duniya ke sabse bade nuclear research program hai, jisme India ka bhi bahut bada role raha hai. to chaliye jante hai BIG BANG , God particle aur hamare existence ke baare mein.

dhurandhar-child-king-returns-7.title: Dhurandhar Child  King Returns
dhurandhar-child-king-returns-7.description: He was a rustic boy in the eyes of the world, but within his soul burned the power of a Chandravanshi prince from a thousand years ago. When his own blood writes the decree of his death, Keshav rises from the darkness, armed with secret mystical arts, ancient warfare strategies, and the mysterious Garud Dal. deva-rahasya.title: Deva Rahasya
deva-rahasya.description: ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕತೆಯ ಅಪೂರ್ವ ಸಂಕೇತಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ಇವು ದ್ರಾವಿಡ, ನಾಗರ ಮತ್ತು ವಸಾತಿ ಶೈಲಿಯ ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಪ್ರತಿ ದೇವಾಲಯವೂ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಶೈಲಿಯ ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತದ ದ್ರಾವಿಡ ಶೈಲಿಯ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳು, ಉತ್ತರ ಭಾರತದ ನಾಗರ ಶೈಲಿಯ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಈಶಾನ್ಯ ಭಾರತದ ವಸಾತಿ ಶೈಲಿಯ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳು ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ. ಹಂಪಿ, ಕೊಣಾರ್ಕ, ಖಜುರಾಹೋ, ಮತ್ತು ಬದಾಮಿ ಮುಂತಾದ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳು ನಮ್ಮ ಪೈತೃಕ ಸೊತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತಿವೆ.

2025-mein-influencer-kaise-banein.title: 2025 Mein Influencer Kaise Banein?

how-to-own-the-world-1.title: How To Own The World

Mana jeevitham lo anni Safi ga sagali ante ivvani manam paatinchali. Veeti gurinchi purthiga telusukovalante meeru ee audio book vinandi.

anr-biography-1.title: ANR Biography
anr-biography-1.description: ఒక  హిస్టరీ సృష్టించిన స్టార్ గా, తిరుగులేని  ట్రెండ్ సెట్టర్ గా, గ్రేటెస్ట్ నాచురల్ యాక్టర్ గా, అన్నిటికీ మించి ఒక గ్రేట్  హ్యూమన్ బీయింగ్  గా  ANR  గురించి చెప్పడమే ఈ  షో పర్పస్, ఇది  వింటే  13 పర్సనాలిటీ  డెవలప్మెంట్  లెసన్స్  విన్నట్టే.

annihilation-of-caste.title: Annihilation of Caste
annihilation-of-caste.description: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's 'Annihilation of Caste' is one of the most important, yet neglected, works of political writing from India. Written in 1936, it is an audacious denunciation of Hinduism and its caste system. Ambedkar offers a scholarly critique of Hindu scriptures, scriptures that sanction a rigidly hierarchical and unfair social system.

virus-4.description: Jayant Narlikar's science fiction novel "Virus" — the same concept that inspired the Hollywood blockbuster Independence Day. the-optimistic-child.title: A Guide to Child Development
the-optimistic-child.description: Aaj Sabhi Parents Apne Bachhe ko aane wale waqt ke liye taiyar karna chahte hai. Taki Vo Apni life ki har problem ka solution khud nikal sake aur zindagi mein kamyabi hasil kar sake. Aur iske liye aapko pehle apne bachhe ki personality ko achhe se samajhna hoga tabhi aap use sahi direction de payenge . Lekin ye itna easy nahi hai, iske liye aapko ek child development programme ko follow karte hue aage badhna hoga. Aur us programme ko samajhne ke liye is audiobook se behtar aur kuch nahi ho sakta. chitra-vichitra.title: Chitra Vichitra
chitra-vichitra.description: When Aarav inherits his ancestral haveli, he discovers a cursed sketchbook whose paintings predict the future. As every attempt to change destiny demands a deadly sacrifice, Aarav and journalist Meera must uncover the centuries-old secret of Chitrarishi and stop a hidden cult before the sketchbook rewrites their fate forever.

dharmasthala.title: DHARMASTHALA
dharmasthala.description: ಇದು ನ್ಯಾಯದೇವಾಲಯ.. ಇಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಮಹಾ ಅನ್ನದಾನ.. ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಗಳು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಅಚ್ಚರಿಯ ಪವಾಡ.. ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರಧಾನಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಪತಿಗಳು ಇಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಭೇಟಿ ನೀಡೋದರ ಹಿಂದಿದೆ ಆ ಮಹಾ ಸತ್ಯ..! ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯವನ್ನು ಸಾರುತ್ತಿರುವ, ಶ್ರೀ ಮಂಜುನಾಥನ ಮಹಿಮೆಗೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಾಗಿರುವ ಪುಣ್ಯಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 'ಧರ್ಮಸ್ಥಳ' ದ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ.

atomic-habits-11.title: Atomic Habits
atomic-habits-11.description: ജീവിതത്തിൽ മാറ്റം കൊണ്ടുവരാൻ നിങ്ങൾ വലിയ വലിയ കാര്യങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യണമെന്നാണ് പലരും കരുതുന്നത്. എന്നാൽ ശീലങ്ങളിൽ ചെറിയ മാറ്റങ്ങൾ വരുത്തുന്നതിലൂടെ  നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതം തന്നെ മാറ്റിമറിക്കാൻ സാധിക്കുമെന്ന് നിങ്ങൾ അറിയുക. ലോകപ്രശസ്ത എഴുത്തുകാരനായ  ജെയിംസ് ക്ലിയർ രചിച്ച ആറ്റോമിക് ഹാബിറ്റ്സ് എന്ന വിഖ്യാത ഗ്രന്ഥം അതിനെ കുറിച്ച് നിങ്ങൾക്ക് പറഞ്ഞ് തരൂം. കുഞ്ഞുകുഞ്ഞു നല്ല ശീലങ്ങളിലൂടെ ജീവിതത്തെ എങ്ങനെ മാറ്റിമറിക്കാം എന്ന് അറിയാൻ കേൾക്കൂ  'അറ്റോമിക് ഹാബിറ്റ്‌സ്' സംഗ്രഹം.

the-game-1.title: Baaton Se Karein Attract
the-game-1.description: Kya aap kafi time se single hain ya hamesha se single hain? Kya aapko kisi ladki ko approach karna bahut tough lagta hai? Kya aap bhi un logon ki tarah logon ko approach karna seekhna chahte hain jo har raat bina party ya saathi ke ghar nahin lautate hain. To ye kitab hai aapki sabse badi madadgaar. rangitaranga.title: Rangitaranga
rangitaranga.description: ನಮ್‌ ಹೀರೋ ಆದಿತ್ಯ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಹಸಿ ಜರ್ನಲಿಸ್ಟ್‌, ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯ ಗರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳ ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಾಪಟ್ಟೆ ಆಸಕ್ತಿ. ಅದ್ಭುತ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳಿಗೇ ಅಂತಾನೇ ಹೆಸರಾಗಿರುವ ಮಧುಮಲೈ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗ್ತಾನೆ. ದಟ್ಟವಾದ ಅರೋಲಾ ಕಾಡಿನ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಇರುವ ಮಧುಮಲೈ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುವ ಆದಿತ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಸಂಗತಿಗಳು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತೆ. ಈ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಸಂಪತ್ತನ್ನು ಲೂಟಿ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಅಂತಾನೆ ಹೊಂಚು ಹಾಕ್ತಿದ್ದ ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ಖದೀಮರ ತಂಡದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆದಿತ್ಯನಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿದು, ಆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಮುಂದಾಗ್ತಾನೆ. ಆದಿತ್ಯನ ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈ ಜುಮ್ಮೆನಿಸುವ ಸಾಹಸಮಯ ಜರ್ನಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "ರಂಗಿತರಂಗ" ಕೇಳಿ KUKUFMನಲ್ಲಿ

goa-par-purtgali-kabza.description: Jis trah angrezon ne goa ko apna gulam banaya tha, usi trah unke aane se bhi pahle Purtgaliyon ne goa ko apne adheen karke wahan isai dharam ke naam par hazaeroo hinduon aur dusre dhram ke logon ko jaan se maar dara tha. beladingala-baale.title: Beladingala Baale
beladingala-baale.description: ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಕಥಾ ನಾಯಕ ರೇವಂತ್ . ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಟ ಚೇಸ್ ಆಟಗಾರ.  ಅಂತಾರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆದ್ದು ಗ್ರಾಂಡ್ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್ ಪದವೀಧರ. ಒಂದು ಫೋನ್ ಕಾಲ್ ನಿಂದ ರಷ್ಯಾದ ಒಬ್ಬ ಹುಡುಗಿಯ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಬೆಳೆದು ಪ್ರೇಮಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿಯ ತಂತ್ರವೆಂದರೆ, ಹುಡುಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳದೇ ಕೇವಲ ಫೋನ್ ಕಾಲ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಭೆಟಿಯಾಗುವ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಯಕ ಹುಡುಕುವಾಗಲು ಅದು ಸಾದಗಯವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ನಾಯಕನ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅವಳು ಪರಿಹಾರದ ರೂಪದ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಹೀಗಾಗಿ, ಅವರ ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಮರ್ಪಣಾ ಭಾವವೇ ಸಂಬಂಧದ ಬಂಧವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಈತನಿಗೆ ಬೇಸರವಾದಾಗ ಆಕೆ ಹುರಿದುಂಬಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ದೂರವಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಬಲ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮವಾಗಿಸಿ ಕಥೆ ಹೆಣೆದ ಪರಿ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆ.

how-to-argue-1.title: How To Argue
how-to-argue-1.description: వాదించడం అంటే ఏమిటి ? వివాదాలను తెలివిగా అర్థం చేసుకోవడం అంటే ఏమిటి ? వివాదాల నుంచి బయటపడాలంటే ఏమి చేయాలి ? ఈ ప్రశ్నలన్నిటికీ సమాధానాలు తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

kamarajar.description: Karma Veerar kamarajar'in vaazhkai varalaarai vivarithu koorukiradhu indha padhivu. Kamarajar patriya pala ariya matrum ariyappadaadha visayangalai arindhu kolla indha padhivai kelungal !

the-prince-2.title: The Prince
the-prince-2.description: రాజ్ ఒక అనాథ. ఆశ్రమంలో ఉంటూ చదువుకుని జాబ్ సాధించాడు. తనలాంటి అనాధలు చదువులో ఇబ్బంది పడకూడదని ఒక యాప్ తయారు చేసాడు? అది మార్కెట్ లోకి వచ్చిందా.? దాన్ని ఆపాలని చూస్తున్నది ఎవరు? మామూలుగా జాబ్ చేసుకునే రాజ్ జీవితం సడెన్ గా ఎలాంటి మలుపు తిరిగింది? ప్రేమను, స్నేహాన్ని అందంగా చూపిస్తూ, కార్పోరేట్ ప్రపంచ నిజ రూపాన్ని బయటపెట్టే షో.. " ది ప్రిన్స్" వినండి.. మీ కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎం లో.

52-red-pills-1.title: 52 Red Pills: A New Age Playbook To Become Healthy, Wealthy And Wise
52-red-pills-1.description: Nalla aarogyam, niraye sambath, agadhamaya ariv ennivayal niranja jeevitham engine nayikkam ennu chinthikkatha aalukal kuravayirikkum alle. Pinne enthu venam Jeevithathil. Ennal ethokke reethiyil kadinadhwanam cheythittum jeevithathil valare cheriya uyarchayo mattamo mathrame palarkkum nediyedukkan kazhinjullu. possessive-doctor.title: Possessive Doctor
possessive-doctor.description: It starts with healing her body—that sweet skin, that gorgeous smile. She’s my latest physical-therapy patient and I don’t mind stretching her out one bit. But something’s off with her injury. It doesn’t match her story. When I find out the truth, I know I need to make sure nothing ever hurts her again. That’s when I make her all mine—every single inch of her. But her rich, stubborn father isn’t about to let her go. He thinks he can use her as a pawn in his business dealings. I’m not about to let her get taken advantage of again. She’s mine now and I don’t let anyone touch what I own. I don’t care about right or wrong. I only care about her. Listen to this passionate story about fighting for your love, despite the odds, only on KUKU FM.

aneka-ramayanalu.title: అనేక రామాయణాలు
aneka-ramayanalu.description: Bharatha desha ithihasala prasthavana vasthe Ramayanam modati sthanam lo untundi. Bharathadesha samskruthini prapanchavyaptham chesina Ramayanam prathi bharathiyuniki entho mukhyamainadi. Mari alanti goppa ithihasagaada nu chala mandi thama thama konallo theliparu. billion-dollar-war.title: Billion Dollar War
billion-dollar-war.description: அனாதைகளான இரண்டு சிறுமிகளை வளர்க்கிறார் தன் அடையாளத்தை மறைத்து, ஏழை குப்பை பொறுக்குபவராக வாழும் ஒரு கோடீஸ்வரர். பேராசையால் ஒரு தங்கை அவரை வெறுத்து ஒதுக்க, மற்றொரு தங்கை உண்மையாகவும் விசுவாசமாகவும் இருக்கும்போது, தனது பிரம்மாண்ட சாம்ராஜ்யத்தை யாருக்கு வழங்குவது என்பதைத் தீர்மானிக்க வைக்கும் சோதனையைச் சந்திக்கிறார்.

the-subtle-art-of-intraday-trading-1.title: The Subtle Art of Intraday Trading

The audiobook contains a great deal of detailed and practical information on various trading methods. Learn more about intraday trading and develop your trading skills today!

nashkapramrashree.title: Nashkapramrashree
nashkapramrashree.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. shonir-sare-sati-theke-banchar-upay.title: Shonir Sare Sati Theke Banchar Upay
shonir-sare-sati-theke-banchar-upay.description: Kono Ekdin Sokale Uthe Jante Parlen Aapni Jei Chakri Kore Seta Chole Geche. Kimba Ekdin Sokale Uthe Dekhlen Aapnar Byabsay Birat Loss Hoyeche. Dishehara Hoye Porlen, Ki Korben Bujhe Uthte Parche Na. Aapnar Kono Porichito Aapnake Bollo Tomar Hoyto Shonir Sare Sati Legeche, Valo Jyotishir Poramorsho Nao. Kintu Aapni Bujhe Uthte Parlen Na Shonir Sare Sati Jinista Ki? Keno Hoy? Kivabe Er Theke Mukti Paoya Jay? Eisob Proshno Ghurpak Khete Roilo Mathay Aar Khunje Chollen Somadhan. Aar Chinta Nei Aapnake Sei Somadhan Dite Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Bishesh Audio Show Jekhan Theke Aapni Bishode Jante Parben Shonir Sare Sati Somporke Ebong Kivabe Eta Theke Mukti Paben Tar Upay Khunje Paben. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Nin Ebong Mukti Pan Shonir Kudrishti Theke.

age-of-pandemics.title: Age Of Pandemics
age-of-pandemics.description: వ్యాధుల యుగం అనేది మానవ చరిత్రలో అత్యంత భయానకమైన కాలంగా నిలిచింది. ఒక అంటురోగం ముగియకముందే మరొకటి విస్తరించి, ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా లక్షలాది ప్రాణాలను బలిగొన్న ఈ యుగం, మానవ సహనాన్ని మరియు పోరాటస్ఫూర్తిని తీవ్రమైన పరీక్షకు గురి చేసింది. ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థలు కూలిపోవడం, సామాజిక నిర్మాణాలు కదలికలు ఎదుర్కోవడం, మరియు భయంతో నిండిన రోజులు — ఇవన్నీ ఆ కాలానికి గుర్తులుగా మిగిలాయి. శాస్త్రజ్ఞానం, వైద్యరంగం, మరియు మానవ అనుకూలత ఆ కాలంలో ఎన్నో సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటూ, భవిష్యత్తులో ఇలాంటి విపత్తులను అధిగమించడానికి పునాది వేసాయి.

breath-believe-balance.title: Breathe, Believe, Balance
breath-believe-balance.description: Kya aap bhi apne daily life mein success aur happiness ke beech ka balance khoj rahe hain? Toh abhi suniye yeh Book Explanation, Jahan aap science, spirituality, aur psychology ki madad se khud ko ek naye nazariye se dekh paayenge aur apni safalta ke naye aayam ko chhu paayenge.

ദുരന്തത്തിൽ-കലാശിച്ച-സ്പേസ്-മിഷനുകൾ.title: ദുരന്തത്തിൽ കലാശിച്ച സ്പേസ് മിഷനുകൾ
ദുരന്തത്തിൽ-കലാശിച്ച-സ്പേസ്-മിഷനുകൾ.description: ഈ ഷോയിൽ, ചരിത്രത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും ദാരുണമായ ചില ബഹിരാകാശ ദൗത്യങ്ങളെ ഓർമ്മിക്കുകയും അവയിൽ നിന്ന് നമുക്ക് എന്തെല്ലാം പഠിക്കാനുണ്ടെന്ന് പരിശോധിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.

rich-dads-retire-young-retire-rich.title: Rich Dad’s Retire Young Retire Rich
rich-dads-retire-young-retire-rich.description: 🎙️ Dive into the Wealth Mindset Revolution! In this Kuku Byte we unlock the secrets of financial success with insights from Rich Dad's playbook. Conquer obstacles, rewrite your financial narrative, and set sail towards abundance! 🚀✨

secret-waris.title: Secret waris
secret-waris.description: Veer is an unemployed live-in son-in-law who is constantly humiliated by his wife Aadhya and her family. Aadhya wants to leave him for her wealthy lover, Rohan. But when Aadhya's father suffers a heart attack and the family urgently needs twenty lakh rupees, Veer arranges the money overnight, leaving everyone stunned. Who is the mysterious man who addresses Veer as "Yuvraj"? And how did a jobless man suddenly manage to arrange such a huge fortune?

the-india-way-1.title: The India Way
the-india-way-1.description: From the 2008 global financial crisis to the 2020 coronavirus pandemic, a series of disruptions have deeply impacted the world. International relations have often been in flux. How these events affected India — and how the country must navigate the future — is what Dr. S. Jaishankar explores in his book "The India Way."

tesla-car-of-the-future.title: TESLA Car of the Future
tesla-car-of-the-future.description: Intha Ulagathaye thirumbi paaka vachha Car oda varalaara namma thirumbi paakurathukkaga thaan intha oru pathivu. Ithula Tesla car patriyum Elon Musk patriyum pala swarasyamaana vishayangalai neenga therinjikkalaam.

द-लास्ट-हार्टबीट--लेखक--आर्यन-सुवाड़ा.title: The Last Heartbeat
द-लास्ट-हार्टबीट--लेखक--आर्यन-सुवाड़ा.description:
कहते है कि मोहब्बत अपने बन्दे खुद चुनती है और अजय और रिया को भी मोहब्बत ने ही चुना था । अजय लोवोलोजिस्ट था लोगो की अधूरी प्रेम कहानी को पूरी करने में मदद करता था । पर वह उस लड़की से प्यार कर बैठा जिस लड़की को मोहब्बत से सख्त नफरत थी । क्या हो पाएगी पूरी अजय की प्रेम कहानी जानने की लिए पढ़िए  मेरी रचना "द लास्ट हार्टबीट"
Author : Aryan Suvada
Voiceover Artist : Surabhi

100-things-successful-people-do-1.title: 100 Things Successful People Do
100-things-successful-people-do-1.description: Jeevitha Vijayam ennu parayunnath kevalam nalla joli sambhadikkuka ennatho nalla veedum car um vanguka ennatho mathram alla. Athil Sambathinodoppam santhoshavum manasamadhanavum adangiyittund. Oro divasavum stressum sammardhangalum koodi varunna ee kalaghattathil cheriya karyangal kond jeevithathil varuthavunna valiya mattangale kurichanu Nigel Cumberland nte '100 Things Successful People Do' enna pusthakam nammalod samsarikkunnath.

a-expert-guide-to-right-first-job.title: An Expert's Guide to Your Right First Job
a-expert-guide-to-right-first-job.description: ఉద్యోగం ఎలా సంపాదించాలి? మనకు ఉండవలసిన నైపుణ్యాలు ఏంటి? మన చదువుకు తగ్గ ఉద్యోగం ఎలా పొందాలి? మీ మొదటి ఉద్యోగం పొందేందుకు సలహాలు.

how-to-follow-your-passion-3.title: How To Follow Your Passion?
how-to-follow-your-passion-3.description: Cheyyunna joli ningalude passion aanengil athu pinne joliyayi thonnilla alle? Swantham passione follow cheythu athil vijayich athine koodekkootti jeevikkan sadhikkunnavar bhaagyam chethavar aanennu pothuve parayarund. Randattam koottimuttikkanulla thathrappadinidayil jeevithathil ishtappettath cheyyan aavathe jeevikkunna ethrayo per namukk chuttum und. Athu oru pakshe nammal thanne aayirikkam alle? Nammude passion yadhardhyamakkunnathu engane ennariyan ee audio book ningale sahayikkum.

what-is-caa.title: What is CAA?
what-is-caa.description: Citizenship Amendment Act nijamave oru nalla sattamaa ? Ithunaala yaaruku saathagam, yaarukku baathippu? Vaanga kettu therinjukalam.

1857-che-swantantrya-samar-bhag-1.title: 1857 Che Swantantrya Samar Bhag 1

Our engaging storytelling brings history to life making the past relevant and exciting. From legendary battles to cultural revolutions enrich your knowledge of the human saga. Listen and connect with the stories that define us

mapa-hanshi-chapa-kanna-1.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

red-light-bungalow.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

secret-to-escaping-aam-aadmi-life.title: Kaise Nikle Aam Zindagi Se Bahar
secret-to-escaping-aam-aadmi-life.description: Life ke utaar-chadhav ko jhelte hue bhi kaise bane Extra-Ordinary? Suniye motivational story jo badal degi aapki soch!

second-half.title: സെക്കന്‍ഡ് ഹാഫ്‌
second-half.description: ഫുട്‌ബോള്‍ ഒരു സുഖമുള്ള ഭ്രാന്താണ്. അതിനുള്ളില്‍ പെട്ട് പോയവര്‍ക്കറിയാം അതിന്റെ ലഹരി. കളി കണ്ടുകഴിഞ്ഞതാണെങ്കിലും ചില കളിയെഴുത്തുകള്‍ നമ്മെ കോരിത്തരിപ്പിക്കും. അത്തരത്തില്‍ രോമാഞ്ചമണിയിക്കുന്ന എണ്ണം പറഞ്ഞൊരു കിടിലന്‍ പുസ്തകമിതാ! സെക്കന്‍ഡ് ഹാഫ്. കേട്ട് കോരിത്തരിക്കൂ Kuku FMലൂടെ!

Kanneeti-Kerataala-Vennelaకన్నీటి-కెరటాల.title: కన్నీటి కెరటాల వెన్నెల
Kanneeti-Kerataala-Vennelaకన్నీటి-కెరటాల.description: భర్తను కోల్పోయిన రేణు , భర్త జ్ఞాపకాల్లో సంతోషం వెతుక్కుంటూ, కొత్త ఊర్లో అనూహ్యం గా కొత్త స్నేహితుడు పరిచయం అయినప్పుడు ఏం చేసింది అనే విషయాన్ని "కన్నీటి కెరటాల వెన్నెల" అనే కథను విని తెలుసుకోండి.

money-know-more-make-more-give-more-2.title: Money : Know More, Make More, Give More
money-know-more-make-more-give-more-2.description: Kya aap wakayi financially independent hai? Ya kya aapko bhi apne paise se paisa banana aata hai? Kya aap financial independence ke us stage par jana chahte hai jahan se aap apni aur apni family ki sabhi desires ko poora kar sake? Agar aapko lag raha hai ki iska jawab savings hai, to wo nahi hai. In sawalon ka jawab chhupa hai is audiobook mein. Isme writer ne khud apne personal experiences se bataya hai ki kaise aap independent wealth bana bhi sakte hai aur usko banaye bhi rakh sakte hai. Aaiye ise sunte hai!

married-to-my-caretaker.title: Married To My Caretaker
married-to-my-caretaker.description: Arohi jis billionaire ki 3 saal se seva kar rahi thi, woh achanak bathtub mein ek aise awkward haalat mein jaaga ki usse laga Arohi ke iraade kuch aur hain. Tab se, Arohi apni masoomiyat ke saboot dhoondhne mein lagi hai aur billionaire usse replace karne mein. Lekin ek sach sab kuch badal sakta hai— jab us billionaire ko yeh pata chalega ke uske khud ke hi apne uske 3 saal purane accident ke peeche hain. Kya aise waqt mein wo apni insecurities ko paar karke masoom Arohi ka haath tham lega?

hell-on-earth.title: Hell On Earth
hell-on-earth.description: Bengaluru ki tezz-tararr journalist Aditi Joshi teen high-profile maut ke cases ke peechhe chhipe raaz ki talaash mein nikalti hai. Ek benaam email usse le jaata hai ek anjaani aur khaufnaak company ke naam tak, "Dark Karma Inc.", ek aisi company jo apne victims ke bure karmon ka hisaab leti hai. Jaise jaise Aditi sach ke kareeb jaati hai, uski zindagi ek psychological game ka hissa ban jaati hai. Kya woh is karmon ke khel mein zinda bach payegi?

extreme-ownership.title: How To Be A Good Leader
extreme-ownership.description: Jab hum great leaders ke baare mein sochte hai, to humare dimaag mein kaunse naam aate hain? Kaise ek insaan accha leader kehlata hai? Kya hai secret ek acche leader banne ka? Sare great leaders pehle se hi acche leader ho aisa zaroori nahi hai, unhone lead karna sikha hai aur aap bhi ek acche leader ban sakte hai, leadership skills seekh sakte hain is audio book ke zariye. Agar aapko  "The CEO Next Door" aur " Start With Why: How Great Leaders Inspire Everyone" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

rajiv-gandhi-murder-case.title: Rajiv Gandhi Murder Case
rajiv-gandhi-murder-case.description: முன்னாள் பிரதமர் ராஜிவ் காந்தியின் கொடூர படுகொலை ஞாபகம் இருக்கா? இந்த கொலை வழக்கோட முழு வரலாறையும் கொஞ்சம் திரும்பி பாக்கலாமா???

julie-zhuo-the-making-of-a-manager.title: Becoming a Great Manager
julie-zhuo-the-making-of-a-manager.description: Manager, ye ek aisa word hai jo kuch logon ko pareshan karta hai toh wahin kuch logon ko yeh word sunte hi support, empower aur ek accha workspace ki yaad dilata hai. Doston ek accha manager na sirf apne business ko fayda pahunchata hai balki apni team ko bhi professionally grow karne mein madad karta hai, toh aakhir ek accha manager bana kaise jaye? Chaliye jaante hain is audiobook mein.

main-pakistan-mein-bharat-ka-jasoos-tha.title: Main Pakistan Mein Bharat Ka Jasoos Tha
main-pakistan-mein-bharat-ka-jasoos-tha.description: Bharat azad hua aur fir bani iski security agency RAW, jisne duniya bhar mein apne jasoos failaye taki bharat ko aage aane wale khatron se bachaya ja sake. Aise hi ek jasoos the "Mohanlal Bhaskar", jinhe RAW ne 60s aur 70s ke dashak mein Pakistan ke Atomic Programme ki jasoosi ke liye Pakistan bheja. Aur ek dusre Jasoos ki wajah se vo pakde gaye aur fir chala mukadma. Kya hai Poori kahani batayenge is Audio book "Main Pakistan Mein Bharat Ka Jasoos Tha" mein.

chandrakant-jha.title: Chandrakant Jha - Delhi's Most Brutal Serial Killer
chandrakant-jha.description: "Agar mujhe es murder mein pakad sake to pakad kar dikhao"  Delhi Police ko ye dhamki di thi khaufnaak serial killer Chandrakant Jha ne. Ek ke baad ek murder karke woh police ko challenge karta tha. Kaise bana Chandrakant serial killer aur woh kaise pakda gaya? Janne ke liye suniye ye special show!

dark-side-of-the-fifa-world-cup.title: Dark Side Of The FIFA World Cup
dark-side-of-the-fifa-world-cup.description: The FIFA World Cup is arguably the biggest and the most celebrated sports event in the world. But the world cup is not just about the good vibes, lavish celebrity performances, and nail-biting excitement during the matches. FIFA, the governing body of international soccer, and the World Cup have been plagued by numerous controversies. Some of the most notable include allegations of corruption in the selection of host nations for the World Cup, the use of slave labor in constructing World Cup-related infrastructure, and the treatment of workers and migrant workers in host countries. And this is just the tip of the iceberg. This exclusive show delves into the often-overlooked controversies and negative impact of the world's most popular soccer tournament. From human rights violations to financial corruption, this show explores the dark side of the FIFA World Cup. It offers a deeper understanding of the tournament and the issues that surround it. Uncover what goes on behind the closed doors at FIFA with this thrilling show.

korananooru.title: கொரோனானூறு
korananooru.description: டிசம்பர் 2019ல் தொடங்கி செப்டம்பர் 2020 வரையிலான கொரோனா காலகட்டத்தில், கொரோனா தொடர்பாக தினந்தோறும் முகநூலில் நெல்லை க. வசந்தன் எழுதிவந்தார். ஊரடங்கு காலத்தில் உலா வந்த அந்த சிந்தனைகளின் தொகுப்பே இந்த 'கொரோனானூறு'

argentina-2.title: Argentina
argentina-2.description: ಈಗ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಿದ್ರು ಫಿಫಾ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಫೇವರ್! ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ 'ಟೀಮ್ ಅರ್ಜೆಂಟೀನಾ' ಮೇಲೆ ಎಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲದ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸ! ಗೋಲ್ಡನ್ ಲೆಗ್ 'ಲಿಯೋನೆಲ್ ಮೆಸ್ಸಿ' ಇದ್ಮೇಲೆ ಪಕ್ಕ ಈ ಸಲ ಕಪ್ ಅರ್ಜೆಂಟೀನಾ ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಅಂತ ಅದೆಷ್ಟೋ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಗಳು  ಶರ ಬರಿದುಬಿಟ್ಟಿದಾರೆ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಟೀಮ್ ಅರ್ಜೆಂಟೀನಾ ಮೇಲೆ ಯಾಕಿಷ್ಟು ನಂಬಿಕೆ? ಮೆಸ್ಸಿ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಜೊತೆ ಮೋದಿ ಮಾಡ್ತಿರೋ ಇತರ ಪ್ಲೇಯರ್ಸ್ ಯಾರ್ಯಾರು? 'ಲೆಜೆಂಡ್ ಮೆರಡೋನ' ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನಿಮಗೆಷ್ಟು ಗೊತ್ತು.? ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್ ಸಮರದಲ್ಲಿ  ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು ಈ ಟೀಮ್ ನ ಸ್ಟ್ರಾಟೆಜಿ.? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ 'ಅರ್ಜೆಂಟೀನಾ ನ್ಯಾಷನಲ್ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಟೀಮ್'ನ ಕಂಪ್ಲೀಟ್ ಡೀಟೇಲ್ಸ್.ಕೇಳಿ 'ಅರ್ಜೆಂಟೀನಾ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ನಲ್ಲಿ .!

decoding-ikigai-with-nandhini.title: Decoding Ikigai With Nandhini
decoding-ikigai-with-nandhini.description: Ikigai - a Japanese secret for a happy life - Idhu dhaan book oda title. Paatha udane secret for a happy life na, yaarukku dhaan therinjikkanum nu aasai varadhu ? aana book ah padicha silar, idhu Indian mindset or lifestyle ku set aagadhu nu solranga. Idhu unmai ah ? Idha thelivu padutha, oru Special guest indha audio la pesi irukaanga. Yaaru, ennalam solli irukanga nu audio la kettu therinjikonga.

thottal-thodarum.title: Thottal Thodarum
thottal-thodarum.description: Vasanthi bhaskarai nambi chennaikku odi vanthudara. Bhaskar vasanthiya kalyanam senjana? Avanoda thittam thaan enna? Pattukkottai prabhakarin asaththalana story...

love-special-tadka.title: Love Special Tadka
love-special-tadka.description: Ayan hates love, trusts no one, and refuses to let anyone into his broken heart. Then Riddhima enters his life as his personal chef—and the one woman who dares to challenge his anger. What begins with clashes, hatred and irresistible nok-jhok soon turns into a dangerous attraction. But with Ayan’s jealous fiancée and powerful mother determined to destroy Riddhima, can their unexpected love survive the storm?

teen-fitness-guide.title: Teen Fitness Guide
teen-fitness-guide.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

100-things-successful-people-do-2.title: 100 Things Successful People  Do
100-things-successful-people-do-2.description: Apni apnar jibone ki dhoroner sofolota chan? Sofolota shobdo tar ortho ki apnar kache? Ar safollyo dekhtei ba kemon lage? Ei audio story ti jodi apni shonen tahole apni apnar jibone sofolota orjon korte parben. Sofolota kenoi ba eto joruri amader sokoler jibone? Amader jibone anek guloi odhyay royeche jegulo apnader jibone safolyo ante sahajyo korbe. Shei odhyay gulo byapareo ei audio story ti bistarito bhabe shunte parben.

kannathil-muthamittaal.title: Kannathil Muthamittaal
kannathil-muthamittaal.description: தன்னை நேசிக்கும் குடும்பத்திடம் நேர்மையுடனும் அன்புடனும் இருக்கும் சத்யா பணி நிமித்தமாய் தன் தாயின் விருப்பத்தை மீறி வெளிநாடு செல்ல நேர்கிறது. சென்ற இடத்தில் வெளிநாட்டு பெண் ஒருத்தி வேறொருவனால் ஏமாற்றப்பட்டு விட்டதாயும், அவளை ஏற்குமாறும் சத்யாவிடம் வேண்டுகோள் வைக்கிறாள். ஊரில் வசிக்கும் சத்யாவின் தங்கை யாமினி , குணத்திலும் பண்பிலும் சிறந்தவனான அவளது அத்தை பையன் சிவாவை மணந்து கொள்ளாமல் பட்டிக்காட்டான் என அலட்சியம் செய்கிறாள். பின்னர் ரவிச்சந்திரன் என்ற கல்லூரி நண்பனால் கெடுக்கப்படுகிறாள். மாமா குடும்பத்தின் மீது பெருமதிப்பு கொண்ட சிவா என்ன செய்தான் என்பதையும் அவன் முடிவை கண்ட சத்யா எடுக்கும் முடிவையும் பற்றின சுவாரஸ்யம் நிறைந்த கதை தான் கன்னத்தில் முத்தமிட்டால்.

unexplained-conspiracy-theories.description: Ulagathaye ulukkiya sila mukkiya nigazhvugalum, athoda pinnaniyum pathina audio book dhaan idhu.

mary-bell-youngest-female-killer.title: Mary Bell : Youngest Female Killer
mary-bell-youngest-female-killer.description: Ek bachpan jo khaufnaak jurm se bhara pada tha! Mary Bell, sirf 10 saal ki umar mein do masoom bachchon ki ban gyi qaatil. Kaise ek nanhi si ladki ban gayi Britain ki sabse chhoti serial killer, aur kaise sirf 12 saalon ke baad hi azaad ho gayi? Suniye, Mary Bell ki dehshat bhari dastaan, jise sun kar aapki rooh kaanp uthegi sirf Kuku Fm par.

ziddi-ishq-1.title: Ziddi Ishq
ziddi-ishq-1.description: Aarav Malhotra, the arrogant heir of a wealthy family, clashes with Aarohi, a fearless and intelligent village girl who refuses to be intimidated by his power. When Aarohi moves into Aarav’s mansion under his grandfather’s protection, their rivalry intensifies through constant arguments and pranks. But as they continue challenging each other, hatred slowly gives way to attraction, setting the stage for a passionate enemies-to-lovers romance.
