detective-raghav-recording-24.title: Detective Raghav: Recording 24
detective-raghav-recording-24.description: शहर का सबसे बड़ा जासूस... और सबसे बड़ा भुलक्कड़! राघव को कल क्या हुआ था, ये याद नहीं रहता... लेकिन किसी जुर्म की गुत्थी सामने आते ही उसका दिमाग बन जाता है सबसे खतरनाक हथियार। जब शहर में एक के बाद एक रहस्यमयी हत्याएं होने लगती हैं, तो राघव उतरता है कातिल की तलाश में। हर सुराग उसे एक नए राज़ तक ले जाता है... और हर राज़ उसके भूले हुए अतीत का दरवाज़ा खोलता है। आखिर राघव के अतीत में छुपा है कौन-सा ऐसा सच, जो इन हत्याओं से जुड़ा है?

manchahi-safalta-prapt-karne-ki-jadui-pu.title: Manchahe lakshya Prapt Karne ki Jadui Pustak
manchahi-safalta-prapt-karne-ki-jadui-pu.description: Aksar humne logo ko kehte hai suna hai ki "Apki safalta apke hath aur apke mann me hoti hai" , aap jaise sochte hai wahi apke jivan me bhi hota hai, to chaliye sikhte hai kaise hum kuchh chizo ko sikh kar , kuch chizo habits ko develop kar ke aur daily Affirmations ke sathMann chahi safalta hasil kar sakte hai. how to be successful and think positive with affirmations

इनाम--लेखक--महेन्द्रनाथ-रामचंद्र-प्रभु.title: इनाम
इनाम--लेखक--महेन्द्रनाथ-रामचंद्र-प्रभु.description:
रमेश आणि सिंधू हे दोघे पती पत्नी... त्यांच्या दोन मुली उषा आणि निशा, सिंधू चा नवरा व्यसनी झाला होता... त्याच्या वागण्याने हैराण झालेल्या सिंधू ने एके दिवशी त्याला पोलिसांची धमकी देखील दिली मात्र त्यावर तो एवढा रंगवला कि सिंधू ला जाळायला निघतो त्यात सिंधू चा मृत्यू होतो व कोर्ट रमेश ला १४ वर्षाची शिक्षा सुनावतात... मोठी वयाने मोठी असल्याने उषा वर दोन्ही भावंडांची जबाबदारी येते... घरची धुनी भांडी करत ती आपल्या भावंडांचा सांभाळ करत असते... अशातच एका मुलावर तिचे प्रेम जडते, तो तिला लग्नाची मागणी सुद्धा घालतो,मात्र एकेदिवशी एका आमदाराकडे काम करत असताना त्याचा मुलगा उशी ची अब्रू लुटतो... तपासाला शिक्षेचा इनाम हि सारे भावंडे मिळून कसा देतात हे समजण्यासाठी ऐका... 
Author : महेन्द्रनाथ रामचंद्र प्रभु
Voiceover Artist : RJ Maya

satya-4.title: Satya
satya-4.description: Satyamev Singh, aka Satyaa, is a shrewd lawyer who knows how to bend the law to his advantage. But when he clashes with powerful crime lord Rahmat Ibrahim, his criminal son Saleem, and his own former protégé Sarita Sanyal, a legal battle turns into a personal war. Caught between prison, conspiracies, and a corrupt system, can Satyaa rewrite the rules of his own game to deliver justice, or will the law finally defeat the master of legal manipulation?

rin-mutiny.title: RIN Mutiny
rin-mutiny.description: 1945 ke baad achanak se aisa kya hua ki British Empire ko Cabinet Mission bhejna pad gaya tha? Kya ye 1942 ke Bharat Choro Andolan ka asar tha ya iske peeche chipi hai koi badi wajah? Sunein “RIN Mutiny” aur jane Bhartiya azadi ki sachchi kahani

the-law-of-success-in-sixteen-lessions.title: The Law of Success In Sixteen Lessons
the-law-of-success-in-sixteen-lessions.description: Is Book Explanation mein kharab economic condition se lad kar safalta hasil karne ke liye 16 lessons bataye gaye hain. Yeh lessons millionaires aur aam aadmi ki soch ke difference ko bhi samjhate hain, Jo ki aapki financial growth ke liye kaafi helpful sabit ho sakte hain.

jyothirlingalu.title: JYOTHIRLINGALU
jyothirlingalu.description: Hara hara mahadeva shabho shankara ani anukogane varalu iche devudu mana bholashankarudu aa shivudu. Alanti deva devudu bhoomi meeda lingaala roopam lo darshanamisthu bhakthula ku varalalanu isthu koluvudeerina kshethrale jyothirlingalu. Randi aa parameshavarunni thaluchukoni thariddam.

b0839d15-c3bc-4965-9774-83bc47da4131.title: பூனாச்சி அல்லது ஒரு வெள்ளாட்டின் கதை
b0839d15-c3bc-4965-9774-83bc47da4131.description: தலைப்பு உணர்த்துவதுபோலவே இந்த நாவல் ஒரு வெள்ளாட்டின் வாழ்வைக் கூறுகிறது. ஆடுகளின் பிரச்சினைகளையும் சிக்கல்களையும் சொல்கிறது. ஆடுகளின் மேல் மனித குணங்களை ஏற்றும் ஆசிரியர் ஆடுகளின் வாழ்வினூடே மனித வாழ்வைப் பேசுவதாகவும் இந்த நாவலை வாசிக்கலாம். பெருமாள்முருகன் தான் வாழும் சமூகத்தையும் அதிலுள்ள மனிதர்களையும் மட்டுமின்றி ஆடுகளைப் பற்றியும் நன்கு அறிந்தவர் என்பதால் இதில் ஆடுகளின் வாழ்வும் மானுட இயல்புகளும் அற்புதமாகத் துலங்குகின்றன. ஆடுகளின் கதையாக வாசிக்கையில் சுவையாகவும் நுட்பமான கூறுகள் நிறைந்ததாகவும் விளங்கும் இந்த நாவல் குறியீட்டுத் தளத்தில் முற்றிலும் வேறொரு வடிவம் எடுத்து வியக்கவைக்கிறது.

joy-baba-loknath.title: Joy Baba Loknath
joy-baba-loknath.description: 'Rone Bone Jole Jongole Jekhane Bipode Poribe, Aamay Smoron Korio Aami Rokkha Koribo' - Ei Kothai Bolechilen Mohajogi Baba Loknath. Jonmastomir Punyo Logne Ramkanai Ghoshal-Er Ghore Kamala Debir Kol Aalo Kore Jonmo Nen Ek Chotto Bishmoy Balok. Je Kichu Bochorer Modheyi Hoye Othen Jogoter Nath. Aasun Tahole Shune Nin Ebong Mon Theke Bolun Joy Baba Loknath.

indian-railway-history.description: మన భారతీయ రైల్వే ఎప్పుడు ప్రారంభమయ్యిందో తెలుసా? మొట్ట మొదటి రైల్వే లైన్ ఎక్కడ నుండి ఎక్కడికి వేశారు? ఇలాంటి ఆసక్తికర విషయాలు మీకోసం.

argentina-vs-brazil.description: Football Mathe Mohajuddho Manei Argentina Vs Brazil. Ei Dui Desh Jokhon Mukhomukhi Hoy Tokhon Gota Biswa Mukhiye Thake Sei Lorai Dekhar Jonyo. E Bole To Aamay Dekh O Bole To Aamay Dekh. Katay Katay Cholte Thake Snaujuddho. Gota Biswer Koti Koti Somorthok Vag Hoye Jay Duti Vage Nijeder Priyo Doler Joy Dekhbe Bole. चुनौती--लेखक--गंथर-बहेनमन-.title: चुनौती
चुनौती--लेखक--गंथर-बहेनमन-.description:
अंधेरी रात में, धमाकों के बीच, अपने ही साथियों की आंख में धूल झोंक कर गंथर भाग निकला… चलने-चलते उस ने पे-मास्‍टर सार्जेंट को घायल कर दिया और रूपयों की तिजोरी अपने साथ ले ली। लेकिन गंथर ने ऐसा क्‍यों किया? एम जर्मन सैनिक की सच्‍ची कहानी जिस ने अपनी सेना के विरूद्ध जिहाद छेड़ा।

Publisher - Vishv Books
Writer - Ganther Bahneman

mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-duryodhan-1.title: Mahabharat ke Amar Patra Duryodhan
mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-duryodhan-1.description: दुर्याेधन हस्तिनापुर के महाराज धृतराष्ट्र और गांधारी के सौ पुत्रें में सबसे बड़ा पुत्र था. दुर्याेधन स्वभाव से बड़ा ही हठी और दुष्ट था. वह पाण्डवों को सदैव नीचा दिखाने का प्रयत्न करता और उनसे ईर्ष्या रखता था. उसके स्वभाव के कारण ही ‘महाभारत’ का युद्ध हुआ. यह उपन्यास इस कठिन चरित्र का वृतांत है.

indian-navy.title: Indian Navy
indian-navy.description: Namma Indian navy oda varalaru evalo sirappanadhu nu indha audio book moolama naama therinjikkalam.

rangavilasa-bangaleya-hatyakanda.title: Rangavilasa Bangaleya Hatyakanda
rangavilasa-bangaleya-hatyakanda.description: ಕ್ರೈಂ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಗರಿಕ ಸಮಾಜವೇ ತಲೆತಗ್ಗಿಸುವಂತ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಅಪರಾಧಗಳು ನಡೆದು ಹೋಗಿವೆ. ಭೂಗತ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಕ್ರಿಮಿಗಳು ಎಸಗಿದ ಹಲವಾರು ಅಪರಾಧ ಕೃತ್ಯಗಳು ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಕ್ರೈ ಡೈರೀಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗಾಗ ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೇ ಇರ್ತವೆ! ಸ್ವತಃ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಂಗ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯೇ ಶಾಕ್‌ಗೆ ಒಳಗಾದಂತಹ ಭೀಭತ್ಸ ಘಟನೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅದು ರಂಗವಿಲಾಸ ಬಂಗಲೆಯ ಹತ್ಯಾಕಾಂಡ! 1956ರಲ್ಲಿ ಖ್ಯಾತ ಕ್ರಿಮಿನಲ್‌ ಲಾಯರ್‌ ಬೇಲೂರು ಶ್ರೀನಿವಾಸ ಅಯ್ಯಂಗಾರ್‌ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಅವರ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಹಲವಾರು ಸದಸ್ಯರು ಭೀಕರವಾಗಿ ಕೊಲೆಗೀಡಾದ ಘಟನೆ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಪೊಲೀಸ್‌ ಹಿಸ್ಟರಿಶೀಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಚ್ಚಹಸಿರಾಗಿದೆ! ಐಷಾರಾಮಿ ರಂಗವಿಲಾಸ ಬಂಗಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಕರಾಳ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಏನೇನೆಲ್ಲಾ ನಡೀತು? ಕೊಲೆಗಳ ತೀವ್ರತೆ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಹಂತಕರು ಯಾರು? - ಹೀಗೆ ಕಾಡುವ ಹಲವಾರು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನ ಸುಧೀರ್ಘವಾಗಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸುವ ಟ್ರೂ-ಕ್ರೈಂ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "ರಂಗವಿಲಾಸ ಬಂಗಲೆಯ ಹತ್ಯಾಕಾಂಡ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

how-to-win-friends-1.title: How To Win Friends and Influence People
how-to-win-friends-1.description: డేల్ కార్నెగీ యొక్క రాక్-సాలిడ్ సలహా లెక్కలేనన్ని మంది వ్యక్తులను వారి వ్యాపారం మరియు వ్యక్తిగత జీవితంలో విజయాల నిచ్చెనపైకి తీసుకువెళ్లడానికి సహాయపడింది.. ఆల్ టైం రికార్డ్ మరియు బెస్ట్ సెల్లర్ ఐన ఈ ‘హౌ టు విన్ ఫ్రెండ్స్ & ఇన్ఫ్లుయెన్స్ పీపుల్ పుస్తకం ప్రజలు మిమ్మల్ని ఇష్టపడేలా చేయడానికి ఆరు మార్గాలు, మీ ఆలోచనా విధానానికి పన్నెండు మార్గాలు, ఆగ్రహాన్ని రేకెత్తించకుండా వ్యక్తులను మార్చడానికి తొమ్మిది మార్గాలను సూచిస్తుంది.

jab-litti-chokha-met-chicken-chettinad.title: Jab Litti Chokha Met Chicken Chettinad
jab-litti-chokha-met-chicken-chettinad.description: Bihar ke ek chhote se gaav se aayi Gauri, Chennai ke ek bade corporate office mein environment aur sustainability ke liye jang chhed deti hai. Uska saamna hota hai Raman se, ek shant aur practical corporate mentor, jo har cheez mein patience aur process mein vishwas rakhta hai. Gauri turant badlaav chahti hai, jabki Raman dheere-dheere system ko badalne ka paksh leta hai. Kya Gauri aur Raman apne rasto ke beech ek behtar raasta dhoondh paayenge? Ya unka yeh takraav unhe hamesha ke liye alag kar dega?

being-reshma-4.title: Being Reshma
being-reshma-4.description: Aakhir kaise ek acid attack survivor ne apne hausle se badal di apni kismat ki rekhaayen,  Aur ban gayi har kisi ki inspiration ? Reshma se seekhiye zindagi ki har mushkil se ladne ka tareeka, is Audiobook Being Reshma me.

youre-hired-mr-ghost.title: You're Hired, Mr. Ghost
youre-hired-mr-ghost.description: Maut ke baad Liang ko mili ek ajeeb naukri—Narak mein HR ki! haunted dungeons mein jaakar dangerous ghosts aur monsters ko apni company ke liye recruit karna. Target fail hua toh punishment tay thi, lekin Liang ne darrne ke bajay apni ghost army banana shuru kar diya. Har successful recruitment ke saath uski rank aur power badhti gayi. Lekin jab Dragon Group aur Narak ke beech ek mysterious deal saamne aayi, Liang ek aise mission mein phans gaya jahan reward bada tha… aur khatra usse bhi bada!

sacred-secrets-erotic-art-on-indian-temp.title: Sacred Secrets: Erotic Art on Indian Temples
sacred-secrets-erotic-art-on-indian-temp.description: దేవుడి గుడుల పైన శృంగార శిల్పాలు ఎందుకు చెక్కబడతాయి? వాటి అంతరార్థం ఏంటి? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

muthamizh-madurai.title: Muthamizh Madurai
muthamizh-madurai.description: Sangam vaithu Thamizh valartha Maduraiyin varalatrai azhagu tamizhil thoguthu solgirathu intha audio puthagam. Vaarungal Sangakala Madurai ku intha puthagathin vazhiyaga oru payanam poi varalaam.

the-new-tenant.title: The New Tenant
the-new-tenant.description: A fresh start in a peaceful apartment turns into a terrifying mystery when Anand discovers that every resident remembers the same tenant in completely different ways. As reality begins to shift around him, he must uncover the truth before he loses his own grip on what is real.

varhad-nighalaya-londonla.title: Varhad Nighalaya Londonla
varhad-nighalaya-londonla.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

mahabharatam.title: Mahabharatam
mahabharatam.description: Bharathiya ithihasalalo Mabharatam mundu varasalo untundi. Thinte gaarale thinali vinte Bharathame vinaali antaaru peddalu. Manishi jivitham lo edurayye prathi samasyaki ee bharatham lo samadhanam untundi. Prapancham lo marey ithara grandham bharatham prabhavitham chesinanthaga cheyyadu. Kulamatha pranthalaku atheethamgaa bharathaanni andaru vintunnaru. Randi meeru kuda vini gnanaanni pondandi.

nanna-thamma-shankara.title: Nanna Thamma Shankara
nanna-thamma-shankara.description: ಶಂಕರ್‌ನಾಗ್‌ ಇದ್ದಿದ್ರೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಚಿತ್ರರಂಗ ಎಲ್ಲೋ ಇರ್ತಿತ್ತು ಅಂತ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಜನ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ ಪಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ. 2014ರ ಹೊತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ರೈಲನ್ನು ಆಗಿನ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕೇ ಕಾರ್ಯ ರೂಪಕ್ಕೆ ತರಲು ಬಯಸಿದ್ದರು ಶಂಕರ್‌ನಾಗ್.‌ ಚಲನಚಿತ್ರಗಳಿಗಷ್ಟೇ ಸ್ಥಿಮಿತವಾಗಿರದಿದ್ದ ಕರಾಟೆ ಕಿಂಗ್‌, ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ನಗರದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಯೋಜನೆಗಳನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ರು. ಅವರನ್ನು ಕುರಿತ ಸ್ವಾರಸ್ಯಕರ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ, ಅವರನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಹತ್ತಿರದಿಂದ ಬಲ್ಲ, ಅವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಅವರ ಅಣ್ಣ ಶ್ರೀ ಅನಂತನಾಗ್‌ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಶಂಕರ್‌ನಾಗ್ ಬದುಕಿನ ಕುರಿತ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ "ನನ್ನ ತಮ್ಮ ಶಂಕರ" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

thamizhin-sirappu.title: Thamizhin Sirappu
thamizhin-sirappu.description: 2000 Varusham ah indha ulagathula irundhu vara namma Tamizh mozhi ku ennana sirappugal iruku theriyuma? Tamizh mozhi la mattum dhan endha oru varthai'kum 7 ezhuthu'ku mela irukaadhu. Idhu vera endha ulaga mozhigal'kum porundhadhu. the-sacred-games-part-2.title: The Sacred Games Part 2
the-sacred-games-part-2.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

vasu-charithra.title: Vasu Charithra
vasu-charithra.description: వాసు చరిత్ర తెలుగు భాషలో రామరాజభూషణుడు రాసిన ప్రాముఖ్యమైన గ్రంథం. ఈ పుస్తకం భారతదేశంలోని ప్రాచీన వాసువు కథను వివరించడంతో పాటు, కవి త్రయం రచించిన మహాభారతంలోని 45 శ్లోకాలపై ఆధారపడి ఉంది. రామరాజభూషణుడు ఈ కథను విస్తరించి, ఆరు విభాగాలుగా విభజించి, తిరుమల నాయకునికి అంకితం చేశారు.

5-steps-to-build-your-personal-brand.title: 5 Steps to Build Your Personal Brand
5-steps-to-build-your-personal-brand.description: Nammatta irukkura thanithuvatha payanpaduthi namma thozhil matrum velaila vetri adaiya udhavura oru kalai thaan personal branding. Panamum, Perumaiyum sambaathikka udhavura personal branding pathi therinjukalaam vaanga !

journey-of-curiosity-cymatics-the-scienc.title: Journey of Curiosity: Cymatics & the Science of Sound
journey-of-curiosity-cymatics-the-scienc.description: Embark on a sonic adventure through the realms of acoustics and psychoacoustics, where we unravel the mysteries of how sound waves propagate, interact, and influence our perception. Uncover the profound impact of sound on our emotions, cognition, and overall well-being, as we explore the therapeutic potential of sound healing and the intricacies of the human auditory system.

swiggy-vs-zomato-ipo-battles-aur-profits.title: Swiggy Vs Zomato: IPO Battles aur Profits ka Maha Sangram!
swiggy-vs-zomato-ipo-battles-aur-profits.description: IPO ki Jung mein kaun banega winner? Swiggy aur Zomato ke beech ka yeh battle hai profits, valuations, aur investors ko apna banane ka! Dekhiye kaise IPO ke iss maha sangram mein dono companies ek doosre ko takkar de rahi hain, aur kya yeh aapke next investment ka mauka ho sakta hai?

how-to-fight-infertility-2.title: How To Fight Infertility?
how-to-fight-infertility-2.description: Lifestyle-um modern bhakshana reethiyum kaarenam innu mikka couples-um anubhavikkunna pradhana aarogya preshnamaanu vandhyatha or infertility ennathu. Aanungalilum pennungalilum vyathyastha kaaranangal kondanu infertility undakunnath. Ah karenangal enthokkeyanennum sexual health engane mechapeduthamennum ee showiloode ariyam..

-“रक्षक”--Duty-After-Death.title: “रक्षक” : Duty After Death
-“रक्षक”--Duty-After-Death.description: India - China border pe jab us raat china ki taraf se achanak hamla shuru karne ka plan bana to  neend me doobe bhartiya sipahiyon ko ek aatma ne hamle ke pahle hi savdhaan kar diya. Itna hi nahi china ki bhayanak saazish ko is aatma ne tabah kar diya , aur Indian Army soldiers ki ladai jeetne me help ki. Ab bas ek hi sawal tha ki kaun hai ye aatma jo marne ke baad bhi kar rahi hai  bharat ki Aan - Baan - Shaan ki raksha ?  Janne ke liye abhi sunein poori kahani !

election-commission-of-india.title: Election Commission Of India
election-commission-of-india.description: Oru naatoda thalaivar ah therndhu edukkuradhu nra dhu saadharanamaana vishyam illa. Andha velai ah sariya seiyya dhaan Election commission iruku, aana athoda mudinjidhaa enna? Election commission eppadi seyal paduthu, athoda pal veru poruppugal enna nu indha audio book la kettu therinjikonga !

celebrities-business-brands.title: Celebrities Business Brands
celebrities-business-brands.description: ಸಿನೆಮಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಪೋರ್ಟ್ಸ್‌ನಂತಹ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಸರು ಮಾಡಿರೋ ಹಲವಾರು ಸೆಲೆಬ್ರಿಟಿಸ್‌ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್‌ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಗಳನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ನಿಮಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಾ? ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ನಟ-ನಟಿಯರು, ಕ್ರೀಡಾಪಟುಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯತೆಯನ್ನ ಕೇವಲ ದುಡ್ಡು ಮಾಡೋದಕ್ಕಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ತಮ್ಮ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್‌ನಾ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಸೋಕೂ ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ತಾರೆ. ಸೆಲೆಬ್ರಿಟಿಸ್ ಫೇಸ್‌ ವ್ಯಾಲ್ಯೂನಿಂದ ಹಲವಾರು ಪ್ರಾಡಕ್ಟ್‌ಗಳು ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಗಮನಾರ್ಹವಾಗಿ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಸಾಧಿಸಿ, ಜನರ ಮನೆಮಾತಾಗಿವೆ. ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ತಾರೆಯರು ಹೊಂದಿರೋ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್‌ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡ್ತಿವೆ ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "Celebrities Business Brands" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

kaise-banayein-apni-life-ko-perfect.title: Kaise Banayein Apni Life Ko Perfect?
kaise-banayein-apni-life-ko-perfect.description: Kya aap bhi apne aap ko humesha blame karte hain ki kyun aapki life perfect nahi hai? Kyun aap dusron se kam successful hain? Kyun luxury aur wealth apke paas dusron se kam hai? நோ-.title: நோ ......
நோ-.description: ஒரு தொழிலதிபர் பிரபல வெளிநாட்டுப் பாடகரை வரவழைத்து பிரமாண்டமான பாடல் நிகழ்ச்சி நடத்த திட்டமிடுகிறார். சில காரணங்களால் அந்தப் பாடகர் நிகழ்ச்சியை ரத்து செய்துவிட்டு அதே தேதியில் வேறு ஒரு தொழிலதிபரின் நிகழ்ச்சிக்கு வர சம்மதிக்கிறார். அவமானமும், நஷ்டமும் அடையும் தொழிலதிபர் இந்தியா வரும் பாடகரைக் கொலை செய்ய கூலிப்படையை நியமிக்கிறார். பிறகு, அந்தப் பாடகரின் நல்ல மனம் அறிந்ததும் கொலைத் திட்டத்தைக் கைவிடுகிறார். ஆனால் கூலிப்படை ஆசாமியைத் தொடர்பு கொள்ள இயலவில்லை. கொலை செய்ய நினைத்தவரே கொலையைத் தடுக்கப் போராடும் வித்தியாசப் பின்னணியில் சுவாரசியமான திருப்பங்கள் கொண்ட கதைதான் .. நோ!'

how-to-talk-to-anyone-12.title: How To Talk To Anyone
how-to-talk-to-anyone-12.description: ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆ, ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಬೆರೆಯುವ ಕಲೆಯೂ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ, ಎಲ್ಲರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಮಂತ್ರಮುಗ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುವ ಹಲವು ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. How to Talk to Anyone ಕೃತಿಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರೇರಿತವಾಗಿ, ಹೊಸ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಮರಸವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡುವುದು, ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿರಗೊಳ್ಳುವುದು, ಮತ್ತು ಧೈರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಕಲಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಂವಹನ ನಡೆಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರು, ಸಹೋದ್ಯೋಗಿಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ಅಪರಿಚಿತರಾಗಲೀ, ಎಲ್ಲರೊಡನೆ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾನ್ವಯ ಹೊಂದಲು ಬೇಕಾದ ಸೂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸಲು ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ.

how-to-apply-bank-loan-for-education-1.title: How To Apply Bank Loan For Education
how-to-apply-bank-loan-for-education-1.description: Students ki Higher Studies kosam Bank nundi Loan Teesukunte Chance undi undi. Kanee Chaalamandi Stundents ki matram Ee Study loan ela Teesukovali Ane daanipai Clear Idea Ledu. Deenivalla Higher Studies ponde Chance ni Kolpotunnaru. Ee Audio book lo Education Loan Ela teesukovali, Inka Ee loan Teesukune Process meda unna Nijalu, Apohalanu, Qualifications Mariyu Nibandanala Gurinchi Ee Audio book lo vini telusukondi

evolution-of-indian-media.title: Evolution Of Indian Media
evolution-of-indian-media.description: Aaj Media ek mahatvachi bhumika bajavatoh ahe . Media mhanje nakki kay? tyachi suruvat kashi zali.. Pragati keli ki adhogati ya baddal apan savistar mahiti ya show dware janun ghenar ahot.  Print Media pasun , te Digital Media paryant anek ranjak goshti tumhala kaltil .

lok-vyavahar-prabhavshali-vyakti-ki-kala.title: Lok Vyavahar: Prabhavshali Vyakti Ki Kala
lok-vyavahar-prabhavshali-vyakti-ki-kala.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether youre aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life youve always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

மலர்கள்-கேட்டேன்-வனமே-தந்தாய்-.title: மலர்கள் கேட்டேன் வனமே தந்தாய்
மலர்கள்-கேட்டேன்-வனமே-தந்தாய்-.description: கல்லூரி இறுதி ஆண்டு படிக்கும் மாயாவிற்கும் அவளுக்குப் பிடிக்காத அத்தை மகனான மாறனுக்கும் கட்டாயத் திருமணம் நடக்கிறது. பட்டாம்பூச்சியாய் சிறகடித்து திரிந்து கொண்டிருந்த மாயா இனி என்ன ஆகப் போகிறாள்?

my-life-77.title: My Life : APJ Abdul Kalam
my-life-77.description: Rameshwaram la oru chinna paiyan parakka aasai patta kadhai idhu. Pala struggles ah thaandi India oda most wanted scientist ah, India’s first citizen ah irundha Abdul Kalam avaroda life la nadantha memorable moments ah pathi sollirukaru. Kelunga “My Life : An illustrated autobiography”

సమస్యలు-పరిష్కారాలు.title: సమస్యలు పరిష్కారాలు
సమస్యలు-పరిష్కారాలు.description: Samasya raganee manam parishkaram alochinchatam manesi, Vicharinchatam prarambhistham. Samudram entha peddadaina, Neellani lopaliki ranivvakapothe padava munagadu. Samasya yeentha peddadaina manasuloki ranivvakapothe bhadha undadu.  Itharula valla vach samasyalu theeralante maravalasindi vaallu manam kaadu. Vaallani marchatam ela ani pathika shatham mandi vicharisthu kaalam gadipestharu.

விண்ணோடும்-முகிலொடும்-.title: விண்ணோடும் முகிலோடும்
விண்ணோடும்-முகிலொடும்-.description: தன் நாயகனுக்கு தான் சற்றும் பொருத்தமில்லாதவள் என நினைத்து அவனை விட்டு பிரிந்து செல்லும் நாயகி. அவள் தானே விட்டு சென்றாள் அவளாகவே உணர்ந்து தன்னிடம் வரவேண்டும் என பிடிவாதத்துடன் இருக்கும் நாயகன். இவர்கள் இணைவார்களா? யார் யாரை தேடி சென்று இணைவார்கள்?

யார்-குற்றவாளி.title: யார் குற்றவாளி?
யார்-குற்றவாளி.description: தமிழகத்தின் பிரபல அரசியல்வாதி ஒருவர் கொடூரமாக கொலை செய்யப்படுகிறார்.  அந்த வழக்கு சிபிஐயிடம் ஒப்படைக்கபடுகிறது. வழக்கு ஒப்படைக்கப்பட்ட அதிகாரி தனக்கு வரும் எதிர்ப்புகளையும் மீறி  இந்த கொலை வழக்கை விசாரணை செய்கிறார். கடைசியாக கொலை குற்றவாளியை கண்டுபிடித்தாரா? அல்லது கண்டுபிடித்த பிறகு அவரது நடவடிக்கை என்ன?

how-to-build-your-wedding-budget-2.title: How to Build Your Wedding Budget
how-to-build-your-wedding-budget-2.description: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರ ಬದುಕಲ್ಲೂ ಮದ್ವೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಒಂದು ಬ್ಯೂಟಿಫುಲ್ ಚಾಪ್ಟರ್..! ಲೈಫಲ್ಲಿ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಬರುವ ಈ ಸೆಲೆಬ್ರೇಶನ್ ಗ್ರಾಂಡ್ ಆಗಿ ಆಗ್ಬೇಕು, ಅದ್ದೂರಿಯಾಗಿರ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಅಂಕೋಳೋದೂ ಮಾಮೂಲಿ...ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ 'ಇಷ್ಟ ' ಮುಂದೆ  'ಕಷ್ಟ' ಆಗ್ಬಾರ್ದು ಅಂದ್ರೆ, ಬಜೆಟ್ ವೆಡ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಮಾಡೋದು ತುಂಬ ಮುಖ್ಯ..! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ಬಜೆಟ್ ವೆಡ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಅಂದ್ರೇನು? ಅದನ್ನ  ಮಾಡೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಸಿಂಪಲ್ ಆಗಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಖರ್ಚಲ್ಲಿ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಖುಷಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವೆ ಹೇಗ್ ಆಗೋದು? ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕಾ, ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕು FM ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ  ' How to Build Your ವೆಡ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಬಜೆಟ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್ .

கடல்-சேரும்-விண்மீன்கள்.title: கடல் சேரும் விண்மீன்கள்
கடல்-சேரும்-விண்மீன்கள்.description: தன் மனதில் உள்ள அழுத்தங்களுக்கும் அச்சங்களுக்கும் இடையே அலைபாய்பவள் திட்டமிடா பயணமொன்றில் கலகலப்பான இளைஞனான தருணைச் சந்திக்கிறாள். அச்சந்திப்பிற்குப் பின்னால் வானில் உறையும் விண்மீனின் பயணம் தடைபட்டதா அல்லது திசை மாறியதா என்பதைச் சுவாரஸ்யமாகச் சொல்லும் கதையே ‘கடல் சேரும் விண்மீன்கள்’.

dharma-and-adharma.title: Dharma And Adharma
dharma-and-adharma.description: ధర్మం అనుసరించడం జీవితం లో న్యాయం, సత్యం, శాంతిని తెస్తుంది. అధర్మం అనైతికత, లోభం, ద్వేషం ద్వారా సమాజంలో అశాంతిని పెంచుతుంది. పురాణాలు ధర్మాన్ని పాటించినవారు విజయం సాధించారని, అధర్మం అనుసరించినవారు నాశనమయ్యారని చెబుతాయి. కర్మ సిద్ధాంతం ప్రకారం మన కర్మలే మన భవిష్యత్తును నిర్ణయిస్తాయి.

বিরহ-সুর--লেখক--নাস্তিক.title: Biraha Sur
বিরহ-সুর--লেখক--নাস্তিক.description: Nilanjanar kache nichok college prem holeo Nikhilesher hridoye shokto pokto hote thake bhalobasa. Modhyobitto premer kache gopon roye jay jonmodiner phul, Nilanjanar ghor bhore jay Nikhiler anka cobi te, ar majhkhane beje othe biroho sur. 5-star-ka-billionaire-naukar.title: 5 Star Ka Billionaire Naukar
5-star-ka-billionaire-naukar.description: Arjun Raichand, a Harvard MBA and billionaire's son, must work as a hotel housekeeping trainee to prove himself worthy of leading his father's 50,000-crore empire. Facing humiliation and betrayal, he uncovers a murder plot and corporate conspiracy. By exposing the villains and saving an innocent woman, Arjun transforms from servant to CEO, earning his birthright through merit and courage.

reflections-by-swami-vivekananda-1.title: Reflections by Swami Vivekananda
reflections-by-swami-vivekananda-1.description: Swami Vivekanandante aazhameriya chinthakalilekulla yathrayanu 'Reflections by Swami Vivekananda' enna ee show. Jeevithan, matham, aathmeeyatha ennivayakurichulla adhehathinte prabhashanangalum rachanakalum ulkollunna ee audiobook ningale chinthipikkanum prachothipikkanum prerana cheyyum.

the-middle-class-genius.title: The Middle-Class Genius
the-middle-class-genius.description: விஞ்ஞானியாக வேண்டும் என்ற கனவுடன் வாழும் நடுத்தர குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த மாணவி சாக்ஷி, தனது திறமையால் ISRO அறிவியல் போட்டிக்காக ஒரு புதுமையான AI திட்டத்தை உருவாக்குகிறாள். ஆனால் அந்த வெற்றி, ஒரு பணக்கார தொழிலதிபரின் மகனின் ஆசைக்கு தடையாக மாறுகிறது. அதிகாரம், பணம், மறைக்கப்பட்ட உறவுகள் மற்றும் பல வருடங்களாக புதைந்து கிடந்த குடும்ப ரகசியங்கள் ஒன்றன்பின் ஒன்றாக வெளிவர, சாக்ஷி தனது கனவையும், உண்மையையும் காப்பாற்ற போராட வேண்டிய நிலை உருவாகிறது.

focus-organic-study-rhythm.title: Focus: Study Music
focus-organic-study-rhythm.description: Calm and distraction-free music designed to improve concentration, support learning, and help you stay focused during study sessions.

dhurandhar-sniper-4.title: Dhurandhar Sniper
dhurandhar-sniper-4.description: For a year, Rohan has been known only as a simple cleaner at a shooting academy. No one knows he is actually G-9, the deadliest sniper. After losing his mentor, he left his past behind, but when the academy, an innocent child, and a family come under threat, he is forced to pick up the gun again. Now every shot becomes a choice - keep his identity hidden or reveal the truth to the world.

denaryache-hath-hajar.title: Denaryache Hath Hajar
denaryache-hath-hajar.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

ashtavakra-gita-maha-gita-part-8.description:
Paap aur Punya se judi har uljhan ka hal, suniye sirf yahaan! Kaise jeetein hai ek mukt jeevan, janiye Giridhar aur Dhananjay ki kahani se

kamayani-1.title: Kamayani
kamayani-1.description:
Kamayani "Kamini Mahal" ki sabse sundar aur prasiddh Nagar Vadhu thi, jisne apna sara jeevan mahal ke niyamon aur kartavya ka imaandari se palan krte hue "Kamini Mahal" Ki seva mein laga diya. Ek din usi Kamayani ko ho gaya ek sadharan se vyapari 'Chandra' se pyar. Jahan ek or Kamayani apne prem or kartvyo ke bich kisi ek ko chunne ki duvidha mein fansi hui thi, vahi dusri taraf Kamayani ke sabse kareebi log hi rach rhe the use "Kamini Mahal" se bahar karne ki sazish. Kya Kamayani ho jaayegi unki sajish ka shikar? Kya karegi Kamayani  jab uspar lagega mahal ke niyamon ko todne ka aarop?  Kise chunegi aakhir wo, apne farz ko ya apne prem ko?
Janne ke liye suniye Kamayani.

get-epic-shit-done-7.title: Get Epic Shit Done
get-epic-shit-done-7.description: 'ಡು ಎಪಿಕ್ ಶಿಟ್' ಖ್ಯಾತಿಯ ಅಂಕುರ್ ವಾರಿಕೂ ಬರೆದಿರುವ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಪುಸ್ತಕ 'ಗೆಟ್ ಎಪಿಕ್ ಶಿಟ್ ಡನ್'..! ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯ ಎದುರಿಸುವ ಹಲವಾರು ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಎದುರಿಸುವುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು 36 ಪ್ರಶ್ನೋತ್ತರ ಮೂಲಕ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಈ ಮೂಲಕ ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲಾ ಗೊಂದಲಗಳಿಗೆ ತೆರೆ ಎಳೆದು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಣ್ತೆರೆಸುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇಂತಹ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ, ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ...

perfect-appraisal-kaise-paayein.title: Perfect Appraisal Kaise Paayein?
perfect-appraisal-kaise-paayein.description: Har koi chahta hai apni job mein top appraisal score paaye, par kaise? Is show mein hum batayenge aasan aur asardaar tareeke, Jo aapko apne career goals achieve karne mein madad karenge. Chaliye, shuru karte hain ek nayi journey, jismein aap seekhenge roz ke kaam ko kaise behtar bana sakte hain.

75d1518b-999b-406c-9797-58d2af2786bb.title: Meendum Vandhavan
75d1518b-999b-406c-9797-58d2af2786bb.description: கோடீஸ்வர தொழிலதிபரான சித்தார்த், பணத்தின் அகந்தையில் தந்தையின் அன்பை நிராகரிக்கிறான். ஆனால் ஒரு துயரமான மரணத்துக்குப் பிறகு, அவனுக்கு கடந்த காலத்திற்குத் திரும்பி வாழ ஒரு வாய்ப்பு கிடைக்கிறது. இம்முறை தந்தையை காப்பாற்றி, குடும்பத்தின் சதிகளை முறியடித்து, தன் விதியையே மாற்ற சித்தார்த் முடிவு செய்கிறான்.

therthal-vazhikatti.title: Therthal Vazhikatti
therthal-vazhikatti.description: Nammala yaar aatchi seiyanumnu select panrathukku makkal aagiya namma kaila kodukka pattu irukura migaperiya aayutham thaan Election. Namma India la Elections Eppadi nadakuthu?, Elections la namma Pangu enna?, Election la sariyana candidate ta choose panrathu eppadi ? nu Elections thodarbana ella kelvigalukkum intha guide la answers iruku. Vaanga therinjukalam.

ஆழ்மனதும்-அதன்-அபரிமித-ரகசியங்களும்.title: ஆழ்மனதும் அதன் அபரிமித ரகசியங்களும்
ஆழ்மனதும்-அதன்-அபரிமித-ரகசியங்களும்.description: Ulaga kodeesvarar bill gateskku irukkum aatral thaan namakkullum irukkirathu. intha bookod nokkkam namakkul irukkum aatralai veliakondu varadhu dhan. Intha booka kettu vazhkkaila vetri pera vazhthukkal

hasrat-musa.title: Hazrat Musa
hasrat-musa.description: When Pharaoh orders every Hebrew boy killed, baby Musa is saved by his mother and raised by Queen Asiya. Forced to flee after defending a slave, he lives as a shepherd in Madyan until God calls him at the burning bush. With his brother Harun, Musa confronts Fir’awn, defeats the magicians and leads Bani Israel across the parted sea. The desert brings trials: hunger, the Golden Calf, Qarun’s rebellion and Khidr’s lessons in humility, until Yusha’s generation stands ready for the Promised Land.

polio-drops-enduku-mukhyam.title: Polio Drop Enduku Mukhyam?
polio-drops-enduku-mukhyam.description: పోలియో ఏ వైరస్ వలన వస్తుంది? పోలియో టీకాను కనుగొన్నది ఎవరు? ఈ మహమ్మారి పూర్తిగా అంతరించిందా? వినండి పోలియో ఆడియో బుక్

black-tiger-remake-1-to-12.title: Black Tiger
black-tiger-remake-1-to-12.description: Pakistan ki Aankhon mein Mission Nuclear Power ka bhayanak sapna tha. Lekin use mitti me mila dene Hindustani sher Black Tiger aya jisne Pakistan ki nak ke neeche se unke is plan ko nestanabud kar diya aur desh ke liye wo kar dikhaya jiski kalpana matra se hi kisi ki rooh kaanp jaye. Suniye India ke sabse khatarnak SPY ki wo kahani jisme desh ke liye mar mit jane ka junoon hai aur Bharat maa ke liye ek anokha pyar bhi “ Black Tiger ''

doosra-a-tale-of-cricket-crime-and-contr.title: Doosra - A Tale of Cricket, Crime And Controversy
doosra-a-tale-of-cricket-crime-and-contr.description: Cricket prapancham chaala klistamainadi. Mana desham lo Cricket ni oka mathamga bhavistharu. Alanti desham lo Cricket lo konnisarlu fixings jarigayi. Daniki karanam kontha mandi aatagaallu mariyu bukilu. Asalu fixing ante emity? Ee amsham ithivrutthamga saage ee thrilling story mee kosam.

చంద్రశేఖర్-ఆజాద్-.title: చంద్రశేఖర్ ఆజాద్
చంద్రశేఖర్-ఆజాద్-.description: మరణం అంటే భయం లేని సమర యోధుడు. బ్రిటిష్ వారి గుండెల్లో గుబులు పుట్టించిన భరత మాత ముద్దు బిడ్డ ఆజాద్... ఆయన చేసిన త్యాగాల ఫలితమే నేటి మన ఈ స్వాతంత్య్రం. వినండి ఈ ధీరుని కథ.

olave.title: Olave
olave.description: 'ಲವ್' ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನು? ಎರಡು ಜೀವಗಳ‌ ನಡುವಿನ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆ? ಆರಾಧನೆ? ಒಲವು? ಮಮತೆ? ಸೆಳೆತ? ನಂಬಿಕೆ? ಊಹೂಂ, ಪ್ರೇಮದ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆಯದೇ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತೆ‌‌. ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ ಪ್ರೀತಿಗೆ ಅದರ ರೀತಿಗೆ ತಲೆಬಾಗದವರೇ ಇಲ್ಲಾ! ಈ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕ 'ರವಿ ಬೆಳಗೆರೆ' ಅವ್ರು ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಧ್ವನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯದ್ಭುತವಾದ ಪ್ರೇಮಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ‌. ಈ 'ಒಲವೇ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

raktim-nyay.title: Raktim Nyay
raktim-nyay.description: ACP Vijay Srivastav par deshdroh ke jhoothe ilzaam ne Maithili ki zindagi barbaad kar di. Pita ki maut aur parivaar ke khoon ke baad, Maithili ne apni masoomiyat ko todkar apradhi duniya mein kadam rakha. Khoobsurti aur chaalaki se raaz kholte hue, woh apne pita ke samman aur apne khoe hue sapno ka badla lena chahti hai. Lekin sachchai yeh hai ki Maithili apne sabse bade dushman par vishwas kar baithi aur isi ne uska sab kuch chheen liya. Kya wo apna badla pura kar payegi? Ya phir apne dushman ke jaal mein phans kar sab kuch kho baithegi?

hunter-3.title: HUNTER
hunter-3.description:
ಮಾನವ್, ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಹುಡುಗ. ತನ್ನ ತಾಯಿಯ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಗಾಗಿ ಹಣದ ತೀವ್ರ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದ್ದಾಗ, ಮೋನಿಕಾ ಎಂಬ ಮಹಿಳೆ ಆತನಿಗೆ ಐದು ಲಕ್ಷ ರೂಪಾಯಿಯ ಡೀಲ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಹೆಲ್ಪ್‌ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.– ಆದರೆ ಈ ಒಪ್ಪಂದವು ಸರಳವಾಗಿರದೆ. ಅವನನ್ನು ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿ ಮಾದಕ ದಾರಿ ಕಡೆ ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.  

ಹಣ, ಮಾದಕಪದಾರ್ಥ, ಅಂಧಕಾರದ ಜಗತ್ತು – ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಮಾನವ್ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಸ ತಿರುವು ತರುತ್ತವೆ. ಅತ್ತ, ತಂಗಿ ನೇಹಾ ಕಾಣೆ ಆಗುವುದು ಹಾಗು ಮಾನವ್‌ ಸಂಕಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಒದ್ದಾಟ ಹಲವು ಹುರಿಗಳಿಂದ ನಡಿಯುತ್ತಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಾನವ್ ಈ ಜಂಜಾಟದಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದಾ? ಅಥವಾ ಹೀಗೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೇಯೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳ್ತಾಇರಿ  "ಹಂಟರ್" – ಹಣದ ಬೆಲೆಯ ಹೋರಾಟ, ಪಾಸ್ಟ್ನ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಬದುಕಿನ ತಿರುವುಗಳ ಕಥೆ! ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ.

chandrababu-kanneerum-punnagayum.title: சந்திரபாபு - கண்ணீரும் புன்னகையும்
chandrababu-kanneerum-punnagayum.description: தமிழ் சினிமாவின் legendary comedian சந்திரபாபுவின் உருக்கமான வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு Audiobook வடிவில் உங்களுக்காக.. சிரிப்பும் - சோகமும் கலந்த ஒரு அற்புதமான நடிப்புக்கலைஞனின் வாழ்க்கைக் கதையை கேட்கலாம் வாங்க.

ಬೆಂಕಿಯಲ್ಲಿ-ಅರಳಿದ-ಹೂವು--ಮಂಜಮ್ಮ-ಜೋಗತಿ.title: Benkiyalli Aralida Hoovu: Manjamma Jogathi
ಬೆಂಕಿಯಲ್ಲಿ-ಅರಳಿದ-ಹೂವು--ಮಂಜಮ್ಮ-ಜೋಗತಿ.description: ಇವ್ರು ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ್ದು ಗಂಡಾಗಿ, ಆದ್ರೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತ ಬದಲಾಗಿದ್ದು ಹೆಣ್ಣಾಗಿ..! ಸಮಾಜದ ಕಟ್ಟುಪಾಡುಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆದರಿ ಮನೆಬಿಟ್ಟು, ಯಾವುದಕ್ಕೂ ಅಂಜದೇ, ಅಳುಕದೇ ಬದುಕು ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡು ನೂರಾರು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಆದರ್ಶಪ್ರಾಯವಾಗಿರುವ ತೃತೀಯ ಲಿಂಗಿ..! ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸಣ್ಣ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ, 'ಪದ್ಮಶ್ರೀ'ಗಾಗಿ ದಿಲ್ಲಿ ತಲುಪಿದ ಸಾಧಕಿಯ ಹೆಸರೇ ಮಂಜಮ್ಮ ಜೋಗತಿ..! ಹೀಗೆ ಮಂಜುನಾಥನಾಗಿದ್ದವರು ಮಂಜಮ್ಮನಾದ ರೋಚಕ ಕಥೆಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಬೆಂಕಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅರಳಿದ ಹೂವು ಮಂಜಮ್ಮ ಜೋಗತಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ...

yayati-yauvan-ka-sauda.title: Yayati: Yauvan ka Sauda
yayati-yauvan-ka-sauda.description: Long before the Mahabharata era, King Yayati of the Chandravanshi dynasty—an ancestor of Lord Krishna—became so consumed by his lust that he forgot all bounds of dharma and morality. When Shukracharya’s curse strips him of his youth, Yayati borrows the youth of his own son and returns to a life of indulgence. But even after a thousand years, will his thirst ever be quenched? Will youth bring him pleasure—or destruction? And will he ever be able to conquer his own desires?

the-art-of-de-attachment.title: Mastering The Art of Detachment
the-art-of-de-attachment.description: Zindagi mein kabhi na kabhi, har koi emotional attachment ki wajah se toot-ta hai. 'Non-attachment se life kaise badlein' sun kar janiye kaise Vishal ne is cycle ko toda aur seekha ki kaise jeena hai bina kisi fear ke. Agar aap bhi apne past se aage badhne ke tips chahte hain, toh ye show miss na karein.

the-jrd-tata-story.title: The J.R.D. Tata Story
the-jrd-tata-story.description:
|Key Highlights - Tata Group Legacy, JRD - Airways Aviation & JRD Family and Career|
Tata Group Ke Foundation, JRD Tata ki Life aur Family ki Kahani. 


Link - https://kukufm.com/show/indira-gandhi-the-story-of-a-leader?utm_source=upsell

how-to-move-abroad-for-studies.title: How To Move Abroad For Studies
how-to-move-abroad-for-studies.description: Eeyide aayi niravadhi yuvakkal aanu nammude nattil ninnu paaschathya raajyangalilek uparipadanathinayi povunnath. Munpum ithu undayirunnenkilum adutha kalathayi nalla vidhyabhyasavum joliyum thedi akkare pokunnavarude ennam dinam prathi koodukayanu. Palarkkum videsha padana mohangal undenkilum shariyaya guidance kittathath kond mathram pinnottu valiyunnavar und. Avarkkullathanu ee show. Madich nilkkaruth. Saadhyathakaludethanu ee lokam. Varoo. Kelkkoo..

how-to-format-your-body-clock.title: How To Format Your Body Clock?
how-to-format-your-body-clock.description: Early ah thoongi, Early ya elundhu, correct time la saaptale namakku paadhi vyadhi varaadhu. Nammal la paadhi per night full ah web series paathutu, morning breakfast ah skip pannitu suthitu irukom. Idhu naala namma body clock bayangarama disturb aagum. Pala health issues um koodave varum. Adhu enna BODY CLOCK? Therinjuka Kelunga “How to Format your Body Clock?” on Kuku FM

indias-ai-gold-rush.title: India’s AI Gold Rush
indias-ai-gold-rush.description: AI sirf jobs replace karne nahi aaya. Ye un logon ke liye ek naya business opportunity bhi lekar aaya hai jo AI ko real-world problems solve karne ke liye use karna jaante hain. Raghav ki journey follow kijiye, jo ek failed career start ke baad AI ki help se businesses ke messy data, payments aur repetitive problems solve karna shuru karta hai. Dheere-dheere ek skill business banti hai. Lekin kya AI se paisa banana itna easy hai?

the-last-days-of-adolf-hitler.title: The Last Days of Adolf Hitler
the-last-days-of-adolf-hitler.description: തകർന്ന നാസി ഭരണം, ബെർലിനിലെ ഒളിത്തടവറയിലെ ഭീതി, ഹിറ്റ്ലറുടെ ഭ്രാന്തമായ മാനസികാവസ്ഥ - യൂറോപ്പിന്റെ ചരിത്രത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും ഇരുണ്ട അധ്യായത്തിന്റെ അവസാനം കേൾക്കൂ.

minni.title: Minni
minni.description: When a devastating earthquake traps 14-year-old Kabir and his eight-year-old sister Minni beneath the rubble of their home, Kabir must hide his suffering and keep his terrified sister alive through darkness, thirst, rats, and fading hope, while their desperate parents race against time to rescue them.

the-disrupter.title: Arvind Kejriwal: The Game Changer
the-disrupter.description:
Ek aandolan se nikli party ne Bharat ki rajneeti me uthal puthal macha kar likh diya ek naya adhyay. Kaise tay ki ek vyakti ne aam se khaas banne ki yatra aur ban gaya desh ki rajdhani Delhi ka mukhyamantri?
Aayiye jante hain is show me jiska nam hai 'Arvind Kejriwal: The Game Changer'...

property-management-dvare-shrimant-vohuy.title: Property Management Dvare Shrimant Kase Vahyache
property-management-dvare-shrimant-vohuy.description: Ghar..Pratyekache Swapn Asate ki swanahache ak tari ghar asave. Pan he ghar ghene, Tyache Documantation far critical kaam asate. Kahi ja nak sodun don ghare pan ghetat, mag ti rent var dene, tyacha maintenance hya sarv ghosti far velkhau asatat. Pan hi sarv kaame karayala akhada Mahitigaar Manus milala tar? Farch chhaan! Mag vel aani energy vachel, pan kaam pan suralitpane maargi lagtil. Hya sarv Kaamachya processla mhantat ‘Property Management’ he kase kartat, kon kartat, yaat kaay kaay kaame include hotat hi sarv mahiti ghvu ‘Property Management dvare Shrimant Vohuyat’ hya show dvare…fakt KUKUFM Var…Sune Jo Maan Chahe!

ishq-ki-kashmakash.title: Ishq ki Kashmakash
ishq-ki-kashmakash.description: Arranged marriage mein bandhano waale do log apne bhoot kaal ko bhula kar ek nayi kahani ki aur badhne wale hai.

aagaayam-kaanaadha-natchathiram.title: ஆகாயம் காணாத நட்சத்திரம்
aagaayam-kaanaadha-natchathiram.description: சினிமா தயாரிப்பாளரான பணக்கார கணவன் ரங்கராஜனை விட்டு, மகனுடன் தனித்து வாழ்பவர் மீனாட்சி. ஆனால், மீனாட்சியின் மருமகள் மாமியாரை  விரட்டிவிட்டு, மாமனாரின் சொத்துக்காக அவருடன் சேர்ந்து கொள்கிறாள். சுய கௌரவத்தோடு வாழ நினைக்கும் மீனாட்சி வாழ்க்கையில் எப்படி வெற்றி பெற்றார்?

ramaku-maribara-panchati-upaya.title: Ramaku Maribara Panchati Upaya
ramaku-maribara-panchati-upaya.description: Jump into a world of diverse tales with Kuku FM's Short Stories. Perfect for listeners on the go our short stories offer quick escapes into fictional worlds. From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

retirement-er-por-sukhi-jibon-poawae-upa.title: Retirement Er Por Sukhi Jibon Pawar Upay
retirement-er-por-sukhi-jibon-poawae-upa.description: Obosor shobdo ta ki apnar mone bhabna niye ashe? Obosor orthe chhuti bojhyae prathomik orthe thik e kintu obosor orthe ki obokash bojhaye na? Obosor orthe kintu notun sujog o bojhaye, obosor kintu bachar notun sujog ene debe , shob kichu nirbhor korche apnar drishtibhongir opor. Sishu boyosh ki bojhar aagei pouche jai joubon kale, ebong eki bhabe pouche jai shesher pataye ar tar e songe pouche jai retirement er patay. Retirement er din ki bhabe kataben, ba songsar e ba ki bhabe chalaben? Ei shob kichu niyei aj ker ei golpo.

balidan-2.title: Balidan
balidan-2.description: Indian Special Forces mein kya hota hai? Wahan sena ke jawan kaise kaam karte hai? Balidan ki is audiobook mein author ne in sabhi sawalon ka na sirf jawab diya hai. Balki un officers ki zindagi ka hissa bhi humare sath share kiya hai.

how-to-follow-your-passion-2.title: How to follow your Passion?
how-to-follow-your-passion-2.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಇಷ್ಟದ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂಬ ಕನಸು ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಪ್ಯಾಷನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಪ್ರೊಫೆಶನ್ ಆಗಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಎದ್ದು ಆಫೀಸ್ ಗೆ ಹೋಗುವುದು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕಷ್ಟದ ಕೆಲಸವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದರ ಪರಿಣಾಮವಾಗಿ ಒತ್ತಡ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಾಸೆ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಪಕ್ಕಾ. ಹೀಗಾದರೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ಯಾಷನ್ ಯಾವುದು ಎಂದು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಎದುರಾಗುವ ಸವಾಲುಗಳು ಯಾವುವು? ಪ್ಯಾಷನ್ ಗೊತ್ತಾದರೆ ದೀರ್ಘಾಯುಷಿ ಆಗಬಹುದು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನಿಜವೇ? ಕೇಳಿ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಪೂರ್ತಿ ತುಂಬುವ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಫಾಲೋ ಯೋರ್ ಪ್ಯಾಷನ್?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ KukuFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ!

कैसा-ये-इश्क़--लेखिका--दिव्या-यादव.title: Kaisa Ye Ishq
कैसा-ये-इश्क़--लेखिका--दिव्या-यादव.description: अनाथ दीया की मुलाकत दीपक से होती है। काम, प्‍यार और तकरार के बीच इन गाड़ी हिचकोले खाते आगे बढ़ती है। तो क्‍या इनकी मोहब्‍बत होगी कामयाब? या कोई बनेगा इनके बीच दीवार? जानने के लिए सुनें पूरी कहानी केवल कुकू एफएम पर।

how-to-read-a-book-2.title: Boi Porar Poddhoti
how-to-read-a-book-2.description: Boi amra sokolei porte pari, kintu bhebe dekhechen je ki bhabe boi porar poddhoti ke ropto kora jaye? Kintu ekta boi pore jodi apni tar ashol manei na bujhte paren tahole apnar khatni o somoy dui britha. Tai nijer jibon ke aro sohoj korte ar boi pore boi er asol ortho bujhte shune ni Mortimer J. Adler er lekha 'How To Read A Book'.

क्या-मोहब्बत-ज़रूरी-है--Season-1--लेखिका.title: Kya Mohobbat Zaruri Hai - Season 1
क्या-मोहब्बत-ज़रूरी-है--Season-1--लेखिका.description: भावार्थ और व्याख्या … जैसे नाम वैसे ही भोले दो लोग जो इश्क़ के एक अनजाने सफर का हिस्सा तो हैं पर फिर भी पूछते हैं एक दूसरे से "क्या मुहब्बत ज़रूरी है?" क्या हुआ इनकी स्कूल वाली नादान सी प्रेम कहानी का? जानने के लिए सुनिए इनकी ये कहानी आपके अपने Kuku FM पर।

tirumala-1.title: Tirumala
tirumala-1.description: Kaliyuga prathyaksha daivam Tirumala, ee punyakshetram lo koluvai unna aa venkateshwara swamy leelalu amogham. Bhakthula korikalanu theerusthu thana kaataakshaanni ellappudu andisthunna ee yedu kondalavaadu, mana andari govindudu. Govindaa Govindaa ani ante sarva paapaalu tholagipothayi, jivitham lo okkasaarainaa darshinchavalasina punya kshyathram Tirumala.

marvel-vs-dc-2.title: Marvel Vs DC
marvel-vs-dc-2.description: Marvel and DC are the two titans of the comic book business, and they have been engaged in a battle of supremacy for more than 50 years. Along with sales, cultural relevance and the affections of millions of admirers are also at risk. With the rivalry now getting extended from the pages of the comics to the silver screen to your smartphone's screen, the most compelling question you can ask a fan of superheroes these days is - "Marvel or DC?" This unique series tries to trace the development of this legendary rivalry. This is the untold tale of the greatest corporate conflict. Each episode will expose the vast array of strategies the two businesses have used to outsmart one another, including ideas theft, employee poaching, sabotage, the use of spies, and price wars, along with the history of this rivalry and its impact on the consumers. Witness the epic feud between Marvel and DC through this captivating series.

joy-of-missing-out-1.title: Joy Of Missing Out
joy-of-missing-out-1.description: ప్రతీ ఉదయం మీరు ఉత్సాహంగా మీ రోజుని ప్రారంభించడానికి మీరు ఏం చేయాలి? ప్రతీ రాత్రి  మీరు ప్రశాంతంగా నిద్రపోవడానికి, మీరు ఏం చెయ్యాలి? మీ జీవితంలో కొన్ని జ్ఞాపకాలు మిగుల్చుకోవడానికి మీ అలవాట్లు ఎలా మలచుకోవాలి? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే " జాయ్ ఆఫ్ మిస్సింగ్ అవుట్ " అనే కుకు ఎఫ్ ఎమ్ బైట్స్ వినండి.

फैशनवाद-ज़िंदाबाद--लेखक--ज्योतिंद्र-प्रसा.title: फैशनवाद ज़िंदाबाद
फैशनवाद-ज़िंदाबाद--लेखक--ज्योतिंद्र-प्रसा.description: Lekhak Jyotindra nath Prasad ne apni book Fashionwad Zindabad ke jariye badalte lifestyle aur logo ke vyvhaar per vyang kiya hai. Bhagdaud bhari zindagi mein insaan jeena ka maja bhul gaya hai. Badalte time ke sath Rishte kaise badal gye jaane ke liye sune Fashionwad Zindabad sirf Kuku FM per.

dharavi-new.title: Dharavi
dharavi-new.description: Mumbai ke sabse bade slum area Dharavi se achanak paani ho gya hai gaayab! Chaaro taraf mach chuka hai hungama. Jahaa'n ek taraf bichhai jaa rahi hai raajneetik bisaat wahi'n doosri taraf shuru ho chuki hai samajik jung. Ek Ek boond ke liye aakhir kyon taras rahi hai dharavi? Kaun hai ye teen ladke jinhone bigaad diye hai'n sabke khel? Kaun hai is hahakaar ka zimmedar? Sochne par majboor ho jaayenge. Abhi suniye humari ye khaas peshkash 'Dharavi'.

sales-success-1.title: Sales Success
sales-success-1.description: Kya aap chahte hain sales mein top performer banna? Agar han, Toh is show mein suniye, kaise Brian Tracy ke 21 anokhe techniques aapko de sakte hain har deal mein jeet! Kyunki ismein sikhaya gaya hai, Har minute ko count karna, competition ko pichhe chhodna, aur megacredibility establish karne jaisi aur bhi bahut saari cheezein. Jo banayengi aapko successful salesman.

the-idea-of-ipl.title: The idea of Twenty:20 League
the-idea-of-ipl.description: IPL Aaj duniya men hone wali Sabse badi cricket league hai ye to aapko pata hi hoga. Lekin kya aapko ye pata hai ki ipl ka idea sabse pahle kiske dimaag men aaya aur aaya to kaise aaya.Kaise ek insan ke is chhote se idea ne duniya bhar ke cricket aur cricket players ki zindagi ko badal kar rakh diya.Aur fir is idea dene wale insan ke saath BCCI ne kya kiya? In sab sawalon  ke jawab aur cricket ke  itihas ki kai parton ko aapke saamne kholne ke liye hi to hai ye hamara special show "The Idea Of IPl" Show.

unstoppable-love.title: Unstoppable Love
unstoppable-love.description: ఎక్కడో, ఎవరో, ఏదో చేస్తే, ఇంకెక్కడో, ఇంకెవరికో అది ఎఫెక్ట్ అయితే, దాన్ని Butterfly ఎఫెక్ట్ అంటారట. మరి అలంటి ఎఫెక్ట్ ఒక నలుగురి జీవితాల్లో జరిగితే? ప్రేమ కథగా సాగిపోతున్న విహారి, శ్వేత, దేవ్, నిత్యల జీవితాలు ఎలాంటి ఒడిదుడుకులకు లోనుకానున్నాయి? అస్సలు బయో వెపన్ కి వారి ప్రేమ కథలకు సంబంధం ఏంటి  తెలియాలంటే వినండి "unstoppable Love" మీ కుకు లో

anjali-8.title: அஞ்சலி
anjali-8.description: ல.ச.ராமாமிர்தம் எழுதிய அஞ்சலி என்ற இந்த சிறுகதைத் தொகுப்பு  நீர், நெருப்பு, நிலம், காற்று, ஆகாயம் ஆகிய பஞ்சபூதங்களை மையமாக வைத்த 5 கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு. இந்த கதைகளின் ஊடாக ல.ச.ரா நம்மை ஒரு மாய உலகத்திற்கு அழைத்துச் செல்கிறார்.. வாருங்கள் ஒரு பயணம் போய்விட்டு வரலாம்..

mafia-premiere-league.title: Mafia Premiere League
mafia-premiere-league.description: IPL team ke malik and ek businessman ke khilaaf hui khooni sajish. Drugs ka case aur hui NCB ki involvement. Rivals ne kiya family ke upar personal attack. Ek aisi thriller story jiska har ek episode aapko dene wala hai goosebumps. Khatarnak Crime aur romanchak Cricket ke tournament me kaun jitega aur kisko milegi trophy. Janne ke liye sune Mafia Premier League.

mastery.title: How To Master Any Skill?
mastery.description: Doston hum jab koi career option choose karte hain toh hamari poori koshish rehti hai ki hum us field mein mastery haasil karein, lekin kya hamesha aisa hota hai? Shayad nahi, kyuki jab hum field mein utarte hain tab humein real-time challenges ka saamna karna padta hai aise mein bahut zaroori hai ki hum khudko groom karte rahein aur apni learning ko jaari rakhein. Aaiye sunte hain ye audiobook jo humein mastery hassil krne ke safar pe le chalegi.

world-famous-churches-1.title: World Famous Churches
world-famous-churches-1.description: ప్రపంచంలో ఎన్ని ప్రసిద్ధ చర్చిలు ఉన్నాయి? యేసు క్రీస్తు నడియాడిన ప్రదేశాలేంటి? వాటికన్ సిటీకి ఉన్న ప్రత్యేకతలేంటి? వినండి ఆడియో బుక్ లో.

the-ferment-youth-unrest-in-india.title: The Ferment: Youth Unrest In India
the-ferment-youth-unrest-in-india.description: Vidhyarthikalude mudravaakyangalaal mukharitham aayirunnu rajyam kazhinja dashaabdathil. Ella aneethikalodum ashanthi prakadippich alari prathikaricha Indian Yuvathayude nerchithram varachidukayanu The Fermant: Youth Unrest In India enna pusthakathilude madhyama pravarthakayaya Nikhila Henry. Rohit Vemulayude aathma hathyayode pottithericha vidhyarthikal bharanakoodathinte ella adichamarthalukalkkethireyum aneethikalkkethireyum nilakondu.

abki-baar-kiski-sarkar-naxal-edition-1.title: Abki Baar, Kiski Sarkar? Naxal Edition
abki-baar-kiski-sarkar-naxal-edition-1.description: Bharat ke kuch rajya Naxal prabhavit ilaakon ke roop mein jaane jaate hain. Is mein Chhattisgarh aur Jharkhand aaj bhi iski maar jhel rahe hain. Orissa aur Bihar pehle ke muqable ab kafi had tak is samasya se ubar gaye hain. Par vichardhara mein badlav abhi bhi baki hai. CPI-ML isi vichardhara se bani party hai jo aaj bhi in rajyon ke chunav mein active rehti hai. Abki baar, Kiski Sarkar ke Naxal Edition mein hum janenge aise hi rajyon ka haal...

the-papin-sisters.title: Sex aur Sisters
the-papin-sisters.description: Ek dusre ke pyar ke junoon mein pagal do behnein, jihonein ne kar di apne malkin ki beti ki berahmi se hatya. kya sambandh tha in behnon ka us ladki se? kyun kiya unhonein itna ghinauna katl? kya hai inki poori kahani janane ke liye suniye pura show KUKU FM par.

communicate-to-influence-5.title: Inform nahi, Influence Kare
communicate-to-influence-5.description: Hum sochte hai ki hum joh keh rahe hai woh log samjh rahe hai. Hume aise lagta hai ki hum public speaking mein bohot hi accha kar rahe hai aur humare colleagues humaari baaton ko asaani se absorb kar rahe hai. Par asal mein aisa nahi hai. Decker ki di hui kuch trademark methods se aap ek communication roadmap bana sakte hai jisse ki aap inform karne ke badle logon ko influence aur inspire karne lagoge

dahan.title: Dahan
dahan.description: Raja Bali ke samne jab bhagwan Vaman avtar leke aaye the, us waqt kuch aisa hua, jisne tapasya mein leen Prahlad ke netr khol diye. Kyunki, Bhakt Prahlad ka sidha naata Bhagwan Vishnu ke Vaman avtar se hai. Kaise? Ise janne ke liye suniye ye audio show.

sathiya-sodhanai.title: Rajakesari
sathiya-sodhanai.description: பதினொன்றாம் நூற்றாண்டு. சோழர் தலைநகரான தஞ்சாபுரியில் மாமன்னர் இராஜராஜ சோழர் பெரிய திருக்கற்றளி எனும் பெயரில் ஒரு பிரம்மாண்டமான கோயில் எழுப்பும் முயற்சியில் ஈடுபட்டிருக்கிறார். அதே சமயம், சேரநாட்டின் இருள் சூழ்ந்த காடுகளில் சில பழைய எதிரிகள் அவருக்கெதிராக ஒரு பயங்கர சதித்திட்டத்தை நிறைவேற்றும் முனைப்பில் உள்ளனர். குறிக்கோளை நிறைவேற்ற எதையும் செய்ய ஆயத்தமாகி நிற்கும் அந்த பயங்கர சதிகாரர்க ளுக்கும் சோழப் பேரரசருக்குமிடையே காலம் எப்படி அம்பலவாணர் எனும் முதிர்ந்த முன்னாள் சோழப் படைவீரரை முன்னிறுத்துகிறது என்பதே இராஜகேசரியின் மையச் சரடு. ஏராளமான கல்வெட்டுகள் மற்றும் களஆய்வுத் தகவல்களின் பின்னணியில் அந்தக்காலச் சோழத் தலைநகரையும் அதன் மக்களையும் பண்பாட்டையும் துல்லியமாகச் சித்தரிக்கும் மகத்தான வரலாற்றுப் புனைவு.

gond-dynasty.title: Gond Dynasty
gond-dynasty.description: RRR film main aapne Bhim ke character ko khoob pyar diya, bheem ek khaas community se aata hai jo Gond kehlate hain, desh ke baaki tribes ke terha he gond iss dharati ke mool nivasi to hain he sath he saath wo courage ke bhi representatives hain, unka lena dena sirf junglon tak nahi hai, gond to ek samay mei takatwar aur samriddh samrajya hua karta tha jisme bade bade fighters nikale aur mughals ko kaye baar yuddh main haraya , seedhi saadhe dikhne wali yeh janjati asal main ek yuddh nipurna, takatwar aur deshpremi dynasty ke successors hain , inhe kudart ke saath taal mel bitha kar rehna bakhoobi aata hai,aur women empowerment jaise cheezein jo west par jabardasti thopi gye, iss samrajya main swatha he hain. Aaiye jaante hain iss audiobook main gond dynasty ka gauravshali itihas sirf KUKU FM par

do-over-7.title: Life Mein Balance Kaise Layein
do-over-7.description: Hum sab apni life mein kabhi kabhi “Jab bhi met” movie ke first half ke vo ‘Aditya’ ban jate hain jiski life mein kuch bhi sahi nahi hai aur bas hum apni life ko, apne aap ko ek burden samajhne lag jaate hain. Lekin yeh Original series aapki life ki 'Geet' ban kar aapko seekhayegi ki kaise life ko restart karna hai, aur khudko khud ka favourite kaise banana hai. Doston ek bar jab aap ye sab seekh gaye toh phir success jhak maar ke aapke peeche aayegi. Toh der kis baat ki chalte hain is safar par.

the-ultimate-sales-machine-2.title: Kivabe Sales Machine Hoye Uthben ?
the-ultimate-sales-machine-2.description: Aapni Byabsa Korun Ba Chakri Korun, Uvoy Jaygatei Kono Na Konovabe Salesta Important. Seta Directly Hok Ba Indirectly, Aamra Ersonge Jure Thaki. Sales E Sofolotar Basic Sutro Ki? Kivabe Sales Technique Improve Kora Jay? Ki Ki Pontha Follow Kora Uchit? Eirokom Kichu Gurutwapurno Kotha Jante Sune Nin Ei Audiobook .

readymade-mogudu.title: రెడీమేడ్ మొగుడు
readymade-mogudu.description: భార్యకు ఏమో బోలెడు ఆశలు, అది తీర్చడానికి అవుతాయి కదా పాపం భర్తకు కాసులు..  'రాంపండు'కి  భార్య మీద తప్ప ఏవేవో ధ్యాసలు.. ఇంటికి వచ్చాక తన భార్య 'రాజీ' కోపం తో ఊగిపోతూ గట్టిగా తీసుకుంటూ ఉంటుంది శ్వాసలు.. ఇక నేను అల్లలేను ఈ వింత దంపతుల పైన ప్రాసలు.. మీరే విని తెలుసుకోండి వీళ్ళు చేసే చేష్టలు!

defining-you-1.title: డిఫైనింగ్ యు!
defining-you-1.description: మనం చేసే పనిలో మన ప్రవర్తన ప్రధానమైనది. ప్రపంచంలోని అత్యంత విజయవంతమైన వ్యక్తులలో కొంతమందికి వారి ప్రవర్తనను అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి మరియు వారి పనితీరును మెరుగుపరచడానికి సహాయం చేసిన ఫియోనా మర్డెన్ మీ బలాన్ని కనుగొనడంలో, జీవితంలో  రాణించడానికి ఎలాంటి పరిసరాలు, సందర్భాలు  సహాయపడతాయో తెలుసుకోవడానికి తన  ప్రైవేట్‌గా & ప్రొఫెషనల్ ప్రొఫైలింగ్ అసెస్‌మెంట్ ప్రాసెస్ ద్వారా ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ లో  మీకు మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తుంది.

creative-confidence-unleashing-the-creat.title: Confidence Booster For Creative People
creative-confidence-unleashing-the-creat.description: Kuch log hote hain hai jo khud ko bohot busy dikhate hai aur smart samjhte hai. Aur kuch log lazy hote hai,unhe yaad dilana padhta hai. Par kai baar wo lazy insaan us Smart aur Intelligent insaan se hume acha aur behtar result deta hai. "Being busy and being Intelligent doesn't mean being productive or Creative". Hume lagta hai ki ek insaan bachpan se he Creative hota hai par aisa bilkul bhi nahi hai iisliye is Audio Show mein humne un sare points ka zikar kiya hai jo aapko Creative banane me help karegi aur aapka Confidence bhi boost karegi.

gloria.title: Gloria
gloria.description: ഫോർട്ട് കൊച്ചിയുടെ ഹൃദയഭാഗത്ത്,  ഏവർക്കും പ്രിയങ്കരി ആയിരുന്ന  ഗ്ലോറിയ എന്ന  ആംഗ്ലോ-ഇന്ത്യൻ  സ്തീയുടെ ജീവിതം തൻ്റെ  ഇരുപതാം വിവാഹ വാർഷിക ദിനത്തിൽ കീഴ്മേൽ മറിയുകയായിരുന്നു. അന്നാണു പോലീസ് ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥൻ ആയിരുന്ന തൻ്റെ ഭർത്താവിനെ ദുരൂഹ സാഹചര്യത്തിൽ മരണപ്പെട്ട നിലയിൽ  കണ്ടെത്തുന്നത്. അതൊരു കൊലപാതകമെന്ന് പറയാവുന്ന യാതൊരു തെളിവും അവശേഷിച്ചിരുന്നില്ല എങ്കിലും  മരണരഹസ്യത്തിലേക്ക് വഴിനടത്തുന്ന ഏക തെളിവായി ഒരു കോപ്പ എല്ലിൻ സൂപ്പ് അവശേഷിച്ചിരുന്നു.....

heroine.title: Lady Superstar
heroine.description: മലയാള സിനിമയിലെ അറിയപ്പെടുന്ന നായികയാകണം എന്ന  സ്വപ്നവുമായാണു മീനാക്ഷി ഫിലിം പ്രൊഡ്യൂസറുടെ ഫ്ലാറ്റിലേക്ക് കയറി ചെന്നത്. എന്നാൽ അയാളുടെ ആഗ്രഹങ്ങൾ സാധിക്കാൻ  ചില അഡ്ജസ്റ്റ്‌മെൻറ്റുകൾക്ക് താൻ  തയ്യാറാകണം എന്ന സത്യം അവൾ മനസിലാക്കുന്നു. പിന്നീട്  മലയാളത്തിലെ മെഗാസ്റ്റാറിനെ പോലും മയക്കിയ അവളുടെ വശ്യതക്കു പിന്നിൽ മറ്റാർക്കും അറിയാത്ത ഒരു രഹസ്യം ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു. ലൈംഗികചൂഷണവും പണവും പ്രശസ്തിയും പ്രണയവും വഞ്ചനയുമെല്ലാം നിറഞ്ഞ മീനാക്ഷിയുടെ  ജീവിതം മലയാളം ഫിലിം ഇൻഡസ്ട്രിയിലെ പലരുടെയും അനുഭവങ്ങൾക്കും സമാനമാണു.

ये-पगली-पगली-क्या-है--लेखक--शैलेश-सिंह-श.title: Ye Pagli Pagli Kya hai
ये-पगली-पगली-क्या-है--लेखक--शैलेश-सिंह-श.description: रमा, सीमा, शिवानी और सोनिया चारों सहेली हैं और सामान्‍य जीवन जी रही थी। रमा का बलात्‍कार होता है जिसमें उसका प्रेमी नीरज भी शामिल होता है। अब चारों लड़कियां खुद इसका बदला लेने की सोचती हैं, क्‍योंकि उन्‍हें कानून पर भरोसा नहीं है। इस काम में उनका साथ देता है शिवानी का प्रेमी आलोक। समाज और उसके रवैये से त्रस्‍त लड़कियों का मसीहा बनती हैं रमा, सीना,‍ शिवानी और सोनिया।

laws-to-achieve-power.title: Laws To Achieve power
laws-to-achieve-power.description: Life la nenachadha achieve pannanum nu nenaippom, aana adhukkana route enna nu theriyama irukkalam. indha book namakkulla irukka oru supreme energy/power moolama eppadi successful aaguradhu nu indha audio book moolama therijikonga.

billionaire-groom-is-my-new-husband-5.title: Billionaire Groom is My New Husband
billionaire-groom-is-my-new-husband-5.description: Abandoned at the altar by Patrick, Cheryl’s world shatters until she marries Neil—a billionaire posing as a cleaning boy to escape his own wedding. But their union ignites a war. Neil’s mother, Sandra, is out for blood, while his vengeful fiancée Sonia and a greedy Patrick plot their downfall. As Sandra unleashes chaos, will Cheryl discover Neil’s billion-dollar secret, or will the weight of his lies destroy her first? A high-stakes tale of love, power, and betrayal.

why-the-middle-class-is-still-middle-cla.title: Why the middle class is still middle class?
why-the-middle-class-is-still-middle-cla.description: வருமானம் உயர்ந்தாலும், பல நடுத்தர வர்க்க குடும்பங்கள் இன்னும் அதே பொருளாதார சுழற்சியிலேயே சிக்கியிருக்கின்றன. இந்த நிகழ்ச்சி, அவர்களின் செலவுகள், கனவுகள், பழக்கவழக்கங்கள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கை முறைகளை ஆராய்கிறது. நிஜ வாழ்க்கை உதாரணங்கள் மூலம், செல்வம் உருவாக்குவது ஏன் பலருக்கும் எட்டாக்கனியாக இருக்கிறது என்பதை வெளிக்கொணர்கிறது.

mahathma-gandhi-1.title: Mahathma Gandhi
mahathma-gandhi-1.description: Bharatha desham ante Gandhi, Gandhi ante Bharatha Desham. Ahimasa margaana deshaniki swathanthryam thechina mahaneeyudu. Bharathadesham prajalalo swathanthra kaankhsanu penchina mahanu bhaavudu, jathipitha mana bapu. Endaro swathanthra udyamakarulaku aadarshamgaa nilichina mana jathi pitha gurinchi marikontha thelusukune prayathnam cheddham.

ravi-paar.title: Ravi Paar
ravi-paar.description: Dive into the beautiful world of Lyric Poetry with Kuku FM. Our collection brings you poems that touch the heart and spark the imagination. These stories in verse are perfect for anyone who loves the rhythm of words and the pictures they paint. Listen now Kuku FM and let poetry fill your world with emotion and beauty.

ബാല്യകാലസ്മരണകൾ-.title: ബാല്യകാലസ്മരണകൾ
ബാല്യകാലസ്മരണകൾ-.description: മാധവിക്കുട്ടിയുടെ മാസ്മരിക തൂലികയിൽ വിരിഞ്ഞ 'ബാല്യകാല സ്മരണകൾ 'സ്നേഹത്തിലും നൈർമല്യത്തിലും പൊതിഞ്ഞ ബാല്യകാലാനുഭവങ്ങളിലേയ്ക്ക് നമ്മെ കൂട്ടിക്കൊണ്ടു പോവുന്നു.

devasur-gatha-100-pauranik-kathayein.title: Devasur Gatha : 100 Pauranik Kathayein
devasur-gatha-100-pauranik-kathayein.description: Bhartiye Puranon mein chhupi devta, rakshas aur veeron ki kahaniyan, pyaar, yuddh aur srishti ke rahsayon ko ujagar karti hain..Aap bhi suniye aur ban jaiye inka hisaa..

saahithya-sakhi-shailaje.title: Saahithya Sakhi Shailaje
saahithya-sakhi-shailaje.description: ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಲೋಕದ ಅನರ್ಘ್ಯ ರತ್ನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ‘ಶೈಲಜಾ ಸುರೇಶ್’ ಕೂಡ ಒಬ್ಬರು. ಇಂದಿರಾ, ಹೃದಯರಾಗ, ಹೊಂಗನಸು, ಊರ್ಮಿಳಾ, ಮಾಮರವೆಲ್ಲೋ ಕೋಗಿಲೆಯೆಲ್ಲೋ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಅತ್ಯದ್ಭುತ ಕೃತಿಗಳನ್ನ ಬರೆದ ಶೈಲಜಾ ಅವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇತರರು ಬರೆದ ಅಭಿನಂದನಾ ಲೇಖನಗಳ ಗುಚ್ಛವೇ ಈ ‘ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಸಖಿ ಶೈಲಜೆ’ ಕೃತಿ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ..

india-pak-wars.title: India- Pak wars
india-pak-wars.description: భారతదేశం మరియు పాకిస్తాన్ అంటే క్రికెట్, ఉగ్రవాదం, సరిహద్దు ఇవే గుర్తొస్తాయి మనకు. అసలు ఇండియా , పాకిస్తాన్ యుద్ధాలు ఎప్పుడు , ఎలా స్టార్ట్ అయ్యాయో ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ లో తెలుసుకుందాం.

ishq-after-marriage.title: Ishq after Marriage
ishq-after-marriage.description:
हस्बैंड  वाइफ  के रिश्ते में इंटिमेट होना कितना ज़रूरी है।  क्या अंतरंगता  रिश्ते के लिए प्यार से ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है 
Voiceover Artist : Rashmi Sharma

ಬಾಡಿಗೆ-ತಾಯಿ--ನಿಮಗೆಷ್ಟು-ಗೊತ್ತು.title: Badige Thayi : Nimageshtu gotthu?
ಬಾಡಿಗೆ-ತಾಯಿ--ನಿಮಗೆಷ್ಟು-ಗೊತ್ತು.description: ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಜೆತನದ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯಿಂದ ಹಲವರು ಬಳಲ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಮಕ್ಕಳಾಗಿಲ್ಲ ಅಂತಾ ಕೊರಗೋ ಅನೇಕರಿಗೆ 'ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ತಾಯಿ' ದೊಡ್ಡ ವರದಾನ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ‌ ಏನಿದು ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ತಾಯಿ? ಆಕೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳಾಗದ ದಂಪತಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡ್ತಾಳೆ? ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ತಾಯಿಯ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಹೇಗೆ? ಅಕೆಯ ಸೇವೆಗೆ ದಂಪತಿಗಳು ಎಷ್ಟು ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೊಡ್ತಾರೆ? ಹೀಗೆ ನಿಮ್ನಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಅನೇಕ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಉತ್ತರ. ಕೇಳಿ 'ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ತಾಯಿ: ನಿಮಗೆಷ್ಟು ಗೊತ್ತು?' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್!

isro-mission-chandrayaan.title: ISRO : Mission Chandrayaan
isro-mission-chandrayaan.description: Prithibir Prothom Desh Hisebe Chander Dokkhin Merute Pa Rekheche Bharot, Ja Bharot Basider Kache Ek Gorber Bishoy. Kintu Ei Safolyer Pichone Thaka ISRO Sokol Byarthota Pichhone Fele Kivabe Tader Ei Mission Sofol Korlo Ebog Kivabe Shuru Hoyechio Tader Poth Chola? Tantan Uttejonay Vorpur Sei Bishoye Jante Kan Rakhte Hobe KUKU FM-Er Ei Bisesh Audio Show-Te.

9eaa3711-1510-4b5a-9a0f-78bc6036d5eb.title: Malar
9eaa3711-1510-4b5a-9a0f-78bc6036d5eb.description: திருமணத்துக்குப் பிறகு கணவன் வீட்டில் புதிய வாழ்க்கையைத் தொடங்க நினைக்கும் மலர், அவமானங்களையும் தந்தை விட்டுச் சென்ற நிலத்தைப் பறிக்க நினைக்கும் சதியையும் எதிர்கொள்கிறாள். தன் உரிமையை விட்டுக்கொடுக்க மறுக்கும் அவள், கதிரின் துணையுடனும் ஊர் மக்களின் ஆதரவுடனும் போராடி, குடும்ப நிலத்தையும் தன் மரியாதையையும் மீட்டெடுக்கிறாள்.

kalo-chitar-photograph.title: Kalo Chitar Photograph
kalo-chitar-photograph.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. immigration-in-america.title: American Dream or Nightmare? Immigration
immigration-in-america.description: People come to America every day to fulfill the ““American dream.” From all walks of life, they come to America searching for a better life, looking for protection, and leading a free life. But does America give them what they seek? America is not just capable of but also needs to receive more immigrants. Latest statistics show that between 2010 and 2020, population growth was the second lowest in US history. A broad decline in immigration has already led to labor shortage. In its report to Congress in 2022, the Federal Reserve noted that reduced immigration had constrained the labor supply. There are some indicators showing that most factors affecting US decision-making do not support the idea that immigration is a problem. For example, public opinion on the issue of immigration is not straightforward, to say the least. While views on immigration policy are increasingly polarized, two third of Americans, still see immigration as a benefit to their country. The mounting desire to reduce immigration is driven, however, by those who vote Republican. Listen to this insightful documentary on the history and politics of immigration.

poisonous-love.title: Poisonous Love
poisonous-love.description: The show is set inside a palace court where power is enforced through suspicion, poison, and public humiliation. Neeloufer, Soraya, Surayya, and other women are repeatedly pulled into conflicts that are less about truth than about who can control the story. Early on, the Sultan publicly honors Neeloufer for saving his sons Farhad and Jamsheed, but that praise sits beside a court atmosphere already poisoned by secrets. A poisoned drink becomes a major source of suspicion, and one woman’s revelation that she has taken poison for years to keep another alive reframes suffering as hidden loyalty rather than guilt. Farhad emerges as a cold, controlling figure whose attention shifts between accusation and fixation, especially when women resist him or threaten the court’s order. Niloufer also uses status and custom to gain leverage, drawing attention in court while lower-ranked women like Kaneez are dragged into the conflict and silenced. The healer Soria continues preparing medicine even while poisoned herself, and her silence is enforced by threats. In the middle of the story, accusations harden into public scandal when Surayya is condemned over pregnancy, dishonor, adultery, and a hidden child. Farhad and other authorities press for confession, while the court turns private pain into spectacle and punishment. The accused women are forced into degrading ordeals, including confinement, interrogation, and demands to prove innocence through dangerous acts. Niloufer escalates the pressure by claiming the child belongs to a servant, widening the humiliation and deepening the class divide. Surayya’s past with Jamshed is gradually exposed through pleas about lost love and a stolen child, but the court responds with harsher punishment rather than mercy. She is blinded and still refuses to submit, showing that defiance survives even under brutal control. A mysterious man’s sudden appearance during the execution chaos adds confusion and suspicion, but it does not immediately break the court’s grip. The final stretch shifts toward escape and revelation when Suraiya is poisoned, rescued by Sultan Kamar, and offered dignity and revenge. At the same time, Farhad’s survival depends on a medicine tied to the long poison plot, making the hidden truth impossible to ignore. The ending revelation is devastating: Soraya had secretly sustained both men by drinking poison and using her own blood as medicine. By the end, the palace order still stands, but it is exposed as a system built on coercion, buried sacrifice, and the constant threat of punishment.

दिल-से-दिल-तक---लेखिका---जसलीन-कौर.description: Shivam Ma ka ladla aur gussail Mijaj ka hai. Kahani mein entry hoti hai Ananya ki, jo seedhi saral aur samajhdaar ladki hai. Ananya ki sautli ma aur behan hai, jo use pareshan karti hai. Shivam aur Ananya ki mulakaat hoti hai, lekin behan Riya ko pasand nahi aata, kyunki vah Shivam ko pasand karti hai man hi man. To ab Kahani mein kya hoga? Shivam ke gussail Mijaz ko Ananya jhel payegi? Inki love hemistry  mai kya twist aayega? Janne ke liye sune puri kahani. Dil Se Dil Tak is a love story of Shivam, a mumma’s boy and an angry young man. And, The writer, Jasleen Kaur beautifully expresses the grief behind Shivam’s anger and the pain behind Ananya’s life. The story starts with the entry Ananya, who is a simple and intelligent girl in the life of Shivam. Ananya has a stepmother and sister, who harass her. Shivam and Ananya both have mutual feelings for each other but Ananya’s sister Riya does not like this because she likes Shivam in mind. So what will happen in the story now? Will Riya act like a villain? Will Ananya tolerate the temperament of Shivam? What will be the twist in their love chemistry? Listen to the full story to know about this. You can listen to this love story- Dil Se Dil Tak in Hindi either on our website or app. You can even download the audio for free. दिल से दिल तक शिवम की एक प्रेम कहानी है जो गुस्सैल युवक है। और, लेखिका जसलीन कौर ने शिवम के गुस्से और अनन्या के जीवन के पीछे के दर्द को बहुत खूबसूरती से व्यक्त किया है। कहानी प्रवेश अनन्या से शुरू होती है, जो शिवम के जीवन में एक सरल और बुद्धिमान लड़की है। अनन्या की एक सौतेली माँ और बहन है जो उसे परेशान करती है। शिवम और अनन्या दोनों एक दूसरे के लिए आपसी भावनाएँ रखते हैं लेकिन अनन्या की बहन रिया को यह पसंद नहीं है क्योंकि वह शिवम को पसंद करती है। तो अब कहानी में क्या होगा? क्या रिया खलनायक की तरह काम करेंगी? क्या अनन्या शिवम के स्वभाव को बर्दाश्त करेगी? उनकी लव केमिस्ट्री में क्या ट्विस्ट होगा? इस बारे में जानने के लिए पूरी कहानी सुनें। आप इस प्रेम कहानी- दिल से दिल तक को हिंदी में हमारी वेबसाइट या ऐप पर सुन सकते हैं। तुम भी मुफ्त में ऑडियो डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।

kuber-mantras-wealth-energy-ka-secret.title: Kuber Mantras: Wealth Energy Ka Secret
kuber-mantras-wealth-energy-ka-secret.description: Why do some people earn money but struggle to keep it, while others steadily build wealth? Is the difference income—or mindset? Kuber Mantras explores the beliefs, self-worth, financial habits, fear, discipline, environment, time and identity that shape our relationship with money. Through a modern interpretation of Kuber symbolism, the series asks a powerful question: before learning how to make more money, have we learned how to receive, retain and handle wealth?

chatrapathi-shivaji.description: అతను మాతృభూమిని రక్షించడానికి జీవించాడు, మరణించాడు. అతను కేవలం ఒక రాజు కాదు, ఒక సంస్కృతిని, ఒక వీరత్వాన్ని, ఒక ధర్మాన్ని ప్రేరేపించిన యుగ పురుషుడు! ప్రతి భారతీయుడు గర్వంగా పలకాల్సిన ఒకే ఒక్క పేరు – "ఛత్రపతి శివాజీ మహారాజ్!" 🚩🔥

weight-loss-with-ayurveda.title: Weight Loss: The Ayurvedic Way
weight-loss-with-ayurveda.description: Ayurveda is a comprehensive medical approach to body healing; it is not simply about diet. The Ayurvedic diet is based on body type and addresses all aspects of physical and mental health, including weight loss, mental clarity, and emotional stability. Whether you're dieting or not, following rules like savoring meals, eating when you're hungry, and being careful while mixing foods is wise advice. Additionally, Ayurveda goes a step further. We can greatly enhance our health by including flavors in our diets. This exclusive show offers a priceless holistic weight-loss strategy based on a traditional Indian system. Let your diet become a lifestyle rather than a moment in your life with this wholesome show.

golddigger-pellam.title: Golddigger pellam
golddigger-pellam.description: ప్రతిభావంతురాలైన విద్యార్థిని స్వేత తన కష్టంతో ప్రతిష్ఠాత్మకమైన సైన్స్ అవార్డును గెలుచుకుంటుంది. ఈ అవార్డు కోసం ఓ కోటీశ్వరుడి కొడుకును ఓడించడంతో, ఆ కుటుంబం కోపంతో స్వేతపై చీటింగ్ చేసిందంటూ నిందలు వేసి అవార్డును లాక్కోవాలని చూస్తుంది. కానీ స్వేత వెనక్కి తగ్గకపోవడంతో, ఈ వివాదం వెనుక దాగి ఉన్న అక్రమాలు, రహస్య సంబంధాలు, కుటుంబ మోసాలు ఒక్కొక్కటిగా బయటపడతాయి. చివరకు ఆ కుటుంబం దాచిన అసలు నిజం అందరి ముందూ బయటపడుతుంది.

yukthahaar.description: Mumbai lo pramukha jeevanan shaili salahadaruralu munmun ganeriwal rasina ee book lo mee health ni improve and reset chesukodaniki 10 weeks programe gurinchi explain chestundi. Inka Tapsi pannu, rakul, nayanatara vanti chalaamandi celebreties ki   gut microbiome analysis tho indian natural food and yoga dwara obesity ni tagginchadaniki, fitness ni kapadukodaniki munmun training istundi. Aa vishayalanni ee audio book lo vivarinchabaddayi.

trishanku-rashtra-by-deepak-kumar.description: Kya Aazadi ke baad is Desh ki Dasha badli? Agar ye Sawal main aapse puchun to aapka kya jawaab hoga? han kehne se pehle aap ek baar sochenge zarur. phoolan-devi.description: Indiayile Madhya Pradeshile chambal kadukalile kollakkariyum pineedu Indian Parliament angavumayi pravarthicha vyakthiyanu Phoolan Devi. Dhaaridhrathil piranna Savarna jaathiyil petta nishkalangayum niraalambayumaya oru penkutty rajyathe virappicha kollakari aayathu engane? Kelkaam Phoolan Deviyude jeevitha kadha.

monkey-man.title: Monkey Man
monkey-man.description: Ek contractor, ek gufa aur ek rakh se zinda hua Daitya, Monkey Man sirf ek kahani nahi, achchayi aur burayi ke beech ka war hai. Jab ek chhota sa ladka apne maa-baap ka badla lene niklta hai, toh uski taqat ban jaata hai uska naam – Bajrang. Kya ek daitya guru Girish Kohli ko rok payega? Aur kya bajrang jeet paauega ye jung? Abhi sunna shuru kariye poori kahani.

chethabadi.title: Chethabadi
chethabadi.description: ఓ మూర్కుడు చేతబడితో ఒక ఊరి జీవితాన్ని కాల్చేసాడు. ముత్తైదువుగా ముస్తాబయ్యి అడవి తల్లికి పూజలు చేయడానికి వెళ్తున్న ఓ ఆడ మనిషిని అతి కిరాతకంగా అనుభవించాడు. అదే వాడి గెలుపు అనుకున్నాడు. గర్భంలో ఉన్న శిశువుని తన శక్తులకు మేతగా వేయాలి అనుకున్నాడు. అదంతా జరిగితే అడవి తల్లి ఊరుకుంటుందా? వేట మొదలు పెట్టింది. మరణాల నుండి ఓ శాసనాన్ని రాసింది. శిలలా మారిన ముత్తైదువు ఆత్మనే ఆయుధంగా మార్చుకుంది. వాడి అంతానికి నందిని అనే అమ్మాయిని ఎంచుకుంది. చీకటి కమ్ముకున్న ఆ కోటకి నందినిని పంపించింది. ఈ కథ మొత్తానికి మూల కారణం అయిన కల్పిక అనే ఓ ఆకు సైన్టిస్ట్ ల మతి పోగొట్టింది. ఇంతకీ ఈ చేతబడికి అడవి తల్లి ముగింపు పలికిందా? కొండ దేవర ఏం పలికాడు? ఎన్ని బలులు జరిగాయి? ఈ ప్రయాణంలో నందిని ప్రేమలో పడితే…?

d808d06b-2bdf-4a7e-8d20-db18bb783ad4.title: தேவை ஒரு தேவதை
d808d06b-2bdf-4a7e-8d20-db18bb783ad4.description:
பெண் எழுத்தாளர் தீர்க்காவும், அஸிஸ்டெண்ட் போலீஸ் கமிஷனர் வசந்தும் இணைந்து ஒரு கொலை சம்பந்தமாய் புலனாய்வு ஒன்றை மேற்கொள்கிறார்கள்.
முதல்கட்ட விசாரணையில் சாதாரணமாக இருப்பது போல் தெரியும் விஷயங்கள், புலனாய்வில் அடுக்கடுக்காய் திடுக்கிடும் சம்பவங்களாக மாற வரவும் இருவரும்
அதிர்கிறார்கள். ஒரு கட்டத்தில் இதுவரைக்கும் அறியப்படாத மர்மங்கள் நிறைந்த கிராமம் ஒன்று தமிழ்நாட்டில் இருப்பது தெரிய வருகிறது. அங்கு இருக்கும் மர்மம் தான் என்ன?

my-useless-husband-is-actually-a-god-4.title: O Marido Inútil é um Deus
my-useless-husband-is-actually-a-god-4.description: Durante anos, Theo foi humilhado como o marido inútil de Helena. O que ninguém sabia: ele é o lendário Último Tecelão, criador da Seda Etérea, um tecido raro que muda de cor com o calor e as batidas do coração, e o verdadeiro segredo do sucesso da Maison Helena. Quando Helena pede o divórcio, Theo se une à rival Diana para erguer um novo império da moda. Mas Helena e Marcus querem sabotá-los, e Marcus está de olho numa orquídea raríssima. Até onde Theo vai para proteger sua arte?

ஸ்ரீமான்-சுதர்சனம்--தேவன்-.description: குடும்பம், அலுவலகம் சார்ந்த உலகம் - இரண்டும் கலந்த ஒரு சராசரி ஆபீஸ் குமாஸ்தாவின் வாழ்க்கையில் நடைபெறும் சம்பவங்கள், அவனை வாழ்வின் அடுத்தக் கட்டத்துக்கு எப்படி உயர்த்துகிறது? குமாஸ்தா சுதர்சனம் எப்படி ஸ்ரீமான் சுதர்சனமாகிறான்? ஸ்ரீமான் சுதர்சனமாக அவன் படும் கஷ்டங்களும், குடும்பத்தினரிடம் மாட்டிக் கொண்டுபடும் அவஸ்தைகளும் தேவனின் நடையில் ஹாஸ்யமாகக் கேட்டு மகிழுங்கள்...

velichathin-niram-karuppu.description: A determined female police superintendent investigates a series of brutal chain-snatching murders in Chennai, while facing mounting pressure from political forces and violent threats, as she races against time to catch the killers before they strike again.

bs-what-to-say-when-you-talk-to-yourself.title: The Positive Intrapersonal Communication
bs-what-to-say-when-you-talk-to-yourself.description: Aaj 70% se jada logon ke thoughts negative hain. aur un sabhi thoughts ko apne mind se erase karna sabhi ke liye kafi jyada mushkil hai. Lekin Sirf Tabtak, jabtak aapne ye Audiobook nahi Suni hai. Ye book hame self-management ke baare mein batati hai, ki kaise hum khud se bat kar sakte hain aur apne andar ke negative thoughts ko khatm kar sakte hain. Aur aapko ye bhi pata chalega ki jaane- anjaane mein hum aisi kaunsi mistakes kar baithte hain jo humein negative thoughts se bhar deti hain. Agar aapko "How to Talk to Anyone" jaisi books pasand hain, to ye audiobook zaroor sunein. Shad Helmstetter Dwara likhi gai ye book hame  batati hai, ki kaise hum khud se bat kar sakte hain aur apne andar ke negative thoughts ko khatm kar skte hain.

trible-leadership.title: Trible Leadership
trible-leadership.description: "ಟ್ರೈಬಲ್ ಲೀಡರ್‌ಶಿಪ್"  ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮುದಾಯ ನಾಯಕತ್ವದ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.  ಸಮುದಾಯದ ಶಕ್ತಿಗೆ, ಮತ್ತು ನಾಯಕತ್ವದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಶೈಲಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಾಮುಖ್ಯತೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ. ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಗುಂಪುಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ, ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಾಗಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಉತ್ತಮ ನಾಯಕತ್ವದ ಗುಣಗಳನ್ನು ಅರಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಹಾಗೂ ತಂಡವನ್ನು ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಲು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಂತೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

thiththikkum-theeye.title: Thiththikkum theeye
thiththikkum-theeye.description: முதல்வருக்கு அடுத்த நிலையில் இருப்பவர் அமைச்சர் கருணாகரன். தேர்தல் நெருங்கும் சமயத்தில் அவரைச் சுற்றி அனைத்தும் கெட்டதாகவே நடக்கிறது. அவரது ஃபேக்டரியில் போதைப் பொருள் பிடிபடுகிறது. அவர் அனுப்ப இருந்த ஹவாலா பணம் சிக்கிக்கொள்கிறது. இந்த நிலையில், கருணாகரனின் வளர்ப்பு மகள் பற்றிய தகவல் வெளிவந்து, அவரது அரசியல் வாழ்க்கையையே காலி செய்கிறது. அந்த ரகசியம் என்ன?

love-beyond-identity.description: பில்லியனர் ஹீஸ்ட் என்பது காதல், சஸ்பென்ஸ், ஆக்ஷன் மற்றும் உணர்ச்சிகள் கலந்த திரில்லர். உலகப் புகழ்பெற்ற கோடீஸ்வரரான தரம் குரானாவின் வாழ்க்கை, விமான நிலையத்தில் நடந்த ஒரு சிறிய லக்கேஜ் மாற்றத்தால் ஒரே இரவில் சிதறி விழுகிறது. காதலியின் உயிரைக் காப்பாற்ற கூட தனது அடையாளத்தை நிரூபிக்க முடியாத நிலைக்குத் தள்ளப்படும் அவர், இழந்த வாழ்க்கையையும் உண்மையையும் மீட்டெடுக்க நடத்தும் போராட்டமே இந்தக் கதையின் மையம்.

vedas-ke-hidden-success-principles.description: AI tumhari job le sakti hai? Phone tumhe control kar raha hai? Salary aate hi khatam ho jaati hai? Sharma ji ka beta tumse aage nikal gaya? Ya tum bas plans banate ho, kaam nahi? Aaj ki in problems ke answers shayad naye nahi hain. none-the-wiser.title: None The Wiser
none-the-wiser.description: What if some secrets were never meant to stay buried? When a parish priest is found brutally murdered, the quiet rural community of the Vale of the White Horse is left reeling in shock and fear. Newly assigned to the area, Detective Sergeant Mark Turpin quickly realizes that the killing bears the unmistakable mark of a ruthless killer—someone who shows no remorse and leaves no trace behind. But when a second priest is discovered, his body subjected to similar ritualistic abuse, it becomes chillingly clear that a serial killer with a deeply personal vendetta is on the loose. As fear grips the once-tranquil countryside, Mark and his team are thrust into a race against time to untangle a web of dark secrets and lies before the killer strikes again. In his relentless pursuit of justice, Mark will soon learn that the truth is far more twisted than he could have ever imagined!

the-art-of-worldly-wisdom.title: The Art of Worldly Wisdom
the-art-of-worldly-wisdom.description: Discover how to live wisely and advance socially with Baltasar Gracián's "The Art of Worldly Wisdom," a compilation of 300 essential maxims for personal and professional growth. 🌐💼📘

gunaah-ka-humsafar.title: Gunaah Ka Humsafar
gunaah-ka-humsafar.description: कायरा, एक अमीर ज़मींदार ठाकुर विक्रम सिंह की बेटी, अचानक वीर नाम के रहस्यमयी आदमी द्वारा किडनैप कर ली जाती है। वीर दावा करता है कि कायरा के पिता ने उसके परिवार और गाँव को बर्बाद किया था, और वह बदला लेने लौटा है। हवेली में कैद रहने के दौरान कायरा वीर के दर्द, उसके अतीत और उसके भीतर छिपी इंसानियत को समझने लगती है। नफरत और दुश्मनी के बीच दोनों के दिल करीब आने लगते हैं, लेकिन अज्ञात दुश्मन, जानलेवा हमले और पुराने राज़ उनकी ज़िंदगी को और उलझा देते हैं।

web-30-1.title: Web 3.0
web-30-1.description: Web 3.0, or the next-gen internet, largely relies on blockchain technology, cryptocurrencies, and most importantly, the philosophy of decentralization. It promises a new era where users have more control over how their data is collected, stored, and distributed. But what is it about? How does it work? People are still confused about it quite a bit. Can Web 3.0 make Internet browsing safer, better, or more secure? Or is it a gateway to a world ruled by artificial intelligence? Let's find out through this show.

maya-6.title: Maya
maya-6.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Our shows celebrate love in all its forms from the first flutter of attraction to the deep bonds that withstand the test of time. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

7-दिन-में-POWER-BI-मास्टर-बनो-और-FREELAN.title: 7 दिन में POWER BI मास्टर बनो और FREELANCING से LAKHS कमाओ
7-दिन-में-POWER-BI-मास्टर-बनो-और-FREELAN.description: 7 दिन में POWER BI मास्टर बनो और FREELANCING से LAKHS कमाओ
