private-job-pane-ke-10-tarike.description: Kya aap bhi sochte hain ki private job mein success paana mushkil hai? Iss Audio Show mein, hum decode karenge myths aur share karenge practical advice jo aapko milegi successful professionals se. Suniye aur jaaniye ki kaise emotional intelligence aur right mindset aapki success aur job pane ki keys hain.

jadoo-bazaar-files-folktales-from-every-.title: Jadoo Bazaar Files: Folktales From Every State
jadoo-bazaar-files-folktales-from-every-.description: జాదూ బజార్ ఫైల్‌లు – ప్రతి రాష్ట్రపు జానపద కధలు" అనేది భారతదేశంలోని ప్రతి రాష్ట్రం నుంచి ఆడిన మరియు త్రవ్విన జానపద కధల శ్రేణి. ఈ షో మన సాంప్రదాయాల, పురాణాల, ఆధ్యాత్మికత మరియు జానపద కధలతో కూడుకున్న ఆచారాలు మరియు కథనాలను ప్రతిబింబిస్తుంది. ప్రతి ఎపిసోడ్ ఒక అద్భుతమైన కథను చెప్పుతూ, ఆ రాష్ట్రంలోని సంస్కృతి, జానపద శైలీ, మరియు పాఠాలు ఉంచుతుంది.

arranged-pyar.title: Arranged Pyar
arranged-pyar.description: Piya runs away from her wedding to escape a forced marriage, only to have her heart shattered by the man she loves. Fate then pushes her into an unexpected six-month contract marriage with billionaire Kabir Raichand. As they fake the perfect love story, family conspiracies, jealous rivals, and dangerous secrets threaten to expose their biggest lie. But when fake love turns real, will they lose everything—or find forever?

neela-theevandiyile-kolapathakam.title: നീലത്തീവണ്ടിയിലെ കൊലപാതകം
neela-theevandiyile-kolapathakam.description: ലണ്ടനിൽ നിന്നും യാത്രപുറപ്പെട്ട നീലത്തീവണ്ടിയിൽ ഒരു യുവതി അതിദാരുണമായി കൊല്ലപ്പെടുന്നു. പ്രായാസമേറിയ ഈ കേസ് തെളിയിക്കാൻ എത്തുകയാണ് വിഖ്യാതനായ ഡിറ്റക്റ്റീവ്  ഹെർക്യൂൾ പൊയ്‌റോട്ട്!

quran-enna-solgirathu.title: Quran Enna Solgirathu
quran-enna-solgirathu.description: Manitha samugathin vidai theriyatha pala kelvigaluku quran la vidai irukku nu quran na padichavanga solraanga ! Iraivanidam irunthu Muhammad Nabigal vazhiyaa velipatta Islamiya maarkathin punitha noolaana quran la irukkura karuthukkalai elimaiyaa ellorukkum puriyura maathiri eduthu solluthu “Quran Enna Solgiradhu” audiobook. Vaanga kekkalam.

kanpur-ke-khooni-kisse.title: Kanpur Ke Khooni Kisse
kanpur-ke-khooni-kisse.description: Kanpur ki andheri galiyon mein teen chhote chor ek chhota sa kaam karne nikle the, lekin unke haath laga ek laash bhara hua bag. Inspector Raghav Tiwari jaise hi case ki tehqiqat shuru karta hai, usse ek aisi chitthi milti hai jo sirf khooni ka paighaam nahi, balki uski apni beti ke khilaf dhamki hai. Laash par chhode gaye ghaav aur message saaf kar dete hain ki yeh ek sadhaaran qatl nahi, kisi purani dushmani ki warning hai. Kya Raghav waqt par apni beti ko bacha paayega? Ya yeh khooni khel ab uske ghar tak pahunch chuka hai?

winston-churchill.title: Winston Churchill
winston-churchill.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

how-to-make-your-baby-sleep.title: How To Make Your Baby Sleep
how-to-make-your-baby-sleep.description: Bache ho ya bade, ek acchi neend sabke liye zaruri hai, Khaas kar newborn babies ke liye. Lekin bahut baar bachon ko neend aane mein pareshani hoti hai ya der raat tak unhe neend nahi aati ya to wo subah jaldi uth jaate hain jisse hum bhi pareshan ho jaate hain. Par aap chinta mat kijiye, agar aap janna chahte hain ki baby ki neend ka khayal kaise rakha jaaye ? To Suniye yeh audiobook jisme hum kuch tips ke baare mein jaan ne ki koshish karenge jo aapko ek accha parent banne mein helpful rahegi

acres-of-diamons.title: Acres Of Diamonds
acres-of-diamons.description: The well-known American Baptist clergyman, orator, philanthropist, lawyer, and author Russell Conwell explains how prosperity is a spiritual idea and the outcome of one's spiritual beliefs in the current book, Acres of Diamonds. This book demonstrates where to look in order to find a fortune. Conwell created opportunities for countless millions of people because he believed that "all good things are achievable." Acres of Diamonds reflects his fundamental conviction that every one of us is here on Earth primarily to be of service to others. This simple-to-read book contains some profound ideas. It is a motivational speech on achieving success in life focusing on the importance of doing good.

reasons-to-stay-alive-5.title: Reasons To Stay Alive
reasons-to-stay-alive-5.description: Thante jeevithathil undaaya asadhaaranamaaya oru prathisanthiye engane tharanam cheythuvennanu Matt Haig thante 'Reasons to Stay Alive' enna pusthakathil parayunnathu. Ee bhoomiyil jeevichirikkunna atrayum kaalam engane manassu niranju jeevikkamennu ee pusthakam namukku kanichu tharunnu.

ayurvedic-tips-for-gut-health.title: Ayurvedic Tips for Gut Health
ayurvedic-tips-for-gut-health.description: ✨ Arogyamaana Kudal (Gut) thaan Arogyamaana Udalin Ragasiyam. Dr. Dimple Jangda 🌱 5000 varusha pazhamaiyaana Ayurveda Vazhimuraigala 🔬 Naveena Ariviyal vazhimuraigaloda kalanthu arogyamaana vaazhkaikkaana unavu muraigala pathi solli kodukkuraanga vaanga therinjukalaam🥗

urmila-1.title: Urmila
urmila-1.description: उर्मिलेच्या जन्मापासून मृत्यूपर्यंतच्या संपूर्ण जीवनाचे चित्रण करणारी ही पहिली कादंबरी. रामायणातील दुर्लक्षित नायिका उर्मिला — लक्ष्मणाची पत्नी — हिच्या भावनांना, त्यागाला आणि एकाकी जीवनाला प्रथमच केंद्रस्थानी ठेवून सांगितलेली अविस्मरणीय कथा!

mullai-periyar-dam.title: Mullai Periyar Dam
mullai-periyar-dam.description: Neerindi amaiyaathu ulagu nu valluvar sollirukaaru. Appadi patta thanni ah vachu inga pala varushangalaa arasiyal pandraanga. Mullai Periyar Dam uruvaana varalaaraiyum atha suthi nadanthuttu irukka arasiyalayum theliva eduthu solra pathivu thaan ithu. Mullai Periyaarai nokki payanikka thayaaraa makkale!

aariyarukku-murpatta-tamil-panpadu.title: Aariyarukku Murpatta Tamil Panpadu
aariyarukku-murpatta-tamil-panpadu.description: Nammaloda thamizh panpadu miga thonmaiyaanadhu. Athoda sirappugal pathi naama kelvi patturupom adhukku innum oru saandru dhaan indha audio book.

how-to-talk-so-kids-will-listen-and-list.title: Parenting Er Byapare Brihot Ideas
how-to-talk-so-kids-will-listen-and-list.description: Apnio ki parenting problems face koren? Apnar bachhao ki apnake ignore kore? Jodi hai hoi, tahole ei boi er sarangsho ti apnar jonnoi banano hoyeche. Apnake shuru korte hobe ki bhabe nijeder chele meye der moner bhabna bujhte hobe, tader ke bujhte hobe. Parenting er byapar e brihot bhabe janar jonnto ei sarangsho ti shune nin.

unwinding-anxiety-3.title: Unwinding Anxiety
unwinding-anxiety-3.description: ಬಹಳ ಜನ ಅನುಭವಿಸೋ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಆಂಕ್ಸೈಟಿ (Anxiety). ಇದ್ರು ಇಲ್ದಿದ್ರೂ ಮನಸ್ಸು ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಯೋಚ್ನೆ ಮಾಡೋದು, ಏನೂ ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಇಷ್ಟ ಇಲ್ಲದಂತೆ ಕಾಣ್ಸೋದು, ಮಲಗೋಕೆ ಕಷ್ಟ ಆಗೋದು, ಜ್ವರ ಬರೋದು, ಈ feelings ನಿಮಗೆ ಬಂದಿರಬಹುದು. ಆಂಕ್ಸೈಟಿಯು ಹೊರಗಿನ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ನಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಒಳಗಿನ ಒತ್ತಡಗಳಿಂದ ಆಗೋದು. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣಗಳು ಅನೇಕ ಇರಬಹುದು - ದುಡಿಮೆ ಒತ್ತಡ, ಕೆಲಸದ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ, ಜೀವನದ ಪ್ರತಿನಿತ್ಯದ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳು, ಅಥವಾ ನಮ್ಮೊಳಗಿನ ಗೊಂದಲಗಳು. ಇನ್ಮುಂದೆ ಇಂತಹ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿಂದ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ತೊಂದರೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸದೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾಧಾನ ತರಿಸೋದು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಂತ ಈ Kuku FM Bytes-ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ

সিনিয়র-ক্রাশ-যখন-বউ--লেখক--শুভদীপ-দাস.title: সিনিয়র ক্রাশ যখন বউ | লেখক - শুভদীপ দাস
সিনিয়র-ক্রাশ-যখন-বউ--লেখক--শুভদীপ-দাস.description: জীবনের প্রথম ক্রাশ, তাও কিনা কলেজের ইংলিশ প্রফেসর, অভ্রর কাছে রাস্তা একটাই নিঃস্বার্থ ভাবে নিজের ভালোবাসার প্রমাণ দিয়ে যাওয়া। কিন্তু কত দিন? ইনফ্যাচুয়েশন নাকি সত্যিকারের প্রেম? কনফিউশান কাটাতে শুনুন গল্পটি।

the-hidden-cartographers.title: The Hidden Cartographers
the-hidden-cartographers.description: భారతదేశపు చరిత్రలో, కాలాన్ని మించిపోయే జ్ఞానం ఉన్న కొంతమంది మేధావులు ఉన్నారు. వారు ప్రపంచాన్ని మామూలుగా చూడలేదు. భూమి, నక్షత్రాలు, ఖగోళ గమనాలు, సముద్రాలు – ప్రతి అంశాన్ని మానవ చైతన్యంతో, పరిశీలనతో గమనించారు. వారు రచించిన పాఠ్యాలు, రూపొందించిన జ్యోతిష్య సిద్ధాంతాలు, వర్ణించిన నక్షత్ర మండలాలు – ఇవన్నీ విశ్వాన్ని కొత్తగా అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి మార్గదర్శకాలు అయ్యాయి.

raajneeti-the-blood-game.title: Raajneeti : The Blood Game
raajneeti-the-blood-game.description: A fearless journalist loses everything after exposing a deadly political conspiracy. Then comes an offer that could make her the Chief Minister. But why was she chosen? Who is really behind the game? And how far will Dhristi go to claim the power that once destroyed her life? When truth becomes a weapon and politics becomes a blood game, who will survive?

haseen-career-ka-raasta.title: Haseen Career ka Raasta
haseen-career-ka-raasta.description: Career mein successful hone ke liye, solid knowledge ka hona toh zaroori hai, Lekin ye bhi pata hona chahiye ki kaise use sahi jagah aur time par apply karna hai. Jiski step by step guidance di gayi hai is show mein. Toh abhi suniye aur dhundhiye apni success ka raasta.

लाश-का-सच--लेखक--भरत-ठाकुर.title: लाश का सच
लाश-का-सच--लेखक--भरत-ठाकुर.description: Raajesh ko apni car mein apne patni Surekha ki laash milti hai... Surekha 3 Mahine se pregnant thi...lekin Police investigation se kuch aur hi baat saamne aati hai... kaun hai Surekha ka kaatil? Surekha maayeka jaane wali thi, wo Mumbai ke Vasai ilake mein kya kar rahi thi? Jaan ne ke liye sune puri kahani.

হরর-স্পেশাল-এপিসোড-.title: হরর স্পেশাল এপিসোড
হরর-স্পেশাল-এপিসোড-.description: ভ্যাম্পায়ার মিস্ট্রি সমাধান করে ডাউহিল থেকে বাড়ি ফিরে আসে সুলেখা। হাওয়াবদলের জন্য তার মা তাকে মামাবাড়ি পাঠায় পুরুলিয়ার বাঘমুন্ডিতে। কিন্তু সেখানে সে জড়িয়ে পড়ে আরেক রহস্যের সামনে, এক এক করে মারা পড়তে থাকে গ্রামের মানুষ? এই হত্যাকারীকে কি খুঁজে বের করতে পারবে সুলেখা? শুনে নিন গল্প রক্তের লালসা।

ichchhamrityu-1.title: Ichchhamrityu
ichchhamrityu-1.description:
Chhatrapati shivaji maharaj ko jab hazaro shatru sainiko dwara buri tarah gher liya tha. Unko niklane ka koi marg nahi bacha tha, Tab unhe bachane ke liye aage aaye Bajiprabhu aur unke 300 sathi. 300 marathon ne jab 12000 mugalo se yudhdh karke shaurya aur virata ki ek adbhut misal kayam kar di. 

(Ye ek kalpanik kahani hai. Kahani me aaye sabhi naam, ghatnayein lekhak ki kalpana par aadharit hain. Kisi bhi jeeveit ya mrit vyakti se kisi bhi prakar ka sambandh ek sanyog maana jayega.)

retire-young-retire-rich-2.title: Retire Young Retire Rich
retire-young-retire-rich-2.description: yavvanamlo padhavi veeraman chesi dhanavanthuluga  konasagadam elago ee audio book chebuthundi. dabbu sampadinchadaniki manakunna parapathulanu e vidhamga upayoginchukovalo rachayitha vivarinchadu. padhavi veeramana mundhugane cheyatam vallaa manalo kalige bhayalaku bharosa isthadu. yavvanamlo padhavi veeramana cheyatam dwara migilina samayani manam e vidhamga sadviniyoogam chesukovalo manam ee audiobook lo vini telusukundam.

1971-bharat-ki-cricketing-greatness-ki-s.title: 1971: Bharat Ki Cricketing Greatness Ki Shuruaat
1971-bharat-ki-cricketing-greatness-ki-s.description: Kya aapko pata hai, 1971 hi woh saal tha jab Bharat ne cricket ki duniya mein apni pehchaan banayi thi? Suno kaise Gavaskar aur Bedi jaise legends ne jeet ki ek nayi kahani likhi aur desh ko garv ka ehsaas dilaya. Is show mein jaaniye un lamhon ko jo ban gaye Bharat ki cricketing greatness ki Shuruaat!

jayan-maranathe-jayicha-naayakan.title: Jayan: Maranathe Jayicha Naayakan
jayan-maranathe-jayicha-naayakan.description: Ennum Malayalikal maravikku vittu kodukkan thazharakaatha oreyoru nadanaanu Jayan. Malayala Cinema kanda ettavum saahasikanaaya nadane ennal vedanayode alathe namuku orkkan sadhikila. Akalathil namme vittu poyathinte vedana ennum oro prekshakanteyum ullil bakkiyanu.

jab-neel-ka-daag-mita.title: Jab Neel ka Daag Mita
jab-neel-ka-daag-mita.description: चम्पारण सत्याग्रह — भारत में गांधीजी के सत्याग्रह का पहला प्रयोग। नीलहे अंग्रेजों के अत्याचार से पीड़ित किसानों की मुक्ति की यह कहानी, अहिंसा और सत्य की ताकत को बयां करती है। उन अनसुने स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों से मिलिए जिन्हें इतिहास ने भुला दिया। किस्सागोई की सहजता से लिखी यह किताब आपको उस दौर में ले जाएगी जब हिंदुस्तान बदल रहा था।

bandhan.title: Bandhan
bandhan.description: An ordinary IT professional, Shantanu Sharma, accidentally enters the mystical realm of Trishandhya and unknowingly marries Kaalika, the legendary Asura Queen cursed into a child's body. Bound by a supernatural destiny system and hunted by the power-hungry Shukradev, he must keep her alive—or doom three worlds to destruction.

i-married-a-broken-soldier-he-was-a-duke.title: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
i-married-a-broken-soldier-he-was-a-duke.description: After being betrayed by her fiancé, Gerald, and cast out by her own family, Princess Juliana finds an unexpected husband in Alexander, a wounded soldier hiding a royal secret. As Juliana rebuilds her life and challenges those who humiliated her, their unlikely marriage sparks a journey of love, courage, and redemption. But when Alexander’s true identity threatens to surface, their enemies may discover they underestimated the wrong couple.

the-art-of-happiness-10.description: Santhushtarayi irikkan vendi enthenkilum okke cheyth kondirikkunnavaranu nammal ellam. Ennal ethra per yadharthyathil jeevithathil santhoshavanmar aanu. fuddu-bana-faulad.title: Fuddu Bana Faulad
fuddu-bana-faulad.description: The show centers on a revenge-fueled collision between love, family power, and corporate manipulation, beginning when Riddhi publicly reveals her secret marriage to Veeru and chooses him over her wealthy father’s approval. Her father’s class prejudice turns the family confrontation into humiliation, threats, and violence, and the fallout becomes catastrophic when Riddhi dies and Veeru is blamed. Veeru is convicted and sent to prison, where grief hardens into a vow of revenge and his allies try to keep that rage from consuming him completely. From there, he is remade as the billionaire Viraj Pratap Singh, a fabricated elite identity designed to let him re-enter the world that destroyed him and strike from within. Under this new persona, business deals become weapons, especially as Viraj targets powerful families and companies through mergers, investments, and conditional alliances that are never just financial. Naina emerges as a central figure in this arena, fighting to control her company and resist Viraj’s pressure even as he uses valuation disputes, funding leverage, and apparent partnership to tighten his grip. Public celebrations of collaboration are repeatedly undercut by private threats, making every alliance feel like a trap and every success potentially the start of someone’s ruin. At the same time, other players such as Aditya and Ajay pursue their own vendettas beneath professional or romantic cover, suggesting that old wounds and unfinished love stories are driving multiple fronts of the conflict. A recurring thread points back to a crime or mistake from ten years earlier, with false murder accusations, suspicious police inaction, hidden files, and possible cover-ups linking personal tragedy to institutional corruption. Investigations widen through surveillance, secret-keepers, legal appeals, and media pressure, exposing how influential patriarchs and their confidants may have buried the truth for years. Grief keeps reproducing itself across generations, with murdered daughters, lost unborn children, and devastated siblings turning sorrow into leverage, coercion, and retaliatory violence. Viraj’s revenge philosophy becomes increasingly explicit: gain the target’s trust, then take away what the target loves most. That logic pushes the story beyond courtroom or boardroom tactics into kidnappings, gunpoint ultimatums, staged spectacles, and public humiliation. Yet the show also keeps stressing the emotional cost of vengeance, as avengers who claim victory still carry guilt, loneliness, and unresolved attachment to the people they failed to save. Romantic tension and family expectation continue to complicate the revenge plot, with flirtation, sibling friction, and strategic intimacy blurring the line between genuine feeling and calculated access. By the later arc, accusations of murder, rape, fabricated evidence, and media manipulation suggest that truth itself has become unstable, with every revelation vulnerable to being weaponized. The stakes therefore expand from one doomed marriage into a broader struggle over identity, justice, inheritance, and who gets to control the story of the dead. Across the series, the central movement is from private heartbreak to public war, as bereaved lovers, ambitious heirs, and powerful fathers collide in a world where business signatures, family loyalty, and revenge are inseparable.

return-for-revenge-5.title: Return for Revenge
return-for-revenge-5.description: The story begins with Aditya Pratap Singh returning to Devgad after years away, driven by an old promise and a desire to meet Vishakha again. His aide Virendra is alarmed by the risk, especially because Aditya insists on going without guards. At the same time, Vishakha is trapped in a painful triangle of old love, present duty, and family pressure. Her past with Ajju resurfaces, while Vicky stands as a protective but controlling fiance figure. Around them, local power brokers and goons enforce illegal collections, intimidate villagers, and turn ordinary disputes into public humiliation. A young villager’s refusal to pay extortion shows that the conflict is also about dignity and sacrifice, not just politics. The tension widens into a struggle over a martyrs' memorial threatened by a hotel project, with Punam leading resistance and Vishakha urging caution. Ajju returns after years away, hardened and politically connected, and his reappearance reopens old wounds with Vishakha while drawing him closer to Punam. Violence follows the protest, and the memorial dispute becomes tied to injuries, police pressure, and rumors about prison, corruption, and hidden alliances. In parallel, Aditya’s disappearance becomes a major concern when his phone is traced to a bloodied scene, suggesting abduction or worse. Virendra pushes through the police station, discovers an injured man left in lockup, and confronts the possibility of a cover-up. Political figures begin circling the case, and the presence of an MLA, a cabinet minister, and local enforcers turns the search into a larger power struggle. The story then shifts into an identity crisis when a man claiming to be Aditya is doubted and humiliated before his legitimacy is confirmed. Once his identity is established, Aditya emerges as a public reformist who openly attacks corruption, illegal tolls, police abuse, and misuse of public property. Evidence gathered by Ravi and Poonam helps expose wrongdoing, leading to official inquiries and suspensions. Vishakha’s personal crisis deepens when she reveals she was blackmailed into marriage, and her fallout with Ajju becomes public. Ajju, in turn, rejects Vishakha and aligns himself with Poonam, making the romantic and political conflicts inseparable. By the end, Aditya is rallying the crowd against corruption, while a familiar woman calling him “Ajju” hints that the past still shadows his public fight.

aadi-purusharu.description:

ಈ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ಅನುಭವವನ್ನು ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ಎಂ ನಲ್ಲಿ! 🎧🔥

ஒற்றை-ரோஜா.title: ஒற்றை ரோஜா
ஒற்றை-ரோஜா.description: கல்கியின் சிறந்த சிறு கதைகளில் ஒன்று ஒற்றை ரோஜா. இந்த நூல் 2007 ஆம் ஆண்டு வெளியிடப்பட்டது. இந்நூலில் மொத்தம் நாற்பத்து ஆறு பக்கங்கள் உள்ளன. ஒற்றை ரோஜா எனும் இந்த நூலில் இளம் வயதில் உள்ள  ஒரு ஆணும் பெண்ணும் இரயில் பயணத்தின் போது சந்திக்கின்றனர். இவ்விருவரும் சென்னையை நோக்கி புறப்படுகின்றனர். இளம் வயதினை உடைய அப்பெண் இலங்கையில் இருந்து வருகிறாள், அந்த இளைஞனின் சொந்த ஊர் சென்னை. இவ்விருவரும் திருநெல்வேலியில் இருந்து சென்னை நோக்கி புறப்படுகின்றனர். இருவரும் தேர்வில் தோல்வி அடைந்ததால் தங்களது வாழ்க்கையை முடித்து கொள்ள செல்கின்றனர்.

history-of-hazrat-musa-3.title: History Of Hazrat Musa
history-of-hazrat-musa-3.description: ಹಜರತ್ ಮುಸಾ - ಇವರು ಕೇವಲ ದೈವದ ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಕ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರನ್ನು ಅಡಿಮತ್ವ ದೇಶದಿಂದ ಬಿಡಿಸಿ, ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ನಾಡಿಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ದ ಮಹಾನ್ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಕಾರಕರೂ ಹೌದು! ಇಸ್ಲಾಂ, ಕ್ರಿಶ್ಚಿಯನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಯಹೂದ ಮೂರೂ ಧರ್ಮಗಳಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಇವರಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸ್ಥಾನವಿದೆ. ಕುರಾನ್ ನೂರಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸ್ಥಳಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಏಕೈಕ ದೈವ ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿತ “ಹಜರತ್ ಮುಸಾ” ಮಾತ್ರ. ದೈವದ ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿತ ಹಜರತ್ ಮುಸಾ ಅವರ ಜೀವನಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೊಬುಕ್ ಮೂಲಕ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ, ಬನ್ನಿ!

ee97d55f-ee78-425b-a290-3d93e49566b5.description: தன் தோழி மற்றும் அவள் காதலனுடன் சினிமா பார்க்கச் செல்கிறாள், நாயகி. அங்கு, நாயகியின் வருங்கால புகுந்த வீட்டினர் பார்த்து விடுகிறார்கள். நாயகி  காதலனுடன் சுற்றுகிறாள் என்று தவறாகப் புரிந்துகொள்கிறார்கள். அவளின் திருமணம் நடந்ததா?

the-exodus-the-night-kashmir-changed-for.title: The Exodus – The Night Kashmir Changed Forever
the-exodus-the-night-kashmir-changed-for.description: One night changed the fate of an entire community in Kashmir. As threats, targeted killings and fear spread across the Valley, the cold night of January 19, 1990 arrived—forcing thousands of Kashmiri Pandit families to leave their homes. Families fleeing in darkness, ancestral homes left behind, and an uncertain future ahead… THE EXODUS tells the story of a displacement whose pain, memories and unanswered questions still remain.

shirdi-wale-sai-baba.title: Mahima Saincha
shirdi-wale-sai-baba.description: Shirdi cha Shree Sai Babanchi khyati sampurna jagbharat pasrli ahe. Anek Jati ani dharmache loka Sai babana aple shradhasthan mantat. Pan Shirdit yenyapurvi, Adhyatik Guru bannyaadhi Babanche jeevan kase hote? Kasa hota tyancha bhutkal? Sai babani aplyala Sukhi jeevnache konte marga sangitle ahet? Sarva kahi janun gheuya ya khas show madhun.

ishq-with-a-billionaire.title: Ishq With A Billionaire
ishq-with-a-billionaire.description: Ek zamindaar family ke bachelor Virat ke raaste takra jate hai ek aam middle-class ghar ki ladki Divya se. Lekin jahan Divya logo ke liye samaaj se ladne ko taiyaar hai toh vahin Virat apne hi parivaar ki viraasat me uljha hua hai. Kya hoga jab billion-dollar ka waris Virat, Ganga kinaare waali muh-fat Divya se ishq kar baithega? Kya Virat apne pyaar ka saath dega ya apne parivaar ke samne jhuk jayega?

basic-of-mutual-funds.title: Basic of Mutual Funds
basic-of-mutual-funds.description: ಹಣ ಮಾಡೋದರ ಜೊತೆಗೆ, ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಸಹ ಗೊತ್ತಿರ್ಬೇಕು. ಆಗಷ್ಟೇ ದುಡ್ಡು ದುಡಿಯುತ್ತೆ.! ನೀವು ಕೂಡ ಹೀಗೆ ದುಡಿದ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಮಾಡೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿಡೋದು ಹೇಗೆ ಅಂತಾ ಯೋಚಿಸ್ತಿದ್ದೀರಾ.? ಮ್ಯೂಚುವಲ್ ಫಂಡ್ಸ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿಯೇ ಇದೆ. ಈ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕಂಪ್ಲೀಟ್ ಡೀಟೈಲ್ಸ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ. ಕೇಳಿ ‘ಬೇಸಿಕ್ ಆಫ್ ಮ್ಯೂಚುವಲ್ ಫಂಡ್ಸ್’ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್..

two-states-one-heart.title: Two States: One Heart
two-states-one-heart.description:
ఎలా మొదలైంది: స్వాతంత్ర్యం తర్వాత తెలుగు ప్రజలు ప్రత్యేక రాష్ట్రాన్ని కోరగా, 1953లో ఆంధ్ర రాష్ట్రం మద్రాసు నుంచి విడిపోయింది.
ఏం జరిగింది: 1956లో ఆంధ్రా మరియు తెలంగాణా (హైదరాబాదు రాష్ట్రంలో భాగం) కలసి ఒకే తెలుగు రాష్ట్రంగా ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌గా ఏర్పడ్డాయి.
ఇప్పుడేమిటి: సాంస్కృతిక, ఆర్థిక, రాజకీయ కారణాలతో 2014లో తిరిగి తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్రంగా విడిపోయి, రెండు రాష్ట్రాలు తమదైన మార్గంలో అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్నాయి.

get-out-of-your-head.title: Negative Thoughts Se Kaise Bachein
get-out-of-your-head.description: Khali dimag shaitan ka ghar hota hai, aakhir kyon hum aksar apne hi negative khayalon ke shikar ban jaate hain ? Kya hum us toxic aur khud ko neeche aur bilkul akela kar dene wali feeling se bach sakte hain? Ji haan, beshak, aur yeh audiobook is vishay par hi hai. Agar aapko Can't Hurt Me jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook aapko behad pasand aayegi.

keralathinte-swathanthra-samara-senanika.title: Keralathinte Swathanthra Samara Senanikal
keralathinte-swathanthra-samara-senanika.description: സാമ്രാജ്യത്വ ചൂഷണങ്ങളുടെ തടവറിയില്‍ നിന്ന് ഇന്ന് നിവര്‍ന്ന് നില്‍ക്കാന്‍ സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യം നല്‍കിയവരാണ് സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യ സമര സേനാനികള്‍. കേരളത്തിന്റെ മണ്ണില്‍ നിന്ന് നാടിനായി പൊരുതിയ അനേകം സ്വാതന്ത്ര്യ പോരാളികളെ മറക്കാനാവില്ല മലയാളികള്‍ക്ക്. അവരെ ഓര്‍ക്കാനുള്ള ശ്രമമാണ് ഈ ഷോയിലൂടെ Kuku FM ഒരുക്കുന്നത്. കേട്ടറിയാം പോരാളികളെ, പോരാട്ടത്തിന്റെ നാളുകളും.

pepsi-varalaaru.title: Pepsi Varalaaru
pepsi-varalaaru.description: During a time when Coca-Cola was flying high as the symbol of America, Pepsi entered the scene. At that point, Pepsi was just a tiny competitor in comparison. When they advertised saying, "We also make soft drinks," no one took them seriously. But today, the same world celebrates Pepsi on par with Coke. N. Chokkan’s book narrates the success story of Pepsi.

feminism-in-kerala.title: Feminism In Kerala
feminism-in-kerala.description: Noottandukalayi orey samoohathinte bhagamayirunittum thudarunna asamathwathinte pariharam kaanuka enna valiya lakshyamanu Feminism munnotu vaikkunna rashtriyam. Pakshe, oru Feministine terrorist enna reethiyil Malayali nokki kaanunathu enthukondanu? Vishadhamayi ariyam ee showiloode.

freshworks-chennai-to-nasdaq.title: Freshworks - Chennai to Nasdaq
freshworks-chennai-to-nasdaq.description: Yeh kahani hai ek aise company ki jiski shuruvaat toh hui Chennai mein par woh jaa pohohchi USA ke stock market tak, aur isse uchaai tak pohochaane ke peeche haath tha Down-to-Earth entrepreneur Girish Mathrubootham ka. Aaiye suntte hai unki yeh inspirational journey

ca96c072-4a9a-4e6d-8cb4-17942e609dfb.title: Rangaraatinam
ca96c072-4a9a-4e6d-8cb4-17942e609dfb.description: ஹொய்சாளர்களாலும் அதற்குப்பின் டெல்லி சுல்தான்கள் படையெடுப்பின் காரணமாகவும் ஸ்ரீரங்க ரங்கநாதன் ஒரு தலைமுறைக் காலம் வரை வெளியூர்களில் உலாச் செய்து அதற்குப் பின் மீண்டும் திருவரங்கம் வந்தடைந்த கதை தான், ரங்கராட்டினம்.

murder-at-riverfront.title: Murder At Riverfront
murder-at-riverfront.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

royal-enfield-1.title: Royal Enfield Chi Success Story
royal-enfield-1.description: Royal Enfield ha motor cycle madhil servant Juna brand ahe. Kashi jhali ya brandchi survat ani kasa jhala ha deshatil sarvat motha brand janun gheuyat kuku fm chya khas show madhye jyacha nav ahe Royal Enfieldchi success story.

hamlavar-1.title: Hamlavar
hamlavar-1.description: Commander desh ki sarvochch jasoosi sansthaan RAW ka agent hai. Jab bhi desh ke aam naagriko par koi sankat aata hai to commander 130 crore hindustaaniyo'n ka muhafiz bankar dushman ke saamne khada ho jaata hai. Is baar desh ki security ka maamla tha. Mulq ke kuch secret papers swiss bank ke vault me chuupakar rakh diye gye the magar us important file tak kaise pahunchega commander Karan Saxena? Aakhir us secret files se kaise paltega desh ka manzar? Duniya ke sabse surakshit vault ko todne ki hairatangez gaatha. Suniye thrill, action, twists and turn se bharpoor ye kahani 'Hamlavar'.

kanchanamala.title: Kanchanamala
kanchanamala.description: తన దేహాన్ని దేవుడికి అంకితం చేసిన ఓ దేవదాసి కథ…పాత తప్పులకు తిరుగుబాటా? లేక కొత్త తప్పులకు ప్రాయశ్చిత్తమా? నాట్యంలో తన బాధను దాచుకున్నా, చూపు ప్రతీకారం కోసం వెతుకుతోందా లేక ప్రేమ కోసమా? ఎవరి కర్మకు ఎవరు బాధ్యులు? తెలియాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో సిరీస్ వినండి.

manal-veedugal.title: மணல் வீடுகள்
manal-veedugal.description:
குடும்பத்திற்காக ஓயாமல் உழைக்கும்,
ஒரு வாடகைத் தாயின் கதை இது.
கேளுங்க “மணல் வீடுகள்”

bhikhari-boss-1.title: Bhikhari Boss
bhikhari-boss-1.description: Meet Yuvaan, a man born into a wealthy family who is living a life of a beggar. Why would someone from such an affluent background choose to live in poverty? What is the secret behind his unusual life? Watch Bikhari Boss to uncover the mystery!

money-know-more-make-more-give-more-1.title: Money: Know More, Make More, Give More
money-know-more-make-more-give-more-1.description: Financial Independence adaiya neenga enna seiyanum nu theriyuma? Neenga nenacha madhiri happy ah oru life, ungalayum unga family'um neengale paathukura alavukku well settled aaga enna seiyum nu therinjuka kelunga "Money: Know More, Make More, Give More" on Kuku FM

barmajhili.title: Barmajhili
barmajhili.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

googled-by-god.title: Googled By God
googled-by-god.description: 1986 me har kisi ke pass rahasya the lekin kya hoga agar ek aam student ka rahasya poore desh ke financial market ko giraane ki taaqat rakhta ho. Is rahasya ko ujaagar karne ke liye use kya karna hoga? Kya hoga jab ek machine ko share baazar ki duniya ka bhagwaan maan liya jaayega? Is safar me bhai ki hatya se lekar pita ke sath vishwasghaat bhi shaamil hai. Share baazar, nivesh aur paise ki badalti duniya ke beech aap khud ko bhaavnaao'n aur karm ke khatarnaak khel ke beech me paayenge.

saradha-chit-fund.title: Saradha Chit Fund Scam
saradha-chit-fund.description: Saradha Group 2006 mein start kiya gaya tha, iske founder Sudipto Sen the. Saradha Group ka naam tab puri duniya ko pata chala jab isne 2013 mein lagbhag 4000 cr. ka scam kar dala, lakho logo ke paise loot liye gaye. Is pure scam mein ek bahut bada political connection bhi samne aaya jisme ek se ek bade political leaders ke naam samne aaye. Saradha Group scam india ke bahut bade Financial scam ki list mein shamil hai jisme 200 se jyada logo ne suicide kar liya tha.

padinjarekollam-chorakkalam-1.title: Padinjarekollam chorakkalam
padinjarekollam-chorakkalam-1.description: ജി.ആർ. ഇന്ദുഗോപന്റെ "പടിഞ്ഞാറെ കൊല്ലം ചോരക്കാലം" — ലളിതവും സുതാര്യവുമായ ഭാഷയിൽ എഴുതപ്പെട്ട മനോഹരമായ കൃതി. വലിയ ചിന്താഭാരമൊന്നുമില്ലാതെ, ഒഴുകുന്ന നദിയെപ്പോലെ സ്വാഭാവികമായി സഞ്ചരിക്കുന്ന കഥാഖ്യാനം വായനക്കാരെ ആദ്യ വരിയിൽ തന്നെ കൂടെ കൂട്ടുന്നു!

tilottama-season-2.title: Tilottama Season 2
tilottama-season-2.description: Jab Tilottama ne apni poori shakti ke saath wapas vaar kiya, tab Harsh aur uske saathiyon ko ek aisi kitaab dhoondhni padi jo sab kuch badal sakti thi. Dosti, wafadari aur sachchai ki asli kasauti ke iss khel mein, unka har faisla zindagi ya maut ka faisla ban gaya. Kya unhe jeet mili, ya andhera unka aakhri mod ban gaya? Aur sab kuch jaankar bhi kya Harsh apne doston ko bacha paaya?

the-real-kerala-story.title: The Real Kerala Story
the-real-kerala-story.description: Indiayile ella samsthangaleyum eduthunokkiyal, athil Keralam ithramathram savisheshamaakkunnath enthanennu ningal eppozhengilum chinthichitundo? Ithrayum shakthamaya saamudhayika sowhardhabhodham valarthiyedukkan Keralathinu engane kazhiyunnu? 'The Real Kerala Story' enna ee showiloode Keralathe kurichulla chila sathyangal ariyam.

o-ateneu.title: O Ateneu
o-ateneu.description: Embarque nas memórias de Sergio, enquanto ele relembra a época em que  estudou no Ateneu, um dos mais renomados internatos da época. Apesar de empolgado, o jovem logo percebe que seu ano letivo não seria tão fácil quando esperava.

disorder.title: Disorder
disorder.description: కంట్రోల్ లేని కామ కోరికలతో  ఆమె శరీరం రగిలిపోతూ ఉంటుంది. ఇటువంటి వింత జబ్బుతో బాధపడే అపురూప సౌందర్య రాశి హంసలేఖ. హద్దు అదుపు లేని  తన ఆకలిని తీర్చుకోవడానికి ఆ  నవ యవ్వన యువతి చేసిన పని ఏమిటి? చావు అంచు దాకా చేరుకున్న ఆమెను  కాపాడిన డాక్టర్ ప్రణవ్  తో ప్రేమలో పడుతుంది హంస లేఖ. మరి  ఆమె శరీర  వాంఛలు తీరాయా? నమ్మి  తన వెంట వచ్చిన హంసలేఖ జబ్బుని డాక్టర్ ప్రణవ్ నయం చేయగలిగాడా? ఆమె గతం తెలుసుకున్న  అతను   ఆమెను పెళ్లి చేసుకున్నాడా?   డాక్టర్ ని నమ్మిన హంసలేఖ  మోసపోయిందా? అతన్నే మోసం చేసిందా

naxal-the-1990-terror.title: Naxal - The 1990 Terror
naxal-the-1990-terror.description: 1990 me dilli ki ek famous university ke andar kuch log students ko Naxal bna rhe the. In sab ke beech 21 saal ka anaath Surya fas gya jise seedha Naxals camp me shaamil kara diya gya. Magar phir jab Indian Army ki nazar Surya par padi tab sara khel ulta pad gya. Kya hoga jab BA Political Science ka ek student baghawat par utar jaayega? Aakhir kisse hai uski ladai? jaanne ke liye suniye dehshat se bharpoor ye kahani 'Naxal-The 1990 Terror'.

how-to-stop-worrying-and-start-living-10.title: How to Stop Worrying and Start Living
how-to-stop-worrying-and-start-living-10.description: Enno Kashtalatho mee burra motham nindi poyinda? aithe ee audio book meekosame. meeru santhoshanga unnara leda ani eppudiana alochinchara? mana ee jeevitham lo manaki enni kashtalu unna kuda mana kosam manam samayam ketayinchali. aithe ee audio book lo manaki rachayatha enni kashtalatho bhadapaduthunna andulo nunchi bayataki ravadaniki gala techniques ni manaku rachayatha indulo teliyachesadu. inkenduku alasyam ventane vinandi.

satta.title: Satta
satta.description: लालमाटी का एक आदर्शवादी शिक्षक, अपने लोगों का भविष्य बदलने के सपने में सत्ता का सबसे भरोसेमंद मोहरा बन जाता है। लेकिन जब उसे पता चलता है कि उसी के हाथों उसकी बस्ती, उसके बच्चे और उनके सपने बिक चुके हैं, तो वह भ्रष्ट राजनीति, पूंजी और सत्ता के उस साम्राज्य के खिलाफ युद्ध छेड़ देता है जहाँ सच नहीं, सिर्फ ताकत राज करती है।

ramayanam-3.title: Ramayanam
ramayanam-3.description: Indhiyavin miga mukkiyamaana kaaviyangalil ondraana Ramayanathai muzhumaiyaaga arinthu kolla elimaiyana vazhi intha audio puthagathai ketpathu thaan. Valmiki, Kambar, Thulasithasar ena Palveru Kalakattathil Palar ezhuthiya Ramayanathin verupatta palveru pathippugalai aarainthu uruvaakka patta muzhumaiyana Ramayanam ithu. Kelungal.

faster-fene-detective.title: Faster Fene Detective
faster-fene-detective.description: Step into a world of fun and learning with Kuku FM's children's stories. Our audiobooks are full of adventures and lessons about friendship courage and curiosity. They're perfect for young listeners making learning exciting and storytelling a joy. Listen now Kuku FM for stories that spark imagination and teach important values in a simple enjoyable way.

mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-bhim.title: Mahabharat ke Amar Patra: Bhim
mahabharat-ke-amar-patra-bhim.description: भीम — महाभारत के पाँच पांडवों में सबसे बलशाली! दस हजार हाथियों का बल, गदा युद्ध में पारंगत। दुर्योधन, दुःशासन सहित गांधारी के सौ पुत्रों का संहारक। हिडिंबा से पुत्र घटोत्कच के पिता और एक अद्भुत रसोइया — भीम का व्यक्तित्व अनेक रंगों से भरा है!

bhopal-family-sucide.title: Bhopal Family suicide
bhopal-family-sucide.description: Online website, loan aur leaked private video . Ek aisa ghinauna jaal jismein phanar Bhopal ke ek pure pariwar ne kar Li aatmhatya. Kya hai is sucide ki puri kahani suniye sirf KUKU FM par.

a-question-of-trust-2.title: A Question Of Trust
a-question-of-trust-2.description: Oru CEO kitta iruka vendiya basic qualities enna? Oru Company ah valarchi paadhi la kondu poga avar endha madiriyana decisions eduka vendi irukum? Indha book oda authors avanga life experiences la irundhu pala interesting perspectives ah share pannirukanga. Therinjuka Kelunga “A Question Of Trust” on Kuku FM

yellara-mane-dose.title: Yellara Mane Dose
yellara-mane-dose.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

hyderabad-nizams.title: Hyderabad Nizams
hyderabad-nizams.description: 1713 nundi 1721 varaku Moghal samrajyam kinda Deccan Waisroy ga panichesina Meer qamariud-din siddiqui chetha Asaf jahi rajavamsham sthapinchabadindi. 1707lo Aurangzeb chakravarthi maraninchina tharvatha ee pranthaanni adapadadapa paripalinchadu. 1724 Mughal niyanthrana balaheenapadindi, Asaf jha Mughal samrajyam nundi swathanthrudayyadu.

rich-dad-poor-dad-54.description: സമ്പത്ത് ഉണ്ടാക്കുക എന്നാൽ ഡ്രൈവിംഗ് പോലെ സ്വയം പരിശീലിക്കേണ്ടുന്ന ഒന്നാണെന്ന് ലോകമാകെ വായിക്കപ്പെട്ട ഈ പുസ്തകം പറയുന്നു. ജീവതത്തിൽ സാമ്പത്തിക വിജയം ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നവർക്കുളള ഏറ്റവും മികച്ച മോട്ടിവേഷണൽ ബുക്ക് ആണിത്. സമ്പത്തിനെ സംബന്ധിക്കുന്ന നിങ്ങളുടെ കാഴ്ചപ്പാടിനെ മാറ്റി തീർക്കുക മാത്രമല്ല, പണം സമ്പാദനം, നിക്ഷേപം, കരുതൽ ഇതിനെ കുറിച്ചെല്ലാം റോബർട്ട് ക്വിയോസ്ക്കി നിങ്ങൾക്ക് പറഞ്ഞ് തരുന്നു.  കേൾക്കൂ..ലോകത്ത് ഏറ്റവും കൂടുതൽ ആളുകൾ വായിച്ച ഗ്രന്ഥം, ജീവിതത്തെ സ്വയം മാറ്റിപണിയൂ....

kiska-saath-kitna-vikaas.description: Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas ka dawa karne wali BJP sarkar kya sach mein sabko ek taraju mein taul rahi hai? Kya is Government ki scheme har varg tak pahunchi? Is show mein hum samaj ke vibhinn tabko aur unke liye shuru ki gayi scheme par nazar dalenge aur dekhenge, ki kahi ye nara bhi jumla to nahi.

rothor-sokori-ghure.title: Rothor Sokori Ghure

arathin-kural.title: Arathin Kural
arathin-kural.description: சத்தியமும் தர்மமும் என்றும் அழியாதவை — இதையே நிரூபிக்கிறது மகாபாரதம். ஐந்து பாண்டவர்களின் போராட்டம், துரியோதனன்-சகுனியின் தீய சதிகள், கண்ணனின் திவ்ய லீலை, அபிமன்யுவின் வீர மரணம் — இந்த மகாகாவியத்தை தமிழில் "ஐவர் காவியம்" என்று சிறப்பிக்கிறோம்!

विक्रांत-दुनिया-तेरी-मेरी-एलीयन-.description: Ab shuru hoga, ek naya khel...khud jaal mein phansa Vikrant, kaise bachayega Pruthvi ko? সন্তাপ--লেখিকা--রিমা-গোস্বামী-দাস.title: Santap

gandhiyum-bagathsingum.description: Mahatma Gandhi yum Bhagat Singh um ennaikume India makkaloda manasa vittu neengaatha rendu perum suthanthira porraatta thalaivargal. black-tigers.description: Kai, Kaalgalai izhantha karumbuli mugunthan, Singala veerargal arukil vara vayitril iruntha buttonai azhuththi, vaayil iruntha cyanide kuppiyai kadiththaan. Irandum ore nodiyil seyalaatra, Enjiyiruntha singala veerargalum vediththu sitharinaargal. Yaar intha karumbuli mugunthan? Avanathu thiyagaththukkaana karanam enna?

operation-smiling-buddha-pokhran-nuclear.title: Operation Smiling Buddha- Pokhran Nuclear Test
operation-smiling-buddha-pokhran-nuclear.description: 18 May, 1974 ko Buddh Purnima ke din Bharat ne pehli baar atom bomb ki testing Pokhran mein ki jise 'Pokhran-1' ya 'Operation Smiling Buddha' kehte hai. Par ye Operation duniya hi nahi Bharat ke andar bhi kaafi khofiya tareeke se kiya gaya tha. Iski khabar Home Ministry aur Defense Ministry tak ko nahi thi. Is Operation ka puri duniya ne virodh kiya aur Bharat pe sanctions bhi lagaye, kyuki United Nations Security Council ka permanent member na hote hue bhi Bharat ne nuclear testing ki. UPSC mein aane wale aur bhi questions ke sawal jane is show se.

ആടുജീവിതം-കഥയും-യാഥാര്‍ത്ഥ്യവും.description: നാം ജീവിക്കാത്ത ജീവിതങ്ങളെല്ലാം നമുക്ക് കെട്ടുകഥകളാണ്. ഈ ഒരു വരി കേള്‍ക്കാത്ത മലയാളികളില്ലെന്ന് തന്നെ പറയാം. ആടുജീവിതം പോലെ മലയാളിയെ സ്വാധീനിച്ച പുസ്തകങ്ങള്‍ ചുരുക്കം. നല്ല ജീവിതത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള സ്വപ്നം കഠിനമായ യാഥാര്‍ത്ഥ്യത്തെ നേരിടാന്‍ പ്രേരിപ്പിക്കുമോ? കേട്ട് തന്നെ അറിയാം..

the-guide-for-understanding-ai-with-ceci.title: The Guide For Understanding AI With Cecil Sunder
the-guide-for-understanding-ai-with-ceci.description:
ஆர்டிபிசியல் இன்டெலிஜென்ஸ் உலகத்துல நாம இருக்கோம். இந்த உலகத்தை பத்தி துல்லியமா தெரிஜிக்க ஒரு சிறப்பான விருந்தினர் இந்த ஆடியோ-ல இணைந்து இருக்காரு. திரு. செசில் சுந்தர்அவர்கள் (AI தலைமை பொறுப்பாளர் மைக்ரோசாப்ட் நிறுவனம்). AI பற்றின நமக்கு தெரியாத பல தகவல்களை பகிர்ந்து இருக்காரு. 
We are in a world of artificial intelligence. We have one of the best experts of AI Mr. Cecil sundar (Director of AI Microsoft) on this audio show to guide and talk to us about the World of AI.

the-placebo-effect-and-how-it-works.description: Manishi alochana vidhaname manishini marcheyagalguthundi ante meeru nammuthara? lekapothe aa matalani kottipadesthara? koni koni sarulu manishi meeda e mandhu panicheyakapoyina manishi alochane marcheyagaladhu ane vishayam meeku telusa? avunu idi nijam ga nijam, mana medhadu manam dani ela control chesthe adhi ala control avuthundi deni gurinchi inka purthiga telusukovalante ee audio book vinandi.

do-it-today-3.description: Kal Je Kajta Korben Vabchen Seta Aaj Korun. Aaj Jeta Korben Vabchen Seta Ekkhuni Korun. Kal Er Jonyo Kono Kaj Fele Rakha Thik Noy. Namma inathoda neenda nediya varalaarai ketka thayaaraa makkale !

uttara-kaanda.title: Uttara Kaanda
uttara-kaanda.description: **ಉತ್ತರಕಾಂಡ** ಎಸ್.ಎಲ್. ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಅವರ ಸಮಕಾಲೀನ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ರಾಮಾಯಣದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಸೀತೆಯ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನದಿಂದ ನಿರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ರಾಮನ ಅನ್ವಯವಲ್ಲದ ಕಥಾಹಂದರವನ್ನು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭೈರಪ್ಪ ಯಥಾರ್ಥವಾದ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಕಥಾನಿರೂಪಣೆಗೆ ಒಳಪಡಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ರಾಮಾಯಣದ ಪೌರಾಣಿಕ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೈನಾಗಿರುವ ಸೀತೆಯ ಬದುಕಿನ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆಯನ್ನೂ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ವಾಸ್ತವಿಕತೆಯೂ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಮುಖ್ಯಾಂಶವಾಗಿದೆ. ಉತ್ತರಕಾಂಡ ಕಥಾ ಹಂದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀತೆ ಒಂದು ಬಲಹೀನಳಲ್ಲ, ಬಲಿಷ್ಠ ಹಾಗೂ ತೀವ್ರ ಮನೋವಿಕಾಸ ಹೊಂದಿದ ಮಹಿಳೆಯಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಸೀತೆನು ಅವಳ ಕುಟುಂಬ, ಸಮಾಜ, ಮತ್ತು ಶಕ್ತಿ-ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಒತ್ತಡಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಅವಳ ಜೀವನದ ತಾತ್ವಿಕ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

wisdom-and-practices-of-pancharatra.title: Wisdom And Practices Of Pancharatra
wisdom-and-practices-of-pancharatra.description: పంచరాత్ర సిధ్ధాంతాలు భారతీయ తత్త్వశాస్త్రంలో అత్యంత ప్రాముఖ్యత గల విభాగం. ఇవి ముఖ్యంగా వైష్ణవ సంప్రదాయానికి చెందినవి, శ్రీవిష్ణువుని మూలాధారంగా భావించి ఆరాధించే తత్వశాస్త్ర సంప్రదాయాలను సూచిస్తాయి. పంచరాత్రం దేవుని ఆధ్యాత్మిక రూపాన్ని, జీవాత్మల సంబంధాన్ని, మోక్ష సాధన మార్గాలను సుదీర్ఘంగా వివరిస్తుంది.

Kya Arjun bacha payega Aditi ko? Kaun hai Raktbeej aur kya hai Morigaon ka 150 saal purana twin curse? Morigaon mein kyon Gayab ho rahe hain judwaa bachche?

disturb-your-depression-3.title: Disturb Your Depression
disturb-your-depression-3.description:
Disturb your depression is related to our very basic and root-level causes of Depression, which has eventually become our everyone's best friend. I have tried to give all such common but important reasons for Stress, Anxiety, Nervousness, Tension, Overthinking, and Depression. Mental Disorders are the outcomes of all these problems. This audio will help us to solve such problems by our own efforts and Self Motivation. Very easy and simple steps have been shared so that it can help each and every age group of Depression to overcome the problem and Lastly can Disturb their Depression.
It is very important to share these kinds of messages and audio with our loved ones too. Thank you.

aapatthige-aahvana.title: Aapatthige Aahvana
aapatthige-aahvana.description: ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿ ಸಜೀವ್ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನಿಂದಲೇ ಅಪಹರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗ್ತನೆ. ತಾನು ಉಳಿಯಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ, ದೇಶದ ಭದ್ರತೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಪಟ್ಟ ರಹಸ್ಯವನ್ನ ತಿಳಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಸಂದಿಗ್ಧ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಅವನದು. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಸಜೀವ್ ಏನ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ? ಕೇಳಿ ಯತಿರಾಜ ವೀರಾಂಬುಧಿ ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರೋ ರೋಚಕ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ 'ಆಪತ್ತಿಗೆ ಆಹ್ವಾನ'

outskill-future-proofing-your-career-in-.title: Outskill: Future Proofing Your Career in a Post-Pandemic World
outskill-future-proofing-your-career-in-.description: இது உங்க கரியர மாத்தி அமைக்க போற ஒரு வரப் பிரசாதம் இந்த புத்தகம்... கேளுங்க அவுட் ஸ்கில்ஸ் உங்க குக்கு எஃப் எம்ல.

sachin-the-god-of-indian-cricket.title: Sachin : The God Of Indian Cricket
sachin-the-god-of-indian-cricket.description: 16 Bochor Boyose Khela Shuru Kora Ek Choto Chele Gota Cricket Biswer Kache Idol Hoye Uthbe Ke Vebechilo. Ekjon Manush Je Ekta Jug Hote Paren Seta Dekhiyechilen Tini. Cricketer Format E 100 ta Century Kore Je Nojir Tini Rekhechilen Gota Cricket Duniyay Jar Jonyo Gorbo Bodh Koren Protita Indian. Hya, Aaj Ei Audio Show Er Modhey Diye Aamra Janar Chesta Korbo Indian Cricket Er God Sachin Tendulkar Er Nana Kahini. Kivabe Tini Elen Cricket Duniyay? Kivabe Somporke Joralen Anjali Er Songe? Keno Captain Hoyeo Chere Dilen Sei Pod? Bharoter Hoye Khelar Agey Kon Desher Hoye Khelen Tini?  Eirokom Kichu Ojana Golpo Shunbo Ei Audio Show Er Modhey Diye.

my-love-kuku.title: মাই লাভ | লেখিকা -  চম্পা চক্রবর্তী
my-love-kuku.description: আমেরিকায় বসবাসকারী মেঘাজ একজন বিখ্যাত অভিনেতা ও পরিচালক। কলকাতায় ফিরে দেখা হয় আরোহীর সাথে, ঘটনাক্রমে, বাড়ির জন্য তাদের বিয়ে করতে হয়। অন্ধকারে ভয় পাওয়া আরোহীর জন্য এই সম্পর্ক কতটা নিরাপদ হবে? মেঘাজ কি পারবে আরোহীকে মেনে নিতে?

bheema-nayak.title: Bheema Nayak
bheema-nayak.description: Nimar ke janglon se Angreji Hukumat ke khilaf uthi hai awaz. Awaz aisi jiski goonj 1857 ke krantikariyon tak bhi pahunch gayi. Kaun the ye Bheema Nayak jinhone angrejon ki neend uda di thi? Janne ke liye sunnein, is veer yodha ki sachchi kahani…

how-ott-is-changing-the-entertainment-in.title: Binge & Chill
how-ott-is-changing-the-entertainment-in.description: Technology has continuously changed with the introduction of suitable inventions that most people wouldn't have predicted. Due to OTT's wide-ranging effects, some of the most cutting-edge integrated developments, such as entertainment showcasing, are now having a significant impact. Nobody should be surprised by the popularity of OTT platforms, but it does make us wonder about the future of the entertainment sector. This unique series will show how the "television industry" is changing and how the media sector is adjusting to the digital era. Each episode will cover topics such as how the market operates right now, how the different actors generate revenue, who pays whom for what, the current changes in the industry, and more. So grab your popcorn and get on this exciting journey.

ind-vs-pak-cricket-rivalry-2.title: IND vs PAK Cricket Rivalry
ind-vs-pak-cricket-rivalry-2.description: IND vs PAK ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಪಂದ್ಯ ಎಂದರೆ ಇವತ್ತು ಕೇವಲ ಆಟವಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ! ಅದು ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಯುದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಯಾಗಿದೆ! ಈ ಪಂದ್ಯವನ್ನು ನೋಡುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಟೇಡಿಯಂ ಒಳಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊರಗೆ ಕೋಟ್ಯಂತರ ಮಂದಿ ಸೇರುವುದು ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ..! ಆದರೆ, ಇಷ್ಟು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪಂದ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮಹತ್ವ ಸಿಗುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು? T20 ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸೋಲಿಸಿದ್ದು ಯಾಕೆ? ಈ ಬಾರಿ ವಿಶ್ವಕಪ್ ಪಂದ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶೇಷತೆಗಳೇನು? ಇವೆಲ್ಲಾ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕಾದರೆ, ಕೇಳಿ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಪ್ರೇಮಿಗಳು ಕಾತುರದಿಂದ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ 'IND vs PAK Cricket Rivalry' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

punyangalude-ramzan.title: Punyangalude Ramzan
punyangalude-ramzan.description: Punyam peythirangunna Ramzan Maasamanu. Vishudhiyude thanalil idam thedunna viswasikk ariyendathum cheyyendathumaya nishtakal orupadund. 1000 maasangalekkal chaithanyavum sreshatavum aaya Lailuthul Kadr nekkurich ningalkk ariyumo. Annu cheyunna pravarthikal enthu kondanu mattellathinekkalum punyamakunnath. Parama karunyavante anugrahathinayi cheyyenda karyangalum prarthanakalum enthellam aanu. Kshamayudeyum paapamochanathinteyum thyagathinteyum maasathekkurich ningalkku ariyendathellam Kuku FMilund.

byjus-downfall.title: Downfall of Byju's
byjus-downfall.description: India ki ed-tech industry ka sabse bada naam hai Byjus. Par jitni jaldi Byju’s ki remarkable growth hui thi, utni hi jaldi hua tha Byju’s ka downfall. Aaj karz mein doobi Byju’s ka kaise hua ye haal? Aur kaun si controversies ke chalte badnam hui Byju's? Byju's ki recent aur controversial history, aaiye jaante hain is show mein!

bitcoin-duniyar-khuntinati.description: Bitcoin Jinista Niye Aamader Oneker Mone Nana Proshno Ghurpak Khay. Bitcoin Jinisti Aasole Ki ? Eta Kivabe Elo ? Kivabe Er Byabohar Hoy ? power-of-bible.description: Prapancha vyapathamga kraisthavulu chadive grandham Bible. Deenini parishuddha grandhamani kuda antaru. Bible anaga greek bashalo vaidika samhitha. Bible grandham vividha kalallo vividha pranthalaku chendina 40 pravakthalu 1400 samvathsarala paatu vrayabadindi. Bible lo moodu rakamulu unnavi.

udyog-tumcha-paisa-dusryacha.title: Udyog Tumcha Paisa Dusryacha
udyog-tumcha-paisa-dusryacha.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

ram-ki-gatha.title: Ram Ki Gatha
ram-ki-gatha.description: Devdutt Pattanaik Ke Sath explore kare Ram ki kahani, maryada purushottam ke roop me unki strengths, weaknesses aur inner divinity ko samajhte hue. Discover karo unke tales me chhipe metaphors aur timeless lessons. Is audiobook ko zaroor suno aur jaano Ram ka relevance aaj ke samay me aur unki kahani ke peeche ki wisdom

gachibowli-divakar.title: Gachibowli Divakar
gachibowli-divakar.description: అవతల వాళ్ళు మనసులో అనుకుంటున్నా మాటలు మనకు తెలిసిపోతుంటే, అది వరమా? శాపమా? మనకేమో కానీ మన "గచ్చిబౌలి దివాకర్" కి మాత్రం శాపమే పాపం. వద్దని ఎంత వారిస్తున్నా పట్టుబట్టి మరి ఆ వరాన్ని పొందిన "దివాకర్" పరిస్థితి చివరికి ఏమైంది? అసలు ఆ వరాన్ని అతనికి ఇచ్చింది ఎవరు? అతనికి వచ్చిన ఆ మ్యాజికల్ పవర్ ని అతను ఎలా ఉపయోగించనున్నాడు ? ఆలస్యంలేకుండా వినండి, నవ్వుకోండి "గచ్చిబౌలి దివాకర్" కామెడి  షో మీ కుకు Fm లో.

jab-neel-ka-dag-mita.title: Jab Neel Ka Daag Mita - Champaran 1917
jab-neel-ka-dag-mita.description: British sarkar ke zulm se bhari yeh audiobook aapko le jayegi Bihar ke Champaran ke mahaveer kisano ki kahani mein. Iss audiobook mein Mahatma Gandhi ki leadership mein British raj ke khilaf diye gaye balidan aur jeet ki vo kahani aapko pata chalegi jiske saamne British taqat bhi kaanp gayi thi. Suniye aur mahsoos kijiye Champaran ke dharti ke veer kisano ke famous itihaas ko sirf Jab Neel Ka Daag Mita: Champaran 1917 kitab ki Audiobook mein!

bhimrao-ramji-ambedkar.title: Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar
bhimrao-ramji-ambedkar.description: Vidhyabhyasathinayum, jathi vivechanathinu ethireyum padaporuthiya Dr. B R Ambedkar ude jeevithavum adarshavum ee kaalaghattathilum prasakthamanu. 'Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar' enna showilude adhehathinte adarshangalum, nilapadukalum, jeevithavum ariyam.

tawoyekor-xadhu.title: Tawoyekor xadhu

Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

సిల్లీఫెలో-.title: సిల్లీఫెలో
సిల్లీఫెలో-.description:
తన కొడుకు పెళ్లి కోసం తహతహలాడుతున్న వాళ్లకు, తన కొడుకు రహస్యంగా పెళ్లి అయ్యి కాపురం చేస్తాడు అని ఎవరు చెబుతారో! బూచిబాబు - సీత ఇద్దరూ కూడా వాళ్ళ గప్ చుప్ ప్రేమను ఎలా కాపాడుకుని వస్తారు?  
తెలిసిపోయాక వచ్చే తలనొప్పి కన్నా తెలిసిపోతుంది ఏమో అని వచ్చే తలనొప్పికి సెంటిమెంట్ అనే ఆయింట్మెంట్ ఎలా రాసుకున్నారు అనేదే మన సిల్లీ ఫెలో గాడి కథ

thulirkkum.title: துளிர்க்கும்
thulirkkum.description: பிள்ளைப் பேற்றுக்காக தவிக்கும் ஒரு பெண்ணின் கதை. ஒரு பெண்சித்தரால் கருவுற்று பிள்ளையை அடைகிறாள். அந்த குழந்தையோ கடத்தப்படுகிறது. அருளால் வந்த பிள்ளை பொருளுக்காக கடத்தப்பட அது எப்படி திரும்ப கிடைக்கிறது என்பதுடன், பல அமானுஷ்ய சம்பவங்கள் மிகுந்த ஒரு புதினம் இது!

power-of-vote.title: పవర్ అఫ్ ఓట్
power-of-vote.description: అసలు ఓటు వెయ్యటం వల్ల ఉపయోగాలు ఏమిటి? ఓటు హక్కు ఖచ్చితం గా ఎందుకు వినియోగించు కోవాలి? దాని వల్ల లాభాలు ఏమిటి ... నష్టాలు ఏమిటి? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

how-to-find-a-perfect-match.title: How To Find A Perfect Match
how-to-find-a-perfect-match.description: Moner manusher khoj pawa khub e dushkor. Lalon phakir bole gechen je uni sara jibon khali moner manusher khoj kore gechen, ebong shei akhyep niye prithibi chharte hoyeche. Anekei khuje paan na nije der moner manush. Ki bhabe khuje paben nijer moner manush? Sothik songi khuje pete nijeder moner manush khuje paben? Ei audiobook ti shunle apni khub sohojei bujhe jabe thik ki bhabe nijer moner manusher khoj paben apnio.

the-death-an-inside-story-by-sadhguru-1.title: The Death - An Inside Story by Sadhguru
the-death-an-inside-story-by-sadhguru-1.description: Prapancham loni manushulandari alochanalalo maranam anedi oka chedu amsham.kaani manam deenni purthiga thappuga bhavisthunnamu. ee vishistamaina grandham vivaranalo, maranam gurinchi chaala arudugaa maatlade lothaina amshaala gurinchi sadguru vivaristhu thana anthargatha anubhavam pai visthruthanga charchinchaaru. Randi ee saaramshaanni vini manaku theliyani enno jeevanmarana rahasyalanu sadguru maatallo thelsukoni puneethalavudham.

0bf41eed-54b3-430c-a14d-7ab5ec4211ef.title: Sarojadevi
0bf41eed-54b3-430c-a14d-7ab5ec4211ef.description: கன்னடத்துப் பைங்கிளி என்று தமிழ் சினிமா ரசிகர்களால் கொண்டாடப்பட்ட சரோஜாதேவியின் வண்ணமயமான வாழ்க்கை. பரதக்கலை, வாய்ப்பாட்டு, மேடை நாடகம் என்பன போன்ற கூடுதல் முகவரிகள் ஏதுமில்லை. நடிப்பில் வழி காட்டுவதற்கு போதிய பின்புலமும் இல்லை.ஆனாலும், தென்னகத் திரையுலகின் உச்சாணிக் கொம்பைத் தொட்டவர் சரோஜாதேவி.

the-hidden-economy-of-crime.description: Aap sochte hain crime sirf police aur criminals ki kahani hai? Sochiye phir se. Drugs, betting apps, Jamtara scams, Dark Web, Hawala, Human Trafficking aur Gold Smuggling... ye sab alag-alag crimes nahi, balki ek hi underground economy ke parts hain. sweet.title: Sweet
sweet.description: My brother is both powerful and cruel which means I have a lot of enemies I've never met. He swears he'll keep me safe but what I want most is to break free. I especially want to break free with Drew my brother's lawyer. I've spent my life under glass. We shouldn't be together but everything about him draws me. His intensity his kindness. And the way he looks in those custom-tailored suits. One night when he's outside my bedroom I give him a sexy show. And in doing so unlock pandora box. Drew shows me everything I've been missing. He touches my body and my heart but when the truth comes to light we're both in danger. The cost of my freedom may be the man I've come to love.

moolika-vaidyam-tho-aarogyam.title: మూలికా వైద్యంతో ఆరోగ్యం
moolika-vaidyam-tho-aarogyam.description: ఈ పుస్తక రచయిత డాక్టర్‌ జి. లక్ష్మణరావు ఆస్ట్రేలియన్‌ నేషనల్‌ యూనివర్శిటీలో పిహెచ్‌.డి. చేశారు. ఆయన తన సహజ జిజ్ఞాసా మనస్తత్వం వల్ల, అనూహ్యంగా మూలికా వైద్యంలో ప్రవేశించారు. ఆయనకు ఒకసారి తీవ్రమైన చిగుళ్ల వ్యాధి వచ్చింది. ఒక దంతం పూర్తిగా కదిలిపోయింది. దంత వైద్యుడు దానిని పీకివేసి బ్రిడ్జికట్టక తప్పదని, ఒక వేళ పీకక పోయినా దానంతటదే ఊడి పోవడం తధ్యమని చెప్పారు. కానీ అందుకు ఆయన ఒప్పుకోక సహజ జిజ్ఞాసతో మూలికా వైద్యం వైపు మొగ్గు చూపారు. రోజుకు మూడు సార్లు జామ చిగురాకులు నములుతూ, ఆ రసాన్ని పుక్కిలిస్తూ పదిరోజుల్లోనే పూర్తిగా శాశ్వతంగా నయం చేసుకోగలిగారు. అదే ఆయన మూలికా వైద్యంలో ప్రవేశించడానికి నాంది అయింది. మూలికల ద్వారా చాల సులభంగా నయం చేసుకోగలిగే వ్యాధులకు కూడా మనం అల్లోపతి చికిత్స కోసం లక్షల్లో డబ్బు ఖర్చుపెడుతున్నాం. ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ లో సాధారణ జబ్బులతో పాటు తీవ్ర ఆరోగ్య సమస్యలను కూడా అతి తక్కువ ఖర్చుతో నయం చేసుకునే మార్గాలను సూచించడం జరిగింది. ఖచ్చితంగా ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ ని పూర్తిగా విని ఆరోగ్యాన్ని పెంచుకోండి, డబ్బు ని ఆదా చేసుకోండి.

women-of-prison.title: Women of Prison
women-of-prison.description: Zoe Callahan, a brilliant young lawyer, finds her world shattered when she's wrongfully convicted of murdering her father by her fiancé. Thrust into the brutal world of Ironcliffe Women's Correctional Facility, Zoe must navigate dangerous alliances, prison politics, corrupt guards, and her own traumatic past. As she struggles to survive her first day behind bars, a mysterious lockdown throws the prison into chaos. Now, Zoe must use her legal mind and newfound street smartness to uncover the truth behind her conviction, take revenge on her fiancé, and fight for her freedom in a place where innocence is a liability.

take-control-and-master-your-loan.title: Take Control and Master Your Loan
take-control-and-master-your-loan.description: "Take Control and Master Your Loan" is a game-changing audiobook that shatters financial myths and provides a clear roadmap for managing your money. In this eye-opening guide, the author dispels common misconceptions about finance that many Indians hold and equips listeners with practical tools to build a smart financial system. Designed specifically for the Indian context, this audiobook addresses the unique financial challenges faced by individuals in India. With a focus on empowering listeners to take charge of their financial well-being, it offers valuable insights into avoiding common financial mistakes that plague the majority of people in the country. Whether you're a beginner or seeking to improve your financial literacy, "Take Control and Master Your Loan" will equip you with the knowledge and confidence needed to navigate the complex world of personal finance and achieve financial freedom.

kanneerajja-matthu-ithare-kathegalu.description: ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವಾದ "ಕಣ್ಣೀರಜ್ಜ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಕಥೆಗಳು" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜೀವಂತ ಚಿತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಥೆಯೂ ನಮ್ಮ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ, ಪರಂಪರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಕುಳಿತಲ್ಲೇ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಸೊಗಸನ್ನು ಆಲಿಸಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಲು ಇದು ಒಂದು ಅದ್ಭುತ ಅವಕಾಶ. ಸರಳ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅರ್ಥಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಈ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಂದ ಹಿರಿಯರವರೆಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ರಂಜಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

Ini adhava pettu poyittundenkil enthanu purath kadakkan maargam. Ithellam innathe kalath arinjirikkendath athyavshyam aanu. Kooduthal ariyam Kuku FMinte ee showyilude.

পরিণীতা-।-লেখিকা--প্রকৃতি-কুণ্ডু.title: Parineeta
পরিণীতা-।-লেখিকা--প্রকৃতি-কুণ্ডু.description: Kriti Ebong Sidhur Bibaho Ki Sesh Obdhi Purnota Pabe? Biyer Por Kriti Sidhuke Ki Mene Nite Parbe Jibon Songi Hisebe Naki Tader Somporko Konodin Jora Lagbe Na? Jante Hole Shunun Ei Golpoti.

brief-answers-to-the-big-questions-2.title: Brief Answers To The Big Questions
brief-answers-to-the-big-questions-2.description: Socho agar ye universe hi na hota? Har din ke basic sawalon ke jawaab kaun banata? Kyun, kya, aur kaise ka ye silsila kabhi khatam hoga? Stephen Hawking ke iss architecture se bane brahmand ke raaz ko jaanne ke liye, ye audiobook zaroor suniye. Ismein science aur spirituality ka woh sangam hai, jo aapki soch badal kar rakh dega.

naanu-badava-naane-sukhi.title: Naanu Badava Naane Sukhi
naanu-badava-naane-sukhi.description: "ನಾನು ಬಡವ, ನಾನು ಸುಖಿ" ಜೋಗಿಯವರಿಂದ ರಚಿತವಾದ ಒಂದು ಆತ್ಮಕಥೆಯಾದ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ. ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಜೀವನದ ಗಂಭೀರ ಸತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಳುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕತೆ, ತೃಪ್ತಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಪುಟದ ಬದುಕನ್ನು ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಡತನವಲ್ಲದೇ, ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತೃಪ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಇರುವ ಮನಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಎತ್ತಿಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಬರಹಶೈಲಿ ಹಾಸ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣತೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆರೆಯುವ ಮೂಲಕ, ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಜೀವನದ ವಿವಿಧ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಆಳದಿಂದ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

apne-business-ko-brand-banaye.title: Apne Business Ko Brand Banaye
apne-business-ko-brand-banaye.description: Business toh har koi khol deta hai aur theek-thaak chala bhi leta hai. Magar business se brand tak ka safar kitne log tay kar paate hai? Bahut kam. Kya hai business se brand banne ke safar ka raaz? Aakhir kyun har business brand nahi ban pata hai? Aur kya iske liye kuch kiya ja sakta hai? Janenge is show mein. Agar aapko Gary Keller dwara likhi "The One Thing: The Surprisingly Simple Truth Behind Extraordinary Results" jaisi books pasand hain to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

creativity-inc-5.title: Byabshaye Creativity Manage Korar Tips
creativity-inc-5.description: Ei boi ti khali ekti jibon kahini noi ba khali golpo noi, ei boi ti aneker kache bible er moto pobitro. Nijer culture ke rich kore tola ebong sheta niye proud feel kora nijer business er jonnyo koto ta important shei shob ei boi ti apnader shekhabe. Edwin Catmull ei boi ti emon anek manual er jonmo diyechen jegulo pore ba shune apnara nijeder originality, identity theke inspired hote paren. Amra aj ke shune nebo animation, movies ar originality theke jonmo neowa bibhinno leading global ventures der somporke.

the-hidden-mahabali.title: The Hidden Mahabali
the-hidden-mahabali.description: தன் தங்கையை காப்பாற்றுவதற்காக, தனது உண்மையான அடையாளத்தையும் அசாத்தியமான வர்மக் கலைத் திறமையையும் மறைத்து பள்ளியில் கிளீனராக வாழ்கிறான் ரண்தீப். ஆனால் த்ரிஷா மகாபலி சாம்பியன்ஷிப்பில் களமிறங்கியதும், ரண்தீப்பின் கடந்த கால எதிரிகள் மீண்டும் வருகின்றனர். குடும்பத்தை அழிக்க நினைக்கும் சதியை எதிர்கொள்ள, தன் தாய்க்கு கொடுத்த சத்தியத்தை மீறி ரண்தீப் மீண்டும் களத்தில் இறங்க வேண்டிய கட்டாயம் ஏற்படுகிறது.

ego-vs-self-respect-1.title: Ego vs Self Respect
ego-vs-self-respect-1.description: మీ అహంకారం మీకు శత్రువు అవుతుందా? ఆత్మగౌరవానికి మరియు అహంకారానికి మధ్య ఉన్న తేడా ఏమిటో మీకు తెలుసా? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.!

lady-boss-returns-15.title: Lady Boss Returns
lady-boss-returns-15.description: Lady Boss Return explores love, betrayal, and revenge through the journey of Kiara Bhansali, a self-made billionaire who hides her identity to test loyalty and integrity — and ends up meeting Tej Jaisingh, an ambitious CEO caught between love and legacy. Their accidental meeting spirals into a whirlwind of mistaken identities, class clashes, fake marriages, and boardroom battles — until Kiara’s true power as the “Sky Queen” turns the game upside down.

vaadivasal.title: வாடிவாசல்
vaadivasal.description: ஜல்லிக்கட்டு ஒரு வீர நாடகம். அது விளையாட்டும் கூட. புய வலு, தொழில் நுட்பம், சாமர்த்தியம் எல்லாம் அதற்கு வேண்டும். மாட்டுக்கும் மனிதனுக்கும் நடக்கும் வீர விளையட்டைத் தத்ரூபமாக வெளிப்படுத்தும் நாவல் இது.

somalian-pirates.title: Somalian Pirates
somalian-pirates.description: Kadal kollaiyar nu sonnadhum namakku takkunu nyabagam varradhu Captain Jack Sparrow dhan. Cinema la mattum illa real life la kooda pirates irukaanga. Indha Originals la Somalian pirates ah pathiyum, avangala suthi nadakura political game pathiyum therinjuka kelunga “Somalian Pirates” on Kuku FM

ష్-ఎవరో-ఉన్నారు-.title: ష్.. ఎవరో ఉన్నారు
ష్-ఎవరో-ఉన్నారు-.description: గుబులు గుబులు మంటూ ఊపిరి పీల్చుకుంటూ, రైఫిళ్లు పట్టుకుని నిలబడిన వాళ్లు ఒక్కసారిగా కనుమరుగైపోతుంటారు... కనిపించని శత్రువు వాళ్లను మింగేస్తున్నాడు! చీకటి నుండి వచ్చే ఒక నీడ... అది ఎవరు? అది ఏమిటి? ఈ కథలో ప్రతి మలుపు కొత్త ఆశ్చర్యాన్ని కలిగిస్తుంది. మనం చూస్తున్న ప్రపంచం కంటే మరొకటి ఉందా? మీరు భయాన్ని ఎదుర్కొనేందుకు సిద్ధమేనా?

ಅಘೋರಿ.title: Aghori
ಅಘೋರಿ.description: ಅಘೋರಿ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಶೈವ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ಭಗವಂತ ಶಿವನ ಭೈರವ ರೂಪವನ್ನು ಪೂಜಿಸುವ ಆಘೋರಿ ಸನ್ನ್ಯಾಸಿಗಳ ಒಂದು ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಮಾರ್ಗವಾಗಿದೆ. ಅವರ ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ತತ್ತ್ವಗಳು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಸಮಾಜದಿಂದ ವಿಭಿನ್ನವಾಗಿವೆ.

sabari-the-warrior-goddess.title: Sabari- The Warrior Goddess
sabari-the-warrior-goddess.description: മലയാള നാട്ടിലെ ആദ്യ രാജവംശമായ ആയ് നാടിന്റെ രക്ഷക്കായ് വൈദേശികരോട് പട പൊരുതി നാടിന്റെ അയ്യനും അപ്പനും ആയി തീര്‍ന്ന ധീര വനിതയുടെ പറയപ്പെടാത്ത കഥ.  സര്‍വ്വൈശ്വര്യങ്ങള്‍ക്കും കാരണമായ ജീവന്റെ കല്ലിനായി ഒരു നാട് നടത്തിയ ഐതിഹാസിക പോരാട്ടത്തിന്റെ കഥ. ആയ് നാടിന്റെ  ജീവാത്മാവായ അയ്യപ്പന്റെ ഉത്ഭവ കഥ കേള്‍ക്കാം സിനിമാറ്റിക്ക് അനുഭവത്തോടെ.

crypto-for-beginners.title: Crypto for Beginners
crypto-for-beginners.description: Cryptocurrencies, Blockchain Technology, and Investment Strategies.

yuvanum-naanum.title: YUVANUM NAANUM
yuvanum-naanum.description: U1 - appadinna its an emotion. Appadi dhan avaroda isai feel panna vachurukku. eppadi patta emotion ah irundhaalum nammala deep ah travel panna vecuruvaaru ivaru. Ivaroda musical life, carrier ups and downs idha appadiye oru recap panna porom indha audio book moolama. So its time for Yuvanism.

bixkumbho.title: Bixkumbho
bixkumbho.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

reflections.title: Reflections
reflections.description: Swami vivekananda gari chetha rachinchabadina pusthakam Reflections indulo manam manishi jeevithaniki, spirituality ki sambandinchina enno aneka vishyala gurinchi ayina teliyachesaru. Thana philosophilu, thanu namme siddhanthala gurinchi inka prathi manishi paatinchalsina vishyala gurinchi kuda ayina indulo matladaru. meeru kuda ee vishyala gurinchi telusukovalante ventane ee audio book vinandi.

panchti-rahasya-upanyash-bishonno.title: Panchti Rahasya Upanyash - Bishonno
panchti-rahasya-upanyash-bishonno.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

living-the-8020-way.title: Living the 80/20 Way
living-the-8020-way.description: 80/20 ನಿಯಮ ಎಂಬುದು ಜೀವನದ ವಿವಿಧ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಬಳಸುವ ತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ನಿಯಮದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದ 20% ಭಾಗವೇ 80% ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಅರ್ಥಾತ್, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶ್ರಮವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದು. ಹಣಕಾಸು, ವೃತ್ತಿ, ವ್ಯವಹಾರ, ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಇದನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದರೆ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಯಶಸ್ಸು, ಸಮಯದ ಸದುಪಯೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂತೋಷ ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕೆಲಸಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಮನಹರಿಸಿ, ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ದುಡಿಯದೇ, ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದು ಮುಖ್ಯ. ಈ ತಂತ್ರವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿದವರು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಶ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹೀಗಾಗಿ, 80/20 ನಿಯಮ ಬಳಸಿ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಸರಳ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸಬಹುದು.

957a7190-8551-41ab-82ec-aeadcab8a29a.title: Alien opponent
957a7190-8551-41ab-82ec-aeadcab8a29a.description: The owner of a small-town junkyard offers a cash reward to whomever can kill her uninvited, space-suited alien guest when its spacecraft crash-lands into her barn. Every wacko within 100 miles turns out, and before long, the junkyard is transformed into a war zone of man vs. man vs. machine vs. alien vs. God only knows what.

watan-ke-naam-usha-mehta.title: Watan Ke Naam: Usha Mehta
watan-ke-naam-usha-mehta.description: Film ‘Ae Watan Mere Watan’ mein Sara Ali Khan ne Usha Mehta ka character play kiya hai. Par kaun thi Usha Mehta? Aur kyon unki awaz se darti thi angrezi sarkar? Unke revolutionary secret radio ki kahani, aaiye sunte hain is show mein.

budget-like-a-pro.title: Budget Like a Pro
budget-like-a-pro.description: బడ్జెటింగ్  ఒక నైపుణ్యం. మీరు దానిపై ఎలా పని చేయాలి?  మీ ఆర్థిక జీవితాన్ని మెరుగు పరచడానికి దాన్ని ఎలా ఉపయోగించాలి? మీరు మీ ఆర్థిక లక్ష్యాలను సాధించడానికి మీకు సహాయపడే నిర్ణయాలు ఎలా తీసుకోవాలి? విని తెలుసుకోండి.

powerful-and-greatest-women-in-indian-hi.title: Powerful And Greatest Women In Indian History
powerful-and-greatest-women-in-indian-hi.description: Indian charithrathil udaneelam sthreekal adichamarthapedukayum dhurupayogam cheyyapedukayum cheythitund. Ennirunalum, avar ella prathibhandhangalkkum ethirayi poradi, purushadhipathya chinthagathikalk ethire poradi, nammude lokathinte purogathikku vendi orupad sthreekal nirnayaka panku vahichitund. Indian chartihrathile ettavum sthaktharaya chila sthreekale kurich ariyam ee showiloode.

spoken-english-made-easy-2.title: Spoken English Made Easy
spoken-english-made-easy-2.description: English samsarikkan ariyathathinte allenkil English fluent allathathinte peril budhimutt anubhavikkukayum parihasikkappedukayum cheythittulla niravadhi per namuk chuttum und. Keralathil janichittulla ethoru sadharanakkaranum jeevithathinte ethenkilum oru ghattathil English oru balikeramalayayi thonniyittundavum. Ennal anganeyalla ennu ee Audio show kettu kazhiyumbol ningalk manasilavum.

karthik-is-back.title: Karthik Is Back
karthik-is-back.description:
లండన్ బిజినెస్ మ్యాన్‌గా మొదలై, హైదరాబాద్ పిజ్జా డెలివరీ బాయ్‌గా మారిన కార్తీక్ ప్రయాణం ఓ మిషన్‌కు సాక్ష్యం.
తన కుటుంబానికి జరిగిన అన్యాయానికి న్యాయం చేయడానికి,   అజ్ఞాతంగా శత్రువులపై ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోడానికి  కార్తీక్ తిరిగి వచ్చాడు.
కానీ ప్రేమ చిగురించిన గుండెల్లో పగ నిలుస్తుందా?
ఇది న్యాయం కోసం, నిజం కోసం, ఓ వ్యక్తి చేపట్టిన ప్రయాణం.

rana-sanga.title: Rana Sanga
rana-sanga.description: Early 16th century mein Mewar ko North India ka sabse powerful state banane wale Maharana Sanga ne Babur ko Delhi par attack karne ke liye invite to kar liya, par kya hua jab usi Babur aur Mughal army ka saamna unhe khud karna pada? Kaise apna hath khone ke baad bhi Maharana Sangram Singh ne na sirf apna rajya sambhala, balki badi ladaiyan bhi jeeti? Rana Sanga ki veerta bhari kahani, aaiye sunte hain is khas peshkash mein.

pranayamazha-kudaykkullil.title: പ്രണയമഴ കുടയ്ക്കുള്ളില്‍
pranayamazha-kudaykkullil.description: കഥ കേള്‍ക്കാനിഷ്ടമാണോ നിങ്ങള്‍ക്ക്. പറഞ്ഞാല്‍ തീരാത്ത കഥകളും ജീവിതങ്ങളും നമുക്ക് ചുറ്റുമുണ്ട്. അത്തരം ചില കഥകളെ എല്ലാ ഊഷ്മതകളോടെയും കണ്ടെടുക്കുകയാണ് സുധാകരന്‍ പുതുക്കുളങ്ങര പ്രണയമഴ കുടയ്ക്കുള്ളില്‍ എന്ന നോവലിലൂടെ. നാട്ടിലെ വയല്‍ വരമ്പിലൂടെയും ഇടവഴിയിലൂടെയും നടന്നു പോകുമ്പോള്‍ തോന്നുന്ന തോന്നലുകള്‍ പോലെയുള്ള കഥകള്‍. അതില്‍ സന്തോഷവും വ്യഥകളും അസ്വസ്ഥതകളുമുണ്ട്. ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വിഭിന്ന ഭാവങ്ങളെയും തൊട്ടുപോകുന്ന ജീവിതഗന്ധിയായ കഥകള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

nlp-dwara-unlimited-success-3.description: NLP-  Ek Scientific Proven Formula jiske madhyam se aap apni Life ko completely Transform kar sakte hai. Ye Apki Health ko, Personal and Professional Life me Balance ke liye, Relationship aur Life ke har ek Area ko jise aap Improve karna chahte hai Aapki Madad kar sakta hai. Ye AudioBook aapko apni sari problems khud kaise handle karna hai bina kisi or par depended hue bahut achce se sikhayegi. Life mein aap NLP ka Use karke Unlimited Success Achieve kar sakte hai.

pregnant-with-the-devils-child.title: Pregnant with the Devil’s Child
pregnant-with-the-devils-child.description: Her husband gave her family’s cursed bloodstones to his mistress. At Manhattan’s glittering diamond auction, master gemcutter Clara Mercer makes him pay, unleashing a power that shatters more than glass. Then she discovers the masked stranger who fathered her child is Lucian Vance, billionaire tycoon and the Devil himself. Now ancient demons want her unborn son dead. Clara’s only way to save him? Claim the throne of Hell.

zidd.title: Zidd
zidd.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

garuda-puran-death-ke-baad-ki-duniya.title: Garuda Puran: Death Ke Baad Ki Duniya
garuda-puran-death-ke-baad-ki-duniya.description: What happens after death? Can the soul see its loved ones? Does every person's karma face judgment before Yamraj and Chitragupt? According to the Garuda Purana, death begins a journey through the first 13 days, Yamlok, the Vaitarani River, terrifying punishments, 84 lakh forms of rebirth and eventually another life. But beneath these frightening descriptions lies a deeper question: is death really the end—or simply the beginning of another journey?

teen-machine.title: Teen machine
teen-machine.description: స్మార్ట్ కిడ్'గా ఉండాలని, తన తండ్రి అంచనాలకు అనుగుణంగా జీవించాలని నిశ్చయించుకున్న అవని అనే అమ్మాయి కథే మన ఈ ఆడియో బుక్. స్మార్ట్ కిడ్ అవ్వాలనే తన కల నెరవేరుతుందా ? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

ronaldo.title: Ronaldo
ronaldo.description: రోనాల్డో తన జీవితంలో ఎదుర్కొన్న ఆటుపోట్లు ఎటువంటివి? ప్రపంచం మెచ్చే ఫూట్ బాల్ ఆటగాడిగా ఎలా ఎదిగాడు? ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

pitch-anything-7.title: Sikhun Sothik Somoye Sothik Kaj Korar Secret
pitch-anything-7.description: Ei Audiobook Ekti Guide, Ja Aapnake Top Notch Quality Pitches Er Bapare Bistarito Sekhabe, Ja Aapnar Biniyogke Nishchit Korbe. Asun Shune Neyoya Jak .

nannappa-superstar.title: Nannappa Superstar
nannappa-superstar.description: ನ್ಯಾಯವಾದ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಷ್ಟ ಪಟ್ಟು ದುಡಿದು ತನ್ನ ಮಗಳು ಮೀರಾಳನ್ನ ಬೆಳೆಸ್ತಿರೋ ಆರ್ಯ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಿಂಗಲ್‌ ಫಾದರ್. ಬಡತನದಲ್ಲೇ ಇದ್ರೂ ಮಗಳನ್ನ ಮಾತ್ರ ರಾಣಿ ಹಾಗೆ ನೋಡ್ಕೋಳ್ತಾ ಇರೋ ಆರ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಮಗಳೇ ಸರ್ವಸ್ವ. ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಟಿತ ಅಂತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಶಾಲೆಯೊಂದ್ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮಗಳನ್ನ ಓದಿಸ್ತಿರೋ ಆರ್ಯ, ಸ್ಕೂಲ್‌ ಫೀಸ್‌ಗಾಗಿ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಕೆಲಸಗಳನ್ನ ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ನಡೀತಿರೋ ಅಪ್ಪ-ಮಗಳ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಗನ್ನಾಥ್‌ ರೆಡ್ಡಿ ಅನ್ನೋ ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿ ಕ್ರಿಮಿನಲ್‌ ಕಂಟಕವಾಗಿ ಬರ್ತಾನೆ! ಮಗಳ ಜೀವಕ್ಕೆ ಅಪಾಯವಿದೆ ಅನ್ನೋ ಮುನ್ಸೂಚನೆ ಸಿಗ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಆರ್ಯ ಇಷ್ಟು ದಿನ ಮುಚ್ಚಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದ ತನ್ನ ನಿಜಸ್ವರೂಪಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ! ಆರ್ಯನ ಪವರ್‌ಫುಲ್‌ ಪಾಸ್ಟ್‌ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಆತನಿಗಿರೋ ರಹಸ್ಯವಾದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಯಾವುದು? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವೀರೇಳಿಸುವ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಫ್ಯಾಮಿಲಿ ಡ್ರಾಮಾ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ನನ್ನಪ್ಪ Superstar" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

karz-mein-qaidishq-mein-azad.title: Karz Mein Qaid,Ishq  Mein Azad
karz-mein-qaidishq-mein-azad.description: When her father sells her to settle a ₹5-crore debt, Ananya Sharma is imprisoned in the haveli of ruthless sugar baron Samar Gurjar, whose brother died in a scam orchestrated by her father. But Ananya’s intelligence soon becomes Samar’s greatest weapon, turning hatred into dangerous desire. With a rival cartel hunting them and betrayal closing in, Samar must choose: avenge his brother or risk his empire for the daughter of the man who destroyed his family.

invisible-man.title: Invisible man
invisible-man.description: Ek galat experiment ne Avyukt ko invisible kar diya tha. Wapas visible hone ke liye wo Melanocyte ki khoj mein criminals ko maut ke ghaat utaar raha hai. Par Dr. Malik ko bhi invisibility ka formula chahiye aur wo ise pane ke liye kisi bhi had tak ja sakta hai. Kya Avyukt invisibility ko apni takat mein badal payega? Kaise rokega Avyukt Dr. Malik ko? Janne ke liye sunein Invisible Man...

upi-jaliyati-theke-bachben-kibhabe.title: UPI Jaliyati Theke Banchben Kibhabe?
upi-jaliyati-theke-bachben-kibhabe.description: Apnio ki amader moto UPI payment korte sochhondyo bodh koren? Kono kichu kinle cash taka dewar bodole apnio ki online payment koren ba UPI payment koren? UPI ba online payment korte ekhonkar generation joto ta socchondyo bodh kore thik tototai bhoy ba itostoto bodh koren ektu boyoshjestho manushera. Hai anekei bhoy paan jodi kichu bhul kore taka chole jaye? Anekei amra UPI jaliyati ke bhoy payi karon taka sokoleri khatnir phol, ar keu e chaibo na amader unawareness er jonno kono jaliyati hok amader songe. Tai kibhabe arki ki poddhoti te khub sohojei UPI jaliyati theke banchben jante shune nin ei audio story ti.

naajayaz-mohabbat.title: Naajayaz Mohabbat
naajayaz-mohabbat.description: After losing her husband, Naina is forced back into the mansion that once threw her out, where her late husband's elder brother, Vivaan, becomes her biggest support. But what begins as responsibility slowly turns into a love he has secretly buried for years. As old conspiracies, family betrayals, and dangerous enemies threaten to destroy them, Naina must uncover the truth behind her husband's death and decide whether to trust the man who has loved her in silence all along—or lose him forever.

hareyada-makkalanna-poshisuvudondu-kale.title: Hareyada Makkalanna Poshisuvudondu Kale
hareyada-makkalanna-poshisuvudondu-kale.description: ಹರೆಯದ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಪೋಷಿಸುವುದೊಂದು ಕಲೆ ಎಂಬ ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಪೋಷಣೆಯ ಅರ್ಥಗರ್ಭಿತ ಹಾದಿಯನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಪೋಷಕರಿಗೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮನೋವಿಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಮತ್ತು ಅವರನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಲು ನೆರವಾಗುವ ಹಾದಿ ಹೊಳೆಯುವ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಂತೆ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

thus-spoke-zarathustra-3.description: Friedrich Nietzsche வோட Thus Spoke Zarathustra  இந்த  வாழ்க்கை, நம்ம சமூகம், நம்பிக்கை, கடவுள்.. னு எல்லாத்தையும் கேள்வி கேட்குது. இதுல Nietzsche சொல்லி இருக்குற கருத்துகள் ரொம்பவே புரட்சிகரமானவை. வாங்க இந்த Kuku Byte மூலமா இந்த புத்தகத்துல என்ன இருக்குனு கேட்டுத் தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம் 🔊📖🚶‍♂️.

the-hidden-ceo.title: The Hidden CEO
the-hidden-ceo.description: Ryan- A billionaire heir, drugged and manipulated by his stepmother, unknowingly commits a crime against an innocent woman. In a quest for redemption, he reinvents himself as a decorated Marine but mistakenly tries to atone for the crime with the wrong woman. Upon returning to Houston's High Society, he discovers the true victim of his past and must navigate a complex web of corporate intrigue, family manipulation, and personal redemption to win her trust and love.

climate-change-a-bigger-problem-1.title: Climate Change - A Bigger Problem
climate-change-a-bigger-problem-1.description: 2021 mein humare atmosphere mein carbon dioxide ki matra sabse zyada payi gayi. 2010-2020 ka dashak pichle 1,25.000 saalon mein sabse garam raha. Hum 1.2 trillion baraf har saal kho rahe hai. Dhire Dhire humne humare unwanted desires ke karan earth ko bahut hu nuksan pahuchaya jisse ab pichhe jana mushkil hai. Isse bachne ke liye ab kya kiya jaye ? Kya koi rasta hai bhi ya nahi ? Jante hai iss audiobook mein

mahasamar-5-antaral.title: Mahasamar 5: Antaral
mahasamar-5-antaral.description: After losing everything in the game of dice, the Pandavas go into exile. But Kunti, who stood by them through every crisis, doesn’t follow them this time. She goes to neither Dwarka nor Bhojpur, and stays at Vidura’s house in Hastinapur instead. Why? Antaral, the fifth book of Narendra Kohli’s Mahasamar, tells the story of the Pandavas’ exile and answers questions like this one with careful reasoning.

prajala-manishi.title: Prajala Manishi
prajala-manishi.description: తెలంగాణ తొలి నవల 'ప్రజల మనిషి' — వట్టికోట ఆళ్వారుస్వామి రచన. నిజాం పాలనలో తెలంగాణ గ్రామీణ జీవితాన్ని కళ్ళకు కట్టినట్టు చూపిన ఈ నవల, నిజామాబాద్ జిల్లా దిమ్మెగూడెం పల్లెలో జరుగుతుంది. దొర రాంభూపాల్ రావు దౌర్జన్యానికి నిస్సహాయంగా నలిగిపోయే రైతుల జీవితాలు మనసును తాకుతాయి. చరిత్రను సజీవంగా చెప్పిన అద్భుతమైన రచన.

aapan-tyanchyasaman-vhave-mahatma-jyotib.title: Aapan Tyanchyasaman Vhave - Mahatma Jyotiba Fule
aapan-tyanchyasaman-vhave-mahatma-jyotib.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

parenting-in-the-age-of-sexposure.title: Parenting In The Age of Sexposure
parenting-in-the-age-of-sexposure.description: Balyathil ninnu kawmaraprayathilekkulla maattathinte sankeernamaya khattathil kuttikale pinthunakkunathinum vazhikaattuthinumulla praayogikavum sahaanubhoothipoornamaya upadeshangal nalkunna oru audiobookanu Parenting In The Age of Sexposure, by Dr. Vandita Dubey.

as-a-man-thinket.title: As a Man Thinketh
as-a-man-thinket.description: Aapke actions aapke thoughts ka parinaam hai. Aap jaise apni duniya banaate hai waise hi aapko duniya banaati hai. Thoughts aapko young rakh sakte hai ya aapko jaldi se budha bhi bana skate hai. Agar aapko apni life ko master karna hai toh aapko power of thoughts ko samajhna bohot jaroori hai. Issi Power of thoughts ko aaiye seekhte hai iss audiobook mein

12-money-saving-schemes-of-indian-govern.title: 12 Money Saving Schemes of Indian Government
12-money-saving-schemes-of-indian-govern.description: ಭಾರತದ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ನಾಗರಿಕನಿಗೂ ಆರಾಮದಾಯಕ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸುವ ಅವಕಾಶವನ್ನ ಆಯಾ ಕಾಲದ ಸರಕಾರಗಳು ಒದಗಿಸಿ ಕೊಡಬೇಕು. ಈಗಷ್ಟೇ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಮಗುವಿನಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ವೃದ್ಧಾಪ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಹಿರಿಯ ನಾಗರಿಕರಿಗೆ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸೋಕೆ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸುಭದ್ರತೆ ಇರೋದು ಅತ್ಯಗತ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ನಿಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರವು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಅನುಕೂಲವಾಗುವಂತೆ ಹಲವಾರು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳನ್ನ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಯಾವ ಸ್ಕೀಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಹಣ ಠೇವಣಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು? ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಾಲ ಠೇವಣಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು? ಸೂಕ್ತ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಹಾಗೂ ಜಾಣ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಈ ಸ್ಕೀಮ್‌ಗಳನ್ನ ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಹೇಗೆ ಫಲಾನುಭವಿಯಾಗೋದು? - ಹೀಗೆ ಹತ್ತು ಹಲವು ಯೋಜನೆಗಳ ಕುರಿತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನ ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "12 Money Saving Schemes of Indian Government" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

think-beyond-fds-investment-strategy.title: Think Beyond FDs - Investment Strategy
think-beyond-fds-investment-strategy.description: Fixed deposit ke alava ese aur kaon se tarike hain jisse hum invest kar sakte hain? Kya sone mein invest karne sahi hai? Bitcoin kya hota hai? Janenge ek nayi investment strategy iss audiobook mein! Agar aapko "Coffee Can Investing: The Low Risk Road To Stupendous Wealth" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook  zaroor sunein.

majha-dhangarwada.title: Majha Dhangarwada
majha-dhangarwada.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination.
