indias-biggest-scams-explained.title: India’s Biggest Scams Explained
indias-biggest-scams-explained.description: How did one broker shake India's financial system? How did thousands of crores disappear from a bank? And how did a company report money that never existed? India's Biggest Scams Explained takes you inside India's biggest financial frauds—from Harshad Mehta and Nirav Modi to Satyam and beyond. These aren't just crime stories; they're gripping tales of money, power, greed and the loopholes that changed India forever.

bhoomiyude-avakashikal.title: ഭൂമിയുടെ അവകാശികള്‍
bhoomiyude-avakashikal.description: വൈക്കം മുഹമ്മദ് ബഷീറിന്റെ പ്രശസ്തമായ കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരം. പ്രണയവും വിരഹവും പ്രകൃതിയും ഇഴചേരുന്ന വശ്യസുന്ദരമായ വാക്കുകൾ.

bali.title: Bali
bali.description: "ಬಲಿ" ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ 1980 ರಲ್ಲಿ "ಹಿಟ್ಟಿನ ಹುಂಜ" ಎಂಬ ಹೆಸರಿನಿಂದ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರಕಟವಾಯಿತು. ಇದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕನ್ನಡ ಮಹಾಕಾವ್ಯವಾದ ಯಶೋಧರ ಚರಿತ್ರೆಯಿಂದ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ನಾಟಕವು ಪುರಾತನ ಮಹಾಕಾವ್ಯವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದ್ದರೂ, ಇದು ಹಲವು ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಹಿಂದಿನಂತೆಯೇ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತವಾದ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನಾಟಕದ ಕಥಾವಸ್ತುವು ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪಾತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ-ರಾಜ, ರಾಣಿ, ಮಹಾರಾಣಿ (ರಾಜನ ತಾಯಿ), ಮಾವುತ. ಹಿಂದೂ ಧರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಜೈನ ಧರ್ಮ ಎಂಬ ಎರಡು ಧರ್ಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಎರಡು ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತಗಳಾದ ಹಿಂಸೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಹಿಂಸೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಮುಖಾಮುಖಿಯನ್ನು ನಾಟಕದ ಮೂಲಕ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತಪಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

detective-ajay-hum-hatyare-nahi.description: Raat ke andhere mein ek khatarnaak iraada, suniye kaise Detective Ajay suljhayega is baar gayab Sanjana ki murder mystery ?

the-audio-message.description: A software engineer's life is turned upside down when he starts receiving WhatsApp voice messages from his own number—sent from the future. As every prediction comes true, he must race against time to change destiny before the next message seals the fate of everyone he loves.

budget-2025-investment-kahan-karein.title: Budget 2025 - Investment Kahan Karein?
budget-2025-investment-kahan-karein.description: Mutual funds ya FD? Budget ke naye rules ke baad best investment kya hai?

how-propaganda-works.title: How Propaganda Works
how-propaganda-works.description: What if your opinions aren't entirely your own? What if a headline, a reel, a repeated slogan, or an emotional story has been quietly shaping the way you think? How Propaganda Works takes you inside the hidden machinery of influence—from governments and media to wars, elections and social media algorithms. Through shocking real-world cases and psychological insights, this series reveals how narratives are engineered to shape emotions, manufacture public opinion and influence human behaviour. Once you understand propaganda, you'll never consume information the same way again.

e6046e7d-3c9c-4d47-9d95-2618ed783c79.title: Love - Sex - Drug
e6046e7d-3c9c-4d47-9d95-2618ed783c79.description: A complex thriller that follows Detective Deepali investigating the mysterious death of Hanithra, who was found dead in actor Viyan's office. As she digs deeper, she uncovers a web of betrayal, drug trafficking, and dangerous criminal enterprises.

vaanprasth.description: Vaanprasth, Sangharsh bhari jindagi me apni bhavnao ko duniya se chhipaati kuch bhavuk kahaniya.

suswadu-khabar-bananor-secret.title: Suswadu Khabar Bananor Secret
suswadu-khabar-bananor-secret.description: Eta Kokhono Vebe Dekhechen Aapnar Ma Barite Rannar Somoy Torkarite Chini Ba Noon Keno Dey? Aabar Dhorun Mangso Ranna Korbar Aagey Keno Holud Makhiye Rakhen? Kivabe Ektu Noon Khabarer Swad Bodle Dey? Aasole Ranna Kora Byparta Holo Ekta Chemical Reaction, Eta Na Bujhle Khabar Hoyto Baniye Felte Parben Kintu Swad Aashbe Na. Ki Chintay Pore Gelen? Vabchen Tahole Ekhn Upay Ki? Aar Chinta Nei Aapnar Sob Chinta Dur Korte Ebong Suswadu Ranna Korar Secret Bolte Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audiobook, Ja Aapnar Sob Chinta Dur Kore Debe. Tai Aar Deri Na Kore Ekkhuni Shune Nin.

naglok.title: Naglok
naglok.description: This is the story of Taksh, whose life changes forever when he discovers that he is the son of the last Naga Emperor. After the death of his mother, Taksh arrives in the underground labyrinth called Nagalok, where he is destined to claim his father's throne. But will the politics, conspiracies, and power struggles of 'Nagalok' allow him to survive? Can Taksh become the most powerful warrior in the realm of serpents? And will he uncover the truth behind his mother's murder? Join him on this thrilling adventure and experience the extraordinary saga of the shape-shifting serpents in this fascinating world of Ichchhadhari Nagas!

shivay-brahmand-ka-yoddha.title: Shivay: Brahmand Ka Yoddha
shivay-brahmand-ka-yoddha.description: Kamzor lagne wala Shivaay ek unexplored planet ki ek prestigious academy mein admission paata hai, jahan use apni rare bloodline aur shaktiyon ka pata chalta hai. "Tower of Opportunity" mein apne doston ke saath, wo khatarnaak secrets aur fir se zinda hue Pishach Raaj ka saamna karta hai. Kya Shivaay apne planet ko bacha payega aur ban payega agla Yoddha? Suniye is romanchak series me.

manusmirti-1.title: Manusmriti : 1
manusmirti-1.description: Manusmriti ko Social media ki reels se nhin poora sunkar samjhiye.Iska gyan jeewan badalne ke sath-sath ise sudhar bhi deta hai aur dikhata hai success pane ki nayi raah. Abhi suniye aur baniye Hindu Dharma ke gyani.

7-cheat-codes-to-get-ahead-in-life.description: Zindagi mein success paane ke 7 asaan aur powerful cheat codes, jo badal denge aapki duniya! Jaaniye kaise.

holy-bible.title: Holy Bible
holy-bible.description: ബൈബിൾ വെറും ഒരു പുസ്തകമല്ല; അത് ജീവന്റെ വചനമാണ്. അതിന്റെ ഓരോ വാക്കിലും നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തെ രൂപപ്പെടുത്താനും നിങ്ങളുടെ വിധിയെ മാറ്റാനുമുള്ള ശക്തിയുണ്ട്.  ഏതു മതത്തിൽപെട്ടവർക്കും ഇന്നത്തെ നമ്മുടെ ജീവിതത്തിലെ പ്രശ്നങ്ങളെ മറികടക്കാൻ വിശുദ്ധമായ ഈ വചനങ്ങൾ കേട്ടാൽ മാത്രം മതി.

fight-right.title: Fight Right
fight-right.description:
"Fight Right" ಪುಸ್ತಕವು, ಸಂವಾದ ಮತ್ತು ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಿಸುವ ಕಲೆಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ, ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಘರ್ಷಣೆ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯ. ಆದರೆ, ಅದನ್ನು ಸರಿಯಾದ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದು ಯಶಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಂತಿಗೆ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಸಮರ್ಥ ವಾದ, ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ, ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾದ ಸಂವಹನ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಕಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಹಜವಾಗಿ ನಮ್ಮಲ್ಲಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಹೋರಾಟವನ್ನು ಗೆಲ್ಲುವ ಬದಲು ಅದನ್ನು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸೂಕ್ತ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಎಂಬ ಸಂದೇಶವನ್ನು ಇದು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗತ ಮತ್ತು ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಉತ್ತಮಗೊಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಈ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ಅತ್ಯಗತ್ಯ!
ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ತಂತ್ರಬದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಎದುರಿಸಿ!

mahacharithamala-muhammad-nabi.title: മഹച്ചരിതമാല - മുഹമ്മദ് നബി
mahacharithamala-muhammad-nabi.description: മുഹമ്മദ് നബിയുടെ ജീവിത കഥ അടങ്ങിയ മഹചരിതമാല. ലോകാനുഗ്രഹിയായ നബി തിരുമേനിയുടെ ജീവിതവും കർമ്മവും സന്ദേശങ്ങളും സമഗ്രമായി വിവരിക്കുന്ന ഗ്രന്ഥം.

telepsychics.title: Telepsychics
telepsychics.description: Socho agar aap apne dimag se kuch pal baat kar payein, aur isse apni zindagi ke aadhe se zyada challenges ko pal bhar mein suljha bhi lein. Mushkil lagta hai na? Par Joseph Murphy ki 'Telepsychics' ke saath, ye sab mumkin hai. Dive in and transform your life now.

criminal-cases-that-shook-india.title: Criminal Cases That Shook India
criminal-cases-that-shook-india.description: ఈ ఆడియో షోలో భారతదేశ చరిత్రలో అత్యంత ప్రబలమైన, సంచలనం సృష్టించిన క్రిమినల్ కేసుల కథనాలను మీకు అందించబడుతుంది. నిజ జీవిత ఘటనలు, దర్యాప్తు పద్ధతులు, న్యాయ ప్రక్రియలు, మరియు వీటి వెనుక ఉన్న సత్యాలను ఆసక్తికరంగా, వివరంగా వినిపించేందుకు ఇది రూపొందించబడింది. ప్రతి ఎపిసోడ్‌ మీకు రహస్యాలను అన్వేషించడానికి, కేసుల వెనుక ఉన్న చీకటి కోణాలను అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి ఒక కొత్త దారి చూపుతుంది.

kaattula-mazhai.title: காட்டுல மழை
kaattula-mazhai.description: வேலைக்குப் போகாமல் ஊரைச் சுற்றிக் கொண்டிருக்கும் சீனுவை அவன் குடும்ப நண்பர் ஒருவர் ஜே.பி எனும் ரியல் எஸ்டேட் முதலாளி ஒருவரிடம் சேர்த்து விடுகிறார். மிகவும் விசித்திரமான குணங்களைக் கொண்ட பணக்காரர் ஜே.பியிடம் வேலைக்கு சேர்ந்து, அவர் பெண் விஜியின் மனதிலும் இடம் பிடிக்கிறான் சீனு. அதன் பின் நிகழும் பலவிதமான குழப்பங்களை சீனு கண்டுபிடிக்கிறான். ஜே.பியின் உண்மை முகத்தை வெளிக்கொண்டு வர முயல்கிறான். கலகலப்பான இந்த நாடகத்தை உங்கள் குக்கூ எப்.எம்.ல் கேளுங்கள்....

khoon-ka-pyasa-1.title: खून का प्यासा
khoon-ka-pyasa-1.description: Delhi Jaise Seher mei ek ke badh ek Ladkiyoo ka katal ho raha hei, Katal Karne ki tarika bilkul Alag hei, Ladkiyo ki Gardaan Kaatkar unke Sarir se saara Khoon Nikal kar Unki Body kon Safed Karke Katil Jungle mei Patak Deta hei. Police Investigation kar rahi hei lekin koi Surag nahi mil raha hei. Kya Hei inn Khoon ka Raaz? Jaane ke liye Suniye ' Khoon Ka pyasa'

जुर्म-ओर-साजिश-.title: Jurm or Saazish
जुर्म-ओर-साजिश-.description: क्या हो अगर रात में किसी आदमी की प्रेमिका उसे अपने घर बुलाए और रास्ते में ही मिल जाए उसे एक खून से लथपथ लडकी जो उससे टकराकर मर जाती है। यह कहानी है एक महेश नाम के आदमीं की जो साजिशों का शिकार हो जाता हैं। पुलिस भी उसे गुनाहगार मानती है, हालातों को समझते और देखते हुए उसका एक चचेरा भाई रोहित और इंस्पेक्टर राजवीर उसकी मदद करते है। क्या महेश ही है असली गुनहगार या है कोई और अनजान दुश्मन? क्या हुआ उसकी प्रेमिका का? क्या है वो ज़िंदा? जानने के लिए सुने साज़िशों के ताने बाने से बुनी हुई यह कहानी जुर्म और साज़िश।

the-leader-in-you-5.title: The Leader In You
the-leader-in-you-5.description: 🌟ஒரு சிறந்த தலைவனா மாற,  நீங்க செய்ய வேண்டிய விசயங்கள எடுத்துக்காட்டுகளோட எடுத்து சொல்லுது இந்த  Audiobook 🔊🎧. வாங்க நமக்குள்ள இருக்குற தலைவன தட்டி எழுப்பலாம் 🚀.

ghar-baithe-lakho-top-5-high-income-jobs.title: Ghar Baithe Lakho - Top 5 High Income Jobs
ghar-baithe-lakho-top-5-high-income-jobs.description: Ghar Baithe Lakho - Top 5 High Income Jobs

the-art-of-speaking.title: The Art Of Speaking
the-art-of-speaking.description: The Art of Speaking is a practical masterclass on turning your voice into influence. Through real-life scenarios, psychology-backed insights, and simple frameworks, this series teaches you how to speak with confidence, structure your thoughts, use pauses effectively, tell memorable stories, and persuade without sounding pushy. From meetings to everyday conversations, you'll learn how to make every word carry weight and become someone people naturally listen to

aarush.title: Aarush
aarush.description: When Sanjana Sachdeva brings the mysterious Aarush into her life, a series of brutal incidents begins to unfold around them. As Inspector Avinash investigates, he discovers disturbing secrets from Aarush’s past that force Sanjana to question whether the child she is trying to protect is actually the key to a deadly mystery.

chhota-boss.title: Chhota Boss
chhota-boss.description: When a tyrannical, 6'4" corporate executive is shrunk to just a few inches by a cursed potion, he must survive the life-threatening hazards of his own home and confront his past.

ಅದೃಷ್ಟ-ರತ್ನ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.title: Adrushta Rathna Rahasya
ಅದೃಷ್ಟ-ರತ್ನ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.description: ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷ್ಯ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ರಾಶಿಯು ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಅದೃಷ್ಟ ರತ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿವೆ. ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಕ್ರಮ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಧರಿಸಿದರೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು ಕೈಗೂಡೋದು ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ..! ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ ಬೇಕಾಬಿಟ್ಟಿ ಧರಿಸಿದರೂ ಅಪಾಯ ಕಟ್ಟಿಟ್ಟ ಬುತ್ತಿ..! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ಹರಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಧರಿಸುವ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಯಾವುದು? ಯಾವ ರಾಶಿಗೆ ಯಾವ ರತ್ನ ಅದೃಷ್ಟ ತಂದು ಕೊಡುತ್ತೆ? ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಧರಿಸಬೇಕು? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಚಾರಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ 'ಅದೃಷ್ಟ ರತ್ನ ರಹಸ್ಯ'ದಲ್ಲಿದೆ, ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ..!

the-maamluk-dynesty.title: The Mamluk Dynasty
the-maamluk-dynesty.description: Bharat ke Hindustaan banne ke is safar mein bharat ko kai jung se guzarna pada. Alag deshon ke rajao ne kabhi bharat par akraman kiya to kabhi bharat par raj. Aise hi ek daur tha Mamluk Rajvansh ka jab bharat par ghulamo ki hukumat thi. Woh daur kaisa tha? Iss rajvansh mein kaun-kaun rulers rahe hain? Kaise yeh raajvansh aaj bharat ke itihas ke panno mein darz hai? Aur kaise is dynasty ka the end hua? Yeh sab kuch jaanege hum is Original Series “ The Mamluk Dynasty” mein.

d5c84946-57f4-4c98-a562-01575649c326.title: Karma Calling Karma
d5c84946-57f4-4c98-a562-01575649c326.description:
Aryan is a good man in a world that keeps punishing him for it. He stops for strangers, chooses family over deals, and helps everyone — and loses something every single time.

But the old man he rescued on the highway had blessed him — Salasar Balaji tujhe khush rakhe — and that blessing refuses to fade.

This is a story of Aryan — a man who kept losing, and Balaji who was quietly keeping score.

khaata-rahe-mera-dil.title: Khaata Rahe Mera Dil
khaata-rahe-mera-dil.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

kanye-west-1.title: Kanye West
kanye-west-1.description: Ye, more commonly known as Kanye West, is a global icon. He is a rapper, record producer, entrepreneur, and also a fashion designer. His music has gone from sensation to staple in the rap industry, while his personality, philosophies, and willingness to speak out for what he believes in have frequently landed him in hot water. In interviews, his thoughtful reflections reveal a complex man that few have taken the time to understand. This exclusive series follows the star from his birth to the present day, examining his career as a singer and producer as well as the forces that prepared him to pursue his dreams. Check out this remarkable journey of one of the most influential hip hop musicians and producers of his generation.

campfire-diaries.title: Campfire Diaries
campfire-diaries.description: Yeh sirf ek kahani nahi, ek daravana safar hai! Basti ke purane rahasyo se ghire kuch doston ka adventure shuru hota hai jab wo ek haunted gaon mein campfire ke liye pahunchte hain. Kya wo bhoot, atma aur shaitani khel se bach paayenge?

history-of-hazrat-yusuf.title: History of Hazrat Yusuf
history-of-hazrat-yusuf.description: Insaan Jab Bahut Si Mushkilon Se Ghira Hua Hota Tab Aksar Uska Allah Par Bharosa Kam Hone Lagta Hai Lekin Wo Log Jo Is Zindagi Aur Duniya Ko Sirf Ek Aazmaish Ki Tarah Dekhte Hain Wo Allah Ka Daman Kabhi Nahi Chhodte. Hazrat Yusuf Alayhi Salaam Ki Zindagi Humein Seekhati Hai Ki Aazmaishon Ka Saamna Kaise Kiya Jaye. Chaliye Sunte Hain Aur Seekhte Hain Zindagi Jeene Ka Sahi Tareeka.

what-is-spiritual-about-being-punctual.title: What Is Spiritual About Being Punctual
what-is-spiritual-about-being-punctual.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki aapki rojmarra ki zindagi mein bhi spirituality ko shamil kiya ja sakta hai? Sri Aurobindo aur the Mother ke vicharon par based, yeh show aapko apne  kaamon mein spirituality ko shamil karne ki kunji deta hai. Photography se lekar Punctuality aur Advertising tak, har cheez mein chhupi spirituality ko pehchanne ke liye, yeh audiobook zaroor sunein.

kanase.title: Kanase
kanase.description: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಒಂದೊಂದು ಕನಸು ಇದ್ದೇ ಇರುತ್ತೆ! ಆ ಕನಸನ್ನು ನನಸು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದೇ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಉದ್ದೇಶ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ಕಾಡೋ ಕನಸೇನು? ಈ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕ 'ರವಿ ಬೆಳಗೆರೆ' ಅವ್ರ 'ಕನಸೇ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಕೇಳಿ. ಕನಸಿನ ಬೆನ್ನೇರಿ!

second-innings-paison-aur-rishton-ki-kah.title: Second Innings: Paison Aur Rishton Ki Kahaani
second-innings-paison-aur-rishton-ki-kah.description: Kya aap life mein financially independent hone ke liye serious hain? Agar haan, toh zaroor suniye yeh show. Ismein jaaniye ki kaise Anand Arora ne, Ghar se nikaal diye jane ke baad, Apni nayi zindagi shuru ki aur investment karke khud ko stable kar liya. Miss mat kariyega kyunki is show mein aapko bhi milegi apne finances ko wisely plan karne ki practical tips.

bharat-ke-charchit-hatyakand.title: Murder Mysteries of India
bharat-ke-charchit-hatyakand.description: Bharat ke kuch sabse charchit hatyakand, jaise Lakshmikanthan ka rahasya, Neeraj Grover ki tragik maut, aur Shivani Bhatnagar ki unsuljhi kahani. Suniye in apradhon ki gehrai mein jaate hue, kaise in hatyakandon ne desh ko hilakar rakh diya. 'Bharat Ke Khooni Raaz', jahan har kahani chhupa rahi hai ek ankahee sachchai.

hitler-and-his-god-1.title: Hitler and his God
hitler-and-his-god-1.description: Hitlerum adheham nayicha Nazi Partiyude bharanavum loka charithrathiley oru karutha adhyayam aanu.  Lakshakanakkinu joothanmarey konnodukkiya HItler enna athikruranaya swechathipathiyudey athikam aarum ariyatha uthabava katha ee Kuku Bytsiludey  kelkkam. Hitlerinte aadyakala jeevitham muthal nazi germanyudey sarvabharanidhikariyayulla valarchayum, adhehathine matha vishwasangalum ee Bytiil charcha cheyyunnu.

crorepati-app-khooni-khel.title: Crorepati App : Khooni Khel
crorepati-app-khooni-khel.description: Aman is drowning in debt when a mysterious app called Crorepati suddenly deposits ₹1 lakh into his account. But every reward comes with a terrifying price. The app forces him to complete dangerous tasks that lead to tragedy and death. Trapped between saving his family, repaying his debts, and protecting his humanity, Aman is drawn into a deadly game where every click can make him richer or turn him into a killer.

bodhi-dharma.title: Bodhi Dharma
bodhi-dharma.description: Namma Thamizh Naatula irukkura Kanjipurathula poranthu valantha oru buddha thuravi Bodhidharmar, China makkalukku vantha oru thotru noiyai gunapadutha china varaikkum travel panni poyi avangaloda noiya sari pannirkaaru nu varalaatru kurippugal irukkuthu. kung fu kalaiya uruvaakunavar ivaru thaan nu solranga !, Tea chediya intha ulagathukku thanthavar ivar thaan nu solranga !  Bodhi dharmar pathina kurippugal la unmaiyum karpanaiyum kalanthe thaan irukku. Bodhi dharmar pathina thagavalgal la  Unmai edhu ? Poi ethu ? nu therinjuka intha audio series sa kelunga ! Bodhi dharmar patriya viyakka vaikkum ariya vishayangalum,  pala suvarasyamana thagavalgalum  idhula irukku !

कुरुक्षेत्र--लेखक--महेन्द्रनाथ-रामचंद्र-.title: कुरुक्षेत्र
कुरुक्षेत्र--लेखक--महेन्द्रनाथ-रामचंद्र-.description: प्रस्तुत कथा महाभारतावर आधारित आहे...लेखक या कथेतून महाभारताची कथा सोप्या भाषेत आणि आजकालकझया तरुण पिढीच्या आधाराने समजावून सांगण्याचा प्रयत्न करतो...या कथेत पुढे काय होते ते जाणून घेण्यासाठी ऐका...

অতর্কিত-অনুষঙ্গ--লেখিকা--স্বরূপা-রয়.title: অতর্কিত অনুষঙ্গ | লেখিকা - স্বরূপা রয়
অতর্কিত-অনুষঙ্গ--লেখিকা--স্বরূপা-রয়.description:
প্রেমের দান যত কঠিন হয়, নিবিড় হয় প্রাপ্তির আনন্দ। আদিত্য বেছে নেয় এক যৌনকর্মীকে তার সঙ্গিনী হিসেবে। কী প্রতিক্রিয়া হবে সমাজের? কেমন থাকবে ব্যক্তিগত অনুভূতি? শুনে নিন গল্প অতর্কিত অনুষঙ্গ। 
Writer- Swarupa Roy g

how-to-motivate-yourself-in-difficult-ti.title: How To Motivate Yourself In Difficult Times
how-to-motivate-yourself-in-difficult-ti.description: జీవితం నిరీక్షణలు, నిరాశల సమ్మేళనం. కష్టాల ముందు నిరుత్సాహంలో కూరుకుపోకుండా ధైర్యంగా ఉండి ముందుకు సాగిపోవాలా ? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

deep-work-rules-for-focused-success-in-a.title: Deep Work
deep-work-rules-for-focused-success-in-a.description:
Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World.
[Key Ideas Explained]

the-art-of-self-love.title: The Art Of Self Love
the-art-of-self-love.description: "Love" idhu dhaan namma ellarayum vaazhkai la oru pidippoda vachurukku. But unga life la neenga love panna vendiya person, yaaru theriyuma? Neenga dhaan. Yen ? nra kelvi kaana badhil indha audio book la kelunga.

shradha-sharma-ek-journalist-se-top-entr.title: Shradha Sharma: Ek JOURNALIST Se TOP ENTREPRENEUR Tak Ka Safar
shradha-sharma-ek-journalist-se-top-entr.description: Subah ke 5 baje the. Phone baja aur udhar se awaaz aayi. "Beta tumhari maa nahi rahi!" Aur uske liye jaise sab kuch bikhar gaya. Maa... maa nahi rahi. Aur us ladki ke mann mein laakhon sawaal ek saath ghoomne lage. Abhi abhi to usne apni comfortable job chhodi thi jab poori duniya ne usse kaha tha ki ladkiyon ko itne risk nahi lene chahiye, aur woh apna startup shuru karne ja rahi thi, us samaaj mein jahan ladkiyon ko bas shaadi karke ghar sambhalne ko kaha jaata hai. Aise mein uski maa hi thi jo uske liye inspiration ka kaam kar rahi thi aur aise crucial moment par yeh tragedy! Us ladki ki aankh se ek bhi aansu nahi nikla – bas ek cheekh nikli. Lekin phir usse apni maa ki baat yaad aayi – "Beta kabhi bhi haar mat maanna." Aur tab jaakar woh royi. Lekin khud se vaada karke ki uski maa uske kaam mein zinda rahegi. Aise mauke par jab sab toot jaate hain, tab woh ladki apne dimaag mein bulandiyon ka woh parcham lehra rahi thi jo aaj tak kisi ne nahi dekha tha.

the-richest-man-in-babylon-11.title: The Richest Man in Babylon
the-richest-man-in-babylon-11.description: George Samuel Clasoninte 'The Richest Man in Babylon' enna pusthakathiloode sambathika abhivridhiyude rahasyangal kandethu. Ee kalatheethamaya guide, purathana Babylonile aakarshakamaya kadhakaliloode praayogika upadhesham nalkikond, sambathth srishtiyude kaalatheethamaya thathwangal pankidunnu.

the-death-an-inside-story-by-sadguru-1.title: Sadhguru Ek Pothprodorshok
the-death-an-inside-story-by-sadguru-1.description: Ei sharangsho ti shei protyek ti byaktir jonnyo karon ek na ekidn ei jogot chhere amra sokolei chole jabo. Sadguru ei sharangshe porishkar kore bujhiyechen je mrityur jonnyo amra nijeder ke ki ki bhabe toiri korte pari, amra ki bhabe emon ekti manusher sahajyo korte pari jini mrityur dike egiye jachhen, ebong mrityur poreo onar attar shantir kamona korar kichu podhyotio uni bujhiyechen.

becoming-supernatural-1.title: Supernatural Hoye Othar Sohoj Upay
becoming-supernatural-1.description: Asambhab bole ashoel kichui hoi na. Chhoto byala theke amader bojhano hoyeche je konta shombhob ar konta ekebarei oshombhob. Ei boiti te amader bojhano hoyeche je ashole kichui oshombhob noi. Cholun shune newa jaak lekhok ei boiti te ki ki ashole bolte cheyechen. Kibhabe meditation er madhyome tader jibon puropuri palte jachhe.

pakeezah.title: Pakeezah
pakeezah.description: सौम्या की खुशहाल जिंदगी तब बदल जाती है, जब एक हादसे में उसका पति अर्जुन जिंदगी और मौत के बीच फंस जाता है। उसे बचाने के लिए सौम्या को एक ऐसा समझौता करना पड़ता है, जिसकी कीमत उसे अपनी आबरू खोकर चुकानी पड़ती है। लेकिन सालों बाद सौम्या पकीज़ा बनकर लौटती है—एक ऐसी औरत, जो अपनी खूबसूरती, समझदारी और लोगों के राज़ को अपना हथियार बनाती है। अब उसका मकसद उन ताकतवर लोगों से बदला लेना है, जिन्होंने उसकी जिंदगी बर्बाद की।

rakshak-dishaon-ke-rakhwale-devta.title: Rakshak : Dishaon Ke Rakhwale Devta
rakshak-dishaon-ke-rakhwale-devta.description: Bramhand ke Santulan ke liye Brahma ji ne Chune 8 Dishaon ke Lokpal yani Rakshak! Jinhone di bejod pariksha! Ye kahani hai 8 rakshakon ke yuddh aur unki shakti ki, jo aapne ab tak nhin suni hogi. To abhi sunna shuru kijiye.

rakesh-jhunjhunwala-the-big-bull-of-indi.title: Rakesh Jhunjhunwala- The Big Bull of India
rakesh-jhunjhunwala-the-big-bull-of-indi.description: అసలు ఈ రాకేష్ ఎవరు? స్టాక్ మార్కెట్ లో ఎదురులేని వ్యక్తిగా ఎలా ఎదిగాడు? చివరి రోజుల్లో రాకేష్ జీవితం మనకు ఏమి నేర్పిస్తుంది? తెలుసుకోండి స్టాక్ మార్కెట్ కింగ్ గురించి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో...

the-great-salesman.title: The Great Salesman
the-great-salesman.description: Kehte Hain Sales Ek Aisa Skill Hai Jo Har Insaan Ko Aana Chahiye. Hamari Poori Zindagi Mein Kabhi Na Kabhi Kuch Sell Zaroor Karte Hain. Jaise Ek Acchi Job Haasil Karne Ke Liye Hum Saamne Wale Ko Apne Skill Bechte Hain, Koi Deal Karte Waqt Hum Apne Ideas Ko Bechate Hain Aur Agar Baat Ki Jaye Business Ki Toh Ye Kaam Seedha Seedha Juda Hota Hai Hamare Products Aur Services Ki Sale Se Toh Chaliye Jaante Hain Kaise Ban Sakte Aap Ek Great Salesman?

ondu-soligi-godi.title: Ondu Soligi Godi

the-rock-hollywood-s-hottest-action-star.title: The Rock: Hollywood's Hottest Action Star
the-rock-hollywood-s-hottest-action-star.description: There are three certainties in life: death, taxes, and Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson's awesomeness. The Rock embodies everything we want from our Hollywood superstars...and everything we admire in those who so boldly pursue the American dream, with a proverbial Rotten Tomatoes score of 100 percent, Certified Fresh. But how did it all come to pass? How did a despised professional wrestler become the world's most famous person? Was it just a coincidence? Countless hours spent at the gym? A winning grin? Or his complete command of Instagram Stories? Our exclusive show on The Rock delves into the career and rise of Dwayne Johnson as one of the most successful and popular action stars in Hollywood and his journey from a professional wrestler to one of the most sought-after actors in the industry. Whether you're a fan of The Rock or just curious about the entertainment industry, this show is a must-listen. It offers a behind-the-scenes look at the life and career of one of the biggest action stars in the world. Listen to what 'The Rock Says' on this exhilarating show.

sala-muktha-jeevana.description: ಸಾಲ ಮುಕ್ತ ಜೀವನ - ಸಾಲದ ಶೂಲಕ್ಕೆ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಸಿಲುಕಿದ್ದೇ ಆದರೆ ಅದರಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರೋದು ಅಷ್ಟು ಸುಲಭವಲ್ಲ. ಹಾಗಂದ ಮಾತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಅದೂ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯವೂ ಅಲ್ಲ. ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ವಿಚಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಳನ್ನ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದರ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಲ ಮುಕ್ತ ಜೀವನವನ್ನ ನಿಮ್ಮದಾಗಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ ಖರ್ಚು, ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಹೂಡಿಕೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸರಳವಾದ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನ ನಿಮಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸತ್ತೆ. ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಭಾವನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿ, ಉಜ್ವಲ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಕನಸಿಗೆ ರಿಯಾಲಿಟಿ ರೂಪವನ್ನೂ ಕೊಡುತ್ತೆ. ಮಿಸ್‌ ಮಾಡದೇ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ ಕೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಲ ಮುಕ್ತರಾಗಿ.

aa-thavalaye-thinnu.description: പണികള്‍ നീട്ടിവെക്കുന്ന പ്രവണത എങ്ങനെ ഒഴിവാക്കാം? വിജയികള്‍ പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട പണികളില്‍ ശ്രദ്ധ കേന്ദ്രീകരിക്കുന്നതെങ്ങനെ?  ലോക പ്രശസ്ത ബെസ്റ്റ്-സെല്ലിങ് എഴുത്തുകാരനായ ബ്രയൻ ട്രേസി, "തവളയെ തിന്നുക" എന്ന തത്വം ഉപയോഗിച്ച് - അതായത് ഏറ്റവും വെല്ലുവിളി നിറഞ്ഞ ജോലി ആദ്യം ചെയ്യുക - എന്നതിലൂടെ ഉത്പാദനക്ഷമത എങ്ങനെ വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കാമെന്ന്   പറഞ്ഞുതരുന്നു.

the-communist-manifesto.title: The Communist Manifesto
the-communist-manifesto.description: Marx ki ideology se panpi yeh vishwa prasiddha jeevan shaili bade bade etihaas ke pal aur naye desho ke nirmaan ka kaaran rahi hai. Originally, yeh Communist Party ke manifesto ke roop mein saamne aaya, jab jo do German philosophers Karl Marx aur Friedrich Engels ne ek pamphlet ke roop mein in vichaaro ko chapvaaya tha. Labour class ka parcham, unka sanvidhaan aur unke symbol par bane auzaaro ki buniyaad hai communist manifesto. Capitalism ki sabse badi takkar 'Communism' ke roop mein hi rahi jo global dominance, cold war aur world ideologies ke roop mein takraayi.

माँ-कैकेयी-के-राम.title: माँ कैकेयी के "राम"
माँ-कैकेयी-के-राम.description: Aapne har baar Ramayan ko alag alag nazariye se suna hai, hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain Ramayan ko Kaikeyi ki drishti se. Vo Kaikeyi jinhein  Prabhu Shree Ram ke vanvas ke liye doshi mana jata hai jinpar kai lankshan lagaye jaate hain  kya wo wakai me doshi hain ? Jaaniye Ramayan ko Kaikeyi ki drishti se Maa Kaikeyi ke Ram mein.

modern-science-aur-hamara-universe.title: Modern Science Aur Hamara Universe
modern-science-aur-hamara-universe.description: Modern Physics se aap kya samajhte hain? Kya aane wale waqt mein hamara modern science is duniya ki tabahi ka karan banega? Ya hoga koi aur revolution, aise bahut se sawal honge aapke man mein aur aapke inhe sawalon ka jawaab dene hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain Quantum Physics ki jaankari aur sath he isme hamari help ki Physics ke researcher “Kishor Bharti” ne Modern Physics aur humare universe ko samjhne ke liye suniye yeh audio show.

ad067772-19b6-4cb5-b806-981cad777899.description: ஐந்து ஆண்டுகளாக மனைவி ரம்யாவுக்காக அனைத்தையும் தியாகம் செய்த தினேஷ், அவள் குடும்பத்தினரால் வேலைக்காரனைப் போல நடத்தப்படுகிறான். ரம்யாவின் அலட்சியமும் அர்ஜுனின் வருகையும் அவனை விவாகரத்து முடிவெடுக்கச் செய்கின்றன. தினேஷை இழந்த பிறகுதான் அவன் மதிப்பு ரம்யாவுக்குப் புரிகிறது. ஆனால், இழந்த உறவை மீண்டும் பெற முடியுமா?

1857-bihar-mein-mahayudh.title: 1857: Bihar Mein Mahayuddh
1857-bihar-mein-mahayudh.description: Ho jaiye taiyar Sahiban, Kyuki aap sunne wale hain ek kamal ki dastan. Saal 1857 Sunkar kuch yaad aaya? Yaad aayi hogi Bharat ki azadi ki pehli ladai ki kahani, yaad aayi hogi 1857 Ki Kranti. Lekin Kya aap is mahan kranti ke sab pahlu aur itihas jante hain? Pata hai ki Bihar ne is kranti ko kaise aag di? Kaise “Delhi Chalo” jaisa ek aur nara “Jagdishpur Chalo” Bihar mein gunja? Kaise pura Bihar British Sarkar ke khilaf ek ho gaya tha? Ye sab aap jaan payenge “1857: Bihar Mein Mahayuddh” .

the-iron-will-jamshedji-tata-story.title: The Iron Will Jamshedji Tata Story

Tyani Tyanchya Carrer Madhye Anek Chad Utar Ale, Pan Tyani Kadhi Hi har Manli Nahi. Pratyek Vela Tyani Navin Jomane Survat Keli Ani Totyat Gelela Business Navyane Survat kela. Tyani Savata Adhi Tyanchya Saglyana Thevla Deshacha Vichar kela ani India Madhli Top University Ubhi Keli, Ek swapna cha Shahar Ubha Kela Jyala Tatanagar mhanun Olakhla jata. Kasa Hota Jamshedjincha Pravas Yat Tyanchya Samaor Kay Adchani Alya Tya janun Gheuyat Kukufmchya Ya docudrama madhun.

budget-2025.title: BUDGET 2025
budget-2025.description: ಈ ವರ್ಷದ ಸೆಂಟ್ರಲ್ ಬಜೆಟ್ ಅನ್ನು ಮಂಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಫೈನಾನ್ಸ್ ಮಿನಿಸ್ಟರ್ ನಿರ್ಮಲಾ ಸೀತಾರಾಮನ್ ಯಾವೆಲ್ಲಾ ಘೋಷಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನು ಸಿಂಪಲ್ ಆಗಿ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾ ಹೋಗೋಣ. ಬಜೆಟ್ನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಟ್ಯಾಕ್ಸ್ ಜಾಸ್ತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ತಿಂಗಳ ಸಂಬಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಟ್ಯಾಕ್ಸ್ ಕಟ್ ಆಗಲಿದೆ. ಯಾವೆಲ್ಲಾ ವಸ್ತುಗಳು ದುಬಾರಿಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಯಾವುದೆಲ್ಲಾ ಇನ್ಮುಂದೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನು ಒಂದಾದರ ನಂತರ ಒಂದರಂತೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಳ್ತಾ ಹೋಗೋಣ. ವೆಲ್ ಕಮ್ ಟು ಬಜೆಟ್ 2025.

मेरी-बीवी-को-प्यार-हो-गया---लेखिका--हेमा.title: Meri Biwi Ko Pyar Ho Gaya
मेरी-बीवी-को-प्यार-हो-गया---लेखिका--हेमा.description: अक्सर जो हम सोचते है वैसा होता नहीं, लाख जतन करने के बाद भी होता वही है जो हाथ की लकीरों में लिखा होता है। कुछ ऐसा ही हुआ आर्यमन औऱ सुकीर्ति के साथ,ऊपर वाले ने विपरीत परिस्थितियों के चलते उन्हें विवाह के पवित्र बंधन में बांध तो दिया पर आगे क्या होगा? सुकीर्ति की चाहत आर्यमन ही है ,या कोई और? क्‍या आर्यमन इस शादी को स्‍वीकार करेगा? सुकीर्ति उससे प्‍यार नहीं करती यह जानकर वह कोई बड़ा फैसला लेगा? सब कुछ जानते हुये उसने सुकीर्ति से शादी करने का फ़ैसला लिया ही क्यों ? कहानी में कई मजेदार मोड़ आते है और कई जगह हमारी आंखें भी नम होती है। जानने के लिए सुनें पूरी कहानी...

pedro-lopez.title: Pedro Lopez
pedro-lopez.description: Pedro lopez ek aisa khoonkhar apradhi jiske jurm sunkar police bhi kaanp gayi thi.jisne kiya tha ek ke baad ek kul 300 ladkiyon ka murder. itna ghinauna jurm karne ke baad bhi ise sirf 20 saal ki hi saza mili. iske baad wo aazad ho gaya. Jail se nikalkar Pedro lopez ne kya kiya? Kaise hua uska ant?  kyun ki usne keval ladkiyon ki hi htya? Suniye ek rongte khade kar Dene Wale  serial killer ki puri kahani KUKU FM par.

successfully-invest-ki-kore-korben.title: Successfully Invest Ki Kore Korben?
successfully-invest-ki-kore-korben.description: Lekhok 2003 saale ekti memo lekhen jekhane tini shob cheye gurutyopurno bishoy ullekh korechilen. Jar modhye investing niye anek ichui likhe chilen. Successful investing er pechone exactly ki ki kaj kore uni shegulo niye alochona korechen. Lekhoker mote biniyog ba investing kono sohoj kaj noi. Ekhane shob theke moulik updana holo chintashil monojog. Lekhok ei boi te alochona korechen je kibhabe jhuki nite hoi ar ki bhabe shei jhuki ke limit e rakhte hoi.

मेरी-मदद-करो---लेखक--अभिषेक-हाड़ा--अभि.title: Meri Madat Karo
मेरी-मदद-करो---लेखक--अभिषेक-हाड़ा--अभि.description:
अमावस की काली रात मेंं गांव के सबसे सुनसान और डरावने रास्ते से ये कहानी शुरू होती है। जहां एक लड़की मदद मांगती है। उसकी आवाज मेरी मदद करो।उस परिवार को सुनाई देती है। लेकिन उसे अनसुना कर वो आगे बढ़ जाते है। उसके बाद उनकी जिंदगी में एक के बाद एक बहुत डरावनी घटनाएं होना शुरू हो जाती है। उनके घर में भूत प्रेत होने जैसी घटनाएं होने लगती है। उसके बाद घर का बड़ा बेटा और बहू अपने बेटे के साथ गायब हो जाते है। उस परिवार की बेटी भी गायब हो जाती है। किसी को कुछ समझ नही आता है कि इन सब के पीछे कौन है। तब कहानी में डिटेक्टिव रूद्र आता है जो इन सब घटनाओं के पीछे होने वाले सच का पता लगाता है। अपने दोस्तों की मदद से वो अधूरे सच तक पहुंचता है। जिस इसांन को सब गुनहगार समझ रहे थे क्या वही इन सब के पीछे था या सच्चाई कुछ और ही थी? कहीं कोई अदृश्य शक्ति तो इसके पीछे नही थी या ये सिर्फ किसी का फैलाया हुआ एक मायाजाल था? क्या रहस्य था उस सुनसान जंगल में गूंजती हुई आवाज मेरी मदद करो का...?
Author : अभिषेक हाड़ा
Voiceover Artist : ASHUTOSH

Meerut-Drum-Hatyakand-धोखेबाज़-बीवी-की-है.title: Meerut Drum Hatyakand: धोखेबाज़ बीवी की हैरान कर देने वाली साज़िश
Meerut-Drum-Hatyakand-धोखेबाज़-बीवी-की-है.description:
"पापा ड्रम में हैं" – एक सनसनीखेज क्राइम सीरीज़

मर्चेंट नेवी अफ़सर सौरभ राजपूत अपनी बेटी का बर्थडे मनाने शहर आया, लेकिन लंदन कभी वापस नहीं जा सका। कुछ दिनों बाद वो अचानक गायब हो गया—पर उसके सोशल मीडिया से तस्वीरें पोस्ट होती रहीं।

फिर उसकी मासूम बेटी ने कहा: "पापा ड्रम में हैं।"

जांच में निकला खौफनाक सच—सौरभ की लाश घर के ही एक सीमेंट ड्रम में टुकड़ों में बंद थी। प्यार, धोखा, अफेयर, तांत्रिक क्रियाएं और चार महीने की साज़िश—सब इस कत्ल के पीछे छिपे थे।

एक सनसनीखेज कहानी… जहां कातिल कोई और नहीं, अपने ही निकले।

तेरी-मेरी-लव-स्टोरी--लेखिका--महिमा-वर्णव.title: Teri Meri Love Story
तेरी-मेरी-लव-स्टोरी--लेखिका--महिमा-वर्णव.description:
काजल का कजिन भाई दीप्ति से प्‍यार करता है, लेकिन इनके प्‍यार के बहाने शुरू होती है काजल और समीर की लव स्‍टोरी। पहली नजर में ही समीर, काजल को अपना दिल दे बैठता है। काजल इस बात से अनजान है। छुट्टियां खत्‍म होते ही समीर को वापस जाना पड़ता है और अपने दिल की बात काजल से नहीं कह पाता है। तो क्‍या काजल समीर के प्‍यार को समझ पाएगी? ड्यूटी के नाते समीर काजल से दूर जा चुका है, तो क्‍या दोनों फिर से मिल पाएंगे? यह जानने के लिए आपको सुननी पड़ेगी पूरी कहानी।

economic-reforms-that-changed-our-nation.title: Economic Reforms That Changed Our Nation: Manmohan Singh
economic-reforms-that-changed-our-nation.description: 1991లో భారత ఆర్థిక వ్యవస్థలో కీలకమైన సంస్కరణలు ప్రారంభమయ్యాయి, వాటిలో ఉదారీకరణ, వ్యవస్థీకరణ, మరియు గ్లోబలైజేషన్ ముఖ్యమైనవి. వీటివల్ల ఆర్థిక వృద్ధి, ఉపాధి అవకాశాలు, మరియు గ్లోబల్ మార్కెట్లో స్థానం లభించినప్పటికీ, ఆర్థిక అసమానతలు మరియు వ్యవసాయ రంగం వెనుకబాటుకు దారితీశాయి. ఈ సంస్కరణలు తెలంగాణ, ఆంధ్ర ప్రదేశ్ లాంటి ప్రాంతాల్లో ఐటీ రంగం మరియు వాణిజ్య అభివృద్ధికి దోహదం చేశాయి. భవిష్యత్తులో, వ్యవసాయ రంగ ప్రాధాన్యతను పెంచుతూ సమగ్ర అభివృద్ధి కోసం సంస్కరణలను ప్రజల అవసరాలకు అనుగుణంగా తీర్చడం అవసరం.

just-aspire-notes-on-technology-entrepre.title: Just Aspire: Notes on Technology, Entrepreneurship and the Future
just-aspire-notes-on-technology-entrepre.description:
எல்லாருக்கும் கனவுகள் இருந்தது. ஆனா ஒரு சிலரால தான் அத நிஜமாக்க முடிஞ்சது. அதோட ரகசியம் என்ன? அதிர்ஷ்டமா, திறமையா, இல்ல வேற ஏதாவதா? 

Just Aspire புக்க எழுதன அஜய் சவுத்ரி, பெரிய கனவுகள காண துணிஞ்ச, ஒரு மனிதனோட எழுச்சியூட்ற கதையின் மூலமாக இந்த கேள்விக்கு பதில் அளிக்கறாரு. அஜய் சவுத்ரி ஒரு சின்ன நகரத்துல தன்னோட பயணத்த தொடங்கனாரு. ஒரு விஷயத்த புதுசா கத்துக்கனும்- ற ஆர்வவும் விடாமுயற்சிய-யும் தவர, அப்ப அவர்கிட்ட எதுவும் இல்ல. எல்லார் மாதிரியும் அவரும் ஒரு கனவு கண்டாரு. ஆனா அந்த கனவ நெனவாக்க, அவர் செயல்லையும் இறங்கனாரு. அது எப்படின்னு தெரிஞ்சுக்க கேளுங்க இந்த ஆடியோ புக்க...

typecast.title: Typecast
typecast.description: Callie Dressler thought she’d put her past where it belonged—behind her. But when her ex-boyfriend brings their breakup to the big screen she can no longer deny that their history has been looming over her all along. At thirty-one Callie Dressler is finally comfortable in her own skin. She loves her job as a preschool teacher and although living in her vacant childhood home isn’t necessarily what dreams are made of the space is something she never could have afforded if she’d stayed in New York City. She knows her well-ordered life will be upended when her type A pregnant sister Nina; adorable four-year-old niece; and workaholic brother-in-law move in but how could she say no when they needed a place to crash during their remodel? As Nina pointed out it’s still their parents’ house even if their mom and dad have relocated. As if adjusting to this new living situation isn’t enough the universe sends Callie another wrinkle: her college boyfriend—who Callie dumped ten years earlier for reasons known only to her—has a film coming out and the screenplay is based on their real-life breakup. While the movie consumes her thoughts Callie can’t help wondering if Nina and her friends are right that she hasn’t moved on. When a complication with Nina’s pregnancy brings Callie in close contact with Nina’s smart and funny architect Callie realizes she’d better figure out whether she wants to open the door to the past—or risk missing out on her future.

jinn-ka-ghulam.title: Jinn ka Ghulam
jinn-ka-ghulam.description: Rampur, 1936. Dr. Rabindra Rai — rationalist, atheist, healer — crashes into a marsh that shouldn't exist. He wakes as the chosen slave of an ancient jinn that doesn't want to kill him. It wants to use him. To force him to murder the people he loves most, one by one, and stay alive to grieve them. As bodies mount, his fiancée Manjari investigates, a British officer closes in, and an old woman reveals the only way to end it — a truth that will cost everything.

eternal-life-for-3000-years.title: Eternal Life for 3000 years
eternal-life-for-3000-years.description: An ancient, immortal being named Adam re-emerges in 2022, seeking complete immortality through a "Red Dust fire test" after millennia of observation. He quickly intervenes in Max City, stopping crime lord Harry King and saving Mr. Lucas, revealing extraordinary martial arts prowess and miraculous healing abilities. This draws the attention of Lucas's skeptical granddaughter, Mary, leading to an unexpected connection despite complications from the menacing Chignan and the aggressive Steve. Adam and Mary are soon drawn into a perilous urban underworld controlled by the enigmatic Dragon King, whose sinister influence masks the city's true power structure. Adam defiantly refuses the Dragon King's demands, setting the stage for a major confrontation, and is later manipulated into accepting an assassination contract via an ancient "Dragon King's Order" token. Concurrently, Milly, an heiress, fiercely resists arranged marriages and finds herself entangled in a deadly trap orchestrated by a powerful dynasty connected to the Dragon King. Adam is revealed to be a powerful CEO with a mysterious 'black card' and consistently protects Milly from various threats, though their bond becomes transactional. Adam is explicitly identified as the formidable "Dragon King," an "undercover CEO" with absolute power, whose true potential is recognized. He orchestrates revenge and confronts Shaan Morgan, leading to Shaan's dramatic downfall as Adam's true, hidden power is unveiled. The narrative introduces emerging mystical threats, ancient cultivation arts, and the formidable "War God" Harry King, who threatens Max City's powerful families, prompting Patriarch Lucas to hire Adam for protection. Adam, revealed as a long-lost heir to the powerful Adam family, returns to save their ancestral legacy and confront Harry King, who is embarking on a ruthless corporate takeover and is identified as an immortal cultivator. The legendary Dragon King undergoes a mystical transformation while protecting a vulnerable family. Adam demonstrates formidable martial prowess, decisively defeating the 'God of War' Harry King and permanently stripping him of his powers. Adam dramatically returns after three millennia, revealing his immortal ancestor status to his family, assuming a leadership role and setting the stage for future conflicts and revelations. Mary Lucas, seeking mentorship from Adam, receives a protective Ice Crystal hairpin and advocates for an alliance against Harry King, later being poisoned in a treacherous plot. Milli, now a burdened heiress, takes over her family's empire after her grandfather falls ill, with her path complicated by Young Master Sam Adam asserting authority.

raja-dulhaniya-le-jayenge.title: Raja Dulhaniya Le Jayenge
raja-dulhaniya-le-jayenge.description: Ishana Shah’s story begins with repeated public humiliation that pushes her to make a defiant choice about her own future. At a Garba celebration, she is shamed in front of others and vows to marry the man who picks up her dandiya stick, turning a moment of insult into a challenge to her family’s control. That choice leads to a ritual bond with a humble waiter, shocking the wealthy Shah household and setting off immediate class prejudice and sibling rivalry. Her relatives reject the match, mock her dignity, and try to force her back into the family’s idea of honor and status. Ishana refuses to back down and insists that trust, companionship, and shared effort matter more than wealth. The wedding becomes another battleground, with family outrage, insults, and pressure to treat the marriage as a disgrace. Yet the groom arrives and behaves in a way that suggests he is not what he first seemed, especially when a commissioner addresses him with unusual respect. This hidden recognition hints that the man Ishana married may be carrying a powerful identity and a buried past. After the wedding, the couple is pushed into a modest domestic life, where small acts of care help them build trust and closeness. Their bond grows through tender moments, even as outside interruptions and unresolved history threaten their fragile peace. Family hostility does not fade, and Ishana continues to face judgment for marrying below her status. In later conflict, secret gifts and official parcels arrive under unclear circumstances, turning celebration into suspicion and public feud. The Shah family escalates its cruelty through inheritance threats, demands for jewelry, and ritual humiliation meant to force Ishana into submission. Ishana is pushed to choose between her marriage and her birth family, and she rejects the Shah name rather than surrender her dignity. Around her, another ring-related dispute reveals that what looked stolen may actually be tied to a royal legacy, reinforcing the theme that appearances are deceptive. The hidden identity thread deepens when the man mistaken for a waiter is revealed as Cabinet Minister Aaryan Rathore, shifting the story from family shame into a larger struggle involving power, corruption accusations, and the threat of arrest. By the end of the batch digests, Ishana’s marriage stands at the center of a widening conflict between love, class prejudice, family control, and political danger.

the-ventilator-project.description: Saal 2020,  China ki  Wuhan city se nikala corona virus lagbhag poori duniya mein fail chuka tha. Charo taraf hahakaar macha tha. पुरानी-हवेली--एक-अफसाना--लेखिका--हरियाणा.description:
समर हॉलिडे में कहां घूमने जाया जाए….और प्‍लान बनता है दोस्‍त के गांव जाना। मुंबई के कॉलेज में पढ़नेवाले अभिनव, सानवी, दक्ष, नित्‍या, तनय और प्रियांस अपने दोस्‍त सुरेश के गांव पहुंचते हैं। सभी आनेवाले खतरे से अनजान है। गांव की पुरानी हवेली का रहस्‍य उन सभी दोस्‍तों को खींचता है लेकिन सुरेश उन्‍हें वहां जाने से रोकता है। लेकिन एक दिन सभी दोस्‍त छुपकर पहुंच जाते हैं। दक्ष गायब हो जाता है अब आगे क्‍या होगा? जानने के लिए सुनें पूरी कहानी। "In this audio book you will get to listen to an audiobook named Purani Haveli. Purani Haveli Horror Story is one of the best horror stories available on our platform. This story is written by Mehak Suthar. This story is about 6 friends named Abhinav, Sanvi, Daksha, Nitya, Tanay and Priyansh. All friends plan to go to their friend Suresh's village during summer vacation. On reaching the village, they get to know about the secret of the old mansion. They prepare to go to that mansion. Suresh stops them from going there but they do not stop and reach that haveli. They had just reached there and some strange incidents started to happen to them. Daksha suddenly disappeared.  All friends were very scared. Where did Daksh go? Has anyone killed him? Is there a ghost in that mansion? To know the answers to all these questions, you should listen to this audiobook till the end. You can listen to the Purani Haveli horror story online on our platform and can also download it for future re-listening. So listen to Purani Haveli in Hindi now.
इस ऑडियो बुक में आपको पुरानी हवेली नामक ऑडियो बुक सुनने को मिलेगी। पुरानी हवेली हॉरर स्टोरी हमारे प्लेटफार्म पर उपलब्ध सबसे अच्छी हॉरर स्टोरीज में से एक है। यह कहानी महक सुथार द्वारा लिखी गई है। ये कहानी अभिनव, सानवी, दक्ष, नित्‍या, तनय और प्रियांस नाम के 6 दोस्तो की है। जो गर्मी की छुट्टियों में अपने दोस्त सुरेश के गांव जाने का प्लान बनाते हैं। गांव पहुंचने पर उनको पुरानी हवेली के रहस्य के बारे में पता चलता है। वे उस हवेली में जाने के लिए तैयार होते हैं। सुरेश उन्हें वहां जाने से रोकता है लेकिन वे नहीं मानते हैं और छुपकर उस हवेली में पहुंच जाते हैं। वे वहां पहुंचे ही थे कि उनके साथ कुछ अजीब घटनाएं होने लगी। उनका एक दोस्त दक्ष अचानक से गायब हो गया। सारे दोस्त बहुत डर गए। आखिर दक्ष कहां चला गया? क्या उसे किसी ने मार दिया? क्या उस हवेली में कोई भूत है? इन सभी प्रश्नों के जवाब जानने के लिए आपको यह ऑडियो बुक अन्त तक सुनना चाहिए। पुरानी हवेली हॉरर स्टोरी आप हमारे प्लेटफार्म पर ऑनलाइन सुन सकते हैं तथा भविष्य में दोबारा सुनने के लिए इसे डाउनलोड भी कर सकते हैं। तो आज ही सुने पुरानी हवेली हिंदी में।"

Khooni-Waaris-3-लाशें-और-एक-मास्टरमाइंड-.description:
Jab Lucknow ki ek family Jammu-Kashmir trip par gayi aur achanak gayab ho gayi, sabne socha ek mamooli landslide ka case hoga. Aakhri WhatsApp message mein likha tha: “Ramsu ke paas phanse hain,” saath mein kuch tasveerein thi—ek sunsaan road aur kohre se dhaki ghaati.

Lekin kuch ghanton baad wahi phone Lucknow mein trace hua.

SSP Mohita Sharma ko laga routine missing case hoga. Lekin na train ya hotel records mein naam mila, na kisi hospital mein. Jaise-jaise tahqiqat aage badhi, case ek dark conspiracy ban gaya.

Photos ke timestamp, call logs aur rishtedaron ke bayan—sab alag raaste dikha rahe the. Family ka bada beta Sarfaraz, jo Lucknow mein tha, investigation ka centre ban gaya.

Purane jhagde aur chhupe raaz samne aane lage. Aur phir Lucknow mein milne lagi laashein.

Ek WhatsApp message se shuru hua case, ab maut aur dhokhe ki bhool-bhulaiyya ban chuka tha.
