Iss show  mein aapko in ssare sawalon ke jawab toh milenge hi aur sath hi pyramids of Egypt ke bare mein kai aur fascinating facts bhi milenge.

raktha-pramanam.title: Raktha Pramanam
raktha-pramanam.description: ఆనన్య ఒక ఆర్కిటెక్చర్ విద్యార్థిని. తన రీసెర్చ్‌లో భాగంగా ఒక పాడుబడిన పురాతన కోటకు వెళ్తుంది. ఆ కోటలో అడుగుపెట్టగానే, ఆమె వంశ రక్తంతో ముడిపడిన శతాబ్దాల నాటి శాపం మేల్కొంటుంది. ప్రతి వందేళ్లకు తిరిగి వచ్చే అమరుడైన ఓ శాపాన్ని ఆపాలంటే, చరిత్రలోనే చెరిపివేయబడిన తన పూర్వీకుల గొప్ప త్యాగం వెనుక దాగి ఉన్న నిజాన్ని ఆనన్య కనిపెట్టాలి.

ooriki-uttaraana.title: Ooriki Uttaraana
ooriki-uttaraana.description:
అడవుల అంచున విరిగిపోతున్న చీకటిలో కమ్ముకున్న ఊరు. అక్కడి లేడీస్ హాస్టల్‌ దగ్గర వరుసగా కనిపించకుండా పోతున్న విద్యార్థినులు. అదే సమయంలో, హైదరాబాదులో ఓ ప్రముఖ బిజినెస్ ఫ్యామిలీలో చోటు చేసుకున్న అనుమానాస్పద మరణం. వీటికి ముడిపడినదే… శతాబ్దాల నాటి శాపం.

తల్లి మరణాన్ని తట్టుకోలేని విశ్వతేజ్ నంద, తన కోపం, విచారం, అనుమానంతో కలిసిపోయి నిజాన్ని వెలికితీసేందుకు సిద్ధమవుతాడు. తన అసలైన హోదాను దాచుకొని, అదే కాలేజ్‌లో లెక్చరర్‌గా చేరుతాడు. కానీ అక్కడ ఎదురవుతున్నది శాస్త్రానికి లోబడని శక్తుల యథార్థం. అరుణశాస్త్రి తన దివ్యజ్ఞానంతో త్రిశూల గ్రంథాన్ని ముందుకు తెస్తాడు. కానీ అది ఆయుధమా? లేక శాపమా?

b4d8b148-2651-4816-b9b0-1133266558af.title: தாண்டவம்
b4d8b148-2651-4816-b9b0-1133266558af.description: ஹரிகிருஷ்ணன் தன் தந்தை விட்டுச் சென்ற ஓலைச்சுவடிகளை படிக்கும்போதுதான், பூமியில் புதைந்து போன எழிமலைக்காவு பகவதி கோவில் பற்றி அறிகிறான். மூன்று நூற்றாண்டுகளுக்கு முன்பு இறந்த அந்தர்ஜன் என்ற இளம் பெண்ணின் வழிகாட்டுதலுடன் தேடிச் செல்கிறான். அந்த ஓலைச் சுவடிகளைக் கைப்பற்ற மேலும் சில மந்திரவாதிகள் முயல்கிறார்கள். வெற்றி பெற்றது யார்? கோட்டயம் புஷ்பநாத்தின் அதிரடி த்ரில்லர் இது...

Balipeetam-బలిపీఠం.title: బలిపీఠం
Balipeetam-బలిపీఠం.description: భాస్కర్ అనే హరిజన యువకుడు,  బ్రాహ్మణ బాల వితంతువైన అరుణను పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటాడు. ఈ జంట ఎప్పుడూ  సమాజం నుండి విమర్శలకు గురవుతారు. పోరాటాలతో నిండిన వారి జీవిత కథను తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ?అయితే రంగనాయకమ్మ గారు రచించిన "బలిపీఠం" అనే ఆడియో కథను వినండి.

rich-dad-poor-dad-29.title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
rich-dad-poor-dad-29.description: Irandu appakaludan vazharum robertkku,rendu appavalayum panathai pathi vevveru puridhal varudhu.kadaisiya yendha appa sonadha follow panni vazhkaila jeicharungratha , panam sambathikura vazhimuraiyaa namakku solraru robert

dopamine-detox-2.title: Overcoming Dopamine Addiction
dopamine-detox-2.description: Kya aap bhi koi kaam concentration se nahi kar paate? Kya aapke liye kisi bhi kaam par focus karna mushkil hota hai? Aur aap har kaam ko bas taalte jaate hain? Then ho sakta hai aapko ek Detox ki zarurat ho, ye shabd sun-ne me jitna mushkil lagta hai utna mushkil samajhne me hai nahi, so hum kaunse Detox ki baat kar rahein hai and kaise aap is detox se apni life ko change kar sakte hai ye sab jaan-ne ke liye suniye humari ye audiobook. To bina time waste kiye shuru karte hai.

the-power-of-subconscious-mind-6.title: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind
the-power-of-subconscious-mind-6.description: Aazh Manasudaiya sakthiya payanpaduthi arogyamaana, selva sezhippaana, magizhchigaramaana  vazhkaiya vaazhrathu eppadinu intha audiobook explain pannuthu. Intha book la sollirukka visayangala follow panni unga vaazhkaiya semmaiyaa maathunga !

singhobahini-jagadhatri.title: Pujo Barshiki: Singhobahini Jagadhatri
singhobahini-jagadhatri.description: Jagadhatri Puja Name Shunlei Jeta Sobar Prothome Mathaya Asey Seta Holo Chandannagar. Kintu Janen Ki Kivabe Ekhane Shuru Holo Ei Puja? Debi Jagadhatri Er Aabirvab Kivabe Holo? Keno Debir Bahoner Niche Rakha Thake Hostimundo? Kemon Chilo Bankim Chandra Er Debi Vabna? Eirokom Aaro Onek Jana-Ajana Kahini Jante eEi Durga Pujo E Aapnake Shuntei Hobe Puja Barshiki r Ei Audiobook.

jung-1.title: Jung
jung-1.description: 1800 mein Konkan rajya ke jangalon mein base kabilon par hamla hota hai aur us kabilon ki saari ladkiyon ko rajmahal ke sainik utha le jaate hain. Unhein wapas laane ke liye Bheema Konkan rajya jaata hai, jahan use pata chalta hai ki yeh saazish rajya ke Maharaj ki nahi balki unke neeche baithe logon ki hai. Vo samriddh rajya andar se khokhla hota ja raha tha. Aakhir kaise Bheema un ladkiyon ko bachayega aur is rajneeti ka pardafash karega?

why-mental-health-is-important.title: Why Mental Health Is Important?
why-mental-health-is-important.description: మానసికంగా ఆరోగ్యంగా ఉండాలంటే ఏమి చెయ్యాలి? మానసిక ఆరోగ్య ప్రభావం మన జీవితం మీద ఎలా ఉంటుంది ? మీకు అవగాహనను ఇచ్చే మంచి ఆడియోబుక్ మీకోసం.

villunaama.title: Villunaama
villunaama.description: తనకంటూ ఎవరూ లేని అనాథ అర్జున్‌కి ఓ కోటీశ్వరుడు తన 500 ఎకరాల మామిడి తోటను వీలునామాలో రాసి పెట్టి చనిపోతాడు. అసలు తనకు పరిచయమే లేని వ్యక్తి ఇంత పెద్ద ఆస్తిని తనకెందుకు ఇచ్చాడో అర్థం కాక అర్జున్ అయోమయంలో పడతాడు. ఆ వీలునామా తర్వాత అతని జీవితమే ఊహించని మలుపు తిరుగుతుంది. తోటలో దొరికిన ఓ పాత డైరీని తెరిచిన క్షణం నుంచి, అర్జున్‌కు తన గతం గురించి దాచిన ఓ భయంకరమైన నిజం తెలుస్తుంది. ఆ డైరీలోని ప్రతి పేజీ అతన్ని తన అసలు గమ్యం వైపు నడిపిస్తుంది.

ribhu.title: Ribhu
ribhu.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

3b12f222-e85a-4ce6-80a8-8f107016e091.title: Mental Chemistry
3b12f222-e85a-4ce6-80a8-8f107016e091.description: Zindagi ke challenges ko kaise handle karein? Aaj ke iss khaas show mein jaaniye kaise apne thoughts ko control karke aap apni life ko behtar bana sakte hain. Charles F. Haanel ki book se inspired ye show aapko dikhayega positive thinking ki taqat!

improve-your-memory-power-1.title: Improve Your Memory Power
improve-your-memory-power-1.description: Dhorun Aapni Ekta Kaj Korlen, Kintu Kichukkhon Por Ki Korlen Seta Mone Kortei Parchen Na. Aabar Dhorun Aapnar Sontan Din-Rat Porche Kintu Kichutei Pora Mone Rakhte Parche Na, Jarfole Porikkhar Somoy Result Valo Hocche Na. Ki Vabchen ? Emonta Aapnar Songeo Hoy ? Khub Chintay Din Katche ? Vabchen Kivabe Smriti Shoktir Unnoti Ghotano Jay ? Aapnar Eisob Proshner Somadhan Dite Kuku Fm Niye Elo ' Improve Your Memory Power ' Boiti. Ei Boite Emonkichu Anushilon Er Kotha Bola Hoyeche Ja Follow Korte Parle Smrti Shoktir Unnoti Ghotano Somvob Ebong Jibone Sofolotar Rasta Khuje Payoya Jete Pare. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Aashun Shune Neyoya Jak.

woh-jo-ladki-thi.title: Woh Jo Ladki Thi
woh-jo-ladki-thi.description: When a buried past resurfaces, District Magistrate Divakar Jha is forced to confront Sunaina, the love he lost eighteen years ago. As long-hidden secrets threaten his marriage, Divakar must uncover the truth before he loses everything.

ncert-class-12th-political-science-part-.title: NCERT Class 12th Political Science Part-2
ncert-class-12th-political-science-part-.description: Yeh Class 12th ki NCERT Political Science Part-2 book ki complete explanation hai. Ise sun kar aap Challenges of Nation-Building, India’s External Relations, Challenges to and Restoration of the Congress System, Regional Aspirations, Recent Developments in Indian Politics jaise topics ko ache se samajh jaayenge. Ismein har topic se jude examples aur important questions bhi bataye gaye hain, jo aapko exam ki taiyari mein aur bhi zyaada help karenge. Agar aap UPSC ki taiyaari kar rahe hain toh yeh information aapke liye kaafi helpful rahegi.

a549fa1d-fd09-4a88-94c9-c1a4523e1ec2.title: सफलता का मंत्र: Buddh Ka Gyan
a549fa1d-fd09-4a88-94c9-c1a4523e1ec2.description: Kaise ek naujawan ne apni haar ko jeet mein badla? Suniye, Buddha ki kahani se prerna lekar kaise jeeti har asambhav jung!

amara-bharatha.title: Amara Bharatha
amara-bharatha.description: ಭಾರತ, ಇದು ನಿಲ್ಲದ ನಾಗರಿಕತೆಯ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿದ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಇತರ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಗಳ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ನೋಡಿದೆ.  ಆದರೆ ಕೆಲವು ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಕುಸಿತದ ನಂತರ, ಇದು ಪುನಃ ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ದಾರಿ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ.  ಭಾರತ. ಹಿಂದುಸ್ತಾನ್. ಭಾರತ. ಹೆಸರಗಳು ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು, ಆದರೆ ಈ ಮಹಾನ್ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಆತ್ಮ ಅಮರವಾಗಿದೆ. ಅಮೀಶ್ ಅವರು, ತೀಕ್ಷ್ಣ ಲೇಖನಗಳು, ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಭಾಷಣಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕರ ಚರ್ಚೆಗಳ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ, ನೀವು ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ಎಂದೆಂದಿಗೂ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಹಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

ஒன்மோர்-எக்ஸார்சிஸ்ட்.title: One More Exorcist
ஒன்மோர்-எக்ஸார்சிஸ்ட்.description: Exorcist movie parthuttu vantha ramanujam & lakshmi couple ku pirantha kuzhanthai udane pesa aarambikkithu. valarumbothu pala vinotha seyalgala seyyaraan. Avanai polave sakthi irukkara ponna kalyanam senji vaikraanga... Athukku piragu nadanthathu thaan One More Exorcist.

not-just-a-civil-servant-2.title: Anil Swarup Er Jiboni
not-just-a-civil-servant-2.description: Sarkari adhikarik bolte amra ja bujhi sudhui name, josh, khyati, kintu pordar opare thik koto ta ondhokar lukiye thake amra jani na. Tader  porisrom amra janteo pari na. Lekhok nije ekjon IAS officer chilen, tar IAS howa theke dirgho kormo jiboner golpo.Proti baar e desh e jokhon kono somoshya dekha geche onar name uthe eseche. Tini sorbodai bhebechen ki bhabe sadharon manusher sahajyo kora jaye. Amra anek somoye dekhechi khomotar kache sarakari officer der bikri hoye jete. Apnar jogyotai apnar porichoy. Onar jounery er byapar e aro bistarito bhabe jante shune nin ei boi tir sarangsho.

sound-of-romance.title: Sound of Romance
sound-of-romance.description: తన తండ్రి కి ఎదురు చెప్పలేని వైష్ణవి, సూర్యను పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటుంది. సూర్యకు అంజలి మీద ఫీలింగ్స్ ఉన్నాయి కానీ ఆ ఫీలింగ్స్ ఏంటో క్లారిటీ లేదు. సరిగ్గా ఇదే సమయంలో, సూర్య బలవంతం చేయడంతో సూర్య మరదలు ప్రేరణ, అర్జున్ ల పెళ్లి అయిపోతుంది. కానీ కాలేజీ టైం నుండి శ్యామ్ ని ప్రేమిస్తున్న ప్రేరణ, తన భర్త అర్జున్ కి దగ్గరవుతుందా? సూర్య వైష్ణవిల జంట పెళ్లి తర్వాత ప్రేమగా కాపురం చేస్తారా? మరి అంజలి పరిస్థితి ఏంటి?

ಅಘೋರಿಗಳ-ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ.title: Aghorigala Lokadalli
ಅಘೋರಿಗಳ-ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ.description: ಅಘೋರಿ.! ಈ ಹೆಸ್ರು ಕೇಳಿದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು, ಅರೆ ಕ್ಷಣ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿ ಬೀಳೋರು ಹಲವರು. ಅವ್ರು ನರಭಕ್ಷಕರಂತೆ! ಶವದ ಜೊತೆ ಸಂಭೋಗ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರಂತೆ! ಸ್ಮಶಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರಂತೆ! ದೀರ್ಘಾಯುಷ್ಯ ಇವರಿಗೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿರೋ ವರವಂತೆ! ಹೀಗೆ ಹಲವು ಅಂತೆಕಂತೆಗಳನ್ನ ನೀವೆಲ್ಲರೂ ಕೇಳಿಯೇ ಇರ್ತೀರಿ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಸತ್ಯ ಏನು.? ಇದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯೋ ಕುತೂಹಲ ನಿಮಗೂ ಇದ್ರೆ, ಈಗ್ಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಅಘೋರಿಗಳ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ!

nagalinga-silai-marmam.title: Nagalinga Silai Marmam
nagalinga-silai-marmam.description: செவ்வந்தி புரத்தில் நடக்கும் அமானுஷ்யங்களுக்கும், மர்மமான கொலைகளுக்கும் பின்னால் இருப்பது கடவுளா இல்லை மனிதனா?

how-to-move-to-us-for-studies-1.title: How to Move to US for Studies
how-to-move-to-us-for-studies-1.description: US la Higher studies Padikkanum nu aasa padravangalukku indha padhivu oru Vazhikaati. America Naatoda Culture, Padikkiradhuku thevaiyaana Scholarship , Bank Loan, VISA edukuradhukaana Guidelines, Best Universities details, Entrance Exam details, nu yegappatta thagavalgal indha padhivu la irukku. Vaanga Therinjukalaam.

ye-meri-zameen-hai.title: Ye Meri Zameen Hai
ye-meri-zameen-hai.description: Yeh Meri Zameen is a small-town family drama about the powerful Sharmas and the humble Vermas. When the Sharmas illegally encroach on the land outside the Vermas' home and block their main entrance to make room for their eldest son's grand wedding, no one dares stand up to them. The helpless Vermas call home their son Kabir, a PWD officer, to fight back. What starts as a blocked doorway becomes a battle of power against law, arrogance against justice, and two families who refuse to back down.

dhurandhar-in-train.title: Dhurandhar in Train
dhurandhar-in-train.description:
Rajveer Goenka, the CEO of a railway catering empire, boards his own train in disguise after a viral video threatens to bring everything crashing down.
No one knows who he is. Not the corrupt staff. Not the passengers hunting for a rumoured billionaire. Not Pritha — the one person on the train who isn't impressed by any of it.
This is a story of Rajveer — a man who had to lose his name to find the truth.

my-dear-ceo.title: My Dear CEO
my-dear-ceo.description:
కార్తీక్, ఒక ఎమ్మెన్సీ కంపెనీ సీఈఓగా ఉన్న అతను, కొన్ని గంటల క్రితమే తన జీవితంలో అపూర్వమైన స్థానంలో ఉన్నాడు. కానీ ఇప్పుడు అతని పరిస్థితి పూర్తిగా మారిపోయి, జీరోగా నిలిచిపోయాడు.  

పుట్టినప్పటి నుంచి అతను వినిపించిన మాట ఒకటే: "జీవితంలో సెటిల్ అవ్వాలంటే బాగా చదువుకోవాలి, బాగా సంపాదించాలి." ఇంజనీర్ లేదా డాక్టర్ అయ్యే మార్గాన్నే విజయానికి సరైనదిగా భావించిన సమాజం, చిన్న వయసులోనే కార్తీక్ మెదడులో దీన్ని పాతుకువేసింది.  

అతని తల్లిదండ్రులు చదువులో ఎడ్యుకేటెడ్ అయినప్పటికీ, ప్రేమ కంటే చదువు, కృషి, ఫలితాల సాధనే అతనికి పరిచయం చేశారు. చిన్నప్పటి నుంచే అతని జీవితంలో వెకేషన్స్, పిక్నిక్స్ వంటి సరదా క్షణాలకు చోటు లేదు. ఫోన్ మాత్రమే అతని ఏకైక సరదా సాధనంగా మారింది.  

ఈ పరిస్థితులన్నీ కార్తీక్ జీవితానికి ఏం నేర్పించాయి?

India-Vs-Pakistan--ক্রিকেটের-মহাযুদ্ধ-.title: India Vs Pakistan : Cricketer Mohajuddho
India-Vs-Pakistan--ক্রিকেটের-মহাযুদ্ধ-.description: Cricket England-Er Matite Shuru Holeo Pray Gota Biswer Jonopriyota Bereche. Aar Sei Cricket Match Jodi Hoy India Vs Pakistan, Tahole To Aar Kono Kothai Nei. Ei Match Shudhu Ekta Match Noy , Jeno Mohajuddho. Aar Cricket Mather Ei Lorai Ghire Unmadonar Parod Thake Chorome. Ei Loraiyer Shuru Kiavbe Holo? Echarao Ei Dui Desher Khelar Mather Kichu Khutinati Golpo Jene Nebo Ei Audiobook Theke.

the-little-book-of-common-sense-investin.title: The Little Book of Common Sense Investing
the-little-book-of-common-sense-investin.description: Vambichcha nettangal kottikhoshikkunna share market vaagdhnangalil kudungathe surakshithamayum sthirathayodeyum niksheppikkan ningale sahayikkunna oru mikacha pusthakamanu 'The Little Book of Common Sense Investing'.

abc-17.title: Kaise Milegi Entry Level Jobs - Apna jobs ke sath
abc-17.description:
Dosto India me 66% of population filhal 35 years se niche ki age ki hai, aur sabhi ko ek job chahiye. kayi baar logo ko apne skills ke according entry level job role nahi milte ,Ya phir unhe achhi Jobs ke application ke liye Platform nahi milta ,  yahi confusions dur karega ye show jaha par 10th pass students se lekar HR, B.com , IT graduates ko Jobs ke liye milegi Tips and Proper Guidance in association with Apna Jobs. Aap bhi Apna Jobs par register karke apni job hunting ko smooth bansakte hai. Register karne ke liye login kijiye at https://l.apna.co/KukuFm
 Career options and interview skills

the-adventures-of-detective-arjun-biswas.title: The Adventures Of Detective Arjun Biswas
the-adventures-of-detective-arjun-biswas.description: বিখ্যাত ডিটেকটিভ অর্জুন বিশ্বাস একের পর এক কেস সল্ভ করেন, কিন্তু কল্যাণীতে এক সিরিয়াল কিলার খুন করতেই থাকে যেখানে কিছু ক্লু পাওয়া যায় না। কীভাবে ধরবে অর্জুন এই সিরিয়াল কিলারকে?

the-price-of-love-1.title: The Price of Love
the-price-of-love-1.description: A billionaire fashion empire owner secretly lives as an ordinary tailor to earn his wife's genuine love. But when her obsession with wealth, betrayal, and greed pushes their marriage to the brink, he must decide whether to keep protecting her with his love or reveal the truth that could change everything.

whole-numbers-and-half-truths.title: Numbers Se Janiye India Ki Sachai
whole-numbers-and-half-truths.description: 21st century me aaj jab bhi koi problem ko face karne ki baat hoti hai tab sab Numbers aur Data ki taraf muh karte hain, Par kya India ko samajne ke liye Data enough hai? Billion logo ki aabadi wale desh ko agar aap sirf number se samjhane ki try karenge to aap problem nahi samjh payenge. Chaliye Jaante hain saare official data aur unke aadhe sach ko aur janne ki koshish karte hain ke modern India ka sach aur bhavishya kya hai?

shrikant-4.title: Shrikant 4
shrikant-4.description: Shrikant: ek shaks ki anokhi kahani  hai jo apni pehchaan aur sapnon ki talaash mein hai. Kya woh apni manzil tak pahunch paayega? Is audiobook mein janiye uthal-puthal se bhari uski Zindagi ki kahani.

jail-diary-of-bhagat-singh.title: Jail Diary of Bhagat Singh
jail-diary-of-bhagat-singh.description:
Inquilab Zindabad!
Bhagat Singh சிறையில் எழுதிய டைரியின் சில முக்கிய பக்கங்கள்!
கேளுங்க “Jail Diary of Bhagat Singh”

valayam.title: വലയം
valayam.description: പാളയം എന്ന സൂപ്പർഹിറ്റ് നോവലിന്റെ രണ്ടാം ഭാഗം!  ലോറിക്കാരൻ നോബിളിനെയും അവൻ സ്വന്തമാക്കിയ ജാൻസിയെയും കാത്തിരിക്കുന്നത് വലിയ അപകടങ്ങളാണ്. പ്രണയം, വേർപാട്, പ്രതികാരം, സസ്പെൻസ്, ആക്ഷൻ - ഇവയെല്ലാം ചേർന്ന വികാര തീവ്രമായ ഒരു ത്രില്ലർ!

the-miracle-morning-4.title: The Miracle Morning
the-miracle-morning-4.description: Jeevithathil vijayikkunnathinayi nammude jeevitha reethiyil, prethyekichu raavilathe sheelangalil, enthoke matangal varuthanam ennu namuku parichayapeduth tharunna pusthakamanu 'The Miracle Morning'.

haunted-by-reapers-devotion.title: Haunted by Reaper's Devotion
haunted-by-reapers-devotion.description:
What happens when the Reaper, who is the very embodiment of death, becomes her protector?

After a brush with death, Morgana Darkwood awakens with a haunting new ability: she can see ghosts and the enigmatic Grim Reaper himself. As she unravels the mystery of her parents' disappearance, she was drawn into a world of underground realm and supernatural forces. Caught between the Reaper's obsessive protection and malevolent entities, she must decide if his devotion is her salvation or her doom!

locker-number-33.title: Locker Number 33
locker-number-33.description: Golper Ek Prodhan Choritro Urmiala Basu Ovijog Koren Tar Bank-Er Locker Er Chabi Churi Kore Paliyeche Tar Barir Kajer Lok Minu, Todonto Shuru Kore Police. Kintu Todonto Shuru Hotei Samne Aasey Shihoron Jagano Ek Chancholoyokor Sotyo. Tantan Ruddhoswas Sei Kahini Jante Ekkhuni Shune Nin Debarati Mukhopadhyay-Er Lekha Golpo Locker Numbar 33.

500-करोड़-का-मुर्दा---लेखक--अनिल-गर्ग.title: 500 करोड़ का मुर्दा
500-करोड़-का-मुर्दा---लेखक--अनिल-गर्ग.description: Sheher ke sabse Bade Rahis Ramchandra Goyenka ki Beti- Rama – jo ki 500 Crore ki malkin hei, aachanak se gayab ho jati hei. Usse Dhund ne ke liye ek Kabil Jasoos Anuj ko bulaya jaata hei. Yeh kahani ussi ke jasoosi aur ameero ke sath hoti Darindgi ki hei. Kya Rama anth mei milti hei? Kya usse kissi ne sahi mein Gayab kiya tha ya thi kissi ki koi bhayanak chal? Jaane  ke liye suniye yeh kahani- 500 Crore ka Murda

psychology-of-success-2.title: Psychology of Success
psychology-of-success-2.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋ ಕನಸು ಇರುತ್ತೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎದುರಾಗೋ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನ ಎದುರಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಜನ ಸೋತಿರ್ತಾರೆ! ಲೈಫು ಇಷ್ಟೇನೇ ಅಂತಾ ಕೈ ಚೆಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತಿರ್ತಾರೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಸೋಲನ್ನ‌ ಗೆಲುವಿನ ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಬದುಕನ್ನ ಬ್ಯೂಟಿಫುಲ್ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಹೇಗೆ? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಸೈಕಾಲಜಿ ಆಫ್ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

deadly-cure.title: Deadly Cure
deadly-cure.description: In 1899 Brooklyn, Dr. Noah Whitestone faces accusations of medical malpractice after a wealthy neighbor's child dies following his emergency treatment. Convinced of foul play, Noah investigates alongside a muckraking journalist and a radical editor, uncovering a sinister connection between experimental German drugs and multiple children's deaths. His pursuit of truth draws him into a deadly web of crime, politics, and pharmaceutical conspiracy.

louder-than-words.title: Non Verbal Communication: Speak Without Words
louder-than-words.description: Agar aapko lagta hai ke aapko apni baat logon tak pahunchaane mein dikkat hoti hai to yeh kitaab aapke liye hai. Communication sirf shabdon ke saath nahi hoti. Vigyaan Kehta hai ke 70% se zyada communication Non verbal hoti hai yaani shabdon ke bina. Agar aap bhi apne non verbal skills ko polish karna chhate hain to suniye yeh show "Non verbal communication" Sirf KukuFM par.

1951-war-without-bullet.title: 1951: War Without Bullet
1951-war-without-bullet.description: 1951: War Without Bullet is the untold story of the man who built the world's largest democratic exercise from scratch. Erased women's names, illiterate voters who cannot read a ballot, floods, sabotaged symbols, a missing candidate, a broken seal — every obstacle threatens to prove the skeptics right. A gripping procedural drama about the true price of making every single vote count.

the-rise-and-fall-of-vijay-deverakonda.title: The Rise And Fall Of Vijay Deverakonda
the-rise-and-fall-of-vijay-deverakonda.description:
అర్జున్ రెడ్డి తో ఒక్క రాత్రిలో స్టార్‌గా వెలుగులోకి వచ్చాడు.
కానీ ఎదుగుదల ఎంత వేగంగా జరిగిందో… పతనమూ అంతే వేగంగా వచ్చింది.
ప్రతి అడుగూ ప్రశ్నల నడుమ. ప్రతి సినిమాకూ విరోధాల పర్వం.
ఒకప్పుడు పీక్ craze ని ఎంజాయ్ చేసిన హీరో… ఇప్పుడు మౌనంలో తన సమాధానాల కోసం వెతుకుతున్నాడు.

ఇది కేవలం ఓ హీరో కథ కాదు —
ఇది ఓ మనిషి ఒంటరి పోరాటం.
తన కోసం… తన అభిమానుల కోసం… తన నిజమైన ‘నేను’ కోసం.

trapped-in-love-1.title: Trapped in Love
trapped-in-love-1.description:
In this gripping tale of love, duty, and family legacy, Damien Winthrop finds himself torn between his dying father's wishes and his own desires. As the heir to a vast business empire, Damien's life takes an unexpected turn when he's saved by Jane, a humble village girl. His father, Lucien, sees in Jane the perfect partner for Damien and makes a shocking request on his deathbed: for them to marry. 

Caught between his love for his fiancée Mia, his respect for his father, and the unexpected connection he feels with Jane, Damien must navigate a web of family expectations, corporate responsibilities, and matters of the heart. As the clock ticks on Lucien's final days, Damien grapples with an impossible choice that could change the course of his life forever. Will he follow his heart or fulfill his father's last wish?

maharashtracha-shaheer.title: 'Maharashtracha Shahirachi' Gatha
maharashtracha-shaheer.description: Maharashtra nehmich aplya Paramparik Sanskruti mule, Kalemule prakash zotat rahila ahe. Maharashtracha Lok kaletil ek gajlela prakar mhnje Powada! ‘Jay Jay Maharashtra Maza’ ha powada aaj hi aiktana Uur abhimanane bharun yeto. Ha powada aplyala denare thor kalawanta mhnje Shahir Sable. Manoranjana sobatch Samajik kranti ghadvnyache atulniya karya Shahir Sable yani kele. Akuyat, ya thor vyaktitvachi Jeevangatha...

681c07a4-ea9c-43d4-94d7-c933664252bb.title: Secret Bigbull
681c07a4-ea9c-43d4-94d7-c933664252bb.description: வெற்றி ஒரு வேலை இல்லாத கணவன். ஜிம்முக்குச் செல்வதும், வீட்டில் சமைப்பதும் அவனது அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை. ஆனால் அவனுக்குள் இந்திய பங்குச்சந்தையை ஆட்டிப்படைக்கும் மர்ம கோடீஸ்வரர் “Mr. Bull” மறைந்திருக்கிறார். அவனை அவமானப்படுத்திய மனைவி ஜனனியே, தன் நிறுவனத்தை காப்பாற்ற அவருடைய முதலீட்டை நாடும்போது, உண்மை ஆபத்தான விளையாட்டாக மாறுகிறது.

deh-zala-chandanacha.title: Deh Zala Chandanacha
deh-zala-chandanacha.description: Explore the divine and the spiritual on Kuku FM where faith meets wisdom and tradition intertwines with enlightenment. Our Religion & Spirituality category offers a sanctuary of audio shows that delve into ancient texts spiritual teachings and life lessons from revered figures. Ideal for those seeking solace understanding and a deeper connection with the universe. Listen now and  embark on a soulful journey that nurtures the spirit expands the mind and enriches the heart.

2025-ka-stock-portfolio-kaise-hona-chahi.title: 2025 Ka Stock Portfolio Kaise Hona Chahiye
2025-ka-stock-portfolio-kaise-hona-chahi.description:
2025 mein market kahan jayega? Complete portfolio planning with sector-wise strategy!
Bear market se bull market tak, har situation ke liye perfect investment plan.

unconventional-pyar.title: Unconventional Pyaar
unconventional-pyar.description: उलझे हुए जज़्बातों को मुक़म्मल करने की कोशिश

1-hinduo-ke-vrat-parv-evam-teej-tyohar.title: Hinduo Ke Vrat-Parv Evam Teej Tyohar
1-hinduo-ke-vrat-parv-evam-teej-tyohar.description: Bharat ek Adhyatmik Bhumi hai jisme hazaro salo se sanatan hindu dharm ka ullekh milta hai, Hindu dharm shuru se hi apni ishwar ke prati vishwas aur manyataon ke liye jana jata hai jisme bahut se parv, vrat aur tyohar sammilit hai. Is AudioBook mein aap un sab ke bare mein sahi jankari prapt kar sakte hai jaise, Gangaur/Gauri Tritiya, Nirjala Ekadashi, Guru Poornima, Sri Krishna Janmashtami, Navratri/ Durga Pujan, Karva Chauth, Ahoi Ashtami, Devotthani Ekadashi, Mahashivratri, Sri Satyanarayana Vrat Katha aur Hindu dharm ke Tyohar jaise Holi, Diwali, Dussehra, Rakshabandhan, Shivaratri, Ganga Snan, Chatt Puja Ityadi.

aagontuk.title: Aagontuk
aagontuk.description: Embark on extraordinary adventures with Kuku FM's Fantasy & SciFi collection. From epic quests in magical realms to interstellar explorations our shows offer an escape into worlds beyond imagination. Meet intriguing characters mythical creatures and face challenges that defy the laws of nature. Perfect for dreamers and adventurers tune in to start your journey into the unknown.

बीच-हाउस--लेखक--मनीष-पाण्डेय-रूद्र.title: बीच हाउस
बीच-हाउस--लेखक--मनीष-पाण्डेय-रूद्र.description: Goa ka beach house... jo rahasya aur romanch se bhara hai. Uski sacchai kya hai aaj tak koi nahi jaanta. Lekin is haunted house ke taar Vedika ke parivaar se juda hua hai. Ajnabee kabeer ke saath vedika pahuchti hai beach house, jaha pahle se kuch log pahuch chuke pahle se kuch chuka hai. Kaun hai ye log? Kya Vedika sachai jaan paayegi? Kabeer kaun hai aur wah Vedika ki madad kya karna chahte hai? Beach house se aati khaufnaak cheekhe kiski hai? Jaan ne ke liye sune puri kahani keval KuKU FM par.

brahmanda-manava-itihasa.title: Brahmanda Manava Itihasa
brahmanda-manava-itihasa.description: ಸುಮಾರು 5೦೦೦೦ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಉಪಕರಣಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಧುನಿಕಗೊಂಡವು ಹಾಗೂ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವೃದ್ಧಿಸಿತು. ಬಿಲ್ಲು ಬಾಣಗಳು, ಭಾಷೆಯ ಬಳಕೆ, ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸಹಕಾರ, ಜ್ಞಾನ ವೃದ್ಧಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಜ್ಞಾನದ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆಗಳಿಂದ ಮಾನವನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿಯಾದನು. ಅದೇ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾನವರು ಆಫ್ರಿಕಾ ಖಂಡದಿಂದ ಹೊರನಡೆದು ವಿಶ್ವದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮೂಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹರಡಿಕೊಂಡರು. ಮಾನವರು ಆಫ್ರಿಕಾದಿಂದಲೇ ವಿಕಾಸಗೊಂಡು ಹೊರಗೆ ಬಂದು, ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಡೆ ಹರಡಿಕೊಂಡರು ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಪುರಾವೆಗಳು ಇವೆ. ಅನುವಂಶಿಕ (DNA & Genetics) ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಇದು ದೃಢಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ. L3 ಹೆಂಗಸು ಎಂಬುವವಳು (L3 Woman) ಆಫ್ರಿಕಾದ ಹೊರಗೆ ಇರುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಾನವರಿಗೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಆಫ್ರಿಕಾದ ಒಳಗೆ ಇರುವ ಕೆಲವು ಮಾನವರಿಗೆ ಪೂರ್ವಜಳು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಅನುವಂಶಿಕ (mitochondria) ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಸಾಬೀತಾಗಿದೆ. ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಮೂಲ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಲೇಖಕರಾದ ಮಡಿವಾಳಪ್ಪ ತಟ್ಟಿಮನಿ ಬರೆದಿರುವ "ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಂಡ ಮಾನವ ಇತಿಹಾಸ" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್‌ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

mahabali.title: Mahabali
mahabali.description: MLA Vikram ki body ko take over kar liya hai Tretayug ke Raja Nahush ne aur ab Nahush ko chahiye total power. Par use nahi pata ki purane samay ke kuch aur log bhi hain is power race mein. Kya Nahush wapas apna samrajya sthapit kar payega? Kya hoga asli Vikram ka? Kaun hai ye Gilgamesh, jiske inscription mein ek bade yuddh ka description hai? Janne ke liye sunein Mahabali, sirf KUKU FM par...

sadhok-bamakhyapa.title: Sadhok Bamakhyapa
sadhok-bamakhyapa.description: Sadhok Bamakhyapar kichu jana ojana kahini jante shune nin, ke chilen ei Bamakhyapa, ki bhabe holen tini hole Maa kalir porom bhakto. Ki bhabe holen tini maa er khyapa chele? Tantra swadhana kibhabe tar kache biswaykor swadhona hoye othe e jante shune nin Maa Kalir porom bhakto Sadhok Bamakhyapa.

Instant-అల్లుడు-.title: Instant Alludu
Instant-అల్లుడు-.description: ఆస్తి కోసం ప్రేమించిన వాడిని కాదని ఒక డెలివరీ బాయ్ ని పెళ్లి చేసుకున్న అనూష. తనను పెళ్లి చేసుకున్నాక తన జీవితంలో ఎలాంటి సమస్యలను ఎదుర్కొంది అనేది ఈ మన Instant అల్లుడు కథ.

കുഞ്ഞിപ്പാക്കാന്‍.title: കുഞ്ഞിപ്പാക്കന്‍
കുഞ്ഞിപ്പാക്കാന്‍.description: കേരളത്തിന്റെ പഴയകാല ഗ്രാമീണ പശ്ചാത്തലത്തിൽ ഒരുക്കിയിരിക്കുന്ന കുഞ്ഞിപ്പാക്കൻ എന്ന നോവൽ, ചെറുപ്പം മുതലേ സമൂഹത്തിലെ   ജാതിയുടെയും ജന്മത്തിന്റെയും അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിലുള്ള വിവേചനം അനുഭവിക്കുന്ന കുഞ്ഞിപ്പാകൻ എന്ന കൊച്ചു പയ്യന്റെ കഥ പറയുന്നു. അവന്റെ നിഷ്കളങ്കമായ ചോദ്യങ്ങളും പ്രതികരണങ്ങളും പാട്ടുമുള്ള ലോകത്തിലേക്ക് ഒരു യാത്ര പോകാം.

nixiddho-obhixaar.title: Nixiddho Obhixaar
nixiddho-obhixaar.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

Buddh-Sootra-संकट-से-समाधान-की-राह.title: Buddh Sootra: संकट से समाधान की राह
Buddh-Sootra-संकट-से-समाधान-की-राह.description: Zindagi mein aane wali samasyaein kab chinta bankar dimag mein ghar bana leti hain pata hi nahi chalta. phir din raat vo chinta aapko satati rehti hai. Inhi chintaon se mukt hone ki raah dikhate hain Buddh. Toh abhi suniye yeh Original Show aur apni zindagi ki har samasya ka samadhan kariye.

think-and-grow-rich-34.title: Vichar kara ani Shrimanta vha
think-and-grow-rich-34.description: Tumhala Tumchi Nirasha dur Karyachi ahe ka?  Ayushat Ashecha Navin Kiran Anaycha Ahe Ka ?  Tar Napoleon Hill Yancha Thiink And Grow Rich Hey pustak Tumchya Sathi Perfect Ahe. Aplya Ayusha Ajun Sukhakar kas Banvaycha? Aplya Vicharanmule Apan Shirmanta Kasa Hou Shakto Ya Baddal Kahi Tricks Ani Tips Lekhak Sangtat. Lekhakane ya Pustakat Anek Udharan Deun Ekhadya Desscion Var Apla Man Firm Asel Tar kay Fayde Hou Shaktat Ya Baddalhi Sangitla Ahe.

తెన్నేటి-సూరి-రచనలు-మొదటవ-సంపుటం-.title: తెన్నేటి సూరి రచనలు మొదటవ సంపుటం
తెన్నేటి-సూరి-రచనలు-మొదటవ-సంపుటం-.description: తెన్నేటి సూరి రచనలు అంటే ఒక ఊతం, జీవిత శైలిని ఎలా మలచుకోవాలో చెప్పే ఒక ముఖ్యమైన పాఠం. ఎప్పటికప్పుడు మనుషులు మారుతూ వస్తున్నా, మళ్ళీ మన ఉనికిని వెలుగు తియ్యడానికి అవసరం అయ్యేది మాత్రం ఇలాంటి కొన్ని రచనలే.  అలాంటి  రచనలు మళ్ళీ మీ ముందుకు తీసుకుని వచ్చే ప్రయత్నమే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్.

aanati-vaana-chinukulu.title: Aanati Vaana Chinukulu
aanati-vaana-chinukulu.description: దర్శకుడు వంశీ రచనా ప్రతిభ అందరికీ తెలిసిందే. ప్రతి పుస్తకం వెనుక ఒక లోతైన ఆలోచన ఉంటుంది. "ఆనాటి వాన చినుకులు" పుట్టింది 25 సంవత్సరాల క్రితం ఒక గూడు రిక్షా మీద చూసిన ఒక వాక్యం నుండి — అది అతన్ని ఆలోచనల్లోకి నెట్టింది. ఆ స్ఫూర్తితో వంశీ మానవత్వం మరియు మానవ సంబంధాల చుట్టూ అల్లిన 24 అద్భుతమైన కథలను మన ముందుకు తెచ్చారు. మీ హృదయాన్ని తాకే ఈ అపూర్వమైన సంకలనాన్ని ఇప్పుడే వినండి

the-pawn.title: The Pawn
the-pawn.description: Gabriel Miller swept into my life like a storm. He tore down my father with cold retribution leaving him penniless in a hospital bed. I quit my private all-girls college to take care of the only family I have left. There's one way to save our house one thing I have left of value. My body- A forbidden auction. Gabriel appears at every turn. He seems to take pleasure in watching me fall. Other times he's the only kindness in a brutal underworld. Except he's playing a deeper game than I know. Every move brings us together, every secret rips us apart. And when the final piece is played only one of us can be left standing. THE PAWN is a full-length contemporary novel from New York Times bestselling author Skye Warren about revenge and seduction in the game of love.

agnikanya.title: Agnikanya
agnikanya.description: Travel back in time with Kuku FM's History shows. Explore ancient civilizations pivotal moments and the people who shaped our world. Our engaging storytelling brings history to life making the past relevant and exciting. From legendary battles to cultural revolutions enrich your knowledge of the human saga. Listen and connect with the stories that define us

after-the-crash.title: After The Crash
after-the-crash.description: The story centers on Ramya, a doctor whose life becomes entangled with the powerful Luthra family and their hospitals, businesses, and hidden loyalties. It begins with medical emergencies, a missing heir, and the fear that a wealthy family secret will surface. Amar is repeatedly presumed dead, revived, and then returned with memory loss, which keeps everyone uncertain about who he is and whom he trusts. Ramya becomes his protector and caretaker, even as the family around him treats her as a threat. Nithya stands at the center of the opposition, using humiliation, guards, accusations, and family pressure to push Ramya out of both the hospital and the household. The conflict is not only personal but also tied to control of Luthra Hospital and Luthra Industries, where ownership, shares, and signatures become weapons. Ramya is denied work, mocked publicly, and even attacked, yet she continues to fight for patients and for the truth. Her medical skill eventually earns her a place in the hospital, but that success only deepens jealousy and sabotage from rivals. Amar’s bond with Ramya grows stronger through repeated crises, and he increasingly chooses her over wealth and status. At the same time, the family tries to force marriages, manage reputations, and hide damaging events, including a cover-up tied to disabled CCTV and earlier harm done to Ramya. Ramya’s claim that she is pregnant with Amar’s child adds another layer of tension and makes the struggle over Amar even more urgent. The family matriarch and other relatives repeatedly try to control the narrative, while Ramya insists on the truth and refuses to be bought off or driven away. Public confrontations in hospitals, hotels, and the family home turn every space into a battleground. Hidden identities are gradually exposed, including Amar’s link to the Luthra heir line and Ramya’s unexpected ownership of the hospital. These reversals shift the balance of power, but they do not end the conflict, because the family continues to challenge Ramya’s place. By the end of the batch digests, love, inheritance, pregnancy, and corporate control are all intertwined, and Ramya and Amar are reunited under intense scrutiny. The overall arc is one of a woman fighting for dignity and truth against a wealthy family determined to control both her future and Amar’s.

currency-wars-the-making-of-the-next-glo.title: Currency Ka Khel
currency-wars-the-making-of-the-next-glo.description: Hum sabne world wars ke bare mein to suna hai, magar kya aap jante hai usse bhi khatarnak ek aisa war hota hai jo sab kuch tabah kar deta hai, bina kisi ki jaan liye. Vo war duniya bhar ke deshon ki sarkar ladte hain, shatranj ki chaalon ki tarah aur usse kehte hain, Currency Wars, jise agar control nahi kiya to janiye iska impact kya ho sakta hai

oonjal.title: ஊஞ்சல்
oonjal.description: குழந்தைக்குள் ஊடுருவும் பேய், அதனால் ஏற்படும் குழப்பங்கள், அனைத்திற்கும் ஒரு ஊஞ்சல் காரணமாக இருக்கிறது.

17a641c2-06d7-41fb-93fe-4ca84de22c29.title: வழிப்போக்கன்
17a641c2-06d7-41fb-93fe-4ca84de22c29.description: உலகத்தில் எல்லோரும் வழிப்போக்கர்களே. ஒவ்வொருவரும் ஒவ்வொரு வழியில் போய்க் கொண்டு இருக்கிறார்கள். சிலர் எங்கே போகிறோம் என்கிற லட்சியம் இல்லாமலே போய் கொண்டு இருக்கிறார்கள், சிலர் இருட்டிலே நடக்கிறார்கள், சிலர் வழியிலேயே நடக்கிறார்கள், சிலர் ஒளியைத் தேடி நடக்கிறார்கள், சிலர் கல்லும் முள்ளும் நிறைந்த கரடு முரடான பாதையில் நடக்கிறார்கள். சிலர் பட்டு விரித்த பாதையில் நடக்கிறார்கள். இரண்டுங்கெட்ட இடர்ப்பட்ட நிலையில் இடை வழியிலேயே பயணத்தை முடித்துக் கொள்பவர்களும் பலர். அவ்வப்போது வறுமையின் கொடுமை பிடியிலிருந்து தன்னை விடுவித்துக்கொண்டு இடையிடையே குறுக்கிடும் இடையூறுகளையும் தோல்விகளையும் எதிர்த்துப் போராடிய வண்ணம் வாழ்க்கையை பஞ்சினும் லேசாக மதித்து புன்னகைத்தபடியே முன்னேற்றம் காண வழி தேடும் சுந்தரத்தின் கதைதான் இந்த வழிப்போக்கன்.

six-months-with-my-enemy.title: Six Months with My Enemy
six-months-with-my-enemy.description: Forced into a six-month marriage with arrogant coal baron Dev Singh, fearless coal loader Kajal faces constant humiliation and conspiracies inside the Singh Haveli. But she refuses to surrender, challenging his family and exposing their dark secrets. As Dev’s hatred turns into love, a deadly battle for power, betrayal, and truth threatens to tear them apart. Can their forced marriage survive the enemies determined to destroy them?

mechanic-millionaire.title: Mechanic Millionaire
mechanic-millionaire.description: மும்பை ஃப்ளைஓவருக்கு கீழே சாதாரண மெக்கானிக்காக வாழும் கரண், உண்மையில் கோடிக்கணக்கான ரூபாய் மதிப்புள்ள சாம்ராஜ்யத்தின் மர்மமான தலைவர். தங்கச்சி மைத்ரியின் திருமணத்தால் பணக்கார சிங்கானியா குடும்பத்துடன் மோதல் ஏற்பட, கரணின் மறைக்கப்பட்ட அடையாளம் வெளிவரத் தொடங்குகிறது. உலகமே அதிரும் உண்மை ஒன்று காத்திருக்கிறது—இந்த மெக்கானிக் தான் ஸ்டார் லார்ட்!

maut-ke-baad-kya.title: Maut Ke Baad Kya?
maut-ke-baad-kya.description: Alvida kehna kabhi aasan nahi hota, Lekin zindagi ka yeh hissa hamesha sath hota hai. Yeh kahani har insan ke aakhiri safar ko batati hai. Aur batati hai ki Maut Ke Baad Kya hota hai. To abhi suniye ye khas audiobook "Maut Ke Baad Kya?".

rani-ronangan.title: রানীর রণাঙ্গণ
rani-ronangan.description: রাণী বোস একজন হাই প্রোফাইল এস্কর্ট, কিন্তু নিজের জীবনে অনেক কষ্ট অবসানের জন্য তাকে এই জীবিকা বেছে নিতে হয়। একজন ট্র্যাভেল এজেন্ট তার অফিসের বাইরে হোটেলের সামনে দাঁড়ানো রানীকে দেখে পুরনো একজন চেনা মুখ খুঁজে পায়। রাণীর অতীত তার সামনে এসে দাঁড়ায় যা তার জীবন পরিবর্তন করে দেয়।

flatmate-se-forever.title: Flatmate se Forever
flatmate-se-forever.description: A small-town girl has one last shot at acting in Mumbai before her parents marry her off. At an audition, she bonds with a stranger — not knowing he's the casting director she just warned her about. He secretly fights for her dream. She accuses him of stealing it. The truth, when it arrives, changes everything.

coke-varalaaru.title: கோக் வரலாறு
coke-varalaaru.description: உலக மக்களின் உற்சாக பானமாக இருக்கும் கோக கோலா, முதன் முதலில் தலைவலிக்கான மருந்தாகத்தான் அறிமுகப்படுத்தப்பட்டது என்றால் நம்ப முடிகிறதா? எத்தனையோ உற்சாக பானங்கள் இருந்தாலும் "கோக கோலா" தனி சாம்ராஜ்யம். தனக்காக தனி ஒரு கோட்டையைக் கட்டிக்கொண்டு வாழும் அதன் கொடியை இறக்க இன்றுவரை எந்த சக்தியாலும் முடியவில்லை.

my-31-money-mistakes.title: 31 Financial Mistakes That Keep You Poor
my-31-money-mistakes.description: Shayad 21 din mein paisa double jaisa kuch hota, par afsos aisa hai nahi, lekin haan kuch  financial principles hai jinhe regularly discipline ke saath follow karne se aap fortune ko zarur attract karenge. Yeh audiobook aapke liye financial guide ke taur par hai. Agar aap kabhi kisi money related problem mein faste hai, to yeh audiobook aapko uss problem se nikalne mein help karegi aur aapko financial independence ki aur le jayegi. ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

talakhi.title: Talakhi
talakhi.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

03a93810-5419-4ccb-a1a1-9940dc997291.title: Kashmir : Zakhmi Sarhad Ki Dastaan
03a93810-5419-4ccb-a1a1-9940dc997291.description: Partition ke zakhamon mein na jaane kitne rishton ka dam toda tha. Ye dard itna hai ki Kashmir ke ped aur patthar bhi na jaane kab se ise chhupaaye baithe hain. Aaiye aaj raat 8 bajejante hain ki kaise ek khoobsurat vaadi aaj bhi jung aur har roz milne wale zakhm se tadap rahi hai.

bhagavante-maranam.title: ഭഗവാന്റെ മരണം
bhagavante-maranam.description: 'ഭഗവാന്റെ മരണം' എന്ന കഥയുൾപ്പെടുന്ന ആറു രാഷ്ട്രീയ ആക്ഷേപ ഹാസ്യ കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരമാണിത്. സാമൂഹികവും വർഗ്ഗീയവുമായ ഫാസിസത്തിന് എതിരെ സന്ധിയില്ലാ സമരം പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ച ഒരു എഴുത്തുകാരിയായി കെ. ആർ മീര ഇവിടെ സ്വയം അവരോധിക്കുകയാണു.

journey-of-indian-20-20-league.title: Journey of Indian 20-20 League
journey-of-indian-20-20-league.description: India la Summer Season vanthutaale 20 20 cricket thiruvizha start agirum. Intha particular Indian Cricket Premier League oda varalaarai therinjuka intha pathivai kelunga. Pala nostalgic moments ayum neenga intha content ketkurathu moolamaa relive pannalaam. Vaanga ulagathoda famous cricket tournament ah pathi kettu therinjukalaam.

bayasade-bali-bande.title: Bayasade Bali Bande
bayasade-bali-bande.description: 'ಅಂಜನಾ' ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನದ ಹುಡುಗಿ. 'ವಿಕ್ರಂ ದೇವ್' ನಿಜವಾದ ಪ್ರೀತಿ ಹುಡುಕ್ತಿರೋ ಆ್ಯಂಗ್ರಿ ಯಂಗ್ ಮ್ಯಾನ್! ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಭೇಟಿಯಾದ ಕೆಲವೇ ನಿಮಿಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ‌ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗೋ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಗೆ ಕಟ್ಟುಬೀಳ್ತಾರೆ. ಅದೂ ಕಾಂಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟ್ ವಿವಾಹ! ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಈ‌ ಜೋಡಿ ಬದುಕಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯೋ‌ ಮುಂದಿನ ಟ್ವಿಸ್ಟ್ ಏನು? ತಿಳಿಯೋ ಕುತೂಹಲನಾ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಬಯಸದೇ ಬಳಿ ಬಂದೆ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

നിധി.title: നിധി
നിധി.description: ക്രൂര ബലാത്സംഗത്തിനിരയായ ഒരു യുവതിയുടെ അതിജീവനത്തിൻ്റെയും പ്രതികാരത്തിൻ്റെയും ത്രസിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കഥ. സമകാലിക യാഥാർത്ഥ്യങ്ങളുടെ നേർപ്പകപ്പായി മാറുന്ന പോരാട്ടത്തിൻ്റെ കഥയാണു സജിത് എം.എസ് രചിച്ച ഈ നോവൽ.

zen-mindful-trance.title: Zen: Mindfulness
zen-mindful-trance.description: Peaceful Zen sounds that help you stay present, clear your mind, and create a deeper sense of focus and awareness.

baddakam-nundi-bayatapadandi.title: Bhaddakam Nundi Bayatapadandi
baddakam-nundi-bayatapadandi.description: చేసే పని మీద ఇష్టాన్ని పెంచుకోండి. అప్పుడు బద్దకం అనే సమస్య అస్సలు ఉండదు. అయితే మనుషుల్లో బద్ధకం అనేది అసలు ఎందుకు వస్తుంది?, బద్ధకం రకాలు, ఆఫీసులో లంచ్ తర్వాత బద్ధకంగా ఉంటుందా?, చ‌లికాలంలో వేధించే బద్ధకాన్ని ఎలా త‌గ్గించుకోవాలో తెలుసా? ఇలా ఎన్నెన్నో ఆసక్తికరమైన విషయాలను ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ ద్వారా అందించబోతున్నాం.

शापित-योद्धा--सीजन-1--लेखक--डॉ-पीयूष--कु.title: शापित योद्धा - सीजन 1
शापित-योद्धा--सीजन-1--लेखक--डॉ-पीयूष--कु.description: मुंबई के चौपाटी इलाके कटी हुई तीन लाशें मिलने से पूरे मुंबई में खलबली मच जाती है। लेकिन पुलिस के लिए सबसे बड़ी पहेली है इन तीनों लाशों के सिर गायब है। दूसरी ओर कुछ दिन बाद मुंबई के प्रमुख अस्‍पतालों में सिलसिलेवार बम धमाके होते हैं। किसने इस हादसे को अंजाम दिया? मीडिया पुलिस पर सवाल उठाने लगती है। क्‍या पुलिस केस को सुलझा पाएगी? सिर कटी लाशें और सिलसिलेवार बम ब्‍लास्‍ट क्‍या दोनों केस आपस में जुड़े हुए हैं? जानने के लिए सुनें पूरी कहानी केवल कुकू एफएम पर।

मोक्ष-पाने-वाले-कैसे-होते-हैं.title: मोक्ष पाने वाले कैसे होते हैं?
मोक्ष-पाने-वाले-कैसे-होते-हैं.description: Jaaniye dharm, karma, bhakti, gyana, aur yog ke madhyam se moksha prapti ka marg, aur sikhiye kaise aadhunik jeevan mein bhi ye sabhi apnaakar aap jeewan ko poornata aur shanti se bhar sakte hain.

become-successful-right-now.title: Become Successful Right Now
become-successful-right-now.description: ജീവിത വിജയത്തിന്റെ രഹസ്യങ്ങൾ! പ്രചോദനം നൽകുന്ന കഥകളിലൂടെയും പ്രായോഗിക ഉപദേശങ്ങളിലൂടെയും എല്ലാ മേഖലകളിലും വിജയം നേടാൻ ആവശ്യമായ കഴിവുകൾ വളർത്താനുള്ള ഒരു മികച്ച പുസ്തകം.

maar-ke-dikha.title: Maar ke Dikha
maar-ke-dikha.description: Karan, a scholarship cadet at elite Astra Veer Defence Academy, is powerless in a world ruled by cybernetic Shakti-Chips. After being forced into the girls’ wing, he clashes with legacy cadet Ira Rathore and discovers a strange ability—every beating makes him stronger. Turning humiliation into power, Karan rises from outcast to feared contender while uncovering a plot to silence him, proving that real strength isn’t bought—it’s earned through pain.

the-railway-conspiracy.title: The Railway Conspiracy
the-railway-conspiracy.description:
When scandalous pamphlets link school teacher Priya Kumari to a notorious coal thief, her quiet life is shattered.
Determined to clear her name, Priya secretly joins forces with RPF Inspector Kabir Singh. Their investigation leads into the heart of Dhanbad’s coal mafia, where Priya is kidnapped and discovers a massive smuggling network.
But the biggest shock comes when she learns the conspiracy was orchestrated by someone from her own family.

how-to-turn-setbacks-into-greenbacks.title: How to Turn Setbacks into Greenbacks
how-to-turn-setbacks-into-greenbacks.description: ఎదురు దెబ్బలను ఆర్థిక ప్రయోజనాలుగా మార్చడం ఎలా సాధ్యం? ప్రతికూల పరిస్థితుల్లో సానుకూల దృక్పథం ఎలా అభివృద్ధి చేసుకోవాలి?  ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

ravan-beyond-the-ramayan.title: Ravan - beyond the Ramayan
ravan-beyond-the-ramayan.description: Mitrano, Ravnane Siteche apharan kela, tyanantr Ram-Ravnache Yuddha zale ya gpshti apan sarvanich aiklya ahet. Matra Ramayana palikade jaun Ravan ek Raja, ek Putra, ek Pati ani ek Pati mhnun kasa hota? Kay ahe Ravnacha Punar-janmacha rahsya? janun gheuya, 'Ravan- beyond the Ramayan' ya khas show madhun.

list-of-countries-an-indian-can-travel-w.title: List of Countries an Indian Can Travel Without VISA
list-of-countries-an-indian-can-travel-w.description: VISA anedi Edaina deshaniki manam vellante aa desham vellu vari deshaniki ravadaniki ichhe anumathi. Visa lekunda enni deshalaku pravesham untundi ane danini batti oka county yokka rich,development, political values ni anchana vestharu. Passport index ranking lo indian passport rank 83 ga undi. ee INDIA passport tho nearly  60 countries ki VISA lekunda vellavachhu. Mari Ala vellagalige deshala pratyekathalanu, takkuva kharchutho vellagalige tourism countries gurinchi ee audio book lo telusukundam.

codebreaker-army-ka-sher.title: Codebreaker: Army Ka Sher
codebreaker-army-ka-sher.description: Ek khamosh jung. Apna bhai nishaane par. 1971: RAW genius Arjun Purohit ko recruit karta hai Pakistan ka sabse khatarnak naval code todne ke liye, isse pehle ki woh Bharat ki Navy doob jaaye. Woh dushman ki pandubbi PNS Ghazi ke liye ek perfect jaal bunta hai jab tak usse pata nahi chalta ki uske raaste mein khadi decoy ship par uska apna bhai sawar hai. Ek galat frequency jung khatam kar degi. Ek sahi faisla usse sab kuch chheen sakta hai. Bandookon se nahi, numbers se ladi gayi ek gumnaam jung

the-art-of-happiness-8.title: The Art Of Happiness
the-art-of-happiness-8.description:
Apni Happiness Ka Reason Khud Ko Banayein! 
[Key Ideas Explained]

చేతబడి-నమ్ము-నమ్మకపో.title: చేతబడి- నమ్ము, నమ్మకపో!
చేతబడి-నమ్ము-నమ్మకపో.description: చేతబడి నిజంగా చేస్తారా? అసలు చేతబడి అనే పద్ధతి ఎలా ప్రారంభమయ్యింది? చేతబడి వెనక ఉన్న రహస్యాలు తెలుసుకోండి.

wonder-boy-ishaan.title: Wonder Boy Ishaan
wonder-boy-ishaan.description: Agar aap kisi ke bhi kapdon ke aar-paar dekh sako to kya karenge sabse pahle? Kuch aesa hi hua tha Ishaan ke saath! Singhaniya diamond company me chhoti si naukri karne vaale chasmish Ishaan ko uski girlfriend Maahira sirf isiliye dhokha de deti hai kyonki vo ushe ek stylish life style nahin de paya. Apni kadvi zubaan se Maahira ushe gaaliyan dete huye Ishaan ki badi mehnat se khareedi hui ring bhi vaapas kar jaati hai.

economic-reforms.title: Economic Reforms 1991
economic-reforms.description: Step into 1991, a year that rewrote India's economic destiny. This original audiobook, "Economic Reforms 1991," is your front-row seat to witness the pivotal decisions and dynamic changes that reshaped India's economic landscape forever. These reforms, marked by liberalization, globalization, and privatization, sparked innovation and prosperity. Join us as we delve into the heart of India's economic challenges and the visionary leaders who dared to dream of a brighter, more prosperous future.

surjotamoshi.title: Surjotamoshi
surjotamoshi.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

കാന്തമല-.title: കാന്തമല
കാന്തമല-.description: ആരും ജീവനോടെ തിരികെവരാത്ത കാന്തമല ക്ഷേത്രത്തിലെ നിധി തേടിപോയതാണ് ശ്രീജിത്ത്. എന്നാൽ അയാളെ കാത്തിരുന്നത് മരണത്തേക്കാൾ ഭയാനകമായ ഒരു അവസ്ഥയാണ്.   വർഷങ്ങൾക്കു ശേഷം, സ്വന്തം ജീവൻ  പണയം വെച്ച് മിഥുൻ എന്ന ചെറുപ്പക്കാരൻ കാന്തമല എന്ന നിഗൂഢത തേടി പുറപ്പെടുകയാണ്. തുടക്കം മുതൽ ആകാംക്ഷയുടെ മുൾമുനയിൽ നിർത്തുകയും, നിങ്ങളെ മറ്റൊരു ലോകത്തേക്ക് കൂട്ടികൊണ്ടുപോവുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ത്രില്ലർ!

chhat-pooja.title: Chhath Puja: Bihar Ki Pehchan
chhat-pooja.description:
Indian culture mein Tyohaaron ki kya Ahamiyat hai ye hum sab jaante hain. Tabhi to UP, Bihar mein manai jane wali Chhath puja aur uske geet aaj desh ke har kone mein sunai dete hain. 
 Akhir kyu manaya jati hai Chhath puja aur kya hai is parv ka mahatva iske bare mein detail mein janenge humare is special show "Chhath Puja: Bihar Ki Pehchan" mein.

the-new-strategic-selling.title: The New Strategic Selling
the-new-strategic-selling.description: ರಾಬರ್ಟ್ ಬಿ. ಮಿಲ್ಲರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟೀಫನ್ ಇ. ಹೈಮನ್ ಅವರ The New Strategic Selling" ಪುಸ್ತಕವು, ಮಾರಾಟದ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ದಿ ಪಡಿಸುವ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಮಾರಾಟವು ಕೇವಲ ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಒಲಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಕಲೆಯಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ನಿರ್ಧಾಮಾಡುವವರನ್ನು ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿಸುವ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ತತ್ವವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ, ನೀವು  ನಿಮ್ಮ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲಿಕ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಸಾಧಿಸಬಹುದು. ಪ್ರಪಂಚದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರರು ಅನುಸರಿಸುವ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಗಿಯಾದ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯಲು ಅಗತ್ಯವಾದ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳು ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಅನ್ನು KUKU FM ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಾರಾಟದ ದಕ್ಷತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ!

asthipanjaram.title: అస్థిపంజరం
asthipanjaram.description: దేశ విభజన అనంతర పరిణామాలను, మఠ విద్వేషాలను స్త్రీవాద కోణంలో రాసిన ఎక్కడైనా నవల “పింజర్” అనువాదమే ఈ అస్థిపంజరం. ఇందులో హిందూ-ముస్లిం విద్వేషాలకు బలై,కుటుంబాల పరువు ప్రతిష్టల మాటున అస్థిత్వాన్ని కోల్పోయింది పురుషాధిపత్య సమాజ పద ఘట్టనాల కింద నలిగి జీవచ్ఛవం లా నలగి పోయిన ఎంత మంది స్త్రీ జీవితమే ఈ అస్థిపంజరం.

share-market-guide-2.title: Share Market Guide
share-market-guide-2.description: Aaj ke waqt me har koi share market me Paisa lagana chahta hai par har kisi ko iske baar me puri tarah se knowledge nahi hai. Share Market me kab paise lagana hai, Kab shares ko khareedana hai use kab bechna hai ye hum mese bauth se logon ko bilkul bhe pata nahi hai. Uske sath sath Mutual Fund kya hota hai, SIP kisi kehte hain in sab ki jaankari dene ke liye hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain Full Audio Book jiska naam hai "Share Market Guide" is book ko sunne ke baad aap bhe apne paison ka sahi istemaal kar payenge or apne shares ko kab khareedana aur bechna hai in sab ko acche tariker se jaan paayenge.

the-8020-principle.title: The 80/20 Principle
the-8020-principle.description: The 80/20 Principle athava Pareto thaththvam prakaaram yethoru lakshyam nedaanum athinte 20 percent pravarthanangal cheythal thanne 80 percent Bhalavum labhikkum ennathaanu. E principle nammude jeevithathil engane praavarthikamaakam ennu nokkam.

maitreyee.title: Maitreyee
maitreyee.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

story-of-charlie-chaplin.title: Story of Charlie Chaplin
story-of-charlie-chaplin.description: Comedy cha badshah Charlie Chaplin, yane sakarleli 'Tramp' chia Manmohak chitranasathi ajunahi smaranat ahe. Charlie chaplin,  hollywoodchya muk yugatil sarvat prabhavshali vyaktinpaiki ek, Vinodi chitrapat tayar kele jyamadhun tyane lokana hasavle ani radavle. Aikuyat Charli chaplin cha jivan pravas KUKU FM Var.

shoorveer-havildar-hangpan-dada.title: Shoorveer Havildar Hangpan Dada
shoorveer-havildar-hangpan-dada.description: On a cold night of May 26, 2016, at the LoC, a small Indian unit stands between four heavily armed terrorists and the country. With the enemy positioned on higher ground, bullets raining down and the entire nation behind him, Havildar Hangpan Dada makes a decision that will make him immortal. But can one soldier sacrifice his life to stop four terrorists from crossing into India?

apocalypse-rewind.title: Apocalypse Rewind
apocalypse-rewind.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a team of survivors led by Ethan Cole prepares for a desperate mission. Using a Time Travel Machine, they plan to travel back in time to change key events, including saving Dr Graham and her research to prevent a catastrophic future. As raiders attack their compound, the team rushes to activate the device. With the fate of humanity hanging in the balance, they step into the portal, determined to rewrite history and save their world from further destruction. Will they succeed in altering the past to secure a better future?

raja-thilakam.title: ராஜ திலகம்
raja-thilakam.description: ராஜசிம்ம பல்லவன் காஞ்சி மற்றும் மல்லையை சாளுக்கிய மன்னன் விக்கிரமாதித்யனின் படையெடுப்பிலிருந்து எப்படிக் காப்பாற்றுகிறான்? காதலும் வீரமும் மிகுந்த சாண்டில்யனின் மாஸ்டர் ஃபீஸ் நாவல்...

ashtamahishi-the-eight-wives-of-krishna.title: Ashtamahishi: The Eight Wives of Krishna
ashtamahishi-the-eight-wives-of-krishna.description: జగన్నాటక సూత్రధారి అయిన కృష్ణుడి అష్టభార్యల గురించి, 16000 గోపికలతో కృష్ణుని అనుబంధం గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి మరి.

how-to-become-network-marketer.title: Mastering The Art of Network Marketing
how-to-become-network-marketer.description: Digital duniya ke is daur mein jahan network marketing 9 to 5 job ke culture ko beat kar rhi hai vahin humein apne mann mutabik kaam karne ki bhi ijazat deti hain. Yeh ek aisa business hai jahan na to koi kisi ka boss hai aur na hi kaam ki bandishein. Lekin ismein har koi aasaani se master nahi ban pata hai. Kuku FM par is Original Series mein aap network marketing mein master banne ki inhi tactics ko seekhenge aur is mein kaise successful ban sakte hain yeh bhi jaan jayenge.

मुहब्बत-का-सफर-इबादत-और-बदला--लेखक--शैले.title: Mohabbat Ka Safar... Ibadat Aur Badla
मुहब्बत-का-सफर-इबादत-और-बदला--लेखक--शैले.description: Chitralekha roopsingh Se Prem karti hei. Lekin Jamindar ke drushta se Beta Yashwant Chitralekha se shadi karna chahata hei aur Pitaji se kehkar chitralekha ke ghar vivah ka prastav bhijvaata hei. Chitralekha apne pitaji jeetsingh se Yashwant ke bhure vyavahar ke baare mei batati hei aur shadi se inkar karti hei. Roopsingh aur apne prem ke baare mei Pitaji ko baatati hei. Jeet singh ke samne dhuvihda hei aajati hei aur Fir Dangal ka Aayogan hota hei jyo Dangal jeetega uski shadi Chitravse hogi. Roopsingh vijay hota hei aur Yashwant ghayal ssher ki tarah ghat lagta hei. aur fir Shru hota hei doo Parivaaro ke bich khoni khel

sothik-option-bachte-sikhun.title: Sothik Option Bachte Sikhun
sothik-option-bachte-sikhun.description: Aamader Jibone Majhe Majhe Emon Poristhiti Chole Aasey Jokhn 2To Option Er Modhey Jekono Ektike Beche Nite Hoy. Dekha Gelo Jei Optionti Aapni Bachlen Seta Aapnar Pokkhe Netibachok Hoye Uthlo Aabar Emonta Hote Pare Je Jibon Palte Gelo. Ebar Aapni Songshoyer Modhey Pore Jan, Jar Fole Nana Somosyar Sristi Hoy. Ebar Proshno Holo Kivabe Ei Songshoy Dur Kora Jay ? Kivabe Sothik Sidhanto Neyoya Jay? Kivabe Sothik Option Beche Neyoya Jay ? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Uttor Dite Kuku Fm Niye Elo Ei Audiobook, Eta Shonar Por Aapni Aapnar Proshner Uttor Khub Sohojei Peye Jaben. Tahole Shuru Kora Jak.

arjun-10.title: Arjun: Krishna Ke Parth
arjun-10.description: Mahabharat ke maidan me mili Krishan se seekh ne Arjun ki hi nahi balki Geeta ko padhne wale har insaan ki zindagi badal di hai. Agar aap aaj bhi anjaan hai Geeta ki seekh se, Krishna ki seekh se toh abhi sune dosti ki misaal par adharit show Arjun: Krishna Ke Parth.

the-rival-bride.title: The Rival Bride
the-rival-bride.description: Betrayed by her husband, abused by her mother-in-law, and shattered by a miscarriage, Meera escapes the Kanak Handlooms haveli to rebuild her life with Ranveer, her husband’s fiercest rival. Armed with her rare weaving talent, she sets out to expose the family’s corruption. But as danger closes in and a new pregnancy changes everything, can Meera trust Ranveer with her broken heart?

modha-africa-obhjin.title: মধ্য আফ্রিকা | লেখক - সাগ্নিক ধর
modha-africa-obhjin.description: অনন্ত সামান্য দিনমজুর, কিন্তু সবসময় সে জীবনে রোমাঞ্চের স্বাদ পেতে চায়। প্রফেসার অচিন্তন বাবুর সঙ্গে মধ্য আফ্রিকায় এক্সপ্লোর করতে যাবার সুযোগ অনন্ত হাতছাড়া করেনা। সঙ্গী আরও তিন বিদেশী এক্সপ্লোরার। অনন্ত জানতে পারে কাকুন্ডাকারি নামক এক প্রাণীর কথা, মধ্য আফ্রিকার সেই জায়গায় গিয়ে আজ পর্যন্ত কেও ফিরে আসেনি। অজানা রহস্য কী সে ভেদ করতে পারবে?

you-are-so-beautiful.title: You Are So Beautiful
you-are-so-beautiful.description: డా. ప్రణయ్ ఓ ఉమనైజర్. కనిపించిన ప్రతీ అమ్మాయిని ఎంజాయ్ చేసే రకం. అలాంటి ప్రణయ్ కి తన మరదలితో పెళ్లి చేయడానికి అతని తండ్రి నిర్ణయిస్తాడు. సరిగ్గా అదే సమయంలో భవానిని చూసి ప్రేమలో పడతాడు. అయితే భవానీని ప్రేమను పొందే సమయానికి అతని జీవితం ఏమైంది... ప్రతీ క్షణం ఉత్కంట భరితంగా, రొమాంటిక్ గా సాగే ఈ సిరీస్ ఆద్యంతం అలరిస్తుంది.

mahavidya-chhupe-rahasyon-ki-kahani.title: Mahavidya : Chhupe Rahasyon Ki Kahani
mahavidya-chhupe-rahasyon-ki-kahani.description: Isha gayab hai aur uske peeche chhupa hai Dasha Mahavidya ka rahasya. Aditya usse dhoondhne nikalta hai, par phans jaata hai ek aisi duniya mein jahan devi-shaktiyon ka raaj hai. Maya ke is cosmic maze mein, har kadam par hai bhram, tandav aur satya ka khel. Pyaar aur sach ke beech Aditya ko lena hoga sabse bada faisla. Kya woh andhkaar ko paar karke roshni tak pahuch payega?

Pather-Panchali--పథేర్-పాంచాలి.title: పథేర్ పాంచాలీ
Pather-Panchali--పథేర్-పాంచాలి.description: హరిహర్ రాయ్ అనే పేద బ్రాహ్మణుని కుటుంబంలో జరిగే రకరకాల సంఘటనలు, కష్టాలు, బాధలు నేపథ్యంగా - అపు, దుర్గా అనే ఇద్దరు పిల్లల ద్వారా చెప్పబడిన కథ ఇది. పిల్లలు ఎంత సున్నిత మనస్కులో, వారి చుట్టూ ఉన్న ప్రపంచాన్ని ఎంత నిశితంగా నిరంతరం గమనిస్తూ ఉంటారో వంటి ఆసక్తికరమైన అంశాలు ఈ "పథేర్ పాంచాలీ" కథ ద్వారా విని తెలుసుకోండి.

काला-पहाड़--लेखक--ई-थियोडोर-किंग.title: Kaala Pahad
काला-पहाड़--लेखक--ई-थियोडोर-किंग.description: Sultaan Karnani ki sena ka Subhedar Kalaachand Ray Dharmishtha Brahamin tha. Sultan ki beti dulhari ne Uss par Mugdha hokar vivah karne ka faisla liya, Lekin dharma ke khatir uss ne yaha prastav thukra diya. Lekin Samaj badla aur usne dulhari kaa Hath tham liya. Fir Suru hui Dharmadha Bhramano ki kutilaata ki kahani- Insaan ka hevan bannane ka safar jaane. Jaane waha pehle Kaalchand Rai se Mohabbat Famuli bana aur Fir ban kaala Pahad kaise bana?

how-to-understand-children-psychology.title: How To Understand Children Psychology
how-to-understand-children-psychology.description: పిల్లల సైకాలజీని అర్థం చేసుకుంటూ వారిని సముదాయించడం, నచ్చజెప్పడం ఎలా?  ఏది మంచో, ఏది చెడో పిల్లలకు ఎలా చెప్పాలి?  మీ ప్రశ్నలకు ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో సమాధానం దొరుకుతుంది.

enikkumoru-swapnamundayirunnu.title: എനിക്കുമൊരു സ്വപ്‍നമുണ്ടായിരുന്നു
enikkumoru-swapnamundayirunnu.description: മഹത്തായ ക്ഷീരവിപ്ലവത്തിന്റെ ഉർജ്ജകേന്ദ്രവും അമുൽ ഇൻഡസ്ട്രീസിന്റെ സ്ഥാപകനുമായ  ഡോ: വർഗ്ഗീസ് കുര്യൻറെ ആത്മകഥയാണ് ഈ ഓഡിയോബുക്ക്. അമൂൽ എന്ന ലോകോത്തര ബ്രാൻഡിന്റെ ജനനവും വളർച്ചയും അതിന്റെ ജനയിതാവിന്റെ വാക്കുകളിലൂടെ അറിയുന്നത് നിങ്ങളിൽ  പോസിറ്റിവിറ്റി നിറയ്ക്കും.

Sister-Abhaya-Ki-Maut-कुएं-में-दफ़न-सच.title: Sister Abhaya Ki Maut: कुएं में दफ़न सच
Sister-Abhaya-Ki-Maut-कुएं-में-दफ़न-सच.description: 1992, Kerala – ek nun, ek well, aur ek aisa raaz jo desh ko hila gaya. Sister Abhaya ki maut suicide thi ya cold-blooded murder? Akhir sach kya tha? 28 saal tak chalte investigation, missing evidence aur Church ke secrets ko explore karta hai yeh show. Aap bhi agar is maut ka raaz janna chahte hain to suniye ye audiobook..

the-happiest-man-on-earth-4.title: The Happiest Man On Earth
the-happiest-man-on-earth-4.description: Jeevithathile dhushkaramaya samayangalil polum engane santhoshavanaayirikkamennu ee pusthakathil ninn namukk padikkan sathikkum. Swantham rajyam nashtapett, veed nashtapett, kudumbam nadshtapett, peedanangal anubhavichch, Hitlerinte concentration campilninnum athijeevichch Eddie Jaku, thante 100-aam vayassil purathirakkiya 'The Happiest Man On Earth' enna pusthakathiloode namukk pakarnnu tharunnath prachothanathinte paadangal aanu.

भुवन-विला--लेखक--आशीष-कुमार-त्रिवेदी.description:

thavittukuppayakkaran.title: തവിട്ടുകുപ്പായക്കാരൻ
thavittukuppayakkaran.description: ആൻ എന്ന ചെറുപ്പക്കാരി ലണ്ടനിലെ റെയിൽവേ ട്രാക്കിൽ ഒരു മനുഷ്യൻ കൊല്ലപ്പെടുന്നത് കാണുന്നു. ആ മരണത്തിന്റെ രഹസ്യം തേടി പോകുകയാണ് ആൻ, ഡിറ്റക്റ്റീവ് കഥകളുടെ രാജ്ഞി അഗത ക്രിസ്റ്റിയുടെ ഒരു ക്ലാസിക് ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലർ!

the-story-of-chhatrapati-shivaji-maharaj.title: ఛత్రపతి శివాజీ మహారాజ్
the-story-of-chhatrapati-shivaji-maharaj.description: శివాజీ మహరాజ్ ఒక గొప్ప యోధుడు. 'రాజధర్మ' గ్రంథాన్ని రచించిన శివాజీ పాలనలో ఎటువంటి నీతి, ధర్మాలను పాటించారు? ఈ విషయాలు భవిష్యత్తు పాలకులకు ఎలాంటి సందేశాన్ని ఇస్తున్నాయి? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో...

d119ca60-cc3e-48b6-914c-7bbe32b69cb9.title: Anaath Se Maharani
d119ca60-cc3e-48b6-914c-7bbe32b69cb9.description:
A simple orphan walks into a palace to claim her place as a lost princess — and finds scheming ministers, rival princes, and a war waiting for her.

When one lakh soldiers march on three thousand, ministers beg for surrender. Minnie invokes the Phoenix Wings — a magic that demands the most precious sacrifice.

This is a story of a girl who was never supposed to be queen — and the kingdom that needed her to be.

namak-isqk-ka.title: Namak Isqk Ka
namak-isqk-ka.description: Meera ne Arjun ko sirf chhoda nahi, balki sabke saamne beizzat karke uske jazbaat bhi kuchal diye. Us din Arjun ne zindagi se haar maan li, aur apna sab kuch chhod dene ka faisla kar liya. Lekin us andhere pal mein ek roshni bankar aayi Jaipur ki Rajkumari Naina. Usne sirf Arjun ki jaan hi nahi bachayi, balki usse ek nayi zindagi bhi di. Naina Arjun ko Jaipur le gayi, jahan usne royal chef competition jeeta aur saath hi Naina ka dil bhi. Dono ek doosre ke pyaar mein doob chuke the, zindagi ke naye sapne dekhne lage the. Lekin tabhi Naina ka mangetar london se wapas aaya. kya hoga ab Naina aur Arjun ki Fairytale kahani me? Kya Naina parampara ke aage jhukegi? Ya Arjun ka saccha pyaar jeetega? Kya ek chef ban sakta hai ek rajkumari ka humsafar?

free-to-focus-14.title: Free to Focus
free-to-focus-14.description: Productivity ennath kooduthal karyangal cheyyunathil alla, athu shariyaya karyangal cheyyunathine kurichanu. Angane shariyaya karyangalil shraddha kendrikarikkan ningale sahayikkunna mikacha 3-step-systemanu Michael Hyatt rachicha 'Free to Focus' enna pusthakathil parichayapeduthunath.

jolotorongor-sur.title: Jolotorongor Sur
jolotorongor-sur.description: Jump into a world of diverse tales with Kuku FM's Short Stories. Perfect for listeners on the go our short stories offer quick escapes into fictional worlds. From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

dhurandhar-survivor.title: Dhurandhar Survivor
dhurandhar-survivor.description: Samar Shukla is a terminally ill coder who boards the overnight express through Jharkhand's deepest forests. But when the train enters a supernatural track loop and the crew is possessed by a vengeful railway spirit, Samar’s phone binds to a terrifying system. To survive and earn life-saving medicine, he must  host a lethal survival game, forcing the divided passengers of the crowded general bogeys and wealthy AC coaches to play by his rules. His own online horror stories come to life.

the-invisible-ceo.title: The Invisible Ceo
the-invisible-ceo.description: Diya ne apne delivery boy pati Karan ko kabhi kaabil nahi samjhaa. Uska sapna tha Angola group mein ek powerful position paana aur uss secret CEO se milna, jise aaj tak kisi ne nahi dekha tha. Iss raaste mein uski madad karta tha usi company ka ek manager, Varun. Lekin us madad ki ek keemat thi. Diya ka uske bistar tak jaana. Lekin Diya ko kya pata tha, jise woh ‘nakaara’ samajh kar thukra rahi thi, wahi Karan ek chhupa hua raaz tha. Jab uski asli pehchaan saamne aayegi, tab kya Diya pachtayegi? Kya wo Karan ko phir se apnaayegi? Ya khulega koi dusra raaz ?

ಸುಗ್ಗಿ-ಸಂಕ್ರಾಂತಿ.title: Suggi Sankranthi
ಸುಗ್ಗಿ-ಸಂಕ್ರಾಂತಿ.description: ಸೂರ್ಯ ತನ್ನ ದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವ ಮಹಾನ್‌ ದಿನವೇ ಸಂಕ್ರಾಂತಿ... ಸಂಕ್ರಾಂತಿ ಅಂದ್ರೆ, ಸುಗ್ಗಿ ಸಂಭ್ರಮದ ಹಬ್ಬ, ಅರ್ಥಾತ್ ಇದೊಂದು ಕೃಷಿ ಆಚರಣೆ...  'ಎಳ್ಳು-ಬೆಲ್ಲ ತಿಂದು ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಮಾತಾಡಿ' ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾ, ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ನಾನಾ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾನಾ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಚರಿಸುವ ಸುಗ್ಗಿ ಹಬ್ಬವೇ ಸಂಕ್ರಾಂತಿ. ಇಂತಹ ಸಂಕ್ರಾಂತಿ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ಅಚ್ಚರಿದಾಯಕ ವಿಚಾರಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೋಬೇಕಾ? ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಸುಗ್ಗಿ ಸಂಭ್ರಮ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್

senior-citizen-companionship-by-ratan-ta.title: Senior Citizen Companionship By Ratan Tata
senior-citizen-companionship-by-ratan-ta.description: Ratan tata nra per ah kettalae oru miga periya mariyadhai namma manasula varum. Adhukku kaaranam avaroda achievements mattum illa, avar eppadi patta manidhan ah irudhirukkaru nradhu dhaan. Ratan tata oda payanam industry la yum personal life la yum eppadi irundhirukku nu indha audio book la kelunga.

zorawar-singh.title: Zorawar Singh
zorawar-singh.description: Gulab Singh ki sena mein ek sipahi ke taur par bharti ho kar Bharat ki seema ko Leh, Ladakh se Tibbet tak le kar jane wale yoddha hain, Zorawar Singh. Par kaun the Zorawar Singh jinke naam par aaj bhi Bhartiya Army mein sena padak diye jate hain. Janne ke liye sunein KUKU FM ki ye khas peshkash…

pazhanthamizhar-arasiyal.title: Pazhanthamizhar Arasiyal
pazhanthamizhar-arasiyal.description: Pazhanthamizh naattula iruntha arasiyal murai pathina virivana thoguppu intha audiobook. Antha kalathu thamizh mannargal eppadi aatchi senjaanga ?, Makkalin Nilai eppadi irunthuchu ?, Thappu senjaa enna mathiriyana thandanaigal koduthanga?, Mannargal Makkaltta Vari vasool senjangala ? idhu mathiriyana pala kelvikalukana pathilgal intha audio book la irukku. Vaanga therinjukalam.

benefits-of-patience.title: Sanyam thevnyache 10 Fayde
benefits-of-patience.description: Asa mhantat ki 'Patience is a key of Success'. Sanyam hich yashachi gurukilli ahe. Chidun kinva hyper houn ghetlela nirnay ha sahsa chuktoch.1 ghav 2 tukade kelyane nuksaan aplech hote. Tyamule Personal life aso va professional life, Sanyam mahtwacha. Pan ya competitive life madhe Self control thewaycha tari kasa? Sanyam aplya ayushyat kay badal ghadvu shakto? Chala janun gheuya 'Sanyam thevnyache 10 Fayde' ya aplya khas show madhun..

being-you-1.title: Being You
being-you-1.description: "நான் யார்? " அப்டிங்க்ற கேள்விக்கான அறிவியல் பூர்வமான தேடல் தான் இந்த Kuku Byte 🔬📚💡, நீங்க  நீங்களா இருக்க காரணமான விசயத்தை அறிவியல் பூர்வமா தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம் வாங்க🧩🧠🚶‍♂️.

mahasamar-4-dharm.title: Mahabharat: Dharma Ki Raah Par
mahasamar-4-dharm.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

the-tandoori-murder-naina-sahni-murder-c.title: The Tandoori Murder : Naina Sahni Murder Case
the-tandoori-murder-naina-sahni-murder-c.description: 1995, ഡൽഹിയിലെ വേനൽച്ചൂടുളള ഒരു വെളുപ്പാൻ കാലം, ഞെട്ടിക്കുന്ന ആ വാർത്ത കേട്ടാണു നഗരം ഉണർന്നത്. പ്രണയം പകയായി തീരുകയും പക അരുംകൊലയിൽ അവസാനിക്കുകയും ചെയ്ത നൈനാ സാഹ്നി എന്ന യുവതിയുടെ  ദാരുണ മരണത്തിൻ്റെ കഥ. നൈനയെ അവളുടെ കാമുകൻ കൊലപ്പെടുത്തുകയും മൃതദേഹം ഹോട്ടലിലെ തണ്ടൂരി അടുപ്പിൽ വെച്ച് ചൂട്ടെരിക്കുകയും ആയിരുന്നു. രാജ്യത്തെ നടുക്കിയ ആ സംഭവം ഒരു സാധാരണ കുറ്റകൃത്യം ആയിരുന്നില്ല; സത്യം മൂടിവെക്കാൻ കൊലയാളികൾ എത്രത്തോളം പോകുമെന്നതിനുളള മനസ്സ് മരവിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഉദാഹരണമായിരുന്നു. കേൾക്കാം മനസ് മരവിപ്പിക്കുന്ന അരും കൊലയുടെ യഥാർത്ഥ കഥ.

office-icon-bano-business-etiquettes-mas.title: Office Icon Bano: Business Etiquettes Master Karo!
office-icon-bano-business-etiquettes-mas.description: Business Etiquettes master karne ka ultimate guide paane ke liye, ye show abhi suniye! Aapko milegi effective communication ke tips jo badhayengi aapka professional impact - chahe woh words ho, tone ho ya phir body language. Tune in kariye aur apne career ko ek nayi uchai par le jaane ka solid start kijiye!

fake-wife-12.title: Fake wife
fake-wife-12.description: 5 bochor dhori Dev Joshi nishobde Riya Kapoor or shokol opoman shohyo koril. Kintu Riya or prothom bhalobasha Avinash wapas ahote Dev divorce papers sign kori gush mari gol. Ekdin billionaire Shreya Rao Dev or jibonorot ahil aar tar proti shochcho prem anubhob koril. Eya dekhi Riya joliya uthil aar nijer karmor jonyo poshtap koril. Shreya ki shochochei Dev or perfect match? Riya ki Dev k Shreya r shonge shukhi dekhibo paribo naki noton bipod shirzil koribo?

eternal-echoes.title: Eternal Echoes
eternal-echoes.description: Eternal Echoes follows the journey of Jennifer Summers, a small-town waitress haunted by unfulfilled childhood love and a tragic past. When a mysterious Instagram message from her long-dead lover Henry appears, Jenifer's carefully constructed world begins to break. Torn between past promises and present reality, she must confront buried memories and unresolved grief through her therapy sessions. As she delves deeper into Henry's enigmatic online presence, Jenifer discovers that some echoes of the past refuse to fade, challenging her to redefine her future and the very nature of love and loss. Listen to the emotionally heart-wrenching love tale of Jennifer only on Kuku FM.

the-road-less-traveled-1.title: Jiboner Somoshya Guloke Chinte Sikhun
the-road-less-traveled-1.description: Kono ekdin apni baranda e coffee khete khete ceiling fan er jhuler dike takiye bhabna e dube achen, jiboner somoshya niye. Ei somoshya apnar matha ghire ache, ei chinta apnake ek muhurter shanti theke bonchito korche. Jiboner kotheen somoshyae klanto apni, bhebe dekhlei bujhte parben je amader ashe pashe sokolei kono na kono struggle er jorjorito. Dhoni goreeb nirbisheshe proti ta manusher e dukhho ache, somoshya ache, shei lorai ke ektu easy korar jonnyo shune nin ei boi tir sarangsho.

pakistan-crisis.title: Pakistan Crisis
pakistan-crisis.description: Sudhandhiram adanja Naal la Irundhu Innaiku varaikkum Pakistan Naadu Anubavichuttu Irukkura Poruladhara , arasiyal  Thuyarangalai Indha Padhivula Virivaa Thoguthu Valangirukkom, Kelunga !

ganbatte-the-japanese-art-of-moving-forw.title: Ganbatte - The Japanese Art
ganbatte-the-japanese-art-of-moving-forw.description: Kya aapko bhi lagta hai agar mere paas yeh hota to main yeh kar leta ? Wo hota to kitni asaani hoti grow karne mein ? Agar lagta hai to yeh kitaab aap ke liye hai. "Ganbette" ek jaapani philosophy hai jiske tehet aapko, jitna hai utne mein aage badhne ki tarkeeb sikhayi jaati hai. Bharat Aur Cheen ke saath saath Japan mein bhi bahut ache philosophers huye hain. Isliye ise aap simple words mein Japan ki geeta bhi keh sakte hain.

mantras-for-men-a-year-of-daily-inspirat.title: Mantras For Men: A Year of Daily Inspiration
mantras-for-men-a-year-of-daily-inspirat.description: Har subah utho, ek naye junoon ke saath apni kismat ko aakar do. "Mantras For Men: A Year of Daily Inspiration" aapke liye laya hai Dr. Napoleon Hill ki amulya soch, jo aapko dikhaayega safalta paane ke asli raaste. Yeh show banega aapki safalta ki nayi chingari!"

detective-ajay-mysterious-deaths.title: Detective Ajay- Mysterious Deaths
detective-ajay-mysterious-deaths.description:
Mahanagar ke top college mein Professor DK Verma ki rahasyamayi maut ka asli karan kya hai? Kya Ajay khulasa kar payega is khaufnak raaz ka? 

Kya hoga Ajay ki zindagi ka agla mod ? Kya woh Arjun Gupta ke road accident ka sach dhoondh payega ? Jaanne ke liye suniye , Detective Ajay ka naya case: 'Road Accident' ! Ajay ki kahani abhi baaki hai !  #DetectiveAjay #ThrillerSeries

dwarka-no-suryaast.description: Embark on extraordinary adventures with Kuku FM's Fantasy & SciFi collection. ഈ-നദിക്കരയിൽ.title: ഈ നദിക്കരയിൽ
ഈ-നദിക്കരയിൽ.description: ജനപ്രിയ സാഹിത്യത്തിലെ അതികായനായ ജോയ്സിയുടെ പ്രശസ്തമായ രചന. നന്തിക്കര എന്ന സങ്കല്പ ഗ്രാമത്തെ പശ്ഛാത്തലമാക്കി മധ്യതിരുവിതാംകൂറിൻ്റെ ജീവിതം പകർത്തുകയാണു ജോയ്സിയിവിടെ. പ്രണയത്തിൻ്റെ ചുടുനിശ്വാസങ്ങളും പകയുടെയും വൈരത്തിൻ്റെയും ആക്ക്രോശങ്ങളും ഇവിടെ ഇടകലരുന്നു. കേൾക്കാം ജോയ്സിയുടെ മനോഹരമായ നോവൽ- ഈ നദിക്കരയിൽ.

the-mysterious-affair-at-styles-1.title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
the-mysterious-affair-at-styles-1.description: A wealthy mistress, a deadly poison, and a manor full of suspects. When Emily Inglethorp is found dead at Styles Court, the brilliant Belgian detective Hercule Poirot comes out of retirement to crack the case. A jealous husband, suspicious stepsons, and cryptic clues — a broken cup, candle grease, a dying whisper. Can Poirot untangle the web of deceit before the truth disappears forever?

maadhyam.title: Maadhyam
maadhyam.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

how-to-earn-by-making-memes.title: How to Earn by Making Memes
how-to-earn-by-making-memes.description: Nammala sirikka vaikura memes namala sambaadhikkavum vaikkumnu sonnaa nambuveengalaa ? Intha pathivu la meme creator ah irukurathu moolam neenga eppadi ellam sambaadhikkalam nu kettu therinjukka porom. Ini unga creativity ah vachum neenga earn pannalam.

the-rainbow-island.title: The Rainbow Island
the-rainbow-island.description: ലോകത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും അപൂർവ്വങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്നായ കോടികൾ വിലമതിക്കുന്ന ഒരു കല്ല്, അത് എവിടെയാണ് എന്നത് ഇന്നും അജ്ഞാതമാണ്. അഞ്ച് ആർക്കിയോളജിസ്റ്റുകളും ഒരു ലൈബ്രെറിയനും അടങ്ങുന്ന ചെറുപ്പക്കാരുടെ സംഘം അത് തേടി പുറപ്പെടുന്നു. അവർ എത്തിപ്പെടുന്നത് ഇന്ത്യൻ മഹാസമുദ്രത്തിലെ അപൂർവ്വ ദ്വീപായ മഴവിൽ ദ്വീപിൽ........ 'റെയിൻബോ ഐലൻഡ്' തൻ്റെ ഗർഭത്തിൽ ഒളിപ്പിച്ച ആ നിധിതേടി സാഹസികതയും അത്ഭുതങ്ങളും ഭയവും നിറഞ്ഞ ഒരു യാത്ര, കേൾക്കൂ.....

హిప్నాటిజం-రహస్యాలు.title: హిప్నాటిజం రహస్యాలు
హిప్నాటిజం-రహస్యాలు.description: మీకు హిప్నాటిజం అంటే ఏంటో తెలుసా ? హిప్నాటిజం తో ఎలాంటి మనిషినైనా మీ అదుపులో పెట్టుకోవచ్చు అనే విషయం మీకు తెలుసా? ఇది మీకు తెలియకపోతే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మీరు వినాల్సిందే.

what-is-governorr-role-in-state-administ.title: What Is Governor's Role In State Administration
what-is-governorr-role-in-state-administ.description: Oru Aalunar oda poruppugal enna, avarakku kudkkapatta power enna nu indha audio book la kelunga.

khooni-nasle.title: Khooni Nasle
khooni-nasle.description: Ek chhote se town mein shuru hota hai ek aisa qatl ka silsila jo sirf khoon tak seemit nahi, balki ek purani, shraapit virasat tak jaata hai. Inspector Aditi Rana jab is case ki tafteesh shuru karti hai, toh use sirf saboot nahi milte, balki apni hi family ke raaz bhi samne aane lagte hain. Har murder kisi nasl ki purani paap ki kahani keh raha hai. Kya Aditi iss khooni nasl ka ant kar paayegi, ya khud uska hissa ban jaayegi?

മാമാങ്കം-1.title: മാമാങ്കം
മാമാങ്കം-1.description: പോരാളികളുടെ പടപ്പാട്ടുകള്‍ എക്കാലവും ഏറ്റുപാടിയ മണ്ണാണിത്. മിന്നല്‍ പോലെ പായുന്ന ഉറുമികള്‍ക്കും ചുരികകള്‍ക്ക് പറയാന്‍ കഥകളേറെ. ഇത് ഇത്താപ്പുവിന്റെ കഥയാണ്. ഭാവനയും പുരാവൃത്തവും ചരിത്രവും ഇഴചേര്‍ന്ന ടി അജീഷിന്റെ മാമാങ്കം കേള്‍ക്കാം.

yogasana-and-sadhana.title: Yogasana And Sadhana
yogasana-and-sadhana.description: Aaj ki is busy life mein hun apne sharir or apni health ka dhyan rakhana shayad bhulte ja rahe hain, Hum ye bhul chuke hain ki humari asli wealth humara paisa nahi humara sharir hai. Is modern or fancy life ko sundar banane ke liye humne Gym to jana shuru kar diya hai par isse bhi zyada agar kisi cheez mein fayda hai to wo hai Yoga. Par sawaal ye hai ki shuruaat kaise ki jaye to aapke inhi sawalon ka jawaab hum lekar aaye hain hamari is book mein jiska naam hai Yogasana Aur Sadhana. Toh chaliye shuru karte hain.

thakumar-jhuli.title: Thakumar Jhuli
thakumar-jhuli.description: Jump into a world of diverse tales with Kuku FM's Short Stories. Perfect for listeners on the go our short stories offer quick escapes into fictional worlds. From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

dard-wala-pyaar.title: Dard Wala Pyaar
dard-wala-pyaar.description: Ruhani ki maang Mudit ne khoon se bhar di, wo bhi bina uske marzi ke. Ruhani ne socha bhi nahi tha ki jise wo apna saccha pyaar samjhti thi vahi Mudit uske liye ek daravana sapna ban jayega. Pehle Mudit ne uske sath zabardasti shaadi ki phir uske sharir par apna haq jataaya… bina uske izazat ke. Ruhani ke liye woh raat sirf ek raat nahi thi – woh ek daravni yaad ban gayi, jisme dard aur beizzati thi. Aur ab… woh maa banne wali hai. Kaise batayegi Ruhani apne parivaar ko apna ye sach?

kaadina-benki.title: Kaadina Benki
kaadina-benki.description: 1990ರಲ್ಲಿ ರಜತ ಕಮಲ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರಶಸ್ತಿ ಪಡೆದ ಹಾಗೂ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಚಲನಚಿತ್ರವಾದ ಕೃತಿ-ಕಾಡಿನ ಬೆಂಕಿ. ನಾ. ಡಿಸೋಜ ಅವರು ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದು, ಲೈಂಗಿಕ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳು, ಅದರ ಒತ್ತಡಗಳು, ಮಡಿವಂತಿಕೆಯ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂತಹ ಭಾವನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಇರದ ಅವಕಾಶಗಳು, ಇದರಿಂದ ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು ಅನುಭವಿಸುವ ಮನೋ ಯಾತನೆ-ಇಂತಹ ವಿಷಯ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಕಾಡಿನ ಬೆಂಕಿ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಚಲನಚಿತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಿಗೆ ಬಂದಿತು. ಮನುಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಊಟ,ನಿದ್ರೆ, ನೀರಡಿಕೆಯಂತೆಯೇ ಲೈಂಗಿಕ ಅಗತ್ಯವೂ ಇದೆ ಎಂಬ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣವು ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ.

tilisma-a-new-begining.title: Tilisma: A New Begining
tilisma-a-new-begining.description: Suyash aur uske saathi Casper ke AI dwara banaye gaye Tilisma mein fans gaye hain. Har kadam par hai ek nayi chunauti jahan unki team ke har member ko aage aana padega. Kya sabhi apne past ka mukabla karte huye is mayajaal se nikal payenge? Janne ke liye suniye Tilisma: A New Begining...

kargil-war-saga.title: Kargil War Saga
kargil-war-saga.description: 1971 mein Bharat se buri tarah haarne ke baad bhi Pakistan ne sabak nahin seekha, aur 1999 mein phir se humare veer jawanon ko lalkaarne ki himmat ki. Badle mein Bharatiya sena aisa muh-tod jawab diya ki itihaas mein veerta aur parakram ka ek naya adhyay likha gaya. Kya kiya tha Pakistan ne aur kaise unki sena ko hamare jawanon ne ghutne ke bal chalne par majboor kiya? Jaanne ke liye suniye Bharatiya sena ke shaurya aur parakram ki anokhi gaatha, "Kargil War Saga."

tuesdays-with-morrie-2.title: Tuesdays With Morrie
tuesdays-with-morrie-2.description: Logo ko aur khudko Maaf karna seekho!

khamma-ghani.title: Khamma Ghani
khamma-ghani.description: Ek kahani ek ladki ki, jiska naam hai Mishri - ek dil se pyaari, bubbly tourist guide jo apni zindagi ke saare sapne tyaag deti hai ek ameer videshi jode ke liye surrogate maa banne ke liye. Lekin jab wahi log uske bache ko apnane se inkaar kar dete hain aur uski zindagi mein badnaami le aate hain, toh Mishri ek nai jung shuru karti hai apni pehchaan wapas paane aur apni beti ke liye ek achha bhavishya banane ke liye. Is raah mein, uska saamna hota hai ek musafir Jay se, jo uske jeevan mein pyaar ka ek naya roop laata hai. Yeh kahani hai unki, jo samaaj ke bhhedbhaav aur galatfehmiyon ke khilaf ladkar apni zindagi hamesha ke liye badal dete hain.

imperfect-zindagi-ke-10-perfect-tareeke.title: Imperfect Zindagi ke 10 Perfect Tareeke
imperfect-zindagi-ke-10-perfect-tareeke.description: "Har chhote kadam mein badi safalta chhupi hoti hai, aur 'Perfect Zindagi' aapki unhi chhoti-chhoti pasandon se banti hai. Is show mein seekhiye kaise samay ka sahi upyog aur rozmarra ke faislon ka sudhaar, aapko ek shandar zindagi ki ore le jaayega. Toh der kis baat ki? Suniye aur apni zindagi ko nayi disha dijiye, abhi!"
