damad-no-1-season-2.title: Damad No. 1 - Season 2
damad-no-1-season-2.description: Ajay aur Janhvi ki khushiyon bhari duniya tab hil jaati hai jab purani dushmaniyan aur supernatural taqaten unke rishte ko chunauti dene lagti hain. Apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye Ajay ko maut aur andhakaar se ladna padega, lekin kya pyaar aur vishwas ke bal se woh iss jung ko jeet payega?

the-pulwama-conspiracy.title: The Pulwama Conspiracy
the-pulwama-conspiracy.description: Pulwama Attack ki asli kahani janane ke liye ho jayiye ready! "The Pulwama Conspiracy" ek thrilling audiobook jo aapko rajneeti aur conspiracy ke dark world mein le jayegi. Abhi suniye aur jaaniye ki kya ye haqeeqat thi ya sirf ek aur saazish?

santo-ki-financial-advice.title: Santo Ki Financial Advice
santo-ki-financial-advice.description: Kya aapne kabhi socha hai ki santon ki seekh aapki financial planning mein kaise madad kar sakti hai? Suniye kaise Kabir, Rahim, aur Tulsidas ji ke dohe badal sakte hain aapki soch!

asli-waaris.title: Asli Waaris
asli-waaris.description: Suraj ek wafadar paltu tha Mittal parivar ka, par Mittal parivaar  apne sabse bade scam mein use phansa kar uski jaan le li. Par Suraj ki aatma ab Mittal khandaan ke sabse chote pote ke shareer mein thi. 18 saal ka Karan ke shareer mein atki Suraj ki aatma ab ye empire apne naam karne mein lagi hai. Kya Karan apne is nayi roop mein apne mission ko poora kar paayega? Ya phir Mittal family ke andar ki saazishein aur manipulations uske plans ko khatam kar denge?

mimalni-mee-pillalu-preminchalante.title: మిమ్మల్ని మీ పిల్లలు ప్రేమించాలంటే
mimalni-mee-pillalu-preminchalante.description: Pillalni Penchadam Anedi Oka Kala, Konnisarlu Vallani Entha Manchiga Chusukunna kuda pillala prema pondadam chala kastam. Inka Pillala pempakam Vishayam lo kuda chala Jagrathalu Patinchalsina Avasaram undi. Samajam Patla Gouravam, Bandhalu, Premalu, Vyakthigata Alochadana Vidhanam, Bhavishyattu pranalika vanti enno vishayalu vaallaku chinnapati nunde avagahana kalpincham Mana Bhadyatha. Ika pillala pempakam lo teesukovalsina jagrathalu, vari premanu mondenduku margalu ee Audiobook lo Vivarinchabaddayi. Audiobook ni Poorthiga vini Ippude mee pillala perugathalo Yandamuri cheppina Amrutha Margalanu Anusarinchandi.

leadership-1.title: Leadership
leadership-1.description: Humare andar unique leadership qualities hoti hain. Bas unhein pehchaan kar develop karne ki zaroorat hai, Taaki koi bhi leadership ki opportunity miss na ho. Lekin yeh kaise kiya jaa sakta hai? Iska poora process janne ke liye abhi suniye author Brian Tracy ki yeh audiobook.

அமெரிக்காவில்-அருக்காணி.title: அமெரிக்காவில் அருக்காணி
அமெரிக்காவில்-அருக்காணி.description: கோபியை வளர்த்து படிக்க வைத்த மாமாவுக்கு நன்றி செலுத்தும் வகையில், அவரது மகள் அருக்காணியை திருமணம் செய்து அமெரிக்கா அழைத்துச் செல்கிறான் கோபி. மகள் அங்கு எப்படி இருப்பாளோ என்று கவலைப்படும் மாமா, தன் மகன் திருப்பதியையும் உடன் அனுப்புகிறார். கோபி, அருக்காணி, திருப்பதி மூவரும் அமெரிக்காவில் சந்திக்கும் சம்பவங்களே இக்கதை.

will-ai-take-our-jobs.title: ChatGPT ani AI aple jobs ghalvnar?
will-ai-take-our-jobs.description: Sadhya AI mhnjech 'Artificial Intelligence' cha bolbala ahe. Anek companies ni Chat GPT sarkhya anek AI Tools cha wapar karyla survat hi keli ahe. Tyamule bhavishyat hi AI tools ani technology, Mansachi jaga ghenar ka? ashi chinta ankekanna ahe. Ya show dware apan AI kasa kam karta ani tyamule aple Jobs dhokyat yenar ka? he janun ghenar ahot

prachina-sabhyata-kahani-greece.title: Prachina Sabhyata Kahani - Greece
prachina-sabhyata-kahani-greece.description: Travel back in time with Kuku FM's History shows. Explore ancient civilizations pivotal moments and the people who shaped our world. Our engaging storytelling brings history to life making the past relevant and exciting. From legendary battles to cultural revolutions enrich your knowledge of the human saga. Listen and connect with the stories that define us

prahelika-series-blood-hound-1.title: Prahelika Series - Blood Hound
prahelika-series-blood-hound-1.description: পাঁচ পাঁচটা নিরস্ত্র অসহায় মানুষের ঘর ভেঙে রক্তপান করবার আনন্দে যারা ন্যায়-অন্যায়, ধৰ্ম-অধর্ম সবকিছু ভুলে গেছে, তারা দস্যু রঘুনাথকেও হারিয়ে দিয়েছে. শুনুন রোমাঞ্চ আর উত্তেজনায় টানটান গল্প, "ব্লাডহাউন্ড", প্রহেলিকা সিরিজ থেকে.

kongu-naattu-varalaaru.title: Kongu Naattu Varalaru
kongu-naattu-varalaaru.description: Government Exams ku prepare panravangalukkum, Antha kaala thamizhnaatta pathi therinjuka nenaikkiravangalukkum intha audiobook nichayam help pannum. Kongu naata pathina ellaa detailsayum azhagu thamizh la eduthu solluthu intha audiobook. Kongu Naatu varalara muzhumaiyaa therinjukalam vaanga.

where-does-currency-come-from.title: Where Does Currency Come From?
where-does-currency-come-from.description: Panam evideninnanu varunnath enna chodhyam namme ellavareyum alattiyitundavum. Nammal upayogikkunna currencikal enganeyanu srishtikappedunnathu, avaikku enthanu moolyam nalkunnath ennivayekurichch ee show vishatdheeikarikkunnu.

chalisa-ka-rahasya.title: Chalisa ka Rahasya
chalisa-ka-rahasya.description: Hanuman Chalisa ke ek rahasya ne Sanjeev ke jeevan ko palat diya. Apne mentor ki maut ke baad, Sanjeev ko milti hai ek gupt box aur ek Hanuman Chalisa, jo chupaye hue hain ek aise sach ko jo duniya badal sakta hai. Kya wo iss adbhut gyaan ko samajh kar apni duniya ko bacha payega? Suniye, 'Chalisa Ka Rahasya'!

rewind.title: Rewind
rewind.description: Scientist Vikrant, jo secret project par kho baitha apni aankhein. Uske badle mein usey mili kuch anokhi shaktiyan, jisse wo kar sakta tha time travel. Jab uski patni Menaka ek khatarnak serial killer ka shikar hui, tab Vikrant apni nayi shaktiyon ka istemal kar jata hai samay me piche. Kaun tha wo killer? Kya wo usey bacha saka? Jaanne ke liye sunein Rewind.

unsung-heroes-freedom-fighters-from-karn.title: UNSUNG HEROES - Freedom Fighters from Karnataka
unsung-heroes-freedom-fighters-from-karn.description: ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರ ಕಪಿಮುಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರಲು ಆದ ತ್ಯಾಗ-ಬಲಿದಾನಗಳಿಗೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಲ್ಲ..! ಈ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದವರು ಬಹಳಷ್ಟು ಜನರಿದ್ದಾರೆ..! ಆದರೆ, ಅವರಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನವರಿಗೆ ಯಾವದೇ ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಲ್ಲ ಅನ್ನೋದು ದುಃಖದ ಸಂಗತಿ... ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ತೆರೆಮರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತು ಪರಕೀಯರನ್ನು ಹೊರದಬ್ಬಲು ಅವಿರತ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಗಾರರು ಯಾರ್ಯಾರು ಅಂತ ತಿಳಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕಾ? ಕೇಳಿ UNSUNG HEROES - FREEDOM FIGHTERS FROM KARNATAKA ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.

south-india-who-vs-bjp.title: Who VS BJP : In South India
south-india-who-vs-bjp.description: Abki baar south mein lagegi BJP ki naiya par? Kya dusare states ki haar ki bharpayi south se kar payegi BJP. Sab janiye is khas show "Who VS BJP : In South India" mein. Vo bhi ek dam dramatic andaz mein.

krusha.title: Krusha
krusha.description: Jump into a world of diverse tales with Kuku FM's Short Stories. Perfect for listeners on the go our short stories offer quick escapes into fictional worlds. From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

birol-manush-bibhutibhushan.title: Birol Manush Bibhutibhushan
birol-manush-bibhutibhushan.description: Bangla Totha Gota Biswer Sahityo Jogote Ekjon Onyotomo Kotha- Sahityik Hisebe Jar Naam Swornakkhore Lekha Thakbe Tini Holen Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay. Sahityo Jogote Tar Obodan Oporisim. Pather Panchali, Aranyak, Ichhamati, Chander Pahar Ityadi Jonopriyo Uponyas Er Srostha Chilen Tini, Ja Aajo Manusher Moner Kothay Jayga Kore Aache. Tini Somokalin Bangla Shahitye Byatikromi Dharar Sahityik Chileno Bote. Lekhar Pashapashi Nana Samajik Kajer Songeo Jukto Chilen Tini. Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye Tar Jiboner Kichu Jana-Ojana Kotha Janar Chesta Korbo. Aasun Shuru Kora Jak.

as-a-man-thinketh-17.title: As A Man Thinketh
as-a-man-thinketh-17.description: Sochne ka andaaz badalne se kya wakai mein destiny badal sakti hai? "As A Man Thinketh" book ke explanation ko suniye, Aur janiye ki, Kaise dimaag mein aane wala ek-ek thought aapko safalta hasil karne mein madad kar sakta hai.

devshakti-adbhut-divyastra.title: Devshakti : Adbhut Divyastra
devshakti-adbhut-divyastra.description: "Prachin Bharat ke devlok mein, Tridev—Brahma, Vishnu aur Mahesh—Indra Sabha mein ek mahasankat par charcha karte hain, jo Prithvi lok aur manav jaati ke vinaash ka sanket hai. Yeh kahani nayi peedi aur adhyatmik shaktiyon ke aadhunik sangharsh ki hai. Nitya, ek saahasini ladki, apne gaon ke mandir aur apne logon ke liye lad rahi hai, jabki kuch log apne swarth aur dhan-lobh ke liye uske raaste mein rukawat ban rahe hain. Mahadev aur Tridev, devtaon ke sahyog se, dharma aur adharma ke is maha-yuddh ko sambhalne ka upaay soch rahe hain. Kya Nitya, Tridevon ki shakti se prerit hokar apne gaon ko is anarth se bacha payegi? Janiye is rahasya aur romanchak kahani mein sirf Kuku FM par!"

breath-believe-balance-1.title: Breathe Believe Balance
breath-believe-balance-1.description: Kya aapko apni limits pata hai ? Aap apni life me kitna achieve kar sakte hain ? Aur aapka best version kya hai ? Agar nahi pata to suniye is Audiobook ko aur janiye apni uss strength ke baare me jisse aap shayad ab tak anjaan the.

dark-web-live-murder-rape-aur-scams-ka-s.title: Dark Web: Live Murder, Rape aur Scams Ka Sach
dark-web-live-murder-rape-aur-scams-ka-s.description: Digital duniya ke is daur mein jahan technology ne humari life ko easy bana diya hai vahin hazaron crimes aur scams isi technology ki shadow mein kiye jaate hain. Aur isi shadow ko kehte hain Dark Web. Aakhir kya hai yeh dark web? Kaise yeh crime ki duniya ki neev ban chuka hai? In sabhi sawalon par se parda uthega iss show mein. Toh chaliye Dark Web ko gehrai se janna shuru karte hain.

measure-what-matters-4.title: Kivabe Nijer Company-R Growth Baraben?
measure-what-matters-4.description: Aapni Mone Korun Ekti Khabar Order Korlen Ba Aapni Kothao Aachen Tar Location Pathalen, Sekhetre Track Kora Somvob. Kintu Aapnar Vetorer Ba Aapnar Company Er Growth Track Korben Kivabe? Kivabe Company Er Growth Somvob? Eirokom Ek System OKR Somporke Aaj Amra Sunbo Ei Book Summary Te. Eta Ekta Osadharon System, Eta Kono Company Ke Comfort Zone Theke Bar Kore Aane. Aar Company Er Vulgulo Dhoriye Dey, Erfole Companygulo Vul Sudhre Safollyer Churay Pouche Jay Khub Druto.

why-they-killed-indira-gandhi.title: Why They Killed Indira Gandhi ?
why-they-killed-indira-gandhi.description: Indiavin Iron Lady Indira Gandhi yai ethukkaga kolai pannunaanga ? Avanga appadi enna pannitaanga ? Vaanga Varalaarai thirumbi paakalaam!

mysterious-celebrity-deaths.title: Mysterious Celebrity Deaths
mysterious-celebrity-deaths.description: Manalni alarinchi, manaku entertainment nu ichi vaallu mathram ee lokam nundi hatatthuga vellipoyaru. Endaro kalakaarulu oka velugu veligi anthakanna ekkuva cheekatiloki vellipoyaaru, Vaari maranam oka anthuchikkani rahasyam. Ila manaku thelisina endaro gurinchi ee audio book lo vini vaarini marokkasari gurthucheskundam.

makeup-punnagai.title: Makeup Punnagai
makeup-punnagai.description: கதாநாயகி சினிமாவில் ஒப்பனை எனப்படும் மேக்கப் கலையில் இயங்கும் பெண்மணியின் மகள். அவளுக்கு ஏற்படும் இயல்பான காதலை நிறைவேற்றிக் கொள்வதில் ஏற்படும் சிக்கல்களை எப்படி வெல்கிறாள் என்பதே இந்தக் கதை.

the-wedding-secret.title: The Wedding Secret
the-wedding-secret.description: Event planner Radhika apne beemar bhai ke ilaaj ke liye majboor hoti hai, tabhi uski zindagi billionaire Kabir se takraati hai. Kabir use gold digger samajhkar apni asli pehchaan chhupa deta hai, taaki uski niyat ko parkhe par jhoot ke beech unka rishta sach bolne lagta hai. Jab raaz khulte hain, ek hi sawaal bachta hai—kya Radhika gold digger thi, ya ek sacchi Dilwali?

how-to-get-high-returns-from-sip.title: How To Get High Returns From SIP
how-to-get-high-returns-from-sip.description: Sirf SIP Start Kar Dene Se Kuch Nahi Hota, Aage Kya Karna Hai Ye Bhi Jaano!

ennam-enna-seiyyum.title: Ennam enna seiyyum ?
ennam-enna-seiyyum.description: மனிதன் தன்னுள் எண்ணுவது போலவே அவனது வாழ்கையும் வடிவமைக்கப்படுகிறது. அவனது ஒவ்வொரு செயலும் அவனுக்குள் பிறக்கும் எண்ணங்களிலிருந்தே உருவாகின்றன. இந்த புத்தகம் ஒரு மனிதனின் வாழ்க்கை அவனது எண்ணங்களின் பிரதிபலிப்பு எண்பதனைப் பற்றி தெளிவுறுத்துகிறது .

journey-of-rcb.title: Journey of  RCB
journey-of-rcb.description: "RCB (ರಾಯಲ್ ಚಾಲೆಂಜರ್ಸ್ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು)" ಯ ಪ್ರಯಾಣವು IPL ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮ ತಂಡದ ಸಾಧನೆ, ಸೋಲುಗಳು, ದ್ರೋಹ, ಸ್ನೇಹಿತತ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ಅಭಿಮಾನಿಗಳ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ಸುತ್ತ ಹೆಣೆದ ಕಥೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. IPL ಒಂದು ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ ಹಬ್ಬವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಅದು ಕೇವಲ ಆಟವಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ಒಂದು ಎಮೋಶನ್. ಈ ತರಹದ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮನರಂಜನೆಯ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೆಳ್ತಾಇರಿ KUKUFM.

Chakravyuh--भारत-के-जांबाज़-अफसरों-की-सच्.title: Chakravyuh : भारत के जांबाज़ अफ़सरों की सच्ची दास्तान
Chakravyuh--भारत-के-जांबाज़-अफसरों-की-सच्.description: Nilgiri ke junglon mein Veerappan ke atank par lagam lagani ho, ya Purvi Bihar mein naksaliyon ko unhi ke bhasha mein jawab dena. DIG Yash More ka militants ke khilaf kadak action ho, ya Assam ki sherni Sanjukta Parashar ka urgrawad par prahar – har jagah khaki vardi ne dikhaya hai apna asli dum. Is show mein aap milenge un real-life superheroes se, jo desh ke liye apna sab kuch daav par lagane se nahi hichkate. Saath hi janenge un daring operations ke bare mein, jo kisi chakravyuh ko todne se kam nahi the. Pesh hai – khaki ke dhamake aur crime ke chakravyuh ko cheer dene wali kahaniyan!

when-money-destroy-nation.title: Inflation aur World Economy
when-money-destroy-nation.description: Inflation kya hota hai aur kab wo hyperinflation ban jata hai? Iska hum par direct asar kaise padta hai? World economy se common man ka kya connection hai aur currency ka value girna hamare liye bura kyon hai? Agar aap wo world politics or world economy fascinate karti hai, toh ye show zaroor sune aur jaane ek jeeti jagti kahani ne - Zimbabwe ki.

the-legend-of-sleepy-hollow.title: The Legend of Sleepy Hollow
the-legend-of-sleepy-hollow.description: The most beloved and oft-adapted work by Washington Irving The Legend of Sleepy Hollow follows a love triangle in the New York countryside in 1790. Sleepy Hollow a supposedly haunted glen on the outskirts of Tarry Town is home to a particularly ghoulish fiend - the Headless Horseman - who is said to be the specter of a fallen soldier. Ichabod Crane a schoolmaster from Connecticut competes with local hero Abraham 'Brom Bones' Van Brunt for the affections of the young beautiful and wealthy Katrina Van Tassel. Crane considered an outsider by the community takes part in an annual harvest party in a bid to win Katrina's hand in marriage. His scheme fails however and Crane has a run-in with Sleepy Hollow's most infamous resident.

paapa-rayudu.title: Papa Rayudu
paapa-rayudu.description: 1930లో కృష్ణానది ఒడ్డున ఉన్న అమరావతి గ్రామం సాదాసీదా జీవితం గడుపుతుండగా, ఒక వింత సంఘటన ఆ ఊరిని కుదిపేస్తుంది. ఒక అజ్ఞాత వ్యక్తి ఫ్లూట్ మ్యూజిక్ ద్వారా ఊర్లో ప్రవేశించటంతో వాతావరణం పూర్తిగా మారిపోతుంది. జ్యోతి, రాఘవ, కేశవలు తమ సమస్యలకు పరిష్కారం వెతుక్కుంటూ ఉండగా, ఊహించని ఈ సంఘటనలు వారిని కొత్త ప్రశ్నలతో ఉక్కిరిబిక్కిరి చేస్తాయి. ఈ కథ కొత్త మలుపులు తిరుగుతూ, అందరి జీవితాల్ని ఒక రహస్య ప్రపంచంలోకి లాక్కెళ్తుంది.

bad-boy-billionaires.title: Bad Boy Billionaires

my-stepbrothers-obsession.title: My Stepbrother's Obsession
my-stepbrothers-obsession.description: Savannah Cross enters the Sterling/Herron world with her mother Nora after Nora marries into the family, and she is immediately treated as an outsider by Cash, the heir who assumes she is chasing money and status. Rather than accept that role, Savannah pushes back at school and at home, refusing to be reduced to a burden or charity case. Her intelligence and financial skill gradually turn her from a target into a threat, especially when she exposes Charlotte DeWitt’s family debt and later proves herself in finance and accounting settings. Cash remains a complicated force in her life, alternating between accusation, protection, control, and attraction. Their tension deepens into a forbidden, scandalous connection that is made more dangerous by the fact that they are step-siblings and by the strain it places on their parents’ marriage. Inside the family, Harvey uses scandal, trust structures, and inheritance pressure to keep everyone in line, making the household feel like a battleground rather than a refuge. Savannah’s work at Sterling Energy pulls her into a larger corporate conflict when she spots suspicious numbers and uncovers a fraud scheme involving false maintenance records and diverted money. Cash joins that fight, and the two of them become uneasy allies as they try to recover control and protect what matters to them. Their alliance is tested by secrecy, surveillance, and the constant risk that any misstep will be used against them. A secret kiss becomes a major liability when it is discovered and turned into leverage in the inheritance struggle. The danger is no longer only social humiliation but also legal exposure, as offshore companies and blind trusts reveal that the family conflict is tied to broader financial misconduct. Savannah urges caution and strategy, while Cash is more inclined toward direct confrontation, and that difference shapes their fragile partnership. At school, Savannah is publicly framed and then vindicated, showing that the same people who try to shame her can also be exposed. Charlotte’s attempts to humiliate her repeatedly backfire, but the pressure never fully disappears. By the end of the arc, Savannah and Cash are bound together by attraction, distrust, and shared enemies, fighting not just for status but for safety, inheritance, and the future of the family itself.

my-secret-soldier-husband.title: My Secret Soldier Husband
my-secret-soldier-husband.description: Sebastian Caine begins the story disgraced after exposing corruption in a defense pipeline, and the system quickly turns against him. His rank is stripped, and his missing sister becomes leverage that keeps him under pressure. At the same time, Scarlett Rhodes is pulled into a family inheritance war that threatens her accounts, her voting power, and her place in the Rhodes estate. To block Richard Rhodes and protect Scarlett’s family trust, a marriage pact is forced into place as legal cover. Scarlett resists the arrangement at first, but the danger around her makes the alliance impossible to ignore. Public humiliations in shops and at elite gatherings show how exposed she has become. Sebastian repeatedly steps in as her husband and protector, even while Scarlett questions his money, identity, and motives. Richard’s campaign grows more aggressive as he moves from court control to armed violence and hired attackers. The couple is pushed into close quarters in a fortified safehouse, where trust becomes as important as survival. Sebastian’s combat skill and hidden past surface under attack, suggesting he is far more than a simple bodyguard. The marriage, which began as a cold legal shield, turns into a constant battleground shaped by surveillance, secrecy, and danger. Scarlett slowly starts to suspect that Sebastian has been protecting her all along. Meanwhile, Sebastian keeps searching for his sister and fighting off the people trying to silence him. The Rhodes family conflict widens into a larger conspiracy involving hidden accounts, corruption, and a frame-up tied to Sebastian’s ruined career. Richard remains the central threat, still trying to seize control of the trust and force Scarlett into submission. Even when Scarlett signs the marriage document and becomes Mrs. Sebastian Caine, the union does not bring peace. The church wedding is interrupted by armed men, and Sebastian is injured protecting her. By the end of the batch, their marriage stands as both shield and battlefield, with the conspiracy still unresolved and Sebastian’s sister confirmed alive but trapped in a psychiatric facility.

the-mafia-queens-secret-heiress-3.title: Comblang Sang Ratu Mafia
the-mafia-queens-secret-heiress-3.description: Nora Quinn begins as a young accountant caught in a ruthless family and money war, first when she is framed for stealing 10 million dollars and pressured into a false confession. Instead of breaking, she gathers hidden evidence, including server logs and proof that the routing number was forged, and starts turning the accusation back on the people who set her up. Her fight quickly becomes personal when she reconnects with her long-lost father, Samuel, after years apart and learns that family secrets and money were used to keep them separated. At the same time, the family faces eviction threats, rent pressure, and attacks on the sewing and tailor business that Nora and Samuel are trying to save. Wealthy elites and the Vance family pull the Quinns into a wider struggle involving marriage offers, public humiliation, trust funds, custody records, and hidden financial schemes. Nora is repeatedly targeted in public, but she refuses to stay ashamed and uses proof, leverage, and sharp timing to protect herself and her father. Cole emerges as a steady protector and ally, standing beside Nora as the conflict grows more dangerous and more public. The story reveals that the attacks are not random, but part of a long-running effort to control assets, silence witnesses, and bury fraud. Nora uncovers forged custody papers, destroyed originals, and signs that trust money was used as collateral in a larger scheme. She also learns that officials and inspectors can be bought, which pushes the battle beyond family drama into legal and civic corruption. When the business is threatened by false inspections and a shutdown attempt, Nora fights back with records and exposes a hidden bribe that helps reverse the ruling. The family shop and license are saved for the moment, but the victory only deepens the war with the Vance side. Nora then pushes into the financial network itself, exposing shell accounts, hidden ledgers, and debt leverage that others used to control the family. Samuel’s past is also revealed to be more dangerous than it first seemed, since he is tied to a former criminal life that enemies have used against him. Even so, Nora keeps choosing action over fear, using every new piece of evidence to reclaim power. By the end of the batch, she has shifted the balance in her favor, but the corruption, old grudges, and unresolved enemies are still active.

dwapara-yuga-arambhadinda-antyada-kathe.title: Dwapara Yuga: Arambhadinda Antyada Kathe
dwapara-yuga-arambhadinda-antyada-kathe.description: ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಆದಿಯಿಂದ ಅಂತ್ಯದ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುವ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಯುಗಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಾಪರಯುಗವು ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ ಘಟನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ವಿಷ್ಣು ದೇವರ ಅವತಾರನಾದ ಭಗವಾನ್‌ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣರ ಜನನದಂತಹ ಪುಣ್ಯ ಘಟನೆಯನ್ನ ಕಣ್ತುಂಬಿಕೊಂಡ ದ್ವಾಪರಯುಗವು, ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ರೋಚಕ ಕುರುಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಸರಿಸುಮಾರು 8 ಲಕ್ಷ 64 ಸಾವಿರ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಸುದೀರ್ಘ ಇತಿಹಾಸವಿರೋ, ಭಾರತೀಯ ಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಭೋದನೆಗಳನ್ನ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಂತಹ ದ್ವಾಪರಯುಗದ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಸುಂದರ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "ದ್ವಾಪರಯುಗ: ಆರಂಭದಿಂದ ಅಂತ್ಯದ ಕಥೆ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

mystery-note-rekha.title: Mystery Note : Rekha
mystery-note-rekha.description:
హైదరాబాద్ టు రఘులాపల్లి ... రేఖా, తన బెస్ట్ ఫ్రెండ్ అజయ్ చనిపోయాక ఊర్లోకి మళ్ళీ రీ-ఎంట్రీ ఇస్తుంది. అక్కడ ఆమెను చూస్తున్న ఆ రెండు మూఢమైన కళ్ళు, అప్పుడే బ్యాక్‌గ్రౌండ్‌లో సీన్ సెట్ చేస్తాయి. ఇంటికి రాగానే, అజయ్ గదిలో దొరికిన ఒక మిస్టీరియస్ పెన్ డ్రైవ్... రాత్రి 1 AM కి లాప్‌టాప్‌కి ప్లగ్ చెయ్యగానే "ENTER PASSWORD" స్క్రీన్... ఇదే అసలు కుట్రకి మెయిన్ గేట్! అదే టైమ్‌లో విండో బయట ఏదో అడుగుల సౌండ్, అజయ్ రైట్ హ్యాండ్ ఫ్రెండ్ రవి ఎంట్రీ... అతని చేతిలో అజయ్ చివరి వాయిస్ నోట్... అందులో "విజయ్, సోనియా, మహేష్… ఏడుపు వినిపించారు" అనే క్రేజీ క్లూ! ఇక్కడి నుండే మొదలవుతుంది రేఖా లైఫ్‌లో అల్టిమేట్ మిస్టరీ అండ్ థ్రిల్లర్ పజిల్!
రవి వాయిస్ నోట్ లోని ఆ పేర్లలో ఫస్ట్ సోనియానే టార్గెట్. రేఖా తన పాత జర్నలిజం టాలెంట్‌తో సోనియా NGO ని పట్టుకుని ఇంటర్వ్యూ అడుగుతుంది. బయట సూపర్ కూల్ అండ్ సాఫ్ట్‌గా కనిపించే సోనియా, లోపల మాత్రం ఒకే ఒక్క ప్రశ్నకు పూర్తిగా స్కాన్ అయ్యినట్టు అవాయిడ్ చేస్తుంది. ఆ బిల్డింగ్ వెనుక ఒక పెయింట్-ఔట్ QR కోడ్... స్కాన్ చేస్తే "Project memory Phase-II" అనే డాక్యుమెంట్ డ్రాప్‌బాక్స్ లింక్! కోట్ల రూపాయల అకౌంటింగ్ రికార్డ్స్, పిల్లల కథలు! ఆ రాత్రే "memory" అనే పాస్‌వర్డ్‌తో డ్రైవ్ ఓపెన్ అవుతుంది. అందులో వీడియో, ఆడియో, టెక్స్ట్, ఇమేజెస్ ఫోల్డర్లు. ఒక చిన్న వీడియో ప్లే చేస్తే... అజయ్‌ను కుడివైపు రక్తం కారుతున్న సీన్ క్లియర్‌గా కనిపిస్తుంది!

maduve-with-my-ex.description: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಲ್ಲಿ ನೂರಾರು ಕೋಟಿ ಟರ್ನ್‌ಓವರ್‌ ಇರೋ ಕಂಪೆನಿಗಳ ಓನರ್‌ ಆಗಿರೋ ವಿಕ್ರಾಂತ್‌, ವೀಕೆಂಡ್‌ ಬಂತು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಪಾರ್ಟಿ, ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್‌ ಅಂತ ಸಖತ್‌ ಜಾಲಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದ. ಆದ್ರೆ, ಅವನ ಲೈಫ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನೀರಿಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ನಡೆದ ಆ ಒಂದು ಘಟನೆಯಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಕಲ್ಲಾಗಿತ್ತು! ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕವಾಗಿ ವಿಕ್ರಾಂತ್‌ನನ್ನ ಮದುವೆಯಾಗಿ, ಗರ್ಭಿಣಿಯೂ ಆಗಿದ್ದ ಪ್ರಿಯಾಳಿಗೆ ವಿಕ್ರಾಂತ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಆತನ ತಾಯಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಟಾರ್ಚರ್‌ ನೀಡಿದ್ರು. ಪ್ರಿಯಾಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಂಡ್ತಿ ಸ್ಥಾನವಾಗಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ಮನೆಯ ಸೊಸೆ ಸ್ಥಾನವಾಗಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ! ಗಂಡ ಮತ್ತು ಅತ್ತೆಯ ಕಾಟವನ್ನ ಸಹಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳದ ಪ್ರಿಯಾ, ವಿಕ್ರಾಂತ್‌ಗೆ ಡಿವೋರ್ಸ್‌ ನೀಡಿ ಈಗ ಸೇಡು ತೀರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾಳೆ. ಆಗರ್ಭ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತನಾಗಿರೋ ವಿಕ್ರಾಂತ್‌ ಮೇಲೆ ಪ್ರಿಯಾ ರೆವೆಂಜ್‌ ತಗೋಳ್ತಾಳಾ? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಮೂಡಿಸೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "ಮದುವೆ With My Ex" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

hiranya-garbha.description: ನಿಧಿಶೋಧದ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಸದಾ ರೋಚಕ. ತಾವು ಪಡೆಯುವರೋ ಇಲ್ಲವೋ ಎಂಬ ಕುತೂಹಲದ ಜೊತೆ, ಹುಡುಕಾಟದ ತಿರುವು-ಸುಳಿವುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಕಾಲದ ಸಹಕಾರ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಅದ್ಭುತ. ನವೀನ್ ಶಾಂಡಿಲ್ಯ ಅವರ 'ಹಿರಣ್ಯ ಗರ್ಭ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಇದನ್ನೇ ಆಕರ್ಷಕವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

But what if you could make a few simple, small changes that significantly improve your life's quality? The daunting task of improving your health would suddenly feel more manageable and achievable, giving you the confidence to take more steps toward a better you. This audiobook is all about the little things you can do every day to improve your well-being. Each episode features intriguing topics that will help you make better choices and provide you with simple ways to promote a healthy lifestyle. Your health should be a top priority, and making time for it is easier than you think! Learn the valuable tips and tricks to take control of your fitness and become healthier with this incredibly informative series.

resurrection-of-the-damned.title: Resurrection of the Damned
resurrection-of-the-damned.description: Three months ago, a demon invasion shattered the world’s order, leaving old rules in the dust as humanity scrambles to identify the true enemy. For Katie, it seems that even when the world’s on fire, there’s no such thing as a vacation. Sometimes, it’s just not worth getting out of bed.

the-war-of-art-2.title: The War Of Art
the-war-of-art-2.description: ಸ್ಟೀವನ್ ಪ್ರೆಸ್‌ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ ಅವರ "ದ ವಾರ್ ಆಫ್ ಆರ್ಟ್" ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಸೃಜನಾತ್ಮಕತೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಅಡಚಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೊಡೆದುಹಾಕಲು ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾದ ಒಂದು ಶಕ್ತಿ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಲಾವಿದ, ಲೇಖಕ, ಮತ್ತು ಕನಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುವ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಮುಂದಿರುವ "ಪ್ರತಿರೋಧ" ಎಂಬ ಅಡಚಣೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೆಳಕು ಚೆಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಆಪ್ತ ಸಲಹೆಗಳನ್ನು, ಚಿಂತನೆಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾದ ಶಬ್ದಗಳನ್ನು, ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರತೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸೃಜನಾತ್ಮಕತೆಯ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಕಾಣಲು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಲಿಸಲು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿರುವ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಪುನಃ ಜಾಗೃತಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಲಾತ್ಮಕ ಉತ್ಸಾಹವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

Khedegavat janmalela ek mulga te Jagtil sarvat Yashasvi ani Shrimant Udyojak banyaparyntcha tyancha Prawas, aplyala Business values chi olkah karun deto, Planning ani Exicution kasa karva he sangto, Mehnat karnyacha yogya Marga dakhvto ani apla Swapana purna karnyasathi Prerna deto. Chala tar mag ya khas show dvare aikuya, Udyog Samratacha motivational jeevan pravas.

netaji-subhash-chandra-bose.title: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose
netaji-subhash-chandra-bose.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

md-siraj-youth-icon.title: Md Siraj: The Youth Icon
md-siraj-youth-icon.description: Cricket er itihas e onupreronadayok kichu golper sari te Md SIraj er golpo ektu onyorokom. Indian premiere league tar jatra dekhar moto, kivabe Md Siraj Hyderabad er chotto ekta goli theke antorjatik cricket er ongsho hoye uthen janen ki? Kenoi ba Md Siraj ke Miyaa bhai ar ekhon kar youth icon hisebe gonyo kora hoi shei shob jante shune nin ei World Cup e ei audio story ti.

how-to-treat-your-pets.title: How to Treat Your Pets
how-to-treat-your-pets.description: Chalamandi Animals tama friends ga penchukuntaru. Rojantha Paniki velli vachhesariki intlo unna pets manani Aa tension marchipoyela Alaristhayi. Inka ontari tananiki toduga, intiki kapalaaga kuda untayi. Mari alanti pempudu jantuvalanu badramga ela chusukovalo ee Audio book lo meeru telsusukuntaru.

murdercom.title: Murder.com
murdercom.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

சிரித்ராலயா.title: சி(ரி)த்ராலயா
சிரித்ராலயா.description: Sithralaya kobuvin kalakalappana thrai payana kurippugal thaan intha audio book. Nakesh, Sivaji ganesan kooda avarukku erpatta anupavangala kelunga...

jivashastra-vignanam-samajam.title: జీవశాస్త్ర విజ్ఞానం సమాజం
jivashastra-vignanam-samajam.description: జీవ పరిణామ సిద్దాంతానికి ఆధునిక వివరణ, మనుషుల,ఇతర ప్రాణుల మనుగడకు,ప్రవర్తనకు జన్యు పరమైన ఆధారాల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? చావు పుట్టుకలు, జన్యువులు, బాక్టీరియా మరియు వైరస్ ల గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనే ఆసక్తి  మీకు ఉందా?  అయితే ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ వినండి.

accidentally-yours-1.title: Accidentally Yours
accidentally-yours-1.description: Varun (23), a shy illustrator, and Anaya (22), a writer nursing a broken heart, are neighbors who have never spoken. They share a lift and a tea stall but remain strangers until Anaya accidentally dials Varun during a breakdown. Encouraged by his quirky friend Yash, Varun calls back, sparking an unexpected bond. Over 25 episodes, they fall for each other’s voices, building a deep connection before ever realizing they are right next door.

kalotiyar-dweep-e.title: Kalotiyar Dweep-e
kalotiyar-dweep-e.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

valmiki-ramayanam-ayodya-kanda.title: Valmiki Ramayanam (Ayodya Kanda)
valmiki-ramayanam-ayodya-kanda.description: వాల్మీకి మహర్షి రచించిన రామాయణాన్ని శ్రీపాద సుబ్రహ్మణ్యశాస్త్రి తెలుగులో అందించారు. అయోధ్యాకాండలో దశరథుని పట్టాభిషేక నిర్ణయం, కైకేయి కోరికలు, రాముని వనవాసం, భరతుని విచారం మరియు దశరథుని మరణం — ఈ హృదయవిదారక ఘట్టాలు అద్భుతంగా చిత్రించబడ్డాయి!

miracle-morning-millionaires.title: Sokale Uthe Kivabe Kotipoti Hoben ?
miracle-morning-millionaires.description: Aapni Hoyto Shune Thakben Jibone Sofol Byaktider Moddhey Beshirvag Vore Othen. Kintu Ki Khunje Pan Tara Vore Othar Moddhey? Kivabe Safolyer Churay Pouchono Jay? 'SAVERS'- Kothar Ortho Ki? Jibone Kon Pothe Egote Hobe Activevabe? Kivabe Nijer Jiboner Goalgulo Thik Korben? Kivabe Plan Kore Vore Uthben? Jibone Kivabe Cholle Aapnio Hote Paren Dhoni Byakti? Kon Pothe Ghotbe Aapnar Jibone Miracle? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Somadhan Sutro Pete Shune Nin Ei Audiobook.

sachin-tendulkar-1.title: Sachin Tendulkar
sachin-tendulkar-1.description: Sachin Tendulkar viramichathinu shesham Indian Cricket orupaad dhooram sancharichu kondirikkunnu. Adhehathinte sakala recordukalum thakarkkapettekaam pakshe Indian janathaye athra yere swaadheenichcha Sachin ennum vyathyasthamaayi thanne nilanilkkum.

the-power-of-subconscious-mind.title: The Power of Subconscious Mind
the-power-of-subconscious-mind.description: nammaloda aazhmanam namma vazhkkaila miga periya thaakatha yerpaduthum!! aazh manathai naama kattupaduthunave naama pala bayangalai vazhkkaila kattu paduthalam. aazh manathin visithirangalai indha bookla kelunga

communicate-to-influence-11.title: Manush Ke Influence Korar Tips
communicate-to-influence-11.description: Ei boi er sarangsho theke amra jante parbo ki bhabe kono barta pouchono uchit jeta manushder inform kora chharao influence ar inspire o korbe. Apnara shikhte parben je  byaparta kokhonoi message noi byapar ta shob somoy e messenger ba dut er byapare, jini ashole message ba barta ta pouchochhen. Communicate To Influence boi tir sarangsho theke amra shikhte parbo je ki bhabe je kono message ba barta kei 'message of influence' kore tola shombhob.

മഹാഭാരതത്തിലെ-അറിയാക്കഥകൾ-ഭാഗം--3.title: മഹാഭാരതത്തിലെ അറിയാക്കഥകൾ, ഭാഗം - 3
മഹാഭാരതത്തിലെ-അറിയാക്കഥകൾ-ഭാഗം--3.description: മഹാഭാരതത്തിലെ കഥകൾ ധാരാളമുണ്ട്, ഇവ പ്രധാന കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളുമായി നേരിട്ടും അല്ലാതെയും ബന്ധപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു.  ഈ കഥകളിൽ ചിലത് അറിയപ്പെടുന്നവയാണ്, മറ്റുള്ളവ അത്ര പ്രശസ്തമല്ല, അങ്ങനെ അറിയപ്പെടാതെ പോയ കഥകളേയും കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളേയും ഒന്ന് കേട്ടു നോക്കിയാലോ...

tales-from-the-arabian-nights.title: Tales From the Arabian Nights
tales-from-the-arabian-nights.description: మనసును దోచే అరేబియన్ కథలు మీ కోసం, ఊహల లోకం లో విహరించండి.

asahaja.title: Asahaja
asahaja.description: ಅಸಂಗತ ನಾಟಕಗಳ ಹರಿಕಾರ ಅಂತಾನೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧರಾದ ‘ಚಂದ್ರಕಾಂತ ಕುಸನೂರು’ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಲೇಖಕ ಹಾಗೂ ರಂಗಕರ್ಮಿ. ಇವರ ಹಲವು ಕೃತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ‘ಅಸಹಜ’ ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು. ಅಪಘಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಲು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ, ಕೆಲಸವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿರ್ತಾನೆ. ಮುಂದೆ ಆತನ ಕೆಲಸ ಹೆಂಡತಿಗೆ ಮಂಜೂರಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಹೀಗೆ ಆತನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ಅಸಹಜ ಘಟನೆಗಳನ್ನ ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನ ರಚಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಆ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

जयललिता--लेखक--सचिन-गोस्वामी.title: Jayalalitha
जयललिता--लेखक--सचिन-गोस्वामी.description:
थलावी अम्मा  जयाकुमार जयललिता उर्फ जे जयललिता । आजाद हिंदुस्तान की चुनिंदा सबसे पॉवरफुल वूमेन पॉलिटीशियन की बात करें तो उस लिस्ट में शायद इंदिरा गांधी के बाद नाम हो  जे जयललिता का,पर अगर  हम बात करें उन महिला शख्सियत की जिन्होंने दो विपरीत क्षेत्रों में अपना दबदबा कायम रखा तो बिना किसी संदेह के उस सूची में केवल एक ही नाम होगा वो है थलावी जे जयललिता का ।

Author : Sachin Goswami
Voiceover Artist : Rj Riddhi

pandayakalathil-vilayattum-vizhakkalum.title: Pandayakalathil Vilayattum Vizhakkalum
pandayakalathil-vilayattum-vizhakkalum.description: Pandayakalathil thamizhargalin vilayattum, avargaloda panpaadayum pattri sila mukkiya vishayangala indha audio book la kelunga.

karz.title: Karz
karz.description: Avantika Basu, 27, ek CBI officer hai, aur uska pati Dhruvesh ek private bank mein kaam karta hai. Pregnancy ke baad Avantika ko darawane sapne aur ajeeb ghatnayein hone lagti hain. Uski mulaqat ek ladki, Jigyasa, se hoti hai jo aatmaon se baat karti hai, aur Avantika ko uske pehle pyaar Aditya ki aatma se milwata hai. Aditya bataata hai ki uska murder hua tha aur apne bache aur pyaar ka karz chukane ki baat karta hai. Kya Avantika apne pyaar ke maut ke raaz ko suljha payegi, jab sab kuch itna complex aur mysterious ho?

understanding-islam-its-spirits-and-valu.title: Understanding Islam- Its spirits and values
understanding-islam-its-spirits-and-valu.description: അടിസ്ഥാന ഗ്രന്ഥമായ വിശുദ്ധ ഖുറാനെ അടിസ്ഥാമാക്കി ഇസ്ലാമിൻ്റെ യഥാർത്ഥ സത്തയെ കുറിച്ചുളള അന്വേഷണമാണു അഹദ് അഹമദ്ദിൻ്റെ ഈ രചന. ഇസ്ലാമിനെ സംബന്ധിച്ച് ഇന്ന് നിലനിൽക്കുന്ന അബദ്ധധാരണകളെ നിക്കി ഖുറാൻ്റെ മൗലികമായ അന്തസത്തയെ ആധുനിക തലമുറക്ക്  കൈമാറുക എന്നതാണു ഈ രചനയുടെ ഉദ്ദേശ്യം. ഖുറാനിലെ വചനങ്ങളെ വളരെ കുറച്ച് മാത്രം വ്യാഖാനിച്ച് കഴിയുന്നത്ര മൗലികതയോടെ അവതരിപ്പിക്കാനാണു ഈ രചനയിൽ ശ്രമിച്ചിട്ടുളളത്.

job-mein-jaldi-promotion-pane-ke-tips.title: Job Mein Jaldi Promotion Pane Ke Tips
job-mein-jaldi-promotion-pane-ke-tips.description: Agar aap chahte hain ki aapki job mein aapka jaldi se promotion ho jaye, toh 'Job mein jaldi promotion pane ke tips' aapke liye perfect hai! Iss audio show mein aap jaan payenge har wo step, jisse aap promotion ko haasil kar paaye, jaise ki apne skills ko kaise develop karein, apne boss ke saath kaise communicate karein, aur kaam mein apna confidence kaise badhayein. Yeh show aapko aapke career growth ke liye behtar tarike batayega, jisse aap apni professional zindagi mein success paa sakte hain.

why-and-how-congress-was-formed.title: Why And How Congress Was Formed?
why-and-how-congress-was-formed.description: Engane allenkil enthinu vendiyanu 'Indian National Congress' enna sanghadana bharathathil roopikrithamayathu. Atharamoru sanghadanayude aavashyakatha enthayirunnu? Sanghadanayude lekshyangal enthoke ayrunnu? Swathantra samarathil enthu swadheenamanu Indian National Congress cheluthiyathu? Oro bharatheeyanum arinjirikkenda ee vasthuthakal enthoke anennu ariyam  'Why and how Congress was formed?' enna ee audio bookilude.

shiva-purana.title: Shiv Puran: आदि से अंत की कथा
shiva-purana.description: Aaj hum har samay choti-badi mushkilon se ghire rehte hain. Kyunki humari zindagi ke dhaage poori tarah se ulajh chuke hain. Jinko suljhane ke liye humein ek badlaav laakar nayi shuruaat karne ki zaroorat hai. Aur vo kaise ki ja sakti hai iska jawab aapko milega is Shiv Puraan mein.

mr-dumb-husband.title: Mr. Dumb Husband
mr-dumb-husband.description: Sabko lagta tha ki Hriday ek pagal aadmi hai jo bas apne khilono ke saath ek bacche ki tarah zindagi guzaar raha hai, lekin sach kuch aur tha. Paanch saal pehle, ek haadse ne Hriday ko ek samajhdar, hoshiyaar aur passionate pati se duniya ki nazaron mein pagal bana diya tha. Jab ek sunehri anguthi uski ungli mein aati hai, toh sab kuch badal jaata hai. Hriday sirf pagal nahi dikhta, ab woh alag lagne bhi lagta hai. Jab Paddy ke gharwale uske pagal pati ko uski zindagi se nikaalne ki saazish rachte hain, toh ek ke baad ek raaz, dhokhe aur dard samne aane lagte hain. Par kya Paddy apne pati ko samajh payegi? Kya Hriday apni patni aur apni pehchaan ko bacha payega? Ya phir ek baar phir, woh sab kuch kho dega?

story-of-human-evolution.title: Story Of Human Evolution
story-of-human-evolution.description: ശാസ്ത്രലോകത്തെ കീഴ്‌മേല്‍ മറിച്ച സിദ്ധാന്തവുമായി ഒരിക്കല്‍ ഒരാള്‍ വന്നു. ചാള്‍സ് ഡാര്‍വിന്‍. താന്‍ ആരാണ് എന്ന ചോദ്യത്തിന് ഉത്തരം തേടിക്കൊണ്ടിരുന്ന മനുഷ്യന് ഏറ്റവും ശാസ്ത്രീയമായ ഉത്തരം നല്‍കിയ സിദ്ധാന്തമാണ് പരിണാമ സിദ്ധാന്തം. നമ്മുടെ കഥ നമ്മള്‍ തന്നെ അറിഞ്ഞില്ലെങ്കില്‍ പിന്നെ എങ്ങനെയാണ്!

lachhama.title: Lachhama
lachhama.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

chinkuche-chale-aani-faster-fene.title: Chinkuche Chale Aani Faster Fene
chinkuche-chale-aani-faster-fene.description: Join the adventure with Kuku FM's Teens & Young Adult shows. Tailored for the young and the young at heart our content ranges from coming-of-age stories to fantastical adventures. Engage with characters facing challenges discoveries and the thrill of growing up. Inspiring entertaining and relatable these shows are perfect for teen listeners and those seeking youthful spirit.

who-killed-naina.title: Who Killed Naina?
who-killed-naina.description: ఒక పేరు మోసిన సైన్స్ ల్యాబ్ లో శవంగా మారి ఉంది ఒక జూనియర్ సైంటిస్ట్.. ఆమెది హత్య అని కొంతమంది.. ఆత్మహత్యా అని మరికొంతమంది చెప్పుకొచ్చారు.అడగడానికి ముందు వెనుక ఎవరూ లేరని తెలిసి తనది ఆత్మహత్యే అని డిక్లేర్ చేసి పోస్టుమార్టం కూడా చేయకుండా బాడీని కాల్చేశారు.. అది నిజంగా హత్యేనా? లేక ఆత్మహత్య? అసలు ఆ అమ్మాయి కథ తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ షో వినాల్సిందే..!

big-life-goals-plan-madodege.title: Big Life Goals : Plan madodege?
big-life-goals-plan-madodege.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಿಗೂ ಒಂದೊಂದು ಗುರಿ ಇದ್ದೇ ಇರುತ್ತೆ! ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲಿ ಇಂತಿಷ್ಟು ವಯಸ್ಸೊಳಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸ್ವಂರ ಕಾರು, ಮನೆ, ಬ್ಯುಸಿನೆಸ್ ಇರ್ಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಇರೋ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾದ ಕನಸು. ಆದ್ರೆ ಎಜುಕೇಷನ್ ಲೋನ್, ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ EMI, ಮದುವೆ ಸಾಲ, ಇನ್ನೊಂದಷ್ಟು ಲೋನ್ಸ್ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ಬದುಕೇ ಸಾಲದ ಸುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಬರೋ ಸಂಬಳದಲ್ಲೇ ತಮ್ಮ ಮದುವೆಗೆ, ಮನೆಗೆ, ಕಾರಿಗೆ, ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಾದ ರಿಟೈರ್ಮೆಂಟಿಗೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ಲಾನ್ ಮಾಡೋದು? ಫೈನಾನ್ಷಿಯಲ್ ಫ್ರೀಡಂ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನು? ನಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಬಹು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಗುರಿಗಳನ್ನ ತಲುಪೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಇರೋ ದಾರಿಗಳೇನು? ಇವೆಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಬಿಗ್ ಲೈಫ್ ಗೋಲ್ಸ್ : ಪ್ಲಾನ್ ಮಾಡೋದೇಗೆ?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

sound-of-om-kya-ek-awaaz-dimaag-badal-sa.title: Sound Of Om: Kya Ek Awaaz Dimaag Badal Sakti Hai?
sound-of-om-kya-ek-awaaz-dimaag-badal-sa.description: Can a single sound change the way your brain works? Revered for thousands of years in Indian philosophy, OM has long been associated with meditation, consciousness, and inner peace. But what does modern neuroscience actually say? Sound of OM investigates the science, psychology, acoustics, and spiritual significance of this ancient syllable, separating evidence from belief while exploring how chanting OM may influence stress, focus, emotional balance, and mental well-being.

collector-bro-ini-njan-thallatte.title: കളക്ടർ ബ്രോ - ഇനി ഞാൻ തള്ളട്ടെ
collector-bro-ini-njan-thallatte.description: ഒരു സാധാരണ സിവിൽ സർവീസ് ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥന്റെ വരണ്ട ഓർമ്മക്കുറിപ്പുകൾ അല്ല ഈ പുസ്തകം. മറിച്ച്, "അനുകമ്പ" എന്ന ഒരൊറ്റ ആശയത്തിൽ കോർത്തിണക്കിയ വ്യക്തിപരമായ അനുഭവങ്ങളുടെയും ആശയങ്ങളുടെയും ഒരു ശേഖരമാണിത്.

alaipaayuthe.title: Alaipaayuthey
alaipaayuthe.description: திருமண வாழ்க்கையில் திருப்தி இல்லாத சந்துருவும் ஐஸ்வர்யாவும் ஓபன் மேரேஜில் சென்று அவர்களின் காமம் , காதல் என இரண்டிலும் முழுமையடைய நினைக்கிறார்கள் . தங்கள் திருமண வாழ்க்கையை காப்பாற்ற அவர்கள் எடுத்த இந்த முடிவு சரியா ?

dharmapuranam-1.title: Dharmapuranam
dharmapuranam-1.description: ധർമ്മപുരാണം അടിയന്തരാവസ്ഥയുടെ കഥയാണെന്ന് ചിലർ വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നു. എന്നാൽ ബിഭത്സമായ കാമരൂപങ്ങൾ നിറഞ്ഞ ഈ മഹാപുരാണത്തെ കാലത്തിന്റെ ചെറിയ അതിരുകൾക്കിടയിൽ തളച്ചിടാനാവില്ല. അത് നമ്മുടെയും ലോകത്തിന്റെയും ചരിത്രത്തിനു മേൽ വീണുകിടക്കുന്ന ദുരന്ത വിധിയാണ്. കാലത്തെ അതിജീവിക്കുന്ന ഒരു രാഷ്ട്രീയ ആക്ഷേപഹാസ്യം.

heroes-of-1971.title: Heroes of 1971
heroes-of-1971.description: 1971 ki yeh kahani un veer jawano ki hai, jinhone Bharat ke liye nayi itihas ki lakirein kheenchi thi. Ye kahani unke veerta bhare kisson ki hai, jinse Bangladesh ka janm hua aur Bharat ka Vijayi Pataka poori duniya mein lehraya.

how-to-make-dividend-income.title: How To Make Dividend Income?
how-to-make-dividend-income.description: Ningal swampnam kannunna sambathika swathanthrathilekkulla vazhikkatti! Ettavum mikacha divident nalkunna oharikal thiranjeddukkunathinulla nurungugal ee show ningale padipikkunnu.

detective-ajay-road-accident-2.title: Detective Ajay - Road Accident
detective-ajay-road-accident-2.description:
Detective Ajay ne is Road Accident ko jab gaur se dekha, toh use yeh ek Murder Case laga. Kya woh Arjun Gupta ke accident ki asli wajah dhoondh payega ?

సంక్రాంతి--సాంప్రదాయాలు--ఆచారాలు-.description: సరదాల సంక్రాంతి వస్తుందంటే చాలు రంగు రంగుల ముగ్గులు, వాటి మధ్యలో గొబ్బిళ్లు, కోడి పందేలు, కొత్త అల్లుళ్లు, పిండి వంటలతో ప్రతి ఒక్కరి ఇల్లు పండుగ శోభతో వెలిగిపోతుంది. సంబురాల సంక్రాంతి పండుగతో పల్లెటూళ్లన్నీ కళకళలాడుతాయి.  ఈ పవిత్రమైన రోజునే మన దేశంలో మకర సంక్రాంతి, పొంగల్ పేరిట పండుగను జరుపుకుంటారు. ఈ సందర్భంగా ఈ పండుగ జరుపుకునేందుకు గల కారణాలేంటి.. దీని వెనుక ఉన్న రహస్యాలేంటో ఇప్పుడు తెలుసుకుందాం.

how-to-learn-english-through-telugu.title: How To Learn English Through Telugu
how-to-learn-english-through-telugu.description: ఇంగ్లీష్ నేర్చుకోవాలా ? కానీ ఎలా మొదలు పెట్టాలో తెలియట్లేదా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మీరు ఖచ్చితంగా వినాల్సిందే.!

malayali-laingikatha-1.title: Malayali Laingikatha
malayali-laingikatha-1.description: മലയാളികൾക്ക് ലൈംഗികത ഇന്നും ഒരു നിഷിദ്ധ വിഷയം. കപടസദാചാരത്തിന്റെ മറവിൽ തെറ്റായ ധാരണകളിൽ കുടുങ്ങി കഴിയുന്ന സമൂഹത്തിന് നഗ്നസത്യങ്ങൾ വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുകയാണ് കെ.ആർ. ഇന്ദിര. സ്ത്രൈണകാമസൂത്രത്തിന്റെ രചയിതാവ് ഈ പഠനത്തിലൂടെ ലൈംഗികതയെ തുറന്നുംധൈര്യത്തോടെയും അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു!

kuyili.description: Indha ulagathoda mudhal tharkolai padai thaakudhal epo nadanduchu nu ketta ellarume Mudhal ulaga por nu solluvanga. baby-5.title: Baby
baby-5.description: "బేబీ" సంతోష్ తో వివాహం అయ్యి చాలా ఆనందంగా కొన్ని సంవత్సరాలు ఉండగా, ఒక రాత్రి తన పాత ప్రియుడు "అభిరామ్" నుంచి ఆమెకు మళ్ళీ కాల్ వస్తుంది! అసలు అన్ని సంవత్సరాలు ఎక్కడ ఉన్నాడో తెలియని వ్యక్తి నుంచి ఎందుకు కాల్ వచ్చింది? ఆ ఒక్క ఫోన్ కాల్ ఆమె ఆలోచనలను ఎక్కడికి తీసుకుని వెళ్ళాయి?   "బేబీ" - ఓ అమ్మాయి లోతైన హృదయాన్ని చెప్పే కథ!

gay-lesbian-pranayam-enthanu-thettu.title: Gay- Lesbian Pranayam: Enthanu Thettu?
gay-lesbian-pranayam-enthanu-thettu.description: Gay- Lesbian pranayathil enthanu thettennu valare shakthamayi palarum chothichu thudangiyrikkunnu. Maarunna kaalaghattathinte pratheeksha nalkunna mattangal. Eniyum othungi kudi erikathe than aranennum, thante laigika thalparyangal enthanennum swayam angeekarikkukayum oppam athu chuttumullavarodum, samoohathinodum parayunnathum ottum elupamulla karyamalla. Aa samayangalil avarkku thunayayilenkilum avare namukku akatti nirthathe erikkam. 'Gay- Lesbian Pranayam: Enthanu Thettu' enna audio bookilude LGBTQIA enna community de porattangal aduthariyam.

kuberavana-kaaval.title: Kuberavana Kaaval
kuberavana-kaaval.description: குபேரவனத்தைக் காவல் காக்கும் யட்சிணியை மீறி, அதன் உள்ளே சென்ற கந்தர்வனைக் கொல்ல பல ஜென்மங்கள் எடுத்தும் வெற்றி பெற முடியாமல் போவதால் கடைசி ஜென்மமாக அழகிய பெண்ணுருவம் பெறுகிறாள் யட்சிணி மிருகா என்ற பெயருடன். அவள் காதல் கொண்டு தன் பகையை முடித்தாளா?

kathege-savilla.title: Kathege Savilla
kathege-savilla.description: ಕೆನಡಾದಿಂದ ಶುರುವಾದ ಕಥೆ, ಹೇಗೆ ಹುಟ್ಟೂರಿನ ಅನೇಕ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಚ್ಚಿಡುತ್ತಾ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಲೇಖಕ 'ಗಿರಿರಾಜ ಬಿ. ಎಂ' ಅವರು ಬರೆದಿರುವ 'ಕಥೆಗೆ ಸಾವಿಲ್ಲ' ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯ ಜೀವಾಳ. ಧರ್ಮದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅನೇಕ ವೈಚಾರಿಕ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆದಿಡುವ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

aisi-vani-boliye-unlock-the-power-of-wor.title: Aisi Vani Boliye: Unlock The Power Of Words
aisi-vani-boliye-unlock-the-power-of-wor.description: "Aisi Vaani Boliye..." aapko le chalegi Kavya ki kahani mein, jisne apne kathor shabdon ko meethe shabdon mein badalkar office ki best employee banne tak ka safar tay kiya. birala-bijaya.title: Birala Bijaya
birala-bijaya.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

history-of-indian-railway.title: History of Indian Railway
history-of-indian-railway.description: Bhartala North te South ani East te West jodnari, Aam aadmi cha budget travel pasun te Luxusy pravasacha anubhav denari apli Indian Railway aaj dimakhane dhavte ahe. Indian railway cha Itihaas hi itkach motha ani interesting ahe. Ya khas show dware apan, Bhartatil pahili Railway kashi suru zali te aaj parynt ti kashi develop hot geli ithparyntcha sampurna prawas aiknar ahot.

vanathil-orunaal.title: வனத்தில் ஒரு நாள்
vanathil-orunaal.description: பிக்னிக் செல்லும் நம் உறவுகளின் கையில் ஒரு பை கிடைக்கிறது. அதில் பலவகை பொம்மைகள் இருக்கின்றன. ஒவ்வொருவரும் ஒவ்வொரு பொம்மையை எடுக்க அவர்களுக்கு ஒரு சக்தி கிடைக்கிறது. அதாவது அவர்கள் எந்த விலங்கு பொம்மையை எடுத்தார்களோ அந்த விலங்கைப் பார்க்கும்போது அது நினைப்பது கேட்கும். அப்படி நம்மவர்கள் விலங்குகளுடன் பேச்சுவார்த்தை நடத்தும் சுவாரசியமான கதை...

oridathoru-lineman-1.title: ഒരിടത്തൊരു ലൈന്‍മാന്‍
oridathoru-lineman-1.description: ജീവിതത്തിന്റെയും മനുഷ്യരെയും നേരും വേരുമറിഞ്ഞ കഥകളാണ് എസ് ജയേഷിന്റേത്. ഒരിടത്തൊരു ലൈന്‍മാന്‍ എന്ന കഥാസമാഹാരവും വ്യത്യസ്തമല്ല. അതില്‍ ഒറ്റപ്പെട്ടവന്റെ പരക്കം പാച്ചിലുകളുണ്ട്, താളം തെറ്റിയ മനസിന്റെ ചാഞ്ചാട്ടങ്ങളുണ്ട്.. നാഗരികതയിലേക്ക് നിര്‍ബന്ധപൂര്‍വം കയറ്റിവിട്ട ഒരു മനസിന്റെ കഥകളാണ് എസ് ജയേഷിന്റേതെന്ന് പറയാം. തന്റേതല്ലാത്ത ഇടത്തില്‍് ജീവിക്കേണ്ടി വരുന്ന എല്ലാ അസ്വസ്ഥകളുടെയും ഭാരം ഈ കഥകള്‍ക്ക് സ്വന്തമാണെന്ന് പ്രശസ്ത എഴുത്തുകാരന്‍ ഷിഹാബുദ്ദീന്‍ പൊയ്ത്തുംകടവ് സാക്ഷ്യപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു.

oil-power-and-war-1.title: Oil, Power and War
oil-power-and-war-1.description: Crude Oil Barrel Vilai evlo kammi aanalum naama yen petrol ah ₹102 kuduthe vaangurom? Petrol vilai yerunaa yen Gold vilaiyum koodave mela pogudhu? Dollar rate kum petrol price kum enna sambandham? Ulagame sandai podra alavukku indha Oil ku apdi enna sakthi iruku?  Idhuku pinnala iruka international politics pathi melum therinjuka kelunga “Oil,Power and War” on Kuku FM

the-blood-countess-elizabeth-bathory.title: The Blood Countess:  Elizabeth Bathory
the-blood-countess-elizabeth-bathory.description: Elizabeth Bathory, ek Hungarian noblewoman aur bathory family ki kathit serial killer, jiske aatank ne har kisi ko chaunka diya tha. Bathory aur uske chaar naukro'n par saikdo'n ladkiyo'n aur mahilao'n ko pratarit karne aur unki hatya karne ka aarop laga, magar anjaam kya hua? Kaise ek countess ban gyi hatyaaran? Sunein ye poori true crime story sirf Kuku Fm par.

As secrets unravel and hidden motives emerge, the characters find themselves trapped in a dangerous web of deception, manipulation, and emotional conflict. Packed with suspense, unexpected twists, and intense mind battles, this compelling story keeps listeners guessing until the very end.

-ఊరికి-ఉప్పులం.description: పల్లెటూరి వాతావరణాన్ని గుర్తుచేస్తూ, పల్లె జీవనాన్ని కళ్ళకు కట్టినట్లు వివరించే అద్భుతమైన కథ. మీరు కూడా విని వాళ్ళ జీవితాలు ఎలా ఉంటాయో తెలుసుకోండి.

history-of-amazon-forest.description: Intha ulagathoda lungs nu solla pada koodiya Amazon kaadugaloda varalaara thaan intha pathivu la namma kekka porom. Ithai kettu mudikurapo Iyarkkai senja athisayam thaan Amazon nu namakku puriya varum.

noor-queen-of-catistan.title: Noor: Queen of Catistan
noor-queen-of-catistan.description: When a deadly army of robotic rats destroys an Indian border post within minutes, the nation is forced to seek help from a dangerous psychopath — Aryan, a man who understands animal minds like no one else. But Aryan doesn’t come alone. He unleashes Noor, a gigantic and terrifying Cat Queen. As war erupts on the India-China border, humans, robotic monsters, and savage felines collide in a brutal battle for survival.

things-we-should-learn-from-mahabharatam.title: Things We Should Learn From Mahabharatam
things-we-should-learn-from-mahabharatam.description: కర్ణుడి నుండి మనం ఏమి నేర్చుకోవాలి? అర్జుని నుండి మనం నేర్చుకోవాల్సిన లక్షణాలేంటి? మహాభారతాన్ని మన జీవితాల్లో ఏ విధంగా అన్వయించుకోవాలో, అందులోని పాత్రల ద్వారా ఏమి నేర్చుకోవాలో ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో వినండి.

dharam-ki-hisaab.title: Dharam ka Hisaab
dharam-ki-hisaab.description:
His love is fighting for her life, but the money needed for her oxygen is locked inside a corrupt bank. When everyone calls him a fraud, NRI Dharam has just six hours to reclaim what belongs to him.

From polished NRI to raw Gorakhpur street fighter, Dharam will break every rule—and the bank itself—to save the woman he came home to marry.

marana-mrudangam.title: మరణ మృదంగం
marana-mrudangam.description: రేప్ చేయటానికి ఉవ్విళ్ళూరే నరరూప రాక్షసుడు సలీంశంకర్, చీకటి ప్రపంచాన్ని తన చేతి వేళ్ళతో శాసించ గల మాఫియా లీడర్ వసంత్ దాదా. రక్తాన్ని చూస్తేనే మూర్ఛపోయే అమాయకపు అమ్మాయికి అనుకోకుండా భయంకరమైన ఒక రహస్యం తెలిసింది.ఆ రహస్యం బయటకొస్తే వసంత్ దాదా సామ్రాజ్యం కుప్పకూలి పోతుంది. నేర ప్రపంచం నాశనమైపోతుంది. ఆ రహస్యం ఏమిటో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? మొదటి నుంచి చివరి వరకు  సస్పెన్స్‌తో, “నిజమే కదా” అనిపించే వాస్తవాలతో – పాఠకుల్ని మెస్మరైజ్ చేసే "మరణ మృదంగం"అనే ఆడియో వినండి.

விடாது-பெய்யும்-மழை-.description: வேடுவர் குலத்தை சேர்ந்த ஏகலைவன், தன் மானசீக குருவிற்கு, குரு தட்சணையாக தன் கட்டை விரலைக் கொடுக்கிறான். அவனால் வில் - அம்பு எய்த முடியாமல் போகிறது. அதை நினைத்து வருந்தும் போது, அரசர்களுக்குள் நடக்கும் போரை நினைத்து, தன் குரு தனக்கு நல்ல காரியம் செய்தார் என்று, மானசீகமாக வணங்கி வழிபடுகிறான். ஏன்? எதற்காக தன் கட்டை விரலை தட்சணையாக கொடுத்தான்? போர் சமயத்தில் ஏன், குருவை நல்லது செய்தார் என்று வணங்கி வழிபட்டான்?  கேளுங்கள்...

the-telgi-files.title: The Telgi Files
the-telgi-files.description: A man who once sold fruits on trains went on to build one of India's most notorious counterfeit empires. Abdul Karim Telgi exploited the stamp-paper system to create fake documents that allegedly reached banks, insurers, courts and government offices across the country. But when investigators finally caught him, Telgi made a chilling claim: “I am only a small fish.” Was he really the mastermind—or just one part of a much bigger network?

the-secret-rulers-of-the-world.description:
The Secret Rulers of the worldఈ విశ్వంలో చాలా చిన్నగమనించిన నాయకులు, పాలకులు, మరియు వారి సంక్లిష్టమైన గూఢరాజ్యాలు మనల్ని ఏ మాత్రం గుర్తించలేకపోయినట్లుగా ఉన్నారు. ఈ సిరీస్‌లో, మీరు ఎప్పటికీ చూడలేని వారిని, వారి అనేక రహస్యాలను, మరియు వారి అధికారం సాగించే మార్గాలను తెలుసుకోగలుగుతారు. ఆ వెనక ఉన్న సీక్రెట్ పవర్‌ ప్లేయర్స్‌ను ఆవిష్కరించటం, వారి కథలు, గూఢచర్యాలు, మరియు వారి ప్రభావం గురించి ఈ సిరీస్‌లో మీరు తెలుసుకుంటారు.

ప్రతీ ఎపిసోడ్‌లో, మన ప్రపంచం పై ఎన్నో రహస్యాలు, గూఢప్రభావాలు మరియు అజ్ఞాత నాయకుల కథలను తెలుసుకునే అవకాశం మీకున్నది.

సీక్రెట్ రూలర్స్ ఆఫ్ ది వరల్డ్ - ఒక రహస్య ప్రపంచం ఆవిష్కరణ!

Aur aapko bhe janna hai ki insab ko kaise control karna hai to ye Audio Book bilkul aapke liye hai.

the-ipl-story.title: The IPL Story
the-ipl-story.description: "ఐపీఎల్ - క్రీడలలో కేవలం ఒక లీగ్ మాత్రమే కాదు, అది భారతీయుల హృదయాలలో పండుగగా నిలిచింది. 2008 లో ప్రారంభమైన ఈ విశిష్ట ప్రాజెక్ట్, కేవలం క్రికెట్ గేమ్‌లను మాత్రమే కాదు, అభిమానుల కల్చర్‌ను, ఆర్థిక శక్తిని, గ్లోబల్ ఆకర్షణను కూడా మార్గదర్శనం చేసింది. సినిమా ప్రపంచపు గ్లామర్, వ్యాపార ప్రపంచపు వ్యూహాలు, క్రికెట్ ప్రపంచపు ప్రతిభను ఒకే వేదికపైకి తీసుకువచ్చిన ఐపీఎల్, ప్రతి సీజన్‌తో కొత్త రికార్డులను సృష్టిస్తోంది. ఇప్పుడు, ఇది కేవలం క్రికెట్ అభిమానులకు మాత్రమే కాదు, ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా ఉన్న మిలియన్ల మంది ప్రేక్షకులకు ఆనందాన్ని, ఉత్కంఠను, వినోదాన్ని అందిస్తోంది. కానీ ఈ league ఎలా మొదలైంది? దీని వెనక ఉన్నది ఎవరు?

arambha-the-birth-of-vijayanagara.title: Arambha: The Birth of Vijayanagara
arambha-the-birth-of-vijayanagara.description: இங்க ஜெயிச்சவங்களோட சரித்திரம் மட்டும் தான் எழுதப்படுது, தோத்தவங்களோட கதை எல்லாம் காணம‌போயிடுது.‌ இதுவும் அப்படியான ஒரு கதைதான். இரண்டு சகோதரர்களோட கதை. ஒரு கனவோட கதை. ஆக்கிரமிப்பிகளின் சாம்பல்ல இருந்து பீனிக்ஸ் பறவ மாதிரி எழுந்து, தங்களோட கௌரவத்தையும், பலத்தையும் மீட்டெடுத்த ஒரு நாகரிகத்தோட கதை. எப்படி நிமிர்ந்து நிற்கிறதுனே  கிட்டத்தட்ட மறந்துபோன ஒரு இனத்தோட கதை.

how-to-crack-an-interview-easily.title: How to crack an Interview easily?
how-to-crack-an-interview-easily.description: ಕಾಲೇಜಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಓದುವ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗುರಿಯೂ ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಪಡೆಯುವುದೇ. ಅದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪರಿಶ್ರಮ ಪಟ್ಟು ಓದಿ, ಉತ್ತಮ ಅಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಅನೇಕರ ಉದ್ದೇಶವಾಗಿದೆ. ಆದರೆ, ಹೀಗೆ ರ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ತಗೊಂಡವರೇ ಇಂಟರ್ವ್ಯೂನಲ್ಲಿ ಫೇಲ್ಹಾಗುವದು ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ.ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಇಂಟರ್ವ್ಯೂಗೆ ತಯಾರಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು? ಯಾವೆಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಚಾರಗಳು ತುಂಬಾ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ? 'ಫೇಕ್ ಜಾಬ್ ಕಾಲ್' ಯಾವುದು ಎಂದು ಹೇಗೆ ಗುರುತಿಸಬೇಕು?ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡುವ 'How to crack an Interview easily?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಕೇಳಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೂಕುFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲೇ!

బాబా-సాహెబ్-అంబేడ్కర్.title: బాబా సాహెబ్ అంబేడ్కర్
బాబా-సాహెబ్-అంబేడ్కర్.description: డా. బాబాసాహెబ్ అంబేడ్కర్ తెలియని భారతీయులు ఉండరు. ఒక న్యాయవాదిగా, ఒక ఆర్థిక శాస్త్రవేత్త గా, ఒక రాజకీయ నేత గా, ఒక సంఘ సంస్కర్త గా నే కాకుండా మన భారతదేశ రాజ్యాంగ రూపకర్త గా అంబేడ్కర్ ఈ దేశానికి చేసిన సేవలు అమోఘం. దళితుల పై అంటరానితనాన్ని ప్రశ్నించి కుల నిర్మూలన కోసం ఎంతో కృషి చేసారు బాబాసాహెబ్ అంబేడ్కర్. ఇంకా పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

gaining-visibility.title: Gaining Visibility
gaining-visibility.description: Julia Berkwith is ready to reclaim her life after breast cancer, setting out to hike Italy’s Cinque Terre—even if she has to do it alone. But when a fall interrupts her plans, Julia finds herself in the care of charming stone mason Vitale DeLuca, whose talent she’s determined to help reveal to the world.

prayaschita.title: Prayaschita
prayaschita.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

how-to-stop-worrying-and-start-living-3.title: How to stop Worrying and Start Living
how-to-stop-worrying-and-start-living-3.description: Reasearch kehta hai ki physical illness ka sabse bada cause hai 'Worry'. Iss kitaab ke zariye kuch simple actionable technique ke saath aap iss Worry ko apni life se kam kar sakte hai. Suniye Dale Carnegie dwara likhit How to stop worrying and start living yeh audiobook

goyanather-haathi.title: Goyanather Haathi
goyanather-haathi.description: Join the adventure with Kuku FM's Teens & Young Adult shows. Tailored for the young and the young at heart our content ranges from coming-of-age stories to fantastical adventures. Engage with characters facing challenges discoveries and the thrill of growing up. Inspiring entertaining and relatable these shows are perfect for teen listeners and those seeking youthful spirit.

ലൈംഗികതയില്‍-നിന്ന്-അതിബോധത്തിലേക്ക്.title: ലൈംഗികതയില്‍ നിന്ന് അതിബോധത്തിലേക്ക്
ലൈംഗികതയില്‍-നിന്ന്-അതിബോധത്തിലേക്ക്.description: ലൈംഗികതയെക്കുറിച്ച് തെറ്റായ ധാരണകളുണ്ടായിരിക്കുന്നിടത്തോളം കാലം പ്രേമത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് എന്തെങ്കിലും മനസിലാക്കുക അസാധ്യമായിരിക്കും. പ്രേമത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ചര്‍ച്ചകളും അപൂര്‍ണമായിരിക്കും. കേള്‍ക്കാം പ്രേമമെന്ന പ്രവാഹത്തെക്കുറിച്ച്.

how-and-why-you-should-quit-drinking-and.title: How and Why you should quit Drinking and Smoking ?
how-and-why-you-should-quit-drinking-and.description: Mathuvum pugai palakkamum naatukkum veetukkum kedu nu therinjum athai neraya per consume pannnite thaan irukkanga. Intha pathivu drinking and smoking oda vilaivugalai eduthu solli atha quit panrathuku useful aah irukkum. Enna makkale keka aaramikalaama !

maharashtrachi-khadyasanskruti.title: Maharashtrachi Khadya-Sanskruti
maharashtrachi-khadyasanskruti.description: Aplya Maharashtat jashi kahi kosanvar Bhasha badlte, tashich tya tya Prantanusar tithli Khadya Sanskruti hi badlte. Vidarbha, Kokan, Marathwada, Pashchim Maharashtra asah vegveglya prantatil Khadya sanskruti vishayi, Tithlya special recipies vishayi ani Loap pavat chalalelya kashi Paramparik padarthanvishayi chi intresting mahiti aikya ya khas show madhun.

ফুলশয্যা--লেখক--রাজকুমার-মাহাতো.title: ফুলশয্যা | লেখক - রাজকুমার মাহাতো
ফুলশয্যা--লেখক--রাজকুমার-মাহাতো.description: পুরুষ হতে না পারার হতাশায় আর্য ক্রমশ নিজের মধ্যে একটু একটু করে শেষ হতে থাকে, এমনকি বিয়েতেও তার অমত এই একই কারনে। কিন্তু বিয়ের পর তার জীবনে আসে মায়া, যার সংস্পর্শে এসে আর্য ধীরে ধীরে নিজেকে জানতে ও বুঝতে শুরু করে।

sivappu-nool.title: Sivappu Nool
sivappu-nool.description:
ஒரு தலைமுறை மரபாக வந்த சிவப்பு நூலை கழற்றும் மருத்துவ மாணவி அனன்யாவின் வாழ்க்கை, விளக்கமளிக்க முடியாத மர்ம சம்பவங்களால் தலைகீழாக மாறுகிறது.
அறிவியலுக்கும் அமானுஷ்யத்திற்கும் நடுவே சிக்கிய அவள், தன் குடும்பம் பல ஆண்டுகளாக மறைத்து வைத்திருக்கும் கொடூரமான ரகசியத்தைத் தேடத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.
அந்த சிவப்பு நூல் வெறும் நம்பிக்கையா... இல்லை ஒரு தலைமுறையின் உயிரைக் காக்கும் சாபமா?

vruddhasadanam.title: വൃദ്ധസദനം
vruddhasadanam.description: ജീവിതത്തിന്റെ വാര്‍ദ്ധക്യകാലത്ത് ഏകാന്തതയിലായ ഒരു മനുഷ്യന്റെ കഥ പറയുകയാണ് ടി. വി കൊച്ചുബാവയുടെ ഈ നോവല്‍. വാര്‍ദ്ധക്യത്തിലെ ഒറ്റപ്പെടലും നോവും അനുഭവിപ്പിക്കുന്നു കേരള സാഹിത്യ പുരസ്‌കാരം നേടിയ ഈ നോവല്‍.

yuktahaar.title: Yuktahaar
yuktahaar.description: Kya aap is baat se pareshaan hain ke kisi bhi tarah ki diet ya exercise follow karne ke bawajood apka weight kam nahi ho raha? Ya fir aap bhi Tapsee Pannu jaisi actresses ki body ko dekh kar sochte hain unhone yeh kaise maintain ki hogi? Agar haan to yeh kitaab aap ke liye hai. Tapsee Pannu ki dietician Munmun Ganeriwal ki likhi is kitaab mein aapko har wo raaz ki baat pata chalegi jo aaj tak kisi bhi diet mein nahi batayi gayi. Suniye "Yuktahaar" Ki Audiobook exclusively KukuFM par.

delhi-2.title: ദല്‍ഹി
delhi-2.description: എം മുകുന്ദന്റെ ഏറ്റവും വിഖ്യാതമായ കൃതികളില്‍ ഒന്നാണ് ദല്‍ഹി. അരവിന്ദന്‍ എന്ന കഥാപാത്രത്തിലൂടെ ദല്‍ഹി എന്ന നഗരത്തെയും അതിന്റെ ആത്മാവിനെയും തൊട്ടറിഞ്ഞുള്ള കൃതി കേള്‍ക്കാം.

nammamma-andhre-nangishta.title: Nammamma Andhre Nangishta
nammamma-andhre-nangishta.description: ತಾಯಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಗನ ನಡುವಿನ ಹೃದಯಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ವಸುಧೇಂದ್ರ ಅವರ ‘ನಮ್ಮಮ್ಮ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನಂಗಿಷ್ಟ’ ಕೃತಿಯು ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿದೆ. ಇದ್ರಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಯಿಯ ಪೋಷಣೆ, ಮಮತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅವಳ ಚಿಂತನಾಶೀಲತೆಯನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡ ಕಥೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ. ಕೇಳಿ ಆನಂದಿಸಿ!

sabse-bade-rupaiya.title: Khoon aur Paisa
sabse-bade-rupaiya.description: Hindustan ke do aise gharon ki kahaani jo America se shuru ho kar, Mumbai ke Raheja Mansion mei khatam hoti hai. Jo humei seekhati hai ki 'Baap bada na bhaiya, Sabse Bada Rupaiya.' Properties aur Companies ki îs jhadap mei do purane dost, Shiv aur Gautam jaani dushman ban jaate hain. Aur dusri taraf, Reyansh ki Aashiqui aur Garv ke Startup ka sapna, is dushmani ki wajah se khatam hone wala hota hai ki tabhi ek Happy Ending ki shuruaat hoti hai. Toh is paheli ko suljhaane ke liye, aap tap kariye Episode 1 ko aur chaliye hamare saath America ki galiyon mei.

how-to-get-success-in-network-marketing.title: How To Get Success In Network Marketing
how-to-get-success-in-network-marketing.description: Network marketing idi present rojulu aithe okka upu upesthundi, evaru chusina network marketing chesthunam baga dabbu sampadisthunam ane chepthunaru. ee network marketing chesthu kuda chaala mandhe success ayaru anukondi. aithe ee network marketing meeda chaala mandhiki ekkuva avaghana ledhu, ee network marketing ante enti? asalu indulo success ela avutharu? ila aneka vishayalu meeru ee audio book lo viini telusukovachu.

radio-waali-ladki.title: Radio Waali Ladki
radio-waali-ladki.description: Ajay Jaipur ka ek struggling ladka tha jo ek purane, band radio station mein bina kisi ijazat ke raaton ko broadcast karna shuru kar chuka tha. Ek raat uske show ke beech ek ladki ki awaaz on-air aayi, RJ Aadya Mehra ki, jo teen saal pehle issi studio mein laapata ho gayi thi. Aadya ki aatma ab har raat Ajay ki frequency ka hissa ban chuki hai, aur har transmission ke saath kisi na kisi maut ka raaz khulta hai. Ajay apna sapna jeena chahta hai lekin ab uski awaaz kisi aur ke badle ka haqdaar ban gayi hai. Kya Ajay samajh paayega ki wo sirf ek RJ nahi, kisi shrapit kahani ka zinda kirdaar ban chuka hai? Aur agar Aadya ka badla poora ho gaya, to kya Ajay zinda bachega?

pazhivaangum-ratham.title: Pazhivaangum ratham
pazhivaangum-ratham.description: 25 ஆண்டுகளாக தன் தந்தை ராஜசேகர் ஒரு கொலைகாரன் என்ற நம்பிக்கையுடன் வாழ்கிறான் கார்த்திக். சிறையில் தந்தை இறந்தபின், மர்மமான கடிதமும் 25 ஆண்டுகளாக செயல்படாத வங்கி கணக்கும் அவன் கையில் கிடைக்கின்றன. உண்மையைத் தேடி மதுரை திரும்பும் கார்த்திக், தன் தந்தையின் தண்டனைக்குப் பின்னால் மறைந்திருக்கும் அதிர்ச்சிகரமான சதியை கண்டுபிடிக்கிறான்.

ghutan-2.title: Ji Hukum
ghutan-2.description: Kaam dene ke bahane mill ke maalik Hukum Singh ne barbad ki kai masoom bacchiyo ki zindagi aur kiye kai ghinaune kaam. Lekin koi hai jo aaya hai wapas Hukum se badla lene. Ab kya hoga Hukum ka anjaam?

हिडन-वॉरियर्स--लेखक--संवर्त-हर्षित.title: हिडन वॉरियर्स
हिडन-वॉरियर्स--लेखक--संवर्त-हर्षित.description: Manali Mein Achanak Dheere- Dheere Dharmik guru, Sant aur gaon ke log gayab hone laagete hei. Yaha kam ek khoonkhar praniyo ka hei, lekin kon hei yeh prani? Kaha se aaya hei? Yeh ko sajish hei ya hadsaa koi nahi samaj paa raha hei. Iss rahasya ka paata karne patrakar Pratik aur Kruti manali ke Rakcham Gaon Pohacte hei. Unki mulakat waha ke Inspector Shamsher se hoti hei. Kruti Hidden Warriors Group ki Sadsya rah chuki hei, Iss baat se Pratik anjaan hei, Lekin Shamsher janta hei. Toh kya yeh teeno uss khatarnak prani ko maar payenge? kya rahasya se pradha utega???? Janeke liye Sunne Puri kahani Hidden Warriors.

shershah-1.title: Shershah- Capt. Vikram Batra
shershah-1.description: Captain Vikram Batra hey Bhatriya senadalatil ek adhimari hote. 6 July 1999 roji kargil yudhat dushmandeshashi ladhtana Shahid Jhale. Nuktach Tyancha Jeevanavar adharit Shershaah navacha chitrapat dekhil ala hota yat abhineta Sidharth Malhotra yane Vikram Batra yanchi bhumika Sakarli hoti. Shroteho chala aikuyat Vikram Batra yanchi Katha Fakta Kuku Fm var.

tax-planning.title: Tax Planning Kase karave
tax-planning.description: Dar March Mahinyachya shevati Paise Kase Vachvayche Kar kasa Vachvaycha Ha Prashna Aplyala padto. Mhanunach Kuku Fm App Aplyasathi Gheun Ala Ahe Khas Show Tax Planning Kase Karayche. Ya Madhye Tumhala Tax Planningchya vividha Prakarnabaddal Mahiti Milel. Tasach Yogya Padhatine Invest karun kasa Taxchi bachat karavi.

faithless.title: Faithless
faithless.description: रुद्र की दुनिया तब बिखर जाती है जब वह अपनी पत्नी आयशा को अपने सबसे अच्छे दोस्त कबीर के साथ देख लेता है। लेकिन उसी रात एक जानलेवा हमला, रहस्यमयी संदेश और छिपी हुई रिकॉर्डिंग्स साबित करती हैं कि यह सिर्फ बेवफाई नहीं, बल्कि एक गहरी साजिश है। आयशा का कथित धोखा दरअसल रुद्र की जान बचाने की मजबूरी हो सकता है। अब रुद्र को सच और झूठ के बीच छिपे उस मास्टरमाइंड का पर्दाफाश करना होगा, इससे पहले कि वह अपने सबसे करीबी लोगों और अपनी जिंदगी को हमेशा के लिए खो दे।

the-aspirant-memoirs-of-a-monk-turned-ci.title: THE ASPIRANT : Memoirs of A Monk Turned Civil Servant
the-aspirant-memoirs-of-a-monk-turned-ci.description: Ek sannyasi ke IAS officer officer banne ki sacchi kahani jante hain aap? Mathew Joseph ki ye sacchi kahani aapko batayegi ki bade sapne aur aatm-gyan dono ko ek sath pana mumkin hai. Aap janenge self-reflection career ke junoon se milta hai, to zindagi ki raah kitni saaf ho sakti hai. Ek sadhu ki sadhana se lekar civil servant banne tak ki sacchi kahani aapko jeevan ke bade faisle lene ka hausla degi aur sahi rasta batayegi. Kyonki zindagi ke sabse mushkil raaston par milti hai sabse khaas manzil! Ye Audiobook aapki zindagi badal sakti hai, suniyega zaroor!

silambam.title: Silambam
silambam.description: Silambam patri itharku mun naam kelvi padaatha pala ariya thagavalgal intha audio book la irukku. Silamba kalaiyin varalaru, Silamba Payirchi thodarbaana nutpangal , Pira tharkaappu kalaigaludan silamba kalaiyai oppiduthal ena Silambam patriya virivana audio puthagam ithu. Vaanga.. veera Thamizh kalaiyin arumaiyum, perumaiyum pathi adippadai la irunthu therinjukalam.

vampire-girl.title: Vampire Girl: Based on true events
vampire-girl.description: Ek haseen ladki, jiski bachpan se hi bhoot-pret mein gehri ruchi thi, ne ouija board ke saath khel khel kar khud ko ek vampire maan liya. Isi bhram mein usne insaano'n ka khoon pina bhi shuru kar diya! Aakhir kaise ho rha tha ye sab mumkin aur kaun de raha tha iska saath? Suniye, is sachchi ghatna par aadharit kahani, jisme vishwas aur vaastavikta ka hairaan kar dene wala mel hai.

kalakalappu-kalyaanam.title: Kalakalappu Kalyaanam
kalakalappu-kalyaanam.description:
புகழ்பெற்ற சர்ஜன் அர்ஜுன், மருத்துவமனை கிளீனரான ஜோதிகாவை காதலித்து குடும்ப எதிர்ப்பையும் மீறி திருமணம் செய்கிறார். திருமணத்திற்குப் பிறகு கிடைத்த வசதியும் அந்தஸ்தும் ஜோதிகாவின் ஆசைகளையும் மனதையும் மெல்ல மாற்றுகின்றன.
புதிய டாக்டர் ராஜின் வருகை, அவர்களது காதல் வாழ்க்கையில் பொறாமை, சந்தேகம் மற்றும் துரோகத்தை உருவாக்குகிறது. இறுதியில், இருபது வருடங்களுக்கு முன்பே அவர்களது திருமணம் திட்டமிடப்பட்டிருந்த அதிர்ச்சியூட்டும் குடும்ப ரகசியம் வெளிப்படுகிறது.

dastan.title: Dastan
dastan.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

the-amazing-secrets-of-the-yogi-3.title: The Amazing Secrets of the Yogi
the-amazing-secrets-of-the-yogi-3.description: Yogigaloda ragasiyangala payanpaduthi naamalum avanga adanja maaya sakthigala adaiya mudiyum nu nambikkai tharuthu intha audiobook.Yogigal eppadi Maaya sakthigala adaiyuraanga?, Avanga seiyura maaya manthirangalukku pinnaadi ulla unmaigal enna? Antha maaya sakthigala naamalum adaiyurathu eppadi? Vaanga therinjukalaam.

826dbee0-1e62-4853-8f98-de8ab7662c4b.title: Dark Web
826dbee0-1e62-4853-8f98-de8ab7662c4b.description: డార్క్ వెబ్. ఇది ఒక అంతులేని అగాధం. దీనిలో జరిగే క్రైమ్స్ మన ఊహకు అందనివి. అసలు డార్క్ వెబ్ అంటే ఏమిటి? దాని లోపల ఏం జరుగుతోంది? డార్క్ వెబ్ ని ఇల్లీగల్గా ఎలా యూజ్ చేశారు? అలా యూజ్ చేసినవారి పరిస్థితి ఏమయ్యింది? ఈ ప్రశ్నలు అన్నింటికీ సమాధానమే "THE DARK WEB

axiom-of-the-ancients.title: Axiom Of The Ancients
axiom-of-the-ancients.description: A young physics student discovers an ancient artifact that seems to defy the laws of physics. As she investigates its origins, she becomes entangled in a centuries-old secret society dedicated to protecting powerful relics. The protagonist must navigate dangerous rivals, decipher cryptic clues, and confront her own beliefs about science and the supernatural as she races to uncover the truth behind the artifact before it falls into the wrong hands.

story-of-jamtara.title: Jamtara : Phishing Capital Of India
story-of-jamtara.description: Ye kahani hai Un Phishing Scammers ki jinhone bollywood superstars , government servants , political leaders aur lakhon aam logon ke bank accounts ko sirf apne ek phone call se khali kar diya. Aur ye call hindustan ke sabse pichde ilake se aata hai, jaha smartphones aur computers ki jankari sirf gine - chune logon ko hi hai aur vo bhi poori tarike se nahi. Lekin Jamtara ke naam se jana jane wala Jharkhand ka ye ilaka  ab india mein 80% se jyada phishing attacks  Karne ke liye apni pehchan bana chuka hai. Toh aakhir kaise hui Jamtara mein is cyber crime ki shuruaat , India ke kaun kaun se VIP's bane is attack ka shikar aur kyu in attacks par ab tak nahi lag paya hai full stop. In sabhi Questions ke answers aapko milenge is audiobook mein.

why-we-worship-heroes.title: Why We Worship Heroes
why-we-worship-heroes.description: మన దేశంలో – ప్రత్యేకంగా తెలుగు రాష్ట్రాల్లో, సినిమా హీరోలు సాధారణ నటులు కాదని, వారు దేవుళ్లవలె భావించబడుతుంటారు. ఇది ఓ సామాన్య భావోద్వేగం కాదు – ఇది ఓ సాంస్కృతిక, సామాజిక, భావనాత్మక అనుబంధం. సాధారణ మనుషుల జీవితాల్లో నడిచే ఆశలు, వేదనలు, విజయాల కోరికలు అన్నీ హీరో రూపంలో తెరపై ప్రతిఫలిస్తాయి. ఒక రైతు, కార్మికుడు, ఉద్యోగి, పేదవాడైనా – అతని మనసులో ఊహాజనిత విరాట రూపం ఆ హీరో. హీరోలు ఏదైనా సాధించగలరనే ఆశ, మనల్ని కూడా సాధించగలమనే నమ్మకాన్ని కలిగిస్తుంది.

హద్దులున్నాయి-జాగ్రత్త.title: హద్దులున్నాయి జాగ్రత్త
హద్దులున్నాయి-జాగ్రత్త.description: వైవాహిక జీవితం లో తమ తమ మొగుళ్ళ వలన ఎంతో బాధ ను అనుభవించడమే కాకుండా చాలా కోల్పోయిన అబలల కథ ఇది. సుమతి, అనసూయ మరియు అహల్య ఈ ముగ్గురి మీదే ఈ కథ మొత్తం ఉంటుంది ఒక్కసారి మీరు కూడా వినండి.

Changhis-Khan--చెంఘీజ్-ఖాన్.title: ఛంఘిజ్ ఖాన్
Changhis-Khan--చెంఘీజ్-ఖాన్.description: ఛంగీజ్ ఖాన్ అంటే ఎవరు?123 గుడిసెలు గల ఒక బంజారీ తండా నాయకుడు ప్రపంచంలో ముప్పాతిక వంతు వరకు ఎలా జయించాడు? మూడు శతాబ్దుల పర్యంతం సువర్ణయుగాన్ని అనుభవించిన ఒక సామ్రాజ్యాని ఎలా స్థాపించగలిగాడు? ఇలాంటి ప్రశ్నలకు రచయిత తెన్నేటి సూరి ఇచ్చిన నవలా రూపం ఈ ఆడియో బుక్.

the-night-india-almost-went-to-nuclear-w.title: The Night India Almost Went To Nuclear War
the-night-india-almost-went-to-nuclear-w.description: India aur Pakistan ke beech nuclear tension ka woh moment jab ek chhoti si miscalculation bhi poore region ko tabah kar sakti thi. Military pressure, political decisions, intelligence warnings aur international intervention ne kaise South Asia ko nuclear brink ke kareeb pahunchaya? Janiye India ke nuclear history ke ek dangerous chapter ki untold story, jahan ek galat decision ka matlab ho sakta tha nuclear war.

the-complete-guide-to-christianity.title: The Complete Guide to Christianity
the-complete-guide-to-christianity.description: This series explores the birth and growth of Christianity, starting from the time of Jesus Christ's life and highlighting important events such as the last supper, crucifixion and resurrection up to the present day. The life and teachings of Jesus Christ are among the most formative and crucial factors in the development of Western culture. Similarly, the advice he gave is a cornerstone of modern Western culture. Jesus spent most of his childhood in Nazareth, a small village in the Galilee area of what is now Israel, even though he was born in Bethlehem in 4 B.C. He preached love, compassion, and dedication to fellow people. In the Jewish community, he held a position of leadership and was a frequent public speaker. Jesus' life and teachings are documented in the New Testament of the Bible, the primary historical source. The Complete Guide to Christianity traces the evolution of the religion, its key players, the major events that have shaped it, and its impact on global history. Listen to this insightful show to delve deep into Christianity's growth.

ramanjaneya-yuddham.title: Sri Ramanjaneya Yuddham
ramanjaneya-yuddham.description: Devuditho yuddham ante chaala mandi nammatam ledu. Ramudu, Hanumanthudu gurinchi mana Hindu matham lo aneka grandhalu, Ithihasalu, Pouranika gadhalu unnayi. Vatilo endulo chusina Sri ramuni gundelo pettukoni pujinche parama pavithra bhakthudu Anjaneyudu. Ayithe yellappudu Ramanama japam chese Hanumanthudu thappanisari paristhithullo Ramunitho yuddham chesthadu. Aa visheshalemito ee Audio book dvaara vindam.

karnan.title: Karnan
karnan.description: Dheerathayum Sahana sakthiyum Dhana dharma sheelavumellam othinangiya Mahabharathathile ettavum karuthutta kadhapathrangalil onnanu Karnan. Kundhikku Sooryadevanil janicha Karnanu jeevithathil udaneelam aneethiyum apamanavum avagananayum anubhavikkendi vannu. Ammayal upekshikkappettu oduvil sahodaranmarkkethire Kauravapaksham chernnu poradendi varunna Karnante Jeevitham kettariyam ee showyilude.

the-aryabhata-clan.title: The Aryabhata Clan
the-aryabhata-clan.description: India par ek khatarnak saazish ka saya mandra raha hai. Shamsur Ali, ek Bangladeshi physicist, desh ko asth-vyast karne ke irade se ek apocalypse paida karna chahta hai, jise 21 saal ki Kubha ko har haal mein rokhna hai. Is ke beech, ek historical structure ki demolition ko legitimize karne ke liye radical Hindu outfit aur Islamic state ka ek bada dhokha samne aata hai. Afsar Fareedi, ek linguistic paleontologist, is fraud ko pakadti hai, jab uske pita samet teen hatyayein hoti hain. Aryabhata ke 1,500 saal purane verse ke raaz ko kholte hue suniye yeh thrilling kahani.

the-bloodborne-warrior.title: The Bloodborne Warrior
the-bloodborne-warrior.description: In an empire where divine powers belong only to royalty, how will Devdan, an orphaned stable boy, avenge his parents’ death? His life takes a terrifying turn when an ancient manuscript awakens the forbidden 'Blood Power' within him, allowing him to steal others’ powers by drinking their blood. But with every new power, the Asur within him grows stronger. Will Devdan become the downfall of the tyrannical royal dynasty, or transform into the most dangerous Asur of all?

fernanda-montenegro.title: Fernanda Montenegro: Um século de encantamento
fernanda-montenegro.description: Quer conhecer um pouquinho mais da vida e carreira de uma das atrizes mais icônicas e premiadas do cinema brasileiro e mundial? Então prepare-se para conhecer os bastidores da trajetória incrível de Fernanda Montenegro, desde seus primeiros passos no teatro até sua consagração nas telas do cinema. Embarque com a gente e descubra curiosidades e segredos que marcaram a vida da estrela!

dinakkondu-kathe-pushya-samputa.title: Dinakkondu Kathe- Pushya Samputa
dinakkondu-kathe-pushya-samputa.description: Join the adventure with Kuku FM's Teens & Young Adult shows. Tailored for the young and the young at heart our content ranges from coming-of-age stories to fantastical adventures. Engage with characters facing challenges discoveries and the thrill of growing up. Inspiring entertaining and relatable these shows are perfect for teen listeners and those seeking youthful spirit.

indistractable-1.title: Indistractable
indistractable-1.description: Practical advice for tackling distractions and enhancing focus in the digital age. ⏳📚💡

vennilave-vennilave.title: வெண்ணிலவே... வெண்ணிலவே
vennilave-vennilave.description: செம்பகசேரி தரவாட்டின் வாரிசாகிய கேசவன் குட்டியை மணக்கிறாள் ரோகிணி என்னும் அதிர்ஷ்ட பெண். அவர்களுக்கு மகளாய் பிறக்கும் தேவி பிறப்பு முதலே விசித்திரங்களையும் மாயாஜாலங்களையும் கொண்டவளாக இருக்கிறாள். அதிர்ஷ்ட தேவதையாக இருக்கும் அவளை அழிக்க நினைக்கும் அந்த ஊரை சேர்ந்த ராகவன் பிள்ளையும், மாதவன் நாயரும், அவர்கள் துணையாய் கொண்ட ஜோசியர்களுக்கும் நம்பூதிரிகளுக்கும் நேரும் கதியை சுவாரஸ்யமாக எடுத்துரைப்பதோடு மாந்திரீகம், ஜோசியம், கந்தர்வர்கள், மோகினிகள் போன்ற அமானுஷ்ய விஷயங்களை விறுவிறுப்புடனும் சொல்லும் கதைதான் வெண்ணிலவே வெண்ணிலவே..!

Mahalo-Kokila-మహాల్లో-కోకిల.title: మహాల్లో కోకిల
Mahalo-Kokila-మహాల్లో-కోకిల.description: కోకిల అనే నర్తకి కథ గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా ? మహల్లో కోకిల చిక్కుకుందా? మహారాణిలా బ్రతుకుతోందా? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

kya-aap-jante-hai.title: Kya Aap Jante Hai?
kya-aap-jante-hai.description: Kya aap bhi science aur general knowledge ke sawalon mein interest rakhte hain? Agar haan to es audiobook ko sun kar aap 500 se adhik aise questions ka Jawab sun sakte hain. Apni knowledge badhane ke liye bacchon ko practice karane ke liye ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

putaputoni.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

marilyn-monroe-2.title: Marilyn Monroe
marilyn-monroe-2.description: Marilyn Monroe, eme gurinchi teliyani varu evaru vundakapovachu. Entho Mandhiki oka fashion icon ga nilichindi, Prapancham lone entho mandhi andhagathelo eme kuda nilichindi, enno goppa goppa awardlu kuda tesukundi, kani chivariki ame jeevitham chikkati mayam ayipoyindi eme maranam entho mandhini kalichivesindi. Thana jeevitham gurinchi enno vishyalu telusukondi mana ee audio book vini.

agent-adithya.title: ఏజెంట్ ఆదిత్య - Season 1&2

Kokhono Kokhono Kauke Dekhe Mone Hoy Jibon Khub Choto, Kintu Jibon Choto Noy, Onekta Lomba Jatra. Jibone Je Poristhiti Aasuk Na Keno Postitive Chinta Rekhe Nijer Lokkhey Sthir Thakhte Hobe. antarani-vasantam.description: దళితుల జీవితం, వారి బాధలు, ఆత్మాభిమానం, మరియు సమాజంలో వారు ఎదుర్కొనే వివక్షను గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? దళిత క్రైస్తవుల జీవన అనుభవాన్ని మరియు పోరాటాన్ని పురాణ పద్ధతిలో విశ్లేషించిన ఒక చారిత్రక నేపథ్యం కలిగిన కథ, జాతి వ్యవస్థ, దళితుల ఆత్మగౌరవం, మరియు వారి స్వాతంత్ర్య పోరాటానికి సంబంధించిన అంశాలను ఈ ఆడియో కథ విని తెలుసుకోండి.
