kamsa-samhara.title: Kamsa Samhara
kamsa-samhara.description: ಕಂಸನು ಯದುವಂಶದ ರಾಜ, ದೇವಕಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಸುದೇವನಿಗೆ ಹುಟ್ಟುವ ಮಗನು ತನ್ನನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುವನೆಂದು ಭಯಪಟ್ಟು, ದೇವಕಿಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನೂ ಕೊಲ್ಲಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಎಂಟನೇ ಮಗುವಾಗಿ ಹುಟ್ಟುವ ಶ್ರೀ ಕೃಷ್ಣನನ್ನು ಗೋಕುಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಚ್ಚಿಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕಂಸನು ಕೃಷ್ಣನನ್ನು ವಧಿಸಲು ಹಲವು ಯತ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದರೂ, ಅವನು ವಿಫಲವಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ . ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಕಂಸನನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಂಹರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ  ಕೇಳಿ "ಕಂಸ ಸಂಹಾರ"  ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

the-mastery-of-destiny-1.title: The Mastery Of Destiny
the-mastery-of-destiny-1.description: Are you tired of feeling like your life is on autopilot? Do you yearn to break free from limitations and forge your own path? Then embark on a life-altering journey with James Allen's "Mastery of Destiny." Allen delves beyond typical self-help notions, focusing on the root of destiny: your thoughts. It's not just a book; it's a call to take charge of your destiny, narrated with passionate wisdom, igniting a fire within to shape the life you deserve.

sleep-midnight-drift.title: Sleep: Midnight Calm
sleep-midnight-drift.description: A deep, calming sleep experience designed to ease anxiety and support better sleep, great for anyone dealing with sleepless nights.

30-dine-ojon-kibhabe-komaben.title: Pujo Barshiki: 30 Dine Ojon Kibhabe Komaben?
30-dine-ojon-kibhabe-komaben.description: Amra sobai nijeder ke sustho ebong sundor rakhte pochondo kori. Kintu shob somoy ar seta hoye othe na. Boyosher songe songe kintu amder cheharao barte thake. Ei barti chehara niye amra sokolei khub chintito thaki. Ar ojon briddhir songe baarte thake anek rog. Amra ki kore kom somoy roga hote parbo ei Durga Pujo e? Byaparta jotota sohoj amra bhabi oto tao kintu noi. Hai roga howa ba roga hoye sustho jibon japon kora tao kintu ekta lifestyle er modhye pore. Ei lifestyle bojaye rakha tai ashol chabi kathi. Erokomi aro anek tips ba podhhoti jante ar roga hote ei Puja Barshiki r audio story ti shune nin.

brothers-against-the-raj.title: Brothers Against The Raj
brothers-against-the-raj.description: Charithra snehikalaya aarum ee amoolyamaya pusthakam kelkkathe pokaruth. Indian swanthanthraya samara porattathile munnani poralikalaya Subhash Chandra Bose, sahodaran Sarad Chandra Bose ennivarekkurich Leonard A Godon ezhuthiya samanathakal illatha charithra grandham.

भक्ति-भारत-की-शान-है-मेरे-भारत-की-पहचान-.title: भक्ति भारत की शान है मेरे भारत की पहचान है
भक्ति-भारत-की-शान-है-मेरे-भारत-की-पहचान-.description:
Bhakti Bharat ki Shaan Hai- Mere Bharat ki Pehchaan Hai Written by Harisha Chandra Narrated by Arjun Dev
Voiceover Artist : Arjun Dev
 If we speak about the religion, then India gives shelter to religions more than any other country, and thus every religion has its own separate history in the world and specifically in India. If you want to know this history then listen to the religious audiobook 'bhakti bharat ki shaan hai mere desh ki pehchan hai' in hindi on our online platform. This story is created by harish chandra sant harish kavita kar. There are numerous mysteries related to religion, man is always eager to know about. There are various poems in bhakti bharat ki shaan podcast. These religion audiobooks make you aware of the exciting things, and also motivate you to follow your own religion and keep you on track. This audiobook consists of 286 episodes but each episode is interesting and unique. You can also download this audio in mp 3 format and share it with you friends and family. यदि हम धर्म के बारे में बात करते हैं, तो भारत किसी अन्य देश की तुलना में अधिक धर्मों को आश्रय देता है, और इस प्रकार हर धर्म का दुनिया में और विशेष रूप से भारत में अपना अलग इतिहास है। अगर आप इस इतिहास को जानना चाहते हैं तो हमारे ऑनलाइन प्लेटफॉर्म पर धार्मिक ऑडियोबुक भक्ति भारत की शान है मेरे भारत की पहचान है (मेरी कहानी मेरी जुबानी) को सुनिए। यह कहानी हरीश चंद्र संत हरीश कविता कर द्वारा बनाई गई है। धर्म से जुड़े कई रहस्य हैं, जिसके बारे में जानने के लिए इंसान हमेशा उत्सुक रहता है। भक्ति भाव की इस पॉडकास्ट में विभिन्न कविताएँ हैं। यह धार्मिक ऑडियोबुक आपको रोमांचक चीजों से अवगत कराते हैं, साथ ही आपको अपने स्वयं के धर्म का पालन करने और आपको ट्रैक पर रखने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं। इस ऑडियोबुक में 286 एपिसोड शामिल हैं, लेकिन प्रत्येक एपिसोड दिलचस्प और अद्वितीय है। आप इस ऑडियो को एमपी 3 प्रारूप में भी डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं और इसे अपने दोस्तों और परिवार के साथ साझा कर सकते हैं।

what-wikipedia-cant-tell-you-about-stock.title: What Wikipedia Can't Tell You About Stock Market
what-wikipedia-cant-tell-you-about-stock.description: The stock market is a volatile market where thousands of traders try their luck and test their skills every day. Some get unbelievable success and become full-time traders while some face immense loss, lose their confidence and quit. No one can deny that all aspiring traders face a rough start when they start trading. Just like a mentor is needed to acquire and polish any skill, the same goes for trading. This book by the prominent stock market trader and author Indrazith Shantharaj will be your mentor on your journey to be a booming stock market trader. It includes valuable lessons and tips which you won't find easily on the usual channel and forums or even online. A must-read if you desire to make a career in the stock market.

welcome-back-to-rambling-texas.title: Welcome Back to Rambling Texas
welcome-back-to-rambling-texas.description: Honey Carmichael has never understood what all the hoopla is about when it comes to men and she’s out to change that with the one man in town known for his ability to get the job done. Blake Dempsey is happy to help Honey with her “problem” as long as she knows he’s only interested in one thing. His heart was broken when his high-school girlfriend was killed in the car he was driving and he has nothing to offer other than fun. That’s just fine with Honey until that fantastic fun isn't enough anymore for either of them. Unexpected feelings result in a messy entanglement—and that most definitely wasn’t in the plans. But you know what they say about plans? This sexy dirty standalone romance is intended for mature audiences.

breathing-zen-oceanic-exhale.title: Breathing Zen: Ocean Wave Breathing
breathing-zen-oceanic-exhale.description: Breathing Zen: Breathe in softly, then exhale long and steady like the ocean, creating a deep sense of relaxation and ease.

Toh suniye is show ko aur jaaniye aisi dil dehla dene wali baate aur un ladaiyon ke baare mein jo hamare bharatvarsh mein ladi gayi, jisne itihaas badal kar rakh diya!

manoj-bajpayee-kuch-pane-ki-zid.description: This audiobook traces the inspiring journey of Manoj Bajpayee, a rare actor whose passion and commitment shaped his rise in Hindi cinema. From his childhood roots and family history to his relentless struggle to become an actor, the story reveals lesser-known moments of his life. Agar aap bhi apni reality ka samna karna chahte hain aur khud ko behtar bana kar succesful hona chahte hain to ye audiobook zaroor suniye.

ಅಜ್ಜಿ-ಕಥೆಗಳು--ಗಿರಿಜಾ-ಲೋಕೇಶ್-ಅವರ-ಜೊತೆ.description: ಹಿರಿಯ ನಟಿ ಗಿರಿಜಾ ಲೋಕೇಶ್ ಅವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಾಲ್ಯದ ಸವಿನೆನಪುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮರಳಿ ಪಯಣಿಸಿ! ಮಕ್ಕಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಅವರು ಹೇಳುವ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಕೇವಲ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ, ದೊಡ್ಡವರಿಗೂ ಜೀವನದ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿಕೊಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಭಾವನೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೀತಿ ತುಂಬಿರುವ ಈ "ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಕಥೆಗಳು" ಸರಣಿಯನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪದೇ ಕುಟುಂಬದೊಂದಿಗೆ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ!

अपने-पराये--लेखक--रा-श्याम-सुंदर-.title: अपने पराये
अपने-पराये--लेखक--रा-श्याम-सुंदर-.description: Ladki ki shaadi hote hi aur uske sasuraal chale jaane par kis tarha apne paraye ho jaate hai, rishte ke is bhanvar ko Beena na samajh saki. Aur uski nasamjhi ne pati panti ke beech darare aa gayi. Unke phulo se sukhad jeevan mein kaaton ki chubhan paida kar di. Yah baat Beena ko bahut der se samajh mein aayi ki uske daampatya jeevan mein katuna laanewaali koyi aur nahi uski apni maa hi hai. Choti choti baato mein gruhasta jeevan mein kis tarah vishwa ghulta hai aur kaise is se bacha ja sakta hai... is upnyaas mein badi rochkata se bataya gaya hai...

beleyuva-pairu.title: Beleyuva Pairu
beleyuva-pairu.description: ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಜೈವಿಕ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳ ಜೊತೆಜೊತೆಗೆ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ಅಂಶಗಳ ಪೂರೈಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪೋಷಕರು ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸಿಬಿಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅಂತಹ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಗಮನಕ್ಕೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕಾದ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಆ ವಿಷಯಗಳು ಯಾವುದೆಂಬುದನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಬೆಳೆದಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಲವು ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಗಮನಕ್ಕೆ ತಂದುಕೊಳ್ಳದಿರುವ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪಶ್ಚಾತ್ತಾಪ ಹೊಂದದಿರುವಂತಹ ಅಂಶಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಬರಹಗಳು ಬೆಳಕು ಚೆಲ್ಲಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಸರ್ವತೋಮುಖ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಹಾಗೂ ನಾಗರಿಕ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಕುರಿತು ಲೇಖಕ ಯೋಗೇಶ್‌ ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್‌ ಬರೆದಿರುವ "ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಪೈರು" ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

odrishya-ostrer-aghaath.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. the-hero-of-tiger-hill-autobiography-of-.title: The Hero Of Tiger Hill-  Autobiography Of Param Vir
the-hero-of-tiger-hill-autobiography-of-.description: Shathruvu pelchina thutalu thana shareeranni chidram chesthunna sare, Sahayam pondadaniki nirakaristhu, Chivari shwasa varaku shathruvutho thalapadaniki siddam ayyaru. Shathruvutho jaripina mukhamukhi poratamlo onti chettho shathruvuni niluvaristhu, matti karipincharu. Tololing parvatha shikharam thirigi chejikkuvadamlo Kalnal Rmakrishnan pathra eppatiki charithralo nilichipothundi.

shoot-for-the-moon-3.title: Apollo 11: The Journey To The Moon
shoot-for-the-moon-3.description: 1969 yeh vo saal tha jab NASA ne chaand par jaane wala apna mission successful banaya aur is mission ka naam tha Apollo 11. Is mission ke under chaand par kadam rakhne wale pehle insaan Neil Armstrong the yeh hum sabhi ko pata hai Lekin, is mission ki neev kaise rakhi gayi? Kya is mission ko successful karna sirf kehne jitna aasaan tha? Neil Armstrong ke liye vo pal kaisa raha jab unhein pata chala ki vo chaand par jaane waale hain? Yeh Sab kuch jaanege Kuku FM par is Original Show mein. Chaliye Shuru Karte hain Apollo 11 ke successful hone ka Safar.

the-mark-killer.title: The Mark Killer
the-mark-killer.description: When a ruthless serial killer begins leaving mysterious marks on his victims, fearless cop Vishal Rathod joins forces with his wife Naina—a former detective haunted by a buried tragedy—to uncover a sinister organization linked to her family’s past.

mulla-nasiruddin-ki-anokhi-duniya.title: Mulla Nasiruddin Ki Anokhi Duniya
mulla-nasiruddin-ki-anokhi-duniya.description: Step into a world of fun and learning with Kuku FM's children's stories. Our audiobooks are full of adventures and lessons about friendship courage and curiosity. They're perfect for young listeners making learning exciting and storytelling a joy. Listen now Kuku FM for stories that spark imagination and teach important values in a simple enjoyable way.

reasons-to-stay-alive-4.title: Reasons to Stay Alive
reasons-to-stay-alive-4.description: Prathi okkari jivithaalu manasika anaarogyaniki guravuthayi. Thana anubhavaala yokka spastatha niraashatho bhayapade vaariki spoorthidayakamgaa untundi mariyu prakashavanthamgaa untundi. Annitikiante minchi, athani haasyam mariyu prothsaham manalni ennatiki aashanu kolponivvadu. Sorangam chivaralo kaanthi undani cheppadu. Jivitham theche chinna santhoshaalu jarupukovalani athanu manaki bhodhisthaadu mariyu sajeevamgaa undataniki ellappudu kaaranaalu unnayani gurtuchesthadu.

yayati-2.title: Yayati
yayati-2.description: ಯಯಾತಿ, ಹಿಂದೂ ಪುರಾಣದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ, ಚಂದ್ರವಂಶದ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ರಾಜ. , ಅವನ ಅಕ್ರಮ ಸಂಬಂಧದಿಂದ ಶುಕ್ರಾಚಾರ್ಯನು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮುದುಕತನ ಶಾಪ ಹಾಕಿದಾಗ  ಅವನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ತಿರುವು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ತನ್ನ ಯೌವನವನ್ನು ಮರಳಿ ಪಡೆಯಲು, ಯಯಾತಿ ತನ್ನ ಮಗ ಪುರುವನ ಬಳಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪುರು ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಮನೋಭಾವದಿಂದ ಶಾಪವನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಲೋಕಸುಖಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು, ಬಾಳಿನ ಆಸೆಗಳ ಅರ್ಥಹೀನತೆಯನ್ನು ಅರಿತುಕೊಂಡ ಯಯಾತಿ, ತನ್ನ ಯೌವನವನ್ನು ಪುನಃ ಪುರುವಿಗೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಕಥೆ ಆಸೆಗಳ ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಮಹತ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠತೆಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

sleeper-cell-ke-yoddha.title: Sleeper Cell Ke Yoddha
sleeper-cell-ke-yoddha.description: Sleeper cell ki ek misfit team, jise sab nakara samajh rahe hain, unke saamne hai ek diplomat ke gayab hone ka case. Lekin investigation ke dauraan kayi raaz benaqab hote hain. Desh par ek bada attack hone wala hai—kya yeh nakare sleeper cell ke yoddha is attack ko rok paayenge?

ratan-tata-the-real-meaning-of-simplicit.description: రతన్ టాటా జీవితం నుండి మనం నేర్చుకోవాల్సిన గొప్ప పాఠాలు ఏమిటి? వ్యాపార నాయకుడిగా ఆయన విజయానికి కారణాలు ఏమిటని మీరు భావిస్తున్నారు? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

astrology-5.title: Basic Indian Astrology
astrology-5.description: Indian Astrology ya Jyotish shastra keval bhavishya batane tak simit nahi hai isme bahut kuchh janne aur sikhne ke layak hai. Ye ek sabse purani scientific padhtti hai jiske madhyam se ham universe ko samajh sakte hai. Tare Sitare, Grah, Nakshatra kaise hamari life me role play karte hai aur ham apni Life ko or behtar tarike se kaise ji sakte hai Astrology hame sikhati hai. Is Series me hamne koshis ki hai ki ham aap tak Astrology ki basic jankari pahunchaye, jisse aap bhi iska labh utha sake.  Indian Astrology kya hai aur ye kaise kaam karti hai?

the-mlm-trap-how-they-fool-us.title: Network Marketing Ka Jhansa
the-mlm-trap-how-they-fool-us.description: Kya sach mein MLM se ameer ban sakte hain? Ya yeh sirf ek bada jhansa hai? Kya hai Multi level Marketing ka Asli Chehra? Janne ke liye suniye yeh Audio show, jo na sirf aapko MLM ke chakravyuh ko samajhne mein madad karega, balki aap yeh bhi jaanege ki kaise in schemes se bach sakte hain aur apni professional growth ko sahi disha mein le ja sakte hain.

kuku-love-cafe.title: Kuku Love Cafe
kuku-love-cafe.description: Kya hoga jab aap sundar aur anjaan logon ke saath ek luxury cafe mein fans jayein toh? Kuku FM le kar aaya hai first Audio OTT reality show, jahaan alag alag jagah se aaye hue khiladi dhoondh rahe hain sacha pyaar. Agar aapko bhi true love hua hai ya dhoondh rahe hain toh suniye abhi aur comments mein bataiye favourite contestant ka naam.

khayidi-billionaire.title: Khayidi Billionaire
khayidi-billionaire.description: తాను ప్రాణంగా ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయిని కాపాడేందుకు మూడేళ్లు జైలుశిక్ష అనుభవించిన కోటీశ్వరుడు అర్జున్, జైలు నుంచి బయటకు వచ్చి ఆమెను పెళ్లి చేసుకోవాలని అనుకుంటాడు. కానీ తన కోసం ఇంత త్యాగం చేసిన అర్జున్‌ను ఆమె ఊహించని విధంగా తిరస్కరిస్తుంది. ఆ తర్వాత సింగిల్ మదర్ కావ్యను అనుకోకుండా పెళ్లి చేసుకుని, ఆమె కూతురికి తండ్రి ప్రేమను అందిస్తాడు. అయితే తన అసలు గుర్తింపును దాచిపెట్టి, అందరి ముందు ఓ అమాయక మాజీ ఖైదీలా నటిస్తూ తన కొత్త జీవితాన్ని కొనసాగిస్తాడు.

yuktahaar-1.title: Yuktahaar
yuktahaar-1.description: Diet - namma ellarum romba curious ah sincere ah follow panra topic. Unmai enna na most of the time idhu oru yetta kani ah ve iruku, and diet ah follow panni oru transformation ah kaatunavanga namma kannu ku super heroes ah dhaan theriyuraanga. Yen adhu nammala la mudiyaadha? Just 10 weeks la mudiyum. Idha pathi idhukaana 'the right expert' aana Munmun Ganeriwal, Fitness and dietetics expert indha audio book la share panni irukaanga. So lets get started with a mental and physical transformation.

dear-lottery-scandal.title: Dear Lottery Scandal
dear-lottery-scandal.description: Lottery Kete Kotipoti Hote Sobai Chay. Kintu Sobai Ki Hote Pare? Sotyi Ki Taka Jeta Jay Naki Eta Faand? Samprotik Somoy Ei Lottery-Ke Kendro Kore Uttal Bangla. criminals-in-uniform.description: 'Criminals In Uniform' ek thrilling kahani hai jo desh ki top investigation agencies ke secrets ko apke samne rakhti hai. Kya aapko pata hai, jo log humein protect karte hain, wahi kabhi kabhi kitna bada khatra ban sakte hain? Power games, corruption aur dhoka, yeh sab kuch hai is kahani mein. Abhi sunna shuru kariye aur dekhiye in agencies ke asli chehre ko!

future-of-indian-agriculture-sector.description: Oru vivasaayi sethula kaal vekkalana naama soru la kai vekka mudiyaathu. Namm naatoda vivasaayathin varalaaru, vivsaayigalin vaazhkai idha pathi vivaramaa solludhu indha audio book.

marketing-management.description: Zamane ka saath saath marketing ke daayre bhi badle hai. Toh sikhe aisi marketing jo aapko 2023 se relevant rakhegi aur aapke brand ko top par layegi!

anjaathey.title: Anjaathey
anjaathey.description: ஒரு கைப்பிடிக்கக் கூடிய தமிழ்த் திரில்லர் கதை, யதார்த்தமும் மாயையும் குழப்பமடையும் கொடிய விளையாட்டில் சிக்கிக் கொண்ட சிலர் குறித்து பேசுகிறது. கதாநாயகன் அர்ஜுன், ஒரு மர்மமான போர்க்களத்தில் விழித்து எழுந்து, யாழினியை சந்திக்கிறார்; அவள் அவர்களது நிலைமை குறித்த அதிர்ச்சிகரமான உண்மைகளை வெளியிடுகிறாள். மறைக்கப்பட்ட கடந்த காலங்கள், துரோகங்கள், கொலைகள் ஆகியவை அடுத்து அடுத்து வெளிவர, விசாரணையாளர் கார்த்திக் இவற்றுக்குப் பின்னிலுள்ள சூழ்ச்சியாளரை கண்டுபிடிக்கச் சவாலடைகிறார். உயிர்தப்பும் போராட்டம், பழிவாங்கும் விருப்பம், மறைந்த பாவங்களின் பயங்கர விளைவுகள் ஆகியவை இந்த கதையின் மையமாகின்றன.

the-man-who-used-the-universe.title: The Man Who Used the Universe
the-man-who-used-the-universe.description: No one knows the true motives of Kees vaan Loo-Macklin. He's a mastermind criminal who gave up his place at the head of the dark underworld to become a legitimate member of Evenwaith's cities. But soon he was reaching out to powerful enemies-the slimy aliens called the Nuel. Loo-Macklin negotiates an illusory peace agreement and gains precious alien secrets in the process. Is he after peace power or pure evil? With enemy starships beginning to amass we won't have to wait long to find out.

panchatantrada-kathegalu-bhaaga-3.title: Panchatantrada Kathegalu Bhaaga 3
panchatantrada-kathegalu-bhaaga-3.description: ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ, ಪಕ್ಷಿ, ಕಾಡು ಮುಂತಾದ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡು ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಬದುಕಿನ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬೋಧಿಸಬಹುದು. ಈ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಸತ್ಯ, ನ್ಯಾಯ, ನೀತಿ, ಪ್ರಾಮಾಣಿಕತೆ ಇವುಗಳ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸಿ, ಅವರು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಇವುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬ ಸಂದೇಶ ನೀಡಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯ.

rich-dad-poor-dad-62.title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
rich-dad-poor-dad-62.description: Schools mein humara education system financial skills se zyada professional skills pe focus karta hai. Issi wajah se log apne professional career mein bohot accha success paane ke bavajood bhi financially strong nahi ho paate. Robert Kiyosaki ki yeh Audiobook aapko apne dimaag aur waqt ka sahi istemaal karke apne investments aur business ke through wealth kamane ke rules samjhaati hai. Iss Audiobook ko sun kar aap seekhenge ki kaise Aapke paise aapke liye kaam karenge naa ki aap paison ke liye.

tumse-hi-waasta.title: Tumse hi Waasta
tumse-hi-waasta.description: One is the love she trusted. The other is the man she never expected to need. Mahika’s perfect love story with Jay begins to crumble when fate brings powerful businessman Prithvi into her life. As Prithvi’s intense love collides with Jay’s hidden ambitions and a dangerous family conspiracy, Mahika is caught between trust, betrayal and a love she can no longer ignore. When the truth finally comes out, whom will her heart choose?

safalta-ke-guru-mantra3feet-from-gold.title: Three Feet From Gold
safalta-ke-guru-mantra3feet-from-gold.description: Nepolean Hills ki adbhut  rachana Think and Grow Rich se Prerit yeh book un logon ke liye preranadayi kahani ka sangraha hain, j kathin samay mein uthkar khade rahe aur bhabisya ki piri ke prerak hero bane. janiye un prerak baton ko jisse apne jiban mein badlab la sakte hain. abhi sune audiobook safalta ke gurumantra kebal kukufm par

terrific.title: Terrific
terrific.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

komagato-maru.title: Komagata Maru Incident
komagato-maru.description: Azaadi ke sangraam mein aise bahut saare naam hain jo itihaas ki kitaabon mein kahin gum ho gye. Unhi mein se ek naam tha Baba Gurdit Singh Komagata Maaru jinhone apni jaan ki parvaah na karte huye aisa jabaaz kaam karke dikhaya ke angrezon ki naak ke neeche se 250 Bharatiyon ko Canada le gaye. Lekin Aisa kya hua 1914 Canada mein jis ke liye aaj bhi Canadian Govt. India se maafi maangti hai. Jaan ne ke liye suniye Komagata Maru Incident sirf KukuFM par.

kathara-nama-banshi.title: Kathara Nama Banshi
kathara-nama-banshi.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

teacher-1.title: Teacher
teacher-1.description: In her journey to overcome intimacy fears, Hanna finds herself at Voyeur, a watching club owned by Daniel. Despite her instinct to run from her past, she finds comfort in Daniel's arms and his promise to teach her. As their friendship evolves into unexpected passion, both must navigate their complicated emotions—she's healing from her past, while he's sworn off love. This final installment in the Voyeur series explores their transformation from friends to lovers.

story-of-irawan-1-to-10.title: Iravan : God of the Transgender
story-of-irawan-1-to-10.description: Mahabharat ke yuddh ke samay, Arjun ek gambhir dharam sankat mein phas gaye the. Is samasya ka samadhan unke apne putra Iravan ne apne balidaan dwara kiya. Suniye Iravan ke atyant mahatvapurn balidaan ki kahani, jo Kinnar samaj ko unki pehchan dilane mein vardaan sabit hui.

hellen-keller-1.title: Helen Keller
hellen-keller-1.description: Helen keller 1800's la vaazhndha oru pen activist, dhairiyama appo irundha samudhaayathula irundha sikkalgala edhirthu kural kudutha, poraadiya pen pathi naama therinjikitte aaganum. Adhukku dhaan indha audio book iruke. Kleunga !

mohanaswamy-1.title: Mohanaswamy
mohanaswamy-1.description: ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊಟ್ಟಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಗೆ ಸಲಿಂಗಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬಂದ ಕೃತಿಯಂದ್ರೆ ಲೇಖಕರಾದ ವಸುಧೇಂದ್ರ ಅವರು ಬರೆದ 'ಮೋಹನಸ್ವಾಮಿ'. ಹನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಒಂದು ಪದ್ಯವಿರುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ, ಸಲಿಂಗಿಯ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಹಾಗೂ ದೈಹಿಕ ತೊಳಲಾಟದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಲಿಂಗ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ನಂತ್ರ ಎದುರಿಸುವ ಸವಾಲುಗಳೇ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ಕಥಾಹಂದರ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

sri-krishna-devarayulu-vijayanagara-samr.title: Sri Krishna Devarayulu- Vijayanagara Samrajyam
sri-krishna-devarayulu-vijayanagara-samr.description: Vijayanagara samrajayaanni Karnataka samrajyam ani, potugese vaaru bisnegar rajyam kuda pilustharu. Idi dakshina bharathadesham loni daccan peetabhoomi prantham lo undi. Deenini 1082 lo sangama rajavamshaniki chendina modati hari hara rayudu, sodarudu modati bukka rayudu sthampincharu. 11 va shathabdam chivari natiki Islamic dandayathralanu nivarinchadaniki dakshinadi shakthula prayathnala parakaastaga ee samrajyam pramukhyathanu santharinchukundi.

blood-emperor.title: Blood Emperor
blood-emperor.description: धनबाद के कोयला यार्ड में देव लंगड़ाकर चलता है, ट्रकों के पहिये साफ़ करता है, गालियाँ खाता है। एक बेबस अनाथ, बस इतना ही सब जानते हैं। पर वो नाटक है। जब टाइकून धरमवीर सिंह का घमंडी पोता राजीव उसे भीड़ के सामने लात मारकर बेइज़्ज़त करता है, देव रोता है, गिड़गिड़ाता है... और उसी पल राजीव की जेब से कार्टेल का पूरा टैक्स-चोरी रिकॉर्ड चुरा लेता है। एक मज़दूर की चुप्पी के पीछे एक साम्राज्य गिराने की तैयारी छिपी है।

pazhassi-raja.title: Pazhassi Raja
pazhassi-raja.description: British adhiniveshathinethire padaporuthiya dheeranaya yodhav aayirunnu Kerala Varma Pazhassi Raja. Britishukarkkethire aadhyam yudham prakhyapicha natturajakkanmaril oral. Kannurile Kuthuparambinu aduthulla kottayam Rajavamshathil aayirunnu Pazhassiyude piravi. Napoleone vare tholppicha Arthur Wellesleyye enna British Commandore vare muttukuthicha asaadharana vyakthithwam aaya Pazhassi Rajayude kadha kelkkam.

boomerang-comeback-stories-by-kunal-pati.title: Best Comeback Stories in Sports
boomerang-comeback-stories-by-kunal-pati.description: Safalta haasil karne ke liye humme lagaatar koshish karni padti hai. Lekin kabhi kabhi aisa hota hai ki ek thoke ke baad hum ruk se jaate hai aur usse apne safalta ka antt maante hai, lekin woh antt nahi shuruvaat hoti hai ek nayi kahaani ki. Iss show mein suniye aatmavishwaas ki kuch best kahaniyaan joh aap mein ek naya josh aur vishwaas paida kar degi.

vachathi-case.title: Vachathi Case
vachathi-case.description: Viduthalai padathula naama paatha edhuvume karpanai illa, adhu nija sambavam nu sonna namba mudiyudha? Andha padathula kaatra madiriye pala appavi graama makkal chitravadhai seiyapattu, seiyaadha kutrathukaga thandanai anubavichanga. Idhukku pinnala irundha arasu adhikarigal, police officers ku edachum thandanai kedaichadha? Therinjuka kelunga “Vachathi Case (1992)” on Kuku FM

the-girl-in-the-wall.title: Qaid ke 17 din
the-girl-in-the-wall.description: Ek nanhi ladki jo apne Family friend ke haathon apaharan ka shikaar hui.  9 saal ki umar mein ek underground bunker mein 16 dino tak band rahi masoom.   Baniye Is anokhi kahani ka hissa aur jaaniye kaise Katherine ne apni himmat aur buddhi se  kiya is  mushkil ghadi ka samna." Suniye puri Khani sirf KUKU FM par.

mastering-money-how-to-become-rich.title: Mastering Money How To Become Rich
mastering-money-how-to-become-rich.description: Kya aap ameer banne ke raaz janna chahte hain? Agar haan, toh ye audiobook explanation aapke liye perfect guide hai. Ismein James Allen, Napoleon Hill, aur Roger Fritz jaise mahir logon ne samjhaya hai paisa banane ke easy tareeke. Toh der kis baat ki? Abhi suniye aur badhaiye financial gyaan, Apni zindagi ko nayi uchaiyon tak le jaane ke liye.

ms-dhoni-3.title: MS Dhoni
ms-dhoni-3.description: Apratheekshithamayi captain aavukayum Indiaye samanathakal illatha vijayangalilek nayikkukayum cheytha captain coolanu MS Dhoni. Orikkalum thakarkkapedan idayillatha recordukal nediya Mahiyude thrassipikkunna cricket journey kelku ee showiloode.

कैसे-बना-बिहार-Sachhidanand-Ki-Sankalp-Y.title: Kaise Bana Bihar? Sachhidanand Ki Sankalp Yatra
कैसे-बना-बिहार-Sachhidanand-Ki-Sankalp-Y.description: Ek State, Ek Sapna Aur Ek Kahaani, jo aapko Bihar ki history se jod degi! Kaise hui ek insaan ki ladai Bihar ke wajood ke liye? Yeh sirf ek rajya ka safar nahi, ek sapne ko haqeeqat banane ka junoon hai. Suniyega zaroor, kyunki yeh kahani hai Bihar ke sangharsh aur uski asli pehchaan ki!

எனது-ராஜ-சபையிலே.title: Enathu Raja Sabaiyiley...
எனது-ராஜ-சபையிலே.description: Palveru porattangalukkup piragu, oru vazhiya sirailerunthu thappichittomnu santhoshap padaraan hero. Anal, avanukkuth theriyathu, naragaththukkulla nuzhaiyiromnu. Paraparappana thriller...!

not-a-serial-killer.title: Not A Serial Killer
not-a-serial-killer.description: Ek ke baad ek brutal murder, har baar wahi pattern - 7 din tak zakhm bhar torture, fir maut. Inspector Mukund Joshi ke liye yeh sirf ek case nahi, uski zindagi ka sabse gehra zakham hai, kyunki pehli victim thi uski apni girlfriend. Jaise jaise woh sach ke kareeb jaata hai, waise waise case aur bhi personal hota jaata hai. Par sawaal yeh hai ki kya yeh kisi manasik rogi ka kaam hai ya koi aisa hai jo jaan bujh kar serial killer banne ka natak kar raha hai? Kya yeh sach mein ek serial killer hai ya sirf ek mask?

the-unusual-billionaires.title: Successful Billionaires ki life journey
the-unusual-billionaires.description: Jockey aur Asian Paints jaisi kuch companies us list mein aati hai jinhone kam se kam apne 500 competitors ko haraya aur list mein sabse upar aaye. Kaise kiya in compaies ne ye haasil? Aur kyun dusri companies ye nahi kar paati? Kya alag kar rahe hai ye? Aaiye jaanein. Agar aapko "Built To Last" jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

whole-numbers-and-half-truths-3.title: Whole Numbers And Half Truths
whole-numbers-and-half-truths-3.description: Mana Desham enno kotla mandhi population unna desham. Ikkada manaki teliyani enno aneka vishayalu dagi unnayi. Aithe indulo mana rachyatha Rukmini. S garu evaru cheyani enno survey lu chesi, mana rajakeeyam gurinchi, mana desha jenaba gurinchi, desham lo yuvatha paristhi gurinchi anthe kakunda evaru ki access leni entho information kanipetti mana ee Whole Numbers And Half Truths ane pusthakam lo pondhuparicharu. Ippudu idi mana Kuku FM lo undi mari inkenduku alasyam ventane ee audio book ni vinandi.

manvini-bhavai.title: Manvini Bhavai
manvini-bhavai.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Our shows celebrate love in all its forms from the first flutter of attraction to the deep bonds that withstand the test of time. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

बवंडर.title: Bavandar
बवंडर.description: एक रेप पीड़िता थी गोवा अंडरवर्ल्ड के 3 बड़े दादाओं की हवस का शिकार बन गयी । उसके बाद "गॉडफादर" ने उन तीनों दादाओं को जिस बेरहमी से सज़ा दी, वह सबक था इंसानी समाज के लिये। उनके मर्डर चौंका देने वाले थे।

ee-ganta-gadiste-chalu.title: EE GANTA GADISTE CHALU
ee-ganta-gadiste-chalu.description: మల్లాది రచించిన "ఈ గంట గడిస్తే చాలు" — ప్రేమ, సస్పెన్స్, క్రైమ్, కామెడీ అన్నీ ఒకే కథలో మిళితమైన అద్భుత రచన! మెడికో ప్రణీత్ మరియు సంధ్య ఒక అవాంతర సంఘటనలో చిక్కుకున్నప్పుడు ఏం జరిగింది? ఆద్యంతం ఉత్కంఠభరితంగా సాగే ఈ కథ మిమ్మల్ని ఒక్క క్షణం కూడా విడువదు!

Apaswaralu--అపస్వరాలు.title: అపస్వరాలు
Apaswaralu--అపస్వరాలు.description: ఓ పేద వాడికి ఉన్నట్టుండి బోలెడంత డబ్బు దొరకడం, చివరకి అతనికి కావాల్సినవి ఏవీ కూడా ఆ డబ్బుతో దొరకని పరిస్థితులు రావడం, ప్రతి పాత్ర మనము మన జీవితం లో తరచూ చూస్తూనే ఉంటాము అన్నట్లు ఉంటుంది.ధనిక, పేద, మధ్యతరగతి జీవిత కథల కలబోత "అపస్వరాలు".

criminal-boyfriend.title: Criminal Boyfriend
criminal-boyfriend.description: లైఫ్ లో సెటిల్ అవ్వడం కోసం, ఒక గొప్పింటి అమ్మాయిని కిడ్నాప్ చేస్తాడు సిద్దార్థ్. కానీ అనుకోని పరిస్థితుల్లో కిడ్నాప్ చేసిన అమ్మాయితోనే ప్రేమలో పడతాడు. కానీ ఊహించని విధంగా, కిడ్నాప్ నుండి, మాఫీయా రంగంలోకి అడుగుపెడతాడు సిద్దార్థ్. అక్కడి నుండి అతడి జీవితం ఏ మలుపులు తిరిగింది, తను ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయికి, సిద్దార్థ్ విషయం తెలిసాక ఎలా రియాక్ట్ అయ్యింది, తెలుసుకోవాలంటే, ఎన్నో మలుపులతో ఉత్కంఠంగా సాగే యూత్ ఎంటర్టైనర్ ఐనా criminal Boyfriend show వినాల్సిందే, only on kuku Fm...

কুহেলিকা---লেখক---মায়ুমী-সেনগুপ্ত-.title: Kuhelika

the-shortest-history-of-india-1.description: Ancient civilization nunchi oka global super power ga marindi mana bharatha desham. Mana Bharatha desham democracy lo chaala peddadi. aithe appati harapan civilization nunchi, muslims palinchina kaalam nunchi, british vaalu elina kaalam nunchi ippudu oka democratic desham ga marindi mana bharatha desham ayithe, ancient kaalam nunchi present kaalam varaku John Zubrzycki mana desha charitra gurinchi entho chakka ga vivarinchadu ee audio book lo. Meeru kuda vini telusukondi.

uttarkashi-tunnel-collapse.title: Uttarkashi Tunnel Collapse
uttarkashi-tunnel-collapse.description: "41 Workers Ki 17 Days" Ke Rescue Mission Ki Jaankari aur Is Haadse ke peeche ka kaaran janenge humare is Original KuKu Byte Mein.

wakil-sahab-adalat-mein-british-empire.title: Wakil Sahab : Adalat Mein British Empire
wakil-sahab-adalat-mein-british-empire.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki Jallianwala Bagh hatyakand ke baad ek vakil ne angrezon ko unhi ki adalat mein ghaseet diya tha? Usne kasam khai thi ki nirdosh Bhartiyon ke qaatil ko aasani se chhodega nahi. Lekin ek akela vakil British hukumat ke saamne kaise khada hua? Kaise usne samraajyavaad ke takat ko adalat ke katghare mein laa khada kiya? Kaunse raste se guzar kar usne itihas mein apna naam likhwaya? Aur kaun tha yeh 'Wakil Sahab'? Jaanein poori kahani es historical docu-drama "Wakil Sahab: Adalat Mein British Empire" mein.

in-the-wreckage.title: In The Wreckage
in-the-wreckage.description: Love is a difficult thing to find when you have superpowers. Captain Jamie Callahan got a new lease on life when he survived a chemical attack that turned him into a metahuman. Now, he leads Alpha Team, the Metahuman Defense Force’s top strike group, a position that puts him at odds with his elite political family. Determined to do his duty, Jamie’s commitment to his team creates a loneliness that is increasingly difficult to ignore. Staff Sergeant Kyle Brannigan was only looking to relieve some stress after a long mission. He didn’t know the hot guy he picked up at a bar was the leader of the MDF’s top field team. When Kyle and his partner get seconded to Alpha Team to help fight a terrorist threat, he has to balance his desire for Jamie against his duty to keep his secrets safe. That gets harder and harder to do amidst regulations both are tempted to break.

72ed3f7b-3f8c-465d-8a76-797d086032de.title: Kaise Karein Budget Mein Shaadi
72ed3f7b-3f8c-465d-8a76-797d086032de.description: Shadi ko budget-friendly aur yaadgar kaise banaye? Jaane Riya aur Aryan ki real-life kahani, jismein unhone apne sapno ki shadi ko kam kharch mein possible banaya! Miss na karein ye inspiring story, bas Kuku FM par.

fast-food-exposed.title: Fast Food Exposed
fast-food-exposed.description: ఫాస్ట్ ఫుడ్ అనేది త్వరగా తయారయ్యే, తక్కువ సమయంలో అందుబాటులో ఉండే ఆహారం. దీంట్లో అధిక మోతాదులో కొవ్వు, ఉప్పు, చక్కెరలు ఉండటంవల్ల గుండె సంబంధిత వ్యాధులు, మధుమేహం వంటి ఆరోగ్య సమస్యలు ఏర్పడతాయి. బర్గర్లు, పిజ్జాలు, ఫ్రెంచ్ ఫ్రైస్ లాంటి ఫాస్ట్ ఫుడ్‌లు యువతలో విపరీతమైన ప్రాచుర్యం పొందాయి.

zindagi-ki-race-finish-line-tak-ka-safar.title: Zindagi ki Race: Finish Line Tak Ka Safar
zindagi-ki-race-finish-line-tak-ka-safar.description: Zindagi ki race mein, kabhi hum aage nikal jate hai, to kabhi piche chhut jate hai. yeh audioshow aapko dikhayega ki kaise har roz ki chunotiyan hume mazboot banati hai. Chaliye, humare saath aur apni zindagi ko nayi nazar se dekhe.

ആമിന-1.title: ആമിന
ആമിന-1.description: ഇന്ത്യാ വിഭജനകാലത്തെ ബംഗാളിന്റെ  പരിസരത്ത്  പറയപ്പെടുന്ന അപൂർവ സുന്ദരമായ ഒരു പ്രണയകഥ.    മതവെറിയുടെയും വർഗ്‌ഗീയഭ്രാന്തിനും ഇരയായി പൊലിഞ്ഞ് പോകുന്ന ആമിന എന്ന താരകവും വിധിയുടെ ക്രുരമായ വിളയാട്ടത്തിന് മുന്നിൽ പകച്ച് നിൽക്കുന്ന രണ്ട് പുരുഷന്മാരും. അവരിൽ ഒരാൾ കാമുകനും മറ്റെയാൾ ഭർത്താവും! ഉറൂബിന്റെ വ്യത്യസ്തമായ ഒരു കൃതി .

how-electronic-devices-evolved-in-the-au.title: How Electronic Devices Evolved in the Automobile Industry
how-electronic-devices-evolved-in-the-au.description: Technology Yellaa thuraigal layum valarchi adanjutte varuthu, Ellaa thuraigal layum electronics udaiya aadhikkam irukku ! Dhinamum pudhusu pudhusa namma kaila irukkura ovvoru gadgets um update agitte irukku. Automobile industry la Electronics eppadi ulla vanthuchu, adhu eppadi valarchi adanjuchu, adhoda ethirkaalam eppadi irukkum ! Intha pathivu la therinjikalam vanga !

yaamirukka-bayamen.title: யாமிருக்க பயமேன்?
yaamirukka-bayamen.description: நாற்பது வயது ஆகியும் திருமணம் ஆகாத அப்பளம் அபிராமிக்கு சைட் சாந்தி, லாயர் கிருஷ்ணவேணி என இரு தங்கைகள். அதில் ஒரு தங்கையான லாயர் கிருஷ்ணவேணியின் கேஸை தட்டிப் பறித்து அவள் வாழ்க்கைக்குள் நுழைகிறான் லாயர் வெற்றிவேல். கோர்ட்டில் எதிர் எதிரே மோதிக் கொள்ளும் இருவரும் ஒன்றினையும் முன்பே வெற்றிவேலின் சித்தப்பாவும் கிருஷ்ணவேணியின் அக்கா அபிராமியும் மணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள்‌. நன்றாக செல்லும் அவர்கள் இல்வாழ்க்கையில் விரிசல் விழ, அதைக் கோர்ட்டில் சரி செய்ய முயல்கிறார்கள். இந்த கோர்ட்டு கேஸ், கலாட்டா இவர்களை ஒன்று சேர்த்தா? கேளுங்கள் உங்கள் குக்கூ எப்.எம்.ல்...

public-awareness.title: Public Awareness
public-awareness.description: ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ವಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ಹಲವಾರು ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಕುರಿತ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಳಿಂದ ಜನಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರು ವಂಚಿತರಾಗೋದು ಸರ್ವೇಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ. ಮನೆ ಕಟ್ಟೋದ್ರಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು, ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಹಾಗೂ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿದಾಯಕ ಜೀವನವನ್ನ ನಡೆಸೋಕೆ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮದ ಜೊತೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಪಟ್ಟ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಳನ್ನ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳೋದು ಅತ್ಯವಶ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ. ರಿಯಲ್‌ ಎಸ್ಟೇಟ್‌, ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ, ಷೇರು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಈ ಸಂಚಿಕೆಗಳು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿವೆ. ಬಜೆಟ್‌ಗೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಮನೆಗಳಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ಹೇಗೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿರಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾದ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುವ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ "ಪಬ್ಲಿಕ್‌ Awareness" ಕೇಳಿ ‌KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

saurav-gangully-biography-1.title: Prince Of Kolkata - Sourav Ganguly
saurav-gangully-biography-1.description: Sourav Ganguly ka jeevan utaar-chadhav se bhara raha hai. Lekin Ganguly ki kahani bhi badi chunautiyon ke saath aayi, apne shuruwati dino se jaha unhe team mein shaamil hone ke liye 4 saal ka intezaar karna pada. Kyun? Aaiye jaane

భార్యా-బాధితుల-సంఘం.description: వెంటపడి బ్రతిమాలి కాళ్ళా వేళ్ళా పడి మరీ.. తాము ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయిలను జీవిత భాగస్వామిని చేసుకున్నారు నలుగురు అబ్బాయిలు. ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయిలు జీవితంలోనికి రావడంతో.. ఇక ఈ ప్రపంచంలోని ఆనందమంతా మాదే..! సంతోషమంతా మాదే..! ఇక మాకు తిరుగులేదు.. అని కాలర్లు ఎగరవేశారు. కొంతకాలం చక్కగా సాగింది సంసారం. ఇక అక్కడి నుంచి మొదలు విసర్లు కసర్లు.. చీటికిమాటికి అలకలు. మాకొద్దు బాబోయ్ ఈ జీవితం అని ఏడుస్తున్న.. అలాంటి వరస్ట్ సిట్యువేషన్ లో వాళ్లకి ఒక అద్భుతమైన అవకాశం దొరికింది. అదేంటో ఈ షో ద్వారా వినండి

Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

thudiyembo-thudiyilla.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

red-diary.title: Red Diary
red-diary.description: Ek reputed medical college ka hostel, jiska Room no. 404 hamesha se ek raaz bana raha. Kehte hain yahaan rehne wala har student unnatural tareeke se gayab ho gaya. Ragging se pareshan Abhimanyu, is room mein shift ho gaya. Pehli raat hi use ek purani red diary mili, ex-student Gaurav ki, jisme usne room ke ajeeb-o-garib haalaat aur apne darawne experience likhe the. Jaise-jaise Abhimanyu diary padhta gaya, waise-waise uske aaspaas bhi anokhe ghatnaayein hone lagi. Diary mein likha hua Gaurav ka past dheere dheere Abhimanyu ka present banne laga. Jaldi hi use samajh aa gaya ki is room se bachne ke liye use kai mushkilon ka saamna karna padega. Inn mushkilon mein uske saath khade the uske dost Neha aur Rohan. Kya Abhimanyu ne sirf room badla tha, ya apne jeevan ka raasta bhi? Kya Abhimanyu apne doston ke sath is Room 404 ke shraap ko tod kar bach payega?

maron-batas.title: Sunday Thriller Stories: Maron Batas
maron-batas.description: Ei golpo ti ashole kar? Hai Suchitra Bhattacharya r to botei, kintu golpo ti kake niye? Ba kader niye? Ei golpe dekha jaye je ekjon lady investigator Mitin ki bhabe tar phanka somoy katan, kaj ba investigation kore naki nijeke somoy diye? Ki emon ghote golper shuru te ba golpe jate Mitin amader lady investigator ekdom somoy noshto na kore kaje lege pore? Ei golpe kenoi ba ekti mohila jar name Chitralekha take nijer borer khuner oporadhe jail bondi kora hoy? Ei rohoshyer golpo jante shune nin Sunday Thriller Stories er ei audio story ti.

virat-kohli.description: ఒక మామూలూ కుర్రాడు ఇండియన్ క్రికెట్ టీం కి సైప్టెన్ ఎలా అయ్యాడు? విరాట్ తన కెరీర్లో ఎదుర్కొన్న సవాళ్లేంటి? స్ఫూర్తి కలిగించే విరాట్ కథ మీకోసం

பத்ரன்-.description: தன்னைக் கொன்ற பத்ரனைப் பழிவாங்க அடுத்தடுத்த ஜென்மங்களில் பத்ரனை தேடுகிறது அவனால் கொலை செய்யப்பட்ட கொள்ளையனின் ஆவி. பத்ரன் பழிவாங்கப்பட்டானா? விஷால் அதிரடியில் அசத்தலான ஒரு ஹாரர் கதை பத்ரன்.

iaf-indian-air-force-1.title: IAF: Indian Air Force
iaf-indian-air-force-1.description: Indian  three defense forces lo Okataina ee Aiforce Britsh Government World War time lo ‘Royal’ ane name tho auxiliary air force ni Start chesindi. Indian Airforce 1932 October 8th na British Goverment Dwara Start Cheyabadina  Ee Airforce Present World Third Storngest and Efficient Airforce ga Peru pondindi. Appti nundi Ippati varaku Ee Airforce Development ela jarigindi. Ee Airforce Chesina Complicated Operations,Awards,Sus-forces, Indian Airforce Day Vanti Munupennadu Vinani Visheshalatho Ee Audiobook Kuku FM Mee kosam Teesukuvachindi.

big-vision-big-success.title: Big Vision Big Success
big-vision-big-success.description: జీవితంలో గొప్ప విజయాన్ని సాధించాలంటే పెద్ద కలలు కనాలి, విశాలమైన దృష్టితో ముందుకు సాగాలి. చిన్నగా ఆలోచించడం, సంకుచితంగా ఉండిపోవడం మన సాధికారతను పరిమితం చేస్తుంది. అయితే, మనం ఎంత పెద్దగా ఆలోచిస్తే, అంత పెద్ద విజయం మన దిశగా అడుగులు వేస్తుంది.

how-to-fight-infertility-3.title: How to fight Infertility?
how-to-fight-infertility-3.description: Innaiku irukka Kaala kattathula Infertility romba mukkiyamaana prachanaiyaa irukku. Ithai eppadi handle pannanum apdinra awarness neraya perukku thevaiyaa irukku. Infertility kaana kaaranangal, athukkana solutions ellathayum ungalukku solra muyarchi thaan intha pathivu. Vaanga makkale Infertility pathiyum athukkana solutions pathiyum kettu therinjukalaam.

paari-vallal.title: Paari Vallal
paari-vallal.description: தனது மக்களின் நிலத்தை காப்பாற்ற போராடும் பழங்குடியினர் உரிமை செயற்பாட்டாளர் குறிஞ்சி, தன்னை சங்ககால வள்ளல் பாறியுடன் இணைக்கும் மறைக்கப்பட்ட வரலாற்றை கண்டுபிடிக்கிறாள். காலம் மாறினாலும், நிலம், அடையாளம் மற்றும் மரியாதைக்கான போராட்டம் அதேபோல தொடர்கிறது. இறுதியில், பாறியைப் போலவே ஒரு பெரிய தியாகத்தை செய்ய வேண்டிய சூழலில் குறிஞ்சி நிற்கிறாள்.

అన్నమయ్య-ఆంధ్రపద-కవితా-పితామహ-.title: అన్నమయ్య- ఆంధ్ర పద కవితా పితామహ
అన్నమయ్య-ఆంధ్రపద-కవితా-పితామహ-.description: అన్నమయ్య కీర్తనలు కేవలం భక్తి గీతాలుగానే కాకుండా సామాజిక, సాంస్కృతిక పరిస్థితులను కూడా చిత్రీకరిస్తాయి. ఆయన కాలం నాటి సమాజాన్ని మనం ఎలా అర్థం చేసుకోవచ్చు? మరిన్ని కొత్త విషయాలు తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ ఆడియోబుక్ వినాలి

shyam-ekvar-aavone-aangane.title: Shyam Ekvar Aavone Aangane
shyam-ekvar-aavone-aangane.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

tilismi-duniya.title: Tilismi Duniya
tilismi-duniya.description: Apne ateet se anjan Pakhi fans gayi hai ek rahasyamayi gufa mein. Ek gufa jahan basti hai ek alag duniya. Pakhi ko nahi pata ki wo is duniya ki rajkumari hai par Chakradhari aisa hone nahi dega. Kaise payegi Pakhi apna hak? Kaise bachegi wo Chakradhari ke tilism se? Janne ke liye sunein, Tilism ki duniya…

beyond-the-8020-principle.title: Beyond the 80/20 Principle
beyond-the-8020-principle.description: Beyond the 80/20 Principle delves deeper into Richard Koch's revolutionary idea of focusing on the vital few over the trivial many, offering advanced insights and practical strategies to amplify success, simplify life, and achieve more with less effort.

sonali-eagley-koni-parile-belie-umoni-di.title: Sonali Eagley Koni Parile Belie Umoni dile
sonali-eagley-koni-parile-belie-umoni-di.description: Jump into a world of diverse tales with Kuku FM's Short Stories. Perfect for listeners on the go our short stories offer quick escapes into fictional worlds. From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

মহাযুদ্ধের-নায়িকা-.title: মহাযুদ্ধের নায়িকা
মহাযুদ্ধের-নায়িকা-.description: রাজ্যপালের সম্মান ফিরিয়ে দিয়ে জাহ্নবী রাতারাতি খবরের শিরোনামে চলে আসে, তার এই সাহসিকতার পরিণাম কী হবে? তার নিজের গ্রামের উন্নয়নের স্বপ্ন কি অধরা থেকে যাবে? শুনে নিন জাহ্নবীর এই দুঃসাহসিক যাত্রার ধারাবাহিক ঘটনা।

kingdom-of-mysore.title: Kingdom of Mysore
kingdom-of-mysore.description: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಮುಕುಟಮಣಿಯಲ್ಲೊಂದು ‘ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ ಮೈಸೂರು’! ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುವ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಅರಮನೆ ಒಂದು ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ, ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ರಸ್ತೆಗಳು ಮಹಾರಾಜರ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾರುತ್ತವೆ. ದಸರಾ ಎನ್ನುವ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಹಬ್ಬ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರ ಸ್ವಾಭಿಮಾನದ ಪ್ರತೀಕವಾಗಿ ವಿಶ್ವವಿಖ್ಯಾತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಮೈಸೂರು ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಆಯಿತು? ಇವತ್ತಿಗೂ ಸಂವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಪಡೆದಿರುವ ಮೈಸೂರು ಮಹಾರಾಜರ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು ಯಾವುವು? ಇವೆಲ್ಲಾ ರೋಚಕ ವಿಚಾರಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕಾ? ಕೇಳಿ 'Kingdom of Mysore' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್!

gandhi-indiakk-munpu.title: ഗാന്ധി ഇന്ത്യക്ക്  മുൻപ്
gandhi-indiakk-munpu.description: ചരിത്രകാരനായ രാമചന്ദ്ര ഗുഹ രചിച്ച മഹാത്മാ ഗാന്ധിയുടെ ജീവച്രിത്രത്തിൻ്റെ ആദ്യ ഭാഗമാണിത്.  ദക്ഷിണാഫ്രിക്കയിൽ ഒരു അഭിഭാഷകനായും പൗരാവകാശ പ്രവർത്തകനായും പ്രവർത്തിച്ച ഗാന്ധിയുടെ  21 വർഷങ്ങളും അതിനു ശേഷം  ഇന്ത്യയിലേക്കുളള തിരിച്ചുവരവും  ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ പ്രതിപാദിക്കുന്നു. ഏറെ ചർച്ച ചെയ്യപ്പെട്ട ഈ ഗ്രന്ഥം കേൾക്കാം..

diabetes-control-1.title: Diabetes Control
diabetes-control-1.description: Diabetes ei muhurte bharatborsher ekta bishal somoshya. Odhikansho bharatiyo der dharona anek beshi mishti khawar jonno hoye thake,ebong sheti bondho kore dile ar hoi na. Ekjoln sadharon byekti ke diabetes somondhye shob information dewar jonno ei boi ti lekha hoyeche. Blood sugar manush ke kathe laga uui pokar moto jhajhra kore dei. Diabetes somporke shob jene newar jonnyo shune nin ei audiobook ti.

fake-date.title: Fake Date
fake-date.description: Online wala pyar Zoya ko le aaya Vietnam, jahan use pata chala, jis Ladke se wo karti thi baate, wo ek saal pehle hi mar chuka tha. Kya ye hai koi scam? ya koi khel rha tha uske sath khatarnak khel ban kar uska Fake Date? Janne ke liye abhi sunein.

find-trending-topics-for-youtube-1.title: Find Trending Topics for YouTube
find-trending-topics-for-youtube-1.description: Inganeyokke poyal mathiyo, kurachu trending topics ningalude YouTubeil pareekshikkande?

அக்னிப்ரவேசம்.title: அக்னி பிரவேசம்
அக்னிப்ரவேசம்.description:
திரேதா யுகத்தில் சீதையை 'அக்னிப் பிரவேசம்' செய்ய வைத்து அவளது பவித்திரத்தை உலகறிய வைத்தார் ஸ்ரீராமர். இந்த காலத்திலும் பல சீதைகள் இருக்கிறார்கள். அவர்கள் அக்னிப் பிரவேசம் செய்து தான் தங்களது பவித்திரத்தை நிலை நாட்ட வேண்டுமா?

கதாநாயகி மிதிலா... மூட நம்பிக்கையில் ஊறிப் போன மலைக் கிராமத்தில்,  புகுந்த வீட்டினர் மூலமாக அக்னி குழியில் இறங்கும்படி நிர்ப்பந்திக்கப் படுகிறாள். தன் மீது விழுந்த களங்கத்தை துடைப்பதற்காக அவள் அக்னிப் பிரவேசம் செய்தாளா?

chausar.title: CHAUSAR "The game of Death"
chausar.description: Mumbai Police ke mahkame mein tab halchal mach gayi jab Vista Technology ke 15 members meeting ke baad achanak gayab ho gaye. Aatankiyon ne agva kiye gaye members ko riha karne ke liye apne sathi Qadir Mustfa ki rehai ki maang ki. Kya bhartiya sarkar Qadir Mustfa ko riha karegi ya Nilesh Pasi aur dusron ko bachaane ka koi aur raasta nikaalegi? Janane ke liye suniye - Chausar - "The Game of Death".

aani-panipat.title: Aani Panipat
aani-panipat.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

ghesu-chand.title: Ghesu Chand Jasoos
ghesu-chand.description: घेसू चंद एक जीनीयस जासूस है और उसकी पार्टनर है इंस्पेक्टर रेखा यह दोनों मिलकर उलझे हुए केस सॉल्व करते रहते हैं चाहे वह केस मर्डर मिस्ट्री का हो।चाहे साइको किलर का किंतु पहली दफा यह दोनों ही मुसीबत में अलग-अलग फंस जाते हैं अपने दुश्मनों की साजिश का शिकार होकर। अब देखना होगा कि यह दोनों अपने दुश्मनों की साजिश का भंडाफोड़ करते हुए खुद को बचाने में सक्षम होते हैं या नहीं।या फिर दोनों ही अपने दुश्मनों की साजिश का शिकार होकर रह जाएंगे।

10-rare-endangered-animals-soon-to-extin.title: 10 Rare Endangered Animals soon to Extinct
10-rare-endangered-animals-soon-to-extin.description: Naalukku naal intha ulagathula pala uyirinangal azhinjutte varuthu. Namma India vula kooda namakku nalla therinja pala vilangugal athoda inathoda iruthi kaalathai vaalanthutu irukku. Azhivu nilayila irukka koodiya 10 endangered species ah pathina pathivu thaan ithu.

262d66b8-2bfe-4273-855f-e5ebf46e3f46.title: அக்காவின் குடை
262d66b8-2bfe-4273-855f-e5ebf46e3f46.description: அக்கா விஜியும், தங்கை ஜெயாவும், விஜிக்குக் கல்யாணம் ஆவதற்கு முன் ஈருடல் ஓருயிர் போலத்தான் பழகினார்கள். அக்காவைப் பெண்பார்க்க வந்த வைத்தியை ஜெயாவுக்குக் கட்டோடு பிடிக்கவில்லை. தன் ஆசை அக்காவுக்கு வைத்தி சற்றும் பொருத்தமே இல்லை என்று அவள் கணித்ததை வீட்டில் யாருமே மதிக்கவில்லையே? ஜெயாவுக்கு மனமுதிர்ச்சியே கிடையாதாம். வைத்தியைத் தான் விஜி அக்கா சம்மதித்துக் கட்டிக்கொண்டாள். ஜெயாவுக்கு அக்கா மீது கோபம்; வருத்தம்; பரிதாபம். வேலைக்குப் போக ஆரம்பித்த ஜெயா, அலுவலக ரீதியில் நட்பான செல்வகுமாரின் மீது காதல் வயப்படுகிறாள். அழகனாயும், புத்திசாலியாயும், தான் கற்பனை செய்த ஆண்மகனாகவும் அமைந்துவிட்ட செல்வாவை வைத்தியோடு ஒப்பிட்டுப் பார்த்து தன்னைத் தானே மெச்சிக்கொள்கிறாள் ஜெயா. ஆனால் அவள் காதலுக்கு அந்த வைத்தியே வில்லனாய் முளைத்தது எப்படி? ஜெயா தனது மிகச் சிறந்த தேர்வாய் அமைந்தவனின் கரம் பிடித்தாளா?

bhaktha-ramadasu.title: భక్త రామదాసు
bhaktha-ramadasu.description: భక్త రామదాసు రాముణ్ణి నమ్ముకున్నా కానీ జైలు పాలయ్యాడా? తానీషా కి రామదాసు మీద కోపం ఎందుకు వచ్చింది? రామ లక్ష్మణులు రామదాసును చెరసాల నుండి నిజంగా విడిపించారా? మీకోసం ఈ ఆడియో బుక్.

how-to-come-out-of-debt.title: How To Come Out Of Debt?
how-to-come-out-of-debt.description: Kadabhadhyathakal kond manam madutho? Sambathika swathanthrathinte swapnam kaanukayano ningal? Enkil ee show ningalkullathanu.

deadly-truths-shocking-murders-of-telang.title: Deadly Truths - Shocking Murders Of Telangana
deadly-truths-shocking-murders-of-telang.description:
తెలంగాణలో జరిగిన భయానక, సంచలనాత్మక హత్యలు... అసలు ఏమి జరిగింది? నేరస్థుల మతిస్థిమితం దెబ్బతిన్న క్షణాలు, పోలీసులు ఎదుర్కొన్న చేదు సత్యాలు, విచారణలో బయటపడిన షాకింగ్ నిజాలు!

ఈ కథలు మిమ్మల్ని షాక్‌లోకి నెడతాయి... మనసును కలచివేస్తాయి! వాస్తవ సంఘటనల ఆధారంగా, కోర్టు కేసులు, నేర పరిశోధన, అసలు మిస్టరీ అంతా ఇక్కడే!

ini-njan-urangatte.title: ഇനി ഞാന്‍ ഉറങ്ങട്ടെ
ini-njan-urangatte.description: മഹാഭാരത കഥയെ കര്‍ണ്ണന്‍ എന്ന ഐതിഹാസിക കഥാപാത്രത്തിന്റെ കാഴ്ചപ്പാടിലൂടെ അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്ന നോവല്‍. പികെ ബാലകൃഷ്ണന്റെ അനുപമമായ ആഖ്യാനം. കേരള സാഹിത്യ അക്കാദമി അവാര്‍ഡിനും വയലാര്‍ അവാര്‍ഡിനും അര്‍ഹമായ കൃതി കേള്‍ക്കാം!

credit-card-se-shaadi.title: Credit Card Se Shaadi
credit-card-se-shaadi.description: Naina ko shaadi mein husband ki jagah mila ek credit card aur paison se bhara bag, jo uska husband use dekar chala gaya London. Dono ne ek dusre ka chehra tak nahin dekha shaadi mein. Majboor Naina ne un paison ka istemaal kiya ek blackmailing se bachne ke liye. Ek saal baad, anjaan Naina ko naukri mil gayi ussi Karan ke office mein, jahaan dono ek dusre ko pehchante nahin the, lekin Karan ko 'Naina' naam se nafrat ho chuki thi. Kya ye boss-employee jaan paenge ki yehi pati-patni hain? Kyon karta tha Karan Naina naam se nafrat? Kaun kar raha tha Naina ko blackmail?

qatilaana.title: Qatilana
qatilaana.description: 6 purane dost Westwood Villa pahunchte hain apni dost Meghna ke suicide ka raaz jaanne. Lekin jab ek aur dost Ruchir ka murder ho jaata hai, to maut ka khaufnaak khel shuru ho jaata hai. Lekin ye asli qatil hai kaun ye janne ke liye suniye poori kahani !

the-ultimate-family-business-survival-gu.title: The Ultimate Family Business Survival Guide
the-ultimate-family-business-survival-gu.description: Thalamurakalayi kaimari labhicha kudumba businessukal ullavaril palarum thangalude noothanamaya aashayangal kondum krithyamaya strategikal kondum businessine vere levelil ethikkunnath kandittille. Priyanka Gupta Zielinski angane oral aanu. Americayil padichu kondirikke pithavinte aavashya prakaram Indiayilek thirich vanna Priyanka thudarnnu kudumba business aaya steal vyavasayathilek praveshichu. Ultimate Family Business Survival Guide enna pusthakathilude Priyanka thante business yathrayil padicha padangal panguvekkukayanu.

beyond-good-and-evil-1.title: Beyond Good and Evil
beyond-good-and-evil-1.description: Beyond Good and Evil idi Friedrich Nietzsche raasina okka goppa pusthakam. Nietzsche thana jeevitham lo anubuthi pondina enno aneka vishyalo indulo chepadu, anthe kakunda oka manishi thana jeevithani thanaki nachinatu ga ela marchukovalo kuda thanu indulo chepadu inkenduku late mari ventane ee goppa pusthakani vineyandi.!

the-porn-trap-1.title: The Porn Trap
the-porn-trap-1.description: വെറുതെ തമാശയ്ക്കും നേരം പോക്കിനും മാത്രം കണ്ടു തുടങ്ങി ഒടുവില്‍ ജീവിതം തന്നെ കുടുക്കിലായിപ്പോയവര്‍ ഒരുപാടുണ്ട് പോണ്‍ വീഡിയോകളുടെ കെണിയില്‍. പോണ്‍ വീഡിയോ എങ്ങനെയാണ് ഒരു കെണിയാവുന്നത് എന്ന് ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്ക് പറയും.

a-question-of-trust.title: A Question Of Trust
a-question-of-trust.description: Gayatri Rath and Paarul Chand Vaati 50 years anubhavam motham rangarinchi Oka CEO edaina brand meeda ela nammakanni kudirinchali, andukosam elanti Communication margalanu anusarinchali, Covid-19 Vanti Pratikula Sandarballo kuda company ni ela succefull ga run cheyalo ee book lo vivarinchabaddayi. Meeru ganuka next CEO avvali anukunte Ee Audiobook Tappakunda Poorthiga Vinalsinde.

the-dummy-who-married-me.title: The Dummy Who Married Me
the-dummy-who-married-me.description: Once dismissed as a mute and powerless husband, Kenneth unveils hidden abilities that defy the ordinary, shocking his scornful in-laws. Amidst family celebrations and sinister secrets, he battles dark forces and people with sinister agendas. As Kenneth uncovers his mystical heritage, he transforms from an underestimated outcast to a powerful protector. This gripping story explores betrayal, redemption, and the timeless battle between light and darkness. A spellbinding audio drama that masterfully blends emotional depth with supernatural elements, this exclusive audio show promises an enthralling escape into a world where the unseen holds extraordinary power.

ಕುಂಭ-ಮೇಳ.title: Kumbha Mela
ಕುಂಭ-ಮೇಳ.description: ಅದು ಏಕಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋಟ್ಯಾಂತರ ಭಕ್ತರು ಸೇರುವ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಸ್ಥಳ... ದೇಶದ ನಾಲ್ಕು ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳಿಂದಲೂ ಅಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಸಾಧು-ಸಂತರು ಸೇರುವ ಪುಣ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಳ... ಪುರುಷರು-ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು, ಹಿರಿಯರು-ಮಕ್ಕಳೆನ್ನುವ ವಯಸ್ಸು, ಜಾತಿ, ಮತ - ಭೇಧವಿಲ್ಲದೇ ಭೇಟಿ ನೀಡಿ, ಪವಿತ್ರ ಸ್ನಾನಗೈಯುವ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಸ್ಥಳ... ಅದುವೇ ಭಾರತ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಇಡೀ ವಿಶ್ವದಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ನಡೆಯುವ ಅತೀ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಆಚರಣೆ ಎಂದೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಿಯಾಗಿರುವ 'ಕುಂಭ ಮೇಳ'...ಇಂತಹ ಮಹಾನ್ ಆಚರಣೆಯ ಪ್ರಾಮುಖ್ಯತೆಯೇನು? ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇಷ್ಟೊಂದು ಜನ ಸೇರೋದ್ಯಾಕೆ? ಇದರ ಹಿಂದಿರುವ ಧಾರ್ಮಿಕ ಹಿನ್ನಲೆಯೇನು? ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ, ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿರುವ 'ಕುಂಭ ಮೇಳ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್...

malhari-the-god-of-destruction.title: Malhari : The God Of Destruction
malhari-the-god-of-destruction.description: Ye Bhagwan Malhari ki gatha hai. Jinhone Malla aur Mani jaise asuron ka sanhaar kiya aur manvata ka ant hone se bachaya. Lekin kis bhagwan ka avtar the Malhari? Aur kiske kahne par lena pada unhe ye avtar? Sab janiye is khas show "Malhari : The God Of Destruction" mein.

மெய்-தீண்டும்-ஒவியம்-நீ.title: மெய் தீண்டும் ஓவியம் நீ
மெய்-தீண்டும்-ஒவியம்-நீ.description: தமிழக நிதித்துறை அமைச்சரின் மகளுக்கும் ஆந்திர முதல்வர் மகனுக்கும் சென்னையில் திருமணம் நடைபெற இருந்த சூழலில், சாணக்கியன் பணத்துக்காக அமைச்சர் மகளை திருமணம் மண்டபத்துக்குள் நுழைந்து தந்திரமாக தூக்கிச் சென்றுவிடுகிறான். அதற்குப் பிறகு தான் தெரிகிறது, மணமகளுக்கும் அந்த திருமணத்தில் விருப்பம் இல்லை என்று.  அதற்குப் பிறகு நடந்தது என்ன?

kaise-karein-bachchon-ka-brain-strong.title: Kaise Karein Bachchon Ka Brain Strong?
kaise-karein-bachchon-ka-brain-strong.description: Kya aap apne bachchon ki achhi grades aur unki learning skills ko achha karne ke liye unhein kaunse tuition ya school mein bheje yeh soch kar pareshan hain? Apni yeh chinta padosi ya rishtedaron ko batane se kuch nahi hoga. In Sab sawalon ke jawab ke liye apko sunna hoga yeh Original Show “Kaise Karein Bachchon Ka Brain Strong”. Jise sunkar aap bachchon ki memory power ko strong karne ki kayi tips jaan jaayenge aur unko apply karke apne bachchon ke brain ko strong bana paayenge.

ganbatte-the-japanese-art-of-moving-forw.title: Ganbatte: The Japanese Art of Moving Forward
ganbatte-the-japanese-art-of-moving-forw.description: Kya aap ready hain life ki challenges ko confidently face karne ke liye? Ganbatte audiobook aapko sikhayegi kaise bade se bada crisis bhi aasaan ho sakta hai. Albert Liebermann ke guidance mein, seekhiye, sudhariye aur safalta ki taraf kadam badhaiye!

alexandria-a-quest-for-the-lost-city.title: Alexandria : A Quest For The Lost City
alexandria-a-quest-for-the-lost-city.description: In 1827, an army deserter leaves everything behind and hides in the dangerous mountains of Afghanistan. Changing his identity, he risks his life to find a mysterious lost empire of Alexander the Great. Defying all odds, he discovers that ancient city and its buried treasure. However, this very success becomes his greatest enemy. The East India Company captures him and forces him into espionage. In this web of betrayal and politics, will he be able to save himself?

pm-svanidhi-scheme-street-vendors-ke-liy.title: PM SVANidhi Scheme: Street Vendors Ke Liye ₹10,000 Loan Ki Complete Guide!
pm-svanidhi-scheme-street-vendors-ke-liy.description: PM SVANidhi Scheme: Street Vendors Ke Liye ₹10,000 Loan Ki Complete Guide!

mystics-of-india.title: Mystics Of India
mystics-of-india.description: ఈ షోలో మన భారతీయ పురాణాలు, దేవతలు, అద్భుతమైన సంఘటనలు, మరియు ఆధ్యాత్మిక గాథలను విభిన్న కోణాలలో అన్వేషించుకుంటాం. ప్రతి ఎపిసోడ్‌లో మనం గణేశ్ జననం, కురుక్షేత్ర యుద్ధం, సముద్ర మంతనం వంటి ముఖ్యమైన పూరాణిక కథలను లోతుగా పరిశీలిస్తాము. ఈ పాఠాలు మనకు ధర్మం, కర్మ, మరియు ఆధ్యాత్మిక గుణాలను అర్థం చేసుకోవడంలో సహాయం చేస్తాయి.

juli.title: Juli
juli.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

vayaktika-yashassu.title: Vayaktika Yashassu
vayaktika-yashassu.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

palsa.title: Palsa
palsa.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Our shows celebrate love in all its forms from the first flutter of attraction to the deep bonds that withstand the test of time. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

1857-che-swantantrya-samar-bhag-2.title: 1857 Che Swantantrya Samar Bhag 2
1857-che-swantantrya-samar-bhag-2.description: Travel back in time with Kuku FM's History shows. Explore ancient civilizations pivotal moments and the people who shaped our world. Our engaging storytelling brings history to life making the past relevant and exciting. From legendary battles to cultural revolutions enrich your knowledge of the human saga. Listen and connect with the stories that define us

the-metamorphosis-4.description:

nilaitha-pugazh-india-1.title: Nilaitha Pugazh India
nilaitha-pugazh-india-1.description: இந்தியா — ஆயிரக்கணக்கான ஆண்டுகள் பழமையான நாகரிகம். கொண்டாடப்பட்டும், தாக்கப்பட்டும், அவமதிக்கப்பட்டும் கூட அழியாமல் நிற்கிறது. பெயர்கள் மாறினாலும் ஆன்மா அழியாதது. அமிஷின் "நிலைத்த புகழ் இந்தியா" — மதம், வரலாறு, பாரம்பரியம், ஆட்சி என அனைத்தையும் நவீன கண்ணோட்டத்தில் விளக்கும் அற்புத நூல்.

the-red-star-life-of-comrade-george-redd.title: The Red Star: Life Of Comrade George Reddy
the-red-star-life-of-comrade-george-redd.description: അനീതിക്കെതിരെ ശബ്ദമുയര്‍ത്തി അനശ്വരതയിലേക്ക് മറഞ്ഞ ഒരു യുവാവ് ഇവിടെ ജീവിച്ചിരുന്നു. എംഎസ്‌സി ഫിസിക്‌സ് ഗോള്‍ഡ് മെഡലിസ്റ്റ്, യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റി ബോക്‌സിങ് ചാമ്പ്യന്‍, ഒസ്മാനിയ യൂണിവേഴ്‌സിറ്റിയിലെ നിര്‍ഭയനായ വിദ്യാര്‍ത്ഥി നേതാവ്. നിങ്ങളിനിയും പരിചയപ്പെട്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്ത പാതി മലയാളിയായ ജോര്‍ജ് റെഡ്ഡി എന്ന വിപ്ലവികാരിയെ അറിയാം.

emotional-intelligence-14.title: Emotional Intelligence
emotional-intelligence-14.description: మన జీవితంలో భావోద్వేగాలు ఎలా సహాయపడతాయో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా? అయితే తప్పకుండా వినండి "ఎమోషనల్ ఇంటెలిజెన్స్" అనే కుకు ఎఫ్ఎమ్ బైట్స్

goddess-of-indian-playback-singing-lata-.title: Goddess of Indian Playback Singing Lata Mangeshkar_1
goddess-of-indian-playback-singing-lata-.description: Kaun deta tha Lata ji ko zahar? Kyon Lata ji fir se Lata ke roop me janma lena nahi chahti? Jab Lataji ko bahut door se haate hue aana pada gaana record karne ke liye? Dilip Sahab ki kaun si baat ko challenge ki tarah sweekar kiya Lata ji ne? Lata ji ki kaun si iksha poori na ho pai? Lata ji ko bhi shuru me rejection mili.

commonman-narendra-modi.title: Commonman Narendra Modi
commonman-narendra-modi.description: यह पुस्तक नरेंद्र मोदी की जीवनी नहीं, बल्कि उनके व्यक्तित्व और कृतित्व को रेखांकित करने का प्रयास है। बचपन, संन्यासी बनने का निर्णय, प्रचारक जीवन और मुख्यमंत्री बनने तक का सफर — मोदी के साक्षात्कार में उनकी राष्ट्रनिष्ठा, विजन और विचारों की बेबाक झलक मिलती है!

focus-hackers-deep-dive.title: Focus: Deep Focus
focus-hackers-deep-dive.description: Minimal, distraction-free sounds designed to improve concentration, mental clarity, and long periods of focused work.

loving-kindness.title: Path Towards Kindness
loving-kindness.description: Doston, duniya mein agar kise ne asal main ishwar ko paaya hai ya keh lijiye ke satisfaction ko prapt kiya hai wo log humesha he karuna se bhare log rahe hain. Chahe wo maryada purusottam Ram ho ya humare pyare Krishna dono main aseem prem hai. Bhagwan Buddha bhi toh kitne karunamayi hain jinhone is duniya ko meditation se salvation ka rasta dikha diya. Kya kaaran hai is karuna ka, is pyar ka, hriday pyar se bhara hua ho toh aapki apni life main kya kya badlaav aayenge? Chaliye jaante hain hamari is khaas peshkash mein. Agar aapko Buddha's Brain jaisi book pasand hai to ye audiobook zaroor sunein.

teluginti-ruchulu.title: Teluginti Ruchulu
teluginti-ruchulu.description: దేశం మొత్తం లో మన తెలుగు వంటలు అంటే పడి చచ్చిపోతారు, ఎందుకో మీకు తెలుసా? మన వంటలు అన్ని మంచి పౌష్టిక విలువలు కలిగి ఉంటాయి కాబట్టి. మీరు కూడా ఒకసారి మన తెలుగింటి రుచులు గురించి వినండి.!

missile-man-apj-abdul-kalam.title: Dr. Abdul Kalam
missile-man-apj-abdul-kalam.description: Bhartache Missile Man- Dr. Abdul kalam, ya uttung vyaktimatva vishayi bolave tewdhe kamich ahe. Sampurna Jagat Deshachi maan abhimanane unchavnare, Vidnyan kshetrat atulniya kamgiri karnare, Deshacha Yuva pidhila ek nave Vision denare Bharat Ratna Dr. Kalam pratyek deshvasiyacha abhiman ahet. Aikuya, tyanchi Prernadayi jeevan gatha...

hold-me-until-forever.title: Hold Me Until Forever
hold-me-until-forever.description: Ella Clark has been in love with Alex Grayson forever. She’s tired of being invisible—or worse, being treated like his kid sister. If she can just get him to drop his iron-fisted control for two seconds she’ll prove she knows exactly how to blow his mind.  Alex has been fighting his attraction to Ella since her should-have-been-innocent sweet-sixteen kiss burned down his world. He's damaged and there's no way he'll ever drag her into his screwed-up life. But then she offers him something he's always craved—steamy no-strings-attached sex inside his exclusive BDSM club where she'll be safe from the darkness that haunts him.  But there's nothing safe about being with Ella, and the more she gives the harder it is to let her go. If he stays, he risks everything, but how can he walk away from the only woman he's ever needed?

dragonfly.title: Dragonfly
dragonfly.description: Ek secret service officer, Amar Verma ki zindagi tab ulat-pulat ho jaati hai jab uski ex-girlfriend Mandira ka achanak gayab hona ban jaata hai ek junoon. Mandira ko dhundhte hue Amar ko milti hai ek anjaan ladki jo Mandira ka naam use kar rahi hai. Mandira ka ye raaz Amar ko le jaata hai India mein ghuse hue Chinese spies ke ek khaufnaak jaal tak. Desh ki security khatre mein hai, aur Amar ka samna hota hai ek aise mastermind se, jiska code name hai ‘Dragonfly’. Kaun hai ye 'Dragonfly'? Aakhir kya hai Mandira ka raaz? Kya Amar pata laga payega aur jeet payega is jaanlewa khel me? Janne ke liye suniye, 'Dragonfly'.

stop-over-thinking.title: Stop Over Thinking!
stop-over-thinking.description: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾಪಾಡೋದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಟೈಮಲ್ಲೂ ನಮ್ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಒಂದೇ ಥರ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳೋಕೆ ಬರಲ್ಲ. ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಖುಷಿಯಾಗಿರುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಇನ್ನೂ ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಾಪಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಜಾರು. ಯಾವ್ದೋ ಒಂದು ವಿಚಾರ ತಲೆಗೆ ಹಚ್ಕೊಂಡು ಅದ್ರ ಬಗ್ಗೆನೇ ಆಲೋಚನೆ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ತಲೆ ಕೆಡಿಸ್ಕೊಳ್ತೀವಿ. ಆದ್ರೆ, ಈ ರೀತಿ ಚಿಂತೆಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿದರೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಹಾಳಾಗೋದು ನಮ್ಮದೇ. ನಾವು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾದಷ್ಟು ಇದರಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರಬೇಕು ಹೇಗೆ ಅನ್ನೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಉತ್ತರವೇ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ.

digital-attacks.title: Digital Attacks
digital-attacks.description: Mitrano, Aajcha ya Digital world madhe anek mahtvache vyavhar apan Online kart asto. Technology ne te kam agadi soppa kela ahe.  Pan Technology jitaki faydyachi tikich ti dhokyak. Alikade Digital attacks, Hacking, Cyber fraud, ATM fraud,ase prakar khup vadhle ahet. Ya frauds pasun kasa savadh rahycha he janun ghenyasathi aika, ha khas show.

নীলাঞ্জনার-নীল-নকশা-.description: Nilanjanar Neel Naksha holo asim sahoshi Nilajanar dusahoshik kormokander golpo. Kivabe ekar haate Nilanjana ekti kuchakroke police er kache dhoriye dilo jante hole shunun ei Thriller audio story ti.

manifest-money.title: Manifest Money
manifest-money.description: Panatha attract panra sakthi namma kitta iruku. Eppadi nu neenga kekkalam. Adhukkana answer indha audio book la iruku. So miss pannama full ah kelunga.

apghati-bhet.title: Apghati Bhet
apghati-bhet.description: Jump into a world of diverse tales with Kuku FM's Short Stories. Perfect for listeners on the go our short stories offer quick escapes into fictional worlds. From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

highway-raja.title: Highway Raja
highway-raja.description:
Shreedhar is just a dusty highway mechanic—or so everyone believes. When he marries a fleeing mother to save her from a ruthless moneylender, he becomes the target of a powerful builder cartel.

But when they threaten the little girl he has sworn to protect, Shreedhar unleashes the hidden power of his billionaire family’s truck empire and takes the entire cartel head-on.

24x7.description: क्या हो अगर आपको किसी की आवाज़ से हो जाए प्यार? पता हो सिर्फ उनका एक नाम और सुनने को मिलें वो दिन में सिर्फ एक बार? ऐसा ही कुछ होता है लखनऊ में रहने वाली आयशा के साथ जिसे प्यार हो जाता 24*7 FM के एक RJ सरस के साथ। क्या उसका ये प्यार रेडियो की फ्रीक्वेंसी से निकल कर असल ज़िन्दगी में उतर पाएगा? जानने के लिए सुनिए 24*7|

एक-कहानी-यह-भी--लेखिका--ओमेश्वरी-नूतन.title: Ek Kahani Ye Bhi
एक-कहानी-यह-भी--लेखिका--ओमेश्वरी-नूतन.description: Ulhaas se bhari Suhana Mausam mei Kante ki Khubne ne Namit ko Uska beeta hua Kaal Yaad dila diya, aur Namita apne jivan ke beete huie pal mein Gauth lagane lagi.

naxalbari.title: Naxalbari
naxalbari.description: 60 ke dashak mein Naxalbari ganv mein hui ghatna ne desh ko Naxalwaad jaisa jakhm diya , jo samay ke saath bharne ke bajaay nasoor mein badalta gaya. Ye ek apradhik ghatna ya mamuli hinsa bhar nahi thi. Is mein rajnaitik dalon ne bhi apni rotiya senkni chahi. Par kya thi wo ghatna aur kin logon ne ise badhaane mein apni bhumika ada kii? Janne ke liye sunein, "Naxalbari"

meditations-3.title: Meditations
meditations-3.description: റോമൻ ചക്രവർത്തിയായിരുന്ന മാർക്കസ് ഓറേലിയസ് എഴുതിയ Meditations എന്ന പുസ്തകം, ജീവിതത്തെ അഭിമുഖീകരിക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള പ്രായോഗികവും കാലാതീതവുമായ നിരവധി ചിന്തകൾ അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു

hridoy-kotha.title: Hridoy Kotha
hridoy-kotha.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

sannyasi-rebellion.title: Sannyasi Rebellion: Azadi Ki Pehli Ladai
sannyasi-rebellion.description: Bharat ki aazadi ki pehli ladai, jisme sannyasiyon aur fakiro ne British Raj ko challenge kiya tha. Ankahee kahaniyon aur veerta ki gathayen, jinme goonjti hai veeron ki lalkar aur Bharat ki nayi disha ka aarambh hota hai. Aaiye sunte hain ye khas peshkash.

love-psycho.title: LOVE TRAP
love-psycho.description: Thideernu oru naal kaalaila Ratha vellathula lock pannappatta avaloda hostel room la uyirukku poraadittu irukkuraa Nilaa ! Nadanthadhu Enna?, ava sucide pannikka try pannaalaa.. Illa idhu Murder raa ? vaanga therinjukalaam.. LOVE TRAP - idhu Suspense kalantha oru Thrilling 'aana Love Story.

devara-vaahanagalu.title: Devara Vaahanagalu
devara-vaahanagalu.description: ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಕರ್ತನ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಗೆ ನವಿರಾದ ಹಂಸ, ಜಗನ್ನಾಥ ವಿಷ್ಣುವಿಗೆ ಭವ್ಯ ಗರುಡ, ಜಗದೀಶ್ವರ ಮಹೇಶ್ವರನಿಗೆ ಮುಗ್ಧ ನಂದಿ, ರಕ್ಷಕಿ ದುರ್ಗೆಗೆ ಅಭಯ ಸಿಂಹ, ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯ ದೇವತೆ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿಗೆ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಗೂಬೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ದೇವಾನುದೇವತೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅವರದ್ದೇ ಆದ ವಿಶೇಷ ವಾಹನಗಳಿವೆ! ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ದೇವರಿಗೆ ವಾಹನಗಳು ಯಾಕಿವೆ? ಆ ದೈವಿಕ ವಾಹನಗಳ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಥೆಯೇನು? ಆ ಪ್ರಾಣಿ-ಪಕ್ಷಿಗಳನ್ನ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮನುಷ್ಯರು ನೋಡಿದ್ರೆ ಅದರ ಸಂಕೇತವೇನು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'ದೇವರ ವಾಹನಗಳು' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

swikruti.title: Swikruti
swikruti.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

bharat-pakistan.title: Bharat - Pakistan: Bante Bigadte Rishte
bharat-pakistan.description: 1947 mein Bharat ke partition se ek naye desh ka janm hua. Pakistan, apne astitv mein aane ke saath hi Bharat se takrav ki sthiti mein tha. Phir mamla chahe Kashmir ke atankwad ka raha ho ya Cricket ke junoon ka, Bharat aur Pakistan ke rishte aaj bhi poori tarah se sahi nahi hai. Kaise hui in rishton mein uthal-puthal ki shuruaat? Kya the karan, jiski wajah se Bharat aur Pakistan mein kabhi aman nahi ho paya? Janne ke liye sunein, Bharat-Pakistan: Bante Bigadte Rishte...

abcd-of-marketing.title: ABCD Of Marketing
abcd-of-marketing.description: “Edharchiyaa naanum en friends’um Bangalore ku ponappo” nu food vlog podradhu la arambichu naama pesuradha ellam otti kettu FB la recommendation kaatra varaikum inge ellame marketing dhan. Athoda basics ah pathi detailed ah therinjuka kelunga “ABCD of Marketing” on Kuku FM

lakshmi-devi-mahimalu.title: Lakshmi Devi Mahimalu
lakshmi-devi-mahimalu.description: Okaroju nenu lakshmi devi pranaya kalaham karanamga vidipoyam. Nenu naa ekantha mandiram lo aligi padukoni unnanu. Naa alaka thirchenduku mandiram loki vasthunte appudu kooda devi ni addukunnaru. Appudu aame koodaa mimmalni shapinchindi. Munula shapam, lakshmi devi shapam phalichi theeralsinde.. thappadu annadu.

married-the-rejected-king.title: Married The Rejected King
married-the-rejected-king.description: Betrayed on his wedding day by his gold-digging girlfriend for playboy Laksh, gifted coder Neeraj enters a contract marriage with powerful CEO Khushi Malhotra. Unbeknownst to everyone, Neeraj is secretly Devraj Roy Chowdhury—the missing billionaire heir to India's grandest empire, set to return and strip his enemies of everything. As corporate warfare, hidden heritage, and high-stakes reveals ignite, Neeraj reclaims his crown to exact ultimate retribution

avtaar-1.title: Avtaar
avtaar-1.description: Moksh, jiski aag aur bijli ki shaktiyan sena ko pal bhar mein khatam kar sakti hain, 20 saal se ek avtaar ki khoj mein hai jo andhere ki kaali shaktiyon ka saamna karega. Use 4 jawan bacche mile hain, jo  avataar ho sakte hain, lekin asli avataar kaun hai, ye use bhi nahi pata. Kya Moksh avtaar ka pata laga payegi aur wo sath milakr Tamas ki kaali shaktiyon ko hara payenge? Janane ke liye suniye Kuku FM.

Advanced-Astrology-Show--जानिए-अपना-राशि.title: Advanced Astrology Show : जानिए अपना राशिफल रोज़ाना
Advanced-Astrology-Show--जानिए-अपना-राशि.description: Qismat ke sitare hi sabka bhavishya tay karte hain, Phir vo Ambani hon ya Adani! Kya aap bhavishya ko behtar banane ke liye har roz raashifal jaankar apne din ki shuruaat karte hain? Agar nahi to aaj se hi shuru karein sunna ye daily show jo har subah 8 baje aap tak pahunchaayega aapki raashi ka haal.

sin-slayer.title: Sin Slayer
sin-slayer.description: Left for dead after failing his family’s sea-magic awakening, a younger son uses a magical brass astrolabe and forbidden tide-lightning to seize control of their trading fleet before his cruel elder brother sells it to their colonial solar conquerors.

ahilyabai-holkar-1.title: Ahilyabai Holkar
ahilyabai-holkar-1.description:
Ahilyabai Holkar, itihas ka ek aisa naam jisne mahilaon ke liye ek aisa darja banaya, feminism ki ek aesi paribhasha likhi, jo aaj bhi mahilaon ke liye ek adarsh ke roop mein kayam hai.
Issi veerangna ke jeevan ki kuch aise hi ahem kisson ko le kar aye hai hum, jo apko apke jeevan ke har kathin samay me himmat ke sath sath khud par bharosha karne mein bhi madad karenge.

adventures-of-stoob-a-difficult-stage-1.title: Adventures of Stoob: A Difficult Stage
adventures-of-stoob-a-difficult-stage-1.description: Step into a world of fun and learning with Kuku FM's children's stories. Our audiobooks are full of adventures and lessons about friendship courage and curiosity. They're perfect for young listeners making learning exciting and storytelling a joy. Listen now Kuku FM for stories that spark imagination and teach important values in a simple enjoyable way.

बिन-फेरे-हम-तेरे--लेखिका--विद्या-शर्मा.title: Bin Phere Hum Tere
बिन-फेरे-हम-तेरे--लेखिका--विद्या-शर्मा.description:
प्रभात के नीरस जीवन में सीमा सावन की फुहार और हरियाली लेकर आती है। एक आदर्श प्रेमिका बनकर प्रभास की बिखरी जिंदगी को संवारती है। लेकिन डॉक्‍टर समीर दोनों के प्‍यार का दुश्‍मन बनकर आता है। सीमा न चाहते हुए भी समीर की हर बात को स्‍वीकार करती है और प्रभात के जीवन से दूर चली जाती है। लेकिन प्रभात सीमा को कभी भुला नहीं पाता है। और सालों बाद सीमा और उसकी बेटी सिया से प्रभात की मुलाकात होती है। प्रभात अपने प्‍यार को स्‍वीकार करता है लेकिन क्‍या वो सिया को भी अपनाता है??? जानने के लिए सुनें एक अच्‍छी और सच्‍ची लव स्‍टोरी बिन फेरे हम तेरे...
Author : Vidhya Sharma
Voiceover Artist : Ruby Pareek

जोकर--लेखक--शैलेश-सिंह-शैल.title: जोकर
जोकर--लेखक--शैलेश-सिंह-शैल.description: Ek patni Puriwaala Seher ke sabse Amir Shaksh Chaudhari sahab ki beti ko Kidnap kar lete hei. Unkhai pohach mantri taak tak hei aur ghar mei kadi suraksha bhi teenat hoti hei, fir bhi yaha sab ho jaata hei. Kidnapper bachi ko koi nuksaan nahi pochate hei aur waha uska dost bhi ban jaate hei. Lekin kidnapping kyo hui hei yaha koi nahi Janta?

samaja-shastragneya-tippanige.title: Samaja Shastragneya Tippanige
samaja-shastragneya-tippanige.description:
"ವೈದೇಹಿ ಕಥೆಗ... 
...ತಿರುವು ಕೌತುಕಗಳ ಕಥೆ ಕಟ್ಟುವ ಚಪಲವಿಲ್ಲ.. 
...ಬೀದಿ ಓಣಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮನೆ ಜಗುಲಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮದುವೆ .. 
 ಚಪ್ಪರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ... 
ತೀರ.. ನಿತ್ಯದ ಬದುಕಿನ... ತೊಡಕಿನ ಅವಸ್ಥೆಗ..
 ಹಸಿ ಮರುಕಗಳಿಲ್ಲದ... ದಿಟ್ಟ ನೆಟ್ಟ ನೋಟ... 
ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಎಂಬ ಭಿನ್ನತೆ ಮಸುಳಿಸಿ.. 
ಈ ಜನರೆಲ್ಲ... ಪ್ರಜಾಪ್ರಭುತ್ವ.. ಭರವಸೆಯ.."

பொய்மான்-கரடு-1.title: பொய்மான் கரடு
பொய்மான்-கரடு-1.description: கதாநாயகன் செங்கோடன் ஐந்து ஏக்கர் காட்டுக்கு ராஜா, அநாதை, கருமி. கதாநாயகி செம்பவளவல்லி அவன் உள்ளத்தைக் கொள்ளை கொண்டவள். இவர்களுக்கு இடையில் குமாரி பங்கஜா என்னும் மாயமான் வர, அதைத் துரத்திக் கொண்டு ஓடுகிறான் செங்கோடன். பிறகு, பங்கஜாவின் கூட்டாளிகளின் திட்டத்தை முறியடிக்கப் போய் கொலைகாரனாகிறான். குமாரி பங்கஜாவின் கூட்டாளிகள் யார்? அவர்களின் திட்டம் என்ன? செங்கோடன் சேர்த்து வைத்த புதையல் என்ன ஆனது? செங்கோடன் கொலை வழக்கிலிருந்து விடுபட்டானா?

5-things-that-make-you-age-faster.title: 5 Things That Make You Age Faster
5-things-that-make-you-age-faster.description: Aapki roz ki aadatein aapko budha bana rahi hain? In 5 galtiyon ko sudhare aur Young bane rahe!

manusmriti-2.title: Manusmriti :2
manusmriti-2.description: Mrityu ke baad Shareer Ka Kya karna chahiye? Pind daan kaise karna chahiye? Mahilaon Ka sammaan kyu zaroori hai? Agar janana hai in jaise kai sawalon ke jawab to abhi suniye Manusmriti ka ye khas show.
