wings-of-fire-an-autobiography-of-abdul-.description:
|Key Highlights - His Childhood, Failures & Inventions|
A journey from humble beginnings to India's presidency, 'Wings of Fire"



Link - https://kukufm.com/show/ramanujan-a-genius-beyond-boundaries?utm_source=upsell

walden.title: Walden
walden.description: Kya Aapne kabhi socha hai ek Insan ke liye sabse jyada zaroori kya hai? Uski internal happiness jo basic needs se poori ki ja sakti hai jaise pet bharne ke liye khana, Rehne ke liye Ghar, Pehnne ke liye Kapde aur kuch paise Jo humein Nature se asaani se mil sakta hai lekin aaj hum Paise ke peeche bhaag rahe hain aur apni peace kho chuke hain. Is AudioBook mein Author apne Philosophical style mein Life ka purpose batate hai aur Nature ke alag alag rang mein jeena sikhate hain.

damroowala.title: Damroowala
damroowala.description:
डमरू विनाश और विंध्वस का प्रतीक है. भगवान शंकर को जब सृष्टि की रचना करनी होती है या विनाश करना होता है, वो डमरू बजाते हैं. वो कहते हैं अब सारी कमान मेरे हाथ में है. डमरूवाले के हाथ में! पहले भी बता चुका हूँ, 'सारा खेल भरा है मुझमें' ! मौत का वो सारा खेल जिससे अब तुम्हें रु-ब-रु होना है. तो दोस्तों बिसात बिछ चुकी है, ठीक वैसी ही बिसात जैसी शतरंज के खेल में बिछती है. मैं अपनी चाल चलूँगा और तुम्हें अपनी चाल चलनी है! 
मगर कौन है असली "डमरू वाला"? जानिए वेद प्रकाश शर्मा के इस थ्रिलिंग उपन्यास में! ऑडियो में ये उपन्यास किसी फ़िल्म के चित्रण जैसा है, जहाँ दर्शक की आँखें ठहरी होती हैं !

why-banking-system-exists-history-of-ban.title: Why Banking System Exists - History Of Banks
why-banking-system-exists-history-of-ban.description: World’s First Bank ah start pannadhu yaaru theriyuma? Banks illama oru country seyal padave mudiyadha? Illuminati’kum Banks’kum oru secret connection nu theriyuma? Indha kelvigal ku badhil therinjuka kelunga “Why Banking System exist” on Kuku FM

journey-of-independence.title: JOURNEY OF INDEPENDENCE
journey-of-independence.description: ವಿಶ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಕಾರದ ಪಾಠ ಹೇಳಿಕೊಟ್ಟ ಭವ್ಯ ಭಾರತ ನಮ್ಮದು. ಇಂಥ ದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇವಲ ಸಾಂಬಾರು ಪದಾರ್ಥಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಬಂದವ್ರು, ನಂತರ ಇಡೀ ಭಾರತವನ್ನ ತನ್ನ ಕಪಿಮುಷ್ಠಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಧಿಸಿಟ್ರು ಬ್ರಿಟೀಷರು. ಆದ್ರೆ ತಾಯ್ನೆಲವನ್ನ ದಾಸ್ಯಮುಕ್ತಗೊಳಿಸ್ಬೇಕು ಅಂತಾ ಹೋರಾಟ ಮಾಡಿ, ತಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಾಣತ್ಯಾಗ ಮಾಡಿದವ್ರು ಲೆಕ್ಕವಿಲ್ಲದಷ್ಟು ಮಂದಿ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಮುನ್ನುಡಿ ಬರೆದ ಘಟನೆಗಳು ಯಾವುವು? ದೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ ಕೆಚ್ಚದೆಯ ಕಲಿಗಳು ಯಾರ್ಯಾರು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'JOURNEY OF INDEPENDENCE' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್.. ನಿಮ್ಮ KukuFMನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ..!

sindoor-ya-sauda.title: Sindoor Ya Sauda
sindoor-ya-sauda.description: To save her little sister Shreya, struggling weaver Radha marries feared silk king Devraj Kashyap—the man whose syndicate she blames for her father’s murder. As their uneasy marriage turns into love, cartel queen Gayatri Devi threatens to destroy them both. Can Radha trust Devraj with her heart while fighting to avenge her father?

ghost-hunter-1.title: Ghost hunter
ghost-hunter-1.description: அமானுஷ்யங்கள் , அப்படினு சொன்ன யாருக்குத்தான் அத பத்தி தெரிஞ்சிக்கணும்ன்ற ஆர்வம் இருக்காது. இந்த ஒலி புத்தகம் பேய்களை தேடிய ஒரு பயணம்னு சொன்ன இத கடைசி வரை கேக்காம இருக்க முடியாது.

kedarnath-yatra.title: Kedarnath Yatra
kedarnath-yatra.description: కేదార్ నాథ్ ఆలయాన్ని ఎవరు నిర్మించారు? మంచు కొండల్లో ఇప్పటికీ చెక్కుచెదరకుండా ఆలయం ఎలా ఉంది? శివుని మహిమలు వినండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో.

indias-five-year-plans.title: India’s Five Year Plans
indias-five-year-plans.description: India mein Azadi ke baad Government ke samne bahut sare challenges the jaise Gareebi, Berojgari, Anpadhta, Rehne ke liye ghar, Food aur bhi bahut kuch, Inhe suljhane ke liye Planning Commission ke andar Five Year Plans banaye gaye jisne India ki Economy ko grow karane mein bahut help kiya. Is Audio Series ke Zariye hum un sare Five Year Plans ke bare mein baat karenge jo abhi tak ban chuke hai, sath hi sath unka kya result hua aur Indian economy mein changes aaye detail mein janenge.

Idandi-MahaBharatam-ఇదండీ-మహాభారతం.title: ఇదండీ మహాభారతం
Idandi-MahaBharatam-ఇదండీ-మహాభారతం.description: ఇదండీ మహాభారతం, మన మూలం, మన ముందు తరం వేసిన బాట, ఇప్పుడు రంగనాయకమ్మ రచనలో కొత్త కోణంలో వినండి, మళ్ళీ ఆ మహా కథలు నెమరు వేసుకోవండి. మొత్తం పద్దెనిమిది పర్వాలు, ఒక కొత్త దృక్పథంలో మళ్లీ మీ ముందుకు తీసుకుని వస్తుంది మీ KUKUFM!

mamaearth-profitable-business-of-skincar.title: Mamaearth: Profitable Business of Skincare Products
mamaearth-profitable-business-of-skincar.description: ನೀವು ದಿನನಿತ್ಯ ಬಳಸೋ ಸ್ಕಿನ್‌-ಕೇರ್‌ ಪ್ರಾಡಕ್ಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕೆಮಿಕಲ್ಸ್‌ ಇರುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತಾ ನಿಮಗ್ ಗೊತ್ತಾ? ಅಮೋನಿಯವನ್ನ ಬಳಸಿ ತಯಾರಿಸೋ ಶಾಂಪೂಗಳು, ಪ್ಯಾರಾಬೆನ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಸೋಡಿಯಂಗಳ ಮಿಶ್ರಣವಾಗಿರೋ ಸೋಪ್‌ಗಳು - ಹೀಗೆ ನೀವು ಬಳಸೋ ಸ್ಕಿನ್‌ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಪ್ರಾಡಕ್ಟ್‌ಗಳು ಚರ್ಮದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾನಿಯುಂಟು ಮಾಡ್ತವೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಕೆಮಿಕಲ್ಸ್‌ನ ಬಳಸದೇ ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಪದಾರ್ಥಗಳನ್ನ ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾದ ಸ್ಕಿನ್‌-ಕೇರ್‌ ಪ್ರಾಡಕ್ಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನ ತಯಾರಿಸಬಹುದು ಅಂತ "Mamaearth" ಕಂಪನಿಯವರು ನಿರೂಪಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಮನೆಯಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದ ಕಂಪನಿಯೊಂದು, ಹೆವಿ ಕಾಂಪಿಟೇಷನ್‌ ಇರೋ ಮಾರ್ಕೆಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಬೃಹದಾಕಾರವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದು ಸಕ್ಸಸ್‌ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಾಫಿಟ್‌ ಅನ್ನ ಸಾಧಿಸಿತು ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಕುರಿತಾದ ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿದಾಯಕ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್‌ "Mamaearth: Profitable Business of Skincare Products" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

kanneerina-hole.title: Kanneerina Hole
kanneerina-hole.description: 'ಕಣ್ಣೀರಿನ ಹೊಳೆ' ಗ್ಯಾರಿ ಮಾಸ್ರಿಯಾ ಅವರ ಕೃತಿಯು ನೋವು, ಆಘಾತ, ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೀತಿ-ನಂಬಿಕೆಯ ಕಥೆ. ಜೀವನದ ಸಂಕಷ್ಟಗಳಿಂದ ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪಾತ್ರಗಳು, ತಮ್ಮ ಕಣ್ಣೀರು ಮತ್ತು ಕಷ್ಟಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೊಸ ದಾರಿ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ಷಣವೂ ಓದುಗರ ಹೃದಯವನ್ನು ತಾಕುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಳಿಸು ತರುತ್ತದೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ನೋವು ಮತ್ತು ಹೋರಾಟಗಳ ನಡುವೆಯೂ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನದಿಂದ ನೋಡಲು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಜ್ಞಾವಂತರಾಗಲು ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಕಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಮಾನವೀಯತೆಯ ಆಳ ಮತ್ತು ನಂಬಿಕೆಯ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುವ ಹೃದಯಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿ ಕೃತಿ. ಕಠಿಣ ಸಮಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಧೈರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ಓದುಗರಿಗೆ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನೂ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಂತಿಯನ್ನೂ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

swami-mattu-snehitaru.title: Swami Matthu Snehitharu
swami-mattu-snehitaru.description: ‘ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರು’ ಮಾಲ್ಗುಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುವ ಕಥಾಗುಚ್ಛ. ಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಹತ್ತು ವರ್ಷದ ಹುಡುಗ. ಜೀವನ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಖಡಕ್ ಅಪ್ಪನ ಬೈಗುಳ, ಮುಗ್ಧೆ ಅಮ್ಮನ ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಶಾಲೆಯ ಹೋಂವರ್ಕ್ ತಲೆಬಿಸಿ, ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಜೊತೆಗಿನ ತರ್ಲೆ ತುಂಟಾಟಗಳೇ ಇದರ ಕಥಾಹಂದರ. ಪ್ರಖ್ಯಾತ ಲೇಖಕ ‘ಆರ್.ಕೆ. ನಾರಾಯಣ್’ ಬರೆದಿರುವ ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

ഒടിഞ്ഞ-ചിറകുകള്‍-1.title: ഒടിഞ്ഞ ചിറകുകള്‍
ഒടിഞ്ഞ-ചിറകുകള്‍-1.description: ലോകത്തിലെ തന്നെ ഏറ്റവും മികച്ച പ്രണയകാവ്യങ്ങളില്‍ ഒന്ന്. ഖലീല്‍ ജിബ്രാന്റെ വിശ്വവിഖ്യാതമായ  അറേബ്യന്‍ നോവല്‍. ഉപാധികളില്ലാത്ത പ്രണയത്തിന്റെ നിത്യ സ്മാരകം പോലെ നിലകൊളളുന്ന സെല്‍മാ കെരാമി എന്ന കാമുകിയും അവളുടെ അജ്ഞാത കാമുകനും. ജീവിതത്തില്‍ ഒരിക്കലെങ്കിലും പ്രണയിച്ചവരില്‍ ഈ കൃതി അവാച്യമായ അനുഭവം നിറയ്ക്കും. പ്രണയാതുര മനസ്സുകള്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാന്‍ കൊതിക്കുന്ന  കവിത പോലെ ഹൃദ്യമായ രചന.

chennai-cricket-team.title: Chennai Cricket Team
chennai-cricket-team.description: Tamilnadu la irukka Cricket fans ellarukkume emotionally connect aana oru vishayam Indian Twenty Twenty league la viladra Chennai Franchise team. Intha team oda legacy, downfall, Comeback ellathayum oru feel good Audio Show va ketka neenga ready aah makkale!

sakaratmak-vicharanche-samarthya.title: Sakaratmak Vicharanche Samarthya
sakaratmak-vicharanche-samarthya.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

sreesanth-the-controversial-cricketer.title: Sreesanth : The Controversial Cricketer
sreesanth-the-controversial-cricketer.description: Okappudu Indian Cricket Team lo pedda perunna Srisanth Ippudu tana game kante Controversies Ekkuva peru techukunnadu. Ayithe Srisanth Journey Ela sagindi, Enduku Famous Controversy King ayyadu Ane vishayalanu Ee Audio book lo Vinandi

हत्यारा-प्रेम---लेखक--मनीष-पांडेय-रूद्र.title: हत्यारा प्रेम
हत्यारा-प्रेम---लेखक--मनीष-पांडेय-रूद्र.description: Pyar me thukrae jane par Rajeev atmahatya kar leta hai. Poora parivar toot jata hai. Lekin koun hai jo Rajeev ka badla leta hai aur shahar ki har Shreya naam ki ladki ka buri tarah katl karta hai?

billion-dollar-wife.title: Billion Dollar Wife
billion-dollar-wife.description: कियारा भंसाली, NICDA की गुप्त चेयरपर्सन, अपने ताकतवर परिवार की विरासत से दूर रहने के लिए एक साधारण रिसेप्शनिस्ट बनकर रहती है। जब उसका मंगेतर उसे एक राजनेता की बेटी के लिए सबके सामने अपमानित कर छोड़ देता है, तो ईमानदार कारोबारी तेज जसिंग उसकी इज़्ज़त बचाने के लिए उससे शादी कर लेता है। तेज के क्रूर परिवार के बीच रहते हुए कियारा अपनी असली ताकत का इस्तेमाल कर उनके अवैध ज़मीन सौदों का पर्दाफाश करती है और तेज का कारोबार बचाती है—लेकिन एक सार्वजनिक ऑडिट उसकी असली पहचान उजागर करने वाला है।

sahitya-ane-cinema.title: Sahitya Ane Cinema
sahitya-ane-cinema.description: Dive into the world of Non-Fiction with Kuku FM where real stories and groundbreaking ideas come to life. Our collection spans intriguing topics from history and science to culture and personal development. Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

khooni-1.title: Khooni
khooni-1.description: కవిరాజు త్రిపురనేని రచించిన "ఖూని" — పురోహితవర్గం మరియు కోటరీల కుతంత్రాలను ధైర్యంగా ఎదిరించిన రాజు కథ. మతం పేరుతో జరిగే అకృత్యాలను, రాజకీయ కుట్రలను నిర్భయంగా విశ్లేషించిన శక్తివంతమైన రచన. చరిత్ర మరియు రాజనీతి ప్రేమికులకు ఒక అద్భుతమైన అనుభవం!

ennaval-nee-oruthiye-season-2-1.title: Ennaval nee oruthiye season 2
ennaval-nee-oruthiye-season-2-1.description:
லிசனர்ஸ் கேட்டுகிட்ட மாதிரியே இப்போ மெஹருநிஷா அன்ட் கபிலோட வாய்ஸ்ல, கேளுங்க என்னவளே நீ ஒருத்தியே சீசன் 2.                                                                                                                                               
அஸ்வினி கர்ப்பமா ஆனதும், விக்ரம் ரொம்ப ஹேப்பியா அவள பார்த்துப்பான்னு கனவு காணுறா அஸ்வினி. ஆனா வீடில்லாம கடினமான சூழ்நிலையில மாட்டி இருக்க தன் சகோதரி இந்துவ நினைச்சு ரொம்ப பீல் பண்ணுறா... அவளுக்கு  ஹெல்ப் பண்ண முடிவு பண்ண அஸ்வினி, விக்ரமோட சம்மதத்தோட  தன்னோட சொத்துகளையும் நிறுவனத்தையும் இந்து பேருக்கு மாத்த டிசைட் பண்ணுறா... ஆனா இந்து அஸ்வினியோட நோக்கத்த தப்பா புரிஞ்சுக்கிட்டு அவளுக்கு அகைன்ஸ்ட்டா கேஸ் கொடுக்குறா....

atheism-world-without-gods.title: Atheism: World Without Gods
atheism-world-without-gods.description: Daivangal Illatha  Lokam Engane Aayirikkum? Nireeshwara Vaadathinu Matha Vishwaasangalolam Pazhakkamundu. Athinte Athishayippikkunna Charithravum Chinthakalum Vishakalam Cheyyunnu Innathey Kuku Bytesil.

मोहरा--ऐ-मर्डर-मिस्ट्री--लेखक--विकास-सीए.title: मोहरा - ऐ मर्डर मिस्ट्री
मोहरा--ऐ-मर्डर-मिस्ट्री--लेखक--विकास-सीए.description: एक व्‍यक्ति निराशा से भरा अपने कमरे में आत्‍महत्‍या करने की कोशिश में फंदे से लटकने ही वाला था कि तभी उसके फोन की घंटी बजी….फोन कट करते ही उस इंसान के चेहरे पर मुस्‍कान आ गई। और आत्‍महत्‍या का विचार त्‍याग दिया। फोन करनेवाले ने उसे एक काम सौंपा था...कौन सा काम था? कौन था वह व्‍यक्ति जिसने निराशा से आशा की दुनिया में उस इंसान को वापस ले आया? सस्‍पेंस और थ्रीलर से भरी कहानी मोहरा ए मर्डर मिस्‍ट्री सुनें केवल कुकू एफएम पर।

kannadave-sathya.title: Kannadave Sathya
kannadave-sathya.description: ನಮ್ಮ ಕನ್ನಡಾಂಬೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯನ ಕಣ್ಣಿನಿಂದ ತನ್ನ ಕನ್ನಡನಾಡನ್ನು ನೋಡಲೇಬೇಕಿತ್ತು. ತನ್ನದೇ ನೆಲದಲ್ಲಿ, ತನ್ನದೇ ಕನ್ನಡದ ಕಂದಮ್ಮಗಳೆದುರು, ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯಳಾಗಿ ತನ್ನದೊಂದು ಪುಟ್ಟ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತು ಹೊರಡುವ ಭುವನೇಶ್ವರಿಯ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡಿದ್ದೇನು? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ, ಕನ್ನಡಾಂಬೆ ಭುವನೇಶ್ವರಿಯ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಅಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಪಯಣದ ಸಾಹಸಗಾಥೆ! ಕೇಳಿ "ಕನ್ನಡವೇ ಸತ್ಯ" ದ್ವನಿ ಸರಣಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

the-mastery-of-destiny-2.description:

gaadegala-kathakosha-bhaaga-2.title: Gaadegala Kathakosha Bhaaga 2
gaadegala-kathakosha-bhaaga-2.description: ಗಾದೆಗಳು ಮನರಂಜನಾಕಾರಿ ಕತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುತ್ತವೆ, ಹಾಸ್ಯ ಹಾಗೂ ವಿಡಂಬನೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡ ಆ ಕತೆಗಳ ಅಂತರಾಳದ ಆಶಯ ಒಂದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ನೀತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುವುದಾಗಿದೆ.

the-rakshasa-detective.title: The Rakshasa Detective
the-rakshasa-detective.description: When a series of ritualistic murders shakes India, a brilliant detective hiding the soul of a Rakshasa must hunt a secret cult before an ancient evil rises—while battling the monster within himself.

డార్లింగ్-.title: డార్లింగ్
డార్లింగ్-.description: విభిన్న నేపథ్యాలకు చెందిన ఇద్దరు వ్యక్తుల మధ్య ప్రేమ ఎలా ఉంటుంది ? వారి సంబంధం ఎలాంటి సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొన్నదో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా "డార్లింగ్" అనే ఆడియో వినండి.

the-richest-man-in-babylon-1.title: The Richest Man in Babylon
the-richest-man-in-babylon-1.description: The Richest Man In Babylon gives common-sense financial advice which you can apply today, told through tales and parables from the times of ancient Babylon.

how-to-breastfeed-your-baby-2.title: How To Breastfeed Your Baby
how-to-breastfeed-your-baby-2.description: Pillala abhivrudhi ki thalli paalu chaala avasaram. mana deshamlo thalli paalaki chaala pramukyatha kuda undhi, anthe kakunda WHO kuda idhe utammamu ani chebuthundi. kani chaala mandhiki pillalaki Breast feeding cheyyadam valla kalige labhala gurinchi telidu. Anduke memu meekosam ee audio book tesukuvachamu.

thamizhar-porneri.title: Thamizhar Porneri
thamizhar-porneri.description: Tamizhar Panbaadu pathina pala books namma Kuku FM App la iruku. Intha book ungaluku Tamilargaloda Porneri ya pathi theliva eduthu solra puthagam. Vaanga Pandaya thamilargal pathi theliva therinjukalaam.

nadunisi-naayagi.title: Nadunisi Naayagi
nadunisi-naayagi.description: A disillusioned cop's fabricated murder cases become terrifyingly real, uncovering his wife as a methodical killer reliving her mother's deadly legacy, he’s trapped between love and psychopath

sampradayik-dangen-aur-bhartiya-police.title: Sampradayik Dange Aur Bharatiya Police
sampradayik-dangen-aur-bhartiya-police.description: Kyu hote hain "Dange" aur kyu bat jaati hai humari socity?  Dango mein kya Hota hai Police Ka role? aapko te sab sab batane aur samjhane ja raha hai KUKU Fm  is Audiobook " Sampradayik Dange Aur Bharatiya Police" mein.

how-to-handle-stress-and-pressure.title: How to Handle Stress and Pressure?
how-to-handle-stress-and-pressure.description: Enthanu maanasika pirimurukkam? Maanasika pirimurukkavum aarogya preshnangalum enthokke? Engane manassika pirimurukka ozhivakam? Eppol chikitza venam? Rogamukthi sadhyamano? Ariyam ee showiloode!

mind-and-memory-power.title: Manacha Shaktine Swathala Badla
mind-and-memory-power.description: Manachi Takad mhanje apli 'Mind Power' hi aplya 'Life' var, aplya 'Personality' var khup motha prabhav padat aste. Pan he Man mhanje nemaka kay, te aplyasathi kasa kam karta, Manachi Shakti kashi vadhvaychi ani ticha madatine Swatahala kase badlayche, tasehc aple ayushya adhik changle kase karyche, ya prashanchi uttra tumhala miltil- Dr. Sachin Deshmukh likhit- 'Manacha Shaktine Swathala ghadva' ya khas Audio book dware, Kuku FM var.

shrapit-ishq.title: Shrapit Ishq
shrapit-ishq.description: Darjeeling ke ek hospital mein, Parth naam ka ek aadmi maut ke baad zinda ho uthta hai, uske honton par sirf ek naam hai, Vedika. Lekin Parth apne jeevan ke pichhle do saal ki yaadon se bilkul anjaan hai. Jab Vedika uske samne aati hai, toh dono ke beech ek ajeeb si kashmakash shuru hoti hai, pyaar, dard, aur dar ka rishta. Unke aaspaas ek tantrik shraap Nishachi ki andekhi taaqat ghoom rahi hai, jo sirf unka milna nahi balki unka jeena bhi mushkil kar rahi hai. Kya Parth apni khoyi hui yaadon ka raaz jaan payega? Aur kya Vedika is shrapit ishq se apne pyaar ko bacha payegi?

paise-ka-psychology.title: Paise Ka Psychology
paise-ka-psychology.description: Why do we make bad financial decisions even when we know better? Paise Ki Psychology explores the hidden forces behind how we spend, save, invest and think about money. Discover how advertising exploits insecurity, why fear can freeze financial decisions, how status drives spending, how childhood shapes our money habits, and why patience and compounding matter. Because building wealth may begin not with earning more—but with thinking differently.

kuku-fm-ki-case-study.title: Kuku FM ki Case Study
kuku-fm-ki-case-study.description: Indian Startup Ecosystem ka ek bahut bada naam, Bharat ka largest audiobooks platform KukuFM, jisne sirf 5 saal mein 30 Lakh se zyada logon ko apne saath joda aur subscription model par education ko ghar ghar gaanv gaanv pahuncha diya. Lekin unhone aakhir aisa kiya kaise ? Aaiye jaante hein hain KukuFM ke teen founders se Lal Chand Bisu, Vikas Goyal Aur Vinod Kumar Meena aur sunte hai unke success ki journey

manthrikapoocha.title: മാന്ത്രികപ്പൂച്ച
manthrikapoocha.description: ബഷീറിന്റെ വീട്ടിൽ കുണുങ്ങിയെത്തുന്ന ഒരു പൂച്ചയുടെ കഥയാണ് മന്ത്രികപ്പൂച്ചയെന്ന ഈ ചെറു നോവൽ. അയലത്തെ വീട്ടിലും ബഷീറിന്റെ വീട്ടിലുമായ് കുണുങ്ങി നടക്കുന്ന പൂച്ചയുടെ ഹിന്ദു-ഇസ്ലാം കീഴ്വഴക്കങ്ങളേയും സ്പർശിച്ചു പോവുന്നു ഈ കഥ.

indhuja-2000.title: Indhuja 2000
indhuja-2000.description:
துரோகங்களுக்குப் பல உள்ளடுக்குகள் காணப்படும் இன்னது இது என்று பிரித்தறிவது சுலபமில்லை.


அந்தமான் தீவிக்கு அருகில் இருக்கும் ஒரு தீவில் பிளாட்டின் கிடைக்க வாய்ப்பு இருப்பதாக ஆராய்ச்சியாளர்கள் சொன்னதைக் கேட்டு கனிம வளத் துறை சேர்ந்த பதினோரு அதிகாரிகள் விமானத்தில் செல்ல, கிளம்பிய பத்து நிமிடத்திலே வெடித்துக் கடலில் மூழ்கிவிடுகிறது. கடலில் மூழ்கிய கருப்பு பெட்டியை தேடி வந்த கப்பல் தான் இந்துஜா 2000.


கிரைம் ஆபிஸர் விவேக்கிற்கு நடந்த சம்பவம் சொல்லப்பட, விபத்திற்கான காரணத்தை அறிய விசாராணையை முடுக்கிவிடும் போது தான் பர்மாவிடம் தங்கத்தை லஞ்சமாக வாங்க ஆசைப்பட்ட சிலஅதிகாரிகள் அதில் பயணம் செய்த பத்து பேரை அத்தீவிலே கொல்ல திட்டம் போட்டது தெரியவருகிறது. இந்தியாவுடன் பர்மா அந்தத் தீவை சொந்தம் கொண்டாடி மல்லுகட்டுவதால் இந்த ஏற்பாடு. இந்தத் திட்டத்திற்கு முன்பே விமானம் வெடித்ததால் வேறு ஒரு குழுவும் இதில் ஈடுபட்டிருக்கலாம் என்ற ஐயம் எழுகிறது.

love-trap-1.title: Love Trap
love-trap-1.description: ಪವರ್‌ಫುಲ್‌ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್‌ಮ್ಯಾನ್‌ ಮನೋಹರ್‌ ರೈ ಅವರ ಒಬ್ಬಳೇ ಮಗಳು ನಿಖಿತಾ. ಅಪ್ಪ ಬೆಳೆಸಿರೋ ಆಲದಮರಕ್ಕೆ ಜೋತು ಬೀಳದೇ ಸ್ವಂತದ್ದೇನಾದ್ರೂ ಸಾಧಿಸಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಪಣ ತೊಟ್ಟಿರೋ ನಿಖಿತಾ ಸಖತ್‌ ಬ್ಯೂಟಿಫುಲ್‌! ಎಂ.ಜಿ ರಸ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿರೋ ಜೆ.ಡಬ್ಲ್ಯೂ.ಮ್ಯಾರಿಯೆಟ್‌ ಇಂಟರ್‌ನ್ಯಾಷನಲ್‌ ಹೋಟೆಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ರೇಟ್‌ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್‌ ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್‌ಗೆ ಅಂತ ಬರೋ ನಿಖಿತಾ ಲೈಫ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡದೊಂದು ಶಾಕ್‌ ಕಾದಿದೆ! ತನ್ನ ತಂದೆಯಷ್ಟೇ ಪವರ್‌ಫುಲ್‌ ಆಗಿರೋ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನ ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗೋಕೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದ ನಿಖಿತಾಗೆ ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಖತ್‌ ಅವಮಾನವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಆಗಿರೋ ಅವಮಾನದಿಂದ ಹೊರಬರಬೇಕು ಅನ್ನೋವಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕೈದು ಆಗಂತುಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳಿಂದ ನಿಖಿತಾ ಕಿಡ್ನಾಪ್‌ ಆಗ್ತಾಳೆ! ನಿಖಿತಾಳನ್ನ ಕಿಡ್ನಾಪ್‌ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು ಯಾರು? ಕಿಡ್ನಾಪರ್‌ ಹಿಂದಿರೋ ಕಾಣದ ಕೈಗಳು ಯಾರದ್ದು? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ಮೈನವೀರೇಳಿಸೋ ರೋಮ್ಯಾಂಟಿಕ್‌ ಥ್ರಿಲ್ಲರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ಲವ್‌ Trap" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

why-do-we-have-fear-of-death.title: Why do we have Fear of Death
why-do-we-have-fear-of-death.description: Why do we fear death so deeply? Is it the fear of dying, or the fear of leaving life unfinished? Exploring science, psychology, philosophy, and spirituality, this journey uncovers humanity's greatest fear—and reveals how understanding death can change the way we live.

murti.title: মূর্তি | লেখক - সুরজ বিশ্বাস
murti.description: অয়ন আর আকাঙ্খার নববিবাহিত জীবন শুরু হয় ভালোবাসা দিয়ে। কিন্তু সমুদ্র থেকে মাছ ধরার জালে পাওয়া এক অদ্ভুত দেবীমূর্তি বাড়িতে নিয়ে আসার পর থেকে ওদের জীবনে অশান্তি শুরু হয়।

the-handbook-of-emergencies.title: The Handbook of Emergencies
the-handbook-of-emergencies.description: Medical emergency kabhi puch kar nahi aati. Aise situation mein ambulance bulana best choice hota hai magar 1 arab se bhi zyada aabadi wale desh mein samay par uska pahuchna kaafi mushkil hai. Aise samay mein hum kya kar sakte hai jab tak ki medical help patient tak pahunch nahi paati? Disaster management hamare school syllabus mein nahi hota magar aise situations mein kya kiya jaaye iska knowledge hona har kisi ke liye bahut zaroori hai. Aise hi kai medical situations ko handle karna sikhayega aapko ye show!

history-of-alexander-the-great.title: History of Alexander
history-of-alexander-the-great.description: Born in 356 BC, Alexander became king of Macedon at the young age of 20 and went on to conquer much of the known world before his death at 32. In this special presentation, we will dive into Alexander's rise as the king of Macedonia, his military strategies, the wars he fought, and the enduring impact of his empire. From his early education under Aristotle to his triumphs at Issus and Gaugamela, our show will reveal the triumphs and tragedies of Alexander's remarkable life. This show will take you back in time to the era of ancient Greece and the remarkable story of Alexander the Great. Join us as we explore the life and legacy of one of history's most legendary figures.

hamari-adhoori-kahani.title: Hamari Adhoori Kahani
hamari-adhoori-kahani.description: Aditya, ek successful CEO, 10 saal baad apne gaon lautta hai, bas ek letter aur kuch adhoori yaadon ke saath. Wahin uski mulaqat hoti hai Meera se, uski bachpan ki mohabbat, jo ab Arjun se mangni kar chuki hoti hai. Ek chhoti diary, ek purana paigaam aur ek pehchani si khamoshi un dono ke beech chhupi hui sachchaiyon ko dobara jaga dete hain. Arjun sab mehsoos karta hai, lekin uski muskurahat ke peeche chhupa hai ek aisa raaz jo rishton ki buniyad hila sakta hai. Jab Aditya ka sach saamne aata hai, to Meera ke paas sirf ek sawaal bach jaata hai, kya dil ke raaste sach mein zindagi ka rukh badal dete hain? Kya Meera apne faisle se kisi ek ka dil tode bina nikal paayegi?

aaj-ke-aiene-mein-rashtravaad.title: Aaj Ke Aiene Mein Rashtravaad
aaj-ke-aiene-mein-rashtravaad.description: Aap Rashtravaad se kya samajhte hain? Kya Rashtravaad ka matlab Jai Hind ke naare lagana hai? Ya phir desh ki sena ko majboot karna? Ya world ki GDP  mein bada contribution karna? Kya Rashtravaad cultural identity hai? Kya hai aaj ka Rashtravaad? Janne ke liye abhi suniye yeh audiobook, jismein sirf facts ke aadhar par baatein ki gayi hain aur rashtravad ki mystery se parda uthaya gaya hai.

ye-saali-ashiqui.title: Ye Saali Ashiqui
ye-saali-ashiqui.description: Meher, planning to marry her fiancé Samarth, has a one-night stand with a stranger, Yuvan, during her bachelorette trip. Upon returning, she discovers Samarth also cheated, so they proceed with their marriage. However, Meher becomes pregnant and suspects the child might be Yuvan’s. Yuvan re-enters their lives as a hospital investor, revealing an obsessive, stalker-like fixation on Meher.

വിചിത്രം-.title: വിചിത്രം
വിചിത്രം-.description: കല്യാണത്തിന്റെ തലേരാത്രിയാണ് കിഴക്കെ കോവിലകം തറവാട്ടിൽ നിന്നും ദേവകി തമ്പുരാട്ടിയെ കാണാതാവുന്നത്. ദുരൂഹതകൾ ഏറെ നിറഞ്ഞ ദേവകിയുടെ തിരോധാനം അന്വേഷിക്കാൻ എത്തുകയാണ് സമർത്ഥനായ ഡിറ്റക്റ്റീവ് കേളു മാരാർ. എന്നാൽ ഇത് വെറും ഒരു സാധാരണ കേസ് അല്ലെന്നു അയാൾക്ക്‌ പെട്ടെന്ന് മനസ്സിലാകുന്നു. കേൾക്കാം, തുടക്കം മുതൽ കേൾവിക്കാരെ പിടിച്ചിരുത്തുന്ന ഒരു പീരീഡ് ക്രൈം ത്രില്ലർ- വിചിത്രം!

aisi-deewangi.title: Aisi Deewangi
aisi-deewangi.description: Ayesha, a hardworking medical student and café waitress, struggles under her cruel manager, Jasmine, while carrying a ₹20 lakh education loan. Her life changes when Ranveer Chauhan, the city's arrogant billionaire heir, enters the café. After a setup leads to his shirt being ruined, Ranveer forces Ayesha to either pay ₹20 lakhs in damages or work as his personal assistant for three months.

the-cursed-kiss.title: The Cursed Kiss
the-cursed-kiss.description: Five years after her mother's mysterious death, journalist Shobha is still searching for the truth. During her investigation, she uncovers a mystery that goes beyond logic and science. She meets Akash, a mysterious young man who knows the unfinished lullaby her mother used to sing. As the truth slowly unfolds, Shobha finds herself trapped in a dangerous web of love, an ancient curse, and death. In the end, one question remains: Who is Akash—a human, or a centuries-old shadow?

romance-of-bodyguard.title: Mr. Undercover
romance-of-bodyguard.description: Vivek ko ek secret mission ke liye undercover rehna padta hai. Kai bade logon se contact banane ke chakkar me uski mulaqaat Sanaya se hoti hai or Sanaya usse shadi karne ki zid pakad leti hai. Vahin billionaire girl Divya ko Vivek underworld se bachata hai or Divya usse apna personal bodyguard banne ki zid karne lagti hai.  Ab kya karega Vivek? Kahin Sanaya or Divya se mulaqaat uske mission ke beech to nahin aa jaayegi? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Mr. Undercover.

mahasamar-7-pratyaksh-1.title: Mahasamar 7: Pratyaksh
mahasamar-7-pratyaksh-1.description: Pratyaksh brings the epic Mahabharata alive in a gripping audio retelling. As the great war of Kurukshetra unfolds, duty, loyalty, ambition and dharma collide on the battlefield. With powerful narration and dramatic storytelling, every moment feels like it is happening right before your eyes.

chiranjeevi-parashurama.title: Chiranjeevi  Parashurama
chiranjeevi-parashurama.description: Suniye Parshuram ke vaibhav ko, Ramayan ke anupam ansh  " Parshuram Lakshman Sanvad " . Jaha Parshuram ne diya dharma ka gyan, aur sajiv banaye purane itihas ko.

immortal-returnee-1.title: Immortal Returnee
immortal-returnee-1.description:
Three hundred years ago, Kai Zhang arrived in the Celestial Realm, and now stands as one of the most powerful immortals. But all is for naught when due to a divine artefact, he is betrayed by his allies and ambushed by his enemies. Transmigrated back to earth, he regains consciousness and finds only three years have passed since the moment of his transmigration and he had been in comma for all this time.
Now, having once again returned to his mortal self, along with the divine artefact he was ambushed for, Kai is stranded and wants to return to the Celestial Realm for his revenge. However, one incident thrusts him into a whole new world of mobsters and superhuman mafias!

beyond-good-and-evil-2.title: Beyond Good and Evil
beyond-good-and-evil-2.description:
Ready for a Philosophical Rollercoaster? 
Listen to Nietzsche's 'Beyond Good and Evil' for life changing தத்துவம்ஸ்!

twitter-varalaaru.title: Twitter Varalaaru
twitter-varalaaru.description: உலகின் மிகப் பெரிய தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்களில் ஒன்றான ட்விட்டரின் விறுவிறுப்பான வெற்றிக்கதை! மற்றவர்களுக்குச் சாத்தியமாகாத ஒரு வெற்றியை ட்விட்டர் பெற்றிருப்பது எப்படி? வாங்க தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம்!

good-strategy-bad-strategy-1.title: Is it a Good Strategy or a Bad Strategy?
good-strategy-bad-strategy-1.description: Kisi bhi bade target ko achieve kaise kiya jata hai? Kya sirf hard work karke hum life mein successful ban sakte hai? Lekin agar aisa hota toh kheton mein din raat mehnat karne wala har kisan ameer hota, magar aisa hai nahi. Toh aisa kya karte hain successful log? Aaiye jaante hain.

b8e065d7-6f4c-49a1-9d39-6bd35ee83bac.title: Ye Junoon Na Jaane Koi Sukoon
b8e065d7-6f4c-49a1-9d39-6bd35ee83bac.description: Ye kaalpanik kahaani hai Rishabh aur Sejal ke pyaar aur junoon ki. Sejal, jo ek transgender hai, apni sacchai ko apnane ki koshish karti hai lekin samaaj ke sakht nazariye aur Rishabh ke junoon ke beech, uska pyaar ek dardnaak mod leta hai. Aayiye, is kahani ke safar mein humare saath judiye aur suniye Rishabh aur Sejal ke pyaar ki daastan ka yeh anokha rang, keval aapke manoranjan ke liye.

खामोश-मोहब्बत---लेखिका--क्रिया-शर्मा.title: Khamosh Mohobbat
खामोश-मोहब्बत---लेखिका--क्रिया-शर्मा.description:
प्यार का एहसास ही इतना खास है, कि पतझड़ के मौसम में भी बहारों सी ठंडक देता है और गर्मी की तपन भी बारिश की बूंदों सी लगती है। कुछ ऐसा ही प्‍यार है क्रिया और पीयुष का। लेकिन इस बनते रिश्‍तों में कई बिखराव वाले पल हैं, जो दोनों के दिलों को दूर करते हैं लेकिन आखिर सच्‍ची मोहब्‍बत कामयाबी हो ही जाती है।
Voiceover Artist : Surabhi
Author : Kriya sharma

kshano-kshani.title: Kshano Kshani
kshano-kshani.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Our shows celebrate love in all its forms from the first flutter of attraction to the deep bonds that withstand the test of time. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

epfo-employees-provident-fund-organisati.title: EPFO Employees' Provident Fund Organisation : A Complete Guide
epfo-employees-provident-fund-organisati.description: ಸೇವಿಂಗ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಮುಖ್ಯ! ನಾವು ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ಹಣವನ್ನ ಸಂಪಾದನೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ, ಆದರೆ ಉಳಿಸೋದು ತುಂಬಾ ಕಮ್ಮಿ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ನಾವು ಕೆಲಸ ಬಿಟ್ಟಾಗ ಏನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು? ರಿಟೈರ್ ಆದಾಗ ಏನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು? ಕಷ್ಟ ಬಂದಾಗ ಹಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಬೇಕು? ಇದಕ್ಕಾಗಿಯೇ ಇರುವುದೇ 'EPFO Employees' Provident Fund Organisation!' ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, PF ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಏನು? PF ಖಾತೆ ತೆರೆಯುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? UAN ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನಿಮಗೆಷ್ಟು ಗೊತ್ತು? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರೂ ಕೇಳಬೇಕಾದ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ 'EPFO Employees' Provident Fund Organisation: A Complete Guide'. ಕೇಳಿ, ಸೇವಿಂಗ್ಸ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚಿಂತೆ ಬಿಡಿ!

nemmanu-nevu-gellabaliri.title: Nimmannu Neevu Gellaballiri
nemmanu-nevu-gellabaliri.description: **ಕುಕು ಎಫ್‌ಎಂ**ನಲ್ಲಿ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಯನ್ನು ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸುವುದು ರೂಪಾಂತರಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರಯಾಣವನ್ನು ಆರಂಭಿಸುವಂತೆ. ಜೀವನದ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಅಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲುಗೆಡೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಬಯಸುವವರಿಗಾಗಿ ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ, ವೃತ್ತಿ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಶಾಂತಿಯಂತಹ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ನಿದರ್ಶನಗೊಳಿಸುವ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಶೋಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿ. ನೀವು ಉತ್ಪಾದಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಲು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಲು ಅಥವಾ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಶಾಂತಿಯನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಉದ್ದೇಶಿಸಿದ್ದರೆ, ಕುಕು ಎಫ್‌ಎಂ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿಯಾದ ತತ್ವಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಫೂರ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈಗಲೇ ಕೇಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕನಸಿನ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲು ತಜ್ಞರ ಸಲಹೆಯನ್ನು ಕಿವಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಚ್ಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

kiss-of-death.title: Kiss Of Death
kiss-of-death.description: రాజమహేంద్రవరంలో ఉన్నట్టుండి ఒక సారి కొంతమంది యువకులు వరుస హత్యలకు గురవుతారు. అవన్నీ మాములు హత్యలుగా కాకుండా  ఆయా యువకులను ముక్కలుగా సంచుల్లో పడ వేసిన ఘటనలతో డిటెక్టివ్ భయంకర్ అలెర్ట్ అవుతాడు. ఈ వరుస హత్యలు ఎవరు, ఎందుకు చేస్తున్నదీ పరిశోధన మొదలు పెడతాడు. ఈ క్రమంలో రకరకాల ట్విస్టులు కధలో ఎదురై కొత్త అనుభూతిని మిగులుస్తుంది. ఊపిరి బిగబెట్టే అనేక విచిత్రమైన సన్నివేశాల సమాహారంగా ఈ కధ సాగుతోంది. అడుగడుగునా ఆసక్తిని పుట్టించే ఈ క్రైమ్ అండ్ సస్పెన్సు థ్రిల్లర్  ఊహకందని మలుపులతో, వైవిధ్యమైన టెంపోతో ఆసక్తికరంగా సాగుతోంది.

bhakt-aur-bhagwan.title: भक्त और भगवान: उद्धव गीता
bhakt-aur-bhagwan.description:
Jaaniye ek sachcha bhakt kaun hota hai aur bhagwan se uske sambandh kaise hote hain. Aur ye bhi jaaniye ki Bhagwan Krishna Uddhav ko kaise samjhate hain bhakti aur jeevan ka gehra saar.

Link- https://kukufm.com/show/%E0%A4%89%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%A7%E0%A4%B5-%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BE-%E0%A4%AC%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A7%E0%A4%A8-%E0%A4%B8%E0%A5%87-%E0%A4%AE%E0%A5%81%E0%A4%95%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%A4%E0%A4%BF?utm_source=upsell

burari-death-case.title: The Burari Death Case
burari-death-case.description: July 1st, 2018. Burari, New Delhi. A family of eleven were found dead on the first floor of their home. Seven males, three females, ages ranging from 15 to 80. The only survivor was the family's dog who was tied up on the terrace. This news immediately made the headlines and shook the entire nation. The incident was so inexplicable and harrowing that anyone who read, heard, or saw the news couldn't help but wonder what really happened. The neighbors called it a work of supernatural while the relatives considered it a case of carefully planned murder. The truth in this case, however, is stranger than fiction. Listen to the shockingly bizzare story and discover the truth behind the Burari deaths through this special show.

sangeet-mruchakatik.title: Sangeet Mruchakatik
sangeet-mruchakatik.description: Dive into the beautiful world of Lyric Poetry with Kuku FM. Our collection brings you poems that touch the heart and spark the imagination. These stories in verse are perfect for anyone who loves the rhythm of words and the pictures they paint. Listen now Kuku FM and let poetry fill your world with emotion and beauty.

अधूरी-सांस--लेखिका--पल्लवी-घोष.title: Aadhuri Saans
अधूरी-सांस--लेखिका--पल्लवी-घोष.description: Bachpan mein hi vaishali k sir se maa baap ka saaya uth gaya tha. Gair hokar bhi aavinash avasthi ka parivaar vaishali ke liye pura parivaar hai. Bachpan kab jawaani ki dahleej par kadam rakhta hai, pata hi nahi chalta. Do dil ki dhadkane kab ek ho jaati hai, kab koi apna ho jaata hai aur ek naya rishta jud jaata hai, yah ahsaah dil ko gud guda jaata hai. Rishto mein pyaar aur tyaad ki kahani hai adhuri saas. Sune keval kuku FM par.

human-actions-a-treatise-on-economics.title: Human Actions: A Treatise on Economics
human-actions-a-treatise-on-economics.description: Apne paise kaise bachaye aur badhaye? Iss show mein hum janenge ki kaise humara har din ka faisla humari jeb par asar dalta hai aur samjhenge aasan tips aur tricks jo aapko ek smart buyer banayega.

gulf-war.title: Gulf War
gulf-war.description: Iraq Naattirkum America Koottu padaikkum  Nadandha Mudhal Matrum Irandaam Valaikudaa Porgal (Gulf war I & II)  Patriya Virivaana Paarvaiyai tharugiradhu Indha Padhivu.

the-orphan-commander.title: The Orphan Commander
the-orphan-commander.description: A bullied low-caste servant at Gwalior Fort Academy unlocks a forbidden, blood-drinking copper heirloom, gaining unmatched martial power to fight arrogant Thakur heirs while hiding a monstrous hunger that would get him executed.

confident-in-any-situation.title: How To Be Confident In Any Situation
confident-in-any-situation.description: Developing your people skills and confidence is a surefire path to success and happiness. We've all envied the person across the room who seems to be able to joke around, be self-assured, and be liked by everyone. They are at ease around strangers, don't worry about being rejected, and seem to have no trouble handling challenging circumstances. Now you can as well. This special series will show you exactly how to become confident and develop better communication for better results. You will be able to get over your fear of being rejected, feel comfortable in a group, deal with challenging circumstances, get better results from conflicts, and communicate more effectively in all situations. Transform your life and become a people magnet with this remarkably uplifting show only on KukuFM.

hinduism-clarified-and-simplified.title: Hinduism - Clarified And Simplified
hinduism-clarified-and-simplified.description: In 1827, a soldier deserts the army to escape a death sentence. Faking his identity, he flees into the treacherous mountains of Afghanistan, obsessed with finding a city lost since Alexander the Great. Against all odds, he discovers the ancient empire and its buried treasure, but his triumph turns into a curse. Authorities track him down and use his past as blackmail, forcing him into a dangerous web of espionage. It is a gripping true story of survival, betrayal, and erasure.

social-media-detox-challange.title: Social Media Detox Challenge
social-media-detox-challange.description:
Social media addiction kooda Dangerous dhan thambi!
If I’m not wrong, Scientifically!
Get Ready for an Detox Detour

fall-of-bitcoin-and-cryptocurrency.description: Bitcoin ani Cryptocurrency cha fad gelya kahi varshapasun satat suru ahe. 20s-financial-planning-kase-karave.description: Apla Finance Kasa Manage karaycha Ha Prashna Saglyanchya manat Yet Asel. Tumchya Hi Manat Ha Prashna Yet Asel Tar Don't worry Amhi Tumchya Sathi Guru Mantra Gheun Alo Ahot. Kukufm Var Aika Financial Planning cha Guru Mantra Ani Tumche Finance Related Problem Soda.

5g-telecomer-noya-digonto.title: 5G: Telecomer Noya Digonto
5g-telecomer-noya-digonto.description: Ekta Somoy Chilo Jokhon Loke Eke Onyer Call Dhorten Na. Karon Call Dhorle Je Call Koreche Tar Ebong Je Call Dhoreche Tar Dujoner Mobile Balance Kata Jeto. gandhinche-dakshin-afriketil-jivan.title: Gandhinche dakshin afriketil jivan
gandhinche-dakshin-afriketil-jivan.description: Mitranno apan jya Gandhijinna Mahatma mhnun olakhto te adhi pasunach ase hote ka ? Afriket Astana Gandhiji yanchi personality ani vichar kase hote ? Tyanchya vicharachi jadan ghadan Kashi jhali ? Ase barech prashn ahet. Ya show madhe apan Gandhijinchya Afriketil ayushya baddhal janun gheuya.

within-you-is-the-power.title: Jaaniye Khud ki 10 Hidden Superpowers
within-you-is-the-power.description: Sapno ko sach karne ka secret hai aapke andar! 'Khud ki 10 Hidden Superpowers' mein aap explore karenge kaise inner powers decide karte hain aapki success ki journey. Isliye ye show suniye aur jaaniye kaise aapki superpowers se zindagi transform ki jaa sakti hai.

billionaire-donga.title: Billionaire Donga
billionaire-donga.description: తాను ప్రేమించిన అమ్మాయిని పెళ్లి చేసుకోవడానికి ఇండియాకు తిరిగొచ్చిన ఓ బిలియనీర్‌ జీవితం ఊహించని మలుపు తిరుగుతుంది. అనుకోని సంఘటన వల్ల ఒక్కసారిగా తన ఐడెంటిటీని, మనీ యాక్సెస్‌ని కోల్పోతాడు. అంతేకాకుండా, తన సొంత బ్యాంక్‌లోనే డబ్బు దొంగిలించాడని ఆరోపణలు ఎదుర్కొంటాడు. మరోవైపు, అతని ప్రియురాలు కూడా ఆసుపత్రిలో ప్రాణాపాయ స్థితిలో ఉంటుంది. మరి అతను తన ఐడెంటిటీని నిరూపించుకుని, తన ప్రియురాలిని కాపాడుకోగలడా

black-death.title: History Of Black Death
black-death.description: Saal 1347, October ka mahina Europe ka mausam har din ki tarah khushnuma tha, Kaale samandar se lambi duri tay karne ke baad bauth sare jahaz  kinare pounche the, Par uske baad aakhir logo ne uss jahaz par aisa kya dekha ki unke hosh udd gaye? Aakhir aisa kya tha uss jahaz me ki logo me afra tafreeh mach gai? Aur Europe me aise konsi mahamari aai ki usne yaha ki aadhi aabadi ko he khatam kar diya. Inn sab ke baare me bataya gaya hai is Original show "History of Black Death" me.

jhadoowala-billionaire.title: Jhadoowala Billionaire
jhadoowala-billionaire.description: Pulkit r dwara mandap e porite rakhi Snehal r jibon bhangil — jotokhon na she Neel k biye koril, jie safaikarmichor rup loichil. Kintu tar biye e ek yuddho jiluai dile. Neel r maa Sudha rokto r pipasha e aase, Sania aar lobhi Pulkit milise shaajish koribo dhoriase. Sudha r tandulov r majhot ki Snehal Neel r billion dollar raaz jaanibo paribo, naki tar mithar boj taake dhongso korib? Prem, xyomota aar biswaasghatakotar ek boro golpo.

how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.title: Breakout Trading Diye Taka Kamate Sikhun
how-to-make-money-with-breakout-trading-.description: Taka Kamano Ekta Art, Ja Sobai Pare Na. Bolte Paren Eta Ekdhoroner Game, Jekhane Risko Ache. Kintu Taka Besi Kamate Gele Risk To Nitei Hobe. Aapni Ki Share Market E Taka Invest Kore Besi Taka Kamate Chan? Erjonyo Aapnake Jante Hbe Breakout Trading Er Bapare. Eta Aapnake Ghore Bose Onek Munafa Orjoner Poth Dekhabe. Aabar Candlestick Chart Ki Janen? Kivabe Ta Porte Hoy Ebong Share Market Er Songe Jukto Bishoyguli Jana Jay? Eirokom Kichu Tips Peye Jaben Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey. Ei Tipsgulo Shonar Por Aapni Nirvoye Share Market E Taka Invest Korte Parben Ebong Trading E Sofolota Aashbei. Tahole Eto Ki Vabchen, Ekkhnui Sune Nin Boitir Sarangsho.

क्यों-होता-है-मोटापा-.title: क्यों होता है मोटापा?
क्यों-होता-है-मोटापा-.description: Aksar hum kayi bachchon mein shuruaat se motapa dekhte hain. Aisa kyun hota hai? Is se kaise bacha jaa sakta hai? Yeh Sab kuch janne ke liye suniye humara yeh Audioshow. Jismein Motape ki wajah aur usse bachne ke sabhi tareeke bataye gaye hain. Toh chaliye shuru karte hain.

four-thousand-weeks-1.title: Gontobye Pouchonor Secrets
four-thousand-weeks-1.description: Amader jibon sonkhipto ebong kichu ta onischit. Bilashbohul jiboner pechone chut te giye, amader beche thakar asol mawja ta hariye jaye. Ei jibone amra sokol e sofol hote chai. Jiboner sei sofolota orjon na korte parle bhenge pori o nijeder dosharop kori. Anek khetrei manush bhabe ek ar hoi ar ek. Sudhu gontobyo ke noi poth chola ke upobhog korte hobe. Ei shob kichur byapar e jante o shikhte shune nin ei boi er sarangsho ti.

the-map-to-abundance.title: The Map to Abundance
the-map-to-abundance.description: ಹಣ ಸಂಪಾದಿಸುವುದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ನಿಮಗೆ ಚಿಂತೆ ಇದೆಯಾ? ಆರಾಮದಾಯಕ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸೋಕೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನ ಸುಧಾರಿಸಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಅನ್ನಿಸ್ತಿದೆಯಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲಾದ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಸಂಗತಿಗಳನ್ನ ನೀವು ಕೇಳಲೇಬೇಕು. ಹಣದ ಕೊರತೆಯನ್ನ ಪರಿಹರಿಸೋಕೆ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸುಭದ್ರತೆಯನ್ನ ಸಾಧಿಸೋಕೆ ಒಂದಿಷ್ಟು ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್‌ ನಡೆಗಳನ್ನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಫಾಲೋ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ನಿಜವಾದ ಸಂತೋಷ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೇವಲ ದುಡ್ಡು ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಕೂಡ ಸಂತೋಷಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾರ್ಗವೇ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಲೇಖಕಿ ತುಂಬಾ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಲೇಖಕಿ ಬೋನಿ ಲಾನ್ಸ್‌ಬರ್ರಿ ಬರೆದಿರುವ "The Map to Abundance" ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

osho-the-guru-of-spirituality-sex-and-co.title: OSHO- The Guru of Spirituality, Sex and Controversy
osho-the-guru-of-spirituality-sex-and-co.description: காமம் மூலமா கடவுளை அடைய முடியும்னு சொன்னவரு.. அவரோட teachings மூலமா அமெரிக்க அரசாங்கத்தையே மிரள வச்ச ஆளு !  சர்ச்சைகளுக்கு பின்னால மறைஞ்சு இருக்குற ஓஷோவுடைய உண்மையான Story என்ன?  இந்த Audio Show ல தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம் வாங்க.

kaviri-maindan-part-2.title: காவிரி மைந்தன்
kaviri-maindan-part-2.description: அமரர் கல்கியின் பொன்னியின் செல்வனின் தொடர்ச்சியே காவிரி மைந்தன் எனும் இக்காவியம். பொன்னியின் செல்வனை முடிக்கும் விதமே பதில்களைத் தராமல் பல புதுக் கேள்விகளைக் கிளப்பிவிட்டது, பொன்னியின் செல்வன் கதையில் வந்த பாத்திரங்கள் பின்னர் என்ன ஆயின என்று அவரே ஒரு கோடிட்டுக் காட்டினார், அதை முடிந்தவரை ஆசிரியர் பின்பற்றி தன் கற்பனையை வளர்த்து இக்காவியத்தை படைத்துள்ளார்.

akhada-the-last-fighter.title: Akhada:The last fighter
akhada-the-last-fighter.description: Trishul Kala Academy, jahan martial arts sikhayi jaati hai, aaj khatre mein hai. Wahin rehta hai Ved, sabse nikamma aur sharaabi ladka, jo sabki daant khata hai aur safai karta hai. Coach Meera aur inspector Dinesh ko us par shak hai. Meera use hero banana chahti hai par Dinesh use jail bhejna chahta hai. Tab academy mein kuch aisa hota hai jo sabko hila deta hai. Kaun hai Ved, ek sharaabi, ek khiladi ya ek qaatil?

the-monk-who-sold-his-ferrari-10.title: The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari
the-monk-who-sold-his-ferrari-10.description:
|Key Learnings- Passion, Purpose, and Peace|
Kahani ek aise Monk ki jisne Ferrari bech kar khareeda ek anokha safar "Inner Peace" ka, aap bhi jaaniye iss show ke zariye zindagi jeene ki asli raah.


Link- https://kukufm.com/show/reasons-to-stay-alive-8?utm_source=upsell
Link - https://kukufm.com/show/free-to-focus-13?utm_source=upsell

prashnpradeshni-pele-par.title: Prashnpradeshni pele par
prashnpradeshni-pele-par.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

the-happiest-man-on-earth-5.title: The Happiest Man on Earth
the-happiest-man-on-earth-5.description: Vaazhkaiyoda Kastamaana Nerathulayum Happy ya Irukkuradhu epdi nu Indha Kuku Byte la irundhu naama Kathuka mudiyum ! Hitler vadhai muhaam la adaipattu Naatta Izhandhu, Veetta Izhanthu, Kudumbatha izhandhu , Sithiravadhaigal anubavichu Thappi Pizhaicha Eddie Jakku thannoda 100 vayasu la release pannina book thaan "Happiest Man On Earth" !.

begum-by-chance.title: Begum by chance
begum-by-chance.description: A brilliant young doctor, Kavya, risks everything to save lives during a mysterious meteor storm, but a fatal accident sends her two centuries into the past. She awakens inside the scarred body of Begum Zoya, the hated wife of Sultan Armaan—who looks exactly like the comatose man she loves in the present. Trapped in a palace filled with betrayal, murder plots, and political conspiracies, Kavya must use her modern medical knowledge to surviv.

the-courage-to-be-disliked-2.title: 12 Tips Nijer Bhoy Ke Joy Korar
the-courage-to-be-disliked-2.description: Lojja ghrina bhoy tin thakte noi. Manush ke porthomei ghrina lojja ar bhoy ke joi korte hobe. Ei tin onubhuti amader ke bibhinyo bishoy abodhyo kore rakhe. Nijeke ki kore free korben, ki bhabe happiness orjon korben? Apnake manush jotoi discourage koruk na keno apnake egiye jete hobe. The Courage To Be Disliked boi tir sarangsho ti shune nin ar jene nin ki bhabe bhoy ke joy kora jaye.

the-quantum-janitor.title: The Quantum Janitor
the-quantum-janitor.description: Follow the adventures of Dr. Zack Particle, a brilliant scientist who accidentally unlocks the secrets of interdimensional travel. After causing a breach in reality, Zack is recruited by a secret organization dedicated to preserving the delicate balance of the multiverse. As Zack navigates bizarre dimensions, encounters eccentric characters, and faces cosmic challenges, he must learn to balance his scientific curiosity with the responsibility of safeguarding the multiverse itself. Dive into a world where the impossible becomes reality with this exciting and hilarious original show!

buddhas-brain-4.title: Neuroscience Er dara Brain Ke Alter Korar Koushal
buddhas-brain-4.description: Moses, Mohammed,Jesus, Gandhi ar Buddha ei sokol great thought leaders ra brain ke alter korechilen nijeder brain er shokti diye. Neuroscience er notun findings diye apnio apnar brain ke alter koreek positive, shaanto ar khushir jibon e bachte pareni. Ashun ei shob tothyo shikhe nawa jaak buddha's vbrain book summary theke

raavanan-aryavarthaavin-ethiri.title: ராவணன் - ஆர்யாவர்த்தாவின் எதிரி
raavanan-aryavarthaavin-ethiri.description: பிரமிக்கவைக்கும் இராமச்சந்திரா தொடரின் மூன்றாவது புத்தகம், ராவணன். முரண்களின் வடிவானவன், படு கொடுமைகளை அஞ்சாமல் செய்பவன், மெத்த படித்த மேதாவி. எதிர்பார்ப்பின்றி அன்பையும் வைப்பான், குற்ற உணர்ச்சியின்றி கொலையும் செய்வான். அவன் வரலாறு காணாத கொடூரனா, அல்லது எப்பொழுதுமே இருளில் மாட்டி தவிக்கும் சாதாரண மனிதனா?

married-to-a-god.title: Married To A God
married-to-a-god.description: A cursed and ostracised princess is forcefully married to a beggar who turns out to the Solar God Suryadev, who is on a mission to recover a stolen solar artefact. This is a journey of the princess from being a cursed princess to becoming the solar queen of Suryaloka.

the-notorious-journey-of-barry-minkow.title: The Notorious Journey of Conman Barry Minkow
the-notorious-journey-of-barry-minkow.description: ZZZZ Best was a carpet cleaning and restoration company founded by Barry Minkow that served as a front for a famous Ponzi scheme. The company went public in December 1986 and was quickly valued at over $300 million. Within just seven months of the initial public offering (IPO), however, ZZZZ Best was bankrupt, and its assets were auctioned for approximately $64,000. Discover who notorious criminal Barry Minkow was, how he began his Ponzi scheme and the repercussions of his actions, through this detailed documentary.

adbhut-anjeri-maharatna-ki-khoj.title: Adbhut Anjeri : Maharatna Ki Khoj
adbhut-anjeri-maharatna-ki-khoj.description: Shivani aur uske dost nikle hain ek adbhut itihas ka pata lagane, jismein chhupe hain gehre raaz aur Shivani ka bhayanak atit. Kya Shivani samay ki seema ko tod, apne atit ke raaz ko ujagar karegi, ya fir ek baar phir itihas ban jayega sirf ek kahani ?

price-of-love-pyar-ki-dardbhari-dastan.title: Price of Love : Pyar Ki Dard Bhari Daastaan
price-of-love-pyar-ki-dardbhari-dastan.description: Pyaar karne ki saza maut se chukani hoti hai? Ye bhayanak sach kisi film ki kahani nahi, balki ek real life incident hai. Jismein do premiyon ka katl sare-aam sirf isliye hua kyunki unhe ek dusre se pyaar ho gaya tha. Kya hai inki poori kahani?  Kiski nazar thi en donon ki Mohabbat par? Tha koi Apna? Ya koi aisa jise lena tha apna Inteqam? Janne ke liye suniye ye audio show!

gst-explained-1.title: GST Explained
gst-explained-1.description: GST patriya varalaaru, Pinnani matrum GST vari vidhippil seyya pattulla pudhiya maatrangalai alasi aaraayum virivaana Padhivu Idhu!

lady-singham.title: Lady Singham
lady-singham.description: Megha Sharma, a courageous woman, challenges police corruption when an auto driver faces extortion at a checkpoint. Arrested and tortured with false charges, she endures intimidation and blackmail while remaining steadfast. As fabricated evidence threatens to destroy her, a stunning revelation emerges: Megha is a newly appointed IPS officer. Her tormentors face justice as their corruption unravels, proving that truth and integrity ultimately triumph over systemic abuse of power.

சந்தோஷ்-கொலையில்-ஒரு-திருப்பம்.title: சந்தோஷ் கொலையில் ஒரு திருப்பம்
சந்தோஷ்-கொலையில்-ஒரு-திருப்பம்.description: சென்னையில் வசிக்கும் முதலீட்டு தொழிலதிபர் சந்தோஷ் இக்கதையின் முதல் காட்சியிலேயே அவரது இல்லத்தில் இருக்கும் சமயம் துப்பாக்கித் தோட்டா பாய்ந்து உயிர் விடுகிறார். கொலைப்பழி அவரின் அந்தரங்க சினேகிதி ரோஷினி மீது விழுகிறது. இந்த மரணத்தை துப்பறியும் குற்றப்பிரிவு ஆய்வாளர் டேனியல், ஒரு கட்டத்தில் ரோஷினி குற்றவாளியல்ல என்று உணர்கிறார். இப்படி பரபரப்பாக நகரும் கதை தான் 'சந்தோஷ் கொலையில் ஒரு திருப்பம்'

why-bharat-matter-part-2.title: Why Bharat Matters Part -2
why-bharat-matter-part-2.description:
|Key Points- Diplomatic Strategy, Digital Transformation & Global Influence|
Bharat ki diplomatic strategy aur digital transformation ko explore karte hue, iss series ke dusre part mein hum dekhte hain Bharat ka global influence aur uski aage ki disha.

oka-radha-iddaru-krishnulu.title: ఒక రాధ ఇద్దరు కృష్ణులు
oka-radha-iddaru-krishnulu.description: ఒక వ్యక్తి పన్నాగం పన్ని చేసిన ద్రోహం కారణంగా అతడి తల్లి జైలుకెళ్లింది. అతడా వ్యక్తిని ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకున్నాడు. అతడి చేత పాతికేళ్ల కిందటి నిజాల్ని కక్కిద్దామనుకున్నాడు. దానికి ఓ అద్భుతమైన ప్లాను వేశాడు.తరువాత ఏం జరిగిందో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? ఊహించలేని మలుపులతో, క్షణక్షణం ఉత్కంఠతో ఉక్కిరి బిక్కిరి చేస్తూ కూడా – చక్కటి హాస్యంతో గిలిగింతలు పెట్టే యండమూరి వీరేంద్రనాథ్‌ హ్యూమర్‌ క్రైమ్‌ నవల – "ఒక రాధ ఇద్దరు కృష్ణులు" అనే ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

edhayum-oru-thadavai.title: எதையும் ஒரு தடவை
edhayum-oru-thadavai.description:
சிகாகோவில் இருக்கும் சூர்யகுமாரிடம் சென்று சேர அவனின் புதுமனைவி அஸ்திராவிற்கு விசா கிடைக்கிறது. அங்கே மர்மமான முறையில் சில
சம்பவங்கள் நடைபெறுகின்றன. இது ராஜேஷ்குமாரின் த்ரில்லர் சம்பவம்.

tamil-characters.title: Tamil Characters
tamil-characters.description: Thamizh naatoda varalaru la sila miga mukkiya kadhapathirangal, adhavadhu nabargal namma naataye poratti potturukanga. Avangala pathina sila mukkiya facts kondahu dhaan indha audio book.

obsession.title: Obsession
obsession.description:
Divya believes her wealthy and charming boyfriend, Rahul, truly loves her. But one night, at an isolated farmhouse in Lonavala, Rahul reveals his true nature. That same night, a terrifying spirit appears before Divya and warns her, “Stay away from Rahul, or you won’t survive.”
Why is this ghost so obsessed with Rahul? What dark connection binds her to him? Was Rahul’s past destined to come between him and Divya? As Divya digs deeper, she uncovers a web of secrets, obsession, and betrayal that threatens to destroy them all. The only question is—how far will the ghost go to keep Rahul from slipping away again?

bachho-ko-bigdane-se-kaise-roke.title: Bachho Ko Bigdane Se Kaise Roke
bachho-ko-bigdane-se-kaise-roke.description: Scientific facts ki maane to humara dimaag galat chizon ki taraf jaldi attract hota hai, Aur aaj ke is modern daur mein ye pata lagana aur bhi mushkil hota jaa raha hai ki humare bacche kis disha mein aage badh rahe hain, Unke dost kaise hain? kahin unhe kisi buri aadat to nahi, Aise bahut se sawal hain jo aaj kal ke parents ko pareshan karte hain. To aakhir bachho ko sahi disha kaise di jaae, Unhe bigadne se kaise roka jae, Aur wo Kaun Kaun se steps hain jise follow kar aap apne bacho ko ek Disciplined way mein raise kar sakte hain jaanenge humare is Audiobook mein.

history-of-tipu-sultan.title: History Of Tipu Sultan
history-of-tipu-sultan.description: Tipu Sultan ko apne samay ke sabse khunkhar Raja ke roop mein maana jaata hai, kya sachme Tipu ne Sher ko maat di thi? Aakhir kyun Angrezon ke liye ve ek krur attyachari the, lekin apni praja ke liye ek buddhiman aur nyanpriya raja the? Unke sahsi karnamo se lekar unke controversial shasan tak, ye audiobook aapko us samay mein jeena ka anubhav degi.

বিকৃত-যৌনতা--লেখিকা--সন্দীপা-সরকার.title: বিকৃত যৌনতা | লেখিকা - সন্দীপা সরকার
বিকৃত-যৌনতা--লেখিকা--সন্দীপা-সরকার.description: সবুজ আর লিজা তাদের ছেলেমেয়েকে নিয়ে বিদেশ থেকে ফিরে যায় জ্যেঠু জ্যেঠইমার কাছে। সবার মধ্যে খুশির জোয়ার কিন্তু তারপর ঘটে ভয়াবহ নির্মম কাণ্ড।

banarasi-ishq-1.title: Banarasi Ishq
banarasi-ishq-1.description: Banaras’ proud Guide-cum-Pandit Adi falls in love with heritage architect Zara. But her powerful builder father, Karimullah, frames Adi’s father and sends him to jail. On Holi, Karimullah forces Adi to abandon Zara to save his father’s life. Believing Adi betrayed her for money, Zara returns to Lucknow. Adi throws the check into the Ganga and vows revenge. He heads to Lucknow to destroy the Siddiqui empire from within.

what-men-should-understand-about-periods.title: What Men Should Understand About Periods?
what-men-should-understand-about-periods.description: Periods na enna? , Andha Naatkal la  Pennukkul nadakkura maatrangal enna?, Periods appo oru aan Kanavanaa, Sagotharanaa, Friend daa seyya vendiyadhu enna? Ippadi.. periods pathina aangalin pala kelvigalukku badhilaa irukkum Indha Padhivu !

i-can-make-you-smarter.title: I Can Make You Smarter
i-can-make-you-smarter.description:
"Dimag Tez karne ke liye kisi Dawai ki nahin es Audiobook ko sunne ki zaroorat hai!"
Smart banna ek talent nahi, ek skill hai!' Aur ye audiobook bataati hai aapko proven formula jisse aap ye skill seekh sakte hain aur apne aapko life ke har field mein smarter bana sakte hain. Author Paul McKenna ki powerful techniques aapki concentration, memory aur learning speed ko boost karengi aur aapko sabse alag aur sabse confident banayengi. Toh agar apne dimaag ko tez karna chahte ho toh is audiobook ko abhi se sunna shuru karo aur dekho kaise aap har cheez mein smart ban jaate ho. Abhi suno, aur apne mind ka superpower jagao!

borrowed-memories.title: Borrowed Memories
borrowed-memories.description: When troubled bartender Jack Holloway starts experiencing haunting visions tied to objects from the dead, he plunges into a chilling mystery that unravels the dark secrets of New Orleans. After his girlfriend Mia is murdered, Jack’s unsettling ability reveals hidden truths and a conspiracy that links him to the past in ways he never imagined. As he struggles with his own demons and the ghosts of others, Jack must confront the blurred line between reality and the supernatural to uncover the truth before it consumes him. Get on a thrilling ride with this dark and atmospheric audio drama, only on KukuFM!

7-habits-of-highly-effective-people-9.description: unga vazhkaila vetrikarama irukka neenga follow panna vendiya mukkiyamana 7 habits pathi intha kuku byte pesuthu. vetrikaramana vazhkkaikku intha 7 habits eppadi help pannum ? ini.description: மக்களின் மனோபாவங்களையும் வாழ்க்கைப் பிரச்சினைகளையும் அலசி ஆராய்ந்து, பண்பட்ட எழுத்தாளராகிய திருமதி. சிவசங்கரி அவர்கள் ஓர் அற்புதமான சித்திரத்தை உருவாக்கிக் காட்டி இருக்கிறார். 'இனி...?' என்ற நாவலில்

best-of-lovelavike.title: Best of Lovelavike
best-of-lovelavike.description: ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಪ್ರೇಮ, ಪ್ರಣಯವು ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಭಾವನೆಗಳ ದೀರ್ಘಸಂಗಮ. ತನ್ನಿಗಿಂತ ದೊಡ್ಡವರು ಯಾರು ಇಲ್ಲ ಎನ್ನುವ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿದ್ದಾಗ "ನೀನೇ ನನಗೆಲ್ಲಾ, ನೀನಿಲ್ಲದೆ ನಾನಿಲ್ಲ" ಎಂದು ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರೇಮ ಪತ್ರಗಳು ಕೆಲವರ ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಆರಾಧನೆಯಂತಿವೆ. ಇಂದಿನ ವಾಟ್ಸಾಪ್, ಇಮೇಲ್‌ಗಳ ಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತು, ಅಂದು ಇವೆಲ್ಲವೂ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಗದದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮೂಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಆ ನವಿರಾದ ಭಾವನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನೆಸಿದರೆ ಹೇಗಿದ್ದಿರಬಹುದೆಂದು ಅನಿಸಬಹುದು. ಆ ಕುತೂಹಲವನ್ನು ತಣಿಸಲು, ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ಸಂಭ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಳೆದು ಹೋಗಲು, ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ನಿಮಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಅವಕಾಶವನ್ನು ಕೊಡುಗೆಯಾಗಿ ನೀಡಲಿದೆ.

crossroad.title: Crossroad
crossroad.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

emergency-ki-inside-story.title: Emergency Ki Inside Story
emergency-ki-inside-story.description: Kya Indira Gandhi ek Dictator thi? Suniye India ki democracy mein lage ek kaale dhabbe ki kahaani ke baare mein, jiska naam hai Emergency. 1975 ke dashak se judi aisi ghatnayein is show mein aapko batayi jayengi, jise sun kar aap dang reh jayenge. Toh suniye is audio show ko abhi.

amman-sonna-ragasiyam.title: Amman sonna ragasiyam
amman-sonna-ragasiyam.description: Selvi, a flower seller devoted to the village goddess, suddenly begins seeing terrifying visions that come true. As each premonition helps save lives and uncover hidden crimes, she is drawn into a decades-old mystery involving a haunted lake, a murdered woman, and powerful people desperate to bury the truth. With the help of a journalist and a police inspector, Selvi discovers that her visions are connected to a secret her mother has protected for years.

bob-jr-king-of-the-serengeti.title: BOB JR. King Of The Serengeti
bob-jr-king-of-the-serengeti.description:
దర్శక ధీరుడు ఎస్.ఎస్. రాజమౌళి ఇటీవల ఇన్‌స్టాగ్రామ్‌లో ఒక పోస్ట్ షేర్ చేశారు, సెరెంగెటి అడవిలోని మహా సింహం "బాబ్ జూనియర్" గురించి. "ఇది సెరెంగెటిలో రాజు, బాబ్ జూనియర్… గుర్తుకు వస్తుందా?" అంటూ మహేష్ బాబును ట్యాగ్ చేయడం అభిమానులను ఉత్కంఠలో పడేసింది. ఈ సింహం, "కింగ్ ఆఫ్ సెరెంగెటి"గా పేరొందింది.

అసలు బాబ్ జూనియర్ ఎవరు? ఈ సింహ౦ వెనుక ఉన్న కథ ఏంటి?

irandhukidantha-thendral.title: Irandhu kidantha Thendral
irandhukidantha-thendral.description: வெளியூரில் வேலை செய்யும் குமரன் தன்னுடைய மனைவி பார்ப்பதற்காக இரவு நேர பஸ்ஸில் பயணம் செய்கிறான். இயற்கை உபாதைக்காக கீழே இறங்கி குப்பை மண்டி கிடந்த அந்த இடத்தில் அவன் கண்ட காட்சி அவனை எப்படிப்பட்ட சிக்கலில் மாட்ட வைக்கிறது என்பதை திகிலோடு சொல்வதுதான் இந்த கதை.

greatest-prime-minister-pv-narasimha-rao.description: Harshad Mehta Scam Se Lekar Bharat Ratna Tak: PV Narasimha Rao Ki Controversial Journey Ka Pura Sach!

cockroach-janta-party.title: Cockroach Janta Party
cockroach-janta-party.description: What began as an insult and an internet joke soon turned into one of India’s most unexpected youth movements. The Party Nobody Took Seriously follows the explosive rise of the Cockroach Janta Party—from a viral post and millions of followers to protests on the streets—asking one thrilling question: Can a meme really become a revolution?

jiddu-krishnamurthy-and-his-teachings.title: Jiddu Krishnamurthy and His Teachings
jiddu-krishnamurthy-and-his-teachings.description: The story of a poor Indian boy who was chosen and raised as the “World Teacher” and messiah—only to reject the throne, followers, and spiritual authority created for him, and show humanity a radically different path: to question everything, break free from fear and conditioning, and discover truth without a guru.

governance-for-growth-in-india.title: Governance for Growth in India
governance-for-growth-in-india.description: Kabhi socha hai ki aapka roz ka routine aur desh ki rajneeti kis tarah se jude hain? Is show mein, hum aapko le chalenge ek aise safar par jahan aap sunenge ki aapki tarakki kaise Bharat ki unnati se judi hai. Suniye, seekhiye, aur saath mein badhiye.

love-station-1.title: Love Station
love-station-1.description: A runaway heiress, Devika, escapes a forced marriage to ruthless gold-cartel heir Sameer and, in desperation, marries a humble railway porter, Kabir. But behind his faded uniform lies a shocking secret—Kabir is actually the powerful heir to Mumbai’s biggest shipping empire. As Devika battles her cruel family to clear her mother’s name, she discovers that her mysterious husband is far more powerful than anyone imagined—and the only man willing to stand beside her against them all.

attitude-is-everything-18.title: Attitude is Everything
attitude-is-everything-18.description: "Attitude badlo, life badal jaayegi!" Jeff Keller ki kahaani se jaaniye, kaise ek chhota sa mindset shift aapki zindagi ko palat sakta hai. Aakhir wo kaunsi raat thi jo Jeff ki life ko hamesha ke liye badal gayi? Suniyega, kyunki aapka bhi wahi moment yahi kahin chhupa hai!

common-wealth-india.description: భారతదేశం మరియు కామన్‌వెల్త్ మధ్య సంబంధం చరిత్ర, రాజకీయం, స్వతంత్ర భావనలతో నిండి ఉంది. బ్రిటిష్ సామ్రాజ్య పాలన తర్వాత కూడా, భారత్ కామన్‌వెల్త్‌లో కొనసాగుతూ తన ప్రత్యేక స్థానాన్ని ఏర్పరచుకుంది. ఇప్పుడు ఇది మిత్ర దేశాల మధ్య సహకారం, అభివృద్ధి, గౌరవానికి ప్రతీకగా నిలుస్తోంది.

the-ultimate-family-business-survival-gu.description: Oru nattudaiya valarchi la kudumba thozhil romba mukkiyam nu solra Priyanka Gupta Zielinski thannoda Kudumba thozhil la vetrikaramana muraila senju atha pala madangu laabam sambaathikkum onnaa maathirukkaanga. discovering-jesus.title: Discovering Jesus
discovering-jesus.description: యేసు క్రీస్తు అనేది ప్రేమ, క్షమ, మరియు త్యాగానికి ప్రతీక. ఆయన తన జీవితం ద్వారా మానవజాతికి దేవుని ప్రేమను తెలియజేశారు. నమ్మకం, ఆశ, మరియు శాంతిని అందించే దైవిక శక్తిగా యేసు పురాణాల్లో పేర్కొనబడ్డారు.

rab-ne-bana-di-galat-jodi.title: Rab Ne Bana Di Galat Jodi
rab-ne-bana-di-galat-jodi.description: Dr. Akash Verma, a brilliant scientist, faces an early moral quandary when his "Lifeline" cure is threatened by his wife Saloni's critical illness and a corporate mogul's demands. He sacrifices his career for Saloni, enduring public humiliation and job loss. Concurrently, his relationship with Anu (later identified as Annu) deteriorates due to his insecurity and her growing independence, fueled by suspected infidelity. Amidst this, Annu's marriage to Sanjay crumbles, drawing her towards Rocky, who demonstrates devotion but also faces professional upheaval. Akash experiences a surprising, intimate reconciliation with Saloni, while also developing a bond with a female colleague. Later, Akash endures public humiliation at high-society parties, orchestrated by Rocky's sister and others, while Rocky attempts to win Anu's affection, even sabotaging Akash's social standing. Akash makes a monumental sacrifice, transferring his financial empire to Manav, before abruptly serving Anu with divorce papers and mysteriously disappearing. Anu grapples with his absence, manipulated by Rocky and a friend who accuse Akash of betrayal. It is revealed that Akash lives a complex double life, initially as an injured watchman, but also as a brilliant scientist and government researcher. His past catches up as he's drawn back into a high-stakes antidote project by CEO Namak. Akash faces legal battles and accusations of fraud and adultery from his estranged wife, Annu, who invalidates their divorce, and from the volatile Rocky, who harbors possessive feelings for Akash's ex-lover, Anu. Akash's hidden identity as a government researcher is dramatically revealed during a brutal street fight while defending Annu. The narrative escalates with the harrowing abduction of Anu by the ruthless criminal Rocky, prompting an injured Akash to launch a frantic rescue mission. His efforts are complicated by a manipulative Siddhi, who extracts a humiliating price for her assistance, and his own arrest. The situation culminates in a high-stakes police chase and standoff, where Akash offers his entire fortune for Anu's freedom. In a shocking turn, a rage-filled Akash holds Anu hostage at gunpoint, rejecting her desperate confession of love, before a gunshot and chaotic escape. A terrifying ordeal involving Anu leads to a violent crash, prompting Akash to rush to her aid, expressing regret. Ultimately, apologies and forgiveness lead to a powerful reconciliation among Akash, Anu, and a third individual, profoundly reaffirming their love and solidifying their bond.

atlas-of-the-heart.title: Atlas of the Heart
atlas-of-the-heart.description: "Atlas of the Heart"🗺️❤️ is your companion in the quest for emotional clarity, offering tools to decode complex feelings.This Kuku Byte is a key to a happier, more connected life. 🌍❤️🔑

பார்த்த-முதல்-நாளில்--காஞ்சனா-ஜெயதிலகர்-.title: பார்த்த முதல் நாளில்
பார்த்த-முதல்-நாளில்--காஞ்சனா-ஜெயதிலகர்-.description: இங்கிலாந்தில் வளர்ந்த சுவாதி, உணர்வால் தமிழ் பெண்தான்... ஆனாலும் தன் கணவனை மற்றவர் தேர்ந்தெடுத்து தருவது அவளை பயமுறுத்தியது... சந்தித்த ஆறடி உயர ஆணின் கர்வம் கலவரப்படுத்தியது! தங்களை நிர்கதியாய் விட்டுப் போன தந்தையின் மீதுள்ள கசப்பு, தன் வாழ்வின் சுவையை பாழடித்து விடுமோ? யாரோ ஒருவனை நம்பி, தாய்நாட்டிற்குத் திரும்புவதால் மட்டும் தன் வாழ்வு சீராகி விடுமா? முக்கியமாய் அன்பின் இதம் கிடைக்குமா? கேளுங்கள் இது உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்.எம்

zphs-devanuru.title: Z.P.H.S Devanuru
zphs-devanuru.description: అంతా సాఫ్ట్వేర్ అని పరుగులు తీస్తున్న ఈ రోజుల్లో.. అర్జున్ ఒక మారు మూల పల్లెటూరి లోని గవర్నమెంట్ హై స్కూల్ కి హెడ్ మాస్టర్ గా వచ్చాడు. పశువుల పాకలా ఉన్న పాడు బడిన ఆ స్కూల్ ని.. అర్జున్ ఎలా తిరిగి పూర్వ వైభవం తీసుకు వచ్చాడు? ఊరిలో అభివృధికి అడ్డుపడ్డ ఊరి సర్పంచ్ నరిసింహన్ని.. అర్జున్ ఎలా ఎదురుకున్నాడు? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఈ షో వినాల్సిందే!

uyiril-kalantha-mellisaiye.title: Uyiril kalantha mellisaiye
uyiril-kalantha-mellisaiye.description: தனக்கு மட்டுமே கிடைக்க வேண்டிய தாய்ப் பாசத்தை தியா பங்கு போட்டுக் கொண்டாள் என நினைக்கிறான் அஸ்வின். வாழ்க்கை முழுவதும் தியாவை வெறுக்கிறான். ஆனால், விதி யாரை விட்டது?

porn-the-hidden-culture.title: Porn: The Hidden Culture
porn-the-hidden-culture.description: భారతదేశంలో పెరుగుతున్న పోర్న్ కల్చర్‌కు మూలాలు ఏమిటి? ఈ పరిశ్రమ వెనక ఉన్న అసలు నిజాలు ఏంటి? గ్లామర్‌గా కనిపించే పోర్న్ ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన వారెంత బంధించబడతారు? వారి జీవితాల్లో ఉన్న చీకటి కోణాలేంటి? ఈ ఆడియో సిరీస్‌లో మీరు వినబోయే ప్రతి ఎపిసోడ్‌… వాస్తవాలపై ఆధారపడిన, ముడిపడిన బాధ, నిస్సహాయత, సమాజపు ద్వంద్వ వైఖరిపై ఓ అంతర్గత వీక్షణం.

the-rise-and-fall-of-the-indus-valley-ci.title: The Indus Valley Civilization-Prachin Sindhu Sanskruti
the-rise-and-fall-of-the-indus-valley-ci.description: Indus Valley civilization, Harrapan Civilization mhanunhi olakhla jate, ya show madhye tumhala Indus Valley civilization baddal savitar mahiti denyat ali ahe. Chala ya show dware apan Prachin Sindhu Sanskruticha Ugam ani asta janun gheuyat. Aika The Rise and Fall of Indus Valley Civilization Kuku Fm var.

desi-wife-ceo-husband.title: Kismat Connection
desi-wife-ceo-husband.description:
Ek jhoothi pehchaan wala CEO aur dhokhe se tooti, ek himmatwali gaon ki ladki.
Ek ajeeb shart unhe zabran shaadi mein baandh deti hai—
aur shuru hoti hai pyaar, badle aur zameen ki ladai.

Deal samajh kar ki gayi shaadi dheere-dheere pyaar ban jaati hai.
Par raaz khulte hi bharosa tootne lagta hai.
Kya Aarav ka sachha pyaar, Arya ka bharosa wapas laa payega?
Ya yeh rishta nafrat aur saazishon mein toot jayega?

i-bought-the-monks-ferrari.title: I Bought The Monk's Ferrari
i-bought-the-monks-ferrari.description: ferrari - indha per ah ketta udane oru special feeling car lovers ku mattum illa common aana makkalukkum irukum. Indha book oru ferrari owner oda experience, antha car avaroda vaazhkai la yerpathiya sila swarasiyamaana vishyangala dhaan indha audio la kekka poreenga.

bikhyuddho-bohni.title: Bikhyuddho Bohni
bikhyuddho-bohni.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

history-of-tirupati.title: History Of Tirupati
history-of-tirupati.description: ಶೇಷಾಚಲ ಪರ್ವತದ ಮೇಲಿರುವ ಈ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರವು ದಂತಕಥೆಗಳಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ರಾಜವಂಶಗಳ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳವರೆಗೆ, ಹಬ್ಬ-ಆಚರಣೆಗಳ ವೈಭವದಿಂದ ಆಧುನಿಕ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯವರೆಗೆ ಅಪಾರ ವೈಭವ ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದು. ವೇದಗಳಂತೆ ಇದ್ದ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮೋತ್ಸವದ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನತೆ, ಶ್ರೀ ವೆಂಕಟೇಶ್ವರನ ದಂತಕಥೆ, ಹಾಗೂ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಿರುವ ಆಡಳಿತಮಂಡಳಿ ಈ ಎಲ್ಲವು ತಿರುಪತಿಯನ್ನು ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ತೀರ್ಥದಂತೆ ಜೀವಂತವನ್ನಾಗಿಸಿದೆ. ಇಂತಹ ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಕುತೂಹಲಕರ ಕಥೆಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕೇಳ್ತಾ ಇರಿ KUKUFM.

mahagatha-100-tales-from-the-puranas.title: Mahagatha : 100 Tales from the Puranas
mahagatha-100-tales-from-the-puranas.description: A journey through the wondrous tales of India's Puranas. From the creation of the universe to Kaliyuga, stories of the gods, asuras and sages of Sanatan Dharma are woven together across all four yugas. Discover the meaning of karma and curses, and hear many rare Puranic tales you've never heard before. Made for Purana lovers and new listeners alike, this sacred collection is now in your ears.

how-to-develop-self-confidence-and-influ.title: How To Develop Self-Confidence And Influence People By Public Speaking
how-to-develop-self-confidence-and-influ.description: Unleash your public speaking prowess with "How to Develop Self-Confidence and Influence People by Public Speaking" by Dale Carnegie. This audiobook is a guide to conquering public speaking fears and enhancing influence. Carnegie's expert advice empowers you to command attention, convey ideas effectively, and exude confidence. Learn the art of engaging communication, building connections, and boosting charisma. With actionable techniques, this audiobook transforms you into a compelling speaker, inspiring confidence and success in various aspects of life.

gaadegala-kathakosha-bhaaga-3.title: Gaadegala Kathakosha Bhaaga 3
gaadegala-kathakosha-bhaaga-3.description: ಗಾದೆಗಳು ಮನರಂಜನಾಕಾರಿ ಕತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುತ್ತವೆ, ಹಾಸ್ಯ ಹಾಗೂ ವಿಡಂಬನೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡ ಆ ಕತೆಗಳ ಅಂತರಾಳದ ಆಶಯ ಒಂದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ನೀತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುವುದಾಗಿದೆ.

shadow-code.title: Shadow Code
shadow-code.description: സാങ്കേതിക വിദഗ്ദ്ധനും  കോളേജ് ഡ്രോപ്പ്ഔട്ടുമായ നിഖില്‍ ഒരു ഫ്രീലാൻസ് എത്തിക്കൽ ഹാക്കറാണു. ഡിജിറ്റൽ കുറ്റകൃത്യങ്ങൾക്കെതിരെ പോരാടുന്നതിൽ അവൻ എപ്പോഴും വ്യാപൃതനായിരുന്നു. ഒരു രാത്രി, സൈബർ പ്രേമികൾക്കായുള്ള ഒരു ഫോറത്തിൻ നിന്നും ഒരു അജ്ഞാത സന്ദേശം അവനു ലഭിച്ചു: *"ഷാഡോ കോഡ് കണ്ടെത്തൂ. നിഗൂഢത പരിഹരിക്കൂ. ജീവനുകളുടെ രക്ഷകനാവു." നിഖിൽ തൻ്റെ കയ്യിലിരിക്കുന്ന ആ കറുത്ത യുഎസ്ബി ഡ്രൈവിലേക്ക് നോക്കി എന്തു വേണം എന്നറിയാതെ ഇരുന്നു. ആ മിഷൻ അവൻ ഏടെടുക്കുമോ? എന്താകും അതിൻ്റെ ഫലം?  കേൾക്കൂ...ഷാഡോകോഡ്.

5858e4e9-9331-49f9-8aff-43fda14b8e28.title: Kya Yahi Pyaar Hai?
5858e4e9-9331-49f9-8aff-43fda14b8e28.description: Misha aur Akshat ka rishta pyaar aur vishwas se bhara tha,  toh phir aakhir kyon Akshat apni biwi ki jaan lene mein majboor ho gaya? Kya tha uska asli maksad? Jaanne ke liye suniye hamari is nayi peshkash ko jo ek aascharyachakit kahaani hai pyaar, vishwaash, aur dhoke ki, keval aapke manoranjan ke liye.

entrepreneurs-of-karnataka.title: Entrepreneurs of Karnataka
entrepreneurs-of-karnataka.description: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕನಸುಗಳ ನಾಡು. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯೋದ್ಯಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಹೇಳಿ ಮಾಡಿಸಿದ ಜಾಗ.! ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಪನಿ ಶುರು ಮಾಡಿ, ಅಂತಾರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯವಾದ ನೂರಾರು ಕಂಪನಿಗಳಿವೆ, ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯೋದ್ಯಮಿಗಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ! ಅಂಥ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಗಳ ಕಥೆಯೇ 'Entrepreneurs of Karnataka' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್!

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: சக மனுசங்களோட  Strong &  Healthy 💪  Relationship  build பண்ணவும் அத தொடர்ந்து Maitain பண்ணவும்  நீங்க செய்ய வேண்டியது என்னனு சொல்லிக்கொடுக்குது இந்த Kuku Byte💑🌱.

மௌனக்-கனவு--அனுராதா-ரமணன்-.title: மௌனக் கனவு
மௌனக்-கனவு--அனுராதா-ரமணன்-.description: ஆத்திரத்தில் அவசரப்பட்டு திருமணம் செய்து கொண்டவர்களின் நிலை, பல நேரங்களில் மோசமாவதுண்டு. அப்படித்தான் முரளியின் வாழ்க்கையிலும் நடந்தது. முரளி தாயில்லாப் பிள்ளை. மாமன் வீட்டில் வளர்ந்தவன். மாமன் பேச்சை கேளாமல் சில பல தவறான முடிவுகளை எடுத்து அதன் கசப்பான விளைவுகளை சுவைக்கிறான். கதைகள் நம் வாழ்க்கையின் கண்ணாடி. இது உங்கள் குக்கூ எஃப்எம் கதை கேளுங்க! மகிழுங்க!

kismat-reloaded.title: Kismat Reloaded
kismat-reloaded.description: Xu Mu, a modern man who finds himself in an ancient empire, rises from an ordinary outsider to a brilliant military strategist. When corrupt ministers, a weak emperor, and invading northern armies threaten his kingdom, Xu Mu uses his sharp mind, unconventional battle tactics, and fearless leadership to turn impossible situations into stunning victories. Betrayed by powerful enemies and abandoned by the royal court, he builds his own strength and leads his soldiers into dangerous enemy territory.

सुपर-सक्सेस-के-गोल्डन-रूल्स.title: Super Success ke Golden Rules
सुपर-सक्सेस-के-गोल्डन-रूल्स.description: Napolean HIll dwara likhi gai 'Super Success ke golden rule' book mein, Cornegy, Ford aur Edison jaise mahan dhan kuberon ki safalta ke baare me bataya gaya hai. Kabhi jhopadi mein rahne wale ye top businessman kaise karodpati banein. Is book me kai prerak udaharan hain, jo apke bheetar aatmavishwas ko badhane aur aage badhne ke liye prerit karta hai. Kuku FM par abhi sunein 'Super Success ke golden rule' aur apne jeevan ko sawariye.

price-of-love.title: Price Of Love
price-of-love.description: Ek event company me 6 mahine saath kaam karne ke baad Shivali ko Dev se pyaar ho jata hai lekin Dev uske sath ‘One Night Stand’ ke baad uski zindagi se hamesha ke liye gaayab ho jata hai. Shivali Pregent ho jati hai or health complication ki vajah se ushe ye bachcha karna pad jaata hai.  Bin Byaahi Maa hone ki vajah se society us par tohmat lagaati hai par fir bhi Shivali is sab se strong ban ke nikal ke career me bahut aage jaati hai lekin kuch saal baad ushe Ruhaan Oberoi ki shaadi ka contract milta hai lekin Ruhan ki shakl-o-soorat ekdam Dev ki tarah hai…. Ab kya karegi Shivali? Kya Dev hi Ruhan hai? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye ye romanchak kahani

the-icon-star.title: The Icon Star
the-icon-star.description:
స్టైలిష్ స్టార్ నుంచి ఐకాన్ స్టార్ వరకు – అల్లు అర్జున్ యొక్క అసాధారణ ప్రయాణం!
గంగోత్రితో అరంగేట్రం చేసి, ఆర్యతో యూత్ ఐకాన్‌గా మారి, అల వైకుంఠపురములో, పుష్పలతో దేశవ్యాప్తంగా అభిమానాన్ని పొందిన అల్లు అర్జున్, తన స్టైల్, డాన్స్, నటనతో ఇండియన్ సినిమా లోగోగా మారాడు. ఇప్పుడు ఆయన పేరు ఒక సింబల్ – ఐకాన్ స్టార్!

the-adventures-of-raja-vikram.title: The Adventures Of Raja Vikram
the-adventures-of-raja-vikram.description: n the ancient kingdom of Pushkar, a 3-year drought has broken the people's spirits. Raja Vikram performs a holy Yagna to please the gods. But his brother Pratap has other plans. Pratap releases the demon Kaalketu from a forbidden magical ring. Instead of life-giving rain, Kaalketu brings a "Magic Rain" that turns every living being it touches into a stone statue

the-5-love-languages-5.title: Relationship Bachiye Rakhar Secrets
the-5-love-languages-5.description: Bhalobasha e pora khub e shohoj kintu shei bhalobasha dhore rakha khub e kotheen. Demnads, struggles, daily life er shomoshyar modhye diye ki bhabe nijer shomporko ke bachiye rakha jaye and ebong grow kora jaye. Ei shob nana rokom secrets janar jonnyo shune nin ei book summary.

get-smart-2.title: Get Smart
get-smart-2.description: Ningalude jeevithathinte oro mekhalayilum kooduthal bhudhipoorvavum vijayakaravumaakan ningale sahayikkuna oru mikacha pusthakamanu Get Smart. Mikacha career, santhoshakaramaya bandhangal, vyakthigatha valarcha - ithellam 'Get Smart' enna ee Kuku Bytes ningalk kaivaraan sahayikkum.

the-rise-and-fall-of-benito-mussolini.title: Benito Mussolini: दुनिया का बदनाम तानाशाह
the-rise-and-fall-of-benito-mussolini.description: Benito Mussolini ka naam jab bhi liya jaata hai, sabke zehen mein khauf aur nafrat ki aandhi umad jaati hai. Fascism ko badhawa dene wala ye saksh aakhir kaise is vichaar ko sweekrutee di aur iske chalte antarashtriya rajneeti mein iska kya prabhav pada, jaane ke liye suniye Benito Mussolini ki rochak jeevan katha.

chanakya-in-daily-life-8.title: Chanakya in Daily Life
chanakya-in-daily-life-8.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

devasur-sangram.title: Devasur Sangram

ab-tum-hi-ho.description: वेद अपने प्‍यार का इजहार कर अस्मि को हासिल कर लेता है, लेकिन अस्मि वेद की साजिश से पूरी तरह अनजान है... अस्मि अब दो भाईयों वेद और रूद के बीच एक अमानत बन गई है... कौन सी साजिश रची है वेद ने? क्‍या रूद्र भी इसमें शामिल है? अस्मि साजिश का शिकार होगी या बच जाएगी? सुनें, दोस्‍ती, प्‍यार और परिवार के बीच बुनी गई चौंकानेवाले रिश्‍तों के सच्‍चाई की कहानी।
