Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

techie-wife-her-romeo.title: Techie Wife & Her Romeo
techie-wife-her-romeo.description: Romeo’s story begins in poverty and humiliation, as he struggles to save his hospitalized mother while being denied money, mocked at work, and treated as disposable by people with wealth and status. His desperation is repeatedly blocked by doctors, employers, and elites who use payment, reputation, and power to control access to care. Around him, small disputes over gifts, antiques, and status keep turning into larger tests of dignity, and Romeo is often accused of fraud or worthlessness before he can prove himself. Saloni enters as a crucial force in his life, first by paying the hospital bill and publicly claiming him as her husband, then by standing beside him as family pressure and social judgment close in. Their bond becomes tangled with inheritance, marriage expectations, and rival claims, making Romeo a target in a household battle over legitimacy and belonging. At the same time, the story widens into business and property conflicts, including a land auction, hidden treasure, and schemes to seize valuable assets. Romeo gains moments of recognition when he exposes a fake antique scam and helps uncover the land’s secret, but each success also draws more suspicion and danger. A supernatural thread deepens the stakes when Annaji’s recovery after ten years in a wheelchair is linked to black magic and a family deity, suggesting that Romeo’s rise may carry a dangerous cost. The family conflict then hardens into open revenge, with factory raids, illegal records, and plots aimed directly at Romeo. He is publicly stripped of his car, house, and money, showing how quickly his fragile standing can be taken away. Saloni remains tied to him through love and destiny, even as others try to redirect her future through marriage and succession politics. Avinash and Rishabh push a secret plan to locate the couple, hide their own involvement, and seize the couple’s property. Their scheme escalates into threats, drugging, ambushes, and assassination attempts, turning the conflict from social humiliation into physical danger. Romeo repeatedly steps in as Saloni’s protector, and she in turn confesses her love after surviving a trap. The violence broadens into a gang war and murder investigation, with police arrests widening the crisis around Ritendhar’s death. By the end of the batch, Romeo is no longer just a poor man fighting for his mother’s treatment; he is caught in a struggle over love, inheritance, survival, and the right to exist without being erased.

i-crave-blood.title: I Crave Blood
i-crave-blood.description: An orphaned scrap-scavenger on the toxic Yamuna riverbank secretly hosts a blood-drinking nano-parasite that cures his rotting lungs, giving him lethal powers to fight a corrupt kingpin who exploits child laborers.

history-of-north-madras.title: History Of North Madras
history-of-north-madras.description: Chennai vada chennai nu gethaa andha area ah serndhavanga perumai ah pesuvanga. Pala varalaaru sirappugal North madras ku iruku. Ennalam nu indha audio la therinjikonga.

sundarboner-kotha.title: Sundarbaner Kotha
sundarboner-kotha.description: Sundarban Aamader Kache Ek Monorom Porjoton Kendro. Bigoto Koyekbochore Nana Somosyar Sommuhin Hoyeche Ei Sundarban, Se Prakitik Biporjoy Hok Ba Monushyo Sristhi Karon. Kintu Kokhono Ki Vebe Dekhechen Kivabe Gore Uthlo Ei Jayga? Kivabe Jibondhara Otibahito Koren Ei Elakar Manushra? Biporjoy Ele Kivabe Mokabila Koren Tara? Ei Jayga Niy Ki Vabna Royeche Goverment Er? Ki Ki Nishedhagga Royeche ? Thik Ki Ki Itihas Lukiye Royeche Ei Jaygay? Eirokom Kichu Jana-Ojana Kotha Jante Shune Nin Ei Audiobook.

nishaanebaz-king.title: Nishaanebaz King
nishaanebaz-king.description: The story begins with a covert sniper mission in which Rohan and veteran Gun Master G-9 complete an impossible long-range kill. G-9 then frames the mission as part of a larger threat involving the Pakistan army, the ISI, and something called Dancing Elephant, but the briefing is cut short by an explosion. From there, the drama shifts into a local power struggle around a petrol pump and shooting academy, where a widow and her daughter are pressured by Sandy over property and control. Sandy uses inheritance claims, intimidation, and even marriage as leverage, making the family’s survival depend on resisting him. Rohan keeps appearing as a hidden sharpshooter, and his precision in gun duels and contests suggests he is more than a simple outsider. The academy side of the story becomes a public arena for hierarchy, pride, and skill, with Sharanpreet trying to hold her side together while elite marksmen and officers test one another. Rohan is repeatedly underestimated because of his low status, yet he keeps stepping into dangerous challenges and proving himself under pressure. One of the contests turns especially tense when he is asked to face stronger opponents, and the crowd’s mockery only sharpens the humiliation around him. A rare shooting technique surfaces in the conflict, hinting at a deeper connection between Rohan and the people already tied to the academy. The rivalry widens when a mysterious unseen shooter appears, showing that the contest is no longer just about one duel but about hidden talent and control. Kiyara, also called Kiara, then enters as a feared sharpshooter with a dangerous reputation and a clear link to G-9. Her arrival shifts the conflict from simple competition to questions of legacy, training, and who truly owns the best technique. When she successfully lands G-9’s signature curved-bullet shot, the crowd is forced to recognize that connection. That public proof humiliates the opposition and confirms that the old master’s influence still shapes the field. Across both the property war and the shooting rivalry, the stakes keep rising from personal pressure to public survival. By the end, the widow is pushed toward a formal shooting contest that will decide land, status, and the safety of the vulnerable girl beside her. The show’s arc is driven by hidden identities, contested inheritance, and the constant threat that skill with a gun will decide who keeps power.

khufiya-soldier.title: Khufiya Soldier
khufiya-soldier.description: In a small, forgotten police station, everyone sees Kabir as nothing more than a timid, insignificant home guard. But behind his quiet demeanour lies a dangerous secret—one that could determine the fate of the entire nation. When a notorious arms smuggler suddenly recognizes Kabir and calls him by a name that should belong to a dead man, everything changes. Who is this mysterious guard, and why has he chosen to remain hidden?

jyotiba-phoole.title: Jyotiba Phoole
jyotiba-phoole.description: This Hindi biography traces the life of Jyotiba Phule (1827–1890), India's pioneering 19th-century social reformer. It chronicles his fight against caste discrimination, his founding of the Satyashodhak Samaj, and his radical work — alongside wife Savitribai — to educate girls and the oppressed, opening India's first school for girls in 1848. A tribute to the man widely regarded as the father of India's social revolution.

1640eac9-5216-42b2-b3d6-e16bd93273c5.title: Operation Osama
1640eac9-5216-42b2-b3d6-e16bd93273c5.description: Kuku FM lekar aaya hai ek hairatangez kahani – Operation Osama. adventures-of-buttercup-bear.title: Adventures of Buttercup Bear
adventures-of-buttercup-bear.description:
Advanture of Buttercup Bear
ಬಟರ್‌ಕಪ್ ಬೆರ್ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಜೊತೆ ಹೊಸ ಸಾಹಸಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತಾ. ಪ್ರೀತಿ, ಧೈರ್ಯ, ಸ್ನೇಹ, ಮತ್ತು ಸೃಜನಾತ್ಮಕತೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಧೈರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾ, ಪುಟ್ಟ ಕರಡಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ತರುವ ಜರ್ನಿ ಇದು.

who-will-cry-when-you-die-4.description: Jibone Cholte Gele Hasi- Kanna Sobkichui Thakbe. Kende Vasanor Theke Hese Jibon Katate Parlei Aapni Sofol. Kokhno Vebe Dekhechen Aapni Ei Prithibi Chere Chole Jayoyar Por Aapnar Jonyo Ke Vabbe? Ke Aapnar Kotha Mone Kore Kandbe? Aapni Ei Prithibite Keno Esechen? how-to-become-pro-in-fortnite.title: How to Become A Pro in Fortnite
how-to-become-pro-in-fortnite.description: Aaj gaming Industry boom pe hai, covid ke baad se ye market aur garm ho gaya hai, Pubg aur Fortnite abhi ke time ke sabse best games hai jinhe worldwide khela jata hai. Fortnite mein pro banne ke liye aapko Fundamentals, Tips aur Tricks ki knowledge honi chahiye is series mein aap Fortnite ki Interesting Story ke sath sath isme pro banne ka tarika bhi seekh sakte hai.

history-of-nato-vs-russia-1.title: History of NATO vs Russia
history-of-nato-vs-russia-1.description: How do former sworn enemies transcend long-standing rivalry on a diplomatic level? In the post-Cold War security relations between NATO and Russia, diplomacy has developed into a common, albeit not always obvious, practice between the two formerly adversaries. According to experts, the intense symbolic power struggles that plagued the relationship ever since NATO started its enlargement at the geographical and functional levels are to blame for this limited pacification. In this series, we take a deep dive into the annals of political history, from the formation of NATO to the collapse of the USSR, and explain how NATO and Russia undermined a possibly long-lasting alliance after the end of the Cold War. Listen to the astounding story of a rivalry that reshaped the world.

security-analysis.title: Investment Ka Funda
security-analysis.description: Bade Bujurgon ka Diya ek gyan to pata hi hoga na, ki “ Paisa Kamane Se Badi Baat Hai Kaise Us Paise Ko Kahin Aur Laga Kar Aur Kamaya Jaye”. Baat bhi ek dam sahi hai Guru. Lekin kahan lagayen aur kaise lagayen ka gyan to bahut kam diya gaya hai. To bas is sawal ka jawab diya hai ek anubhavi aur share market se akoot paisa kamane wale business man Warren Buffett ne unke dost Benjamin Graham ne is kitab "Investment Ka Funda" mein.

rise-of-isro-1.title: RISE OF ISRO
rise-of-isro-1.description: ನಮ್ಮ ಭಾರತದ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ISRO! ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಕೀರ್ತಿ ಪತಾಕೆಯನ್ನು ಹಾರಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ISRO ಮಹತ್ವದ ಪಾತ್ರ ವಹಿಸಿದೆ. ಆದರೆ ISRO ಏಕಾಏಕಿ ಈ ಹಂತಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದರ ಹಿಂದೆ ಅನೇಕ ನೋವು, ಸೋಲು, ತ್ಯಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ಅವಮಾನಗಳಿವೆ. ಈ ಮಹಾಯಾನ ಹೇಗೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಯಿತು? ISRO ಇಲ್ಲಿವರೆಗೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳೇನು?  ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ರೋಚಕ ವಿಚಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ RISE OF ISRO ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್. ಕೇವಲ KukuFMನಲ್ಲಿ!

dare-to-dream.title: Dare to Dream - The Forgotten Heroines
dare-to-dream.description: 'Dare to Dream' is a gripping audio series that brings to life the stories of fearless women who quietly shook the world of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics i.e STEM. From late-night experiments in dark labs to bold rebellions against society’s limits, each episode explores their struggles and hidden victories. A tribute to the silent revolutionaries whose discoveries helped shape the future of our world.

iruttil-veitha-kuri.title: இருட்டில் வைத்த குறி
iruttil-veitha-kuri.description: சிங்கப்பூரில் இருக்கும் ரப்பர் தோட்டத்தை விற்பதற்காக அண்ணன், தம்பி இருவரும் சிங்கப்பூர் செல்கிறார்கள். அங்கு, டைமண்டைக் கடத்திய ஒரு பெண்ணின் கார் விபத்துக்குள்ளாகிறது.  அந்த டைமண்டை இருவரும் திருடிவிடுகிறார்கள். அதை எப்படியாவது ஊருக்குக் கொண்டுவர முயற்சி செய்கிறார்கள். அவர்களின் முயற்சி கைகூடியதா?

byabsar-jonyo-loan-neben-kivabe.title: Byabsar Jonyo Loan Neben Kivabe?
byabsar-jonyo-loan-neben-kivabe.description: Oneke Vaben Bank Theke Loan Niye Ekta Byabsa Shurur Kotha, Kintu Sothik Poramorsher Ovabe Seta Kora Hoye Othe Na. Sei Sothik Poramorsho Dite KUKU FM Niye Elo Ei Bisesh Audio Show, Ja Aapnake Janabe Kivabe Bank Theke Loan Niye Byabsa Shuru Kora Jay. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Nin Ebong Egiye Cholun Aapnar Swopno Puroner Dike.

gumnami-baba-ya-undercover-netaji.title: Gumnami Baba ya Undercover Netaji
gumnami-baba-ya-undercover-netaji.description: In 1945, the world was told that Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose had died in a plane crash. But missing records and unanswered questions kept the mystery alive. Decades later, a secretive ascetic died behind closed doors in Faizabad. Inside his room were private photographs of Netaji's family and documents linked to the Azad Hind Fauj. The discovery stunned the nation and raised one chilling question—Did Netaji ever die, or did he spend decades living in India as Gumnami Baba?

dropaudi-murmu.title: Droupadi Murmu - The President of India
dropaudi-murmu.description: Agar Aapse koi Adivasi samaj ki mahila jo ki ek Gareeb parivar se samabandh rakhti hai Kahe ki ek din Main Bharat ki Rashtrapati banungi to aap kya kahenge? Sayad Aaj aap Droupadi Murmu ki safalta dekhne ke baad aasani se keh de ki Haan aap jarur banoge. Lekin agar thoda ruk kar socha jaye to samajh aayega ye bahut mushkil hai Jo kar dikhaya hai Droupadi Murmu ne. Is Series mein ham janenge unke sangharsh ki kahani, kaise hasil kiya itna bada mukam?

feel-my-love.title: Feel My Love
feel-my-love.description: ஒரு பெயிலியர்  உன்ன, நான் ஏண்டா கல்யாணம் பண்ணனும்ன்னு மொத்த சொத்தையும் இழந்து நின்ன அம்ரித்த நடுத்தெருல கழட்டி விட்டுட்டு போனா நித்யா... அவள பழி வாங்க மறுபடியும் பணக்காரன் ஆறான் அம்ரித். ஆனா அவன் ரெண்டு வருஷம் கழிச்சு நித்யாவ பார்க்கும் போது... அவங்க வாழ்கைல ஒரு பெரிய திருப்புமுனை வருது...

the-business-school-2.title: Janun Network Marketing-Er Khuntinati
the-business-school-2.description: Network Marketing Sobdota Shunle Oneke Eriye Jan. Vaben Etay Kono Bhobisyot Nei. Kintu Ekta Sofol Byabsar Khetre Er Vumika Royeche. Ekjon Sofol Byabsai Hoye Uthhte Kivabe Sahajya Kore Ei Network Marketing? Er Valo-Kharap Dikgulo Ki Ki? Kivabe Nijer Arthik Bhobisyot Niyontron Kora Jay? Kivabe Ei Network Marketing Er Sohayotay Dhoni Hoyoya Jay? Eirokom Kichu Proshner Uttor Jante Aasun Shune Ni Ei Audiobook .

so-good-they-cant-ignore-you.title: Apne Passion ko Pehchano
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you.description: Aaj kal har koi kehta hai "follow your Passion" but kya ye sahi hai?! kaafi log passion follow karne ke path par jane ke liye apna sab kuch daav par laga dete hai. Passion wo nahi jo waqt ke sath badal jaye! passion wo hai jo kai saalo ki mehnat aur practice se banta hai , Log aksar iss baat se confuse ho jaate hai! So Good they can't ignore you book summary me aap kuch aise rules jaan sakte hai jinse apne aapko inta behtar bana sakte hai ke Success apke piche piche dodti ayegi.  To chaliye sunte hai....

85e58ab7-69bc-4290-be9d-7b3ac64dd7b2.title: Chaahat: Ek Murder Mystery
85e58ab7-69bc-4290-be9d-7b3ac64dd7b2.description: Aapke manoranjan ke liye hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain ek aur romanchak kahani hai jo ek gumshuda aurat ki tahqiqaat ki hai. Jatin Mehra ki patni Bhavana achanak laapata ho jaati hai.  Inspector Arjun bina koi waqt gavaaye investigation shuru kar dete hain aur phir saamne aate hai kayeen chhipi hui qisse. Kya Inspector Arjun Bhavana ko insaaf dilane mein safal ho payenge? Jaane ke liye suniye Chaahat - Ek Murder Mystery.

the-mysterious-affair-at-styles.title: The Mysterious Affair At Styles
the-mysterious-affair-at-styles.description: Uncover the brilliance of Hercule Poirot in his debut case, "The Mysterious Affair at Styles." Filled with suspense, clever plot twists, and a captivating narrative, this show is a must-listen for mystery enthusiasts. Join Poirot on this thrilling journey and see if you can solve the case before he does.

my-imperfect-love.title: My Imperfect Love
my-imperfect-love.description: Fashion designer banne ka sapna lekar Shruti London pahunchti hai. London me vo takraati hai Ameer baap ki bigdi aulaad Rohan se. Is ajab gazab Imperfect jodi ke beech nazdeekiyan aane lagti hain lekin Rohan apni personal life aur past ke karan chaah kar bhi shruti ko apna nahi pa Raha. Aakhir kya hai inki love story ki uljhan… Janne ke liye sunte rahiye "My Imperfect Love"

the-secret-affair.title: The Secret Affair
the-secret-affair.description: ఒక ఆడపిల్లగా ప్రతి ఒక్కరికీ పెళ్లి పట్ల ఎన్నో కలలు ఉంటాయి. కానీ, మాయ అనే సాధారణ యువతికి, ఆమె కలలు కన్న జీవితాన్ని నాశనం చేస్తూ, తల్లిదండ్రులు ఇష్టం లేని పెళ్లి చేశారు. ఆమె భర్త విక్రమ్‌తో సంబంధం భవిష్యత్తులో ఏదో భారీ మలుపు తిరుగుతుంది. అదే సమయంలో, మాయ గతం నుంచి వచ్చిన ఫర్హాన్ అనే వ్యక్తి మాయ జీవితంలో తిరిగి ప్రవేశించాడు. ఆమె భర్తతో సంబంధం, ఫర్హాన్‌తో ఉన్న అనుబంధం జీవితాన్ని మలుపుతిప్పే కీలక ఘట్టాలను సృష్టిస్తోంది.

Talikota-War--सनातन-धर्म-और-साम्राज्य-का.title: Talikota War : सनातन धर्म और साम्राज्य का अंतिम संग्राम
Talikota-War--सनातन-धर्म-और-साम्राज्य-का.description: Krishna nadi ke kinare 80 saal ke boodhe samrat Aliya Rama Raya ne 1 lakh sainikon ke saath wo jung ladi, jisne Bharat ka bhavishya hi badal diya. Jaaniye Talicota ke us khooni yuddh ki kahani, jahan ek din mein poore desh ka naksha badal gaya. kyon es jung ko Sanatan ki raksha ka mahasangram kaha gaya? Es sawal ka jawab bhi aapko rongte khade karne wali es historical kahani mein milega.

your-guide-for-parenting.title: Your Guide To Teenage Parenting
your-guide-for-parenting.description: As a parent, hum sabse zyada concerned rehte hain apne teenage bacchon ki parvarish ko lekar, kahin wo kisi galat sangat mein na pad jayein, unka jhalla kar baat karna, khud ko isolated rakhna. Aise bahut sare concerns hain maa-baap ke aur utne he concerns hai bacchon ke jinhe lagta hai ki unke parents unhe nahi samajh rahe hain, ya unhe zyada control kar rahe hain. Yeh sari baatein dono he parties ko pareshan karti hain. Toh chaliye is ice ko break karte hain aur jaante hain inh problems ke solutions ko.

secret-empire-4.title: Secret Empire
secret-empire-4.description: Bankrupt CEO Samar Malhotra er bou Tara taakey baar baar divorce debar bhoy dekhato. Shoshurbari r lokjonrao khub mazak korto. Kintu ekdin Tara emon ek raaz jaante parlo jeta tar jibon bodlee dilo. Samar er bankruptcy er pechone chilo tar nijer maa Kamla er haat! Aar Samar shob jene o bankrupt howar natok korchilo. Kintu keno? Duniyar shobboche boro banking group er CEO keno ei abhinoy korlo? Protishshodh? Naki chilo kono boro master plan?

adhura-pyaar-pura-sach.title: Adhura Pyaar, Pura Sach
adhura-pyaar-pura-sach.description: Sheher aayi Priyanshi ko mila sapno jaisa pyaar aur ek achhi naukri lekin ek din saamne aaya aisa sach, jo uski saari zindagi ulat kar rakh deta hai. Har rishte ka ek doosra chehra hai, har raaz ek naye jhatke ke saath. Pyaar, dhokha, aur zakhmon ke beech Priyanshi ko apni awaaz buland karni hai. Kya woh sach ko duniya ke saamne laa paayegi? Ya chehre badalte rahenge, aur sach dabta rahega?

3da8e020-1e7e-44df-9257-f1019821d802.title: Viral Vishwaas
3da8e020-1e7e-44df-9257-f1019821d802.description:
Vinayak has failed his police exam four times. His family has written him off. His fifth and final attempt is tomorrow — and the only one who hasn't given up on him is Bappa, whose photo stays on his phone wallpaper through every humiliation.

When he sacrifices his last attempt to save a life, it looks like the end.

This is a story of Vinayak — a man whose vishwas in Ganpati Bappa never wavered, and whether Bappa's plan was bigger than any exam result.

puri-jagannadh.title: Puri Jagannadh
puri-jagannadh.description: పూరి కి మొదటి సినిమా అవకాశం ఎలా వచ్చింది? అతని జీవితంలో ఎదుర్కున్న ఆర్థిక కష్టాలేంటి? మీకు మోటివేషన్ ను కల్గించే మన పూరి కథ మీకోసం

what-is-digital-gold.title: What Is Digital Gold?
what-is-digital-gold.description: സ്വര്‍ണത്തോളം സേഫായ ഒരു നിക്ഷേപം ഈ ലോകത്ത് വേറെയില്ല. എന്തിനൊക്കെ വില കുറഞ്ഞാലും സ്വര്‍ണത്തിന് വില കുറയില്ല. നിക്ഷേപമെന്ന നിലയ്ക്ക് സ്വര്‍ണം വീട്ടില്‍ വാങ്ങി സൂക്ഷിക്കാന്‍ പേടിയാണെങ്കില്‍ ഏറ്റവും നല്ല ഓപ്ഷനാണ് ഡിജിറ്റല്‍ ഗോള്‍ഡ്. കൂടുതല്‍ അറിയാന്‍ കേള്‍ക്കാം.

insurance-coverages-you-need.title: Insurance Coverages You Need
insurance-coverages-you-need.description: Insurancekal edukkuka ennu parayunnathu pazhchilavaayittanu palarum innum karuthunnathu. Enthinanu masaa maasam allenkil varshaa varsham veruthe oru thuka kalayunnathu? Ithanu palarudeyum chinthagathi. Ennal enthu kondaanu insurance nirbhandhamayum edukkanamennu parayunnathu? Athinte praadhanyam enthanu? Ethellam ariyan kelkku, 'Insurance Coverages You Need' enna show.

sai-baba-5.title: Sai Baba: Sabka Malik Ek
sai-baba-5.description: Shirdi ke Sai Baba ke darshan se judey anek chamatkar aur unke prati vishvas par adharit ye show apko kuch aisi kahaniyon ke beech le jayega ki aap shocked reh jayenge. Is show mein Sai Baba ke anubhavon aur unki karunamayi shaktiyon ki katha bhi kahi jayegi. Show mein Baba ke chamatkarik roop mein sharan lene wale logon ki zindagi mein hone wale badlavon ke bare mein bhi bataya jayega. Sai baba se jude har sawal aaj jawab apko is show ke ant mein milega.

alcohol-kitna-sahi-kitna-galat.title: Alcohol? Kitna Sahi... Kitna galat....
alcohol-kitna-sahi-kitna-galat.description: Kya aapki enjoyment bhi addiction mein badal chuki hai? Ya aapke aas paas aise log hain, jo alcohol jaisi toxic cheez ko bina soche samjhe zaroorat se jyada consume karte hain. Toh jaaniye aise solutions, jo aapko na sirf alcohol ke negative effects ke baare mein batayenge balki kitna alcohol peena sahi hai aur kitna galat? Iske baare mein aapko pata chalega. Suniye abhi.

jallikattu-2.title: Jallikattu
jallikattu-2.description: Namma Thamizhargal Udaiya Veera Vilayattu la romba mukkiyamana onnu intha jallikattu. Jallikattu Pathina Sanga Kaala Padalgal la thodangi sama Kaala Varalaru varaikkum alasi aarayura Virivana Audio Puthagam Idhu. Ovvoru Thamizhanum Kattayam therinjika vendiya Thagavalgal idhula irukku. Kelunga !

india-as-vishwaguru.title: INDIA as VISHWAGURU
india-as-vishwaguru.description: BHARATHA.! Ivatthu namma deshavanna idi prapanchave thirugi nodthide. Sada pragathi pathadattha hejje idtha, prathi kshethradallu sadhaneya haadiyalli munnugthiro Bharathakke Bharathave sarisaati.! Innenu 2047 ra hotthige Bharatha, Vishwaguru agutthe annodu halavu pandithara maathu. Hagadre nijakku India, Vishwaguru aguttha.? Ega naavu elliddeve.? Shikshana, Vignana, Thanthragnana, Ahaara, Aarthika vahivaatu, Sene, heege namma desha eshtu strong.? 1947 rinda eechege enella badalavanegalagive.? Mundina daari hegide.? Idellavannu thilkollo kuthoohala nimgu idiya.? Keli 'INDIA as VISHWAGURU' audio book. Kannadadalli matra.!

thalaimuraigal.title: Thalaimuraigal
thalaimuraigal.description: நீல. பத்பநாபன் எழுதியிருக்கும் தலைமுறைகள் எனும் சிறந்த படைப்பை ஆடியோ வடிவில் Kuku FM App-இல் கேளுங்கள்.

f29ffa0f-8c5d-4472-9ff0-de6f7d8c4f62.title: Main Teri Kaatil
f29ffa0f-8c5d-4472-9ff0-de6f7d8c4f62.description: Jaipur ke pratishthit Shah parivaar ki Avantika Shah par apne premi Doctor Faizal Ali ki hatya ka aarop hai. Avantika apne upar lage is aarop ko nakar rahi hai par kya wo sach mein nirdosh hai? Is rahasya aur suspense se bhari kahani mein janiye kaise Avantika, uska parivaar, naukar aur padosi is hatya ke maamle ko aur pechida bana dete hain.

yashaswibhava.title: Yashaswibhava
yashaswibhava.description: ಡಾ. ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅನನ್ಯ ಸಾಧನೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಯಶಸ್ವೀ ಲೇಖಕರಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅವರ ಲೇಖನಗಳು ವಾಸ್ತವಿಕತೆಯ ಕಥಾವಸ್ತು, ಆಳವಾದ ವಿಚಾರಧಾರೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಮನೋವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಪರಿಸರವನ್ನು ಓದುಗರ ಮುಂದಿಡುವ ಔದಾರ್ಯದಿಂದ ಹೆಸರು ಗಳಿಸಿವೆ. "ಯಶಸ್ವಿಭವ" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಅವರ ಜೀವನದ ಹಾದಿ, ಸಾಧನೆಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವದ ಆಳವನ್ನ ವಿವರಿಸುವ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ಆತನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಗಿರುವ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಶ್ರೋತೃಗಳ ಮುಂದೆ ತೆರೆದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ್ ಬದುಕಿನ ಹಲವು ಮಾದರಿಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಗುರಿ ಸಾಧನೆ, ಪ್ರತಿಷ್ಠೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ನಿಭಾಯಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

thrikottoor-peruma.title: തൃക്കോട്ടൂര്‍ പെരുമ
thrikottoor-peruma.description: കഴിഞ്ഞുപോയൊരു ചരിത്രഗാഥയുടെ ഈണം തത്തിക്കളിക്കുന്ന തൃക്കോട്ടൂരംശത്തിന്റെ ഊടുവഴികളിലും തൃക്കോട്ടൂരങ്ങാടിയിലും മാടത്തുമ്മല്‍ തറവാട്ടിലുമൊക്കെയായി പടര്‍ന്നു പന്തലിച്ചു കിടക്കുന്ന കഥകള്‍. നാടോടിക്കഥകളുടെ മൊഴിവഴക്കവും ഗ്രാമ്യതയും നാട്ടുവര്‍ത്തമാനങ്ങളുടെ കഴക്കെട്ടുകളും കലര്‍ന്ന ആഖ്യാനത്തിലൂടെ ഒരു നാടോടി ഇതിഹാസം തീര്‍ക്കുകയാണ് യു.എ. ഖാദര്‍. കേരളസാഹിത്യ അക്കാദമി അവാര്‍ഡ് നേടിയ കൃതി.

நான்-அசைவன்.title: Naan Asaivan
நான்-அசைவன்.description: Ovvoru bournami andrum rattha veri kondu alaium vishnuvidam maati uyir vidukindranar ilam pengal. Pidikka Muyalum vishalidam pidipadamal Vishallin kaathali aarthiyaiyum kadaththi vidukiran vishnu. Aduththu enna nadanthathu? Viruviruppana 'Naan Asaivan'. Kettu makizhungal.

somoy-noy-nijer-mind-ke-manage-korte-sik.title: Somoy Noy Nijer Mind-Ke Manage Korte Shikhun
somoy-noy-nijer-mind-ke-manage-korte-sik.description: Aamder Onek Somoy Emon Hoy Je Mon Chaiche Eta Kori, Kintu Somoyer Jonyo Kore Uthte Pari Na. Aabar Emon Onek Somoy Hoy Somoy Bachanor Jonyo Taratari Sob Kore Felechen, Kintu Ja Productivity Aasha Korechilen Seivabe Pelen Na. Tai Dhondhe Pore Jan Ki Kora Uchit. Aar Chinta Nei Sei Dhondho Dur Korte Kuku Fm Niye Eseche Ei Bishesh Audiobook, Jekhane Aapni Jante Parben Kivabe Nijer Mind Ke Manage Korte Hoy. Echarao Jante Parben Kivabe Kaje Productivity Barano Jay. Nishchoi Jante Icche Korche Ki Sei Upayguli? Aasun Shune Neyoya Jak.

the-secret-enemy.title: Youngest Secret Billionaire
the-secret-enemy.description: Cantene me kaam karne wala ek  waiter Vinay ek aise secret enemy se badla lena chahta hai jise koyi janta tak nahi. Lekin usse jude hain Vinay ke past ke taar aur present ki hakikat . College me apni gareebi ko lekar bully  hone wala Vinay mazbur hai yeh chhupane ke liye ki Asal me woh ek Billionaire hai. Aakhir kya reason hai itni badi sachchayi chhupane ka? Aur kaun hai woh Secret enemy jisne Vinay ki poori zindagi badal kar rakh di? Aayiye jante hain is naye show "The Secret Enemy" me

flying-shoes.title: फ्लाइंग शूज
flying-shoes.description: America ke scientist Lucifer aur Rubesca Milkar flying shoes ka aavishkaar kar rahe hai, lekin jaise hi shoes taayar hote hai waise hi vo gaayab ho jaate hai, scientist pareshan hai ki flying shoes kaha gaayab ho gaye, kya koi un shoes ka galat istemaal kar raha gai, dono scientist khufiya tarika apnakar shoes dhundne ki koshish kar rahe hai, kya unhe shoes mil payenge? Flying does kisne chori kiye honge? Kya wo kisi galat haatho mein lag gaye hai aur koi unka galata istemaal kar raha hai, jaan ne ke liye suniye hamari kahani The Flying Shoes.

നിന്റെ-ഓര്‍മ്മയ്ക്ക്‌.title: നിൻ്റെ ഓർമ്മയ്ക്ക്
നിന്റെ-ഓര്‍മ്മയ്ക്ക്‌.description: പന്തീരാണ്ടിന് ശേഷം ലീലയെക്കുറിച്ചോര്‍ത്തുപോയി..വിളറിയ നിറത്തില്‍ വിടര്‍ന്ന കണ്ണുകളും കഴുത്തുവരെ വളര്‍ത്തിയ ചുരുണ്ട ചെമ്പന്‍ മുടിയുമുള്ള ഒരു പെണ്‍കുട്ടി. വെളുത്ത സില്‍ക്കില്‍ ചുവന്ന വലിയ പൂക്കളുള്ള ഒരു ഗൗണാണിട്ടിട്ടുള്ളത്. ആറു വര്‍ഷത്തിന് ശേഷം നാട്ടില്‍ വരുന്ന അച്ഛനേക്കാളുമധികം മറ്റുള്ളവരുടെ ശ്രദ്ധയാകര്‍ഷിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത് ആ പെണ്‍കുട്ടിയാണ്. ലീല... വളരെക്കാലത്തിന് ശേഷം പഴയ പെട്ടിക്കടിയില്‍ ആ റബ്ബര്‍ മൂങ്ങയെക്കിട്ടിയപ്പോള്‍ ലീലയെ ഓര്‍ത്തു.. വായിക്കാം എംടിയുടെ അനശ്വരമായ കഥ 'നിന്റെ ഓര്‍മ്മയ്ക്ക്' എംടിയുടെ തന്നെ ശബ്ദത്തില്‍ ജോൺസൺ മാസ്റ്ററുടെ സംഗീതത്തിൽ.

sinhalese-monarchy.title: Sinhalese Monarchy
sinhalese-monarchy.description: India oda inaintha nilam dhaan Srilanka. how-i-quit-google-to-sell-samosas-1.title: Sofol Businessman Hoye Uthun
how-i-quit-google-to-sell-samosas-1.description: Nijeke sofol business person hishebe ki bhabe dekhben? Ashole saradine kajer phanke khabar e sosti dite pare manush ke. Manusher mon ar moner modhye thaka sopner michil guloi amader ke notun notun jinisher proti dharon toiri korte sahajyo kore. Ei boi tir sarangsho ti asha korchi apnader inspire korte parbe. Ei srangshe apnara jante parben je ki bhabe Munaf Kapadia mane lekhok nijer Google er chakri chhere notun kore ekti byabsha shuru korechilen ar ki bhabe sekhane sofolota orjon korechilen.

ചോരപ്പുഴ-.title: Chorapuzha
ചോരപ്പുഴ-.description: നഗരത്തെ അക്ഷരാർത്ഥത്തിൽ ഞെട്ടിച്ച് കൊണ്ട് ഫോർട്ട്കൊച്ചിയിലും പരിസരങ്ങളിലുമായി ഒരു കൊലപാതക പരമ്പര അരങ്ങേറുന്നു. നിഷ്ഠൂരമായ ആ കൊലകൾക്ക് പിന്നിൽ സത്യത്തിൽ അതിസമർത്ഥയായ ഒരു പെൺ ക്രിമിനൽ ആയിരുന്നു. അന്വേഷണം അവളിലേക്ക് എത്തുന്നതോടെ കൊലയാളിയും പോലീസും അധോലോകവും തമ്മിലുള്ള ഒരു മാരക കളിക്ക് തുടക്കം കുറിക്കുന്നു. പകയും, പ്രതികാരവും, രക്തചൊരിച്ചിലും നിറഞ്ഞ സംഭ്രമജനകമായ കഥ.

kya-aapki-kundali-mein-hai-rajyog.title: Kya Aapki Kundali Mein Hai Rajyog?

mount-athos.title: Mount Athos: A Place Where All The Females Are Banned
mount-athos.description: India main aap sab ne sabrimala temple women activism amidst ban toh khub suna hoga par kya sabrimala temple ek akeli jagha hai jahan par females ke aane par rok hai? jee nahi, duniya main aise bahut sari jagha hain jahan par females banned hain, unhi main se ek hai mount athos, Europe main situated yeh mountain ghar hain monastries ka, toh kya reasons hai athos par woemn ban ke aur 7 other places jahan par females ka jana banned hai , yeh sab rochak baate jaanenge iss original audioseries main toh suniye yeh exclusive creation of KUKU FM

sakshi-4.title: Sakshi
sakshi-4.description: జర్నలిజం తన కళ, తన కళ కోసం ఎంతో కష్టపడింది , ఒక పెద్ద ప్రఖ్యాతి ఉన్న కాలేజీ లో జర్నలిజం పూర్తి చేసింది. చివరకు జాబ్ కూడా సంపాదించింది కానీ, తన జాబ్ లో చేరిన మొదటి రోజు నుంచే తనకి ఎన్నో సమస్యలు ఎదురయ్యాయి, నేను చదువుకున్న జర్నలిజం ఇది కాదు కథ అనే ఆలోచన తనకి మొదలయింది, ఏమైనా సరే జర్నలిజం అంటే నిజాన్ని చెప్పే వాళ్ళు అని నమ్మిన తన సిద్ధాంతాన్ని వదులుకోకుండా నిజాన్ని మాత్రమే చూపించింది కానీ ఆ క్రమం లో తనకి అన్ని అవాంతరాలే ఎదురయ్యాయి, అవ్వని దాటుకొని ఆమె ధర్యంగా నిలబడుతుందా ? తెలుసుకోండి మన Kuku FM lo ఉన్న సాక్షి ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

रुद्रावतार--लेखिका--अंकु-ठाकुर.title: रुद्रावतार
रुद्रावतार--लेखिका--अंकु-ठाकुर.description: Shivanshi Ka Balatkar Ussi Ke College ke 4 Ladke Karte hei Lekig Galatfehmi Se Ek  Bejunah Ladka bhi Bhi Piss Jaata hei Jo Inn Chaaro Ka Dost Hota hei. how-to-improve-your-emotional-intelligen.title: How to Improve Your Emotional Intelligence
how-to-improve-your-emotional-intelligen.description: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಫೀಲಿಂಗ್ಸ್ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳೋಕೆ ಹೆಲ್ಪ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ ಈ ಶೋ . ಟೆನ್ಷನ್ ಆಗೋದು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ರಿಲೇಶನ್‌ಶಿಪ್‌ಗಳನ್ನ ಇನ್ನೂ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಇಟ್ಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಈಸಿ ಟಿಪ್ಸ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಎಪಿಸೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಹೊಸ ಟ್ರಿಕ್ಸ್ ಕಲಿತು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಲೈಫ್ ಚೇಂಜ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು! ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಪರ್ಟ್‌ಗಳು ನೀವು ಆಗಬೋದು , ಈ ಟಿಪ್ಸ್ ಫಾಲೋ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರೆ ಸಾಕು - ಆಫೀಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ, ಮನೇಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕಡೆ ಕೂಲ್ ಆಗಿರ್ತೀರಾ! ಒಂದ್ಸಲ ಕೇಳಿ ನೋಡಿ, ಲೈಫೇ ಚೇಂಜ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೊಳಿ "ಹೌ ಟು ಇಂಪ್ರೂವ್ ಯುವರ್ ಎಮೋಷನಲ್ ಇಂಟೆಲಿಜೆನ್ಸ್" ಶೋ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

felani.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. instant-kalyanam.title: Instant Kalyanam
instant-kalyanam.description: ஒரு வேடிக்கையான குழப்பத்தால் கிராமத்து தைரியப் பெண் பானிக்கும், பணக்கார CEO பார்த்திற்கும் கட்டாயத் திருமணம் நடக்கிறது. பார்த்த் தன் அடையாளத்தை மறைக்க, குடும்பச் சண்டைகள், துரோகங்கள் மற்றும் கார்ப்பரேட் சதிகளுக்கு இடையே அவர்களின் போலி பந்தம் மெல்லக் காதலாகிறது. எதிரிகளின் சதியை முறியடித்து, தன் துணிச்சலால் அனைவரின் மரியாதையையும் வெல்லும் பானி, பார்த்திற்கு இணையான அதிகார சக்தியாக உயர்ந்து நிற்கிறாள்.

murdered-bride.title: The Murdered Bride: Jassi Sidhu
murdered-bride.description: Kehte hain Ishq me kahan koi usool hota hai, Agar Ishq ho gya to yaar chahe kaisa bhe ho haar haal me wo qubool hota hai. Aapne aisi bauth saari love story suni hogi jo kavi puri nahi ho paai, Aisi bahut saari love story jiski shuruwat to achi hui par ant bauth he dardnaak raha Aur kahin na kahin us pyar ke dushman koi aur nahi humare apne he hote hain, Mano jaise pyar karna is duniya ka sabse bada crime ho. Aaj ke is original Audio show me hum aisi Prem kahani ke baare me zikar karnege jisme premika ne apne pyar ko bachane ke liye apni aakhri saans tak ladai ki, Aur kis tarh ladki ke ghar wale he uske pyar ke dushman ban gaye, Aur kaise aaj bhe Premi Mithu apne pyar ke justice ka intzar kar rha hai.

From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

unsolved.title: Unsolved
unsolved.description:
For true-crime podcaster Cal Lovett, every missing persons case holds a painful echo of his own past - his sister Margot's unsolved disappearance that has haunted him since childhood. When notorious serial killer Marc Dubois, known as The Woodland Killer, unexpectedly breaks his decades-long silence to request a meeting with Cal, it seems too good for his struggling podcast to pass up. But Dubois's unsettling knowledge about Cal's personal life suggests this is more than just another interview.
Desperate to escape the shadow of this disturbing encounter and salvage his show's plummeting ratings, Cal immerses himself in a cold case from the Scottish Highlands. Thirty-five years ago, a young woman named Layla vanished during a solitary horseback ride, her mount returning without her. While authorities concluded she suffered a tragic accident in the wilderness, Cal's investigation begins to unravel a more sinister truth.
As Cal delves deeper into Layla's disappearance, his own life starts to unravel. Yet he can't pull away from the case, driven by an obsessive need to give Layla's family the closure he never had. But the threads connecting these two mysteries - Layla's vanishing and Dubois's cryptic invitation - may lead Cal to answers about his sister's fate that he's not prepared to face.

super-bodyguard.title: Super Bodyguard
super-bodyguard.description:
The best bodyguards are the ones you never see coming.

Ex-mercenary Lucas "Luke" Grey thought guarding a billionaire's daughter would be a cakewalk compared to his shadowy past. But when Victoria Ashford becomes the target of a sophisticated kidnapping plot, Luke finds himself thrust back into a world of violence and intrigue. As the threats escalate, Luke must use all his skills to keep Victoria safe while unraveling a conspiracy that reaches into the highest echelons of power. In Beverly Hills' glittering mansions and dark alleys alike, danger lurks around every corner - ..and in this high-stakes game, second place is six feet under.

reflection-swami-vivekanand.title: Reflections by Swami Vivekanand
reflection-swami-vivekanand.description: Kya aap jeevan ke sahi mayne khoj rahe hai ? Swami Vivekanand ki shikshaye aur unke jeevan ke anubhav aapko iss khoj mein aapki madad kar sakte hai. Iss book explanation se janiye kaise Vivekanand ne jeevan ki gehraiyon ko samjha.

manipallavam-1.title: மணிபல்லவம் - 1
manipallavam-1.description: இளங்குமரனைத் தான் மணப்பேன் என்று ஒற்றைக் காலில் நிற்கும் சுரமஞ்சரி. காதலே வேண்டாம் என்று வாழும் இளங்குமரன். இருவரில் யாருடைய பிடிவாதம் வென்றது? சங்ககால பூம்புகார் வாழ்க்கையைக் கண்முன்னால் காணும் சுவாரஸ்ய பயணம்...

maximizing-your-productivity.description: Business karna to kaafi log chahte hai, lekin business karte waqt kin chizon ka dhyan rakhna hota hai, ye sirf chuninda logon ko hi pata hota hai. 050581d1-381e-4704-86ff-ba8029e24f4a.title: என் சரித்திரம்
050581d1-381e-4704-86ff-ba8029e24f4a.description: ‘தமிழ்த் தாத்தா’ உ.வே.சா. அவர்கள் எழுதிய, தன் வரலாற்று நூல் இது. தமிழின் ஈடு இணையற்ற இலக்கியப் படைப்புகளை இன்றைக்கு நாம் வாசிக்கிறோம் என்றால், அதற்கு அடிகோலியவர் தமிழ்த் தாத்தா. காலத்தால் போற்றிப் பாதுகாக்கத்தக்க பொக்கிஷப் படைப்புகள் பலவும் கரையான் அரிப்புக்கும், தீயின் நாக்குக்கும், செல் பாதிப்புக்கும் இரையானது தமிழ் மொழிக்கு ஏற்பட்ட பேரிழப்பு. இழந்தவை போனாலும், எஞ்சிய செல்வங்களைக் காப்பாற்றி இன்றைய தமிழ்த் தலைமுறையின் பார்வைக்கு எடுத்து வந்தவர் நம் தமிழ்த் தாத்தா அவர்களே!

7c5f9cdc-8107-4012-adad-af9953c46c2d.title: The Sexpert Next Door
7c5f9cdc-8107-4012-adad-af9953c46c2d.description: 'The Sexpert Next Door' is a hilarious, and heartfelt journey into the world of Amelia Rodriguez, a brilliant but bumbling psychology student at Westridge University, thrust into the spotlight as the anonymous host of a steamy college radio show. By day, she's drowning in textbooks and self-doubt; by night, she's the campus's secret love guru, dishing out advice with a side of sass. But when her best friend Jake calls in, unknowingly confessing his love for her on air, Amelia's world spins faster than a DJ's turntable. With a cast of quirky characters, from stern professors to loyal sidekicks, this show tackles sex, love, friendship, and self-discovery with wit and warmth. Will Amelia navigate the choppy waters of romance without capsizing her budding career as "Ms. A" – the sexpert who's anything but an expert in her own sex life? Has she bitten off more than she can chew? To find out, listen to this light-hearted comedy drama, exclusively on KUKU FM.

Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

the-two-week-arrangement.title: The Two-Week Arrangement
the-two-week-arrangement.description: Dear Sexy AF Intern I know you don't particularly care that I'm the CEO of this company and you're just an intern. I also know you're not impressed by my power or my wealth and that's fine. You think you've got me all figured out from working alongside me for two weeks but you don't know me. Not really. You don't know that I'm a single dad to twin toddlers or that those two little girls matter more to me than this entire hotel chain. I'm not interested in starting something deep and meaningful but what I am interested in is the way your body reacts to mine when we're in the same room. You probably assume the concentration on my face is work-related when in reality I'm figuring out which I want more - to nail you against the wall or to bend you over my desk. While you're too disciplined to act on it I'm not. And the night you stepped into my limo all bets were off.

Edu-Tharalu-ఏడుతరాలు.title: ఏడు తరాలు
Edu-Tharalu-ఏడుతరాలు.description: ఆఫ్రికా చీకటి ఖండంలో ఉన్న తన వంశం మూలాలు, దాని పుట్టుపూర్వోత్తరాలను వెతికి పట్టుకునేందుకు నల్లజాతి అమెరికన్ రచయిత ఎలెక్స్ హేలీ చేసిన అసాధారణ అన్వేషణ ఈ ఆడియో పుస్తకం లో మనం చూడచ్చు.  కేవలం నల్లజాతి అస్తిత్వాన్ని ఎలుగెత్తి చాటడం మాత్రమే కాక జాతి వివక్షపై తిరుగుబాటు జెండా ఎగరెయ్యటంలో కీలకపాత్ర పోషించింది. సంకెళ్ళ నుంచి విముక్తికి సాగిన ఈ ప్రస్థానం మానవీయత కోణాన్ని ఆవిష్కరిస్తుంది.

the-stoneman-killings.title: The Stoneman Killings
the-stoneman-killings.description: Saal 1985 ki wo ghatnayein jisne pure desh ke kanoon vyavastha par sawaal khade kar diye the. Ek aisa aadmi jo footpath par soye logon ko pathhar se kuchal kar maar dalta tha. Ye hatyaein kolkata ki sadkon se shuru hokar mumbai tak pahunch chuki thi. Footpath par soye in logon se kisi ki kya dushmani ho sakti hai? Aakhir kya mindset thi in murders ke peeche? Jaanne ke liye abhi suniye true crime ki sabse thrilling story 'The Stoneman Killings' sirf KUKU FM par.

magical-son-in-law.description: Nanki Devi Khanna ne apni hi beti ki shaadi rok di! Ek raaz se bhara purana box, ek shaadi jo sirf mohabbat ka imtihaan nahi—ek andheri shakti se takraav bhi hai! Nagini ki kaali nazar, kya pyaar ki shakti jeetegi ya Nagini ka shraap likhega is kahani ka ant? Kya hoga jab khulenge Darpan Dwaar ke us paar ke raaz? Kya Akshara aur Siddhant  hamesha ke liye jud paayenge?

ದೇಜಾವು-ಅಂದ್ರೆ.title: Dejavu Andre?
ದೇಜಾವು-ಅಂದ್ರೆ.description: ಈ ಸ್ಥಳವನ್ನ ಮೊದಲೇ ನೋಡಿದ್ದೆ ಅಲ್ವಾ.? ಈ ಕಥೆ ಎಲ್ಲೋ ಕೇಳಿದ್ದೆ.! ಇವ್ರನ್ನ ನಾನೆಲ್ಲೋ ಭೇಟಿ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೆ.! ಹೀಗೆ ನೀವು ಎಷ್ಟೋ ಬಾರಿ ಯೋಚನೆ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ.? ಆದ್ರೆ ಅದೆಲ್ಲವೂ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೊದಲ ಬಾರಿಯೇ ಅಲ್ವಾ.? ಆದ್ರೂ ಯಾಕೆ ಹೀಗಾಗುತ್ತೆ.? ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೂವರಲ್ಲಿ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಈ ಅನುಭವಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗ್ತರೆ, ಇಬ್ಬರಲ್ಲಿ ನೀವು ಕೂಡ ಒಬ್ಬರು.! ಏನಿದು.? ಇದೇ ದೇಜಾವು.! ಏನಪ್ಪಾ ಈ ದೇಜಾವಿನ ಕಥೆ. ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಿಂಪಲ್ ಆಗಿ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡ್ಸಿ ಅನ್ನೋದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನದಾಳದ ಮಾತಾಗಿದ್ರೆ? ಕೇಳಿ ಮನಃಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಕುತೂಹಲಕಾರಿ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆಯಿರೋ 'ದೇಜಾವು ಅಂದ್ರೆ?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು ಎಫ್ ಎಂ ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ.

punnami-ratri.title: Punnami Ratri
punnami-ratri.description:
ఎన్నో ప్రేమ కథలకు మౌనసాక్షంగా మిగిలిపోయిన కాలం తను చేసిన తప్పును సరిదిద్దుకోవాలనుకున్నది. కొన్ని యుగాలక్రితమే అసంపూర్తిగా ఆగిపోయిన ఆ ప్రేమ కథ మళ్లీ సరికొత్తగా మొదలు పెట్టబోతోంది. ఆమెని చేరుకోవాలని యుగయుగాలుగా అతని నిరీక్షణ. అతని కౌగిలిలో కరిగిపోవాలని జన్మజన్మలుగా ఆమె తపన.

 ప్రతి పున్నమికి ఆమెకి రకరకాల కలలు వస్తూ ఉంటాయి. అనుకోకుండా ఒక పున్నమి రాత్రి ఆమె తనకు సంబంధం లేని మరో ప్రపంచం లోకి అడుగుపెడుతుంది. అక్కడే తనకి పరిచయం అవుతాడు అమరేంద్ర. యుగాలక్రితం ఆగిపోయిన వాళ్ళ ప్రేమకథ మళ్లీ సరికొత్తగా మొదలవుతుంది. ఆమె పునరాగమనానికి తిరిగి మేల్కొన్న దుష్టశక్తులతో ఆమె పోరాటం మళ్ళీ మొదలైంది. కాలాన్ని పరిస్థితుల్ని దుష్టశక్తుల్ని ఎదిరించి వాళ్ళ ప్రేమ కథ ఏ తీరం చేరుతుందో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే వినండి పున్నమి రాత్రి…

how-to-master-any-skill.description: మీకు నచ్చిన రంగంలో నిలదొక్కుకోవాలంటే ఏమి చేయాలి? మనకు నచ్చిన స్కిల్ లో నైపుణ్యం ఎలా పెంపొందించుకోవాలి? ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

meerasadhu.title: മീരാ സാധു
meerasadhu.description: ഉടലിന്റെ വശ്യതതേടിയെത്തുന്ന ആണ്‍കാമത്തിന് എല്ലാം സമര്‍പ്പിക്കുകയും അതേ സമര്‍പ്പണബോധത്തോടെ ഉയിരും ഉടലുംകൊണ്ട് ആണ്‍വഞ്ചനയ്‌ക്കെതിരെ പ്രതികാരം ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുന്ന ഒരു മീരാസാധുവിന്റെ കഥ. ഭക്തിയും കാമവും അതിന്റെ തീവ്രശോഭയില്‍ പ്രകാശിതമാവുന്നു ഇവിടെ.

kedavnino-koyodo.title: Kedavnino Koyodo
kedavnino-koyodo.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

ഓണവും-ദ്രാവിഡ-സംസ്‌കൃതിയും.title: Onavum Dravida Samskruthiyum
ഓണവും-ദ്രാവിഡ-സംസ്‌കൃതിയും.description: ചിങ്ങമാസത്തിലെ പൊന്നോണനാളിൽ പ്രജകളെ കാണാനെത്തുന്ന മഹാബലിയെ  വരവേൽക്കാൻ മലയാളനാട് ഓണം ആഘോഷിക്കുന്നു.ഓണം സംബന്ധിച്ച് പല ഐതിഹ്യങ്ങളും ചരിത്രരേഖകളും നിലവിലുണ്ടെങ്കിലും ഓണം ആത്യന്തികമായി ഒരു വിളവെടുപ്പു അഥവാ വ്യാപാരോത്സവമാണെന്ന് കരുതിപ്പോരുന്നു. ഓണത്തിന്റെ വേറിട്ട കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം 'ഓണവും ദ്രാവിഡ സംസ്‌കൃതിയും' എന്ന ഓഡിയോ ബൂക്കിലൂടെ.

hindu-rashtra-vs-secularism.title: Hindu Rashtra Vs Secularism
hindu-rashtra-vs-secularism.description: Bharat ko Hindu Rashtra batane walon ki sankhya badhti ja rahi hai. Par kya Hindu Rashtra ki bhavna Secularism ke liye khatra hai? Kya Bharat, Islamic States ki tarah radicalism ki or badh raha hai? Kya Hindu Rashtra mein Muslimon ke saath Jews jaisa bartav kiya jayega? Ya ye sab sirf ek myth hai? Kya hai sach, janne ke liye sunien, Hindu Rashtra vs Secularism...

dr-abhinav-talks.title: DR. Abhinav Talks
dr-abhinav-talks.description:
సమాజంలో సెక్స్ పై ఉన్న అపోహలను తొలగించేందుకు, ఆరోగ్యకరమైన సెక్సువల్ అవగాహనను పెంపొందించేందుకు మిమ్మల్ని సిద్ధం చేసే పోడ్‌కాస్ట్!

ఈ పోడ్‌కాస్ట్‌లో, ప్రఖ్యాత సెక్సాలజిస్ట్ డాక్టర్ అభినవ్ కెంబవి గారు పురుషులు మరియు మహిళలు ఎదుర్కొనే ప్రధానమైన సెక్సువల్ సమస్యల గురించి స్పష్టమైన వివరణ ఇస్తారు. సైన్స్ ఆధారంగా సెక్సువల్ ఆరోగ్యం, మైథ్స్, శారీరక-మానసిక సమస్యలు మరియు మరెన్నో ఆసక్తికరమైన విషయాలను చర్చిస్తారు.

💡 మీ మైండ్‌లో ఉన్న సెక్సువల్ డౌట్స్‌ను క్లియర్ చేసుకోవడానికి, మీ సెక్సువల్ జీవితం ఆరోగ్యంగా ఉండేలా మార్గనిర్దేశం పొందడానికి ఇప్పుడు వినండి!

🎧 ప్రతి ఎపిసోడ్ వినేందుకు రెడీ అవ్వండి – మీ ఆరోగ్యకరమైన భవిష్యత్తు ఇక్కడే మొదలవుతుంది!

mana-mahatmudu.title: మన మహాత్ముడు
mana-mahatmudu.description: భారతదేశానికి స్వాతంత్య్రం గాంధీ వల్ల వచ్చిందా? గాంధీ వల్ల ఆలస్యమైందా? అవతార పురుషుడు, అహింసాప్రవక్త, అపరక్రీస్తు అని నిఖిలలోకం కీర్తించిన మహాత్ముడి నిజస్వరూపం ఏమిటి? స్వాతంత్య్ర సంగ్రామంలో ఆయన పాత్ర ఏ రకమైంది? వాస్తవానికి ఆయన ఎవరి పక్షం? ఆయన తప్పులకు దేశం ఎటువంటి మూల్యం చెల్లించింది? ఇంతకీ దేశానికి గాంధీ వరమా? శాపమా? ఆఫ్రికానుంచి 'అసహాయం' దాకా గాంధీ కెరీర్ ను విశ్లేషించే అద్భుత సంచలన గ్రంథం "మన మహాత్ముడు".

manusmriti-jeewan-ka-arth.title: Manusmriti : Jeewan Ka Arth
manusmriti-jeewan-ka-arth.description: Hindu dharma ke sabse purane shastro me se ek Manusmriti aapko dharm aur jeene ka saar samajhati hai. Abhi iske saare part suniye! Aur janiye ki kaise ye mahaan shastra aapki zindagi ko behtar banane  mein bahut madadgar hai.

the-tell-tale-heart.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
the-tell-tale-heart.description: In The Tell-Tale Heart the narrator strives to convince the reader of his sanity while describing a murder he committed. The motivation for murder appears to be the narrator's fixation on the victim's cloudy vulture-eye. After disposing of the body the narrator calmly entertains (at first) three policemen who come to investigate reports of screaming in the night. First published in 1843 in The Pioneer a short-lived Boston magazine edited by James Russell Lowell The Tell-Tale Heart is widely considered a classic of the Gothic fiction genre and is one of Poe's most famous short stories.

karikala-chozhanum-kallanaiyum.title: Karikala Chozhanum Kallanaiyum
karikala-chozhanum-kallanaiyum.description: Tamizharin kalai azhagai ulagukku paraisaatriya kallanaiyai uruvaakiya karigalanaiyum., andha kalai pokkisathin varalaatraiyum athan suvai kuraiyaamal vilakkum pathivu idhu

vaazhnthal-unthan-madiyil.title: Vaazhnthal unthan madiyil
vaazhnthal-unthan-madiyil.description: ஒரு காதல் ❤️ ஜோடி தனிமைல இருக்கும்போது எல்லை மீறுறாங்க, சந்தோஷமா இருக்காங்க ❤️. அப்போ, அவுங்களுக்குத் தெரியாம சிலர் கேமராவுல வீடியோ எடுத்துடறாங்க...! அதுக்குப் பிறகு என்ன நடந்துச்சி???

adnyat-gandhi.title: Adnyat Gandhi
adnyat-gandhi.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

Science-of-Breath-मन-शांत-रखने-का-उपाय.title: Science of Breath: मन शांत रखने का उपाय
Science-of-Breath-मन-शांत-रखने-का-उपाय.description: Kya aap jaante hain ki sahi saans lene ka tareeka aapke mental aur physical health ko kis had tak behtar bana sakta hai? Lekin kaise? janne ke liye abhi suniye yeh show, Jahan aap Oriental Breathing Philosophy ko samajh kar khud ko ek nayi energy se bharpoor paayenge, jo aapki everyday life ko behtar banane mein madad karegi.

dadan.title: Dadan
dadan.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

jai-bharat-jai-jagat-bhag-2-vidnyan-ani-.title: Jai Bharat Jai Jagat Bhag 2 - Vidnyan Ani Adhyatma
jai-bharat-jai-jagat-bhag-2-vidnyan-ani-.description: Dive into the world of Non-Fiction with Kuku FM where real stories and groundbreaking ideas come to life. Our collection spans intriguing topics from history and science to culture and personal development. Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

bible-enna-solgirathu.title: Bible Enna Solgirathu
bible-enna-solgirathu.description: Christhavargalin punitha noolaana Bible la Arivuraigal, Thathuvangal, Irai anubavam, Vazhkaiyin kastangalukkaana theervugal nu pala visayangal irukku. Bible adpdingrathu oru single book illa adhu 40+ nabargal 1500+ varusangalaa ezhuthina 66 puthakangal konda thoguppu !  Pazhaya yerpadu, Puthiya yerpadu nu vagaipaduthi thoguka patta intha 66 puthakangal la enna irukku nu intha audiobook la romba thelivaga puriyum vagaila sollirukanga. Bible la Complete ta Purinjikka intha audiobook nichayam oru vazhikaatti. Bible enna solluthu nu therinjikalam vaanga.

3-5.title: Vishal in 3
3-5.description: Sharmikku mattum oru pennin uruvam therikirathu. Sharmi anthap pennai akka, akka endru uravu kondadukiraal. Intha nilaiyil, Aduththaduththu kolaikal kodooramaaga nadakkindrana. Kolaikalukkum kannukkuth theriyaatha anthap pennukkum enna thodarbu? Marmangal vilakuma?

instant-success-zero-to-hero.title: Instant Success : Zero to Hero
instant-success-zero-to-hero.description: ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗುರಿ ಒಂದೇ. ಅದು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗೋದು.! ಇದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕಷ್ಟ ಪಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಲಕ್ ಹಿಂದೆ ಓಡ್ತಾರೆ.! ಆದ್ರೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಈ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಫಲರಾಗೋದಿಲ್ಲಾ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಥಟ್ ಅಂತಾ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್ ಆಗೋದು? ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಇರೋ ದಾರಿಗಳೇನು? ತಿಳಿಯೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'Instant Success: Zero to Hero' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

apna-routine-kaise-set-karen.title: Apna Routine Kaise Set Karein
apna-routine-kaise-set-karen.description: Kya aap apni life mein bahut hi disorganised feel karte hai ? Kya aapko un cheezon par focus karne mein problem hoti hai jo aapke liye sabse zyada important hai? To suniye yeh audiobook jo aapko apne din ko puri tarah se productive banane aur focus karne mein help karegi. Aur aapko apna Routine set karne mein help karegi

Gokulamlo-Radha--గోకులంలో-రాధ.title: గోకులంలో రాధ
Gokulamlo-Radha--గోకులంలో-రాధ.description: ఎన్నోఏళ్ళుగా ఎదురుచూస్తున్న ప్రియుడు ఎన్నో వందలమైళ్ళ దూరం నించీ ఆమెకు రాసిన ప్రేమలేఖ అది. అనుభూతుల్ని ఆహారం చేసుకుని బతుకుతున్న ఆమె పేరు రాధ. తన ప్రియుడు ఎప్పుడు వస్తాడు అని కోటి కనులతో ఎదురుచూస్తున్న రాధకి కొన్ని అనుకోని సంఘటనలు ఎదురువుతాయి అందులో నుంచి బయట పడి తన ప్రియుడితో సంతోషంగా ఉంటుందా ? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

rent-vs-buy-in-2023-1.title: Rent Vs Buy In 2023
rent-vs-buy-in-2023-1.description: Money management oda aarambamame, Endha vaanganum vaanga koodadhu nra alavu dhaan. Idha pathi theliva indha audio book la keppom.

ultimate-guide-to-master-your-memory.title: The Ultimate Guide To Master Your Memory
ultimate-guide-to-master-your-memory.description: ദൈനംദിന ജീവിതത്തിൽ എളുപ്പത്തിൽ ഉപയോഗിക്കാവുന്ന വിവിധ വിദ്യകൾ  ഈ ഷോയിലൂടെ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് പഠിക്കാം.  പേരുകൾ, മുഖങ്ങൾ, ടെക്സ്റ്റുകൾ, തീയതികൾ എന്നിവ ഓർക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള പ്രത്യേക രീതികൾ ഈ പുസ്തകം നിങ്ങളുടെ ഓർമശക്തി വർധിപ്പിക്കാൻ സഹായിക്കുന്നു.

how-to-handle-the-stress-and-pressure-2.title: How to Handle the Stress and Pressure
how-to-handle-the-stress-and-pressure-2.description: Stress sa correct taa manage panna kathukitta , athu nalla stress sa maari namakku nallathu pannum, athe nerathula , atha sariya manage pannaama apdiye vituttaa athu namma health tha gaali pannirum ! Ipo lam kutti kuzhanthaigal mudhal periyavanga vara ellorukkum etho oru vagai la stress varuthu. Namakku Stress irukka nu eppadi kandu pidikirathu ?, Stress sa eppadi manage panrathu? , Stress sa handle panni healthy ya vazhvathu eppadi ? vaanga intha pathivu la detailed da kathukalam.

tujhse-hai-rabta.title: Tujhse Raabta
tujhse-hai-rabta.description: "Kya tumhe pata bhi hai tum kis aag se khel rahi ho?" Apne bistar par use laane se pehle Yug ne aakhiri baar Geet se sawal kiya tha. Nashe mein Geet baar baar uske qareeb aane ki koshish kar rahi thi, aur ab Yug, Geet ki asliyat se anjaan us khel ko khelne ke liye taiyar tha jo Geet ne nashe mein uske sath shuru kiya tha. Kya hoga jab Geet agli subah Yug ki baahon mein uthegi? Kya wo iss raat ki baat apne mangetar ko bata payegi?

মায়া-অরণ্য-.title: মায়া অরণ্য
মায়া-অরণ্য-.description: হিমালয় পর্বতের গা ঘেঁষে ছোট্ট একটা গ্রাম বোধিজয়ন্তীর উত্তরে এক জঙ্গল আছে আর সেই জঙ্গলে প্রতি পূর্ণিমার রাত্রে নাকি ফোটে স্বর্গের পারিজাত ফুল l যারা যারা পারিজাত ফুলের সন্ধানে ওই অরণ্যের অভিযাত্রী হয়েছে তারা কেউই আর শেষ পর্যন্ত ফিরে আসতে পারেনি l গল্পের হাত ধরে তুতুম ও তানি পৌঁছে যাবে এই মায়া অরণ্যের গোলক ধাঁধাঁয়, তারা কি ফিরতে পারবে নাকি সবার মত হারিয়ে যাবে প্রকৃতির রহস্য গহ্বরে?

shaapit-1.title: Shaapit
shaapit-1.description: Manyata hai ki ek bahut shaktishaali pishaach Surik ka sir aur dhad  Almora aur Nainital ke do Shiv mandiro me dafan hai, jahan kisi bhi insaan ko kadam rakhne ki ijaazat nahi hai. Kehte hain agar uske sir aur dhad aapas mein jud gaye to qayamat aa jaayegi. Kya hoga jab Sureek firse zinda hoga? Kya sach hai is lok katha ka? Aayiye sunte hain sirf Kuku FM par.

the-urban-healer.title: The Urban Healer
the-urban-healer.description: Elena, a librarian with a secret ability to heal through her tears takes a job at a cutting-edge biotech company, unaware that its ruthless CEO has discovered her power and will stop at nothing to exploit it, forcing her to choose between a normal life and embracing her extraordinary gift to save those she loves.

the-forced-bride.title: The Forced Bride
the-forced-bride.description: கோல்ட் டிக்கர் என்பது காதல், குடும்பம், பணம், தியாகம் மற்றும் தவறாகப் புரிந்துகொள்ளப்பட்ட ஒரு பெண்ணின் வாழ்க்கையை மையமாகக் கொண்ட உணர்வுப்பூர்வமான குடும்ப நாடகம். ஒரு கோடீஸ்வரரின் உயிரைக் காப்பாற்றிய துளசி, குடும்பத்தை காப்பாற்ற வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்தில் ஒரு கோடி ரூபாய் கேட்கும் தருணத்தில், அனைவரின் பார்வையிலும் "கோல்ட் டிக்கர்" ஆக மாறுகிறாள்.

jeevan-ki-zaruratein.title: Jeevan ki Zaruratein
jeevan-ki-zaruratein.description: Life is god's greatest gift. Jeevan mein jitna hum positive sochte hai utne hi positive raastein khul jaate hai. But iss busy life mein hum jeevan ki basic jaruraton ko bhul se gaye hai, aaiye iss audio se jaante hai ki kya hai joh aapki basic life ko better bana sakta hai

importance-of-patience-for-success.title: Importance Of Patience For Success
importance-of-patience-for-success.description: ఓపికగా ఉంటె విజయం మీ సొంతం అవుతుంది తెలుసా? ఆశ్చర్యపోతున్నారా అది ఎలాగో తెలుసుకోవాలంటే ఇంకెందుకు ఆలస్యం వినేయండి.

tholkaapiar-kaala-thamizhar.title: Tholkaapiar Kaala Thamizhar
tholkaapiar-kaala-thamizhar.description: Ulagathula matha naattu makkal ellaam kaattuvaasigalaa iruntha kaalathulaye, Thamizh Makkal naagareegama vaazhnthavanga. Antha kaala Thamizh Makkal enna maathiriyaana vaazhkai vazhnthu irupaanga nu namakku kedachurakka romba pazhaya thamizh book tholkappiyatha aathaaramaa vachu aaraichi seiyuthu intha audiobook. Vaanga mei silirka vaikkum thamizhar perumaiya kekkalam !

মন-চুরি--লেখিকা--সুমনা-ব্যানার্জি.title: Mon Churi
মন-চুরি--লেখিকা--সুমনা-ব্যানার্জি.description: Shreyan Ekjon Dokkho Police  Officer, Uchchobitto Bonedi Poribarer Chele Howar Sotteo Konorokom Ohonkar Or Mone Nei. Shreyander Boro Akta Multinational Company Ache Jetir Dayitte Or Baba Alok Banarjee Achen, Chelek Onek Bar Onader Office Join Korte Bolechilen  Kintu Shreyan Tate Raji Hoy Na.  Nijer Chestay  O Pollice Officer Pode Nijukto Hoy. Baba Cheler Somporke Vit Khub Akta Valo Na . Ar Adike Gobindo Pur Gramer Shanto, Snigdho, Sorola Poribeshe Golper Nayika Sorbani Boro Hoyeche , Nimno Moddhyobitto Poribarer Meye Sorbani Das . Bochor Atharor Chonchol  Meyeta  Nijer Jiboner Apon Mone Mete Chilo  Chokhe Sajiyechilo Ak Rash Swpno. Sobe Matro College A Podarpon Koreche, English A  Honors Korche, Tar Pasapasi Designing Course Korche. Onnayo Meyeder Motoi Moddhyobitto Poribarer Meye Sorbanir(Dustu) Jiboneo Chilo Ak Rash Swpno, College A Podarpon Korar Sathe Kichudiner Moddhye Or Porichoy College Ar Senior Orkor Sathe, Somoy Ar Sathe Orkor Hat Dhore Or Jibone Asechilo Rongin Bosonto. Kintu Niyoti Hoyto Or Jonyo Onyo Kichu Likhe Rekhechilo, Dui Poribarer Oder Ai Somporko Mene Niye Char Hat Ak Korte Sommoti Diyechilo. Nijer Ojantei Sorbani Ak  Govir Chokranter shikar Hoy. Biyer Subho Logne Orko Udhao Hoye Jay . Akjon Lognovrostha Meyeder Somaje Kotota Nichu Hoye Cholte Hoy,  Koto Kharap Poristhitir Shikar Hote Hoy, Sei Sob Dik Bibechone  Kore Sorbanir Mayer Akmatro Bandhobir Gita Debir Chele Shreyaner Sathe Oi Logne Biye Hoy Sorbanir. Kintu Oder Ai Ojachit Porinoy Ki Purnota Pabe? Naki  Notun Kono Chokranto Oder Alada Kore Debe?

osho-the-mystery.title: Osho the Mystery
osho-the-mystery.description: Osho enna peru kelkumbol manassil theliyunnath swathanthra chinthayudeyum vimarshanathmakathayudeyum swaramanu.  Osho The Mystery enna showil, ee vivaadhapurushante jeevithathile aparichitha kadhakalilekum adhehathinte aashayangalude aazhangalilekkum namalle kai pidichu nayikkunnu.

on-air-under-fire.title: On Air, Under Fire
on-air-under-fire.description: Join Aisha, a Muslim radio jockey, in this gripping audio show as she fights to clear her name after being accused of inspiring a murder. Explore the complexities of faith, identity, and media influence as Aisha navigates the consequences of her ambitions. Will she uncover the truth and challenge stereotypes, or become a victim of them? Tune in for a riveting tale of resilience and redemption.

karna-parambarai.title: Karna Parambarai
karna-parambarai.description: கரணம் தப்பினால் மரணம்" — இந்த பழமொழியில் மறைந்திருக்கும் மூலிகை ரகசியமே "கர்ணபரம்பரை"யின் மையம். பஞ்சகரணி என்ற ஆபத்தான மூலிகை ரகசியம் திருடப்பட, கண் தெரியாத வனதாயி மனக்கண்ணால் கொலைகாரனை வேட்டையாடுகிறாள் — விறுவிறுப்பான மர்மக் கதை!

ছুয়ো-না-আমায়--লেখক--অজয়-সাউ-.title: Chhuyo Na Amaye
ছুয়ো-না-আমায়--লেখক--অজয়-সাউ-.description: Ayan ar Priyar premer golper shuru ta tahole holo kivabe? Kintu Ayan er Priyar proti eto udashinota keno, eki university te pore tar aage biye, kintu ei shob kichur shuru jante shune nin ei Love audio story ti.

kashi-the-ultimate-trial.title: Kashi - The Ultimate Trial
kashi-the-ultimate-trial.description: The man Kashi once loved is now on death row for murdering her husband… and she is the lawyer fighting to save him. But Kashi knows the truth—Vihaan died by her hand when she tried to save Aman from his violent attack. Now, as Aman’s execution draws closer, Kashi uncovers a conspiracy that turned the truth into a lie. To save the man she loves, will Kashi expose the secret that could destroy her family forever? When love becomes the biggest evidence… will Kashi choose the truth or the man she loves?

inayum-thunayum.title: Inayum Thunayum
inayum-thunayum.description: Exploring personal development is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether youre aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life youve always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

holi-dahan.title: Holi Dahan
holi-dahan.description: Holi par ladkiyon ko koi kar raha andha. Kaun hai yeh serial blinder aur kya connection hai iska Holi se? Kya Inspector Amrit is mystery ko suljha paya? Suspect male hai ya female? budha aadmi hai ya kinnar? jaanne ke liye sune Holi Dahan.

how-to-respond-to-your-childs-embarrassi.title: How to Respond to your Child's Embarrassing Questions?
how-to-respond-to-your-childs-embarrassi.description: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಮುಗ್ಧತೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಅದೇ ಇನ್ನೋಸೆನ್ಸ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವ್ರು ಕೇಳೋ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು, ಎಷ್ಟೋ ಬಾರಿ ಮುಜುಗರ ಉಂಟು ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ.! ಇಂಥ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೆಲವ್ರು ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನೇ ಬೈದು ಸುಮ್ಮನಿರಿಸಿದ್ರೆ, ಇನ್ನು ಕೆಲವ್ರಿಗೆ ಏನ್ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೊಡೋದು ಅನ್ನೋದೇ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಟೆನ್ಶನ್.! ನಿಮಗೂ  ಈ ಅನುಭವ ಆಗಿದಿಯ.? ಅಥವಾ ಮುಂದೆ ಇಂಥ ಸಂಧರ್ಭ ಎದುರಿಸು ಯೋಚ್ನೆಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೀರಾ.? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'How to Respond to your ಚೈಲ್ಡ್ 'ಸ್  ಎಂಬರ್ರಾಸ್ಸಿಂಗ್ ಕ್ಯೂಸ್ಷನ್ಸ್?' ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್.! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ .!

রহস্যবাড়ি.title: রহস্যবাড়ি
রহস্যবাড়ি.description: নতুন বাংলো কিনেছে বিপিনবাবু। কিন্তু সেই বাড়িতে স্ত্রী পুত্র ও বৌমাকে নিয়ে আসার পর থেকেই নানান বিচিত্র ঘটনা ঘটতে থাকে । কি আছে এই রহস্যময় বাংলো বাড়িতে জানতে শুনুন রহস্যবাড়ি।

success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.title: Success Through a Positive Mental Attitude
success-through-a-positive-mental-attitu.description: Jeevitham lo success avvadam chaala mukhyam, prathi okkaru dani gurinche paritapisthu untaru aithe manam aa success vaipu velle kramam lo manaki enno aneka alochanalu vasthayi. gelusthamo, odipothamo ani kuda anipisthundi. aithe meru ee paristhithi lo unna kuda mi alochana marchukodaniki, anukunna dishaga veladani koni margalu aithe vunayi avi ento telusukovalante meeru ee audio book vinalsindhe.

the-full-concerto.title: The Full Concerto
the-full-concerto.description: The good news is that the Gold Quartet has been invited to play one of their favorite concertos as guest artists with the noted Berlin Philharmonic. The bad news? The concert falls on Ruby’s birthday so she’ll be traveling to Europe with her fellow musicians instead of celebrating at home with family and friends. The guys hatch a plan to make it up to her— a plan to celebrate Ruby’s birthday in a way she’ll never forget. Playing with one of the foremost orchestras in the world is cool but fulfilling one of Ruby’s naughtiest fantasies is even better. Her three trusted friends and lovers take her on a ride of deep passionate surrender bringing this quartet of sensual stories to a spectacular close.

the-mountains-that-china-fears.title: The Mountains That China Fears
the-mountains-that-china-fears.description: Why does China repeatedly claim Arunachal Pradesh? Why is Tawang so strategically important? What role do the Himalayas, Tibet, the Brahmaputra River, military infrastructure, and geography play in one of the world's most dangerous border disputes? The Mountains That China Fears is an investigative documentary series that uncovers the history, strategy, and geopolitics behind the India–China frontier, revealing why these mountains could shape the future of Asia.

devdas-1.title: Devdas
devdas-1.description: Surrender to the allure of love with Kuku FM's Romance collection. Experience heartwarming tales romantic escapades and the magic of falling in love. Our shows celebrate love in all its forms from the first flutter of attraction to the deep bonds that withstand the test of time. Perfect for the hopeless romantic tune in and let your heart be swept away.

the-anarchy.title: The Anarchy
the-anarchy.description: "The Anarchy" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಈಸ್ಟ್ ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಏಳ್ಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ಆಳುವ ಹಾದಿಯ ಗಾಢ ಚರಿತ್ರೆಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುವ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಕೃತಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕವು ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಕಂಪನಿಯು ಹೇಗೆ ಶಕ್ತಿಶಾಲಿ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸೋಲಿಸಿ ತನ್ನ ಆಧಿಪತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿತು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತಲೆಕೆಳಗಾಗಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ವಸಾಹತುಶಾಹಿಯ ಪ್ರಭಾವ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಹೋರಾಟ ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಶೋಷಣೆಯ ಕುರಿತು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಇಚ್ಛಿಸುವವರಿಗೆ ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಅವಶ್ಯಕ.

email-facebook-twitter.title: Email Facebook Twitter
email-facebook-twitter.description: Intha digital yugathula Velai Vaippu, Thozhil Valarchi, Samooga munnetram nu pala nalla visayangalukku samuga valaithalangal karanama irukku. Samooga valaithalangalai eppadi nammaloda nanmaikku payanpaduthuvathu nu therinjukka intha thalangal la pathi therinjuka vendiyathu mukkiyam. Intha audiobook la Email, Facebook, Twitter pathina pala mukkiyamana thagavalgal irukku. Vaanga therinjukalam.

sarada-devi-divine-mother.title: Sarada Devi : Divine Mother
sarada-devi-divine-mother.description: 'Ma' Ei Shobdotar Modhey Gota Biswa Thake. Tini Jonmo Den, Lalon-Palon Koren, Aagle Rakhen Sontander. Aaj Aamra Ei Audiobook Er Modhey Diye Emon Ek Mayer Kotha Janbo Jini Gota Jogoter Maa. Tini Sikhiyechen Kivabe Somaje Lorai Korte Hoy, Nijer Adhikar Bujhe Nite Hoy, Kivabe Sokolke Valobaste Hoy. Tar Bola Banigulo Aajo Aamder Cholar Shokti Jogay. Hya Thik Dhorechen, Aaj Aamra Janbo Maa Sarada Er Jiboner Kichu Kotha. Kivabe Tini Hoye Uthlen Sobar Maa ? Kivabe Tini Shekhalen Valobaste Sobaike ? Kivabe Tini Rukhe Dariyechilen Tokhonkar Somajer Birudhey ? Echarao Tar Jiboner Nana Kotha . Aasun Shuru Kora Jak.

the-power-of-focus-6.title: The power of Focus
the-power-of-focus-6.description: "The Power of Focus"  ಆಡಿಯೋ ನಿಮ್ಗೆ ಬ್ಯುಸಿನೆಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಗುರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸೋಕೆ ಇರೋ ಸ್ಕಿಲ್ಸ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೆ. ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಹ್ಯಾಬಿಟ್ಸ್ ನ ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಹ್ಯಾಬಿಟ್ಸ್ ಆಗಿ ಮಾರ್ಪಾಡು ಮಾಡೋಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಲಸ್ಯವನ್ನ ದೂರ ಮಾಡಿ ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ದಾರಿಗೆ ಎಳೆಯೋ ಗೈಡೆನ್ಸ್ ಕೊಡುತ್ತೆ. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳೋ ಮೂಲಕ ನೀವು ಬ್ಯುಸಿನೆಸ್ ನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಕ್ಸಸ್ ಮಾಡ್ಕೋಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ತಮ್ಮ ಜೀವನದ ಉದ್ದೇಶವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಹೇಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪ್ರೊಡಕ್ಟಿವ್ ಆಗಿರಬಹುದು? ಅನ್ನೋದ್ರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಇಂಟ್ರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಟಿಪ್ಸ್ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಕೇಳಿ ನೋಡಿ.

matrimonial-mosadi.title: Matrimonial Mosadi
matrimonial-mosadi.description: வரதட்சணை புகாரால் சிறையில் வாடும் சாந்தனு, மேகலாவின் மோசடியை அறிந்து அவளை பழிவாங்கத் துடிக்கிறான். விக்ரமின் உதவியுடன் ஆதாரங்களைத் திரட்டி, பல தடைகளைத் தாண்டி, மேகலாவின் அடுத்தடுத்த திருமண முயற்சிகளை முறியடித்து, இறுதியில் அவளை கையும் களவுமாக பிடித்து சட்டத்தின் முன் நிறுத்துகிறான் சாந்தனு. இந்த பரபரப்பான ஆடியோ தொடர், ஏமாற்றம், பழிவாங்கல் மற்றும் நீதிக்கான போராட்டத்தை உணர்வுப்பூர்வமாக விவரிக்கிறது.

babysitter.title: Babysitter
babysitter.description: హర్ష కి మేల్ ఇగో ఎక్కువ, సత్యకి ఆత్మ విశ్వాసం ఎక్కువ. డెలివరీ తరువాత జాబ్ మానేసిన సత్య ని చులకనగా చూస్తున్న హర్ష ఆపై ఛాలెంజ్ విసిరి, జాబ్ ప్రయత్నాలు చేస్తుంది సత్య. ఇంటిని, చంటి బిడ్డని, ఒంటి చేత్తో హేండిల్ చేయగలనని శపధం చేసి ఇంట్లోనే ఉంటాడు హర్ష. మరి ఎవరు ఎవరి పై గెలిచారు. ఎలా గెలిచారో తెలియాలంటే వినండి "Mr Baby Sitter" మీ kuku Fm లో

the-secret-heir.title: The Secret Heir
the-secret-heir.description: Kabir is an illegitimate youth forced to work on his uncle Gajendra's sugarcane fields to pay a fake family debt. When the cooperative bank tries to seize his paralyzed father's ancestral tractor, Kabir uses his mathematical genius to crack the bank's secret parallel ledgers. He exposes massive loan frauds committed by Gajendra to fund a political campaign. By secretly buying up the debt slips of poor sugarcane farmers, Kabir rallies the village to launch a ruthless boardroom coup and reclaim his family's lost honor.

mera-rich-boyfriend.title: Supreme Wealth
mera-rich-boyfriend.description:
Jai ne apni girlfriend Neena se yeh sachhai chhupai thi ki woh Bajaj empire ka eklauta waaris hai. Apni sachchai bataane se pehle, woh ek accident ka shikaar ho gaya aur 10 saalon ke liye coma mein chala gaya.

Neena ne uski sachchai se anjaan, bahut mehnat karke uske saare hospital bill chukaaye. Jab 10 saal baad Jai ki aankhen khulin, toh usne Neena ki zindagi badal di aur use aise bemisaal tohfe (unique gifts) diye jinhein dekhkar sab hairaan reh gaye.

sthalathe-pradhana-divyan.title: സ്ഥലത്തെ പ്രധാന ദിവ്യൻ
sthalathe-pradhana-divyan.description: ബഷീറിന്റെ പ്രശസ്തരായ സ്ഥിരം കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളായ ആനവാരി രാമൻ നായർ,പൊൻകുരിശു തോമ,ഒറ്റക്കണ്ണൻ പോക്കർ, എട്ടുകാലി മമ്മൂഞ്ഞ്, മണ്ടൻ മുത്തപ തുടങ്ങിയ കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളെ വെച്ച് സാമൂഹ്യ-രാഷ്ട്രീയ വിമർശനമാണ് ബഷീർ ഈ നോവലിലൂടെ നടത്തുന്നത്.

butchers-of-america-charles-manson.title: Butchers of America : Charles Manson
butchers-of-america-charles-manson.description: America ke itihaas ka wo khatarnaak hatyara  jiske upar the kai jaani maani hastiyon ke maut ke ilzaam. Yeh ek apraadhik samudaye chalata tha or iske kehne par iske followers logo'n ki hatyaein karte the. America ke sabse kukhyaat hatyaro'n mei'n shumar Charles Manson ka maqsad duniya ko hairan karna tha. Usne kyun shuru kiya ye silsila? Kya hai iske peeche ki puri kahani? Suniye serial killing ki dil dehla dene wali kahani KUKU FM par.

ninaivellam-neeye.title: Ninaivellam Neeye
ninaivellam-neeye.description: டீப்பாக லவ் பண்ணிய காதலி கீர்த்தியை அம்மாவின் பேச்சை கேட்டு பிரேக்கப் செய்கிறான் பிரத்யுன் .... ஆனால் அவன் தேடி கொண்ட கல்யாண வாழ்க்கை கசப்பாய் மாறி வாழ்வை விரக்தியாக்கும் நேரத்தில் ஐந்து வருடங்கள் கழித்து அவன் வாழ்வில் தென்றலாய் நுழைகிறாள் கீர்த்தி... பழைய காதல் நெருப்பாய் வளர, இருவரின் விதி தான் என்ன?

ರಷ್ಯಾಉಕ್ರೇನ್-ಮಹಾಕದನ.title: Russia-Ukraine Mahakadana
ರಷ್ಯಾಉಕ್ರೇನ್-ಮಹಾಕದನ.description: ಈ ಭೂಮಿ ಉಗಮವಾದಾಗಿನಿಂದಲೂ ಮಣ್ಣಿಗಾಗಿ ಜಗಳ, ಯುದ್ಧಗಳು ನಡೀತಾನೆ ಇವೆ. ಅದ್ರಲ್ಲೂ ಇತ್ತೀಚೆಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಚಾಲ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿರೋದು 'ರಷ್ಯಾ-ಉಕ್ರೇನ್' ಕದನ. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ದೈತ್ಯ ದೇಶವಾದ 'ರಷ್ಯಾ', ಈ ಪುಟ್ಟ 'ಉಕ್ರೇನ್' ಮೇಲೆ ಸಮರ ಸಾರೋದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು? ಇದು ಮೂರನೇ ಮಹಾಯುದ್ಧದ ಮುನ್ಸೂಚನೆಯಾ? ಇದ್ರಿಂದ ಭಾರತದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಗುವ ಪರಿಣಾಮವೇನು? ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ರಷ್ಯಾ-ಉಕ್ರೇನ್ ಬಗೆಗಿನ ಪಿನ್ ಟು ಪಿನ್ ಡೀಟೈಲ್ಸ್. ಕೇಳಿ 'ರಷ್ಯಾ-ಉಕ್ರೇನ್ ಮಹಾಕದನ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್! ನಿಮ್ಮ KukuFMನಲ್ಲಿ
