Janaki-Vimukti-3-జానకి-విముక్తి3.title: జానకి విముక్తి-3
Janaki-Vimukti-3-జానకి-విముక్తి3.description: చిత్రహింసలు పెట్టే భర్త ఉంటే ఎవరి జీవితం సంతోషంగా ఉండదు. అయితే మన కథ లో భర్త పెట్టే చిత్రహింసలకు తట్టుకోలేక విడాకులు ఇద్దాం అని వెళ్లిపోయిన భార్య తన భర్తని వదులుకుంటుందా? లేక మళ్ళీ కలిసి ఉంటుందా? తెలుసుకోండి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని.

tota-maina-of-hindi-cinema-featuring-dha.title: Tota Maina of Hindi Cinema Featuring Dharam & Hema
tota-maina-of-hindi-cinema-featuring-dha.description: Hindi filmo ke asli He-Man. Dharmendra Ji ki tarah kyon banna chahate the Dilip Kumar? Hema Malini ke sath waqt bitane ke liye anginat retakes diye Dharmendra Ji ne. Vo waqt bhi tha jab Dharam ji ke paas khane tak ke bhi paise na the. Javed Akhtar ko kyon daanta Dharmendra Ji ne? Dharmendra aur Hema Malini ki shadi ka kissa

mithakon-se-vigyan-tak.title: Mithakon Se Vigyan Tak
mithakon-se-vigyan-tak.description: Mythakon Se Vigyan Tak is a thought-provoking audio journey that takes you from ancient myths to modern science. This audiobook asks an essential question—are science and religion in conflict, or are they simply two different paths to knowledge? Exploring the universe, life, and belief, it invites you to question deeply held ideas. Listen to this audiobook to deepen your scientific and philosophical understanding

the-leader-in-you-1.title: Nijer Bhetorer Leader Ke Chinte Sikhun
the-leader-in-you-1.description: Cold war er por theke shobe tei amul poriborton eseche. Customer er chahida ke ograjhyo kore apnar business ke daar korate parben na. Aj amra chorcha korchi The Leader In You boi ti niye. Ekobingsho shotok e amra industrialism e probesh korechi. Business environment e competition aro eseche. Human relationship ar kokhonoi sohoj bhabe newa jabe na. Ar kono company tar product er proti udasheen hote parbe na. Ei shob somporke aro jante shune nin ei sarangsho ti.

rogue-sync-rise-of-the-forbidden-anomaly.title: Rogue Sync : Rise of the Forbidden Anomaly
rogue-sync-rise-of-the-forbidden-anomaly.description: Betrayed by his partner and branded a traitor, frontline pilot Austin Reed is left to die in Fort Redoubt's toxic pits. But a forbidden neural bond with living weapon Taryn Frost unlocks his rare ability to control multiple war-frames. As corrupt Warden Knox targets his sisters and mutant hordes close in, Austin must survive deadly trials and unite condemned warriors into an unstoppable force. Once discarded as worthless, he now rises to destroy the empire that betrayed him.

lakshmi-deviya-kathegalu.title: Lakshmi Deviya Kathegalu
lakshmi-deviya-kathegalu.description: ಸಂಪತ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿಯ ಅಧಿದೇವತೆ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ. ನಂಬಿದವರನ್ನು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಕೈಬಿಡದ, ಧರ್ಮದ ರಕ್ಷಕಿ, ದುಷ್ಟರ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕಿ ತಾಯಿ ಮಹಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ. ಅನಾದಿ ಕಾಲದಿಂದ್ಲೂ ಜಗನ್ಮಾತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪವಾಡ ಅಪಾರ! ಭಕ್ತರ ಬಾಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಕು ತಂದ ಜಗತ್ಜನಿನಿಯ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಇಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಕೇಳಿ ಪದ್ಮಪ್ರಿಯೆ 'ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ದೇವಿಯ ಕಥೆಗಳು'.. ನೀವೂ ಮಾತೆಯ ಕೃಪೆಗೆ ಪಾತ್ರರಾಗಿ.

house-of-secrets-the-burari-deaths.title: Maut Ke Unsuljhe Rahasya
house-of-secrets-the-burari-deaths.description: Andhvishwas ka ek chakrvyuh jisme padkar Ek  poora pariwar achank lga leta hai maut ko gale. Ghatna jisne Delhi ki janta or police dono ko hi shock mein daal Diya tha. Kya hai BURARI DEATH ka inside sach? Kya hai is charchit ghatna ki poori kahani suniye KUKU FM par.

irumbu-kudhiraigal.title: Irumbu Kudhiraigal
irumbu-kudhiraigal.description: விஸ்வநாதன் தன் கம்பெனி சரக்கு ஏற்றி வந்த லாரி காணாமல் போகும்போது, அதைத் தேடி ஒரு புரியாத பயணம் தொடங்குகிறது. அந்தத் தேடலில் சில விசித்திரமான மனிதர்களை சந்திக்கிறார், பல பிரச்சினைகளும் வருகின்றன. லாரி போக்குவரத்து உலகில் நடக்கும் ஒரு அரிய கதை. பாலகுமாரனின் காலத்தால் அழியாத படைப்பு — "இரும்பு குதிரைகள்" — இப்போது கேளுங்கள், Storytel-ல் மட்டும்.

master-the-art-of-wealth-creation.title: Master the Art of Wealth Creation
master-the-art-of-wealth-creation.description: Kya aap paise ki duniya mein maharath haasil karna chahte hain? Is show ke saath apni wealth ki duniya ko dijiye ek nayi udaan, jisse aap apne sapno ko jald se jald haqeeqat mein badal payenge. Mindset, Action Plan se le kar Knowledge tak, is show mein milega aapko ek step by step guide. Suniye abhi.

maharashtra-desha.title: Maharashtra Desha
maharashtra-desha.description: Mitrano, apan jantoch ki 1 May 1960 roji Mumbai saha Maharashtra ya svatantra rajyachi sthapana jhali. Aaj war aplya aplya Maharashtra rajyane sarwach kshetrat uttung Pragati keli ahe. Aplya Bharat deshacha naw jagat motha kela ahe. Aaj Maharashtra Dinachya nimittane amhi khas tumchyasathi gheun ala ahe  Maharashtra che Pragati pustak, ya khas show madhun. Nakki aika Maharashtra Desha...aplya Kuku FM war. Jai Maharashtra!

the-ghost-queen-is-my-wife.title: The Ghost Queen Is My Wife
the-ghost-queen-is-my-wife.description: A thousand-year-old Fox Queen named Rani transforms into a human and marries Raj to secure her soul. While Raj navigates poverty, Rani uses magic and ancient treasure to protect him from greedy humans and malevolent ghosts. They soon face a deadly demonic shadow born from a Guru’s greed. Aided by Raj’s devotion and a mysterious savior, Rani defeats the darkness, ultimately choosing a human life of love over her supernatural fox throne.

മർഡർ.title: മർഡർ
മർഡർ.description: അസ്‌പർജേഴ്സ് സിന്‍ഡ്രോം ബാധിച്ച ഒരു ഇൻവെസ്റ്റിഗേറ്റർ, മറ്റുള്ളവർ കാണാതെ പോവുന്ന രീതികളും രഹസ്യങ്ങളും അയാൾ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നു. നഗരത്തെ നടുക്കിയ ആയ കൊലപാതകത്തിൻ്റെ രഹസ്യങ്ങൾ ചികയുമ്പോഴും മനസ്സ് ഒന്നു മാത്രമായിരുന്നു അയാളുടെ കൈയ്യിലെ ആയുധം. ശബ്ദഘോഷങ്ങളുടെ ലോകത്തിനു നടുവിൽ വിഷമകരങ്ങളായ അനേകം സമസ്യകൾക്ക് പരിഹാരം കാണുന്നത് അയാളുടെ  നിശ്ശബ്ദബുദ്ധിയാകുന്നു.

என்-சீனி-கருப்பட்டி.title: என் சீனி கருப்பட்டி
என்-சீனி-கருப்பட்டி.description: தன் குடும்பத்திற்காக தனது சொந்தத்தில் ஒருத்தியை மணம் முடிக்கிறான் போலீஸ் நாயகன். ஆனால், நாயகியோ அவனைத் திட்டம் போட்டே மணந்து கொள்கிறாள்.

ekoda-ek-paanshalate.title: Ekoda ek Paanshalate
ekoda-ek-paanshalate.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

b3813964-82a7-4081-a134-1f1f621142de.title: Rs 10000 se Rs 37 Crores: Buffest Ki Strategy
b3813964-82a7-4081-a134-1f1f621142de.description: Kya aap bhi Warren Buffett ki tarah crorepati banna chahte hain? Janiye unke Investing ke Masterstrokes jo badal sakte hain aapki zindagi!

kaappan.title: Kaappan
kaappan.description:
Right now, the guy is living life as a security guard. At the same time, a turning point comes in his life — and that is, his girlfriend brings him an opportunity to save a village.
Did he save that village? Did the two of them get married?

slaves-of-sleep-the-masters-of-sleep.title: Slaves of Sleep & The Masters of Sleep
slaves-of-sleep-the-masters-of-sleep.description: Jan Palmer has everything — except happiness. He wishes to escape to another world. But be careful what you wish for.... Waking out of a deep sleep he escapes — into a living nightmare. In a realm of deadly secrets and dangerous dancing girls he discovers that humankind's fate lies in his hands. Abounding in revelation this is a tale that might just open your eyes. I stayed up all night finishing it. The yarn scintillated.

antim-daka.title: Antim Daka
antim-daka.description: Ragu, Aman, Shivani, Kabir aur Roy ne apni zindagi ki antim chori plan ki, shehar ke sabse surakshit Royal Jewellery House ko lootne ki. Ek purane tunnel ka raaz unhe is chori ke sapne ke aur kareeb le aaya. Lekin sab kuch tab bigad gaya jab Shivani ke personal issues aur gang ke andar chhupi gaddari saamne aa gayi. Kya ye gang apne sapne ko poora kar paega, ya antim daka unki zindagi ka sabse bada galat faisla ban jaega?

vilomlok-the-hidden-heaven.title: Vilomlok : The Hidden Heaven
vilomlok-the-hidden-heaven.description: When Aarav begins seeing terrifying dreams of VilomLok - a mysterious hidden heaven where everything exists in reverse, his ordinary life is turned upside down. As he searches for his missing father, his path crosses with a brilliant scientist, a ruthless woman obsessed with unlocking VilomLok, and dark forces that have waited for centuries. But is VilomLok humanity's greatest discovery... or its ultimate doom? The journey has just begun.

thalaikeezh-vigithangal.title: Thalaikeezh Vigithangal
thalaikeezh-vigithangal.description: 23 வயசு இளைஞன் ஒருத்தனோட  வாழ்க்கைல நடக்குற மனப்போராட்டத்த எழுத்தாளர் நாஞ்சில நாடன் இந்த கதைல பதிவு செஞ்சு இருக்காரு. சுயமரியாதைக்கும், வாழ்க்கைப் பிழைப்புக்கும் இடையில அவனோட மனசு போராடுது.. இந்த போராட்டத்துல வெற்றியடைஞ்சது  சுயமரியாதையா - வாழ்க்கைப் பிழைப்பா ? வாங்க தெரிஞ்சுக்கலாம்..

vittu-vidu-karuppaa.title: விட்டுவிடு கருப்பா
vittu-vidu-karuppaa.description: வேட்டைக்காரன் மங்கலம் கருப்புசாமி துடியான சாமி. இந்த சாமி உத்தரவு தந்தால் தான் யாரும் எதையும் செய்யலாம். இந்த ஊரை சேர்ந்த ரத்னாவை டாக்டர் ஒருவர் காதலிக்க ரத்னா, 'கருப்பு உத்தரவு தராது. என்னை காதலிக்காதே' என்கிறாள். கருப்பு யார் காதலிக்க அனுமதி தர? டாக்டர் நீனா என்பவள் உண்மையை கண்டறிய வருகிறாள். கண்டுபிடித்தாளா? ஒரு கிராமத்து மர்மம் தான் விட்டு விடு கருப்பா!

Chakravyuh-2--वतन-के-नाम-सब-कुछ-कुर्बान.title: Chakravyuh 2 : वतन के नाम, सब कुछ कुर्बान
Chakravyuh-2--वतन-के-नाम-सब-कुछ-कुर्बान.description:
Khaki Vardi pehne un superheroes ki thrilling aur sacchi kahaniyaan jo watan ke liye sab kuch kurban kar dete hain!
Apni duty ke pehle din hi goliyon ka saamna karti IPS Shahida kaise bani ‘Kashmir ki Sherni’ ? Hyderabad mein ek narbhakshi qaatil khoon ki holi khel raha tha, to Inspector Dinesh ne apne retirement ke din khaki pehenkar uska khatma kaise kiya? Uttar Pradesh ke Gonda mein 13 logon ki maut ke peeche kya tha sach? Fake encounter tha ya koi bada raaz? Chakravyuh 2 mein milengi aisi kai sacchi kahaniyaan, jo batati hain ki khaki vardi waale har mushkil Chakravyuh ko tod sakte hain.

business-model-of-cricket-premier-league.title: Business Model Of Cricket Premier League
business-model-of-cricket-premier-league.description: Indian Crickettine mathram alla loka crickettine thanne maatti marikkunna tharathil valarcha prapicha onnanu Indian Cricket Premier League. Lokam muzhuvan uttu nokkunna league kodikalude kilukkam kondum varthakalil idam pidikkarund. Thaaralelam muthal Branding, Kalikkarude shambalam, Sponsership enningane pala vidhathilum panakkozhuppinte business aanu cricket league. Etharathil aanu Cricket Leagueinte business work cheyyunnathennu ee showyilude kelkkam.

rakta-charitre.title: Rakta Charitre
rakta-charitre.description: ಕರಾಳ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳನ್ನ ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರೋ ದಟ್ಟವಾದ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಂಡಿರೋ ನಿಗೂಢವಾದ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಪುರ. ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕತ್ತಲಾಗೋ ಮುಂಚೆನೇ ಮನೆ ಸೇರಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಭಯದಲ್ಲೇ ಬದುಕೋ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ. ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಪೂಜಾರಿ ಶಿವಪ್ಪ ಹುಣ್ಣಿಮೆಯ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಊರ ಕಾವಲುಗಾರ ರಂಗಸ್ವಾಮಿಯನ್ನ ಕರೆದುಕೊಂಡು ತಡರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಹಸ್ಯ ಆಚರಣೆಗೆ ತೆರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕಾಡಿನ ಕರಾಳ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೋಗೋವಾಗ ರಂಗಸ್ವಾಮಿಯ ಮಗ ಅರ್ಜುನ್‌ ಆತನನ್ನ ಕರೆದ ಹಾಗೆ ಭಾಸವಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಪೂಜಾರಿ ಶಿವಪ್ಪ ರಂಗಸ್ವಾಮಿಗೆ ತಿರುಗಿ ನೋಡದಂತೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಾರಿ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರೂ ಕೇಳದ ರಂಗಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಮಗನನ್ನ ಹುಡುಕೋಕೆ ಅಂತ ಹೋದಾಗ ನಿಗೂಢವಾಗಿ ಮಾಯಾವಾಗ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಕ್ಷರಶಃ ಬಾನಾಮತಿ ನಡೆಯೋ ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯೋ ಭಯಾನಕ ಅನುಭವಗಳೇನು? ಕಾಣೆಯಾದ ರಂಗಸ್ವಾಮಿಯ ರಹಸ್ಯವೇನು? ಕ್ಷಣ-ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಕೂ ದಿಗಿಲು ಮೂಡಿಸೋ ಕ್ಲಾಸಿಕ್‌ ಹಾರರ್‌ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ "ರಕ್ತ ಚರಿತ್ರೆ" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

brazil-2.title: BRAZIL
brazil-2.description: ಈಗ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕಡೆ ನೋಡಿದರೂ FIFA ಫೀವರ್ ಶುರು ಆಗಿದೆ. ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ 5 ಬಾರಿ ವಿಶ್ವ ಚಾಂಪಿಯನ್ ಪಟ್ಟವನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಮುಡಿಗೇರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವ 'ಬ್ರೆಜಿಲ್', ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಫೇವರಿಟ್. 'ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ನ ಕಿಂಗ್' ಅಂತ ಹೆಸರಾಗಿರುವ 'ಪೆಲೆ' ಕೂಡಾ ಬ್ರೆಜಿಲ್‌ನವರೇ. ಇಂತಹ ಲೆಜೆಂಡ್ ಆಟಗಾರರನ್ನು ಹುಟ್ಟುಹಾಕಿದ ಬ್ರೆಜಿಲ್ ತಂಡದ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ದೌರ್ಬಲ್ಯವೇನು? 27 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಬ್ರೆಜಿಲ್ ಅನುಭವಿಸಿದ ಚಾಂಪಿಯನ್‌ಷಿಪ್‌ ಲೇಪನವಾಸನೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ದೊಡ್ಡದು?ಇವೆಲ್ಲದರ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೇಳಿ 'ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಬೆಸ್ಟ್ ತಂಡ - ಬ್ರೆಜಿಲ್' ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೂಕುFM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲೇ!

kohinoor-diamond.title: Mystery of Kohinoor
kohinoor-diamond.description: Telugu Vaari Great Wealth ki, India's most extraordinary Historic events lo Ee Kohinoor Diamond Oka particular importance undi. Krishan teeram loni Kollur lo Ee Vishwa Vikhyatha Kohinoor Diamond Dorikindi. British Maharani Kireetam lo podagabadina Ee Diamond ki chala pedda History undi. Deenitho paatu chala Controversies kuda unnayi. Mari Ee Great Diamond First Evariki,Ekkada,Ela Dorikindi?!, Afghans nundi moghals aa Tarwatha British Valla Daggaraku ela cherindi. Daani venuka Unna Raktha Charitra, Ritka Katha nu Ee Audiobook lo vinandi. Idi Kuku FM Exclusive Special Story

detective-ajay-jungle-ke-shikari-1.title: Detective Ajay- Jungle ke Shikari
detective-ajay-jungle-ke-shikari-1.description: Dev Pura gaon mein Jawan lashon ka milna aur Jungle mein hota janwaron ka shikar . Aakhir kya hai is bhayanak khel ka raaz ?  Kya Ajay dhoondh payega asli apradhi ko ?

yamraj-no-5003.title: Yamraj No. 5003
yamraj-no-5003.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

sunil-chhetri-2.title: SUNIL CHHETRI
sunil-chhetri-2.description: ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರಿಕೆಟ್ಗೆ ಇರುವಷ್ಟು ಕ್ರೇಜ್, ಅಭಿಮಾನಿಗಳು ಬೇರೆ ಯಾವಾದಿಕ್ಕು ಇಲ್ಲ... ಇಂಥಾದ್ರಲ್ಲಿ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಒಂದಷ್ಟು ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡ್ತಿದೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ, ಅದಿಕ್ಕೆ ಕರಣ ಒಬ್ಬರೇ..! ಆತನೇ ಸುನಿಲ್ ಛೆಟ್ರಿ...ಭಾರತೀಯ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ತಂಡದ ನಾಯಕ ..! ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಶಕ್ಕೊಂದು ಸ್ಥಾನ ಕಲ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಟ್ಟ ಸೂಪರ್ ಸ್ಟಾರ್..! ಈತನ ಹೆಸರು ಕೇಳಿದ್ರೆ  ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರ ಕಿವಿ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ನೆಟ್ಟಗಾಗುತ್ತೆ! ಆಂದ್ರಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ , ಬಂಗಾಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಫುಟ್ಬಾಲ್ ಜೀವನ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡ ಸುನಿಲ್  ಛೆಟ್ರಿ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರಿಗೆ ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದ ಕಥೆಯೇ ರೋಚಕ..! ಇಂತಹ ಛಲಗಾರನ ಜೀವನಚರಿತ್ರೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕಾ? ಕೇಳಿ , 'ಸುನಿಲ್ ಛೆಟ್ರಿ ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬೂಕ್, ನಿಮ್ಮ  ಕುಕು FM ಕನ್ನಡದಲ್ಲಿ ...

অপরিচিতা.title: Oporichita
অপরিচিতা.description: Valobasar Manushke Hariye Pagol Hoye Jayoya Dristi O Monorog Biseshoggo Doctor Rohaner Ek Premer Golpo. Tobe Otitke Vule Notun Valobasar Aashroye Ki Nijeke Somorpon Korte Parbe? Jante Hole Shunte Thakun Ei Golpo.

tapasi-malik-hotya-rohosyo-rajnitir-aara.title: Tapasi Malik Hotya Rohosyo : Rajnitir Aarale
tapasi-malik-hotya-rohosyo-rajnitir-aara.description: Salta 2006, Jomi Aandolonke Kendro Kore Uttopto Singur. Sorkar Pokkho Theke Tata Nano Prokolper Jonyo Jomi Neyoya Hocchilo, Sei Somoy Jomi Dite Oswikar Koren Beraberi Gramer Ek Shrenir Chashi. Jomi Bachanoke Kendro Kore Gore Othe Ekta Committee. Aar Ei Committee Gore Shuru Hoy Jomi Rokkha Aandolon-e. Je Aandoloner Onyotomo Mukh Hoye Othe Bochor 16-Er Tapasi Malik. Kintu Hotath Ekdin Take Aagun Diye Jwaliye Deyoya Hoy. Jar Fole Aaro Uttopto Hoye Othe Singur Er Beraberi Gram. Kintu Tapasi Malik Hotyar Nepothye Kara? Rajnoitik Karone Hotya Naki Onyo Karon? Eisob Kichu Ojana Proshner Uttor Pete Aapnake Ei Show Purota Shunte Hobe . Aasun Tahole Deri Na Kore Shuney Neyoya Jak Sei Tantan Shihoron Jagano Sotyo Ghotonar Golpo.

parivarthane.title: Parivarthane
parivarthane.description: ಕನ್ನಡದ ನವ್ಯ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಪರಂಪರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ‘ಡಾ. ಶಾಂತಿನಾಥ ದೇಸಾಯಿ’ ಅವರ ಹೆಸರು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾದುದು. ಇವರು ಕಥೆ, ಕಾದಂಬರಿ, ಪ್ರಬಂಧಗಳು, ವಿಮರ್ಶೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಹಲವು ಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃತಿಗಳನ್ನ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ‘ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ’ ಕಥೆ ಕೂಡ ಒಂದು. ತನ್ನ  ಮಗಳು ಪ್ರೀತಿಸಿದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಜೊತೆ ಮನೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೋದಾಗ, ತಂದೆ ಅನುಭವಿಸುವ ತೊಳಲಾಟವೇ ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಎಳೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ.

my-mechanic-brother-runs-the-universe-2.title: My Mechanic Brother Runs The Universe
my-mechanic-brother-runs-the-universe-2.description: Karan lives a double life as an ordinary mechanic while secretly being the legendary Star-Lord, a powerful figure feared by the world. When his sister Maitri is humiliated and betrayed by her billionaire fiancé’s family, Karan steps in to protect her. As he exposes his true identity, those who underestimated him face the shocking consequences of challenging the wrong man.

maanasika-vaidyudu-leni-chota.title: మానసిక వైద్యుడు లేని చోట
maanasika-vaidyudu-leni-chota.description: మానసిక వత్తిడి ఎలా తగ్గించుకోవాలి ? తెలుసుకోవాలి అంటే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినాల్సిందే.

fast-cheap-and-viral-2.title: Viral Marketing Masterclass
fast-cheap-and-viral-2.description: Viral hona luck ki baat nahi, ek art hai. "Viral Marketing Masterclass" mein, Aashish Chopra aapko viral video marketing ki duniya mein le jaate hain. Ek aisa show jo sikhaega kaise bina heavy budget ke, sirf right techniques se aap lakho ka attention attract kar sakte hain. To kya aap Ready hain viral journey ke liye?

horpal-1.title: Horpal
horpal-1.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

anand-mahindra-1.title: Anand Mahindra
anand-mahindra-1.description: India oda valarchi la mukkiya pangu vagicha sila mukkiya pramoogargal la ivarum oruthar. Ivaroda life , business , challenges adangiya oru inspiring aana audio book dhaan idhu.

रुद्रवीरा--लेखिका--अंकु-ठाकुर.title: रुद्रवीरा
रुद्रवीरा--लेखिका--अंकु-ठाकुर.description: Ek ladki Jungke mei buri tarah ghayal aavasta hei Savarm ko milti hei. Ilaaj hone par pata chalta hei ki uski yaadash chali gaie hei...Kya yeh sach hei? Aachanak Savarm par jaanleva hamla hota hei...Kya yeh hamla uss ladki se juda hai?? Uss ladki ki kya hai sacchai? Rahasya aur romanchak se bhar pur sune kahani Rudraveer

jonathan-james-the-boy-who-hacked-nasa.title: Jonathan James: The boy who hacked NASA
jonathan-james-the-boy-who-hacked-nasa.description: Internetinte rahasyangal parathunathinide NASAyude surakshitha samvidhanangalilekk kadannukayariya balan! Pakshe, kouthukathinte purakil kaathirunnath valiya vila! Jonathan James enna 16 vayassukarante jeevithathe maattimarichcha njettikunna sambavangalude kadhayanu ningal kelkan pogunnath.

the-power-of-storytelling-in-marketing.title: The Power Of Storytelling In Marketing
the-power-of-storytelling-in-marketing.description: “Ennana Solraan Paarunga, Kambi katra kadhai ellam soltu irukaan” nu namakku pala nerangal thonum. Oru Product ah namma kitta sell panna indha market enna venalum sollum. Adha analyze panni edhu venum, edhu vendam nu mudivu panradhu consumers kai la dhan iruku. Marketing oda miga mukkiya aspect aana Storytelling pathi in and out therinjuka kelunga “The Power Of Storytelling In Marketing” on Kuku FM

web-30.title: Web 3.0
web-30.description: Web 3.0 yani humare aane wale future ka zabardast technological experience. Magar yeh sach mein hai kya ? Aur kaise kaam karta hai ? Iss Par kafi confusion hai. Kya Web 3 Humare internet ke experience ko aur zyada safe, secure aur behtar bana sakta hai ya phir yeh sirf kuch tech companies ki sajish hai jo ki ek dot com bubble ki tarah phat jayega ? Jante hai iss show mein

attitude-is-everything-7.title: Attitude is Everything
attitude-is-everything-7.description: Manapokkunu sollapadura attitude thaan Ellaame nu solludhu Indha Book. Panakkaaranga Panakkaarangalaa irukkuradhukkum, Ezhai Ezhaiyaa Irukkradhukkum, Saadhanai padaikkiravanga vetri adaiyaradhukkum, tholvila  odanju Poravanga failure raa aaguradhukkum Manapokku dhaan Kaaranam. Namma Attitude da  Mathrathu moolamaa Namma Vaazhkaiyave Maatha Mudiyumnu Nambikkai Kodukkudhu Indha Book. Vaanga Success kaana Manapokku Ennanu therinjukittu adha naama nammaoloda manapokkaa maathi gethaa vaazhalaam !

ramar-paalam.title: Ramar Paalam
ramar-paalam.description: Indiavukkum Ilangaikkum idaila kadalukku naduvula irukkura intha Ramar Paalam Pathina Puraana Kaala Kadhaigal, Ariviyal Aaivugal, Arasiyal sarchaigal  nu pala suvarasiyamana visayangal la azhaga thoguthu intha pathivu la solli irukkom. Idhu Ramar Paalam Patriya muzhumaiyana pathivu ! Indha Padhivu moolamaa Kadalukku naduve oru payanam pogalaam vaanga !

pani-gabhini-asil-aru-anyanya.title: Pani Gabhini Asil aru Anyanya
pani-gabhini-asil-aru-anyanya.description: Jump into a world of diverse tales with Kuku FM's Short Stories. Perfect for listeners on the go our short stories offer quick escapes into fictional worlds. From suspenseful thrillers to heartfelt dramas each story is a unique journey. Listen during your commute on a break or whenever you need a brief diversion from the everyday.

raajakiya-kathalu.title: Raajakiya Kathalu
raajakiya-kathalu.description: తెలుగు స్త్రీవాద సాహిత్యంలో ఓల్గాకు ప్రత్యేక స్థానం ఉంది. "రాజకీయ కథలు"లో స్త్రీల శరీరాలు, సంబంధాలు, సమాజంతో వారి అనుబంధం — అన్నీ శక్తివంతంగా చిత్రించబడ్డాయి. అపోహలను బద్దలు కొట్టి, కొత్త కోణాన్ని ఆవిష్కరించే అద్భుతమైన కథా సంకలనం!

rajeshree.title: Rajeshree
rajeshree.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

i-am-in-love-with-a-ghost.title: I Am In Love With A Ghost
i-am-in-love-with-a-ghost.description:
Sahil Singh Oberoi—ek safal businessman, jo tanha raha karta tha kyuki paanch saal pehle ek accident ne usse uska sab kuch cheen liya tha - uska pyaar, uski khushi. Tab se zindagi sirf ek samjhauta ban kar reh gayi thi uske liye. Meera—ek ladki jo dheere-dheere uski tanhai ka hissa banne lagi. Dosti shuru hui, par jaise-jaise baatein badhti gayi, ek ajeeb ehsaas hone laga. Yeh rishta sirf insaano tak simit nahi tha, yeh ek rooh ka bandhan tha.
Ek aisi mohabbat jo mehsoos toh ki ja sakti thi, par samjhi nahi ja sakti. Lekin jab sacchai saamne aayi, Sahil ke hosh udd gaye. Kya yeh pyaar hai ya ek aisi kahani jo sirf barbaadi la sakti hai? Kya pyaar maut se pare ho sakta hai?

how-to-raise-your-own-salary.title: How To Justify Your Own Salary
how-to-raise-your-own-salary.description: Kya Aap apni Salary Badhana chahte hain? Ya Aap Jitna earn karte hain usse zyada earn karna chahte hain? Aap kahenge kaun nahi chahta, par sawal ye hai ki Kaise aur kya karne se Income badhai ja sakti hai? Dekhiye is Audio Show mein kuch Universal aur Natural laws bataye gaye hain jinki help se aap kisi bhi field mein apni value badha sakte hain. Lekin ek shart hai aap is Audio Show ko ek ache Student ki tarah sunenge aur apni Life mein ise Apply bhi karenge. To chaliye shuru karte hai is safar ko.

why-we-sleep-by-mathew-walker.title: Aapki Neend Important hai!
why-we-sleep-by-mathew-walker.description: Hum sote kyun hai? Hum kyun asani se so nahi paate? Sone ke kya fayde hai aur na sone ke kya nuksan? Hamari health aur life ka sone se kya taluq hai? Hum sapne kyu dekhte hai? Kya Sleeping pills lena sahi hai? Technology ka sleep quality par kya asar padhta hai? Chaliye inh sabhi sawalon ke jawab jaante hain is audiobook mein.

budhiyok-xiyal.title: Budhiyok xiyal
budhiyok-xiyal.description: Step into a world of fun and learning with Kuku FM's children's stories. Our audiobooks are full of adventures and lessons about friendship courage and curiosity. They're perfect for young listeners making learning exciting and storytelling a joy. Listen now Kuku FM for stories that spark imagination and teach important values in a simple enjoyable way.

bosonto-utsobe-ghure-aashun-ei-10-jaygay.title: Bosonto Utsobe Ghure Aashun Ei 10 Jaygay
bosonto-utsobe-ghure-aashun-ei-10-jaygay.description: Bosont Utsob Manei Rong Er Bahar. Eke Oporke Rong Makhiye Deyoya Theke Shuru Kore Nanarokom Khunsuti. Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Bharoter Emon 10 Ti Offbeat Jaygar Kotha Bola Hoyeche Jekhane Aapni Khub Sohojei Pouche Jete Paren Ebong Samil Hote Paren Bosonter Rong Laganor Utsobe. Sudhu Rong Khela Noy, Seisob Jaygar Nanarokom Riti Niti Theke Shure Kore Kivabe Pouchoben Sei Jaygagulote Sobkichur Khuntinati Jante Parben Ei Audiobook Er Moddhey Diye. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Bosonte Rongin Hote Beriye Porun.

autocracy-inc.title: Autocracy, Inc.
autocracy-inc.description: ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರಾಳ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅದು ಸರ್ವಾಧಿಕಾರತ್ವದ ಆಡಳಿತ. ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಧೋರಣೆಗಳಿಂದ, ನಾಗರಿಕರಿಗೆ ಹಿಂಸೆ ನೀಡಿದ ಅನೇಕ ಡಿಕ್ಟೇಟರ್ಸ್ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅಂಥ ಸರ್ವಾಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳ ಆಡಳಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಐಡಿಯಾಲಜಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ರಚನೆಯಾದ ಕೃತಿಯೇ 'Autocracy, Inc.' ಇದರ ಆಡಿಯೋಬೈಟ್ಸ್ ಕೇಳಿ.

field-marshal-sam-manekshaw-1.title: Field Marshal Sam Manekshaw
field-marshal-sam-manekshaw-1.description: ఎవరి పేరు చెప్తే గుండెల్లో దేశభక్తి పొంగుతుందో, ఎవరి పేరు చెప్తే పిరికివాడు కూడా ధైర్యంగా లేచి నిలబడతాడో అలాంటి రియల్ హీరో “ఫీల్డ్ మార్షల్ సామ్ మానేక్షా” గురించి, ఇండియా- పాకిస్తాన్ యుద్ధంలో ఆయన పాత్ర గురించి ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో...

kismat-ka-retake.title: Kismat Ka Retake
kismat-ka-retake.description: Aryan and Kashish are two aspiring actors whose undeniable on-screen chemistry slowly turns into a real-life romance. As they chase their dreams in the ruthless entertainment industry, fame, ambition, jealousy, and painful misunderstandings begin to test their relationship. With every audition, heartbreak, and success, they must decide whether their love can survive beyond the camera—or if it was always just another perfect performance.

neermathalam-poothakalam.title: നീർമാതളം പൂത്ത കാലം
neermathalam-poothakalam.description: 1977ൽ പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ച നീർമാതളം പൂത്ത കാലം എന്ന ഈ പുസ്തകം, മാധവികുട്ടിയുടെ ബാല്യകാല ഓർമ്മകളുടെ വിവരണമാണ്. നാലപ്പാട്ടെ തറവാട്ടിൽ കടന്നുപോയ കുട്ടിക്കാലത്തിന്റെ സൗന്ദര്യവും സന്തോഷവും ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിൽ വ്യക്തമായി തെളിഞ്ഞു നിൽക്കുന്നു.

गुजरा-हूँ-जिधर-से--लेखक--तेजपाल-सिंह-तेज.title: Guzra Hun Jidhar Se
गुजरा-हूँ-जिधर-से--लेखक--तेजपाल-सिंह-तेज.description:
गुज़रा हूँ जिधर से कविता संग्रह
Voiceover Artist : RJ Nitin
Author : Tejpal Singh ' Tej'

arambha-the-birth-of-vijayanagara-1.title: Arambha : The Birth of Vijayanagara
arambha-the-birth-of-vijayanagara-1.description: This gripping historical narrative chronicles the extraordinary rise of two captive brothers who break free from a tyrannical Sultan's custody. From prisoners of war, they systematically expand their influence to lay the foundation of a magnificent southern empire that would endure for over two centuries.

stock-market-simplified-part-9-futures-o.title: Futures & Options: Stock Market Simplified
stock-market-simplified-part-9-futures-o.description:
Stock market ke future aur options ke barein mein sab kuch janiye, aur apne investments ko smart tareeke se manage kijiye. Aaye, sikhiye aur kamaiye!


Part 8- https://kukufm.com/show/sms-part-8?utm_source=upsell

easy-financial-tips.title: Financial Independence che Marga
easy-financial-tips.description: Financial Independence mhanje keval Shrimant hona nahi, tar apan kamavat aslelya Paishancha yogya viniyog karna, te vrudhingat karnyache vividha prayay niwadna mhnje khra Arthik Swatantrya. Yach vishyichi savistr mahiti apan ya show madhun ghenar ahot. Aikuya Personal finance vishayi tips.

how-prime-ministers-decide-indiras-polit.title: Indira Gandhi's Political Comeback
how-prime-ministers-decide-indiras-polit.description:
Suniye Neerja Choudhury ki popular book "How Prime Ministers Decide" par based yeh show aur jaaniye itihaas ka wo kissa jab Indira Gandhi ne sabko apni shandaar wapsi se chauka diya! Kaise Janta Party power me to aayi magar jyada waqt tik na payi.

Link- https://kukufm.com/show/mysterious-chapati-movement-of-1857?utm_source=upsell

dhurandhar-sniper-2.title: Dhurandhar Sniper
dhurandhar-sniper-2.description: For a year, Rohan has been known only as a simple cleaner at a shooting academy. No one knows he is actually G-9, the deadliest sniper. After losing his mentor, he left his past behind, but when the academy, an innocent child, and a family come under threat, he is forced to pick up the gun again. Now every shot becomes a choice - keep his identity hidden or reveal the truth to the world.

dr-death-1.title: Dr. Death Calling
dr-death-1.description: "You can be fixed". Someone finally says that about your spine, and you believe him, you had to, he is the most famous surgeon in Texas. The doctor called himself "God’s gift to spine surgery” so you are assured.  But in Operation Theatre, he puts a nail right at your spine, he lets your blood flow, your blood pressure shoots, and the assisting team give you CPR. But you can’t be saved, your back can’t be saved. Listen to the story of a doctor performing such surgeries on 33 of his 38 patients in two years, leaving some dead and most injured for life.

mafia-god.title: Mafia God
mafia-god.description: Aditya, ek aam college student, ek rahasya se bhari Kal Granth ko paata hai jo use chetavani deti hai: "Tu khud hi apna kaal banega." Is jaadooi kitaab ki shaktiyon se wo apne sapno ki crush, Professor Richa Chaturvedi ko apne paas paata hai, aur Swapnraj ki duniya ka malik banne ki shakti milti hai—jahan wo sapno aur manasik control ke zariye duniya ko badal sakta hai. Kitaab ushe ajeeb tasks deti hai—college ki sabse haseen professor ke saath raat bitaana, beshumaar paisa aur taqat paana. Par jaise-jaise shaktiyan badhti hain, kitaab Aditya ko hi control karne lagti hai. Ab sawal yeh hai—kya Aditya apne iradon aur shaktiyon ko sambhal paayega? Ya yeh kitaab use Mafia God banake uska ant likhegi? Kya karega Aditya?

high-class-secret-love.title: High Class Secret Love
high-class-secret-love.description: తన ఆస్తిని కాదు, తన మనసును చూసి ప్రేమించే అమ్మాయినే పెళ్లి చేసుకోవాలని నిర్ణయించుకున్న ఓ బిలియనీర్‌ పేదవాడిలా నటించడం మొదలుపెడతాడు. చివరకు తనను నిజంగా ప్రేమించే అమ్మాయి దొరికిందని నమ్మి ఆమెను పెళ్లి చేసుకుంటాడు. కానీ అతని అసలు గుర్తింపు, ఆస్తి గురించి తెలిసిన తర్వాత ఆమె తన ప్రియుడితో కలిసి అతన్ని మోసం చేసి, అతని కోట్ల సామ్రాజ్యాన్ని కాజేయడానికి కుట్ర పన్నుతుంది. ఆమె మోసం బయటపడిన క్షణం నుంచి అతని ప్రేమ ప్రతీకారంగా మారుతుంది.

the-imperfect-1.title: The Imperfect
the-imperfect-1.description: A hopeless romantic tangled in a web of his own making! Rishabh loves Aarti, who only sees him as a friend. Ruhana loves him, but he doesn't see it. He's about to marry Priyanka, unsure of his feelings. And Shefali is carrying his child. Caught in a whirlwind of love, longing, and confusion — will Rishabh find his perfect ending, or will life's messy chapters define him forever?

joker-7.title: Joker
joker-7.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

sherlock-holmes-baskervillesile-vettanay.title: ഷെർലക് ഹോംസ്:  ബാസ്കർവിൽസിലെ വേട്ടനായ
sherlock-holmes-baskervillesile-vettanay.description: ലോകത്തുടനീളം വായനക്കാരെ ഹരം കൊള്ളിച്ച ഒരു ക്ലാസിക് ഡിറ്റക്റ്റീവ് ത്രില്ലർ!  ബാസ്കർവിൽസിലെ ചതുപ്പുകളിൽ പതിയിരിക്കുന്ന ഭീകരനായ വേട്ടനായുടെ രഹസ്യം അന്വേഷിച്ചു പോകുന്ന ഷെർലക് ഹോംസ്.  കേൾക്കൂ, Kuku FMൽ!

lakshmikanthan-murder-case.title: Lakshmikanthan Murder case
lakshmikanthan-murder-case.description:
இந்த கதை'ல வர்ற ரெண்டு முக்கிய புள்ளிகள் 1940's தமிழ் சினிமா ஓட சூப்பர் ஸ்டார்'கள். இவங்க ரெண்டு பத்தி வெளி வந்த இந்த கொலை வழக்குக்கு பின்னாடி நடந்த உண்மை  என்ன? இத பத்தி இந்த ஒலி புத்தகத்துல கேக்கலாம் வாங்க. 

The two super stars of tamil cinema in 1940's where involved in a murder case. Was this actually true? what could have happened? Let's take a listen to this audio book to know more.

சிலிக்கான்-மனிதன்-.title: சிலிக்கான் மனிதன்
சிலிக்கான்-மனிதன்-.description: ஒரு ஆடியோ கதையின் மூலம், திரைப்படம் பார்க்கும் உணர்வைத் தர முடியுமா? முடியும், அதற்கான முயற்சி தான், இந்த 'சிலிக்கான் மனிதன்'. அரசிடம் பொய் சொல்லி, ஒரு பயோ-டெக்னாலஜி ரோபோவை உருவாக்கத் துடிக்கும்  சென்னையைச் சேர்ந்த பன்னாட்டு நிறுவனம் ஒன்று, அதனை எப்பாடு பட்டேனும் தடுக்க முனையும் தமிழகத்தைச் சேர்ந்த தொண்டு நிறுவனம் ஒன்று, அந்தத் தொண்டு நிறுவனத்திற்கு ஆதரவாக கோர்ட்டில் சாட்சி சொல்ல வரும் சிலிக்கான் எக்ஸ்பெர்ட் ஆராச்சியாளன் ஒருவன், அவனை முறியடிக்க நினைக்கும் அந்தப் பன்னாட்டு நிறுவன சி.ஈ.ஓ, தொண்டு நிறுவனத்திற்காக வாதாடும் பெண் வக்கீல்; இவை எல்லாவற்றிற்கும் அடிப்படையான, அந்த ஆட்கொல்லி சிலிக்கான் மனிதன்; இவர்களால் சென்னையும், தமிழகமும், இந்தியாவும் சந்திக்கும் பிரச்சினைகள் என்ன? இவற்றை ஹாலிவுட் பட பாணியில், சயின்ஸ் ஃபிக்ஷன் ஆக்ஷன் கதையாகக் கூறுவது தான், இந்த 'சிலிக்கான் மனிதன்.'

ഷേക്‌സ്‌പിയർ--സമ്പൂർണ്ണ-കഥകൾ--ഭാഗം-2.title: ഷേക്‌സ്‌പിയർ കഥകൾ: ഒഥല്ലോ, മാക്ബത്ത്, ഹാംലെറ്റ്, ജൂലിയസ് സീസര്‍
ഷേക്‌സ്‌പിയർ--സമ്പൂർണ്ണ-കഥകൾ--ഭാഗം-2.description: ഒഥല്ലോ, ജൂലിയസ് സീസ്സർ, മാക്ക്ബത്ത് ഷേക്ക്സ്പിയറുടെ തൂലികയിൽ പിറന്ന സമാനതകളില്ലാത്ത കഥാപാത്രങ്ങൾ. ലോകമെമ്പാടും, ഏറ്റവും കൂടുതൽ വായിക്കപ്പെട്ട- അവതരിപ്പിക്കപ്പെട്ട  മൂന്ന് നാടകങ്ങൾ.  അത്യന്തം സംഘർഷഭരിതങ്ങളായ ആ കഥകൾ കേൾക്കാം..

rudra-the-warrior.title: Rudra: The Warrior
rudra-the-warrior.description: Rudra ka janm ek aisi duniya mein hua jahan har taraf khoon aur khauf ka raaj tha. Dushman aur rahasyamay janwar uske jeevan ko baar baar chunauti de rahe the. Yoddha banne ke alawa uske paas koi raasta nahi tha. Lekin ek din, usse pata chala ki vah dusri duniya se aaya hai aur uske paas kuchh adbhut shaktiyan hai. Kaun hai Rudra aur kya hai un shaktiyon ka raj, jaanne ke liye sune...Rudra: The Warrior

history-of-nato-vs-russia.title: History of NATO vs Russia
history-of-nato-vs-russia.description: Capitalism banaam Communism! 2nd World War ke baad duniya sirf in 2 ideologies ke beech faskar reh chuki thi. U.S.A aur Soviet Union, duniya ke sabse mazboot desh bankar ubhre. Aur jaha world dominance ki baat aati hai, toh in dono ka etihaas boht ghamaasan kisso se bhara hua hai. Cold War ke dauraan 1949 mein ek organisation bani jise kaha gaya NATO - North Atlantic Treaty Organisation. Inka agenda Soviet Union ke badhte kadam ko rokna. Toh aaiye jaante hai 40 saal se bhi zyada lade gaye Cold War, U.S.S.R ka tutna, Berlin Wall ka girna aur aaj bhi Ukraine ke saath Russia ke yuddha mein NATO ka stand kya hai.

tharayil-irangum-vimaanangal.title: தரையில் இறங்கும் விமானங்கள்
tharayil-irangum-vimaanangal.description: தரையில் இறங்கும் விமானங்கள் விஸ்வம் என்னும் நடுத்தர குடும்பத்தைச் சேர்ந்த இளைஞனின் கதை. அவன் தனது நண்பர்களுடன் சுற்றித் திரிந்து கொண்டு கதைகள் மற்றும் கவிதைகள் எழுதி தனது நேரத்தை செலவிடுகிறான். அவனது அண்ணனும் அண்ணியும் அவனது வாழ்க்கையில் ஒரு திருப்புமுனையைக் கொண்டு வருகிறார்கள். எப்படி என்பதை அறிய கேளுங்கள்.

how-to-follow-food-cycle-2.title: How to follow Food Cycle ?
how-to-follow-food-cycle-2.description: Noyatra Vaalve Kuraivatra Selvam nu oru palamozhi irukku. Antha vithathula intha pathivula ethu sariyana diet, ethu correct aana food cycle nu ungalukku solla muyarchi pannirukom. Intha pathivai kettu unga life la neenga healthy aah irukkurathu eppadinu therinjukonga. Enna makkale aarambikalaama !

chemical-ishq.title: Chemical Ishq
chemical-ishq.description: विक्रांत सिंह और सौदामिनी दास की मुलाकात नवलोक में होती है— एक ऐसी भविष्य की डिस्टोपियन सिटी, जहाँ पानी के ज़रिए लोगों की भावनाएँ नियंत्रित की जाती हैं और हर नागरिक सिस्टम की निगरानी में जीता है। जब उनके बीच दबी हुई भावनाएँ जागती हैं, तो वे उस रहस्य तक पहुँचते हैं जो पूरे शहर को आज़ाद कर सकता है। लेकिन क्या वे नवलोक को फिर से महसूस करना सिखा पाएँगे… या सिस्टम उनके प्यार के साथ हर एहसास को हमेशा के लिए खत्म कर देगा?

negotiating-the-nonnegotiable-1.title: Negotiating The Nonnegotiable
negotiating-the-nonnegotiable-1.description: Negotiating the Nonnegotiable ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ಡೇನಿಯಲ್ ಎಲ್. ಶಾಪಿರೊ ಅವರ ದ್ವಂದ್ವ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಸ್ಯಾ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಕಲೆ ಕುರಿತು ತೀವ್ರವಾದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಮ್ಮ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿನ ಹಾಗೂ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಬದುಕಿನ ಅಡಚಣೆಯನ್ನು ಮನೋವಿಜ್ಞಾನ, ಭಾವನೆ, ಮತ್ತು ವಾಸ್ತವಿಕ ತಂತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ಹೇಗೆ ಪರಿಹರಿಸಬೇಕು ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸುವುದು, ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಗೆಹರಿಸುವುದು, ಮತ್ತು ನಮ್ಮ ಅಂತರಂಗದ ಅಡೆತಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿ ಗೆಲ್ಲುವುದು ಈ ಕೃತಿಯ ಮುಖ್ಯತತ್ತ್ವವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸರಳ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ತಂತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಲು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ಅತೀ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಾರ್ಗಸೂಚಿಯಾಗಿದೆ.

vampires-son-in-law.title: Vampire's Son In Law
vampires-son-in-law.description: Kya aapne kabhi kisi insaan ko ek vampire ke ghar paida hote hue suna hai? Kya aapne kabhi kisi vampire ke bacche ko khun ki jagah dudh pite hue suna hai? Agar nahi to ab suniye, Angad Raichand ki dilchasp kahani jo ek vampire ke ghar janam lete hue bhi... Ek vampire nahi balki ek insaan hai.... Aakhir kya hai pura maajra... Janne ke liye suniye humara latest show.... " Vampire's Son In Law"... Aur Janiye ek aise duniye ki kahani jahan insaanon se kahin dur, taqatwar vampire apni ek alag hi duniya mein raaj karte hain.

in-the-shadows.title: In the Shadows
in-the-shadows.description:
Never trust the spy who loves you.
Staff Sergeant Alexei Dvorkin has a history with spies that typically ends with most of them dead. But Agent Sean Delaney is proving to be the frustrating exception to every one of Alexei’s rules of engagement. As part of Alpha Team’s long-running mission to stop an enemy metahuman the two are constantly forced to work together resulting in a simmering attraction neither can ignore.
When the MDF tasks them with finding evidence of criminal wrongdoing against the owner of a private military company Sean knows exactly how to play the game to win. But it’s one thing to con the enemy quite another to con his own heart. When the mission goes sideways Sean must put his life in Alexei’s dangerously capable hands and hope their burgeoning relationship doesn’t go up in flames.

52-red-pills-3.title: 52 Red Pills
52-red-pills-3.description: Zindagi ke har padav par aapki chaal kaisi honi chahiye? Kaisa hona chahiye zindagi ko lekar aapka ravaiya? Ye batane wali hai aapko 52 Red Pills ki ye audiobook. Ise ant tak sunne ke baad aapko healthy, wealthy aur wise hone ke liye ek anokhi motivation milegi, jiske baad aap bhi zindagi ke sath taal se taal milakar chal payenge.

irappatharkku-24-mani-neram.title: இறப்பதற்கு 24 மணி நேரம்
irappatharkku-24-mani-neram.description: A psychotic killer meticulously recreates murders from a popular crime novel, leaving detectives racing to decipher the connection. The reason behind his deadly game unfolds into a heart-pounding thriller with a shocking twist.

eta-dweep-xaatta-kobor.title: Eta Dweep Xaatta Kobor
eta-dweep-xaatta-kobor.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

jolokonya.title: Jolokonya
jolokonya.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

chess-king.title: Chess King
chess-king.description: கிராண்ட்மாஸ்டர் ஆக வேண்டும் என்ற கனவுடன் இருக்கும் திறமையான இளம் Chess வீரன் Keith. மர்மமான ஒருவர் அவன் வாழ்க்கையில் நுழைந்ததும், அம்மாவின் மறைக்கப்பட்ட Chess கடந்த காலமும், சக்திவாய்ந்த பயிற்சியாளர் Nikhil உடனான பழைய போட்டியும் வெளிவருகிறது. புதிய Academy-யில் Keith விளையாடும் ஒவ்வொரு போட்டியும், அம்மாவின் முடிக்கப்படாத கதையின் உண்மையை நெருங்கச் செய்கிறது.

nishabdha-vispotanam.title: నిశ్శబ్ద విస్ఫోటనం
nishabdha-vispotanam.description: బోల్డెంత సస్పెన్సూ, కాసింత రొమాన్సూ, అక్కడక్కడ పురాణాలూ, కొండకచో ప్రబంధ వర్ణనలూ మహాభారతంలోని లౌక్యం, భాగవతంలోని అర్థం కలగలిపినదే మన ఈ నిశ్శబ్ద విస్ఫోటనం. మీరు కూడా ఒకసారి వినండి.!

corporate-kalugugal.title: Corporate kalugugal
corporate-kalugugal.description:
பிரபல தொழிலதிபரான நந்தினியின் பிறந்த குழந்தையை, அவளுடைய கணவனும் அவனது காதலியும் சேர்ந்து பறிக்கின்றனர்.
தன் மகனை அவர்களுடைய வாரிசாக வளர்வதை பார்த்துக்கொண்டே, நந்தினி தன் வலியை மறைத்து அமைதியாக காத்திருக்கிறாள்.
பதினெட்டு ஆண்டுகளாக அவர்களின் பேரரசை அழிக்க ஒரு ரகசிய பழிவாங்கும் திட்டத்தை உருவாக்குகிறாள்.
அவளுடைய பழிவாங்கல் தொடங்கும் நேரத்தில், அவளை ஏமாற்றிய குடும்பத்தின் ஒவ்வொரு ரகசியமும் வெளிவரத் தொடங்குகிறது.

101056e7-0203-48c2-ab25-60fab7ebd232.title: Sex, Lies and Two Hindu Gurus: My Journey to Hell and Back
101056e7-0203-48c2-ab25-60fab7ebd232.description: Karen Jonson's shocking memoir chronicles her harrowing 15-year ordeal inside a Texas-based Hindu organization. Through her personal account, she exposes how two self-proclaimed gurus manipulated and exploited their followers while masquerading as spiritual leaders.

slim-chance-at-love.title: Love Shot
slim-chance-at-love.description: Boss ke impossible demands, life ke ups aur downs, aur uske sath hi love story mein baar baar aanewali musibaton ko ek sath kaise balance kiya ja sakta hai? Iski seekh milegi aapko humari is audiobook mein. Kyunki ye audiobook aapko na sirf hasayegi, balki life ke kayi important message bhi dene wali hai.

kanavu-thozirchalai.title: Kanavu Thozirchalai
kanavu-thozirchalai.description:
Tamil:
எஸ்.எஸ்.வாசன், நாகிரெட்டியார், ஏவிஎம் செட்டியார் போன்ற ஜாம்பவான்கள் கட்டிக் காத்த தமிழ்த் திரையுலகம் இன்று எங்கே நிற்கிறது? வெளியில் பளபளப்பு — உள்ளே அழுக்கும் அழுகலும்! நஷ்டங்களின் கூக்குரல்கள் நிறைந்த இந்தக் கனவுத் தொழிற்சாலையின் உண்மை முகத்தை அம்பலப்படுத்தும் நூல்!

hyderabad-blasts-1.title: Hyderabad Blasts
hyderabad-blasts-1.description: ఉగ్రవాదులకు హైదరాబాద్ ఎందుకు టార్గెట్ అయ్యింది? ఐసిస్ మూలాలు ఇప్పటికి హైదరాబాద్ లో ఉన్నాయా? భీతిని కల్గించే విషయాలు మీకోసం.

the-secret-of-ages.title: The Secret of Ages
the-secret-of-ages.description: Apne mann ke andar ki shaktiyon ko unlock karne ka raasta jaanna chahte ho? Robert Collier ki "The Secret of the Ages" mein chhupi hui strategies ko jaan kar, aap bhi apne jeevan ko ek nayi udaan de sakte ho. Abhi sune.

ഗോവന്‍-ഡയറി.title: ഗോവന്‍ ഡയറി
ഗോവന്‍-ഡയറി.description: ഇന്ത്യയിലെ വിനോദസഞ്ചാരികളുടെ പറുദീസ എന്ന് വിശേഷിക്കപ്പെടാവുന്ന ഗോവയിലേക്ക് സകുടുംബം ചെയ്ത ഒരു യാത്രയുടെ വിവരണമാണ് ചേപ്പാട് ഭാസ്ക്കരന്‍ നായരുടെ ‘ഗോവന്‍ ഡയറി’. ഗോവയുടെ ഹൃദയഹാരിയായ ഭൂപ്രകൃതിയുടെ അതിസൂക്ഷ്മ വിവരണം ഈ പുസ്തകത്തിന്റെ പ്രത്യേകതയാണ്.  ഗോവയുടെ കല, സംസ്ക്കാരം, കൃഷി, പാചകം തുടങ്ങി എല്ലാറ്റിനെയും ഈ പുസ്തകം അടയാളപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു. കൂടാതെ ഗോവയുടെ സുദീര്‍ഘമായ ചരിത്രവും ആഖ്യാനം ചെയ്യുന്നു, ചുരുക്കത്തില്‍ ഗോവയെ അറിയാന്‍ അനുവാചകനെ സഹായിക്കുന്ന ഉപകാരപ്രദമായ രചന.

poattu-thallu.title: Pottu Thallu
poattu-thallu.description: Indha "Pottu Thallu" audiobook ,business la ungalukku Pottiyaa irukkura competitors sa identify panni, avangala jeyikka neenga seiya vendiya vazhimuraigala solli kodukkudhu. Indha audiobook nichayam unga business -sa top-la kondu vara udhavum.

drive-me-crazy-daddy.title: Drive Me Crazy, Daddy
drive-me-crazy-daddy.description: An accidental one night stand with the hot and tempting business tycoon Denzel Washington changed everything for Scarlet. The forced contract marriage was just the beginning of Denzel’s revenge. He made Scarlet pay for that night each time she visited his office. Denzel, blinded by his revenge never realised his love for Scarlet, till she said, “Drive me Crazy, Daddy.”

852509d6-66f5-451d-b238-172a95d6dcc1.title: Phoenix Jay
852509d6-66f5-451d-b238-172a95d6dcc1.description: Naalu close friends idhula oruthanukku kidaikkura super power nalla avanga sandhikkura nerikkadigal.. avangalukkula nadakkakoodiya emotional battle pathi dhaan indha kadhai..!

neeraj-grover-murder-case-1.title: Neeraj Grover Murder Case
neeraj-grover-murder-case-1.description: ಸಿನೆಮಾ ಪ್ರಪಂಚ ಅನ್ನೋದು ಮೇಲ್ನೋಟಕ್ಕೆ ಕಲರ್‌ಫುಲ್‌ ಆಗಿ ಕಂಡ್ರೂ, ಅದರೊಳಗಿರೋ ಕರಾಳತೆ ಹತ್ತಿರದಿಂದ ನೋಡಿದವರಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಗೊತ್ತಿರುತ್ತೆ. ಬಣ್ಣದ ಬದುಕನ್ನ ಕಟ್ಕೋಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಮುಂಬೈ, ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಂತಹ ನಗರಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೋಗೋ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಜನ ಸಿನೆಮಾ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಕ್ರೂರತೆಗೆ ಬಲಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದಾರೆ. 2008ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂಬೈನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಈ ಕರಾಳ ಘಟನೆಯಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ಸಿನೆಮಾಲೋಕವೇ ಶಾಕ್‌ಗೆ ಒಳಗಾಗಿತ್ತು! ಹಿಂದಿ ಸಿನೆಮಾಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿರೋಯಿನ್‌ ಆಗಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಮುಂಬೈಗೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದ ಸ್ಯಾಂಡಲ್‌ವುಡ್‌ ನಟಿಯೊಬ್ಬಳಿಂದ ನಡೆಯಬಾರದ ಭೀಕರ ಕೃತ್ಯವೊಂದು ನಡೆದುಹೋಗಿತ್ತು! ಆಕೆ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಿಯಕರನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿ ಎಸಗಿದ ಅಪರಾಧ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಕ್ರೈಂ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡ್ತಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ, ಆ ನಟಿ ಯಾರು? ಆಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದ ಭೀಕರ ಕೃತ್ಯವಾದ್ರೂ ಏನು? ಅಪರಾಧ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಚ್ಚಹಸಿರಾಗಿರೋ ಇಂಟರೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ ಕ್ರೈಂ ಸ್ಟೋರಿ "ನೀರಜ್‌ ಗ್ರೋವರ್‌ Murder Case" ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

untold-mysteries.title: Paranormal Mysteries
untold-mysteries.description: ప్రపంచమనే మహా సముద్రంలో ఎన్నో మిస్టరీలు ఉన్నాయి...వాటిని చేధించాలని శాస్త్రవేత్తలు ఎంత ప్రయత్నించినా అవి సాధ్యం కావడం లేదు. అవి మిస్టరీలా లేక అతీంద్రియ శక్తుల అనేది ఎవరికీ అంతుపట్టని విషయం..అయితే ఇండియాలో కూడా ఇలాంటి మిస్టరీలు ఎన్నో ఉన్నాయి. అవి ఇప్పటికీ శాస్త్రవేత్తలకు చిక్కక పరిశోధనల్లో తేలక అలాగే మిగిలి ఉన్నాయి. అవేంటో తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా.

mulancha-concentration-kasa-vadhvaycha.title: Mulancha Concentration Kasa Vadhvaycha?
mulancha-concentration-kasa-vadhvaycha.description: ''Amcha mulga kinva mulgi hushar ahet pan tyancha Concentration weak aslya mule te mage padtat, tyancha focus kami padto...'' ashi takrar anek palak kartat. Mulancha Concentration kasa vadhwycha ya sathiche sope upay apan ya show madhun aiknar ahot. Jyacha tumhala nakki fayda hoil ashi amhi asha karto.

দ্য-থর্নি-লাভ--লেখিকা--বিদিশা-সরকার.title: The Thorny Love
দ্য-থর্নি-লাভ--লেখিকা--বিদিশা-সরকার.description: College e porar somoyi Toma tar Maa Baba ke haraye ar tokhon pashe daraye priyo bandhobi Tomashar poribar. College e Soumya ar Toma preme pore, kintu shei prem e kudrishti pore Mainaker ar shey kono na kono bhabe Toma ke pete chesta kore ar bishiye dei Soumya ar Tomar somporko. Toma ar Soumyar bhalobasha ki sesh porjonto protikulata chhapiye jete parbe jante shune nin ei Love Thriller audio story ti.

kya-aap-apne-har-role-main-excellent-hai.title: Kaise Banein Apne Har Role Mein Excellent
kya-aap-apne-har-role-main-excellent-hai.description: Apni Life ke har role mein excellent rehne wale log hi ultimate success ko achieve kar paate hain. Aur Iske liye bas ek role se mili learnings ko dusre mein apply karte rehna hai, Lekin kaise? Ye aapko is show mein janne ko milega.

raktha-niramulla-orange.title: രക്തനിറമുള്ള ഓറഞ്ച്
raktha-niramulla-orange.description: ജി.ആർ ഇന്ദുഗോപന്റെ പ്രശസ്തമായ ഡിറ്റക്ടീവ് പ്രഭാകരൻ സീരീസിലെ മൂന്നാമത്തെ പുസ്തകമാണിത്. നൊവെല്ലകളുടെ ഈ സമാഹാരത്തിൽ ഡിറ്റക്ടീവ് പ്രഭാകരൻ രണ്ടു രഹസ്യങ്ങളുടെ ചുരുളുകളാണ് അഴിയ്ക്കുന്നത്!

bigyana-barnali.title: Bigyana Barnali
bigyana-barnali.description: Dive into the world of Non-Fiction with Kuku FM where real stories and groundbreaking ideas come to life. Our collection spans intriguing topics from history and science to culture and personal development. Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

30-days-change-your-habits-change-your-l.title: Matro 30 Dine Bodle Felun NijerJibon
30-days-change-your-habits-change-your-l.description: Aamra Jibone Onekkichu Pete Chai, Kintu Seta Hoye Othe Na. Onek Somoy Er Karon Hisebe Dekha Jay Je Aamader Kichu Baje Ovyesh Er Jonyo Dayi. Kintu Ebar Proshno Holo Sei Ovyeshgulo Tyag Kore Kivabe Sofolota Payoya Jay Ebong Tao Matro 30 Dine. Shune Chomke Uthlen Naki? Hya Emonta Hotei Pare. Kintu Kivabe? Tar Jonyo Aapnake Shunte Hobe Ei Audiobook .

suheldev-1.title: Suheldev
suheldev-1.description: Embark on extraordinary adventures with Kuku FM's Fantasy & SciFi collection. From epic quests in magical realms to interstellar explorations our shows offer an escape into worlds beyond imagination. Meet intriguing characters mythical creatures and face challenges that defy the laws of nature. Perfect for dreamers and adventurers tune in to start your journey into the unknown.

தாமரை-நெஞ்சம்-.title: தாமரை நெஞ்சம்
தாமரை-நெஞ்சம்-.description: நட்பிற்காக தனது உயிரைத் தியாகம் செய்த ஹீரோவுக்கும், காதலுக்காக அவரை அடைய விரும்பும் கதாநாயகிக்கும் இடையே தொடரும் வாழ்க்கைப் போராட்டம் இது... யார் வெற்றிபெற்றார்கள்?

1962-himalaya-ke-veer.title: 1962: Himalaya Ke Veer
1962-himalaya-ke-veer.description: 1962: Himalaya Ke Veer takes you inside the India-China war that changed the course of Indian history. From Delhi’s power corridors to the frozen battlefields of Namka Chu, Tawang, Walong, Chushul and Rezang La, witness the decisions, warnings, sacrifices and courage behind the war. Follow soldiers who fought against impossible odds, leaders caught between politics and reality, and civilians whose lives were forever changed by the conflict

chhupa-rustam-1.title: Chhupa Rustam
chhupa-rustam-1.description: The woman Rohan loves betrays him for a richer man, humiliating him in front of everyone. But they have no idea who they’ve just insulted. Rohan is secretly the mysterious Technology King, hiding his true identity behind the life of an ordinary employee. When he joins forces with CEO Alia to uncover a conspiracy threatening her company, his hidden power begins to surface. And when his true identity is finally revealed, everyone who betrayed and underestimated him is in for a shock.

marketing-tricks-of-the-trade-they-wont-.title: Marketing: Tricks of The Trade They Won't Teach You at B-Schools
marketing-tricks-of-the-trade-they-wont-.description: മിക്ക ബിസിനസ് സ്കൂളുകളും മാർക്കറ്റിംഗ് രംഗത്ത് പ്രായോഗിക അറിവുകൾ നൽകാറില്ല. ഈ പുസ്തകം സിദ്ധാന്തങ്ങളെ മറികടന്ന് മാർക്കറ്റിംഗ് തന്ത്രങ്ങളും ആസൂത്രണവും നടപ്പിലാക്കൽ മാർഗ്ഗങ്ങളും ഉൾക്കൊള്ളുന്ന ലളിതമായ മാർഗ്ഗനിർദ്ദേശമാണ്. TVC, പ്രിന്റുകൾ, ഡിജിറ്റൽ ക്യാമ്പെയ്‌നുകൾ, നെറ്റ്വർക്കിംഗ് എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള പ്രായോഗിക പരിഹാരങ്ങൾ ഇവിടെ വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.

mapa-hanshi-chapa-kanna-4.title: Mapa Hanshi Chapa Kanna
mapa-hanshi-chapa-kanna-4.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

arun-gavli.title: Dagadi Chawl che 'Daddy'
arun-gavli.description: Daddy, Mumbai ka Don asha anek navani eke kali Mumbai cha underworld madhe apla dabdaba nirman karnare Arun Gavli. Arun Gavali aka Daddy Mumbait kase ale, Dagadi Chawl ani Daddy yancha nata kasa julala, ek samnaya marathi mulga te Mumbai cha Don ani Rajkarni ha tyancha pravas kasa hota, aikuya ya saglya pravasachi ranjak kahani- 'Dagadi chalicha Daddy'

the-girl-from-fergana.title: The Girl from Fergana
the-girl-from-fergana.description: The Girl from Fergana by Jonathan Gil Harris is a poignant memoir that pieces together his mother Stella’s life using the contents of her Chinese tea chest. Escaping Nazi-occupied Poland in 1939, her journey leads her to Central Asia's Fergana Valley. Intertwining personal trauma with 2,500 years of Silk Road history, it explores displacement, fading memory, and a vanished pluralistic world.

the-billionaires-debt.title: The Billionaire's Debt
the-billionaires-debt.description: Shiva, a humble driver in billionaire Shikhar Singh’s mansion, secretly lives as Shivansh Rathore, heir to one of the world’s richest families. After five years of exile, his disguise ends just as Shikhar loses his empire and Meera is abandoned by her fiancé. With his fortune restored, Shivansh returns to reveal his true identity and make everyone who humiliated him pay for underestimating him.

bangla-desh-se-kyon-bhag-rahe-hain-hindu.title: Bangladesh Se Kyu Bhaag Rahe Hain Hindu
bangla-desh-se-kyon-bhag-rahe-hain-hindu.description: Log apne ghar se dur rehne ka dukh nahi seh paate toh sochiye apne desh se dur jaane ka dukh sehna kitna mushkil hota hoga. Humari audiobook “Bangladesh Se Kyu Bhaag Rahein Hain Hindu” mein aapko jaan-ne ko milega ki kaise Hinduon par alag-alag tarah se zulm aur atyaachaar karke unhein apne hi gharon se nikalne ke liye pareshaan kiya gaya. Lekin kya kisi ne Hinduon ki madad ki ya in saari problems ka koi solution nikala bhi gaya? Ye sab jaan-ne ke liye shuru karte hai humara pehla episode.

get-it-done-2.title: Get It Done
get-it-done-2.description: Kya To-Do list banane ke baad bhi aapko apne kaam karne mein mushkil hoti hai? Agar haan, to dikkat list mein nahi, aapke tarike mein hai! Kyunki To-Do list banane ka ek sahi aur verified formula hai. Ise follow kar, hum sahi tarah se apne din aur kaam ka division kar sakte hain. Aur Procrastination se bach sakte hain. Is tarike ko janne ke liye sunni hogi aapko Get It Done ki ye audiobook!

escape-the-emi-cycle.title: Escape The EMI Cycle
escape-the-emi-cycle.description:
EMI தொல்லை! இனி இல்லை!
Know the Secrets for an EMI less Life!

the-compound-effect-8.title: Sofolota Pete Ki Ki Mene Cholte Hobe ?
the-compound-effect-8.description: Aamra Sobai Nijder Sopno Puron  Korte Chai. Jibone Sofolota Aante Chai. Kintu Sei Poth Soja Noy. Sofolotar Kono Shortcut Hoy Na. Jodi Aapni Shortcutvabe Kono Kaje Sofolota Pan Tahole Mathay Rakhben Seta Samoyik. Sofolota Asey Anekgulo Bishoyer Upor Nirvor Kore. Ebar Aapnar Mone Proshno Jagche, Ki Sei Bishoyguli? Kon Kon Poddhoti Anusoron Kore Sofolotar Sirshe Pouchono Jay? Kon Pothe Lukiye Royeche Sofolotar Chabikathi? Ei Boitir Moddhey Lukiye Royeche Seisob Pother Sondhan. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Shune Neyoya Jak Ei Audiobook.

insanvar-1-to-18.title: Insanvar
insanvar-1-to-18.description: Insaan ke roop mein chhipe janwar ko jagakar, ek shakhs ne duniya ko diya ek naya avtaar - 'Insanvar'. Kaun tha yeh rahasyamayi shakhs? Kya hai uski asliyat aur maksad ? Aur phir milie us bahadur insaan se, jo chamgadar banne ke baawjood insaniyat ke liye ladta raha. Suniye, dekhiye aur mehsoos kijiye 'Insanvar' ka adbhut sansar, sirf KUKUFM par.

what-is-illuminati-1.title: What is Illuminati?
what-is-illuminati-1.description: Ee Lokathinte niyanthranavum nammude oro neekkavum ajnathamaya etho shakthikalude kayyil aanenna ghoodalochana siddhanthangal orupad naalayi nammude samoohathil und. Ee shakthikale Illuminatikal ennanu goodalochana siddhanthakkar vilikkunnath. Yadrichikamennu thonnunna pala sambhavangalum nigoodamam vidham bhandham undennu ivar Parayunnu. Illuminati sathyamo Mithyayo ennu parishodhikkam,  aa nigooda vazhikal kettariyam.

marthandavarma.title: മാര്‍ത്താണ്ഡ വര്‍മ്മ
marthandavarma.description: തിരുവിതാംകൂര്‍ രാജ്യാധികാരത്തിനു വേണ്ടിയുള്ള അധികാര വടംവലിയും തുടര്‍ന്നുണ്ടായ യഥാർത്ഥ സംഭവങ്ങളെയും  ചുറ്റിപ്പറ്റി നടക്കുന്ന കഥ ഒരു പൊളിറ്റിക്കല്‍ ത്രില്ലറാണ് മാര്‍ത്താണ്ഡ വര്‍മ്മ. സിവി രാമന്‍പിള്ള രചിച്ച് 1891 പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കപ്പെട്ട മലയാളത്തിലെ ക്ലാസിക് നോവലുകളില്‍ ഒന്നാണിത്.

the-art-of-war-8.title: The Art of War
the-art-of-war-8.description: 5th Century la Sun Tzu Ezhuthuna "The Art of War" book la irukura strategies sa Maaveeran Napoleon maathiriyaana periya periya por veerargal ellaam payanpaduthi vetriya kuvichurukaanga ! Intha war strategies sa naama Por la jeikirathuku mattum illama vazhkaila jeikirathukum kooda use pannalam. Vazhkaiye Porkalam , Vazhnthu thaan Parkanum. Vaanga Sun Tzu solli kudukura Por kalaiya Kathukalam, Vazhkaila Jeyikalam.

paheli-maut-ki.title: Paheli Maut Ki
paheli-maut-ki.description: Chhote se town mein ek ladki ki maut ne police ko hila kar rakh diya tha. Inspector Neelam ne jaise hi investigation shuru ki, har clue usse ek naye raaz tak le gaya, jahan sach aur bhi zyada darawana nikla. Maut ke tareeke, logon ke badalte bayaan, aur chhupaye gaye connections ne case ko aur uljha diya. Sawal yeh tha ki yeh sirf ek haadsa tha, ya kisi bade qatl silsile ki pehli maut?

kesavadevinte-kathakal.title: കേശവദേവിൻ്റെ കഥകൾ
kesavadevinte-kathakal.description: പി. കേശവദേവിൻ്റെ ഹൃദയഹാരി ആയ 37 കഥകളുടെ സമാഹാരം. ജീവിതത്തിൻ്റെ തീക്ഷണ യാഥാർത്ഥ്യങ്ങളെയും നന്മയുടെ ഉറവകളെയും ഒരു പോലെ അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്ന കഥകൾ. നല്ല നാളെ എന്ന ശുഭചിന്തയുടെ ആന്തരധ്വനി കേശവദേവിൻ്റെ കഥകളിലെ അനുപേക്ഷണീയതയാണു. മലായാളത്തിൻ്റെ ഗതകാലത്തിൻ്റെ നേർചിത്രങ്ങളാകുന്ന മനോഹരങ്ങളായ  കേൾക്കാം...

jamtara-1.title: Jamtara
jamtara-1.description: Pala vagayaana cybercrime pathi namma kelvi patruppom. Jamtara vai pathi kelvi pattinga naa athu ungalukku innum aacharyathai kodukkum. Cybercrime pathiyum Jamtara pathiyum intha pathivula kekalaam.

the-deoliwallahs-1.title: The Deoliwallahs
the-deoliwallahs-1.description: China la irundhu India ku pulampeyarndhavargal oda vaazhkao pathina book dhaan idhu.

sohoj-upay-pora-toirir-secret.title: Sohoj Upay Pora Toirir Secret
sohoj-upay-pora-toirir-secret.description: Aamader Moddhey Emon Oneke Aache Jader Boi Porte Ektuo Valo Lage Na. Ei Valo Na Lagar Ekta Karon Hote Pare Pora Mukhostho Na Hoyoya. Aabar Oneke Aache Jara Dekhe Class Er Oi Cheleta Ba Oi Meyeta Prothom Hocche Aami Keno Parchi Na? Ora Ki Kono Secret Follow Kore? Eirokom Kichu Proshno Sadharonoto Dekha Jay Chatro-Chatrider Mone. Tahole Ebar Proshno Holo Emon Ki Kichu Upay Aache, Jeta Follow Korte Parle Pora Mukhostho Kora Jabe, Valo Result Kora Jabe Khub Sohojei. Hya Seirokom Kichu Secret Aalochona Kora Hoyeche Ei Audiobook E, Ja Chatro-Chatrider Mone Ghurpak Khayoya  Proshnogulo Somadhan Kore Dite Pare. Tahole Aar Deri Na Kore Jhotpot Shune Neyoya Jak Sei Secretgulo.

garuda-puranam.title: Garuda Puranam
garuda-puranam.description: Sri Maha Vishnuvu Garuthmanthuniki vaitharini gurinchi vivarinchadu. Narakamante emity? Adi evariki prapthisthundi. Daanini ela thappinchukovali. Adi ela untundi. vivaralu indulo vivarinchabaddayi. Papathmulu mathrame yamapuriki dakshina dvaram gunda povalsi untundi. Manishiga putti cheyyakudani paapala gurinchi indulo cheppabadindi.

galpa-swalpa-part-1.title: Galpa Swalpa - Part 1
galpa-swalpa-part-1.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

indias-biggest-money-mistakes.title: India’s Biggest Money Mistakes
indias-biggest-money-mistakes.description: Why does your salary disappear every month? India’s Biggest Money Mistakes explores the financial mistakes millions of Indians make—from FOMO shopping, EMI traps and impulsive spending to lifestyle inflation, fake luxury and poor investment choices. Discover the psychology behind your money habits, understand the difference between looking rich and building wealth, and learn practical lessons to spend smarter, save better and create long-term financial freedom.

hero-of-the-emergency-jayaprakash-naraya.title: Heroes Of Emergency: Jayaprakash Narayan
hero-of-the-emergency-jayaprakash-naraya.description: JP: wo naam jisse Emergency lagane wali wali Indira government khauf khati thi, jinhe Jawaharlal Nehru Deputy Prime Minister banana chahte the, aur jinhone poore India ko corruption aur sarkar ki manmani ke khilaf sadko par laa diya tha. Kya hai Bharat mein ‘Total Revolution’ ki mashal jalaane wale JP ki kahani? Aur kyon unhe PM banna manzoor nahi tha? Aaiye sunte hain is show mein.

padharasa-paravaikal.title: Paatharasa Paravaigal
padharasa-paravaikal.description: ஒரு அடுக்குமாடி அபார்மெண்டுக்குள் நடக்கும் கலகலப்பான காமெடி கலந்த காதல் கதையே பாதரசப் பறவைகள்...

ayodhya-facts-and-findings.title: Ayodhya: Facts and Findings
ayodhya-facts-and-findings.description: Ayodhyayile Babri Masjid Thakartha Sambhavam Indian Janathaye njetticha sambhavam aayirunnu. Babri Masjid thakartha sthalath supreme kodathi vidhi prakaram puthiya ramakshethram panithirikkukayanu ipol. Sambhavathinte charithravum vasthuthakalum ee Bytesilude ariyam.

nutrition-in-todays-food-culture.title: Nutrition In Today's Food Culture
nutrition-in-todays-food-culture.description: Nammude aarogyathinum dhynamdina karyangal cheyyanulla oorjathinum bhakshanam athyavashyamaanu. Ennal vishappu mattan enthenkilum kazhichal mathi enna nilayil aano karyangale kanendath. Bhakshanam kazhikkayka mathramalla asradhamaya bhakshana sheelavum aarogyathinu nallathalla. Poshakangal adangiya aaharam kazhikkuka ennath ella kalathum nam sradhikkenda karyam aanu. Bhakshanathile poshakangalude pradhanyathe kurich ariyan ee show kelkkam.

suryaputra-karna.title: Suryaputra Karna
suryaputra-karna.description: Story of karn starting in mahabharat with glimpses of his past as the story moves on, Karna, Arjun, Kunti , Krishna are the main characters with Karna being the lead.

mahabharathada-mahashapagalu.title: Mahabharathada Mahashapagalu
mahabharathada-mahashapagalu.description: "ಮಹಾಭಾರತ ಮಹಾಶಾಪಗಳು" ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಶಾಪಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಪಂಡಿತರು ತಮ್ಮ ಮೊಮ್ಮಗ ಆರ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುವ ಕಥೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ,  ದ್ರೌಪದಿಯ ಶಾಪ, ಕರ್ಣನ ಶಾಪ, ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮನ ಕುತಂತ್ರ, ಗಾಂಧಾರಿಯ ಕೋಪ, ದುರ್ವಾಸರ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಲವಾರು ಶಾಪಗಳನ್ನು ಅನ್ವೇಷಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಶಾಪಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಕರ್ಮದ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಹಾಭಾರತದ ಕಥಾಹಂದರವನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನ ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.  ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯೂ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಸನಾತನ ಸತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋ ಸರಣಿ ನಮಗೆ ನೆನಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

the-ventilator-project-how-iit-kanpur-sa.title: The Ventilator Project : How IIT Kanpur Saved India
the-ventilator-project-how-iit-kanpur-sa.description: Prithibi Totha Gota Bharot Jokhon Coronar Thabay Jorjorito, Charidike Ghote Choleche Mrityu Micchil. Thik Sei Somoy IIT Kanpur Er Jugantokari Aabishkar Ventilator Pran Banchay Bohu Manusher. Kintu Tara Eto Kom Somoye Kivabe Plan Korechilo Ei Project-Er? Cholun Shune Nebo Sei Bishoy Ei Audio Book-E.

isro-the-pride-of-india.title: ISRO: The Pride Of India
isro-the-pride-of-india.description:
ఇస్రో (ISRO) అంటే ఇండియన్ స్పేస్ రీసెర్చ్ ఆర్గనైజేషన్. ఇది భారతదేశం యొక్క అంతరిక్ష పరిశోధన సంస్థ. 1969లో స్థాపించబడిన ఈ సంస్థ స్థాపకుడు డా. విక్రమ్ సారాభాయ్. భారత్‌ను స్వయం సమర్థ దేశంగా తీర్చిదిద్దడమే ఈ సంస్థ లక్ష్యం.

ఇస్రో ద్వారా భారతదేశం ఎన్నో విజయాలను సాధించింది. ముఖ్యంగా:

చంద్రయాన్-1, చంద్రయాన్-3 మిషన్ల ద్వారా చంద్రుడిపై విజయవంతమైన అన్వేషణ
మంగళ్యాన్ (Mars Orbiter Mission) ద్వారా భారతదేశం అంగారక గ్రహానికి చేరిన మొదటి దేశాలలో ఒకటిగా మారింది
PSLV, GSLV వంటి నమ్మదగిన రాకెట్ లాంచర్ల అభివృద్ధి
ఇస్రో తక్కువ వ్యయంతో అధిక ఫలితాలు సాధించడంలో ప్రపంచానికి ఆదర్శంగా నిలిచింది.

galikondapuram-railway-gate.title: గాలికొండపురం రైల్వే గేటు
galikondapuram-railway-gate.description: కథానాయకుడు ఒక చిన్న పల్లెటూరి వాతావరణంలో ఉండే రైల్వే గేట్ వద్ద విధులు నిర్వహిస్తాడు. అతని జీవితంలో చోటు చేసుకున్న సంఘటనలు, వాస్తవాలు మరియు అనుభవాలు మనిషి జీవితాన్ని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయో మనకు తెలియజేస్తుంది. రైల్వే గేట్ వద్ద జరిగే జీవిత ఘటనలు, ప్రేమ, బాధ, ఆనందం వంటి అనేక భావోద్వేగాలను ఈ "గాలికొండపురం రైల్వే గేటు" కథను విని తెలుసుకోండి.

the-power-of-influence-1.title: The Power of Influence
the-power-of-influence-1.description: "Prabhav Kaise Jamaye": Yoritomo-Tashi ke nuskhe se seekho kaise apne aap ko aur doosron ko prabhavit kar sakte hain. Ye show aapko batayega ki kaise confidence aur common sense se aap apne goals achieve kar sakte ho.

maaya.title: Wonder Woman
maaya.description: Ek normal workshop mein kaam karne wali Maaya ki jindagi us waqt badal jati hai jab use milta hai ek naya PA. Is PA ke pane ke liye ek badi MNC kisi bhi had tak ja sakti hai. Par is PA ki madad se Maaya, aane wali tabahi ko bhi rok sakti hai. Kya Maaya is duniya ko bacha payegi? Janne ke liye sunein, Wonder Woman

chunavi-chitthiyan-1.title: Chunavi Chithiyaan
chunavi-chitthiyan-1.description: 2002 mein kya hua tha Atal aur Amma Ke beech jisse aaj Modi 2024 ke chunav mein seekh le rhe hain? Kya hai un chithiyon ki kahani jisse sarkar 4 baar girte-girte bachi? Sab janiye "Chunavi Chithiyaan" mein.

quiet-1.title: Introvert Der Sommondhe Jene Nin
quiet-1.description: Dekha geche je ek tritiyangsho lok introverts ei prithibi te. Tara hochhe shei manush guli jara gaan shunte pochondo kore karur sathe kotha bolar theke beshi. Jara innovate ba notun kichu srishti korte bhalobashe,kintu nije der promote korte na. Ei shob manushera eka eka kaj e biswasi, sobar songe kaj korar theke beshi. Amra sohojei introverts der heo ba chhoto kore thaki. Sara biswa jure jemon anek prosidhyo extroverts ache thik shei rokom introverts o ache. Ei book summary ti jodi apnara shonen tahole amader introverts der somporke anek dharonai bodle jabe.

beating-the-street-6.title: Investing Che Guide
beating-the-street-6.description: Beating Street Hey  Peter lynch Yani Lihilela Pustak Ek Investment Guide Ahe. Lekhak Svata Investment Kshetratle Expert Ahet. Tyana Ya Kshetratla Master Manla Jata. Stock Investment Madhil Gudie Aslela Hey Pustak Tumhala Lynch Yanchahya Jounreyshi Connect Karel. Yat Tyani Trading, Stock Market Madhil Anek Formula Sangitle Ahet.

cricket-evolution-in-india-after-20-20-l.title: Cricket Evolution In India After 20-20 League
cricket-evolution-in-india-after-20-20-l.description: 2007 T20WC ku aprm India yen oru cup kooda jeikala? Franchise Cricket vandha aprm cricketers ellarume national team ku importance kudukuradhu illa nu varra complaints unmaiya? Ulagam mulukka nadakkum cricket leagues la Indian players yaarume yen aadurathu illa? Idhuku pinnala iruka pala vishayangala therinjuka kelunga “Evolution of cricket in India after 20-20 League” on Kuku FM

the-wealth-money-cant-buy.title: The Wealth Money Can't Buy
the-wealth-money-cant-buy.description: ನಮ್ಮ ನಿಜವಾದ ಸಂಪತ್ತು , ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಇವೆ, ಹಾಗು ಇದನ್ನು ರೋಬಿನ್ ಶರ್ಮಾ ಅವರು 8  ಅದ್ಭುತ ಹವ್ಯಾಸಗಳನ್ನು  ಮೂಲಕ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾರೆ – ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸ,ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕಾಳಜಿ,ಹಣದ ಸತತ ಬಳಕೆ,ಸಮಾಜಿಕ ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು,ಕುಟುಂಬ ಪ್ರಾಮುಖ್ಯತೆ, ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆ, ಸಾಹಸ, ಮತ್ತು ಸೇವಾ ಮನೋಭಾವ. ಈ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡರೆ ನಾವು ಆಂತರಿಕ ಸಂತೋಷ, ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ, ಮತ್ತು ನಿಜವಾದ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು. ನಿಜವಾದ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತಿಕೆ ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿಇದೆ ಎಂಬುವುದನ್ನು ಈ ಕಥೆಯ ಸಾರಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವಿರಿ.

aankhon-dekhi.title: Aankhon Dekhi
aankhon-dekhi.description: 26/11 ko jab Leopold Cafe mein atankwadi ghuse to vaha ke logo ne jaan bachane ke liye kya kiya? 2009 mein Pulwama Hamla kaise hua? 2013 mein Kedarnath mein jab badal phata toh log kaise mandir ki ghanti se latak kar apni jaan bacha rahe the? COVID ke dauran videsh mein atke Indians ko lane wali Kozhikode-Dubai plane ke crash ke samay aakhir hua kya tha? Itihas mein darj aisi hi durghatnao ke baare mein jaane lekin ek eye witness ki aankhon se.

kaamsutrakaar-vaatsayan.title: Kaamsutrakaar Vaatsayan
kaamsutrakaar-vaatsayan.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

అతడే-ఆమె-సైన్యం.title: అతడే ఆమె సైన్యం
అతడే-ఆమె-సైన్యం.description: అతడొక సినిమా హీరో. సినిమా షూటింగ్‌ జరుగుతుండగా స్పృహ తప్పింది. స్పృహ వచ్చేసరికి అతడు ఆసుపత్రిలో ఉన్నాడు. డాక్టర్లు, నర్సులు అందరూ అతడిని సెక్రటేరియట్‌ గుమాస్తాగా గుర్తించారు. తాను సినిమా హీరోనని నిరూపించుకోవటానికి అతడు చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలన్నీ తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా?అయితే అడుగుడుగునా సస్పెన్షన్ తో యండమూరి వీరేంద్రనాథ్ రాసిన సస్పెన్స్  థ్రిల్లర్ నవల - "అతడే ఆమె సైన్యం" అనే ఆడియో వినండి.

dbce63eb-612b-4f7c-aa9e-4412939e51b6.title: Shiv Ne Bana Di Jodi
dbce63eb-612b-4f7c-aa9e-4412939e51b6.description:
Mansi discovers her fiancé's betrayal the night before their wedding. Broken and furious, she storms into a Shiv temple and turns her back on the very god she worshipped.

But Lord Shiv has other plans. Enter Rudra — calm, powerful, with a Mahadev tattoo on his hand.

This is a story of Mansi — a woman who lost her faith, not knowing Lord Shiv was already sending her something better.

siru-deiva-valibaadum-nambikkaigalum.title: Siru Deiva Valibaadum Nambikkaigalum
siru-deiva-valibaadum-nambikkaigalum.description: Sakthi vaaindha Siru devangal ah vazhipadurathan nanmaigal enna, Tamilnadu la enga lam sirappana kovilga sthalangal amanjurukku nu indha audio book la kelunga.

col-ekalingam-adventures-1.title: Col Ekalingam Adventures
col-ekalingam-adventures-1.description: మల్లాది గారి "కర్నల్ ఏకలింగం అడ్వెంచర్స్" ఒక సాహసోపేతమైన ప్రయోగం. స్నేహితుల మధ్య పంచుకునే హాస్య కథలను ఏకలింగం జీవితం చుట్టూ అల్లారు. ఆడవారైనా, మగవారైనా నవ్వించే ఈ కథలు మన నిజజీవితానికి అద్దం పడతాయి

free-to-focus-13.title: Free to Focus
free-to-focus-13.description:
Achieve more by doing less.
[Key Ideas Explained]

ramas-final-journey.title: Rama's Final Journey
ramas-final-journey.description:
இராவணனை வீழ்த்தி அயோத்திக்குத் திரும்பிய இராமனின் வாழ்க்கையில், உண்மையான சோதனை அதன்பிறகே தொடங்குகிறது.
மக்களின் சந்தேகத்திற்காக சீதையைப் பிரிந்த இராமன், தனது மகன்களான லவனையும் குசனையும் அறியாமலேயே சந்திக்கிறான்.
குடும்பப் பிரிவு, தர்மம், அரசக் கடமை மற்றும் இழப்புகளின் வழியாக இராமனின் வாழ்க்கை புதிய திருப்பங்களைச் சந்திக்கிறது.
இறுதியில், அன்பையும் கடமையையும் தாங்கிய இராமனின் கடைசி பயணம் சரயு நதிக்கரையை நோக்கிச் செல்கிறது.

hiroshima-nagasaki-1.title: Hiroshima Nagasaki
hiroshima-nagasaki-1.description: అమెరికా జపాన్ మీద అణుబాంబు ఎందుకు వేసింది? అణుబాంబు ప్రయోగం తర్వాత జపాన్ పరిస్థితి ఏంటి? నేటికీ ఆనాటి గాయాలు జపాన్ ని వెంటాడుతున్నాయా?

general-dyre.title: Dyer's Bloodbath: Jallianwala Bagh 1919
general-dyre.description: 13 April, 1919 ko General Dyer ne Amritsar ke Jallianwala Bagh mein Baisakhi ki khushiyan manane aaye Bhartiyon ko apne ek order par khatam kar diya. Par kya aapko pata hai, Bharat ke itihas ke iss khoonkhar villain ko British Government ne kabhi 'Patriot' ka samman diya tha? Itna hi nahi, aaj tak na toh Buckhingham Palace ne na hi British sarkar ne is hatyakaand ki maafi mangi hai. Itne logo ko maarne ke bad bhi Dyer shaant nahi hua tha, Wo Amritsar se aur bada badla lene ko taiyaar tha. Jane kya thi uski saazish aur kaise hua tha uska ant?

behind-the-business-dindugal-biriyani.title: Behind the Business - Dindugal Biriyani
behind-the-business-dindugal-biriyani.description:
ஒரு சிறிய ஹோட்டலில் தொடங்கிய பிரியாணி, எப்படி உலகம் முழுக்க தமிழர்களின் மனதை வென்ற பிராண்டாக மாறியது?
தரம், பாரம்பரியம் மற்றும் மாறாத சுவையை மட்டுமே நம்பி வளர்ந்த திண்டுக்கல் தலப்பாக்கட்டியின் பயணத்தை இந்த நிகழ்ச்சி ஆராய்கிறது.
ஒரு பெயர் எப்படி ஒரு நகரத்தின் அடையாளமாக மாறியது என்பதன் உண்மையான கதை இது.

ahare-onahare-vivekananda.title: Ahare Onahare Vivekananda
ahare-onahare-vivekananda.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

the-bridge-between-times.title: The Bridge Between Times
the-bridge-between-times.description:
"In a twist of fate, death becomes a doorway to a second chance at love."

Betrayed and murdered in the present, Lucas awakens in medieval Ensia—a kingdom shrouded in mystery. Alongside Catherine, the enigmatic daughter of a missing bridge maker, he's thrust into a world of royal intrigue and forgotten lore. As they unravel the kingdom's dark secrets, Lucas and Catherine's unexpected bond deepens. But a cosmic clock ticks relentlessly, threatening to tear Lucas from this new world—and the love he never saw coming.

Listen to "The Bridge of Time" on Kuku FM and immerse yourself in this thrilling tale of betrayal, romance, and time-bending adventure!

ఆనందో-బ్రహ్మ.title: ఆనందో బ్రహ్మ
ఆనందో-బ్రహ్మ.description: కోనసీమ కొబ్బరాకు - గలగలా గోదావరి. ఆ ఇసుక తిన్నెల మీద నుంచి గాలి తరంగాల్లోంచి వచ్చే వేద పఠనంలా ఒక కుర్రవాడెగిరి పట్నం వచ్చి పడ్డాడు. ఉక్కిరి బిక్కిరి అయ్యేడు. ఓ ఇరవై నాలుగేళ్ల గృహిణి అతడిని లలితంగా సేదదీర్చింది. అది ప్రేమా ? ఆకర్షణా? స్పందనా? సెక్సా? ఆ బంధం నిర్వచనం ఏమిటి? ఫ్యూచరాలజీకి పాస్టాలజీ మిక్సు చేసి అచ్చ తెలుగులో వీరేంధ్రనాథ్ అల్లిన సరళ లాలిత్య పదాల సన్నజాజి పందిరి ఈ ’ఆనందో బ్రహ్మ’.

nathuram-nathi.title: Nathuram Nathi
nathuram-nathi.description: Travel back in time with Kuku FM's History shows. Explore ancient civilizations pivotal moments and the people who shaped our world. Our engaging storytelling brings history to life making the past relevant and exciting. From legendary battles to cultural revolutions enrich your knowledge of the human saga. Listen and connect with the stories that define us

psychiatric-lobby.title: Psychiatric Lobby
psychiatric-lobby.description: Haunted by elusive memories and sinister entities in an abandoned asylum, Evelyn battles anxiety and disturbing hallucinations. As she pieces together her fractured past, she uncovers a harrowing truth: her mind, twisted by an experimental drug, holds the key to a dark secret of revenge she’s yet to fully remember.

partha-chattopadhyay-jana-ojana-kahini.title: Partha Chattopadhyay - Jana Ojana Kahini
partha-chattopadhyay-jana-ojana-kahini.description: Partha Chattopadhyay ke keno dol theke ekghore kore deowa holo? Doler proti eto ta responsible thaka sotteo ki emon ghotlo? Partha Chattopadhyay er journey shuru theke shesh kina jani na kintu ekhono obdhi political ebong social journey jante shune nin ei audiobook ti.

begusarai-ki-biwi.title: Begusarai ki Biwi
begusarai-ki-biwi.description: Begusarai ke rivaaj aur rajneeti ke beech, pyar aur nafrat ka ek anokha rishta janm leta hai. Yeh hai Bibi Gupta ki kahani, jo apne apmaan ka badla lene aur apni nayi pehchaan banane nikli hai. Shaadi ke mandap mein IPS officer Raja Tripathi ki zindagi ulat-palat hoti hai jab Bibi apni biwi hone ka dawa karti hai. Lekin yeh toh sirf shuruat hai, kyunki Bibi shatranj ke khiladi ki tarah har chaal soojh-boojh se chalti hai. Kya woh apne dushman ka chehra badal paayegi, ya khud is khel ka shikar ban jayegi ?

hindosta-hamara.title: Hindosta Hamara
hindosta-hamara.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

nirakarna.title: Niraakarana
nirakarna.description: "ಸಂಸಾರಸಾಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಈಜಿ ದಡ ಸೇರಿದವ್ರಿಗಿಂತ, ಕೈಚೆಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿದವರೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚು‌." ಹೀಗಾಗಿಯೇ ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ ಸಂಸಾರದ ಸಹವಾಸವೇ ಬೇಡ ಎಂದು, ಸಮಾಜದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬಂಧಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗ್ತನೆ. ಈ ಯಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಏನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಘಟಿಸುತ್ತೆ ಅನ್ನೋದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಕೇಳಿ ಎಸ್. ಎಲ್ ಭೈರಪ್ಪನವರ 'ನಿರಾಕರಣ' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

nishabda-sancharangal.title: നിശബ്ദ സഞ്ചാരങ്ങൾ
nishabda-sancharangal.description: ആടുജീവിതത്തിനുശേഷം പ്രവാസികളുടെ ഹൃദയഹാരിയായ ഒരു കഥയുമായി ബെന്യാമിൻ വീണ്ടുമെത്തുന്നു!  ആദ്യമായി കേരളത്തിൽ നിന്നും കടൽ കടന്ന് വിദേശത്തേക്കുപോയ നേഴ്‌സുമാരുടെ ജീവിതം വരച്ചുകാട്ടുന്ന ഒരു അതുല്യ കൃതി- നിശബ്ദ സഞ്ചാരങ്ങൾ!

universe-mysteries.title: Universe Mysteries
universe-mysteries.description:
ప్రపంచంలో ఉన్న రహస్యాలను చెప్తున్న ఈ ఆడియో షోలో మీరు కూడా భాగమవ్వండి.

"యూనివర్సల్ మిస్టరీస్"లో మీరు మన విశ్వంలోని అనేక అపురూపమైన రహస్యాలు, తెలియని సంఘటనలు, మరియు వివరణ చేయలేని విషయాలు తెలుసుకుంటారు. ఈ షోలో ప్రతీ ఒక్కవిషయం ఒక రహస్యం, ప్రతి చర్చ ఒక కొత్త అన్వేషణ.

మిమ్మల్ని ఈ అన్వేషణలో భాగస్వాములు చేసుకోవడానికి సిద్ధంగా ఉన్నారా?

ఆడనటానికి, శ్రవణానందం పొందేందుకు "యూనివర్సల్ మిస్టరీస్"ను వినండి!

Valliddaru-Antena-వాళ్ళిద్దరూ-అంతేనా.title: వాళ్ళిద్దరూ అంతేనా?
Valliddaru-Antena-వాళ్ళిద్దరూ-అంతేనా.description: భార్య భర్తల కథ లో నాస్తికత్వం అనే కోణం జోడిస్తే, అది వారి దాంపత్యాన్ని ఏ విధంగా ముందుకు నడిపింది. సమస్యలు వస్తే, ఎవరిది తప్పు? ఎవరిది ఒప్పు?  'వాళ్ళిద్దరూ అంతేనా' ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోసం...

54f688bc-7425-4ea9-b758-6bdb079ff4fe.description: Pyaar ko ek bhayanak junoon mein badalte zyada waqt nahin lagta. Par jab wo junoon kisiki hatya mein tabdil ho jaaye, toh pyaar se khoonkaar aur koi cheez bhi nahin hota. Suniye ek aisi hi chaunka dene waali kahaani, kewal aapke manoranjan ke liye.

जानलेवा-सफर.description: Kya koi kalpana bhi kar sakta hai ki uska safar itna jaanlewa ho sakta hai? Kahani ki shuruwaat hoti hai saat dosto se jo apni pareshaniyo se door bhagne ke liye apne parivar ko bina batae Laddakh ghoomne nikal padte hai, shuruwaat me inka safar kaafi dilchasp lagta hai lekin ek waqt ke baad inka safar itna bhayanak ban jaata hai ki jiski kalpana bhi inhone kabhi nahi ki thi, yah sabhi aisi jagah fas jaate hain jahan fasne ke baad yah sabhi pachhtate hain ki inhone ghoomne ka faisla kyon kiya, situation itni naajuk ho jati hai ki inka bachkar nikal pana bhi mumkin nahi lag raha hai, shayad hi itne bhayanak safar ki inhne kalpana ki thi, kis tarah se inka suhana safar badal gaya janleva safar mein, janne ke liye suniye kahani 'Janleva Safar".

the-item-girl.title: Item Girl
the-item-girl.description: భయంకరమైన బాల్యాన్ని పంచుకునే కవల సోదరీమణుల కథ గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? బాలీవుడ్‌లో ప్రముఖ ఐటెమ్ గర్ల్ గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? పేలుడు, రేప్-టేప్, క్రూరమైన బ్లాక్‌మెయిలర్, క్రూరమైన బాయ్‌ఫ్రెండ్, విరక్తితో కూడిన జర్నలిస్ట్ మరియు కఠినమైన పోలీస్ పాత్రలతో మన మనస్సును కదిలించే సైకలాజికల్ థ్రిల్లర్ కథ ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా వినండి.

how-to-sell-your-way-through-life-2.description: Sales enna kalayil mikav pularthan aagrahikkunna aarkkum vilappetta ulkkazhchakalum athinu uthakunna thanthrangalum pakarnnu nalkunna pusthakamanu Napoleon Hillinte How to sell your way through life.
