Sales ennath ulppannangalo Sevanangalo mathramalla, Athu ningalude aashayangaleyum falapradhamayi vipananam cheyyunnathanennu pusthakam parayunnu.

married-by-chance.title: Married By Chance
married-by-chance.description: The story centers on housing trouble that repeatedly forces strangers into close quarters and unstable relationships. It begins with apartment confusion, locked doors, and a flat that is shown to the wrong people, making simple housing search into a crisis. Because bachelors and single tenants are not welcome, the characters are pushed toward fake-marriage arrangements and public performances of being husband and wife. These cover stories are sold through staged photos, rehearsed answers, and careful household rules, but they quickly become harder to maintain. As the flatmates live together, friction turns into familiarity, and the line between acting and real feeling starts to blur. Arjun and Meera/Mira become the main center of this pressure, with their relationship shifting from deception to something more emotionally serious. Family members then begin to notice wedding photos, old profiles, and inconsistent details, turning private lies into public scrutiny. Mothers, uncles, and other relatives keep testing the couple, and each visit threatens to expose the truth. At the same time, jealous exes and hidden past relationships add more tension around Arjun and Meera/Mira. The story also widens into money and career trouble, including a scam, a property-related app launch, and attempts to protect one another from outside harm. Arjun increasingly steps in to shield Mira/Meera, which deepens their bond but also raises the stakes of the deception. In one branch of the story, a fake-marriage setup is described as a long-term arrangement where the pair must act married outside while living as flatmates inside. In another, family approval becomes the central obstacle, especially when relatives suspect the couple is using the relationship to secure property. Arjun's mother appears to accept Meera as family, while his uncle remains suspicious and confrontational. The pressure eventually pushes Arjun toward a real commitment, and he proposes marriage rather than continuing the lie. The couple later returns with a marriage certificate and asks for approval, suggesting a move from cover story toward formal recognition. Even so, the broader world of suspicion, exes, scams, and family conflict remains unresolved around them.

how-to-sell-your-product.title: How to sell your product?
how-to-sell-your-product.description: வெற்றிகரமான விற்பனைக்கும் வலிமையான பிராண்டுகளுக்கும் பின்னால் இருக்கும் உளவியலை அறிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள். விலை நிர்ணயம், வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் உணர்வுகள், நம்பிக்கை, பார்வை மற்றும் மார்க்கெட்டிங் உத்திகள் வாங்கும் முடிவுகளை எவ்வாறு பாதிக்கின்றன என்பதைப் புரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள். வாடிக்கையாளர்களைக் கவர்ந்து, நிலையான உறவுகளை உருவாக்கி, உங்கள் தயாரிப்பை வெற்றிகரமான பிராண்டாக மாற்றக் கற்றுக்கொள்ளுங்கள்.

rohan-bopanna-story-of-an-underdog-tenni.description: Har kisi ke andar chhupa hai ek champion, bas zarurat hai pehchaan ki aur sahi guidance ki. Rohan Bopanna ki life se seekhiye ki kaise ek ordinary player ban sakta hai tennis ke world mein extraordinary. Is show mein, aapko milenge woh sabak jo aapko bhi bana sakte hain apne field ka star. Toh, are you ready to serve an ace in your life? Suniye abhi

checkmate-billionaire.description: Mandy's life takes a shocking turn when a mysterious night leaves her pregnant and trapped in a cruel marriage to Jake Mallory, New York's ruthless billionaire. Years later, she emerges stronger, allying with Jake's rival, Kai Thompson, to seek justice. Will she find redemption or be dragged back into the abyss? Two billionaires. One golden girl. A journey of vengeance, resilience, and unexpected love.

depression-signs-and-symtoms.title: Depression Signs And Symtoms
depression-signs-and-symtoms.description: Depression ha ek asa aajar ahe ki jyamadhe aapli jagnyacha aanad ghenyachi icchach nahishi hote. Depression he atmahtyeche ek pramukh karan ahe. Deepika padukone sarkhya celebritiesnahi nairashyacha samna karava lagla hota. Pan nairashyatunn baher padun jivanacha anand ghene shakya ahe. Tyasathi nairashya ya aajarachi nit mahiti karun ghene aavashyak ahe. Ya showmadhe tumhala nairashyachi lakshane, prakar ani tyavrche upay yabaddalchi mahiti milel ani nairashyashi ladha kasa dyava hyababat margadarshanhi hoil.Ha show aikun nairashyagrast vyakatina nakkich madat hoil.

the-comedy-bible.title: A-Z of Standup Comedy
the-comedy-bible.description: Kya aapko lagta hai aap logo ko hasa sakte ho? Aur kya isse aap apna career bana sakte hai? Kaise banega career? Kya kuch cheezon ko sikhne ki zarurat hogi? Aaiye jaane A-Z of standup comedy!

the-wolf-queen-of-the-vampire-king-4.title: A Loba do Rei Vampiro
the-wolf-queen-of-the-vampire-king-4.description: Ela foi rejeitada da forma mais cruel: seus dois companheiros destinados esmagaram sua loba interior e a abandonaram para morrer no frio. Sozinha e quebrada, ela tem só uma chance de sobreviver: um laço de sangue com o temido Rei Vampiro. Desse pacto nasce outra mulher, uma híbrida poderosa que nenhum lobo consegue encarar. Agora ela está de volta, e os homens que a descartaram vão implorar por perdão. Mas, depois de tudo, será que ela ainda tem algum perdão para dar?

लावण्या--लेखिका---अर्चना-ठाकुर-कनक.title: Lavanya
लावण्या--लेखिका---अर्चना-ठाकुर-कनक.description:
लावण्‍या एक बेसहारा लड़की जिसे अपने ही सौतेले बाप ने साहूकार के पास बेच दिया था। बचपन भयंकर यातनाओं के बीच गुजरा। गांव के एक नि:संतान दंपत्ति अपने घर ले आए लेकिन ज्‍यादा दिनों तक खुशियां यहां भी नसीब नहीं हुई और 15 साल की उम्र में ही अनाथ हो गई। दूसरे गांव का अंश नाम का लड़का ना जाने क्‍यों लावण्‍या की ओर खींचा चला जाता है। लावण्‍या भी उसे चाहती है लेकिन वह अपना प्‍यार प्रदर्शित नहीं करता। यह कहानी रिश्‍तों और प्‍यार के भावुकता के साथ बंधी है। लावण्‍या और अंश का प्रेम केवल दैहिक नहीं है बल्कि दो आत्‍माओं का पवित्र मिलन है।
Author : अर्चना ठाकुर कनक
Voiceover Artist : RJ Manish "Lavanya
Listen to the beautiful story of a helpless girl turning into a strong woman. Lavanya's love story in Hindi is a beautiful story with a lot of twists and turns. In this story you will see how a small girl is not treated well by her father and takes her to a sahukara to sell the poor girl. But by the mercy of god she gets adopted by a couple but again the fate takes a turn and she becomes orphan at the age of 15. She fights with all the problems and crosses all the hurdles thrown to her by society but loses her inner being, finally her life takes a happy turn and she meets someone who makes her life happy and she is able to find herself again. The name of the girl is Lavanaya. Lavanya's story in Hindi is a romantic drama. You will enjoy the love story and feel the pain of Lavanya while you listen to Lavanaya by Archana Thakur. You can listen to the story online or download it either from the app or from the website.
एक असहाय लड़की की एक मजबूत महिला में बदल जाने की खूबसूरत कहानी सुनिए। लावण्या की हिंदी में प्रेम कहानी एक खूबसूरत कहानी है जिसमें बहुत सारे मोड़ हैं। इस कहानी में आप देखेंगे कि कैसे एक छोटी बच्ची के साथ  उसके पिता द्वारा अच्छा व्यवहार नहीं किया जाता है और वह बेचारी लड़की को बेचने के लिए एक साहूकार के पास ले जाता है। लेकिन भगवान की दया से वह एक दंपति द्वारा अपनाई जाती है, लेकिन फिर से भाग्य बदल जाता है और वह 15 साल की उम्र में अनाथ हो जाती है। वह सभी समस्याओं से लड़ती है और समाज द्वारा उसके लिए फेंके गए सभी बाधाओं को पार कर जाती है लेकिन अपने आंतरिक जीवन और सुख को खो देती है , अंत में उसका जीवन एक खुशहाल मोड़ लेता है और वह किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति से मिलती है जो उसके जीवन को खुशहाल बनाता है और वह फिर से खुद को खोजने में सक्षम हो जाती है। लड़की का नाम लावण्या है। लावण्या की हिंदी में कहानी एक रोमांटिक ड्रामा है। आप प्रेम इस कहानी का आनंद लें और अर्चना ठाकुर द्वारा लावण्या की बात सुनते हुए लावण्या के दर्द को महसूस करें। आप कहानी को ऑनलाइन सुन सकते हैं या इसे ऐप से या वेबसाइट से डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।
"

cc830896-120b-40a4-880e-5c2b6889b1e9.title: Lady Boss
cc830896-120b-40a4-880e-5c2b6889b1e9.description: శాన్వి ఒక స్ట్రాంగ్ అయినా వ్యక్తిత్వం కలిగిన అమ్మాయి. ఆరు సంవత్సరాలుగా తను ప్రేమించిన మధుని వేరే అమ్మాయితో హోటల్ రూమ్లో చూడాల్సి వచ్చింది. ఇంకా దురదృష్టం ఏమిటంటే ఆ హోటల్ రూమ్లో మధు తో ఉన్నది తన తండ్రి రెండో భార్య కూతురు, తన చెల్లెలు సితార. వాళ్ళిద్దరినీ అలా చూసిన  శాన్వి బాగా తాగిన మత్తులో ప్రణవదిత్య గ్రూప్ ఆఫ్ కంపెనీస్ అధినేత ది గ్రేట్ ప్రణవ్ తో ఒక రాత్రి గడపడానికి మ్యారేజ్ అగ్రిమెంట్ మీద సంతకం పెడుతుంది. అనుకోకుండా జరిగిన ఆ పెళ్లి ఆమెని ఏ తీరం చేరుస్తుంది? శాన్వి తన సొంత ఫ్యామిలీ కే ఎందుకు శత్రువుగా మారిపోతుంది? శాన్వి తండ్రి రెండో పెళ్లి ఎందుకు చేసుకున్నాడు? శాన్వి తల్లికి జరిగిన అన్యాయం ఏమిటి? శాన్వి తన తల్లికి జరిగిన అన్యాయానికి ఏ విధంగా ప్రతీకారం తీర్చుకోబోతుంది?

hide-and-seek.title: Hide And Seek
hide-and-seek.description: In the shadowy corners of New Jersey, justice and corruption clash as Detective Sarah Chen and criminal psychologist Dr. Lucas Simmons hunt a vigilante serial killer with a dark past. Mira Vance, the enigmatic killer, meticulously exposes the sins of her powerful victims, leaving behind chilling crime scenes that challenge the very fabric of the justice system. As Lucas confronts old demons and questions his own morality, the line between hunter and hunted blurs in this gripping psychological thriller. How far will they go to stop a killer who believes she’s the ultimate arbiter of justice?

അതിവേഗം-അനായാസം-50-വായ്പ്പകൾ.title: അതിവേഗം അനായാസം 50 വായ്പ്പകൾ
അതിവേഗം-അനായാസം-50-വായ്പ്പകൾ.description: ഈ ഓഡിയോബുക്ക് നിങ്ങളുടെ സാമ്പത്തിക ആവശ്യങ്ങൾ പരിഹരിക്കാൻ വിവിധതരം ലോണുകളെക്കുറിച്ച് വിവരങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്നു. ബാങ്ക് ലോണുകൾ, ഫിനാൻസ് കമ്പനികളിൽ നിന്നുള്ള ലോണുകൾ, സർക്കാർ പദ്ധതികളിലൂടെയുള്ള ലോണുകൾ എന്നിവയുൾപ്പെടെ 50 തരത്തിലുള്ള ലോണുകളെക്കുറിച്ച് ഇത് വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.

mafia-premier-league.title: Mafia Premier League
mafia-premier-league.description: Nanbanukku uthavap poi, drug casela maattikkaran cricketer abhinav. Athunala avanoda life, love ellame spoil aagiduthu. Avanukku thirumbavum cricketla jeyikka oru vaaippu kidaikkuthu. Athula eppadi jeyichaan? Avanoda lover thirumba vanthala?

vande-matram-by-savyasachi-bhattacharya.title: Vande Mataram : National song ki kahani
vande-matram-by-savyasachi-bhattacharya.description: “Sujalam sufalam malayaja shitalam sashya shamlam Mataram, Vande Mataram” ye lines 1882 me publish hui lekin Inko kayi saalo pehle likha gaya tha, chaliye jaante hain Vande Mataram kavita ki is biography mein ke kaise 19th century me likhi gayi ye lines humari azadi ki warcry bani aur kyu abhi bhi ye kavita har indian ke dil mein desh bhakti ka josh bhar deti hai.

the-sociology-of-riots.title: The Sociology Of Riots
the-sociology-of-riots.description:
ప్రపంచంలో జరిగిన అల్లర్ల వెనుక ఉన్న సమాజ శాస్త్రాన్ని ఈ కార్యక్రమం లో పరిశీలిస్తాం.
ఎందుకు మరియు ఎలా అల్లర్లు వస్తాయో, వాటి ప్రభావం సామాజిక వ్యవస్థపై ఎలా ఉంటుందో విశ్లేషిస్తాం.
గొడవల లక్షణాలు, కారణాలు, పరిణామాలను వివిధ కోణాల్లో పరిశీలించే ఓ లోతైన సిరీస్.

ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.title: Yashassina Rahasya
ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ-ರಹಸ್ಯ.description: ಯಶಸ್ಸಿನ ಸೂತ್ರಗಳು; ಪಾಲಕರಿಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ; ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಹೇಳಲ್ಲ- ಈ ಕೃತಿಯು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯೊಬ್ಬನ ದೌರ್ಬಲ್ಯವನ್ನು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡುವ ವಿವಿಧ ವರಸೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಪಾಲಕರು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಸಹ ಓದಬೇಕಾದ ಪುಸ್ತಕ. ಅತಿಯಾದ ನಿದ್ದೆ, ಕೋಪ, ಸಿಟ್ಟು, ಕೀಳರಿಮೆ ಇವುಗಳನ್ನು ಮೆಟ್ಟಿ ಓದಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಏಕಾಗ್ರತೆ ಸಾಧಿಸಿ ಗೆಲುವು ದಕ್ಕಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕೆಂಬದರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸವಿಸ್ತಾರವಾಗಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ ಲೇಖಕ ಯಂಡಮೂರಿ ವೀರೇಂದ್ರನಾಥ.

हादसे-की-रात--लेखक--अमित-खान.title: Hadse ki Raat
हादसे-की-रात--लेखक--अमित-खान.description: दिल्ली के एक मामूली ऑटो रिक्शा ड्राइवर की किस्मत ने बड़े ज़बरदस्त अंदाज़ में पलटा खाया और उसके हाथ 24 कैरेट शुद्ध सोने की 6 एंटीक मूर्तियाँ लग गयीं, जिनकी कीमत 10 करोड़ रुपये थी! लेकिन मूर्तियाँ मिलने के बाद उस ऑटो ड्राईवर के जीवन में तबाही, आतंक और बेहद चौंका देने वाली घटनाओं का ऐसा खौफनाक सिलसिला शुरू हुआ कि वह त्राहि-त्राहि कर उठा। जानने के लिए सुने "एक हादसे की रात!"

vishkanya-pratishodh-aur-prem.title: Vishkanya : Pratishodh Aur Prem
vishkanya-pratishodh-aur-prem.description: वैशाली एक विषकन्या है, जिसे बचपन से ही मौत को हथियार बनाना सिखाया गया है। बदले की आग में जलती वैशाली की मुलाकात देवदत्त से होती है, जो उसे नफरत और खून-खराबे से परे एक नई जिंदगी का सपना दिखाता है। लेकिन जब प्यार उसके मकसद के आड़े आने लगता है, तभी उसके अतीत का एक खतरनाक राज़ सामने आता है - एक ऐसा सच, जो उसके दुश्मन, उसके प्यार और उसकी खुद की किस्मत के बारे में सबकुछ बदल सकता है। क्या वैशाली बदला चुनेगी, या उसका प्यार ही उसकी सबसे बड़ी कमजोरी बन जाएगा?

the-confidence-project-1.title: The Confidence Project
the-confidence-project-1.description: Kya aapke andar bhi self-doubt ka shor machta hai? Agar haan, to yeh audiobook aapke liye hi hai. Simple tips, powerful strategies aur real-life inspiration ke saath, yeh audiobook aapko har situation mein fearless banne ki technique sikhayegi. Toh abhi suniye aur apni hesitation ko confidence mein badal dijiye.

manna-dey-hoyto-tomari-jonyo.title: Manna Dey : Hoyto Tomari Jonyo
manna-dey-hoyto-tomari-jonyo.description: Coffe House Er Adda Aaj Thakleo Aamader Modhey Aaj Nei Sei Ganer Gayok. Kintu Tini Na Thekeo Aajibon Omor Hoye Thakben Tar Srishtir Modhey Diye. Koto Na Gan Geyechen Tini, Ja Aajo 8-80 Sobar Mukhe Mukhe. Jekono Poristhitite Tar Gaan Aamder Ek Odvut Shanti Dey. Sob Dharar Ganei Gola Diyechen Tini. Bangla Hok Ki Hindi Film Industry, Dui Jaigatei Soman Jonopriyo Tini. Aaj Aamra Ei Audio Show Er Modhey Diye Janar Chesta Korbo Kingbodonti Gayok Manna Dey-Er Somporke. Kivabe Tini Elen Ei Songeet Er Duniya? Kivabe Hoye Uthlen Jonopriyo? Tar Jiboner Nana Golpo Shune Nebo Ei Show Er Modhey Diye.

xurongor-majere.title: Xurongor majere
xurongor-majere.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

ചുക്ക്‌.title: ചുക്ക്‌
ചുക്ക്‌.description: തേയിലത്തോട്ടങ്ങളുടെയും മലഞ്ചരക്കുകളുടെയും ഇടയില്‍ കണ്ണീരും ചിരിയുമായി കഴിയുന്ന കുറേ മനുഷ്യര്‍. മോഹങ്ങളും മോഹഭംഗങ്ങളും അവര്‍ക്കുമുണ്ട്. കച്ചവടത്തില്‍ നിന്ന് ലക്ഷങ്ങള്‍ സമ്പാദിക്കുമ്പോഴും മനസിന്റെ കോണിലെവിടെയോ വിഷാദങ്ങള്‍ നഷ്ടക്കച്ചവടങ്ങളായി മാറുന്നു. എന്നും ഓര്‍മ്മയില്‍ തങ്ങി നില്‍ക്കുന്ന കഥാപാത്രങ്ങളെ അവതരിപ്പിക്കുന്നു തകഴി. 'ചുക്ക്' കേള്‍ക്കാം Kuku FMലൂടെ പ്രൊഫസര്‍ അലിയാരുടെ ശബ്ദത്തില്‍.

social-worker-baba-amte-anandvan.title: Samajsevak Baba Amte
social-worker-baba-amte-anandvan.description: Swargavasi thor samaj sevak Murlidhar Devidas Amte jyana Apan  Baba amte ya navanehi olakhto. Baba yani baryach jananche jeev vachavle,  lokana tyancha payavar ubharayla shikavla, tyana samajat man dila.  Te peshane lawyer hote,  ani Mahatma Gandhi yanchya vicharane prerit houn tyani changli lawchi practice sodun tyani Wardha jilhyatil 'Hemalkasa' ani 'Anadwan' ya chotyashya gavat jaun samaj seva keli. Tya gavat Krustarogane pidhit aslelya lokana khup ghanerdi vagnuk det asat, ani  Baba Amte yani ya Chala aaikuyat asha thor vyaktimatvachi katha kasa ek lawyer eka chotyashya gavat jaun samajsevak jhala yachi jeevan katha.

en-purushan-oru-boss.title: En Purushan Oru Boss
en-purushan-oru-boss.description: தன் தோழியை ஏமாற்றிய சாண்டியைத் தேடி சென்னை வரும் கீர்த்தி, தவறுதலாக கோடீஸ்வர CEO கிஷோரையே சாண்டி என நினைத்து அடித்துவிடுகிறாள். இதனால் அவனைத் திருமணம் செய்ய வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்தில் சிக்குகிறாள். கிஷோர் ஒரு சாதாரண ஊழியர் என்றே நினைக்கும் கீர்த்திக்கு, அவனுடைய உண்மையான அடையாளம் தெரியவரும் போது அவர்களின் ஒப்பந்தத் திருமணம் எதிர்பாராத காதலாக மாறுகிறது.

chained-to-you.title: Chained to You
chained-to-you.description: Minnie Adams, an astute CEO, keeps her emotions under lock and key until an unexpected moment of attraction, igniting a fervent, forbidden passion with her bodyguard, Mike Warner, amidst a rival's scheme. Between the ruthless hospitality industry and familial expectations, they plunge into an affair that burns with insatiable desire. Every secret rendezvous, laden with thrills and perils, intensifies their intoxicating connection. As their illicit love threatens the very fabric of the family business, Minnie and Mike are faced with a dilemma. Will their euphoric union pave the way to liberation or spell disaster? Tune into “Chained to You” to experience the exhilarating journey of a love that dares to challenge the boundaries, where wild and ecstasy intertwine in the pursuit of fate and destiny.

pocso-act.description: Kuzhanthaigalukku ethiraa nadakka koodiya paaliyal thunburuthal ku ethiraa kondu vara patta sattam thaan POCSO. Ovvoru kudimaganum intha act pathi kandippa therinjurukanum. POCSO sattathai patri virivana vilakkathai intha pathivula kettu therinjukonga.

mahasamar-4-dharna.description: Indraprastha flourishes, and Yudhishthira performs the Rajasuya yagna. But the Pandavas’ success only feeds Duryodhana’s envy. An invitation to a game of dice arrives, and Yudhishthira, bound by dharma, cannot refuse. Throw by throw, he loses his kingdom, his brothers, himself and finally Draupadi. Dharma, the fourth book of Narendra Kohli’s Mahasamar, asks what dharma really is, and whether someone can lose everything while still following it.

Jarar 7 June 2013 er por bhulei gechilen sabhabik bhabe jibon japoner kotha. Hai apnara aj jante parben Kamduni r ghotona. Ki ghotechilo shei grame. Keno eto lojjar, ba omanobik ghotona bola hoye thake ei ghotona take. Ek college purua meye ke nrishongsho bhabe gono dhorhson kora hoi ei din ta e. Ki ghotechilo shei din? Karma Healing For Success karma ko ek fixed destiny nahi, balki thoughts, behaviour aur actions ke cycle ki tarah explore karta hai. Ancient wisdom aur modern psychology ke through samjhiye ki past ke patterns ko identify karke aap apne decisions, habits aur future ko kaise badal sakte hain.

87043aab-f33c-4b02-9345-cce539642c93.title: My Dear Bajrangi
87043aab-f33c-4b02-9345-cce539642c93.description:
Reyansh is drowning — in alcohol, in guilt, and in the wreckage of every relationship he's destroyed. His father is done with him. Ira, the girl he loved, is gone. And the cousins circling his family's property are waiting for him to fall completely.
His mother never stops praying to Lord Hanuman — and somehow, her prayers keep finding him.
This is a story of a son who hit every bottom there is, and Lord Hanuman who kept pulling him back up every single time.

laagi-tujhse-lagan.title: Laagi tujhse lagan
laagi-tujhse-lagan.description: Wedding bells ring, but a hail of bullets turns the celebration into a bloodbath. Right at the mandap, Swati watches helplessly as unknown gunmen brutally murder her fiancé, Priyam. Just when all hope seems lost, Priyam's estranged elder brother, Sarthak, returns and rescues her. But fate has an even more shocking twist in store. To protect the family's honor and Swati's future, the elders get them married. Bound by tragedy,  can two broken hearts ever accept this unexpected marriage?

vishwanath-ka-ran.title: Vishwanath Ka Ran
vishwanath-ka-ran.description:

The very symbol that empires tried to destroy became a sacred centre of faith for millions. This is the story of Kashi Vishwanath—a temple and a city that history tried to erase again and again, only to see them rise stronger and grander every time.

kaalpurush.description: मुंबई का एक मामूली चोर करण और इतिहास की छात्रा अंशिका एक रहस्यमयी स्वर्ण कड़े की शक्ति से अचानक 1858 के मनीसा राज्य में पहुँच जाते हैं। लेकिन वहाँ कदम रखते ही पूरा राज्य करण के सामने झुक जाता है और उसे अपना खोया हुआ महाराज मान लेता है। जबकि असली महाराज इंद्र वर्मा रहस्यमयी परिस्थितियों में लापता हैं और राज्य पर सेनापति विक्रम सिंह की साज़िशों का साया मंडरा रहा है। अब करण को न सिर्फ़ मनीसा को बचाना है, बल्कि यह भी पता लगाना है कि आखिर इस रहस्य के पीछे छिपा इतिहास क्या है।

siggestondi.description: ఈ పుస్తకం స్త్రీలపై ఇంట్లో, బహిరంగ స్థలాల్లో, కార్యాలయాల్లో జరిగే అణచివేతను శక్తివంతంగా చిత్రిస్తుంది. బాలల వేధింపులు, అత్యాచారం, మానసిక హింస — అన్నీ నిజాయితీగా చర్చించబడ్డాయి. పిల్లలతో సంభాషణ యొక్క ఆవశ్యకతను గుర్తుచేసే అవగాహన కల్పించే రచన!

the-power-of-mindfulness.title: The Power of Mindfulness
the-power-of-mindfulness.description: ದೈನಂದಿನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಂಟಾಗುವ ಒತ್ತಡ, ಆತಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿವಾರಿಸಲು ಮೈಂಡ್‌ಫುಲ್‌ನೆಸ್ ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಈ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ವರ್ತಮಾನ ಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾಗೃತರಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಜೀವನದ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ಹೇಗೆ ಸುಧಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳು ಉತ್ತಮಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಗ್ರ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಹೇಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ತಿಳಿಸಿಕೊಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ, ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸುವ ಪಯಣಕ್ಕೆ ಚಾಲನೆ ನೀಡಿ. ಕೇಳಿ ದಿ ಪವರ್ ಓಫ್ ಮೈಂಡ್ ಫುಲ್ ನೆಸ್ ಶೋ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ.

how-to-turn-setbacks-into-green-backs-1.title: How To Turn Setbacks Into Green Backs
how-to-turn-setbacks-into-green-backs-1.description:
தடைகளை தகர்த்து நம்ம மனச வெற்றிய நோக்கி எடுத்துட்டு போக கூடிய திறன எப்படி வளர்க்குறதுனு இந்த ஒலி புத்தகம் நமக்கு சொல்லி குடுக்க போகுது. 

Its time to erase off your failure and focus what the biggest picture of life is. This audio book is goin to be your companion on pushing your mental limits towards positivity.

seeing-what-others-dont.title: How to Think Creative
seeing-what-others-dont.description:
Kya aapko pata hai ki aap apni life mein jo bhi achieve karna chahte hain uspar rok lagane wala koi aur nahi balki aap khud hai?
Darasal koi ek insaan ho ya poori organization, decision making sabke liye humesha ek  bada task hota hai aur agar vo perfectly kar liya jae toh ek naya business start karna , business ya job mein progress karne ka naya tarika dhundhna ya fir apni personal problems ko solve karne jaise har ek kam ko quicker, easier aur better tarike se kiya ja sakta hai. Lekin hum perfect decision isliye nahi le paate kyuki hum apni life ko usi nazariye se dekh rahe hain jisse baki poori duniya, jabki  humein toh har ek situation mein vo positive dekhna chahiye jo baki koi aur na dekh pa raha ho, tbhi toh perfect decision lekar quicker and better action kiya ja sakta hai. Lekin kaise ? Iska Jawab aapko is audiobook mein milega.

razakkar-movement.title: Razakkar Movement
razakkar-movement.description:
ఇది హైదరాబాద్ రాష్ట్రంలో నిజాం పరిపాలనలో జరిగిన అత్యాచారాన్ని, హింసను, భయాన్ని విపులంగా వెలుగులోకి తెస్తుంది.
రజాకార్‌ల నియంతృత్వాన్ని ఎదుర్కొన్న ప్రజల పోరాట గాథను వివరిస్తుంది.
ఇది హైదరాబాద్‌ను భారతదేశంలో విలీనం చేసే యుద్ధపు చరిత్రను ప్రేక్షకులకు పరిచయం చేస్తుంది.

broken-promises.title: Broken Promises
broken-promises.description:
Betrayed. Blind. Broken.
Susan's world was shattered when her husband's lover, Charlotte, pushed her into an icy pond, jeopardizing her life and her child's future. As tensions boiled over and Mike, Susan's husband, accused her father of a heinous crime, Susan had to navigate a treacherous web of deceit to uncover the truth. With each shocking revelation, the line between justice and revenge blurred. Immerse yourself in "Broken Promises," a relentless, mind-bending audio thriller where Susan battled betrayal, lies, and scandal. Binge every twist and turn now, exclusively on the KUKUFM app!

diary-1.description: Dive into the world of Non-Fiction with Kuku FM where real stories and groundbreaking ideas come to life. Our collection spans intriguing topics from history and science to culture and personal development. Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

uplift-your-life-morning-positive-affirm.title: Uplift Your Life  - Morning Positive Affirmations
uplift-your-life-morning-positive-affirm.description: Jeevithathil parajayavum, niraashayum, vishadhavum orupaad anubhavikkunna vyakthi aano ningal? Jeevithathil maattangal varuthan ningal shramikkunundengilum, evide ninnu thudanganamennum enth cheyyanamennum clarity ilathe valayukayaano? Enkil, Uplift Your Life  - Morning Positive Affirmations enna ee show ningalkullathanu.

jawaharlal-nehru-1.title: Jawaharlal Nehru
jawaharlal-nehru-1.description: Indiayude pradhama pradhanamanthri, kuttikalude chachaji angane niravadhi visheshanangalanu Jawaharlal Nehru enna charitra purushanu nammal nalkiyittulathu. Ennal ethinokke appuram arayirunnu, enthayirunnu Nehru? Indian swathantra samarathil pradhana panku vahicha idheham Indian ye kurichu kanda swapnangal enthayirunnu? Ithokke ariyam ‘Jawaharlal Nehru’ enna audiobookilude.

d9545552-6a81-49b7-998d-fc94dd80ed23.title: Amma Vanthaal
d9545552-6a81-49b7-998d-fc94dd80ed23.description: அப்பு வேதம் படிக்க திருச்சிக்கு செல்கிறான். அங்கு, கணவனை இழந்த இந்து அப்புவைக் காதலிக்கிறாள். அப்பு அவளது காதலை நிராரிக்க இந்து ஒரு உண்மையை சொல்கிறாள். அது அப்புவின் அம்மா, வேறு ஒரு இளைஞனுடன் உறவில் இருக்கிறாள் என்பதே. அதைக் கேட்ட அப்பு துடித்துப் போகிறான். அதற்குப் பிறகு, அப்பு இந்துவை ஏற்றுக் கொள்கிறானா? உறவுகளின் உணர்வுகளை வெளிப்படுத்தும் தி.ஜானகிராமனின் தலைச்சிறந்த நாவல் இது.

ಕನ್ನಡ-ಸಿನಿಮಾ-ಲೋಕ.title: Kannada Cinema Loka
ಕನ್ನಡ-ಸಿನಿಮಾ-ಲೋಕ.description: ಸದ್ಯ ವಿಶ್ವದೆಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಕನ್ನಡ ಚಿತ್ರರಂಗ...ಆದರೆ, ಅದರ ಆರಂಭದ ದಿನಗಳು ಹೀಗಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ..! ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಏಳು-ಬೀಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ, ಚಂದನವನದ ಆ ದಿನಗಳು ಹೇಗಿದ್ದವು? ಸ್ಯಾಂಡಲ್‌ವುಡ್‌ನ ಮೊಟ್ಟಮೊದಲ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಯಾವುದು? ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಖರ್ಚಾಗಿದ್ದೆಷ್ಟು?  ಹೀಗೆ, ಕನ್ನಡ ಚಿತ್ರರಂಗದ ಭವ್ಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಅದು ಹಂತಹಂತವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದು ಬಂದ ರೀತಿಯನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕೇಳಿ, 'ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಲೋಕ' ಆಡಿಯೋ ಬುಕ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕುಎಫ್‌ಎಂನಲ್ಲಿ.

the-power-is-within-you-2.description: Tumchya aat madhye ek power ahe utha jage vha aplyatla herola saglyan samor ana. Svatar prem kara ani svatala kami lekhu naka.svatavar prem kasa karyacha ya baddal aplyala prasidha lekhika Louise Hay yani tyanchya The power is within you ya pustakadware sangitla ahe.  Chala janungheuya swatavar prem kasakaryache sope marga.

tillismii-khajaana.title: Tilismi Khajana
tillismii-khajaana.description:
Band Khandhar ke Darwaze mei, Tilismi Khazana kar raha hai, Sadiyon Se Intezaar! Ankhir Kya hai rahsya, Khandhar mei bhikre Nar Kankalon ka? Aur Kisko Bula Rahi hai Khandhar se Aati Awaaz? Do Veer Yuvak, 'Arjun Aur Pandit' Nikal Pade hain Tilismi Khazane ki talash mei! Kya Pariyon Ka Nritya dekhne ke Baad woh unke maya jaal se baach payenge? 
Kya bhed Payenge Apni Budhi Aur Bal se Khajane ka Rahsya...?

the-8020-principle-the-secret-to-achievi.title: The 80/20 Principle: The Secret to Achieving More with Less
the-8020-principle-the-secret-to-achievi.description: Aapni Kaj Korun Ba Byabsa Korun, Aabar Aapnar Byaktigoto Jiboner Sob Khetrei 80/20 Ekta Rule Kaj Kore. Aapnar Diner Shuru Theke Rate Ghumano Sob Kichui Nirdharon Hoy Ei Rule Diye. Aabar Kaje Productivity Barate Onek Help Kore Ei Rule. Ki Vabchen? Ei 80/20 Rule Ki? Kivab Eti Aapnake Provabito Kore? Kivabe 80/20 Chinta Korben? Eisob Uttor Khunje Pete Aapnake Mon Diye Purota Shuntei Hobe Richard Koch Er Lekha 'The 80/20 Principle: The Secret to Achieving More with Less' - Boiti. Jibone Cholar Pothe Ebong Jibone Valo Thakar Rosod Khunje Pete Ei Boi Aapnake Onek Help Korte Pare. Aasun Tahole Shune Neyoya Jak.

kgf-kolar-gold-fields.title: KGF : Kolar Gold Fields
kgf-kolar-gold-fields.description:
ಇವತ್ತು ನಾವು ನಿಮಗೆ ಹೇಳಲು ಹೊರಟಿರುವುದು ಕೆಜಿಎಫ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ! ಈ ಹೆಸರು ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ ನೀವು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ರಾಕಿ ಭಾಯ್ ಕೆಜಿಎಫ್ ಅಂತ ಅಂದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು. ಆದರೆ ನಾವು ಹೇಳುವುದಾದರೆ ರೀಲ್ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲ, ರಿಯಲ್ ಕಥೆ!
ಅದೇ ಕೊಲಾರ ಗೋಲ್ಡ್ ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ಸ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ.ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಕೊಲಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಗಣಿಗಾರಿಕೆ ಹೇಗೆ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಯಿತು? ಇದನ್ನು 'ಮಿನಿ ಇಂಗ್ಲೆಂಡ್' ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವೇನು? ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುವ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಎಷ್ಟು? ಇವತ್ತಿಗೂ ಜಗತ್ತು ಕೊಲಾರದ ಕಡೆ ನೋಡುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಇರುವ ರಹಸ್ಯವೇನು? ಕೆಜಿಎಫ್ ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಲಾರದ ಮೈನಿಂಗ್‌ಗಿಂತ ಇರುವ ಸಂಬಂಧವೇನು?
ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ ನಿಜವಾದ ಕಥೆ! ಕೇಳಿ 'ಕೆಜಿಎಫ್ : ಕೊಲಾರ ಗೋಲ್ಡ್ ಫೀಲ್ಡ್ಸ್' ಕನ್ನಡ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್, ಕೇವಲ ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKu FM ನಲ್ಲಿ!

yuktahaar-the-belly-and-brain-diet-2.title: Yuktahaar: The Belly And Brain Diet
yuktahaar-the-belly-and-brain-diet-2.description: Orupadu dietukal pareekshichittum shareerathinu oru prayojanavum undavathathu enthu kondanu ennu namallil palarum chinthichitundakum. Ennal athinoru vyakthamaya utharam lebhichitundo? Ella, alle? Athoru pakshe nammude shareerathinu yojicha dieto, vyayamamo akila nammal pinthudarunnathu ennathu kondakam. Yuktahaar: The Belly And Brain Diet', enna thante pusthakathilude celebrity nutritionist um Taapsee Pannu nte dieticianum aya Munmun Ganeriwal ethuvare aarum parayatha healthy tips ningalumayi pankuvekkunnu.

video-game.title: Rising Careers In Gaming
video-game.description: Is new age ke digitalisation ne kaafi kuch badal kar rakh diya hai. Agar aapka kaccha gaming ko leke bohot passionate hai aur saara din gaming mein busy hota hai, toh kya kabhi aapne socha hai ki shayad uska career calling yahi ho? Ji haan, ab gaming ki duniya bhi itni badi ho chuki hai ki isme kai saare career options available hai. Magar kya hai ye? aur kya ye reliable hai? Jaanenge aise hi kai saare details gaming ko lekar is audiobook mein

the-ruined-dukes-bride-from-the-future.title: The Ruined Dukes Bride From The Future
the-ruined-dukes-bride-from-the-future.description: Transported 200 years into the past by a mysterious stopwatch, Mara Vale awakens as the unwanted bride of Rowan Blackwood, a duke accused of treason. Armed with a time-traveling heirloom, she must survive a hostile family, uncover deadly royal conspiracies, and clear her missing husband's name. As betrayal and hidden enemies threaten her every move, Mara discovers that changing the past may come at a dangerous cost—and the stopwatch holds secrets of its own.

how-to-attract-money-8.title: How To Attract Money
how-to-attract-money-8.description: Paisa aapka dost kaise bane, ye janne ki ichha rakhte hain? "How To Attract Money" mein, Joseph Murphy aapko dhan ke prati jagruk banane aur paise mein vishwas dilane ka rastadikhate hain. Is audiobook se seekhiye ki kaise aap apni Financial safalta ke liye darwaze khol sakte hain aur jo aap deserve karte hain, vah success pa sakte hain.

the-dink-life-a-modern-social-debate.title: The DINK Life: A Modern Social Debate
the-dink-life-a-modern-social-debate.description: More millennials are choosing a DINK (Dual Income, No Kids) lifestyle. Is it about financial freedom, personal choice, career growth, or changing social values? This show explores both sides through expert insights and real stories from couples navigating modern relationships.

विचारांची-शक्ती-ओळखा-.title: Vicharanchi Shakti Olkha

how-numerology-works.title: How Numerology Works
how-numerology-works.description: Kya aap Luck aur Astrology mein vishwas rakhte hai ? Kya aap mante hai ki chote-mote upay karke aap sukh, shanti aur tarakki pa sakte hai ? Agar ha to yeh audiobook dhyan se suniyega kyuki iss audiobook mein hum charcha karne wale hai Numerology ke baare mein yani Ank Shastra. Jis tarah Kundli mein grahon ka asar hum par hota hai, usi tarah Numerology mein bhi har ek ank kisi na kisi grah se juda hota hai. To yeh ank aur grah hume kaise affect karte hai ? Kya sach mein Numerology se hum apne bhavishya ko jan sakte hai ? Numerology mein kitni sachai hai ? Jane iss Audiobook mein

the-art-of-choosing-1.title: Choosing is an Art
the-art-of-choosing-1.description: Aaj hum aapko kuch aisa sunane wale hai jise sunne ke baad aapke liye apne jiwan ke faisle lena asaan ho jayega. Kyunki yeh show hum sabhi ke faisle lene ke tarike pe baat karta hai, aur humein guide karta hai ki kaise hum mushkil waqt mein bhi patience ke sath sahi decisions le sakte hai. Toh aaiye apne dimag ko shant rakhkar, apni zindagi ko asaan banane ke tarike ko jante hai, humare is audiobook se.

mafia-queen-1.title: Mafia Queen
mafia-queen-1.description: Kabhi thi ek millionaire, aur ab ban gayi ek shikari! Aarohi, jo aayi hai Mafia Queen banke apne pita ki maut ka raaz suljhane. Par yeh keval naam nahi, ye toh unke liye jeeta jaagta khauf ka saya hai jinhone uska sab kuch cheen liya. Kya woh apne pita ke hatyaro ko dhundh payegi, jab police aur underworld dono uske peeche hain? Jaanne ke liye sunein Mafia Queen!

the-great-train-robbery.title: The Great Train Robbery
the-great-train-robbery.description: Jaaniye 1963 ki sabse badi heist, The Great Train Robbery ki kahaani - jisme 15 armed robbers ne ek hi raat mein 2.4 million Euros...yaani ki 21 crore rupay loot liye thei! Yeh show aapko transport kar dega us thrilling raat ki aur, jab Glasgow se London jaane wali Royal Mail train ko target banaya gaya thaa. Abhi suniye aur jaaniye is daring heist ki har detail!

the-impact-of-technology-over-humans.description: Namma innaiku adanjurukura munnetrathukku technology oru mukkiyamana karanam nu sollalam, Thagaval Thodarbu, Viraivu Payanam,  Pesum Puthagangal, Parakkum Enthirangal nu Pala aacharyangala  idhu saathiyam aakiruku. the-parable-of-the-pipeline-4.title: Incomecha Road Map
the-parable-of-the-pipeline-4.description: "The Parable of the Pipeline" chi book summary aplyala residual income kasa build karyacha yacha road map sangte. Residual Income ek asa income ahe jyat tumhala ekdach kam karaycha ahe ani ayusha bhar paise kamvayche ahet. Ya pustakat writer ne savistar ritya samjavla ahe ki atacha kalat job security asa kahi nahi ahe tyamule aatach tumhala pipeline banvaychi ahe ek ashi pipeline ji tumhala ayusha bhar purel.

undercover-ishq.title: Undercover Ishq
undercover-ishq.description: Ishita Saxena – ek undercover agent hai, jo apne kaam se break lekar vacations par Goa aayi hui hai, jahan wo ek mafia gangwar ke deadly jaal mein fans jaati hai. Goan mafia gangs – Simon aur White Elephant ke beech hone wala ye gang war masoom zindgiyon ko khatre mein daal deta hai. Ishita, isi dauraan inhi mein se ek gang ke member, Sameer se milti hai, aur dono ke beech pyaar ka kissa shuru ho jata hai. Kya pyar, jhooth aur dhokhe ke beech jhoolte Ishita aur Sameer, apne mission aur emotions ke beech balance dhoondh paayenge? Kya Ishita apni agency, parivaar aur khud ki values ko bachate hue yeh jang jeet paayegi?

nikamma-husband.title: Nikamma Husband
nikamma-husband.description: Samrat ek billionaire tha, lekin usne apni asli pehchaan chhupa li aur pure 5 saalo tak Anika Mehra ka nikamma pati Abhimanyu bankar uske sath raha. Anika ke liye Samrat ek maamuli sa ladka tha, isliye ek din Anika ne use divorce de diya. Lekin jab use pata chala ki jise wo fatichar samajhkar chhod chuki hai, wo ek billionaire hai, to Anika ke pairo tale zameen khisak gai. Samrat Saxena, Anika ki life me ek tufaan bankar lauta. Kya wo lega Anika se badla ya shuru hogi mohabbat ki ek nayi daastaan?

life-lesson-from-buddha.title: Lessons From The Buddha
life-lesson-from-buddha.description: Bhagwaan Buddha ki teachings se jeevan mein sukh aur shanti paane ke tareeke janiye. Aapke liye laaye hain hm Bhagwan Buddh ke gyan se nikaalkar kuch practical solutions. To abhi hi sun lijiye ye khas show.

3790efe2-54b6-4090-8180-1ab5cc2cd334.title: Dhruv Tara: Kahaani Ek Avishvasaniya Bhakti Ki
3790efe2-54b6-4090-8180-1ab5cc2cd334.description: Bharat ke anek pauranik gaathaon mein se hum aapke liye lekar aaye hain ek aur rochak kahaani. Yeh kahaani hai chhote Dhruv ki, jo apne maata-pita se alag hokar bhagwaan Vishnu ki bhakti mein magn ho jata hai aur apni tapasya hetu  bhagwaan Vishnu ko prakat hone par majboor kar deta hai taaki wo sirf unke godi mein baith sake. Maasomiyat aur bhakti ki ye bemisaal kahaani aapke dil ko choo jaayegi.

Bobby-Kaand-Ka-Sach-बिहार-का-सियासी-खेल.title: Bobby Kaand Ka Sach: बिहार का सियासी खेल
Bobby-Kaand-Ka-Sach-बिहार-का-सियासी-खेल.description: Bobby scandal Bihar mein tab saamne aaya jab ek high-profile neta ke bungalow se ek secret diary mili. Us diary mein film actress Bobby ke saath unke rishte aur blackmail ke saboot mile. Rajneeti, paisa aur glamour ke is chakravyuh ne puri state ko hila diya tha. Is case ka kala sach janne ke liye suniye ye audiobook..

Vijayamlo-Bhagaswamyam-విజయమ్లో-భాగస్వామ.description: భార్యా భర్తలు అన్యోన్యంగా వుంటూ పొరపొచ్చాలు లేకుండా కాపురం చేయాలంటే, దాంపత్య విజయంలో సమాన భాగస్వామ్యం పొందాలంటే ఎలా ప్రవర్తించాలో, పరస్పరం ఎలా సహకరించుకోవాలో ఆ విషయాలన్నింటినీ వివరంగా ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ లో మీరు తెలుసుకోవచ్చు. వెంటనే వినండి.

hungarian-lady-killer.title: Hungarian Lady Killer
hungarian-lady-killer.description: హంగేరియన్ లేడీ కిల్లర్ అనేది సాంప్రదాయ మరణాలు, హింస మరియు అన్యాయాలను ప్రేరేపించిన ఒక నిజమైన కథ ఆధారంగా రూపొందించబడింది. ఎలిజబెత్ బాథోరీ, ఆమె వ్యక్తిగత జీవితం మరియు అనేక అనుమానిత హత్యలు ఈ కథలో ప్రధానాంశంగా ఉన్నాయి. ఈ కథ యూవ్ మహిళలను హింసించి, వాళ్ళను మరణానికి గురిచేసిన అలా కొన్ని ఏషియన్ కథలను మతిమరుపు చేసే అంశాలపై దృష్టి సారిస్తుంది.

chaand-chhupa-badal-me.title: Chaand Chhupa Badal Me
chaand-chhupa-badal-me.description: Reyansh - ek aisa ladka jiski girlfriend Soniya use sirf isilie chhod deti hai,  kyunki wo gareeb aur fatichar hai. Lekin phir usi raat ko, wo apne baare me ek aisi sacchai jaanta hai,  jise jaan lene ke bad uski poori life hi badal jaati hai. Wo raat koi aam raat nahi thi, balki chandra grahan ki raat thi, jab Reyansh ne pehli bar apna roop badla tha aur use pata chala tha ki wo ek werewolf hai. Tab use majburi me werewolf academy me jana pada, lekin ittefaq se wahan uska saamna Niya se hota hai, jiski shakl  bilkul Soniya jaisi hai. Shuruaat mein Reyansh, Niya se nafrat karta hai, lekin fir dheere dheere wo usse pyaar karne lagta hai. Lekin jab Niya ki sacchai uske aati hai saamne, to uski duniya hi badal jati ha. Aakhir kaun hai Niya? Kya wo aur Soniya ek hi hain ya dono alag hain?

mankuthimmana-kagga.title: Mankuthimmana Kagga
mankuthimmana-kagga.description: ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಲೋಕ ಕಂಡ ಅನರ್ಘ್ಯ ಕವಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 'ದೇವನಹಳ್ಳಿ ವೆಂಕಟರಮಣಯ್ಯ ಗುಂಡಪ್ಪ' ಅವರ ಹೆಸರು ಮುಂಚೂಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತೆ. ಡಿ.ವಿ.ಜಿ ಅಂತಲೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧರಾದ ಗುಂಡಪ್ಪ ಅವರು, ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಅದ್ಭುತವಾದ ಕೃತಿಗಳನ್ನ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ‌. ಅವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 'ಮಂಕುತಿಮ್ಮನ ಕಗ್ಗ' ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯವಾದುದು. ಮನುಕುಲಕ್ಕೆ ದಾರಿ ತೋರಿಸುವ, ಬದುಕಿನ‌ ಮಹಾಸತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನ ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಕಗ್ಗದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಟ್ಟಿರುವ ಡಿ.ವಿ.ಜಿ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಅವರೇ ಸಾಟಿ! ಇವರು ರಚಿಸಿದ ಒಟ್ಟು 945 ಕಗ್ಗಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅವುಗಳ ತಾತ್ಪರ್ಯ ಇಲ್ಲಿದೆ‌. ಕೇಳಿ..

uri-naye-bharat-ka-palatwar.title: Uri: Naye Bharat ka Palatwar
uri-naye-bharat-ka-palatwar.description: For decades, India absorbed terror attacks, infiltration and bloodshed without crossing the Line of Control. But when 19 Indian soldiers were killed in the Uri attack, the country faced a defining question—how long can a nation keep showing restraint before it decides to strike back?

malgudicha-narbhakshak.title: Malgudicha Narbhakshak
malgudicha-narbhakshak.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

thamovedam.title: തമോവേദം
thamovedam.description: മന്ത്രവാദത്തിന്റെയും സാത്താന്‍ സേവയുടെയും ലോകമാണ് തമോവേദം എന്ന നോവല്‍ പരിസരം. ജന്മവശാല്‍ തന്നെ സാത്താന്‍ സ്പര്‍ശ ഗുണങ്ങളുള്ള വിശ്വനാഥന്‍ എന്ന ചെറുപ്പക്കാരന്‍ ഒരു മന്ത്രവാദ സംഘത്തിന്റെ നേതാവായി മാറുന്നു. കൃസ്തീയ വിശ്വാസങ്ങളുടെ മറുപുറമായി കരുതപ്പെടുന്ന സാത്താന്‍ പ്രീതിയുടെ നാള്‍വഴികളിലൂടെയും തുടര്‍ന്നുള്ള പ്രശ്‌നങ്ങളിലൂടെയും നോവല്‍ സഞ്ചരിക്കുന്നു.

ugadi-panchanga-shravanam.title: Ugadi Panchanga Shravanam
ugadi-panchanga-shravanam.description:
**ఉగాది పంచాంగ శ్రవణం** అంటే వచ్చే నూతన సంవత్సరానికి సంబంధించిన పంచాంగాన్ని చదివించడం. ఇది ప్రతి ఉగాది రోజు జరిగే ముఖ్యమైన సంప్రదాయ కార్యక్రమం. ఇందులో పండితులు ఆ సంవత్సరానికి సంబంధించిన రాశిఫలాలు, శుభాశుభాల వివరాలు, వర్షాభిప్రాయం, రాజకీయ పరిణామాలు, రైతు పరిస్థితులు, ఆరోగ్య పరిస్థితులు మొదలైనవి చెబుతారు.

ఈ శ్రవణం విని, ప్రజలు కొత్త సంవత్సరాన్ని ఆశాజనకంగా ప్రారంభిస్తారు.  
ఉగాది అంటే **యుగాది** – ఒక కొత్త కాలానికి ఆరంభం.  

🌿 ఈ ఉగాదిని పంచాంగ శ్రవణంతో ప్రార్థన, అభిమతం, ఆశయంతో ప్రారంభిద్దాం!

jagate-thiba-jete-dina.title: Jagate Thiba Jete Dina
jagate-thiba-jete-dina.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

the-wealth-code-cracking-the-secrets-to-.title: The wealth code: Cracking the secrets to become rich.
the-wealth-code-cracking-the-secrets-to-.description: നെപ്പോളിയൻ ഹിൽ, ജയിംസ് അലൻ, റോജർ ഫ്രിട്സ് എന്നിവർ ചേർന്ന് എഴുതിയ ലോകപ്രശസ്ത ഗ്രന്ഥം. സമ്പത്തിൻ്റെ രഹസ്യവഴികൾ നിങ്ങളെ പരിചയപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന അപൂർവ്വഗ്രന്ഥം. അനുശീലനവും ശ്രദ്ധയും വിവേകവും കൊണ്ട്  സമ്പത്തിൻ്റെ  രഹസ്യ അറ നിങ്ങൾക്കും സാധിക്കും. അതിനുളള ഉപാധികൾ ഈ പുസ്തകം നിങ്ങൾക്ക് പറഞ്ഞ് തരൂം.

indias-most-haunted-places.title: India's Most Haunted Places
indias-most-haunted-places.description: കാലം നിശ്ചലമായി നിൽക്കുന്ന, ഇന്ദ്രിയങ്ങൾക്ക് അറിയാൻ കഴിയാത്ത ഭയപ്പെടുത്തുന്ന അനുഭവങ്ങൾ നമ്മുക്ക് നൽകുന്ന വിശേഷപ്പെട്ട സ്ഥലങ്ങൾ ഭൂമിയിൽ ഏറെയുണ്ട്. ശാസ്ത്രം ഇത്രത്തോളം പുരോഗമിച്ചിട്ടും മനുഷയ് യുക്തിക്ക് പിടി തരാത്ത Haunted Space കൾ ആണിവ.  ഭാംഗഡ് കോട്ട, മലബാർ ഹില്ലിലെ ടവർ ഓഫ് സൈലൻസ്, ജമ്മു-കശ്മീരിലെ കുപ്രസിദ്ധമായ ഖൂനി നാള തുടങ്ങി ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ഏറ്റവും ഭയാനകങ്ങളായ ഇത്തരം ഇടങ്ങളെ കുറിച്ചുളള കഥകൾ ഈ ഓഡിയോ ബുക്കിലൂടെ കേൾക്കാം.

on-the-meaning-of-mahabharat.title: On The Meaning of Mahabharat
on-the-meaning-of-mahabharat.description: 1942 mein Dr. V.S.Sukthankar 'Meaning of the Mahabharata' ka apna 4th lecture Mumbai University mein dene waale the. Par, usse pehle hi unka dehaant hogaya. Unke unn lectures ko leke iss book ka nirmaan kiya gaya hai jisse aap Mahabharata iss maha kavya ko ek alag nazariye se dekhna shuru karenge

bloodstone-fortune.title: Bloodstone Fortune
bloodstone-fortune.description:
Discover the thrilling world of "Bloodstone Fortune" where one man's humiliation becomes the catalyst for extraordinary power!

After a disastrous blind date, Jason Lyonis stumbles upon an ancient ring that grants him Quantum Vision. Suddenly, he can see opportunities not invisible to others, rocketing him from nobody to somebody overnight. But with great power comes dangerous enemies. As Jason navigates his new reality, he uncovers a sinister plot at the dazzling Eryndor Gem Fair.

Will Jason's newfound abilities be enough to outwit his foes? Or will the price of power prove too high?
Immerse yourself in this addictive blend of fantasy and suspense. Your next obsession awaits!

thirumba-thirumba.title: Thirumba Thirumba

പ്രണയത്തിനൊരു-സോഫ്റ്റ്‌വെയർ-.description: ബാംഗ്ലൂരിലെ ഐ.ടി മേഖലയുടെ പശ്ഛാത്തലത്തില്‍ പറയപ്പെടുന്ന ഒരു ചെറിയ പ്രണയകഥ. തെറ്റിധാരണകൾക്കും ആശങ്കകൾക്കും ഇടയിലൂടെ കൂടിപിണയുന്ന പ്രണയം. സമകാലിക യുവതയുടെ പ്രണയവഴികൾ മിഴിവോടെ പറയുന്നു.സുന്ദരങ്ങളായ കഥകളിലൂടെ വായനാക്കാരുടെ  പ്രിയ കഥകാരനായി അറിയപ്പെട്ട ഇ. ഹരികുമാറിന്റെ മിഴിവുറ്റ കഥ, ദാമോദർ രാധാകൃഷ്ണന്റെ ശബ്ദത്തിൽ കേൾക്കു...

naam-gum-jayega.title: Naam Gum Jayega
naam-gum-jayega.description: Meera and Aarohi are step-sisters bound by blood, betrayal, and buried secrets. While kind-hearted Meera builds a happy life with Arjun, the neglected Aarohi is consumed by jealousy after discovering the truth about her mother's death. Guided by the mysterious occultist Nishaan, she embraces black magic to steal Meera's identity, rewrite Arjun's memories, and erase her sister from everyone's lives and her love turns into obsession.

the-wolf-queen-of-the-vampire-king-3.title: Ratu Serigala Raja Vampir
the-wolf-queen-of-the-vampire-king-3.description: Astrid’s story unfolds as a brutal supernatural struggle over shame, control, and identity. At first, she is publicly humiliated, forced to kneel, and left begging for help from Ronan and Cale, only to be rejected and blamed by the pack. Rival women and pack politics turn her into a scapegoat, and a confrontation involving wolfsbane leads to false accusations of poisoning and violence. Ronan sides against her, has her restrained with silver chains, and finally banishes her into a storm while warning that the pack will hunt her if she returns. What looks like total defeat is not the end, because the story shifts toward survival when a hidden rescue and later shelter from Lucien Veya keep her alive. Lucien becomes both protector and mentor, helping Astrid endure a dangerous awakening of her hidden wolf power. A forbidden blood ritual and a monstrous presence make it clear that awakening her power could save her or kill her. As Astrid learns that control matters more than speed, she begins to understand her own strength and the cost of using it. Outside her personal crisis, the wider camp also fractures under hunger, failing systems, and challenges to ruthless authority. Astrid is eventually revealed to be alive, which exposes the lies that were used against her and forces others to face their guilt. The truth around Ingrid’s deception and the false story about the drug or poison slowly comes into focus, though the damage is already done. Even after the accusations shift, Astrid remains threatened, restrained, and pushed toward retaliation rather than reconciliation. Ingrid’s murder deepens the conflict and hardens Astrid’s resolve, making revenge part of her path forward. Ronan’s guilt grows as he realizes he abandoned Astrid during the storm and acted on false information. Astrid refuses forgiveness from Cale and rejects the men who tried to reclaim her after failing to protect her. She returns stronger, sabotages the camp’s machinery, and forces the conflict into the duel arena, tying her personal revenge to the camp’s survival crisis. In the end, she wins the challenge and is declared the new Alpha, but the power struggle does not fully settle. Even after that rise, she is still pulled into new attempts to control her through bonds, captivity, and supernatural corruption. By the close of the arc, Astrid has not found peace, but she has reclaimed enough power to choose her own path, and her future remains in her own hands.

passion-to-profit.description: ప్యాషన్ టు ప్రాఫిట్: మీకు నచ్చిన పనినే ఆదాయంగా ఎలా మార్చుకోవాలో ఈ సిరీస్ ద్వారా తెలుసుకోండి. ఇందుకు అదృష్టం లేదా ప్రేరణ ఒక్కటే సరిపోదు—సరైన ప్లానింగ్, స్ట్రాటజీ, అలాగే మార్కెట్‌ను అర్థం చేసుకోవడం ఎంత ముఖ్యమో ఈ సిరీస్ వివరిస్తుంది.

paradise.title: Paradise
paradise.description: जब आकाश जोशी अपने परिवार को लेकर रहस्यमयी ‘द पैराडाइज एस्टेट’ में शरण लेता है, तो उसे सुरक्षा मिलती है, दौलत मिलती है… लेकिन धीरे-धीरे वह नोटिस करता है कि इस सोसाइटी में लोग गायब हो जाते हैं, मंदिर सबके लिए नहीं खुलता, और बाहर जाने की कोशिश करने वाले कभी लौटकर नहीं आते।

kaandhalur-vasanthakumaran-kadhai.title: Kaandhalur Vasanthakumaran Kadhai
kaandhalur-vasanthakumaran-kadhai.description: ராஜராஜ சோழன் காலகட்டத்தில் நம்பகமான கதாபாத்திரங்களுடன் உருவான ஒரு விறுவிறுப்பான சரித்திரக் கதை! உண்மையான சம்பவங்களை ஆதாரத்துடன் சொல்லும் சுஜாதாவின் மாஸ்டர் பீஸ்!

the-moral-compass.title: The Moral Compass
the-moral-compass.description: Hardayal Singh ki 'The Moral Compass' mein dharma aur moral integrity ko interesting real-life stories ke zariye samjhaya gaya hai, jahan logon ne morality ke asli essence ko samjha. Is audio show mein dekhiye kaise pracheen gyaan aur aaj ke challenges milkar aapko ek moral compass dete hain. Abhi suniye, aur apni zindagi mein asli fulfillment ka raasta paiye!"

belaku-beladingala-deepagalu.title: Belaku Beladingala Deepagalu
belaku-beladingala-deepagalu.description: Exploring personal development on Kuku FM is like embarking on a transformative journey. Dive into audio shows that guide you through self-improvement career growth and mindfulness designed especially for those who seek to excel in every aspect of life. Whether you're aiming to boost your productivity enhance your mental health or find inner peace Kuku FM offers actionable insights and inspiration. Listen now and start crafting the life you've always envisioned with expert advice right in your ears.

andekhi-anjaani-si.title: Andekhi Anjaani Si
andekhi-anjaani-si.description: Divya ko bhagwaan ne ek sundar shareer or achchi shakal nahin di thi. Uske bhadde roop-rang ki vajah se Abhishek 7 faire poore hote hi beech mandap se uth ke chala gaya,  Divya is sadme se behosh ho gai, Jab ushe hosh aaya to pata chala ki vo 5 mahine se pregnant hai jabki uske aaspaas to kabhi koi ladka bhatka bhi nahin tha. Aakhir kaise hui Divya pragnent? Kya kabhi hatega us par se badsoorti ka shraap? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye "Andekhi Anjaani Si" sirf Kukufm par.

love-vs-lust.title: Love V/S Lust
love-vs-lust.description: కాలేజ్ లో జరిగే వరుస హత్యలకు కారణమైన వారిని పట్టుకోవడానికి రంగంలోకి దిగుతాడు ACP విక్రమ్. మరోవైపు అదే కాలేజ్ లో చదివే రిషి, కాలేజీలో కొత్తగా జాయినైన సమీరాకి ప్రపోజ్ చేస్తాడు. ఒకవైపు ఆ ప్రపోజల్ ని యాక్సెప్ట్ చేసిన సమీరా, మరోవైపు కాలేజ్ లెక్చరర్ తో వన్ నైట్ స్టాండ్ కి ఒప్పుకుంటుంది. కానీ అనుకోని సందర్భంలో ఆ లెక్చరర్ చనిపోవడంతో, కథ కొత్త మలుపు తీసుకుంటుంది. అసలు హత్యలు చేసేది ఎవరు? సమీరా, లెక్చరర్ తో వన్ నైట్ స్టాండ్ కి ఎందుకు ఒప్పుకుంటుంది? ఆమె ప్రవర్తనకి రిషి ఎలా స్పందిస్తాడు? హంతకులను ACP విక్రమ్ పట్టుకుంటాడా? ఇలాంటి ఎన్నో ఉత్కంఠమైన ప్రశ్నలకు సమాధానాలు తెలియాలంటే, Love Vs Lust స్టోరీ వినేయండి మీ Kuku Fm లో…

build-for-tomorrow.title: Future Ki Karein Taiyari
build-for-tomorrow.description: Bhagwan Krishna kahte hain “Jeevan Mein Badlav Zaroori Hai”. Jisne badlav ke sath Khud ko badla use Success milti hai lekin jo badlav se samjhauta nahi kar paate, unka kya? Unke liye hai ye khas show “Future Ki Karein Taiyari”. Yahan aapko milenge apne sawalo ke jawab Ki kaise future mein hone wale badlav ko predict karke aap future planning kar sakte haihn. Chaliye jaante hain kaise change se dosti karein aur fir success ke liye kaam karein.

amara-vichitra-kathe.title: Amara Vichitra Kathe
amara-vichitra-kathe.description: ಕ್ರಯಾನಿಕ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನೋದು ವೈಜ್ಞಾನಿಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ಒಂದು ವಿಸ್ಮಯ! ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಸತ್ತ ಮನುಷ್ಯನನ್ನ ಕ್ರಿಪೋ ಫ್ರೀಝಿಂಗ್ ಅನ್ನೋ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿಕೊಂಡು, ದೇಹದ ಕೋಶಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಷ್ಕರಿಸಿ, ಜೀವ ತುಂಬುವ ಒಂದು ಕ್ರಿಯೆ‌. ಈ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ, ಲೇಖಕ ವಿಠಲ್ ಶೆಣೈ ಅವರು 'ಅಮರ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಕಥೆ' ಅನ್ನೋ ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ‌. ಕಥಾನಾಯಕ ಅಮರ್, 3 ದಶಕಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಕುಟುಂಬವನ್ನು ತೊರೆದು ಅಮೆರಿಕಾದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಾರಣವೇನು? ಮುಂದೆ ನಡೆಯೋ ವಿಚಿತ್ರಗಳೇನು ಅನ್ನೋದೇ ಇದರ ಕಥಾಹಂದರ‌. ಈ ಮೆಡಿಕಲ್ ಮಿಸ್ಟರಿ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

love-stories-from-the-puranas.title: Love Stories From The Puranas
love-stories-from-the-puranas.description:
|Key Points- Eternal Love, Inspirational Tales & Faith In Love|
Nal aur Damyanti se lekar Savitri aur Satyavan tak, suniye kaise sachcha pyar kismat ko bhi badal deta hai. Chaliye prem kahaniyon ke iss anokhe safar mein jahan hum aapko le chalenge vaidik kaal ki un kahaniyon tak, jo aaj bhi hai amar hai.


Link- https://kukufm.com/show/garuda-purana-ke-rahasya?utm_source=upsell

mummy-pappa.title: Mummy Pappa
mummy-pappa.description: Join the adventure with Kuku FM's Teens & Young Adult shows. Tailored for the young and the young at heart our content ranges from coming-of-age stories to fantastical adventures. Engage with characters facing challenges discoveries and the thrill of growing up. Inspiring entertaining and relatable these shows are perfect for teen listeners and those seeking youthful spirit.

the-psychology-of-money-18.title: The Psychology of Money
the-psychology-of-money-18.description: Panam undenkil thanne oru manushyante jeevithathile pakuthiyil kooduthal preshnangalkkum pariharamayi ennu ningalum ketitundakum. Pakshe ee panam enganeyanu sambhadhikkuka, enganeyanu athu nilanirthuka? Morgan Housel nte ''The Psychology of Money'' enna pusthakathil panam sambhandhikunathu sambhandhicha ella samshayangalkkum ulla krityamaya utharangal nalkiyitundu. Ippol thanne ee audio book kelkku, panam sambhadhikanula tricks manassilakku.

the-deal.title: The Deal
the-deal.description: In Manhattan what I did to Jesse Somerset was mine. Five years ago I spent the night with my brother's best friend. Only my brother doesn't know it. Now he's back in my life...and in need of a phony wife. And I know I'm going to sin again... The third full-length standalone novel in the Manhattan Nights series is a brother's best friend/forbidden romance full of humor suspense and plenty of heat.

boond-aur-samudra.title: Boond Aur Samudra
boond-aur-samudra.description: Explore the world of classic tales with Kuku FM. Our collection takes you on adventures with timeless stories about brave heroes deep friendships and big challenges. These stories teach us about life love and the choices we make. Perfect for anyone who loves good stories that never get old. Listen now Kuku FM for a journey through stories that have been loved for years.

manjina-bettada-sahasi-chirathe.title: Manjina Bettada Sahasi Chirathe
manjina-bettada-sahasi-chirathe.description: ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಮಹಾವೀರ ಚಕ್ರ ಪಡೆದ ಕೆಲವೇ ಕೆಲವರಲ್ಲಿ 'ಕರ್ನಲ್ ಚೆವಾಂಗ್ ರಿಂಚೆನ್' ಒಬ್ಬರು. ಅಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೂ ಇವರಿಗೆ ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಈ ಗೌರವ ದೊರೆತದ್ದು ಯಾಕೆ? ಮೈಕೊರೆಯೋ ಚಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವೀರಯೋಧನ ಹೋರಾಟ ಹೇಗಿತ್ತು? ಈ ಕೆಚ್ಚೆದೆಯ ಸೈನಿಕನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ 'ಚಕ್ರವರ್ತಿ ಸೂಲಿಬೆಲೆ' ಅವರು 'ಮಂಜಿನ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಸಾಹಸಿ ಚಿರತೆ' ಅನ್ನೋ ಕೃತಿ ರಚಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ!

bhitti.title: Bhitti
bhitti.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

lockdown-1.title: Lockdown
lockdown-1.description: Lockdown Nanavabe Aamder Jibonjatrake Byahoto Korechhe, Kintu Tar Modhyeo Keu keu Peyechhe Obosor, Sob Kichhu Notun Kore Thik Korar Monobol. Golpti Temon Ek Dompotir Kahini Bole Jader Jibone Lockdown Ekti Suvo Suchona.

vrindavan-vaat-jata.title: Vrindavan Vaat Jata
vrindavan-vaat-jata.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

captain-vikram-batra.title: Kargil Ke Paramvir Captain Vikram Batra
captain-vikram-batra.description: Palampur Ka Ek Aam Sa Ladka Jisne 25 Saal Ki Umar Se Pehle Hi Apne Desh Ke Liye Shahadat De Di Aaiye Sunte Hain Us Veer Jawan Ki Kahani Is Audiobook Mein Aur Jaante Hain Indian Army Ke Shershah Ko Thoda Aur Kareeb Se.

science-of-getting-rich-1.title: Science of Getting Rich
science-of-getting-rich-1.description: This Audiobook gives you permission to embrace your natural desire for wealth and explains why riches lead to a prosperous and abundant life in mind, body, and soul.

vivek-3.title: VIVEK
vivek-3.description: Ivaru Comedy yum marangalai yum mattume vithaichittu pogala, Athayum thaandi nalla memories ah namakkaga vittutu poirukaaru. Intha pathiuvu Vivek sir kodutha antha nalla memories oda thoguppu. Chinna Kalaivaanar Vivek avargalukku Kuku FM in tribute.

build-a-successful-business-from-scratch.title: Build A Successful Business From Scratch
build-a-successful-business-from-scratch.description: బిజినెస్ పెట్టాలి అనుకుంటున్నారా? కానీ ఎలా మొదలు పెట్టాలో తెలియట్లేదా? అయితే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోసమే వెంటనే వినండి.

smoke-ashes-opiums-hidden-histories.title: Smoke & Ashes: Opium’s Hidden Histories
smoke-ashes-opiums-hidden-histories.description: "Smoke & Ashes" ek travelogue, memoir aur historical journey hai, jo opium trade ke peeche chhupi dark reality ko samne laata hai. British Empire ne kaise is trade se India, China aur poori duniya ko badla, aur iska aaj ki global economy par kya asar pada hai, ye show aapko detail mein batayega. Suniye aur samjhiye ek chhoti si plant ka bada impact!

how-to-be-a-productivity-ninja-1.title: How To Be A Productivity Ninja
how-to-be-a-productivity-ninja-1.description: నింజా అంటే ఎవరు ? మీరు ప్రొడక్టివ్ నింజాగా మారాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? అయితే  రిస్క్‌ను ఎలా తీసుకోవాలో మరియు సవాళ్లను ఎలా అంగీకరించాలో  తెలుసుకోవాలని ఉందా ? ఆలస్యం చేయకుండా వినండి " హౌ టు బి ఏ ప్రొడక్టివిటీ  నింజా " అనే కుకు ఎఫ్ఎమ్ బైట్స్ ని.

Learnings-From-Ramakrishna-सही-जीवन-की-ख.title: Learnings From Ramakrishna: सही जीवन की खोज
Learnings-From-Ramakrishna-सही-जीवन-की-ख.description: Kya aap har din ki stress aur life ke challenges se pareshaan hain? Toh abhi suniye yeh show, jiske har episode mein aapko Ramakrishna ji ke life lessons, aur effective tips milenge, jo aapki sabhi life problems ko solve kardenge aur aapko apni life mein khush aur successful banayenge.

tondaiman-kadhaigal-untold-stories-of-th.title: Tondaiman kadhaigal - Untold stories of the Tondaiman dynasty
tondaiman-kadhaigal-untold-stories-of-th.description: Thamizh naata aanda sila sirappana mannar vamsa vazhiyila Thondaiman vamsathukku pala sirappugal iruku. Avangaloda sila mukkiya nigazhvugal konda varalaru dhaan indha Thondaiman kadhaigal audio book.

deadly-cults-around-the-world.title: Duniya Ke Khatarnak Cults
deadly-cults-around-the-world.description: Yaqin karna mushkil hai na ki kisi ne aastha, dharm ya behtar life dene ka jhaansa dekar murder aur rape jaise bhayanak apradho ko anjam diya. Khud hi khud ko bhagwan bana liya aur logo ko andhbhakt. Is series me ham baat karenge kuch aise hi 'Cults' ki jinhone darindagi ki sari hade paar kar di aur unka ant hi unki pehchan ban gaya.

election-process-of-india.title: Election Process In India
election-process-of-india.description: Aaj ke waqt mein agar hum rajneeti ki baat kare to sabke dimag mein bas ek he khayal aata hai ki bhai jo bhe ho bas rajniti se door raho, humne aksar logon se kehte suna hai ki har cheez me rajneeti mat kiya karo, aur pata nahi kitni he aisi baate suni hogi apni zindagi mein. Politics ne sach me aaj ke waqt mein aisa roop le liya hai ki aaye din hume news par Netaon ke bade bade karname dekhne ko milte hai, lekin kahin na kahin aaj bhe hum Indian politics ke baare mein puri tarah nahi hai jaante hain isiliye hum aapke liye lekar aaye hai bilkul original content jiska naam hai "Election Process in India". Is Audio book se aapko har uss Election process ke baare mein pata chalega jo ki shayad abtak aap nahi jaante honge.

3be8e94e-f3c9-44d3-8b21-a38b047e635d.title: Kabhi Bhakti Kabhi Shakti
3be8e94e-f3c9-44d3-8b21-a38b047e635d.description:
Two brothers. One land. One wants to build a factory — the other refuses to break their father's dying wish to build a Shiv temple.

Shiwani raised both sons with the same devotion to Lord Shiv, but faith and ambition have pulled them to opposite ends.

This is a story of a family torn between karma and bhakti — and Lord Shiv watching over every decision they make.

nizam-vs-aawam-hyderabad-ka-faisla.title: Nizam Vs Aawam: Hyderabad ka Faisla
nizam-vs-aawam-hyderabad-ka-faisla.description: 1948, आज़ाद भारत के नक्शे के बीचों-बीच एक ऐसी रियासत खड़ी है, जो हिंदुस्तान में मिलने को तैयार नहीं। निज़ाम आज़ादी पर अड़ा है, रज़ाकार हथियार उठा चुके हैं और हैदराबाद में बाहर से हथियार पहुँच रहे हैं। बातचीत की हर कोशिश नाकाम हो रही है, जबकि अंतरराष्ट्रीय दखल का खतरा बढ़ता जा रहा है। अब सरदार पटेल के सामने सिर्फ़ एक सवाल है, क्या हैदराबाद को बातचीत की मेज़ पर झुकाया जाएगा, या हिंदुस्तान की फौज उसकी सरहदें पार करेगी? और अगर फौज गई… तो क्या हैदराबाद पाँच दिन टिक पाएगा?

the-art-of-strategic-portfolio-managemen.title: The Art of Strategic Portfolio Management
the-art-of-strategic-portfolio-managemen.description: Life mein Paisa toh bahut log kamaate hain lekin us paise ko sahi jagah invest karna bhi utna hi zaroori hai, jitna us paise ke liye mehnat karna. Paison ke comfort mein hum emergency situations ke liye khud ko prepare nahi karte, jisse ek din hamaara bura sapna sach mein badal jaata hai. Lekin kaise seekh sakte hain apne liye best portfolio banaane ka tareeka. Jaaniye is show mein jahaan aapko milenge Equity, Gold, Mutual Funds se le kar Fixed Deposit tak ke investment options.

இமாலயன்--பாகம்-2.title: Imalayan - Part 2
இமாலயன்--பாகம்-2.description: 1962 - l imayamalaip paguthiyil nadantha india - China porai adippadaiyagak kondathu Imalayan. 1959 muthal 1962 varaiyilaana india, china and Tibetin arasiyal soozhalgal intha novelil vivarikkappattullana...

the-case-of-the-green-dressed-ghost.title: The Case of the Green-Dressed Ghost
the-case-of-the-green-dressed-ghost.description: Kester Lanner didn't know what he was getting into when he followed his mother's dying request to contact the mysterious Dr. Ribero. Kester's youthful surety of the world is shaken as he learns the secrets his mother took great care to keep. Meeting Dr. Ribero reveals a side of his mother he never even guessed existed for Ribero is his long lost father and soon Kester is thrown headlong into the family business: catching supernatural spirits. A logically-minded academic type Kester is frightened by the sudden plunge into an unknown and dangerous world. He's intrigued despite his fear as he reads an old diary that tells the chilling tale of the portrait of a beautiful woman which is the home of an old and malevolent spirit. She's a cunning spirit and she just might be more than Dr. Ribero's agency can handle. Kester soon becomes enmeshed in a struggle with a ghost so powerful and haunting that his first real case with the family business might just be his last.

kokkokam-illara-ragasiyam.title: Rathi Ragasiyam
kokkokam-illara-ragasiyam.description: “Pengal naalu vagai , Inbam nooru vagai” nu kannadhasana paada vacha puthagam intha Rathi Ragasiyam thaan ! Idhu kamasutra kkum munnaadi kaalathula ezhutha patta oru inba nool nu solranga. “Kokkogam - Illara ragasiyam” apdinu intha book ka pathinaram nootrandil vazhntha  pandiya mannar “ Adhi Veera Rama Pandian” thamizh la mozhi maatram senju ezhuthi veliyitrukaar. Intha pazhanthamizh puthagathukkulla enna iruku nu intha audio book ka kettu therinjukalaam vaanga !

besties.title: Besties
besties.description: What if the bestie you betrayed came back from the dead to take back everything you stole from her? Mithyaa, an ambitious model consumed by jealousy of her beautiful best friend Satya, murders her and steals her career, crown and place beside Aryan. But Satya returns as a vengeful spirit, slowly destroying everything Mithyaa stole - her beauty, body, ambition & sanity - until Mithyaa's own public confession exposes her & leaves her condemned to an eternal afterlife with the friend she betrayed.

triste-fim-de-policarpo-quaresma.title: Triste Fim de Policarpo Quaresma
triste-fim-de-policarpo-quaresma.description: Neste livro, acompanhamos a história de Policarpo, um homem de patriotismo ímpar que sonha em mostrar o valor da cultura brasileira aos seus compatriotas. No entanto, a busca por costumes e culturas exclusivamente nacionais é mais difícil do que ele imaginava.

guns-and-thighs-1.title: GUNS & THIGHS : The Story of My Life
guns-and-thighs-1.description: రామ్ గోపాల్ వర్మ జీవితంలో జరిగిన ఆసక్తికర సంఘటనలు గురించి తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నారా ? RGVని సినిమాల వైపు ఆకర్షించిన ప్రభావాలు , సినిమా టెక్నిక్‌లు, అతని విజయవంతమైన మరియు విజయవంతం కాని సినిమాలు,  మీడియాతో అతని సంబంధాలు మరియు అతనిని వేధిస్తున్న వివాదాల వరకు అనేక రకాల విషయాలను ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ విని తెలుసుకోండి.

-মিঠি--Mithi--Ratna-Halder.title: মিঠি | লেখিকা - রত্না হালদার
-মিঠি--Mithi--Ratna-Halder.description: শুভর চাকরি সুত্রে রাই ও শুভ বিয়ের পর গুজরাটে সংসার শুরু করে। সেখানে রাইদের এক প্রতিবেশী পরিবারের চার পাঁচ বছর বয়সী মিঠি রাই এর ভালবাসার সঙ্গী হয়। কিন্তু মিঠির মা ছবি বাড়িতে অত্যাচারিত হয় নিয়মিত স্বামী ও শ্বাশুরির কাছে। সেই পুরুষ নিজের মেয়েকেও মারতে ছাড়েনা।

aryaveer.title: Aryaveer
aryaveer.description: Can a young man defeat a ferocious wild elephant with his bare hands? Could anyone survive the sting of a hundred venomous scorpions at once? And can you tame a fire breathing dragon? Dressed as a beggar, a mysterious young man enters a grand competition. He has only one goal—to win Princess Hansika’s hand in the swayamvar. But will his journey really be that easy? Listen to Aryaveer—an epic tale of sacrifice, love, betrayal filled with thrilling challenges and dangerous conspiracies.

aashiqui-1.title: ఆషికి
aashiqui-1.description: చరణ్ పాటల ప్రోగ్రాం కోసం పల్లెటూరికి వెళ్ళి అక్కడ సాహిత్యతో ప్రేమలో పడతాడు. సాహిత్య లవ్ ఆక్సెప్ట్ చేసింది అన్న సంతోషంలో ఉండగా, ఎప్పటినుండో కదలలేని స్థితిలో ఉన్న తల్లిలో కదలిక రావడంతో అన్నీ మంచి రోజులే అనుకున్నాడు. సరిగ్గా అదే సమయంలో చరణ్ కి తనలాగే ఉన్న మరో మనిషి కనిపిస్తాడు. అతని రాకతో చరణ్ లైఫ్ ఎలా టర్న్ అవ్వబోతుంది? అసలు వాళ్ళిద్దరూ ఒకేలా ఎందుకు ఉన్నారు? సాహిత్య వెనుక ఉన్న ఫ్లాష్ బ్యాక్ ఏంటి? తెలుసుకోవాలంటే "ఆషికి" షో వినేయండి.

kootathil-oruvan.title: Kootathil Oruvan
kootathil-oruvan.description:
தன் பணத்திற்காக அல்ல, தன்னை மனிதனாக மதிப்பவர்களை அறிய ஒரு பில்லியனர் கிளீனராக வேடமிட்டு பயணிக்கிறார். அவரை பலர் அவமானப்படுத்தும் நிலையில், மீரா மட்டும் அவரை மரியாதையுடன் நடத்துகிறாள்.
இருவருக்கும் இடையே எதிர்பாராத பந்தம் உருவாக, அவனது உண்மையான அடையாளம் அனைத்தையும் மாற்றுகிறது. ஆனால் பழைய காதல், ரகசியங்கள் மற்றும் துரோகம் அவர்களின் வாழ்க்கையைப் புரட்டிப் போடுகின்றன.

137c73ea-d1e5-45da-9810-587cdd99db67.title: Legend of Suheldev : The King Who Saved India
137c73ea-d1e5-45da-9810-587cdd99db67.description:
ஒரு மறக்கப்பட்ட ஹீரோ. ஒரு மறக்க முடியாத போர்.

இந்தியா, 1025 கி.பி. முஹமது கஜினி மற்றும் அவரது காட்டுமிராண்டித்தனமான துருக்கியப் படையினர் இந்தியாவைத் தாக்கி அழிக்கிறார்கள். இந்த அவநம்பிக்கையான நேரத்தில் ஒரு போர் வீரன் நாட்டைக் காக்க எழுகிறான். அவன் தான் மன்னர் சுஹேல் தேவ்.  

சுஹேல் தேவின் வீரமிக்க இந்த பிளாக்பஸ்டர் காவிய சாகசத்தைக் கேளுங்கள்...

dreams-vs-scams.title: Dreams Vs Scams
dreams-vs-scams.description: ಭಾರೀ ಭೂ ಹಗರಣವೊಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಬಲಿಯಾಗೋ ಮಿಡಲ್‌ಕ್ಲಾಸ್‌ ತ್ಯಾಗಿ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ದಿವಾಳಿತನದ ಚಕ್ರವ್ಯೂಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ವಂತ ಮನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಕನಸು ಕಾಣೋ ರಾಕೇಶ್‌ ತ್ಯಾಗಿ, ಕಾಂಟ್ರ್ಯಾಕ್ಟರ್‌ ನೇಗಿಯಿಂದ ಮೋಸಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗ್ತಾನೆ. ಈ ಶಾಕ್‌ನಿಂದ ತ್ಯಾಗಿ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಚೇತರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಾಗದಷ್ಟು ಆಘಾತಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಅಮೇರಿಕದಿಂದ ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗೋ ತ್ಯಾಗಿಯ ಹಿರಿಯ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ತನ್ನ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕಾದ ಮೋಸದ ತೀವ್ರತೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗುತ್ತಾ ಹೋಗುತ್ತೆ. ಜೀವನದ ಕಠಿಣ ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನ ನಂಬಿಕೆ, ದೃಢನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ದಿಟ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಎದುರಿಸೋ ತ್ಯಾಗಿ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ರೋಚಕ ಕಥೆ "Dreams Vs Scams" ಕೇಳಿ KUKU FMನಲ್ಲಿ.

you-can-heal-your-life-12.title: You Can Heal Your Life
you-can-heal-your-life-12.description: Discover how spirituality and self-help come together in Louise Hay's ‘You Can Heal Your Life’. This book gives great advice on how to handle emotional and physical problems for a healthier and happier life. 🌟💓📘

para-purusha.title: Para Purusha
para-purusha.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

gurunanak-dev-ji.title: Gurunanak Dev Ji
gurunanak-dev-ji.description: గురునానక్ సిక్కుల ఆరాధ్య దైవంగా ఎలా అయ్యారు? ఆయన చేసిన నీతి బోధనలు ఏంటి?సిక్కుల ఆచార వ్యవహారాలు ఎందుకు భిన్నమైనవి? ఆసక్తికర ఆడియో బుక్ మీకోసం

palani-baba-1.title: Palani Baba
palani-baba-1.description: Palani baba oru activist and a politician, ivaroda life la nadandha pala swarasyangal dhaan indha audio book.

brahmagantu.title: Brahmagantu
brahmagantu.description: ಒಂದು ಕಡೆ ಬಿಲಿಯನೇರ್ ಹುಡುಗ, ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯನ್ನ ಹೇಳ್ಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದ ದಿನವೇ ಕೋಮಾಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ದುಃಸ್ಥಿತಿ. ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಕಡೆ ತನ್ನ ಹುಡುಗನಿಗಾಗಿ ವಿಧಿಯನ್ನೇ ಎದುರು ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡ ಪ್ರೇಯಸಿ! ಹೀಗೆ ಪ್ರೇಮವೇ ಉಸಿರಾಗಿ ಬೆರೆತ ಜೋಡಿ, ಹೇಗೆ ಒಂದಾಗುತ್ತೆ? ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ ಎದುರಾಗೋ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನ ಮೆಟ್ಟಿ‌ ನಿಂತದ್ದು ಹೇಗೆ? ಕೇಳಿ ಅಪರೂಪದ ಪ್ರೇಮಕಥೆ 'ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಗಂಟು'.

how-to-live-on-24-hours-a-day-7.title: How to live on 24 hours a day
how-to-live-on-24-hours-a-day-7.description: ✨ Unga vaazhkaiyoda ovvoru nodiyaiyum productive va vazhradhu eppadi nu kathukkanuma ? appo indha audiobook ka kelunga 🎧 Time management la Master aagunga ⏳⏰

సేల్స్-యొక్క-సక్సెస్-ఫార్ములా.title: సేల్స్ యొక్క సక్సెస్ ఫార్ములా
సేల్స్-యొక్క-సక్సెస్-ఫార్ములా.description: ఎంత కష్టపడ్డా సేల్స్ డిపార్ట్మెంట్ లో సక్సెస్ అవ్వలేకపోతున్నారా? అయితే ఇందులో ఉన్న కొన్ని ఈజీ ట్రిక్స్ ని ఫాలో అవుతే ఈజీ గా మీరు సక్సెస్ అవ్వొచ్చు. ఇంకెందుకు లేట్ వెంటనే ఈ ఆడియో బుక్ వినండి.

फँस-गया-ऑटो-वाला--लेखक--प्रवीण-सिंह-नेगी.title: फँस गया ऑटो वाला
फँस-गया-ऑटो-वाला--लेखक--प्रवीण-सिंह-नेगी.description: Zara sochiye aap kabhi kisi museebat mein pad jaaye aur jaane anjaane mein hi sahi par aap kar lete hai kisi se sachi dosti. Par jab aapka bura waqt aata hai toh aur aap sabko chodkar sirf usi pe bharosa karte hai. Lekin wo dost bhi de deta hai aapko vishwaasghaat. Aise hi dhoke aur dosti ki yeh kahani likhi hai aapke apne Pravin Singh Negi ne.

make-your-life-extraordinary.title: Make Your Life Extraordinary
make-your-life-extraordinary.description: Sochiye, agar aapke paas safalta hai par achi sehat aur shanti nahi, to iska kya fayda ? "Make Your Life Extraordinary Right Now" audioshow aapko sikhayega kaise ek santulit jeevan kiya jaye. Hum explore karenge Sadhguru ke pratical tips se lekar Autobiography of Yogi aur Ikigai tak ki ankahi baatein.

the-dragon-king.title: The Dragon King
the-dragon-king.description: In Darjeeling’s tea estates, Dev is reduced to a lowly worker after his rival Rohan cripples his hands and steals his inheritance. Discovering a secret breathing technique, Dev regains his strength and partners with Kavita to rebuild his empire. To save Binu from debt bondage and reclaim his family estate, he must defeat the elite planters in a dangerous high-altitude tea-picking duel.

the-protectors-promise.title: The Protector's Promise
the-protectors-promise.description: A love story shattered by a promise made twenty-five years ago. On the day of her engagement, Rupali's life is turned upside down when the mysterious billionaire Vikram Khanna storms into the ceremony, claims she is his wife, and takes her away by force. To the world, he is a ruthless criminal. But is he truly the villain, or a man risking everything to fulfill a sacred promise? Who will Rupali trust??

niyati.title: Niyati
niyati.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

how-to-prepare-for-group-2.title: How To Prepare For GROUP 2 ( TSPSC - APPSC )
how-to-prepare-for-group-2.description: Manalo chala mandiki prabhuthva udyogam pondalani untundi, Manchi prabhuthva udyogam techukovalani andariki entho korikaga untundhi, andulo bagam gane mi mundhuku ee Group 2 ane audio book tesukuvachamu. EE group 2 ante enti, indulo emi emi groups untayi, pariksha vidanam ela untundi, eni papers untayi ila miku teliyani enno vishyalu ee audio book lo unnai. Mi Dream prabhuthva udyogam aithe idhi mikosame.!

pralay-the-alien-protocol.title: Pralay: The Alien Protocol
pralay-the-alien-protocol.description: In the year 2092, when a top-secret space vessel crashes deep inside the Sahyadri forests, ex-commando Nishant leads a black-ops team to retrieve its classified data. But the mission turns into a nightmare when they discover a deadly alien predator hunting them one by one, while the ruthless corporation that sent them is secretly willing to sacrifice the entire team to turn the creature into the world's deadliest biological weapon.

yeh-jo-hai-zindagi.title: YEH JO HAI ZINDAGI
yeh-jo-hai-zindagi.description: “Haara wahi hai, Jo Lada Nhin Hai” ye line to aapne suni hi hogi aur mahsoos bhi ki hogi kyun ki shayd hi kabhi aisa waqt aata hota jab ham apni samsyaon ka saamna nhin kar rahe hote hain.Kabhi haarte hain, kabhi jeet jaate hain.Lekin sabse badi cheez hoti hai Ladna.samsyaon se ladne aur samaj ko samjhne ki kuch kamal ki tarqeebon ko batane ke liye ham laye hain kitab YEH JO HAI ZINDAGI.Jise likha hai famous Anchor aur writer Oprah Winfrey ne.  Ham laye hain kitab YEH JO HAI ZINDAGI.Jise likha hai famous Anchor aur writer Oprah Winfrey ne.

hamare-ateet-i.title: NCERT Hamare Ateet: I
hamare-ateet-i.description: Bharat ka naam Bharat kyon pada? Kaun the shuruati raja aur kaisa tha unka samrajya? Kya shuru se hi raja aur rajyavansh the? In sabhi sawalon ke jawab milenge apko hamari is khash peshkash mein. Is knowledge ka istemal sirf awareness ke liye hi nahi balki competitive exams mein bhi kiya ja sakta hai. To abhi sunein, Hamare Ateet...

jhaduwale-ki-crorepati-wife.title: Jhaduwale ki Crorepati Wife
jhaduwale-ki-crorepati-wife.description: तीन साल पहले एक अनजान युवक ने करोड़पति ईशा की जान बचाई थी, और तभी से ईशा अपने रक्षक को तलाश रही है। किस्मत उसे उसी युवक निहाल से मिलाती है, जब वह उसके दादाजी की जान बचाता है। दादाजी दोनों की शादी करा देते हैं, लेकिन निहाल अपनी बीमार मां और घर को बचाने के लिए एक करोड़ रुपये मांगता है। ईशा उसे लालची समझती है, मगर शादी के बाद उसे पता चलता है कि उसका पति उसी की कंपनी में झाड़ू-पोंछा करता है। क्या ईशा इस रिश्ते को दिल से स्वीकार करेगी? और क्या खुलेगा निहाल के अतीत का राज?

uttar-kashi-tunnel-rescue.title: Uttar Kashi Tunnel Rescue
uttar-kashi-tunnel-rescue.description: Utharakhandiley  Silk Yara thurangathil 2023 Novemberil Undaya Apakadathil 41 Thozhilaalikalaanu  Maranavumayi Mallittu 17 divasam kazhichu kootiyathu.  Yatharthathil Annu Enthanu Sambhavichathu? Enganeyaanu Ee 41 jeevanukalum sangethika Vidyayudey Sahayathodey Rakshapeduthiyathu?  Ningale Aakamshayudey Mulmunayil Nirthunna Aa Adbudha Katha  Innathe Kuku Fm Byteudey Kelkkaam.

bloody-billionaire-affair.title: Bloody Billionaire Affair

Jab Maya apni notebook bhool jaati hai, Rohan uske investigation notes padh leta hai — jisme maut, purane raaz aur ek stalker ka zikr hai. Jaise-jaise Maya apne sach ke kareeb jaati hai, uski zindagi ek dangerous obsession ka hissa ban jaati hai. Kya Maya sach ka raasta chunegi, ya Rohan ke jaal mein ulajhti chali jaayegi?

અધૂરી-પ્રેમ-કહાની.title: અધૂરી પ્રેમ કહાની
અધૂરી-પ્રેમ-કહાની.description: Naina returns to Mumbai hoping to secure help for her mother’s worsening illness, but she is immediately pulled into a harsh family and social struggle. Her father’s household humiliates her, withholds money, and treats her as unwanted, while her attempt to earn through painting is also blocked. Kabir Ahuja enters as a feared and possessive power figure whose fixation on Naina begins after a mistaken-identity encounter. From there, he repeatedly pushes marriage, uses money and influence to corner her, and even ties her mother’s treatment to her agreement. Naina is also caught between Kabir and Akash, her longtime fiancé, who offers support and marriage but cannot fully resolve the pressure around her. As the story develops, marriage becomes less a romance than a transaction controlled by powerful men and family interests. Naina refuses to surrender her dignity, even when she is threatened, restrained, or publicly shamed. A hidden marriage is eventually exposed at a lavish wedding, shifting the conflict into open scandal and forcing everyone to confront what has been concealed. The family web grows darker with accusations of betrayal, money deals, and possible hidden identity or parentage issues. Kabir repeatedly claims Naina as his wife in public, turning her name and status into a battleground. At the same time, Naina’s mother remains a constant emotional anchor and a source of urgency, since her treatment is repeatedly delayed or used as leverage. The story also widens into violent confrontations among relatives and rivals, with revenge and blackmail shaping the atmosphere. Kabir’s control is challenged by other men who try to manipulate Naina or pull her away, but he continues to intervene forcefully. Over time, the romance shifts from coercion and mistrust toward a more openly emotional bond. A major turning point comes when Kabir rescues Naina from attackers and she refuses to leave his side. The childhood-rescuer mystery is then confirmed through a tattoo reveal, showing that Kabir was the boy who saved her years earlier. This revelation softens the conflict and helps explain Naina’s conflicted feelings. By the end of the batch, Kabir forgives Naina and their relationship moves into an open romantic reunion, even though the larger family tensions and past betrayals remain unresolved.
