sales-success.description: Dive into the dark and mysterious world of crime with Kuku FM. Explore true crime stories unsolved mysteries and thrilling detective tales. Each episode takes you on a journey through the minds of criminals and the heroes who bring them to justice. Perfect for fans of suspense and intrigue our crime shows will keep you on the edge of your seat. Tune in to unravel the mysteries.

you-are-the-best-wife_mix.title: You are the Best Wife
you-are-the-best-wife_mix.description: Aksar pyaar shabd ke sath logon ki ek bahut hi common baat bhi sunai deti hai....Opposites attract! Kyunki jab do logon ko pyaar hota hai to wo apni apni dissimilarity mein bhi apna comfort dhund lete hai. Ye audiobook bhi aise hi do logon ki kahani hai, jinhone, college crush se lekar pati-patni banne tak ka safar tay kiya. Par badkismati se baaki logon ki tarah inke pyaar ko Happy Ending naseeb na ho saki. Ise sunne ke baad aapko bhi ehsaas hoga ki pyaar karna aur pyaar nibhana kya hota hai. To chaliye bina deri ke ise sunna shuru karte hai

ahalyas-awakening.title: Ahalya's Awakening
ahalyas-awakening.description: Ahalya's Awakening is a powerful retelling of the legendary Ahalya's journey. More than a tale of beauty, it explores her extraordinary intellect, curiosity, and courage as she challenges tradition in search of knowledge and self-identity. Filled with love, duty, betrayal, destiny, and redemption, this audiobook presents Ahalya as a resilient woman whose awakening inspires generations and redefines the meaning of strength.

blind-eyes-of-bhagalpur.title: Blind Eyes of Bhagalpur
blind-eyes-of-bhagalpur.description: 1980 ke dashak Mein Bihar Rajya Mein Crime apne Peak Par tha, Police Laachar thi, Pura Political System Corrupt tha. Is Daur mein Bihar Rajya ke Bhagalpur Distric mein ek aisi ghatna hui jisne pure desh ko hila kar rakh diya jise Ankhfodwa Kand bhi kaha jata hai. Police ne Jail mein band 33 Kaidiyo ki Ankh Fod kar unme Tejaab dal diya tha. Akhir Police ne Aisa kyon kiya? Vaha ke logo ka kya reaction tha? sab kuch detail me discuss karenge.

maloy-boner-atonko.title: Maloy Boner Atonko
maloy-boner-atonko.description: Experience the pulse-pounding excitement of Thrillers on Kuku FM. Our shows are masterfully crafted to keep you in suspense with twists and turns that will leave you breathless. From psychological dramas to action-packed adventures the thrill is in the chase the mystery and the ultimate revelation. For those who crave adrenaline tune in and prepare for a rollercoaster of emotions.

bhagat-singh-ki-jail-diary.title: Bhagat Singh ki Jail Diary
bhagat-singh-ki-jail-diary.description: Bhagat Singh apne antim dinon mein Lenin ko padh rahe the. Communist vichardhara un par havi thi. Ye sab to hum sabne padh ya sun rakha hai. Par kya the unke actual thoughts? Desh aur samaj ke vibhinn muddon par wo kya sochte the? Ye sab janne ko milega unki likhi jail diary se aur uske liye suniye ye show...

lokesh-cinematic-universe.title: Lokesh Cinematic Universe
lokesh-cinematic-universe.description: Vikram, Rolex, Dilli, Leo... Ee Perukal kettu koritharikkatha cinema aaswadhakar kuravayirikkum. Loki ennu aaradhakar vilikunna Lokesh Kanagarajinte thalayil virinja Massum Classum Othinangiya ee kadhapathrangal Indian Cinemayude Box Officine thiruthi ezhuthunna kazhchakal naam kandu. Iniyum kaanan irikkunnu. Aa sahacharyathil thanneyanu Lokeshinte LCU valiya charchayavunnath. Enthanu LCU. Engane aanu athu roopam kondath. Enthayirikkum athinte bhaavi. Etharathil aanu Lokesh ithine design cheythittullath. Kelkkam ee Bytesilude.

உன்னத--உறவுகள்.title: Unnadha Uravugal
உன்னத--உறவுகள்.description: Innaikku namma elarum personal life la athigama pesurathu "the pure relationship" pathi dhan. yedhu pure relationship? kelunga puriyum!!

management-lessons-from-iconic-brands-of.title: Management Lessons from Iconic Brands of India
management-lessons-from-iconic-brands-of.description: ನಾವು ಯಾವುದೇ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ವಾಗ ಮೊದಲು ನೋಡೋದು ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಯಾವುದು ಅಂತಾ.. ಆದ್ರೆ ಇವತ್ತು ಫೇಮಸ್ ಆಗಿರುವ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ಸ್  ಶುರುವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಸ್ಕ್ರ್ಯಾಚ್ ಮೂಲಕವೇ. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಭಾರತದ ಯಾವ್ಯಾವ ಬ್ರ್ಯಾಂಡ್ಸ್ ಹೇಗೆ ಶುರುವಾದ್ವು? ಅದರ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಥೆಗಳೇನು? ಆ ಮೂಲಕ ನಾವು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳೋ ಪಾಠವೇನು? ಈ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ತಿಳಿಯೋಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ 'Management lessons from iconic brands of India' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

bokya-satbande-part-9.title: Bokya Satbande - Part 9
bokya-satbande-part-9.description: Step into a world of fun and learning with Kuku FM's children's stories. Our audiobooks are full of adventures and lessons about friendship courage and curiosity. They're perfect for young listeners making learning exciting and storytelling a joy. Listen now Kuku FM for stories that spark imagination and teach important values in a simple enjoyable way.

rabindra-nath-tagore.title: Rabindra Nath Tagore
rabindra-nath-tagore.description: "JAN GAN MAN" Hmara Rashtragaan hai ye ham sab jaante hain aur ye bhi jaante hain ki iske rachyita Mahan Rachnakaar Gurudev Rabindra Nath Tagore hain lekin kya aap men se kam hi log jaante honge ki Gurudev Tagore ek Zamidar pariwar se the.Aur unhen bachpan men kavitayen nhin pasand thin.Kya Aapko pata hai ki unhen Nobel Puraskaar Dilaane wali rachna Geetanjali Sabse pahle English men chhapi thi. Rabindra nath tagore ji ke jeewan ki aisi kai unjani baton ko aap tak ham unki biography ki audiobook ke madhyam se laaye hain.To chaliye, Jaante hain Mahakavi Tagore ji ko Aur kareeb se.

murder-at-the-mushaira.title: Murder At The Mushaira
murder-at-the-mushaira.description: Sabki madad karne ko hamesha tayar  Ghalib yoon toh peshe se shayar hain, lekin qatl ke ek maamle ne unhe jasoos bana diya. Kotwal Chainsukh Ko hai khooni ki talaash. Kya Mirza apne dimaag aur soch ke balboote par kar payenge is khatarnak murder mystery ko solve? Jaanne ke liye sunte rahiye Kuku FM…

chennai-pattinam.title: Chennai Pattinam
chennai-pattinam.description: Vanakkam Vaazhavaikkum Chennai ah pathina swaarasyamaana pala vishayangal intha pathivula irukku. Chennai oru oor ila athu oru emotion nu intha pathivu namakku kandippa unarthum.

ashtavakra-gita-the-man-who-saw-beyond-r.title: Ashtavakra Gita: The Man Who Saw Beyond Reality
ashtavakra-gita-the-man-who-saw-beyond-r.description: सब कुछ पाने के बाद भी बेचैन राजा जनक की मुलाकात युवा ऋषि अष्टावक्र से होती है, जो उसे उसके विचारों, इच्छाओं, रिश्तों, पहचान और अहंकार पर सवाल उठाने के लिए मजबूर करते हैं—और अंततः उसे एहसास होता है कि जिस मुक्ति की वह पूरी जिंदगी तलाश करता रहा, वह कभी उससे दूर थी ही नहीं।

antha-or-iravu.title: Antha Or Iravu
antha-or-iravu.description: ஒரு நாள் ராத்திரி சரவணன் தன்னோட காதலி காயத்ரிய பார்க்க அவளோட வீட்டுக்கு போறான். ரெண்டு பேரும் சந்தோஷமா இருக்காங்க. காலைல எழுந்து பார்த்தா, காயத்ரி செத்துப் போய் கெடக்கறா. சரவணன போலீஸ் அர்ரெஸ்ட் செய்யறாங்க. காயத்ரிய கொலை செஞ்சது யாரு? சரவணனா இல்ல வேற யாராவதா?

chandrakanta-2.title: Chandrakanta
chandrakanta-2.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

big-magic-creative-living-beyond-fear.title: Creative Kasa Vahave
big-magic-creative-living-beyond-fear.description: Creativity hi fakta eka kalakaratach nasta. Ek teacher sudha creative asu shakte. Tumhi shodhyala gela tar Pratyek mansat mhanje tumchat majhat aplya saglyat creativity dadleli ahe fakta ti baher kadahychi deri ahe. ani yachsathi amhi gheun alo ahot Creativty chya shodhat ha khas show.

mission-moon.title: Mission Moon
mission-moon.description: இது இந்தியாவோட 🇮🇳 நிலவுப் பயணம் 🌕 பற்றிய ஒரு Docu-Drama 🎥. ஒரு High Budget படம் தயாரிக்க ஆகுற செலவ விட கம்மியான Budget ல நம்ம நாடு 🌍 நிலவைத்தொட்ட 🚀 சாதனைச் சரித்திரத்தை 📜 ஒரு கதை போல கேட்கலாம் வாங்க.. ✨

ayodhya-2.title: Ayodhya
ayodhya-2.description: 1992 mein Babri Masjid ke girte hi Bhartiya rajneeti mein ek naya badlav aaya. Sare samikaran teji se badle aur log vote bank ke hisab se sahi aur galat ko dekhne lage. Lal Krishna Advani ki rath-yatra se shuru hua ye safar aaj kahan ja kar pahuncha hai, ye hum sab jante hi hain. Par kya the us samay ke halat? Kin ghatnaon ke chalte bheed swayam apne netaon ki pakad se bhi bahar chali gayi? Janne ke liye sunein, Ayodhya...

மகுடபதி.title: Magudapathi
மகுடபதி.description: Amarar kalki ezhuthiya puthinangalul sirappaanathu, 'magudapathi'. Thiruppumunaigal niraintha suvarasyamaana kathai. Kaathapaaththirangalai arumaiyaaga seuthukki nam kan munne alaiya vittiruppaar. Rasigargalin manam kavarntha sirappaana naaval, magudapathiyai kuku fm-l kelungal...

how-to-become-an-air-hostess.title: How to become an Air Hostess
how-to-become-an-air-hostess.description: Aaj ke samay mein har kisi ko career ki chinta hoti hai. Lekin ek golden opportunity hai jo 12th pass ke criteria par bhi aapko luxurious life de sakti hai. Bas dikkat ye hai ki is field mein entry kaise karein ye hum mein se zyadatar log nahi jaante. Toh aaiye is field ke bare mein is show mein detail mein samjhein.

kesavante-vilapangal.title: കേശവന്റെ വിലാപങ്ങള്‍
kesavante-vilapangal.description: സര്‍ക്കാന്‍ ഓഫീസില്‍ ക്ലാര്‍ക്കായി ജോലി ചെയ്യുന്ന കേശവന്‍, അപ്പുക്കുട്ടന്റെ വിലാപങ്ങള്‍ എന്ന നോവല്‍ എഴുതുന്നതും അയാള്‍ അനുഭവിക്കുന്ന സംഘര്‍ഷങ്ങളുമാണ് എം മുകുന്ദന്റെ ഈ നോവലിന്റെ ഇതിവൃത്തം. ഇ.എം.എസ് കേശവന്റെ നോവലിലെ കേന്ദ്രകഥാപാത്രമായി എത്തുന്നു.

paadey-the-house-of-dead.title: Paadey: The House of Dead
paadey-the-house-of-dead.description:
హైదరాబాద్‌లో ఫోరెన్సిక్ డాక్టర్‌గా పని చేసే అభిరామ్ రెడ్డి, తన తండ్రి మృతి తర్వాత కడపకు తిరిగి వస్తాడు. కుటుంబ సొంతంగా నడుపుతున్న శ్మశానవాటిక లో అనుమానాస్పద పరిస్థితుల్లో తండ్రి శవం చలించటం, “నన్ను వారికిచ్చేను, ఎవ్వరిని నమ్మకూడదు” అనే మాటలతో మొదలవుతుంది ఒక భయంకరమైన ప్రయాణం.

ఈ శ్మశానవాటిక faction హత్యలు, రాజకీయ హత్యలు, క్రిమినల్ కవర్-అప్స్ కోసం ఉపయోగించబడుతోంది. కానీ అభి ఒక్కసారి లోతుగా దర్యాప్తు చేస్తే, అతడి తండ్రిని అవయవాల కోసం చంపారని తెలుస్తుంది. ఇది కేవలం ఓ మాఫియా కథ కాదు – ఇది ఆత్మల పోరు, శాపాల ఒడిలో మానవత్వం పడే పోరాటం.

అవయవ మాఫియా, faction రాజకీయాలు, తాంత్రిక శాపం, ఆత్మల సహాయంతో న్యాయం కోసం చేస్తున్న పోరాటం — ఇవన్నీ కలసి భయానకమైన, ఉద్వేగభరితమైన, ఊహించని మలుపులతో కూడిన కథగా తయారవుతుంది.

ponon-gombe.title: പൊനോന്‍ ഗോംബെ
ponon-gombe.description: ഭീകരവിരുദ്ധപോരാട്ടത്തിന്റെ പേരില്‍ അധിനിവേശസേന നടത്തുന്ന ക്രൂര പീഡനങ്ങള്‍ക്ക് ഇരയാകേണ്ടിവരുന്ന ആഫ്രിക്കന്‍ജനതയുടെ കഥ. സൊമാലിയയിലെ  മത്സ്യബന്ധനത്തൊഴിലാളിയായ സുലൈമാന്‍ ഭീകരാക്രമണത്തിന്റെ പേരില്‍ അമേരിക്കന്‍ പട്ടാളത്തിന്റെ തടവിലാകുന്നതും തുടര്‍ന്ന് നേരിടേണ്ടിവരുന്ന പീഡനപരമ്പരകളുമാണ് നോവലില്‍ പറയുന്നത്.

diamonds-stones.title: Diamonds & Stones
diamonds-stones.description:
அருணா ஒரு மர்ம கும்பலால் கடத்தப்படுகிறாள். ஏன்? எதற்காக? 
அவளின் பைலட் கனவு நிறைவேறுமா?

vyas-and-umesh-chandra.title: Vyas and Umesh Chandra
vyas-and-umesh-chandra.description: Reel life lo heros ni chusi manam greate ani abhimanistham. Criminals nundi police lu shatru deshala nundi kapadutunna sainikula gurinchi manam anthaga gurthupettukomu, kani nijamiana hero lu veere. Chattanni, nyayanni kapaduthu samajam kosam ashuvulu basina Umesh chandra, vyas vanti  kondari real heros gurinchi ee audio book lo manam telusukundam

krushnakath.title: Krushnakath
krushnakath.description: Step into the lives of remarkable people with our Biography genre. From entrepreneurs who changed the world to artists who inspired generations these stories are about real-life heroes and their journeys. Learn from their challenges successes and the lessons they share. Perfect for anyone who loves true stories of grit creativity and determination. Listen now KUKU FM for these inspiring narratives and discover the paths they carved in history.

mouna-yuddham.title: மௌன யுத்தம்
mouna-yuddham.description:
ரகுராம், ஒரு இக்கட்டான சூழ்நிலையில் இழந்த தன் காதலை மீட்டு எடுக்கிறான். 
ஜான்வி அதே இக்கட்டான சூழ்நிலையில் ரகுவின் வாழ்வில் வருகிறாள்.
இருவரிடையே நிகழும் காதல் கலந்த போர் - “மௌன யுத்தம்”

how-to-handle-the-stress-and-pressure-1.title: How to handle the Stress and Pressure?
how-to-handle-the-stress-and-pressure-1.description: ಈ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸದೇ ಇರೋದು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಅದು ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಮಾತ್ರ...! ಈ ಸತ್ಯ ಗೊತ್ತಿದ್ದರೂ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗುವ ಸಣ್ಣ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆಲೂ ತುಂಬಾ ಒತ್ತಡವನ್ನು ತಾಳುತ್ತೇವೆ..! ಅದು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿರಲಿ, ಕೆಟ್ಟ ವಿಚಾರವಾಗಿರಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲಕ್ಕೂ ಒತ್ತಡವೊಂದು ಅಂತಿಮ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಅನ್ನುವಂತಾಗಿದೆ..! ಇದರ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲವೇ BP, ಶುಗರ್ ಇತ್ಯಾದಿ ಕಾಯಿಲೆಗಳು! ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ನೀವು ಇದರಿಂದ ದೂರವಾಗಬೇಕೆಂದರೆ, ಒತ್ತಡ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೆಶರ್ ನಿಭಾಯಿಸಲು ಕಲಿಯಬೇಕು. ಆದರೆ ಹೇಗೆ??? ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನಿಮ್ಮ KuKuFMನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿದೆ, ಕೇಳಿ 'ಹೌ ಟು ಹ್ಯಾಂಡಲ್ ಸ್ಟ್ರೆಸ್ ಆಂಡ್ ಪ್ರೆಶರ್' ಆಡಿಯೋಬುಕ್.

satyajit-ray-the-maestro-of-indian-cinem.title: Satyajit Ray: The Maestro of Indian Cinema
satyajit-ray-the-maestro-of-indian-cinem.description: A young man caught between his mother’s expectations and his burning desire to become a filmmaker chooses a path filled with heartbreak, rejection and financial hardship. When producers refuse to back his first film, he risks his savings and everything he has to bring his vision to life. Against all odds, *Pather Panchali* goes on to change the course of Indian cinema. This is the story of Satyajit Ray—the man who refused to compromise on his dream and became a legend.

right-under-your-nose.title: Right Under Your Nose
right-under-your-nose.description:
Ek aurat ka accident, ek scientist ka din ke ujale mein qatl — phir bhi, koi qatil nahi dekha gaya.

Ek badi khoj ke daayre mein scientists ek-ek karke rahasyaatmak taur par maare ja rahe hain.

Superintendent Vijay, maahir detective, apne dushmano ki chaalon mein phans chuka hai. Bharosa toot chuka hai, jab tak journalist Padmini uski zindagi mein nahi aati.

Ab Vijay ki tezi aur Padmini ki soojh-boojh ko bhidna hai ek dikhayi na dene wale genius se, jo saboot unki aankhon ke saamne mita raha hai.

Darr aur dhokha se bhare shahar mein, Vijay, Dalvi, aur Padmini ke paas sirf ek hafta hai — qatil ko dhundne ka... ya sachchai samajhne ka!

leela-1.title: Leela
leela-1.description: In a small town in Rajasthan, a baby is born—but not 'son', not 'daughter'—her own father wants to bury alive. While her mother's love saves her, but the truth couldn't stay hidden forever! Thrown out of her home, Leela ends up as a sex worker in a brothel. But she fights her fate, taking a stranger's place as a bride... in a new family that has no idea who she really is. Will she find love, or just another betrayal? How long can her secret stay buried?

4d5e70a4-c96c-43d3-a85c-a12c1384c827.title: Sahi Nirnay Kaise Liya Jaye: Buddh Ka Gyan
4d5e70a4-c96c-43d3-a85c-a12c1384c827.description: Kya Bhagwan Buddha ke paas thi koi divya shakti? Jaane kaise ek choti si kahani badal sakti hai aapki soch aur decision-making capacity.

detective-ajay.title: Detective Ajay - Hard to Hide
detective-ajay.description: ఒక చోట హత్య జరిగిన వెంటనే పోలీసులు హంతకుడిని పట్టుకోవడానికి చాలా చురుగ్గా పని చేసి హంతకుడిని పట్టుకొని కేసు సాల్వ్ చేస్తారు, కానీ ఒక హత్య పోలీస్ వారికి కూడా అంతు చిక్కనిది అలాంటి హత్యను డిటెక్టివ్ అజయ్ ఎలా చేదించబోతున్నాడు అసలు హత్యకు గురైన వారు ఎవరు .. తెలుసుకోండి ఈ మీ డిటెక్టివ్ అజయ్ షో లో

insaniyat-2.title: Insaniyat
insaniyat-2.description: Immerse yourself in the boundless possibilities of fiction on Kuku FM. Our diverse range of stories from contemporary life to speculative futures offers something for every listener. Engage with complex characters and compelling narratives that reflect challenge and entertain. Whether you seek laughter tears or thought-provoking themes our fiction category is your gateway to myriad worlds.

apna-financial-iq-badhaayen.title: Increase Your Financial IQ
apna-financial-iq-badhaayen.description: Rich Dad Poor Dad” se liabilities ko kaise asset mein badlein yeh to aapne samajh liya lekin stock market mein paise doobne se ya bachat karne ke bawjood bhi hone wale loss se apne aap ko kaise bachaayenge? Isiliye zaroori hai ki aap apne financial IQ ko badha lein taki financial turbulence se bach sakein . Par yeh kaise karna hai? Iske liye aapko humari yeh audiobook sunni padegi. To chaliye Financial IQ ko badhaane ki study ko shuru karte hain.

mithigalannu-meeri-meleru-asadarana-mahi.title: Mithigalannu Meeri Meleru: Asadarana Mahileyara Kathegalu
mithigalannu-meeri-meleru-asadarana-mahi.description: ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ  ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು ಬಡತನ, ಲಿಂಗ ತಾರತಮ್ಯ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯ ಅಡಚಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಟಿ ಹೊಸ ಮಾರ್ಕ್  ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅವರು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ, ಕಲೆ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜಸೇವೆ ಹೀಗೆ ಹಲವು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮ ಗುರುತನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.ಇಂತಹ ಕಥೆಗಳು ಜನರಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯನ್ನು ಕೊಡುತ್ತವೆ , ಸಮಾನತೆಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದಿನ ತಲೆಮಾರಿನ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರಲ್ಲಿ ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸವನ್ನು ಬಿತ್ತುವ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮಹಿಳಾ ಸಾಧಕಿಯರ ಕಥೆ ತಿಳ್ಕೊಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಕೇಳಿ "ಮಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿ ಮೇಲೇರು: ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರ ಕಥೆಗಳು" ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಕು FM ಅಲ್ಲಿ.

ammacchi-yemba-nenapu.title: Ammacchi Yemba Nenapu
ammacchi-yemba-nenapu.description: "ಅಮ್ಮಚ್ಹಿ ಎಂಬ ನೆನಪು"ವಿಜಯನಗರದ ನಾಡಿನ ನೆನಪಿನ ಅಲೆಮಳೆಯಾದ ಕತೆ. ವೈದೇಹಿ ಅವರ ಈ ಕಾದಂಬರಿಯು ಅಜ್ಜಿಯ ಪಾತ್ರದ ಮೂಲಕ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಬದುಕು, ಸಂಬಂಧಗಳ ಭಾವನಾತ್ಮಕ ಲಹರಿ, ಮತ್ತು ತಾಯಿತನದ ಪವಿತ್ರತೆಯನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಜ್ಜಿಯ ಪಾತ್ರವು ಜೀವನದ ಸಾರಿ, ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದ ಜೀವನದ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಆಕೆಯ ಸಾರ್ಥಕ ಬದುಕುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಧಾರಿತವಾಗಿದೆ. ಈ ಕೃತಿ ಆಳವಾದ ಭಾವನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸುವಂತದ್ದು, ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಅಂತರಂಗದ ಆವಿಷ್ಕಾರವು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮವಾಗಿ ಮೂಡಿಬಂದಿದೆ. "ಅಮ್ಮಚ್ಹಿ ಎಂಬ ನೆನಪು" ಕಾದಂಬರಿ ಓದುಗರ ಹೃದಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಟ್ಟುವಂತೆ ತಾಯಂದಿರ ನಿಜವಾದ ಭಾವನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿದೆ.

odishare-prakruti-parjyatana.title: Odishare Prakruti Parjyatana
odishare-prakruti-parjyatana.description: Dive into the world of Non-Fiction with Kuku FM where real stories and groundbreaking ideas come to life. Our collection spans intriguing topics from history and science to culture and personal development. Perfect for the curious minds looking to understand the world and themselves better. listen now Kuku FM for a dose of reality that educates inspires and entertains.

the-war-in-vietnam.title: The War In Vietnam
the-war-in-vietnam.description: The Vietnam War was a defining moment in American history, a conflict that continues to evoke strong emotions and memories among Americans to this day. The war had far-reaching consequences, both for the United States and for Vietnam, and its legacy continues to be felt around the world. In this audio show, we will explore the Vietnam War in depth, from its origins and causes to its impact on American society. We will examine the strategies and tactics used by both sides, the key battles and turning points of the war, and the political and social forces that shaped its outcome. Join us on this journey through one of the most pivotal events of the 20th century, and gain a deeper understanding of the forces that shaped the modern world.

oil-power-and-war.title: Oil, Power And War
oil-power-and-war.description: The story of oil is one of luck, betrayal, and devastation. It is the story of a resource that has been undeniably central to the formation of our modern culture. Oil has become the most critical component of economic, military, and political power over the last 150 years. And it has led us to the current situation, in which political leaders and the fossil-fuel industry present dangerous policies on a global stage marked by shifting power bases. Get on this spectacular and eye-opening journey as we explore the impact of the 'Black Gold' in our lives and wonder what the future holds as the race to control the last of the world’s easily and cheaply extractable reserves becomes increasingly desperate.

how-to-start-career-as-a-freelancer.title: How to Start Career as a Freelancer
how-to-start-career-as-a-freelancer.description: Oru Freelancer raa work panradhukku neenga seyya vendiya 9 mukkiyamaana steps & freelancer raa career start panna poravangaluku ku vara koodiya adippadaiyaana doubts kaana answers  indha audio book la irukku ! Kelunga, freelanceraa unga career ra start pannunga.

autobiography-of-a-yogi-4.title: Autobiography of a Yogi
autobiography-of-a-yogi-4.description: Apple company CEO 'Steve Jobs' Indha book ka thannoda Favourite book nu solraaru. Ulagin Thalai Sirandha Aanmeega Puthagam nu Indha Book ka neraya per solraanga ! Neraya Celebrities Indha Book ka recommend Panraanga !  Apdi Enna Thaan Irukku Indha Book la ?, Vaanga Indha Summary la adha Therinjukalaam.

pakistani-corpse-rapist.title: Pakistani Darinde
pakistani-corpse-rapist.description: Pakistan ke kai kabristaon mein kabron se bahar nikaal kar kai murda ladkiyon ke rapes ne pure desh ko hilakar rakh diya. Kaun hain ye darinde,kya ye kisi ek shaksh ka kaam hai ya iske peeche hai poora giroh. Kya hai iske peeche ki poori kahani jaaniye sirf KUKU FM par.

vayuputra-pramanam.title: Vayuputra Pramanam
vayuputra-pramanam.description: Vayuputra Pramanam idi Amish Tripathi rasina 3 dava Pusthakam, Shivudu gurinchi varu chesina yuddham gurinchi indulo klishtamaga undhi, Inkenduku mari late Ventane ee goppa audio book ni vinandi.

auto-shankar-mix-episodes.title: Love Lust & Murder: Auto Shankar
auto-shankar-mix-episodes.description: Chennai mein kai saalon tak Gauri Shankar urf Auto Shankar ke naam se log kaanp uthte the. Movies mein hero nahi villan se inspire hone wala Auto Shankar, paise ke lalach mein pyar ka jaal bun kar, kaise apne pyar ko ek khunkhar anjaam deta tha. Kaise usne ek bar nahi, do bar nahi, balki kai bar is darindgi ko anjaam diya, sunein Love, Lust & Murder: Auto Shankar mein.

sundarboner-bonbibi-rohosyo.title: Sundarboner Bonbibi Rohosyo
sundarboner-bonbibi-rohosyo.description: Sundarbon Onchole Ek Debike Hindu-Muslim Dui Somprodayer Lok Pujo Koren, Keu Bolen Bono Debi Aabar Keu Bolen Bono Bibi. Tar Utpottir Pichhone Lukiye Ek Rohosyojonok Itihas. Rohosye Mora Ei Bono Debi Ba Bono Bibir Somporke Jante Aapnake Shuntei Hobe Ei Audio Show.

operation-trident-the-night-karachi-burn.title: Operation Trident - The Night Karachi Burned
operation-trident-the-night-karachi-burn.description: On 3 December 1971, Pakistan attacked Indian airbases. But an Indian naval response was already waiting in the Arabian Sea. Under the cover of darkness, three missile boats moved towards Karachi with a dangerous mission: strike deep inside enemy waters. When their targets appeared on radar, the Indian Navy launched its missiles. Karachi's harbour erupted in flames. This is the story of Operation Trident—the audacious attack that shook Pakistan's naval power during the 1971 war.

third-eye.title: Third Eye
third-eye.description: कॉलेज जाने वाली एक लड़की के हैं अपने अलग शौक पर घरवालों के डर से बदल लेती है अपना अवतार। सुनें सत्तू के डिटेक्टिव "कुमार सात्यकि" बनने का सफर सिर्फ Kuku FM पर।

Vishwamitra-देवताओं-पर-भारी-मनुष्य-.title: Vishwamitra: देवताओं पर भारी मनुष्य
Vishwamitra-देवताओं-पर-भारी-मनुष्य-.description: Ek din Swarg mein Indra ki sabha chal rahi thi ki tabhi unke swarg ke samne ek naye swarg ka nirman hone laga. Is naye swarg ke nirmata the brahnmrishi Vishwamitra. Wahi Vishwamitra jinki tapasya apsara Menka ne bhang karne ki koshish ki thi. Kya wo aisa karne mein safal ho payi thi? Aur kya aap jante hain, Vishwamitra ek Rishi banne se pahle ek mahan pratapi raja the. Wo kaise ek rishi se ek raja bane, ye janne ke liye suniye hamara ye show..

behind-the-business-arun-icecreams.title: Behind The Business - Arun Icecreams
behind-the-business-arun-icecreams.description: ஒரு சாதாரண பால் நிறுவனமாகத் தொடங்கி, தமிழ்நாட்டின் மிகவும் பிரபலமான ஐஸ்கிரீம் பிராண்டாக அருண் ஐஸ்கிரீம்ஸ் எப்படி வளர்ந்தது? இந்த நிகழ்ச்சி, அந்த பிராண்டின் பின்னணிக் கதை, வளர்ச்சி, விநியோக வலையமைப்பு மற்றும் வெற்றியின் ரகசியங்களை ஆராய்கிறது. ஒரு ஐஸ்கிரீம் ஸ்கூப்பின் பின்னால் இருக்கும் மிகப்பெரிய வணிகப் பயணத்தை அறிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள்.

blades-of-the-old-empire.title: Blades of the Old Empire
blades-of-the-old-empire.description: When Prince Kythar falls under attack in his own castle he has no idea that his enemies are none other than the ancient Kaddim Brotherhood plotting to destroy his royal line. His inborn ability to control the elements is the only power that can stop this plot—but there is one problem. Kyth's fighting skills are no match for the Kaddim leaving him no time to put his magic to work. To defeat the Kaddim Kyth must rely on his bodyguard Kara a beautiful Diamond-ranked assassin from the elite Majat Guild. But his enemies develop an elaborate plan to remove her from their way. Acting through treachery and scheming they pitch Kara against the Majat marking her as a target for the only warrior who can defeat her in battle. With the deadly assassin on their trail Kythar and Kara must face impossible odds to save the kingdom and their lives.

sam-manekshaw-vs-93000.title: Operation Vijay vs 93,000
sam-manekshaw-vs-93000.description: When the 1971 crisis pushes India to the brink of war, One Army Chief refuses to fight on emotion. Instead, he turns patience into strategy; training Mukti Bahini, preparing troops, navigating rivers and geopolitics, isolating Dhaka and breaking the enemy’s morale, until 93,000 Pakistani personnel are forced to surrender.

aandavan-kattalai.title: Aandavan kattalai
aandavan-kattalai.description: கோடீஸ்வர தொழிலதிபர் தேவராஜ், தன் மகனின் காதலி ரூபி உண்மையாகக் காதலிக்கிறாளா அல்லது குடும்பத்தின் செல்வத்தை குறிவைக்கிறாளா என்பதை அறிய சாதாரண மனிதராக வாழ்கிறார். ஆனால் ரூபி வீட்டின் பழைய ரகசியத்தைத் தேடத் தொடங்கியதும், அபிஷேக்குடன் சேர்ந்து நடக்கும் சதியின் பின்னணி வெளிவருகிறது. மகனை காப்பாற்ற தேவராஜ் மறைந்த உண்மையை வெளிக்கொணர வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்தில் சிக்குகிறார்.

gulf-malayalis-paradise.title: Gulf: Malayali's Paradise
gulf-malayalis-paradise.description: Malayaliyude swargam thanneyanu Gulf rajyangal ennu nissamshayam parayan sadhikkum. Naattil muzhu pattiniyilum kadathilum jeevitham thallineekkunna oro kudumbavum Gulf enna swapnam kanunnu. Chilarkkenkilum arbhadathinte lokamalla Gulf rajyangal marichu jeevikkanulla avasanathe kachithirumbanu.

positive-thinking-11.title: Positive Thinking
positive-thinking-11.description: Manushyamanassinte apaara shakthikaleyum vijayathilekkulla paathakaleyum velippeduthunna Nalpoleon Hillinte kaalatheetha krithiyanu 'Positive Thinking'. Nammude chinthakal nammude jeevithathe roopappeduthunnu enna shakthamaya aashayathe adisthanamaaki, vijayam aakarshikkanulla thanthrangal ee pusthakam avatharippikkunnu. Manassinte shakthiye kurichum vijayathilekkula paathayile velluvilikaleyum athijeevikkunathinulla thanthrangale kurichum aagadhamaaya arivu nalkunna ee pusthakam jeevithathinte ella mekhalakalilum vijayam nedan aagrahikkunavark upakaarapradhamanu.

sunkar-dekho-somnath-mandir.title: Sunkar Dekho : Somnath Mandir
sunkar-dekho-somnath-mandir.description: Har-har Mahadev! Aap sabhi ko aamantrit karte hain Kuku FM ki iss vishesh peshkash mein, jahan hum aapko Somnath Mandir ke alaukik vatavaran mein le chalenge aur prakritik dhwani aur hamare guide ke vivaran se aapko Mahadev ke darshan karayenge. Saath hi Somnath Mandir ke aitihasik aur dharmik mahatva ke baare mein bhi batayenge. To judiye hamare saath aur anubhav kijiye is divya yatra ko. Har-har Mahadev!

seven.title: Seven
seven.description: Seven friends arrive on a private island to celebrate a pre-wedding party, where the mysterious billionaire Viraj Malhotra welcomes them with unmatched luxury. The next morning, one of them is found murdered, and Viraj announces a deadly game called "The Last Circle." For the next seven days, they must fight to survive, as only the last person alive will earn freedom. As the game unfolds, Dev uncovers the truth and confronts the sinister conspiracy behind the game.

piravi-20.title: Piravi 2.0
piravi-20.description: தந்தையை காப்பாற்ற முடியாத குற்ற உணர்வுடன் தனிமையில் இறக்கும் ஜான்சனுக்கு, மரணம் ஒரு அதிசயமான இரண்டாவது வாய்ப்பைத் தருகிறது. 25 ஆண்டுகள் பின்னோக்கி சென்று மீண்டும் சிறுவனாக விழித்தெழும் அவன், இம்முறை தந்தையின் வாழ்க்கையை மாற்றவும், கடந்த காலத் துயரங்களைத் தடுக்கவும், பணத்தை விட குடும்பத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும் முடிவு செய்கிறான்.

bike-repair-service-zero-se-malik-tak.description: Bike Repair & Service - Zero Se Malik Tak

cf810edb-ede6-4a0d-b15b-3af9509d0df8.title: My Sister Stole My Billionaire Groom
cf810edb-ede6-4a0d-b15b-3af9509d0df8.description: Betrayed by her own sister, Ellie Whitmore loses the love she believed was hers. Damian Vale, the man she loved, becomes the source of her deepest heartbreak, while Vivienne’s manipulations shatter her world. As Ellie struggles to rebuild her life, Sebastian Mercer enters the picture, revealing a love that has waited two years for a second chance. Torn between painful memories and a new beginning, Ellie must learn to trust again, choose herself, and discover what real love truly means.

eab09266-edf2-4041-8a95-766402523bcd.title: My Sister Claimed My Billionaire Husband

0d3226f2-3e70-4555-bfdb-931c948c31a8.title: Arambha : The Birth of Vijayanagara
0d3226f2-3e70-4555-bfdb-931c948c31a8.description: சுல்தானின் சிறைப்பிடிப்பில் இருந்து தப்பித்து, தென்னிந்தியாவில் ஒரு பிரம்மாண்டமான பேரரசை உருவாக்கிய இரு சகோதரர்களின் எழுச்சிமிகு வரலாற்று கதை. கைதிகளாக இருந்து பெரும் ஆட்சியாளர்களாக அவர்கள் உருவெடுத்த வீர வரலாற்றை இந்த பகுதி விவரிக்கிறது.

a45842aa-2133-4e67-ace6-e5a636c320cd.title: The Rickshaw Driver is my King

a0a9ae3c-61ff-41e5-912f-2c029a9d9fa7.title: The last promise to my brother (Hindi)

ea062234-5428-43d3-99d5-ec88f0d805aa.title: Mirchi Mahal
ea062234-5428-43d3-99d5-ec88f0d805aa.description: జానకికి గుంటూరులోని శక్తివంతమైన వ్యాపార సామ్రాజ్య వారసుడైన కళ్యాణ్‌తో బలవంతంగా పెళ్లి జరుగుతుంది. అతని నమ్మకద్రోహానికి బలై, తన బిడ్డను కోల్పోయి, తాను కూడా చావు అంచుల వరకు వెళ్తుంది. జానకి చనిపోయిందని అందరూ భావించినా, ఆమె శివ సాయంతో కొత్త గుర్తింపుతో తిరిగి వచ్చి తనను మోసం చేసిన వారిపై పోరాటం మొదలుపెడుతుంది. తండ్రి గౌరవాన్ని నిలబెట్టి, శత్రువుల సామ్రాజ్యాన్ని కూల్చే ఈ ప్రయాణంలో జానకి ప్రేమను కూడా కనుగొంటుందా?

dumped-for-a-richer-man-married-a-billio.title: Dumped for a Richer Man, Married a Billionaire (German)

legacy.title: Legacy
legacy.description: When an impoverished hotel waiter discovers that the signet ring left by his murdered father is the supreme underworld seal Rajamudra, he is thrust into a forced marriage and a multi-layered gangland conspiracy—only to realize that his legendary father is still alive and orchestrating every betrayal to forge him into a ruthless successor. After defeating that legacy, Deepak learns the ring holds ancient powers that can protect or destroy the world beyond his city.

kiss-of-the-cursed-crown.title: KISS OF THE CURSED CROWN
kiss-of-the-cursed-crown.description: Princess Scarlett, the true heir imprisoned in Bellafonte’s frozen royal tower, must escape the regent who steals her life to make Catherine’s biological daughter, Scarlett’s stepsister, a false queen and learn that safety, love, and a future are worth more than revenge.

hiring-a-husband.title: Hiring a Husband
hiring-a-husband.description: When Ananaya Menon a Kochi business heiress is given thirty days to marry or surrender control of her father's empire to her ruthless cousin, she offers Arun Sreedharan a debt-ridden Mattancherry delivery boy fifty lakh to become her husband. But a blackmailing housekeeper, a family determined to expose them, and a love neither expected turn their carefully priced arrangement into a fight for her company, his dignity and a future together.

the-revenge-saga-shikhandi.title: The Revenge Saga: Shikhandi
the-revenge-saga-shikhandi.description: On the tenth day of the Mahabharata war, Bhishma faces Shikhandi, a warrior driven by vengeance from a forgotten past. Once Amba, a princess whose life Bhishma shattered, she was betrayed by the man she loved and denied justice, so she vowed revenge even beyond death. Reborn as Shikhandi, she returns to make him answer for his past as Krishna guides Arjun towards Bhishma's only weakness, turning the battlefield into a reckoning of dharma, betrayal and revenge across lifetimes.

yeh-awarapan.title: Yeh Awarapan
yeh-awarapan.description: Deva Chauhan, an undercover operative infiltrating a Mumbai port drug and human trafficking cartel, seeks revenge for his father Raghav’s murder by kingpin Rudra “Katiyal Bhau.” He falls for Mohini, forced into trafficking to save her captive brother, Mohit. As betrayal and corruption close in, Deva fights to destroy the syndicate. In the final Sewri docks shootout, Mohini dies saving him, inspiring Deva to avenge her and dismantle Katiyal Bhau’s empire.

billionaires-quadruplet-trap-5.title: Quadrigêmeos do CEO
billionaires-quadruplet-trap-5.description: Cinco anos atrás, Clara Evans foi dopada e incriminada por uma socialite ciumenta. Hoje, ela comanda um café tradicional e querido no bairro e cria, em segredo, quadrigêmeos geniais. Até que o destino dá as cartas, literalmente: numa leitura de tarô na rua, o bilionário da tecnologia Damian Prescott descobre as crianças. Bem quando o prazo de sucessão do fundo da família ameaça sua cadeira de CEO. A saída dele? Uma proposta milionária para Clara. Mas será que tudo tem preço?

obsesion-prohibida.title: Obsesión Prohibida
obsesion-prohibida.description: Cuando una chica lista de pueblo se muda a la mansión de un magnate petrolero de Texas, debe sobrevivir a las rivales despiadadas de su escuela privada y a su obsesión prohibida por su hermanastro, la estrella del fútbol americano, antes de que una conspiración empresarial los destruya a los dos.

cole-y-buddy.title: Cole y Buddy
cole-y-buddy.description: Cole begins as a mocked street performer on the edge of eviction, with only his loyal companion Puppet keeping him going. A mysterious private offer from Victor Vane opens a path forward, and a viral breakthrough soon turns Cole and his singing dog Buddy into an overnight sensation. What starts as survival quickly becomes a fight over image, control, and whether Cole can stay authentic while the industry tries to package him. As studios, interviews, showcases, and bigger public events enter the picture, Mia, Vic Caine, and other industry figures help shape the act while repeatedly questioning Buddy’s place in it. Daisy arrives as a polished commercial rival, and her presence sharpens the pressure around branding, sponsorships, and replacement. Cole keeps insisting that Buddy belongs beside him, but executives and sponsors increasingly treat the dog as a distraction to be removed. The conflict spreads from public appearances into the home, where loyalty and belonging are tested by rivalry, punishment, and blame. Buddy is repeatedly left out, separated, or accused, even as allies try to defend him and expose the danger around Cole’s rising career. A series of backstage problems, equipment failures, and suspicious incidents push the story toward a larger crisis. Mia begins to suspect that the accidents are not random, and the tension around the tour and live performances keeps building. During a major live event, the production collapses into chaos, trapping Mia and putting a wounded dog in danger. In the aftermath, the dog is publicly celebrated as a hero, but the question of whether the collapse was accidental remains unresolved. That uncertainty deepens as Buddy is blamed again and threatened with removal, while Cole is pushed to choose between career stability and loyalty. Sponsor pressure grows harsher, with major money and tour opportunities tied to Buddy being excluded from the deal, the house, and the branding. Investigations into footage, contracts, footprints, and timestamps begin to point away from Buddy and toward a staged setup. The emotional stakes rise further when Cole’s father’s ashes and urn are damaged, turning the conflict into a personal wound as well as a professional one. By the end, Cole is still trapped between ambition, truth, and the people trying to control his future, while Buddy’s safety and place in his life remain at risk.

the-secret-king-revenge-of-betrayed-husb.title: EL REY SECRETO: LA VENGANZA DEL ESPOSO TRAICIONADO
the-secret-king-revenge-of-betrayed-husb.description: Steve Blackwell viaja a Hawái para sorprender a su esposa embarazada, Nancy, pero el sorprendido es él: Nancy tiene un amorío con Alex, el hombre que ahora controla el resort de ella. Alex no se conforma con quitarle a su mujer. Lo humilla sin piedad y destruye la corona que su familia ha guardado durante 300 años. Lo que ninguno de los dos sabe es quién es Steve en realidad, y muy pronto el mundo entero lo va a descubrir. ¿Pagarán caro su traición?

indrajalam.title: Indrajalam
indrajalam.description: When a mysterious street magician, David, enters the life of Rachel, a wealthy entrepreneur fighting to save her family’s jewellery empire, an unexpected romance blossoms. But as betrayal and powerful enemies threaten to destroy everything, David must use his extraordinary skills, intelligence, and secrets from his past to protect the woman he loves and reclaim her stolen legacy.

even-winners-pay-the-price-5.title: O Preço da Vitória
even-winners-pay-the-price-5.description: Esquecido no banco, um quarterback reserva ganha um poder sobrenatural antigo: dez passes perfeitos por dia. O problema é o preço: cada arremesso provoca uma dor nos nervos que pode destruir seu braço para sempre. Ele vai ter que contar com sua inteligência de jogo, descobrir o destino sombrio de quem usou esse poder antes e driblar um esquema de patrocinadores corruptos. A meta: levar um time azarão do Texas ao título estadual. Mas será que o braço dele aguenta até a final?

hijos-del-dragon.title: Hijos del Dragón
hijos-del-dragon.description: A mixed-heritage outsider is pulled from street-level hardship into the center of royal conflict after saving a cursed prince from a burning carriage. Her survival of his deadly touch creates a fate-bound connection that the court quickly turns into a political weapon. She is publicly humiliated, pressured into engagement and marriage bargaining, and then claimed by the prince as his wife and protector. That claim gives her some shield from harm, but it also makes her a target for nobles who resent her bloodline and status. Poison plots, court protocol, and repeated public trials become the main tools used to isolate or destroy her. The queen unexpectedly defends her, yet the palace remains divided over whether she belongs beside the prince. As the danger grows, magical signs reveal a deeper bond and a pregnancy that must be hidden for safety. The revelation that she carries three dragon heirs raises the stakes from personal survival to succession and legitimacy. Around her, other outsiders and mixed-blood fighters also face mockery, lethal trials, and attempts to erase their worth. Several of them answer with skill, law, or explosive hidden power, overturning elite expectations. The prince’s curse and the court’s succession crisis become intertwined, making his survival a matter of state. Evidence of poison and sabotage suggests a larger conspiracy tied to rival factions and ambitious nobles. The heroine repeatedly risks herself to save the prince, even absorbing poisoned fire at great cost. That sacrifice strengthens the bond between them and turns a temporary arrangement into something lasting. At the same time, enemies continue to target the unborn heirs, the prince’s claim, and anyone who supports the couple. The court’s attempts to control bloodline, rank, and inheritance keep failing, but the conflict never fully settles. By the end of the batch, the palace is still under threat, legitimacy is still contested, and the central pair must fight for survival, recognition, and the future of the royal line.

the-stormkeepers-revenge.title: The Stormkeeper’s Revenge
the-stormkeepers-revenge.description: The story unfolds in a coastal business world where storms, shipping deadlines, and hidden money keep turning routine trade into crisis. Early warnings about a massive storm suggest that the danger is not only weather, but also tied to older records and inherited knowledge. As the harbor and port come under pressure, business leaders scramble to protect shipments, contracts, and ownership before time runs out. Written terms become crucial, because several deals are challenged when people demand to know who really controls the company and what was promised. Hidden financing, especially Blackwater-backed money, deepens mistrust between partners and lovers and makes every agreement feel unstable. At the same time, outside investors and rivals try to take advantage of distressed boats, permits, and assets. The seafood supply chain becomes the center of the conflict, with shrimp, frozen goods, and harvest deliveries all threatened by weather, spoilage, and transport failures. Theo repeatedly fights to keep shipments moving, using cold trailers, ice, fuel, and emergency reroutes to prevent losses. Bo is also pushed to honor commitments while facing power failures, rising costs, and suspicion that something has been arranged behind the scenes. Cade acts as a persistent challenger, exposing questionable arrangements and pressing others about sabotage, insider knowledge, and hidden shipping plans. Alice becomes important as warning notes and direct interventions blur the line between sabotage and protection. Public confrontations over pricing, deadlines, and contract language turn private business disputes into open dockside battles. A Wall Street-style negotiator and local leaders clash over whether every clause should be read aloud before anyone signs. The pressure of flooded routes, quitting drivers, and damaged equipment makes the logistics crisis feel close to collapse. Even when a shipment is nearly lost underwater or trapped by a failed compressor, the characters keep forcing the operation forward. By the end of the batch, paperwork, deposits, and shipment proof become the final battleground. Order is only briefly restored when a risky delivery is approved, but the trust between the people involved remains badly damaged. The overall arc is about survival in business under storm pressure, where every contract, route, and secret can decide who keeps control.

even-winners-pay-the-price-4.title: Dix Lancers Parfaits
even-winners-pay-the-price-4.description: Dix lancers parfaits par jour. C'est ce que garantit l'ancien système surnaturel qui s'éveille chez un quarterback remplaçant de football américain, oublié sur le banc. Mais chaque lancer a un prix : une douleur nerveuse paralysante. Il devra compter sur son sens du jeu, percer le sombre destin de ceux qui ont eu ce pouvoir avant lui et déjouer de riches mécènes corrompus. Mènera-t-il une équipe texane d'outsiders au titre avant que son bras ne lâche pour de bon ?

guardian-angel-mom-on-the-move-3.title: Guardian Angel: Mom on the Move
guardian-angel-mom-on-the-move-3.description: Guardian Angel: Mom on the Move

jab-mila-tu.title: Jab Mila Tu
jab-mila-tu.description: Kashish, a hardworking waitress, is abandoned on her wedding day when fiancé Veer leaves her for heiress Tanya. When a hotel cleaner defends her, she impulsively marries him, unaware he is billionaire Armaan Raheja, the man she loved before an accident three years ago erased her memory. Bound by a seven-day marriage deal, they honeymoon at a luxury resort as Kashish falls for him again. But jealous rivals, his controlling mother and her returning memories threaten the truth Armaan is hiding.

agents-in-love-1.title: Agents In Love
agents-in-love-1.description: Nikhil and Keerthana enter an arranged marriage, unaware that both are undercover agents. As love blossoms between them, their secret missions collide, turning husband and wife into masked rivals.

the-last-larkin.title: The Last Larkin
the-last-larkin.description: Darius Larkin, a humble kitchen worker, secretly possesses the forbidden power to restore stolen and altered memories. As the last survivor of a family destroyed by Lucian Lorcan's syndicate, he enters the Grand Exhibition to uncover his past and protect the Vesper shop. Facing ruthless rivals and deadly trials, Darius unleashes his hidden abilities, exposes a citywide memory-tampering conspiracy, and fights to reclaim his identity and clear his family's name.

secret-don-1.title: Secret Don
secret-don-1.description:
A young woman’s carefully built life takes an unexpected turn when circumstances force her into a marriage she never imagined.  

What follows is a journey filled with danger, unexpected alliances, and secrets hiding in plain sight.  
But some truths are far more powerful than they first appear.

super-deluxe-returns.title: Super Deluxe Returns
super-deluxe-returns.description: மனைவியும் நண்பனும் செய்த துரோகத்தால், செய்யாத கொலைக்குச் சிறை செல்கிறான் ரமேஷ். அவர்களிடம் சிக்கிய மகளைக் காப்பாற்றத் தப்பிக்கும் அவனுக்கு ஒரு தெய்வ வரம்—பகலில் ரெஜினா, இரவில் ரமேஷ்! எதிரிகள் அடையாளம் காண முடியாத பெண் உருவத்தில் திரும்பும் அவன், துரோகிகளைப் பழிவாங்கி மகளை மீட்பானா?

jeeva-grandham.title: Jeeva Grandham
jeeva-grandham.description: Jeeva Grandham follows Gautham, a witty and unconventional Ayurvedic healer who inherits an ancient scripture containing extraordinary healing secrets. As he uses its knowledge to save lives in the modern medical world, he encounters professional rivalry, unexpected relationships, and mysterious challenges. However, the scripture's unique powers attract dangerous people who want to uncover its secrets, turning Gautham's journey into a battle to protect his inheritance.

naagamani-the-snake-crown.title: Naagamani: The Snake Crown
naagamani-the-snake-crown.description: அவனைக் காப்பாற்ற தன் நாகமணியையே கொடுத்தாள் நிலா… ஆனால் மகுடம் சூடியதும் வேறொருத்தியைத் தன் துணையாக அறிவிக்கிறான் வீரன்! உயிரைக் கொடுத்த காதலுக்குப் பரிசு, ஊரறிய அவமானமா? சக்திகள் குறைந்து மரணத்தை நெருங்கும் நிலா, அவனது துரோகத்தின் பின்னுள்ள உண்மையைத் தேடுகிறாள். மறுபுறம், மனித உலகை அழிக்கக் காத்திருக்கிறது ரகசிய நாகப் போர்! வீரனின் காதல் பொய்யா… இல்லை இந்தத் துரோகமே அவளைக் காப்பாற்றும் கவசமா?

daanveer-karna.title: Daanveer Karna
daanveer-karna.description: Born with divine powers but abandoned at birth, Karna fights all his life for the respect society denies him because of his birth. When Duryodhana honours him, Karna vows a loyalty that seals his fate, standing against his own brothers in the greatest war of his age. In his final moments, Lord Krishna guides him through the choices, curses and painful truths that shaped him. Danveer Karna is the tragic tale of a warrior whose greatest strength became his greatest weakness.

nidhi-4.title: Nidhi
nidhi-4.description: Shy freshman Nidhi, bullied by her influencer stepsister Swathi, auditions for the lead in the National Drama Festival to keep her scholarship. Meanwhile, Swathi’s boyfriend Vineeth, the student director, battles election rival Anand and must choose between commercial pressure and real talent as Nidhi fights for her dignity.

vishwamitra-ka-pratisodh.title: VISHWAMITRA KA PRATISODH
vishwamitra-ka-pratisodh.description: The story begins with Trishanku’s rejection from heaven, which drives Vishwamitra to vow that he will create a new heaven through the force of his own ascetic power. That ambition soon becomes entangled with the sacred cow Shabala, whose miraculous ability to feed an army makes her the center of a bitter struggle. Vishwamitra repeatedly demands Shabala, but Vashistha refuses every offer of wealth, cattle, gold, elephants, horses, and jewels, insisting that sacred power cannot be bought or owned. What starts as a dispute over possession grows into a larger conflict between royal force and spiritual authority. Shabala is treated not only as a miracle but also as a symbol of protection, loyalty, and the right to defend the home. The confrontation hardens into open warfare, with armies, archers, war elephants, and divine reinforcements entering the field. Amid the fighting, younger warriors and princes are forced to choose between retreat and honor, while family duty and grief deepen the emotional cost of the war. A wounded king’s final moments and the news of dead brothers push the conflict into tragedy and succession. The defeated ruler eventually transfers the kingdom to his son and withdraws to the Himalayas for penance. In parallel, Vishwarath continues the same struggle from another angle, seeking Shiva’s boon and mastery of Dhanurveda and divine weapons. Shiva grants him full knowledge of sacred warfare, and Vishwarath bows in reverence before immediately renewing his vow to surpass Vashistha. That rivalry escalates into destructive astras and battlefield devastation, with sacred spaces turned into war zones. Vashistha repeatedly stands firm to protect villagers, children, and other innocents from the violence. Vishwarath’s anger and hunger for revenge threaten to undo the value of his penance, even as he presses toward greater power. The conflict widens into a mythic struggle over Brahmastra-level force, mercy, and the limits of sacred ambition. By the end of the batch, the fallen ruler’s path turns toward severe penance and the hope of becoming a Brahma Rishi, while the central rivalry remains unresolved and dangerous.

secret-baby.title: My CEO made me Pregnant
secret-baby.description: My CEO made me Pregnant is a high-stakes romantic drama where powerful secrets, betrayal, and hidden identities collide as Leena, a brilliant tech genius, fights to reclaim her place and protect her unborn child. Amidst corporate wars and emotional chaos, she must expose lies, survive conspiracies, and stand against the man she once loved.

sauda-biwi-ka.title: Sauda Biwi Ka
sauda-biwi-ka.description: The episode opens at a public launch event where Avinash is forcibly restrained by guards and brutally humiliated by Sahil and Tanya in front of his wife, Shanaya, and her returning former flame, Zoravar. When Shanaya demands a subservient apology in exchange for taking him back, Avinash refuses to submit, even as Tanya crushes his fingers beneath her heel. A flashback reveals that five days prior, Avinash informed Daman that their five-year marriage arrangement had officially concluded. Realizing Shanaya will never reciprocate his feelings now that Zoravar is back from Dubai, Avinash states he is ready for a divorce and that his love has expired. Returning to the recent past, Avinash prepares one final, meticulous dinner and irons Shanaya's clothes, only for his quiet devotion to be completely ignored as she arrives home thoroughly distracted by a phone call with Zoravar.

the-secret-king-revenge-of-betrayed-husb.title: LE ROI SECRET : LA VENGEANCE DU MARI TRAHI
the-secret-king-revenge-of-betrayed-husb.description: Steve Blackwell débarque à Hawaï pour faire une surprise à sa femme enceinte, Nancy. Mais c'est lui qui tombe de haut : Nancy le trompe avec Alex, l'homme qui contrôle désormais son complexe hôtelier. Humilié en public, Steve voit Alex détruire la couronne que sa famille se transmet depuis trois cents ans. Ce que Nancy et Alex ignorent, c'est qui est vraiment Steve… et ce dont il est capable. L'heure de la revanche a sonné. Qui paiera le prix de cette trahison ?

billionaires-quadruplet-trap-6.title: Los Cuatrillizos del CEO
billionaires-quadruplet-trap-6.description: Hace cinco años, una celosa mujer de la alta sociedad le tendió una trampa cruel que le arruinó la vida. Hoy, Clara Evans tiene un café tradicional que todos adoran y cría en secreto a cuatrillizos con mente de genio. Todo cambia cuando el magnate tecnológico Damian Prescott descubre a los niños por una lectura de tarot callejera, justo cuando el estricto plazo de sucesión del fideicomiso familiar pone en riesgo su puesto como CEO. Su solución: una oferta millonaria. ¿Aceptará Clara?

the-pirate-who-never-drown-5.title: El Pirata sin Magia
the-pirate-who-never-drown-5.description: Lo arrojaron al mar de bebé por nacer sin magia, pero Ronan Drift sobrevivió. Creció sin vínculo, sin tatuajes y olvidado por todos. Hoy es un vagabundo solitario que, al rescatar a una princesa pirata, descubre la verdad: es el heredero perdido de una casa real que lo dio por muerto. Para recuperar a su familia tendrá que abrirse paso entre los piratas más letales del mundo, hasta llegar al número uno. Venganza, poder y un amor que el mismo mar eligió. ¿Está listo para la batalla?

dark-side-of-romance.title: Dark Side Of Romance
dark-side-of-romance.description: After seven years of marriage, Meera discovers her husband Veer is cheating with her childhood friend Shanaya and wants to seize her shares in their resort. When a planned accident nearly kills her, she fakes memory loss and begins a dangerous game of revenge. Casino king Rudra Pratap Singh, Veer's rival, offers her protection, and their deal sparks attraction and jealousy. Together they dismantle Veer's empire, and as he faces ruin, Meera marries Rudra, sealing her revenge.

brahmand-ka-rakshak.title: Brahmand Ka Rakshak
brahmand-ka-rakshak.description: Ek anjaane safar ne Ken ki zindagi poori tarah badal di, jab woh aaj ki duniya se sau crore saal purani saadhana ki duniya mein pahunch gaya. Wahan woh Maya Lin ka Rakshak Dev bana, sabne use kamzor samjha lekin uski asli taakat sabki soch se kahin zyada thi. Apni anokhi shaktiyon aur mazedaar andaaz se Ken ne Maya ki taakat badhane mein madad ki. Lekin is rahasyamayi duniya mein uske saamne abhi kai chunautiyan aur hairaan kar dene wale raaz aane baaki the.

not-your-heir.title: Not Your Heir
not-your-heir.description: Suman, a simple and devoted wife, is betrayed by her wealthy husband Aarav, who falls for Kinjal, an ambitious woman obsessed with stealing his love and life. Humiliated and mistreated, Suman decides to break free from her toxic marriage and reclaim her dignity. At a grand family celebration, she delivers a shocking revelation: “I’m pregnant… but this child isn’t yours!”

pokkiri-husband.title: Pokkiri Husband
pokkiri-husband.description:
Betrayed by Ramya, secret billionaire Jai becomes a reckless drunkard until an unexpected marriage to traditional Aishu changes his life.
As their constant fights turn into love, Aishu unknowingly transforms the powerful businessman hiding behind a rowdy image.
But when Jai’s past returns to haunt him, will his hidden identity save their love or destroy it?

the-monster-i-married.title: The Monster I Married
the-monster-i-married.description: Jonah Mercer and his wife Mara live peacefully, running a cemetery in Blackwood Ridge, unaware of each other's deadly secrets. Jonah is the legendary occult hunter "The Graveblade," while Mara is "The Frost Hound," a terrifying supernatural predator hiding her hunger and a cursed relic. When the Black Covenant arrives to claim the Saint's Heart, their dark pasts collide. Together, they must confront their monstrous identities, destroy the syndicate, and protect the peaceful life they've built.

the-real-heiress-is-back.title: The Real Heiress is Back
the-real-heiress-is-back.description: Rowan, a gifted commoner witch, dreams of entering the prestigious Vanguard Academy, but her lack of pure-blood ancestry stands in her way. When she discovers she is the true heiress of the powerful Sterling family, she hopes to secure her future. Instead, she faces a family that favors Chloe, the girl raised in her place. Refusing to be crushed by their manipulation and humiliation, Rowan relies on her extraordinary magical talent to prove her worth.

the-adorable-toddler-and-her-monster-bab.title: The Adorable Toddler and Her Monster Babysitters
the-adorable-toddler-and-her-monster-bab.description: When a deadpan five-year-old girl mistaken for the Realm King's ancient bloodline stumbles into a hidden supernatural underworld, three ruthless warlords—a vampire lord, a werewolf alpha, and a sorcerer sovereign—must freeze their bloody war and compete to win her love through juice boxes, naps, and bedtime stories.

suryagarh-2050.title: Suryagarh 2050
suryagarh-2050.description: When a poor boy dies because Suryagarh’s royal system refuses him care, his mother’s grief begins a chain of secrets, betrayals and rebellions that could bring an entire kingdom down. At the center of it all is a prince who realizes too late that the child the kingdom abandoned was his own son.

rise-of-the-beast-king.title: Rise of the Beast King
rise-of-the-beast-king.description: Reborn in a world ruled by prehistoric beasts, Lu Yuan awakens a mysterious Beast Evolution System that grants him the power to transform ordinary creatures into extraordinary companions. With Xiaobai by his side, he takes on fierce rivals, dangerous battles, and powerful challenges, determined to rise from an underestimated newcomer to the ultimate Beast Master.

triplets-one-billionaire-pilot-one-secre.title: Des Triplés et un Secret
triplets-one-billionaire-pilot-one-secre.description: Nora begins as a desperate flight attendant trying to raise money for her mother’s urgent surgery, and that need pulls her into the orbit of the powerful Vance aviation world. A dangerous runway incident and workplace humiliation expose how little protection she has inside the company. The owner then offers to cover the surgery only if she accepts a coercive heir arrangement, tying her survival to the family’s control. As Nora tries to keep working, she is repeatedly pressured, monitored, and threatened with exposure of a hidden pregnancy. Julien, the powerful man at the center of the company, increasingly steps in to protect her, even as his protection also becomes controlling. The story widens from cabin discipline and medical secrecy into a struggle over inheritance, status, and who gets to decide Nora’s future. Nora’s pregnancy is eventually revealed to involve triplets, making her central not only to the romance but to the dynasty’s succession. A strange pain bond between Nora and Julien intensifies their connection and makes every crisis feel shared. At the same time, rivals inside the airline use records, credentials, and audits to attack her credibility and force her out. Nora keeps proving her competence through regulations, route planning, and high-pressure training, refusing to be reduced to a secret. Family figures and executives push for searches, blood tests, and legal leverage in an effort to expose her and control the heir question. Julien’s mother and other hostile insiders treat Nora as a threat to the company’s future, while Nora is accused of using her body and relationship for advantage. The conflict escalates into confinement, rescue attempts, and repeated life-threatening emergencies, including cargo holds, smoke, and severe weather. Nora is also targeted through her mother’s medical care, showing that the fight reaches beyond the workplace into her family’s survival. Later, the danger becomes even more physical when Nora is trapped, beaten, or hidden away while Julien races to reach her. The medical crisis peaks when Nora collapses at the airport and doctors discover the triplets, turning her condition into an immediate neonatal emergency. Around the same time, newborn children become targets in a broader succession struggle, suggesting that the family war is no longer only about romance or reputation. By the end of the batch, the conflict has expanded into kidnapping, sabotage, and a public corporate scandal, with evidence surfacing ahead of an international audit. Nora refuses to disappear, insisting on presenting her own work and claiming her place in both the airline and the future being fought over.

durvasa-the-angry-god.title: Durvasa : The Angry God
durvasa-the-angry-god.description: Born from Lord Shiva’s divine fury, Maharishi Durvasa possesses the power to curse even the gods. But when his uncontrollable anger threatens the heavens, he embarks on a journey to conquer the darkness within. Can Durvasa transform his destructive rage into divine blessings before it destroys the universe?

saat-saal-ka-genius.title: Saat Saal Ka Genius
saat-saal-ka-genius.description: Aarav, a poor seven-year-old boy raised by his struggling grandmother, possesses an extraordinary intellect that allows him to master subjects far beyond his age. Mocked by his teachers and dismissed by his own family, Aarav shocks the academic world with his knowledge of advanced science and his dream of solving the world's energy crisis.

waris-the-stolen-heiress.title: Waris: The Stolen Heiress
waris-the-stolen-heiress.description: Sia Rathore, true heir to the Rathore Marwari Stud Farm, is cast aside by her father Gajendra and stepmother Vidya for her half-sister Lavanya, who gets engaged to Sia's secret love, tycoon Kabir Singhania. Framed for a deadly stable fire, Sia is thrown out into a storm with champion stallion Badal. Three years later, rich from Badal's breeding rights and armed with proof that her mother was poisoned, Sia returns to strip the Rathores of everything and claim the Mewar legacy.

i-wore-her-ring-before-she-did.title: I Wore Her Ring Before She Did
i-wore-her-ring-before-she-did.description: The story follows Kritika Rathod, a fiercely independent superbike racer seeking justice and vengeance against her wealthy stepfamily who usurped her late mother's estate. Her path crosses with Ashish, a powerful billionaire who was her secret lover before becoming engaged to her stepsister, Shruti, and Ashish's devoted younger brother, Ved.

theliyani-nijam.title: Theliyani Nijam
theliyani-nijam.description: Theliyani Nijam is a romantic mystery thriller about marriage, betrayal, and hidden identities. When Karthik disappears after a devastating house explosion, his wife Keerthana becomes the prime suspect. As Inspector Rudra investigates their troubled relationship, secrets, affairs, and unexpected revelations emerge. With every clue, the truth becomes more complicated, leaving everyone questioning what really happened to Karthik.

el-hijo-del-diablo.title: El Hijo del Diablo
el-hijo-del-diablo.description: Su esposo le regaló a su amante las piedras de sangre malditas de su familia. En una lujosa subasta de diamantes en Manhattan, la maestra joyera Clara Mercer le hace pagar y desata un poder que rompe mucho más que vidrio. Luego descubre que el desconocido enmascarado que es padre de su hijo es Lucian Vance, magnate millonario y el mismísimo Diablo. Ahora demonios antiguos quieren muerto a su bebé, y su única salida es reclamar el trono del Infierno.

ekalavya-astrayuddh.title: Ekalavya: Astrayuddh
ekalavya-astrayuddh.description: The show begins with a deep injustice: a mother brings her son to a gurukul, only for the guru to reject him because of his birth and status. That humiliation becomes the seed of a long struggle, as the boy later returns after years of secret training with rare archery skill and a need to prove his worth. His return forces others to reconsider him, but it also draws rivalry, public scrutiny, and repeated tests of discipline. Around him, other young archers face similar barriers, with stigma, class prejudice, and family burdens shaping who is allowed to rise. The story keeps returning to the same conflict: gifted children are denied access, then pushed to fight for recognition through endurance and precision. In the modern archery thread, talent alone is not enough, and competitors must learn strategy, control, and adaptation under pressure. One archer’s painful equipment problems and a new rule against modified grips raise the stakes further, threatening disqualification and exposing how fragile success can be. Another underdog is selected for a prestigious championship, creating tension with a team captain and showing how status can matter as much as skill. As these human struggles unfold, the story widens into mythic territory. A guardian heir learns that her family has long protected a hidden divine weapon and must keep it sealed until a foretold warrior arrives. She is taught a mantra to control its fire, while the weapon remains concealed behind frozen ruins and a hidden gate. The threat grows when a returned enemy and dark forces begin hunting the astras for destructive purposes. At the same time, a separate mythic war thread introduces a destined warrior, a demon, and a dark force that can resurrect evil for future conflict. The present-day conspiracy layer adds unrest, weapons, and a plan to overthrow the government, making the danger feel both personal and political. By the end, the show connects these arcs through the idea of hidden power, inherited duty, and the cost of misuse. Whether the struggle is in a gurukul, an archery field, or a sacred ruin, the characters are forced to choose between submission and defiance. The overall arc builds toward larger destiny-driven confrontations where recognition, revenge, and protection all collide.

the-pregnant-king-1.title: The Pregnant King
the-pregnant-king-1.description: Maharaja Veeraendhar’s downfall begins when his arrogance toward a sacred temple and the divine feminine crosses into sacrilege. He mocks the idol, orders its ornaments removed, and seizes temple wealth, provoking a supernatural punishment that no one in the palace can ignore. Soon after, he is struck by severe internal pain and weakness, and the court cannot tell whether he is ill, cursed, or both. As his condition worsens, he refuses ordinary help and tries to hide his suffering, but the signs become harder to contain. Rajaguru Devarath eventually reveals the shocking truth that Veeraendhar has been cursed by Ardhanareeswarar and is carrying a child. Veeraendhar rejects this revelation and clings to denial, even as the curse is described as punishment that cannot simply be undone by apology. Chandrika repeatedly tries to care for him and shield him from shame, but she is also blamed and humiliated in the marriage, especially over the lack of an heir. Her efforts cannot stop the growing suspicion inside the palace, where servants, advisers, and nobles begin watching every movement around the king’s chamber. Prince Devendra investigates secret nighttime access, bloodstained treatment cloth, and hidden passages, convinced that something is being concealed. In parallel, the court grows more political and dangerous as access to medical records is blocked and loyal guards enforce silence. The ruler’s weakness becomes public through failed strength tests, fading swordsmanship, and even a trusted horse refusing to obey him. Rival commanders begin challenging his authority, turning his private crisis into a threat to the throne itself. Veeraendhar and his adviser resort to secrecy and false explanations to protect royal stability, but the cover-up only deepens mistrust. When he collapses in court and reveals a long-hidden wound, panic spreads through the palace. By the end of the batch, both the supernatural curse and the political struggle have pushed the kingdom into open instability, with Veeraendhar’s body, reputation, and rule all under threat.

she-is-a-billionaire.title: She Is A Billionaire
she-is-a-billionaire.description: After being heartlessly abandoned on her anniversary, Radhika, a hidden heiress, embarks on a powerful journey of revenge, love, and self-discovery. In a world ruled by wealth, betrayal, and secrets, she rises to reclaim her dignity—and her throne.

mr-mittal-vs-vikram.title: Mr. Mittal Vs Vikram
mr-mittal-vs-vikram.description: An ambitious young man, Vikram, faces betrayal and humiliation when the love of his life chooses status over loyalty—sparking a gripping battle of pride, revenge, and rediscovery in a world ruled by power and ego.

ultimate-minister-4.title: Ultimate Minister
ultimate-minister-4.description:
Ashutosh, the newly appointed Health Minister, returns to his village after ten years for his first love, Prerna, only to discover she is engaged to the corrupt MLA’s son and has completely rejected him.
While exposing the illegal hospital racket, Ashutosh is brutally attacked and nearly killed, unaware that his true identity as the Health Minister is about to turn the entire corrupt system upside down.

broken-heirs-revenge.title: Broken Heir's Revenge
broken-heirs-revenge.description: The story follows Ambar as he is trapped in a widening web of family betrayal, hidden identity, and public humiliation. It begins with forbidden love, missing-person tension, and a wealthy family scandal that quickly turns into accusations, punishment, and fear. As the conflict grows, Ambar is treated as an outsider, blamed for disasters, and pushed between hostile relatives and the woman he loves. His prison ordeal, kidnapping threat, and repeated humiliation show how little protection he has in either the underworld or the household. The family crisis then shifts into a search for his true origins, and Ambar publicly exposes clues about his past in hopes of finding his real family. That search collides with a medical emergency when Vicky’s kidney failure forces the family to pressure Ambar into donating, even as he suspects deception and manipulation. The hospital arc deepens the mistrust, with surgery, secrecy, and accusations of a transplant scam leaving the family divided over what is real. Ambar’s identity is eventually confirmed through a tattoo, a locket, and DNA evidence, revealing him as Aditya Singhania’s long-lost son. This revelation changes his status, but it does not end the conflict, because the household still treats him with suspicion and hostility. At the same time, the family’s financial crisis turns marriage and inheritance into weapons, and alliances are arranged around business survival. Ambar is repeatedly humiliated in elite spaces, branded a fraud, and forced to defend his legitimacy in public. Dadi’s collapse and later accusations against Vicky intensify the sense that old crimes and cover-ups are finally surfacing. As more truth comes out, the balance of power shifts away from the family members who tried to control him. Aditya grows protective of Ambar and eventually transfers wealth to him, marking his rise from rejected outsider to recognized heir. Even so, Ambar remains wounded by the years of abuse, the loss he has suffered, and the people who once rejected him. The final stretch centers on revenge, exposure, and the collapse of the family’s public image as hidden betrayals are forced into the open. By the end, Ambar refuses to kneel or accept humiliation, and the story leaves the family fractured, exposed, and still fighting over loyalty, legitimacy, and power.

shaapit-ishq.title: Shaapit Ishq
shaapit-ishq.description: Museum restorer Meera's haunting dreams lead her into a mysterious forest, where she meets Veer, a prince cursed with immortality who has waited 900 years for his lost love. As their matching lotus pendants awaken old memories, Meera learns she is the reincarnation of Mrinalini. But the ancient enemy who tore them apart has returned to claim Meera and two sacred stones that control life and death. Can they break the curse, and will Veer love Meera for who she is today?

reborn-from-the-mud.title: Reborn from the Mud
reborn-from-the-mud.description: Stripped of his royal status and dragged through the mud by his treacherous stepbrother and betrothed, Prince Shyam plays the helpless beggar to keep his dying father alive, while secretly ruling the underworld as "Sam"—the untraceable weapons king who holds the entire empire's fate in his hands.

demon-ki-dulhaniya.title: Demon Ki Dulhaniya
demon-ki-dulhaniya.description: When a cynical, 200-year-old immortal Asur loses his Shakti to a fiercely guarded Mumbai billionaire heiress during a botched assassination, they must enter a high-stakes contract marriage where physical touch is his only source of strength and her only shield against murderous family conspirators.

triplets-one-billionaire-pilot-one-secre.title: Embarazada del Piloto
triplets-one-billionaire-pilot-one-secre.description: Para pagar las cuentas médicas de su madre, una azafata firma un contrato secreto con un piloto multimillonario: darle un heredero. Pero ahora espera trillizos y la despiadada familia de él hará lo que sea para sabotearla, incluso a miles de metros de altura. Y hay algo más: un extraño vínculo mágico obliga al piloto a sentir cada uno de los síntomas de su embarazo en plena cabina, en pleno vuelo. ¿Podrán sobrevivir a una familia dispuesta a todo?

spirit-of-the-dragon-4.title: Spirit Of The Dragon
spirit-of-the-dragon-4.description: ஒரு எரிகின்ற அக்கினி மழை, கம்பிகளின் ஒலி மற்றும் ஒரு ட்ராகன்—அது வாழ்க்கையின் ஒவ்வொரு சவாலையும் வென்றது! கேளுங்கள், எப்படி ஒரு சாதாரண கார்ப் தன் விதியை மாற்றி, ஒரு தெய்வீக ட்ராகனாக மாறியது—அது செழிப்பு மற்றும் நற்குடமையின் அடையாளமாகியது. இப்போது இந்த முழு நிகழ்ச்சியைக் காணுங்கள்!

love-ka-jackpot.title: Love Ka Jackpot
love-ka-jackpot.description: Karan, a hardworking waiter, is dumped by his girlfriend Riya for wealthy hotel heir Dhruv Rathore. When Dhruv publicly humiliates and attacks him, three powerful women, business leader Meghna, actress Tamanna and tennis champion Shruti, step in and reveal Karan is their brother, abducted as a child and the rightful Maheshwari heir. But as love blooms with Suhani, his uncle Mukul, who planned his disappearance to secure the fortune for his son Kabir, threatens everything Karan has found.

married-to-a-mafia-queen.title: Married to a Mafia Queen
married-to-a-mafia-queen.description: Thrown out by his wife Rhea with one bag and ₹300, Aman Sharma takes an unusual job: becoming a father figure to Aarav, the frightened four-year-old boy raised by Mumbai's powerful mafia queen Samaira Rana. Their marriage begins as a paid arrangement with separate bedrooms, but Aman's patient care wins Aarav's heart and draws Samaira closer. As their bond turns real and he faces his former family's scorn and Samaira's enemies, the woman everyone fears stands beside the man everyone dismissed.

the-wronged-mother-3.title: The Wronged Mother
the-wronged-mother-3.description: This microdrama chronicles the profound suffering and eventual vindication of a sacrificing matriarch, initially known as Keya, whose selfless devotion to her son's education is met with cruel ingratitude. Her ambitious son, Deepayon, driven by a desire for social status, publicly disowns her, conceals her true identity, and even fabricates her death to secure his marriage into an elite family. The matriarch endures relentless public humiliation, false accusations of theft, and physical abuse, often mistaken for a mere servant. However, a growing number of loyal sons and unexpected allies rise to her defense, determined to expose the truth and fight for justice. The escalating deception and mistreatment trigger severe family conflicts, leading to financial ruin for those who disrespect the matriarch and violent confrontations. The disowning son's carefully constructed life unravels as his impoverished origins and living mother are exposed, resulting in public humiliation, the collapse of his marriage, and vows of retribution from his powerful in-laws. Despite her immense suffering, the matriarch strives to maintain her independence and return to her home, occasionally disowning her sons for their betrayals. The stakes intensify with the kidnapping of a grandchild and the matriarch's own abduction and critical injury, fueled by deep-seated vengeance. The series ultimately explores the devastating clash between ambition and filial love, the corrosive effects of class prejudice, and the enduring quest for truth and family honor, as the matriarch's true identity and past suffering are dramatically revealed, challenging societal norms and reshaping the family's future.

chathurangam.title: Chathurangam
chathurangam.description: To save her framed father from prison, a fierce woman binds herself to a ruthless corporate heir in a high-tech logistics empire, only to trigger a destructive war when his dangerous younger brother returns to claim the dynasty and win her heart.

cole-e-buddy-1.title: Cole e Buddy
cole-e-buddy-1.description: Um músico em dificuldades alcança a fama viral graças aos uivos acidentais do seu cão vira-lata resgatado. Tentado pelo sucesso, decide trocá-lo por um puro-sangue polido e "pronto para a indústria". O leal companheiro que lhe deu tudo é isolado, abandonado e morre esperando por um homem que nunca volta, até que sinais estranhos e inexplicáveis forçam Cole a encarar a verdade e recuperar o que a fama quase lhe custou: o amigo que o amou antes de alguém estar olhando

falling-for-a-bar-dancer.title: Falling for a Bar Dancer
falling-for-a-bar-dancer.description: Billionaire Dhruv rescues club dancer Tara and offers her a fresh start, only to fall for her honesty and street-smart charm. But his jealous fiancée and scheming stepbrother turn her past into a weapon against her. As humiliation becomes a deadly conspiracy, Tara must fight for her dignity and the man she loves. Can their love survive a world determined to tear them apart?

parasuramante-santhathi.title: Parasuramante Santhathi
parasuramante-santhathi.description: The story opens in a mythic crisis, with Devalokam under relentless attack from Asura and Paathaalam forces. The gods are pushed into survival mode, and their rulers begin searching for the one warrior worthy to defend the realm. A divine trial of strength is announced, tied to destiny, royal honor, and the right to wield Parasurama’s sacred sword. Arjun first appears as a fallen or underestimated warrior, marked by exile, shame, and a hidden past. He is repeatedly mocked as weak, yet the digests consistently show that he has been concealing real power. Around him, family honor becomes inseparable from the fate of heaven itself. Mahendra Suryavanshi and his sons are drawn into the public contest, while Sooraj is treated as the more obvious heir. Arjun, however, keeps emerging as the unexpected center of the conflict. His motivation is not glory or wealth, but the restoration of his mother Kamala’s honor and return. Kamala’s banishment and disgrace deepen the emotional stakes, and her fate remains a major wound in the larger war. The gods also try to expose the hidden protector who has been saving them from the shadows, but trust remains fragile. As the battles widen, the enemy side grows more dangerous through dark magic, overwhelming strength, and cunning tactics. Arjun is forced into direct confrontation with underworld rulers and rival warriors, while still trying to conceal his full abilities. His hidden strength finally begins to surface, shocking both allies and enemies. The conflict then shifts from suspicion to recognition, as Arjun proves he is not the weak son others dismissed. Even so, victory does not end the danger, because the defeated underworld powers vow revenge and the war continues. By the end of the arc, Arjun stands as the realm’s feared and uncertain hope, while Devalokam still struggles to find a stable protector and a just resolution.

secret-heartbeat.title: Secret Heartbeat
secret-heartbeat.description: A billionaire who hides his identity — and lives on another man's transplanted heart — marries an amnesiac widow and must defend her forgotten dream of becoming an IPS officer against a land-grabbing cartel that has decided she is the only way to destroy him.ma

papa-i-found-you.title: Papa, I Found You!
papa-i-found-you.description:
Born and brought up in jail, 6-year-old Mahi runs away to find her papa Samar, a billionaire who still hates her mother Sneha for leaving him for a rich boy in college.

But Sneha had left only to save Samar’s life. As little Mahi fights to bring her parents together, Samar’s scheming would-be bride Vartika frames Sneha for murder to keep Samar and his empire for herself.

marriage-of-lies.title: Marriage of Lies
marriage-of-lies.description: When her fiancé abandons her days before their wedding, a desperate Jhanvi Gupta enters a six-month marriage of convenience with Raman Mehra, the billionaire heir who shattered her life ten years ago.
