But as their fake romance draws them into a dangerous game of family power, political ambition and buried secrets, two sworn enemies must confront the possibility that the hatred separating them has been masking a love neither can escape.

hate-you-to-the-moon-and-back.title: Hate you to the moon and back
hate-you-to-the-moon-and-back.description: Marcus’s story centers on a man trapped between a hidden past, a broken family, and a space program in crisis. At first, he is treated as a nobody, even publicly humiliated when his estranged daughter Ava rejects him. That humiliation is undercut by a larger truth: Marcus is tied to SpaceGen in a far more important way than anyone around him realizes. As the company’s Mars and orbital efforts begin to fail, pressure builds for him to return and help solve the emergency. His hidden identity as the founder and key engineer of SpaceGen is gradually exposed, shifting him from mocked outsider to indispensable authority. The crisis is not only technical but political, since foreign agents also try to lure him away for his thruster blueprints. While the space stakes rise, his private life keeps collapsing around him. Karen’s pregnancy, her divided loyalties, and the presence of Avian and later Dean deepen the sense that Marcus has lost his place in his own home. He is blamed, insulted, and pushed into humiliating positions by Karen’s family and by rivals who use wealth and status against him. Even when he tries to step away from SpaceGen and hand over his stake for Ava’s future, the mission emergency pulls him back in. The company’s survival depends on his knowledge, and the astronauts’ safety becomes urgent enough to override his wish to leave. At the same time, his relationship with Serena remains unresolved, adding another emotional pressure point. Serena supports him and wants him to stop chasing Karen, but Marcus cannot fully let go of his marriage or his daughter. Public confrontations repeatedly expose old resentment, especially when Karen and her allies dismiss his sacrifices and deny his authority. By the end of the batch, Marcus has reclaimed control of SpaceGen in the face of crisis, but his family life remains fractured and his reputation is still under attack. The show’s tension comes from that split: he may be powerful enough to save the mission, yet still unable to repair the damage at home.

pregnant-king.title: Pregnant King
pregnant-king.description: After insulting Ardhanarishvara, a ruthless king is cursed with an impossible pregnancy, forcing him to discover that true strength lies not in power, but in love and sacrifice.

i-married-a-divorce-lawyer.title: I Married A Divorce Lawyer
i-married-a-divorce-lawyer.description: A ruthless divorce lawyer enters a contract marriage with a compassionate counsellor, only to discover the family he never believed in.

not-for-sale.title: Not For Sale
not-for-sale.description: Nila Varma escapes a forced marriage arranged to settle her father’s debts. She then encounters Rishi Singhania, an arrogant billionaire who believes everyone has a price. When she rejects his property offer, he engineers a deception to humiliate her. Their conflict gradually turns into attraction, but his betrayal and their families’ conspiracies threaten their growing bond. Nila must protect her dignity while discovering whether Rishi can earn her trust and love.

suryaputhiran-kadhai.title: Suryaputhiran Kadhai
suryaputhiran-kadhai.description: விறகு வெட்டியாக வளர்ந்த அனாதை இளைஞன், தான் ஒரு அரச குடும்பத்தின் வாரிசு என்பதையும், தன்னுள் சூரிய தேவனின் தெய்வீக சக்தி இருப்பதையும் உணர்கிறான். கொடூர எதிரி அவனது குடும்பத்தையும் நாட்டையும் அழிக்க ஒரு அரக்கப் படையை ஏவும்போது, சூரஜ் ‘ராஜாக்களுக்கெல்லாம் ராஜா’ என்ற தன் உண்மையான அடையாளத்தை ஏற்று, அந்த இருளை வீழ்த்தும் மகா வீரனாக உருவெடுக்கிறான்.

torn-between-brothers-2.title: Torn Between Brothers
torn-between-brothers-2.description: பொய் வழக்கில் சிறைப்பட்ட தந்தையைக் காப்பாற்ற, நடுத்தரக் குடும்பத்துப் பெண் ஒருத்தி இரக்கமற்ற தொழிலதிபர் வாரிசுடன் ரகசிய உடன்படிக்கை செய்கிறாள். ஆனால், அவளை அடையத் துடிக்கும் அவனது அடங்காத முரட்டுத் தம்பி களமிறங்கும்போது, இரு சகோதரர்களுக்கு இடையே ஆபத்தான ஆசைப் போரில் அவள் சிக்குகிறாள்.

ditched-by-snake-kissed-by-wolf-1.title: Ditched by Snake, Kissed by Wolf
ditched-by-snake-kissed-by-wolf-1.description:
In the world of beast courts, one law rules them all: never love outside your blood.
Rejected at the altar, Thalia Veyl, the only Snake Court daughter born without venom or scales, marries a scarred, wolf-blooded beggar to keep her dignity. He is Rowan Greymoor, the presumed-dead Alpha Duke of the Wolf Court, whose wolf has been bound inside him since he was betrayed in the war. One kiss… could start a war. And they’re getting closer every night.

century-kadhal.title: Century Kadhal
century-kadhal.description: துரோகம் செய்த காதலனை உதறி, தாயைக் காக்கப் போராடும் ஏழை கிரிக்கெட் வீரன் ராஜ்வர்தனுடன் ஒப்பந்தத் திருமணம் செய்கிறாள் பெரும் பணக்கார வாரிசு மீனாட்சி. ஆனால், சதியால் ராஜ் மீது பழி விழ, அவனைக் கேவலப்படுத்தி அழிக்கிறாள். அவமானங்களை வென்று ராஜ் மீண்டும் கேப்டனாக உயர, இருவரிடமும் காதல் மலர்கிறது. அப்போது அவர்களின் ரகசியத் திருமணத்தையும் அவன் வாழ்க்கையையும் அழிக்க மீண்டும் ஒரு பெரும் சதி வலை பின்னப்படுகிறது.

aakhri-take.title: Aakhri Take
aakhri-take.description: Bollywood laughed when star kid Rehaan Khanna fell from the 7th floor after two flops. But the man who woke up isn’t the same. A forgotten writer’s soul now lives behind his scar, and with it, a buried secret. One last film stands between Rehaan and the end of his career. His brother sabotages every shot, the media hunts him and his father wants him gone. Now, alongside co-star Ishita, Rehaan will turn this film into the Khanna family’s final reckoning. Aakhri take. Aakhri mauka.

i-married-a-beggar-he-was-the-son-of-a-g.title: I Married a Beggar. He Was the Son of a God.
i-married-a-beggar-he-was-the-son-of-a-g.description: The story follows a long chain of survival, betrayal, and resistance in a mythic world where rulers, gods, and captors keep tightening their grip. Leander stands at the center of much of the conflict, moving from imprisoned husband and accused laborer to rebel, captive, and symbol of defiance. His bond with Selena remains one of the story’s strongest threads, even as they are repeatedly separated by courts, prisons, battlefields, and supernatural forces. Selena is shown as healer, seeker, and avenger, but her compassion is constantly tested by poison plots, hostage threats, and the danger of being branded a witch. Around them, women such as Lynda, Xenia, Nysa, and others are forced into bargains, confinement, or public accusation, yet they keep resisting in whatever ways they can. The early arc is shaped by public humiliation, coerced quests, and prison bargains, including the search for the Black Lotus and the exposure of gem theft and corruption. As the story widens, healing and magic become inseparable from danger, with poisoned queens, hidden ledgers, and secret books revealing that the powerful are using illness and law as weapons. Sea voyages, storms, and cursed islands add another layer of peril, while captains, nobles, and enforcers try to control who may travel, speak, or survive. Leander’s captivity deepens into arena punishment and divine coercion, but each attempt to break him instead turns him into a rallying point for others. Selena’s own path grows darker as she uncovers family secrets, inherited power, and the possibility that betrayal came from inside her own bloodline. The rulers answer rebellion with chains, beasts, starvation, and public spectacle, yet the crowd increasingly sees the oppressed as martyrs rather than criminals. Several storylines also focus on rescue: chained workers, hidden captives, trafficked girls, and women trapped in households or underground chambers all become part of the same larger struggle. Xenia’s violent takeover of a household briefly offers a different kind of power, one that promises protection for women who have been sold or beaten. Meanwhile, Damon and other wounded men carry grief, pain, and silence through the chaos, showing how private suffering mirrors the larger political cruelty. The final stretch pushes the conflict toward open war, divine judgment, and repeated attempts to force Leander and Selena apart through leverage, prophecy, and punishment. Even so, their relationship keeps returning as a source of resolve, and their choices repeatedly turn survival into resistance. By the end, the world remains unstable, but the balance of power has clearly shifted toward those willing to defy kings, gods, and captors.

hendati-re-strong-guru.title: Hendati Re, Strong Guru!
hendati-re-strong-guru.description: The drama follows Pushpa and Sanjay through a world where marriage, family duty, and legal power constantly collide. It begins with women pushing back against controlling men, including a wife who demands divorce from a powerful husband and another woman who openly challenges his dominance. From there, the story widens into courtrooms and households where lawyers, relatives, and family elders use shame, pressure, and authority to force obedience. Pushpa emerges as a woman who resists being controlled, even when her family pushes her toward an arranged match and questions her choices. Sanjay is introduced as a polished lawyer whose reputation matters deeply, and his connection to Pushpa grows through a family-approved introduction that seems respectful on the surface. Their bond becomes more complicated when hidden blood, an unexplained injury, and family concerns about his past begin to shadow the relationship. The story then shifts into a more intimate domestic arc, where Pushpa and Sanjay are revealed to have a secret marriage. Pushpa tries to earn acceptance inside the household, especially from Charvi, a grieving child who resists calling her mother. Sanjay insists on family unity, but his own guilt and emotional collapse show that the household is built on unresolved pain. He later confesses responsibility for Asha’s death, adding a heavy moral burden to the family conflict. As Pushpa moves deeper into the home, she encounters injury, secrecy, and signs that the family’s private world is more dangerous than it first appeared. She also discovers a hidden interrogation room, linking the domestic space to Sanjay’s legal and police connections. Meanwhile, relatives openly humiliate her, showing that acceptance is still far from secure. The conflict escalates from emotional pressure into physical confrontation, suggesting that the family struggle has become immediate and dangerous. Across the arc, Pushpa remains the emotional center, trying to protect her dignity while also caring for others. Sanjay stands between support and secrecy, torn between family responsibility, reputation, and past guilt. The stakes are not only whether Pushpa will be accepted, but whether this marriage can survive the weight of hidden history, public shame, and escalating domestic danger.

the-secret-king-revenge-of-betrayed-husb.title: O REI SECRETO: A VINGANÇA DO MARIDO TRAÍDO
the-secret-king-revenge-of-betrayed-husb.description: Steve Blackwell viaja até o Havaí para fazer uma surpresa para Nancy, sua esposa grávida. Mas quem leva a surpresa é ele: Nancy está tendo um caso com Alex, o homem que agora controla o resort dela. Como se a traição não bastasse, Alex humilha Steve e destrói a coroa de 300 anos da família dele. O que eles não sabem é que o marido que acabaram de pisar esconde uma identidade capaz de virar o jogo. A coroa pode ter sido quebrada, mas a vingança de Steve está só começando.

daddy-rules-the-world.title: Daddy Rules the World
daddy-rules-the-world.description: Living as a humble farmer in Haryana, Pushpendra Singh is secretly India's top covert commando, Cobra Commander. After being publicly humiliated by his daughter's arrogant billionaire fiancé, he reveals his true identity to restore her self-respect and dismantles a deadly underworld casino syndicate exploiting retired soldiers.

too-heavy-to-handle.title: Too Heavy To Handle
too-heavy-to-handle.description: The microdrama begins with Priya, a hopeful wife, discovering her husband Rohan's cruel affair with Natasha during their anniversary, leading to public humiliation, a forced divorce, and the loss of her home. Devastated by the profound deceit that began on her wedding day, Priya vows fierce retribution against her betrayers. She finds an unexpected ally and burgeoning romantic interest in Arjun, a childhood friend who helps her reclaim her self-worth. Transformed and adopting the new identity of Avni, Priya embarks on a meticulously planned quest for vengeance, infiltrating Rohan's corporate world as his personal assistant. A fated attraction ignites between Rohan and Avni, further complicating his life, while his partner Natasha grows suspicious of his infidelity. Rohan, a rising corporate titan, also clashes with Arjun Malhotra, whose animosity stems from a deep-seated past betrayal. As corporate rivalries escalate, Rohan confesses his love for Avni, revealing his marriage to Natasha was one of convenience, unaware of Avni's true agenda. However, Avni harbors a significant, undisclosed secret, as she is revealed to be Natasha's accuser, seeking revenge for a past wrong. A powerful matriarch, Rohan's mother, initiates a secret investigation into Avni, sensing her manipulative schemes against the family. Rohan, with his mother's complicity, plans to exploit Avni for corporate secrets, callously discarding Natasha and orchestrating a strategic marriage to Avni. The wedding is dramatically interrupted when a mysterious woman exposes Avni's true identity as Priya, the woman Rohan had previously humiliated and cast out. Transformed and vengeful, Priya, supported by Arjun, confronts Rohan and his mother, accusing them of illicitly acquiring her home and building their empire on lies. Priya orchestrates a catastrophic market crash, leading to the complete financial insolvency of Rohan's empire as retribution for past betrayals and body-shaming. Her journey culminates in the successful execution of her revenge plan and Rohan's downfall, offering her a second chance at happiness with Arjun.

kiss-and-clash.title: Kiss And Clash
kiss-and-clash.description: కాలేజీ క్లాస్ మేట్ గౌతం చేసిన మోసానికి బలవుతుంది ఆర్కిటెక్ట్ సాహితి. కానీ ఐదేళ్ల తర్వాత అతనితో ఆమెకు అవసరం ఏర్పడుతుంది. ఒకప్పుడు ఒకరిని ఒకరు అసహ్యించుకున్న ఇద్దరు.. మళ్ళీ కలిసే అవకాశం వస్తే వాళ్ళ మధ్య ఎలాంటి పరిస్థితులు ఏర్పడుతాయై అనేది తెలుసుకోవాలంటే కిస్ అండ్ క్లాష్ చూడండి.

wonder-boy-parth.title: Wonder Boy Parth
wonder-boy-parth.description: The microdrama begins with Parth, a blind man, suffering a devastating betrayal by his wife, Jasmine, who is having an affair with the wealthy Raj Talwar, despite Parth sacrificing his eyesight for her. Consumed by a burning desire for vengeance against Jasmine, Parth experiences a mysterious onset of mystical powers and enhanced perception, drawing him into a world of ancient artifacts and corporate intrigue. He partners with Maya, a disgraced CEO, to expose forgeries and navigate the ruthless Taneja Group, led by the formidable Anil Taneja, challenging powerful elites with his newfound abilities. Parth's path intertwines with Raj Talwar, who faces accusations of fraud, and he makes a bold wager involving Jasmine, hinting at their complex past. He later faces a life-threatening wager over a mystical sword, eventually regaining his sight and confronting Mr. Taneja about a cursed painting. Meanwhile, Anil Taneja, revealed as a powerful don, forms new alliances and vows revenge against Raj Talwar for targeting his friend. Parth, initially humble, dramatically reveals his true identity as a powerful CEO and mall owner, still driven by a quest for revenge against his materialistic ex and her arrogant partner. He confronts Jasmine about a mysterious past "condition," further entangling their destinies. The ancient "Saundarya Dhara" formula becomes a focal point in a high-stakes corporate and medical drama, forcing rivals into uneasy alliances to save a massive investment. Shrewd heiress Sanvi Khandelwal, plagued by the mystery of her deceased husband's ancient mines and suspecting her stepson, hires Parth to uncover the truth. Parth, using his extraordinary knowledge, uncovers a sinister family plot against Sanvi, blending corporate intrigue with ancient mysticism and personal betrayals. Concurrently, Aryan, initially deemed "useless," defies his mother and ruthlessly pursues his deceased father's legacy and Saanvi, conspiring against her. A mysterious protector, later implied to be Parth, emerges to defend Saanvi and reclaim stolen heritage, challenging Aryan to perilous tasks. Aryan's power grows, marked by a mystical "vardaan" and a powerful ring, as he faces new adversaries and engages in high-stakes wagers, even confessing to murdering Saanvi's father. The narrative culminates in Aryan's megalomaniacal quest for ultimate power and possession of Saanvi, while Parth, now a charismatic leader, grapples with personal relationships amidst rising supernatural threats. The stakes involve personal revenge, corporate control, the power of ancient artifacts, and the ultimate fate of legacies and lives.

my-wife-chose-the-gym-trainer.title: My Wife Chose The Gym Trainer
my-wife-chose-the-gym-trainer.description: When his unfaithful wife and her lover humiliate him and his father-in-law, a seemingly ordinary IT consultant sets out to take revenge. As he exposes their lies, betrayal and financial crimes, he slowly reveals his true identity and fights to protect his family, reclaim his respect and make those who wronged him pay for their actions.

mera-pati-jinn-nikla.title: Mera Pati Jinn Nikla
mera-pati-jinn-nikla.description: Atharv, a jinn freed by a dying industrialist on the condition that he marries the man's granddaughter Ishanvi Rathore and protects her for five years, lives as a despised ghar jamai until his secret is exposed, his wife throws him away, and he rises as the hidden founder of a business empire while Ishanvi learns too late who truly stood behind her.

love-and-century-2.title: Love And Century
love-and-century-2.description: After catching her fiancé cheating, a powerful Mumbai heiress, Meenakshi, impulsively enters a contract marriage with a struggling cricketer, Rajvardhan, to save his dying mother—only to unknowingly become the wife of the very man she later humiliates and destroys after he is framed for betrayal. As Raj fights his way back from disgrace to captaincy, the two slowly fall in love, while a dangerous conspiracy threatens to tear apart both his career and their secret marriage.

student-no-1.title: Student No.1
student-no-1.description: When a simple village boy from Daulatpur joins India’s most elite college, his rich classmates mock him as a charity-quota beggar. They don’t know that his “humble” village is the wealthiest in the country, and that his family is the college’s biggest shareholder.

the-beggar-prince.title: THE BEGGAR PRINCE
the-beggar-prince.description: Murdered at her own wedding by a jealous sister, a Chola princess is reborn into the same family. In her second life she gives up wealth and power to marry a beggar, who turns out to be the King of the Kadambas in disguise.

mahadev-is-my-friend.title: Mahadev Is My Friend
mahadev-is-my-friend.description: Meet Bum Laheri, a lovable, food-obsessed, and hopelessly unlucky man whose life takes an extraordinary turn when Yamraj's buffalo accidentally kills him. But his unwavering devotion to Lord Shiva brings him face-to-face with Mahadev himself. Touched by Bum's innocence and love for his best friend Prabhas, Mahadev brings him back to life and orders the gods to help him whenever he is in trouble.

kiss-and-kill.title: Kiss And Kill
kiss-and-kill.description: Mihika enters the Singhania household as a new bride and immediately finds herself under strict rules, constant watching, and open suspicion. The family treats her as an outsider, and Gayatri in particular tests and humiliates her while trying to protect the family’s status and control. Viren repeatedly steps in to defend Mihika, but his support is complicated by his own doubts and by the pressure of the family empire. Mihika is not only fighting for dignity in the house, but also trying to prove her value through her design work. She gradually earns recognition at the Singhania Atelier, including through a bridal design challenge, which gives her a public foothold inside the family’s world. At the same time, she is secretly working with her brother Rohan to gather evidence tied to the Singhania past and to records connected to her father. The investigation deepens into hidden identity and parentage, and Devraj Sharma is revealed as Mihika’s biological father. As the secrets pile up, surveillance and deception become part of daily life, including signs that the household itself is being monitored. Viren’s gestures of support are repeatedly undercut by suspicion, including questions about missing dossiers, hacked records, and hidden evidence. A gift that turns out to contain a tracker shows how even intimacy is being used as a tool of control. Mihika also begins looking into suspicious wine and possible sedative traces, suggesting that the family’s troubles may include a poisoning mystery. Corporate conflict grows alongside the personal conflict, with investor documents, financial traps, and business power struggles threatening the family company. Public events become battlegrounds where private secrets spill into view, and the family’s image starts to crack under media attention. By the end of the arc, Mihika’s marriage, identity, and safety are all under attack at once. Viren remains both her shield and a source of tension, leaving their relationship caught between loyalty, suspicion, and survival. The story builds toward a crisis involving police attention, a hospital emergency, and accusations that could destroy the family from within. In the end, Mihika stands at the center of a struggle over truth, inheritance, and who gets to control the Singhania name.

the-magic-hand-doctor-vs-billion-dollar-.title: The Magic Hand Doctor vs Billion-Dollar Hospital
the-magic-hand-doctor-vs-billion-dollar-.description: A brilliant but debt-trapped doctor must secretly reverse the toxic medical treatments of an elite heiress before her corrupt fiancé—his clinic director rival—forces her to sign away her massive family trust.

jhadoowala-sikander.title: Jhadoowala Sikander
jhadoowala-sikander.description: Thrown out and called “illegitimate” by his rich father, Kabir Kapoor quietly takes over a sick old sweeper’s job on the highway. Then he saves the life of Pakhi Malhotra, a dying billionaire heiress. As the people who looked down on him close in, it comes out that this “mere jhadoowala” is really Acharya Agnivesh, a healer and business genius no one has ever seen. He uses that power to ruin the Kapoor empire that humiliated him and his mother.

billionaires-quadruplet-trap-4.title: Le Piège des Quadruplés
billionaires-quadruplet-trap-4.description: Il y a cinq ans, Clara Evans a été victime du piège d'une mondaine jalouse. Aujourd'hui, elle tient un café historique adoré du quartier et élève en secret quatre petits génies, ses quadruplés. Damian Prescott, magnat milliardaire de la tech, découvre leur existence grâce à une tireuse de tarot de rue, alors même que la succession familiale menace son fauteuil de PDG. Sa solution : offrir à Clara un rachat à plusieurs millions. Mais Clara est-elle prête à vendre ?

royal-ghudsawar.title: Royal Ghudsawar
royal-ghudsawar.description: A stable boy who has spent five years hiding his true identity rises to protect a kingdom under attack, revealing extraordinary swordsmanship and a mysterious supernatural power. As he battles ruthless princes and a cursed warrior, his growing strength threatens to expose the truth about a legendary warrior believed dead—and the secret past that could change the fate of the kingdom.

my-unborn-angel-made-me-a-billion-dollar.title: My Unborn Angel Made Me a Billion Dollar Queen
my-unborn-angel-made-me-a-billion-dollar.description: Once a gifted fashion student, Vanessa Rose sacrificed her dreams to marry Blake Whitmore. Now pregnant, she discovers his affair with her younger sister Valerie and is abandoned with nothing. At her lowest point, Lumi, a mischievous baby angel, appears to help her reclaim her dream of becoming a designer. As Blake and Valerie plot to sabotage her comeback, billionaire fashion mogul Theo Sinclair takes an unexpected interest in Vanessa, opening the door to a new future.

triplets-one-billionaire-pilot-one-secre.title: Trigêmeos do Bilionário
triplets-one-billionaire-pilot-one-secre.description: Nora Gray enters Vance Aviation as a desperate flight attendant trying to raise money for her mother’s urgent surgery. Her life collides with Julian Vance, the powerful aviation heir, after a runway emergency and a coercive offer tied to his family’s demand for an heir. What begins as a workplace crisis quickly becomes a private and corporate power struggle, with Nora forced to hide a pregnancy while facing humiliation, scrutiny, and threats from senior crew and executives. Vanessa and Evelyn repeatedly work against her, using suspicion, records, lawyers, and sabotage to expose or remove her. Julian alternates between controlling Nora’s movements and publicly defending her, and his protection grows more intense as the danger around her increases. A doctor reveals that Nora is carrying triplets, raising the stakes of every attack and making her safety inseparable from the unborn children’s survival. The story also suggests a strange bond between Nora and Julian, since her pain and danger are mirrored by him. Nora is pushed into confinement at Julian’s estate, but she resists losing her work, identity, and freedom. At the same time, her spotless record, medical payments, and hidden documents become evidence in a widening scandal. Nora continues to prove her competence through route analysis, emergency performance, and refusal to rely on favoritism. Even so, rivals try to trap her in freezing compartments, drug her, and discredit her credentials. Julian repeatedly risks himself to rescue her, and his authority shields her from suspension, exposure, and removal. The conflict then escalates beyond workplace abuse into kidnapping, hospital removal, and a waterfront rescue. Nora survives captivity, taunting, and violence, while Julian and allies trace the betrayal and expose bribery and sedatives. After these attacks, Nora refuses to disappear and insists on facing the threat beside Julian. Her route innovation and aviation work become the next target during an audit, showing that the fight is now about both her future and the airline’s power structure. By the end of the batch, Nora’s survival, her triplets, and the struggle over Vance Aviation are all bound together in one ongoing battle.

time-travel-delivery-boy.title: Time Travel Delivery Boy
time-travel-delivery-boy.description: A simple delivery boy suddenly enters a new world while searching for his father, who mysteriously disappeared twelve years ago. What happens after he enters this strange new world is the story.

neeli-the-vampire-beauty.title: Neeli: The Vampire Beauty
neeli-the-vampire-beauty.description: When a murdered tech worker unleashes an ancient Yakshi to avenge her death, brilliant forensic doctor Vandana Sharma becomes the unwilling host of a bloodthirsty supernatural killer. As powerful corporate figures turn up mysteriously drained of blood, a relentless police inspector and an occult researcher race to uncover the conspiracy—before the spirit consumes Vandana completely and turns its deadly vengeance against everyone in its path.

king-of-cash.title: King of Cash
king-of-cash.description: As Emperor Zhu Di grows older, Li Qing—the immortal who has stood beside him through years of war and political intrigue—struggles to protect the Ming Dynasty from internal conflicts and power struggles within the royal family. As tensions rise between Zhu Di’s sons and grandson, Li Qing also helps uncover conspiracies and confront the unresolved legacy of the former Jianwen Emperor.

love-and-century-1.title: Love and Century
love-and-century-1.description: After catching her fiancé cheating, a powerful Mumbai heiress, Meenakshi, impulsively enters a contract marriage with a struggling cricketer, Rajvardhan, to save his dying mother—only to unknowingly become the wife of the very man she later humiliates and destroys after he is framed for betrayal. As Raj fights his way back from disgrace to captaincy, the two slowly fall in love, while a dangerous conspiracy threatens to tear apart both his career and their secret marriage.

torn-between-brothers-1.title: Torn Between Brothers
torn-between-brothers-1.description: Kavya is pulled into a long, escalating struggle after Dev Vardhan publicly accuses her father of fake billing and uses the case to force her into a one-year contract as his personal secretary. What begins as a fight to save her father quickly becomes a battle over control, humiliation, and hidden truth inside the Vardhan household and business empire. Kavya is mocked by family members and staff, but she refuses to submit and keeps searching for proof that can clear her father’s name. Her investigation leads to suspicious files, a hidden ledger, forged signatures, and later a wider trail of fake invoices, bank records, CCTV, and bribery evidence. As the conflict widens, Veer returns and becomes both a rival force and a protector, deepening the tension around Kavya and Dev. Dev remains a conflicted presence, sometimes acting as an oppressor and sometimes as an insider who withholds or reveals evidence depending on the pressure around him. The family matriarch and other powerful relatives repeatedly try to preserve reputation, block disclosure, and keep Kavya under control. The story expands beyond the original accusation into corporate fraud, land disputes, redevelopment pressure, and a threatened studio, making the stakes larger than one family scandal. Kavya is repeatedly humiliated, threatened, confined, and pushed to choose between her father’s safety and her own freedom. Even when her father’s bail is secured at one point, the larger truth remains buried and the danger does not end. The hidden contract, the disputed records, and the land fraud all become part of the same larger conspiracy. Kavya keeps refusing to be treated like property or a prize, even as both family pressure and romantic rivalry intensify around her. She and her allies keep chasing original documents, survey records, and other proof before deadlines and legal threats close in. The conflict then moves into boardrooms, courts, and protected archives, where missing files and forged paperwork threaten the company’s survival. Dev’s engagement and family obligations add another layer of tension, but the central struggle stays focused on whether the truth can be exposed before the powerful side forces a settlement. By the end of the available material, Kavya is still fighting on her own terms, with the evidence hunt and the larger fraud case unresolved.

the-secret-yoddha-returns.title: The Secret Yoddha Returns
the-secret-yoddha-returns.description: Aarav, the eldest son of the powerful Suryagarh family, hides his true strength while secretly planning to avenge his mother's murder by his father and stepmother.

shani-the-dark-destiny.title: SHANI — The Dark Destiny
shani-the-dark-destiny.description: A newborn child enters the story under a terrifying prophecy that links his birth to darkness, eclipse, and danger for the celestial order. From the beginning, the court treats him as an inauspicious omen rather than a son, and fear spreads among priests, sages, servants, and rulers. Chaya stands at the center of the conflict, repeatedly shielding the child and refusing to let others define him as cursed. Surya, the solar ruler and father, initially rejects the baby, questions his legitimacy, and struggles to accept him as his own. As the child grows, the dispute shifts from the circumstances of his birth to his place in the family and the realm. The child is named Shani, but the name does not resolve the deeper rejection surrounding him. Sacred records, lineage rules, and divine law are repeatedly invoked to deny him recognition. Surya orders separation, confinement, and removal, keeping Shani away from the household and from Surya Loka. Chhaya continues to defend her son against humiliation and harm, even when the court and family authority turn against them. Shani is left to live with exclusion, hidden away and treated differently from others. He begins to ask painful questions about his father, his sacred thread, his food, and why he has been concealed for so long. Those questions expose the emotional cost of the silence around his birth. Yama and other divine figures add pressure by challenging the fairness of condemning a child before any wrongdoing. Surya, however, hardens his public denial and uses the missing family record to justify exclusion. By the end of the arc, the truth of Shani’s identity remains contested, and the family is still fractured. The central struggle remains a battle between maternal protection and divine rejection, with Shani increasingly demanding recognition through truth rather than fear.

jaadugar-ki-wapasi.title: Jaadugar Ki Wapasi
jaadugar-ki-wapasi.description: Born with extraordinary knowledge but rejected by the royal academy for his commoner status, 19-year-old Veer discovers he is the discarded true heir of the powerful Vardhan clan. Armed with unmatched genius and elemental powers, he enters the elite world that once denied him, determined to shatter its rules, defeat his jealous rivals, and prove that true greatness comes from merit—not bloodline.

even-winners-pay-the-price-2.title: Zehn perfekte Würfe
even-winners-pay-the-price-2.description: Er sitzt nur auf der Ersatzbank, bis ein uraltes übernatürliches System dem Backup-Quarterback zehn perfekte Würfe pro Tag garantiert. Doch jeder Wurf hat seinen Preis: Ein lähmender Rückschlag greift seine Nerven an. Er muss sich auf seinen Football-Verstand verlassen, das düstere Schicksal früherer Nutzer aufdecken und ein korruptes Netzwerk mächtiger Geldgeber austricksen. Kann er sein Underdog-Team aus Texas zum Meistertitel führen, bevor sein Wurfarm für immer zerstört ist?

the-wolf-queen-of-the-vampire-king-2.title: Die Wolfskönigin
the-wolf-queen-of-the-vampire-king-2.description: Astrid begins as a publicly shamed outcast in a harsh wolf-pack world, where rejection, restraint, and exile strip her of status and safety. She is framed with poison, accused of murder, and abandoned by the people who should have protected her. Cale and Ronan repeatedly fail her in different ways, while Ingrid uses the power vacuum to push Astrid out and claim influence. When Astrid is driven away wounded and believing her wolf is gone, Lucien Vayer, the Vampire King, rescues her and shelters her by a lakeside house. There she learns that her wolf was not lost, but sealed away by silver and trauma, and Lucien helps her begin to recover. Her survival story then turns into one of transformation, as blood rituals, training, and painful recovery awaken hidden strength and force her to confront what was done to her. As Astrid grows stronger, the conflict widens into pack and court politics, with challenges to authority, public humiliation, and repeated attempts to control her through bonds, chains, and ritual. She refuses easy forgiveness, especially from those who stayed silent while she suffered. Instead of returning to submission, she sabotages, challenges, and eventually wins formal contests that shift the balance of power. Across these struggles, Lucien remains both protector and political liability, because his bond with Astrid draws court hostility and succession pressure. The story then expands into royal intrigue, where Astrid and Lucien face trials, accusations, and a murder case that is really part of a larger conspiracy. Evidence of poison, planted blades, missing witnesses, and hidden records suggests that the truth has been deliberately buried. Astrid learns that her mother’s death was tied to a royal decree and that years of silence have protected the wrong people. Lucien’s own past is also exposed, including hidden identity, family rejection, and a childhood poisoning that shaped his weakness. Together, they form a fragile alliance around truth, blood, and survival, even as the court tries to force them apart. By the end of the arc, Astrid is no longer only a victim or exile; she is a defiant force demanding justice, repayment, and answers. The stakes remain personal and political at once, because uncovering the conspiracy could cost them their lives, their bond, and the future of the throne.

la-revanche-de-la-louve.title: La Revanche de la Louve
la-revanche-de-la-louve.description: Après que ses deux cruels compagnons loups ont brisé sa louve intérieure et l’ont bannie dans les étendues glacées, une paria anéantie survit en scellant un pacte de sang avec un roi vampire. Devenue une puissante hybride, elle revient pour voir ses anciens amants la supplier de leur pardonner.

the-female-lead-is-the-strongest-mouthpi.title: The Female Lead is the Strongest Mouthpiece Substitute
the-female-lead-is-the-strongest-mouthpi.description: The microdrama centers on Jang Sun-sun, a sharp-witted woman entangled in a marriage of convenience with CEO Dong Fang Mo, a union initially driven by pragmatism or corporate necessity, and later revealed to be rooted in a forgotten shared childhood kidnapping trauma. Their combative relationship is constantly tested by external pressures and internal family strife. Jang Sun-sun frequently seeks divorce, but circumstances, including corporate appearances and the dying wishes of the powerful matriarch, Nanamma, compel the couple to maintain their pretense. A central conflict involves Jang Sun-sun's critically ill sister, Jiang Yuan Yuan, whose need for rare blood unravels deep family secrets, including their father's past sacrifice and exploitation. This fuels an intense sibling rivalry between Jang Sun-sun and Jiang Yuan Yuan, often over Dong Fang Mo's affections and accusations of betrayal. Meanwhile, Dong Fang Mo's avaricious brother, Dong-Fang Ji, relentlessly schemes to usurp his elder brother's power within the influential Dongfang Group, leading to escalating corporate feuds and betrayals. Jang Sun-sun faces accusations and threats, but also finds protection from a mysterious figure, Jong Shensis. The family matriarch, Nanamma, exerts immense pressure, even attempting to force Jang Sun-sun to consume sedative-laced wine, and later collapses into a coma, revealing past sacrifices and betrayals. Amidst these power struggles, Jang Sun-sun, a wealthy heiress, is brutally kidnapped for ransom, sparking determined rescue missions and vows of revenge from Dong Fang Mo and his family. Dong Fang Mo makes significant sacrifices, including forfeiting his corporate succession, to protect Jang Sun-sun, even as his own illegitimacy is revealed. The narrative culminates in a grand celebration where Jang Sun-sun, now identified as Dongfang Moti, is unveiled as a formidable heiress poised to chair the powerful Dongfang Group, suggesting a resolution to the corporate and familial power struggles. However, hints of a meta-narrative and blurring reality suggest that the true nature of events, and the future, remain uncertain.

demons-blood.title: Demons Blood
demons-blood.description: Desperate to save his dying son,Ehan his father Arjun awakens an ancient blood-hungry deity with his own sacrifice and uses its dark blessing to build a vast fortune. Years later, when his reckless son squanders the empire, he begins secretly feeding vulnerable patients from their own hospital to the creature in exchange for gold. But when the horrified father tries to stop him and is thrown into the deity’s cursed pond, their pact unleashes an ancestral horror.

jaadugar-rajkumar.title: Jaadugar Rajkumar
jaadugar-rajkumar.description: When the most powerful mage of Aryavarta refuses to become his father's weapon of conquest, he abandons his royal identity and chooses a life away from war—but when his past catches up with him in Himgarh and threatens the people he loves, Karan is forced to reveal that the humble man everyone underestimated is actually the missing Yuvraj of Aryavarta.

alien-preyasi.title: Alien Preyasi
alien-preyasi.description: Sandeep is a struggling shop owner and repairman whose life is already under severe pressure from debt collectors, especially Ranga, who publicly humiliates him and threatens to take his shop and papers. In the middle of this crisis, Sandeep hides a mysterious injured young woman, first known as Thara and later called Tara, and refuses to let outsiders or even his own family send her away. She will not go to a hospital, insists on secrecy, and repeatedly says she needs electricity, which makes her presence even harder to explain. The household is forced to invent cover stories as neighbors grow suspicious and gossip spreads, putting family honor at risk. Sandeep’s mother and other family members worry about disgrace, police trouble, and the danger of sheltering an unknown woman. Gopi watches the strange events closely and becomes increasingly suspicious of what is really happening in the shop and home. Thara’s condition is not ordinary: she reacts to darkness, blue light appears around her, and she seems to understand damaged machinery and electrical faults in ways that surprise everyone. The repair shop itself becomes the center of both the financial struggle and the mystery, with a damaged board, a tablet, and a machine that seems to signal or whisper. Thara’s unusual technical insight helps with repairs, but it also deepens the fear that she is connected to something beyond the household’s understanding. As pressure from Ranga intensifies, the secret becomes more dangerous, and the shop is eventually shut down. In the later part of the story, a strange incident involving a power surge, metallic sound, and failed transmission suggests that Tara’s arrival is tied to a larger hidden event. She cannot fully explain who she is or where she came from, even saying she came from the sky. Sandeep’s protectiveness grows stronger, and his bond with her becomes more emotionally charged, even as she begins to believe she may be the cause of the trouble around her. Ranga returns as a direct threat to her safety, making it clear that her presence is not just a family secret but a real danger. The family tries to hold together under suspicion, fear, and rumor while Tara remains caught between wanting answers and wanting to leave. By the end of the batch, the central conflicts remain unresolved: Sandeep’s shop is in jeopardy, Tara’s identity is still hidden, and the truth behind her strange powers and arrival is only beginning to surface.

born-to-be-the-villain.title: Born to be the Villain
born-to-be-the-villain.description: Yang Lin gets transported into a game world, where he chooses to become a Super Villain instead of a hero’s sidekick. Armed with a powerful system, irresistible charm, and supernatural abilities, he turns the original storyline upside down. As he crushes heroes, wins heroines, and unlocks powerful rewards, Yang Lin proves one thing: in his world, villains write the rules!

step-sister-stole-my-diamond-empire-6.title: La Reina de los Diamantes
step-sister-stole-my-diamond-empire-6.description: Alice begins as a gifted artisan whose work is repeatedly stolen, dismissed, or credited to Beatrice and the Hamilton power structure. The first phase centers on a stolen blue Kashmir diamond and the way Barbara’s control of the company, trust fund, and workshop keeps Alice trapped in silence. Even when Alice is humiliated in public, she keeps proving her skill by correcting gemstone work, defending her mother’s legacy, and challenging false claims in front of witnesses. Daniel Sorandos becomes an important outside judge of the stones and a source of leverage, while Jacob quietly helps Alice shift from survival to strategy. As the conflict widens, the fight is no longer only about credit but about inheritance, legal authority, and who truly owns the Hamilton name and assets. Public inspections, appraisals, and legal standoffs expose fake stones, forged claims, and the collapse of Beatrice’s polished image. Alice then uncovers hidden documents, including a true will and other proof that overturn Barbara’s authority and reveal the inheritance scheme. The family’s financial position deteriorates rapidly as loans, mortgages, and blocked accounts leave the rivals exposed. Barbara responds with increasingly desperate measures, but each attempt only deepens the scandal and strengthens the case against her side. Alice’s return to the center of the story is marked by her ability to produce proof, reclaim control of the estate, and force others out as their authority evaporates. The gemstone trade itself becomes the arena where reputation is won or destroyed, with auctions, cutting trials, and public reviews serving as tests of legitimacy. Beatrice repeatedly tries to dominate elite society through bold deals and public performance, but her claims are steadily undermined. Alice’s technical mastery, especially her ability to identify faults and prove authenticity, becomes the key to her rise. The scandal eventually reaches a public breaking point, with investors, buyers, and reporters watching the Hamilton empire unravel. Barbara is exposed as part of a long-running fraud and loses control of the company and family assets. Beatrice is also stripped of credibility as her authorship and designer status are challenged and rejected. By the end, Alice is publicly restored as the rightful heir and skilled artisan, while the Hamilton empire is forcibly reset under new leadership.

suryaputhran.title: Suryaputhran
suryaputhran.description: An abandoned boy raised as a humble carpenter discovers that he is the long-lost son of a royal family and possesses the divine powers of Surya Dev. When a ruthless enemy threatens his newly reunited family and unleashes a monstrous force against the kingdom, Suraj must embrace his true identity as the chosen successor to the Rajaon Ke Raja and rise as the legendary warrior destined to defeat the darkness.

the-poor-autowalas-royal-secret.title: The Poor Autowala's Royal Secret
the-poor-autowalas-royal-secret.description:
A poor but honest Mumbai autowala, Samar, is betrayed and humiliated by his America-return girlfriend Myra, unaware that his estranged parents are among the most powerful people in the world.

As Samar fights for his dignity and finds love in Ishita, a shocking royal secret about his billionaire father and RAW Chief mother turns his life upside down.

hello-senior.title: Hello Senior.!
hello-senior.description: తొలి చూపులోనే తన సీనియర్  మీరాను చూసి మనసు పారేసుకున్నాడు ఆర్య, జూనియర్ అని తెలిసి కూడా ఆర్య ప్రేమలో మీరా పడుతుందా? ఎంతో ప్రశాంతంగా సాగుతున్న కాలేజ్ వాతావరణం మొత్తం వికాస్, నక్షత్రల సూసైడ్ తో ఒక్కసారిగా ఉలిక్కిపడింది..! ఆ సూసైడ్ లకు, ఆర్య మీరాలకు ఏమైనా సంబంధం ఉందా? తమ మధ్యలో ఏర్పడిన ఎన్నో అవాంతరాలను అధిగమించి ఆర్య, మీరా ఒక్కటి అవ్వగలిగారా? ఇవన్నీ తెలియాలి అంటే వినెయ్యండి Hello Senior..!

ring-ka-sikandar.title: Ring Ka Sikandar
ring-ka-sikandar.description: Boxing God follows Roku, a humble cleaner hiding godlike strength after a childhood tragedy. When corrupt rivals, deadly Titans, and supernatural forces threaten the woman he loves and everything he holds sacred, Roku must overcome his fear and embrace his true identity as the Golden Warrior. His ultimate battle is not just to defeat his enemies, but to prove that true power lies in protecting others—not destroying them.

the-last-delivery.title: The Last Delivery
the-last-delivery.description: పేదరికం వల్ల భార్య చేత అవమానించబడి, వదిలేయబడిన ఒక పేద ఫుడ్ డెలివరీ బాయ్... తన నానమ్మ సాంప్రదాయ వంటల అనుభవాన్ని ఉపయోగించి ఒక విప్లవాత్మక ఫుడ్ బిజినెస్‌ ప్రారంభించి తనను తాను నిరూపించుకోవాలనుకుంటాడు. కానీ, బలీయమైన కార్పొరేట్ కంపెనీలు అతని ఐడియాను దొంగిలించి, అతను నిర్మించుకున్న సమాజానికే ముప్పుగా మారినప్పుడు—అతను కేవలం విజయం కోసం మాత్రమే కాకుండా, తన గుర్తింపు, వారసత్వం మరియు తనను నమ్మిన ప్రజల కోసం ఎలా పోరాడాడు అనేదే ఈ కథ.

love-and-century.title: Love and Century
love-and-century.description: After catching her fiancé cheating, a powerful Mumbai heiress, Meenakshi, impulsively enters a contract marriage with a struggling cricketer, Rajvardhan, to save his dying mother—only to unknowingly become the wife of the very man she later humiliates and destroys after he is framed for betrayal. As Raj fights his way back from disgrace to captaincy, the two slowly fall in love, while a dangerous conspiracy threatens to tear apart both his career and their secret marriage.

mating-in-captivity-1.title: Better Sex, Better Life
mating-in-captivity-1.description: Long term rishton mein passion kyon kam ho jata hai? Kya shaadi ke saalon baad bhi same energy zinda rakh paana mumkin hai? Kaise relationship mein wo beauty wapas laayi jaa sakti hai? Suniye ye show aur jaane apne relationship ke foundation ko stronger banane ke secrets!

good-karma-right-choices-for-tomorrow.title: Good Karma : Right Choices For Tomorrow
good-karma-right-choices-for-tomorrow.description: మన దైనందిన జీవితంలో సరైన నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకుంటూ ప్రశాంతమైన భవిష్యత్తును ఎలా నిర్మించుకోవాలో తెలిపే అద్భుతమైన మార్గదర్శిని ఇది. ప్రాచీన వేదాంత జ్ఞానాన్ని ఆధునిక జీవిత సమస్యలకు అనువర్తింపజేస్తూ, కర్మ సిద్ధాంతం వెనుక ఉన్న అసలు రహస్యాలను స్పష్టంగా వివరిస్తుంది. ప్రతికూల ఆలోచనలను జయించి, నిజమైన సంతోషం మరియు ఆధ్యాత్మిక ఎదుగుదల వైపు అడుగులు వేయడానికి ఇది ఒక అమూల్యమైన సూచిక.

a-monks-almanac-life-sutras-for-troubled.title: A Monk's Almanac: Life Sutras for Troubled Times
a-monks-almanac-life-sutras-for-troubled.description: జీవితం అనేక అనిశ్చితులు, సవాళ్లు, కష్టమైన నిర్ణయాలతో నిండి ఉంటుంది. ఇలాంటి క్లిష్ట సమయాల్లో ప్రశాంతత, ధైర్యం, స్పష్టతతో ముందుకు సాగడానికి అవసరమైన జీవిత సూత్రాలను ఈ పుస్తకం అందిస్తుంది. ఒత్తిడిని అధిగమించడం, సమస్యలను ఎదుర్కోవడం, మనసును ప్రశాంతంగా ఉంచుకోవడం, అంతర్గత శక్తిని గుర్తించడం వంటి విలువైన పాఠాలను తెలుసుకోండి. జీవితాన్ని మరింత అర్థవంతంగా, సమతుల్యంగా, ప్రశాంతంగా గడపడానికి ఈ పుస్తకం మీకు మార్గదర్శకంగా నిలుస్తుంది.

mohabbat-gumshuda.title: Mohabbat Gumshuda
mohabbat-gumshuda.description: Forced into a marriage of convenience with comatose fashion heir Ranveer Oberoi, Meera hopes her childhood love Kabir will save her. But after discovering his betrayal with Ranveer’s sister-in-law Riya and the theft of her designs, Meera fights back to protect her helpless husband and his fashion empire. Unaware that Ranveer is secretly awake and watching her struggle, she battles betrayal, ambition and a ruthless fashion war until his shocking public awakening changes everything.

india-and-the-silk-roads.title: India and the Silk Roads
india-and-the-silk-roads.description: భారతదేశం మరియు మధ్య ఆసియా దేశాల మధ్య సాగిన చారిత్రాత్మక పట్టు మార్గాల వర్తక ప్రయాణాన్ని అత్యంత ఆసక్తికరంగా ఆవిష్కరించే కథనమిది. వర్తకులు, ప్రతికూల వాతావరణం మరియు అపారమైన సంపద మార్పిడి ద్వారా రూపుదిద్దుకున్న ఆనాటి సామాజిక, ఆర్థిక విప్లవాలను వివరిస్తుంది. ప్రాచీన కాలంలో ప్రపంచ వ్యాపార రంగాన్ని శాసించిన సంస్కృతి మరియు చరిత్రను లోతుగా విశ్లేషించే ఒక అద్భుతమైన పరిశోధనాత్మక చిత్రం.

the-happiness-story-unlock-secrets-to-be.title: The Happiness Story : Unlock Secrets to Best Life
the-happiness-story-unlock-secrets-to-be.description: జీవన ప్రయాణంలో ఎదురయ్యే సవాళ్లను దాటుకుంటూ నిజమైన ఆనందాన్ని మరియు ఆత్మసంతృప్తిని ఎలా పొందాలో తెలిపే స్ఫూర్తిదాయక మార్గదర్శి. వ్యక్తిగత అనుభవాలు, సరళమైన కథనాలు మరియు ఆచరణాత్మక చిట్కాల ద్వారా ప్రతికూల ఆలోచనలను తొలగించి, సంతోషకరమైన మరియు అర్థవంతమైన జీవితాన్ని గడపడానికి కావలసిన అంతర్గత శక్తిని ఈ పుస్తకం అందిస్తుంది.

immortal-yoddha.title: Immortal Yoddha
immortal-yoddha.description: Ek accident ke baad Rudraksh jab mentally aur physically weak ho jata hai to use apne classmates aur relatives se humiliation ka samna karna padta hai. Lekin ekdin Rudraksh ke sath kuch aisa hota hai, jisse uski zindagi hamesha ke liye badal jaati hai. Use pata chalta hai ki wo immortal duniya ka ek haara hua yoddha hai, jise uski girlfriend ne hi dhokha diya hai. Ekdin college mein Rudraksh nayi teacher Sonakshi ko dekhkar shocked rah jata hai, Sonakshi hi immortal duniya mein uski girlfriend thi. Apni immortal identity jaanne ke baad kya karega Rudraksh? Kya wo lega badla apne sath hue dhokhe ka ya phir lautega Immortal duniya mein haari hui ladai jeetne ke liye?

mrityunjay-1.title: Mrityunjay
mrityunjay-1.description: Jisne banaya Sikandar ko duniya ka samrat, jisne Hiroshima mein machai tabahi, wo aa gaya hai wapis. Saalo baad apni neend se jaaga Mrityunjay. Jo hai kisi ke liye devta aur kisi ke liye shaitan, aa gaya hai wo likhne nayi dastaan.

qaatil-mera-aashiq.title: Qaatil Mera Aashiq
qaatil-mera-aashiq.description: Is Sheher Par Varun Shukla Naam Ke Ek Khatarnaak Gangster Ka Hai Raaj. Sheher Ki Hawayein Bhi Varun Shukla Ke Naam Se Khaati Hain Khauf. Logon Ke Seene Mein Dar Aur Dehshat Paida Karne Wale Varun Shukla Ki Zindagi Ko Tabaah Karne Ke liye Hoti Hai Is Khaas Shakhs Ki Entry. Gangster Ki Beti Banegi Iski Hathiyaar Aur Nishaane Par Hoga Varun Shukla. ACP Kirti Ke Tevar Se Aa Jaayega Is Kahani Mein Naya Mod. Pyar, Dhokha, Khoon, Dar Aur Badle Ki Is Kahaani Mein Kiski Hogi Jeet? Kya Hogi Qaatil Ki Asli Pehchaan? In Paheliyo'n Ko Suljhaane Ke Liye Suniye Ye Kahaani.

zeba-1.title: Zeba
zeba-1.description: న్యూయార్క్‌లో విలాసవంతమైన జీవితాన్ని గడుపుతూ, ఎవరి మాట వినని ఒక తిరుగుబాటు స్వభావం గల యువతి కథను ఈ ఫాంటసీ నవల వివరిస్తుంది. ఒక విదేశీ ప్రయాణంలో ఆమె అనుకోకుండా ఒక పవిత్రమైన జలధార ద్వారా లభించిన అద్భుతమైన అతీంద్రియ శక్తులను కనుగొంటుంది. తన సుఖవంతమైన జీవితం నుండి బయటకు వచ్చి, తన లోపాలను అధిగమిస్తూ, నల్లమందు శక్తులను ఉపయోగించే ఒక క్రూరమైన పాలకుడి నుండి తన కుటుంబాన్ని మరియు ఈ ప్రపంచాన్ని రక్షించడానికి ఆమె చేసే పోరాటాన్ని ఈ కథనం ఉత్కంఠభరితంగా ఆవిష్కరిస్తుంది.

extraordinary-dumb-son-in-law.title: Extraordinary Dumb Son-in-Law
extraordinary-dumb-son-in-law.description: This urban drama follows a young man who endured a decade of humiliation, pretending to be a mute outcast after his parents disappeared. Trapped in a marriage where his in-laws constantly mock him, he patiently bides his time until a secret agreement ends. Once the restrictions shatter, he unlocks his true inner power, breaks his long silence, and fights back against corporate rivals to reclaim his heritage and protect those who truly matter.

the-stolen-necklace.title: The Stolen Necklace
the-stolen-necklace.description: కూతురి పెళ్లి కోసం స్వగ్రామానికి వచ్చిన ఒక సాధారణ వ్యక్తి, చేయని దొంగతనం నేరంలో ఇరుక్కుని జైలుపాలవుతాడు. వ్యవస్థలోని లోపాలు, పోలీసుల నిర్లక్ష్యం వల్ల అన్యాయానికి గురైన ఆ వ్యక్తి, తన నిర్దోషిత్వాన్ని నిరూపించుకోవడానికి చేసిన సుదీర్ఘమైన మరియు సాహసోపేతమైన పోరాటం ఈ సత్య ఘటనాత్మక కథనం.

luka-chuppi.title: Luka Chuppi
luka-chuppi.description: Meera enters her new home believing she has married the man she loves, but her wedding night turns into a deadly nightmare. Trapped inside a mansion, she discovers that her husband and his family have lured her into a bloody ritual where a bride must be sacrificed to protect their fortune. Hunted by her own in-laws, Meera must turn from prey into predator before sunrise.

billionaire-hotel-servant.title: Billionaire Hotel Servant
billionaire-hotel-servant.description:
A hidden billionaire heir must live as a hotel servant for four days to prove his worth.
Humiliated, betrayed, and pushed to the edge, he fights back while uncovering dark secrets.
But when the truth is revealed, the servant rises as CEO, and everyone who doubted him falls.

love-to-hona-he-tha.title: Love To Hona He Tha
love-to-hona-he-tha.description: The story centers on a long, messy bond between Ankit and the women around him, especially Sandy, Sanvi, and later Ishani, with teasing often hiding deeper feelings. It begins with forced cohabitation and old childhood grudges, as Sandy is made to share a home with Ankit, her childhood bully, and their reunion quickly turns into hostile banter. That comic friction continues through domestic interruptions, mistaken identities, and constant intrusions into daily life. As the conflicts deepen, the show reveals more painful history, including a woman’s four-year abusive relationship and a wedding that is already set for next month. Ankit steps in as a protective presence in that crisis, but his help also carries a possessive edge that keeps his motives unclear. The tone then shifts between flirtation and suspicion during party nights, calls from mothers and aunts, and embarrassing misunderstandings about what happened the previous night. These moments keep trust fragile, because private details become public and apologies do not fully clear the air. The emotional center later moves toward Sanvi, whose closeness with Ankit grows more openly charged even while both of them keep denying what is obvious. Jealousy repeatedly interrupts that slow-burn romance, especially when another man is mentioned or when rivals try to provoke Ankit. Sanvi’s boyfriend, childhood friend, and other visitors all expose how unstable the situation is, with class resentment and possessiveness making every confrontation sharper. A birthday surprise and dinner confrontation push Ankit and Sanvi closer, and Sanvi begins to realize that his feelings are real. Even then, the pair still dodge direct confession, and the story keeps their relationship suspended between friendship and romance. Ankit’s protectiveness becomes more serious when Sanvi is ill, showing that his concern is no longer just teasing or pride. The final emotional turn comes when Ankit finally confesses his love to Ishani in a tender, celebratory setting. After years of teasing, arguments, and unspoken attachment, Ishani admits that she loves him too. The show closes on mutual affection finally spoken aloud, resolving the long tension into a confirmed romance.

highway-44.title: Highway 44
highway-44.description: At 2 a.m., a wounded girl seeks refuge at a lonely dhaba on Highway 44, unaware that her protector, Mangal, shares a mysterious past with her. As ruthless gangsters close in, Mangal fights to save her, not knowing who she truly is to him. But when the shocking truth finally comes to light, will he be able to face the reality that changes everything?

rakhigarhi-mitti-mein-dafn-itihaas.title: Rakhigarhi : Mitti mein Dafn Itihaas
rakhigarhi-mitti-mein-dafn-itihaas.description: Beneath thousands of years of soil lies a city that tells the story of India’s ancient civilization and our roots. Through the excavations at Rakhigarhi, discover the world of a civilization that built well-planned cities, traded with distant lands, and left behind mysteries that archaeologists are still trying to uncover today.

mrityunjay-the-last-healer.title: Mrityunjay - The Last Healer
mrityunjay-the-last-healer.description: जब 25 वर्षीय अजय को अचानक पता चलता है कि वह एक रहस्यमयी Healers के गुप्त कबीले का हिस्सा है—जहाँ लोग इंसानों के Aura देख सकते हैं, दर्द को अपने अंदर खींच सकते हैं, भावनाओं को नियंत्रित कर सकते हैं और यहाँ तक कि लाइलाज बीमारियों को भी ठीक कर सकते हैं—तो उसे अपनी असाधारण शक्तियों पर काबू पाना सीखना होगा। लेकिन अपने विलुप्त होते कबीले की आखिरी उम्मीद बन चुका अजय उन बेरहम Aura Eaters से कैसे बचेगा, जो उसे खत्म करने के लिए उसका शिकार कर रहे हैं

the-hidden-genius.title: The Hidden Genius
the-hidden-genius.description: Krishna, an honest orphan working at a saree shop in Karol Bagh, is falsely accused of theft and thrown onto the streets. That same stormy night, he saves the life of an old man who turns out to be India’s richest billionaire, Yashvardhan Singhania. Yashvardhan makes him the company’s Chief Advisor. Krishna’s brilliant mind exposes a 5,000 crore scam, but greedy relatives Karan and Vikram now want him dead.

billionaire-ex-wife-1.title: Billionaire Ex - Wife
billionaire-ex-wife-1.description: Anjali ne pyaar ke liye sab kuch chhod diya, lekin badle mein mila sirf dhokha, wo bhi apne hi bedroom mein. Beizzati ke saath ghar se nikal di gayi Anjali ne chup chaap sab kuch chhod diya. Par duniya ko kya pata tha ki Anjali sirf ek biwi nahi, ek billion-dollar company ki secret CEO bhi hai. Ab wo wapas aayi hai, badle ke liye nahi, apni taqat dikhane ke liye.... aur is baar, interest ke saath.

rishta-confirmed-dulha-missing.title: Rishta Confirmed Dulha Missing
rishta-confirmed-dulha-missing.description: Mahi ki zindagi ek aam ladki ki tarah chal rahi thi, jab ek din ek unexpected pregnancy ne sab kuch hila kar rakh diya. Ishan Grover—ek akadwala businessman jo sirf apni sharton par jeena jaanta tha—hamesha se ek sach se bhaagta raha: wo kabhi pita ban hi nahi sakta tha! Toh phir yeh kaise ho gaya? Kya jo rishta kabhi tha hi nahi, usse ek naya mod milne wala tha? Ya taqdeer sirf ek aur khel khel rahi thi?

balidan-para-special-forces-stories.title: Balidan : Para Special Forces Stories
balidan-para-special-forces-stories.description: దేశ రక్షణ కోసం ప్రాణాలను సైతం లెక్కచేయకుండా పోరాడిన భారతీయ పారా స్పెషల్ ఫోర్సెస్ వీరుల అసాధారణ సాహసగాథల సమాహారమిది. అత్యంత ప్రమాదకరమైన మిషన్‌లు, శత్రువుల గుండెల్లో వణుకు పుట్టించే ధైర్యసాహసాలు మరియు సైనికుల త్యాగాలను కళ్ళకు కట్టినట్లు వివరిస్తుంది. దేశభక్తి, అంకితభావం మరియు ప్రతికూల పరిస్థితుల్లో సైన్యం ప్రదర్శించే పరాక్రమాన్ని ప్రతిబింబించే అత్యంత స్పూర్తిదాయకమైన యథార్థ కథనం.

the-magic-mindset-how-to-find-your-happy.title: The Magic Mindset: How to Find Your Happy Place
the-magic-mindset-how-to-find-your-happy.description: జీవితంలో ఎలాంటి పరిస్థితులు ఎదురైనా ఆనందంగా ఉండటం ఎలా? ఈ పుస్తకంలో ప్రీతి షెనాయ్ జీవితాన్ని కొత్త కోణంలో చూడటానికి ఉపయోగపడే ఆచరణాత్మక సూత్రాలు, ఆసక్తికరమైన వ్యాయామాలు, స్ఫూర్తిదాయకమైన అనుభవాలను పంచుకుంటారు. సంబంధాలు, కెరీర్, ఆరోగ్యం, ఆర్థిక విషయాలు వంటి జీవితంలోని ప్రతి అంశంలో సానుకూల దృక్పథాన్ని పెంపొందించుకోవడం, ప్రతికూల ఆలోచనలను అధిగమించడం, ఆశతో కూడిన ఆనందకరమైన జీవితాన్ని నిర్మించుకోవడం ఎలాగో తెలుసుకోండి.

understanding-islam-its-spirit-and-value.title: Understanding Islam : Its Spirit and Values
understanding-islam-its-spirit-and-value.description: ఇస్లాం మతం యొక్క నిజమైన ఆత్మ, శాంతియుత విలువలు మరియు విశ్వజనీన సూత్రాలను సముచితంగా విశ్లేషించే కథనమిది. సామాజిక సమరసత, ఆధ్యాత్మిక లోతు మరియు తోటి మానవుల పట్ల ప్రేమను పెంపొందించే మూల సిద్ధాంతాలను ఇది స్పష్టంగా వివరిస్తుంది. అపోహలను తొలగించి, నైతిక జీవనం మరియు మానవత్వంతో కూడిన సత్య మార్గాన్ని అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి దోహదపడే ఒక అద్భుతమైన పరిశోధనాత్మక ఆలోచనాత్మక చిత్రం.

upgrade-moving-up-in-life-and-career.title: Upgrade : Moving Up In Life And Career
upgrade-moving-up-in-life-and-career.description: వృత్తిపరమైన జీవితంలో వేగంగా ఉన్నత స్థాయికి చేరుకోవడానికి అవసరమైన కార్పొరేట్ సూత్రాలు మరియు నైపుణ్యాలను విశ్లేషించే అద్భుతమైన మార్గదర్శిని ఇది. ఆఫీసు రాజకీయాలను నిర్వహించడం, సరైన సంబంధాలను నిర్మించుకోవడం మరియు నాయకత్వ లక్షణాలను పెంపొందించుకోవడం ఎలాగో వివరిస్తుంది. కెరీర్‌లో ఎదురయ్యే సవాళ్లను అధిగమించి విజయం సాధించాలనుకునే ప్రతీ ఉద్యోగికి ఇది ఒక అమూల్యమైన కార్యాచరణ ప్రణాళిక.

8-steps-to-innovation-1.title: 8 Steps to Innovation
8-steps-to-innovation-1.description: ఆవిష్కరణ అంటే కేవలం తాత్కాలిక పరిష్కారాలు లేదా జుగాడ్‌పై ఆధారపడటం కాదు. నాణ్యతతో కూడిన, శాశ్వతమైన పరిష్కారాలను రూపొందించడం. సృజనాత్మక ఆలోచనలను అర్థవంతమైన ఆవిష్కరణలుగా మార్చడానికి అవసరమైన ఎనిమిది ఆచరణాత్మక దశలను ఈ పుస్తకం వివరిస్తుంది. కొత్త అవకాశాలను గుర్తించడం, సంప్రదాయ ఆలోచనలను ప్రశ్నించడం, సవాళ్లను అధిగమించడం, సమర్థవంతమైన పరిష్కారాలను రూపొందించడం ఎలాగో తెలుసుకోండి. జుగాడ్‌ను దాటి నాణ్యత, విజయం సాధించే ఆవిష్కరణల దిశగా అడుగులు వేయండి.

mindfked-overthinking-at-4-am.title: Mindf**ked : Overthinking At 4 a.m.
mindfked-overthinking-at-4-am.description: అర్థరాత్రి వేళల్లో మనసును వెంటాడే మితిమీరిన ఆలోచనలు, మానసిక ఆందోళన మరియు భావోద్వేగ సంఘర్షణల నుండి బయటపడే మార్గాలను తెలిపే కథనమిది. సంబంధాలలో ఎదురయ్యే సందేహాలు, మనోవేదన మరియు గందరగోళాన్ని తొలగించి, జీవితంలో స్పష్టత మరియు ప్రశాంతతను ఎలా పొందాలో ఇక్కడ వివరించబడింది. మనస్సులోని గందరగోళాన్ని దూరం చేసి, స్వీయ ప్రేమ మరియు సంతోషం వైపు అడుగులు వేయించే ఒక ఆత్మీయ మార్గదర్శి.

kingfizzer-the-rise-and-fall-of-vijay-ma.title: Kingfizzer : The Rise and Fall of Vijay Mallya
kingfizzer-the-rise-and-fall-of-vijay-ma.description: విలాసవంతమైన జీవనశైలికి ప్రతీకగా నిలిచి, దేశవ్యాప్తంగా సంచలనం సృష్టించిన ఒక ప్రముఖ వ్యాపార దిగ్గజం యొక్క అద్భుతమైన ఉత్థాన పతనాల ప్రయాణమిది. భారీ ఆర్థిక సంక్షోభాలు, వ్యాపార వ్యూహాల్లో లోపాలు మరియు దేశం విడిచి వెళ్లవలసి వచ్చిన పరిస్థితుల వెనుక ఉన్న అసలు నిజాలను ఈ కథనం వివరిస్తుంది. ఆధునిక భారతీయ కార్పొరేట్ చరిత్రలో అత్యంత సంచలనాత్మకమైన పరిణామాలను లోతుగా కళ్ళకు కట్టే ఒక సత్యసంధమైన విశ్లేషణ.

just-aspire.title: Just Aspire
just-aspire.description: సాంకేతికత, వ్యాపార రంగం, ఆవిష్కరణలు భవిష్యత్తును ఎలా మలుస్తున్నాయో ఈ పుస్తకం వివరిస్తుంది. Just Aspire కొత్త ఆలోచనలు, వ్యాపార అవకాశాలు, సాంకేతిక పరిణామాలు, భవిష్యత్తుపై ఆసక్తికరమైన విశ్లేషణలను అందిస్తుంది. సంప్రదాయ ఆలోచనలకు భిన్నంగా ఆలోచించడం, మారుతున్న పరిస్థితులకు అనుగుణంగా కొత్త అవకాశాలను అందిపుచ్చుకోవడం, ఆలోచనలను కార్యరూపంలోకి తీసుకురావడం వంటి అంశాలపై పాఠకులకు అవగాహన కల్పిస్తుంది. ఆవిష్కరణలతో కూడిన భవిష్యత్తును నిర్మించుకోవడానికి స్ఫూర్తినిస్తుంది.

reboot-manage-career-breaks-return-with-.title: Reboot: Manage Career Breaks & Return with Success
reboot-manage-career-breaks-return-with-.description: ఉద్యోగంలో విరామం తీసుకున్నవారు లేదా అనుకోకుండా కెరీర్ బ్రేక్ వచ్చినవారు తిరిగి విజయం దిశగా ఎలా అడుగుపెట్టాలో తెలిపే ఆచరణాత్మక మార్గదర్శి. నైపుణ్యాలను పెంపొందించుకోవడం, నెట్‌వర్కింగ్‌ను పునర్నిర్మించుకోవడం మరియు ఇంటర్వ్యూలలో ధైర్యంగా సమాధానం ఇవ్వడానికి కావలసిన వ్యూహాలను ఇది స్పష్టంగా వివరిస్తుంది

as-far-as-the-saffron-fields.title: As Far as the Saffron Fields
as-far-as-the-saffron-fields.description: కాశ్మీర్‌లోని అందమైనప్పటికీ ఉద్రిక్తతలతో నిండిన నేపథ్యంలో సాగే ఈ కథ రహస్యాలు, ఉత్కంఠ, కుట్రలతో నిండి ఉంటుంది. పుల్వామా దాడి నేపథ్యంలో సాగే ఈ కథలో దాగి ఉన్న సంబంధాలు, అనూహ్య పరిణామాలు, చరిత్రలో కీలక ఘట్టం వెనుక ఉన్న సంక్లిష్టతలు వెలుగులోకి వస్తాయి. ప్రతి మలుపులోనూ కొత్త ప్రశ్నలను రేకెత్తిస్తూ, చివరి వరకు ఉత్కంఠను కొనసాగించే కథనం.

blood-for-blood-global-khalistan-project.title: Blood for Blood : Global Khalistan Project
blood-for-blood-global-khalistan-project.description: గత ఐదు దశాబ్దాలుగా అంతర్జాతీయ స్థాయిలో సాగుతున్న ప్రత్యేక ఉద్యమాల చరిత్ర మరియు దాని వెనుక ఉన్న రాజకీయ పరిణామాలను లోతుగా విశ్లేషించే పరిశోధనాత్మక కథనమిది. ప్రపంచ దేశాల మధ్య నడిచిన దౌత్యపరమైన వ్యూహాలు, హింసాత్మక ఘటనలు మరియు వాటి ప్రభావాలను నిష్పక్షపాతంగా వివరిస్తుంది. ఆధునిక రాజకీయ మరియు సామాజిక చరిత్రను అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి దోహదపడే ఒక అద్భుతమైన విశ్లేషణాత్మక చిత్రం.

1971-the-beginning-of-indias-cricket-gre.title: 1971: The Beginning of India's Cricket Greatness
1971-the-beginning-of-indias-cricket-gre.description: 1971 భారత క్రికెట్ చరిత్రలో ఒక మైలురాయి. వెస్టిండీస్, ఇంగ్లాండ్ వంటి దిగ్గజ జట్లపై భారత జట్టు సాధించిన చారిత్రాత్మక విజయాలు దేశ క్రికెట్‌కు కొత్త గుర్తింపును తీసుకొచ్చాయి. అజిత్ వాడేకర్ నాయకత్వం, సునీల్ గవాస్కర్ అద్భుత అరంగేట్రం, ఆటగాళ్ల అసాధారణ ప్రతిభతో భారత క్రికెట్‌లో ఒక కొత్త శకం ప్రారంభమైంది. భారత క్రికెట్ గొప్పతనానికి పునాది వేసిన ఆ మరపురాని ప్రయాణాన్ని ఈ పుస్తకం వివరిస్తుంది.

active-parenting-2.title: Active Parenting
active-parenting-2.description: పిల్లలను పెంచడం అంటే వారి అవసరాలను తీర్చడమే కాదు, ప్రతి దశలో వారిని అర్థం చేసుకుంటూ, సరైన మార్గంలో నడిపించడం కూడా. Active Parenting పిల్లలను ఆత్మవిశ్వాసం, బాధ్యత, భావోద్వేగ పరిపక్వత కలిగిన వ్యక్తులుగా తీర్చిదిద్దడానికి ఉపయోగపడే ఆచరణాత్మక సూచనలను అందిస్తుంది. తల్లిదండ్రులు, పిల్లల మధ్య బలమైన అనుబంధాన్ని పెంపొందించడం, సానుకూల ప్రవర్తనను ప్రోత్సహించడం, సమర్థవంతమైన సంభాషణను అలవర్చుకోవడం, రోజువారీ సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కోవడం వంటి అంశాలను ఈ పుస్తకం వివరిస్తుంది.

we-the-people-of-the-states-of-bharat-1.title: We The People of the States of Bharat
we-the-people-of-the-states-of-bharat-1.description: స్వతంత్ర భారతదేశంలో రాష్ట్రాల సరిహద్దులు ఎలా ఏర్పడ్డాయి మరియు వాటి వెనుక ఉన్న రాజకీయ, సామాజిక పరిణామాలను విశ్లేషించే కథనమిది. భాషా ప్రయుక్త రాష్ట్రాల ఏర్పాటు నుండి నూతన ప్రాంతాల ఆవిర్భావం వరకు దేశ అంతర్గత పటం మారిన తీరును విస్తృతంగా వివరిస్తుంది. రాజ్యాంగ నిబంధనలు మరియు పౌరుల సమైక్యత వెనుక ఉన్న చారిత్రాత్మక మార్పులను సరికొత్త కోణంలో ఆవిష్కరించే ఒక అద్భుతమైన పరిశోధనాత్మక చిత్రం.

fourth-estate-smoke-and-ashes.title: Fourth Estate Smoke And Ashes
fourth-estate-smoke-and-ashes.description: చరిత్ర పేజీలలో దాగివున్న నల్లమందు వర్తకం మరియు దాని వెనుక ఉన్న సామాజిక, ఆర్థిక పరిణామాలను లోతుగా ఆవిష్కరించే పరిశోధనాత్మక ప్రయాణమిది. ఒక కాలంలో ప్రపంచ ఆర్థిక రంగాన్ని శాసించిన ఈ వాణిజ్యం, ముఖ్యంగా ఆసియా మరియు యూరప్ దేశాల మలుపులకు ఎలా కారణమైందో వివరిస్తుంది. వ్యక్తిగత పరిశీలనలు మరియు ప్రాచీన ఆధారాలతో నాడు సమాజంపై పడిన ప్రభావాలను కళ్ళకు కట్టే అత్యంత శక్తివంతమైన చారిత్రాత్మక చిత్రం.

lost-in-the-valley-of-death-1.title: Lost In The Valley Of Death

the-silent-lie.title: The Silent Lie
the-silent-lie.description: Emily, a pregnant heiress, finds herself ensnared in a treacherous web of betrayal orchestrated by her husband, Jackson, and her sister, Sophia, who conspire to seize her vast inheritance. They cunningly stage her death as an accident, recording her 'last words' and manipulating a key figure to sign a will, believing her to be in a coma. However, Emily remains fully conscious, feigning deafness to overhear their sinister plans to transfer her empire. After miraculously surviving this initial murder attempt, she awakens with amnesia, forcing her to navigate a world rife with deceit and hidden dangers while repeatedly facing assassination attempts from various individuals, including Jackson and corporate rivals. Presumed dead, Emily makes a dramatic return to her company, igniting a high-stakes corporate war and uncovering further betrayals within her own marriage and company. She is revealed to be a master manipulator, orchestrating a meticulous counter-plot against Jackson and Sophia, using her feigned deafness as a strategic advantage. Emily uncovers evidence of Jackson's corruption and his role in her father's suspicious death, using this knowledge to blackmail him and eventually seize control of the Lee Group. Her new position, however, makes her a target for a deadly conspiracy involving Mr. Thomas's wife and Jackson, who plots to frame her for suicide. Despite her own betrayals, such as against her partner Honey, Emily meticulously fakes her demise once more to trap Jackson and Sophia. The saga culminates with Emily's shocking return, exposing her monstrous husband and his accomplice, leading to their apprehension on charges of attempted murder. Yet, their defiant threats from behind bars suggest the cycle of greed and power is far from over, with Emily's hidden pregnancy adding another layer of vulnerability and ongoing stakes.

the-samaritans.title: The Samaritans
the-samaritans.description: What begins as a reunion of friends and coworkers around a startup app and a social gathering steadily mutates into a supernatural siege that feeds on the group’s private guilt, rivalries, and buried history. Frank, Rosie, Daisy, and Eddie emerge as the core figures as ordinary tensions over funding, credit, privacy, and leadership are interrupted by a violent electronic disturbance and an unseen force that starts trapping and controlling people. The haunting quickly proves personal rather than random, with bindings, possessions, riddles, and bodily coercion seeming to react to lies, denial, and unresolved harm inside the group. Daisy and Eddie are both overtaken at different points, and the others struggle to decide whether emotional connection, confession, or ritual can bring them back. At the same time, accusations of sexual abuse and betrayal fracture any remaining trust, especially as Frank denies responsibility while Rosie presses claims and Eddie repeatedly tries to mediate. The show keeps linking these confrontations to a broader pattern in which hidden truths must be exposed, whether through forced confession sessions, recorded evidence, or supernatural punishment. The startup’s app and related research become part of the mystery, suggesting that the technology may be entangled with the entities and with hidden knowledge left by Aunt Olivia. That knowledge appears to connect the present crisis to older deaths and disappearances, including Jena’s vanishing during a surf lesson and Rosie’s confession that she once watched someone die without intervening. As wronged figures return seeking revenge or “badla,” the group is pushed toward bargains and rituals that promise freedom only if everyone holds together, even as skepticism and panic threaten to break the circle. Survival repeatedly depends on cooperation, but the pressure of guilt and fear keeps turning allies against one another. Mechanical crashes, cold confinement, disembodied voices, and roaring wet transformations make the threat feel unstable and evolving rather than containable. Several characters are forced into moral breaking points: one makes a self-sacrificial stand, another commits a bloody act in panic, and another is revealed to have traded others’ safety for personal freedom. These betrayals deepen the sense that the supernatural force is exploiting not just past wrongdoing but the group’s willingness to abandon each other under pressure. Parallel corporate and workplace settings reinforce the same dynamic, as launches, partnerships, and celebratory meetings become scenes of leverage, hostage-like confinement, reputational blackmail, and coercive demands for loyalty. Frank remains especially unstable within the ensemble’s power structure, at times host, accused, victim, possible threat, and controlling presence, which keeps the group’s center morally uncertain. By the later arc, the survivors are no longer simply trying to escape a haunting but trying to understand what debt is being collected, who has already bargained with it, and whether confession can free them or only feed the cycle. The overall show arc is a dark fusion of startup thriller and supernatural reckoning in which friendship, romance, and professional ambition are stripped down by possession and revenge. Its central stakes are survival, truth, and moral accountability: if the group cannot face what happened in the past and stop turning on each other in the present, the entities seem poised to keep using their bonds, bodies, and secrets against them.

the-legend-of-wushuang.description: Stella, a formidable Commander of the Golden Tiger Special Force, is recalled to duty to dismantle the notorious Black Fox gang. Unbeknownst to her, her sister Eva is trapped in an abusive marriage with Henry Brick, who is deeply connected to the Black Fox and involved in a sinister plot hinting at human trafficking. Stella initially believes Eva is in a beneficial marriage, but the truth of Eva's brutal torture shatters her world, prompting a vow to rescue her and destroy the Black Fox. She confronts Henry Brick at a high-society event, demanding answers and threatening severe consequences. Stella then crashes further elite gatherings, facing public accusations but ultimately revealing her true identity as the formidable Great General, turning the tables on her adversaries. Henry boasts of Eva's critical state, intensifying Stella's resolve. As the enigmatic Great General and Divine Master, Stella systematically dismantles the empires of corrupt leaders within Silver Wing, seeking retribution and answers for Eva's suffering. Her identity is challenged by imposters, and she must prove her legitimacy, often through the legendary Phoenix Sword. However, this sword shatters, unleashing catastrophe and leading to accusations of treason against Stella. A ruthless mastermind, Briana, leverages Eva, leading to her tragic death, forcing Stella to sacrifice her own life force to resurrect her sister, leaving Stella severely weakened. The Silver Wing Kingdom then faces escalating internal and external threats, with the North Duke, the King's uncle, orchestrating a treacherous coup to seize the throne. Stella is falsely accused of treason and the King is imprisoned. The King bestows the mythical Golden Wing Sword upon Stella, but it is sealed, and the North Duke demands the sacrifice of Stella's beloved sister, Eva, to unseal it. Despite Eva's patriotic willingness to die, her sacrifice leaves the Golden Wing Sword inactive, revealing further manipulation by the North Duke and Chacha Ji, who seek the throne. Ultimately, Stella, bearing a mysterious Phoenix mark, is revealed as the true heir to Hell Palace by her father, Master Hades, who exposes a vast conspiracy against their homeland. Now the undisputed Master of Hell Palace, Stella vows relentless retribution against all traitors.
